title: Heiress Meets Boyfriend's Parents
description: A wealthy heiress brings expensive gifts to meet her boyfriend's mother for the first time, only to face unexpected humiliation.
context:
Title: Heiress Meets Boyfriend's Parents
Description: A wealthy heiress brings expensive gifts to meet her boyfriend's mother for the first time, only to face unexpected humiliation.

INT. GU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

GU MOTHER arranges elegant gift boxes on the coffee table. GU QINGCHENG sits nearby, twisting her fingers.

GU MOTHER
Qingcheng, your father insisted. The bird's nest is from his supplier, the snow lotus is certified wild Tianshan, and the jewelry—well, you know his taste. It's his way of showing care.

GU QINGCHENG
(quietly)
Mom, Linfeng's family lives modestly. All this... won't it seem like I'm trying to buy their approval?

GU MOTHER
You're meeting his mother, not a business rival. Show respect. That's all.

GU QINGCHENG
(hesitating)
He said she values... substance over display.

GU MOTHER
Then she'll appreciate quality. Just be your genuine self.
(patting Qingcheng's hand)
I'll arrive after my meeting. Don't look so worried.

GU MOTHER stands, squeezes GU QINGCHENG's shoulder, and exits. GU QINGCHENG stares at the gifts, then carefully adds a small, worn recipe book to the pile before gathering everything.
continuation:
EXT. GARDEN RESTAURANT ENTRANCE - DAY

LINFENG waits in a slightly worn but pressed suit, checking his phone nervously.

GU QINGCHENG approaches, struggling with multiple bags. LINFENG immediately moves to help.

GU QINGCHENG
Linfeng, I brought a few things. My family means well, but—

LINFENG
(interrupting gently)
My mom cares about you, not what's in the bags. Though I do see your grandmother's recipe book. Smart touch.

GU QINGCHENG
You noticed.

LINFENG
That's the Qingcheng I know. Come on.

LINFENG leads GU QINGCHENG into the restaurant.

INT. RESTAURANT PRIVATE ROOM - DAY

LINFENG'S MOTHER sits in a simple wool coat, hands folded, expression unreadable.

LINFENG and GU QINGCHENG enter. GU QINGCHENG extends her hand.

GU QINGCHENG
Mrs. Chen. Thank you for inviting me.

LINFENG'S MOTHER
(doesn't take her hand)
You're Gu Qingcheng. The only daughter of Gu Enterprises.

GU QINGCHENG
Yes, but—

LINFENG'S MOTHER
(cuts her off)
Turn around.

LINFENG starts to speak but she silences him with a glance.

LINFENG'S MOTHER
Let me see the girl who arrives bearing gifts worth more than my annual salary.

GU QINGCHENG'S face flushes with shame. She turns slowly.

LINFENG'S MOTHER
(leaning forward, voice low and cutting)
Slender waist, delicate hands, a body shaped by private trainers and privileged ease. My son works seventy-hour weeks. What could you possibly know about his life?

GU QINGCHENG stands frozen as the words land like blows. The lavish gifts on the table now look like accusations.

title: Rise to the Peak After Devaluation
description: A man killed by a rich driver is reborn into a world where global currency has devalued by a million times, making his small savings worth a fortune.
context:
Title: Rise to the Peak After Devaluation
Description: A man killed by a rich driver is reborn into a world where global currency has devalued by a million times, making his small savings worth a fortune.

ON SCREEN: DEVALUATION - RISE TO THE PEAK

EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

A black Mercedes speeds in, stopping with a sharp drift. The EX-GIRLFRIEND, dressed in luxury, emerges and slaps ZHOU SHENG.

EX-GIRLFRIEND
You think I'd have cheated if you weren't broke?

ZHOU SHENG
Lanlan, just listen—

The RICH SECOND GEN sneers from inside the car.

The EX-GIRLFRIEND shoves ZHOU SHENG onto the hood. The RICH SECOND GEN laughs, watching.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

ZHOU SHENG walks on, shattered. His MOTHER chases after him, clutching a handmade sweater.

MOTHER
Son... please. Mom made this for you. Winter's coming.

A red sports car screams toward them.

MOTHER
(screaming)
Ah!

ZHOU SHENG and MOTHER collapse in a pool of blood. The DRIVER and FEMALE COMPANION step out, shaken.

FEMALE COMPANION
(terrified)
He's... he's dead.

DRIVER
(coldly)
Dead poor people don't sue. It's cheaper than injuries. Let's go.

They drive away.

MOTHER
(weakly)
Save my son...

ZHOU SHENG lies there, eyes burning with rage and regret.
continuation:
INT. DARK SPACE - NIGHT

Voices echo in ZHOU SHENG'S mind.

EX-GIRLFRIEND (V.O.)
If you weren't broke...

DRIVER (V.O.)
...poor people don't sue.

The word "POOR" appears large.

MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)
Seek vengeance? The world mocks your worth. I grant you true value.

The accident rewinds.

ON SCREEN: Global prices collapse 1,000,000x. Your money stays the same. What do you do?

EXT. STREET - DAY

ZHOU SHENG rides an electric scooter, determined. A BEGGAR stops him.

BEGGAR
Spare change, brother?

ZHOU SHENG
No, sorry.

ZHOU SHENG hands him a one-yuan coin.

BEGGAR
(shocked)
A whole yuan?! I can buy a house!

The BEGGAR runs off ecstatic. ZHOU SHENG stares, bewildered.

INT. BANK - DAY

ZHOU SHENG walks into Yueyi Bank with a cloth bag. Security guards block him.

SECURITY GUARD 1
Stinking beggar. This isn't your hangout. Get lost.

SECURITY GUARD 2
Another AC leech. So annoying.

ZHOU SHENG
(firmly)
I'm here to deposit money.

title: Baby's Wild Ride Episode 1
description: A woman betrayed by her family gives birth in secret, loses her child, and is forced to take the fall for her sister's crimes, vowing revenge from prison.
context:
Title: Baby's Wild Ride Episode 1
Description: A woman betrayed by her family gives birth in secret, loses her child, and is forced to take the fall for her sister's crimes, vowing revenge from prison.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

SONG YUAN lies on the bed, screaming in pain, giving birth.

MRS. SONG and SONG XIYUE rush into the room.

MRS. SONG
(contemptuous)
Screaming won't erase your disgrace. You couldn't even name the father.

SONG YUAN
(agonized)
I don't... remember. Just save my baby.

MRS. SONG
A bastard has no place in the Song family.

SONG YUAN lets out a piercing scream. The BABY'S CRY is cut short.

FADE TO BLACK.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - LATER

SONG YUAN lies weakly on the bed, arm outstretched toward an empty bassinet.

SONG YUAN
Where... where is he?

MRS. SONG
(turning away)
Gone. Some things are better lost.

SONG YUAN's face shows shock and despair as she sees the empty bassinet.

INT. SONG FAMILY MANSION - DAY

SONG YUAN, wearing a thin coat, confronts MRS. SONG and SONG XIYUE.

SONG YUAN
Why am I being arrested for Xiyue's fraud?

MRS. SONG
You signed the documents. Repay your shame this way.

SONG XIYUE
(not looking up)
You're only ruining us. This makes you useful.

A POLICE OFFICER enters and handcuffs SONG YUAN.

INT. PRISON - DAY

SONG YUAN, in prison uniform, scrubs floors.

A PRISON GUARD watches, then deliberately knocks over a cleaning bucket.

PRISON GUARD
Pick that up, Song. You're nothing special here.

The GUARD walks away. SONG YUAN's jaw tightens, but she bends to clean the spill.

EXT. CAR WASH - DAY

SONG YUAN, in dirty work clothes, sits by a lamppost, looking dejected but determined.

SONG YUAN (V.O.)
For every night I spent wondering if he's still breathing... you'll pay.

SONG YUAN's eyes sharpen with cold, calculated determination.

title: Supreme Prince Consort
description: A modern bioengineer dies from experimental serum overload and awakens in the body of a prince targeted for castration—his own research may be the key to survival.
context:
Title: Supreme Prince Consort
Description: A modern bioengineer dies from experimental serum overload and awakens in the body of a prince targeted for castration—his own research may be the key to survival.

INT. PRINCE OF ZHENBEI'S MANOR - NIGHT

Dark clouds veil the full moon, casting shadows across orange lanterns swaying beneath the eaves.

QIN FEIYANG lies rigid on a rosewood bed, silk sheets tangled at his waist. His eyes move frantically beneath closed lids.

QIN FEIYANG (V.O.)
(intellectual panic)
Song dynasty dagger pattern. I've studied enough metallurgy to know this isn't a normal dream—

ASSASSIN A checks Qin Feiyang's pulse.

ASSASSIN A
The meng-hun powder should hold three hours. Young Master wants him conscious for the procedure.

ASSASSIN B produces a curved dagger.

ASSASSIN B
Five hundred taels for a surgical cut. Don't disappoint the client.

QIN FEIYANG (V.O.)
(sudden clarity)
Procedure? Client? That's not historical accuracy—

QIN FEIYANG's eyes snap open. He registers the blade.

QIN FEIYANG
(disoriented cadence)
This body—it's been drugged!

He rolls sideways, silk robe twisting around him, and crashes to the floor.

QIN FEIYANG
(panicked authority)
Treason! Guards! Anyone with a sword!

The assassins freeze—this wasn't the mission profile.

A shadow detaches from the rafters. ZHENG FENG lands silently, sword already in motion.

ZHENG FENG
(cold)
You're not the only ones on retainer.

He fights with clinical precision—disarming, disabling. In five moves, both assassins kneel with broken wrists.

ZHENG FENG
(not turning)
Your late mother hired me. I'm the monthly expense you never questioned.

QIN FEIYANG clutches the bedpost as his vision splits: ancient tapestry overlaid with lab safety posters.

CUT TO:
continuation:
INT. BIOENGINEERING LAB - DAY

A modern man in surgical scrubs injects a glowing violet serum. Monitors scream warnings. He clutches his chest, foam and blood mixing—neurological cascade.

BACK TO:

INT. PRINCE OF ZHENBEI'S MANOR - NIGHT

QIN FEIYANG gasps as the memory slots into place. He touches his throat, his hands—no scars, no calluses.

QIN FEIYANG
(half-laugh)
I died... and my consciousness propagated? The quantum decay alone—

ZHENG FENG
(studying him)
Your Highness?

QIN FEIYANG
(recovering mask)
Philosophical musing.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
(sharp authority)
Imperial decree for Prince Zhenbei! Attend immediately!

FADE OUT.

title: The Dragon Doctor Son-in-Law
description: A legendary battlefield surgeon returns after six years to find his wife forced to humiliate him at a lavish banquet, where a powerful rival threatens their daughter's life.
context:
Title: The Dragon Doctor Son-in-Law
Description: A legendary battlefield surgeon returns after six years to find his wife forced to humiliate him at a lavish banquet, where a powerful rival threatens their daughter's life.

INT. LUXURIOUS BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

LIN YIYI (second daughter of the Lin Group) wears a crimson evening gown and a jeweled crown, walking alongside LIU SHAO (eldest son of the Liu family). They approach XUANYUAN YINGXIONG (a scarred vagrant in a worn military coat).

Suddenly, a glass of red wine is poured over XUANYUAN YINGXIONG's head. The vintage runs down his face.

GUESTS laugh mockingly.

LIN YIYI
(contemptuously)
'72 Lafite. You've never even tasted it, have you? My parting gift.

XUANYUAN YINGXIONG
(quietly)
You once said that name belonged to a hero.

LIN YIYI
Humiliate you? How could it ever be enough? Six years of whispers that I married a phantom. Liu Shao has given me what you never could—a future. As for you, since you disappeared for six years, why didn't you just die out there? It would save you from dirtying my sight here.

LIU SHAO embraces LIN YIYI from behind and whispers in her ear.

LIU SHAO
Sign the papers. Or that brat in the hospital discovers how fragile life support can be.

LIN YIYI's expression changes. After a moment of hesitation, she slowly leans toward LIU SHAO. XUANYUAN YINGXIONG watches helplessly, his eyes filled with pain. A surgical scar on his hand catches the light.

LIN YIYI
(turning to XUANYUAN YINGXIONG)
Go. The lawyers will find you.

XUANYUAN YINGXIONG
(his voice low, dangerous)
I see the chains now.

He walks away, leaving wet footprints on marble.
continuation:
EXT. UNDER THE OVERPASS - DAY (SIX YEARS AGO)

FLASHBACK:

Young XUANYUAN YINGXIONG lies on the ground in tattered clothes, blood seeping through a field dressing on his arm. A worn military coat covers him.

Young LIN YIYI walks down the steps, sees him, and crouches down.

LIN YIYI
(calling softly)
Hey. You're bleeding.

XUANYUAN YINGXIONG wakes with a start and sits up alertly.

LIN YIYI
(gently)
Easy. I'm a medical volunteer. Let me help.

She produces a sterile packet from her bag and begins dressing his wound.

LIN YIYI
What's your name?

XUANYUAN YINGXIONG
Xuanyuan Yingxiong.

LIN YIYI
(encouragingly)
A name for a ghost. I'm Lin Yiyi. Ghosts have a way of finding me.

She presses a silk scarf into his palm. His fingers close around it. A glimmer of light flashes in his eyes.

title: Mr. Gu's Secret Criminal Wife
description: A woman serves as a living blood bank for her husband's true love, only to have her pregnancy dismissed and destroyed by the man she married.
context:
Title: Mr. Gu's Secret Criminal Wife
Description: A woman serves as a living blood bank for her husband's true love, only to have her pregnancy dismissed and destroyed by the man she married.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The hospital corridor compresses into controlled chaos. NURSES and DOCTORS surge forward with XIAO YUE on a gurney, her white dress soaked crimson at the abdomen.

NURSE
Make way, make way!

GU YANCHEN keeps pace beside the gurney, his hand on Xiao Yue's shoulder. His other hand grips a phone like a weapon.

GU YANCHEN
Xiao Yue!

The emergency room doors swallow them whole.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR ANOTHER AREA - DAY

GU YANCHEN paces with predatory intensity, phone welded to his ear. He checks his watch: 11:47 PM.

GU YANCHEN
(angry)
What good is a mobile blood bank that doesn't answer when her one purpose is needed?

GU YANCHEN
(shouting into phone)
Where are you? Answer me.

HAN CHUYAO (O.S.)
I was at the research lab, my phone was on silent—I'm here—

GU YANCHEN
(interrupting)
Fifth floor emergency room. Now.

GU YANCHEN hangs up. HAN CHUYAO appears at the far end of the corridor, running full tilt.
continuation:
INT. EMERGENCY ROOM ENTRANCE - DAY

HAN CHUYAO runs to the emergency room entrance where GU YANCHEN is waiting.

GU YANCHEN
(impatiently)
Why did it take you so long?

A NURSE comes out pushing a medical cart, preparing to draw blood from HAN CHUYAO for testing.

GU YANCHEN
(to the nurse)
Bombay phenotype negative. She's the only match. Draw what the surgical team requests.

HAN CHUYAO looks at GU YANCHEN, something breaking behind her eyes.

MONTAGE

title: Post-2000s Dad's Wild Parenting Style

context:
Title: Post-2000s Dad's Wild Parenting Style
Description: A young man travels through time, becomes a father to an 8-year-old son, and joins a parenting reality show where he challenges traditional education methods with his gaming-friendly approach.

INT. GAMING ROOM - DAY

Quick cuts: RGB lights syncing to a quiet hum. A gaming chair still warm. Code on a monitor shifts to a child's screensaver.

KUNHUN (O.S.)
Dad. You promised me a study desk. This is a gaming throne.

KUNHUN pulls AICHEN's hand, his expression caught between hope and disappointment. AICHEN (25, eyes still adjusting to this timeline) looks at the setup like it's evidence in a trial.

A CAMERAMAN edges into frame, capturing the moment.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Education Master System initialized. Current reputation: 0. Demonstrate your philosophy.

A translucent UI materializes: [REPUTATION: 0]. It highlights Kunhun's frayed backpack strap, the tell of weight carried.

AICHEN
(stunned whisper)
Philosophy?

AICHEN (V.O.)
In my past life, screens were the enemy. Eighteen years of digital exile meant freedom tasted like regret. I won't build his cage from the same keys.

AICHEN looks at Kunhun. Sees the kid he could have been.

AICHEN
Desk upgrade pending. Homework—show me the damage.

KUNHUN extracts a workbook, every answer correct but the pages thin from eraser burn.

AICHEN
You did the work. You kept the promise.

He sets the book down with respect, not dismissal.

AICHEN
Now I keep mine. One mission.

KUNHUN
(suspiciously)
This is a loyalty test. For the cameras.

AICHEN
(hands him a controller)
This is a trust fall. I'll catch you.

CAMERAMAN
We're live in ninety seconds.

AICHEN
Perfect. We'll show them the tutorial.

He helps Kunhun into the co-pilot chair. They load a cooperative puzzle game. Problem-solving, not violence.
continuation:
INT. STUDIO - DAY

HOST XIAO SA faces the audience and panel.

XIAO SA
"Parenting Done Right." Three methods. One million yuan. Your vote decides which child gets the future you trust.

The central screen illuminates.

INT. ZHANG YAN'S HOME - DAY

ZHANG YAN mops with metronomic intensity. Daughter ZI HAN writes, flinching at every splash.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

AUDIENCE MEMBER A (Female)
She sacrifices everything.

OBSERVER A (Female)
Everything includes her daughter's focus.

AUDIENCE MEMBER B (Female)
I saw the girl lose her place three times.

The screen transitions.

INT. WANG LEI'S HOME - DAY

WANG LEI stands over son WANG ZIXUAN, who's clutching a phone like a lifeline.

WANG LEI
(shouting)
Run! Run from your potential! Run!

Zixuan runs. Not away—he runs stairs. Punishment laps. His face is stone.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

AUDIENCE MEMBER C (Male)
Tough love built our generation.

OBSERVER B (Female)
Tough love, or just tough?

AUDIENCE MEMBER B (Female)
First was love through labor. Second, love through fear. What could possibly be third?

The screen reveals Aichen and Kunhun.

INT. GAMING ROOM - DAY

AICHEN and KUNHUN wear headsets, but their eyes meet across the monitors. Their game—a city builder—requires planning, resource management, compromise.

KUNHUN
(into mic)
Dad, if I zone the residential wrong, the whole simulation collapses.

AICHEN
(into mic)
Then we rezone. Failure's just data.

The system UI pulses: [REPUTATION +250].

KUNHUN
Will this hurt my chances at... the good schools?

AICHEN
You're building a functional economy at eight. I'd say you're auditing college courses.

KUNHUN
(laughs)
Can we put a skate park in the university quad?

AICHEN
Design it for the kid you are. Not the resume they want.

The system UI glows: [MILESTONE: Authentic Play].

INT. STUDIO - DAY

The footage freezes on Kunhun's face—alive, deciding.

XIAO SA
Sacrifice. Authority. Or... collaboration?

OBSERVER A
The boy's hands move with purpose. Not escape.

AUDIENCE C
My son is asking me what game that is.

XIAO SA
Vote now. But remember—one child wins the fund. A million children watch the lesson.

INT. GAMING ROOM - DAY

Kunhun saves his progress. Logs off. No argument.

KUNHUN
Dad? That was the best homework ever.

AICHEN
System, status.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
[REPUTATION: 1,850]. Not trending. Enduring.

Aichen watches Kunhun drift toward bed, already sketching tomorrow's build.

AICHEN (V.O.)
Maybe the best parenting isn't a system to game.

He turns off the rig. The RGB fades to a single nightlight.

AICHEN (V.O.)
It's a campaign we choose to play together.

FADE OUT.

title: A Suona Shakes Heaven and Earth
description: Lin Chuan, a legendary musician known as the Music God, survives a car accident only to return three years later to find traditional music under threat from foreign rivals.
context:
Title: A Suona Shakes Heaven and Earth
Description: Lin Chuan, a legendary musician known as the Music God, survives a car accident only to return three years later to find traditional music under threat from foreign rivals.

INT. CONCERT HALL STAGE - NIGHT

Darkness. A spotlight ignites, cutting through swirling smoke. LIN CHUAN (30s, calloused hands, intense focus) emerges, raising a gleaming suona.

CLOSE-UP - LIN CHUAN's fingers dance across the instrument's holes with practiced precision.

The suona BLARES to life - a soaring, defiant melody that commands the hall.

INT. CONCERT HALL AUDIENCE - NIGHT

The house is packed. In the front row, MATSUSHITA SHAEKO (40s, elegant, granite composure) watches Lin Chuan's technique, her eyes sharp and assessing.

INT. CONCERT HALL STAGE - NIGHT

Lin's performance builds to a climax, every muscle coiled. The final note hangs, piercing and perfect.

He lowers the suona, breathing hard.

The audience erupts. Thunderous applause and cheers.

AUDIENCE (O.S.)
Music God! Encore!

An EMCEE appears with a golden trophy. Confetti rains down.

EMCEE (V.O.)
For the third consecutive year - Lin Chuan of Daxia.

ON SCREEN: LIN CHUAN - THREE-TIME WORLD CHAMPION

INT. SEDAN CAR - NIGHT

Lin sits in the dark backseat, trophy glinting. The DRIVER's eyes flick to the rearview mirror.

DRIVER
Mr. Lin. That sedan's been with us since the venue.

Lin turns. Headlights fill the rear window.

LIN CHUAN
Lose them.

The Driver accelerates onto a mountain highway. The pursuing car surges forward, BUMPING their rear bumper.

DRIVER
They're trying to--

The pursuing vehicle RAMS them again, harder. Tires scream.
continuation:
INT./EXT. SEDAN CAR - MOUNTAIN ROAD - CONTINUOUS

The car careens through a guardrail and plunges down the slope.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - NIGHT

The sedan lies twisted at the bottom, smoke billowing.

A figure at the roadside watches, then melts into darkness.

ON SCREEN: MUSIC GOD LIN CHUAN - ACCIDENT - FATE UNKNOWN

INT. INSTRUMENT SHOP - DAY

Sunlight illuminates dusty rows of traditional instruments. A small TV flickers silently in the corner. SU YING (30s, weary but determined) works at the counter. Her sister SU WAN (20s, fiery) polishes a pipa.

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER

The door chimes. CHEN JIANGHAI (40s, corporate polish, predatory smile) enters with TAKEDA TARO (50s, distinguished, inscrutable).

SU YING
Can I help you?

Chen picks up a suona, examining it with a slight smile.

SU YING
All our instruments are performance-grade. You're welcome to try them.

Chen sets it down with a sharp TAP. The reed cracks audibly.

Su Wan rushes over.

SU WAN
That was deliberate.

CHEN JIANGHAI
I'm Chen Jianghai, Jiangbei representative for the International Music Development Council.

He produces a card.

CHEN JIANGHAI
And this is Takeda Taro, Special Advisor to the Ishikawa Music Hall.

ON SCREEN: CHEN JIANGHAI - INTERNATIONAL MUSIC DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL

ON SCREEN: TAKEDA TARO - ISHIKAWA MUSIC HALL ADVISOR

SU YING
(frowning)
What do you want?

TAKEDA TARO
(bows slightly)
The Ishikawa Hall is establishing a cultural exchange in Jiangbei. With sponsored instruments for all major academies.

CHEN JIANGHAI
We're inviting local partners. Or competitors.

He slides a sealed black envelope across the counter.

CHEN JIANGHAI
Our proposal. Accept, and your instruments reach three hundred students. Refuse...

He glances at the broken suona.

CHEN JIANGHAI
...and we demonstrate why some traditions belong in museums.

SU YING's hand trembles as she reaches for the envelope.

title: Phoenix Reborn from Ashes
description: A wealthy merchant's daughter is poisoned and left for dead, but awakens to memories of a past life that ended in betrayal.
context:
Title: Phoenix Reborn from Ashes
Description: A wealthy merchant's daughter is poisoned and left for dead, but awakens to memories of a past life that ended in betrayal.

EXT. ANCIENT ALLEY - NIGHT

Moonlight filters through haze, silvering the cobblestones.

SONG NANZHI, merchant's daughter in torn silk robes, stumbles from a courtyard, spine against the wall. Her breath clouds in the cold air, but sweat sheens her brow. She claws at her throat, fingernails leaving raw marks.

ON SCREEN: Daughter of the Capital's Wealthy Merchant
ON SCREEN: SONG NANZHI

SONG NANZHI
(strangled whisper)
Fire... it's in my blood...

Her knees buckle. She slides down the wall, leaving a smear of grime on silk.

A NIGHT WATCHMAN passes the alley's mouth, lantern swinging. Light strobes across stone.

NIGHT WATCHMAN (O.S.)
Dry night—mind your hearths.

The lantern's rhythm matches a heartbeat. SONG NANZHI's eyes fix on the light, pupils dilating.

Memory fragments crash through:
- A bridal chamber, crimson candles.
- Her mother's pearl hairpin, bloodied.
- Her own hands, pale and still.

SONG NANZHI (V.O.)
(fragmented)
Mother... the candles... they put something in the wine...

Back to present. SONG NANZHI's hands tremble before her face.

SONG NANZHI
continuation:
(to herself)
These hands... they haven't married yet...

Her gaze snaps to the courtyard she fled—then to her unbound feet. Comprehension dawns like ice water.

SONG NANZHI (V.O.)
(quiet, deadly)
They poisoned the betrothal wine. The Crown Prince's men. They wanted me silenced before the selection.

In the alley's mouth, SHADOWS shift. Three BEGGARS in ragged furs melt from darkness, moving with predatory economy. One carries a hemp sack.

BEGGAR A
(low, to others)
She's primed. Just like the patron described.

BEGGAR B
The silk alone'll feed us winter through.

BEGGAR C
(licking cracked lips)
Patron said make it loud. Make it shame the family.

They close in, forming a semicircle. SONG NANZHI's head lifts. Her terror crystallizes into something colder.

SONG NANZHI
(weak but clear)
Stay back.

BEGGAR A grins, revealing blackened teeth. He lunges.

BEGGAR A
No one hears in the merchant's quarter at night.

He grabs her wrist. She fights, but the drug turns her limbs to water. The sack comes down over her head. The scene darkens to the sound of tearing silk.

ON SCREEN: PHOENIX REBORN FROM ASHES

FADE OUT.

Description: A woman with a scarred past uses a staged confrontation at a blind date banquet to catch the attention of her real target, a powerful and elusive businessman.

TITLE CARD: HUNTING RELATIONSHIP

EXT. LUXURIOUS ROOM - DAY (FLASHFORWARD)

JIANG MUSHENG, wearing sexy pajamas, walks barefoot on the floor, light and shadow dappled across her.

JIANG MUSHENG
Come here.

JIANG MUSHENG sits in a chair. ZHOU CHAOXUAN walks toward her.

JIANG MUSHENG
Help me take off my clothes.

ZHOU CHAOXUAN
I am willing to become your slave.

JIANG MUSHENG's hand caresses the scar on her chest, her eyes filled with pain.

JIANG MUSHENG (V.O.)
That cut really hurt.

ZHOU CHAOXUAN
You are the most perfect woman I have ever seen in this world.

continuation:
INT. LUXURIOUS BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

A grand banquet is underway. JIANG MUSHENG, wearing a gorgeous evening gown, stands to the side on the phone.

FRIEND (V.O.)
This blind date banquet your stepmother arranged for you today has no good intentions. That Chen family second generation heir is not a good person.

JIANG MUSHENG
I know. So he's not my target at all. He can't get what I want.

JIANG MUSHENG's gaze moves past the crowd and locks onto ZHOU CHAOXUAN, who is conversing with someone.

JIANG MUSHENG
And he is my prey.

FRIEND (V.O.)
You mean Zhou Chaoxuan? He's not easy to approach. Can you really take him down?

JIANG MUSHENG
Special people require special methods to attract attention.

JIANG MUSHENG hangs up the phone, picks up a glass of red wine from a passing waiter's tray, and walks elegantly toward the center of the banquet. She passes by ZHOU CHAOXUAN, and the two briefly make eye contact.

ZHOU CHAOXUAN
(to the person beside him)
Continue.

JIANG MUSHENG walks up to CHEN LIN. CHEN LIN looks her up and down.

CHEN LIN
The scar's a shame. But I suppose every commodity has its flaws.

JIANG MUSHENG
At least my flaws are visible. Yours just cost your company three points in today's market.

Chen's face darkens—she's struck true.

JIANG MUSHENG
Your father sent you here to prove you can handle a wife. But you can't even handle a conversation.

CHEN LIN is enraged.

CHEN LIN
You little bitch!

CHEN LIN suddenly strikes, grabbing JIANG MUSHENG by the throat and pushing her against a table. JIANG MUSHENG struggles painfully—real fear mixing with calculation.

ZHOU CHAOXUAN sees this and immediately steps forward, grabbing CHEN LIN's wrist.

ZHOU CHAOXUAN
You're making a scene. In my hotel.

ZHOU CHAOXUAN forcefully pushes CHEN LIN away. CHEN LIN stumbles, and seeing it's ZHOU CHAOXUAN, immediately puts on an ingratiating smile.

CHEN LIN
President Zhou—it's a misunderstanding. We were—

ZHOU CHAOXUAN
Leave.

Chen retreats.

JIANG MUSHENG touches her reddened neck, looking at ZHOU CHAOXUAN with lingering fear and dawning recognition.

JIANG MUSHENG
Thank you.

ZHOU CHAOXUAN studies her exposed scar for a beat too long.

ZHOU CHAOXUAN
Hunt more carefully. Some predators bite back.

He walks away. She watches him go, her triumph edged with uncertainty.

JIANG MUSHENG (V.O.)
The predator sees the hunter.

TITLE CARD: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Rise Against All Odds: A Life of Dominance
description: A young man wrongfully imprisoned for murder discovers his parents were killed while trying to clear his name, and a mysterious inmate offers him a chance to escape and seek revenge.
context:
Title: Rise Against All Odds: A Life of Dominance
Description: A young man wrongfully imprisoned for murder discovers his parents were killed while trying to clear his name, and a mysterious inmate offers him a chance to escape and seek revenge.

INT. PRISON SOLITARY CONFINEMENT CELL - DAY

A SIGN on the wall reads: "SOLITARY CONFINEMENT AREA."

CHEN XUEWEN, a young prisoner in a torn uniform with healing injuries, sits motionless against the concrete. The food slot opens.

DU LAO, a middle-aged prisoner with glasses, peers through.

DU LAO
Your parents stopped coming. Three weeks ago.

CHEN XUEWEN
(voice hollow)
They gave up.

DU LAO
Or someone made them stop. Forever.

Chen jerks toward the bars.

CHEN XUEWEN
What are you saying?

DU LAO
They were coming to see me. About your case. Then they died. Car accident.

CHEN XUEWEN
(quietly)
That's what I was told.

DU LAO
In Black Water, accident and execution look the same on paper. You want truth? Stay alive. Ghosts don't get answers.

The slot slams shut.

CUT TO:

FLASHBACK - ONE MONTH AGO

INT. PRISON CORRIDOR - DAY

GUARDS shove CHEN XUEWEN through intake. He's clean-cut, terrified.

CHEN XUEWEN
(shouting)
Officer! The timeline doesn't match—check the library cameras!

GUARD #1
Save it for your appeal, kid.

They throw him into GENERAL POPULATION. The door CLANGS shut. SCARFACE, prisoner leader with a scar, watches from his bunk.

SCARFACE
Fresh meat thinks he's special.

Chen is knocked to the ground.

INT. PRISON CELL - DAY

Prisoners surround newcomer CHEN XUEWEN.

PRISONER A
Kid.

PRISONER B
I heard you're in here for raping and killing a college girl. That true?

CHEN XUEWEN
(terrified)
No—I was at the library—

PRISONER B
(sneering)
Sure.

SCARFACE steps forward. Punches Chen in the stomach. Chen doubles over.

CHEN XUEWEN
(gasping)
Coward...

SCARFACE
(contemptuously)
You talk back?

SCARFACE kicks him down.

SCARFACE
Beat him until he learns.

Prisoners rush forward. DU LAO watches coldly from his bunk.
continuation:
INT. PRISON CAFETERIA - DAY

Prisoners line up for food. CHEN XUEWEN, thinner now, approaches TRUSTEE GUARD RAMOS.

CHEN XUEWEN
Sir. My parents visited every other day. Now nothing. Please—can you check?

RAMOS
(avoiding eye contact)
Stop talking. Eat your food.

RAMOS moves off. Chen stands frozen. Behind him, OLD MAN WU (70s), a lifer, murmurs.

OLD MAN WU
They won't tell you official. But word travels. Car accident. Both of them. Last Tuesday.

The food tray falls. Spills across the floor.

CHEN XUEWEN
(repeating)
My parents... are dead?

He stares at the mess. His hands shake—not with grief. With something colder.

SCARFACE and followers approach, surrounding Chen.

SCARFACE
(mocking)
College boy's learning his place. On the floor.

SCARFACE spits on the spilled food.

SCARFACE
Show us how sorry you are.

Prisoners laugh. Chen raises his head. His eyes are different now—empty of fear.

CHEN XUEWEN
(quietly)
My parents are dead because of you people.

SCARFACE
What'd you say?

Chen's hand darts out—grabs a broken shard. He launches at Scarface, drives him onto a table, shard at his throat.

SCARFACE
(terrified)
I'm talking to you! Can't you hear me!

CHEN XUEWEN
(roaring)
YOU THINK I'M EASY TO BULLY! FRAMING ME, KILLING THEM! I'M ALREADY DEAD—BUT I'M TAKING YOU!

PRISON WARDEN BASONG arrives with guards.

BASONG
(shouting)
STAND DOWN!

Guards rush forward. Tasers crackle. Chen convulses. They drag him off. Through chaos, DU LAO watches.

CHEN XUEWEN
(struggling)
Let me die! Let me die!

DU LAO
(to a guard)
I'll calm him.

Du Lao locks Chen in a chokehold. Whispers.

DU LAO
(whispering)
Not here. Not like this.

Chen goes limp.

GUARD
Take him to the hole!

INT. PRISON SOLITARY CONFINEMENT CELL - NIGHT

CHEN XUEWEN curls up in the corner, covered in fresh wounds, eyes vacant.

CHEN XUEWEN
(muttering)
Mom... Dad... I'm coming...

DU LAO appears at the cell door holding a broom and dustpan. He unlocks it.

DU LAO
Young man. Three days without food. You keep this up, you'll die. And no one will know why your parents were murdered.

CHEN XUEWEN suddenly looks up. Grabs the bars.

CHEN XUEWEN
(urgently)
What do you know?

DU LAO
I know they were silenced. I know who gave the order. And I know you have a choice.

(beat)

Become a ghost or become a weapon. But you can't be both.

FADE OUT.

title: Carefree Medical Immortal in the City
description: A swordsman's romantic practice session with his junior sister is interrupted by a powerful War Goddess bearing a marriage contract.
context:
Title: Carefree Medical Immortal in the City
Description: A swordsman's romantic practice session with his junior sister is interrupted by a powerful War Goddess bearing a marriage contract.

EXT. LAKESIDE MEADOW - DAY

MONTAGE:

YE CHENYANG and JUNIOR SISTER, dressed in ancient costumes, practice swordsmanship on a misty lakeside meadow.

The two display elegant sword techniques, exchanging moves, their eyes full of affection. Between strikes, YE CHENYANG's fingertips emit brief pulses of green healing energy that correct JUNIOR SISTER's form.

Cut to: The two face each other closely, sword tips touching, smiling at each other.

Overhead shot: The two spin on the meadow, sword light flashing. Their blades leave trails of faint green light.

They stop their movements. YE CHENYANG's sword gently rests on JUNIOR SISTER's neck as she looks up at him.

The two spar again, their movements fluid and graceful.

END MONTAGE

YE CHENYANG and JUNIOR SISTER stop their practice. YE CHENYANG blocks JUNIOR SISTER's hand with his palm.

YE CHENYANG
Junior Sister, you've practiced the Tender Affection Sword well.

JUNIOR SISTER
That's because you taught me well, Senior Brother.

YE CHENYANG
Then let me teach you something else.

YE CHENYANG takes JUNIOR SISTER's hand, pulls her into his arms, and strikes a romantic pose.

JUNIOR SISTER
(shyly)
Senior Brother, you're so naughty.

YE CHENYANG
Junior Sister, don't we look just like the Divine Eagle couple right now?

JUNIOR SISTER
We do, but Senior Brother...

JUNIOR SISTER glances to the side.

JUNIOR SISTER
There's a big rooster over there watching us.

YE CHENYANG follows her gaze. A majestic black rooster stands in the distance, watching them. Its eyes glow with faint crimson light.

YE CHENYANG
(turning back, gently)
No problem. I'll slaughter it later and make you soup to nourish your body.

JUNIOR SISTER
(quietly)
The City sent another one.

JUNIOR SISTER shyly lowers her head and leans into YE CHENYANG's embrace.
continuation:
JUNIOR SISTER
Senior Brother, you're so good to me.

The two embrace tightly. The rooster in the distance turns and quickly runs away, dissolving into smoke.

Suddenly, powerful music begins to play.

XIAOYUE WAR GODDESS, wearing black combat attire and a red cape, arrives with six BLACK-CLAD SUBORDINATES, walking with imposing momentum.

YE CHENYANG and JUNIOR SISTER look at these unexpected visitors in surprise.

XIAOYUE WAR GODDESS and her group stop in front of them.

XIAOYUE WAR GODDESS
Are you Ye Chenyang?

YE CHENYANG
I am. Who are you?

SUBORDINATE
(sternly)
Insolent! How dare you speak to Lord Xiaoyue that way?

YE CHENYANG
(confused, to Junior Sister)
Xiaoyue War Goddess? Have you heard of her? Hm?

JUNIOR SISTER
Only in City reports. She never leaves the capital.

XIAOYUE WAR GODDESS
I am the only Five-Star War Goddess of the Longxia Nation. Within five years, I pacified the four seas for the nation and helped the Sovereign unify the realm. With my own power, I defeated the ten great overseas masters of our Longxia Nation. Due to my illustrious achievements, I now command the Four War Gods of the Four Territories, second in position only to the Sovereign.

XIAOYUE WAR GODDESS is about to continue.

YE CHENYANG
(impatiently interrupting)
And... alright, alright, alright, alright. Aren't you tired talking so much in one breath?

YE CHENYANG waves his hand dismissively.

YE CHENYANG
Just tell me directly. Why are you looking for me?

XIAOYUE WAR GODDESS produces a red scroll from behind her and unfurls it dramatically. It is a marriage contract.

XIAOYUE WAR GODDESS
This is a marriage contract. Come back with me to get married.

YE CHENYANG and JUNIOR SISTER are both stunned. YE CHENYANG's eyes widen, his mouth forming an "O" shape, his face full of shock.

JUNIOR SISTER
(whisper)
The contract from Qingyun Pass...

YE CHENYANG
What?

FADE OUT.

TITLE CARD: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Ghost Doctor Young Master
description: A disabled man confronts his ex-girlfriend who stole his sister's insurance money, only to be brutally beaten by her new lover at a hotel.
context:
Title: Ghost Doctor Young Master
Description: A disabled man confronts his ex-girlfriend who stole his sister's insurance money, only to be brutally beaten by her new lover at a hotel.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Opening with a series of fast-cut montage shots:
- LIU SISI glances at the door, guilt flickering across her face.
- WU TIANFENG pours champagne, confident and predatory.
- A single red rose rests on LIU SISI's hand as she lies on the bed.

EXT. HOTEL - NIGHT

HAN YICHEN stands across the street, staring up at the building. Rain pounds the pavement. His phone glows in his hand—a text message: "Paradise Hotel, Room 27, if you want the money back."

He looks at his watch: 11:47 PM. He pockets the phone and limps toward the entrance, his crutch clicking against the wet pavement.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

The door bursts open. HAN YICHEN stumbles in, panting.

HAN YICHEN
Liu Sisi!

HAN YICHEN
My sister's insurance. Fifty thousand. Now.

LIU SISI
(sitting up, alarmed)
You can't just—

HAN YICHEN
The bank confirmed the transfer timestamp. You took it three hours ago, while I was at the hospital.

LIU SISI
(to WU TIANFENG)
My ex-boyfriend. I broke up with him after his accident, but he won't accept it.

HAN YICHEN
(accusatory but tired)
Construction site, five years. Every paycheck. Then the crane cable snapped.
(taps his leg)
This happened. You disappeared. Fine. But that money was for my sister's surgery.
continuation:
HAN YICHEN
(pleading)
Return it. I won't bother you again. Just let her have the operation.

LIU SISI
(coldly)
Don't make it sound like theft. Five years of my life, Han Yichen. The money's compensation for wasted youth.

HAN YICHEN
(stunned)
She's eight, Sisi. They're moving her to hospice tomorrow without payment.

WU TIANFENG
(stepping forward)
Okay, pity party's over, cripple. You have ten seconds to crawl out.

WU TIANFENG shoves HAN YICHEN. He stumbles back against the doorframe, his crutch clattering to the floor.

HAN YICHEN
(desperate)
I'll kill you for this!

HAN YICHEN lunges toward LIU SISI. WU TIANFENG intercepts, delivering a brutal kick to HAN YICHEN's chest. He crashes to the carpet.

WU TIANFENG places his designer loafer on HAN YICHEN's already-crippled leg, grinding down.

HAN YICHEN
(screaming in agony)
Ah!

WU TIANFENG
(malicious grin)
One crippled leg isn't enough? Let me fix the other one for you.

WU TIANFENG raises his foot. HAN YICHEN's hand instinctively goes to his pocket—where an old doctor's ID badge peeks out. But he's too slow.

The stomp comes down. The sickening crack of bone echoes.

HAN YICHEN's scream is raw, primal. He clutches his deformed leg, his face contorted in pain and fury.

FADE TO BLACK.
full_script:
Title: Ghost Doctor Young Master
Description: A disabled man confronts his ex-girlfriend who stole his sister's insurance money, only to be brutally beaten by her new lover at a hotel.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Opening with a series of fast-cut montage shots:
- LIU SISI glances at the door, guilt flickering across her face.
- WU TIANFENG pours champagne, confident and predatory.
- A single red rose rests on LIU SISI's hand as she lies on the bed.

EXT. HOTEL - NIGHT

HAN YICHEN stands across the street, staring up at the building. Rain pounds the pavement. His phone glows in his hand—a text message: "Paradise Hotel, Room 27, if you want the money back."

He looks at his watch: 11:47 PM. He pockets the phone and limps toward the entrance, his crutch clicking against the wet pavement.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

The door bursts open. HAN YICHEN stumbles in, panting.

HAN YICHEN
Liu Sisi!

HAN YICHEN
My sister's insurance. Fifty thousand. Now.

LIU SISI
(sitting up, alarmed)
You can't just—

HAN YICHEN
The bank confirmed the transfer timestamp. You took it three hours ago, while I was at the hospital.

LIU SISI
(to WU TIANFENG)
My ex-boyfriend. I broke up with him after his accident, but he won't accept it.

HAN YICHEN
(accusatory but tired)
Construction site, five years. Every paycheck. Then the crane cable snapped.
(taps his leg)
This happened. You disappeared. Fine. But that money was for my sister's surgery.

HAN YICHEN
(pleading)
Return it. I won't bother you again. Just let her have the operation.

LIU SISI
(coldly)
Don't make it sound like theft. Five years of my life, Han Yichen. The money's compensation for wasted youth.

HAN YICHEN
(stunned)
She's eight, Sisi. They're moving her to hospice tomorrow without payment.

WU TIANFENG
(stepping forward)
Okay, pity party's over, cripple. You have ten seconds to crawl out.

WU TIANFENG shoves HAN YICHEN. He stumbles back against the doorframe, his crutch clattering to the floor.

HAN YICHEN
(desperate)
I'll kill you for this!

HAN YICHEN lunges toward LIU SISI. WU TIANFENG intercepts, delivering a brutal kick to HAN YICHEN's chest. He crashes to the carpet.

WU TIANFENG places his designer loafer on HAN YICHEN's already-crippled leg, grinding down.

HAN YICHEN
(screaming in agony)
Ah!

WU TIANFENG
(malicious grin)
One crippled leg isn't enough? Let me fix the other one for you.

WU TIANFENG raises his foot. HAN YICHEN's hand instinctively goes to his pocket—where an old doctor's ID badge peeks out. But he's too slow.

The stomp comes down. The sickening crack of bone echoes.

HAN YICHEN's scream is raw, primal. He clutches his deformed leg, his face contorted in pain and fury.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: Reborn Di Consort Is Not to Be Trifled With
description: A deposed empress is betrayed and murdered by her husband the Emperor and her cousin. Given a chance by a mysterious entity, she vows to return and seek revenge.
context:
Title: Reborn Di Consort Is Not to Be Trifled With
Description: A deposed empress is betrayed and murdered by her husband the Emperor and her cousin. Given a chance by a mysterious entity, she vows to return and seek revenge.

INT. GREAT HALL - NIGHT

Moonlight cuts through cracked shutters, illuminating the deposed EMPRESS QIN SHUANGYUE. She sits alone on the cold floor, her magnificent red wedding dress and phoenix crown now faded reminders of her fall from grace. Her expression is stone, her eyes hollow.

The hall doors groan open. Torchlight spills across the floor.

QIN SHUANGYUE turns her head slowly, and in her eyes, sorrow hardens into quiet resolve.

EXT. PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

A light snow falls on the gray stones. QIN SHUANGYUE's brother, QIN YI, son of the Duke of Zhenguo, is forced to his knees by two SOLDIERS. His scholar's robes are torn, his face bloodied but defiant.

A third SOLDIER shoves Shuangyue forward. She stumbles, then steadies herself, chin lifted.

Her cousin QIN SHUYA enters in fine sable robes, flanked by SOLDIERS bearing an imperial edict and a lacquered tray with wine pot and cups.

QIN YI
(strangled)
Sister—don't—

A SOLDIER silences him with a blow. Shuangyue flinches, her hands clenching into fists.

QIN SHUYA
(coldly triumphant)
Third Sister, His Majesty is merciful. He grants you a final reunion before death.

QIN YI
It's poison! Turn away!

QIN SHUYA signals with her eyes. A SOLDIER draws his sword and stabs Qin Yi.

QIN YI falls dead, blood staining the snow.

QIN SHUANGYUE
(a broken whisper)
Brother...

SHUYA pours the wine deliberately. The dark liquid steams in the winter air.

MING YANYU, the new Emperor of Great Wei, emerges onto the gallery above, his dragon robes stark against the stone. He watches with cold detachment.

MING YANYU
Your father, the Duke of Zhenguo, plotted treason and has been executed by slow slicing. Qin Shuangyue, I show mercy for our past as husband and wife by granting you an intact corpse. Do not be ungrateful.

QIN SHUANGYUE
(voice trembling with fury)
Treason? My father bled for your throne. You used us, then discarded us like refuse.

MING YANYU
(angrily)
Your tongue remains sharp. Cripple her hands and feet!

SOLDIERS seize Shuangyue's arms. One stomps on her wrist. The CRACK echoes. She bites back a scream, her face draining of color.

QIN SHUYA
The Crown Prince is already dead. Third Sister should go to the underworld for a family reunion.

QIN SHUANGYUE
continuation:
(frozen)
What did you do to Cheng'er?

QIN SHUYA
(smiling contemptuously)
His little heart made excellent medicine for my fertility. The Emperor's new heir deserves proper omens.

QIN SHUANGYUE
(raging)
Ming Yanyu, how vicious you are! That was your own son!

MING YANYU
That was clearly a bastard child you conceived with Ming Yuchen!

QIN SHUYA grabs Shuangyue's chin, forcing the poisoned wine down her throat.

QIN SHUANGYUE collapses, convulsing. Black blood trickles from her lips.

QIN SHUANGYUE (V.O.)
If I must walk through hell... I will return. And you will suffer as I have suffered.

A SOLDIER runs in frantically.

SOLDIER
Your Majesty! Prince Chen is leading troops into the palace!

MING HONGLI, Prince Chen of Great Wei, wearing armor and wielding a sword, charges in with killing intent, engaging the SOLDIERS in fierce combat.

In the chaos, Hongli's blade finds Shuya's throat. She drops the wine cup, surprise frozen on her face as she falls.

Ming Hongli defeats all the SOLDIERS and runs to Qin Shuangyue, taking her into his arms.

MING HONGLI
(anguished)
Qin Shuangyue!

Qin Shuangyue dies in Ming Hongli's embrace, her eyes fixed on the sky as a single tear slides down her cheek.

MING HONGLI
(roaring to the heavens)
Ah—!

INT. VOID SPACE - NIGHT

QIN SHUANGYUE, wearing white robes, her soul floating in darkness.

A WHITE-HAIRED OLD MAN appears before her.

WHITE-HAIRED OLD MAN
Qin Shuangyue. Walk through shadow and return to sun. But the price is memory—of all you loved.

Images of her brother and son's tragic deaths flash before Qin Shuangyue's eyes.

QIN SHUANGYUE
(resolute)
I am willing.

EXT. PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

Ming Hongli holds Qin Shuangyue's body, grief-stricken, as snow covers them both.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Supreme Nine Thousand Years Old
description: A modern doctor is transported to ancient times and becomes a eunuch in the imperial palace.
context:
Title: Supreme Nine Thousand Years Old
Description: A modern doctor is transported to ancient times and becomes a eunuch in the imperial palace.

INT. CLINIC - DAY

DR. LIN XUAN, young and meticulous in his white coat, arranges medicinal herbs with surgical precision.

A WOMAN in a black dress enters, her elegance edged with quiet fury. She sits on the edge of his desk.

WOMAN
Your massage therapy. It really works?

LIN XUAN
Yes. It treats illness and extends vitality.

WOMAN
Good. My chest has felt tight lately. Perhaps you could demonstrate?

LIN XUAN reaches for water; his hand trembles. The glass tips. Water splashes her dress.

WOMAN
(sharp)
You—

LIN XUAN
(stammering)
I didn't— forgive me, I'll get towels—

WOMAN
(cold)
You refused what's offered. A man who doesn't know his place... belongs in a eunuch's shoes.

Her eyes flash crimson. A vortex of ancient symbols swallows Lin Xuan.

LIN XUAN
(choking)
No—
continuation:
EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

LIN XUAN snaps awake in eunuch robes, slumped against a pillar. An OLD EUNUCH prods him with a whisk.

OLD EUNUCH
On your feet. Consort Shen's bathwater won't carry itself.

LIN XUAN
(dazed)
Where's the director? The costumes are... authentic.

OLD EUNUCH
No director. Only consequences.

LIN XUAN
I'm a doctor, not a—

OLD EUNUCH
You're whatever keeps your head on your shoulders. Move.

A MAID appears in the doorway, her tone edged with steel.

MAID
Why the noise? The Consort waits. You have until the incense burns through.

OLD EUNUCH
(to MAID)
Apologies. We're coming.

OLD EUNUCH
(to LIN XUAN)
Yesterday, three eunuchs died for spilled oil. Spare me your delusions and run.

The OLD EUNUCH and MAID exit. Lin Xuan stares at his unfamiliar hands, at the calluses that aren't his.

LIN XUAN
(to himself)
This is real. Adapt or die.

He lifts the water bucket, his medical training screaming: assess, survive, outlast.

INT. BATH CHAMBER - DAY

LIN XUAN rushes in, slips on wet tiles, and crashes through the door screen. He looks up.

CONSORT SHEN, radiant and composed in her bath, meets his gaze. Behind her, two GUARDS draw their swords as one.

title: My Mommy is a Big Boss
description: A young heiress is drugged and framed by her sister on her 18th birthday, leading to a scandal that destroys her family's reputation and results in her being disowned while pregnant.
context:
Title: My Mommy is a Big Boss
Description: A young heiress is drugged and framed by her sister on her 18th birthday, leading to a scandal that destroys her family's reputation and results in her being disowned while pregnant.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Silhouettes of a man and woman embrace by the window, their shadows stretching across the luxury suite. Romantic music drifts from the walls.

FAST CUTS:
YE YUNRAN lies unconscious on silk sheets, a stranger's lips on hers.
A pink ribbon binds her wrist to the bedpost.
He kisses her neck; her fingers spasm against his palm.
Their hands clasp. A white dress pools on marble.

INT. BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

Golden text materializes: THREE HOURS EARLIER.

YE YUNYING, in a sharp white blazer, pours a vial of purple liquid into a wine glass at the darkened bar.

ON SCREEN CHARACTER INTRODUCTION:
YE YUNYING
Second Miss of Ye Group

Through the starlit ballroom, Ye Yunyao approaches her sister.

YE YUNYING
(voice like honey)
Sister. Happy birthday.

YE YUNRAN
(18, radiant but weary)
Thank you. I'm just—

GUESTS
Happy birthday, heiress!

Everyone drinks. Ye Yunran's throat works as she swallows.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

ON SCREEN LOCATION: EMPEROR HOTEL - SUITE 706

Ye Yunran lies on the bed, a syringe mark on her arm. Ye Yunyao checks a hidden camera in the smoke detector.

YE YUNYING
(into phone)
President Cheng, she's ready. Stream the footage.

She hangs up, glances at her sister, and leaves. The door locks.

A man's dress shoes stop outside 706. He uses a keycard. Enters.

INT. NEWS STUDIO - DAY

A NEWS ANCHOR delivers headlines.

NEWS HEADLINE: HAICHENG ENTERTAINMENT HEADLINES

NEWS ANCHOR
Breaking: Ye Group heiress Ye Yunran's 18th birthday gala ended in scandal when leaked footage showed her with an unidentified man. Stock plummeted 40% overnight. The board demands action.

Monitors flash: hotel surveillance, intimate stills, blood-red tickers.

INT. YE FAMILY VILLA - DAY

ON SCREEN LOCATION: YE FAMILY VILLA

YE ZHENSHAN backhands Ye Yunran. She crumples.

YE ZHENSHAN
(voice cracking)
The morality clause. The board voted.

YE YUNRAN
(protecting her stomach)
Dad, she drugged me. Check the wine—

YE ZHENSHAN
Your sister testified you left willingly.

YE YUNYING appears with a medical report.

YE YUNYING
She's pregnant. Ye blood.

YE ZHENSHAN
(turning away)
That's my shame. South wing. No contact.

He walks away as guards drag Ye Yunran out.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Fill in the Blank
description: A woman discovers her husband's lingering feelings for another woman through a misdelivered bouquet of flowers.
context:
Title: Fill in the Blank
Description: A woman discovers her husband's lingering feelings for another woman through a misdelivered bouquet of flowers.

INT. FRONT DOOR - DAY

The doorbell rings.

YE WANQIU walks from inside the house toward the door.

YE WANQIU
Coming.

YE WANQIU opens the door. A cascading bouquet of white roses rests at the doorstep. She lifts it with hesitant joy and closes the door.

YE WANQIU (V.O.)
Four years. He's never once remembered.

YE WANQIU extracts the card with trembling fingers. It reads: "Jingyi—Welcome home." Her face drains of color, breath catching in her throat.

YE WANQIU (V.O.)
The name that haunts this marriage.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

GU HANCHEN sits on the sofa, phone in hand, gaze deliberately averted. YE WANQIU approaches him.

YE WANQIU
A Chen. You're back early.

GU HANCHEN continues scrolling, unresponsive. YE WANQIU kneels before him, smoothing her features into a placating smile.

YE WANQIU
Tiring day?

GU HANCHEN remains silent. YE WANQIU presses on, voice brightening with forced cheer.

YE WANQIU
A Chen, Mrs. Liu's terrace—her peonies are blooming. She wanted me to ask your opinion on the fertilizer.

GU HANCHEN still doesn't look up. YE WANQIU rises, reaching for his empty teacup.

YE WANQIU
A Chen, your favorite soup is still warm—

GU HANCHEN
(impatiently interrupting)
continuation:
If you're that desperate to be useful, sort the dry cleaning. Spare me the chatter.

YE WANQIU lowers her head, wounded. Her eyes land on a faint coral smudge on GU HANCHEN's collar—lipstick. She freezes, the cup nearly slipping from her grasp.

YE WANQIU
(tentatively)
A Chen, a florist delivery came today. For a Jingyi Su. Wrong address?

GU HANCHEN
(without looking up)
Mistake. Return it.

YE WANQIU
Oh. Of course. A mistake.

YE WANQIU
(gathering courage)
A Chen, did you... spend the day with her?

GU HANCHEN's head snaps up, eyes blazing. He hurls his phone onto the sofa cushion, the crack of impact echoing.

GU HANCHEN
(shouting)
Get out!

He shoves his jacket into her arms, fabric bunched like an accusation.

GU HANCHEN
Now!

YE WANQIU stumbles back, clutching the jacket, and flees.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

YE WANQIU holds the jacket and her phone, back pressed against the wall for support. GU HANCHEN's phone buzzes in her pocket—she must have grabbed it unconsciously. She answers.

SU JINGYI (O.S.)
Mrs. Gu? It's Jingyi. I assume the roses arrived.

YE WANQIU
(shocked)
You—how—

SU JINGYI (O.S.)
Four years, and he still uses our code. 'Welcome home.' Tell me, does he still call you by my name when he dreams?

The line cuts. YE WANQIU's hand drops, phone clattering to the floor. She sinks down, the wall holding her up as betrayal settles into her bones with quiet, final weight.

GU HANCHEN's head snaps up, eyes blazing. He hurls his phone onto the sofa cushion, the crack of impact echoing.

GU HANCHEN
(shouting)
Get out!

He shoves his jacket into her arms, fabric bunched like an accusation.

GU HANCHEN
Now!

YE WANQIU stumbles back, clutching the jacket, and flees.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

YE WANQIU holds the jacket and her phone, back pressed against the wall for support. GU HANCHEN's phone buzzes in her pocket—she must have grabbed it unconsciously. She answers.

SU JINGYI (O.S.)
Mrs. Gu? It's Jingyi. I assume the roses arrived.

YE WANQIU
(shocked)
You—how—

SU JINGYI (O.S.)
Four years, and he still uses our code. 'Welcome home.' Tell me, does he still call you by my name when he dreams?

The line cuts. YE WANQIU's hand drops, phone clattering to the floor. She sinks down, the wall holding her up as betrayal settles into her bones with quiet, final weight.

title: Proud God Venerable
description: A legendary warrior returns to his homeland after five years of conquering foreign lands and unifying criminal forces, ready to settle old scores with his family and the nation.
context:
Title: Proud God Venerable
Description: A legendary warrior returns to his homeland after five years of conquering foreign lands and unifying criminal forces, ready to settle old scores with his family and the nation.

EXT. ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT

METAL-TEXTURED TITLE: PROUD GOD VENERABLE - EPISODE 1

Smoke chokes the ruins. BLOOD FIEND BUTCHER (40s), bald, scarred, skull-patched gear, stands like a monument to violence.

A SPECTRAL BLUR cuts across night cityscapes.

Butcher ROARS - a territorial challenge.

SUPER: BLOOD FIEND BUTCHER - WORLD-CLASS CRIMINAL

GUARDS in tactical gear breach the smoke. Silent. Precise.

SHENTU LING (30s), red halter dress, emerges through their ranks. The circle forms.

SHENTU LING (V.O.)
Futile resistance.

SHENTU LING
Butcher. Your five-year reign ends tonight. The God Venerable does not wait.

BLOOD FIEND BUTCHER
(laughs)
Then I'll send my regards through you.

He attacks. The Guards fall - not dead, but dismantled. Butcher uses their own momentum against them.

BLOOD FIEND BUTCHER
World-class? I am the world!

He lifts a car overhead one-handed. The frame groans.

BLOOD FIEND BUTCHER
Today, your Sin God Domain runs with blood!

YE LINGXIAO (30s), black battle armor, appears on the platform above. He watches like a scientist observes an experiment.

YE LINGXIAO
In all nations, no one speaks those words twice.

He drops. The impact CRACKS concrete. Red energy bleeds from him like radiation. Not a show. A leak.

SHENTU LING and surviving Guards kneel, foreheads to ground.

GUARDS
(in unison)
Welcome, God Venerable!

SHENTU LING
We disturbed your return. This subordinate deserves—

YE LINGXIAO
You delivered my opponent. Well done.

YE LINGXIAO
Half-god realm. Perfect for calibration.

He moves. Butcher flies into the car. The wreckage collapses on him.

BLOOD FIEND BUTCHER
(roars, lifting the car)
continuation:
I yield to NO ONE!

YE LINGXIAO
The Sin God Domain yields to one law.

The thrown car detonates mid-air. Ye Lingxiao stands in the fire, absorbing it. His eyes glow with borrowed heat.

YE LINGXIAO
Power answers to power.

He strikes. Butcher drops. Ye Lingxiao's boot finds his throat. Not pressing. Present.

BLOOD FIEND BUTCHER
(begging)
I can serve! Information, territory—

YE LINGXIAO
You already served your purpose.

Presses down. The sound is final.

Ye Lingxiao stares at the body. The energy around him flickers. Diminishes.

SHENTU LING
Congratulations, God Venerable. You surpass the divine realm. Unmatched.

GUARDS
(in unison)
Unmatched in the world!

YE LINGXIAO
(to himself)
Unmatched. And alone.

YE LINGXIAO
Is my return to Dragon Country prepared?

SHENTU LING
These five years, you unified the Sin God Domain. Nations list you SSS-class. Dragon Country's Four War Gods will mobilize.

YE LINGXIAO
The Four War Gods are outdated. Handle them.

YE LINGXIAO looks to the horizon, where city lights bleed into dawn.

YE LINGXIAO
(to himself)
Five years. Invincible. Yet Xueqing's grave is untended. My father sleeps easy. That ends now.

The energy flares - angrier. Personal.

EXT. AIRPORT TARMAC - DAWN

Black SUVs. Ye Lingxiao stands apart, watching a jet land. His armor is gone. Simple black suit.

Shentu Ling offers a wooden box.

SHENTU LING
Her personal effects?

YE LINGXIAO
My last weakness.

He boards. The door seals. He is alone with the ghosts of his making.

FADE OUT.

title: Untitled Hospital Drama
description: A woman saves her husband's life with her blood, only to be met with cold rejection and disgust.
context:
Title: Untitled Hospital Drama
Description: A woman saves her husband's life with her blood, only to be met with cold rejection and disgust.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Two DOCTORS push a stretcher carrying LU BOCHUAN at high speed. His abdomen is bleeding profusely, and he is unconscious.

DOCTOR
The patient has lost too much blood, we can't stop the bleeding!

ANOTHER DOCTOR
His wife's a rare match—get her prepped!

INT. HOSPITAL LABORATORY - DAY

A DOCTOR is drawing blood from JIANG ZIXI. JIANG ZIXI's face is pale, her body weak.

DOCTOR
Mrs. Lu.

JIANG ZIXI
(weakly)
I'm fine.

JIANG ZIXI
(firmly)
Keep drawing. Saving my husband is what matters.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LU BOCHUAN lies on the hospital bed, still unconscious. JIANG ZIXI sits beside the bed, gently caressing his cheek. A medical BANDAGE covers the crease of her elbow.

LU BOCHUAN slowly opens his eyes. His gaze falls on the bandage.

LU BOCHUAN
(coldly)
...Don't.

JIANG ZIXI
(stunned)
Yunxi.

LU BOCHUAN
Where is Yunxi?

LU BOCHUAN struggles to get up. JIANG ZIXI quickly holds him down.

JIANG ZIXI
Bochuan, you just woke up after losing so much blood. Don't try to get out of bed yet.

LU BOCHUAN
(staring at her bandage)
Lost too much blood. Is that your new refrain?

JIANG ZIXI
I didn't—

LU BOCHUAN
(angrily)
You never do. Always the accident. I'm exhausted watching you perform. Every drop of your blood in my veins feels like a chain.

JIANG ZIXI
(hurt)
Bochuan...

JIANG ZIXI looks at him, her eyes filled with shock and pain.

title: Episode One
description: Gu Mo, the CEO known for his ruthless efficiency, arrives to find his poised secretary Gao Wanyi navigating a delicate threat disguised as mentorship.
context:
Title: Episode One
Description: Gu Mo, the CEO known for his ruthless efficiency, arrives to find his poised secretary Gao Wanyi navigating a delicate threat disguised as mentorship.

TITLE CARD: EPISODE ONE

EXT. INTERNATIONAL FINANCIAL CENTER - DAY

A sleek white sedan stops at the base of the gleaming tower. The door opens—GU MO, early 30s, gray tailored suit, steps out without looking back. His driver hurriedly deposits a briefcase in his hand.

GU MO glances at his watch: 8:47 AM. He strides toward the revolving doors, phone already pressed to his ear.

INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

GU MO crosses the lobby, typing on his phone. Employees freeze, then scatter like fish before a shark.

PASSERBY A (O.S.)
Morning, President Gu.

GU MO doesn't look up—just gives a curt nod, still walking.

A JUNIOR ANALYST trips over herself to hold the elevator, but GU MO has already diverted to the private lift.
continuation:
INT. CEO'S OFFICE - DAY

GAO WANYI, late 20s, immaculate and unflappable, stands at the window with a tablet, briefing PRESIDENT MO (50s, Wencheng Group) who seems visibly impressed.

GAO WANYI
—projections show 23% ROI by Q3. President Gu will confirm the timeline. Please, have a seat.

GU MO enters. GAO WANYI pivots smoothly, extending the tablet.

GAO WANYI
(continuing without pause)
Your 9 AM is here. I've flagged three clauses in the merger draft that need your attention.

PRESIDENT MO
Your secretary's quite the negotiator, President Gu.

GU MO
(taking the tablet)
She doesn't negotiate. She presents facts. Hello, President Mo.

They shake. GU MO's eyes are already scanning the flagged clauses.

ON SCREEN: GU MO, CEO, GU CORPORATION

ON SCREEN: GAO WANYI, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR & CHIEF OF STAFF

INT. BREAK ROOM - DAY

GAO WANYI prepares pour-over coffee with surgical precision. The door clicks shut behind her.

DEPARTMENT HEAD ZHANG (40s, polished, dangerous) leans against the counter, watching.

ZHANG
You're wasting your talent on coffee, Wanyi. The regional director position we discussed—it's still yours. All you have to do is say yes.

GAO WANYI
(pouring water slowly)
My position here is quite sufficient, thank you.

ZHANG
(moving closer)
Sufficient? Or are you just waiting for Gu Mo to notice you? Let me be clear—my recommendation carries weight. But recommendations go both ways.

His hand reaches for her shoulder. GAO WANYI shifts, coffee pot in hand, using it as a barrier.

GAO WANYI
I suggest you step back, Director Zhang. This coffee is very hot.

A SHARP RAP on the glass door. Both turn.

Through the window: GU MO, holding the flagged merger documents, his expression unreadable.

title: Urban Hero's Soul
description: A man diagnosed with a terminal illness at 38 drowns his sorrows in alcohol, only to mysteriously wake up back in his high school classroom.
context:
Title: Urban Hero's Soul
Description: A man diagnosed with a terminal illness at 38 drowns his sorrows in alcohol, only to mysteriously wake up back in his high school classroom.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

A dimly lit bar. CHU FENG sits alone at the bar counter, fingers tracing a hospital envelope.

CHU FENG
(subtitle: Unlucky Chu Feng)
Something with teeth.

The BARTENDER pours a double shot of overproof whiskey.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (FLASHBACK)

The image is overexposed with a whitish tone.

DOCTOR (O.S.)
Pancreatic neuroendocrine carcinoma. Stage four.

CHU FENG looks shocked, staring at ghostly white lesions on a PET scan.

DOCTOR (O.S.)
Conservatively, six months. Perhaps a year if you fight.

The doctor's pager beeps—she's already leaving.

DOCTOR (O.S.)
Go live properly, Mr. Chu.
continuation:
INT. BAR - NIGHT

CHU FENG pulls a graduation photo from the envelope and taps his glass against it in a bitter toast.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (FLASHBACK)

CHU FENG crouches dejectedly in a corner, phone glowing with a text from "Wife."

WOMAN (TEXT)
You still want money? Your life is finished.

CHU FENG deletes his half-written reply: "For her treatment." Sends instead: "Understood."

CHU FENG (V.O.)
Thirty-eight. Senior engineer at a company that folded. Husband to a woman who couldn't wait. Father to a daughter who calls someone else Dad.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

CHU FENG painfully crumples the photo into a ball.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (FLASHBACK)

A WOMAN yells at him furiously, her voice echoing in the empty corridor.

WOMAN (O.S.)
You couldn't even keep us afloat! What happens to our daughter when you're gone?

CHU FENG keeps his head down, crouching on the ground in pain.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

CHU FENG lies slumped over the bar counter, emotionally broken.

CHU FENG
(to himself)
No equity. No family. No way to fix this.

He smiles bitterly, then raises his hand again.

CHU FENG
Another. Same measure.

BARTENDER
Here's your drink, sir.

CHU FENG takes the glass, downs it in one gulp, then slams it down and collapses drunk on the counter.

BARTENDER
(panicking)
Sir! Someone help! Quickly!

INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

The color tone shifts cold, turning cyan-blue.

CHU FENG suddenly wakes to find himself wearing a school uniform, sitting in a high school classroom. He looks around in confusion.

The TEACHER slams the desk hard at the podium.

The blackboard reads "100 Days Until College Entrance Exam."

CHU FENG'S eyes widen in disbelief, seeing the date carved into his desk: April 5, 2005.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: My Love Begins With You
description: A young woman attends a business dinner to help her mother, only to encounter a man from her past who reveals a shocking secret.
context:
Title: My Love Begins With You
Description: A young woman attends a business dinner to help her mother, only to encounter a man from her past who reveals a shocking secret.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

CLOSE UP - A pair of nude-colored high heels walking on a carpeted hallway. The steps are measured, controlled.

Camera tilts up to reveal GU XINING in a white blouse and blue skirt. Determination barely masks her tension.

GU XINING (V.O.)
For Mom's sake. Just get through tonight.

GU XINING arrives at a door marked 1958, swipes her card with a trembling hand, and enters.

INT. HOTEL PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

GENERAL WANG stands too close to GU XINING, his hand a weight on her shoulder. GU XINING holds a wine glass like a shield.

GENERAL WANG
The Fangyuan project is yours. Your mother would be proud.

GU XINING
(frozen smile)
I'm grateful for the opportunity.

The door opens.

JIN BEICHUAN stands motionless in the doorway. His gaze locks with GU XINING's.
continuation:
GENERAL WANG
(standing quickly)
Jin! We didn't expect—

JIN BEICHUAN
(entering)
My plans changed. How fortunate.

His eyes note GENERAL WANG's hand, GU XINING's rigid posture.

JIN BEICHUAN
(to GU XINING)
Jingbei taught us negotiation, didn't it? Some tactics shouldn't require repetition.

GENERAL WANG
Both Jingbei alumni—perfect for the project!

JIN BEICHUAN
A collaborative partnership. That's what we called it.

He moves closer. GU XINING's knuckles whiten on her glass.

JIN BEICHUAN
Six months of research. Shared resources. Shared space.

JIN BEICHUAN
Shared a bed.

CLOSE UP - GU XINING's face. Shock flickers, then something harder: recognition of a trap. Her jaw sets.

title: My Stunning Landlady
description: A young man struggles to pay rent and fix his beautiful landlady's toilet, while daydreaming about her rewarding him in unexpected ways.
context:
Title: My Stunning Landlady
Description: A young man struggles to pay rent and fix his beautiful landlady's toilet, while daydreaming about her rewarding him in unexpected ways.

INT. BATHROOM - DAY

LIN YANG kneels on the floor, wrestling with a plunger. SISTER WEN leans in the doorway, red silk robe cinched tight, arms crossed, watching him.

LIN YANG
(mutters)
Third time this month...

SISTER WEN
(coolly)
Problem?

LIN YANG
Just... wondering what went down this time.

SISTER WEN

LIN YANG's knuckles whiten on the plunger handle.

LIN YANG
Let me try the auger.

He threads the auger into the bowl. SISTER WEN steps closer. LIN YANG pushes harder. A geyser erupts, spraying them both.

SISTER WEN
(sharp gasp)
Shit!

LIN YANG
(frozen)
Sister Wen—

SISTER WEN looks at the water spots on her robe. Her jaw tightens.

SISTER WEN
Two hours.

Candlelight flickers. SISTER WEN appears in a white slip dress.

SISTER WEN
(soft)
Lin Yang.

She perches on the toilet lid. LIN YANG remains kneeling, transfixed.

SISTER WEN
Your hands are bleeding.

LIN YANG
(glancing down)
Are they?

SISTER WEN
Let me see.

She takes his calloused hand, inspecting broken blisters gently.

SISTER WEN
You're always fixing things.

LIN YANG
(voice cracking)
Someone has to.

SISTER WEN leans in, breath warm against his ear.

SISTER WEN
What if you fixed something for yourself instead?

Her fingers brush his jawline. LIN YANG's eyes flutter closed—

LIN YANG jerks awake against his delivery scooter, wiping drool. His phone vibrates.

LIN YANG
(to himself)
Dreams don't pay rent.

Order #58. Pickup in 3 minutes.

LIN YANG scrambles for his thermal bag. His phone rings. He answers.

SISTER WEN (V.O.)
(calm, almost tired)

LIN YANG listens, his expression shifting from confusion to something almost like hope, then quickly hardening into resolve.

title: I Am a Super Tycoon in 2060
description: A man killed in a hit-and-run accident is transported to the year 2060, where global resource surplus has caused extreme price deflation, making his small amount of cash incredibly valuable.
context:
Title: I Am a Super Tycoon in 2060
Description: A man killed in a hit-and-run accident is transported to the year 2060, where global resource surplus has caused extreme price deflation, making his small amount of cash incredibly valuable.

EXT. DOWNTOWN STREET - NIGHT (2024)

JACK MULLEN (40s), weathered hands clutching a brown envelope, steps off the curb. Headlights bear down. Tires SCREAM.

SMASH CUT TO:

EXT. ALLEYWAY - DAY (2060)

Jack lands hard on pristine asphalt. No blood. No pain. The envelope sits beside him, cash spilling out ($200).

He squints at holographic billboards advertising:
"BOTTLED WATER: 2¢ / LUXURY APARTMENT: $1.50/month"

LINA (20s, wearing recycled-tech jumpsuit) rounds the corner.

LINA
Whoa! You can't sleep here. Shelter's three blocks—

She spots the cash. Her eyes widen.

LINA
Is that... paper currency?

JACK
(standing, confused)
Where am I?

LINA
2060. And you're holding a felony.

JACK
It's two hundred bucks.

LINA
That's enough to buy a city block.

INT. AUTOMATED MARKET - CONTINUOUS

Jack and Lina enter. Robotic VENDORS display prices:
"organic apple: 0.001¢" "transport pod: 8¢"

Jack approaches a FOOD VENDOR.

JACK
One coffee.

The vendor scans his $20 bill.

VENDOR
(robotic voice)
Accepted. Your change: $19.9999. Please wait six hours for transaction approval.

Lina pulls him aside, urgent.

LINA
You don't spend it all in one place. Ever. The Resource Authority tracks large transactions.

JACK
So I'm rich but I can't... be rich?

LINA
You need a sponsor. Someone to launder your temporal cash into digital micro-credits.

A uniformed AUTHORITY OFFICER enters, scanning the room.

LINA
(whispering)
Too late. That twenty just flagged us.

OFFICER
(to Jack)
Sir, I need to verify your currency's origin timestamp.

JACK
I don't know what—

LINA
(interrupting)
He's my temporal transfer. Section 7b.

OFFICER
Sponsor papers?

Lina pulls out a forged tablet document. The officer scans it.

OFFICER
(eyes narrowing)
This expires in twenty minutes.

The officer leaves. Lina exhales.

LINA
That cost me my last credit. You're buying me dinner. 1950s-style.
continuation:
EXT. SKYLINE TERRACE - SUNSET

Jack and Lina share canned beans heated over a small fire. The city glows—towering vertical farms, solar skin buildings.

JACK
So you saved me why?

LINA
Everyone deserves a reset. Even ghosts from the waste era.

JACK
I was a ghost before. Working paycheck to paycheck...

He holds up the remaining cash.

JACK
Now I'm a king with paper.

LINA
(shaking her head)
You're a target. Tomorrow we digitize that money. Give you a real life.

JACK
And if I don't want to? If I want to burn it all at once?

LINA
Then you learn why deflation's a curse. One man's fortune is everyone's poverty.

Beat. Jack looks at the city, then at his worn hands.

JACK
Let's digitize it. But you keep half.

LINA
(startled)
What?

JACK
You gave me a future. Seems fair.

Lina smiles. First genuine smile.

LINA
Welcome to 2060, Jack.

FADE OUT.

title: Blood Wolf Hall
description: A former heir to a powerful organization is called back after being betrayed and exiled years ago, only to find himself drawn into a conspiracy involving a stolen artifact and danger to his loved one.
context:
Title: Blood Wolf Hall
Description: A former heir to a powerful organization is called back after being betrayed and exiled years ago, only to find himself drawn into a conspiracy involving a stolen artifact and danger to his loved one.

EXT. HELIPAD - DAY

A helicopter touches down. ZHUQUE, sharp-suited, steps onto the tarmac.

Three black SUVs screech to a halt, dust billowing.

CHEN TIANQI, white jacket, stands surrounded by CAMOUFLAGE SOLDIERS.

ZHUQUE walks straight toward CHEN TIANQI.

ZHUQUE
Zhuque, Guardian of Blood Wolf Hall, greets the Young Master!

The SOLDIERS kneel as one.

SOLDIERS (in unison)
We greet the Young Master!

CHEN TIANQI
Blood Wolf Hall is dead to me. You've wasted a trip.

ZHUQUE
The Old Hall Master issued twelve Blood Wolf Orders before his death. You must return and take charge.

CHEN TIANQI
(coldly)
The same man who ordered my execution? If Second Master Ye hadn't bartered his life for mine, I'd be dust in a mass grave. You have Chen Tianyu. Find him.
continuation:
INT. DARK ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

CHEN TIANQI, bound and bleeding, crumples from a blow.

His brother, CHEN TIANYU, watches with a cold smile.

CHEN TIANYU
A bastard who steals secrets deserves a dog's death.

CHEN TIANQI
(struggling)
Grandfather, I was framed!

The OLD HALL MASTER, stone-faced, turns away.

OLD HALL MASTER
Beat him until he stops breathing. Feed him to the dogs.

SECOND MASTER YE, old but steady, steps between them.

SECOND MASTER YE
Hall Master, executing him without proof will split the council.

OLD HALL MASTER
Then leave with him. Your life's work for his.

CHEN TIANYU
(angrily)
Rebellion! Out! All of you!

EXT. HELIPAD - DAY

ZHUQUE
Young Master, you may not know. After the Old Hall Master died, Chen Tianyu disappeared. The Blood Wolf Talisman was stolen.

She moves closer.

ZHUQUE
That talisman controls our global shipping network. Without it, Blood Wolf Hall shatters. Wars will ignite.

CHEN TIANQI
Then let it burn.

He turns to his electric scooter.

A SOLDIER runs up, thrusting a phone at ZHUQUE.

SOLDIER
Lady Zhuque, from the Fan asset!

ZHUQUE takes it. Her face pales. She rushes toward CHEN TIANQI.

ZHUQUE
Young Master, your wife is in danger!

CHEN TIANQI
(grabbing her arm)
What happened to Qingcheng?

ZHUQUE hands him the phone. The screen shows QINGCHENG unconscious. A man with a syringe kneels beside her.

CHEN TIANQI watches, his grip crushing the phone's frame.

title: The Nation's Mighty Dragon
description: A powerful commander returns to eliminate an international criminal who traffics children and threatens national security.
context:
Title: The Nation's Mighty Dragon
Description: A powerful commander returns to eliminate an international criminal who traffics children and threatens national security.

INT. HELICOPTER - DAY

SOUND of helicopter blades whirring.

A helicopter flies over a coastal city at dusk.

Inside, MU SHAOFENG, dressed in a black leather coat, sits calmly. He opens a vintage pocket watch, revealing a photo of a young girl—his daughter.

CAN LANG (V.O.)
Sir, we've confirmed the location. Port 7 warehouse. Six children inside.

MU SHAOFENG
Land. This ends tonight.

He closes the pocket watch with a determined look.

EXT. AIRFIELD - DAY

CAN LANG leads a group of soldiers in tactical gear. They stand in formation as the helicopter lands.

MU SHAOFENG exits the helicopter with a commanding presence.

SOLDIERS
(in unison)
Welcome, General!

The soldiers kneel on one knee in two rows, creating a path for MU SHAOFENG.

MU SHAOFENG walks forward, followed by CAN LANG.

MU SHAOFENG
All units, extract the children. Poison Fang is mine.

SOLDIERS
(in unison)
Yes, sir!
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Two terrified CHILDREN are huddled together inside a large metal cage.

POISON FANG, with a distinctive wolf tattoo, crouches by the cage, taunting them.

POISON FANG
Such clear eyes. Such healthy organs. You'll make me rich.

A SUBORDINATE approaches him.

SUBORDINATE
Boss, everything's ready for tomorrow's shipment.

Suddenly, a voice echoes through the warehouse.

MU SHAOFENG (V.O.)
Poison Fang. You traffic children, collude with foreign powers, threaten national security.

POISON FANG and his men look around, startled.

POISON FANG
Who's there? Show yourself!

MU SHAOFENG (V.O.)
Three crimes. One sentence.

MU SHAOFENG walks into the light, confronting them.

POISON FANG
You're a dead man walking.

MU SHAOFENG
(smiles)
Justice doesn't wait.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED
