title: The Prince's Awakening
description: A modern man finds himself transported into an ancient painting, awakening as the Crown Prince of the Great Qin Empire, only to discover a conspiracy against him.
context:
Title: The Prince's Awakening
Description: A modern man finds himself transported into an ancient painting, awakening as the Crown Prince of the Great Qin Empire, only to discover a conspiracy against him.

INT. MODERN OFFICE - DAY

A young man in a suit (THE PRINCE) sits in a luxurious office chair, slowly unrolling an ancient scroll painting.

THE PRINCE (V.O.)
Seventy million yuan for a painting. The board wants my head, but the Jade Maiden... she recognized me.

He traces the woman's face with his finger. The silk seems to breathe beneath his touch. The lights flicker—then die. The city skyline dissolves into darkness.

The woman in the painting turns her head. Looks at him.

THE PRINCE
(whisper)
That's not—

ZHAO RUI (O.S.)
Am I beautiful?

THE PRINCE recoils. ZHAO RUI stands before him—identical to the painting, but alive. Breathing.

Reality warps. The office dissolves like ink in water.

INT. ANCIENT PALACE CHAMBER - DAY

THE PRINCE snaps awake in ancient robes, his head pillowed on ZHAO RUI's lap. The scent of sandalwood fills his lungs.

THE PRINCE
(struggling upright)
I was just—

ZHAO RUI
(gently)
Your Highness. You fainted.

She holds a calligraphy brush, ink still wet on the tip.

ZHAO RUI (CONT'D)
(leaning close)
There's a mark I've been meaning to show you. A mole, here.

THE PRINCE
(fighting dizziness)
My office. The painting—

Pain lances through his skull. Memories bloom: a crown, a throne room, this woman's face at a court ceremony.

THE PRINCE (V.O.)
Hostile takeover. I'm wearing another man's sins.

ZHAO RUI
continuation:
Your Highness?

THE PRINCE looks at her—really looks. The careful way she holds herself. The rehearsed blush.

THE PRINCE
Show me.

ZHAO RUI
(breath catching)
Your Highness...

She reaches for her collar.

THE PRINCE (V.O.)
Six months ago, she entered the Eastern Palace. The old me treated her like a goddess. Untouchable. But her pulse is too steady.

THE PRINCE grabs her wrist.

THE PRINCE
Tell me, Zhao Rui... if you were truly mine, what would you give up for me?

ZHAO RUI
Everything. I am devoted—

THE PRINCE
Even your clan? The Prime Minister's ambitions? The Empress's favor?

ZHAO RUI
(panicking)
I don't understand what you—

THE PRINCE
You understand perfectly. They sent you to make me weak. Distracted. To prove I'm unfit for the succession.

ZHAO RUI
(voice shaking)
I'm just a woman.

THE PRINCE
(finger to her lips)
No. You're a battlefield. And I intend to win.

THE PRINCE tears her garment slightly at the shoulder. The silk whispers.

ZHAO RUI
(startled)
They'll say you're depraved.

THE PRINCE
(smiling)
Then let them. Let them see exactly what they wanted.

THE PRINCE leans in. The screen fades to black.

Title: Dragon Hall of Great Xia
Description: The master of Dragon Hall discovers his long-lost granddaughter has been imprisoned and abused, and immediately mobilizes his forces to rescue her.

INT. DRAGON HALL GREAT CHAMBER - DAY

A magnificent great hall with a long red carpet. Black-clad GUARDS stand on both sides in solemn formation.

ZHUGE XUANYI
Martial God, Zhuge Xuanyi, pays respects to the Hall Master.

GUIGU YONG leads a group of disciples up the red carpet, bowing collectively.

GUIGU YONG
Medical Saint Guigu Yong, pays respects to the Hall Master.

ALL
(in unison)
We pay respects to the Hall Master!

LONG WANNIAN sits on the throne at the end of the hall, gripping a surveillance photograph that shows a distinctive birthmark.

LONG WANNIAN
The mark convinces.

HAN XIAO kneels on the ground, reporting with controlled urgency.

HAN XIAO

Post it: Imperial Grand Hotel refuses entry to marked women.

She'll hide forever.

title: The Tycoon Goes South
description: A powerful master maintains order among his subordinates in a brutal hierarchy, where even the strongest warriors must submit or face severe punishment.
context:
Title: The Tycoon Goes South
Description: A powerful master maintains order among his subordinates in a brutal hierarchy, where even the strongest warriors must submit or face severe punishment.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

A group of people are brawling on the grass.

CHEN LONG and SHOU SHEN face off against each other.

CHEN LONG
Your shadow has challenged mine for three years. Today it ends.

SHOU SHEN
My people starve while your coffers swell. The debt comes due.

CHEN LONG
The Young Master's law is clear. Challenge me, and we both fall.

SHOU SHEN
Then let him come. I no longer fear the fall.

CHEN LONG
So be it.

The two begin fighting fiercely. SHOU SHEN releases an energy wave, knocking CHEN LONG back.
continuation:
EXT. STREAM - DAY

WU QI QIANG floats above the stream water, meditating. He suddenly opens his eyes.

WU QI QIANG
Shou Shen's heart is breaking. Chen Long's is already stone.

WU QI QIANG disappears instantly.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

WU QI QIANG suddenly appears between CHEN LONG and SHOU SHEN, knocking both to the ground with one strike.

CHEN LONG and SHOU SHEN kneel on the ground, begging for mercy.

CHEN LONG
Young Master, have mercy! The fault was mine—I baited him about the famine!

WU QI QIANG
You think mercy is what he needs? You think it's what you deserve?

SHOU SHEN
Young Master, my sister's children... they haven't eaten in days. I lost control.

WU QI QIANG
Compassion without discipline is just another form of chaos. Break your sword arms. Without energy. Show me you're still warriors.

SHOU SHEN and CHEN LONG each painfully break their own arms.

WU QI QIANG
(to the watching men in black)
And you jackals, hoping to scavenge promotion from their pain. Ten laps. Full armor. Now.

WU QI QIANG kicks out. All the men in black fall to the ground.

DOCTOR POISON (O.S.)
You let them keep their pride. I would have taken their heads.

A man wearing a skull mask and conical hat, DOCTOR POISON, appears.

WU QI QIANG
(respectfully)
Master.

DOCTOR POISON
Your compassion is emerging. It will destroy everything I've built.

DOCTOR POISON kicks WU QI QIANG to the ground.

CHEN LONG
(terrified)
Ghost Commander.

title: Love Ends
description: A man confronts his estranged wife in the rain, where her desperate plea for help reveals buried truths about their past, while their critically ill daughter's life hangs in the balance.
context:
Title: Love Ends
Description: A man confronts his estranged wife in the rain, where her desperate plea for help reveals buried truths about their past, while their critically ill daughter's life hangs in the balance.

EXT. ROAD IN THE RAIN - NIGHT

Torrential rain hammers the asphalt. A black Rolls-Royce cuts through the downpour, headlights catching a figure ahead.

YIN HUI sits collapsed on the roadside, drenched, her thin dress plastered to her frame. She shields her eyes against the blinding lights.

The Rolls-Royce stops inches from her. The passenger door opens.

A YAN emerges, immaculate in a tailored suit. A BODYGUARD immediately holds an umbrella over him, keeping the rain at bay.

A YAN pulls a thick envelope from his breast pocket. He fans the cash—hundreds, thousands—then lets the wind scatter them across the wet pavement.

A YAN
For your performance.

YIN HUI
(whispering)
A Yan...

A YAN
Get up. You're embarrassing yourself.

YIN HUI
(struggling to stand)
She's dying. Our daughter—

A YAN
(flinching at "our")
Don't.

YIN HUI
Please. Just one test. One DNA test. Yiyi is yours. She has your eyes, your—

A YAN
I said don't.
(beat)
Five years ago, you vanished. With my child inside you. Now you return with a dying daughter and a new story?

YIN HUI
It wasn't a story. Yao Qiaoqiao threatened—she had evidence that could ruin you. She forced me to leave, to sign those papers—

A YAN
(laughs, sharp and hollow)
Of course. The villainess. And the man you were photographed with?

YIN HUI
(voice breaking)
A friend. Only a friend who helped me hide. I kept our baby, A Yan. I kept her.

A YAN
And lost her. Just like you lost us.

He moves to leave. Yin Hui lunges forward, grasping his sleeve. The bodyguard tenses.

YIN HUI
If you ever loved me...

A YAN
(quietly, not turning)
That man died five years ago.

He shakes free. The car door closes. The Rolls-Royce melts into the darkness.

Yin Hui watches the taillights fade, then slowly, methodically, begins gathering the soaked bills from the pavement.

YIN HUI
(to herself)
Mommy has the deposit. Mommy's coming.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The specialized oncology ward is painfully bright. YIN HUI, now in clean but faded clothes, clutches a hospital admission form in one hand and the damp envelope in the other.

She approaches the CHARGE NURSE at the reception desk.

YIN HUI
The deposit. It's here. Fifty thousand. Please, can we start Yiyi's treatment?

The nurse scrolls through a tablet, expression neutral.

CHARGE NURSE
Yin Yi, room 403. Balance due: three hundred fifty thousand. Without full payment by end of day, they can't proceed with the marrow extraction.

YIN HUI
(desperately)
She'll be gone by then. The fever's consuming her.

CHARGE NURSE
(policy-weary)
I need to unbook the OR. There are other children.

The nurse turns away. Yin Hui stands frozen, the envelope trembling in her grip.

From down the corridor, a doctor's phone rings. He answers, listens, then looks directly at Yin Hui.

DOCTOR
(into phone)
Confirmed. We'll prepare transfer papers.

He hangs up, approaches Yin Hui. His professional mask slips, revealing something colder.

DOCTOR
You're Yin Hui? The mother?

YIN HUI
Yes—has something changed?

DOCTOR
Your daughter's being transferred to a private facility. Full coverage. Though God knows why anyone would invest in that outcome.

YIN HUI
(confused)
What? Who?

A hand clamps on her shoulder from behind—firm, immovable.

A YAN
(voice low)
I would.

Yin Hui whirls. A Yan stands there, no umbrella, no guards, just the raw aftermath of the storm in his eyes.

A YAN
(to Doctor)
Take her. Now.

The doctor nods, moving toward Yiyi's room. Yin Hui tries to follow, but A Yan's grip tightens—not cruel, but unyielding.

A YAN
She'll receive the best care. You and I have paperwork to settle.

YIN HUI
(struggling)
Let me go to her!

A YAN
(quietly fierce)
You wanted me to believe? Fine. But belief comes with a price. And you're going to pay it.

The doctor wheels a gurney past them. A small, frail form lies beneath sterile sheets. Yin Hui reaches out, fingers brushing the fabric as it passes.

A Yan watches her face—not with triumph, but with something that might be grief, might be vengeance, might be both.

He doesn't release her arm.

title: The Queen's Master Painter
description: A modern fitness coach is transported to ancient times after touching a mysterious three-bead necklace, where he is mistaken for a painter summoned to paint the prince's portrait.
context:
Title: The Queen's Master Painter
Description: A modern fitness coach is transported to ancient times after touching a mysterious three-bead necklace, where he is mistaken for a painter summoned to paint the prince's portrait.

INT. GYM - DAY

YE TIAN frames LILY through his phone, movements precise. Lily poses in workout gear.

YE TIAN
Chin down. Core tight. Perfect.

YE TIAN
That's the shot.

Two GIRLS in workout clothes nearby watch, impressed.

GIRL A
(whispering)
He makes everyone look like a star.

LILY straightens, moving to Ye Tian with a practiced smile.

LILY
Coach Ye, these need to be flawless. My brand depends on it.

YE TIAN
(reviewing photos)
Composition's perfect. But this necklace...

He zooms on the image. The three beads seem to trap light.

LILY
(proudly)
Three Unity Beads. Ancient tech from grandpa. They align things.

YE TIAN
(skeptical)
Align what?

LILY
Everything. Try it.

She places the three beads on a weight bench. They roll into a triangle.

YE TIAN
Mysticism breaks my focus.

LILY
Scared?

YE TIAN
(scoffs)
Of beads?

To prove it, he flicks the center bead. They SNAP together.

A BLINDING GREEN LIGHT erupts. The beads VANISH, fused to his finger as a glowing mark.

YE TIAN
(voice warping)
What—

The vortex CONSUMES him. His phone drops—Lily's shocked face filling the screen as he VANISHES.
continuation:
EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

Ye Tian JOLTS awake on a stone stool. Modern gym clothes, but his hair is now in an ancient topknot with a pin. He touches it, bewildered.

Two HANDMAIDENS in pink ancient costumes watch.

HANDMAIDEN A
Another one. Third this moon.

HANDMAIDEN B
At least his hair accepted the binding. That's a sign.

They approach. Ye Tian scrambles up.

HANDMAIDEN A
The Prince's portrait. Due before the eclipse. You the painter?

YE TIAN
(confused)
Portrait? Eclipse? The beads...

HANDMAIDEN A
You know the artifact? Spies who steal qi die first.

HANDMAIDEN B
General Qin's orders. Verify or eliminate.

They grab his arms to drag him. Ye Tian's FITNESS TRACKER BEEPS.

HANDMAIDEN A
Warning charm?

A female GENERAL QIN ZHAO in armor appears at the entrance.

QIN ZHAO
(deadly calm)
You wear displacement qi. You speak of the artifact. But your garments insult our rites. Explain. Now.

Ye Tian looks from his tracker to her blade. Trapped.

title: The Blind Young Master of a Wealthy Family Cannot Be Bullied
description: A blind massage therapist discovers his ex-wife's betrayal when he is humiliated by a wealthy hotel manager during what he thought would be a routine service call.
context:
Title: The Blind Young Master of a Wealthy Family Cannot Be Bullied
Description: A blind massage therapist discovers his ex-wife's betrayal when he is humiliated by a wealthy hotel manager during what he thought would be a routine service call.

INT. MASSAGE PARLOR HALLWAY - DAY

A hushed corridor lined with gilt-framed paintings. Potted palms cast long shadows across marble floors.

LIN YU (30s, composed, wearing sunglasses and a crisp white coat) taps his cane with practiced efficiency. A blue toolkit hangs from his shoulder, its leather worn from years of expert use. He trails his fingers along the wallpaper, not groping—memorizing.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

A luxury suite's living area. LIU TIANHAO (40, predatory grace) reclines on a velvet sofa, his silk shirt unbuttoned. LIU YIYI (28, brittle beauty) sits stiff beside him, her hand resting on his chest like a caged bird.

LIU TIANHAO
(subtitle: Wanhao Hotel General Manager Liu Tianhao)
Your blind ex-husband has a booking. Shall we make it memorable?

LIU TIANHAO
(low, intimate)
I've always wanted to see a man massage his own coffin.

LIU YIYI
(subtitle: Lin Yu's Ex-Wife Liu Yiyi)
(quietly)
Don't. Please.

LIU TIANHAO
(smiling)
Too late, my dear. The game's begun.

The door opens. LIN YU enters, stopping precisely three paces inside.

LIN YU
(subtitle: Massage Therapist Lin Yu)
Technician 66. I'm here for the deep tissue booking.

LIN YU
(handing over a card)
My certification includes sports rehabilitation and circulatory therapy.

LIU TIANHAO
(ignoring the card)
Wonderful. Start with my feet. While kneeling.

LIN YU
Sir, my service includes a portable table. I'll set it up—

LIU TIANHAO
continuation:

freezes. His cane stops mid-tap.

title: The Young Healer Disciple
description: A young herbalist is seduced by his senior brother's widow when he comes to deliver medicine.
context:
Title: The Young Healer Disciple
Description: A young herbalist is seduced by his senior brother's widow when he comes to deliver medicine.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

JIN LIANZI (32) wears a faded red robe, sits by the window, lost in grief.

HUANG XIAOYAO (19) enters with herbs, stops short, surprised.

HUANG XIAOYAO
Sister-in-law? The shop was closed—

JIN LIANZI rises, looks at him, walks toward him with measured steps.

JIN LIANZI
Three years today. Since Meng Sheng left.

HUANG XIAOYAO
Sister-in-law, the medicine.

HUANG XIAOYAO hands it over. JIN LIANZI takes it, sets it aside, her fingers brushing his.

HUANG XIAOYAO
(flustered)
I should go. Xiao Lian expects me.

JIN LIANZI
You've become the man he dreamed. While I've been alone. Watching.

JIN LIANZI steps closer. HUANG XIAOYAO stands firm, torn.

JIN LIANZI
(soft)
The village whispers about this widow. They're right. I'm hungry.

JIN LIANZI suddenly embraces him—desperate, not seductive.

HUANG XIAOYAO
(startled)
Sister-in-law, please...

JIN LIANZI
(whispered)
Just hold me. Pretend he's here.
continuation:
HUANG XIAOYAO
(struggling)
I can't. I'm not his ghost.

JIN LIANZI kisses him—grief, not lust. He doesn't yield, but doesn't push her away.

JIN LIANZI
(broken)
Teach me to feel alive again.

Her hands tremble on his robes. He gently pries them off.

HUANG XIAOYAO
(quiet strength)
He asked me to care for you. Better than this.

JIN LIANZI
(laugh that becomes a sob)
That girl is blessed.

She lunges again—a collapse. He catches her.

JIN LIANZI
(whispered in his ear)
I'm afraid I'll forget his face.

HUANG XIAOYAO
(soft)
Let me help you remember. Properly.

He guides her to sit, places the medicine in her hands.

HUANG XIAOYAO
These calm the heart. I'll come daily. As family.

JIN LIANZI's face shows pain crumble into relief.

JIN LIANZI
(voice breaking)
Don't leave me.

HUANG XIAOYAO
I'm here. Not as him. As me.

He sits beside her, a healing hand on her shoulder. Grief shared is grief halved.

title: Dragon King in the City
description: The mysterious founder of a trillion-dollar empire rejects worldly glory and disguises himself as a security guard, but danger follows him.
context:
Title: Dragon King in the City
Description: The mysterious founder of a trillion-dollar empire rejects worldly glory and disguises himself as a security guard, but danger follows him.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY VENUE - NIGHT

Aerial shot of the city at night, brightly lit.

The HOST stands on stage, smiling.

HOST
Ladies and gentlemen, good evening! Tonight's grand reveal: the Global Super Business Empire rankings.

The audience watches expectantly.

HOST
The champion: Yuhao Group, valued at two trillion dollars!

Enthusiastic applause erupts from the audience.

HOST
Please welcome founder Song Yuhao!

Thunderous applause. The spotlight sweeps the stage. Silence. Then, from offstage—

BAI FENG (O.S.)
I am Mr. Song's assistant, Bai Feng.

An elegant woman in a black sequined slip dress steps into the spotlight.

BAI FENG
Mr. Song built this empire to create opportunity from nothing. He doesn't seek fame. This honor belongs to his people. Thank you.

BAI FENG finishes speaking, bows slightly, turns and leaves.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Inside the room, a man wearing a golden mask (SONG YUHAO) faces away from the door, looking out the window.

A FEMALE SUBORDINATE in black tactical clothing walks in quickly.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
Master, the uniform you requested.

SONG YUHAO turns around. The FEMALE SUBORDINATE hands him a black shopping bag.

SONG YUHAO takes the bag and pulls out a security guard uniform.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE (confused)
A security uniform, Master?

SONG YUHAO
You're managing the Group now. That's all you need to know.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE (surprised)
But I—

SONG YUHAO
No need to say more. You may go.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
Yes.

The FEMALE SUBORDINATE bows and turns to leave.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR/ROOM ENTRANCE - DAY

The FEMALE SUBORDINATE opens the door. Three figures in golden skull masks emerge from the shadows, blades glinting.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE (alert)
Who are you?

The screen flickers and ends.

title: Eternal Immortal King
description: A powerful cultivator's soul is reborn into the body of a dying young man, awakening a mysterious system that grants enlightenment to master martial arts.
context:
Title: Eternal Immortal King
Description: A powerful cultivator's soul is reborn into the body of a dying young man, awakening a mysterious system that grants enlightenment to master martial arts.

INT. GREAT HALL - NIGHT

Red malevolent energy swirls through shattered pillars. SENIOR BROTHER (30s, elegant robes torn) crawls across the bloody floor toward a fallen disciple.

SENIOR BROTHER
Who are you? Why annihilate Purple Gold Peak?

A tall figure in black robes (BLACK-ROBED MAN) stands amidst the carnage, power crackling visibly around him.

SENIOR BROTHER
(shocked)
Tribulation Transcendence... late stage.

His fingers brush the cold hand of a dead girl beside him.

SENIOR BROTHER
Ming'er...

A woman (JUNIOR SISTER) stumbles in, white dress soaked in blood, positioning herself between them.

SENIOR BROTHER
Go quickly!

JUNIOR SISTER
(resolute)
I'll defend you with my life.

SENIOR BROTHER
Junior Sister, you're no match for him.

JUNIOR SISTER
(to BLACK-ROBED MAN)
Don't even think about harming my Senior Brother!

BLACK-ROBED MAN
(contemptuous)
So weak, yet you dare try to kill me.

BLACK-ROBED MAN waves his hand. JUNIOR SISTER is sent flying and falls dead.

SENIOR BROTHER
(grief-stricken)
Junior Sister! Junior Sister!

BLACK-ROBED MAN
Die together.

BLACK-ROBED MAN launches a fatal strike. The screen is consumed by red energy.

SENIOR BROTHER (V.O.)
I promised I'd protect her...
continuation:
EXT. FOREST - DAY

SENIOR BROTHER's consciousness awakens in a ragged young man (LIN FENG) lying on the leaf-covered ground.

LIN FENG
(confused)
Where is this?

He looks at his hands and tattered clothes.

LIN FENG
How did I become like this?

LIN FENG clutches his chest, feeling sharp pain.

LIN FENG
Spiritual veins... shattered. What's going on?

He finds a book in his chest pocket and pulls it out.

LIN FENG
(reading the title)
Collapsing Mountain Fist, Yellow Grade Lower Rank technique.

Two cultivators in blue training clothes (LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 1 and LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 2) approach and discover LIN FENG.

LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 1
(cold smirk)
Still breathing? Must've been a weak dose.

LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 2
Lin Feng. Hand it over.

LIN FENG
(to himself)
Lin Feng... is that my name?

LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 1
We destroyed your qi sea, yet you still survived.

LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 2
You're just a mongrel stepson. How dare you possess our Lin Family's secret manual?

LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 1
The manual. Now.

LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 2
Or we finish what we started.

LIN FENG
(internal)
Die again? Or...

Suddenly, everything around him freezes. The two LIN FAMILY CULTIVATORS remain motionless mid-draw of their swords.

LIN FAMILY CULTIVATOR 1
(voice frozen)
Why can't I—

A small boy in light-colored clothes (SYSTEM) appears out of thin air, slowly walking toward LIN FENG.

LIN FENG
(alert)
Who are you?

SYSTEM
Your technique. From before.

LIN FENG
What?

SYSTEM
The "Collapsing Mountain Fist" you perfected. When you fell, I fell with you.

LIN FENG
Why did I become another person?

SYSTEM
I attached your spirit soul to a dying body. I was formed from your cultivation technique—I only activate when your life is in mortal danger.

SYSTEM finishes speaking and disappears in a flash of golden light.

A blue virtual prompt box appears before LIN FENG's eyes.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Enlightenment Point: 1. Survive. Use it.

Time resumes around him. The two LIN FAMILY CULTIVATORS continue charging toward LIN FENG.

LIN FENG
(shouting at the air)
Wait!

LIN FENG looks at the "Collapsing Mountain Fist" manual in his hand, then at the approaching enemies.

LIN FENG
(determined)
Then let me comprehend this. System, use one Enlightenment.

LIN FENG closes his eyes and begins flipping through the manual.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Host comprehends Collapsing Mountain Fist skill. One Enlightenment Point consumed.

LIN FENG's consciousness enters a golden space. Countless texts and images about the fist technique flood into his mind.

LIN FENG (V.O.)
Spirit and intent combined, body and technique unified. The essence flows directly into my primordial spirit. Is this the Enlightenment System?

LIN FENG opens his eyes, now sharp and focused. He stands up, assumes a fighting stance, and golden light emanates from his fists.

title: The Paranoid Wife of the Obsessed CEO Gu
description: A pregnant woman fleeing in the rain gives birth, only to be accused by her husband of murder and adultery, leading to her arrest.
context:
Title: The Paranoid Wife of the Obsessed CEO Gu
Description: A pregnant woman fleeing in the rain gives birth, only to be accused by her husband of murder and adultery, leading to her arrest.

EXT. HIGHWAY - NIGHT

Rain slashes across the asphalt. JING YAN (28, drenched hospital gown, bleeding leg wound) stumbles along the shoulder, clutching her belly.

A taxi emerges through the downpour. Jingyan waves frantically, nearly collapsing in its path.

INT. TAXI - NIGHT

JING YAN sprawls in the back seat, water pooling beneath her.

JING YAN
(gasping)
Hospital... please—

The taxi accelerates into the night.

ONE WEEK LATER

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

JING YAN lies on the sofa, pale but smiling down at a bassinet. Afternoon light filters softly.

The door opens. GU SHEN (35, tailored suit, dark circles under his eyes) enters with two BODYGUARDS. He freezes at the sight.

JING YAN
(gently)
Gu Shen... come see her.

GU SHEN's expression hardens. He pulls a document from inside his jacket.

GU SHEN
(cold)
The DNA results came back.
continuation:
JING YAN
(quietly)
What?

GU SHEN
She's not mine.

JING YAN
(confused)
What are you—

GU SHEN
(to bodyguards)
Take her.

JING YAN
(panicked)
Gu Shen, wait—

GU SHEN
(furious)
Xinyi died from an overdose. Your prescription. Your handwriting. And this child...

His voice cracks slightly, eyes not leaving the baby.

GU SHEN
...isn't mine. Detectives are downstairs.

The bodyguards lift JING YAN from the sofa. She struggles weakly.

JING YAN
(desperate)
Please... just look at her—

GU SHEN turns away, his expression unreadable. The BABY begins to CRY.

GU SHEN remains motionless, his eyes closed.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

YE NANXI (V.O.)
Three years I've waited. Watched him destroy her piece by piece. Today, she stopped letting him.

ASSISTANT
Young Master, the board will say she's—

YE NANXI
(sternly)
She survived alone. What does that make us?
continuation:
EXT. OUTSIDE CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - DAY

SU AN crouches on the ground, picking up the scattered cards. Her fingers brush a locket at her throat.

SU AN (V.O.)

SU AN
(quietly)
Keep going. Always keep going.

YE NANXI walks over and crouches down to pick up a card.

YE NANXI
(reading the flyer)
"Must value loyalty above all."

SU AN looks up and sees YE NANXI. She freezes—recognition flickering.

SU AN (V.O.)
Those eyes. I've seen them in business journals.

YE NANXI
You're looking in the wrong place.

SU AN
And you're the right one?

YE NANXI
I don't scare easy.

SU AN
(simultaneously)
Got your ID?

YE NANXI
(smiling)
And the rings.

SU AN
(taking out a marriage certificate)
Express appointment. My treat.

YE NANXI
(smiling)
Su An, this time I'm not letting you escape.

The two walk out of the Civil Affairs Bureau holding red marriage certificates.

YE NANXI
One more signature needed.

SU AN
Where?

YE NANXI
What, are you scared?

SU AN
In broad daylight, you can't possibly sell me off, can you?

YE NANXI leads SU AN into a magnificent, luxurious mansion. A row of MAIDS bow in unison.

(in unison)

title: A Wealthy Son-in-Law and a Top-Tier Goddess
description: A security guard goes on a blind date and unexpectedly meets a beautiful billionaire CEO who is looking for a father for her son.
context:
Title: A Wealthy Son-in-Law and a Top-Tier Goddess
Description: A security guard goes on a blind date and unexpectedly meets a beautiful billionaire CEO who is looking for a father for her son.

INT. COMPANY HALLWAY - DAY

A WOMAN hands folded paper to security guard FANG ZHIQIANG.

WOMAN (O.S.)
Room six. She's already rejected three men.

FANG ZHIQIANG walks forward holding the paper. A GOLD DIGGER stumbles out of Room Six, phone to her ear.

GOLD DIGGER
Another security guard?

She bumps him. The paper falls open—a child's crayon drawing.

GOLD DIGGER
That's your resume?

She scoffs and exits. Fang folds the drawing.

INT. VIP ROOM EXTERIOR/INTERIOR - DAY

FANG ZHIQIANG enters. WANG YAXIN looks up from her tea.

WANG YAXIN
You're not the banker.

FANG ZHIQIANG
He sent me instead.

WANG YAXIN
Why?

FANG ZHIQIANG
My nephew drew this.

He shows the drawing: three stick figures holding hands.

WANG YAXIN
continuation:
My son stopped drawing families.

She slides a folder across the table.

WANG YAXIN
I'm Wang Yaxin. CEO. I need a father, not a husband.

FANG ZHIQIANG opens the folder. A contract.

TANGTANG (O.S.)
Did you sign it?

TANGTANG peeks from behind a screen, holding a toy stethoscope.

TANGTANG
Mommy's heart is broken. Can you fix it?

WANG YAXIN
Tangtang—

TANGTANG
You said I could choose.

He puts the stethoscope in Fang's hand.

TANGTANG
If you hear it cracking, you have to stay.

He exits. Wang Yaxin wipes her eyes.

WANG YAXIN
He hasn't spoken in six months.

Fang looks at the stethoscope, the contract, the drawing.

FANG ZHIQIANG (V.O.)
I came for a blind date. I'm leaving with a broken heart and a toy doctor kit.

WANG YAXIN
Sign it before I change my mind.

The contract waits. The drawing trembles in Fang's hand.

title: Shallow Marriage, Deep Love
description: A woman trapped in a loveless marriage endures her husband's cruelty while desperately hoping for his affection.
context:
Title: Shallow Marriage, Deep Love
Description: A woman trapped in a loveless marriage endures her husband's cruelty while desperately hoping for his affection.

INT. LU FAMILY VILLA - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

SONG WANQING sits alone on the sofa, clutching a medical bill from three years ago. The door opens. LU MING, dressed in a suit and visibly drunk, stumbles in.

SONG WANQING
(standing up, voice steady)
You're home.

LU MING
(eyes cold)
Song Wanqing, let's get divorced.

SONG WANQING
(smile freezing, forcing composure)
The probate hearing is next month. You agreed to five years.

SONG WANQING steps forward to help the swaying LU MING.

LU MING
(pushing her away)
Don't touch me!

SONG WANQING is pushed to the ground, the bill falling from her hand.

LU MING
(looking down at her, voice contemptuous)
Three years ago, while my father was dying, you and my grandmother conspired to chain me to this. What did you expect?

LU MING
I'll ask you one more time. Are we getting divorced or not?

SONG WANQING
(tears in her eyes, stubbornly)
No.

LU MING
(laughing bitterly in anger)
No?

LU MING suddenly leans down and grabs SONG WANQING by the throat.

LU MING
Then honor the contract you wrote.

SONG WANQING
(struggling)
Let me go!

LU MING
(moving closer, eyes vicious)
You bought five years, Song Wanqing. You've got two left.

SONG WANQING
(crying)
I won't divorce...

LU MING
Shut up. Your tears won't change the terms.

LU MING roughly pins SONG WANQING down on the sofa. The screen fades to black.
continuation:
INT. LU FAMILY VILLA - BEDROOM - DAY

The next morning. LU MING stands by the bed adjusting his suit, his knuckles bruised. SONG WANQING enters carrying a bowl of hangover soup, a determined smile on her face.

SONG WANQING
Brother Ming, you're awake. I made you some hangover soup. Drink some, it'll help with the headache.

LU MING
(looking at her coldly)
Song Wanqing, do you ever run out of rituals? You weren't drunk last night.

SONG WANQING
(offering the soup)
Drink some, it's freshly made.

LU MING swings his hand, but stops short. The cup remains. He pulls out a pack of contraceptive pills and sets them on the table.

LU MING
Birth control pills. Dr. Chen's orders—until the merger closes.

SONG WANQING
(looking at the pills in disbelief)
Lu Ming...

LU MING
(shouting)
Take them!

SONG WANQING trembles all over, but remains standing. She picks up one pill from the table. With tears streaming down her face, she swallows it, never breaking eye contact. LU MING watches, something flickering in his expression, then turns and strides away.

SONG WANQING (V.O.)
(tears streaming down her face)
Lu Ming, if you ever read that medical bill, you'd know I never wanted a merger. I wanted a miracle.

SONG WANQING stands in the doorway, clutching her wrist, watching him leave.

title: The Funeral Director
description: A recent college graduate arranges his mother's funeral at a funeral shop, where he encounters a woman in a qipao and a violent debt collector.
context:
Title: The Funeral Director
Description: A recent college graduate arranges his mother's funeral at a funeral shop, where he encounters a woman in a qipao and a violent debt collector.

INT. FUNERAL SHOP - NIGHT

YANG LI (23) sits alone, staring at a small URN on the counter. His fingers trace the cheap metal lid. QIN (30s) emerges from the back, wearing a vintage qipao—faded silk, frayed at the hem. She moves with practiced grace, but her eyes are tired.

QIN
(softly)
Your mother deserves a proper resting place.

YANG LI
I can barely cover the cremation.

QIN
(quietly)
Living costs money. Dying costs everything.

YANG LI
(flushing)
I just graduated. The medical bills—

QIN
I understand. But this...

(she gestures to the urn)
...isn't peace. It's postponement.

(she pulls out a small brochure)
A simple ceremony. Flowers from the market. I can do it for half price.

YANG LI
(defeated)
What's the point? She's gone.

QIN leans forward, her voice low and fierce.

QIN
The point is you don't let debt collectors become the only ones who mark her passing.

The door SLAMS open. LIN DALI (40s) enters, flanked by two HENCHMEN. Gold watch, tailored suit, knuckles scarred. He surveys the shop like he owns it. He does.

LIN DALI
(mock surprise)
Qin Qian. Still peddling salvation to the broke?

QIN
(stiffening)
Lin Dali.

LIN DALI
Not answering my calls. Hiding in this corpse cubbyhole.

(Yang Li flinches at "corpse")
continuation:
Your father borrowed three million. This shop is my collateral. My patience is my charity.

QIN
I've paid the interest—

LIN DALI
You paid what I told you to pay. Now I'm telling you it's not enough.

He picks up the URN, examines it like a defective product.

LIN DALI
(to Yang Li, conversational)
You know her old man ran this place into the ground? Gambling. Same thing that killed him.

QIN
(quietly)
Please leave my client out of this.

LIN DALI
(smiling)
Client? He's a vulture. Like me. Picking at what's left.

He tosses the urn back on the counter. Yang Li catches it mid-fall, clutching it to his chest.

LIN DALI
(turning to QIN)
Rent's tripled. Effective yesterday. Wang family territory, Wang family rates.

He moves closer, backing Qin against the wall.

LIN DALI
(low, intimate)
Or we renegotiate. You. Me. Tonight.

His hand goes to her shoulder. She doesn't flinch, but her knuckles whiten on the counter edge.

YANG LI
(voice cracking)
Stop.

LIN DALI
(without turning)
This don't concern you, boy.

YANG LI
(standing, urn clutched like a shield)
My mother died in Wang Family Hospital. Their billing department called while she coded. Three minutes.

(beat)
You own that too?

LIN DALI stops. Turns slowly. Recognition flickers.

LIN DALI
(in disbelief)
Yang Li?

title: Wife's Return
description: A woman fights for survival while her estranged husband races to save her, forcing both to confront the cost of their choices.
context:
Title: Wife's Return
Description: A woman fights for survival while her estranged husband races to save her, forcing both to confront the cost of their choices.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

SU MO, 26, kneels in a torn gold dress, suspended by chains. She forces shallow breaths, scanning the warehouse.

ASSISTANT (V.O.)
(phone filter)
Tracker confirms Chenglin warehouse. But sir, Mrs. Huo—

HUO SIHAN (V.O.)
(phone filter)
She knew the risks.

A WHIP cracks across Su Mo's back. She chokes back a scream.

The KIDNAPPER, 40s, checks his phone.

KIDNAPPER
Your husband's not responding. Maybe I need to be more persuasive.

SU MO
(strained)
He won't pay. We're separated. Bad intel.

KIDNAPPER
(showing screen)
This says Mrs. Huo. This says two million pending.

SU MO
(desperate)
Not his money. Please, I can explain—

KIDNAPPER
Wrong answer.

He raises the whip.

EXT. HIGHWAY - NIGHT

Rain pelts the road. A white sports car weaves through traffic.

INT. SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

HUO SIHAN, 32, watches Su Mo's location pulse on his phone. His jaw is tight.

The ASSISTANT balances a tablet.

ASSISTANT
Company funds are ready, but the prenup—paying legally validates the marriage.

HUO SIHAN
Use the offshore account. Not mine.

DRIVER
Seventeen minutes out. Police are slower.

HUO SIHAN
Drive faster.
continuation:
INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Su Mo's head lolls. She counts silently, eyes tracking exits.

KIDNAPPER
(into phone)
You guaranteed he'd pay.

SU MO
(whisper)
Huo Sihan... don't.

KIDNAPPER
Rich bitches always think you're special.

SU MO
(looking up)
I was leaving him. That's why he—

CRACK. The whip again.

INT. SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

Red brake lights fill the windshield. The Driver hits the horn.

DRIVER
Accident ahead. Detour?

Huo Sihan checks the map—five minutes out.

HUO SIHAN
Take the shoulder.

DRIVER
Sir—

HUO SIHAN
Now.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Su Mo spits blood, defiant.

SU MO
Wrong account. The two million is mine. Pre-marriage.

The Kidnapper freezes, rechecks his screen.

SU MO
He's not coming.

The Kidnapper's face hardens.

KIDNAPPER
Then you're dead.

He draws a knife. Su Mo's breath catches.

INT. SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

Huo Sihan's phone BUZZES. A text from Su Mo: "Don't come."

He stares. Then locks the screen.

HUO SIHAN
South entrance. Go dark.

DRIVER
Yes sir.

The car veers off-road.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

The knife glints. Su Mo shuts her eyes—

A SHOT rings out. The knife hits concrete.

HUO SIHAN (O.S.)
She's not dead yet.

The Kidnapper whirls. Huo Sihan stands in the doorframe, weapon raised, rain-soaked.

SU MO
(barely breathing)
You shouldn't have.

Huo Sihan's eyes stay on the Kidnapper.

HUO SIHAN
We need to talk.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

Su Mo spits blood, defiant.

SU MO
Wrong account. The two million is mine. Pre-marriage.

The Kidnapper freezes, rechecks his screen.

SU MO
He's not coming.

The Kidnapper's face hardens.

KIDNAPPER
Then you're dead.

He draws a knife. Su Mo's breath catches.

INT. SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

Huo Sihan's phone BUZZES. A text from Su Mo: "Don't come."

He stares. Then locks the screen.

HUO SIHAN
South entrance. Go dark.

DRIVER
Yes sir.

The car veers off-road.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

The knife glints. Su Mo shuts her eyes—

A SHOT rings out. The knife hits concrete.

HUO SIHAN (O.S.)
She's not dead yet.

The Kidnapper whirls. Huo Sihan stands in the doorframe, weapon raised, rain-soaked.

SU MO
(barely breathing)
You shouldn't have.

Huo Sihan's eyes stay on the Kidnapper.

HUO SIHAN
We need to talk.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Mr. Fu Still Has Lingering Feelings
description: A woman diagnosed with terminal lung cancer seeks closure with her estranged husband, only to be confronted by her best friend who has become his mistress.
context:
Title: Mr. Fu Still Has Lingering Feelings
Description: A woman diagnosed with terminal lung cancer seeks closure with her estranged husband, only to be confronted by her best friend who has become his mistress.

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

LIN WANWAN sits across from the DOCTOR, staring at the scan images. Her fingers trace the shadow on her lung.

DOCTOR
The biopsy confirms stage four. It's metastasized.

LIN WANWAN
(quietly)
Treatment options?

DOCTOR
Palliative care. We can manage pain, but...

The Doctor slides a pamphlet across the desk. Wanwan doesn't touch it.

LIN WANWAN
Timeline?

DOCTOR
Four to six months. Maybe less.

EXT. SEASIDE - DAY

LIN WANWAN stands alone by the crashing waves, her phone glowing in her hand. She dials. One ring. Two.

FU SHIQIAN (V.O.)
(recorded voice)
You've reached Fu Shiqian. Leave a message.

The call disconnects. Wanwan's thumb hovers over the keypad, then types: "At the cove. Remember?"

She hits send. No reply.

LIN WANWAN (V.O.)
We always said this is where we'd say goodbye.

WANWAN turns toward the tide pools where they once collected sea glass.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. SEASIDE COVE - DAY (PAST)

Young FU SHIQIAN, soaked to the knees, holds up a piece of sea glass smoothed by the waves.

FU SHIQIAN
Found it. Just like you—rough edges worn beautiful.

He places the glass in YOUNG WANWAN's palm, not a ring box. His hands cover hers.

FU SHIQIAN
Promise we'll come back here. No matter what.

YOUNG WANWAN
Promise.

They clasp hands, the glass cutting slightly between their palms.

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
EXT. SEASIDE - DAY

WANWAN opens her palm. The same sea glass, now dull and cloudy, rests there. She lets it fall into the water.

YE SHENGER (O.S.)
You shouldn't be here alone.

WANWAN turns. YE SHENGER stands twenty feet away, wind whipping her designer coat. Not angry—exhausted.

LIN WANWAN
How did you—

YE SHENGER
(shrugs)
Shared location. From his phone. He didn't even notice when I borrowed it.

LIN WANWAN
You borrowed it. Or you took it?

YE SHENGER
Does it matter? You're the one trespassing.

LIN WANWAN
This was our place.

YE SHENGER
(walking closer)
Was. Just like the company shares were yours. Just like the house was yours. Everything was yours.

She stops near the water's edge. The waves splash her heels.

YE SHENGER
(quietly)
You left, Wanwan. You retreated into that silent, sick house for two years. Did you think he'd wait forever?

LIN WANWAN
You were my friend.

YE SHENGER
I was your assistant. Your confidante. The one who read your medical reports when you were too scared to open them.

Wanwan's face goes pale.

LIN WANWAN
You knew?

YE SHENGER
About the recurrence? Yes. Three months ago. About the divorce papers you drafted but never served? Yes.

She pulls a folded document from her bag—Wanwan's unsigned petition.

YE SHENGER
You were already letting him go. I'm just making it official.

LIN WANWAN
(snatches it away)
This isn't about him. This is about us.

YE SHENGER
There is no us. There's survival.

She grabs WANWAN's wrist, her grip tight but not violent. The sea glass cuts into their palms again.

YE SHENGER
You think dying makes you noble? It makes you reckless.

In the distance, FU SHIQIAN's car screeches to a halt. He runs toward them, phone in hand.

FU SHIQIAN
(shouting)
Shenger! Let go!

YE SHENGER
(whispering to Wanwan)
You want closure? Let's see what he chooses.

She twists, pulling Wanwan toward the water's edge. A large wave crashes over them both.

YE SHENGER
(calling out)
Shiqian!

FU SHIQIAN
(shouting in terror)
No!

title: Mr. Ming, Your Wife Only Sees You as a Substitute - Episode 1
description: A bride is publicly accused at her wedding of being a murderer by her groom, who reveals himself to be the brother of her deceased former lover.
context:
Title: Mr. Ming, Your Wife Only Sees You as a Substitute - Episode 1
Description: A bride is publicly accused at her wedding of being a murderer by her groom, who reveals himself to be the brother of her deceased former lover.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

FU XIN wears a wedding dress, smiling at her reflection. MING HAO appears behind her.

MING HAO
Hello.

FU XIN
(startled)
You shouldn't—

MING HAO
See you soon. Save your surprise for the altar.

He exits. Her smile fades.

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

A sunny lawn wedding venue. Guests murmur expectantly.

OFFICIANT
Miss Fu Xin, do you take Mr. Ming Hao to be your husband?

FU XIN
(happily)
I do.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Ming Hao, do you take Miss Fu Xin to be your wife?

MING HAO
(quietly)
I do not.

The crowd gasps. FU XIN's face drains of color.

MING HAO
(loudly)
I have an announcement!
continuation:
A funeral wreath crashes at the altar. FU XIN stares, frozen.

CHEN MEILING and SUN WEIWEI arrive with bodyguards. CHEN MEILING holds a memorial portrait of GU TONG.

FU XIN
(whispering)
Aunt Chen?

CHEN MEILING
(trembling with rage)
She burned my son for our fortune!

MING HAO
(to Fu Xin)
Today's the anniversary. You remember, don't you?

SUN WEIWEI
Sister. You haven't forgotten Brother Gu Tong's death day?

FU XIN
(in disbelief)
You're his brother? The one who disappeared after—

MING HAO
(slams lectern)
Don't you dare speak his name. That fire was no accident.

FU XIN
(voice breaking)
I never meant—

CHEN MEILING rushes forward and slaps FU XIN. FU XIN falls, veil tearing.

CHEN MEILING
(crying out)
He died fetching your birthday gift!

FU XIN
(on the ground, trembling)
It was an engagement ring. I wanted—

MING HAO
(coldly)
You gave us a cremation instead.

title: My Foolish Husband Is Actually a Big Shot
description: A woman marries a man believed to be mentally impaired after an attack, only to discover there's more to him than meets the eye.
context:
Title: My Foolish Husband Is Actually a Big Shot
Description: A woman marries a man believed to be mentally impaired after an attack, only to discover there's more to him than meets the eye.

INT. PHOTO STUDIO - DAY

A PHOTOGRAPHER adjusts his camera, glancing between the lens and HUO BEICHEN, 28, whose eyes hold an innocent vacancy, and JIANG ROU, 26, composed but with a tightness around her eyes.

PHOTOGRAPHER
(to Huo Beichen)
Big smile for me... there we go.

The photographer's assistant holds up a squeaky toy. Huo Beichen's face lights up with genuine delight as the SHUTTER CLICKS.

A COUPLE in the waiting area exchange whispers. The woman glances sympathetically at Jiang Rou.

WOMAN
(quietly to her partner)
That's the Huo family heir. Such a tragedy.

Huo Beichen gently reaches for Jiang Rou's hand, his thumb tracing circles on her palm. She flinches slightly, then stills.

HUO BEICHEN
(softly)
Your hands are cold, Wife.

JIANG ROU
They'll warm up.

She forces a small smile. Huo Beichen mimics her expression, his imitation eerily precise.

PHOTOGRAPHER
(to Jiang Rou)
Alright, one more. Look at each other.

They turn. For a moment, Jiang Rou sees something flicker in Huo Beichen's gaze—awareness, depth—before it vanishes behind childlike simplicity. She holds his hand tighter.
continuation:
EXT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU ENTRANCE - DAY

Huo Beichen and Jiang Rou exit, snow dusting their shoulders. A sedan idles nearby. Suddenly, THREE REPORTERS approach, keeping respectful distance.

REPORTER 1
Miss Jiang, is it true you signed a prenuptial agreement waiving inheritance rights?

REPORTER 2
Sources say Young Master Huo's condition is permanent. How will this affect the Huo Group?

Huo Beichen steps between Jiang Rou and the reporters, his posture shifting—suddenly protective, his expression no longer vacant but focused. Jiang Rou notices.

JIANG ROU
We're grateful for the family's support. That's all we're discussing today.

LI XUN, 45, immaculately dressed, emerges from the sedan with two bodyguards.

LI XUN
Apologies for the intrusion. I'm Li Xun, representing the Huo family estate.

The reporters turn their recorders toward him.

LI XUN
The family wishes to clarify: Jiang Rou is now a Huo. The hundred million bride price was her decision to accept, not a transaction.

He produces a document.

LI XUN
Furthermore, any child born of this union will receive a one billion trust fund, per Old Madam Huo's directive. Not as incentive, but as their birthright.

His tone is formal, almost legal. The reporters scramble to process this. Huo Beichen watches Li Xun, recognition flashing in his eyes before he turns back to Jiang Rou and smiles, the childlike mask sliding back into place.

HUO BEICHEN
Can we go home now? I'm cold.

Jiang Rou studies his face—confusion and something else warring in her expression.

JIANG ROU
Yes. Let's go home.

They walk toward the sedan, Huo Beichen's grip on her hand firm and sure. The reporters part for them, silent for once.

title: Impostor Goddess
description: A novelist celebrating her book publication discovers a glowing copy of her own novel in a restroom and is mysteriously transported into the world of her story.
context:
Title: Impostor Goddess
Description: A novelist celebrating her book publication discovers a glowing copy of her own novel in a restroom and is mysteriously transported into the world of her story.

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

City night view, tall buildings everywhere, lights shining brightly.

A group of friends are having a party on the rooftop, celebrating XIE WANQING's novel publication.

FRIEND A
Let's toast to our Wanqing, the great author, for her novel publication, cheers!

EVERYONE
Cheers!

Everyone raises their glasses and drinks them down.

FRIEND B
I wish your novel becomes a bestseller.

XIE WANQING
A bestseller.

FRIEND B
It will definitely be a bestseller.

XIE WANQING drinks, appearing somewhat tipsy. She continues drinking and celebrating with her friends.

After a while, XIE WANQING feels a bit dizzy and stands up.

XIE WANQING
I'm going to the restroom first. You guys keep drinking, I'll be right back.

XIE WANQING walks somewhat unsteadily.

FRIEND C
Are you okay?

XIE WANQING
I'm fine, fine, fine.

FRIEND D
Don't drink too much.

XIE WANQING
I'm fine.

XIE WANQING leaves the party alone.
continuation:
INT. RESTROOM - NIGHT

XIE WANQING enters the restroom, tidies up her appearance in the mirror, then walks to the sink to wash her hands.

She fixes her hair and turns to leave when she notices a glowing book on the floor.

Curious, she walks over and crouches down to pick up the book.

The cover has her name written on it: "XIE WANQING."

XIE WANQING
(to herself)
How is my book here?

She opens the book. Golden text floats around her, all plot points and character names from her novel, such as "Male Lead: BAI SHAN," "Female Lead: LUO XI."

A flash of white light appears, and XIE WANQING disappears.

INT. UNKNOWN LOCATION - DAY

Two men's shadows are projected on the wall. One of them is on the phone.

MAN A (V.O.)
Alright, we don't need to discuss this anymore.

MAN A (V.O.)
By the way, is there any news about her?

INT. INDOOR SWIMMING POOL - DAY

A woman in a white dress (looking identical to XIE WANQING) struggles in the pool, about to drown.

DROWNING WOMAN
Ah!

A man (BAI SHAN) quickly jumps into the water and swims toward the drowning woman.

BAI SHAN rescues the woman and brings her to the poolside, laying her flat.

He immediately performs CPR and mouth-to-mouth resuscitation on the woman.

As he performs mouth-to-mouth resuscitation, a golden light flashes.

FADE OUT.

title: Rejuvenation
description: A man afflicted with premature aging awakens from a three-year coma to protect his devoted wife who sacrificed everything for him.
context:
Title: Rejuvenation
Description: A man afflicted with premature aging awakens from a three-year coma to protect his devoted wife who sacrificed everything for him.

INT. ANCIENT STYLE COURTYARD - DAY

A classical courtyard dusted with snow. NING CHEN (30s, but appears 80: frail, white hair, weathered skin) sits motionless in a wheelchair. Behind him, his wife SU LAN (28, elegant, tired eyes) adjusts his blanket.

A COUPLE passes the pavilion, slowing at the sight.

PASSERBY WOMAN
(to Su Lan)
Your father? How wonderful you take him out.

SU LAN
My husband.

The couple's smile fades. They glance at Ning Chen, then quickly away.

PASSERBY MAN
We... see. Enjoy your day.

They retreat, their whispers just audible.

PASSERBY WOMAN
(O.S., hushed)
Must be the money. Why else?

SU LAN's knuckles whiten on the wheelchair handles. She kneels beside Ning Chen, pouring tea with trembling hands.

SU LAN
(softly)
I remember my grandfather's words. "A man of destiny." When our families arranged our meeting, I saw your portrait. You were... you.

She takes his gnarled hand—contrasting sharply with her smooth skin.

SU LAN
The Zhao family has a trial drug. Experimental. They say it could... reverse this.

Her voice cracks. She touches her stomach, a reflexive, protective gesture.

SU LAN
They need a test case. And I need a guarantee. So I made a bargain. A marriage contract.

A single tear falls on their clasped hands.

SU LAN
(whispering)
I'm sorry, Ning Chen. I can't watch you die.

She kisses his forehead and leaves, shoulders shaking. The JADE PENDANT on Ning Chen's chest flickers—once, twice—then floods with golden light. Energy pulses into him.

His fingers twitch.

FLASHBACK
continuation:
INT. WEDDING CHAPEL - DAY (THREE YEARS EARLIER)

Young, radiant NING CHEN (30, striking) and SU LAN in white satin exchange vows. SU HAO (60s, Su Lan's father) and her MOTHER watch, beaming.

The sky outside darkens in seconds—not clouds, but a rent in reality itself. Black energy bleeds through.

Ning Chen's hand flashes with an ancient, glowing rune. It fractures.

NING CHEN
(anguished)
The Five Decays...

He grips Su Lan's hand, desperate.

NING CHEN
Wait for me. However long.

He forces himself to release her and sprints toward the darkness. Lightning screams through the chapel windows. Su Lan collapses, clutching her abdomen. Her parents catch her as the world strobes black and white.

END FLASHBACK

INT. ANCIENT STYLE COURTYARD - DAY

Ning Chen's eyes snap open. Clear. Focused. Gone is the fog of three years.

His gaze falls on the pendant. Memories flicker behind his eyes—not his own, but images the jade absorbed: Su Lan reading to him, defending him from whispers, signing papers in a cold office.

NING CHEN (V.O.)
Three years as a prisoner in my own body. Three years she fought alone. The jade kept my spirit anchored. Now...

Ning Chen's jaw tightens. His old hands clench into fists.

NING CHEN (V.O.)
...it's her turn to rest.

INT. SONG FAMILY BEDROOM - DAY

(breathless)

He clutches his own glowing wrist, eyes wide with hope and fear.

Still breathing? Figured he'd be gone by now.

SU FAMILY SERVANT 1

Servant 1 lifts an incense burner, angling it over Ning Chen's lap.

SU FAMILY SERVANT 2

SU FAMILY SERVANT 1

You were saying?
full_script:
Title: Rejuvenation
Description: A man afflicted with premature aging awakens from a three-year coma to protect his devoted wife who sacrificed everything for him.

INT. ANCIENT STYLE COURTYARD - DAY

A classical courtyard dusted with snow. NING CHEN (30s, but appears 80: frail, white hair, weathered skin) sits motionless in a wheelchair. Behind him, his wife SU LAN (28, elegant, tired eyes) adjusts his blanket.

A COUPLE passes the pavilion, slowing at the sight.

PASSERBY WOMAN
(to Su Lan)
Your father? How wonderful you take him out.

SU LAN
My husband.

The couple's smile fades. They glance at Ning Chen, then quickly away.

PASSERBY MAN
We... see. Enjoy your day.

They retreat, their whispers just audible.

PASSERBY WOMAN
(O.S., hushed)
Must be the money. Why else?

SU LAN's knuckles whiten on the wheelchair handles. She kneels beside Ning Chen, pouring tea with trembling hands.

SU LAN
(softly)
I remember my grandfather's words. "A man of destiny." When our families arranged our meeting, I saw your portrait. You were... you.

She takes his gnarled hand—contrasting sharply with her smooth skin.

SU LAN
The Zhao family has a trial drug. Experimental. They say it could... reverse this.

Her voice cracks. She touches her stomach, a reflexive, protective gesture.

SU LAN
They need a test case. And I need a guarantee. So I made a bargain. A marriage contract.

A single tear falls on their clasped hands.

SU LAN
(whispering)
I'm sorry, Ning Chen. I can't watch you die.

She kisses his forehead and leaves, shoulders shaking. The JADE PENDANT on Ning Chen's chest flickers—once, twice—then floods with golden light. Energy pulses into him.

His fingers twitch.

FLASHBACK

INT. WEDDING CHAPEL - DAY (THREE YEARS EARLIER)

Young, radiant NING CHEN (30, striking) and SU LAN in white satin exchange vows. SU HAO (60s, Su Lan's father) and her MOTHER watch, beaming.

The sky outside darkens in seconds—not clouds, but a rent in reality itself. Black energy bleeds through.

Ning Chen's hand flashes with an ancient, glowing rune. It fractures.

(anguished)
The Five Decays...

He grips Su Lan's hand, desperate.

NING CHEN
Wait for me. However long.

NING CHEN (V.O.)

title: Her Son Was Targeted by the Boss
description: A woman scorned by her cheating fiancé seeks revenge at a bar, leading to a fateful encounter with a powerful man from her fiancé's own family.
context:
Title: Her Son Was Targeted by the Boss
Description: A woman scorned by her cheating fiancé seeks revenge at a bar, leading to a fateful encounter with a powerful man from her fiancé's own family.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

QIAO JING (eldest daughter of the Qiao family) sits at the bar, her phone screen showing Yan Xuan's betrayal. She drains her martini.

QIAO JING (V.O.)
Three years. A text message. "Sorry, things changed." Watch what change looks like, Yan Xuan.

A SLEAZY MAN approaches.

SLEAZY MAN
Beautiful lady, let me erase your ex for you.

QIAO JING
You're not my type.

SLEAZY MAN
(grabbing her wrist)
Let me change your mind—

YAN QIN (head of the Yan family) appears, gripping the man's wrist.

SLEAZY MAN
(terrified)
Fourth Master Yan...

YAN QIN
Disappear.

The Sleazy Man flees.

QIAO JING studies YAN QIN through her drunken haze, then drapes her arms over his shoulders.

YAN QIN
You're playing with fire.

QIAO JING
I came here to burn it all down.

She kisses him. His hand finds her waist. He doesn't pull away.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

The door slams. Silk shimmers to the floor. YAN QIN and QIAO JING tumble onto the bed.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - NIGHT

QIAO WU (second daughter of the Qiao family) strides in, YAN XUAN following.

QIAO WU
(consulting phone)
Room 1808. She's so predictably desperate.

YAN XUAN
(furious)
If she's with someone—

QIAO WU (V.O.)
Then you'll need a new fiancée. Someone loyal. Someone who knows family secrets.

She pockets her phone.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

QIAO JING straddles YAN QIN on the bed, her fingers tracing his scar.

YAN QIN
You know who I am?

QIAO JING
(laughing)
Your nephew's ex-fiancée. The one he fears.

YAN QIN
Are you sure?

QIAO JING
Wasn't yesterday.

She kisses his scar.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

QIAO WU and YAN XUAN stop at Room 1808. YAN XUAN's hand trembles on the handle.

YAN XUAN
(venomous)
This ends tonight.

QIAO WU
For her, yes.

He throws the door open. Inside: empty champagne bottles, a silk tie monogrammed YQ, the bed still warm. The window drapes billow. Empty.

YAN XUAN
Where—

QIAO WU checks her phone. A new message: "With Fourth Master. Safe."

She stares at the tie. Her smile vanishes.

QIAO WU
(whisper)
You stupid girl.

ON SCREEN: THE END

title: Top Scholar Replaced, Furiously Submits Lithography Machine
description: A brilliant student who solved an impossible exam question discovers his college admission has been stolen by a wealthy rival, while top scientists desperately search for him.
context:
Title: Top Scholar Replaced, Furiously Submits Lithography Machine
Description: A brilliant student who solved an impossible exam question discovers his college admission has been stolen by a wealthy rival, while top scientists desperately search for him.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

LAO LI, grizzled in camouflage, slams the table. MR. BAI, exhausted in a rumpled suit, sits across from him.

LAO LI
Bai, you're chasing ghosts.

MR. BAI
I'm out of options.

LAO LI
(emotionally)
My team's on half-pay. Our last prototype flopped. And you plant state secrets in a high school exam?

MR. BAI
(thin smile)
Not secrets. A puzzle. The puzzle that's broken us for twenty years.

LAO LI
One student won't change that.

MR. BAI
Maybe not. But a thousand might. Ten thousand.

MR. BAI stands, pacing.

MR. BAI (CONT'D)
Wall Street's building 3-nanometer fabs while we're stuck at 28. I don't need a miracle. I need a beginning.

JIN, young researcher, enters holding an exam paper. She stops, seeing the tension.

JIN
Sir... Question 47. It's been answered.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

XU ZHI, 18, pushes his parents' sanitation cart in a faded uniform. MR. SU limps beside him; MRS. SU sorts bottles.

XU ZHI
Baba, I've got the hill.

MR. SU
Top scholar belongs in lab, not alley.

NEIGHBOR
(calling from window)
Old Su! Your Xu Zhi's made you proud!

MRS. SU
(softly)
Hard work. That's all.

A white sports car glides too close, scattering trash. BAO ZHI steps out, bored.

XU ZHI
(helping his mother)
Mom?

BAO ZHI
(to his phone)
Migrant workers. Always in the way.

XU ZHI
We have the right of way.

BAO ZHI
(not looking up)
Rights? My father buys rights. He just bought Tsinghua's last admission spot. From Xu Zhi to Bao Zhi. Clean transfer.

XU ZHI
(frozen)
What?

BAO ZHI
You're not in the system. You never were.

BAO ZHI drives away, trash crunching under tires.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

LAO LI and MR. BAI stare at Jin's screen. The solved equations glow.

MR. BAI
This isn't an answer. It's a map.

LAO LI
Find the student.

JIN pulls up a file: XU ZHI. Perfect scores. Status: REVOKED.

JIN
Someone erased him three days ago. His name, his admission. Everything.

MR. BAI
Then find what's left. Before they erase him completely.

LAO LI is already on his phone, barking orders.

title: The Weight of Vows
description: A bride's perfect wedding day shatters when her groom's hidden debts ignite a violent confrontation, leaving her in a coma only to awaken to an even deeper betrayal.
context:
Title: The Weight of Vows
Description: A bride's perfect wedding day shatters when her groom's hidden debts ignite a violent confrontation, leaving her in a coma only to awaken to an even deeper betrayal.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

OFFICIANT
Please welcome the bride.

The GUESTS applaud. SU YE, 28, in a white wedding dress, walks toward HAN WENBO on stage. Her smile is radiant but her eyes scan the room nervously. Her sister XIAO QIU watches from the front row.

HAN WENBO
(affectionately)
Darling, you look so beautiful.

OFFICIANT
Han Wenbo, please vow before your family and friends: do you take this woman as your wife?

HAN WENBO
I do.

OFFICIANT
Su Ye, do you take—

SU YE
(interrupting)
I do. I do, I do.

The GUESTS laugh. XIAO QIU shakes her head with a helpless smile.

XIAO QIU
Sis, could you be a bit more reserved?

SU YE
(laughing)
I can't help it.

HAN WENBO kisses her forehead. For a moment, his expression flickers—guilt, fear—before he composes himself.

SU YE (V.O.)
The moment every woman dreams of. So why does it feel like I'm waiting for disaster?

DEBT COLLECTOR (O.S.)
(shouting)
Han Wenbo!

The doors burst open. Three MEN in suits enter, carrying legal documents. The DEBT COLLECTOR has a face like stone.

DEBT COLLECTOR
Asset seizure order. You don't get to play husband while you hide.

GUESTS scatter. The Collector grabs a champagne bottle.

DEBT COLLECTOR
You're coming with me—

He swings. HAN WENBO flinches back—and in a split second of panic, pushes SU YE forward. The bottle clips her temple. She collapses, blood flowing from her forehead.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: Six months later

SU YE lies in a bed, comatose. Sunlight streams across her face.

XIAO QIU (O.S.)
(quietly)
You can't keep coming here. What if she—

HAN WENBO (O.S.)
The doctors say she won't wake for months. Maybe never.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

FLASHBACK. HAN WENBO and XIAO QIU stand close in the hallway. Six weeks post-accident.

HAN WENBO
Every day I sit there, I see what I did to her.

XIAO QIU
You panicked. You didn't mean to—

HAN WENBO
I used my wife as a shield. Your sister.

A long beat. She touches his arm.

XIAO QIU
(softly)
I know. I know you didn't mean to.

He breaks. She holds him. What starts as comfort becomes something else. He kisses her. She doesn't pull away.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

SU YE's eyes open. She lies still, processing. Slowly, she sits up, pulls out her IV. Stands—legs weak—and shuffles to the door.

INT. STAIRCASE/LIVING ROOM - DAY

SU YE descends the stairs, gripping the railing. Voices drift from below.

HAN WENBO (O.S.)
We can't keep doing this.

XIAO QIU (O.S.)
Then stop coming to me.

SU YE reaches the bottom step. Peers around the corner. In the living room, HAN WENBO and XIAO QIU stand inches apart. He touches her face. They kiss.

SU YE
(hand over mouth)
No...

She stumbles back against the wall. The monitor she disconnected begins beeping upstairs—urgent and frantic.

HAN WENBO (O.S.)
Shit. She's—

They break apart, looking up.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Han Wenbo and Xiao Qiu rush in. Su Ye stands by the window, her back to them. Composed.

SU YE
(quietly)
When did it start?

The monitor keeps screaming. They stare at her back. She turns to face them.

FADE OUT.

title: Runaway Groom
description: A reluctant groom flees his arranged marriage to the daughter of a powerful family, pursued by his mother, the legendary East Land War God.
context:
Title: Runaway Groom
Description: A reluctant groom flees his arranged marriage to the daughter of a powerful family, pursued by his mother, the legendary East Land War God.

EXT. DESERT - DAY

A vast desert. A motorcycle races across the sand, kicking up dust.

Several motorcycles follow close behind, all ridden by fully armed female riders.

FEMALE PURSUER A
Stop running!

FEMALE PURSUER B
The War God commands it!

LI QIANFAN rides in front, glancing back over his shoulder.

LI QIANFAN
(casually)
Since when do I obey commands?

FEMALE PURSUER C
The East Land War God demands your return—alive!

LI QIANFAN
(dismissively)
Find another puppet for your alliance.

FEMALE PURSUER A
Last warning, Qianfan!

FEMALE PURSUER D
Don't force our hand, little brother.

The chase continues. Suddenly, two SUVs charge out from the side, cutting off Li Qianfan's path and forcing him to stop. The female pursuers surround him.

The car doors open. A middle-aged woman with a powerful presence, LI WUJIANG, steps out with several subordinates.

FEMALE PURSUERS
(in unison)
War God!

LI QIANFAN removes his helmet, revealing a helpless expression.

LI QIANFAN
Mother.

LI QIANFAN
(strained)
You shouldn't have come.

LI WUJIANG steps forward and grabs Li Qianfan's ear.

LI WUJIANG
My heir runs from his wedding? Of course I come. The Du alliance waits, yet you play games.

LI QIANFAN
(in pain)
Du Junlin wants a trophy, not a husband!

LI WUJIANG twists his ear harder.

LI QIANFAN
Ow! Fine—Granny!

LI WUJIANG
Granny?

LI QIANFAN seizes the moment to pull a packet from his jacket and hurls it upward.

LI QIANFAN
Think fast!

The powder bursts in the air—chili dust. Everyone chokes and coughs. LI QIANFAN leaps onto his motorcycle and roars away.

LI QIANFAN
(shouting)
I choose my own fate!

LI WUJIANG watches her son disappear, fury crackling in her eyes as she grips her whip.

LI WUJIANG
That boy will learn!
continuation:
INT. LUXURIOUS BANQUET HALL - DAY

LI WUJIANG, in a commanding black uniform, strides into the banquet hall flanked by elite guards. The assembled power brokers rise.

SUBORDINATE
The War God!

Guests snap to attention.

XIAO WANSAN
Governor Xiao, Qingyun Province.

XU QIANJIANG
Xu Qianjiang, Southern Territories.

AO ZHAN
Ao Zhan, West Sea Authority.

AO KUN
Ao Kun, East Sea Collective.

AO TIAN
Ao Tian, Northern Holdings.

AO BING
Ao Bing, Southern Division.

EVERYONE
(in unison)
Hail the East Land War God!

LI WUJIANG takes her place at the head of the obsidian table.

LI WUJIANG
Sit.

They sit.

XIAO WANSAN
General, your son's in the city causing... a scene.

LI WUJIANG lifts her teacup, studying the amber liquid.

LI WUJIANG
Elaborate.

EXT. MATCHMAKING CORNER - DAY

LI QIANFAN sits on a folding chair before a whiteboard reading: "ELITE SPOUSE: 9.99 Dowry." He holds a megaphone.

LI QIANFAN
(through megaphone)
Nine ninety-nine! No contractual obligations!

INT. LUXURIOUS BANQUET HALL - DAY

LI WUJIANG
Nine ninety-nine what?

XIAO WANSAN
(cautiously)
He's auctioning himself, General. To undermine the Du family.

LI WUJIANG slams her teacup. It shatters.

LI WUJIANG
(furious)
Retrieve him. Immediately.

EVERYONE
(in unison)
Yes, War God!

EXT. MATCHMAKING CORNER - DAY

A black luxury car stops. SU ZIYU emerges—white dress, sunglasses, bodyguards.

BODYGUARD
Miss Su.

LI QIANFAN watches her approach.

LI QIANFAN
(to himself)
Someone who writes her own rules.

LI QIANFAN stands.

LI QIANFAN
Interested in a real partnership?

A red laser dot appears on his chest.

FADE OUT.

Description: A reluctant groom flees his arranged marriage to the daughter of a powerful family, pursued by his mother, the legendary East Land War God.

EXT. DESERT - DAY

A vast desert. A motorcycle races across the sand, kicking up dust.

Several motorcycles follow close behind, all ridden by fully armed female riders.

Stop running!

FEMALE PURSUER B
The War God commands it!

LI QIANFAN rides in front, glancing back over his shoulder.

LI QIANFAN
(casually)
Since when do I obey commands?

FEMALE PURSUER C
The East Land War God demands your return—alive!

(dismissively)

Last warning, Qianfan!

War God!

Mother.

title: Missed in Your Whole World
description: On their wedding anniversary, a woman is brutally confronted by her husband who accuses her of threatening his first love, leading to the revelation of her family's downfall.
context:
Title: Missed in Your Whole World
Description: On their wedding anniversary, a woman is brutally confronted by her husband who accuses her of threatening his first love, leading to the revelation of her family's downfall.

INT. VILLA DINING ROOM - DAY

AN YUEXI cuts vegetables in the kitchen, humming softly. She brings the finished dishes to the dining table, arranging them with ritualistic care.

AN YUEXI (V.O.)
Tingmo, I cooked everything you love. Maybe today you'll finally see me.

The door opens. SHENG TINGMO stands in the entryway, his suit immaculate, his eyes empty.

AN YUEXI
(hopefully)
Tingmo, you're home. Today is our—

SHENG TINGMO
(cutting her off)
You threatened Qianya.

He strides to the table, lifts a plate of vegetables, and dumps it over her head. AN YUEXI gasps, bits of food clinging to her hair.

SHENG TINGMO
Her hands trembled so badly she dropped a glass. Her nurse called me in tears.

AN YUEXI
(frantically)
I would never—

SHENG TINGMO
(grabbing her throat)
The recording was your voice. Clear as day.

He squeezes until her breath hitches, then shoves her toward the door.
continuation:
EXT. VILLA EXTERIOR - DAY

SHENG TINGMO pushes AN YUEXI onto the front steps. She falls to her knees on the gravel.

AN YUEXI
(struggling up)
Where—

SHENG TINGMO points. Across the street, INVESTIGATORS lead AN YUEXI'S FATHER from the An Group headquarters. Yellow tape already blocks the entrance.

AN YUEXI'S FATHER
(strained)
Yuexi, don't look!

AN YUEXI
(lurching forward)
Dad!

SHENG TINGMO
(trapping her)
He's been under investigation for eighteen months. I submitted the final evidence this morning.

AN YUEXI
(whirling to face him)
You married me to destroy my family.

SHENG TINGMO
(softly, almost intimate)
Five billion in fraud. He'll never see daylight again.

AN YUEXI
(trembling)
All this... for Qianya?

SHENG TINGMO crouches down, his face inches from hers.

SHENG TINGMO
Four years ago, you used your father's influence to force my hand. Now his name is poison, and you're nothing.

He releases her, letting her collapse onto the walkway.

SHENG TINGMO
The divorce papers are on your nightstand. Be gone by tomorrow.

He turns and walks toward his waiting car, leaving her in the settling dust of the driveway.

title: The Masked Dialogue
description: A mother is dragged away by demon clan members as her daughter escapes, leading to a confrontation between powerful warriors and the demon clan.
context:
Title: The Masked Dialogue
Description: A mother is dragged away by demon clan members as her daughter escapes, leading to a confrontation between powerful warriors and the demon clan.

INT. VILLAGE SQUARE - DAY

Two DEMON CLAN MEMBERS wearing skull masks drag QING'ER'S MOTHER through a square littered with broken pottery and fresh scorch marks. Glowing blue chains pulse around her body.

QING'ER'S MOTHER
(panicked, but clear)
Qing'er, run! Don't look back!

QING'ER stands at the forest edge, tears streaming, watching her mother disappear. She turns and sprints.

EXT. BAMBOO FOREST - DAY

QING'ER runs desperately into a bamboo forest and collides with a group of people: a MAN IN MODERN UNIFORM, a WOMAN IN A LIGHT-COLOURED DRESS, a FEMALE SWORDSWOMAN, and a man named HEI ZE.

QING'ER
(crying out)
Help!

QING'ER collapses to her knees, exhausted.

MAN IN UNIFORM
What happened?

QING'ER
(grief-stricken)
They took my mother. The demon clan—they're destroying the village.

MAN IN UNIFORM
(frowning)
How many?

QING'ER
At least ten. Maybe more.

MAN IN UNIFORM
(quietly)
Then we are ten too few, or just enough.

WOMAN IN DRESS
(softly)
continuation:
This child can't go back.

FEMALE SWORDSWOMAN
I'll shield her. Go.

MAN IN UNIFORM
(to Qing'er)
Will you trust us?

QING'ER
(looking at them)
You... you feel different from them.

MAN IN UNIFORM
We are. Stay with her. We'll return with your mother if she still—

He stops, seeing Qing'er's face crumple.

MAN IN UNIFORM
We'll stop them. That's our vow.

QING'ER nods. The Female Swordsman takes her hand.

FEMALE SWORDSWOMAN
Hold on tight.

They run deeper into the forest.

The Man in Uniform pulls a military insignia from his gear. It dissolves into shadow. Hei Ze removes his hood, revealing pale eyes that begin to glow.

MAN IN UNIFORM
(to Hei Ze)
For the first time, let us show the power of Dou Saint and Dou Emperor.

HEI ZE
(softly)
Let them remember why they feared those names.

Energy spirals around them—blue lightning and black flame. The bamboo groans, bending away.

They walk toward the village, each step leaving scorched prints in the earth.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: Supreme God Emperor
description: When four evil gods threaten to destroy Yunzhou City and annihilate the Great Xia people, the legendary God Emperor Xiao Yu emerges from his statue to defend his land and people with ancient divine weapons.
context:
Title: Supreme God Emperor
Description: When four evil gods threaten to destroy Yunzhou City and annihilate the Great Xia people, the legendary God Emperor Xiao Yu emerges from his statue to defend his land and people with ancient divine weapons.

INT. YUNZHOU CITY PLAZA - NIGHT

Under a crimson sky, lightning tears through darkness. The God Emperor statue stands in a rubble-strewn plaza, its gold leaf peeling.

TEXT ON SCREEN: Great Xia, Yunzhou

The Four Evil Gods—DEMON EMPEROR TUNTIA N, DEMON WITCH SHEMEI, DEMON MONK WUXIN, and DEMON KING GUIYU—appear as phantoms, radiating evil energy. In the plaza, two dozen SURVIVORS kneel. Among them, MEI (8) clutches a jade amulet.

DEMON EMPEROR TUNTIA N
Yunzhou's walls are dust. Once these last embers die, Great Xia's heart is next.

DEMON WITCH SHEMEI
We will annihilate the Great Xia people, destroy their nation and exterminate their race!

DEMON MONK WUXIN
(laughing maniacally)
The tender taste of hope...

DEMON KING GUIYU
(silent, raises spined fist)

Mei's GRANDFATHER whispers to her.

GRANDFATHER
The amulet holds his blood. Believe, child.

Mei looks at the statue, its eyes dark.

MEI
God Emperor... please wake up.

Other survivors take up her cry, voices ragged.

SURVIVORS
God Emperor, manifest!

DEMON WITCH SHEMEI
(laughing contemptuously)
A broken statue can't save you.

DEMON EMPEROR TUNTIA N
(raising hand)
Then let oblivion take you.

Four beams of light descend. The FOUR HEAVENLY KINGS materialize—scarred, armor scorched.

VERMILLION BIRD KING
For Yunzhou!

They charge. Magic erupts—sacred flames meet black lightning. The Kings fight as one, pushing demons back. But Wuxin's jaws unhinge, swallowing fire. Guiyu's shell turns blades. Shemei's laughter rusts steel.

One by one, the Kings fall—each blow meant for survivors.
continuation:
DEMON EMPEROR TUNTIA N
(crumpling the last King's throat)
Ants in god's clothing.

Mei's amulet BLINDS—a drop of blood evaporates into golden smoke that races to the statue. Its eyes IGNITE. Stone shatters.

XIAO YU emerges in white robes, divine majesty warring with exhaustion. He steadies himself.

DEMON WITCH SHEMEI
(shocked)
The sleep was eternal!

FALLEN KING
(bloodied, grinning)
She... believed...

XIAO YU
(quiet, building)
One child's voice... cuts through stone.

He looks at Mei—she doesn't flinch.

XIAO YU
You invaded my land. Shattered my guardians. For this...

A dragon roars. The XUANYUAN SWORD flies into his hand.

DEMON EMPEROR TUNTIA N
(gathering shadows)
You're a ghost! The Ten Artifacts are myth!

XIAO YU
Then let myths haunt you.

Around the plaza, NINE spectral Artifacts flicker—power awakening.

XIAO YU
One blow. With what strength I've reclaimed.

He swings. Sword energy streaks, remembering every death. The demons SCREAM as light unwrites them.

Xiao Yu drops to one knee—exhausted. He looks at Mei.

XIAO YU
(breathing hard)
The Ten are not yet mine. I... am not what I was.

He stands, leaning on the sword.

XIAO YU
But I am here.

He touches the statue's base. Golden light spreads—rebuilding.

FADE OUT.
