title: Days to Come
description: A wealthy businessman returns to his homeland and encounters his former love, now working as a cleaner, who no longer remembers him.
context:
Title: Days to Come
Description: A wealthy businessman returns to his homeland and encounters his former love, now working as a cleaner, who no longer remembers him.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

BO FENGFENG, in a sharp suit and gold-rimmed glasses, stares out the window. SHEN RUOYI, elegant and watchful, sits beside him.

BO FENGFENG
Finally back home.

SHEN RUOYI
Fengfeng, where are we going?

BO FENGFENG
I bought a house here.

EXT. SU FAMILY VILLA - DAY

A black luxury car drives toward a restored mansion.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

SHEN RUOYI sees the villa and tenses.

SHEN RUOYI
The Su family estate?

FLASHBACK:

EXT. BURNING VILLA - NIGHT

Flames consume the mansion. YOUNG BO FENGFENG, desperate, carries an unconscious woman in white (SU QIANQIAN) through smoke.

END FLASHBACK.

SHEN RUOYI
You still can't forget her, can you?

BO FENGFENG
(reminiscing)
Five years ago, after I made my first fortune, I bought this place.

BO FENGFENG
To remind myself what happened here.

SHEN RUOYI
(inner monologue)
Remind yourself... or keep her close?

SHEN RUOYI
(plaintively)
Fengfeng, why can't you look at me?

BO FENGFENG
I'll have the driver take you to the hotel. The banquet's in three days.

SHEN RUOYI takes out a medicine bottle and hands it to BO FENGFENG.

SHEN RUOYI
Your health just recovered. Don't stop taking this.

BO FENGFENG
Okay.

BO FENGFENG gets out.
continuation:
EXT. VILLA ENTRANCE - DAY

BO FENGFENG adjusts his suit, looking up at the mansion.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. SNOWY FIELD - NIGHT (5 YEARS AGO)

Young BO FENGFENG in a white suit kneels in snow, holding a ring box to SU QIANQIAN, radiant in a winter coat.

BO FENGFENG (V.O.)
Qianqian...

SU QIANQIAN
(turning away)
Don't, Bo. You can't even pay my father's debts. What life can you give me?

EXT. BURNING VILLA - NIGHT (5 YEARS AGO)

The villa erupts in flames. BO FENGFENG charges toward it as SHEN RUOYI shouts.

SHEN RUOYI
Fengfeng!

INT. BURNING VILLA - NIGHT (5 YEARS AGO)

BO FENGFENG finds unconscious SU QIANQIAN, picks her up.

BO FENGFENG
Qianqian, stay with me. I'm getting you out.

He carries her out as glass shatters behind them.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY (5 YEARS AGO)

BO FENGFENG wakes with bandaged hands. SHEN RUOYI sits nearby, her own hands bandaged.

BO FENGFENG
Qianqian?

SHEN RUOYI
She's alive. She asked me to tell you something.

BO FENGFENG
What?

SHEN RUOYI
(eyes down)
She said... don't come looking. She doesn't need rescuing.

BO FENGFENG lowers his head. Shen's grip tightens on her own bandages.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. VILLA ENTRANCE - DAY

Five years later.

BO FENGFENG and a BUTLER walk toward the steps.

INT. VILLA - DAY

Two MAIDS polish the grand staircase.

MAID A
I heard Mr. Bo rebuilt everything exactly as it was. Down to the wallpaper.

MAID B
They say he keeps one room locked. No one's allowed inside.

SU QIANQIAN, in cleaning clothes with worn hands, mops the marble floor, concentrated.

The CLEANING SUPERVISOR approaches.

CLEANING SUPERVISOR
You're on the foyer? Mr. Bo's early. Finish within the hour.

SU QIANQIAN
Okay.

INT. VILLA FOYER - DAY (MOMENTS LATER)

BO FENGFENG enters, stopping short of the wet floor.

SU QIANQIAN
(panicked)
Sorry—I'll move—

She looks up. Their eyes meet. Bo's breath catches. Qianqian's forehead creases with vague recognition.

BO FENGFENG
Qianqian... what are you doing here?

SU QIANQIAN
You know me?

BO FENGFENG
(soft laugh, bitter)
So you really don't remember.

SU QIANQIAN
(cautious)
I think you have the wrong person. I'm just staff.

SU QIANQIAN stands to leave. BO FENGFENG blocks her path.

BO FENGFENG
(low)
Stay.

Qianqian freezes. They stand inches apart.

SU QIANQIAN
(voice small)
Why does your voice sound like tears?

BO FENGFENG
Because I've been waiting five years to ask you a question.

BO FENGFENG opens a door—the one the maids mentioned.

BO FENGFENG
After you see what's inside, you can decide if I'm a stranger.

SU QIANQIAN
(hesitant)
What's in there?

BO FENGFENG
The truth about who you were. And who we were.

He holds out his bandaged hand—the fire scars visible. Qianqian stares at it, something flickering in her eyes.
full_script:
Title: Days to Come
Description: A wealthy businessman returns to his homeland and encounters his former love, now working as a cleaner, who no longer remembers him.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

BO FENGFENG, in a sharp suit and gold-rimmed glasses, stares out the window. SHEN RUOYI, elegant and watchful, sits beside him.

BO FENGFENG
Finally back home.

SHEN RUOYI
Fengfeng, where are we going?

BO FENGFENG
I bought a house here.

EXT. SU FAMILY VILLA - DAY

A black luxury car drives toward a restored mansion.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

SHEN RUOYI sees the villa and tenses.

SHEN RUOYI
The Su family estate?

FLASHBACK:

EXT. BURNING VILLA - NIGHT

Flames consume the mansion. YOUNG BO FENGFENG, desperate, carries an unconscious woman in white (SU QIANQIAN) through smoke.

END FLASHBACK.

SHEN RUOYI
You still can't forget her, can you?

BO FENGFENG
(reminiscing)
Five years ago, after I made my first fortune, I bought this place.

BO FENGFENG
To remind myself what happened here.

SHEN RUOYI
(inner monologue)
Remind yourself... or keep her close?

SHEN RUOYI
(plaintively)
Fengfeng, why can't you look at me?

BO FENGFENG
I'll have the driver take you to the hotel. The banquet's in three days.

SHEN RUOYI takes out a medicine bottle and hands it to BO FENGFENG.

SHEN RUOYI
Your health just recovered. Don't stop taking this.

BO FENGFENG
Okay.

BO FENGFENG gets out.

EXT. VILLA ENTRANCE - DAY

BO FENGFENG adjusts his suit, looking up at the mansion.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. SNOWY FIELD - NIGHT (5 YEARS AGO)

Young BO FENGFENG in a white suit kneels in snow, holding a ring box to SU QIANQIAN, radiant in a winter coat.

BO FENGFENG (V.O.)
Qianqian...

SU QIANQIAN
(turning away)
Don't, Bo. You can't even pay my father's debts. What life can you give me?

EXT. BURNING VILLA - NIGHT (5 YEARS AGO)

The villa erupts in flames. BO FENGFENG charges toward it as SHEN RUOYI shouts.

SHEN RUOYI
Fengfeng!

INT. BURNING VILLA - NIGHT (5 YEARS AGO)

BO FENGFENG finds unconscious SU QIANQIAN, picks her up.

BO FENGFENG
Qianqian, stay with me. I'm getting you out.

He carries her out as glass shatters behind them.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY (5 YEARS AGO)

BO FENGFENG wakes with bandaged hands. SHEN RUOYI sits nearby, her own hands bandaged.

BO FENGFENG
Qianqian?

SHEN RUOYI
She's alive. She asked me to tell you something.

BO FENGFENG
What?

SHEN RUOYI
(eyes down)
She said... don't come looking. She doesn't need rescuing.

BO FENGFENG lowers his head. Shen's grip tightens on her own bandages.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. VILLA ENTRANCE - DAY

Five years later.

BO FENGFENG and a BUTLER walk toward the steps.

INT. VILLA - DAY

Two MAIDS polish the grand staircase.

MAID A
I heard Mr. Bo rebuilt everything exactly as it was. Down to the wallpaper.

MAID B
They say he keeps one room locked. No one's allowed inside.

SU QIANQIAN, in cleaning clothes with worn hands, mops the marble floor, concentrated.

The CLEANING SUPERVISOR approaches.

CLEANING SUPERVISOR
You're on the foyer? Mr. Bo's early. Finish within the hour.

SU QIANQIAN
Okay.

INT. VILLA FOYER - DAY (MOMENTS LATER)

BO FENGFENG enters, stopping short of the wet floor.

SU QIANQIAN
(panicked)
Sorry—I'll move—

She looks up. Their eyes meet. Bo's breath catches. Qianqian's forehead creases with vague recognition.

BO FENGFENG
Qianqian... what are you doing here?

SU QIANQIAN
You know me?

BO FENGFENG
(soft laugh, bitter)
So you really don't remember.

SU QIANQIAN
(cautious)
I think you have the wrong person. I'm just staff.

SU QIANQIAN stands to leave. BO FENGFENG blocks her path.

BO FENGFENG
(low)
Stay.

Qianqian freezes. They stand inches apart.

SU QIANQIAN
(voice small)
Why does your voice sound like tears?

BO FENGFENG
Because I've been waiting five years to ask you a question.

BO FENGFENG opens a door—the one the maids mentioned.

BO FENGFENG
After you see what's inside, you can decide if I'm a stranger.

SU QIANQIAN
(hesitant)
What's in there?

BO FENGFENG
The truth about who you were. And who we were.

He holds out his bandaged hand—the fire scars visible. Qianqian stares at it, something flickering in her eyes.

title: Since We Parted, A Billion Reunions
description: A father's business deal leads to a tragic moment when his daughter is kidnapped while waiting in the car.
context:
Title: Since We Parted, A Billion Reunions
Description: A father's business deal leads to a tragic moment when his daughter is kidnapped while waiting in the car.

INT. CAR - DAY

XINYI traces hearts on the fogged window. FATHER checks his phone at a red light.

XINYI
Dad, you promised today was just for us.

FATHER
(quietly)
This is the last time. For your school.

He pulls into a convenience store lot, parks under a streetlight. Locks the doors.

FATHER
(removes a silver necklace)
Mom wore this when she was scared. Put it on. Two minutes.

He puts it on her, points to the store entrance.
continuation:
INT. CONVENIENCE STORE - DAY

FATHER signs papers with MR. ZHU by the window, constantly glancing at the car.

FATHER
Never again after today.

MR. ZHU
Good father.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

A TRAFFICKER on a tricycle watches, then approaches the car.

TRAFFICKER
Little girl, your dad forgot his phone.

XINYI
(softly)
He said don't open the door.

TRAFFICKER
See? He's waving at me.

He points to the store. Xinyi looks. The TRAFFICKER unlocks the door with a tool, covers her mouth. She struggles weakly. He places her in the cart, covers her. A butterfly hair clip falls to the pavement.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

FATHER walks out, smiling. Sees the car door open. The necklace hangs from the seat.

FATHER
Xinyi?

He picks up the butterfly clip from the pavement. Recognizes it—he gave it to her that morning.

FATHER
(whisper)
No...

He sees the tricycle turning. A small shoe visible under the cloth.

FATHER
(shouting)
XINYI!

He sprints to his car, fumbling with his keys.

title: Rise from Humble Beginnings
description: A modern poetry champion finds himself transported to ancient times after a mysterious earthquake, waking up bound in a woodshed far from his former life of luxury.
context:
Title: Rise from Humble Beginnings
Description: A modern poetry champion finds himself transported to ancient times after a mysterious earthquake, waking up bound in a woodshed far from his former life of luxury.

INT. MODERN LOFT - NIGHT

Candlelight flickers. GU QING is tied to a chair with silk rope, smiling.

ZHANG XIAOMAN (V.O.)
Brother Gu Qing, you're so predictable when you win.

ZHANG XIAOMAN, wearing a black silk dress, walks up to GU QING.

ZHANG XIAOMAN
This year's Poetry Competition. First place. Again.

GU QING
(smiling proudly)
Winning is a habit. Understanding the price—that's the art.

LI SHISHI, wearing a red dress, approaches from behind and rests her hands on GU QING's shoulders.

GU QING
Soon you'll find out that I'm even better in other ways.

LI SHISHI
Brother Qing, you're playing a dangerous game.

ZHANG XIAOMAN sits on GU QING's lap. The three share a charged moment.

GU QING
You're both afraid of the silence after the applause.

LI SHISHI
Then show us there's nothing to fear.

GU QING
What? Can't wait already?

ZHANG XIAOMAN
The great poet has been working all day. We should help you... relax properly.

Suddenly, the room SHAKES. The floor SPLITS with a glowing seam.

GU QING
(panicking)
What the hell?

The chair TIPS backward. He VANISHES into the light.
continuation:
EXT. DALIANG CAPITAL CITY - DAY

Majestic ancient city gates. Soldiers ride horses beneath poetry banners.

INT. WOODSHED - DAY

GU QING, now wearing ancient clothing, is tied to a chair with rough hemp rope. He wakes up with a start.

GU QING
(shouting)
Xiaoman! Shishi! The floor—!

He looks around and realizes the environment has completely changed. Two men in ancient clothing enter: a bald, scarred man named ZHANG LONG and his HENCHMAN.

HENCHMAN
Boss, the thief's awake.

ZHANG LONG
(contemptuously)
Thief? He's a ghost. No record of him anywhere.

GU QING
(confused and terrified)
Where is this? Who are you people? Where are my girls?

ZHANG LONG and the HENCHMAN close in on GU QING, their expressions menacing.

title: The Billionaire CEO's Beloved Substitute Wife
description: A woman serves as a marriage substitute for two years, only to face the return of the real bride after completing one final task.
context:
Title: The Billionaire CEO's Beloved Substitute Wife
Description: A woman serves as a marriage substitute for two years, only to face the return of the real bride after completing one final task.

INT. HOTEL BEDROOM - NIGHT

SU CI stands at the door, looking at the sleeping CEO FU on the bed.

SU CI (V.O.)
This is my husband. Two years of secret marriage, and I've never heard his voice. Never seen his face. Until tonight.

SU CI holds a glass, her expression complex. Her fingers tremble slightly.

SU CI (V.O.)
Every signature, every legal document—her name, my hand. But grandmother's medical bills are paid through tomorrow. That's all that matters now.

SU CI makes up her mind, walks to the bedside, and reaches out to touch CEO FU's chest with hesitant fingers.

SU CI (V.O.)
One night. Then this borrowed life finally ends.

CEO FU suddenly wakes up, grabs SU CI's wrist, and pulls her toward him. His eyes are sharp, predatory.

CEO FU
(low, dangerous)
Name yourself.

SU CI places her index finger on CEO FU's lips. For a moment, raw vulnerability flashes in her eyes.

SU CI
(quiet)
Someone who knows you're more than headlines and stock prices.

SU CI leans closer. Their breath mingles.

SU CI
Your wife.

SU CI kisses CEO FU, and the two become entangled together. She melts into him—not with triumph, but with the exhaustion of someone reaching the end of a long road.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL BEDROOM - DAY

CEO FU gets up and dresses. The ASSISTANT stands outside the door with BODYGUARDS.

ASSISTANT
President Fu, the hotel is locked down. The woman's trail is cold—she planned her escape.

CEO FU looks at a red stain on the bedsheet, his eyes cold. But his hand lingers on the fabric, almost... curious.

CEO FU
Two years of silence. Then she appears, vanishes, and leaves only questions.

The ASSISTANT walks into the room.

ASSISTANT
We've identified her. She's the one who signed the contract. The actual signatory.

CEO FU
(surprised)
The proxy bride? Not Su Xue?

CEO FU picks up the glass, now seeing it as evidence rather than a weapon.

CEO FU
Prepare the car. We're visiting the Su family residence.

BODYGUARD (O.S.)
Yes, President!

INT. VILLA ROOM - DAY

SU CI stands at the door, speaking to someone outside. She clutches her phone like a lifeline.

SU CI
(into phone)
The task is complete. Send the photograph of Grandma—timestamped. I need proof she's safe.

She hangs up, eyes hollow. She touches her lips, remembering.

EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

SUPER: THREE DAYS AGO

SU XUE sits at a table, giving orders to SU CI who is standing. Rain begins to fall.

SU XUE
The fertility specialist delivered the final report. I cannot conceive. You will take my place tonight.

SU CI
(refusing)
I've played your wife for two years. Not this.

SU XUE
Grandmother's private nurse reports her condition is declining. One photo of her, alive. That's what this night buys you.

SU XUE stands up and walks to SU CI, invading her space.

SU XUE
After tonight, the contract is void. You return to being nobody. I reclaim my name, my husband, my life. That's the deal.

SU XUE reveals a triumphant smile that doesn't quite reach her eyes.

title: Deep Love, Misty Tears
description: A man slaps his wife after being manipulated into believing she orchestrated an attack on her sister at a wedding, causing a miscarriage.
context:
Title: Deep Love, Misty Tears
Description: A man slaps his wife after being manipulated into believing she orchestrated an attack on her sister at a wedding, causing a miscarriage.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

The slap cracks like a gunshot. SU YU stumbles back, handprint blooming on her cheek. FU SINIAN's hand trembles.

FU SINIAN
Your driver. Your car. Your sister's blood on your scarf. How many coincidences make a plan?

He grabs her throat, pins her against the wall.

SU YU
(choked)
I was trying to save her. The car wasn't mine anymore.

FLASHBACK

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

SU CI lies still, fingers curled over her flat stomach. The fetal monitor shows a flatline, then her own steady heartbeat.

SU CI
(whisper)
Promise me... tell no one...

SU YU sits beside her, a blood-stained scarf in her lap.

SU YU
Tell them I wasn't driving. Tell them it was the backup car.

SU CI's eyes fix on the scarf. She flinches back.

SU CI
(terrified)
You promised safe...

She falls. Her head cracks against linoleum.

FU SINIAN bursts in. His eyes land on the scarf in SU YU's hands.

END FLASHBACK
continuation:
INT. HALLWAY - DAY

FU SINIAN's grip tightens.

FU SINIAN
She said "you promised safe." Those were her words. You're the only one who makes her promises.

SU XIA walks over, holding a phone.

SU XIA
The police recovered Big Sister's messages. From Second Sister's number. About the driver change.

(softly)
You did delete them from your phone, didn't you?

SU YU
(dawning horror)
My phone was missing that morning.

ASSISTANT LIN walks over with a folder.

ASSISTANT LIN
President Fu. The driver's statement. And the transfer records. Half a million from Mrs. Fu's account to his wife's clinic.

FU SINIAN
(quiet fury)
You bought loyalty. Then you bought silence.

SU YU
For his daughter's surgery. You signed it.

FU SINIAN
I signed for a child to live. Not for ours to die.

He releases her. She collapses against the wall.

FU SINIAN
Dissolution papers by morning. You're dead to this house.

He walks away. SU XIA remains, watching SU YU slide to the floor.

SU XIA
(quietly)
He was always going to choose the daughter who looked like his mother. Legitimacy has its privileges.

She touches SU YU's shoulder. Her smile is winter.

SU XIA (V.O.)
The shadow daughter wins. You just never thought to look for me in the dark.

title: Hello, Sweetheart
description: A professional mistress-remover uses deception to break up illicit relationships, but her latest job leads to an unexpected encounter with a mysterious man.
context:
Title: Hello, Sweetheart
Description: A professional mistress-remover uses deception to break up illicit relationships, but her latest job leads to an unexpected encounter with a mysterious man.

EXT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - DAY

Two BODYGUARDS in black suits and sunglasses walk past a black sedan.

XU QINGWU, wearing a loose overcoat and beret, runs anxiously into the parking garage.

XU QINGWU (V.O.)
My name is Xu Qingwu. I'm a gold-level relationship disruptor. I specialize in removing mistresses and defending the sanctity of marriage. But some days, I wonder who's really being saved.

XU QINGWU walks along, removing her bulky overcoat to reveal a fashionable beige knit dress underneath. She adjusts her appearance, her demeanor instantly transforming. She takes out her phone and makes a call.

XU QINGWU
(into phone)
Hello, Old Jin. Mission accomplished.

The two BODYGUARDS walk quickly in her direction. XU QINGWU looks back alertly, her expression tightening. She hangs up and walks briskly toward a silver Rolls-Royce.

XU QINGWU quickly opens the car door and gets into the passenger seat.

INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - DAY

XU MUSHEN, a handsome man wearing glasses, sits in the driver's seat. He looks at XU QINGWU in surprise as she suddenly enters.

XU MUSHEN
What are you doing?

XU QINGWU
(hands clasped together, pleading)
Emergency situation. Please help me.

XU QINGWU doesn't wait for XU MUSHEN to respond. She quickly leans forward, cups his face in her hands, and kisses him—precise, professional, a performance she's given a hundred times. The two BODYGUARDS outside see this through the window, pause for a moment, then turn and leave.

XU MUSHEN
(after being kissed, quietly)
You're not actually pregnant.

XU QINGWU (V.O.)
I never imagined that this man—who saw my truth in a single glance—would become the one disruption I couldn't plan for.
continuation:
INT. UPSCALE RESTAURANT - DAY

TITLE CARD: ONE HOUR EARLIER

XU QINGWU (V.O.)
It all started with one of my removal jobs. Standard protocol. Until it wasn't.

XU QINGWU, wearing a fake pregnancy belly under her loose overcoat, walks into a modern restaurant. She looks around and locks onto her target—JIAJIA, sitting in a booth wearing a fur coat with two BODYGUARDS standing beside her.

XU QINGWU walks up to JIAJIA and sits down.

JIAJIA
Who are you?

XU QINGWU
(stroking her belly)
Where's Old Jin?

JIAJIA
Why did he send you to meet me?

XU QINGWU
(smugly)
Oh, I'm pregnant. The due date is next month on the ninth. Old Jin was so happy when he heard. He's at my place right now preparing the full-month celebration for our son.

JIAJIA
(shocked)
What did you say?

XU QINGWU
(coolly)
Take the offer, Jiajia. The penthouse and three million. Or lose everything. Men like Jin don't leave—they upgrade.

JIAJIA
(through gritted teeth)

(angrily)

(calmly)

XU QINGWU darts past him, registering his words. XU MUSHEN stands firmly at the entrance, not yielding. The BODYGUARDS cannot pass. XU MUSHEN watches the direction XU QINGWU escaped, looking thoughtful.

XU MUSHEN's lips quirk slightly. He continues toward his car.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: CEO Fu's Mysterious Wife & The Runaway Wife is Beautiful and Cool
description: A woman married for three years to a CEO she's never met has a wild night with a stranger at a bar, only to discover he might be closer than she thinks.
context:
Title: CEO Fu's Mysterious Wife & The Runaway Wife is Beautiful and Cool
Description: A woman married for three years to a CEO she's never met has a wild night with a stranger at a bar, only to discover he might be closer than she thinks.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

A hand lifts a fox mask from the wall. RUOHAN (26), face obscured, scans the room. Her gaze lands on CEO FU (32), solitary in a VIP booth with a half-empty glass. She glides over, perches beside him, fingers trailing his thigh.

RUOHAN
(muffled behind mask)
Handsome. Can I borrow your... belt?

CEO FU
(eyes darkening)
Is that a request or a confession?

RUOHAN
Which one makes you unzip it?

CEO FU
(captures her wrist)
The one that gets you into trouble.

RUOHAN
Then I'm already there.

CEO FU
(sweeps her into his arms)
Let's see how deep.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

CEO FU lays RUOHAN on the bed. Silk sheets catch the moonlight. The fox mask stays on as his tie slides free. Their shadows merge on the wall.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Morning light stripes across couture casualties. RUOHAN's eyes snap open—CEO FU asleep beside her, his hand resting on her hip. She freezes. Recognition slams into her: she's memorized this face in Forbes. Her gaze drops to the lingerie strap on her shoulder. Panic crystallizes.
continuation:
INT. BAR - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

RUOHAN and her BEST FRIEND roll dice on the bar counter.

BEST FRIEND
Three years, Ruohan. You've studied his face in every business magazine, but your husband doesn't know you exist. Divorce papers tomorrow—so tonight, you're invisible.

RUOHAN
Invisible sounds perfect.

BEST FRIEND
Loser pulls the belt off Mr. VIP. No mask, no mercy.

RUOHAN
(rolls)
Deal.

She loses. Grabs the fox mask from the wall.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

RUOHAN (V.O.)
Invisible. Not divorced yet. If he sees me—

She secures the fox mask. Gathers her dress, her heels. Spots her bra hooked on his wristwatch—unclasps it with trembling fingers. She's three steps from the door when—

CEO FU
(grabs her waist from behind)
The fox leaves her den?

RUOHAN
We had a transaction. It's done.

CEO FU
(pulls her flush against him)
I never signed the receipt.

RUOHAN
We were drunk.

CEO FU
I wasn't.

RUOHAN
Then you know the rules.

CEO FU
(turns her to face him)
The mask stays on. Curious rule for a one-night hunt.

RUOHAN
I'm full of contradictions.

CEO FU
So am I.

He pushes her against the wall, hands framing the mask.

RUOHAN
What are you doing?

CEO FU
Testing your rules.

His robe drops. She gasps.

RUOHAN
We said once!

CEO FU
We said nothing.

The mask slips.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Flash Marriage CEO Dotes on Me
description: At her engagement party, a woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal with her sister, leading to a shocking incident by the pool.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage CEO Dotes on Me
Description: At her engagement party, a woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal with her sister, leading to a shocking incident by the pool.

EXT. ENGAGEMENT PARTY LAWN - NIGHT

A banner reads "Engagement Party - FU BEITING x YE WUYOU."

FU BEITING and YE WUYOU stand together, facing the guests.

FU BEITING
Everyone, thank you for celebrating with us. Please enjoy yourselves.

The guests applaud.

FU BEITING
(to Ye Wuyou)
I'll be back.

YE WUYOU nods. FU BEITING leaves.

YE WUYOU walks alone toward the bar and picks up a glass of wine. YE RANYI approaches in white silk.

YE RANYI
Sister. You finally trapped him. But you can't keep a man who doesn't want to be kept.

YE WUYOU
(coldly)
Is that so?

YE RANYI
(leaning in)
Last night he told me you're just a merger. And mergers can be broken.

YE WUYOU's hand trembles. Wine spills across Ye Ranyi's dress.
continuation:
YE WUYOU
Careless of me.

YE RANYI
Look.

She shows her phone—a hotel selfie. Fu Beiting asleep beside her. Timestamped 3:47 AM.

YE WUYOU
(very quiet)
How sad for you.

Ye Wuyou turns away. Ye Ranyi grabs her wrist.

YE RANYI
Let's see who he loves.

She pulls Ye Wuyou toward the pool's edge.

YE RANYI
If we both fall, who does he save?

Ye Ranyi pushes. Ye Wuyou falls, struggling.

YE WUYOU
(screaming)

She surfaces, gasping.

YE WUYOU
(calling for help)
Help! Help!

Guests rush over. Fu Beiting appears on the terrace, frozen. Behind him, a MAN IN BLACK suit moves forward, already unbuttoning his jacket.

title: Future Diary
description: A photographer encounters a mysterious old man in white during a photoshoot at a pig farm.
context:
Title: Future Diary
Description: A photographer encounters a mysterious old man in white during a photoshoot at a pig farm.

INT. PIG FARM - DAY

Funky music plays with a strong rhythm.

A beautiful woman in an orange dress and high heels walks down the aisle of the pig farm, carrying an iron basin. Her movements are graceful and alluring. Pigs poke their heads out from the pens on both sides.

The WOMAN turns to face the camera, striking various poses.

A PHOTOGRAPHER in the distance takes photos of her.

PHOTOGRAPHER
Hey, hey, not bad. Looking good, beautiful. Very good, let's take a break.

The WOMAN stops posing and walks toward the PHOTOGRAPHER. The PHOTOGRAPHER looks down at his camera, reviewing the photos.

PHOTOGRAPHER
(confused)
Miss, when we were shooting just now, was there an old man around?

WOMAN
(puzzled)
An old man? No, it's just the two of us, right?

The PHOTOGRAPHER continues scrolling through the camera. He zooms in on one photo. In the image, an old man in white clothes holding a fan stands behind the WOMAN.

PHOTOGRAPHER
(shocked)
What the... There's an old man right here! What's going on?

Suddenly, all the lights in the pig farm go out. Everything plunges into darkness.
continuation:
PHOTOGRAPHER
(panicking)
What the... Why did it go dark? Miss?

A beam of light suddenly illuminates. The OLD MAN in white Tang suit appears in front of the PHOTOGRAPHER, smiling at him.

OLD MAN
Young man. The diary shows what will be. Your final photo proves it.

The PHOTOGRAPHER checks his camera. The last image shows the WOMAN, lifeless beside the basin. He looks up—she's stumbling toward it.

PHOTOGRAPHER
(desperate)
Miss! Stop!

He lunges, pulling her back as the basin crashes. The lights RETURN. The OLD MAN is gone.

The WOMAN touches the camera screen, showing her alive and safe.

WOMAN
You saw it. My death.

She sees the PHOTOGRAPHER's reflection in the lens—behind it, the faint image of the OLD MAN's fan.

WOMAN
(whispering)
The diary... now has your name, doesn't it?

PHOTOGRAPHER
(quietly)
Let's finish the shoot.

He pockets the diary that materialized in his hand.

FADE OUT.

title: Power and Favor Under Heaven
description: A modern surgeon is electrocuted and transmigrates into the body of an ancient princess who forced a prince into marriage, leading to his downfall.
context:
Title: Power and Favor Under Heaven
Description: A modern surgeon is electrocuted and transmigrates into the body of an ancient princess who forced a prince into marriage, leading to his downfall.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

Tense, minimalist music. A digital surgical monitor BEEP steadily.

CLOSE UP - YUAN QINGLING's gloved hands accept instruments with surgical precision: forceps, scalpel, hemostat. Her fingers move with the muscle memory of a thousand procedures. The monitor shows a complex cardiac reconstruction.

YUAN QINGLING (O.S.)
Defer the distal anastomosis. Monofilament 5-0.

She completes a microscopic suture pattern—a technique she pioneered for pediatric patients. The BEEPING steadies. She steps back, eyes exhausted but satisfied.

YUAN QINGLING
Heart's compensating. I'll write the post-op orders.

She turns. Muted conversation behind her:

MALE DOCTOR
(off-record)
That curvature on the inferior vena cava... who else would attempt it?

FEMALE NURSE
(quietly)
She hasn't slept in 36 hours. Again.

INT. DOCTOR'S LOUNGE - DAY

YUAN QINGLING (30s, sharp features, hair in a practical bun) enters, shoulders slumped. She places her coat on the rack with ritualistic care—aligning the collar exactly.

YUAN QINGLING (V.O.)
Third double-shift this month. The chief warned me about burnout. I told him pediatric hearts don't wait for optimal work-life balance.

She fills her cup at the sink. Her hand trembles slightly—just enough. Water sloshes onto the counter, trickling toward a charging cable plugged into a portable ultrasound device.

The cup slips. It hits the cable connection. Not a dramatic shower of sparks—a single fizzing arc, almost soundless.

YUAN QINGLING's body seizes. Her hand grips the metal cup, frozen. The world strobes: lounge lights flicker against a vision of dark wooden beams. Then black.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT BEDCHAMBER - DAY

YUAN QINGLING awakens on cold stone. Her fingers—now pale and uncalloused—grasp silk robes soaked with blood. She gasps, tasting copper and incense.

YUAN QINGLING
(weakly)
This isn't... the hospital...

She touches her chest. A jade hairpin, snapped in half, protrudes from a shallow puncture wound just lateral to her sternum—avoiding the lung by centimeters.

YUAN QINGLING
(shocked, professional instinct surfacing)
Subcutaneous placement. Not arterial... but contamination risk...

She extracts it, noting the entry angle with clinical distance. Blood oozes, not spurts. A calculated wound—the work of someone who didn't fully commit.

A door slides open. PRINCE CHU YUWEN HAO (late 20s, rigid posture, eyes hollowed by sleeplessness) enters. He stops, seeing her awake. His jaw tightens.

YUAN QINGLING
(uncertain, testing)
...Your Highness?

YUWEN HAO
(walking past her to the bed)
You missed the artery. Pity. It would have saved me the paperwork of a divorce.

YUAN QINGLING
(flinching)
You wanted me to—

YUWEN HAO suddenly pivots, his hand around her throat—controlled, not crushing. His thumb presses against her carotid with disturbing familiarity.

YUWEN HAO
(low, measured)
Want? I wanted to spend my life rebuilding flood defenses. I wanted to marry Ming Cui and honor my mother's dying wish. What I want is irrelevant. What I have is a scarlet-handed daughter of a war hero who drugged my wine, crawled into my bed, and then watched her father destroy my credibility with the Emperor when I refused the marriage.

He releases her. She staggers back.

YUWEN HAO
I drank the physician's tonic to get through one night. One night. And lost everything that mattered.

He turns to leave, then pauses at the threshold.

YUWEN HAO
(to the guards outside)
The Princess Consort is confined to quarters. She has no rank, no privilege, no name here. She is a ghost the manor forgot.

The door slides shut. YUAN QINGLING stands frozen, the original body's memories flooding her—not as narrative, but as physical sensations: the taste of the drugged wine, the prince's cold hands, the hollow victory of the wedding night.

Her fingers find a second hairpin in her hair. She stares at it. Her medical mind calculates the angle, the force required.

YUAN QINGLING
(V.O., whispered)
She couldn't live with being his regret.

She drives it toward her chest—but her modern reflexes twist at the last second. The pin grazes her shoulder, tearing fabric. She collapses against the bedpost, breathing hard.

The fragmented memories settle. She understands.

YUAN QINGLING
(to herself, voice gaining strength)
No. I didn't survive a thousand hours in the OR to die as someone else's mistake.

She rips silk from her sleeve to bandage the wound with practiced efficiency.

NANNY QI (60s, face like weathered leather, keys jangling at her waist) enters without knocking. She sees the blood on the floor and the discarded hairpin.

NANNY QI
(contemptuous, but tired)
Still breathing? The Marquis taught his daughter many things, but follow-through wasn't one of them.

She kicks YUAN QINGLING's ankle—not hard, just enough to move her aside and mop the blood with a rag.

NANNY QI
The prince wants this room cleared by dusk. Your belongings will be sent to the west storage. Where they belong.

A MAID (16, breathless) appears at the door.

MAID
Physician Li is needed! The carpenter's apprentice fell from the roof beam—his leg's turned wrong!

NANNY QI
Fetch the old doctor from town. Physician Li won't touch commoners.

YUAN QINGLING's head snaps up. She tests her legs, stands.

YUAN QINGLING
(internal monologue, sharp and clear)
Compound fracture. Possible vascular compromise. Every minute counts.

She moves toward the door, her modern stride clipping the silk robes. Her eyes are no longer a victim's.

Subcutaneous placement. Not arterial... but contamination risk...

She extracts it, noting the entry angle with clinical distance. Blood oozes, not spurts. A calculated wound—the work of someone who didn't fully commit.

A door slides open. PRINCE CHU YUWEN HAO (late 20s, rigid posture, eyes hollowed by sleeplessness) enters. He stops, seeing her awake. His jaw tightens.

YUAN QINGLING
(uncertain, testing)
...Your Highness?

YUWEN HAO
(walking past her to the bed)
You missed the artery. Pity. It would have saved me the paperwork of a divorce.

YUAN QINGLING
(flinching)
You wanted me to—

YUWEN HAO suddenly pivots, his hand around her throat—controlled, not crushing. His thumb presses against her carotid with disturbing familiarity.

YUWEN HAO
(low, measured)
Want? I wanted to spend my life rebuilding flood defenses. I wanted to marry Ming Cui and honor my mother's dying wish. What I want is irrelevant. What I have is a scarlet-handed daughter of a war hero who drugged my wine, crawled into my bed, and then watched her father destroy my credibility with the Emperor when I refused the marriage.

He releases her. She staggers back.

YUWEN HAO
I drank the physician's tonic to get through one night. One night. And lost everything that mattered.

He turns to leave, then pauses at the threshold.

YUWEN HAO
(to the guards outside)
The Princess Consort is confined to quarters. She has no rank, no privilege, no name here. She is a ghost the manor forgot.

The door slides shut. YUAN QINGLING stands frozen, the original body's memories flooding her—not as narrative, but as physical sensations: the taste of the drugged wine, the prince's cold hands, the hollow victory of the wedding night.

Her fingers find a second hairpin in her hair. She stares at it. Her medical mind calculates the angle, the force required.

YUAN QINGLING
(V.O., whispered)
She couldn't live with being his regret.

She drives it toward her chest—but her modern reflexes twist at the last second. The pin grazes her shoulder, tearing fabric. She collapses against the bedpost, breathing hard.

The fragmented memories settle. She understands.

YUAN QINGLING
(to herself, voice gaining strength)
No. I didn't survive a thousand hours in the OR to die as someone else's mistake.

She rips silk from her sleeve to bandage the wound with practiced efficiency.

NANNY QI (60s, face like weathered leather, keys jangling at her waist) enters without knocking. She sees the blood on the floor and the discarded hairpin.

NANNY QI
(contemptuous, but tired)
Still breathing? The Marquis taught his daughter many things, but follow-through wasn't one of them.

She kicks YUAN QINGLING's ankle—not hard, just enough to move her aside and mop the blood with a rag.

NANNY QI
The prince wants this room cleared by dusk. Your belongings will be sent to the west storage. Where they belong.

A MAID (16, breathless) appears at the door.

MAID
Physician Li is needed! The carpenter's apprentice fell from the roof beam—his leg's turned wrong!

NANNY QI
Fetch the old doctor from town. Physician Li won't touch commoners.

YUAN QINGLING's head snaps up. She tests her legs, stands.

YUAN QINGLING
(internal monologue, sharp and clear)
Compound fracture. Possible vascular compromise. Every minute counts.

She moves toward the door, her modern stride clipping the silk robes. Her eyes are no longer a victim's.

title: Back to Ancient Times as a Boss - Episode 1
description: A modern man transmigrates into ancient China, only to discover he's become the son of a notorious traitor working in a brothel.
context:
Title: Back to Ancient Times as a Boss - Episode 1
Description: A modern man transmigrates into ancient China, only to discover he's become the son of a notorious traitor working in a brothel.

INT. YANYU BROTHEL - DAY

Silk lanterns and painted screens. Laughter mingles with lute music in a haze of incense.

WOMAN (V.O.)
Master, I have a black mole on my chest. Do you want to come see it?

INT. ROOM - DAY

QIN MU lies in bed, blanket covering his face, twitching in restless sleep.

WOMAN (V.O.)
Stop—your hands are too bold. Not here... I can't. If you truly want me, come to my chamber.

QIN MU suddenly sits up, looking around, shocked.

QIN MU
(to himself)
I've transmigrated... to a brothel?

He blinks—then a grin spreads wild across his face.

QIN MU
Thirty years a virgin, and now this? The heavens have finally answered! Attendant!

The door opens. MADAM (40s) enters in purple silk, her expression all business.

QIN MU
(pointing at the MADAM)
You! Attend me well, and you'll be handsomely rewarded.

MADAM
(beckoning with one finger)
Come here.

QIN MU
(rubbing his hands, walking over eagerly)
Here I come!
continuation:
MADAM touches his face—then slaps him hard.

QIN MU
(stunned)
What was that for? I ordered service!

MADAM
(ice in her voice)
Order me? Qin Mu, have you lost your mind? Two men upstairs demanded you by name. They're waiting.

QIN MU
(shocked)
Me? Serve them? You mean I'm not a customer—I'm the merchandise?

He sinks to his knees, head in hands.

QIN MU
Emperors and princes... they get thrones. I get a pleasure house.

MADAM
(kneeling, urgent)
You've only been here three days—yet they knew your name. These aren't customers. They're Palace Bureau agents. One wrong word and I can't save you. Remember: you are Qin San. Not Qin Mu. Never Qin Mu.

QIN MU
(muttering)
Imperial City... why me...?

Images flash: iron shackles, a prison cart, his father's name on a wanted scroll.

QIN MU (V.O.)
Great Xia Dynasty. My father is Qin Hui—the traitor who murdered General Yue Fei. And I am his only son.

All color drains from his face.

QIN MU
(cold terror)
If they find me... they'll cut me to pieces.

QIN MU points at the ceiling, voice raw with grief.

QIN MU
From traitor's son... to hunted whore. Heaven's joke, or my doom?

title: Return to Shanghai Bund - Rising to the Top
description: A boxer loses a match to save his wife, but arrives too late. A mystical amulet sends him back to 1847 Shanghai, where he gets a second chance.
context:
Title: Return to Shanghai Bund - Rising to the Top
Description: A boxer loses a match to save his wife, but arrives too late. A mystical amulet sends him back to 1847 Shanghai, where he gets a second chance.

INT. BOXING GYM - NIGHT

On the boxing ring, LIN YUAN and TAI SHAN are in an intense match. The audience below is excited, shouting and cheering loudly.

After several rounds, TAI SHAN pins LIN YUAN to the ground.

TAI SHAN
(whispering)
The money's already in your account. Stay down. Think of Ruo Qi.

LIN YUAN
(whispering)
Your belt... your career...

TAI SHAN
Just a belt. You keep your word.

TAI SHAN releases LIN YUAN, who stays down. The match continues.

LIN YUAN's voice echoes in TAI SHAN's mind.

LIN YUAN (V.O.)
You keep your word.

TAI SHAN knocks LIN YUAN to the ground with one punch.

The REFEREE raises TAI SHAN's hand.

REFEREE
In this boxing championship, Tai Shan wins!

The audience angrily throws things at the stage.

AUDIENCE
Refund! Refund! Can't you fight properly!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

LIN YUAN runs anxiously to a DOCTOR and shows his phone.

LIN YUAN
Doctor, the transfer cleared! Start the treatment!

DOCTOR
I'm sorry, Mr. Lin. We needed it hours ago. Say your goodbyes.

LIN YUAN
(grabbing the doctor's collar)
Then why did you tell me—

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LIN YUAN rushes to RUO QI's bedside. RUO QI lies weakly on the bed.

LIN YUAN
Ruo Qi! I got the money. I did it.

RUO QI
You threw it... your shot... for nothing...

RUO QI takes out an amulet.

RUO QI
This is for your next fight... so you never lose again. Find me there.

RUO QI puts the amulet around LIN YUAN's neck.

The heart monitor flatlines with a long beep.

LIN YUAN
(shouting)
Ruo Qi! Ruo Qi! Ruo Qi!

The amulet around LIN YUAN's neck emits a dazzling green light.

MONTAGE

Quick flashes of outer space, Earth, ancient sailing ships, the year 1847, a time tunnel, and other images.

EXT. SHANGHAI BUND STREET - NIGHT

LIN YUAN, dressed in Republic-era clothing, sits in a rickshaw, looking bewildered.

A rickshaw puller, XIANG ZI, stands beside the cart.

XIANG ZI
Ruo Qi.

LIN YUAN
(confused)
Ruo Qi?

XIANG ZI
Ruo Qi!

LIN YUAN looks at the unfamiliar surroundings and realizes he has traveled through time.

title: Canary Training Manual
description: A dark tale of control and complicated relationships involving power dynamics and past connections.
context:
Title: Canary Training Manual
Description: A dark tale of control and complicated relationships involving power dynamics and past connections.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

In the dark room, LU JINGCHU sits on the sofa, turning a lighter over in his fingers. Flame on. Flame off.

The door opens. YE XIN walks in, exhaustion in her posture.

LU JINGCHU holds up a photograph. A young man's face.

YE XIN stops. Stares.

LU JINGCHU pulls her to the sofa, ignites the photo. The flame lights his cold face.

LU JINGCHU
Three years. You still keep his photo?

He drops the burning photo, grips her chin.

LU JINGCHU
You knelt for your father's life. Now you posture for a ghost? Even if Lu Zhisen returns, would he want what's left?

YE XIN meets his eyes. Something steels there.

YE XIN
If I had a choice, I'd choose neither.

LU JINGCHU smiles, thin. Kisses her hard. Pushes her toward the bedroom.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - CONTINUOUS

LU JINGCHU throws YE XIN onto the bed, pins her wrists.

YE XIN
(struggling)
Get off me!

LU JINGCHU
(whispering)
Keep cursing.

He leans down. She turns away.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Morning. Sunlight.

LU JINGCHU smokes. YE XIN lies with her back to him.

LU JINGCHU
Dinner tonight. Come.

YE XIN
(coldly)
Take someone else.

LU JINGCHU
Fine.

She picks up her phone. The screen shows a news article: "Lu Zhisen Returns, Spotted With Companion." The photo: Lu Zhisen with a woman.

She looks at it. No tear. She zooms in on the woman's face, then closes it.

She sits up. Looks at LU JINGCHU's back. Practices a small smile in the mirror.

title: The Peerless Mystic Healer
description: A man desperately tries to get his family's demolition compensation money from his girlfriend to save his dying mother, only to be humiliated and refused.
context:
Title: The Peerless Mystic Healer
Description: A man desperately tries to get his family's demolition compensation money from his girlfriend to save his dying mother, only to be humiliated and refused.

INT. SWIMMING POOL - DAY

MISS SU, in a red bikini, swims through the pool. A MEDICAL ID BRACELET glints on her wrist.

She swims to the edge and climbs out using the ladder, breathing heavily.

QING TAN, a woman in a black business suit, walks forward with a white cover-up and drapes it over MISS SU.

QING TAN
The hospital confirmed the kidney donor. Friday's surgery.

QING TAN
You'll finally be free from dialysis.

MISS SU
Another stranger's organ. Another debt.

On the other side, YE FENG anxiously looks at his phone, then rushes off.

YE FENG accidentally bumps into MISS SU, instinctively steadying her. For a heartbeat, MISS SU's fatigue seems to ease.

QING TAN (O.S.)
(angrily)
How dare you! Do you know who—

YE FENG
(apologizing)
Sorry—I'm in a hurry. My mother—

MISS SU
Qing Tan, forget it.

YE FENG
Thank you. Thank you.

YE FENG hurries away.

MISS SU (V.O.)
Strange... why did his touch make the pain disappear?

MISS SU
Qing Tan, go follow him. Help if you can.

QING TAN
Yes, Miss.

QING TAN walks in the direction YE FENG went.
continuation:
INT. SWIMMING POOL LOUNGE AREA - DAY

LILI and LILI'S MOM are leisurely lying on lounge chairs.

YE FENG runs up to them.

YE FENG
Lili. The demolition money—Mom's crashing. ICU says tonight.

LILI'S MOM
(contemptuously)
It's been in our account three days. We told you—we're using it for the house down payment.

YE FENG
(pleading)
You promised to hold it for Mom's surgery. Please—

LILI
Oh, Ye Feng. The doctors say it's fifty-fifty. Why waste it?

YE FENG
I'm begging you. It's my parents' entire life. I'll work triple shifts—

LILI'S MOM
(mocking)
With what skills? You're a delivery boy who can't even afford rent.

LILI picks up a water glass from the table and splashes the water in YE FENG's face.

LILI'S MOM
(mocking)
A useless waste like you? You're daydreaming. Today, you get nothing.

YE FENG's face is dripping with water, his eyes filled with anger and despair.

title: Seduced the Wrong Uncle: Madam's Daily Revenge
description: A secretary is framed for embezzlement and faces arrest, but she holds leverage over her boss after a night together, threatening to expose their affair to his nephew, her fiancé.
context:
Title: Seduced the Wrong Uncle: Madam's Daily Revenge
Description: A secretary is framed for embezzlement and faces arrest, but she holds leverage over her boss after a night together, threatening to expose their affair to his nephew, her fiancé.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: President Nan

QIN KE lies on the sofa, breathless. NAN MING cages her with his arms, suit jacket gone.

ON SCREEN: Night

Their lips meet. A shattered wine glass on the floor.

ON SCREEN: One night passes

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Two SECURITY GUARDS enter the elevator.

QIN KE rises from the sofa, adjusting her red dress.

ON SCREEN: Nan Ming's Office

NAN MING touches the lipstick mark on his jaw. He turns toward QIN KE, lifting her chin.

ON SCREEN: Nanfeng Group President - Nan Ming
ON SCREEN: Nanfeng Group Secretary - Qin Ke

NAN MING
Thirty million in bribes. Police downstairs. Kneel now, and I'll cut three years from your sentence.

QIN KE
(smiling faintly)
Uncle... are you certain I'm the one who took it?
continuation:
KNOCKING at the door.

POLICE (O.S.)
Open up! Police!

QIN KE glances toward the door, blows NAN MING a kiss, then opens it.

She immediately pulls NAN MING against the door, pinning him.

NAN MING
Qin Ke—

QIN KE
Beg?

NAN MING
Your final chance.

QIN KE
Prison for peace? Perfect. But last night... you were compromised. I saved you. The five billion shares from our Liyuan merger—transfer them to Nan Yibo before my sentencing. Your nephew. Your blood. You wouldn't betray family, would you?

NAN MING
(angrily)
Still thinking about money? You have no heart.

QIN KE
I'm his woman, not yours. Whether I have a heart is none of your business.

NAN MING grabs QIN KE, pins her against the door, and kisses her fiercely.

The POLICE burst through the door.

POLICE
Don't move!

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Runaway Bride Marries Right
description: A powerful leader in disguise as a taxi driver helps a runaway bride escape her wedding, while secretly hunting down a traitor within his organization.
context:
Title: The Runaway Bride Marries Right
Description: A powerful leader in disguise as a taxi driver helps a runaway bride escape her wedding, while secretly hunting down a traitor within his organization.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

LING TIAN, the crisp yellow vest reading "Yihao Taxi" at odds with his tailored trousers, leans against his black sedan. He methodically closes a worn leather notebook as he finishes his lunchbox.

Bare feet sound on asphalt. A WOMAN in a torn wedding dress appears, veil discarded, determination etched on her face.

LING TIAN glances up, registers her, then reaches for his car door—

A nondescript van screeches to a halt behind him. DA EN steps out, alone, in a delivery uniform. He approaches casually, but his posture screams military precision.

DA EN
(flat, rehearsed)
Your delivery. Sign here.

He slides a sealed envelope across the roof of the car. Ling Tian's fingers brush it—paper thin, but heavier than it should be.

LING TIAN
How long have I been waiting for this delivery?

DA EN
Three weeks. The package is getting impatient. Thinks the recipient moved.

LING TIAN
(tucking envelope away)

DA EN
Understood.

Da En nods, turns on his heel, and walks back. The van pulls away.

Ling Tian watches them go, his thumb tracing the envelope's edge. He slides into the driver's seat.
continuation:
EXT. HIGHWAY - CONTINUOUS

The Runaway Bride — MIAN — sprints toward a gap in traffic, wedding dress bunched in her fists. She spots Ling Tian's car, the only vehicle not speeding past—and the driver's calm profile.

She veers toward it.

EXT. LING TIAN'S CAR - CONTINUOUS

(into phone)

title: The Young Marshal Coaxed Me All Wedding Night
description: A modern doctor is killed in a car accident and wakes up in the body of a simple-minded young woman in the Republican era, discovering she was murdered and must navigate her new life as a marshal's wife.
context:
Title: The Young Marshal Coaxed Me All Wedding Night
Description: A modern doctor is killed in a car accident and wakes up in the body of a simple-minded young woman in the Republican era, discovering she was murdered and must navigate her new life as a marshal's wife.

EXT. MODERN CITY STREET - DAY

WAN WAN (28), sharply dressed in a white blazer and heels, applies lipstick while walking. Wireless earbuds nestle in her ears.

DEAN (V.O.)
Just remember to mention the hospital during your acceptance speech.

WAN WAN
(smiling)
Don't worry, I'll make sure you're credited.

A SCREECHING ENGINE. Wan Wan's head snaps up—

METAL IMPACT. Her body CRASHES onto a sedan hood. The lipstick rolls across pavement.

MONTAGE:
- Skyscrapers blur into watercolor
- Air bubbles rise through dark water
- Golden light fractures into shards

INT. REPUBLICAN ERA BEDROOM - DAY

WAN WAN's eyes flutter open. She lies in an ornate four-poster bed, silk canopy overhead. Her temples throb beneath linen bandages.

ON SCREEN: QIN WAN WAN - SECOND MISS OF THE QIN FAMILY

Her fingers trace the unfamiliar qipao collar. Pain lances through her skull—not from the bandages, but from memories that aren't hers.

WAN WAN (V.O.)
Dead. And then... not.

She stumbles to a vanity. The face in the mirror is wrong—softer, younger, with haunted eyes.

Her reflection triggers—

INSERT - FLASHBACK:
continuation:
EXT. QIN ESTATE - GARDEN - NIGHT

The ORIGINAL QIN WAN WAN (20) clutches a silk handkerchief, her features gentle but vacant. She rocks slightly, humming.

BUTLER (50s), polished shoes clicking on stone, approaches with practiced sympathy.

BUTLER
Miss, the Young Master is waiting by the pavilion. He has a surprise for you.

ORIGINAL QIN WAN WAN
Fireworks? He promised fireworks...

BUTLER
Exactly. But you must hurry. This way.

He guides her toward shadowed hedges. She trips; he steadies her, gaze flicking toward darkness beyond.

ORIGINAL WAN WAN
(whispering)
Pretty lights...

A FIGURE emerges behind her. Not a word—just a swift, silent strike. She crumples. The BUTLER catches her, lowering her silently.

A gloved hand checks her pulse. Nods.

FIGURE
Payment. Then we disappear.

They melt into shadows.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. REPUBLICAN ERA BEDROOM - DAY

WAN WAN stares at her new face, knuckles white on the vanity.

WAN WAN (V.O.)
She trusted them. And they killed her for it.

FOOTSTEPS echo in the hall. Heavy. Purposeful. Multiple sets.

She straightens, steel entering her eyes. No time for weakness.

She grabs a silver hairpin—weapon? Tool?—and slips it into her sleeve.

The door handle turns.

WAN WAN
(softly, to her reflection)
Let's see what we're dealing with.

The door begins to open—

FADE OUT.

title: Supreme War Wolf
description: On his wedding night, a groom's devotion becomes his downfall when his bride's betrayal unleashes a blood feud that will reshape the martial world.
context:
Title: Supreme War Wolf
Description: On his wedding night, a groom's devotion becomes his downfall when his bride's betrayal unleashes a blood feud that will reshape the martial world.

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - NIGHT

Fast cuts: A giant red double happiness character is splattered with blood. A group wearing white masks and black robes move with surgical precision through the chaos. Guests fall silently, tables overturn with military precision, lanterns extinguish one by one.

YE XINGCHEN, wearing a golden groom's suit, clutches a shattered jade betrothal token in his bloodied hand. He lies among the fallen, his breathing labored.

YE XINGCHEN
(strangled)
Ah...

LONG SHAO, in an obsidian-black suit, stands with ZHOU YUERU in her bridal gown—now stained crimson. Black-robed figures flank them, their blades still dripping.

YE XINGCHEN
(lifting his head, voice cracking)
Yu'er... the vows we wrote...

YE XINGCHEN
(struggling)
Even if you never loved me... why destroy everyone?

ZHOU YUERU
(her voice wavers for half a heartbeat, then hardens)
Love? The Zhou clan's survival demanded a better alliance. You were simply... convenient leverage.

YE XINGCHEN
(demanding)
Seventeen years of protection! My father saved your life!

ZHOU YUERU
continuation:
She glances at Long Shao's impassive face, then forces a cruel smile.
That's why you're still breathing. Consider it... interest on the debt.

LONG SHAO
He toys with a ring bearing the Ye family crest, now his trophy.
I don't just take what I want, boy. I erase the very memory of those who opposed me. You'll live to witness your clan's legacy become mine.

YE XINGCHEN
(struggling)
I'll see you in hell!

YE XINGCHEN tries to rise. Zhou Yueru's red heel crushes his fingers—not stomping, but grinding slowly, methodically. Her eyes show fleeting regret; Long Shao's show pure fascination.

LONG SHAO
(quietly delighted)
Good. Let the last Ye remember how powerless he was. How even his bride's cruelty was borrowed from my will.

ZHOU YUERU
(to Long Shao, voice hollow)
The Ye manor burns beautifully. Shall we watch from our wedding chamber?

LONG SHAO
(lifting her chin)
You learn quickly. Tonight, you'll consummate your real marriage—to power.

They turn. Ye Xingchen watches, his bloody fingers closing around the broken jade token, now cutting his palm. He doesn't roar—he whispers.

YE XINGCHEN
(viciously quiet)
Every drop. Every name. I'll write them with your blood.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Reborn: Medical Hands Cover the Sky
description: A man who sacrificed everything for love is reborn after a tragic death, discovering he has returned with mysterious powers.
context:
Title: Reborn: Medical Hands Cover the Sky
Description: A man who sacrificed everything for love is reborn after a tragic death, discovering he has returned with mysterious powers.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

NURSES wheel a gurney with LING CHEN through the corridor. He convulses violently, foam flecking his lips.

NURSE
Make way! Poisoning case!

They crash through the OR doors.

FLASHBACK TO:

EXT. HOSPITAL PLAZA - DAY

QIAN TING collapses at LING CHEN's feet in the pouring rain.

QIAN TING
(crying)
Ling Chen... malignant tumor. I need a living donor. Can't afford the tests.

LING CHEN helps her up, his fingers pressing her pulse. His eyes shimmer with inner light.

LING CHEN
I'll get tested. Don't worry about the cost.

QIAN TING
(moved)
You'd really do that... for me?

She hugs him. Over his shoulder, her smile turns triumphant.
continuation:
INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

LING CHEN lies anesthetized, oxygen mask on. DOCTOR LI operates laparoscopically.

NURSE
Doctor, pressure's dropping. The tissue is regenerating as we cut.

DOCTOR LI
Note the anomaly. Increase fluids.

The monitor flickers with impossible readings.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

LING CHEN kneels. QIAN TING packs a suitcase.

LING CHEN
Qian Ting, the doctors said I almost died on that table.

QIAN TING slaps him hard.

QIAN TING
I stayed one year. We're even.

LING CHEN
(pleading)
Don't leave me with the debt. Please.

QIAN TING
You volunteered. Sign the papers.

LING CHEN
(desperate)
I gave you my liver...

QIAN TING
(quietly)
And I gave you a year. Now get it over with.

An empty pill bottle rolls to his feet.

LING CHEN
If that's what you truly want...

He swallows the remaining pills. QIAN TING watches, frozen, as he collapses.

BACK TO PRESENT:

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

DOCTOR LI attempts resuscitation. Asystole.

DOCTOR LI
Time of death, 14:37.

The monitor flatlines. The team steps back.

Suddenly, LING CHEN bolts upright, ripping off his mask. His eyes glow faintly blue.

LING CHEN
(whispering)
The tribulation... I survived?

He looks at his hands. Surgical scars fade. The monitor starts beeping—perfect rhythm.

LING CHEN
What am I now?

The room shifts. Sterile walls become a white, ethereal space.

LING CHEN
Who are you?

title: Ghost Gate Thirteen Needles
description: A young man practices an ancient acupuncture technique to avenge his master, while navigating unexpected encounters in his village.
context:
Title: Ghost Gate Thirteen Needles
Description: A young man practices an ancient acupuncture technique to avenge his master, while navigating unexpected encounters in his village.

EXT. ANCESTRAL HALL - NIGHT

Incense smoke curls around gilt deity statues, their painted eyes cold and watchful.

XIAO LIN (20s, black silk tunic) lights three incense sticks. He bows devoutly before the ancestral shrine, then inserts them into the bronze burner.

XIAO LIN
Fifth Uncle.

FLASHBACK: MASTER (70s, white hair) chops wood behind the hall—his movements measured, deliberate.

A dead carp SLAPS onto a red lacquered cutting board.

XIAO LIN unrolls a black silk bundle. Thirteen silver needles gleam in perfect rows.

XIAO LIN (V.O.)
Ghost Gate Thirteen Needles. Ascending to the Jade Pool, descending to the Netherworld Spring. Strike!

XIAO LIN holds a needle aloft—it glows with spectral silver light. He drives it into the carp's flesh.

The dead fish convulses, then swims—slowly, impossibly—in the pool of its own blood.

XIAO LIN
(delighted)
Twelve. The twelfth needle lives.

XIAO LIN carries a plate of braised fish and places it before the shrine.

XIAO LIN
Master. I made this myself.

XIAO LIN holds three incense sticks and pays respects again.

XIAO LIN
Master above, your disciple Xiao Lin has mastered twelve of the Ghost Gate Thirteen Needles. The Ghost Gate Sect will rise again.

XIAO LIN bows and inserts the incense into the burner. Two sticks stand upright. One lies horizontally across the top.

XIAO LIN
(whisper)
I will avenge you.
continuation:
EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

Master chops wood in the courtyard—his last morning.

XIAO LIN, now in a light-colored floral tunic, stands in the yard.

SISTER ZHOU (20s, white fox-fur coat) rushes into the courtyard, clutching her collar.

SISTER ZHOU
(urgent)
Xiao Lin! Come—your sister's taken ill.

XIAO LIN
Sister Zhou, what symptoms?

Master stops his work, his knuckles white on the axe.

SISTER ZHOU
Let's talk inside.

She takes XIAO LIN's hand and walks him toward a dilapidated room.

XIAO LIN
Sister Zhou...

Master watches their departing figures, his face carved from stone.

INT. DILAPIDATED COTTAGE - DAY

SISTER ZHOU pulls XIAO LIN inside, bolts the shabby wooden door.

She turns, her smile thin as a blade.

XIAO LIN
Sister Zhou...

SISTER ZHOU slips off her white fur coat. Her shoulders are bare, her eyes empty of warmth.

SISTER ZHOU
(soft)
Your needles raise the dead, little doctor. Can they mend a widow's grief?

She steps closer. The air smells of rain and something metallic.

SISTER ZHOU
Some illnesses need... human touch. Not medicine.

Her fingers brush his wrist, where his pulse hammers against dead men's needles.

title: Reborn: Phoenix Rising from the Ashes
description: A college student is betrayed by her father and assaulted by a wealthy young man. Her boyfriend seeks justice as she struggles with trauma.
context:
Title: Reborn: Phoenix Rising from the Ashes
Description: A college student is betrayed by her father and assaulted by a wealthy young man. Her boyfriend seeks justice as she struggles with trauma.

INT. LUXURY BEDROOM - NIGHT

Through the downpour outside floor-to-ceiling windows, CHEN XINGRUO stumbles barefoot across marble tiles, a cheap restaurant apron still tied around her waist. The door is locked. Behind her, YOUNG MASTER WANG's shadow stretches across the wall.

CHEN XINGRUO
(whispered)
Please let me go.

He catches her at the doorway. She fights back with the instinctive force of someone who's worked double shifts - a sharp elbow to his ribs, a kick that lands solidly. It only enrages him.

YOUNG MASTER WANG
(cold fury)
Your father showed me your university ID. The scholarship student who thinks she's better than this. Better than me.

He slams her back against the bed. Her student ID card falls from his pocket - her freshman photo, hopeful, lands face-up on the carpet.

YOUNG MASTER WANG
But you're just a waitress. Fifty yuan for a twelve-hour shift. And you cost me fifty thousand. Waitresses get what they deserve.

He laughs - a sound like glass breaking.

CHEN XINGRUO
(crying out)
Please let me go!
continuation:
EXT. RAINY NIGHT STREET - NIGHT

CHEN XINGRUO walks through the downpour, her restaurant uniform drenched and clinging. She moves like a sleepwalker, arms wrapped around herself. Headlights sweep past, drivers oblivious.

A figure sprints into frame - BOYFRIEND, her phone clutched in his hand, location tracking still open. His own clothes are plastered to his body; he's been searching for hours.

BOYFRIEND
Xingruo - stop!

He catches up, drapes his jacket over her shoulders. She flinches at the touch, then recognizes him. Her knees buckle.

BOYFRIEND
I got your location text. The panic button. I've got you.

CHEN XINGRUO collapses into his arms, her cry barely human - more animal howl than tears.

title: Reborn: Master Qi's Pampered Wife Acts Coquettish Again
description: On her wedding day, Shen Yunqiao discovers her groom and cousin's betrayal, learning the marriage was a scheme to steal her family fortune.
context:
Title: Reborn: Master Qi's Pampered Wife Acts Coquettish Again
Description: On her wedding day, Shen Yunqiao discovers her groom and cousin's betrayal, learning the marriage was a scheme to steal her family fortune.

INT. WEDDING CHAMBER - DAY

SHEN YUNQIAO (daughter of the Shen Group) enters the wedding chamber, her white dress catching the light as she clutches her bouquet with trembling anticipation.

SHEN YUNQIAO
Brother Yanchen, we're finally getting marr—

SHEN YUNQIAO's voice breaks. In the mirror, MU YANCHEN is adjusting SHEN WAN'ER's diamond necklace—the one from Yunqiao's mother.

That woman is her cousin, SHEN WAN'ER.

SHEN YUNQIAO
(voice cracking)
Wan'er... that's my mother's necklace.

SHEN YUNQIAO reaches for the necklace. MU YANCHEN blocks her, the force sending her backward. Her veil catches and tears.

MU YANCHEN gets up from the bed, coldly straightening his clothes.

SHEN YUNQIAO
(tears streaming down, in disbelief)
Mu Yanchen, you hit me for her?

MU YANCHEN
(coldly)
Shen Yunqiao.

SHEN WAN'ER touches the necklace, her eyes on Yunqiao. She wraps her arm through MU YANCHEN's.
continuation:
MU YANCHEN
The only one I ever loved is Wan'er. You were a means to an end.

SHEN WAN'ER
The shares transfer was triggered by the marriage license, not the ceremony. It's already done.

SHEN YUNQIAO
(heartbroken)
Ten years... You were only with me for my family fortune?

MU YANCHEN
(not meeting her eyes)
You should have read what you signed.

SHEN WAN'ER
Your parents are facing their creditors now. The villa was collateral.

SHEN YUNQIAO
(desperately shaking her head)
That's impossible! Impossible!

SHEN WAN'ER picks up a remote control and turns on the TV on the wall.

On the TV news screen, chaos unfolds at the entrance of the Shen family villa as SHEN YUNQIAO's parents are pushed and shoved out by a group of people.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
The Shen Group has declared bankruptcy due to inability to repay debts. The Shen family villa has been sealed, and the whereabouts of the Shen couple are unknown.

SHEN YUNQIAO watches the images on TV, collapsing to the floor, her face ashen, her eyes hollow.

SHEN WAN'ER picks up a heavy crystal ashtray. Her knuckles whiten. One swing and the inheritance is finally, truly hers.

title: Daddy Don't Be Afraid, I'm Here
description: A young girl travels back in time to save her father from a dark fate by preventing him from becoming an underworld emperor.
context:
Title: Daddy Don't Be Afraid, I'm Here
Description: A young girl travels back in time to save her father from a dark fate by preventing him from becoming an underworld emperor.

INT. LUXURIOUS BEDROOM - NIGHT

A stormy night. Thunder and lightning flash outside the window.

A man lies on the bed, his body and the bedside covered with yellow talismans. He is unconscious.

Little girl ZHUZHU sits on the carpet, her hands forming seals, golden light radiating from her body, talismans dancing around her.

A MASTER in Taoist robes rushes in and casts a spell to interrupt ZHUZHU's magic.

ZHUZHU is struck by the backlash of the spell and falls to the ground.

MASTER helps ZHUZHU up.

MASTER
Zhuzhu, your eyes are bleeding. You're burning through your soul.

ZHUZHU
(tearfully)
But Daddy's going away, Master. I can feel him going.

MASTER
You rush his ending, you join him. But there is another way... one that takes you from this time entirely.

ZHUZHU
Anything.

MASTER
Ten years ago, Shen Yan made a choice that damned him. Find him before he builds his empire. Before the blood. Before he becomes the man on that bed. You must make him choose differently. But Zhuzhu... he won't know you. And you cannot tell him why.

ZHUZHU
(shows no hesitation)
I'll make him good again.

MASTER
Good child. Then hold on tight.

MASTER casts a spell, sending a golden light into ZHUZHU's body.

MASTER (V.O.)
Zhuzhu! Time is a river that drowns children!

ZHUZHU is pulled into a space-time tunnel.
continuation:
EXT. MODERN CITY STREET - DAY

ZHUZHU appears on a bustling modern street. She is wearing ancient costume, looking bewildered at the surrounding skyscrapers and traffic.

ZHUZHU
(to herself)
The air smells... clean.

MALE PASSERBY
Kid's standing on that trash can like it's a temple.

FEMALE PASSERBY
Someone should call—oh! She fell!

ZHUZHU stands on a trash can and accidentally falls down.

The copper coin necklace around her neck emits golden light.

MASTER (V.O.)
Zhuzhu? Your lifeline flickers.

ZHUZHU
(picking up the necklace, whispering)
Master, the ground is hard here.

MASTER (V.O.)
Southeast Street factory. Your father's blood hasn't turned cold yet. Hurry.

ZHUZHU
(firmly)
I'm coming, Daddy.

MASTER (V.O.)
And Zhuzhu... the man he is now would kill even you.

ZHUZHU
(inspects her scraped knee)
Then I'll just have to be too quick to catch.

She clutches the necklace and sprints forward, her small form weaving through the crowd.

INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY

Young SHEN YAN sits in a chair, surrounded by his subordinates. Several beaten men lie on the ground.

A man with a bruised and swollen face (HUMAN TRAFFICKER) kneels on the ground begging for mercy.

HUMAN TRAFFICKER
Boss Shen, the Green Gang's rules—I forgot! The children, I didn't know they were tagged for your docks! I won't touch them again, I swear on my mother's grave!

SHEN YAN
(coldly)
Your mother died last year. I sent the flowers.

SHEN YAN raises his gun and shoots the HUMAN TRAFFICKER dead.

Another beaten man trembles in fear.

MAN
Shen Yan! You're completely inhuman! At this point, aren't you afraid of having no descendants and getting your retribution?

XIA MING
(chuckles dryly)
Should've cut his tongue first. At least he died believing in karma.

SHEN YAN
(dismissively)
Superstition is for the weak.

XIA MING
Yeah? Well, the weak keep having kids. Imagine that.

SHEN YAN
No descendants? I'll take that as his blessing to me.

EXT. FACTORY EXTERIOR - DAY

ZHUZHU runs into the open area outside the factory, breathless.

ZHUZHU
(to the necklace)
Master, I can smell the gunpowder. I'm almost—

She sees SHEN YAN and XIA MING walking out of the factory, SHEN YAN wiping blood from his knuckles.

ZHUZHU
(whispers)
Daddy.

SHEN YAN
Burn the bodies in the east furnace. Not the west—the east burns hotter.

ZHUZHU runs forward and hugs SHEN YAN's leg, her small arms tight as vices.

ZHUZHU
(looking up, smiling innocently)
I found you! I found you, Daddy!

SHEN YAN and XIA MING freeze. SHEN YAN looks down at the child clinging to him, his face unreadable. XIA MING's hand moves instinctively toward his gun.

SHEN YAN
(hard, quiet)
Who sent you?

ZHUZHU
(confused)
Nobody. You're my daddy.

She holds up the copper coin necklace. It glows faintly against her chest. SHEN YAN's eyes narrow at it, then at her.

title: Fill-in-the-Blank Screenplay Task
description: Based on the screenplay context, predict the dialogue content that should appear at the [MASK] position.
context:
Title: Fill-in-the-Blank Screenplay Task
Description: Based on the screenplay context, predict the dialogue content that should appear at the [MASK] position.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

Inside the courtroom, the atmosphere is solemn and serious. The PRESIDING JUDGE sits at the bench. Defendants ZHANG SHENGBIN and ZHAO SHURAN stand in the dock. Plaintiff SHEN NIAN and lawyer LIN YUE are in the gallery.

PRESIDING JUDGE
Defendants Zhang Shengbin and Zhao Shuran, through forging psychiatric records and a series of illegal acts, you have caused irreparable harm. Your crimes of custodial interference and fraud have destroyed a family. This court sentences you to death.

The PRESIDING JUDGE strikes the gavel. BAILIFFS step forward to escort ZHANG SHENGBIN and ZHAO SHURAN away.

ZHANG SHENGBIN
(struggling)
No! I was trying to fix things! Shen Nian, you don't know the truth!

ZHAO SHURAN
(being dragged)
You can't do this!

SHEN NIAN
(coldly)
Justice for my son.

ZHANG SHENGBIN becomes emotional and is forcibly taken away by bailiffs. He turns back to glare at SHEN NIAN and the lawyer.

ZHANG SHENGBIN
(roaring)
Lawyer! I paid you! Why?

ZHAO SHURAN
(crying out)
Presiding Judge! The records were real!
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

SHEN NIAN sits at her desk, gently caressing a photo frame containing a picture of her and her son.

SHEN NIAN (V.O.)
They hid you from me for years, Haoyu. But I never stopped searching. Now nothing can keep us apart.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

A luxury sedan drives along the road. SHEN NIAN sits in the back seat, LIN YUE is driving. The car radio is broadcasting news.

RADIO (V.O.)
Tianbao Group's new General Manager Shen Nian made headlines today. The business community expects her first priority will be securing custody of her son.

LIN YUE
The final custody hearing is tomorrow. You'll have him back soon.

SHEN NIAN
Five years. Tomorrow it ends.

SHEN NIAN takes out the photo frame and looks at it affectionately.

SHEN NIAN (V.O.)
When your father took you, I had nothing. Now I have everything. And I'm bringing you home.

EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

A funeral procession appears ahead of the car, with suona horns playing, blocking the road.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

SHEN NIAN
What's happening up ahead?

LIN YUE
A funeral. For a child.

A GIRL walks past carrying a memorial portrait. The boy in the portrait looks very similar to SHEN NIAN's son.

LIN YUE
(seeing the name on the portrait clearly)
The name on the wreath... Zhang Haoyu.

SHEN NIAN hears the name, her expression changes drastically.

LIN YUE
(turning back, shocked)
Shen Nian, that's your son.

SHEN NIAN
(shaken)
No. That's impossible. He's... he's waiting for me.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: School Bullying Incident
description: A terrified student named Xiao Yan is hunted through her school at night by bullies led by Gu Wei, while desperately trying to reach her cold, career-focused mother who ignores her calls during an important business meeting.
context:
Title: School Bullying Incident
Description: A terrified student named Xiao Yan is hunted through her school at night by bullies led by Gu Wei, while desperately trying to reach her cold, career-focused mother who ignores her calls during an important business meeting.

INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - NIGHT

In the dimly lit school hallway, XIAO YAN runs forward in panic, her face filled with terror.

Upstairs, GU WEI leads a group of GIRLS chasing after her. They shine flashlights everywhere.

XIAO YAN runs to a door and desperately pulls the handle, but the door is locked. She looks back in despair and continues running down the hallway.

She hides in a sports equipment room filled with clutter, curling up under a metal rack.

INT. SPORTS EQUIPMENT ROOM - NIGHT

XIAO YAN hides under the metal rack, takes out her phone, and dials with trembling hands. The battery icon flashes red: 3%.

XIAO YAN
(whispering, pleading)
Mom, answer the phone, answer the phone, please answer!

INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - NIGHT

GU WEI and her companions search through the hallway.

GU WEI
(angry)
Damn it! That bitch Xiao Yan got away!

COMPANION
Don't worry, she can't escape.

GU WEI
(vicious)
She dared to report me. I'll make her regret being born into this world.
continuation:
INT. HONGYAN GROUP CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT

MS. FANG, a powerful female CEO with a commanding presence, is sternly addressing her subordinates in a meeting.

MS. FANG
I need all of you at full attention. If your work mistakes affect our company's project progress tomorrow, none of you will keep your jobs!

SUBORDINATES
Yes, yes.

MS. FANG's phone rings on the table. The caller ID shows "Yanyan." She glances at it and immediately declines the call.

MONTAGE

A) INT. SPORTS EQUIPMENT ROOM - NIGHT
XIAO YAN hides in the darkness, hearing the message "Your call has been declined" from her phone. She's on the verge of tears.

XIAO YAN
(crying)
Mom, please answer the phone...

B) INT. HONGYAN GROUP CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT
In the conference room, MS. FANG's phone rings again. She silences it with a swipe, her jaw tightening.

C) INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - NIGHT
The footsteps of the bullies and the beams of their flashlights draw closer to the equipment room door.

INT. HONGYAN GROUP CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT

The phone rings for the third time. MS. FANG stares at it.

MALE SUBORDINATE
Ms. Fang, perhaps your daughter needs—

MS. FANG
(coldly, cutting him off)
What she needs is to learn self-reliance. Saint project is what matters now.

She switches her phone to silent mode and places it in her handbag.

INT. SPORTS EQUIPMENT ROOM - NIGHT

GU WEI and her companions enter the equipment room, shining their flashlights around.

They discover XIAO YAN hiding under the metal rack.

GU WEI crouches down, shining her flashlight directly into XIAO YAN's face, a triumphant smile spreading across her face.

GU WEI
Baby, found you.

XIAO YAN covers her mouth in terror, her eyes filled with fear. Her phone screen shows "Missed Calls (3)" then goes black: 0% battery.

GU WEI lifts the dead phone from XIAO YAN's trembling hands, glances at the screen, and drops it.

GU WEI
(softly)
No one is coming for you.

BLACKOUT.

SOUND: A phone vibrating silently inside a closed handbag.
