Description: A terrified student named Xiao Yan is hunted through her school at night by bullies led by Gu Wei, while desperately trying to reach her cold, career-focused mother who ignores her calls during an important business meeting.

INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - NIGHT

In the dimly lit school hallway, XIAO YAN runs forward in panic, her face filled with terror.

Upstairs, GU WEI leads a group of GIRLS chasing after her. They shine flashlights everywhere.

XIAO YAN runs to a door and desperately pulls the handle, but the door is locked. She looks back in despair and continues running down the hallway.

She hides in a sports equipment room filled with clutter, curling up under a metal rack.

INT. SPORTS EQUIPMENT ROOM - NIGHT

XIAO YAN hides under the metal rack, takes out her phone, and dials with trembling hands. The battery icon flashes red: 3%.

XIAO YAN
(whispering, pleading)
Mom, answer the phone, answer the phone, please answer!

INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - NIGHT

GU WEI and her companions search through the hallway.

GU WEI
(angry)
Damn it! That bitch Xiao Yan got away!

COMPANION
Don't worry, she can't escape.

GU WEI
(vicious)
She dared to report me. I'll make her regret being born into this world.

INT. HONGYAN GROUP CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT

MS. FANG, a powerful female CEO with a commanding presence, is sternly addressing her subordinates in a meeting.

MS. FANG
I need all of you at full attention. If your work mistakes affect our company's project progress tomorrow, none of you will keep your jobs!

SUBORDINATES
Yes, yes.

MS. FANG's phone rings on the table. The caller ID shows "Yanyan." She glances at it and immediately declines the call.

MONTAGE

A) INT. SPORTS EQUIPMENT ROOM - NIGHT
XIAO YAN hides in the darkness, hearing the message "Your call has been declined" from her phone. She's on the verge of tears.

XIAO YAN
(crying)
Mom, please answer the phone...

B) INT. HONGYAN GROUP CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT
In the conference room, MS. FANG's phone rings again. She silences it with a swipe, her jaw tightening.

C) INT. SCHOOL HALLWAY - NIGHT
The footsteps of the bullies and the beams of their flashlights draw closer to the equipment room door.

INT. HONGYAN GROUP CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT

The phone rings for the third time. MS. FANG stares at it.

MALE SUBORDINATE
Ms. Fang, perhaps your daughter needs—

MS. FANG
(coldly, cutting him off)
What she needs is to learn self-reliance. Saint project is what matters now.

She switches her phone to silent mode and places it in her handbag.

INT. SPORTS EQUIPMENT ROOM - NIGHT

GU WEI and her companions enter the equipment room, shining their flashlights around.

They discover XIAO YAN hiding under the metal rack.

GU WEI crouches down, shining her flashlight directly into XIAO YAN's face, a triumphant smile spreading across her face.

GU WEI
Baby, found you.

XIAO YAN covers her mouth in terror, her eyes filled with fear. Her phone screen shows "Missed Calls (3)" then goes black: 0% battery.

GU WEI lifts the dead phone from XIAO YAN's trembling hands, glances at the screen, and drops it.

GU WEI
(softly)
No one is coming for you.

BLACKOUT.

SOUND: A phone vibrating silently inside a closed handbag.

title: New Year's Eve
description: A desperate worker confronts his corrupt boss on a rooftop after being denied wages needed for his dying mother's surgery.
context:
Title: New Year's Eve
Description: A desperate worker confronts his corrupt boss on a rooftop after being denied wages needed for his dying mother's surgery.

INT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

Brilliant fireworks bloom in the night sky, snowflakes falling.

ZHANG WEI, face bruised, clutches his mother's black-and-white portrait, standing at the edge of the rooftop.

A group of COWORKERS watch him anxiously from a distance.

ZHANG WEI
(roaring)
Wang Kun! Get Wang Kun up here!

A COWORKER takes a careful step forward, holding a thermos.

COWORKER
Brother Zhang... it's New Year's. We brought dumplings. Still warm.

ZHANG WEI
Stay back! I'll jump!

COWORKER
He's coming! Just hold on!

Boss WANG KUN arrives with foreman MA KAI and LI JUAN.

WANG KUN
(contemptuously)
Zhang Wei. Come down. We can negotiate.

ZHANG WEI
(pointing at Wang Kun)
Kowtow to my mother! Confess what you did!

WANG KUN
(laughing)
Confess? Your mother died of illness. Tragic, but not my concern.

ZHANG WEI
(voice breaking with tears)
You withheld my wages! Her surgery was tomorrow! You knew!

MA KAI
(stepping forward)
Spoilage penalties. It's in the handbook you signed. Legal and documented.

ZHANG WEI
(furious)
Legal? You changed the rules!

LI JUAN
(quietly)
Zhang Wei... please. Don't make this worse. For both of us.

ZHANG WEI
(turning to Li Juan, sudden realization)
You. You're wearing his watch.

LI JUAN
(defensive)
I made a choice! Someone had to be realistic!

WANG KUN
(to Zhang Wei)
You're a contractor, not family. We have procedures. Your mother—unfortunate timing.

ZHANG WEI
(despairingly)
Timing...

He looks at the portrait, then at the fireworks.

WANG KUN
I can offer 10,000. For funeral expenses. Sign the release, it's yours.

ZHANG WEI
Ten thousand. For her life.

WANG KUN
Business is business. Sign, or get nothing.

ZHANG WEI becomes agitated, his foot slips on the icy edge, and he falls from the rooftop. He crashes heavily into the snow below, blood flowing from his mouth and nose, the portrait frame shattered.

WANG KUN runs to the edge of the rooftop, looks down, then turns to face the crowd.

WANG KUN
(calmly)
You all saw. He lost his footing. Tragic accident.
(to Ma Kai)
Call Chief Liu. Get the settlement papers ready.

WANG KUN starts toward the stairs.

WANG KUN
(to Li Juan)
Come on. There's a banquet waiting.

He leaves. The fireworks continue, reflected in Li Juan's tears.

TRANSITION: Several hours earlier
continuation:
INT. FACTORY WORKSHOP - DAY

Red lanterns hang in the workshop, full of New Year atmosphere. ZHANG WEI, wearing work clothes, is on the phone.

ZHANG WEI
(into phone, gently)
Mom, doctor says deposit's due Monday. I'm getting 60,000 today. Yes, I'll be there tomorrow.

ZHANG WEI hangs up, a smile on his face. He opens a small red notebook—meticulous medical expense tallies.

Two COWORKERS chat nearby.

COWORKER A
Seven days straight. Glad this Gu Corp order's done.

COWORKER B
Boss made a fortune. Hope our bonuses reflect it.

LI JUAN walks over to ZHANG WEI, looking at his red notebook.

LI JUAN
You're really getting 60,000? Buy me that phone, like you promised?

ZHANG WEI
(awkwardly)
After Mom's surgery. She's first.

LI JUAN
(coldly)
Always your mom. What about us?

ZHANG WEI
Don't be like that.

LI JUAN
(shaking off his hand)
You don't get it.

MA KAI and WANG KUN come down from upstairs.

MA KAI
Payday! When your name is called, take your envelope. Wang Qiang! Ma Jun! Li Jun! Zhou Wei! Zhang Wei!

MA KAI throws ZHANG WEI's envelope on the ground. ZHANG WEI bends down to pick it up, looks inside, his expression changes drastically.

ZHANG WEI
(confused)
Twelve thousand? My bonus alone is sixty!

Other COWORKERS open their envelopes.

COWORKERS
(murmuring)
This is half! What's this deduction? "Equipment fees"? "Management costs"?

ZHANG WEI holds his envelope, looking up at WANG KUN in shock.

ZHANG WEI
Boss, this is wrong.

WANG KUN
(leaning on the railing)
Section 8.4. Spoilage penalties. You all signed the updated handbook.

ZHANG WEI
I never—

LI JUAN
(quietly, beside him)
Just sign it, Zhang Wei. It's how things are done.

ZHANG WEI looks at her, then at Wang Kun, then at the red notebook in his hand.

He walks toward the stairs.

WANG KUN
(calling after)
Where are you going?

ZHANG WEI
(quietly)
To see my mother.

He exits. Wang Kun watches him go.

WANG KUN
(to Li Juan)
He'll be back. They need the money.

Li Juan nods, but her fingers tremble as she touches the gold watch on her wrist.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Four Treasures Strike: Mommy Prepares to Attack
description: A hacker child discovers his father is about to marry the woman who wronged his mother six years ago, and rallies his siblings to intervene.
context:
Title: Four Treasures Strike: Mommy Prepares to Attack
Description: A hacker child discovers his father is about to marry the woman who wronged his mother six years ago, and rallies his siblings to intervene.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

CONGCONG (10, Second Treasure), leather jacket swallowing his frame, types furiously. Sunglasses perch on his head. A lollipop sticks from his mouth.

Monitors glow: news footage shows LING FAMILY HEIR beside TANG QIANQIAN. Headline scrolls: "LING-TANG WEDDING: 7 DAYS."

CONGCONG (V.O.)
Dad's getting married. To the woman who buried Mom six years ago.

A young ASSISTANT enters, holding a burner phone.

ASSISTANT
Boss, DNA match confirmed. Ling Xiang is your father.

CONGCONG takes the phone, studies it. Jaw tightens.

CONGCONG
(into encrypted mic)
Big Brother, Third Brother. Target acquired. Operation Family Extraction is go.

EXT. MOUNTAIN FOREST - DAY

DAXI (11, First Treasure), meditation robes faded, sits on granite. Stillness personified.

His smartwatch vibrates. Encrypted message: "Wedding in 7 days. Tang Qianqian."

DAXI
(soft, certain)
The mountain taught me patience. Not for this.

He stands, bowing to the peaks.
continuation:
EXT. BAMBOO FOREST COTTAGE - DAY

TIANTIAN (9, Third Treasure), lab coat dragging, measures tincture drops. Round glasses magnify focused eyes.

An OLD MAN watches from a wheelchair, breathing eased.

OLD MAN
Little miracle worker. Leaving us?

TIANTIAN
(never looking up)
Family emergency. One drop at dawn, not two.

He checks his cracked tablet. Message: "Wedding. Tang Qianqian."

TIANTIAN
(whisper)
She doesn't get to finish what she started.

EXT. CITY ROAD - NIGHT

TANG YUE (28), helmet on, weaves through traffic. Precise, not reckless.

RADIO BROADCAST (V.O.)
...Ling Xiang and Tang Qianqian's Golden Moon Hotel wedding. A corporate takeover in bridal white...

She stops at a red light. Removes helmet. Face etched with exhaustion.

TANG YUE (V.O.)
Six years dead. Time to RSVP.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT (SIX YEARS AGO)

TITLE: SIX YEARS AGO

TANG YUE (22), tentative, holds a wine glass. TANG QIANQIAN (24) pours, smile sharp as broken glass.

TANG QIANQIAN
One toast, Sister. For your birthday.

She taps the rim. Powder dissolves.

TANG QIANQIAN
(over her shoulder)
The entertainment's here.

THREE MASKED MEN enter. Corporate event masks—owl, fox, stag.

TANG YUE
(stiffening)
Qianqian, what is this?

TANG QIANQIAN
(leaning close)
Your inheritance. Drink.

The men cheer, pressing the glass to TANG YUE's lips. Not violent—insistent. Celebratory.

Her vision blurs. TANG QIANQIAN answers her phone, turning away.

TANG QIANQIAN
(into phone)
It's done. Shares transfer at midnight.

She looks back once. Not triumphant—relieved. As if closing a door.

TANG YUE collapses. The last sound: champagne cork pop. Celebration.

TITLE: TO BE CONTINUED

title: I'll Take the Boss for Revenge
description: Ni Zhixia confronts her grandmother and aunt about her rightful place in the family company after her father's death.
context:
Title: I'll Take the Boss for Revenge
Description: Ni Zhixia confronts her grandmother and aunt about her rightful place in the family company after her father's death.

INT. VILLA COURTYARD - DAY

ON SCREEN: THREE MONTHS LATER

NI ZHIXIA clutches an acceptance letter, her expression controlled steel.

GRANDMA NI snatches it, tearing it cleanly in half.

GRANDMA NI
You think you'll run from your father's mess?

NI ZHIXIA retrieves the pieces, folding them into her pocket.

NI ZHIXIA
This scholarship took two years. Father arranged it—

GRANDMA NI
(pointing at Ni Zhixia)
While your second uncle holds the company together?

NI YUE hurries over, steadying Grandma Ni.

NI YUE
(supporting Grandma Ni)
He secured you a department position. That's security.

NI ZHIXIA
I want to build my own security at Ni Group. Dad's will—

NI YUE
Wills can be interpreted, dear.

NI YUE
(steps forward and slaps Ni Zhixia)
continuation:
Stop being naive!

GRANDMA NI
You've embarrassed us enough. A woman's place is securing alliances, not spreadsheets.

NI ZHIXIA
(covering her reddening cheek)
Is that why you removed my name from the memorial plaque?

GRANDMA NI
You never earned it.

NI ZHIXIA
I cleaned your floors while reading every file in Dad's office. I know the gaps in your quarterly reports.

NI YUE
You're delusional—

NI ZHIXIA
Am I? Or do you just need me married before I find the offshore accounts?

GRANDMA NI
Go. Find out how far that scholarship takes you without our name.

NI ZHIXIA
You never accepted me. Since Dad died, I've been redundant anyway.

GRANDMA NI
Then leave. However you came, go the same way.

NI ZHIXIA meets their eyes, tears held back by pure will. She turns and walks out, each step deliberate.

EXT. FOREST PATH - DAY

NI ZHIXIA stops where the trees clear, looking back.

NI ZHIXIA (V.O.)
Ni family, I will return. And I'll take what's mine.

title: Reborn: All In (Episode 84)
description: A ruthless tycoon who lost his wife and daughter gets a second chance when he's murdered and wakes up twenty years in the past.
context:
Title: Reborn: All In (Episode 84)
Description: A ruthless tycoon who lost his wife and daughter gets a second chance when he's murdered and wakes up twenty years in the past.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

CHEN RAN lies rigid in silk sheets, sweat staining his collar, fingers twitching.

FLASHBACK:

CHEN RAN (V.O.)
Wanqing... Yaoyao...

Twenty years ago in the family home, WANQING backs against the wall, clutching her purse. Little YAOYAO hides behind her leg.

WANQING
Chen Ran, this is for Yaoyao's school fees. You promised—

YOUNG CHEN RAN slumps on the sofa, surrounded by empty bottles. He reeks of cheap liquor.

YOUNG CHEN RAN
(slurring)
Promised? I promised a lot of things. Hand it over.

WANQING
Please. The hospital said I shouldn't donate again so soon—

He lunges, snatching the purse. Wanqing stumbles. Yaoyao's eyes fill with tears.

YAOYAO
(whispering)
Daddy, I'm hungry...

YOUNG CHEN RAN
(counting cash)
You got more than last time. Good.

He pockets the money, grabs a bottle, stumbles out. SLAM.

YAOYAO (V.O.)
I wish you weren't my daddy.

Yaoyao runs to her room, slamming the door.

CHEN RAN (muttering in sleep)
You're not my father...

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - MORNING

FEMALE ASSISTANT enters, approaches the bed.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
President Chen. President Chen.

CHEN RAN wakes with a start, instinctively grabbing her wrist. For a heartbeat, his grip tightens—then releases.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Today's schedule is arranged.

CHEN RAN sits up, straightening his clothes.

CHEN RAN
The Qingyao Charity press conference. Every media outlet in the province. I want saturation coverage.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Yes.

EXT. CHEN FAMILY OLD HOUSE - DAY

A Rolls-Royce stops in front. CHEN RAN gets out, carrying a small velvet box.

CHEN RAN (V.O.)
Wanqing, Yaoyao. Wait for me.

INT. CHEN FAMILY OLD HOUSE - DAY

CHEN RAN enters, picks up a photo from the table: Wanqing and Yaoyao at a beach.

FLASHBACK:

WANQING (V.O.)
You said you'd take care of me for a lifetime. That's a long contract, Chen Ran.

YAOYAO (V.O.)
Daddy! This is for you!

END FLASHBACK.

Chen Ran strokes the photo, his hand trembling.

CHEN RAN
Twenty years. I've carried you both every day.

The FEMALE ASSISTANT and two BODYGUARDS follow him in.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
President Chen, the board is concerned. One hundred billion yuan in assets from Chen Corporation—are you really decided on donating it all to society?

CHEN RAN
(firmly)
It was never a question. The fund is my promise to them.

The FEMALE ASSISTANT's expression changes, revealing a vicious look.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Then go down and join them.

A BODYGUARD strikes CHEN RAN from behind with a baseball bat. CHEN RAN falls, blood splattering on the photo frame.

FEMALE ASSISTANT (V.O.)
President Chen became ill from missing his late wife. His hundred-billion-yuan fortune will be managed by me. That's what today's press conference is really about.

The FEMALE ASSISTANT holds a document, grabbing Chen Ran's hand and pressing a bloody thumb onto his seal ring.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Stamp it.

She stamps the document with his ring.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Kill him.

The BODYGUARD raises the baseball bat.

INT. PAST - FAMILY HOME - DAY

TV NEWS (V.O.)

CHEN RAN
Yaoyao... Wanqing... Am I dead? Or am I dreaming?

WANQING
(tentatively)
Chen Ran? You're home...

CHEN RAN
(voice breaking)
...I'm home.
full_script:
Title: Reborn: All In (Episode 84)
Description: A ruthless tycoon who lost his wife and daughter gets a second chance when he's murdered and wakes up twenty years in the past.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

CHEN RAN lies rigid in silk sheets, sweat staining his collar, fingers twitching.

FLASHBACK:

CHEN RAN (V.O.)
Wanqing... Yaoyao...

Twenty years ago in the family home, WANQING backs against the wall, clutching her purse. Little YAOYAO hides behind her leg.

WANQING
Chen Ran, this is for Yaoyao's school fees. You promised—

YOUNG CHEN RAN slumps on the sofa, surrounded by empty bottles. He reeks of cheap liquor.

YOUNG CHEN RAN
(slurring)
Promised? I promised a lot of things. Hand it over.

WANQING
Please. The hospital said I shouldn't donate again so soon—

He lunges, snatching the purse. Wanqing stumbles. Yaoyao's eyes fill with tears.

YAOYAO
(whispering)
Daddy, I'm hungry...

YOUNG CHEN RAN
(counting cash)
You got more than last time. Good.

He pockets the money, grabs a bottle, stumbles out. SLAM.

YAOYAO (V.O.)
I wish you weren't my daddy.

Yaoyao runs to her room, slamming the door.

CHEN RAN (muttering in sleep)
You're not my father...

END FLASHBACK.

INT. BEDROOM - MORNING

FEMALE ASSISTANT enters, approaches the bed.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
President Chen. President Chen.

CHEN RAN wakes with a start, instinctively grabbing her wrist. For a heartbeat, his grip tightens—then releases.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Today's schedule is arranged.

CHEN RAN sits up, straightening his clothes.

CHEN RAN
The Qingyao Charity press conference. Every media outlet in the province. I want saturation coverage.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Yes.

EXT. CHEN FAMILY OLD HOUSE - DAY

A Rolls-Royce stops in front. CHEN RAN gets out, carrying a small velvet box.

CHEN RAN (V.O.)
Wanqing, Yaoyao. Wait for me.

INT. CHEN FAMILY OLD HOUSE - DAY

CHEN RAN enters, picks up a photo from the table: Wanqing and Yaoyao at a beach.

FLASHBACK:

WANQING (V.O.)
You said you'd take care of me for a lifetime. That's a long contract, Chen Ran.

YAOYAO (V.O.)
Daddy! This is for you!

END FLASHBACK.

Chen Ran strokes the photo, his hand trembling.

CHEN RAN
Twenty years. I've carried you both every day.

The FEMALE ASSISTANT and two BODYGUARDS follow him in.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
President Chen, the board is concerned. One hundred billion yuan in assets from Chen Corporation—are you really decided on donating it all to society?

CHEN RAN
(firmly)
It was never a question. The fund is my promise to them.

The FEMALE ASSISTANT's expression changes, revealing a vicious look.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Then go down and join them.

A BODYGUARD strikes CHEN RAN from behind with a baseball bat. CHEN RAN falls, blood splattering on the photo frame.

FEMALE ASSISTANT (V.O.)
President Chen became ill from missing his late wife. His hundred-billion-yuan fortune will be managed by me. That's what today's press conference is really about.

The FEMALE ASSISTANT holds a document, grabbing Chen Ran's hand and pressing a bloody thumb onto his seal ring.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Stamp it.

She stamps the document with his ring.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Kill him.

The BODYGUARD raises the baseball bat.

INT. PAST - FAMILY HOME - DAY

CHEN RAN jolts awake on a ragged sofa. The TV blares. Bottles and betting slips surround him. A calendar on the wall: MAY 2002.

TV NEWS (V.O.)
—May 15, 2002. A ceremony commemorating the eightieth anniversary of the founding of the Communist Youth League was held at the Great Hall of the People.

CHEN RAN looks around in shock, seeing WANQING and YAOYAO standing in the doorway, looking at him fearfully.

Yaoyao... Wanqing... Am I dead? Or am I dreaming?

WANQING
(tentatively)
Chen Ran? You're home...

Yaoyao watches him, still afraid but trying to hide it.

Chen Ran stares at them, breath coming short. He looks at his hands—then their faces.

CHEN RAN
(voice breaking)
...I'm home.

title: My Dorm Manager Auntie
description: A young man dies saving a girl and discovers his late aunt, his dorm manager, was a deity who grants him a second chance with a mysterious power.
context:
Title: My Dorm Manager Auntie
Description: A young man dies saving a girl and discovers his late aunt, his dorm manager, was a deity who grants him a second chance with a mysterious power.

EXT. CROSSWALK - DAY

A TEENAGE GIRL in a gray camisole and denim shorts crosses.

A WHITE SEDAN speeds through the red light.

ZHANG XIAZHI (O.S.)
Watch out!

ZHANG XIAZHI lunges, shoving her clear. The car hits him. He crashes down, still.

The girl crawls to him, trembling.

GIRL
Sir? Please—don't—

ZHANG XIAZHI (weakly)
Auntie... will kill me... for this...

He dissolves into particles of light.
continuation:
INT. ETHEREAL SPACE - DAY

ZHANG XIAZHI stands where sky reflects on water.

ZHANG XIAZHI
Where...?

AUNTIE LIU (V.O.)
Right where I was, Xiao-Zhi.

ZHANG XIAZHI
Auntie Liu? But you're—

AUNTIE LIU (V.O., firm)
Dead. Like you. I protected my dorm for twenty years. Now you will.

ZHANG XIAZHI
I can't...

AUNTIE LIU (V.O.)
The power in your hands reveals need, not greed. Use it. Wake up.

ZHANG XIAZHI opens his palms—golden light flashes. He disappears.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

ZHANG XIAZHI awakens in a hospital bed, gasping.

ZHANG XIAZHI
Auntie...

He looks at his hands—glowing red-hot.

ZHANG XIAZHI
Her dorm...

The glow shifts to amber. He stares at the door, resolve hardening.

title: When Will the Moon Be Full & When Will the Moon Shine on My Return
description: A young man returns to the city, leaving behind his beloved in the countryside, but tragedy strikes before their reunion.
context:
Title: When Will the Moon Be Full & When Will the Moon Shine on My Return
Description: A young man returns to the city, leaving behind his beloved in the countryside, but tragedy strikes before their reunion.

INT. FAREWELL CEREMONY - DAY

Gongs and drums echo across the village square. A banner hangs: "Farewell to Educated Youth." Villagers swarm a registration table.

LI MINGGUANG (23), red flower pinned to his shirt, clutches a worn suitcase. He checks the crowd again, his smile tightening.

LI MINGGUANG (V.O.)
Qiuyue promised she'd come. She never breaks a promise.

He signs the departure ledger with trembling fingers, then brushes dust from his suitcase—faintly embroidered: "Q.M. Forever."

LI MINGGUANG (V.O.)
Unless she's found out.

EXT. LAKESIDE - MEMORY

Young Li Mingguang and LU QIUYUE (18) sit by the lake. She threads a reed through his fingers.

LU QIUYUE
Hold this. Tighter. Like you're holding onto me.

She ties the reed into a ring, then slips a small magnolia hairpin from her braid—tucks it into his palm.

LU QIUYUE
When you see this, you'll remember. I'll come to the city. We'll build a home with real windows.

Li Mingguang clutches the pin, their foreheads touching.

BACK TO:

INT. BUS - DAY

Li Mingguang sits alone, turning the magnolia hairpin over in his fingers. The seat beside him stays empty.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The bus rumbles forward. LU QIUYUE appears around the bend, sprinting, her braid coming loose. She waves a package.

LU QIUYUE
(calling out)
Mingguang! The puppy—your mother—
continuation:
INT. BUS - DAY

A PASSENGER points out the window.

PASSENGER
Isn't that your girl? Running like her feet are on fire.

Li Mingguang snaps his head around. He shoves the window open, hairpin clutched in his fist.

LI MINGGUANG
Qiuyue! Here—stop!

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The bus brakes. Qiuyue stumbles to the window, gasping, clutching a squirming black puppy.

LU QIUYUE
(trying to smile)
Your mother wanted you to have Dahuo. For the city. So you won't be alone.

LI MINGGUANG
(taking the puppy)
Qiuyue, listen. I've got work lined up at the steel factory. Three months. Then I'll send for you.

LU QIUYUE
I placed third in the province. On the exam. They'll announce it next week.

Li Mingguang's face lights up.

LI MINGGUANG
Third? Qiuyue, that's—

She presses the reed ring into his hand alongside the puppy.

LU QIUYUE
Keep your window open. I'll find you.

The bus lurches forward. Their hands stretch until only fingertips touch—then separate. Qiuyue stands in the dust, watching until the bus vanishes.

INT. BUS - NIGHT

Li Mingguang tucks the puppy under his coat. He threads the magnolia hairpin through the reed ring, holding it up to catch moonlight.

LI MINGGUANG (V.O.)
Third in the province. She'll get that scholarship. We'll find a place near the university.

Headlights sweep the road. Suddenly, a flock of geese scatters across the headlights. The DRIVER swerves hard.

Metal screams. The bus tilts.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAYBREAK

Morning mist. Villagers cluster around a radio bulletin. LU QIUYUE pushes through, pale.

RADIO ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
...Bus Seventeen bound for the city was found overturned in the ravine. Rescue efforts continue.

An ELDERLY VILLAGER shakes his head.

ELDERLY VILLAGER
They say no survivors. Not yet.

Qiuyue's knees buckle. She catches herself on a post, then turns and walks away—steadier with each step.

CROWED
Qiuyue? Someone go with her—

INT. LU QIUYUE'S HOME - DAY

Qiuyue sits motionless on the bed. Her MOTHER hovers while an OLD DOCTOR packs his kit.

OLD DOCTOR
(quietly, to the parents)
She's carrying. Early days, but the pulse doesn't lie. And the sickness—morning and night.

FATHER
(whispering, sharp)
Who's the father?

The doctor glances at Qiuyue's steady gaze.

OLD DOCTOR
She hasn't spoken. But she's decided something. I can see it in her spine.

Qiuyue touches her stomach, her face hardening into a mask of determination.

title: Ex-Wife's Allure: Mr. Fu's Endless Devotion
description: After a night of unexpected passion with her estranged husband, a woman discovers a conspiracy and faces the consequences of a marriage arranged three years ago.
context:
Title: Ex-Wife's Allure: Mr. Fu's Endless Devotion
Description: After a night of unexpected passion with her estranged husband, a woman discovers a conspiracy and faces the consequences of a marriage arranged three years ago.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHENG MIAN showers, water cascading down her skin.

The door BURSTS open. FU YANCHENG stands in the threshold.

SHENG MIAN gasps, clutching a towel.

SHENG MIAN
How did you get in?

FU YANCHENG's eyes are glacial as he advances.

FU YANCHENG
You invited yourself.

He corners her against the tile, their breath mingling.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Bodies entangled in blurred motion.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Morning light cuts across rumpled sheets. SHENG MIAN wakes first, wincing.

SHENG MIAN
(under her breath)
God...

She surveys the destruction: clothes scattered, pillows on the floor.

SHENG MIAN (V.O.)
What the hell happened?

She turns. Freezes. FU YANCHENG sleeps beside her.

SHENG MIAN (V.O.)
Him. Of all people.

She squeezes her eyes shut, fragments returning.

INT. BANQUET HALL - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHENG MIAN in a shimmering gown, backing into a champagne tower. Glass shatters.

Her stepmother, SU LAN, appears at her elbow.

SU LAN
Clumsy girl. Come, use my suite to freshen up.

SU LAN presses a key card into her palm, smiling.

SU LAN
Quickly now. Before anyone notices.

SU LAN watches her go, her smile sharpening.

SU LAN (V.O.)
Let's see if you still look so smug after tonight.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

SHENG MIAN's eyes snap open. She glares at the sleeping Fu Yancheng.

SHENG MIAN (V.O.)
Three years of silence, and this is how we reunite?

She throws off the covers, pain shooting through her.

SHENG MIAN (V.O.)
(quiet fury)
Perfect. Just perfect.

FU YANCHENG stirs. Sits up. His gaze sweeps over her with cool assessment.

FU YANCHENG
Well. You finally got what you wanted.

SHENG MIAN
Excuse me?

FU YANCHENG retrieves his wallet, pulls out a card. Drops it on the nightstand.

FU YANCHENG
Name your price.

SHENG MIAN stares at the card. Then at him. A brittle laugh escapes.

SHENG MIAN
Let me guess. That's either hush money... or a retainer?

FU YANCHENG rises, stepping into her space.

FU YANCHENG
What if I want the full service?

She holds his gaze, unmoving.

SHENG MIAN
Then you should ask for a refund.

She pushes past him, heading for the door.

FU YANCHENG
The money stays.

SHENG MIAN pauses, hand on the knob.

SHENG MIAN
Keep it. You need the practice.

She exits. The door closes softly. Fu Yancheng's jaw tightens.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

SHENG MIAN hurries out in a bathrobe, nearly colliding with--

QI SHEN, briefcase in hand, who does a double-take.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

QI SHEN enters to find Fu Yancheng pulling on his shirt, the untouched bank card on the bed.

QI SHEN
Sir? Was that--

FU YANCHENG
Don't.

QI SHEN clears his throat, professional mask restored.

QI SHEN
The divorce papers. Miss Sheng wasn't at her residence. Shall we courier them to Sheng Corporation?

FU YANCHENG
Get her on the phone first. Give her forty-eight hours.

QI SHEN
Understood.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

SHENG MIAN lingers near the door, her name catching her ear. She leans closer.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

QI SHEN notices the bloodstain on the sheets. Freezes.

FU YANCHENG follows his gaze. His expression shifts: surprise, then something darker.

QI SHEN
Mr. Fu... is that--

FU YANCHENG
(out of patience)
Get out.

Qi Shen retreats. Fu Yancheng stands alone, staring at the stain.

FU YANCHENG (V.O.)
Her first time. And I—

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: My Dad Commands Respect Across Nine Provinces
description: A seemingly ordinary middle-aged man running a street barbecue stand is revealed to be a legendary commander when his past comes calling.
context:
Title: My Dad Commands Respect Across Nine Provinces
Description: A seemingly ordinary middle-aged man running a street barbecue stand is revealed to be a legendary commander when his past comes calling.

INT. BARBECUE STAND - NIGHT

A street-side barbecue stand under the night sky, full of smoky atmosphere.

XIANG WEIHUA, a seemingly ordinary middle-aged man, skillfully flips meat skewers on the grill and sprinkles seasoning.

XIANG WEIHUA
(to customers)
Ready.

He plates the grilled skewers and serves them to a table of customers.

XIANG WEIHUA
(smiling)
Enjoy, everyone.

The customers take the skewers. XIANG WEIHUA turns around, his smile instantly disappearing, becoming serious and alert.

A young girl eating skewers suddenly looks up, expression surprised.

CUT TO: Fantasy/Memory Sequence

On a foggy road, a female general (ZHU QUE) wearing battle armor and wielding a Green Dragon Crescent Blade rides a tall horse, followed by two rows of men in black suits and fedoras, approaching with intimidating momentum.

XIANG WEIHUA (V.O.)
They found me.

The barbecue stand customers see this scene and scatter in fear.

PASSERBY (O.S.)
Run!

ZHU QUE rides to the barbecue stand and dismounts smoothly. The men in black quickly follow.

ZHU QUE walks to XIANG WEIHUA and kneels on one knee, saluting with a fist.

ZHU QUE
Greetings, Marquis of the Nation!

All the men in black kneel in unison.

MEN IN BLACK
Greetings, Marquis of the Nation!

XIANG WEIHUA looks at them, clearly displeased.

XIANG WEIHUA
You just cleared my dinner rush.

ZHU QUE
By order of the Sovereign—the western provinces rebel. The National Guard Army needs its Commander.

XIANG WEIHUA turns around, picks up raw skewers and places them on the grill, indifferent.

XIANG WEIHUA
The provinces have governors. My army days are ash. I've guarded the Nine Provinces long enough.

ZHU QUE
Forgive me, Marquis.

ZHU QUE suddenly rises, wielding her large blade and charging at XIANG WEIHUA.
continuation:
An intense fight begins. ZHU QUE and the men in black attack XIANG WEIHUA.

XIANG WEIHUA, bare-handed, moves with lethal precision, deflecting strikes and knocking down men in black. He flings a handful of chili powder in a blinding cloud.

Finally, XIANG WEIHUA catches ZHU QUE's descending blade between two fingers. His hand trembles for an instant—an old wound.

XIANG WEIHUA
(sharp gaze)

Move.

You cost me money, old man.

Run!

title: Longing Unlike Recognition
description: A childhood promise made in a hospital after a tragic accident reunites two souls fifteen years later through an arranged marriage, but only one remembers their bond.
context:
Title: Longing Unlike Recognition
Description: A childhood promise made in a hospital after a tragic accident reunites two souls fifteen years later through an arranged marriage, but only one remembers their bond.

EXT. TUNNEL - NIGHT

A white sedan speeds through the tunnel.

INT. SEDAN - NIGHT

DUOLE'S MOTHER drives anxiously, clutching little DUOLE (7) in the passenger seat.

DUOLE'S MOTHER
(whispering)
Just a little farther...

The speedometer needle climbs past 160 km/h.

DUOLE'S MOTHER
Watch out—

A large truck's headlights fill the windshield.

MONTAGE:

Hospital bed wheels rolling through corridors.
IV fluid dripping from a bottle.
Little DUOLE lies on a hospital bed, gauze covering her eyes.
Glass and metal fragments scattered across asphalt.

END MONTAGE.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Little DUOLE (9) lies in a hospital bed, eyes covered with gauze, fingers trembling.

LITTLE DUOLE
Mom... Dad... Why is it dark?

Little TIANBAO (9) sits in a wheelchair beside the bed.

LITTLE TIANBAO
Your eyes got hurt. Don't cry.

LITTLE DUOLE
Who are you?

LITTLE TIANBAO
Tianbao. From the next room.

LITTLE DUOLE
The doctors said my blood could make you better.

LITTLE TIANBAO
(smiling)
My mama told me you saved me. With your bone marrow.

LITTLE DUOLE
Will you stay until I can see again?

LITTLE TIANBAO
Every single day. I promise.

LITTLE DUOLE
Even when I'm scared?

LITTLE TIANBAO
Especially then.

LITTLE DUOLE reaches out. TIANBAO ties a red string from his wrist around her finger.

LITTLE TIANBAO
When we grow up, we'll find each other. No matter what.

Sunlight streams through the window onto their joined hands.

LITTLE DUOLE
(laughing)
I feel it! The light!

LITTLE TIANBAO
It's always there. Even when you can't see it.

Both children smile, hands clasped.
continuation:
EXT. CITY - DAY

ON SCREEN: FIFTEEN YEARS LATER

Aerial view of a modern metropolis.

EXT. LU FAMILY MANOR - DAY

A black luxury car stops at the manor entrance. Adult DUOLE (24, now LI JINYAN) steps out, holding a worn medical file.

DUOLE (LI JINYAN)
This is the Lu Family Manor?

BUTLER
Miss Li. The marriage contract is ready. Your grandfather's expenses will be covered as the old master promised.

DUOLE (LI JINYAN)
(quietly)
He doesn't remember, does he?

BUTLER
I'm not at liberty to discuss President Lu's personal affairs, miss.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Adult TIANBAO (24, now LU HUAIXING) sits behind his desk, rotating a red string bracelet around his wrist.

ASSISTANT LI
President Lu, Miss Li has arrived. The old residence is prepared.

LU HUAIXING
Mm.

ASSISTANT LI
Regarding the wife—

LU HUAIXING
(interrupting)
That woman only occupies the title. What kind of wife is she?

LU HUAIXING looks down at the bracelet, his eyes becoming tender.

LU HUAIXING
(softly)
Mrs. Lu can only be Duole.

The bracelet catches a shaft of light from the window.

title: The Security Guard Who Stole a Wedding
description: A wealthy heir disguised as a security guard witnesses his savior being humiliated at her own wedding, where the groom publicly rejects her for her sister.
context:
Title: The Security Guard Who Stole a Wedding
Description: A wealthy heir disguised as a security guard witnesses his savior being humiliated at her own wedding, where the groom publicly rejects her for her sister.

INT. CHURCH - DAY

The church is filled with guests. JIANG WANQING, wearing a wedding dress and veil, walks toward the altar with her back to the camera.

A man (YOUNG MASTER) in a black security uniform stands by the guest seating, talking on the phone.

BUTLER CHEN (V.O.)
Young Master, the board demands your return. Why must you stay by Miss Jiang's side as a security guard?

YOUNG MASTER
I finally found my savior. I protect what's mine. Handle the lawyers. We'll discuss inheritance when I'm ready.

YOUNG MASTER hangs up the phone.

JIANG WANQING walks to the altar, where the groom GU SHAO and the OFFICIANT are standing.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Gu, do you take Miss Jiang Wanqing to be your wife?

GU SHAO looks at JIANG WANQING with disdain.

GU SHAO
No. I'm here to break off the engagement.

The guests gasp in shock.

FEMALE GUEST
What? You're breaking off the engagement?

GU SHAO
The one I'm marrying is someone else. Please welcome my bride, Jiang Yueyue!

JIANG WANQING drops her bouquet.

JIANG YUEYUE, wearing a white dress and a crown, walks in from the church entrance smiling, and stands beside GU SHAO.

JIANG WANQING
(voice steady)
You're certain you want to marry my cousin at our wedding?

GU SHAO
continuation:
(smugly)
That's right. You wear that veil for a reason—burns, scars, a face that launched ships away. I'm not the Li family's sacrifice. No man here would marry you.

MALE GUEST 1
Heard the eldest Miss is hideous, burned by fire.

MALE GUEST 2
Right. Why else would she wear a veil?

JIANG YUEYUE
(holding GU SHAO's arm)
If it weren't for Grandpa's marriage contract, do you think Young Master Li would marry an ugly woman like you? Cousin, if I were you, I'd find a hole to crawl into. It's so embarrassing.

JIANG WANQING
Are you so sure I'm hideously ugly?

GU SHAO
Today I'll show you. Look around—which man here would be willing to marry you?

GU SHAO points to an elderly man.

GU SHAO
Sir, would you be willing to marry her?

ELDERLY MAN
Ah no, no, I wouldn't.

GU SHAO
(mockingly)
See? Guard by the door—five million cash. I bet he wouldn't either.

JIANG WANQING turns to look at YOUNG MASTER.

JIANG WANQING
If I give you five million, would you marry me?

YOUNG MASTER
(surprised)
Five million?

YOUNG MASTER lowers his head, then raises it with a serious expression that seems to see through her veil.

YOUNG MASTER
No.

title: The Foolish Prince
description: A war hero is reduced to a helpless fool in a wheelchair, living with his betrothed's family who mock and plot against him.
context:
Title: The Foolish Prince
Description: A war hero is reduced to a helpless fool in a wheelchair, living with his betrothed's family who mock and plot against him.

MONTAGE

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

Stirring orchestral music.

YOUNG MASTER LIN, in battle-scarred armor, rides his black warhorse through the city gates.

He leads his troops in a desperate battle, swords clashing, the combat brutal.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
For the empire!

YOUNG MASTER LIN swings his blade, cutting down enemies. An arrow grazes his temple.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
First warrior of the grasslands? Just a man!

He gallops toward the setting sun.

INT. LIN MANOR COURTYARD - DAY

Scene transition. Music becomes light, mocking.

YOUNG MASTER LIN sits in a crude wooden wheelchair, plain white robes. Expression vacant, but his knuckles whiten on the armrests.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
Giddyup, giddyup, horsey run fast!

WORTHY NEPHEW walks over, prying YOUNG MASTER LIN's fingers off.

WORTHY NEPHEW
Enough.

AUNT emerges with a plate of pastries.

AUNT
Worthy Nephew, come sit. Qiuxue will— Oh my!

She sees YOUNG MASTER LIN and nearly drops the pastries.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
Mother, I'm riding a big horse!

WORTHY NEPHEW
There's no horse.

AUNT
(to YOUNG MASTER LIN)
You fool, stop embarrassing us. Go inside, now!

YOUNG MASTER LIN lowers his head, wheels himself to the corner. His jaw tightens.

WORTHY NEPHEW
(to AUNT)
Aunt, this is the fool Old General Lin betrothed to Miss Lin.

AUNT
(angrily)
continuation:
Worthy Nephew, the old master must have been blind! Claiming he arranged an excellent match for Qiuxue. But as soon as he died, they sent us this—this good-for-nothing!

AUNT turns with a practiced smile.

AUNT
But Qiuxue keeps him here from pity. Nothing more.

WORTHY NEPHEW
Miss Lin's compassion is known. But marriage?

AUNT
Oh, absolutely not! We honor the old general's memory.

WORTHY NEPHEW
Then let me relieve her burden.

He walks to YOUNG MASTER LIN's wheelchair.

AUNT
Worthy Nephew?

WORTHY NEPHEW
(confidently)
A small kindness. Fresh air.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
(fearfully)
Big horse...

WORTHY NEPHEW
(leaning close, voice like silk)
Let's find you a real one, fool.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
(immediately excited)
Real horse? Charge, charge!

WORTHY NEPHEW pushes the wheelchair at a run.

EXT. BACK ALLEY OF LIN MANOR - DAY

WORTHY NEPHEW helps YOUNG MASTER LIN onto a brown horse. The stablehand looks away.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
(sitting on the horse, terrified)
Too high... let me down... scared...

WORTHY NEPHEW ignores him, slaps the horse's flank hard.

The horse bolts forward.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
Ahh!

He falls, crashing onto stone. Coughs blood, lies motionless.

WORTHY NEPHEW watches coldly, a satisfied smirk.

WORTHY NEPHEW
(softly)
Farewell.

The horse stops in the distance. In the shadows, YOUNG MASTER LIN's fingers curl into a fist.

title: I Am King
description: A man disguised as a migrant worker returns home, but his true identity as a legendary military commander is revealed at a train station security checkpoint.
context:
Title: I Am King
Description: A man disguised as a migrant worker returns home, but his true identity as a legendary military commander is revealed at a train station security checkpoint.

INT. TRAIN STATION HALL - DAY

A plainly dressed man who looks like a migrant worker (JUN HOU) walks through the spacious train station hall, carrying one large checkered woven bag on his back and another in his hand.

His phone rings.

JUN HOU answers the call, a tired but genuine smile appearing.

JUN HOU
Hello, Wei. I'm at the station. Job's done—saved enough. I'll be home tonight.

A fashionably dressed WOMAN with her son (XIAO BAO) brushes against Jun Hou's bag.

XIAO BAO
Mom!

WOMAN
(catching herself, voice sharp)
Watch where you're—

She sees Jun Hou's weathered clothes. Disdain flickers, mixed with something else.

WOMAN
(to her son, quieter)
Let's go, Xiao Bao.

They leave. Jun Hou watches them, hand pressing his chest briefly. He continues forward.

INT. TRAIN STATION SECURITY CHECKPOINT - DAY

JUN HOU arrives at the security checkpoint. A young SECURITY GUARD (GUARD A) stops him.

GUARD A
Sir, step through the scanner.

Jun Hou does. The machine emits an UNUSUAL ALARM. Guard A checks his monitor.

GUARD A
Sir, you're showing embedded metal fragments. Raise your arms.

GUARD A scans Jun Hou with a handheld detector. It SCREAMS. He tries again. Same result.

Another GUARD (GUARD B) walks over.

GUARD A
(to GUARD B)
Twenty-nine fragments. Not modern alloy.

GUARD B
(shocked)
Historic?

GUARD B
(into radio)
Supervisor to Gate 3. Artifact alert.

WARNING LIGHTS flash. Two SPECIAL OFFICERS approach.

SECURITY CAPTAIN
Sir, remove your shirt. Now.

JUN HOU
(quiet)
Will this get me home?

SECURITY CAPTAIN
Just do it.
continuation:
JUN HOU removes his shirt. His torso bears twenty-nine dark circular scars, each with a metallic fragment.

All the guards stare.

SECURITY CAPTAIN
(awed)
Twenty-nine... impossible.

FLASHBACK BEGINS

An ancient battlefield. Jun Hou, in armor, fights fiercely. Projectiles strike his chest. He keeps fighting, bloodied but unyielding as wound after wound accumulates.

FLASHBACK ENDS

Back at the station, bystanders gasp.

BYSTANDER
My God...

SPECIAL OFFICER
(softly, to Captain)
Jun Lin signature confirmed.

YUE JI (O.S.)
Let him go.

A woman in a black leather jacket (YUE JI) approaches with three women. She shows a badge.

YUE JI
(to Captain)
Historical Protection Bureau. This man is under our authority.

She turns to Jun Hou, composure cracking.

YUE JI
Commander. You missed your check-in.

JUN HOU
I wanted to come home quietly.

YUE JI
Your wife?

JUN HOU
She doesn't know.

YUE JI
(nods)

YUE JI walks up to JUN HOU, kneels on one knee, salutes with cupped fist.

YUE JI
General Yue Ji respectfully welcomes the return of Commander Jun Lin Hou.

The women kneel in unison.

ALL WOMEN
We respectfully welcome the return of Jun Lin Hou!

Jun Hou looks at the kneeling soldiers, then at the crowd.

JUN HOU
(quietly)

full_script:
Title: I Am King
Description: A man disguised as a migrant worker returns home, but his true identity as a legendary military commander is revealed at a train station security checkpoint.

INT. TRAIN STATION HALL - DAY

A plainly dressed man who looks like a migrant worker (JUN HOU) walks through the spacious train station hall, carrying one large checkered woven bag on his back and another in his hand.

His phone rings.

JUN HOU answers the call, a tired but genuine smile appearing.

JUN HOU
Hello, Wei. I'm at the station. Job's done—saved enough. I'll be home tonight.

A fashionably dressed WOMAN with her son (XIAO BAO) brushes against Jun Hou's bag.

XIAO BAO
Mom!

WOMAN
(catching herself, voice sharp)
Watch where you're—

She sees Jun Hou's weathered clothes. Disdain flickers, mixed with something else.

WOMAN
(to her son, quieter)
Let's go, Xiao Bao.

They leave. Jun Hou watches them, hand pressing his chest briefly. He continues forward.

INT. TRAIN STATION SECURITY CHECKPOINT - DAY

JUN HOU arrives at the security checkpoint. A young SECURITY GUARD (GUARD A) stops him.

GUARD A
Sir, step through the scanner.

Jun Hou does. The machine emits an UNUSUAL ALARM. Guard A checks his monitor.

GUARD A
Sir, you're showing embedded metal fragments. Raise your arms.

GUARD A scans Jun Hou with a handheld detector. It SCREAMS. He tries again. Same result.

Another GUARD (GUARD B) walks over.

GUARD A
(to GUARD B)
Twenty-nine fragments. Not modern alloy.

GUARD B
(shocked)
Historic?

GUARD B
(into radio)
Supervisor to Gate 3. Artifact alert.

WARNING LIGHTS flash. Two SPECIAL OFFICERS approach.

SECURITY CAPTAIN
Sir, remove your shirt. Now.

JUN HOU
(quiet)
Will this get me home?

SECURITY CAPTAIN
Just do it.

JUN HOU removes his shirt. His torso bears twenty-nine dark circular scars, each with a metallic fragment.

All the guards stare.

SECURITY CAPTAIN
(awed)
Twenty-nine... impossible.

FLASHBACK BEGINS

An ancient battlefield. Jun Hou, in armor, fights fiercely. Projectiles strike his chest. He keeps fighting, bloodied but unyielding as wound after wound accumulates.

FLASHBACK ENDS

Back at the station, bystanders gasp.

BYSTANDER
My God...

SPECIAL OFFICER
(softly, to Captain)
Jun Lin signature confirmed.

YUE JI (O.S.)
Let him go.

A woman in a black leather jacket (YUE JI) approaches with three women. She shows a badge.

YUE JI
(to Captain)
Historical Protection Bureau. This man is under our authority.

She turns to Jun Hou, composure cracking.

YUE JI
Commander. You missed your check-in.

JUN HOU
I wanted to come home quietly.

YUE JI
Your wife?

JUN HOU
She doesn't know.

YUE JI
(nods)

YUE JI walks up to JUN HOU, kneels on one knee, salutes with cupped fist.

YUE JI
General Yue Ji respectfully welcomes the return of Commander Jun Lin Hou.

The women kneel in unison.

ALL WOMEN
We respectfully welcome the return of Jun Lin Hou!

Jun Hou looks at the kneeling soldiers, then at the crowd.

JUN HOU
(quietly)
Get up. I've spent three lifetimes earning the right to stand among you.

YUE JI
(rising)
Then let us walk with you.

They move toward the exit as the station lights seem to bend around them.

FADE OUT.

title: Heaven-Sent Intern God of Wealth
description: Tao Lele, an underperforming intern God of Wealth, is given one last chance to help a struggling young man achieve wealth or face demotion to working in the kitchen god's boiler room.
context:
Title: Heaven-Sent Intern God of Wealth
Description: Tao Lele, an underperforming intern God of Wealth, is given one last chance to help a struggling young man achieve wealth or face demotion to working in the kitchen god's boiler room.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

FAST CUTS:
- SIZZLING wok tossing vegetables over flames.
- TAO LELE (23), in faded crimson celestial robes, guiltily stuffs a STEAMED BUN behind a wooden post.
- SONG LI (25), in a threadbare basketball jersey, slurps noodles alone.

TAO LELE (V.O.)
My name is Tao Lele. Worst intern the Celestial Bureau has seen in three thousand years.

TAO LELE and a SENIOR GODDESS (40s) in pristine white robes watch Song Li from the shadows.

TAO LELE (V.O.)
And that's Song Li. My final chance.

TAO LELE stares at Song Li's worn jersey with dawning horror.

TAO LELE
This... this is my mission target?

SONG LI carefully drinks the last of his broth, then licks the bowl clean.

TAO LELE (V.O.)
So there's a reason I failed. This story starts from the day I was late.

INT. GOD OF WEALTH HALL - DAY

The HEAD GOD OF WEALTH (50s) sits behind an ornate desk, fingers drumming a towering stack of green petition slips.

TAO LELE rushes in, robes askew, nearly tripping over her own sash.

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
Tao Lele. Third time this month.

TAO LELE steadies herself, straightening her robes with an ingratiating smile.

TAO LELE
Boss! I can explain—

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
Spare me. Your district hasn't produced a single six-figure earner in two quarters.

The Head God grabs a handful of green slips, letting them flutter down like leaves.

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
All complaints. "Where's my promotion?" "Why'd my stock crash?" "Who cursed my side-hustle?"

TAO LELE
But... the red ones?

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
continuation:
Don't. Those are all from Xi Mei.

The Head God gestures. A vision appears: XI MEI, flawless in gold, scattering blessings as mortals cheer.

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
She closes million-yuan cases in a week. You can't get one mortal past minimum wage!

TAO LELE
(mutters)
Different districts, different rules. She's in Shenzhen tech. I'm in—

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
What?

TAO LELE
(immediately at attention)
Reporting! I will exceed expectations, Boss!

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
Empty promises. If you can't breakthrough zero this quarter, forget permanent status.

The Head God leans forward, stabbing a finger at her.

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
You'll be transferring to the Kitchen God's boiler room. Permanently.

TAO LELE
(eyes lighting up)
The Kitchen God? Actually, Boss, I've always loved his soup dumplings...

She catches his glare, backpedaling frantically.

TAO LELE
I mean—your hope! I won't let down the hope you've placed in me!

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
(sitting back, suspicious)
Hope. Right.

He unfurls a golden scroll with a flourish.

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
One candidate. One month. Make him prosperous, and you're permanent. Fail...

He lets the threat hang. Tao Lele leans in, squinting at the scroll.

TAO LELE
Song...

HEAD GOD OF WEALTH
(correcting)
Li. Song Li.

TITLE CARD: HEAVEN-SENT INTERN GOD OF WEALTH

title: Reborn in the Apocalypse: Marrying My Scumbag's Rival
description: A global cold wave plunges the world into an icy apocalypse where survival means abandoning all morality, and a woman finds herself caught between her past and a desperate present.
context:
Title: Reborn in the Apocalypse: Marrying My Scumbag's Rival
Description: A global cold wave plunges the world into an icy apocalypse where survival means abandoning all morality, and a woman finds herself caught between her past and a desperate present.

EXT. FROZEN CITY - DAY

The sky is overcast. The city is covered in ice and snow, a scene of apocalypse.
FROZEN CORPSES lie in the streets, preserved like statues. A TRAIL OF BLOOD stains the snow, already freezing over. In the distance, a SMOKE PLUME rises from a burning building, the flames struggling against the cold.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Three months. That's how long the world has been freezing.

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING - DAY

The interior of the building is dilapidated, covered in dust and debris.
FROST covers the walls. A dead RADIATOR sits in the corner. A SURVIVOR'S BREATH crystallizes in the air, visible and desperate.

VICTIM (O.S.)
(weakly)
Please... my daughter...

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING HALLWAY - DAY

A THUG in heavy black clothing drags an injured VICTIM by the collar.
The victim's hands leave bloody smears on the icy floor.

VICTIM
(struggling)
We had a deal! I gave you everything!

THUG
(quietly, almost gentle)
Everything wasn't enough.
(hefts the victim up)
The cold takes us all eventually.

The THUG throws the VICTIM out the window from the high floor. No scream—just the dull crunch of impact.
continuation:
EXT. SNOWY GROUND - DAY

The VICTIM falls onto the snowy ground. Their body is still. Within seconds, ICE CRYSTALS spiderweb across their skin. A stray dog approaches, nudges the body, then backs away as it begins to freeze solid.

EXT. SHEN YUNAN'S HOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY

Heavy snow falls. XU ZHIYI (28, exhausted but determined), XIAO LIANG (30, handsome but with hollow eyes), and CHEN MENGROU (26, nervous) huddle at the entrance. Xu Zhiyi rubs her hands, her fingers blue at the tips.

XIAO LIANG
(softly)
You're shivering.

XU ZHIYI
(avoiding his gaze)
We shouldn't be here.

CHEN MENGROU
We have to. Your ex... he's the only one with supplies left in this district. The military cleared out yesterday.

XIAO LIANG
(places a hand on Xu Zhiyi's shoulder)
Remember what he was like before all this? He'd have given you the world.

XU ZHIYI
(flinched at his touch)
That was a lifetime ago.

She stares at the door. A flicker of memory crosses her face—falling snow, a different door, a different betrayal. She blinks it away.

XU ZHIYI
(quietly)
He won't help us. Not after what I did.

XIAO LIANG
Then we give him a reason.

Xiao Liang's hand moves to his belt. The kitchen knife handle is visible. Xu Zhiyi sees it. Their eyes meet. Something passes between them—recognition, resignation.

XU ZHIYI
(dully)
I'll try.

She knocks. The sound is muffled by the cold.

XU ZHIYI
Shen Yunan. It's... it's me.

The door opens a crack. SHEN YUNAN (29, hardened, eyes sharp) appears. He sees her. His expression doesn't change, but his grip tightens on the doorframe.

SHEN YUNAN
You're still alive.

XU ZHIYI
(nods, voice breaking)
I need—

XIAO LIANG suddenly grabs Xu Zhiyi from behind, the knife blade cold against her skin. But his grip is loose, his hands trembling.

XIAO LIANG
(shouting)
Open the door, Shen! Or she freezes out here with the rest of us!

SHEN YUNAN's eyes flick from the knife to Xiao Liang's face. He sees the desperation, the calculation. He sees Xu Zhiyi's eyes—wide, but not surprised. She's been here before.

SHEN YUNAN
(stepping out, unarmed)
Let her go. Take me instead.

XIAO LIANG
(laughs, brittle)
You think I'm stupid? Inside. Now.

Shen Yunan holds Xu Zhiyi's gaze for a long moment. Something in her expression makes him pause. Then he opens the door completely.

Waiting inside, barely visible: rows of SUPPLIES. Canned goods. Medicine. And on a table, a PHOTO of Shen Yunan and Xu Zhiyi—years younger, smiling.

XIAO LIANG pushes Xu Zhiyi forward, toward the warmth, toward the past she left behind.

title: Vanished Love
description: A mother rushes her sick son to the hospital on her daughter's birthday, only to face her husband's fury and a devastating choice between her two children.
context:
Title: Vanished Love
Description: A mother rushes her sick son to the hospital on her daughter's birthday, only to face her husband's fury and a devastating choice between her two children.

EXT. HOSPITAL - DAY

A series of fast-paced hospital shots: a nurse pouring saline solution, hospital bed wheels rolling rapidly, ambulance lights flashing, surgical instruments, blood bags.

NURSE (V.O.)
Incoming acute renal failure. Six-year-old male, status post. Prep the pediatric ICU team now!

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

ZHOU WENMEI, wearing a green dress, runs anxiously through the hospital corridor.

ZHOU WENMEI
Mingzhe, thank God—

SU MINGZHE shoves ZHOU WENMEI against the wall, his face contorted with panic.

SU MINGZHE
(low, dangerous)
Dr. Zhao said one more episode could kill him. One. And you took him to an amusement park?

ZHOU WENMEI
Tears streaming down her face, she reaches for him.

ZHOU WENMEI
(struggling for breath)
Today is Yiyi's birthday. Xiaohui begged me. He wanted to feel normal, just for one hour—

SU MINGZHE
(fingers digging into her shoulders)
Normal? My son will never be normal because you decided to have another child. The pregnancy complications weakened him. Every specialist said so.

ZHOU WENMEI
That's not how—

SU MINGZHE
(shoving her away)
Since Yiyi was born, it's been infection after infection. The fortune teller was right. She's poisoned this family.

ZHOU WENMEI
(on her knees)
She's four years old. Your daughter.

SU MINGZHE
My son is dying. My company is collapsing from his medical bills. She took everything from him before she could even walk.

ZHOU WENMEI
(crawling forward)
Mingzhe, please. I know you blame me. But they're both my babies. I can't choose—

SU MINGZHE
(turning away)
Then I'll choose for you. Where is she? I told Song to bring her.

ZHOU WENMEI
(panicking)
Yiyi was right behind me in the lobby. She promised she'd stay with the receptionist—

SONG YUANJIANG rushes over, his expression grim.

SONG YUANJIANG
Mr. Su, the receptionist says she never arrived at the desk.

ZHOU WENMEI
(frantic)
What? No, I told her "wait by the flowers, don't move"—

FLASHBACK
continuation:
EXT. HOSPITAL ENTRANCE - DAY

ON SCREEN: Twenty minutes ago

ZHOU WENMEI carries XIAOHUI toward the sliding doors, YIYI clutching her dress.

ZHOU WENMEI
Yiyi, wait by the flower pots. Right here. Don't move until I come back.

YIYI
(trembling)
Mommy, I'm scared.

ZHOU WENMEI
(fighting tears)
Be my brave girl. Just for a little while.

INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - DAY

Through the glass doors, we see ZHOU WENMEI sprint toward the ER. YIYI stands alone, watching. A large family rushes past, knocking her small backpack off her shoulders. As she bends to pick it up, she wanders a few steps away from the designated spot. A security guard approaches.

END FLASHBACK

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

ZHOU WENMEI
She's lost. Oh God, she's lost in the hospital—

She bolts down the corridor.

INT. HOSPITAL STAIRWELL - DAY

SU MINGZHE and SONG YUANJIANG meet with DR. ZHAO.

DR. ZHAO
Xiaohui's creatinine levels are critical. He needs a transplant within weeks, not months.

SU MINGZHE
The previous compatibility tests—Yiyi was a match?

DR. ZHAO
(hesitant)
She's a 95% match. But Mr. Su, she's under five. The ethics board will never approve harvesting a kidney from a minor without her consent and extensive evaluation.

SU MINGZHE
She can consent. She'll do anything for her brother.

DR. ZHAO
(carefully)
Legally, she cannot. And your wife would need to—

SU MINGZHE
My wife would sign. If it meant saving Xiaohui.

DR. ZHAO
Mrs. Zhou would have to be evaluated for coercion. And Yiyi would need psychological screening. This isn't a simple procedure.

SU MINGZHE
(furious whisper)
My daughter is missing in this hospital while my son codes upstairs. If we find her, and she agrees, will you file the paperwork?

DR. ZHAO
I can start the process. But Mr. Su, the board may still deny it.

SONG YUANJIANG
Sir, security footage shows Yiyi wandering toward the pediatric ward on the fourth floor. Alone.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

YIYI sits on a hospital bed, clutching a stuffed rabbit. SU MINGZHE enters, his face transforming from panic to a fragile hope.

SU MINGZHE
(gently)
Found you, little rabbit.

YIYI
Daddy! I got lost. I was trying to find Xiaohui's room.

SU MINGZHE
(sitting beside her)
You want to help your brother?

YIYI
(nodding)
Mommy says he's very sick.

SU MINGZHE
He needs a special gift. From inside you. A tiny bean that makes him better.

YIYI
(scared but brave)
Will it hurt?

SU MINGZHE
A little. But you're so strong. You'd do that for Xiaohui?

YIYI
(wiping her eyes)
If it makes him play with me again.

SU MINGZHE
(hugging her)
Good girl. Such a good girl.

He looks over her head at the NURSE entering.

SU MINGZHE
(to Nurse)
Preliminaries first. Draw her blood. Start the assessment protocol.

The NURSE approaches with a pediatric blood draw kit. YIYI extends her arm, trying to be brave. The rabbit falls from her lap.

END FLASHBACK

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

ZHOU WENMEI
She's lost. Oh God, she's lost in the hospital—

She bolts down the corridor.

INT. HOSPITAL STAIRWELL - DAY

SU MINGZHE and SONG YUANJIANG meet with DR. ZHAO.

DR. ZHAO
Xiaohui's creatinine levels are critical. He needs a transplant within weeks, not months.

SU MINGZHE
The previous compatibility tests—Yiyi was a match?

DR. ZHAO
(hesitant)
She's a 95% match. But Mr. Su, she's under five. The ethics board will never approve harvesting a kidney from a minor without her consent and extensive evaluation.

SU MINGZHE
She can consent. She'll do anything for her brother.

DR. ZHAO
(carefully)
Legally, she cannot. And your wife would need to—

SU MINGZHE
My wife would sign. If it meant saving Xiaohui.

DR. ZHAO
Mrs. Zhou would have to be evaluated for coercion. And Yiyi would need psychological screening. This isn't a simple procedure.

SU MINGZHE
(furious whisper)
My daughter is missing in this hospital while my son codes upstairs. If we find her, and she agrees, will you file the paperwork?

DR. ZHAO
I can start the process. But Mr. Su, the board may still deny it.

SONG YUANJIANG
Sir, security footage shows Yiyi wandering toward the pediatric ward on the fourth floor. Alone.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

YIYI sits on a hospital bed, clutching a stuffed rabbit. SU MINGZHE enters, his face transforming from panic to a fragile hope.

SU MINGZHE
(gently)
Found you, little rabbit.

YIYI
Daddy! I got lost. I was trying to find Xiaohui's room.

SU MINGZHE
(sitting beside her)
You want to help your brother?

YIYI
(nodding)
Mommy says he's very sick.

SU MINGZHE
He needs a special gift. From inside you. A tiny bean that makes him better.

YIYI
(scared but brave)
Will it hurt?

SU MINGZHE
A little. But you're so strong. You'd do that for Xiaohui?

YIYI
(wiping her eyes)
If it makes him play with me again.

SU MINGZHE
(hugging her)
Good girl. Such a good girl.

He looks over her head at the NURSE entering.

SU MINGZHE
(to Nurse)
Preliminaries first. Draw her blood. Start the assessment protocol.

The NURSE approaches with a pediatric blood draw kit. YIYI extends her arm, trying to be brave. The rabbit falls from her lap.

title: Deserted City
description: A young woman returns to her hometown five years after being falsely accused, only to find the past still haunts her. Her grandmother arranges a marriage to help her start anew in another city.

Title: Deserted City
Description: A young woman returns to her hometown five years after being falsely accused, only to find the past still haunts her. Her grandmother arranges a marriage to help her start anew in another city.

INT. HAITONG'S HOME - DAY

ON SCREEN: DESERTED CITY

A red "Fu" character peels at the corners on the weathered door. HAITONG (17), hair plastered to her face, fumbles with her keys in the downpour.

HAITONG
Grandma! The sky just opened up!

She ducks inside, stripping her soaked uniform with practiced haste, pulling on a worn tank top. The sound of heavy, unsteady footsteps approaches.

LAO WANG (50s, reeking of alcohol) shoulders through the unlocked door, eyes glazed.

LAO WANG
Xiao Tong... your grandma mentioned you'd be alone...

He lunges. Haitong's textbook falls, pages scattering.

HAITONG
(screaming)
Get away!

LAO WANG
Don't fight. No one will believe you anyway.

HAITONG
(struggling, nails raking his arm)
Help! Someone!

LAO WANG'S WIFE appears in the doorway, breathless. Her face hardens at the scene—not just the struggle, but the bottle slipping from Lao Wang's pocket. She chooses her target.

LAO WANG'S WIFE
(rushing toward HAITONG)
You little slut! Setting traps for my husband? I'm right here!

She grabs Haitong's hair. The first blow lands.

LAO WANG'S WIFE
Bitch! Whore! This is YOUR home—if you didn't invite him, how'd he get in? I've heard about girls like you. Desperate for cash. Just like your mother who dumped you here!

HAITONG
(crying, protecting her face)
He broke in! Look at the door!

LAO WANG'S WIFE
Explain to the police! Oh wait—they'll see exactly what you are.

NEIGHBORS cluster at the threshold. NEIGHBOR A (40s, laundry basket in arms) points with her chin.

NEIGHBOR A (Female)
Seventeen and already wrecking homes. Shameless.

NEIGHBOR B (Male)
 apple doesn't fall far from the tree.

NEIGHBOR C (Female, older)
Grandma Hai tried so hard...

NEIGHBOR B (Male)
Parents died. Bound to happen.

NEIGHBOR A (Female)
If she had any decency, she'd disappear.

NEIGHBORS
(talking over each other)
Little demon. Vixen. She asked for it.

ON SCREEN: FIVE YEARS LATER
continuation:
INT. BUS - DAY

HAITONG (22), black-framed glasses masking her eyes, watches Wan City blur past the rain-streaked window. Her knuckles are white on her portfolio.

HAITONG (V.O.)
Five years. I built a new name. But Grandma's letters... they smell of this rain.

INT. OLD BUILDING STAIRWELL - DAY

Haitong climbs. The walls still bear the ghost of old posters—"SLUT," "VIXEN"—now faded, layered with peeling paint. She touches one.

LAO WANG'S WIFE (O.S.)
You actually came back.

She stands on the landing, gripping a shopping bag, eyes colder.

LAO WANG'S WIFE
Everyone remembers. How you tried to steal him. The lies you told.

HAITONG
I didn't invent his fingerprints on my neck.

LAO WANG'S WIFE
(flinches, then recovers)
Words. All just words.

GRANDMA HAI shuffles out, a wool shawl over her shoulders, holding a thermos of tea.

GRANDMA HAI
Xiao Tong. You came.

LAO WANG'S WIFE
(to GRANDMA HAI)
You're still covering for her?

GRANDMA HAI
(protecting HAITONG)
I'm covering nothing. You're standing in my doorway.

LAO WANG'S WIFE
Like grandmother, like granddaughter. Everyone knows you—

HAITONG
Enough.

She steps forward. Lao Wang's Wife stumbles back, dropping her bag. Oranges roll down the stairs.

GRANDMA HAI
(to LAO WANG'S WIFE)
Next time you slander my granddaughter, bring proof. Or a lawyer.

HAITONG
(supporting her grandmother)
Grandma, let's go inside.

GRANDMA HAI
Xiao Tong. You never apologized. I did.

HAITONG's phone rings—an unknown number. She answers.

HAITONG
(answering)
Hello?

HR (V.O.)
Miss Haitong? Shengda Group. We need to discuss your application.

HAITONG
Yes, I interviewed last week—

HR (V.O.)
We've received... concerning information about your history in Wan City. Several firms in our network share a background system. Given the documentation of "moral deficiencies"—

HAITONG
Documentation? It was never—

HR (V.O.)
The system is the system. I'm sorry. We'll be rescinding the offer. And... others may follow.

The call ends. Haitong's portfolio slips. Pages scatter—her resume, shredded by rain.

HAITONG
(crying)
Grandma, they found me.

GRANDMA HAI
(holding HAITONG)
The world is small for women with rumors. But hearts can be bigger.

HAITONG (V.O.)
I thought the internet forgot. But Wan City is the internet.

Haitong picks up a piece of her resume. Her hand trembles, then stills.

HAITONG (V.O.)
Fine. If Wan City is a cage, I'll find a door.

GRANDMA HAI
Qin Chuan. Remember him? My friend Aiyu's grandson. He works in Beijing now. A good boy. Quiet. Steady. He needs... a partner. For family reasons. No one there knows our ghosts. You could breathe again.

ON SCREEN: BEIJING CITY

INT. MARRIAGE REGISTRATION OFFICE - DAY

STAFF MEMBER
Sign here. And here. Congratulations.

HAITONG holds the certificate. Her signature is firm. QIN CHUAN (30s, clean-shaven, eyes distant) signs without looking up.

HAITONG (V.O.)
I married a signature.

QIN CHUAN slides a matte black card across the counter.

QIN CHUAN
I fly to San Francisco tonight. For work. The PIN is our date. Use what you need. I'll be back in three months. We can... figure it out then.

He turns. Haitong watches him—his posture military-straight, his left hand drumming a rhythm against his thigh.

HAITONG
Wait. I didn't come here for charity.

QIN CHUAN
(pausing)
Neither did I.

He's gone before she can process it. The staff member already gestures to the next couple.

HAITONG (V.O.)
He left me with a number and a question.

She looks at the card. Then at the certificate. Her thumb runs over the seal.

HAITONG
(to herself)
Three months.

STAFF MEMBER
Miss? Your husband forgot his pen.

HAITONG takes it—a heavy fountain pen, engraved with initials that aren't his.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Peerless Hero
description: A prince awakens from a five-year seal to discover betrayal and conspiracy within the imperial palace.
context:
Title: Peerless Hero
Description: A prince awakens from a five-year seal to discover betrayal and conspiracy within the imperial palace.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE COURTYARD - NIGHT

Heavy snow falls, burying the execution platform in white. The FOURTH PRINCE, LI XINGHE, kneels in blood-soaked snow as GUARDS deliver methodical blows with iron rods. Xinghe's head lolls, consciousness fading.

LI WENYAN (O.S.)
Third Brother!

LI WENYAN
Please! I beg you, stop beating Fourth Brother! Commander Ye has gone to the Crown Prince with the Flying Phoenix seal!

The guards hesitate. Princess LI WENYAN stands in the snow, clutching a jade token.

INT. THIRD PRINCE'S STUDY - NIGHT

The THIRD PRINCE holds a scroll, watching through a lattice window. His expression is cold.

THIRD PRINCE
(whispering)
Imperial Sister... some doors, once opened, cannot be closed.
continuation:
INT. CROWN PRINCE'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

Commander YE LAN stands rigid in armor before the CROWN PRINCE and CONSORT AN. The Crown Prince lounges with his wine cup.

CONSORT AN
Commander Ye in full armor at this hour? How... pointed. You have your answer. Get out.

YE LAN
The Fourth Prince dies in the courtyard as we speak. The Flying Phoenix Army remembers their true commander.

The Crown Prince's hand tightens on his cup.

CROWN PRINCE
The position was always mine. Father's favor was the aberration. If Xinghe still drew breath as a whole man, how could I sit securely?

YE LAN
Whole? He's been simple-minded for five years.

CROWN PRINCE
A condition that requires... maintenance. Some poisons work slowly. Some mercy takes time to reveal its wisdom.

CONSORT AN
(firmly)
Your Highness, you tire.

CROWN PRINCE
(shaking her off)
The physician's visits. The "tonics."

YE LAN
(deadly quiet)
I understand now.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE COURTYARD - NIGHT

A GUARD raises his rod for the final blow. Xinghe's blood drips onto snow, forming a circle. The sky flashes VIOLET—a celestial alignment.

Xinghe convulses. His wounds seal, steaming. Snowflakes hover frozen around him.

LI XINGHE grips the platform. The iron rod in the guard's hand warps without contact.

LI XINGHE slowly stands up, looking around, his eyes shifting from confusion to grief to fury.

LI XINGHE (V.O.)
Five years... I was here. Watching. Trapped behind my own eyes. Whoever I was before this life... they're going to wish I'd stayed dead.

title: The Imperial Consort's Career Guide
description: A woman finds herself caught in a deadly palace conspiracy as she is framed and condemned, while those who love her fight to save her.
context:
Title: The Imperial Consort's Career Guide
Description: A woman finds herself caught in a deadly palace conspiracy as she is framed and condemned, while those who love her fight to save her.

INT. OUTSIDE YANGXIN PALACE - DAY

MURONG LE kneels on the ground, her expression filled with grief—and steel.

MURONG LE
Your Majesty, my father and brothers have been utterly loyal to you. Do not listen to slander and frame the innocent!

The EMPRESS walks out from inside Yangxin Palace, her expression cold and cruel.

EMPRESS
Bind her and throw her into the Cold Palace.

GUARDS step forward and seize MURONG LE.

MURONG LE
(struggling)
Let me go! Your Majesty!

The REGENT PRINCE arrives and blocks the way in front of MURONG LE.

EUNUCH
Regent Prince.

EMPRESS
She is now the daughter of a criminal. Will you still protect her?

REGENT PRINCE
(to MURONG LE)
I will take you away.

EMPRESS
(mocking)
Has she ever given you even a small place in her heart? Wake up!

The EMPRESS becomes emotional. A flashback flickers.

EMPRESS (V.O.)
continuation:
I became Empress for you, yet I still cannot compare to her. Murong Le, go die!

The EMPRESS pulls out a guard's dagger and stabs toward MURONG LE. The REGENT PRINCE fails to stop her.

MURONG LE is stabbed and falls into the REGENT PRINCE's arms.

REGENT PRINCE
(horrified)
Murong Le!

The EMPRESS laughs maniacally nearby.

REGENT PRINCE holds MURONG LE, devastated.

REGENT PRINCE
Murong Le! Murong Le!

MURONG LE (V.O.)
I feel... like I can't breathe.

REGENT PRINCE
Murong Le!

The scene flashes back to modern times, where a woman named XIA KE questions someone in a video call.

XIA KE (V.O.)
Xia Qianqian, why is his heart only for you? Why?

The scene returns to ancient times. The EMPRESS laughs, her voice overlapping with XIA KE's questioning.

EMPRESS (V.O.)
Go die!

REGENT PRINCE holds MURONG LE's body and cries out to the heavens.

REGENT PRINCE
Ah!

INT. MODERN BEDROOM - DAY

A modern woman who looks remarkably like MURONG LE wakes up startled from her bed, gasping for air.

title: The Storm Rises Again
description: A humble fish vendor's quiet life shatters when his wife's betrayal with a local strongman forces him to confront the cost of survival in Jinghai Market.
context:
Title: The Storm Rises Again
Description: A humble fish vendor's quiet life shatters when his wife's betrayal with a local strongman forces him to confront the cost of survival in Jinghai Market.

INT. FISH MARKET - NIGHT

LI YOUCAI and his HENCHMEN shove WANG QIANG's head into a fish tank. Water erupts, scattering silver-scaled fish.

LI YOUCAI
(laughing)
You see? Even the fish know their place.

The HENCHMEN yank WANG QIANG out, gasping. Water streams from his nose and mouth.

LI YOUCAI
(grabbing Wang Qiang's collar)
Twenty years selling fish, and you still think this water belongs to you?

The HENCHMEN force WANG QIANG to his knees. His fingers curl through the wet gravel.

LI YOUCAI
Show him the price of pride.

HENCHMAN
Yes, boss.

WANG QIANG
(through gritted teeth)
Cai. This is between us.

LI YOUCAI
(contemptuously)
Is it? Your wife didn't think so. She paid your protection fee with something sweeter than cash.

LI YOUCAI's HENCHMEN kick WANG QIANG's legs out. He collapses face-down among scattered crawfish, their claws clicking in the puddles.

LI YOUCAI slides his arm around ZHANG FANG's waist. She stares at WANG QIANG's unconscious body, her smile tight as a wire.

WANG QIANG (V.O.)
My father taught me that still waters run deep. But tonight, the water broke me.

BLACK SCREEN

ON SCREEN: Half an hour earlier
continuation:
EXT. MARKET - DAY

The market churns with evening crowds. A POLICE SIREN wails in the distance, ignored.

INT. WANG QIANG'S FISH STALL - DAY

WANG QIANG deftly guts a carp for an OLD LADY, his knife flashing with practiced grace.

WANG QIANG
Twenty even, Auntie Chen. The liver's good for your eyes.

OLD LADY
(quietly urgent)
Qiangzi... I saw Zhang Fang go into Youcai's shop ten minutes ago. She looked... she looked like she was walking to her own execution.

WANG QIANG's knife stills. A drop of blood beads on his thumb.

OLD LADY
The stall fees can wait. Go.

WANG QIANG wipes his hands, his movements precise, too calm. He unstraps his apron.

EXT. MARKET ALLEY - DAY

WANG QIANG moves through the maze of stalls, his pace quickening with each step. Vendors avert their eyes.

WANG QIANG
(under his breath)
Fang...

INT. LI YOUCAI'S BUTCHER SHOP - DAY

LI YOUCAI reclines in a blood-stained apron, sipping baijiu. ZHANG FANG stands at the window, her back to him.

LI YOUCAI
You think running to me saves him? Every choice has interest.

ZHANG FANG
(quietly)
Just take the money and let us be.

LI YOUCAI
The money was never enough.

WANG QIANG appears in the doorway, his knuckles white on the frame.

WANG QIANG
Fang. We're leaving.

LI YOUCAI
(mock surprise)
The fishmonger prince arrives. Tell me, does it sting more knowing she came to me, or that she enjoyed the transaction?

WANG QIANG
(steady)
The stall fee. Give it back.

LI YOUCAI
Your wife paid it. Didn't you, darling?

LI YOUCAI pulls ZHANG FANG to him. She stumbles, her eyes locking with WANG QIANG's—filled with something unreadable. Shame, fear, and beneath it, defiance.

WANG QIANG
(roaring)
Let her GO!

WANG QIANG snatches a cleaver from the block. The blade catches the light.

BLACK SCREEN

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

Description: A humble fish vendor's quiet life shatters when his wife's betrayal with a local strongman forces him to confront the cost of survival in Jinghai Market.

LI YOUCAI
(laughing)
You see? Even the fish know their place.

The HENCHMEN yank WANG QIANG out, gasping. Water streams from his nose and mouth.

LI YOUCAI
(grabbing Wang Qiang's collar)
Twenty years selling fish, and you still think this water belongs to you?

The HENCHMEN force WANG QIANG to his knees. His fingers curl through the wet gravel.

Show him the price of pride.

Yes, boss.

Cai. This is between us.

(contemptuously)

title: Ex-Husband Gains Mind Reading After Divorce
description: A woman threatens to jump from a building to prevent divorce, but her husband coldly calls her bluff. After a car accident, he gains the ability to hear her inner thoughts.
context:
Title: Ex-Husband Gains Mind Reading After Divorce
Description: A woman threatens to jump from a building to prevent divorce, but her husband coldly calls her bluff. After a car accident, he gains the ability to hear her inner thoughts.

EXT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

LIN XUEZHI (28, porcelain defiance in a battered bridal gown) stands at the rooftop edge.

Below, HE YAN (35, tailored suit tailored cruelty) and his assistant ZHANG YUAN (30s, nervous energy) look up.

LIN XUEZHI
He Yan! If you divorce me, I'll jump!

HE YAN
(coldly)
Third building this month. Try the north tower—it's taller.

LIN XUEZHI
(angrily)
You bastard!

HE YAN
Now you're getting it.

He turns to leave.

ZHANG YUAN
(worried)
President He, the reporters—

HE YAN
Will have to find a new story. She won't jump.

LIN XUEZHI
(shouting)
He Yan! I will never sign those papers!

A black sedan SCREENS around the corner and speeds toward them, horn BLARING.

HE YAN shoves ZHANG YUAN aside. The sedan clips him. He crumples, head cracking against pavement.

LIN XUEZHI
(scream)
HE YAN!

She sprints for the fire escape.
continuation:
EXT. CITY STREET - CONTINUOUS

LIN XUEZHI cradles HE YAN, blood pooling beneath his head.

LIN XUEZHI
(frantically)
He Yan! Please—

HE YAN
(weakly)
Am I—

LIN XUEZHI (V.O.)
 dying? God. I wanted to hurt you, not kill you. I wanted you to need me. If you die, I'm still Mrs. He. The shares. The will. Stop. Think of him, not the money. The money is just... security. If he lives.

LIN XUEZHI
(trembling)
He Yan, don't leave me...

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

HE YAN lies unconscious, head wrapped, eyes closed. ZHANG YUAN stands nearby.

The door bursts open. LIN XUEZHI, in wrinkled casual clothes, rushes in.

She seizes his hand.

LIN XUEZHI
(crying softly)
He Yan. He Yan, wake up.

ZHANG YUAN
Madam, his monitors—

HE YAN slowly opens his eyes.

LIN XUEZHI
(gasp)
He Yan—

LIN XUEZHI (V.O.)
 —thank God. The prenup is void if he dies. No. Stop. I just want him to see me. Not the contract. Me.

HE YAN stares at her, hearing every silent word.
