title: Descending the Mountain into the Mortal World
description: A master chess player sends his disciple, who possesses mystical powers and a thirst for justice, down the mountain with meaningful gifts to confront a dark past.
context:
Title: Descending the Mountain into the Mortal World
Description: A master chess player sends his disciple, who possesses mystical powers and a thirst for justice, down the mountain with meaningful gifts to confront a dark past.

EXT. LAKESIDE PAVILION - DAY

A white-haired MASTER and his disciple YE CHEN face each other across a stone chessboard. Morning mist rises from the lake.

MASTER (V.O.)
Within these nineteen lines, the world itself unfolds. Every stone placed is a choice made.

Ye Chen captures a white piece, his movements precise with barely contained energy. The Master strokes his beard, studying the board.

MASTER (V.O.)
The question isn't who wins. It's whether he can see beyond the board.

INT. MENTAL CHESS REALM - CONTINUOUS

The pavilion dissolves into a starlit void. A massive chess grid pulses beneath their feet.

MASTER
Watch closely.

The Master gestures. His pieces ignite into constellations, forming an overwhelming tide of light.

MASTER
All Things as Chess.

YE CHEN (V.O.)
He expects fury. He taught me better.

Ye Chen's pieces shimmer with golden fire, arranging themselves into a coiled DRAGON that doesn't strike—it rests, watchful, between the stars.

YE CHEN
I see your formation. Do you see mine?

The Master's tide of light halts, unable to advance without destroying the entire pattern.
continuation:
EXT. LAKESIDE PAVILION - DAY

Ye Chen places a final black stone. The game is complete. The Master exhales slowly.

MASTER
You didn't shatter my attack. You made it obsolete. That's... unexpected.

YE CHEN
I learned from watching you.

MASTER
Ten years ago, you came to me hollowed out. Body broken. Spirit burning. I gave you the Qilin Kidneys so you could heal. Today, you show me you can wield such power without letting it consume you.

YE CHEN
(quietly)
And now?

MASTER
Now you must face what made you. The Jiang family still roams free. They took your future; you'll reclaim your name.

YE CHEN
(stiffening)
Master... the procedure they used on me. No anesthesia. They left me to die.

MASTER
(tosses him a leather pouch)
Then make them feel every choice they've made. Take this.

Ye Chen catches it. Inside: four objects that gleam even in daylight.

MASTER
The obsidian card holds resources—use them to rebuild what was destroyed. The token commands the Angel Guard; they'll follow you because they've seen what you survived, not because I command it. The ring was earned when you chose restraint over victory today. And the golden needle... use it on those who deserve a second chance you never received.

YE CHEN
You're not coming back, are you?

The Master turns away, hands clasped behind his back.

MASTER
My path ends where yours begins. Three years, and you've become everything I hoped. And feared.

(beat)
The Qilin Blood in your veins will draw many things—power, temptation, old ghosts. Remember why you chose the dragon's watchfulness over the dragon's fire.

YE CHEN
(lowers his head)
Master... thank you. For the kidneys. For the lesson. For everything.

MASTER
Go. Before I forget my own teachings.

Ye Chen bows deeply, then walks toward the mountain path. He doesn't look back.

The Master watches him go, his satisfied smile fading into quiet concern.

MASTER
(softly)
A hidden dragon rises. May the world be ready.

FADE OUT.

title: Guardian God of Jiang Domain
description: A powerful lord returns home to find his benefactor dead and his family in danger from a scheming mistress and treacherous relative.
context:
Title: Guardian God of Jiang Domain
Description: A powerful lord returns home to find his benefactor dead and his family in danger from a scheming mistress and treacherous relative.

EXT. GOLF COURSE - DAY

JIANG SHOU is swinging a golf club, with two MAIDS in red qipao standing behind him.

He swings forcefully, and the golf ball flies into the distance.

A convoy of luxury cars arrives and stops by the roadside. The lead vehicle is a white sports car.

QING YUN gets out of the sports car, followed by a group of SUBORDINATES in black.

QING YUN leads everyone running quickly toward JIANG SHOU.

Everyone runs behind JIANG SHOU and kneels on one knee.

QING YUN
Qing Yun pays respects to the Supreme Lord of Jiang Domain.

SUBORDINATES
(in unison)
We pay respects to the Supreme Lord of Jiang Domain!

JIANG SHOU turns around, his expression calm.

JIANG SHOU
Rise. This is a personal matter now.

QING YUN
Supreme Lord, Jiang Domain remains peaceful in your absence.

JIANG SHOU
Good. Then my work there is done.

QING YUN
Forgive my intrusion, but there is urgent news from your homeland.

JIANG SHOU
Speak.

QING YUN
Old Master Jiang has fallen. Li Yue and Jiang Xun have taken control of the estate. Your sister's safety cannot be guaranteed.

JIANG SHOU's grip tightens on his club. He slowly places it back in the bag.

JIANG SHOU
The old man gave me everything. And this is how they repay his memory?

JIANG SHOU
Qing Yun!

QING YUN
Yes!

JIANG SHOU
Ready the convoy. We're going home.

QING YUN
Yes!

JIANG SHOU turns and leads everyone away with determined strides.
continuation:
INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

Inside the mourning hall, LI YUE kneels before the ancestral tablet, pretending to mourn. JIANG XUN stands beside her, his voice low and urgent.

LI YUE
(quietly, with a smirk)
The lawyers finalize the inheritance papers tomorrow. Once Jiang Yun's signature is on them, she'll have nothing.

JIANG XUN
She trusts me. Her dear uncle, looking out for her interests.

LI YUE
And the old fool actually thought she'd inherit everything. Ridiculous.

JIANG XUN
He always favored my brother's brats. But dead men can't protect their children.

LI YUE
Hush. Someone might hear.

JIANG XUN
Let them. By the time anyone realizes what happened, it will be too late.

The two exchange a glance, their smiles cold.

Suddenly, JIANG YUN appears at the doorway, having overheard. Her face pales with shock.

JIANG YUN
(whispering, horrified)
Uncle... what have you done?

title: Episode One
description: A woman gives birth to triplets while dealing with betrayal and loss, as her cold husband blames her for his sister's fate.
context:
Title: Episode One
Description: A woman gives birth to triplets while dealing with betrayal and loss, as her cold husband blames her for his sister's fate.

INT. DELIVERY ROOM - DAY

XIA WANQING lies on the delivery bed, drenched in sweat, her face contorted in pain. Two healthy INFANTS cry in incubators nearby.

NURSE
Push harder! Push harder!

NURSE
Come on, take a deep breath.

NURSE
This is the last one, hang in there.

DOCTOR
Mrs. Huo, the head is out, take a deep breath.

XIA WANQING
(screaming in pain)
Huo Jinsheng, why couldn't you believe me?!

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

XIA WANQING and JIANG SHICHU kneel before an altar. A portrait of HUO YAN in a wheelchair watches over them. XIA WANQING sobs uncontrollably.

HUO JINSHENG, wearing a white suit, enters with HUO MOTHER and BODYGUARDS. His hand trembles slightly as he drops divorce papers.

HUO JINSHENG
(coldly)
Sign it.

HUO JINSHENG throws the document in front of XIA WANQING. He crouches down, his eyes red-rimmed.

HUO JINSHENG
What poetic justice. She died without legs. You get to walk away.

XIA WANQING
(tearfully)
You wish it was me in that photograph.

HUO JINSHENG
You took her future. Now pay the price.

XIA WANQING's fingers trace her cracked jade bracelet—her grandmother's.

XIA WANQING
Grandmother's death... Xia Wanyi wasn't alone, was she?

HUO JINSHENG stands up, takes out a black card and tosses it onto the document.

HUO JINSHENG
Consider it compensation for four years.
continuation:
JIANG SHICHU
(angrily)
You—

HUO JINSHENG
Xia Wanqing, are you that eager to get rid of me?

XIA WANQING picks up the pen, signs the document, and throws it back at HUO JINSHENG.

XIA WANQING
Don't let the door hit you on the way out.

HUO JINSHENG takes the document, turns to leave, then looks back at XIA WANQING.

HUO JINSHENG
Xia Wanqing, your hell is just beginning. Enjoy the taste of losing your loved ones.

HUO JINSHENG and HUO MOTHER leave. XIA WANQING collapses on the floor in anguish.

JIANG SHICHU
(supporting XIA WANQING)
Wanqing, why didn't you tell him? About the triplets—

XIA WANQING
(desperately)
There's no point.

INT. DELIVERY ROOM - DAY

FLASHBACK. XIA WANQING has just given birth, extremely weak. The DOCTOR holds the third, smallest baby.

DOCTOR
Miss Xia, the third triplet weighs less than 2 kilograms. She needs NICU care we can't provide. First Hospital—

XIA WANQING
(weakly)
Call him. This number.

A NURSE brings a document for XIA WANQING to sign.

XIA WANQING
(pleading)
He'll save her. Please.

DOCTOR
(to the nurse)
Quickly, quickly, go!

The DOCTOR and NURSE hurry away with the baby.

XIA WANQING
(closing her eyes, tears streaming)
Baby, I'm sorry. Mommy has no choice but to let you go.

Miss Xia, the third triplet weighs less than 2 kilograms. She needs NICU care we can't provide. First Hospital—

XIA WANQING
(weakly)
Call him. This number.

A NURSE brings a document for XIA WANQING to sign.

XIA WANQING
(pleading)
He'll save her. Please.

DOCTOR
(to the nurse)
Quickly, quickly, go!

The DOCTOR and NURSE hurry away with the baby.

XIA WANQING
(closing her eyes, tears streaming)
Baby, I'm sorry. Mommy has no choice but to let you go.

title: Revenge of the Betrayed General's Daughter
description: A woman is tortured and murdered by her lover and his mistress after her family helped him rise to power.
context:
Title: Revenge of the Betrayed General's Daughter
Description: A woman is tortured and murdered by her lover and his mistress after her family helped him rise to power.

INT. WOODSHED - NIGHT

In the dim woodshed, flames flicker in a brazier.

GU YANHANG, in blood-stained white robes, wears an iron collar and kneels in the dirt. Before her stands PEI ZHI in black, his face unreadable. Her father, FATHER GU, bleeds in shackles nearby.

A RED-ROBED WOMAN holds a wine cup, watching.

GU YANHANG
(quiet, broken)
Pei Zhi. Let him die at home. Not like this.

PEI ZHI lifts fire tongs from the brazier—a branding iron glows at their tip, his house sigil.

GU YANHANG
(horrified recognition)
That brand... you swore it would never touch my flesh.

PEI ZHI presses it to FATHER GU's throat. The sizzle cuts her words.

GU YANHANG
(screams)

GU YANHANG
(choking on smoke)
Father! Shuobei—was it worth it? Worth ten winters of false vows?

PEI ZHI's hand trembles once. He drives a wooden spike through FATHER GU's chest.

GU YANHANG
(collapses)

PEI ZHI
continuation:
(flat)
Your name was the only thing worth keeping.

GU YANHANG
(over her father's body)
Then you were never worthy of it.

RED-ROBED WOMAN
She's learned too late. Just like her father.

RED-ROBED WOMAN produces a poison vial.

PEI ZHI
(hand out)
Give it to me.

GU YANHANG looks up—hope or horror, unclear.

PEI ZHI
(leaning close, pouring)
Sleep now.

His thumb brushes her lip—a ghost of old habit—then forces the poison down. RED-ROBED WOMAN laughs.

QUICK FLASHBACK MONTAGE:
- GU YANHANG carves PEI ZHI's sigil into a shield, laughing.
- She kisses his thumb as he traces her smile.
- Their foreheads touch; his hand at her neck—not a collar, but a caress.

BACK TO PRESENT:

GU YANHANG (V.O.)
(venom-quiet)
Pei Zhi... that thumb. I'll take it from you myself.

She convulses, eyes fixed on his. Dies unclosed, unforgiven.

title: Ink-Stained Pear Blossoms White
description: Two childhood friends separated at an orphanage are reunited fifteen years later when the boy, now the world's richest man, returns to fulfill his promise to marry her.
context:
Title: Ink-Stained Pear Blossoms White
Description: Two childhood friends separated at an orphanage are reunited fifteen years later when the boy, now the world's richest man, returns to fulfill his promise to marry her.

INT. ORPHANAGE STEPS - DAY

The camera shows a weathered sign reading "Haicheng City Orphanage."

Young SHEN MO (10) and young A LI (8) sit on the crumbling steps, knees touching. Rain dots the concrete. SHEN MO cradles a broken jade pendant.

YOUNG SHEN MO
Dragons chase phoenixes. This half is yours.

SHEN MO fastens the phoenix pendant around A LI's neck, his fingers trembling.

YOUNG SHEN MO
No matter how far... however long... this will find you back. Promise you'll wait?

YOUNG A LI
(clutching the pendant)
Every day. Every single day.

YOUNG A LI
(whispering)
The director says my mother left me. What if she never—

YOUNG SHEN MO
Then I'll find you anyway. Pendants don't forget.

DIRECTOR (V.O.)
Shen Mo! Your family is here.

The DIRECTOR (50s) approaches, her face tight with forced cheer.

DIRECTOR
Come along, child. They're waiting.

She extends her hand. SHEN MO takes it but doesn't move, his eyes locked on A LI.

YOUNG A LI
Brother Mo...

SHEN MO lets the DIRECTOR pull him away, walking backward to keep A LI in sight.

YOUNG A LI
(running after them)
Wait! Brother Mo, wait!

The DIRECTOR gently blocks A LI as SHEN MO is guided toward the gate.
continuation:
EXT. OUTSIDE ORPHANAGE - DAY

A modest sedan waits at the curb. The DRIVER holds the door open.

YOUNG SHEN MO
(leaning out, voice cracking)
Keep it safe! Keep it—

YOUNG A LI
(running, pendant bouncing)
Brother Mo! Brother Mo!

YOUNG SHEN MO
(tears streaming)
—I'll come back! I swear!

YOUNG A LI
(tripping, catching herself)
Always! I'll wait—

A LI collapses to her knees in the muddy road, clutching the pendant as the sedan rounds the corner and vanishes. She remains there, shoulders shaking, as the orphanage gates loom behind her.

FADE TO:

TRANSITION: FIFTEEN YEARS LATER

EXT. MODERN BUILDING EXTERIOR - DAY

A black Maybach purrs to a stop at the base of a glass tower.

Adult SHEN MO (25) emerges—impeccable suit, exhausted eyes. ASSISTANT GU and two BODYGUARDS trail him.

ON SCREEN: SHEN MO - WORLD'S RICHEST MAN - CEO

ASSISTANT GU
The board approved the Haicheng acquisition, sir. Though I must question the timing, given the Singapore merger—

SHEN MO
The merger can wait. Haicheng can't.

In the car, SHEN MO extracts his half of the pendant from a velvet pouch. The dragon glitters.

SHEN MO
(whisper)
A Li... I'm so late.

The two halves click together seamlessly.

EXT. ORPHANAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

Adult A LI, now JIANG LI (23), stands before the condemned orphanage with a single suitcase.

ON SCREEN: JIANG LI - SHEN MO'S CHILDHOOD FRIEND

JIANG LI (V.O.)
Tomorrow, they demolish everything. One final goodbye before the past becomes dust.

The Maybach turns onto the narrow street, tires crackling on gravel. JIANG LI glances at it, unsurprised.

JIANG LI (V.O.)
Probably the developer. Good. Maybe the new building will know happier endings.

She turns away. The window glides down.

Inside, SHEN MO's eyes trace the chain around JIANG LI's neck, following it down to the phoenix half—identical to his own memory.

The car stops. JIANG LI's hand is on the gate. She feels the weight of a gaze and turns.

Their eyes find each other through the distance. The pendant catches the afternoon sun.

Both freeze.

title: The Foolish Crown Prince
description: A debauched crown prince, manipulated by a seductive woman, recklessly issues imperial edicts while his father the Emperor lies paralyzed, watching helplessly as his son destroys the kingdom.
context:
Title: The Foolish Crown Prince
Description: A debauched crown prince, manipulated by a seductive woman, recklessly issues imperial edicts while his father the Emperor lies paralyzed, watching helplessly as his son destroys the kingdom.

INT. PALACE HALL - NIGHT

Night deepens, candles flicker within the palace hall. The jade seal rests beside scattered edicts.

QIN YAN'ER (V.O.)
(laughing, breathless)
Crown Prince... come catch me...

CROWN PRINCE (V.O.)
I'm coming, little fox.

The CROWN PRINCE sweeps QIN YAN'ER into his arms beside the dragon desk. Their shadows merge on silk screens.

CROWN PRINCE
You are my Regent now.

QIN YAN'ER
For every seal you press... I unwrap another layer. Fair trade, my lord?

CROWN PRINCE
(gently stroking her cheek)
The throne was never meant for such sport.

The CROWN PRINCE presses QIN YAN'ER back against the imperial desk.

CUT TO:

The XIA EMPEROR lies rigid, fingertips trembling against silk covers. His wide eyes track shadows on the ceiling. A muscle in his jaw twitches.

BACK TO:

QIN YAN'ER unfolds a silk edict.

QIN YAN'ER
Read for me, my prince.

CROWN PRINCE
(reading)
"Grant Qin Yan'er ten million taels. Construct a Palace of Pleasure."

The XIA EMPEROR's chamber is seen through a distant doorway. His expression: horror carved in stone.

The CROWN PRINCE lifts the jade seal and stamps it down heavily.

XIA EMPEROR (V.O.)
(strangled whisper)
Unfilial beast...

CROWN PRINCE
He can speak? Quickly, quickly!
continuation:
The CROWN PRINCE snatches another edict.

CROWN PRINCE
"The Xiongnu are mighty... cede nine border cities."

The XIA EMPEROR struggles, his throat producing only a dry rasp.

CROWN PRINCE
Good. The frontier is vast.

XIA EMPEROR (V.O.)
(desperate)
No!

The CROWN PRINCE stamps the seal again.

CROWN PRINCE
Nine cities for peace. A bargain.

He stamps once more, as if crushing something beneath it.

QIN YAN'ER
Mighty prince! See how the realm obeys?

QIN YAN'ER removes her outer robe. It pools at her feet like dark water. Her eyes—hungry, knowing—never leave his.

CROWN PRINCE
(reading the edict)
"Abdicate Regency... bestow upon Qin Song."

The CROWN PRINCE's hand freezes.

QIN YAN'ER
Being prince is so tiring. Wouldn't you rather we simply... danced?

CROWN PRINCE
To my uncle? That is everything.

QIN YAN'ER
Stamp this... and I am yours without games. True obedience.

QIN YAN'ER sinks to her knees, miming a bridle between her teeth.

CROWN PRINCE
(hushed)
You would truly...

QIN YAN'ER
Your horse. Your hound. Anything.

The CROWN PRINCE lifts the seal. His hand trembles—with need, with fear, with madness. He stamps.

Suddenly, the XIA EMPEROR sits up from his bed. Not paralyzed. Merely waiting. Gathering strength. His eyes blaze with the fury of a dragon who feigned sleep while thieves plundered his horde.

title: Yinyang Village: Rebirth Blood Pu
description: A village doctor investigates the mysterious plague that killed his father, uncovering dark secrets involving ancient witchcraft and blood rituals.
context:
Title: Yinyang Village: Rebirth Blood Pu
Description: A village doctor investigates the mysterious plague that killed his father, uncovering dark secrets involving ancient witchcraft and blood rituals.

INT. DARK ROOM - NIGHT

A woman in a red traditional Chinese wedding dress kneels before an altar table, her back to us. A candle burns. Ritual objects rest on the table.

SOUND EFFECT: Muffled weeping that twists into a giggle.

The screen flashes to black.

EXT. MISTY FOREST - NIGHT

DUGU MU (20s, medical bag on his back) runs through the mist. He clutches a SPINNING compass.

DUGU MU (V.O.)
My father died three days ago. His last words: "Chongming Village. The plague that wasn't a plague."

Dugu Mu stops. The compass needle STOPS—pointing at a village gate swallowed by fog. He pulls out an ANCIENT BOOK. The cover reads "Ancient Witchcraft Codex." Pages flip themselves, stopping at a diagram: a woman and man bound to an altar, bodies marked with Yin-Yang symbols.

DUGU MU (V.O.)
The codex spoke of blood rituals. Of bodies preserved beyond death. Of a bargain that marks its vessels for exactly one year.

A vision flashes: an OLD MAN with a goatee, hunched over the same book, cutting his palm.
continuation:
EXT. RAINY FOREST - NIGHT

The sky is covered with dark clouds. Thunder and lightning flash.

The Old Man stands in the pouring rain, raising both hands high. Grief and madness war on his face.

OLD MAN
Souls bewildered, Yin and Yang reversed! I will not lose her!

INT. DARK ROOM - NIGHT

The woman in red still kneels before the altar. The Old Man enters, holding a candle that trembles.

OLD MAN
(whispering)
Meimei... I heard you singing.

The woman in red slowly turns her head. Her face is pale, her eyes vacant, but her smile is knowing.

WOMAN IN RED
(voice distorted)
Father... the year is done.

The candlelight flares green. Her shadow on the wall has too many limbs.

title: Dragon King of the Heavens, Jiang Fusheng
description: Jiang Fusheng, betrayed by his half-brother and stripped of his dragon blood, survives and returns three years later as a humble village keeper with unmatched power.
context:
Title: Dragon King of the Heavens, Jiang Fusheng
Description: Jiang Fusheng, betrayed by his half-brother and stripped of his dragon blood, survives and returns three years later as a humble village keeper with unmatched power.

EXT. JIANG CLAN SACRED GROUNDS - DAY

Morning mist clings to ancient stone circles. JIANG FUSHENG (20s, proud in crimson robes) gasps, his sword trembling. Golden veins that once glowed beneath his skin are fading.

JIANG CHENJUN (late 20s, black scaled armor) circles like a wolf, his own aura crackling with stolen power. He smirks.

JIANG CHENJUN
The dragon blood's finally drained, brother. Canglan purged the last drop from your veins last night. You're just a bastard again.

JIANG FUSHENG stumbles, fingers clawing at his chest where poison still burns.

JIANG FUSHENG
(Chenjun...)
We shared the same cradle. I carried you through the Bone Tempering Valley when your legs broke.

JIANG CHENJUN's jaw tightens. He attacks—no honor, just raw fury. Their swords sing. Jiang Fusheng's blade moves with remembered grace, but slower... weaker. Chenjun's strikes carry unnatural weight.

JIANG CHENJUN
Shared? You took everything! Father's eye, the elders' hope, MY BIRTHRIGHT!

He hammers down a blow that shatters Fusheng's guard. Fusheng falls to one knee.

JIANG CHENJUN
(raising sword)
A bastard should know his place.

Fusheng's sword flashes up—not at Chenjun, but at a pendant around his neck. The chain snaps. A childhood charm falls.

FLASHBACK TO:

EXT. BONE TEMPERING VALLEY - NIGHT (10 YEARS EARLIER)

Two boys huddle in a cave. YOUNG FUSHENG (8) ties a carved dragon tooth around YOUNG CHENJUN's (6) neck.

YOUNG FUSHENG
This keeps you safe, little brother. Promise me—

YOUNG CHENJUN
—promise we'll always protect each other!

Their small hands clasp. Blood oaths in the dark.

BACK TO:

EXT. JIANG CLAN SACRED GROUNDS - DAY

JIANG CHENJUN stares at the charm in the dirt. For a heartbeat, his ferocity cracks.

JIANG FUSHENG
(breathing hard)
Leave. Just... leave.

Fusheng turns. Chenjun's eyes harden. He lunges.

The blade slides through Fusheng's back with a wet sound. No flash. No drama. Just betrayal in its purest form.

FATHER JIANG (50s, white beard stained with power) emerges from the mist with twelve BLACKROBES. Their presence warps the air.

JIANG CHENJUN
Father... the Supreme Bone is ready.

JIANG FUSHENG
(through blood)
You knew... all along...

FATHER JIANG
Every dragon needs a whetstone. Your blood awakens his potential. Your sacrifice... is complete.

His staff descends. Not on Fusheng's body—but on his dantian. The core shatters audibly. Fusheng's scream is Silent.

JIANG FUSHENG
(voice barely there)
Then I become the ghost that haunts your throne.

His eyes close. Father Jiang doesn't even look at the body.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Jiang Fusheng, heir apparent, died during the Canglan expedition. His brother inherited everything.

The Blackrobes depart. The charm lies in the dirt, swallowed by blood.

DISSOLVE TO:

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER - THE VILLAGE THAT REFUSES TO BE FOUND
continuation:
EXT. HIDDEN DRAGON VILLAGE - NIGHT

Moonlight carves the characters "Hidden Dragon" into a weathered stone arch. The characters shift if stared at too long.

A column of masked PRISON GUARDS marches MOSES—6'5", iron mask, chains that smoke with dark runes. Each step leaves scorched earth.

ON SCREEN: MOSES - SUPREME ASSASSIN, WANTED: 3,000 SPIRIT STONES

JIANG FUSHENG waits beneath the arch. Gray robes, wooden sandals. A jade token hangs at his waist—carved with the same dragon tooth pattern. His eyes are ancient lakes.

JIANG FUSHENG
State your business.

MASKED GUARD
By decree of the Sovereign, we deliver Moses to serve his sentence.

JIANG FUSHENG
The cow shed lacks a shoveler. The horse stable needs muck raked. Choose.

MOSES
(processed voice, dripping contempt)
A peasant gravekeeper dares—

He flexes. Chains explode into shrapnel. Guards scatter. Moses moves like oil over water, a blade of darkness forming in his hand.

JIANG FUSHENG doesn't move. He exhales.

The exhalation becomes a wind. The wind becomes a dragon's sigh. Moses and his men hang suspended, caught in an invisible maw that slowly... tightens.

JIANG FUSHENG
You mistake humility for helplessness. This is not a prison. It is a choice.

He flicks his wrist. They crash down—not onto earth, but into freshly tilled furrows that weren't there a moment ago.

MOSES
(terrified, gasping)

Choose.

The shovel! The shovel, my lord!

Marshal Yun... your eye...

(perfect unison)
Keeper.

Title: Dragon King of the Heavens, Jiang Fusheng
Description: Jiang Fusheng, betrayed by his half-brother and stripped of his dragon blood, survives and returns three years later as a humble village keeper with unmatched power.

EXT. JIANG CLAN SACRED GROUNDS - DAY

Morning mist clings to ancient stone circles. JIANG FUSHENG (20s, proud in crimson robes) gasps, his sword trembling. Golden veins that once glowed beneath his skin are fading.

JIANG CHENJUN (late 20s, black scaled armor) circles like a wolf, his own aura crackling with stolen power. He smirks.

JIANG CHENJUN
The dragon blood's finally drained, brother. Canglan purged the last drop from your veins last night. You're just a bastard again.

JIANG FUSHENG stumbles, fingers clawing at his chest where poison still burns.

JIANG FUSHENG
(Chenjun...)
We shared the same cradle. I carried you through the Bone Tempering Valley when your legs broke.

JIANG CHENJUN's jaw tightens. He attacks—no honor, just raw fury. Their swords sing. Jiang Fusheng's blade moves with remembered grace, but slower... weaker. Chenjun's strikes carry unnatural weight.

JIANG CHENJUN
Shared? You took everything! Father's eye, the elders' hope, MY BIRTHRIGHT!

He hammers down a blow that shatters Fusheng's guard. Fusheng falls to one knee.

JIANG CHENJUN
(raising sword)
A bastard should know his place.

Fusheng's sword flashes up—not at Chenjun, but at a pendant around his neck. The chain snaps. A childhood charm falls.

FLASHBACK TO:

EXT. BONE TEMPERING VALLEY - NIGHT (10 YEARS EARLIER)

Two boys huddle in a cave. YOUNG FUSHENG (8) ties a carved dragon tooth around YOUNG CHENJUN's (6) neck.

YOUNG FUSHENG
This keeps you safe, little brother. Promise me—

YOUNG CHENJUN
—promise we'll always protect each other!

Their small hands clasp. Blood oaths in the dark.

BACK TO:

EXT. JIANG CLAN SACRED GROUNDS - DAY

JIANG CHENJUN stares at the charm in the dirt. For a heartbeat, his ferocity cracks.

JIANG FUSHENG
(breathing hard)
Leave. Just... leave.

Fusheng turns. Chenjun's eyes harden. He lunges.

The blade slides through Fusheng's back with a wet sound. No flash. No drama. Just betrayal in its purest form.

FATHER JIANG (50s, white beard stained with power) emerges from the mist with twelve BLACKROBES. Their presence warps the air.

JIANG CHENJUN
Father... the Supreme Bone is ready.

JIANG FUSHENG
(through blood)
You knew... all along...

FATHER JIANG
Every dragon needs a whetstone. Your blood awakens his potential. Your sacrifice... is complete.

His staff descends. Not on Fusheng's body—but on his dantian. The core shatters audibly. Fusheng's scream is Silent.

JIANG FUSHENG
(voice barely there)
Then I become the ghost that haunts your throne.

His eyes close. Father Jiang doesn't even look at the body.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Jiang Fusheng, heir apparent, died during the Canglan expedition. His brother inherited everything.

The Blackrobes depart. The charm lies in the dirt, swallowed by blood.

DISSOLVE TO:

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER - THE VILLAGE THAT REFUSES TO BE FOUND

EXT. HIDDEN DRAGON VILLAGE - NIGHT

Moonlight carves the characters "Hidden Dragon" into a weathered stone arch. The characters shift if stared at too long.

A column of masked PRISON GUARDS marches MOSES—6'5", iron mask, chains that smoke with dark runes. Each step leaves scorched earth.

ON SCREEN: MOSES - SUPREME ASSASSIN, WANTED: 3,000 SPIRIT STONES

State your business.

The cow shed lacks a shoveler. The horse stable needs muck raked. Choose.

You mistake humility for helplessness. This is not a prison. It is a choice.

title: Tiger Courage, Dragon Prestige
description: A legendary warrior known as the Phoenix War God searches for her lost brother, who has been working as a delivery driver, unaware of his noble heritage.
context:
Title: Tiger Courage, Dragon Prestige
Description: A legendary warrior known as the Phoenix War God searches for her lost brother, who has been working as a delivery driver, unaware of his noble heritage.

INT. LUXURIOUS MANOR - DAY

A red carpet stretches across the manor courtyard. BODYGUARDS in black suits stand at attention. LIU MULAN strides forward, her military-green cloak billowing, every step radiating authority.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Sovereign's decree is simple: Liu Mulan, the Phoenix War God, is granted the title of King. She who turned the tide against three hundred thousand. She who commands the four seas.

ZHUQUE, sharp in leather, drops to one knee, head bowed.

ZHUQUE
Phoenix War God.

Behind her, LUO SONG (Grand Governor), SHEN WANSAN (tycoon), and SAI HUATUO (physician) follow suit, forming a semicircle of deference.

LUO SONG
Daxia recognizes its protector.

SHEN WANSAN
The markets bless this union.

SAI HUATUO
The people gain their healer.

ALL
Lord Phoenix.

LIU MULAN's gaze sweeps across them—brief, weighted acknowledgment.

LIU MULAN
Zhuque.

ZHUQUE
Your brother lives. Jiangcheng.

LIU MULAN
The night we lost him... twenty-three years. Your report says he's—?

ZHUQUE
A delivery rider. Electric scooter. Single income.

LUO SONG
(in quiet devastation)
A king's blood...

LIU MULAN
Jiangcheng. Now.

They move as one.
continuation:
EXT. PARK BENCH - DAY

LIU HUIQIANG perches on his scooter, devouring rice from a plastic container. GAO QILAN watches, smoothing his collar.

GAO QILAN
You'll choke.

LIU HUIQIANG
(still chewing)
Your soy chicken. Better than any banquet.

She offers him a thermos. He takes it, their fingers brushing.

GAO QILAN
Quit this. My uncle offered you warehouse work.

LIU HUIQIANG
And lose flexibility? Peak bonus is tonight. Three more orders, we're talking new shoes for—

GAO QILAN
—I'm not suffering. But I see you.

LIU HUIQIANG
I promised you a ceremony.

GAO QILAN
You promised to share your mapo tofu recipe. Still waiting.

His phone SCREAMS with a notification.

LIU HUIQIANG
Hospital order. 306, stat.

GAO QILAN
Don't run reds again.

LIU HUIQIANG
Only on Tuesdays.

He kisses her forehead, revs the scooter.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

LIU HUIQIANG stops at 301, three delivery bags hanging from his shoulders. He knocks.

The door opens. A MAN in a designer shirt takes the food without looking up from his phone.

LIU HUIQIANG
Mr. Chen? Two meals, no cilantro. Extra chili oil on side.

MAN
Where's my cigarettes? Premiums. I tipped for them.

LIU HUIQIANG
Platform rules prohibit tobacco. But I can redirect you to—

MAN
It's 9pm. My deadline's midnight. You think I care about your app?

LIU HUIQIANG
I care about my rating. Sir.

MAN
Then care about this: one-star unless you're back in ten minutes with exactly what I asked for.

He slams the door. LIU HUIQIANG stares at the closed door, a muscle working in his jaw.

title: Fishing Beauty Survives in a Shura Field
description: A woman's soul is transported into the body of a villainess who has simultaneously provoked multiple dangerous men, and must now survive the deadly consequences.
context:
Title: Fishing Beauty Survives in a Shura Field
Description: A woman's soul is transported into the body of a villainess who has simultaneously provoked multiple dangerous men, and must now survive the deadly consequences.

INT. LUXURIOUS BEDROOM - NIGHT

CLOSE UP on JIANG HUAZHI's fingers gliding black silk into a perfect knot.

JIANG HUAZHI (20s, sleek predator in black) ties the blindfold around YUAN HENIAN's (20s, handsome shark in white) eyes. He is sitting on the edge of a silk-draped bed.

Her touch traces his jaw. His collar. A button pops. Fabric parts. Their faces inch together. Her lips brush his neck.

Then—she freezes. The room tilts. Her breath catches wrong.

SFX: DEAFENING WHOOSH. A digital GLITCH that distorts the air.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
(filtered, clinical)
Carrier locked. Host transfer protocol engaged.

JIANG HUAZHI blinks. The bedroom sharpens into terrifying focus. Her hand—someone else's hand—still rests on his chest.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
You have transmigrated into Jiang Huazhi. Secondary antagonist. Motivation: eliminate Qiao Yan and claim her male lead collection. Methods: seduction, coercion, chemical manipulation. Status: critical failure.

Her free hand flies to her mouth.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
continuation:
Current objective: survive. Your actions have triggered three simultaneous death flags.

FLASH IMAGES: LU SIYAN kneeling in a shower, shirt soaked, fists clenched. XI JIN slumped unconscious in a supply closet, necktie gag. GU YUZHI glaring from a Ferrari dashboard, jaw tight.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Scholar Lu Siyan: currently locked in bathroom penance. Childhood friend Xi Jin: sedated and confined. Fiance Gu Yuzhi: ETA three minutes. Intent: homicide.

JIANG HUAZHI's knees buckle. She lands on the bed. A hysterical laugh bubbles out—cut short by a sob.

JIANG HUAZHI
(whispered)
Three... different... men... at once? What kind of kamikaze bimbo—

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Survival probability: 0.03%. Recommend immediate damage control.

YUAN HENIAN's hand snaps up. Yanks the blindfold down. His stare could etch glass.

YUAN HENIAN
Jiang Huazhi.

He captures her wrist. Squeezes until bone grinds.

YUAN HENIAN
(low, almost curious)
Did you truly believe I'd be the easiest to break?

END SCENE

title: Why Provoke Her? She Remarried but is the Emperor's Beloved
description: A general's wife, poisoned and humiliated in her past life, is reborn on her wedding night and vows to become the emperor's most treasured woman to avoid repeating her tragic fate.
context:
Title: Why Provoke Her? She Remarried but is the Emperor's Beloved
Description: A general's wife, poisoned and humiliated in her past life, is reborn on her wedding night and vows to become the emperor's most treasured woman to avoid repeating her tragic fate.

INT. IMPERIAL STUDY - DAY

The curtains are pulled open. QI YUAN, Emperor of the Qi Kingdom, holds General's wife XU WANNING in his embrace, their actions intimate.

XU WANNING
(breathing heavily)
Your Majesty... be gentle. This wife cannot bear it.

QI YUAN
(whispered command)
Then let him hear you break.

XU WANNING
My husband waits beyond.

QI YUAN
I should claim you there. Aning, when will you be mine alone?

XU WANNING (V.O.)
I am Xu Wanning, wife to General Yan Yuanzheng. In my past life, my sister Xu Wanyu poisoned me with Seven Month Birth. Three sons, stillborn. My husband called me barren—then had me passed among his men as final disgrace.

INT. DILAPIDATED HUT - NIGHT

XU WANNING, eight months pregnant and dressed in rags, slumps against the wall. Her clothes are bloodied around her belly. Her younger sister XU WANYU walks in, dressed luxuriously.

XU WANYU
How does failure taste, sister? Your third dead son is coming. I live for your suffering.

XU WANYU laughs and kicks XU WANNING's swollen belly.

Several men step forward and grab the struggling XU WANNING.

XU WANNING
(terrified)
Let me go! Let go—!

XU WANNING (V.O.)
I bit my tongue and died. Heaven pitied me—I woke on my wedding night, the poison still steaming in its bowl.
continuation:
INT. YAN FAMILY BEDROOM - NIGHT

XU WANNING, wearing a bright red wedding dress, wakes with a start on the bed. She sees a bowl of black medicinal soup on the table beside the bed.

NANNY LI
Madam? You cried out.

NANNY LI walks in carrying a tray with the bowl of medicine.

NANNY LI
The pregnancy tonic. Drink it hot. Tonight you must conceive.

XU WANNING
(staring at the bowl)
I've returned.

XU WANNING
The smell turns my stomach. Fetch candied fruit.

NANNY LI
Yes, Madam.

NANNY LI turns and leaves. XU WANNING picks up the medicine bowl, her eyes cold and hard.

XU WANNING (V.O.)
Not a tonic—Seven Month Birth, a yin poison that breeds life only to strangle it at seven months. I blamed my barren womb. Now I know the truth poured down my throat.

XU WANNING pours the medicine from the bowl into a nearby potted plant.

NANNY LI returns carrying candied fruit.

NANNY LI
(smiling obsequiously)
Finished, Madam?

XU WANNING
(sets down empty bowl)
Every drop.

XU WANNING picks up a piece of candied fruit and puts it in her mouth.

XU WANNING
Wouldn't want it to lose potency.

NANNY LI
Then serve the General well tonight. Conceive in one try.

NANNY LI smiles and withdraws.

XU WANNING picks up a small bronze mirror and looks at herself in it, her eyes becoming determined and ruthless.

XU WANNING (V.O.)
Serve him? My enemy will be Empress. To survive her, I must become the Emperor's treasure—the one woman he'd burn kingdoms to possess.

title: In the Eighties, Raising Children Towards a Happy Life
description: A woman who devoted her life to her husband discovers he only married her out of obligation and always loved another woman. Given a second chance, she is reborn and vows to change her fate.
context:
Title: In the Eighties, Raising Children Towards a Happy Life
Description: A woman who devoted her life to her husband discovers he only married her out of obligation and always loved another woman. Given a second chance, she is reborn and vows to change her fate.

EXT. SCHOOL GATE - DAY

SFX: 1980s-style radio broadcast and children laughing and playing.

Elementary students in red scarves stream from the concrete school building.

DING XIAOYAN, a young teacher in a red polka-dot dress with braided hair, walks out carrying books.

STUDENT
Teacher Ding, goodbye!

DING XIAOYAN
Goodbye.

DING XIAOYAN smiles and continues walking. MALE TEACHER (40s, glasses) walks over and calls to her.

MALE TEACHER
Comrade Ding.

DING XIAOYAN stops and looks at him.

MALE TEACHER
(pointing into the distance)
Deputy Director Gu has been waiting.

DING XIAOYAN looks in the direction he's pointing. GU ZHENGYAN, a young man wearing a Mao suit, is standing at the gate in the distance pushing a bicycle, his smile tentative.

GU ZHENGYAN
Xiaoyan.

MALE TEACHER
(smiling at DING XIAOYAN)
Go ahead.

MALE TEACHER turns and leaves. DING XIAOYAN stands motionless, her expression unreadable.

Two colleagues, PASSERBY A (male) and PASSERBY B (female), approach and speak to DING XIAOYAN.

PASSERBY A
Comrade Ding, the Deputy Director's devotion is the envy of everyone.

PASSERBY B
A husband like that? I'd quit teaching tomorrow.

DING XIAOYAN listens to their words, her eyes becoming distant as memory takes hold.

DING XIAOYAN (V.O.)
Everyone praised his devotion. In my last life, I believed it. Until his dying breath revealed a lifetime of lies.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Elderly GU ZHENGYAN lies in a hospital bed, his face pale. Elderly DING XIAOYAN sits beside the bed, her expression sorrowful.

GU ZHENGYAN
(weakly)
Bury me with Qianqian. She's the only one I ever loved.

Back to reality, DING XIAOYAN's eyes become cold and resolute.

GU ZHENGYAN
(shouting in DING XIAOYAN's direction)
Xiaoyan!

FAN QIANQIAN
(shyly)
Brother Zhengyan.

GU ZHENGYAN sees FAN QIANQIAN, his face showing shock and longing.

GU ZHENGYAN
Qianqian... you've returned.

DING XIAOYAN stands in the distance, watching them coldly.

DING XIAOYAN (V.O.)

FAN QIANQIAN
(eyes filling with tears)

GU ZHENGYAN looks at FAN QIANQIAN, his eyes full of guilt and deep affection. He closes his eyes and nods painfully.

GU ZHENGYAN
Yes.

DING XIAOYAN watches this scene. Then she turns and walks toward the village path, away from the gate.

GU ZHENGYAN
(still looking at Fan Qianqian)
Xiaoyan?

No answer. He glances toward the school gate. The spot where DING XIAOYAN stood is empty.

FADE OUT.

title: Sorry, I Am the Leading Lady
description: Wen Chuxia prepares to meet her boyfriend's parents with lavish gifts, only to discover his family's unexpected plans to move into her apartment.
context:
Title: Sorry, I Am the Leading Lady
Description: Wen Chuxia prepares to meet her boyfriend's parents with lavish gifts, only to discover his family's unexpected plans to move into her apartment.

INT. WEN CHUXIA'S VANITY TABLE - DAY

WEN CHUXIA applies makeup—lipstick, mascara, perfume. The mirror reflects her nervous smile.

WEN CHUXIA (V.O.)
Three months of planning. One perfect afternoon. Just breathe.

WEN ZHENNAN, Wen Chuxia's father, appears, placing a velvet jewelry box beside her cosmetics.

WEN ZHENNAN
Your mother added this. For his mother.

Several MAIDS enter carrying trays: ginseng roots, a Hermès scarf, gold-plated tea sets.

WEN CHUXIA stands, surveying the display.

WEN CHUXIA
Dad, this is... a lot.

LIN XING, Wen Chuxia's mother, enters, adjusting a gift box.

LIN XING
We want them to see how treasured you are.

WEN CHUXIA
It's too much.

LIN XING
Love only grows where respect is planted.

WEN CHUXIA and her parents embrace.

WEN CHUXIA
I will be happy.

LIN XING
(smiling)
Yes.

WEN ZHENNAN
It's time.

WEN CHUXIA
Mom, Dad, I'll be going now.

LIN XING
Yes.

WEN ZHENNAN
Go ahead.

WEN CHUXIA walks out.
continuation:
INT. WEN FAMILY LIVING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

After WEN CHUXIA leaves, the BUTLER approaches WEN ZHENNAN and LIN XING.

BUTLER
The young man's family arrived early. They're waiting by her gate.

WEN ZHENNAN
Let her write her own story.

LIN XING
And if she falls?

WEN ZHENNAN
We'll catch her.

INT. CHUXIA'S APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - DAY

WEN CHUXIA arranges the gifts on the coffee table—each placement deliberate. The doorbell RINGS.

She opens it. LIN ZIQIANG stands there, flowers in hand.

LIN ZIQIANG
Chuxia. You look—

ZIQIANG'S MOTHER pushes past him, dragging a wheeled suitcase.

ZIQIANG'S MOTHER
—tired! City life is exhausting. Good thing we're here now.

Behind her, ZIQIANG'S SISTER and NEPHEW enter, carrying duffel bags and a plastic tray of eggs.

WEN CHUXIA
(confused)
Auntie, the hotel I booked—

ZIQIANG'S MOTHER
Hotel? Nonsense. We're family.

She surveys the apartment like a general claiming territory.

ZIQIANG'S MOTHER
Ziqiang said three bedrooms? Sister takes the small one, I'll take the master, and the boy gets your study.

WEN CHUXIA
The... master?

LIN ZIQIANG
(to Chuxia, low)
She just wants to see where we'll live...

WEN CHUXIA
We?

ZIQIANG'S SISTER opens the fridge, frowning.

ZIQIANG'S SISTER
No fresh milk? Little Bin needs milk every morning.

ZIQIANG'S NEPHEW kicks off his shoes on her white sofa, leaving a muddy print.

ZIQIANG'S NEPHEW
This is my new home?

WEN CHUXIA watches the footprint sink into designer fabric. The eggs sweat on marble. The suitcase blocks her hallway.

Her phone BUZZES—her mother's text: "Everything alright?"

WEN CHUXIA doesn't answer. She just stares at LIN ZIQIANG, waiting.

He smiles that same tight smile.

LIN ZIQIANG
Mom brought her homemade quilt. For our bed.

WEN CHUXIA looks at the quilt—polyester, floral-printed, utterly wrong. Her perfect afternoon dissolves into a stranger's living room.

title: You Were Sent Undercover, But You Married the Family Heiress
description: A police officer who spent ten years undercover in a triad organization is given a second chance when he is reborn to the day he received his mission, allowing him to change the tragic fate of the woman he loves.
context:
Title: You Were Sent Undercover, But You Married the Family Heiress
Description: A police officer who spent ten years undercover in a triad organization is given a second chance when he is reborn to the day he received his mission, allowing him to change the tragic fate of the woman he loves.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

A ceiling fan slowly rotates in the dim room.

A television screen displays the news.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
The Jincheng Society, the largest triad organization in the nation, has been dismantled. Criminal leader Shen Nan was executed this morning.

On the table sits a framed photo of ZHENG CHUAN and SHEN LI together, next to a pot of black roses.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Officer Zheng Chuan, who served ten years undercover, will be awarded posthumously for his service.

Several photos hang on the wall: a solo portrait of Zheng Chuan, photos of the couple together, and a group graduation photo from the police academy.

EXT. HOSPITAL ROOFTOP - DAY

SHEN LI, wearing a white dress, stands at the rooftop edge, hollow-eyed.

ZHENG CHUAN, wearing a leather jacket, rushes onto the rooftop.

ZHENG CHUAN
(barely breathing)
Shen Li.

SHEN LI
My father was executed yesterday. My mother died this morning. Because of you.

ZHENG CHUAN
It wasn't—

SHEN LI
continuation:
You were his son. His heir. I was carrying your child. You can't quit what you never were.

ZHENG CHUAN
(desperate)
Then I'll be what you need. Just come down.

SHEN LI
We can't walk away from blood.

She falls backward. Zheng Chuan lunges, catches air.

He doesn't hesitate. He jumps.

ZHENG CHUAN (V.O.)
If I couldn't save you... I'll die with you.

They fall, separated by meters, united by momentum.

EXT. NIGHT MARKET STREET - NIGHT

A motorcycle crashes. ZHENG CHUAN flies off, landing hard.

He groans, peels a newspaper off his face. Date: February 14, 2005.

ZHENG CHUAN (V.O.)
Ten years ago. The day I accepted the mission.

He looks up. SHEN LI, young and vivid in red, walks through the crowd.

ZHENG CHUAN
(voice breaking)
Shen Li...

He reaches out. She doesn't see him.

FLASHBACK: The two falling from the high building.

title: Mr. Huo, Your Wife is a Bit Wild
description: A red-clad martial arts girl performing on an ancient-style street encounters the mysterious Mr. Huo when fate brings them together in an unexpected collision.
context:
Title: Mr. Huo, Your Wife is a Bit Wild
Description: A red-clad martial arts girl performing on an ancient-style street encounters the mysterious Mr. Huo when fate brings them together in an unexpected collision.

EXT. HERITAGE DISTRICT STREET - DAY

A GIRL IN RED, 20s, athletic and fierce, spins a long spear under a blooming peach tree. Tourists watch as petals drift down around her.

DIRECTOR (V.O.)
Action in three... two... one...

EXT. MODERN CITY STREET - DAY

MONTAGE:
- A black Porsche accelerates through afternoon traffic.
- MR. HUO (30s, sharp suit) grips the steering wheel, his luxury watch gleaming.
- His eyes, normally cold steel, now blink with disorientation.
- A motorcycle cuts across his lane.
- MR. HUO swerves, jaw clenched.

EXT. HERITAGE DISTRICT STREET - DAY

The GIRL IN RED strikes a bronze gong beside a vintage weapons rack. Tourists and locals turn.

GIRL IN RED
(shouting with practiced charm)
Witness living history, folks! Authentic martial arts from the Tianyi lineage!

She addresses the growing crowd with a performer's smile.

GIRL IN RED
They say home is where family helps, but out here, we rely on kind strangers. My family's school needs support. If you can, toss a coin. If you can't, your applause is just as valuable.

She hefts a convincing plaster "stone" above her head, preparing for her finale. The crowd murmurs with anticipation.

FEMALE TOURIST
(raising her phone)
This is incredible!
continuation:
INT. PORSCHE - DAY

MR. HUO's knuckles are white on the wheel. He blinks hard, fighting dizziness.

MR. HUO (V.O.)
(quietly)
Should've known they'd spike the toast. Never attend a "friendly" merger lunch.

EXT. HERITAGE DISTRICT STREET - DAY

A SKEPTICAL TEEN points at the stone, smirking.

SKEPTICAL TEEN
That thing's obviously fake!

The GIRL IN RED's smile doesn't falter. She locks eyes with him.

GIRL IN RED
Fake? Let's see if you can tell the difference.

She hurls the prop at him—not hard enough to hurt, but enough to startle. He stumbles back, tripping over a curb. The crowd roars approval. She winks, then collects tips in a wooden bowl while handing out cards.

GIRL IN RED
(to an elderly man)
Tianyi Martial Arts Hall offers heritage lessons. Show this card for a discount.

EXT. HERITAGE DISTRICT STREET - DAY

The GIRL IN RED counts her earnings in the shade, relief softening her features.

GIRL IN RED
(whispering)
Three months of rent. We might survive after all.

A black sedan rounds the corner too fast, screeching. Papers scatter. She whirls, planting both hands on the hood as the car halts inches away.

Through the windshield, her eyes meet MR. HUO's—his sharp with surprise, hers flashing with fury.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Marquis Lady's Rebirth
description: A woman betrayed by her husband and killed in a frozen apocalypse is reborn to the days before disaster strikes, determined to stockpile resources and seek revenge.
context:
Title: The Marquis Lady's Rebirth
Description: A woman betrayed by her husband and killed in a frozen apocalypse is reborn to the days before disaster strikes, determined to stockpile resources and seek revenge.

EXT. NINGYUAN MARQUIS MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

The manor entrance is piled high with sacks and crates. SERVANTS busily carry goods into the manor.

SERVANT A
(adjusting slipping crate)
Steady now!

SERVANT B
(grunting under weight)
What's in these? Rocks?

SERVANT C
(to Servant D)
Third delivery this morning...

STEWARD (O.S.)
Mind the porcelain! Inside, quickly!

Several MERCHANTS and LADIES stand nearby, watching with growing alarm.

ONLOOKER A
(whispering)
That's the fifth grain merchant today.

ONLOOKER B
She bought out Chen's entire fur inventory. In summer!

ONLOOKER C
The Liu family just lost their daughter to her—paid triple for a dowry's worth of silk.

INT. NINGYUAN MARQUIS MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

A MEDICINE MERCHANT rushes toward SU HUA, clutching a ledger.

MEDICINE MERCHANT
(breathless)
Lady Marquis, every herb from my shop—winter stock, fever tonics, wound salves. All delivered.

SU HUA, dressed in fine robes, holds a box filled with banknotes. She pulls out a stack without looking at the merchant.

SU HUA
The Liu Family Apothecary as well?

MEDICINE MERCHANT
(stammering)
They... they refused at first, but your price...

SU HUA places the notes in his hand and walks past, eyes fixed on the horizon.

SU HUA
Everything they have. By sundown.

The merchant bows repeatedly, backing away. The onlooking crowd erupts.

ONLOOKER D
The Liu shop too? That's half the city's medicine!

ONLOOKER E
She's emptied the granaries. What is she planning?

CLOTH SHOP OWNER
(to a companion)
She didn't even haggle. Just pointed at my most expensive furs and said 'all'.

MEDICINE MERCHANT
(joining them, wiping sweat)
Twelve years of stock. The rhubarb alone could supply an army.

CROWD
(shocked)
An army?

MEDICINE MERCHANT
(shaking his head)
In this heat? Most will spoil before autumn.

ONLOOKER F
Madness. Pure madness.

FEMALE ONLOOKER
(quietly)
They say the Marquis hasn't visited her chambers in months. Prefers that concubine from the Zhang household.

ONLOOKER G
Even grief doesn't excuse this.

ONLOOKER H
Alright, alright. Nothing to see.

The crowd gradually disperses. SU HUA stands in place, fingers trembling slightly as she touches a jade pendant at her throat.

SU HUA (V.O.)
Ten days. In ten days, this jade—and every coin I own—will be worthless. But these supplies...

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
EXT. EXECUTION GROUND - DAY

SU HUA and her family, wearing prisoner's garb, kneel in the dirt. SOLDIERS hold them at spearpoint.

SU HUA (V.O.)
The Duke of Dingguo's "treason." Ningyuan Manor implicated. Confiscated. Exiled.

NING YANSHAN emerges from the crowd, pointing at GENERAL SU.

NING YANSHAN
There! The General's seal—found in the Duke's study. Proof of their conspiracy!

GENERAL SU
(struggling against bonds)
Ning Yanshan! I treated you as a son!

NING YANSHAN
(cold)
You treated me as a fool.

The EXECUTIONER's blade rises. Blood splatters across Su Hua's cheek.

SU HUA
(screaming, voice cracking)
Father!

EXT. SNOWY ROAD - DAY

Heavy snow blankets a line of shackled prisoners. Frozen corpses dot the roadside.

SU HUA (V.O.)
We marched for ten days. Then winter came early.

A FIRE USER conjures flame, warming abusive GUARDS. An ICE USER freezes a prisoner's shackles to brittle cracking.

SU HUA (V.O.)
Some awakened. Most died.

SU HUA trudges forward, frostbitten, as prisoners collapse around her.

INT. CAVE - NIGHT

SU HUA lies weakly on frozen ground. NING YANSHAN enters with ABILITY USERS—scavengers with dead eyes.

NING YANSHAN
(to the Users)
She's General Su's daughter. Strong stock. Might survive the bonding.

ABILITY USER ONE
(grinning)
And if not?

NING YANSHAN
Then she dies like the rest.

He shoves SU HUA forward. She grabs his sleeve.

SU HUA
(whisper)
Why?

NING YANSHAN
(ripping away)
Your dowry was never enough.

The ABILITY USERS close in. SU HUA's scream echoes off stone.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. NINGYUAN MARQUIS MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

SU HUA's tears fall on the jade pendant. She closes her fist around it, then opens her hand. The pendant is gone.

SU HUA (V.O.)
Heaven gave me back the days. This time, I have the supplies. And soon—

SU HUA turns. A faint red mark glows on her forehead. She gestures. A nearby crate vanishes with a soft ripple of air.

SU HUA (V.O.)
—I will have the power.
full_script:
Title: The Marquis Lady's Rebirth
Description: A woman betrayed by her husband and killed in a frozen apocalypse is reborn to the days before disaster strikes, determined to stockpile resources and seek revenge.

EXT. NINGYUAN MARQUIS MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

The manor entrance is piled high with sacks and crates. SERVANTS busily carry goods into the manor.

SERVANT A
(adjusting slipping crate)
Steady now!

SERVANT B
(grunting under weight)
What's in these? Rocks?

SERVANT C
(to Servant D)
Third delivery this morning...

STEWARD (O.S.)
Mind the porcelain! Inside, quickly!

Several MERCHANTS and LADIES stand nearby, watching with growing alarm.

ONLOOKER A
(whispering)
That's the fifth grain merchant today.

ONLOOKER B
She bought out Chen's entire fur inventory. In summer!

ONLOOKER C
The Liu family just lost their daughter to her—paid triple for a dowry's worth of silk.

INT. NINGYUAN MARQUIS MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

A MEDICINE MERCHANT rushes toward SU HUA, clutching a ledger.

MEDICINE MERCHANT
(breathless)
Lady Marquis, every herb from my shop—winter stock, fever tonics, wound salves. All delivered.

SU HUA, dressed in fine robes, holds a box filled with banknotes. She pulls out a stack without looking at the merchant.

SU HUA
The Liu Family Apothecary as well?

MEDICINE MERCHANT
(stammering)
They... they refused at first, but your price...

SU HUA places the notes in his hand and walks past, eyes fixed on the horizon.

SU HUA
Everything they have. By sundown.

The merchant bows repeatedly, backing away. The onlooking crowd erupts.

ONLOOKER D
The Liu shop too? That's half the city's medicine!

ONLOOKER E
She's emptied the granaries. What is she planning?

CLOTH SHOP OWNER
(to a companion)
She didn't even haggle. Just pointed at my most expensive furs and said 'all'.

MEDICINE MERCHANT
(joining them, wiping sweat)
Twelve years of stock. The rhubarb alone could supply an army.

CROWD
(shocked)
An army?

MEDICINE MERCHANT
(shaking his head)
In this heat? Most will spoil before autumn.

ONLOOKER F
Madness. Pure madness.

FEMALE ONLOOKER
(quietly)
They say the Marquis hasn't visited her chambers in months. Prefers that concubine from the Zhang household.

ONLOOKER G
Even grief doesn't excuse this.

ONLOOKER H
Alright, alright. Nothing to see.

The crowd gradually disperses. SU HUA stands in place, fingers trembling slightly as she touches a jade pendant at her throat.

SU HUA (V.O.)
Ten days. In ten days, this jade—and every coin I own—will be worthless. But these supplies...

FLASHBACK:

EXT. EXECUTION GROUND - DAY

SU HUA and her family, wearing prisoner's garb, kneel in the dirt. SOLDIERS hold them at spearpoint.

SU HUA (V.O.)
The Duke of Dingguo's "treason." Ningyuan Manor implicated. Confiscated. Exiled.

NING YANSHAN emerges from the crowd, pointing at GENERAL SU.

NING YANSHAN
There! The General's seal—found in the Duke's study. Proof of their conspiracy!

GENERAL SU
(struggling against bonds)
Ning Yanshan! I treated you as a son!

NING YANSHAN
(cold)
You treated me as a fool.

The EXECUTIONER's blade rises. Blood splatters across Su Hua's cheek.

SU HUA
(screaming, voice cracking)
Father!

EXT. SNOWY ROAD - DAY

Heavy snow blankets a line of shackled prisoners. Frozen corpses dot the roadside.

SU HUA (V.O.)
We marched for ten days. Then winter came early.

A FIRE USER conjures flame, warming abusive GUARDS. An ICE USER freezes a prisoner's shackles to brittle cracking.

SU HUA (V.O.)
Some awakened. Most died.

SU HUA trudges forward, frostbitten, as prisoners collapse around her.

INT. CAVE - NIGHT

SU HUA lies weakly on frozen ground. NING YANSHAN enters with ABILITY USERS—scavengers with dead eyes.

NING YANSHAN
(to the Users)
She's General Su's daughter. Strong stock. Might survive the bonding.

ABILITY USER ONE
(grinning)
And if not?

NING YANSHAN
Then she dies like the rest.

He shoves SU HUA forward. She grabs his sleeve.

SU HUA
(whisper)
Why?

NING YANSHAN
(ripping away)
Your dowry was never enough.

The ABILITY USERS close in. SU HUA's scream echoes off stone.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. NINGYUAN MARQUIS MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

SU HUA's tears fall on the jade pendant. She closes her fist around it, then opens her hand. The pendant is gone.

SU HUA (V.O.)
Heaven gave me back the days. This time, I have the supplies. And soon—

SU HUA turns. A faint red mark glows on her forehead. She gestures. A nearby crate vanishes with a soft ripple of air.

SU HUA (V.O.)
—I will have the power.

title: Fu Beichen's Marriage Crisis
description: A wealthy CEO remarries a woman who looks identical to his enemy, only to be confronted at his wedding with the shocking news of his ex-wife's death.
context:
Title: Fu Beichen's Marriage Crisis
Description: A wealthy CEO remarries a woman who looks identical to his enemy, only to be confronted at his wedding with the shocking news of his ex-wife's death.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Today marks Jiangcheng's most anticipated event. Billionaire Fu Beichen marries Shen Mengyao, heiress of the Shen empire, in what the media calls the wedding of the century.

ON SCREEN: "Fu Beichen's Fiancée: Shen Mengyao" and "Fushi Group President: Fu Beichen"

INT. GROOM'S LOUNGE - DAY

SHEN MENGYAO, radiant in her wedding gown, finds FU BEICHEN alone with his phone.

SHEN MENGYAO
Beichen?

FU BEICHEN
(brusque)
I'm fine. Leave me.

SHEN MENGYAO
You're shaking. It's our wedding day.

FU BEICHEN
I know what day it is. Please. Just go.

SHEN MENGYAO
(faltering)
I'll be waiting.

She exits. FU BEICHEN grips his phone, staring at a message thread: "Lin Nian."

FU BEICHEN (V.O.)
Two years. You think a signature ends everything? I sent you this invitation so you'd see what you threw away. I want you to feel it.

FU BEICHEN'S ASSISTANT enters with a parcel.

FU BEICHEN'S ASSISTANT
President Fu. From Miss Lin Nian. Wedding gift.

FU BEICHEN
She didn't deliver it herself?

FU BEICHEN'S ASSISTANT
Courier. No personal note.

FU BEICHEN
Typical.

The assistant hands him a weathered black umbrella.

FU BEICHEN'S ASSISTANT
She said this was yours. Returning it.

FU BEICHEN
She kept this for ten years just to throw it back at me?

He drops it. Next, a gold bank card.

FU BEICHEN'S ASSISTANT
Seventeen million. The debt her family owed. Paid in full.

FU BEICHEN
Where did she get—

FU BEICHEN'S ASSISTANT
She didn't say.

FU BEICHEN discards the card. Finally, a small pink diary with a lock.

FU BEICHEN'S ASSISTANT
Sir... the diary. She said you'd understand.

FU BEICHEN
(cold)
Burn it. I don't want her memories in my life.

FU BEICHEN'S ASSISTANT
Yes, President.
continuation:
INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

FU BEICHEN and SHEN MENGYAO stand before the OFFICIANT.

OFFICIANT
Miss Shen Mengyao, do you take Fu Beichen as your husband, in prosperity and adversity, in abundance and want?

SHEN MENGYAO
I do.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Fu Beichen, do you take Shen Mengyao as your wife, in sickness and health, until death parts you?

FU BEICHEN sees LIN NIAN's ghostly smile in Shen Mengyao's face.

SHEN MENGYAO
(softly)
Beichen?

FU BEICHEN
I do.

OFFICIANT
Exchange the rings.

FU BEICHEN places his ring on her. As Shen Mengyao lifts his hand, the doors burst open.

MEN IN BLACK flood in. SONG YIHENG leads them.

FU BEICHEN
Song Yiheng! This is madness!

SONG YIHENG
I brought Niannian. Since you invited her.

FU BEICHEN
She chose not to come.

SONG YIHENG raises a black-and-white memorial portrait of LIN NIAN.

SONG YIHENG
She died three days ago. Cancer.

FU BEICHEN
(stricken)
No. She would've told me...

SONG YIHENG
Would she? After what you did?

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Mr. Jin, Your Wife Has Run Away With Your Daughter Again
description: A woman trapped in a loveless marriage faces betrayal and near-death, confronting her husband who never believed her cries for help.
context:
Title: Mr. Jin, Your Wife Has Run Away With Your Daughter Again
Description: A woman trapped in a loveless marriage faces betrayal and near-death, confronting her husband who never believed her cries for help.

EXT. SNOWY STAIRCASE - DAY

LU YING, wearing a white dress, walks barefoot up snow-dusted stairs. Snowflakes drift around her. Her expression is desolate as she climbs.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LU YING walks barefoot through a modern hotel room, heading toward a standalone bathtub. Without hesitation, she steps into the already-filled bathtub while still wearing her dress, then slowly lies down, letting the water submerge her body.

LU YING (V.O.)
No one wants me to live. Not even my husband of three years, who I've known for twenty-two years since childhood. Not even for her sake.

INT. DARK TUNNEL - NIGHT

FLASHBACK. LU YING sits in a dark tunnel, hands bound behind her back, mouth gagged. A MAN (KIDNAPPER) holds a phone to her mouth.

LU YING
(muffled, calling out)
Jin Beizhou! Jin Beizhou, something happened to me!

The phone screen shows an ongoing call with "JIN BEIZHOU."

JIN BEIZHOU (V.O.)
(through phone, voice tight)
Had enough of your games? Do you even remember what day it is today?

LU YING
(crying)
I'm not playing, Jin Beizhou! I'm going to die!

JIN BEIZHOU (V.O.)
(through phone)
Isn't Lu Ying the indestructible cockroach? If you really die, I'll follow you to the grave.

LU YING
(desperately)
Jin Beizhou! Jin Beizhou, no!

The KIDNAPPER hangs up the phone.

KIDNAPPER
Looks like he's not coming to save you. So you can just stay here and wait to die!

The KIDNAPPER leaves. A car drives away and the tunnel plunges into darkness. LU YING is left alone. Another car approaches from deep in the tunnel—police lights flash red and blue.

LU YING
Help! Over here! Please!
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Back to reality. LU YING is in the bathtub, her own cries for help echoing in her ears. Her phone rings on the nearby shelf. She sits up abruptly and answers.

FRIEND (V.O.)
What's wrong with you? Running away on his birthday? The announcement just dropped—Jin Meimei's pregnant. She even had the nerve to pose with your daughter at the party. People who don't know would think she's the real Mrs. Jin.

LU YING
What is it?

FRIEND (V.O.)
Jin Beizhou left the party early. Just... vanished. Babe, where's your daughter? The nanny's frantic.

LU YING
She's safe. With me.

FRIEND (V.O.)
Okay. But you must let me know if you're alright.

LU YING hangs up and numbly places the phone back on the shelf. The doorbell rings. She gets up, changes clothes, and goes to answer the door.

JIN BEIZHOU stands at the door in a brown suit, his expression cold but his jaw tight.

LU YING
Why are you here?

JIN BEIZHOU
The police report from the tunnel. I had to identify some belongings. Then I tracked the credit card.

LU YING
So you know it wasn't a game.

JIN BEIZHOU
I know you took my daughter. I know you chose today. What I don't know is why I'm still here.

LU YING
Now you can leave.

LU YING tries to close the door, but JIN BEIZHOU blocks it with his hand. He walks into the room.

JIN BEIZHOU
Lu Ying, there's a limit to playing games.

LU YING
(turning around, eyes angry)
I never had limits. Why don't you just kill me then!

LU YING glares at JIN BEIZHOU with fury, her eyes filled with determination.

title: Compete with Me on Fathers? My Dad is the Dragon Emperor!
description: The legendary Dragon Emperor discovers his wife and son are living in poverty and humiliation, and vows to return and protect them.
context:
Title: Compete with Me on Fathers? My Dad is the Dragon Emperor!
Description: The legendary Dragon Emperor discovers his wife and son are living in poverty and humiliation, and vows to return and protect them.

EXT. ABANDONED FACTORY EXTERIOR - NIGHT

Night shrouds a dilapidated factory. Broken windows breathe cold air.

INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT

White-clad soldiers clash with black-clad raiders. Steel rings against steel.

Two FEMALE ASSASSINS in black leather cut through three soldiers with synchronized precision.

A SKULL-MASKED LEADER charges with a greatsword. They drop him with a leg sweep—he crashes, clutching his hamstring.

Through the smoke, THE GRIM REAPER emerges, scythe blade gleaming. The assassins attack. He deflects both with a single spin, sending them sprawling.

GRIM REAPER
(chuckling low)

GRIM REAPER
Pests.

The ceiling EXPLODES. A figure in GOLDEN ARMOR crashes down, GREEN DRAGON CRESCENT BLADE catching the light. CHU ZHANTIAN lands in a crouch.

He rises. One swing—three raiders fall. Another—two more.

GRIM REAPER
Identity?

CHU ZHANTIAN
A dragon among men. An emperor among dragons.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
(gasping)
Dragon... Emperor?

GRIM REAPER
Impossible! You vanished—

CHU ZHANTIAN
My domain is inviolate. Choose your death.

Grim Reaper charges. Their blades meet—his shatters. A red line appears on his throat. He drops.

The assassins throw down their weapons, crawling forward.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
We were forced! Please—let us serve—

CHU ZHANTIAN
Service requires honor.

His blade flashes. The assassins collapse.
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - LATER

Bodies litter the concrete. CHU ZHANTIAN stands motionless. QINGLONG drops from above, one knee down, tablet extended.

QINGLONG
Emperor. The Northern Seal has finally lifted. Your family—

CHU ZHANTIAN
Where?

QINGLONG
Jinghai. Construction site and West Market.

On the tablet: a woman hauling bricks, a young man gutting fish.

CHU ZHANTIAN's knuckles whiten on his blade.

CHU ZHANTIAN
(quietly, dangerously)
Five years holding the demon gate... and this is their "protection"?

QINGLONG
The seal hid them from our enemies. And our eyes.

CHU ZHANTIAN
Summon them all. Every. Single. One.

EXT. CITY BUILDING - DAY

A skyscraper buckles inward. Windows cascade downward.

INT. MARKET - DAY

Fluorescent lights hum over fish scales. CHU XIAOQIANG, frayed apron tied tight, guts fish with mechanical precision. LIN XUEYAO counts worn bills.

CHU XIAOQIANG
Another month. We'll have it.

LIN XUEYAO
You're getting faster.

She wipes concrete dust from his cheek. He catches her hand.

CHU XIAOQIANG
Your father's offer—

LIN XUEYAO
—is still refused.

Behind them, MOTHER hauls ice buckets, her back permanently bent.

THUG
(O.S.)
Move it, stink-fish.

Two FLORAL-SHIRT THUGS kick the stall. Fish spill across concrete.

THUG
Boss Huang's spot. Rent's due.

The second thug grabs LIN XUEYAO's wrist.

THUG 2
Nice hands for a fish-monger's girl. Boss Huang needs a secretary.

CHU XIAOQIANG's knife SLAMS into the wood—quivering. For an instant, his eyes flash with something... not quite human.

CHU XIAOQIANG
Let. Her. Go.

The thugs laugh. The knife's handle cracks under his fingers.

description: A betrayed noblewoman loses everything to her scheming sisters, but after a tragic death, her body is taken over by a modern warrior who vows to reclaim what was stolen and exact revenge.

Title: Peerless Cute Baby: Genius Mother is Stunning
Description: A betrayed noblewoman loses everything to her scheming sisters, but after a tragic death, her body is taken over by a modern warrior who vows to reclaim what was stolen and exact revenge.

INT. UNDERWATER - DAY

YE CHUYUE and YE MOHAN embrace in a desperate kiss beneath the water. She struggles weakly, her eyes glazed—drugged.

INT. CAVE - DAY

YE NINGYAN holds a candle, leading CROWN PRINCE XUANYUAN CHEN and several HANDMAIDENS into a misty cave.

YE NINGYAN
Crown Prince, over here! Third Sister!

YE NINGYAN walks to the edge of a pool and looks at YE CHUYUE, whose clothes are disheveled and who appears disoriented.

YE NINGYAN
(voice trembling)
Third Sister... you were betrothed to the Crown Prince. How could you...

XUANYUAN CHEN looks at YE CHUYUE with fury.

XUANYUAN CHEN
You. I will destroy your face. Let's see your shame then.

XUANYUAN CHEN casts a spell. A pink beam of light strikes YE CHUYUE's face.

YE CHUYUE
(in pain)
The tea... it was you...

YE CHUYUE touches her bleeding face, consumed by agony.

YE CHUYUE
My face! My face! Ah!

TRANSITION: EIGHT MONTHS LATER
continuation:
EXT. SEPARATE COURTYARD - NIGHT

YE CHUYUE, heavily pregnant, cries out in pain in the courtyard.

YE CHUYUE
Someone! Is anyone there! I'm going into labor!

YE RUOXUE slowly approaches, carrying a lantern.

YE CHUYUE
Elder Sister, please help me, my child...

YE RUOXUE
Don't be afraid, Third Sister. The pain will end soon. Let me help you.

YE RUOXUE suddenly reveals a vicious expression and casts a spell. A green light is extracted from YE CHUYUE's body and flows into her own hand.

YE CHUYUE
(screaming)
My cultivation! My core!

YE RUOXUE
Ye Chuyue, your mother stole my mother's position. You stole my status. This is what you owe me.

YE RUOXUE
(continuing to cast the spell)
A divine root, wasted on a whore's body. Better I take it, to please... him.

YE RUOXUE laughs maniacally as she completely absorbs YE CHUYUE's cultivation.

YE CHUYUE
(in agony)
Go to hell...

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Once heaven's favored child. Framed by a sister, face destroyed by my fiancé, dantian crippled, martial root stolen. How tragic... this life.

TRANSITION: FIVE YEARS LATER

EXT. STREET - DAY

XUANYUAN CHEN rides a white horse, leading a wedding procession with gongs and drums, very lively.

INT. TAVERN - DAY

YE CHUYUE stands on the second floor of a tavern, watching the procession below. Her face is hidden by a veil.

YE CHUYUE (V.O.)
Xuanyuan Chen. Today, you die.

YE CHUYUE leaps from the building and crashes heavily to the ground, blood flowing everywhere. Her veil falls away, revealing her scarred face.

PASSERBY A
Look, the Ye family's fool jumped off the building!

PASSERBY B
Seeking death by jumping! She must be jealous that the Crown Prince is getting married!

PASSERBY A
Her death is a small matter, but she'll bring misfortune to the Ye family!

MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)
Your hatred... I accept. Phoenix Flame, awaken.

A mysterious power flows into YE CHUYUE's body. Her eyes emit golden light.

YE CHUYUE slowly opens her eyes and rises from the ground.

YE CHUYUE (V.O.)
I'm not dead. I am the Ancient Martial Sect Master of the 23rd century. I died purging traitors. Instead...

YE CHUYUE stands up, her eyes becoming sharp and fierce.

YE CHUYUE (V.O.)
Since I've taken this body, I will repay your vengeance tenfold.

title: Countdown to National Ruin, Little Princess's Thoughts Save the Emperor
description: A girl transmigrates into a novel as a cannon fodder princess about to be executed by a tyrant emperor, but discovers he can hear her inner thoughts.
context:
Title: Countdown to National Ruin, Little Princess's Thoughts Save the Emperor
Description: A girl transmigrates into a novel as a cannon fodder princess about to be executed by a tyrant emperor, but discovers he can hear her inner thoughts.

EXT. PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

LU JUNZHOU, the King of Chu, walks with a grave expression. He wears magnificent black and gold court robes and holds prayer beads in his hand.

A little girl with double buns, LU ZHAZHAO, kneels on the stone pavement. Her face is smudged with dirt, her eyes confused. In front of her on the ground lies a shattered jade pendant.

LU JUNZHOU stands on the steps, looking down at LU ZHAZHAO. Two GUARDS stand on either side of her.

LU JUNZHOU
(coldly)
The tribute from Loyalty Province. Destroyed by your carelessness.

LU JUNZHOU
(coldly)
Take her. Beheading at dawn.

LU ZHAZHAO (V.O.)
I've read this scene. The pendant... the tyrant... the execution at dawn.

The two GUARDS step forward and grab LU ZHAZHAO by the arms, dragging her away.

LU ZHAZHAO (V.O.)
Page three. I'm the princess who dies on page three.

LU ZHAZHAO
(screaming)
Wait!

LU ZHAZHAO breaks free from the guards and rushes toward LU JUNZHOU.

LU ZHAZHAO
(urgently)
continuation:
Father Emperor, the artisans can repair it! Just give me—

LU JUNZHOU
You think I tolerate you because of blood? You've disgraced the crown. Take her.

LU JUNZHOU turns around, his back to LU ZHAZHAO.

LU ZHAZHAO (V.O.)
Seven days. The ancestral rites. He collapses then. I just need to survive...

LU JUNZHOU pauses mid-step, as if hearing something. He tilts his head slightly.

LU JUNZHOU
(puzzled)
What voice is this?

LU ZHAZHAO (V.O.)
Once he's dead, the siege begins. Survive him. That's all.

LU JUNZHOU
(internally, surprised)
Inner thoughts?

LU ZHAZHAO
(shouting)
Seven days! Grant me seven days and I'll restore the pendant!

LU ZHAZHAO (V.O.)
Please. Let his pride be as monstrous as the book promised.

LU JUNZHOU whips around, his sharp gaze fixed on LU ZHAZHAO.

LU JUNZHOU
(commanding loudly)
Stop.

title: Heaven-Sent Divine Healer
description: A young healer who has mastered the ancient Tianxing Medical Canon descends from the mountain to the modern world to find his fiancée and face his destiny.
context:
Title: Heaven-Sent Divine Healer
Description: A young healer who has mastered the ancient Tianxing Medical Canon descends from the mountain to the modern world to find his fiancée and face his destiny.

INT. ETHEREAL SPACE - DAY

XIAO TIANYI sits cross-legged, surrounded by flowing energy. Five figures in RED MASKS circle him - each mask bears a different suffering expression: Pain, Fever, Delusion, Decay, Death. They whisper fragments of symptoms.

The figure of Pain reaches out. Tianyi touches it. Light flows from his fingers; the mask cracks, revealing peace beneath.

MASTER (65), weathered and blindfolded, sits opposite him.

MASTER
The seventh realm isn't about resisting distraction. It's about seeing that every poison is medicine misapplied. Your skill is proven. But can you heal what cannot be seen?

Tianyi's fingers tremble. The energy stutters.

MASTER (CONT'D)
Go. Find what the books couldn't teach you.

Tianyi opens his eyes. They shimmer with acupuncture points pulsing beneath the skin. He bows.

XIAO TIANYI
I will return with answers... or not at all.

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

XIAO TIANYI navigates the sidewalk, his long hair tied with a worn jade ornament. He stops at a crosswalk, confused. A DELIVERY SCOOTER nearly clips him - Tianyi sidesteps with inhuman speed, hand instinctively forming a needle-holding gesture.

His phone buzzes. He taps it awkwardly.

SENIOR SISTER (V.O.)
Tianyi? I felt the mountain's energy shift. You're really—?

XIAO TIANYI
(into phone)
Where is she?

A group of TEENAGE GIRLS film him. One waves.

SENIOR SISTER (V.O.)
Third People's Hospital, VIP wing. But Tianyi, the modern world sees a boy, not a master.

XIAO TIANYI
Then I'll show them what I see.
continuation:
EXT. BUS STOP - DAY

XIAO TIANYI studies a digital bus schedule, brow furrowed. The display glitches— his reflection shows ancient robes for a heartbeat before returning to normal.

GIRL A (16), uniformed, nudges her friend.

GIRL A
Ask him. He's obviously foreign—

GIRL B
(approaching)
Need help with the app?

XIAO TIANYI
(to the schedule)
This "delayed." Is that a spiritual blockage?

GIRL B
(puzzled)
Just traffic—

XIAO TIANYI
Mundane obstruction. I understand.

His phone shows a map with a pulsing red marker: "GU RUOXUE - CRITICAL."

XIAO TIANYI (CONT'D)
Thank you, but I cannot wait for things merely delayed.

He walks away. The bus arrives.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

XIAO TIANYI runs, passing a room where a CHILD cries. His hand twitches toward his empty sleeve.

From behind a door marked "VIP WARD CONSULTATION":
DOCTOR (O.S.)
Mr. Gu, her neural pathways are degrading in patterns we've never—

OLD GU (O.S.)
(yelling)
I don't pay for "we've never!" I pay for answers!

The camera pans across a door sign: "VIP WARD - AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY."

INT. VIP WARD - DAY

GU RUOXUE (22) lies still, skin translucent. Her fingers clutch a half-finished sketch of a mountain landscape - the peaks match Tianyi's home. A jade bracelet pulses faintly in rhythm with Tianyi's heartbeat.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

OLD GU (60s, salt-and-pepper hair, bespoke suit soaked with sweat) looms over a shattered water glass. Two DOCTORS cower. A NURSE holds a tablet showing a brain scan lit like a star map.

OLD GU
(voice ragged)
That's my daughter's mind turning against her body in ways your textbooks never imagined.

DOCTOR 1
The neurological degeneration is—we're consulting specialists—

OLD GU
Consult faster.

He notices Tianyi in the doorway. Their eyes meet - Old Gu pauses.

BODYGUARD
Wait! This is the VIP ward area, you cannot enter.

XIAO TIANYI
I'm here to find my fiancée. Her name is Gu Ruoxue.

BODYGUARD
Sure you are, kid. Move—

XIAO TIANYI
(quietly, to Old Gu)
Her jade is calling. Let me answer.

Old Gu's hand flies to his own jade pendant - it warms against his chest. He stares at Tianyi's hands: perfectly steady, fingertips marked with faint, ancient needle scars.

OLD GU
(to bodyguards)
Let him pass.

The bodyguards part. Tianyi steps forward, his shadow falling across Ruoxue's doorway — but the shadow is shaped like a healer's mountain peak.
