title: She Gave Birth But Her Ex-Husband Claims He's Celibate
description: After the death of the family matriarch, a wealthy heir prepares to abandon his intellectually disabled wife and unborn twins, unaware of the danger lurking around them.
context:
Title: She Gave Birth But Her Ex-Husband Claims He's Celibate
Description: After the death of the family matriarch, a wealthy heir prepares to abandon his intellectually disabled wife and unborn twins, unaware of the danger lurking around them.

EXT. BEIJING CITY - DAY

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Beijing's financial magnate, Madam Qin, passed away April 15th, 2024, at eighty-six. Her grandson, Qin Wangyan, now fully controls Qin Financial Group. Though rumors persist about his marriage, his wife's identity remains unconfirmed as the funeral approaches.

A black sedan crosses a bridge, stopping before a traditional Chinese mansion.

QIN WANGYAN, thirty, pristine suit, jaw tight, exits. He doesn't look back.

Across the courtyard, XIA WANQING, elegant in black, hand resting on her barely-there bump, watches with a smile that doesn't reach her eyes.

XIA WANQING (V.O.)
The dragon's finally dead. Nothing stands between Wangyan and me now.

INT. MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

White chrysanthemums blanket the hall. OLD MADAM QIN's portrait watches from above.

QIN WANGYAN sits alone, eyes hollow. He touches the frame once, then turns away.

On a side table, a document: "Divorce Agreement."

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

QIN NIANWAN, twenty-two, twin braids, a fading scar on her temple, moves carefully with her full-term belly. She carries a soup bowl, concentrating hard on each step.

QIN NIANWAN
(excitedly)
Wangyan home!

QIN WANGYAN
Come here.

QIN NIANWAN
(offering bowl)
Soup! Make you strong.

QIN WANGYAN takes it, sets it down untouched. He guides her to the sofa.

QIN WANGYAN
Sit.

She obeys, smiling. He picks up the divorce papers, hands them over.

QIN NIANWAN
What's this?

She turns pages upside down, squinting.

QIN NIANWAN
Too many words.

QIN WANGYAN
Sign your name. Here. Like I taught you.

Her face lights up. She takes the pen, tongue between teeth, copying each stroke with painstaking care.

QIN NIANWAN
Qin... Nian... Wan. Done, Wangyan!

QIN WANGYAN takes the papers, can't look at her. He calls his assistant.

QIN WANGYAN
Qin Chao?

QIN CHAO enters, eyes downcast.

QIN CHAO
Master. The hotel staff—nurse, doctor, nanny—everything's ready. As requested.

QIN CHAO
(quieter)
The twins come in five weeks. Sending her away now...

QIN WANGYAN
She'll want for nothing. I promised Grandmother. That's all that matters.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

OLD MADAM QIN, frail, grips a MASTER's arm. On the bed, QIN WANGYAN lies still, monitors beeping.

OLD MADAM QIN
Three months. The doctors do nothing. You swear this works?

MASTER
The girl has imperfect understanding, but her fortune runs deep. She matches Third Master's chart. It is... your best chance.

OLD MADAM QIN
Then we marry them tonight.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

QIN NIANWAN in oversized wedding red, clutching the bedpost. QIN WANGYAN's eyes flutter open.

OLD MADAM QIN
(tears falling)
She did it. You woke. You owe her your life, Wangyan. Remember this.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

QIN NIANWAN
Where we going, Wangyan?

QIN WANGYAN
You wanted snow. Qin Chao's taking you to Xiangshan. Hot springs. Snow.

QIN NIANWAN
You come too?

QIN WANGYAN
Soon. Wait for me there.

QIN NIANWAN
(jumping up)
Promise?

QIN WANGYAN nods. She runs upstairs, humming. He watches until she's gone, then crumples the divorce papers in his fist.

EXT. HOT SPRING HOTEL COURTYARD - NIGHT

Snow falls, thick. QIN NIANWAN stands alone, shivering, looking up at the dark windows.

QIN WANGYAN watches from a second-floor balcony, a shadow.

XIA WANQING appears beside QIN NIANWAN, umbrella shielding her from snow.

XIA WANQING
Waiting for someone?

QIN NIANWAN
Wangyan comes soon.

XIA WANQING
The funeral's over. The contract's fulfilled. Blessing marriages don't last, little sister.

QIN NIANWAN
We promised!

XIA WANQING
A promise to a simpleton doesn't count. Neither do children that shouldn't exist. Move.

She steps closer. QIN NIANWAN stumbles back, protecting her belly.

XIA WANQING turns to her SUBORDINATE, barely visible in the snowfall.

XIA WANQING
The room?

SUBORDINATE
Prepared. Third floor. Quiet.

XIA WANQING (V.O.)
Some accidents happen before the snow melts.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

OLD MADAM QIN, frail, grips a MASTER's arm. On the bed, QIN WANGYAN lies still, monitors beeping.

OLD MADAM QIN
Three months. The doctors do nothing. You swear this works?

MASTER
The girl has imperfect understanding, but her fortune runs deep. She matches Third Master's chart. It is... your best chance.

OLD MADAM QIN
Then we marry them tonight.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

QIN NIANWAN in oversized wedding red, clutching the bedpost. QIN WANGYAN's eyes flutter open.

OLD MADAM QIN
(tears falling)
She did it. You woke. You owe her your life, Wangyan. Remember this.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

QIN NIANWAN
Where we going, Wangyan?

QIN WANGYAN
You wanted snow. Qin Chao's taking you to Xiangshan. Hot springs. Snow.

QIN NIANWAN
You come too?

QIN WANGYAN
Soon. Wait for me there.

QIN NIANWAN
(jumping up)
Promise?

QIN WANGYAN nods. She runs upstairs, humming. He watches until she's gone, then crumples the divorce papers in his fist.

EXT. HOT SPRING HOTEL COURTYARD - NIGHT

Snow falls, thick. QIN NIANWAN stands alone, shivering, looking up at the dark windows.

QIN WANGYAN watches from a second-floor balcony, a shadow.

XIA WANQING appears beside QIN NIANWAN, umbrella shielding her from snow.

XIA WANQING
Waiting for someone?

QIN NIANWAN
Wangyan comes soon.

XIA WANQING
The funeral's over. The contract's fulfilled. Blessing marriages don't last, little sister.

QIN NIANWAN
We promised!

XIA WANQING
A promise to a simpleton doesn't count. Neither do children that shouldn't exist. Move.

She steps closer. QIN NIANWAN stumbles back, protecting her belly.

XIA WANQING turns to her SUBORDINATE, barely visible in the snowfall.

XIA WANQING
The room?

SUBORDINATE
Prepared. Third floor. Quiet.

XIA WANQING (V.O.)
Some accidents happen before the snow melts.

title: Where to Find You Upon Descending the Mountain
description: A young woman fleeing her master encounters an unconscious man in the forest. Five years later, her act of kindness has unexpected consequences.
context:
Title: Where to Find You Upon Descending the Mountain
Description: A young woman fleeing her master encounters an unconscious man in the forest. Five years later, her act of kindness has unexpected consequences.

INT. FOREST - NIGHT

A dead campfire.

In the background, SONG YIN (20s) lies beside the unconscious GU HENG (20s). She suddenly wakes with a start, sitting up with a confused and frightened expression.

SONG YIN (V.O.)
Oh heavens, I only stole three fish and two chickens from my master, did you really have to deliver a corpse to my side?

She checks her bamboo basket frantically, then notices GU HENG's ashen face. Her fingers hover near his neck, checking for a pulse. She exhales in relief.

SONG YIN (V.O.)
Alive then. For now.

SONG YIN discovers an exquisite jade pendant on the ground, glowing faintly. She picks it up to examine it.

SONG YIN
What's this?

She looks at the jade pendant, then at GU HENG, as if realizing something.

SONG YIN
Didn't I say that caring for a man brings bad luck for a lifetime, and spending money on a man brings bad luck for three lifetimes? I can't let you latch onto me.

She tosses the jade pendant back onto GU HENG.

SONG YIN
Here, take it back. We have no karmic debt.

SONG YIN stands up to leave, but hesitates. Her gaze lingers on Gu Heng's pale face. She takes a chicken and a fish from the bamboo basket beside her.

SONG YIN
I'm being righteous enough. Fish, chicken.

She places the fish and chicken on GU HENG's body.

SONG YIN
Payment given, we're even, never to meet again.

As she turns, GU HENG's hand twitches, almost touching her sleeve. Song Yin doesn't notice.
continuation:
SONG YIN picks up her bamboo basket, turns, and runs off.

After she leaves, the pendant PULSES. The fish and chicken emit a strange glow, transforming into the shapes of a dragon and phoenix. The light flows into GU HENG's body. In the distance, OLD MAN SHEN (60s, white hair and long beard) quietly observes everything. He nods, as if a long wait has ended.

GU HENG suddenly wakes with a start, discovering a chicken perched on his chest. He sits up, confused, clutching the pendant.

GU HENG
My dream last night wasn't fake.

He stands up, holding the chicken in one hand and the fish in the other, and sees the jade pendant SONG YIN dropped on the ground.

GU HENG
But this... this was given freely.

He pockets the pendant deliberately.

CUT TO:

ON SCREEN: Five Years Later

EXT. THATCHED HUT - DAY

A large pot simmers with chicken soup, steam rising.

Two children (a boy and a girl, about 5 years old) lean over the pot, drooling with desire. They both wear simple jade pendants identical to the one from the forest.

BOY
Mommy, it's so good.

SONG YIN (O.S.)
Quiet, darling, we're sneaking a taste.

The wooden door of the thatched hut is pushed open. OLD MAN SHEN walks out.

OLD MAN SHEN
So, you do know you're sneaking a taste.

The two children and SONG YIN (off-screen) all look up in alarm.

SONG YIN (O.S.)
Master! I thought you were meditating until sundown!

OLD MAN SHEN
The dragon and phoenix in the soup told me otherwise.

title: After Leaving with Nothing, I Build Wealth with My Sister-in-Law
description: A delivery man betrayed by his wife is given a second chance when a mysterious system appears, offering him choices that will change his destiny.
context:
Title: After Leaving with Nothing, I Build Wealth with My Sister-in-Law
Description: A delivery man betrayed by his wife is given a second chance when a mysterious system appears, offering him choices that will change his destiny.

INT. RENTAL APARTMENT - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: RENTAL APARTMENT

A cramped studio apartment. Delivery bags and beer cans cover the floor. LIN FENG, mid-30s, in a worn delivery jacket, staggers through the door, clutching a half-empty bottle.

LIN FENG (V.O.)
Three years. Two jobs. One big mistake.

A FIGURE moves in the kitchen. Lin Feng tenses.

LIN FENG
(slurred)
Couldn't wait to finish the job?

He lurches forward, grabbing the figure's shoulder. She SPINS—it's QU YI, 30s, weary-faced.

LIN FENG
(grabbing)
Yan—

QU YI
(sharp, scared)
Lin Feng, stop! It's me!

He freezes—recognition dawning. He releases her immediately.

LIN FENG
(horror)
Qu Yi? I thought—

QU YI
That I'd rob you? Look around.

She gestures at the sparse apartment, then steadies her breathing.

LIN FENG
(stumbling back)
I'm sorry. The light was on, I just—

QU YI
Your cousin would want me to check.

She moves to the stove, dishes noodles into a bowl.

QU YI
You missed the hearing.

LIN FENG
Didn't seem the point.

She sets the bowl down on the table, then hesitates.
continuation:
QU YI
We're still family, Lin Feng.

She leaves. The door clicks shut.

QU YI (V.O.)
Arranged engagement. Before he died. Never formally dissolved.

Lin Feng slumps into a chair, lighting a cigarette. His eyes find a wedding photo—him and YAN DONGPING, smiling.

LIN FENG
(to the photo)
Your mother's debts. Your sister's tuition. I carried it all.

He exhales smoke.

LIN FENG
Then you carried him into my bed.

He slams his palm down. The cigarette ASH flares.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Resentment threshold critical. God-Level Choice System activating.

A holographic interface materializes.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Select your trajectory.

OPTION 1: Reclaim your losses. Reward: 10 million RMB.
OPTION 2: Transcend the past. Reward: Maybach 600 + Executive Network Access.

LIN FENG
(surprised)
A system?

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Choose, Host.

Lin Feng stares at the photo, then at the steaming noodles.

LIN FENG
She can have the money. I'll take freedom.

He taps Option 2.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Trajectory locked. Assets dispatched.

A black card and invitation materialize: "Executive Gala - Claim Your Vehicle."

Lin Feng picks them up, his hands trembling. He stands, shoulders straightening for the first time in months.

LIN FENG
(thrilled)
Time to enjoy life.

title: Marriage Ad on Electric Pole Turns Out to Be Beautiful Boss
description: Su Han discovers he has a superpower that turns fake things into reality, leading him to respond to a suspicious marriage advertisement.
context:
Title: Marriage Ad on Electric Pole Turns Out to Be Beautiful Boss
Description: Su Han discovers he has a superpower that turns fake things into reality, leading him to respond to a suspicious marriage advertisement.

INT. SU HAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

Su Han lies in bed, his gaunt face lit by a cheap phone screen. A fan whirs in the corner. Overdue bills are stacked on a crate serving as a nightstand.

SU HAN (V.O.)
My name is Su Han. I've been scammed by online romance, phone fraud, and job scams. But from now on, I will never be scammed again. If anyone tries to deceive me, their lies will become true. Starting today, I will marry a rich and beautiful woman and reach the peak of my life!

Su Han jerks awake, gasping. He checks his phone—3:47 AM.

SU HAN
(whispering)
A dream... it had to be.

His thumb hovers over a "Red Envelope Game" scam app. He taps it. The screen glitches. Then—DING! DING! DING! Bank notifications cascade down the screen.

SU HAN
(stunned)
It worked... it actually worked.

Su Han scrambles out of bed.

SU HAN
(shouting)
Finally! My turn!
continuation:
A notification pops up: "Security alert: Irregular activity. Account suspended."

Su Han's face falls. He stares at the screen, then laughs—a hollow, desperate sound.

SU HAN
Right. Too easy.

He tosses the phone on his pillow. It lands face-up on a cached screenshot: "Lonely female CEO seeks healthy male for marriage."

Su Han's breath catches. He slowly picks up the phone.

SU HAN
Healthy. Male. Age 28.

A dangerous smile crosses his face.

SU HAN
Let's test this properly.

INT. SHEN RUMENG'S HOME - DAY

A sharp-eyed woman in a black silk robe, SHEN RUMENG, sits on a leather sofa. Her phone rings—"Unknown Caller" flashes on screen. Beside her, a printed copy of the same marriage ad.

SHEN RUMENG
(answering)
This is Shen Rumeng. You have thirty seconds.

title: Family Forces Me to Take the Blame for Ten Years for Adopted Son
description: A man returns to his birth family after ten years, only to be forced to take the blame for a crime committed by his adopted brother.
context:
Title: Family Forces Me to Take the Blame for Ten Years for Adopted Son
Description: A man returns to his birth family after ten years, only to be forced to take the blame for a crime committed by his adopted brother.

INT. YUAN FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

A television news broadcast is playing.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Special report: A serious fire has broken out in the new district. According to sources, police are naming Yuan Yu, son of the Yuan family, as a person of interest.

YUAN MOTHER holds the trembling YUAN JUN protectively. YUAN FATHER sits rigid, his expression grave. The family watches in tense silence.

YUAN YU rushes into the living room.

YUAN YU
The police just called. You told them it was me?

YUAN SHUANG stands to the side and slams down her cup.

YUAN SHUANG
A-Jun didn't mean for this to happen. He needs help, not prison.

YUAN SHUANG
(pausing)
You can survive this. He can't.
continuation:
YUAN YU
(in disbelief)
What?

YUAN FATHER stands up from the sofa and walks over to YUAN YU.

YUAN FATHER
It's okay, son.

YUAN FATHER
That's why it has to be you. He wouldn't last.

YUAN MOTHER
(holding YUAN JUN, speaking to YUAN YU)
A-Yu, please. It's only until we sort this out.

YUAN YU
(emotionally agitated)
Dad, Mom, Sis... I'm your biological son. Ten years I waited to come home. And him? He's—

YUAN FATHER suddenly slaps YUAN YU across the face.

YUAN FATHER
You ungrateful bastard.

YUAN YU covers his face, looking at his father in shock.

title: Limited Marriage Spoiling, Iceberg Daddy's Wife-Doting Daily Life
description: A hotel worker discovers she's pregnant with twins after a one-night encounter. Five years later, she crosses paths again with the wealthy CEO father of her children.
context:
Title: Limited Marriage Spoiling, Iceberg Daddy's Wife-Doting Daily Life
Description: A hotel worker discovers she's pregnant with twins after a one-night encounter. Five years later, she crosses paths again with the wealthy CEO father of her children.

INT. HOTEL OFFICE - DAY

GAO MINGYUAN sits behind his desk, looking at an ultrasound report with a surprised expression.

XIA NIAN stands opposite him, her expression calm.

GAO MINGYUAN
Twins. That's... statistically impressive.

GAO MINGYUAN pushes the report across the desk.

GAO MINGYUAN
I assume this is why you're resigning?

XIA NIAN
(touching her belly)
High-risk pregnancy. Doctor's orders for bed rest.

GAO MINGYUAN
Summer job, Xia Wei's recommendation?

(beat)
She left last month. Found herself a wealthy boyfriend.

(leaning forward)
Will the father be providing?

XIA NIAN
(quietly evasive)
The father won't be a factor.

FLASHBACK MONTAGE - INT. HOTEL SUITE - NIGHT

SUBTITLE: One month ago

XI YAOTING (V.O.)
A staff member who doesn't know her place.

XIA NIAN (wearing her staff uniform) feels her body burning up, swaying unsteadily.

XIA NIAN
(to herself)
That water Xia Wei gave me... something's off.

XI YAOTING stands by the window, looking at the snowy scene outside.

XIA NIAN stumbles toward him.

XIA NIAN
(weakly)
Please... I need help.

XI YAOTING turns around. Their eyes meet. He hesitates, then moves closer.
continuation:
INT. XIA NIAN'S HOME - DAY

SUBTITLE: Five years later

The door opens. XIA NIAN enters with a pair of boy-girl twins, TIANTIAN and MIMI.

XIA NIAN
Tiantian, Mimi, Mommy has a late shift tonight. Be good for Grandma?

MIMI
We'll be angels!

TIANTIAN
Can we have one more cartoon?

XIA NIAN
(smiling)
One. Then straight to bed.

LU AIMEI sits on the sofa, video chatting with LIU JINHUA on her phone.

LU AIMEI
(to the phone)
...wedding in the Maldives. So exclusive.

(ends call, to Xia Nian)
Xia Wei's mother. Her daughter's set for life.

LU AIMEI
(continuing)
You work double shifts, exhausting yourself. Xia Wei? She sleeps in, shops, lives in luxury.

XIA NIAN
(firmly)
We're fine on our own terms. That's what matters.

MIMI
Mommy's strong!

TIANTIAN
Superhero strong!

LU AIMEI
(dismissively)
Superheroes burn out.

XIA NIAN
Then we rise from the ashes. That's our family motto.

INT. OT CLUB - NIGHT

The bar is filled with flashing lights and loud music.

XI YAOTING and his friend LIN CHUAN sit in a booth.

XI YAOTING
You insisted on this place because...?

LIN CHUAN
You've been a ghost for five years! Since that hotel night—

XI YAOTING
Don't.

LIN CHUAN
(leaning closer)
You keep her in that mansion like a shrine. Never visit.

XI YAOTING
(coldly)
I have my reasons.

LIN CHUAN
Reasons or regrets?

DJ (O.S.)
Next, please welcome our resident singer, Xia Nian!

XI YAOTING hears the name and freezes.

XIA NIAN, wearing a sparkling dress and a tassel veil, walks onto the stage.

XI YAOTING stands up, recognition hitting him.

LIN CHUAN
(surprised)
You know her?

XI YAOTING
(staring at the stage)
She's the one.

LIN CHUAN
(stunned)
Holy shit.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

Xia Wei's mother. Her daughter's set for life.

LU AIMEI
(continuing)
You work double shifts, exhausting yourself. Xia Wei? She sleeps in, shops, lives in luxury.

XIA NIAN
(firmly)

MIMI
Mommy's strong!

TIANTIAN
Superhero strong!

LU AIMEI
(dismissively)

Don't.

title: Private Collection & Private Tasting
description: A woman running a bar reluctantly agrees to a marriage of convenience with an older man she's never met, only to encounter complications when a persistent suitor appears.
context:
Title: Private Collection & Private Tasting
Description: A woman running a bar reluctantly agrees to a marriage of convenience with an older man she's never met, only to encounter complications when a persistent suitor appears.

INT. BAR/SHU YANG'S HOME - NIGHT

Scene alternates between SHU YANG on the phone at the bar and her mother SHU MEI on the phone at home.

SHU YANG (V.O.)
An old man no one dares to marry—why volunteer myself as tribute?

SHU MEI
(on the phone)
He's thirty-six, Yangyang. And he saw your graduation photo. Wouldn't take no for an answer.

SHU YANG sits at the bar counter, phone pinched between shoulder and ear, wiping down a glass.

SHU YANG
(into the phone)
I'd rather auction the bar and sleep in the storage room.

SHU MEI
(on the phone, lowering voice)
The trust fund hits seven figures. Fully liquid. You'd never have to call your uncle again.

SHU YANG
(into the phone, flatly)
Do I look like I'm for sale?

SHU MEI
(on the phone)
One year. Separate residences. A post-nup that gives him nothing if he breaks the terms.

SHU YANG is silent, the glass forgotten in her hand.

SHU YANG
(into the phone)
Civil Affairs Bureau. Nine a.m. If he's late, I'm gone.

SHU MEI
(on the phone, exhales)
I'll forward the meeting details.

SHU YANG hangs up, pours herself a finger of whiskey.

SHU YANG
(to herself)
Seven figures for twelve months of theater. As long as he doesn't drool.

She knocks it back in one swallow.
continuation:
INT. BAR - NIGHT

Three men (PASSERBY A, B, and C) nurse beers in a corner booth, eyes flicking toward SHU YANG.

PASSERBY A
Third time this month she's closed alone.

PASSERBY B
Debts like hers don't leave room for a social life.

PASSERBY C
Debt's the least of it. Huo's kid comes every Tuesday like a mortgage payment.

HUO ZHEYU enters, roses replaced by a leather folio and the inevitable ring box.

PASSERBY B
Tuesdays, man.

HUO ZHEYU walks to the bar counter, places the folio between them.

HUO ZHEYU
Sister Shu Yang, the foreclosure notice is dated three days from now. My family's offer expires at midnight.

SHU YANG
And if I prefer bankruptcy?

HUO ZHEYU
(opening the ring box)
Then you'll remember that I offered. When no one else did.

EXT. BAR ENTRANCE - NIGHT

A black Maybach stops at the curb. The door opens; a polished oxford tests the pavement.

QI SHUO, thirty-something in a tailored coat, adjusts his glasses. A silver coin dances across his knuckles as he walks toward the bar.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

QI SHUO enters. The temperature drops.

SHU YANG looks up. Their eyes meet across the empty room.

SHU YANG
(internal monologue)
That bone structure. I've seen it on a museum wall I couldn't afford to enter.

QI SHUO's coin disappears into his palm. His gaze doesn't waver.

title: The Handsome Husband in the Jade Hairpin - Episode 1
description: A college student trapped in a nightmare finds herself forced into a ghostly wedding with the King of Hell, only to wake up to a horrifying reality.
context:
Title: The Handsome Husband in the Jade Hairpin - Episode 1
Description: A college student trapped in a nightmare finds herself forced into a ghostly wedding with the King of Hell, only to wake up to a horrifying reality.

INT. FEMALE DORMITORY - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Haicheng University - Female Dormitory

MU WAN lies on the top bunk of her dormitory bed, surrounded by crumpled talismans. She twitches in a nightmare.

INT. ANCIENT BRIDAL CHAMBER - NIGHT

MU WAN wears a red wedding dress, lying on an antique wedding bed, her hands bound by red silk cords.

MALE VOICE (V.O.)
The King of Hell claims his bride. The living shall not interfere.

MU WAN opens her eyes, breath misting in the cold. She strains against the cords.

MU WAN (V.O.)
A ghost wedding... the bride is me.

She spots an ornate mirror—her reflection shows the bridal veil.

MU WAN
Grandma's charms failed. This can't be real.

She struggles, trying to reactivate the faded ink on her palm with spit and friction, muttering protective mantras.

A figure materializes: KING OF HELL in crimson wedding robes, black silk sash covering his eyes.

KING OF HELL (V.O.)
Need help, little bride?

MU WAN
(desperate)
Yes! Cut these ropes—I'll pay you anything, just get me out!

She freezes. His robes match hers—the same phoenix embroidery.

MU WAN
Your clothes...
continuation:
The KING OF HELL helps her untie the cloth strips on his hands. Just as MU WAN tries to escape, the KING OF HELL grabs her and pins her down on the bed.

KING OF HELL
Where are you running?

MU WAN
(panicking)
My grandmother's a medium—she'll banish you!

He touches the jade hairpin to her lips.

KING OF HELL
She protected you for twenty years. Tonight, her ink ran dry.

He kisses her. The hairpin falls.

INT. FEMALE DORMITORY - DAY

KING OF HELL (V.O.)
A gift awaits you.

MU WAN jolts awake, gasping. Talismans litter her blanket.

Noisy voices outside.

PASSERBY (O.S.)
Someone jumped! Call 911!

MU WAN immediately gets out of bed and rushes to the window, knocks over red ink—spills across a torn photo of her with two girls, their faces scratched out.

EXT. BELOW DORMITORY BUILDING - DAY

Two female corpses lie on concrete. Blood pools. A bystander's phone shows a video: two girls throwing a notebook off the roof, laughing.

INT. FEMALE DORMITORY - DAY

MU WAN looks at the tragic scene below, her face deathly pale, her eyes filled with shock and terror.

MU WAN (V.O.)
The gift... from my nightmare husband?

Her hand finds the jade hairpin on her windowsill.

title: All-Around City Dad
description: A former military commander working undercover as a security guard while secretly investigating his wife's murder crosses paths with his sister-in-law during an unexpected blind date.
context:
Title: All-Around City Dad
Description: A former military commander working undercover as a security guard while secretly investigating his wife's murder crosses paths with his sister-in-law during an unexpected blind date.

INT. RESTAURANT HALLWAY - DAY

SU FAN, wearing a security guard uniform, walks through the restaurant hallway while talking on the phone, holding his daughter's hand.

SUBORDINATE (V.O.)
Commander, the target from three years ago is still dark. No new signals.

SU FAN
Stay on it.

SUBORDINATE (V.O.)
Yes, sir.

SUBORDINATE (V.O.)
Your sister-in-law's in the crosshairs now. Board's forcing a marriage merger. Should we intervene?

SU FAN
I've got eyes on her. Low profile.

SUBORDINATE (V.O.)
Yes, sir.

SU FAN hangs up the phone, stops walking, and smiles at his daughter.

SU FAN
Go ahead.

The daughter happily runs toward a table inside the restaurant.
continuation:
INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

SU FAN sits at the table, watching his daughter play on the sofa. A WAITER brings over a steak.

WAITER
Your steak, sir.

SU FAN cuts a small piece of steak, picks it up with a fork, and offers it to his daughter.

DAUGHTER
You didn't eat at the mess hall again.

SU FAN
Dad's fine.

Meanwhile, JIANG YINGXUE, wearing a black business suit, walks into the restaurant while talking on the phone.

JIANG YINGXUE
(on phone)
Tell the board I'll handle my personal life. I don't need their candidates.

JIANG YINGXUE walks to the middle of the restaurant, looking at SU FAN and his daughter sitting in the distance.

JIANG YINGXUE
(on phone)
He's here? With a child? Whatever. I'll take it from here.

JIANG YINGXUE hangs up and walks toward SU FAN's table, sitting down.

JIANG YINGXUE
Name?

SU FAN
Su Fan.

SU FAN (V.O.)
She can't know. Not like this.

JIANG YINGXUE
Background? Occupation?

SU FAN
Special forces, retired. Security guard.

JIANG YINGXUE
Jiang Yingxue, Lingxiao Financial Group. Assets over a hundred billion, personal net worth ten billion. Your salary?

SU FAN
Four thousand. Less after deductions.

JIANG YINGXUE laughs.

JIANG YINGXUE
Xiaoyu set this up. A security guard's salary, a daughter, and the nerve to marry up. Explain.

SU FAN and his daughter both freeze, expressions shocked.

SU FAN (V.O.)
Blind date?

title: Destined Life
description: A martial arts disciple tries to save his master's student and her newborn child, but is betrayed and killed by his sworn brother who was deceived by their corrupt master.
context:
Title: Destined Life
Description: A martial arts disciple tries to save his master's student and her newborn child, but is betrayed and killed by his sworn brother who was deceived by their corrupt master.

INT. NANGONG YA'S RESIDENCE - DAY

ZANG LONG (a disciple of the Martial Arts Alliance) holds a baby in swaddling clothes, looking tenderly at his wife NANGONG YA beside him.

ZANG LONG
Xiao Ya. Thank you for your hard work.

NANGONG YA
This is the name my father prepared for him early on, Zang Feng. Hoping he will hide his sharpness and stay away from conflict.

Zang Long smiles and kisses the baby's forehead.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

Thunder and lightning rage outside.

HONG YING (Zhentian's wife) lies on the bed, screaming in pain, clutching a newborn daughter.

ZANG LONG (O.S.)
Hong Ying!

Hong Ying struggles, questioning her master QIU BAICHUAN (Leader of the Martial Arts Alliance) who stands by the bed, his face impassive.

HONG YING
Master, please. Zhentian is your finest disciple. This child is his bloodline...

QIU BAICHUAN
Her life force will complete my breakthrough. A small sacrifice for the Alliance's true power.

HONG YING
(desperately)
Someone save my child!

Qiu Baichuan's palm begins to glow with dark energy.

ZANG LONG (O.S.)
Stop!

Zang Long and Nangong Ya burst in. Zang Long intercepts Qiu Baichuan while Nangong Ya shields Hong Ying.

ZANG LONG
Master, we swore to protect the innocent. This is madness.

HONG YING
(to Zang Long)
Senior Brother... he's already killed three disciples who questioned him. He'll come for Feng'er next.

ZANG LONG
(realizing)
So that's why you wanted our son brought here tonight.

QIU BAICHUAN
(to Zang Long)
Two pure newborns in one night. Fate smiles upon my ascension.

ZANG LONG
(furious)
I would rather die than let you touch either child.

Hong Ying thrusts her daughter into Nangong Ya's arms.

HONG YING
Take her! Find Zhentian! He's in the northern village--

Qiu Baichuan strikes Hong Ying. She collapses, lifeless.

NANGONG YA
(to Zang Long)
We must take them both. He'll hunt Feng'er if we leave him.

ZANG LONG
Go!

Zang Long and Nangong Ya flee, each carrying a baby.
continuation:
EXT. BAMBOO FOREST - NIGHT

Heavy rain pours down. Zang Long and Nangong Ya stumble through the mud.

ZANG LONG
We reach Zhentian by dawn. He'll protect all of us from the master's madness.

Suddenly, CHEN ZHENTIAN (disciple of the Martial Arts Alliance) blocks their path, sword trembling in his hand, his eyes red-rimmed.

ZANG LONG
Zhentian! Thank the gods. Hong Ying is--

Chen Zhentian's sword flashes. Zang Long falls, the baby in his arms (Hong Ying's daughter) nearly dropping.

NANGONG YA
A Long!

CHEN ZHENTIAN
(voice breaking)
Master sent me her bloodied robe... her hairpin... and this.

He holds up a jade token - Zang Long's own disciple token.

CHEN ZHENTIAN
He said you murdered her last night. That you stole our child for a forbidden ritual. That you envied what I had.

ZANG LONG
(gasping, struggling to rise)
The master... lies... she died... protecting your daughter...

CHEN ZHENTIAN
(seeing the baby Zang Long holds)
That child... is mine?

He sees Nangong Ya clutching Zang Feng protectively.

CHEN ZHENTIAN
And you keep yours safe while mine dies? You planned this?

NANGONG YA
No! Feng'er is our son! That is your daughter in A Long's arms! The master killed Hong Ying before our eyes--

Zhentian's grief overwhelms reason. He strikes again.

CHEN ZHENTIAN
Master told me everything! Your false righteousness. Your hidden jealousy. Your betrayal!

Zang Long falls dead. Zhentian turns to Nangong Ya, tears mixing with rain.

CHEN ZHENTIAN
Now you will feel what I feel.

He pierces her heart. As she collapses, Zang Feng rolls from her arms, wailing into the storm. Zhentian stares down at the infant, his face a mask of torment and doubt.

title: Husband Goes Bankrupt, Wife Turns the Tables in One Shot
description: After her husband is scammed and loses everything in a rigged pool game, his wife reveals her hidden skills to win it all back.
context:
Title: Husband Goes Bankrupt, Wife Turns the Tables in One Shot
Description: After her husband is scammed and loses everything in a rigged pool game, his wife reveals her hidden skills to win it all back.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Fast-paced montage shots.

A man (HUSBAND) holds an axe, his expression furious, violently chopping a pool cue in half.

A woman (WIFE) walks in from the doorway, watching him with a calm expression.

HUSBAND swings the axe, smashing a table lamp. Glass shatters.

HUSBAND drops the axe and sinks to his knees among the splinters.

WIFE stands quietly, watching him.

HUSBAND
(sobbing)
I'm sorry... I'm so sorry.

HUSBAND grabs the hem of her coat. She gently pulls away and sets down her briefcase.

WIFE
(flatly)
How much?

HUSBAND
(looking up)
What?

WIFE
The real number. Not what they told you.

HUSBAND
Five hundred... they said five hundred thousand. But I only—

WIFE
(interrupting)
Small bets first. They let you win. Someone raised the stakes. You were drunk enough to say yes.

HUSBAND
(stunned)
How do you—

WIFE
Because that's how Marcus runs his games. He did the same thing to my father.

She picks up the broken cue pieces, examining them.

WIFE
This isn't even your cue. Yours is still in the car. You were too drunk to notice they switched it.

HUSBAND
continuation:
(voice cracking)
The house... I mortgaged it. They come tomorrow—

WIFE
Today. Noon. Not tomorrow.

She checks her watch. 10:47 AM.

WIFE
We have seventy-three minutes.

HUSBAND
(panicking)
I'll go to the bank—

WIFE
The papers are signed. The only thing that voids them is clearing the debt before the notary arrives.

She shows him her phone. A text reads: "Notary finalizing transfer at 12:00 PM."

HUSBAND
(desperate)
What do we do?

WIFE
(eyes sharp)
You take what's left of this cue. We go find your friends.

She helps him to his feet, brushes dust from his shirt.

WIFE
And when we get there, I need you to do exactly what I say.

HUSBAND
(quietly)
What are you going to do?

WIFE
I'm going to borrow a proper cue. And you're going to bet everything we have left.

HUSBAND
We have nothing—

WIFE
Not true.

She taps her temple.

WIFE
We have me.

WIFE heads for the door. Husband stares after her, then at the wrecked room. A flicker of hope crosses his face.

A flash of determination crosses WIFE's face as she exits.

title: The White Affairs Master of the 80s
description: A man is reborn into the 1980s and decides to follow his grandfather's profession of conducting funeral rites, discovering it to be surprisingly lucrative.
context:
Title: The White Affairs Master of the 80s
Description: A man is reborn into the 1980s and decides to follow his grandfather's profession of conducting funeral rites, discovering it to be surprisingly lucrative.

INT. MOURNING HALL - NIGHT

Inside the mourning hall, candles flicker, creating a solemn atmosphere. SUN CHUANWU kneels on a prayer mat, staring at his hands with quiet disbelief.

SUN CHUANWU (V.O.)
1983. I've been reborn.

He touches the rough fabric of his period clothing, a shadow of a smile crossing his face.

SUN JIUDAO, an old man with a head full of silver hair but a vigorous spirit, watches from the shadows.

SUN JIUDAO
Chuanwu. The incense.

SUN CHUANWU
(startled)
Yes. Right away.

Sun Chuanwu scrambles to his feet, moving with unfamiliarity toward a large bamboo basket filled with yellow paper money and incense.

EXT. COURTYARD - CONTINUOUS

Sun Jiudao hands three carefully measured bundles to HU LAODA, a villager in mourning clothes.

SUN JIUDAO
Three pounds, six ounces. Burn them whole. Seven packets of ash for the procession.

HU LAODA
I understand.

SUN JIUDAO
Watch the corpse lamp. If it dies, so does the soul's passage.

Hu Laoda nods gravely, then presses a thick envelope into Sun Jiudao's palm.

HU LAODA
For the Master's trouble.

Sun Jiudao pockets it without looking. But SUN CHUANWU, lingering in the doorway, catches the glint of plastic-wrapped bills. His breath hitches.

Sun Chuanwu touches his own worn shirt sleeve, eyes fixed on the transaction.

SUN JIUDAO
(sharp)
Chuanwu. We're leaving.

SUN CHUANWU
Coming!
continuation:
EXT. VILLAGE ROAD - NIGHT

Sun Jiudao and Sun Chuanwu walk along a small path in the village, dust rising underfoot.

SUN JIUDAO
Your cousin sent lamb this morning. We'll stew it.

SUN CHUANWU
Cousin? I thought—

He freezes, the words hanging wrong between them. Sun Jiudao stops dead.

SUN JIUDAO
(very quiet)
It was your uncle.

The old man's grip clamps down on Sun Chuanwu's wrist like iron.

SUN JIUDAO
(eyes glittering in the dark)
My grandson knows his own blood. You... you're something else wearing his skin.

The air around them grows heavy, still. Sun Jiudao's shadow seems to stretch longer than it should.

SUN CHUANWU
(terrified)
Grandfather, I can explain—

SUN JIUDAO
Spirit or demon, you've made a grave mistake. This old man doesn't bargain with the dead.

The wind dies completely. The road ahead disappears into impenetrable darkness.

title: Reborn in the Seventies, Substitute Husband, It's Your Turn to Suffer
description: Fengxia overhears her husband's plot to assume his deceased brother's identity and abandon her, revealing a shocking betrayal by her entire family.
context:
Title: Reborn in the Seventies, Substitute Husband, It's Your Turn to Suffer
Description: Fengxia overhears her husband's plot to assume his deceased brother's identity and abandon her, revealing a shocking betrayal by her entire family.

EXT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

FENGXIA presses against the warped doorframe, her knuckles white around the basket handle. Raised voices bleed through the splintered wood.

INT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

LI ZHIGANG towers over his PARENTS, a crumpled telegram in his fist.

LI ZHIGANG'S MOTHER
(trembling)
Your brother's barely cold, and you're taking his name? What becomes of Fengxia and the girl?

LI ZHIGANG
(urgent)
Not another word. From this moment, I'm Li Zhiqiang. The name sticks.

LI ZHIGANG'S FATHER
(quiet)
She's worked these fields ten years for us. Raised our grandchild. How does she survive this?

LI ZHIGANG
(scoffs)
She's peasant stock, Dad. Hardship's in her bones. But Wanqing? She's carrying the Li heir. One month without meat and she'd lose the child.

LI ZHIGANG
(pressing his advantage)
Tell me, can you watch her take your grandson to another man's house?
continuation:
EXT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

FENGXIA stumbles back, tears streaking through the dust on her cheeks.

FENGXIA (O.S.)
So she's Wanqing now. How long have they whispered that name?

INT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

LI ZHIGANG'S FATHER
(frowning)
The commune knows both our sons. The cadres, the work unit records--

LI ZHIGANG
(cutting him off)
The mountain flood took everything. Papers, photos, the entire dossier. Who questions a grieving widow?

EXT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

FENGXIA (O.S.)
That won't do.

INT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

LI ZHIGANG'S MOTHER
(avoiding her husband's eyes)
Old man... we can't even earn eighty yuan a year. The baby's milk powder alone...

LI ZHIGANG'S FATHER
(stiff nod)

EXT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

FENGXIA's eyes harden, the pain calcifying into something colder.

FENGXIA (O.S.)
Ten years of steam buns and saved cooking oil. And they sell me for a dead man's salary.

INT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

LI ZHIGANG
(triumph in his voice)
That's settled then. Tomorrow we bury Li Zhigang. Remember-- the name belongs to me now.

LI ZHIGANG turns toward the door, a thin smile on his lips.

INT. DOORWAY - DAY

LI ZHIGANG pulls the door open. FENGXIA stands there, basket at her feet, her gaze clear and dry.

LI ZHIGANG
(horror dawning)
Fengxia--

title: The Last Immortal in the City
description: Zhou Yuan, the last cultivator on Earth, must leave his wife and infant daughter to suppress an ancient evil for eighteen years.
context:
Title: The Last Immortal in the City
Description: Zhou Yuan, the last cultivator on Earth, must leave his wife and infant daughter to suppress an ancient evil for eighteen years.

INT. GARDEN - DAY

Close-up of an ancient bronze sword, its blade covered with mysterious patterns that pulse with red light.

ZHOU YUAN, wearing a black cloak, holds a swaddled baby in his arms. His wife, QIN LING, dressed in a white cheongsam, stands beside him, her face full of worry.

QIN LING
Honey, are you really going?

ZHOU YUAN
(grave expression)
The North Sea calamity has begun. Eighteen years until it devours everything.

QIN LING
But she's only three days old.

ZHOU YUAN
That's why I must go now. While there's still time.

He touches the sword's hilt. The patterns flare, burning his palm. He doesn't flinch.

QIN LING
(tears in her eyes)
The doctors said she might not walk until she's two. She might not talk until she's three. You'll miss it all.

ZHOU YUAN
(quietly)
I'll count every step. Every word.

Thunder rumbles. Dark clouds gather. The baby stirs.

QIN LING
(fiercely)
Swear to me. Not as the last cultivator. As her father.

ZHOU YUAN looks at his daughter, then meets Qin Ling's eyes.

ZHOU YUAN
I swear on my immortal soul. I'll return on her eighteenth birthday. I'll be there when she blows out the candles.

He grasps the hilt fully. The blade erupts in crimson light. Wind whips through the garden.

QIN LING
continuation:
(shouting over the wind)
What if she doesn't recognize you?

ZHOU YUAN
(turning back)
Then I'll spend every day after reminding her.

He pulls the sword from the earth. His cloak billows. He walks toward the storm.

QIN LING
(calling after)
I'll tell her every night! I'll tell her—

The baby begins to CRY. Zhou Yuan pauses, shoulders tense, then continues into the swirling clouds without looking back.

QIN LING
(to the baby, tears streaming)
Shh, Xue'er. Listen. That's your father. He's saving the world for you.

She holds the child close, watching until he disappears.

INT. INTERDIMENSIONAL SPACE - DAY

ZHOU YUAN sits cross-legged in a void of cosmic space, surrounded by a golden energy barrier. Opposite him, a demon with a hideous face is bound by red chains. The bronze sword floats between them, embedded in a seal.

DEMON
(sneering)
Eighteen years, Zhou Yuan. She'll learn to hate you. "Why did he leave us?"

ZHOU YUAN
(roaring)
SILENCE!

ZHOU YUAN channels his power. Golden light blazes, but his hair begins to turn white at the temples. The demon howls.

DEMON
(laughing)
You're burning your lifespan to fuel the seal! Even if you survive, you'll be a stranger to her!

ZHOU YUAN (V.O.)
Father said I bore the mark of immortals. But immortals don't age. They don't feel their child's cry in their bones.

ZHOU YUAN
(through gritted teeth)
Then I'll be the father... who grew old so she could grow up.

He pushes harder. The demon's laughter turns to screams. Zhou Yuan's eyes blaze with golden determination—and desperate, human love.

title: My Goddess Wife Is Stuck on Me
description: A man from a secretly wealthy family pretends to be poor to find true love, but accidentally gets entangled with a beautiful woman fleeing an arranged marriage.
context:
Title: My Goddess Wife Is Stuck on Me
Description: A man from a secretly wealthy family pretends to be poor to find true love, but accidentally gets entangled with a beautiful woman fleeing an arranged marriage.

EXT. RURAL COURTYARD - DAY

LI FENG'S MOTHER inspects a silk scarf for mildew.

LI FENG'S MOTHER
If we don't air these collections weekly, everything turns green.

LI FENG'S FATHER paces with a ledger.

LI FENG'S FATHER
We're bleeding money to stay "poor." When does this end?

LI FENG'S MOTHER
When Feng brings home a wife who loves him, not his trust fund.

LI FENG'S FATHER
(sighing)
The boy won't even look at a woman.

LI FENG'S MOTHER
Then no stipends until he does.

EXT. PARK - DAY

LI FENG, in a worn suit, holds a "SEEKING SERIOUS RELATIONSHIP" sign.

A BEAUTIFUL WOMAN stops, eyes his shoes.

BEAUTIFUL WOMAN
Property portfolio?

LI FENG
Family homestead. And transportation there.

He nods to a modest white van.

BEAUTIFUL WOMAN
(disdainfully)
No equity, no elevator, no chance.

She clicks away. LI FENG squares his shoulders.

An AUNTIE in neon wear waddles over.

AUNTIE
My niece likes honest men. You insured?

LI FENG
Basic rural coverage. You seem young to be matchmaking?

AUNTIE
(laughing, grabbing his wrist)
Who said it's my niece? Auntie's still game!

LI FENG untangles himself politely.

LI FENG
Forgive me, appointment awaits.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

JIANG YUROU storms, phone to ear, tears of fury glinting.

JIANG YUROU
(into phone)
Chen's third mistress called me. Force this merger and I dissolve my shares. All of them.

She hangs up, blinded by tears, and slams into LI FENG. He catches her.

Their eyes lock—hers desperate, his startled.

CHEN ZIZHOU appears with bodyguards.

CHEN ZIZHOU
My fiancée. In a gigolo's arms.

LI FENG
(steadying her)
Sir, she was falling—

JIANG YUROU
Chen Zizhou, I told you never follow me.

CHEN ZIZHOU
I own this park. I own you.

He snaps fingers. Bodyguards step forward.

JIANG YUROU
(tightening grip on LI FENG)
Wrong. I just accepted his proposal. Li Feng, my choice.

LI FENG
(quietly)
You're shaking. We can just leave—

JIANG YUROU
(fierce whisper)
Please. Ten minutes. Save my life.

LI FENG's demeanor shifts. He faces Chen.

LI FENG
She said no. That word is free.

CHEN ZIZHOU
Remove the pest.
continuation:
EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

LI FENG helps JIANG YUROU into the van. Bodyguards approach.

CHEN ZIZHOU
(slamming hood)
This rust bucket is your rebellion? I'll crush it.

LI FENG
(over shoulder)
Touch it and meet my lawyers.

He starts the engine. The van roars. Bodyguards dive aside as it peels out.

CHEN ZIZHOU
(screaming)
I'll take your deed! Your family! Everything!

A vintage blue Porsche screeches up. Chen shoves the driver out, takes wheel.

CHEN ZIZHOU
You can't hide in poverty!

EXT. RURAL COURTYARD - DAY

A Bentley is wheeled into a barn. FEMALE ASSISTANT consults tablet.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
(into walkie-talkie)
Phase three. All vehicles to secondary garage. Confirm.

LI FENG'S FATHER unplugs a fountain's gold trim.

LI FENG'S MOTHER
(hoisting bags)
These were last season. Feng won't notice.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
(to LI FENG'S FATHER)
Young master's five minutes out. And he's not alone.

LI FENG'S MOTHER
A woman?

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Verified. Jiang heiress. The one avoiding the Chen merger.

LI FENG'S parents exchange a look—shock to calculation.

LI FENG'S FATHER
(slow smile)
The enemy of our enemy...

LI FENG'S MOTHER
...might be our daughter-in-law. Rural dinner. But break out the '82 Bordeaux—in mason jars.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Copy.

EXT. RURAL COURTYARD - DAY

The van rumbles in, parking. LI FENG and JIANG YUROU emerge. Several "villagers" converge.

VILLAGER A
Brother Niu! Your ma's soup is boiling.

LI FENG
(to JIANG YUROU)
Welcome to the family farm.

JIANG YUROU
(nose wrinkling)
Authentic.

The Porsche shrieks to a halt, spraying gravel. Chen emerges, phone filming.

CHEN ZIZHOU
Livestream time, Yurou. Show your board where their CEO sleeps.

LI FENG
Five seconds to leave private property.

CHEN ZIZHOU
(to phone)
See this sty? This is rejecting progress.

JIANG YUROU
(striding forward)
Progress? Your three pending paternity suits?

She grabs mud, smears it on her blouse.

JIANG YUROU
(to LI FENG)
Show me the kitchen. I want your mother's recipes.

CHEN ZIZHOU
(laughing, desperate)
Ten minutes! You'll beg for conditioner!

JIANG YUROU
(over shoulder, mud-caked)
And you'll still be a joke without a punchline.

She tugs LI FENG toward the cottage. A disguised FEMALE ASSISTANT gives Li Feng a subtle thumbs-up.

Family homestead. And transportation there.

He nods to a modest white van.

BEAUTIFUL WOMAN
(disdainfully)
No equity, no elevator, no chance.

She clicks away. LI FENG squares his shoulders.

An AUNTIE in neon wear waddles over.

AUNTIE
My niece likes honest men. You insured?

LI FENG
Basic rural coverage. You seem young to be matchmaking?

AUNTIE
(laughing, grabbing his wrist)
Who said it's my niece? Auntie's still game!

LI FENG untangles himself politely.

LI FENG
Forgive me, appointment awaits.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

JIANG YUROU storms, phone to ear, tears of fury glinting.

JIANG YUROU
(into phone)
Chen's third mistress called me. Force this merger and I dissolve my shares. All of them.

She hangs up, blinded by tears, and slams into LI FENG. He catches her.

Their eyes lock—hers desperate, his startled.

CHEN ZIZHOU appears with bodyguards.

CHEN ZIZHOU
My fiancée. In a gigolo's arms.

LI FENG
(steadying her)
Sir, she was falling—

JIANG YUROU
Chen Zizhou, I told you never follow me.

CHEN ZIZHOU
I own this park. I own you.

He snaps fingers. Bodyguards step forward.

JIANG YUROU
(tightening grip on LI FENG)
Wrong. I just accepted his proposal. Li Feng, my choice.

LI FENG
(quietly)
You're shaking. We can just leave—

JIANG YUROU
(fierce whisper)
Please. Ten minutes. Save my life.

LI FENG's demeanor shifts. He faces Chen.

LI FENG
She said no. That word is free.

CHEN ZIZHOU
Remove the pest.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

LI FENG helps JIANG YUROU into the van. Bodyguards approach.

CHEN ZIZHOU
(slamming hood)
This rust bucket is your rebellion? I'll crush it.

LI FENG
(over shoulder)
Touch it and meet my lawyers.

He starts the engine. The van roars. Bodyguards dive aside as it peels out.

CHEN ZIZHOU
(screaming)
I'll take your deed! Your family! Everything!

A vintage blue Porsche screeches up. Chen shoves the driver out, takes wheel.

CHEN ZIZHOU
You can't hide in poverty!

EXT. RURAL COURTYARD - DAY

A Bentley is wheeled into a barn. FEMALE ASSISTANT consults tablet.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
(into walkie-talkie)
Phase three. All vehicles to secondary garage. Confirm.

LI FENG'S FATHER unplugs a fountain's gold trim.

LI FENG'S MOTHER
(hoisting bags)
These were last season. Feng won't notice.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
(to LI FENG'S FATHER)
Young master's five minutes out. And he's not alone.

LI FENG'S MOTHER
A woman?

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Verified. Jiang heiress. The one avoiding the Chen merger.

LI FENG'S parents exchange a look—shock to calculation.

LI FENG'S FATHER
(slow smile)
The enemy of our enemy...

LI FENG'S MOTHER
...might be our daughter-in-law. Rural dinner. But break out the '82 Bordeaux—in mason jars.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Copy.

EXT. RURAL COURTYARD - DAY

The van rumbles in, parking. LI FENG and JIANG YUROU emerge. Several "villagers" converge.

VILLAGER A
Brother Niu! Your ma's soup is boiling.

LI FENG
(to JIANG YUROU)
Welcome to the family farm.

JIANG YUROU
(nose wrinkling)
Authentic.

The Porsche shrieks to a halt, spraying gravel. Chen emerges, phone filming.

CHEN ZIZHOU
Livestream time, Yurou. Show your board where their CEO sleeps.

LI FENG
Five seconds to leave private property.

CHEN ZIZHOU
(to phone)
See this sty? This is rejecting progress.

JIANG YUROU
(striding forward)
Progress? Your three pending paternity suits?

She grabs mud, smears it on her blouse.

JIANG YUROU
(to LI FENG)
Show me the kitchen. I want your mother's recipes.

CHEN ZIZHOU
(laughing, desperate)
Ten minutes! You'll beg for conditioner!

JIANG YUROU
(over shoulder, mud-caked)
And you'll still be a joke without a punchline.

She tugs LI FENG toward the cottage. A disguised FEMALE ASSISTANT gives Li Feng a subtle thumbs-up.

title: When I Left, I Still Resent This Long Separation
description: A former noblewoman, now destitute and dying in a ruined temple, is confronted by her adopted daughter who reveals the truth about the betrayal that destroyed their family.
context:
Title: When I Left, I Still Resent This Long Separation
Description: A former noblewoman, now destitute and dying in a ruined temple, is confronted by her adopted daughter who reveals the truth about the betrayal that destroyed their family.

INT. RUINED TEMPLE - NIGHT

A stormy night with thunder and rain. A dilapidated temple.

SHEN CHANGLI, white-haired and dressed in rags, sits on a pile of dry straw, looking sadly at a painting in her hands.

SHEN CHANGLI
Shuhua... your fifteenth birthday. I promised you a jade comb from the capital.

SHEN CHANGLI coughs violently, her frail body shaking. She carefully tucks the painting inside her tattered robes.

The temple door is kicked open. XIE YURONG, dressed in luxurious robes, walks in surrounded by GUARDS. She covers her nose with a handkerchief in disgust.

XIE YURONG
Is this even a place for people to live?

XIE YURONG
Shen Changli, you were once a high and mighty descendant of a military family. How is it that now you live worse than a stray dog?

SHEN CHANGLI
Eighteen years ago, you were freezing in a temple like this. I took you in. I gave you a name.

XIE YURONG suddenly steps forward and snatches the painting from SHEN CHANGLI's hands.

SHEN CHANGLI
(panicked)
What are you doing?

SHEN CHANGLI lunges forward trying to grab the painting back, but is pushed to the ground by XIE YURONG. She struggles to get up, clutching the painting tightly, crying in pain.

XIE YURONG
I tore all her portraits. But you kept one.
continuation:
XIE YURONG
Now you'll never be able to find her.

SHEN CHANGLI
(sobbing)
Yurong, she is your sister!

XIE YURONG
Who told you to drive your own daughter out? While giving me her title, her dowry, her life?

XIE YURONG
If I found her, where would I be?

SHEN CHANGLI
(desperate)
I raised you as a noble lady for eighteen years. Even a wolf would recognize its pack.

XIE YURONG
I recognize opportunity. You taught me that.

XIE YURONG
Every time I called you Mother, I earned another piece of your empire.

XIE YURONG kicks SHEN CHANGLI, who falls to the ground. The painting also falls onto the dry straw.

XIE YURONG
(coldly laughing)
Shen Changli, let me tell you the truth. The Crown Prince's bed? My design. The witnesses? My coin. Your husband's execution? My signature.

XIE YURONG
But the hand that struck her? That pushed her into the snow? That was yours.

SHEN CHANGLI, hearing the truth, clutches her chest. She coughs blood, but with her last strength, grabs the painting and clutches it to her heart as she dies.

Fresh blood splatters onto her daughter's portrait.

END SCENE

title: Deep Love Falls
description: After serving five years in prison for a crime she didn't commit, Shen Wanyi is released and returns to find the man she once loved still blames her for his beloved's condition.
context:
Title: Deep Love Falls
Description: After serving five years in prison for a crime she didn't commit, Shen Wanyi is released and returns to find the man she once loved still blames her for his beloved's condition.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

SHEN WANYI (20s) lies in bed, her breath catching as her body tenses through a nightmare.

INT. ROOM - DAY

SHEN MENGYAN (20s) wears an exquisite black dress, her expression controlled as she looks at SHEN WANYI.

SHEN MENGYAN
(measured)
You're the biological daughter. So what? Blood doesn't entitle you to anything.

SHEN MENGYAN reveals a calculated smile.

SHEN MENGYAN
(quietly)
Not when you don't know how to take it.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

MOTHER SHEN (40s) grabs SHEN WANYI's shoulders, pleading.

MOTHER SHEN
(pleading)
Your father needs the treatment, Wanyi. Just a few years. I'll make sure you're protected inside.

INT. HOSPITAL - DAY

MU SILAN (20s) wears a black suit, his back to SHEN WANYI as he stands beside a bed.

MU SILAN
(quietly)
She's been in that bed for three months because of you. Five years doesn't even the scales.

INT. PRISON CELL - DAY

SHEN WANYI wears a blue prison uniform, sitting dejectedly, her thumb tracing a hidden photograph.

PRISON GUARD (O.S.)
Number 113031. You're up.
continuation:
EXT. PRISON GATE - DAY

SHEN WANYI, in a white top and jeans, walks out. The gate clangs shut.

PRISON GUARD (O.S.)
Keep walking. Don't look back.

She hesitates, then walks forward without turning.

INT. TAXI - DAY

SHEN WANYI sits in the back seat.

SHEN WANYI
Capital First Hospital.

EXT. HOSPITAL - DAY

Aerial shot of Capital First Hospital.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

SHEN WANYI walks urgently, searching. She stops at a door, looks through the window—then pulls back, pressing against the wall.

She closes her eyes, breathing hard.

EXT. PARK - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG HUAICHUAN (40s) holds young SHEN WANYI, his face full of affection.

JIANG HUAICHUAN
Music University. You'd better practice, kiddo. I'll be in the front row.

YOUNG WANYI
Promise?

JIANG HUAICHUAN
(ruffling her hair)
Try and stop me.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

SHEN WANYI's eyes redden, tears welling up.

SHEN WANYI (V.O.)
Dad, I'm back. That's all that matters now.

Footsteps approach. Slow. Measured.

MU SILAN walks past, stops, looks back at her.

MU SILAN
(cautious)
...Do I know you?

SHEN WANYI
(quietly)
I don't think so.

She tries to leave. MU SILAN grabs her arm, pushes her against the wall—controlled, not violent.

MU SILAN
(sternly)
Shen Wanyi. It really is you. What are you doing at the hospital?

SHEN WANYI
(struggling)
Mu Silan—let go.

MU SILAN
I almost forgot. Out today and came straight here. Trying to finish what you started?

SHEN WANYI
(leaning in)
The woman you love is in that room. Yet here you are, assaulting another. What would she think?

MU SILAN angrily grabs SHEN WANYI's neck, pinning her.

MU SILAN
(fiercely)
Five years. You learned nothing.

SHEN WANYI
(struggling)
It taught me that some men confuse punishment with justice.

His eyes search hers, finding something that makes his grip falter. He doesn't release her.

title: The Commoner Physiognomist
description: A delivery man encounters a desperate heiress who refuses an arranged marriage, leading to an unexpected night and a confrontation about responsibility and fate.
context:
Title: The Commoner Physiognomist
Description: A delivery man encounters a desperate heiress who refuses an arranged marriage, leading to an unexpected night and a confrontation about responsibility and fate.

INT. XIAO YAROU'S HOME - NIGHT

Opening with a series of close-up shots of XIAO YAROU, wearing exquisite makeup, her eyes hazy—but a faint tremor in her hand betrays her.

XIAO YAROU wears a silk robe, lounging lazily on the sofa, holding a glass of red wine, gently swirling it. The liquid sloshes slightly unevenly.

Her phone on the table suddenly rings. She picks it up and answers.

XIAO YAROU
Hello?

MALE VOICE (V.O.)
Xiao Yarou, you're marrying Young Master Wang in three days. No matter where you are, come back immediately.

XIAO YAROU
(angrily)
The Wang family is a cesspool. I'd rather die than marry into it!

MALE VOICE (V.O.)
Then your mother's medical bills die with her. The wedding is non-negotiable.

XIAO YAROU
(quietly, voice breaking)
You bastard...

XIAO YAROU hangs up and angrily throws the phone on the table. It clatters loudly.

The doorbell rings.

XIAO YAROU
(impatiently)
Who is it?

DELIVERY GUY (O.S.)
Hello, your food delivery is here.

XIAO YAROU gets up and walks to the door to open it.

A young DELIVERY GUY stands at the door, holding a delivery bag. His eyes quickly scan her face—noticing the puffy eyes beneath makeup, the wine glass clutched like a lifeline.

DELIVERY GUY
Hello, this is our restaurant's signature fried rice.

Without a word, XIAO YAROU grabs the DELIVERY GUY by the collar, pulls him into the room, pushes him hard against the wall, and kisses him.

The DELIVERY GUY looks completely shocked—but his hand briefly hesitates near her trembling waist.

XIAO YAROU pushes the DELIVERY GUY onto the bed.

Quick scene transition, screen goes black.
continuation:
INT. XIAO YAROU'S HOME - DAY

The next morning, the DELIVERY GUY wakes up shirtless in bed, covered with lipstick marks. He sits up, looking confused. He touches his lips thoughtfully.

DELIVERY GUY
(to himself)
Peach blossom curse... but her face showed no joy. Only desperation.

XIAO YAROU walks out of the bathroom wrapped in a towel. Her makeup is gone, revealing dark circles and a pallor.

DELIVERY GUY
Last night was my first time. You have to take responsibility for me.

XIAO YAROU
(coldly)
I take responsibility for you? If you don't want to die, disappear before I change my mind.

DELIVERY GUY
(agitated)
Hey! You haven't even put your pants on and you're already denying everything? Last night it was me, the boss myself, who delivered your food, and you wore me out all night. My back is about to break.

XIAO YAROU ignores him and turns to walk away.

DELIVERY GUY
Hey!

The DELIVERY GUY gets dressed and stands in the room.

XIAO YAROU
Shut up.

XIAO YAROU takes out a bank card and throws it to the DELIVERY GUY.

XIAO YAROU
There's one million here. Enough to buy you a hundred food stalls. Leave now and disappear forever.

DELIVERY GUY
(shocked)
One million? You think I'm a gigolo? What happened between us isn't something money can solve.

The DELIVERY GUY throws the bank card on the floor.

XIAO YAROU
Then what do you want?

The DELIVERY GUY walks toward her step by step, his gaze tracing the exhaustion etched into her face.

DELIVERY GUY
I want...

Their eyes lock. The frame freezes. End.

title: Daughter-in-Law Treasured by the Noble House
description: A dying matriarch realizes too late that she drove away her true daughter-in-law and let a poisonous woman destroy her family from within.
context:
Title: Daughter-in-Law Treasured by the Noble House
Description: A dying matriarch realizes too late that she drove away her true daughter-in-law and let a poisonous woman destroy her family from within.

INT. DILAPIDATED SHACK - DAY

XUE SHI lies on a crude bed, trembling as she reaches for a spilled medicine bowl just beyond her grasp.

XUE SHI
(rasping)
My medicine... please...

LIU RUYAN enters, silk robes gleaming. Her embroidered shoe crushes the clay bowl, grinding it into dirt.

LIU RUYAN
(contemptuous)
Wasting good herbs on a corpse-in-waiting, Mother?

She walks to the bedside and grips Xue Shi's jaw, forcing her to look up.

LIU RUYAN
(mocking)
The great Lady Qin. Third-rank imperial decree. Look at you now.

XUE SHI
(anguished)
I chose fish eyes over pearls. I sent her away.

LIU RUYAN
(cold)
Regret changes nothing. The manor is mine. Your son is dead. Your line ends.

XUE SHI
(desperate)
A Yu... my grandson...

LIU RUYAN kicks Xue Shi down onto the bed.

LIU RUYAN
(triumphant)
A Yu is mine. He calls my lover Father. He will inherit your titles while you Qin bones rot in unmarked earth.

She forces a pastry between Xue Shi's teeth.

LIU RUYAN
Your final medicine.

Xue Shi convulses. Blood flows from all seven orifices. She stops breathing, eyes wide.

XUE SHI (V.O.)
Sixteen... the imperial seal... glory... then her hands... sewing my robes...

QUICK FLASHES:
- Young Xue Shi receives the decree.
- SHENG QINGWAN places a warming pan.
- Liu Ruyan's false smile.
continuation:
INT. DILAPIDATED SHACK - LATER

SHENG QINGWAN rushes in, plain cotton robes. She falls to her knees.

SHENG QINGWAN
(agonized)
Mother! Qingwan is here!

XUE SHI (V.O.)
Qingwan...

SHENG QINGWAN grasps Xue Shi's cold hand, tears streaming.

SHENG QINGWAN
(choked)
Though I'm no longer your daughter-in-law, I will bury you where the mountain winds are clean.

Xue Shi's hand slips from her grasp.

SHENG QINGWAN
(whisper)
Rest now.

XUE SHI (V.O.)
The daughter I cast away returns to mourn a mother. If Heaven grants another life...

SHENG QINGWAN covers Xue Shi's face with a white cloth.

I chose fish eyes over pearls. I sent her away.

LIU RUYAN
(cold)
Regret changes nothing. The manor is mine. Your son is dead. Your line ends.

XUE SHI
(desperate)
A Yu... my grandson...

LIU RUYAN kicks Xue Shi down onto the bed.

LIU RUYAN
(triumphant)
A Yu is mine. He calls my lover Father. He will inherit your titles while you Qin bones rot in unmarked earth.

She forces a pastry between Xue Shi's teeth.

LIU RUYAN
Your final medicine.

Xue Shi convulses. Blood flows from all seven orifices. She stops breathing, eyes wide.

XUE SHI (V.O.)
Sixteen... the imperial seal... glory... then her hands... sewing my robes...

QUICK FLASHES:
- Young Xue Shi receives the decree.
- SHENG QINGWAN places a warming pan.
- Liu Ruyan's false smile.

INT. DILAPIDATED SHACK - LATER

SHENG QINGWAN rushes in, plain cotton robes. She falls to her knees.

SHENG QINGWAN
(agonized)
Mother! Qingwan is here!

XUE SHI (V.O.)
Qingwan...

SHENG QINGWAN grasps Xue Shi's cold hand, tears streaming.

SHENG QINGWAN
(choked)
Though I'm no longer your daughter-in-law, I will bury you where the mountain winds are clean.

Xue Shi's hand slips from her grasp.

SHENG QINGWAN
(whisper)
Rest now.

XUE SHI (V.O.)
The daughter I cast away returns to mourn a mother. If Heaven grants another life...

SHENG QINGWAN covers Xue Shi's face with a white cloth.

title: Rise to Fame with a Shuttlecock
description: A shuttlecock champion achieves his lifelong dream of winning the national championship.
context:
Title: Rise to Fame with a Shuttlecock
Description: A shuttlecock champion achieves his lifelong dream of winning the national championship.

INT. SPORTS ARENA - DAY

Inside the sports arena, the audience ROARS. Thousands of hands clap in unison. Flags wave like a crimson storm. Li Jiang stands frozen, trophy in hand, as if the moment might shatter.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
And now, the moment we've all been waiting for—your 2025 National Dabaijian Champions!

Four athletes (LI JIANG and his teammates) wearing red and yellow gradient sportswear stand in a row. Li Jiang's knuckles are white where he grips the trophy.

An AWARD PRESENTER walks forward and hands a golden trophy to LI JIANG, who stands at the front.

AWARD PRESENTER
Don't drop it, son. You've earned every gram.

Li Jiang stares at his own reflection in the polished gold, seeing a younger version of himself.

AWARD PRESENTER
(grasping Li Jiang's shoulder)
Your master would be proud.

LI JIANG
(voice cracking)
continuation:
Thank you, sir.

AWARD PRESENTER
(to teammates)
You boys made history today.

TEAMMATE
(pumping fist)
For Master Chen!

LI JIANG'S TEAMMATES
(in unison)
We promised him!

ON SCREEN: Dabaijian Promotion Ambassador Li Jiang

LI JIANG (V.O.)
(thick with emotion)
Master... the doctors said you'd never see this day. But you saw it first. Ten thousand times.

Li Jiang raises the trophy slowly, as if performing a ritual. His face remains stoic, but a single tear escapes.

The arena lights BLAZE. For a moment, Li Jiang is silhouetted against the brilliance, a solitary figure holding the weight of a promise kept.

A white light flashes across the screen.

title: The Disgraced General and the Widow
description: A widow who was saved by a general's kindness witnesses his downfall and recalls how his compassion once saved her life.
context:
Title: The Disgraced General and the Widow
Description: A widow who was saved by a general's kindness witnesses his downfall and recalls how his compassion once saved her life.

INT. MARKETPLACE - DAY

The marketplace is bustling with people, noisy and chaotic.

SISTER-IN-LAW
(anxiously)
The pig slipped its rope!

LU QINIANG
I'll catch it, sister.

A pig runs wildly through the crowd. LU QINIANG, a plump woman in red, chases after it with all her might.

LU QINIANG
Not so fast!

LU QINIANG acts quickly and skillfully, lassoing the pig with a rope.

LU QINIANG
(panting, triumphantly)
Got him!

SISTER-IN-LAW runs over and gives LU QINIANG a thumbs up.

SISTER-IN-LAW
(taking the rope)
Hold tight. I won't chase him twice.

LU QINIANG
My thanks.

SISTER-IN-LAW
I'll fatten him a few days. First cut is yours.

LU QINIANG
(hands on hips, laughing)
Good!

Two scholars in silk robes watch from a tea stall.

SCHOLAR A
A woman of substance.

SCHOLAR B
Substance a poor man can't afford.
continuation:
LU QINIANG
(displeased)
Never seen a woman work? Small minds.

A squad of armored GUARDS shoves through the crowd, flanking a prison cart.

GUARD LEADER
Clear the way! State criminal! Stand back!

LU QINIANG
(hands on hips, dismissively)
He looks heavy.

GUARD LEADER
Foolish woman. This is General Xiao Yan, Vanquisher of Enemies.

LU QINIANG is startled. Her hand moves to a worn leather pouch at her waist. She looks toward the prison cart. Inside, a handsome man covered in wounds (XIAO YAN) keeps his head lowered.

LU QINIANG
(thinking)
Xiao Yan?

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

FLASHBACK

The battlefield is littered with corpses, flames and smoke everywhere. ZHANG HEYAO falls during fierce combat.

He lies among the bodies, quietly opening his eyes. His fingers find a jade token in his sleeve - his wife's parting gift. He smiles, tight and cruel, then closes his eyes and continues playing dead.

EXT. OUTSIDE LU FAMILY HOME - DAY

FLASHBACK

Rain hammers the courtyard. LU QINIANG, gaunt and pale, shivers in a thin robe. A SOLDIER stands at the gate, a wooden box in his arms.

SOLDIER
Zhang Heyao, confirmed fallen. Compensation from the general's office.

The SOLDIER opens the box. Inside: five silver ingots and a battered jade token.

SOLDIER
The general made sure you were provided for. Live well.

LU QINIANG takes the box. Behind her, the Zhang family door slams shut. The bolt slides.

She clutches the token against her chest, then tucks it into her waist pouch. Rain streams down her face, mixing with tears.

She doesn't wipe them.

title: Landing Ashore, Discarding the Devoted Husband First
description: A man who built his wife's streaming career watches as she betrays his trust with false advertising and is tempted by her ex-lover.
context:
Title: Landing Ashore, Discarding the Devoted Husband First
Description: A man who built his wife's streaming career watches as she betrays his trust with false advertising and is tempted by her ex-lover.

INT. LIVE STREAMING ROOM - DAY

WEIYA and another FEMALE HOST are live streaming, selling products. WEIYA glances at a monitor showing real-time sales figures ticking upward.

WEIYA
This tea is completely different from anything else on the market. Our blend can relieve rhinitis, reduce fever, even help with urticaria—

FEMALE HOST
(nervously)
That's what the traditional medicine studies suggest, yes—

WEIYA
And the antioxidants can inhibit cancer cell growth. You heard that right. So who wants it?

FEMALE HOST
We do!

WEIYA
Who's ready to change their life?

FEMALE HOST
We are!

INT. QIN MING'S OFFICE - DAY

QIN MING sits at his desk, watching Weiya's live stream on his phone, his brow furrowed. A poster appears on the phone screen showing Weiya has achieved "Sales Champion" with "Sales Breaking 100 Million."

QIN MING (V.O.)
Three years of scripts. Countless all-nights selecting products. I built her from nothing to a hundred-million-dollar empire. Where did I lose her?

EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE - DAY

A black luxury car stops abruptly. CHEN GUO and XIANG TAI exit, visibly distressed.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
(to CHEN GUO)
Mr. Chen, the live stream just claimed our floral tea has oncological benefits.

XIANG TAI
That's not just deceptive—that's regulatory suicide.

CHEN GUO
We need to shut this down before the authorities notice.

XIANG TAI
Qin Ming's office. Now.
continuation:
INT. QIN MING'S OFFICE - DAY

CHEN GUO and XIANG TAI burst in. Qin Ming and his ASSISTANT stand.

CHEN GUO
(calm but firm)
Qin Ming, your wife just made unsubstantiated medical claims. The FDA warning will arrive before the day ends.

XIANG TAI
And the learning machine? Contract price: $1,800. Her price: $2,800. That's breach of contract and price gouging.

On Qin Ming's laptop, Weiya's stream continues.

WEIYA (in the live stream)
—not five thousand, not four thousand. Only two thousand eight hundred for the future of your child's education!

XIANG TAI
Our legal team is drafting papers. Right now.

QIN MING
(measured)
She must have received the wrong script revision.

ASSISTANT
(hesitant)
Mr. Qin... Sister Weiya said your script was... "too conservative for today's algorithm." She had her team rewrite it.

Qin Ming's knuckles go white on the desk edge. He stares at the screen, then executes a remote kill command. The stream goes black.

QIN MING (V.O.)
The script wasn't conservative. It was sustainable. But sustainability doesn't trend.

WEIYA, wearing a white dress, storms into the office, phone clutched like a weapon.

WEIYA
You killed my stream? I was five minutes from breaking my own record!

QIN MING
You were five minutes from a federal investigation.

WEIYA
I was giving them a story they could believe in! Your scripts treat them like children—

QIN MING
They trust you!

WEIYA
They want to be transformed! They want miracles! I'm just smart enough to sell them what they already want to buy. If they can't afford it, that's economics, not ethics.

QIN MING
Xiao Ya, this isn't the plan we—

WEIYA
(throwing her phone on the desk)
Your plan caps my growth! With my numbers, I am the plan now. You, the merchants—you adapt to me.

Applause from the doorway. FAN CHEN leans against the frame, impeccably tailored.

FAN CHEN
Selling transformation instead of product? That's not a crime, Qin Ming. That's evolution.

FAN CHEN
(to Weiya)
You're performing heart surgery with a knife the board dulls after each use. Come build with me. Equity partnership. Full creative control. No one holding the algorithmic reins.

FAN CHEN
(to Qin Ming, almost sympathetic)
You taught her to swim. Now she needs deeper water.

His smile isn't triumphant. It's certain.

title: Cherished in His Heart
description: A young woman discovers she is pregnant after a mysterious night with a stranger, unaware that he is searching for her.
context:
Title: Cherished in His Heart
Description: A young woman discovers she is pregnant after a mysterious night with a stranger, unaware that he is searching for her.

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

The sterile room smells of antiseptic. SU QIN (23, anxious but composed) sits across from a NURSE (40s, professional but tired) who consults a tablet.

NURSE
Ms. Su? Your results are ready.

The nurse slides a diagnostic report across the desk. SU QIN's fingers tremble as she picks it up.

INSERT - ULTRASOUND IMAGE
A small gestational sac, 6 weeks.

SU QIN (V.O.)
Six weeks. That night... the man in the hotel.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Handheld, dreamlike. SU QIN stumbles, fanning herself. Her face is flushed, breathing ragged. She clutches the wall for support.

SU QIN (V.O.)
(hushed)
So hot... what did they put in my drink?

GU BEISHEN (29, sharp features blurred in the darkness) appears, equally unsteady, his expensive shirt unbuttoned. He grips a doorframe.

They notice each other. Time slows.

GU BEISHEN
(bruised voice)
You're... from the family dinner?

SU QIN
(confused, defensive)
What? No. I'm just—

She backs into a wall. He follows, but stops an arm's length away. Their eyes lock. Something passes between them—recognition of mutual vulnerability.

GU BEISHEN
(whisper)
You're not her. But you smell like...

He leans in slightly. SU QIN doesn't pull away. Their foreheads almost touch.

SU QIN
(barely audible)
Gardenias.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK CONTINUES)

Dimly lit. They fall through the door together, a tangle of urgent need and shared desperation.

QUICK CUTS:
- Their hands clasp, fingers intertwining.
- GU BEISHEN's thumb wipes a tear from SU QIN's cheek.
- He produces a simple pearl earring from his pocket.
- She flinches as he gently fastens it to her lobe.

GU BEISHEN
(whispering against her temple)
This will keep you safe.

SU QIN
(aching)
I don't even know your name.

He kisses her before she can finish. The world dissolves.

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

BACK TO SCENE.

SU QIN looks up from the report, pale.

NURSE
Ms. Su? Are you alright?

SU QIN
(stammering)
I... I don't know how to—

NURSE
(softening)
It's a lot. Your chart says you're unmarried. Do you have family support?

SU QIN
My parents are...

She stops. The nurse nods, understanding.

NURSE
You have options. But you're already near the surgical cutoff. If you're considering termination, costs run 6-8 thousand, depending—

SU QIN
(quietly)
That's... I don't have—

NURSE
(sighs)
Then you'll need to decide fast. Either way, you'll need prenatal vitamins if you continue.

The nurse stands, leaving SU QIN with the report. She touches the pearl earring still in her ear.

INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - DAY

GU BEISHEN (immaculate suit, controlled) walks with LU LINJING (32, cheerful doctor). Both carry coffee.

LU LINJING
Ninth Brother, you flew three thousand miles because you "can't feel anything"? That's not a medical diagnosis, that's poetic despair.

GU BEISHEN
(icy)
My therapist recommended a change of scenery. Not a commentary.

LU LINJING
Right. And testing for every allergy known to medicine was... what?

GU BEISHEN
Precaution.

They pass the consultation wing desk. SU QIN emerges, folding her report into her bag, her hair concealing her face.

GU BEISHEN freezes. His nostrils flare subtly. He turns.

HIS POV: SU QIN walking away. A glimpse of her profile. The pearl earring catches the fluorescent light.

GU BEISHEN (V.O.)
Gardenias... and the earring. It's her.

He starts after her, abandoned coffee cup in hand.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Secret of Club No. 9
description: At an elite club, a powerful woman named Tina selects male consultants from thousands of applicants, testing their skincare knowledge and ability to handle demanding clients.
context:
Title: The Secret of Club No. 9
Description: At an elite club, a powerful woman named Tina selects male consultants from thousands of applicants, testing their skincare knowledge and ability to handle demanding clients.

INT. TOP-TIER CLUB - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Feisi Club No. 9 - Private Consultation Wing

Fifteen MALE CONSULTANTS stand at attention along a mirrored corridor. Their black linen uniforms and translucent face shields create an anonymous, clinical line.

MALE ASSISTANT
Sister Tina. Final candidates from thirty thousand applicants.

TINA'S REFLECTION appears in the mirror before she does—gold glasses, sleek suit, assessing eyes. She walks the line with a digital stylus in hand.

TINA
Your face is your resume here. But resumes can be airbrushed. Skin can't.

Tina stops before CONSULTANT #7. His shoulders tense.

She lifts his face shield. Studies him. Her stylus hovers near his jaw.

TINA
(quietly)
This redness isn't acne. It's over-exfoliation. You panicked and tried to fix your skin last night, didn't you?

Consultant #7's jaw tightens.

TINA
Our clients can smell desperation. Thank you for your time.

She taps her stylus. He exits, dignity intact but defeated.
