title: Rather Die Than Submit
description: A young girl confronts the Emperor on the street, claiming he is her father, shocking the crowd who believed he came to select concubines.
context:
Title: Rather Die Than Submit
Description: A young girl confronts the Emperor on the street, claiming he is her father, shocking the crowd who believed he came to select concubines.

EXT. ANCIENT STREET - DAY

SOLDIERS in crimson armor shove forward, their spear-butts thudding against cobblestones. DESPERATE WOMEN clutch hand-painted portraits and wilting lotus blossoms, pressing against the soldiers' shields.

SOLDIER
Make way! Make way! By order of the Crown Prince!

Shoving intensifies. A crone's basket spills—dates scatter, trampled underfoot.

From a shadowed doorway, YUEYUE (9, filthy, in threadbare hemp) clutches a silk scroll. She unrolls it: a vibrant imperial portrait with edges worn by countless secret viewings.

At the procession's head, PRINCE XIAO CHENGRUI (30s, cold-eyed) surveys the crowd like a falcon. Behind his mount, the Emperor's carriage—black lacquer, unadorned, its curtains sealed tight.

WOMAN A
(voice cracking)
Ten years... ten years since any woman entered the Jade Pavilion!

WOMAN B
(shoving a painting through a guard's arm)
The astrologers said the Phoenix Star aligns today! He must choose!

XIAO CHENGRUI wheels his horse toward the carriage, his voice low but cutting.

XIAO CHENGRUI
Imperial Brother. Mother grows desperate. You grace these filthy streets for temple incense while your throne stands heirless. She demands you return with at least three new consorts.

He straightens in his saddle, suddenly projecting his voice for the masses.

XIAO CHENGRUI
Hear this! His Majesty rides today for the Temple of Heaven's Blessing—not for any lowborn selection!

A groan ripples through the crowd. Hope falters.

XIAO CHENGRUI
(silkily)
continuation:
But should any maiden's... virtue... pierce his refined sorrow? She would be raised as high as the moon itself.

The crowd erupts. Women surge, paintings tearing, flowers crushed. The soldiers grin—more chaos means more bribes.

From the carriage, a voice like grinding jade.

XIAO JINGRUI (O.S.)
Enough, Chengrui. You play too long with mice.

Yueyue's knuckles whiten around the portrait. She whispers to its painted eyes.

YUEYUE
(to herself)
Mother died whispering your name. I won't.

She bolts. Small and quick, she darts between legs, past the soldiers' line—

XIAO CHENGRUI
(reining in his horse)
Whoa!

His horse rears, hooves flashing. Yueyue stands her ground, arms spread, holding the portrait up like a shield.

XIAO CHENGRUI
What gutter spawn—

The carriage door opens. EMPEROR XIAO JINGRUI (40s, face carved by years of solitude) emerges. His gaze finds Yueyue.

Her chin lifts. Tears cut clean tracks through the dirt on her cheeks. Her voice carries—clear, young, unbreakable.

YUEYUE
Father. Your daughter Yueyue has waited seven winters.

Silence. Even the soldiers freeze.

WOMAN A
(whispered prayer)
She called him Father. The gods forgive us all.

title: Bound by Heart
description: A peasant girl sold to a brothel is bought by a mysterious lord who forces her to impersonate a minister's daughter and marry the Crown Prince to retrieve a secret item.
context:
Title: Bound by Heart
Description: A peasant girl sold to a brothel is bought by a mysterious lord who forces her to impersonate a minister's daughter and marry the Crown Prince to retrieve a secret item.

INT. DRUNKEN FLOWER BROTHEL - DAY

Dust motes swirl in the lantern light. SU WANWAN, seventeen, calloused hands clutching torn hemp clothing, is shoved to the filthy floor. She scrambles backward like a cornered animal.

SU WANWAN
(pleading)
Father, please—not me! The spring planting isn't done. The well needs mending. Who'll care for Mother when the cough returns?

FATHER
(hollow-eyed, reeking of sorghum wine)
The fields are ruined. The well is dry. Your mother died last winter.

He delivers a numb kick to her ribs—more exhaustion than malice. She curls around the blow.

MADAM
(red lacquered nails tapping a wooden paddle)
First lesson, piglet. My house, my rules.

Su Wanwan bolts. A SERVANT'S meaty hand snags her hair. Another clamps her waist. She thrashes, kicking over a spittoon.

SU WANWAN
(between gritted teeth)
Let—me—go!

ZHAO JIN
(emerging from shadows)
Hold her still.

Outside, a carriage with no markings stops. The curtain parts a finger's width. HUAN CHU's gaze flickers over the scene like a snake tasting air.

MADAM
(sugar-sweet, bowing low)
My deepest apologies, my lord. Fresh stock, still feral. We'll have her docile by month's end.

HUAN CHU
(voice barely a murmur)
I'll take that one.

MADAM
(stuttering)
This... this one?

ZHAO JIN
(produces a silk pouch)
Her entire debt. Plus twenty years of your best earnings.

He spills golden taels like water. They clink against the floorboards, rolling. The Madam's eyes fix on the gold, then on Su Wanwan—truly seeing her for the first time.

MADAM
(hand trembling as she extends the contract)
Take her. She was born for better things.

ZHAO JIN
(tears the parchment once, twice)
Her past is ash.

Su Wanwan is half-carried toward the carriage. Her father lunges for a rolling tael.

FATHER
(to Madam)
You gave me two silvers! She's worth a hundred!

MADAM
(to Bouncer)
Break his fingers.

TRANSITION: Three weeks later
continuation:
INT. LUXURIOUS CHAMBER - DAY

Sunlight cuts through sandalwood incense, illuminating SU WANWAN in bridal scarlet. She doesn't touch the silk—holds herself as if the fabric might bite. Her reflection in the bronze mirror is a stranger.

HUAN CHU stands at the lattice window, a cut-paper silhouette.

HUAN CHU
The Grand Secretary's daughter died of fever last month. You have her name, her face, and now—her destiny.

SU WANWAN
(frozen)
You mean... the prince thinks I'm—

HUAN CHU
In three days, you marry the Crown Prince. You will be perfectly behaved.

SU WANWAN
(laughs, bordering hysteria)
I'll be dead in three days. They'll see through me before the first tea ceremony.

HUAN CHU
(turns, sword sliding from scabbard)
Then you'll die here instead.

The blade's tip catches the light, rests beneath her jaw. Su Wanwan's breath stills. Her eyes drop to the jade-inlaid hilt, then to his face—searching for bluff. Finding none.

SU WANWAN
(whisper)
What do you want from me?

HUAN CHU
The Prince keeps a jade seal in his private study. It opens a box. Bring me the box.

SU WANWAN
(swallowing against steel)
And if I do? If I'm lucky enough to live that long?

HUAN CHU
Your contract burns. You get fifty taels and a new name in a southern province.

SU WANWAN's fingers twitch. Her eyes calculate—fifty taels. A field. A house that locks. A life.

SU WANWAN
(very slowly)
I'm strong. I learn fast. And I've kept secrets before.

HUAN CHU
Three months. Fail, and your father doesn't die—he merely wishes he had.

SU WANWAN
(voice flat)
He's already dead to me.

HUAN CHU
(smile without warmth)
Then I'll take your hands instead. The Prince prefers docile wives.

SU WANWAN
(pale, but eyes steady)
I'll get your box.

HUAN CHU
Zhao Jin—take her to the governess. If she uses one phrase of village dialect, cut out her tongue.

ZHAO JIN
Yes, my lord.

Su Wanwan rises. Her hands shake, but she smooths the bridal silk with the same reverence she'd show a plow handle—tool of her survival.

SU WANWAN
(to herself, barely audible)
Just another field to tend.

She follows Zhao Jin out. Huan Chu watches her go, his expression for once uncertain.

title: Cute Baby National Master: Asked to Perform Immortal Arts, You Perform Magic Tricks
description: A world-famous magician transmigrates into a seven-year-old national master in an ancient dynasty, where he must use his magic tricks to solve supernatural crises and help the struggling empress.
context:
Title: Cute Baby National Master: Asked to Perform Immortal Arts, You Perform Magic Tricks
Description: A world-famous magician transmigrates into a seven-year-old national master in an ancient dynasty, where he must use his magic tricks to solve supernatural crises and help the struggling empress.

INT. TRUCK - DAY

ZHAO XU, a young and handsome man, drives a cargo truck through heavy rain, jaw tight with fatigue.

On the passenger seat, his phone rings. The caller ID shows "Boss Zhou."

ZHAO XU taps the phone. 

BOSS ZHOU (V.O.)
Xu. Five thousand seats. You're on in twenty.

ZHAO XU
(casually)
Prop check ran long. I'm five minutes out.

BOSS ZHOU (V.O.)
Don't make me remind you what's riding on this.

ZHAO XU
You won't have to.

He hangs up. Rain hammers the windshield.

ZHAO XU
(muttering)
One last show. Then I'm done.

A CYCLIST swerves in front of the truck without warning.

ZHAO XU's eyes widen. He slams the brakes.

Tires SCREAM. The truck HYDROPLANES.

EXT. NATIONAL MASTER'S RESIDENCE - DAY

An elegant ancient-style mansion with a plaque reading "National Master's Residence."

A EUNUCH stands at the entrance, voice cracking with urgency.

EUNUCH
Imperial decree has arrived!
continuation:
INT. NATIONAL MASTER'S RESIDENCE MAIN HALL - DAY

ZHAO XU, now a seven-year-old child in oversized robes, sleeps fitfully on a worn couch.

LU LINGLONG, a young maidservant with ink-stained fingers, shakes him awake.

LU LINGLONG
Master! The palace summons—now!

ZHAO XU
(groggy)
The what?

LU LINGLONG
An imperial decree! After three years of nothing but porridge! Do you know how hard it is to stretch one bag of flash powder?

ZHAO XU sits up, rubbing his eyes, and catches his reflection in a bronze mirror—seven-year-old face.

ZHAO XU
We're still this short?

LU LINGLONG
You're seven.

ZHAO XU (V.O.)
Seven years. One truck crash. A thousand magic props turned to ash—except what I held. I've performed for rats to survive. Today, I perform for a queen.

ZHAO XU stands, rolling up too-long sleeves.

ZHAO XU
Fetch the remaining smoke bombs. We're going to work.

LU LINGLONG
(voice cracking)
Thank the heavens.

EXT. PALACE SQUARE - DAY

EMPRESS WU, 25, stands rigid in plain armor. PRINCESS MEI, her younger sister, hovers close.

PRINCESS
Imperial Sister, the National Master is a child. What can he possibly—

EMPRESS
The tax silver didn't vanish. It was taken by something that left no footprints. Minister Cai blames my rule. I blame myself.

MINISTER CAI, smirking, approaches with a scroll.

MINISTER CAI
(mockingly)
Your Majesty, the hour expires. Perhaps the spirits are too greedy, they've eaten your little magician too?

The EUNUCH's voice cuts through the wind.

EUNUCH
The National Master has arrived!

OFFICIALS glance around. The square is empty except for swirling dust.

OFFICIAL
Where? I see nothing.

EMPRESS
Show yourself!

PRINCESS
(points)
There!

At the far end of the square, a single red silk ribbon unfurls—snaking across the stones as if pulled by invisible hands.

ZHAO XU (V.O.)
Last smoke bomb. Don't choke.

Thick white mist EXPLODES upward. Through it, a crimson carpet rolls out.

ZHAO XU, in ill-fitting National Master robes, walks the carpet alone. Every step echoes.

His seven-year-old face is stone-cold serious.

ZHAO XU
(to himself)
Showtime. For real.

One more task. Just this.

A WHITE SERPENT erupts from the frozen pool, scales scraping stone. Feng Xi doesn't scream—she rolls, grabs a sharp icicle, and drives it into the beast's eye as it strikes. Black vapor hisses from the wound. She collapses, clutching her ribs.

Feng Xi crawls back to the flower. Her fingers close around the stem.

SHEN ZHILAN (20s, immaculate white robes) appears at the cave entrance, already holding a cluster of identical blossoms.

SHEN ZHILAN
(mock pity)
All that effort for a weed.

FENG XI
(frozen)
Senior Sister... those are Ice Lilies. The Essence is—

SHEN ZHILAN
I know what it is. I also know you logged the coordinates in the sect ledger three days ago.

Feng Xi's face crumples—not with rage, but dawning betrayal.

FENG XI
(quietly)
You've been waiting.

SHEN ZHILAN
(smiling)
I let you clear the path. Consider it... a service to your betters.

FENG XI
(struggling up)
I'll report this. Master sees the truth in blood memory.

She pulls out a jade talisman. Shen Zhilan's smile flickers—panic, then something harder.

SHEN ZHILAN
(tossing the lilies)
Then remember this.
continuation:
The flowers arc through the air. As Feng Xi's eyes follow them, Shen Zhilan's sword flashes—not at her heart, but her wrist. The blade pins Feng Xin's sword-hand to the ice wall. The talisman falls.

FENG XI
(gasping)
My meridians...

SHEN ZHILAN
Now you can't hold a blade. Can't prove a thing.

She plucks the glowing Essence from Feng Xi's slack fingers.

SHEN ZHILAN
(softly)
You were supposed to stay in the outer sect where you belonged. Grateful. Invisible.

She turns to leave. Feng Xi spits blood onto the ice.

FENG XI
(whispered)
I was never invisible.

INT. MODERN OFFICE - CUBICLE - NIGHT

OFFICE WORKER (20s, hoodie, dead eyes) stares at the same scene on her laptop. She knows what's next.

OFFICE WORKER
(to the screen)
Don't say it. Don't you dare—

She slams the laptop shut. The blue standby light flares, reflecting in her glasses. It pulses once, twice—then floods the cubicle.

OFFICE WORKER
(tired, unsurprised)
Third time this month.

INT. EXTREME COLD ILLUSION REALM - CAVE - DAY

Feng Xi's eyes snap open—different eyes. She stares at her impaled hand, the blood, the robes. Her first breath is a laugh, bitter and familiar.

FENG XI/OFFICE WORKER
(quietly)
Chapter forty-seven. The one where the plot armor cracks.

She looks at the cave entrance where Shen Zhilan disappeared.

FENG XI/OFFICE WORKER
(to herself, determined)
Okay, Feng Xi. Let's see if we can rewrite this ending.

title: My Brother is the Chosen One
description: A man reincarnates as a villain destined to oppose his younger brother, the legendary Chosen One, and discovers he can grow stronger by beating him up.
context:
Title: My Brother is the Chosen One
Description: A man reincarnates as a villain destined to oppose his younger brother, the legendary Chosen One, and discovers he can grow stronger by beating him up.

INT. QIN FAMILY ESTATE - COURTYARD - NIGHT

Crimson lanterns drift across the ink-black sky. QIN TIAN (30s, exhausted) paces the sandstone courtyard, his robes disheveled. The QIN FAMILY ANCESTOR (ancient, dignified) leans on a jade staff.

QIN TIAN
(whispering)
One hundred years... one hundred winters of immortal elixir and prayers.

QIN FAMILY ANCESTOR
(gnarled hand trembling)
Patience, grandson. The heavens honor those who wait.

QIN TIAN
(low, desperate)
The other clans whisper of curses. Of a lineage that dies with me.

He stops, staring up at the bleeding moon.

INT. DELIVERY ROOM - CONTINUOUS

LADY QIN (beautiful, deathly pale) clutches silk sheets, her scream muffled by a jade bite-guard. MIDWIFE WANG (60s, steady hands) presses cool compresses to her brow.

MIDWIFE
Breathe, my lady. The child rides the lightning.

Lady QIN's knuckles whiten. A single tear escapes.

INT. CHAOTIC SPACE - VOID

QIN CHANGSHENG (glowing fetus, consciousness flickering) floats in a nebula of memory and potential.

QIN CHANGSHENG (V.O.)
Three years since I died in that hospital bed. Three years since this system yanked my soul into this... womb. But they've been waiting a century.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Alert: Host's Emperor Potential detected. Final integration complete. Rewards: Thirty-Three Heavens Fortune Art. Celestial phenomenon pending activation.

EXT. QIN FAMILY ESTATE - COURTYARD - CONTINUOUS

The sky hemorrhages crimson. A blood moon calcifies overhead—massive, predatory. Qin Tian falls to his knees. The Ancestor's staff clatters to stone.

QIN TIAN
(hoarse)
The omen...

QIN FAMILY ANCESTOR
(awe and terror warring)
"When the blood moon swallows the heart-star, a sovereign of shadow rises." This child... he may doom the Ancient Wasteland.

QIN TIAN
(defiant)
 Then we'll teach him to wield that shadow. He's my son.
continuation:
INT. CHAOTIC SPACE - CONTINUOUS

A SECOND FETUS manifests—golden, voracious, drawing essence from Changsheng like a black hole.

QIN CHANGSHENG (V.O.)
My brother. The sun to my eclipse. Even now, he drains the immortal essence mother drank for a century. But I learned something last week...

CHANGSHENG's embryonic form lashes out with a spectral kick.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Villain Points +10. Emperor Potential amplified. Host's attributes increasing tenfold.

QIN CHANGSHENG (V.O.)
(quietly savage)
The system rewards every strike. Every humiliation. I was a cancer patient who couldn't fight back. Now... I have a reason to fight.

EXT. QIN FAMILY ESTATE - DELIVERY ROOM DOOR - DAWN

Midwife Wang bursts through, a wriggling bundle in her arms. The blood moon begins to pale.

MIDWIFE
Master Qin! The firstborn—breathing and crying!

QIN TIAN
(trembling)
Let me see him—

He reaches with hands that have killed men. The baby opens his eyes—inky black, ancient.

QIN TIAN
(choked)
My son...

QIN FAMILY ANCESTOR
(leaning close)
The features of our line. Strong.

QIN TIAN
(laughing through tears)
He has his mother's eyes.

QIN CHANGSHENG (V.O.)
I see a man ready to die for me. That's... new.

QIN TIAN
How is my wife?

Midwife Wang's face clouds.

INT. DELIVERY ROOM - CONTINUOUS

Qin Tian rushes in. Lady Qin breathes raggedly, her body spent.

MIDWIFE
(quietly)
Master... the second child. He is... waiting. He demands three more years of gestation.

QIN TIAN
(shocked)
Demands?

LADY QIN
(whisper)
I can feel him... he's singing to himself. He says he's not finished.

INT. CHAOTIC SPACE - CONTINUOUS

CHANGSHENG floats, his spectral fists clenched.

QIN CHANGSHENG (V.O.)
No. No more waiting. I've hoarded thirty-three thousand points for this moment. If he stays, the system starves.

INT. DELIVERY ROOM - CONTINUOUS

QIN CHANGSHENG, in his father's arms, lets out a controlled, powerful wail. A shockwave of raw qi EXPLODES outward.

QIN TIAN
(grunting)
The roof—

They CRASH through wood and tile in a tangle of limbs and love. Qin Tian lands hard, shielding the baby with his body. Blood trickles from his scalp.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Filial piety subversion detected. Villain Points +500.

QIN CHANGSHENG (V.O.)
What? Even when they love me, I win?

The Ancestor helps Qin Tian stand. The baby reaches a tiny hand toward his father's bleeding brow.

QIN FAMILY ANCESTOR
(amazed)
He controlled it. Ten times the strength, but he pulled back. My grandson... he chose to spare you.

QIN TIAN
(dazed, laughing)
He's thinking? Already?

Split screen: Qin Tian weeps with pride. Qin Changsheng's infant face shows the ghost of a smile—not cruel. Calculating. But something else flickers in those dark eyes: the memory of being helpless. Of being saved.

FADE OUT.

title: Rescue from the Flames
description: A factory worker risks his life to save a woman and a baby from a burning building, adopting the child as his own daughter.
context:
Title: Rescue from the Flames
Description: A factory worker risks his life to save a woman and a baby from a burning building, adopting the child as his own daughter.

INT. FACTORY STAIRWELL - NIGHT

A raging fire roars through the production floor. Smoke billows up the stairwell. A WORKER in blue coveralls shouts over the alarm.

WORKER
Fire! Everyone evacuate now!

Workers scramble down the stairs, covering their faces.

WORKER 2
The chemical storage! It's going to blow!

EXT. FACTORY YARD - NIGHT

Workers gather at a safe distance. YANG TIANWEI (40s), his scarred face streaked with soot, collapses against a barrel.

WORKER 3
Catch your breath, Old Yang. The manager—Director Zhang—is still inside.

PRODUCTION CHIEF
And two infants in the second-floor nursery.

Yang Tianwei looks at the flames, then bolts back toward the building.

WORKER 4
You can't! The roof's collapsing!

INT. BURNING FACTORY - NIGHT

Flames lick at the conveyor belts. ZHANG MEI crawls toward the exit, choking on smoke.

ZHANG MEI
Help... someone...

Yang Tianwei bursts through the doorway, spots her.

YANG TIANWEI
I've got you. Hold on.

He lifts her in a fireman's carry, shielding her from falling embers.

EXT. FACTORY YARD - NIGHT

Workers wait by the ambulance. The Production Chief checks his clipboard.

PRODUCTION CHIEF
Zhang Mei, the new director. And her sister's baby in childcare.

Yang stumbles out with Zhang Mei. Workers rush to help.

WORKER 3
Over here! Quick!

As paramedics load Zhang Mei into the ambulance, Yang turns back to the inferno.

WORKER 4
Yang! It's too late!
continuation:
INT. BURNING FACTORY - NIGHT

Yang climbs the collapsing staircase to the second-floor nursery. A burning beam crashes behind him.

In the smoke-filled room, a BABY cries in a crib. Yang wraps the infant in a wet blanket.

YANG TIANWEI
(softly)
Got you. Got you.

EXT. FACTORY RUINS - NIGHT

Yang sits on the ground, exhausted, cradling the baby. The ambulance with Zhang Mei drives away, sirens wailing.

YANG TIANWEI
(to baby)
Your aunt saved my life once. Now I've got you.

He touches the scar on his face.

YANG TIANWEI
I'll call you Xiao Ai. For the mountain that raised me.

He lies back, holding her close.

EXT. VILLAGE COURTYARD - DAY

TITLE CARD: 6 Years Later

Young YANG XIAO AI (6) puffs her cheeks, trying to play a child-sized suona. Yang Tianwei guides her fingers.

YANG TIANWEI
Breathe from here. Not from here.

He touches her belly, then her mouth. Xiao Ai manages three notes.

XIAO AI
I did it!

YANG TIANWEI
That's the spirit. Again. Do-re-mi...

They play together, her small melody following his deeper tune.

TITLE CARD: 14 Years Later

Adult YANG XIAO AI (20) plays a mournful suona piece. Yang Tianwei listens, tapping his foot.

He stops her at a key phrase.

YANG TIANWEI
The high note needs weight. It's a life, not just a sound.

YANG XIAO AI
(frustrated)
I want to play joy, not sorrow. I want to leave this village.

YANG TIANWEI
This is our living. My living.

YANG XIAO AI
Your living. Not mine.

She stands, packing her suona case.

YANG TIANWEI
Xiao Ai...

YANG XIAO AI
I'm auditioning in Shanghai. For a music academy.

She walks away, leaving Yang holding her vegetables.

YANG TIANWEI
Take your suona!

She doesn't turn back.

INT. LUXURIOUS OFFICE - DAY

ZHANG MEI (50s), elegant and poised, shows her daughter ZHANG RONG a worn photograph of Yang Tianwei with the baby.

ZHANG MEI
For twenty years I've searched. Comas, surgeries, building the company... but I never forgot.

ZHANG RONG
The private investigator found them. Ai Mountain Village. He's raised her as his own.

ZHANG MEI
(tears in eyes)
She's a musician. Like her mother wanted.

ZHANG RONG
She's coming to Shanghai tomorrow. For an audition.

Zhang Mei looks at the photo, then out the window.

INT. YANG TIANWEI'S HOME - NIGHT

Yang Tianwei polishes his suona. His phone buzzes. A text from Xiao Ai: "Arrived safely. Audition tomorrow."

He smiles. Another message appears, from an unknown number: "Director Zhang Mei knows. She's coming."

Yang's face goes pale. He looks at the old scar in the mirror, then at a photo of six-year-old Xiao Ai with her suona.

He grips the instrument tightly.

title: Social Butterfly Baby Saves Cannon Fodder Mom in Period Drama
description: A modern reader transmigrates into a period novel as the weak female lead who must stand up to her oppressive in-laws to protect her genius twins.
context:
Title: Social Butterfly Baby Saves Cannon Fodder Mom in Period Drama
Description: A modern reader transmigrates into a period novel as the weak female lead who must stand up to her oppressive in-laws to protect her genius twins.

INT. READER'S HOME - NIGHT

A young woman (NOVEL READER) in a white nightgown lies on the sofa, focused on reading a novel on her phone.

NOVEL READER
(sighing)
Tian Cuifen... you vicious old bat.

She stares at the text on her phone screen, frowning, getting more and more angry.

NOVEL READER
(in disbelief)
How is she putting up with this?

She suddenly sits up from the sofa, throws her phone aside, and stands up in anger.

NOVEL READER
(furious)
That's it! This story is infuriating! The heroine has a battalion commander husband, gave birth to brilliant twins, and what does she do? Lets her in-laws bleed her dry while her children suffer.

The more she thinks about it, the angrier she gets, and she starts pacing around the room.

NOVEL READER
(talking to herself)
If it were me...

She suddenly stops, her eyes determined, and starts gesturing.

NOVEL READER
(excitedly)
I'd kick that biased mother-in-law to the curb and knock that leech of a sister-in-law flat!

She makes kicking and punching motions, as if venting her emotions.

NOVEL READER
(satisfied)
That's more like it.

After venting, she calms down and sees a document on the table. She picks it up to look. It's a diagnosis report.

NOVEL READER
(dejected)
Infertile. If I could be like the heroine and have two perfect twins, I'd never let them endure this.

As she's feeling sad, a strong light suddenly emanates around her body and engulfs her.

NOVEL READER
(screaming in terror)
What the—?!
continuation:
INT. NOVEL WORLD - DAY

You little tramp, if our family hadn't sacrificed to send Donglin to the army, you'd have starved long ago. My daughter needs this house for her wedding. Pack your things. Tonight.

Two children (TWINS) stand not far away, looking at them fearfully.

NOVEL READER/JIANG NINGNING
(confused)
Where is this?

She looks around and sees a calendar on the wall that reads "1976".

NOVEL READER/JIANG NINGNING
(shocked)
Nineteen seventy-six?

Her head throbs with pain as a flood of memories that don't belong to her rush into her mind.

FLASHBACK BEGINS

The scene blurs, presenting the plot from the novel.

A handsome man in military uniform (HUO DONGLIN) speaks to a woman who looks just like her (ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING).

ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING (V.O.)

Why does that woman have my face?

TIAN CUIFEN (V.O.)

The scene switches again. ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING has given birth to twins.

HUO CHUNFANG gossips behind ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING'S back.

TIAN CUIFEN forces the weak ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING, who just gave birth, to get out of bed and write a letter.

(internal monologue)
If I give them everything, they'll finally accept me as family.

FLASHBACK ENDS

NOVEL READER/JIANG NINGNING awakens from the memories. TIAN CUIFEN is impatiently yelling at her.

title: He Gave Me Starlight
description: A forbidden romance between Sang Muye and Shen Xingli unfolds, but their secret relationship is exposed when her grandfather discovers compromising photos.
context:
Title: He Gave Me Starlight
Description: A forbidden romance between Sang Muye and Shen Xingli unfolds, but their secret relationship is exposed when her grandfather discovers compromising photos.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

SANG MUYE, a bespectacled, refined man, and SHEN XINGLI, a beautiful woman in business attire, stand before a floor-to-ceiling window. The city sprawls below them like scattered starlight.

Their palms press against the glass, fingers interlocking with hesitant tenderness.

SANG MUYE
What are we doing?

SHEN XINGLI's fingers trace across SANG MUYE's lips, his Adam's apple, then grasp his tie.

SHEN XINGLI
What I've wanted since that broken telescope.

She pulls SANG MUYE closer. They embrace tightly, gazing deeply at each other, then kiss passionately.

SANG MUYE
(barely a whisper)
Your grandfather—

SHEN XINGLI
—will never know.

They kiss again, urgent and desperate.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - LATER

The bed is covered with rose petals. SANG MUYE presses SHEN XINGLI beneath him.

SANG MUYE
If he finds out—

SHEN XINGLI
Then at least I had this.

He leans down to kiss her.

INT. SHEN FAMILY MANSION - NIGHT

SHEN XINGLI tiptoes in through the front door, looking nervous.

SHEN XINGLI (V.O.)
Not tonight. Please, not tonight.

She carefully crosses the living room. The room is brightly lit. OLD MASTER SHEN, an elderly man with a stern expression, sits on the sofa with a manila envelope.

OLD MASTER SHEN
Your security detail reported an anomaly.

SHEN XINGLI's body stiffens. She stops in her tracks.

SHEN XINGLI
A business dinner ran late. I should have called.

She smiles and tries to slip away.

OLD MASTER SHEN
Shen Xingli. Did you think I wouldn't recognize his father's building?

He throws surveillance photos onto the coffee table.

OLD MASTER SHEN
Look at what you've done.

SHEN XINGLI hesitantly walks forward and picks up the photos. When she sees their silhouettes against the city lights—starlight trapped between them—her pupils dilate instantly, shock written all over her face. The photos show her and SANG MUYE kissing passionately in the apartment.

OLD MASTER SHEN
(softly, dangerously)
You've brought the son of my enemy into my house. Through my granddaughter.

title: Fairy Child Cheats, Saves Father, Wins Brides, Conquers the World
description: Little Lucky Star Jin Bao steals celestial nectar at the Peach Banquet and replaces it with urine, tricking the Celestial Emperor and all the immortals. The Emperor is furious, and Jin Bao is struck down to the mortal realm by the Nine Heavens Thunder Tribulation to undergo trials, reincarnating into the womb of Princess Xiao Jinlan.
context:
Title: Fairy Child Cheats, Saves Father, Wins Brides, Conquers the World
Description: Little Lucky Star Jin Bao steals celestial nectar at the Peach Banquet and replaces it with urine, tricking the Celestial Emperor and all the immortals. The Emperor is furious, and Jin Bao is struck down to the mortal realm by the Nine Heavens Thunder Tribulation to undergo trials, reincarnating into the womb of Princess Xiao Jinlan.

INT. PEACH BANQUET - DAY

The heavenly palace shrouded in clouds and mist. The Peach Banquet scene with several tables displaying immortal peaches and delicacies.

Little Lucky Star JIN BAO weaves between the tables, tossing an immortal peach into the air and catching it. He picks up a jade bottle and takes a sip.

JIN BAO (V.O.)
(panicked)
The celestial nectar! Father will be furious...

JIN BAO
(having a bright idea)
I'll replace it with essence of morning dew—identical appearance!

JIN BAO closes his eyes and casts a spell. The empty jade bottles on the ground are refilled.

IMMORTALS (O.S.)
This year's celestial nectar is purer than the finest jade!

JIN BAO
(nervous)
Someone's coming!

IMMORTALS (O.S.)
Let us toast to the Emperor's health!

JIN BAO quickly hides beneath a banquet table.

The CELESTIAL EMPEROR and the IMMORTALS arrive at the Peach Banquet.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
(surprised)
Jin Bao? Perfect timing. Help me sample this year's nectar.

JIN BAO
(waving his hand)
I'm just a trainee, Your Majesty. This honor is too great.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
Nonsense. One sip grants a century of wisdom. You need it most.

The CELESTIAL EMPEROR picks up a bottle of "celestial nectar" and prepares to drink.

JIN BAO
(shouting)
Emperor, wait!

The CELESTIAL EMPEROR has already taken a sip.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
(frowning)
Interesting... earthy notes. Unconventional.

TAIBAI JINXING
(choking back laughter)
Dew essence, Your Majesty. The boy's signature move.

The IMMORTALS suppress smiles, accustomed to Jin Bao's antics.

CELESTIAL GENERAL
Your Majesty, the law demands—

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
(raises hand)
continuation:
He who guards the nectar must taste it first. Tradition.

JIN BAO's spell misfires, ringing the Thunder Bell.

The sky fills with dark clouds, lightning and thunder.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
The Nine Heavens Thunder Tribulation? For a child's prank?

A bolt of lightning strikes toward JIN BAO.

JIN BAO
(screaming)
I didn't mean to!

JIN BAO falls from the sky, encased in protective golden light.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
Jin Bao!

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
Heaven tempers flawed jade through trial.

TAIBAI JINXING
This mortal journey will teach him responsibility.

CELESTIAL EMPEROR
When his merit is complete, he shall return. Perhaps then he'll be worthy of his title.

JIN BAO transforms into a golden light, descending from the heavens.

JIN BAO (V.O.)
Mortal life? Maybe I can finally escape celestial law! Wait... what's a 'father'?

EXT. FOREST - DAY

A horse carriage stops in the forest. Guards stand watch.

The golden light flies into the carriage. Inside, PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN rests. The golden light enters PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN's womb.

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN suddenly awakens, feeling the sacred energy.

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN
(whispering)
A celestial soul... chooses me?

YE SHUZE approaches with a physician's bag.

YE SHUZE
(calling out)
Princess, you fainted. I brought medicine—

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN
(shocked, protective)
Stay back!

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN's palm strikes out, maternal magic flaring.

YE SHUZE dodges, eyes widening with recognition.

YE SHUZE
(astonished)
Your Highness... you're carrying the prophesied one.

PRINCESS XIAO JINLAN
(determined)
Then this child already protects his mother. Good.

title: The Best Stand-In
description: A young woman is coerced into seducing her brother-in-law to bear his child in exchange for recognition by her family.
context:
Title: The Best Stand-In
Description: A young woman is coerced into seducing her brother-in-law to bear his child in exchange for recognition by her family.

INT. VILLA EXTERIOR - NIGHT

SONG CHUWAN, a young woman in a black slip dress, walks barefoot by the poolside, her steps silent on the cool stone. She clutches a glass of milk, her knuckles white.

SONG CHUWAN (V.O.)
The water holds a moon that doesn't belong to me. Tonight, I become a ghost to earn my own life.

She takes a steadying breath, mounts the steps, and enters the villa.

INT. VILLA HALLWAY - NIGHT

SONG CHUWAN pauses before a door, composes herself, then knocks.

The door opens. QI SHUOZHOU, a handsome man in a black shirt, appears, his expression unreadable.

QI SHUOZHOU
Is there something you need?

SONG CHUWAN
Yes.

QI SHUOZHOU
(eyes lingering on her a moment)
Come in.

He steps aside. As she enters, he watches her with quiet intensity.

QI SHUOZHOU (V.O.)
She moves like a woman walking on knives.
continuation:
INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

SONG CHUWAN sets the milk on the marble counter and hoists herself onto it. She catches her reflection in the mirror—briefly, she doesn't recognize herself. She takes a small sip.

Her eyes find QI SHUOZHOU's in the glass. She slides off the counter, closes the distance, and kisses him. It's hesitant at first, then deepens.

He responds—then suddenly seizes her wrist, pushing her back with controlled force.

QI SHUOZHOU
What are you doing?

SONG CHUWAN
(her gaze steady)
Grandma's recipe. For... family health.

QI SHUOZHOU
Studies her, then the milk. He wipes his mouth slowly.

QI SHUOZHOU
Then next time, we'll drink it together. Anything else?

SONG CHUWAN
(quietly)
I'm burning up.

She takes his hand and presses it to her cheek. It's shaking.

QI SHUOZHOU
You're trembling.

He doesn't pull away. They kiss again, slower, more dangerous.

SONG CHUWAN
(whispering against his lips)
Qi Shuozhou... I feel like I'm falling.

QI SHUOZHOU
lifts her effortlessly. She wraps her legs around his waist.

SONG CHUWAN
Let me test the goods before the blind box arrives. If I unseal it after marriage and find you're defective... too late for refunds, isn't it? Unless you admit now you're damaged goods.

QI SHUOZHOU
(a cold, amused laugh)
Test the goods?

QI SHUOZHOU
carries her toward the bedroom door.

SONG CHUWAN
(in his ear, barely audible)
Brother-in-law... don't prove me wrong.

INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

MU WANNING, pristine in a sequined dress, holds a silver locket up to the light, letting it dangle before SONG CHUWAN's face.

MU WANNING
My tests came back. Barren. You will get pregnant with Qi Shuozhou's child for me. In return, I acknowledge you as the Mu family's Second Miss. Refuse... and this trinket your mother left funds my next renovation. You were born expendable. Consider this your elevation.

She drops the locket onto the glass coffee table. It lands with a sharp click. She turns on her heel and exits.

SONG CHUWAN stares at the locket, then at Mu Wanning's retreating form. Her hand closes around the silver chain.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT (BACK TO PRESENT)

SONG CHUWAN looks down at the milk glass, half-empty. Her reflection distorts in the liquid.

SONG CHUWAN (V.O.)
Some flowers die in heaven's light. In hell, they learn to bloom through stone.

The scene cuts to SONG CHUWAN and QI SHUOZHOU on the bed, intertwined. The milk glass sits on the nightstand, nearly empty, a faint lipstick mark on its rim.

lifts her effortlessly. She wraps her legs around his waist.

SONG CHUWAN
Let me test the goods before the blind box arrives. If I unseal it after marriage and find you're defective... too late for refunds, isn't it? Unless you admit now you're damaged goods.

QI SHUOZHOU
(a cold, amused laugh)
Test the goods?

QI SHUOZHOU
carries her toward the bedroom door.

SONG CHUWAN
(in his ear, barely audible)
Brother-in-law... don't prove me wrong.

INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

MU WANNING, pristine in a sequined dress, holds a silver locket up to the light, letting it dangle before SONG CHUWAN's face.

MU WANNING
My tests came back. Barren. You will get pregnant with Qi Shuozhou's child for me. In return, I acknowledge you as the Mu family's Second Miss. Refuse... and this trinket your mother left funds my next renovation. You were born expendable. Consider this your elevation.

She drops the locket onto the glass coffee table. It lands with a sharp click. She turns on her heel and exits.

SONG CHUWAN stares at the locket, then at Mu Wanning's retreating form. Her hand closes around the silver chain.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT (BACK TO PRESENT)

SONG CHUWAN looks down at the milk glass, half-empty. Her reflection distorts in the liquid.

SONG CHUWAN (V.O.)
Some flowers die in heaven's light. In hell, they learn to bloom through stone.

The scene cuts to SONG CHUWAN and QI SHUOZHOU on the bed, intertwined. The milk glass sits on the nightstand, nearly empty, a faint lipstick mark on its rim.

title: Oh No, Young Master Wen Has Fallen
description: A reserved college beauty attends a birthday party where she encounters the mysterious man who saved her years ago, hoping to reconnect with him after three years of effort.
context:
Title: Oh No, Young Master Wen Has Fallen
Description: A reserved college beauty attends a birthday party where she encounters the mysterious man who saved her years ago, hoping to reconnect with him after three years of effort.

INT. PRIVATE DINING ROOM - NIGHT

A boisterous group of university friends surround a banquet table littered with half-empty bottles and birthday decorations. The mood is loud, familiar.

ALL
Happy birthday, Brother Qi!

They raise glasses in unison. JIN QI—23, in a pink suit that somehow works—grins, toasting himself.

The door swings open. SHEN JIANAN stands framed in the entrance, one hand on her hip, scanning the room. WEN LIWAN hovers just behind her, poised but visibly out of her element.

JIN QI
Sister-in-law's here.

The group turns. Conversations hush. WEN LIWAN steps into the light—white dress, effortless grace, an unruffled calm that instantly redefines the room's center of gravity.

LU YUZHOU
(low whistle)
Well, damn.

ANOTHER GUY
(mutters to his friend)
You seeing this?

JIN QI
(to SHEN JIANAN)
And you've brought a friend.

SHEN JIANAN
This is Wen Liwan. My best friend. She's under my protection tonight, so behave.

WEN LIWAN
(faint, genuine smile)
Nice to meet you.

GUY IN BLACK T-SHIRT
Wen Liwan... why's that name familiar?

LU YUZHOU
Jing University's phantom. Runs the student film archive like a secret society. Never shows at mixers.

JIN QI
Thought I'd never actually meet you.

BROTHER QI
She's got that whole untouchable vibe down.

JIN QI
(to SHEN JIANAN)
Take the seat of honor.

GUY IN BLACK T-SHIRT
(to WEN LIWAN)
Liwan, you're next to Jingbai. He won't bite.

He points to WEN JINGBAI—24, magnetic in his stillness, nursing a drink, detached from the chaos.

WEN LIWAN's breath catches. She recovers, crossing the room with measured steps. She doesn't look at him directly. Not yet.

MONTAGE:
continuation:
EXT. UNDER THE BRIDGE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Years earlier. Teenage WEN LIWAN—bruised, soaked, trembling—crouches among scattered, moaning thugs. Her knuckles are raw. A black leather jacket drops over her shoulders.

WEN JINGBAI (YOUNGER) holds an umbrella over her, his face unreadable. Behind him, police sirens paint the rain red and blue.

WEN JINGBAI
Go home. It's over.

He walks away. She clutches the jacket, watching his retreating back with something like reverence and terror.

END MONTAGE.

INT. PRIVATE DINING ROOM - NIGHT

WEN LIWAN settles into her seat beside WEN JINGBAI. Her fingers trace the edge of her wine glass. Controlled. Certain.

WEN LIWAN (V.O.)
Three years. Twenty-seven attempts. One failed film project. All for this moment.

WEN JINGBAI's eyes drift to her hands—faded scars on her knuckles. His glass pauses mid-air. Something registers.

He looks at her profile. She meets his gaze, steady, unflinching. A ghost of recognition flickers across his face.

WEN JINGBAI
(quietly)
You kept the jacket.

A statement, not a question. WEN LIWAN's composure cracks—just barely—into something fierce and hopeful.

FADE OUT.

title: Designated Theft
description: A talented designer's career is sabotaged when her ex-boyfriend steals her portfolio to land his dream job—only to discover she left a digital fingerprint he can't erase.
context:
Title: Designated Theft
Description: A talented designer's career is sabotaged when her ex-boyfriend steals her portfolio to land his dream job—only to discover she left a digital fingerprint he can't erase.

INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY

JIANG ZHIWAN (25, composed but trembling) sits before the INTERVIEWER, a tablet displaying her work between them.

INTERVIEWER
(coldly)
These designs were submitted by Gao Yize three days ago. With complete development logs.

JIANG ZHIWAN
(quietly furious)
He had access to my workstation. We were—partners.

INTERVIEWER
(sliding a nondisclosure agreement forward)
Then you understand our position. We cannot risk hiring someone with potential IP disputes. This interview is over.

The interviewer exits. Jiang Zhiwan stares at the tablet, her reflection ghosting over her stolen designs.

INT. CHEN CORPORATION OFFICE - DAY

GAO YIZE (28, immaculate suit) scrolls through his phone near the elevator. COLLEAGUES A and B pass with deferential nods.

COLLEAGUE A
Morning, Designer Gao. Client loved your pitch.

COLLEAGUE B
Saved us the entire quarter.

JIANG ZHIWAN emerges from the interview room. She sees Gao Yize. Her expression shifts from shock to ice-cold clarity.

JIANG ZHIWAN
(striding forward)
Yize.

GAO YIZE
(turning, smooth)
Zhiwan. Did you come to congratulate me?

JIANG ZHIWAN
(low, dangerous)
You submitted my thesis project. The one you called "unmarketable."

GAO YIZE
(louder, for the gathering crowd)
We ended things because you couldn't handle my success. Is this your attempt at reconciliation?
continuation:
COLLEAGUE C and D drift closer, sensing drama.

JIANG ZHIWAN
(hand in her bag)
You thought you deleted everything. My laptop. The backup drive.

GAO YIZE
(sighing, performance for others)
Delusions won't repair our relationship.

JIANG ZHIWAN
You missed something.

She produces her phone. On screen: a video—Gao Yize at her apartment, clearly accessing her computer, dated two weeks prior.

GAO YIZE
(paling)
How—

JIANG ZHIWAN
(loudly, clearly)
My security camera. Motion-activated.

She holds the phone up. The crowd leans in. On screen, Gao YIZE'S VOICE: "This will be my ticket into Chen Corporation."

COLLEAGUE C
(to D)
Is that...?

GAO YIZE
(grabbing her wrist)
Delete that. Now.

JIANG ZHIWAN
(yanking free)
Call security. Please. I want this on record.

She starts a livestream with a tap. The phone screen shows "Recording - 5 viewers... 12 viewers..."

GAO YIZE
(stammering)
Zhiwan, we can discuss this privately—

JIANG ZHIWAN
(to the camera)
Meet Gao Yize. Chen Corporation's newest designer. And a thief.

She turns the lens on his face—cornered, desperate. The colleagues' phones rise, a constellation of judgment.

FADE OUT.

title: Reborn and Running, My Awakening Makes My Ex-Husband Panic
description: A woman discovers the dark truth about her marriage and family, leading to a desperate act of revenge before her rebirth.
context:
Title: Reborn and Running, My Awakening Makes My Ex-Husband Panic
Description: A woman discovers the dark truth about her marriage and family, leading to a desperate act of revenge before her rebirth.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: 1990 - Town Courtyard

SU QINGRAN sits on the edge of the bed, folding her husband's shirts into perfect squares. Her movements are slow, methodical.

XIAO GUODONG adjusts his tie in the mirror. A thick envelope of cash rests beside him.

XIAO GUODONG
Time moves quickly. Xiao Jun's wedding is almost here. Qingran, I've made arrangements. We'll relocate to the east courtyard. This house will serve its proper purpose.

SU QINGRAN stops mid-fold.

SU QINGRAN
My father built this house.

XIAO GUODONG
(without turning)
Family shares everything. Possessions have no memory.

SU QINGRAN
Sixteen years ago, you brought Shen Yunfang and her son here. "Temporary," you said.

XIAO GUODONG
(turning to her)
Consider it practice. For the family we never had.

The barb lands. Su Qingran's fingers tighten on the fabric.

XIAO GUODONG (CONT'D)
The Shanghai shop will be sold. Mother agrees—the proceeds, combined with your father's compensation and your nephew's settlement, will purchase Xiao Jun's new home. A fresh start for everyone.

SU QINGRAN
That money is blood money.

XIAO GUODONG
Don't be dramatic. Blood washes off.

He exits. Su Qingran stares at the closed door.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

SU QINGRAN intercepts XIAO GUODONG before he reaches the front door.

SU QINGRAN
(low)
You swore on our wedding day you'd never touch it.

XIAO GUODONG
I swore to protect you. This is protection.

SU QINGRAN
My nephew died because—

XIAO GUODONG
(interrupting)
Your nephew died because he couldn't control his temper. Just as your father couldn't control his tongue. Some families are cursed, Qingran. Ours doesn't have to be.

SU QINGRAN
(quietly)
I am not cursed.

XIAO GUODONG
(looking at her stomach)
Some things we must accept. I've been generous.

He leaves. Su Qingran stands alone, her eyes finding the framed photograph on the wall—her father, confident and young.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Young SHEN YUNFANG and ZHANG GUILAN sit on wooden stools, shelling peas.

ZHANG GUILAN
She still doesn't know?

SHEN YUNFANG
Guodong is careful. She trusts him.

ZHANG GUILAN
Good. She owes you everything. If Guodong hadn't reported her father to the authorities—

SU QINGRAN watches through a crack in the door, her face draining of color.

ZHANG GUILAN (V.O.)
"—the whole family would have been sent down. She'd be dead or worse."

QUICK CUT: SU QINGRAN's hand covering her mouth, tears tracking silent paths.

ZHANG GUILAN (V.O.)
"The compensation was her father's guilt. And that nephew..."

QUICK CUT: A memory—Su Qingran's nephew, passionate and alive, arguing with Xiao Guodong.

ZHANG GUILAN (V.O.)
"...Guodong just pointed him toward trouble. Boys will be boys."

ZHANG GUILAN (V.O.)
Now Xiao Jun will have what he deserves. What we all deserve.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

SU QINGRAN kneels beside the gas tank, her hands steady as she opens the valve. The hiss is soft, insistent. She pours rice wine in a careful line across the floor, the liquid darkening the wood.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SHEN YUNFANG and ZHANG GUILAN walk toward the house, carrying groceries.

SHEN YUNFANG
(sniffing)
Do you smell that? Like the market near the distillery—

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

ZHANG GUILAN and SHEN YUNFANG enter, freezing as the fumes hit them.

ZHANG GUILAN
(shouting)
Have you lost your mind?

SU QINGRAN stands near the kitchen, a single match between her fingers.

SU QINGRAN
(calm)
I'm returning what was borrowed. With interest.

She strikes the match. It flares to life. She opens her hand.

The match falls.

BOOM!

Fire races across the floor, up the walls. ZHANG GUILAN and SHEN YUNFANG scream, stumbling backward. The photograph of Su Qingran's father faces the flames.

SU QINGRAN stands motionless at the center, the fire reflected in her clear, dry eyes.

title: Reigniting the Glorious Era
description: A weapons researcher dies with regret and is reborn to the early days of the nation, determined to prevent the tragedy that cost his beloved colleague her life.
context:
Title: Reigniting the Glorious Era
Description: A weapons researcher dies with regret and is reborn to the early days of the nation, determined to prevent the tragedy that cost his beloved colleague her life.

INT. MUNITIONS FACTORY - DAY

ON SCREEN: MUNITIONS FACTORY AUDITORIUM

LI LONG, a middle-aged man in a Zhongshan suit with a commanding presence, walks into a spacious factory workshop. Inside, a group of SOLDIERS in military uniforms and TECHNICIANS in civilian clothes stand in neat formation. A military truck loaded with rocket artillery and a large cannon are displayed nearby.

LI LONG
Comrades, you are all top students who have returned from studying abroad, especially proficient in weapons research. The weapon placed on my left, I'm sure you are all familiar with it. Our Soviet allies call it Katyusha.

CHEN HUAN, a young technical backbone, shows shock and disbelief in his eyes.

LI LONG
The higher-ups have issued orders for us at North Ordnance to make further improvements on the existing Type-63 artillery within one month.

CHEN HUAN (V.O.)
Type-63... North Ordnance... Wanning?

ZHAO WANNING, a young female researcher with double braids, gently pats CHEN HUAN on the shoulder.

ZHAO WANNING
Comrade Chen Huan.

CHEN HUAN is startled and turns to see ZHAO WANNING. He freezes.

ZHAO WANNING
What's wrong? Are you feeling unwell?

CHEN HUAN
(murmuring)
Wanning...
continuation:
INT. FIELD HOSPITAL - DAY (FLASHBACK)

The hospital corridor is chaotic, with wounded being carried in continuously. Young CHEN HUAN frantically grabs a NURSE.

CHEN HUAN
Excuse me, do you know where Zhao Wanning from the Independent Regiment is?

NURSE
I don't know.

CHEN HUAN searches frantically through the corridor and finally sees two SOLDIERS carrying a stretcher covered with a white cloth. He rushes over to stop them.

CHEN HUAN
Where is Zhao Wanning?

SOLDIER
(quietly)
Engineer Zhao was killed in an artillery strike. Direct hit.

CHEN HUAN
(trembling)
She's okay, right?

SOLDIER
(avoiding his eyes)
She's gone, comrade.

CHEN HUAN reaches out to lift the white cloth. He sees ZHAO WANNING'S face—peaceful beneath the dust and blood. He takes a step back, his legs giving way as he collapses.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. MUNITIONS FACTORY - DAY

CHEN HUAN snaps back to reality, looking at the living ZHAO WANNING before him, his eyes filled with pain. He grips the workbench to steady himself.

ZHAO WANNING
(concerned)
Chen Huan, talk to me.

CHEN HUAN
(softly)
Just... a nightmare. From before.

LI LONG
We cannot depend on foreign designs forever. We must forge our own sword!

CHEN HUAN (V.O.)
The Eagle Offensive begins in six months. Wanning will volunteer, and that Type-63 will fail—and she'll be gone. I've lived forty years of regret. Not again.

CHEN HUAN'S eyes change from confusion to determination.

CHEN HUAN
(loudly)
Yes! We Chinese must have our own Katyusha—but thirty days won't be enough. We need to start from the propellant up.

Everyone looks at him in surprise. CHEN HUAN steps forward, his gaze fixed on the weapon.

CHEN HUAN
We'll build it better than theirs.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

The hospital corridor is chaotic, with wounded being carried in continuously. Young CHEN HUAN frantically grabs a NURSE.

CHEN HUAN
Excuse me, do you know where Zhao Wanning from the Independent Regiment is?

NURSE
I don't know.

CHEN HUAN searches frantically through the corridor and finally sees two SOLDIERS carrying a stretcher covered with a white cloth. He rushes over to stop them.

CHEN HUAN
Where is Zhao Wanning?

SOLDIER
(quietly)
Engineer Zhao was killed in an artillery strike. Direct hit.

CHEN HUAN
(trembling)
She's okay, right?

SOLDIER
(avoiding his eyes)
She's gone, comrade.

CHEN HUAN reaches out to lift the white cloth. He sees ZHAO WANNING'S face—peaceful beneath the dust and blood. He takes a step back, his legs giving way as he collapses.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. MUNITIONS FACTORY - DAY

CHEN HUAN snaps back to reality, looking at the living ZHAO WANNING before him, his eyes filled with pain. He grips the workbench to steady himself.

ZHAO WANNING
(concerned)
Chen Huan, talk to me.

CHEN HUAN
(softly)
Just... a nightmare. From before.

LI LONG
We cannot depend on foreign designs forever. We must forge our own sword!

CHEN HUAN (V.O.)
The Eagle Offensive begins in six months. Wanning will volunteer, and that Type-63 will fail—and she'll be gone. I've lived forty years of regret. Not again.

CHEN HUAN'S eyes change from confusion to determination.

CHEN HUAN
(loudly)
Yes! We Chinese must have our own Katyusha—but thirty days won't be enough. We need to start from the propellant up.

Everyone looks at him in surprise. CHEN HUAN steps forward, his gaze fixed on the weapon.

CHEN HUAN
We'll build it better than theirs.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Sisters' Choice
description: Two sisters face a difficult decision when only one teaching position is available, leading to a conflict that will change both their lives.
context:
Title: The Sisters' Choice
Description: Two sisters face a difficult decision when only one teaching position is available, leading to a conflict that will change both their lives.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

UNCLE LI sits behind his desk. HE SHUYIN and HE SHUYUAN sit across from him.

UNCLE LI
Today you both graduated. The school only has one teaching assignment available. That is, to teach in Jiangjia Village.

UNCLE LI
I've already discussed this with your father. His intention is to let... Shuyuan go.

HE SHUYIN
(quietly)
May I ask why?

HE SHUYUAN
(jumping up)
No! Jiangjia Village is a poor mountain village! Are you sure you want me to go?

UNCLE LI
This is your father's decision.

HE SHUYUAN
Of course it is. He always finds ways to protect his favorite.

HE SHUYIN
Dad believes hardship will strengthen your qualifications.

HE SHUYUAN
(agitated)
Then you go. Prove how much you love sacrifice.

UNCLE LI
That's enough! Respect your father's decision.

HE SHUYIN
Uncle Li, is this really my father's decision?

UNCLE LI
continuation:
Absolutely.

UNCLE LI
Your father and I are doing this for your own good. Just listen to me and go to Jiangjia Village. Besides, after graduation, you still need to fulfill the marriage arrangement with the Liu family.

HE SHUYUAN (V.O.)
The Liu family of Jiangcheng... She can't have that too.

HE SHUYUAN
Sister, didn't you say you would always give in to me? Then go to Jiangjia Village in my place. I'll fulfill the marriage arrangement for you.

HE SHUYIN
Are you certain? Their son is—

HE SHUYUAN
Yes! I want to go!

UNCLE LI
Nonsense! Would your father and I harm you?

HE SHUYUAN
(standing up, slamming the table)
You're sending me to waste my life while she gets the city and a wealthy marriage? I see exactly what's happening!

HE SHUYIN
That's enough. Uncle and Dad are doing this for your future.

HE SHUYUAN suddenly slaps HE SHUYIN.

HE SHUYUAN
Stop pretending to care about my future!

HE SHUYIN covers her face, shocked and hurt. HE SHUYUAN also freezes, then her attitude softens.

HE SHUYUAN
Sister... I didn't mean that. I just can't go there. Please. For me. One last time.

HE SHUYIN looks at her sister with complex emotions, then finally makes up her mind.

HE SHUYIN
Fine. I'll take the post. I hope you won't regret this choice.

title: Accidentally Pregnant with My Boss's Child
description: A woman discovers she is pregnant after a drunken night with a mysterious man, while helping her friend deal with her own pregnancy troubles.
context:
Title: Accidentally Pregnant with My Boss's Child
Description: A woman discovers she is pregnant after a drunken night with a mysterious man, while helping her friend deal with her own pregnancy troubles.

INT. SU XIA'S APARTMENT - DAY

SU XIA (28, weary but resilient) enters the cramped apartment, juggling grocery bags and exhaustion.

From her bedroom, YE LIN (26, sharp features masking desperation) emerges. Her eyes lock on the designer handbag dangling from Su Xia's wrist.

YE LIN
Su Xia.

Ye Lin intercepts her, snatching the bag with trembling hands. She examines it like a prosecutor with evidence.

YE LIN
(quietly fierce)
New scratches. Right across the clasp.

SU XIA
(confused)
I kept it wrapped the entire interview. It never left my sight--

YE LIN
(turning the bag)
Here. Here. And here. Do you know what this cost?

SU XIA
(softly)
I'll replace it. Once I land something.

YE LIN
The rent's already three weeks late.

Su Xia flinches. Ye Lin softens, a practiced shift.

YE LIN
(conciliatory)
But you're trying. That's what matters.

YE LIN (V.O.)
She'll never know I scratched it myself. The consignment shop needs pristine bags. We need groceries.

YE LIN's fingers brush SU XIA's neck, revealing a purple bruise beneath her collar. Ye Lin's breath catches.

YE LIN
What happened?

SU XIA
(covering it)
Networking event. Open bar. I don't... remember getting home.

FLASHBACK:

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT (MEMORY FRAGMENT)

SU XIA stumbles, vision swimming. A man's hands—strong, unfamiliar—steady her. She sees only a blurred face and a hint of ink on his wrist before darkness.

BACK TO:
continuation:
INT. SU XIA'S APARTMENT - DAY

SU XIA
I woke up alone. Clothes intact. Figured I just...

YE LIN
(quietly)
You were a virgin. Was it worth it?

YE LIN doubles over, hand flying to her mouth. She retches into the sink.

SU XIA
(rushing over)
Linlin!

YE LIN waves her off, spitting water. Her reflection in the faucet shows tears, not nausea.

SU XIA
How long?

YE LIN
Don't.

SU XIA
(eyes hardening)
The test in your trash. The prenatal vitamins. It's Li Kai's.

YE LIN
(defeated)
He blocked my number yesterday.

SU XIA grabs her phone. Ye Lin reaches for it—too slow.

INT. POOL HALL - DAY

LI KAI (30, casual cruelty) lines up a shot. His phone buzzes. He checks the screen, smirking.

LI KAI
(answering)
The charity case is calling me?

SU XIA (V.O.)
(fierce)
Li Kai. Ye Lin's pregnant. You disappeared.

LI KAI
(leaning against the table)
So? I'm not a doctor. I'm not her husband. What do you want, a medal for stating facts?

SU XIA (V.O.)
You promised--

LI KAI
I promised a good time. Not a lifetime. Tell her to handle it.

CLICK. He hangs up.

INT. SU XIA'S APARTMENT - DAY

The phone drops from SU XIA's hand.

YE LIN
(whispered fury)
You just made it worse. He thinks I'm pathetic.

SU XIA
He is pathetic.

YE LIN
And what are you? Meddling where you're not wanted. Maybe you just need me to be as miserable as you are.

YE LIN storms out, slamming the door. Su Xia stands frozen, the hickey burning like a brand.

EXT. CITY SKYLINE - DAY

AERIAL SHOT: The city sprawls beneath a hazy sky.

SUPER: Ten weeks later.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

SU XIA sits straighter now, worn blazer over a changed body. She grips her knees.

DOCTOR
(50s, professional)
Your hormone levels confirm it. Ten weeks.

SU XIA
But I haven't... I mean, I thought it was stress.

DOCTOR
It often is. Until it isn't. Have you considered your options?

SU XIA (V.O.)
Options. As if that night was a multiple-choice question I could erase.

FLASHBACK:

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT (MEMORY FRAGMENT)

SU XIA on her back, the MYSTERIOUS MAN above her. His glasses catch the light, obscuring his eyes. On his forearm, a flame tattoo licks toward his wrist. His lips brush her neck.

MYSTERIOUS MAN
(low)
Is this okay?

SU XIA
(dreamlike)
Mmm.

He kisses her throat, hard enough to mark.

BACK TO:

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

SU XIA's fingers trace the ghost of that bruise on her neck, now faded. Her other hand rests on the soft curve beneath her shirt.

SU XIA (V.O.)
The man with the flame tattoo. Who was he? And why do I feel like I've seen that tattoo before...

title: Baby Strike: Where Can the Cold-Faced Daddy Escape
description: A taxi driver's night of reckoning begins when a desperate fugitive dives into his cab, igniting a chase that unearths his own buried war with the city's underworld.
context:
Title: Baby Strike: Where Can the Cold-Faced Daddy Escape
Description: A taxi driver's night of reckoning begins when a desperate fugitive dives into his cab, igniting a chase that unearths his own buried war with the city's underworld.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

City nightscape, heavy traffic. A black sedan stops at the hotel entrance. A woman gets out and closes the door.

INT. TAXI - NIGHT

LIN XIAO (30s) sits in the driver's seat, his expression serious, eyes on the hotel entrance. A child's sticker is half-peeled from his dashboard. His phone rings.

He answers.

YING SHA (V.O.)
You answered. After six months, I wasn't sure—

LIN XIAO
The Crimson Syndicate. Tell me you have something solid.

YING SHA (V.O.)
Your mother's accident wasn't an accident. They flagged her file. And now they've flagged you.

Lin Xiao's jaw tightens. He ends the call.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

SHEN AOXUE, wearing a white dress, runs out from somewhere in panic, her expression fearful. She clutches her arm where a red stain seeps through.

She desperately runs toward Lin Xiao's taxi, pulls open the back door, and gets in.

INT. TAXI - NIGHT

SHEN AOXUE
(panting)
Southwest service gate. Now. I'll pay ten thousand.

Lin Xiao looks back and sees several men in suits chasing after them.

LIN XIAO
Buckle up.

He punches the accelerator. The taxi tears into traffic.
continuation:
EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

The pursuing men watch the car drive away, furious.

PURSUIT LEADER
Track the cab. The cocktail's timed—we need her talking.

They run to a row of motorcycles, quickly put on helmets, start the motorcycles, and give chase.

EXT. CITY ROADS/TUNNEL - NIGHT

Intense chase scene. The taxi speeds ahead with several motorcycles in hot pursuit, lights strobing in the tunnel.

INT. TAXI - NIGHT

SHEN AOXUE
(anxious)
Driver, please go faster!

LIN XIAO
Tunnel's speed-governed. This is it.

Shen Aoxue takes out her phone, quickly operates it. Lin Xiao's phone pings—a payment app shows $10,000.

LIN XIAO
(glancing at the screen)
That won't un-govern the engine.

SHEN AOXUE
(her words slurring)
Then... think of something else.

LIN XIAO
Hold on.

Lin Xiao drops two gears, the engine screaming as the tachometer redlines. The speedometer climbs past the governed limit. Tires smoke against the pavement.

The taxi accelerates through the tunnel, successfully losing the motorcycle convoy, and exits the tunnel.

EXT. REMOTE SIDE ROAD - NIGHT

The taxi stops by the roadside. Lin Xiao takes a sip of water and sees through the rearview mirror that the distant motorcycle convoy has driven off in another direction.

He breathes a sigh of relief and turns to look at the back seat.

LIN XIAO
We're clear. You can get out now.

Shen Aoxue lies in the back seat, her face flushed, breathing rapidly, fingers twitching.

SHEN AOXUE
(painfully)
Burning... everything's burning...

LIN XIAO
(puzzled)
AC's maxed out.

Lin Xiao gets out of the car, opens the back door, and leans in to check on Shen Aoxue.

LIN XIAO
Miss?

Shen Aoxue's eyes snap open, pupils blown wide. She grabs Lin Xiao's jacket with surprising strength, pulling him into the car.

The child's sticker peels completely from the dashboard, falling to the floor.

FADE OUT.

title: Never Meet Again at the Place of Longing
description: A legendary warrior from ancient times gives up everything to reunite with her beloved in the Republican era, only to discover his betrayal.
context:
Title: Never Meet Again at the Place of Longing
Description: A legendary warrior from ancient times gives up everything to reunite with her beloved in the Republican era, only to discover his betrayal.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

SHEN QINGTANG, dressed in elegant ancient attire, sits before her vanity. Her fingers trace the jade pendant on the table, its surface worn smooth by countless journeys.

SHEN QINGTANG (V.O.)
This pendant has carried me across centuries. But this time, I'm not returning.

EXT. DOORWAY - DAY

FLASHBACK:

SHEN QINGTANG, wearing red battle armor and drenched in blood, collapses through the doorway. Her sword CLATTERS against stone.

CHEN FENG, a Republican-era youth wearing glasses, rushes forward. His hands tremble as he presses cloth against her wounds.

CHEN FENG
Stay with me. Please. I don't even know your name, but please—don't die.

Her blood seeps through his fingers. His eyes are raw with genuine terror.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

Close-up of SHEN QINGTANG, her reflection fractured in the bronze mirror.

SHEN QINGTANG (V.O.)
They call me the Nation-Guarding Martial Saint. Tomorrow, they'll call me a deserter. Let them.

INT. REPUBLICAN BEDROOM - DAY

SHEN QINGTANG wakes with a gasp. Republican-era ceiling fan spins lazily overhead. CHEN FENG dozes in a chair beside her, spectacles askew.

SHEN QINGTANG
Where...?

CHEN FENG
(startles awake)
My home. You're safe now.

He pours medicine with steady hands, but dark circles shadow his eyes.

CHEN FENG
Drink slowly. You've been feverish for three days.

He feeds her the spoonfuls with practiced care. She watches him, something softening in her gaze.

SHEN QINGTANG (V.O.)
He saved me when I had nothing. In this strange era, his kindness feels like the only certain thing.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

SHEN QINGTANG closes the ancient book, its pages marked with Chen's careful annotations in modern ink. She lifts the jade pendant, now bound with thread from her own armor.

SHEN QINGTANG
(thirty years of longing in her voice)
One last time.
continuation:
EXT. QINZHEN HALL - DAY

SHEN QINGTANG emerges from the hall. Above, storm clouds gather. The jade pendant flares in her palm, dissolving into threads of light that weave through her armor, transmuting it into a Republican-era dress. She vanishes.

Light arcs across the sky, striking the Chen Residence.

EXT. CHEN RESIDENCE COURTYARD - NIGHT

The light deposits SHEN QINGTANG in the courtyard. Thunder rumbles. She looks up at the brewing storm, then at the house where Chen's silhouette moves behind a window.

SHEN QINGTANG
(whispering)
Not tonight.

She raises her hand. The clouds still, then unravel like silk threads, revealing a full moon.

She watches the moonlight touch Chen's window, a genuine smile on her face.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

SHEN QINGTANG kneads dough, her ancient hands clumsy with modern tools. A burn mark scars her wrist—oven, not battlefield. She smiles at it.

SHEN QINGTANG (V.O.)
Last time he ate my pastries, he said they tasted like home. I want to deserve that word.

EXT. CHEN RESIDENCE COURTYARD - DAY

CHEN FENG's mother SUN XIUFANG adjusts his tournament robes. CHEN FENG stares at his hands—these hands that have held Shen's, that have learned sword forms from her memory.

SUN XIUFANG
The Zhao family sent their betrothal gift yesterday. After tomorrow's tournament, you'll be engaged to their daughter.

CHEN FENG
(something hollow in his voice)
Mother, Shen Qingtang—

SUN XIUFANG
—is a ghost from another time. Useful, but not a wife. You've always known this.

A beat. Chen looks away.

CHEN FENG
The Ancient Martial Arts she taught me... I've incorporated them into my own style. No one can tell.

SUN XIUFANG
Good. Let her win your preliminary matches. When she faces you in the final, she'll yield. She loves you.

CHEN FENG
She'll yield.

He says it like he's trying to convince himself. Then, quieter:

CHEN FENG
After the wedding... I'll give her a position. As concubine. It's more than she could have hoped for, in her era.

A plate SHATTERS.

They turn. SHEN QINGTANG stands there, flour on her hands, the shattered pastries at her feet. Her face is a battlefield of realization.

CHEN FENG
Shen—

The name dies in his throat. He sees what she heard written across her face.

SUN XIUFANG takes Chen's arm, pulling him back.

The courtyard becomes very quiet.

SHEN QINGTANG looks at Chen. Then at the broken pastries. Then at the sky she cleared for him last night.

You came back for me.

Title: Never Meet Again at the Place of Longing
Description: A legendary warrior from ancient times gives up everything to reunite with her beloved in the Republican era, only to discover his betrayal.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

SHEN QINGTANG, dressed in elegant ancient attire, sits before her vanity. Her fingers trace the jade pendant on the table, its surface worn smooth by countless journeys.

SHEN QINGTANG (V.O.)
This pendant has carried me across centuries. But this time, I'm not returning.

EXT. DOORWAY - DAY

FLASHBACK:

SHEN QINGTANG, wearing red battle armor and drenched in blood, collapses through the doorway. Her sword CLATTERS against stone.

CHEN FENG, a Republican-era youth wearing glasses, rushes forward. His hands tremble as he presses cloth against her wounds.

CHEN FENG

Her blood seeps through his fingers. His eyes are raw with genuine terror.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

Close-up of SHEN QINGTANG, her reflection fractured in the bronze mirror.

SHEN QINGTANG (V.O.)

SHEN QINGTANG (V.O.)

Shen—

title: Night in Fancy Dress
description: A young woman faces escalating abuse from her stepfather while her mother's denial deepens their desperate situation.
context:
Title: Night in Fancy Dress
Description: A young woman faces escalating abuse from her stepfather while her mother's denial deepens their desperate situation.

INT. TANG YU'S HOUSE/BEDROOM - NIGHT

Thunder and lightning rage outside.

TANG YU (female, about 20 years old) sleeps fitfully. The door opens silently—her stepfather TIAN DALEI (male, about 50 years old) enters, whiskey bottle in hand. He moves to the bedside and leans close.

Lightning flashes across his face. TANG YU wakes with a start.

TANG YU
(terrified)
Stepfather—don't—

TIAN DALEI
(low, slurred)
Don't fight me. I'm all that's keeping a roof over your head.

He lunges. TANG YU struggles. His hand finds the sheets—blood.

TIAN DALEI
(disgusted)
Filthy.

He wipes his hand on the blanket, turns back to her.

TIAN DALEI
(cold)
I'll wait.

He exits. TANG YU sits up, trembling. Her terror shifts to something harder—resolve.
continuation:
INT. TANG YU'S HOUSE/LIVING ROOM - DAY

The living room is in disarray, furniture overturned. TIAN DALEI is assaulting TANG YU's mother HAN MEI (female, about 40-something years old), tearing at her clothes.

TIAN DALEI
(roaring)
Where's the money?

He strikes HAN MEI. She falls. TANG YU hides behind the door, gripping the frame, tears streaming down her face.

TIAN DALEI
I need it now! Don't make me ask again!

HAN MEI
(crying out)
It's gone! Everything's gone!

TIAN DALEI searches her roughly, finds a wad of bills tucked in her waistband. He pockets it.

TIAN DALEI
(turning, sees Tang Yu)
How long?

TANG YU
(voice shaking)
Two days.

TIAN DALEI
(nods)
Lock your door.

He leaves. TANG YU rushes to HAN MEI.

TANG YU
(crying)
Mom—we have to go—

HAN MEI
(shoves her away)
And go where?

TANG YU
Anywhere—I've saved—

HAN MEI
(slaps her)
You think he'd let us leave? You think I can survive without him?

Han Mei's voice breaks. She won't look at her daughter.

HAN MEI
(whispering)
Just... make yourself scarce. Please.

TANG YU sits back, stunned. TIAN DALEI's words echo.

TIAN DALEI (V.O.)
I'll wait.

TANG YU's hand finds a piece of broken glass on the floor. She holds it up, watching the light. Her tears stop. She makes a choice.

title: My General Dotes on His Wife's Maid
description: On a wedding day where a noble lady and her maid are both marrying the general as equal wives, the bride's arrogance leads to an unexpected turn of events.
context:
Title: My General Dotes on His Wife's Maid
Description: On a wedding day where a noble lady and her maid are both marrying the general as equal wives, the bride's arrogance leads to an unexpected turn of events.

INT. GENERAL'S MANSION WEDDING HALL - DAY

SFX: Stirring music

The hall is adorned with red silk, filled with guests. LADY ZHAO sits in the seat of honor, her posture rigid.

GUEST (V.O.)
(whispered)
A minister's daughter sharing the altar with her maid... and as equal wives? Unprecedented.

GUEST (V.O.)
(whispered)
General Zhao's reputation will be tested today.

GUEST (V.O.)
(whispered)
The Minister won't stand for an insult to his house.

The groom, ZHAO WUXU, dressed in red wedding attire, enters the hall with two brides. One is MENG YAOHUA, covered with a red veil, and the other is QING YUAN, her face hidden behind a round fan.

ZHAO WUXU
Mother.

LADY ZHAO nods with a measured smile.

OFFICIANT
The auspicious hour has arrived. Let the newlyweds bow together!

MENG YAOHUA suddenly lifts her veil, interrupting the ceremony.

MENG YAOHUA
Wait! I am the legitimate daughter of the Minister's household. Though we are married together, I should bow first. How can I bow side by side with a mere maid?

ZHAO WUXU
Since you are unwilling to bow together, then we shall not bow together.

MENG YAOHUA
(stunned)
General, this...

ZHAO WUXU ignores MENG YAOHUA, takes QING YUAN's hand, and they bow together toward the seat of honor.

QING YUAN
(softly)
General...

MENG YAOHUA stands to the side, her face filled with shock and humiliation.

QING YUAN (V.O.)
Ten days ago, I was sent to test a marriage. I never expected to become the bride.
continuation:
EXT. MINISTER'S MANSION - DAY (FLASHBACK)

TITLE CARD: Ten Days Ago

A group of maids walks in formation through the courtyard of the Minister's mansion.

MAID (V.O.)
(overlapping whispers)
Keep straight. Don't stumble.

INT. MINISTER'S MANSION GREAT HALL - DAY

The maids stand in formation. NANNY QIN holds a discipline ruler, her expression stern as she scrutinizes them.

MAID ONE
(whispered)
The Emperor's decree came down days ago. They're selecting a maid to test the marriage for the young mistress.

NANNY QIN
No good! Posture reveals character.

MAID TWO
(whispered)
General Zhao has campaigned for years without a woman. If he favors you after the test...

NANNY QIN
(sternly)
Silence! Whispers will be expelled!

NANNY QIN walks up to QING YUAN, measures her shoulders with the ruler, then lifts her chin to examine her carefully.

NANNY QIN
You. Come with me.

QING YUAN looks straight ahead with determined eyes.
