title: 90s Mom: Beautiful and Wild
description: A young woman faces betrayal when her fiancé returns from studying abroad with a new girlfriend and tries to break off their engagement without compensation.
context:
Title: 90s Mom: Beautiful and Wild
Description: A young woman faces betrayal when her fiancé returns from studying abroad with a new girlfriend and tries to break off their engagement without compensation.

INT. RURAL COURTYARD - DAY

JIANG TANG (early 20s, calloused hands, determined eyes) rides an old-fashioned bicycle into the courtyard. A live chicken is tied to the rear rack; fresh vegetables fill the front basket.

She stops, unloads everything onto a wooden table. Chops vegetables. Starts a fire under the iron pot. Adds water.

She places the prepared chicken into the pot.

CAO GENSHENG (60s, stooped, weathered face) walks out from the main house.

CAO GENSHENG
Daughter-in-law, don't rush with that. Ding'an should be arriving soon. Go call your mother back.

JIANG TANG
(wiping her hands, smiling)
Alright, Dad. You watch the pot then.

CAO GENSHENG
Okay.

JIANG TANG turns to leave--

HU DING'AN (O.S.)
Dad, I brought my girlfriend home!

JIANG TANG stops. Her smile vanishes. She slowly turns.

At the gate: HU DING'AN (late 20s, tailored suit, nervous eyes) stands with a suitcase. Beside him, ZHAO HONGXIA (early 20s, fashionable clothes, uneasy expression). Their hands don't quite touch.

HU DING'AN
(seeing JIANG TANG, voice tight)
Jiang Tang? Why are you still at our house? Didn't my mother tell you about breaking off the engagement?

JIANG TANG
(breath shallow)
Breaking off the engagement?

HU DAHUA (50s, sharp features) hurries in from outside, positioning herself between them.

HU DAHUA
Oh, my son is back! Come, let's go inside!

She pulls HU DING'AN and ZHAO HONGXIA toward the house, blocking JIANG TANG.

HU DAHUA
(whispering to HU DING'AN)
It's fine, I'll talk to Jiang Tang later. Come on.

JIANG TANG's hands tremble. She grabs the cleaver, points it.

JIANG TANG
Stop right there!

ZHAO HONGXIA flinches, steps behind HU DING'AN.

JIANG TANG
If you don't give me an explanation today, none of you are getting through that door!

HU DING'AN
(swallowing hard, voice rising)
What are you being so aggressive about? I'm the one breaking off the engagement with you, so what? Back then I was young and about to study abroad. That engagement was just talk. Now, I'm a returned overseas graduate. You and I aren't even on the same level anymore. Let's just forget about the engagement.

JIANG TANG
(quiet laugh, eyes glistening)
Not on the same level? What, I'm standing on the ground and you've descended to the eighteenth level of hell?

ZHAO HONGXIA
(almost to herself)
Why are you so vulgar? Can't we talk nicely?

JIANG TANG
Bah! I'm an uneducated country woman. But I don't know who it was back then who shamelessly came to propose, holding my hand, begging me to wait for you, begging me to take care of your parents. How come you didn't say we were on different levels then?

ZHAO HONGXIA
(looking at her shoes, voice small)
Ding'an, let's not waste words with her. I think she just wants money.

HU DING'AN
continuation:
Money?

JIANG TANG
What? Drank too much foreign ink and got brain atrophy?

HU DING'AN
You!

JIANG TANG
Your mistress is smarter than you! Pay up!

HU DING'AN
Who are you calling a mistress? She's my true love, you're just an accident!

JIANG TANG
(crossing her arms, laughing coldly)
Ha! Oh, so when men keep mistresses it's called true love. I've really learned something today.

HU DAHUA
(impatiently)
Enough! No matter what, the Hu family is breaking off this engagement! If you're smart, pack your things and leave while it's still light out. Otherwise, you'll be sleeping in the pigsty tonight!

HU DAHUA tells CAO GENSHENG to bring the luggage inside.

JIANG TANG glances at the chicken in the pot—three years of meals, care, waiting. Her jaw tightens.

She rushes forward, kicks HU DING'AN in the shin.

JIANG TANG
Take that!

HU DING'AN bends over in pain. ZHAO HONGXIA's shoes get dirty.

JIANG TANG
You want to break off the engagement? Fine! But settle all the compensation I'm owed for these three years. You want to tear off the mask? I, Jiang Tang, am ready!

ZHAO HONGXIA
(looking at her shoes distressedly)
Ding'an, these are my new shoes!

JIANG TANG
New shoes?

HU DING'AN
(supporting ZHAO HONGXIA)
It's okay, it's okay. I'll take you to the bathroom to clean up. It's fine, let's go.

They walk toward a small storage room. HU DING'AN looks back at JIANG TANG, a flicker of guilt crossing his face.

HU DING'AN
(in a low voice)
You want money? Dream on!

JIANG TANG watches them enter. Her hand finds the padlock hanging beside the door. Her fingers hesitate—then click it shut.

HU DING'AN (O.S.)
(banging on the door)
Jiang Tang, what are you doing?

JIANG TANG picks up a string of firecrackers, lights the fuse, slides a bamboo tube through the ventilation gap above the door, blows smoke inside.

Screams and coughing echo from inside.

HU DING'AN (O.S.)
Jiang Tang! Open the door!

JIANG TANG lights another, larger string of firecrackers, wedges it against the door's hook latch, then runs away laughing.

The firecrackers explode. The latch breaks. Thick smoke billows.

HU DING'AN and ZHAO HONGXIA burst out, faces covered in black soot, clothes torn, coughing continuously.

HU DING'AN
(pointing at JIANG TANG)
Jiang Tang! I—

JIANG TANG grabs a cloth bag and throws its contents (chicken feathers and ash) at them.

JIANG TANG
You wanted me to sleep in the pigsty? I'll blow you cheating scum to pieces!

JIANG TANG packs up her belongings and walks out of the courtyard without even glancing at the disheveled pair.

Now, I'm a returned overseas graduate. You and I aren't even on the same level anymore. Let's just forget about the engagement.

JIANG TANG
(quiet laugh, eyes glistening)
Not on the same level? What, I'm standing on the ground and you've descended to the eighteenth level of hell?

ZHAO HONGXIA
(almost to herself)
Why are you so vulgar? Can't we talk nicely?

JIANG TANG
Bah! I'm an uneducated country woman. But I don't know who it was back then who shamelessly came to propose, holding my hand, begging me to wait for you, begging me to take care of your parents. How come you didn't say we were on different levels then?

ZHAO HONGXIA
(looking at her shoes, voice small)
Ding'an, let's not waste words with her. I think she just wants money.

HU DING'AN
Money?

JIANG TANG
What? Drank too much foreign ink and got brain atrophy?

HU DING'AN
You!

JIANG TANG
Your mistress is smarter than you! Pay up!

HU DING'AN
Who are you calling a mistress? She's my true love, you're just an accident!

JIANG TANG
(crossing her arms, laughing coldly)
Ha! Oh, so when men keep mistresses it's called true love. I've really learned something today.

HU DAHUA
(impatiently)
Enough! No matter what, the Hu family is breaking off this engagement! If you're smart, pack your things and leave while it's still light out. Otherwise, you'll be sleeping in the pigsty tonight!

HU DAHUA tells CAO GENSHENG to bring the luggage inside.

JIANG TANG glances at the chicken in the pot—three years of meals, care, waiting. Her jaw tightens.

She rushes forward, kicks HU DING'AN in the shin.

JIANG TANG
Take that!

HU DING'AN bends over in pain. ZHAO HONGXIA's shoes get dirty.

JIANG TANG
You want to break off the engagement? Fine! But settle all the compensation I'm owed for these three years. You want to tear off the mask? I, Jiang Tang, am ready!

ZHAO HONGXIA
(looking at her shoes distressedly)
Ding'an, these are my new shoes!

JIANG TANG
New shoes?

HU DING'AN
(supporting ZHAO HONGXIA)
It's okay, it's okay. I'll take you to the bathroom to clean up. It's fine, let's go.

They walk toward a small storage room. HU DING'AN looks back at JIANG TANG, a flicker of guilt crossing his face.

HU DING'AN
(in a low voice)
You want money? Dream on!

JIANG TANG watches them enter. Her hand finds the padlock hanging beside the door. Her fingers hesitate—then click it shut.

HU DING'AN (O.S.)
(banging on the door)
Jiang Tang, what are you doing?

JIANG TANG picks up a string of firecrackers, lights the fuse, slides a bamboo tube through the ventilation gap above the door, blows smoke inside.

Screams and coughing echo from inside.

HU DING'AN (O.S.)
Jiang Tang! Open the door!

JIANG TANG lights another, larger string of firecrackers, wedges it against the door's hook latch, then runs away laughing.

The firecrackers explode. The latch breaks. Thick smoke billows.

HU DING'AN and ZHAO HONGXIA burst out, faces covered in black soot, clothes torn, coughing continuously.

HU DING'AN
(pointing at JIANG TANG)
Jiang Tang! I—

JIANG TANG grabs a cloth bag and throws its contents (chicken feathers and ash) at them.

JIANG TANG
You wanted me to sleep in the pigsty? I'll blow you cheating scum to pieces!

JIANG TANG packs up her belongings and walks out of the courtyard without even glancing at the disheveled pair.

title: The Celestial Beast Hunter
description: When ancient beasts escape to the mortal realm, a sleepy celestial guardian is sent to capture them, only to find a village in chaos and a mysterious pregnancy.
context:
Title: The Celestial Beast Hunter
Description: When ancient beasts escape to the mortal realm, a sleepy celestial guardian is sent to capture them, only to find a village in chaos and a mysterious pregnancy.

INT. TEMPLE - NIGHT

The EMPRESS kneels before a gilded statue, prayer beads clicking rhythmically. Incense smoke curls through the still air.

A low growl reverberates through the temple. The EMPRESS's prayer beads snap—beads scatter across the stone floor.

She turns. TAOTIE's massive horned silhouette fills the doorway, its three eyes burning with violet flame.

TAOTIE charges. Violet light engulfs the EMPRESS.

EMPRESS
(strangled gasp)
No... cannot... let it—

Her body convulses, spine bending at an impossible angle. Her eyes roll back, replaced by flickering violet fire.

EMPRESS
(voice layered with unnatural hunger)
Empty... all so... empty...

She lurches toward the offering table, stuffing rice and fruit into her mouth with clawed hands.

INT. HEAVENLY PALACE - DAY

XIAO QI dozes on a cloud, using a celestial map as a blanket. Soft snores escape her lips.

IMMORTAL LORD materializes beside her, his robes crackling with barely contained fury. He kicks the cloud.

IMMORTAL LORD
Xiao Qi! Awaken, you worthless scroll-reader—

XIAO QI
(mumbling without opening eyes)
Five more centuries, master...

IMMORTAL LORD
The Four Fiends have breached the mortal gate. Taotie, Qiongqi, Hundun—devouring entire harvests. And where is our guardian? Napping!

XIAO QI cracks one eye open.

XIAO QI
(quietly)
But I'm the lowest-ranked...

IMMORTAL LORD
Every other celestial warrior defends the Jade Emperor's banquet! You are our only available disaster.

The IMMORTAL LORD gestures. Golden chains materialize around XIAO QI's wrists.

IMMORTAL LORD
These bonds will guide you. Do not return without the beasts' essences.

He shoves her off the cloud. She falls, flailing.

XIAO QI
(shouting upwards)
I demand a labor contract renegotiation!
continuation:
EXT. XU VILLAGE - DAY

Dry wind scatters empty husks across the village square. VILLAGERS claw through shattered storage jars.

VILLAGER A
My winter reserves... gone. Not a single grain.

VILLAGER B
Same here. And the soil—look. Blackened. Like something poisoned it.

VILLAGER C points to massive footprints in the dirt—clawed, each as wide as a man is tall.

SONG XIANG examines a winnowing basket, his face grim.

SONG XIANG
Every storehouse. Every field. Cleaned out in one night.

CLAN ELDER
(whispers)
The old stories... when earth grows barren overnight...

SONG XIANG spots two distant figures—SONG EN and YU HUI—limping toward the village with threadbare packs.

SONG XIANG
(eyes narrowing)
Outsiders. Arriving at dawn's first light.

CLAN ELDER
They wear the Song clan colors, but—

SONG XIANG
They've been gone thirty years. Now they return as our grain vanishes?

VILLAGER D
Can't be coincidence!

SONG XIANG
Hold them!

VILLAGERS swarm forward, forming a bristling wall of hoes and scythes.

SONG XIANG
Song En! Yu Hui! You return after three decades, and our village starves.

SONG EN
Nephew, we've walked three days without food. We have no—

SONG XIANG
Then why do you carry magic's stench on your clothes!

He grabs SONG EN's sleeve. A faint violet residue smears his fingers.

YU HUI
That's from the woods! We slept in a cave that smelled of sulfur!

She lunges to free her husband. In the scuffle, she bites SONG XIANG's hand.

SONG XIANG
(yanks back)
She draws blood!

CLAN ELDER
Witchcraft!

VILLAGERS
Demons! Thieves! Beat the evil from them!

They surge forward. SONG EN shields YU HUI.

A golden shockwave ripples through the square. VILLAGERS freeze mid-swing.

XIAO QI descends slowly, her robes billowing. The golden chains around her wrists glow, connecting to each villager's chest—revealing faint violet threads of possession.

XIAO QI
(dryly)
First day on the job, and it's a riot.

She flicks her wrist. The frozen villagers stumble back. Violet threads snap and dissolve.

SONG EN helps YU HUI to her feet. She's pale, clutching her stomach.

YU HUI
(whisper)
Something moves inside... like fire.

Her stomach distends violently, skin stretching thin. Veins pulse violet beneath the surface.

VILLAGER E
(gasping)
Seventy years old... impossible...

CLAN ELDER
(lifting trembling finger)
The beast's hunger... it has found a vessel.

SONG EN and YU HUI also stare in shock at her belly—where a violet eye blinks beneath the skin, then fades.

title: Mother-in-Law's Card Game Saves the Day
description: A skilled card player mother-in-law wins at every table, but rushes to save her son-in-law when he's trapped in a gambling den after being set up.
context:
Title: Mother-in-Law's Card Game Saves the Day
Description: A skilled card player mother-in-law wins at every table, but rushes to save her son-in-law when he's trapped in a gambling den after being set up.

INT. COURTYARD MAHJONG TABLE - DAY

Four women huddle around a crowded mahjong table in a tight community courtyard. QIN LING (60s, sharp-eyed, nimble fingers) casually arranges her tiles. Three NEIGHBORS sweat nervously.

MALE CARD PLAYER
(leaning over Aunt Zhang's shoulder)
Hey, let me draw for you. Can't be worse than your luck.

AUNT ZHANG
(praying with hands together)
God of Wealth, just once. Let me break even before my husband notices.

CARD PLAYER A
(impatiently)
Play something. Anything.

QIN LING
(smiling faintly)
Last tile.

QIN LING reveals her hand with a quiet flourish.

QIN LING
Nine Gates. Pure and perfect.

CARD PLAYER B
(awestruck)
Twenty years... first time I've seen a Nine Gates in the wild.

AUNT ZHANG
(defeated)
That's six rounds straight. You should just empty my purse at the start.

MALE CARD PLAYER
(to others)
Told you. Never bet against Qin Ling.

QIN LING
(gathering cash with practiced ease)
Sun's getting low. My daughter's family is coming for dinner.

AUNT ZHANG
(grabbing her sleeve)
One more round. Double stakes.

QIN LING
(standing firmly)
When I'm good, I'm good. When I'm done, I'm done.

CARD PLAYER B
(to the table)
Wins and walks. Every. Single. Time.

INT. COURTYARD PAIGOW TABLE - DAY

QIN LING crosses the courtyard to a rougher table where four MEN play Pai Gow. They stiffen as she approaches.

CARD PLAYER C
(covering his tiles)
Sister Qin. We weren't expecting royalty.

CARD PLAYER D
(scrambling)
Go, go, deal her in.

CARD PLAYER C
(sighing)
I'm out. Folded before I started.

QIN LING
(sitting smoothly)
Don't be dramatic. One hand.

CARD PLAYER E
(resigned)
There goes my cigarette money for the month.

The DEALER slides tiles. QIN LING's fingers dance across them.

CARD PLAYER F
(confident)
Double nine cakes. Beat that, Sister Qin.

QIN LING
(laughing softly)
Let me see.

She reveals the Supreme Pair with a sharp snap.

CARD PLAYER C
(jumping back)
Supreme Pair?! We're playing for pennies!

CARD PLAYER E
(to the ceiling)
Why do I do this to myself?

QIN LING
(collecting the modest pot)
Gentlemen, it's been educational.

She stands, leaving them gaping.

CARD PLAYER F
That's it? One hand?

CARD PLAYER D
She's a phantom. A card shark phantom.
continuation:
INT. INDOOR CARD TABLE - DAY

QIN LING enters a smoky back room. XIAO LIU (20s, cocky) deals cards to three PLAYERS.

XIAO LIU
(slapping cards down)
Today I bankrupt you grandpas.

QIN LING
(leaning in the doorway)
Mind if I cut in, Xiao Liu?

XIAO LIU
(stuttering)
A-Aunt Qin. I meant, please, sit.

CARD PLAYER H
(awed)
You're everywhere.

CARD PLAYER I
(chuckling)
Like a tax collector.

QIN LING
(settling in)
Only for the careless.

She plays with surgical precision.

QIN LING
Bomb. Straight. Triple with kicker. Spring hand. Pay.

The table groans. She sweeps the money.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

QINGQING (30s, frantic) skids her bicycle into the courtyard, spots QIN LING emerging.

QINGQING
(gasping for breath)
Aunt Qin! Da Niu's in trouble. They dragged him to the—

QIN LING
(calm exterior cracking)
My son-in-law doesn't gamble.

QINGQING
Exactly! He refused, so they forced him. Said he owes "entertainment fees." Now he's down five thousand at Boss Zhou's den.

QIN LING
(eyes flashing)
Get me there. Now.

INT. GAMBLING DEN - DAY

Smoke hangs thick. DA NIU (40s, terrified) sits at a dice table. His shirt is soaked with sweat and spilled beer. A HEAVY (30s, scarred) looms behind him.

GAMBLERS
Big! Big! Big!

The dice settle. Wrong. DA NIU watches his last chips vanish.

DA NIU
(whispering)
It's gone. My daughter's tuition...

EXT. OUTSIDE GAMBLING DEN - DAY

QINGQING's bicycle screeches to a halt. A NEIGHBOR woman waits, twisted with worry.

FEMALE NEIGHBOR
Sister Qin, thank heaven. They're not letting him leave. Says he owes interest now.

QIN LING
(striding forward)
I brought interest.

She pulls a thick roll of cash from her pocket.

INT. GAMBLING DEN - CONTINUOUS

QIN LING bursts through the door, QINGQING behind her. The room goes silent.

QIN LING
(to the room)
My son-in-law's debt. I'll clear it.

BOSS ZHOU (50s, gold chains) emerges from shadows.

BOSS ZHOU
(smiling coldly)
A woman? How quaint. Double or nothing. Your money against his freedom.

QIN LING
(fierce smile)
One hand. My game.

She points to a pristine mahjong table in the corner.

QIN LING
Nine Gates. If I don't make it, you get everything. If I do, Da Niu walks.

The room holds its breath.

title: Love in Peril
description: A man seeks revenge after being betrayed and left for dead, confined to a wheelchair as he uncovers the truth behind his father's death.
context:
Title: Love in Peril
Description: A man seeks revenge after being betrayed and left for dead, confined to a wheelchair as he uncovers the truth behind his father's death.

INT. CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Shadows stretch across a dim corridor. GU MOXUAN walks with measured steps, his suit sharp as a blade.

Close-up: GU MOXUAN's face—alert, searching.

GU MOXUAN stops, adjusts his tie. His eyes sweep the darkness.

The stairway railing shatters. GU MOXUAN drops into a fighting stance before it hits the ground.

GU MOXUAN engages several THUGS in black. Each movement precise, economical.

GU MOXUAN knocks one THUG down with a single strike.

He spins, sending another THUG crashing into the wall.

GU MOXUAN defeats the thugs. He checks his watch, continues forward.

TITLE CARD: LOVE IN PERIL
continuation:
EXT. RAIN-SOAKED CLEARING - DAY

Thunder cracks. Rain hammers down.

GU MOXUAN lies in a puddle, his face bloodied, legs twisted at impossible angles.

THUG A and THUG B stand over him, sticks raised.

THUG A
Your father's dead. You living is a loose end.

THUG A grinds his boot into GU MOXUAN's hand.

GU MOXUAN
(strangled)
Second Uncle... sent you?

THUG B
Family business.

THUG B strikes down. GU MOXUAN's face vanishes beneath the water.

EXT. VILLA TERRACE - DAY

Morning light. GU MOXUAN sits in a wheelchair, SUBORDINATES behind him, a FEMALE ASSISTANT with medical supplies.

GU MOXUAN holds a diamond ring, turning it slowly. His thumb traces the inscription inside.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Your uncle's gala begins at eight. He expects you to sign the papers.

GU MOXUAN
(quietly)
Let him think he's won.

GU MOXUAN pockets the ring. The coldness in his eyes reveals itself as grief, hardening to steel.

Morning light. GU MOXUAN sits in a wheelchair, SUBORDINATES behind him, a FEMALE ASSISTANT with medical supplies.

GU MOXUAN holds a diamond ring, turning it slowly. His thumb traces the inscription inside.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Your uncle's gala begins at eight. He expects you to sign the papers.

GU MOXUAN
(quietly)
Let him think he's won.

GU MOXUAN pockets the ring. The coldness in his eyes reveals itself as grief, hardening to steel.

title: The Day an Equal Wife Enters, the Day an Imperial Edict Ends the Marriage
description: A woman who sacrificed everything for her husband chooses to divorce him when he takes a concubine as an equal wife, reclaiming her power and independence.
context:
Title: The Day an Equal Wife Enters, the Day an Imperial Edict Ends the Marriage
Description: A woman who sacrificed everything for her husband chooses to divorce him when he takes a concubine as an equal wife, reclaiming her power and independence.

INT. IMPERIAL PALACE HALL - DAY

The EMPRESS sits in the high seat. SU YUYING kneels in the hall, her spine a steel rod.

EMPRESS
You wish to divorce Xiao Linchuan?

SU YUYING
I cannot give him children, nor can I share his bed with another. I set him free.

EMPRESS
(eyes flashing with fury)
You lost your child saving his life. You knelt on frozen ice until your blood froze. And he repays you thus?

SU YUYING
(looking up, eyes dry but red-rimmed)
He broke his promise. I will not break myself.

MONTAGE

SU YUYING (V.O.)
"Only you in this life."

XIAO LINCHUAN (V.O.)
Childhood words. Let them go.

XIAO LINCHUAN (V.O.)
Ruyue carries my heir. She enters as equal wife in two days.

END MONTAGE

EMPRESS
(rising and walking to SU YUYING, taking her hand)
Your mother entrusted you to me. I raised you as my own blood. The Xiao family dares—

SU YUYING
I ask only for a clean separation.

EMPRESS
(quietly fierce)
You gave up the Observatory for him. You gave him his dukedom. You owe him nothing.

EMPRESS
(sighing)
I... grant your divorce.

SU YUYING
(kowtowing, forehead to marble)
Thank you, Your Majesty.

EMPRESS
The edict will be delivered in seven days. But know this—every title, every estate they hold, exists because of you.

The EMPRESS presses a jade tablet into SU YUYING's palm.

EMPRESS
With this, reclaim what is yours. Or let them keep it. The choice is entirely yours.
continuation:
EXT. PALACE CORRIDOR BRIDGE - DAY

SU YUYING and her maid XINYUE walk on the corridor bridge, their reflections rippling below.

XINYUE
(hesitant)
Miss... the child you're carrying. If the Lord knew—

SU YUYING
My child is not a weapon. To announce it now would be... beneath me.

XINYUE
(quietly urgent)
The Marquis title, the imperial favor—all yours. He could never have—

SU YUYING
We share a bed but not a heart. Better a clean fracture than a festering wound.

XINYUE
He was never worthy, Miss.

The CROWN PRINCE SHEN QUE runs over from the distance.

SHEN QUE
(calling out)
Su Yuying! Su Yuying!

SHEN QUE runs up to them.

SHEN QUE
The Empress Mother told me. You're divorcing that fool?

SU YUYING
(bowing)
My affairs shouldn't trouble Your Highness.

SHEN QUE
(grinning)
Trouble? I've held the Observatory directorship empty for three months. Jiangnan's floods approach in seventy days. We need your stars.

SHEN QUE presses a gold tablet into SU YUYING's hand.

SHEN QUE
Your seal. Your choice. But I won't accept refusal.

SHEN QUE turns and leaves.

SU YUYING
Crown Prince!

INT. XIAO RESIDENCE - DAY

XIAO LINCHUAN bursts into the chamber.

XIAO LINCHUAN
You went to the Empress?

SU YUYING
(turning, jade tablet in hand)
I did.

title: The Bright Moon Should Return
description: A woman finds herself in the body of a neglected wife in ancient times, only to discover her husband is destined to become a notorious villain in history.
context:
Title: The Bright Moon Should Return
Description: A woman finds herself in the body of a neglected wife in ancient times, only to discover her husband is destined to become a notorious villain in history.

INT. XIE RESIDENCE ENTRANCE - NIGHT

A WU stands at the entrance, torn robes and bloodied knuckles, watching XIE JIAN walk ahead.

A WU (V.O.)
Could this be him? The future grand villain?

XIA SHI strides out with her son XIE MIN, her glare sharp enough to draw blood.

XIA SHI
What time is it, and you finally know to come back? We've fed you well for two years, even the fiercest beast should have softened by now, you ungrateful thing.

XIA SHI looks A WU up and down.

XIA SHI
Why are you so filthy? Your clothes are even torn?

XIE MIN (pulling XIA SHI's sleeve)
Mother, don't be harsh on A Wu. A Wu is so pitiful.

A Wu's gaze flicks from Xia Shi's contempt to Xie Min's worried face.

A WU (V.O.)
The history books mentioned a sister-in-law and nephew. These must be them.

A WU (lowering her head)
I just ran into two mad dogs.

XIA SHI
Serves you right! Who told you to always think about running back to your parents' home? You're lucky they didn't bite you to death.

XIE JIAN (coldly)
A Jian needs to sleep. Hurry and prepare the bedding.

A Wu's throat tightens. She bows her head and slips past them into the residence.
continuation:
INT. XIE RESIDENCE BEDROOM - NIGHT

A Wu stumbles over a wooden practice sword and bites back a cry of pain.

A WU (V.O.)
They think I ran home. They don't know about the elopement.

She steadies herself, surveying the sparse room. One bed. One desk. The sword—deliberately placed?

A WU (V.O.)
Two years of hate. One thousand taels of dowry. And yet they share a bed.

A WU (to herself)
No way, do we have to sleep in the same bed tonight too?

The door opens. A Wu scrambles backward, colliding with the bed frame.

XIE JIAN enters without a glance. He bolts the door, then sits at the desk with a scroll. The candlelight carves his perfect profile.

A WU (V.O.)
Even better looking than his AI photo. And even colder.

A Wu's gaze drops to the sword. The lover's voice echoes: "Xie Jian let it slip..."

A WU (V.O.)
Wait. That's not right.

FLASHBACK BEGINS:

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

A MAN on horseback leans toward his companion, voice pitched to carry.

MAN
He was practicing sword forms yesterday. Between strokes, he said his wife's dowry was a thousand taels. Said she keeps it hidden somewhere in the west wing. She'll come for it. They always come for love.

FLASHBACK ENDS.

INT. XIE RESIDENCE BEDROOM - NIGHT

A Wu's breath catches. She stares at the sword, then at Xie Jian's impassive face.

A WU (V.O.)
Xie Jian let it slip? The grand villain who does everything flawlessly?

A Wu's fingers find the hidden key in her sleeve. Xie Jian turns a page, the sound crisp and final.

A WU (V.O.)
Oh my god. He orchestrated everything. Even his own wife's escape.

A Wu watches him, motionless, as the candle burns down.

title: Mr. Fu, You're Pursuing a Bit Too Hard
description: Shen Qingqiu hides her identity as a wealthy heiress to marry Lu Zhuo, only to be abandoned at their wedding when his first love is injured. A mysterious man named Fu Yichen rescues her in the rain.
context:
Title: Mr. Fu, You're Pursuing a Bit Too Hard
Description: Shen Qingqiu hides her identity as a wealthy heiress to marry Lu Zhuo, only to be abandoned at their wedding when his first love is injured. A mysterious man named Fu Yichen rescues her in the rain.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

SHEN QINGQIU wears a pure white wedding dress, her face bearing a composed smile. She subtly scans the crowd, noting the empty seats where Lu's parents should be.

SHEN QINGQIU (V.O.)
Three years building this empire together, and he still doesn't know who built it.

LU ZHUO, dressed in a tailored suit, stands rigid on stage. His phone vibrates in his pocket—he silences it.

OFFICIANT
Do you, Mr. Lu Zhuo, take Miss Shen Qingqiu to be your lawfully wedded wife, to love and care for her in sickness and in health, remaining faithful until death do you part?

LU ZHUO hesitates, his jaw tight. The silence stretches.

Suddenly, LU YAO rushes into the wedding venue, her designer heels clicking against marble.

LU YAO
(anxiously)
Brother! The hospital called Nianyao's emergency contact. Her stitches ruptured—she's hemorrhaging. They need authorization for transfusion.

LU ZHUO
(shocked)
What?

LU ZHUO turns to leave. SHEN QINGQIU steps forward, her voice cutting through the whispers.

SHEN QINGQIU
(calmly)
Finish the vow first. Then go save your friend.

LU ZHUO
(pulling away)
She saved my life. This is non-negotiable.

SHEN QINGQIU
(crying out)
Lu Zhuo!

LU ZHUO walks away without looking back.

SHEN QINGQIU
(following, voice choked)
Lu Zhuo! At least sign the certificate! The company boards are watching—

LU ZHUO
(coldly)
The merger will proceed regardless. The arrangement was always paper, not sentiment.

LU ZHUO drops the wedding band on the ground and leaves with LU YAO. SHEN QINGQIU stands frozen, then bends to retrieve the ring.

SHEN QINGQIU (V.O.)
So the Lu family empire stands on Shen family capital, and he sees only paper.

LU YAO approaches SHEN QINGQIU, arms crossed, her smile cruel.

LU YAO
(contemptuously)
Did you honestly think a woman like you could become my sister-in-law? Nianyao has Lu blood in her veins. You have nothing but debt.

SHEN QINGQIU
(lifting her head, eyes determined)
Your family's company was three days from bankruptcy when I met him. Who do you think funded those new factories?

LU YAO
(scoffing)
Delusional. Even if that were true, it's not yours. It's his.

SHEN QINGQIU removes her veil, folds it deliberately, and walks toward the exit.
continuation:
EXT. RAINY STREET - NIGHT

Rain pours down heavily. SHEN QINGQIU walks down the street, her wedding dress clinging to her legs. She stops at an intersection, the traffic lights blurring.

SHEN QINGQIU (V.O.)
The man who couldn't see me. The rain that washes everything clean.

A delivery van skids through a puddle, hydroplaning toward the curb. SHEN QINGQIU falls back as it misses her by inches, her bag flying open, scattering documents.

A black sedan idles at the light. FU YICHEN, holding an umbrella, steps out and walks toward the fallen SHEN QINGQIU.

SHEN QINGQIU (V.O.)
The bidder from last month's acquisition. Of course.

FU YICHEN
You dropped something.

FU YICHEN helps SHEN QINGQIU up, his umbrella covering them both. He retrieves a document—a loan agreement with the Shen Group seal.

FU YICHEN (CONT'D)
You're bleeding. And your ride appears to have abandoned you.

SHEN QINGQIU
I have resources.

FU YICHEN
Yes. You do. Let me provide this one.

SHEN QINGQIU studies his face, recognition dawning.

FU YICHEN (CONT'D)
My car is behind you. Or I can leave you to explain to the police why the Shen heiress is soaked in a wedding dress.

SHEN QINGQIU
You knew?

FU YICHEN
Since the beginning. Now, shall we discuss the terms of your actual marriage? The one that matters.

FU YICHEN guides SHEN QINGQIU toward his waiting car as the rain obscures everything else.

title: Prison Cart Rides to the Golden Hall
description: An emperor refuses to name an heir, while his long-lost son unknowingly faces a terrible fate in the capital.
context:
Title: Prison Cart Rides to the Golden Hall
Description: An emperor refuses to name an heir, while his long-lost son unknowingly faces a terrible fate in the capital.

INT. GOLDEN HALL - DAY

EMPEROR WEN (40s, granite-eyed but weighted by memory) stands before his council. MINISTER LIU (60s, unyielding) steps forward.

MINISTER LIU
The throne's succession remains hollow, and the realm trembles. Your physicians have spoken plainly—the imperial line requires an heir of your own blood, yet fifteen years have passed.

EMPEROR WEN
(low, dangerous)
My bloodline is my own concern, Minister.

MINISTER LIU
(kneeling, voice cracking)
Your Majesty, the memorials overflow! Name a successor, any prince from the clan, or court the chaos you court now!

ALL MINISTERS
(kneeling in unison)
Name a successor, secure the dynasty!

EMPEROR WEN
(drawing his sword, measured)
You test how far my mercy extends.

EMPRESS DOWAGER
Your Majesty, enough!

The EMPEROR drives his sword through Minister Liu. The old man collapses, crimson blooming across the jade carpet. The EMPRESS DOWAGER (70s, iron in silk) turns away, jaw tight.

EMPEROR WEN
(quietly, to the hall)
Speak of adoption again, and the carpet will thirst.

He discards the sword. From his sleeve, he withdraws a faded silk pouch, thumb tracing its embroidery.

INT. HUMBLE COTTAGE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SHEN ZHIROU (30s, gentle but resolute) ties a matching pouch to young XIAO LANG's (25, calloused hands, hungry eyes) belt as he cradles their infant son.

SHEN ZHIROU
One for you, one for me. When you reach the capital... remember the weight of home.

XIAO LANG
(holding the baby close)
When the throne is mine, this cottage will become a palace. You and Zhou'er will wear gold.

SHEN ZHIROU
(soft smile touching her eyes)
Just return to us.

She touches the baby's forehead.

SHEN ZHIROU
Zhou'er. His father's stubborn chin.
continuation:
INT. GOLDEN HALL - DAY

EMPEROR WEN
(V.O.)
Rou'er... I've kept the promise. Where have you hidden our son?

EMPRESS DOWAGER
(approaching, voice low)
Every day you kill in the name of an heir that may not exist. The clan princes wait.

EMPEROR WEN
(spins on her)
He exists. I have turned the empire inside out searching. When Zhou'er stands here, no adopted pup will challenge him.

INT. HUMBLE COTTAGE - DAY

SHEN ZHIROU (50s now, gray threading her hair) clutches the pouch as SHEN YUNZHOU (20, her eyes but his father's bearing) shoulders a traveler's pack.

SHEN YUNZHOU
Mother, you weep over that pouch as if it breathes. It leads to Father. And I will find him.

SHEN ZHIROU
The capital devours boys like you.

SHEN YUNZHOU
Then let it try.

He kisses her forehead and strides out. She clutches the doorway, the pouch fraying in her grip.

SHEN ZHIROU
(whispered into the wind)
Zhou'er...

INT. CAPITAL RECRUITMENT OFFICE - DAY

SHEN YUNZHOU stands before LIU ERGOU (40s, polished cruelty), who studies a roster with feigned boredom.

LIU ERGOU
Imperial service is an honor. You seek a father? The palace knows every man in the capital.

SHEN YUNZHUO
(eager, naive)
Then you'll help me?

LIU ERGOU
(smiling)
Sign here. We'll place you where secrets flow.

Shen Yunzhou presses his thumb to the scroll. Liu Ergou's smile sharpens.

INT. CASTRATION ROOM - DAY

Shen Yunzhou is pinned to a blood-stained bench by two silent GUARDS. His face drains of color.

SHEN YUNZHOU
(struggling)
Wait—there's been a mistake! I'm here for the imperial records, not—

LIU ERGOU
(flicking the blade with his thumb)
Every boy thinks he's special. Your ink is dry. The palace needs eunuchs, and your name topped today's list.

SHEN YUNZHOU
(pleading)
My mother waits! Please, check the records again!

LIU ERGOU
(raising the curved blade)
Hold him tight. This one fights like he has something to lose.

The blade catches the torchlight.

SHEN YUNZHOU
(screaming, primal)
Mother—!

INT. GOLDEN HALL - DAY

The Emperor's fingers tighten around his pouch. The embroidery—"Zhou"— catches the light.

EMPEROR WEN
(to himself)
Soon. Soon he will come.

SHEN ZHIROU (30s, gentle but resolute) ties a matching pouch to young XIAO LANG's (25, calloused hands, hungry eyes) belt as he cradles their infant son.

SHEN ZHIROU
One for you, one for me. When you reach the capital... remember the weight of home.

XIAO LANG
(holding the baby close)
When the throne is mine, this cottage will become a palace. You and Zhou'er will wear gold.

SHEN ZHIROU
(soft smile touching her eyes)
Just return to us.

She touches the baby's forehead.

SHEN ZHIROU
Zhou'er. His father's stubborn chin.

INT. GOLDEN HALL - DAY

EMPEROR WEN
(V.O.)
Rou'er... I've kept the promise. Where have you hidden our son?

EMPRESS DOWAGER
(approaching, voice low)
Every day you kill in the name of an heir that may not exist. The clan princes wait.

EMPEROR WEN
(spins on her)
He exists. I have turned the empire inside out searching. When Zhou'er stands here, no adopted pup will challenge him.

INT. HUMBLE COTTAGE - DAY

SHEN ZHIROU (50s now, gray threading her hair) clutches the pouch as SHEN YUNZHOU (20, her eyes but his father's bearing) shoulders a traveler's pack.

SHEN YUNZHOU
Mother, you weep over that pouch as if it breathes. It leads to Father. And I will find him.

SHEN ZHIROU
The capital devours boys like you.

SHEN YUNZHOU
Then let it try.

He kisses her forehead and strides out. She clutches the doorway, the pouch fraying in her grip.

SHEN ZHIROU
(whispered into the wind)
Zhou'er...

INT. CAPITAL RECRUITMENT OFFICE - DAY

SHEN YUNZHOU stands before LIU ERGOU (40s, polished cruelty), who studies a roster with feigned boredom.

LIU ERGOU
Imperial service is an honor. You seek a father? The palace knows every man in the capital.

SHEN YUNZHUO
(eager, naive)
Then you'll help me?

LIU ERGOU
(smiling)
Sign here. We'll place you where secrets flow.

Shen Yunzhou presses his thumb to the scroll. Liu Ergou's smile sharpens.

INT. CASTRATION ROOM - DAY

Shen Yunzhou is pinned to a blood-stained bench by two silent GUARDS. His face drains of color.

SHEN YUNZHOU
(struggling)
Wait—there's been a mistake! I'm here for the imperial records, not—

LIU ERGOU
(flicking the blade with his thumb)
Every boy thinks he's special. Your ink is dry. The palace needs eunuchs, and your name topped today's list.

SHEN YUNZHOU
(pleading)
My mother waits! Please, check the records again!

LIU ERGOU
(raising the curved blade)
Hold him tight. This one fights like he has something to lose.

The blade catches the torchlight.

SHEN YUNZHOU
(screaming, primal)
Mother—!

INT. GOLDEN HALL - DAY

The Emperor's fingers tighten around his pouch. The embroidery—"Zhou"— catches the light.

EMPEROR WEN
(to himself)
Soon. Soon he will come.

title: Flirting with the Wrong Person, Climbing to High Society
description: A young woman tries to seduce a wealthy heir but ends up targeting the wrong man, leading to unexpected consequences.
context:
Title: Flirting with the Wrong Person, Climbing to High Society
Description: A young woman tries to seduce a wealthy heir but ends up targeting the wrong man, leading to unexpected consequences.

INT. ELEGANT HALLWAY - NIGHT

CLOSE UP on shiny black dress shoes walking across a polished floor, shrouded in smoke. The camera pans up to reveal several men in black suits walking with purpose.

XIE DU, a handsome young man in a dark suit, leads the group with a serious expression. He is flanked by his entourage, including XIE QUAN.

They walk through a crowded, opulent party hall.

XIE QUAN
Uncle, the board members are waiting. Shouldn't you greet them first?

Xie Du glances at Xie Quan with a cold look.

XIE QUAN
(nervously)
Right, right. The lounge is ready when you need it.

XIE DU
Alone.

Xie Du walks away, leaving Xie Quan behind.

INT. PARTY HALL - CONTINUOUS

Champagne glasses are stacked in a pyramid. Guests mingle and chat.

JIANG HUAN, a beautiful woman in a sparkly gown, speaks to her friend, YU JINGHUA.

JIANG HUAN
The Xie family's private lounge, third floor. Their young master is up there right now.

YU JINGHUA
(leaning in)
The Yu family's creditors are circling. If I'm going to use this face to climb higher, better aim for the top.

JIANG HUAN
He's just a university student, always buried in his lab. No experience with women at all.

YU JINGHUA
(adjusting her dress)
Perfect. I'll head up first.

Yu Jinghua and another woman walk towards the stairs. Jiang Huan follows them but stops at the bottom of the stairs.

Her FATHER, an older man in a suit, approaches her.

JIANG HUAN'S FATHER
Huan. The Ninth Master is here today, in his private lounge.

JIANG HUAN
(confused)
Ninth Master? I thought his nephew was—

JIANG HUAN'S FATHER
Don't question. Just follow.

He leads her away. Jiang Huan looks back towards the stairs, worried.

JIANG HAN (V.O.)
Wait. Did Xiaohua just get the wrong room?
continuation:
INT. LOUNGE ROOM - NIGHT

The room is dimly lit. Xie Du sits on a leather sofa, reviewing documents.

Yu Jinghua enters, composing herself, then approaches with rehearsed confidence. She leans over him, hands on his shoulders.

YU JINGHUA
(whispering)
Mr. Xie. I need your help.

XIE DU
(calmly)
Who sent you?

YU JINGHUA
No one. I came myself. I need someone like you.

YU JINGHUA (V.O.)
They said the Xie heir likes bold women. But this one... he's not blushing at all.

YU JINGHUA
The Yu family of South Capital. We used to matter. Now we need someone who remembers.

XIE DU
(looking her up and down)
The Yu family.

YU JINGHUA
(nods slowly)
I'm of age. Legal. If that's your concern.

XIE DU
(smiles slightly)
You want me to save you?

YU JINGHUA
I want you to want to.

XIE DU
Show me why I should.

YU JINGHUA (V.O.)
This isn't a college boy. This is a man who eats boardrooms for breakfast.

XIE DU
What's wrong? You approached me. Now you're trembling.

Xie Du gently lifts her chin with his hand. She looks nervous but determined.

He leans in, wrapping an arm around her.

title: Black Moonlight, She's Full of Lies
description: After dying in a car crash orchestrated by those who wanted her gone, a young woman is reborn five years in the past, determined to turn the tables on those who wronged her.
context:
Title: Black Moonlight, She's Full of Lies
Description: After dying in a car crash orchestrated by those who wanted her gone, a young woman is reborn five years in the past, determined to turn the tables on those who wronged her.

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

A rainy night. A red Ferrari speeds through neon-lit city streets, wipers fighting the downpour. Inside, XIAO YIN drives with white knuckles.

INT. BUS - NIGHT

A man wearing a black mask and cap loads a handgun with a soft CLICK, his eyes cold behind the mask.

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

The bus suddenly cuts in front of the Ferrari, tires SCREAMING. XIAO YIN screams and jerks the steering wheel.

In slow motion, the Ferrari crashes into the bus. The windshield shatters instantly into a thousand diamonds. XIAO YIN's head snaps back—then darkness.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

XIAO YIN jolts awake in bed, gasping for air.

XIAO YIN (V.O.)
I died. I felt the life leave my body. So why am I breathing?

She looks around in confusion, finding the room unchanged yet alien.

XIAO YIN (V.O.)
Wait. The Hong mansion. My childhood prison. Five years ago.

In the mirror, dark wings flicker behind her—a trick of light or something more? The wall painting writhes, briefly becoming thorns and roses. A leather-bound book on the shelf begins to glow.

XIAO YIN (V.O.)
A novel. My life is a novel, and I was written as disposable. That crash was their final edit.

The book flips open, pages turning themselves. Sketches flash: the crash, a girl in blue, Xiao Yin's name crossed out.

XIAO YIN (V.O.)
They killed me to clear the path. They never expected a sequel.

A MAID enters, carrying a silver tray with amber liquid.

MAID
Miss, are you awake? Does your head still hurt? I've brought tonight's medicine.

XIAO YIN
My head is clear. Take it away.

MAID
Miss, your father just called. He said he's bringing back a girl around your age.

XIAO YIN
(eyes on the glowing book)
The protagonist arrives. How convenient.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

In the luxurious living room, a middle-aged man (FATHER) sits impatiently on the sofa, checking his gold watch. Next to him sits a young girl (NEW GIRL) wearing a light blue dress, hands folded demurely. Another young man (HONG YUAN) leans lazily on the armrest, scrolling his phone.

FATHER
Why isn't Xiao Yin coming down yet? I have a dinner reservation.

NEW GIRL
I had no idea there was suddenly another sister.

HONG YUAN
(puts down his phone, voice dripping with venom)
My mother's been in the ground two months. You must've been digging fast, little grave-robber.

FATHER
(angrily)
Hong Yuan, that's enough!

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

XIAO YIN sits at her vanity as twilight bleeds through the windows. She studies her younger face in the mirror.

XIAO YIN (V.O.)
Eighteen and already dead once. This time, I write my own story.

She picks up an eyebrow pencil and lipstick, applying them with the precision of someone painting a mask. Her eyes hold the weight of five years of graves.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Father comforts the New Girl, but his gaze keeps drifting to the staircase.

FATHER
It's fine, it's fine. Xiao Yin's probably just... adjusting.

NEW GIRL
(obediently)
Thank you, Father. I'll be no trouble at all.

Hong Yuan watches her performance, unimpressed, then looks toward the stairs. His smirk fades.

INT. MANSION STAIRCASE - NIGHT

XIAO YIN, fully made up and dressed in an elegant black evening gown, descends gracefully down the spiral staircase with a noble bearing. Each step is a promise. The living room falls silent below. She doesn't rush toward her revenge—she lets it come to her.

title: Lottery Winner's Time Travel
description: A security guard wins the lottery but gets hit by a car while retrieving his ticket, only to wake up in ancient times and meet his ancestor.
context:
Title: Lottery Winner's Time Travel
Description: A security guard wins the lottery but gets hit by a car while retrieving his ticket, only to wake up in ancient times and meet his ancestor.

INT. LOTTERY SHOP - DAY

A composed woman in red (LOTTERY ATTENDANT) writes the winning numbers on a whiteboard.

Security guard YE CHEN sits at a table, clenching his lottery ticket, muttering as he checks each number.

YE CHEN
Thirty-one... thirty-two... four...

YE CHEN jumps up, the ticket trembling. Nearby players cast surprised looks.

YE CHEN
(barely breathing)
Eighty-seven million. Mom's surgery... it's real.

A WOMAN IN BLACK approaches, resting a hand on YE CHEN's arm.

WOMAN IN BLACK
(practiced charm)
Security guard? My employer wants to discuss your... windfall. Somewhere private.

The WOMAN IN BLACK and two associates guide YE CHEN toward the exit.

WOMAN IN BLACK
This way.

LOTTERY ATTENDANT watches them leave, subtly touching a jade pendant.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

YE CHEN is steered along the sidewalk when the ticket is torn from his hand by a gust.

YE CHEN
(panicking)
No! My daughter's future—

YE CHEN breaks free, sprinting back. He scoops up the ticket on the crosswalk.

YE CHEN
(relieved)
Got it—

A black sedan barrels through. Headlights. Impact.

INT. ANCIENT STABLE - DAY

YE CHEN awakens on hay, wearing coarse linen robes.

YE CHEN
(confused)
Where am I?

A woman in white silk (LOTTERY ATTENDANT) enters, carrying a lantern.

YE CHEN looks up, recognition dawning.

YE CHEN
(surprised)
You... from the shop?

LOTTERY ATTENDANT
I am Guanyin, matriarch of the Chen bloodline. And you... wear my grandson's face.

She reveals the ticket—now parchment—it crumbles, leaving the number "31" glowing on his palm.

YE CHEN
(stunned)
Huh?

title: Sharing a Bed, Different Dreams
description: A pregnant woman discovers her paralyzed husband calls her best friend "wife" due to amnesia, forcing her to make painful sacrifices to help him recover his memory.
context:
Title: Sharing a Bed, Different Dreams
Description: A pregnant woman discovers her paralyzed husband calls her best friend "wife" due to amnesia, forcing her to make painful sacrifices to help him recover his memory.

INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM - DAY

Opening shot: A wedding photo—CAI PENG stands tall, SHEN QING glowing. Beside it, a withering bouquet.

SHEN QING (V.O.)
Ten years. That's how long he's been my whole world. Even after the accident stole his legs, he was still whole in my eyes.

Footsteps. Pregnant SHEN QING enters, steadied by TANG QIAOQIAO. CAI PENG sits in his wheelchair, back to them.

CAI PENG
(to TANG QIAOQIAO)
You're home late. I kept thinking...

TANG QIAOQIAO
(gently)
Hospital traffic. The therapist says you're making remarkable progress.

SHEN QING's smile freezes. She watches her husband reach for QIAOQIAO's hand, his eyes never finding her.

SHEN QING (V.O.)
That word. Home. As if I'd become the guest in my own marriage.

TANG QIAOQIAO
(over her shoulder)
Dr. Lin's method requires consistency, Xiao Qing. The immersive reconstruction...

CAI PENG
(interrupting)
She shouldn't leave. Qiaoqiao stays.

SHEN QING
(fumbling)
A-Peng, Dr. Lin only suggested she assist with your exercises...

CAI PENG
(wheeling around, low and dangerous)
Assist? She's been here every morning, every night. Who do you think I've been seeing when I open my eyes? You, flitting in and out like some overpaid nurse? Or her—my wife?

ZHANG MA appears in the kitchen doorway, a tea tray trembling.

ZHANG MA
Sir, your medication...

CAI PENG
Memory? I remember promises. I remember a woman who swore to stand by me. That woman is Qiaoqiao.

SHEN QING
(quietly, to herself)
And who am I, then?

TANG QIAOQIAO
(stepping between them, protective hand on SHEN QING's stomach)
Brother Peng, you're upsetting the baby.

SHEN QING flinches at the touch.

CAI PENG
Then maybe she should rest. In the guest room. Qiaoqiao needs proper sleep for the therapy.

SHEN QING
(looking at her belly, then at him)
Our bedroom. Where we planned...

CAI PENG
A child you keep telling me is mine. Convenient.

TANG QIAOQIAO
Xiao Qing, it's temporary. For his recovery. You said you'd do anything.
continuation:
SHEN QING studies her friend's face—the same face that held her through three miscarriages. Now offering this poisoned contract.

SHEN QING
(to TANG QIAOQIAO, not CAI PENG)
You moved his medication to the nightstand. The green pills. He hates those.

TANG QIAOQIAO
(defensively)
Dr. Lin said...

SHEN QING
(still staring)
You know he hates them. That's why you do it.

A beat. TANG QIAOQIAO looks away.

CAI PENG
(agitated, wheels squeaking)
Enough! Qiaoqiao, tell her. Or I stop eating. Stop therapy.

TANG QIAOQIAO
(softly, eyes on the floor)
He wants me to manage the household. And... you to prepare our meals. Just like you used to.

SHEN QING's laugh is brittle.

SHEN QING
(reading from some internal script)
Immersive reconstruction might trigger...

She turns toward the kitchen.

SHEN QING
(over her shoulder)
The congee takes two hours. You must be hungry.

ZHANG MA follows, her hand not quite touching SHEN QING's elbow.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT

ZHANG MA moves through the darkened study, collecting teacups. Moonlight reveals CAI PENG at the window, his wheelchair abandoned.

He stands. Not trembling. Simply stands, rolling his shoulders.

ZHANG MA
(voice barely a whisper)
Sir... your legs...

CAI PENG
(turning, face unreadable)
Sometimes, Zhang Ma, a man must lose everything to see what he truly had.

He picks up the wedding photo—tenderly.

CAI PENG
She never looked at the medical reports. Not in three months. The dates didn't match the accident.

ZHANG MA
You mean...

CAI PENG
I mean she's so desperate to believe I'm broken, she'll sacrifice everything to fix me.

He sets the photo down. In the glass reflection, ZHANG MA's stricken face.

CAI PENG
Tell her, and you'll break her heart. Not me.

ZHANG MA backs toward the door, cups rattling.

CAI PENG
Tomorrow, buy fresh flowers. The kind from our wedding. Qiaoqiao prefers them.

Memory? I remember promises. I remember a woman who swore to stand by me. That woman is Qiaoqiao.

SHEN QING
(quietly, to herself)
And who am I, then?

TANG QIAOQIAO
(stepping between them, protective hand on SHEN QING's stomach)
Brother Peng, you're upsetting the baby.

SHEN QING flinches at the touch.

CAI PENG
Then maybe she should rest. In the guest room. Qiaoqiao needs proper sleep for the therapy.

SHEN QING
(looking at her belly, then at him)
Our bedroom. Where we planned...

CAI PENG
A child you keep telling me is mine. Convenient.

TANG QIAOQIAO
Xiao Qing, it's temporary. For his recovery. You said you'd do anything.

SHEN QING studies her friend's face—the same face that held her through three miscarriages. Now offering this poisoned contract.

SHEN QING
(to TANG QIAOQIAO, not CAI PENG)
You moved his medication to the nightstand. The green pills. He hates those.

TANG QIAOQIAO
(defensively)
Dr. Lin said...

SHEN QING
(still staring)
You know he hates them. That's why you do it.

A beat. TANG QIAOQIAO looks away.

CAI PENG
(agitated, wheels squeaking)
Enough! Qiaoqiao, tell her. Or I stop eating. Stop therapy.

TANG QIAOQIAO
(softly, eyes on the floor)
He wants me to manage the household. And... you to prepare our meals. Just like you used to.

SHEN QING's laugh is brittle.

SHEN QING
(reading from some internal script)
Immersive reconstruction might trigger...

She turns toward the kitchen.

SHEN QING
(over her shoulder)
The congee takes two hours. You must be hungry.

ZHANG MA follows, her hand not quite touching SHEN QING's elbow.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT

ZHANG MA moves through the darkened study, collecting teacups. Moonlight reveals CAI PENG at the window, his wheelchair abandoned.

He stands. Not trembling. Simply stands, rolling his shoulders.

ZHANG MA
(voice barely a whisper)
Sir... your legs...

CAI PENG
(turning, face unreadable)
Sometimes, Zhang Ma, a man must lose everything to see what he truly had.

He picks up the wedding photo—tenderly.

CAI PENG
She never looked at the medical reports. Not in three months. The dates didn't match the accident.

ZHANG MA
You mean...

CAI PENG
I mean she's so desperate to believe I'm broken, she'll sacrifice everything to fix me.

He sets the photo down. In the glass reflection, ZHANG MA's stricken face.

CAI PENG
Tell her, and you'll break her heart. Not me.

ZHANG MA backs toward the door, cups rattling.

CAI PENG
Tomorrow, buy fresh flowers. The kind from our wedding. Qiaoqiao prefers them.

title: Showdown: I Am the Dragon Mother
description: A powerful woman hides her identity to support her husband for 20 years, only to face his ex-wife's return on the eve of his greatest success.
context:
Title: Showdown: I Am the Dragon Mother
Description: A powerful woman hides her identity to support her husband for 20 years, only to face his ex-wife's return on the eve of his greatest success.

INT. SEAFOOD MARKET TRADING AREA - DAY

DRAGON MOTHER rides a white electric scooter, grocery basket balanced carefully.

A black Mercedes SUV glides to a sharp stop before her. Above, a SILVER DRAGON manifests overhead, its form flickering like heat in the sun.

SUBORDINATE in a black embroidered leather jacket steps out with TWO PROTECTORS. They bow low.

SUBORDINATE
Madam.

The dragon spirit dissipates. DRAGON MOTHER's expression flickers—annoyance masking relief.

DRAGON MOTHER
We've discussed this. No titles. No audiences.

SUBORDINATE
Tomorrow's ceremony changes everything. The East Consortium, the Premier—Yunxuan will stand among Great Xia's architects. You've shielded him long enough. The family should know.

DRAGON MOTHER
(a quiet triumph)
He's built it himself. That's what matters.

SUBORDINATE
Your daughters—

DRAGON MOTHER
—are returning for my birthday. They believe I'm just their mother. Let them believe that for one more day.

She adjusts her grocery bag, turns to leave.

SUBORDINATE
Wang Manli has been seen in the city.

DRAGON MOTHER
(pausing)
Then she knows it's time. Handle the ceremony. I'll manage my home.

She rides away.

FLASHBACK
continuation:
EXT. PRIVATE ESTATE - CLIFF EDGE - DAY

GU YUNXUAN stands at a cliff's edge in a disheveled suit, phone clutched in hand. Waves crash below.

From the estate behind him, three YOUNG DAUGHTERS' voices call out, fearful.

DAUGHTERS (O.S.)
Daddy! Please!

GU YUNXUAN
(whispering)
Everything... gone. And she left. I can't—

He steps forward. A shadow moves—YOUNG DRAGON MOTHER appears from nowhere, catching him mid-air. They land in soft sand, hidden from view.

GU YUNXUAN
(breathless)
Qinglian? You...?

DRAGON MOTHER (YOUNG)
(eyes fierce with purpose)
You fell. I caught you. That's all that matters now.

END FLASHBACK

INT. SEAFOOD MARKET TRADING AREA - DAY

DRAGON MOTHER's face softens at the memory.

DRAGON MOTHER
He fell. I caught him. But I couldn't just set him down and walk away. Twenty years of ordinary life—for him, for our daughters. A fair trade.

SUBORDINATE
Madam, she won't come in peace.

DRAGON MOTHER
(smiling faintly)
Neither will I.

EXT. VILLA EXTERIOR - DAY

DRAGON MOTHER parks her scooter at the gated mansion, lifts her grocery basket.

DAUGHTER (O.S.)
Mom! Is the sauce right?

DRAGON MOTHER
(calling back)
Coming, darling!

INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM - DAY

DRAGON MOTHER enters, smiling. Her expression shatters.

WANG MANLI stands by the grand piano, holding a family photo.

WANG MANLI
He never mentioned his previous business partner?

DRAGON MOTHER's grocery bag slips.

WANG MANLI
Wang Manli. I built the foundation. You kept the house.

DRAGON MOTHER
You left him bankrupt. You made him choose death.

WANG MANLI
(circling closer)
I made him hungry. You made him comfortable. There's a difference.

She touches DRAGON MOTHER's weathered hand.

WANG MANLI
You've been... thorough. No wonder he never looked back.

DRAGON MOTHER
(shaking free)
This is my home.

WANG MANLI
(eyes glittering)
Is it? Let's ask my daughters.

She sweeps a crystal vase from the table. It shatters.

WANG MANLI
(screaming)
She attacked me! Help!

DRAGON MOTHER stands frozen, vase shard in hand, as FOOTSTEPS thunder from above.

title: On the Day of the Broken Engagement, My Parents Reveal They Are From the Supreme Divine Clan
description: A transmigrated young lord with blocked meridians lives as a carefree playboy until his fiancée comes to break their engagement, only for his parents to reveal their true divine heritage.
context:
Title: On the Day of the Broken Engagement, My Parents Reveal They Are From the Supreme Divine Clan
Description: A transmigrated young lord with blocked meridians lives as a carefree playboy until his fiancée comes to break their engagement, only for his parents to reveal their true divine heritage.

INT. YAN PRINCE MANOR GREAT HALL - DAY

Opening scene, music and dance fill the air. Several RED-CLAD DANCERS perform gracefully.

WU NING reclines on a soft couch, two MAIDSERVANTS attending to him, feeding him wine and food.

WU NING (V.O.)
When others transmigrate, they dominate worlds. Me? I got blocked meridians and a PhD in spectatoring. Twenty years of cultivation failure teaches you life's true secret: if you can't be the protagonist, be the most comfortable NPC in the room.

WU NING
A little to the left. Perfect. See? Mastery comes in many forms.

A SERVANT stumbles into the great hall, breathless and pale.

SERVANT
Your Highness—disaster! Princess Qingyao is here with the Seven Star Sect. They've come to sever the engagement!

WU NING
And she couldn't send a messenger first?

Before he finishes speaking, LIN YAO strides into the hall. Behind her, a SEVEN STAR SECT ELDER floats inches above the ground, radiating pressure. ARMORED ATTENDANTS flank them.

LIN YAO
I won't waste words. The engagement is a shackle—for both of us. I've awakened my Seven Star Physique. In three years, I'll be core formation. In thirty, I'll be legend. How long before you can even gather qi?

WU NING
I ask myself that every morning.

LIN YAO
The Pingxi Prince Manor owes your family a debt. I don't. This document ends our ties. Sign it.

WU NING's mother MURONG YIN and father WU TIANYUN emerge from behind a silk screen. Their presence immediately shifts the room's atmosphere—the dancers freeze.

MURONG YIN
You think we raised our son to be mocked in his own home?

WU TIANYUN
When the Pingxi Manor was three days from annihilation, you begged for this union. Not for love—for survival. My son gave you sanctuary. You repay him with a spectacle?

WU NING
I get it, Lin Yao. You found a better ladder. Just wish you weren't stepping on my face to climb it.
continuation:
SEVEN STAR SECT ELDER
You speak to a heaven-blessed prodigy! She will be my sect's jewel. Your son is dust beneath her feet. Sign, or this dust will settle over your entire manor.

The Elder raises a hand. Seven starlight swords materialize, humming with lethal intent. He flicks his wrist—one sword streaks toward WU TIANYUN.

WU TIANYUN doesn't move. The sword shatters against his chest like glass, not even tearing his robe.

WU TIANYUN
Who gave you permission to draw weapons in my house?

He extends two fingers. A ripple of golden light erupts. The Elder is blasted backward, crashing through three stone pillars before embedding in the wall. The starlight swords dissolve into nothing.

WU NING (V.O.)
Okay. Dad's been holding out on career day.

WU TIANYUN
Take your elder. Leave the document. My son will sign nothing.

LIN YAO
The Seven Star Sect Leader wields the Starfall Formation. Even the Imperial Ancestor fears it. Today's matter will not end here.

WU TIANYUN
The heavens? Child, I built the heavens your sect borrows light from.

He gestures. An invisible force lifts Lin Yao's group and deposits them gently—but firmly—outside the manor gates. The doors slam shut.

WU NING
Twenty years. You let me believe I was broken.

MURONG YIN
We let you live, beloved. The moment you showed blocked meridians, seventeen divine clans marked you for death. We sealed our powers, hid among mortals, bound our cultivation to your heartbeat. Your weakness was your shield. Your pain was our price.

WU TIANYUN
The seal is broken now. They know where we are. And more importantly... they know what you might become.

WU NING
What I might become? I can't even cultivate!

MURONG YIN
Your meridians aren't blocked, my son. They're waiting. For divine essence. The moment it flows through you, not even the heavens will be able to look away.

WU NING stares at his parents, then at his own hands. Golden light flickers between his knuckles.

WU NING (V.O.)
Twenty years the punchline. Guess it's time to learn the joke.

title: Famine Year - The Village Eats Tree Bark While I Feast on Meat with My Family
description: A man transmigrates into a poor young man's body during a famine year, inheriting memories of his selfish past and facing a starving family.
context:
Title: Famine Year - The Village Eats Tree Bark While I Feast on Meat with My Family
Description: A man transmigrates into a poor young man's body during a famine year, inheriting memories of his selfish past and facing a starving family.

INT. DILAPIDATED HUT - DAY

A thatched hut suffocating under famine's weight. GU ZHOUYUAN (19) lies deathly still on moldy straw, corpse-pale. His younger brother GOUDAN (9) clutches his hand, weeping. Older sister GU ZHAODI (21) hovers, hollow-eyed, watching her brother's chest for any rise.

GOUDAN
(crying out)
Second Brother, Second Brother, wake up! Don't die!

At the doorway, SEVERAL VILLAGERS watch like carrion birds.

VILLAGER A
Even the Gu family's pampered son is about to starve. This famine year... it shows no mercy.

VILLAGER B
(quieter, cutting)
His siblings gave him everything. If he goes, at least they can finally eat.

GU ZHAODI
(whirling, voice raw)
All of you, shut up!

GU ZHOUYUAN's eyes SNAP OPEN—confusion, then the sickening lurch of wrong memories. Wrong life.

GOUDAN
continuation:
(overjoyed)
Sister, he's awake! Second Brother is awake!

GU ZHAODI
(crying tears of joy)
Second Brother is awake! Xiaoyuan, you scared me to death!

The VILLAGERS at the door recoil, murmuring superstitious prayers.

VILLAGER C
Hey, look at him...

VILLAGER A
How did he wake up?

VILLAGER B
How did he come back from the dead?

VILLAGER C
He really has a tough life!

GU ZHOUYUAN slowly sits up, head splitting. His gaze lands on ZHAODI's rope-thin wrists, GOUDAN's swollen hunger-belly, the empty pot in the corner. Memory fragments assault him—taking their food, their mother's last grain, complaining it wasn't meat.

GU ZHOUYUAN (V.O.)
I was a ghost in their lives. Now I'm the one who's haunted.

He looks at his siblings. They meet his eyes—then glance away, the old reflex. For the first time, he truly sees them. And himself.

title: Transmigrated as the Male Lead's Cannon Fodder Wife
description: A doctor finds herself transmigrated into a novel as the disposable wife of the male lead, married to a man who despises her and keeps a mistress.
context:
Title: Transmigrated as the Male Lead's Cannon Fodder Wife
Description: A doctor finds herself transmigrated into a novel as the disposable wife of the male lead, married to a man who despises her and keeps a mistress.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

LU CHENGYAN holds an ultrasound report, looking contemptuously at the doctor XIA WAN standing across from him. Next to LU CHENGYAN stands a delicate pregnant woman, his mistress. XIA WAN's FEMALE COLLEAGUE stands beside her.

LU CHENGYAN
Don't think this changes anything. You're still trying to interfere.

XIA WAN
I'm not interfering. I'm stepping aside. You can have the life you want.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(quietly to XIA WAN)
Dr. Xia, they're humiliating you. You don't have to do this.

XIA WAN
(smiling faintly)
You can't force what's not meant to be. Why should we all be miserable?

XIA WAN
(turning back to LU CHENGYAN)
Because I'm giving you what you want. It's the fastest way to be free of each other.

XIA WAN turns to leave.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Dr. Xia, wait for me!

The FEMALE COLLEAGUE chases after XIA WAN.

MISTRESS
(tentatively)
Chengyan... is she serious?

LU CHENGYAN
She's playing games. Someone like her doesn't give up that easily.

MISTRESS
(quietly)
What if she means it? I don't want our child caught in the middle of...

LU CHENGYAN
(gently cupping her face)
Our child will be safe. I'll handle Xia Wan. From now on, I'm not letting you out of my sight.

MISTRESS
Okay, good.

LU CHENGYAN embraces the MISTRESS and leaves.
continuation:
EXT. CITY NIGHT SCENE - NIGHT

Time-lapse of the city at night, lights beginning to glow.

EXT. VILLA EXTERIOR - NIGHT

XIA WAN, now in business attire, walks down the road pulling a suitcase. Her phone rings, the caller ID shows "SONG YAN."

XIA WAN
(V.O.)
At least someone will be happy for me.

XIA WAN answers the call.

XIA WAN
Hello?

INT. BAR - NIGHT

SONG YAN sits in the colorful bar, smiling as she talks on the phone.

SONG YAN
(on phone)
Wanwan. Tell me it's true—you left him?

XIA WAN
(outside the villa)
Signed a lease today. I'm officially out.

SONG YAN
About damn time. Come out tonight. We're celebrating.

The camera finds PEI YANLI alone at the bar, nursing a drink.

SONG YAN
(on phone)
And I may have found the perfect distraction.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

SONG YAN sits in the colorful bar, smiling as she talks on the phone.

SONG YAN
(on phone)
Wanwan. Tell me it's true—you left him?

XIA WAN
(outside the villa)
Signed a lease today. I'm officially out.

SONG YAN
About damn time. Come out tonight. We're celebrating.

The camera finds PEI YANLI alone at the bar, nursing a drink.

SONG YAN
(on phone)
And I may have found the perfect distraction.

INT. BAMBOO FOREST - DAY

A funeral procession dressed in white mourning clothes carries a black coffin along a bamboo forest path. The leading girl scatters paper money.

SU QINGWU, in white robes, holding a white oiled-paper umbrella, walks slowly from the distance.

SU QINGWU stops and watches the funeral procession.

SU QINGWU (V.O.)
Something's wrong. The person in the coffin still has a breath of life.

SU QINGWU steps forward, extends her hand and presses it on the coffin, stopping the procession.

The funeral procession is forced to stop and sets the coffin on the ground.

FUNERAL LEADER

FUNERAL LEADER

SU QINGWU spins her umbrella, and a strong wind blows the funeral attendants to the ground.

SU QINGWU takes a pill from her sleeve, opens the coffin lid, and places the pill under the nose of the man inside (FU LIANG).

SU QINGWU

FU LIANG suddenly opens his eyes and sits up.

FUNERAL LEADER (terrified)
The... the dead man is alive! The dead man is alive!

SU QINGWU turns and walks away with her umbrella.

FUNERAL LEADER (suddenly understanding)
She's the Medical Immortal of Luofu!

The funeral procession members all kneel down and kowtow toward the direction SU QINGWU departed.

FUNERAL PROCESSION (CONT'D)
Thank you, Medical Immortal! Thank you, Medical Immortal!

TRANSITION TO:

Six years later
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

SU QINGWU sits on the examination table, clutching her purse. A FEMALE DOCTOR, mid-thirties with kind eyes, is preparing equipment.

FEMALE DOCTOR
First pregnancy? Your husband couldn't make it?

SU QINGWU
He's at a conference. I didn't want to bother him.

SU QINGWU (V.O.)

A knock at the door. Three sharp raps - authoritative, impatient.

FU LIANG (O.S.)
Doctor Chen? I need a favor.

SU QINGWU (V.O.)
That voice. Six years, and he still doesn't let me visit his hospital.

The door opens. FU LIANG, wearing a white coat, enters with PEI YU beside him - also in a white coat, her hand resting on her swollen belly. They're laughing at something shared.

FEMALE DOCTOR
Director Fu, Dr. Pei. I have a patient right now.

FU LIANG
This'll be quick. Pei needs her glucose test moved up. She's on afternoon rounds.

Only then does FU LIANG's gaze land on SU QINGWU. His professional smile falters.

FU LIANG
Qingwu?

PEI YU's hand tightens on her belly. Her smile doesn't reach her eyes.

PEI YU
What a coincidence.

SU QINGWU (V.O.)
So this is why he worked late. Why he didn't want children. Why he built walls I wasn't allowed to climb.

PEI YU (to SU QINGWU, voice like silk)
You're here alone? How... independent. Don't worry, I won't take up much of his time. Unlike some people, my work has value.

The FEMALE DOCTOR glances between them, sensing the tension.

SU QINGWU stands, her own pregnancy just starting to show beneath her loose dress.

SU QINGWU
The appointment was mine.

FU LIANG (recovering)
Qingwu, Pei Yu's a department chief. Her schedule -

SU QINGWU
I'm his wife.

PEI YU
A title without weight. Tell me, when was the last time he introduced you as such?

SU QINGWU's hand clenches. She takes a step toward PEI YU.

SU QINGWU
You don't know what weight is. Let me show you.

SU QINGWU slaps PEI YU. The crack echoes.

FU LIANG (grabbing SU QINGWU's wrist)
You think you're the only one who matters? I built this hospital with my hands! Pei Yu helped me! What have you done but wait at home?

He shoves her back. SU QINGWU stumbles, her hip catching the edge of the examination table. She cries out, doubling over. A small red stain spreads on her dress.

SU QINGWU (in pain, voice breaking)
Our baby...

FU LIANG's face drains of color. He takes a half-step toward her.

FU LIANG
Qingwu -

PEI YU (touching her cheek)
She's dramatic. Check if she's really -

FU LIANG turns back to PEI YU, his hand hovering near her shoulder, unsure.

SU QINGWU (gasping, on the floor)
You're choosing... which one to save?

FEMALE DOCTOR
Call a code! We need a gurney, now!

FU LIANG hovers between the two women, his face a mask of guilt and calculation.

FU LIANG (voice low)
If the child's gone... we can try again. I won't leave you. But I need you to be reasonable. For both our sakes.

SU QINGWU laughs, a hollow, broken sound. She presses a hand to her belly, and for a moment, something ancient flares in her eyes - then dies.

SU QINGWU (V.O.)
I saved your life once. I won't make that mistake again. Fu Liang... we're done.

FADE OUT.

title: Ex-Wife's Redemption
description: A wealthy CEO accepts a challenge to fake bankruptcy for three months to test the loyalty of those around her, betting company shares with her best friend.
context:
Title: Ex-Wife's Redemption
Description: A wealthy CEO accepts a challenge to fake bankruptcy for three months to test the loyalty of those around her, betting company shares with her best friend.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

Sunlight streams through massive floor-to-ceiling windows into the misty, luxurious living room, creating a soft, dreamlike glow.

BEST FRIEND, wearing a black strapless top and silver sequined gown, walks toward XUE'ER, who sits on a beige sofa, carrying two glasses of red wine. Her measured steps echo across the marble floors.

ON SCREEN: XUE'ER - CEO OF ZHAO CORPORATION

XUE'ER accepts the wine glass, her fingers lingering on the stem as she meets BEST FRIEND's gaze.

BEST FRIEND
My lawyers drafted the contract this morning. Three months, controlled insolvency simulation. Complete legal protection.

BEST FRIEND
The question is—do you actually have the courage to see who stays when the money disappears?

XUE'ER
continuation:
(smiling, but her eyes tighten)
What's there to be afraid of?

BEST FRIEND
Don't answer so quickly. Pan Ming is already planning your engagement. And your dear "brother" Ryan has been making some interesting calls to our competitors.

BEST FRIEND
(leaning closer)
Your father lost everything to people he trusted.

BEST FRIEND
(quietly)
Are you sure you want to bet twenty percent of Zhao Corporation on that same mistake?

XUE'ER
(chuckles, swirling her wine)
If you want to walk away from your own company, who am I to stop you?

They raise their glasses. The crystal chimes hang in the air as XUE'ER downs her wine in one swallow, her hand trembling almost imperceptibly.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Blade of the Rose
description: A woman returns home to find her gambling-addicted father in despair, but she has a plan to teach the local card shark a lesson.
context:
Title: Blade of the Rose
Description: A woman returns home to find her gambling-addicted father in despair, but she has a plan to teach the local card shark a lesson.

INT. HOME - DAY

XIAO XI steps through the door, her suitcase catching on the frame. The living room is spotless except for a single overturned chair. Her father, DA ZHUANG GE, kneels by the sideboard, his back to her, stuffing crumpled bills into a cookie tin.

XIAO XI
Dad?

He startles, sending the tin clattering. Bills flutter around his bandaged hand.

DA ZHUANG GE
Xiao Xi. You're early.

XIAO XI drops her suitcase and moves toward him, eyes on his swollen knuckles.

XIAO XI
What happened to your hand?

DA ZHUANG GE
(tucking the tin away)
Nothing. Just... dropped something.

XIAO XI
The chair?

Her gaze finds the chair, then returns to him. He won't meet her eyes.

XIAO XI
How much this time?

DA ZHUANG GE
It's handled. Don't worry about it.

He tries to stand, winces. She helps him up, her touch gentle but her voice firm.

XIAO XI
Mom's hospital fund is almost gone, isn't it?

DA ZHUANG GE
(finally looking at her)
I'll get it back. I promise.

XIAO XI releases him. She goes to her bag, pulls out an envelope thick with cash.

XIAO XI
Three years. Every overtime shift. Every weekend.

She holds it between them.

XIAO XI
Take me with you. Or I burn it.
continuation:
EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

DA ZHUANG GE walks faster now, the envelope secure in his jacket. XIAO XI matches his pace, her eyes scanning the empty fields.

DA ZHUANG GE
With this much, I can cover the losses. Get us square.

XIAO XI
Square's a good place to start.

EXT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

The metal door is rusted shut, but the ground before it shows fresh tire tracks. DA ZHUANG GE raps a coded rhythm. A slot slides open. Sunglasses reflect them back.

DONG WEI SHU
Back for more?

XIAO XI
I'm here to watch my father win.

The slot closes. Chains rattle. The door lifts just enough for them to duck under.

INT. WAREHOUSE GAMBLING DEN - DAY

Cigarette smoke hangs thick. A dozen men circle a green felt table, their shadows dancing under a single swinging bulb. FU QIANG, mid-30s with grease-stained fingers, flips his cards.

FU QIANG
Eight. Not enough.

DONG ZI, young and twitchy, slams his cards down.

DONG ZI
Five. Damn it.

The dealer, A GOU, reveals a nine. His gold tooth catches the light as he rakes in the chips.

A GOU
House takes it. Always does.

DA ZHUANG GE pushes to the table, brandishing the envelope.

DA ZHUANG GE
Deal me in.

A GOU barely glances up, shuffling.

A GOU
Your two hundred yuan wouldn't cover the ante, old man.

DA ZHUANG GE
Today I'm playing big.

He slaps the cash on the felt. The table goes quiet. A GOU's shuffle stops.

DA ZHUANG GE
My daughter's stake.

XIAO XI steps from the shadows. Her smile is ice.

XIAO XI
A Gou.

A GOU studies her, then the money. The corners of his mouth lift.

A GOU
City girl knows the game. Excellent.

He signals. DONG WEI SHU appears with a rack of chips.

A GOU
Let's see if your luck runs in the family.

DA ZHUANG GE reaches for the chips. XIAO XI's hand stops him.

XIAO XI
Deal first.

She pulls out a chair. Sits. The men exchange looks. A GOU's smile fades slightly. XIAO XI's eyes haven't left his hands since she entered.

A GOU
You playing or watching?

XIAO XI
Both.

She places the envelope directly in front of her. Her fingers trace the edge like a blade.
