title: Your Majesty, the Empress Has Snuck Out Through the Dog Hole Again
description: After witnessing her family's execution in a nightmare, a mischievous young noblewoman disguised as a man accidentally punches a mysterious man in the street, only to realize he may be from the imperial palace.
context:
Title: Your Majesty, the Empress Has Snuck Out Through the Dog Hole Again
Description: After witnessing her family's execution in a nightmare, a mischievous young noblewoman disguised as a man accidentally punches a mysterious man in the street, only to realize he may be from the imperial palace.

INT. PRIME MINISTER'S MANSION - NIGHT

Raging flames engulf the Prime Minister's mansion. A plaque reading "Prime Minister's Mansion" hangs above the gate.

IMPERIAL HERALD (V.O.)
By order of the Emperor, Prime Minister Luo Chuanhe, for treason and conspiracy to usurp the throne, is sentenced to immediate execution!

Young LUO CHANG'AN, wearing a pink dress, runs frantically through the burning courtyard.

LUO CHANG'AN
Father!

SOLDIERS wielding torches and swords charge into the mansion.

IMPERIAL HERALD (V.O.)
Imperial Attendant Luo Chang'an is to be exiled to Lingnan! Traitors and their kin shall be punished by all!

LUO CHANG'AN watches in horror as her father and family members are executed on the spot by soldiers, their blood staining the snow. Her eyes widen in terror.

LUO CHANG'AN
Father!

INT. CARRIAGE - DAY

LUO CHANG'AN wakes from her nightmare, gasping for air. She is now dressed as a man in blue robes, her hair tied up in a high bun.

ATTENDANT (O.S.)
Young Master, we've arrived at Fengyue Tower.

LUO CHANG'AN lifts the carriage curtain and peers out, seeing the bustling street. She exhales slowly, steadying herself.

LUO CHANG'AN
(to herself)
Just a dream. Same dream.

She adjusts her composure, a practiced smile masking her trembling lips.

LUO CHANG'AN
(quietly)
Time to play the part.

She jumps down from the carriage with forced cheerfulness.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

LUO CHANG'AN swaggers down the lively street, fanning herself with a folding fan. She accidentally bumps into a woman called MEI JIAONIANG.

MEI JIAONIANG
I'm sorry, Young Master.

LUO CHANG'AN
(flirtatiously)
Oh my. No apology needed, miss.

LUO CHANG'AN lifts MEI JIAONIANG's chin with her fan.

LUO CHANG'AN
Such fresh beauty deserves better than this dusty street.

LUO CHANG'AN puts her arm around MEI JIAONIANG's shoulder.

LUO CHANG'AN
Let me buy you some wine. We'll make a day of it.

MEI JIAONIANG
(panicked)
Help! That little devil from the merchant quarter is harassing women again!

LUO CHANG'AN
You know my reputation and still tempt me? I must be truly charming.

LUO CHANG'AN
Come, one drink won't hurt.

A man in black robes, SONG YE, blocks their path.

SONG YE
Excuse me, brother. The lady is uncomfortable.

LUO CHANG'AN
(irritated)
Brother? I have no brother who'd interfere so. Move aside.

LUO CHANG'AN shoves SONG YE. He stands firm. She raises her fist—

— and punches SONG YE in the nose. SONG YE's nose starts bleeding.

ATTENDANT
Master!

A plump EUNUCH, EUNUCH CAO, runs over.

EUNUCH CAO
(in a shrill voice)
How dare you! Assaulting someone in broad daylight! You—

EUNUCH CAO sees SONG YE's bleeding nose.

EUNUCH CAO
You're bleeding, Master!

LUO CHANG'AN freezes when she hears EUNUCH CAO's voice.

LUO CHANG'AN (V.O.)
That voice... palace cadence. I've struck imperial blood.

LUO CHANG'AN turns and runs.

EUNUCH CAO
You dare run!

SONG YE
No need.

SONG YE wipes the blood from his nose, watching LUO CHANG'AN's fleeing figure with an amused smile.

SONG YE
I know that face. From the archives.

EUNUCH CAO
My lord?

SONG YE
(turning away)
Follow her. Don't be seen.

LUO CHANG'AN puts her arm around MEI JIAONIANG's shoulder.

LUO CHANG'AN
Let me buy you some wine. We'll make a day of it.

MEI JIAONIANG
(panicked)
Help! That little devil from the merchant quarter is harassing women again!

LUO CHANG'AN
You know my reputation and still tempt me? I must be truly charming.

LUO CHANG'AN
Come, one drink won't hurt.

A man in black robes, SONG YE, blocks their path.

SONG YE
Excuse me, brother. The lady is uncomfortable.

LUO CHANG'AN
(irritated)
Brother? I have no brother who'd interfere so. Move aside.

LUO CHANG'AN shoves SONG YE. He stands firm. She raises her fist—

— and punches SONG YE in the nose. SONG YE's nose starts bleeding.

ATTENDANT
Master!

A plump EUNUCH, EUNUCH CAO, runs over.

EUNUCH CAO
(in a shrill voice)
How dare you! Assaulting someone in broad daylight! You—

EUNUCH CAO sees SONG YE's bleeding nose.

EUNUCH CAO
You're bleeding, Master!

LUO CHANG'AN freezes when she hears EUNUCH CAO's voice.

LUO CHANG'AN (V.O.)
That voice... palace cadence. I've struck imperial blood.

LUO CHANG'AN turns and runs.

EUNUCH CAO
You dare run!

SONG YE
No need.

SONG YE wipes the blood from his nose, watching LUO CHANG'AN's fleeing figure with an amused smile.

SONG YE
I know that face. From the archives.

EUNUCH CAO
My lord?

SONG YE
(turning away)
Follow her. Don't be seen.

title: My Money Printer is Slightly Better
description: A live-streaming saleswoman's secret pregnancy is exposed during a broadcast, but her boss unexpectedly claims his wife.
context:
Title: My Money Printer is Slightly Better
Description: A live-streaming saleswoman's secret pregnancy is exposed during a broadcast, but her boss unexpectedly claims his wife.

INT. LU CORPORATION SALES CENTER - DAY

ON SCREEN: Lu Corporation Sales Center

SHEN FANXING stands before a massive property model, live-streaming on her phone. Colleagues and clients cluster behind her.

SHEN FANXING
Everyone can see that seventy percent green space coverage means breathing room, not just numbers. This pool? Temperature-controlled, year-round.

LU JINGJIE sits on a sofa across the room, watching Shen Fanxing's broadcast on his phone. SONG HAIQING stands beside him, tablet in hand.

SHEN FANXING (V.O.)
(through phone)
Our property is nestled by mountains and water.

SHEN FANXING
Now, this user "Flowers Bloom, Wealth Comes" wants to video chat. Let's connect you, Auntie—

She taps accept. The screen buffers, then her mother's frantic face fills the frame.

SHEN FANXING
(shocked, whisper)
Mom? I'm working—

SHEN'S MOTHER
(through phone, desperate)
Your father found a prenatal report in your bag—three months! No boyfriend, Fanxing, how could you hide this? Wait... what's that scrolling?

Live comments flood the screen: "Pregnant?" "Scandal!" The call drops. The room falls silent.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(whispering to another)
Did she just...?

MALE COLLEAGUE
(staring at his phone)
Two thousand shares already. She's trending.

LU JINGJIE looks up, his gaze sharp on Shen Fanxing. His knuckles whiten around his phone.

LU JINGJIE
(internal)
That voice. And she's pregnant.

FLASHBACK
continuation:
EXT. RESORT POOL - NIGHT

LU JINGJIE emerges from the pool, water droplets sliding down his back. SHEN FANXING stumbles to the edge in a wrinkled dress, clearly drunk. She trips over a lounge chair.

LU JINGJIE
(catching her elbow)
Careful—

SHEN FANXING
(disoriented)
So hot... everything's spinning...

She drops her purse. A gold star keychain tumbles out. Lu Jingjie catches it, pauses.

LU JINGJIE
VIP wing's off-limits, miss.

SHEN FANXING
(laughing helplessly)
Tell the bachelorette party...

She sways. He steadies her toward a chair. They tumble together, faces inches apart. Her eyes are glassy, scared.

LU JINGJIE
(softening)
Just breathe.

She kisses him, impulsive. He freezes—then pulls back, pressing the keychain into her palm.

LU JINGJIE
(gruffly)
You're drunk. This didn't happen.

He walks away. She stares at the star in her hand, confused.

END FLASHBACK

INT. LU CORPORATION SALES CENTER - DAY

Colleagues whisper, phones out.

MALE COLLEAGUE
She's still in probation. No severance.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
The company can't afford this PR mess.

SONG HAIQING walks to Shen Fanxing, her voice ice.

SONG HAIQING
Shen Fanxing. Concealing material facts breaches your contract. You're terminated. Collect your wages and leave.

SHEN FANXING
(quietly)
I didn't mean—

SONG HAIQING
Don't. Just go.

LU JINGJIE
(standing, voice cutting through)
That's enough.

He crosses to Shen Fanxing, his hand finding hers. She flinches. He holds firm.

LU JINGJIE
(to the room, calmly)
Anyone firing my wife answers to legal.

SHEN FANXING
(heart in her throat)
What are you—

SONG HAIQING
(stunned)
Mr. Lu, you can't—

LU JINGJIE
I just did.

He looks at Shen Fanxing. For the first time, his expression isn't cold—it's complicated.

LU JINGJIE
(very quietly)
Gold star. I kept the match.

Shen Fanxing's breath catches. Recognition floods her terror-stricken face.

FADE OUT.

title: I Once Sponsored Her
description: After being reborn, a woman discovers that the impoverished student she sponsored was actually her husband's illegitimate daughter with their housekeeper, and seeks revenge.
context:
Title: I Once Sponsored Her
Description: After being reborn, a woman discovers that the impoverished student she sponsored was actually her husband's illegitimate daughter with their housekeeper, and seeks revenge.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Quick, sharp cuts. SHEN YUNXI holds gold scissors, savagely slicing through a silver sequined dress on a mannequin.

SHEN YUNXI (V.O.)
After my rebirth, I destroyed the Chanel dress and Hermès bag I'd bought for my daughter. In my previous life, these same gifts appeared on the body of He Niannian—the "impoverished" student I'd sponsored.

The scene changes. ZHAO YU and HE LING wheel a cake cart toward HE NIANNIAN, who wears the same sequined dress. Zhao Yu's hand lingers on her shoulder a beat too long.

ZHAO YU
Happy birthday, my precious girl.

HE NIANNIAN
(catching his eye)
Thank you, Dad.

SHEN YUNXI stands frozen in the doorway, her face draining of color as she notices the matching dress.

SHEN YUNXI (V.O.)
That's when I realized—the girl I'd clothed and educated was their daughter. My husband and my housekeeper's.

SHEN YUNXI
(quietly, dangerously)
Zhao Yu.

She strides into the room, her voice rising with each step.

SHEN YUNXI
Twenty years. You moved her into our home, made me sponsor our own bastard daughter—so you could play happy family under my roof?

She shoves the cake cart. It topples, frosting smearing across the marble floor.

ZHAO YU
(grabbing her arm)
Yunxi, wait—the company needs you! I was going to tell you—

SHEN YUNXI
Let go!

HE NIANNIAN
(stepping between them)
He won't let go. Without you, his business collapses. But you? You've been blind for two decades.

She slaps Shen Yunxi, the crack echoing. Shen Yunxi stumbles, her temple striking the table edge.

ZHAO YU
(starting toward Shen Yunxi)
Niannian, enough—

HE NIANNIAN
(white-lipped)
She calls me a bastard? She lives in her gilded cage while Mom scrubs her floors. Soon, neither of them will matter.

SHEN YUNXI
(dazed)
Don't you touch my daughter—

HE NIANNIAN
continuation:
She's already here.

SHEN YAO races down the stairs.

SHEN YAO
Mom!

She rushes to Shen Yunxi, who clutches her sleeve.

SHEN YUNXI
Run, Yaoyao. Please.

HE NIANNIAN
Too late.

A knife clatters from He Niannian's sleeve onto the floor.

HE NIANNIAN
One sacrifice. That's all I need.

SHEN YAO's gaze flicks from the blade to her mother's bleeding forehead. Her breath catches. In one fluid motion, she seizes the knife.

SHEN YAO
(softly)
Not her.

She drives it into her own abdomen.

SHEN YUNXI
(screaming)
Yaoyao!

Shen Yunxi crawls through the blood, pulling Shen Yao into her arms.

SHEN YUNXI
(sobbing)
No, no, no—

HE NIANNIAN
(flicks a lighter)
Accidental gas leak. Tragic, really.

The flame arcs through the air. Curtains ignite.

Shen Yunxi cradles her daughter as smoke billows.

SHEN YUNXI (V.O.)
I gave them everything. They took my daughter. Heaven heard my rage.

INT. SHEN YUNXI'S STUDIO - DAY

Clean, bright. Shen Yunxi stands before the mannequin in the intact silver dress, her phone showing the birthday photo.

SHEN YUNXI (V.O.)
This time, I see clearly.

Her fingers trace the scissors' edge. The blade catches the light.

SHEN YUNXI (V.O.)
And I remember everything.

Her eyes reflect cold fire.

title: So What If I'm Arrogant
description: A centuries-old cultivator emerges from seclusion and navigates the modern world, meeting a young woman he befriended online who has no idea of his true age.
context:
Title: So What If I'm Arrogant
Description: A centuries-old cultivator emerges from seclusion and navigates the modern world, meeting a young woman he befriended online who has no idea of his true age.

INT. GU YUROU'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

GU YUROU, wearing white pajamas, lies on her bed happily chatting on her phone.

The phone screen shows the chat history.

SO WHAT IF I'M ARROGANT (TEXT)
Where should we meet?

GU YUROU
Then it's settled. Tomorrow we'll meet at the bus stop across from Jiangcheng Huanshi Plaza.

EXT. MOUNTAIN COTTAGE - DAY

A group of VILLAGERS kneels before a thatched cottage shrouded in golden light. The VILLAGE CHIEF holds up a new smartphone.

VILLAGE CHIEF
Immortal, you mentioned the signal was weak. Please accept this.

A grand voice emanates from the cottage.

JIANG YI (O.S.)
A hundred years have passed. I have emerged from seclusion. There will be no more immortal in this valley. You need not return.

Golden light shoots skyward and vanishes. The villagers remain kneeling, awestruck.

YOUNG VILLAGER
(whispering)
The last cultivator... truly exists.

INT. ANCIENT STYLE ROOM - NIGHT

Candlelight flickers. JIANG YI, in traditional costume, sits with the new phone, replying to messages.

LITTLE ROU CAN'T SLEEP ENOUGH (TEXT)
Tomorrow we'll meet at the bus stop across from Jiangcheng Huanshi Plaza.

SO WHAT IF I'M ARROGANT (TEXT)
Good! I have a request!

GU YUROU looks at her phone and smiles.

SO WHAT IF I'M ARROGANT (TEXT)
In my heart there is a tiger that sniffs at roses. Bring a rose with you.

GU YUROU
(to herself)
Oh, right.

LITTLE ROU CAN'T SLEEP ENOUGH (TEXT)
We've been chatting for so long, but I still don't know how old you are. Are you a post-90s or post-00s?

SO WHAT IF I'M ARROGANT (TEXT)
What do you mean by post-90s and post-00s?

LITTLE ROU CAN'T SLEEP ENOUGH (TEXT)
Don't tease me. Of course post-90s means born after 1990, and post-00s means born after 2000.

JIANG YI sends a "oh" emoji.

SO WHAT IF I'M ARROGANT (TEXT)
Then I'm post-00s.

GU YUROU
Yay!

GU YUROU excitedly rolls around on the bed, hugging a teddy bear.

GU YUROU
(to herself)
Finally meeting after so long. He knows so much, yet he's my age. What does he even look like?
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT STYLE ROOM - NIGHT

JIANG YI puts down his phone and picks up a black and white photo of two men from the Republican era.

JIANG YI (V.O.)
A hundred years in seclusion, and it's time to emerge again. Brother, I will take care of your descendants.

EXT. BUS STOP - DAY

GU YUROU, wearing a white dress, holds a red rose and waits anxiously at the bus stop.

GU YUROU
(to herself)
"Tigers sniffing roses"... making me bring a rose. This is so embarrassing.

The petals suddenly fall off. She gasps as they instantly restore themselves. She stares at the rose in shock.

A man in a blue Taoist robe wearing sunglasses, JIANG YI, walks toward her. Several PASSERBY GIRLS turn to stare, phones out.

PASSERBY GIRL A
Wow, so handsome...

JIANG YI walks up to GU YUROU, also holding a red rose, and hands it to her.

JIANG YI removes his sunglasses.

JIANG YI
Are you Little Rou Can't Sleep Enough?

GU YUROU
(surprised)
You're So What If I'm Arrogant? You're post-00s?

JIANG YI
Born in 1900. According to what you said, that's post-00s. That's correct.

GU YUROU
(in disbelief)
1900 counts too?

GU YUROU is dumbstruck.

FADE OUT.

title: In the Name of Medicine
description: A man who injured a perpetrator to protect his sister faces an unjust legal system where mental illness becomes a shield for crime.
context:
Title: In the Name of Medicine
Description: A man who injured a perpetrator to protect his sister faces an unjust legal system where mental illness becomes a shield for crime.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

A parole hearing. XU HAO sits in the victim's gallery. ZHANG QIANG appears on a monitor, flanked by orderlies.

XU HAO
I forgive Zhang Qiang for what he did to my sister.

The gallery whispers.

AUDIENCE (V.O.)
But she died. How can he forgive?

ZHANG QIANG smiles, a hint of glee.

XU HAO
As the family, I issue a letter of understanding. I won't pursue further action.

ZHANG QIANG suddenly leans into the camera.

ZHANG QIANG
(smugly)
You lost.

XU HAO lowers his head.

FADE OUT.

FADE IN:

TITLE CARD: THREE YEARS EARLIER

EXT. FARM PORK SHOP - DAY

XU HAO chops meat. A white sedan screeches up. FRIEND 1 runs over.

FRIEND 1
Brother Hao. Xiao Yu. Zhang Qiang found her.

XU HAO drops the cleaver. Removes his apron.

XU HAO
Hospital?

FRIEND 1 nods. Xu Hao runs. Friend 2 moves to follow.

XU HAO
(stopping him)
Stay. I handle my own blood.

He sprints off. The friends watch.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

XIAO YU on the floor, her leg in a cast. ZHANG QIANG stands over her, unstable.

ZHANG QIANG
You can't hide from me.

XU HAO bursts in. Takes in the scene.

XU HAO
Get back!

ZHANG QIANG
Or what? More prison time?

He lunges. Xu Hao intercepts. They crash down.

XU HAO's fists find flesh. Then bone. A sharp CRACK.

XIAO YU
Brother! Stop! You'll—

XU HAO
(quiet rage)
You can't control it. So I controlled it for you.

He stands, knuckles bleeding. Orderlies rush in.

FLASHBACK TO:

TITLE CARD: TWENTY YEARS AGO

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

YOUNG XU HAO and XIAO YU watch their MOTHER fade.

MOTHER
(weakly)
Xiao Bao... protect her... but not...

She doesn't finish. Her eyes close. The children weep.

BACK TO:

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

XU HAO kneels by Xiao Yu. POLICE OFFICERS enter.

POLICE OFFICER 1
Assault. You're under arrest.

XIAO YU
(whispering)
I'll wait.

XU HAO
(to officer)
He's schizophrenic. In psychiatric care?

POLICE OFFICER 2
Treatment, not prison. That's the law.

ZHANG QIANG
(on gurney)
When I get out, I'll—

ORDERLY
Sedative's working. He won't remember.

ZHANG QIANG laughs through the fog.

FADE OUT.

FADE IN:

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

Back at the hearing. Xu Hao stands to leave.

DR. LI
Your sister's medical expenses?

XU HAO
She died. Complications.

ZHANG QIANG's smile fades.

XU HAO
(to monitor)
You think you won? I served three years. You served none. But everyone knows what you are. Even if the medicine of law can't touch you.

FADE OUT.

Title: In the Name of Medicine
Description: A man who injured a perpetrator to protect his sister faces an unjust legal system where mental illness becomes a shield for crime.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

A parole hearing. XU HAO sits in the victim's gallery. ZHANG QIANG appears on a monitor, flanked by orderlies.

XU HAO
I forgive Zhang Qiang for what he did to my sister.

The gallery whispers.

AUDIENCE (V.O.)
But she died. How can he forgive?

ZHANG QIANG smiles, a hint of glee.

XU HAO
As the family, I issue a letter of understanding. I won't pursue further action.

ZHANG QIANG suddenly leans into the camera.

ZHANG QIANG
(smugly)
You lost.

XU HAO lowers his head.

FADE OUT.

FADE IN:

TITLE CARD: THREE YEARS EARLIER

EXT. FARM PORK SHOP - DAY

XU HAO chops meat. A white sedan screeches up. FRIEND 1 runs over.

FRIEND 1
Brother Hao. Xiao Yu. Zhang Qiang found her.

XU HAO drops the cleaver. Removes his apron.

XU HAO
Hospital?

FRIEND 1 nods. Xu Hao runs. Friend 2 moves to follow.

XU HAO
(stopping him)
Stay. I handle my own blood.

He sprints off. The friends watch.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

XIAO YU on the floor, her leg in a cast. ZHANG QIANG stands over her, unstable.

ZHANG QIANG
You can't hide from me.

XU HAO bursts in. Takes in the scene.

XU HAO
Get back!

ZHANG QIANG
Or what? More prison time?

He lunges. Xu Hao intercepts. They crash down.

XU HAO's fists find flesh. Then bone. A sharp CRACK.

XIAO YU
Brother! Stop! You'll—

XU HAO
(quiet rage)
You can't control it. So I controlled it for you.

He stands, knuckles bleeding. Orderlies rush in.

FLASHBACK TO:

TITLE CARD: TWENTY YEARS AGO

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

YOUNG XU HAO and XIAO YU watch their MOTHER fade.

MOTHER
(weakly)
Xiao Bao... protect her... but not...

She doesn't finish. Her eyes close. The children weep.

BACK TO:

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

XU HAO kneels by Xiao Yu. POLICE OFFICERS enter.

POLICE OFFICER 1
Assault. You're under arrest.

XIAO YU
(whispering)
I'll wait.

XU HAO
(to officer)
He's schizophrenic. In psychiatric care?

POLICE OFFICER 2
Treatment, not prison. That's the law.

ZHANG QIANG
(on gurney)
When I get out, I'll—

ORDERLY
Sedative's working. He won't remember.

ZHANG QIANG laughs through the fog.

FADE OUT.

Back at the hearing. Xu Hao stands to leave.

DR. LI
Your sister's medical expenses?

XU HAO
She died. Complications.

ZHANG QIANG's smile fades.

XU HAO
(to monitor)
You think you won? I served three years. You served none. But everyone knows what you are. Even if the medicine of law can't touch you.

XU HAO exits. The monitor flickers. Zhang Qiang's face hardens.

FADE OUT.

title: Rebirth for Redemption
description: A woman betrayed by her fiancé and sister is given a second chance when she travels back in time to her wedding day, three years before her tragic death.
context:
Title: Rebirth for Redemption
Description: A woman betrayed by her fiancé and sister is given a second chance when she travels back in time to her wedding day, three years before her tragic death.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

YANYAN lies in a spreading pool of blood. LI SHIYUAN stands over her.

YANYAN
(crying)
Shiyuan... please... I'm your fiancée...

LI SHIYUAN kicks her ribs. She gasps.

YANYAN
(screaming)
Ah!

LI SHIYUAN
(disdainfully)
I'm the Li Group heir. Why would I marry a slut? I've always loved your sister.

YING WENXIN enters in black silk, draping herself against him.

YANYAN stares, betrayal sinking in.

INT. ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

YANYAN in a pink dress hugs LI SHIYUAN.

LI SHIYUAN
Get me the Li Group's secrets, and I'll marry you.

YANYAN
(affectionately)
I'll do anything for you.

They embrace. LI SHIYUAN's eyes are dead.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

YANYAN
(in despair)
Everything was a lie.

YING WENXIN crouches beside her.

YING WENXIN
Not everything. We really did enjoy watching you suffer.

YANYAN
(angrily)
Li Sihan will make you pay!

YING WENXIN slaps her across the face.

LI SHIYUAN pours gasoline around YANYAN.

YING WENXIN
(coldly)
In your next life, try being less stupid.

She ignites the lighter, drops it.

YANYAN
(terrified)
No! No!

Flames erupt, surrounding her.
continuation:
YANYAN
(screaming in the fire)
I'll haunt you both!

LI SIHAN crashes through the flames.

LI SIHAN
Yanyan!

He reaches her side.

YANYAN
Why did you come?

LI SIHAN
You called.

A burning beam cracks overhead.

LI SIHAN
Watch out!

He shoves her. The beam strikes him, and he falls.

YANYAN crawls to LI SIHAN's side.

YANYAN
(crying)
Sihan... I'm sorry...

LI SIHAN
(weakly)
I was wrong... caged you with love...

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

LI SIHAN pins YANYAN against the wall.

LI SIHAN
(furiously)
You're mine! You can't leave!

YANYAN
Li Sihan, please--

LI SIHAN
(to his subordinates)
If she runs, break her legs.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

LI SIHAN
(dying)
Now you're free. Live.

He dies. YANYAN screams as flames consume everything.

INT. BRIDAL ROOM - DAY

YANYAN wakes in a white wedding dress, her hands bound.

She sees the wedding photo. Herself and LI SIHAN.

YANYAN
(to herself)
Three years... before the fire.

She begins untying the rope, her expression hardening.

FADE OUT.

title: The Scam
description: A man in a denim jacket is tricked into signing away his house, which was meant to cover his sister's surgery costs, and confronts the scammer in a desperate attempt to get it back.
context:
Title: The Scam
Description: A man in a denim jacket is tricked into signing away his house, which was meant to cover his sister's surgery costs, and confronts the scammer in a desperate attempt to get it back.

EXT. STREET - DAY

DENIM JACKET MAN (30s, hollow-eyed) watches from across the street as SUITED MAN (50s, polished) and QIN HUAMEI (30s, nervous smile) exit a notary office, laughing over documents. He clutches a phone: a hospital text reads "Final payment: 48 hours."

His gaze drops to a loose brick near a construction barrier.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

DENIM JACKET MAN follows them into a luxury hotel lobby. As SUITED MAN turns toward the elevators, DENIM JACKET MAN shoves him hard against a marble column. SUITED MAN's briefcase spills, papers scattering.

DENIM JACKET MAN
(brick trembling in hand)
Transfer it back. Now.

QIN HUAMEI
(backing away)
Security! Please!

TWO SECURITY GUARDS rush over, pinning DENIM JACKET MAN's arms.

DENIM JACKET MAN
(struggling, eyes fixed on SUITED MAN)
You forged my signature! My sister's surgery—

SUITED MAN
(straightening his suit, cold fury)
You're confused. Remove him.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

The SECURITY GUARDS deposit DENIM JACKET MAN on the sidewalk. One flashes a warning look.

SECURITY GUARD 1
Don't come back.

DENIM JACKET MAN sits dazed, a cut on his temple. SUITED MAN emerges, lighting a cigarette.

SUITED MAN
(exhaling)
Black and white, friend. Your signature. Her collateral.

DENIM JACKET MAN
(barely audible)
Three days...

SUITED MAN
Then work fast.

SUITED MAN drops the signed contract pages. They flutter around DENIM JACKET MAN, QIN HUAMEI's signature visible: Witness.

title: Love Like a Meteor
description: At a prestigious business gala, three powerful young heirs are drugged in a sinister plot, leading to a fateful encounter that will change their lives forever.
context:
Title: Love Like a Meteor
Description: At a prestigious business gala, three powerful young heirs are drugged in a sinister plot, leading to a fateful encounter that will change their lives forever.

INT. PINNACLE BUSINESS ASSOCIATION - NIGHT

Under the night sky, an iconic commercial building is brilliantly lit. Text overlay: South Province Pinnacle Business Association.

Inside the association, lights are dazzling, voices buzzing.

HOST (V.O.)
Gu Shiming—Eastgate Group. Shi Jing—Vortex Pharma. Jiang Chenglin—Aurora Industries. When they move, Rongcheng trembles.

GU SHIMING (black suit, 30s) walks through the crowd like a blade. SHI JING (white suit, 20s) shadows him, alert. JIANG CHENGLIN (purple suit, 20s) brings up the rear, watchful.

PRESIDENT WU intercepts a SERVER, swaps one glass for another. A seamless pass.

PRESIDENT WU (V.O.)
By sunrise, Eastgate will be mine. The drug only needs one host—and Gu Shiming never declines a toast.

The SERVER offers the tray. GU SHIMING takes the tampered glass. SHI JING and JIANG CHENGLIN take clean ones.

INT. HALLWAY/ROOM - NIGHT

GU SHIMING stumbles. Clutches a marble column, knuckles white.

SHI JING
Brother?

GU SHIMING
(pushing them toward a door)
Inside. Both of you. Lock it until Zhao arrives.

JIANG CHENGLIN
Big Brother—your glass was—

GU SHIMING
That's why you need to stay safe. Text him: code seven-one-nine.

SHI JING
And leave you?

GU SHIMING
I don't plan on being found.

He shuts the door. Locks it from outside.
continuation:
INT. ANOTHER ROOM - NIGHT

The room is dim. LIN QIAO (25), event coordinator, cowers behind a service cart, her gown torn. She clutches a broken name tag.

GU SHIMING stumbles in, tugging his tie. Sees her.

LIN QIAO scrambles back.

LIN QIAO
(panicked)
He locked me in here—said I saw something—

GU SHIMING
(staying across the room)
Then we were both meant for this room.

He slides down the opposite wall.

GU SHIMING
(voice hoarse)
Stay there. I'll pass out in twenty minutes. Then you can run.

LIN QIAO
(quietly)
I have antihistamines. Slows heart rate...

GU SHIMING
You'd help your captor?

LIN QIAO
I'd help someone the President wants destroyed.

She holds out a pill bottle.

BLACKOUT.

title: The You I Lost
description: Two children are separated during a kidnapping attempt. Fifteen years later, the boy, now a powerful CEO, searches for the girl who saved his life.
context:
Title: The You I Lost
Description: Two children are separated during a kidnapping attempt. Fifteen years later, the boy, now a powerful CEO, searches for the girl who saved his life.

INT. OUTSIDE ABANDONED BUILDING - DAY

Two PRIVATE SCHOOL CHILDREN, LITTLE MU (10, terrified heir) and YIYI (10, fierce protector), sprint through debris. THREE MEN in black pursue.

YIYI
(urgently)
Little Mu, hurry! We can't let them catch us!

VILLAIN LEADER
(40s, scarred)
Faster!

CHASER
Chase them! Faster!

LITTLE MU stumbles, his blazer tearing on rebar. He hits the ground.

LITTLE MU
(in pain)
Don't worry about me, just run!

YIYI runs back, yanks him up by the arm.

YIYI
I will never leave you behind!

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

YIYI and LITTLE MU hide behind a haystack, watching the window. The VILLAIN LEADER and his HENCHMEN search outside.

VILLAIN LEADER
We planned this for so long. If that little master escapes, I'll kill you all! They're nearby, split up and search!

HENCHMAN
Yes, Captain Tang!

YIYI and LITTLE MU hide, frozen. YIYI spots a CHILD'S VIOLIN CASE half-buried in the straw.

YIYI
(whispering)
Little Mu.

LITTLE MU
(comforting)
Don't be afraid.

YIYI takes off a jade pendant from her neck and ties it around his wrist.

YIYI
I told you I would take good care of you. This belonged to my mother. If we meet again, this will be our token. You must keep it safe.

YIYI grabs the violin and rushes out, drawing the enemies away.

LITTLE MU
(panicking)
Yiyi!
continuation:
EXT. WOODS - DAY

The VILLAIN LEADER catches YIYI by the hair.

VILLAIN LEADER
You brat, where's that boy?

YIYI keeps her mouth shut. The VILLAIN LEADER slaps her; the violin falls, splintering against a rock.

VILLAIN LEADER
Will you talk? Will you talk?

YIYI still refuses. The Villain Leader laughs.

VILLAIN LEADER
(to henchman)
Take her back first! The state orphanage will get a nice donation for this one.

HENCHMAN
Yes!

The HENCHMAN carries Yiyi away. LITTLE MU emerges, picks up the broken violin neck and pendant from the dirt.

LITTLE MU
(choking up)
Yiyi, wait for me.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

Fifteen years later. YIYI (25, faded bruises) is pushed down by YAO YUWAN. She hits the marble floor.

YAO YUWAN
Give it to me! Give it to me!

A middle-aged wealthy woman, CHEN MEIRU, walks over.

YIYI
(timidly)
Mom...

CHEN MEIRU
(with disgust)
Who are you calling Mom? Your mother died of grief looking for you long ago!

YAO YUWAN
(clinging to CHEN MEIRU's arm)
Mom, Dad said that restaurant is really hard to book. We should hurry.

CHEN MEIRU
(indulgently)
Alright. If you weren't somewhat useful, I would have kicked you out long ago. Go practice! You're going to the Moon Garden tomorrow too.

CHEN MEIRU leaves with YAO YUWAN. YIYI lies alone on the floor, takes out the TWIN PENDANT from under her collar.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

The adult LITTLE MU, now XIAO MU (25, sleepless), looks at the pendant in his hand.

XIAO MU
Yiyi, where are you?

SECRETARY LI (40s, efficient) rushes in with a tablet.

SECRETARY LI
Mr. Xiao! There's a lead on Miss Yiyi!

XIAO MU
(excited)
Tell me quickly!

SECRETARY LI
Baokui Theater's gala performer list. She's there, with the pendant.

A glimmer of light flashes in Xiao Mu's eyes, his expression determined. Through the window, lightning illuminates Baokui Theater's dome.

title: You Are the April of This World
description: A young woman drugged at a party ends up spending a night with a stranger—only to discover he is the husband she's never met, who is already filing for divorce.
context:
Title: You Are the April of This World
Description: A young woman drugged at a party ends up spending a night with a stranger—only to discover he is the husband she's never met, who is already filing for divorce.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

Close-up of hotel room door number "610".

YE NANSHENG (25), in a white dress, steadies herself against the wall, gripping a room card. Her expression is foggy but resolute.

YE NANSHENG (V.O.)
Father's favors always come with a price. Tonight, he collected.

YE NANSHENG swipes the card. As the door opens, a strong hand pulls her inside.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

Dimly lit. YE NANSHENG stumbles backward into a table, sending a glass crashing. A man's silhouette moves toward her. They collide—his lips find hers in the darkness.

YE NANSHENG pushes against his chest, breaking the kiss. The man staggers back, his face catching the light—SI YIHAN (30), sharp features glazed with disorientation.

YE NANSHENG
(faint recognition)
The portrait in grandfather's study...

SI YIHAN
(gravelly)
Who sent you?

He reaches for her again. She braces against the wall—then the world tilts.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Morning light cuts through curtains.

SI YIHAN buttons a crisp black shirt. On the bed, YE NANSHENG clutches the sheets, a faint bruise blooming on her collarbone.

YE NANSHENG (V.O.)
Two years of signatures and ceremonies, yet we've remained strangers. Until now.

SI YIHAN
(cool, precise)
State your terms. I'll meet them.

YE NANSHENG
I don't want—

SI YIHAN
—Don't insult us both by refusing compensation. Name your price, then we both move on.

YE NANSHENG
(sitting taller)
You misunderstand. I'm—

SI YIHAN's phone RINGS. Caller ID: ATTORNEY.

SI YIHAN
(on phone)
Report.

ATTORNEY (V.O.)
Papers delivered to Miss Ye's residence. She has 48 hours to sign.

SI YIHAN
Tell her the settlement stands. The Ye family got their alliance; they don't get to waste my time with delays.

YE NANSHENG's fingers tighten on the sheets. Her voice is very small.

YE NANSHENG
I see. You're already done with the marriage.

SI YIHAN slides a business card from his wallet, places it on the nightstand.

SI YIHAN
The card contacts my accountant. Consider this resolved.

He takes his jacket and leaves. The door clicks shut.

YE NANSHENG touches the card, her expression hardening from hurt to something else—determination.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Reborn: The Warlord's Wife Wants Divorce
description: After being betrayed and murdered by her warlord husband and his mistress, Lin Jingyun is reborn one year earlier, determined to make them pay for what they did to her and her family.
context:
Title: Reborn: The Warlord's Wife Wants Divorce
Description: After being betrayed and murdered by her warlord husband and his mistress, Lin Jingyun is reborn one year earlier, determined to make them pay for what they did to her and her family.

INT. LIN FAMILY COMPOUND - NIGHT

Rain lashes the courtyard. Lanterns flicker, casting trembling shadows.

LIN JINGYUN and her PARENTS kneel in the mud, surrounded by ARMED SOLDIERS. WARLORD GU BEICHEN watches from the steps, untouched by the storm.

SOLDIER
Execute!

LIN JINGYUN
(terrified)
No! No!

FATHER LIN
(furious)
Gu Beichen! I took you from nothing—

Mother Lin crumples first, a red stain spreading across her chest. Father Lin falls beside her, reaching for Jingyun until his hand drops.

LIN JINGYUN
(heart-wrenching)
Father! Mother!

QIN HUAMEI and ANOTHER WOMAN watch from the steps, sheltered under an oil-paper umbrella.

Gu Beichen descends. Mud splashes his boots.

LIN JINGYUN
(crying)
Why? We gave you everything—

GU BEICHEN
(cold laugh)
Your father gave me everything. With his money. His name. And his daughter.

(crouches)
Every time he called me 'boy,' I imagined this day.

LIN JINGYUN
(bitter laugh)
I was so stupid... to believe your vows...

GU BEICHEN
Let me give you one truth. That hero who saved you? Li Feiyu. We staged it.

LIN JINGYUN
(shocked)
Everything... was a lie.

QIN HUAMEI
(stepping forward)
Brother Beichen only ever loved me. You were just a stepping stone.

(mocking)
Don't be so stupid in your next life.

GU BEICHEN raises his pistol.

LIN JINGYUN
(whisper)
Did you ever—

GU BEICHEN
No.

He fires. Lin Jingyun falls.

LIN JINGYUN (V.O.)
If there is a next life... I'll make your Gu family pay blood for blood.
continuation:
INT. GU FAMILY ANCESTRAL HALL - DAY

Lin Jingyun's eyes snap open. She's seated in a chair, wearing an elegant white qipao. Incense smoke curls through the air.

OLD MADAM GU addresses the servants.

OLD MADAM GU
Today is the master's death anniversary. No mistakes, or you're all dismissed.

Lin Jingyun looks at her unblemished hands.

LIN JINGYUN (inner monologue)
Madam Gu. The ancestral hall. But I died. How—?

QIN HUAMEI enters in a bright qipao.

QIN HUAMEI
(bowing)
Daughter-in-law Qin Huamei pays respects to Old Madam.

OLD MADAM GU
(disdainful)
What wild woman is this?

GU BEICHEN
Mother, this is Huamei. My childhood friend. I wish to take her as concubine.

LIN JINGYUN (inner monologue)
Qin Huamei entering the household—this happened a year ago. I've been reborn.

OLD MADAM GU
That opera singer?

QIN HUAMEI
(pitifully)
My family fell into ruin. I only wish to serve—Gu Beichen, Sister Lin, this house.

LIN JINGYUN (inner monologue)
In my last life, I wept and accepted. In this life...

Lin Jingyun rises. Her eyes are cold and determined.

LIN JINGYUN
(to Old Madam Gu)
Mother. Should we not consult the astrologer first? Or does my husband wish to bring theater scandal into our ancestral rites?

Gu Beichen's jaw tightens. Qin Huamei's smile freezes.

LIN JINGYUN (inner monologue)
I remember every wound. Every lie. And I know exactly where you're weakest.

FADE OUT.

title: The CEO's Contract Wife
description: A woman who traded her independence for luxury as a CEO's contractual wife faces a crisis that threatens her carefully constructed world.
context:
Title: The CEO's Contract Wife
Description: A woman who traded her independence for luxury as a CEO's contractual wife faces a crisis that threatens her carefully constructed world.

INT. LUXURY MANSION - DAY

RUAN NINGXIA (30s), exquisite makeup, pink silk bathrobe, white towel around her head, reclines in a massage chair. MASKED SERVANTS attend: a muscular man massages shoulders, one maid does nails, another applies makeup.

The HOUSEKEEPER rushes in urgently.

HOUSEKEEPER
Madam! Mr. Fu's car accident—St. Mary's demands immediate family!

RUAN NINGXIA
(carefully setting down her wine glass)
Which hospital? Was he alone?

RUAN NINGXIA
(to the camera, a brittle smile)
Three years of this. You learn which answers matter.

HOUSEKEEPER
Alone, but unconscious. Hurry, Madam!

RUAN NINGXIA
(shocked, sitting up straight)
Unconscious.

RUAN NINGXIA (V.O.)
(secretly delighted)
Our contract never mentioned medical proxy. If he can't sign, the board takes control.

HOUSEKEEPER
The car was totaled, Madam. Mr. Fu is in surgery now.

RUAN NINGXIA
(disappointed)
I'll dress.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

RUAN NINGXIA, now in luxurious fur and dress, designer bag clutched too tightly, runs anxiously through the corridor. She sees FU LINCHENG'S ASSISTANT with JIANG YAO, both in power suits.

RUAN NINGXIA
(pretending to cry)
Assistant Chen! My husband?

FU LINCHENG'S ASSISTANT
(to JIANG YAO)
Miss Jiang is COO. She's managing the emergency response.

RUAN NINGXIA
(to the ASSISTANT)
Status. Now.

FU LINCHENG'S ASSISTANT
Surgery continues. We wait.

RUAN NINGXIA (V.O.)
(anxiously thinking)
If he dies, the deposits stop. If he's compromised... I lose the identity I bought with them.

The operating room door opens, and the DOCTOR walks out.

DOCTOR
Successful surgery. He'll recover with rest.

RUAN NINGXIA (V.O.)
(ecstatic inside)
The contract holds. My cage holds.

JIANG YAO
(to the DOCTOR)
May I see him?

DOCTOR
Five minutes. No stress.

JIANG YAO walks toward the hospital room, then looks back to see RUAN NINGXIA unconsciously twisting her wedding band. She walks over.

JIANG YAO
Miss Ruan. The post-nuptial agreement is in my safe. We should talk... when you're ready.

title: Beauty, Don't Flirt - I Don't Do Flash Marriages
description: After a night together, a delivery driver and a CEO find themselves entangled in a dangerous situation when an assassin targets them.
context:
Title: Beauty, Don't Flirt - I Don't Do Flash Marriages
Description: After a night together, a delivery driver and a CEO find themselves entangled in a dangerous situation when an assassin targets them.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LU FAN and YE ZHIHAN lie in bed, covered by a blanket.

CLOSE-UP: LU FAN's chest and neck have several red kiss marks. Faint bruises pattern his shoulders.

LU FAN opens his eyes, wincing. YE ZHIHAN also wakes up, staring at the ceiling with hollow dread.

LU FAN
So... how are you taking responsibility for this?

YE ZHIHAN
You're alive. That's more than you'll get if you stay.

LU FAN looks at her in shock.

LU FAN
Pull up your pants and deny everything, is that it?

LU FAN throws off the blanket and gets out of bed. He's wearing only shorts and an open white shirt. He paces beside the bed, his body showing strain.

LU FAN
I had a life. A job. And now I can barely stand.

YE ZHIHAN
Shut up. Just... stop talking.

YE ZHIHAN covers her head with the blanket.

FLASHBACK:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

YE ZHIHAN lies on the bed in business attire, seemingly unconscious. LU FAN stands by the bed wearing a blue designated driver vest. YE ZHIHAN suddenly reaches out and pulls him down onto the bed. LU FAN looks shocked.

BACK TO PRESENT:
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

YE ZHIHAN stands by the bed wrapped in a bath towel, throwing a check onto the bed.

YE ZHIHAN
Five hundred thousand. For your trouble.

LU FAN sits on the bed and picks up the check.

LU FAN
What do you take me for?

LU FAN's gaze falls on a bloodstain on the bedsheet. He freezes, then looks up at YE ZHIHAN.

LU FAN
You need to add more money.

FLASHBACK:
INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

LU FAN is driving. YE ZHIHAN lies in the back seat, her face flushed, disoriented.

YE ZHIHAN
(mumbling)
Water... it's so hot...

LU FAN
Your building's forty minutes in this traffic. Hang on.

LU FAN (V.O.)
She's fighting whatever they gave her. ER means questions she doesn't want.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

LU FAN carries the unconscious YE ZHIHAN and gently lays her on the bed.

LU FAN
Water's here. Then I'm gone.

LU FAN turns to leave. YE ZHIHAN suddenly grabs his wrist.

YE ZHIHAN
(groggily)
Don't. They'll know I'm alone.

YE ZHIHAN pulls hard, dragging LU FAN onto the bed, then rolls over on top of him.

LU FAN (V.O.)
Designated driver. Not designated... this.

BACK TO PRESENT:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LU FAN sits on the bed, looking at YE ZHIHAN.

LU FAN
Five million. For a new life.

YE ZHIHAN
You bastard!

YE ZHIHAN lunges at him in anger, but he grabs her wrist. She screams.

YE ZHIHAN
Ah!

EXT. OPPOSITE BUILDING - DAY

A SNIPER wearing a mask and cap aims a sniper rifle at the two people in the room.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LU FAN's expression becomes serious. He notices YE ZHIHAN's eyes fix on something behind him—the window.

LU FAN
Down. Now.

A gunshot rings out. The window glass shatters instantly.

LU FAN immediately holds YE ZHIHAN and rolls onto the bed, using his body to shield her. Both lie on the bed with terrified expressions as the bullet flies past where they were just standing.

LU FAN and YE ZHIHAN look at each other, eyes full of shock. Their breath comes fast, in sync.

title: When Spring Comes to South Tower and Snow Melts Away
description: A devoted husband prepares a romantic anniversary dinner for his wife, only to discover her heart belongs to someone else.
context:
Title: When Spring Comes to South Tower and Snow Melts Away
Description: A devoted husband prepares a romantic anniversary dinner for his wife, only to discover her heart belongs to someone else.

INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

Opening shot: A close-up of red roses at night, a desolate beauty.

FU YANZHOU, a refined man wearing a white Chinese-style mandarin collar shirt and gold-rimmed glasses, is asleep at a carefully decorated dining table. A timer on the table finishes counting down and beeps.

FU YANZHOU wakes up, rubbing his eyes. The table is filled with flowers, dishes, and gifts, clearly prepared for a romantic dinner.

FU YANZHOU (V.O.)
Third time tonight.

He stands up, picking up a plate of cold food to reheat it.

The camera shifts to the doorway. SU ZHIXIA, a woman in an elegant white dress, walks in silently. She sits down at the table, fingering a string of Buddhist prayer beads, her expression distant.

FU YANZHOU sees her, and his face immediately lights up with fragile hope.

FU YANZHOU
You're home.

FU YANZHOU gently touches her shoulder, but she barely reacts.

FU YANZHOU
I'll warm everything. Just a moment. All your favorites, as always.

SU ZHIXIA
No need.

FU YANZHOU
Please. It'll go cold again.

SU ZHIXIA
I already ate.

FU YANZHOU's smile falters, his hand still hovering near her shoulder.

FU YANZHOU
But you promised... for our anniversary.

SU ZHIXIA
A client stayed late.

FU YANZHOU
Of course. Then just stay with me while I—
He pours wine with careful ceremony.

FU YANZHOU
I had this brought from the monastery. They say it's purified. Please. One cup.

SU ZHIXIA
(voice hardening)
continuation:
I don't drink.

FU YANZHOU
It's only bamboo sap. It won't break your vow.

He extends the cup. Su Zhixia's hand trembles slightly before she knocks it away. Wine spills across the table.

SU ZHIXIA
(quietly, dangerously)
Stop trying to unravel my practice, Yanzhou. Two years, and you still don't understand?

FU YANZHOU
(voice barely a whisper)
Understand what? That I'm sharing my wife with a ghost?

SU ZHIXIA stands, sweeping the wine pot to the floor where it shatters.

SU ZHIXIA
Don't speak of things you cannot see.

She turns and leaves.

FU YANZHOU
(calling softly)
Zhixia...

FU YANZHOU (V.O.)
When will you see me?

A fluffy cat walks to his feet, meowing. Fu Yanzhou crouches down, picking up the cat, his face full of quiet defeat.

FU YANZHOU
(to the cat)
At least you'll stay.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

FU YANZHOU lies in bed. In his sleep, he reaches out, but touches only cold sheets. He wakes, discovering the space beside him empty. His eyes dim.

He gets up, walks downstairs, and stops before a closed door he has never entered. Light seeps from beneath it.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT

FU YANZHOU peers through the crack in the door.

Inside, SU ZHIXIA faces a wall covered in photographs of a young man who looks nearly identical to her. She touches one frame with trembling fingers.

SU ZHIXIA (V.O.)
(whispered, broken)
Xingshen... forgive me for coming home late. Forgive me for still being here.

Outside the door, FU YANZHOU witnesses this. His expression shifts from shock to a slow, devastating understanding.

SCENE END

Description: A devoted husband prepares a romantic anniversary dinner for his wife, only to discover her heart belongs to someone else.

INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

Opening shot: A close-up of red roses at night, a desolate beauty.

FU YANZHOU, a refined man wearing a white Chinese-style mandarin collar shirt and gold-rimmed glasses, is asleep at a carefully decorated dining table. A timer on the table finishes counting down and beeps.

FU YANZHOU wakes up, rubbing his eyes. The table is filled with flowers, dishes, and gifts, clearly prepared for a romantic dinner.

FU YANZHOU (V.O.)
Third time tonight.

He stands up, picking up a plate of cold food to reheat it.

The camera shifts to the doorway. SU ZHIXIA, a woman in an elegant white dress, walks in silently. She sits down at the table, fingering a string of Buddhist prayer beads, her expression distant.

FU YANZHOU sees her, and his face immediately lights up with fragile hope.

FU YANZHOU
You're home.

FU YANZHOU gently touches her shoulder, but she barely reacts.

FU YANZHOU
I'll warm everything. Just a moment. All your favorites, as always.

SU ZHIXIA
No need.

FU YANZHOU
Please. It'll go cold again.

SU ZHIXIA
I already ate.

FU YANZHOU's smile falters, his hand still hovering near her shoulder.

FU YANZHOU
But you promised... for our anniversary.

SU ZHIXIA
A client stayed late.

FU YANZHOU
Of course. Then just stay with me while I—
He pours wine with careful ceremony.

FU YANZHOU
I had this brought from the monastery. They say it's purified. Please. One cup.

SU ZHIXIA
(voice hardening)
I don't drink.

FU YANZHOU
It's only bamboo sap. It won't break your vow.

He extends the cup. Su Zhixia's hand trembles slightly before she knocks it away. Wine spills across the table.

SU ZHIXIA
(quietly, dangerously)
Stop trying to unravel my practice, Yanzhou. Two years, and you still don't understand?

FU YANZHOU
(voice barely a whisper)
Understand what? That I'm sharing my wife with a ghost?

SU ZHIXIA stands, sweeping the wine pot to the floor where it shatters.

SU ZHIXIA
Don't speak of things you cannot see.

She turns and leaves.

FU YANZHOU
(calling softly)
Zhixia...

FU YANZHOU (V.O.)
When will you see me?

A fluffy cat walks to his feet, meowing. Fu Yanzhou crouches down, picking up the cat, his face full of quiet defeat.

FU YANZHOU
(to the cat)
At least you'll stay.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

FU YANZHOU lies in bed. In his sleep, he reaches out, but touches only cold sheets. He wakes, discovering the space beside him empty. His eyes dim.

He gets up, walks downstairs, and stops before a closed door he has never entered. Light seeps from beneath it.

INT. STUDY - NIGHT

FU YANZHOU peers through the crack in the door.

Inside, SU ZHIXIA faces a wall covered in photographs of a young man who looks nearly identical to her. She touches one frame with trembling fingers.

SU ZHIXIA (V.O.)
(whispered, broken)
Xingshen... forgive me for coming home late. Forgive me for still being here.

Outside the door, FU YANZHOU witnesses this. His expression shifts from shock to a slow, devastating understanding.

SCENE END

title: Exiled at the Start, Sweet Treasure Becomes the Darling of the Valley
description: A young girl used as an experimental subject awakens in an ancient world after a laboratory explosion, finding herself in the care of a loving family.
context:
Title: Exiled at the Start, Sweet Treasure Becomes the Darling of the Valley
Description: A young girl used as an experimental subject awakens in an ancient world after a laboratory explosion, finding herself in the care of a loving family.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Sterile white walls. A small girl (12) lies on an operating table, electrodes dotting her temples. Her breath fogs a cold metal panel. Nearby, a CAT scans flickers with impossible shapes—objects materializing from static.

DR. CHEN (40s) slams a clipboard onto a counter. The HEART MONITOR's steady beep underscores his agitation.

DR. CHEN
They're pulling our funding. Monday, we pack up.

RESEARCHER LIA (30s) never looks up from the anomaly on the screen.

RESEARCHER LIA
Because she conjured a diamond from air yesterday? Or a living butterfly last week?

DR. CHEN
Because she's a child, not a miracle. Six years, and we can't replicate it. We can't even trigger it. She's either broken or she's choosing not to perform.

He approaches the table. The girl's eyes snap open—ancient, tired. Not twelve. A thousand.

EXPERIMENTAL SUBJECT ZERO
(whisper)
I'm not your monster.

The monitor SCREAMS. Red warning lights flash: "QUANTUM ANOMALY DETECTED."

The girl's fingers twitch. Every glass surface in the lab fractures simultaneously—beakers, windows, the observation mirror behind which her parents once stood.

The researchers stumble back as the AIR ITSELF begins to crystallize.

The girl's lips form one word:

EXPERIMENTAL SUBJECT ZERO
Goodbye.

FLASHBACK TO:

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (SIX YEARS PRIOR)

A small girl (6) hugs a worn teddy bear. Her parents argue with a man in a suit, hushed and desperate.

FATHER
...the treatments aren't working. We can't afford—

MOTHER
She's getting worse. The doctors say it's some kind of... decay. In her cells.

A NURSE exits a room, shaking her head. The mother's face crumples. The suited man extends a clipboard.

MAN IN SUIT
We can ease your debts. Give her a chance at a cure.

The father looks down at the girl. She smiles up at him, trusting. He turns away.

FATHER
(whisper)
Forgive us.

The mother kneels, gripping the girl's shoulders too tight.

MOTHER
You're going to a special hospital, sweetie. They'll make you better.

But her eyes say: "You're going away."

The metal door closes. The girl stands alone, teddy bear clutched to her chest. A single, perfect rose petal drifts from thin air onto her shoe.

Her first miracle. Her last memory of them.

BACK TO:
continuation:
INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

The explosion tears through the facility—not fire, but light. A collapsing star of pure white.

The girl's body flickers, translucent. She is there and not there, quantum-uncertain.

She chooses the "not there."

CUT TO:

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

Dust motes dance in shafts of warm morning light. Faded silk curtains. The smell of herbs and woodsmoke.

LIU YUELAN (30s, weary but gentle) cradles an unconscious girl, stroking matted hair from a fever-damp forehead.

LIU YUELAN
(chanting soft lullaby)
"Little treasure, little moon, mother's heart will find you soon..."

The girl's eyelids flutter. Liu Yuelan freezes.

LIU YUELAN
Bao'er?

TIAN BAO's eyes open—clear, lucid, ancient. She sees the trembling hope in this stranger's face and doesn't understand it.

A ceramic bowl SHATTERS.

Granny Su (70s, sharp-eyed) stands in the doorway, medicine pooling at her feet. She doesn't blink at the broken bowl. Only at the child.

GRANNY SU
The fever's broken.

LIU YUELAN
(laughing through tears)
My baby. My little treasure.

She pulls Tian Bao into an embrace so fierce it hurts. Tian Bao's arms hang limp—six years since anyone held her without measuring her first.

TIAN BAO
(inner monologue)
This is... wrong. Too warm. Too real.

GRANNY SU
(bustling, practical)
Eldest son! The black hen—now! And rice water, not too hot!

She wipes her hands on her apron, eyeing Tian Bao with something like wonder.

GRANNY SU
(quieter, to herself)
Thought we'd lost you, little fox.

Tian Bao's gaze falls to her own hand. A faint shimmer clings to her fingertips—her power, quieter here. Different.

She curls her fingers into a fist. For the first time in six years, she chooses to hold it in.

FADE OUT.

TO BE CONTINUED

title: He Is The Light
description: Song Zhinuan finds herself seated next to Zhou Siluo, the boy she never expected to be her deskmate, leading to unexpected encounters and complications.
context:
Title: He Is The Light
Description: Song Zhinuan finds herself seated next to Zhou Siluo, the boy she never expected to be her deskmate, leading to unexpected encounters and complications.

INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

SONG ZHINUAN, fingers tight on her backpack straps, pauses at the doorway. ZHOU SILUO taps a pencil rhythm on her desk. She straightens her collar before entering.

SONG ZHINUAN (V.O.)
Please don't notice me. Please don't—

ZHOU SILUO turns. His smile catches her mid-step.

ZHOU SILUO
Morning.

She slides into her seat, eyes on her backpack zipper.

ZHOU SILUO
The teacher thinks you're my last shot at not flunking. No pressure.

SONG ZHINUAN
(chin lifting)
I charge by the question.

He laughs—surprised, genuine.

ZHOU SILUO
Deal. So question one: why sit like you're bracing for impact?

SONG ZHINUAN
I don't—

ZHOU SILUO
(off her posture)
Defcon 1, clearly.

She consciously relaxes. He extends his hand.

ZHOU SILUO
Now we're just normal deskmates.

She stares at his hand. He lets it hang.

ZHU LIANG taps him from behind.

ZHU LIANG
Yo, Luo. Basketball.

ZHOU SILUO doesn't turn.

ZHOU SILUO
Busy.

ZHU LIANG
(surprised)
Since when?

He peers over ZHOU SILUO's shoulder at SONG ZHINUAN.
continuation:
ZHU LIANG
Oh. I get it. Hi, sister-in-law.

ZHOU SILUO's hand—still extended—flips into a warning finger.

ZHOU SILUO
Say it again and I'll delete your account.

ZHU LIANG
(mock-scared)
Empty threat.

ZHOU SILUO drops his hand, digs in his bag, and sets sesame crackers on her textbook.

ZHOU SILUO
Tutoring fee. In advance.

He exits. ZHU LIANG's arm slings around his shoulder as they go.

ZHU LIANG
She's got you leashed, bro...

BEST FRIEND slides into the empty seat, picking up the crackers.

BEST FRIEND
He remembered you like these.

SONG ZHINUAN
Coincidence.

BEST FRIEND
Right. And he 'coincidentally' told Mrs. Chen he needed academic assistance. ZHOU SILUO. Requesting homework help. Since never.

BEST FRIEND tears the package open.

BEST FRIEND
Keep telling yourself that.

A FEMALE CLASSMATE shouts from the doorway, her smile tight.

FEMALE CLASSMATE
Song Zhinuan. Someone's asking for you.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

The FEMALE STUDENT leans against the lockers, arms crossed. Her nails tap ZHOU SILUO's pencil rhythm against her sleeve.

FEMALE STUDENT
You sit next to him now.

Not a question. SONG ZHINUAN's hand stops on the classroom door—still ajar.

FEMALE STUDENT
I need you to understand something. He doesn't want a tutor.

She steps closer. The overhead fluorescent flickers.

FEMALE STUDENT
He wants a project.

title: Wrong Marriage, Entangled with the Tycoon
description: A woman is tricked into marrying a disabled tycoon in place of her stepsister, unaware that her groom is not what he seems.
context:
Title: Wrong Marriage, Entangled with the Tycoon
Description: A woman is tricked into marrying a disabled tycoon in place of her stepsister, unaware that her groom is not what he seems.

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

A convoy of black wedding cars cruises through the financial district. The lead Maybach glints, hood draped in red ceremonial ribbons.

INT. WEDDING CAR - DAY

SU QINGQIAN sits in a white wedding gown, a silk blindfold secured across her eyes. She holds white roses, her knuckles white.

JIANG HAO (V.O.)
(filtered)
Trust me, Qingqian. We're almost there.

FLASHBACK:

INT. ROOM - DAY

Jiang Hao ties the blindfold on Qingqian. His touch is clinical.

JIANG HAO
Li family tradition. For your protection.

SU QINGQIAN
Protection from what?

JIANG HAO
From seeing too much, too soon.

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

The convoy stops before the Xipai Yiyuan, a tower of mirrored glass.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Jiang Hao embraces SU YIYI, both in eveningwear.

JIANG HAO
You look like a woman who just won the lottery.

SU YIYI
I prefer my prizes with a pulse and a portfolio. Let Qingqian nurse your crippled cousin.

JIANG HAO
By the time Li Yeting discovers the substitution, your father's debt is cleared. Clean and simple.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

A laptop displays surveillance of Jiang Hao and Su Yiyi. LI YETING watches from his wheelchair, expression unreadable.

LI YETING (V.O.)
Clean and simple. For them.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

JIANG HAO
That Su Qingqian should feel fortunate to take care of him for you.

SU YIYI
Such a sweet talker. Let me reward you properly.

SU YIYI and JIANG HAO kiss.

INT. ANOTHER HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

SU QINGQIAN, blindfolded, navigates a dark suite. Her voice echoes.

SU QINGQIAN
Jiang Hao? Are you here?

INT. OFFICE - DAY

LI YETING watches Qingqian on the laptop. She moves methodically, not panicked.

Secretary QU YAO pushes LI YETING's wheelchair forward.

QU YAO
Young Master, Su Yiyi refused the contract. She substituted a ward from her family.

QU YAO hands over a document.

QU YAO
The woman inside is—

LI YETING raises his hand.

LI YETING
I know who she is. Prepare the annulment. Five million. And a separate suite—she doesn't share my room.

QU YAO
Yes.

QU YAO turns, drops the file. SU QINGQIAN's photo slides out—her graduation picture, eyes bright with ambition. LI YETING's gaze stays on the surveillance screen, where Qingqian has found the window. She removes the blindfold, stares at her reflection in the glass. No tears. Only resolve.

FADE OUT.

title: Only Pretending to Be Good for You
description: A contractual marriage between He Jingzhun and Jiang Baoci reveals underlying tensions as they navigate their business arrangement disguised as matrimony.
context:
Title: Only Pretending to Be Good for You
Description: A contractual marriage between He Jingzhun and Jiang Baoci reveals underlying tensions as they navigate their business arrangement disguised as matrimony.

EXT. MANSION POOLSIDE - NIGHT

HE JINGZHUN and JIANG BAOCI sit at a table by the pool, the atmosphere tense. He stares at his whiskey. She calculates on her phone.

JIANG BAOCI
He Jingzhun, let's get divorced.

HE JINGZHUN
Is there anything... you want?

HE JINGZHUN
How about... adding me to your asset list?

JIANG BAOCI
(smiling faintly)
You already are.

TITLE CARD: Six Months Earlier

EXT. MANSION POOLSIDE - DAY

HE JINGZHUN, JIANG BAOCI, and GRANDMA HE sit around a table drinking tea.

GRANDMA HE
Baoci has graduated now. Are you two planning to have a baby?

JIANG BAOCI (V.O.)
We agreed to only talk business, not feelings. How could we have a baby?

JIANG BAOCI
Grandma, he can't.

HE JINGZHUN and GRANDMA HE freeze, their expressions shocked. JIANG BAOCI shows a hint of a smug smile.

HE JINGZHUN
(low voice, through gritted teeth)
Jiang Baoci, I think you're tired of living.

JIANG BAOCI kicks HE JINGZHUN under the table.

JIANG BAOCI
(smiling at GRANDMA HE)
But don't worry, Grandma. His tools don't work, but his tadpoles do. In the future, we'll definitely give you a grandson. He Jingzhun has so many women around him, who knows, maybe one day you'll get to pick up a ready-made son.

GRANDMA HE
(amused)
What are you saying to an old woman like me? You two go have dinner.

HE JINGZHUN and JIANG BAOCI get up to leave. GRANDMA HE smiles and picks up her teacup.
continuation:
EXT. MANSION CORRIDOR - DAY

HE JINGZHUN and JIANG BAOCI walk one after the other. HE JINGZHUN suddenly stops and blocks her.

HE JINGZHUN
(pointing at his face)
It's written in the agreement.

JIANG BAOCI
Insulting someone costs a thousand, hitting someone costs a hundred thousand.

JIANG BAOCI lightly pokes HE JINGZHUN's cheek with her finger, then turns and walks away smugly.

EXT. MANSION GARDEN CORRIDOR - DAY

JIANG BAOCI walks alone, counting a stack of bills in her hand. BUTLER LI approaches from the opposite direction.

BUTLER LI
Young Madam, it's time for dinner.

JIANG BAOCI
I just extorted two hundred yuan from him. I feel a bit embarrassed to eat his family's food.

JIANG BAOCI (V.O.)
Pocket money. Keeps the game interesting.

BUTLER LI
It's your family too.

JIANG BAOCI
It's not my family. This place is my company. The old lady is the chairman, He Jingzhun is my direct supervisor. Two million yuan salary per month.

JIANG BAOCI (V.O.)
Where else can you find such a good job?

JIANG BAOCI walks away with a smile, leaving BUTLER LI standing alone.

BUTLER LI (V.O.)
If the young master didn't want to, who in the He family could force him to marry? Who could make him let her win?

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

QUICK FLASH: HE JINGZHUN and JIANG BAOCI sit on a sofa, gazing at each other with an ambiguous atmosphere. Their fingers brush accidentally. Neither pulls away.

Description: A contractual marriage between He Jingzhun and Jiang Baoci reveals underlying tensions as they navigate their business arrangement disguised as matrimony.

EXT. MANSION POOLSIDE - NIGHT

HE JINGZHUN and JIANG BAOCI sit at a table by the pool, the atmosphere tense. He stares at his whiskey. She calculates on her phone.

JIANG BAOCI
He Jingzhun, let's get divorced.

HE JINGZHUN
Is there anything... you want?

HE JINGZHUN
How about... adding me to your asset list?

JIANG BAOCI
(smiling faintly)
You already are.

TITLE CARD: Six Months Earlier

EXT. MANSION POOLSIDE - DAY

HE JINGZHUN, JIANG BAOCI, and GRANDMA HE sit around a table drinking tea.

GRANDMA HE
Baoci has graduated now. Are you two planning to have a baby?

JIANG BAOCI (V.O.)
We agreed to only talk business, not feelings. How could we have a baby?

JIANG BAOCI
Grandma, he can't.

HE JINGZHUN and GRANDMA HE freeze, their expressions shocked. JIANG BAOCI shows a hint of a smug smile.

HE JINGZHUN
(low voice, through gritted teeth)
Jiang Baoci, I think you're tired of living.

JIANG BAOCI kicks HE JINGZHUN under the table.

JIANG BAOCI
(smiling at GRANDMA HE)
But don't worry, Grandma. His tools don't work, but his tadpoles do. In the future, we'll definitely give you a grandson. He Jingzhun has so many women around him, who knows, maybe one day you'll get to pick up a ready-made son.

GRANDMA HE
(amused)
What are you saying to an old woman like me? You two go have dinner.

HE JINGZHUN and JIANG BAOCI get up to leave. GRANDMA HE smiles and picks up her teacup.

EXT. MANSION CORRIDOR - DAY

HE JINGZHUN and JIANG BAOCI walk one after the other. HE JINGZHUN suddenly stops and blocks her.

HE JINGZHUN
(pointing at his face)
It's written in the agreement.

JIANG BAOCI
Insulting someone costs a thousand, hitting someone costs a hundred thousand.

JIANG BAOCI lightly pokes HE JINGZHUN's cheek with her finger, then turns and walks away smugly.

EXT. MANSION GARDEN CORRIDOR - DAY

JIANG BAOCI walks alone, counting a stack of bills in her hand. BUTLER LI approaches from the opposite direction.

BUTLER LI
Young Madam, it's time for dinner.

JIANG BAOCI
I just extorted two hundred yuan from him. I feel a bit embarrassed to eat his family's food.

JIANG BAOCI (V.O.)
Pocket money. Keeps the game interesting.

BUTLER LI
It's your family too.

JIANG BAOCI
It's not my family. This place is my company. The old lady is the chairman, He Jingzhun is my direct supervisor. Two million yuan salary per month.

JIANG BAOCI (V.O.)
Where else can you find such a good job?

JIANG BAOCI walks away with a smile, leaving BUTLER LI standing alone.

BUTLER LI (V.O.)
If the young master didn't want to, who in the He family could force him to marry? Who could make him let her win?

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

QUICK FLASH: HE JINGZHUN and JIANG BAOCI sit on a sofa, gazing at each other with an ambiguous atmosphere. Their fingers brush accidentally. Neither pulls away.

title: I'm Really Not a Hidden Master
description: A simple village man practicing tai chi becomes the unexpected target of a forced marriage proposal from a powerful young lady who possesses extraordinary abilities.
context:
Title: I'm Really Not a Hidden Master
Description: A simple village man practicing tai chi becomes the unexpected target of a forced marriage proposal from a powerful young lady who possesses extraordinary abilities.

INT. JIANG FAMILY HALL - DAY

JIANG CHEN, wearing a white practice outfit, practices tai chi in the courtyard. JIANG QILIN and JIANG ZHIHU sit at a tea table inside the room, drinking tea.

JIANG QILIN
Chen'er, how many times can you recite our Jiang family's ancestral teachings now?

JIANG ZHIHU
I can recite it nine times. Though the words about "hidden dragons" and "unseen storms" seemed like old men's fears... until today.

JIANG QILIN
(sipping tea slowly)
Some fears age into wisdom. When I was your age, I could only manage three repetitions before my hands shook too much to hold the scroll.

Suddenly, a loud bang. The main door is pushed open by an invisible force.

NING YANRAN and NING YUAN walk in.

JIANG CHEN, JIANG QILIN, and JIANG ZHIHU all look at them in surprise.

NING YANRAN
Jiang Chen of the Jiang family.

NING YANRAN
Sign it.

NING YANRAN throws a scroll onto the table. It unfurls with a soft, golden glow.

JIANG CHEN
Well, well, so you're here to break the engagement. Let me tell you, thirty years on the east side of the river—

NING YANRAN
(interrupting)
The betrothal stands. I am here to honor it.

JIANG CHEN picks up the scroll, unfolds it, and sees the words "Marriage Certificate" written in blood-red ink.
continuation:
NING YANRAN
Three years ago, your father saved my life with a single acupuncture needle. The Ning family pays its debts in iron and ink. This contract was sealed before the Jade Council itself.

NING YANRAN
(her voice softening for a heartbeat)
And I... I remember a hand that was steady when my world was not.

JIANG CHEN
(shocked)
But I'm just a village healer. I mend bones and brew teas. You command forces that shatter doors without touch.

JIANG QILIN
(rising, his voice heavy)
Chen'er, your mother wanted you free of these weights. But the world remembers promises, even when we forget.

JIANG ZHIHU
(quietly, only to Jiang Chen)
Brother, her spirit pressure could crack walnuts. Maybe... sign quickly and negotiate later?

NING YANRAN
I will not chain a man who truly refuses. But enemies hunt my bloodline, and your name is already written in their death scrolls. This marriage is a shield as much as a vow.

NING YANRAN
(stepping closer)
I offer you a world you never asked for. But I offer it honestly.

JIANG CHEN
(to himself, barely audible)
A cage of silk and steel... or a life spent running from shadows I cannot see.

JIANG CHEN
(looking up, eyes clear)
And if I sign, what do you become?

NING YUAN steps forward. Flames erupt in his palm, forming the character for "PROTECTOR" that hangs in the air.

NING YUAN
Someone worth the trouble.

title: Rise to Power
description: In a dark prison, Meng Qing interrogates criminals about missing women in Luo City, while his sister Meng Guangyin faces threats from the arrogant Xiao Yun who tries to force her into marriage using business contracts and blackmail.
context:
Title: Rise to Power
Description: In a dark prison, Meng Qing interrogates criminals about missing women in Luo City, while his sister Meng Guangyin faces threats from the arrogant Xiao Yun who tries to force her into marriage using business contracts and blackmail.

INT. PRISON - NIGHT

A dark prison holds many inmates. The iron door slowly opens.

MENG QING, wearing a black cloak, enters with two SUBORDINATES, his presence commanding.

PRISONER
(through the bars)
If you've got guts, fight me again!

MENG QING
(to his subordinates)
Open the door.

The iron door opens. A bald PRISONER rushes out as other inmates jeer and shout.

PRISONER
(charging at Meng Qing)
Yeah!

MENG QING easily dodges, subdues the prisoner with a counter move, and spits in his face.

MENG QING
Where is she?

The PRISONER charges again. MENG QING kicks him, sending him flying into the iron bars.

LI QINGXIAO
That's enough.

MENG QING doesn't stop. He grabs the PRISONER by the throat and beats him until he falls, spitting blood.

MENG QING
(asking Li Qingxiao)
Progress?

LI QINGXIAO
Tough nut to crack. Won't talk.

MENG QING
Oh? How interesting.

LI QINGXIAO
Shura, this is the one.

MENG QING walks toward another PRISONER who is hanging, covered in blood. He cuts the rope and the prisoner falls to the ground.

MENG QING
(looking down at the prisoner)
Women suddenly disappearing in Luo City—what do you know about it? Not talking? Then you're useless.

MENG QING steps on the prisoner's throat.

MENG QING
My sister could only call for our mother when they took her. Your sister works the Southeast warehouse, doesn't she? Every new moon?

PRISONER 2
(struggling)
The Xiao family...

MENG QING's eyes sharpen.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

MENG GUANGYIN enters the office, her ASSISTANT following behind.

ASSISTANT
Director Meng, the company lost two million last quarter.

XIAO YUN appears from the side, approaching Meng Guangyin.

XIAO YUN
Long time no see.

MENG GUANGYIN
(warily)
Xiao Yun.

XIAO YUN
(pulling out documents)
As long as you agree to be my woman, this two million yuan contract is yours.

XIAO YUN tosses a rose on the desk and tries to forcibly embrace MENG GUANGYIN. She pushes him away.

MENG GUANGYIN
Young Master Xiao, please show some respect. We're only here to discuss the contract today.

XIAO YUN
(disdainfully sitting on the sofa)
Rejecting my kindness, are you?

MENG GUANGYIN
Xiao Yun, you're using the contract to coerce me? Then now, take your contract and leave.

XIAO YUN
Guangyin, don't forget—you still have several sisters.

MENG GUANGYIN
(quiet fury)
Xiao Yun.

XIAO YUN stands and walks toward MENG GUANGYIN, pushing her down onto the sofa.

XIAO YUN
So what if I'm threatening you? This young master is going to take what he wants today by force!

MENG GUANGYIN struggles and slaps XIAO YUN.

MENG GUANGYIN
Xiao Yun, you bastard!

XIAO YUN slaps her back, then leans close.

XIAO YUN
Getting cocky, are we? That crippled sister of yours—Bai Fei from the Bai family did that. But I kept your other sister safe. So far.

MENG GUANGYIN
(in disbelief)
You...

XIAO YUN
(leaning closer)
Marry me, and I'll solve all your problems. Refuse, and I become one of them.

XIAO YUN stands, straightening his clothes and picking up his suit jacket.

XIAO YUN
You're the one who needs something from me. Don't be so quick to refuse. Three days, Guangyin. Then I can't guarantee what happens to that celebrity sister of yours.

XIAO YUN leaves with a smile.

MENG GUANGYIN angrily sweeps the documents off the desk, crying out in anguish.

MENG GUANGYIN
Xiao Yun, you bastard!

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Female CEO's Personal Imperial Physician
description: A man awakens in a hospital believing he has traveled through time from ancient China, where he served as the imperial physician to an empress he must protect.
context:
Title: The Female CEO's Personal Imperial Physician
Description: A man awakens in a hospital believing he has traveled through time from ancient China, where he served as the imperial physician to an empress he must protect.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

The blood oxygen monitor's steady rhythm spikes. A hand twitches, fingers clawing at air.

XIAO RAN jolts awake, oxygen mask fogging with ragged breaths. His eyes snap open - ancient, haunted. He rips the mask off.

XIAO RAN (V.O.)
Fifteen years... It worked.

His fingers fly to his chest, searching, then dig frantically at his hospital gown. Nothing. Panic twists his features.

XIAO RAN
The pendant...

He throws off the blanket, tearing at IV tubes, searching the sheets.

EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

LIN YAO's sword bites into EMPRESS GU HUAN's throat. A single crimson bead wells against the blade.

XIAO RAN (in blood-stained imperial physician robes) stumbles forward, hand extended.

XIAO RAN
Release Her Majesty!

LIN YAO
Surrender the Dao Heart Manual or she dies!

GU HUAN
Husband, no!

The words strike Xiao Ran like a physical blow. He drops to his knees, blood spilling from his lips.

LIN YAO
Your martial arts mean nothing without your Dao heart. You're already dead.

Lin Yao raises his sword for the killing strike.

The pendant - simple jade, glowing from within Xiao Ran's robes - blazes to life. It launches itself into the air, shattering the descending blade in a burst of golden light.

LIN YAO
(shielding his eyes)
The Human Emperor Pendant!

Xiao Ran grabs the glowing relic, feeling its power surge through his veins.

XIAO RAN
(roaring)
When I return, Lin Yao, you'll beg for death!

Light engulfs everything.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

GU HUAN - power suit, stilettos clicking urgency - rushes through the door, phone still clutched in hand.

GU HUAN
Xiao Ran!

She freezes. Xiao Ran's eyes lock on her, overflowing with recognition and devotion.

XIAO RAN
Your Majesty...

GU HUAN
(at his bedside, voice cracking)
Don't move. The doctor said -

XIAO RAN
(grabbing her wrist)
The pendant's gone. If Lin Yao followed us through-

GU FEIFEI saunters in, chewing gum, designer bag swinging.

GU FEIFEI
Cousin, he's been delusional since the beating. Young Master Lin barely tapped him.

YOUNG MASTER LIN enters, polished and predatory, BODYGUARD looming behind him.

GU FEIFEI (CONT'D)
(to Gu Huan)
Seriously, dumping him at the altar was smart. Keeping him? That's just sad.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
(to Gu Huan)
Your "husband" needs to learn his place. He soiled my shoes. This is mercy.

XIAO RAN
(fury boiling)
You dare-

GU HUAN
(clenching his hand)
Not now.

GU FEIFEI
Oh please. He's the family embarrassment. Always has been.

She moves to slap Gu Huan. Xiao Ran intercepts, his grip iron around her wrist.

XIAO RAN
Touch Her Majesty and lose the hand.

YOUNG MASTER LIN
(to his bodyguard)
Break him. Again.

The bodyguard advances.

GU HUAN
(stepping between them, voice like steel)
Try it. This hospital has excellent lawyers. And better security cameras.

TO BE CONTINUED

title: Peerless War Spirit
description: In a world where humans awaken martial spirits to enhance their cultivation, a young genius suffers a devastating failure during his awakening ceremony and faces public humiliation and the breaking of his engagement.
context:
Title: Peerless War Spirit
Description: In a world where humans awaken martial spirits to enhance their cultivation, a young genius suffers a devastating failure during his awakening ceremony and faces public humiliation and the breaking of his engagement.

INT. MARTIAL SPIRIT AWAKENING CEREMONY - DAY

NARRATOR (V.O.)
In the Azure Continent, martial spirits decree destiny.

QIN XUE stands at the ancient altar. Golden light coils around her, solidifying into a serpentine phantom.

QIN XUE
Martial spirit, awaken!

The phantom rises five zhang tall, its scales shimmering.

DISCIPLE A
Five zhang of pure gold. Yellow level, fifth grade beast spirit.

DISCIPLE B
Senior Sister Qin just made her future. Guess we know who to bow to.

CHANG KONG takes the altar. Azure light erupts, twisting into a fierce beast phantom eight zhang high.

QIN FAMILY HEAD
Eight zhang of azure light! Mystic level, eighth grade! Truly worthy of being my son!

QIN XUE
Brother Chang Kong's gift eclipses Linshui City. I trust you'll lift your sister up as you climb.

CHANG KONG
(smiling thinly)
Of course, of course.

DISCIPLE A
Qin Nan mastered ancestral sword forms at ten. This could break records.

DISCIPLE B
If anyone hits Mystic level, it's him.

QIN NAN grips his ancestral sword, drawing upon the power of heaven and earth. The sky bleeds crimson. The blade shrieks under the strain.

QIN FAMILY HEAD
(shocked)
continuation:
Heaven level...?!

The sword splinters. QIN NAN vomits blood, collapsing as the red light dissolves into smoke.

QIN FAMILY HEAD
(furious)
No spirit emerges! Heaven Waste—a curse on our name!

QIN NAN
(dragging himself up)
The spirit is silent. But I am not.

FANG FAMILY HEAD
(mocking)
The "genius" who can't conjure a spark? A dog has more dignity.

Laughter spreads.

ANNOUNCER
Miss Nalan has arrived!

NALAN LIULI enters with her MAIDSERVANT. The crowd kneels. QIN NAN remains standing.

DISCIPLE A
(whispering)
Ninth-grade Yellow spirit... and that broken engagement.

DISCIPLE B
This won't end well.

QIN NAN
(struggling to stand)
Liuli—

NALAN LIULI
(ice in her voice)
You lost that right.

She throws a marriage contract scroll. It lands in the dust.

NALAN LIULI
Today, I, Nalan Liuli, annul my engagement to Qin Nan. This contract is void.

QIN NAN stares at the scroll, his knuckles white around his shattered blade.
