Qin Nan mastered ancestral sword forms at ten. This could break records.

DISCIPLE B
If anyone hits Mystic level, it's him.

QIN NAN grips his ancestral sword, drawing upon the power of heaven and earth. The sky bleeds crimson. The blade shrieks under the strain.

QIN FAMILY HEAD
(shocked)
Heaven level...?!

The sword splinters. QIN NAN vomits blood, collapsing as the red light dissolves into smoke.

QIN FAMILY HEAD
(furious)
No spirit emerges! Heaven Waste—a curse on our name!

QIN NAN
(dragging himself up)
The spirit is silent. But I am not.

FANG FAMILY HEAD
(mocking)
The "genius" who can't conjure a spark? A dog has more dignity.

Laughter spreads.

ANNOUNCER
Miss Nalan has arrived!

NALAN LIULI enters with her MAIDSERVANT. The crowd kneels. QIN NAN remains standing.

DISCIPLE A
(whispering)
Ninth-grade Yellow spirit... and that broken engagement.

DISCIPLE B
This won't end well.

QIN NAN
(struggling to stand)
Liuli—

NALAN LIULI
(ice in her voice)
You lost that right.

She throws a marriage contract scroll. It lands in the dust.

NALAN LIULI
Today, I, Nalan Liuli, annul my engagement to Qin Nan. This contract is void.

QIN NAN stares at the scroll, his knuckles white around his shattered blade.

title: The Useless Young Marshal of the Republic Era
description: A security guard reading a novel about a weak young marshal in the Republic era is transported into the story after mocking the protagonist.
context:
Title: The Useless Young Marshal of the Republic Era
Description: A security guard reading a novel about a weak young marshal in the Republic era is transported into the story after mocking the protagonist.

INT. WARLORD MANSION - DAY

Classical music warbles from a gramophone, the needle skipping.

Five women in silk qipaos huddle against a velvet sofa, wrists bound. Their faces show fading bruises, eyes hollowed by days of fear.

A dead servant lies crumpled near the doorway, blood pooling dark on Persian rugs.

The WARLORD (50s), uniform askew, stumbles through the door. Laudanum glassiness fades from his eyes as he takes in the scene—pistol hanging slack in his grip.

Six SOLDIERS in grey uniforms burst in. Four seize the Warlord, slamming him to the polished floor. Two more pin the YOUNG MARSHAL (22) across the mahogany table, his face pressed against scattered playing cards.

The Warlord's head clears. He spots the bound women and wrenches one arm free, pistol swinging toward them.

WARLORD
(strangled voice)
Move, and they die first.

YOUNG MARSHAL
(struggling against the soldiers)
Father, they're innocent! Take me!

The Warlord's hand trembles—withdrawal or rage—then fires once into the ceiling. Plaster rains down.

The soldiers haul the Young Marshal before his AUNT (40s), who sits in a carved rosewood chair, red prayer beads clicking through her fingers like abacus stones.

The Young Marshal drops to his knees, palms pressed together. His voice cracks.

YOUNG MARSHAL
Aunt, father's debts paid his gambling losses. The estate is yours. Just... let them leave Shanghai. I'll sign anything.

AUNT
(sneering)
You think ink on paper stops whispers? The moment your father married those five merchants' daughters, he branded us weak. I'll not rule a house with reminders of his failures.

She grips his chin, nails pressing dimples into his skin.
continuation:
AUNT
You were the final miscalculation. A son who reads poetry while enemies load guns.

Through the door's cracked lacquer, the Warlord watches. His tremor steadies. He brings a finger to his lips—eyes glittering with coming victory.

The Aunt lifts a teacup with her free hand. Porcelain clinks against her wedding ring.

The Young Marshal's eyes fix on the coal scuttle beside the soldier's boot. He lunges.

YOUNG MARSHAL
(roaring)
Then I take the name with me!

He palms a shard of coke, pistol already coming up—trained, smooth, a motion practiced thousand times in private.

The Aunt doesn't flinch. The Warlord steps from shadows, grip solid, and cracks the pistol butt across his son's temple.

The Young Marshal's body folds—head bouncing once against tile. Still.

The Warlord stares at his dead heir. His smile is a wound.

INT. MODERN PARKING LOT SECURITY BOOTH - DAY

A SECURITY GUARD (28) slouches in a folding chair, uniform shirt unbuttoned at the neck. He thumbs through the novel, its pages yellowed.

SECURITY GUARD
(muttering)
Betrayed by his aunt, killed by his dad... and he still apologized to the women. I'd have shot the old man in the back first chance.

He glances at the security monitor—empty garage levels scrolling.

SECURITY GUARD
(fantasizing)
Give me his foundational training, his wives' dowries, one day. I'd own this city by nightfall.

He barks a laugh, then chokes on his instant noodles. A wet cough splatters broth across the page.

The words blur. The ink runs.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Dark Abyss Prison
description: A legendary female war god delivers the world's most dangerous criminal to a maximum security prison, only to discover his capture was part of a plan to challenge the prison's supreme ruler.
context:
Title: Dark Abyss Prison
Description: A legendary female war god delivers the world's most dangerous criminal to a maximum security prison, only to discover his capture was part of a plan to challenge the prison's supreme ruler.

INT. DARK ABYSS PRISON - NIGHT

Alarms SHRIEK. Red lights STROBE through smoke and shadow.

Inmates howl in their cells. Two PRISONERS face off in the common area.

CANNON FACE
(low, dangerous)
Number two spot's mine. Six months running.

PRISONER A
Prove it.

They clash. Others scramble for cover. A TOWER GUARD watches from reinforced glass, unblinking.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
They call this chaos. They haven't seen anything yet.

EXT. DARK ABYSS PRISON - COURTYARD - DAY

Rain hammers the concrete. A MILITARY TANK rolls through the gates. BLACK SUVs and ARMED SOLDIERS follow.

QIN SHIYUE (30s), red coat snapping in the wind, stands on the tank. Her uniform bears five stars—Great Xia's highest honor. Her eyes scan the prison with cold assessment.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Qin Shiyue. Youngest Five-Star War God in history. She delivered him.

INT. DARK ABYSS PRISON - NIGHT

TANG JIE (40s), massive, wrists and neck locked in CARVED WOODEN SHACKLES that glow with faint runes. TWO SPECIAL OPS guards escort him. Qin Shiyue follows, hand on sword hilt.

Inmates press against cell bars, whispering.

PRISONER 2099
(quietly)
Tang Jie. The Butcher of Shanghai. They actually got him.

Qin Shiyue stops Tang Jie before a reinforced door.

QIN SHIYUE
Seventh 3S criminal this year. Don't make this difficult.

TANG JIE
(turns slowly)
Difficult? For you?

His eyes flick to her ready sword hand. Then to the pulsing runes on his shackles.

TANG JIE
You protect a family, General? A people?

QIN SHIYUE
That's not your concern.

TANG JIE
Exactly. You'd never walk into hell willingly.

The runes FLARE. The shackles CRACK and splinter.

TANG JIE
I needed the invitation.

He EXPLODES free. A SHOCKWAVE sends guards sprawling. Qin Shiyue draws her blade—

Tang Jie catches her wrist. Not a fight. A statement.

TANG JIE
Stay down.

He releases her. She drops to one knee, not from force, but from the weight of realization.

TANG JIE
(to the cells)
Three years without a king. That ends today.

The block erupts. Inmates cheer, bang bars.
continuation:
PRISONER 2099
The Emperor will fillet you for this!

He charges from his cell. Tang Jie side-steps, uses momentum to send him into the wall. One strike. Down.

CANNON FACE
(from the shadows)
The Domain Emperor's word is law here. You breathe because he allows it.

TANG JIE
Then I suggest he stop allowing it.

SNAKE MOUNTAIN DEMON
Kill the blasphemer!

Inmates pour from cells. A tide.

TANG JIE
(grinning)
Let's see what three years of fear has built.

He moves like a storm. Precise, economical. Bodies drop—disabled, not dead. This isn't rage. It's surgery.

Silence. Twenty inmates on the ground, groaning. Tang Jie stands untouched.

TANG JIE
Three years ago, I built this place. Then I left. Now I'm back.

BOOTS on metal stairs from above.

DOMAIN EMPEROR (O.S.)
You built a prison. I built an empire.

The DOMAIN EMPEROR (20s), young, descends in a black embroidered coat. Each step rings with authority.

PRISONER 2099
(from the floor)
My lord... we tried—

DOMAIN EMPEROR
I know. As planned.

He reaches the bottom floor. Faces Tang Jie.

DOMAIN EMPEROR
Three years. Forty-seven challengers. All failed because they wanted the throne. You want something else.

TANG JIE
What I built wasn't meant to be a throne room.

They move. Inhumanly fast. Tang Jie's raw power meets the Emperor's fluid precision. Blows echo like thunder.

Tang Jie lands a hit. The Emperor smiles.

Then the Emperor strikes.

Three blows. Tang Jie's defense shatters. A final palm sends him through a concrete pillar.

Tang Jie struggles up, coughing blood.

TANG JIE
(ragged)
You... you're not—

DOMAIN EMPEROR
(steps on his chest, firm)
I'm what this place needed.

He looks at Qin Shiyue, still on one knee.

DOMAIN EMPEROR
General. Tell your masters the Butcher is contained. His surrender?

He meets Tang Jie's eyes.

DOMAIN EMPEROR
We'll discuss terms.

FADE OUT.

title: Hit by the Campus Belle, I Became the World's Richest Man
description: A poor student is betrayed by his girlfriend and humiliated by a rich rival, but a mysterious jade pendant may change his fate.
context:
Title: Hit by the Campus Belle, I Became the World's Richest Man
Description: A poor student is betrayed by his girlfriend and humiliated by a rich rival, but a mysterious jade pendant may change his fate.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

LIANG SHAO and ZHU CHENCHEN sit at a corner table. He slides a bank card toward her.

LIANG SHAO
For the trip. My place tonight.

ZHU CHENCHEN
(fingers hovering over the card)
Liang Shao... Chen Fan and I, we've been together three years.

LIANG SHAO
And yet here you are. The choice is made.

CHEN FAN appears, holding two cups of coffee. His expression freezes.

CHEN FAN
Chenchen...?

ZHU CHENCHEN
(quietly, not meeting his eyes)
I texted you. We were done yesterday.

CHEN FAN
One fight about a lipstick and you're—who is this?

ZHU CHENCHEN
(looking up, voice hardening)
It's not about the lipstick. It's about sitting in a campus café holding cheap coffee, pretending this is enough. It was never enough.

CHEN FAN
(pleading)
continuation:
The bride price... my parents borrowed against everything. You knew what it cost us.

ZHU CHENCHEN
Then they should've borrowed more.

LIANG SHAO
(leaning back)
Your uncle's medical bills are due next week, I hear. Touch me, and that loan I approved? Disappears. Along with your degree.

CHEN FAN
(hands shaking)
You can't—

LIANG SHAO
I can. Also, Chenchen? That purity act you've been playing? I've heard the rumors. How you made him wait. Let's give him a real show tonight, shall we?

ZHU CHENCHEN
(to Chen Fan, voice cold)
Don't make this harder than it is. Some people climb. Others are just weight to be cut loose.

She stands, slipping the card into her bag.

CHEN FAN
(roaring)
Chenchen!

LIANG SHAO
(softly, to the room)
Remove him.

TWO BODYGUARDS at a nearby table stand and move in. They grab Chen Fan's arms.

The first bodyguard drives a fist into his stomach. Chen Fan doubles over.

The jade pendant beneath his shirt PULSES with a faint, unseen light—only Chen Fan's eyes widen at it.

title: Dragon Lord of Dragon Gate
description: Qi Tian, a legendary warrior who conquered millions, now lives in hiding selling watermelons, while secretly protecting his wife and wielding immense power.
context:
Title: Dragon Lord of Dragon Gate
Description: Qi Tian, a legendary warrior who conquered millions, now lives in hiding selling watermelons, while secretly protecting his wife and wielding immense power.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - NIGHT

THREE YEARS AGO

QI TIAN (30s), black battle armor slick with rain, cuts through a horde of enemies. Steel flashes. Lightning illuminates the carnage.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
They called him the Dragon Lord. In one night, ten million fell. By dawn, the four seas belonged to Great Xia. Then... he vanished.

EXT. ROADSIDE WATERMELON STAND - DAY

QI TIAN, white tank top and worn trousers, splits a watermelon with a single stroke. Beside him, a faded flag bearing the character "Dragon" flutters lazily.

A group of PEDESTRIANS approach.

QI TIAN
Dragon melons. Hundred thousand a pound. Guaranteed sweet.

PEDESTRIAN A
Hundred thousand? For fruit? You cracked?

PEDESTRIAN B
Guy's a nutter. Let's go.

They retreat. Qi Tian resumes cutting, unfazed.

A luxury sedan glides to a halt. WANG JINSONG (50s), green suit, emerges with two BODYGUARDS. They hang back as Wang approaches alone, bowing deeply.

WANG JINSONG
(bowing low)
Forgive the intrusion, Dragon Lord. That flag... I've been searching three months.

QI TIAN
(without looking up)
You found me. Now what?

WANG JINSONG
Your wife's company—her new medicine. The approvals are... expedited. She'll have them by dawn.

Qi Tian's knife pauses mid-slice. He glances at a simple silver ring on his finger.

QI TIAN
What do you want?

A Bodyguard steps forward with a velvet tray bearing an antique key and a black card. Wang waves the card away.

WANG JINSONG
The Cloud Province Villa. Key's yours. For one melon.

QI TIAN
A villa for fruit? You're overpaying.

WANG JINSONG
I'm paying what it's worth to me.

QI TIAN
(takes the key, hefts it)
Protection doesn't come this cheap.

WANG JINSONG
(hastily)
The card holds a hundred million. For... expenses.

Qi Tian pockets both, selects a perfect melon.

QI TIAN
You're under Dragon Gate's roof now. Don't make me regret it.

WANG JINSONG
(gravely)
continuation:
Thank you, Dragon Lord.

The Bodyguard reveals a glass case containing a Tianshan snow lotus.

WANG JINSONG
For your wife's research. A token.

Qi Tian accepts it with surprising gentleness, wrapping it in clean cloth before placing it beneath the stand.

QI TIAN
You're thorough. We're done.

WANG JINSONG
Yes, Dragon Lord.

They retreat backwards, heads bowed.

A WOMAN in a red halter top materializes from the shadows. Qi Tian's knife flashes to her throat in one motion.

QI TIAN
I'm retired.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
Sir. Your wife—

QI TIAN
(lowering the blade)
What about her?

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
The five hundred million is gone. Her drug failed. Zero sales.

Qi Tian selects a melon slice, studies it.

QI TIAN
Buy every unit. Five billion. Anonymously.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
She'll suspect.

QI TIAN
Let her think she's brilliant. Let her win.

She nods, vanishing as silently as she came.

A red Ferrari roars up. LIU RUYAN (20s), white designer dress, steps out with an imperious bearing.

LIU RUYAN
Qi Tian.

He bites into a rind, unimpressed.

QI TIAN
You're blocking my sun.

LIU RUYAN
My father... Zongheng Group. He said you owed him a promise.

QI TIAN
Old Liu's girl. I owe no one.

LIU RUYAN
(smiling coldly)
Then why did you send him a jade pendant when I was born? With a vow.

QI TIAN
(still)
That was before.

LIU RUYAN
I'm here to collect. The vow was for marriage.

She places a jade pendant on the stand—the twin of his ring.

The Bodyguard reveals a glass case containing a Tianshan snow lotus.

WANG JINSONG
For your wife's research. A token.

Qi Tian accepts it with surprising gentleness, wrapping it in clean cloth before placing it beneath the stand.

QI TIAN
You're thorough. We're done.

WANG JINSONG
Yes, Dragon Lord.

They retreat backwards, heads bowed.

A WOMAN in a red halter top materializes from the shadows. Qi Tian's knife flashes to her throat in one motion.

QI TIAN
I'm retired.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
Sir. Your wife—

QI TIAN
(lowering the blade)
What about her?

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
The five hundred million is gone. Her drug failed. Zero sales.

Qi Tian selects a melon slice, studies it.

QI TIAN
Buy every unit. Five billion. Anonymously.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
She'll suspect.

QI TIAN
Let her think she's brilliant. Let her win.

She nods, vanishing as silently as she came.

A red Ferrari roars up. LIU RUYAN (20s), white designer dress, steps out with an imperious bearing.

LIU RUYAN
Qi Tian.

He bites into a rind, unimpressed.

QI TIAN
You're blocking my sun.

LIU RUYAN
My father... Zongheng Group. He said you owed him a promise.

QI TIAN
Old Liu's girl. I owe no one.

LIU RUYAN
(smiling coldly)
Then why did you send him a jade pendant when I was born? With a vow.

QI TIAN
(still)
That was before.

LIU RUYAN
I'm here to collect. The vow was for marriage.

She places a jade pendant on the stand—the twin of his ring.

title: Senior Sister Dotes on Me
description: A young boy survives a family massacre and is taken in by martial arts masters who promise to teach him and help him grow strong.
context:
Title: Senior Sister Dotes on Me
Description: A young boy survives a family massacre and is taken in by martial arts masters who promise to teach him and help him grow strong.

EXT. ZHOU FAMILY GATE - NIGHT

Several masked men in black, armed with weapons, breach the compound gate with brutal efficiency.

INT. ZHOU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

MOTHER clutches young ZHOU HAO, her back pressed against a lacquered cabinet. A jade talisman hangs at her throat.

MOTHER
Master!

FATHER rushes downstairs, his dao singing from its scabbard. He positions himself between his family and the intruders.

FATHER
Take the child and go!

MOTHER scoops up ZHOU HAO and sprints outside.

EXT. ZHOU FAMILY COURTYARD - CONTINUOUS

FATHER's blade becomes a whirling barrier as MOTHER races toward the servant's gate.

FATHER
Go! Don't worry about me!

MOTHER reaches the gate—locked. She frantically shakes the iron bars, then spots a loose one. With desperate strength, she pries it open and pushes ZHOU HAO through, pressing the jade talisman into his palm.

MOTHER
Run forward. Don't look back.

ZHOU HAO
(crying)
Mama...

MOTHER
Go!

ZHOU HAO runs forward, crying, as the iron bars clang shut.

MOTHER turns, her eyes resolute, and sprints back toward the fight.

FATHER is outnumbered and knocked to the ground.

MOTHER rushes forward, standing back-to-back with FATHER, fighting the remaining masked men together.

The two fight desperately, but there are too many enemies.

FATHER is struck down and falls.

MOTHER is cornered by a masked man. She fights back fiercely, taking down several enemies.

Suddenly, several silver needles strike MOTHER's back. She painfully falls to her knees, then collapses.

ZHOU HAO runs alone through the dark streets, crying as he runs. The jade talisman swings from his neck.
continuation:
EXT. PARK - DAY

OLD MAN, MAN IN SUIT, and MAN IN CHINESE TUNIC walk the morning paths.

MAN IN SUIT
Huh?

OLD MAN
Is that a child crying?

MAN IN CHINESE TUNIC
It really is. From the willows.

MAN IN SUIT
Over there.

The three follow the sound and find ZHOU HAO sitting alone on the grass, crying. The Zhou talisman hangs from his neck.

OLD MAN walks up and crouches down.

OLD MAN
Child, whose family are you from?

MAN IN SUIT
Why are you here alone?

OLD MAN
What's your name?

MAN IN SUIT
Who are your parents?

ZHOU HAO
(clutching the talisman)
Zhou Hao.

OLD MAN
Oh.

MAN IN SUIT
The Zhou family that was wiped out overnight...

MAN IN CHINESE TUNIC
The heir. We'd heard rumors.

The three exchange serious glances.

OLD MAN
(looking at ZHOU HAO)
Child, you may never see your family again. But you must be strong. Will you come with us? We can teach you martial arts and skills.

ZHOU HAO looks at the talisman, then at OLD MAN. He wipes his tears and nods.

MAN IN SUIT
Let's go, then.

MAN IN CHINESE TUNIC
Ha ha ha. The young miss will finally have a sparring partner.

The three men leave the park with ZHOU HAO.

title: Spring Warmth at Jinping
description: A widow's secret love with her brother-in-law shatters when her pregnancy is discovered, forcing a tragic confrontation between duty, honor, and survival.
context:
Title: Spring Warmth at Jinping
Description: A widow's secret love with her brother-in-law shatters when her pregnancy is discovered, forcing a tragic confrontation between duty, honor, and survival.

INT. MOURNING HALL - NIGHT

White banners drift in the drafty hall. "In Memoriam" hangs center. The memorial tablet reads: "Spirit Tablet of Lu Xu."

XIE JINPING, in mourning white, feeds paper offerings to the fire basin.

XIE JINPING (V.O.)
Thirty-three days, husband. Soon the mourning veil lifts. Then I can speak his name aloud...

The door SLAMS. LADY LU storms in with two MAIDS, her face carved from jade.

LADY LU
Remove her from my son's presence.

The two MAIDS seize XIE JINPING by the arms, dragging her from the altar.

XIE JINPING
(carefully calm)
Mother-in-law. What has happened?

LADY LU
What has happened? The Minister of Rites' daughter has made this house a brothel.

Lady Lu produces a small silk pouch, tosses it at Jinping's feet. Dried herbs scatter.

LADY LU (CONT'D)
Your loyal Chunxia kept this. Wouldn't speak, even when questioned. Found her this morning in the well. Such devotion.

Two SERVANTS enter with a stretcher bearing CHUNXIA's soaked body.

XIE JINPING
(breath catching)
Chunxia...

XIE JINPING looks up at Lady Lu, understanding hardening in her eyes.

XIE JINPING (CONT'D)
You had her interrogated about my courses.

LADY LU
I had her questioned about her mistress's honor. Which is more than you did.

A third maid, CHUNTAO, brings forward a ceramic bowl. The smell is bitter iron.

LADY LU (CONT'D)
Your father stands before the Emperor's tribunal next week. A grandchild—born seven months after my son's death? I will not gift his enemies this blade.

XIE JINPING
The child is Lu Sheng's.

LADY LU
Precisely. When he returns from the Western campaign, he marries Princess Huaying. That alliance keeps our family standing. You would make him a mockery.

XIE JINPING
He promised—

LADY LU
(crouching, grip like iron)
Men promise many things in shadows. In daylight, they obey necessity.

She signals the maids. They force XIE JINPING's jaw open. Chuntao brings the bowl.

XIE JINPING
(struggling against them)
Mother-in-law... the child is innocent...

LADY LU
(voice low, terrible)
Innocence is a luxury for women who choose properly. You chose my dead son over my living one.
continuation:
EXT. BAMBOO GROVE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Sunlight patterns through bamboo. LU SHENG's battle-worn hands tie a wreath. His forearm bears an old scar.

LU SHENG
Father pledged me to Zhao's daughter before I could refuse. But Xu's death changed the law. When I return with the victory seal, I can petition for you. Not for passion—for justice.

He places the wreath in XIE JINPING's hair.

LU SHENG (CONT'D)
Wait for me.

XIE JINPING
(tracing his scar)
Always.

INT. MOURNING HALL - NIGHT (PRESENT)

The maids pour the draught down XIE JINPING's throat. She chokes, liquid spilling dark across white silk.

LADY LU
Hold her.

XIE JINPING convulses. Blood blooms at her lips. She crawls toward CHUNXIA's body, fingers brushing cold flesh.

XIE JINPING
(whispered)
Chunxia... I thought... we could choose...

She collapses. Blood pools beneath her, black in the firelight.

LADY LU watches, face unreadable. Her hand trembles once, then stills.

She turns away.

title: Reborn Warrior
description: A construction worker is beaten unconscious and awakens memories of his past life as a powerful warrior who fought against invaders to protect his homeland.
context:
Title: Reborn Warrior
Description: A construction worker is beaten unconscious and awakens memories of his past life as a powerful warrior who fought against invaders to protect his homeland.

PREVIOUSLY ON:

INT. HOSPITAL WAITING ROOM - NIGHT

YAN JUN deletes a medical bill on his phone. It rings with "SISTER" calling. He silences it.

EPISODE ONE:

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

Workers rest in the shade. YAN JUN pushes a rebar cart past them.

The FOREMAN blocks his path with three WORKERS. The Foreman holds Yan Jun's timecard.

FOREMAN
Two days' pay. Docked.

YAN JUN
For what?

FOREMAN
For thinking you're better than us.

YAN JUN
I just want to work.

FOREMAN
Then work. Move all those bricks. Alone.

The Foreman points. Yan Jun sees the massive pile.

YAN JUN
Understood.

The Foreman shoves. Yan Jun blocks instinctively. The Foreman stumbles.

FOREMAN
Beat him to death!

Workers rush in. Yan Jun defends but is overwhelmed. He falls.

FOREMAN
(getting up)
Get back! I'll finish it.

The Foreman grabs a rebar. Yan Jun sees it coming. Impact. Darkness. His jade pendant cracks, glowing.
continuation:
EXT. WILDERNESS - NIGHT

YAN JUN in black armor. Before him: REFUGEES from the Northern Kingdom, starving. JUNIOR SISTER stands between them.

JUNIOR SISTER
These are families, Senior Brother! Not soldiers!

YAN JUN
They sheltered the enemy prince.

JUNIOR SISTER
And you'll slaughter children for that?

A REFUGEE MAN lunges with a tool. Yan Jun's sword moves. JUNIOR SISTER blocks. She falls into his arms, impaled.

YAN JUN
(eyes wide)
No... not again...

His pendant glows. White light erupts from his eyes.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

YAN JUN's eyes snap open. White light fades. He catches the Foreman's descending wrist. The rebar bends in his grip.

title: After Divorce, My Wife Learns I Am the Emperor
description: The legendary Night Emperor, who saved the nation from rebellion, hides his identity as a humble husband. After being summoned back to defeat a traitor, he declines the victory banquet to return home to his wife.
context:
Title: After Divorce, My Wife Learns I Am the Emperor
Description: The legendary Night Emperor, who saved the nation from rebellion, hides his identity as a humble husband. After being summoned back to defeat a traitor, he declines the victory banquet to return home to his wife.

INT. BATTLEFIELD - NIGHT

Flames surge into the sky, explosions echo everywhere.

QIN TIAN, wearing red battle armor, fights fiercely against multiple opponents. His martial arts are supreme, no one can match him.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The First War God of Great Xia faces the legend who vanished three years ago.

A mysterious man wearing a skull mask (YE FENG) appears, confronting QIN TIAN.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Eighteen golden decrees summoned him from seclusion.

YE FENG removes his mask, revealing a face hardened by three peaceful years.

YE FENG
I left the battlefield to protect one life. You threaten millions.

YE FENG and QIN TIAN engage in fierce combat, blades flashing. Finally, YE FENG defeats him with one strike. QIN TIAN falls to the ground.

QIN TIAN lies bleeding.

QIN TIAN
You... mastered the Yin Yang Scripture.

YE FENG looks down at him.

YE FENG
I mastered being a husband first.
continuation:
EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE PLAZA - NIGHT

YE FENG stands in magnificent armor at the end of a red carpet. Before him, black-clad guards kneel in unison.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Night Emperor has achieved supreme merit. Power to judge emperors, authority over all lords.

ALL
(in unison)
Long live our Emperor! Long live! Long live!

NARRATOR (V.O.)
But the long night ends at home.

The SOVEREIGN'S ENVOY steps forward to deliver the decree.

SOVEREIGN'S ENVOY
By the Sovereign's decree, the Night Emperor is invited to the victory banquet.

YE FENG
I won't go. I have to go home tonight... before the divorce papers arrive tomorrow.

YE FENG turns and leaves, leaving everyone stunned.

SOVEREIGN'S ENVOY
(muttering to himself)
Three years secluding as a husband... and now she learns what she truly lost.

title: Opening with a Broken Engagement - I Am the Emperor and I Reveal It
description: A modern scientist is transported to ancient times after a lab explosion, where he discovers he is the Sixth Prince and becomes entangled in palace intrigue.
context:
Title: Opening with a Broken Engagement - I Am the Emperor and I Reveal It
Description: A modern scientist is transported to ancient times after a lab explosion, where he discovers he is the Sixth Prince and becomes entangled in palace intrigue.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

Lights flicker in a high-tech laboratory. A young scientist, HAN JUN, wearing a white lab coat and goggles, conducts a chemical experiment.

He carefully drops a liquid into a flask. The liquid produces white smoke.

HAN JUN picks up a beaker and looks at the reactants inside with satisfaction.

HAN JUN
Now my doctoral thesis should be fine.

He mixes two chemical reagents. Suddenly, a violent explosion occurs, producing a dazzling blue light.

HAN JUN
(terrified)
What the—

The scene enters a time-travel special effect. Year numbers rapidly rewind and finally freeze on an ancient scene.

EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD LAWN - NIGHT

HAN JUN falls from the sky and crashes heavily onto the grass. He is wearing ancient costume.

HAN JUN
(screaming)
Ah!

He struggles to get up from the ground and looks around in confusion.

He staggers toward a building draped with white gauze curtains.

INT. BATHHOUSE - NIGHT

HAN JUN passes through the flowing gauze and enters an antique room filled with mist.

He sees the back of a woman bathing in a wooden tub. The woman has a graceful figure.

HAN JUN stares in amazement.

HAN JUN (V.O.)
Okay, this hallucination is getting specific—

The woman, SHEN QINGZHU, senses someone's presence and turns around abruptly. Her eyes flash with fury and recognition.

SHEN QINGZHU
(low, dangerous)
You.

HAN JUN
(startled)
I can explain—

SHEN QINGZHU grabs a jade soap dish and hurls it at HAN JUN.

SHEN QINGZHU
The women's bathhouse, Sixth Prince? Have you no shame?

HAN JUN
(dodging)
Laboratory! I was in a laboratory! This is a massive misunderstanding!

SHEN QINGZHU stops, her anger shifting into something colder, more calculating.

SHEN QINGZHU
Sixth Prince. Breaking a betrothal is one thing. Breaking into here suggests you've lost more than your senses.

HAN JUN
Betrothal? What—
(looks down at his robes)
Wait. Wasn't I wearing a lab coat?

SHEN QINGZHU
Your fevered pursuit ends now. Return to your chambers before I report this to the Empress Dowager.

HAN JUN (V.O.)
Time travel is a statistical impossibility. Unless the explosion—

HAN JUN turns and runs.
continuation:
EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

HAN JUN runs out of the bathhouse in panic. A EUNUCH hurries toward him from a nearby lantern-lit path.

EUNUCH
(anxiously)
Your Highness! The Emperor summons the princes for marriage decrees. This servant has searched every—

The EUNUCH sees SHEN QINGZHU emerging behind HAN JUN and immediately bows, lowering his voice.

EUNUCH
(quietly)
Miss Shen. The Prime Minister's reputation hangs on discretion. We need not burden the Empress with tonight's... confusion.

HAN JUN
(confused)
You're a eunuch? That's historically accurate.

SHEN QINGZHU
(to HAN JUN)
Your proposal was already an embarrassment. This performance proves the Prime Minister's daughter deserves better.

SHEN QINGZHU turns and leaves, her bearing regal.

HAN JUN stands there, processing fragments.

EUNUCH
(pulling HAN JUN)
Your Highness, the ancestral hall awaits. Delay will insult the Emperor personally.

HAN JUN
(struggling)
I'm not a prince! I'm a postdoc in inorganic chemistry!

EUNUCH
(whispering)
And this old servant is a dragon. Come—before we both lose our heads.

The EUNUCH forcibly drags HAN JUN away. HAN JUN continues to resist, his eyes scanning for any scientific explanation.

EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD LAWN - NIGHT

HAN JUN falls from the sky and crashes heavily onto the grass. He is wearing ancient costume.

HAN JUN
(screaming)
Ah!

He struggles to get up from the ground and looks around in confusion.

He staggers toward a building draped with white gauze curtains.

INT. BATHHOUSE - NIGHT

HAN JUN passes through the flowing gauze and enters an antique room filled with mist.

He sees the back of a woman bathing in a wooden tub. The woman has a graceful figure.

HAN JUN stares in amazement.

HAN JUN (V.O.)
Okay, this hallucination is getting specific—

The woman, SHEN QINGZHU, senses someone's presence and turns around abruptly. Her eyes flash with fury and recognition.

SHEN QINGZHU
(low, dangerous)
You.

HAN JUN
(startled)
I can explain—

SHEN QINGZHU grabs a jade soap dish and hurls it at HAN JUN.

SHEN QINGZHU
The women's bathhouse, Sixth Prince? Have you no shame?

HAN JUN
(dodging)
Laboratory! I was in a laboratory! This is a massive misunderstanding!

SHEN QINGZHU stops, her anger shifting into something colder, more calculating.

SHEN QINGZHU
Sixth Prince. Breaking a betrothal is one thing. Breaking into here suggests you've lost more than your senses.

HAN JUN
Betrothal? What—
(looks down at his robes)
Wait. Wasn't I wearing a lab coat?

SHEN QINGZHU
Your fevered pursuit ends now. Return to your chambers before I report this to the Empress Dowager.

HAN JUN (V.O.)
Time travel is a statistical impossibility. Unless the explosion—

HAN JUN turns and runs.

EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

HAN JUN runs out of the bathhouse in panic. A EUNUCH hurries toward him from a nearby lantern-lit path.

EUNUCH
(anxiously)
Your Highness! The Emperor summons the princes for marriage decrees. This servant has searched every—

The EUNUCH sees SHEN QINGZHU emerging behind HAN JUN and immediately bows, lowering his voice.

EUNUCH
(quietly)
Miss Shen. The Prime Minister's reputation hangs on discretion. We need not burden the Empress with tonight's... confusion.

HAN JUN
(confused)
You're a eunuch? That's historically accurate.

SHEN QINGZHU
(to HAN JUN)
Your proposal was already an embarrassment. This performance proves the Prime Minister's daughter deserves better.

SHEN QINGZHU turns and leaves, her bearing regal.

HAN JUN stands there, processing fragments.

EUNUCH
(pulling HAN JUN)
Your Highness, the ancestral hall awaits. Delay will insult the Emperor personally.

HAN JUN
(struggling)
I'm not a prince! I'm a postdoc in inorganic chemistry!

EUNUCH
(whispering)
And this old servant is a dragon. Come—before we both lose our heads.

The EUNUCH forcibly drags HAN JUN away. HAN JUN continues to resist, his eyes scanning for any scientific explanation.

title: Chaotic Times Wedding - The Lady Wants to Escape Marriage
description: A woman tortured in a dungeon by her rival relives memories of her deceased husband, a military commander, before seemingly encountering him again on a train.
context:
Title: Chaotic Times Wedding - The Lady Wants to Escape Marriage
Description: A woman tortured in a dungeon by her rival relives memories of her deceased husband, a military commander, before seemingly encountering him again on a train.

INT. DUNGEON - NIGHT

In the dark, gloomy dungeon, flames flicker in a fire basin.

YAN'ER is bound to a massive wooden cross, covered in blood and wounds, her hair hanging disheveled. She is unconscious.

The sounds of whipping and water splashing on her body echo continuously.

GU YUTING, wearing a luxurious qipao and high heels, slowly walks into the dungeon. She toys with a sharp dagger in her hand.

GU YUTING approaches YAN'ER and looks at her miserable state.

GU YUTING
(contemptuously)
Oh, awake now?

GU YUTING
I just don't understand. Tell me, what does Huo Xizhou see in you? Losing your virginity before marriage, your reputation ruined.

GU YUTING slides the back of the dagger blade across YAN'ER's arm.

GU YUTING
I shouldn't have sent you to Huo Minghao's bed. It only made him love you more.

GU YUTING rips a pair of broken jade pendants from YAN'ER's neck, stained with blood.

GU YUTING
You don't know yet, do you? Huo Xizhou went to suppress bandits. He's dead.

GU YUTING's expression becomes twisted, tears in her eyes.

GU YUTING
The Huo family is finished!

GU YUTING suddenly bursts into maniacal laughter.
continuation:
GU YUTING
(laughing wildly)
Ha ha ha! Ha ha!

YAN'ER slowly opens her eyes, calling out weakly.

YAN'ER
(barely breathing)
Xizhou...

GU YUTING leans close to YAN'ER's ear.

GU YUTING
(whispering)
Huo Xizhou... go to hell!

GU YUTING viciously stabs the dagger into YAN'ER's side. YAN'ER spits out a mouthful of black blood and her body goes limp.

The dungeon door slams shut. Darkness consumes the cell.

MONTAGE

- HUO XIZHOU in military uniform lifts YAN'ER's red wedding veil in the bridal chamber. They gaze deeply at each other. He fastens the jade pendants around her neck.
- The two kiss on the wedding bed, embracing as they sleep.
- YAN'ER and HUO XIZHOU in casual clothes, nestled together by the window, peaceful and content.
- HUO XIZHOU is shot on the battlefield, his face covered in blood, his eyes filled with despair.

INT. TRAIN CAR - DAY

YAN'ER sits by the window, looking forlorn. She holds the broken jade pendants in her hand, joining the two pieces together. A scar peeks from her collar.

She looks at an old newspaper on the table with the headline "Year 12 of the Republic."

A MAN in a trench coat and fedora walks past in the aisle, his silhouette strikingly similar to HUO XIZHOU. Gunpowder and sandalwood scent the air.

YAN'ER suddenly lifts her head, her eyes filled with shock and hope.

FADE OUT.

title: Baby Strike: Agent Mommy Is Not to Be Messed With
description: A female agent is betrayed by her partner and wakes up in a hospital, finding herself in a strange situation with unfamiliar people.
context:
Title: Baby Strike: Agent Mommy Is Not to Be Messed With
Description: A female agent is betrayed by her partner and wakes up in a hospital, finding herself in a strange situation with unfamiliar people.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

On the messy warehouse floor lie several unconscious MEN IN BLACK.

Female agent FANG NUAN (dressed in black tactical clothing) wakes from unconsciousness, fingers instinctively checking her ballistic vest. She sits up alertly and looks around.

FANG NUAN activates the communicator in her ear.

FANG NUAN
Command, the orphanage led to a trap. There's a breach.

Not far away, an injured MALE COLLEAGUE struggles to raise his pistol, aiming at FANG NUAN.

A gunshot rings out.

FANG NUAN reacts extremely fast, instantly raising her gun and returning fire, taking him down.

Another MALE COLLEAGUE, FU TING, stands up from the ground and walks toward her with a smile that doesn't reach his eyes.

FANG NUAN sees FU TING, breathes a shaky sigh of relief, and runs forward to embrace him.

FANG NUAN
Thank God. Tell me Mei-Mei's safe.

FU TING holds FANG NUAN, a cold smile playing on his lips as tears pool in his eyes. He pulls out a syringe and stabs it into her neck.

FANG NUAN's eyes widen in shock as her body goes limp. FU TING slowly lowers her to the ground.

FU TING
(whispering)
Remember you have a daughter.

FU TING raises his gun, firing into the concrete beside her head. He empties a blood pack across her vest.

FU TING
I had no choice. You have to die.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

FANG NUAN lies in a hospital bed, covered with a blue and white striped blanket, eyes closed. A faded surgical scar peeks from her gown.

A woman in a pink cheongsam, LU QIANQIAN, stands beside the bed holding a baby monitor, looking at her with contempt.

LU QIANQIAN (V.O.)
Bitches have tough lives. Even this couldn't drown her.

FANG NUAN suddenly opens her eyes and leaps up from the bed, looking at LU QIANQIAN in terror.

LU QIANQIAN
(surprised)
You...

LU QIANQIAN recovers and becomes angry.

LU QIANQIAN
You dare glare at me!

LU QIANQIAN raises her hand to strike FANG NUAN. FANG NUAN quickly counterattacks, grabs LU QIANQIAN's hand, pins her down on the bed, and chokes her neck.

LU QIANQIAN
(struggling)
She'll be an orphan!

FANG NUAN
(coldly)
Who are you? Do you want to die?

LU QIANQIAN
(struggling)
Let go of me!

A man in a gray suit (MAN IN SUIT) walks into the ward holding a toddler's photo. Seeing this scene, he is shocked.

MAN IN SUIT
Lu Nuan, that's enough! Think of your daughter!

FADE OUT.

title: CEO Fu's Lucky Pampered Wife
description: A young woman is forced to sacrifice herself to save her grandmother's life, entering into a complicated arrangement with her employer's daughter's fiancé.
context:
Title: CEO Fu's Lucky Pampered Wife
Description: A young woman is forced to sacrifice herself to save her grandmother's life, entering into a complicated arrangement with her employer's daughter's fiancé.

INT. LUXURIOUS HALLWAY - TWILIGHT

JIANG YING, wrapped in a white bath towel, stands before a mahogany door. Her reflection in the mirrored wall reveals a girl drowning in fear.

ZHAO WENHUI and YU HUAN wait behind her, impatience crackling between them.

ZHAO WENHUI
Second thoughts?

JIANG YING
(timidly)
Madam, my grandmother's medication—

ZHAO WENHUI
(approaching)
Screening live from the ICU right now.

She shoves a phone forward—hospital footage. Grandma sleeps peacefully. For now.

ZHAO WENHUI
Yu Huan's generosity has limits.

INT. HOSPITAL UTILITY ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

GRANDMOTHER lies unconscious on a gurney, a PRIVATE DOCTOR poised with a syringe. JIANG YING is held back by two MEN IN BLACK.

JIANG YING
(crying out)
Grandma! I'll do anything, please!

YU HUAN watches from the corner, a vial of golden liquid in her palm.

YU HUAN
This drug—my family's patent. One course, one cure.

She crouches, gripping Jiang Ying's chin, forcing their faces side-by-side.

YU HUAN
(softly vicious)
See? Master Lao wasn't lying. You look enough like me to fool the curse. But only a virgin's qi can sever Fu Shiyan's bloodline hex. Tonight, you become my vessel.

GRANDMOTHER seizes. The doctor waits—Yu Huan's signal.

YU HUAN
Decide. Her life, or your innocence.

JIANG YING
(terrified)
What must I do?

YU HUAN
No sound. No light. Let him touch you first. Dawn breaks the spell. Break the rules, and the treatment stops. Permanently.

She presses a jade pendant into Jiang Ying's palm.

YU HUAN
Wear it. It... masks your essence.
continuation:
INT. LUXURIOUS HALLWAY - TWILIGHT (PRESENT)

ZHAO WENHUI
(sternly)
He took the draught. Won't remember. But I'll know if you break conditions. And Grandma's ventilator has an off switch.

Jiang Ying's eyes harden with desperate resolve. She nods, wipes tears, and enters.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

FU SHIYAN lies asleep, bare-chested, moonlight painting silver across his skin. He mutters in his sleep, haunted.

Jiang Ying approaches. Her V.O.:

JIANG YING (V.O.)
For Grandma. Not for them. For her.

She slips beneath the silk sheets, trembling. Her eyes trace his face—this man she's been commanded to save, through violation.

FLASHBACK IMAGE:

FU SHIYAN in a tailored suit kisses the forehead of JIANG YING in a simple white sundress—not a wedding gown. His thumb brushes a tiny scar above her eyebrow. The memory is fragmented, dreamlike.

BACK TO:
INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jiang Ying's breath catches. Did she imagine—

Fu Shiyan's hand moves. In the darkness, his fingers find her wrist. Not roughly. Gently. As if seeking something lost.

HOLD ON Jiang Ying's face—fear, hope, and terrible recognition warring in her eyes.

title: The Imperial Consort is a Man
description: A man finds himself transported to ancient times, forced into the role of an imperial consort, and desperately trying to return to his own world.
context:
Title: The Imperial Consort is a Man
Description: A man finds himself transported to ancient times, forced into the role of an imperial consort, and desperately trying to return to his own world.

INT. LUXURIOUS BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

ASSASSINS are subdued, kneeling. Their leader speaks.

ASSASSIN
Your Majesty, this lowly servant deserves death.

LI XUAN
You may all leave.

The assassins retreat. LI XUAN walks toward the bed, looking at WEI YUCHEN lying on it.

LI XUAN
Wei Yuchen.

WEI YUCHEN, wearing a red wedding dress, sits up from the bed, looking at LI XUAN with a blank expression.

LI XUAN
You were just conferred the title of Imperial Consort today. Why are you acting like this?

WEI YUCHEN
(disgusted)
What the hell? Who are you?

LI XUAN
Me? I am the sovereign of the Li Kingdom, Li Xuan.

WEI YUCHEN
(shocked)
What? You're the Emperor? Is this the Tang Dynasty or the Song Dynasty?

LI XUAN
Wei Yuchen, just now you and I were inseparable, why don't you remember me now?

WEI YUCHEN (V.O.)
I'm done for. How can I travel back? Oh right, death! If I die, I'll go back.

WEI YUCHEN gets up and runs for the sword display. Guards subdue him. He collapses.
continuation:
EXT. PAVILION - DAY

WEI YUCHEN lies on a soft couch, opens his eyes and finds himself lying in LI XUAN's arms.

WEI YUCHEN (V.O.)
I must be able to return to reality! Three, two, one!

WEI YUCHEN suddenly sits up, breaks free from LI XUAN's embrace, and stands to the side.

LI XUAN
Beloved Consort, are you still angry with me because I didn't choose you as Empress back then?

WEI YUCHEN
(impatiently)
Damn it! The way I look now, even if you made me Empress Wu Zetian, I wouldn't do it!

LI XUAN
I don't care who Empress Wu Zetian is. Beloved Consort.

LI XUAN steps forward and pulls WEI YUCHEN into his arms, their posture intimate.

LI XUAN
You are my one true love.

WEI YUCHEN
(struggling)
Your Majesty, stop flirting. We're really not suitable for each other.

EMPRESS MA enters with her MAIDS.

EMPRESS MA
Wei Yuchen! On your wedding night, you dared to assassinate His Majesty! Guards, drag him out and behead him!

GUARD (O.S.)
Yes!

WEI YUCHEN
(overjoyed)
Good, good, good!

MAIDS step forward to drag WEI YUCHEN away.

LI XUAN
(stopping them)
Wait!

title: If Love Had Another Life
description: A woman betrayed by her fiancé and sister is given a second chance when she wakes up three years in the past on her wedding day.
context:
Title: If Love Had Another Life
Description: A woman betrayed by her fiancé and sister is given a second chance when she wakes up three years in the past on her wedding day.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

YAN YAN is covered in wounds and blood, lying on the cold ground. SHI YUAN stands before her in a suit vest, cold and indifferent.

YAN YAN
(crying, weak)
Shi Yuan... Shi Yuan... please save me! I did everything for you!

SHI YUAN kicks YAN YAN away as she crawls toward him.

YAN YAN
(screaming in pain)
Ah!

SHI YUAN
(cruelly)
You were a convenient asset. Now you're just loose ends.

YAN YAN
(crying, disbelief)

SHI YUAN
(sneering)
Your sister was always the smarter choice.

The sound of high heels. WEN QIAN walks in wearing a sharp black dress, standing beside SHI YUAN and caressing his chest.

YAN YAN
(shocked)
Sister...

FLASHBACK:

INT. LI CORPORATION - DAY

Young YAN YAN downloads files onto a drive in a glass office. SHI YUAN watches over her shoulder.

SHI YUAN
(whispering)
Those merger documents will ruin Li Si Han. Perfect.

YAN YAN
(eyes full of love)
For us, I'll do anything.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

YAN YAN lies on the ground, realization dawning.

YAN YAN
(softly, broken)

title: Guardian Heavenly Venerable
description: A legendary warrior who was cast out returns to ordinary life as a delivery driver, only to be found by his former subordinates on the eve of his wedding.
context:
Title: Guardian Heavenly Venerable
Description: A legendary warrior who was cast out returns to ordinary life as a delivery driver, only to be found by his former subordinates on the eve of his wedding.

EXT. NIGHT MARKET - NIGHT

A man in a flowered shirt (FLOWERED SHIRT MAN) blocks LONG YUAN, who is wearing a delivery uniform.

FLOWERED SHIRT MAN
Two hundred fifty bucks?

FLOWERED SHIRT MAN
That's what you bring to my wedding?

FLOWERED SHIRT MAN
(to his girlfriend beside him)
This is the guy who was supposed to be my best man.

LONG YUAN holds out the money.

LONG YUAN
It's all I have.

FLOWERED SHIRT MAN
(taking the money)
Keep it.

FLOWERED SHIRT MAN
(to LONG YUAN)
Don't come tomorrow. You'll just embarrass yourself.

FLOWERED SHIRT MAN
(to GIRLFRIEND)
Let's go. Some people never change.

FLOWERED SHIRT MAN leaves with his arm around his GIRLFRIEND.

LONG YUAN looks at the money in his hand, then at his phone: a text reading "WEDDING GIFT SECURED."

EXT. HIGHWAY - NIGHT

LONG YUAN stops by the roadside. He checks his delivery bag: one last order.

Several motorcycles speed past. One SNATCHES a woman's bag.

LONG YUAN sees this and immediately gets on his electric scooter.

LONG YUAN cuts through a narrow alley, emerges ahead of the motorcyclist, and swings his delivery bag.

The motorcyclist crashes. LONG YUAN retrieves the bag.

LONG YUAN
(returning the bag to the WOMAN)

FEMALE MOTORCYCLIST
(to the other bikers)
Did he just...?

BIKER A
That was military interception protocol.

BIKER B
For a guy in a delivery uniform?

Suddenly, a convoy of luxury cars arrives.

FEMALE MOTORCYCLIST
(surprised)
Who orders a convoy to a highway?

A woman in a red dress (RED DRESS WOMAN) gets out.
continuation:
RED DRESS WOMAN
(to the bikers)
Leave.

The bikers scatter.

WHITE SUIT MAN gets out of another car.

WHITE SUIT MAN and RED DRESS WOMAN approach LONG YUAN.

WHITE SUIT MAN
Heavenly Venerable.

LONG YUAN
Don't.

LONG YUAN starts his scooter. The convoy blocks him.

RED DRESS WOMAN
The Council fell. Asura was a setup.

LONG YUAN
Then you don't need me.

WHITE SUIT MAN
Your unit is being held at the border.

WHITE SUIT MAN
They won't break. But they will listen to you.

LONG YUAN looks at his phone: a picture of his fiancée.

LONG YUAN
I have different responsibilities now.

RED DRESS WOMAN
(bowing)
Then we'll wait. At your wedding.

LONG YUAN speeds away. The White Suit Man and Red Dress Woman watch.

WHITE SUIT MAN
(to Red Dress Woman)
He'll come. When he sees the price.

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

LONG YUAN, wearing a suit, stands with his BRIDE.

OFFICIANT
If anyone objects, speak now--

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(standing)
I don't object. I clarify.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(walking forward)
My daughter received a gift this morning.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(showing her phone)
An anonymous deposit. Five hundred thousand.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(eyes on Long Yuan)
The note said "For the Heavenly Venerable's bride."

The BRIDE looks at LONG YUAN, shocked.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
So. Which wedding are you actually attending today?

title: After Flash Marriage to a Tycoon
description: A woman leaves her ungrateful husband after years of sacrifice, while her sister discovers his true nature.
context:
Title: After Flash Marriage to a Tycoon
Description: A woman leaves her ungrateful husband after years of sacrifice, while her sister discovers his true nature.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The penthouse reeks of stale whiskey. ZHOU DONGNING, 45, slumps on the leather sofa, his designer shirt unbuttoned, a crystal tumbler dangling from his fingers. The shattered remains of a photo frame—his wife and child—lies on the marble floor.

Footsteps. LIN YING, 28, appears, her face set. She surveys the wreckage, then walks forward and takes the glass.

LIN YING
Brother-in-law. The lawyers are waiting for your signature.

ZHOU DONGNING
(laughs bitterly)
She's really doing it. The woman I pulled from nothing.

LIN YING
She built your life. You built her cage.

ZHOU DONGNING
(drunkenly)
Your sister... used to be so grateful. Now she thinks stretch marks entitle her to half my empire.

LIN YING
She hasn't slept through the night in five years. She doesn't recognize her own reflection. You did that.

ZHOU DONGNING
I gave her everything! This apartment, that brat's tuition. All she had to do was stay quiet and pretty.

LIN YING
(quietly furious)
She was. You stopped seeing her.

ZHOU DONGNING stands, swaying. He pours another drink, his back to her.

ZHOU DONGNING
You always defend her. So loyal. So... young.

He turns, his gaze crawling over her.

ZHOU DONGNING
She's across town now, isn't she? In that shitty rental. Maybe I should visit. Remind her what she's losing.

LIN YING blocks him, phone raised.

LIN YING
Restraining order drops tonight if you do. Try me.

ZHOU DONGNING's face darkens. He lunges, grabbing her wrist.

ZHOU DONGNING
You've lived here six months. Ate my food. Let me pay for your degree. Time for interest.
continuation:
LIN YING
(struggling)
I paid rent. I cooked. I cleaned—

ZHOU DONGNING pushes her back onto the sofa, his breath hot with alcohol and entitlement.

ZHOU DONGNING
—And you watched me. Judged me. Thought you were better than her.

LIN YING's hand finds the marble lamp base. She swings.

The shatter echoes. ZHOU DONGNING crumples, blood seeping between his fingers.

LIN YING stands over him, breathing hard, her voice shaking with adrenaline and disgust.

LIN YING
You don't get to touch either of us again.

At the door, she pauses, knuckles white on the frame.

LIN YING
(quietly)
She was right. You were never a tycoon. Just a man who bought what he couldn't earn.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

AN LIN, 35, stands before a mirror in a sparsely furnished room, smoothing a simple dress. Her daughter sleeps on a mattress on the floor. She's still bruised under her eyes, but her spine is straight.

LIN YING enters, spots the blood on her sleeve, quickly rolls it down.

AN LIN
(softly)
Did he sign?

LIN YING
He'll sign tomorrow. Or we go to court.

AN LIN looks at her sister's face, sees the truth. She takes LIN YING's hands.

AN LIN
What did you do?

LIN YING
What you couldn't. What I should have done months ago.

AN LIN pulls her into a fierce hug, her voice breaking.

AN LIN
We're free now. Both of us.

The two women hold each other in the silence of their new beginning.

title: Endless Purgatory
description: Dragon Emperor breaks free from the Endless Purgatory after three years of imprisonment and torture, only to discover his master has arranged nine marriage contracts for him.
context:
Title: Fox Demon
Description: Dragon Emperor breaks free from the Endless Purgatory after three years of imprisonment and torture, only to discover his master has arranged nine marriage contracts for him.

INT. MISTY POOL - NIGHT

In a pool shrouded in smoke, a woman in red wearing a mask (FOX DEMON) plays in the water, her voice echoing like a memory.

Title: Endless Purgatory

INT. DARK CELL - NIGHT

A disheveled man with ethereal chains binding his wrists (DRAGON EMPEROR) crouches in isolation. A man wearing an ornate mask (WUTIAN) materializes in the shadows above.

FOX DEMON (V.O.)
(whispering seductively)
Just surrender, Qin Yang. Three years is enough.

DRAGON EMPEROR (V.O.)
(strained)
Dragon Emperor... never breaks.

The FOX DEMON appears behind the DRAGON EMPEROR, wrapping ghostly arms around his neck, her breath cold against his ear.

FOX DEMON
Let go. I'll make the pain stop.

The DRAGON EMPEROR's eyes flicker, his resolve wavering for a heartbeat. Then his gaze hardens.

DRAGON EMPEROR
Get away!

The DRAGON EMPEROR releases a burst of pure will, shattering the FOX DEMON's illusion. The phantom dissipates into mist. He collapses forward, the spiritual chains glowing brighter.

INT. BURNING CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Two GUARDS drag a man wearing a muzzle mask, bound in physical chains (BLACK EMPEROR), through a corridor lined with fire basins.

GUARD
Move! The Hall Master waits!

Title: Black Emperor

The BLACK EMPEROR is shoved before a group of men in black. Alarm bells toll in the distance.

The BLACK EMPEROR suddenly breaks his restraints, using the chains as weapons. He moves with brutal precision, his strikes fueled by desperation. He defeats all of them, but hesitates, looking toward the prison depths.
continuation:
INT. PRISON - NIGHT

A man hangs suspended by spiritual chains, then is slammed heavily to the ground. The Dark Hall Master WUTIAN stands nearby, examining his fingernails.

WUTIAN (V.O.)
Your loyalty is touching. But your master has suffered enough for today.

The BLACK EMPEROR kneels on the ground, his voice muffled behind the mask.

BLACK EMPEROR
(voice muffled)
Hall Master, I only wanted to test his limits. Forgive me.

WUTIAN laughs, the sound echoing off stone walls.

WUTIAN
Test? You'll have your chance. When he's broken.

INT. MISTY CELL - NIGHT

Title: Dragon Emperor's Golden Sword

The DRAGON EMPEROR sits in meditation, his eyes burning with determination. The Fox Demon's whispers fade from his mind.

DRAGON EMPEROR
Three years of voices. Today, they end.

The DRAGON EMPEROR focuses his core energy. The spiritual chains on his hands shatter. A white sword hilt materializes before him—his manifested will. He grasps it, and a light sword blazes to life.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

WUTIAN and the BLACK EMPEROR walk through a warehouse littered with corpses—the failed challengers.

WUTIAN
Mere rebels. They thought they could free him.

A blinding golden light floods the room. The DRAGON EMPEROR, wearing radiant armor and wielding his light sword, blocks their path. His presence is vast, overwhelming.

WUTIAN
(terrified)
The... the Dragon Emperor's true form!

WUTIAN falls to his knees, his mask cracking.

DRAGON EMPEROR
Wutian. You were my warden. Now you're just a witness.

WUTIAN
(trembling)
It was the Elder's orders! I had no choice!

BLACK EMPEROR
(voice muffled)
Master, he's still weakened! We can—

DRAGON EMPEROR
(coldly)
You've mistaken your master.

BLACK EMPEROR charges, chains whirling. The DRAGON EMPEROR deflects with a single precise strike. The BLACK EMPEROR's mask splits; he falls, his energy dissipated.

WUTIAN crawls backward, pleading.

WUTIAN
Spare me! I only guarded the prison!

DRAGON EMPEROR
You enjoyed it.

The DRAGON EMPEROR swings his sword. A flash of sword light cuts through WUTIAN's defenses. WUTIAN falls, dissolving into shadow.

A woman in a black qipao (QINGFENG) arrives with a group of people in black. They kneel before the DRAGON EMPEROR.

Title: Qingfeng

QINGFENG
Dragon Emperor. We felt your breakthrough. The Elder's arrangements...

She presents a red box with both hands. The DRAGON EMPEROR's sword vanishes.

DRAGON EMPEROR
What is this?

QINGFENG
Nine marriage contracts. To bind the fractured realms. Your final trial.

The DRAGON EMPEROR's face shows an expression of weary disbelief.

DRAGON EMPEROR
I just escaped one prison.

The DRAGON EMPEROR focuses his core energy. The spiritual chains on his hands shatter. A white sword hilt materializes before him—his manifested will. He grasps it, and a light sword blazes to life.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

WUTIAN and the BLACK EMPEROR walk through a warehouse littered with corpses—the failed challengers.

WUTIAN
Mere rebels. They thought they could free him.

A blinding golden light floods the room. The DRAGON EMPEROR, wearing radiant armor and wielding his light sword, blocks their path. His presence is vast, overwhelming.

WUTIAN
(terrified)
The... the Dragon Emperor's true form!

WUTIAN falls to his knees, his mask cracking.

DRAGON EMPEROR
Wutian. You were my warden. Now you're just a witness.

WUTIAN
(trembling)
It was the Elder's orders! I had no choice!

BLACK EMPEROR
(voice muffled)
Master, he's still weakened! We can—

DRAGON EMPEROR
(coldly)
You've mistaken your master.

BLACK EMPEROR charges, chains whirling. The DRAGON EMPEROR deflects with a single precise strike. The BLACK EMPEROR's mask splits; he falls, his energy dissipated.

WUTIAN crawls backward, pleading.

WUTIAN
Spare me! I only guarded the prison!

DRAGON EMPEROR
You enjoyed it.

The DRAGON EMPEROR swings his sword. A flash of sword light cuts through WUTIAN's defenses. WUTIAN falls, dissolving into shadow.

A woman in a black qipao (QINGFENG) arrives with a group of people in black. They kneel before the DRAGON EMPEROR.

Title: Qingfeng

QINGFENG
Dragon Emperor. We felt your breakthrough. The Elder's arrangements...

She presents a red box with both hands. The DRAGON EMPEROR's sword vanishes.

DRAGON EMPEROR
What is this?

QINGFENG
Nine marriage contracts. To bind the fractured realms. Your final trial.

The DRAGON EMPEROR's face shows an expression of weary disbelief.

DRAGON EMPEROR
I just escaped one prison.

title: Purple Qi from the East
description: A hidden god-level figure has secretly helped his wife build a billion-dollar fortune over three years of marriage, and now prepares to reveal his true identity.

Title: Purple Qi from the East
Description: A hidden god-level figure has secretly helped his wife build a billion-dollar fortune over three years of marriage, and now prepares to reveal his true identity.

EXT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - DAY

SHEN ZHUO holds a bouquet of pink roses, smiling as he waits.

SHEN ZHUO (V.O.)
Three years in the shadows. Today, I step into the light.

WANG BAICHUAN, a middle-aged man in a suit with graying hair, walks up quickly and kneels on one knee before SHEN ZHUO.

WANG BAICHUAN
God Lord, Old Madam Song has taken your Life Extension Pill—her illness is cured. Tonight's charity banquet includes a one-billion-yuan partnership signing with your wife, Lin Qingxin. Old Madam requests your attendance.

SHEN ZHUO
Rise.

WANG BAICHUAN stands up.

WANG BAICHUAN
She wishes to thank you in person and witness the ceremony alongside you.

SHEN ZHUO
The Song family knows their place. I'll be there.

SHEN ZHUO (V.O.)
With this final partnership, Qingxin's freedom is complete. Our life together begins tonight.

SHEN ZHUO
Wang Baichuan, two things. First, announce the Temple of Heaven's return to Daxia. Convene the Heavenly God Banquet—every top family must attend. Second, buy Mountain Water Manor's Villa One and prepare gifts. Deliver them to tonight's banquet.

WANG BAICHUAN
The Heavenly God Banquet? God Lord, won't this shake all of Daxia to its core?
continuation:
SHEN ZHUO
Let it shake. I reveal myself to Qingxin tonight and let her receive everyone's blessings.

WANG BAICHUAN
God Lord, the best villa district in Yunzhou is Mountain Water Manor. It's divided into three tiers: mountain foot, mountainside, and mountaintop. The best and most prestigious is naturally the Villa Number One on the east side of the mountaintop. It's called Purple Qi from the East.

WANG BAICHUAN
I will go buy it right away. I take my leave now.

WANG BAICHUAN turns and leaves.

A blue Porsche speeds up and stops at the roadside. The door opens, and SONG ZHANYAN, a fashionably dressed young woman, gets out and walks toward SHEN ZHUO.

SONG ZHANYAN
Let me introduce myself. I'm Song Zhanyan, twenty-four years old, Stanford double degree PhD, currently Executive President of Song Group. Annual income? One billion. Car? You see it. House? A detached villa in the mountainside section of Mountain Water Manor.

SONG ZHANYAN
(looking SHEN ZHUO up and down)
Your turn to introduce yourself.

SHEN ZHUO
Ah? Oh, my name is Shen Zhuo, twenty-five years old. Education? None. Work? Currently unemployed. Income? Five hundred a month in pocket money. Car... I usually ride an electric scooter. Healthy, environmentally friendly, and good exercise. House? Don't have one yet, but I've already asked a friend to look into it.

SONG ZHANYAN
No job, no education, earning five hundred a month and want to buy a house? You're really poor and naive.

SHEN ZHUO
(confused)
What?

SONG ZHANYAN
Forget it. It's urgent, I'll just make do with you. Come on, let's go register and get married.

SONG ZHANYAN turns and walks away, leaving SHEN ZHUO stunned.

title: Mute Heiress
description: On a stormy night, a desperate mother makes a heartbreaking decision to abandon her mute daughter to save her from an abusive father—hoping the jade heirloom will reveal her true lineage.
context:
Title: Mute Heiress
Description: On a stormy night, a desperate mother makes a heartbreaking decision to abandon her mute daughter to save her from an abusive father—hoping the jade heirloom will reveal her true lineage.

INT. HOME - NIGHT

A night of thunder and rain.

SHEN TANG (30s, bruised) looks ahead in terror. FATHER (40s, drunk) storms in.

Little girl NIU NIU (6, silent) clings to her mother SHEN TANG in fear.

Thunder roars.

FATHER
(roaring)
The matchmaker returned the bride price! Six years wasted on a mute girl!

FATHER lunges at SHEN TANG and strikes her.

SHEN TANG
(struggling)
She's your daughter!

NIU NIU signs frantically.

FATHER
(yelling at NIU NIU)
Don't you dare beg!

FATHER tries to grab NIU NIU. SHEN TANG desperately protects her daughter.

SHEN TANG
Let go! Let go of her!

In the violent struggle, SHEN TANG is pushed down and hits the cabinet.

FATHER
(to NIU NIU)
Worthless child!

SHEN TANG struggles to her feet, grabs a bottle from the cabinet, and smashes it against FATHER'S head.

FATHER falls to the ground, unconscious.

NIU NIU trembles, signing: "Mama, hurt?"

SHEN TANG rushes over and embraces her daughter.

SHEN TANG
(whispering)
He'll wake soon. We have to run.

SHEN TANG carries NIU NIU and leaves. Two enamel cups with double happiness characters sit on the cabinet.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Heavy rain pours down. SHEN TANG walks through the rain with NIU NIU, settling her on a stone bench.

NIU NIU
(sign language)
Mama, where is this?

SHEN TANG
(choking)
Good people will find you here. Wait for Mama.

SHEN TANG hugs her daughter tightly, tears streaming down her face.

SHEN TANG
Show them this jade pendant. You're the Chen heir.

NIU NIU nods.

SHEN TANG
(crying)
If kind people come... go with them.

NIU NIU
(sign language)
Don't cry. Niu Niu will be good.

SHEN TANG puts the jade pendant in NIU NIU'S hand.

SHEN TANG
Mama... Mama is sorry.

SHEN TANG kisses NIU NIU'S forehead, steels herself, stands up, and turns to leave.

She looks back at her daughter sitting alone on the stone bench.

SHEN TANG (V.O.)
Niu Niu, don't blame Mama.

SHEN TANG'S eyes become hollow and resigned as she walks forward in the rain.

SHEN TANG (V.O.)
This is the only way to break the cycle.

Little NIU NIU sits alone on the street in the rainy night, clutching the pendant.

title: The Medical Emperor Returns Invincible
description: A powerful medical master uses ancient techniques to cure the incurable and faces challenges from his past, including an arranged marriage.
context:
Title: The Medical Emperor Returns Invincible
Description: A powerful medical master uses ancient techniques to cure the incurable and faces challenges from his past, including an arranged marriage.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

LING YUNLONG, a young man in a white traditional Chinese robe, sits cross-legged. Across from him, ELDER ZHU trembles, sweat beading on his forehead. Something WRITHES beneath the skin of his cheeks.

ELDER ZHU
(whispered)
It moves... when I sleep.

LING YUNLONG forms hand seals. Golden light collects at his fingertips like dew, then drifts into Elder Zhu's eyes—not as attack, but as question.

LING YUNLONG
(quietly)
Southern Border Gu sorcery. Third variation.

LING YUNLONG
The host lives seven days. The parasite lives forever. Which will you be?

EXT. FORBIDDEN LAND - NIGHT

Ling Yunlong's translucent figure appears in this shadow-realm echo of the room.

GU WOMAN (30s, sharp features, red robes like drying blood) appears with MASKED SUBORDINATES. They take defensive stance.

GU WOMAN
You don't belong here, Medical Emperor. This soul is claimed.

LING YUNLONG
And you don't belong in the living world. Your master still using orphans?

The Gu Woman attacks, hands flickering green venom-light. Ling Yunlong steps through attacks like avoiding raindrops. Deflections economical, almost gentle.

LING YUNLONG
(voice quiet)
I taught him this technique. Before he broke it.

His palm barely touches her chest. She flies back—from shock, not force.

GU WOMAN
(gasping)
You... you're the one—

INT. GHOST DOCTOR'S PAVILION - NIGHT

GHOST DOCTOR (50s, surgeon's hands, grave-robber eyes) coughs blood. Jewel-like Gu insect on table CRACKS, leaks black fluid. Portrait slips from his sleeve—child him beside younger Ling Yunlong.

GHOST DOCTOR
(choked whisper)
So... you remember...

He slides to floor, dead.
continuation:
EXT. FORBIDDEN LAND - NIGHT

Ling Yunlong holds energy needle over fallen Gu Woman. It trembles in his hand.

LING YUNLONG
Your master is dead. The Gu dies with him. But you—

He looks at her with pity.

LING YUNLONG
What will you die for?

Needle dissolves. He extends hand instead.

GU WOMAN
You're... sparing me?

LING YUNLONG
I don't kill students of medicine. Even broken ones.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

Ling Yunlong gasps, eyes snap open. His hands shake slightly. Elder Zhu's face is clear, normal.

Elder Zhu bows deeply, the gesture of one emperor to another.

ELDER ZHU
The Medicine King said you were... different.

LING YUNLONG
(steadying his breathing)
Your payment is the Zhu family scrolls. Originals.

ELDER ZHU
We have billions, mansions—

LING YUNLONG
—I need a library, not a tomb.

He stands, revealing weariness beneath the power.

LING YUNLONG
Tell my disciple his homework is late.

EXT. HEAVENLY GATE - DAY

Ling Yunlong walks through an archway reading "Miraculous Healing Hands." Weathered, barely visible.

SENIOR DISCIPLE and JUNIOR DISCIPLE wait at attention.

SENIOR DISCIPLE
The council asks—will you take your seat?

LING YUNLONG
(sweeping dust from the stoop)
I left because they sat while people died.

JUNIOR DISCIPLE
The Gate opening? The century—

LING YUNLONG
—opens for those who need it, not those who can pay.

He hands broom to Junior Disciple.

LING YUNLONG
Sweep here. Learn more than in council.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

Convoy stops. YUAN LING, a young woman in a white lace qipao, exits surrounded by BLACK-SUITED BODYGUARDS.

EXT. HEAVENLY GATE ENTRANCE - DAY

Ling Yunlong washes hands in a basin. Yuan Ling's shadow falls across the water.

YUAN LING
(sizing him up)
You look like a janitor.

LING YUNLONG
I look like someone who cleans messes.

YUAN LING
Our families promised. Promises are chains.

She drops red box. It lands heavy, final.

YUAN LING
I forge my own chains now.

Ling Yunlong watches her turn to leave. Not surprised—resigned.

LING YUNLONG
Your brother's Gu poisoning. I removed it last month.

Yuan Ling freezes. Shoulders tense.

LING YUNLONG
The box is empty, Yuan Ling. It always was.

She doesn't turn back. Step falters, just slightly.

LING YUNLONG
(softly)
So are we.

He picks up box, weighs it in hand, sets aside. Water in basin still ripples from her shadow.

title: Burning Love
description: A woman's daughter needs an emergency blood transfusion, but she desperately tries to prevent her wealthy former guardian from donating, hiding a dangerous secret.
context:
Title: Burning Love
Description: A woman's daughter needs an emergency blood transfusion, but she desperately tries to prevent her wealthy former guardian from donating, hiding a dangerous secret.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Close-up of HOSPITAL BED WHEELS racing across linoleum, BLURRED and SHAKING.

SHI HUAN (O.S.)
Yueyue! Yueyue!

SHI HUAN pushes the bed, sprinting through the corridor. YUEYUE (6), pale and fragile, lies unconscious.

SHI HUAN
Stay with me, baby. Please.

INT. HOSPITAL NURSES' STATION - DAY

NURSE (without looking up)
Surgery deposit: five hundred thousand. We can't proceed without it.

SHI HUAN freezes, her knuckles white on the counter. SHEN YAN (30s, tailored suit) appears beside her, producing a BLACK CARD.

SHEN YAN
Charge it.

The nurse swipes the card. SHI HUAN's reflection shows in the glass partition—anguish written across her face.

SHI HUAN (voice trembling)
Brother... I'll repay every cent.

SHEN YAN
Charity for a beggar. Consider it a parting gift.

SHI HUAN flinches as if struck. Her fingers dig into her worn handbag.

SHEN YAN
You walked away from the Shen family five years ago. Is this the life you chose?

SHI HUAN
(staring at the floor)
The best decision I ever made.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

JIAN SHEN (30s, construction worker) hurries over with a TUPPERWARE BOWL.

JIAN SHEN
Huanhuan, you need to eat. Plain porridge—your stomach can't handle more.

He presses it into her hands. SHI HUAN manages a grateful smile between spoonfuls. SHEN YAN watches from twenty feet away, his gaze glacial.

SHEN YAN (V.O.)
The girl I raised on Château Lafite and winter truffles now eats cold porridge in a hospital corridor. Shi Huan, was your freedom worth this?

His hand tightens around his phone until the screen cracks.

NURSE (rushing over)
Miss Shi! We're critically low on irradiated Type O blood. Pediatric protocol requires screened directed donors—banked supplies could compromise her.

SHEN YAN (removing his jacket, rolling up his sleeve)
I'm Type O. Screen mine.

SHI HUAN (dropping the bowl)
No! Brother, you can't donate!

SHEN YAN (sneering)
You'd rather she die than owe me?

SHI HUAN (to NURSE)
His medical history—he takes suppressants for a condition. It would show up in screening.

NURSE
We can work around most—

SHI HUAN (cutting her off)
Please! Just give me an hour to find another donor! His blood would complicate everything!

She turns. SHEN YAN seizes her wrist, yanking her close.

SHEN YAN
What are you so afraid they'll find in my blood?

JIAN SHEN shoves between them, forcing SHEN YAN's grip to break.

JIAN SHEN
She said no. Back off.

The two men lock eyes. SHEN YAN's expression shifts from rage to cold calculation.

SHEN YAN
(quietly, to Shi Huan)
This isn't about blood. You never could lie to me.

He pulls a DNA TEST KIT from his jacket pocket.

SHEN YAN
I'll have the answer in twenty-four hours. With or without your permission.

He walks away. SHI HUAN collapses against the wall. JIAN SHEN steadies her as the Nurse watches, suspicion dawning.

JIAN SHEN (30s, construction worker) hurries over with a TUPPERWARE BOWL.

JIAN SHEN
Huanhuan, you need to eat. Plain porridge—your stomach can't handle more.

He presses it into her hands. SHI HUAN manages a grateful smile between spoonfuls. SHEN YAN watches from twenty feet away, his gaze glacial.

SHEN YAN (V.O.)
The girl I raised on Château Lafite and winter truffles now eats cold porridge in a hospital corridor. Shi Huan, was your freedom worth this?

His hand tightens around his phone until the screen cracks.

NURSE (rushing over)
Miss Shi! We're critically low on irradiated Type O blood. Pediatric protocol requires screened directed donors—banked supplies could compromise her.

SHEN YAN (removing his jacket, rolling up his sleeve)
I'm Type O. Screen mine.

SHI HUAN (dropping the bowl)
No! Brother, you can't donate!

SHEN YAN (sneering)
You'd rather she die than owe me?

SHI HUAN (to NURSE)
His medical history—he takes suppressants for a condition. It would show up in screening.

NURSE
We can work around most—

SHI HUAN (cutting her off)
Please! Just give me an hour to find another donor! His blood would complicate everything!

She turns. SHEN YAN seizes her wrist, yanking her close.

SHEN YAN
What are you so afraid they'll find in my blood?

JIAN SHEN shoves between them, forcing SHEN YAN's grip to break.

JIAN SHEN
She said no. Back off.

The two men lock eyes. SHEN YAN's expression shifts from rage to cold calculation.

SHEN YAN
(quietly, to Shi Huan)
This isn't about blood. You never could lie to me.

He pulls a DNA TEST KIT from his jacket pocket.

SHEN YAN
I'll have the answer in twenty-four hours. With or without your permission.

He walks away. SHI HUAN collapses against the wall. JIAN SHEN steadies her as the Nurse watches, suspicion dawning.

title: Underworld Chat Group
description: A morgue attendant flirts with a girl online late at night, only to discover she is a ghost from a corpse delivered the day before.
context:
Title: Underworld Chat Group
Description: A morgue attendant flirts with a girl online late at night, only to discover she is a ghost from a corpse delivered the day before.

INT. FUNERAL HOME - NIGHT

Inside the quiet funeral home, the lighting is ghostly blue. ZHOU YAN, a young morgue attendant in a white coat, sits on a metal stool, gazing at his phone.

ZHOU YAN
(softly)
Those photos... it's been so long since someone smiled at me like that.

He clears his throat and sends a voice message.

ZHOU YAN (V.O.)
Hey, you seem really cool. Want to meet sometime? I'm off at dawn.

He sends the voice message and quickly receives a reply.

TONG'ER (V.O.)
A good guy? Then I'll come find you right now.

ZHOU YAN
(startled)
Wait—now?

He hurriedly sends another voice message.

ZHOU YAN (V.O.)
It's 3 AM, and I'm at work. The funeral home on East River Road.

His phone receives another voice message from TONG'ER.

TONG'ER (V.O.)
I know. Number 36. I arrived yesterday, too. So fated, big brother.

ZHOU YAN's expression shifts. He stares toward the cold storage.

ZHOU YAN
(whispering)
Yesterday... only delivery was that accident victim...

He suddenly realizes, looking around, his eyes widening.

ZHOU YAN
(panicking)
continuation:
No... this is a prank. Has to be.

He rushes to the door and finds it won't open. His phone receives another message.

TONG'ER (V.O.)
Big brother, why aren't you replying? Please don't leave me alone.

The lights begin to flicker, and an eerie voice echoes through the room.

TONG'ER (ghostly voice)
I'm so cold. Let me hold you.

ZHOU YAN cowers by the door, trembling all over.

ZHOU YAN
(trembling)
Stay away! I'm not afraid!

TONG'ER (ghostly voice)
Working alone must be lonely. I'll keep you company.

A pale white hand extends from under the door gap and grabs ZHOU YAN's ankle.

ZHOU YAN
(screaming)
Ahhhhh!

The screen goes black.

EXT. NAIHE BRIDGE - NIGHT

The scene shifts to a bridge shrouded in mist with flickering green light. BLACK AND WHITE IMPERMANENCE and other ghost officers roam the bridge. ZHOU YAN stumbles onto the bridge, his phone clutched in hand, and falls to the ground before the stone monument.

ZHOU YAN
(whispering)
Naihe Bridge... from her profile picture...

He sees the stone monument at the bridge head.

ZHOU YAN
(shocked)
She wasn't inviting me out... she was inviting me here.

A white light flashes, and ZHOU YAN disappears. His phone clatters to the stone, screen still showing their chat log. The last message reads: "Welcome home."

SCENE END
