title: Baby's Arrival: No Escape
description: A woman pregnant with a powerful CEO's child becomes the target of a deadly conspiracy, forcing her to flee for her life and protect her unborn baby.
context:
Title: Baby's Arrival: No Escape
Description: A woman pregnant with a powerful CEO's child becomes the target of a deadly conspiracy, forcing her to flee for her life and protect her unborn baby.

INT. CEO SHEN'S OFFICE - DAY

ASSISTANT CHEN stands before SHEN QILUO's desk, holding a medical file.

ASSISTANT CHEN
Mr. Shen, we've located Miss Bai. The private clinic forwarded her records—she's twenty-three weeks pregnant. The paternity test confirms...

SHEN QILUO
(cutting him off, voice tight)
I don't need the details.

(beat, staring out window)
The woman who got my sister killed... now carrying my child. The irony.

ASSISTANT CHEN
The board is already asking questions. If this goes public before we contain it—

SHEN QILUO
Contain it. Her, the situation, all of it. Have security monitor her movements. I want weekly updates, not daily dramas.

ASSISTANT CHEN
Understood, sir.

INT. COMPANY HALLWAY - DAY

MU YUAN watches Assistant Chen leave Shen's office. Her knuckles whiten around her phone.

MU YUAN (V.O.)
So she kept the baby. How... resourceful. But Brother Qiluo's eyes are finally open to her betrayal. Now I just need to remove the evidence.
continuation:
INT. PRIVATE CLINIC OPERATING ROOM - DAY

BAI SHUANG lies on the bed, woozy from mild sedation. DR. LIU approaches with a clipboard, a NURSE prepares a syringe.

BAI SHUANG
Doctor? What's happening? I came for a routine checkup—

DR. LIU
Your test results show severe abnormalities. We need to terminate immediately to save your life. The father already consented.

BAI SHUANG
(eyes widening, fully alert)
What? No—he wouldn't—my baby is healthy! I saw the ultrasound!

The NURSE moves to restrain her. Bai Shuang's maternal instinct triggers—she kicks the tray, sending instruments flying, elbows Dr. Liu in the jaw. The sedation makes her clumsy but desperate.

INT. PRIVATE CLINIC CORRIDOR - DAY

BAI SHUANG stumbles from the room, clutching her belly, hospital gown flapping. Her bare feet slap against the linoleum. DR. LIU scrambles after her, forehead bleeding.

DR. LIU
Stop her! She's having a psychotic episode! Call security!

BAI SHUANG slams the elevator button. A patient's family member stares, confused. The doors close just as Dr. Liu reaches them. He pounds the metal, then whips out his phone.

EXT. PRIVATE CLINIC PARKING LOT - DAY

BAI SHUANG emerges, disoriented, into the afternoon light. She hears shouts behind her. She runs for the tree line at the property's edge.

INT. PRIVATE CLINIC RECEPTION - DAY

DR. LIU cups his hand around the phone, voice low and venomous.

DR. LIU
She's heading for the service road behind the property. She's drugged—she won't get far. Send your team now.

MU YUAN (O.S.)
(phone voice, icily calm)
Finish what you started, or I'll finish you. Don't disappoint me again.

INT. ABANDONED PARKING GARAGE - DAY

BAI SHUANG collapses behind a rusted sedan, gasping. The sedative blurs her vision. She feels a sharp cramp—panic seizes her.

BAI SHUANG
(not a scream—a whispered prayer)
Stay with me, little one. Please.

Boots echo on concrete. Someone approaches slowly, deliberately.

MYSTERIOUS WOMAN (O.S.)
You always were too stubborn for your own good, Shuang.

BAI SHUANG looks up in terror at the person who has arrived.

FADE OUT.

title: Betrayal and Rebirth
description: A woman who sacrificed everything for her boyfriend discovers his affair with a wealthy heiress on his birthday, leading to a heartbreaking confrontation.
context:
Title: Betrayal and Rebirth
Description: A woman who sacrificed everything for her boyfriend discovers his affair with a wealthy heiress on his birthday, leading to a heartbreaking confrontation.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

SU YAO enters carrying a cake box, her face glowing with anticipation.

SU YAO (V.O.)
Just made it home before his meeting ends. The matcha cake from that bakery he loves. He'll think I forgot—

A muffled giggle comes from the bedroom. Su Yao freezes. The cake box slips from her fingers, landing with a dull thud.

SONG RUYI (O.S.)
—so different from what I'm used to. Refreshing.

JIANG HE (O.S.)
Five years of playing the good boyfriend. You have no idea.

Su Yao's face goes pale.

JIANG HE (O.S.) (CONT'D)
She's probably at the clinic right now, dreaming about our wedding.

She moves toward the door.

INT. BEDROOM - CONTINUOUS

Jiang He sits up sharply as the door opens. SONG RUYI, adjusting a silk robe, turns with cold curiosity.

JIANG HE
Yaoyao—this isn't—

SU YAO
What it looks like?

She takes in the scene—scattered clothes, the unmade bed, the expensive perfume that isn't hers.

SONG RUYI
You're early.

Song Ruyi ties her robe, picks up a limited-edition watch from the nightstand.

SONG RUYI (CONT'D)
Jiang He was just explaining how you put him through school. Very touching.

Jiang He scrambles for his shirt.

SU YAO (to Jiang He)
The night shifts. The loans in my name. Your mother calling me her daughter—

JIANG HE
You don't understand the pressure! Song Ruyi can get me the fellowship—

SONG RUYI
Can make all his problems disappear. But first, he needs to prove he's serious.

She studies Su Yao like a specimen.
continuation:
SONG RUYI (CONT'D)
Hit her. Once. Then we can talk.

JIANG HE
What? No—

SU YAO (to Jiang He)
Don't.

She looks at Song Ruyi.

SU YAO (CONT'D)
Don't degrade yourself more.

Jiang He sees the contempt in Song Ruyi's smile, the pity in Su Yao's eyes. His hand rises.

The slap cracks across Su Yao's cheek. Her head turns, but she doesn't move.

SONG RUYI
Again. Say the words.

JIANG HE (voice breaking)
I love Song Ruyi.

Second slap.

SONG RUYI
Tell her it's over.

JIANG HE
We're done!

Third strike. Su Yao steps back, touches her lip. Looks at the blood. Then laughs—a sharp sound.

SU YAO
Five years. I thought I was building a life.

She turns, spine straight.

SU YAO (CONT'D)
Happy birthday, Jiang He.

She exits.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

SU YAO sits at the bar, a single glass in front of her. Her cheek is swollen. She twists the engagement ring off her finger.

A MAN watches from a corner booth, phone showing a news article: SONG GROUP SCANDAL.

Su Yao stands, steadies herself. Walks toward the exit, drops the ring in a tips jar.

The Man rises. Their paths intersect at the door.

Their eyes meet—his sharp with recognition, hers clear with purpose.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Substitute Tycoon
description: A wealthy family's heir is missing, and a desperate mother searches for a lookalike to prevent a illegitimate son from inheriting the family fortune.
context:
Title: Substitute Tycoon
Description: A wealthy family's heir is missing, and a desperate mother searches for a lookalike to prevent a illegitimate son from inheriting the family fortune.

INT. JIANG FAMILY MANSION - DAY

JIANG WANQING (50s), matriarch of the Jiang empire, sits rigidly before a massive wall screen.

TV NEWS (V.O.)
With Chairman Jiang's health failing, his illegitimate son Jiang Mingyu has reportedly seized a key executive role. Jiangcheng's financial landscape hangs in the balance.

Jiang Wanqing's knuckles whiten around her teacup. She sets it down with a sharp CLINK.

JIANG WANQING
(under her breath)
Mingyu...

She snatches her phone.

JIANG WANQING
(into phone)
Ruoxi. The Dragon Banquet is tonight. Our last chance.

JIANG WANQING (V.O.)
He doesn't get a single share.

EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

CHEN RUOXI (30s), the family's razor-sharp fixer, glides toward a Rolls-Royce flanked by BLACK-SUITED BODYGUARDS. She studies a tablet displaying a man's photo.

Chen Ruoxi dons a wireless earpiece and enters the vehicle.

The motorcade drives down an empty road.
continuation:
INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - DAY

CHEN RUOXI
(into earpiece)
Madam, we have a match. 98% facial recognition.

INT. JIANG FAMILY MANSION - DAY

Jiang Wanqing remains on the sofa, phone pressed to her ear.

JIANG WANQING
Bring him to the west gate. Tonight.

INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - DAY

CHEN RUOXI
Understood.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

COWORKER A shouts beside a flooded foundation pit.

COWORKER A
The drill bit's sheared off down there!

The FOREMAN runs over, cash wads in hand.

FOREMAN
Twenty thousand to whoever retrieves it!

Several workers gather, wary.

COWORKER B
That's a death sentence. You'd need a real diver.

JIANG YICHEN (late 20s), lean and weathered, pushes through the crowd.

JIANG YICHEN
I was a commercial diver. I'll go.

COWORKER A
(grabbing him)
This ain't no ocean, kid. It's liquid concrete and rebar.

JIANG YICHEN
(shaking free)
My daughters need tuition. And I know what I'm doing.

FOREMAN
(shoving the cash at him)
Prove it. Gear's in the trailer.

Yichen suits up in a worn wetsuit and battered helmet. Workers secure his safety line with calloused hands.

He drops into the murky pit. The line whirs out.

Bubbles explode to the surface. Then nothing.

FOREMAN
Hold that rope! Tight, damn it!

The water stills.

title: Secret Wife Brought Home
description: A young master searches for a woman from his past, but the one who returns seems increasingly different from the person he remembers, while a kind stranger appears who looks identical to her.
context:
Title: Secret Wife Brought Home
Description: A young master searches for a woman from his past, but the one who returns seems increasingly different from the person he remembers, while a kind stranger appears who looks identical to her.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Soft music plays.

Moonlight falls across the bed. The YOUNG MASTER touches a jade pendant resting on a WOMAN'S neck.

WOMAN
(softly)
Promise you'll remember me like this.

She closes his hand over the pendant.

INT. STUDY - DAY

The YOUNG MASTER sits at his desk, staring at the same pendant. His expression is troubled.

The ASSISTANT enters.

ASSISTANT
Young Master, we found her. She's waiting.

The RETURNING WOMAN enters, white dress pristine. Her eyes scan the room before landing on him. She touches her bare neck.

RETURNING WOMAN
(smiling)
Darling. I told you I'd come back.

The YOUNG MASTER studies her, his hand closing around the pendant. Doubt crosses his face.

INT. STUDY - DAY (FIVE YEARS LATER)

ON SCREEN: Five Years Later

The YOUNG MASTER reviews adoption papers. His phone rings repeatedly—six missed calls from "HOME." He ignores it, pouring a drink.

He glances at a photo: him, the RETURNING WOMAN, and MENGMENG (5), posed and uncomfortable. The RETURNING WOMAN's smile doesn't reach her eyes.

The phone rings again. He answers.

YOUNG MASTER
(coldly)
I'm working.

The RETURNING WOMAN'S voice comes through, sharp-edged with false concern.

RETURNING WOMAN (O.S.)
Mengmeng's fever spiked again. She's asking for you.

He sets down his glass hard.

I'll be there.

continuation:

The RETURNING WOMAN in a red dress paces, phone in hand. MENGMENG sits at the table, tear-streaked.

RETURNING WOMAN
(into phone, sweetly)
He's on his way now.

She hangs up and turns to MENGMENG, the sweetness vanishing.

RETURNING WOMAN
(sneering)
Six years of playing perfect mother. For what?

She snatches MENGMENG'S stuffed rabbit from the table.

RETURNING WOMAN
You don't even look like him.

MENGMENG reaches for the rabbit. The RETURNING WOMAN holds it just out of reach.

RETURNING WOMAN
(sharply)
If you tell him I was mean, I'll make sure you regret it.

MENGMENG snatches the rabbit and runs for the door. The RETURNING WOMAN watches her go, then smiles at her reflection.

EXT. BUILDING EXTERIOR - DAY

A KIND WOMAN in gray and white walks through the courtyard, tenant applications under her arm. She looks identical to the woman from the flashback. The jade pendant hangs at her throat.

MENGMENG runs straight into her. The KIND WOMAN steadies her, crouching.

KIND WOMAN
(startled)
Whoa, little one. Where's the fire?

MENGMENG clutches her rabbit, saying nothing.

KIND WOMAN
(softening)
Okay. Quiet is okay too.

She pulls a candy from her pocket.

KIND WOMAN
Auntie lives in 3B. You can sit with me while we find your grown-up.

MENGMENG looks at the pendant, eyes widening. She takes the candy, then buries her face in the KIND WOMAN'S shoulder.

The KIND WOMAN holds her, concerned, as the YOUNG MASTER bursts through the building doors.

YOUNG MASTER (O.S.)
MENGMENG!

The KIND WOMAN looks up. The pendant catches the light.

title: Baby Cupid, Daddy Slow Down
description: A woman faces a difficult choice to save her father, leading to a fateful encounter that changes everything.
context:
Title: Baby Cupid, Daddy Slow Down
Description: A woman faces a difficult choice to save her father, leading to a fateful encounter that changes everything.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

LU ZIHAO lounges with two MODELS, drinking.

LU ZIHAO
Drink up! Tonight's on me.

LIN RUOFEI enters, wearing a white strapless dress, and stands before him.

LU ZIHAO
(mockingly)
Lin Ruofei. Here to beg?

LIN RUOFEI
My father's surgery is tomorrow. You promised you'd help.

LU ZIHAO
Room 886 at the Four Seasons. Wash yourself clean and wait for me. Serve me well tonight, and I'll help you.

LU ZIHAO
(triumphantly)
My cousin Lu Beichen is... indisposed. I'm sure he'll appreciate the gift more than I would.

LU ZIHAO
(laughing)
Hahaha!

LIN RUOFEI silently turns and leaves.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

A FENG supports LU BEICHEN, who is unsteady on his feet.

A FENG
Master Lu! Hang in there, Master Lu.

INT. HOTEL ROOM 886 - NIGHT

A FENG helps LU BEICHEN sit on the sofa.

A FENG
Master Lu, wait here. I'll find a woman for you right away.

A FENG hurries out, leaving the door ajar.

LU BEICHEN lies on the sofa, his body burning with fever.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

LIN RUOFEI stands before Room 886, steeling her resolve.

LIN RUOFEI (V.O.)
(whispering)
Dad, I'm sorry. This is what your daughter is worth.

She takes a deep breath and pushes the ajar door open.

INT. HOTEL ROOM 886 - NIGHT

LIN RUOFEI enters the dimly lit room. LU BEICHEN rushes from the shadows and pins her against the wall.

LIN RUOFEI
(screaming)
Ah!

LU BEICHEN moves closer. They lock eyes. A flicker of recognition crosses her face—he's the benefactor who paid her university tuition years ago. He sees only a stranger.

Intimate music plays as montage shots flash of their closeness.

On the bed, LIN RUOFEI lies beneath LU BEICHEN.

LIN RUOFEI
(determined)
Don't forget what you promised me.

LU BEICHEN
(disoriented)
I won't... I won't hurt you...

LU BEICHEN kisses her neck gently, lost in his haze.

LIN RUOFEI (V.O.)
(coldly)
So be it. As long as Dad lives.

She closes her eyes. A tear rolls down her cheek—not from sorrow, but from the death of her pride.

title: Young Master Ye, Your Wife is a Celestial Goddess
description: A celestial goddess is framed for theft and banished to the mortal realm, where she must find a sacred jade to prove her innocence.
context:
Title: Young Master Ye, Your Wife is a Celestial Goddess
Description: A celestial goddess is framed for theft and banished to the mortal realm, where she must find a sacred jade to prove her innocence.

INT. CELESTIAL PALACE - DAY

The ANCIENT EMPEROR sits high upon his throne, looking down at LINGBI FAIRY below.

ANCIENT EMPEROR
Lingbi Fairy, your service has been exemplary. By celestial decree, you are promoted to Upper Goddess.

A radiant light surrounds LINGBI FAIRY. Her robes transform, becoming more magnificent. She bows deeply.

LINGBI FAIRY
Thank you, Ancient Emperor.

ZIYAN FAIRY (V.O.)
Wait!

ZIYAN FAIRY enters, her purple robes marking her high status. She carries a jade shard.

ZIYAN FAIRY
Ancient Emperor, the Divine Light Ancient Jade has been stolen from the tribute platform. Lingbi Fairy's seal was found on the case.

LINGBI FAIRY
(urgently)
Ziyan, you know I would never—

ZIYAN FAIRY
(coldly)
My mirror shows otherwise.

ZIYAN FAIRY waves her sleeve. A water mirror appears, showing a figure with Lingbi's seal breaking the jade's case.
continuation:
INT. CELESTIAL TRIBUTE PLATFORM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

In the water mirror, a figure wearing LINGBI FAIRY's seal breaks the case and takes the Divine Light Ancient Jade.

INT. CELESTIAL PALACE - DAY

The water mirror vanishes.

LINGBI FAIRY
(desperately)
My seal was stolen three days ago! I reported it, but—

ZIYAN FAIRY
Convenient timing. Ancient Emperor, the jade's power is needed for the upcoming celestial trial. We cannot risk chaos.

ANCIENT EMPEROR
(sternly)
The seal's signature is undeniable. Lingbi, do you deny this?

LINGBI FAIRY
I deny the crime, not the seal. Someone used my stolen seal to frame me. The jade recognizes its true keeper—let me retrieve it and prove my innocence!

ZIYAN FAIRY
A clever ploy to escape execution.

ANCIENT EMPEROR
(considering)
Very well. You have three mortal months. The jade's consciousness will reveal truth. But understand—if you fail, the realm's stability requires your execution. The seal must be protected.

The ANCIENT EMPEROR casts a spell. Golden light envelops LINGBI FAIRY, and chains of light bind her celestial essence.

INT. SU FAMILY RESIDENCE - DAY

Golden light strikes SU WAN's body as she collapses. Her eyes snap open, now glowing faintly.

SU WAN
(groaning in pain)
Where... what is this?

She sees wounds on her arm, then touches her face—unfamiliar features.

SU WAN
(whispering)
A vessel? Three months...

A YOUNG WOMAN in pink and a MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN appear at the doorway.

YOUNG WOMAN (V.O.)
She survived the poison? Impossible.

The two enter the room and look down at SU WAN on the floor, exchanging a glance.

title: The Great Xia Dynasty
description: A messenger brings urgent news as the Emperor mourns his lost daughter. When word arrives that the Tenth Princess has been found, the princes compete to show their devotion, unaware she is being held captive elsewhere.
context:
Title: The Great Xia Dynasty
Description: A messenger brings urgent news as the Emperor mourns his lost daughter. When word arrives that the Tenth Princess has been found, the princes compete to show their devotion, unaware she is being held captive elsewhere.

EXT. PALACE EXTERIOR - DAY

A MESSENGER sprints through the palace gates, his armor mud-splattered. Guards scramble aside.

MESSENGER
(shouting)
Eight hundred li urgent report! Move!

The messenger doesn't slow, his voice echoing through the courtyards.

EXT. PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

The GREAT XIA EMPEROR sits alone, turning a broken jade pendant over in his palm. His shoulders tremble.

GREAT XIA EMPEROR
(whispering)
Yu'er...

SECOND PRINCE YE ZIHAO approaches quietly, holding a fur-lined cloak.

SECOND PRINCE YE ZIHAO
Father. The north wind bites.

GREAT XIA EMPEROR
Ten winters since she vanished. And still...

SECOND PRINCE YE ZIHAO
I've doubled the search parties. Every province, every village.

SECOND PRINCE YE ZIHAO drapes the cloak over the Emperor's shoulders.

CROWN PRINCE YE ZHUOYUN bursts into the courtyard, breathless, clutching a scroll.

CROWN PRINCE YE ZHUOYUN
Father! Word from Guangzhou!

The Emperor rises, the pendant slipping from his fingers.

GREAT XIA EMPEROR
Where is she?

CROWN PRINCE YE ZHUOYUN
A trader's caravan. The description matches—birthmark on her left wrist, the jade pendant.

A EUNUCH rushes forward, head bowed.
continuation:
EUNUCH
Your Majesty! The other princes approach! Their banners were spotted at dawn.

Hooves thunder. The THIRD PRINCE dismounts, his silk robes travel-stained.

THIRD PRINCE
Father, I've prepared Yueyang Manor. Roofs of gold leaf, just as she used to draw.

The FOURTH PRINCE follows, his hand on his sword hilt.

FOURTH PRINCE
The Shadow Guard stands ready. Let me escort her.

The FIFTH PRINCE enters more slowly, a wooden box in his hands.

FIFTH PRINCE
From the southern abyss. A pearl that glows in moonlight. For her chamber.

CROWN PRINCE YE ZHUOYUN
Ginseng from Changbai. Snow lotus from Kunlun. All en route.

SECOND PRINCE YE ZIHAO watches the Emperor retrieve the fallen pendant. He takes it from his father's trembling hand.

SECOND PRINCE YE ZIHAO
I will bring her home myself.

The broken pendant glows as their hands touch, warmth spreading through the jade. The light intensifies, then fades.

INT. INTERIOR ROOM - DAY

TENTH PRINCESS SU YAO, bruised but upright, faces JIANG CHUYUE. The matching half of the jade pendant hangs visible at her throat.

JIANG CHUYUE
The formula. Where did you sell it?

TENTH PRINCESS SU YAO
I sold nothing.

JIANG CHUYUE backhands SU YAO across the face. SU YAO spits blood, but her hand closes protectively around her pendant.

JIANG CHUYUE
You think your silence protects you? No one is coming.

SU YAO's fingers tighten on the pendant. It flickers—faint, almost imperceptible.

SU YAO
(quietly)
You have no idea who I am.

Her eyes, fixed on JIANG CHUYUE, burn with quiet fury.

title: After Being Betrayed, I Became the CEO's Treasure
description: A heartbroken young woman who discovers her boyfriend's infidelity finds herself handcuffed by a mysterious man in a KTV room, leading to an unexpected turn in her life.
context:
Title: After Being Betrayed, I Became the CEO's Treasure
Description: A heartbroken young woman who discovers her boyfriend's infidelity finds herself handcuffed by a mysterious man in a KTV room, leading to an unexpected turn in her life.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Music plays dimly from the sound system. JIANG CHENG sits alone on the sofa, surrounded by empty bottles. Her face is tear-streaked as she stares at her silent phone. The screen shows her last message to "Haoze" - unread, three hours ago. She takes another drink, her hands trembling.

She checks her phone again. Still nothing. Her bitter laugh dissolves into a sob.

JIANG CHENG
(whispering)
Three years... and you can't even text me back.

Her phone slips from her fingers. She leans back, eyes closing.

A pair of men's dress shoes stops beside the sofa. A SECURITY BADGE gleams at the belt.

JIANG CHENG's eyes flutter open. She sees the man through a haze.

JIANG CHENG
(mumbling)
...not causing trouble. Just... tired.

The man - crisp suit, impassive face - produces professional-grade zip-tie cuffs and secures her wrist to the table leg.

ON SCREEN: Sincere devotion, misplaced. Who holds the key to her heart's prison?

EXT. PLAZA - DAY

(FLASHBACK)

JIANG CHENG in a bulky frog mascot costume staggers in the midday heat, handing out flyers for a PHONE COMPANY PROMOTION. Sweat drips inside the foam head. Passersby ignore her.

JIANG CHENG (O.S.)
(muffled, exhausted)
Free case with purchase...

She collapses onto a bench, removes the headpiece, gasping. Her phone shows her bank balance: ¥9,120. She smiles through the exhaustion.

JIANG CHENG
(to herself)
Enough. Finally enough.
continuation:
INT. PHONE STORE - DAY

JIANG CHENG examines the latest phone model, her reflection showing dark circles under her eyes.

STORE CLERK
Finalizing the payment?

JIANG CHENG
Yes. It's... for someone important.

She scans the QR code. ¥8,999. Her thumb hovers, then confirms.

STORE CLERK
Packing it now.

JIANG CHENG dials a number. It rings.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

(SCENE CUTS)

MU HAOZE, shirtless, reaches for his phone on the nightstand. HUO YUSHAN traces patterns on his chest.

MU HAOZE
It's Jiang Cheng.

HUO YUSHAN
Let her hear how little she matters.

MU HAOZE answers, putting it on speaker.

JIANG CHENG (O.S.)
Haoze? I have a surprise for you. I'm coming over—

A moan cuts through. The sound of silk sheets rustling. Jiang Cheng's voice stops.

MU HAOZE (O.S.)
(to Huo Yushan)
She's nothing compared to you.

The phone goes dead.

INT. PHONE STORE - DAY

JIANG CHENG stares at her phone, the gift box at her feet. The STORE CLERK's voice is distant.

STORE CLERK (O.S.)
Miss? Your receipt...

Tears fall on the shattered screen of her old phone, dropped on the tile.

ON SCREEN: Some prisons have no bars. Some treasures are found in ruins.

JIANG CHENG
Yes. It's... for someone important.

She scans the QR code. ¥8,999. Her thumb hovers, then confirms.

STORE CLERK
Packing it now.

JIANG CHENG dials a number. It rings.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

(SCENE CUTS)

MU HAOZE, shirtless, reaches for his phone on the nightstand. HUO YUSHAN traces patterns on his chest.

MU HAOZE
It's Jiang Cheng.

HUO YUSHAN
Let her hear how little she matters.

MU HAOZE answers, putting it on speaker.

JIANG CHENG (O.S.)
Haoze? I have a surprise for you. I'm coming over—

A moan cuts through. The sound of silk sheets rustling. Jiang Cheng's voice stops.

MU HAOZE (O.S.)
(to Huo Yushan)
She's nothing compared to you.

The phone goes dead.

INT. PHONE STORE - DAY

JIANG CHENG stares at her phone, the gift box at her feet. The STORE CLERK's voice is distant.

STORE CLERK (O.S.)
Miss? Your receipt...

Tears fall on the shattered screen of her old phone, dropped on the tile.

ON SCREEN: Some prisons have no bars. Some treasures are found in ruins.

title: My Dad is a Live-in Son-in-law
description: A young man endures three years of humiliation in his wife's family after his father allegedly swindled them, only to discover his father's risky gamble is about to pay off spectacularly.
context:
Title: My Dad is a Live-in Son-in-law
Description: A young man endures three years of humiliation in his wife's family after his father allegedly swindled them, only to discover his father's risky gamble is about to pay off spectacularly.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

BAI RUXUE, wearing a blue dress and high heels, walks toward JIANG ZHOU, who is tied to a chair with rope.

JIANG ZHOU
Sister.

BAI RUXUE slaps JIANG ZHOU across the face.

BAI RUXUE
Currency of privilege. You have none.

JIANG ZHOU
Sister.

BAI RUXUE picks up a whip and lashes at JIANG ZHOU.

BAI RUXUE
You inventory groceries while your father inventories our trust. Three hundred million units of betrayal.

BAI RULAN, sitting on the sofa, speaks up.

BAI RULAN
The board convenes in ten. Save some for later.

BAI RUXUE
This is more productive.

(to Jiang Zhou)
Three years ago, my mother extended your family a lifeline. Your father used it as a noose. Company funds diverted, then vanished. Now we circle bankruptcy. Your contribution?

JIANG ZHOU
Every meal calibrated, every garment preserved, every surface reflecting your status. I account for every cent I cost you. But not my father's vision.

BAI RUXUE
(another lash)
Dignity doesn't appear in our ledgers.

BAI RUXUE kicks over JIANG ZHOU's chair. JIANG ZHOU falls to the ground with the chair.

BAI RUXUE walks forward and steps on JIANG ZHOU with her high heel.

BAI RUXUE
(leaning down)
The view from down there—does it clarify your position?

JIANG ZHOU turns his head away.

BAI RUXUE
(another lash)
Look at me when I'm appraising you.

BAI RULAN
He's convinced he has a valuation ability. Claims he can see intrinsic worth.

BAI RUXUE
Then value this crop. Or my patience.

Jiang Zhou's expression flickers.

JIANG ZHOU
It's inconsistent. But three years ago, on that land, it was absolute. Ten billion in development potential.

FLASHBACK TO:
continuation:
EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

Three years ago.

JIANG WANNIAN
Son, every analyst calls it worthless.

JIANG ZHOU
I see hotels. Conferences. Infrastructure grants. Ten billion in five years.

JIANG WANNIAN
The buy-in is three hundred million. I don't have that kind of collateral.

JIANG ZHOU
You have your reputation. Your track record. Your word as a Jiang.

JIANG WANNIAN
My word just became leverage.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

BAI RULAN
The funding gap is four hundred million. We need solutions, not delusions.

Jiang Zhou's phone vibrates. He extracts it awkwardly.

Screen shows JIANG WANNIAN: "Position closed: 10B realized. Transfer initiated. Vanquis Tower, 8 PM. Formal attire."

BAI RULAN
Your father? Put him on speaker. I want promises, not texts.

JIANG ZHOU
(quiet laugh)
Three hundred million was the down payment. A three-year hold. Market rate of return is tenfold.

BAI RUXUE
You're hallucinating debt relief.

She swings the whip. Jiang Zhou catches it with one hand.

BAI RUXUE
(shocked)
You dare fight back? I don't think you want to stay in the Bai family anymore!

JIANG ZHOU
The debt is settled. The returns are mine. When I return, I'll value this house properly. And your position in it.

He drops the whip.

JIANG ZHOU
Five hundred million. One billion. Whatever the numbers require.

JIANG ZHOU finishes speaking, turns and leaves, leaving BAI RUXUE and BAI RULAN in shock.

title: Surgical Vengeance
description: A woman is forced into surgery to lose her child, manipulated by her scheming sister who wants to erase all ties between her and the man they both love.
context:
Title: Surgical Vengeance
Description: A woman is forced into surgery to lose her child, manipulated by her scheming sister who wants to erase all ties between her and the man they both love.

INT. PRIVATE CLINIC OPERATING ROOM - NIGHT

QIN YIMO, 28, clutches her abdomen as FU RONGCHUAN, 35, pulls her toward the operating table. She resists with the last of her strength, a mother's instinct.

QIN YIMO
(strangled whisper)
Let me go. You can't do this.

FU RONGCHUAN
It's already done.

QIN YIMO
(pleading, voice raw)
Rongchuan, feel this. He's yours. He kicks when you're near.

She guides his hand. He jerks away, a spasm crossing his face.

FU RONGCHUAN grabs her throat—not with rage, but with terrible certainty, his thumb pressing her pulse point.

FU RONGCHUAN (V.O.)
Qing showed me the DNA report. The dates don't lie. But we both know they do.

FU RONGCHUAN releases his grip, turns to the DOCTOR, 50s, whose hands shake as he sterilizes instruments.

FU RONGCHUAN
The transfer is authenticated. Proceed. No records.

FU RONGCHUAN exits without looking back. QIN YIMO starts after him, but QIN QING, 30, elegant and unnaturally calm, blocks the doorway.

QIN QING
Running again? You never faced consequences well.

QIN YIMO
(whisper)
You told him to keep it. Until you changed the rules.
continuation:
QIN QING
(to medical staff, crisp)
She's hysterical. Soft restraints.

MEDICAL STAFF move forward, professional but grim, securing QIN YIMO to the table with padded cuffs.

QIN YIMO
(terrified whisper)
Please. Not like this.

QIN QING walks to the operating table, leans over. Her perfume is cloying, her smile doesn't reach her eyes.

QIN QING
Mother's will. Her first grandchild inherits everything. Mine died in the womb. Yours dies here.

QIN YIMO
(hollow)
This was never about him. It's about money.

QIN QING
It's about the sister who survived. When this is over, I'll finally breathe.

QIN YIMO
(voice breaking)
I'll sign it over. The inheritance. Just—

QIN QING
The child is your signature. And his excuse to see you.

QIN QING straightens, addressing the DOCTOR with practiced authority.

QIN QING
Use the local. She needs to remember why she should never return.

QIN QING places a bite block between QIN YIMO's teeth, her fingers trembling slightly.

QIN QING
Scream into this. It's what I did for nine months.

The heart monitor accelerates. The DOCTOR begins. QIN YIMO's body arches in silent agony, her eyes fixed on QIN QING—who watches with a smile that cracks into something like grief.

title: Pet
description: A woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal on the eve of their arranged marriage and decides to take revenge by seducing his uncle, her powerful CEO boss.
context:
Title: Pet
Description: A woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal on the eve of their arranged marriage and decides to take revenge by seducing his uncle, her powerful CEO boss.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

JIANG LIN (Lu family grandson) presses BAI LIU (eldest daughter of the Bai family) onto a leather sofa. His bathrobe hangs loose. Her blouse is askew.

BAI LIU
(gasping)
Wait... what if Tao Tao finds out?

JIANG LIN
She won't. She's too busy being grateful.
(tasting her neck)
A "bastard" like her should know her place.

He kisses her deeply. The door cracks open.

BAI TAO (second daughter of the Bai family) stands frozen in the doorway. Her engagement ring glints as her hand trembles.

INT. CAFE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

XU XIAORAN (Bai Tao's best friend) slams her phone down. A photo shows Jiang Lin and Bai Liu entering a hotel.

XU XIAORAN
This is the third time. You can't keep defending him.

Opposite her, BAI TAO stares at the photo, thumb circling her engagement ring.

XU XIAORAN (O.S.)
Your mom would want you to be happy—

BAI TAO
(cutting her off)
My mom wanted me to keep my promise.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

BAI TAO stands at room 1808. Her black dress is severe. She raises her fist to knock.

JIANG LIN (O.S.)
Who's there?

Her fist freezes.

BAI LIU (O.S.)
Just staff. Ignore it.

BAI TAO's hand drops. She presses against the wall, breathing shallow. She looks at her ring, then the door. Something hardens.

A key beeps. LU ZHAOHE (CEO of Shengchuan Group) emerges, heading for room 1809.

LU ZHAOHE
Assistant Bai.

She turns.

LU ZHAOHE (O.S.)
You're working late.

BAI TAO
Something like that.

Inside 1808, Jiang Lin's laughter spills out.

BAI TAO's eyes meet Lu Zhaohe's. She sees the family resemblance. An idea crystallizes.

She steps forward.

BAI TAO
CEO Lu... are you single?

He studies her.

LU ZHAOHE
What are you doing, Bai Tao?

She pushes him through his door.
continuation:
INT. LU ZHAOHE'S HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

BAI TAO stumbles. LU ZHAOHE catches himself, regaining control. He doesn't touch her.

LU ZHAOHE
You've had too much to drink.

BAI TAO
I'm sober. I've memorized your schedule three years.

She steps closer.

BAI TAO (O.S.)
I've never seen you with anyone. Some say you have... standards.

He touches one finger under her chin, lifting her face.

LU ZHAOHE
You're engaged to my nephew.

BAI TAO
Am I?

She reaches for his tie.

BAI TAO (O.S.)
Three years ago, Jiang Lin's family covered my mother's bills. Tonight, I find out that debt's been... accumulating interest.

LU ZHAOHE
Revenge is a poor reason.

BAI TAO
What about leverage?

LU ZHAOHE
You want to use me against him?

BAI TAO
I want to win.

Silence. A briefcase clicks open. LU ZHAOHE extracts a folder, hands it to her.

LU ZHAOHE
Page seven.

BAI TAO opens it. Photos—Jiang Lin and Bai Liu, dated months back. Bank statements. Texts.

LU ZHAOHE (O.S.)
You're not the only one who's been watching.

Her hands tremble. She looks up.

BAI TAO
Why?

LU ZHAOHE
I protect my investments. Jiang Lin is a liability.

She drops the folder. Slowly unzips her dress.

BAI TAO
What am I?

LU ZHAOHE
(catching her wrist)
Don't.

He pulls her close, lips at her ear.

LU ZHAOHE (O.S.)
Tonight, you're whatever you want to be.

He kisses her—precise. She melts into it. A wine glass tips, forgotten.

FADE OUT.

title: Uncle's Little Wife
description: A young woman deliberately sabotages her arranged marriage meeting with an old man by appearing in outrageous attire, but her plan backfires when he approves of the match anyway.
context:
Title: Uncle's Little Wife
Description: A young woman deliberately sabotages her arranged marriage meeting with an old man by appearing in outrageous attire, but her plan backfires when he approves of the match anyway.

INT. LAKESIDE PAVILION - DAY

OLD GU sits holding a cane inlaid with rubies.

CHAIRMAN TANG sits across from OLD GU. Exquisite dishes are laid out on the table.

Several BODYGUARDS in black suits approach carrying expensive gift boxes.

CHAIRMAN TANG
Old Gu, I trust Nuannuan's portrait meets your standards?

OLD GU looks at a photo of a girl. The girl in the photo is demure and poised.

OLD GU
Acceptable. She knows her angles.

CHAIRMAN TANG
(relieved)
She's been groomed for this alliance since childhood.

Suddenly, TANG NUANNUAN appears in the doorway. She sports a neon-pink wig, a clashing floral jacket, and holds a comically oversized lollipop. She swaggers toward them.

CHAIRMAN TANG
(horrified)
Miss, you've mistaken this pavilion for the costume party.

TANG NUANNUAN
(defiantly)
Cut the act, Dad. I'm your three o'clock.

OLD GU
(intrigued)
Remarkable. You share minimal DNA with this photograph.

TANG NUANNUAN
That's Photoshop for you. The photo's my highlight reel.

TANG NUANNUAN grabs a shrimp dumpling. CHAIRMAN TANG looks mortified. OLD GU appears calculating.
continuation:
TANG NUANNUAN
Not terrible. Still not worth my freedom.

CHAIRMAN TANG
(to OLD GU, desperate)
Obviously this performance voids our agreement. We'll triple your compensation—

CHAIRMAN TANG stands up, trying to pull TANG NUANNUAN away.

CHAIRMAN TANG
(hissing)
You've ruined us!

OLD GU
(standing up, stopping them)
Wait. I find her... authentic. August 15th stands.

TANG NUANNUAN
(stunned)
What?

EXT. GOLF COURSE - DAY

GU CHENYU, a sharp-featured man in his thirties, swings a golf club.

An ASSISTANT holds an umbrella and a tablet.

GU CHENYU takes a sip of water.

ASSISTANT
President Gu, Old Master Gu confirmed the wedding. He said: "She has spine."

GU CHENYU
(expressionless)
Did she now.

A faint smile plays on GU CHENYU's lips.

INT. BRIDAL SHOP - DAY

TANG NUANNUAN, now stripped of costume, stands before a mirror in a sleek wedding gown. GU CHENYU appears behind her.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Ex from Luocha Kingdom
description: After a betrayal shatters his martial arts legacy, a broken instructor discovers his ancestors' blood-bound combat techniques may be his last hope.
context:
Title: The Ex from Luocha Kingdom
Description: After a betrayal shatters his martial arts legacy, a broken instructor discovers his ancestors' blood-bound combat techniques may be his last hope.

INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT

Opening with a fast-cut fight sequence.

CHEN YIFAN (28), a martial arts instructor in a worn denim jacket, fights four MEN IN BLACK with precise techniques. He downs two cleanly.

Suddenly, a man in black smashes a bottle on CHEN YIFAN's head from behind.

CHEN YIFAN falls to the ground, blood trickling from his temple.

Flashback begins.

YIFAN'S EX-GIRLFRIEND (V.O.)
I can't carry your legacy anymore, Yifan.

You sold our dojo for him?

YIFAN'S EX-GIRLFRIEND
Your pride blinded you. I finally see that.

You're nothing but a delusional loser. Honor doesn't pay rent.
continuation:

No more students. No more lineage.

CHEN YIFAN lies on the ground, his expression shocked.

In the Luocha Kingdom, broken things stay broken. Keep your head down.

CHEN YIFAN drags his injured body into a dilapidated hall. He faces the Chen family tablet.

CHEN YIFAN
(to himself)

title: Episode 1
description: A mysterious man in black rescues a woman in red from villains in an ancient mansion.
context:
Title: Episode 1
Description: A mysterious man in black rescues a woman in red from villains in an ancient mansion.

INT. ANCIENT MANSION CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Darkness shifts through smoke-filled air. Footsteps echo.

A WOMAN IN RED (30s, elegant but disheveled) sprints forward, breath ragged. She glances back—eyes widening.

She stumbles, crashes to the ground. A SHADOW overtakes her.

FADE TO BLACK.

A single BEIGE HIGH-HEELED SHOE lies abandoned on the stone floor.

INT. ANCIENT MANSION HALL - CONTINUOUS

The Woman in Red is bound to a wooden chair, rope biting into her wrists. Her defiant mask slips—she's scanning exits, not just cowering.

She strains against the ropes. Useless.

WOMAN IN RED
(whispered plea)
Please... not like this.

From the shadows, the VILLAIN BOSS (50s, tailored suit) materializes. He doesn't touch her—he circles, predator surveying prey.

VILLAIN BOSS
You brought him here. Just as promised.

The Woman in Red flinches. More from guilt than fear.

A beat. Then—

A window SHATTERS. The MAN IN BLACK (40s, weathered, trench coat flaring) lands in a crouch at the hall's center.

MAN IN BLACK
(disappointment in his voice)
Was I your only option?

The Villain Boss chuckles, drawing a blade.
continuation:
VILLAIN BOSS
My men were getting bored.

THUGS materialize from doorways, forming a loose circle.

They close in. The Man in Black doesn't wait.

He moves—economical, brutal. An elbow shatters a thug's nose. A spinning kick drops another. He uses their momentum, their numbers, against them.

One thug goes through a rotting table. Another hits the wall—stays there.

The Villain Boss's smile fades. He lunges.

The Man in Black sidesteps, catches the wrist, twists. The blade clatters. A boot to the ribs sends the Villain Boss sprawling.

The Man in Black stands over him. Decides against finishing it.

He crosses to the Woman in Red. Their eyes meet—hers searching, his unreadable.

MAN IN BLACK
Can you stand?

WOMAN IN RED
...I can try.

He cuts her bonds with a concealed knife. She rises, wobbling—but pushes his supporting hand away.

They stand close. The moment stretches.

MAN IN BLACK
You owe me an explanation.

WOMAN IN RED
(quietly)
I know.

She picks up her shoe from where it fell. Considers it like evidence.

MAN IN BLACK
Then let's find somewhere safer to talk.

He offers his arm, not a princess carry. She takes it, leaning only slightly. They exit through the shattered window.

title: Reborn as the Foolish Prince's Peerless Princess
description: A princess consort is betrayed on her wedding day but is given a chance at rebirth with newfound powers to seek revenge.
context:
Title: Reborn as the Foolish Prince's Peerless Princess
Description: A princess consort is betrayed on her wedding day but is given a chance at rebirth with newfound powers to seek revenge.

TITLE CARD: REBORN AS THE FOOLISH PRINCE'S PEERLESS PRINCESS - EPISODE 1

MONTAGE

A series of aesthetic shots: JIANG YUANXIA in red robes plays a guqin, her eyes melancholic. A man's hand covers hers. The hand tightens, possessive. A single tear falls.

INT. ROOM - DAY

A group of ragged THUGS burst into the room, led by a BALD MAN with a scarred face.

JIANG YUANXIA, magnificent in her red wedding dress, backs against the wall.

JIANG YUANXIA
Who are you? What do you want? I'm telling you, I am the Prince Consort! If you dare touch me, you're all dead!

BALD MAN
(grinning wickedly)
The Prince isn't here. And by morning, neither will you be.

The THUGS swarm forward. One grabs her wrist. Another covers her mouth. She bites down hard, but they don't stop. Her eyes flash with sudden understanding. This is no random attack.

MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)
Jiang Yuanxia... I give you another chance. Unravel what was woven.

A golden light erupts from JIANG YUANXIA'S chest, throwing the thugs back. She collapses.

The light fades. JIANG YUANXIA opens her eyes. They're sharp now, ancient. She stares at her hands, flexing them. Energy crackles beneath her skin.

A LONG-HAIRED MAN lunges at her. JIANG YUANXIA strikes, grabbing his throat.

LONG-HAIRED MAN
(in pain)
Ah! Let go!

JIANG YUANXIA
continuation:
(coldly)
Who sent you?

LONG-HAIRED MAN
You wretched woman dare to resist—

She squeezes. He chokes. JIANG YUANXIA throws him. He crashes through a wooden screen.

Another THUG draws a knife and charges.

THUG
Hey!

JIANG YUANXIA dodges, the blade whispering past her throat. She catches his wrist. The knife flips into her hand. JIANG YUANXIA strikes him down with the pommel.

JIANG YUANXIA moves efficiently, defeating each thug. Finally, she holds the knife to the BALD MAN'S throat.

BALD MAN
(terrified)
Wait! I'll talk! The Second Miss—the Prince's Second Miss! She paid us to ruin you! So the Prince would divorce you and marry her!

JIANG YUANXIA (V.O.)
Have I been reborn? This power... I've never felt it before.

JIANG YUANXIA'S eyes flash. She focuses. The air around the BALD MAN'S throat thickens. He chokes.

BALD MAN
(choking)
Please... mercy...

JIANG YUANXIA
You were shown none to me.

She releases her grip. He collapses. JIANG YUANXIA leans close, her voice ice.

JIANG YUANXIA
Tell your mistress: I remember. If I see you again, you won't have eyes to see with.

JIANG YUANXIA straightens, her wedding dress seeming like armor now. Her eyes freeze with the promise of revenge.

title: Return to Ancient Times as a Wastrel
description: A modern archaeologist is transported to ancient times after discovering a mysterious jade artifact and finds himself in the body of a prince.
context:
Title: Return to Ancient Times as a Wastrel
Description: A modern archaeologist is transported to ancient times after discovering a mysterious jade artifact and finds himself in the body of a prince.

INT. ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITE - DAY

XU JIPING, wearing blue work clothes, extracts a wooden box from the muddy earth with trembling care. He cracks the lid.

A jade bi disc gleams. He lifts it, studying the ancient engravings.

XU JIPING
(to himself)
Xia burial goods, but the context is impossible. Unless—

The jade flares. Light engulfs him. He disappears. The box drops into the mud.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

XU JIPING lies on a bed, eyes closed, wrists loosely bound. CHU XIANGXIANG stands over an overturned wine service. Two HANDMAIDENS huddle near the door.

HANDMAIDEN
(whispering)
Miss Chu, the physician swore it was only enough to flush him from your chambers. Not... fatal.

CHU XIANGXIANG
(quiet, fierce)
The wastrel's constitution proved weaker than I calculated.

XU JIPING's eyes snap open. He focuses on Chu Xiangxiang. She goes pale.

XU JIPING
Where— Who bound me—
continuation:
He sits up. The poorly-tied cords slip free. The handmaidens stare.

HANDMAIDEN
His mind... it must have broken.

XU JIPING
(touching his temples)
Hallucination. Possible toxin. Cultural disorientation—

A memory surfaces: HIMSELF—this body—leaping from behind a pillar, spilling Chu Xiangxiang's pastries. Her humiliated fury.

XU JIPING
(realization)
Chu Xiangxiang. I've... I've time-traveled.

His legs buckle. The aphrodisiac's heat floods his veins. He stumbles toward the table for water, but collides with Chu Xiangxiang. They fall back onto the bed.

CHU XIANGXIANG
(struggling)
Get off—stop—

The door explodes open. FATHER CHU charges in, sword bared.

FATHER CHU
(roaring)
Defile my daughter, you diseased goat? I'll send you to your ancestors!

He slashes. Xu Jiping—pure instinct—whips the silk cord around the blade, yanking it off-course. The sword buries in a floorboard. Both stare, stunned.

FADE OUT.

title: Untouchable Her
description: A woman seeks revenge against Yin Hongqiang, but becomes entangled with his son Yin Jiyun in a dangerous game of power and vengeance.
context:
Title: Untouchable Her
Description: A woman seeks revenge against Yin Hongqiang, but becomes entangled with his son Yin Jiyun in a dangerous game of power and vengeance.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

YIN HONGQIANG throws the FEMALE LEAD onto the bed, silk sheets tearing beneath her.

YIN HONGQIANG
I built this empire waiting for what's mine. I'm done waiting.

The FEMALE LEAD's hand slips under the pillow, fingers brushing cold metal. She freezes.

FEMALE LEAD
Your men are right outside the door.

YIN HONGQIANG slaps her across the face. A pearl earring skitters across marble.

YIN HONGQIANG
They're my men. Not yours. And you flinch like I'm already dead.

YIN HONGQIANG lunges. The door splinters open. YIN JIYUN appears, grabs YIN HONGQIANG by the throat, cigarette smoke curling from his lips.

The FEMALE LEAD sits up, eyes on the gun hidden beneath her pillow.

FEMALE LEAD
Yin Jiyun! What are you doing? He's your father!

YIN HONGQIANG
Get out! This is business.

YIN JIYUN
(exhaling)
Your business is bleeding money. I checked the books. Found your "entertainment" receipts.

YIN JIYUN's gaze flicks from his father's face to hers.
continuation:
INT. CASINO - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Montage: The FEMALE LEAD's fingers copy numbers from a ledger. She swaps a dealer's deck. She studies CCTV footage of YIN HONGQIANG.

FEMALE LEAD (V.O.)
Seventeen months to become a ghost in his machine.

She stands at a two-way mirror, watching YIN JIYUN deal cards below.

FEMALE LEAD (V.O.)
Two nights to realize his son sees through every mask.

At the card table, the FAT MAN holds a cigar cutter to a debtor's finger. The man screams. YIN JIYUN keeps dealing, jaw tight.

FEMALE LEAD (V.O.)
The Fat Man thinks he's untouchable because he remembers when Hongqiang was nothing. He mistakes memory for immortality.

FAT MAN
If Yin Hongqiang has something to say, tell him to come himself. You aren't qualified.

YIN JIYUN
My father gave me his mask. His signature. That's all I need.

FAT MAN
(contemptuously)
Yin Jiyun, you're a fucking bastard son. What right do you have? Without me, your father would still be a street rat!

YIN JIYUN flicks his wrist. The ace of spades buries itself in the FAT MAN's throat. Superficial, but precise.

YIN JIYUN
(quietly)
Your men just watched you bleed. Tell me again what belongs to you.

The FEMALE LEAD watches from the shadows, a cold smile on her face.

title: Hidden Dragon
description: A powerful warrior lord with godlike abilities decides to cultivate a supreme technique that seals his memories for three years, only to wake up as a security guard with no recollection of his past glory.
context:
Title: Hidden Dragon
Description: A powerful warrior lord with godlike abilities decides to cultivate a supreme technique that seals his memories for three years, only to wake up as a security guard with no recollection of his past glory.

INT. INTERIOR ROOM - DAY

Quick montage: Go stones, clashing swords, a glowing scroll.

WANG HAO and MALE SUBORDINATE play Go. FEMALE SUBORDINATE enters.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
Young Master, the Southern Reaches have fallen. The Four Demon Kings are dead.

WANG HAO
And General Song?

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
Holding the plaza. She asks for your blessing.

WANG HAO places a stone. The board cracks.

WANG HAO
She'll learn to stand alone.

EXT. PLAZA - DAY

SONG HONGYAN in red-black armor, faces FOUR ADVERSARIES. Quick, brutal strikes. They fall.

She kneels, offering a broken crown.

SONG HONGYAN
For the Young Master.
continuation:
INT. CORRIDOR - DAY

WANG HAO and subordinates watch from above.

WANG HAO
The Supreme Heart Technique. Three years of memories for true immortality.

He takes the manual. It glows.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
You'll be defenseless. A god in a mortal's shell.

MALE SUBORDINATE
If enemies find you...

WANG HAO
Then guard me well.

He gives her a jade token.

WANG HAO
If I'm lost, this will find me.

SOLDIER (O.S.)
General Song Hongyan!

EXT. PLAZA - DAY

SONG HONGYAN approaches, bloodied.

SONG HONGYAN
Young Master, I've brought proof.

MALE SUBORDINATE
The Young Master sees no one. Not even you.

SONG HONGYAN
Then I'll wait. However long it takes.

She salutes and leaves.

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER

INT. UPSCALE RESTAURANT - DAY

WANG HAO, in a security uniform, sits with BLIND DATE WOMAN.

WANG HAO
I'm the top-rated guard in my district. Very dependable.

BLIND DATE WOMAN
Dependable? My Uber driver is dependable.

She splashes water. It soaks his shirt.

BLIND DATE WOMAN
Don't call me.

As she leaves, Wang Hao touches his chest. His fingers find a chain—the jade token, now dull.

It flickers. Just once.

WANG HAO
(to himself)
Why does that name... Song...?

The token pulses again, brighter.

ON SCREEN: HIDDEN DRAGON

SONG HONGYAN in red-black armor, faces FOUR ADVERSARIES. Quick, brutal strikes. They fall.

She kneels, offering a broken crown.

SONG HONGYAN
For the Young Master.

INT. CORRIDOR - DAY

WANG HAO and subordinates watch from above.

WANG HAO
The Supreme Heart Technique. Three years of memories for true immortality.

He takes the manual. It glows.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
You'll be defenseless. A god in a mortal's shell.

MALE SUBORDINATE
If enemies find you...

WANG HAO
Then guard me well.

He gives her a jade token.

WANG HAO
If I'm lost, this will find me.

SOLDIER (O.S.)
General Song Hongyan!

EXT. PLAZA - DAY

SONG HONGYAN approaches, bloodied.

SONG HONGYAN
Young Master, I've brought proof.

MALE SUBORDINATE
The Young Master sees no one. Not even you.

SONG HONGYAN
Then I'll wait. However long it takes.

She salutes and leaves.

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER

INT. UPSCALE RESTAURANT - DAY

WANG HAO, in a security uniform, sits with BLIND DATE WOMAN.

WANG HAO
I'm the top-rated guard in my district. Very dependable.

BLIND DATE WOMAN
Dependable? My Uber driver is dependable.

She splashes water. It soaks his shirt.

BLIND DATE WOMAN
Don't call me.

As she leaves, Wang Hao touches his chest. His fingers find a chain—the jade token, now dull.

It flickers. Just once.

WANG HAO
(to himself)
Why does that name... Song...?

The token pulses again, brighter.

ON SCREEN: HIDDEN DRAGON

title: Mr. Fu's Priceless Little Treasure
description: A woman in a wedding dress flees from a forced marriage, only to be rescued by a man from her past who still remembers her kindness.
context:
Title: Mr. Fu's Priceless Little Treasure
Description: A woman in a wedding dress flees from a forced marriage, only to be rescued by a man from her past who still remembers her kindness.

EXT. STREET - DAY

XIN TIAN, 26, runs frantically down the street, her white wedding dress torn, veil lost.

A black sedan speeds up and blocks her path.

ZHAO JUN (V.O.)
Stop right there!

ZHAO JUN, 38, a man in a pinstriped suit and gold-rimmed glasses, gets out with a cold expression.

XIN TIAN presses against the wall, breathing hard. She rips a strip from her dress.

XIN TIAN
Send the invoices to my parents. I'm not for sale.

She throws the fabric at his feet. The BODYGUARDS close in.

ZHAO JUN
continuation:
(sneering)
Contracts don't require consent. Just payment.

XIN TIAN darts toward the road. A black sedan brakes inches from her. She falls, palm bleeding.

The driver's door opens. FU YAN, 30, a handsome man in a suit with a scar crossing his left temple, gets out. He looks at Xin Tian on the ground.

FLASHBACK - INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT (5 YEARS AGO)

FU YAN, battered, lies on a cot. XIN TIAN, 21 in a volunteer uniform, presses a jade pendant into his hand.

XIN TIAN (V.O.)
Don't be afraid. I'll stay with you.

BACK TO REALITY

FU YAN looks at Xin Tian clutching her bleeding palm. His hand moves to his pocket—finds the pendant.

FU YAN
(to himself)
It's really her.

FU YAN helps Xin Tian up, positioning himself between her and the guards. They lock eyes—hers questioning, his fiercely protective.

title: Everything Starts from a Broken Engagement
description: A powerful man imprisoned in name receives his fourteenth visit from a fiancée seeking to break their engagement, unaware of his true identity and status.
context:
Title: Everything Starts from a Broken Engagement
Description: A powerful man imprisoned in name receives his fourteenth visit from a fiancée seeking to break their engagement, unaware of his true identity and status.

EXT. POOLSIDE - NIGHT

Quick cuts: high-voltage cables searing flesh, a hand forced beneath black water. A woman in a black power suit (LIU QINGYAN) strides through the gates with corporate swagger. A man in a black military-style jacket (CHEN YE) sits poolside, maids hovering like shadows, swirling red wine.

SONG SHEN
Master Warden, the dissidents are pacified. Await your command?

A subordinate (LI MANG) rushes over and kneels on the wet tile.

LI MANG
Commander, another fiancée at the east wall. Refused screening. Climbed.

CHEN YE
Another one? How many does this make?

SONG SHEN
To answer you, sir, this is the fourteenth.

CHEN YE
(sighing)
The wall now? Li Mang, escort her to the west parlor. Use the long corridor.

LI MANG
Yes, sir.

CHEN YE changes into a casual black polo shirt and checks his reflection in the darkened window.
continuation:
INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

CHEN YE sits at the head of the dining table. LIU QINGYAN sits across from him, posture perfect, eyes cold.

LIU QINGYAN
You're Chen Ye?

CHEN YE
I am.

LIU QINGYAN
I'm Liu Qingyan, your fiancée in name only. From this moment, we are nothing. Don't imagine you can claim me. My biotech firm cleared ten million last quarter. I hold patents on three cancer treatments. You're a convicted spy facing eight years. If you're intelligent, you'll sign the dissolution. I'll have you out by Monday. Freedom is what you want, isn't it? Not me.

CHEN YE
(confused)
A prisoner? Who told you that?

LIU QINGYAN
It doesn't matter who told me. You're unworthy of me. Hand over the certificate. I'll show mercy.

CHEN YE
(impatiently)
You're the fourteenth to say so. The script never changes.

LIU QINGYAN
(shocked)
You!

CHEN YE
You what? Wait here.

CHEN YE takes out a leather satchel and dumps a cascade of red marriage certificates across the mahogany table.

CHEN YE
(searching through them, muttering)
Oh right, what's your name again? Oh yeah, Liu Qingyan.

He picks up one certificate and looks at it.

CHEN YE
Heiress of the Zhao family from Jiangzhou.

He tosses it aside casually and picks up another.

CHEN YE
The Dragon Nation's Goddess of War.

He continues searching and finally finds Liu Qingyan's certificate.

CHEN YE
Ah, Liu Qingyan.

CHEN YE lifts his head, his eyes becoming sharp, as if flames are igniting around him.

title: Husband from Outer Space
description: A star explorer from planet Hacker falls in love with an Earth woman, breaking planetary law, and faces execution by his own brother.
context:
Title: Husband from Outer Space
Description: A star explorer from planet Hacker falls in love with an Earth woman, breaking planetary law, and faces execution by his own brother.

INT. FOREST - DAY

QIAN ZICHU (30s, otherworldly stillness) and CHU YU'ER (20s, defiant) sprint through the forest, sunlight flashing through canopy. They stop abruptly—

QIAN SIQI (30s, rigid posture, cybernetic eye pulsing) blocks the path ahead, energy bow manifesting in his hand.

QIAN SIQI
Qian Zichu. As a Hacker Planet explorer, you violated the Prime Directive by bonding with an Earth native. By planetary law, you face erasure. Any final words, brother?

CHU YU'ER
(shoving between them)
I won't let you take him!

QIAN ZICHU
(yanking her back)
Yu'er, the teleport beacon—it's still primed. You have to go!

QIAN SIQI
(cold smile)
The lock is encoded on both signals. She won't escape.

CHU YU'ER
I'm not leaving you!

QIAN ZICHU
Go!

QIAN ZICHU activates his wrist device. Chu Yu'er begins to dematerialize—then suddenly snaps back, half-phased, flickering.

QIAN SIQI
Emotional interference destabilizes the transfer. Predictable.
continuation:
His cybernetic eye flares BLUE. He draws the energy bow, arrow crackling. Chu Yu'er, caught between states, lunges toward Qian Zichu as the arrow releases. The bolt strikes her mid-teleport—she becomes solid as it pierces her chest.

QIAN ZICHU
(horrified)
Yu'er! No!

He catches her collapsing form. Blood spreads across her shirt. Her breath hitches.

CHU YU'ER
(whispering)
...wouldn't go... without you...

She goes limp.

QIAN ZICHU
(grief-stricken)
Yu'er...

He looks up at his brother, anguish hardening into rage.

QIAN ZICHU
(low, dangerous)
You meant to hit her.

Energy surges through Qian Zichu's hands, earth trembling beneath them.

INT. WHITE SPACE - DAY

QIAN ZICHU floats in infinite white, eyes closed. CHU YU'ER's phantom appears, translucent.

CHU YU'ER (V.O.)
Zichu... you promised we'd find each other...

QIAN ZICHU's eyes snap open, pulsing with electric BLUE light.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: What About the Promised Happiness
description: On a stormy night, a father's violence tears a family apart. A young boy loses his mother and childhood friend, spending fifteen years searching for answers.
context:
Title: What About the Promised Happiness
Description: On a stormy night, a father's violence tears a family apart. A young boy loses his mother and childhood friend, spending fifteen years searching for answers.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Rain lashes against windows. Thunder rumbles in the distance.

FATHER (40s, haggard, reeking of alcohol) towers over MOTHER (30s, bruised but defiant) near the worn sofa.

FATHER
The money, Lian. Where is it?

He yanks her arm. She stumbles but doesn't fall.

MOTHER
I gave you everything for your debts. The last of my savings.

CHEN'ER (8, face healing from a previous bruise) peeks through a cracked doorway, breath shallow.

FATHER
Don't lie to me!

He shoves her against the wall. A photo frame crashes - it's a family portrait, the glass spider-webbing.

CHEN'ER bursts in, small fists clenched.

CHEN'ER
Stop it!

FATHER wheels around, sees his son, and laughs bitterly.

FATHER
You want to protect her? You're just like her - weak!

He backhands Chen'er, who sprawls on the carpet.

MOTHER scrambles between them, shielding Chen'er with her body.

MOTHER
He's your son!

FATHER
Then give me what the Li family left you. The inheritance.

MOTHER
(quiet, steel in her voice)
That money is Chen'er's future. Not your gambling stake.

FATHER's face purples. He snatches a green glass bottle from the table, raises it overhead.

FATHER
You're both going to break me? Fine!

Mother turns, curling her body around Chen'er like armor.

The bottle descends. Sickening impact. Blood blooms across her temple. She goes limp.

CHEN'ER
Mom?

He shakes her shoulder. No response.

FATHER
(panting)
Get up. Get up!

Chen'er doesn't move. He just holds her, tears dropping onto her still face.

FATHER grabs Chen'er's collar, hauls him up.

FATHER
Look what you made me do!

The door CREAKS open. YAO YAO (7, pigtails, soaked from rain) stands there, cake box clutched to her chest.

YAO YAO
Mrs. Zhang? Chen'er said you liked chocolate--

She sees the blood. The bottle. Father's hand on Chen'er's neck.

YAO YAO drops the box. Chocolate cake splatters.

CHEN'ER
(screams)
Yao Yao, RUN!

Instead, she rushes forward, small hands pushing at Father's leg.

YAO YAO
Let him go!

FATHER releases Chen'er, who collapses. Father stares at Yao Yao with dead eyes.

FATHER
Another one?

He raises the bottle again. Chen'er lunges, but too slow.

The swing connects. Yao Yao crumples, her small body folding like paper.

FATHER stands there, bottle in hand, breathing harsh. He looks at what he's done. The room goes silent except for rain and Chen'er's broken sobbing.

FADE OUT.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

Sterile white walls. Chen'er (bandaged forehead) stirs awake.

AUNTIE (40s, kind-eyed, exhausted) sits in a plastic chair, gripping a tissue.

CHEN'ER
Mom...?

His voice is cracked, hopeful.

AUNTIE
(swiping her nose)
Chen Chen.

CHEN'ER
Is she in another room?

Auntie shakes her head. Her silence is the answer.

AUNTIE
Your mother... she didn't make it.

Chen'er's face crumples. He presses his lips together, but the grief leaks out anyway.

CHEN'ER
Yao Yao?

Auntie looks away. In the window reflection, Chen'er sees her throat work.

AUNTIE
They took her away. Her parents... they moved. I don't know where.

CHEN'ER
She's alive?

AUNTIE
I don't know. The doctors wouldn't tell me. The Li family... they want nothing to do with us now.

Chen'er stares at the ceiling, tears tracking down his temples.

CHEN'ER
(whisper)
Find her. I have to find her.

AUNTIE
I know. We will.

She takes his hand. Outside, rain begins again.

FADE TO BLACK.

MONTAGE

- The words "FIFTEEN YEARS LATER" dissolve in rain.
- Adult CHEN'ER (23, sharp suit, hollow eyes) stands at a window. He opens a weathered pocket watch: inside, a faded photo of Mother, young Chen'er, and Yao Yao with chocolate frosting on her nose.
- He touches the photo. His reflection overlays young Chen'er in that hospital bed, making the same silent vow.

CHEN'ER (V.O.)
Yao Yao. Fifteen years. Where did they take you?

FADE OUT.

title: The Yang Family Banquet Betrayal
description: At a family celebration, a trusted adopted daughter reveals her true intentions and betrays the family that raised her.
context:
Title: The Yang Family Banquet Betrayal
Description: At a family celebration, a trusted adopted daughter reveals her true intentions and betrays the family that raised her.

INT. YANG FAMILY BANQUET HALL - DAY

YANG CHEN and SONG WANQIU sit at a round table. Crimson lanterns cast flickering light. Chen's hand rests protectively on a small wooden box.

YANG CHEN
Tonight, Father names me his successor.

SONG WANQIU
(gaze fixed on the box)
The treasure too?

YANG CHEN
It's already in my keeping.

FATHER YANG enters with YANG XUE. The hall falls silent.

FATHER YANG
Sixty years, and my son takes his rightful place. Let us honor the bonds that make us family.

He sits. The feast begins.

YANG CHEN
(to SONG WANQIU)
Now that I'll be head of the family...

He reaches for her hand, earnest.

YANG CHEN (CONT'D)
Will you marry me?

SONG WANQIU
A smile flickers, then hardens.

SONG WANQIU
Show me what you'd build our future on. Let me hold the treasure.

YANG CHEN
He places the box in her open palms.

YANG CHEN
Everything I am.

Her thumb activates the hidden latch. Green vapor hisses from the seal—qi-poison, keyed to her energy signature.
continuation:
YANG CHEN
(doubling over)
Ah...!

FATHER YANG
(cup shattering)
The seal...!

YANG XUE collapses, silent.

SONG WANQIU
(coldly)
Twenty years of "daughter" while you chose his meager talent over my dedication!

YANG CHEN
(blood trickling)
You corrupted... the treasure itself...

SONG WANQIU
I was always the true heir.

FATHER YANG
Guards!

A GUARD attacks. Song Wanqiu flicks a qi-needle through his throat. He drops.

FATHER YANG
(desperately)
I trusted you...

He dies slumped forward.

YANG CHEN
(crawling)
Father! Wanqiu, you—

SONG WANQIU
He was my cage.

She opens the box fully. Empty. Her composure cracks.

SONG WANQIU
(shocked)
The aura... it was here! Where—

She overturns the box. Nothing. She stares at Father Yang's corpse. The ghost of a smile plays on his dead lips.

Everything I am.

YANG CHEN

Ah...!

(cup shattering)
The seal...!

(coldly)

I was always the true heir.

Guards!

FATHER YANG
(desperately)

(crawling)

context:
Title: Black Domain Supreme
Description: A man imprisoned and betrayed by his wife and her lover is sold to an underground entertainment venue where he is tortured for the audience's amusement while forced to witness his wife's betrayal.

INT. BLACK DOMAIN SHOWROOM - NIGHT

MONTAGE - NIGHTSCAPE
Fast cuts: Rain-slicked streets, flickering neon kanji, a towering megastructure in the distance labeled "TOWER-7 SECURITY FACILITY." Camera pushes through a steel door into a pulsing underground showroom.

SHOWROOM HOST (30s, razor-sharp suit) grips a chrome microphone, pacing the catwalk stage.

SHOWROOM HOST
(into microphone, showman's grin)
Black Domain! Where the City's finest come to play!

He gestures to a massive holographic screen descending behind him.

SHOWROOM HOST
Tonight's special - a Tower transfer who thinks he's going home. Place your bets, ladies and gentlemen. How long until Lu Yun breaks?

The screen displays: "LU YUN - INMATE #7734" with timer options: 5 MIN / 10 MIN / 15 MIN. The capacity crowd, including SUN QIANG and ZHAO YA in a velvet booth, taps their phones. Results flash: 89% voted 5 MIN.

Two GUARDS shove LU YUN (30s, broken but defiant) onto the stage. A smart-collar blinks red around his neck. His prison uniform is torn, one eye swollen shut.

LU YUN (V.O.)
(barely a whisper)
Yaya's birthday is next week. Zhao Ya promised we'd get her that doll...

A GUARD plants a boot in Lu Yun's back.

GUARD
Move, convict!

INT. VIP ROOM - NIGHT

Behind one-way glass, SUN QIANG (40s, predator-calm) sips whiskey with ZHAO YA (30s, brittle elegance). She watches Lu Yun on a monitor, knuckles white on her clutch.

LU YAYA (6, pigtails) bursts in, clutching a crayon drawing.

LU YAYA
Mommy, look! I drew Daddy!

ZHAO YA
(flinching, then cold)
Not now, Yaya.

She sets the child on the floor a bit too firmly. Yaya's lip trembles.

SUN QIANG
(eyes on Zhao Ya, not the child)
They say a hundred days of marriage builds grace. You Jiang City women are... efficient.

He traces Zhao Ya's jawline. She doesn't pull away.

SUN QIANG
Sent him to prison. Sold his sentence to us. What's next?

ZHAO YA
(tight smile)
Young Master Sun, that transfer fee bought this room. Consider it... entertainment insurance.

She kisses his knuckles. He catches her wrist.

SUN QIANG
Then let's make sure he gets his money's worth.

LU YAYA
(small voice)
Mommy, why are you with the bad man?

ZHAO YA
(eyes flashing, then dead)
He's not bad, baby. He's just... winning.
continuation:
INT. BLUE ROOM - NIGHT

Lu Yun is shoved into a sapphire-lit chamber, walls dripping with condensation. Steel drains line the floor.

GUARD
In you go!

Lu Yun stumbles. His hands touch the cold metal. He looks up.

LU YUN
This isn't the transfer bus...

A ONE-EYED MAN (50s, scarred, silver canine tooth) emerges from shadow. His eyepatch is etched with a barcode.

ONE-EYED MAN
Daxia Tower breeds soft men. Lucky for us.

He seizes Lu Yun's throat. Two BULL-MASKED ATTENDANTS pin his arms.

LU YUN
(choking)
Sun Qiang's testimony... already got me five years...

ONE-EYED MAN
(leaning in, whisper)
This isn't prison, pretty boy. This is premium content. And your wife? She's a producer now.

He forces Lu Yun to his knees facing a glass wall.

ONE-EYED MAN
The good viewers of Channel Black want their finale. Kneel for camera three.

INT. VIP ROOM - NIGHT

Sun Qiang taps a remote. The glass wall between rooms clears. Zhao Ya inhales sharply.

INT. BLUE ROOM - NIGHT

Lu Yun sees them. His wife. The man who framed him. Behind the glass, untouchable.

LU YUN
(anguished howl)
Zhao Ya! You said it was a conjugal visit!

Sun Qiang's voice crackles through a speaker.

SUN QIANG (O.S.)
She lied. Shocking, I know.

He hauls Lu Yaya up to the glass. The child's face presses against it.

LU YAYA
Daddy!

ZHAO YA
(on the phone, voice honeyed)
Honey, tell him what you told me. About the money.

LU YUN
(shattered)
You sold my sentence... for a fucking VIP room?

SUN QIANG
Through the glass, he mimes a kiss at Zhao Ya. She takes the gesture, but her reflection shows a tear she won't let him see.

ZHAO YA
(into phone, breaking)
I'm his secretary now. Yaya needs a future.

SUN QIANG
(to Yaya, gentle)
Your daddy's going to sing for us. Isn't that nice?

He puts Yaya down. She runs to Zhao Ya, who turns away.

LU YUN
(screaming, to Zhao Ya)
You look at her! LOOK AT HER!

ONE-EYED MAN
(pressing a blade to Lu Yun's ear)
She's looking at her new life. Now... let's give them a show.

The smart-collar injects something. Lu Yun's body goes rigid. The One-Eyed Man whispers:

ONE-EYED MAN
Your daughter gets to watch you cry. Family entertainment.

FADE OUT.

title: Romantic Crime
description: A wealthy heiress encounters a drugged CEO at a hotel and finds herself caught in a dangerous setup orchestrated by her own sister.
context:
Title: Romantic Crime
Description: A wealthy heiress encounters a drugged CEO at a hotel and finds herself caught in a dangerous setup orchestrated by her own sister.

INT. HOTEL BATHROOM - DAY

CHI RANRAN is adjusting her makeup in front of the mirror when her phone buzzes—a single text: "Room 2808. Now."

Her jaw tightens. She pockets her phone and exits.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

HAN YU (Han Corporation CEO) slumps against the wall, sweat soaking his collar. He has been drugged.

He takes out his phone and makes a call.

HAN YU
(strained)
It's happening. Get up here.

ASSISTANT (V.O.)
(cautious)
Should I bring... cleanup?

HAN YU
Just hurry.

HAN YU pockets the phone as CHI RANRAN hurries past, barely glancing at him.

HAN YU
Wait—

He lunges, trapping her against a pillar.

CHI RANRAN
(ice cold)
Wrong woman.

She drives her knee into his ribs. As he gasps, she twists his arm behind his back.

CHI RANRAN
The stairwell's that way. Cool off.

She shoves him into the FIRE STAIRWELL and slams the door, wedging it with a stiletto heel from her clutch.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL SUITE - DAY

CHI SHUNING (Chi family second daughter) stirs powder into a crystal tumbler. This is HAN YU's suite.

CHI SHUNING (thinking)
Daddy's heir needs a scandal to match her ego. Smile for the cameras, sis.

CHI RANRAN bursts in.

CHI RANRAN
A prank text? Really?

CHI SHUNING
(innocent)
I heard screaming. Thought you were hurt.

CHI RANRAN
My head— She spots the bar. Water.

She grabs the tumbler and drinks. CHI SHUNING's lips curl.

CHI RANRAN
(sneering)
Just fought off some trust fund brat who thinks drugged means desirable.

CHI SHUNING (V.O.)
Not for long.

CHI RANRAN
The nerve of—

She stops. The room tilts.

CHI SHUNING reveals a victorious smile and snaps her fingers. The ASSISTANT emerges from the bedroom.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

CHI RANRAN stumbles into the hall. Down the corridor, two MEN in hotel uniforms spot her.

MAN (V.O.)
There! Shuning said she'd try to escape!

CHI RANRAN realizes: they're not staff. She ducks into the only open door—Han Yu's suite.

INT. HOTEL SUITE - CONTINUOUS

CHI RANRAN locks the door, breathing hard. The room spins.

She turns. HAN YU lies unconscious on the king bed, his glasses folded on the nightstand. The assistant's work.

CHI RANRAN
(sinking onto the bed)
They wanted me caught with you...

Her fingers trace his jawline—conflicted.

CHI RANRAN
You said you'd take responsibility. Fine. Let's see them explain this.

She removes his glasses and kisses him—not a victim's assault, but a player flipping the board.

title: I Conquer the World for the Empress
description: A modern man is electrocuted and transmigrates into ancient times, finding himself in the body of a eunuch tasked with serving the emperor.
context:
Title: I Conquer the World for the Empress
Description: A modern man is electrocuted and transmigrates into ancient times, finding himself in the body of a eunuch tasked with serving the emperor.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

A nervous JIANG SHENG (23) sits surrounded by history books, typing on his phone. He reads a draft message: "Sorry, I can't make it tonight."

He deletes it, retypes: "I'll be there." He hesitates, thumb hovering over send.

A HISTORY BOOK on his desk catches his eye - opened to a chapter about imperial court intrigue. He touches the page.

JIANG SHENG
(whispering)
If only I could actually do something that mattered...

His elbow knocks over a water glass. It spills toward a frayed lamp cord.

JIANG SHENG
(scrambling)
Shit—

The lamp shorts. Electricity surges through him.

JIANG SHENG
(screaming)
I haven't even lived yet!

He convulses and passes out.

EXT. ANCIENT PALACE - NIGHT

Lightning slashes across imperial rooftops. Rain hammers down.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT PALACE ROOM - NIGHT

JIANG SHENG, now in eunuch robes, clutches a heavy copper washbasin. He staggers, disoriented, through the opulent chamber.

Pale moonlight reveals blood on his temple.

A SHADOWY FIGURE moves past the window. Jiang Sheng turns—

WHACK! A hidden assailant strikes his head. He collapses.

LATER

JIANG SHENG groans, waking on cold stone. He touches his throbbing skull, then stares at his silk-robed body.

JIANG SHENG (V.O.)
Okay... not a dream. Way too much pain for a dream.

He looks down at himself, confusion mounting.

JIANG SHENG (V.O.)
Why am I dressed like—

His hand freezes mid-reach. Understanding dawns with horror.

JIANG SHENG (V.O.)
...no. Please, no.

Footsteps approach. He scrambles behind a screen.

DONGXIANG (O.S.)
Jiang-xiao? The Empress Dowager's bath grows cold.

DONGXIANG (18), a sharp-eyed palace maid, enters. She spots his boots behind the screen.

DONGXIANG
You want another beating? She dismissed three eunuchs already tonight.

JIANG SHENG steps out, voice cracking.

JIANG SHENG
I... fell. Inspecting the floor. For the Empress's safety.

DONGXIANG stares at him, then a small, knowing smile appears.

DONGXIANG
The old Jiang-xiao never spoke in complete sentences. Maybe that knock knocked some sense into you.

She turns to leave, then pauses.

DONGXIANG
Be careful. Tonight, the Empress Dowager meets with General Li. If she catches you listening at doors again, she won't just have you beaten.

She exits. Jiang Sheng stands frozen.

JIANG SHENG (V.O.)
Listening at doors? Who was I before this?

He looks toward the window. Lightning reveals the silhouette of the imperial throne room.

JIANG SHENG (V.O.)
Assassin? Spy? Or just another dead man walking?

He straightens his robes, picks up the basin, and walks toward the door with grim determination.

FADE OUT.
