title: CEO's Sweet Love
description: A family heiress is drugged and framed on the night before her wedding. Four years later, terminally ill and desperate to find her child's father, she encounters a mysterious masked man with a familiar dragon tattoo.
context:
Title: CEO's Sweet Love
Description: A family heiress is drugged and framed on the night before her wedding. Four years later, terminally ill and desperate to find her child's father, she encounters a mysterious masked man with a familiar dragon tattoo.

INT. LUXURY HOTEL SUITE - NIGHT

JI SHISHI (24), elegant but visibly disoriented, stumbles through the penthouse suite. Her reflection in the floor-to-ceiling windows shows a woman fighting through chemical fog. She clutches a torn wedding invitation.

XIAO SHENGHAN (28), CEO of Shengshi Group, stands by the window, phone to his ear. His crisp shirt is unbuttoned at the collar, revealing a distinctive dragon-shaped birthmark on his neck that resembles an intricate tattoo.

JI SHISHI
(voice slurred)
Wait... this isn't—

She reaches for him, desperate for stability. He turns. Their eyes lock. Recognition flickers—then confusion.

CLOSE-UP: The dragon birthmark seems to pulse as his jaw tightens.

They collide. Not passion—gravity. Two people falling.

INT. LUXURY HOTEL SUITE - DAY

Sunlight slices through silk curtains. JI SHISHI awakens alone, silk sheets pooled around her. She touches her temple, wincing at the tenderness. On the nightstand: a single cufflink, silver, engraved with a dragon motif.

She spots it. Her fingers close around it just as the door bursts open.

INT. JI FAMILY MANSION - DAY - CONTINUOUS

JI GUOHUA (60s, patriarch) storms in, his face stone. Behind him, WANG XUCHEN (28) hovers, his expression shattered rather than furious. JI ANAN (22) lingers in the doorway, watching like a director.

JI GUOHUA
(roaring)
The wedding is OFF! Shengshi Group's CEO saw you leave with that... that escort! Our merger is ruined!

He strikes. The slap cracks across her face. JI SHISHI's head snaps sideways—not from force, but from shock at the lie's precision.

JI SHISHI
(choked)
Dad, I was drugged. Check the hotel cameras—

JI ANAN
(stepping forward, voice honeyed)
Sister, the footage shows you drinking alone. No one else. Father's heart can't take these fabrications.

She produces a phone. On screen: JI SHISHI, seemingly lucid, ordering another drink. The timestamp loops, damning.

WANG XUCHEN
(quietly broken)
Shishi... the man you were seen with. Was he worth everything?

JI SHISHI
(turning to him, raw)
Xuchen, you know me. Twelve years—you know me.

WANG XUCHEN
I thought I did.

He turns. JI ANAN catches his sleeve—a gesture too practiced, too comforting. He doesn't shake her off.

JI ANAN
(whispering, just for JI SHISHI)
I told you. Some players don't deserve the board.

She drops a business card on the bed: "VIP Escort Services." The number is handwritten—JI SHISHI's own, from the phone she lost yesterday.

JI ANAN sweeps out, taking the men with her. JI SHISHI stares at the card. At the cufflink. Her fingers close around both.

BLACK SCREEN. TEXT APPEARS: Four Years Later
continuation:
INT. MODEST APARTMENT - NIGHT

JI SHISHI, now 28, sits by XIAOSHAN (3), her son. The diagnosis on her lap reads "Stage III Malignant Tumor—Metastasized." Her fingers trace the dragon-shaped cufflink.

JI SHISHI
(softly)
Your grandmother's jewelry paid for three years of treatment. This... this is all that's left to find him.

She tucks the cufflink into XIAOSHAN's small hand.

JI SHISHI
(whispering)
But you're worth every second of the search.

EXT. BACK ALLEYS - NIGHT

Rain slicks the brick walls. JI SHISHI, thinner but harder, staples a weatherproof flyer: "URGENT: Seeking man, mid-20s, dragon birthmark left neck. Medical emergency. Reward: mother's antique jade collection." No name. No number—just an email: dragonsearch@protonmail.com.

She turns, colliding with a MAN IN GOLDEN MASK. His collar is high, but rain has plastered his shirt to his neck. The birthmark—raised, distinct, undeniably the same—peeks above his collar.

(taking a step back)
I'm sorry—

Her eyes fix on his neck. His hand flies up, covering it. Through the mask's eyeholes, his gaze is guarded, familiar.

JI SHISHI
(barely breathing)
...you.

His fingers tighten on the birthmark. The cufflink in her pocket suddenly burns hot.

Title: CEO's Sweet Love
Description: A family heiress is drugged and framed on the night before her wedding. Four years later, terminally ill and desperate to find her child's father, she encounters a mysterious masked man with a familiar dragon tattoo.

INT. LUXURY HOTEL SUITE - NIGHT

JI SHISHI (24), elegant but visibly disoriented, stumbles through the penthouse suite. Her reflection in the floor-to-ceiling windows shows a woman fighting through chemical fog. She clutches a torn wedding invitation.

XIAO SHENGHAN (28), CEO of Shengshi Group, stands by the window, phone to his ear. His crisp shirt is unbuttoned at the collar, revealing a distinctive dragon-shaped birthmark on his neck that resembles an intricate tattoo.

JI SHISHI
(voice slurred)
Wait... this isn't—

She reaches for him, desperate for stability. He turns. Their eyes lock. Recognition flickers—then confusion.

CLOSE-UP: The dragon birthmark seems to pulse as his jaw tightens.

They collide. Not passion—gravity. Two people falling.

INT. LUXURY HOTEL SUITE - DAY

Sunlight slices through silk curtains. JI SHISHI awakens alone, silk sheets pooled around her. She touches her temple, wincing at the tenderness. On the nightstand: a single cufflink, silver, engraved with a dragon motif.

She spots it. Her fingers close around it just as the door bursts open.

INT. JI FAMILY MANSION - DAY - CONTINUOUS

JI GUOHUA (60s, patriarch) storms in, his face stone. Behind him, WANG XUCHEN (28) hovers, his expression shattered rather than furious. JI ANAN (22) lingers in the doorway, watching like a director.

JI GUOHUA
(roaring)
The wedding is OFF! Shengshi Group's CEO saw you leave with that... that escort! Our merger is ruined!

He strikes. The slap cracks across her face. JI SHISHI's head snaps sideways—not from force, but from shock at the lie's precision.

JI SHISHI
(choked)
Dad, I was drugged. Check the hotel cameras—

JI ANAN
(stepping forward, voice honeyed)
Sister, the footage shows you drinking alone. No one else. Father's heart can't take these fabrications.

She produces a phone. On screen: JI SHISHI, seemingly lucid, ordering another drink. The timestamp loops, damning.

WANG XUCHEN
(quietly broken)
Shishi... the man you were seen with. Was he worth everything?

JI SHISHI
(turning to him, raw)
Xuchen, you know me. Twelve years—you know me.

WANG XUCHEN
I thought I did.

He turns. JI ANAN catches his sleeve—a gesture too practiced, too comforting. He doesn't shake her off.

JI ANAN
(whispering, just for JI SHISHI)
I told you. Some players don't deserve the board.

(softly)

(whispering)
But you're worth every second of the search.

title: The Demon's Arrival
description: A Demon Lord defeated in battle is reborn in the modern world and must navigate his new identity while planning his return to the demon realm.
context:
Title: The Demon's Arrival
Description: A Demon Lord defeated in battle is reborn in the modern world and must navigate his new identity while planning his return to the demon realm.

INT. DEMON REALM - NIGHT

The DEMON LORD hovers above his shattered throne, surrounded by three CELESTIAL AVATARS. His armor bleeds shadows.

OPPONENT 1
Demon Lord, your reign ends here!

DEMON LORD
Then let oblivion know... I never bowed.

Abyssal lightning arcs from his fists. The avatars raise shields of pure starlight. Sparks weld cracks in reality itself.

OPPONENT 2
Your twelve legions are broken. Your human consort sealed beyond time itself. Why continue?

The DEMON LORD's hand strays to his chest—where a human heartbeat pulses faintly beneath divine armor.

DEMON LORD
(softly)
She taught me that even gods can bleed.

He unleashes a nova of blue-black fire, shattering two avatars. OPPONENT 3 rises from the ash, opening a portal that inverts gravity.

OPPONENT 3
Hahaha! The Chaos Abyss doesn't rebirth, Demon Lord. It UNMAKES!

The DEMON LORD's form unravels, atom by atom. As he vanishes, his armor disintegrates—revealing a simple SILVER NECKLACE. Human work.

The necklace falls. Clatters once. Dissolves into light.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

YE TIAN wakes with a violent gasp. Sweat-drenched sheets. Wrong body. Wrong world. He stares at his hands—too soft, too mortal. LIN YIXUE clutches the sheets, watching him.

YE TIAN (V.O.)
A thousand years of blood... undone by a heartbeat I never wanted.

LIN YIXUE
You're saying you transmigrated? Everything Ye Tian did—none of it was you?

YE TIAN
Precisely.

LIN YIXUE
Bastard... I'll destroy you.

She lunges. Ye Tian catches her wrist mid-swing. Not rough—just immovable. Her fury meets his abyss.

YE TIAN
You've already tried. Last night, with wine and tears.

He releases her. She stumbles back, not from force, but from the truth.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

Three REPORTERS and a CAMERAMAN huddle outside ROOM 1208, studying a blurry paparazzi photo on a phone—Ye Tian's face circled in red.

FEMALE REPORTER
(whispering)
Ye family's bastard heir, caught with Lin Corp's president. This is our golden ticket.

The CAMERAMAN checks his watch: 8:47 AM. He kicks the door.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

YE TIAN's head whips toward the door. His pupils dilate—inhuman. He hears the whispers, the autofocus, the heartbeat in the corridor.

YE TIAN
Four mortals. One lens. They think you're sleeping with a "bastard."

LIN YIXUE
(laughs, bitter)
Which part is the lie?

CRACK! The doorframe splinters. The lock shatters.

Ye Tian moves—not teleportation, but pure, blurring speed. He snags his jacket, drapes it over Lin Yixue, and backs into the bathroom. Light catches the SILVER NECKLACE around his throat.

REPORTERS flood in. Lin Yixue stands, jacket held like armor.

FEMALE REPORTER
Lin Yixue! Where's Ye Tian—the illegitimate heir?

MALE REPORTER 1
We have photos! He's here!

LIN YIXUE
(frozen, then... smiles)
Photos? Of me... alone?

The bathroom door clicks open. Empty. The window's glass is FROSTED with rime. A single BLACK FEATHER drifts to the tiles.

MALE REPORTER 2
What the hell... it's July.

Lin Yixue touches the frost on the sill. It's real. And for the first time, her shock becomes wonder.

FADE OUT.

title: Mr. Jiang's Beloved Wife
description: Three years ago, a woman breaks up with her dying lover to protect him from the burden of her terminal illness.
context:
Title: Mr. Jiang's Beloved Wife
Description: Three years ago, a woman breaks up with her dying lover to protect him from the burden of her terminal illness.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

SUPER: Three years ago

JIANG CI lies in a hospital bed, oxygen mask fogging with each labored breath. Bandaged hands rest on white sheets—he's reduced to tubes and tremors. His eyes track only NAN ZHI.

She stands at the foot of the bed, gripping her purse until her knuckles whiten.

NAN ZHI
You had them page me. Said it was critical. Did you think nearly dying would make me forget why I left?

JIANG CI
(whispering)
Can't... leave it like this...

NAN ZHI
You think love's a magic trick? You're breaking apart, and I'm supposed to glue myself back together waiting for pieces?

She moves closer—cruelly close—her voice a scalpel.
continuation:
NAN ZHI
You're not the future I signed up for. You're just the past that won't let go.

The heart monitor flatlines—a single, endless tone.

Nan Zhi doesn't flinch. She turns and walks out. The door clicks shut.

Jiang Ci rips at his IV, dragging himself from the bed. He crashes to the floor, bandaged fingers reaching toward the empty doorway.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Nan Zhi slides down the closed door, landing hard.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Miss Mu, you need to start treatment immediately. The cancer is aggressive. Your chances...

She shoves a fist into her mouth, biting down on her knuckles. A folded biopsy report falls from her coat.

NAN ZHI
(muffled)
Can't... let you bury yourself with me...

She curls into the space where door meets floor, shaking, soundless.

title: From Corporate Slave to Boss
description: An ordinary office worker's life is turned upside down when a freak accident causes her to swap bodies with her billionaire CEO boss.
context:
Title: From Corporate Slave to Boss
Description: An ordinary office worker's life is turned upside down when a freak accident causes her to swap bodies with her billionaire CEO boss.

INT. CITY STREET - DAY

A black Lamborghini cuts through traffic, pausing at a light.

A modest crowd of PHONE-OUTSPECTATORS jockeys for position, some waving, others muttering to friends.

GU NIANYI (28) weaves through on an electric scooter, gripping a delivery bag. She pauses, one foot down, checking her phone at the same intersection.

GU NIANYI (V.O.)
One minute you're delivering revised reports, the next you're delivering... nothing. Just trying to survive another performance review.

The Lamborghini's window rolls down. SONG RUICHEN (32) glances at his watch, impatience flickering across sharp features.

GU NIANYI (V.O.)
That's Song Ruichen. My boss. The man who once restructured an entire department between the 4th and 5th floors of an elevator ride.

TWO WOMEN beside Gu whisper, phones raised.

WOMAN 1
They say he fired his own uncle for looking at him wrong.

WOMAN 2
I'd be terrified to work for him. But god, the dental plan must be incredible.

The light changes. The Lamborghini purrs forward. Gu shakes her head, scooter humming as she turns toward a side entrance.
continuation:
INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

SONG RUICHEN strides through the lobby, two assistants scrambling to keep pace, folders extended like offerings.

GU NIANYI waits by the elevators, tapping her foot, checking her cracked phone screen. A CLEANING LADY works a mop in tight circles nearby.

GU NIANYI
(thinking)
Two minutes late. He's already upstairs. Safe.

She exhales—just as Song's entourage rounds the corner. Gu spins, steps back, and her sneaker hits the wet tile.

GU NIANYI
Shit—

She lunges for the wall, misses, and careens forward. Song turns at the sound. They collide. Heads crack. Both bodies hit the marble with sickening finality. The assistants freeze.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

GU NIANYI wakes with a jolt. Fluorescent lights sear her vision. The smell is wrong—disinfectant and expensive cologne.

Her throat feels different when she swallows. She reaches up. Her fingers find cartilage. An Adam's apple.

GU NIANYI
(thinking)
No. That's not—

She pulls back the blanket. A man's chest. A hospital gown. Her hands—no, these hands—are wrong. Too large. Too smooth.

She spots a phone on the nightstand. Not her cracked screen. The latest model, unlocked with a face she doesn't recognize until—

She holds it up. The camera shows Song Ruichen's face, pale and bruised. The screen reflects his sharp jaw, his disheveled hair, his eyes—her eyes—wide with panic.

GU NIANYI
(thinking)
...me.

title: My Junior Sister is a Hidden Boss
description: In the Tianqing era, after a war between Suyu and Ning kingdoms, Ning is defeated and forced to marry their princess to General Xiao's son. But Xiao Qifeng has other plans with the mysterious Xuannü.
context:
Title: My Junior Sister is a Hidden Boss
Description: In the Tianqing era, after a war between Suyu and Ning kingdoms, Ning is defeated and forced to marry their princess to General Xiao's son. But Xiao Qifeng has other plans with the mysterious Xuannü.

INT. WEDDING CHAMBER - DAY

NARRATOR (V.O.)
In the first year of Tianqing, the kingdoms of Suyu and Ning went to war, and Ning was defeated. To secure the release of thirty thousand prisoners held in Suyu, Ning was forced to marry their princess to Xiao Qifeng, son of Suyu's great general.

XIAO QIFENG, dressed in casual clothes, sits at a table, calmly playing with a chess piece. His expression is indifferent.

A FRIEND enters, wearing the red wedding robe that should belong to XIAO QIFENG.

FRIEND
Your wedding robe fits me pretty well.

XIAO QIFENG
(without looking up)
Then you go bow at the altar for me.

FRIEND
(surprised)
You're truly refusing? Xiao Qifeng eloping with his junior sister from the Tianming Bureau—every hunter in the empire will chase you.

XUANNÜ enters through the balcony window.
continuation:
XUANNÜ
Who said I'm eloping?

XUANNÜ walks up to XIAO QIFENG.

XUANNÜ
I want to do this openly.

XUANNÜ points at XIAO QIFENG.

XUANNÜ
You - will not marry the Ning princess. Refuse the marriage. Marry me.

XUANNÜ throws a scroll toward XIAO QIFENG.

XUANNÜ
Do you dare?

XIAO QIFENG catches the scroll and looks at XUANNÜ. His fingers tighten around it.

XUANNÜ
(softly)
Senior Brother?

Golden light shimmers across XUANNÜ's face, her eyes determined.

title: Supreme Merchant Emperor: Starting from Refusing to Marry In
description: The new Merchant Emperor of the Universal Commerce Alliance returns to his birthplace in humble disguise, carrying a priceless gift for his past.
context:
Title: Supreme Merchant Emperor: Starting from Refusing to Marry In
Description: The new Merchant Emperor of the Universal Commerce Alliance returns to his birthplace in humble disguise, carrying a priceless gift for his past.

EXT. CROSS-SEA BRIDGE - DAY

A convoy of BLACK SUVs speeds across the suspension bridge, their tinted windows reflecting the morning sun.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The new Merchant Emperor of the Universal Commerce Alliance is arriving in Sea Sky City. All welcoming parties, proceed to the central plaza.

EXT. TRAIN STATION PLAZA - DAY

YE JIUJIANG, in plain work clothes, carries a worn canvas bag as he exits the station. His eyes scan the transformed cityscape—a mixture of memory and assessment.

YE JIUJIANG
(to himself)
Sea Sky. I'm back.

ZHAO JIA, sharp suit and controlled bearing, approaches with measured steps. He stops at a respectful distance.

ZHAO JIA
Young Master. The Heart of the Universe. Secured as requested.

ZHAO JIA opens a jewelry box. The blue gemstone seems to hold galaxies within.

ZHAO JIA
(quietly)
The Jiang family has... prospered. Under our discreet guidance.

A WOMAN in designer sunglasses, arm-in-arm with a LOCAL THUG, brushes past Ye Jiujiang.

WOMAN
Hey! You almost ripped my dress, you filthy—

LOCAL THUG
(shoving forward)
Apologize. Now. Or I break your fingers.

He raises his hand. Zhao Jia's hand flashes out, catching the wrist.

ZHAO JIA
(low, dangerous)
Touch him and lose the hand.

LOCAL THUG
(struggling)
Who do you think—this is my territory! I'm connected!

A row of Rolls-Royces enters the plaza, surrounding it. BODYGUARDS in black suits exit.

BODYGUARD
(calm, amplified)
Clear the area. All civilians, withdraw.

The LOCAL THUG sees the insignia on the vehicles. His face drains of color.

LOCAL THUG
(terrified)
Four Great Families... City Lord...
continuation:
YE JIUJIANG frowns, turning away.

YE JIUJIANG
Zhao Jia. I said no display.

ZHAO JIA
(following)
I contained it, Young Master.

YE JIUJIANG walks toward the plaza's edge. The DIGNITARIES arrive, approaching Zhao Jia with cupped-fist bows.

HAN LIANCHENG
City Lord Han Liancheng welcomes the Merchant Emperor.

LI KUOHAI
Li Group presents East Sea Pearls.

MA WUDI
Ma Group presents Tang Yin's "Sunset and Solitary Wild Duck."

SONG CHONG
Song Group presents a thousand taels of gold.

JIANG YUANHENG
Jiang Yuanheng, patriarch, presenting a pearl branch.

ZHAO JIA
The Emperor traveled by rail to avoid this. You've missed him.

HAN LIANCHENG
(regretfully)
To miss the dragon's face...

LI KUOHAI
Star Group's establishment here will reshape commerce. We must host a proper banquet.

SONG CHONG
Then we should finalize arrangements between our families.

JIANG YUANHENG
(to Song Chong)
Precisely what I was thinking.

EXT. JIANG FAMILY MANSION - DAY

Ye Jiujiang stands before the traditional mansion. His grip tightens on the canvas bag.

YE JIUJIANG
(quietly)
This is where she died.

A young man, JIANG FAMILY HEIR, exits. He spots Ye Jiujiang.

JIANG FAMILY HEIR
(disgusted)
Guards! Remove this beggar!

FLASHBACK - YE JIUJIANG'S POV: A woman's hand slipping from his as she's dragged through these gates. Her voice echoes: "Live well, my son."
full_script:
Title: Supreme Merchant Emperor: Starting from Refusing to Marry In
Description: The new Merchant Emperor of the Universal Commerce Alliance returns to his birthplace in humble disguise, carrying a priceless gift for his past.

EXT. CROSS-SEA BRIDGE - DAY

A convoy of BLACK SUVs speeds across the suspension bridge, their tinted windows reflecting the morning sun.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The new Merchant Emperor of the Universal Commerce Alliance is arriving in Sea Sky City. All welcoming parties, proceed to the central plaza.

EXT. TRAIN STATION PLAZA - DAY

YE JIUJIANG, in plain work clothes, carries a worn canvas bag as he exits the station. His eyes scan the transformed cityscape—a mixture of memory and assessment.

YE JIUJIANG
(to himself)
Sea Sky. I'm back.

ZHAO JIA, sharp suit and controlled bearing, approaches with measured steps. He stops at a respectful distance.

ZHAO JIA
Young Master. The Heart of the Universe. Secured as requested.

ZHAO JIA opens a jewelry box. The blue gemstone seems to hold galaxies within.

ZHAO JIA
(quietly)
The Jiang family has... prospered. Under our discreet guidance.

A WOMAN in designer sunglasses, arm-in-arm with a LOCAL THUG, brushes past Ye Jiujiang.

WOMAN
Hey! You almost ripped my dress, you filthy—

LOCAL THUG
(shoving forward)
Apologize. Now. Or I break your fingers.

He raises his hand. Zhao Jia's hand flashes out, catching the wrist.

ZHAO JIA
(low, dangerous)
Touch him and lose the hand.

LOCAL THUG
(struggling)
Who do you think—this is my territory! I'm connected!

A row of Rolls-Royces enters the plaza, surrounding it. BODYGUARDS in black suits exit.

BODYGUARD
(calm, amplified)
Clear the area. All civilians, withdraw.

The LOCAL THUG sees the insignia on the vehicles. His face drains of color.

LOCAL THUG
(terrified)
Four Great Families... City Lord...

YE JIUJIANG frowns, turning away.

YE JIUJIANG
Zhao Jia. I said no display.

ZHAO JIA
(following)
I contained it, Young Master.

YE JIUJIANG walks toward the plaza's edge. The DIGNITARIES arrive, approaching Zhao Jia with cupped-fist bows.

HAN LIANCHENG
City Lord Han Liancheng welcomes the Merchant Emperor.

LI KUOHAI
Li Group presents East Sea Pearls.

MA WUDI
Ma Group presents Tang Yin's "Sunset and Solitary Wild Duck."

SONG CHONG
Song Group presents a thousand taels of gold.

JIANG YUANHENG
Jiang Yuanheng, patriarch, presenting a pearl branch.

ZHAO JIA
The Emperor traveled by rail to avoid this. You've missed him.

HAN LIANCHENG
(regretfully)
To miss the dragon's face...

LI KUOHAI
Star Group's establishment here will reshape commerce. We must host a proper banquet.

SONG CHONG
Then we should finalize arrangements between our families.

JIANG YUANHENG
(to Song Chong)
Precisely what I was thinking.

EXT. JIANG FAMILY MANSION - DAY

Ye Jiujiang stands before the traditional mansion. His grip tightens on the canvas bag.

YE JIUJIANG
(quietly)
This is where she died.

A young man, JIANG FAMILY HEIR, exits. He spots Ye Jiujiang.

JIANG FAMILY HEIR
(disgusted)
Guards! Remove this beggar!

FLASHBACK - YE JIUJIANG'S POV: A woman's hand slipping from his as she's dragged through these gates. Her voice echoes: "Live well, my son."

title: The Pig Castrator's Debt
description: A skilled pig castrator living a humble life is sought out by a wealthy heiress to repay a life-saving debt, but finds her methods more insulting than grateful.
context:
Title: The Pig Castrator's Debt
Description: A skilled pig castrator living a humble life is sought out by a wealthy heiress to repay a life-saving debt, but finds her methods more insulting than grateful.

INT. PIG PEN - DAY

In the dim passageway of a pig pen, a muscular man in a black tank top and apron, XIAO FAN, sits with his back to the camera on a small stool. A whetstone sits on the table in front of him.

CLOSE UP - XIAO FAN's hands sharpen a slender surgical knife on the whetstone with methodical precision.

XIAO FAN picks up the sharpened knife and examines it against the light, his expression focused and meditative.

In the pig pen, a pig pokes its head out, looking curiously.

XIAO FAN turns around, his face bearing a professional calm.

In a bowl of clear water, two purple objects bubble gently.

In the pig pen, several pigs stir restlessly, squealing.

XIAO FAN stands up, wearing black pants and boots, and strides deeper into the pig pen. He holds the knife with practiced ease.

He stops, looking at the pigs ahead with quiet authority.

CUT TO:

EXT. OUTSIDE PIG PEN - DAY

A luxurious Maybach pulls up in a cloud of dust. The door opens.

A woman in a sequined dress with an elegant figure, NANGONG XUE, steps out. She surveys the surroundings with subtle distaste.

CUT BACK TO:

INT. PIG PEN - DAY

XIAO FAN hears the commotion, turns around, playing with two surgical knives in his hands, his expression unreadable.

CUT TO:

EXT. OUTSIDE PIG PEN - DAY

A hen walks leisurely on the dirt road.

NANGONG XUE approaches with several BODYGUARDS in suits and two ASSISTANTS in qipao dresses. The assistants carry ornate trays.

CUT TO:

EXT. PIG PEN ENTRANCE - DAY

XIAO FAN pokes his head out from behind the door curtain, watching the visitors with weary recognition.

XIAO FAN
Nangong family always did have lousy timing.

NANGONG XUE and her entourage stop at a weathered table in the courtyard.

NANGONG XUE
Mr. Xiao. I've come to fulfill my obligation.

XIAO FAN walks out, drying his hands on a stained towel. He looks at them with quiet impatience.

XIAO FAN
Your brother's surgery was two years ago. The debt is paid.

NANGONG XUE
Not to me. To the family that saved him from that accident.

She snaps her fingers.

Two qipao-clad assistants step forward. One tray holds car keys, the other several stacks of RMB. One bodyguard carries a case filled with US dollars, another holds a plate of gold bars.

NANGONG XUE
50 gold bars, a Ferrari, 30 million in cash. Standard gratitude package.

XIAO FAN picks up a cloth and wipes his tools without looking up.

XIAO FAN
I castrated pigs to pay for medical school. Your brother got the care he needed. We're even.

NANGONG XUE
Mr. Xiao, if you find these gifts too cumbersome...

NANGONG XUE takes out a black bank card.

NANGONG XUE
This card contains 100 million. And my personal promise of marriage. The Nangong family doesn't leave debts unpaid.

XIAO FAN stops what he's doing and looks up, his jaw tight.

XIAO FAN
You think you can buy me because I work with my hands?

NANGONG XUE
(confused)
It's not a purchase. It's appreciation.
continuation:
XIAO FAN
Appreciation doesn't come with price tags. Can you castrate a pig?

NANGONG XUE
(offended)
What?

XIAO FAN
That's what I thought. If you can't do what I do, you don't respect what I do. Just your money.

A bald BODYGUARD can't hold back and steps forward.

BODYGUARD
Show some respect! Miss Nangong traveled 800 kilometers!

NANGONG XUE
(sternly, without looking at him)
Stand down.

The bodyguard reluctantly steps back.

NANGONG XUE
(quietly)
My brother was in that factory explosion. You carried him three miles to the hospital. The Nangong name means nothing if we can't honor that.

XIAO FAN
You already did. He sent one thank you card. That was enough.

XIAO FAN turns to leave.

NANGONG XUE
(urgently)
I dissolved my engagement for this! My family thinks I've lost my mind!

XIAO FAN stops, shoulders tense.

XIAO FAN
That's your choice. Not my burden.

NANGONG XUE
Let me... let me understand your life. Please.

XIAO FAN looks back at her, seeing genuine desperation beneath the privilege.

XIAO FAN
Feed the pigs. The ones in the back pen haven't eaten. If you can do that without complaining, we'll talk.

The bodyguard is about to react again.

BODYGUARD
Miss, you can't—

NANGONG XUE
I will.

She walks toward the pig pen, hesitating only slightly at the smell.

TRANSITION

INT. PIG PEN - LATER

NANGONG XUE's designer dress is smeared with mud. She scoops feed with shaking hands, but her expression has softened. The pigs jostle around her.

XIAO FAN watches from the doorway, his expression shifting.

CUT TO:

EXT. COURTYARD - SUNSET

XIAO FAN hands NANGONG XUE a simple porcelain cup of hot water. She's cleaned up, but her manicure is ruined.

XIAO FAN
My wife died three years ago. Leukemia. I came back here to remember what real things feel like.

NANGONG XUE
(sincerely)
I didn't know.

XIAO FAN
Now you do. Your gratitude? It's a performance. Real gratitude is quiet. It's letting people keep their dignity.

NANGONG XUE looks at the calluses on his hands, then at her own.

NANGONG XUE
What if I want to learn the quiet kind?

XIAO FAN
Then come back next month. With work clothes. And no entourage.

He walks back toward the pig pen, then calls over his shoulder:

XIAO FAN
And Miss Nangong? Leave the Ferrari. The roads here will ruin it.

She watches him disappear into the pen, a small, genuine smile forming.

FADE OUT.

title: The Queen's High Heels
description: A woman attends a garden party with her lover, but a pair of crystal-studded high heels triggers a deadly turn of events.
context:
Title: The Queen's High Heels
Description: A woman attends a garden party with her lover, but a pair of crystal-studded high heels triggers a deadly turn of events.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - NIGHT

A woman in a silver sequined evening gown walks barefoot across the floor.

She approaches a display stand where a pair of crystal-studded high heels sits under a glass dome.

She lifts the glass dome and takes the high heels.

EXT. GARDEN PARTY - NIGHT

At the party, guests mingle with champagne glasses, the atmosphere lively. A champagne tower sparkles.

LI SHANGJUN gazes affectionately at RUOXI.

LI SHANGJUN
Seven years. Will you give me the next seventy to prove I deserve you?

RUOXI
(tearfully)
You always did know how to make an exit impossible.

LI SHANGJUN
Then you'll accept?

RUOXI
I will.

Guests applaud and cheer.

LI SHANGJUN and RUOXI begin to dance, gazing deeply into each other's eyes.

MONTAGE - A series of quick flashback shots

- LI SHANGJUN and another woman (MISTRESS) intimate in bed.
- LI SHANGJUN and MISTRESS embracing in a bathroom.
- RUOXI alone, testing the crystal shoe studs against her palm, a drop of blood falling.
continuation:
END MONTAGE

Back to the party scene.

RUOXI suddenly staggers while dancing, her expression pained. She is wearing the sparkling high heels.

She bends over, gasping in pain.

RUOXI
(whispering)
I wanted... to walk away...

A GUEST screams.

GUEST
Murder!

The music stops abruptly. Everyone looks toward the screaming guest.

LI SHANGJUN and RUOXI also look over in surprise.

Suddenly, RUOXI'S body goes limp and she collapses into LI SHANGJUN'S arms.

LI SHANGJUN
(panicking)
Ruoxi!

LI SHANGJUN holds the fallen RUOXI, shaking her anxiously.

LI SHANGJUN
Ruoxi! Are you okay, Ruoxi?

He sees his hands are covered in blood from her feet.

Guests cover their mouths in horror.

LI SHANGJUN
(shouting)
Call an ambulance!

title: You Are My Thousands of Stars
description: A woman is framed for pushing her husband's mistress down the stairs, leading to the destruction of her family and a decade of love ending in betrayal.
context:
Title: You Are My Thousands of Stars
Description: A woman is framed for pushing her husband's mistress down the stairs, leading to the destruction of her family and a decade of love ending in betrayal.

INT. MANSION STAIRCASE - NIGHT

TANG SHI screams as she is pushed down the spiral staircase.

TANG SHI (V.O.)
My name is Tang Shi. I thought tonight's accident would shatter my decade with Bo Ye. Instead, it opened the door to an abyss I never saw coming.

Overhead shot: another woman, AN MI, lies crumpled in a pool of blood at the bottom of the staircase.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

BO YE grips TANG SHI's throat, pinning her against the wall.

BO YE
You pushed her.

BO YE throws a divorce agreement at TANG SHI's feet.

BO YE
Sign it. Then spend your life atoning for two lives.

TANG SHI
(choking)
I didn't—I watched her fall—

BO YE
The cameras show otherwise.

TANG SHI
Bo Ye, we've built ten years together.

BO YE
Then consider them a foundation of lies.

BO YE delivers a sharp backhand across TANG SHI's face.

BO YE
Did you think a signature would end this?

TANG SHI
What more do you want from me?

BO YE
Your family. Reduced to dust.

TANG SHI
Bo Ye, I am your wife! Wasn't An Mi—

BO YE
Wife? If you hadn't trapped me with tricks, you'd never have been worthy of my shadow.

TANG SHI
If you ever learn the truth...

BO YE
The only truth is your betrayal.
continuation:
EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

A news voiceover reports Tang Shi, once-heiress of Tang Group, faces murder charges as the company stock plunges.

BO YE marches TANG SHI through a gauntlet of reporters summoned by his anonymous tip.

REPORTER (O.S.)
Young Master Bo! Did your wife's jealousy know any bounds?

BO YE forces Tang Shi before a trembling man clutching an urn.

BO YE
Beg for her forgiveness.

BO YE's hand crushes down on Tang Shi's shoulder, driving her toward the ground.

BO YE
Kneel.

BO YE seizes the urn and hurls it against a marble monument. Ashes explode across the grass.

BO YE
You dared to hesitate.

LIN CI, Bo Ye's assistant, approaches with a document.

LIN CI
The acquisition is complete. Every asset is frozen.

BO YE
A parting gift. I hope you find it... comprehensive.

The reporters' whispers rise like a tide.

REPORTER (O.S.)
Murderess in bridal white. Young Master Bo showed remarkable restraint.

POLICE OFFICERS emerge from the crowd, cuffs glinting.

TANG SHI
(desolate)
You summoned them. My only crime was loving you.

The officers shackle Tang Shi and lead her away. Bo Ye watches, motionless, as she disappears through the gates.

TANG SHI (V.O.)
Five years longing. Five years dying. All to become his perfect scapegoat.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Reverse Scale
description: After ten years guarding the border, the legendary God of War returns home, but declines the grand ceremony prepared in his honor.
context:
Title: Reverse Scale
Description: After ten years guarding the border, the legendary God of War returns home, but declines the grand ceremony prepared in his honor.

EXT. DAXIA BORDER - NIGHT

Three horses gallop through darkness, skidding to a halt at a granite marker: "DAXIA BORDER - GODS FORBIDDEN TO PASS." The riders—MAN TU (The Slaughterer), TIAN NU (Heaven's Wrath), and LILITH, the Heaven List's elite—catch their breath, eyes on the border.

LILITH
The border. We're almost—

TIAN NU
(laughing, touching the marker)
"Gods Forbidden"? Just words on stone.

MAN TU
We failed the contract.

TIAN NU
The Emperor still bleeds. There's always tomorrow.

MAN TU
The Underworld Emperor's hunters are close. Mount up.

LILITH
Wait—

A blade RINGS. Above, YE TIANCHEN stands on the cliff in silver armor, sword drawn.

YE TIANCHEN
The Heaven List's finest. All three.

MAN TU
Who—

YE TIANCHEN
Daxia's law is simple: Gods forbidden, trespassers forfeit. You drew blades on our soil. Now leave them here.

YE TIANCHEN raises his sword. It hums with suppressed power. Text appears on screen: YE TIANCHEN - DAXIA'S GOD OF WAR.

MAN TU
The Emperor's Hound.

TIAN NU
World-suppressor,
continuation:
LILITH
The undefeated.

TIAN NU
(disdainful)
Titles for children. Your "Underworld Emperor" couldn't take us together. Can you?

MAN TU
Together then. Tian Nu, center. Lilith, flank.

TIAN NU
Watch me.

TIAN NU vaults from his horse, blade screaming through the air. YE TIANCHEN doesn't move. One parry, one strike. Tian Nu crashes down, his blade shattered, blood on his lips.

MAN TU and LILITH don't wait. They spur their horses in opposite directions.

TIAN NU
(gurgling)
Traitors...

YE TIANCHEN
No one leaves.

He flicks his wrist. His sword becomes two streaks of light, piercing MAN TU and LILITH before their horses complete a stride. Both slump from their saddles, dead.

Headlights sweep the ridge. Three military jeeps screech to a halt. UNDERWORLD EMPEROR, commander of Daxia's shadow legion, steps out with elite troopers. They keep respectful distance.

YE TIANCHEN
Commander.

UNDERWORLD EMPEROR
The Council wanted prisoners for interrogation.

YE TIANCHEN
They drew steel. The law is clear.

The UNDERWORLD EMPEROR salutes.

UNDERWORLD EMPEROR
Ten years, Teacher. The Emperor requests your presence at the capital. A celebration. National broadcast.

YE TIANCHEN
Tell him the term is served. I'm going home.

YE TIANCHEN walks past, sheathing his sword. The UNDERWORLD EMPEROR watches him go, then signals his troops to secure the bodies.
full_script:
Title: Reverse Scale
Description: After ten years guarding the border, the legendary God of War returns home, but declines the grand ceremony prepared in his honor.

EXT. DAXIA BORDER - NIGHT

Three horses gallop through darkness, skidding to a halt at a granite marker: "DAXIA BORDER - GODS FORBIDDEN TO PASS." The riders—MAN TU (The Slaughterer), TIAN NU (Heaven's Wrath), and LILITH, the Heaven List's elite—catch their breath, eyes on the border.

LILITH
The border. We're almost—

TIAN NU
(laughing, touching the marker)
"Gods Forbidden"? Just words on stone.

MAN TU
We failed the contract.

TIAN NU
The Emperor still bleeds. There's always tomorrow.

MAN TU
The Underworld Emperor's hunters are close. Mount up.

LILITH
Wait—

A blade RINGS. Above, YE TIANCHEN stands on the cliff in silver armor, sword drawn.

YE TIANCHEN
The Heaven List's finest. All three.

MAN TU
Who—

YE TIANCHEN
Daxia's law is simple: Gods forbidden, trespassers forfeit. You drew blades on our soil. Now leave them here.

YE TIANCHEN raises his sword. It hums with suppressed power. Text appears on screen: YE TIANCHEN - DAXIA'S GOD OF WAR.

MAN TU
The Emperor's Hound.

TIAN NU
World-suppressor,

LILITH
The undefeated.

TIAN NU
(disdainful)
Titles for children. Your "Underworld Emperor" couldn't take us together. Can you?

MAN TU
Together then. Tian Nu, center. Lilith, flank.

TIAN NU
Watch me.

TIAN NU vaults from his horse, blade screaming through the air. YE TIANCHEN doesn't move. One parry, one strike. Tian Nu crashes down, his blade shattered, blood on his lips.

MAN TU and LILITH don't wait. They spur their horses in opposite directions.

TIAN NU
(gurgling)
Traitors...

YE TIANCHEN
No one leaves.

He flicks his wrist. His sword becomes two streaks of light, piercing MAN TU and LILITH before their horses complete a stride. Both slump from their saddles, dead.

Headlights sweep the ridge. Three military jeeps screech to a halt. UNDERWORLD EMPEROR, commander of Daxia's shadow legion, steps out with elite troopers. They keep respectful distance.

YE TIANCHEN
Commander.

UNDERWORLD EMPEROR
The Council wanted prisoners for interrogation.

YE TIANCHEN
They drew steel. The law is clear.

The UNDERWORLD EMPEROR salutes.

UNDERWORLD EMPEROR
Ten years, Teacher. The Emperor requests your presence at the capital. A celebration. National broadcast.

YE TIANCHEN
Tell him the term is served. I'm going home.

YE TIANCHEN walks past, sheathing his sword. The UNDERWORLD EMPEROR watches him go, then signals his troops to secure the bodies.

title: Peerless Divine Doctor
description: Lin Tianxuan, a top family heir, is betrayed by his fiancée and left for dead. A mysterious jade pendant awakens ancient medical knowledge within him, giving him a second chance at life and revenge.
context:
Title: Peerless Divine Doctor
Description: Lin Tianxuan, a top family heir, is betrayed by his fiancée and left for dead. A mysterious jade pendant awakens ancient medical knowledge within him, giving him a second chance at life and revenge.

INT. WILDERNESS - DAY

LIN TIANXUAN lies on rain-slicked grass, motionless and bloodied.

Two women, WOMAN A and WOMAN B, drag LIN TIANXUAN's body.

WOMAN A
(straining)
They said he's a goner. Saves his fiancée the hospital fees.

WOMAN A
(glancing around, lower)
Rich people problems. Let's dump and go.

They push LIN TIANXUAN down a slope. His head strikes a rock with a THUD.

LIN TIANXUAN's fingers twitch. The jade pendant around his neck emits a RED GLOW, pulsing like a heartbeat.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Lin Tianxuan, heir to Jiangdu's top elite family. Framed by his fiancée and her accomplice. His sister, Lin Xin'er, is also missing.

LIN TIANXUAN sits up, eyes clear but haunted. He looks at the pendant in his hand—his wounds GLOW faintly, knitting closed.

LIN TIANXUAN
(quiet horror)
Medicine Emperor's Heart Sutra...?
continuation:
INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - NIGHT

SHEN MEI sits on the sofa, smiling as she studies a tablet.

SHEN MEI
Xiaoxue. Our patience pays off.

BAI XUE, wearing a red dress, walks over gracefully. QI TIANCHENG steps forward, takes her hand and kisses it.

QI TIANCHENG
Apologies for the delay, my love. But we must be discreet until the Lin estate is ours.

BAI XUE
looks at QI TIANCHENG, a slight smile at the corner of her mouth.

BAI XUE
Tomorrow. Then we celebrate properly.

QI TIANCHENG
(toasts)
To tying up loose ends.

EXT. LIN FAMILY COURTYARD - NIGHT

LIN TIANXUAN walks alone in the courtyard of his family's estate, his eyes determined and cold.

LIN TIANXUAN
(voice low, trembling)
Heaven gave me a second chance. You took everything.

He crushes a dry leaf in his fist. It turns to ash.

LIN TIANXUAN
(quiet, deadly)
I won't let you go. I'll take it all back.

title: Absolute Devotion
description: A bride discovers her groom's betrayal with her best friend on their wedding day, only to be rescued by a mysterious man.
context:
Title: Absolute Devotion
Description: A bride discovers her groom's betrayal with her best friend on their wedding day, only to be rescued by a mysterious man.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

A grand and romantic wedding is taking place. The groom SHEN YUNLANG and bride QIN YAN stand on stage.

OFFICIANT
Groom, what do you most want to say to the bride at this moment?

SHEN YUNLANG
(affectionately)
I love you, Weiwei.

QIN YAN's expression freezes instantly.

OFFICIANT
(confused)
Isn't the bride's name Qin Yan?

OFFICIANT
(smoothing things over)
Ah, it must be that our groom is getting married for the first time and is too nervous. Come, let's say it again. Who do you really love?

SHEN YUNLANG
I love you, Weiwei.

QIN YAN slaps SHEN YUNLANG—not in fury, but in finality.

QIN YAN
My name is Qin Yan.

She notices the scratch marks on his neck.

QIN YAN
(quietly)
Shen Yunlang, those marks—

WANG WEI (O.S.)
They're mine.

WANG WEI, wearing a red dress, walks into the wedding venue.

QIN YAN
(shattered)
Wang Wei. Not you.

WANG WEI
I've always been me, Qin Yan. You just never looked.

WANG WEI walks to SHEN YUNLANG's side.

WANG WEI
continuation:
We were going to tell you. After.

SHEN YUNLANG
After the company went public. After the shares vested.

SHEN'S MOTHER stands.

SHEN'S MOTHER
This is business, Qin Yan. Wang Wei's father controls three suppliers. You control nothing.

WANG WEI
(to Qin Yan)
You've been... useful. But Yunlang needs a partner, not a patron.

QIN YAN
I mortgaged my mother's house for you.

SHEN YUNLANG
You chose to. I chose her.

QIN YAN removes her ring.

QIN YAN
I'm not going through with this.

She drops the ring. It rolls across the floor.

SHEN YUNLANG
Then get out. You're thirty-one, exhausted, with our company's debt in your name. Enjoy bankruptcy.

A man's voice.

MYSTERIOUS MAN (O.S.)
The Shen family is truly bullying people too much.

A handsome MYSTERIOUS MAN pushes through the door.

MYSTERIOUS MAN
If you won't marry her, I will.

He extends a hand to Qin Yan. Not for rescue, but for alliance.

MYSTERIOUS MAN
My legal team is outside. They specialize in corporate fraud. And broken contracts.

QIN YAN looks at the hand. Then at Shen's face, pale now. At Wang Wei's hand gripping his arm.

QIN YAN
(to Shen)
I built you. I'll unbuild you.

She takes the MYSTERIOUS MAN's hand. Not as a bride, but as a warrior.

FADE OUT.

title: My Black Lotus Princess
description: A woman betrayed by her lover and sister discovers the truth too late, as the Regent King arrives to save her.
context:
Title: My Black Lotus Princess
Description: A woman betrayed by her lover and sister discovers the truth too late, as the Regent King arrives to save her.

INT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

Snow falls, turning to slush where it meets blood. TANG SHI, crimson bridal robes now torn and dark, lies crumpled in the spreading stain. ZHOU NIAONIAO stands over her, silver dagger glinting. SONG LIN watches from the pavilion shadows.

ZHOU NIAONIAO
(toying with the blade)
Ten fingers to the heart, they say. Does it hurt, sister? You look like a dog in the street. But you chose this. You chose to shame yourself for a prince who never wanted you.

TANG SHI
(struggling to lift her head)
Song Lin... you swore on our child's grave...

SONG LIN
(chuckling)

SONG LIN crouches, seizing her jaw.

SONG LIN
I swore to give you what you deserve. You believed my lies about Song Ci. You delivered your family's secrets. You built my empire.

TANG SHI
(shocked)
Song Ci... you said he murdered...

ZHOU NIAONIAO
The Regent King chose you over his throne. A mistake I'll correct. You'll die together, and I'll be queen.

TANG SHI
(spitting blood)
You'll both die screaming.

ZHOU NIAONIAO
You'll scream first.

ZHOU NIAONIAO drives the dagger into Tang Shi's shoulder.

TANG SHI
(screaming)
Ah!

ZHOU NIAONIAO
Tang Shi.
continuation:
ZHOU NIAONIAO slices a ribbon of flesh from the wound's edge.

ZHOU NIAONIAO
(examining the flesh)
They say a piece of the heart, fed to kin, damns them through lifetimes. Let's test it.

SONG LIN
Be careful not to kill her. We need Song Ci to see this.

ZHOU NIAONIAO
The best part is his arrival.

SONG LIN gags Tang Shi with red silk. Two SOLDIERS drag the bound GENERAL TANG forward.

ZHOU NIAONIAO
General Tang. You must be hungry.

GENERAL TANG
(forced to kneel)
Zhou Niaoniao! Where is my daughter!

ZHOU NIAONIAO forcibly stuffs the flesh into GENERAL TANG's mouth.

GENERAL TANG
(muffled, choking)
No! Ah Shi!

ZHOU NIAONIAO
(laughing triumphantly)
Does it taste good? Her heart's flesh. Now you're bound forever.

ZHOU NIAONIAO laughs.

GENERAL TANG
(breaking down)
Ah Shi! My girl!

GENERAL TANG struggles and crawls toward TANG SHI.

GUARD (O.S.)
The Regent King! The courtyard!

Regent King SONG CI bursts through the gates, sword clearing its sheath. Guards fall around him.

SONG CI
(eyes cold as ice)
Who dares touch my wife?

title: The Last Confession
description: A dying woman records a final message to the man she has always loved, revealing a truth buried since childhood, moments before he returns to accuse her of betrayal.
context:
Title: The Last Confession
Description: A dying woman records a final message to the man she has always loved, revealing a truth buried since childhood, moments before he returns to accuse her of betrayal.

INT. SU FAMILY VILLA - BEDROOM - NIGHT

A camera is mounted on a tripod, its red light glowing. YE QINXIN sits on the bed, holding a silver ring.

YE QINXIN
Xiao Jiu... I know I promised never to call you that again. I'm dying. Weeks, maybe days. And I lied to you. When you asked at eighteen why I said yes, I told you it was gratitude. For the Ye family adopting me after the earthquake.

YE QINXIN looks at the ring.

YE QINXIN
But gratitude doesn't make a girl steal her rescuer's jacket and sleep with it for three months. I loved you since I was eight years old, when you pulled me from the rubble. You just never let yourself see it.

Footsteps sound on the stairs. YE QINXIN's expression turns panicked. She hides the ring and turns off the camera.

SU YUNJING enters the room.

YE QINXIN
Xiao Jiu, you're back.

SU YUNJING's face is dark. He strides forward and grabs YE QINXIN by the throat.

SU YUNJING
(angrily)
Don't call me that. You lost that right when you killed my brother.

SU YUNJING throws YE QINXIN onto the bed.

SU YUNJING removes his tie and blindfolds YE QINXIN with it, tying her to the bedframe.

YE QINXIN lies on the bed, blindfolded.
continuation:
YE QINXIN
(weakly)
Do you hate me this much?

SU YUNJING
(coldly)
You betrayed me with him. Got pregnant with his child. Then let him die in that car. Tell me why I shouldn't hate you.

YE QINXIN
Because the child was yours. That night at the lake house, before the accident. Because I was trying to save him from Ye Ruoyao's men. Because my fingerprints on that wrench were from trying to fix what they'd broken.

SU YUNJING
(shouting)
Yaoyao's in a coma because of you! She's fighting for her life while you—

His phone rings. He answers.

SU YUNJING
(into the phone)
What? ...She's awake? I'll be there.

SU YUNJING hangs up.

SU YUNJING
Tomorrow, I'm divorcing you.

SU YUNJING turns and leaves.

YE QINXIN removes the blindfold. She retrieves the camera from under the pillow and turns it on.

YE QINXIN
(to camera)
Live well, Xiao Jiu. Since you finally learned how to let me go.

title: After Divorce, My Ex-Husband's Uncle Spoiled Me
description: A woman betrayed by her husband and sister finds unexpected romance with a mysterious stranger after a drunken night.
context:
Title: After Divorce, My Ex-Husband's Uncle Spoiled Me
Description: A woman betrayed by her husband and sister finds unexpected romance with a mysterious stranger after a drunken night.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

A melancholic melody plays. SU NING and the handsome QIN SIYUE share a wine-tinged kiss that gradually deepens on the hotel bed, their silhouettes merging in the dim light.

ON SCREEN: HOTEL

INT. HUO ZICHENG'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Tense strings rise.

HUO ZICHENG hurls a stack of photos onto the bed where SU NING sits frozen. The images spill across the quilt—each showing a woman unmistakably Su Ning in a hotel room.

ON SCREEN: HUO ZICHENG'S HOUSE

SU NING's hands tremble as she picks up a photo.

HUO ZICHENG
(fury barely contained)
Your private investigator? These are from mine. The woman has your scar. Your necklace. Your watch. Explain.

SU NING
(quietly desperate)
Zicheng, someone forged these. We pledged trust—

HUO ZICHENG
(grabbing her arms, pulling her close)
Trust? While I was building our future, you were in another man's bed. I gave you everything.

He shoves her back, snatches a belt from the dresser, and cracks it against the wall beside her head. She flinches. Plaster crumbles.

SU NING
(gasp of terror)

INT. SU NING'S HOUSE BEDROOM - DAY

SU NING pushes open the bedroom door, finding her sister SU NIANROU lounging on the bed, one hand resting on a visible pregnant belly, the other scrolling through photos of her and Huo Zicheng together.

SU NING
(whispered)
No...

SU NIANROU
(without looking up)
Three months. It's a boy. Brother-in-law is so excited.

SU NING
You planned this the whole time...

SU NIANROU
(finally meets her eyes)
You wore the perfect mask too long. It cracked.

HUO ZICHENG walks out wearing a bathrobe, holding papers.

HUO ZICHENG
(cold)
Sign it. The car is yours. I keep the house.

He drops the divorce papers and walks out. SU NING stands frozen, the puzzle pieces clicking into place.
continuation:
EXT. CITY NIGHT VIEW - NIGHT

The city's neon lights blur past Su Ning's taxi window.

INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

SU NING stumbles from a private room, drunk but trying to hold it together. She collides with QIN SIYUE, who catches her with steady hands.

QIN SIYUE'S FRIEND (O.S.)
Young master, shall I call security?

QIN SIYUE
(focused on Su Ning)
No. I know her.

QIN SIYUE
(quietly)
Su Ning? From the conference last month. Are you okay?

SU NING
(blurred, bitter laugh)
Okay? I'm perfect. Young master... you look expensive. Tonight, you're mine.

She grabs his tie, her bravado cracking. Qin Siyue studies her face, sees the pain beneath, and lifts her carefully.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - MORNING

Gentle piano music.

SU NING wakes in an unfamiliar bed, disoriented. QIN SIYUE, now in a dress shirt, watches from a chair.

QIN SIYUE
(softly)
You kept saying "not real" in your sleep. I stayed to make sure you were safe.

SU NING
(realizing)
We didn't...?

QIN SIYUE
(shakes head)
You passed out. I slept here.

The doorbell rings. Qin Siyue answers. His ASSISTANT hands him a shopping bag.

ASSISTANT
Mr. Qin, your nephew called. He asked about the acquisition.

QIN SIYUE
(dismissive)
Later.

Qin Siyue returns, offering the bag.

QIN SIYUE
Your handbag was damaged in the hallway. Please accept a temporary replacement.

Inside: a designer handbag. Su Ning's old, torn bag sits beside it.

SU NING
How much? I'll pay you back.

QIN SIYUE
Consider it an apology for my assistant's clumsiness. I'll be in the lounge.

He indicates a connecting door, then exits. Su Ning opens her wallet—eight hundred yuan.

SU NING (V.O.)
Eight hundred yuan left. A luxury suite. And a man who asks nothing.

She looks at the connecting door, then at the designer bag.

SU NING (V.O.)
The math doesn't add up.

She gathers her things, pausing at the door.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED
full_script:
Title: After Divorce, My Ex-Husband's Uncle Spoiled Me
Description: A woman betrayed by her husband and sister finds unexpected romance with a mysterious stranger after a drunken night.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

A melancholic melody plays. SU NING and the handsome QIN SIYUE share a wine-tinged kiss that gradually deepens on the hotel bed, their silhouettes merging in the dim light.

ON SCREEN: HOTEL

INT. HUO ZICHENG'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Tense strings rise.

HUO ZICHENG hurls a stack of photos onto the bed where SU NING sits frozen. The images spill across the quilt—each showing a woman unmistakably Su Ning in a hotel room.

ON SCREEN: HUO ZICHENG'S HOUSE

SU NING's hands tremble as she picks up a photo.

HUO ZICHENG
(fury barely contained)
Your private investigator? These are from mine. The woman has your scar. Your necklace. Your watch. Explain.

SU NING
(quietly desperate)
Zicheng, someone forged these. We pledged trust—

HUO ZICHENG
(grabbing her arms, pulling her close)
Trust? While I was building our future, you were in another man's bed. I gave you everything.

He shoves her back, snatches a belt from the dresser, and cracks it against the wall beside her head. She flinches. Plaster crumbles.

SU NING
(gasp of terror)

INT. SU NING'S HOUSE BEDROOM - DAY

SU NING pushes open the bedroom door, finding her sister SU NIANROU lounging on the bed, one hand resting on a visible pregnant belly, the other scrolling through photos of her and Huo Zicheng together.

SU NING
(whispered)
No...

SU NIANROU
(without looking up)
Three months. It's a boy. Brother-in-law is so excited.

SU NING
You planned this the whole time...

SU NIANROU
(finally meets her eyes)
You wore the perfect mask too long. It cracked.

HUO ZICHENG walks out wearing a bathrobe, holding papers.

HUO ZICHENG
(cold)
Sign it. The car is yours. I keep the house.

He drops the divorce papers and walks out. SU NING stands frozen, the puzzle pieces clicking into place.

EXT. CITY NIGHT VIEW - NIGHT

The city's neon lights blur past Su Ning's taxi window.

INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

SU NING stumbles from a private room, drunk but trying to hold it together. She collides with QIN SIYUE, who catches her with steady hands.

QIN SIYUE'S FRIEND (O.S.)
Young master, shall I call security?

QIN SIYUE
(focused on Su Ning)
No. I know her.

QIN SIYUE
(quietly)
Su Ning? From the conference last month. Are you okay?

SU NING
(blurred, bitter laugh)
Okay? I'm perfect. Young master... you look expensive. Tonight, you're mine.

She grabs his tie, her bravado cracking. Qin Siyue studies her face, sees the pain beneath, and lifts her carefully.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - MORNING

Gentle piano music.

SU NING wakes in an unfamiliar bed, disoriented. QIN SIYUE, now in a dress shirt, watches from a chair.

QIN SIYUE
(softly)
You kept saying "not real" in your sleep. I stayed to make sure you were safe.

SU NING
(realizing)
We didn't...?

QIN SIYUE
(shakes head)
You passed out. I slept here.

The doorbell rings. Qin Siyue answers. His ASSISTANT hands him a shopping bag.

ASSISTANT
Mr. Qin, your nephew called. He asked about the acquisition.

QIN SIYUE
(dismissive)
Later.

Qin Siyue returns, offering the bag.

QIN SIYUE
Your handbag was damaged in the hallway. Please accept a temporary replacement.

Inside: a designer handbag. Su Ning's old, torn bag sits beside it.

SU NING
How much? I'll pay you back.

QIN SIYUE
Consider it an apology for my assistant's clumsiness. I'll be in the lounge.

He indicates a connecting door, then exits. Su Ning opens her wallet—eight hundred yuan.

SU NING (V.O.)
Eight hundred yuan left. A luxury suite. And a man who asks nothing.

She looks at the connecting door, then at the designer bag.

SU NING (V.O.)
The math doesn't add up.

She gathers her things, pausing at the door.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Reborn as a Tycoon of the Era
description: A man betrayed by his wife and friend is given a second chance to correct his mistakes and save his family.
context:
Title: Reborn as a Tycoon of the Era
Description: A man betrayed by his wife and friend is given a second chance to correct his mistakes and save his family.

INT. PIGSTY - NIGHT

Opening with fast-cut images: WU QIANQIAN in designer clothes carries a bucket past the pigsty. Pigs jostle at the trough. LU YAO and eldest sister LU TIANFENG are tied up. Second sister LU TIANJIAO lies unconscious on the ground.

YANG HAILIANG holds a phone camera, framing Wu Qianqian.

YANG HAILIANG
Beautiful! One more!

WU QIANQIAN
(impatiently)
Brother Yang, are you done? We have business.

YANG HAILIANG
(leering)
Perfect.

WU QIANQIAN pours pig feed into the trough. Pigs surge. LU TIANJIAO stirs, turning toward the sound.

LU TIANJIAO
(groggily)
...hungry...

YANG HAILIANG
(laughing)
See? Even swans come to feed.

LU TIANFENG
(struggling and shouting)
Don't! Tianjiao, don't!

LU TIANFENG glares at the couple.

LU TIANFENG
Yang Hailiang! Wu Qianqian! My brother treated you like family, and you betrayed him! Now you want our home? You ungrateful—if I survive, I'll end you both!

WU QIANQIAN
(contemptuously)
Kill me? I'm waiting.

YANG HAILIANG laughs triumphantly.

WU QIANQIAN
(to LU YAO)
You think I married you for love? I married your debt. And Ming... he takes after his real father.

YANG HAILIANG laughs again.
continuation:
WU QIANQIAN
(seeing no reaction)
Nothing? Then know this: your sisters' "collectors" were my gift. For every dollar you gambled away.

LU YAO trembles, rage building. But something else too—recognition.

LU YAO
(voice breaking)
...I did this. God forgive me.

LU TIANFENG
(crying)
Xiao Yao, we forgive you. Just stop gambling.

YANG HAILIANG
(mocking)
Next life? This pigsty is your eternity!

He snaps one final photo. The FLASH ignites something in LU YAO—he yanks free, grabs a knife.

YANG HAILIANG
(panicking)
Wait—we can renegotiate! The house—

WU QIANQIAN
Don't!

LU YAO charges. A white flash crosses the screen.

INT. VOID - CONTINUOUS

Time freezes. LU YAO mid-thrust.

MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)
You see the truth now. One chance to choose again. Will you?

LU YAO
(without hesitation)
I'm willing!

MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)
Then wake.

INT. ROOM - DAY

Time-travel effects ripple across the screen.

LU YAO wakes with a gasp, looking around in confusion.

Golden text appears on screen: TO BE CONTINUED.

title: Dragon Lord of the Nation
description: A security guard who moonlights as a ride-share driver hides his true identity as the legendary Dragon Lord, protector of the Great Xia nation.
context:
Title: Dragon Lord of the Nation
Description: A security guard who moonlights as a ride-share driver hides his true identity as the legendary Dragon Lord, protector of the Great Xia nation.

EXT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

SECURITY GUARD A stifles a yawn, exhausted.

SECURITY GUARD B walks over, phone ready.

SECURITY GUARD A
Qin Feng. Ten-hour shifts, then ride-share till dawn. The kid's a machine.

SECURITY GUARD B
For a wife like his? I'd work three jobs. But watch this.

SECURITY GUARD B takes out his phone, and the two huddle together to watch.

INT. PHONE SCREEN - NIGHT

Shaky footage shows QIN FENG in scarred armor fighting NINJAS. Lightning crackles. Overlaid text: "DRAGON LORD HOAX?" Comments scroll: "FAKE."

THUNDER GOD RAY (V.O.)
Your reign ends tonight.

QIN FENG (V.O.)
Great Xia stands.

The screen whites out in a massive explosion.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

SECURITY GUARD A and SECURITY GUARD B watch with surging passion.

SECURITY GUARD B
Dragon Lord of the Nation... they say he saved us.

SECURITY GUARD A
If he existed. Forums debunked that footage.

SECURITY GUARD B
(looking closely)
Hey... doesn't that look like Qin Feng?

SECURITY GUARD A
(dismissive)
A security guard? Don't be stupid.

QIN FENG appears behind them, knuckles raw.

QIN FENG
Shift's over.

They spin. Guard B fumbles his phone—it lands face-up on the helmet frame.

SECURITY GUARD B
(stammering)
Qin Feng! We were just—

Qin Feng picks up the phone. His scarred fingers brush the image. He hands it back without meeting their eyes.

QIN FENG
Good render.

He walks to his dented car. The guards stare after him.

SECURITY GUARD B
(whisper)
His knuckles were bleeding.

SECURITY GUARD A
(scoffs)
Paper cuts. Let it go.

FADE OUT.

title: After the Groom Fled, My Contract Marriage Can't Be Dissolved
description: A celebrity bride is abandoned at the altar by her A-list actor fiancé, only to have a mysterious stranger appear at the last moment.
context:
Title: After the Groom Fled, My Contract Marriage Can't Be Dissolved
Description: A celebrity bride is abandoned at the altar by her A-list actor fiancé, only to have a mysterious stranger appear at the last moment.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

A news broadcast plays on the television screen.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
D-list actress Zhao Xinyue and A-list actor Liu Jiacheng, after three years of dating, have finally achieved their happy ending. An unequal romance in the entertainment industry has finally come to fruition.

Zhao Xinyue, wearing a wedding dress, catches up to Liu Jiacheng who is about to leave.

ZHAO XINYUE
Where are you going?

LIU JIACHENG
Xinyue, the wedding... it's not happening today.

ZHAO XINYUE
(shocked)
Not happening?

INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY

The EMCEE stands on the empty stage, practicing.

EMCEE
I believe, if there is still pure love in the entertainment industry...

Zhao Xinyue grabs Liu Jiacheng's arm.

ZHAO XINYUE
Jiacheng, three hundred guests. Fifty live feeds. Every contact I have in this industry. If you do this—

LIU JIACHENG
(pulling away)
I'm sorry. It's the only way.

Liu Jiacheng leaves without looking back. Zhao Xinyue watches his departing figure in the mirror.

ZHAO XINYUE
(calling out tearfully)
Liu Jiacheng! Liu Jiacheng!

The AGENT runs to Zhao Xinyue's side.

AGENT
This is catastrophic. Your endorsement penalties alone... I'm controlling the narrative. You delay them.

The AGENT hurries away. Zhao Xinyue stands alone, holding her bouquet, looking devastated.
continuation:
EMCEE (V.O.)
That must be the groom and bride, this golden couple...

The bouquet falls from Zhao Xinyue's hands to the floor.

EMCEE
(holding the microphone)
Now, let us welcome the bride and groom to make their grand entrance!

Two ATTENDANTS push open the hall doors. No one is there.

GUESTS (V.O.)
Where are the bride and groom?
Where did the groom go?
Did the groom run away?
Where are they?

EMCEE
(awkwardly repeating)
Now, let us welcome the bride and groom to make their grand entrance!

The doors are pushed open again. Still no one.

Zhao Xinyue takes a deep breath, bends down to pick up the bouquet from the floor. Her eyes become determined. She lifts her wedding dress and walks toward the hall.

INT. WEDDING HALL AISLE - DAY

Zhao Xinyue walks alone toward the stage. REPORTERS swarm around her.

REPORTER A
Miss Zhao, why didn't the groom appear with you? Is there a problem with the engagement?

REPORTER B
There are reports that the groom has already left the venue. Is this true?

REPORTER C
Miss Zhao, is this wedding falling apart? Why make such a big production out of it?

Zhao Xinyue ignores them and walks straight to the stage, taking the microphone from the EMCEE.

ZHAO XINYUE
I announce that the wedding...

Suddenly, the hall doors are pushed open again.

JIANG XIAOBAI, wearing a white suit, walks in from the entrance.

JIANG XIAOBAI
The groom is present. Apologies for my tardiness.

title: He Kissed Me With Pain
description: A wealthy heiress is betrayed by her husband, loses everything, and is imprisoned. After two years, she is released and must confront her past.
context:
Title: He Kissed Me With Pain
Description: A wealthy heiress is betrayed by her husband, loses everything, and is imprisoned. After two years, she is released and must confront her past.

INT. PRISON - DAY

The prison iron gate groans open. Female prisoners in faded uniforms stand in a row, their expressions solemn.

Close-up - NAN XI's feet, wearing worn prison shoes, number 16375.

GUARD (O.S.)
Number 16375.

NAN XI raises her head, her face bearing faded scars, but her eyes hold something harder now—calculation beneath the damage.

NAN XI
Present.

The GUARD consults a clipboard, expression unreadable.

GUARD
After you leave, obey the law and be a good person.

NAN XI
I won't be back.

EXT. OUTSIDE PRISON - DAY

NAN XI changes into casual clothes, a simple dress hanging loose on her frame. She carries a white canvas bag and walks through the gate, squinting against the sudden light, her hand trembling slightly as she shields her eyes.

NAN XI (V.O.)
My name is Nan Xi. Two years ago, I was the Nan Group's golden heiress. Then my husband built our marriage on a fifteen-year lie, my father's empire collapsed, and I took the fall for a crime I didn't commit.

NAN XI stands under the sign reading "Dongcheng Prison," her gaze drifting to her right leg, which bears a slight limp.

NAN XI (V.O.)
Two years.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

FLASHBACK - Two years ago

Heavy rain pours down. NAN XI wears black mourning clothes with a white flower pinned to her chest, clutching her father's portrait. The BUTLER holds an umbrella as they walk across muddy grass.

The tombstone reads "Beloved Father Nan Jinzhi's Tomb."

BUTLER
Miss, let Director Nan rest in peace.

NAN XI kneels, placing the portrait against the tombstone. A convoy of black cars arrives and stops by the road. HUO ZHENG steps out, immaculate in black. The ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE YE FAMILY joins him under a shared umbrella, her hand resting on his arm.

GUESTS begin whispering.

GUEST A
Hey, look, it's Mr. Huo.

GUEST B
He actually dares to come!

GUEST C
I heard Nan Group's bankruptcy was his merger strategy.

GUEST B
Director Nan's death—his doing.

GUEST A
Isn't that the Eldest Daughter of the Ye Family? Could they be...

The BUTLER steps forward.

BUTLER
Mr. Huo, respect the dead. You should...

NAN XI stands, meeting HUO ZHENG's gaze with cold fury.

NAN XI
What are you doing here?

HUO ZHENG
(with a cold smirk)
continuation:
Paying respects to my dear father-in-law.

NAN XI
(in disbelief)
Father-in-law? You destroyed him. And you bring her to his grave?

ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE YE FAMILY
Nan Xi, watch your mouth. Your father destroyed himself—with fraudulent loans, embezzlement. What does that have to do with Ah Zheng?

NAN XI
Leave. Now.

HUO ZHENG ignores her, crouching to pick up the portrait.

HUO ZHENG (V.O.)
Fifteen years.

NAN XI
You're not worthy to touch him!

HUO ZHENG (V.O.)
This day has finally come.

HUO ZHENG stands, gripping her wrist suddenly. He pulls her close—a rough, merciless kiss filled with fifteen years of hatred. Then he shatters the portrait against the tombstone.

NAN XI
(crying out)
Dad!

She shoves him away, her knee cracking against the tombstone's edge. She raises a hand and slaps the ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE YE FAMILY across the face.

ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE YE FAMILY
(covering her face, shocked)
Nan Xi, you dare hit me? I'm pregnant!

NAN XI
Hit you? You took everything—

HUO ZHENG grabs her wrist, eyes ice-cold.

HUO ZHENG
If you don't want this hand, I can arrange it.

He forcefully pushes NAN XI down onto the muddy grass. Two BODYGUARDS step forward, pinning her.

NAN XI
Let go!

A BODYGUARD produces a document—bank transfers with her signature. Another scatters ashes from a concealed urn.

NAN XI
(breaking down)
Dad! What did I ever do to you?

HUO ZHENG
(coldly)
You made it possible. Every signature, every trust. You were the perfect weapon, Nan Xi. Marrying you was always the plan.

NAN XI
What do you mean?

HUO ZHENG
Your father bankrupted my family fifteen years ago. I built my entire life to return the favor.

He nods. The BODYGUARDS haul NAN XI up. She struggles, her damaged leg buckling.

HUO ZHENG
(ordering the bodyguards)
Police are waiting. Assault charges. She'll confess to the financial crimes while she's inside.

NAN XI
No! Ah!

The BUTLER is blocked by BODYGUARDS as NAN XI is dragged toward the cars.

BUTLER
Miss! Let me go! Miss!

NAN XI's voice is raw as they force her into the vehicle, leaving only the broken portrait in the mud.

Director Nan's death—his doing.

GUEST A
Isn't that the Eldest Daughter of the Ye Family? Could they be...

The BUTLER steps forward.

BUTLER
Mr. Huo, respect the dead. You should...

NAN XI stands, meeting HUO ZHENG's gaze with cold fury.

NAN XI
What are you doing here?

HUO ZHENG
(with a cold smirk)
Paying respects to my dear father-in-law.

NAN XI
(in disbelief)
Father-in-law? You destroyed him. And you bring her to his grave?

ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE YE FAMILY
Nan Xi, watch your mouth. Your father destroyed himself—with fraudulent loans, embezzlement. What does that have to do with Ah Zheng?

NAN XI
Leave. Now.

HUO ZHENG ignores her, crouching to pick up the portrait.

HUO ZHENG (V.O.)
Fifteen years.

NAN XI
You're not worthy to touch him!

HUO ZHENG (V.O.)
This day has finally come.

HUO ZHENG stands, gripping her wrist suddenly. He pulls her close—a rough, merciless kiss filled with fifteen years of hatred. Then he shatters the portrait against the tombstone.

NAN XI
(crying out)
Dad!

She shoves him away, her knee cracking against the tombstone's edge. She raises a hand and slaps the ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE YE FAMILY across the face.

ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE YE FAMILY
(covering her face, shocked)
Nan Xi, you dare hit me? I'm pregnant!

NAN XI
Hit you? You took everything—

HUO ZHENG grabs her wrist, eyes ice-cold.

HUO ZHENG

He forcefully pushes NAN XI down onto the muddy grass. Two BODYGUARDS step forward, pinning her.

NAN XI
Let go!

A BODYGUARD produces a document—bank transfers with her signature. Another scatters ashes from a concealed urn.

NAN XI
(breaking down)
Dad! What did I ever do to you?

HUO ZHENG
(coldly)
You made it possible. Every signature, every trust. You were the perfect weapon, Nan Xi. Marrying you was always the plan.

NAN XI
What do you mean?

HUO ZHENG
Your father bankrupted my family fifteen years ago. I built my entire life to return the favor.

He nods. The BODYGUARDS haul NAN XI up. She struggles, her damaged leg buckling.

HUO ZHENG
(ordering the bodyguards)
Police are waiting. Assault charges. She'll confess to the financial crimes while she's inside.

NAN XI
No! Ah!

The BUTLER is blocked by BODYGUARDS as NAN XI is dragged toward the cars.

BUTLER
Miss! Let me go! Miss!

NAN XI's voice is raw as they force her into the vehicle, leaving only the broken portrait in the mud.

title: The Masked God of War
description: A legendary warrior named Ye Chen is honored as the God of War but mysteriously disappears, losing his memory and becoming a security guard, only to be rescued by the woman he once saved.
context:
Title: The Masked God of War
Description: A legendary warrior named Ye Chen is honored as the God of War but mysteriously disappears, losing his memory and becoming a security guard, only to be rescued by the woman he once saved.

INT. OUTSIDE SHENWU HALL - DAY

The characters "SHENWU HALL" appear on screen.

A masked herald blows a ceremonial horn.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Ye Chen of the Northern Territory. Slayer of rebels, shield of the realm. Today, he ascends as the God of War, Supreme Commander of Great Xia.

YE CHEN, in black battle armor, leads JIUXIAO DRAGON LADY, FEI LONG, and a procession of officers toward the hall.

INT. INSIDE SHENWU HALL - DAY

YE CHEN and his subordinates walk a red carpet as soldiers line both sides.

ALL
Congratulations! Congratulations! Congratulations!

YE CHEN stands center, facing the assembly.

YE CHEN
This honor belongs to those who fell. To every brother still standing.

YE CHEN raises his bowl.

YE CHEN
Remember them. Drink!

ALL
Drink!

They drain their bowls and smash them in unison.

EXT. ON A BRIDGE - DAY

The words "OUTSIDE SHENWU HALL" appear on screen.

XU XUEROU and her sister XU QINGYUN watch distant palace fireworks.

XU QINGYUN
You came all this way just to glimpse his procession? You didn't even see his face.

XU XUEROU
Knowing he's safe is enough. Some debts don't need repayment.

XU QINGYUN
But you don't even know what he looks like. How can you—?

A car horn blares from above.

XU QINGYUN
Driver's waiting.

From the woods below, YE CHEN staggers forth, his clothes torn, fresh bandages seeping through.

XU QINGYUN
(frightened)
Stay back! There's a shelter in the city—

XU XUEROU
He's wounded. We can't leave him.

XU XUEROU
(to YE CHEN)
Can you walk? We're heading to Qing City.

YE CHEN clutches his head, voice raw.

YE CHEN
Fragments... just my name. Ye Chen.

XU QINGYUN
(shocked)
Ye—? Like the God of—

YE CHEN collapses. XU XUEROU catches him.

XU XUEROU
Easy. We've got you.
continuation:
EXT. ON THE ROAD - DAY

JIUXIAO DRAGON LADY leads a covert unit at a dead run.

JIUXIAO DRAGON LADY
The God of War is compromised. Notify the Sovereign—silent search. No panic. No leaks.

FEMALE SOLDIERS
Yes, Commander!

INT. XU GROUP CORPORATION LOBBY - DAY

The words "THREE YEARS LATER" and "XU GROUP CORPORATION LOBBY" appear on screen.

CHEN XIULI, in a red power suit, crosses the marble floor. YE CHEN, in a security uniform, tries to blend into the wall.

CHEN XIULI
You're the stray Xuerou brought home? Still here.

She shoves a hotel keycard into his hand.

CHEN XIULI
Your boss got cornered at the Yangtze Tower dinner. Room 808. She's not herself—go.

YE CHEN studies the card, his fingers brushing old scars.

INT. YUEYI HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

XU XUEROU, in a white silk dress, sways by the window. Glassy eyes, unnatural flush.

The door cracks. YE CHEN enters, movements measured.

YE CHEN
President Xu?

YE CHEN closes the door.

YE CHEN
Miss Xu?

XU XUEROU spins, breath catching.

XU XUEROU
(whispering)
You came... burning... something's wrong—

She stumbles into him. They fall onto the bed. Her fingers grip his collar.

From a vent above, a hidden camera's red dot blinks steady.

title: No Worries, Mrs. Huo Will Handle It
description: Gu Wantang wakes up after a one-night stand with Huo Yunshen, unaware of his true identity. Meanwhile, her husband's affair is exposed, leading to a confrontation with her mother-in-law.
context:
Title: No Worries, Mrs. Huo Will Handle It
Description: Gu Wantang wakes up after a one-night stand with Huo Yunshen, unaware of his true identity. Meanwhile, her husband's affair is exposed, leading to a confrontation with her mother-in-law.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - EARLY MORNING

GU WANTANG wakes up in bed, lying on her side, looking at HUO YUNSHEN sleeping beside her.

She sits up and leans over to carefully study HUO YUNSHEN's face, gently tracing her fingers over his brow and eyes.

GU WANTANG (V.O.)
He's quite handsome. What a pity.

GU WANTANG gets out of bed and puts on a black sequined jacket. She takes a stack of cash from her bag, places it in an envelope, and sets the envelope on the nightstand. She checks her phone—photo evidence of Lu Sheng's affair glows on screen.

She takes one last look at HUO YUNSHEN on the bed, then turns and leaves the room.

Later, HUO YUNSHEN wakes up. He sits up and looks around.

ON SCREEN: Character Introduction - HUO YUNSHEN, CEO of Huo Group.

HUO YUNSHEN notices the envelope and note on the nightstand. He picks up the note and reads it.

NOTE (V.O.)
Not bad. This is your payment.

HUO YUNSHEN picks up the money from the envelope and laughs contemptuously.

HUO YUNSHEN
Two thousand yuan? She didn't recognize who I am at all.

HUO YUNSHEN picks up his phone, looking thoughtful.

HUO YUNSHEN (V.O.)
But she's been married for a year, and it was still her first time.

HUO YUNSHEN makes a phone call.

HUO YUNSHEN
(into phone)
Look into the Lu family for me.
continuation:
EXT. VILLA GARDEN CAFE - DAY

LIU MEIYING and several wealthy lady friends are having afternoon tea.

FRIEND A
Oh, Sister Meiying, isn't that bag the latest from G brand?

FRIEND B
Oh my, everyone in our circle knows Sister Meiying has a daughter-in-law who can make money. A three-million-yuan bag, she buys it so casually to honor her. We can only be envious.

ON SCREEN: Character Introduction - LIU MEIYING, Lu Sheng's Mother.

LIU MEIYING
This was my son showing his filial piety to me. Don't praise my daughter-in-law too much, she's useless except for making money. It's just a bag, after all.

FRIEND A
(looking at her phone)
Hey, Sister Meiying, the person in this news story looks like your son.

LIU MEIYING takes the phone.

LIU MEIYING
Oh my, Xiao Sheng is in the news again. It must be some financial news praising him. Let me see what they're saying about him.

LIU MEIYING looks at the phone screen. Her smile gradually fades, replaced by shock and anger.

LIU MEIYING
This is impossible! This can't be my son!

Her phone rings.

INT. HOTEL SUITE - DAY

LU SHENG stands by the window, peeking through the curtains at reporters outside. He frantically makes a phone call.

ON SCREEN: Character Introduction - LU SHENG, Gu Wantang's Husband.

LU SHENG
(into phone)
Hello, Mom. I'm trapped by reporters at the hotel! Call that Gu Wantang quickly and tell her to find a way to get me out of here!

EXT. VILLA GARDEN CAFE - DAY

LIU MEIYING hangs up the phone, angrily grabs her bag, and storms off.

INT. GU WANTANG'S OFFICE - DAY

GU WANTANG sits at her desk, looking at the news on her phone. The headline reads: "Lu Sheng Suspected of Affair, Spent Entire Night at Hotel with Mysterious Actress."

GU WANTANG (V.O.)
Lin Jiaojiao, I once considered you my best friend, but you've stabbed me in the back multiple times.

The office door is suddenly pushed open. LIU MEIYING barges in, ignoring the secretary's attempts to stop her.

SECRETARY (O.S.)
You can't go in! You can't go in!

LIU MEIYING
I'm her mother-in-law! What are you? How dare you stop me? Get out of my way!

LIU MEIYING angrily walks to GU WANTANG's desk.

LIU MEIYING
Gu Wantang! Lu Sheng is trapped by entertainment reporters at the hotel. Hurry up and find a way to get him out!

GU WANTANG slowly lifts her head, a slight smile on her face.

GU WANTANG
Is that so? But those reporters were arranged by me.
