title: CEO Run, Your Wife Is Actually a Princess
description: A princess from 1,500 years ago is betrayed by her lover from the future and reborn in the modern world seeking revenge.
context:
Title: CEO Run, Your Wife Is Actually a Princess
Description: A princess from 1,500 years ago is betrayed by her lover from the future and reborn in the modern world seeking revenge.

INT. PALACE EXTERIOR - NIGHT

Under a bleeding moon, UNCLE WANG (50s, battle-scarred general) and his elite SOLDIERS form a tight circle around FU CHENG (28, mysterious modern jacket, defiant stance). Princess ZHAO YUANXI (18, regal yet trembling) stands apart, her eyes reflecting shattered trust.

ZHAO YUANXI (V.O.)
Fifteen hundred years ago, I was Princess of Great Xia. Uncle Wang captured a demon in the palace. He wore strange clothes and spoke of impossible things.

MONTAGE - DAY/NIGHT

-- FU CHENG paints ZHAO YUANXI in a pavilion. She steals glances at him, not the canvas.
-- Their hands brush while painting. She doesn't pull away.
-- They sit on palace steps, sparklers reflecting in both their eyes. Her head rests on his shoulder.

ZHAO YUANXI (V.O.)
He was from the future. A world without royal chains. Where love needed no permission. I believed every word.

INT. PRINCESS'S CHAMBER - NIGHT

ZHAO YUANXI stares at her reflection in bronze, dressed in crimson wedding silks. Her fingers trace the embroidery like a death shroud.

FU CHENG emerges from shadow, his face half in darkness.

FU CHENG
(softly)
Prince Xiao's twin jade. It opens doors between worlds. I'll have it by dawn. We'll vanish.

ZHAO YUANXI
(whisper)
And if he discovers you?

FU CHENG
Then I'll burn his kingdom down.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

Rain hammers the stones. UNCLE WANG blocks ZHAO YUANXI's path, his sword half-drawn.

UNCLE WANG
Escaping a political marriage is treason. That stranger is gambling with your bloodline.

ZHAO YUANXI
(meeting his gaze)
Then consider me all-in.
continuation:
INT. PRINCESS'S CHAMBER - NIGHT

ZHAO YUANXI presses her forehead against the chamber door. UNCLE WANG stands guard outside, his silhouette rigid.

ZHAO YUANXI
You raised me when my father couldn't. Tonight... let me be a foolish girl one last time.

Silence. Then—a single nod of his shadow.

EXT. CITY GATE - DAY

The marriage procession snakes through the gate like a funeral march. ZHAO YUANXI sits in the palanquin, gripping the jade pendant hidden in her sleeve.

EXT. PRINCE XIAO'S CAMP - NIGHT

ZHAO YUANXI slips through the command tent, her heart hammering. She spots the TWIN JADE on Prince Xiao's armor stand.

Her fingers close around it—

PRINCE XIAO (40, war-hardened) erupts from his cot, sword singing from its scabbard.

PRINCE XIAO
Spy! That pendant is my soul!

He lunges. UNCLE WANG crashes through the tent flap, taking the blade through his shoulder. Blood sprays ZHAO YUANXI's wedding dress.

EXT. WILDERNESS - NIGHT

The caravan burns. UNCLE WANG, bleeding, drags ZHAO YUANXI toward a riderless horse.

UNCLE WANG
Yongning Gate. Noon. He'll be there?

ZHAO YUANXI
He swore it.

UNCLE WANG
Then ride like the dynasty depends on it.

EXT. YONGNING GATE EXTERIOR - NIGHT

ZHAO YUANXI and UNCLE WANG, both bloodied, stumble toward the towering gate. Twenty enemy HORSEMEN close in, torches painting the night orange.

Behind the iron bars—FU CHENG stands motionless, twin jade pendants glowing in his fist.

FU CHENG
(shouting)
You took her from me. Now you both die in her name!

UNCLE WANG
(bellowing)
Open the gate! For the Princess of Xia!

The gate doesn't move. Arrows thud into the wood around them.

ZHAO YUANXI (V.O.)
Little Uncle Wang fought three days straight. A thousand miles. The gate never opened.

An arrow takes UNCLE WANG in the back. He drops to one knee, still swinging his sword.

UNCLE WANG
(gasping)
Princess... I got you... home...

ZHAO YUANXI
(screaming)
Little Uncle Wang!

The gate groans open. FU CHENG stands in the gap, backlit like an angel of death.

ZHAO YUANXI
(sobbing, crawling)
The twin jade can heal! Please—save him!

FU CHENG
(cold)
It doesn't heal. It erases. And I'm done erasing pieces of my past.

He strikes. She crumples, the pendant clutched to her chest. It flares—blinding white.

ZHAO YUANXI (V.O.)
Fu Cheng killed me. But Uncle Wang's sacrifice... that was love.

EXT. MODERN CITY - NIGHT

Neon floods ancient stone streets. ZHAO YUANXI lies in a Shanghai alley, coughing on 21st-century air. Skyscrapers pierce clouds where palaces once stood. Her fingers—still gripping the jade—twitch.

ZHAO YUANXI
(disoriented, venomous)
Where...?

She sees a digital billboard flashing Fu Cheng's face—now a CEO in a tailored suit. Her eyes narrow. The jade glows in her fist.

FADE OUT.

(cold)
It doesn't heal. It erases. And I'm done erasing pieces of my past.

He strikes. She crumples, the pendant clutched to her chest. It flares—blinding white.

ZHAO YUANXI (V.O.)
Fu Cheng killed me. But Uncle Wang's sacrifice... that was love.

EXT. MODERN CITY - NIGHT

Neon floods ancient stone streets. ZHAO YUANXI lies in a Shanghai alley, coughing on 21st-century air. Skyscrapers pierce clouds where palaces once stood. Her fingers—still gripping the jade—twitch.

ZHAO YUANXI
(disoriented, venomous)
Where...?

She sees a digital billboard flashing Fu Cheng's face—now a CEO in a tailored suit. Her eyes narrow. The jade glows in her fist.

FADE OUT.

title: Tang Clan
description: Tang Seventh Master, guardian of the Tang Clan's forbidden legacy, faces a lethal ambush that forces him to choose between preserving tradition or passing its burden to an unlikely heir.
context:
Title: Tang Clan
Description: Tang Seventh Master, guardian of the Tang Clan's forbidden legacy, faces a lethal ambush that forces him to choose between preserving tradition or passing its burden to an unlikely heir.

EXT. ABANDONED INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX - DAY

Explosions tear through rusted structures. TANG SEVENTH MASTER (40s, robes tattered) weaves through the ruins on horseback, smoke trailing behind him.

FEMALE ASSASSIN (V.O.)
Your clan's secrets die with you, Tang!

He swerves as a BLAST erupts through a water tower. Debris rains down.

TANG SEVENTH MASTER
Then come and claim them.

He vaults from his horse, lands in a crouch. Four ASSASSINS drop from above, surrounding him:

- FEMALE ASSASSIN (30s, qipao lined with blades)
- MALE ASSASSIN 1 (40s, wide-brimmed hat)
- MALE ASSASSIN 2 (30s, trench coat)
- MALE ASSASSIN 3 (20s, hooded)

FEMALE ASSASSIN
Your life for the manual. Final offer.

TANG SEVENTH MASTER
(quietly)
The manual burned. The knowledge... is here.
(taps his temple)

MALE ASSASSIN 1
Then we take your head.

Silver chains whip from his sleeves. MALE ASSASSIN 2's fingers ignite with crimson energy. The FEMALE ASSASSIN's blade sings. MALE ASSASSIN 3 melts into shadow.

TANG SEVENTH MASTER exhales. Golden light fractures across his skin as a towering dharma form materializes—flickering, unstable.

He slams his palm down. A shockwave erupts.

The ASSASSINS crash through concrete pillars, their totems (Azure Dragon, Vermillion Bird, White Tiger, Black Tortoise) shattering like glass.

Tang Seventh Master collapses to one knee, coughing blood. He clutches his chest—black veins spiderweb across his skin.

MASKED MAN (O.S.)
Let him run.

A figure in a crimson demon mask emerges from smoke. The assassins struggle to their feet, bloodied.

MASKED MAN (CONT'D)
The Fire Cloud Seal is set. He has until midnight to find a successor... or the line ends.

The black veins pulse visibly.
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Tang Seventh Master stumbles through darkness, each step heavier. He reaches a support beam and slides down it.

Footsteps echo. XIE FENG (20s, scavenger's gear) freezes twenty feet away, holding a knife.

XIE FENG
(whisper)
The Ghost Hand of Chengdu...

TANG SEVENTH MASTER
(struggling to focus)
Not anymore. Boy... do you know what the Tang Clan guards?

He extends his hand. Black veins climb toward his fingertips—while golden light pools in his palm, swirling into ancient characters.

XIE FENG
(backing away)
I want no part of your world.

TANG SEVENTH MASTER
(laughs, bitter)
Neither did I.

The characters flicker brighter. His eyes meet Xie Feng's—one pupil pure white, one burning gold.

FADE OUT.

title: Supreme
description: A man on an electric scooter is mocked by motorcycle-riding women, until the Southern King himself arrives to kneel before him, revealing his true identity as the Supreme.
context:
Title: Supreme
Description: A man on an electric scooter is mocked by motorcycle-riding women, until the Southern King himself arrives to kneel before him, revealing his true identity as the Supreme.

EXT. CITY HIGHWAY - NIGHT

Night falls over a wide city highway. A group of young women in leather jackets ride heavy motorcycles at high speed, engines roaring. Quick cuts showcase their speed and passion.

At an intersection, a man (YE FAN) rides a small electric scooter, wearing a helmet, quietly waiting at a red light. Several female bikers pull up beside him and stop, looking at him contemptuously.

FEMALE BIKER A
No way, old man. Riding a little electric scooter and wearing a helmet?

FEMALE BIKER B
(laughing)
So afraid of death.

SU XIAOXIAO
(arms crossed, leaning on her motorcycle)
Are you even a man? This road is where we sisters race. A coward like you, afraid of death, has no right to be here. I'll give you one minute. Get lost!

YE FAN
(looking at them, voice muffled through helmet)
Racing? The asphalt is cold tonight. And asphalt doesn't care about your courage.

SU XIAOXIAO
(furious)
Bastard, how dare you lecture me!

The light turns green. YE FAN starts his scooter and drives forward.

SU XIAOXIAO
(shouting to her sisters)
He's getting away! Sisters, let's chase him down!

The biker women immediately rev their motorcycles and chase YE FAN. A pursuit unfolds on the highway, the small scooter weaving through the heavy motorcycles.

YE FAN glances at his side mirror, seeing them close in. He doesn't speed up, but maintains a steady, uncatchable pace just ahead.

Suddenly, a row of black luxury cars (Rolls-Royces, Maybachs) speeds in from the side, forming a wall of vehicles that blocks the biker women's path. Tires screech against the pavement.

The biker women brake hard, staring in shock at the convoy.

FEMALE BIKER A
Whose motorcade is this?

FEMALE BIKER B
(checking her phone, panicked)
My tracker just went crazy. Authorities issued a priority-1 clearance two minutes ago for—

Close-up of the license plate "South A·00001."

SU XIAOXIAO
(whispering)
The Southern King's direct envoy.

FEMALE BIKER A
The Southern King?

FEMALE BIKER B
The Seven-Star War God, protector of the nine provinces, Qi Kunlun himself.

The door of the lead Maybach opens. A man in a black trench coat with a powerful aura (QI KUNLUN) steps out. Following him, dozens of men in black exit the convoy, moving in perfect unison, walking toward YE FAN.

FEMALE BIKER A
(nervously to SU XIAOXIAO)
Xiaoxiao... did you cross the Southern King?
continuation:
SU XIAOXIAO
(uncertain, watching YE FAN)
I don't... I don't think so.

QI KUNLUN and his men stop before YE FAN, dropping to one knee in perfect unison.

QI KUNLUN
(respectfully, but with urgency)
Supreme. Your presence here has been detected. We must move.

MEN IN BLACK
(in unison)
Supreme!

SU XIAOXIAO and her sisters are frozen.

SU XIAOXIAO (V.O.)
The highest authority of the nine provinces... kneeling before a man on a scooter? What have we done?

YE FAN
(removes helmet, revealing tired eyes)
I was trying to observe quietly. To remember what it felt like... before everything.

QI KUNLUN
(standing)
Your wife's condition has stabilized. The council awaits your decision on the border crisis.

YE FAN
(sighs)
Decisions. Always decisions.

YE FAN walks slowly toward SU XIAOXIAO, who flinches.

YE FAN
(gently)
You ride well. But courage without cause is just noise. The road you're on... it leads to places you can't imagine.

YE FAN hands his helmet to her. It's heavier than it looks, engraved with a symbol she doesn't recognize.

YE FAN
Keep this. It might remind you that the man you mocked today chose mercy over wrath.

SU XIAOXIAO
(trembling, barely audible)
Who... who are you?

YE FAN
Someone who remembers being young and foolish. Be safe.

Su Xiaoxiao's hands tremble as she takes it. She looks up to speak, but YE FAN has already turned away.

QI KUNLUN
(barking)
Clear the road. Let them leave.

The convoy shifts, opening a path. YE FAN enters the Maybach without looking back.

QI KUNLUN glances at the bikers, his expression unreadable.

QI KUNLUN
You raced with a ghost tonight. Be grateful ghosts don't hold grudges.

The luxury convoy departs, red taillights disappearing into the night.

Su Xiaoxiao stands alone, holding the helmet, staring at the empty highway ahead.

FADE OUT.

title: Dragon's Kiss
description: A construction worker unknowingly becomes entangled in a web of betrayal when his girlfriend and his boss carry on an affair behind his back.
context:
Title: Dragon's Kiss
Description: A construction worker unknowingly becomes entangled in a web of betrayal when his girlfriend and his boss carry on an affair behind his back.

INT. CONSTRUCTION SITE OFFICE - DAY

ZHOU GE sits at his desk, reviewing paperwork. The air conditioner hums.

YE HUAN enters, removing his safety helmet.

YE HUAN
Brother Zhou.

ZHOU GE
(looking up)
Ye Huan.

YE HUAN
Here for my wages.

ZHOU GE
Right.

ZHOU GE opens a drawer, counts out cash, and hands it to YE HUAN.

ZHOU GE
Three days' work.

YE HUAN
(taking the money)
Thanks, Brother Zhou.

YE HUAN lingers, looking at a photo on the desk—Zixuan and Zhou Ge at a company event, Zhou Ge's arm around her shoulders.

YE HUAN
That's a good picture of her.

ZHOU GE
(covers it with a file)
Office party.

YE HUAN
Zixuan mentioned she might drop by today.

ZHOU GE
(stiffens)
She hasn't.

YE HUAN
She should. You did us a real favor with this job.

ZHOU GE
Just business.

YE HUAN
Still. We're grateful.

YE HUAN turns to leave.

ZHOU GE watches the door close, then exhales.

The camera pans down under the desk. A red handbag sits in the shadows.
continuation:
EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

ZIXUAN walks through the site in jeans and a blouse, more practical but still out of place. She carries a lunch bag.

WORKERS watch her pass.

YE HUAN sees her and smiles.

YE HUAN
You made it.

ZIXUAN
(strained smile)
Brought you lunch.

YE HUAN
You shouldn't have. Site's too dirty.

ZIXUAN
(glances toward the office)
Wanted to see where you work.

YE HUAN
At least let me wash my hands first.

ZIXUAN
I'll wait in the office.

She moves toward it before he can respond.

INT. CONSTRUCTION SITE OFFICE - DAY

ZIXUAN enters. ZHOU GE stands, blocking her path.

ZHOU GE
You can't keep doing this.

ZIXUAN
(defensive)
He asked me to bring food.

ZHOU GE
And you always say yes.

He pulls her close. The lunch bag drops.

ZIXUAN
(soft, desperate)
We have to tell him.

ZHOU GE
Never.

Footsteps. The door opens.

YE HUAN stands in the doorway, holding the red handbag.

YE HUAN
(quiet)
You forgot something.

The tableau: ZHOU GE's arms around ZIXUAN, her bag on the floor.

YE HUAN
(to ZIXUAN)
Under the desk?

ZIXUAN
(pales)
Ye Huan—

YE HUAN
(cutting her off, to ZHOU GE)
How long?

ZHOU GE
Does it matter?

YE HUAN
(softly)
Three hundred yuan a day. I thought I was building us a future.

He looks between them. Neither can hold his gaze.

YE HUAN
Guess I was just digging my own grave.

He drops the handbag. It thuds.

YE HUAN turns and walks out. The door stays open.

ZIXUAN starts toward it. ZHOU GE grabs her arm.

ZHOU GE
He'll get over it.

ZIXUAN
(quietly, with venom)
You don't know him at all.

She pulls free and follows YE HUAN.

ZHOU GE stands alone, looking at the red handbag on his polished floor. He picks it up, brushes off the dust, and sets it on his desk next to the photo.

He straightens the picture frame.

title: Cunning Wife Goes Undercover
description: A woman whose family was destroyed by betrayal infiltrates her enemies' household disguised as a worker, seeking revenge with the help of an unlikely ally.
context:
Title: Cunning Wife Goes Undercover
Description: A woman whose family was destroyed by betrayal infiltrates her enemies' household disguised as a worker, seeking revenge with the help of an unlikely ally.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

Neon lights flicker.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO, dressed provocatively, dances by a pole. Her eyes are alluring, her movements seductive—but her knuckles are white where she grips the metal.

A man in a suit, SONG YAN'AN, sits nearby, watching her with a complex expression. He rotates a wedding band on his finger—not on his hand.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO accidentally drops a bracelet on the floor.

SONG YAN'AN picks up the bracelet and walks through the hallway.

He sees JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO in a glass room, adjusting her long boots. A photograph peeks from her boot—a family portrait.

SONG YAN'AN (V.O.)
(internal)
That engraving...

SONG YAN'AN walks up to JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO.

SONG YAN'AN
Miss, you dropped this.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO
Thanks.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO takes the bracelet, leaning against the wall, her eyes full of provocation.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO
Sorry for the trouble.

She moves closer to SONG YAN'AN, touching her earring, then leans in, almost kissing him. SONG YAN'AN's eyes dart away, but his voice drops.

SONG YAN'AN
(quietly)
He Residence. Tomorrow. Ten o'clock. Measurements.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO
(eyes narrowing)
He Luoluo?

SONG YAN'AN
Don't be late.

He turns and leaves. Jiang Yao watches his retreating figure, then checks the bracelet's engraving: a date. She smiles.
continuation:
INT. HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS

HE CHENFENG, a man wearing glasses, appears beside JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO.

HE CHENFENG
He knows who you are.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO
He knows what it's like to be owned by that family.

She shows him the photograph—her mother, and a younger He Chenfeng in the background.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO
(eyes filled with hatred)
Your sister seized my mother's shares. Your father witnessed the will. Who knew kindness could be so profitable?

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO
(looking at HE CHENFENG)
When you go to He Luoluo's house tomorrow to take her measurements, remember to bring me along.

JIANG YAO/SHEN YAOYAO
(eyes determined)
She destroyed everything I had. Naturally, I'm going to take away everything she can't afford to lose.

(eyes determined)
She destroyed everything I had. Naturally, I'm going to take away everything she can't afford to lose.

title: Peerless Sword Hall
description: A modern martial arts organization led by powerful women faces a confrontation when thugs arrive seeking compensation after a business dispute.
context:
Title: Peerless Sword Hall
Description: A modern martial arts organization led by powerful women faces a confrontation when thugs arrive seeking compensation after a business dispute.

INT. CHINESE COURTYARD - DAY

Overhead shot of an elegant traditional courtyard with gray tile roofs and weathered stone pathways. Morning mist clings to the ground.

A dozen women in midnight-black martial arts tunics hold jian swords with matte-black hilts, arranged in a perfect diamond formation. Their movements are silent, precise, lethal.

LIU YIXIAO, 35, stands before them wearing a black silk changpao, her silver hairpin catching the light. Her presence is a blade drawn quiet.

LIU YIXIAO
Ready. Seven stars. Reverse. Hold.

The formation shifts as one body, swords slicing air in a dance older than the courtyard stones. No wasted motion. No hesitation.

On the carved wooden pavilion opposite, WANG QIANNAN, 40, sits before a calligraphy table in indigo hanfu. She grinds ink with a jade muller, each circular press deliberate. She does not watch the sword practice. She feels it.

INT. CORRIDOR/COURTYARD - DAY

XIAO WAN, 28, stumbles from the corridor. Her white blouse is torn at the shoulder, blood seeping through. A bruise blossoms across her cheekbone. But her jaw is set, eyes bright with fury.

She crosses the courtyard with unsteady purpose, her footfalls echoing on stone. The sword formation holds, but every woman angles slightly toward her, protective.

LIU YIXIAO's command hand stops mid-gesture.

LIU YIXIAO
Xiao Wan.

XIAO WAN
Manager Liu. The Xiashui contract. We secured it.

She sways. LIU YIXIAO is there before she falls, catching her with a swordsman's sure grip.

LIU YIXIAO
The cost?

XIAO WAN
They sent enforcers. We... dissuaded them.

Her knees buckle. LIU YIXIAO nods to two swordswomen who materialize at her sides.

LIU YIXIAO
Stabilize her. Doctor Chen's clinic. No records.

They bear XIAO WAN away. WANG QIANNAN sets down her brush. The ink has bled perfect through the rice paper. She folds it once, twice, and places it in her sleeve.

WANG QIANNAN (softly)
The water always finds the stone's weakness.

LIU YIXIAO
Then we become the stone.
continuation:
INT. COURTYARD - DAY

FAN XIAOGANG, 45, enters with LI TIAN and four men in ill-fitting business suits. Their shoes are too shiny for this courtyard. FAN XIAOGANG's thumb flicks the latch of a briefcase. LI TIAN's hand never leaves his belt.

LI TIAN
This is private property.

LIU YIXIAO
This is sacred ground. Your kind doesn't belong here.

FAN XIAOGANG
Our kind? Lady, we got a contract says different. Your girl took something that wasn't hers. Cost my associate here three men and a very profitable demolition deal.

LI TIAN
We don't want trouble with women. We want compensation. Medical. Lost wages. And the Xiashui contract, signed over.

LIU YIXIAO's smile doesn't reach her eyes. She looks past them to WANG QIANNAN, who now stands at the pavilion edge, a scroll in hand.

WANG QIANNAN
You mistake negotiation for leverage.

She unrolls the scroll. It's the Xiashui development plan, stamped with the municipal seal. Red approval characters bleed across the bottom.

WANG QIANNAN (continuing)
The contract was never yours to lose. It was always ours. We simply... reminded the officials where true strength resides.

LI TIAN's hand moves. The briefcase falls open. Steel glints inside.

LIU YIXIAO
Choose.

She doesn't raise her voice. The black-clad swordswomen flow into a new formation, surrounding the men with quiet steps. No one speaks.

LIU YIXIAO (continuing)
The gate is behind you. Or we demonstrate why this hall has no doors for the uninvited.

FAN XIAOGANG glances at LI TIAN. The calculation is visible. The briefcase closes.

LI TIAN
This isn't over.

LIU YIXIAO
It never is. But today, it ends.

The men retreat, backward, eyes on the swords. Only when the gate clangs shut do the swordswomen lower their blades.

WANG QIANNAN descends the pavilion steps, the scroll held like a sword.

WANG QIANNAN
Tomorrow, they will bring guns.

LIU YIXIAO
Then tomorrow, we teach them why swords don't run out of bullets.

They stand side by side as the formation dissolves into individual warriors, each tending to her blade with quiet ritual.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Hidden Tycoon
description: A seemingly ordinary bathhouse worker is secretly the heir to a wealthy empire, protecting his CEO wife from the shadows.
context:
Title: The Hidden Tycoon
Description: A seemingly ordinary bathhouse worker is secretly the heir to a wealthy empire, protecting his CEO wife from the shadows.

INT. BATHHOUSE - DAY

LI FEILONG, late twenties in a tank top and cargo shorts, mops the steamy floor.

A TV on the wall broadcasts news.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Yutong Group CEO Su Yutong secures a landmark deal with the Li family, entering Jinghai City's financial elite.

ON SCREEN: Su Yutong at a press conference.

LI FEILONG glances up, a genuine smile touching his lips.

LI FEILONG
My wife.

Two women in white bathrobes (ASSASSIN A, ASSASSIN B) enter with predatory grace.

LI FEILONG
(approaching)
Sorry, ladies. We're closed for the day.

The women exchange glances. Their robes drop, revealing combat suits.

LI FEILONG
(alarmed)
Security contractors?

ASSASSIN A draws a blade from her thigh sheath.

ASSASSIN A
Contract termination.

ASSASSIN B
(to Li Feilong)
Don't resist.

She lunges. LI FEILONG blocks with his mop handle.

LI FEILONG
Let's keep this professional.

LI FEILONG easily evades and counters the attacks from both assassins.

He disarms Assassin A, her blade clattering away. ASSASSIN B slashes; he catches her wrist.

LI FEILONG
Good equipment. Poor execution.
continuation:
LI FEILONG throws Assassin B into the pool, then subdues Assassin A and sends her after.

Later. Both assassins sit drenched, hands bound with bathrobe sashes, on the massage bed.

LI FEILONG
The Li family?

ASSASSIN B
(laughs bitterly)
The century-old Lis? They could crash global markets. We're not qualified to mop their floors.

LI FEILONG
(mutters)
Good. I was worried they'd come for me.

LI FEILONG
Who hired you?

ASSASSIN B
We don't name clients.

LI FEILONG leans close, holding up his phone.

LI FEILONG
Security footage. Ten years minimum. Or cooperation?

ASSASSIN B
(defeated)
Chu Ruxuan. Your wife's competitor.

ASSASSIN A
The Chus think you're Su Yutong's silent partner. Remove you, they get the Li contract.

LI FEILONG
A third-rate family dares target my wife?

LI FEILONG cuts their bonds with a utility knife.

LI FEILONG
Tell your employer: the Chus have twenty-four hours to leave Jinghai. Permanently.

The assassins flee.

LI FEILONG takes out his phone, makes a call.

LI FEILONG
(on phone)
Qingqiu. Chu family made their move. Resolve it by morning.

He hangs up, eyes cold.

title: One Palm, One Universe
description: A disabled delivery man is beaten near death by a rich young master after protecting his mother from an aggressive guard dog, only to be resurrected by a deity who grants him a martial legacy that demands a heavy price.
context:
Title: One Palm, One Universe
Description: A disabled delivery man is beaten near death by a rich young master after protecting his mother from an aggressive guard dog, only to be resurrected by a deity who grants him a martial legacy that demands a heavy price.

EXT. STREET - DAY

1.

Delivery man JIANG PING supports his mother JIANG MU, a sanitation worker, as they walk. He limps on a crutch.

JIANG PING
(subtly checking her blistered palms)
Mom, the dumpling shop had leftovers. I saved you the pork ones.

JIANG MU
(frowning)
Waste of money.

A LOW GROWL. SHEN HAO, suited, struggles with a muscular BELGIAN MALINOIS.

SHEN HAO
(into phone)
—just get the car, the deal's—

The DOG lunges at JIANG MU. Jiang Ping shoves his mother aside, interposing his crutch. The dog yelps.

Shen Hao yanks the dog back, checking it.

SHEN HAO
(to Jiang Ping, ice quiet)
You struck a protection animal.

JIANG PING
(keeping himself between them)
It was going to bite her.

SHEN HAO
It's worth more than your annual income. Probably your lifetime.

A SMALL CROWD has gathered, phones out. No one intervenes.

JIANG MU
(quietly insistent, to Shen Hao)
I'll pay the vet. How much?

SHEN HAO
(eyes on Jiang Ping, not her)
Three hundred thousand. For starters.

JIANG MU
(horrified whisper)
We don't—

SHEN HAO
(to Jiang Ping, pulling out foil-wrapped takeout)
Then eat this. My dog's dinner. Premium kibble and truffle oil.

He opens it. The smell is foul.

JIANG PING
You're not serious.

SHEN HAO
Every bite. Or I call police and lawyer. Assault on private property.

JIANG PING
(jaw tight)
No.

Shen Hao's face flushes. He backhands Jiang Ping. The younger man staggers, crutch slipping.

SHEN HAO
(low, to the crowd)
This cripple attacked my dog. You all saw it.

The crowd murmurs agreement.

JIANG MU
continuation:
(trying to pull Jiang Ping away)
Xiao Ping, please—

Jiang Ping shakes her off.

JIANG PING
They saw you assault me.

Shen Hao's smile is thin. He nods to two BODYGUARDS from a black SUV.

SHEN HAO
(to bodyguards)
He resisted.

The bodyguards move in. Jiang Ping swings the crutch; they disarm him. They hold him kneeling.

Shen Hao picks up the crutch, examines it.

SHEN HAO
(quietly, to Jiang Ping)
You embarrassed me. In front of witnesses.

He strikes. Not the head—the spine. Precise. The crutch cracks against bone.

JIANG PING
(strangled sound)

Jiang Ping goes limp. Jiang Mu screams.

JIANG MU
No! He's had surgery—his spine—

Shen Hao tosses the crutch, pulls a money clip. He peels off hundreds, lets them fall on Jiang Ping's form.

SHEN HAO
(to Jiang Mu)
For the ambulance. If you can find one that'll come.

He walks away, dog at heel. The crowd dissolves. Jiang Mu cradles her son as bills blow away.

INT. MYSTICAL REALM - DAY

2.

Darkness. Then: ELECTRICITY crackling through neurons. Jiang Ping floats in synaptic light.

JIANG PING
(disembodied whisper)
...not again...

An IMMORTAL (ageless, linen tunic, scarred palms) appears.

IMMORTAL
You're not dead. Not yet. But your body is breaking its final promise.

JIANG PING
Who...?

IMMORTAL
Someone who chose the wrong student once. Watched him become the man who just broke you.

A beat.

IMMORTAL
I can offer you a second body. Rewritten. But the technique exacts a cost. Every strike you land, you feel their pain. Every life you take, a memory of yours burns away. Compassion or power. Choose.

Jiang Ping's spectral form flickers—his mother, crying over him.

JIANG PING
(voice gaining strength)
If it means she never has to beg again...

The Immortal extends his palm. A seal brands into Jiang Ping's chest.

IMMORTAL
The First Palm shatters bone. The Second Palm... shatters karma. You will never need a third.

Jiang Ping's eyes snap open—not fierce, but emptied. Resigned.

title: The Empress Dowager is with Child
description: A forbidden romance between an empress and an emperor ends in tragedy, leading to a modern-day woman's rebirth into the past.
context:
Title: The Empress Dowager is with Child
Description: A forbidden romance between an empress and an emperor ends in tragedy, leading to a modern-day woman's rebirth into the past.

INT. ANCIENT PALACE - DAY

Melodious ancient music plays.

JIANG WANSHUANG (30s), Empress Dowager in scarlet silk, reclines on a rosewood divan. Two male COURTIERS attend her—one pours wine, the other massages her shoulders.

EMPEROR LONG ZE (20s) storms in, dragon robes swirling.

LONG ZE
(angrily)
Get out. All of you.

The courtiers flee. Jiang Wanshuang doesn't move.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(leisurely)
What brings the Son of Heaven to this dowager's chambers?

Long Ze seizes her wrist.

LONG ZE
Wanshuang, I will not marry the Prime Minister's daughter. Don't use this method to anger me.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(serious)
Your father's will made me Empress Dowager. I'm your mother, by law.

LONG ZE
(coldly laughing)
Last moon you were in my bed. Not my mother's.

Jiang Wanshuang meets his eyes. Her expression hardens.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(laughing lightly)
Then perhaps I've tired of your inexperience, Your Majesty.

LONG ZE
(shocked)
You're lying.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(impatiently)
Leave me. Please.

Long Ze turns. Exits. Jiang Wanshuang watches until he's gone. She coughs. Blood spatters the jade cup. She collapses.

Long Ze hears. Rushes back in.

LONG ZE
(panicking)
Shuang'er! What did you do?

He catches her falling body.

JIANG WANSHUANG
(weakly)
Prime Minister's poison... finally took. Had to push you away... save you...

She dies. Long Ze holds her as the screen fades to black and white.

SUPER: Great Liang Dynasty, Year 1 of Tiansheng. Empress Dowager Jiang, deceased.
continuation:
INT. MODERN MANSION - DAY

2023. LIU HANYAN (20s) models a pink designer gown and diamonds, admiring herself in a mirror.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN, 20s) enters in monochrome separates. She hurls a velvet box at Liu Hanyan's feet. A diamond necklace spills out.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN)
Well, well, Liu Hanyan, you dare to steal my mother's heirlooms.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN) crushes the necklace under her heel.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN)
You and your mother are gone by dawn.

She exits. Liu Hanyan gathers the broken diamonds. Her eyes turn venomous.

INT. MANSION STAIRCASE - DAY

Jiang Wanshuang (Modern) climbs the marble stairs. Liu Hanyan appears at the top.

LIU HANYAN
Jiang Wanshuang!

Liu Hanyan shoves her. Jiang Wanshuang tumbles down the stairs. Her skull cracks against marble. Blood pools.

Liu Hanyan descends, first smiling, then feigning horror.

LIU HANYAN
(screaming)
Help! Somebody! Oh God!

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Jiang Wanshuang (Modern) lies on a hospital bed. A DOCTOR checks his watch.

DOCTOR
(looking at watch)
Time of death. 14:38.

The DOCTOR and NURSE exit. The body under the sheet opens ancient eyes—sharp, cold.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

Prime Minister's poison... finally took. Had to push you away... save you...

She dies. Long Ze holds her as the screen fades to black and white.

SUPER: Great Liang Dynasty, Year 1 of Tiansheng. Empress Dowager Jiang, deceased.

INT. MODERN MANSION - DAY

2023. LIU HANYAN (20s) models a pink designer gown and diamonds, admiring herself in a mirror.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN, 20s) enters in monochrome separates. She hurls a velvet box at Liu Hanyan's feet. A diamond necklace spills out.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN)
Well, well, Liu Hanyan, you dare to steal my mother's heirlooms.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN) crushes the necklace under her heel.

JIANG WANSHUANG (MODERN)
You and your mother are gone by dawn.

She exits. Liu Hanyan gathers the broken diamonds. Her eyes turn venomous.

INT. MANSION STAIRCASE - DAY

Jiang Wanshuang (Modern) climbs the marble stairs. Liu Hanyan appears at the top.

LIU HANYAN
Jiang Wanshuang!

Liu Hanyan shoves her. Jiang Wanshuang tumbles down the stairs. Her skull cracks against marble. Blood pools.

Liu Hanyan descends, first smiling, then feigning horror.

LIU HANYAN
(screaming)
Help! Somebody! Oh God!

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Jiang Wanshuang (Modern) lies on a hospital bed. A DOCTOR checks his watch.

DOCTOR
(looking at watch)
Time of death. 14:38.

The DOCTOR and NURSE exit. The body under the sheet opens ancient eyes—sharp, cold.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Crushed Tenderness
description: A blind woman is hunted through an abandoned factory by her abusive boyfriend who wants to use her pregnancy with a wealthy heir's child as leverage.
context:
Title: Crushed Tenderness
Description: A blind woman is hunted through an abandoned factory by her abusive boyfriend who wants to use her pregnancy with a wealthy heir's child as leverage.

INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT

A fire burns in a rusted barrel. Smoke hangs in the air.

LU ZHIYUAN, blind from birth, runs panicked. Her white dress is blood-stained.

FENG CHAO (O.S.)
Where did that blind bitch run off to!

Lu stumbles and falls. She crawls behind a concrete barrier.

Feng Chao emerges with a torch, searching.

FENG CHAO (O.S.)
Come out here!

FENG CHAO
Little treasure, come out now, stop hiding.

Lu hides, trembling with fear.

FENG CHAO
Miss Lu, stop running. You're carrying the Bo family's eldest grandson in your belly.

Lu's hand goes protectively to her stomach.

Feng Chao walks up a metal staircase.

FENG CHAO
As long as you go to the Bo family and they acknowledge you, our future will be completely secure. Just come out obediently, and I won't beat you anymore.

FLASHBACK BEGINS:
continuation:
INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

FENG CHAO roughly shoves LU ZHIYUAN against the bar.

LU ZHIYUAN
Go to hell!

FENG CHAO
Little cutie, you slut!

LU ZHIYUAN (crying)
I'm your woman, how can you force me to sleep with another man?

FENG CHAO
Lu Zhiyuan, you slut! I used to think you had the Lu family inheritance backing you. For five years I've fed you and clothed you, you should repay me now. Right now, I'm just making you pay back your debt with your body.

FENG CHAO grabs LU ZHIYUAN by the throat, pinning her against the wall.

FENG CHAO
Lu Zhiyuan, listen carefully! I drugged the drink of Bo Wang, the young master of Bo Corporation. You're going to sleep with him right now! Understand? You slut!

FENG CHAO pushes LU ZHIYUAN into a room and locks the door.

LU ZHIYUAN (O.S.)
Feng Chao, let me out! Let me out!

Bo Wang's hand reaches for her from the shadows.

INT. CAR - NIGHT

LU ZHIYUAN and BO WANG are in the back seat. She struggles desperately.

LU ZHIYUAN
No! No! Let me go!

BO WANG
Miss Lu, you're safe. I promise.

FLASHBACK ENDS.

INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT

LU ZHIYUAN hides in a corner, clutching a medical report. Her fingers read Braille: POSITIVE.

FENG CHAO (O.S.)
Come out! You little slut, where are you hiding? Come out!

LU ZHIYUAN (inner monologue)
Child, although I only conceived you because I was used by someone, you are still mother's only family in this world. Mother will do everything to protect you, and will never let you be used as a bargaining chip.

Feng Chao's footsteps grow closer.

BO WANG appears and touches Lu's shoulder. The pregnancy report falls.

BO WANG
Miss Lu, I finally found you.

Lu raises a sharp metal fragment, defiant.

BO WANG
Tell me, whose child are you carrying in your belly?

He catches the report, fingers the Braille.

BO WANG
Let me help you.

She hears Feng Chao approaching. She makes her choice.

LU ZHIYUAN
Get me out. Please.

BO WANG leads her away as Feng Chao's yell echoes.

FADE OUT.

title: Seven Years to Stardom
description: After seven years of supporting his wife's rise to fame, a songwriter faces divorce when she becomes a superstar and wants to hide their marriage.
context:
Title: Seven Years to Stardom
Description: After seven years of supporting his wife's rise to fame, a songwriter faces divorce when she becomes a superstar and wants to hide their marriage.

INT. UPSCALE BAR - NIGHT

LIN XI, YIN SHIYAN, and agent ZHU WENQI sit around a table. Wine and documents are on the table.

LIN XI
We really doing this?

YIN SHIYAN
I want to make this right. That's why I asked Sister Qi to draft a settlement.

ZHU WENQI
(sliding documents toward LIN XI)
The terms are generous. Shiyan's success reflects on everyone connected to her. We need a clean transition.

LIN XI
A confidentiality clause. Of course.

ZHU WENQI
In three days, Shiyan receives the Golden Phoenix Award. The press will be relentless. Every detail of her life dissected. You understand the position this puts her in.

LIN XI
So I'm a detail to be erased.

YIN SHIYAN
(quietly)
That's not what I said.

LIN XI
Then what, Shiyan? Seven years, and I get a check?

YIN SHIYAN
Those songs you wrote... they built my career. I want to pay what they're worth. Three million. It's not charity.

LIN XI
Three million for seven years. For the lyrics, the melodies, the nights I spent rewriting when you doubted yourself. For giving up my own deal to be your ghostwriter.

ZHU WENQI
(leaning forward)
Let's be honest. Those songs became hits because Shiyan sang them. You were a decent writer with no platform. She gave your work a voice.

LIN XI
(to YIN SHIYAN)
Is that what you believe?

YIN SHIYAN
(meeting his eyes, voice strained)
I believe... this is the only way forward for both of us.

LIN XI
The confidentiality clause. You really think I'd sell our story?

ZHU WENQI
We can't take that risk.

LIN XI
Then you don't know me at all. Keep your money. Keep your secrets.

ZHU WENQI
continuation:
(standing, controlled anger)
You're making a mistake.

YIN SHIYAN
Sister Qi. Remove the confidentiality clause.

ZHU WENQI
Shiyan—

YIN SHIYAN
Please.

ZHU WENQI snatches the documents and exits.

LIN XI
(quietly)
Was it worth it? Everything you left behind?

YIN SHIYAN
The view from the top is incredible. But the air is thin up there.

LIN XI
Maybe I'll find out for myself.

YIN SHIYAN
(smiling sadly)
You're thirty-two. The industry chews up artists younger than you every day.

LIN XI
I guess we'll see.

LIN XI raises his glass.

LIN XI
To your success, Shiyan. May it be everything you wanted.

LIN XI drinks, stands, and walks toward the stage.

INT. BAR STAGE - NIGHT

LIN XI picks up a guitar and sits in front of the microphone.

LIN XI (V.O.)
Seven years ago, I walked away from my own record deal to write love songs for someone else's future. Tonight, I'm taking my voice back.

LIN XI begins to play. YIN SHIYAN watches from below, tears forming.

LIN XI
(singing)
Seven years of whispers in the dark / Gave you every word that held my heart / You wear the crown I helped you earn / While I fade into the pages that burn

YIN SHIYAN
(whispering)
Lin Xi...

ZHU WENQI appears, gripping YIN SHIYAN's arm.

ZHU WENQI
Feng Shao's people are here. Now.

ZHU WENQI pulls YIN SHIYAN toward the exit. She looks back once as LIN XI's voice fills the room.

title: The Group's Beloved Heiress Has Her Identity Exposed Again
description: A young woman raised as a servant discovers her true identity when her powerful brothers come to take her home.
context:
Title: The Group's Beloved Heiress Has Her Identity Exposed Again
Description: A young woman raised as a servant discovers her true identity when her powerful brothers come to take her home.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

MU GUANG stands at the window, a silhouette against the city skyline. FEMALE ASSISTANT enters with a tablet.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Young Master Mu, this is the scholarship recipient from the provincial program.

She hands him the tablet. MU GUANG studies the screen—MU LI's photo, her eyes hauntingly familiar.

INSERT: DNA report. 99.9% paternal match.

FEMALE ASSISTANT (CONT'D)
The mandatory screening your foundation sponsors. Her sample lit up the family genome archive.

MU GUANG's knuckles whiten on the tablet.

MU GUANG
Get the car. Now.

INT. OFFICE/LABORATORY/ESPORTS ROOM - DAY

MONTAGE - THE BROTHERS ARE ACTIVATED

MU GUANG sends a text: "Location confirmed. Wu residence. Move."

INT. BOARDROOM - DAY

MU JING presides over a hostile takeover meeting. His phone BUZZES. He stands, throwing documents down.

MU JING
Deal's dead. I have family business.
continuation:
INT. RESEARCH LAB - DAY

MU SI explains a compound microscope to interns. Phone BUZZES. He strips off his lab coat.

MU SI
Grant presentation is postponed. Indefinitely.

INT. ESPORTS TRAINING ROOM - DAY

MU CHEN wears headphones, mid-ranked match. Phone lights up. He forfeits immediately.

MU CHEN
(into mic)
Family emergency. Gotta go.

EXT. CHINESE-STYLE COURTYARD - DAY

The four brothers converge from different directions at the Wu family's gate.

FOUR BROTHERS
(in unison)
Little sister, your brothers are here.

EXT. COURTYARD STEPS - DAY

MU LI sits on cracked steps, reading a vintage mathematics text. She carefully mends a torn page with tape.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY

MU LI enters, still reading. WU MEI bursts out, clutching a past-due notice.

WU MEI
The school called again. Another perfect score—so what? You think that makes you special?

She rips the book from MU LI's hands.

WU MEI (CONT'D)
This garbage! You think books will feed you?

She throws it down. MU LI's jaw tightens, but she doesn't move.

MU LI
(measured)
That book is library property. I work there three nights a week to pay for my school fees.

WU MEI
You ungrateful—

MU GUANG (O.S.)
The arrangement ends today.

All four brothers fill the courtyard entrance. WU MEI pales.

MU GUANG walks past her, retrieves MU LI's book, hands it back to her.

MU GUANG
(quiet)
I'm Mu Guang. We've been looking for you, Mu Li.

MU LI's fingers tighten on the book. She searches his face.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Book Dream Romance
description: A resilient fish vendor's dreams are shattered by betrayal, but a second chance awaits in a world where stories and reality collide.
context:
Title: Book Dream Romance
Description: A resilient fish vendor's dreams are shattered by betrayal, but a second chance awaits in a world where stories and reality collide.

INT. SEAFOOD MARKET - DAY

Fast-paced montage: Fishing boats unload at dawn, crabs scuttling across ice, Liang Xu's weathered hands counting change.

LIANG XU, late 20s, tired but focused, pins down a rebellious crab.

LIANG XU (V.O.)
Three years. Three hundred and sixty-two days per year. That's how long I've been saving for a different story.

LIANG XU pulls out a worn flask, pours a small offering onto the cutting board for the crab, then takes a careful sip himself, wincing at the burn.

ON SCREEN: LIANG XU - FISH VENDOR, DREAMER

His friend WEN XI, a delivery driver with ink-stained fingers, appears with a cardboard box.

WEN XI
Drawing a sword to cut water—

LIANG XU
—makes it flow more. I know, I know. You rehearse your lines more than I count crabs.

WEN XI grins, then his face multiplies in LIANG XU's vision, each version shouting louder.

WEN XI
A Liang! Delivery! A Liang!

LIANG XU
(steadying himself)
Alright. The manuscripts?

WEN XI
(proudly)
Proofed and perfect. Your novel edits. Plus something new.

WEN XI hands him paper-clipped pages beneath a waterproof bag.

LIANG XU
Keep them dry. My laptop died last month.

WEN XI
(tapping a crab)
These guys have better arcs than half the slop publishers print.

LIANG XU
(flipping pages)
Why do all these villains steal the protagonist's love interest? No buildup. Just... poof. Betrayed.

WEN XI
Instant rage-clicks. You wouldn't understand. Some people want pure catharsis.

LIANG XU reaches a handwritten margin note, his own cramped handwriting: "What if the villain wins because he's already inside the hero's house?" He swallows hard.

LIANG XU
(quietly)
I'd settle for just being able to finish my own story.

LIANG XU pulls out a thin bank envelope, thumbing the cash inside.

LIANG XU
Qingqing's tuition balance. Finally. She can graduate, we can—

YE CHEN, 30, immaculate suit, sunglasses reflecting the market grime, approaches with two BODYGUARDS who clear a path. He carries a leather portfolio.

YE CHEN
(pleasantly)
Vendor. Your crabs. Do they all come with guarantees?

LIANG XU
Depends on the guarantee.

YE CHEN
continuation:
That they won't disappoint me. Like people do.

LIANG XU
Males fight. Females nurture. Which disappointment are you?

YE CHEN's smile vanishes. He signals. One bodyguard produces a roll of bills—exactly twice what LIANG XU saved.

YE CHEN
I'll take them all. And your loyalty.

LIANG XU
Not for sale.

YE CHEN leans in, his voice dropping to a whisper.

YE CHEN
She already took the tuition money, you know. Yesterday. Said it was for you.

LIANG XU goes pale. YE CHEN pulls him into a forced embrace, knife sliding from his sleeve. The blade enters beneath LIANG XU's ribs—precise, hidden by their bodies.

LIANG XU
(gasping)
Why... this?

YE CHEN
(leaning close)
Because you exist. That's offense enough.

QINGQING appears, 24, nervous, clutching a designer bag. She sees them, understands, but doesn't scream.

ON SCREEN: QINGQING - LIANG XU'S FIANCEE, DEBT-RIDDEN

LIANG XU reaches for her.

LIANG XU
Qingqing... the money...

YE CHEN
(laughing)
Oh, she has your money. Spent it on that bag. Cost less than her silence.

QINGQING
(desperate, not cold)
Don't make this about money, A Liang. You never had enough to fix my problems. He does.

LIANG XU
(bleeding)
I gave you everything—

QINGQING
(tears falling)
Exactly! Everything you had was everything I couldn't afford to need. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.

QINGQING turns away. YE CHEN twists the knife.

YE CHEN
The only real prison is poverty. Welcome to your escape.

LIANG XU collapses. Blood pools on his manuscript pages.

LIANG XU (V.O.)
So this is how my story ends. Not with words, but with—

MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)
—silence? No. This chapter merely needs a better editor. Someone who understands that villains should fear the epilogue.

Memory fragments: Qingqing's exhausted nights studying, Ye Chen's shadow in her doorway, the tuition deadline notice, Liang Xu's own written words: "The hero dies on page one. The legend begins on page two."

His vision darkens, then a single spark. Water rushes.

INT. POOLSIDE - DAY

Several beautiful girls laugh in a sun-drenched pool.

LIANG XU's eyes snap open. He's lying on a marble deck, shirtless, a manuscript page clutched in his hand. His own handwriting now reads: "Chapter Two: The Villain's Mistake."

Vendor. Your crabs. Do they all come with guarantees?

LIANG XU
Depends on the guarantee.

YE CHEN
That they won't disappoint me. Like people do.

LIANG XU
Males fight. Females nurture. Which disappointment are you?

YE CHEN's smile vanishes. He signals. One bodyguard produces a roll of bills—exactly twice what LIANG XU saved.

YE CHEN
I'll take them all. And your loyalty.

LIANG XU
Not for sale.

YE CHEN leans in, his voice dropping to a whisper.

YE CHEN
She already took the tuition money, you know. Yesterday. Said it was for you.

LIANG XU goes pale. YE CHEN pulls him into a forced embrace, knife sliding from his sleeve. The blade enters beneath LIANG XU's ribs—precise, hidden by their bodies.

LIANG XU
(gasping)
Why... this?

YE CHEN
(leaning close)
Because you exist. That's offense enough.

QINGQING appears, 24, nervous, clutching a designer bag. She sees them, understands, but doesn't scream.

ON SCREEN: QINGQING - LIANG XU'S FIANCEE, DEBT-RIDDEN

LIANG XU reaches for her.

LIANG XU
Qingqing... the money...

YE CHEN
(laughing)
Oh, she has your money. Spent it on that bag. Cost less than her silence.

QINGQING
(desperate, not cold)
Don't make this about money, A Liang. You never had enough to fix my problems. He does.

LIANG XU
(bleeding)
I gave you everything—

QINGQING
(tears falling)
Exactly! Everything you had was everything I couldn't afford to need. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.

QINGQING turns away. YE CHEN twists the knife.

YE CHEN
The only real prison is poverty. Welcome to your escape.

LIANG XU collapses. Blood pools on his manuscript pages.

LIANG XU (V.O.)
So this is how my story ends. Not with words, but with—

MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)
—silence? No. This chapter merely needs a better editor. Someone who understands that villains should fear the epilogue.

Memory fragments: Qingqing's exhausted nights studying, Ye Chen's shadow in her doorway, the tuition deadline notice, Liang Xu's own written words: "The hero dies on page one. The legend begins on page two."

His vision darkens, then a single spark. Water rushes.

INT. POOLSIDE - DAY

Several beautiful girls laugh in a sun-drenched pool.

LIANG XU's eyes snap open. He's lying on a marble deck, shirtless, a manuscript page clutched in his hand. His own handwriting now reads: "Chapter Two: The Villain's Mistake."

title: Twin Treasures - Daddy's Here, Mommy Run
description: A woman plans an elaborate heist to reclaim her late mother's precious gemstone from an auction.
context:
Title: Twin Treasures - Daddy's Here, Mommy Run
Description: A woman plans an elaborate heist to reclaim her late mother's precious gemstone from an auction.

INT. BEDROOM - FLASHBACK

A MAN IN GLASSES and LU WANQING (20s) lie together. She spots his LIN CORPORATION ID badge and quietly slips away at dawn, taking a LOCKET.

EXT. PARKING LOT - NIGHT

LU WANQING (30s, red gown) wears a bluetooth earpiece, her expression serious.

LU WANQING
(internal monologue)
Five years ago, that Lin Corp executive gave me Jiujiu. Tonight, I reclaim what his family stole.

LU JIUJIU (O.S.)
Mommy! Mommy, the security loop's active!

LU WANQING
Jiujiu, I hear you. Everything is ready on my end. How about yours?

INT. ELECTRICAL ROOM - NIGHT

LU JIUJIU, a five-year-old boy wearing a shirt and tie, also wears an earpiece, his expression serious.

LU JIUJIU
The North Star gemstone that Grandma left behind is on display now. Such an interesting treasure hunt game, I've been ready for ages.
continuation:
EXT. PARKING LOT - NIGHT

LU WANQING
Good, baby. Then let's proceed according to plan.

INT. AUCTION HALL - NIGHT

The AUCTIONEER rings a golden bell.

AUCTIONEER
Once again, thank you all for attending the jewelry exhibition hosted by Lin Corporation. Next, please welcome our grand finale item, the North Star gemstone.

A necklace adorned with a huge blue heart-shaped gemstone is displayed inside a laser-protected case.

INT. ELECTRICAL ROOM - NIGHT

LU JIUJIU watches the surveillance footage.

LU JIUJIU
Alright, go.

He pulls down the circuit breaker.

INT. AUCTION HALL - NIGHT

The lights instantly go out, plunging the venue into darkness. Guests become agitated.

GUEST A
What's happening?

GUEST B
Such a big event and there's a power outage?

GUEST C
The North Star was just brought out, I was looking at it.

The lights come back on.

GUEST D
(terrified)
The gemstone is gone!

The AUCTIONEER looks at the empty display stand, shocked.

AUCTIONEER
Seal all exits, don't let anyone through!

LU WANQING walks calmly through the crowd. She holds a necklace in her hand - the missing North Star gemstone. She reveals a triumphant smile, touching her locket.

LU WANQING
(internal monologue)
Daddy's corporation. Mommy's jewel. Jiujiu's legacy.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: I Bid Farewell to Old Love with a New Marriage
description: A young woman agrees to a marriage alliance to save her mother, but the groom refuses to show up at their wedding ceremony.
context:
Title: I Bid Farewell to Old Love with a New Marriage
Description: A young woman agrees to a marriage alliance to save her mother, but the groom refuses to show up at their wedding ceremony.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

Crystal chandeliers cast fractured light across empty chairs. QINGQING, 25, walks the aisle alone in a white gown and rose crown. Scattered guests record on phones, but most whisper behind raised hands.

GUEST A (O.S.)
(whispering)
She's stunning. Pity about the circumstances.

GUEST B
(arms crossed, low voice)
All that preparation. For what?

GUEST C
(leaning in)
Groom hasn't been seen in days. Not a single confirmation.

GUEST D
What happens if he doesn't show?

GUEST B
(shrugs)
The contract's signed. Ceremony's just for show.

GUEST C
Quiet. She's reaching the altar.

QINGQING (V.O.)
I signed Father's contract. My signature for Mother's life. What happens at an altar doesn't change that.

The stage sits empty. The officiator avoids eye contact.

GUEST D
(points)
Old Mrs. Gu is on her phone again.

GU MOTHER stands rigid, phone pressed to her ear.
continuation:
INT. WEDDING VENUE - CONTINUOUS

INTERCUT WITH:

INT. GU CORPORATION PENTHOUSE - DAY

GU XIAOCHEN, 28, watches the city through floor-to-ceiling windows, phone to his ear.

GU MOTHER
(into phone)
The ballroom is waiting.

GU XIAOCHEN
Then un-wait it.

GU MOTHER
The Su family's funds are transferred. Your refusal humiliates them.

GU XIAOCHEN
Your contract. Not mine.

GU MOTHER
(pleading)
She's a good girl. She deserves—

GU XIAOCHEN
She deserves a choice. You gave her none.

GU MOTHER
You'd destroy your own family?

GU XIAOCHEN
I'd save it from you.

He hangs up. Gu Mother stares at the screen, knuckles white.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - LATER

Empty chairs, cleared tables. QINGQING sits on the stage's edge, crown in her lap. GU MOTHER approaches, guilt in every step.

GU MOTHER
(sitting beside her)
Qingqing... I've wronged you.

QINGQING
(turning, calm)
You've freed me.

She produces a folded paper from her sleeve - the marriage contract.

QINGQING (CONT'D)
Clause twelve. 'Should either party fail to appear, the arrangement is null.'

GU MOTHER
The money—

QINGQING
—was for my mother's care. Not my person.

She tears the contract cleanly. The sound echoes.

QINGQING (CONT'D)
Your son's absence honored both our boundaries. Tell him I'm grateful.

She stands, places the rose crown on the stage, and walks toward the exit. At the doors, she pauses.

QINGQING (CONT'D)
And tell Father: my price just went up.

She exits. Gu Mother sits alone, the crown gleaming in her hands.

title: Unbridled
description: A woman dying of cancer realizes she was only a substitute for her husband's true love and decides to end her life, but mysterious voices intervene.
context:
Title: Unbridled
Description: A woman dying of cancer realizes she was only a substitute for her husband's true love and decides to end her life, but mysterious voices intervene.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Medication bottles line the nightstand. SU JINMO watches FU YANCHEN pack a suitcase.

SU JINMO
Yanchen... the doctor called today.

FU YANCHEN
(doesn't turn)
I know.

He slams the suitcase shut. A photograph peeks out—him with a woman who looks like Jinmo, but isn't.

ON SCREEN: Character introduction text - FU YANCHEN, President of Fu Group; SU JINMO.

SU JINMO
You know?

FU YANCHEN
Xining saw you at the hospital. She told me everything.
(beat)
This card has one million in it, and this house. They're yours. Our relationship ends here.

He places a keycard on the dresser. Jinmo's reflection in the mirror shows her hand trembling near her abdomen.

SU JINMO
(softly)
I wasn't going to ask for money.

FU YANCHEN
Then what? Pity?

He walks to the door, pauses.

FU YANCHEN
You got three years because you looked like her. Be grateful.

He leaves. Jinmo's fingers find a crumpled pathology report in her robe pocket. She stares at the words: METASTATIC.
continuation:
INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

SU JINMO lies in the bathtub, candlelight flickering on wet porcelain. Her phone glows with a social media post: Fu Yanchen and Su Xining at a gala, captioned "Back where I belong."

SU JINMO (V.O.)
(thready)
You said you'd love me until I died. You just didn't think it would be so soon.

Her hand slips beneath the water. A single red ribbon swirls upward.

SU JINMO (V.O.)
This time, I won't be anyone's ghost.

Her head tilts back. A drop of blood falls. The ribbon drifts toward the drain.

ON SCREEN: Episode One

ON SCREEN: Bullet comments flood the frame.

BULLET COMMENTS (V.O.)
(chaotic)
She's actually doing it? No way they'll kill the FL! Classic torture drama!

SU JINMO (V.O.)
(whisper)
Who's... talking?

The candle flames flicker blue. The blood drop rolls UP the tub's curve, defying gravity.

MYSTERIOUS VOICE (V.O.)
(urgent, layered)
Hey! Not this again! Wake up! WAKE UP WAKE UP WAKE—

The ribbon flies from the drain, wrapping Jinmo's wrist like a tourniquet. Her eyes snap open.

title: Unrivaled Under Heaven & Purple Robe (Episode 97) Wang Xingchen
description: The Weapon Queen, Eagle Nation's Grand Special Envoy, and the Temple Master witness the ascension of Master Qin, as he transcends mortality through a lightning baptism.
context:
Title: Unrivaled Under Heaven & Purple Robe (Episode 97) Wang Xingchen
Description: The Weapon Queen, Eagle Nation's Grand Special Envoy, and the Temple Master witness the ascension of Master Qin, as he transcends mortality through a lightning baptism.

EXT. CHINESE GARDEN - DAY

The WEAPON QUEEN, EAGLE NATION'S GRAND SPECIAL ENVOY, and the TEMPLE MASTER kneel on one knee, facing an ancient circular pavilion. The Envoy's hand grips his sword hilt. The Temple Master's forehead nearly touches the ground.

XU LIUYING, wearing a red dress, walks up the steps carrying a tray with a neatly folded yellow robe.

TEMPLE MASTER
Eastern Kingdom's Royal Master Xu Liuying.

EAGLE NATION'S GRAND SPECIAL ENVOY
Eastern Kingdom's Royal Master Xu Liuying.

WEAPON QUEEN
(looking up)
What a schemer you are.

XU LIUYING
(contemptuously)
To actually lower yourself to serve as a maid here.

WEAPON QUEEN
Serving the Celestial Master.

XU LIUYING
So what if I am? Today the Celestial Master becomes a saint. Make him owe me one glance, and a century of servitude is worth it.

EAGLE NATION'S GRAND SPECIAL ENVOY
(angrily standing)
Despicable Eastern Kingdom people! Where is the Celestial Master?

XU LIUYING
(looking skyward)
Bathing in the lightning pool.

The sky ruptures. Dark clouds spiral, vomiting thunder.

TEMPLE MASTER
(shielding his face)
He welcomes the tribulation into his body!
continuation:
In the sky, QIN XIU, bare-chested and wearing white pants, weaves through countless lightning bolts. Each strike brands glowing meridians on his skin. His expression remains serene.

WEAPON QUEEN
(to herself)
Heaven's wrath descending, Earth's core-fire rising... he's triggering the twin phenomena.

TEMPLE MASTER
Three hundred years. Billions of souls. Only he has entered the Dao.

EAGLE NATION'S GRAND SPECIAL ENVOY
(quietly)
The undisputed number one person in the world.

The lightning phenomenon disappears. QIN XIU stands on a stone platform, steam rising from his shoulders.

XU LIUYING
(smiling, stepping forward)
Congratulations to the Celestial Master for transcending mortality and becoming a saint!

The Weapon Queen, Eagle Nation's Grand Special Envoy, and Temple Master kowtow. Their voices overlap unevenly.

ALL
Congratulations... Celestial Master... Saint...

XU LIUYING
(holding the tray higher)
Celestial Master, allow me to dress you.

QIN XIU
(expression indifferent)
No need. The robe will find its master.

A resonant voice echoes from all directions:

VOICE (O.S.)
Celestial Master Qin transcends into sainthood! The Nether Lord's gift has arrived!

Twilight swallows the garden. From the shadows, a procession emerges—figures wearing lacquered masks that weep sap, moving to the rhythm of a phantom drum.

QIN XIU
(a faint smile)
Debt collectors.

Sparks dance around his fingertips, casting sickly light on the weeping masks.

title: You Are the Fireworks of the World
description: A secretary discovers her boyfriend's betrayal with her boss's fiancée and proposes an unexpected form of revenge.
context:
Title: You Are the Fireworks of the World
Description: A secretary discovers her boyfriend's betrayal with her boss's fiancée and proposes an unexpected form of revenge.

INT. JUNAN HOTEL - NIGHT

Exterior of the hotel building, countless windows lit up. Text overlay: Junan Hotel.

MU ZIAN half-lies on the bed, GONG JIAOJIAO straddles him.

MU ZIAN
Jiaojiao.

GONG JIAOJIAO
Look how eager you are.

The two embrace and kiss. The camera pans across a bouquet of flowers by the bed. Hidden beneath the ribbon of the bouquet is a tiny camera, its red light blinking.

INT. MU XINGYUAN'S OFFICE - DAY

MU XINGYUAN sits at his desk, surveillance footage from the hotel room playing on his computer screen. He watches with a serious expression.

XU YI walks into the office angrily.

XU YI
President Mu, we have a situation. Your nephew and... the other party.

MU XINGYUAN
Two idiots. Not worth dirtying my hands over.

MU XINGYUAN clenches his fist, his eyes cold.

MU XINGYUAN
Go get Secretary Jiang for me.

XU YI
Yes.

XU YI turns and leaves.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE CORRIDOR/MU XINGYUAN'S OFFICE - DAY

JIANG WANQING, wearing professional attire and flat shoes, walks down the office corridor. She glances at her phone—a hospital payment reminder—then enters.

JIANG WANQING
President Mu, you wanted to see me?

MU XINGYUAN
Are you dating my nephew Mu Zian?

JIANG WANQING
(pause)
Yes, President Mu.

MU XINGYUAN
As far as I know, Mu Zian has cheated more times than you can count on both hands. What exactly do you tolerate it for?

JIANG WANQING
(smiling tightly)
The same reason anyone honors a bad contract. I have obligations.

MU XINGYUAN
(challenging)
Do you know who the woman is this time?

MU XINGYUAN turns the computer screen toward JIANG WANQING. She sees the surveillance footage, her smile shatters—hurt, then hardened resolve.

JIANG WANQING
(quietly)
Your fiancée. He's surpassed himself.

MU XINGYUAN
Junan Hotel. Room 8808. Still in progress.

MU XINGYUAN pushes a room key card across the desk.

MU XINGYUAN
Here's the key card. Go now, and you might still catch the climax.

MU XINGYUAN stands to leave. JIANG WANQING reaches out and stops him.

MU XINGYUAN
What? Secretary Jiang doesn't want to catch them in the act?

JIANG WANQING
(smiling again)
Direct confrontation is for those with nothing to lose. For revenge that actually costs him? I have a better idea.

MU XINGYUAN
I'm listening.

JIANG WANQING moves closer to MU XINGYUAN, grabs his tie, tilts her head up and kisses him.

INT. MU XINGYUAN'S OFFICE - DAY

MU XINGYUAN sits at his desk, surveillance footage from the hotel room playing on his computer screen. He watches with a serious expression.

XU YI walks into the office angrily.

XU YI
President Mu, we have a situation. Your nephew and... the other party.

MU XINGYUAN
Two idiots. Not worth dirtying my hands over.

MU XINGYUAN clenches his fist, his eyes cold.

MU XINGYUAN
Go get Secretary Jiang for me.

XU YI
Yes.

XU YI turns and leaves.

INT. OFFICE CORRIDOR/MU XINGYUAN'S OFFICE - DAY

JIANG WANQING, wearing professional attire and flat shoes, walks down the office corridor. She glances at her phone—a hospital payment reminder—then enters.

JIANG WANQING
President Mu, you wanted to see me?

MU XINGYUAN
Are you dating my nephew Mu Zian?

JIANG WANQING
(pause)
Yes, President Mu.

MU XINGYUAN
As far as I know, Mu Zian has cheated more times than you can count on both hands. What exactly do you tolerate it for?

JIANG WANQING
(smiling tightly)
The same reason anyone honors a bad contract. I have obligations.

MU XINGYUAN
(challenging)
Do you know who the woman is this time?

MU XINGYUAN turns the computer screen toward JIANG WANQING. She sees the surveillance footage, her smile shatters—hurt, then hardened resolve.

JIANG WANQING
(quietly)
Your fiancée. He's surpassed himself.

MU XINGYUAN
Junan Hotel. Room 8808. Still in progress.

MU XINGYUAN pushes a room key card across the desk.

MU XINGYUAN
Here's the key card. Go now, and you might still catch the climax.

MU XINGYUAN stands to leave. JIANG WANQING reaches out and stops him.

MU XINGYUAN
What? Secretary Jiang doesn't want to catch them in the act?

JIANG WANQING
(smiling again)
Direct confrontation is for those with nothing to lose. For revenge that actually costs him? I have a better idea.

MU XINGYUAN
I'm listening.

JIANG WANQING moves closer to MU XINGYUAN, grabs his tie, tilts her head up and kisses him.

context:
Title: THE PEERLESS KING
Description: A humble delivery driver conceals a legendary past as the master who trained four war gods. When imperial tradition collides with modern life, he must choose between the quiet existence he craves and the destiny that refuses to let him go.

EXT. STREET SIDE - DAY

Several DELIVERY WORKERS in branded uniforms share a meal around their parked scooters. Steam rises from takeout containers. The city hums in the background.

CHUBBY COLLEAGUE
Hey, Chu Chen. Your dad still setting you up on those blind dates?

CHU CHEN
(leaning against his scooter)
It's a disaster. Last one asked about my salary before my name.

WISE COLLEAGUE
(grinning)
You're a good man. My daughter's too young, but I'd put in a word if I could.

CHUBBY COLLEAGUE
(laughing, mouth full)
With your ugly mug? She'd run for the hills.

The delivery app on Chu Chen's phone chirps.

PHONE NOTIFICATION (V.O.)
New order confirmed. Priority pickup.

CHU CHEN
(capping his thermos)
Gotta bounce. Cover for me?

He tosses his half-eaten meal to Chubby Colleague.

CHUBBY COLLEAGUE
(calling after)
You're too nice, bro!

A procession of twelve WOMEN in tailored black suits rounds the corner. Their synchronized stride draws every eye. At their head is ZHU QUE, her presence magnetic and unmistakable.

STARSTRUCK COLLEAGUE
(whispering, awestruck)
That's her. That's War God Zhu Que. I saw her feature last month...

WISE COLLEAGUE
She sealed the northern borders three years running. What is she doing in our district?

CHUBBY COLLEAGUE
(urgent whisper)
Show some respect!

The workers and nearby PEDESTRIANS begin to kneel, heads bowed.

CHU CHEN
(quietly, to himself)
Not this again.

CHUBBY COLLEAGUE
(panicked whisper)
Chen! Get down!

Chu Chen steps forward instead, casual in his worn delivery jacket.

CHU CHEN
Zhu Que. We're in public.

Zhu Que's disciplined mask cracks. She drops to one knee on the pavement, heedless of the dirt.

ZHU QUE
Master. Forgive this interruption.

HER GUARDS
(in perfect unison)
Master.

A hush falls. Chubby Colleague's takeout container slips from his hands.

CHU CHEN
(sighs)
I trained you better than this. On your feet. All of you.

Zhu Que rises, her bearing military-perfect. She produces a sealed scroll from her jacket.

ZHU QUE
continuation:
The Council's decree. They refused my petition to let you remain—

CHU CHEN
(holds up a hand)
Don't. Not here.

ZHU QUE
(quietly urgent)
Your three senior disciples hold the peace across the territories. The northern clans, the eastern seas, the western plains... they all answer to us. To you. The Council needs a symbol.

CHU CHEN
I have a job. See this uniform?

ZHU QUE
(pleading)
Just read the decree. Please.

Chu Chen breaks the seal. His eyes scan the document. His shoulders tighten.

CHU CHEN (V.O.)
They never understand. Power isn't a gift. It's a cage.

He looks at his colleagues—his friends—frozen in shock.

CHU CHEN
(to Zhu Que)
Get your people out of here. I'll consider it.

ZHU QUE
Master—

CHU CHEN
That's an order.

Zhu Que snaps a salute. The procession melts away as swiftly as it appeared.

WISE COLLEAGUE
(voice shaking)
Chu Chen... what did she call you?

CHU CHEN
(shouldering his delivery bag)
A ghost from someone else's life. Lunch is on me tomorrow.

He walks off, phone already ringing.

CHU CHEN
(into phone)
Dad, I'm working—

CHU CHEN'S FATHER (O.S.)
(no-nonsense)
The hotel address is in your messages. Be there in forty minutes. Don't you dare disappoint her.

The line goes dead. Chu Chen stares at his screen.

INT. CLOUD PEAK HOTEL - GOLDEN LOBBY - DAY

Chu Chen enters, still in his work clothes. He smooths his hair and approaches the concierge.

CONCIERGE
(coldly)
Deliveries are the service entrance.

CHU CHEN
I'm meeting someone.

The concierge's skeptical glance slides down Chu Chen's worn sneakers.

CONCIERGE
(sarcastic)
Of course. Room 208. The Sapphire Suite.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

Chu Chen walks the plush carpet. At the door marked 208, he pauses. Through the crack, he glimpses a woman's hand—manicured, poised—pouring tea with deliberate grace. A diamond bracelet catches the light.

The hand stills. She knows he's there.

CHU CHEN
(under his breath)
This should be interesting.

He raises his hand to knock.

title: The Foolish Son-in-Law of Qimen
description: A man who sealed his own soul for five years awakens to find himself married, facing humiliation from a arrogant rival.
context:
Title: The Foolish Son-in-Law of Qimen
Description: A man who sealed his own soul for five years awakens to find himself married, facing humiliation from a arrogant rival.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

A black luxury car arrives. BODYGUARDS open the rear doors for SONG YAN and CHU CHEN.

SONG YAN, wearing a pink dress, has an elegant yet brittle demeanor. CHU CHEN, in a simple white shirt, has a dazed expression—his fingers constantly tracing patterns against his palm.

They exit. The BODYGUARDS bow.

Two FEMALE PASSERSBY point and whisper nearby.

FEMALE PASSERBY A
Song Yan's really shackled herself to that... damaged collateral?

FEMALE PASSERBY B
They say he can't finish a sentence. The Ye family must be thrilled.

YE SHAOHUANG, a young man with eccentric silver hair and a blindingly white suit, blocks their path. He sucks on a gold-dusted lollipop.

YE SHAOHUANG
The Ye family hotel has a reputation, Song Yan. We don't host mental health cases.

SONG YAN
(angrily)
Your father built this empire with Song capital. Show some respect.

YE SHAOHUANG
(chuckling)
After tonight, you'll be capitalizing on my last name. The merger is signed at dawn.

SONG YAN
Dream on. I will never marry you.
continuation:
YE SHAOHUANG
Can you really decide that?

He waves the lollipop before Chu Chen's face. Chu Chen's eyes TRACK it—a flicker of cognition breaking through.

YE SHAOHUANG
I advise you to cooperate obediently.

CHU CHEN
(shouting)
Don't bully my wife!

CHU CHEN rushes toward YE SHAOHUANG but is easily kicked to the ground. He lies motionless.

YE SHAOHUANG
(disdainfully)
Your wife? By midnight, she'll be sending thank-you notes.

A faint GLOW emanates from beneath Chu Chen's shirt collar—ancient seal marks pulsing.

CHU CHEN (V.O.)
Five years I erased myself. Now I wake to a wife I never earned... and blood debt I must collect.

YE SHAOHUANG
(to himself)
Let the fool inside. The board needs to see how desperate the Songs have become.

YE SHAOHUANG laughs smugly.

SONG YAN
(furious, cradling Chu Chen's head)
You think this makes you a man?

CHU CHEN, lying on the ground, suddenly opens his eyes. His gaze becomes sharp, pupils contracting to molten gold. The concrete beneath his fingertips SPLINTERS.

title: Return of the Strongest King
description: A former young master now running a barbecue stall is confronted by thugs demanding protection money, revealing his hidden identity.
context:
Title: Return of the Strongest King
Description: A former young master now running a barbecue stall is confronted by thugs demanding protection money, revealing his hidden identity.

EXT. NIGHT MARKET BARBECUE STALL - NIGHT

Under the night sky at a barbecue stall, flames rise. FAN TIAN, a young man wearing a white shirt, bow tie, and apron, focuses intently on grilling meat skewers. Calloused knuckles reveal old scars.

ON SCREEN: Sea City's Young Master - Fan Tian

LIN FAMILY'S young master SU ZE swaggers in with a group of subordinates.

ON SCREEN: Lin Family's Eight Chief Enforcers - Su Ze

SU ZE's subordinates rush into the barbecue stall and begin wildly smashing things, overturning tables and chairs. CUSTOMERS flee in panic.

SU ZE
Love to show off, don't you? Don't want to pay protection fees? This is what happens.

FAN TIAN
(calmly)
Three months for that license.

FAN TIAN takes out a business license and hands it to SU ZE.

FAN TIAN
What protection fee?

SU ZE takes the license and tears it in half.

SU ZE
In Sea City, my uncle's the First Bureau. You're not even worthy of polishing my shoes.

FAN TIAN
I earn money with my own hands. Watch your mouth.
continuation:
SU ZE
(laughing in anger)
I'll take those hands right now!

SU ZE angrily reaches for FAN TIAN, but his wrist is blocked by an unsheathed sword. A woman in black combat attire, LUO CHUAN, appears, gripping the sword with cold eyes.

ON SCREEN: Capital's Imperial Sky Army Vice General - Luo Chuan

LUO CHUAN
(to SU ZE)
Move and lose it.

FAN TIAN
Luo Chuan.

SU ZE
(to LUO CHUAN)
Get lost!

LUO CHUAN twists her wrist. SU ZE cries out in pain and drops his weapon. LUO CHUAN sheathes her sword, turns, and kneels on one knee before FAN TIAN.

LUO CHUAN
Subordinate arrived late. Please punish me, Master.

FAN TIAN
(helping her up)
Three years, Luo Chuan. I almost had a normal life.

FAN TIAN glances at the ruined stall, the watching crowd.

FAN TIAN
Clean this up. Quietly.

LUO CHUAN lowers her head, showing a guilty expression, then signals to shadows in the crowd.

title: The Heiress Goes Crazy in the Entertainment Industry
description: A young woman wakes up in a hospital after an accident, believing she is a prime minister's daughter from ancient times, only to find herself in the modern world engaged to a man she once knew.
context:
Title: The Heiress Goes Crazy in the Entertainment Industry
Description: A young woman wakes up in a hospital after an accident, believing she is a prime minister's daughter from ancient times, only to find herself in the modern world engaged to a man she once knew.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

FLASHBACK:

QIN YINGYING (V.O.)
(voice tight with manufactured guilt)
I really didn't mean to. It was all sister, sister pushed me, and she fell down herself.

LU SIYA (V.O.)
(eagerly)
Yingying, everyone knows you and my uncle are a match made in heaven. Qin Xi, this country bumpkin from the countryside, how is she worthy of my uncle?

FLASHBACK TO:

EXT. ANCIENT BATTLEFIELD - DAY

LU JINGSHEN, covered in blood, collapses in QIN XI's arms. Then LU JINGSHEN lies on the ground, surrounded by enemies. Their blades glint in firelight.

BACK TO:
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

QIN XI lies in a hospital bed, head wrapped in bandages, and suddenly wakes up with a start.

QIN XI
(terrified)
Jingshen!

QIN XI sits up, looks around, confused. QIN YINGYING and LU SIYA enter the ward.

QIN XI
(confused, formal)
Miss, where is this place? Everything I see is white... Jingshen, is he dead?

QIN YINGYING
(impatiently)
Qin Xi, did you knock your head stupid?

LU SIYA
(disdainfully)
Vulgar and crude, no knowledge, no manners. I really don't know how someone like you could be my uncle's fiancée.

QIN XI
(angry, drawing herself up)
How dare you! I am the legitimate daughter of the Prime Minister's household. How dare you insult me like this?

LU SIYA
(mocking)
Qin Xi, are you playing cosplay now? You're the Prime Minister's daughter, and I'm a princess.

QIN YINGYING
(suspicious, head tilting)
Sister, you're not trying to use amnesia to cover up the fact that you grew up in the countryside, with limited knowledge and vulgar manners, are you?

QIN XI clutches her head in pain. Memories war within her.

LU JINGSHEN appears at the door, stance rigid.

LU JINGSHEN
Qin Yingying.

LU JINGSHEN (V.O.)
(internal, cold)
Mama Chen saw with her own eyes that you pushed her.

QIN XI sees LU JINGSHEN, immediately gets out of bed, rushes over and hugs him tightly, IV pole clattering.

QIN XI
(crying, desperate)
Jingshen! Jingshen, thank goodness you're alive. I thought I would never see you again.

QIN XI cries in LU JINGSHEN's arms. LU JINGSHEN stands with a complex expression on his face, his hands hovering at his sides.

FADE OUT.

title: Wudao Mountain Wuji Temple
description: A humble temple janitor reveals his hidden strength when confronted by arrogant visitors before a martial arts trial assembly.
context:
Title: Wudao Mountain Wuji Temple
Description: A humble temple janitor reveals his hidden strength when confronted by arrogant visitors before a martial arts trial assembly.

TITLE CARD: WUDAO MOUNTAIN WUJI TEMPLE

EXT. TEMPLE MOUNTAIN GATE - DAY

A black sedan stops at the bottom of a long stone staircase. Several BODYGUARDS exit the car and open an umbrella for an elegant woman in a black dress (QIN RUOYU).

QIN RUOYU walks briskly up the stone steps in high heels.

On the steps, a young man in simple white clothing (YE QINGYUN) is lying down sleeping, with a broom and a pile of swept leaves beside him.

QIN RUOYU
Ye Qingyun?

YE QINGYUN opens his eyes—not lazy, but assessing.

YE QINGYUN
You're early. The Assembly doesn't start for hours.

QIN RUOYU
The Xia family petitioned the Council. Intervene today, and you're rogue. No sect, no protection.

She places a sealed envelope beside him.

YE QINGYUN
(sitting up)
They think sweeping temples scares me?

QIN RUOYU
They think losing your name terrifies you.
