title: Gale: Desperate Escape
description: Xiao Lang and his companions attempt to escape from a compound in Myawaddy, only to be caught by ruthless guards.
context:
Title: Gale: Desperate Escape
Description: Xiao Lang and his companions attempt to escape from a compound in Myawaddy, only to be caught by ruthless guards.

INT. COMPOUND COURTYARD - NIGHT

A pair of THUGS patrol, their synchronized footsteps echoing off concrete. One pauses to light a cigarette - a predictable sixty-second delay.

XIAO LANG, YANG HAO, and two others flatten against a barracks wall. Xiao Lang's fingers trace a grease-pencil map on his palm.

The Thugs move on. Xiao Lang exhales, turns to Yang Hao.

XIAO LANG
(whisper)
They're gone. Ninety seconds.

XIAO LANG
She's occupied with the new shipment. Our only window.

XIAO LANG
If the south wall fails, scatter for the river. Don't wait.

Xiao Lang leads them in a low run across open ground, hugging the shadows.

EXT. FACTORY GATE - NIGHT

The group reaches a drainage pipe along the perimeter wall. Rusted barbed wire glints overhead. Xiao Lang tests the pipe - it holds.

YANG HAO
(voice cracking)
The map showed a cleared section. This is suicide!

A metallic PING rings out - a companion's belt buckle hits the pipe. They freeze.

THUG (O.S.)
Movement! North wall!

XIAO LANG
(shoving Yang Hao)
Up! Now!

YANG HAO
(frantic)
We've been spotted! Fall back?

XIAO LANG
(feral whisper)
Going back means the cages. Climb.

ANOTHER COMPANION
(weeping)
The wire's live! I saw them test it this morning!
continuation:
EXT. FACTORY DEAD END - NIGHT

Xiao Lang leads them along the wall to a stack of rotting pallets blocking a narrow gap. The wall ahead is sheer.

XIAO LANG
(desperate)
The river access should be...

He shoves a pallet. Beyond it, chain-link hums with current, razor wire glinting.

YANG HAO
(turning on Xiao Lang)
You said the south wall was low! You promised!

XIAO LANG
(quiet, hollow)
Someone gave me bad information. Someone here.

Bootsteps echo. The LEAD THUG emerges, tapping a baton against his palm. Six men fan out behind him.

LEAD THUG
(calling back)
Dead end! Surrounded!

He advances.

LEAD THUG
Boss said make it educational. Who's first?

THUGS swarm. Xiao Lang takes a blow to his ribs, crumpling over another companion.

XIAO LANG
(gasping)
We're contracted! You can't—

FEMALE BOSS (O.S.)
Stop.

The assault freezes. The FEMALE BOSS emerges, heels clicking. The MALE BOSS follows, examining his fingernails.

FEMALE BOSS
(measured)
Chen. I said contained, not pulped.

MALE BOSS
(to Female Boss)
One facility. That's what I entrusted you with. And you're staging a broadcast of incompetence?

He gestures at the beaten men.

MALE BOSS
My Bangkok partners see this footage, they'll question my stability. Then I question yours.

FEMALE BOSS
(crouching before Xiao Lang)
You came to Myawaddy seeking sanctuary. I gave you work. This is your gratitude?

She smiles, cold.

FEMALE BOSS
Here's your new contract. You tell me who sold you that map. Tonight. Or my men demonstrate the full hospitality of this city. Starting with your friend who can't stop crying.

A companion whimpers. Xiao Lang's jaw tightens.

FEMALE BOSS
(softly)
Nobody leaves Myawaddy without settling their tab.

title: Fall of Nation and Family
description: A ruthless enemy prince invades the capital, forcing the last empress to flee as her kingdom falls, only for a modern scholar to awaken in her body centuries later.
context:
Title: Fall of Nation and Family
Description: A ruthless enemy prince invades the capital, forcing the last empress to flee as her kingdom falls, only for a modern scholar to awaken in her body centuries later.

INT. PALACE - DAY

SOUND: The distant echo of siege towers colliding with stone. Not chaos—methodical destruction.

LAO DAZHEN (V.O.)
Your Majesty's "generosity" sustains my army. The ceded lands are fertile. The gold restocks our armories. For this, I am... grateful.

EXT. CITY GATE - DAY

Corpses lie in deliberate patterns—defenders cut down in their final formation. Blood seeps into the mortar.

LAO DAZHEN, Crown Prince of Great Jin, surveys the carnage with tactical precision. A SCAR bisects his left eyebrow.

LAO DAZHEN
Pass the order! The palace archives remain untouched—everything else burns. For the Empress: one thousand taels and the Turtle Seal for whoever brings her alive.

CHU QINGHUAN, nineteen, her wedding silks torn and muddy, stumbles with PRIME MINISTER SONG LIANG, sixtys, whose scholar's hands now grip a bloodied sword.

SONG LIANG
(without looking at her)
Your father took me from a rice field and taught me to read. I will not watch his daughter become a trophy.

Song Liang SLAMS Chu Qinghuan through the postern gate with a strength that surprises them both.

SONG LIANG
(spitting blood from a wound we hadn't seen)
Live. Even if it means hating every breath.

He throws his weight against the iron gate. It groans shut.

CHU QINGHUAN (looking back, crying out)
Song Liang!

SONG LIANG
Go, little swallow.

The gate closes. Lao Dazhen arrives. Spears thrust through the narrowing gap—one, two, three, piercing Song Liang's torso. He coughs—a wet, final sound.

SONG LIANG
(whispering, to himself)
The rice fields...

Lao Dazhen watches Song Liang fall. For a heartbeat, his expression flickers—respect? Regret? Then it's gone.

LAO DAZHEN
She wears white. Find the girl in white.
continuation:
EXT. FOREST - DAY

CHU QINGHUAN's bare feet bleed into the snow. Each step is a separate act of will. She stops beneath an ancient pine. The white silk sash is her own inner belt.

CHU QINGHUAN (V.O.)
I was taught to embroider, to recite poetry, to sit still while men decided my fate. I was never taught to rule. Now the snow tastes of ash.

She loops the silk over a branch. Her hands know the knots from binding scrolls.

CHU QINGHUAN
(quietly, to the wind)
Forgive me, Father. I tried to be a wall. I was only a curtain.

She steps onto a fallen log. The silk tightens.

INT. MODERN LECTURE HALL - DAY

Modern CHU QINGHUAN, same face but harder around the eyes, clicks to the next slide. The lecture hall is half-empty.

CHU QINGHUAN (Modern)
"The Xia-Jin Treaty of 734. Territory ceded. Indemnities paid. The empire's death sentence."

She pauses. Her breath fogs slightly, though the AC is off.

MALE AUDIENCE MEMBER
Emperor was a puppet, right? Regent held the real power.

FEMALE AUDIENCE MEMBER
Still. Puppet or not—you don't just give up.

CHU QINGHUAN (Modern)
He didn't. Historical consensus is wrong.

She clicks again. A 3D facial reconstruction appears—her face, but wearing the ghost of a crown. The audience gasps. Someone's phone drops.

Chu Qinghuan stares at the screen. Her reflection overlaps the portrait. For a moment, both have the same bruised eyes.

CHU QINGHUAN (Ancient V.O.)
...if there could be another...

The hall tilts. She reaches for the podium. Her palm comes away wet—snow? Blood?

Modern CHU QINGHUAN collapses.

INT. ANCIENT PALACE - DAY

CHU QINGHUAN awakens on a couch carved with phoenixes. Silk, not polyester. Air that smells of ink and winter, not disinfectant.

She touches her throat. It burns.

CHU QINGHUAN
(whisper)
The snow was real.

She looks down. Her hands are smaller. Unfamiliar calluses.

She looks up. Her eyes—sharp, piercing—aren't entirely her own.

title: Restart and Rise Again
description: A dying man filled with regret is given a second chance to fix the mistakes that destroyed his family.
context:
Title: Restart and Rise Again
Description: A dying man filled with regret is given a second chance to fix the mistakes that destroyed his family.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

XIAO RAN (50s, gaunt, trembling) clutches a family photo, coughing blood into a tissue. The room reeks of medicine and silence.

Footsteps thunder. LIN WEI (30s, hardened) bursts in, a crumpled will in his fist.

LIN WEI
What the hell is this? You name me in your will—like I'm your son? Like I owe you a grave?

XIAO RAN
(weakly)
Lin Yue and Ying... they're buried in the family plot. I just want to be near them.

LIN WEI
Don't you dare. You lost that right when you let Ying die. When you drove my sister to—

LIN WEI chokes on the words, fury boiling over.

LIN WEI
You think a deathbed apology erases fifteen years? You think you get to play grieving husband now?

XIAO RAN
(whispering)
I was drowning. I pulled them under with me.
continuation:
LIN WEI
Then sink alone. That's what you deserve.

XIAO RAN collapses, the photo frame shattering. Blood sprays across the glass.

FLASHBACK BEGINS.

QUICK CUTS:
- XIAO RAN, younger, slamming a door. LIN YUE crying on the other side.
- Tiny YING (3) reaching for his hand. He turns away, grabs a bottle.
- LIN WEI holding LIN YUE as she sobs, shooting Xiao Ran a look of pure hatred.
- A child's coffin. LIN YUE's empty pill bottles.
- XIAO RAN, drunk, screaming silent words.

FLASHBACK ENDS.

XIAO RAN lies still, eyes fixed on the bloody photo. His fingers brush the faces of his wife and daughter.

XIAO RAN
(fading)
Lin Yue... I'm sorry I wasn't... stronger...

XIAO RAN'S hand drops. He is still.

The photo frame GLOWS faintly. The blood on the glass SLOWLY FADES, as if being drawn back in. The air shimmers.

A second chance begins.

title: The Antique Apprentice's Divorce
description: A humble antique shop apprentice is coldly divorced by his now-successful wife, who has struck it rich at a jade conference and sees him as a burden to her rising status.
context:
Title: The Antique Apprentice's Divorce
Description: A humble antique shop apprentice is coldly divorced by his now-successful wife, who has struck it rich at a jade conference and sees him as a burden to her rising status.

INT. ANTIQUE SHOP - DAY

LIN FEI sleeps at a cluttered appraisal desk, his head resting on aged reference books.

MALE COLLEAGUE sets down a Ming dynasty scroll with a sharp TAP on the wood.

LIN FEI wakes, instantly steadying the scroll.

LIN FEI (V.O.)
First rule: respect the pieces.

MALE COLLEAGUE
(angrily)
That "Song" inkstone you logged? It's fake. Boss wants it fixed before close.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(arms crossed, disdainfully)
Some apprentices just take up space.

LIN FEI rubs his neck, fingers brushing a small scar on his palm.

The shop bell CHIMES.

JIANG CHURAN enters in a tailored suit, jade earrings catching the light. She carries a leather portfolio.

LIN FEI
(surprised)
Ranran?

He stands, teacup wobbling. Catches it without looking.

LIN FEI
You're back early. The conference—?

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(proudly)
Our President Jiang closed the deal of the century. That "wasteland" plot? Primary jade vein. They're calling her a tycoon.

LIN FEI
(beginning to smile)
That's incredible.

He moves toward her. JIANG CHURAN's expression doesn't change.

JIANG CHURAN
We need to talk. Here.

She throws a leather portfolio. It slides across the desk, spilling out a "DISSOLUTION OF MARRIAGE" agreement.

LIN FEI
(voice tightening)
What is this?

JIANG CHURAN
My attorney's work. Clean break. No fault.

LIN FEI
But why?

JIANG CHURAN
In forty-eight hours, I announce a ten-billion-yuan partnership. My name on museum wings. I can't have people whispering about my 'personal choices.'
continuation:
LIN FEI
(quietly)
So I'm a liability.

JIANG CHURAN
You're an assistant who confuses celadon with cheap porcelain. You earn what I spend on lunch. It's not blame. It's trajectory.

MALE COLLEAGUE
(sotto voce)
Even the tea he brews is mediocre.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Don't embarrass yourself. Sign it.

JIANG CHURAN
There's a settlement. One million. Nondisclosure attached.

She places the check. LIN FEI stares at it. At her.

LIN FEI
(fingers trembling slightly)
You wore jade earrings when we met. I warned you they were treated. You said you didn't care.

He folds the check. Once. Precisely.

LIN FEI
Here's my counter-offer.

He tears it. The RIP echoes.

LIN FEI
(voice low)
Keep your money. Return my mother's bracelet.

JIANG CHURAN
That tourist trinket?

LIN FEI
You wore it to every conference. Every deal.

President Jiang was being charitable.

Title: The Antique Apprentice's Divorce
Description: A humble antique shop apprentice is coldly divorced by his now-successful wife, who has struck it rich at a jade conference and sees him as a burden to her rising status.

INT. ANTIQUE SHOP - DAY

LIN FEI sleeps at a cluttered appraisal desk, his head resting on aged reference books.

MALE COLLEAGUE sets down a Ming dynasty scroll with a sharp TAP on the wood.

LIN FEI wakes, instantly steadying the scroll.

LIN FEI (V.O.)
First rule: respect the pieces.

MALE COLLEAGUE
(angrily)
That "Song" inkstone you logged? It's fake. Boss wants it fixed before close.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(arms crossed, disdainfully)
Some apprentices just take up space.

LIN FEI rubs his neck, fingers brushing a small scar on his palm.

The shop bell CHIMES.

JIANG CHURAN enters in a tailored suit, jade earrings catching the light. She carries a leather portfolio.

LIN FEI
(surprised)
Ranran?

He stands, teacup wobbling. Catches it without looking.

LIN FEI
You're back early. The conference—?

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(proudly)
Our President Jiang closed the deal of the century. That "wasteland" plot? Primary jade vein. They're calling her a tycoon.

LIN FEI
(beginning to smile)
That's incredible.

He moves toward her. JIANG CHURAN's expression doesn't change.

JIANG CHURAN
We need to talk. Here.

She throws a leather portfolio. It slides across the desk, spilling out a "DISSOLUTION OF MARRIAGE" agreement.

LIN FEI
(voice tightening)
What is this?

JIANG CHURAN
My attorney's work. Clean break. No fault.

LIN FEI
But why?

JIANG CHURAN
In forty-eight hours, I announce a ten-billion-yuan partnership. My name on museum wings. I can't have people whispering about my 'personal choices.'

LIN FEI
(quietly)
So I'm a liability.

JIANG CHURAN
You're an assistant who confuses celadon with cheap porcelain. You earn what I spend on lunch. It's not blame. It's trajectory.

MALE COLLEAGUE
(sotto voce)
Even the tea he brews is mediocre.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Don't embarrass yourself. Sign it.

JIANG CHURAN
There's a settlement. One million. Nondisclosure attached.

She places the check. LIN FEI stares at it. At her.

LIN FEI
(fingers trembling slightly)
You wore jade earrings when we met. I warned you they were treated. You said you didn't care.

He folds the check. Once. Precisely.

LIN FEI
Here's my counter-offer.

He tears it. The RIP echoes.

LIN FEI
(voice low)
Keep your money. Return my mother's bracelet.

JIANG CHURAN
That tourist trinket?

LIN FEI
You wore it to every conference. Every deal.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
President Jiang was being charitable.

MALE COLLEAGUE
I'll buy you ten better ones. Cartier. Van Cleef.

Here. Severance.

Card's in the envelope. If you need a reference... or a loan. Professional courtesy.

Don't let pride starve you.

Her smile is polite. Camera-ready. Empty.

title: Report to the Prince, the Princess Wants a Divorce
description: A modern doctor is transported back in time after an accident on Ghost Festival, finding herself buried alive as a sacrificial bride to a dead prince.
context:
Title: Report to the Prince, the Princess Wants a Divorce
Description: A modern doctor is transported back in time after an accident on Ghost Festival, finding herself buried alive as a sacrificial bride to a dead prince.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

SUPER: Year 2023, Ghost Festival

Paper money ashes swirl through the air. Flames gutter from small offering bowls.

WEI ZIXUAN (28, exhausted but sharp) walks while on the phone, medical bag slung over her shoulder.

WEI ZIXUAN
(on phone)
Patient's stable. Finally.

Her foot steps on something. She looks down: a red envelope. Picks it up.

Inside: a silver bracelet, a lock of hair, a note reading "Happy Marriage."

WEI ZIXUAN
(smiling faintly)
Someone's superstition...

An OLD WOMAN materializes from the smoke.

OLD WOMAN
...will cost you dearly.

WEI ZIXUAN
We don't do arranged marriages anymore, auntie.

She pockets the bracelet, turns—slips. Headlights BLAZE. A car HORN SCREAMS.

Impact. She hits the pavement. The bracelet lands beside her, glowing with unnatural green light.

WEI ZIXUAN
(whispering)
Not... a ghost...

The world SPINS into a vortex of light and shadow.
continuation:
INT. INSIDE COFFIN - NIGHT

WEI ZIXUAN's eyes snap open. Red silk wedding robes. A phoenix crown digging into her scalp. Cramped darkness.

She gasps, choking on stale air. Her hands explore the wooden inches above her face.

WEI ZIXUAN
(voice cracking)
No... not a dream...

Her fingers touch something cold beside her. A man's hand. Green light pulses from his palm—luminous pearl.

She recoils, muffling a scream. Her fists pound the lid.

WEI ZIXUAN
(strangled)
Help! Someone—!

INT. PRINCE JING'S MANOR MOURNING HALL - NIGHT

The coffin dominates the room. White candles drip wax. Two spirit tablets: "Wei Zixuan" and "Li Jing."

EXT. WEI MANOR - DAY (FLASHBACK)

The IMPERIAL ASTRONOMER reads from a jade scroll. The Wei family kowtows.

IMPERIAL ASTRONOMER
The Wei second daughter bears the Phoenix Mark. She shall ascend with Prince Jing in death, ensuring the dynasty's fortune.

WEI ZHENG (50s, calculating) hides a smile.

EXT. WEI MANOR COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Snow falls like ash.

BAI AN (40s, elegant cruelty) holds a drug vial. Beside her, YOUNG WEI ZIXUAN (10) watches her own mother collapse in the snow.

YOUNG WEI ZIXUAN
Mother!

BAI AN
(to the unconscious woman)
Your daughter's destiny belongs to my Shu-lan now.

INT. WEI MANOR KITCHEN - DAY (FLASHBACK)

TEENAGE WEI ZIXUAN (16) crawls, dish of scraps pushed toward her. WEI SHULAN (18) grabs her hair.

WEI SHULAN
Smile, little fool. You're going to be a princess.

She forces a bitter potion down Zixuan's throat. Zixuan convulses.

INT. INSIDE COFFIN - NIGHT

Memories crash like waves. Wei Zixuan clutches her head, breathing ragged.

WEI ZIXUAN
(voice trembling)
Phoenix destiny... mine?

She pounds again, weaker now.

INT. PRINCE JING'S MANOR MOURNING HALL - NIGHT

WEI SHULAN (20, radiant in mourning white) hears the thumping. She places her palm on the coffin.

WEI SHULAN
(softly)
Stop fighting, sister. The bracelet chose you. But the phoenix destiny... that was always mine.

She drapes a white silk cloth over the coffin—sealing it.

INT. INSIDE COFFIN - NIGHT

The thumping stops. Darkness presses in. Then—

WEI ZIXUAN's fingers find the silver bracelet on her wrist. It glows faintly. Her hand trembles, then steadies.

She begins feeling the coffin seams, searching methodically. A doctor's fingers, trained for emergencies.

Silence. Focus. Survival.

FADE OUT.

title: Extraordinary
description: A young master who lost his memory five years ago is kidnapped, triggering his sister's desperate rescue mission and the return of his memories.
context:
Title: Extraordinary
Description: A young master who lost his memory five years ago is kidnapped, triggering his sister's desperate rescue mission and the return of his memories.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE ROADSIDE - DAY

The YOUNG MASTER wears work clothes and a yellow safety helmet, struggling to lift a stone. A vacant, contented smile plays on his face.

Security camera footage angle.
A white van drives up and stops by the roadside.

The door opens. The KIDNAPPER LEADER and two HENCHMEN rush out.

They quickly subdue the YOUNG MASTER and forcibly shove him into the van.

The van door slams shut and speeds away from the scene.

EXT. AIRPORT RUNWAY - DAY

A helicopter sits on the runway.

The ELDEST MISS leads her ASSISTANT and a team of black-suited BODYGUARDS, striding quickly toward the helicopter.

ASSISTANT
(urgent)
Eldest Miss, surveillance confirms they've taken the Young Master. Location is a warehouse on the outskirts.

ASSISTANT
(continuing)
I can mobilize the team. You needn't risk yourself for—

ELDEST MISS
(venomous)
He's my brother. After five years of hiding him, they found him. I will not lose him again.

ASSISTANT
(turning and shouting)
All units, board now! Extract the Young Master!

Everyone quickly boards the helicopter.

The helicopter blades spin, taking off and flying over the cityscape.
continuation:
INT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

The KIDNAPPER LEADER unties a sack and dumps the YOUNG MASTER out. The YOUNG MASTER's hands are bound with rope.

YOUNG MASTER
(disoriented)
Need to finish... the bricks...

KIDNAPPER LEADER
(sneering)
The Zhou heir, a common laborer. Your sister will pay dearly for this embarrassment.

He kicks the YOUNG MASTER in the head.

KIDNAPPER LEADER
(coldly)
Sleep now, prince.

The YOUNG MASTER falls to the ground, his head bleeding, and passes out.

FLASHBACK:

A car plunges off a cliff.

ON SCREEN: Five years ago - The Zhou Family

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

The ELDEST MISS sits by the bed, looking worriedly at the unconscious YOUNG MASTER.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

The YOUNG MASTER lies on the ground, his head in severe pain, struggling in agony.

He clutches his head, as if remembering something.

Suddenly, he lifts his head. His eyes transform from their previous foolishness to sharp and lucid clarity.

title: Back to Ancient Times as a Waiter
description: A modern man wakes up in ancient China after an accident on a film set, finding himself in a new family with a confusing identity.
context:
Title: Back to Ancient Times as a Waiter
Description: A modern man wakes up in ancient China after an accident on a film set, finding himself in a new family with a confusing identity.

INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

Close-up of HUA MENGYAN's eyes as they slowly open.

The camera cuts to reveal the room's antique decor, with an ornate carved window open.

HUA SANNIANG leans over him, worried.

HUA SANNIANG
Mengyan? Thank heavens you're awake.

EXT. MODERN FILM SET - NIGHT

The DIRECTOR speaks into a microphone to the crew.

DIRECTOR
This is our premium production. Act like professionals.

A CREW MEMBER carries a long ladder past.

CREW MEMBER
Heads up! Coming through!

The ladder clips a light stand.

CREW MEMBER
(impatiently)
Watch where you're standing!

The light fixture falls toward HUA MENGYAN (modern clothes, server's apron) and a GLASSES-WEARING AD. Both are dressed in modern clothes, looking up in horror.

It crashes down.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

HUA MENGYAN (ancient costume) sits in a chair as HUA SANNIANG wipes his face with a handkerchief.

HUA MENGYAN looks around in confusion.

HUA MENGYAN
Where... where is this place?

HUA SANNIANG
(distressed)
You fell, child. The physician fears memory loss. Don't you know me?

HUA MENGYAN
(confused)
I don't... I don't know you.

HUA SANNIANG
(internal monologue)
Could he have forgotten his purpose?

HUA SANNIANG
(flustered)
If I am not your mother, then who would be?

HUA SIJIN enters with medicine.

HUA SIJIN
Brother is awake?

HUA SANNIANG
(relieved)
He remembers nothing of the Silver Pavilion.

HUA SIJIN
Mother, there's something I've never understood. You only gave birth to me and my brother, so why do people call you Third Mother?

HUA SANNIANG
(matter-of-factly)
I am the third daughter. The staff called me Third Mother as a girl. It stuck.

HUA MENGYAN
(turning to HUA SIJIN)
Sister--what do they call me? At the restaurant?

HUA SIJIN
Mengyan. The Dreamer.

HUA MENGYAN stares at his calloused hands. A waiter's hands.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: I Love You, I'm Guilty
description: A woman suffers abuse and false accusations from a man who refuses to believe her innocence.
context:
Title: I Love You, I'm Guilty
Description: A woman suffers abuse and false accusations from a man who refuses to believe her innocence.

INT. ROOM - DAY

TANG XIAOYAN lies on the floor, clutching a torn PHOTOGRAPH, her eyes hollow with exhaustion beneath the sorrow. AN OLD MAN leans down close to her, his fury edged by desperation.

OLD MAN
Go on. Tell them how you smile for those cameras while you sell our family's shame for your apartment. That's my son in those pictures. Your husband. While I paid for your law degree.

A tear rolls down TANG XIAOYAN's cheek.

The OLD MAN stands up, straightening his clothes.
continuation:
TANG XIAOYAN slowly sits up, adjusting her own clothes.

OLD MAN
(contemptuously)
You think you're better than us. But you're just like your mother. Taking what doesn't belong to you.

TANG XIAOYAN stands up, looking at the OLD MAN with emotional intensity.

TANG XIAOYAN
(quietly)
I loved him. And I loved you. That's why I'm guilty.

The OLD MAN's expression turns furious. He steps forward and slaps TANG XIAOYAN hard across the face.

title: Supreme Beauty
description: A mentally disabled man and his daughter sell socks on the street when they are confronted by a cruel woman who steals from them, leading to a violent encounter with dangerous men.
context:
Title: Supreme Beauty
Description: A mentally disabled man and his daughter sell socks on the street when they are confronted by a cruel woman who steals from them, leading to a violent encounter with dangerous men.

EXT. WASTELAND - DAY

A cloth is laid on the ground with intricately knitted socks displayed on it. A cardboard sign next to it reads "10 yuan for 5 pairs."

WANG QUAN (40s), wearing an army coat and Lei Feng hat, rocks gently as he arranges socks with repetitive care. His daughter XIAO YU (8) sits beside him, knitting.

A MEAN WOMAN in an expensive coat approaches.

MEAN WOMAN
Cheap enough.

She crouches, selects five pairs, then stands and walks away.

XIAO YU
(standing)
Auntie, you didn't pay.

WANG QUAN
(voice low)
Sign says ten yuan.

The Mean Woman turns, sneering.

MEAN WOMAN
Your mother didn't teach you not to touch your betters?

She shakes off Xiao Yu's hand.

XIAO YU
Mom taught me not to steal.

MEAN WOMAN
Mom abandoned you with this retard.

She shoves Xiao Yu. Wang Quan catches her, his rocking stopped.

WANG QUAN
(quietly)
Don't touch her.

MEAN WOMAN
What are you going to do?

She slaps Wang Quan. He doesn't flinch, just holds Xiao Yu.

XIAO YU
(crying)
Take them! Just go!

PASSERBY MAN
Police are on their way!
continuation:
PASSERBY WOMAN
We've got you on camera!

The Mean Woman drops the socks, dialing her phone as she retreats.

MEAN WOMAN
(into phone)
Found them. Under the north bridge.

Wang Quan picks up the socks, checking for damage. Xiao Yu wipes her eyes.

XIAO YU
Dad... your face?

WANG QUAN
(pats her hand, resumes rocking)
Doesn't hurt.

He pulls out a tin lunchbox, opens it to reveal dumplings arranged in a flower pattern.

WANG QUAN
Mom's supreme beauty dumplings. Circle means family comes back.

XIAO YU
(quietly)
Mom's not coming back.

WANG QUAN
(fiercely)
YES. She promised.

A black SUV screeches to a stop. WANG WEI (late 30s, sharp suit) gets out with TWO HENCHMEN.

WANG WEI
(to Henchmen)
The girl. Court order.

The Henchmen grab Xiao Yu. She screams. Wang Quan lunges but is restrained.

WANG WEI
(to Wang Quan)
You're unfit. She comes with me.

Wang Wei kicks the lunchbox. Dumplings scatter across the pavement.

XIAO YU
Dad! The dumplings!

WANG QUAN
(howling)
YU WEI! SUPREME BEAUTY!

His cry echoes. Wang Wei hesitates at his sister's name, then pulls Xiao Yu toward the SUV as Wang Quan strains against the Henchman's grip, face twisted in anguish.

She shoves Xiao Yu. Wang Quan catches her, his rocking stopped.

WANG QUAN
(quietly)
Don't touch her.

MEAN WOMAN
What are you going to do?

She slaps Wang Quan. He doesn't flinch, just holds Xiao Yu.

XIAO YU
(crying)
Take them! Just go!

PASSERBY MAN
Police are on their way!

PASSERBY WOMAN
We've got you on camera!

The Mean Woman drops the socks, dialing her phone as she retreats.

MEAN WOMAN
(into phone)
Found them. Under the north bridge.

Wang Quan picks up the socks, checking for damage. Xiao Yu wipes her eyes.

XIAO YU
Dad... your face?

WANG QUAN
(pats her hand, resumes rocking)
Doesn't hurt.

He pulls out a tin lunchbox, opens it to reveal dumplings arranged in a flower pattern.

WANG QUAN
Mom's supreme beauty dumplings. Circle means family comes back.

XIAO YU
(quietly)
Mom's not coming back.

WANG QUAN
(fiercely)
YES. She promised.

A black SUV screeches to a stop. WANG WEI (late 30s, sharp suit) gets out with TWO HENCHMEN.

WANG WEI
(to Henchmen)
The girl. Court order.

The Henchmen grab Xiao Yu. She screams. Wang Quan lunges but is restrained.

WANG WEI
(to Wang Quan)
You're unfit. She comes with me.

Wang Wei kicks the lunchbox. Dumplings scatter across the pavement.

XIAO YU
Dad! The dumplings!

WANG QUAN
(howling)
YU WEI! SUPREME BEAUTY!

His cry echoes. Wang Wei hesitates at his sister's name, then pulls Xiao Yu toward the SUV as Wang Quan strains against the Henchman's grip, face twisted in anguish.

title: Return After a Thousand Years of Looping
description: A desperate delivery man trapped in a time loop for a thousand years masters countless skills and discovers everyone's secrets, only to seek a way to break free.
context:
Title: Return After a Thousand Years of Looping
Description: A desperate delivery man trapped in a time loop for a thousand years masters countless skills and discovers everyone's secrets, only to seek a way to break free.

EXT. BRIDGE - NIGHT

Neon reflections shimmer on the river below. XIAO ZIYU (20s) balances on the guardrail, his delivery uniform frayed at the seams, eyes hollow with millennium-old exhaustion. He tilts his head back—not in despair, but recognition.

A MAN IN A SUIT approaches with two SUBORDINATES, stopping ten paces short, as if facing a spooked animal.

MAN IN A SUIT
Kid. I've stood where you're standing. Seventeen times.

XIAO ZIYU turns his head. The smile he gives is terrible—amused and empty.

XIAO ZIYU
Beautiful?

MONTAGE:
- XIAO ZIYU in delivery uniform, asleep at his scooter handlebars.
- An alarm clock blinking "8:00" in a bare apartment.
- XIAO ZIYU jolting awake, gasping the same breath.
- XIAO ZIYU curled on his mattress, counting cracks in the ceiling.

XIAO ZIYU (V.O.)
Day 365,242. The bridge still smells like river rust and cheap fireworks. And you—you're still saying the same thing.

MAN IN A SUIT
I'm not here to stop you. I'm here to tell you it won't work. Tomorrow, you'll still wake up at 8:00 AM, and I'll still be here, trying to save someone who doesn't want saving.

XIAO ZIYU glances back. For the first time in centuries, something like interest flickers across his face. Then he simply steps backward into empty air.

The MAN IN A SUIT and SUBORDINATES rush to the edge. All they see is darkness.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

XIAO ZIYU lurches awake, his hand already reaching for the phantom impact. The alarm clock reads "AM 8:00." His phone shows "08:00."

XIAO ZIYU
(to the ceiling)
Seventeen times? Who's counting who now.

He swings his legs over the bed. His movements hold the precision of ritual—the same fold of the blanket, the same press of his palm against the cold window glass. But his eyes, when they catch his reflection, hold something new.

MONTAGE:
- XIAO ZIYU delivering the same package to the same woman—first desperately, then kindly, then with mechanical efficiency.
- Quick cuts of him learning piano, calligraphy, surgery, each skill mastered in weeks of repeated days.
- XIAO ZIYU sitting in a library, surrounded by the same twenty-seven people, memorizing their micro-expressions.
- XIAO ZIYU planting a tree that will never grow, his hands in dirt, finally still.
- XIAO ZIYU in the casino, not celebrating, simply stacking chips with the boredom of accounting.

XIAO ZIYU (V.O.)
The first century was panic. The second, rage. The third, experimentation. Now? Now I maintain. Because somewhere in this city's 8.4 million people, there has to be a seam in the loop. And I have nothing but time to find it.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

XIAO ZIYU sits at the bar in his yellow delivery uniform, facing JIANG YIYI (20s), whose designer dress contrasts with her tired eyes.

JIANG YIYI
(skeptical)
Thousand years. That's a specific number. Most guys just say "forever."

She glances at his uniform, then at his hands—clean, nails trimmed with surgical precision.

JIANG YIYI
Delivery, right? You must know every back alley in this city.

XIAO ZIYU doesn't answer. He drains his water—he never drinks alcohol anymore—and taps her phone.

XIAO ZIYU
You've been checking that screen every forty seconds. Why?

JIANG YIYI
(stiffening)
None of your—

XIAO ZIYU
You're waiting for a text that won't come. From someone named David. Who's married. And whose wife is about to walk through that door.

JIANG YIYI
(phone clattering)
How did you—

XIAO ZIYU
Same way I know you're about to lose sixty grand on stocks. Unless you sell in the next thirty seconds.

JIANG YIYI
What stocks? I don't—

Her phone buzzes. Not with a text. With a market alert. She stares at the screen, blood draining from her face.

JIANG YIYI
(voice cracking)
It's tanking.

A MAN rises from the corner booth—someone XIAO ZIYU has seen come here every night for three years. Someone whose life XIAO ZIYU once saved. The MAN smashes a bottle across XIAO ZIYU's temple.

XIAO ZIYU slumps against the bar, consciousness bleeding away. The last thing he hears is the same sound he's heard before: the loop resetting. But this time, it feels different.

title: General Consort, You Must Not
description: A woman experiences visions of her past life as a general betrayed by a prince, only to wake up in the modern world where her husband bears his face.
context:
Title: General Consort, You Must Not
Description: A woman experiences visions of her past life as a general betrayed by a prince, only to wake up in the modern world where her husband bears his face.

INT. MODERN BEDROOM - DAY

FU YUAN lies on the bed, staring at the ceiling. Her fingers curl, gripping phantom weapons.

The door slams. Her HUSBAND enters, exhaustion and rage on his face.

HUSBAND
You'd rather die than stay married to me? Just to chase my brother?

FU YUAN's eyes focus on his face. Horror and hope collide.

FU YUAN
(murmuring)
Rong Lang...

HUSBAND
What did you—

CUT TO:

EXT. ANCIENT PALACE ROOFTOP - DAY

Year 783 AD.

Rain hammers the tiles. FU YUAN, in blood-spattered armor, faces PRINCE RONG. Corpses of her guard lie between them.

PRINCE RONG
Yuan'er, your grandmother's letter was forged! The Crown Prince needed you to hate me—needed your army to stand aside!

FU YUAN's spear trembles. Red mist coils around her shoulders—her battle aura awakening.

FU YUAN
(voice cracking)
I saw the poison, Rong. I held my father's hand. He wrote your name.

PRINCE RONG
That was his fever! The Crown Prince's physician confessed—

A horn blares from below.

CUT TO:
continuation:
EXT. ANCIENT PALACE COURTYARD - NIGHT

Fifty archers line the walls. The CROWN PRINCE stands with CROWN PRINCESS WEN. She sharpens a dagger.

CROWN PRINCE
General Fu Yuan! Prince Rong! For conspiracy against the empire—execute them!

The archers draw. FU YUAN and PRINCE RONG share one look. Betrayal. Understanding. Love.

They move back-to-back. Too many arrows.

PRINCE RONG grunts, three shafts in his chest. He stumbles toward FU YUAN.

PRINCE RONG
(collapsing)
Yuan'er... next life... be my wife. Not my enemy.

FU YUAN catches him, an arrow grazing her throat.

FU YUAN
(voice breaking)
Next life... I'll protect you.

PRINCE RONG dies. CROWN PRINCESS WEN strides forward, dagger raised.

CROWN PRINCESS WEN
You were always too strong to live, General. Die knowing I will wear his ring.

She strikes. Blackness.

CUT TO:

INT. MODERN BEDROOM - DAY

FU YUAN gasps awake, hand flying to her throat. No wound. But phantom pain lingers.

She sees HUSBAND staring. She touches his face—this face she's already watched die.

FU YUAN
(whispering)
You lived.

Her grip tightens. The wooden bedframe splinters under her other hand—unseen.

CUT TO:

INT. MODERN LIVING ROOM - DAY

FU YUAN carries HUSBAND in a princess carry, her steps sure. He freezes, too shocked to struggle. She sets him on the sofa, kneels, and frames his face in her hands.

FU YUAN
(crying, but focused)
You're real. You're here.

Her thumb brushes his cheek—too hard. A red mark rises.

HUSBAND
(breathless)
You're crushing my jaw—

The FAMILY DOCTOR pokes his head in.

FAMILY DOCTOR
Coming!

He stops short. FU YUAN releases HUSBAND, looks at her own hands.

Behind the doctor, a WOMAN passes in the hallway. CROWN PRINCESS WEN's face, modern clothes, same cruel smile.

FU YUAN sees her. Her eyes narrow. Ancient hatred awakens.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Hidden Dragon
description: In accordance with the ancient Liu family tradition, whoever can pull the divine sword from its stone shall become the family's son-in-law and inherit its power.
context:
Title: The Hidden Dragon
Description: In accordance with the ancient Liu family tradition, whoever can pull the divine sword from its stone shall become the family's son-in-law and inherit its power.

EXT. LIU FAMILY ANCESTRAL HALL - DAY

A grand aerial shot reveals a magnificent complex of classical Chinese architecture nestled in the mountains.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
According to ancient Liu family tradition, whoever pulls the divine sword shall become the Liu family's son-in-law and wield the family's power.

The camera cuts to the massive plaza in front of the ancestral hall. At its center, a divine sword locked with iron chains stands embedded in a stone pedestal. Many people gather around the plaza.

A chubby man in white training clothes steps forward.

CHUBBY MAN
Let me try first!

The chubby man takes a running start, leaps toward the divine sword, and grabs the hilt with both hands, pulling with all his might. A powerful burst of blue energy erupts, sending him flying backward. He crashes heavily to the ground, coughing up blood.

ZHOU LING, a sharp-tongued young woman in a white suit jacket, stands beside LIU PIAOXUE, who sits in a wheelchair, her face pale but eyes determined.

ZHOU LING
Another challenger falls. How many more must we watch die?

A young man named JIANG FENG, wearing a blue water delivery vest and carrying a water jug, walks up the steps. He pauses, seeing the scene, then approaches LIU PIAOXUE.

JIANG FENG
Miss Liu? Your Longquan water delivery.

ZHOU LING
(suspiciously)
We're in the middle of a sacred trial. Leave it and go.

LIU PIAOXUE
(weakly, but politely)
Thank you. Just leave it there.

JIANG FENG sets the jug down, but his gaze lingers on the sword. He speaks softly, almost to himself.

JIANG FENG
The Azure Dragon Seal... still bound after all these years.

ZHOU LING
(overhearing, angry)
What did you say? A delivery man dares to speak of our ancestral sword? In three days, 1,876 challengers have tried. Not one has even touched the hilt and lived.

LIU PIAOXUE
(to Zhou Ling, voice trembling)
If the sword doesn't accept a master soon... my cultivation illness will claim me before the month's end.

LIU PIAOXUE coughs violently, a silk handkerchief coming away with crimson spots.

LIU FAMILY STEWARD
(reciting, voice echoing)
"A three-foot blade that split the heavens, yet none perceive the immortal within."

An elderly man with white hair and beard, FANG WENDAO, appears in immortal-like robes, surrounded by a cluster of flying swords that hum with power.

ZHOU LING
(astonished)
Supreme Sword Saint Fang Wendao!

LIU PIAOXUE
(low voice)
The only grandmaster to comprehend sword intent... they say he commands thirty-three spiritual blades.

FANG WENDAO
(arrogantly)
Little steward, you quote the prophecy well. Perhaps today, it finally speaks of me.

LIU PIAOXUE
(frustrated)
The sword chooses its master. It cannot be forced!

FANG WENDAO
Everything in this world yields to power. Once I claim this blade, the Liu family legacy will be in expert hands.

FANG WENDAO ascends toward the divine sword, his robes billowing.

LIU PIAOXUE
(whispering to Zhou Ling)
He's over seventy... if he succeeds, my fate...

FANG WENDAO hovers above the divine sword, forming hand seals. Red energy swirls violently around him as he attempts to wrest the sword from the stone.

FANG WENDAO
(shouting)
Yield to me!
continuation:
The divine sword erupts with blinding blue energy, the force sending everyone in the plaza staggering backward. FANG WENDAO is hurled down, crashing to the stones, unconscious, blood at his lips.

ZHOU LING
(stunned)
Even the Sword Saint... could the family head be right? That only one with a true dragon's destiny—

JIANG FENG
(quietly, to himself)
Destiny... or perhaps something the sword has waited for.

ZHOU LING
(wheeling on him)
You! Still here? If you think you're so special, why don't you try?

LIU PIAOXUE
(urgently)
No! The sword's spirit is too volatile. Even touching it without invitation could—

JIANG FENG
(meeting her eyes)
Miss Liu, do you want to live?

LIU PIAOXUE
(frozen, then whispers)
More than anything.

JIANG FENG
Then trust the sword's judgment.

JIANG FENG walks toward the divine sword. LIU PIAOXUE reaches for him but stops mid-gesture.

JIANG FENG
(confidently)
A Sword Saint's pride blinded him. I see the sword for what it is.

JIANG FENG shakes off LIU PIAOXUE's hand, walks to the divine sword, and pulls out a folding ladder from behind him, setting it up. The sword's fierce energy has quieted to a soft hum.

LIU FAMILY STEWARD
(mockingly)
All that big talk, and he's climbing up with a ladder.

FANG WENDAO
(lying on the ground, weakly)
Utter foolishness! The sword's spirit is merely recharging after rejecting me. It will destroy him!

LIU PIAOXUE
(anxiously, to Zhou Ling)
Quick, pull him back, or he'll die!

JIANG FENG climbs the ladder and reaches out to touch the divine sword. The sword emits a brilliant blue light—but instead of an attack, it pulses with recognition.

FANG WENDAO
(struggling to lift his head)
What... why doesn't it strike him?

LIU PIAOXUE
(shocked, realization dawning)
It accepts him...

JIANG FENG grips the hilt, his voice calm but firm.

JIANG FENG
You were waiting for someone who didn't want to use you.

He pulls upward with steady force. The divine sword slowly emerges from the stone pedestal, its chains dissolving into light.

ZHOU LING
(whisper)
It didn't fight him...

LIU PIAOXUE
(tears in her eyes)
It recognized its true master.

The sword hums in Jiang Feng's hand, its light reflecting in his calm eyes.

FANG WENDAO
(barely conscious)
Who... are you...

JIANG FENG looks at the old master, then at Liu Piaoxue, and finally at the sword.

JIANG FENG
Just a man who delivers what is needed.

He turns toward LIU PIAOXUE, sword in hand, as the blue light begins to envelop her wheelchair.

FADE OUT.

Then trust the sword's judgment.

JIANG FENG walks toward the divine sword. LIU PIAOXUE reaches for him but stops mid-gesture.

JIANG FENG
(confidently)
A Sword Saint's pride blinded him. I see the sword for what it is.

JIANG FENG shakes off LIU PIAOXUE's hand, walks to the divine sword, and pulls out a folding ladder from behind him, setting it up. The sword's fierce energy has quieted to a soft hum.

LIU FAMILY STEWARD
(mockingly)
All that big talk, and he's climbing up with a ladder.

FANG WENDAO
(lying on the ground, weakly)
Utter foolishness! The sword's spirit is merely recharging after rejecting me. It will destroy him!

LIU PIAOXUE
(anxiously, to Zhou Ling)
Quick, pull him back, or he'll die!

JIANG FENG climbs the ladder and reaches out to touch the divine sword. The sword emits a brilliant blue light—but instead of an attack, it pulses with recognition.

FANG WENDAO
(struggling to lift his head)
What... why doesn't it strike him?

LIU PIAOXUE
(shocked, realization dawning)
It accepts him...

JIANG FENG grips the hilt, his voice calm but firm.

JIANG FENG
You were waiting for someone who didn't want to use you.

He pulls upward with steady force. The divine sword slowly emerges from the stone pedestal, its chains dissolving into light.

ZHOU LING
(whisper)
It didn't fight him...

LIU PIAOXUE
(tears in her eyes)
It recognized its true master.

The sword hums in Jiang Feng's hand, its light reflecting in his calm eyes.

FANG WENDAO
(barely conscious)
Who... are you...

JIANG FENG looks at the old master, then at Liu Piaoxue, and finally at the sword.

JIANG FENG
Just a man who delivers what is needed.

He turns toward LIU PIAOXUE, sword in hand, as the blue light begins to envelop her wheelchair.

FADE OUT.

title: I'm Really Not the God of War
description: A man selling lingerie on the street is mistaken for a legendary warrior called Dragon Lord by assassins and warriors who come to kill or protect him.
context:
Title: I'm Really Not the God of War
Description: A man selling lingerie on the street is mistaken for a legendary warrior called Dragon Lord by assassins and warriors who come to kill or protect him.

INT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

A motorcycle tears through neon-lit streets, weaving through traffic. BLACK ROSE brings it to a screeching halt, removes her helmet—her eyes sharp enough to cut glass.

ON SCREEN: BLACK ROSE - ASSASSIN

EXT. CITY PLAZA - NIGHT

LI XIAOFAN scrambles behind a makeshift stall, rearranging silk and lace under flickering streetlights.

LI XIAOFAN
(shouting)
Last chance! Factory boss eloped with the accountant—entire inventory must go! Luxury lingerie, street-side prices!

A young woman quickens her pace, shielding her face.

LI XIAOFAN
(approaching)
Miss, wait—genuine French lace, never worn!

PASSERBY WOMAN
(disgusted)
Creep!

She hurries away. Li Xiaofan sags, counting loose change in his palm.

BLACK ROSE approaches, sword hilt visible at her back. Li Xiaofan's face lights up.

LI XIAOFAN
Miss! Perfect timing—I've got pieces that'd make a warrior feel like royalty.

LI XIAOFAN holds up midnight-black lace.

LI XIAOFAN
This one's called "Dragon's Whisper." Honestly, you...

BLACK ROSE
You don't recognize me. Of course you don't.

LI XIAOFAN
Should I? Wait—did we match on FriendFinder?

BLACK ROSE
The Heartbreak Powder was supposed to erase your memories, not your dignity.

She draws her sword. The blade sings as it clears the sheath.

LI XIAOFAN
Easy! No commission is worth this—

BLACK ROSE
Don't play the fool. Even without your powers, you're still the man who burned three empires to ash.

She strikes. Li Xiaofan stumbles backward, tripping over his own merchandise.

LI XIAOFAN
Okay, okay—it's a prank! Very funny. Where's the director? That's real steel!
continuation:
BLACK ROSE
It's also real blood you'll be bleeding.

She lunges. Li Xiaofan rolls aside, a silk camisole tangled around his wrist.

LI XIAOFAN
Alright, that's it! I warned you!

He whips the silk upward—it catches the blade, deflecting it inches from his throat. In the same motion, he traps her wrist against the stall's frame.

LI XIAOFAN
(panting)
Not so fun when the prop fights back, huh?

He releases her. Black Rose stares at her own hand like it's betrayed her.

BLACK ROSE
That technique... you taught it to me.

LI XIAOFAN
Lady, I can barely teach myself to file taxes.

BLACK ROSE
Then why spare me?

LI XIAOFAN
You dropped this.

He kicks her fallen sword toward her boot.

LI XIAOFAN
Also, I'm pretty sure murder voids my vendor's license.

Black Rose picks up the blade, studying his face for something that isn't there. She mounts her bike.

LI XIAOFAN
And hey—if you're not busy Friday, I've got a trunk of "Warrior Princess" sets arriving!

BLACK ROSE
(quietly)
You really don't remember.

She roars away. Li Xiaofan exhales, wiping sweat onto his sales apron.

EXT. CITY PLAZA - NIGHT

A black SUV skids to a halt, doors flying open. QING LING emerges in white combat silks, face veiled. RED DUST follows, crimson hair catching the neon.

ON SCREEN: QING LING - FIVE-STAR FEMALE GENERAL
ON SCREEN: RED DUST - QING LING'S DEPUTY

LI XIAOFAN is on all fours, gathering scattered inventory. The two women kneel, offering their weapons palms-up.

QING LING
We lost the signal. Forgive our delay, my Lord.

LI XIAOFAN looks up, a red thong dangling from his fingers.

FADE OUT.

title: Dragon Sky Divine Lord
description: Betrayed by his former mentor and poisoned by the Five Elements Sect, Lin Cang makes his last stand at Wushuang City to protect the forbidden scroll containing his fallen master's final technique.
context:
Title: Dragon Sky Divine Lord
Description: Betrayed by his former mentor and poisoned by the Five Elements Sect, Lin Cang makes his last stand at Wushuang City to protect the forbidden scroll containing his fallen master's final technique.

FADE IN.

EXT. WUSHUANG CITY - DAY

A magnificent ancient city gate tower rises against iron-gray skies. The plaque reads: "Wushuang City."

LIN CANG, white robe stained crimson, staggers up the stone steps. Each footprint smears blood. His notched sword scrapes granite.

GOLDEN LIGHT explodes from the gate. LIN CANG hurtles backward, crashes down.

Blood sprays from his lips. He forces himself upright, blade clattering against stone.

Five figures materialize in the square—MASTER BENLAI, QINMO, DAOSHEN, MEIJI, and YINGWANG. The Five Flag Masters.

QINMO
The Five Poisons should have liquefied your meridians by now. How do you still rise?

DAOSHEN
Wushuang City never opened its gates to traitors.

MEIJI
(opening her bamboo umbrella with a whisper)
What a waste of your golden core. Just give us the scroll, Little Dragon.

YINGWANG
continuation:
(licking his lips beneath his mask)
Your master's forbidden technique dies with you. Our pact remains unbroken.

MASTER BENLAI
(bowing his head, voice soft)
Benefactor Lin. You were my finest student. Please. Don't force me to extinguish your soul entirely.

LIN CANG's fingers tighten around something beneath his robe. Weak golden light flickers across his skin.

LIN CANG
(eyes locked on BENLAI)
You taught me mercy is a blade that cuts both ways, Master.

He pulls a SILK SCROLL from his robes.

LIN CANG (cont'd)
You want the Dragon Sky Rites? Come take them from my cold ashes.

MEIJI's umbrella stops spinning. QINMO's hand moves to his sword hilt.

MASTER BENLAI
(to himself, barely audible)
So be it.

The Five Masters charge. YINGWANG's obsidian gauntlets crack the flagstones with each step.

LIN CANG whispers a mantra. The blood on his blade begins to glow—

FADE OUT.

title: Fall from Grace
description: A loyal celestial general is falsely accused and executed, while his sister is stripped of her immortal bone and banished to the mortal realm.
context:
Title: Fall from Grace
Description: A loyal celestial general is falsely accused and executed, while his sister is stripped of her immortal bone and banished to the mortal realm.

INT. HEAVENLY PALACE - DAY

The Heavenly Palace shrouded in clouds and mist. Celestial beings gather together, their robes catching the aurora light.

IMMORTAL A (V.O.)
Nine Heavens Mystic Art, reveal all truths...

IMMORTAL B (V.O.)
Nine Heavens Mystic Art, obey my command.

FAIRY
General Vermillion Bird has cleansed the Northern Wastelands and returned the Demon Clan's ancestral seal. The Realm itself owes him debt!

XUANNIAO CLAN LEADER
(laughing heartily, yet weary)
Three generations of blood-soaked feathers... When the Heavens call, we answer. Even when the Heavens forget why they called.

HEAVENLY EMPEROR'S ENVOY
The Heavenly Emperor's Envoy, Lady Yao Ji arrives! All bow!

Lady Yao Ji, dressed in magnificent robes, walks forward with a scroll case that bleeds darkness.

CROWD
We welcome Lady Yao Ji.

LADY YAO JI
Nan Tian of the Xuanniao, kneel for judgment.

Heavenly soldiers step forward and grab NAN TIAN—golden chains materializing around his wrists.

FAIRY RUO LI
(shocked, stepping between them)
Lady Yao Ji! My brother bears the Emperor's own Phoenix Seal. He stood against the Demon King's blade when—

LADY YAO JI
continuation:
—when he learned their blade could cut both ways. The Nine Heavens Mystic Art caught him drafting new celestial laws. With demon script.

She unfurls the scroll. The characters writhe like black serpents.

FAIRY RUO LI
That's impossible! The Xuanniao cannot even read—

LADY YAO JI
Say another word, and you confess by association. Your clan's loyalty is precisely what makes his betrayal so poisonous.

FAIRY RUO LI
(kneeling, desperate)
Then let the Emperor himself wield the Thunder! Let him look in my brother's eyes when—

HEAVENLY EMPEROR'S ENVOY
The Emperor has looked. And wept. Do it.

Heavenly lightning—purple and sentient—descends from above and strikes NAN TIAN.

NAN TIAN
(screaming, his voice splintering into echoes)
Ruo Li—fly! The cage is the—!

Nan Tian turns to ash in the lightning, his Phoenix Seal shattering. Fairy Ruo Li watches in agony and collapses to the ground.

A MASKED FIGURE in black detaches from Yao Ji's shadow.

MASKED FIGURE
(whispering to Ruo Li)
You were always the brighter flame. That's why they clipped your wings first.

The Masked Figure reaches out and extracts a glowing immortal bone from Fairy Ruo Li's body. The bone pulses with her lineage memory. Fairy Ruo Li falls in pain, her eyes locked on the ashes.

HEAVENLY EMPEROR'S ENVOY
(reading the decree, voice hollow)
By order of the Heavenly Emperor: Fairy Ruo Li, stripped of the Xuanniao immortal bone, cast to the mortal realm. Her name erased from the Jade Record. Let no one speak of her again.

Lady Yao Ji watches coldly as the Masked Figure grinds the immortal bone to dust. Fairy Ruo Li loses consciousness and falls from the clouds, her silhouette shrinking against the endless sky.

title: Loveless Marriage
description: A woman bound by a three-year pregnancy agreement with her mother-in-law discovers her husband's indifference and possible infidelity as her deadline approaches.
context:
Title: Loveless Marriage
Description: A woman bound by a three-year pregnancy agreement with her mother-in-law discovers her husband's indifference and possible infidelity as her deadline approaches.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

The FEMALE LEAD, wearing a patient gown, sits on the hospital bed, looking sadly at a fertility treatment log. A circled date looms three weeks away. Her phone BUZZES.

FEMALE LEAD
(into phone)
What is it?

FU JINYAN (O.S.)
What do you need?

FEMALE LEAD
The specialist called. We need to talk about—

FU JINYAN (O.S.)
I'm in a meeting.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

FU JINYAN, wearing a suit, walks while talking on the phone. The WOMAN IN PINK (20s) walks beside him, carrying documents.

FU JINYAN
(into phone)
If it's medical, ask your doctor. If it's urgent, text my assistant.

He hangs up, pocketing the phone.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

The FEMALE LEAD looks at the disconnected phone. Through the open door, she sees Fu Jinyan in the corridor—with the Woman in Pink. Her face freezes.

MONTAGE BEGINS:

- Fu Jinyan stands at the registration counter with the Woman in Pink, signing forms
- The Woman in Pink rests her hand on Fu Jinyan's arm, leaning close
- Close-up of the Female Lead's face, watching through glass, her expression hollow

MONTAGE ENDS.

INT. HOSPITAL REGISTRATION AREA - DAY

The Woman in Pink shows Fu Jinyan a medical clearance form.

WOMAN IN PINK
False alarm. I'm cleared for the merger. Thanks for coming.

FU JINYAN
Remember our agreement. Your health is a contractual asset. Don't jeopardize it.

WOMAN IN PINK
My body, your investment. I understand.

FU JINYAN
Don't call me for minor things.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

The FEMALE LEAD clutches her abdomen in severe pain. She falls from the bed to the floor. A water glass shatters.

She looks at her hands covered in blood, terrified.

NURSES rush over to help her up. One calls for a doctor.

In the distance, Fu Jinyan and the Woman in Pink are leaving the registration area. He glances back at the commotion, his eyes briefly finding the Female Lead's. Then he turns and leaves.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

FU JINYAN returns to the dimly lit bedroom, removing his suit vest. The FEMALE LEAD lies on the bed wearing a red nightgown, her hand bandaged.

The FEMALE LEAD wakes up startled and sits up. She hugs Fu Jinyan from behind, her bandaged hand leaving a faint red stain.

FEMALE LEAD
Can we just hold each other for a while?

FU JINYAN looks down at the stain on his shirt. He gently but firmly removes her hands.

FU JINYAN
You need rest. Not this.

FU JINYAN turns and leaves. The FEMALE LEAD sits alone on the bed, looking up at the ceiling, her eyes empty but resolved.

FEMALE LEAD
(to herself)
Not this. Not ever.

title: Untitled Script
description: A taxi driver intervenes when a local thug harasses a woman after a traffic incident.
context:
Title: Untitled Script
Description: A taxi driver intervenes when a local thug harasses a woman after a traffic incident.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

A yellow taxi idles by a quiet roadside. XIAO SONG (20s, weary eyes, taxi driver uniform) steps out, stretching stiff shoulders.

COLLEAGUE BROTHER (40s, weathered suit) waits by the curb with a plastic bag of breakfast.

XIAO SONG
Brother.

XIAO SONG takes the bag.

XIAO SONG
Thanks for this.

COLLEAGUE BROTHER
Another month of doubles? You're running yourself into the ground.

XIAO SONG
Anniversary today. Want to make it special.

COLLEAGUE BROTHER
(snorts)
She's a lucky woman.

XIAO SONG offers a tired smile. COLLEAGUE BROTHER clasps his shoulder, then gets in the car and drives off. XIAO SONG stands by the road, eating in the morning light.

EXT. ROAD UNDER BRIDGE - DAY

A white BMW and a black sedan sit by the roadside, hazard lights blinking. Traffic echoes from the overpass above.

LUO YIHONG (30s, expensive jacket, entitled swagger) blocks HONG GU (20s, business attire, trembling hands) from her car door.

LUO YIHONG
You break like you own the whole road.

HONG GU reaches into her car for her insurance papers.

HONG GU
This covers everything. We're done here.

LUO YIHONG slams her car door shut.

LUO YIHONG
I don't do insurance.

He steps closer, invading her space.

LUO YIHONG
One drink. We call it even.

HONG GU
I don't drink with strangers.
continuation:
LUO YIHONG
We'll fix that.

His hand moves toward her face. She slaps it away.

HONG GU
Don't.

LUO YIHONG
(chuckles)
You have no idea what you're missing.

HONG GU
I'm not missing anything.

LUO YIHONG
What did you just say to me?

XIAO SONG walks over from nearby.

XIAO SONG
Problem here?

LUO YIHONG turns, sizing him up.

LUO YIHONG
Private matter.

XIAO SONG
(to Hong Gu)
You okay, miss?

HONG GU
(quickly)

Description: A taxi driver intervenes when a local thug harasses a woman after a traffic incident.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

A yellow taxi idles by a quiet roadside. XIAO SONG (20s, weary eyes, taxi driver uniform) steps out, stretching stiff shoulders.

COLLEAGUE BROTHER (40s, weathered suit) waits by the curb with a plastic bag of breakfast.

XIAO SONG
Brother.

XIAO SONG takes the bag.

XIAO SONG
Thanks for this.

COLLEAGUE BROTHER
Another month of doubles? You're running yourself into the ground.

XIAO SONG
Anniversary today. Want to make it special.

COLLEAGUE BROTHER
(snorts)
She's a lucky woman.

XIAO SONG offers a tired smile. COLLEAGUE BROTHER clasps his shoulder, then gets in the car and drives off. XIAO SONG stands by the road, eating in the morning light.

EXT. ROAD UNDER BRIDGE - DAY

A white BMW and a black sedan sit by the roadside, hazard lights blinking. Traffic echoes from the overpass above.

LUO YIHONG (30s, expensive jacket, entitled swagger) blocks HONG GU (20s, business attire, trembling hands) from her car door.

LUO YIHONG
You break like you own the whole road.

HONG GU reaches into her car for her insurance papers.

HONG GU
This covers everything. We're done here.

LUO YIHONG slams her car door shut.

LUO YIHONG
I don't do insurance.

He steps closer, invading her space.

LUO YIHONG
One drink. We call it even.

HONG GU
I don't drink with strangers.

LUO YIHONG
We'll fix that.

His hand moves toward her face. She slaps it away.

HONG GU
Don't.

LUO YIHONG
(chuckles)
You have no idea what you're missing.

HONG GU
I'm not missing anything.

LUO YIHONG
What did you just say to me?

XIAO SONG walks over from nearby.

XIAO SONG
Problem here?

LUO YIHONG turns, sizing him up.

LUO YIHONG
Private matter.

XIAO SONG
(to Hong Gu)
You okay, miss?

HONG GU
(quickly)
I'm fine. Please, just go.

(to Xiao Song)
You know who you're talking to? Luo Yihong. My family built this district.

You know him?

(laughs)
Liar.

I tried to be reasonable.

The two men move forward, flanking Xiao Song on both sides.

title: Urban Hidden Dragon
description: Lu Fan, wrongfully imprisoned for five years, breaks through to the Celestial Realm and prepares to reunite with his wife while secretly building her family's empire.
context:
Title: Urban Hidden Dragon
Description: Lu Fan, wrongfully imprisoned for five years, breaks through to the Celestial Realm and prepares to reunite with his wife while secretly building her family's empire.

INT. CONSCIOUSNESS SPACE - DAY

Golden text appears in the center of the screen: ZHONGZHOU PRISON - SOLITARY.

VOICEOVER (V.O.)
Lu Fan. Attempted rape. Five years.

LU FAN sits cross-legged, eyes closed in meditation, his body emanating a faint golden glow. Phantom chains crisscross around him.

FLASHBACK - INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Two THUGS pin a MAN onto a bed where an unconscious WOMAN lies. A CAMERA on a tripod records.

THUG
(laughing maniacally)
Smile for the lens, Liu family son-in-law.

END FLASHBACK

LU FAN continues meditating. A seductive woman in red robes (INNER DEMON) appears behind him, placing her hands on his shoulders.

INNER DEMON
Why continue cultivating? It's so painful.

FLASHBACK - INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

A MAN lunges toward the unconscious WOMAN on the bed. This is the FRAME that convicted him.

ANOTHER MAN
You're asking for death!

The MAN is kicked away and falls to the ground in pain——but the camera catches only his "assault."

END FLASHBACK

INNER DEMON
Come with me instead, sink into pleasure.

The INNER DEMON's hand gently caresses LU FAN's cheek.

INNER DEMON
She never visited. Why waste this cultivation on her?

LU FAN's eyes snap open——blazing white-gold.

LU FAN
Because she is my wife.

LU FAN's gaze becomes resolute.

LU FAN
A mere nascent demon dares to question my path to the Celestial Realm!

LU FAN waves his hand. A powerful golden energy wave explodes outward, shattering the INNER DEMON. Countless papers flutter through the air——legal appeals, news clips of LIU SHIQING. He is enveloped by golden halos and energy.

LU FAN slowly rises into the air, consumed by a golden pillar of light, then vanishes.
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

The light pillar dissipates. LU FAN appears in the center of a spacious, dusty warehouse filled with light beams.

He stands up and adjusts his sleeves.

QING LUAN leads four BLACK-CLAD FEMALE SUBORDINATES forward. They kneel on one knee before him, weapons in hand.

QING LUAN AND FEMALE SUBORDINATES
Congratulations, Master, on breaking through to the Celestial Realm!

LU FAN
Rise.

They stand.

LU FAN
How are the tasks I assigned?

QING LUAN
We've turned Lord Guo Tianfang. Black Gold Consortium enters Jiangzhou tomorrow.

SUBORDINATE WEI
Under the Dragon Hall's covert guidance, all the prominent families have directed their resources toward the Liu family. Your wife believes she outmaneuvered them.

QING LUAN
The Liu family has not only escaped crisis but has elevated to second-tier elite family status. Their development speed and potential are unmatched in Jiangzhou.

LU FAN
(satisfied)
Well done.

QING LUAN
Master, with your abilities, making the Liu family Jiangzhou's top family would be easy. Why go to such lengths?

LU FAN
My wife has a strong sense of career and responsibility. If I tell her all of this was my doing from a prison cell, she'll think it's another manipulation.

SUBORDINATE WEI
Do you plan to keep this hidden forever?

LU FAN
No. Five years are up. It's time for my release. Make arrangements for the Dragon Summoning Banquet. Have the Black Gold Consortium prepare a ten-billion-yuan contract for the Liu family. I will confess everything to Liu Shiqing then and give her a grand surprise.

QING LUAN
Yes, Master.

SUBORDINATE WEI
Master, the warden's convoy is here. Unscheduled.

QING LUAN's expression becomes serious. Her hand moves to her sidearm.

FADE OUT.

title: Record of Spirit Beasts - Nine-Tailed Fox King
description: A veterinary intern discovers his hidden lineage when three shape-shifting demons test him in a neon-lit alley, awakening powers he never knew he possessed.
context:
Title: Record of Spirit Beasts - Nine-Tailed Fox King
Description: A veterinary intern discovers his hidden lineage when three shape-shifting demons test him in a neon-lit alley, awakening powers he never knew he possessed.

INT. NEON ALLEY - NIGHT

A DRUNK MAN and a WOMAN IN RED kiss under pink neon lights.

LIN walks by with a medical satchel, glancing at the couple with clinical detachment.

The Woman opens her eyes. They glow GREEN. She transforms into a GIANT COBRA, striking the man. He collapses, paralyzed.

LIN
(whispering)
Neurotoxic venom... respiratory paralysis within minutes.

The Cobra turns to Lin, unhinging her jaw.

LIN
(stumbling back)
Running triggers pursuit reflex. Bad idea. Doing it anyway.

He sprints. The snake crashes through trash cans behind him.

Lin trips. The LEOPARD DEMON and PIG DEMON block his path.

LEOPARD DEMON
Sisi's shy. You ran, so now she chase.

LIN
(gasping)
That man needs intubation! Let me help him—

LEOPARD DEMON
(smiling)
Help is for the strong. Are you strong?

Her face SHIFTS into a LEOPARD MUZZLE, eyes burning YELLOW.

LEOPARD DEMON
Prey should squeal. Why don't you?

SNAKE DEMON (SISI)
Appears behind him, humanoid with scales and forked tongue.

SNAKE DEMON (SISI)
You don't squeal. You diagnose. Unusual for a human.

LIN
How do you know my name?

PIG DEMON
Your blood stinks of old hunters. Fox King's line.

The Pig Demon steps forward, tusks glinting.

PIG DEMON
Time to see if you're worthy of the name.

LIN
(frantically searching his satchel)
Porcine metabolism... high sensitivity to anticholinergics...
continuation:
He flings WHITE POWDER. The Pig Demon inhales, staggers, snout appearing.

PIG DEMON
(slurred, furious)
You... drugged me?

LEOPARD DEMON
(eyes widening)
The mark! He's awakening!

Lin's sleeve burns away, revealing a GLOWING NINE-TAILED FOX TATTOO on his forearm.

SNAKE DEMON (SISI)
(bowing her head slightly)
The King returns. Our test is complete.

NINE CRIMSON TAILS of spectral light manifest around Lin.

LIN
(staring at his hands)
What... what am I?

SNAKE DEMON (SISI)
The hunter we were sworn to serve. The treaty is broken.

The demons VANISH in swirling smoke.

Lin kneels by the unconscious man. The venom visibly withdraws from the man's veins.

Lin's eyes glow AMBER with slit pupils. He stands, tails flickering.

A TINY FOX SPIRIT emerges from his satchel.

FOX SPIRIT
(squeaky voice)
Finally awake, lazy heir. Can we get dumplings now?

LIN
(whispering)
What just happened?

FOX SPIRIT
You passed the test. Welcome to the hunt, King.

Lin looks down the neon alley, seeing ghostly spirits among the crowd. He squares his shoulders.

LIN
I don't understand my powers.

FOX SPIRIT
Then let's hunt. Starting with dinner?

LIN
(smiling despite himself)
After I save this man.

Lin's tails fade as he pulls out a syringe, his hands steady now.

FOX SPIRIT
(sighs)
So responsible. Just like your grandmother.

The city pulses with hidden life. Lin works, the first true Fox King in a century.

title: Little Qiao's Troubles
description: A young woman gets hit by a car and wakes up in a strange body, confronting the driver who turns out to be a CEO.
context:
Title: Little Qiao's Troubles
Description: A young woman gets hit by a car and wakes up in a strange body, confronting the driver who turns out to be a CEO.

INT. STREET - DAY

QIAO SHENGNAN kneels on the crosswalk, frantically picking up scattered documents. A red car speeds toward her with a piercing screech of brakes.

QIAO SHENGNAN turns back in horror, pupils dilating.

The car hits QIAO SHENGNAN. She is thrown onto the hood, then rolls to the ground, unconscious.

YOU BAI and GAO SHENG get out of the car.

GAO SHENG
Ca-call someone!

YOU BAI
(on phone)
Hello, 120? Someone's injured here!

YOU BAI
(to QIAO SHENGNAN)
Are you okay? Can you hear me?

The screen flickers and goes dark. Ambulance siren sounds.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

QIAO SUMIAN lies in bed, slowly opening her eyes. YOU BAI is leaning over, looking at her.

QIAO SUMIAN (V.O.)
Did heaven outsource to male models?

YOU BAI
Awake?

QIAO SUMIAN
(startled)
Huh?

QIAO SUMIAN (V.O.)
This isn't my voice.

A DOCTOR enters the room.

DOCTOR
Miss Qiao has minor scrapes. She fainted from shock and low blood sugar.

FLASHBACK: The car brakes hard, GLANCING QIAO SHENGNAN—less impact than remembered.

QIAO SUMIAN (V.O.)
That's not what I felt. Something's wrong.

YOU BAI speaks to GAO SHENG.

YOU BAI
Clear her for discharge. Transfer Miss Qiao to Cloud Peak Villa for observation.

QIAO SUMIAN (V.O.)
continuation:
Villa observation? This guy's guilt is extreme.

QIAO SUMIAN suddenly sits up, startling YOU BAI and GAO SHENG.

QIAO SUMIAN
(pointing at YOU BAI)
Your surname. Gu? Lu? Then it must be You!

A NURSE walks in with a report.

NURSE
President You, all reports are normal.

QIAO SUMIAN
(laughing)
Ha! Your surname is You! Of course it is!

QIAO SUMIAN laughs, the sound fraying at the edges.

GAO SHENG
(to YOU BAI)
Sir, she seems different.

QIAO SUMIAN
(jumping off the bed)
Domineering CEO falls in love with me? Such a cliché plot! Compensation. Medical, trauma, inconvenience—pay me and I'll leave!

QIAO SUMIAN reaches out her hand, then clutches her head.

YOU BAI
What's wrong now?

QIAO SUMIAN
I need to pee!

QIAO SUMIAN limps away.

GAO SHENG
Sir, what should we do?

YOU BAI
(waving hand)
Let me catch my breath first.

INT. RESTROOM - DAY

QIAO SUMIAN stands at the sink, splashing water on her face. She lifts her head and looks at herself in the mirror, suddenly discovering a completely unfamiliar face.

QIAO SUMIAN stares in horror, wide-eyed, and lets out a scream.

QIAO SUMIAN
Ah!

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

YOU BAI sits on the sofa reading medical records. Hearing the scream, he jerks his head up with a shocked expression.

YOU BAI moves toward the restroom door.

FADE OUT.
