title: Lord of the Northern Cang Palace
description: A powerful warrior returns to his homeland after five years, hiding his true identity as he seeks to protect his wife and reclaim what is rightfully hers.
context:
Title: Lord of the Northern Cang Palace
Description: A powerful warrior returns to his homeland after five years, hiding his true identity as he seeks to protect his wife and reclaim what is rightfully hers.

EXT. NORTHERN CANG COURTYARD - DAY

A bodyguard in a suit walks out of the revolving door of a modern building, full of authority. Several similar bodyguards stand on either side. LIN YANG, wearing a black leather jacket, walks straight toward the entrance and is stopped by the bodyguards.

BODYGUARD
Sir, the Northern Cang Courtyard is not receiving any guests tonight.

LIN YANG
I gave that order.

BODYGUARD
Sir, please mind your tone. The master of our Northern Cang Courtyard is the Palace Lord of the Northern Cang Palace. At the highest position in the Northern Border, an existence above tens of thousands.

LIN YANG
Step aside.

LIN YANG reveals a golden dragon-shaped ring on his hand. The BODYGUARD sees it and is shocked, stumbling backward.

BODYGUARD
(stuttering)
This... this...

The BODYGUARD is pushed back by an invisible force. At this moment, a woman in black leather (SILVER DRAGON GUARD) and a middle-aged man in a black robe (JIANG NANCHENG) emerge from the hall with a large group of people.

The SILVER DRAGON GUARD pushes aside the blocking bodyguard.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
(kneeling on one knee)
The Silver Dragon Guard of the Northern Cang Palace pays respects to the Master and welcomes the Master's return to the country!

JIANG NANCHENG
(leading everyone to kneel on one knee)
Jiang Nancheng, Protector of the Cloud Capital Branch of the Northern Cang Palace, pays respects to the Master and welcomes the Master's return to the country!

LIN YANG
Everyone, rise.

Everyone stands up.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
Master, with your sudden return to the country, the powerful figures in Central Province will likely be restless.

LIN YANG
Let them be.
continuation:
EXT. CITY ROAD - DAY

A convoy of several black luxury cars speeds through the city roads, finally stopping in front of the Northern Cang Courtyard.

EXT. NORTHERN CANG COURTYARD - DAY

Three men wearing ornate military-style coats (THREE COMMANDERS) get out of the cars and rush to LIN YANG, kneeling on one knee.

ARMY COMMANDER
Commander of the Cloud Capital Army!

NAVY COMMANDER
Commander of the Cloud Capital Navy!

AIR FORCE COMMANDER
Commander of the Cloud Capital Air Force!

THREE COMMANDERS
(in unison)
We have come to welcome the Northern Border Commander, Lord Lin Yang!

LIN YANG
The moment I set foot in Cloud Capital, you followed. Am I so dangerous that you are this wary of me?

ARMY COMMANDER
Commander, you jest. You are the Lord of the Northern Border.

AIR FORCE COMMANDER
The War God of the Dragon Kingdom.

ARMY COMMANDER
Your sudden arrival in Cloud Capital, we...

LIN YANG
I came to reclaim what's mine.

THREE COMMANDERS
(in unison)
We are at the Commander's service!

LIN YANG
(waving his hand)
No. This time, I serve her.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

LIN YANG sits on the sofa, playing with a string of black prayer beads in his hand. The SILVER DRAGON GUARD walks in and kneels to adjust his shoes.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
Master, wealthy families from various regions have sent invitations, hoping to pay their respects to you in Cloud Capital.

LIN YANG
Refuse them.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
Yes.

LIN YANG
On our wedding night, the Northern Border fell into turmoil. This separation has lasted five years. I owe her far too much. Now the Su family is in chaos, she is overwhelmed, worried sick, and I was the last to know.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
Master, tomorrow night at the Cloud Capital Summit, Jiang Nancheng of the Northern Cang Palace will publicly announce support for your wife, Su Shiyan. She will be the center of attention, and all of this is what you have given her. Without your authorization, Miss Su would never have achieved what she has today. Moreover, Miss Su is not in any danger now. You need not blame yourself.

LIN YANG
Everything I have should have been hers. I came back this time to let Shiyan know that everything I have...

LIN YANG clenches his fist. White light emanates from his body, his aura overwhelming.
full_script:
Title: Lord of the Northern Cang Palace
Description: A powerful warrior returns to his homeland after five years, hiding his true identity as he seeks to protect his wife and reclaim what is rightfully hers.

EXT. NORTHERN CANG COURTYARD - DAY

A bodyguard in a suit walks out of the revolving door of a modern building, full of authority. Several similar bodyguards stand on either side. LIN YANG, wearing a black leather jacket, walks straight toward the entrance and is stopped by the bodyguards.

BODYGUARD
Sir, the Northern Cang Courtyard is not receiving any guests tonight.

LIN YANG
I gave that order.

BODYGUARD
Sir, please mind your tone. The master of our Northern Cang Courtyard is the Palace Lord of the Northern Cang Palace. At the highest position in the Northern Border, an existence above tens of thousands.

LIN YANG
Step aside.

LIN YANG reveals a golden dragon-shaped ring on his hand. The BODYGUARD sees it and is shocked, stumbling backward.

BODYGUARD
(stuttering)
This... this...

The BODYGUARD is pushed back by an invisible force. At this moment, a woman in black leather (SILVER DRAGON GUARD) and a middle-aged man in a black robe (JIANG NANCHENG) emerge from the hall with a large group of people.

The SILVER DRAGON GUARD pushes aside the blocking bodyguard.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
(kneeling on one knee)
The Silver Dragon Guard of the Northern Cang Palace pays respects to the Master and welcomes the Master's return to the country!

JIANG NANCHENG
(leading everyone to kneel on one knee)
Jiang Nancheng, Protector of the Cloud Capital Branch of the Northern Cang Palace, pays respects to the Master and welcomes the Master's return to the country!

LIN YANG
Everyone, rise.

Everyone stands up.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
Master, with your sudden return to the country, the powerful figures in Central Province will likely be restless.

LIN YANG
Let them be.

EXT. CITY ROAD - DAY

A convoy of several black luxury cars speeds through the city roads, finally stopping in front of the Northern Cang Courtyard.

EXT. NORTHERN CANG COURTYARD - DAY

Three men wearing ornate military-style coats (THREE COMMANDERS) get out of the cars and rush to LIN YANG, kneeling on one knee.

ARMY COMMANDER
Commander of the Cloud Capital Army!

NAVY COMMANDER
Commander of the Cloud Capital Navy!

AIR FORCE COMMANDER
Commander of the Cloud Capital Air Force!

THREE COMMANDERS
(in unison)
We have come to welcome the Northern Border Commander, Lord Lin Yang!

LIN YANG
The moment I set foot in Cloud Capital, you followed. Am I so dangerous that you are this wary of me?

ARMY COMMANDER
Commander, you jest. You are the Lord of the Northern Border.

AIR FORCE COMMANDER
The War God of the Dragon Kingdom.

ARMY COMMANDER
Your sudden arrival in Cloud Capital, we...

LIN YANG
I came to reclaim what's mine.

THREE COMMANDERS
(in unison)
We are at the Commander's service!

LIN YANG
(waving his hand)
No. This time, I serve her.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

LIN YANG sits on the sofa, playing with a string of black prayer beads in his hand. The SILVER DRAGON GUARD walks in and kneels to adjust his shoes.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
Master, wealthy families from various regions have sent invitations, hoping to pay their respects to you in Cloud Capital.

LIN YANG
Refuse them.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
Yes.

LIN YANG
On our wedding night, the Northern Border fell into turmoil. This separation has lasted five years. I owe her far too much. Now the Su family is in chaos, she is overwhelmed, worried sick, and I was the last to know.

SILVER DRAGON GUARD
Master, tomorrow night at the Cloud Capital Summit, Jiang Nancheng of the Northern Cang Palace will publicly announce support for your wife, Su Shiyan. She will be the center of attention, and all of this is what you have given her. Without your authorization, Miss Su would never have achieved what she has today. Moreover, Miss Su is not in any danger now. You need not blame yourself.

LIN YANG
Everything I have should have been hers. I came back this time to let Shiyan know that everything I have...

LIN YANG clenches his fist. White light emanates from his body, his aura overwhelming.

title: Dragon Guard God Level - Shen Lang Returns
description: A legendary warrior returns to find his comrades under attack by the Yama Hall assassins at the border.
context:
Title: Dragon Guard God Level - Shen Lang Returns
Description: A legendary warrior returns to find his comrades under attack by the Yama Hall assassins at the border.

INT. PLAZA - NIGHT

FAST CUTS: An intense battle unfolds. Dragon Hall warriors in camouflage uniforms clash fiercely with men in black. Blades flash, bodies fall.

A Dragon Hall warrior is cut down by a man in black.

Hordes of men in black charge out from under a magnificent gate tower, their momentum fierce.

The Dragon Hall warriors engage in a chaotic melee with the men in black. The battle is massive, both sides fighting fiercely, people constantly falling.

One Dragon Hall warrior (WARRIOR) survives the battle but is covered in wounds. He looks around - the ground is littered with the corpses of comrades and enemies.

WARRIOR
(strained)
Hold the line...

The remaining men in black surround the WARRIOR. He fights back desperately, taking down several more, but finally collapses to his knees from exhaustion and injury.

The WARRIOR struggles toward a red banner emblazoned with the character "Dragon," painfully planting it in the ground.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
While the Dragon Banner stands, none shall cross our border.

The YAMA HALL LEADER (a fat man in armor) jumps down from above, laughing triumphantly.

YAMA HALL LEADER
(laughing)
Ha ha ha! Since the Dragon God retired, your Dragon King Hall is nothing but a rabble. Today, I will wipe you all out!

The WARRIOR pulls out a golden token from his chest. It pulses with faint light.

WARRIOR
The ones who will die are you.

YAMA HALL LEADER
(shocked)
The Dragon Token? How do you have the Dragon Token?

WARRIOR
When the Divine Token appears, all must submit! That lord will avenge us!

YAMA HALL LEADER
(laughing maniacally)
Ha ha ha! So what if it's the Dragon Token? Today I'm going to kill you! Yah!

The YAMA HALL LEADER raises his blade to strike the WARRIOR. Suddenly, a man in a tank top, shorts, and flip-flops (SHEN LANG) appears, talking on his phone while casually blocking the leader's attack with a sword.

SHEN LANG
(into phone)
Hello, honey. Hey, speak louder, it's really noisy here.

YAMA HALL LEADER
Who are you?

YAMA HALL LEADER
Black and White Demons, attack!

Two masked figures (BLACK AND WHITE DEMONS) charge at SHEN LANG.

SHEN LANG
(into phone)
Hey, honey, I really am saving the border. I'm not lying to you, believe me. Why would I lie to you?

SHEN LANG continues his phone call while effortlessly dodging and defeating the Black and White Demons.

SHEN LANG
(into phone)
Come on, send me a voice message. Huh?

Golden electric light emanates from the Black and White Demons' bodies before they collapse.

SHEN LANG
(hanging up)
Huh? Honey?

WARRIOR
(weakly)
Dragon God, sir! They're from Yama Hall, don't let them go!

SHEN LANG
Yama Hall?

SHEN LANG
Kneel.
continuation:
INT. SHEN FAMILY VILLA - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SHEN'S FATHER and SHEN'S MOTHER kneel on the ground, surrounded by masked Yama Hall assassins. Their hands are bound with black iron chains.

SHEN'S FATHER
Please don't kill us, spare us.

YAMA HALL ASSASSIN
Remember, the ones who killed you are from Yama Hall!

The assassin swings his blade. SHEN'S FATHER and MOTHER fall in pools of blood.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. PLAZA - NIGHT

YAMA HALL LEADER
Dragon God, die!

The YAMA HALL LEADER charges at SHEN LANG. SHEN LANG extends a finger. The leader clutches his chest in pain and staggers back several steps.

SHEN LANG
(sighing)
Geez, just these few small fries, and you can't even handle them? Can you guys step it up a bit?

WARRIOR
(ashamed)
Dragon God, sir...

SHEN LANG
(sighing)
Sigh.

WARRIOR
(kneeling, presenting the Dragon Token with both hands)
The Dragon Token is here. What right do I have to hold this Divine Token?

SHEN LANG
Remember, you need to stand strong.

SHEN LANG'S eyes become sharp.

SHEN LANG
Yama Hall!

SHEN LANG turns. His casual clothes instantly transform into mighty black armor, flames roaring in the background. Ghostly Dragon banners materialize around him.

FADE OUT.

title: Substitute Bride Discovers Her Husband is a Hidden Tycoon
description: Jiang Can is forced to marry in place of her stepsister to a man rumored to be a ex-convict thug, only to discover shocking truths on their wedding night.
context:
Title: Substitute Bride Discovers Her Husband is a Hidden Tycoon
Description: Jiang Can is forced to marry in place of her stepsister to a man rumored to be a ex-convict thug, only to discover shocking truths on their wedding night.

INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - NIGHT

Red lanterns cast a warm glow. JIANG CAN sits on the sofa in her white wedding dress, hands clenched in her lap.

GU MANG enters, shirt unbuttoned at the collar. His gaze sharp as he looks at her.

JIANG CAN sees him and instinctively draws back.

GU MANG walks up to her and leans down.

GU MANG
The bathroom's through there. Unless you plan to sleep in that dress.

JIANG CAN
(timidly)
I thought... I should wash up first.

GU MANG
(nods slowly)
Don't take too long.

JIANG CAN stands and hurries toward the bathroom.

GU MANG sits on the sofa, picking up the jade bracelet she left behind.

GU MANG (V.O.)
So this is the bride they sent.
continuation:
INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

JIANG CAN stands before the mirror, still in her wedding dress, fighting tears. She removes a jade bracelet, revealing a faint scar on her wrist.

FLASHBACK BEGINS:

INT. JIANG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

JIANG FENG stands by the window, his back to Jiang Can.

JIANG FENG
Your mother's surgery is scheduled for next week. The Gu family has been... generous.

YANG JUAN arranges flowers, her voice deceptively gentle.

YANG JUAN
Such a fortunate match. And your mother receiving the best care... it's what we all want, isn't it?

JIANG YAO touches Jiang Can's shoulder with delicate fingers.

JIANG YAO
Poor little sister. I heard the Gu family's younger son has... a reputation. But I'm sure you'll change him.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Jiang Can walks down the street in her wedding dress, needing air. She overhears:

MALE PASSERBY (V.O.)
The Gu family thug finally got himself a bride. Hope she survives the wedding night.

FEMALE PASSERBY (V.O.)
She's not the one he was supposed to marry anyway. Just a stand-in.

FLASHBACK ENDS.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

Jiang Can stands under the shower. Her face crumples—then firms with resolve. She touches the scar on her wrist.

JIANG CAN (V.O.)
Mother's medicine. Brother's tuition. This is just a transaction. I can endure anything.

She wraps herself in a towel and walks out.

INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - NIGHT

GU MANG lies on the bed. He turns as she emerges.

He rises and crosses to her. He pins her against the doorframe.

GU MANG
Do you know who you're married to?

JIANG CAN
(eyes downcast)
Gu Mang. My husband.

GU MANG
(lifts her chin)
Your family expected my brother—the one with the record. They sent you to replace your sister. And I replaced him.

GU MANG
I'm not the thug from the rumors. But I am your husband. Knowing that, are you still afraid?

JIANG CAN
(meets his gaze)
I married the Gu family. Whoever you are... I'm not afraid.

A slight smile touches his lips.

GU MANG
Then let's see if you can handle the truth.

GU MANG leans down. The scene fades to black.

title: Xuanyuan Medical Saint
description: A legendary healer returns to avenge his grandfather's death and clear his name from false treason charges.
context:
Title: Xuanyuan Medical Saint
Description: A legendary healer returns to avenge his grandfather's death and clear his name from false treason charges.

EXT. ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT

Rain hammers the corrugated roof of a derelict chemical plant. Inside, three THUGS huddle around a bubbling hotpot, their shadows monstrous against the concrete walls. They grip meat with blood-stained fingers, laughing through mouthfuls.

A CASKET—plain pine, unvarnished—floats into view, carried by unseen hands. The thugs freeze, chopsticks mid-air.

XUANYUAN (28) enters. A drifter's coat hangs off his shoulders, but his stride is that of a general. He doesn't look at the thugs. He looks up.

His GRANDFATHER—frail in life, skeletal in death—dangles from a rusted gantry, a noose around his neck. The old man's medical robe, once white as lambswool, is shredded and scorched.

Xuanyan's knuckles whiten around a worn jade pendant—the Medicine King's Seal. His grandfather's final patient had sent it back with a note: "Traitor's blood."

XUANYUAN
(whisper)
...still can't rest.

The Thug Leader—scar splitting his left eyebrow—emerges from the gantry's shadows. He uses the old man's body as a footrest.

THUG LEADER
You're the pup? Should've stayed buried.

XUANYUAN
Step away from him.

THUG LEADER
This old fossil confessed. Sold secrets to the Western Barbarians. We just... expedited his sentencing.

The Leader draws a blade across his own throat in a mocking gesture. The other thugs brandish iron pipes, spreading out.

XUANYUAN
You misunderstand. That wasn't a request.

He clicks his tongue once. A sound like a temple bell.

The pendant shatters between his fingers. Dust swirls. The thugs' eyes glaze. They drop their weapons, clawing at their necks—pressure points screaming.

XUANYUAN
(to himself)
Guan points for paralysis. Grandfather taught me that at six.

He walks through them unaffected. They collapse, twitching.

Xuanyuan leaps to the gantry—three stories in one breath. The Leader slashes at him. Xuanyuan catches the blade between his palms, twists. The steel snaps.

They lock eyes.

XUANYUAN
You slit his throat?

He taps the Leader's collarbone. Once. The Leader's arm goes limp.

XUANYUAN
(quietly)
Then you won't be needing this.

The Leader's throat constricts. He drops, gasping.

Xuanyuan cradles his grandfather's body, cutting him down with the broken blade. The old man's fingers are still stained with ink. His final prescription—unfilled.
continuation:
A PIPA STRING hums. Sonic wave shatters a jar beside Xuanyuan's head.

NIGHT SAINT (30s), her face veiled, stands on a water tower. The pipa across her chest.

NIGHT SAINT
You were exiled, Senior Brother. This is defiance.

DAY SAINT (40s) drops from above, his staff cracking the concrete. His robes bear the Imperial Inspector's seal.

Xuanyuan lays his grandfather's body in the casket. Gently. He covers him with his own coat.

XUANYUAN
(to Night Saint)
You play the Echoing Death Song now? For them?

He gestures at the prostrate thugs.

NIGHT SAINT
Orders. The Emperor demands proof of your execution.

XUANYUAN
(turning)
And you, Day Saint? You taught me anatomy. You know what I can do with a single needle.

DAY SAINT
I taught you to save. Not to—

XUANYUAN
—not to what? Not to kill the disease?

The Saints exchange glances. They attack in concert, a harmony of sound and steel.

Xuanyuan doesn't draw a weapon. He uses the casket lid as a shield, deflecting sonic waves. His fingers flick—each gesture targeting nerve clusters.

Night Saint's fingers slip on her strings. Cramp.

Day Saint's staff slows. His joints lock.

They stumble back, bleeding from their ears.

NIGHT SAINT
(ragged)
You... you're not just sealing points. You're...

XUANYUAN
...unlearning your teachings. Yes.

A single red FLARE bursts outside—his signal.

Twelve FIGURES in physician's coats drop through the ceiling, landing in perfect formation. They kneel, not to Xuanyuan, but to the casket.

SUBORDINATES
(in unison)
The Medical Saints Corps serves. The innocent shall be healed. The guilty—

They rise, turning to Xuanyuan. He holds the broken blade over his heart.

XUANYUAN
(finishing)
—will know their own diagnosis.

He snaps the blade in half. The sound echoes like a verdict.

title: Peerless War God
description: A legendary military commander is falsely accused of treason by a corrupt official and a traitor, forcing him to make an impossible choice between his honor and his army.

Title: Peerless War God
Description: A legendary military commander is falsely accused of treason by a corrupt official and a traitor, forcing him to make an impossible choice between his honor and his army.

INT. WAR ROOM - DAY

LIE LANG stands before a sand table, flanked by two armed GUARDS. A sealed imperial dispatch rests beside the maps.

LIE LANG
Deploy one hundred thousand troops through the western passes. Phi Nation's forces await our signal. When they strike, Great Xia's defenses will shatter.

INT. CORRIDOR - DAY

XIAO POTIAN blocks LIE LANG's path.

XIAO POTIAN
Commander Lie. Your men march without my authority. Explain yourself.

LIE LANG
Explain treason, Marshal? I've already sent my report. You've been secretly negotiating with Phi Nation's War God.

XIAO POTIAN
Fifteen years I've held this border.

LIE LANG
Fifteen years you prepared your betrayal. The evidence waits inside. Surrender, and you might keep your head.

XIAO POTIAN
Show me this evidence—or lose yours.

The GUARDS attack. XIAO POTIAN strikes—three movements, impossibly fast. Both men are disarmed, and LIE LANG stumbles back against the wall.

XIAO POTIAN
From now on, any man who questions my loyalty answers to my blade.

LI FENG appears, imperial edict in hand.

LI FENG
Rebel Xiao Potian, traitor to the nation, turning against heaven itself. Kneel and receive the imperial edict!

LIE LANG
(struggling to his feet)
Vice Minister Li! He discovered I had proof of his Phi Nation correspondence—he tried to murder me to suppress it!

XIAO POTIAN
(to LI FENG)
Li Feng, you accuse me of treason. Do you have evidence?
continuation:
LI FENG
Evidence? The sovereign's decree is the evidence.

LI FENG unfolds the edict. XIAO POTIAN is shocked after reading it.

XIAO POTIAN
Impossible! Li Feng, you've set me up!

LI FENG
How dare you! The evidence is right before you, and you still dare to argue?

XIAO POTIAN
I enlisted at fifteen to defend our borders. At twenty, I led three hundred soldiers against the Eagle Nation's eight War Gods. At twenty-two, I crushed four allied armies at Red River Ford. I am the Tiger Marshal, appointed by the sovereign himself. If you would convict me, have him speak the words to my face.

LI FENG
A condemned traitor doesn't demand audiences. Consider your million soldiers, Marshal. If you resist, they'll die as conspirators. Their families will starve in the mines. Is that your legacy?

XIAO POTIAN
My men are innocent.

LI FENG
Then kneel. Accept the investigation.

As XIAO POTIAN's eyes drop to the edict, LIE LANG produces a hidden dagger from his boot.

LIE LANG
(viciously)
Die, traitor!

He stabs downward. XIAO POTIAN twists, the blade scoring his shoulder. He seizes LIE LANG'S wrist and forces the blade back.

XIAO POTIAN
(roaring)
Great Xia's safety is my only line! Those who cross it find death!

He drives the dagger through LIE LANG'S throat.

XIAO POTIAN rises, blood streaming from his shoulder, and faces LI FENG.

LI FENG
You dare defy the imperial edict?

XIAO POTIAN
My loyalty was never to seals or decrees. It was to the soldiers who bleed for this land. You can kill me, Li Feng, but you cannot kill what I protected. From this day, I sever the chain that bound my honor to your corruption.

XIAO POTIAN drops his sword. It rings against the stone.

title: After Entering the Book, I Found My Happy Ending with the Villain
description: A woman finds herself transported into a book world where she becomes entangled with the villain, only to discover betrayal and sacrifice at a critical moment.
context:
Title: After Entering the Book, I Found My Happy Ending with the Villain
Description: A woman finds herself transported into a book world where she becomes entangled with the villain, only to discover betrayal and sacrifice at a critical moment.

EXT. MODERN APARTMENT - NIGHT

FENG QINGRAN (25), disheveled, clutches a novel titled "Heavenly Demon Ascension." A truck's headlights flash through the window.

INT. CAVE - DAY

SU YANRAN (24), modern features clashing with her ancient black robes, clutches her chest. Her eyes dart around the unfamiliar cave.

On a stone altar, MO JINGHONG (ageless, white-haired, black-robed) meditates, blue spiritual energy coiling around him like serpents. His breathing is measured.

A massive flying vessel materializes at the cave entrance. Its hull pulses with malevolent pink light.

Mo Jinghong's eyes snap open. The blue energy in his hands destabilizes.

MO JINGHONG
(speaking through gritted teeth)
Who dares—

The vessel's energy core detonates. The concussive blast shatters stalactites.

Mo Jinghong is flung backward, crashing into the cave wall. Blood trickles from his mouth.

Su Yanran steps from the smoke, her expression cold but her fingers trembling.

Feng Qingran bursts into the cave, her green robes stained with ash. She races toward Mo Jinghong.

FENG QINGRAN
(wild-eyed)
Jinghong!

She catches him as he slumps forward. His weight nearly pulls her down.

FENG QINGRAN
(whispering)
No, no, no. Your meridians—

SU YANRAN
(cutting in, voice steady)
Are ruptured. Because of you.

Feng Qingran freezes. Mo Jinghong's hand finds her cheek, smearing blood across her skin.

MO JINGHONG
(weakly)
Don't. Let them... see you cry.

SU YANRAN
You called me your sister. Told me he was vulnerable during his tribulation. You forgot one thing, Feng Qingran.

Su Yanran raises her hand. The pink energy of a dozen slain Demon Saints swirls around her fingertips.
continuation:
SU YANRAN
(inhaling sharply)
I am the protagonist of this world. And you are merely a reader who fell into the wrong pages.

Feng Qingran's eyes widen. She looks from Su Yanran's cruel smile to Mo Jinghong's fading strength.

FENG QINGRAN
(voice breaking)
I was supposed to... you were supposed to be good. The book said—

SU YANRAN
The book lied. Or maybe you simply never finished reading.

Su Yanran fires a bolt of pink energy. It strikes the ground between them, cracking the stone.

Feng Qingran instinctively shields Mo Jinghong with her body.

FENG QINGRAN
(screaming)
Stop! Please! Take my spiritual core instead! He never wanted this war!

MO JINGHONG
(gripping her sleeve)
Qingran... don't beg. Never... beg.

His body convulses. More blood seeps from his lips.

MO JINGHONG
(to Su Yanran, voice ragged)
Let her return... to her world. Then I'll give you... my ascension energy.

Su Yanran hesitates. The pink light flickers.

Feng Qingran clutches Mo Jinghong tighter, realizing the truth too late.

FENG QINGRAN
(whispering to him)
You knew? All along... you knew I wasn't from here?

Mo Jinghong's eyes meet hers. For the first time, he smiles.

MO JINGHONG
Your first night... you spoke in your sleep. About... plot holes.

INT. CAVE - CONTINUOUS

ON FENG QINGRAN'S FACE: Tears fall silently as she understands the depth of his protection.

SU YANRAN
(raising her hand again)
Choose. Ascension now, or your happy ending?

FADE TO BLACK.

END OF EPISODE

title: From Commanding the Entertainment Bureau to Ruling the World
description: A modern waiter is killed by a thug and thrown into a pool, only to awaken in ancient times as a prince, discovering his modern crush in a bathhouse.
context:
Title: From Commanding the Entertainment Bureau to Ruling the World
Description: A modern waiter is killed by a thug and thrown into a pool, only to awaken in ancient times as a prince, discovering his modern crush in a bathhouse.

EXT. SWIMMING POOL - NIGHT

Quick flashback shots: YE CHEN (in modern clothes) blocks a THUG's path to a cowering woman. The THUG's fist connects—YE CHEN crashes backwards into the pool.

YE CHEN (V.O.)
I died defending her. Now the water won't let me go.

YE CHEN sinks, his outstretched hand brushing a dropped jade pendant on the pool floor.

YE CHEN (V.O.)
It remembers.

A strobe of images: silk banners, rehearsal bells, a dancer's ribbon.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT BATHHOUSE - DAY

YE CHEN explodes from the lotus-pond surface, choking on incense-thick air. Ancient robes cling to him—jade pendant around his neck.

TITLE CARD: Prince Ye Chen, Overseer of the Imperial Entertainment Bureau

YE CHEN
(pressing his temple)
Two memories. One breath.

A splash. Laughter. A pink curtain drifts near the lotus partition. YE CHEN reaches for stability, glimpsing dancers beyond.

WOMAN
(spinning, silks clutched to her chest)
The Bureau's train here! Have you no shame?

YE CHEN
(voice cracking)
Qianqian... your pendant. It matches mine.

He holds up the jade pendant. The woman's hand flies to her own bare neck.

The frame freezes on YE CHEN's face. Ink spreads from his eyes, swallowing reality.

title: Red Eyes, Golden Pupils
description: After his family is massacred and his father killed, Wang Hao inherits the Divine Master Ring and vows revenge against the traitor Qin Ao.
context:
Title: Red Eyes, Golden Pupils
Description: After his family is massacred and his father killed, Wang Hao inherits the Divine Master Ring and vows revenge against the traitor Qin Ao.

EXT. VILLA COURTYARD - NIGHT

Rain lashes the courtyard. Torchlight flickers across wet stone as BLACK-CLAD ASSASSINS cut down fleeing SERVANTS. Blood pools at the base of guardian lion statues. A cold wind carries the stench of iron.

A MAN IN BLACK silences WANG HAO'S MOTHER with a swift, professional cut. She falls without a sound.

QIN AO (50s), bald, beads clicking in his grip, watches from the veranda. Not with glee—with grim necessity.

QIN AO
(quietly)
Find the Master. Not the ring. The man.

SUBORDINATE
(bowing)
The family wing is clear. Only the old basement remains.

QIN AO
He won't hide. Not from me.

Qin Ao steps over a fallen guard, his robes untouched by blood.

QIN AO (CONT'D)
Burn it. Let the past turn to ash.

Torches arc through the rain. Smoke billows as fire devours the wooden eaves.

INT. BASEMENT - NIGHT

WANG YUANSHAN (50s), pale from poison, presses an ornate ring into his son WANG HAO's palm. The younger man's scholar's hands tremble.

WANG YUANSHAN
You were never meant for this path. The academy... your books...

WANG HAO
(whisper)
We can still leave. Together.

WANG YUANSHAN
This was your brother's burden. Now it's yours.

WANG HAO
(choked)
It's just metal. Brother is dead. Mother—

WANG YUANSHAN
Metal that holds a million souls. Qin Ao thinks he wants it. He doesn't understand the weight.

Footsteps pound overhead. Dust showers from the beams.

WANG YUANSHAN (CONT'D)
The tunnel behind the wine racks. It leads to the old well.

WANG HAO
Not without you.

WANG YUANSHAN
I've been dead for three years, Hao'er. Since the day they poisoned me. Today, I'm just making it official.

WANG HAO
(tears falling)
You promised to see me graduate.

WANG YUANSHAN
And you promised never to draw a blade. We both lied.

He shoves Wang Hao toward the hidden entrance.

WANG YUANSHAN (CONT'D)
Remember: the ring commands nothing. You command it.
continuation:
EXT. VILLA COURTYARD - NIGHT

Wang Hao emerges from the well, mud-soaked. The villa blazes, but rain contains the worst.

Through the flames, he sees his father in the basement doorway—upright, defiant.

WANG HAO
(scream swallowed by thunder)
FATHER!

WANG YUANSHAN (V.O.)
Don't seek revenge. Seek justice. Or become what he is.

The villa collapses inward. Sparks spiral into the storm.

EXT. VILLA COURTYARD - NIGHT

Wang Hao kneels before his father's scorched body in the smoking ruins. The ring rests in his palm—cold metal, no magic.

WANG HAO
(voice raw)
Justice. Or become what he is.

He slips the ring on. Nothing happens. No glow. Just weight.

WANG HAO (CONT'D)
Qin Ao. I'm coming. Not for Cloud Heaven Hall. For the man you burned. And the one you made me become.

A wave of dizziness hits. The smoke... the grief... Wang Hao's vision blurs. For a moment, the ring seems to pulse with heat.

His eyes sting. Tears? No—something else. A golden shimmer reflects in a puddle before him. In it, he sees his own eyes: bloodshot red, pupils flecked with gold.

Not a power. Not magic. Just the look of a man who's lost everything—and found something harder in its place.

WANG HAO (CONT'D)
(whisper)
This is what you wanted, Qin Ao? Then come and see what you've created.

The golden flecks fade, but the hardness remains. The ring is just metal. The transformation is his alone.

title: Trapped in Time Loop
description: A wealthy heir trapped in a time loop for a thousand years uses his accumulated knowledge to navigate betrayal and manipulation.
context:
Title: Trapped in Time Loop
Description: A wealthy heir trapped in a time loop for a thousand years uses his accumulated knowledge to navigate betrayal and manipulation.

ON SCREEN: 01 - This story is purely fictional. Any similarities are purely coincidental.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

A row of girls in maid outfits jog into position, forming two lines.

A Rolls-Royce pulls up and stops at the entrance.

CHU BEICHEN (V.O.)
My name is Chu Beichen, and I have lived August 8th exactly one thousand, three hundred and seventy-four times. I have died seventy-three ways. I have learned everything. I have lost everything. Today, I try something different.

CHU BEICHEN steps out of the car. A BODYGUARD drapes a coat over his shoulders. He hands a single, perfectly folded bill to one MAID—the same one who always cries when no one watches.

CHU BEICHEN (V.O.)
The loop resets at midnight. Memories stay. Knowledge stays. The burden stays. But today, the pattern cracks.

CHU BEICHEN walks toward the hotel, not looking back as the MAIDS bow in unison.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

CHU BEICHEN exits the elevator, walking with measured steps that betray a thousand years of repetition. He removes his coat and shirt, each gesture precise, exhausted.

CHU BEICHEN (V.O.)
She arrives in four minutes. She always does. What she does next... that will be new.

INT. INDOOR POOL - DAY

CHU BEICHEN sits alone at the pool's edge, watching the water ripple. Several BIKINI-CLAD WOMEN keep their distance, sensing his isolation.

LIN XUEYING enters in a white silk shirt, black pencil skirt, and frameless glasses. She stands at the pool's edge, her reflection trembling on the water.

LIN XUEYING
The young master has been waiting.

CHU BEICHEN
(three heartbeats of silence)
Your perfume is wrong. He prefers vanilla on you. For me, you wear nothing.

LIN XUEYING's composure flickers—a tremor in her fingers.

LIN XUEYING
Chu Tianyou sent me to ask if you're still... incapable.

CHU BEICHEN
You came to take photos. To capture my humiliation. To prove I haven't changed.

He turns to her, water dripping from his fingers.

CHU BEICHEN
But I have. And so have you, Lin Xueying.

LIN XUEYING
(crouching, voice lowered)
continuation:
I am your brother's property. He owns my sister's medical bills. He owns my future.

CHU BEICHEN
And yet your hands are shaking.

He meets her gaze. The water between them goes still.

CHU BEICHEN
Take the picture. Or take something real.

He doesn't touch her. The choice hangs in the humid air.

LIN XUEYING
(whisper)
I cannot afford real.

She pulls him into the pool.

The splash echoes. LIN XUEYING surfaces, gasping, her glasses gone. CHU BEICHEN holds her at arm's length, studying her face as if seeing a ghost.

LIN XUEYING
What are you waiting for?

CHU BEICHEN
Proof that this time matters.

INT. POOLSIDE LOUNGE AREA - DAY

LIN XUEYING sits wrapped in a towel, her hair still dripping. She watches CHU BEICHEN approach, a lipstick camera resting on the glass table between them.

LIN XUEYING
Why didn't you stop me?

CHU BEICHEN
Because you hesitated.

LIN XUEYING
For three seconds. That's all.

CHU BEICHEN
In a thousand years, three seconds is everything.

He picks up the camera, ejects the memory card, and places it in her palm.

CHU BEICHEN
Give him what he wants. Or give him what he fears.

LIN XUEYING
(turning the card over)
What does he fear?

CHU BEICHEN
That I'll become someone worth following.

He walks away. LIN XUEYING stares at the card, then at his retreating back. The card feels warm.

A white flash of light.
full_script:
Title: Trapped in Time Loop
Description: A wealthy heir trapped in a time loop for a thousand years uses his accumulated knowledge to navigate betrayal and manipulation.

ON SCREEN: 01 - This story is purely fictional. Any similarities are purely coincidental.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

A row of girls in maid outfits jog into position, forming two lines.

A Rolls-Royce pulls up and stops at the entrance.

CHU BEICHEN (V.O.)
My name is Chu Beichen, and I have lived August 8th exactly one thousand, three hundred and seventy-four times. I have died seventy-three ways. I have learned everything. I have lost everything. Today, I try something different.

CHU BEICHEN steps out of the car. A BODYGUARD drapes a coat over his shoulders. He hands a single, perfectly folded bill to one MAID—the same one who always cries when no one watches.

CHU BEICHEN (V.O.)
The loop resets at midnight. Memories stay. Knowledge stays. The burden stays. But today, the pattern cracks.

CHU BEICHEN walks toward the hotel, not looking back as the MAIDS bow in unison.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

CHU BEICHEN exits the elevator, walking with measured steps that betray a thousand years of repetition. He removes his coat and shirt, each gesture precise, exhausted.

CHU BEICHEN (V.O.)
She arrives in four minutes. She always does. What she does next... that will be new.

INT. INDOOR POOL - DAY

CHU BEICHEN sits alone at the pool's edge, watching the water ripple. Several BIKINI-CLAD WOMEN keep their distance, sensing his isolation.

LIN XUEYING enters in a white silk shirt, black pencil skirt, and frameless glasses. She stands at the pool's edge, her reflection trembling on the water.

LIN XUEYING
The young master has been waiting.

CHU BEICHEN
(three heartbeats of silence)
Your perfume is wrong. He prefers vanilla on you. For me, you wear nothing.

LIN XUEYING's composure flickers—a tremor in her fingers.

LIN XUEYING
Chu Tianyou sent me to ask if you're still... incapable.

CHU BEICHEN
You came to take photos. To capture my humiliation. To prove I haven't changed.

He turns to her, water dripping from his fingers.

CHU BEICHEN
But I have. And so have you, Lin Xueying.

LIN XUEYING
(crouching, voice lowered)
I am your brother's property. He owns my sister's medical bills. He owns my future.

CHU BEICHEN
And yet your hands are shaking.

He meets her gaze. The water between them goes still.

CHU BEICHEN
Take the picture. Or take something real.

He doesn't touch her. The choice hangs in the humid air.

LIN XUEYING
(whisper)
I cannot afford real.

She pulls him into the pool.

The splash echoes. LIN XUEYING surfaces, gasping, her glasses gone. CHU BEICHEN holds her at arm's length, studying her face as if seeing a ghost.

LIN XUEYING
What are you waiting for?

CHU BEICHEN
Proof that this time matters.

INT. POOLSIDE LOUNGE AREA - DAY

LIN XUEYING sits wrapped in a towel, her hair still dripping. She watches CHU BEICHEN approach, a lipstick camera resting on the glass table between them.

LIN XUEYING
Why didn't you stop me?

CHU BEICHEN
Because you hesitated.

LIN XUEYING
For three seconds. That's all.

CHU BEICHEN
In a thousand years, three seconds is everything.

He picks up the camera, ejects the memory card, and places it in her palm.

CHU BEICHEN
Give him what he wants. Or give him what he fears.

LIN XUEYING
(turning the card over)
What does he fear?

CHU BEICHEN
That I'll become someone worth following.

He walks away. LIN XUEYING stares at the card, then at his retreating back. The card feels warm.

A white flash of light.

title: My Delivery is Not Simple
description: A young delivery man takes a mysterious job from an old woman, only to discover his customer is something beyond the living world.
context:
Title: My Delivery is Not Simple
Description: A young delivery man takes a mysterious job from an old woman, only to discover his customer is something beyond the living world.

INT. ZHONG PO'S SHOP - NIGHT

Incense smoke fills a cramped apothecary. ZHONG PO (70s) counts prayer beads.

ZHONG PO
The deliveries from my shop are not for ordinary people to handle.

LI XINGYONG (20s), in a worn delivery uniform, checks his phone. An overdraft notice glows.

ZHONG PO
Young man. Are you present?

LI XINGYONG
(startled)
Sorry. What?

ZHONG PO
Can you handle the unusual?

LI XINGYONG
(exhales)
I'm three months behind on rent. Unusual is fine, so long as it pays cash.

ZHONG PO studies him. Slides a black package across the counter—wax paper, red thread.

ZHONG PO
Old dental clinic on Fushou Road. Half an hour. No later. Don't untie the thread. Don't look inside. Knock three times, then leave it at the threshold.

LI XINGYONG
Threshold. Got it.

He tucks the package into his bag.
continuation:
EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT

Rain slicks the cobblestones. LI XINGYONG rides his scooter through the darkness, the package secured. He checks his watch: 23:47.

EXT. OLD DENTAL CLINIC - NIGHT

A condemned stone building. LI XINGYONG consults the address. The red thread glimmers faintly.

He knocks three times. The sound echoes.

He waits.

Nothing.

He places the package at the threshold.

His phone BUZZES. He answers.

LI XINGYONG
(into phone)
Zhong Po? I'm here.

A WITHERED HAND slides from beneath the door—translucent, rotting. It closes around the package.

LI XINGYONG
(into phone, voice tight)
Your customer...

The hand retreats, pulling the package inside. A muffled voice from within:

MUFFLED VOICE (O.S.)
Thank you... I was so hungry.

LI XINGYONG hangs up. Kneels. Peers through the keyhole.

Inside: darkness, a single candle, a black-and-white portrait of an elderly man.

LI XINGYONG
(whisper)
What did I just feed?

He touches his wallet in his pocket. Slowly stands. Looks back at the building.

The red thread lies on the threshold, untied.

FADE OUT.

title: Dragon Cauldron
description: A legendary general returns victorious from the Western Regions to rescue his wife, only to face political intrigue at the imperial court.
context:
Title: Dragon Cauldron
Description: A legendary general returns victorious from the Western Regions to rescue his wife, only to face political intrigue at the imperial court.

INT. BARBARIAN CAMP - NIGHT

A signal flare erupts above the barbarian camp, showering amber sparks. Scattered bonfires illuminate celebrating warriors.

The EMPRESS OF JINGJUE reclines on furs, toying with a dagger etched with Xia characters.

EMPRESS OF JINGJUE
Bring me the Xia general. Let her hear our songs of victory.

A BARBARIAN GENERAL on horseback rallies the crowd.

Soldiers drag MU QINGLUAN into the firelight. Her armor hangs in tatters, blood crusted at her temple. They drop her at the Empress's feet.

MU QINGLUAN
(struggling to rise)
Jingjue dogs... you'll never break the Xia border.

EMPRESS OF JINGJUE
(rising, smiling)
We already have. Tonight, we break your spirit.

The camp erupts. Warriors bang swords against shields.

BARBARIAN GENERAL
The Xia dragon is toothless! Let her blood feed our fires!

A flaming arrow pierces the central bonfire. Coals spray skyward. Silence.

EMPRESS OF JINGJUE
(shielding her face)
Archers! Formation--

A figure in scarred armor—LIN YANG—leaps from the darkness behind the Empress's couch, blade drawn.

LIN YANG
The Xia dragon still has fangs.

He cuts down the nearest guards in two fluid strokes.

MU QINGLUAN (V.O.)
Husband... I knew you'd come.

EMPRESS OF JINGJUE
(backing away)
Dingyuan? You left the capital undefended?
continuation:
LIN YANG
(reaching Mu Qingluan)
My wife is my capital.

He pulls her to her feet. She leans against him, trembling.

EMPRESS OF JINGJUE
(signals hidden archers)
A touching sentiment. Pity you brought no army.

Horns sound. Xia cavalry burst through the treeline, torches ablaze.

JIU FENG
(galloping forward)
My Lord! Elite vanguard in position. The main force encircles the valley.

LIN YANG
(cradling Mu Qingluan)
Take the Empress alive. Her ransom will rebuild our western forts.

JIU FENG
And the camp?

LIN YANG
Burn it. Let the ash warn the other thirty-five kingdoms.

EXT. GREAT XIA IMPERIAL PALACE ENTRANCE - DAY

Two weeks later. Morning mist clings to the palace steps.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Lord Dingyuan returns with the Empress as hostage, thirty-five treaties signed in blood, and a wife who refuses to leave his side—even in the capital's den of wolves.

LIN YANG, ceremonial mask covering the scar on his jaw, climbs the steps. JIU FENG follows, watching the shadows.

YUAN HONG
(approaching with open hands)
Lord Dingyuan. The King honors your victory with the Nine Cauldrons Banquet. A first in three dynasties.

LIN YANG
The King's generosity weighs heavily.

YUAN HONG
Your wife insisted on delivering this personally. She waits in the east chamber.

He produces a wax-sealed scroll. Lin Yang's fingers hesitate before breaking the seal. His knuckles whiten. The mask hides his expression, but his hand tremors slightly.

LIN YANG
(to Jiu Feng, voice low)
Double the guard on my wife's chambers. No one enters without my word.

title: The Husband's Betrayal
description: A woman disguises herself as a bunny girl waitress to catch evidence of her husband's affair with his returning first love at a KTV.
context:
Title: The Husband's Betrayal
Description: A woman disguises herself as a bunny girl waitress to catch evidence of her husband's affair with his returning first love at a KTV.

INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

SANG WANYI, dressed in a bunny girl waitress uniform and wearing a mask, walks through the neon-lit hallway carrying a tray of drinks.

SANG WANYI (V.O.)
Third club tonight. In this uniform, I'm invisible. That's the point.

SANG WANYI walks to a private room door and pushes it open.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

The room pulses with purple strobe lights. LU LINYUAN sits rigid on the sofa as SU ENYUE drapes herself across his shoulder. FEMALE FRIEND and FRIEND sway nearby.

SU ENYUE
(cooing)
Be honest. When you saw her at that gallery, did you think "close enough"? Or was it always about the insurance clause?

FRIEND
(slurred)
Man's gotta diversify.

FEMALE FRIEND
(to Sang Wanyi)
Refills.

SANG WANYI approaches, face angled from the light. She pours steadily.

SU ENYUE
(teasing)
Three rounds, Brother Linyuan. Truth or consequences?

LU LINYUAN
Consequences.

SU ENYUE
Then text her. "We need to talk about the prenup."

SANG WANYI (V.O.)
The prenup I signed while he held my hand.
continuation:
SANG WANYI's apron pocket buzzes. She doesn't react.

LU LINYUAN
(typing)
Done.

SU ENYUE
(pouting)
You're no fun. How about a real penalty? One photo.

SANG WANYI pivots, pretends to adjust a speaker, snaps a burst. The flash reflects off a mirrored wall—brief, disguised.

FRIEND
(squinting)
Did you—

SANG WANYI drops the tray. Glass shatters. She bolts.

FEMALE FRIEND
(yelling)
Get her!

INT. KTV RESTROOM - NIGHT

SANG WANYI locks herself in a stall, screenshooting the message: "We need to talk about the prenup."

INT. KTV MAIN HALL - NIGHT

SANG WANYI walks out from the restroom area. A hand catches her elbow. LU LINYUAN.

LU LINYUAN
(quietly)
Sloppy. For a lawyer.

SANG WANYI
(beat)
You saw.

LU LINYUAN
Reflection. In the champagne bucket.

SANG WANYI (V.O.)
Game over. Or just beginning?

title: Adorable Baby Hard to Coax, Mom Hard to Chase
description: Six years after a fateful night at a hotel, a woman and a man meet again at a chaotic matchmaking corner in a park, each with a child in tow.
context:
Title: Adorable Baby Hard to Coax, Mom Hard to Chase
Description: Six years after a fateful night at a hotel, a woman and a man meet again at a chaotic matchmaking corner in a park, each with a child in tow.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

A young man in a white shirt (GU ZEYAN) sprints down the corridor, two THUGS closing in. He tries each door—locked.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

LIN XIAO lies unconscious on the bed, her breathing shallow.

JIA MINGZHU and a MAN IN BLACK loom over her.

JIA MINGZHU (V.O.)
After tonight, she'll be ruined. And the Jia family empire will finally be mine.

They exit.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

Gu Zeyan ducks into room 808, just as a door slams shut behind him.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Dark. Gu Zeyan catches his breath, then notices Lin Xiao. He checks her pulse—steady—and covers her.

TRANSITION

TITLE CARD: Six Years Later
continuation:
EXT. PARK MATCHMAKING CORNER - DAY

Parents brandish signs like weapons in a battlefield of matrimony.

MAMA'S BOY'S MOTHER
(sign held high)
My son—stable job, owns his condo. Seeks family-oriented bride.

BROTHER-SUPPORTING DEMON
(to a prospect)
I support my younger brother. The dowry would need to cover his tuition.

MAMA'S BOY
(to a prospect)
My mom says you'd quit working. Her pension covers us both.

BROTHER-SUPPORTING DEMON
My parents will live with us. They'll need a six-figure dowry.

MAMA'S BOY'S MOTHER
(pointing at BROTHER-SUPPORTING DEMON)
You expect us to finance your family? Not a chance.

BROTHER-SUPPORTING DEMON
(to a prospect)
Your son would need to go. I won't be a stepmother.

MAMA'S BOY'S MOTHER / BROTHER-SUPPORTING DEMON
(in unison)
Understand?

LIN XIAO walks over with a LITTLE GIRL, overhearing MAMA'S BOY'S MOTHER.

LIN XIAO
(to MAMA'S BOY'S MOTHER)
You're not hiring a wife—you're hiring a servant.
(to MAMA'S BOY)
On a pension? Good luck with that.

GU ZEYAN walks over with a LITTLE BOY, hearing BROTHER-SUPPORTING DEMON.

GU ZEYAN
(to BROTHER-SUPPORTING DEMON)
If you're selling yourself, list the fine print.

BROTHER-SUPPORTING DEMON
You're raising another man's child and judging me?

MAMA'S BOY'S MOTHER
(furious, to Lin Xiao)
You lecture us? A mother with no wedding ring?

She lunges. Gu Zeyan blocks—the slap lands on his face.

SOUND EFFECT: A crisp slapping sound.

Silence. Gu Zeyan and Lin Xiao lock eyes. Six years melt away.

LIN XIAO
(whisper)
It was you.

GU ZEYAN
Room 808.

The children glance between them, confused.

title: Eight Desolations
description: A ten-thousand-year-old master faces his 998th tribulation, only to watch his disciples ascend to immortality while he remains behind, unable to ascend despite countless good deeds.
context:
Title: Eight Desolations
Description: A ten-thousand-year-old master faces his 998th tribulation, only to watch his disciples ascend to immortality while he remains behind, unable to ascend despite countless good deeds.

INT. GREAT HALL - NIGHT

Opening scene. In the center of the great hall, on an octagonal diagram, YE HUANG kneels on the ground, concentrating on playing Landlord on his phone. Around him, XIA RUSHUANG, CHANG TIANXING, LIE DAO, LIU ZHI, and HUO DOU (a black dog) each stand at one position, their expressions serious as they protect him during his tribulation.

MOBILE GAME SOUND EFFECT
Grab the Landlord!

YE HUANG
I'll grab it!

LIU ZHI
(sitting in a wheelchair, exhausted)
Master, please... can you at least pretend to take this seriously?

XIA RUSHUANG
(calmly)
What's the rush? Master has accumulated countless good deeds over ten thousand years. Nine hundred ninety-eight tribulations endured. He's survived more lightning than words you have complained.

CHANG TIANXING
Exactly. With the four of us...

HUO DOU
(barks indignantly)

CHANG TIANXING
(correcting himself)
Five, five of us. With five half-step immortals anchoring the formation, this mere lightning tribulation is nothing to worry about.

CHANG TIANXING
(looking up at the sky, puzzled)
Strange... the heavenly law is usually punctual. What delays the tribulation?

YE HUANG
(puts down his phone, sighs and stands up)
Sigh.

A strong wind blows, causing everyone to stagger. LIU ZHI's wheelchair rolls back slightly; LIE DAO steadies it with his foot.

YE HUANG
(shouting at the sky)
Taking forever just to send down some lightning. If you dare, strike me right now!

continuation:
EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

YE HUANG
(sneezes, smoke coming from his nostrils)
I!

Everyone rushes to surround him.

LIE DAO
Master! The formation held!

XIA RUSHUANG
Any injuries?

YE HUANG
(dismissively waving his hand, though his fingers tremble slightly)
Oh, just messing with you. A few lightning tribulations can't harm me. I just don't understand why I still haven't ascended.

CHANG TIANXING
(quietly)

YE HUANG
(nonchalantly)
Ah, no problem. I'll go down the mountain and resolve it.

CHANG TIANXING
Not so simple. These tribulations are intertwined with your own. Heaven's will is... cryptic.

YE HUANG
(taps CHANG TIANXING on the head)
Stop pretending!

XIA RUSHUANG
(laughing softly)
If you don't know, just say you don't know.

CHANG TIANXING
(waving from within the light beam, bewildered)
Master! The tribulation... it wasn't for you! It was for—

XIA RUSHUANG
(calling out as she ascends)
We'll wait at the gates!

The four are lifted by the light beams, slowly ascending and disappearing into the night sky.

YE HUANG
(dumbfounded, reaching out)
Hey! Another batch... When will it be my turn?

YE HUANG looks at HUO DOU beside him.

YE HUANG
Good Huo Dou, you're the best. You wouldn't—

As soon as he finishes speaking, another beam of light descends, covering HUO DOU. HUO DOU looks up at Ye Huang, tail wagging once, before ascending.

YE HUANG
(completely shocked, voice cracking)
Huo Dou! You too?!

The light beam disappears, leaving only YE HUANG alone.

YE HUANG
(first laughing maniacally, the sound hollow, then collapsing to his knees in despair, howling at the sky)
Ha ha ha! No way! Where is the justice of heaven!

title: Reborn as the Fake Heiress in a Group Favorite Story
description: A modern office worker dies from overwork and transmigrates into a novel as the tragic fake heiress who was killed by her adoptive family.
context:
Title: Reborn as the Fake Heiress in a Group Favorite Story
Description: A modern office worker dies from overwork and transmigrates into a novel as the tragic fake heiress who was killed by her adoptive family.

INT. LUXURIOUS MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

ZHOU NIAN (18, hollow-eyed) mops the marble floor in slow, labored strokes. Her knuckles are raw. The Zhou family sits on velvet sofas, orbiting ZHOU LINGSHAN (18, pristine) like she's fragile glass.

ZHOU FATHER
West wing. It's yours now.

ZHOU MOTHER
(to ZHOU LINGSHAN)
Twenty-four hours ago, I thought I'd lost you forever. Now you're home, where you always belonged.

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(quietly)
It's a lot to take in.

ZHOU MOTHER's gaze shifts to ZHOU NIAN, still mopping. Her voice cools.

ZHOU MOTHER
(to ZHOU NIAN)
Dinner. Six-thirty. Red-braised pork—the recipe book.

ZHOU NIAN
(stopping, voice hoarse)
The doctor said I need rest. After the fever—

ZHOU MOTHER
(standing)
Excuses. That's all you've ever given us.

She crosses to Zhou Nian, heels clicking on wet marble. In one motion, she yanks the mop from Zhou Nian's hands.

ZHOU MOTHER
This is what you are. A tool. Tools don't complain.

She swings the handle. It cracks across Zhou Nian's shoulder—not a slap, a strike that staggers her.

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(standing, dismayed)
Mother, she's still recovering.

ZHOU MOTHER
(never taking eyes off Zhou Nian)
She's been recovering for eighteen years. Go.

ZHOU FATHER
(from sofa, not looking up)
The pork, Nian. Don't be late.

ZHOU NIAN clutches her shoulder, swallows blood from a bitten lip, and walks toward the kitchen.
continuation:
INT. KITCHEN - DAY

ZHOU NIAN chops scallions. Each impact of the knife jars her bruised shoulder. She coughs—wet, deep.

ZHOU LINGSHAN enters, pouring a glass of water. Offers it.

ZHOU LINGSHAN
You look awful. Should you be cooking?

ZHOU NIAN
(not taking it)
I'm fine.

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(sets glass down, voice gentle)
They worry when you withdraw. It makes them... defensive.

ZHOU NIAN
(looks up, eyes sharp)
Is that what you call it?

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(leaning close, whisper)
I call it survival. But here's the thing—some of us are born to survive. Others are born to belong. They're not the same.

She places a hand on Zhou Nian's chopping hand. Zhou Nian jerks away. The knife clatters. Zhou LingShan stumbles back—genuine, not theatrical—catching herself on the counter.

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(gasping)
I was only trying to help—

ZHOU MOTHER bursts in, sees: knife on floor, Zhou LingShan off-balance, Zhou Nian frozen.

ZHOU MOTHER
(to Zhou Nian, voice low)
What did you do?

ZHOU NIAN
Nothing, I—

ZHOU MOTHER lunges. Not a push—a collision of fury. Zhou Nian's head cracks against marble. She slides down, leaving a smear of red.

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(rushing over)
Her breathing—it's shallow—

ZHOU FATHER appears in doorway, phone in hand.

ZHOU FATHER
The driver is here. We're late for the Chen gala.

ZHOU MOTHER
(steeling herself)
She's faking. Always desperate for attention.

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(fingers at Zhou Nian's neck)
No pulse. Mother, there's no pulse.

Silence. The three exchange glances—panic, calculation, fear.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

MODERN ZHOU NIAN (25, sharp suit, sharper eyes) scrolls through a web novel on her monitor. The office is dark except for her desk lamp and deadline emails.

MODERN ZHOU NIAN
(whispering as she reads)
"Zhou Nian's death was swift, forgotten by Chapter 3. Her real family—the Lu dynasty—never knew she existed." Idiot protagonist. I'd have burned their world down by page two.

Her phone BUZZES. Message: "URGENT: Q3 Report. Boardroom. 7am." It's 2:47 AM.

MODERN ZHOU NIAN
(to herself)
Rich girls fight for inheritance. Corporate slaves fight to breathe. Different battles, same rule: don't die.

She laughs, wincing. Presses a hand to her chest. The laughter dies. Her breath hitches. The monitor blurs. She reaches for water, knocks it over. Liquid spreads toward the novel's text on screen.

The screen flickers. Flares white-hot, consuming her reflection.

EXT. STREET - DAY

A quiet side street. The Zhou family's sedan idles at the curb, trunk open. ZHOU FATHER and ZHOU MOTHER struggle with a rolled Persian rug—ZHOU NIAN's body inside.

ZHOU MOTHER
(hushed, frantic)
The river is twenty minutes. No traffic cameras on the service road—

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(watching, composed despite trembling hands)
She had a heart condition. On her school medical file. Very tragic.

ZHOU FATHER
(stopping, breathless)
She's... still warm.

ZHOU LINGSHAN
(quietly)
Then hurry. Before rigor makes the rug harder to move.

They lift. The rug's edge slips. As Zhou Mother adjusts—

The rug shifts. A hand slips out. Then eyes open—not weak, not confused. Clear. Calculating. Alive.

ZHOU NIAN stares at the three faces, sees the trunk, the street, the panic. A slow smile touches her lips.

ZHOU NIAN
(softly)
The dead have excellent hearing.

The family recoils. Zhou Nian sits up, blood caking her hair, but her spine is steel. She looks at her hands—work-roughened, young—then at the three people who thought to bury her.

ZHOU NIAN
Now. Which one of you wants to tell me about the Lu family?

title: Untitled Medical Drama
description: A woman gives birth to twins alone after being expelled from her family, facing tragedy and loss, only to return five years later transformed.
context:
Title: Untitled Medical Drama
Description: A woman gives birth to twins alone after being expelled from her family, facing tragedy and loss, only to return five years later transformed.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - NIGHT

MISS SU lies on the operating table, drenched in sweat.

FEMALE DOCTOR
(rapid-fire)
Twins in distress, severe hemorrhaging. We need consent for C-section.

MISS SU
(weakly)
No husband. Just... me.

She grips the pen, her signature barely legible.

FEMALE DOCTOR
(to staff)
Let's go. Page NICU.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

ZHOU SHUYAN leans over the sleeping woman.

ZHOU SHUYAN
Who are you?

WOMAN
(seductively)
Sleep... or go.
continuation:
INT. OPERATING ROOM - NIGHT

DR. WANG checks vitals as MISS SU fades.

DR. WANG
(to nurse)
Pressure's dropping. Hang another unit.

MISS SU
(whispering)
Two heartbeats... both mine...

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

DR. WANG holds a swaddled infant. MISS SU'S YOUNGER SISTER approaches.

DR. WANG
Your sister is in recovery. But the other twin—

MISS SU'S YOUNGER SISTER
(taking the baby)
I'll ensure this one wants for nothing. The Zhou family will be... grateful.

She walks away, already making a call.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

MISS SU jolts upright, clutching her empty abdomen.

MISS SU
(urgent)
Where—

DR. WANG enters with a baby, his expression grim.

DR. WANG
He's stable. But there are complications. He'll need specialized care.

MISS SU
(taking him)
I'll find his father. Get the best treatment.

DR. WANG
Your sister has the other child. She claims she's protecting the Zhou lineage.

Miss Su's face hardens. She looks down at her son.

MISS SU
(vowing)
We'll survive. And we'll take back what's ours.

TITLE CARD: FIVE YEARS LATER

EXT. STREET - DAY

SU SHAN rides a sleek motorcycle through traffic. She stops at a curb, removes her helmet. Her eyes are cold, determined. She touches a locket around her neck, then speeds off.

title: The Scandal Plan
description: Zhong Xing'an is a small-time actress working as a stunt double in the entertainment industry, dreaming of her big break while facing harassment from a sleazy producer.
context:
Title: The Scandal Plan
Description: Zhong Xing'an is a small-time actress working as a stunt double in the entertainment industry, dreaming of her big break while facing harassment from a sleazy producer.

INT. BAR/FILM SET - NIGHT

ZHONG XING'AN (V.O.)
My name is Zhong Xing'an. I'm a stunt double. Actresses get close-ups. I get bruises and producers who think "no" is just the opening offer.

ACTION
A bar set on a soundstage. Zhong Xing'an executes a flawless spin kick, sending a man in a black suit crashing into breakaway furniture. She barely pauses before dropping another attacker.

DIRECTOR (O.S.)
Cut! Cut!

ACTION
The DIRECTOR emerges from behind the monitor, clapping slowly. He's in his 50s with an oily smile.

DIRECTOR
Impressive improvisation. But my female lead doesn't fight back—she swoons. We should discuss your interpretation. Tonight. Over drinks.

ZHONG XING'AN
(flat smile)
I'll have my agent check my calendar.

DIRECTOR
(leaning in, slipping a key card into her pocket)
Don't bother. Smart girls make their own opportunities.

ACTION
Zhong Xing'an's jaw tightens. She pockets the card.
continuation:
INT. GU CORPORATION OFFICE - DAY

ACTION
A glass office tower. Young Master Gu reclines behind a mahogany desk, flicking a lighter. Zhong Xing'an enters, composed, tablet in hand.

YOUNG MASTER GU
The stunt girl who ghosted me. To what do I owe this honor?

ZHONG XING'AN
You offered a "private meeting" about the female lead. Here I am.

YOUNG MASTER GU
And the terms? Last time you mentioned principles.

ZHONG XING'AN
(smiling slightly)
I said I wouldn't bend for small money. For Gu Corporation's flagship production? I'm... flexible.

ACTION
Young Master Gu circles her, rests a hand on her hip.

YOUNG MASTER GU
What did you have in mind?

ZHONG XING'AN
(turning to face him)
First, I need to know—do you prefer it rough?

YOUNG MASTER GU
(delighted)
You read my mind.

ACTION
Zhong Xing'an's fingers trail up his chest—then shove him hard. She yanks his belt off in one motion.

YOUNG MASTER GU
(gasping)
What—

ZHONG XING'AN
(loudly, clearly)
THIS is for every "private meeting" you force on girls trying to work!

ACTION
She cracks the belt across his desk. He flinches. She advances.

YOUNG MASTER GU
(scrambling backward)
Security! SECURITY!

ACTION
She herds him toward the door.

ZHONG XING'AN
(raising voice)
Harassing actresses! Blacklisting those who say no! How many careers?

ACTION
The door opens—a handsome man in a black coat (GU SHIXING) stands in the corridor with several SECURITY GUARDS. Young Master Gu collapses behind him.

YOUNG MASTER GU
Brother! This psychopath assaulted me!

ACTION
Gu Shixing surveys: Zhong Xing'an holding the belt, breathing hard; his cowering brother; the tablet on the floor, camera light blinking.

GU SHIXING
(to Zhong Xing'an)
You've made your point. Creatively.

ACTION
He nods. The guards step aside. Zhong Xing'an locks eyes with Gu Shixing, then walks out, head high. Young Master Gu trembles.

FADE OUT.

She cracks the belt across his desk. He flinches. She advances.

YOUNG MASTER GU
(scrambling backward)
Security! SECURITY!

ACTION
She herds him toward the door.

ZHONG XING'AN
(raising voice)
Harassing actresses! Blacklisting those who say no! How many careers?

ACTION
The door opens—a handsome man in a black coat (GU SHIXING) stands in the corridor with several SECURITY GUARDS. Young Master Gu collapses behind him.

YOUNG MASTER GU
Brother! This psychopath assaulted me!

ACTION
Gu Shixing surveys: Zhong Xing'an holding the belt, breathing hard; his cowering brother; the tablet on the floor, camera light blinking.

GU SHIXING
(to Zhong Xing'an)
You've made your point. Creatively.

ACTION
He nods. The guards step aside. Zhong Xing'an locks eyes with Gu Shixing, then walks out, head high. Young Master Gu trembles.

FADE OUT.

title: Yan's Little Darling
description: A young woman returns to reclaim what was taken from her family, confronting the heir to the empire built on her family's ruin.
context:
Title: Yan's Little Darling
Description: A young woman returns to reclaim what was taken from her family, confronting the heir to the empire built on her family's ruin.

INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY

Three interviewers sit on one side: YAN WANGSHU, DING YAO, and another MALE INTERVIEWER. LIN CHI (WEN RAN) sits across from them.

LIN CHI
My name is Lin Chi. I'm here to interview for the designer assistant position.

DING YAO picks up Lin Chi's resume and glances at it with thinly veiled disdain.

DING YAO
(to Yan Wangshu)
Self-taught applicant. No university credentials.

LIN CHI
(confidently)
This year's Jewelry Star Design Competition gold medalist. The design drawings on your desk are qualification enough.

YAN WANGSHU picks up the design drawings and looks at Ding Yao with measured interest.

YAN WANGSHU
Ding Yao. You lost to this candidate.

YAN WANGSHU puts down the drawings and studies Lin Chi.

YAN WANGSHU
Tell me, why do you want to work at Yan's Jewelry as a designer assistant?

LIN CHI
(looking directly at him)
Because of you, Yan Wangshu.

YAN WANGSHU
You think just because you changed your name, I wouldn't find you?
continuation:
INT. WEN FAMILY MANSION - DAY (FLASHBACK - SIXTEEN YEARS AGO)

YOUNG YAN WANGSHU stands with his GRANDFATHER. YOUNG WEN RAN holds an exquisite filigree incense box.

YOUNG YAN WANGSHU
(pointing at the box)
Grandfather, I want this one.

GRANDFATHER
(proudly)
My grandson has good taste. This is the only filigree incense box of its kind in the world.
(to Wen Ran's father)
Wrap it for the young master.

WEN RAN'S FATHER tries to take the incense box from his daughter.

YOUNG WEN RAN
(clutching it tightly)
It's Mother's work! I won't give it up!

A SUBORDINATE rushes in, pale-faced.

SUBORDINATE
Master Wen! Old Master Wen... he's on the roof!

The incense box slips from Young Wen Ran's hands and falls to the floor with a deafening clang.

INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY

LIN CHI takes out a wooden box from her bag and places it on the table with deliberate care.

LIN CHI
Yan's Jewelry gave the filigree incense box as this year's competition grand prize.

She opens the box. The filigree glints under fluorescent lights.

LIN CHI
Why is the one I received a fake?

YAN WANGSHU
(seriously)
What makes you say it's fake?

Their eyes lock. Yan Wangshu's fingers drum the table, a calculated gesture.

LIN CHI
Mother's filigree had 1,847 joints. This has 1,846.

She traces a nearly invisible seam. Yan Wangshu's breathing stills.

YAN WANGSHU
The real one has been waiting.

He slides the assistant contract across the steel table. Lin Chi's hand trembles as she reaches for it.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: His Canary
description: A woman seeks revenge on the man responsible for her brother's death by becoming his kept mistress, while his true love returns from abroad.
context:
Title: His Canary
Description: A woman seeks revenge on the man responsible for her brother's death by becoming his kept mistress, while his true love returns from abroad.

INT. BEDROOM - DAWN

In a candlelit bedroom, LU LINFENG buttons a crisp black shirt, his silhouette stark against the pale morning light.

RUAN LVXIA stirs on the bed. She sits up slowly, watching his reflection in the dressing mirror.

RUAN LVXIA
Formal for this early.

LU LINFENG
Silent, he smooths his collar with exacting precision.

RUAN LVXIA rises and pads barefoot across the room. She reaches around him, adjusting the collar he just straightened. Her fingers linger a heartbeat too long.

LU LINFENG
Qingmeng lands at eight.

RUAN LVXIA's hands still. She meets his eyes in the mirror.

LU LINFENG
(turning, lifting her chin)
Regrets?

RUAN LVXIA
A ghost of a smile.
Should I?

He kisses her. It's deliberate, almost clinical.

LU LINFENG
(against her lips)
The house account is yours.

He turns. The door clicks shut. RUAN LVXIA touches her mouth, the gesture turning into a slow wipe. Her reflection hardens.

RUAN LVXIA (V.O.)
Lin Qingmeng. The name that started all this.

She doubles over, hand to her mouth, and hurries to the bathroom.

RUAN LVXIA (V.O.)
Soon, brother.

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
INT. BANQUET HALL - 10 YEARS AGO - NIGHT

A teenage RUAN LVXIA in a school uniform pushes through a gaudy, drunken crowd.

TEENAGE RUAN LVXIA
Brother? Yan? Excuse me—

She breaks through. Her brother YAN BAI lies at the bottom of the marble stairs, blood pooling beneath his head. A shattered champagne glass glitters beside him.

TEENAGE RUAN LVXIA
(screaming)
Brother!

She drops to her knees, cradling him. A shadow falls across them—LU LINFENG, barely twenty, supporting a swooning LIN QINGMENG. Her sequined dress is stained.

A BODYGUARD blocks the crowd.

BODYGUARD
(to Teenage RUAN LVXIA)
Your brother fell. Down the stairs. Accident. Understand?

He drops a thick envelope. Bills spill out, fluttering over Yan Bai's still chest like leaves.

TEENAGE RUAN LVXIA looks up through her tears. Young LU LINFENG meets her gaze for one second before turning away, LIN QINGMENG clutched to his chest.

TEENAGE RUAN LVXIA
(whispered)
Brother...

END FLASHBACK

INT. BATHROOM - PRESENT

RUAN LVXIA studies herself in the mirror. In the reflection, she opens a hidden drawer. Inside: a calendar with tomorrow's date circled in red, beside it a faded photo of Yan Bai.

RUAN LVXIA (V.O.)
Three hundred and sixty-four days.

She touches the photo.

RUAN LVXIA (V.O.)
The stairwell camera malfunctioned. Qingmeng's dress was burned. Lu Linfeng's alibi was airtight. But accidents don't pay hush money.

She lifts her gaze to her own reflection.

RUAN LVXIA
(softly, precisely)
Lu Linfeng. One year of accidents is enough.

She picks up a red pen and slashes an X through the circled date. The ink bleeds.

FADE TO BLACK

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Reborn After Being Kicked Out by My Daughter
description: A dying man filled with regret is given a second chance when he is reborn back to 1998, the day his gambling addiction began to destroy his family.
context:
Title: Reborn After Being Kicked Out by My Daughter
Description: A dying man filled with regret is given a second chance when he is reborn back to 1998, the day his gambling addiction began to destroy his family.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

XIA DONG (60s), frail beneath an oxygen mask, lies on the floor where he's been dumped from the hospital bed. IV tubes dangle from his arms, dripping onto the hardwood.

In the bed above him, ZHOU YING (50s) watches with dead eyes. BOSS HUANG (40s), sleek in designer suit, adjusts his cufflinks with a smirk.

BOSS HUANG
(whispering)
Your husband's still breathing down there. And you called me anyway.

ZHOU YING
(sweet poison)
Breathing isn't living. Not for years. Why let his pride suffer when I can have what I need?

She trails a finger down Boss Huang's chest.

BOSS HUANG
(low laugh)
Practical woman.

XIA DONG
(strangled wheeze)
Bitch... bitch...

XIA DONG (V.O.)
I let this serpent coil around my life. For what? For this?

Xia Dong convulses. Blood sprays the inside of his oxygen mask. His body goes limp.

BOSS HUANG
(alarmed)
Is he...?

ZHOU YING
(calmly)
Dead? Finally. No more bills. No more witnesses.

BOSS HUANG
The daughter--

ZHOU YING
--will sign whatever I give her. She hates him more than we do.
continuation:
EXT. VILLA LAWN - NIGHT

Xia Dong's body lies in the grass where it was dragged, IV ripped out. He stirs, consciousness flickering back.

Through blurred vision, he sees RUO RUO (30s) standing at a distance, arms crossed, face stone.

XIA DONG
(rasping)
Ruo Ruo... I'm sorry... your mother... please...

He coughs wetly.

RUO RUO
(quiet, brutal)
You want to lie beside Mom? You stole her morphine money. She died screaming, counting pills. One. At. A. Time.

She takes a step closer, her shadow falling over him.

RUO RUO
I was twelve. Three days without food. Mrs. Chen was cooking pork next door. I looked. You beat me until I couldn't stand. Remember?

XIA DONG
(trembling)
I remember... every... day...

RUO RUO
Then remember this: You're not my father. You're the man who killed my mother for poker chips.

She turns away. He reaches for her, fingers scraping dirt.

XIA DONG (V.O.)
One chance. That's all I need. Just one.

EXT. WILDERNESS - DAY

Xia Dong lies in a ditch off a dirt road, flies already gathering. A car engine fades in the distance.

Ruoruo stands above him, flanked by two MEN IN BLACK. She doesn't look at his face.

RUO RUO
No burial. No name on stone. You don't deserve to share her air.

She drops a shovel. It clatters beside him.

RUO RUO
The wolves can have what's left.

She walks away. The Men in Black follow. Xia Dong watches clouds drift overhead, each breath shallower.

XIA DONG (V.O.)
If I could take it back... every bet... every lie...

Wolf howls echo. Paws crunch on gravel. Two shadows lope into frame, circling.

CLOSE ON: Xia Dong's eyes. He doesn't blink.

INT. GAMBLING DEN - DAY

The stench of sweat and cheap cigarettes. A CROWD roars around a table.

GAMBLER
Big! Big! Big!

XIA DONG's eyes snap open. He's younger, stronger hands clenched on the table. The roar floods his ears.

He looks down. No tubes. No pain. Just sweat-soaked shirt and a fistful of crumpled bills.

XIA DONG (V.O.)
Dead. I was dead.

He stares at the faces around him: OLD LIU, fat and laughing; LI SANSHUI, toothless grin. He knows them. Knew them. Twenty-six years ago.

Xia Dong looks at his hands again. Young. Capable. The bet he hasn't placed yet. The future unwritten.

XIA DONG (V.O.)
Please... let this be real.

The dice rattle in the cup. The world holds its breath.

title: Mr. Huo's Sweet Little Wife
description: A woman married for three years to a powerful CEO she's never met finds herself drugged at a company party and fleeing into an elevator, where she crashes into her husband for the first time.
context:
Title: Mr. Huo's Sweet Little Wife
Description: A woman married for three years to a powerful CEO she's never met finds herself drugged at a company party and fleeing into an elevator, where she crashes into her husband for the first time.

EXT. ROAD - DAY

Several black luxury vehicles drive in formation down a city boulevard.

BODYGUARDS in tactical earpieces exit, forming a discrete perimeter.

LU BAI steps out and adjusts his cufflinks.

HUO SINIAN emerges from a Rolls-Royce, his presence drawing the air from the street.

The bodyguards snap to attention.

BODYGUARDS
(in unison)
Welcome back, President Huo.

INT. RECEPTION HALL - NIGHT

AI QIQI stands alone with a champagne flute, surrounded by laughter she isn't part of.

NEWS ALERT chimes across the room—phones lighting up in unison.

FEMALE GUEST A and FEMALE GUEST B exchange glances, screens glowing.

FEMALE GUEST A
Huo Sinian... after three years.

FEMALE GUEST B
They say his wife is... not presentable.

AI QIQI's fingers tighten on her glass.

AI QIQI (V.O.)
Three years. One signature. Zero memories.

She downs the champagne. A server immediately offers another.

MALE VOICE (V.O.)
Target's consuming the spiked glass.

AI QIQI blinks—her vision swimming. She touches her temple.

AI QIQI
(under her breath)
Not now.

She navigates through the crowd and slips up the spiral staircase.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR/ELEVATOR BANK - NIGHT

AI QIQI stumbles toward the elevators, her phone ringing. She glances at it—three missed calls from "Husband"—and hangs up.

PURSUER A and PURSUER B appear at the corridor's end.

AI QIQI looks back, shows a cunning smile.

AI QIQI
Hi.

She runs. The Pursuers chase.

HUO SINIAN stands before the elevator as the doors close.

AI QIQI lunges through the narrowing gap and crashes into his arms.

He catches her automatically, then releases her like flame.

HUO SINIAN
Get off.

He straightens his jacket, his eyes tracking her unsteady breathing—something almost like recognition flickers, then dies.

The elevator descends.

title: Flash Marriage to the CEO After Breakup
description: After discovering her fiancé's betrayal, Shu Wanrou impulsively agrees to a blind date that turns out to be Lu Boyan—the CEO who secretly remembers her as his childhood savior. Their flash marriage begins as a contract but reveals deeper connections.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage to the CEO After Breakup
Description: After discovering her fiancé's betrayal, Shu Wanrou impulsively agrees to a blind date that turns out to be Lu Boyan—the CEO who secretly remembers her as his childhood savior. Their flash marriage begins as a contract but reveals deeper connections.

INT. NEWS STUDIO - DAY

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
At the helm of Lu Corporation, CEO Lu Boyan has transformed a regional firm into a Wall Street phenomenon in just twelve months. But sources say the young billionaire remains notoriously private...

EXT. LU CORPORATION BUILDING - MORNING

A Rolls-Royce glides to a stop. LU BOYAN steps out, exhaustion in his eyes despite his immaculate suit.

SUBORDINATES
(in unison)
Good morning, CEO.

Lu Boyan barely nods.

INT. LU CORPORATION CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

The room falls silent as Lu Boyan enters. An ASSISTANT reaches for his coat; Lu Boyan waves him off.

EXECUTIVE
(carefully)
The board congratulates you on the Entrepreneur award. The East Suburb projections—

LU BOYAN
(interrupting)
I need results, not congratulations. By tomorrow, I want viable plans that don't rely on Dingyu's cooperation.

He glances at his watch—a faded, cheap thing.

LU BOYAN
Meeting adjourned.

INT. COMPANY CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

Lu Boyan walks briskly, ASSISTANT scrambling to keep pace.

ASSISTANT
CEO Lu, your 10 AM is at the Riverside Café. Dingyu's president will be there.

LU BOYAN
The girl. Any progress?

ASSISTANT
None match the bracelet description.

LU BOYAN
(stopping)
Expand the search. The star charm.

ASSISTANT
Sir, President Li mentioned bringing a personal acquaintance. A woman.

LU BOYAN
(disturbed)
I said no matchmaking.

ASSISTANT
Shall I cancel?

LU BOYAN
No. Business first.
continuation:
INT. CAFÉ - DAY

SHU WANROU sits by the window, a battered notebook open. She clutches a phone.

SHU WANROU
(into phone, controlled)
I saw the messages, Shen Zichu. The wedding's off.

SHEN ZICHU (O.S.)
Wanrou—

SHU WANROU

You're Lu Boyan?

You...

One year. Mutual benefit.

The bureau opens in an hour.
