title: Thorns in a New Marriage
description: A woman wakes up after a mysterious night, finds herself pregnant, and is accused of infidelity by her husband's family, only to discover the truth may be far more complex.
context:
Title: Thorns in a New Marriage
Description: A woman wakes up after a mysterious night, finds herself pregnant, and is accused of infidelity by her husband's family, only to discover the truth may be far more complex.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

A luxury suite. MISS XIA struggles to focus. A man's SILHOUETTE pours champagne. Her vision swims. She reaches for him.

MISS XIA
(weakly)
He Cong...

She collapses back onto silk sheets.

TRANSITION: Six weeks later

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

MISS XIA clutches an ultrasound photo, knuckles white. DR. CHEN watches her.

MISS XIA
(to herself)
This can't be real...

DR. CHEN
Six weeks. The heartbeat is strong.

The door opens. AUNT HE enters, eyes locked on the ultrasound.

AUNT HE
(to Dr. Chen)
Give us privacy.

DR. CHEN exits. MISS XIA stands, defensive.

MISS XIA
Mom—

AUNT HE snatches the ultrasound, her face hardening.

AUNT HE
(quietly seething)
My son builds his empire. You build a lie.

AUNT HE shoves MISS XIA hard. MISS XIA stumbles, catches herself on the desk.

AUNT HE
(angrily pointing at her)
Five weeks in Berlin. Yet here you are. Disgrace.

MISS XIA
(looking up, tearful)
continuation:
I don't even remember...

The door opens. HE MEIMEI enters, designer suit, venom smile.

HE MEIMEI
(coldly)
Convenient. Brother Cong remembers his vows. Every single one.

HE MEIMEI
(arms crossed, mocking)
Marrying into the He family was your miracle. Aunt He was your blessing. And you? You couldn't wait.

MISS XIA
(voice breaking)
Something's wrong. That night—

AUNT HE
(furious)
Enough! Guards will escort you out. Take nothing.

AUNT HE drags MISS XIA toward the door.

EXT. STREET - DAY

Rain falls. MISS XIA stands outside, phone to her ear. The call disconnects.

PHONE VOICE (V.O.)
The number you have dialed is unavailable.

MISS XIA lowers the phone, clutching her stomach.

MISS XIA (V.O.)
If it wasn't He Cong... then who?

A black Mercedes pulls up. The DRIVER holds an umbrella.

DRIVER
Miss Xia. Mr. Song is waiting.

MISS XIA
(warily)
I don't know any Mr. Song.

The door opens. MR. SONG (40, composed power) studies her.

MR. SONG
(with a slight smile)
Your child has answers.

MISS XIA stares, rainwater mixing with tears.

END SCENE

title: Dragon Suppressor
description: In 2043, a prison riot erupts as criminals attempt to free the infamous Evil Dragon General, but the new Dragon Lord arrives to restore order.
context:
Title: Dragon Suppressor
Description: In 2043, a prison riot erupts as criminals attempt to free the infamous Evil Dragon General, but the new Dragon Lord arrives to restore order.

INT. TIANHAI PRISON - DAY

ON SCREEN: July 1, 2043

The prison is in chaos, with inmates rioting. A muscular man (IRON HAMMER) in an orange prison uniform, wrapped in glowing chains, slams a guard through reinforced glass.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Tianhai Prison, 2043. The Evil Dragon General awaits trial. His followers will reduce Great Xia to ash to free him. The guards have one hope left.

The guards are beaten back. A uniformed officer crashes to the ground, clutching his radio.

GUARD
(shouting)
Dragon Lord, we need you NOW!

The inmates surge forward. Suddenly, a man in a high-ranking military uniform (DRAGON LORD) enters, leaning on a carved cane. His eyes survey the chaos with cold precision.

A white-haired woman wearing a metal mask (WITCH) stands among the inmates, watching him.

WITCH
I didn't expect the new Dragon Lord to be a cripple.

DRAGON LORD
(leaning on his cane)
You're not leaving this block alive.

WITCH
The old Dragon Lord died standing. You'll die crawling.
continuation:
WITCH turns to IRON HAMMER.

WITCH
Kill him. Become a legend.

IRON HAMMER
(laughing loudly)
Ha ha ha!

IRON HAMMER lifts a massive iron ball, aiming at the DRAGON LORD.

IRON HAMMER
One swing. One corpse.

IRON HAMMER throws the iron ball. The DRAGON LORD taps his cane—an energy shield appears, shattering the projectile. He taps again. A concussive wave slams IRON HAMMER into a wall, engulfing him in flames. WITCH and the inmates stare in shock.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

A woman in a black leather jacket (NANGONG LUOYUN) gets out of a car, holding documents marked "DIVORCE PAPERS—SHEN FENG."

NANGONG LUOYUN
(into phone)
Confirm the meeting. I want him gone by morning.

NANGONG LUOYUN looks at the papers, a contemptuous smile on her face.

NANGONG LUOYUN
Shen Feng. Three years, and you still can't even walk without that cane.

She walks toward the elevators, heels clicking against the concrete.

title: Apocalypse Equation 01
description: A woman runs for her life in a dark corridor as zombies hunt her down, while a narrator reveals the story of a global virus outbreak that transformed 80% of humanity into monsters—and the secret only she possesses.
context:
Title: Apocalypse Equation 01
Description: A woman runs for her life in a dark corridor as zombies hunt her down, while a narrator reveals the story of a global virus outbreak that transformed 80% of humanity into monsters—and the secret only she possesses.

INT. DARK CORRIDOR - NIGHT

The woman, DR. MIRA CHEN (30s, athletic, torn lab coat), sprints through a narrow, flickering corridor. She clutches a blood-stained research tablet to her chest, its screen cracked but still glowing with data.

The woman stops, pressing flat against a concrete wall. Her breathing is ragged. She glances at the tablet: a single file labeled "APOCALYPSE EQUATION—REVERSAL PROTOCOL."

A grotesque zombie drops from the ceiling, landing silently behind her. Its head rotates 180 degrees with a wet crack.

The woman spins, gasping, her back against the wall. She holds the tablet up like a shield.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
They said it was just the seasonal flu. By the time Patient Zero collapsed, Dr. Chen's algorithm had already predicted the exact mortality rate.

MONTAGE BEGINS:

- Time-lapse: Grand Central Station at rush hour becomes an abattoir in 47 seconds.
- Macro footage: The virus rewriting DNA in real-time, elegant and merciless.
- Mira's own lab footage—from 48 hours ago—showing her face as her model hits 80% infection rate.
- A news ticker: "SCIENTIST CLAIMS VIRUS IS 'SOLVABLE'" / "CHEN'S EQUATION UNDER FIRE" / "CONSPIRACY: DID SHE CREATE IT?"

NARRATOR (V.O.)
An unknown virus spread rapidly. Those infected mutated into monsters that attacked humans. Initially, everyone thought it could be quickly resolved, but within just 24 hours, this virus had already infected 80% of humanity worldwide.

- A global heat map, pulsing red. Each pulse matches the predictive model's timestamp exactly.
- More chaos: the infected scale buildings, their movements too coordinated to be random.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
People don't know how to end this disaster, nor does anyone know when it will end.

- Security footage: Mira deleting the original algorithm, her face determined. A final comment: "Only the author can unpublish the book."

NARRATOR (V.O.)
What they don't know is that the outbreak isn't the disease. It's the proof of concept.

MONTAGE ENDS.
continuation:
INT. DARK CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

The woman stumbles, her ankle twisting. She falls hard, the tablet skidding away.

The zombie crawls toward her on all fours, its movements jerky but deliberate.

The woman sits up, her palm cut, retreating backward. Her eyes lock on the tablet.

WOMAN
(voice cracking)
Stay back. The data... I can still fix this. I can fix all of this.

The zombie lunges. The woman grabs a broken pipe.

WOMAN
(screaming with fury)
I wrote your goddamn code!

She swings as we—

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Guardian Saint
description: In 2045, mutated sea beasts attack China's coast after nuclear contamination. The legendary warrior Guan Tiance returns from seclusion to protect his homeland and clear his father's name, but must confront the true cost of the power that could save them all.
context:
Title: Guardian Saint
Description: In 2045, mutated sea beasts attack China's coast after nuclear contamination. The legendary warrior Guan Tiance returns from seclusion to protect his homeland and clear his father's name, but must confront the true cost of the power that could save them all.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Classical rosewood furniture. A holographic screen flickers, showing aerial footage of devastation. Tea grows cold on the desk.

SUPER: October 16, 2045

On screen, mutated creatures tear through coastal defenses. Emergency alerts scroll.

NEWSCASTER (V.O.)
...third mutation event confirmed. These bioforms absorb and redirect energy weapons. The South China Sea coast is falling. Evacuation corridors collapsing...

JI YINGYING (50s, elegant, steel beneath silk) clutches a jade pendant, watching footage of soldiers dying. She taps a communicator, gets static. A sad, proud smile.

JI YINGYING
(whispering)
Don't be a hero, Tian. Just come home.

EXT. CITY ROOFTOP - DAY

A command spire. GENERAL JIU FENG (30s, scarred, dual swords) stands before three commanders: steady ZHUANG SHAN, fierce BING PO, and pragmatic MALE COMMANDER. Below, 360,000 troops hold energy pikes in a complex spiral formation—the Tiangang Array.

The BEAST KING (stories tall, chitinous plates pulsing with absorbed energy) roars. It's missing an eye—a fresh wound.

MALE COMMANDER
General, the array is holding, but it's learned. Every strike we land, it... remembers.

JIU FENG
It bleeds. We adapt faster. Zhuang Shan, signal the pivot. Po, harry its flank. We take the other eye.

Jiu Feng LEAPS. The formation channels energy through her blades as she carves a golden arc.

The Beast King SCREAMS, blinded. It staggers.

SOLDIER (O.S.)
The array works! It's vulnerable!

The creature's plates suddenly GLOW, redirecting the energy back outward in a shockwave. Troops fly backward. The formation shatters.

Zhuang Shan staggers up, armor cracked.

ZHUANG SHAN
It's using our own power against us...

The Beast King's wounds knit with sickening speed. It GROWS, towering larger, dorsal spines blazing blue-white. It inhales.

COMMUNICATOR VOICE (V.O.)
All units! Energy critical mass! Take cover!

JIU FENG
(shouting)
Disperse! NOW!

She hurls herself at the Beast King, trying to draw its fire. Too late.

The creature releases a cataclysmic energy wave. The explosion engulfs the army. Soldiers vaporize. The three commanders are hurled back, slamming into the spire, bleeding.

Jiu Feng crawls, one leg shattered, dragging her sword.

JIU FENG
(strangled)
The array... was our best. I'm sorry.

BING PO
(weakly)
We failed them...

MALE COMMANDER
(points skyward)
Movement! Something's breaking through the energy field!

In the sky, a meteor of black flame. GUAN TIANCE (late 20s, armor cracked, eyes hollow) descends on a blade wreathed in dark fire. He's not triumphant—he looks exhausted, haunted.

JIU FENG
(breathless)
continuation:
The Saint... but his seclusion was penance. If he uses that power again—

GUAN TIANCE
(hand outstretched)
Blade. Come.

His sword arrives. The Beast King locks onto him, sensing fresh power.

GUAN TIANCE
(to himself)
Father's name... or their lives. Can't have both.

He doesn't charge. He stands, sword planted, as the Beast King unleashes another energy wave—straight at him. He ABSORBS it. His armor cracks glow, burning his skin. He channels it back through the blade, but inverted, unstable.

GUAN TIANCE
(straining)
Jiu Feng! The weak point! Where you struck!

JIU FENG
The eye socket! But you'll burn out!

GUAN TIANCE
Already burning.

He LAUNCHES, a comet of inverted energy. The blade pierces the Beast King's blind socket. The creature's own power, reversed, unravels it from within. It collapses, disintegrating.

Guan Tiance falls, smashing into the rooftop. His flame dies. He doesn't move.

Bing Po stares, then rushes over.

BING PO
Gods... he didn't just kill it. He unmade it.

Jiu Feng crawls toward Guan Tiance's body.

JIU FENG
(dazed)
He traded his saint realm... for us.

VOICE (V.O.)
The Heavenly Decree arrives! Guan Tiance, receive the edict!

A golden scroll descends, hovering over Guan Tiance's unconscious form.

VOICE (V.O.)
Martial Saint Guan Tiance, your selfless act has preserved Great Xia. Rise as Guardian Saint of the Nation.

Guan Tiance's eyes snap open—but they're different now. Duller. The price is paid. He rises, swaying.

GUAN TIANCE
(voice rough)
I accept... the burden.

Jiu Feng and surviving soldiers kneel—fewer than before. Many gaps in their ranks.

JIU FENG
The Phoenix Battalion... what's left of us. We'll follow you south.

GUAN TIANCE
(shaking his head)
Not to fight. To rebuild. My father's name won't matter if there's no home left.

He summons his blade. The flame is weaker, sputtering. He steps onto it, unsteady.

GUAN TIANCE (V.O.)
Five years ago, I left my aunt Yingying to prove my father's innocence. Today I learned some truths cost more than others. Now I return... to see which truth she values more.

He flies toward the horizon, trailing smoke.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Ji Yingying's communicator finally lights up. A single message: "It's done. Coming home."

She closes her eyes, tears falling.

JI YINGYING
(to the empty room)
Welcome back, nephew. Welcome back.

The creature releases a cataclysmic energy wave. The explosion engulfs the army. Soldiers vaporize. The three commanders are hurled back, slamming into the spire, bleeding.

Jiu Feng crawls, one leg shattered, dragging her sword.

JIU FENG
(strangled)
The array... was our best. I'm sorry.

BING PO
(weakly)
We failed them...

MALE COMMANDER
(points skyward)
Movement! Something's breaking through the energy field!

In the sky, a meteor of black flame. GUAN TIANCE (late 20s, armor cracked, eyes hollow) descends on a blade wreathed in dark fire. He's not triumphant—he looks exhausted, haunted.

JIU FENG
(breathless)
The Saint... but his seclusion was penance. If he uses that power again—

GUAN TIANCE
(hand outstretched)
Blade. Come.

His sword arrives. The Beast King locks onto him, sensing fresh power.

GUAN TIANCE
(to himself)
Father's name... or their lives. Can't have both.

He doesn't charge. He stands, sword planted, as the Beast King unleashes another energy wave—straight at him. He ABSORBS it. His armor cracks glow, burning his skin. He channels it back through the blade, but inverted, unstable.

GUAN TIANCE
(straining)
Jiu Feng! The weak point! Where you struck!

JIU FENG
The eye socket! But you'll burn out!

GUAN TIANCE
Already burning.

He LAUNCHES, a comet of inverted energy. The blade pierces the Beast King's blind socket. The creature's own power, reversed, unravels it from within. It collapses, disintegrating.

Guan Tiance falls, smashing into the rooftop. His flame dies. He doesn't move.

Bing Po stares, then rushes over.

BING PO
Gods... he didn't just kill it. He unmade it.

Jiu Feng crawls toward Guan Tiance's body.

JIU FENG
(dazed)
He traded his saint realm... for us.

VOICE (V.O.)
The Heavenly Decree arrives! Guan Tiance, receive the edict!

A golden scroll descends, hovering over Guan Tiance's unconscious form.

VOICE (V.O.)
Martial Saint Guan Tiance, your selfless act has preserved Great Xia. Rise as Guardian Saint of the Nation.

Guan Tiance's eyes snap open—but they're different now. Duller. The price is paid. He rises, swaying.

GUAN TIANCE
(voice rough)
I accept... the burden.

Jiu Feng and surviving soldiers kneel—fewer than before. Many gaps in their ranks.

JIU FENG
The Phoenix Battalion... what's left of us. We'll follow you south.

GUAN TIANCE
(shaking his head)
Not to fight. To rebuild. My father's name won't matter if there's no home left.

He summons his blade. The flame is weaker, sputtering. He steps onto it, unsteady.

GUAN TIANCE (V.O.)
Five years ago, I left my aunt Yingying to prove my father's innocence. Today I learned some truths cost more than others. Now I return... to see which truth she values more.

He flies toward the horizon, trailing smoke.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Ji Yingying's communicator finally lights up. A single message: "It's done. Coming home."

She closes her eyes, tears falling.

JI YINGYING
(to the empty room)
Welcome back, nephew. Welcome back.

title: Mr. Cheng, Long Time No See
description: A young man introduces his fiancée to his family, unaware that she shares a mysterious past with his older brother.
context:
Title: Mr. Cheng, Long Time No See
Description: A young man introduces his fiancée to his family, unaware that she shares a mysterious past with his older brother.

INT. CHENG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHENG JUN'AN, JIANG YAN, and CHENG JUN'AN's PARENTS sit in silence. The tea between them has gone cold.

CHENG JUN'AN
Dad, Mom... Yanyan and I want to marry. Right after graduation.

CHENG HONGZHOU
You've made your decision, then.

CHENG JUN'AN
Yes.

JIANG YAN
(nodding)
Yes, sir.

MOTHER CHENG studies Jiang Yan's hands—clasped too tightly.

MOTHER CHENG
(to Jiang Yan)
You've had a difficult journey, child. We respect that.

CHENG JUN'AN
She'll have a family now. We'll have a family.

The door opens. CHENG JUNNIAN steps in, still in his overcoat.

CHENG JUNNIAN
Jun'an.

CHENG JUN'AN
(delighted)
Big Brother! You came.

CHENG JUN'AN embraces him. CHENG JUNNIAN's eyes find JIANG YAN over his brother's shoulder.

CHENG JUN'AN
continuation:
(to JIANG YAN)
Yanyan, this is my brother. Quick, say hello.

JIANG YAN
(standing)
Big Brother.

CHENG JUNNIAN
(very quiet)
...Jiang Yan.

CHENG JUN'AN
I told you about her, remember?

CHENG JUNNIAN doesn't answer. He simply stares, and something in his composure fractures for half a second.

EXT. CHENG FAMILY VILLA - DAY

CHENG JUNNIAN, CHENG JUN'AN, and JIANG YAN walk toward a black sedan.

CHENG JUN'AN
Brother, we can get back ourselves. Don't trouble yourself.

CHENG JUNNIAN
I'm heading that way.

CHENG JUNNIAN checks his pockets. Frowns.

CHENG JUNNIAN
My keys. Wait here.

CHENG JUN'AN
(to JIANG YAN)
I'll be right back.

CHENG JUN'AN jogs back inside. The gate clangs shut.

CHENG JUNNIAN turns to JIANG YAN. Winter air visible between them.

CHENG JUNNIAN
Tell me, Miss Jiang... was my brother part of your plan, or an accident?

title: Unexpected Assistant
description: Yu Sheng attends a job interview at Lu Jin's company, unaware that he is the man she tied up the night before. A confrontation with a rival leads to an unexpected turn of events.
context:
Title: Unexpected Assistant
Description: Yu Sheng attends a job interview at Lu Jin's company, unaware that he is the man she tied up the night before. A confrontation with a rival leads to an unexpected turn of events.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

LU JIN and a BODYGUARD stand in front of the elevator.

BODYGUARD
Young Master, the woman in the video can't be identified. I've already destroyed it. Won't you go back and explain to the Master?

LU JIN stands expressionless, lost in thought. The BODYGUARD glances nervously toward the elevator door, rubbing his wrist where faint rope marks are visible.

INT. ELEVATOR - DAY

The elevator door opens. YU SHENG rushes in.

YU SHENG
(out of breath)
Sorry, I'm in a hurry for an interview.

LU JIN
It's fine.

YU SHENG looks up and sees LU JIN. She freezes, blood draining from her face.

YU SHENG (thinking)
Lu Jin? That psychopath I left tied up in a hotel bathtub last night... Oh god, why did he have to be here? And sober?

FLASHBACK:

LU JIN, shirtless, is tied up in a bathtub, struggling. A half-empty bottle of whiskey sits nearby. YU SHENG's hands shake as she ties the last knot, her face streaked with tears and anger.

END FLASHBACK.

YU SHENG (thinking)
He doesn't remember. Thank god. Or... wait. That might be worse.

LU JIN
You know me?

YU SHENG (thinking)
Wait. Is that... confusion? Or is he testing me?

YU SHENG
(forcing a smile)
Who doesn't know the famous Young Master Lu?

LU JIN
(frowning)
Young Master?

The elevator shakes slightly. LU JIN's expression darkens, his knuckles white against the handrail.

YU SHENG (thinking)
Why is he staring at me like that? Like he's trying to see through me. Keep it together. He was drunk, you were masked. There's no way.

The elevator door opens. YU SHENG exits.
continuation:
INT. COMPANY HALLWAY - DAY

YU SHENG walks into the office area and is immediately stopped by SU QIANQIAN, examining her nails with a smug expression.

SU QIANQIAN
Oh my, if it isn't Miss Yu? The Yu family has such a huge corporation, and with your family bankrupt without any connections, you still have to lower yourself to come for an interview?

YU SHENG
You're wrong. I'm here to sell cemetery plots. Miss Su, we have a connection, so I'll give you a twenty percent discount.

SU QIANQIAN
Yu Sheng, I'm the CEO's assistant. One phone call from me and you won't be able to find a job anywhere.

LU JIN walks out of his office, his eyes immediately finding Yu Sheng.

LU JIN
Who said you're my assistant?

SU QIANQIAN
(immediately switching to a gentle tone)
Brother Lu Jin, Uncle Lu sent me to be your assistant. Didn't he tell you?

LU JIN
(walking up to SU QIANQIAN)
What a coincidence.

LU JIN turns and walks toward YU SHENG, studying her face intently.

LU JIN
I already have an assistant.

LU JIN points at the stunned YU SHENG.

LU JIN
It's her.

A flash of light. YU SHENG stands frozen in place.

title: Azure Dragon of the Northern Territory
description: The Dragon Kingdom's greatest warrior, disguised as a security guard, defends the northern border from invasion while his family faces persecution back home.
context:
Title: Azure Dragon of the Northern Territory
Description: The Dragon Kingdom's greatest warrior, disguised as a security guard, defends the northern border from invasion while his family faces persecution back home.

INT. NORTHERN TERRITORY BATTLEFIELD - DAY

Wind howls across a desolate borderland. Snow mixes with ash. THREE FOREIGN COMMANDERS survey the breached wall ahead.

The JAPANESE WARRIOR tests the air with his katana. Sparks flicker where the blade meets an invisible barrier.

A crunch of instant noodles echoes across the silence.

CHEN TAIYI (EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI), mid-thirties with tired eyes, sits on a supply crate in a worn security uniform. He slurps noodles from a metal cup, steam fogging his battered name tag.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
(casual, almost bored)
Border's closed. Come back with a visa.

SOUTHERN BARBARIAN WAR GOD
(eyes narrowing, to allies)
The barrier pattern... it's his work.

The JAPANESE WARRIOR laughs, but it rings hollow.

JAPANESE WARRIOR
A wage slave? This is the Dragon Kingdom's defense?

He draws the Ame-no-Murakumo-no-Tsurugi. The legendary blade gleams with dark energy.

JAPANESE WARRIOR
I'll send your corpse back in ramen containers.

He charges. Taiyi doesn't look up. He flicks his noodle lid—

CLANG. The cheap aluminum stops the divine katana cold.

Taiyi's two fingers tap the blade's flat side.

The JAPANESE WARRIOR rockets backward, skidding through snow and rock.

His sword embeds in ice, humming like a tuning fork.

JAPANESE WARRIOR
(struggling to rise)
This force... can't be...

SOUTHERN BARBARIAN WAR GOD
(reaching for his war hammer)
All formations! Surround—

A sword materializes in Taiyi's hand—not with flames, but with the quiet glow of dawn through temple windows.

JAPANESE WARRIOR
(voice cracking)
The Eastern Emperor Sword...

SOUTHERN BARBARIAN WAR GOD
The Butcher of Baijiang... disguised as a watchman?

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
(FINALLY looks up, sad smile)
Someone has to watch the night shift.

His uniform shimmers, dissolving into ancient battle-scarred armor.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYYI
(softly)
The Northern Territory remembers every name etched on its stones. Shall I add yours?

The three commanders attack as one. It's over in four moves.

Taiyi's sword sings. A wrist flick disarms. A pivot shatters the War God's hammer. A final strike—

The third commander—a WOMAN IN ONI MASK—drops, her mask splitting.

Blood drips from Taiyi's gauntlet. Not his own. He studies it.

ANOTHER WARRIOR (the Oni woman, revealed as young)
(gasping)
Your family... they're already...

CUT TO:
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

CHEN YONGSHENG (40s, Taiyi's brother) collapses over his desk. Papers scatter. A coffee mug shatters.

He claws at his throat, wheezing. His skin shows faint blue veins—poison's signature.

INT. NORTHERN TERRITORY BATTLEFIELD - DAY

Taiyi's head snaps up as if hearing a distant scream. He clutches his chest.

The Oni Woman laughs through blood.

ONI WOMAN
Sympathetic poison bond. While you fought us, our allies visited your brother.

SOUTHERN BARBARIAN WAR GOD
(coughing)
The Zhang family sends their regards.

The War God triggers a sigil on his chest. Dark energy pours out—suicide blast.

Taiyi doesn't dodge. He steps INTO it, absorbing the blast with his body.

The other two attackers are vaporized. Taiyi kneels, armor smoking, blood at his mouth.

ONI WOMAN
(her last breath)
You can't save them... if you're dead...

Taiyi's hand trembles. Golden energy flickers, unstable. He forces it down.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
(to himself, ragged)
Hold on, Yongsheng...

He plants his sword in the frozen earth. A golden dragon phantom rises—not with a roar, but a keening cry that shatters the remaining barrier.

Silence. Only wind.

A figure in a simple cloak—CHONGLOU—kneels at the crater's edge.

CHONGLOU
Commander. Your brother's stable. The Seven Kills sealed the poison.

Taiyi doesn't look up.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
The source?

CHONGLOU
Zhang Conglomerate. They took the house.

CUT TO:

INT. CHEN FAMILY ANCESTRAL HOME - DAY

CHEN WANRONG (70s, Taiyi's father) sits in a threadbare chair, holding a faded military commendation. LIU SHUFEN (60s, Taiyi's mother) stands between him and YOUNG MASTER ZHANG (30s, shark-smile suit).

YOUNG MASTER ZHANG
(inspecting the ceiling)
Your son's "service" is the only reason we offered compensation. Most eminent domain cases get nothing.

LIU SHUFEN
He holds the Northern Territory! You can't—

YOUNG MASTER ZHANG
(turns, smile vanishing)
He holds nothing. We checked. His command was transferred yesterday.

He drops a holo-pad. A news clip plays: "King of Northern Territory announces new leadership."

YOUNG MASTER ZHANG
Your hero son abdicated. You're squatters.

Wanrong's hand tightens on the commendation. His knuckles are white.

CHEN WANRONG
(quiet, but iron)
He saved 300,000 lives at Baijiang. How many have you saved?

YOUNG MASTER ZHANG
(softly)
I'm about to save Cloud City from blight. Starting with this shack.

He gestures. Two enforcers step forward.

BACK TO:

INT. NORTHERN TERRITORY BATTLEFIELD - DAY

Taiyi examines the broken Oni mask. Inside: a Zhang family crest.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
(quiet fury)
They used foreign invaders as a distraction. For a land grab.

CHONGLOU
Seven Kills is ready. One word, we erase the Zhangs.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
No.

He pulls the Northern Territory seal from his armor. The dragon sigil glows.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
This territory needs a king who can stay. I can't.

He places the seal in Chonglou's hands.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
You're King now. Orders: defend the border. And... investigate how the Zhangs knew I'd be distracted.

CHONGLOU
They had inside information?

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
(walking away)
Someone always does. I'll find them.

CHONGLOU
Where will you go?

Taiyi's armor fades back to the security uniform. He picks up his noodle cup from the snow.

EASTERN EMPEROR TAIYI
(over his shoulder)
To watch the day shift.

His silhouette flickers—there, not there. Gone.

SEVEN KILLS LEGION (O.S.)
(in unison, a whisper)
Hail the Azure Dragon.

FADE OUT.

title: My Secret Marriage: The CEO's White Moonlight
description: Lin Tang prepares to meet her husband of two years for the first time, but fate has other plans.
context:
Title: My Secret Marriage: The CEO's White Moonlight
Description: Lin Tang prepares to meet her husband of two years for the first time, but fate has other plans.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

LIN TANG, elegant in a tailored suit, hesitates before a hotel suite door, fingers hovering near the handle.

LIN TANG (V.O.)
Two years of signatures on paper. A marriage in name only. And tonight, we become strangers no more...

LIN TANG steels herself, smoothing her jacket.

LIN TANG (V.O.)
Just be professional. You're here for the merger meeting, not a fairy tale. But what if he hates me on sight?

The door suddenly swings open. Strong hands pull her inside.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

HUO BEICHENG, white shirt disheveled, grips LIN TANG's arm. His eyes are lucid but desperate.

LIN TANG
Mr. Huo—

HUO BEICHENG
Someone spiked my drink. I need help.

LIN TANG
Help?

Huo Beicheng
You're the doctor Su Zhenguo sent, aren't you?

Before Lin Tang can clarify, he stumbles forward. Instinctively, she catches him. Their eyes meet.

LIN TANG (V.O.)
He doesn't know. After all this time, he doesn't recognize his own wife.

She could push him away. Instead, she guides him toward the bed.

HUO BEICHENG
Stay. Please.

LIN TANG
You won't remember this tomorrow.

HUO BEICHENG
I'll remember you.

MONTAGE
- Lin Tang's fingers hesitantly brush his cheek
- The two embrace among scattered rose petals
- A single high heel falls silently from the bed
- Lin Tang's hand rests on his chest, a quiet choice
- Morning light filters through curtains
END MONTAGE
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LIN TANG wakes beside HUO BEICHENG. His face is peaceful in sleep. She watches him, emotions warring across her features.

Her phone BUZZES. Caller ID: "Dad - Su Zhenguo."

DAD (V.O.)
Tangtang. Home. Now.

LIN TANG
(panicked whisper)
What did you do?

She silences the call. Huo Beicheng stirs. Grabbing her clothes, she flees. A distinctive red-soled heel remains on the carpet. Huo Beicheng's eyes open slowly. He touches the empty space beside him, then notices the shoe.

HUO BEICHENG
(softly)
Who are you?

INT. HOTEL ROOM - LATER

HUO BEICHENG, immaculate in a black suit, holds the shoe. SECRETARY ZHAO waits with a tablet.

HUO BEICHENG
Find the owner. Discreetly.

SECRETARY ZHAO
The car's waiting. Your grandmother insists you collect Mrs. Huo from the Su residence today.

HUO BEICHENG
The life-saving grace from two years ago. I've honored the contract. She hasn't.

He turns the shoe over in his hands, thoughtful.

HUO BEICHENG
The one who saved me last night—she left this behind. And something else.

SECRETARY ZHAO
Sir?

Huo Beicheng
A sense of... recognition.

He pockets the shoe.

HUO BEICHENG
To the Su family. Let's meet my wife.

FADE OUT.

title: Mrs. Fu Stops Pretending
description: Xu Qingcheng confronts the lecherous Mr. Ye at a KTV to negotiate a debt, but when he assaults her, she fights back and escapes into the arms of Fu Jingting.
context:
Title: Mrs. Fu Stops Pretending
Description: Xu Qingcheng confronts the lecherous Mr. Ye at a KTV to negotiate a debt, but when he assaults her, she fights back and escapes into the arms of Fu Jingting.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Neon lights strobe. MR. YE, 50s, sleaze personified, lounges among giggling hostesses. The bass THUMPS through the walls.

The door swings open. XU QINGCHENG, late 20s, enters. Her posture is rigid, eyes like flint. She adjusts her cufflink with surgical precision—a tell, for those who know.

XU QINGCHENG
Mr. Ye. We need to discuss Shengshi's hundred-million debt.

MR. YE's grin curdles. He flicks two fingers—the women scatter, sensing violence.

MR. YE
The little negotiator. Drink first. Talk later.

He sloshes baijiu into a tumbler, the amber liquid slopping over his rings. Pushes it across the glass table.

XU QINGCHENG
(smiling coldly)
Fair terms.

She downs it. A beat. Her vision wavers—only for an instant, but he catches it. His trap springs.

MR. YE
Now... payment.

He lunges, grabbing her wrist. She lets him pull her close—then her elbow snaps up, shattering his nose.

XU QINGCHENG
I already paid.

She snatches the ashtray, cracks it against his temple as he stumbles. He crumples, howling.

XU QINGCHENG
(voice slurring slightly)
Interest.

Her heel drives into his groin. The room tilts. She clutches the wall, fighting the drug, and staggers out.
continuation:
INT. KTV CORRIDOR - NIGHT

XU QINGCHENG stumbles, using the wall as a crutch. Her breath comes ragged.

Behind her, MR. YE erupts, blood streaming, flanked by HENCHMEN.

MR. YE
(Ye a guttural scream)
Break her! Don't let—

At the corridor's far end, FU JINGTING appears. Late 30s, tailored suit, eyes scanning. His phone glows—her location, tracked.

MR. YE's goons barrel past him, blind with rage.

FU JINGTING
(quietly, into phone)
Too late. I've got her.

XU QINGCHENG careens around the corner—straight into his chest. In one fluid motion, he yanks her close, spins, pins her to the wall. His hand clamps over her mouth, not to silence, but to steady. His other hand brushes the hair from her face.

FU JINGTING
(whisper)
You're early, Mrs. Fu.

Her eyes—wide, furious, relieved—find his. The footsteps thunder past.

FADE OUT.

title: Untouchable Pain
description: A woman marries into the household of her family's murderer to exact revenge for a massacre that occurred twenty years ago.
context:
Title: Untouchable Pain
Description: A woman marries into the household of her family's murderer to exact revenge for a massacre that occurred twenty years ago.

INT. GU MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

FIFTH CONCUBINE XU YUE, in a white qipao, kneels to offer tea to FIRST WIFE CHEN RUQIN, who lounges on the sofa.

XU YUE
First Wife, please have some tea.

CHEN RUQIN accepts the cup, turning it in her hands without drinking.

CHEN RUQIN
They say you were an actress before. I can see it in every gesture.

XU YUE
(eyes downcast)
One learns to survive in this house.

INT. GU MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

ON SCREEN: TWENTY YEARS AGO

EXT. STREET - DAY

YOUNG CHEN RUQIN, gaunt and desperate, trails XU YUE'S MOTHER - a pregnant woman in scholar's robes.

CHEN RUQIN
Madam... please. I can serve.

XU YUE'S MOTHER studies her, then gestures for her to follow.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Blood spreads across silk sheets. Xu Yue's mother gasps, dying. YOUNG XU YUE (5) watches through a cracked wardrobe door as Chen Ruqin, blood-splattered, pries a jade bracelet from the woman's wrist.

CHEN RUQIN
(whispering)
You shouldn't have trusted me.

EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

Fire consumes the scholars' quarters. Chen Ruqin walks away, the bracelet catching moonlight.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. GU MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

Back in the present, Chen Ruqin touches her abdomen.

CHEN RUQIN
The other concubines... they asked too many questions.

XU YUE
What happened to them?

CHEN RUQIN
They forgot their place.

XU YUE straightens, her gaze sharpening.

XU YUE
Four wives before me. All vanished.

QUICK FLASHES: FIRST CONCUBINE, SECOND CONCUBINE, FOURTH CONCUBINE - beautiful faces frozen in terror, then fading to black.

XU YUE
This house remembers everything.

CHEN RUQIN
You speak of ghosts.

XU YUE
(smiling faintly)
Don't I serve one? A woman who became mistress by erasing those who trusted her.

XU YUE turns to leave. Chen Ruqin's eyes narrow, recognition dawning.

CHEN RUQIN
Wait.

Chen Ruqin stands, tea sloshing over her fingers.

CHEN RUQIN
What did you say your mother's name was?

XU YUE
(over her shoulder)
She died twenty years ago. But before she did, she taught me the danger of kindness.

CHEN RUQIN
(remembers, horrified)
The scholars' fire...

XU YUE
Yes.

XU YUE walks out. Chen Ruqin stands frozen, then violently smashes the teacup against the floor.

title: Emperor Shrouding the Heavens
description: A man at rock bottom is transported to a cultivation world where he must fight off a soul-stealing elder using the power of his beliefs.
context:
Title: Emperor Shrouding the Heavens
Description: A man at rock bottom is transported to a cultivation world where he must fight off a soul-stealing elder using the power of his beliefs.

EXT. CITY STAIRWAY - NIGHT

LU YU, 30s, disheveled in black clothes, trudges down outdoor steps. He stops at the bottom, pulling crumpled papers from his pocket: an EVICTION NOTICE and DIVORCE DECREE. He lets them flutter into the wind.

ON SCREEN: LU YU [THREE-NOTHINGS PERSON]

LU YU (V.O.)
Divorced two days ago. Fired yesterday. Evicted today. Thirty years old, less than a thousand yuan in savings, and nothing to show for it.

LU YU slumps against the railing, scrolling his phone. A motivational poster flashes across the screen: "PROSPERITY, DEMOCRACY, EQUALITY, FREEDOM." He sneers, swiping it away.

LU YU
(shouting)
I might as well just die!

CUT TO:

A bright moon in the night sky.

ON SCREEN: Host detected in state of despair

SYSTEM VOICE (V.O.)
Host detected in state of despair.

The phone screen flickers in LU YU's hand, magnetized to his palm.

ON SCREEN: Transmigration conditions met

SYSTEM VOICE (V.O.)
Transmigration conditions met.

ON SCREEN: Commencing transmigration now

SYSTEM VOICE (V.O.)
Commencing transmigration now.

A spinning energy vortex erupts from the phone screen, rapidly expanding to envelop LU YU. He SCREAMS as his body is sucked into the light and disappears. The phone drops onto the steps, the vortex on its screen vanishing.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT CAVE - DAY

LU YU wakes with a GASP on cold stone, now wearing period robes. He touches his long hair, shocked.

LU YU (V.O.)
Where is this?

He struggles to his feet, staring at his transformed body.

LU YU
I've transmigrated.

A BEAUTIFUL WOMAN in red silk materializes behind him, gently caressing his face. Her touch is ice-cold.

SNAKE DEMON BEAUTY
My lord. Come here. Come.

The SNAKE DEMON BEAUTY's image becomes blurred.

SNAKE DEMON BEAUTY (V.O.)
Come here.

LU YU looks down, seeing her feet floating above ground. He jerks his head up; her face has become grotesque, surrounded by green smoke.

LU YU (V.O.)
What kind of godly opening is this? Just transmigrated and already have a beauty throwing herself at me.

LU YU
(terrified)
Holy shit, what are you?!

LU YU scrambles backward. LV CHAO RAN, white-haired and imposing, appears in a flash. He flicks his fingers; the demon evaporates.

ON SCREEN: LV CHAO RAN [IMMORTAL UNITY REALM NINTH HEAVEN]

LV CHAO RAN
Fool. That phantom was the first test. You barely passed.

LV CHAO RAN thrusts his palm. A blue energy wave SLAMS into LU YU, knocking his soul loose. LU YU's body collapses; his translucent SOUL stumbles out, flickering.

LU YU (V.O.)
Soul separation? I'm in a cultivation world?

LU YU's soul flees in panic, but LV CHAO RAN's energy strikes it down. The soul crashes back into the body. LU YU's body sits up cross-legged, eyes closed. His soul re-enters. He opens his eyes to see LV CHAO RAN's translucent soul standing before him.

LV CHAO RAN (SOUL)
A Desolate Ancient Waste Body? Useless. But your youth... that I can claim.

LU YU (INNER MONOLOGUE)
I can't die. Not after getting a second chance.

LV CHAO RAN (SOUL)
Half an hour ago, you begged for death. Why resist now? Let this master avenge your grievances.

The soul phantom of LU YU's body's original owner appears beside him.

LU YU (SOUL PHANTOM)
I know transmigration comes with cheats, but you're one ugly old man. I don't want you.

LV CHAO RAN (SOUL)
Without powerful conviction, you cannot stop me from seizing your body.

LU YU (SOUL PHANTOM)
Powerful conviction?

LU YU (INNER MONOLOGUE)
The mantra... it was on my phone.

LU YU (SOUL PHANTOM)
Prosperity, democracy, equality, freedom!

Golden light flickers around him.

LV CHAO RAN (SOUL)
What incantation is this?

LU YU (SOUL PHANTOM)
Not an incantation. The Twenty-Four Character Mantra!

LV CHAO RAN (SOUL)
Never heard of it!

LU YU (SOUL PHANTOM)
Integrity! Kindness! All evil spirits and demons, begone!

LU YU's body erupts with powerful golden flames, forcing LV CHAO RAN's soul back. The scene freezes on him surrounded by flames, sitting in solemn meditation.

title: Peerless Xiao Clan
description: A construction worker named Xiao Fan warns a powerful CEO about a business deal, revealing hidden knowledge that hints at his mysterious past.
context:
Title: Peerless Xiao Clan
Description: A construction worker named Xiao Fan warns a powerful CEO about a business deal, revealing hidden knowledge that hints at his mysterious past.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

XIAO FAN (30s), calloused hands and weathered work clothes, wipes grease from a wrench. He glances at his phone—financial headlines scroll past. He pockets it, shaking his head.

A convoy of black SUVs tears onto the site, kicking up dust. BODYGUARDS fan out as XIA YOURAN (30s) emerges, sharp suit, sharper eyes. EXECUTIVES scurry behind her.

The machine beside Xiao Fan SPUTTERS. His CO-WORKER fumbles the controls—CRACK! A piston slams down, knocking Xiao Fan back.

CO-WORKER A
Shit! You okay?

CO-WORKER B
(staring at the motorcade)
That's Xia Youran. Tianyu Group's CEO.

XIAO FAN
(clutching his shoulder)
I know who she is.

CO-WORKER B
You? Man, you don't even use Instagram.

Xiao Fan looks at his oil-stained hands, then at Xia Youran—who's now twenty yards away, surrounded by her board.

XIA YOURAN
Block 3. Status?

MANAGER ZHANG
Longding's still in play.

MANAGER WANG
They've shadowed us on three bids this quarter. Always the bridesmaid.

XIA YOURAN
They want a fight?

MANAGER LI
Then we double down. Take Block 3 at any cost.

XIAO FAN
(quietly)
Longding...

XIA YOURAN
(icy)
Two days of meetings, and your strategy is 'copy Longding'?

MANAGER WANG
Their analytics are oracle-level. They don't make mistakes.

CO-WORKER B
(grabbing Xiao Fan's arm)
Don't even think about it. Those guys break people for sport.

Xiao Fan brushes him off. Walks straight to Xia Youran.

XIAO FAN
President Xia—walk away from Block 3.

XIA YOURAN
(turns)
Do I know you?

MANAGER ZHANG
(backing her up)
This is a private meeting.

MANAGER WANG
Step back. Now.

XIAO FAN
Longding's pulling out at three o'clock. Can Tianyu swallow a two-billion-dollar hole?

XIA YOURAN
continuation:
(frozen, searching his face)
No. It can't be...

MANAGER ZHANG
Based on what? Your gut?

XIAO FAN
Based on five years of watching them.

Xiao Fan turns. Retrieves his dented scooter helmet.

XIAO FAN
(over his shoulder)
We'll meet again, President Xia.

He kickstarts his scooter—the tiny engine WHINING against the purr of V8s.

MANAGER ZHANG
(mutters)
Delusional.

Her phone BUZZES. She answers. The blood drains from her face.

MANAGER ZHANG
(into phone)
Confirm that. Longding's entire stake?

She hangs up. Dead silence.

MANAGER WANG
They withdrew?

MALE SUBORDINATE
If we'd leveraged up... we'd be finished.

MANAGER LI
Bankrupt by dawn.

MANAGER ZHANG
(whispers)
He knew.

XIA YOURAN
(staring at the scooter's dust trail)
Not knew. Remembered. Find him.

EXT. STREET - EVENING

Xiao Fan's scooter putters to a stop. He checks his wallet—empty. A RED NOTICE peeks from his pocket: RENT OVERDUE.

His phone RINGS.

XIAO FAN
(into phone)
Mike. You still owe me for the Johnson job. I'm outside your place right now.

The line goes dead.

XIAO FAN
(sighs)
Great. Another ghost.

He pockets the phone. Headlights BLARE—three black SUVs box him in.

SONG QI'AN (40s) emerges, suit impeccable, eyes respectful.

SONG QI'AN
Dragon.

XIAO FAN
(quietly)
Five years, Qi'an. You were supposed to forget.

SONG QI'AN
The world didn't forget. They need you back.

title: Rescue Day: Daughter Refuses to Sign
description: A daughter confronts her dying father in the hospital, haunted by memories of his abuse that led to her mother's death twenty years ago.
context:
Title: Rescue Day: Daughter Refuses to Sign
Description: A daughter confronts her dying father in the hospital, haunted by memories of his abuse that led to her mother's death twenty years ago.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

A quiet, dimly lit corridor, only the echo of high heels clicking on the floor.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Miss Ye, your father is in critical condition. We need your signature.

LIN YIYI (V.O.)
Even someone like you has a day like this?

The camera pulls up to reveal a fashionably dressed woman, LIN YIYI, who stops in her tracks, her eyes cold as she looks ahead.

LIN YIYI
Do you still remember how you treated us, mother and daughter? Do you still remember how Mom died?

TRANSITION: A white flash, entering a flashback.

INT. HOME - DAY

ON SCREEN: Twenty years ago.

Little YIYI runs into the room holding a colorful pinwheel, happy and excited.

LITTLE YIYI
Daddy, look at my pinwheel!

Her father, YE FENG, lying on the bed looking irritated, snatches the pinwheel and throws it on the ground.

YE FENG
Get lost!

Little YIYI is frightened and starts crying.

YE FENG
(impatiently)
Always crying. Worthless girl.

YE FENG gets up and roughly grabs Little YIYI.

YE FENG
You're still crying! You jinx, you've cried away all my luck!

Mother SUN YUYU rushes in, kneeling down to protect Little YIYI.

SUN YUYU
Yiyi! Don't hit the child! If you want to hit someone, hit me!

YE FENG
(roaring)
Fine!

YE FENG unbuckles his belt and wildly whips SUN YUYU.

YE FENG
I'll teach you! Teach you both!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

LIN YIYI and the DOCTOR stand by the bed. YE FENG lies unconscious with an oxygen tube.

DOCTOR
Your father's organs are failing. We need your consent to continue life support.

LIN YIYI
Is that so?

LIN YIYI
(interrupting)
Then don't trouble yourself, Doctor.

LIN YIYI takes out a bundle of dried mugwort and a lighter from her designer bag.

LIN YIYI
In our hometown, there's a folk remedy.

She lights the mugwort. The doctor flinches.

DOCTOR
Miss Ye, you cannot—

LIN YIYI
Please. Let us have a moment.

The doctor hesitates, then exits. LIN YIYI sits, holding the smoking mugwort.

INT. HOME - DAY

In the flashback, YE FENG lights a bundle of mugwort, smoke swirling.

YE FENG
I asked around. You're just being dramatic. Fumigate it and you'll be fine.

SUN YUYU lies in bed, seriously ill, coughing continuously. YE FENG waves the smoking mugwort around in front of her.

YE FENG
See, aren't you better now? You still have some money at home, right? I saw you hide it.

YE FENG lifts the pillow and takes the money hidden underneath. SUN YUYU weakly tries to stop him.

SUN YUYU
You can't... it's for Yiyi's school...

YE FENG
(pushing her away)
Get away from me! When I win at gambling, I'll bring it back tenfold.

YE FENG turns and leaves with the money.

INT. HOME - NIGHT

YE FENG returns home with a bruised and swollen face, horrified to find SUN YUYU collapsed on the ground, no longer breathing. Little YIYI cries heart-wrenchingly beside her.

YE FENG is so frightened by the scene that he collapses to the ground.

YE FENG
Yuyu... no...

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Back to reality, LIN YIYI holds the smoking mugwort, slowly approaching YE FENG on the bed.

LIN YIYI (V.O.)
This is the method you used to kill my mother. Now you're getting what you deserve.

LIN YIYI sits by the bed, tears welling up in her eyes.

LIN YIYI
You took everything from us. What right do you have to live?

YE FENG on the bed sheds a tear, his lips moving slightly.

YE FENG
(weakly)
Yiyi... forgive me... I was... a fool...

YE FENG finishes speaking, slowly closes his eyes, and stops breathing.

LIN YIYI watches for a long moment, then extinguishes the mugwort. She stands, smooths her dress, and walks out without a backward glance.

title: The General Takes a Job (The War Goddess Plays Unfair)
description: A legendary female general is betrayed and killed, only to be reborn in the modern world where she must face her ancient enemies in new forms.
context:
Title: The General Takes a Job (The War Goddess Plays Unfair)
Description: A legendary female general is betrayed and killed, only to be reborn in the modern world where she must face her ancient enemies in new forms.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

SHEN QINGHE, battle-scarred armor glinting, cuts through enemy soldiers with economical precision. An arrow thuds into her back from behind. She stumbles, sword digging into the stone to keep her upright.

QING'ER
Qinghe!

QING'ER, in crimson wedding silks, clutches an arrow in her chest. Blood spreads like a flower. She collapses.

Soldiers close in, swords forming a cage around SHEN QINGHE. She grits her teeth, forcing herself to stand.

SHEN QINGHE
(breathing ragged, eyes burning)
I am Shen Qinghe. Daughter of the Shen family. The War Goddess who carved borders for Wei. My marriage was decreed by the Emperor himself.

LIN WAN emerges from the shadows, silk robes whispering. EUNUCH ZHANG trails behind, his face a mask of gloating.

LIN WAN
Sister. Still clinging to titles?

SHEN QINGHE
(eyes widening)
Lin Wan. You were family.

LIN WAN
(smiling coldly)
Family? The Shen family conspired with foreign powers while you were at the border. Treason. They were exiled yesterday. You were declared dead tomorrow.

SHEN QINGHE
(trembling)
Lies. My family bled for Wei. We built this empire.

LIN WAN
The Emperor believes otherwise.

A scroll lands at SHEN QINGHE's feet. She doesn't look at it.

SHEN QINGHE
(whispered fury)
You repay our protection with poison. I should have let your house fall.

She lunges. Her legs give way. Blood spatters the stone.

EUNUCH ZHANG
(mocking bow)
General. Always so dramatic.
continuation:
SHEN QINGHE
(laughing bitterly)
Zhang. I remember you groveling at my father's feet. Fetching his wine.

LIN WAN
(leaning close, voice honeyed)
Your achievements eclipsed the throne. This is the price of glory.

SHEN QINGHE
(fingers clawing at stone)
Where is Jiang Yao?

LIN WAN
(softly)
The Regent Prince? He traded his armies for your freedom. The Emperor accepted... then ordered his execution. He died at sunrise.

SHEN QINGHE
(hand flying to her chest)
No.

Her fingers close around a small wooden horse. She stares at it.

SHEN QINGHE (V.O.)
(whispered)
Jiang Yao. I kept my promise. I came back.

Snow begins to fall. The wooden horse slips from her fingers. Her eyes close.

INT. MODERN BEDROOM - DAY

SHEN QINGHE's eyes snap open. Silk sheets. A ceiling fan. The smell of cheap perfume and debt.

SHEN QINGHE (V.O.)
This is not the afterlife.

Footsteps approach. CHAIRMAN ZHANG appears in the doorway, his belt already loosening. Same predatory smile, now in a tailored suit.

CHAIRMAN ZHANG
Xiao He. You're awake.

SHEN QINGHE
(frozen)
Zhang.

CHAIRMAN ZHANG
(stepping closer, voice slimy)
Your father signed the contract. You're mine until the debt's cleared. Be a good girl.

He reaches for her. She sees the wooden horse on the nightstand, just out of reach.

title: Double Identity
description: A man is mistaken for a robbery suspect on his birthday night when he tries to help a woman being attacked by someone who looks just like him.
context:
Title: Double Identity
Description: A man is mistaken for a robbery suspect on his birthday night when he tries to help a woman being attacked by someone who looks just like him.

INT. HALLWAY/GU ZE'S HOME - NIGHT

A man's silhouette moves with mechanical precision—straightening his shoes by the door before entering. The television drones in the background.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Police seek a man in connection with three daylight robberies. Suspect is approximately thirty, last seen wearing a dark jacket and cap. Citizens are advised not to approach.

GU ZE (30s, meticulous) steps inside, hanging his coat at a perfect ninety-degree angle. He places a wrapped gift on the table—accounting for his mother, as always.

Suddenly, the lights BLINK on.

XIAO FANG comes out carrying a birthday cake with lit candles. GU ZE'S PARENTS follow behind her, smiling.

XIAO FANG
Surprise! Happy birthday!

GU ZE'S FATHER
Thirty years of playing it safe. Maybe this is the year you finally—

GU ZE'S MOTHER
(fondly interrupting)
Let him enjoy his cake, dear.

GU ZE
(smiling tightly)
One year older. Same me.

The lights FLICKER violently, then die. Emergency EXIT lights cast a red glow.

GU ZE'S MOTHER
Not again. Third time this month.

GU ZE
Probably the junction box. I'll reset it.

XIAO FANG
Be careful.

GU ZE'S FATHER
Sometimes you have to get your hands dirty, son.

Gu Ze hesitates, then grabs a flashlight.

EXT. STAIRWELL - NIGHT

Gu Ze sweeps his flashlight across the circuit panel. Nothing.

Footsteps echo from above. TIAN E (late 20s, disheveled) freezes on the landing, clutching the railing. Her face drains of color.

She stumbles backward, speechless, her free hand protectively over her stomach.

Gu Ze follows her gaze to the window—his own reflection stares back, fractured by wire mesh.

He turns. CHEN LIE (30s, Gu Ze's face but unshaven, eyes wild) descends, cap pulled low.

Gu Ze's flashlight beam catches Chen Lie's profile—mirror image.
continuation:
EXT. GROUND FLOOR AREA - NIGHT

Tian E intercepts Chen Lie near the exit, her voice a raw whisper.

TIAN E
The rent money. That's all I have left.

CHEN LIE
I'll quadruple it. One more game.

TIAN E
(shoving an envelope)
Take it. Then you'll be a father.

Chen Lie's hand trembles as he pulls out the ultrasound photo. For a moment, his face crumples.

CHEN LIE
(quietly)
I could be different.

TIAN E
Then stop—

CHEN LIE
(throwing it back)
I don't know how!

He shoves her. She falls, the envelope scattering cash. He snatches it.

Gu Ze appears at the stairwell door, his father's words ringing in his ears.

GU ZE
Hey!

Chen Lie spins. Gu Ze drops his flashlight—it rolls, illuminating both their faces side by side.

Tian E gasps. Chen Lie bolts.

Gu Ze lunges, tackling him. The envelope rips, bills fluttering. Chen Lie scrambles free, leaving the bag behind.

SIRENS wail. Tian E grabs Chen Lie's ankle.

TIAN E
(despairing)
They're coming!

Chen Lie kicks free and sprints into the night.

Gu Ze stands, breathing hard, holding the bag. He turns to help Tian E.

UNCLE ZHOU leads a group of neighbors rushing down the stairs, their phone lights creating a blinding glare. They see Gu Ze holding the bag, Tian E on the ground, and the scattered cash.

UNCLE ZHOU
(seizing Gu Ze)
Got you! We saw the alert!

GU ZE
Uncle Zhou, no—I'm me!

XIAO FANG and GU ZE'S PARENTS run out. Xiao Fang rushes to Tian E.

Tian E points, trembling, between Gu Ze and the direction Chen Lie fled.

TIAN E
(barely audible)
Two of them... same face...

Uncle Zhou's grip loosens. He looks at Gu Ze—really looks—then at the stairwell where Chen Lie disappeared.

GU ZE
(to Uncle Zhou, calmly)
Call them. I'll wait.

Gu Ze meets his father's eyes across the courtyard. His father nods, understanding.

Xiao Fang helps Tian E to her feet, picking up the ultrasound photo from the ground.

XIAO FANG
(softly)
It's his birthday today.

Tian E looks at Gu Ze, at the cake his mother still holds, at the chaos.

TIAN E
(to Gu Ze)
I'm sorry.

GU ZE
(quietly)
Don't be. Just... when they catch him—

He hands her the torn envelope, cash spilling out.

GU ZE (CONT'D)
—make sure he sees that photo again.

Police lights paint the walls red. Gu Ze doesn't resist as Uncle Zhou guides him to the steps. He sits, waiting.

His mother brings the cake over, setting it beside him. The candles have melted into a puddle of wax.

GU ZE'S MOTHER
(handing him the ruined cake)
Still your birthday.

Gu Ze looks at the candles—then blows them out anyway.

FADE OUT.

EXT. GROUND FLOOR AREA - NIGHT

Tian E intercepts Chen Lie near the exit, her voice a raw whisper.

TIAN E
The rent money. That's all I have left.

CHEN LIE
I'll quadruple it. One more game.

TIAN E
(shoving an envelope)
Take it. Then you'll be a father.

Chen Lie's hand trembles as he pulls out the ultrasound photo. For a moment, his face crumples.

CHEN LIE
(quietly)
I could be different.

TIAN E
Then stop—

CHEN LIE
(throwing it back)
I don't know how!

He shoves her. She falls, the envelope scattering cash. He snatches it.

Gu Ze appears at the stairwell door, his father's words ringing in his ears.

GU ZE
Hey!

Chen Lie spins. Gu Ze drops his flashlight—it rolls, illuminating both their faces side by side.

Tian E gasps. Chen Lie bolts.

Gu Ze lunges, tackling him. The envelope rips, bills fluttering. Chen Lie scrambles free, leaving the bag behind.

SIRENS wail. Tian E grabs Chen Lie's ankle.

TIAN E
(despairing)
They're coming!

Chen Lie kicks free and sprints into the night.

Gu Ze stands, breathing hard, holding the bag. He turns to help Tian E.

UNCLE ZHOU leads a group of neighbors rushing down the stairs, their phone lights creating a blinding glare. They see Gu Ze holding the bag, Tian E on the ground, and the scattered cash.

UNCLE ZHOU
(seizing Gu Ze)
Got you! We saw the alert!

GU ZE
Uncle Zhou, no—I'm me!

XIAO FANG and GU ZE'S PARENTS run out. Xiao Fang rushes to Tian E.

Tian E points, trembling, between Gu Ze and the direction Chen Lie fled.

TIAN E
(barely audible)
Two of them... same face...

Uncle Zhou's grip loosens. He looks at Gu Ze—really looks—then at the stairwell where Chen Lie disappeared.

GU ZE
(to Uncle Zhou, calmly)
Call them. I'll wait.

Gu Ze meets his father's eyes across the courtyard. His father nods, understanding.

Xiao Fang helps Tian E to her feet, picking up the ultrasound photo from the ground.

XIAO FANG
(softly)
It's his birthday today.

Tian E looks at Gu Ze, at the cake his mother still holds, at the chaos.

TIAN E
(to Gu Ze)
I'm sorry.

GU ZE
(quietly)
Don't be. Just... when they catch him—

He hands her the torn envelope, cash spilling out.

GU ZE (CONT'D)
—make sure he sees that photo again.

Police lights paint the walls red. Gu Ze doesn't resist as Uncle Zhou guides him to the steps. He sits, waiting.

His mother brings the cake over, setting it beside him. The candles have melted into a puddle of wax.

GU ZE'S MOTHER
(handing him the ruined cake)
Still your birthday.

Gu Ze looks at the candles—then blows them out anyway.

FADE OUT.

title: Episode One
description: A desperate young woman in a school uniform bursts into a KTV room seeking help, claiming to be the bride of Youlan Court, and finds herself caught between pursuing gangsters and a reluctant stranger.
context:
Title: Episode One
Description: A desperate young woman in a school uniform bursts into a KTV room seeking help, claiming to be the bride of Youlan Court, and finds herself caught between pursuing gangsters and a reluctant stranger.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

A luxurious KTV private room with flashing lights. Smoke hangs in the air, bottles scattered across the table.

LU HANTING holds a microphone, singing to himself—detached, weary.

LU HANTING
(singing)
Let me pluck your heart...

Below the stage, HUO XIZE and his FRIENDS raise their glasses, the atmosphere turning restless.

HUO XIZE
(singing along)
Pluck your heart!

LU HANTING
(singing)
Try to melt it slowly...

The door bursts open. The music cuts out.

XIA DUOWAN rushes in, hyperventilating. Her school uniform is torn, makeup smudged across her face.

XIA DUOWAN
(out of breath)
Please. Help me.

She rushes to LU HANTING, gripping his arm with trembling fingers.

LU HANTING
(frowning)
Who are you?

Without explanation, XIA DUOWAN hides behind LU HANTING. HUO XIZE and his LACKEYS burst in after her.

HUO XIZE
(seeing them, laughing)
Found you.

XIA DUOWAN peeks out, voice trembling.

XIA DUOWAN
This... this is my fiancé. Talk to him.

XIA DUOWAN forces a brittle smile, grabbing a drink she can't afford.

XIA DUOWAN
Let's all just... have a drink.
continuation:
HUO XIZE walks up to LU HANTING, looking him up and down with contempt.

HUO XIZE
Who are you? My family runs this street.

LU HANTING remains expressionless, unmoved.

LU HANTING
You guys have fun.

LU HANTING turns to leave. XIA DUOWAN blocks him, fierce desperation in her eyes.

XIA DUOWAN
Hey!

HUO XIZE smiles smugly, approaching XIA DUOWAN.

XIA DUOWAN
(desperately shouting)
I'm the bride of Youlan Court!

Hearing this, LU HANTING stops and turns, his eyes becoming sharp.

HUO XIZE's LACKEY freezes, then mocks her.

THUG
And I'm the boss of Youlan Court!

HUO XIZE
(smirking evilly)
Then we'll... play with the bride.

HUO XIZE and his men close in on XIA DUOWAN.

XIA DUOWAN
(terrified)
Don't come near me!

XIA DUOWAN backs up to the table, jumps onto it, and grabs two bottles as weapons.

XIA DUOWAN
I'm going to use my ultimate move! I mean it!

Just as HUO XIZE moves, LU HANTING suddenly acts, grabbing him by the collar.

HUO XIZE
(struggling)
You're asking for a beating! Can't stop me!

LU HANTING's eyes are ice cold as he swings a punch at HUO XIZE.

SFX: Punch impact sound

LU HANTING looks expressionlessly at the fallen HUO XIZE.

title: Sword Breaks the Heavens Episode 98
description: A modern young man reading web novels suddenly finds himself transmigrated into the body of a villain simp character in an ancient cultivation world.
context:
Title: Sword Breaks the Heavens Episode 98
Description: A modern young man reading web novels suddenly finds himself transmigrated into the body of a villain simp character in an ancient cultivation world.

INT. ANCIENT TOWN STREET - DAY

A young man (JUNIOR BROTHER YUN) in a modern jacket walks down the street, phone in hand, scrolling through a cultivation novel.

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN
(muttering)
Three hundred chapters of pure simping. If I were that guy, I'd have turned villain and ruled the sect by now...

His phone screen flickers. A notification pops up: "Character alignment syncing..."

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN
The hell?

A distant female voice calls out—unmistakably the Holy Maiden's tone from the novel.

MYSTERIOUS FEMALE VOICE (O.S.)
Young Master Yun! Please wait!

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN stops. A migraine hits like a sledgehammer. He clutches his head, phone slipping from his grip.

A vision floods his mind: an ancient man on a bridge, robe torn, face bruised—the exact description from chapter 98.

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN
(strangled)
Hey—little help here—

The ancient man in the vision turns. Their eyes meet. The world tilts.

MYSTERIOUS FEMALE VOICE (O.S.)
(urgent, closer)
Young Master, you mustn't—

His vision tunnels. The phone screen glows on the ground: "Sync complete. Welcome, Villain Simp #47."

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN
(whisper)
...shit.

He collapses.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT ROOM - DAY

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN jolts awake. Antique bed. Ancient robes. His own face—except for the fresh bruises.

He sits up too fast. Pain lances through his ribs. His hand finds a hidden pouch at his belt—empty.

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN
(barely audible)
...robbed already.

Memories that aren't his surface: the failed confession, the public humiliation, the beating. His jaw tightens.

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN
(soft, calculating)
Alright. So I'm the simp. And Senior Brother's the real villain.

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN (V.O.)
Chapter 98 beatdown. Chapter 99 poisoning. Chapter 100—body disposal. Standard trope, but I'm not playing by the book.

He swings his legs off the bed, testing his weight. A scroll falls from his sleeve: "Spirit Meridian Sealing Poison—Antidote requires core disciple tokens."

JUNIOR BROTHER YUN
(quietly)
So that's the game.

A sword tip erupts through the door. Wood splinters.

The door crashes open. SENIOR BROTHER stands there, green robes immaculate, a delicate vial visible in his sleeve.

SENIOR BROTHER
(coldly pleasant)
Awake so soon, Junior Brother? One might think you're eager for... round two.

title: Beauty in Troubled Times
description: At an engagement banquet, a mysterious dancer from the Fairy Music Hall confronts a warlord with secrets from a tragic past.
context:
Title: Beauty in Troubled Times
Description: At an engagement banquet, a mysterious dancer from the Fairy Music Hall confronts a warlord with secrets from a tragic past.

INT. WARLORD'S MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

A magnificent banquet hall filled with guests, wine glasses clinking.

GUEST A (V.O.)
Worthy of being Warlord Qin's only beloved daughter. The wedding banquet alone is such a grand affair.

GUEST B (V.O.)
He is the most powerful governor in the last three years, Shen Shixiang.

QIN LINGXI, wearing a red evening gown, sees her brother QIN CHUAN approaching and looks displeased.

QIN LINGXI
Brother, why are you only just arriving?

QIN CHUAN
(smoothing his cuff)
I was preparing a gift for you.

QIN LINGXI
That's more like it. Where's the gift?

QIN CHUAN
You've been complaining that Father won't let you go to Fairy Music Hall. I've brought the person here for you now.

QIN CHUAN gestures toward the staircase.

GUEST C
Isn't that the White Rose from Fairy Music Hall?

A spotlight shines down. WHITE ROSE, wearing a magnificent white dress and holding a white rose, walks forward slowly. She wears a beaded veil, mysterious and beautiful.

SHEN SHIXIANG, in military uniform, watches WHITE ROSE. His posture stiffens almost imperceptibly.

SHEN SHIXIANG (V.O.)
This bearing... why does it ache like a phantom wound?

WHITE ROSE walks up to SHEN SHIXIANG. SHEN SHIXIANG gazes at her intently.

WHITE ROSE extends the white rose in her hand toward SHEN SHIXIANG.

QIN LINGXI suddenly steps forward, positioning herself between them, pushing away WHITE ROSE's hand.

QIN LINGXI
continuation:
(sharply)
What are you doing?

WHITE ROSE ignores her, produces a red rose from somewhere, and gently pins it to QIN LINGXI's chest.

WHITE ROSE
(like a curse wrapped in silk)
Miss Qin, congratulations on your engagement.

SHEN SHIXIANG looks down and discovers the white rose has somehow been placed in his jacket pocket. He takes out the rose and finds a note attached to it.

He unfolds the note.

INSERT - NOTE
"I know the truth about the Ye family massacre"

SHEN SHIXIANG's expression changes.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. YE FAMILY MANSION - NIGHT - THREE YEARS AGO

In the darkness, bodies lie scattered at the entrance of the Ye family mansion.
Young WHITE ROSE (MISS YE) sits collapsed on the ground in a red wedding dress, filled with despair.
Young SHEN SHIXIANG, dressed in black, holds a gun and looks at her coldly.

WHITE ROSE (V.O.)
(crying out)
So you deliberately got close to me from the beginning just to take revenge on the Ye family?

SHEN SHIXIANG (V.O.)
(coldly)
Did Miss Ye actually think what we had was true love?

END FLASHBACK.

INT. WARLORD'S MANSION - BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

SHEN SHIXIANG holds the note, his knuckles white around the paper.

WHITE ROSE suddenly raises her hand and slaps QIN LINGXI across the face--a measured retaliation.

QIN LINGXI covers her face, looking at her in astonishment.

INSERT - NOTE
The other side of the note reads: "Ten o'clock tonight, Lake Pavilion. Come alone."

The scene darkens. White feathers fall like ash. SHEN SHIXIANG stands alone in the center of the empty hall, the rose still clutched in his fist.

title: Oops! CEO Mommy Goes to Work
description: A wealthy mother secretly takes a job as a cleaner, prompting her powerful children to mobilize their resources to protect her.
context:
Title: Oops! CEO Mommy Goes to Work
Description: A wealthy mother secretly takes a job as a cleaner, prompting her powerful children to mobilize their resources to protect her.

INT. PARK - DAY

MOMMY rides a vintage bicycle along a park path, humming softly to herself.

A BODYGUARD in a black suit hides in the roadside bushes, phone held low.

BODYGUARD (into earpiece)
Young Master, she's actually going through with it.

INT. AIRPORT TARMAC - DAY

DABAO, a small boy in a striped suit and gold-rimmed glasses, descends private jet stairs. Bodyguards flank a red carpet.

BODYGUARDS (in unison)
Welcome, Young Master!

ASSISTANT rushes over, tablet in hand.

ASSISTANT
Sir, the Canadian delegation awaits.

DABAO
Reschedule. Priority one: Mommy.

ASSISTANT
At once.

INT. HACKER BASE - NIGHT

Dim room pulsing with green light. ERBAO, a small boy in an oversized hoodie, faces wall-to-wall monitors.

HACKER SUBORDINATE
Threat neutralized, boss. Systems locked down.

ERBAO
Good. Now full surveillance on Mommy's route.

HACKER SUBORDINATES (in unison)
Yes, boss!
continuation:
EXT. CROSSWALK - DAY

A car brakes hard. An OLD GRANNY stumbles on the crosswalk.

SANBAO, a small girl in a taekwondo uniform, darts forward, steadies the woman.

SANBAO
Got you!

She taps her smartwatch.

SANBAO
Nini, coordinates sent. Don't lose her.

WATCH (V.O.)
On it.

SANBAO effortlessly shifts the car aside. Two GIRLS on the roadside gasp.

PASSERBY A
What the—?

SANBAO
(bows politely)
Safety first!

EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

MOMMY pedals her bicycle. Two black SUVs pull alongside, forcing her to stop.

MOMMY (startled)
Hey!

Car doors open. DABAO and ERBAO step out. A pink mini motorcycle arrives; SANBAO removes her helmet.

MOMMY (softly)
...My babies.

The children rush in, enveloping her in a hug.

CHILDREN
Mommy!

DABAO
You don't have to prove anything. Come work with me.

MOMMY
Sweetheart, I need to remember who I am beyond just your mom.

ERBAO
(tugging her sleeve)
Then let me buy the hotel. You can be the boss.

MOMMY
That's not the point, honey.

SANBAO
You want to make your own things happen again. Right?

MOMMY
Exactly. Now let Mommy do this. Please?

MOMMY checks her watch, eyes widening.

MOMMY
Late. Remember — not a word about who I am. Promise?

She mounts her bicycle and rides away. The children watch.

DABAO (to ASSISTANT)
Acquire Yunmeng Hotel. Silent partner.

ASSISTANT
Immediately.

ERBAO (softly)
Tap their security feeds. Just to watch.

SANBAO
She'll know.

SANBAO grins, pulling out a lollipop.

SANBAO
That's what makes it fun.

FADE OUT.

title: Mr. Li's Infinite Love for His Wife
description: A woman sold by her father fights back against her abuser and finds unexpected help from a mysterious stranger.
context:
Title: Mr. Li's Infinite Love for His Wife
Description: A woman sold by her father fights back against her abuser and finds unexpected help from a mysterious stranger.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

HE JINGYUE pins XU NIAN down on the sofa, his hand over her mouth.

HE JINGYUE
Don't move. Your father signed for this.

XU NIAN bites his hand. As he recoils, she smashes a bottle and presses the glass to his throat.

HE JINGYUE
(laughing through pain)
Little wolf.

Several HENCHMEN surround them.

XU NIAN
(low, clear)
Phones on the table.

title: Dynasty Heavy Industries
description: A chemist researching gunpowder is killed in a lab explosion and reincarnates as a puppet emperor in a dynasty controlled by the Empress Dowager. He must navigate palace intrigue and bring the nation to greatness.
context:
Title: Dynasty Heavy Industries
Description: A chemist researching gunpowder is killed in a lab explosion and reincarnates as a puppet emperor in a dynasty controlled by the Empress Dowager. He must navigate palace intrigue and bring the nation to greatness.

INT. LABORATORY - NIGHT

In the dimly lit laboratory, JIN ZHENG (male, 20s, glasses, athletic build) carefully adds red liquid into a test tube. Chemical instruments cover the desk.

WANG XIAOYU (female, 20s, lab assistant) approaches, her expression worried.

WANG XIAOYU
Jin Zheng, the Defense Ministry cut our funding. We're the only lab still researching this.

JIN ZHENG
(looking up)
Because they forgot what happened three centuries ago.

WANG XIAOYU
That was ancient history!

JIN ZHENG
(regarding the test tube)
History has a way of repeating itself. I'd rather have solutions we never need than need solutions we don't have.

WANG XIAOYU
(sighs, reaching for his notes)
But this formula's impossible. The stabilization--

JIN ZHENG
(grabs her wrist sharply)
Don't touch that!

The equipment shatters. A fireball erupts, consuming the frame.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE - DAY

MONTAGE:
Jin Zheng's consciousness hurtles through darkness. Images flash: ancient battlefields, cannon fire, palace corridors, a dying emperor's face—his own face.

INT. PALACE HALL - DAY

XIAO DEZI (eunuch, 40s, weathered) kneels, voice cracking.

XIAO DEZI
His Majesty has ascended to heaven!

EMPRESS LI (female, 20s, regal robes) storms across the marble floor toward CONSORT ZHEN (female, 20s, plain silk gown).

EMPRESS LI
You did this.

CONSORT ZHEN
(kneeling, trembling)
Your Highness, the Emperor collapsed before he reached my chambers. I swear--

EMPRESS LI
(viciously quiet)
Swear to what? That you didn't poison his wine? That your clan didn't bribe the kitchen staff?

CONSORT ZHEN
No! Please--

FLASHBACK - INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

EMPRESS DOWAGER (female, 40s, iron gaze) sits on the throne, sliding a red bottle across the jade table.

EMPRESS DOWAGER
He refuses the consort I chose for him. Let him rest forever.

EMPRESS LI
(picking up the bottle)
And Consort Zhen?

EMPRESS DOWAGER
Someone must answer for the divine departure.

END FLASHBACK - RETURN TO:
continuation:
INT. PALACE HALL - DAY

CONSORT ZHEN
(whispering)
I would never...

EMPRESS LI
Of course not. But the Empress Dowager requires a culprit. Choose: your life, or three hundred lives in your clan?

CONSORT ZHEN
(eyes closing)
May my death serve them.

EMPRESS LI
(shouts)
White silk! Make it quick.

Eunuchs close in on Consort Zhen.

INT. EMPEROR'S BEDCHAMBER - DAY

JIN ZHENG wakes in the emperor's bed. He touches his face—different hands, different skin. Memories flood him: a lifetime of being called useless, watching his empire weaken, the bitter taste in his wine.

JIN ZHENG
(softly)
This... this is my face.

XIAO DEZI (O.S.)
By decree of the Empress Dowager, Jin Zheng inherits the Mandate of Heaven. Era name: Tongguang.

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

EMPRESS DOWAGER sits on the dragon throne, reviewing scrolls. JIN ZHENG stands beside her, wearing imperial robes.

JIN ZHENG
Mother Empress, when may--

EMPRESS DOWAGER
(drops a scroll)
All matters rest with me. You rest in your chambers.

INT. EMPEROR'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

JIN ZHENG lies awake, memories of two lives colliding.

JIN ZHENG (V.O.)
The last emperor. Puppet to a Dowager, pawn to an Empress. And Zhen... she tried to warn me about the wine.

FOOTSTEPS. JIN ZHENG sits up.

JIN ZHENG
Who's there?

Four EUNUCHS enter with ropes. Their leader, EUNUCH LI (40s, scarred), smirks.

EUNUCH LI
Empress Dowager's orders. The new emperor sleeps poorly.

Jin Zheng's military training kicks in—he disarms the first eunuch, uses the rope to trip two others, elbow strikes the fourth.

EMPRESS LI appears in the doorway, stunned.

EMPRESS LI
You're alive.

JIN ZHENG
Seems your poison wasn't thorough.

He rushes past her into the hall.

INT. PALACE HALL - CONTINUOUS

Consort Zhen struggles as eunuchs tighten the silk. Jin Zheng tackles one, catches another's wrist.

CONSORT ZHEN
(crying)
Why save me? Death is cleaner than life as your shadow.

JIN ZHENG
(quietly)
You warned him. You tried to save me before.

CONSORT ZHEN
(confused)
What?

EMPRESS LI
(from across the hall)
Touching. But the Dowager's will is iron. You survive tonight, but not the coronation feast.

She retreats.

JIN ZHENG helps Consort Zhen up, his voice low.

JIN ZHENG
Then we change the menu.

He looks at his hands—chemist's hands, now an emperor's—and clenches them.

FADE OUT.

title: Master Er's Divine Fortune Teller Wife
description: A young Taoist girl with a rare yin body is sent down the mountain to marry a powerful businessman to save both their lives through destiny and balance.
context:
Title: Master Er's Divine Fortune Teller Wife
Description: A young Taoist girl with a rare yin body is sent down the mountain to marry a powerful businessman to save both their lives through destiny and balance.

INT. QINGYUN TEMPLE - DAY

In the misty mountains, the TEMPLE MASTER, an old Taoist priest with white hair and beard, sits cross-legged in meditation. The golden aura around him flickers, dimming.

JIANG WAN, a young girl in white Taoist robes, walks briskly to the Temple Master and crouches down. Her playful smile doesn't reach her eyes.

JIANG WAN
Old man, what do you want?

TEMPLE MASTER
(his aura flickering as he opens his eyes)
Show some respect. I summoned you because your fate has become... urgent.

TEMPLE MASTER
The Ultimate Yin Cold Body will claim you before twenty. Unless your thread is tethered to another's.

TEMPLE MASTER
The Second Master of the Lu family walks the knife's edge this year. Same thread. Same shears. You must descend the mountain and marry him—balance the scales, or both snap.

The Temple Master hands Jiang Wan a black business card. Modern lettering gleams against the ancient paper.

Jiang Wan takes the card, her thumb tracing the embossed name.

JIANG WAN
(reading softly)
Lu Lixing.
continuation:
EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

JIANG WAN, carrying a cloth bag, walks along a modern city street. She takes out the business card again—the name reflects in her eyes.

Ahead, GRANDMA LU stumbles from a black sedan, her jade bracelet catching the light. She collapses, clutching her chest.

PASSERBY A
Ma'am! Are you—

GRANDMA LU
(gasping)
My heart pills...

PASSERBY B
(filming)
Don't touch her! It's a scam!

PASSERBY C
(to Jiang Wan)
Walk away, girl. Rich families will bleed you dry.

JIANG WAN's eyes fix on the Lu family seal engraved on the bracelet. She drops to her knees, her acupuncture kit already open.

JIANG WAN
(to Grandma Lu)
Breathe. I've got you.

With steady hands, she inserts the silver needle. A flicker of recognition passes between them.
