title: Young Master Chi's Sweet Romance & Flash Marriage Secret Love
description: A woman enters into a contract marriage to save her imprisoned father, only to discover a year later that her mysterious husband might be closer than she thinks.
context:
Title: Young Master Chi's Sweet Romance & Flash Marriage Secret Love
Description: A woman enters into a contract marriage to save her imprisoned father, only to discover a year later that her mysterious husband might be closer than she thinks.

INT. MARRIAGE REGISTRATION OFFICE - DAY

A hand stamps a red seal on a marriage certificate.

The FEMALE LEAD stands at the counter of the "Binjiang City Marriage Registration Office." The MALE ASSISTANT, wearing a suit, checks his watch with professional detachment.

FEMALE LEAD (V.O.)
A ghost for a groom. Father has no time for my pride.

The STAFF MEMBER hands two red marriage certificates to the Male Assistant.

MALE ASSISTANT
Thank you.

The Male Assistant turns and hands the marriage certificate to the Female Lead.

MALE ASSISTANT
Madam. All legal.

She takes it.

MALE ASSISTANT
Mr. Chi's number is in your phone.

The Female Lead takes out her phone, sees the new contact, and changes the note to "Cheap Husband."

The Male Assistant produces a black VIP card.

MALE ASSISTANT
For your expenses. Password is your birthday.

FEMALE LEAD
(sliding it back)
No contact means no complications.

She turns and leaves. The Male Assistant watches her go, then makes a call.
continuation:
INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

MR. CHI sits in the back seat of a luxury sedan. The Male Assistant stands outside the window, reporting.

MALE ASSISTANT
She refused the card, sir. Said no contact means no complications.

The Male Assistant hands the marriage certificate and black card to Mr. Chi.

MR. CHI
I see.

Mr. Chi looks out the window, watching the Female Lead walk down the street with a teddy bear backpack. He pockets the card.

EXT. OFFICE BUILDING CORRIDOR - DAY

The Female Lead leans against the wall, phone to her ear.

FEMALE LEAD
(into the phone)
It's done. I've married into the Chi family. Now release my father—

STEPMOTHER (O.S.)
The Chi contract isn't signed yet. Once I have their signature, then we'll discuss your father's situation. Be patient, stepdaughter.

The Female Lead listens, her fist clenching with quiet fury.

ONE YEAR LATER

INT. CAFÉ - DAY

The Female Lead and her BEST FRIEND sit in a café. The Female Lead wears a white sweater and a beret, her hands supporting her chin, looking worried.

FEMALE LEAD
The advisor demands a family meeting by Friday. She knows my stepmother won't come.

BEST FRIEND
Your husband?

FEMALE LEAD
(quickly waving her hands)
We don't exist to each other.

The Best Friend's eyes fix on the door.

BEST FRIEND
What if you do?

She points subtly. The Female Lead turns to see Mr. Chi enter, heading for the counter.

BEST FRIEND
That suit. That watch. Chi family money. I'd bet on it.

The Best Friend snatches the phone from the table.

FEMALE LEAD
Don't—

The Best Friend dials "Cheap Husband." The phone screen shows calling.

INTERCUT WITH:

Mr. Chi at the counter ordering. His phone rings. He stops, seeing the caller ID. He turns, scanning the room. His eyes land on their table.

BACK TO:

The Best Friend watches him answer.

BEST FRIEND
(whispering to the Female Lead)
He's looking right at us.

The Female Lead stares as Mr. Chi lifts his phone to his ear across the café.

MR. CHI (O.S.)
Hello, wife.

The Female Lead's shock turns to dawning recognition and something more.

TO BE CONTINUED

title: After Faking Death, the Domineering CEO Misses Me to the Bone
description: A woman suffering from a terminal illness endures her husband's cold cruelty, while he remains obsessed with his first love.
context:
Title: After Faking Death, the Domineering CEO Misses Me to the Bone
Description: A woman suffering from a terminal illness endures her husband's cold cruelty, while he remains obsessed with his first love.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

WU MENG sits on the sofa, gripping a "Critical Illness Notice" in her trembling hand. She stares at the words until they blur. A thin smile forms—three months might be enough.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (FLASHBACK)

WU MENG leans against the wall, the doctor's words echoing.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Miss Wu, without immediate treatment... three months. But the chemo would leave you unable to—

She crumples the prescription in her fist.

WU MENG (V.O.)
I know what I need to do.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

WU MENG tucks the notice into her sleeve as the lock clicks. She forces her trembling hands still.

HAN JINGCHENG enters, loosening his tie. He pauses, seeing her.

WU MENG
(softly)
There's soup. Still warm.

HAN JINGCHENG
(studying her)
You're pale.

WU MENG
Just tired.

HAN JINGCHENG
(crossing to the bar)
Then stop waiting up. It's... performative.

WU MENG
(very quiet)
Twenty-seven days. You've counted?

HAN JINGCHENG
What?

WU MENG
Nothing.

He pours whiskey. The glass clinks like a verdict.

WU MENG
(cont'd)
The neurologist called. About my headaches—

HAN JINGCHENG
I don't have time for another one of your symptoms, Wu Meng. Anna's exhibition opens next week.

WU MENG
(fingering her sleeve)
Of course. I only thought—

HAN JINGCHENG
(interrupting)
You thought? That's the problem. You think staying in this house, playing the devoted wife, changes anything?

WU MENG
(standing slowly)
I'm not playing.

HAN JINGCHENG
Then what do you call it? She left because you existed. Because your family—because this marriage—made her believe I was something I'm not.

WU MENG

title: The Turbulent Nineties
description: A man is executed for killing his wife's rapist, but is given a second chance when he is reborn back to 1990, the day tragedy struck his family.
context:
Title: The Turbulent Nineties
Description: A man is executed for killing his wife's rapist, but is given a second chance when he is reborn back to 1990, the day tragedy struck his family.

EXT. SNOWY ROOFTOP - DAY

FLASHBACK - YEAR 2000

A snow-covered landscape. TANG CAISHAN stands with her back to the camera on a rooftop, snow beneath her feet.

Young LI XIAOXUE, wearing a school uniform with a backpack, holds an acceptance letter in her hand as she walks down the street. She looks up and sees her mother on the rooftop.

LI XIAOXUE
(shouting in terror)
Mom!

TANG CAISHAN closes her eyes and jumps from the building.

LI XIAOXUE witnesses everything, frozen in shock. The "Jiangcheng University" acceptance letter slips from her hand and falls to the ground.

Blood splatters onto the acceptance letter.

INT. PRISON VISITATION ROOM - DAY

LI GAOYUAN, wearing prison uniform and handcuffs, sits behind the visitation window and picks up the phone.

LI GAOYUAN
Daughter.

Adult LI XIAOXUE sits on the other side, her expression furious as she picks up the phone.

LI XIAOXUE
Li Gaoyuan, shut up. You don't get to call me that.

(beat)
You gambled away our lives. You let Mom die. And you killed a man. Do you know what that makes me?

LI GAOYUAN
(softly)
Xiaoxue...

LI XIAOXUE
(crying out)
Don't. I'm taking the prosecutor's exam next month. I'll make sure people like you never hurt families again.

She slams down the phone, knocking over her chair, and runs away crying.

LI GAOYUAN
(speaking into the phone, tears in his eyes)
She was raped, Xiaoxue. By Xu Cheng. Ten years ago. She stayed alive for you—until that letter came. That debt wasn't money. It was her soul.

FLASHBACK: XU CHENG pins TANG CAISHAN on the bed, assaulting her. Another image shows LI GAOYUAN hitting XU CHENG with a brick.
continuation:
INT. COURTROOM - DAY

JUDGE (V.O.)
(solemnly)
After court evaluation, the defendant Li Gaoyuan is found guilty of intentional homicide and is hereby sentenced to death, to be executed immediately.

LI GAOYUAN is led away by bailiffs, his shackles dragging on the ground.

EXT. BARREN MOUNTAIN - DAY

LI GAOYUAN is escorted to a desolate snowy mountain, prepared for execution by firing squad.

LI GAOYUAN kneels on the ground, his expression pained and remorseful.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

FLASHBACK - YEAR 1990

The room is filled with smoke. A group of men surround a table gambling. Young LI XIAOXUE does homework at a small table nearby, watching everything uneasily.

XU CHENG
(to Li Gaoyuan)
Li Gaoyuan, you've lost everything. If you bet again, all you can put up is your wife!

The gamblers jeer. XU CHENG's eyes drift toward the inner room door.

EXT. BARREN MOUNTAIN - DAY

FLASHBACK - CONTINUOUS

LI XIAOXUE (V.O.)
You made me the daughter of a murderer. So I'll become the law that judges you.

INT. ROOM - DAY

YEAR 1990

LI GAOYUAN jolts awake to find himself lying on his own floor, surrounded by broken bottles. He looks at his hands in shock, then sees the calendar on the wall showing "1990."

LI GAOYUAN
(shocked)
I've been reborn?

He hears his wife's cries for help and a man's lewd laughter from the next room.

XU CHENG (O.S.)
I've waited ten years for this, Caishan. Your husband finally made it possible.

LI GAOYUAN
(shouting)
Wife!

He rushes out of the room and sees XU CHENG about to assault TANG CAISHAN.

LI GAOYUAN
(roaring)
Not this time.

LI GAOYUAN grabs a chair and smashes it hard into XU CHENG. He shields his frightened wife behind him, glaring furiously at XU CHENG lying on the ground.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Renting a Boyfriend for Chinese New Year
description: A young woman quits her job after her boss refuses her leave and rushes to meet a man she hired to pose as her boyfriend for the holiday.
context:
Title: Renting a Boyfriend for Chinese New Year
Description: A young woman quits her job after her boss refuses her leave and rushes to meet a man she hired to pose as her boyfriend for the holiday.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

YE XI (27, composed but with fraying patience) holds a leave request form. Her boss, MR. CHEN, never looks up from his monitor.

YE XI
Mr. Chen, I've submitted this three times.

MR. CHEN
And I've ignored it three times. We're finalizing the Q4 report. Everyone stays.

YE XI
(quietly)
My grandfather's turning ninety. He thinks I'm bringing someone home.

MR. CHEN
(typing)
Your personal life doesn't pay your bonus. Welcome to corporate reality.

His phone BUZZES. He reaches for it instinctively, catching the name "WIFE" on screen. He angles away, but Ye Xi sees.

MR. CHEN
(sotto voce, into phone)
Hey, sweetheart... Yes, I'll make the reunion dinner... No, work won't keep me this year.

Ye Xi's expression shifts from resignation to calculation.

YE XI
(loudly, to herself)
Corporate reality, right.

She clicks her phone's voice memo app, holds it up.

YE XI
(to the room)
Just want to document this motivational moment. Mr. Chen confirming that family comes second to productivity.

MR. CHEN
(hand over phone)
What are you—

YE XI
Affects everyone, doesn't it? Or does policy only apply when your wife's not calling?

MR. CHEN
(frantic, to phone)
It's not what it sounds like—

YE XI
(to the office)
I've canceled three trips home. Worked eighty-hour weeks. My grandfather's crying when I call.

Turns to leave, pauses at the door.

YE XI
You're right about one thing. I won't find life value here.

She drops her access card on the reception desk. The whole office watches.

MR. CHEN
(into phone, desperate)
No, no, I was telling them to work harder, not me—

YE XI
Tell your wife I said happy new year.
continuation:
INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

YE XI hurries in, checks her phone: 3:47. Half an hour late. Her confident mask slips—she's genuinely flustered.

She scans the room: GRAY COAT, BEIGE SCARF—yes, there. But the man is already watching her, like he knew she'd be late.

YE XI
(hovering)
Gu Li?

GU LI (30s, sharp eyes, sleeves rolled to reveal faded calligraphy tattoos) sets down his espresso.

GU LI
You texted you'd be twenty minutes. You were optimistic.

YE XI
(fumbling)
The meeting ran... no. I quit my job. It was... loud.

GU LI
(slight smile)
So I gathered. You're shaking.

YE XI
(hands in pockets)
It's nothing. You're ready, right? We have the contract—

GU LI
The basics. Pretend we're dating. Endure three days of family interrogation. Don't embarrass you.

YE XI
Exactly. Five thousand, as agreed.

GU LI
You should know: I'm expensive at pretending. But when I commit, I'm convincing.

YE XI
That's... what I need.

GU LI
Then let's rewrite the terms.

She blinks. He stands, drapes his scarf around her neck.

GU LI
A boyfriend wouldn't let you freeze. And he'd know your grandfather's favorite tea.

YE XI
(pause)
Pu'er. The aged kind.

GU LI
Good. Now we have somewhere to start.

He gestures to the door. She leads, but differently—less desperate, more cautiously hopeful.

title: Million Dollar Bride
description: A young woman is forced by her father to marry into a wealthy family to save her comatose mother, leading her to a reckless night that changes everything.
context:
Title: Million Dollar Bride
Description: A young woman is forced by her father to marry into a wealthy family to save her comatose mother, leading her to a reckless night that changes everything.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

MU XINGRAN sits alone at the bar counter, picks up a glass and drinks it in one gulp.

MU XINGRAN (V.O.)
Young master Li. The idiot prince of a golden cage. They trade my life for his comfort.

INT. MU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

FLASHBACK:

SHEN QIUHE, Mu Xingran's stepmother, is persuading MU WANQING.

SHEN QIUHE
The Li family offers what your mother needs. What you need. Think of it as preservation.

MU WANQING
A great opportunity to bring luck to an idiot? Why not let Mu Wanqing do it?

INT. BAR - NIGHT

Back to reality, MU XINGRAN drinks again, her eyes filled with pain.

INT. MU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

FLASHBACK:

MU ZHENGUO, Mu Xingran's father, points at MU WANQING and scolds her angrily.

MU ZHENGUO
Do you have no conscience? She's your own sister!

MU WANQING
(emotionally agitated)
Less than half a month after my mother's accident, the mistress had already moved in. This illegitimate daughter of yours is only one year younger than me. Speaking of conscience, in Jiangcheng if you rank second, who would dare claim first place?

MU ZHENGUO angrily slaps MU WANQING.

MU ZHENGUO
Ungrateful daughter. You will marry whether you like it or not. Otherwise, forget about your mother's medical expenses!
continuation:
INT. BAR - NIGHT

MU ZHENGUO (V.O.)
A half-dead vegetable, better off dead!

End of flashback. MU XINGRAN continues drinking at the bar.

A THUG approaches MU XINGRAN.

THUG
Little sister, all alone? Tell big brother what's troubling you.

The THUG puts his hand on MU XINGRAN's shoulder. In the distance on a sofa, LI SITING watches this scene coldly. A LI FAMILY RING gleams on his finger.

MU XINGRAN
(pushing him away)
Get lost!

THUG
(grabbing her again)
Where are you going? Let's find a place, and big brother will help you relax.

LI SITING stands up and walks over, grabbing the THUG's wrist.

THUG
Who the hell are you? Dare to ruin my fun?

LI SITING punches the THUG to the ground.

LI SITING
(coldly)
Get out!

The THUG flees in embarrassment. MU XINGRAN, drunk, falls into LI SITING's arms.

MU XINGRAN (V.O.)
I'm about to marry an idiot anyway. Can't I go crazy just once?

MU XINGRAN
(looking up at LI SITING)
Handsome.

LI SITING
What?

MU XINGRAN
(wrapping her arms around his neck)
Spend the night with me, how about it?

LI SITING
I'm not interested in you.

LI SITING tries to push her away, but MU XINGRAN holds on tighter.

MU XINGRAN
(whispering in his ear)
Not interested, or does the Li family not allow it?

LI SITING's eyes flash with anger, his expression provoked.

LI SITING
What do you know about my family?

MU XINGRAN
Enough to know they're buying what I'm selling.

She kisses him before he can respond.

TO BE CONTINUED

The Lu brothers are coming out!

ON SCREEN: LU NANCHEN - HEAD OF THE LU FAMILY
ON SCREEN: LU YIZE - TOP ACTOR
ON SCREEN: LU YUNQING - RENOWNED LAWYER

REPORTER B
Mr. Lu Yize, three years since your last win—how does it feel to hold the Best Actor award again?

REPORTER C
Mr. Lu Nanchen, with Lu Corporation's relisting, who deserves your thanks most?

LU NANCHEN
The three of us stand here today because of one person.

LU YUNQING
Without her, we'd be nothing.

LU NANCHEN
She is our sister, Chi.

A young woman in a pristine white suit, LU XIAOXIAO, pushes through the crowd.

LU XIAOXIAO
Big Brother!

She rushes toward LU NANCHEN with outstretched arms.
continuation:
EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

CHI XIA, wrapped in a worn red hoodie and scarf, stands alone on a desolate, snow-swept street. She watches the press conference on a building screen.

CHI XIA
(to herself)
Back to their perfect family. They won't miss my cheap noodles now.

She turns away, shoulders slumping. Snowflakes cling to her eyelashes.

Suddenly—a MAN stumbles into the road as a car speeds toward him.

CHI XIA
(shouting)
Watch out!

She lunges forward, shoving him clear. The car slams into her.

She hits the pavement hard. Blood trickles from her temple. Her vision blurs.

CHI XIA
(inner voice)
So this is how it ends... for people like me. Unseen. Unneeded.

She fades into darkness.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE - DAY

Time rewinds. LU XIAOXIAO is about to embrace LU NANCHEN.

LU NANCHEN's hand shoots out, stopping her cold. He pushes her back gently but firmly.

LU YUNQING
Who exactly are you?

LU XIAOXIAO
(panicked)
I... Big Brother, it's me—Xiaoxiao!

LU YIZE
The adoptive daughter who cut all ties when we went bankrupt.

LU NANCHEN
The one who disappeared for three years without a word.

LU YUNQING
You're not our sister.

LU XIAOXIAO's face drains of color as the three brothers turn away in unison.

title: Primordial Supreme
description: The God King battles the ancient demon Ao Zu who has devoured the Heavenly Dao. Millennia later, the God King reincarnates as Xiao Yi, a fallen genius stripped of his status, who must reclaim his power after betrayal.
context:
Title: Primordial Supreme
Description: The God King battles the ancient demon Ao Zu who has devoured the Heavenly Dao. Millennia later, the God King reincarnates as Xiao Yi, a fallen genius stripped of his status, who must reclaim his power after betrayal.

INT. HEAVENLY REALM - DAY

The dim yellow sky bleeds through tears in reality. Dark clouds churn with the weight of digested gods. The GOD KING, golden armor splintering at the joints, stands above the clouds.

GOD KING
Ao Zu, the Heavenly Dao wasn't yours to eat. You've broken the first contract.

From the dark clouds, a pair of blood-red eyes open. It is AO ZU's true form, vast enough to swallow principles.

AO ZU (O.S.)
I am the only contract, God King. Your light is just a memory in my belly.

The GOD KING spreads his arms. Behind him appears a massive golden beam of light—his own death, monumentally postponed.

GOD KING
Then I teach you what memory can do.

He attacks, becoming the light.

AO ZU (O.S.)
Get lost!

The GOD KING is thrown back, spits blood that hangs in the air like golden thread, and kneels on one knee. His armor weeps light.

AO ZU (O.S.)
Continue and you'll cease to exist. Retreat while you still have a self to preserve.

GOD KING
You forced me to this.

The GOD KING places his palm over his own heart. Light bleeds between his fingers.

AO ZU (O.S.)
What—

GOD KING
continuation:
With my name, I seal the Star Gate. With my soul, I buy time. Tens of millions of years, Ao Zu. That's what you'll give me.

A massive red vortex appears in the sky—the Star Gate—devouring the light he sheds.

GOD KING
And that's what I'll use to remember how to kill you.

The GOD KING uses all his strength to deliver his final strike—against himself. His body detonates into ten thousand motes of divine light, scattering through the gate. Some bury in AO ZU's form.

AO ZU (O.S.)
(raging, fading)
TENS OF MILLIONS OF YEARS, GOD KING! I'LL HUNT EVERY FRAGMENT OF YOU!

The last light vanishes. Silence.

INT. XIAO FAMILY GREAT HALL - DAY

Tens of millions of years later.

The XIAO FAMILY ELDER holds a scroll and reads it aloud to the assembly gathered in the decaying hall.

XIAO FAMILY ELDER
Xiao Yi, heir of the Xiao Family, due to his inability to awaken his martial soul, is hereby stripped of his position as heir and expelled from the Xiao Family. After death, he shall not enter the ancestral shrine!

XIAO YI, the reincarnation of the God King, dressed in white robes, stands expressionless. His knuckles are white around his jade token.

XIAO YI (V.O.)
The awakening stone felt like a tomb. Ten times. Good.

The GUESTS murmur among themselves, careful not to meet his eyes.

FEMALE GUEST
Ten consecutive awakening attempts, and the awakening stone showed no reaction. It went dark. Like it was afraid.

The Elder gestures. Two guards step forward, but XIAO YI has already dropped the token. It shatters. He walks toward the exit.

Behind him, the awakening stone—the one that "failed"—cracks down the center. A single golden light pulses within, then dims.

No one notices. Everyone watches the exile.

title: Oh No, I've Forgotten How to Love
description: A delivery man betrayed by his girlfriend is granted a system that rewards him for winning over women, turning his humiliation into a path to wealth and power.
context:
Title: Oh No, I've Forgotten How to Love
Description: A delivery man betrayed by his girlfriend is granted a system that rewards him for winning over women, turning his humiliation into a path to wealth and power.

INT. UPSCALE RESTAURANT - DAY

JIANG TAO (26), a delivery driver with tireless eyes and a helmet tucked under his arm, weaves through linen-draped tables. His uniform shows signs of a recent spill—sauce stains on his sleeve.

Behind the maître d' stand, a FEMALE CUSTOMER (30s) in designer athleisure checks her diamond-encrusted watch.

JIANG TAO
(out of breath)
Miss Li? Your order from Imperial Kitchen.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(inspects the bag)
The packaging's crushed. What happened?

JIANG TAO
(apologetic but direct)
T-boned by an e-bike. I kept it upright, but the soup—

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(sharp)
You expect me to serve this to my clients?

JIANG TAO
Ma'am, the food's intact. I can show you—

She snatches the bag, unzips it, and shoves it toward him.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Does this look "intact" to you?

JIANG TAO
(steady)
The restaurant will remake it. I'll get it here in twenty minutes.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Too late. My meeting starts in ten.

She drops the bag. Containers CLATTER on marble tile. Soup pools at their feet.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(contemptuous)
One-star review. Expect a complaint call.

She strides away. Jiang Tao's phone BUZZES. He answers.

JIANG TAO
Mom?

MOTHER (V.O.)
Xiao Tao... your father's car accident. The surgery went well, but the hospital—they're demanding payment by noon tomorrow. Eighty thousand yuan. They'll transfer him out if we can't...

JIANG TAO
(firm)
I'll handle it. Tell Dad I'm coming.

He pockets the phone, scoops up the mess with mechanical precision, and exits.
continuation:
INT. LUXURY APARTMENT DOOR - DAY

Jiang Tao, helmet in hand, raps on a mahogany door. No answer. He tries the passcode—still works.

INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - CONTINUOUS

Jiang Tao enters. The air smells of imported coffee and betrayal.

CHEN XUE (25), once his high school sweetheart, now stands in a silk robe, holding a wine glass. Beside her, WU SHAO (30), sharply dressed, scrolls through his phone.

CHEN XUE
(startled)
Tao? You're supposed to be working.

JIANG TAO
(quiet fury)
The payment for our apartment—the 300,000 down payment I made. I need it back.

WU SHAO
(without looking up)
Who's this guy?

CHEN XUE
(to Wu Shao)
My ex. Still on the lease.

JIANG TAO
Ex? We were planning our wedding last week.

CHEN XUE
(defensive)
Things change. I met someone who can actually provide.

WU SHAO
(glances at Jiang Tao)
The down payment was a gift, right? I saw the transfer note: "For our future."

JIANG TAO
(desperate)
My father is in the hospital. That money is his surgery fee. You know I'd never ask otherwise.

Chen Xue's expression flickers—guilt, then resolve. She pulls out her phone.

CHEN XUE
I can send you 5,000. Consider it charity.

JIANG TAO
(raising his voice)
Three hundred thousand, Chen Xue. That's every cent my family has.

WU SHAO
(sets down his phone)
Xue, let me handle this.

Wu Shao pours a glass of wine. He doesn't offer it. He points to a framed photo on the wall—Jiang Tao and Chen Xue, happier times.

WU SHAO
You want the money? Apologize to that photo. Tell it you were never good enough for her.

JIANG TAO
(disbelieving)
What?

WU SHAO
Then delete every picture you have of her. Publicly. Post a statement: "I was a placeholder. She deserves better."

JIANG TAO
(quiet, dangerous)
This is between me and her.

CHEN XUE
(stepping forward)
Do it, Tao. Then we're even.

Jiang Tao stares at her. The woman he built his future around. He pulls out his phone, opens his social media. His thumb hovers.

JIANG TAO
(voice breaking)
This is what I am to you now.

He doesn't wait. He presses delete. The post goes live. Wu Shao checks his own phone—smiles.

WU SHAO
Transfer initiated. 5,000 yuan. The rest? Consider it an education.

CHEN XUE
(slips one bill from her wallet)
Take this. For the delivery fee.

She places a 100-YUAN NOTE on the console table—not in his face, but with precision that hurts more.

JIANG TAO
(picks it up slowly)
I paid for this apartment's mortgage for two years.

WU SHAO
(opening the door)
Then consider it severance.

The door clicks shut. Jiang Tao stands alone in a home that was never his.

INT. LUXURY APARTMENT HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS

Jiang Tao slides down the wall. His vision blurs—exhaustion, rage, defeat. The hallway lights seem to pulse.

A translucent BLUE INTERFACE materializes before him, scrolling data:

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Ultimate Devotion Protocol initiated. Host status: Peak emotional vulnerability. Qualification: Verified.

The interface resolves into clearer text:

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Core Directive: Authentic connection yields authentic returns. Investment threshold: 10,000,000 yuan operational budget. Every 10,000 yuan demonstrably spent on sincere romantic pursuit converts to 1,000 yuan personal asset upon relationship validation (90% compatibility).

A sleek BLACK CARD materializes in his palm, cold and weightless.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Operational funds: 500,000,000 yuan. Personal assets: 0. Counterparties must initiate romantic interest. Manipulation detected = system termination.

Jiang Tao's fingers close around the card. His expression shifts—from broken to something forged in the fire of betrayal.

title: Arranged Marriage Pressure
description: A young woman faces mounting pressure from her traditional parents to find a husband and continue the family legacy, but she resists their matchmaking attempts.
context:
Title: Arranged Marriage Pressure
Description: A young woman faces mounting pressure from her traditional parents to find a husband and continue the family legacy, but she resists their matchmaking attempts.

MONTAGE

A series of photos on a bedroom wall: XU SUINING and a young man, laughing at a carnival, cooking together, hiking. She removes the last photo, her face stoic.

TRANSITION

TITLE: Three Years Later

EXT. CITY LANDSCAPE - DAY

Aerial shots of a modern metropolis, a magnificent bridge spanning across the river.

INT. XU FAMILY ANCESTRAL HALL - DAY

The ancestral hall is solemn and dignified, with memorial tablets of the Xu ancestors. XU YAQING, the Xu clan matriarch, kneels on a cushion, her posture rigid with prayer.

XU YAQING
(whispering fervently)
Ancestors, grant me strength... before the business crumbles and I do.

XU HAITAO, Xu Yaqing's husband, shuffles in holding a thick photo album. It slips from his hands, pages scattering with a fluttering sound.

XU SUINING
(startled)
Dad!

XU HAITAO
(apologetic)
Clumsy old man.

XU HAITAO gathers photos, offering one to his daughter who doesn't take it.

XU HAITAO
(holding up photo)
This one runs a startup.

XU SUINING
He looks like the startup is a pyramid scheme.

XU HAITAO
(flipping page)
Architect. Good bones.

XU SUINING
(in unison with XU YAQING)
And knows it.
continuation:
XU YAQING strides over, still holding prayer beads.

XU HAITAO
(showing another)
This doctor—steady income.

XU SUINING
Steady ego, too.

XU YAQING
(interrupting)
Xu Suining. You think you have forever? The Shanghai branch is hemorrhaging money. The board wants family stability—meaning you, married, producing an heir.

XU SUINING
And if I refuse?

XU YAQING's hand trembles as she reaches for a ceremonial spear mounted on the wall—not in theatrics, but in barely-contained fury.

XU HAITAO
(softly, to Suining)
Don't. She's been sleeping here three nights.

XU SUINING catches her mother's wrist mid-reach—not with dramatic flair, but with quiet, firm pressure. Their eyes lock.

XU SUINING
Mom, you want me to replicate your life? When was the last time you slept through the night without worrying about the ancestors' judgment? When did Dad last voice an opinion without calculating your reaction first?

XU YAQING's face drains of color. XU HAITAO studies his shoes.

XU HAITAO
(quietly)
I'll... check the ledgers.

He exits. The ancestral hall feels larger, emptier.

XU YAQING releases the spear. Her voice cracks.

XU YAQING
One month. Not for the ancestors. For me. Before I become one of them.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

XU SUINING walks furiously, swiping at her phone—deleting a contact. She hurls her rabbit hand warmer onto the road.

A luxury car brakes smoothly. Behind the window, a man, LING SHAO, watches her. His gaze isn't just interested—it's recognition.

LING SHAO
(to driver)
Stop.

Steady ego, too.

XU YAQING
(interrupting)
Xu Suining. You think you have forever? The Shanghai branch is hemorrhaging money. The board wants family stability—meaning you, married, producing an heir.

XU SUINING
And if I refuse?

XU YAQING's hand trembles as she reaches for a ceremonial spear mounted on the wall—not in theatrics, but in barely-contained fury.

XU HAITAO
(softly, to Suining)
Don't. She's been sleeping here three nights.

XU SUINING catches her mother's wrist mid-reach—not with dramatic flair, but with quiet, firm pressure. Their eyes lock.

XU SUINING
Mom, you want me to replicate your life? When was the last time you slept through the night without worrying about the ancestors' judgment? When did Dad last voice an opinion without calculating your reaction first?

XU YAQING's face drains of color. XU HAITAO studies his shoes.

XU HAITAO
(quietly)
I'll... check the ledgers.

He exits. The ancestral hall feels larger, emptier.

XU YAQING releases the spear. Her voice cracks.

XU YAQING
One month. Not for the ancestors. For me. Before I become one of them.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

XU SUINING walks furiously, swiping at her phone—deleting a contact. She hurls her rabbit hand warmer onto the road.

A luxury car brakes smoothly. Behind the window, a man, LING SHAO, watches her. His gaze isn't just interested—it's recognition.

LING SHAO
(to driver)
Stop.

title: The Whole World Thinks I Love Him
description: Lin Qian endures a loveless marriage to Huo Shaoting, a man who bears the face of her lost love Ling Yunchen. Her tolerance masks a desperate strategy.
context:
Title: The Whole World Thinks I Love Him
Description: Lin Qian endures a loveless marriage to Huo Shaoting, a man who bears the face of her lost love Ling Yunchen. Her tolerance masks a desperate strategy.

EXT. STREET - DAY

LIN QIAN stands on the roadside, rubbing her hands together and breathing on them for warmth.

LING YUNCHEN stands across the street, holding a bouquet of white roses.

LING YUNCHEN
Qianqian!

LIN QIAN sees him and smiles, her face transformed.

LIN QIAN
Ah Chen!

LIN QIAN runs toward LING YUNCHEN, about to cross the street.

A white SUV speeds toward them with a sharp honking sound.

LING YUNCHEN throws away the bouquet and rushes over to push LIN QIAN out of the way. He is hit by the car and falls to the ground.

LIN QIAN and LING YUNCHEN both fall to the ground. Blood flows from the corner of LING YUNCHEN'S mouth as he lies unconscious.

INT. LIN QIAN'S HOME - NIGHT

LIN QIAN suddenly wakes up in bed, gasping for air, reaching for emptiness.

Her phone on the nightstand rings. The caller ID shows "HUO SHAOTING."

LIN QIAN answers the phone.

LIN QIAN
Hello.

HUO SHAOTING (V.O.)
Crystal Hotel. Room 802. Ten minutes.

LIN QIAN
Okay.

LIN QIAN hangs up and gets out of bed.
continuation:
EXT. CRYSTAL HOTEL - NIGHT

Night view of a luxurious spherical hotel, light shimmering on its surface.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

HUO SHAOTING lies on the bed, his eyes covered with a blindfold. A woman in a sexy slip dress (MISTRESS) teases him with a feather.

LIN QIAN, wearing a white dress and carrying a black box, walks to the hotel room door.

LIN QIAN (V.O.)
Everyone in City A knows Huo Shaoting's wife, Lin Qian, is a joke. Buying gifts for his mistress, taking his mistress to the hospital. What they don't know is what I'm collecting in return.

LIN QIAN enters the room and sees the scene on the bed, her face expressionless.

LIN QIAN
Mr. Huo, the item you asked me to buy.

HUO SHAOTING pulls off the blindfold and sits up. The MISTRESS snuggles beside him.

LIN QIAN hands over the box.

HUO SHAOTING takes the box and opens it for a glance.

HUO SHAOTING
Wrong specifications. Did you forget what I use?

LIN QIAN
I'm sorry, I'll go buy it again.

LIN QIAN turns to leave.

HUO SHAOTING
Wait.

HUO SHAOTING gets out of bed and walks over to LIN QIAN.

HUO SHAOTING
You bought the wrong one on purpose. To remind me you're still here.

LIN QIAN
I've never used them. How would I know the specifications?

HUO SHAOTING suddenly pushes LIN QIAN onto the bed. The MISTRESS on the bed looks at them.

HUO SHAOTING leans over LIN QIAN.

HUO SHAOTING
Then maybe you should try being my wife instead of his widow.

MISTRESS
Mr. Huo, are we... having a threesome? Secretary Lin is so beautiful.

HUO SHAOTING
(to the MISTRESS)
Get out.

The MISTRESS reluctantly grabs her clothes and leaves.

HUO SHAOTING turns back to LIN QIAN.

HUO SHAOTING
You've ruined my evening. Don't you think you should compensate me?

HUO SHAOTING'S hand touches LIN QIAN'S face.

LIN QIAN
(looking at him)
Because you're good-looking. Because from this angle, you look most like him.

HUO SHAOTING
Secretary Lin, right now you're not Secretary Lin, you're my wife. Know your place.

HUO SHAOTING takes LIN QIAN'S hand. She lets him.

LIN QIAN (V.O.)
Marrying Huo Shaoting, everyone thinks I'm trying to climb the social ladder, but only I know I'm digging for the truth.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

On the heart monitor screen, the flatline returns to a beating rhythm.

LIN QIAN lies in the hospital bed, her head wrapped in bandages, wearing an oxygen mask and neck brace, dressed in a hospital gown.

An ASSISTANT in a suit stands by the bed.

ASSISTANT
Miss, you're awake. You were injured on the roadside. Mr. Ming brought you in.

LIN QIAN'S gaze moves past the ASSISTANT to see a man sitting on the sofa, MING CHUAN. He wears glasses and a black suit, his face stern, looking exactly like HUO SHAOTING and LING YUNCHEN.

MING CHUAN
Your name.

LIN QIAN
(weakly, calculating)
Ah Chen...

LIN QIAN (V.O.)
How can there be three men who look the same? I don't need to understand it. I just need to use it.

FADE OUT.

title: Tomb Keeper's Notes: Return to Coffin Mountain
description: A man plagued by nightmares seeks a legendary cure from a mysterious mountain, but obtaining it requires more than just finding it.
context:
Title: Tomb Keeper's Notes: Return to Coffin Mountain
Description: A man plagued by nightmares seeks a legendary cure from a mysterious mountain, but obtaining it requires more than just finding it.

INT. COFFIN MOUNTAIN - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHI QINGPING lies on the ground, convulsing. His fingers tear at the dirt, seeking purchase. He sits up, terror flattening his features.

Two silhouettes with furnace-green eyes manifest from the blackness. They move like puppets with cut strings—jerky, too fast. The air between them warps.

They hit him like a wave. His back arches. Something beneath his ribs glows—faint, fruit-shaped—then fades to nothing.

EXT. HAICHENG SHI MANSION COURTYARD - DAY

SHI QINGPING lurches awake. The teacup slips from his fingers and shatters. He stares at the shards, breathing hard.

BAO WANRU appears without a sound. Her hand hovers near his shoulder, not quite touching.

BAO WANRU
(low)
Again.

QINGWEN lingers by the courtyard gate, wringing a letter.

QINGWEN
Master. Doctor Xing... he's coming tonight. Says tomorrow's too late.

Shi Qingping closes his eyes. He already knows.
continuation:
INT. HAICHENG SHI MANSION INNER CHAMBER - DAY

The room sinks into twilight. DOCTOR XING ZICHENG holds SHI QINGPING's wrist, his thumb pressing the hollow of the pulse. The silence stretches.

XING ZICHENG
Your pulse is fleeing.

SHI QINGPING
(cold)
Give me a name for it.

XING ZICHENG
Coffin King Fruit. Nothing else.

SHI QINGPING
Coffin—

XING ZICHENG
Mountain. Yes.

Shi Qingping's hand tightens on the chair arm.

SHI QINGPING
How did you—

XING ZICHENG
I smell wet earth on you. The day after rain. Only one place near Haicheng.

LEI WENLI shifts from the shadows. His scarred knuckles are white.

LEI WENLI
(interjecting)
Master Shi. My grandfather was a tomb keeper there.

SHI QINGPING
(looking at LEI WENLI in surprise)
Speak.

LEI WENLI
The fruit doesn't obey. It collects. It chooses who owes the debt. If it summons you, it's not to give. It's to take payment.

SHI QINGPING
(turning to glare at XING ZICHENG)
If you're lying—

XING ZICHENG
Touch your left ribs. Count the marks.

Shi Qingping's hand goes to his chest. He doesn't look. He already feels the three bruises, glowing faintly through his silk robe.

title: Dangerous Encounter
description: A nurse saves a man being chased by thugs in an underground parking garage, only to discover he's been poisoned and is searching for her.
context:
Title: Dangerous Encounter
Description: A nurse saves a man being chased by thugs in an underground parking garage, only to discover he's been poisoned and is searching for her.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

Female nurse LI RONGYUE walks toward her car while talking on the phone.

LI RONGYUE
(on phone)
Don't worry, just enjoy your date with your rich boyfriend.

A man in black, PEI HENG, stumbles from behind a pillar, his movements labored.

LI RONGYUE
(on phone)
No one noticed I covered your shift.

As LI RONGYUE reaches for her car door, PEI HENG lunges forward, muffling her startled cry and pulling her behind the vehicle.

LI RONGYUE
(terrified, muffled)
Hey! Ahhh!

PEI HENG fumbles with the back door, urgency in his trembling hands.

Three THUGS holding clubs and knives rush into the parking garage.

INT. CAR - CONTINUOUS

PEI HENG collapses against LI RONGYUE, his hand gently but firmly covering her mouth, his breathing ragged.

LI RONGYUE
(struggling, muffled)
Ahhh!

PEI HENG
(whispering, desperate)
Please... be quiet. They'll kill us both.

LI RONGYUE's eyes widen in recognition, then steel with resolve.

LI RONGYUE
(inner monologue)
That face... from the news? The missing CEO?

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - CONTINUOUS

The LEAD THUG and his two lackeys scan the area, their footsteps echoing.

LEAD THUG
Damn it! He can't be far, not with that poison in his system. Split up!

INT. CAR - CONTINUOUS

PEI HENG's grip loosens as his strength fades.

PEI HENG
(whisper fading)
Don't... move.

LI RONGYUE watches the thugs approach, her medical training warring with her fear.

LI RONGYUE
(inner monologue)
His pulse is erratic. He's dying.

LI RONGYUE grabs PEI HENG's wrist, pressing her thumb urgently to his radial pulse.

LI RONGYUE
(aloud, firm)
Stay with me.

She shifts abruptly, leaning out the window with calculated annoyance.

LI RONGYUE
(shouting at the thugs)
Excuse me! Do you mind? Some of us are trying to have a private moment here!

The THUGS freeze, caught off guard.

LI RONGYUE turns back to PEI HENG, her voice dropping to a honeyed whisper.

LI RONGYUE
Hold on, love. I'll get rid of them.

She leans out again, brandishing her hospital ID.

LI RONGYUE
I'm a nurse, and this is my break. You want me filing a harassment report?

LEAD THUG
(stammering)
We... we didn't realize—

LI RONGYUE
Then keep walking!

The THUGS retreat, glancing back suspiciously.

Li Rongyue slumps back inside, sealing the doors. She turns to PEI HENG, now convulsing gently.

LI RONGYUE
What's in your system? How much time?

PEI HENG
(voice cracking)
Need... hospital. But they'll be watching.

His hand clutches hers, accidentally snagging her necklace.

LI RONGYUE
My necklace—

The chain breaks. PEI HENG collapses against her shoulder, unconscious.
continuation:
INT. CAR - LATER

LI RONGYUE sits alone in the back seat, her uniform disheveled, clutching her broken chain.

PEI HENG (V.O.)
I will find you.

LI RONGYUE exits the car. A ruby pendant lies on the seat.

PEI HENG's fingers close around it as consciousness returns.

CLOSE-UP: LI RONGYUE's ID badge, reading "Name: Li Rongyue, Position: Emergency Nurse, Number: H027."

CLOSE-UP of PEI HENG's face, his eyes burning with grim determination.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - LATER

PEI HENG leans against the car, weak but upright. Three SUBORDINATES in suits approach with medical equipment.

SUBORDINATE
Young Master Pei, your security detail failed. The antidote—

PEI HENG
(cutting him off)
Find the woman who saved me. She dropped this.

He holds up the ruby pendant.

PEI HENG
She's about 5'4", mid-twenties, works at Central Hospital. And she risked her life for a stranger.

SUBORDINATE
We'll have her located within the hour.

PEI HENG
Bring her to me safely. And find out who poisoned me.

FLASHBACK

INT. HOSPITAL LOCKER ROOM - DAY

LI RONGYUE sits on a bench, examining her broken necklace chain. The ruby pendant is missing. A COLLEAGUE NURSE enters.

COLLEAGUE NURSE
You okay? You look exhausted.

LI RONGYUE
(carefully)
Long shift. Thought I lost something important.

She touches her bare neck.

LI RONGYUE
Turns out I did.

COLLEAGUE NURSE
Director needs you in trauma bay two. Possible poisoning case.

LI RONGYUE stands, her expression hardening with recognition.

LI RONGYUE
I'm on my way.

title: Save My Boss
description: A delivery man at rock bottom is struck by lightning and receives a mysterious call from a trapped CEO who promises him wealth in exchange for rescue.
context:
Title: Save My Boss
Description: A delivery man at rock bottom is struck by lightning and receives a mysterious call from a trapped CEO who promises him wealth in exchange for rescue.

INT. STAIRWELL - NIGHT

Delivery man WU YAOZU, late twenties, sprints down a fire escape, the delivery box slamming against his spine. Rain streaks the tiny window above. He juggles his phone with one hand.

WU YAOZU
(into phone)
Three minutes! This elevator's been down for a week—

LANDLORD'S AGENT (V.O.)
My boss doesn't care about your logistics, Wu. Rent's due midnight.

WU YAOZU
(pleading)
I have cash. Right here, from my best route. Please, until Friday.

LANDLORD'S AGENT (V.O.)
Half measures get evicted. I've got three guys waiting to change those locks.

The line cuts. Wu stares at his cracked phone screen—his wallpaper shows him and LIU FANG in happier times. He stops on the landing and slowly removes his helmet, letting it roll down the stairs. He just sits, breathing hard.

WU YAOZU
(whispered)
Fangfang's deposit...

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Wu limps along the curb, favoring his ankle. Rain begins to fall. Across the street, a Bentley's hazard lights flash. Through the windshield, he glimpses LIU FANG checking her reflection.

WU YAOZU
(freezing)
Fang...

He glances both ways and jogs across.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

LIU FANG sits in the passenger seat, her phone buzzing with missed calls from "Yaozu ❤️". She silences it without looking. Beside her, MA ZHIWEI, fortyish, checks a contract.

LIU FANG
Her mother's surgery is scheduled. Monday morning.

MA ZHIWEI
Good. Sign this, and the private room is covered. Plus the tuition.

He produces a pen. She hesitates, then signs with a flourish.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Wu taps on the tinted window. It hums down. Liu Fang's eyes meet his—no surprise, just resignation.

WU YAOZU
(out of breath)
Your mom said you weren't home. I was worried.

LIU FANG
I have a new home now. Third ring road. Two bedrooms.

WU YAOZU
(quietly)
The bride price... I'm two months away. The night shifts—

LIU FANG
(interrupting)
Mom's dialysis is weekly. My sister's cram school is monthly. You're counting in months.

She holds his gaze, her voice dropping.

LIU FANG
(quietly)
You can't save everyone, Yaozu. I can't wait for everyone's happy ending.

MA ZHIWEI leans into view, his hand resting on her shoulder.

MA ZHIWEI
Now you're just making her feel guilty. That's not love, boy.

Two BODYGUARDS step from the shadows. One gently takes Wu's arm.

MA ZHIWEI
(to Bodyguard)
Get his jacket. It's worth more than he makes in a week. Consider it... interest.

title: Brother, Spoil Me Sweetly
description: When a corporate heir saves a frightened girl from bullies, he reshapes both their destinies. Ten years later, her eighteenth birthday becomes a crucible of hidden truths and dangerous revelations.
context:
Title: Brother, Spoil Me Sweetly
Description: When a corporate heir saves a frightened girl from bullies, he reshapes both their destinies. Ten years later, her eighteenth birthday becomes a crucible of hidden truths and dangerous revelations.

EXT. STREET - DAY

Rain slicks the pavement outside an exclusive private school. A black Maybach glides to the curb.

ASSISTANT XU (40s, meticulous) opens the rear door with gloved hands.

ASSISTANT XU
Third Master. Your evening schedule is cleared.

PEI SHANGYU (28, sharp suit, tired eyes) emerges, loosening his tie. He takes a worn leather backpack.

PEI SHANGYU
I'll walk from here. Pick me up at nine.

ASSISTANT XU
Sir, your father specifically requested—

PEI SHANGYU
—That I stop being late? Message received.

He slings the backpack over his shoulder and cuts through the park.

EXT. PARK LAWN - DAY

Five TEENS encircle a small figure—AN YAN (8, oversized uniform, defiant chin). They flick popcorn at her like stones.

TEEN LEADER
 charity case trailer trash

YOUNG AN YAN wipes her face, silent, fists clenched.

Pei Shangyu's polished shoes crunch through the gravel.

PEI SHANGYU
(cold authority)
The headmaster's office. Now.

The teens scatter. He kneels, brushing kernels from her hair. His fingers pause on a scar behind her ear—faint, old.

PEI SHANGYU
(quieter)
Do you always let them see you bleed?

YOUNG AN YAN
Only on the outside.

Pei Shangyu studies her: this feral, intelligent child.

PEI SHANGYU
What's your name?

YOUNG AN YAN
An Yan. It means "peaceful." It lied.

PEI SHANGYU
Come home with me.

YOUNG AN YAN
(eyes narrowing)
Why would you want that?

PEI SHANGYU
Because someone should have done it for me.

He offers his hand. She takes it, small fingers disappearing in his.

BLACK SCREEN

ON SCREEN: TEN YEARS OF SILENCE
continuation:
INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM - EVENING

AN YAN (18, restless grace) kicks off designer heels, her school uniform replaced by a silk slip dress. She checks her phone—nothing.

AN YAN
Mrs. Chen, has my brother called?

HOUSEKEEPER MRS. CHEN (60s, stern but fond) polishes crystal, not looking up.

MRS. CHEN
Third Master is in a closed-door meeting. He said, and I quote: "Tell her I'm not dead, just detained."

AN YAN
(small smile fading)
He missed my art exhibition. My mock exams. My—

MRS. CHEN
—eighteenth birthday. Yes, Miss An. The flowers arrived.

Guilt laces her tone. An Yan softens.

AN YAN
I know. It's just... today feels different.

Her phone BUZZES. A text from an unknown number: "Suite 2201. The surprise he couldn't bring himself to give you."

An Yan's breath catches. She grabs a coat.

MRS. CHEN
Miss—your security detail—

But An Yan is already gone.

INT. STAR SHORE HOTEL - SUITE 2201 - NIGHT

An Yan enters the darkened suite, city lights bleeding through floor-to-ceiling windows.

AN YAN
Brother?

Silence. Then—movement. Pei Shangyu emerges from shadows, but it's wrong: his shirt is untucked, his jaw clenched, a wine glass shattered on the carpet.

PEI SHANGYU
(low, dangerous)
You shouldn't have come.

He backs her against the wall. Not tenderly—strategically. His body shields hers from the open balcony door.

AN YAN
You're scaring me.

PEI SHANGYU
Good. Now you're paying attention.

He grips her wrist—firm, not cruel—and presses something cold into her palm: a data drive.

PEI SHANGYU
(against her ear)
In five minutes, men will break down that door. They think you're the key to destroying me. Prove them wrong.

His lips brush her temple. Not a kiss. A calculation.

PEI SHANGYU
Run. Or become a weapon. Your choice.

The door SHATTERS. Pei Shangyu shoves An Yan behind him, spreading his arms wide—a shield, a sacrifice, a wolf baring its throat.

BLACK SCREEN

ON SCREEN: CHOOSE LOYALTY OR LEGACY

title: Mr. Mo, Come Spoil Me
description: A woman with a birthmark marries a rumored invalid, but both harbor secrets that make them far more capable than they appear.
context:
Title: Mr. Mo, Come Spoil Me
Description: A woman with a birthmark marries a rumored invalid, but both harbor secrets that make them far more capable than they appear.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

SU MUYAN wears a red Chinese-style wedding dress, a prominent birthmark visible on her face. She looks terrified as a knife is held to her throat.

KIDNAPPER (V.O.)
Who are you?

SU MUYAN
Who am I?

INT. STUDY - DAY

MO BEIHAN sits at a desk, the BUTLER standing behind him. He is speaking to the kidnappers through an earpiece.

MO BEIHAN
Third time this month. My uncle's men never learn.

KIDNAPPER (V.O.)
Hmph, Mo Beihan actually married an ugly freak.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

The KIDNAPPER holds SU MUYAN hostage with a knife.

KIDNAPPER
Don't move!

KIDNAPPER (V.O.)
Mo Beihan, if you want your woman to live, surrender the Jiangnan project now.
continuation:
INT. STUDY - DAY

MO BEIHAN listens to the phone expressionlessly.

MO BEIHAN
A forced bride? Expendable. But billion-dollar assets? That's the real leverage.

KIDNAPPER (V.O.)
Hmph, you really are heartless.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

The kidnapper's knife presses closer to SU MUYAN's throat. Suddenly, another KIDNAPPER is sent flying. SU MUYAN seizes the opportunity to fight back, taking the knife and subduing the kidnapper.

INT. BALCONY - DAY

SU MUYAN and MO BEIHAN stand facing each other.

MO BEIHAN
I never expected that someone the Su family didn't want would have such skills. Truly impressive.

SU MUYAN
I heard Mo Beihan is a sickly invalid. You don't look like one to me.

MO BEIHAN
Such a sharp tongue... ugly freak.

SU MUYAN takes a small vial from her sleeve, her expression resolute.

SU MUYAN
This antidote—take it now.

MO BEIHAN suddenly grimaces in pain, his body weakening.

MO BEIHAN
(in pain)
Go!

SU MUYAN
(worried)
You... what's wrong...

MO BEIHAN clutches his chest in pain, his eyes becoming fierce.

SU MUYAN
(crying out)
Mo Beihan!

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

MO BEIHAN writhes in pain on the bed, the BUTLER trying to hold him down.

BUTLER (V.O.)
Young Master! The toxin is spreading!

MO BEIHAN
(roaring)
Get out!

SU MUYAN approaches.

BUTLER
Young Madam, don't come closer. The Young Master will hurt you.

SU MUYAN
I stabilized the formula. Get Dr. Chen!

BUTLER
Ah, yes.

The BUTLER hurries away. SU MUYAN walks to the bedside.

SU MUYAN
Let me check your pulse.

As she approaches, the delirious MO BEIHAN suddenly grabs her and pulls her onto the bed. MO BEIHAN pins her down, looking at her with eyes both dazed and aggressive.

TO BE CONTINUED

title: Showdown, I Am the Group's Young Miss
description: The heiress of a corporate empire goes undercover to investigate missing luxury goods and uncover corruption within a branch company.
context:
Title: Showdown, I Am the Group's Young Miss
Description: The heiress of a corporate empire goes undercover to investigate missing luxury goods and uncover corruption within a branch company.

EXT. REMOTE HIGHWAY - DAY

A refrigerated VAN with "XIA CORPORATION - LIQUID ASSETS" printed on the side drives along the highway. Three THUGS crouch in the bushes. The lead THUG BOSS wears a floral shirt.

THUG BOSS
Here it comes... here it comes...

His men throw a wooden board with nails onto the road. The van drives over it, TIRES BLOWING OUT. It brakes to an emergency stop.

THUG BOSS
Go!

The DRIVER gets out to check the tire. The THUGS, holding steel pipes, rush forward and surround the DRIVER. The THUG BOSS raises his steel pipe and smashes the car window with practiced precision.

INT. XIA CORPORATION CEO OFFICE - DAY

XIA MANTING studies a spreadsheet while XIA ZHIRONG examines a security photo of the wrecked van.

XIA MANTING
Third shipment this quarter. The insurance is bleeding us dry.

XIA ZHIRONG
(off photo)
That's not opportunistic theft. The security lock was dismantled with a key code. Someone on the inside gave them the route.

XIA MANTING
Father built that division himself. Every warehouse, every route.

XIA ZHIRONG
Let me embed. One week. I'll trace the inventory trails myself.

XIA MANTING
You'll be a ghost. No backup, no authority.

XIA ZHIRONG
Better. They'll think I'm just another desperate mid-level hire.
continuation:
INT. BRANCH COMPANY - SUPPLY CLOSET - NIGHT

MANAGER LU whispers into his phone.

MANAGER LU
(into phone)
...heard the Group's sending someone. Not sure when.

(listens)
No, not yet. But if it's the daughter--

(listens, face paling)
Understood. I'll handle it.

INT. BRANCH COMPANY HR DEPARTMENT - DAY

XIA ZHIRONG, now in budget business attire with her hair styled differently, walks into the HR floor carrying a worn portfolio. She approaches the office where HU HAI interviews candidates.

XIA ZHIRONG
(under her breath)
Let's see what you've been hiding.

She walks to the office door, knocks, then pushes it open. Inside, HU HAI and his secretary MINA are conducting interviews.

XIA ZHIRONG
(smiling)
Zhao Rong. Here for the assistant manager position.

MINA checks her list, then glances at Xia Zhirong's face. She leans close to HU HAI to whisper.

MINA
(whispering to HU HAI)
She looks exactly like the Group's photo--

HU HAI
(cutting her off, to Xia)
Your resume says logistics experience. Can you read inventory manifests?

XIA ZHIRONG
(meeting his gaze)
Every code. Every discrepancy.

The room goes silent. Hu Hai studies her, uneasy.

FADE OUT.

title: KTV Private Room
description: A young woman trying to earn money for her grandmother's medical treatment faces pressure at a KTV gathering with entertainment company executives.
context:
Title: KTV Private Room
Description: A young woman trying to earn money for her grandmother's medical treatment faces pressure at a KTV gathering with entertainment company executives.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Neon reflections pulse on black marble. BOSS JIANG (40s, gray suit, glasses) watches from the sofa, wine glass in hand.

BOSS ZHANG leads in five CHRISTMAS BUNNY GIRLS. SHEN XINGCHEN (20, pale, trembling) trails last, clutching a champagne bottle.

BOSS ZHANG
(to Boss Jiang)
Boss Jiang, take a look. These are the newest starlets our company just signed. Just say the word, and they can do many things for you.

BOSS ZHANG
(continuing)
Whichever one you like can come over and have a drink with you.

BOSS JIANG remains silent, observing. His gaze lingers on Shen Xingchen's trembling hands.

BOSS ZHANG
(pointing at one girl)
This one?

BOSS ZHANG
(pointing at another)
Or... this one?

BOSS ZHANG yanks SHEN XINGCHEN forward.

BOSS ZHANG
This one, come!

SHEN XINGCHEN
(to Boss Zhang)
Boss Zhang, didn't you say I would only be selling alcohol?

BOSS ZHANG
(dismissively)
Are you really pure or just pretending? Which entertainment company signs artists just to sell drinks? Can selling drinks give you a twenty thousand yuan commission per night? Hurry up and go!

SHEN XINGCHEN
Boss Zhang, you didn't make this clear when you signed the contract.

SHEN XINGCHEN puts the bottle in her hand on the table.

BOSS ZHANG shoves her. BOSS JIANG catches her—gently—then releases.

BOSS JIANG
continuation:
(cold)
Go.

BOSS JIANG pushes SHEN XINGCHEN away.

SHEN XINGCHEN
(straightening her clothes)

(looking at Boss Zhang)

(laughing awkwardly)

(raising his glass)

(to Boss Zhang)

BOSS JIANG sits behind his desk. An ASSISTANT hands him an envelope.

BOSS JIANG (V.O.)
So it really is her.

BOSS JIANG looks at the photo, his eyes becoming complex and profound. He signs the cheque beside the invoice.

title: Leng Anyu & Chu Qianxun Wedding
description: A cold-hearted playboy's wedding is disrupted when his bride appears in black and his uncle arrives to steal her away, revealing a deeper conspiracy.
context:
Title: Leng Anyu & Chu Qianxun Wedding
Description: A cold-hearted playboy's wedding is disrupted when his bride appears in black and his uncle arrives to steal her away, revealing a deeper conspiracy.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

LENG ANYU (Cold family playboy), wearing a black suit, grips the wedding bouquet with white knuckles on stage.

The doors slowly open. CHU QIANXUN (Chu family heiress), wearing a black strapless gown and a crown, enters with predatory grace.

ZHEN XIAOMI (Qianxun's stepmother) in the audience feigns shock, touching a black handkerchief to her lips.

ZHEN XIAOMI
(whispering)
This is so unlucky...

LENG ANYU sees CHU QIANXUN's outfit, his face livid.

LENG ANYU
Wearing funeral colors to our wedding? Have you lost your mind?

CHU QIANXUN
(smiling coldly)
I'm celebrating the death of your ambitions.

A mysterious man, UNCLE, wearing a black suit, calmly enters. The crowd murmurs.

LENG ANYU sees who it is, eyes widening in shock.

LENG ANYU
Uncle? You're actually here... to steal the bride?

UNCLE walks to CHU QIANXUN, gently adjusting her crown. They share a knowing look.

UNCLE kneels on one knee, producing a ring.

UNCLE
Miss Chu Qianxun, will you marry me... and bury them?

CHU QIANXUN
(voice echoing)
I will. But first, they must pay.

The lights flicker. Her eyes glow with supernatural intensity.

TRANSITION: ONE WEEK EARLIER

INT. NIGHTCLUB - NIGHT

Lights flashing, music blaring. CHU QIANXUN, with purple wig and smoky makeup, parties wildly. Her eyes betray hollow exhaustion.

DJ (V.O.)
This is the party of Miss Chu Qianxun, sole heir of Chu Group! DJ, drop the beat!

CHU QIANXUN stands on a red motorcycle, holding up a bottle.

CHU QIANXUN
All the drinks tonight are on me!

She throws cash into the air. The crowd goes wild. She whispers to herself.

CHU QIANXUN
(whisper)
Let's see how far they'll go...
continuation:
INT. CHU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

The TV shows news about CHU QIANXUN's nightclub party.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
North City socialite Chu Qianxun's wild social life continues as her engagement approaches...

CHU QIANXUN returns home in last night's party outfit. Her father FU XINHAN (Chu Group Chairman) slaps her. The sound echoes.

FU XINHAN
You disgrace! Today is your engagement banquet, and you shame us!

ZHEN XIAOMI steps forward, placing a restraining hand on his arm.

ZHEN XIAOMI
Why are you hitting her? She's just nervous about marrying Mr. Leng.

ZHEN XIAOMI's eyes dart to CHU QIANXUN with hidden calculation.

CHU QIANXUN's stepsister FU ANNI (Chu family stepdaughter) hands Qianxun a tissue.

FU ANNI
Yes Dad, Qianxun is still young. Here, wipe your face.

FU XINHAN
You two just keep spoiling her! Clean yourself up!

FU XINHAN storms off.

FU ANNI helps CHU QIANXUN up, her grip tight.

FU ANNI
Does it hurt? We can't be late.

INT. BANQUET HALL CORRIDOR - DAY

CHU QIANXUN changes into a black leather jacket with double braids, walking with FU ANNI toward the banquet hall.

CHU QIANXUN (V.O.)
Father, you're selling your daughter for glory. I won't let you have your way.

They meet LENG ANYU and his MOTHER arriving.

FU XINHAN
Hello, President Fu.

CHU QIANXUN looks at LENG ANYU with disdain and lights a cigarette with her lighter.

FU ANNI immediately steps forward and takes away her cigarette, fingers pressing Qianxun's wrist.

FU ANNI
Stop smoking. It'll ruin your complexion for the cameras.

FU ANNI hands her a steaming cup of tea.

FU ANNI
Here, this is your favorite flower tea. It'll calm you down.

CHU QIANXUN takes the teacup and drinks. Suddenly, she feels dizzy. The teacup falls and shatters. She collapses.

FU ANNI
(panicked)
Qianxun, what's wrong? Qianxun! Qianxun!

LENG ANYU stands aside with a smug smile. FU ANNI looks up at him, mouthing: "It's done."

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

CHU QIANXUN lies unconscious on the bed. LENG ANYU leans over, unbuttoning his collar, shadow looming.

CHU QIANXUN
(waking up)
Help! Let me go!

She struggles, grabbing a glass ornament and smashing it on LENG ANYU's head. He clutches his head, blood trickling.

LENG ANYU
(in pain)
Ah! Damn it, you bitch!

CHU QIANXUN escapes barefoot.

INT. SPIRAL STAIRCASE - NIGHT

CHU QIANXUN, wearing a nightgown, runs down the stairs and encounters FU ANNI at the landing.

CHU QIANXUN
(pleading)
Sister, save me! He tried to—

FU ANNI
(cold smile)
I know. That's the plan.

FU ANNI suddenly reaches out and pushes CHU QIANXUN down the stairs.

LENG ANYU chases down from upstairs, witnessing everything, eyes wide with shock.

CHU QIANXUN falls to the bottom of the stairs, head bleeding, motionless.

FU ANNI
(whispering to Leng Anyu)
The Chu fortune is ours now.

INT. CHU QIANXUN'S BEDROOM - DAY

CHU QIANXUN's eyes snap open. She's back in her nightclub outfit, on the motorcycle, cash in hand. The DJ's voice echoes.

DJ (V.O.)
This is the party of Miss Chu Qianxun, sole heir of Chu Group! DJ, drop the beat!

She looks around, disoriented, touching her head where the wound should be. She sees the date on her phone: ONE WEEK EARLIER.

CHU QIANXUN
(whisper)
I'm... back?

She crushes the cash in her fist, eyes turning cold and calculating.

CHU QIANXUN
Then let's play a different game this time.

title: Prison Birth and Revenge
description: A woman imprisoned for a crime gives birth in custody, and five years later faces her vengeful ex-husband upon release.
context:
Title: Prison Birth and Revenge
Description: A woman imprisoned for a crime gives birth in custody, and five years later faces her vengeful ex-husband upon release.

INT. PRISON - DAY

Quick cuts of the prison watchtower and barbed wire fences.

INT. PRISON INFIRMARY - DAY

YE JIUXUE, wearing a prison uniform, lies on a hospital bed with her wrists secured to the rails, screaming in agony from labor pains.

FLASHBACK:

INT. CONVERTIBLE CAR - DAY

MU YICHEN and a VERY PREGNANT YE JIUXUE share tamarind candy, laughing together.

MU YICHEN
So sour. Our little tradition.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. PRISON INFIRMARY - DAY

YE JIUXUE continues to scream in pain, sweat soaking her hair.

FLASHBACK:

INT. CONVERTIBLE CAR - DAY

MU YICHEN sits with another WOMAN, eating the same tamarind. His face is stone.

MU YICHEN
Drive. Before I remember.

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
INT. PRISON INFIRMARY - DAY

YE JIUXUE struggles in pain as the DOCTOR performs the procedure.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Baby born at 18:35, weighing three kilograms, female. Ward of the state.

YE JIUXUE lies exhausted, her eyes vacant but burning with quiet fury.

INT. PRISON CELL - NIGHT

A beam of light falls on the floor. YE JIUXUE is curled up on the ground, crying in anguish.

YE JIUXUE
(whispering, to her child)
An'an... wait for mommy to get out of prison. I will definitely bring you home.

ON SCREEN: FIVE YEARS LATER

EXT. HELIPAD - DAY

A helicopter lands. MU YICHEN sits in the cabin, his expression cold, clutching a faded candy wrapper.

FAST CUTS/FLASHBACK:

MU YICHEN (V.O.)
You chose him. You chose prison over our family.

YE JIUXUE (V.O.)
I chose the truth. You chose revenge.

MU YICHEN (V.O.)
I chose to forget I ever loved you.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

MU YICHEN gets out of a white Rolls-Royce convertible and sits in the driver's seat.

MU YICHEN
(on phone)
Secretary Lin, bring the termination papers.

EXT. PRISON GATE - DAY

YE JIUXUE's hand reaches toward the sunlight.

YE JIUXUE (V.O.)
Finally released. An'an, mommy is coming for you.

YE JIUXUE stands outside the prison, looking up at the sky with a determined expression.

EXT. SUBURBAN ROAD - DAY

YE JIUXUE walks alone on the road. MU YICHEN stands in front of her, blocking her way.

MU YICHEN
Ye Jiuxue, get in the car with me.

YE JIUXUE
No.

MU YICHEN
I don't want to repeat myself a second time.

YE JIUXUE
(angry)
Five years of your influence, making sure I suffered. Isn't that enough?

MU YICHEN
(closing in, through gritted teeth)
Sign the papers. Give up your rights as a mother.

YE JIUXUE
(screaming)
Never! She's MY daughter!

MU YICHEN
(voice low)
You lost that right. Murderer.

He grabs her wrist. She fights back.

The frame freezes on their confrontation.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Ice Queen CEO's Wife Runs Away With The Baby
description: After a one-night stand with her billionaire boss, a woman discovers she's pregnant and decides to flee rather than face his wrath.
context:
Title: The Ice Queen CEO's Wife Runs Away With The Baby
Description: After a one-night stand with her billionaire boss, a woman discovers she's pregnant and decides to flee rather than face his wrath.

TITLE CARD: THE ICE QUEEN CEO'S WIFE RUNS AWAY WITH THE BABY

MONTAGE:

- GU YUNTING and JIANG YINING passionately kissing in a hallway.
- GU YUNTING lifts JIANG YINING up and carries her into a room.
- They fall onto a bed, JIANG YINING's glasses fall off.
- JIANG YINING tugs at GU YUNTING's tie.
- JIANG YINING quietly gets up and puts on her clothes.

END MONTAGE.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

GU YUNTING and JIANG YINING lie in bed, both asleep.

JIANG YINING wakes first. She opens her eyes in confusion, then jolts upright, seeing GU YUNTING beside her.

JIANG YINING (V.O.)
My boss. The man who eats people alive.

She slides out carefully, dressing with shaking hands.

JIANG YINING (V.O.)
If he finds me, I'm dead.

She grabs her bag and flees.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - LATER

GU YUNTING wakes, frowning. He sits up, sees he's alone.

He gets out of bed. Spots her resume on the floor: "JIANG YINING."

He photographs it.

GU YUNTING
(on phone)
Xiao Xu. Find her.

EXT. OUTDOORS - DAY

ASSISTANT XU answers quickly.

ASSISTANT XU
Yes, President Gu.

TRANSITION: ONE MONTH LATER

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

JIANG YINING sits alone on a bench, holding a test report, her expression grave.

JIANG YINING (V.O.)
Positive.

She touches her abdomen, her jaw setting with determination.

JIANG YINING (V.O.)
They'd take my baby. I have to disappear.

Her phone rings. She answers.

JIANG YINING
Hello?

INT. LIN XIAOXIAO'S APARTMENT - DAY

LIN XIAOXIAO sits on the sofa, talking on the phone.

LIN XIAOXIAO
Yining, thank God. Can you cover my rent this month? I'm desperate.

JIANG YINING
I'll send it.

LIN XIAOXIAO
Lifesaver. Hey, can I borrow that bracelet you left here?

JIANG YINING
Keep it.

A knock at the door.

LIN XIAOXIAO gets up to answer it.

INT. APARTMENT ENTRANCE - CONTINUOUS

LIN XIAOXIAO opens the door to see GU YUNTING in a suit standing there, with two MEN IN BLACK behind him.

LIN XIAOXIAO looks stunned.

LIN XIAOXIAO
May I ask who you're looking for?

GU YUNTING looks at her expressionlessly.
full_script:
Title: The Ice Queen CEO's Wife Runs Away With The Baby
Description: After a one-night stand with her billionaire boss, a woman discovers she's pregnant and decides to flee rather than face his wrath.

TITLE CARD: THE ICE QUEEN CEO'S WIFE RUNS AWAY WITH THE BABY

MONTAGE:

- GU YUNTING and JIANG YINING passionately kissing in a hallway.
- GU YUNTING lifts JIANG YINING up and carries her into a room.
- They fall onto a bed, JIANG YINING's glasses fall off.
- JIANG YINING tugs at GU YUNTING's tie.
- JIANG YINING quietly gets up and puts on her clothes.

END MONTAGE.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

GU YUNTING and JIANG YINING lie in bed, both asleep.

JIANG YINING wakes first. She opens her eyes in confusion, then jolts upright, seeing GU YUNTING beside her.

JIANG YINING (V.O.)
My boss. The man who eats people alive.

She slides out carefully, dressing with shaking hands.

JIANG YINING (V.O.)
If he finds me, I'm dead.

She grabs her bag and flees.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - LATER

GU YUNTING wakes, frowning. He sits up, sees he's alone.

He gets out of bed. Spots her resume on the floor: "JIANG YINING."

He photographs it.

GU YUNTING
(on phone)
Xiao Xu. Find her.

EXT. OUTDOORS - DAY

ASSISTANT XU answers quickly.

ASSISTANT XU
Yes, President Gu.

TRANSITION: ONE MONTH LATER

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

JIANG YINING sits alone on a bench, holding a test report, her expression grave.

JIANG YINING (V.O.)
Positive.

She touches her abdomen, her jaw setting with determination.

JIANG YINING (V.O.)
They'd take my baby. I have to disappear.

Her phone rings. She answers.

JIANG YINING
Hello?

INT. LIN XIAOXIAO'S APARTMENT - DAY

LIN XIAOXIAO sits on the sofa, talking on the phone.

LIN XIAOXIAO
Yining, thank God. Can you cover my rent this month? I'm desperate.

JIANG YINING
I'll send it.

LIN XIAOXIAO
Lifesaver. Hey, can I borrow that bracelet you left here?

JIANG YINING
Keep it.

A knock at the door.

LIN XIAOXIAO gets up to answer it.

INT. APARTMENT ENTRANCE - CONTINUOUS

LIN XIAOXIAO opens the door to see GU YUNTING in a suit standing there, with two MEN IN BLACK behind him.

LIN XIAOXIAO looks stunned.

LIN XIAOXIAO
May I ask who you're looking for?

GU YUNTING looks at her expressionlessly.

title: The Cherished Heiress - Spoiled by Four Powerful Brothers
description: A young woman working as a delivery driver to support her busy husband is suddenly confronted by four powerful men who reveal themselves as her brothers, asking her to come home.
context:
Title: The Cherished Heiress - Spoiled by Four Powerful Brothers
Description: A young woman working as a delivery driver to support her busy husband is suddenly confronted by four powerful men who reveal themselves as her brothers, asking her to come home.

EXT. FRESH MARKET ENTRANCE - DAY

FAST CUTS: A row of luxurious black sedans cuts through twilight traffic.

Several MALE DELIVERY DRIVERS in yellow uniforms squat at a "Fresh Market" entrance, shivering.

DELIVERY DRIVER A
So cold!

DELIVERY DRIVER B
Delivering in this freeze—it's a wonder we don't freeze solid.

An electric scooter WHIRS. LIN YIMO (Lin Family Heiress) removes her helmet, revealing wind-chapped cheeks. Her uniform is threadbare but clean. The male drivers stare.

DELIVERY DRIVER A
Young lady. So young, already delivering. Husband doesn't mind?

LIN YIMO
My husband works hard. I want to lighten his burden.

She turns to her delivery box, methodically checking orders.

DELIVERY DRIVER B
Women should be cherished. No matter his wealth, if he doesn't value you...

DELIVERY DRIVER C
Exactly.

A convoy of luxury vehicles—Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Mercedes—parks illegally. The drivers stand, transfixed.

DELIVERY DRIVER A
Latest Rolls-Royce model. Twenty million. I'm actually seeing a Bentley too!

A door opens. LIN YIDA (Undefeated War God) steps out, scar crossing his temple.

DELIVERY DRIVER A (O.S.)
continuation:
(shocked)
War God Lin Yida. Eight hundred warriors. Conquered territories.

Another door opens. LIN YILI (King of Archaeology) steps out, polishing a small bronze artifact.

DELIVERY DRIVER B (O.S.)
Archaeology King Lin Yili. Qin's tomb. National Association President.

A third door opens. LIN YIBAI (Divine Physician) emerges, medical bag in hand.

DELIVERY DRIVER C (O.S.)
Divine Physician Lin Yibai. Brings back the dead. Medical legend.

DELIVERY DRIVER A
Three young masters from a super family. The last one must be—

Inside the Rolls-Royce, LIN YIHAN (Trillionaire Heir) looks up from his tablet, then exits. His gaze finds Lin Yimo immediately.

DELIVERY DRIVER A (O.S.)
(voice trembling)
Lin Yihan. Built Lin Corporation. Worth trillions. The heir.

DELIVERY DRIVER A
Four legends. I must be dreaming.

The brothers stand together, their formation instinctive. They walk toward Lin Yimo.

THE FOUR LIN BROTHERS
Little sister, come home with us.

LIN YIMO looks at them, her face crumpling for a heartbeat before she steels it. Her hand finds her wedding ring.

LIN YIMO
(whisper)
I am home.

FREEZE FRAME on her conflicted eyes as "TO BE CONTINUED" appears.

FADE OUT.

title: The Heavenly Life Creditor
description: A mysterious young man with the power to borrow life from heaven arrives at a wealthy family's estate as the patriarch lies dying.
context:
Title: The Heavenly Life Creditor
Description: A mysterious young man with the power to borrow life from heaven arrives at a wealthy family's estate as the patriarch lies dying.

INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - DAY

A luxury motorcade glides along a tree-lined road. In the back seat, YE GUODONG (50s, black tailcoat, granite demeanor) clutches a jade amulet, eyes closed in meditation.

EXT. LUXURY ESTATE - DAY

The motorcade stops at a marble mansion. BODYGUARDS in black suits snap to attention as the DRIVER opens Ye Guodong's door.

INT. VILLA HALL - DAY

YE GUOLIANG (40s, gray suit, bloodshot eyes) freezes mid-stride, phone clutched white-knuckled, as Ye Guodong enters.

YE GUOLIANG
(quietly breaking)
He's still breathing. But the machines...

YE GUODONG
How long?

Ye Guoliang shakes his head. They move toward the stairs in unison.
continuation:
EXT. PARK - DAY

GU QING (20s, black tangzhuang, still as a heron) stands beneath a ginkgo tree, watching golden leaves fall in reverse.

GU QING (V.O.)
Heaven's ledger balances all debts. Some accounts... I choose to reopen.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

OLD MR. YE (70s) lies corpse-pale, ventilator hissing. The DOCTOR packs his instruments with painful slowness.

YE GUOLIANG
(barely controlled)
There must be something. Experimental, illegal, I don't care--

DOCTOR
(quietly)
The heart is a house with all lights out. I cannot undo time.

Ye Guodong's jaw tightens. He turns to find GU QING standing inside the doorway, untouched by the bodyguards who flank him.

YE GUODONG
(low, dangerous)
How did you get past security?

GU QING
(gesturing to the dying man)
The same way I'll pass through death's door.

Ye Guoliang steps between them.

YE GUOLIANG
Who is this?

YE GUODONG
(never breaking eye contact)
A ghost story. From our grandfather's time.

GU QING
Flesh merchants call us many things. Life Creditor is... polite.

The brothers lock eyes. Outside the window, autumn leaves suddenly swirl as if caught in a summer storm--then freeze mid-air.

CLOSE-UP: GU QING's pupils become twin golden coins, ancient and unreadable.
