title: Unfilial Son, How Do You Know the Family is Rich?
description: A wealthy chairman disguises himself as a poor security guard to test his lazy son, hiding his fortune while pretending to struggle financially.
context:
Title: Unfilial Son, How Do You Know the Family is Rich?
Description: A wealthy chairman disguises himself as a poor security guard to test his lazy son, hiding his fortune while pretending to struggle financially.

INT. STREET - DAY

Multiple black sedans stop at the roadside. BODYGUARDS quickly exit the cars and form a perimeter.

NAN SISI (Executive Assistant) emerges from the lead car, elegant and poised.

QIAN WANCAI (Chairman of Wanguan Company), wearing a white suit, steps out with practiced authority.

NAN SISI
Chairman, our real estate investment just cleared final valuation. It's worth triple what we paid.

QIAN WANCAI
Good. Transfer ten million to the community outreach fund. And here—

QIAN WANCAI hands her a black card. It slips from his fingers, sliding down inside his jacket lining.

NAN SISI
(helping retrieve it)
Let me get that.

QIAN WANCAI
Thanks. Now, the uniform?

NAN SISI produces a folded security guard uniform from the car.

NAN SISI
Are you sure about this, Uncle? The quarterly—

QIAN WANCAI
—reports can wait. This can't.

He disappears behind the open car door. Emerges moments later in the uniform, rolling his shoulders uncomfortably.

QIAN WANCAI
Did you bring the "props"?

NAN SISI
(handing him a worn briefcase)
Old phone, no smart pay. Cash only. Just like you requested.

She also slips him a folded envelope.

NAN SISI
His resume rejections. All seventeen of them.

QIAN WANCAI
(pocketing it)
He doesn't know I forwarded those companies his gaming history, does he?

NAN SISI
No, sir. He thinks he's just unlucky.

QIAN WANCAI
Not luck. Character. We'll see if he notices the difference.

The bodyguards pile back into the sedans. They drive off, leaving QIAN WANCAI alone on the sidewalk, briefcase in hand.

INT. RENTAL APARTMENT - DAY

QIAN DUODUO, mid-twenties, lounges on a threadbare sofa, thumbs dancing over his phone.

QIAN DUODUO
(to game)
One more hit, one more... Yes!

QIAN WANCAI enters, uniform slightly askew. He sets the briefcase down with deliberate heaviness.

QIAN WANCAI
Rent's due tomorrow.

QIAN DUODUO
(not looking up)
I said I'll handle it.

QIAN WANCAI
Handle it? With what? You've got four hundred in your account.

QIAN DUODUO pauses his game. Looks at his father for the first time.

QIAN DUODUO
How do you know—

QIAN WANCAI
—because I'm the one covering your overdrafts. Every month.

He points to a bank statement on the coffee table, circled in red.

QIAN DUODUO
(deflating)
I told you I'm trying.

QIAN WANCAI
Trying? Or waiting for something to fall into your lap?

QIAN WANCAI picks up the briefcase. Walks toward the bedroom.

QIAN WANCAI
I picked up an extra shift tonight. Don't forget to eat.

The bedroom door closes quietly.

QIAN DUODUO stares at the bank statement. His phone buzzes with a game notification. He ignores it.

QIAN DUODUO
(under his breath)
What's he planning now?
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

QIAN WANCAI opens the briefcase. Inside: bundles of cash, a security ID badge, and a small wireless camera disguised as a button.

He hides the briefcase beneath a false bottom in the wardrobe, then positions the camera to face the room.

QIAN WANCAI
(quietly)
Let's see if you even ask why I'm suddenly carrying cash.

INT. RENTAL APARTMENT - LATER

QIAN WANCAI emerges in a different, older uniform.

QIAN WANCAI
Forgot my lunch again. Left it on the counter.

He exits. The apartment falls silent.

QIAN DUODUO watches from the sofa. He waits ten seconds. Then twenty.

He puts his phone down. For the first time, it stays dark.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

QIAN DUODUO enters. He goes straight to the wardrobe, opens it.

He sees nothing unusual. Starts to close it.

Pauses.

His hand traces the wardrobe's bottom. Finds the seam. Presses.

The false bottom clicks open.

He stares at the cash. Then at the button camera, blinking red.

QIAN DUODUO
(to camera)
You wanted me to find this, didn't you?

He picks up a stack of bills. Runs his thumb across it. Then pulls out his phone.

He doesn't open a game. He opens the banking app.

Anger, shame, and something else flicker across his face. He looks at the camera again.

QIAN DUODUO
You think money's what I'm after? Really?

He pulls out the seventeen rejection emails from beneath the cash. Reads them. His jaw tightens.

QIAN DUODUO
You tested me. Fine. But did you ever test yourself?

He leaves the cash untouched. Closes the briefcase. Resets the false bottom.

From his pocket, he pulls out a folded job application. For a junior security position. Still blank.

He smooths it out on the wardrobe door. Fills in his name.

QIAN DUODUO
(quietly)
See you at work tomorrow, Old Qian.

He walks out, leaving the application where the camera can see it.

INT. SECURITY OFFICE - NIGHT

QIAN WANCAI watches a monitor. Sees his son walk away. Sees the application.

His phone rings. NAN SISI.

NAN SISI (V.O.)
Uncle? The board—

QIAN WANCAI
—can wait. And Sisi? Cancel the outreach fund.

NAN SISI (V.O.)
Cancel it?

QIAN WANCAI
Transfer it to the training program instead. For new security hires.

He hangs up. On screen, the application sits waiting.

QIAN WANCAI
(to monitor)
You passed. Now we'll see if I do.

The monitor shows QIAN DUODUO back at the sofa, phone in hand—but this time, searching job listings.

FADE OUT.

title: Flash Marriage: My Sugar Daddy Husband Gained Mind Reading
description: A woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal on their wedding day, unaware that her arranged marriage holds deeper secrets.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage: My Sugar Daddy Husband Gained Mind Reading
Description: A woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal on their wedding day, unaware that her arranged marriage holds deeper secrets.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

ZHOU ZIHENG and JIAN YUWEI are entangled on the velvet sofa, lipstick smudged on his collar.

ZHOU ZIHENG
(glancing toward the door)
The ceremony's in twenty minutes.

JIAN YUWEI
(fingers tracing his jaw)
Perfect timing. She won't leave her makeup chair until her entrance.

ZHOU ZIHENG
(stiffening)
If this costs me the merger shares—

JIAN YUWEI
My dear brother-in-law... by this time tomorrow, Jian Ning will have signed everything over. Then we can be as public as you like.

ZHOU ZIHENG
You have proof the documents are ready?

JIAN YUWEI
(leaning closer)
I have something better. I have her trust.

INT. BRIDE'S LOUNGE / EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

JIAN NING stands before a floor-length mirror, her wedding dress immaculate, phone pressed to her ear.

JIAN NING
Chu Yanchi. Highway traffic reports are green. You have no excuse.

CUT TO:

CHU YANCHI's gloved hands grip the steering wheel of a crimson Bugatti. The speedometer kisses 180 km/h.

CHU YANCHI
(voice calm through the speaker)
Your assistant is currently airborne. The contract's buckled in the passenger seat.

JIAN NING
(eyes narrowing)
Don't perform for me. Just deliver.

CHU YANCHI
I never perform, President Jian. I execute.

JIAN NING
(fingers tightening on the phone)
Three minutes.

She ends the call, gaze falling to the photo tucked in her phone case—her mother, younger, wearing the same stoic expression.

JIAN NING (V.O.)
Mom, you thought marriage would soften me. You were wrong. Today, I reclaim your empire. One signature at a time.
continuation:
INT. BRIDE'S LOUNGE - DAY

The PHOTOGRAPHER hovers in the doorway, camera ready.

PHOTOGRAPHER
Miss Jian, the publicity team requested pre-ceremony content for the company newsletter...

JIAN NING
(not turning)
Send it to my director of communications for approval. Every frame.

PHOTOGRAPHER
But Miss Zhou specifically said—

JIAN NING
(finally facing him, gaze like ice)
My sister doesn't sign your checks. I do. Now go. And if I see that camera turned on before I arrive, you'll be photographing pigeons in the park.

The photographer retreats. Jian Ning's shoulders drop one fraction.

JIAN NING
(softly, into the phone)
Chu Yanchi? New priority. Find out why my sister hired a photographer.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

The Bugatti's tires scream as CHU YANCHI brakes. He steps out, every movement precise, expensive. Time seems to slow around him.

ZHANG MAO
(whispering)
President Chu, the photographer's in place. Miss Jian's sister arranged it.

CHU YANCHI
(hand extended for the folder)
She wants leverage. She'll use it tonight.

ZHANG MAO
(fumbling with the contract)
Sir?

CHU YANCHI
(almost imperceptible smile)
Mind reading, Zhang Mao. It's called observation. Now go. You're her assistant today. Not mine.

He watches Zhang Mao enter, his eyes narrowing at the hotel's facade as if seeing through walls.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

JIAN NING's hand trembles on the doorknob. She steels herself, then pushes.

The room is dim, but the image is clear: ZHOU ZIHENG and JIAN YUWEI, caught mid-adjustment, her lipstick on his collar, his hand on her waist. Their faces freeze in twin masks of shock.

The PHOTOGRAPHER, positioned behind Jian Ning, captures everything.

JIAN NING
(to the photographer, voice steady)
Keep recording. Every second. This is my wedding gift to myself.

Title: Flash Marriage: My Sugar Daddy Husband Gained Mind Reading
Description: A woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal on their wedding day, unaware that her arranged marriage holds deeper secrets.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

ZHOU ZIHENG and JIAN YUWEI are entangled on the velvet sofa, lipstick smudged on his collar.

ZHOU ZIHENG
(glancing toward the door)
The ceremony's in twenty minutes.

JIAN YUWEI
(fingers tracing his jaw)
Perfect timing. She won't leave her makeup chair until her entrance.

ZHOU ZIHENG
(stiffening)
If this costs me the merger shares—

JIAN YUWEI
My dear brother-in-law... by this time tomorrow, Jian Ning will have signed everything over. Then we can be as public as you like.

ZHOU ZIHENG
You have proof the documents are ready?

JIAN YUWEI
(leaning closer)
I have something better. I have her trust.

INT. BRIDE'S LOUNGE / EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

JIAN NING stands before a floor-length mirror, her wedding dress immaculate, phone pressed to her ear.

JIAN NING
Chu Yanchi. Highway traffic reports are green. You have no excuse.

CUT TO:

CHU YANCHI's gloved hands grip the steering wheel of a crimson Bugatti. The speedometer kisses 180 km/h.

CHU YANCHI
(voice calm through the speaker)
Your assistant is currently airborne. The contract's buckled in the passenger seat.

JIAN NING
(eyes narrowing)
Don't perform for me. Just deliver.

CHU YANCHI
I never perform, President Jian. I execute.

JIAN NING
(fingers tightening on the phone)
Three minutes.

She ends the call, gaze falling to the photo tucked in her phone case—her mother, younger, wearing the same stoic expression.

JIAN NING (V.O.)
Mom, you thought marriage would soften me. You were wrong. Today, I reclaim your empire. One signature at a time.

INT. BRIDE'S LOUNGE - DAY

The PHOTOGRAPHER hovers in the doorway, camera ready.

PHOTOGRAPHER
Miss Jian, the publicity team requested pre-ceremony content for the company newsletter...

(not turning)
Send it to my director of communications for approval. Every frame.

PHOTOGRAPHER
But Miss Zhou specifically said—

JIAN NING
(finally facing him, gaze like ice)
My sister doesn't sign your checks. I do. Now go. And if I see that camera turned on before I arrive, you'll be photographing pigeons in the park.

JIAN NING
(softly, into the phone)
Chu Yanchi? New priority. Find out why my sister hired a photographer.

ZHANG MAO
(whispering)
President Chu, the photographer's in place. Miss Jian's sister arranged it.

CHU YANCHI
(hand extended for the folder)
She wants leverage. She'll use it tonight.

ZHANG MAO
(fumbling with the contract)
Sir?

CHU YANCHI
(almost imperceptible smile)
Mind reading, Zhang Mao. It's called observation. Now go. You're her assistant today. Not mine.

title: Return of the Son-in-Law
description: Li Shiheng, leader of the Liuhe Commerce Association, is ambushed in a warehouse and saved by the mysterious Ye Feng, to whom he pledges his loyalty and resources.
context:
Title: Return of the Son-in-Law
Description: Li Shiheng, leader of the Liuhe Commerce Association, is ambushed in a warehouse and saved by the mysterious Ye Feng, to whom he pledges his loyalty and resources.

INT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

Aerial shot of a massive industrial area. On-screen text reads: "Port City - Liuhe Warehouse District."

LI SHIHENG, blood at the corner of his mouth, is surrounded by more than a dozen men in black at the center of the warehouse.

BLACK-CLAD LEADER (O.S.)
Shiheng! There's no escape!

LI SHIHENG
(breathing heavily, defiant)
Twenty years I built Liuhe in this city. Come then. Let's see if you have the steel to finish what your masters started.

LI SHIHENG takes the initiative and fights the black-clad men. His skills are impressive, but he's outnumbered. Soon, a black-clad man holds a knife to his throat and pins him to the ground.

BLACK-CLAD MAN
(urgent whisper)
Time to retire, old man.

Just as the black-clad man is about to strike, a figure drops from the rafters with a kick, sending the attacker flying. The newcomer is YE FENG, wearing a black trench coat, with an extraordinary presence.

BLACK-CLAD MAN
Who are you?

YE FENG
(quiet, dangerous)
Wrong warehouse.

BLACK-CLAD LEADER
What audacity! Brothers, kill him!
continuation:
All the black-clad men rush at YE FENG. YE FENG moves with lethal economy, using precise strikes, quickly rendering all the black-clad men immobile. They lie motionless.

The roar of motorcycles is heard outside the warehouse. Four motorcycles speed in, followed by a large group of reinforcements in black suits.

SUBORDINATE
(anxiously)
President! The Four Pillars are coming! We got your tracker signal—

The reinforcements rush into the warehouse and freeze when they see the enemies on the ground and YE FENG standing unharmed. A subordinate runs to LI SHIHENG and kneels before him.

SUBORDINATE
(stricken)
We were blocked at the bridge. President, please forgive us!

LI SHIHENG ignores the subordinate and walks straight to YE FENG, kneeling on one knee. All the reinforcements behind him kneel in unison.

LI SHIHENG
(voice cracking)
You wear no colors. No banners. Yet you stand when I fall.

YE FENG
(helping LI SHIHENG up)
Please rise. I don't want this.

LI SHIHENG
(standing, intense)
They broke every rule of this city to take me down. You... you had no reason to interfere. Yet here I stand.

LI SHIHENG takes out a black card from his chest and hands it to YE FENG.

LI SHIHENG
The Eighth Card. There are only seven in existence. Until now. This isn't a favor—it's a foundation. Whatever you build in this city, Liuhe stands beneath it.

YE FENG takes the black card, looks at LI SHIHENG, deep in thought.

title: Cunning Sister's Flirtation
description: A mysterious woman with a powerful aura gives a special birthday gift to a handsome young man, while three days earlier, she confronts her captive in an abandoned factory.
context:
Title: Cunning Sister's Flirtation
Description: A mysterious woman with a powerful aura gives a special birthday gift to a handsome young man, while three days earlier, she confronts her captive in an abandoned factory.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Dim lighting, sensual music. ZHUANG LI (female, black dress, calculated command) pushes NING FENG (male, white shirt, guarded intensity) onto the sofa, tugging at his tie.

ZHUANG LI
Today is little brother's birthday. Big sister came to give you a gift.

ZHUANG LI leans down and kisses NING FENG. NING FENG closes his eyes, then opens them, grabbing her hand.

NING FENG
What contract am I signing?

ZHUANG LI
(caressing his lips)
Delivery confirmation.

NING FENG
(sharp gaze)
You can't afford the price.

ZHUANG LI
(whispering in his ear)
I already paid it.

NING FENG
Sister, you're playing with fire.

ZHUANG LI
No.

ZHUANG LI leans close to NING FENG again.

ZHUANG LI
Sister is collecting what's owed.

ZHUANG LI pushes NING FENG down onto the sofa, takes out a white cloth and covers his eyes, then leans down to kiss him deeply.
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - DAY

FLASHBACK - THREE DAYS AGO

In the dusty abandoned factory, two BLACK-CLAD HENCHMEN drag a woman with a black cloth over her head - ZHUANG YA.

ZHUANG YA
(struggling)
Let me go!

HENCHMAN
Stay still!

The HENCHMAN pushes ZHUANG YA to the ground and pulls off the black cloth. ZHUANG YA looks ahead with defiance.

A woman wearing a black lace mask - ZHUANG LI - sits leisurely in a chair, swirling a glass of red wine.

ZHUANG YA
(angry)
So it was you who kidnapped me. Do you know who I am? The lawyer for the Zhuang family. How dare you?

ZHUANG LI puts down her wine glass, rises, and walks slowly toward ZHUANG YA, suddenly slapping her to the ground.

ZHUANG LI
(laughing lightly)
Sister, hello there.

ZHUANG YA
(covering her face, incredulous)
You hit me? Aren't you afraid he'll retaliate?

ZHUANG LI
(laughing)
At a time like this, dear sister still hasn't figured out the situation.

ZHUANG LI gestures to the HENCHMAN beside her.

ZHUANG LI
Someone, help my sister recognize her situation.

A HENCHMAN walks toward the fallen ZHUANG YA with a tablet.

ZHUANG YA
(screaming in terror)
Don't come near me! Don't come near, he'll kill you for this!

ZHUANG LI
(standing)
He already knows. It's his twenty-first birthday present.

The HENCHMAN forces ZHUANG YA's thumb onto the tablet scanner. The beep echoes. ZHUANG YA's face drains of hope.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Radiant Like Her
description: A wealthy heiress hides her identity to live a simple life with the man she loves, only to face a turning point on their third anniversary.
context:
Title: Radiant Like Her
Description: A wealthy heiress hides her identity to live a simple life with the man she loves, only to face a turning point on their third anniversary.

INT. BARBECUE STALL - NIGHT

JIANG YAO, a young woman in a simple apron, skillfully grills meat skewers. Her scarred hands belie her noble birth.

EXT. CITY NIGHT ROAD - NIGHT

A convoy of black luxury cars speeds through the night.

QIN YUE (V.O.)
The old master is dying. Three years of silence is enough.

The lead car is a Rolls-Royce, imposing and powerful.

INT. BARBECUE STALL - NIGHT

JIANG YAO serves the grilled skewers to two male customers, THUG A and THUG B.

JIANG YAO
Enjoy.

THUG A suddenly grabs JIANG YAO's wrist.

THUG A
(grinning)
Boss lady, you're too good for this dump. Come work for me.

JIANG YAO struggles forcefully.

JIANG YAO
Let go of me!

THUG B also steps forward, and together with THUG A, they pull at JIANG YAO.

THUD B
Don't be shy. We'll triple your pay.

JIANG YAO
Let go of me!

THUG B
Just hear us out.

Suddenly, a BODYGUARD in a suit rushes forward and kicks THUG B away. More BODYGUARDS appear and quickly subdue the two thugs.

QIN YUE walks over, surrounded by bodyguards. He pulls out a stack of cash from his pocket and throws it on the ground.
continuation:
QIN YUE
This money buys your lives. Don't let me see you in Jiangzhou again. Get lost!

The two thugs scramble to pick up the money and flee.

QIN YUE turns to JIANG YAO and bows respectfully.

QIN YUE
Young lady, your father's final wish is to see you. The contract you signed gave you away.

JIANG YAO
(coldly)
I signed as Jiang Yao. Hui Zhou knows nothing.

QIN YUE
The board knows everything. They expect their chairwoman tomorrow.

JIANG YAO
(emotionally)
I have an anniversary. I promised Hui Zhou—

QIN YUE
Three years of secret assistance ends now. He thinks he earned his success alone.

JIANG YAO
(touching her simple wedding ring)
He did. I only opened doors.

QIN YUE
The Jiang family fortune of hundreds of millions needs its heir. Not a grill cook.

JIANG YAO
No more persuasion. Go back.

QIN YUE has no choice but to leave with the bodyguards.

JIANG YAO watches them go, then begins to pack up her stall. She picks up an exquisitely wrapped pink gift box, a happy smile on her face.

JIANG YAO (V.O.)
Tomorrow I tell him everything. Three years of secrets end at our anniversary.

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

A Rolls-Royce drives down the road.

JIANG YAO, holding the gift box, stands by the roadside, full of joy and anticipation.

The Rolls-Royce makes a beautiful drift and stops in front of JIANG YAO. The door opens, and a handsome man in a black coat with an extraordinary air steps out. This is HUI ZHOU.

HUI ZHOU looks at JIANG YAO, his eyes complex.

title: The Su Family Villa
description: After three years of silent servitude, Lin Fan's final hope shatters when he discovers his wife wearing a token that should have been impossible to obtain.
context:
Title: The Su Family Villa
Description: After three years of silent servitude, Lin Fan's final hope shatters when he discovers his wife wearing a token that should have been impossible to obtain.

INT. SU FAMILY VILLA LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

SU WEIWEI and SHEN YUMEI watch a Korean drama on the oversized TV. Wine glasses and imported snacks cover the marble table between them.

SU WEIWEI
(low, eyes on screen)
Do you think he'll actually choose her?

SHEN YUMEI
(loud, toward the stairs)
Lin Fan. We're waiting.

LIN FAN descends the stairs, gripping a sandalwood foot basin. His threadbare sleeves reveal scarred forearms. He moves with deliberate slowness.

LIN FAN
(setting the basin at SHEN YUMEI's feet)
The temperature you specified.

He kneels. SHEN YUMEI's foot jerks, spilling water across his hands.

SHEN YUMEI
(frowning)
Intentionally careless. Three years and you've learned nothing.

SU WEIWEI
(distant)
Don't scald yourself, Mom. The paperwork isn't finalized.

LIN FAN wipes the floor silently, his knuckles raw.

SHEN YUMEI
(to SU WEIWEI)
Quarterly premium's due next week. Then we can finally discuss arrangements.

SU WEIWEI
(stiffening)
I said that's enough.

The door opens. XU ZIHENG enters, custom suit catching the light. He surveys the scene with cold amusement.

XU ZIHENG
(to LIN FAN, not a question)
Still here.

LIN FAN
(rising, voice low)
continuation:
This is my home.

XU ZIHENG's shoe connects with LIN FAN's ribs. A sharp exhale.

SU WEIWEI
(crossing arms)
Don't mark his face. The adjusters take photos.

LIN FAN
(laughing, pained)
Three years of your tea, your warmth, and I'm an asset?

SU WEIWEI steps close. Her palm cracks against his cheek. The sound echoes.

SU WEIWEI
(quiet)
You were a solution. Know your place.

XU ZIHENG fingers the silver chain at SU WEIWEI's throat.

XU ZIHENG
The night wastes. Our buyers wait.

SU WEIWEI
(nodding, avoiding LIN FAN's eyes)
Tokyo closes at ten.

LIN FAN lunges, catching her wrist. His thumb brushes the red cord bracelet hidden beneath her sleeve.

SU WEIWEI
(gasping)
Your hands are filthy—let go!

LIN FAN stares at the crimson weave. The silver crest woven into its center.

LIN FAN (V.O.)
Mother's token. She knew.

XU ZIHENG shoves him back. LIN FAN's head cracks against the side table.

XU ZIHENG
(pulling SU WEIWEI toward the door)
Touch her again, and I'll have you prosecuted for fraud.

They exit. LIN FAN sits slumped on the floor, blood trickling from his temple. His eyes fix on the bracelet's reflection in the polished marble.

LIN FAN
(to the empty room)
She wore the Blood Prison Token. She knew.

title: My Best Friend's Blind Date - The CEO Won't Let Me Go
description: A young woman agrees to attend a blind date in place of her wealthy best friend, only to catch the attention of a handsome CEO.
context:
Title: My Best Friend's Blind Date - The CEO Won't Let Me Go
Description: A young woman agrees to attend a blind date in place of her wealthy best friend, only to catch the attention of a handsome CEO.

INT. NIGHT MARKET FOOD STALL - NIGHT

ZHAO QIANQIAN'S BROTHER holds a phone, live-streaming ZHAO QIANQIAN pretending to taste soup.

ZHAO QIANQIAN'S BROTHER
Sis, lean in. Smile like you mean it.

ZHAO'S FATHER walks over, his apron stained, face clouded.

ZHAO'S FATHER
Jiayue Group employs her. They see this, she's finished.

ZHAO'S MOTHER doesn't look up from the cash box.

ZHAO'S MOTHER
Her salary won't save us. This livestream might.

ZHAO QIANQIAN
(softly)
I'll finish the segment. Just stop watching.

ZHAO QIANQIAN'S BROTHER
(to the phone)
Hand-ground spices! Secret recipe!

ZHAO QIANQIAN's phone BUZZES. Payment reminder. Then RINGS.

ZHAO QIANQIAN
(turns away)
Hello?
continuation:
INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

FAN LUOLUO paces beside a Maserati, voice unsteady.

Qianqian, please. Dad's forcing me to meet some CEO. I can't—

INT. NIGHT MARKET FOOD STALL - NIGHT

ZHAO QIANQIAN
So stand him up. It's your specialty.

FAN LUOLUO (V.O.)
He'll freeze my accounts. Two hours, that's it. I'll make it worth your while.

ZHAO QIANQIAN
How worth it?

FAN LUOLUO (V.O.)
One hundred thousand. Already transferred. Check.

Zhao Qianqian glances at her screen: payment confirmed.

ZHAO QIANQIAN
Name and address. Now.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

ZHAO QIANQIAN sits in Fan Luoluo's dress—too tight in the chest, too loose in the waist—stirring her latte.

XU JIAZE
Miss Fan Luoluo?

ZHAO QIANQIAN
(perfect imitation of Fan's smile)
Mr. CEO. Shall we—

XU JIAZE
(sits, cuts her off)
You don't match your profile.

ZHAO QIANQIAN's smile doesn't break. Neither does his stare.

XU JIAZE
(CONT'D)
This just became interesting.

title: The Runaway Heiress
description: A wealthy heiress runs away from home for love, working as a delivery driver to support her boyfriend's business, while her protective brothers track her down.
context:
Title: The Runaway Heiress
Description: A wealthy heiress runs away from home for love, working as a delivery driver to support her boyfriend's business, while her protective brothers track her down.

.MONTAGE START

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

SU JINGCHEN (eldest brother) sits at the head of a long conference table, his expression serious.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY STAGE - DAY

SU TINGXUAN (second brother) wears a sequined suit, accepting an award.

EXT. RACE TRACK - DAY

SU ZIYAO (third brother) in racing gear, wearing a helmet, straddles a motorcycle, preparing for a race.

.MONTAGE END

INT. OFFICE - DAY

SU JINGCHEN is looking at his phone.

SU OLD MASTER (V.O.)
First, second, third sons.

EXT. RACE TRACK - DAY

SU ZIYAO is looking at his phone.

SU OLD MASTER (V.O.)
First, second, third sons.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY BACKSTAGE - DAY

SU TINGXUAN is looking at his phone.

EXT. VILLA EXTERIOR - DAY

SU OLD MASTER holds his phone, shouting excitedly.

SU OLD MASTER
Your sister has been found!
continuation:
INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

SU JINGCHEN hears the news and immediately stands up.

SU JINGCHEN
Meeting adjourned. I need to pick up little sister.

He strides out of the conference room.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY STAGE - DAY

SU TINGXUAN shoves his newly received trophy into the presenter's hands.

SU TINGXUAN
Give the Tianma Award to someone else. I'm going to pick up my little sister.

He turns and walks off the stage.

EXT. RACE TRACK - DAY

SU ZIYAO speaks into his phone.

SU ZIYAO
Race postponed. I need to pick up my little sister first.

He starts his motorcycle and speeds away.

EXT. CITY PLAZA - DAY

SU WAN (little sister) wearing a yellow delivery uniform, sits on the steps reviewing her delivery app. Her phone chimes with an order notification.

PHONE NOTIFICATION
You have a new order, please check.

SU WAN immediately puts down her meal, grabs her helmet and phone, and runs toward her electric scooter.

Three heavy motorcycles and two luxury sports cars roar up and stop in the plaza.

SU JINGCHEN, SU TINGXUAN, and SU ZIYAO get out of their respective vehicles, walking toward SU WAN with powerful presence.

ON SCREEN character introduction subtitles appear:
SU TINGXUAN - Su Family Second Brother - Three-Time Golden Melody Winner
SU JINGCHEN - Su Family Eldest Brother - Chairman of Su Group
SU ZIYAO - Su Family Third Brother - GP Racing Champion

SU WAN sees them, looking panicked.

SU WAN
(internal monologue)
Dummy account compromised. Should've used a better VPN.

SU ZIYAO
Little sister. Your form's improved—took you ninety seconds to pocket that order.

SU JINGCHEN
You ran away for a year. Now that we finally found you, you want to run again?

SU WAN
(laughing awkwardly)
Hello, brothers. Great timing as always.

SU TINGXUAN
Little sister, you left for Jiang Hao. Does he know his girlfriend's a Su?

SU WAN
He knows I have money. He doesn't know I'm your sister. That's the point.

SU ZIYAO
So you're delivering food while his green tech startup pitches to our venture capital arm next week?

SU WAN
Someone had to teach you what actual work looks like. And yes, I ghost-wrote his deck.

SU JINGCHEN
Those projections were yours? The Henderson deal—

SU WAN
—was going to tank. You're welcome.

SU TINGXUAN
Little sister, come home. You don't need to prove anything.

SU WAN
I need to prove I can choose my own life. Investigate Jiang Hao if you want. Vet his code yourselves.

She mounts her scooter.

SU WAN
But right now, I have a delivery to make. And if you follow me, I'll route you through every red light in this city.

She rides off, beeping her horn twice.

The three brothers watch her departing figure.

SU ZIYAO
Eldest brother, what do we do now?

SU JINGCHEN
(eyes determined)
We do what she said. Investigate. Then we invest.

title: Double Trouble: Daddy Chase, Mommy's Running Again
description: A woman who had a mysterious encounter six years ago returns home, only to face her father's wrath over a secret pregnancy and her mother's cherished necklace.
context:
Title: Double Trouble: Daddy Chase, Mommy's Running Again
Description: A woman who had a mysterious encounter six years ago returns home, only to face her father's wrath over a secret pregnancy and her mother's cherished necklace.

INT. HOT SPRING POOL - NIGHT

Candlelit steam curls above the pool where LI SHAOCHEN (30s, sharp jaw tight with pain) sits submerged. He suddenly sinks below the surface.

Outside, snow falls thick. LUO QINGBEI (20s, fever-flushed and unsteady) stumbles in, white bathrobe clutched tight, eyes glassy with confusion.

She kneels at the edge, reaching trembling fingers toward the water. A spasm contorts her face.

LUO QINGBEI loses her balance and plunges into the pool.

Water erupts. LI SHAOCHEN surfaces, seizing her waist. Their faces collide—strangers drowning together. Then his mouth finds hers, urgent and desperate.

Snowflakes melt against their skin as the kiss deepens.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LUO QINGBEI and LI SHAOCHEN lie in bed asleep.

LUO QINGBEI jolts awake. She sits up in terror, staring at the unfamiliar luxury and the man beside her.

LUO QINGBEI (V.O.)
 Last night... what did they give me?

MALE VOICE (O.S.)
 Young Master, the board member's sedative should be wearing off.

LUO QINGBEI looks at LI SHAOCHEN, confusion and shock flooding her eyes.

LUO QINGBEI
 Young Master? Could he be...?

LUO QINGBEI (V.O.)
 I can't believe my first time was with a gigolo.

LUO QINGBEI scrambles up, pulls on a brown coat, and finds a subway token in the lining.

LUO QINGBEI
 (whispering)
 This is all I have. I'm sorry.

She tries to place the token in LI SHAOCHEN's hand. He stirs. Startled, she drops it on his chest and flees, barefoot.

LI SHAOCHEN frowns in his sleep, fingers curling around the cold metal.
continuation:
EXT. CITY SKYLINE - DAY

Time-lapse: storm clouds swallow six years in spinning seconds.

ON SCREEN: SIX YEARS LATER

INT. LUO FAMILY HALL - DAY

A bankruptcy auction in progress. STRANGERS finger porcelain as LUO QINGBEI (now with lines around her eyes) kneels before the platform where LUO HAICHANG (50s, salt-and-pepper hair) clutches a jade necklace.

LUO QINGBEI
 (pleading)
 Dad, Mom's voice is in that stone. Don't auction her silence.

LUO HAICHANG
 (voice trembling)
 You...

He stands, slapping her hard. She catches herself on the platform, chin lifting.

LUO HAICHANG
 Rebellious daughter! Disgracing us with a bastard while I drown in debt!

He yanks his tie loose, knuckles white.

LUO HAICHANG
 Why couldn't you stay dead to us?

He kicks her as she curls around the fallen jewelry box—protecting the only mother she has left.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Wife's Trial
description: On a snowy New Year's Eve, the wealthiest man in Ying City dies of food poisoning. His wife becomes the prime suspect and faces a three-day televised trial that could end in immediate execution.
context:
Title: The Wife's Trial
Description: On a snowy New Year's Eve, the wealthiest man in Ying City dies of food poisoning. His wife becomes the prime suspect and faces a three-day televised trial that could end in immediate execution.

EXT. LI FAMILY VILLA - NIGHT

Snow swirls beneath ambulance lights flashing red against the darkness.

ON SCREEN: December 31, 2023 - Outside the Li Family Villa

Reporters mass at the gates, cameras shouldering like weapons. Flashbulbs pop in irregular bursts, catching falling snowflakes mid-descent.

SHI ZHU (V.O.)
December 31. My husband died. They say I killed him.

INT. VILLA - NIGHT

Stretcher wheels whisper across marble. A gloved hand draws a blue sheet over still features. A platinum watch peeks from beneath—frozen at 11:47.

MEDICAL PERSONNEL navigate the stretcher through the gauntlet of reporters.

SHI ZHU (V.O.)
Food poisoning, the coroner said. Jasmine powder in his chicken soup.

CLOSE ON: A porcelain bowl, half-full of golden broth. LI GAISI's body lies on polished wood, a crimson thread at his lips.

The stretcher slides into the ambulance bay.

SHI ZHU (V.O.)
The soup I made.

SHI ZHU emerges, black silk evening gown untouched by the chaos. Security flanks her. She moves through the frenzy like a blade through water.

ON SCREEN: Shi Zhu - Wife of Ying City's Richest Man
continuation:
EXT. VILLA ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Reporters surge. Security forms a human wedge.

REPORTER 1
Mrs. Li—any response to the allegations?

REPORTER 2
Did you argue that evening, Mrs. Li?

Shi Zhu's face remains a mask. Only her eyes move—flickering across the crowd with something like assessment. The corner of her mouth twitches. Not quite a smile.

SECURITY GUARD
Step back! All of you!

SHI ZHU (V.O.)
They arrested me before dawn. The whole country watched.

EXT. CITY ROAD - NIGHT

Black SUVs knife through the city's neon veins.

SHI ZHU (V.O.)
The FTI. Financial Tribunal International. For cases that threaten market stability.

The convoy halts before a glass tower. CHIEF JUDGE LIN BIN exits, followed by his panel.

ON SCREEN: Chief Judge Lin Bin - FTI Special Tribunal

They stride toward the illuminated building.

SHI ZHU (V.O.)
Three days. Broadcast worldwide. A conviction means no appeal. No delays.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

SHI ZHU stands in the dock, hands cuffed before her. The evening gown now looks like armor. She surveys the courtroom as if it belongs to her.

SHI ZHU (V.O.)
My life reduced to a 72-hour performance. Act one: establish doubt.

Chief Judge LIN BIN and the JURY take their positions. The gavel's crack echoes.

LIN BIN
This tribunal is now in session. Ms. Shi Zhu, how do you plead?

SHI ZHU
(eyes locked on Lin Bin)
Not guilty. To every charge.

LIN BIN
The deceased consumed chicken soup you prepared. You ate none. Explain.

SHI ZHU
The chicken was a Silkie. Twenty thousand yuan per bird. Li family tradition: precious ingredients are for the patriarch only.

LIN BIN
Tradition established by?

SHI ZHU
My mother-in-law. Wang Jie.

The camera FINDS WANG JIE in the gallery—fur draped over shoulders, knuckles white on her handbag.

ON SCREEN: Wang Jie - Family Matriarch

WANG JIE
(rising, voice trembling with fury)
Tradition? She's mocking us, Chief Judge. This woman—she's unnatural. She killed my son. And her own daughter—

The gallery erupts. Shi Zhu's head turns slowly toward Wang Jie. Her expression shifts: not quite a smile. Something colder. More knowing.

QUICK FLASH: WANG JIE cradles a small, still form. Blood on a child's lips. Her face—grief mixed with something else. Guilt?

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

FADE OUT.

description: The Dragon Marshal of Great Xia, Ye Lingtian, defeats his enemies but chooses to return to his wife, taking a mysterious pill that strips him of his power and memory, only to awaken three years later.
context:
Title: Apocalypse
Description: The Dragon Marshal of Great Xia, Ye Lingtian, defeats his enemies but chooses to return to his wife, taking a mysterious pill that strips him of his power and memory, only to awaken three years later.

INT. PALACE - DAY

YE LINGTIAN and the EMPRESS OF GREAT XIA sit across a Go board in the silent throne room. The black stones hold a decisive advantage.

Shadows coalesce at the balcony. YAKSHA KING and ASURA KING materialize, backed by twelve ARMORED ASSASSINS. Their blades drip with spectral poison.

EMPRESS OF GREAT XIA
(eyes on the board)
Dragon Marshal, the southern border has fallen. Your move.

YE LINGTIAN
(places a white stone)
The game was won three moves ago.

ASURA KING
(mocking)
Drinking wine and playing Go while your empire burns. The Apocalypse Dragon Marshal—truly unprecedented.

ENEMY COMMANDER
After today, Great Xia will no longer have that name. After you die, we shall gladly accept your Empress.

YAKSHA KING
Dark Court rules ninety-nine kingdoms. Great Xia is the hundredth. Surrender the throne, or we take it in blood.

ENEMY COMMANDER
(drawing his sword)
Kill them both!

The EMPRESS remains composed, pouring wine into YE LINGTIAN's cup.

YE LINGTIAN
Wait for me to return. Then we'll drink.

YE LINGTIAN rises. His movements blur—precise, economical. Each assassin falls before their blade can clear its sheath. He returns to his seat, not a hair out of place.

EMPRESS OF GREAT XIA
The wine is still warm. Your sword hasn't slowed.

YE LINGTIAN drains the cup in one motion.

YE LINGTIAN
This board was set for you. Now that the great task is complete, I shall store away my weapons.

EMPRESS OF GREAT XIA
(standing, voice trembling)
Where are you going? Ye Lingtian, you are not allowed to leave! The nine provinces, supreme royal power—none of it compares to a single finger of yours. Bring the Dragon Ring!

A HANDMAIDEN brings a sandalwood box. The EMPRESS opens it to reveal an imperial seal.

EMPRESS OF GREAT XIA
From this day, you are Emperor. I am Empress. The empire and its beauty—all yours.

YE LINGTIAN
(pushing the box away)
Empire and beauty hold no interest. My wife has waited three years. She has not betrayed me. I cannot betray her.

EMPRESS OF GREAT XIA
She's a woman from the lowest class. How can she compare? She loves your invincible bearing. If you became less than ordinary, would she still love you? Do you dare to find out?

She opens her palm. The WORRY-FREE ELIXIR rests there, glowing with internal light.

YE LINGTIAN takes it without hesitation, turns, and walks toward the doors.
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

Three years later. YE LINGTIAN—plaid shirt, glasses askew—lies crumpled on concrete. YOUNG MASTER WEI'S SUBORDINATES and three THUGS surround him.

YOUNG MASTER WEI'S SUBORDINATE
(laughing)
Look at this stupid dog.

YOUNG MASTER WEI'S SUBORDINATE
(crouching, contemptuous)
Your mistake was looking at Zhang Xue. Young Master's fiancée.

He produces a bottle of yellowed liquid.

YOUNG MASTER WEI'S SUBORDINATE
Drink this. Forget her. Or we make you forget everything.

He tips the bottle toward YE LINGTIAN's face.

YE LINGTIAN
(struggling)
No—my suit—

YOUNG MASTER WEI'S SUBORDINATE
(angry)
You dare resist?

A THUG hands him a baseball bat. He swings it down on YE LINGTIAN's skull.

The scene strobes: ancient palace, wine cup, glowing pill, the EMPRESS's face.

YE LINGTIAN collapses, blood pooling beneath his head. He goes limp.

YOUNG MASTER WEI'S SUBORDINATE
Let's go.

The THUGS turn. Behind them, golden light spills across the concrete. YE LINGTIAN slowly rises, his eyes no longer human—ageless, pitiless.

YE LINGTIAN
(coldly)
Stop right there.

The light intensifies, blinding.

END SCENE

title: Medical Consort and Cute Baby: Mother, This Is My Real Father
description: A pregnant princess consort is betrayed by her husband and sister, discovering a shocking truth about her unborn child on a stormy night.
context:
Title: Medical Consort and Cute Baby: Mother, This Is My Real Father
Description: A pregnant princess consort is betrayed by her husband and sister, discovering a shocking truth about her unborn child on a stormy night.

INT. SERVANTS' QUARTERS - PRINCE QI'S MANOR - NIGHT

Thunder rumbles. The night is deep and dark. Rain seeps through cracked shutters.

SU WEISHAN (Princess Consort of Prince Qi), six months pregnant, lies on a straw pallet, stroking her belly with trembling fingers.

SU WEISHAN
(whispered)
Stay still, my little one.

SU SHIYUN (Side Consort of Prince Qi) enters, silk robes brushing the doorway. She covers her nose.

SU SHIYUN
Isn't this the famous Princess Consort? Why are you in such a wretched state now?

SU WEISHAN
(warily)
What are you doing here? Where is the Prince?

SU SHIYUN
(contemptuously)
Still clinging to hope? The Prince has long been disgusted with you. Otherwise, why would you be six months pregnant and the Prince won't even glance at you?

SU WEISHAN
I'm carrying the Prince's child. He wouldn't be so heartless.

SU SHIYUN
(laughing)
Ha ha ha, the Prince's child? You don't really think that bastard in your belly is the Prince's, do you?

SU WEISHAN
continuation:
(shocked)
Bastard? What are you talking about?

SU SHIYUN
Let me be plain. If it weren't for the Su family's fortune, the Prince wouldn't have looked at you twice. That child—it was merely insurance. A stablehand's gratitude.

SU WEISHAN
(choking)
Impossible. You're lying—

SU WEISHAN struggles up and lunges. SU SHIYUN forcefully pushes her shoulder.

SU WEISHAN
(gasping)
Ah!

SU WEISHAN falls against a wooden chest. Blood seeps through her robes. She slides to the floor.

PRINCE QI enters, his expression cold.

PRINCE QI
What did you expect to accomplish by coming here?

SU WEISHAN sees PRINCE QI and reaches out, her fingers smearing blood on stone.

SU WEISHAN
(whispered)
Your Highness... the decree...

SU SHIYUN immediately turns to PRINCE QI, voice honeyed.

SU SHIYUN
Your Highness, even after the Emperor's judgment on the Su family, I had to see my sister one last time.

SU WEISHAN hears "judgment" and freezes, her bloodied hand pressed to her mouth.

title: After Misdiagnosis, Miss Ji Goes Crazy When She Sees People
description: Miss Ji receives a devastating late-stage liver cancer diagnosis and struggles with her crumbling family life.
context:
Title: After Misdiagnosis, Miss Ji Goes Crazy When She Sees People
Description: Miss Ji receives a devastating late-stage liver cancer diagnosis and struggles with her crumbling family life.

EXT. STREET INTERSECTION - DAY

MISS JI walks on the street in a daze, holding a document, preparing to cross the road. She stands frozen as people flow around her like a river around stone.

A WHITE SEDAN speeds toward her and brakes urgently in front of her, tires SCREECHING.

The MALE DRIVER leans out of the window and shouts angrily.

MALE DRIVER
Hey! You crazy? Move it!

MISS JI does not respond, her eyes vacant. She takes a step toward the car, then stops, disoriented. Flashbacks of the doctor's diagnosis play in her mind.

BEGIN FLASHBACK

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

The DOCTOR sits at the desk, his expression serious. He removes his glasses.

DOCTOR
Miss Ji, you have late-stage liver cancer. The results are conclusive.

MISS JI looks down at the diagnosis report in her hand. It reads: "Confirmed Diagnosis: Late-stage Liver Cancer, Chemotherapy Recommended." Her face is deathly pale, unable to believe it.

END FLASHBACK
continuation:
EXT. STREET INTERSECTION - DAY

MISS JI still stands in the middle of the road, immersed in despair. She flinches violently as another car HONKS.

MALE DRIVER (O.S.)
Are you deaf?! I'm talking to you! Get out of the way and stop blocking the road!

EXT. LU FAMILY MANSION - DAY

The camera shows a magnificent luxury mansion.

INT. LU FAMILY MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

MISS JI returns to the mansion, takes off her coat, and begins picking up toys scattered on the floor. Each small action seems to drain her.

HAOHAO, a young boy, runs out with a toy water gun, pointing it at MISS JI.

HAOHAO
Pew pew pew! Die, monster!

MISS JI
Haohao, stop fooling around.

HAOHAO
(excitedly)
I'm going to eliminate you, you big bad guy!

MISS JI tries to stop him, her expression exhausted and helpless. She raises a hand to shield herself.

MISS JI
(with emphasis)
I told you to stop fooling around!

HAOHAO is startled and immediately bursts into tears.

MISS JI is somewhat at a loss. She crouches down and continues picking up toys, trying to comfort him.

MISS JI
Haohao, stop crying. When I'm done cleaning up, Mommy will help you with your homework.

MOTHER LU hears the commotion and rushes over, immediately holding HAOHAO in her arms.

MOTHER LU
What's wrong, what's wrong? What happened? Oh my!

HAOHAO
(crying)
Grandma, the sick woman bullied me! You need to beat her up for me. I don't want her as my mom!

MOTHER LU
(distressed)
Okay, okay, Haohao, don't cry. Oh dear, you're crying so much it breaks Grandma's heart. Don't cry now, okay?

MISS JI crouches on the floor, looking up in shock.

MISS JI
What did you just say?

HAOHAO
(loudly)
Big bad guy! Sick woman! I said I don't want you as my mom! I want Aunt Anna to be my mom!

MISS JI freezes in place, her face filled with heartbreak and disbelief.

title: The Rejected Ex-Wife, Beautiful and Bold
description: A woman betrayed by her husband and cousin is left to die in a fire, vowing revenge if given another life.
context:
Title: The Rejected Ex-Wife, Beautiful and Bold
Description: A woman betrayed by her husband and cousin is left to die in a fire, vowing revenge if given another life.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

LI SHENGXIA's hands are bound behind her back, blood at the corner of her mouth, lying disheveled on the ground beside a shattered jade pendant. She struggles to sit up.

LI SHENGXIA
Yufei, why are you doing this? I'm your cousin!

SU YUFEI, wearing a red dress, walks forward and grabs LI SHENGXIA's hands.

SU YUFEI
Cousin? While you inherited Li Group, I got scrubbed from the family portraits. You ask me why I'm doing this?

SU YUFEI pushes LI SHENGXIA hard. LI SHENGXIA falls to the ground.

LIN YUNFAN, wearing a suit, stands to the side, watching coldly.

LI SHENGXIA
(crying out)
Yunfan, save me!

LIN YUNFAN walks forward and kicks LI SHENGXIA.

LIN YUNFAN
You're too filthy. Stay away from me.

LI SHENGXIA
(desperately)
Yunfan! I'm your wife! Why are you treating me like this?

LIN YUNFAN
Wife? You mean the woman who couldn't even smell the perfume on my collar? Yufei knows my favorite brand.

LIN YUNFAN walks to SU YUFEI and puts his arm around her. SU YUFEI smiles triumphantly.
continuation:
LIN YUNFAN
Li Shengxia, actually, from beginning to end, I've always loved Su Yufei.

LIN YUNFAN crouches down and grabs LI SHENGXIA's chin.

LIN YUNFAN
Marrying you was only to take control of Li Group. Now that I've achieved my goal, you can die.

LI SHENGXIA
(shocked)
You... you've been deceiving me all along!

LIN YUNFAN picks up a bucket of liquid and pours it on the ground around LI SHENGXIA.

LI SHENGXIA
(terrified)
What are you doing? What are you doing!

LIN YUNFAN
Ah, don't worry. Your parents' private jet had a "mechanical failure" over the Pacific. On the road to the underworld, you won't be lonely. Hahaha.

SU YUFEI takes out a box of matches, lights one, and says with a smile.

SU YUFEI
Cousin, don't be so stupid in your next life. Hahaha.

SU YUFEI throws the burning match on the ground. Flames instantly ignite.

LIN YUNFAN and SU YUFEI laugh and turn to leave.

LI SHENGXIA
(screaming in the fire)
Lin Yunfan! Su Yufei! I will return from the ashes and reclaim every thing you stole!

The flames consume LI SHENGXIA. The jade pendant glows green in the inferno.

title: Hidden for Three Years, They All Beg Me to Return
description: A legendary warrior who retired to sell fish is sought out by his former student to defend the nation against foreign threats.
context:
Title: Hidden for Three Years, They All Beg Me to Return
Description: A legendary warrior who retired to sell fish is sought out by his former student to defend the nation against foreign threats.

EXT. SEAFOOD SHOP ENTRANCE - DAY

Opening scene. CHEN YIDAO, a fish vendor wearing an apron, is processing fish. A young MALE CUSTOMER and FEMALE CUSTOMER watch nearby.

MALE CUSTOMER
Boss, you're really skilled! Did you train before?

CHEN YIDAO
(without looking up)
Comes with the job.

Suddenly, a line of black SUVs speeds up and screeches to a halt outside the seafood shop. A group of SOLDIERS in black uniforms carrying weapons step out of the vehicles.

CHU YUETIAN, a man in an elaborate military officer's uniform, gets out of a car. His uniform bears the seal of the Border Army.

MALE CUSTOMER
(shocked)
That's the War God's adjutant...

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Why is he here?

The SOLDIERS quickly form ranks, their movements precise and uniform.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
We shouldn't get ourselves into trouble.

MALE CUSTOMER
Let's go, let's go, let's go.

The MALE and FEMALE CUSTOMERS hurriedly leave.

CHU YUETIAN walks toward CHEN YIDAO with his soldiers.

CHU YUETIAN
Mr. Chen. We need you to come with us.

CHEN YIDAO
(wiping his hands)
You're looking at the wrong person. I'm just a fish seller.

CHU YUETIAN
An old acquaintance sent us. She was insistent.

CHEN YIDAO
Don't have acquaintances anymore. Just customers.

YANG NINGBING, a female military officer, steps forward from behind CHU YUETIAN.

YANG NINGBING
You always did prefer simple answers.

CHU YUETIAN
Go on alert outside.

SOLDIERS
Yes, sir!

The SOLDIERS disperse to secure the perimeter.
continuation:
YANG NINGBING picks up a knife from the cutting board and confronts CHEN YIDAO. The two exchange moves quickly. CHEN YIDAO easily subdues YANG NINGBING.

CHEN YIDAO
You're using my own forms against me. But you've forgotten why they were made.

YANG NINGBING
Then remind me.

YANG NINGBING draws the long blade from her waist and attacks CHEN YIDAO again. CHEN YIDAO easily deflects all her moves with a fish-gutting knife and stops the blade's tip in front of YANG NINGBING's neck.

CHEN YIDAO
To protect. Not to perform.

YANG NINGBING sheathes her blade and stands respectfully.

YANG NINGBING
Churi infiltrators are inside our borders. They know our command structure. They know our tactics.

CHEN YIDAO
You were trained for this.

YANG NINGBING
They know me. They don't know you.

A girl in a school uniform, CHEN YUJIA, runs in.

CHEN YUJIA
Dad!

YANG NINGBING
(looking at CHEN YUJIA)
You must be Chen Yujia.

CHEN YUJIA hides behind CHEN YIDAO, frightened.

CHEN YUJIA
Dad.

CHEN YIDAO
(protecting his daughter)
It's fine.

YANG NINGBING
Your blades were meant for more than this.

CHEN YIDAO
This is what matters now.

YANG NINGBING is silent for a moment, then turns to leave.

YANG NINGBING
(to CHU YUETIAN)
Stay. Keep watch.

CHU YUETIAN
Yes.

YANG NINGBING turns back, her eyes resolute as she looks at CHEN YIDAO.

YANG NINGBING
Master. They have a file on every former operative. But they don't have one for a fish seller's daughter.

YANG NINGBING finishes speaking and turns to leave.

Don't have acquaintances anymore. Just customers.

YANG NINGBING, a female military officer, steps forward from behind CHU YUETIAN.

YANG NINGBING
You always did prefer simple answers.

CHU YUETIAN
Go on alert outside.

SOLDIERS
Yes, sir!

The SOLDIERS disperse to secure the perimeter.

YANG NINGBING picks up a knife from the cutting board and confronts CHEN YIDAO. The two exchange moves quickly. CHEN YIDAO easily subdues YANG NINGBING.

CHEN YIDAO
You're using my own forms against me. But you've forgotten why they were made.

YANG NINGBING
Then remind me.

YANG NINGBING draws the long blade from her waist and attacks CHEN YIDAO again. CHEN YIDAO easily deflects all her moves with a fish-gutting knife and stops the blade's tip in front of YANG NINGBING's neck.

CHEN YIDAO
To protect. Not to perform.

YANG NINGBING sheathes her blade and stands respectfully.

YANG NINGBING
Churi infiltrators are inside our borders. They know our command structure. They know our tactics.

CHEN YIDAO
You were trained for this.

YANG NINGBING
They know me. They don't know you.

A girl in a school uniform, CHEN YUJIA, runs in.

CHEN YUJIA
Dad!

YANG NINGBING
(looking at CHEN YUJIA)
You must be Chen Yujia.

CHEN YUJIA hides behind CHEN YIDAO, frightened.

CHEN YUJIA
Dad.

CHEN YIDAO
(protecting his daughter)
It's fine.

YANG NINGBING
Your blades were meant for more than this.

CHEN YIDAO
This is what matters now.

YANG NINGBING is silent for a moment, then turns to leave.

YANG NINGBING
(to CHU YUETIAN)
Stay. Keep watch.

CHU YUETIAN
Yes.

YANG NINGBING turns back, her eyes resolute as she looks at CHEN YIDAO.

YANG NINGBING
Master. They have a file on every former operative. But they don't have one for a fish seller's daughter.

YANG NINGBING finishes speaking and turns to leave.

title: Invincible Below Immortals
description: Lin Qiye, master of the Carefree Sect, faces the ninth heavenly tribulation in his attempt to ascend to immortality, only to be struck down by the Heavenly Emperor himself.
context:
Title: Invincible Below Immortals
Description: Lin Qiye, master of the Carefree Sect, faces the ninth heavenly tribulation in his attempt to ascend to immortality, only to be struck down by the Heavenly Emperor himself.

EXT. VIEWING PLATFORM - NIGHT

Dark clouds gather, lightning flashes and thunder roars. The sky presents an ominous scene.

LIN QIYE, dressed in ancient robes, holding a long sword, stands alone on a wooden viewing platform, his back to the camera, gazing up at the sky.

Three veiled women in different attire—YE QINGLUAN, MU LUOXUE, ZHANG YIXI—stand on distant steps, nervously watching LIN QIYE.

LIN QIYE turns around, raising his sword to point at the sky.

ON SCREEN: Carefree Sect Master Lin Qiye

LIN QIYE
The nine tribulations? Just formalities.

LIN QIYE
Below the immortals—I am the standard they measure against.

ON SCREEN: Carefree Sect Eldest Disciple Ye Qingluan

YE QINGLUAN
Ninth tribulation... he's holding nothing back.

ON SCREEN: Carefree Sect Second Disciple Mu Luoxue

MU LUOXUE
(not looking at the sky, but at the ground)
The mountain's spirit is screaming.

ON SCREEN: Carefree Sect Youngest Disciple Zhang Yixi

ZHANG YIXI
(whispering to a talisman)
Just like you promised... you'll come back.

The lightning in the sky becomes even more fierce.

ON SCREEN: The Ninth Tribulation - Ten Thousand Thunderbolts

LIN QIYE
(smiling, but not at the sky)
Watch closely now.
continuation:
LIN QIYE leaps into the air, transforming into a golden light shooting toward the sky, swinging his sword at the thunder clouds. A massive bolt of lightning descends from the heavens, striking the ground and creating a huge explosion. The three female disciples are pushed back by the powerful shockwave.

After the explosion, the sky briefly clears.

ZHANG YIXI
(delighted)
He redirected it! The platform is intact!

YE QINGLUAN
(suspicious)
No... that's not tribulation lightning anymore.

The sky darkens again. A massive, majestic human face emerges from the dark clouds, its eyes glowing.

ON SCREEN: Heavenly Emperor Haotian

HEAVENLY EMPEROR HAOTIAN (V.O.)
Lin Qiye of the Carefree Sect. You have not survived the tribulation—you have consumed it. An immortal who feeds on the mortal realm would leave it barren. I cannot permit such a parasite.

LIN QIYE
(laughing, but bitter)
So I'm too efficient for Heaven's liking?

LIN QIYE
(eyes on his disciples)
Then let the Carefree Sect remember: the heavens fear those who need them least.

LIN QIYE transforms into golden light once more, charging toward the giant face in the sky. A massive energy palm extends from the clouds, striking LIN QIYE down.

YE QINGLUAN
Master! Your core!

MU LUOXUE
He's dispersing it willingly!

ZHANG YIXI
Master! Please!

LIN QIYE is caught by the giant palm in mid-air, not struggling against it but channeling his energy outward. The golden light fragments into three streams, each flying toward a disciple.

ZHANG YIXI
(running forward, catching her stream)
No... this is... his understanding?

LIN QIYE falls with an unyielding smile on his face, watching the three lights reach his disciples.

FADE OUT.

title: The War Emperor's Return
description: As enemy forces breach the imperial city, the Dragon Empress faces her doom until the legendary War Emperor returns to defend the kingdom.
context:
Title: The War Emperor's Return
Description: As enemy forces breach the imperial city, the Dragon Empress faces her doom until the legendary War Emperor returns to defend the kingdom.

INT. ICE AND SNOW PALACE - DAY

The EMPRESS sits rigid on her ice and snow throne, magnificent robes spattered with blood. Her GUARDS stand in a final, thin line before her.

CUT TO:

The corridor outside the palace. The DEMON EMPEROR'S warriors cut down the last of the EMPRESS'S GUARDS. The DEMON EMPEROR moves through them like a reaper, each strike ending a life.

DRAGON MARSHAL, his war hammer shattered and armor soaked in blood, staggers into the great hall and kneels before the EMPRESS.

DRAGON MARSHAL
(struggling for breath)
Your Majesty... inner wall... breached. You must... flee...

EMPRESS
(shocked)
The city... is truly lost?

DRAGON MARSHAL
This old soldier... failed you...

DRAGON MARSHAL coughs blood and falls dead.

EMPRESS
(desperate)
Dragon Marshal!

SOLDIERS
(crying out)
Dragon Marshal! Dragon Marshal!

The SOLDIERS gather around, grief etched on their faces.

EMPRESS
(quiet, deadly)
Four great kings. Nine war gods. How?

A SOLDIER, arm hanging useless, stumbles to the throne.

SOLDIER
Your Majesty! The Demon Emperor himself leads this alliance. He butchered our war gods. Our kings are scattered. You must survive this.

EMPRESS
(cold)
I will not abandon my people. I am the Dragon Empress. I stand with my city.

The DEMON EMPEROR enters the great hall with two SUBORDINATES, his laugh echoing off the walls.

DEMON EMPEROR
(delighted)
Such nobility. Such waste.

He gestures. The two GUARDS beside the EMPRESS crumple.

DEMON EMPEROR
continuation:
(savoring)
A dragon in a cage, Empress. Wouldn't that be a sight? Your defiance on display. For my amusement.

SOLDIER
(roaring)
Over my dead body!

The SOLDIER charges with his broken blade.

DEMON EMPEROR
(bored)
As you wish.

He catches the blade and strikes the SOLDIER down with one palm.

DEMON EMPEROR
(to Empress)
Kneel. Or I butcher them all, one by one.

WAR EMPEROR (O.S.)
(steel-cold)
Touch her and die.

DEMON EMPEROR
(spinning)
Who—

The great doors crash open. The WAR EMPEROR, black cloak billowing, strides into the hall.

EMPRESS
(hope breaking through)
Lord War Emperor...

DEMON EMPEROR
(startled)
The ghost of legends.

The surviving SOLDIERS immediately kneel.

SOLDIER
(weakly)
Lord War Emperor...

SOLDIERS
(in unison)
Lord War Emperor!

The WAR EMPEROR walks to stand before the EMPRESS, facing the DEMON EMPEROR.

DEMON EMPEROR
(cautious)
So. The great War Emperor. I was told you were dead.

WAR EMPEROR
(stone-faced)
You were misinformed.

The WAR EMPEROR stands expressionless, his eyes sharp and piercing as he stares at the DEMON EMPEROR.

title: Love Never Missed
description: A wealthy CEO disguises himself as a fish seller to find the woman who saved him, only to discover she's about to marry someone else.
context:
Title: Love Never Missed
Description: A wealthy CEO disguises himself as a fish seller to find the woman who saved him, only to discover she's about to marry someone else.

INT. INDOOR SWIMMING POOL - DAY

YE LAN, wearing a white swimsuit and goggles, swims powerfully in the clear pool.

She surfaces, removes her goggles, and shakes her wet hair. Her reflection distorts in the water. Two young men, MAN A and MAN B, approach her in the water, carrying fruit platters.

MAN A
Sister, have some watermelon.

MAN B
Sister, have some grapes.

MAN A
Sister, let me give you a massage.

As MAN A's hand reaches for YE LAN's shoulder, her eyes turn cold. She swims between them and gets out of the pool.

By the poolside, a row of MAIDS and a row of BODYGUARDS wait respectfully.

ASSISTANT HU hurries forward to drape a white bathrobe over YE LAN.

ASSISTANT HU
Director Ye, the trillion-yuan dowry is secured at Haicheng Bank. Transferable to the Jiang family upon marriage.

YE LAN
(adjusting her bathrobe, expression calm)

ASSISTANT HU
But you're the second richest person in the country. Why the charade of bankruptcy to test him?

YE LAN
Three days ago, he saved a stranger from drowning. Such character deserves a worthy partner.

YE LAN
(a slight smile appears)
Prepare the car. Let's go to the wedding venue.

ASSISTANT HU
Yes, Director.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

Several black luxury cars arrive and stop at the hotel entrance.
continuation:
INT. SEAFOOD MARKET - DAY

YE JINGHUAI wears a leather apron covered in fish scales, skillfully scaling and cleaning fish. A faded photograph of a woman's silhouette is tucked near his cash box.

YE JINGHUAI
(to a customer)
This fish is all cleaned for you. It's 30 yuan and 80 cents, just give me 30.

The CUSTOMER pays and leaves.

YE JINGHUAI
(to the customer's back)
Thank you! Take care!

A convoy of black luxury cars stops at the seafood market entrance.

QIN SONG leads a group of BODYGUARDS in black suits out of the cars, walking quickly toward YE JINGHUAI's stall.

BODYGUARDS
President Ye! President Ye!

YE JINGHUAI turns, sees them, looking impatient.

QIN SONG
(anxiously)
President Ye, stop selling fish! The woman who saved you three days ago has been found!

YE JINGHUAI
(eyes light up, delighted)
You found her?

QIN SONG
(nodding with a smile)
Bank cameras confirm her identity. But there's a complication...

YE JINGHUAI
Where is she?

QIN SONG
She's getting married right now at Litian Hotel. Her groom is Jiang Xu from a low-tier family in Haicheng.

YE JINGHUAI
(shocked, grabbing QIN SONG by the collar)
What?!

YE JINGHUAI
(furious)
My woman can only marry me!

QIN SONG
But the Old Madam has already selected a fiancée for you, the chairman of Blue Leaf Group.

YE JINGHUAI
(releases QIN SONG, turns to leave)
Cancel the engagement!

QIN SONG
(chasing after him)
President Ye!

QIN SONG
(shouting helplessly at YE JINGHUAI's back)
The board meeting is in one hour!

YE JINGHUAI gets into the luxury car without looking back. The convoy speeds away.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

GUESTS are applauding.

YE LAN wears a white wedding dress, a happy smile on her face, though her hands tremble slightly.

At the altar, JIANG XU takes her hands. His grip is too tight.

JIANG XU
(through a perfect smile)
You're shaking, my poor bride.

YE LAN
(sensing something wrong)
Jiang Xu?

Suddenly, a loud slap.

JIANG XU slaps YE LAN hard across the face.

The GUESTS gasp in shock.

YE LAN covers her face, staring at JIANG XU in disbelief.

YE LAN
Jiang Xu, are you crazy!

JIANG XU
(sneering)
Let's see how Blue Leaf's chairman explains these.

JIANG XU pulls out a stack of photos and throws them violently in YE LAN's face.

JIANG XU
You played the bankrupt woman. I played the devoted fiancé. But I don't marry liars.

The photos scatter on the floor. YE LAN looks at them in shock.

title: Body Swap with the Richest Husband Who Suffers Abuse for Me Daily
description: After saving her husband from drowning, a mistreated wife wakes up to find they have swapped bodies.
context:
Title: Body Swap with the Richest Husband Who Suffers Abuse for Me Daily
Description: After saving her husband from drowning, a mistreated wife wakes up to find they have swapped bodies.

EXT. LU FAMILY ESTATE - NIGHT

The Lu family estate glitters like a prison of jewels under night watch lights. SHEN ZHIWAN (the only daughter of the Shen family) stands by the pond railing, her white long-sleeved shirt clinging to her thin frame. She touches her wrist—faded bruises beneath a jade bracelet that feels like shackles.

A desperate splash shatters the silence.

ZHANG LANQIN (Lu family maid) spots the disturbance from a nearby pavilion.

ZHANG LANQIN
(shrieking)
Second Young Master! Help!

Shen Zhiwan turns, sees the sinking figure.

SHEN ZHIWAN
(voice barely a whisper)
Jinian...

She kicks off her slippers and plunges in fully clothed.
continuation:
INT. POND - NIGHT

Underwater, LU JINIAN (heir of the Lu family) drifts downward, lifeless. Shen Zhiwan swims to him, her hair a dark fan around them both.

SHEN ZHIWAN (V.O.)
You don't get to leave me. Not before you see what your family has done.

She cups his face and kisses him, forcing air into his lungs.

FADE TO WHITE.

INT. LU JINIAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

LU JINIAN lies on the bed, slowly waking beneath silk sheets that smell of expensive cologne. His movements are delicate, birdlike.

LU JINIAN (V.O. / SHEN ZHIWAN)
So cold. They didn't even bother to change the sheets. They never stop—

SHAO HENG (O.S.)
President Lu.

The body jerks upright. SHAO HENG (Lu Jinian's personal assistant) stands at a respectful distance.

LU JINIAN
Shao Heng? What are you doing in—

The voice is deep, commanding. His own hands fly to his throat in terror.

LU JINIAN (V.O. / SHEN ZHIWAN)
My voice? Why does my—

SHAO HENG
Dr. Chen ordered surveillance. I'll leave immediately.

He turns to go.

LU JINIAN
Wait!

Shao Heng stops, looking back.

LU JINIAN (V.O. / SHEN ZHIWAN)
He called me President Lu?

LU JINIAN
(voice hoarse, testing)
Bring me a mirror.

SHAO HENG
Yes, sir.

FADE OUT.

title: Getting Rich After Divorce
description: A gambling addict loses everything including his family in pursuit of a big win, only to face devastating consequences.
context:
Title: Getting Rich After Divorce
Description: A gambling addict loses everything including his family in pursuit of a big win, only to face devastating consequences.

INT. ONLINE CASINO - DAY

A DEALER (30s, polished, professional) faces the camera with a practiced smile.

DEALER
Hello, sir. I am your exclusive dealer. I will now deal the cards. Please place your bets.

INT. YE CHEN'S APARTMENT - DAY

SMASH CUT TO:

YE CHEN (40s, unshaven, eyes bloodshot) wears a stained tank top, frantically clicking his mouse. The laptop screen reflects cards being dealt.

LI MEIYUN (30s, exhausted, clutching medical bills) enters with their daughter, TONGTONG (7, frail, with a hospital bracelet).

LI MEIYUN
Ye Chen. The deed—where is it?

YE CHEN
(not turning)
Safe. Don't worry about it.

LI MEIYUN
You didn't.

YE CHEN
It's a concrete box. I'll buy you a real home.

LI MEIYUN
Tongtong's fever spiked again. They won't treat her without today's deposit.

TONGTONG
(weakly)
Daddy... my head hurts.

She touches his arm. Ye Chen flinches.

YE CHEN
(shrugging her off)
Not now. I'm close.

TONGTONG stumbles back, clips the table edge. Falls.

LI MEIYUN
Tongtong!

She rushes over. Blood seeps from the girl's temple.

LI MEIYUN
(quietly)
She needs you.

YE CHEN
I'm making the money you need!

LI MEIYUN
This is how?

YE CHEN
Insider information. This hand—then we're free.

LI MEIYUN stares at him, sees a stranger.

LI MEIYUN
You're already gone.

She scoops up Tongtong and leaves. The door slams.
continuation:
INT. YE CHEN'S APARTMENT - LATER

Ye Chen hunches closer to the screen, surrounded by takeout containers and cigarette butts.

DEALER (V.O.)
Banker nine points, player eight points. Banker wins.

YE CHEN
(wiping sweat)
Again. One more.

He types frantically to "Customer Service Wenwen." Messages bounce back: "User not found."

YE CHEN
No... Wenwen, the tip—why?

His phone RINGS—UNKNOWN NUMBER.

YE CHEN
(answering)
What?

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Mr. Ye? This is City Central. We called your wife's phone—yours was listed as emergency contact.

YE CHEN
Is she—

DOCTOR (V.O.)
About Tongtong. The fall caused a hemorrhage. We did everything we could.

The phone slips. Ye Chen stares at nothing. A laugh escapes—small, involuntary. He clamps a hand over his mouth. Tears fall. He laughs again, choking on it, collapsing into a sound that isn't quite human.

END SCENE

title: The Devil by My Side
description: A woman marries an older man for a dowry, only to endure abuse, betrayal, and ultimately a deadly conspiracy orchestrated by her husband and her best friend.
context:
Title: The Devil by My Side
Description: A woman marries an older man for a dowry, only to endure abuse, betrayal, and ultimately a deadly conspiracy orchestrated by her husband and her best friend.

INT. WEDDING BANQUET PRIVATE ROOM - DAY

HE RUOQING (20s) wears a red toast dress, serving tea to WANG MOTHER (50s). Her husband WANG CHANGLIN (40s) watches with detached amusement. Both sets of parents are present.

WANG MOTHER (accepting tea)
A daughter-in-law is family. You'll serve well.

He Ruoqing's smile doesn't reach her eyes.

INT. WEDDING BANQUET HALL - DAY

Wang Changlin's phone buzzes. He glances at the screen—ZHANG MEIZHEN's name visible—then at He Ruoqing, who looks away.

WANG CHANGLIN
(to He Ruoqing)
Business call.

He pockets the phone, screen-side in.

INT. WANG FAMILY HOUSE - DAY

He Ruoqing scrubs dishes. Her hands are raw. Wang Mother watches, unimpressed.

WANG MOTHER
My son married down. Remember your place.

Wang Changlin enters, smelling of alcohol. He grabs He Ruoqing's arm.

WANG CHANGLIN
Where's the money I gave you?

HE RUOQING
For groceries—

WANG CHANGLIN
(shoving her)
You think I don't know you steal?

INT. WANG FAMILY HOUSE - NIGHT

He Ruoqing curls on the sofa as Wang Changlin unbuckles his belt.

WANG CHANGLIN
(belt snapping)
Learn your lesson.

The blows land. He Ruoqing bites her lip, silent.

INT. UNDERGROUND CLINIC - DAY

He Ruoqing lies on a stained examination table, bleeding. The FEMALE DOCTOR (40s) shakes her head.

FEMALE DOCTOR
(to Wang Changlin)
She's lost the pregnancy. She needs rest, not more—

WANG CHANGLIN
It's just a child.

WANG MOTHER
She's young. She'll conceive again.

He Ruoqing turns her face to the wall, tears tracking down.
continuation:
INT. HE FAMILY HOUSE - DAY

He Ruoqing stands before her parents, clutching her bruised arm.

HE FATHER
Divorce? Over some arguments?

HE RUOQING
He hits me. I lost the baby—

HE FATHER
(slams table)
You endure! The dowry bought your brother's future!

HE MOTHER
Ruoqing, be reasonable.

He Ruoqing's younger brother HE BAOZHEN (20s) appears, hearing the raised voices.

HE BAOZHEN
Sis, what's wrong?

HE FATHER
Nothing! She's returning to her husband.

HE BAOZHEN
(breaking)
We used your dowry for my business. It failed. We're bankrupt.

HE RUOQING
(quietly)
How much?

HE BAOZHEN
Two hundred thousand. They'll take everything.

HE FATHER
You can't leave him. We need that money.

HE BAOZHEN
(pleading)
Sis, I didn't know. I'm sorry.

He produces a kitchen knife—not threatening, but desperate.

HE BAOZHEN
I'll end this. All of it.

HE FATHER
Baozhen!

HE BAOZHEN
(pointing knife at himself)
I ruined us. Let me fix it.

HE RUOQING
Stop!

She moves toward him. He shifts, knife now toward her.

HE BAOZHEN
(to their father)
Kneel! Beg her to stay, or I cut her first!

HE MOTHER
(screaming)
Baozhen, no!

He Ruoqing's father drops to his knees.

HE FATHER
Please. For your brother.

He Ruoqing walks out, leaving the knife clattering to the floor.

EXT. STREET - DAY

He Ruoqing sits at a bus stop, trembling. She scratches a lottery ticket from her purse—last month's purchase.

The numbers match. Not a million. Fifty thousand.

She laughs, a broken sound.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Wang Changlin and Zhang Meizhen lie tangled together. His phone shows a text: BANK ALERT: 50K DEPOSIT.

WANG CHANGLIN
She actually won.

ZHANG MEIZHEN
(kissing his neck)
Take it. Say it's joint property.

WANG CHANGLIN
Divorce would only get me half. This way...

ZHANG MEIZHEN
(smiling)
She'll give it willingly. For love.

INT. BATHTUB - NIGHT

He Ruoqing soaks in a tub, red candlelight flickering. Her phone shows texts from Wang Changlin: "Forgive me. Come home."

WANG CHANGLIN and Zhang Meizhen stand over her.

HE RUOQING
(weakly)
The water... feels strange...

WANG CHANGLIN
Just relax.

He Ruoqing's eyes flutter. She tries to stand, slips. Wang Changlin pushes her shoulders down.

HE RUOQING
(struggling)
I can't... breathe...

WANG CHANGLIN
(whispering)
For our future.

Zhang Meizhen holds her legs still. He Ruoqing's hands claw at the tub's edge, then go limp.

The water stills. Only candles remain lit.

title: Miss Zhong Who Doesn't Want to Get Married
description: A koi spirit loses her body after being struck by a coin during her tribulation and finds herself inhabiting the body of a woman in danger.
context:
Title: Miss Zhong Who Doesn't Want to Get Married
Description: A koi spirit loses her body after being struck by a coin during her tribulation and finds herself inhabiting the body of a woman in danger.

EXT. GARDEN POND - DAY

A tranquil garden, mist floating over the pond. ZHONG BAOYAN sits on a rock by the water, lost in thought. Across the pond, TANG XINYANG's figure appears and disappears in the mist.

ZHONG BAOYAN (V.O.)
Do you believe that to meet the right person, you would use up all your luck?

MONTAGE - VARIOUS LOCATIONS

- Zhong Baoyan angrily pushes away a man.  
- Tang Xinyang saves Zhong Baoyan from a speeding car. They fall together onto the car hood, close to each other.  
- Tang Xinyang gently holds Zhong Baoyan.  
- Zhong Baoyan lies in bed, thoughtful.  
- A man with glasses holds Zhong Baoyan in a wedding dress.  
- Zhong Baoyan tightly embraces Tang Xinyang.  
- Tang Xinyang holds an unconscious Zhong Baoyan in his arms, looking panicked.  

TANG XINYANG
(shouting)
Baoyan, Baoyan!

TITLE CARD: Six Months Ago

INT. KTV ROOM - NIGHT

Noisy music, flashing lights. A group of young people dancing and celebrating.

ZHONG BAOYAN walks in carrying a FENDI gift bag. She sees her friend NANA. Her movements carry an unnatural grace—she's still learning to inhabit this body.

NANA
Baoyan! You made it!

ZHONG BAOYAN
Happy birthday. I... had trouble finding the place.

NANA
You seem different. More poised somehow.

Nana runs over and hugs Zhong Baoyan tightly.

NANA (CONT'D)
Thank you, babe! This bag costs a fortune.

Later. Nana is singing karaoke. Zhong Baoyan sits on the sofa, watching the room with ancient eyes. A man, NANA'S SENIOR, watches her from a distance.

NANA
(to Zhong Baoyan)
You sing first, I'm going to the restroom.

ZHONG BAOYAN
I'll wait here.

Nana leaves. Nana's senior carries two drinks and comes to sit next to Zhong Baoyan. She tenses imperceptibly—predator instincts recognize predator.

NANA'S SENIOR
I'm Nana's college senior. Let me toast you.

He hands her a drink. She accepts it, her eyes narrowing.

ZHONG BAOYAN
What is this?

NANA'S SENIOR
Just whiskey. You looked thirsty.

Both drink. He watches her with calculated patience.

NANA'S SENIOR (CONT'D)
You're not like Nana's other friends. There's something... different about you.

Zhong Baoyan's vision begins to blur. She grips the armrest.

ZHONG BAOYAN (V.O.)
Poisoned. Like river water turned to ink.

NANA'S SENIOR
(leaning closer)
Had too much to drink? We have a room upstairs where you can rest.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Nana's senior guides Zhong Baoyan to a luxurious bed. She's dazed but fighting consciousness. He locks the door.

NANA'S SENIOR
This drug works fast. But don't worry—you have spirit. I like that.

ZHONG BAOYAN (V.O.)
I am a koi spirit, not prey in a net.

Nana's senior begins to unbutton his shirt and reaches out to touch her. Zhong Baoyan's hand shoots up, gripping his wrist with surprising strength.

ZHONG BAOYAN
(whispering)
Water repays every debt. Every drop.

A pipe suddenly bursts in the bathroom. Water floods the suite. He slips, cursing, as she rolls off the bed.

FLASHBACK

TITLE CARD: One Hundred Years of Cultivation

EXT. GARDEN POND - DAY

KOI SPIRIT, in beautiful ancient costume, kneels by the same pond. She speaks to the koi swimming below.

KOI SPIRIT
Today I complete my tribulation. A century of merit, and I can find my sister at the Dragon Palace. Remember—cultivate with purpose.

TANG XINYANG, wearing a modern suit, walks through the garden background. He flips a commemorative coin upward.

The coin arcs through the air and strikes the koi spirit's forehead. She gasps, falling backward. Her form flickers between human and spirit.

KOI SPIRIT (V.O.)
One hundred years... could metal and chance undo it all?

On the rock by the pond, a koi fish flops helplessly. The koi spirit's body on the ground shimmers, then vanishes completely.

END OF FLASHBACK

EXT. HOTEL - NIGHT

Tang Xinyang's car screeches to a halt. He sees Zhong Baoyan stumble out, drenched and glowing faintly in the streetlight. He recognizes something impossible.

TANG XINYANG
That woman... the one I thought I imagined...

He runs toward her.

FADE OUT.
