title: The Secret That Cannot Be Told
description: A security guard gains the ability to see people's secrets after hitting his head, discovering hidden truths about those around him.
context:
Title: The Secret That Cannot Be Told
Description: A security guard gains the ability to see people's secrets after hitting his head, discovering hidden truths about those around him.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITY ENTRANCE - DAY

A young SECURITY GUARD squats by the roadside, eating his boxed meal while highlighting a worn security manual.

A WOMAN IN PINK walks toward the entrance, designer bag clutched tight, on her phone. The SECURITY GUARD glances up.

The WOMAN IN PINK stops, her shoulders tightening.

WOMAN IN PINK
(to the guard, voice sharp)
Problem?

SECURITY GUARD
(standing)
Just verifying resident access, ma'am.

WOMAN IN PINK
(ends her call)
Do I look like I need verifying?

SECURITY GUARD
I'd be happy to—

WOMAN IN PINK
(flashes her keycard, cutting him off)
You were staring.

SECURITY GUARD
(quietly)
My apologies. Protocol requires—

WOMAN IN PINK
(impatiently)
Protocol? One complaint and you're scanning IDs at a parking garage.

She thrusts her keycard toward him. He processes it with his phone. The gate opens.

She snatches the phone back, her polished facade cracking—exhaustion flickers across her face.

WOMAN IN PINK
(low, almost to herself)
Don't let me see you looking again.

She sweeps through the gate. The SECURITY GUARD watches her go, jaw tight.

BROTHER WANG leans out from the guard booth, thermos in hand.

BROTHER WANG
continuation:
Kid, some battles you don't fight.

SECURITY GUARD
(quietly)
She's not a battle. She's just...

BROTHER WANG
Rich? Stressed? Doesn't matter. They're all buttons you don't push.

BROTHER WANG
Last month, Chen from Block 3 reduced a guard to tears over a wet umbrella. That's the math.

SECURITY GUARD
Maybe he should've—

BROTHER WANG
Known his place? These apartments cost more than our souls.

The SECURITY GUARD turns, his foot catches on the manual. He falls backward, head cracking against concrete.

SECURITY GUARD
(groaning)
Ah... damn.

He sits up, head throbbing. BROTHER WANG rushes over.

BROTHER WANG
You alright?

Suddenly, the air shimmers around BROTHER WANG. Transparent images flicker—cash register, hospital bill, his fingers sliding money into his pocket. Ghostly text appears.

SYSTEM VOICE (V.O.)
[Name: Wang Gang] [Discrepancy: 574 yuan. Context: Wife's medication.]

The SECURITY GUARD blinks hard. The images vanish.

SECURITY GUARD
(disoriented)
I saw... your wife's pills.

BROTHER WANG
What?

SECURITY GUARD
(looks at him sharply)
Last week. The equipment purchase. You moved 574 yuan.

BROTHER WANG's face goes slack. The thermos slips from his hand, dents on concrete. His eyes show not just terror, but a deep, worn shame.

BROTHER WANG
(hoarse whisper)
How... how could you possibly...
full_script:
Title: The Secret That Cannot Be Told
Description: A security guard gains the ability to see people's secrets after hitting his head, discovering hidden truths about those around him.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITY ENTRANCE - DAY

A young SECURITY GUARD squats by the roadside, eating his boxed meal while highlighting a worn security manual.

A WOMAN IN PINK walks toward the entrance, designer bag clutched tight, on her phone. The SECURITY GUARD glances up.

The WOMAN IN PINK stops, her shoulders tightening.

WOMAN IN PINK
(to the guard, voice sharp)
Problem?

SECURITY GUARD
(standing)
Just verifying resident access, ma'am.

WOMAN IN PINK
(ends her call)
Do I look like I need verifying?

SECURITY GUARD
I'd be happy to—

WOMAN IN PINK
(flashes her keycard, cutting him off)
You were staring.

SECURITY GUARD
(quietly)
My apologies. Protocol requires—

WOMAN IN PINK
(impatiently)
Protocol? One complaint and you're scanning IDs at a parking garage.

She thrusts her keycard toward him. He processes it with his phone. The gate opens.

She snatches the phone back, her polished facade cracking—exhaustion flickers across her face.

WOMAN IN PINK
(low, almost to herself)
Don't let me see you looking again.

She sweeps through the gate. The SECURITY GUARD watches her go, jaw tight.

BROTHER WANG leans out from the guard booth, thermos in hand.

BROTHER WANG
Kid, some battles you don't fight.

SECURITY GUARD
(quietly)
She's not a battle. She's just...

BROTHER WANG
Rich? Stressed? Doesn't matter. They're all buttons you don't push.

BROTHER WANG
Last month, Chen from Block 3 reduced a guard to tears over a wet umbrella. That's the math.

SECURITY GUARD
Maybe he should've—

BROTHER WANG
Known his place? These apartments cost more than our souls.

The SECURITY GUARD turns, his foot catches on the manual. He falls backward, head cracking against concrete.

SECURITY GUARD
(groaning)
Ah... damn.

He sits up, head throbbing. BROTHER WANG rushes over.

BROTHER WANG
You alright?

Suddenly, the air shimmers around BROTHER WANG. Transparent images flicker—cash register, hospital bill, his fingers sliding money into his pocket. Ghostly text appears.

SYSTEM VOICE (V.O.)
[Name: Wang Gang] [Discrepancy: 574 yuan. Context: Wife's medication.]

The SECURITY GUARD blinks hard. The images vanish.

SECURITY GUARD
(disoriented)
I saw... your wife's pills.

BROTHER WANG
What?

SECURITY GUARD
(looks at him sharply)
Last week. The equipment purchase. You moved 574 yuan.

BROTHER WANG's face goes slack. The thermos slips from his hand, dents on concrete. His eyes show not just terror, but a deep, worn shame.

BROTHER WANG
(hoarse whisper)
How... how could you possibly...

title: Double-Faced Heiress
description: A top-ranked female assassin infiltrates a villa to eliminate a target, only to discover he anticipated her attack.
context:
Title: Double-Faced Heiress
Description: A top-ranked female assassin infiltrates a villa to eliminate a target, only to discover he anticipated her attack.

INT. HUO FAMILY VILLA - NIGHT

Through the view of binoculars, a MAN (TARGET) sits in a dimly lit room, looking physically weak, coughing.

MALE PARTNER (V.O.)
Mr. Huo. Syndicate banker. They need him gone by morning.

EXT. HUO FAMILY VILLA BALCONY - NIGHT

A masked FEMALE ASSASSIN and her MALE PARTNER are monitoring the Target with binoculars.

MALE PARTNER
Never thought someone this sick would be this exposed.

The Target pours two glasses of wine, placing one beside his. He raises his glass toward the balcony.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
He knows we're here.

MALE PARTNER
That's impossible—

The Female Assassin taps her earpiece. Static. She pulls out a SILENCED HANDGUN, chambers a round.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
Do you still think this is a standard contract?
continuation:
INT. HUO FAMILY VILLA BEDROOM - CONTINUOUS

The Female Assassin silently opens the window and slips into the room. She tiptoes toward the bed, where the blanket is raised as if someone is sleeping underneath.

She pulls back the covers: PILLOWS beneath.

She freezes.

TARGET (O.S.)
Your father always checked the closets first.

She spins. The Target stands in the bathroom doorway, holding the second wine glass. No weapon.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
(whisper)
You're not sick.

TARGET
I'm dying. Not the same thing.

He takes a deliberate step forward. She attacks.

They engage in fierce combat. Her gun is knocked away. After a struggle, the Target uses her momentum to throw her onto the bed. He's weaker but precise.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
(breathing heavily)
The cough... it was real?

TARGET
Chemotherapy. Stage four.

The shattered wine glass glitters on the floor.

TARGET
But the wine was for you. Sedative, not poison. I'm not a monster.

The Female Assassin pulls out a DAGGER and attacks again. He catches her wrist, twists, and pins her—minimum force, maximum control.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
(struggling)
What do you want?

TARGET
(quiet)
The same thing your father wanted. To watch them burn.

He releases her slowly, pulls out a DATA DRIVE from his pocket, sets it on the nightstand.

TARGET
Every name. Every account. Including the one that pays you.

The Female Assassin looks at the drive, then at him. Understanding dawns.

TARGET
You wear two faces, assassin. Their weapon... or his daughter.

He backs away, giving her space.

FADE TO BLACK

title: After My Daughter's Suicide, I Returned to the Year 2000
description: A successful businesswoman's daughter is driven to suicide by bullying. After losing her, she is given a chance to go back and change everything.
context:
Title: After My Daughter's Suicide, I Returned to the Year 2000
Description: A successful businesswoman's daughter is driven to suicide by bullying. After losing her, she is given a chance to go back and change everything.

EXT. SCHOOL - ROOFTOP - DAY

MENG XIAOWAN, a girl in a school uniform, stands on the edge of the rooftop, her eyes filled with despair.

Below, several CLASSMATES look up at her, mocking her mercilessly.

FEMALE CLASSMATE A
Oh, Meng Xiaowan, why are you trying to jump like everyone else?

MALE CLASSMATE
Jump then!

FEMALE CLASSMATE B
Jump and show us.

FEMALE CLASSMATE C
Yeah, are you jumping or not? Don't waste my lunch time.

Pain flashes across MENG XIAOWAN's face as memories of being bullied flood her mind.

INT. SCHOOL - RESTROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Several FEMALE CLASSMATES corner MENG XIAOWAN in the restroom, throwing things at her.

FEMALE CLASSMATE A (V.O.)
Meng Xiaowan, you bastard child!

INT. SCHOOL - AUDITORIUM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

MENG XIAOWAN is pushed to the ground, surrounded by several FEMALE CLASSMATES.

MENG XIAOWAN
(hurt)
I have a mother!

FEMALE CLASSMATE A
Who's ever seen your mother? Has she ever come to parent-teacher meetings?

FEMALE CLASSMATE B
Still useless.

FEMALE CLASSMATE C
What's the point of good grades?

FEMALE CLASSMATE A
You're just a bastard child!

FEMALE CLASSMATE A picks up a hot curling iron and presses it against MENG XIAOWAN's arm.

MENG XIAOWAN
(screaming)
Ahhh!

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
EXT. SCHOOL - ROOFTOP - DAY

MENG XIAOWAN snaps back to reality, trembling as she takes out her phone.

EXT. YUNCHENG AIRPORT - DAY

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Fifteen years ago, Chen Yilian lost her husband. She fought her way out of poverty, building an empire to protect her daughter. She was wrong.

A helicopter lands on the tarmac. CHEN YILIAN, wearing a trench coat and sunglasses, walks out of the helicopter with a powerful presence. Her fiancé, XU DANIAN, waits at the end of a red carpet with a group of BODYGUARDS in black suits.

XU DANIAN smiles and approaches, taking CHEN YILIAN's bag. Her phone rings in his hand. The caller ID shows "Xiaowan."

XU DANIAN
Your daughter.

CHEN YILIAN glances at the phone, then waves her hand dismissively.

CHEN YILIAN
Tell her I'm in a meeting.

She walks toward the waiting car. Xu Danian answers.

EXT. SCHOOL - ROOFTOP - DAY (INTERCUT)

MENG XIAOWAN hears Xu Danian's voice.

XU DANIAN (V.O.)
Xiaowan? Your mother will call you tonight.

The call disconnects. Meng Xiaowan stares at the screen, her eyes completely losing their light.

INT. CHEN YILIAN'S SEDAN - DAY

CHEN YILIAN sits in the back seat, scrolling through a long text message from her daughter, frowning. The phone rings again. Xiaowan. She answers.

EXT. SCHOOL - ROOFTOP - DAY (INTERCUT)

MENG XIAOWAN
(crying)
Mom, in my next life, I don't want to be your daughter anymore.

INT. CHEN YILIAN'S SEDAN - DAY (INTERCUT)

CHEN YILIAN's expression changes drastically, her pupils dilating.

CHEN YILIAN
(shouting at the driver)
Quick, turn around! Now! Turn around! Hurry!

CHEN YILIAN's expression is filled with terror and despair.

title: Peerless County Magistrate
description: A modern scientist is struck by lightning and transported to ancient times, where he becomes a county magistrate leading refugees during a famine.
context:
Title: Peerless County Magistrate
Description: A modern scientist is struck by lightning and transported to ancient times, where he becomes a county magistrate leading refugees during a famine.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

A woman (WANG XIAOYU) in a white lab coat, black skirt, and high heels walks through the laboratory, her heels clicking sharply against the linoleum. Sunlight glares through the windows, catching the dust motes dancing above sterile steel tables.

QIN ZHENG, a young man wearing glasses and a white lab coat, is focused on looking through a microscope at a slide marked "Sample-207 - Drought Resistant Strain."

WANG XIAOYU walks up behind him, her shadow falling across his work.

WANG XIAOYU
Senior Brother Qin.

QIN ZHENG looks up, surprised to see her. He smiles, pushing his glasses up.

QIN ZHENG
Junior Sister. You won't believe—

WANG XIAOYU moves closer, her expression unreadable. She places a printed email on the bench beside him. The header reads "PROJECT REASSIGNMENT - Lead Researcher: Wang Xiaoyu."

WANG XIAOYU
It's not ours anymore. The committee gave me full credit. Your visa expires next week.

QIN ZHENG stares at the paper, his face draining of color.

WANG XIAOYU suddenly pushes QIN ZHENG. QIN ZHENG crashes into the equipment behind him, his body convulsing as he's struck by electrical current. The microscope slides shatter. The tray of seedlings—their three-week-old rice shoots—topples.

The screen flickers, showing a rapid montage of cosmic nebulae folding into ancient constellations, then decaying into ink wash paintings on yellowed scrolls.

EXT. FOREST - DAY

A group of ragged refugees surrounds a young official (QIN ZHENG) lying on the ground, crying. The air smells of unwashed bodies and dust. Flies buzz around parched lips.

ON SCREEN: First Year of Emperor Jing of Great Qian, Jingzhao Prefecture, Taoyuan County

REFUGEE A
County Magistrate!

REFUGEE B (crying)
Struck down by heaven's fire... just like the others!

REFUGEE C
My lord... speak to us...

QIN ZHENG, lying on the ground, suddenly opens his eyes. For a heartbeat, the voices around him sound like gibberish—then snap into perfect clarity. He sits up abruptly, his hand flying to his chest where the lab's security keycard still hangs on a lanyard.

The refugees retreat in fear.

REFUGEE D
The dead walks!

QIN ZHENG (rubbing his head)
Shut up. I'm breathing, aren't I?

A young refugee named CHENG FEI, maybe sixteen with rope-calloused hands, steps forward.

CHENG FEI
My lord... your eyes changed color.

QIN ZHENG (confused)
Where is this?

CHENG FEI
The western road, my lord. Six days from the county seat. We're fleeing the famine.

QIN ZHENG (shocked)
Famine?
continuation:
EXT. WASTELAND - DAY

QIN ZHENG, supported by CHENG FEI, leads a group of refugees struggling forward across parched land. The earth is cracked like old leather. In the distance, vultures circle.

OLD REFUGEE (grasping a dead walking stick)
My granddaughter died yesterday. Her body weighed less than kindling.

QIN ZHENG (eyes scanning the terrain like a man reading data)
How long since rain?

CHENG FEI
One hundred and seventeen days, my lord.

QIN ZHENG
(to himself, barely audible)
One seventeen...

EXT. FOREST - DAY

QIN ZHENG and the refugees rest under a dying elm. He leans against the trunk, eyes closed.

QIN ZHENG (V.O.)
Seed viability after electrical trauma. Sample-207. Three weeks germination. If the packet survived...

QIN ZHENG instinctively reaches into his coat and pulls out a oilpaper package, slightly scorched at the edges. He unwraps it with trembling fingers. Inside: two dozen rice seedlings, their roots wrapped in moist cotton, and a handful of labeled seeds. A corner of his lab notebook peeks out.

QIN ZHENG (opening the package and seeing the seeds inside)
The cryo-viable batch. The F3 generation markers are still visible.

QIN ZHENG is overjoyed, tears cutting through the dust on his face.

QIN ZHENG
Ha... haha! The controls survived.

Suddenly, a richly dressed young master (WU BAIWAN) approaches with his servants, their fine silk contrasting with the refugees' rags. His expression is bored, businesslike.

SERVANT
My master offers ten pounds of rice for a healthy girl, twelve to sixteen, literate preferred. Contract until next harvest.

A ragged young girl (XIAO LU), sixteen with clear amber eyes despite the starvation, rushes forward, kneeling before WU BAIWAN. Her hands are covered in ink stains.

XIAO LU
Sir, I can read. I can work. Please—my brother is seven. He won't last another night.

WU BAIWAN studies her like a horse trader. He nods to his servant.

WU BAIWAN
She'll do. Bind the contract.

QIN ZHENG suddenly stands, his voice cutting through the air like a whip.

QIN ZHENG
She's a citizen of Taoyuan County. You will not touch her.

The refugees gasp. This hasn't happened before.

WU BAIWAN turns, amused.

WU BAIWAN
Magistrate Qin. You're dead. Or mad. Which is it?

QIN ZHENG holds up the seed packet.

QIN ZHENG
I'm the man who's going to grow rice in thirty days. Anyone who stays with me eats. Anyone who sells my people... gets nothing.

The refugees stare between the seeds and Qin Zheng's wild, certain eyes. The choice hangs in the air like thunder.

title: Return of the King - Homecoming in Glory (Episode 87)
description: A corrupt contractor refuses to pay migrant workers their wages, boasting about his powerful connections, when a mysterious woman arrives to stop the violence.
context:
Title: Return of the King - Homecoming in Glory (Episode 87)
Description: A corrupt contractor refuses to pay migrant workers their wages, boasting about his powerful connections, when a mysterious woman arrives to stop the violence.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

WANG FU sits on a leather sofa, an arm draped around each of two women. One pours champagne, the other offers him a cherry.

WOMAN A
Brother Fu.

WOMAN B
Have another.

WANG FU
He drains the glass, takes the cherry, and laughs—a rolling, satisfied sound.

WANG FU
(laughing)
Good. Very good.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE GATE - DAY

Two dozen MIGRANT WORKERS block the entrance, hoisting a red banner: "QIANGSHENG GROUP: RETURN OUR HARD-EARNED MONEY!!!" Their white signs read "PAY YOUR DEBTS."

MIGRANT WORKERS
(chanting)
Return our hard-earned money! Pay us! Wang Fu pay us!

INT. OFFICE - DAY

A sharp KNOCK.

WANG FU
Come in.

WANG FU'S SUBORDINATE enters, face slick with sweat.

WANG FU'S SUBORDINATE
Brother Fu, the workers. They're all here.

WOMAN A
We'll wait inside.

WANG FU
(to the women)
Don't move. I'll handle this.

He rises, straightening his collar, and exits.
continuation:
EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE SECOND FLOOR CORRIDOR - DAY

WANG FU and his subordinate overlook the courtyard. Five THUGS grip metal clubs below.

WANG FU
(shouting)
Clear them out!

The THUGS charge. The workers stand firm. Clubs swing. Bodies fall.

MIGRANT WORKERS
(screaming)
Stop hitting! You're killing us! We just want our wages!

WANG FU
(calling down)
Enough!

The THUGS lower their weapons. Workers lie bleeding in the dust.

WANG FU
(arrogantly)
You stinking migrants dare ask me for money? Leave now, or don't leave at all.

MIGRANT WORKER REPRESENTATIVE
(cradling a broken arm)
Boss Wang, you promised—year-end settlement. Our families starve!

MIGRANT WORKERS

title: The Domineering CEO's Strategy Manual
description: A journalist accidentally photographs a boss harassing an employee at a car show and must flee, finding unexpected refuge in a mysterious car.
context:
Title: The Domineering CEO's Strategy Manual
Description: A journalist accidentally photographs a boss harassing an employee at a car show and must flee, finding unexpected refuge in a mysterious car.

INT. CAR SHOW VENUE - DAY

A series of close-up shots of luxury sports cars, accompanied by upbeat music.

Several CAR MODELS pose in various positions next to the luxury cars.

MENG RUI'ER (30s, determined, camera bag worn like armor) scans the crowd, her press pass visible. Her colleague DING HAOJIE (20s, nervous, juggling equipment) trails behind.

DING HAOJIE
Chief says we need shots of the new Fleetwood coupe. Just... cars, right? No drama?

MENG RUI'ER
(eyes narrowing)
Just cars. I'm here for the wheels, not the heels.

She raises her camera, framing a pristine vehicle. Through the lens, she spots a MAN IN TAILORED SUIT whispering intensely to a WOMAN in company uniform.

INT. CAR SHOW ANOTHER CORNER - DAY

The BOSS (40s, silver cufflinks, voice like pressed steel) corners XIAO LI (20s, makeup barely hiding her exhaustion) near a display pedestal.

BOSS
Xiao Li. Your mother's specialist consultation. It's scheduled for Monday. Company policy provides discretionary support for... loyal employees.

He places an envelope on the pedestal. His hand rests on hers.

XIAO LI
(quietly, frozen)
Boss, I appreciate the help. But this isn't—

BOSS
(softly)
The contract extension just needs your signature. Tonight. At the hotel suite. We'll discuss your future.

He leans closer. Her badge catches the light as she flinches.

MENG RUI'ER peeks from behind a pillar, snapping rapid shots. Her lens cap accidentally drops—CLATTERING against marble.

BOSS
(turning, voice dropping an octave)
Interesting. Company media policy prohibits unauthorized photography.

He signals two SECURITY GUARDS with a subtle hand gesture.

BOSS
(to guards)
That equipment contains proprietary images. Retrieve it. Now.

MENG RUI'ER
(to herself, snatching lens cap)
Stupid. Stupid.

She sprints away.
continuation:
INT. CORRIDOR - DAY

MENG RUI'ER runs, shoving the camera into DING HAOJIE's hands.

MENG RUI'ER
Memory card's in the side pocket. Get it to Xu at Legal. Tell him "Project Lavender."

DING HAOJIE
(confused, panicking)
Legal? What are you—

MENG RUI'ER
Just run!

She bolts down a different corridor, her phone already dialing a number.

SECURITY GUARDS
(to radio)
Seal the east exit. Female journalist, press pass.

DING HAOJIE looks at the camera, then at Meng's retreating form. He slips out a service door.

EXT. BACK ALLEY - NIGHT

MENG RUI'ER emerges into a narrow service alley, breathless. She pockets her phone, deletes a recent call.

MENG RUI'ER
(to herself)
Great. Expose corruption, lose job, possibly get sued. Happy Tuesday.

A BLACK SEDAN with tinted windows idles at the alley's end, exhaust curling in the cold. The rear door UNLOCKS with a soft CLICK. Through the tinted glass, she sees the silhouettes of the pursuing GUARDS at the alley entrance.

MENG RUI'ER hesitates, then ducks inside.

INT. SEDAN - NIGHT

MENG RUI'ER collapses against the leather seat, shoulder brushing the MAN beside her. He wears gold-rimmed glasses, his attention fixed on a tablet displaying her press badge photo.

MAN
(without looking up)
Project Lavender. Bold codename. The data breach lawsuit from last year?

MENG RUI'ER
(stiffening)
Who—

MAN
(swipes tablet, revealing case files)
You're investigating Apex Automotive's labor violations. I know. I hired Xu.

He finally turns. His eyes are cold, analytical.

MAN
Now. Let's discuss whether you want to survive this story... or become it.

title: The Young Marshal's Wife is Charming Again
description: A modern actress dies in an accident at an awards ceremony and is reborn into the Republican era as a blind girl who was murdered by her stepmother and stepsister.
context:
Title: The Young Marshal's Wife is Charming Again
Description: A modern actress dies in an accident at an awards ceremony and is reborn into the Republican era as a blind girl who was murdered by her stepmother and stepsister.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY HALL - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Year 2024

A gorgeous awards ceremony venue. A red carpet is laid on grand stairs. Reporters on both sides take photos.

EMCEE (V.O.)
Please welcome the winner of the 38th Golden Phoenix Award for Best Actress, Mu Qingyu!

MU QINGYU, 28, glides down the stairs in a silver evening gown, her smile camera-perfect but her eyes hollow.

MU QINGYU (V.O.)
Third award this year. Another role I hated.

Suddenly, the crystal chandelier overhead SHRIEKS—metal cables snapping.

Mu Qingyu looks up as—

The chandelier IMPLODES downward.

Shards of crystal and brass engulf her.

Silence.

Mu Qingyu lies among the wreckage, a single crystal in her hand, blood pooling beneath her.

EXT. MU FAMILY'S BACK GARDEN - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Republican Era - Mu Family's Back Garden

MU QINGYU (in Republic-era silk qipao) lies unconscious beside a lotus pond.

BAI CAIWEI, 45, checks Qingyu's pulse with trembling fingers, lantern shaking.

MU QINGYA, 19, paces nervously, biting her nails.

BAI CAIWEI
(sotto voce)
No pulse. Let's go—before the servants return.

MU QINGYA
(angry whisper)
She shouldn't have fought me. The Young Marshal's wife should've been—

BAI CAIWEI drags her away. Their footsteps fade.

Mu Qingyu's eyes snap open. She gasps, choking on pond water, and grabs her throat.

MU QINGYU (V.O.)
Where—

Images flood her mind: An identical girl being shoved into this pond. Darkness. Blindness.

She touches her face—then her eyes. Opens them.

The moon. Clear. Perfect.

MU QINGYU (V.O.)
(quietly)
Not blind anymore. And... I'm in a drama.
continuation:
INT. MU FAMILY'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

MU QINGYA trims roses, her hands shaking enough to draw blood from a thorn.

MU ZHENGKAI, 50, reads a newspaper at his desk, avoiding her.

BAI CAIWEI
(Forcing cheer)
Qingya's eighteen now. We should discuss her engagement to—

The door opens.

Mu Qingyu enters, soaking wet, her qipao clinging to her frame. She doesn't flinch under their stares.

MU QINGYA
(screams)
You—you were—

MU ZHENGKAI
(Newspaper snapping shut)
Qingyu! What happened?

MU QINGYU
(coldly)
Fell in the pond. Couldn't see.

She watches Mu Qingya shrink behind Bai Caiwei.

MU QINGYU (V.O.)
Scared. Guilty. Good.

MU ZHENGKAI
(avoiding her eyes)
You're a mess. Go clean up.

MU QINGYU
Yes, Father.

She turns, but pauses.

MU QINGYU
(over her shoulder)
The pond water was surprisingly... clear. I saw everything.

She exits, leaving silence.

MU QINGYU (V.O.)
Let them wonder what I remember.

INT. MU QINGYU'S ROOM - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Republican Era - Mu Qingyu's Room

Mu Qingyu locks the door, finally allowing herself to tremble. She lights a cigarette—then remembers it's not her body and stubs it out.

MU QINGYU (V.O.)
No time for shock. Plan.

She crosses to the wardrobe mirror, touching her new face.

MU QINGYU (V.O.)
(re: mirror)
Who were you?

Glass shatters outside.

SUBORDINATE (V.O.)
(yelling)
Block all exits! Don't let the traitor escape!

A BLOODY HAND smears the window glass. The lock clicks.

JIN SHAOTING, mid-20s, military uniform torn, collapses across the sill—unconscious.

MU QINGYU
(quietly, to herself)
Well. This body came with baggage.

FADE OUT.

title: Prosperous Blossoms
description: A modern finance student is electrocuted and transported into an ancient dynasty, where he wakes up in the empress's bed, facing the same fate as his historical namesake.
context:
Title: Prosperous Blossoms
Description: A modern finance student is electrocuted and transported into an ancient dynasty, where he wakes up in the empress's bed, facing the same fate as his historical namesake.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

XIAO QIAN and his GIRLFRIEND are passionately kissing against the wall. She pulls back, breathless.

GIRLFRIEND
Shower first. You're vibrating with caffeine.

XIAO QIAN
That's just market excitement. Made three hundred on the yuan dip.

XIAO QIAN
Wait for me.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

GIRLFRIEND towel-dries her hair, picks up an ancient book from the study materials. She reads aloud.

GIRLFRIEND
(sardonic)
"Xiao Qian of the Southern Kingdom—gambled away his fortune, sold his wife into servitude, and after failing as a eunuch, was executed by five horses for touching the Emperor."

She flips the page. The book's spine crackles with static electricity.

GIRLFRIEND
(calling out)
Your father sent another "educational" text. This guy's supposedly our ancestor?
continuation:
INT. BATHROOM - DAY

XIAO QIAN wipes steam from the mirror, sees the CURLING IRON dangling near the sink edge—unplugged but still hot.

XIAO QIAN
(to himself)
Risk assessment: high. Reward: none.

He reaches to move it safely away. His wet hand touches the metal.

A neon-blue current erupts—not from the iron, but from the ANCIENT BOOK in the other room, channeling through the apartment's wiring.

XIAO QIAN's body seizes. The mirror cracks, spiderwebbing from his reflection.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

GIRLFRIEND sees blue light bleeding under the bathroom door. She drops the book.

GIRLFRIEND
Xiao Qian!

The book flares. Pages fly, whipping into a vortex.

MONTAGE

Blue lightning becomes silk threads. The apartment's modern grid morphs into ancient constellations. "Southern Kingdom" appears in elegant calligraphy across a dawn sky.

INT. ANCIENT PALACE BEDCHAMBER - DAWN

XIAO QIAN gasps awake. Silk sheets. Sandalwood and wine. His hands clutch brocade.

He turns. Beside him, the EMPRESS sleeps with a dagger under her pillow.

XIAO QIAN
(whisper)
No... no, no, no...

He checks his body—intact. Then spots his reflection: he's wearing a EUNUCH'S UNIFORM.

XIAO QIAN
(voice cracking)
I'm the eunuch. The one who—

The Empress stirs. Xiao Qian freezes. His hand brushes her ankle.

The Empress's eyes snap open. Her hand goes for the dagger.

EMPRESS
(low, dangerous)
Another one who wants to die before sunrise?

XIAO QIAN
Your Majesty, I—I tripped on history!

VOICE (O.S.)
Urgent news! The Emperor approaches!

The Empress's gaze doesn't leave Xiao Qian. She smiles, thin and terrible.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The CEO's Wife Is A Bit Wild
description: A young woman in a wedding dress flees from a forced marriage, only to collide with a wheelchair-bound CEO who recognizes her as the doctor who once saved him.
context:
Title: The CEO's Wife Is A Bit Wild
Description: A young woman in a wedding dress flees from a forced marriage, only to collide with a wheelchair-bound CEO who recognizes her as the doctor who once saved him.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

A magnificent door swings open. SHEN QINGHUAN (24) stumbles out in a voluminous white wedding dress, her veil torn. She kicks off her heels and sprints barefoot.

Two MEN IN BLACK round the corner behind her.

MAN IN BLACK 1
Third floor! Move!

MAN IN BLACK 2
Split up—cut her off at the service elevator!

Their radios crackle with coordination as they fan out with practiced precision.

INT. HOTEL STAIRCASE/CORRIDOR - DAY

SHEN QINGHUAN lifts her elaborate gown and takes the stairs two at a time, fabric ripping. She bursts through a fire door into—

A stark white corridor. At the far end, a glass wall overlooks the atrium.

She skids to a stop. Her reflection reveals desperate eyes and a smudged cheek—but also fierce determination.

Behind her, footsteps echo. Multiple sets. They're boxing her in.

SHEN QINGHUAN spots an arched side corridor. She darts toward it.

The Men in Black converge at the archway. They peer down the empty corridor. One checks under a housekeeping cart. The other sweeps behind a pillar—nothing.

MAN IN BLACK 1
(into radio)
She's in the walls. Check all service access on levels four and five.

They retreat, boots clicking in precision.

SHEN QINGHUAN slips out from behind a recessed wall panel, not a pillar. She exhales, clutching a stolen access keycard.
continuation:
INT. LOUNGE - DAY

FU ZHOUCHENG (30s) sits in a carbon-fiber wheelchair, a cashmere blanket across his lap. His assistant WANG ZHANG (40s) pushes him toward floor-to-ceiling windows.

WANG ZHANG
The German specialist arrives Tuesday. Until then, Doctor Murad suggests hydrotherapy—

FU ZHOUCHENG
(gazing out at city)
I didn't ask for suggestions. I asked for results.

His fingers trace a small red amulet in his palm.

FU ZHOUCHENG
(low)
Five years. She'd be what... twenty-four now?

WANG ZHANG
Sir?

FU ZHOUCHENG
Nothing.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

FLASHBACK:

YOUNG FU ZHOUCHENG lies in a dimly lit ICU, monitors beeping softly. His leg is in a complex external fixation frame.

The door cracks open. INTERN SHEN QINGHUAN checks both ways before slipping in.

SHEN QINGHUAN
(whispering)
They said you refused sedation. That's... either very brave or very stupid.

FU ZHOUCHENG
(deadpan)
The morphine makes the dreams worse.

She notices his clenched fist—he's been biting his hand to stay conscious.

Without a word, she produces a small red amulet from her ID badge lanyard.

SHEN QINGHUAN
My grandmother gave me this. Said it helped her through the Cultural Revolution. Placebo effect is scientifically documented.

She drapes it over his IV pole.

SHEN QINGHUAN
If you make it through tonight without punching a nurse, you can return it. Deal?

A ghost of a smile crosses his face.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. LOUNGE - DAY

FU ZHOUCHENG's phone buzzes. He glances at it—an urgent message from Legal.

WANG ZHANG
The Shen Group acquisition papers?

FU ZHOUCHENG
They're trying to force the daughter's signature. Find out why.

Suddenly, a blur of white careens through the lounge door.

SHEN QINGHUAN, breathing hard, sprints straight toward the windows—then sees the wheelchair.

She tries to stop. Her wedding dress's train catches on a floor lamp.

She crashes into FU ZHOUCHENG's wheelchair. They tumble backward.

WANG ZHANG lunges but too late.

FU ZHOUCHENG catches SHEN QINGHUAN as they fall. Her face ends up inches from his.

He stares at her. She stares back, wild-eyed.

The amulet falls from his hand, landing on her heaving chest.

FU ZHOUCHENG
(softly, amazed)
...You kept it.

Behind them, the Men in Black burst through the door.

FREEZE ON SHEN QINGHUAN's shocked face.

title: Love It or Not - Episode 1
description: A bestselling romance novelist who moonlights as a fake boyfriend-for-hire gets a new gig from his manager friend.
context:
Title: Love It or Not - Episode 1
Description: A bestselling romance novelist who moonlights as a fake boyfriend-for-hire gets a new gig from his manager friend.

INT. FAN WENYAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

FAN WENYAN sleeps soundly in bed, his phone ringing beside him. The screen shows: "Zhou Teng - 7 missed calls". He turns over, burying his head under a pillow stained with ink and coffee.

FAN WENYAN (V.O.)
My name is Fan Wenyan. I used to be a bestselling romance novelist.

INT. FAN WENYAN'S HOME - DAY

ZHOU TENG pounds on the bedroom door, a publishing contract visible in his bag.

FAN WENYAN opens the door, squinting, wearing a "World's Okayest Author" t-shirt.

ZHOU TENG
Your editor's terminating your contract in two hours unless you deliver Chapter 20. She's downstairs in my car.

FAN WENYAN freezes. ZHOU TENG pushes past him toward the bookshelf, where a pristine 2019 award sits beside stacks of unsold copies.

ZHOU TENG picks up a dusty book: "Love's Algorithm 2.0". Three hundred printed. Two hundred ninety-seven returned.

FAN WENYAN deflates onto the bed, face in hands.

ZHOU TENG leans against the doorframe.

ZHOU TENG
Got a job for you. Triple rate.

FAN WENYAN
(face buried in pillow)
Not going.
continuation:
ZHOU TENG
Client's father runs your former publishing house. You land this, he reconsiders your contract.

FAN WENYAN sits bolt upright, eyes sharp.

FAN WENYAN (V.O.)
Welcome to my side business: emotional rent-a-hero. We solve problems, play roles, and never break character. Especially when our own lives are the biggest fiction.

FAN WENYAN tears off his t-shirt, revealing a pressed suit underneath. He ties a perfect Windsor knot while studying a client profile.

ZHOU TENG
Room 109. The daughter's been inventing boyfriends for three years. Her father's a lie detector.

FAN WENYAN
What's my cover?

ZHOU TENG
Stable, successful novelist.

FAN WENYAN
That's not a cover, that's a ghost story.

ZHOU TENG
Then haunt them convincingly.

FAN WENYAN checks his reflection, smoothing his hair. For a moment, he looks genuinely confident. ZHOU TENG watches him, then pulls out his own phone—his lock screen shows them toasting at Fan's first book launch.

ZHOU TENG
(quietly)
Don't forget to charge your phone. Real boyfriends answer texts.

FAN WENYAN strides out. ZHOU TENG watches him go, then starts tidying the chaos—closing the laptop, stacking manuscripts, a routine clearly done many times before.

title: Dragon Abyss
description: A delivery man named Lin Yang, betrayed and left for dead by his wife, returns after three years of mastering divine martial arts, seeking revenge with the power of dragon blood and the authority of Haotian Hall.
context:
Title: Dragon Abyss
Description: A delivery man named Lin Yang, betrayed and left for dead by his wife, returns after three years of mastering divine martial arts, seeking revenge with the power of dragon blood and the authority of Haotian Hall.

EXT. BUSINESS CENTER EXTERIOR - DAY

Two delivery workers, LIN YANG and his COLLEAGUE, sit on the steps outside a building eating boxed lunches.

COLLEAGUE
You barely touched your food. Third day in a row.

(beat)
Your ex... she's not worth destroying yourself over.

The COLLEAGUE offers a boiled egg. LIN YANG's knuckles whiten around his chopsticks.

A SECURITY GUARD approaches, his radio crackling with static.

SECURITY GUARD
Delivery guys can't loiter here. Event prep starts tonight.

The GUARD's boot "accidentally" catches LIN YANG's lunch box, spilling it down the steps.

SECURITY GUARD
(tight smile)
Oops. These steps are for tenants. Not sewer rats who can't read signs.

LIN YANG rises slowly, his breathing measured. The air seems to grow heavier.

LIN YANG
You wear a uniform. Does it make you forget you're also just a man?

The GUARD's hand drifts toward his baton. LIN YANG's eyes fix on a spot over the guard's shoulder—seeing something else.

LIN YANG's mind flashes back to his master's teachings.

MASTER (V.O.)
The mountain teaches patience. The world will test it.

FLASHBACK BEGINS:
continuation:
EXT. MOUNTAIN PAVILION - DAY

On a misty mountaintop, LIN YANG sits cross-legged in white robes, meditating. Energy ripples distort the air around him.

MASTER (V.O.)
Three winters. Three summers. You rebuilt yourself from nothing.

The MASTER, an elderly man with white hair and a long beard, materializes from the mist. LIN YANG's eyes snap open—solid gold pupils that fade back to brown.

LIN YANG
Master... the visions won't stop.

MASTER
They are not visions. They are memories your body refuses to release.

The MASTER places a hand on LIN YANG's shoulder. Ancient scars beneath the fabric pulse with faint light.

MASTER
She took your marrow. The mountain gave you something... else. Something that hasn't walked this earth in five dynasties.

The MASTER removes a dragon-shaped ring from his finger. It seems carved from solid twilight.

MASTER
Haotian Hall waits for one who can carry its weight without being crushed. Show me you are that man.

LIN YANG accepts the ring. The metal burns cold against his skin.

MASTER
The silver needles. The technique I taught you... it wasn't for healing. It was to teach you control. Dragon blood doesn't obey those ruled by rage.

LIN YANG's jaw tightens. When he speaks, his voice carries an undercurrent that makes the mist recede.

LIN YANG
Then what obeys?

MASTER
Purpose.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. BUSINESS CENTER EXTERIOR - DAY

The scene cuts back to reality. The SECURITY GUARD is sweating now, though he doesn't know why.

SECURITY GUARD
Tomorrow... the Song family marries off their daughter here. Miss Song Wan'er. Xiao family. Biggest event of the year. I'm not losing my job because some delivery trash—

The name hits LIN YANG like a physical blow. His COLLEAGUE notices Lin's stillness—the dangerous kind.

LIN YANG
(VO)
Wan'er. Here. So close I can taste the irony.

The ring on his finger—drab, unremarkable—catches a sliver of sunlight. For an instant, it gleams like a predator's eye.

LIN YANG's fingers flex. Somewhere in the business center, every light bulb flickers.

LIN YANG
(softly, to the guard)
You should leave now.

The GUARD hesitates, sensing something fundamentally wrong, but his pride won't let him retreat.

SECURITY GUARD
Or what?

LIN YANG smiles. It's not a pleasant expression.

LIN YANG
Or you'll learn what happens when dragon blood remembers.

title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (Episode 92)
description: A prodigal son's return ignites a treacherous power struggle within the Qiao family, where a fateful banquet becomes the stage for betrayal and tested loyalties.
context:
Title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (Episode 92)
Description: A prodigal son's return ignites a treacherous power struggle within the Qiao family, where a fateful banquet becomes the stage for betrayal and tested loyalties.

INT. ANCESTRAL HALL - NIGHT

QIAO AN stands before the Guan Gong statue, offering incense. QIAO QUAN hovers behind him.

QIAO QUAN
Brother An, why did Sizhong suddenly return now?

QIAO AN turns and snorts contemptuously.

QIAO AN
Probably misses Dad.

QIAO QUAN
Dad promised you Qiaoxin International. You built it while he was—

QIAO AN
Without Dad's name, what would we be? Me? A fishmonger. You? Picking through scraps.

QIAO QUAN
(laughing)
You always said that was the honest life.

QIAO AN
A man can't be ungrateful. He's the blood heir. I'm just the spare.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

QIAO SIZHONG in a bathrobe sits beside LI YI on the bed.

LI YI
You're certain about tomorrow?

QIAO SIZHONG
Father's "accident" at the banquet clears our path. The board will beg for blood.

LI YI
And Qiao An?

QIAO SIZHONG
Will kneel or break.

They kiss.

EXT. VILLA ENTRANCE - DAY

QIAO SIHAI exits the villa with LI YI and QIAO SIZHONG. QIAO AN approaches.

QIAO AN
Dad. Xie Wuxin's men have been probing our routes. The timing—

QIAO SIHAI
(laughing heartily)
Business is business. He wouldn't dare at his own table.

QIAO SIZHONG
Father, let me handle Xie Wuxin. Prove I'm worthy.

LI YI
Sihai, your son wants to make you proud. Don't deny him his moment.

QIAO AN
As you say. Father's safety is... paramount.

QIAO SIHAI
Hold the fort, An.

They walk toward the black Audi. Qiao An watches them go, his eyes filled with worry.

title: Flying Life: 1988
description: A father sells his daughter for money, leading to tragedy and a cycle of revenge that spans twenty years.
context:
Title: Flying Life: 1988
Description: A father sells his daughter for money, leading to tragedy and a cycle of revenge that spans twenty years.

INT. QI FENG'S HOUSE - NIGHT

A man (THIRD BROTHER) examines a little girl's (QI XIAOYA) teeth.

QI XIAOYA
(crying)
Dad, I'm scared.

QI FENG
(to Xiaoya)
Quiet.
(to Third Brother)
She's healthy. Never sick.

THIRD BROTHER
Six hundred. Market's flooded.

QI FENG
You said eight last month!

THIRD BROTHER
Take it or leave it. The loan sharks want their money tonight.

Qi Feng glances at the table: medical bills, pill bottles, a loan notice.

QI FENG grabs Xiaoya's arm, hard.

QI XIAOYA
Dad, I'll eat less! I promise!

QI FENG hands XIAOYA to THIRD BROTHER, who passes him a thin stack of cash. QI FENG counts it frantically.

THIRD BROTHER and his accomplice carry away the struggling XIAOYA.

SU QIAN enters, dropping groceries, seeing the scene.

SU QIAN
Qi Feng! What are you doing?

QI FENG
Stay out of it!

They struggle. He pushes. She falls, hits her head, lies still.

QI XIAOYA
Mom!

The door slams. QI FENG drops beside SU QIAN. She stirs, eyes slits.

SU QIAN
(whisper)
My baby...

She crawls to the kitchen drawer. Pulls out scissors.

QI FENG
Su Qian, don't—

She stabs her stomach. Determined. Not theatrical. Blood spreads.

QI FENG catches her falling body.

SU QIAN
(blood on lips, barely breathing)
She will hate you... forever...

She goes limp. The money falls from QI FENG's hands, scattering.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Twenty years later.

The heart monitor beeps. QI FENG (60s, frail but wealthy) lies with oxygen tube.

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
Jiangzhou's richest man, Qi Feng, built his empire on contested evictions. Now dying, he claims he's found his estranged daughter...

Adult QI XIAOYA (30s, composed, sharp suit) enters.

QI FENG
(weak, eyes opening)
Xiaoya... you came.

He gestures to an envelope on the bedside table.

QI FENG
Everything... for you. Please forgive...

XIAOYA takes the will, glances at it, tears it in half.

ADULT XIAOYA
Six hundred yuan. Sold to a mountain village. Married at thirteen. I traced your blood money through every corrupt deal, every shell company, to find you.

QI FENG
(crying)
I had no choice. Your mother's medicine—

ADULT XIAOYA
You chose. I survived. She didn't.

She pulls out the oxygen tube. The monitor alarms.

ADULT XIAOYA
Mom was right.

She watches the flatline, face empty, then turns and leaves.

INT. QI FENG'S HOUSE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

QI FENG wakes from drunkenness. SU QIAN holds XIAOYA in the corner.

SU QIAN
Don't come closer!

QI XIAOYA
Dad, I'll collect more bottles! Don't sell me!

THIRD BROTHER bursts in with two men.

THIRD BROTHER
Qi Feng! The loan sharks sent us. Fifty thousand, or we take the girl and your kidneys.

Qi Feng sees the unsigned transfer paper. Su Qian's terminal diagnosis. Xiaoya's terrified face.

His hand shakes as he reaches for the pen.

QI FENG signs. THIRD BROTHER takes the paper, satisfied.

THIRD BROTHER
Smart man. You'll bounce back.

Qi Feng sits alone, crumpling Xiaoya's drawing: "Daddy, I love you." He presses it to his face.

FADE OUT.

(weak, eyes opening)
Xiaoya... you came.

He gestures to an envelope on the bedside table.

QI FENG
Everything... for you. Please forgive...

XIAOYA takes the will, glances at it, tears it in half.

ADULT XIAOYA
Six hundred yuan. Sold to a mountain village. Married at thirteen. I traced your blood money through every corrupt deal, every shell company, to find you.

QI FENG
(crying)
I had no choice. Your mother's medicine—

ADULT XIAOYA
You chose. I survived. She didn't.

She pulls out the oxygen tube. The monitor alarms.

ADULT XIAOYA
Mom was right.

She watches the flatline, face empty, then turns and leaves.

INT. QI FENG'S HOUSE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

QI FENG wakes from drunkenness. SU QIAN holds XIAOYA in the corner.

SU QIAN
Don't come closer!

QI XIAOYA
Dad, I'll collect more bottles! Don't sell me!

THIRD BROTHER bursts in with two men.

THIRD BROTHER
Qi Feng! The loan sharks sent us. Fifty thousand, or we take the girl and your kidneys.

Qi Feng sees the unsigned transfer paper. Su Qian's terminal diagnosis. Xiaoya's terrified face.

His hand shakes as he reaches for the pen.

QI FENG signs. THIRD BROTHER takes the paper, satisfied.

THIRD BROTHER
Smart man. You'll bounce back.

Qi Feng sits alone, crumpling Xiaoya's drawing: "Daddy, I love you." He presses it to his face.

FADE OUT.

title: Flash Marriage: The Billionaire CEO's Doting Love
description: Fang Qingqing, CEO of Fang Group, proposes to intern Cheng Yize to secure her company shares and silence the board, unaware that he is secretly a CEO himself pursuing her.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage: The Billionaire CEO's Doting Love
Description: Fang Qingqing, CEO of Fang Group, proposes to intern Cheng Yize to secure her company shares and silence the board, unaware that he is secretly a CEO himself pursuing her.

INT. FANG GROUP LOBBY - DAY

FANG QINGQING, 28, strides through the lobby in a sharp white suit. Her heels click a staccato rhythm. She projects power, but her knuckles are white on her handbag.

FANG QINGQING (V.O.)
My grandfather's will is very specific: married by twenty-eight, or forfeit my shares. Today's my birthday.

She enters the bullpen. Conversations evaporate. Employees scramble to look busy.

FANG QINGQING (V.O.)
I need someone convenient. Someone with no agenda. Someone... disposable.

She stops at CHENG YIZE's desk. He looks up from a spreadsheet, unflustered.

CHENG YIZE
President Fang.

FANG QINGQING
Last quarter's audit. You caught the discrepancy. No one else did.

CHENG YIZE
Just doing my job.

FANG QINGQING
(V.O.)
Exactly.

She drops to one knee. The ring box snaps open. The office falls silent.

FANG QINGQING
Cheng Yize. Marry me.

Whispers ripple through the crowd. Phones appear, recording.

CHENG YIZE studies the ring, then her face. A slow smile.

CHENG YIZE (V.O.)
She thinks I'm just an intern.
continuation:
INT. CHENG YIZE'S OFFICE - DAY (FLASHBACK - ONE MONTH AGO)

CHENG YIZE sits at a CEO desk, reviewing Fang Group's capital structure. His secretary XIAO LI enters.

XIAO LI
You're officially registered as an intern analyst. But I don't understand—Chen Enterprises is three times Fang Group's size. Why the infiltration?

CHENG YIZE
Not infiltration. Due diligence.

He glances at his phone—FANG QINGQING's photo from a Forbes cover.

CHENG YIZE
And personal interest.

XIAO LI
She's famous for not dating.

CHENG YIZE
She's about to change her mind.

INT. FANG GROUP OFFICE - DAY

BACK TO SCENE. The ring waits between them.

CHENG YIZE
You don't know anything about me.

FANG QINGQING
I know you need this job. The contract offers financial security. No complications.

CHENG YIZE takes the ring, slips it on.

CHENG YIZE
Then we have an agreement.

The office erupts. A colleague's phone flashes as they livestream.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Lord of the Snowy Domain
description: A legendary immortal lord in seclusion is confronted by enemies seeking the divine weapon he guards, forcing him to return to the mortal world after five years.
context:
Title: Lord of the Snowy Domain
Description: A legendary immortal lord in seclusion is confronted by enemies seeking the divine weapon he guards, forcing him to return to the mortal world after five years.

EXT. SNOWY WILDERNESS - DAY

A vast snowy plain stretches endlessly. A withered tree stands alone. YE FENG, white-haired and dressed in blue robes, sits cross-legged on a dead branch, eyes closed in meditation. Above in the sky, a golden glowing Divine War Bow appears within a halo of light.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR leads several oddly-shaped SUBORDINATES walking through the snow.

ON SCREEN: YE FENG - LORD OF THE SNOWY DOMAIN
HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR
Lord of the Snowy Domain, I advise you to hand over the Divine War Bow. On the road to the Yellow Springs, I will personally escort you.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR and his group close in on YE FENG.

SUBORDINATE
Ancestor, it seems the information was correct. The Lord of the Snowy Domain has entered the True Immortal Realm. This is the perfect moment.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR
(coldly laughing)
In that case, don't blame me. You've been invincible in this world relying on the Divine War Bow. Now, it's mine!

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR waves his staff and slams it into the ground. A black energy surges toward the Divine War Bow phantom in the sky. The phantom explodes into black smoke. HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR immediately casts a spell. A blue beam shoots toward YE FENG but is deflected by a barrier, transforming into a bow that flies back into HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR'S hands.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR
(shocked)
The Divine War Bow? My Divine War Bow? How can this be? This isn't the Divine War Bow. This is just your illusion!

YE FENG slowly opens his eyes.

YE FENG (V.O.)
The Ten Families guard the bow in the mortal world. You waste your time.

YE FENG
Mirror Reflection.
continuation:
YE FENG forms a seal with one hand. A massive golden magic circle descends from the sky, striking down HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR and all his subordinates.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR
(groveling on the ground)
I was wrong, Lord! I was wrong! Please spare me!

YE FENG descends gracefully, looking at him coldly.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR
(on the ground, tone suddenly changing)
Human hearts have grown corrupt. They have been consumed by greedy desires. The Divine War Bow is about to be corrupted too!

YE FENG (V.O.)
Five years. The bow dims in a corrupt world. Xia's fate is the bow's fate.

YE FENG
You will descend with me. Consider it atonement.

YE FENG waves his hand. In a flash of blue light, HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR transforms into a golden retriever dog.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR (as golden retriever)
Ye Feng! You dare turn this ancestor into a dog! I will never forgive you!

YE FENG
Say one more word of nonsense, and I'll take your life right now.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR (as golden retriever)
(immediately backing down)
I... I was wrong.

YE FENG
Big Yellow, let's go.

YE FENG turns and walks away. The golden retriever follows behind.

HUANG QUAN ANCESTOR (as golden retriever)
Must you call me that? I govern the Yellow Springs. My pen still writes in the Book of Life and Death. I can be useful.

YE FENG and the golden retriever walk through a blue portal and disappear into the snowy wilderness.

title: After Big Brother's Death, Sister-in-Law Goes Berserk
description: After her husband's sudden death, a powerful woman faces challenges from the family as they try to seize control of the estate.
context:
Title: After Big Brother's Death, Sister-in-Law Goes Berserk
Description: After her husband's sudden death, a powerful woman faces challenges from the family as they try to seize control of the estate.

INT. PARKING GARAGE - DAY

A white van door opens. 

SHEN QIUSHUI, wearing a white cheongsam and sunglasses, steps out with a commanding presence. Her gloved hand grips the doorframe a moment too long—just enough to notice—before releasing. A young male assistant immediately approaches and drapes a black coat over her shoulders.

ON SCREEN: SHEN QIUSHUI - ELDEST SISTER-IN-LAW OF THE SONG FAMILY

EXT. MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

A row of black-suited BODYGUARDS stand in formation at the entrance. As SHEN QIUSHUI approaches, they bow in unison at ninety degrees.

BODYGUARDS
(in unison)
Good day, Sister-in-Law!

SHEN QIUSHUI walks past them expressionlessly and enters through the gate.

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

The mourning hall is solemnly decorated. Guests in dark suits with yellow ribbons pinned to their chests line both sides.

ANNOUNCER (O.S.)
Sister-in-Law has arrived!

SHEN QIUSHUI, accompanied by her assistant, walks down the black-carpeted aisle with a cold gaze. Guests whisper among themselves.

GUEST 1
She's the wife of Boss Song.

GUEST 2
That's right. They hadn't been married three months when Boss Song suddenly died.

GUEST 1
With such a major upheaval, the Song family is in for a bloodbath.

A MAN holding SONG XINGZHI's portrait approaches and hands it to SHEN QIUSHUI.

SHEN QIUSHUI takes the portrait and slowly walks toward the altar at the front of the hall. She places the portrait carefully, then takes out a yellow tulip from inside her coat. Her fingers linger on the petals for a heartbeat before she gently places it beside the portrait.

SHEN QIUSHUI turns to face all the guests.

SHEN QIUSHUI
Thank you all for attending my late husband's funeral.

SONG ZHENGDE, a middle-aged man wearing glasses, steps forward.

ON SCREEN: SONG ZHENGDE - SECOND UNCLE OF THE SONG FAMILY

SONG ZHENGDE
Niece-in-law, please accept my condolences. 

He reaches out to pat SHEN QIUSHUI's shoulder. She sidesteps, her hand brushing his away with a controlled flick that borders on offensive.

SONG ZHENGDE awkwardly retreats to the side.

A YOUNG WOMAN steps forward, glaring at SHEN QIUSHUI.

YOUNG WOMAN
Shen Qiushui, how can you be so rude? My father is just showing concern.

SHEN QIUSHUI ignores her and walks directly to a chair, sitting down. She picks up an apple and a small knife from the table and begins to peel the apple in one continuous, spiraling motion.

SHEN QIUSHUI
Concern for me? Or concern for the thirty-seven subsidiaries and the seal that controls them?
continuation:
YOUNG WOMAN
You—

SONG ZHENGDE restrains his daughter and steps forward to address SHEN QIUSHUI.

SONG ZHENGDE
Niece-in-law, although you are Song Xingzhi's wife, now that Xingzhi has passed, and moreover, you're an outsider to the family name. The Song enterprise must be handed over to someone with Song bloodline.

SHEN QIUSHUI
(stops peeling the apple)
What if I refuse?

A MAN in a blue suit steps forward arrogantly.

PROVOCATIVE MAN
What does a woman like you understand about running a conglomerate? Go back to your tea parties. Hand over the seal now, or you'll find out how we handle trespassers.

SHEN QIUSHUI's ASSISTANT suddenly laughs—a sharp, humorless sound.

ASSISTANT
Ha ha ha!

PROVOCATIVE MAN
(to the assistant)
Even your lackey knows you're finished. Stop struggling.

ASSISTANT
(smiling)
I'm laughing at your funeral.

PROVOCATIVE MAN
You—

Before he can finish, SHEN QIUSHUI suddenly hurls the small knife in her hand.

The knife whistles through the air, precisely slashing the provocative man's cheek and embedding itself deep in the door frame behind him.

The PROVOCATIVE MAN's legs give way and he collapses to the ground, clutching his bleeding face, staring at SHEN QIUSHUI in terror.

SHEN QIUSHUI
(turning her head slightly, coldly)
Sorry. My hand slipped.

PROVOCATIVE MAN
(trembling all over)
Noth... nothing...

SHEN QIUSHUI snorts coldly and crosses her arms. Her assistant taps his earpiece once. The bodyguards from the entrance rush in with batons, forming a perimeter around the hall.

SHEN QIUSHUI
(looking around)
Does anyone else want to speak?

The hall falls completely silent.

Suddenly, a loud voice comes from outside the mourning hall.

VOICES (O.S.)
Yes!

The doors of the mourning hall are pushed open forcefully. Blinding sunlight streams in. A tall figure walks in against the light with steady steps—the same measured gait from the photograph.

The newcomer is the man from the portrait—SONG XINGZHI. He wears a black coat, his face stern, his eyes sharp. A thin scar mars his temple that wasn't in the photograph.

Everyone stares at him in shock, as if seeing a ghost.

SONG XINGZHI walks to the center of the mourning hall, stops, and scans the entire room with a determined gaze that lands last on SHEN QIUSHUI and the knife still quivering in the doorframe.

title: Meeting Your Glimmer - Episode 01
description: A woman haunted by her mother's tragic suicide must confront her past when her stepmother threatens to sell the special education school her mother founded.
context:
Title: Meeting Your Glimmer - Episode 01
Description: A woman haunted by her mother's tragic suicide must confront her past when her stepmother threatens to sell the special education school her mother founded.

INT. CITY NIGHT VIEW/SHOPPING MALL/STREET - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

City night view. Rain sheets across a high-rise balcony. A woman's silhouette sways.

A phone VIBRATES on marble tile.

Young XU NIAN runs through a brightly lit shopping mall, anxiously looking around.

YOUNG XU NIAN
Mom! Mom! Mom!

Close-up of XU NIAN'S MOTHER holding a phone, tears streaming down her face. She stares at Young Xu Nian's photo on the screen, then across the intersection at her daughter.

XU NIAN'S MOTHER
(whispered)
I'll show you all.

Young XU NIAN runs onto a street at night, stops breathlessly, looking around bewildered.

A loud CRACK.

Young XU NIAN turns back in horror.

YOUNG XU NIAN
(heart-wrenching cry)
Mom!
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

XU NIAN wakes abruptly, gasping. Her hand reaches for a worn newspaper clipping on the nightstand—"Song Yuzhi, 39. Depression. Fall."

She sits up, gets up, walks into the bathroom, turns on the shower.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL COMPLEX - DAY

XU NIAN, wearing a beige turtleneck sweater, walks through the complex. Her fingers trail along a children's mural—hand-painted sun, clouds, small hands reaching.

A red BMW is parked by the roadside. The STEPMOTHER inside sees XU NIAN.

STEPMOTHER
(leaning out of the car)
Xu Nian.

STEPMOTHER gets out of the car, a measured smile on her face.

STEPMOTHER
Your father asked me to come. Xinliang Group is restructuring. We're selling the Xiangyang Road property.

XU NIAN
(coldly)
The school was my mother's. The land was hers.

STEPMOTHER
The land is group-owned now. The school runs at a deficit. Your father feels it's time.

XU NIAN
My father hasn't set foot there in fifteen years.

STEPMOTHER
(quieter)
I know what it means to you. Come home. Talk to him. There might be another way.

XU NIAN
(eyes on the mural)
Pick me up at six. Tell him I want the deed and ten minutes.

STEPMOTHER
(surprised)
Six o'clock.

XU NIAN'S expression is serious, her mind made up.

(surprised)
Six o'clock.

XU NIAN'S expression is serious, her mind made up.

title: Martial Soul Under Heaven & Martial Blood Loyal Heart (Episode 78)
description: After a decade of hunting, Yang Zaitian confronts the mastermind behind his family's massacre, forcing him to choose between vengeance and the future he fought to protect.
context:
Title: Martial Soul Under Heaven & Martial Blood Loyal Heart (Episode 78)
Description: After a decade of hunting, Yang Zaitian confronts the mastermind behind his family's massacre, forcing him to choose between vengeance and the future he fought to protect.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

Blinding sunlight beats down. YANG ZAITIAN (30s), bare-chested and scarred, plants a black-flagged spear into the roof tile. The flag trembles. Below, YAMAMOTO'S GUARDS scatter across adjacent rooftops, their corpses marking a trail of blood.

YANG ZAITIAN touches a jade locket around his neck. Inside: a miniature painting of WAN'ER.

YANG ZAITIAN (V.O.)
Ten years. Ten years of painting this city in their blood.

MONTAGE:
- YAMAMOTO HONGFU (50s, corpulent) lounges poolside, his wine goblet filled with dark liquid. He watches a caged songbird.
- Yang Zaitian's eyes: cold, exhausted, unblinking.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. YANG FAMILY COURTYARD - DAY (TEN YEARS AGO)
Black-and-white, cold tones.

YANG DINGTIAN (40s, armored) kneels, impaled by three shadow blades. His blood pools black.

YANG DINGTIAN
(rasping)
The people... we protected...

A WHITE-ROBED FIGURE stands before him, holding a blood-filled vial that GLOWS faintly.

WHITE-ROBED MAN
The Martial God's blood doesn't belong to peasants. It belongs to progress.

He drips the glowing blood into a silver flask.

YANG DINGTIAN
My son... will—

WHITE-ROBED MAN
Your son will fuel the next ascension. Just like your daughter. And your youngest.

The Figure gestures. YANG ZAIYU (20s) lies crumpled against a pillar, her blade broken. Young YANG ZAIYE (8) cowers by the well, clutching a wooden sword.

YANG ZAITIAN (V.O.)
They didn't just kill them. They harvested them.

The White-Robed Man touches the boy's forehead. YOUNG YANG ZAITIAN (15) watches from the well, covered in his brother's hiding.

WHITE-ROBED MAN (O.S.)
This one has the purest strain. Find him.

Young Yang Zaitian vanishes into the well's darkness.

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

Yang Zaitian YANKS his spear free. His knuckles are white.

YANG ZAITIAN (V.O.)
You taught me what strength was for.

MONTAGE:
- Yang Zaitian moves through Yamamoto's guards: precise, economic strikes. Each kill uses their own weapons against them.

YANG ZAITIAN (V.O.)
Not for thrones. Not for gods.

EXT. POOLSIDE - DAY

Yamamoto Hongfu backs against his birdcage, wine spilled. The songbird inside is dead.

YAMAMOTO HONGFU
You think this ends with me? The Southern Kingdom has a thousand more like me!

YANG ZAITIAN
Then I'll learn their names.

He stabs the spear through Yamamoto's chest. Yamamoto's body slides off, revealing:

INT. BIRDCAGE - DAY

WAN'ER (20s) huddles inside, her wrists marked with extraction scars. She sees Yang Zaitian.

WAN'ER
(whispering)
You came... for the living.

Yang Zaitian SMASHES the cage lock. He helps her out. She touches his face.

WAN'ER
Not just for ghosts anymore.

YANG ZAITIAN
There's a difference between justice and vengeance. You taught me that.

He presses the jade locket into her palm.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

Yang Zaitian stands on the rooftop, Wan'er beside him. Below, the city begins to stir. He looks at his bloodied hands, then at her.

YANG ZAITIAN
Great Xia can wait. This city needs a protector who remembers what we're fighting for.

They watch the sunrise. The black flag catches fire from a nearby torch. Yang Zaitian lets it burn.

FADE OUT.

title: Golden Kingdom - The Little President Dares to Love Me
description: A young woman faces an arranged engagement with a powerful family heir and devises a plan to make him call off the wedding.
context:
Title: Golden Kingdom - The Little President Dares to Love Me
Description: A young woman faces an arranged engagement with a powerful family heir and devises a plan to make him call off the wedding.

TRAILER MONTAGE

MAN (V.O.)
Maybe only when I find the real answer—

BAI QIAN
It's impossible to break off the engagement now.

MAN (V.O.)
—will I have the courage to marry you.

LIU WU (V.O.)
The patriarch wants you engaged to the Ouyang heir. The contract is bound in blood and gold.

BAI QIAN
The head of Fancheng's four great families?

OUYANG FENG
Look into Bai Qian's background. Every detail.

WANG NING
Feng'er, just break the engagement. Pay the gold coin penalty.

BAI QIAN
You're using ancient gold coins to trade lives like livestock?

OUYANG TIAN
The Ouyang family will cut ties with the Wang family soon. Before the lunar eclipse.

WOMAN (V.O.)
After all, she's not my own flesh and blood. That coin should've been mine.

SHANGGUAN YAN
What kind of joke is this, Feng? A scooter?

BO SHI
Don't go too far with this charade, Miss Bai.

SAITO JIRO
When you see the Eight-Foot Jade of the Ouyang clan, you must kneel. It is older than their fortune.

SHEN ZIYU
Take down that plaque. The one that says "Eternal Alliance."

TEN ELDERS
You crazy woman, you've ruined six generations of planning!

LAO FAN
Please accept Manager Bai's kindness. She hasn't slept in three days.

BAI QIAN
Ouyang Feng, how much longer will you watch?

MAN (V.O.)
Less than a hundred gold coins remain. Each one costs a year of someone's life. How can I obtain another?

MAN (V.O.)
A death match between the chosen ones. That's what the coins were originally for.

BAI QIAN (V.O.)
Why hasn't he called my bluff yet?

WOMAN (V.O.)
Because he's already calculated ten moves ahead.

BAI QIAN (V.O.)
Will you come back when I break my coin?

TITLE CARD: GOLDEN KINGDOM - THE LITTLE PRESIDENT DARES TO LOVE ME

EXT. BAI FAMILY VILLA - DAY

A light drizzle. BAI QIAN (24, sharp eyes hidden beneath calculated nonchalance) stands with her back to the gates, phone pressed to her ear.

BAI QIAN
(into phone)
I don't care what it takes. Get me everything on Ouyang Feng's real estate holdings. Not the family—the man himself.

A MAID rushes through the rain, umbrella tilted against the wind.

MAID
(out of breath)
Young Miss, Fifth Madam moved up the meeting. She's already inside. Brought accountants.

BAI QIAN
(smiles, hangs up)
Here comes the real trouble.
continuation:
INT. BAI FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

LIU WU (60s, silk suit, jade bracelet clicking with every gesture) pours tea with ceremonial precision. BAI QIAN watches from the doorway.

LIU WU
(without turning)
Your grandfather's will was quite specific, Qian'er. The gold coin must be transferred before the new moon.

BAI QIAN
(enters, sits opposite)
The Ouyang coin belongs to the main family line. Not some fifth concubine's gambling debt.

LIU WU
(slides a velvet box across the table)
The patriarch's seal says otherwise. Young Master Ouyang has already accepted the alliance.

Inside the box: a single ancient gold coin, stamped with a phoenix.

LIU WU (CONT'D)
(leaning forward)
Of course, a man of his stature would never bind himself to... damaged goods. Make him see that.

BAI QIAN
(quietly)
And if I refuse?

LIU WU
Then I'll activate the secondary clause. Your sister gets your mother's medical bills. All of them.

BAI QIAN's fingers tighten on the box. She stands.

BAI QIAN
(bright smile)
For my family's happiness, I'll make sure this engagement dies a swift death.

MONTAGE

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

BAI QIAN weaves on a pink electric scooter, Hello Kitty helmet, fake designer bag. She stops to buy oranges from a roadside vendor.

BAI QIAN (V.O.)
Step one: Become the nightmare they never saw coming.

The vendor hands her change. She counts it twice, loudly.

EXT. OUYANG FAMILY VILLA ENTRANCE - DAY

The gates tower like a fortress. OUYANG FENG (28, quiet intensity) stands at the top step, watching the scooter's approach through security cameras.

OUYANG FENG
(to his assistant, softly)
She's wearing last season's Chanel. Badly replicated. Interesting.

SHANGGUAN YAN (26, ice in her veins) joins him, spotting the scooter.

SHANGGUAN YAN
Is that... her? Feng, this is beneath you.

OUYANG FENG
Let's see how deep the performance goes.

BAI QIAN screeches to a halt, knocking over a potted bonsai.

BAI QIAN
(overly loud)
Oopsie! I'll pay for that. With my future husband's money, 'kay?

The HEAD MAID hurries forward with a velvet cushion for the gold coin ceremony.

HEAD MAID
Please present your family's coin, Miss Bai—

SHANGGUAN YAN
(intercepts)
Don't you dare. This is a sacred exchange, not a farmer's market.

She swats at BAI QIAN's orange bag. BAI QIAN lets it fall—strategically. Oranges tumble down the marble steps.

BAI QIAN
(faux gasp)
My dowry! Do you know how much these cost? Six yuan a jin!

SHANGGUAN YAN
(whispers harshly)
You're trash. My family earned our coin through blood at Chang'an. You—

OUYANG FENG
(cuts in, voice low)
Yan'er. The Ouyang code. Article three.

SHANGGUAN YAN's face drains. She knows what's coming.

OUYANG FENG (CONT'D)
(to BAI QIAN, formally)
My cousin dishonored your offering. Choose her penalty.

BAI QIAN
(crouches, picks up a muddy orange)
Just have her taste my sincerity.

OUYANG FENG
(nods)
Peel it. Yourself.

SHANGGUAN YAN
Feng—

OUYANG FENG
Now.

The servants turn away. SHANGGUAN YAN's hands shake as she peels the orange, dirt under her nails. Takes one bite. Tears of rage.

SHANGGUAN YAN
(quietly)
Delicious.

BAI QIAN
(leans in, whisper)
The bitterness hides in the pith. Like family.

OUYANG FENG
(observing, to himself)
She doesn't flinch. Not even when Yan'er raised her hand.

BAI QIAN
(stands, stretches)
So, when's the wedding? I'll need an advance.

OUYANG FENG
You'll move in tonight. East wing.

BAI QIAN
Whoa, whoa. A million a month, or I spill family secrets to the press. I've got pics of your grandfather's mistress.

SHANGGUAN YAN
(laughs, recovering)
She's blackmailing you! Feng, throw her out!

OUYANG FENG
(looks directly at BAI QIAN for the first time)
Two million. Starting tonight. But you'll earn it.

He descends the steps, stops beside her.

OUYANG FENG (CONT'D)
(softly, for her ears only)
The replica Chanel is a nice touch. The real one doesn't use that clasp.

He walks away. BAI QIAN's smile freezes.

BAI QIAN (V.O.)
(quiet panic)
He knew. He knew from the first second.

FADE OUT.

title: Return After Six Years
description: A woman returns after six years with her son, seeking justice for past betrayals and ready to reclaim what was taken from her.
context:
Title: Return After Six Years
Description: A woman returns after six years with her son, seeking justice for past betrayals and ready to reclaim what was taken from her.

INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - DAY

WEN RUAN (Wen family heiress), dressed in a black business suit, wearing sunglasses, pulling a suitcase, holds the hand of her son WEN CHENG (Wen Ruan's son) as she walks with a powerful presence.

WEN RUAN removes her sunglasses, her eyes determined.

WEN RUAN
Six years. Time to settle accounts.

WEN CHENG
(looking up at his mother)
Mommy, will Daddy be here?

WEN RUAN
(her eyes darken)
Your father died six years ago. We're here for justice. And to make those who broke us pay.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

ON SCREEN: SIX YEARS AGO

WEN RUAN lies on the hospital bed, looking weak. LIN QIANQIAN (Lin family illegitimate daughter) holds a baby in swaddling clothes, standing by the bed with a vicious smile.

LIN QIANQIAN
The child didn't make it. Brother Jing Hang sends his regards.

WEN RUAN
(in pain)
No... he wouldn't...

LIN QIANQIAN
You were convenient comfort while he was blind. Now? You're obsolete.

LIN QIANQIAN turns to the DOCTOR nearby.

LIN QIANQIAN
She doesn't leave this room alive. The transfer clears in one hour.

DOCTOR
(hesitant)
The protocols—

LIN QIANQIAN
continuation:
Will be compensated. Tenfold.

LIN QIANQIAN exits. The DOCTOR approaches with a syringe.

WEN RUAN
(through gritted teeth)
Wait... I'll triple any offer.
(clutches her locket)
I'm Wen family's lost heir. Proof's in my necklace.

The DOCTOR pauses, checks the engraving: "Wen Estate - First Daughter." His expression shifts.

DOCTOR
(resigned)
Push. Now.

WEN RUAN grips the bedsheet, pushing through agony. Blood stains spread beneath her.

WEN RUAN
(screaming)
Aaghh!

She collapses.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

LIN QIANQIAN, now wearing the same hospital gown as WEN RUAN, holds the baby and walks toward XIE JING HANG (Xie Group CEO), his vision still blurry post-surgery.

LIN QIANQIAN
(joyfully)
Jing Hang, the surgery worked! Our son is waiting.

XIE JING HANG
(squinting, disoriented)
Mengmeng? Your voice sounds...

LIN QIANQIAN
(leaning close)
Everything's changed. But this moment... it's ours.

XIE JING HANG
(touches the baby's face)
Our child...

XIE JING HANG cradles the baby, his expression tender.

From the shadows, WEN RUAN—holding HER baby—watches, devastation etched into her features. She clutches the child tighter, her gaze never leaving the twisted scene as silent tears begin to fall.

(touches the baby's face)
Our child...

XIE JING HANG cradles the baby, his expression tender.

From the shadows, WEN RUAN—holding HER baby—watches, devastation etched into her features. She clutches the child tighter, her gaze never leaving the twisted scene as silent tears begin to fall.

title: CEO Lu's Wealthy Princess
description: A princess from ancient times wakes up in the modern world after dying in battle, only to find herself face-to-face with her mortal enemy reincarnated.
context:
Title: CEO Lu's Wealthy Princess
Description: A princess from ancient times wakes up in the modern world after dying in battle, only to find herself face-to-face with her mortal enemy reincarnated.

EXT. CITYSCAPE - NIGHT

Rain claws at glass towers. Lightning fractures the sky, turning skyscrapers into fleeting skeletons of light.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

A heart monitor's beep cuts the silence—steady, alien, relentless.

A young woman, YUN BINGJIN, lies beneath white sheets. A bandage crowns her forehead like a fallen tiara. Her eyelids tremble, trapped in a dream of smoke and steel.

INT. PALACE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

YUN BINGJIN stands regal in crimson robes, a golden hairpin her only crown. The throne hall yawns empty behind her.

LU BEICHEN (V.O.)
The seal, Princess. Last relic of your fallen kingdom.

YUN BINGJIN (V.O.)
Then I will fall with it.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

YUN BINGJIN's eyes snap open—ancient fury in a modern body.

NURSE
Mrs. Lu? Can you hear me?

YUN BINGJIN sits up, her warrior's grace clashing with the hospital gown.

YUN BINGJIN
This title... this place—

Her gaze snags on the IV pole, the window view of a world that shouldn't exist. Pain lances through her skull as memories flood in: a castle burning, a blade falling, a promise broken.

EXT. PALACE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

The palace courtyard is a maelstrom of clashing steel.

EUNUCH
(running toward YUN BINGJIN)
Princess! Invaders have breached the north gate!

YUN BINGJIN draws her sword, her eyes already scanning for the next threat.

LU BEICHEN emerges from smoke in golden armor, his army a tide behind him.

LU BEICHEN
Your kingdom is ash. The seal for your brother's life.

YUN BINGJIN
You slaughtered thousands. You expect surrender?

LU BEICHEN
I expect you to be practical.

Soldiers drag forward AH ZE—barely a man, crowned in borrowed authority.

AH ZE
(struggling)
Sister, don't—

YUN BINGJIN
(panicked)
Ah Ze!

LU BEICHEN
(grabbing her wrist)
Choose.

AH ZE
(roaring)
I would rather—
continuation:
A blade flashes. AH ZE crumples.

YUN BINGJIN
(heartbroken, hollow)
You gave your word.

YUN SHUANGSHUANG glides from the shadows, her blue robes unstained by battle.

YUN BINGJIN
(in disbelief)
You were his—

YUN SHUANGSHUANG
His agent. Your downfall was always the plan.

Fury blazes in YUN BINGJIN's eyes. She pulls a dagger from her sleeve and drives it toward LU BEICHEN.

YUN BINGJIN
(voice cracking)
Was any of it real?

The dagger pierces LU BEICHEN's chest. He staggers, his hand closing over hers.

LU BEICHEN
(weakly)
In your heart... was I only your enemy?

YUN BINGJIN
(tearfully)
You destroyed everything I loved.

YUN SHUANGSHUANG
Kill the traitor princess!

An arrow buries itself in Yun Bingjin's shoulder. She falls forward into Lu Beichen's arms. Their blood mingles on the stones.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

Yun Bingjin gasps, clutching her unmarked shoulder.

DOCTOR
Mrs. Lu, I'm Dr. Chen. Can you tell me your name?

YUN BINGJIN
(studying his white coat)
You heal with silk and metal?

DOCTOR
Just a quick neuro check.

He produces a penlight. Yun Bingjin's hand shoots up—a warrior's reflex.

YUN BINGJIN
(defensive)
Keep your flame away from my eyes!

NURSE
(whispering to the DOCTOR)
Possible TBI-related delusions. Should we sedate?

The NURSE taps her own head.

The door opens. LU BEICHEN enters in a tailored suit. His eyes—a map of histories she can't forget.

LU BEICHEN
Hello, Princess.

YUN BINGJIN sees his face. Her pupils contract sharply.

YUN BINGJIN
(filled with hatred)
Lu Beichen.

She lunges. But her hands—trained to kill—falter at the last second. Something in his expression is wrong. Too human. Too familiar.

She stumbles, caught between a war that ended and one just beginning.
