title: A Wife's Devotion
description: A woman fights to protect her cognitively impaired husband's autonomy, but is thwarted by her scheming mother and a predatory trustee.
context:
Title: A Wife's Devotion
Description: A woman fights to protect her cognitively impaired husband's autonomy, but is thwarted by her scheming mother and a predatory trustee.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

BAI YU, wearing a white silk blouse and black skirt, sits on the sofa. Close-up of her legs and hands.

A JUN, a handsome man in a suit vest but with the mind of a child, kneels on the floor holding a communication board, making careful gestures with his hands, learning happily.

BAI YU watches him with a complicated expression.

BAI YU
Come here, A Jun.

BAI YU points to the board, guiding him.

BAI YU
Stop—

A JUN
(imitating)
Stop—

BAI YU
No—

A JUN
(imitating)
No—

BAI YU
(smiling helplessly)
Okay, stop playing now.

A JUN laughs happily and continues gesturing with his board.

BAI YU
(softly, seriously)
A Jun, the court deadline is tomorrow. If you can't show self-advocacy, they'll take your guardianship. Today, I'm going to make sure you keep your rights.

A JUN
(innocently)
A Jun, A Jun is good.

BAI YU
(gently)
Come, you're so good. Let's play our game, okay?

A JUN
(excitedly)
Okay, okay, okay, okay!

BAI YU
Come here.

BAI YU gently positions A JUN on the sofa.

BAI YU
From today on, you decide who controls you. This way, no one will ever be able to take your life from you.

BAI YU places a consent form between them. Suddenly, the door bursts open.

LI GUILAN, a woman in a white suit dressed like a wealthy matron, and XU SHAO, a man in a yellow suit, walk in.

LI GUILAN
(sternly)
Bai Yu! What are you doing?

A JUN and BAI YU are both startled.

LI GUILAN
(contemptuously)
Are you filling his head with delusions of competence?

BAI YU
(standing up to defend him)
He's learning to protect himself!

A JUN hides behind BAI YU.

BAI YU
continuation:
Whatever I do for him is right!

LI GUILAN rushes forward and slaps BAI YU hard across the face.

A JUN
(rushing out)
Hey, don't hit my wife!

LI GUILAN pushes A JUN away forcefully.

LI GUILAN
Get away!

A JUN falls to the ground.

BAI YU
(distressed)
A Jun!

LI GUILAN
(pointing at BAI YU and scolding)
You ungrateful daughter, you're driving me crazy! What do you mean it's right? This burden, sick for three years, draining our family's resources! Are you really going to waste the rest of your life on this worthless case?

XU SHAO
Xiao Yu, no matter what, you can't defy the medical assessments—

BAI YU
(interrupting him)
I told you, he has the right to his own life! Whatever I do with him has nothing to do with you, Xu Shao!

LI GUILAN
Xu Shao has secured the facility order, but you refuse him and cling to this fantasy instead! What are you trying to do? Leave with me right now!

BAI YU
I'm not leaving!

LI GUILAN
Fine! Your grandmother's birthday is our deadline. Sign the commitment papers tonight, or you both get nothing! Guards, take her away!

Two BODYGUARDS in black step forward and grab BAI YU.

BAI YU
(struggling)
A Jun!

A JUN
No!

BAI YU
Let go! A Jun!

The bodyguards forcibly drag BAI YU away. LI GUILAN pushes A JUN down as he tries to approach.

LI GUILAN
Get away, get away, get away!

LI GUILAN turns to XU SHAO with a fawning smile.

LI GUILAN
Xu Shao, Xiao Yu is too stubborn. She doesn't understand. Don't worry, I'll make her sign when I get back. As for this idiotic fool, get his signature on these papers. Make him your puppet.

LI GUILAN and XU SHAO exchange a knowing look, then follow the bodyguards out.

Only XU SHAO and A JUN, sitting on the floor, remain in the living room.

XU SHAO
(walking toward A Jun with a sinister smile)
Idiot. You like playing games, don't you? How about big brother plays a game with you?

XU SHAO picks up a blue cushion from the sofa.

XU SHAO
Come on, sign here or else.

XU SHAO forcefully covers A JUN's head with the cushion. Then he picks up a glass fruit bowl from the coffee table and raises it high.

XU SHAO
(grinning viciously)
Sign it, or no more games. Ever.

He violently smashes the bowl toward A JUN, whose head is covered by the cushion.

title: President Li, Your Wife Refuses to Divorce
description: After being murdered by her ex-boyfriend and witnessing her husband and son's death, Shen Zhixia is reborn to the day her disabled husband asks for a divorce, determined to change their fate.
context:
Title: President Li, Your Wife Refuses to Divorce
Description: After being murdered by her ex-boyfriend and witnessing her husband and son's death, Shen Zhixia is reborn to the day her disabled husband asks for a divorce, determined to change their fate.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

TITLE CARD: SHEN ZHIXIA, WIFE OF LI JINCHI

TITLE CARD: QIU YIRAN, SHEN ZHIXIA'S EX-BOYFRIEND

FLASHBACK: QIU YIRAN and SHEN ZHIXIA embrace intimately.

BACK TO SCENE

QIU YIRAN's grip tightens around SHEN ZHIXIA's throat. Her back slams against the wall.

QIU YIRAN
(softly lethal)
You were supposed to make him trust you. Not put him in the hospital.

SHEN ZHIXIA
(gasping)
I did everything you asked—drugged his tea, the car accident, the money transfers—

QIU YIRAN
(leaning in)
And now you're useless.

He shoves his phone in her face. The screen shows a news headline: "HUACHENG MAJOR EVENT NEWS - LI GROUP CEO AND SON FOUND DEAD. FAMILY TUTOR PRIME SUSPECT."

QIU YIRAN
(mock pity)
Look what your husband's little art teacher did. Su Jingxi always had more spine than you.

The phone PLAYS a video: LI JINCHI's body lies in his study. His son RUI RUI nearby. SU JINGXI, in red, is dragged away by police, screaming.

TITLE CARD: SU JINGXI, ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE SU FAMILY

SU JINGXI (ON SCREEN)
(hysterical)
He was supposed to love ME!

QIU YIRAN
(chuckling)
She beat me to the finish line. But don't worry, I'll take good care of your investment portfolio.

SHEN ZHIXIA
(whisper)
Ruirui... Jinchi...

QIU YIRAN
It's too late for them. But not for you.

He pins her down. Her vision blurs. Blood trickles from her nose.

SHEN ZHIXIA (V.O.)
The last thing I heard was his watch ticking. The same one I bought him with Jinchi's money.

MONTAGE

Quick flashbacks: QIU YIRAN's cold smile, LI JINCHI's disappointed eyes, RUI RUI reaching for her hand. All fading to red.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

SHEN ZHIXIA's eyes snap open. She's in bed.

LI JINCHI sits in his wheelchair, a folder sliding from his lap onto the covers. The divorce papers.

TITLE CARD: LI JINCHI, CEO OF LI GROUP

LI JINCHI
One hundred million. Clean break.

She sees the calendar: May 3rd. The day everything started.

SHEN ZHIXIA (V.O.)
The watch ticked. May 3rd. Before I signed, before the tea, before—

LI JINCHI
The car arrives in ten minutes.

SHEN ZHIXIA stares at his hands on the wheelchair. Hands that haven't been broken yet. She touches her throat—no bruises.

SHEN ZHIXIA
(barely breathing)
You're here. You haven't—

She lunges from the bed, her arms circling him. Not a hug—an anchor.

LI JINCHI
(stiffening)
What are you—

Her face presses against his shoulder. Silent. Possessive. Final.

FADE OUT.

title: Divorced CEO Stuns the World
description: A billionaire CEO secretly works as a delivery driver to support her husband, only to discover his betrayal on their anniversary.
context:
Title: Divorced CEO Stuns the World
Description: A billionaire CEO secretly works as a delivery driver to support her husband, only to discover his betrayal on their anniversary.

INT. INDOOR POOL - DAY

CEO LI (30s) floats in the pool, her face unreadable. Her MALE ASSISTANT (40s) waits poolside with a tablet, surrounded by discreet STAFF.

MALE ASSISTANT
The last acquisition closed. Press wants a statement. Should I...

CEO LI
(eyes closed)
You handle it.

A MAID sets a phone on the pool edge. It buzzes. CEO Li's eyes open.

CEO LI
It's our anniversary. I've delivered every order he's placed for three years.
(beat)
Three days. Yunding Villa. Invite the board. I'll tell him then.

MALE ASSISTANT
And if he can't accept the truth?

CEO LI
Then I'll know I was delivering to a stranger.

She pulls herself from the water, already checking her other phone.

INT. MANSION GARAGE - DAY

CEO LI sheds a silk robe, revealing a delivery uniform underneath. She twists her hair into a simple bun, erases her makeup with a wipe. The transformation takes seconds.

Her bodyguard, CHEN, holds out an electric scooter helmet.

CHEN
The motorcade will shadow you three blocks back.

CEO LI
The scooter's new. He'll notice. Have them wait at the warehouse.

She pockets a plain wallet, leaving her black card visible for a moment.

CEO LI
And Chen? If anyone touches the Rolls, you're delivering next week's orders.

She winks, but her voice is steel. He almost smiles.
continuation:
EXT. OFFICE BUILDING PLAZA - DAY

CEO LI parks her scooter among a row of delivery bikes. She secures the scratched helmet. In the glass reflection, she's unrecognizable.

INT. OFFICE LOBBY - DAY

MR. FU (late 30s) discusses blueprints with his own assistant. CEO Li brushes past, delivery bag in hand. Her shoulder barely grazes his.

MR. FU
(freezing)
Li...

CEO LI doesn't break stride. She drops a card on the reception desk without looking back.

CEO LI
For the dry cleaning.

MR. FU picks it up. A plain business card, not black. On the back, her handwriting: "None of your business."

MR. FU's ASSISTANT
Sir? Was that...

MR. FU traces the letters with his thumb.

MR. FU
She's still running.
(beat)
Make sure she gets out clean. No cameras.

INT. OFFICE COMMON AREA - DAY

CEO LI navigates cubicles. WHISPERS follow like smoke.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE A
...her again. The delivery girl.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE B
He lets her do this. It's a power thing.

CEO Li's knuckles tighten on the bag handles. She stops at a corner office door. The nameplate: LIN ZHITING, DIRECTOR.

Inside, LAUGHTER. A woman's giggle, cut short.

FEMALE SECRETARY (O.S.)
Stop. She'll be here any minute.

ZHITING (O.S.)
Let her watch.

CEO Li's hand rises to knock. Hesitates. She can see through the gap: silk blouse on the floor, a manicured hand on his neck. Her own hands are chapped from handlebars.

She pushes. The door swings open.

INT. ZHITING'S OFFICE - CONTINUOUS

For the dry cleaning.

She's still running.

title: I Can Travel Back and Forth
description: A young woman delivering medical supplies accidentally crosses into an ancient battlefield and saves a general, discovering she can travel between two worlds.
context:
Title: I Can Travel Back and Forth
Description: A young woman delivering medical supplies accidentally crosses into an ancient battlefield and saves a general, discovering she can travel between two worlds.

INT. CAR/EXT. BAMBOO FOREST - DAY

A white SUV navigates a dirt road through dense bamboo. Medical supply boxes visible in back.

Inside the car, a young woman wearing glasses (YANG XIN) drives. Her phone BUZZES. She pulls over, gets out, holding it up.

YANG XIN
(answering the phone)
Hello? Supervisor?

SUPERVISOR (V.O.)
(voice breaking up)
—Shuhou Village before dark, you're fired!

YANG XIN
(irritated)
What a terrible place!

YANG XIN turns. A wooden sign reading "Shuhou" flashes with light. The SUV idles past it.

She gets back in, drives forward.

EXT. ANCIENT BATTLEFIELD - DAY

The scene shifts. In the same forest, soldiers in ancient armor fight fiercely.

A general in golden armor (ZHAO CHEN) fights bravely but is outnumbered.

SOLDIER
General! We've been ambushed! You go first!

ENEMY GENERAL
Zhao Chen, surrender to our Great Xia, and I will spare your life!

ZHAO CHEN
(firmly)
I would rather die than surrender!

ENEMY GENERAL
You're asking for death! Whoever kills Zhao Chen will be rewarded with ten thousand taels and promoted three ranks! Kill!

SOLDIERS
Kill!
continuation:
INT. CAR - DAY

Yang Xin sits in the driver's seat, terrified, as if just waking from a nightmare. In her panic, her foot presses the accelerator.

EXT. ANCIENT BATTLEFIELD - DAY

The white SUV suddenly crashes into the battlefield, sending several soldiers flying, and finally knocking down the ENEMY GENERAL.

The car stops. The battlefield falls silent. Everyone stares in shock at this "iron box."

ZHAO CHEN is also stunned.

YANG XIN gets out of the car, still shaken.

YANG XIN
(to herself)
Did I...?

ENEMY SOLDIER
This demon woman killed the general! Kill her!

SOLDIERS
Kill!

The soldiers charge at YANG XIN. She screams and hides behind the car. Suddenly, all the soldiers freeze in place, flickering.

YANG XIN
(confused)
What's happening? Are they filming a movie?

ZHAO CHEN walks toward her, looking at her with complex emotions.

ZHAO CHEN
Archers!

Archers appear in the forest, drawing their bows and aiming.

YANG XIN realizes the danger and immediately grabs ZHAO CHEN's arm.

YANG XIN
Get in the car!

YANG XIN pulls ZHAO CHEN to dodge the flying arrows, pushes him into the car, quickly gets in herself, and slams on the accelerator.

The car speeds away with ZHAO CHEN inside, a group of soldiers chasing behind.

title: Flash Marriage CEO: Mrs. Gu Is Actually a Hidden Boss
description: A woman seeking revenge infiltrates the Gu family through a chaotic wedding where the bride has fled, only to discover dark secrets about her parents' murder.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage CEO: Mrs. Gu Is Actually a Hidden Boss
Description: A woman seeking revenge infiltrates the Gu family through a chaotic wedding where the bride has fled, only to discover dark secrets about her parents' murder.

INT. MOUNTAIN PAVILION - DAY

QINGQING (25, sharp eyes, quiet intensity) stands beside her SENIOR BROTHER overlooking the valley below. Morning mist curls around stone pillars carved with modern graffiti tags beneath traditional eaves.

SENIOR BROTHER
Master left you the Azure Garment Hall, but also a warning. Revenge is a blade that cuts both ways.

QINGQING
Then I'll find a sharper one.

SENIOR BROTHER studies her, then produces a velvet pouch. He tips it, and a broken jade pendant falls into his palm.

SENIOR BROTHER
The other half isn't just a clue. It's a key. And keys open doors people want kept shut.

QINGQING
The Gu family has it.

SENIOR BROTHER
They'll be looking for you, too. The moment you step into South City, you're not the hunter anymore. You're bait.

QINGQING
Good. Bait catches bigger fish.

INT. GU FAMILY HOTEL BALLROOM - DAY

Elegant chaos. Wedding guests murmur as staff rush to adjust floral arrangements. GU MINGCHUAN (30, tailored suit, controlled fury) stands alone at the altar, staring at his phone.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Gu Mingchuan built his empire on precision. Today, his wedding day, the universe decided to mock him.

FATHER GU storms in, face purple. He grabs MOTHER XU by the elbow.

FATHER GU
Your daughter just posted a video from Bali. Bali! While my son stands there like a fool. This is how you raise children?

MOTHER XU
(stumbling)
I-I don't understand. She was here this morning...

FATHER GU
The Xu family humiliates us, then plays innocent? My family will be the laughingstock of South City!

MOTHER XU wrings her hands, then spots XU JIAOJIAO (22, demure dress, calculating eyes) crying softly in a corner.

MOTHER XU
continuation:
Wait... Jiaojiao has always admired Mingchuan. And she's here. Dressed. Ready.

FATHER GU
You want to substitute one daughter for another? Like swapping defective goods?

MOTHER XU
Better a flawed solution than a public disaster. The contracts are signed, the merger depends on this union.

XU JIAOJIAO approaches, wiping fake tears.

XU JIAOJIAO
Uncle, please don't blame Mother. Sister always runs from responsibility. But I... I would never shame the Gu family.

She steals a glance at GU MINGCHUAN. He doesn't look at her.

MOTHER GU
(stepping forward)
Mingchuan, Jiaojiao is a good girl. Sensible. Unlike her sister.

GU MINGCHUAN
(coldly)
I'm not interested in sensible. I'm interested in honest.

XU JIAOJIAO
Brother Mingchuan, I can be whatever you need. My sister only cares about herself.

GU MINGCHUAN
And you care about... what? The family reputation? Or the Gu family assets?

XU JIAOJIAO
(flushing)
I-I don't know what you mean...

FATHER GU
(clutching his chest)
Enough! Mingchuan, for once in your life, think of someone other than yourself. Your stubbornness is killing me.

GU MINGCHUAN
The doctor said your heart is fine, Father. Save the dramatics.

A commotion at the entrance. Heavy footsteps on marble.

XU QIAN (O.S.)
Move. Or get moved.

The crowd parts. XU QIAN (26, red leather jacket, sunglasses, bruised knuckles) walks down the aisle like a storm front. She stops before GU MINGCHUAN, smirking.

XU QIAN
The woman you're marrying isn't here. But the woman you need just arrived.

title: Goodbye and Best Wishes
description: A woman in her wedding dress is abandoned by her groom who leaves to care for his childhood friend, forcing her to confront the truth about their seven-year relationship.
context:
Title: Goodbye and Best Wishes
Description: A woman in her wedding dress is abandoned by her groom who leaves to care for his childhood friend, forcing her to confront the truth about their seven-year relationship.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

MU YUN, wearing a pristine white wedding dress, sits on the edge of the bed, her face glowing with happiness. FU HANZHOU stands with his back to her, talking on the phone.

MU YUN (V.O.)
This morning I woke up thinking seven years had finally led us here. I didn't know it would end like this.

The phone rings. FU HANZHOU answers, his expression becoming grave.

FU HANZHOU
Xinxin collapsed. I have to go.

MU YUN
(shocked)
The ceremony starts in two hours.

FU HANZHOU
(turning around)
She's alone.

MU YUN
(agitated)
Since we started dating, how many birthdays, anniversaries, and holidays have you left me alone for her? I've put up with it before, but today is our wedding!

FU HANZHOU
She's my sister.

MU YUN
(coldly laughing)
A sister who calls you at 3 AM because she had a bad dream?

FU HANZHOU
(impatiently)
Don't do this now.

FU HANZHOU picks up his coat, preparing to leave.

MU YUN
(pressing)
Fu Hanzhou, if you walk out that door...

FU HANZHOU doesn't answer. He walks straight out and closes the door.
continuation:
EXT. CITY - DUSK

Empty shot of the city at night, lights glimmering.

MU YUN (V.O.)
Seven hours. That's how long I sat in this dress, waiting for a call that never came.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

MU YUN sits alone on the bed in her wedding dress, looking forlorn. She picks up her phone and calls FU HANZHOU.

MU YUN
(into the phone)
Hanzhou... the guests are asking...

FU HANZHOU
(phone voice, exhausted)
Xinxin just stabilized. We'll talk tomorrow.

He hangs up before she can respond.

MU YUN listens to the dial tone as tears stream down her face.

MU YUN (V.O.)
Tomorrow. There's always a tomorrow for us, until today.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

FU HANZHOU sits beside the hospital bed. SU XIN, wearing a patient gown, sleeps with her head resting on his shoulder. FU HANZHOU is looking at his phone.

The door opens. MU YUN enters, wearing a trench coat over her wedding dress, her makeup smudged.

MU YUN (V.O.)
Seven years, and you've never watched over me like this.

MU YUN
(quietly)
Hanzhou.

FU HANZHOU ignores her, gently tucking in SU XIN's blanket. He then stands up and walks with MU YUN to the hospital corridor.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

MU YUN and FU HANZHOU stand face to face.

MU YUN
She's stable now. What about us?

FU HANZHOU
Xinxin had a panic attack. She needed me.

MU YUN
And I didn't?

FU HANZHOU
You were surrounded by family. She was alone.

MU YUN
She's always alone. By choice.

FU HANZHOU
(sighs)
The wedding is cancelled.

MU YUN stares at him, then slowly nods.

MU YUN
No. I'm cancelling it. And us.

She removes her engagement ring and places it in his hand.

MU YUN (V.O.)
Seven years to learn I was always the third person in our relationship. Goodbye, Fu Hanzhou. And best wishes.

MU YUN turns and walks away, leaving FU HANZHOU standing alone.

title: After Divorce, CEO Fu Tries to Win Her Back
description: Mu Nansheng confronts Fu Jincheng about her pregnancy, but he demands she terminate it to save his childhood friend. A flashback reveals how their unconventional relationship began a year ago.
context:
Title: After Divorce, CEO Fu Tries to Win Her Back
Description: Mu Nansheng confronts Fu Jincheng about her pregnancy, but he demands she terminate it to save his childhood friend. A flashback reveals how their unconventional relationship began a year ago.

INT. LUXURY LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

MU NANSHENG stands trembling, hand on her stomach. FU JINCHENG faces the window.

MU NANSHENG
(quietly)
I'm pregnant. Two months.

FU JINCHENG
(without turning)
Wan'er needs a kidney transplant. You're a match.

MU NANSHENG
The baby doesn't change that. I can still—

FU JINCHENG
(turning sharply)
Pregnancy hormones disqualify you. This child cannot exist.

He closes the distance between them.

FU JINCHENG
(low, controlled)
That fire you started three years ago. The fire that put her in that wheelchair.

He takes her wrist.

FU JINCHENG
You owe her this.

MU NANSHENG
(whispered)
No...

FU JINCHENG
The appointment is in an hour.

She wrenches backward.

MU NANSHENG
(screaming)
I won't! It's mine too!

A grandfather clock spins backward, distorting.

ONE YEAR AGO
continuation:
EXT. MODERN BUILDING EXTERIOR - DAY

MU NANSHENG, in punk attire and a beret, cradles a handmade voodoo doll. She speaks into her phone.

MU NANSHENG
(into phone)
Relax, Yunyun. By the time I'm done, he'll beg to cancel the arranged marriage himself.

INT. CAFÉ - DAY

FU JINCHENG sits alone, scrolling through a photo of a demure woman in a wheelchair. Glacial patience.

FU JINCHENG (V.O.)
Another perfectly suitable match. How predictable.

A hand-stitched doll lands on his espresso saucer. His eyes lift.

FU JINCHENG
That's not standard tableware.

MU NANSHENG slides into the opposite seat, props her boots on a chair.

MU NANSHENG
Mu Nansheng. Your blind date. This is my emotional support demon.

FU JINCHENG
(registering the name mismatch)
The file said Gu Yun. Demure. Classical piano.

MU NANSHENG
(leaning forward)
And you were described as a gentleman CEO. We both got scammed.

The corner of his mouth twitches.

FU JINCHENG (O.S.)
The doll has your eyes.

MU NANSHENG
She sees through bullshit. Says you've got a ghost on your shoulder. Female. Very angry.

FU JINCHENG
(flatly)

Description: Mu Nansheng confronts Fu Jincheng about her pregnancy, but he demands she terminate it to save his childhood friend. A flashback reveals how their unconventional relationship began a year ago.

INT. LUXURY LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

MU NANSHENG stands trembling, hand on her stomach. FU JINCHENG faces the window.

MU NANSHENG
(quietly)
I'm pregnant. Two months.

FU JINCHENG
(without turning)
Wan'er needs a kidney transplant. You're a match.

MU NANSHENG
The baby doesn't change that. I can still—

FU JINCHENG
(turning sharply)
Pregnancy hormones disqualify you. This child cannot exist.

He closes the distance between them.

FU JINCHENG
(low, controlled)
That fire you started three years ago. The fire that put her in that wheelchair.

He takes her wrist.

FU JINCHENG
You owe her this.

MU NANSHENG
(whispered)
No...

FU JINCHENG
The appointment is in an hour.

She wrenches backward.

MU NANSHENG
(screaming)
I won't! It's mine too!

A grandfather clock spins backward, distorting.

ONE YEAR AGO

EXT. MODERN BUILDING EXTERIOR - DAY

MU NANSHENG, in punk attire and a beret, cradles a handmade voodoo doll. She speaks into her phone.

MU NANSHENG
(into phone)
Relax, Yunyun. By the time I'm done, he'll beg to cancel the arranged marriage himself.

INT. CAFÉ - DAY

FU JINCHENG sits alone, scrolling through a photo of a demure woman in a wheelchair. Glacial patience.

FU JINCHENG (V.O.)
Another perfectly suitable match. How predictable.

A hand-stitched doll lands on his espresso saucer. His eyes lift.

FU JINCHENG
That's not standard tableware.

MU NANSHENG slides into the opposite seat, props her boots on a chair.

MU NANSHENG
Mu Nansheng. Your blind date. This is my emotional support demon.

FU JINCHENG
(registering the name mismatch)
The file said Gu Yun. Demure. Classical piano.

MU NANSHENG
(leaning forward)
And you were described as a gentleman CEO. We both got scammed.

The corner of his mouth twitches.

FU JINCHENG (O.S.)
The doll has your eyes.

MU NANSHENG
She sees through bullshit. Says you've got a ghost on your shoulder. Female. Very angry.

FU JINCHENG
(flatly)
Does she have a name?

Wan'er. Says you owe her a debt.

She's biting your neck. Run!

You first. Your doll moved.

What—

Title: The World's Wealth Emperor
Description: The most powerful and wealthy man in the land holds the fate of kingdoms in his hands as kings compete for his fortune.

EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

SOUND of intense fighting.

Several KINGS wearing distinct royal robes sit in chairs watching the battle. In the center of the courtyard, ASURA WAR GOD wields a battle axe, fighting fiercely against armored training dummies. He moves with precision, each strike sending sparks flying.

SUPER: King of Dasi Kingdom

SUPER: Asura War God - Great Xia's Invincible Champion

ASURA WAR GOD
You are no match for this War God.

QINGTIAN WAR GOD holds a sword, confronting ASURA WAR GOD.

SUPER: Qingtian War God - Great Lin's Final Hope

QINGTIAN WAR GOD
Don't be arrogant! The Wealth Emperor's bounty must save Great Lin Kingdom! Military funding issues plague us.

ASURA WAR GOD
The Wealth Emperor's reward can erase that debt.

SUPER: King of Great Lin Kingdom

KING OF GREAT LIN KINGDOM
For Great Lin Kingdom!

QINGTIAN WAR GOD
For Great Lin Kingdom, I will fight you to the death!

QINGTIAN WAR GOD brandishes his sword and charges at ASURA WAR GOD. The two begin an intense battle.

KING OF GREAT LIN KINGDOM
Qingtian War God, Asura War God, win this and our debt to the Wealth Emperor is erased. I'm counting on you!

The two continue fighting.

SUPER: King of Great Chen Kingdom

KING OF GREAT CHEN KINGDOM
(anxiously)
Lord Wealth Emperor, plague runs rampant in Great Chen Kingdom. Our people are displaced, dying of disease and hunger. We urgently need your aid.
continuation:
The KINGS descend from their chairs and kneel on the ground.

ALL KINGS
We beg the Wealth Emperor for mercy! We beg the Wealth Emperor for rewards!

A team of MEN IN BLACK SUITS carry several large chests into the courtyard and neatly place them on the ground. A man wearing an ornate mask and black robes—THE WEALTH EMPEROR—walks through the main gate.

ALL KINGS
(in unison)
We welcome the Wealth Emperor!

SUPER: The World's Wealth Emperor - Bian Wudao

WEALTH EMPEROR
Everyone, rise.

The KINGS stand up.

ALL KINGS
We pay our respects to the Wealth Emperor.

WEALTH EMPEROR
Your groveling entertains me. Open the chests.

The MEN IN BLACK open the chests, which are filled with imperial credits. The KINGS show expressions of surprise and greed.

WEALTH EMPEROR
Today, this Emperor grows bored of your duels. All shall be rewarded!

The WEALTH EMPEROR throws credits into the air. The KINGS kneel on the ground scrambling to collect them.

A blonde woman, LONG KUI, leaps down from the roof and lands steadily before the WEALTH EMPEROR.

SUPER: Long Kui - The Wealth Emperor's Shadow

LONG KUI
Reporting to the Wealth Emperor, the daughter of Jiang City's wealthiest man has vowed to marry only you. She has prepared a banquet and wishes to wed you before the city's elite.

WEALTH EMPEROR
Marriage? This Emperor will marry, but not her.

LONG KUI
The Wealth Emperor is the richest in the world. What woman could be worthy?

WEALTH EMPEROR
Someone, bring the Ten National Treasures and ten thousand taels of gold. Accompany this Emperor to Jiang City to present betrothal gifts. The woman this Emperor will marry is...

title: Summoning Heroes
description: A modern man playing a card game is struck by lightning and transported to an ancient dynasty, where he becomes the disgraced First Prince with a mysterious summoning system.
context:
Title: Summoning Heroes
Description: A modern man playing a card game is struck by lightning and transported to an ancient dynasty, where he becomes the disgraced First Prince with a mysterious summoning system.

INT. MODERN APARTMENT - NIGHT

Several Three Kingdoms Kill cards are scattered on the table, one of them is a "Traitor" card.

The FIRST PRINCE sits on the sofa, surrounded by three BEAUTIFUL WOMEN.

BEAUTIFUL WOMAN A
You've been stockpiling "peach" cards all night.

BEAUTIFUL WOMAN B
(acting coquettishly)
Save me, my lord! I'm one health from death.

BEAUTIFUL WOMAN C
Please, my lord. I'm about to die.

FIRST PRINCE
(proudly)
I'll save you all. I have nothing but peaches in my hand!

Suddenly, lightning flashes and thunder roars outside the window. The lights flicker.

FIRST PRINCE
(confused)
Huh?

A massive bolt of lightning strikes down, filling the room with electric light.

FIRST PRINCE
What's happening?

The BEAUTIFUL WOMEN scream and scatter.

FIRST PRINCE
Ah! Don't go!

A huge vortex appears on the laptop screen on the table and sucks the FIRST PRINCE in.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT PALACE BEDCHAMBER - DAY

The FIRST PRINCE wakes up on an antique bed, finding himself dressed in ancient costume. Beside him lie two MAIDSERVANTS in ancient dress, MINGYUE and QINGFENG.

FIRST PRINCE
(internal monologue)
Holy shit, I got transported just from playing a card game? And I became a prince of the Great Qian Dynasty?

The FIRST PRINCE's head throbs with pain as fragmented memories flash through his mind.

FLASHBACK BEGINS

EXT. IMPERIAL CITY - DAY

Rebel forces storm into the imperial city, killing and pillaging.

REBEL GENERAL (V.O.)
The Empress is mine, the Princesses are for you all to enjoy! Hahaha!

INT. PALACE THRONE HALL - DAY

The GREAT QIAN EMPEROR, wearing dragon robes, points angrily downward.

GREAT QIAN EMPEROR (V.O.)
The Great Qian Dynasty was blessed by Heaven, and I inherited the Dragon's bloodline. How did I give birth to such a wastrel like you! By imperial decree! From this day forth, all stipends to the First Prince are revoked! Officials of the Great Qian court shall not assist him, and military generals shall not approach his residence!

INT. PALACE - NIGHT

The EMPRESS lies in a pool of blood, barely alive.

EMPRESS (V.O.)
Avenge your mother!

END FLASHBACK

The FIRST PRINCE sits up abruptly, his face full of terror.

FIRST PRINCE
Mother... These are all... my memories? Damn! My life as First Prince was this miserable? I have no allies, no family, and even my mother...

MINGYUE and QINGFENG are startled awake. They immediately get out of bed and kneel on the floor.

MINGYUE & QINGFENG
Your Highness, please forgive us!

FIRST PRINCE
(startled)
Hey, hey, hey! How powerful are the military generals in this era?

QINGFENG
The most powerful warrior is the Martial Saint White Wolf of the Wo Kingdom.

FIRST PRINCE
(confused)
Martial Saint? Isn't the Martial Saint Guan Yu?

MINGYUE
The greatest strategist is Master White Wolong, under the Fourth Prince.

FIRST PRINCE
Wolong? Isn't Wolong's surname Zhuge? Huh?

The FIRST PRINCE frantically searches around the bed.

FIRST PRINCE
Planes! Tanks! Cannons! BMWs! At least give me a medical kit!

He discovers a deck of cards by the pillow, identical to the ones before he was transported.

FIRST PRINCE
(breaking down)
Is this it? After transporting me here, you're just giving me this thing?

The cards suddenly emit golden light, and a game interface unfolds before him.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Collect 100 favorability points to complete the summoning of famous generals to assist you. But each soul summoned carries a debt. The Traitor card remains active.

A huge "Summoning System" card phantom appears in the center of the room.

The FIRST PRINCE stares at the scene before him, his expression changing from despair to calculation.

FIRST PRINCE
Holy... shit.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: I Bring Four Treasures to Break the CEO's Ten Generations of Single Heirs
description: A woman betrayed by her family gives birth to quadruplets and reunites with their father six years later.
context:
Title: I Bring Four Treasures to Break the CEO's Ten Generations of Single Heirs
Description: A woman betrayed by her family gives birth to quadruplets and reunites with their father six years later.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

The "SURGERY IN PROGRESS" light glows red above the operating room door.

SONG QINGHUA lies on the operating table, screaming in pain as she goes through labor.

DOCTOR
Deep breaths!

NURSE
Deep breaths!

DOCTOR
Quick, get the blood supply!

SONG QINGHUA closes her eyes in agony, falling into a flashback.

MADAME HUANG (V.O.)
Song Qinghua. You served President Wang, yet return pregnant by a laborer. This disgrace ends tonight.

EXT. DOORWAY - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Heavy rain pours down. Pregnant SONG QINGHUA holds an urn of ashes, soaked to the bone. Across from her, her half-sister SONG YAN'ER and her stepmother MADAME HUANG stand under an umbrella, their faces carved from ice.

SONG QINGHUA
(pleading)
She's gone, Yan'er. Please. Just let me say goodbye.

SONG YAN'ER
(contemptuously)
Your mother always was in the way. Even ashes inconvenience us.

SONG YAN'ER snatches the urn easily and drops it. It shatters. Ashes scatter in the rain.

SONG QINGHUA
(heartbroken)
Mom!

SONG QINGHUA collapses to her knees, scrambling through broken porcelain. MADAME HUANG steps on her bleeding hand.

MADAME HUANG
Let me tell you plainly. My mother was his first wife. You are the mistake.

SONG QINGHUA
(in disbelief)
He wouldn't...

She looks desperately toward her FATHER, who stands coldly under an umbrella, then turns away.

SONG QINGHUA
(crying out)
The baby... please...
continuation:
INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY (PRESENT)

The scene cuts back to the operating room. SONG QINGHUA is still in the agony of childbirth.

DOCTOR
Deep breaths, deep breaths! Push! It's coming out!

NURSE
It's a beautiful little fairy. Miss Song, you're amazing.

SONG QINGHUA barely catches her breath when another wave of pain hits. She screams again.

DOCTOR
What? There's another? Quick, keep going! Hold on, hold on, hold on, almost out! Good, it's out! There's more, quick, keep pushing! Push harder! Come on! You can do it! It's out, it's out!

SONG QINGHUA
(weakly)
Still not done?

DOCTOR
Last one! Hold on, quick! Push harder, quick! Good, it's out, it's out!

NURSE
(surprised)
How many?

DOCTOR
(counting)
One, two, three, four. Quadruplets! My God, they're quadruplets! This is a one in seven hundred thousand chance. It's a miracle!

SONG QINGHUA
(relieved)
Quadruplets. That's wonderful.

EXT. COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

ON SCREEN: Six years later.

A line of black luxury cars slowly approaches. SONG QINGHUA, wearing a delivery uniform, rides an electric scooter with a little girl, ZAOZAO, sitting in front. To avoid the convoy, SONG QINGHUA brakes hard. The scooter tips over and ZAOZAO falls to the ground.

ZAOZAO
Mommy!

SONG QINGHUA
(rushing to help her daughter)
Zaozao! Are you okay?

ZAOZAO
I'm fine. But the order spilled.

The convoy stops. Several BODYGUARDS in black suits exit. LI JINXUAN steps out of the lead Bentley, his expression cold and stern.

ZAOZAO sees LI JINXUAN. Her eyes widen. She takes a step forward.

ZAOZAO
(softly)
Daddy?

LI JINXUAN
(startled)
What did you call me?

title: Eyes Against the Wind
description: A man betrayed by his girlfriend and humiliated by her lover awakens with a mysterious ability to see the value of objects after a violent confrontation.
context:
Title: Eyes Against the Wind
Description: A man betrayed by his girlfriend and humiliated by her lover awakens with a mysterious ability to see the value of objects after a violent confrontation.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Muffled sounds from behind the bedroom door. Soft laughter, a gasp.

LILI (O.S.)
Wait—what if—

GANG GE (O.S.)
He's not home.

WENZE enters the apartment, keys in hand. He pauses at the sounds from the bedroom.

He approaches the door. Pushes it open.

Inside, LILI and GANG GE freeze on the bed.

WENZE
(whisper)
...Lili?

WENZE lunges forward, grabs Gang Ge's arm. They struggle.

WENZE
(to Lili)
How could you—

LILI
(wrapping herself in a sheet)
How could I? Wenze, look at this place. You think ramen and cheap wine is a life?

WENZE
Everything I earned, I gave to—

LILI
You gave me debt and dreams. Gang Ge gives me security.

GANG GE
You're embarrassing yourself. Walk away now, and we forget this.

WENZE swings. Gang Ge sidesteps, snatches a crystal vase—

SMASH.

WENZE crumples, blood pooling beneath his temple. Still.

GANG GE
(to Lili)
Get dressed. We're leaving.

Gang Ge guides Lili out. She glances back once, expression unreadable.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - LATER

WENZE sits at the table, a butterfly bandage on his forehead. An empty beer bottle in front of him. He stares at his phone—photos of him and Lili. Deletes them, one by one.

WENZE
(quiet)
All that time...

He deletes the last photo. The screen goes black. He sets the phone down, rests his head in his hands.

INT. LIVING ROOM - MORNING

Sunlight slashes across the table. Wenze jerks awake, disoriented.

WENZE
What—?

He touches his forehead—the wound is gone. Checks his fingers. No blood.

WENZE
(softly)
Was it—

His eyes land on his sneakers. Golden text flickers: [Warrior Brand - Street Vendor - Value: $2.30].

WENZE
...a dream?

He blinks. The text remains, hovering.
full_script:
Title: Eyes Against the Wind
Description: A man betrayed by his girlfriend and humiliated by her lover awakens with a mysterious ability to see the value of objects after a violent confrontation.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Muffled sounds from behind the bedroom door. Soft laughter, a gasp.

LILI (O.S.)
Wait—what if—

GANG GE (O.S.)
He's not home.

WENZE enters the apartment, keys in hand. He pauses at the sounds from the bedroom.

He approaches the door. Pushes it open.

Inside, LILI and GANG GE freeze on the bed.

WENZE
(whisper)
...Lili?

WENZE lunges forward, grabs Gang Ge's arm. They struggle.

WENZE
(to Lili)
How could you—

LILI
(wrapping herself in a sheet)
How could I? Wenze, look at this place. You think ramen and cheap wine is a life?

WENZE
Everything I earned, I gave to—

LILI
You gave me debt and dreams. Gang Ge gives me security.

GANG GE
You're embarrassing yourself. Walk away now, and we forget this.

WENZE swings. Gang Ge sidesteps, snatches a crystal vase—

SMASH.

WENZE crumples, blood pooling beneath his temple. Still.

GANG GE
(to Lili)
Get dressed. We're leaving.

Gang Ge guides Lili out. She glances back once, expression unreadable.

INT. LIVING ROOM - LATER

WENZE sits at the table, a butterfly bandage on his forehead. An empty beer bottle in front of him. He stares at his phone—photos of him and Lili. Deletes them, one by one.

WENZE
(quiet)
All that time...

He deletes the last photo. The screen goes black. He sets the phone down, rests his head in his hands.

INT. LIVING ROOM - MORNING

Sunlight slashes across the table. Wenze jerks awake, disoriented.

WENZE
What—?

He touches his forehead—the wound is gone. Checks his fingers. No blood.

WENZE
(softly)
Was it—

His eyes land on his sneakers. Golden text flickers: [Warrior Brand - Street Vendor - Value: $2.30].

WENZE
...a dream?

He blinks. The text remains, hovering.

title: The Illusion of Happiness
description: Lin Xi seems to have a perfect life with a loving family, but a mysterious illness threatens to shatter her happiness, and a dark secret lurks beneath the surface.
context:
Title: The Illusion of Happiness
Description: Lin Xi seems to have a perfect life with a loving family, but a mysterious illness threatens to shatter her happiness, and a dark secret lurks beneath the surface.

INT. VILLA/POOLSIDE - DAY

A montage of happy life moments. Sunlight glints off the pool, balloons dance in the breeze.

Family and friends stand by the pool, ready to give LIN XI a surprise.

LIN XI pushes open the door and sees everyone.

FAMILY
Surprise!

LIN XI (V.O.)
I am Lin Xi. Today I turn thirty.

DAUGHTER runs toward LIN XI, holding up a crayon drawing.

DAUGHTER
Mommy, happy birthday! I made you an angel!

LIN XI picks up DAUGHTER and studies the drawing - three figures, but she's drawn lying down while Husband and Daughter stand.

LIN XI
(softly)
I'll treasure this.

The family sits around an outdoor dining table, raising their glasses. HUSBAND gives LIN XI a small jewelry box.

HUSBAND
Open this later. Alone.

LIN XI (V.O.)
My husband gives the best gifts.

The family poses for a photo. Husband's hand on Lin Xi's shoulder tightens imperceptibly.

LIN XI (V.O.)
But the one who broke this family was me. My body.

The image flickers, cracks spidering across the photo.

BLACK SCREEN. TEXT APPEARS: ONE YEAR LATER
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

HUSBAND holds a glass of water, peeking from behind the door at LIN XI sleeping in bed.

He walks to the bedside and gently pushes LIN XI.

HUSBAND
Honey, time for your medicine.

LIN XI slowly wakes up, stares at the pill organizer. Wednesday's compartment is empty.

LIN XI
(weakly)
I didn't take yesterday's dose.

HUSBAND
You did. You just don't remember.

LIN XI
(quietly)
I remember everything... now.

His phone buzzes. He glances at it, screen turned away.

HUSBAND
Hospital emergency. I'll be back for dinner.

LIN XI
Go ahead. I'll manage.

HUSBAND
Good girl.

HUSBAND walks out with his phone.

LIN XI (V.O.)
I've been tracking the pill colors. Blue, then green, now blue again.

She pulls a notebook from her nightstand - dates, symptoms, pill colors in meticulous handwriting.

She hides it as Husband's footsteps return.

HUSBAND (CONT'D)
Forgot my keys.

He scans the room. She closes her eyes, still.

He leaves. Her eyes open - clear, hard.

She moves to the potted plant by the window, finds the tiny camera. Looks directly into it.

INT. VILLA STAIRCASE - DAY

HUSBAND walks downstairs while talking on the phone, his expression clinical.

HUSBAND
(into the phone)
Increasing dosage. She's becoming suspicious.

INT. BEDROOM - CONTINUOUS

Lin Xi pries open the jewelry box from her birthday. Inside the velvet lining - a micro SD card labeled "DAY ONE."

Quick flashbacks: Husband's tight grip on her shoulder, the drawing of her sleeping, pill color changes, his scanning eyes.

Lin Xi pockets the SD card, places a mint from her pocket on her tongue, and waits.

Her eyes stay open, fixed on the door.

title: The Errand Runner is a Mysterious Boss
description: An errand runner stumbles upon a kidnapping and rescue attempt, revealing hidden depths beneath his humble occupation.
context:
Title: The Errand Runner is a Mysterious Boss
Description: An errand runner stumbles upon a kidnapping and rescue attempt, revealing hidden depths beneath his humble occupation.

EXT. PARK - NIGHT

Moonlight cuts through the tree branches. NALAN YANRAN, late 20s, runs along a dimly lit park path, her designer heels in hand. She looks back, gasping. Mud streaks her designer suit.

She stumbles, catches herself on a bench, and pushes forward. Her phone lies shattered in the grass behind her.

She reaches a residential building's service entrance and ducks inside, pressing against the wall. A SHADOW passes the doorway. She freezes. A gloved hand covers her mouth from behind.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

NALAN YANRAN lies bound with rope, black tape over her mouth, on a worn sofa. Her eyes burn with fury.

ONE-EYED DRAGON ASSASSIN, 40s, skull eyepatch over his left eye, speaks into a burner phone.

ONE-EYED DRAGON ASSASSIN
Package secured. Price just doubled.

MASTERMIND (V.O.)
We had an agreement.

ONE-EYED DRAGON ASSASSIN
In Great Xia, Nalan contracts come with regrets. Pay now, or I disappear.

MASTERMIND (V.O.)
Done. No witnesses.

He pockets the phone and approaches NALAN YANRAN, studying her.

ONE-EYED DRAGON ASSASSIN
They say you built an empire by thirty. Pity.

He rips the tape from her mouth.

NALAN YANRAN
(spitting the words)
My family will hunt you to the ends of the earth.

ONE-EYED DRAGON ASSASSIN
Who said anything about killing?

He produces a small black pill. NALAN YANRAN thrashes. He forces it between her teeth. She struggles as it dissolves.
continuation:
INT. HALLWAY - NIGHT

CHU FAN, early 30s, wearing a blue "Run Your Legs Off" delivery vest, checks a crumpled receipt against the apartment door.

CHU FAN
4B. Third time's the charm.

He knocks. Silence. He knocks harder. A muffled thump comes from inside.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

ONE-EYED DRAGON ASSASSIN freezes at the knock. He pulls a silenced pistol and moves toward the door.

NALAN YANRAN'S vision blurs. She fights the effects of the pill.

CHU FAN (O.S.)
Management said someone's home. I'm not leaving this package in the hall.

The lock turns. The door cracks open. Chu Fan's foot slides into the gap, preventing it from closing.

CHU FAN
(different tone)
Open the door.

ONE-EYED DRAGON ASSASSIN
Wrong apartment.

He tries to shove it closed. The door explodes inward. CHU FAN stands in the doorway, his delivery vest askew, his expression cold and calculating.

ONE-EYED DRAGON ASSASSIN
You have no idea what you've stepped into.

Chu Fan's gaze sweeps the room: the restraints, the pistol, Nalan Yanran's dilating pupils.

CHU FAN
Neither do you.

He drops his clipboard. His hands come up, loose and ready.

title: Return to 1990: Entertainment Godfather
description: A Golden Palm Award-winning actor is poisoned by his wife and manager on the night of his triumph, only to wake up thirty years in the past at a talent show audition.
context:
Title: Return to 1990: Entertainment Godfather
Description: A Golden Palm Award-winning actor is poisoned by his wife and manager on the night of his triumph, only to wake up thirty years in the past at a talent show audition.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY VENUE - DAY

The Golden Palm Best Actor award ceremony. Lights are dazzling. Newly crowned Best Actor XU TIANYANG holds his trophy, standing on stage, surrounded by a group of REPORTERS.

REPORTERS (O.S.)
Mr. Xu! Over here! Mr. Xu!

REPORTER A
They call you a kept man riding your wife's fame. Your response?

REPORTER B
From security guard to Best Actor—was it all thanks to Zhao Jiaojiao?

CROWD (O.S.)
Details! Give us details!

REPORTER C
Rumors about Zhao Jiaojiao and your agent Chu Wei—any comment?

XU TIANYANG
(calmly, but a flicker in his eyes)
I thank two people. My wife Zhao Jiaojiao, who's stood behind me. And my agent Chu Wei. Without them, I'm not here today.

XU TIANYANG's phone vibrates. He glances—UNKNOWN CALLER. He answers.

XU TIANYANG
(low)
Hello?

VOICE ON PHONE (V.O.)
Tianyang... it's Mom's caretaker. She collapsed. Please—

The phone drops. Xu Tianyang's knuckles whiten around the trophy.

XU TIANYANG
(to reporters)
Family emergency. Excuse me.

XU TIANYANG exits, leaving the reporters clamoring.
continuation:
INT. XU FAMILY VILLA - BEDROOM - DAY

XU TIANYANG rushes in. His MOTHER lies still on the bed, lips pale. Agent CHU WEI stands near the window. Wife ZHAO JIAOJIAO hovers by the bedside.

XU TIANYANG
Mom!

CHU WEI
(gripping his shoulder)
Take a breath. I called emergency services. Here—water.

Chu Wei hands him a glass. Xu Tianyang downs it without thinking.

XU TIANYANG
(crouching)
Her lips... discolored. This looks wrong—

A spasm wrenches through him. The glass shatters.

XU TIANYANG
(gasping)
The water...

ZHAO JIAOJIAO
(stepping back)
Finally figured it out?

XU TIANYANG
(doubled over)
You...

CHU WEI
(smirking)
She walked in on us this afternoon. Threatened to cut you from her will. We had to act fast.

ZHAO JIAOJIAO
Cold, honey? You've been living off me for five years while we played house. Time's up.

XU TIANYANG
(straining)
My son... spare my son...

A CHILD stands in the doorway—XU TIANYANG'S SON, holding a toy airplane. He surveys the scene, then walks past Xu Tianyang and takes Chu Wei's hand.

XU TIANYANG'S SON
Daddy, is he finally leaving?

CHU WEI
(ruffling the boy's hair)
Soon, champ. Then it's just us.

XU TIANYANG
(trembling)
No... he's...

CHU WEI
(leaning close)
I didn't just spend your money and fuck your wife, Xu. I raised your child. Every time you kissed him goodnight, he called me Daddy in his heart.

XU TIANYANG's fingers claw at the carpet. His eyes lock on the trophy—a mockery in his grip.

XU TIANYANG
(whisper)
Next life... I'll bury you.

His breath rattles. Stops.

INT. TIME TUNNEL

The trophy glints. Time rewinds in stuttered flashes—Xu Tianyang's face aging backward, lights reversing, film spooling backward.

INT. TALENT SHOW VENUE - DAY

XU TIANYANG suddenly wakes up, wearing a security guard uniform, seated among unfamiliar young faces.

XU TIANYANG
(disoriented)
Where is this?

HOST (O.S.)
Welcome everyone to Good Voice.

On stage, a MALE and FEMALE HOST are hosting the show. The background displays "Good Voice Talent Show - 1990."

FADE OUT.

title: Good Baby Arrives
description: A five-year-old girl is abandoned by her adoptive parents on a rainy night and desperately searches for her deceased mother.
context:
Title: Good Baby Arrives
Description: A five-year-old girl is abandoned by her adoptive parents on a rainy night and desperately searches for her deceased mother.

INT. STREET - NIGHT

A rainy night, the street is wet. XIAO TUANZI (a girl, about 5 years old) carries a white backpack, walking with difficulty in the rain. She cries while looking at a family photo in her hand.

XIAO TUANZI
(crying)
Mommy... Mommy...

INT. HOME DINING ROOM - NIGHT

A bowl is smashed on the floor.

FATHER (O.S.)
(angry)
You put saffron in your mother's porridge!

XIAO TUANZI sits at the dining table, crying sadly.

XIAO TUANZI
(crying)
I just wanted it to smell right...

FATHER points at XIAO TUANZI furiously.

FATHER
(shouting)
Your mother is dead! This one is carrying our real child!

The pregnant ADOPTIVE MOTHER walks over, stroking her belly.

ADOPTIVE MOTHER
(quietly)
She's trying to help, honey. She doesn't understand.

FATHER
(firmly)
She has to go. Tonight.

XIAO TUANZI gets down from the chair, walks to ADOPTIVE MOTHER, and reaches out her small hand wanting to touch ADOPTIVE MOTHER's belly.

Suddenly, FATHER pushes XIAO TUANZI away.

FATHER
(shouting)
No!

XIAO TUANZI is pushed to the ground, leaning against the sofa, looking at them in fear.

XIAO TUANZI
(pleading, crying)
Daddy, Mommy, please. Xiao Tuanzi will be good. I can teach baby the rules. I remember them all...

FATHER walks to ADOPTIVE MOTHER's side and comforts her.

FATHER
(to his wife, not to Tuanzi)
We'll call the agency. She needs more than we can give.

XIAO TUANZI
(crying)
Daddy, I won't make mistakes anymore...
continuation:
INT. STREET - NIGHT

The scene cuts back to the rainy street. XIAO TUANZI is alone, crying out.

XIAO TUANZI
(crying out)
Mommy... Mommy...

In the mist ahead, the figure of a woman in ancient costume holding an oil-paper umbrella appears. It is XIAO TUANZI's biological MOTHER.

MOTHER
(gently)
My good girl.

XIAO TUANZI
(surprised, crying)
You found me!

MOTHER
Come. Before it's too late.

XIAO TUANZI runs crying toward MOTHER's phantom.

XIAO TUANZI
(running and shouting)
Mommy! Don't go!

A car speeds toward her, its lights blinding. The sound of emergency braking.

The family photo floats down from the air and falls on the wet ground.

XIAO TUANZI lies in the middle of the road, unconscious, her hand reaching weakly forward.

MOTHER's phantom appears again, smiling at her.

MOTHER
(gently)
You found me first. My brave girl.

XIAO TUANZI lies on the ground, weakly reaching out her hand.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

MOTHER
(gently)
You found me first. My brave girl.

XIAO TUANZI lies on the ground, weakly reaching out her hand.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

Title: A Mother's Desperate Search
Description: A pregnant woman's daughter is kidnapped and sold by her gambling addict husband on the child's birthday, leading to a tragic night of loss and desperation.

EXT. ANCIENT TOWN STREET - NIGHT

QIN FANGHAO (pregnant) and her daughter YOUYOU walk hand-in-hand along the stone-paved road.

QIN FANGHAO
We'll make something delicious when we get home. I saved a little.

They pass a cake shop window. YOUYOU stops, looking at the cakes.

QIN FANGHAO
(gently)
Does Youyou want cake?

YOUYOU
Mom, didn't you say Dad took all the money?

QIN FANGHAO
I kept some aside. For your birthday.

YOUYOU
(happily)
Thank you, Mom.

QIN FANGHAO opens the shop door. YOUYOU lingers outside, still looking at the display. The SHOPKEEPER's bells JANGLE from within, and QIN FANGHAO turns her head inside for just a moment.

In that instant, LIN WEI crosses the narrow street from shadows. He covers YOUYOU's mouth and pulls her into the dark passage beside the shop.

EXT. DARK ALLEY - NIGHT

LIN WEI drags YOUYOU into the alley. A couple (BUYER MAN, BUYER WOMAN) waits.

LIN WEI
Here she is.

BUYER WOMAN
Let me see her.

LIN WEI pulls YOUYOU forward. She trembles.

YOUYOU
(crying)
Dad, please don't sell me.

LIN WEI
(avoiding her eyes)
You eat too much.

YOUYOU
I'll eat less! I can work--

LIN WEI
(impatiently)
Enough.

He shoves YOUYOU toward the buyers. She stumbles. The woman catches her, starts walking away.

YOUYOU
(calling back)
Dad!

LIN WEI takes the money envelope, counts it, not watching them leave.
continuation:
EXT. IN FRONT OF CAKE SHOP - NIGHT

QIN FANGHAO exits with a cake box, turning with a smile.

QIN FANGHAO
My daughter loves strawberry cake the most.

She looks for YOUYOU. Sees the empty spot where she stood. Sees the alley mouth.

QIN FANGHAO
(anxiously)
Youyou? Youyou! Youyou!

She runs to the alley entrance, shouting.

QIN FANGHAO
Youyou!

LIN WEI appears from the alley, breathing hard.

LIN WEI
What are you shouting about? Where's the child?

QIN FANGHAO
(flustered)
I don't know! She was right here--

LIN WEI
(roaring)
You lost her?

He slaps her. The cake box falls. QIN FANGHAO stumbles.

QIN FANGHAO
(voice breaking)
I bought a cake and came out--

LIN WEI
(pointing)
I told you not to celebrate! Now look!

He kicks her leg. She goes down, clutching her belly.

LIN WEI
Your crying makes me feel terrible! Get up and search!

He kicks the vegetable basket beside her, spilling contents.

LIN WEI
Where's the money?

QIN FANGHAO
(crying)
You took everything! Where would I have money?

LIN WEI
Go home and cook!

He turns away, hands shaking, and leaves without looking back. QIN FANGHAO lies on the ground, blood seeping through her skirt. She reaches tremblingly to the smashed cake, picks up a tiny bit of frosting.

QIN FANGHAO
(sobbing)
Youyou...

QIN FANGHAO
(lying on the ground, weak but determined)

title: Rebirth of the Crown Prince
description: A murdered crown prince is reborn back to the moment before his betrayal, determined to take revenge on those who conspired against him.
context:
Title: Rebirth of the Crown Prince
Description: A murdered crown prince is reborn back to the moment before his betrayal, determined to take revenge on those who conspired against him.

INT. WINE POOL AND PLEASURE PALACE - NIGHT

Quick cuts of a group of beautiful women in ancient costumes playing and frolicking in a pink pool.

A man in white robes (CROWN PRINCE) emerges from the water, gasping, terror in his eyes. He freezes, scanning the opulent chamber.

TITLE: CROWN PRINCE OF THE GREAT ZHOU DYNASTY

CROWN PRINCE (V.O.)
The Wine Pool... It can't be...

INT. FOREST - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

CONSORT ZHUANG and THIRD PRINCE LI CHANGHE watch the CROWN PRINCE struggle against guards, a cloth gag in his mouth.

CONSORT ZHUANG
You were always a placeholder, nothing more.

The CROWN PRINCE's eyes burn with betrayal.

THIRD PRINCE
(crouching)
Forgive me, brother. The path to destiny requires... sacrifices.

The THIRD PRINCE drives his sword forward. The CROWN PRINCE's vision goes black.

INT. WINE POOL AND PLEASURE PALACE - NIGHT

The CROWN PRINCE stumbles back against the pool edge, his face a mask of cold fury.

BEAUTIES
(playfully)
Crown Prince, join us!

CROWN PRINCE (V.O.)
Li Changhe's trap. Same night. Same bait.

CROWN PRINCE
(calm but commanding)
Xu Sisi.

A beautiful woman (XU SISI) turns in the water, her smile faltering at his expression.

XU SISI
Crown Prince... you called?

She approaches slowly, her seductive manner now cautious. She reaches for him.

XU SISI
The night is still young. Perhaps in your chambers--

CROWN PRINCE
What year of the Wansheng Era?
continuation:
XU SISI
The seventh year. But why--

His grip tightens on her wrist. Not violent, but unbreakable.

CROWN PRINCE
(quietly)
How much did he promise you? Enough to gamble your life?

XU SISI
I... I don't understand.

CROWN PRINCE
Then understand this: in precisely one hour, Li Changhe will storm these gates with witnesses, branding you the victim of my debauchery. Your reputation will be his weapon. And your life?

He leans closer, his voice a blade.

CROWN PRINCE (V.O.)
He'll dispose of her afterward. She doesn't know.

CROWN PRINCE
—expendable.

XU SISI's face drains of color.

CROWN PRINCE
(shouting to the chamber)
All of you! Clear this palace. Now!

The beauties scatter. A EUNUCH (EUNUCH SU) ducks behind a screen, pulling out a hidden message scroll.

The CROWN PRINCE hauls Xu Sisi from the pool, wrapping her in a robe. She trembles, but doesn't resist.

CROWN PRINCE
(to Xu Sisi)
You have two choices. Be the bait in a trap that will destroy us both. Or help me spring it on the hunter.

He guides her to a private alcove, where a scroll and seal await.

CROWN PRINCE
Write to Li Changhe. Tell him your mission is successful. That I've taken the bait... and you've secured the evidence he wanted.

He places a small packet in her hand—her own letters to a secret lover, which he somehow possesses.

CROWN PRINCE
And this will ensure your cooperation.

XU SISI
(whispering)
You... you wouldn't.

CROWN PRINCE
I already died once tonight. The question is: will you live?

The candlelight flickers across Xu Sisi's trembling hand as she reaches for the brush. The Prince's shadow falls across the scroll—a protector or a warden, she can no longer tell.

The camera pans to the burning candle, melting away the old wax, forming something new.

title: The Empress of Great Zhou
description: An empress discovers her husband the emperor in bed with her own sister and confronts them, only to be betrayed and poisoned.
context:
Title: The Empress of Great Zhou
Description: An empress discovers her husband the emperor in bed with her own sister and confronts them, only to be betrayed and poisoned.

INT. PALACE CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Empress JIANG XUE, dressed in magnificent robes, walks briskly toward the Emperor's bedchamber, surrounded by a group of PALACE MAIDS and EUNUCHS.

EUNUCH
Your Majesty the Empress, entering the Emperor's bedchamber without his summons is a capital offense.

JIANG XUE
He hasn't attended court for days. I must see what he's doing.

JIANG XUE ignores the obstruction and continues forward.

INT. EMPEROR'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

JIANG XUE kicks open the bedchamber door with one foot. The door shatters. She walks into the incense-filled chamber with anger.

On the dragon bed, Emperor LI QINGXUAN is startled awake.

LI QINGXUAN
Who?

JIANG XUE walks into the inner chamber and sees clearly what is before her. Emperor LI QINGXUAN sits on the bed in disheveled clothing, and behind him is none other than her own sister, JIANG YING.

JIANG XUE
(shocked)
Li Qingxuan... Jiang Ying... You two!

LI QINGXUAN
(coldly)
Empress, you have intruded into the bedchamber. That is a capital offense.

JIANG XUE
(questioning)
Then what crime is it for the Emperor to casually bed an unwed woman from outside the palace and neglect state affairs?

LI QINGXUAN
(sneering)
Ridiculous! I am the Emperor. What crime is it to favor a woman? Let me tell you, today I will make her Empress! And you, for intruding and disturbing me, shall be executed on the spot!

LI QINGXUAN
(shouting)
Guards!
continuation:
A group of GUARDS rush into the bedchamber, drawing their swords and surrounding JIANG XUE.

GUARDS
Ha!

The GUARDS swing their swords at JIANG XUE. She dodges easily, grabs one GUARD by the neck, and throws him out, knocking down another GUARD.

Her movements are fluid. Within a few moves, she has defeated all the GUARDS.

The GUARDS struggle to their feet, looking at her in terror.

LI QINGXUAN
(furious)
Capture Jiang Xue! Ten thousand taels of gold as reward! Anyone who retreats will have nine generations of their family executed!

Spurred by the reward and punishment, the GUARDS roar and charge at JIANG XUE again.

GUARDS
Yah!

JIANG XUE crouches down, placing both hands on the luxurious carpet and channeling her internal energy. The carpet instantly shatters, and a powerful wave of force sends all the GUARDS flying backward. They crash heavily to the ground, unconscious.

JIANG XUE
(contemptuously)
You cannot kill me.

As soon as she finishes speaking, JIANG XUE suddenly feels a sharp pain. She falls to her knees and violently coughs up blood.

JIANG YING on the bed reveals a triumphant smile.

JIANG YING
The incense, sister. It was laced with poison from the moment you entered.

JIANG YING rises from the bed, draping herself in imperial robes.

JIANG YING
The Jiang clan grows tired of warrior Empresses. We prefer puppet rulers.

JIANG XUE collapses, her eyes locked on the dragon emblem above. A final smile frozen on her lips.

JIANG YING
(whisper)
Why do you smile?

Silence. JIANG XUE is still.

title: Divorce! Stop Treating Me Like a Toad
description: A devoted husband discovers his wife's betrayal on the day his grandmother dies in the hospital.
context:
Title: Divorce! Stop Treating Me Like a Toad
Description: A devoted husband discovers his wife's betrayal on the day his grandmother dies in the hospital.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - LATE AFTERNOON

CLOSE UP on a heart monitor, rhythm weak but steady.

GRANDMOTHER lies in the hospital bed, oxygen tube hissing. YU XUAN holds her hand, dark sunglasses masking his red-rimmed eyes.

YU XUAN
Grandmother.

GRANDMOTHER
(strained)
Yu Xuan... Xia Zhu...

YU XUAN
She's filming. I left word.

GRANDMOTHER
Call her. Must... see...

YU XUAN stands, moves to the window. He dials, throat tight.

YU XUAN
(into phone)
She's asking for you. Doctor says—

INT. CAR - EVENING

XIA ZHU sits in the backseat, watching the city blur past. Her phone lights up: Yu Xuan calling. She stares at it. Lets it ring. Declines. Powers off the phone.

The driver, GAO NING, glances in the rearview mirror.

GAO NING
Problem at home?

XIA ZHU
Nothing that can't wait.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - EVENING

YU XUAN hears the disconnect tone. He tries again. The automated voice answers.

AUTOMATED VOICE (V.O.)
The number you have dialed is unavailable.

YU XUAN removes his sunglasses. His eyes are raw, exhausted. He wipes them with a shaking hand, forces a smile, returns to the bedside.

YU XUAN
(voice controlled)
She's on her way. Traffic.

Grandmother's fingers tighten weakly on his. Her lips form words without sound. The monitor's beep stretches into a monotone flatline.

YU XUAN
(whisper)
No—no, no...

He presses the call button, then crumples, forehead to her hand.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

The car glides into a garage. XIA ZHU stares at her dead phone screen. GAO NING parks, shifts to face her.

GAO NING
Three years is a long time to stay silent.

XIA ZHU
You were sick.

GAO NING
You waited.

XIA ZHU
(small voice)
And now you're here.

He reaches for her hand. She doesn't pull away. The garage lights flicker overhead.

INT. PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

A white sedan screeches to a halt. YU XUAN stumbles out, still wearing his funeral clothes. His phone shows XIA ZHU's location—her car's GPS, a shared safety feature he'd forgotten about until tonight.

YU XUAN
(into phone)
Grandmother's gone. I just need you to—

He looks up. Through the luxury car's windshield, he sees XIA ZHU leaning into GAO NING's embrace.

YU XUAN's phone slips from his hand. It cracks on the concrete.

YU XUAN
(barely audible)
Xia Zhu...

He stands frozen as the garage door grinds closed behind him, sealing the darkness.

title: KTV Debt Confrontation
description: A tense negotiation in a KTV room over a debt, where loyalties and power dynamics clash.
context:
Title: KTV Debt Confrontation
Description: A tense negotiation in a KTV room over a debt, where loyalties and power dynamics clash.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

LAO MEI'ER holds a microphone, singing. HUA ZI, LIN TAO, and other FRIENDS sit on the sofa listening.

LAO MEI'ER finishes singing and puts down the microphone. FRIENDS applaud.

HUA ZI
Lao Mei'er, that voice could make a dead man cry. Wasted on this room.

LAO MEI'ER
(to LIN TAO)
Brother Tao, did it reach you?

LIN TAO
Every word.

LIN TAO
(to HUA ZI)
Hua Zi, the guarantor papers show thirty thousand principal. Let's settle at forty-five and be done.

HUA ZI
Interest adds up. Fifty thousand flat. But for you, Tao Zi—I'll cut the trouble fee. Forty-eight. Generous, right?

LAO MEI'ER
(standing up, angry)
This room costs eight hundred an hour. You're haggling over pennies while my sister's shop dies? Zhou Da Yong is family. Half. Now.

HUA ZI
Not blood. But Lao Mei'er—one private song, I drop ten thousand. Just us upstairs. I'll be gentle.

LIN TAO
continuation:
(to HUA ZI)
Mountains don't move, Hua Zi. But rivers remember stones. You might need a bridge.

HUA ZI
(taking a sip of wine)
Bridges are for movers. You're furniture. Don't you know your price?

LIN TAO
(standing up)
Say it.

HUA ZI
You're a ghost. A favor. Fifty thousand. Not one less, or the shop is mine.

HUA ZI
(looking at LIN TAO)

Bao Ge.

BAO GE sits down.

title: Eight Years Later
description: A woman secretly posing as the righteous thief Jade Hero to aid the poor discovers her husband, comatose for eight years, has finally awakened.
context:
Title: Eight Years Later
Description: A woman secretly posing as the righteous thief Jade Hero to aid the poor discovers her husband, comatose for eight years, has finally awakened.

INT. OUTSIDE GOVERNMENT OFFICE - DAY

An OFFICIAL rides his horse, shouting angrily.

OFFICIAL
Sealed! Every road out of the province!
I want Jade Hero's head by dawn!

A masked figure, JADE HERO, leaps across rooftops above a bamboo forest. The OFFICIAL's guards rampage through an impoverished village, and VILLAGERS scatter to avoid them.

VILLAGER (V.O.)
(whispered)
Bless you, Jade Hero...

INT. DILAPIDATED SHACK - DAY

A LITTLE GIRL sits by the bed, caring for her seriously ill MOTHER.

LITTLE GIRL
(quietly desperate)
I'll find a way. The apothecary said three days—

MOTHER
(weakly)
No, child. Let me go.

A cloth pouch lands in the doorway. The LITTLE GIRL retrieves it, revealing silver taels.

LITTLE GIRL
(breathless)
Mother... it's from Jade Hero.

MOTHER
(tearfully)
Then I can die in peace... May heaven guard that noble soul.
continuation:
EXT. VILLAGE - DAY

JADE HERO rides into a stable. Dismounting, QIN XIANGYU removes her mask, revealing her face.

TITLE CARD: CHEN HEMEI'S WIFE - QIN XIANGYU

She stuffs her black cloak into a feed sack, rubbing dirt onto the horse's distinctive markings.

SOLDIERS (O.S.)
The horse came this way! Search every stall!

SOLDIERS rush toward QIN XIANGYU but see only a woman in plain clothes with a common nag.

SOLDIER
You—see anyone in black?

QIN XIANGYU
(shakes head)
Only my husband's horse, sir.

The soldiers charge past. Qin Xiangyu exhales.

EXT. VILLAGE MARKET - DAY

AUNT WANG tends her bun stall.

AUNT WANG
Two steamed, coming up!

QIN XIANGYU walks over carrying a basket.

QIN XIANGYU
Aunt Wang.

AUNT WANG
Yu'er, you're finally here. Take these.

AUNT WANG stuffs two steaming buns into QIN XIANGYU's hands.

QIN XIANGYU
Auntie, I can't—

AUNT WANG
You saved Xiao Hu. Let an old woman help.

(beat)
Still tending his horse?

QIN XIANGYU
(nods)
He'll want it waiting.

AUNT WANG
(sighs)
Top scholar... what a waste.

Qin Xiangyu's expression darkens. Her daughter, CHEN YUEPING, runs over.

CHEN YUEPING
(shouting)
Mother!

CHEN YUEPING
(out of breath)
Father's eyes... they opened!

QIN XIANGYU lifts her head in shock, the buns falling from her hands to the ground.

title: Late Sound of Rain
description: A young woman discovers she is the lost daughter of a wealthy tycoon, but the family she serves tries to steal her identity.
context:
Title: Late Sound of Rain
Description: A young woman discovers she is the lost daughter of a wealthy tycoon, but the family she serves tries to steal her identity.

INT. SHEN FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

RUOLAN, wearing a simple white suit, carries a tray of pastries toward the living room.

RUOLAN
Miss.

MISS SHEN sits on a zebra-striped sofa. She deliberately tips the tray with her foot. Pastries scatter across the floor.

MISS SHEN
You're getting worse. At least a dog learns.

RUOLAN lowers her head, hurt.

RUOLAN
I'm sorry.

RUOLAN crouches down to clean up the pastries on the floor. The TV in the background is playing the news.

TV NEWS (V.O.)
Billionaire Xiao Pingchuan announced today he's narrowed his search for his missing daughter to this district. A press conference at his estate tomorrow will reveal his findings.

The TV shows a photo of XIAO PINGCHUAN with his young daughter at a cherry blossom tree. RUOLAN sees the news and, shocked, touches the locket at her throat. She opens it—same tree, same child, but only half the photo remains.

RUOLAN
(whispering)
Mother...

MISS SHEN snatches the locket from RUOLAN's hand.

MISS SHEN
Give it to me! Where did you get this?

RUOLAN
It was my mother's.

MRS. SHEN walks over from the side. She takes the locket. Studies it.

MRS. SHEN
You will leave tonight. My daughter attends the press conference tomorrow.

RUOLAN
He'll know—

MRS. SHEN
Men see what they want. Especially fathers who've searched twenty years.

She produces a small scalpel.

MRS. SHEN
The birthmark is your proof. Remove it, and you're free. Or we remove your chance to interfere.

MISS SHEN moves forward and pins down the struggling RUOLAN.

RUOLAN
(crying out)
No! Let me go!

MRS. SHEN
Don't move.

Suddenly, a MAID runs in frantically.

MAID
Madam! Xiao Pingchuan's assistant called—he's arriving tonight instead!

MRS. SHEN and MISS SHEN freeze instantly, their faces full of shock. RUOLAN lies on the ground, covering her face, still shaken.
continuation:
INT. AIRPORT ARRIVALS HALL - DAY

XIAO PINGCHUAN walks through the terminal with his ASSISTANT, cane clicking against the floor.

XIAO PINGCHUAN
The investigator confirmed the birthmark?

ASSISTANT
Yes. She's at the Shen residence. Tomorrow's press conference is arranged.

XIAO PINGCHUAN
Tomorrow feels very far away.

They exit.

INT. SHEN FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

RUOLAN lies on the floor. MISS SHEN holds the locket. MRS. SHEN stands over Ruolan.

MRS. SHEN
We have one hour. He'll verify her identity. We must ensure she has no proof.

She pulls out a small bottle.

MRS. SHEN
This chemical removes birthmarks. Painless. Or I make you disappear. Choose.

RUOLAN
(desperate but determined)
The truth doesn't need proof.

MRS. SHEN
(coldly)
Truth is what powerful men declare it to be.

MISS SHEN forces RUOLAN's head back. MRS. SHEN opens the bottle.

RUOLAN
(terrified)
Don't! Please!

MRS. SHEN
Don't move.

Suddenly, the MAID bursts in.

MAID
Madam! Xiao Pingchuan is at the gate! He demands to see Ruolan immediately!

MRS. SHEN and MISS SHEN freeze, faces full of shock. RUOLAN lies on the ground, covering her face, still shaken.

title: Phoenix Rebirth
description: A woman witnesses the despair of company shareholders on the brink of collapse, marking the beginning of her transformation from overlooked to unstoppable.
context:
Title: Phoenix Rebirth
Description: A woman witnesses the despair of company shareholders on the brink of collapse, marking the beginning of her transformation from overlooked to unstoppable.

INT. LUXURY VILLA - NIGHT

Overhead shot, a woman (FEMALE LEAD) in an elegant white gown lies at the bottom of a spiral staircase, gazing up at a massive crystal chandelier. Architectural blueprints are scattered beside her.

Close-up shot, a pearl high-heeled shoe falls to the floor, landing on a blueprint corner.

Close-up shot, FEMALE LEAD's hand rests on the edge of a bathtub, the water surface covered in foam. A red pen stains her fingers.

FEMALE LEAD (V.O.)
Yesterday, you wouldn't even look at me.

FEMALE LEAD slowly descends the spiral staircase, her eyes resolute. She steps over the blueprints without a glance.

FEMALE LEAD (V.O.)
Today... you can't afford to.

Scene transitions, white screen fades in.

TITLE CARD: ONE DAY EARLIER

EXT. OFFICE BUILDING EXTERIOR - DAY

Rain is falling. FEMALE LEAD wears a simple white shirt and jeans, carrying a bag and holding a rolled drawing board, rushing toward a modern office building. A security guard barely glances at her ID.

EXT. OFFICE BUILDING ROOFTOP - DAY

Three men in suits (SHAREHOLDERS A, B, and C) stand near the rooftop edge. SHAREHOLDER A stands on the ledge, rain plastering his hair. The others look panicked.

SHAREHOLDER B
Come down, Lao Zhang! We can still find a way!

SHAREHOLDER A
(voice cracking)
The vultures already picked us clean. There's nothing left.

SHAREHOLDER C
(to Shareholder B)
He hasn't slept in three days. Neither have you. We're not thinking straight--

SHAREHOLDER A
Don't come closer!

A man in a trench coat (DIRECTOR WEI) rushes onto the rooftop.

DIRECTOR WEI
Zhang! Step back from there!
continuation:
The SHAREHOLDERS turn. SHAREHOLDER A wavers on the ledge.

SHAREHOLDER B
Director Wei, thank God. Talk some sense into him.

DIRECTOR WEI
(calm but firm)
Zhang, I've been on the phone with Hong Kong since dawn. There's interest. Real interest.

SHAREHOLDER A
(bitter laugh)
They're circling, not investing. They want us broken.

DIRECTOR WEI
Then we don't break. Step down. That's an order.

SHAREHOLDER A
After thirty years? To become a cautionary tale?

FEMALE LEAD appears at the rooftop door, breathless, drawing board under her arm. She freezes.

SHAREHOLDER B
You! Girl from design--call security!

FEMALE LEAD
(quietly)
I was... I brought the renovation plans you requested.

She unrolls the board with trembling hands. Rain spatters the ink.

SHAREHOLDER A
Renovation? There's nothing left to renovate.

FEMALE LEAD's eyes scan the blueprints, then lift to the skyline visible from the ledge. Something clicks in her expression.

DIRECTOR WEI moves toward SHAREHOLDER A, carefully.

DIRECTOR WEI
There's always something. There has to be.

SHAREHOLDER A starts to turn. DIRECTOR WEI lunges, grabbing his arm. The two men stumble back from the edge, falling to the ground. The other shareholders rush to help.

FEMALE LEAD stands alone, the ruined blueprints in her hands. She looks from the struggling men to the city beyond. Slowly, her trembling stops. Her grip tightens on the red pen still clipped to her shirt pocket.

FEMALE LEAD (V.O.)
They see a dead building. I see three million square feet of vertical potential.

She turns and walks back through the door, her shoulders squaring. The ruined plans slip from her fingers, landing in a puddle. We see a corner: "ZEYUE GROUP - ROOFTOP EXPANSION."

FADE OUT.

title: Reborn 2004
description: A man discovers his wife's betrayal on the same day he learns his mother has terminal leukemia.
context:
Title: Reborn 2004
Description: A man discovers his wife's betrayal on the same day he learns his mother has terminal leukemia.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

ZHENG HAO stares at the diagnosis report, the paper trembling slightly in his hands. The DOCTOR stands by silently.

DOCTOR
Your mother's AML is accelerating. She needs immediate induction therapy. The targeted medication isn't covered by basic insurance.

ZHENG HAO
(voice hollow)
How much?

DOCTOR
Two million yuan. For the first cycle.

She touches his shoulder. He doesn't react.
continuation:
EXT. HOME ENTRANCE - DAY

Zheng Hao stands at his doorstep, the diagnosis heavy in his briefcase. A man's leather shoe peeks from beneath the doormat.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Zheng Hao enters. From the bedroom: a man's low laugh, Pan Lian's murmured voice. He stops, keys still in hand.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

PAN LIAN sits on the bed with a jewelry catalog. XIMEN pours wine at the dresser.

XIMEN
He still suspects nothing?

PAN LIAN
Yoga class. Every Tuesday.

She points to a diamond necklace.

PAN LIAN
The children asked about their father. I said soon.

XIMEN
Soon. When the villa transfer clears.

Their glasses clink. The door swings open.

Zheng Hao stands motionless, the diagnosis report slipping from his fingers. The shoe, the wine, her smile—everything slots into place with devastating clarity.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Heiress's Intricate Schemes
description: A young executive on a forced blind date encounters a rebellious heiress and a mysterious woman who may unlock the memory he's been chasing for fifteen years.
context:
Title: The Heiress's Intricate Schemes
Description: A young executive on a forced blind date encounters a rebellious heiress and a mysterious woman who may unlock the memory he's been chasing for fifteen years.

EXT. OUTDOOR CAFÉ - DAY

LUO CHEN (28, sharp suit, gold-rimmed glasses) sits rigidly at a bistro table, tapping his pen against a closed leather portfolio.

Clicking heels approach.

ZHAO FEIFEI (22, black feathered dress, sunglasses) strides over with the practiced confidence of someone performing a role. She sits, removes her sunglasses, and appraises him like an acquisition target.

ZHAO FEIFEI
You're early. I like that.

LUO CHEN
I was told this meeting was at 3:30. It's 3:45.

ZHAO FEIFEI
And I was told you'd be some middle-aged divorcee. Imagine my disappointment.

She flags a waiter with an imperious gesture, then turns back to Luo Chen.

ZHAO FEIFEI
Let's skip the pageantry. My father wants me married by quarter end. You have the right surname and a clean balance sheet. Those are my qualifying criteria.

LUO CHEN
(closing his portfolio)
Miss Zhao, I'm here because my mother's health is fragile. She believes in... auspicious dates. But I have no intention—

ZHAO FEIFEI
(interrupting, leaning forward)
Of course you don't. That's the point. We could be terrible for each other and it wouldn't matter. The shareholders get their spectacle, our parents get their peace, and we get...
