title: The Richest Mother, I Am Your Real Daughter
description: A baby girl is taken away at birth, believed to be a curse. Fifteen years later, her jade pendant becomes the key to finding her true family, but jealousy and deception threaten to keep them apart.
context:
Title: The Richest Mother, I Am Your Real Daughter
Description: A baby girl is taken away at birth, believed to be a curse. Fifteen years later, her jade pendant becomes the key to finding her true family, but jealousy and deception threaten to keep them apart.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

SFX: Thunder

Lightning flashes across a dark sky.

SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER, wearing a hospital gown, screams emotionally.

SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER
No! No!

Two BODYGUARDS in black suits hold a baby wrapped in swaddling clothes. SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER kneels on the ground, desperately trying to stop them.

SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER
Please don't take my child! She was just born!

BODYGUARD
The Master said the astrologer predicted it—a daughter born tonight would cost the family everything by her fifteenth birthday. She must go.

SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER
No!

Another BODYGUARD steps forward.

BODYGUARD 2
Young Madam, forgive us. We have orders.

The BODYGUARDS turn to leave. SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER collapses on the ground, crying out in pain, crawling forward.

SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER
Wait!

The BODYGUARDS stop.

SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER
(sobbing uncontrollably)
Please. Let her live.

She takes off a jade pendant necklace from her neck and hands it to the BODYGUARD. The BODYGUARD takes it and turns to leave.

SHEN WAN'ER'S MOTHER
(to the departing baby)
Grow strong. I will find you.

FIFTEEN YEARS LATER
continuation:
INT. ORPHANAGE DORMITORY - DAY

Fifteen-year-old SHEN WAN'ER sits at a desk, holding the jade pendant her mother left behind.

SHEN WAN'ER (V.O.)
Fifteen years. The deadline in the prophecy.

The door bursts open. DUAN XIAOQIU, a girl wearing the same school uniform, runs in excitedly.

DUAN XIAOQIU
Wan'er! My grandmother found me!

SHEN WAN'ER
(delighted)
She's really coming?

DUAN XIAOQIU
But I want to wait until I'm off that machine. I don't want her first memory of me to be weak.

She points to the oxygen concentrator—a shared medical device for children with respiratory conditions.

DUAN XIAOQIU suddenly looks pained, clutching her chest, breathing rapidly.

SHEN WAN'ER
(supporting her)
Xiaoqiu!

SHEN WAN'ER helps DUAN XIAOQIU sit on the bed and puts an oxygen mask from a nearby machine on her face.

DUAN XIAOQIU takes deep breaths of oxygen and slowly calms down.

SHEN WAN'ER
Your heart will heal. Come on, Xuanxuan should hear this.

DUAN XIAOQIU nods. The two link arms and walk out. SHEN WAN'ER'S jade pendant remains on the desk.

Outside the door, LIN XUAN watches their departing figures, her hand on her own bare throat.

LIN XUAN (V.O.)
Third adoption. That's how many I've lost. And now you get a family too?

LIN XUAN walks into the dormitory. An envelope—Wan'er's scholarship letter—sits on the desk. She sweeps it aside. The pendant catches the light.

The DIRECTOR walks into the dormitory.

DIRECTOR
Xuanxuan, the Chen family is coming tomorrow. They've chosen Wan'er.

After the DIRECTOR leaves, LIN XUAN'S expression becomes resentful.

LIN XUAN (V.O.)
You took my chance. I'll take the only thing that matters to you.

She picks up the jade pendant from the desk and puts it in her pocket. She glances at the oxygen machine.

LIN XUAN (V.O.)
And without it, maybe they'll finally see me instead.

LIN XUAN turns to leave. Two well-dressed MEN appear at the doorway.

FAMILY SEARCH MAN
(holding a photo of a jade pendant)
Miss. We're searching for a girl born on this date, with this pendant. The Shen family matriarch's final wish.

LIN XUAN looks at the pendant in the photo. It's the same one she just took.

LIN XUAN (thinking)
Wan'er's birthday. The prophecy deadline.

A calculating expression appears on LIN XUAN'S face.

title: Don't Cry, Mom
description: A mother faces cruelty from her mother-in-law who refuses to give back money needed for her sick daughter's surgery, while a wealthy chairman searches for his long-lost daughter.
context:
Title: Don't Cry, Mom
Description: A mother faces cruelty from her mother-in-law who refuses to give back money needed for her sick daughter's surgery, while a wealthy chairman searches for his long-lost daughter.

INT. ZHANG DASHAN'S HOUSE - DAY

ZHOU HUI and WANG GUIYING struggle over a money pouch.

WANG GUIYING
Hand it over. Now.

ZHOU HUI
This is Miaomiao's surgery money!

WANG GUIYING
You think bills pay themselves? Give it here!

WANG GUIYING shoves ZHOU HUI down. She falls, clutching her stomach. ZHANG MIAOMIAO runs in.

ZHANG MIAOMIAO
Mommy!

WANG GUIYING
Back to your room!

ZHOU HUI
Miaomiao, don't—

WANG GUIYING grabs a feather duster.

WANG GUIYING
I'll teach you to steal from this family!

She beats ZHOU HUI as she cries out. The door bursts open. ZHANG DASHAN rushes in.

ZHANG DASHAN
Stop!

ZHANG MIAOMIAO
Daddy!

ZHANG DASHAN helps ZHOU HUI up.

ZHANG DASHAN
What happened?

ZHOU HUI
(voice breaking)
Mom took Miaomiao's treatment money.

WANG GUIYING
It's called being filial! Your monthly pittance doesn't keep this house running.

ZHANG DASHAN
Mom, Miaomiao needs that surgery.

WANG GUIYING
She's draining us dry! If her real family cared, they'd have found you. That worthless jade around your neck proves they don't!

WANG GUIYING exits with the pouch. The family holds each other.
continuation:
INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

SHEN QIAOSHENG throws documents on the table before cowering employees.

SHEN QIAOSHENG
Three weeks for this garbage?

An ASSISTANT rushes in.

ASSISTANT
Chairman, news about your daughter.

SHEN QIAOSHENG
Another hoax?

ASSISTANT
The pendant. It's the phoenix half.

The ASSISTANT shows a tablet photo of a broken jade pendant. SHEN QIAOSHENG takes out his dragon pendant.

SHEN QIAOSHENG
(whispering)
Zhenzhen...

INT. ZHANG DASHAN'S HOUSE - DAY

ZHOU HUI removes her phoenix pendant.

ZHOU HUI
Sell this. For Miaomiao.

ZHANG DASHAN
Your family—

ZHOU HUI
—can find me without it. My daughter can't wait.

ZHOU HUI leaves. ZHANG DASHAN examines the pendant. From his pocket, he pulls an old cloth bundle. Inside: the dragon pendant. He fits them together.

title: The Entire Entertainment Industry Is Waiting for Our Divorce
description: A Chinese medicine practitioner wakes up to find her face has been swapped with a famous celebrity after being drugged at a KTV.
context:
Title: The Entire Entertainment Industry Is Waiting for Our Divorce
Description: A Chinese medicine practitioner wakes up to find her face has been swapped with a famous celebrity after being drugged at a KTV.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

SHEN SHULI, wearing a pink dress, examines the liquor bottles with trembling fingers. A row of empty glasses sits on the table.

She walks toward LI LI, who sits on the sofa in a black evening gown, scrolling through news about her own divorce scandal on her phone.

SHEN SHULI
I've finished all of these. Where is my sister?

LI LI
(sneering)
Satisfy me, and you'll naturally be able to see your sister.

SHEN SHULI grabs an expensive bottle, sniffs it, then wavers.

SHEN SHULI
(in pain)
So dizzy... these herbs...

The bottle slips and shatters.

SHEN SHULI
(terrified)
You've mixed sedatives with alcohol!

SHEN SHULI staggers and grabs LI LI's shoulder.

SHEN SHULI
What exactly do you want?

SHEN SHULI collapses. LI LI stands, looking at her phone screen: a text reads "Procedure ready."

LI LI
(quietly)
What I want is to swap faces with you. And your clean medical record.
continuation:
INT. OPERATING ROOM - NIGHT

Bright surgical lights shine down. SHEN SHULI lies unconscious as a MECHANICAL DEVICE hums above her face.

LI LI (O.S.)
She's about to wake up. Quickly swap our faces. The prototype is ready.

Medical instruments appear on screen - syringes, scalpels, and a HIGH-TECH FACIAL MAPPING scanner.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

SHEN SHULI wakes up startled in the hospital bed. She wears a patient gown with an IV needle still in her hand. She frantically touches her face.

SHEN SHULI
My face...

She sees herself in the mirror - she has become LI LI, but her own BIRTHMARK remains near her eye.

SHEN SHULI
(shocked)
How did my face turn into Li Li's? I need to find out what's going on.

A TV on the wall shows entertainment news: "Actress LI LI hospitalized amid divorce crisis. Husband demands settlement."

SHEN SHULI covers her face with both hands, her eyes filled with fury.

SHEN SHULI
(whispering)
She took my life. Now I have her scandal. Her divorce. Her empire.

She lowers her hands, expression hardening with determination.

title: Battle of Kunlun Mountain
description: A sword master must defend Kunlun Mountain and the Dragon Kingdom against an invasion of demons seeking to open the Land of Apotheosis.
context:
Title: Battle of Kunlun Mountain
Description: A sword master must defend Kunlun Mountain and the Dragon Kingdom against an invasion of demons seeking to open the Land of Apotheosis.

INT. KUNLUN MOUNTAIN - DAY

Opening shot: Kunlun Mountain shrouded in clouds and mist, celestial energy crackling through the fog. XIAO MING sits cross-legged mid-air, eyes closed in meditation. A golden magical array pulses beneath him.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

YE LIULI sprints into the courtyard, her gaze fixed upward.

YE LIULI
Sect Master! The Demon Lord comes. He brings war.

Xiao Ming's eyes open. The array vanishes. He extends a finger—a single golden light shoots forth.

Black demonic energy pours through the mountain, forming into a giant demon shape.

Xiao Ming drops from the clouds, landing silently in the courtyard.

DEMON LORD SHI TIAN appears with LEI ZHENZI, SNAKE WOMAN, and a horde of demons.

DEMON LORD SHI TIAN
At last, we meet face to face.

XIAO MING
Your face was always forgettable.

I have the pen.

Steel is older than thunder.

title: Divorce Countdown: 91 Days
description: A woman crashes her car and wakes up inside a novel as the villainous supporting character who shares her name, determined to divorce the male lead and survive.
context:
Title: Divorce Countdown: 91 Days
Description: A woman crashes her car and wakes up inside a novel as the villainous supporting character who shares her name, determined to divorce the male lead and survive.

INT. BMW CAR - NIGHT

CHU LAN drives, earphones in, knuckles white on the wheel.

CHU LAN
That book you recommended should come with a health warning. Same name, same background, but she's got the survival instincts of a lemming. Fighting mistresses when she should be fighting for her trust fund?

BEST FRIEND (O.S.)
I told you to watch the romance, not the villain!

CHU LAN
Hard to ignore when she's me with worse decision-making.

High beams BLIND her from oncoming traffic. She jerks the wheel—

CHU LAN
Ah!

The car SPINS. Metal SCREAMS. WHITEOUT.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

CHU LAN jolts awake on plush carpet. Her head pounds. She sees:
- A diamond wedding ring on her finger
- Her reflection in a mirror—same, yet softer
- LU YUN, impatient, dangerous

LU YUN
Chu Lan, what are you thinking? I'm talking to you!

XIN YI sits on the bed, eyes red but dry.

XIN YI
Sister Lan, Brother Yun and I are innocent. We really didn't do anything to betray you.

CHU LAN
(shocked)
Brother Yun? Xin Yi?

LU YUN
Apologize to Xin Yi. Now.

CHU LAN looks at the two people in front of her, then steps forward and slaps XIN YI hard across the face.
continuation:
XIN YI
(screaming)

LU YUN
(shocked)

XIN YI
(hissing)
You actually—

CHU LAN stares at her reddened palm, flexing it against the sting.

CHU LAN (V.O.)
Ninety-one days. That's how long before this character dies broke and alone.

LU YUN
What nonsense are you talking about?

CHU LAN (V.O.)
He resents Chu Lan for breaking him up with his white moonlight. Now he's cheating. I need away from this trash. Survival first.

A strange expression flickers across LU YUN's face—like he's hearing an echo.

LU YUN
...you want to divorce me?

CHU LAN immediately puts on an affectionate expression and walks toward LU YUN.

CHU LAN
Honey, I love you the most. For you, I'm willing to do anything. How could I bear to divorce you?

CHU LAN (V.O.)
Initiate the split. Half the assets. Over a billion. Freedom.

LU YUN looks at CHU LAN, a slow smile forming. He approaches step by step, trapping CHU LAN against the wall.

LU YUN
That's right. You love me so much, how could I bear to...

LU YUN leans close to CHU LAN's face.

LU YUN
(whispering)
...divorce you?

CHU LAN looks stunned.

ON SCREEN: DIVORCE COUNTDOWN: 91 DAYS

title: Adorable Mom Arrives, CEO's Secrets Exposed - Episode 1
description: A woman who lost her twins at birth is told they died, but three years later, fate brings her face to face with two children who may change everything.
context:
Title: Adorable Mom Arrives, CEO's Secrets Exposed - Episode 1
Description: A woman who lost her twins at birth is told they died, but three years later, fate brings her face to face with two children who may change everything.

INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - DAY

The "Surgery in Progress" light glows red above the operating room door.

LIN WENSHOU (20s, exhausted but radiant) lies on the delivery bed, her hand trembling as she reaches out.

DOCTOR (O.S.)
(alarmed)
Heart rate's dropping on the second twin! Nurse, call NICU, stat!

A BABY'S CRY—singular, fragile.

A NURSE rushes two swaddled infants past Lin, who barely glimpses them.

LIN WENSHOU
(weakly)
Wait... let me see...

Her fingers close around two jade pendants at her neck. She fumbles to unclasp them.

LIN WENSHOU
(whispering)
Your grandmother wanted you to have these...

She presses the pendants into the nurse's hand as the room spins into darkness.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Lin jerks awake, her hand flying to her empty neck.

LIN'S MOTHER (50s, impeccably dressed) stands at the window, her back to the bed.

LIN'S FATHER (50s, stern) holds a clipboard near the door.

LIN WENSHOU
(disoriented)
The babies... where...

LIN'S MOTHER
(without turning)
They were transferred. Emergency surgery.

LIN'S FATHER
They didn't survive. We've handled the arrangements.

LIN WENSHOU
What? I never saw them! I never—

LIN'S FATHER
You were unconscious. The hospital needed consent. As your legal guardians, we gave it.

He exits. Lin stares at the empty doorway, her knuckles white on the bedsheet.

LIN WENSHOU
(voice cracking)
I never got to hold them...

LIN'S MOTHER
Some things aren't meant to be.
continuation:
EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER

An orange McLaren weaves through traffic.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

CEO SHENG (30s, sharp suit, sharper eyes) scrolls through a tablet in the backseat. His ASSISTANT speaks quietly.

ASSISTANT
The board expects your engagement announcement by week's end. The shareholders are...

CEO SHENG
The Intercontinental. Now.

His phone BUZZES. He glances at the screen—two children making frantic hand gestures. His jaw tightens.

CEO SHENG
(cutting off)
Turn the car around. Home.

EXT. STREET - DAY

LIN WENSHOU (late 20s, worn but determined) balances grocery bags while her phone blasts VOICE on speaker.

LIN'S MOTHER (V.O.)
...found you a match. Divorced, but his family offers 800,000 bride price. That's more than your dead-end job will earn in—

LIN WENSHOU
I have an interview in twenty minutes. For the Sheng Corporation position.

LIN'S MOTHER (V.O.)
What position? You think some corporation wants a disgraced—

LIN WENSHOU
It's childcare. For executive families. Pays triple my current salary.

A beat of silence.

LIN'S MOTHER (V.O.)
Fine. But that heirloom pendant? It covers your brother's gambling debt if you fail. Again.

Lin stops mid-stride. Her fingers trace the jade pendant hidden under her shirt.

LIN WENSHOU
(quietly, to herself)
Not this time.

INT. SHENG CORPORATION - CHILD DEVELOPMENT CENTER WAITING AREA - DAY

Lin enters a gleaming reception area. Three women in designer outfits whisper, eyeing her thrift-store blazer.

WOMAN IN BLACK (30s, ice-cold smile)
Nobodies always think they're the exception.

Suddenly—TWO SMALL BLURS dart past. One collides with the Woman in Black's stiletto.

SHENG DABAO (3, scuffed shoes, fierce eyes) stumbles back.

SHENG ERBAO (3, matching scuffs, older-soul stare) grabs her brother's hand.

WOMAN IN BLACK
(frozen smile)
Children should be seen, not heard. Especially the unwanted kind.

She taps his shoulder with a manicured finger. Dabao falls.

SHENG ERBAO
You forgot your own rule. You're definitely not chosen.

WOMAN IN BLACK
(to Lin, not the children)
Some people hire help. Others collect strays. Which are you?

Her hand snakes toward Erbao's wrist. Lin's grocery bag drops. The sound echoes.

LIN WENSHOU
(stepping forward, voice low)
Touch her. I dare you.

title: Terrifyingly Strong After Divorce
description: A legendary figure known as the Godmother returns home incognito after years of serving her country, hoping to reunite with her family and reveal her true identity to her husband.
context:
Title: Terrifyingly Strong After Divorce
Description: A legendary figure known as the Godmother returns home incognito after years of serving her country, hoping to reunite with her family and reveal her true identity to her husband.

EXT. HELIPAD - DAY

A white helicopter sits on the wet tarmac after the rain. ZHAO FU, QIAN BIAO, SUN WU, and others lead rows of subordinates in black suits, standing solemnly in two lines.

ZHAO FU
(clasping fists)
Zhao Fu, Qingcheng Chamber of Commerce.

QIAN BIAO
(clasping fists)
Qian Biao. Eighteen Provinces.

SUN WU
(clasping fists)
Governor Sun Wu.

ALL
(kneeling in unison, clasping fists)
Welcome home, Godmother!

A red sports car drifts onto the helipad and stops in front of everyone. They turn around in surprise.

The car door opens. A SUBORDINATE gets out with a black umbrella and opens the rear door for YOUNG MASTER PEI. PEI SHAO, wearing a black suit and holding a bouquet of red roses, steps out with an arrogant expression.

QIAN BIAO
Young... Young Master Pei?

ZHAO FU
Pei Xu?

SUN WU
The National Treasure?

ZHAO FU
(approaching with a broad smile)
Here for the Godmother?

PEI SHAO
(leaning on his car)
No. I'm here to propose.

Everyone looks shocked.

ALL
(in unison)
Propose?

PEI SHAO
(raising his voice slightly)
They call me heaven's chosen son. Unmarried. Waiting. For her.

The helicopter door opens. A woman in fashionable black athletic wear (THE GODMOTHER'S ASSISTANT) steps out.

GODMOTHER'S ASSISTANT
(coldly)
She's gone. Incognito. Clear the pad.

PEI SHAO
(frowning)
...Gone?
continuation:
EXT. TRAIN STATION PLAZA - DAY

THE GODMOTHER, wearing plain black casual clothes, carries a backpack and pulls a suitcase. She walks across the plaza with her subordinate ZHU YUE.

ZHU YUE
Godmother, let me—

GODMOTHER
Don't call me that here.

ZHU YUE
Master of the God-Making Palace. You've built empires. You're just... walking away?

GODMOTHER
(stopping)
Si Cheng carried our family alone. Duoduo doesn't even know my face.

She touches the pendant on her necklace.

GODMOTHER
(quietly)
Three days. The trillion-dollar Gu contract signs. Then I'll show him why they kneel.

ZHU YUE
And if they won't understand?

GODMOTHER
Then I chose wrong. But I already chose.

She opens the locket, revealing a photo of a little girl inside.

INT. GARBAGE BIN - DAY (FLASHBACK)

A little girl (DUODUO) in ragged clothes, her face dirty, rummages through a garbage bin.

She finds a half-rotten apple.

DUODUO
(softly)
Apple...

She takes a bite. Stops. Looks toward a distant tent.

DUODUO
Grandma's still hungry.

She wraps the apple in a scrap of cloth, her small hands trembling slightly.

title: Trillion-Dollar Junk King
description: A down-on-his-luck man discovers a system that pays him thousands for collecting trash, just as his girlfriend's family demands more money for marriage.
context:
Title: Trillion-Dollar Junk King
Description: A down-on-his-luck man discovers a system that pays him thousands for collecting trash, just as his girlfriend's family demands more money for marriage.

INT. OUTSIDE MODERN BUILDING - DAY

LIN BEI, rumpled suit, sits on the curb beside a stack of rejection letters.

SPECIAL EFFECT: A translucent holographic screen flickers to life before him.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Junk System activated.

SPECIAL EFFECT: The screen displays: [USER: LIN BEI] [CREDIT: ¥0] [QUOTA: 10 items/day]

LIN BEI
(blinking hard)
This... can't be real.

SPECIAL EFFECT: The screen highlights a crumpled bottle at his feet.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Target acquired. 500ml PET bottle. Value: ¥1,000. Compensation transferred.

LIN BEI's phone vibrates. He checks the screen.

PHONE NOTIFICATION (V.O.)
Incoming: ¥1,000.00 - Available in 24h.

LIN BEI
(whispering)
A thousand... for trash?

He looks at the bottle, then at the overflowing dumpster nearby.

LIN BEI
Okay then.

He stands.
continuation:
EXT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU ENTRANCE - DAY

LIN BEI approaches, nervously clutching a document folder and the bottle.

ZHOU HUIMIN, elegant but tense, waits with her mother LI XIULIAN and brother ZHOU ZIFENG.

ZHOU HUIMIN
Lin Bei. We need to talk.

LI XIULIAN
Before you go in, the bride price needs adjusting. Two relatives are coming—housing in Shanghai isn't cheap.

LIN BEI
(confused)
Auntie, we agreed on 300,000. I've already borrowed—

LI XIULIAN
(cutting him off)
Another 150,000. One time. For Huimin's future security.

ZHOU HUIMIN
(quietly)
Lin Bei... just this last thing.

LIN BEI
(defeated)
Huimin, my account's empty. But I swear, I'll—

ZHOU ZIFENG
Let me see.

He grabs Lin Bei's phone before Lin Bei can react.

ZHOU ZIFENG
Sis, he's got a thousand yuan pending some trash app. This is the guy you want to pin your future on?

ZHOU HUIMIN glances at the screen, then away. Her expression hardens.

LIN BEI
So if I don't find 150,000 in three days...

ZHOU HUIMIN
(coldly)
Then we don't have a future.

She drops the phone into his hand and walks away. Li Xiulian and Zhou Zifeng follow.

LIN BEI stands frozen, looking at the bottle in his fist.

He checks his phone again. The notification still reads: "Available in 23:58:12..."

LIN BEI
(to himself)
Three days. That's all they gave me.

LIN BEI looks from the trash-strewn street to the government building. His jaw sets.

LIN BEI
(to his phone)
System. Make me money. Lots of it.

SPECIAL EFFECT: A beam of light erupts from the phone, wrapping around LIN BEI like a shroud.

(whispering)
A thousand... for trash?

He looks at the bottle, then at the overflowing dumpster nearby.

LIN BEI
Okay then.

He stands.

EXT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU ENTRANCE - DAY

LIN BEI approaches, nervously clutching a document folder and the bottle.

ZHOU HUIMIN, elegant but tense, waits with her mother LI XIULIAN and brother ZHOU ZIFENG.

ZHOU HUIMIN
Lin Bei. We need to talk.

LI XIULIAN
Before you go in, the bride price needs adjusting. Two relatives are coming—housing in Shanghai isn't cheap.

LIN BEI
(confused)
Auntie, we agreed on 300,000. I've already borrowed—

LI XIULIAN
(cutting him off)
Another 150,000. One time. For Huimin's future security.

ZHOU HUIMIN
(quietly)
Lin Bei... just this last thing.

LIN BEI
(defeated)
Huimin, my account's empty. But I swear, I'll—

ZHOU ZIFENG
Let me see.

He grabs Lin Bei's phone before Lin Bei can react.

ZHOU ZIFENG
Sis, he's got a thousand yuan pending some trash app. This is the guy you want to pin your future on?

ZHOU HUIMIN glances at the screen, then away. Her expression hardens.

LIN BEI
So if I don't find 150,000 in three days...

ZHOU HUIMIN
(coldly)
Then we don't have a future.

She drops the phone into his hand and walks away. Li Xiulian and Zhou Zifeng follow.

LIN BEI stands frozen, looking at the bottle in his fist.

He checks his phone again. The notification still reads: "Available in 23:58:12..."

LIN BEI
(to himself)
Three days. That's all they gave me.

LIN BEI looks from the trash-strewn street to the government building. His jaw sets.

LIN BEI
(to his phone)
System. Make me money. Lots of it.

SPECIAL EFFECT: A beam of light erupts from the phone, wrapping around LIN BEI like a shroud.

title: 99 Kisses to You
description: A young woman under a family curse must kiss a man before turning thirty or face death. After a drunken mistake, she faces dire consequences.
context:
Title: 99 Kisses to You
Description: A young woman under a family curse must kiss a man before turning thirty or face death. After a drunken mistake, she faces dire consequences.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

HE CHUXIA (29) lies on a moving gurney, blood at the corner of her mouth, face pale. A faint red character "MISFORTUNE" (misfortune) pulses on her wrist. Medical personnel push the bed forward at high speed.

BAI YANLI
Chuxia, open your eyes! You promised me you'd fight this!

MEDICAL PERSONNEL
(urgently)
Pressure's dropping! Move!

HE CHUXIA
(weakly)
Yanli... I kissed the wrong...

DOCTOR
(blocking BAI YANLI)
Sir, you need to wait here.

The operating room door closes. HE JINGYAO rushes over, looking pale, a matching "MISFORTUNE" mark visible on his neck.

HE JINGYAO
Is she—

BAI YANLI
(angrily grabbing HE JINGYAO's arm)
She's hemorrhaging because of your curse! She spent three years trying to work up the courage to kiss me, and now you've ruined everything!

HE JINGYAO
(shoving his hand away)
I never asked for this. She did this to herself.

FLASHBACK

INT. BAR - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: 24 Hours Until Her Birthday

HE CHUXIA raises her glass with friends, the "MISFORTUNE" on her wrist glowing brighter with each pulse.

HE CHUXIA
One day left. One chance left.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Chuxia, you've barely eaten in weeks. This is insane.

HE CHUXIA
The curse doesn't care. If I don't kiss someone who truly wants me... I don't make it to thirty.

She downs her drink, staggers. BAI YANLI watches from across the bar, concerned.

HE CHUXIA
(whispering)
Where is he?

She stumbles toward the restroom corridor and collides with HE JINGYAO exiting. The "MISFORTUNE" on her wrist flares crimson.

HE CHUXIA
(grabbing his face, desperate)
Bai Yanli, please. Just let me—

She kisses him. HE JINGYAO's eyes widen in shock. He jerks back, gasping, the "MISFORTUNE" branding onto his skin.

HE JINGYAO
(choked)
He Chuxia... look at me.

HE CHUXIA
(realization dawning)
Oh no...

Blood trickles from her mouth. She collapses. The "MISFORTUNE" on both their wrists pulses in unison.

END FLASHBACK
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

HE CHUXIA wakes in the hospital bed, sees the deep crimson "MISFORTUNE" on her wrist. She touches it, tears falling.

HE CHUXIA (V.O.)
Grandfather, I got the rules wrong.

FLASHBACK

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Young HE CHUXIA (10) sits by her dying GRANDFATHER'S bedside.

GRANDFATHER
(weakly)
The curse demands a kiss... of true acceptance. If you force it on someone unwilling... the curse doesn't break. It multiplies.

He touches her wrist, where a pale "MISFORTUNE" waits.

GRANDFATHER
Your time runs out at thirty. But your heart... must be brave enough to wait.

END FLASHBACK

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

HE CHUXIA lies crying. HE JINGYAO enters, wearing a scarf that hides his neck.

HE JINGYAO
(sitting nearby)
The doctors say you'll recover. The ulcer, at least.

HE CHUXIA
(quietly)
Did it transfer? The curse?

HE JINGYAO
(pausing)
It's... shared. That's why we're both still breathing.

He offers a handkerchief. She hesitates, then takes it.

BAI YANLI enters carrying a small cake with a single candle.

BAI YANLI
Midnight just passed. You're thirty now.

HE CHUXIA
(panicking)
But the curse didn't—

BAI YANLI
—didn't kill you. Because I accepted it.

He sets down the cake, pulls back his sleeve to reveal a matching "MISFORTUNE" mark, now faded.

BAI YANLI
I've been in love with you since the day your grandfather warned me. I've been waiting for you to see me.

He leans in. Their lips meet. The "MISFORTUNE" on HE CHUXIA's wrist glows once, then vanishes.

The candle tips. Frosting smears across her cheek. She laughs through tears, the first real smile we've seen.

FADE OUT

title: A String, A Pillar, Remembering the Years
description: A woman is reborn to the day she and her sister were both to be married. She decides to swap fates with her sister to protect her from a dangerous marriage.
context:
Title: A String, A Pillar, Remembering the Years
Description: A woman is reborn to the day she and her sister were both to be married. She decides to swap fates with her sister to protect her from a dangerous marriage.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

MU MIANMIAN walks along a country road, suitcase in hand. Her MOTHER and FATHER follow behind.

MOTHER
Mianmian! Stop!

Mother catches up, grabs Mianmian's arm.

MOTHER
Five years with a good man—you throw it away for some island soldier? What kind of daughter—

MU MIANMIAN
The kind who keeps her word.

Mianmian pulls free and boards a waiting minibus. Mother pounds on the door.

MOTHER
Mianmian! Mianmian! Get off that bus! You'll regret this!

The minibus pulls away. Mother chases, shouting.

MOTHER
Mianmian!

INT. MINIBUS - DAY

Mianmian watches her mother recede. Her knuckles whiten on the suitcase handle.

DRIVER
You sure, miss? That ferry doesn't come back 'til tomorrow.

MU MIANMIAN
I'm sure.

She looks at her hands—smooth, young. A scar on her palm she hasn't earned yet.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: THREE HOURS EARLIER

Mianmian wakes with a gasp, clutching her chest. She touches her face—smooth. No wrinkles. She sits up, breathing hard.

A red wedding dress hangs on the wall. Beside it—a 1980 calendar, today's date circled.

The door opens. Mother enters with steaming dumplings.

MOTHER
Finally awake! Today of all days—your sister's already dressed. Eat, then get ready. The accountant's family will be here soon.

Mother sets down the dumplings. Mianmian stares at them.

MU MIANMIAN
(whispering)
The accountant...

MOTHER
What's wrong? You begged to marry him!

Mother notices Mianmian's fixed gaze on the calendar.

MOTHER
You forget your own wedding day?

Mianmian's fingers find the scar on her palm. Her eyes harden.

MU MIANMIAN
No. I remember everything.

MONTAGE - MU MIANMIAN'S MEMORIES

A) INT. OFFICE - DAY (FLASHBACK) - Older Mianmian signs divorce papers. LIU YUNQING won't meet her eyes.

B) INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK) - Mianmian's SISTER smiles in a wedding photo with stern soldier SHEN HUANIAN.

C) INT. POLICE STATION - DAY (FLASHBACK) - Mianmian, now 60s, identifies her sister's body. A PHOTO of a young, delicate woman flashes on a bulletin board. DETECTIVE (V.O.): "...suspected accomplice..."
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Mianmian stands before her sister's door. Enters.

INT. SISTER'S BEDROOM - DAY

SISTER sits on the bed, folding a wedding veil with trembling hands. She looks up—Mianmian in the doorway, still in nightclothes.

SISTER
Mianmian? Why aren't you—

Mianmian crosses, takes her sister's hands.

MU MIANMIAN
Switch with me.

SISTER
What?

MU MIANMIAN
I'll marry Shen Huanian. You take the accountant.

SISTER
(shocked)
Have you lost your mind? Shen Huanian's dangerous—he has that woman, that—

MU MIANMIAN
That "green tea" viper he's kept since childhood? I know. That's why I'm going.

Mianmian squeezes her sister's hands.

MU MIANMIAN
She killed you, sister. In a life you never lived. I'm not letting it happen again.

SISTER
(whispering)
How can you know that?

MU MIANMIAN
Because I died old and alone, and woke up with a second chance. I know how this ends. Let me rewrite it.

Mianmian forces a smile.

MU MIANMIAN
Besides. Grandfather never specified which granddaughter. And me against some delicate island girl? Don't you remember who won every fight?

She throws a precise jab at the air.

SISTER
(laughing through tears)
You were eleven.

MU MIANMIAN
And undefeated.

Mianmian picks up Shen Huanian's wedding clothes—red silk like armor.

MU MIANMIAN
I'll send word when I'm settled. If it goes wrong... I'll handle it. Revenge for revenge, grievance for grievance. But she won't touch our family.

MU MIANMIAN
(softening)
Please, sister.

SISTER studies her, sees something unshakeable. Finally—she nods.

SISTER
(deadly serious)
You come back to me.

Mianmian embraces her, fierce and brief.

MU MIANMIAN
I promise.

INT. MINIBUS / EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

BACK TO PRESENT

The minibus rattles down the road. Mother runs alongside, hoarse.

MOTHER
Mianmian! Mianmian, come back!

Mianmian leans out the window. Wind tears at her hair.

MU MIANMIAN
(calling out)
Mother! I'm keeping my promise!

She holds up her scarred palm. Mother can't see it, but Mianmian needs her to witness the gesture.

MU MIANMIAN
I'll be home for Spring Festival!

The bus accelerates. Mother stops, doubled over. She watches the bus disappear into dust and light.

Mianmian settles back, eyes forward. Her hand rests on the suitcase—heavy with a dead woman's wedding clothes and a living woman's fury.

title: A Thought of Warmth
description: A woman destined for seven lifetimes of loneliness is granted seven soulmates in one life by the Moon God, leading to chaos at her wedding and a journey through fated love.
context:
Title: A Thought of Warmth
Description: A woman destined for seven lifetimes of loneliness is granted seven soulmates in one life by the Moon God, leading to chaos at her wedding and a journey through fated love.

EXT. WEDDING LAWN - DAY

WEN NUAN (28, elegant but hollow-eyed) walks with her FATHER toward YU HAN. Her bouquet trembles slightly.

FATHER
You're freezing.

WEN NUAN
Just nerves.

FATHER
Yu Han, I'm entrusting my daughter to you.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Yu Han, do you take Miss Wen Nuan?

YU HAN
I do.

OFFICIANT
Miss Wen Nuan, do you take Mr. Yu Han?

WEN NUAN
I...

Seven phantom threads shimmer from her fingertips, tugging toward different guests.

WEN NUAN
(voice cracking)
I object!

SEVEN OBJECTORS rise from the crowd. Each carries himself differently: a CEO, a musician, a teacher, a chef, an artist, an athlete, a scholar.

OBJECTORS
We object!

YU HAN
(steps closer, protective)
She's already chosen.

CEO OBJECTOR
Has she? Or has she simply settled for what's safe?

The seven move in, surrounding Wen Nuan. They kneel, producing rings.

OBJECTORS
Marry me. Choose me. Save me.

WEN NUAN
(backing away)
I just want one proper wedding!
continuation:
INT. MOVIE THEATER - NIGHT

Wen Nuan jerks awake in her seat. Seven crimson threads wrap her fingers, pulsing. MOON GOD (white-haired, ancient) watches the screen replay the wedding.

WEN NUAN
That wasn't a dream.

MOON GOD
Memory. Of what will be.

WEN NUAN
Seven lifetimes alone, and your solution is seven chains?

MOON GOD
I gave you what you earned. Love in abundance.

WEN NUAN
(standing)
I learned to stand without it.

MOON GOD
Then break them. The threads are yours.

He vanishes. The theater dissolves to mist.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Wen Nuan snaps awake. She checks her fingers: seven faint red circles remain. She touches them, resigned but determined.

WEN NUAN
(whisper)
Break them.

INT. COMPANY HALLWAY - DAY

Wen Nuan sits among INTERVIEWEES, hiding her marked hand. YU HAN approaches, sizing up the room.

YU HAN
Mind if I sit?

WEN NUAN
Please.

He sits beside her. She quickly hides her marked hand.

YU HAN
Yu Han.

WEN NUAN
Wen Nuan.

They shake. For a moment, only ONE solid thread appears between them, bright and true.

INTERVIEWER (O.S.)
Wen Nuan?

She stands, takes a breath. The phantom threads tug at her fingers. She walks forward anyway, leaving them slack behind her.

FADE OUT.

title: One Rage Shatters Mountains and Rivers
description: A young man secretly learns martial arts and faces the consequences when his forbidden training is discovered, awakening memories of a tragic past.
context:
Title: One Rage Shatters Mountains and Rivers
Description: A young man secretly learns martial arts and faces the consequences when his forbidden training is discovered, awakening memories of a tragic past.

INT. FOREST - DAY

A group of young men in Zhang family training uniforms flow through the Coiling Dragon sequence. Their MASTER (60s), scarred and wiry, moves among them.

MASTER
Root! Sink!

STUDENTS
(Ha!)

MASTER
Strike! True!

STUDENTS
(Ha!)

The Master halts. He extends his hand, palm down. Air ripples. He punches. Twenty feet away, bamboo shivers, leaves raining down.

Behind dense bamboo, YOUNG ZHANG HAO (10) in servant's hemp mirrors the movement. His fingers tremble.

MONTAGE - ZHANG HAO'S SECRET TRAINING

- Under a waterfall, Zhang Hao's fist splits the cascade; his arms bear scars.
- Leaping a mountain crevice, he catches the edge with bleeding fingers.
- By a stream at dusk, his bruised reflection punches, water spiraling.

THIRTEEN YEARS LATER

EXT. DILAPIDATED COURTYARD - DAY

ADULT ZHANG HAO (23) practices in a cramped yard. His final punch warps the air. A wooden washboard splinters.

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER (50s) freezes in the doorway. Her vegetable basket slips—carrots scatter. Her face drains of color.

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER
Hao'er...

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER sees a shadow flicker across the courtyard wall—a figure in Zhang family colors. She gasps, dropping the basket.

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER
(terrified)
No... not again...

ZHANG HAO turns, sweat-soaked.

ZHANG HAO
Mother?

She points a shaking finger at the scattered vegetables.

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER
Kneel down!

ZHANG HAO immediately kneels on the ground.

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER
They've come twice this week. Asking about the damaged training grounds.
(quieter)
You think they don't already know?

ZHANG HAO
Mother, no one knows about my martial arts practice.

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER
If people find out... Have you forgotten what happened thirteen years ago?
continuation:
INT. ZHANG FAMILY MANSION - COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

13 YEARS AGO - The plaque reads: "Zhang Residence—Honor Through Restraint."

LITTLE AN RAN (8) runs with a phoenix kite. An arrow whistles—THWACK—severing the string.

AN RAN
Ah! My kite!

ZHANG LONG (14) and three boys corner her against a stone lion. He catches the kite, tears the Shen family crest.

ZHANG LONG
Presumptuous little thing.

AN RAN
Please—

He shoves her. Young ZHANG HAO (10) rushes over.

ZHANG HAO
Zhang Long, let her go!

ZHANG LONG
(turns slowly)
The bastard speaks. Does your mother still mend our robes well? She'll need more work... when you're turned out.

ZHANG HAO's fists clench—the forbidden Coiling Dragon twist. Zhang Long sees it. Smiles.

ZHANG LONG
Oh? Made a fist, have you? Show us.

ZHANG HAO charges. The boys swarm, pinning his arms. Zhang Long's boot presses his neck.

ZHANG HAO
(struggling)
Let me go!

AN RAN
(crying)
Stop hitting him!

ZHANG HAO wrenches one hand free. His fingers form the forbidden twist. He strikes Zhang Long's knee. The crack echoes. Boys scatter.

ZHANG LONG
(screaming, clutching his leg)
He used the forbidden sequence!

ZHANG SHAN (20) steps from the mansion, face like stone.

ZHANG SHAN
(to the guards)
Take the boy. Find his mother.

ZHANG HAO
Brother—!

ZHANG SHAN
(beat)
I am not your brother.

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER (O.S.)
Hao'er! Run!

A bright flash of light.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. DILAPIDATED COURTYARD - CONTINUOUS

ZHANG HAO still kneels. His mother touches his shoulder—light, afraid.

ZHANG HAO'S MOTHER
They never found her body. Only blood on the stones.

ZHANG HAO
(voice low)
I remember.

He stands. His scarred fist uncurls.

ZHANG HAO
This time, I won't run.

A KNOCK pounds at the courtyard gate—three sharp, official raps.

FADE OUT.
full_script:
Title: One Rage Shatters Mountains and Rivers
Description: A young man secretly learns martial arts and faces the consequences when his forbidden training is discovered, awakening memories of a tragic past.

INT. FOREST - DAY

A group of young men in Zhang family training uniforms flow through the Coiling Dragon sequence. Their MASTER (60s), scarred and wiry, moves among them.

title: A Dream Recalled
description: A woman confronts her treacherous husband who deceived her into marriage, stole her family's fortune, and now forces her into degradation.
context:
Title: A Dream Recalled
Description: A woman confronts her treacherous husband who deceived her into marriage, stole her family's fortune, and now forces her into degradation.

INT. DONGFANG MANSION - GRAND STAIRCASE - NIGHT

A woman in white (MEI PING) tumbles down the stairs, her body covered in blood. Chaos surrounds her as GUESTS cry out in alarm.

GUESTS (O.S.)
Something's happened!

INT. DONGFANG MANSION - SECOND FLOOR CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Lights blaze and festivities continue. JU XIANG and HUI NIANG flank MEI PING in the corridor.

JU XIANG
Madam, don't blame the master. You refuse to serve Lord Zhang - you're deliberately blocking the master's promotion.

MEI PING, covered in wounds with blood at the corner of her mouth, looks up defiantly at the upper floor. On the balcony above, her husband DONGFANG DE is intimate with another woman.

KANG RUI'ER supports MEI PING, pleading anxiously.

KANG RUI'ER
Sister, don't! Stop fighting with them.
continuation:
MEI PING
(shouting up at the balcony)
Dongfang De! You tricked me into marriage, seized my family's fortune, and drove my father to his death! Demoting me from wife to concubine wasn't enough - now you force me to entertain guests, paving the way for your promotion and wealth! Are you even human?

DONGFANG DE
(laughing from above)
I'm honoring you by doing so!

DONGFANG DE looks at the other maids and servants in the mansion.

DONGFANG DE
Look at the maids and servants in this household - which one hasn't served officials and nobles? As long as I'm pleased, even if I matched them with pigs, dogs, cattle, or horses, who would dare refuse? Guards!

Several GUARDS rush toward MEI PING and KANG RUI'ER.

DONGFANG DE descends from the upper floor and approaches MEI PING, who lies on the ground. He looks down at her condescendingly.

DONGFANG DE
Only you - you're the most disobedient of all.

MEI PING
(Quietly)
Good. I was listening.

title: A Son's Desperate Choice
description: When his father is critically injured and needs emergency surgery, a young man must choose between his family's future and his father's life.
context:
Title: A Son's Desperate Choice
Description: When his father is critically injured and needs emergency surgery, a young man must choose between his family's future and his father's life.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

QIN JIANGUO lies motionless on a gurney, blood seeping through bandages. MEDICAL STAFF rush him toward the emergency room.

QIN XIAOFENG
(panicked)
Dad—stay with me! Please—open the door!

The STAFF vanish through double doors. A NURSE blocks Qin Xiaofeng.

NURSE
You can't go in. Wait here.

The doors swing shut. Qin Xiaofeng slumps against the wall.

A DOCTOR emerges. Qin Xiaofeng, his mother ZHANG HUILAN, and sister QIN XIAOWAN surge forward.

QIN XIAOFENG
Doctor?

DOCTOR
Severe subdural hematoma. Emergency craniotomy within the hour. Who signs?

Zhang Huilan's knees buckle. Qin Xiaowan steadies her.

ZHANG HUILAN
(whispering)
No... not Jianguo...

QIN XIAOWAN
Mom—stay with me.

QIN XIAOFENG
I'll sign. Whatever it takes.

DOCTOR
80,000 yuan. 50,000 deposit required.

QIN XIAOFENG
(stunned)
Eighty thousand?

ZHANG HUILAN
(quietly)
Our savings... 12,000. For your university...

QIN XIAOFENG
We'll find it.

DOCTOR
Without the deposit, we can't proceed.

QIN XIAOFENG
Two hours. Please.

He signs with a shaking hand.

QIN XIAOFENG
Mom—the envelope in Dad's toolbox. Bring it all.

ZHANG HUILAN
(hesitating)
Your future—

QIN XIAOFENG
Dad IS my future.

He squeezes his sister's shoulder.

QIN XIAOFENG
Stay with her.

He runs.
continuation:
INT. UNCLE'S HOUSE - DAY

UNCLE paces. AUNT watches from the doorway.

UNCLE
Zhao Youde called. Offering 100,000 yuan. "Compensation." For the faulty scaffolding.

AUNT
Jianguo called it blood money.

The door bursts open. Qin Xiaofeng stands panting.

QIN XIAOFENG
Uncle. I need 38,000 yuan. In one hour.

UNCLE
We have 8,000. The rest... Zhao's waiting at the site office.

QIN XIAOFENG
The developer who let Dad fall?

UNCLE
He wants silence.

Qin Xiaofeng's jaw tightens. He nods.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE OFFICE - DAY

ZHAO YOUDE sits behind a desk. Qin Xiaofeng enters, eyes red but steady.

ZHAO YOUDE
The prodigal son. Here for your father's "compensation"?

QIN XIAOFENG
A loan. 30,000 yuan.

ZHAO YOUDE
Summer security work. Keep quiet about the "accident."

He slides a contract forward.

INT. HOSPITAL WAITING ROOM - DAY

Zhang Huilan clutches an envelope. Qin Xiaowan sits rigid. Qin Xiaofeng enters, placing cash on the table.

QIN XIAOFENG
Deposit's paid.

ZHANG HUILAN
(softly)
Zhao's money?

QIN XIAOFENG
My choice.

They sit. The operating room doors remain closed.

QIN XIAOWAN
Will Dad be proud?

QIN XIAOFENG
Let him be alive. That's enough.

The doors stay shut. They wait.

title: Love at First Sight, Destined to Be Together
description: A Taoist disciple with a rare constitution must find her destined partner before her twentieth birthday or face certain death. She falls from the sky into the arms of her betrothed.
context:
Title: Love at First Sight, Destined to Be Together
Description: A Taoist disciple with a rare constitution must find her destined partner before her twentieth birthday or face certain death. She falls from the sky into the arms of her betrothed.

INT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

Golden light flashes. JIANG YI descends from the sky, silk robes fluttering as she lands.

JIANG YI
(laughing breathlessly)
Little Phoenix, your feathers can't hide you forever!

XUAN WUMING sits at a stone table, pouring tea.

LITTLE PHOENIX darts from behind his robes, tail feathers looking ragged.

LITTLE PHOENIX
Master, she'll pluck me bare!

JIANG YI chases LITTLE PHOENIX around XUAN WUMING.

JIANG YI
Just one! For my calligraphy!

XUAN WUMING flicks his fan. Invisible force lifts JIANG YI, suspending her.

JIANG YI
(surprised)
Master!

XUAN WUMING
(eyes sharp)
The winter solstice approaches. Your twentieth birthday with it. Do you feel the cold deepening?

JIANG YI
In my bones. Every night.

XUAN WUMING
Then you know what comes next.

He releases her. She lands, face serious. From his sleeve, a red silk scroll materializes.

JIANG YI takes it, unrolling it with trembling fingers.

JIANG YI
Fu Chengyan. The name means nothing.

XUAN WUMING
His chi burns with Mystic Yang fire. Only his flame can thaw the ice in your veins. But he burns too bright—without balance, he'll be ash before the moon turns.

Wind swirls. JIANG YI's satchel floats into her hands.

XUAN WUMING (V.O.)
Your senior sister waits in the mortal realm. Silk pouch for emergencies, paper for pride. I depart at dawn. Do not seek me.

JIANG YI
(calling into the wind)
Master—what if he refuses?
continuation:
INT. HOT SPRING POOL - DAY

Scalding mist rises. FU CHENGYAN floats in the center, silver-streaked hair clinging to his neck. Iron chains glow with sealing runes. Each breath makes the water hiss.

ELDER HEALER (V.O.)
The Yang fever rages. Seven days, perhaps eight, before his own life force turns to ash. Only Clear Spring Mountain's recluse might temper this fire—but he vanished into mist a decade past.

EXT. EDGE OF HOT SPRING POOL - DAY

ASSISTANT XU addresses a line of veiled women, each bearing medicinal herbs.

ASSISTANT XU
The matriarch offers sanctuary and honor to any woman who can quell Young Master Fu's affliction. Her gratitude would know no bounds.

WOMEN
(whispering)
A chance to save him...

ASSISTANT XU
Please. He suffers.

The women approach the pool with hesitant reverence, extending lotus leaves with cooling salves.

FU CHENGYAN
(voice hoarse but commanding)
Withdraw. This burden is not yours.

They retreat with respect. One woman pauses.

WOMAN
(gently)
We meant no offense, Young Master. Only... your clan needs you.

They depart. ASSISTANT XU wrings his hands.

ASSISTANT XU
Young Master, your betrothed from the Jiang family delays again. Your uncle moves in the shadows. If you cannot be saved, at least let the line continue...

FU CHENGYAN
Dismissed. Seal the spring.

He coughs. Blood drips into the water, hissing like molten metal.

ASSISTANT XU
But--

FU CHENGYAN
Seal it.

ASSISTANT XU bows and retreats. The chain runes glow brighter.

Suddenly, a cry echoes from above.

JIANG YI (O.S.)
Below! Clear the--

JIANG YI crashes through the canopy and plunges into the spring.

She surfaces, sputtering—and locks eyes with FU CHENGYAN.

The phoenix feather in her hair glows. The chain on his wrist pulses.

Both still. Both seeing.

The water around them begins to shimmer—not with heat, but with something else entirely.

title: Sweet Qixi Festival
description: A single mother doing food delivery encounters the man from her past during an arranged blind date, while trying to protect her daughter from getting a stepfather.
context:
Title: Sweet Qixi Festival
Description: A single mother doing food delivery encounters the man from her past during an arranged blind date, while trying to protect her daughter from getting a stepfather.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

A woman in a white dress (XINBAO'S MOM) walks briskly down the corridor, then swipes her card to enter a room.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

MR. GU lies sleeping on the bed.

XINBAO'S MOM quietly lies down beside him. MR. GU turns and embraces her.

MR. GU wakes up. They gaze at each other deeply, then kiss.

MR. GU's hand caresses XINBAO'S MOM's hand and discovers she is clutching a jade pendant tightly. His fingers graze the engraved character—"bao."

EXT. MODERN CITY - DAY

ON SCREEN: Eight Years Later

INT. OFFICE/CAFE - DAY

BOSS (O.S.)
Mr. Gu.

The BOSS stands before MR. GU and his assistant HE YU.

BOSS
The delivery platform acquisition. Final terms are...

MR. GU
(to He Yu)
He Yu, you're in charge of moving this forward.

HE YU
Yes, Mr. Gu.

BOSS
(bowing)
Thank you, Mr. Gu, thank you so much. Good.

The BOSS leaves happily.

HE YU
Mr., Mr. Gu.

MR. GU
Speak.

HE YU
The old master has arranged several more blind dates for you. For Qixi festival.

MR. GU
(slams the table)
Cancel all of them!

HE YU
But... but...

MR. GU
(glaring at him)
Hmm?

HE YU
Ah, yes, yes. I'll get back to work then.

HE YU hurries away.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

XINBAO'S MOM, wearing a food delivery uniform, holds her daughter XINBAO's hand while talking on the phone.

XINBAO'S MOM
(into phone)
Mom, I don't want to go on blind dates anymore.

XINBAO'S GRANDMA (V.O.)
You stubborn girl! Your brother's future depends on you. Tonight, seven. Don't shame us.

XINBAO'S MOM angrily hangs up the phone.

The BOSS walks out of a building.

XINBAO'S MOM
(surprised)
Boss!

XINBAO'S MOM pulls her daughter and runs over, but the BOSS has already walked away.

XINBAO'S MOM
(relieved)
That was close.

XINBAO
Mom, you're just looking for a dad for me, right? Can't you just pick someone?

XINBAO'S MOM
What are you thinking? Some stepfathers take your voice before your candy. Remember Auntie Lin?

XINBAO
(nods)
They sent her away.

XINBAO'S MOM
So we stick to the plan. Quick and clean.

XINBAO
200 then.

XINBAO'S MOM
What?

XINBAO
Performance fee.

XINBAO'S MOM
(holds up five fingers)
50.

XINBAO
100.

XINBAO'S MOM takes out a hundred yuan from her pocket and hands it to XINBAO.

XINBAO
(taking the money)
Deal.

XINBAO'S MOM
Let's go.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

XINBAO'S MOM walks into the restaurant with XINBAO.

XINBAO'S MOM
Remember what to say?

XINBAO
I remember, I remember.

XINBAO suddenly points excitedly in a direction.

XINBAO
Hey, Mom, look, there's a handsome guy.

XINBAO'S MOM looks in the direction her daughter is pointing and sees MR. GU sitting at a table.

Their eyes meet. Both freeze, recognizing each other.

title: Seven Feet of Body, Pledged to Country Not to You
description: A scientist returns after five years on a secret lunar mission to find his past and the woman he left behind.
context:
Title: Seven Feet of Body, Pledged to Country Not to You
Description: A scientist returns after five years on a secret lunar mission to find his past and the woman he left behind.

EXT. FUTURISTIC CITY - DAY

Giant spaceships hover above futuristic skyscrapers. On a massive screen in the city center, a FEMALE NEWS ANCHOR delivers the news.

FEMALE NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Welcome to our Spring Festival broadcast. We have uplifting news to share. After five years, our nation's lunar research on controlled nuclear fusion has achieved a historic breakthrough. Breaking the international energy monopoly is now within reach.

The news footage cuts to a rocket launch, astronauts moving inside a space capsule. Pedestrians on the street stop and look up at the giant screen.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

A man (LING FENG) stands in front of a television, watching the news with a complex expression.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

LING FENG, wearing a black suit, stands before a hospital bed, saluting the elderly man WANG DONG lying in it.

LING FENG
Teacher, Ling Feng has not failed his mission. I have successfully completed the task assigned by the nation.

WANG DONG lies in the hospital bed, laughing excitedly.

WANG DONG
Good, well done! You've worked hard.

EXT. AIR FORCE BASE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

WANG DONG sits in a wheelchair, speaking to young LING FENG who is wearing a space suit.

WANG DONG
Xiao Feng, you are the outstanding talent of the younger generation in the field of nuclear energy. Only you can take my place and carry out the controlled nuclear fusion lunar landing plan.

LING FENG stands next to a fighter jet, holding WANG DONG's wheelchair.

LING FENG
Teacher, as your student, it is my duty.

War Department Commander ZHANG GUOQIANG walks over, his expression serious.

ZHANG GUOQIANG
Ling Feng, the lunar landing plan has been classified as the highest national secret. All traces of your existence must be erased from today. Not even your closest loved ones can know your whereabouts, until the plan is complete. If you go and never return...

LING FENG
(resolutely)
Then I will never return! To strengthen the nation, to protect our territory, fearless, with no regrets even unto death!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY (PRESENT)

WANG DONG
Back then, my condition suddenly deteriorated. If you hadn't stepped up in that critical moment to accept this arduous task, our nation's energy would still be controlled by foreign powers. You are a hero of our nation.

LING FENG
Teacher, this is what I should do.

WANG DONG
The Commander has decided to hold a scientific research press conference tomorrow to commend your significant contributions to the nation and award you the title of National Scholar. To bring you heroes who worked behind the scenes to the forefront, to be honored by tens of thousands.

LING FENG
Teacher, the title of National Scholar carries great significance. I'm afraid I'm not worthy of it.

WANG DONG
You are a pillar of the nation, you deserve it without question. Besides, even if not for yourself, you should think about your family. Don't you want to clear up the misunderstanding with Xiao Bing? Don't you want to tell her openly that five years ago you left for a national mission, that you didn't just leave without saying goodbye?

EXT. PARK - DAY (FLASHBACK)

TANG YUBING stands with her back to LING FENG.

TANG YUBING
Disappeared for three months again without reason. Ling Feng, if you keep doing this, we have no future.

LING FENG tries to hold her.

LING FENG
Yubing, wait, let me explain. Trust me, after this time, I really won't leave again.

TANG YUBING
Every time you tell me you won't leave, but in the end you always break your promise. Ling Feng, how long are you going to keep lying to me?

LING FENG takes out a ring box, about to open it when his phone rings.

LING FENG
(answering phone)
Academician Ling, the organization has orders. Please return immediately.

LING FENG hangs up, looking at the ring box in his hand, then at TANG YUBING, his expression pained.

LING FENG
I'm sorry.

LING FENG puts away the ring box and runs off. TANG YUBING stands in place, her hand unconsciously touching her belly, tears streaming down her face.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY (PRESENT)

WANG DONG
The agreement lifts at midnight. After that... you're just a man again.

He produces a black envelope. No names on it.

WANG DONG
She works here. Has for three years.

WANG DONG takes out a black invitation from the bedside table.

WANG DONG
This is the invitation to the press conference, keep it safe. Teacher has been through this. I sincerely hope you can reclaim your own happiness and have no regrets. Go.

LING FENG takes the invitation.

LING FENG
Teacher, please rest well.

LING FENG turns and leaves the ward.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

LING FENG walks to the elevator, looking at the invitation in his hand, inner monologue.

LING FENG (V.O.)
I left without saying goodbye back then. Yubing probably hates me to death. In this lifetime, I don't know if I'll ever have another chance to see her and explain everything clearly.

LING FENG puts away the invitation and enters the elevator. The elevator doors slowly close.

Just as the elevator doors are about to completely shut, a woman (TANG YUBING) rushes over pulling a little girl.

TANG YUBING
Wait!

LING FENG sees them from inside the elevator, his eyes shocked. The elevator doors close.

FADE OUT.

title: Rebirth of the Villain Ex-Wife
description: A reader transmigrates into a novel as the villainous ex-wife who abandoned the male lead during his downfall, only to face karmic retribution when he rises again.
context:
Title: Rebirth of the Villain Ex-Wife
Description: A reader transmigrates into a novel as the villainous ex-wife who abandoned the male lead during his downfall, only to face karmic retribution when he rises again.

INT. BESIDE GARBAGE BINS - NIGHT

A stormy night with thunder and lightning.

A man rummages through a box of discarded lettuce.

JIANG YUMAN, ragged and soaked to the bone, hides behind a garbage bin. She takes a vegetable heart from the man and devours it hungrily, yet her face shows a satisfied smile.

A distant SHOUT echoes: "Check the alleys!"

A black Mercedes drives up and stops in the rain.

A man in a black suit with shiny leather shoes gets out. A BODYGUARD opens a black umbrella for him. This is FU JINGCHEN.

JIANG YUMAN sees him. The vegetable heart drops from her hand. Her eyes show shock.

FU JINGCHEN holds the umbrella, looking at her coldly.

JIANG YUMAN crawls toward him desperately, then stands up with a fawning smile on her face.

JIANG YUMAN
Fu Jingchen, they cleared your name. I knew they would. We can start over--

A BODYGUARD steps forward and pushes JIANG YUMAN to the ground.

FU JINGCHEN
(coldly)
Jiang Yuman. Is this what you left me for?

An elegantly dressed woman, YAO SIMENG, gets out of the car.

YAO SIMENG
(contemptuously)
This is her? The one who vanished when the investigators came? Who filed the divorce papers before your sentencing?

JIANG YUMAN
(voice cracking)
Ten thousand. Just ten thousand. The loan sharks-- they'll take my hands.

FU JINGCHEN
You gave up the right to ask for my help when you erased our child.

YAO SIMENG
Jingchen, don't waste your vindication on her.
continuation:
FU JINGCHEN turns to leave.

JIANG YUMAN
Wait! I'll beg. I'll grovel--

FU JINGCHEN
(sternly)
You already did. Two years ago. It was enough.

Several men wielding clubs rush over.

DEBT COLLECTOR
There she is! Don't let her run!

JIANG YUMAN flees in terror. The DEBT COLLECTORS chase after her. She runs blindly into the middle of the road.

A car speeds toward her, its headlights blinding.

BANG! JIANG YUMAN is struck and sent flying, landing in a pool of blood.

The scene freezes, transforming into an illustration in a book.

INT. MODERN APARTMENT - DAY

A READER wearing glasses and pajamas closes the book.

READER
(gleefully)
She got exactly what she deserved. Every last bit of it.

The READER stands, reaching for a water glass. Her foot slips on a wet patch. She falls--

Her head strikes the table corner. The glass shatters.

The book on the floor flips open. White light spills from its pages, enveloping the room.

INT. INSIDE A CAR - DAY

The READER slowly opens her eyes and finds herself in an unfamiliar environment, her face showing confusion.

She looks down at her hands - manicured, unblemished.

Outside the window, a gated estate waits.

She touches her face in the rearview mirror.

JIANG YUMAN's reflection stares back, eyes brimming with dawning horror.

title: The Yang Family Villa
description: A woman's carefully planned transfer of her legacy sets off a chain of events that unravels a web of deception, culminating in a hospital revelation that questions everything she thought she knew about family.
context:
Title: The Yang Family Villa
Description: A woman's carefully planned transfer of her legacy sets off a chain of events that unravels a web of deception, culminating in a hospital revelation that questions everything she thought she knew about family.

INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM - DAY

MOTHER-IN-LAW, YANG XIAOYAN, ZHAO WENBIN, and their son TAOTAO (9) examine documents spread across the coffee table.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(thumbing through a stack)
Thirty-five properties. All for my grandson's future.

TAOTAO
(bored)
Can I go play now?

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Not yet, sweetheart. Mommy needs to sign everything first.

YANG XIAOYAN
(hesitant)
Mother, are you sure this is necessary? Taotao's only nine.

ZHAO WENBIN
She's right to worry, but the lawyers say it's better this way. Protects everything from your uncles' legal challenges.

YANG XIAOYAN
(signing the last document)
Father built this empire for our family. Not for them.

MOTHER-IN-LAW watches her sign, a flicker of calculation crossing her face before she beams.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Such a devoted mother. Wenbin, you've married well.

ZHAO WENBIN squeezes Yang Xiaoyan's shoulder. She smiles, but studies her mother-in-law's reflection in the darkened window.
continuation:
INT. VILLA KITCHEN/LIVING ROOM - DAY

YANG XIAOYAN is busy at the kitchen counter, her back to the living room.

MOTHER-IN-LAW sits on the sofa, eating fruit while making a call.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(quietly into phone)
She signed the properties. But the company shares—her father's voting rights—those are still in her name. We need a more permanent solution.

TAOTAO zooms through the living room on a scooter, weaving between furniture.

YANG XIAOYAN
(without turning)
Taotao, not in the house.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Let the boy play.

MOTHER-IN-LAW waves him on, then casually drops a grape stem on the floor. She continues her call.

TAOTAO rounds the corner sharply. His scooter wheel catches the grape stem. He loses control and crashes into the side table, hitting his head on the marble edge.

YANG XIAOYAN hears the impact and spins around.

YANG XIAOYAN
(screaming)
Taotao!

She runs to him. Blood pools beneath his head. MOTHER-IN-LAW stands frozen, the phone still to her ear.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YANG XIAOYAN paces, her knuckles white around her phone. The NURSE approaches with a clipboard.

YANG XIAOYAN
How is he?

NURSE
Stable, but he needs blood. You're his mother—what's your blood type?

YANG XIAOYAN
A-positive. Same as his father's. We had it tested for school.

NURSE
(frowning at the chart)
That's... problematic. The screen shows he's Rh-negative. Extremely rare—the "panda blood type." We need a full panel and paternal confirmation.

YANG XIAOYAN
Rh-negative? But that's not possible. Neither of us...

Her voice trails off. She stares at the nurse, then looks down at her phone—at a photo of Taotao and Zhao Wenbin laughing together. Something in their features. The shape of their eyes. The set of their jaw.

YANG XIAOYAN
(quietly)
Neither of us has that blood type.

NURSE
We'll need your husband's blood work immediately. Is he here?

YANG XIAOYAN
Not yet.

She looks back at the photo. For the first time, she really looks at it. At them.

YANG XIAOYAN (V.O.)
If it's hereditary... and neither of us carries it...

The realization hits like ice water. She grips the phone tighter and turns toward the emergency room doors, her expression hardening from fear to something else entirely.

YANG XIAOYAN
(screaming)
Taotao!

She runs to him. Blood pools beneath his head. MOTHER-IN-LAW stands frozen, the phone still to her ear.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YANG XIAOYAN paces, her knuckles white around her phone. The NURSE approaches with a clipboard.

YANG XIAOYAN
How is he?

NURSE
Stable, but he needs blood. You're his mother—what's your blood type?

YANG XIAOYAN
A-positive. Same as his father's. We had it tested for school.

NURSE
(frowning at the chart)
That's... problematic. The screen shows he's Rh-negative. Extremely rare—the "panda blood type." We need a full panel and paternal confirmation.

YANG XIAOYAN
Rh-negative? But that's not possible. Neither of us...

Her voice trails off. She stares at the nurse, then looks down at her phone—at a photo of Taotao and Zhao Wenbin laughing together. Something in their features. The shape of their eyes. The set of their jaw.

YANG XIAOYAN
(quietly)
Neither of us has that blood type.

NURSE
We'll need your husband's blood work immediately. Is he here?

YANG XIAOYAN
Not yet.

She looks back at the photo. For the first time, she really looks at it. At them.

YANG XIAOYAN (V.O.)
If it's hereditary... and neither of us carries it...

The realization hits like ice water. She grips the phone tighter and turns toward the emergency room doors, her expression hardening from fear to something else entirely.

title: Triple Treasure Alliance, Daddy You Found the Wrong Mommy
description: A woman is betrayed by her sister and fiancé, drugged at her engagement party, and left to die in a fire while pregnant. The mysterious man from that night searches for her while raising their rescued child.
context:
Title: Triple Treasure Alliance, Daddy You Found the Wrong Mommy
Description: A woman is betrayed by her sister and fiancé, drugged at her engagement party, and left to die in a fire while pregnant. The mysterious man from that night searches for her while raising their rescued child.

INT. BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

MENG YAO glides through the crowd toward MENG XIN, champagne flute catching the light.

MENG YAO
Sister.

MENG XIN
Congratulations.

MENG YAO
I hope you and brother-in-law are very happy together.

MENG XIN
Thank you.

Their glasses touch. MENG XIN drinks deep. MENG YAO watches her over the rim, smile never reaching her eyes.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

FLASHBACK. MENG XIN sprawls across the bed, drugged and helpless. BO YITING emerges from the shadows.

MENG XIN (V.O.)
My engagement night. The night my family sold me.

BO YITING studies her face, then tucks a jade pendant into her palm.

BO YITING
(low)
Take this. Come to the Bo estate. I keep my promises.

He vanishes as quickly as he appeared. MENG XIN's fingers twitch around the pendant.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: EIGHT MONTHS LATER

MENG XIN cradles her enormous belly. SONG XIAO explodes through the door, face purple with rage.

SONG XIAO
You whore! Pregnant with some stranger's bastard and you dare call it mine?

He drives his foot into her ribs. She collapses, gasping.

MENG XIN
(strangled)
You were the only one... you know that...

MENG YAO glides in, wrapping herself around SONG XIAO.

MENG YAO
Sweet sister. Song Xiao spent your engagement night in my bed. We watched you stumble into that room. Whoever you found—he wasn't your groom.

MENG XIN's hand flies to her stomach. The truth hits like a fist.

MENG XIN
(to MENG YAO)
You drugged me? Your own sister?

MENG YAO
(slaps her)
Don't you dare speak of family.

SONG XIAO
(restraining MENG YAO)
That's enough.

MENG YAO
(whispering, venomous)
Mother's death wasn't an accident. Dad and my mother took their time. They kept you alive to steal your inheritance. Now we take the rest.

MENG XIN
(broken)
You killed her...

MENG XIN lunges. SONG XIAO slams her head against the marble table edge. She crumples, blood pooling beneath her skull and spreading between her thighs.

MENG XIN
(whispered)
My baby...

MENG YAO
Burn it. Burn everything.

SONG XIAO splashes liquid across the floor, then strikes a match. Flames erupt instantly. They watch MENG XIN lying in the fire, then turn and leave.

EXT. VILLA DISTRICT - DAY

BO YITING stands on the balcony, city sprawled below. ZHANG ZE approaches with a baby wrapped in sterile blankets.

ZHANG ZE
Master Bo. The child survived—miraculously. Paternity confirmed. But the mother... she disappeared from the ambulance. No records exist.

BO YITING takes the fragile infant, his face granite.

BO YITING
She's alive. Find her. I don't care what it costs.

ZHANG ZE
Yes, sir.

title: After Joining the Show, the Big Shot's Identity Can't Be Hidden
description: A wealthy heir conceals his identity for love, but when his wife joins a reality show for prize money, his secret life begins to unravel.
context:
Title: After Joining the Show, the Big Shot's Identity Can't Be Hidden
Description: A wealthy heir conceals his identity for love, but when his wife joins a reality show for prize money, his secret life begins to unravel.

EXT. TELEVISION STATION - DAY

YE FAN stands outside the television station, bathed in bright sunlight.

YE FAN (V.O.)
Three years of disappearing into the crowd. For her. Now this million-yuan circus is about to blow those years to dust.

SU WANYI runs out from the television station entrance.

SU WANYI
Ye Fan! Why are you still out here?

SU WANYI runs to YE FAN's side and grabs his arm.

SU WANYI
We have to check in.

YE FAN
Wanyi, we could still withdraw. Use my emergency fund instead.

SU WANYI
And start over? No. This money is our way forward.

SU WANYI pulls YE FAN into the television station.

INT. PROGRAM RECORDING HALL - DAY

SU WANYI and YE FAN walk arm-in-arm into the brightly lit program recording hall.

SU WANYI
Made it.

CHEN JING
Su Wanyi. What a surprise.

SU WANYI
(delighted)
Jingjing! I didn't know you'd be here.

CHEN JING
(tight smile)
That's the magic of casting. Though I didn't expect they'd go so... grassroots.

SHEN DAYU
(to CHEN JING)
You know them?

CHEN JING
Distantly. Very distantly.

YE FAN
(to SU WANYI)
continuation:
We don't have to engage.

SHEN DAYU
I see.

SU WANYI
(to CHEN JING)
Jingjing, we're family.

CHEN JING
Family? That word meant something at the village reunion. Now it just means shared ancestry and old photographs. You've always been provincial, Wanyi. But I suppose that's authentic.

YE FAN
Authenticity scares those built on artifice.

SU WANYI
(pulling YE FAN back)
He's nervous. First TV appearance.

CHEN JING
Of course. (to SHEN DAYU) Dayu, didn't you need an assistant? Someone with grit?

SHEN DAYU
(smiling at SU WANYI)
I admire perseverance.

CHEN JING
(to SU WANYI)
There. A real stepping stone. Why settle for potential when you could have proven success?

SHEN DAYU
Or we could skip the formalities. I've got room for ambition in my circle.

CHEN JING
(angrily to SHEN DAYU)
Shen Dayu!

SHEN DAYU
(grinning)
Just exploring options, darling. Like you.

CHEN JING
(to SU WANYI, poison-sweet)
Fine. You want what I have? I'll share. One season. One roof. Let's test your appetite.

Chen Jing links arms with Shen Dayu, staring down Su Wanyi. The challenge is explicit.

SU WANYI
(to YE FAN, shaken)
Let's find our marks.

YE FAN
(quietly)
We will. And by the end, she'll see exactly what she's been mocking.

He squeezes her hand. Su Wanyi's humiliation hardens into resolve. They step forward together, facing the stage.

title: Meeting the In-Laws
description: A woman prepares expensive gifts for her first visit to her boyfriend's family, but his unexpected request tests her generosity.
context:
Title: Meeting the In-Laws
Description: A woman prepares expensive gifts for her first visit to her boyfriend's family, but his unexpected request tests her generosity.

INT. CAR TRUNK - DAY

GIRLFRIEND places a final gift box into an overflowing trunk. BOYFRIEND rearranges bags to make them fit.

BOYFRIEND
Pu'er tea for Dad?

GIRLFRIEND
(handing over a red box)
Top grade. And those are Mom's.

BOYFRIEND
(taking it, noticing the brand)
Bird's nest? The premium stuff...

He lifts a shopping bag, genuinely surprised by the weight.

BOYFRIEND
How much is all this?

GIRLFRIEND
Just want them to feel respected.

She pulls out an envelope, offers it casually.

GIRLFRIEND
And a gift card for Mom. She can pick what she likes.

BOYFRIEND
(peeking inside, startled)
This is... ten thousand?

GIRLFRIEND
(getting into the driver's seat)
It's our first meeting. They're family now, right?

BOYFRIEND
(moved, following to passenger side)
You're something else. Really.

GIRLFRIEND
(softly)
I just want us to start right.

She starts the engine.
continuation:
INT. CAR - DAY

Highway stretches ahead. Snow begins to dust the windshield.

BOYFRIEND
It's really coming down.

GIRLFRIEND
(adjusting wipers)
We'll be fine.

BOYFRIEND
Hey, about my sister... she's retaking the Gaokao. Pretty depressed.

GIRLFRIEND
That's tough. I could get her something? A new tablet for studying?

BOYFRIEND
She's eighteen. If she fails again...

GIRLFRIEND
Let's not assume the worst.

BOYFRIEND
Just being realistic. In that case, a tablet won't help.

GIRLFRIEND
(glancing over)
What are you thinking?

BOYFRIEND
(looking out window)
She'll need capital. To start something. A real future.

GIRLFRIEND
I... guess?

BOYFRIEND
Turns to face her.

BOYFRIEND
What if we give her fifty thousand? As a meeting gift.

GIRLFRIEND
Eyes stay on the road. Her grip tightens on the wheel.

GIRLFRIEND
Fifty thousand.

BOYFRIEND
For her future. It's what family does, right?

GIRLFRIEND
(quietly)
The gifts in the trunk were for the family.

BOYFRIEND
This is different. Direct support.

Snow falls heavier. The car slows.

GIRLFRIEND
(still quiet)
Your sister. Your parents know about this?

BOYFRIEND
(pause)
I was thinking it could be... between us. My gift to her, but, you know—

GIRLFRIEND
(finishing, voice flat)
From me.

She pulls over to the shoulder. Puts the car in park. Turns to him.

GIRLFRIEND
Let's get one thing straight. I'm generous. Not a bank.

She reaches into her bag, pulls out a phone box.

GIRLFRIEND
This is for your sister. For studying. Or whatever.

She places it on the console between them.

GIRLFRIEND
The rest? We'll see how tonight goes.

She puts the car back in drive, merging into traffic. He stares at the phone, snow melting on the windshield.

title: After Descending the Mountain, A Peerless Beauty Insists on Becoming My Disciple
description: A powerful cultivator is hunted by celestial forces after defying the heavens and avenging his master.
context:
Title: After Descending the Mountain, A Peerless Beauty Insists on Becoming My Disciple
Description: A powerful cultivator is hunted by celestial forces after defying the heavens and avenging his master.

EXT. SNOWY MOUNTAIN WILDERNESS - DAY

A fractured solar halo stains the heavens.

ANCESTOR (V.O.)
Jiang Wuqi! You shattered the Heavenly Court's edict and slew your own ancestor! Ten thousand deaths cannot atone for this sin!

JIANG WUQI crashes from the sky, slamming into the frozen earth. Blood sprays across the snow.

JIANG WUQI struggles to rise, violet light flickering beneath his skin. Blood drips from his mouth.

Three IMMORTALS descend from the sky, hovering in the air, surrounding JIANG WUQI—IMMORTAL A, IMMORTAL B, IMMORTAL C.

IMMORTAL A
Surrender the Samsara Codex, Jiang Wuqi. Return to the Immortal Court in chains, and we might spare a fragment of your soul.

JIANG WUQI
The same court that watched my master shatter into soul-dust? The same ancestor who sent my senior sister into the Demonic Abyss? Come then. Take me.

IMMORTAL C
Insolence!

The three IMMORTALS attack simultaneously. JIANG WUQI forms a violet lotus seal, and a barrier appears, blocking the attack.

The barrier shatters instantly. JIANG WUQI is sent flying.

JIANG WUQI rolls on the ground dodging wave after wave of attacks, but is eventually hit by several energy blasts and falls motionless.

The three IMMORTALS slowly land and walk toward JIANG WUQI lying on the ground.

IMMORTAL B
With injuries like these, how did you ever break the Ancestor's Nine Heavens Seal?

Suddenly, the sound of clapping comes from behind them. The three turn around in shock.
continuation:
JIANG WUQI's true body appears behind them at some point, looking composed but pale.

JIANG WUQI
A decent effort. You nearly destroyed my blood puppet.

The "JIANG WUQI" on the ground dissolves into motes of violet light, leaving only a bloodstained talisman.

IMMORTAL A
Blood puppetry? That art was lost with the ancient immortals—

JIANG WUQI
Let me show you what else was lost.

JIANG WUQI gathers powerful violet lightning energy spheres in both hands. His hands tremble slightly.

IMMORTAL A (terrified)
He's channeling Primordial Lightning...

JIANG WUQI slams the lightning spheres into the ground. Countless bolts of lightning instantly engulf the three IMMORTALS.

The three IMMORTALS are blasted away by the electric light, falling to the ground in disarray, severely injured.

IMMORTAL B (struggling)
You're no mere cultivator... Who are you?

JIANG WUQI (bitter smile)
Just a disciple who buried his master.

The sky tears open, and a massive figure formed of storm clouds appears above.

ANCESTOR
Will you bury your sect next, traitor?

JIANG WUQI looks up at the ANCESTOR in the sky, his expression grave. For a heartbeat, grief crosses his face.

JIANG WUQI
If I must.

In the treeline, a PEERLESS BEAUTY in white watches, her eyes reflecting starlight.
