title: Tiger Descending the Mountain
description: Chen Hu is reborn after being murdered by his family and returns to the moment that started his downfall, determined to turn the tables on those who betrayed him.
context:
Title: Tiger Descending the Mountain
Description: Chen Hu is reborn after being murdered by his family and returns to the moment that started his downfall, determined to turn the tables on those who betrayed him.

INT. HOT SPRING POOL - NIGHT

CHEN HU, white shirt and black pants clinging to his frame, floats face-down in the hot spring pool, motionless.

Suddenly, CHEN HU bolts upright from the water, gasping for air, his eyes wild, searching.

CHEN HU (V.O.)
Back here. I'm back.

FLASHBACK:

INT. BATHTUB - NIGHT

CHEN HU struggles violently in the water, finally sinking to the bottom.

CHEN HU (V.O.)
Chen Xiaolong's cocktail. The bathtub "accident" that ruined me.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

CHEN HU, wearing a hospital gown, sits in a wheelchair with a vacant stare, drool running down from the corner of his mouth. A DOCTOR speaks with CHEN SHAN.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Oxygen deprivation caused permanent damage. He'll need full-time care.

CHEN QINGXUE and CHEN XIAOLONG stand outside the ward, looking at the scene inside.

CHEN QINGXUE
What a pity. He survived.

CHEN XIAOLONG
He's dead enough. Reputation ruined, mind gone.

CHEN SHAN walks over.

CHEN XIAOLONG
Once I'm confirmed as company heir, I'll finish him.

END FLASHBACK.

ANOTHER FLASHBACK:
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

CHEN HU lies on the ground covered in injuries, barely alive. CHEN SHAN looks down at him from above.

CHEN SHAN
Xiao Hu, don't blame Dad. The company belongs to Xiaolong and Xiaoxue. Your sacrifice is necessary.

CHEN XIAOLONG walks toward CHEN HU holding an iron rod, his face twisted with malice. CHEN HU's eyes widen—then harden.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. HOT SPRING POOL - NIGHT

CHEN HU returns to reality, his expression cold and determined.

CHEN HU (V.O.)
This time, the hunt goes both ways.

A woman in a red dress and gold robe, LIU SHUANGSHUANG, cautiously approaches the hot spring pool.

LIU SHUANGSHUANG
Tiger Young Master, are you alright? You were under so long.

CHEN HU
Liu Shuangshuang.

LIU SHUANGSHUANG
(nervously)
If you're okay, then I'll just...

CHEN HU rises from the water and walks toward her.

CHEN HU
Chen Xiaolong sent you to check, didn't he? Surprised I'm not dead?

LIU SHUANGSHUANG
(flustered)
No, this has nothing to do with me.

CHEN HU
Where is he?

LIU SHUANGSHUANG
He's... downstairs.

CHEN HU beckons to LIU SHUANGSHUANG with his finger. LIU SHUANGSHUANG hesitantly steps forward. CHEN HU suddenly reaches out and pulls her into the water.

LIU SHUANGSHUANG screams as she falls into the water. The two face each other in the pool.

CHEN HU
(quietly)
If I'd died tonight, Xiaolong's next move would be your arrest. "Self-defense against assault." He wins twice.

LIU SHUANGSHUANG
(shocked)
Is what you're saying true?

CHEN HU
I'm giving you one more chance to choose again.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Fill in the Blank Task
description: A man's mother is held hostage by his unfaithful wife and her lover, who extort money from him while his sick father is locked away.
context:
Title: Fill in the Blank Task
Description: A man's mother is held hostage by his unfaithful wife and her lover, who extort money from him while his sick father is locked away.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

MOTHER-IN-LAW kneels on the floor, surrounded by broken bowl shards and blood. Her face is bruised, her expression pained.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(whispered)
I'll give you nothing more.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW (O.S.)
Then your husband gets nothing.

WU DONGMING appears wearing a fashionable suit vest, looking at everything with contempt.

WU DONGMING
Wasteful.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW, wearing a red robe, walks toward WU DONGMING with a smile. WU DONGMING picks her up and sits on the bed edge. The two flirt intimately.

WU DONGMING
She's still useful. The son pays.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW
(fawningly)
Young Master, your Wu conglomerate is Great Xia's crown jewel. Two hundred thousand is just... maintenance.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW turns to MOTHER-IN-LAW, her tone becoming vicious.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW
The transfer. By three. Or Ye Ping's morphine pump has an accident.

WU DONGMING
Oh right. Your husband's still in the climate-controlled unit. His withdrawal timeline is... unforgiving.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(crying out, anguished)
You drained his pension! His insurance! My son's savings—how much more?

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW walks forward and grabs MOTHER-IN-LAW's hair.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW
continuation:
Mom.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(screaming)
We raised you!

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW
(interrupting)
And I learned which accounts to bleed first.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(incredulous)
You shameless poison—

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW
Better than a ghost. Like you.

A phone rings. DAUGHTER-IN-LAW picks up the phone and glances at it.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW
(impatiently)
The mark. Persistent.

WU DONGMING lies on the bed, saying leisurely.

WU DONGMING
Century Park suite. Our anniversary trip.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW throws the phone toward MOTHER-IN-LAW.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW
Ye Ping's next dose. One transfer. Or I cancel his prescription.

WU DONGMING gets up, walks to the door, and turns back to threaten MOTHER-IN-LAW.

WU DONGMING
His monitor alerts my watch. Don't get creative.

DAUGHTER-IN-LAW
Now.

MOTHER-IN-LAW crawls over in despair, then slowly stands up, her eyes becoming firm and complex.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Not Being a Stepfather, I Took Off
description: A man who prioritized his stepchildren over his own daughter is abandoned by them when he falls ill. Given a second chance, he travels back in time to fix his mistakes.
context:
Title: Not Being a Stepfather, I Took Off
Description: A man who prioritized his stepchildren over his own daughter is abandoned by them when he falls ill. Given a second chance, he travels back in time to fix his mistakes.

EXT. VILLA ENTRANCE - NIGHT

A white sedan glides to a stop. HE HU steps out, mid-20s, designer clothes hanging loose like armor. He doesn't look at the wheelchair-bound figure being shoved through the front door.

CHEN XUERU (40s, sharp features) and XU FENG (20s, delicate, avoiding eye contact) dump a worn suitcase beside the wheelchair. It spills open—pill bottles scatter on concrete.

CHEN XUERU
(frosted smile)
Your real family's waiting.

HE HU joins them, a cluster of PERFUMED WOMEN trailing behind. He lights a cigarette, the flare illuminating his bored expression.

HE HU
(shoving the wheelchair)
Down you go.

HE QINGJUN (60s, frail) topples onto pavement. Breath knocked out. No one moves to help.

HE HU
(to the women, gesturing with cigarette)
Remember that investment I mentioned? This is the asset that depreciated.

CHEN XUERU
(covering a laugh)
Hu!

HE HU
(studying He Qingjun)
Mom's daughter always came first. Isn't that right, Feng?

XU FENG
(staring at her phone)
Can we just go? I'm cold.

Thunder rolls, low and distant.

CHEN XUERU
(brightening)
Of course, baby. I'll make dumplings. Your favorite.

SHE clicks the suitcase shut with her foot. They turn.

HE HU
Dinner first. Then we'll call the lawyer about the house papers.

He flicks the cigarette. It bounces near He Qingjun's hand.

CHEN XUERU
(over her shoulder)
You chose this.

XU FENG
(doesn't look back)
Don't clog our drain.

The door snaps shut. Locks click.

A black umbrella blooms in the downpour. HE AN'AN (30s, rainwater streaming off her trench coat) stops. Sees the figure on the ground.

The door cracks open. Chen Xueru's smile vanishes, then reforms—crueler.

CHEN XUERU
Oh. An'an. Perfect timing.

XU FENG
(slipping inside)
Mom, hurry.

HE HU
(laughs)
Natural selection.

The door shuts again. This time, the porch light dies.

HE AN'AN stands in the rain, umbrella forgotten. She watches He Qingjun struggle to breathe.
continuation:
EXT. VILLA ENTRANCE/FLASH INSERTS - CONTINUOUS

As An'an watches, images flicker:

- A young girl's blistered feet in sandals, snow falling.
- A boy tearing into roast duck while small hands press against a fogged window.
- A child's voice: "Dad, it's cold."

BACK TO SCENE:

HE AN'AN
(quietly)
Thirty years. I waited for this moment.

She crouches. The rain has plastered his hair to his forehead.

HE AN'AN
You don't recognize me, do you?

He Qingjun's eyes flutter. Sees her face. Something registers.

HE AN'AN
The fire. You remember the fire.

FLASHBACK - INT. BURNING HOUSE - NIGHT (INSERT)

Young He An'an pounds on a window, flames behind her. Sees He Qingjun running past, carrying XU FENG's limp form. He doesn't stop. Doesn't look.

Young An'an's palm slaps the glass. Leaves a small, sooty print.

BACK TO PRESENT:

HE AN'AN
(touching his wet hair)
I had third-degree burns. She had a blister. You said, "Girls can't have scars."

A pill bottle floats past in a gutter stream.

HE AN'AN
(standing)
You gave them everything. They gave you a sidewalk. This is just math.

HE QINGJUN
(wheezing)
An'an...

HE AN'AN
Don't. The word doesn't belong to you.

He grabs her wrist. Surprisingly strong.

HE QINGJUN
I saw... red shoes...

His eyes focus past her, seeing something else.

HE QINGJUN
(whisper becoming a rasp)
Let me... try again...

His grip loosens. The rain intensifies.

He is still.

HE AN'AN stares at his hand on her wrist. Then at his face. Something breaks in her expression—just for a second.

INT. SHABBY ROOM - DAY

YOUNG HE QINGJUN (30s) gasps awake. Sunlight slashes through broken blinds onto his face. He looks at his hands—strong, unmarked.

On a nearby chair: a pair of bright red leather shoes, still in their box.

FADE OUT.

title: After I Stopped Being a Simp, My Husband Panicked
description: After years of devotion to her husband who cheated on her, Qiao Shuang decides to divorce and claim what she deserves, leaving Gu Chen desperate to win her back.
context:
Title: After I Stopped Being a Simp, My Husband Panicked
Description: After years of devotion to her husband who cheated on her, Qiao Shuang decides to divorce and claim what she deserves, leaving Gu Chen desperate to win her back.

EXT. SNOWY NIGHT - NIGHT

QIAO SHUANG and GU CHEN face off in the snow.

QIAO SHUANG
Five years. I had to wade through five years of shit to see the cesspit for what it is.

QIAO SHUANG turns and walks away.

GU CHEN
(taking out his phone, voice low)
Find out who's advising her.

INT. QIAO SHUANG'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

QIAO SHUANG lies asleep on the sofa.

GU CHEN enters the apartment and sits beside the sofa, watching her.

GU CHEN
(softly)
This is where you ran to?

GU CHEN reaches out to gently caress QIAO SHUANG's cheek. QIAO SHUANG wakes with a start.

QIAO SHUANG
(panicked)
How did you get in?

QIAO SHUANG
(to herself)
The building manager. Right.
continuation:
GU CHEN
Why don't you come back to the Gu residence? Why are you holed up in such a small apartment?

QIAO SHUANG
Gu Chen, are you deaf? I told you, I want a divorce!

GU CHEN
(angry, barely controlled)
Qiao Shuang, haven't you made enough of a scene?

QIAO SHUANG
How is this making a scene? You cheated on me with Bai Le first. In these five years as Mrs. Gu, I have a clear conscience. So, the property that should be divided, I won't take a penny less.

GU CHEN stands up, straightens his tie, his expression unreadable.

GU CHEN
(measured)
What a calculated scheme. Gu Corporation is Jiangcheng's number one conglomerate. Even one-tenth of the profits would be enough for you to squander for a lifetime.

QIAO SHUANG
(crossing her arms)
Of course. If I can't get love, I might as well get some money.

GU CHEN steps forward and forcefully grabs QIAO SHUANG's chin.

QIAO SHUANG
(struggling)
Gu Chen, what are you doing?

GU CHEN
(closing in, voice dangerously quiet)
What am I doing? Taking my money to fund some rival company? Or some man who'll pretend you're worth more than a transaction?

QIAO SHUANG
(steady, meeting his eyes)
Maybe both. After all, you taught me how profitable betrayal can be.

title: Unbearable
description: A legendary military commander mobilizes the entire nation's resources to save the daughter of a doctor who has dedicated everything to the country.
context:
Title: Unbearable
Description: A legendary military commander mobilizes the entire nation's resources to save the daughter of a doctor who has dedicated everything to the country.

EXT. JIANGNING AIRPORT - EVENING

A passenger plane slowly lands against a brilliant sunset.

ON SCREEN: JIANGNING AIRPORT

INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - NIGHT

Two security personnel in black uniforms rush into the airport arrival hall and stop at the entrance. Inside the hall, passengers are blocked on both sides by red barrier tape, forming long queues, waiting anxiously.

ANNOUNCEMENT (V.O.)
Attention passengers of flight TC8741, your flight route has been adjusted. Boarding time is to be determined. Please wait patiently.

MALE PASSENGER 1
(low, to companion)
Three hours. Not a single departure.

FEMALE PASSENGER 1
(quietly)
Something's wrong. Look at their faces.

MALE PASSENGER 2
(pointing outside)
Armed escort. Not standard police.

EXT. AIRPORT EXTERIOR - NIGHT

A convoy of Hummers speeds in, making a sharp drift and stopping in front of the terminal. Doors open, and soldiers in camouflage combat uniforms quickly exit and form ranks. Then, LAN YUE—mid-30s, tactical gear, calm focus—steps out of the lead white Hummer.

ON SCREEN: LAN YUE, SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMANDER

LAN YUE, escorted by a squad of soldiers, strides toward the terminal.
continuation:
INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - NIGHT

CHEN HAOTIAN in military officer uniform and LIN YE in a worn tweed jacket, surrounded by two discreet guards, walk through the empty corridor toward the center of the hall. LAN YUE approaches from the other end.

LAN YUE
(standing at attention, saluting)
General.

Behind her, soldiers snap to attention.

SOLDIERS (O.S.)
(sharp, unified)
Sir.

ON SCREEN: CHEN HAOTIAN, SUPREME COMMANDER
ON SCREEN: LIN YE, CHIEF EPIDEMIOLOGIST

LIN YE
(checking his watch)
The synthetic antigen. Status.

CHEN HAOTIAN
Commander?

LAN YUE
Central Special Department escort. Airspace locked. Twenty-three minutes.

LIN YE
(exhales)
Her liver can't process the natural strain. She's twelve.

CHEN HAOTIAN
(to Lan Yue)
Secondary protocols?

LAN YUE
Jiangning Central's isolation unit is prepped. Our medical team's scrubbing in.

CHEN HAOTIAN
(to Lin Ye)
Your work on the Northern Frontier Protocol saved forty thousand. We don't forget.

LAN YUE
Cargo's marked H-1. No inspection. No delay.

CHEN HAOTIAN
(quietly)
Doctor. This is what the nation owes you. Not charity. Debt.

CHEN HAOTIAN places his fist over his heart. LAN YUE and the soldiers follow suit.

CHEN HAOTIAN
Twenty minutes. The medicine arrives. Then we breathe.

LIN YE looks at them, nods once, turns and walks alone toward the depths of the empty corridor, his figure heavy but upright.

LAN YUE
(softly)
General. He hasn't slept in three days.

CHEN HAOTIAN
He's been fighting for thirty years. Let him walk.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

JIANG YUXIN sits by the bedside, holding her daughter LIN MENG's hand. The girl's breathing is shallow, her skin waxen.

ON SCREEN: JIANG YUXIN, RESEARCH PARTNER
ON SCREEN: LIN MENG, DAUGHTER

LIN MENG
(whisper)
Mom. The light's fuzzy.

JIANG YUXIN
(leans close, steady voice)
That's the medicine working. Daddy's medicine.

full_script:
Title: Unbearable
Description: A legendary military commander mobilizes the entire nation's resources to save the daughter of a doctor who has dedicated everything to the country.

EXT. JIANGNING AIRPORT - EVENING

A passenger plane slowly lands against a brilliant sunset.

ON SCREEN: JIANGNING AIRPORT

INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - NIGHT

Two security personnel in black uniforms rush into the airport arrival hall and stop at the entrance. Inside the hall, passengers are blocked on both sides by red barrier tape, forming long queues, waiting anxiously.

ANNOUNCEMENT (V.O.)
Attention passengers of flight TC8741, your flight route has been adjusted. Boarding time is to be determined. Please wait patiently.

MALE PASSENGER 1
(low, to companion)
Three hours. Not a single departure.

FEMALE PASSENGER 1
(quietly)
Something's wrong. Look at their faces.

MALE PASSENGER 2
(pointing outside)
Armed escort. Not standard police.

EXT. AIRPORT EXTERIOR - NIGHT

A convoy of Hummers speeds in, making a sharp drift and stopping in front of the terminal. Doors open, and soldiers in camouflage combat uniforms quickly exit and form ranks. Then, LAN YUE—mid-30s, tactical gear, calm focus—steps out of the lead white Hummer.

ON SCREEN: LAN YUE, SPECIAL OPERATIONS COMMANDER

LAN YUE, escorted by a squad of soldiers, strides toward the terminal.

INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - NIGHT

CHEN HAOTIAN in military officer uniform and LIN YE in a worn tweed jacket, surrounded by two discreet guards, walk through the empty corridor toward the center of the hall. LAN YUE approaches from the other end.

LAN YUE
(standing at attention, saluting)
General.

Behind her, soldiers snap to attention.

SOLDIERS (O.S.)
(sharp, unified)
Sir.

ON SCREEN: CHEN HAOTIAN, SUPREME COMMANDER
ON SCREEN: LIN YE, CHIEF EPIDEMIOLOGIST

LIN YE
(checking his watch)
The synthetic antigen. Status.

CHEN HAOTIAN
Commander?

LAN YUE
Central Special Department escort. Airspace locked. Twenty-three minutes.

LIN YE
(exhales)
Her liver can't process the natural strain. She's twelve.

CHEN HAOTIAN
(to Lan Yue)
Secondary protocols?

LAN YUE
Jiangning Central's isolation unit is prepped. Our medical team's scrubbing in.

CHEN HAOTIAN
(to Lin Ye)
Your work on the Northern Frontier Protocol saved forty thousand. We don't forget.

LAN YUE
Cargo's marked H-1. No inspection. No delay.

CHEN HAOTIAN
(quietly)
Doctor. This is what the nation owes you. Not charity. Debt.

CHEN HAOTIAN places his fist over his heart. LAN YUE and the soldiers follow suit.

CHEN HAOTIAN
Twenty minutes. The medicine arrives. Then we breathe.

LIN YE looks at them, nods once, turns and walks alone toward the depths of the empty corridor, his figure heavy but upright.

LAN YUE
(softly)
General. He hasn't slept in three days.

CHEN HAOTIAN
He's been fighting for thirty years. Let him walk.

title: Without Rebirth I Can Still Take Back Everything That Belongs to Me
description: A young woman endures abuse from her husband and mother-in-law, nearly driven to suicide—until a discovery forces her to fight for survival.
context:
Title: Without Rebirth I Can Still Take Back Everything That Belongs to Me
Description: A young woman endures abuse from her husband and mother-in-law, nearly driven to suicide—until a discovery forces her to fight for survival.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

LIU XINXIN, a young woman in casual home clothes, stands on a low stool with empty eyes, facing an open window.

LIU XINXIN (V.O.)
Rather than living like this, I might as well be dead.

A series of quick flashbacks:
QIN WEN pushes LIU XINXIN to the ground.
QIN WEN pins LIU XINXIN down on the bed.
XIA HUA slaps LIU XINXIN across the face.
XIA HUA steps on LIU XINXIN's hand as she lies on the ground.

XIA HUA (V.O.)
You're nothing but a dog of the Qin family!

Back to reality, LIU XINXIN stands by the window, tears streaming down her face.

LIU XINXIN
Mom... your daughter can't serve you anymore.

INT. STAIRCASE - DAY

Mother-in-law XIA HUA and husband QIN WEN watch coldly from outside the apartment door.

XIA HUA
She's actually going to jump. The little bitch found her courage.

QIN WEN
Qingming Festival is next week. One cemetery visit.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

LIU XINXIN is about to step forward when she hears a baby crying from the living room. Her whole body trembles.

LIU XINXIN
No... I can't die. If I die, what will happen to the baby?

She gets down from the stool, staggers, and collapses on the sofa as if awakening, gasping for air.
continuation:
INT. STAIRCASE - DAY

QIN WEN and XIA HUA see that LIU XINXIN hasn't jumped.

QIN WEN
Why isn't she jumping?

XIA HUA
The Shen Group heiress doesn't like loose ends.

QIN WEN checks his phone: "Shen Mansion Tomorrow 10PM."

Their footsteps CREAK toward the door.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

LIU XINXIN hears their voices through the door, her eyes filled with shock.

QIN WEN (O.S.)
—the Shen opportunity. Our chance to cross over. Xinxin must—

XIA HUA (O.S.)
—Make it look natural.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

SUPER: "Two Months Ago"

A DOCTOR runs hurriedly through the hospital corridor.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LIU XINXIN lies on a hospital bed, moaning in pain, about to give birth. QIN WEN holds her hand, pretending to comfort.

LIU XINXIN
Honey, I'm in so much pain.

QIN WEN
Don't worry, I'm here. Everything will be fine.

Doctor ZHANG XIAOLONG walks in holding a report.

ZHANG XIAOLONG
Abnormal fetal position, umbilical cord wrapped around the neck. Emergency surgery now.

Medical staff quickly wheel LIU XINXIN toward the operating room.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

LIU XINXIN lies on the operating table, the surgical lights on.

ANESTHESIOLOGIST
Blood pressure's dropping. I can't give her the full dose.

The doctor picks up the scalpel. LIU XINXIN suddenly screams in pain.

DOCTOR A
What's happening?

NURSE
She's feeling everything!

DOCTOR A
Do we stop?

ZHANG XIAOLONG
No time. Continue.

LIU XINXIN lets out a heart-wrenching scream.

NURSE A
For your baby. Hold on!

NURSE A stuffs a bite guard into LIU XINXIN's mouth. LIU XINXIN struggles and loses consciousness.

ZHANG XIAOLONG
Massive hemorrhage. I need consent for emergency hysterectomy.

NURSE B
The husband is signing now.

A NURSE carries the silent newborn and hurries away.

NURSE A
The baby isn't crying...

FADE OUT.

title: I Stopped Pretending - After Divorce I Inherited Billions
description: A billionaire heiress hides her identity as a delivery driver to support her husband, only to discover his betrayal on the day she plans to reveal the truth.
context:
Title: I Stopped Pretending - After Divorce I Inherited Billions
Description: A billionaire heiress hides her identity as a delivery driver to support her husband, only to discover his betrayal on the day she plans to reveal the truth.

EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

LING ZHI, in a yellow delivery vest and scuffed pink helmet, navigates her scooter through traffic. Her phone chimes.

PHONE VOICE (O.S.)
Priority order: Platinum Hotel, Suite 2201.

She checks her mirror - a black sedan shadows her. She signals, taking the next exit. The sedan follows.

She swerves into a service alley. The sedan stops at the entrance.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

LING ZHI reaches Suite 2201. She knocks.

LING ZHI
Delivery.

The door opens. LIN JIAHE, shirt untucked.

LIN JIAHE
Ling Zhi?
continuation:
Behind him: a woman's silk scarf on the desk. Red heels kicked off near the bed.

LING ZHI
(voice tight)
Your order.

She extends the bag. He hesitates.

MEI RAN (O.S.)
Jiahe, the shower's free.

LING ZHI
(barely audible)
You said... investors.

The bag slips from her fingers. She turns and walks away, steps measured.

INT. PARKING GARAGE - DAY

LING ZHI sits on her scooter. She pulls out her phone.

She texts FEMALE ASSISTANT: "Void the contract. All future dealings."

She blocks Lin Jiahe's number, then starts her scooter.

FADE OUT.

title: Not Recognizing the Moon in the Clouds
description: A former orphan who became a general's wife discovers her husband's betrayal with a woman presumed dead.
context:
Title: Not Recognizing the Moon in the Clouds
Description: A former orphan who became a general's wife discovers her husband's betrayal with a woman presumed dead.

EXT. GENERAL'S MANSION - DAY

A low-angle shot of a magnificent ancient mansion. A plaque reads "GENERAL'S MANSION." The lacquer on the characters has begun to fade at the edges.

INT. BATHING ROOM - DAY

SHEN SUYUE bathes in a steaming wooden tub, scrubbing at a faint scar on her forearm.

SHEN SUYUE (V.O.)
Charity house soap. Battlefield iron. Neither scent ever truly washes away.

FLASHBACK:

A ragged little girl (YOUNG SHEN SUYUE) huddles in a corner, protecting her face with scarred arms.

SHEN SUYUE (V.O.)
I learned early that softness invites bruises.

FLASHBACK:

The grown SHEN SUYUE wears dented armor, brawling desperately against a masked general (XIE YUN) in the mud. She lands one clean blow.

Back to the present, handmaidens dress SHEN SUYUE in magnificent robes. She touches a jade bracelet on her wrist—worn smooth from years of wear.

SHEN SUYUE (V.O.)
Then I found a name, a rank, a husband who built me a wheelchair with his own hands. I thought I'd finally earned a softness that wouldn't cut.

SHEN SUYUE smiles at the handmaidens, a gesture still slightly stiff.

SHEN SUYUE
You've all been patient with me.

She turns, attempting to walk. Her steps falter.

SHEN SUYUE
(calling out)
Ah Yun?

She stumbles forward. Strong hands catch her mid-fall.

XIE YUN
(O.S.)
I've got you.

XIE YUN rushes into the room, holding SHEN SUYUE against his chest. He lifts her effortlessly.

XIE YUN
(to the handmaidens)
Leave us.

The handmaidens bow and exit. Xie Yun carries her toward a divan, passing an exquisite wooden wheelchair.

XIE YUN
(gently reproaching)
The physician said the chair's wood needs rest too. It groans when you overwork it.

SHEN SUYUE
(playfully)
I was afraid you'd be waiting.

XIE YUN
Your father sent the Crane Divine Physician ahead of schedule. He's prepping the treatment room now.

SHEN SUYUE
It's been five years of needles. What difference will one early session make?

XIE YUN
Then I'll replace the chair's joints. And the ones in your steps. For as many years as it takes.

He settles her onto cushions. From his robe, he produces a hairpin—cranes in flight.

XIE YUN
I carved it while you slept.

He tucks it into her hair, fingers lingering.
continuation:
EXT. PAVILION - DAY

SHEN SUYUE sits in her wheelchair. Her handmaiden ZHU XUAN sorts lacquered boxes.

ZHU XUAN
Miss, the jade comb goes with the other birthday gifts?

SHEN SUYUE
The crane one. Yes.

ZHU XUAN
And Master Xie's letter from the capital?

SHEN SUYUE
Let me see it later. After treatment.

ZHU XUAN
The physician says you worry too much. That your body needs more time.

SHEN SUYUE touches her abdomen. A brief, shadowed gesture.

SHEN SUYUE
Time. Yes.

ZHU XUAN says nothing. Bows her head.

EXT. GARDEN - DAY

SHEN SUYUE wheels herself along a pebbled path. A bamboo grove rustles. Beyond it, the abandoned west courtyard—closed for "repairs" since her wedding.

Her wheelchair catches on loose stone. She bends to free the wheel when voices drift through the bamboo.

SHEN LUOYI (O.S.)
...said you wouldn't come until dusk.

SHEN SUYUE's hands go still.

XIE YUN (O.S.)
I found a way to slip the physician's notice.

Through the bamboo slats: XIE YUN embraces SHEN LUOYI, tight and desperate. The girl's face is hidden, but her voice carries clear.

SHEN LUOYI
Ah Yun, I can't stay in that room another day—

XIE YUN
Just until the new moon. Then I'll have the papers.

SHEN SUYUE's fingers grip the wheelchair rim. The jade bracelet snaps. A bead rolls into the grass.

She does not breathe. Does not blink. Only watches, her palm pressed hard against her mouth.

title: I Will Not Fail My Lovesickness, Nor You
description: A successful CEO encounters his ex-girlfriend who once left him for money, now working as an employee in his company, forcing him to confront their painful past.
context:
Title: I Will Not Fail My Lovesickness, Nor You
Description: A successful CEO encounters his ex-girlfriend who once left him for money, now working as an employee in his company, forcing him to confront their painful past.

INT. COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

A black Rolls-Royce glides to a stop at the entrance. The rear window lowers, revealing GU JINCHUAN's impassive profile.

ON SCREEN: GU JINCHUAN, CEO of Tomorrow Group

Through the windshield: EMPLOYEES stream through the lobby. Among them, CHEN QIANQIAN clutches a worn tote bag, her white trench coat too thin for the weather.

ON SCREEN: CHEN QIANQIAN, Single Mother

The car door opens. GU JINCHUAN emerges, his black overcoat sharp against the morning light. He strides toward the entrance, ASSISTANT LIN scrambling to keep pace.

The lobby stills. EMPLOYEES line the atrium, bowing in practiced unison.

EMPLOYEES
(in unison)
Good morning, President Gu.

GU JINCHUAN's gaze sweeps across them—then locks onto CHEN QIANQIAN. Her bow is deeper than the others, her knuckles white around the tote bag.

Their eyes meet. Her lips part in silent shock.

ASSISTANT LIN
(low, urgent)
President Gu—your 9 AM acquisition briefing—

FLASHBACK TO:
continuation:
EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Eight Years Ago

A rooftop scattered with vintage astronomy charts. Candles outline Cassiopeia. FRIENDS hold mismatched lanterns, their whispers eager.

FRIENDS
Say yes! Say yes!

Young GU JINCHUAN kneels, offering not roses but a hand-bound journal pressed with forget-me-nots.

GU JINCHUAN
Qianqian, every constellation I mapped this year, I named after you. Be my girlfriend.

CHEN QIANQIAN's fingers tremble as she accepts. GU JINCHUAN lifts her, spinning them through the candlelight.

EXT. HOSPITAL PARKING LOT - DAY

ON SCREEN: Six Years Ago

Rain slicks the asphalt. GU JINCHUAN stands in a damp shirt, facing CHEN QIANQIAN under the awning.

GU JINCHUAN
Break up? Qianqian, we've built everything together. The company just secured Series A—

CHEN QIANQIAN
(cutting him off)
Can you secure a bone marrow transplant for my mother? The deposit alone is eighty thousand. Your "everything" won't even cover her first week in ICU.

GU JINCHUAN
(desperately)
I can raise it. I'll mortgage everything. Just give me three days—

CHEN QIANQIAN
And then what? More debt, more "potential"? I have a degree I can't use and a mother who's dying. Your love doesn't pay medical bills.

A silver Mercedes pulls up. The DRIVER steps out, holding an umbrella.

DRIVER
Miss Chen? Mr. Wang is waiting.

CHEN QIANQIAN turns. Her voice drops.

CHEN QIANQIAN
I was pregnant, Jinchuan. I took care of it. Some futures you can't build on promises.

She walks away. GU JINCHUAN stands frozen, rainwater mixing with tears he won't let fall.

INT. COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

GU JINCHUAN looks at the woman before him—her trench coat fraying at the cuffs, her eyes hollowed by sleepless nights.

GU JINCHUAN (V.O.)
She burned our future to save her mother. And I became the man who could buy a thousand hospitals. Yet neither of us survived what she chose.

He starts to turn away. Stops. A muscle in his jaw tightens.

GU JINCHUAN
(to Assistant Lin, low)
Transfer her to the sixteenth floor. My secretarial pool.

He walks past her, close enough to smell her perfume—lavender, the same as eight years ago.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

Say yes! Say yes!

Young GU JINCHUAN kneels, offering not roses but a hand-bound journal pressed with forget-me-nots.

GU JINCHUAN
Qianqian, every constellation I mapped this year, I named after you. Be my girlfriend.

CHEN QIANQIAN's fingers tremble as she accepts. GU JINCHUAN lifts her, spinning them through the candlelight.

EXT. HOSPITAL PARKING LOT - DAY

ON SCREEN: Six Years Ago

Rain slicks the asphalt. GU JINCHUAN stands in a damp shirt, facing CHEN QIANQIAN under the awning.

GU JINCHUAN
Break up? Qianqian, we've built everything together. The company just secured Series A—

CHEN QIANQIAN
(cutting him off)
Can you secure a bone marrow transplant for my mother? The deposit alone is eighty thousand. Your "everything" won't even cover her first week in ICU.

GU JINCHUAN
(desperately)
I can raise it. I'll mortgage everything. Just give me three days—

CHEN QIANQIAN
And then what? More debt, more "potential"? I have a degree I can't use and a mother who's dying. Your love doesn't pay medical bills.

A silver Mercedes pulls up. The DRIVER steps out, holding an umbrella.

DRIVER
Miss Chen? Mr. Wang is waiting.

CHEN QIANQIAN turns. Her voice drops.

CHEN QIANQIAN
I was pregnant, Jinchuan. I took care of it. Some futures you can't build on promises.

She walks away. GU JINCHUAN stands frozen, rainwater mixing with tears he won't let fall.

INT. COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

GU JINCHUAN looks at the woman before him—her trench coat fraying at the cuffs, her eyes hollowed by sleepless nights.

GU JINCHUAN (V.O.)
She burned our future to save her mother. And I became the man who could buy a thousand hospitals. Yet neither of us survived what she chose.

He starts to turn away. Stops. A muscle in his jaw tightens.

GU JINCHUAN
(to Assistant Lin, low)
Transfer her to the sixteenth floor. My secretarial pool.

He walks past her, close enough to smell her perfume—lavender, the same as eight years ago.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Good Deeds Bring Good Rewards
description: A sanitation worker's lunch is ruined by an angry lottery player, but fate has a surprising twist in store when she discovers one of his discarded tickets.
context:
Title: Good Deeds Bring Good Rewards
Description: A sanitation worker's lunch is ruined by an angry lottery player, but fate has a surprising twist in store when she discovers one of his discarded tickets.

INT. STREET - DAY

A woman in an orange sanitation worker uniform (WENTAO'S MOM) sits on a street curb, unwrapping a modest lunch.

A middle-aged man (LOTTERY MAN) exits a lottery shop, crumpling lottery tickets with a defeated expression.

LOTTERY MAN, distracted, collides with WENTAO'S MOM, sending her lunch box to the ground.

WENTAO'S MOM
My lunch...

LOTTERY MAN
(mutters, walking past)
Should've moved.

LOTTERY MAN accidentally steps on the spilled food, not noticing. The crumpled tickets fall from his hand.

WENTAO'S MOM
(kneeling)
Sir, please—

She salvages what she can, then notices the discarded tickets. She smooths one out, curious.

RADIO (V.O.)
...winning numbers for this billion-dollar jackpot: red balls 10, 17, 19, 34, 35, blue balls 09, 11.

WENTAO'S MOM checks the ticket in her hand. The numbers align. She freezes, her face showing disbelief and sudden guilt.

INT. LOTTERY SHOP - DAY

WENTAO'S MOM rushes into the lottery shop with the ticket.

WENTAO'S MOM
(breathless)
Sir... these numbers...

The LOTTERY SHOP OWNER takes the ticket and checks it against his terminal.

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
(shocked, whispering)
Ma'am... this is the winner. You need to sign it. Call the lottery office—today.

WENTAO'S MOM
(quietly)
But the man who—

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
It's yours now. Go, before you change your mind.

WENTAO'S MOM takes back the ticket, tears welling up—relief, sorrow, and hope mixed together.

WENTAO'S MOM
(choked)
Son... Mom can help you now.
continuation:
INT. LUXURY APARTMENT ENTRANCE - DAY

WENTAO'S MOM, now wearing simple but clean clothes, carries bags of local specialties and knocks on a door.

The door opens. A fashionably dressed young woman (WANTING) opens it, her expression shifting from neutral to uncomfortable.

WANTING
Hi? Can I... help you?

WENTAO'S MOM
(smiling tentatively)
Wanting. It's me. I moved to the city to be closer.

A middle-aged woman (WANTING'S MOM) walks out from inside, mid-sip of coffee.

WANTING'S MOM
Oh. That smell... farm? Wentao's mother. You quit your job?

WENTAO'S MOM
Yes. I brought eggs, sweet potatoes—for nourishment.

WENTAO'S MOM lifts the bags, offering them.

WENTAO'S MOM
For you both.

WANTING hesitates, then pushes the basket away. Items scatter.

WANTING
We didn't ask for this. We're not a charity.

WANTING'S MOM
So much... rustic charm.

WANTING
My son and I are building a life. Are you trying to complicate it?

WANTING'S MOM
Don't be harsh. She came all this way.

WANTING
(over her shoulder)
Wentao? Come handle this.

A young man in an apron (WENTAO) emerges from the kitchen, surprised.

WENTAO
Mom? We talked about calling first.

WENTAO'S MOM
I have news. Good news.

WANTING'S MOM
(faux-solicitous)
She's brought gifts, Wentao. So generous.

WANTING
(quietly to Wentao)
If she's staying here, I'm leaving.

WENTAO'S MOM hears. Her smile fades, but she straightens as Wentao looks between his mother and his wife, caught in the tension.

title: A Long Song With You
description: The Master of Star Plucking Tower's assassination attempt on the Prince of Jing'an is thwarted by a jade pendant bearing a childhood memory, while a cunning strategist engineers his own rescue.
context:
Title: A Long Song With You
Description: The Master of Star Plucking Tower's assassination attempt on the Prince of Jing'an is thwarted by a jade pendant bearing a childhood memory, while a cunning strategist engineers his own rescue.

INT. STAR PLUCKING TOWER HEADQUARTERS - NIGHT

Inside a cavern lit by votive candles, crimson silk banners hang from above. The MASTER OF STAR PLUCKING TOWER, in plum robes and a silver fox mask, reclines on a lacquered couch.

A SUBORDINATE in black scale armor enters and kneels.

SUBORDINATE
Master, the Jing'an assassination unit has been eliminated.

The MASTER sits up, candlelight reflecting off his mask.

SUBORDINATE
The survivors' final report mentions the Longevity Manual. The Prince carries it.

The MASTER hurls his scroll case across the stone floor. He selects another from a rack, breaking its wax seal.

The scroll reads: Grade A Commission - Prince of Jing'an - Jiang Yan - 500,000 taels.

MASTER
(to the flame)
Five years chasing that manual. If Jiang Yan holds it...

EXT. QINGYANG MOUNTAIN PASS - DAY

The PRINCE OF JING'AN moves through a bamboo grove in cerulean scholar's robes, two GUARDS trailing. His gait is measured, a hand pressed to his ribs.

The MASTER descends silently from the canopy, his folding fan snapping open.

GUARDS
Protect the Prince!

The Master's fan becomes a blur. Both GUARDS crumple, struck at pressure points, disarmed but alive.

The PRINCE draws a thin sword, his stance betraying him—too rigid, compensating for weakness.

Their clash sends tremors through bamboo. The Prince parries twice before the Master's palm strike sends him staggering back.

The pendant swings free—a lotus-carved jade, weathered, split by a hairline crack.

The MASTER's breath catches. His own pendant, hidden beneath his robes, pulses warm against his skin.
continuation:
INT. MASTER'S MEMORY - FLASH

A young boy clutching the same broken pendant, pulled from a burning manor. A promise whispered: "Find your brother by this token."

EXT. QINGYANG MOUNTAIN PASS - DAY

The Master's fan freezes mid-strike.

PRINCE
(struggling for breath)
Finish it.

MASTER
(whisper)
...Brother?

He vanishes into the forest shadows.

GUARD 1
Fifth Prince! The Shadow Dragon talisman—it's reacting!

The PRINCE glances at his chest, where a hidden seal glows crimson.

PRINCE
The manual warns of assassins. We must move.

They limp away.

EXT. QINGYANG MOUNTAIN PASS - DUSK

Twilight settles over a wrecked carriage. Three BANDIT CORPSES lie facedown, neck wounds precise, professional.

A toppled sedan chair lies in the wreckage, red silk torn.

The PRINCE approaches, his GUARD drawing a blade.

GUARD 1
Scholarwood arrows. Military issue. Crimson Lotus bandits don't carry these.

He lifts the curtain. Inside: SU ZIYUAN, bound in wedding crimson, mud-stained, a gag soaked with blood. His eyes remain sharp.

The Guard cuts his bonds. Su Ziyuan rises, kneels, offers a proper bow despite the mud.

SU ZIYUAN
Su Ziyuan, third son of the Su household. My life is yours, noble sir.

PRINCE
Did the Crimson Lotus take you?

SU ZIYUAN
Their leader claims legitimacy through marriage. When I refused her... hospitality, she dispatched these men to deliver my corpse. I... persuaded them otherwise.

He gestures to the bodies, a grim smile playing on his lips.

PRINCE
We ride for the Martial Arts Convention. You're free to go.

SU ZIYUAN sways, his knees buckling. The Prince catches him, noting scholar's calluses on his palms.

SU ZIYUAN
(murmuring)
My retinue waits at White Dew Crossing, three li north. The head injury...

His eyes flutter closed.

A MAN in traveler's clothes bursts from the bamboo, crossbow raised.

ATTENDANT
Unhand him!

GUARD 1
We found him like this—Crimson Lotus work.

The Attendant's eyes scan the Prince's embroidered insignia, the precise wounds on the bandits, Su Ziyuan's limp form. His crossbow lowers.

ATTENDANT
My pardon. I tracked these bandits since dawn. When I saw the uniform...

He holsters the weapon, approaches Su Ziyuan with genuine worry.

ATTENDANT
Young Master needs warmth and wine. We lost our supplies.

The Prince studies Su Ziyuan's face—the too-steady breathing, the tension in his jaw.

PRINCE
(to Guard 1)
Prepare the spare palanquin. Send a scout to White Dew Crossing.

As they lift Su Ziyuan, the Attendant's fingers brush his sleeve—three rapid taps, a prearranged signal. Su Ziyuan's lips curl, barely perceptible.

They carry him toward the horses, the Prince's gaze lingering on the scholar's face, suspicion and curiosity warring.

title: Cherish Love in Our Youth Part 1
description: A desperate mother makes an impossible choice when faced with her daughter's life-threatening illness and the stark inequality of medical care.
context:
Title: Cherish Love in Our Youth Part 1
Description: A desperate mother makes an impossible choice when faced with her daughter's life-threatening illness and the stark inequality of medical care.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

LI FANG kneels on the linoleum floor, fingers clutched around a NURSE's polyester scrubs. Her husband SHI GUOQING stands beside her, rocking their sleeping infant. Fluorescent lights cast a sickly pallor over the scene.

LI FANG
(whispered, trembling)
Please. She's only three months old. The heart surgery—she won't survive without it.

NURSE
(detaching Li Fang's grip)
Ma'am, I understand. But the surgeon needs the deposit first. That's hospital policy.

SHI GUOQING
(stepping forward)
Then take it from me. Blood, bone marrow—whatever you need. I'll sign anything.

NURSE
(adjusting her clipboard)
We don't barter here. You need sixty thousand. Cash or transfer.

Down the corridor, a commotion. A NANNY in a starched uniform hurries ahead of an entourage, speaking into a phone. Behind her, ZHAO WANQIU glides forward in silk loungewear, an infant in her arms.

NANNY
(urgent, to phone)
—yes, Doctor Chen is meeting us personally. The private elevator.

The NURSE's demeanor shifts instantly. She smooths her hair and steps around Li Fang, who stumbles backward onto the floor.

DOCTOR CHEN emerges from double doors, stethoscope already in hand.

ZHAO WANQIU
(concerned)
Her temperature's been up three degrees. Should I be worried?

DOCTOR CHEN
(taking the baby gently)
Let's have a look, shall we? The pediatric suite is ready.

NANNY
(brusque)
Miss Zhao expects the full panel. No waiting.

DOCTOR CHEN
Of course. Right this way.

The group moves past. Li Fang scrambles to her feet, blocking the Nurse's path.

LI FANG
(quiet, dangerous)
Why does her baby get a suite while mine gets a waiting list?

NURSE
(over her shoulder, matter-of-fact)
Shi Group endows our cardiology wing. Their donations keep this hospital running. You? You haven't paid a cent.

The Nurse walks away. Shi Guoqing sinks to the floor. Li Fang stares after the retreating figures, her expression hardening into glass.

LI FANG (V.O.)
(soft, fractured)
Daughter... there are rules. And then there's survival.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

A private room. ZHAO WANQIU's daughter sleeps in a glass crib, an ID bracelet catching the light. Li Fang watches from the doorway, her own baby mewling softly against her chest.

ZHAO WANQIU
(to the Nanny, gathering her purse)
I'll be in the consultation room. Page me if Doctor Chen calls.

The Nanny settles into an armchair, already scrolling through her phone. Within minutes, her head nods forward.

Li Fang hovers at the threshold. She checks both wrists—identical pink bracelets, tiny fingers, dark hair. The babies could be sisters.

NURSE (V.O. FLASHBACK)
Their donations keep this hospital running... You haven't paid a cent.

Li Fang's hands tremble as she tests the crib latch. It opens silently. She glances at the Nanny—snoring softly now.

LI FANG
(to her daughter, barely breathing)
They'll save you now. They have to.

She lifts her baby into the crib. For a moment, her hands rest on two infants. Then she lifts the sleeping child of wealth and privilege, tucking her into a worn shawl.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Morning light filters through frosted windows. ZHAO WANQIU walks toward the ward, thumbing through lab results.

LI FANG approaches from the opposite direction, the shawl-wrapped baby held close. Her eyes stay fixed on the floor.

ZHAO WANQIU
(stepping aside, distracted)
—just need to check her bilirubin levels—

Their shoulders brush. Zhao Wanqiu frowns, turning back, but Li Fang is already disappearing around the corner. Zhao Wanqiu glances at the shawl—expensive cashmere—and relaxes, assuming it's a fellow patient.

She pushes open the ward door.

FADE OUT.

title: The Person Who Loved Me Most in the World is Dead
description: A woman's mother-in-law dies while her doctor husband chooses to save his first love instead, revealing a painful betrayal.
context:
Title: The Person Who Loved Me Most in the World is Dead
Description: A woman's mother-in-law dies while her doctor husband chooses to save his first love instead, revealing a painful betrayal.

INT. MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

Close-up of chrysanthemums and lit candles.

SHEN RONG (V.O.)
They say the cruelest questions come from love. But real life doesn't ask. It just watches while you drown.

The camera turns to the memorial hall, where a banner reads "In Loving Memory of Ms. Zhao Lan."

SHEN RONG (V.O.)
My mother-in-law died three days ago. Her son—my husband, the man who knows hearts better than anyone—was busy mending someone else's.

SHEN RONG, dressed in black, walks into the memorial hall with a controlled, hollow expression. She sees her husband ZHOU SHENGYU standing near the altar, his arm supporting a weeping YI XIAOWAN. He doesn't look up.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Text appears on screen: Five Days Ago.

Medical staff lift the MOTHER-IN-LAW from an ambulance and push her on a gurney toward the emergency room. SHEN RONG follows, gripping her phone.

NURSE
Dr. Zhou's the attending cardiothoracic surgeon on call. His expertise could make the difference. Have you reached him?

SHEN RONG
He's not answering. I've left three messages.

NURSE
Try again. Every minute counts.

(weakly, panicked)

continuation:
(to YI XIAOWAN, then protocol)

(blocking him)

(finally looking at Shen Rong)

SHEN RONG
(low, desperate)
She's your mother. She has you.

ZHOU SHENGYU
(quiet, awful certainty)

NURSE
Miss! We need consent for the procedure.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

The MOTHER-IN-LAW lies in bed, post-surgery, monitors beeping steadily. She's pale but lucid. SHEN RONG sits beside her.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Did he come?

SHEN RONG
Dr. Chen did. The surgery was... successful.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(small smile)
But my son didn't.

She takes SHEN RONG's hand, her grip surprisingly strong.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Rongrong, when I'm gone, don't let them bury me in the Zhou family plot. Don't give them the satisfaction of mourning properly. Cremate me, scatter me under the sunflowers in the west field. You know the ones—we planted them together last spring.

SHEN RONG
Mom, stop. You'll recover.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
No. But you will. You're stronger than all of us.

The MOTHER-IN-LAW's monitors begin to alarm—gradual, not crashing. Her breathing slows.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Thank you... for being the daughter I chose.

SHEN RONG
(sobbing, but steady)
Thank you for choosing me.

The MOTHER-IN-LAW's hand goes limp. The monitor's alarm becomes a single, endless tone. SHEN RONG doesn't scream. She just holds the cooling hand and stares at the door—still waiting.

title: Deep Spring in the Eastern Palace
description: At a royal banquet, a maidservant named Liu Ruyan becomes entangled with Crown Prince Li Chengjin after preventing her sister from drugging him, leading to a fateful night that changes her destiny.
context:
Title: Deep Spring in the Eastern Palace
Description: At a royal banquet, a maidservant named Liu Ruyan becomes entangled with Crown Prince Li Chengjin after preventing her sister from drugging him, leading to a fateful night that changes her destiny.

INT. BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

A grand banquet is in progress. Crown Prince LI CHENGJIN stands at the front.

CROWD (O.S.)
We wish the Crown Prince victory in advance. Let us drink the sacred deer blood together, and may it bless our great Sheng warriors with peace and prosperity.

LI CHENGJIN takes a cup of wine from a maidservant's tray.

LI CHENGJIN
To victory!

Veiled maidservant LIU RUYAN is preparing wine. Another woman, LIU RUXU, approaches her in a lady's fine veil—noble women serve at victory banquets.

LIU RUYAN
(whispering)
Elder sister, the aphrodisiac incense is forbidden.

LIU RUXU
(whispering)
He is the Crown Prince.

LIU RUYAN
(whispering)
I cannot let you.

LIU RUXU
Then I'll see you buried.

LIU RUXU walks toward LI CHENGJIN.

LIU RUXU
Liu Ruxu, legitimate daughter of the Prime Minister, also toasts Your Highness. I pray for Your Highness's victorious return.

LIU RUYAN follows behind carrying a tray with the drugged wine. LIU RUXU glares at her viciously.

LIU RUXU (V.O.)
She thinks to cross me? I'll have her ruined.

LIU RUYAN approaches LI CHENGJIN to pour wine and deliberately spills it on him.

LIU RUYAN
Ah!

The wine cup and pot fall and shatter. LIU RUXU is both shocked and furious.

LIU RUXU
(to LIU RUYAN)
Useless thing!

LIU RUYAN
(kneeling)
Crown Prince, forgive me!

LIU RUXU
(to LI CHENGJIN)
Your Highness, please don't blame her. This maidservant has always been clumsy. She has disturbed Your Highness.

LI CHENGJIN
No harm done. I shall go change my clothes.

LI CHENGJIN leaves. LIU RUXU slaps LIU RUYAN.

LIU RUXU
You can't even pour wine properly! A perfect opportunity to become Crown Princess, wasted by you!

LIU RUYAN
Since the Crown Prince didn't drink it...

LIU RUXU
Then you drink it!

LIU RUXU forces the remaining wine into LIU RUYAN's mouth, then throws her outside onto the ground. Two THUGS appear.

LIU RUXU
(to the thugs)
She's yours now.

THUGS
Yes.

LIU RUXU
A ruined woman, marrying that seventy-year-old Minister, is quite a fitting match.

LIU RUXU leaves with a cold laugh.
continuation:
EXT. PALACE GARDEN - NIGHT

LI CHENGJIN walks with a EUNUCH, looking unwell.

LI CHENGJIN
My chest feels unbearably hot.

EUNUCH
Perhaps it's the deer blood. This treasure always causes heat and restlessness. Shall this servant accompany you for a walk?

LI CHENGJIN
I will go clear my head from the wine. You go attend to matters ahead.

EUNUCH
Yes.

The EUNUCH leaves. LI CHENGJIN clutches his chest.

LIU RUYAN (O.S.)
Help!

LI CHENGJIN hears the cry for help and sees two THUGS assaulting LIU RUYAN.

LIU RUYAN (V.O.)
Better the unknown than her bargain.

LI CHENGJIN
By royal command--unhand her!

The thugs see his dragon insignia and flee.

LI CHENGJIN approaches the unconscious LIU RUYAN and picks her up.

INT. BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

LI CHENGJIN places LIU RUYAN on the bed. She awakens.

LIU RUYAN
Young Master, your fine clothing suggests you are a noble who can attend the palace banquet. I only beg you to save this humble woman from her suffering. I will repay you as an ox or horse, whatever it takes.

LI CHENGJIN (V.O.)
A beauty with iron in her spine...

LIU RUYAN
If you don't agree, Young Master, this humble woman has nowhere else to turn...

LIU RUYAN faints and slides off the bed. LI CHENGJIN catches her.

LI CHENGJIN
I will save you.

He places her back on the bed.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Your Highness, the Emperor urgently summons you back to the palace.

LI CHENGJIN takes out a jade pendant and places it in her hand.

LI CHENGJIN
With this token, no one will dare touch you. Wait for my return.

He leaves. The scene cuts to the exterior of the palace.

INT. BEDCHAMBER - DAY

LIU RUYAN wakes alone in the bed. She looks at the jade pendant.

LIU RUYAN
(to herself)
Young Master, when will you come to rescue me?

FLASHBACK: Fragments from last night.

LIU RUYAN
(to herself)
The wine was too strong. I can't even remember what he looked like.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

LIU RUYAN walks through a courtyard. LIU RUXU appears.

LIU RUXU
You slut! You dare to come back!

LIU RUXU slaps LIU RUYAN.

title: The Lottery Winner
description: A kind-hearted woman buys a lottery ticket and wins 1 billion yuan, only to discover a shocking betrayal when she returns home to celebrate.
context:
Title: The Lottery Winner
Description: A kind-hearted woman buys a lottery ticket and wins 1 billion yuan, only to discover a shocking betrayal when she returns home to celebrate.

INT. LOTTERY SHOP - DAY

The LOTTERY SHOP OWNER hands SISTER QIN a lottery ticket.

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
Here you go.

SISTER QIN
Thank you.

SISTER QIN takes the ticket and pulls out money from her wallet to pay.

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
Auntie, the draw is about to start. The jackpot is 1 billion yuan.

SISTER QIN
(laughing)
Just my Friday ritual. Someone has to win, right? Family's waiting.

SISTER QIN prepares to leave. Another young couple in the shop is looking at lottery tickets.

YOUNG MAN
Prize is insane. My dad's been playing thirty years—best he got was a free ticket.

YOUNG WOMAN
You never know.

YOUNG WOMAN
(looking at the TV)
It's starting.

SISTER QIN stops and turns back to look at the TV. The winning numbers are being announced on screen.

TV ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
The winning numbers are: 04, 13, 17, 19, 26, 29, 16.

SISTER QIN looks down at the lottery ticket in her hand. The numbers match one by one. Her expression changes from calm to dazed.

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
(quietly)
Someone's life just changed.

SISTER QIN
(whispering)
I think it's mine.

SISTER QIN doesn't answer. She clutches the lottery ticket and her wallet tightly, turns around, and walks out—controlled, almost too controlled.
continuation:
EXT. LOTTERY SHOP ENTRANCE - DAY

SISTER QIN walks out the door and leans against the wall, looking at her wallet with a trembling smile.

SISTER QIN (V.O.)
Eight hundred million. Hongjun's surgery, Hongwen's wedding. Maybe I can finally breathe again.

EXT. SEAFOOD MARKET - DAY

SISTER QIN arrives at a seafood stall.

SEAFOOD VENDOR
Oh, Sister Qin! This fish just died. I'll sell it to you cheap.

SISTER QIN
(beaming)
Live crabs today. Your best prawns. The works.

SEAFOOD VENDOR
(surprised)
Big celebration?

SISTER QIN
(smiling)
Thirty years of patience. Finally paid off.

INT. APARTMENT HALLWAY - DAY

SISTER QIN carries her shopping basket, humming a tune happily as she walks to her front door.

As she's about to open the door, she hears her husband's voice and a young woman's voice talking and laughing inside.

HUSBAND (O.S.)
She'll be at her sister's until eight. We have time.

MISTRESS (O.S.)
(laughing)
Good. Because next month, this is our apartment.

HUSBAND (O.S.)
Hahaha.

The smile on SISTER QIN's face freezes. She stands there, then carefully tucks the lottery ticket into her pocket.

title: After Winning the Lottery, My Son Cut Ties With Me (Episode 1)
description: A street cleaner's life changes when she wins a billion-dollar lottery, but her son and daughter-in-law don't know about her fortune yet.
context:
Title: After Winning the Lottery, My Son Cut Ties With Me (Episode 1)
Description: A street cleaner's life changes when she wins a billion-dollar lottery, but her son and daughter-in-law don't know about her fortune yet.

INT. STREET - DAY

WENTAO'S MOM (50s, weathered hands gripping a worn lunch pail) sits on a curb, shielding her food from dust.

A MIDDLE-AGED MAN stumbles out of a lottery shop, crumpling losing tickets with trembling fingers. He collides with her shoulder.

The impact sends her lunch pail clattering. Rice scatters across the pavement.

WENTAO'S MOM
(startled)
Oh—

MIDDLE-AGED MAN
(snarling)
Watch it, hag! You're bad luck incarnate!

He kicks the spilled rice, his frustration boiling over.

WENTAO'S MOM
(quietly)
Please, that's my dinner—

The man shoves past, sending her stumbling. Lottery tickets flutter from his pocket.

MIDDLE-AGED MAN
Then pick up your trash! Take those cursed tickets with you!

He stalks off. She steadies herself, then methodically retrieves the tickets along with a salvaged bun, tucking them into her uniform pocket.

A static-filled RADIO from a nearby shop crackles to life.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
...billion-dollar jackpot results. Red balls: 10, 17, 19, 34, 35. Blue: 09, 11.

She pulls out the tickets, her thumb tracing the numbers. Her breath catches.
continuation:
INT. LOTTERY SHOP - DAY

WENTAO'S MOM enters, smoothing her uniform. She slides one ticket across the counter.

WENTAO'S MOM
(softly)
Sir? I... think I should check this.

The LOTTERY SHOP OWNER (40s, skeptical) scans it. His eyes widen. He checks twice.

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
(whispering)
Ma'am... do you know what this is?

WENTAO'S MOM
(voice barely audible)
Is it... real?

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
One billion. It's real.

She leans against the counter, tears streaming silently.

WENTAO'S MOM
(to herself)
I can finally stop being his burden...

INT. APARTMENT DOOR - DAY

WENTAO'S MOM stands before a polished door, wearing her cleanest blouse. She clutches a cloth bag, knuckles white.

The door opens. WANTING (late 20s, immaculate, visibly pregnant) blinks.

WANTING
Guarded, sizing her up
Can I help you?

WENTAO'S MOM
(a hopeful smile)
Wanting, it's—

WANTING'S MOM (50s, sharp-eyed) appears behind her.

WANTING'S MOM
Oh. The smell of the countryside arrives.

WENTAO'S MOM
I... I left my job. Thought I'd be closer. Brought eggs, fresh from—

She extends the bag. Wanting flinches back.

WANTING
Eggs? Do you know what salmonella is? We eat organic.

WANTING'S MOM
(to Wanting, faux-kind)
She means well, dear. Probably wants to be your housemaid.

WANTING
(turning cold)
We're hiring professionals. Not charity cases.

WENTAO rushes to the door, tie loosened.

WENTAO
What's the commotion— Mom?

WENTAO'S MOM
(desperate)
Son, I just want to help with the baby—

WANTING
(eyes flashing)
Wentao, tell her. Tell her now, or I walk.

WENTAO
(trapped, voice cracking)
Mom... you can't just... show up like this.

The door closes. Wentao's Mom stands frozen, the bag slipping from her grasp.

WENTAO'S MOM
(startled)
Oh—

MIDDLE-AGED MAN
(snarling)
Watch it, hag! You're bad luck incarnate!

He kicks the spilled rice, his frustration boiling over.

WENTAO'S MOM
(quietly)
Please, that's my dinner—

The man shoves past, sending her stumbling. Lottery tickets flutter from his pocket.

MIDDLE-AGED MAN
Then pick up your trash! Take those cursed tickets with you!

He stalks off. She steadies herself, then methodically retrieves the tickets along with a salvaged bun, tucking them into her uniform pocket.

A static-filled RADIO from a nearby shop crackles to life.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
...billion-dollar jackpot results. Red balls: 10, 17, 19, 34, 35. Blue: 09, 11.

She pulls out the tickets, her thumb tracing the numbers. Her breath catches.

INT. LOTTERY SHOP - DAY

WENTAO'S MOM enters, smoothing her uniform. She slides one ticket across the counter.

WENTAO'S MOM
(softly)
Sir? I... think I should check this.

The LOTTERY SHOP OWNER (40s, skeptical) scans it. His eyes widen. He checks twice.

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
(whispering)
Ma'am... do you know what this is?

WENTAO'S MOM
(voice barely audible)
Is it... real?

LOTTERY SHOP OWNER
One billion. It's real.

She leans against the counter, tears streaming silently.

WENTAO'S MOM
(to herself)
I can finally stop being his burden...

INT. APARTMENT DOOR - DAY

WENTAO'S MOM stands before a polished door, wearing her cleanest blouse. She clutches a cloth bag, knuckles white.

The door opens. WANTING (late 20s, immaculate, visibly pregnant) blinks.

WANTING
Guarded, sizing her up
Can I help you?

WENTAO'S MOM
(a hopeful smile)
Wanting, it's—

WANTING'S MOM (50s, sharp-eyed) appears behind her.

WANTING'S MOM
Oh. The smell of the countryside arrives.

WENTAO'S MOM
I... I left my job. Thought I'd be closer. Brought eggs, fresh from—

She extends the bag. Wanting flinches back.

WANTING
Eggs? Do you know what salmonella is? We eat organic.

WANTING'S MOM
(to Wanting, faux-kind)
She means well, dear. Probably wants to be your housemaid.

WANTING
(turning cold)
We're hiring professionals. Not charity cases.

WENTAO rushes to the door, tie loosened.

WENTAO
What's the commotion— Mom?

WENTAO'S MOM
(desperate)
Son, I just want to help with the baby—

WANTING
(eyes flashing)
Wentao, tell her. Tell her now, or I walk.

WENTAO
(trapped, voice cracking)
Mom... you can't just... show up like this.

The door closes. Wentao's Mom stands frozen, the bag slipping from her grasp.

title: The Sales Champion's Layoff
description: A veteran employee's celebration of his third consecutive sales championship shatters when his name appears on the company's layoff list.
context:
Title: The Sales Champion's Layoff
Description: A veteran employee's celebration of his third consecutive sales championship shatters when his name appears on the company's layoff list.

INT. COMPANY CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

Fluorescent lights hum over a polished conference table. JIANG JIANGUO (52) sits with a quiet smile, polishing a small "SALES CHAMPION" trophy with his thumb. Nearby COLLEAGUES murmur appreciatively.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Third month in a row, Old Jiang? You're making us look bad.

JIANG JIANGUO
(soft laugh)
Just lucky.

MALE COLLEAGUE
Li's wallet is gonna feel this one.

BOSS LI raps his Montblanc pen on the table. The chatter dies.

BOSS LI
Monthly numbers. Excellent work.

His eyes scan the room, resting on Jiang for half a second too long.

BOSS LI
However. "Strategic optimization" requires... difficult decisions.

He nods to ASSISTANT WANG, who distributes single sheets—face down.

BOSS LI
Marked papers. HR after the meeting.

Jiang turns his sheet over. A RED LINE slashes through his name. The trophy slips—CLATTERS on the table.

JIANG JIANGUO
...what?

WHISPERS ripple. Colleagues stare at their clean sheets, then at Jiang.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
continuation:
(to herself)
No.

ANOTHER COLLEAGUE
(quiet)
Cost-cutting.

BOSS LI gathers his tablet.

BOSS LI
Meeting adjourned--

JIANG JIANGUO
Wait.

Boss Li pauses.

JIANG JIANGUO stands, holding the paper.

JIANG JIANGUO
My clients. Eight years I've built this.

BOSS LI
The company appreciates that. But we need "fresh energy" in market development.

JIANG JIANGUO
Fresh energy.

He touches the trophy on the table.

JIANG JIANGUO
So the twelve-hour days. The clients who call me at midnight. That's just... outdated?

BOSS LI
Don't make this difficult. Be a team player.

Jiang's jaw tightens. He picks up the trophy. SLAMS it down.

CRYSTAL SHATTERS. A woman GASPS. Silence.

Jiang stares at his hand. Blood wells from a deep cut. He looks at Boss Li, breathing hard, the broken trophy glittering between them.

title: Episode One
description: A masked fighter faces defeat on a rooftop, his final thoughts revealing the hidden martial art of medical acupuncture. A reflection on the Five Schools of Chinese Medicine explains his lineage, while a flashback shows his reluctant apprenticeship under a drunken master.
context:
Title: Episode One
Description: A masked fighter faces defeat on a rooftop, his final thoughts revealing the hidden martial art of medical acupuncture. A reflection on the Five Schools of Chinese Medicine explains his lineage, while a flashback shows his reluctant apprenticeship under a drunken master.

INT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

Intense battle music plays.

A WOMAN IN BLACK, wearing a tight leather outfit, fights fiercely with a MASKED MAN. Her strikes target precise meridian points.

The two exchange blows—her attacks like needles seeking acupoints, his movements flowing with defensive grace.

After a fierce exchange, the MASKED MAN (HUANG ERYU) clutches his numb arm and stumbles back.

HUANG ERYU (V.O.)
Seventeen years of piercing radishes... and I still can't match the Needle School's precision.

The WOMAN IN BLACK drives her fingers into his chest like a needle. He collapses.

HUANG ERYU (V.O.)
Father said healing and killing share the same pressure points. I chose to heal.

HUANG ERYU lies on the ground, his trembling hands—the hands of a healer—unable to rise.

FADE TO BLACK.
continuation:
INT. STUDY/ARCHIVAL FOOTAGE - DAY

Ancient background music, muted.

The screen shows yellowed medical scrolls—the Compendium of Materia Medica, Meridian Atlas.

HUANG ERYU (V.O.)
The Five Great Schools of Chinese Medicine. The Needle School kills with precision. The Herbal School... that was ours.

Images of herbs and grinding tools appear.

HUANG ERYU (V.O.)
While others chased power or immortality, the Huang lineage swore one oath: knowledge is for healing only. Father broke that oath once. I'm paying for it.

On screen: a family tree—every Huang name crossed out, except one.

FADE TO BLACK.

EXT. DILAPIDATED COURTYARD - NIGHT

A middle-aged man (FATHER), drunk, leans against a wall, watching a boy practice.

At the table, YOUNG HUANG ERYU (12) threads a silver needle, hands steady as he pierces a radish marked with meridian lines.

FATHER
(singing, slurred)
Needles can kill, can save...

YOUNG HUANG ERYU (V.O.)
He's made me pierce everything—fish, shrimp, radishes. I thought it was just drunken nonsense.

FATHER
(quieter, to himself)
Your grandfather learned that too late.

YOUNG HUANG ERYU's jaw tightens—resentment warring with devotion as he continues his practice.

YOUNG HUANG ERYU (V.O.)
I didn't know he was trying to keep me alive.

title: Biological Daughter Xia Tian vs Adopted Daughter Yin Hong
description: A story of jealousy and resentment between a biological daughter and an adopted daughter in rural China, as one gets the chance to return to the city while the other is left behind.
context:
Title: Biological Daughter Xia Tian vs Adopted Daughter Yin Hong
Description: A story of jealousy and resentment between a biological daughter and an adopted daughter in rural China, as one gets the chance to return to the city while the other is left behind.

INT. PEACH ORCHARD - DAY

Sunlight filters through the leaves.

XIA TIAN stands on a simple wooden ladder, wearing a white dress, happily picking peaches.

Adopted daughter YIN HONG, wearing a red floral shirt, stands below the ladder, looking up at XIA TIAN.

XIA TIAN
Yin Hong, we'll have peaches to eat with Mom tonight.

YIN HONG
Sister Xia Tian, there are a few more peaches over there.

XIA TIAN turns to reach for the peaches farther away. YIN HONG watches her back, her envy gradually turning to jealousy. Her hand grips the ladder leg.

The ladder wobbles. XIA TIAN screams and falls from the ladder. Peaches roll everywhere.

XIA TIAN
Ah!

YIN HONG runs forward and helps XIA TIAN up. XIA TIAN's knee is scraped, blood flowing.

YIN HONG
Sister Xia Tian, are you okay? I lost my grip.

XIA TIAN
(enduring the pain)
Just a scrape, it's fine.

YIN HONG
(staring at the wound)
Falling from that height and not breaking your leg. You're lucky.

THREE DAYS LATER
continuation:
INT. SIMPLE HOUSE - NIGHT

A table is set with a few simple dishes and a cake with "Happy Birthday" written on it, with a single candle on top.

TEACHER MENG helps XIA TIAN, whose knee is bandaged, sit at the table. YIN HONG is already seated there.

XIA TIAN
Wow!

TEACHER MENG
Make a wish.

XIA TIAN and YIN HONG both close their eyes and clasp their hands together to make wishes.

XIA TIAN (V.O.)
I hope we can always be together.

YIN HONG (V.O.)
I hope she never leaves this place.

After making wishes, everyone prepares to eat.

TEACHER MENG
(to YIN HONG)
Yin Hong, actually there's something...

XIA TIAN
(interrupting)
Mom, we're going back to the city tomorrow night. Village Chief Uncle said the bus will wait for us at the east end of the village at seven tomorrow night. When should we pack our luggage?

YIN HONG
(turning to XIA TIAN, quiet)
You're leaving... together?

TEACHER MENG looks troubled and remains silent.

XIA TIAN
(pulling TEACHER MENG's hand, anxiously)
Teacher Meng, please take her with us.

TEACHER MENG
(stroking YIN HONG's shoulder, with difficulty)
Yin Hong, the work assignment only covers biological children. If anyone finds a discrepancy, none of us can leave.

TEACHER MENG
(guiltily)
Yin Hong, I'm sorry. When the roster was made, only Xia Tian's name was listed.

XIA TIAN
(angrily)
If Sister Yin Hong isn't going, then I'm not going either!

TEACHER MENG
Let's do this: we'll go back to the city and get settled first, then we'll find a way to bring Yin Hong back, okay?

XIA TIAN
(with tears)
Then we have to bring Sister Yin Hong back before autumn, okay?

TEACHER MENG hugs XIA TIAN to comfort her. YIN HONG sits to the side, watching them with cold eyes.

YIN HONG (V.O.)
It's all because of you. If it weren't for you, I could go to the city with Teacher Meng and live a good life.

title: After Three Years as a Slave, My Beloved Stepbrother Begs for Forgiveness
description: A young woman's forbidden love for her stepbrother is exposed, leading to her punishment and exile to the military camp.
context:
Title: After Three Years as a Slave, My Beloved Stepbrother Begs for Forgiveness
Description: A young woman's forbidden love for her stepbrother is exposed, leading to her punishment and exile to the military camp.

INT. MARQUIS RESIDENCE GREAT HALL - DAY

Inside the great hall, MARQUIS XIE, MADAM XIE, SHEN CHANGLI, GU FEIYAN and retainers sit in judgment. XIE QINGNING kneels center floor.

MADAM XIE
I ask once. Do you have feelings for your elder brother?

XIE QINGNING raises her head—defiance battling shame.

XIE QINGNING
(quietly)
I do.

Shen Changli's knuckles whiten on his teacup. He does not look at her.

INT. MARQUIS RESIDENCE GREAT HALL - DAY (FLASHBACK - THREE DAYS PRIOR)

Shen Changli stands in the same hall, silk handkerchief clutched in his fist. Mandarin ducks swim across the fabric.

SHEN CHANGLI
(soft rage)
Mandarin ducks on personal silk. Your name beside mine.

XIE QINGNING
A girl's foolish embroidery. What does it prove?

MARQUIS XIE
The scandal already reaches the capital. My peers whisper.

SHEN CHANGLI
Do you comprehend what you've done to me?

GU FEIYAN coughs delicately, drawing all eyes.

GU FEIYAN
If only a handkerchief, why summon the household?
(to the doorway)
Bring the box.

A MAID enters bearing a lacquer box filled with letters.

MARQUIS XIE
What is this?

MAID
The young miss's correspondence to the General.

GU FEIYAN lifts a letter, scanning it. A small, satisfied smile plays at her lips.

GU FEIYAN
continuation:
Every line drips with longing. Not sisterly affection—something that makes poets blush.

Shen Changli's teacup shatters against the floor. Letters scatter like leaves.

SHEN CHANGLI
You quote sages at breakfast and write this filth by candlelight?

MADAM XIE
(rising, trembling)
Your brother bleeds for the empire, and you dream of him in your bed?

XIE QINGNING
He is adopted. No blood binds us.

MADAM XIE
Rebellious wretch! We indulged your books for this?

SHEN CHANGLI's hand twitches toward his sword hilt. He masters himself.

GU FEIYAN
She is young. Sheltered. The inner chambers breed confusion.

MADAM XIE
She tried to poison you!

XIE QINGNING wheels on Gu Feiyan, betrayal burning in her eyes.

XIE QINGNING
I confided in you. You swore secrecy.

GU FEIYAN
Promises mean nothing when honor is at stake.

SHEN CHANGLI crosses the distance in three strides. His palm cracks across Xie Qingning's cheek. She sprawls across the scattered letters.

XIE QINGNING
(whisper)
You struck me.

SHEN CHANGLI
(cold)
Better my hand than the executioner's.

MARQUIS XIE strokes his beard, eyes calculating.

MARQUIS XIE
The northern camp needs healing hands. And discipline.

SHEN CHANGLI
(nodding)
The physician there owes me a favor. He will teach her propriety through service.

XIE QINGNING looks at SHEN CHANGLI, the word "service" sinking like a stone.

title: Report Me for Selling Fake Medicine, Now You Cry When I Won't Sell
description: A traditional Chinese medicine practitioner saves a woman at an accident scene after Western doctors declare her dead, proving the power of ancient remedies.
context:
Title: Report Me for Selling Fake Medicine, Now You Cry When I Won't Sell
Description: A traditional Chinese medicine practitioner saves a woman at an accident scene after Western doctors declare her dead, proving the power of ancient remedies.

EXT. CITY ROAD - DAY

CHEN XIAO (40s, weathered hands gripping handlebars tightly) rides an electric scooter. His daughter CHEN XIAOTONG (8, clutching a worn pink piggy bank) sits behind him. A faded "TCM Practitioner" bag hangs from the handlebars - a newspaper clipping inside reads "License Revoked Pending Investigation."

SOUND: Ambulance siren wails in the distance.

An ambulance rushes past, splashing through puddles.

CHEN XIAOTONG
Dad, look. Should we help?

CHEN XIAO
(flinching)
Doctors are already there. Your medicine's getting cold.

CHEN XIAOTONG
But you always say we can't turn away.

She touches his shoulder. Chen Xiao's jaw tightens—he's thinking of the courtroom, the accusations. The scooter slows.

EXT. CAR ACCIDENT SCENE - CONTINUOUS

A three-car pileup. LUO MENG (30s, blue business suit) lies on asphalt, shallow breath misting in cold air. Paramedics work frantically.

CHEN XIAO hangs back at the crowd's edge, his daughter pulling his sleeve.

CHEN XIAOTONG
Please. Just look.

AN OLD DOCTOR (60s, stethoscope around neck) checks LUO MENG's vitals. Younger paramedics exchange grim looks.

OLD DOCTOR
(to his team)
No pulse. Pupils fixed. Prep the sheet.

A PARAMEDIC reaches for a white cloth.

ONLOOKER A
She's so young.

ONLOOKER B
Nothing more they can do.

CHEN XIAO
(quietly)
Wait.

OLD DOCTOR
(turning)
Who said that?

CHEN XIAO pushes forward, Xiaotong behind him.

CHEN XIAO
She's in suspended animation. Not death.

YOUNG DOCTOR (O.S.)
(stepping into view)
You can't be serious. Master Li has forty years' experience.

CHEN XIAOTONG
My dad saved three people last month.

YOUNG DOCTOR

Silence. Only traffic hum.

He stands, takes Xiaotong's hand. Turns.

YOUNG DOCTOR

LUO MENG's hand spasms. She gasps—a wet, ragged inhale. Coughs violently.

ONLOOKER B

OLD DOCTOR

YOUNG DOCTOR

CHEN XIAO
(touching the newspaper clipping)
Probably not.

They merge into pedestrian flow. Behind them, the Young Doctor pulls out his phone—record function on.

YOUNG DOCTOR
(to Old Doctor)
We need to study this.

The Old Doctor watches Chen Xiao disappear, thoughtful.

title: The Unstoppable Young Lady
description: A wealthy heiress and her father are drugged during a celebration, victims of a betrayal orchestrated by those closest to them.
context:
Title: The Unstoppable Young Lady
Description: A wealthy heiress and her father are drugged during a celebration, victims of a betrayal orchestrated by those closest to them.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Inside a brightly lit KTV private room, a group of people sit around a table in a lively atmosphere.

JIANG MINGYE
To empires that outlive their emperors.

YU KEWEI
And to the heirs who deserve them.

Everyone raises their glasses and drinks them down in one gulp. Subtitles introduce the characters: JIANG MINGYE, General Manager of Hao Group; YU KEWEI, Chairman of Hao Group.

JIANG MINGYE
(to YU KEWEI, envy barely masked)
Chairman Yu, your daughter's already signed three acquisition deals this quarter. Some of us took twenty years.

The camera turns to YU KEWEI's wife GU MIAOMIAO and daughter YU XINGCHEN beside him. Subtitles introduce: GU MIAOMIAO, YU KEWEI's wife; YU XINGCHEN, heiress of Hao Group.

YU XINGCHEN
Meeting minutes don't show the votes you influenced, Uncle Jiang. Just the outcome.

YU KEWEI and GU MIAOMIAO both show proud smiles—his genuine, hers brittle.

JIANG MINGYE
(raising his glass again)
Then let's toast to... outcomes.
continuation:
YU KEWEI
Come.

YU XINGCHEN
(examining her glass)
New vintage?

GU MIAOMIAO
A special reserve. For family.

JIANG MINGYE
Mrs. Yu is so considerate.

The four clink glasses and drink them down in one gulp.

FLASHBACK:

GU MIAOMIAO's hand holds a small bottle, dripping liquid from it into two specific glasses, marked by lipstick prints.

BACK TO REALITY.

After drinking, YU KEWEI and YU XINGCHEN suddenly feel dizzy, their expressions pained, then both collapse onto the table, unconscious.

JIANG MINGYE watches all this with a smile on his face.

GU MIAOMIAO gives JIANG MINGYE a meaningful smile.

Under the table, GU MIAOMIAO's foot in high heels gently steps on JIANG MINGYE's shoe.

A triumphant smile curves at the corner of JIANG MINGYE's mouth.
