title: The Poisonous Concubine's Daughter
description: A concubine's daughter is forced by her stepmother to become a servant in the Prince's mansion to secure her legitimate sister's position, while her mother and brother are held hostage.
context:
Title: The Poisonous Concubine's Daughter
Description: A concubine's daughter is forced by her stepmother to become a servant in the Prince's mansion to secure her legitimate sister's position, while her mother and brother are held hostage.

EXT. REAR COURTYARD OF MARQUIS QI'S MANSION - DAY

Heavy rain pours down, turning the courtyard to mud.

MADAM JIANG crosses the stone path with SERVANTS, her silk shoes untouched.

MADAM JIANG
Yun Niang. You always did have poor timing.

The servants seize YUN NIANG. She falls to her knees, pulling JIANG JINXIN into the mire.

YUN NIANG
Madam, I only begged for my son's medicine...

MADAM JIANG
(icy smile)
And I've brought you a permanent solution. Servants—make her grateful.

A wooden club strikes YUN NIANG's back.

JIANG JINXIN
Mother!

JIANG JINXIN crawls to MADAM JIANG's feet.

JIANG JINXIN
Madam, please! She'll die!

MADAM JIANG crouches, fingers biting into Jinxin's jaw.

MADAM JIANG
Your sister's confinement approaches. Prince Rui requires a particular companion—someone familiar with our family's...delicate arts. You defy me, and your mother's bloodline ends in this courtyard. Starting with that feverish son.

Servants drag out the young brother, limp with illness.

JIANG JINXIN
(strangled)
He's a child!

MADAM JIANG
Fever doesn't discriminate.

JIANG TIANCHENG (O.S.)
Enough theater.

MARQUIS QI YUAN, JIANG TIANCHENG, appears under an oil-paper umbrella, court documents in hand.

MADAM JIANG
continuation:
My lord. Instructions were nearly complete.

JIANG JINXIN
Father—
(her voice cracks)
They send me to Prince Rui's mansion. As my sister's maidservant.

JIANG TIANCHENG
The Prince's request specified a woman skilled in herbal arts. Your mother's teaching becomes your dowry to this family.
(He glances at Yun Niang)
Consider it gratitude for her instruction.

MADAM JIANG
The Prince's heir secures our position. You understand obligation.

JIANG TIANCHENG
Your brother receives the physician. Your mother receives quarters. While you serve.

JIANG JINXIN searches her father's face. Finds only the marquis.

JIANG JINXIN
And if I...displease?

MADAM JIANG
Then physicians forget. Quarters become cells.

Rain hammers down. JIANG JINXIN's fingers brush her mother's bloodied hand. Their hands twine for one heartbeat.

JIANG JINXIN
(raising her head)
I am honored to serve my sister's interests.

JIANG TIANCHENG
Lock Yun Niang and the boy away. We'll revisit their situation after Jinxin enters service.

JIANG TIANCHENG turns. Servants drag YUN NIANG and the brother away.

MADAM JIANG grips Jinxin's chin once more.

MADAM JIANG
Remember—inappropriate ideas cost more than your life. They cost his.

MADAM JIANG
Let's go!

MADAM JIANG departs. JIANG JINXIN remains kneeling in the rain.

JIANG JINXIN (V.O.)
(internal monologue, eyes becoming resolute)
You believe chains make a servant. I know they forge a weapon.

JIANG JINXIN lifts her head, her quiet hatred measured and infinitely more dangerous.

title: Sweet Little Village Wife
description: A CEO is abandoned in a rural village by his assistant on his father's orders, where he encounters a young woman being mistreated by her ex-boyfriend.
context:
Title: Sweet Little Village Wife
Description: A CEO is abandoned in a rural village by his assistant on his father's orders, where he encounters a young woman being mistreated by her ex-boyfriend.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

A black sedan navigates potholes on a rural highway, flanked by lush green rice paddies. The car jerks violently.

INT. SEDAN - DAY

XIAO YI, CEO of Xiao Corporation, mid-30s, wearing a rumpled suit, jolts awake. Dark circles under his eyes. Coffee stains his shirt cuff. He checks his watch, then his phone—no signal.

XIAO YI
(quietly)
We should've been at the Imperial Hotel two hours ago. Ake, where are we?

The driver, AKE, 40s, grizzled hands on the wheel, avoids the rearview mirror. His knuckles are white.

AKE
Mr. Xiao... your father called again this morning.

XIAO YI
(rubbing his temples)
The Bai family merger. I told him—no marriage meetings during the quarterly reviews.

AKE
Chairman's consolidating his holdings. He said... he said if you won't consider Miss Bai seriously, you're to spend time in Xu Family Village. Without corporate resources.

The car hits another pothole. XIAO YI's coffee cup tips. He catches it, but hot liquid splashes his shirt.

XIAO YI
(ice in his voice)
You diverted my car. Based on a threat.

AKE
I have a daughter starting university. The Chairman's been... generous with the staff investment program.

A long beat. XIAO YI looks out at the endless fields.

XIAO YI
Pull over.
continuation:
EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The sedan stops. AKE pops the trunk, removes a duffel bag.

AKE
I keep spare clothes for village visits. Fresher uniform than that stained suit.

From the bag: a simple button-down shirt, work pants, sturdy boots. Practical. Not a uniform.

XIAO YI
(taking the clothes)
You're not coming back.

AKE
Chairman's tracking the car GPS. I need to drive around two hours. Then... I don't know.

XIAO YI studies his assistant—ten years of loyalty, now this.

XIAO YI
Make sure your daughter gets her tuition.

AKE nods, throat tight. XIAO YI changes beside the car, methodical. The CEO disappears; a regular man remains.

XIAO YI
When my father asks—tell him I said the Bai family bleeds companies dry. I'd dissolve Xiao Corp before merging with parasites.

AKE
He won't listen.

XIAO YI
Then he'll learn what happens when you corner someone.

AKE gets in the car. The engine starts. XIAO YI turns away, not watching it leave.

The car reverses, turns, and speeds back the way it came. Dust settles.

XIAO YI stands alone. He checks his pockets—wallet, dead phone, keys to apartments and offices that mean nothing here. He begins walking.

A worn stone marker: "Xu Family Village - 3 Li."

XIAO YI (V.O.)
Xu Family Village. Mother's hometown. Before grandfather disowned her.

In the distance: voices. A man's slurred shouting. A woman's sharp retort. XIAO YI's head lifts. He changes direction toward the sound.

EXT. XU FAMILY VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

Village youth XU SHENG, 20s, blocks LIU MINGZHU's path. He reeks of cheap alcohol. She's steady, holding a canvas grocery bag.

XU SHENG
Two nights at Er Niu's place. Nothing happened. You're being dramatic.

LIU MINGZHU
Step aside. We're done.

XU SHENG
(venom building)
Done? Your grandma's medical bills last month—who helped? You think some stranger's gonna—

XIAO YI (O.S.)
Is there a problem here?

XIAO YI appears from around the corner. He doesn't approach directly. He leans against a tree, casual but present. His gaze settles on Xu Sheng.

XU SHENG
(challenging)
Mind your business, outsider.

LIU MINGZHU
(quietly fierce)
I paid back every cent you lent me. With interest. Now get out of my way.

She steps forward. Xu Sheng grabs her wrist. The grocery bag falls—apples roll in the dirt.

XIAO YI
(repeating, softer)
I said. Is there a problem?

Xiao Yi straightens. The tree no longer supports him. He is very still.

title: Rural Teacher Sweeps the World & Run, Teacher
description: A renowned professor who saved Earth from an asteroid chooses to return to rural teaching, leaving behind his powerful students who wish to honor him.
context:
Title: Rural Teacher Sweeps the World & Run, Teacher
Description: A renowned professor who saved Earth from an asteroid chooses to return to rural teaching, leaving behind his powerful students who wish to honor him.

INT. SPACE COMMAND CENTER - DAY

Space. Thousands of meteors hurtle toward Earth.

A hand operates frantically at a control panel.

PROFESSOR WANG JIANGUO, white coat and glasses, watches the screen in shock.

A rocket launches from the ground, flying into space.

Missiles intercept the meteorites. Violent explosions. White light fills the screen.

The command center's large screen displays the explosion footage.

Inside the command center, all the RESEARCHERS burst into enthusiastic cheers.

WANG JIANGUO
We did it.

ASSISTANT
(excitedly)
All fragments destroyed. Blue Star is safe.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(applauding)
You did it, Wang. You actually did it.

WANG JIANGUO
(smiling with relief)
Saved. It's saved.

The command center door opens. DRAGON GOD, PHOENIX, and CANGHAI walk in with powerful presence.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Master of the Northern Territory's Dragon Warriors, Dragon God. Blue Star's business tycoon, Phoenix. President of the Four Seas Canglang Group, Canghai. All his students.

DRAGON GOD, PHOENIX, and CANGHAI walk up to WANG JIANGUO and kneel on one knee in unison, clasping their fists in salute.

DRAGON GOD
Teacher. You preserved our world.

DRAGON GOD, PHOENIX, CANGHAI
(in unison)
Let us honor you.
continuation:
WANG JIANGUO
(laughing, helping them up)
Rise, please. Your intention means everything. But Teacher is returning to the countryside.

PHOENIX
(urgently)
You've earned every honor. Don't exhaust yourself further.

WANG JIANGUO
I need to teach.

DRAGON GOD
You gave eight years to this. Rest.

ASSISTANT
Yes.

WANG JIANGUO
(sighing)
Eight years.

WANG JIANGUO picks up a photo of himself and his wife from the desk, falling into memory.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - 8 YEARS AGO

Young WANG JIANGUO paces anxiously outside the delivery room. His WIFE'S painful cries come from inside.

WANG JIANGUO
(praying with hands clasped)
Please. Let them both be safe.

Several ASSISTANTS rush over.

ASSISTANT
(out of breath)
Professor Wang—Pluto's orbit is destabilizing. Moving toward us. Eight years.

WANG JIANGUO
At that time...

ASSISTANT

full_script:
Title: Rural Teacher Sweeps the World & Run, Teacher
Description: A renowned professor who saved Earth from an asteroid chooses to return to rural teaching, leaving behind his powerful students who wish to honor him.

INT. SPACE COMMAND CENTER - DAY

Space. Thousands of meteors hurtle toward Earth.

A hand operates frantically at a control panel.

PROFESSOR WANG JIANGUO, white coat and glasses, watches the screen in shock.

A rocket launches from the ground, flying into space.

Missiles intercept the meteorites. Violent explosions. White light fills the screen.

The command center's large screen displays the explosion footage.

Inside the command center, all the RESEARCHERS burst into enthusiastic cheers.

WANG JIANGUO
We did it.

ASSISTANT
(excitedly)
All fragments destroyed. Blue Star is safe.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(applauding)
You did it, Wang. You actually did it.

WANG JIANGUO
(smiling with relief)
Saved. It's saved.

The command center door opens. DRAGON GOD, PHOENIX, and CANGHAI walk in with powerful presence.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Master of the Northern Territory's Dragon Warriors, Dragon God. Blue Star's business tycoon, Phoenix. President of the Four Seas Canglang Group, Canghai. All his students.

DRAGON GOD, PHOENIX, and CANGHAI walk up to WANG JIANGUO and kneel on one knee in unison, clasping their fists in salute.

DRAGON GOD
Teacher. You preserved our world.

DRAGON GOD, PHOENIX, CANGHAI
(in unison)
Let us honor you.

WANG JIANGUO
(laughing, helping them up)
Rise, please. Your intention means everything. But Teacher is returning to the countryside.

PHOENIX
(urgently)
You've earned every honor. Don't exhaust yourself further.

WANG JIANGUO
I need to teach.

DRAGON GOD
You gave eight years to this. Rest.

ASSISTANT
Yes.

WANG JIANGUO
(sighing)
Eight years.

WANG JIANGUO picks up a photo of himself and his wife from the desk, falling into memory.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - 8 YEARS AGO

Young WANG JIANGUO paces anxiously outside the delivery room. His WIFE'S painful cries come from inside.

WANG JIANGUO
(praying with hands clasped)
Please. Let them both be safe.

Several ASSISTANTS rush over.

ASSISTANT
(out of breath)
Professor Wang—Pluto's orbit is destabilizing. Moving toward us. Eight years.

WANG JIANGUO
At that time...

ASSISTANT
Blue Star will perish.

WANG JIANGUO
(shocked)
What?

WANG JIANGUO adjusts his glasses, his eyes filled with disbelief and gravity.

title: Super Wheat
description: Agricultural scientist Lin Weimin returns home after twenty years of secret research on super wheat that could revolutionize food security for the nation.
context:
Title: Super Wheat
Description: Agricultural scientist Lin Weimin returns home after twenty years of secret research on super wheat that could revolutionize food security for the nation.

INT. STATE LABORATORY - DAY

A pristine, high-security research facility. LIN WEIMIN (50s, weathered hands, eyes focused) examines wheat specimens under a microscope. His worn jacket hangs beside a photo of a wheat field—faded, from another era.

CHEN CHENG (20s, ambitious assistant) bursts through the airlock doors, tablet in hand, trying to maintain composure.

CHEN CHENG
Professor Lin! The Gobi test fields just reported in.

(pause)
Double the standard yield. Per acre.

A hush falls. Nearby, DR. ZHOU (40s, lead agronomist) drops her tablet on a workstation. Rushes over.

DR. ZHOU
(double-checking the data)
These readings... they're not possible. 
(glances at Lin)
If we scale this—

CHEN CHENG
The broadcast is already starting.

On a wall monitor, the NATIONAL LEADER addresses the nation. Lin watches, silent.

NATIONAL LEADER (ON SCREEN)
—a breakthrough that will secure our nation's future. In three days, Academician Lin will receive the nation's highest honor.

The screen shows footage of golden wheat fields. Lin touches the faded photo on his desk.

LIN WEIMIN
(quietly, to himself)
Two decades.

DR. ZHOU
Professor?

LIN WEIMIN
The Gobi strain isn't the limit. It never was.

CHEN CHENG
There's more?

Lin pulls out an old field journal. The cover bears a woman's name: SU MEI. He opens it, revealing meticulous notes alongside pressed wheat samples.

LIN WEIMIN
My wife cultivated the mother strain. In our village. Before I left.

Dr. Zhou leans in, studying the notes. Chen Cheng's eyes widen.

LIN WEIMIN
She was the one who saw its potential first. I need to finish what we started.

CHEN CHENG
I'll arrange transport—

LIN WEIMIN
(shaking his head)
Alone. It's been twenty years.

The laboratory doors slide open. Two PROTOCOL OFFICERS enter, forming an honor guard. The National Leader's voice continues on screen.

The scientists straighten. Lin picks up the journal, edges worn from twenty years of handling, and walks toward the exit.
continuation:
INT. WANG BANCHENG'S PENTHOUSE OFFICE - DAY

Floor-to-ceiling windows overlook a glittering city. WANG BANCHENG (50s, diamond cufflinks, smile that doesn't reach his eyes) scrolls through news on a curved monitor.

The headline: "NATIONAL HERO LIN WEIMIN—SUPER WHEAT SAVES NATION."

LIN TINGTING (20s, sharp features, sharper ambition) enters with a lacquered tray of tea. She pours with practiced elegance, her reflection ghosting across the dark screen.

LIN TINGTING
The board wants to know our position on the wheat contracts.

Wang doesn't look up. Tingting's fingers tighten on the teapot.

WANG BANCHENG
We don't have a position. Yet.

He zooms in on Lin Weimin's photo. Studies it.

WANG BANCHENG
Jiangcheng Chamber of Commerce controls food distribution for three provinces. We become irrelevant if we don't control the seeds.

LIN TINGTING
What do you need?

WANG BANCHENG
A gesture of goodwill. Something... personal.

He swivels his chair. Faces her fully for the first time.

WANG BANCHENG
I recall you mentioned property in your hometown. Prime location?

LIN TINGTING
(voice measured)
My father's land. But there's... a complication. Someone still lives there.

WANG BANCHENG
People can be persuaded.

LIN TINGTING
She's a widow. Stubborn. Refused previous offers.

Wang opens a drawer. Places a bankbook on the glass desk.

WANG BANCHENG
One million. For relocation.

Tingting's breath catches. She reaches for the bankbook. Wang's hand covers hers.

WANG BANCHENG
Handle this properly. The Chamber's influence depends on it.

She meets his gaze. A calculation passes between them.

LIN TINGTING
(softly)
What about your current wife?

WANG BANCHENG
What about Academician Lin's wife?

The words hang. Tingting's smile widens, understanding the unspoken bargain. She slips the bankbook into her purse.

LIN TINGTING
I'll leave tonight.

Wang turns back to the window. In the reflection, he watches her leave—then pulls up a second screen: demographics of Lin Weimin's hometown village.

He zooms in on a name: SU MEI. Widow. Property holder.

WANG BANCHENG
(to himself)
Gifts should arrive before the guest.

He picks up a phone.

WANG BANCHENG
(into phone)
Ready the demolition crew. Quietly.

title: The Amazing Mother
description: A mother who collects trash to fund her daughter's education must protect her from being sold into marriage by her abusive gambling husband.
context:
Title: The Amazing Mother
Description: A mother who collects trash to fund her daughter's education must protect her from being sold into marriage by her abusive gambling husband.

EXT. GARBAGE DUMP - NIGHT

A light rain slicks the mountain of refuse. LI YUN (40s, scholar's hands now calloused) stuffs plastic bottles into her sack. Her flashlight beam catches a discarded textbook—she pauses, wipes mud from its cover, adds it to her haul.

LI YUN
(to herself)
One hundred seventeen. Enough.

She ties the sack, a weary satisfaction on her face.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT

LI YUN drags the heavy sack when MRS. CHEN (60s, neighbor) emerges from the shadows, slippers slapping wet pavement.

MRS. CHEN
(urgent, low)
Li Yun—they're saying Old Tang took Youyou to the Zhang matchmaker. Tonight.

LI YUN's sack slips from her grasp. Bottles scatter. She doesn't retrieve them. She runs.

EXT. HOUSE ENTRANCE - NIGHT

The door SLAMS open. OLD TANG (50s, bloated with drink) shoves YOUYOU (18) onto the steps—she's in a red wedding qipao, a bruise darkening her jaw. She catches herself on the railing.

OLD TANG yanks his belt free. The leather WHIPS the air.

OLD TANG
Twenty years I've fed you—time to pay back!

YOUYOU
(quiet, terrified)
Mom's tuition money...

OLD TANG
What money? Zhang's paying triple my debt!

The belt descends. YOUYOU flinches.

LI YUN sprints into the courtyard. Without a word, she THROWS herself over her daughter. The belt cracks across her shoulders—she grunts but doesn't cry out.
continuation:
LI YUN
(hissing)
You want to hit someone? Hit me.

OLD TANG
(tangling hand in her hair)
Think I won't?

YOUYOU
(eyes flashing)
I'm not a thing to sell!

OLD TANG
(mocking)
With what money? More trash?

YOUYOU
I'll get scholarships. I'll work—

OLD TANG
You'll—

LI YUN's hand finds a brick from the crumbling step. She swings it sideways into Old Tang's knee. He howls, buckles, slumps against the doorframe—DIZZY, cursing, but conscious.

LI YUN stares at the brick, drops it. From her pocket she pulls a roll of damp bills—fives and tens, meticulously saved.

LI YUN
(hand shaking)
Train fare. To Shanghai. Go.

YOUYOU
Mom, I can't—

LI YUN
You must. Now.

She stuffs the money into Youyou's palm, pushes her toward the street. Youyou stumbles, looks back—her mother standing guard over Tang's groaning form.

YOUYOU's face shifts: terror hardening into resolve. She clasps the money and sprints into the darkness.

ON LI YUN—breathing hard, a fragile wall between her daughter and the world—as Old Tang's hand gropes for her ankle.

FADE OUT.

title: A Second Chance at Love
description: A wealthy CEO and his son visit a construction site incognito. The son meets a kind-hearted woman selling buns and decides she would be perfect for his widowed father.
context:
Title: A Second Chance at Love
Description: A wealthy CEO and his son visit a construction site incognito. The son meets a kind-hearted woman selling buns and decides she would be perfect for his widowed father.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

A black Mercedes speeds down the road, performing a stylish drift and stopping abruptly at the entrance of a construction site.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE ENTRANCE - DAY

ZHAO YI (Chairman of Zhao Group) and ZHAO YUNFAN (Zhao Yi's son) step out of the car. Yunfan pockets his phone.

A group of WORKERS wearing hard hats stand in formation, bowing in unison.

WORKERS
(in unison)
Hello, Chairman! Hello, Young Master!

An ASSISTANT approaches respectfully, handing them two sets of work uniforms and white hard hats.

ZHAO YI
Remember - we blend in today. See the real operation.

ZHAO YUNFAN
Dad, I've got the blueprints on my phone. Fully digital.

ZHAO YI
Your phone can't smell the mortar.

They change into the work uniforms and put on the hard hats.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION AREA - DAY

ZHAO YI and ZHAO YUNFAN walk the site. General Manager LIU FENG hurries over with a folder.

LIU FENG
Chairman, the Cultural Park bids.

ZHAO YI
Not now. Walk with us.

ZHAO YUNFAN
(intercepting the folder)
Dad's doing "undercover boss" today. The fifty million can wait.

ZHAO YUNFAN'S PHONE buzzes - dating app notifications. He silences it.

ZHAO YI
What smells so good?

YI walks toward the aroma. Yunfan follows.

EXT. BUN STAND - DAY

LI YUMEI kneads dough at her bun stand, a modified tricycle. Steam rises.

ZHAO YUNFAN
Two buns, please.

LI YUMEI
Four yuan. Cash only.

ZHAO YUNFAN pats his pockets - only his phone and Platinum cards.

ZHAO YUNFAN
(embarrassed)
I'm digital generation. Forgot cash.

LAO LUO, a nearby worker, steps up with cash.

LAO LUO
Two buns, Sister Mei.

LAO LUO spots Yunfan's hesitation.

LAO LUO
(mocking)
Forgot what money looks like?

ZHAO YUNFAN
Just forgot my wallet.

LAO LUO grabs ZHAO YUNFAN by the collar.

LAO LUO
Playing games while we work?

ZHAO YUNFAN
Let go!

LI YUMEI hurries over, separating them with flour-dusted hands.

LI YUMEI
Lao Luo, he's just hungry.
continuation:
(to Yunfan)
First day? My treat. Can't work on empty.

She bags three buns and adds a soy milk.

LI YUMEI
Bring your father by. That man needs real food.

ZHAO YUNFAN
You noticed him?

LI YUMEI
Hard to miss. He watches you like my husband watched our boy.

Yunfan studies her - her natural warmth, the dough-stained hands.

ZHAO YUNFAN
He hasn't eaten right since Mom died.

LI YUMEI
(softly)
Then make him eat. Good food helps grief.

She hands him the bag. Yunfan is deeply moved.

ZHAO YUNFAN
Auntie... are you single?

LI YUMEI
(stunned)
Huh?

ZHAO YUNFAN
Would you meet someone? He's... not good at this.

LI YUMEI
(laughing shyly)
A woman my age?

ZHAO YUNFAN
My dad's fifty too. And you look right for each other.

Li Yumei hesitates, then writes on a receipt.

LI YUMEI
Tell him: if he's serious, he finds me here. Every morning.

She hands him the flour-dusted note.

ZHAO YUNFAN
(taking it, happily)
Future Mom. I've got to work.

ZHAO YUNFAN walks away cheerfully.

LI YUMEI
(shy and helpless)
Oh, this kid...

A BLACK AUDI screeches to a halt nearby, throwing dust. YU FUSHENG chases QIAN LILI as she throws luggage.

QIAN LILI
Get your mother OUT or I'm GONE!

She hurls a designer suitcase. It crashes into Li Yumei's tricycle, toppling the steamer. Hot water spills. Li Yumei falls.

LI YUMEI
(screaming in pain)
Ah!

Yunfan drops the bag and sprints back. Zhao Yi appears, face pale.

ZHAO YI
Medical! Now!

He rips off his work shirt to staunch burns, revealing a tailored undershirt. His eyes lock with Li Yumei's.

LI YUMEI
(whispering)
Your son... good boy.

She passes out. Yunfan clutches the note, knuckles white.

ZHAO YUNFAN
Dad...

ZHAO YI
(into phone)
Dr. Chen. Construction site. Burns. Five minutes.

His other hand stays on Li Yumei's shoulder - protective, certain.

The scene freezes: Yunfan's desperation, Yi's focused calm, Li Yumei unconscious, the Zhao Group hard hat rolling in the dust.

title: The Distance Between Cloud and Sea
description: After five years of a contractual marriage, Xu Huanyan finally decides to divorce Pei Congwen, who remains oblivious and only has eyes for his first love, An Xin.
context:
Title: The Distance Between Cloud and Sea
Description: After five years of a contractual marriage, Xu Huanyan finally decides to divorce Pei Congwen, who remains oblivious and only has eyes for his first love, An Xin.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

XU HUANYAN initiates intimacy with PEI CONGWEN. He responds, but his face remains detached, turned toward the ceiling.

XU HUANYAN
(softly)

She grabs her phone.

XU HUANYAN
(into phone)
Mother. I'm divorcing him.

MOTHER-IN-LAW (V.O.)
(a beat)
The contract ended last month. You've waited long enough.

XU HUANYAN
I'll arrange the papers.

She hangs up. In her white nightgown, she moves to the window. Her reflection overlays the city. On the nightstand: their wedding photo, positioned so his face is turned away.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM/DINING AREA - DAY

XU HUANYAN (white slip dress) stands at the counter beside a manila envelope labeled "Documents."

PEI CONGWEN (suit, no tie) scrolls his phone while eating. A VOICE MESSAGE plays:

AN XIN (V.O.)
Congwen! Boarding now. See you in two hours!

PEI CONGWEN
(voice message reply)
Wait for me.

He grins, typing rapidly.

XU HUANYAN
Sign this. The orphanage needs it today.

She slides the envelope over. He pulls out the document, glances at it—"DIVORCE AGREEMENT" is visible but he's already flipping pages.

PEI CONGWEN
(scribbling without looking)
Whatever you need.

He signs, turns to leave.

XU HUANYAN
That's not the supply contract.

PEI CONGWEN
(pulling on his jacket)
You handle it.

XU HUANYAN
I said it's not—

PEI CONGWEN
I know, I know. You're efficient.

His phone BUZZES. He checks it, his expression softening.

PEI CONGWEN
(to himself)
She's nervous about landing...

He heads out. The door shuts.

Silence.

XU HUANYAN picks up the agreement. Her fingers trace his signature. She folds it with precision, tucks it into her bag, and walks toward the door.

She passes the wedding photo on the wall. For the first time, she looks at it—directly at her own image. Then she turns away, opens the door, and leaves without looking back.

title: No Return in the Deep Clouds
description: The granddaughter of Asia's richest man flees an arranged marriage to return home and find her missing ex-boyfriend, while her family mobilizes their vast resources to track her down.
context:
Title: No Return in the Deep Clouds
Description: The granddaughter of Asia's richest man flees an arranged marriage to return home and find her missing ex-boyfriend, while her family mobilizes their vast resources to track her down.

EXT. PARK - DAY

Several BODYGUARDS in black suits fan out through manicured lawns, scanning.

BODYGUARD (into earpiece)
Visual lost. Check all park exits.

YUN WUSHUANG (24), ivory silk dress stained with grass, sprints toward a maintenance gate. She yanks off a diamond pendant necklace—drops it. Kicks free of her Louboutins, keeps running barefoot.

YUN WUSHUANG (V.O.)
Three years. No messages. No goodbyes. Just... gone.

Her bare feet hit gravel. She flinches but doesn't slow.

YUN WUSHUANG (V.O.)
Grandfather says I'm chasing ghosts. Maybe I am.

She vaults over a low fence, disappears into an alley.

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

A black convoy snakes through traffic. The lead Rolls-Royce stops at a security checkpoint.

JIANG JIUSI (40s), impeccably suited, steps out. He surveys the area with cold precision.

JIANG JIUSI (into phone)
Activate regional protocols. Bus terminals. Highway cameras. Not a total lockdown—too much attention. Make it look routine.

He signals. Two BODYGUARDS peel off toward a patrol car.

JIANG JIUSI
(under his breath)
Where would you run, Wushuang?
continuation:
EXT. PLAZA - DAY

YUN GROUP TOWER looms in the background. The CHAIRMAN (70s), leaning on his cane, watches Jiang approach.

JIANG JIUSI
Chairman. She's breached the perimeter.

CHAIRMAN
She's going back to that town. To him.

The Chairman pulls out an old photograph—Yun Wushuang laughing with a young man (QIN MUYE, early 20s) at a beach carnival.

CHAIRMAN
Deploy the discrete unit. No media. No police involvement. Find her before she finds nothing but heartbreak.

JIANG JIUSI
And if she refuses to return?

CHAIRMAN
Then remind her who she is.

He pockets the photo. Jiang's jaw tightens.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

FEMALE EMPLOYEE 1 scrolls through a staff group chat on her phone—rumors about the Chairman's granddaughter "disappearing."

FEMALE EMPLOYEE 1
(whispering)
They say she's been gone for days. Some psycho on the dark web is selling "authentic photos"...

MALE EMPLOYEE
Who even knows what she looks like? Last official photo was from her high school graduation.

FEMALE EMPLOYEE 2
Wait—new manager orientation starts in five minutes. HR said she came straight from HQ.

A commotion at the entrance. YUN NIANQIN (25) enters in a power suit, flanked by assistants. She has Yun Wushuang's exact posture, the same sharp cheekbones.

FEMALE EMPLOYEE 1
(gasps)
That's her! From the Chairman's annual report!

She holds up her phone—a blurry zoomed-in photo of Yun Nianqin at a charity gala, wearing an evening gown.

Meanwhile, YUN WUSHUANG in a server's uniform, scarfs down a bun behind a potted plant. A gold name tag: "TRAINEE: AN."

YUN WUSHUANG (V.O.)
Okay. New plan: work here two days, earn bus fare, disappear forev—

She freezes. Yun Nianqin is walking straight toward her, the employee entourage following.

HOTEL EMPLOYEES (in unison)
Welcome, Miss Yun!

Yun Wushuang's eyes go wide. The bun slips from her fingers.

title: Five Treasures Unite: Daddy Chases Mommy
description: A young woman's desperate night leads to an unexpected encounter with a mysterious man, resulting in quintuplets that will change both their lives forever.
context:
Title: Five Treasures Unite: Daddy Chases Mommy
Description: A young woman's desperate night leads to an unexpected encounter with a mysterious man, resulting in quintuplets that will change both their lives forever.

INT. NIGHTCLUB - NIGHT

SU XIWEI balances a champagne tray, her mother's bracelet catching the strobe lights.

SU XIWEI (V.O.)
That night, I thought I was fighting for my diploma. Turns out, I was fighting for five.

BOSS FU leers from his VIP sofa. BAI YAN corners SU XIWEI near the bar.

BAI YAN
Last chance. Thirty thousand yuan for one hour with Boss Fu. Or you're deported tomorrow.

SU XIWEI
I said no. I'll find another way.

She spins away—and collides with FU JINGSHEN. Champagne soaks his shirt.

FU JINGSHEN
(steadying her)
Usually people apologize first.

SU XIWEI
I'm sorry! I'll pay for—wait, your bracelet—

Their identical prayer bead bracelets clink together.

FU JINGSHEN
My mother's. She said I'd know my destiny when I saw its match.

ASSISTANT ZHU appears, whispering urgently. FU JINGSHEN's jaw tightens.

FU JINGSHEN
(to SU XIWEI)
Thirty thousand yuan. Marry me tonight. Save your visa. Save my company from my grandmother's ultimatum.

SU XIWEI searches his face. Desperation meets desperation.

SU XIWEI
Just for show?

FU JINGSHEN
Just business. One year. Our secret.

He removes his bracelet, clasping it around her wrist.

FU JINGSHEN
Now we match.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - DAY

FADE IN:

TEXT ON SCREEN: NINE MONTHS LATER

SU XIWEI screams, gripping the bracelet. A hidden LED pulses with her heartbeat.

SU XIWEI
(between contractions)
You said you'd find me...

DOCTOR
First baby's out! Wait—this is impossible. It's... quintuplets?

SU XIWEI
(shocked)
What?

She faints. Five nurses hold five newborns. One has a blue birthmark.

ASSISTANT ZHU (V.O.)
Boss Fu, the tracker in her bracelet just went active. She's at City Hospital—

FU JINGSHEN (O.S.)
I'm already in the elevator.

FADE OUT.

title: Fifty-Year-Old Sister, Beautiful and Sassy (Episode 35)
description: A paralyzed woman suffers abuse from her caretaker while her husband carries on an affair, until her daughter discovers the truth.
context:
Title: Fifty-Year-Old Sister, Beautiful and Sassy (Episode 35)
Description: A paralyzed woman suffers abuse from her caretaker while her husband carries on an affair, until her daughter discovers the truth.

INT. ZHOU FAMILY KITCHEN - DAY

LANZI scrubs dishes with violent efficiency. Her knuckles are raw. She glances at a family photo on the windowsill—ZHOU JUAN stands vibrant between husband and daughter. The photo is turned facedown.

LANZI fills a bowl with congee, the steam fogging her expression.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

ZHOU JUAN lies paralyzed, her fingers twitching involuntarily. Sunlight through half-drawn blinds casts prison bars across the bedsheets.

LANZI enters, the bowl cooling in her hands.

LANZI
Time for your medicine.

LANZI scoops the congee with deliberate sloppiness. Rice drips onto ZHOU JUAN's chin. ZHOU JUAN's throat convulses—she turns her head, the congee spilling.

LANZI
(with cold precision)
They say the sixth year is the hardest. Families break. Hearts give out.

LANZI presses the spoon against ZHOU JUAN's closed lips.

LANZI
(whispering)
You're the one who hired me. Remember that.

A key turns in the front door lock—soft, but LANZI freezes. She hears FOOTSTEPS. LANZI drops the spoon.

LANZI
(loudly, suddenly)
Sister Juan, please don't refuse food again!

ZHOU FUGUI (O.S.)
What's happening?

ZHOU FUGUI appears. His tie is loosened. He smells of whiskey lunches.

LANZI
(eyes downcast)
She won't eat. Says the texture reminds her of what she's lost.

ZHOU FUGUI moves to the bed, avoids his wife's eyes.

ZHOU FUGUI
(to ZHOU JUAN)
You're testing everyone's patience. ZHAODI graduates next month. She'll finally see you for the burden you are.

ZHOU FUGUI straightens, his gaze finding LANZI's in the mirror above the dresser. A silent communication.

ZHOU FUGUI
Be more useful.

ZHOU FUGUI exits. LANZI watches him go, a flicker of something—longing? calculation?—crossing her face.
continuation:
INT. HALLWAY - DAY

LANZI catches ZHOU FUGUI near the study. LANZI's hand on his arm is light, practiced.

LANZI
She didn't mean it. The pain makes her cruel.

ZHOU FUGUI
(turning, voice softening)
You always defend her. That's your kindness—and your fault.

ZHOU FUGUI touches her cheek. From the bedroom doorway, ZHOU JUAN's eyes—wide, reflecting the hallway light—watch. ZHOU JUAN has managed to roll onto her side, her paralyzed fingers digging into the mattress.

INT. LIVING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

The front door opens. ZHOU ZHAODI stops mid-step.

Her father's hand on LANZI's face. LANZI's other hand on his chest.

ZHOU ZHAODI
(low, dangerous)
Dad. The caregiver you hired has a record. I checked.

A thud from the bedroom. ZHOU JUAN has pulled herself to the floor, her mouth open in a silent scream, one trembling finger pointing.

ZHOU FUGUI
(pulling away)
ZHAODI—it's not—

ZHOU ZHAODI
(not looking at her father, only at her mother on the floor)
Mama, I came home early because the doctor called. He said your paralysis tests came back negative.

ZHOU ZHAODI takes out her phone, presses play—a recording: LANZI's voice, clear and calculating. "Six months, and the house will be ours."

ZHOU ZHAODI
(to LANZI)
You miscalculated. And you—
(to ZHOU FUGUI)
—underestimated her.

ZHOU JUAN's pointing finger drops. ZHOU JUAN's lips form one word:

ZHOU JUAN
(whisper)
Wait.

title: Five Elements Legend (Episode 65)
description: At a temple, disciples train under Master Hu Shan's watchful eye when the sinister Qing Sha and his black-clad soldiers arrive at the gates.
context:
Title: Five Elements Legend (Episode 65)
Description: At a temple, disciples train under Master Hu Shan's watchful eye when the sinister Qing Sha and his black-clad soldiers arrive at the gates.

EXT. TEMPLE COURTYARD - DAY

Wide shot.

On the broad stone steps in front of the temple, DISCIPLE A and DISCIPLE B are engaged in intense sparring. MASTER HU SHAN stands nearby, holding a monk's staff, watching them sternly.

Close shot.

DISCIPLE A and DISCIPLE B wield heavy weapons, their moves sharp and fierce—A pressing forward with raw intensity, B defending with fluid precision. The clashing of their weapons rings out continuously. DISCIPLE A executes a graceful backflip and lands steadily.

MASTER HU SHAN
(to Disciple B)
Your form holds, but your conviction trembles. They will sense that.

The disciples cross their weapons in front of MASTER HU SHAN.

MASTER HU SHAN
(to both)
Good. Remember—protecting the temple means more than winning.
continuation:
EXT. MILITARY CAMP GATE - DAY

Wide shot.

A heavily guarded city gate with a plaque reading "General's Mansion." A woman in white robes walks slowly toward the gate, her hand clutching a broken sword hilt bearing the temple's insignia.

A group of black-clad soldiers kneel on one knee, holding their weapons. A black flag bearing the character "Sha" flutters in the wind.

Close-up of the unusual weapons in the soldiers' hands—obsidian blades that seem to absorb light rather than reflect it.

A man dressed in red and white robes plays with a throwing knife between his fingers, his eyes locked on the woman's pendant.

EXT. TEMPLE COURTYARD - DAY

The red temple doors are pushed open from the outside.

Outside the gate, QING SHA appears with a large group of black-clad soldiers. His armor bears the same broken-sword insignia as the woman's hilt.

Inside the courtyard, MASTER HU SHAN and his disciples maintain their defensive stance, watching the entrance warily.

DAOIST ELDER stands to the side. Seeing who has arrived, his face shows shock and bitter recognition.

DAOIST ELDER
(shocked)
Qing Sha. You traded your soul for those blades.

QING SHA enters the courtyard with a smug smile on his face, his gaze falling on the Daoist Elder.

QING SHA
Elder. You taught me that mercy is weakness. I've merely learned my lesson.

Inside the courtyard, MASTER HU SHAN and his disciples maintain their defensive stance, watching the entrance warily.

DAOIST ELDER stands to the side. Seeing who has arrived, his face shows shock and bitter recognition.

DAOIST ELDER
(shocked)
Qing Sha. You traded your soul for those blades.

QING SHA enters the courtyard with a smug smile on his face, his gaze falling on the Daoist Elder.

QING SHA
Elder. You taught me that mercy is weakness. I've merely learned my lesson.

title: Exchanged Life: The Doctor of Two Worlds (Episode 56)
description: A woman in a wedding dress flees an unwanted marriage, confronting her past and choosing death over a life without freedom.
context:
Title: Exchanged Life: The Doctor of Two Worlds (Episode 56)
Description: A woman in a wedding dress flees an unwanted marriage, confronting her past and choosing death over a life without freedom.

EXT. QIZHOU CITY GATE - DAY

SHEN MUHE, magnificent in red wedding silk, sprints toward the city gate. Her elaborate headdress is gone, hair loosened by the chase.

GUARD (O.S.)
Seal the gate!

Three GUARDS rush from the watchtower, weapons drawn.

SHEN MUHE (V.O.)
Three li more. Just three li, and the world opens again.

GUARD
In the prince's name! Stand!

SHEN MUHE glances back—not at the guards, but at the city beyond them. Her jaw tightens.

SHEN MUHE (V.O.)
He should have listened.

The guards form a half-circle. HOOFS thunder. ZHU ZAISHENG, all red silk and polished armor, reins his black horse to block the gate. His sword clears its scabbard, point steady at her chest.

ZHU ZAISHENG
Shen Muhe. Is marrying this prince so unbearable?

SHEN MUHE
(contemptuously)
Marry you?

MONTAGE:

A misty grassland at dawn. LI SHIZHEN follows SHEN MUHE as she gathers herbs by a stream.

They discover ZHU ZAISHENG, severely injured and unconscious beneath a scholar tree.

SHEN MUHE treats his wounds—checking pulse, packing the wound, methodical and precise.

LI SHIZHEN and SHEN MUHE support the weakened ZHU ZAISHENG between them as they depart.
continuation:
INT. ROOM - NIGHT

ZHU ZAISHENG, in a loose white robe, sits on the bed's edge. SHEN MUHE examines his nearly-healed injuries. He reaches for her hand; she deflects, checking his pulse at his wrist.

ZHU ZAISHENG
Stay. I'll build you a clinic in the capital. A hundred clinics.

SHEN MUHE
I have a teacher. He has one pair of hands. That's enough.

She turns to leave. He catches her shoulder, pulls her close. She presses her silver hairpin to his throat—steady, not trembling. He freezes, then laughs softly, releasing her.

INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY

Red silk drapes the ancestral tablets. ZHU ZAISHENG and SHEN MUHE, wed-locked in ceremonial dress, bow in unison.

OFFICIANT (O.S.)
First bow—to heaven and earth.

ZHU ZAISHENG (V.O.)
She wore silver in her hair. I should have known.

OFFICIANT (O.S.)
Second bow—to the ancestors.

SHEN MUHE (V.O.)
May they forgive what I'm about to do.

OFFICIANT (O.S.)
Husband and wife bow to each other!

ZHU ZAISHENG (V.O.)
She is mine.

SHEN MUHE (V.O.)
I am my own.

They bow. ZHU ZAISHENG's hand finds hers—she doesn't grasp back. He tightens his grip, possessive.

ZHU ZAISHENG
(whisper)
Never run. I will find you.

EXT. QIZHOU CITY GATE - DAY

Back to reality. ZHU ZAISHENG's sword point hasn't wavered. SHEN MUHE studies the blade.

SHEN MUHE
Marry you? I'd choke on the words. I'm a physician. My life belongs to the dying, not to princes.

Her hand closes around the blade. Blood ribbons down her wrist—bright, arterial.

ZHU ZAISHENG
(shattered)
Release it! I'll let you go—

SHEN MUHE
(screaming through tears)
In this life and the next, we owe each other nothing!

She yanks the sword toward her throat. A red line opens. She falls backward, limbs loose, head cracking against stone. Blood pools beneath her.

ZHU ZAISHENG
(terrified)
Muhe!

Next to SHEN MUHE's body, a worn copy of the COMPENDIUM OF MATERIA MEDICA falls from her sleeve. Her bleeding hand rests on the page for "Arsenic."

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Kiss My Baby
description: A woman drugged and framed by her sister gives birth to a sick child, forced to choose between saving his life and never seeing him again.
context:
Title: Kiss My Baby
Description: A woman drugged and framed by her sister gives birth to a sick child, forced to choose between saving his life and never seeing him again.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

City night view, camera moves to a bed where SHEN JIAYI and a shirtless MAN lie sleeping.

SHEN JIAYI and a shirtless MAN lie sleeping on the bed.

A woman in high heels, SHEN YANRAN, walks into the room, her reflection smiling.

SHEN YANRAN (V.O.)
Poor little sister. Someone had to sacrifice.

FLASHBACK:
SHEN YANRAN hands a glass of water to SHEN JIAYI.

SHEN YANRAN is on the phone, watching Jiayi drink.

MAN (V.O.)
The room's ready. She's out.

SHEN YANRAN (V.O.)
Get her out of my life.
continuation:
EXT. CITY - DAWN

City skyline at dawn, streaked with light.

ON SCREEN: Nine months later

INT. SHADY CLINIC - DAY

ON SCREEN: Shady Clinic

SHEN JIAYI lies on a crude operating table, screaming through a dirty rag.

DOCTOR (O.S.)
Push! Breathe! Again!

SHEN JIAYI (in pain)
Ah!

DOCTOR (O.S.)
Harder! One more!

SHEN JIAYI lets out a painful scream, finally giving birth to the child, collapsing exhausted.

SHEN JIAYI (V.O.)
Your cry gave me something to fight for.

The DOCTOR holds the newborn baby and hands it to SHEN YANRAN, who stands nearby.

SHEN JIAYI (weakly)
Sister, let me see the child.

SHEN YANRAN coldly holds the baby, turning away.

DOCTOR
Cyanotic. Critical heart defect. He won't survive without surgery.

SHEN JIAYI sits up in shock, unable to believe it.

SHEN JIAYI (crying)
What?

SHEN YANRAN
You slept with a stranger. Did you expect a healthy child?

SHEN JIAYI (breaking down crying)
It's all my fault. Please... I'll do anything.

SHEN YANRAN
You're a college dropout. You have nothing.

SHEN YANRAN takes out a document with "Irrevocable Relinquishment" written on it.

SHEN YANRAN
I can save him. But you must sign this and disappear forever.

CLOSE-UP: The three large characters "Irrevocable Relinquishment" on the document.

title: My Dear Emperor
description: A young woman dreams of an ancient emperor searching for her, only to wake and face betrayal from her boyfriend and stepsister in modern times.
context:
Title: My Dear Emperor
Description: A young woman dreams of an ancient emperor searching for her, only to wake and face betrayal from her boyfriend and stepsister in modern times.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

SONG YOUYOU lies on her side, phone slipping from her fingers as her breathing deepens.

BEGIN DREAM SEQUENCE

INT. PALACE - DAY

EMPEROR LUO NANCHEN, magnificent robes cascading, stands before trembling guards.

LUO NANCHEN
Search for her! If you cannot find her, I will have your heads!

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

LUO NANCHEN clutches a scroll painting, his expression sorrowful.

LUO NANCHEN
(to himself)
Youyou, where are you?

END DREAM SEQUENCE

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Dream images dissolve across SONG YOUYOU'S sleeping face.

She wakes with a gasp, sitting upright.

SONG YOUYOU
(confused)
Luo Nanchen... why him?

She glances at her phone, eyes widening.

SONG YOUYOU
My shift.
continuation:
INT. HIGH-END RESTAURANT - DAY

SONG YOUYOU, in a server's uniform, wipes down a table. A wall-mounted TV drones softly.

TV NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...archaeologists report unprecedented discoveries at the sealed tomb of Emperor Chonghe, the Tyrant of the North...

SONG YOUYOU freezes at the name.

Sharp heels click on marble. LIN JIE enters with SONG QIAOQIAO on his arm.

SONG QIAOQIAO
Waitress.

SONG YOUYOU looks up, sees them, and freezes.

SONG YOUYOU
(shocked)
Lin Jie? Song Qiaoqiao?

SONG QIAOQIAO
(smugly)
As you can see, your boyfriend? I've taken him.

SONG YOUYOU
(looking at Lin Jie)
What's the meaning of this?

LIN JIE
Song Youyou, let's break up. Look at you, serving plates, looking so diminished.

LIN JIE
I pursued you because you were a Song. You had presence. But now? You're nothing but a working girl. Look at my status, and look at yours. You're not worthy of me.

SONG QIAOQIAO
Ajie runs a publicly listed company. You run tables. Still think you're one of us?

LIN JIE
Exactly. Qiaoqiao's the real thing. You and her are like heaven and earth. You're not even worth one of Qiaoqiao's toes.

SONG YOUYOU angrily throws the cloth in her hand at LIN JIE.

SONG YOUYOU
I'll return those words. Do you think I loved you? I accepted your pursuit because your features bore a three-point resemblance to the man in my heart.

LIN JIE
(grabbing Song Youyou's arm)
What do you mean?

SONG YOUYOU
(shaking him off)
Three years ago, I worked doubles to support you because you reminded me of him. But now? You're nothing like him at all. You disgust me.

LIN JIE
(furious, advancing on her)
Who is he?

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Finding Love in Midlife & The Flash Marriage Partner is the Nation's Richest
description: A woman discovers her husband's betrayal at a young man's celebration banquet, only to be unexpectedly defended by a security guard.
context:
Title: Finding Love in Midlife & The Flash Marriage Partner is the Nation's Richest
Description: A woman discovers her husband's betrayal at a young man's celebration banquet, only to be unexpectedly defended by a security guard.

INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY

A grand academic celebration banquet is underway, packed with guests and a lively atmosphere. CHEN XIULAN, her husband ZHAO JIANMIN, and her mother-in-law LI GUILIAN sit at the main table. Chen Xiulan's fingers trace the edge of an envelope in her lap.

CHEN XIULAN
(whispering to ZHAO JIANMIN)
Old Zhao.

ZHAO JIANMIN
(not looking up from his phone)
Mmm?

CHEN XIULAN
Twenty thousand for Zhao Liang's scores... that's six months of my nursing shifts. You never even asked.

LI GUILIAN
(stabbing a dumpling precisely)
A childless woman shouldn't question a man's decisions. Zhao Liang's university seat is the Zhao family's future.

ZHAO JIANMIN
(pocketing his phone)
Mother's right. It's an investment.

CHEN XIULAN
(folding the envelope into her bag)
I see. An investment.

EMCEE
(on stage)
Now let's have our future college student, Zhao Liang, say a few words!

Guests applaud. ZHAO LIANG walks onto the stage accompanied by his mother, ZHANG FENGXIA. Chen Xiulan's eyes narrow—Zhao Liang has Zhao Jianmin's exact jawline.

ZHAO LIANG
(taking the microphone, voice cracking)
First, thank you for coming. My achievements belong to my mother, Ms. Zhang Fengxia... who raised me alone in Qingzhou while building her business.

FEMALE GUEST
(surprised)
Qingzhou? Isn't that where Zhao Jianmin's company opened a branch?

MALE GUEST
The timeline fits. Been operating there for... what, nineteen years?

ZHAO JIANMIN stands, straightening his jacket. Chen Xiulan doesn't flinch—just watches.

ZHAO LIANG
(announcing, but his eyes find Chen Xiulan)
Today, I also thank the man who taught me what responsibility looks like. My father—Zhao Jianmin.

The hall erupts. Chen Xiulan rises slowly, her hand still in her bag.

CHEN XIULAN (V.O.)
Nineteen years. The Qingzhou "business trips." The separate bank account. The daughter they told me died of "complications."

ZHAO LIANG
(walking toward ZHAO JIANMIN)
Dad.

ZHAO JIANMIN
(smiling, but it doesn't reach his eyes)
Son.
continuation:
ZHANG FENGXIA
(to ZHAO JIANMIN, voice low)
I told you to wait until after the divorce.

ZHAO JIANMIN
(patting her arm)
The timing is perfect.

CHEN XIULAN
(stepping into their path, voice steady)
Zhao Jianmin. The Qingzhou property in your name. Built during our marriage. Care to explain?

ZHAO JIANMIN
(coldly)
Fengxia and I have been partners—in every sense—for two decades. I married you because my mother demanded a "respectable" wife. You've served your purpose.

CHEN XIULAN
(breaking down the facade)
Purpose? I worked eighty-hour weeks to pay for your mother's surgery. Your "business trips" were family vacations. The car, the house—my debt, your assets.

LI GUILIAN
(rushing over, voice like a whip)
You dare speak? You couldn't carry a son! Fengxia gave me a grandson. Your daughter was defective—weak lungs, they'd said.

CHEN XIULAN
(finding her volume)
She was premature because you pushed me down the stairs!

FLASHBACK - 18 YEARS AGO

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

CHEN XIULAN, pale and trembling, holds a tiny infant. YOUNG LI GUILIAN and YOUNG ZHAO JIANMIN hover.

YOUNG LI GUILIAN
(hissing)
A daughter? With her health problems, she'll cost us everything. The doctors say she might not survive. Sign the papers, Jianmin. Let the state have her.

YOUNG ZHAO JIANMIN
(avoiding Chen Xiulan's eyes)
It's... mercy.

The MIDWIFE takes the baby. Chen Xiulan's screams are muffled by a nurse closing the door.

END FLASHBACK

INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY

LI GUILIAN
(pointing, but uncertainty flickers)
You still dare mention that burden?

ZHAO JIANMIN
(disgusted)
Chen Xiulan, you're a ghost of a woman. But I'll be generous—stay as my housekeeper, and I won't contest the divorce. Though who would want a used nurse pushing fifty?

A SECURITY BADGE appears between them. WEI BAOGANG, 45, weathered hands holding it up.

WEI BAOGANG
(officer's badge, not a guard's)
Detective Wei, Economic Crimes Unit. I've been investigating Zhao Jianmin's offshore accounts. Mrs. Chen, I believe you have evidence of marital asset fraud?

Chen Xiulan pulls the envelope from her bag—bank statements. Her tears dry.

CHEN XIULAN
(to Wei)
I do. And I know exactly where my daughter is.

A SECURITY BADGE appears between them. WEI BAOGANG, 45, weathered hands holding it up.

WEI BAOGANG
(officer's badge, not a guard's)
Detective Wei, Economic Crimes Unit. I've been investigating Zhao Jianmin's offshore accounts. Mrs. Chen, I believe you have evidence of marital asset fraud?

Chen Xiulan pulls the envelope from her bag—bank statements. Her tears dry.

CHEN XIULAN
(to Wei)
I do. And I know exactly where my daughter is.

title: Life Upgrade Guide
description: A man who became a villain's pawn is given a second chance when a game of Russian roulette miraculously sends him back ten years to correct his mistakes.
context:
Title: Life Upgrade Guide
Description: A man who became a villain's pawn is given a second chance when a game of Russian roulette miraculously sends him back ten years to correct his mistakes.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

JIANG MING, in a suit, stands at the edge of the rooftop, holding a revolver.

JIANG MING (V.O.)
My name is Jiang Ming. My business cards say I'm a real estate executive.

JIANG MING points the gun at his temple.

JIANG MING (V.O.)
One bullet. Five pulls. 16.67% survival. Better odds than I've given my victims.

JIANG MING (V.O.)
In this life, I've perfected the art of looking away.

JIANG MING pulls the trigger. It clicks empty.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Young JIANG MING wears work clothes. A CONTRACTOR hands him a red safety helmet filled with money.

CONTRACTOR
Xiao Jiang, Li Yong was your brother. But brothers don't bankrupt projects. One accident, and this development becomes a ghost property.

JIANG MING
The pit wasn't marked. We both knew the sign was missing.

CONTRACTOR
(interrupting)
What sign? The only sign that matters is the one you didn't give—the warning he never heard. From now on, Li Yong never existed.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

Back on the rooftop, JIANG MING's eyes are filled with pain.

JIANG MING (V.O.)
I'm sorry, Yongzi. If I had another chance, I would definitely save you.

JIANG MING pulls the trigger again. Another empty click. He moves the gun to his chin.

JIANG MING
Dad, forgive me.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG MING's FATHER grabs his arm, emotional.

JIANG MING'S FATHER
Jiang Ming, do you know what that means? Prison!

JIANG MING
Dad, that's the boss of Hengyuan Real Estate. If I take the fall for him for three years, I can get five hundred thousand! Only a fool would refuse!

JIANG MING shakes off his father and walks toward the door.

JIANG MING'S FATHER
Jiang Ming! If you walk out that door today, don't call me your father anymore!

JIANG MING leaves without looking back. His FATHER clutches his chest and collapses painfully onto the sofa.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

JIANG MING (V.O.)
Dad, Yongzi, give me one more chance, I will definitely be a good person!

JIANG MING
(shouting)
Do you know what happened to me after that?

INT. OFFICE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

XU HENGYUAN, the boss of Hengyuan Real Estate, pats JIANG MING on the shoulder.

XU HENGYUAN
Jiang Ming, from today on, you are Hengyuan Real Estate's top enforcer!

JIANG MING
(smiling obsequiously)
Thank you, Brother.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

LI YONG'S MOTHER kneels on the ground, crying and grabbing JIANG MING's pant leg.

LI YONG'S MOTHER
Jiang Ming! Your housing project, they just stopped building it! This money is my life savings!

INT. OFFICE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG MING is tied with rope, kneeling before XU HENGYUAN.

XU HENGYUAN
Jiang Ming, you're nothing but a dog by my side, and you dare to report Hengyuan Group? Even though I did all the bad things, the public will think it was Jiang Ming who owes them billions in relocation funds!

XU HENGYUAN laughs maniacally.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

JIANG MING (V.O.)
I became exactly what they needed: a scapegoat with a name and face. I, Jiang Ming, am nothing but debt.

JIANG MING shoves the gun in his mouth and frantically pulls the trigger. Another empty click.

JIANG MING
(desperately)
Four shots.

JIANG MING
(roaring at the sky)
Heaven! Are you trying to let me live again?

Past scenes flash rapidly. JIANG MING's emotions collapse. He points the gun at his temple again and roars as he pulls the trigger for the fifth time.

SOUND: A gunshot rings out.

INT. DORM ROOM - DAY

JIANG MING jolts awake from a crude bed, screaming frantically.

JIANG MING
(touching his head, in disbelief)
I'm not dead? I'm not dead!

He looks around and realizes he's in the construction site dormitory from ten years ago.

JIANG MING
I've been reborn!

JIANG MING clasps his hands together, excited and grateful.

JIANG MING
Thank you, Heaven! In this life, I will never go down the wrong path again! I will definitely be a good person!

He sees a calendar on the wall showing April 2nd.

JIANG MING
April 2nd... I will never forget this day. This is the day Li Yong fell into the pit.

AMING'S GIRLFRIEND (O.S.)
Aming, you're awake.

A pretty girl wearing a white top and plaid skirt walks in.

title: True Love Exists in the World
description: A vegetable vendor who won a lottery jackpot is hit by a car before he can claim his prize. His devoted wife spends seven years working multiple jobs to keep him alive, unaware of the winning ticket.
context:
Title: True Love Exists in the World
Description: A vegetable vendor who won a lottery jackpot is hit by a car before he can claim his prize. His devoted wife spends seven years working multiple jobs to keep him alive, unaware of the winning ticket.

EXT. STREET - DAY

Close-up shot of a crate of freshly picked vegetables, still covered with soil.

ZHAO ZHENLIN drives a blue tricycle loaded with vegetables, his wife CHEN FANG sitting beside him. The vehicle stops at the roadside.

CHEN FANG gets out of the vehicle and walks toward ZHAO ZHENLIN.

CHEN FANG
Old Zhao, you've been having back pain lately. Come home early tonight, okay?

ZHAO ZHENLIN
(smiling)
Okay, I know. You go to work now.

CHEN FANG
Alright.

CHEN FANG helps ZHAO ZHENLIN adjust his collar.

CHEN FANG
Oh, let me fix this.

ZHAO ZHENLIN
Okay.

CHEN FANG
I'm leaving now.

ZHAO ZHENLIN
Go on.

CHEN FANG smiles, turns to leave, and waves back at him.

ZHAO ZHENLIN watches her leave, then takes out a lottery ticket from his pocket.

ZHAO ZHENLIN (V.O.)
Xiao Fang, even though we're a second marriage, a couple who met halfway through life, you're a teacher who has lived so many hard years with me without complaint. I won a hundred million in the lottery. When it comes through tomorrow, I'll give you the biggest surprise ever.

ZHAO ZHENLIN carefully puts the lottery ticket back in his wallet. Suddenly, a white van speeds toward him and crashes into him violently.

ZHAO ZHENLIN is thrown into the air and falls to the ground, unconscious. His wallet SKIDS across the pavement, disappearing under a storm drain grate.

CHEN FANG hears the loud crash, turns back in horror, sees her fallen husband, and runs toward him, screaming.

CHEN FANG
(shouting)
Old Zhao!

CHEN FANG runs to ZHAO ZHENLIN and falls to her knees beside him.

CHEN FANG
(crying out)
Old Zhao! Old Zhao! Old Zhao, wake up! Someone, help! Please! Someone help!

Close-up of ZHAO ZHENLIN's phone on the ground, the screen showing lottery redemption information with a validity period of 7 years.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

CHEN FANG anxiously grabs DR. LI's hand.

CHEN FANG
Doctor, how is Old Zhao doing now? How is he?

DR. LI
The patient's head suffered severe trauma. He's become a vegetative patient.

CHEN FANG is struck as if by lightning, frozen in place.

CHEN FANG
(crying and pleading)
Doctor, I'm begging you, please find a way to save him. I'm begging you! Please!

DR. LI
(helplessly)
Calm down and listen to me. We've done everything we can. Unless a miracle happens.

DR. LI leaves. CHEN FANG collapses to the floor in despair, her eyes vacant.

CHEN FANG (V.O.)
Then I'll stay by his side until a miracle happens.

A series of montage shots:
- CHEN FANG wearing a sanitation worker's uniform, sweeping the street.
- CHEN FANG wearing a delivery uniform, struggling to carry a case of bottled water upstairs.

DR. LI (V.O.)
Continuing treatment costs at least 25,000 yuan per month. Insurance ran out last year. Do you still want to persist?

CHEN FANG (V.O.)
I'll find a way to earn the money.
continuation:
INT. LOTTERY REDEMPTION CENTER - DAY

ON SCREEN: Six months later

Two young lottery center EMPLOYEES are talking behind the counter.

EMPLOYEE A
Boss, the jackpot of a hundred million has arrived in the company account.

EMPLOYEE B
If this Zhao Zhenlin doesn't show up... once it goes to the state education fund, we lose the finder bonus.

EMPLOYEE A
(sighing)
Shame. That money could've changed someone's life.

INT. HOSPITAL BILLING OFFICE - DAY

ON SCREEN: Five years later

CHEN FANG sits across from a BILLING MANAGER, her hands trembling.

BILLING MANAGER
Mrs. Zhao, you owe 280,000 yuan. The director—

CHEN FANG
(interrupting)
Please. Just one more month. I have a new tutoring job.

BILLING MANAGER
(sighs)
Three days. Then we transfer him to county care.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: Seven years later

CHEN FANG washes ZHAO ZHENLIN'S hands, her face etched with exhaustion. She opens his bedside drawer to find a fresh towel.

Inside: his old wallet, water-damaged, tagged "EVIDENCE - HOLD."

She hasn't touched it since the accident.

Her fingers brush the leather. She flips it open: their wedding photo, a few yuan, and a faded lottery ticket tucked in a secret fold.

She pulls it out absently—then freezes. Checks her phone. Checks the numbers.

CHEN FANG
(barely breathing)
No... Old Zhao, what did you do?

She scrambles for the redemption date: valid until TODAY.

CHEN FANG
(quiet panic)
Seven years. Today's the day.

She looks at the clock: 5:13 PM. Redemption closes at 6:00.

CHEN FANG
(kissing his forehead)
Wait for me.

She sprints out. ZHAO ZHENLIN'S closed eyes well with tears.

INT. LOTTERY REDEMPTION CENTER - DAY

CHEN FANG slams the ticket on the counter at 5:57 PM, gasping.

CHEN FANG
Please... is this...?

EMPLOYEE A stares at the numbers, then at her.

EMPLOYEE A
Mrs. Zhao Zhenlin?

CHEN FANG
His wife.

The printer whirs. The stamp comes down: VALIDATED.

EMPLOYEE B
(stunned)
Hundred million yuan. It went through.

CHEN FANG sinks to the floor, clutching the ticket—laughing, weeping.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

CHEN FANG sits by ZHAO ZHENLIN'S bed, the validated ticket in hand.

CHEN FANG
(softly)
We can go to Switzerland now. Or Germany. Anywhere.

She pauses. Looks at his face, peaceful in the moonlight.

CHEN FANG
Or maybe... we already have everything.

She tears the ticket in half, then into quarters. Lets the pieces flutter into a drawer.

CHEN FANG
The money doesn't matter. You matter. We matter.

She takes his hand. On the monitor, his heart rate steady. Strong.

FADE OUT.

title: The Housewife and the Domineering CEO
description: A talented woman who left her career to become a housewife catches the attention of a powerful CEO who recognizes her hidden potential.
context:
Title: The Housewife and the Domineering CEO
Description: A talented woman who left her career to become a housewife catches the attention of a powerful CEO who recognizes her hidden potential.

INT. KITCHEN/DINING ROOM - DAY

In the kitchen, a wok sizzles at precisely 220°C. SU YINGXIA adjusts the flame with practiced fingers, timing the Maillard reaction on the scallions.

In the dining room, her daughter XIAO NING stares at a half-completed sugar cube structure, tears silently tracking down her cheeks.

SU YINGXIA hears the sniffle and turns the heat to simmer without looking.

SU YINGXIA
Stuck on the load distribution again?

XIAO NING
The cubes keep collapsing.

SU YINGXIA wipes her hands, kneels beside her daughter, and clicks three cubes together in a triangular base.

SU YINGXIA
See? Three points of contact. Basic physics.

Xiao Ning's milk glass tips as she reaches for the model. Su catches it mid-fall, but a few drops splash the table. She wipes it with one hand while showing Xiao Ning the completed structure with the other.

Her phone BUZZES with a calendar reminder: "Jingyan - Dinner 7PM."

SU YINGXIA answers, cradling the phone between shoulder and ear as she returns to the kitchen.

SU YINGXIA
Hey. The fish finishes in seven minutes. Thought you—

INT. OFFICE - DAY

ZHANG JINGYAN stands by the floor-to-ceiling windows, phone to his ear, watching the city lights flicker on. His desk displays a half-eaten takeout container, spreadsheets glowing on his monitor.

ZHANG JINGYAN
(weary)
System migration. You know how it is.

SU YINGXIA (V.O.)
Tonight was supposed to be—

ZHANG JINGYAN
I'll grab something here. Don't wait up.

He ends the call. Su lowers the phone, then forcefully taps "Reset" on a kitchen timer.

Behind Zhang, LUO QING enters with a tablet, her red suit jacket draped over one arm.

LUO QING
The Singapore brief. Final signatures.

Zhang turns, accepts the tablet. Their fingers brush. Luo Qing leans against his desk, close but not touching.

LUO QING
She's still tracking your dinner hour?

ZHANG JINGYAN
Old habits.

He signs with a flourish. Luo Qing's reflection in the window shows a small, satisfied smile.

LUO QING
The board's reviewing headcount next week. They prefer... streamlined households.

ZHANG JINGYAN
(glances at her)
I'm handling my side of the streamlining.

Their eyes meet in the glass.
continuation:
INT. CHEN YIHAN'S OFFICE - DAY

CHEN YIHAN sits behind his desk, studying three monitors: one shows a compound formula, another a patent database, the third—his assistant's face via video call.

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
We ran the simulation ten times. The stabilization matrix is identical to Project Ghost.

CHEN YIHAN
Publication date?

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
Three years ago. Then... nothing. No citations, no follow-ups.

Chen zooms on the author profile: "S.Y. Su - Jiangdu Polytechnic." Last login: 18 months ago.

CHEN YIHAN
The IP trace?

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
Residential fiber. But her early posts—she tagged them with spectrography timestamps. Lab-grade precision.

Chen clicks through archived posts. Stops on one: "Had to leave the synthesis midway. Baby's crying. Will yield hold at 4°C?"

CHEN YIHAN
(murmurs)
She was working from home. With an infant.

He straightens, decision crystallizing.

CHEN YIHAN
Move the biotech summit to Jiangdu. Book the university's presentation hall.

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
Sir, that's three days away—

CHEN YIHAN
Also find out which preschools in Jiangdu have structural engineering toys on their supply list.

He reaches for his jacket.

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
You're going yourself? We could send a team—

CHEN YIHAN
Talent like this doesn't respond to teams. She responds to knowing someone read her footnotes.

He exits, leaving the monitors glowing with Su Yingxia's forgotten research.

ZHANG JINGYAN stands by the floor-to-ceiling windows, phone to his ear, watching the city lights flicker on. His desk displays a half-eaten takeout container, spreadsheets glowing on his monitor.

ZHANG JINGYAN
(weary)
System migration. You know how it is.

SU YINGXIA (V.O.)
Tonight was supposed to be—

ZHANG JINGYAN
I'll grab something here. Don't wait up.

He ends the call. Su lowers the phone, then forcefully taps "Reset" on a kitchen timer.

Behind Zhang, LUO QING enters with a tablet, her red suit jacket draped over one arm.

LUO QING
The Singapore brief. Final signatures.

Zhang turns, accepts the tablet. Their fingers brush. Luo Qing leans against his desk, close but not touching.

LUO QING
She's still tracking your dinner hour?

ZHANG JINGYAN
Old habits.

He signs with a flourish. Luo Qing's reflection in the window shows a small, satisfied smile.

LUO QING
The board's reviewing headcount next week. They prefer... streamlined households.

ZHANG JINGYAN
(glances at her)
I'm handling my side of the streamlining.

Their eyes meet in the glass.

INT. CHEN YIHAN'S OFFICE - DAY

CHEN YIHAN sits behind his desk, studying three monitors: one shows a compound formula, another a patent database, the third—his assistant's face via video call.

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
We ran the simulation ten times. The stabilization matrix is identical to Project Ghost.

CHEN YIHAN
Publication date?

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
Three years ago. Then... nothing. No citations, no follow-ups.

Chen zooms on the author profile: "S.Y. Su - Jiangdu Polytechnic." Last login: 18 months ago.

CHEN YIHAN
The IP trace?

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
Residential fiber. But her early posts—she tagged them with spectrography timestamps. Lab-grade precision.

Chen clicks through archived posts. Stops on one: "Had to leave the synthesis midway. Baby's crying. Will yield hold at 4°C?"

CHEN YIHAN
(murmurs)
She was working from home. With an infant.

He straightens, decision crystallizing.

CHEN YIHAN
Move the biotech summit to Jiangdu. Book the university's presentation hall.

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
Sir, that's three days away—

CHEN YIHAN
Also find out which preschools in Jiangdu have structural engineering toys on their supply list.

He reaches for his jacket.

AN JINGJING (V.O.)
You're going yourself? We could send a team—

CHEN YIHAN
Talent like this doesn't respond to teams. She responds to knowing someone read her footnotes.

He exits, leaving the monitors glowing with Su Yingxia's forgotten research.

title: Invincible From the Womb
description: A celestial being chooses to fall to the mortal realm rather than marry a persistent princess, only to be reborn and face new challenges.
context:
Title: Invincible From the Womb
Description: A celestial being chooses to fall to the mortal realm rather than marry a persistent princess, only to be reborn and face new challenges.

EXT. HEAVENLY REALM - ABOVE THE SEA OF CLOUDS - DAY

YE CHEN rides a burning fire dragon, flying through the immortal mist-wreathed sea of clouds. In the distance stand magnificent celestial palace buildings.

YE CHEN kneels on his dragon, black energy tearing through his body as his cultivation core destabilizes. Blood trickles from his lips.

YE CHEN (V.O.)
Invincible from the womb—yet this final step to Immortal Emperor has blocked me for a thousand years. What is "hardship"?

A woman in gorgeous red robes, DI AOSHUANG, appears in a ripple of light, a red marriage contract glowing in her hand.

DI AOSHUANG looks at the struggling YE CHEN.

DI AOSHUANG
Give it up. You were born a prodigy, never tested. Your Dao heart is incomplete. You'll never break through this way.

YE CHEN opens his eyes, his gaze cold.

YE CHEN
Then teach me, Princess. Or leave me to fail.

YE CHEN stands, noticing her robes with dawning realization.

YE CHEN
Red Phoenix bridal silk. Who's the fortunate groom?

DI AOSHUANG
You're the only one who recognizes it. The only one worthy of it.

YE CHEN
Spare me. Over these thousand years, you've asked me one hundred fifty-three thousand five hundred eighty-two times to dual cultivate. Persistence is not fate.

DI AOSHUANG laughs and unfurls the marriage contract. Golden characters blaze.

DI AOSHUANG
Father's seal says otherwise. Either you marry me now, or you fall to the mortal realm with your power sealed.

YE CHEN's smile vanishes. He stares at the contract's binding clauses.

YE CHEN
You would chain what you cannot understand?

DI AOSHUANG
I would bind what is mine.

She reaches for his hand to place on the contract.

DI AOSHUANG (CONT'D)
Sign it. Choose the easier path.

YE CHEN pushes her hand away. His voice is quiet but absolute.

YE CHEN
I choose the path I was never given.

YE CHEN shatters his own core. Golden light explodes as he falls toward the mortal realm. DI AOSHUANG holds the burning contract, her voice echoing.

DI AOSHUANG
Fall then! Powerless from the start, just like everyone else. I'll be waiting when you remember who you were!
continuation:
INT. MORTAL REALM - TUNNEL - DAY

YE CHEN's reincarnation, TIAN CHENG, and a girl named YAO YAO run through a narrow tunnel, panic on their faces. TIAN CHENG's eyes flicker with faint golden light as he stumbles.

YAO YAO
Tian Cheng! Your eyes—

Several men in black suits catch up to them. The lead man notices the light with unease.

SUITED MAN
Boss wants his money. The glowing trick won't save you.

YAO YAO helps TIAN CHENG up and shields him.

YAO YAO
Run! They need me alive—

TIAN CHENG breaks free and stands before her. Above, a dragon's roar echoes faintly. The suited man's subordinates flinch back.

TIAN CHENG
I won't let them use you.

A red energy ball—Di Aoshuang's seal—crashes through the ceiling and strikes YAO YAO's abdomen.

SUBORDINATE
Out of the way!

YAO YAO is hit. She clutches her stomach, a crimson mark burning into her skin.

FADE OUT.

title: He Arrives with Cupid
description: A wounded heir fleeing assassins in a misty forest is rescued by a mysterious young woman with extraordinary medical skills who discovers his hidden identity.
context:
Title: He Arrives with Cupid
Description: A wounded heir fleeing assassins in a misty forest is rescued by a mysterious young woman with extraordinary medical skills who discovers his hidden identity.

INT. FOREST - NIGHT

Mist curls through ancient trees, swallowing sound.

FU TINGYE sprints through darkness, one hand clutching his bleeding chest. Behind him, BLACK-CLAD ASSASSINS wielding short blades pursue relentlessly.

ASSASSIN LEADER
Fan out. He can't run far.

ASSASSIN
Blood trail leads east.

Fu Tingye's breath hitches. He veers left, shoulder scraping bark.

ASSASSIN LEADER
The wound was deep. He'll bleed out.

Fu Tingye's legs buckle. He catches himself against a moss-covered trunk, breathing heavily. Assassins materialize in a tightening circle, blades glinting.

FU TINGYE
(gasping)
You know what this means... if you kill me.

ASSASSIN LEADER
(predatory sneer)
We know exactly who we're killing. The last son of the Fu family.

The Leader raises his blade. Fu Tingye's eyes close—

A sound cuts through air. The Leader's blade CLATTERS to ground.

ASSASSIN LEADER
What—

A figure materializes from mist—SHEN XINGWAN, carrying a bamboo basket.

SHEN XINGWAN
(mildly)
This is a protected mountain. No hunting.

She flicks her wrist. A cloud of fine powder blooms. Assassins stagger, coughing, then drop.

SHEN XINGWAN
(crouching)
Sleepwell powder. They'll wake in three days... with headaches.
continuation:
She approaches Fu Tingye, who tenses, hand moving to hidden dagger.

FU TINGYE
(rasping)
Who—

SHEN XINGWAN
Someone saving your life. Unless you'd rather bleed.

She nods to his wound, already darkening his coat. Fu Tingye's grip weakens.

FU TINGYE
This forest is death to outsiders. You walk through it like a garden.

SHEN XINGWAN
(smiling slightly)
I planted some of those poisonous flowers. They mind their gardener.

She uncorks a gourd, pouring amber powder directly into his wound. He flinches but doesn't cry out.

SHEN XINGWAN
Hold still. This clots bleeding. Or faint and make it easier.

FU TINGYE
Can you... counter Heartvalve poison?

SHEN XINGWAN
(eyes sharp)
Whoever stabbed you wanted it to look natural. Smart.
She pulls silver needles from her basket.
But I'm smarter.

She chews a bitter root, spits paste onto leaf, presses it to his wound. With other hand, she inserts needles—one at his temple, one near his heart.

FU TINGYE convulses, coughs black blood onto moss, slumps unconscious.

SHEN XINGWAN
(pressing fingers to neck)
Pulse stabilizing. Good.

She begins cleaning her tools, then pauses. Something catches her eye—at his hairline, a slight edge where skin meets not-skin. She peels carefully.

A translucent membrane lifts away, revealing different features—sharper, younger.

SHEN XINGWAN
(whisper)
Well. You're not just a fugitive. You're a ghost.

Fu Tingye doesn't hear. He's already gone.

title: His Exclusive Love
description: A young woman escapes her brother-in-law's harassment through a blind date, only to be proposed to immediately by a mysterious and handsome man.
context:
Title: His Exclusive Love
Description: A young woman escapes her brother-in-law's harassment through a blind date, only to be proposed to immediately by a mysterious and handsome man.

EXT. BUSY CITY STREET - DAY

LU XI (22, determined but exhausted) hurries down the sidewalk, clutching a worn duffel bag and her phone.

ZHUANG YI (V.O.)
Xixi, Brother Jiang's waiting. He doesn't know you're coming—Mom set this up for him. But listen: he's stable, he's single, and he's your ticket out of that house. Just don't scare him off.

FLASHBACK BEGINS:

INT. LUXURY PENTHOUSE - DAY

LU XI folds laundry while CHE NAN (40s, predatory) watches from the doorway.

CHE NAN
Your sister's at the spa until midnight. We could... renegotiate your living arrangement. Again.

He slides a key across the counter—his "private study."

CHE NAN (CONT'D)
Might be more comfortable than the storage room.

Lu Xi grips the laundry so tightly her knuckles whiten.

FLASHBACK ENDS.

LU XI
(into the phone, voice tight)
My bags are already packed. If this falls through, I'm sleeping in the office lobby tonight.

ZHUANG YI (V.O.)
Then sell it, Xixi. Make him see you're the solution to his problems too. And hurry—he's leaving in fifteen minutes.

LU XI
I remember. Pen in the pocket.

She hangs up, squares her shoulders, and pushes through the cafe door.
continuation:
INT. CAFE - DAY

LU XI scans the room, spotting a MAN in a bespoke suit, pen gleaming in his pocket, reading Financial Weekly.

She freezes. She knows that face—FU NANZHOU (30s, glacially poised), graced last month's "30 Under 30" cover.

LU XI steels herself and approaches.

LU XI
Mr. Fu? I'm Lu Xi. Zhuang Yi's... friend.

FU NANZHOU
(looks up, assessing)
She didn't mention sending a replacement.

LU XI sits without waiting for permission.

LU XI
She didn't mention sending me to a CEO either. But you're here, I'm here, and neither of us wants to be.

FU NANZHOU raises an eyebrow, intrigued despite himself.

FU NANZHOU
Impressive. You have two minutes.

LU XI
Your board thinks you're unstable. My brother-in-law thinks I'm available. We can solve both problems permanently.

She slides her ID onto the table.

LU XI (CONT'D)
A marriage certificate. Today. No strings, no expectations. Just a contract that gets everyone off our backs.

FU NANZHOU checks his phone: "BOARD MEETING IN 90 MINUTES. HOPE YOU'VE SOLVED YOUR 'FAMILY MAN' IMAGE."

He studies her—her bruised knuckles, the duffel bag, the fierce desperation in her eyes.

FU NANZHOU
Vows are legally binding, Miss Lu. Even the ones made to strangers.

LU XI
Then let's make them count.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED
