title: His Love Came Just in Time
description: A young girl searches for her father, a wealthy CEO, to save her mother from danger.
context:
Title: His Love Came Just in Time
Description: A young girl searches for her father, a wealthy CEO, to save her mother from danger.

INT. BUS - DAY

YUEYUE (six or seven) sits hunched in her seat, clutching a worn magazine. Rain streaks the window.

CONDUCTOR (O.S.)
Next stop, West Station. Tickets, please.

The CONDUCTOR stops beside Yueyue, glancing at her mud-stained backpack.

CONDUCTOR
Where to, little one?

YUEYUE
(softly)
The capital.

CONDUCTOR
That's ¥150. What you've got... maybe ¥20?

YUEYUE
( showing the magazine)
My father will pay when I find him. He's Mo Yunpei.

The bus lurches. Passengers murmur. A MAN scoffs.

MAN
Everyone in the capital wishes Mo Yunpei was their daddy.

CONDUCTOR
(sighing)
Rules are rules. I can't let you ride.

YUEYUE
Please. My mother needs—

CONDUCTOR
Off at the next stop. I'll say I miscounted.
continuation:
EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

YUEYUE stands in the rain as the bus pulls away. The magazine falls open. A photo of MO YUNPEI at a gala—circled in red marker.

She picks herself up, counts the wet bills, and starts walking along the highway.

YUEYUE
(to herself)
Mom said the capital is north. Just keep north.

A truck horn blares. Yueyue stumbles back, falling. A silver bracelet slips from her sleeve—engraved with the Mo family crest.

YUEYUE
(touching the bracelet)
Mom, I won't let them hurt you again.

FLASHBACK - INT. ROOM - DAY

CHENG SINING, bruises on her wrists, packs a backpack. She pins the magazine photo inside Yueyue's jacket.

CHENG SINING
This came out the week you were born. If I'm not at the station by morning, take the bracelet to him. He'll know.

END FLASHBACK

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

Yueyue wipes mud from her face. Headlights appear in the distance—a black luxury sedan.

She holds up the magazine, waving frantically.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

MO YUNPEI reviews contracts. WU PEIYI watches the rain.

WU PEIYI
Slow down. That child's going to get herself—

Through the rain-streaked window: Yueyue's bracelet catches the light.

WU PEIYI
( sharp intake of breath)
Stop the car. Now.

DRIVER
Sir?

MO YUNPEI
(glancing up)
Mother?

WU PEIYI
That bracelet—

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

The car stops. MO YUNPEI steps out, briefcase in hand.

YUEYUE runs to him, hugging his leg. Rainwater drips from her hair.

YUEYUE
(crying)
Dad, please. Mom needs help.

MO YUNPEI
(staring at the bracelet)
Where did you get that?

YUEYUE
Mom gave it to me. She said you'd know.

Mo's grip tightens on the briefcase. He looks from the bracelet to the magazine in Yueyue's hand—the circled photo, the date.

MO YUNPEI
(quietly)
What's your mother's name?

YUEYUE
Cheng Sining. She's waiting—

MO YUNPEI
(to Driver)
Call Dr. Chen. Tell him we have an emergency.

Mo kneels, his hand trembling as he touches the bracelet.

MO YUNPEI
(whisper)
Get in the car.

title: The Revenant Sisters
description: Two sisters perish in betrayal within a royal tomb, only to awaken in their shared past. When both carry the weight of memory, their second chance becomes a battlefield of revenge and redemption.
context:
Title: The Revenant Sisters
Description: Two sisters perish in betrayal within a royal tomb, only to awaken in their shared past. When both carry the weight of memory, their second chance becomes a battlefield of revenge and redemption.

INT. IMPERIAL TOMB RUINS - NIGHT

A suffocating chamber. Torn paper clings to rotting window frames. One candle drips wax onto stone, its flame guttering.

LUO XIAN'ER, skeletally thin, lips cracked, trembles on moldy straw. Each breath rattles.

FEMALE GUARD (V.O.)
First Princess arrives.

Footsteps echo. LUO JUN'ER enters, silk robes brushing grime. She kneels, her perfume cutting the rot.

LUO XIAN'ER
(rasping)
Sister.

LUO JUN'ER
(softly)
I'm here. I've secured your release.

She helps Xian'er sit. Their hands touch—Xian'er's fingers like ice.

LUO XIAN'ER
Closer. A secret.

Jun'er leans in. Xian'er's empty sleeve slides back. A hairpin flashes—drives into Jun'er's chest with practiced precision.

LUO JUN'ER
(gasp)
Xian'er...

The guard lunges forward.

FEMALE GUARD
Guards! Guards!

Xian'er twists the pin deeper, her wasted face inches from Jun'er's.

LUO XIAN'ER
(whispering, vehement)
You remember that day—when you 'saved' me from Prince An? How you wept, saying you'd take my place? I died in his tomb because of your kindness. Your perfect, righteous kindness.

Blood spreads across silk. Jun'er's hands clutch her sister's, not to push away, but in desperate reflex.

LUO XIAN'ER
(laughing wetly)
You came to watch me end. But endings... can be shared.

They collapse together, the candle extinguished in pooling blood.

TRANSITION:
continuation:
INT. LUO RESIDENCE BEDROOM - DAY

Morning light filters through delicate silk curtains. LUO JUN'ER's eyes snap open, pupils contracting too fast.

GU QIN sits embroidering, needle freezing mid-stitch.

GU QIN
Miss? You've been delirious—

LUO JUN'ER (V.O.)
...the pin... her laugh... impossible.

She bolts upright. Her hands—unblemished—clutch her chest. No wound.

GU QIN
The Master summoned you twice. About the marriage arrangements.

The word "marriage" lands like a hammer. Jun'er's gaze snaps to the calendar: the tenth year of Yonghe. Ten years before.

EXT. LUO RESIDENCE COURTYARD - DAY

Jun'er moves through the garden on unsteady legs. Then—her sister's voice, sharp and young, exactly as memory preserved it.

LUO XIAN'ER (V.O.)
Father, exchange our betrothals! Let Luo Jun'er wed Prince An—I insist on Xia Yuecheng!

Jun'er halts. A petal drifts onto her shoulder. She doesn't brush it away.

LUO JUN'ER (V.O.)
...the same words. The same tone. The same choice that killed us both.

Her lips part. Not quite a smile. Something colder. More certain.

LUO JUN'ER (V.O.)
Then we both remember.

She continues toward the study, her shadow stretching long across the stones.

title: In the Name of Brotherhood
description: A man is poisoned and betrayed by his wife and best friend on his birthday, only for his powerful brother to learn of his death and vow revenge.
context:
Title: In the Name of Brotherhood
Description: A man is poisoned and betrayed by his wife and best friend on his birthday, only for his powerful brother to learn of his death and vow revenge.

INT. LAKESIDE CABIN - NIGHT

XIAO TINGSHENG and WU YUTING share a candlelit dinner. A birthday cake sits between them. Their wine glasses meet with a soft CLINK.

XIAO TINGSHENG
You brought me all this way for my birthday?

WU YUTING
(smiling strangely)
Some journeys are necessary.

She stands, moves to his lap, her arms around his neck.

WU YUTING
(softly)
I have news.

She guides his hand to her stomach.

XIAO TINGSHENG
(beat, then joy)
The doctors said—

WU YUTING
(cutting him off)
They were wrong.

She returns to her seat. Raises her glass.

WU YUTING
To family.

He drinks. She doesn't. He notices.

XIAO TINGSHENG
You're not drinking?

WU YUTING
I changed my mind.

The door opens. XIMEN QING enters, pours himself wine from their bottle.

XIMEN QING
Three months of careful preparation.
continuation:
XIAO TINGSHENG
(realizing)
The vitamins... the medical reports...

XIMEN QING
Undetectable. Slow-acting. Tonight's dose was the accelerator.

XIAO TINGSHENG
(struggling to stand)
My company—

XIMEN QING
Your proxy votes transferred yesterday. Your signature is perfect.

XIMEN QING shows documents. Tingsheng weakens.

XIAO TINGSHENG
(weak)
Mother...

WU YUTING
Will be cared for.

XIAO TINGSHENG
(voice fading)
You won't...

XIMEN QING
We already have.

XIMEN QING assists Tingsheng back into his chair. Pours the remaining wine on the floor. Drops a lighter. Flames rise.

INT. EMPEROR ORGANIZATION HEADQUARTERS HALL - DAY

Several men dressed in elaborate foreign attire kneel before XIAO TINGYUAN.

WESTERN FAMILY REPRESENTATIVE
We pledge our assets to your organization.

A SUBORDINATE approaches with a phone.

SUBORDINATE
Your brother's emergency beacon, sir. Activated two minutes ago.

XIAO TINGYUAN reads the message. His knuckles whiten.

XIAO TINGYUAN
(decisively)
The meeting is over. Prepare the plane.

title: Temptation by Design (Episode 51)
description: A woman wakes up in a hospital to find herself recruited into a revenge scheme by her enemy's adoptive brother, who offers her a new identity as his deceased sister.
context:
Title: Temptation by Design (Episode 51)
Description: A woman wakes up in a hospital to find herself recruited into a revenge scheme by her enemy's adoptive brother, who offers her a new identity as his deceased sister.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Sunlight cuts through blinds, striping the sterile room. The FEMALE LEAD stirs, her fingers twitching against white sheets. A heartbeat monitor beeps steadily.

GU SHIYAN sits in shadows, his face half-lit. He leans forward as her eyes flutter open.

GU SHIYAN
(gently)
Welcome back.

The FEMALE LEAD jolts upright, pain flashing across her features. Her hand flies to her bandaged ribs.

FEMALE LEAD
(her voice raw)
Did they—

GU SHIYAN
(interrupting)
He thinks you're dead. The river current helped.

She studies him, her gaze sharpening despite the drugs. She notices his expensive watch, the way he doesn't quite sit like a worried relative.

FEMALE LEAD
You're not a doctor.

GU SHIYAN
(observing her closely)
No. I'm the man who pulled you out. And the man who can put you back in.

A beat. She understands.

FEMALE LEAD
Gu Ruosheng's brother.

GU SHIYAN
(slight nod)
Gu Shiyan. You've done your homework.

FEMALE LEAD
(defensive edge)
When your husband tries to kill you, you learn his enemies.

She winces, touching her throat—fingerprint bruises still visible.

GU SHIYAN
(quietly)
My adopted sister Gu Yan spent twenty-three years in a private facility. Three days ago, she died during an "experimental therapy" session. Her death certificate is still warm.

He slides a leather folder onto her lap. She doesn't open it.

GU SHIYAN
Gu Ruosheng signed the transfer papers himself. Another loose end tied.

FEMALE LEAD
(whisper)
Why would I become someone else's ghost?

GU SHIYAN
Because Gu Yan was heir to fifteen percent of Gu Group shares. Because as her, you can walk into any room. Because I saw your face in the water—calm. Like someone who'd already died and decided to come back anyway.

She finally opens the folder. A photo: a fragile girl with her same build, similar eyes.

FEMALE LEAD
(softly)
I don't know how to be her.

GU SHIYAN
You don't have to. You just have to be angry enough to pretend.

He places a small keycard on the file.

GU SHIYAN
Room 314. Her personal effects. I'll give you tonight to decide if you want to keep breathing as a corpse... or start living as a weapon.

He leaves. She stares at the photo—at the girl who could be her sister, her mirror. Her hands tremble.
continuation:
INT. PRESS CONFERENCE VENUE - DAY

The ballroom hums with camera clicks and hushed greed. The backdrop looms: "Lin-Fu Group Merger."

CEO FU adjusts his black mourning armband, playing the grieving widower. His smile is carefully broken.

Below, GUEST 1 checks his phone, leaning to his companion.

GUEST 1
(quietly)
Lin's stock dropped forty percent since the "accident." Efficient way to clear a boardroom.

GUEST 2
Still. Killing your wife? That's—

GUEST 1
That's what happens when you marry your accountant's daughter.

At the podium, CEO FU taps the microphone. The room hushes.

CEO FU
(voice cracking)
My beloved wife lost her battle with depression. In her memory, I've chosen to merge Lin Group—her family's legacy—with Fu Group. Together, we will honor her by building something stronger.

A FEMALE REPORTER stands, her press badge catching light.

FEMALE REPORTER
CEO Fu, sources claim Fu Group's debt load exceeds assets by three hundred million. They allege this "merger" is asset stripping, and your wife discovered the scheme before her death.

The room holds its breath.

A COLD VOICE cuts through from the back row.

GU YAN (O.S.)
She discovered more than that.

Heads turn. GU YAN rises, wearing Gu Yan's signature ivory blazer. She walks with a limp—the real Gu Yan's childhood injury. CEO FU's face drains.

GU YAN
(approaching slowly)
She discovered the offshore accounts. The falsified therapy records. TheDates. She found out you were going to kill her three weeks before the wedding.

She stops ten feet from the stage, her eyes locked on his.

GU YAN
You even asked if I'd be your maid of honor. Remember?

CEO FU
(stammering)
Gu Yan is—that's impossible, she's—

Suddenly, the projectors flicker. Documents, signatures, therapy dates flash across the backdrop. The flyers aren't thrown—they cascade from the ceiling like judgment.

CLOSE-UP: A photo floats down—CEO FU and a doctor exchanging money outside a psychiatric facility.

GUEST 3
(catching one)
My god. That's his signature on the commitment papers.

GUEST 4
He committed his own sister-in-law?

CEO FU stumbles backward as the papers rain down. One sticks to his shoe: "Patient Gu Yan: Termination Authorization."

GU YAN
(her voice carrying)
You wanted a merger? Here's your paperwork.

Camera flashes strobe like lightning. CEO FU clutches the podium, his ashen face reflecting in the dying projector light.

title: Disguised Affection
description: A woman drugged at a hotel encounters a man in the same condition, leading to a fateful night that echoes a traumatic past orchestrated by her scheming family.
context:
Title: Disguised Affection
Description: A woman drugged at a hotel encounters a man in the same condition, leading to a fateful night that echoes a traumatic past orchestrated by her scheming family.

INT. HOTEL BATHROOM - NIGHT

GU BEISHENG, wearing a red blouse, holding a wine glass, staggers into the bathroom. She places the glass on the sink, looking dizzy and disoriented.

She turns on the faucet and splashes cold water on her face, trying to stay conscious.

GU BEISHENG (V.O.)
I feel terrible. Something's wrong with that drink.

In the mirror, a man, FU XIZHOU, appears at the doorway. He removes his suit jacket.

GU BEISHENG
Who are you?

FU XIZHOU steadies himself against the doorframe, breathing heavily.

FU XIZHOU
Same question.

He stumbles toward her. She backs against the sink. They both waver, drugged.

GU BEISHENG
(struggling)
The wine...

FU XIZHOU clutches the sink edge beside her. They lock eyes, recognizing mutual desperation.

FU XIZHOU
(quietly)
They got you too.

He leans close, not predatory—trying to focus. His fingers, trembling, brush her earring. It slips, falling to the floor with a sharp CLICK.

FU XIZHOU (V.O.)
Now I understand everything. She was drugged too. The earring is proof.

They gaze deeply into each other's eyes, then kiss. FU XIZHOU lifts GU BEISHENG into his arms and carries her toward the room.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

FU XIZHOU gently lays GU BEISHENG on the bed.

GU BEISHENG
(hazily)
Don't.

FU XIZHOU holds her hand.

FU XIZHOU
I won't leave you here.

He leans closer to her.

FU XIZHOU
I remember you.

INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - FLASHBACK (FIVE YEARS AGO)

GU BEISHENG lies on the delivery bed, screaming in pain during childbirth. Doctors and nurses surround her.

GU BEISHENG (V.O.)
Five years ago, I was framed and violated, then became pregnant and gave birth to a stillborn child.

Through the small window in the operating room door, she sees her stepmother XU HUIRONG and sister GU XINYU watching her coldly.

INT. PSYCHIATRIC HOSPITAL - FLASHBACK

GU BEISHENG (V.O.)
To seize the shares my grandmother left me, my family had me committed to a psychiatric hospital.

An older man (FAMILY MEMBER) and a woman force GU BEISHENG to place her fingerprint on documents.

FAMILY MEMBER
Sign it, now!

GU BEISHENG struggles fiercely, breaks free from her restraints, and runs through the ward, trying to escape. Several medical staff in white coats chase after her.

MEDICAL STAFF
Catch her! Don't let her get away!

GU BEISHENG
Let me go!

She is caught and guided back to her room.

GU BEISHENG
(desperately)
This is illegal!

INT. PSYCHIATRIC HOSPITAL WARD - PRESENT DAY

GU BEISHENG wakes from a nightmare, lying in an empty ward.

GU BEISHENG
(terrified)
No!

A doctor wearing a mask enters the ward.

DOCTOR
Gu Beisheng, your family is here to pick you up.

At the doorway, GU XINYU and XU HUIRONG look at her with triumphant smiles.

GU BEISHENG
(fearfully)
Stay away!

GU XINYU
Sister, we've found you a good match.

XU HUIRONG
You'll be discharged very soon.

GU BEISHENG clutches her pillow tightly, her eyes filled with fear and hatred.

INT. LUXURY VILLA - DAY

FU XIZHOU stands on the second-floor balcony, cutting and lighting a cigar before taking a puff.

FU XIZHOU
(to his subordinates below)
I asked you to find a woman. Five years and you still can't find her.

He angrily throws the cigar to the ground.

FU XIZHOU
A bunch of useless fools!

The subordinates bow collectively.

FU XIZHOU
Keep searching. I must find her whereabouts.

XU HUIRONG
You'll be discharged very soon.

GU BEISHENG clutches her pillow tightly, her eyes filled with fear and hatred.

INT. LUXURY VILLA - DAY

FU XIZHOU stands on the second-floor balcony, cutting and lighting a cigar before taking a puff.

FU XIZHOU
(to his subordinates below)
I asked you to find a woman. Five years and you still can't find her.

He angrily throws the cigar to the ground.

FU XIZHOU
A bunch of useless fools!

The subordinates bow collectively.

FU XIZHOU
Keep searching. I must find her whereabouts.

title: Switched at Birth
description: A vengeful servant switches two newborns during a stormy night at a rural hospital, setting in motion a tale of mistaken identities and separated families.
context:
Title: Switched at Birth
Description: A vengeful servant switches two newborns during a stormy night at a rural hospital, setting in motion a tale of mistaken identities and separated families.

INT. VILLAGE HOSPITAL - NIGHT

Rain lashes a dark window. HE XI runs beside her HUSBAND as he pushes a hospital bed. On it, ZHAO WANRU, 25, writhes in advanced labor.

HE XI
(shouting)
Doctor! My mistress—she's breech!

ZHAO WANRU
(screaming through contraction)
Don't let me die in this filth!

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Narrow, dimly lit. The HUSBAND swerves to avoid a water bucket—COLLIDES with SU SHANHE, 40s, on crutches. Both men crash down.

HE XI
Clumsy oaf!

HUSBAND
(struggling up)
Do you know whose child that is? One word from her and we—

SU YUQIAO'S ADOPTIVE MOTHER stumbles from a doorway, clutching her belly.

SU YUQIAO'S ADOPTIVE MOTHER
You maniac! You could've killed him!

She shoves He Xi. He Xi recoils, knocking the woman against the wall. She doubles over, gasping, water soaking her dress.

SU SHANHE
No— the baby! It's too soon!

He hammers on a supply closet.

SU SHANHE
Nurse! My wife—she's bleeding!

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - LATER

He Xi and her Husband slump against opposite walls, soaked in rain and dread.

HUSBAND
(soft)
Flash flood on the main road. We had no choice.

HE XI
(whisper)
If she blames us... Mingming pays the price.

The DELIVERY ROOM DOOR opens. A NURSE steps out.

NURSE
Zhao Wanru? Mother and daughter are stable.

He Xi's breath hitches—relief and something darker.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

Lightning flickers. ZHAO WANRU lies on starched sheets, already scrolling on her phone, untouched water beside her.

ZHAO WANRU
(without looking up)
Where is it?

HE XI enters, clipboard in hand.

HE XI
The nurse will bring her soon. You should—

ZHAO WANRU
(razor-sharp)
Should? I should be in a private suite, not this sewer. She kicks the bedframe. He Xi flinches.

ZHAO WANRU
My daughter deserves a proper welcome. Not whatever diseases linger in your poverty. Fetch her. And pray she's perfect.

INT. NURSERY - NIGHT

He Xi stands before two cribs. Storm knocked out half the lights. One card: "MOTHER: ZHAO WANRU." The other: "MOTHER: SU YUQIAO'S MOTHER."

Zhao's baby sleeps fitfully. The Su baby is calm, thumb in mouth.

HE XI
(whisper)
You'd be her mirror. Her little monster.

Her hand strays to her knee—old pain.

FLASHBACK

INT. MANSION - DAY

One month ago. He Xi scrubs marble floors. ZHAO WANRU glides past. He Xi shifts the bucket—too slow. Water darkens silk hem.

SECOND MAID
Mistress! It won't happen again!

HE XI
(whisper)
My son needs this job. Please.

ZHAO WANRU
(cold)
My Mingming fell because of you. He still has the scar.

She lifts a crystal bowl—drops it. SHATTER.

ZHAO WANRU
Kneel.

HE XI
Mistress—

ZHAO WANRU
Or I call the authorities. Your boy becomes a ward of the state.

He Xi kneels. Glass bites through fabric. Blood pools.

ZHAO WANRU
Some people are born to serve. Some are born to be served.

She nods. The Second Maid slaps He Xi—once, twice. Mechanically. Ashamed.

HE XI
(soft)
Mingming... forgive me...

END FLASHBACK

INT. NURSERY - NIGHT

Back to the present. HE XI looks at ZHAO WANRU's crying baby daughter. Her hand trembles above the crib.

The Su infant stirs, opens eyes—dark, like her son's. He Xi notices a strawberry birthmark on the girl's wrist. Identical to Mingming's.

HE XI
(whisper)
God forgive me.

She lifts the Su baby. The child nuzzles into her neck, trusting. He Xi holds her close—one moment of tenderness.

Then, trembling, she places the Su baby in Zhao's crib. Lifts Zhao's daughter.

HE XI
(to the baby girl)
She'll never know you. And you'll never know her poison.

HE XI cradles the infant, her face a mask of pain and fierce possession. She disappears into the thunder.

title: Courting Death Villain: You Dare Kidnap the Immortal's Daughter
description: A young girl with immortal powers searches for a mother for her cultivator father, but gets kidnapped by mysterious assailants.
context:
Title: Courting Death Villain: You Dare Kidnap the Immortal's Daughter
Description: A young girl with immortal powers searches for a mother for her cultivator father, but gets kidnapped by mysterious assailants.

INT. MODERN BUILDING ENTRANCE - DAY

A SECURITY GUARD dozes against the wall.

SU KEKE, a little girl with double braids, wearing ancient-style clothing and round sunglasses, sits leisurely on a high platform with a blade of grass in her mouth.

SU KEKE (V.O.)
Dad's too busy cultivating all day. No way, I need to find myself a mom.

A black Mercedes speeds in and stops with a beautiful drift.

AN NING, a young woman in a black business suit with a cold demeanor, gets out of the car.

SU KEKE (V.O.)
Found Dad's destined woman.

SU KEKE leaps down from the high platform, her movements light and graceful like a fairy descending, landing gently.

EXT. COMMERCIAL STREET - DAY

AN NING and her maid XIAO LIAN walk down the street.

XIAO LIAN
Miss, the board is pressuring you again. They say a marriage alliance is the only way to save the company.

AN NING
I told you, I will not marry.

XIAO LIAN
He's a married man who vanished ten years ago. After his wife left, he took his daughter and sealed himself away. You have to let him go.

AN NING
I...

SU KEKE suddenly pops her head out between them, grinning.

SU KEKE
Beautiful sister! Looking for a husband? My dad just became available—you're exactly his type.

AN NING
(sternly)
Little friend, tell your father that child exploitation is a crime. Don't let me see you again.

AN NING and XIAO LIAN turn to leave.

SU KEKE
(shouting after them)
Hey, I'm not a scammer! My name is Su Keke, I live on Qinghua Mountain, and my dad is Su--

Suddenly, the jade pendant necklace around SU KEKE's neck glows with warning light, then shatters.
continuation:
SU KEKE
(surprised)
My life-bound object broke.

A black van screeches to a halt beside SU KEKE. Two men in black combat uniforms get out.

KIDNAPPER 1
Move.

The two kidnappers rush toward SU KEKE.

SU KEKE
Who are you?

SU KEKE easily dodges their attacks, kicks one into a nearby trash bin, and uses her inner force to blast the other back.

SU KEKE
(proudly)
You dare challenge me?

The KIDNAPPER LEADER steps out from behind the van, his presence overwhelming.

KIDNAPPER LEADER
Miss.

SU KEKE channels her inner force, but it shatters against him. He doesn't budge.

SU KEKE
(thinking)
That suppression... Martial Master realm.

SU KEKE immediately changes her expression, putting on an innocent smile, and runs toward the KIDNAPPER LEADER.

SU KEKE
Daddy, you're here!

She pretends to hug him.

KIDNAPPER LEADER
Petty tricks.

The KIDNAPPER LEADER grabs SU KEKE, lifts her up, and shoves her into the van.

SU KEKE
(sticking her head out the window, shouting)
Beautiful sister, save me!

In the distance, AN NING hears the cry and whips her head around.

AN NING
(angrily)
Human traffickers!

Energy fluctuations ripple around AN NING's body, her eyes flashing with recognition—and fury.

title: You and Time Are Both Sweet
description: A pregnant surrogate discovers the child she carries is genetically the Pei heir's, but he believes she's a gold-digger trying to trap him into marriage.
context:
Title: You and Time Are Both Sweet
Description: A pregnant surrogate discovers the child she carries is genetically the Pei heir's, but he believes she's a gold-digger trying to trap him into marriage.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

LIN MOMO, eight months pregnant, touches her belly while holding a FOLDED DOCUMENT.

LIN MOMO
(whispering)
Almost here, little one. Almost a real family—

The door SLAMS open. PEI YOUQI enters in a hospital gown, his wrist bandaged.

LIN MOMO
(startled)
Pei Youqi—

PEI YOUQI
You just couldn't wait, could you? Demanding marriage before my mother even—

LIN MOMO
That's not what happened!

PEI YOUQI
(grabbing her wrist)
Fang Xue showed me the emails. Fifteen million and a wedding? For what—a contract baby?

LIN MOMO
(struggling)
You're wrong! The tests prove—

PEI YOUQI
I don't want your fake tests! You think bleeding our family dry makes you worthy?

LIN MOMO
(desperate)
The cord blood matches your mother! That's all I—

PEI YOUQI
(laughing)
I found a better donor. You're expendable.

He shoves her shoulder. She stumbles, trips, and CRASHES to the floor.

LIN MOMO
(screaming)
The baby—he's yours! The paternity—

PEI YOUQI
(crouching)
Stop performing.

He stands, turns toward the door.

LIN MOMO
(crying out)
Pei Youqi! Please! Our child's only hope—

PEI YOUQI
Don't follow me.

He exits. Lin Momo curls on the floor, clutching a SONOGRAM.

CUT TO:
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY (ONE YEAR AGO)

LIN MOMO sits by MOTHER LIN's bedside. Medical bills cover the table. The TV shows PEI YOUJI and FANG XUE at a charity event.

MOTHER LIN
(weak)
Momo... Miss Fang's offer...

LIN MOMO
I'll handle it, Mom.

LIN MOMO picks up a water pitcher.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

LIN MOMO fills the pitcher at the sink. FANG XUE approaches, designer sunglasses in hand.

FANG XUE
The contract arrived. Sign today, and his mother's treatment begins tomorrow.

LIN MOMO
(quietly)
Your boyfriend—he knows it's my egg?

FANG XUE
(smiling)
He knows what he needs to know. The Pei family money will be yours, and your mother gets the best care.

FANG XUE places a PEI FAMILY RING in Lin Momo's palm.

FANG XUE (CONT'D)
Wear this during the pregnancy. Consider it... collateral.

Lin Momo watches Fang Xue walk away, her face pale.

BACK TO:

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - PRESENT

LIN MOMO on the floor, the ring falls from her hand.

LIN MOMO
(whispering)
It was never about the money...

FADE OUT.

title: You Are the Mantis, I Am the Sparrow (Episode 41)
description: A woman is nearly killed by her brother-in-law after her sister's miscarriage, only to be reborn and given a second chance to change her fate.
context:
Title: You Are the Mantis, I Am the Sparrow (Episode 41)
Description: A woman is nearly killed by her brother-in-law after her sister's miscarriage, only to be reborn and given a second chance to change her fate.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

WANG HU (O.S.)
You think you can erase her child with a single mistake?

SONG NUAN lies on the stone floor, gasping. WANG HU, in ceremonial armor, towers over her. LI QING stands in the shadows, avoiding her gaze.

SONG NUAN (V.O.)
They blame me for my sister's fall. For the life inside her. For the heir they would have killed me to protect.

WANG HU's boot presses down on her throat.

INT. THEATER - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SONG YUN YAN clutches the second-floor railing, eight months swollen. Her foot catches on a loose board. She tumbles forward, silk dress catching air.

SONG YUN YAN
(scream cuts short)

She lands at the bottom. Crimson spreads across marble.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

LI QING
You think I didn't see your relief when she fell? This was always about envy.

SONG NUAN
(strangled)
I loved her. I would never—

LI QING
You kept her in the heat. You watched her beg. The seat I gave you became her death sentence.
continuation:
INT. ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

LI QING drapes a mink stole over SONG NUAN's shoulders.

LI QING
First row. Just for you. I bribed three officials for this view.

SONG NUAN
But Yun Yan is with child. The second floor is so hot—

LI QING
She wanted to come. Let her appreciate the gesture.

INT. THEATER - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SONG YUN YAN leans over the second-floor railing, pale and sweating.

SONG YUN YAN
Sister, please. I feel faint.

SONG NUAN
(stares at her velvet seat)
This was his gift to me.

SONG YUN YAN
Just for the first act. Please.

SONG NUAN turns away.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

LI QING draws his sword. The blade sings.

LI QING
Brother Wang. The family justice is yours to deliver.

He offers the hilt. WANG HU takes it.

The candlelight catches the steel as it rises.

EXT. THEATER ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Snow falls like ash. The opera's aria spills into the street:

OPERA SINGER (O.S.)
One life ends, another begins... the wheel turns blind...

SONG NUAN stands in the snow, looking bewildered. SONG YUN YAN walks up to her, eight months pregnant, very much alive.

SONG YUN YAN
Sister, why are you standing there in a daze? Let's go in and watch the opera.

SONG NUAN looks around, then at the Buddhist prayer beads in her hand—one bead is cracked, leaking faint golden light.

SONG NUAN (V.O.)
This is... I've been reborn. Reborn one hour before the fall.

title: You Said You'd Find Me
description: In 2009, a CEO mother and her young daughter are hunted through the mountains in a storm. The daughter sacrifices herself to save her mother.
context:
Title: You Said You'd Find Me
Description: In 2009, a CEO mother and her young daughter are hunted through the mountains in a storm. The daughter sacrifices herself to save her mother.

INT. JIANG FAMILY BACK MOUNTAIN - NIGHT

Torrential rain pours down, thunder rumbles. JIANG SHU (38, sharp features now haggard) runs frantically along a muddy mountain path in a torn black suit, soaked through. She clutches her daughter JIANG XIA (7, small but fierce).

PURSUER (O.S.)
Hurry up and find those two! If the Jiang family finds them first, we're finished!

Jiang Shu slips, slamming into a puddle with Jiang Xia. Her temple strikes a rock. Blood mixes with rainwater. Her grip loosens.

JIANG XIA
(anxious)
Mom! Your head--

Jiang Shu blinks hard, fighting unconsciousness.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

FLASHBACK. Jiang Shu and Jiang Xia cower against a concrete wall as kidnappers close in. SCARFACE (40s, brutal, calculating) cracks his knuckles. Rain hammers a distant window.

SCARFACE
The boss says you don't leave here alive. Nothing personal—just business.

JIANG SHU
(angry and terrified)
I'm CEO of Jiang Corporation. My family will pay triple whatever you're getting.

SCARFACE
(leaning in)
Your own brother hired us, Mrs. CEO. Said you and the brat are blocking his inheritance.

He signals his men. They advance.

SCARFACE (CONT'D)
Take them to the mountain. Make it look like an accident.

INT. JIANG FAMILY BACK MOUNTAIN - NIGHT

Back to reality. Scarface leads several THUGS through the storm, flashlights cutting through the downpour.

THUG
(excitedly)
Two million! Boss promised two million for the Jiang heir and her kid!

SCARFACE
Shut up and search!
continuation:
INT. CAVE - NIGHT

Jiang Shu lies unconscious in a dark cave. Blood flows from her temple. Jiang Xia rips fabric from her own shirt, pressing it to her mother's wound.

JIANG XIA
(crying quietly)
Mommy... please...

Jiang Shu's eyes flutter open, unfocused.

JIANG SHU
(whispering)
Pain pain fly away... Mommy doesn't hurt anymore...

Her eyes roll back. She goes limp.

JIANG XIA
(crying louder)
Mom! Wake up! You promised you'd find me!

FOOTSTEPS approach outside. Flashlight beams dance near the entrance.

JIANG XIA (CONT'D)
(whispering)
You have to hide. Don't move.

She covers her mother with dry leaves and branches, then kisses her forehead.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - NIGHT

Three black sedans skid to a halt. JIANG FAMILY BODYGUARDS leap out, weapons drawn.

CHIEF BODYGUARD
(into walkie-talkie)
Fan out! Find them before the kidnappers do! Move!

The bodyguards storm up the mountain.

INT. CAVE - NIGHT

FLASHLIGHT beams pierce the darkness. Scarface's silhouette looms.

SCARFACE (O.S.)
Check every hole. They can't be far.

Jiang Xia's eyes widen. She looks at her unconscious mother, then at the jade pendant around her own neck—a family heirloom.

EXT. JIANG FAMILY BACK MOUNTAIN - NIGHT

Jiang Xia bursts from the cave, running perpendicular to her mother's location.

JIANG XIA
(shouting)
I'm here! Come get me!

Scarface and the Thugs wheel around. Rain drenches them all.

SCARFACE
(grinning viciously)
Smart little brat. But not smart enough.

He lunges, grabbing her neck. He rips the jade pendant from her, then throws her down a steep slope. She vanishes into the darkness with a scream.

SCARFACE (CONT'D)
She's gone. Find the mother—fast!

A THUG
(panicked)
Boss! Jiang family guards!

Flashlight beams sweep from another ridge—fifty yards away.

INT. CAVE - NIGHT

Jiang Shu's eyes snap open. She hears the commotion. Her fingers find the spot where Jiang Xia hid her. Empty. She sees light—her bodyguards.

She also sees something glinting in the mud near the cave entrance: the jade pendant.

CLOSE ON: Jiang Shu's bloodied hand clutching the pendant. Her face crumples.

JIANG SHU
(whispered)
You said you'd hide... not run.

She struggles to her feet, staring at where her daughter disappeared.

JIANG SHU (CONT'D)
(weak but determined)
You said you'd find me. Now I'll find you.

She staggers toward the slope as bodyguards rush in.

FADE OUT.

title: You Chose Your First Love, Why Cry When I Leave
description: A woman married a man for five years but never loved him, keeping her heart for her ex-boyfriend who abandoned her, until he returns.
context:
Title: You Chose Your First Love, Why Cry When I Leave
Description: A woman married a man for five years but never loved him, keeping her heart for her ex-boyfriend who abandoned her, until he returns.

INT. LUXURY MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

XU WANQING descends the spiral staircase, silk robe trailing, and freezes. JIANG CHEN stands at the window, garment steamer in hand, hovering over a brown suit on a mannequin.

XU WANQING
(sharp)
Jiang Chen.

She crosses the room in three strides, fingers closing around his wrist like a vise.

XU WANQING
The one thing I asked. The ONE thing.

JIANG CHEN
The lining was pulling. I know a tailor who--

XU WANQING
--isn't you. I told you before we signed the contract: this room, this closet, this suit, they don't exist to you.

JIANG CHEN
Five years. You think I'd forget which seams I'm allowed to touch?

XU WANQING
Then act like it.

She wrenches the steamer from his grip, sets it down with deliberate slowness.

XU WANQING
Professionals handle what matters. You handle what's left.

JIANG CHEN
There's less left every day.

XU WANQING's phone rings. She answers, turning her back to him.

XU WANQING
(into phone)
Hello? ... Slow down. ... He's what?

FLASHBACK - EXT. VILLA EXTERIOR - DAY (FIVE YEARS AGO)

Vintage color grade. XU WANQING, twenty-two and hollow-eyed, clutches a velvet ring box. SHU YAN adjusts his cufflinks, refusing to look at her.

XU WANQING
(crumbling)
I found the designer you liked. The one from Milan. Please. Just open it.

SHU YAN
Your father already opened my company books. He's reading them very carefully.

XU WANQING
So we run. We start over--

SHU YAN
--with your cut-off trust fund? With my employees' mortgages? This isn't a romance, Wanqing. It's a ransom note.

He pulls his arm free. She collapses onto the gravel, the ring box cracking open to reveal two simple gold bands.
continuation:
INT. LUXURY MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

XU WANQING grips the phone, knuckles white. JIANG CHEN watches from the periphery.

XU WANQING
(into phone)
Today? ... Yes, the house is exactly as you left it. Everything's preserved. ... Nothing's changed. ... No. Nothing.

She ends the call. Walks past JIANG CHEN without a glance. He picks up the steamer, fingers brushing the suit's lapel where a hidden repair stitch now holds the lining—his work, invisible.

FLASHBACK MONTAGE - INT. BAR - NIGHT (FIVE YEARS AGO)

JIANG CHEN on stage, fingers flying over guitar strings. Below, XU WANQING drains a tumbler, tears cutting through her makeup.

SHU YAN (V.O.)
It's a ransom note.

XU WANQING stumbles onto the stage, grabs the micstand.

XU WANQING
(loudly)
You. Marry me.

JIANG CHEN
(quietly)
You're drunk.

XU WANQING
Five million. One signature. Three years.

She slaps a cashier's check on his amp. The bar erupts. JIANG CHEN's eyes flick from the check to her wrecked face, to his own calloused hands.

CUT TO: A marriage certificate. Two photos—hers polished, his weary.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL AREA DOWNSTAIRS - NIGHT

JIANG CHEN stands across the street, watching XU WANQING emerge from SHU YAN's sedan, laughing too loudly. She doesn't look back.

JIANG CHEN pulls out his phone. A calendar alert glows: "CONTRACT ENDS - 30 DAYS." He pockets it, turns away. A sparkler sputters in a child's hand nearby, illuminating his face—resigned, but not broken.

title: Countdown to Love
description: A doctor experiences his final moments at a wedding, then finds himself transported 100 days into the past.
context:
Title: Countdown to Love
Description: A doctor experiences his final moments at a wedding, then finds himself transported 100 days into the past.

TITLE CARD

Black screen with white text: This is the last moment of my life.

COUNTDOWN TIMER

Countdown 100 Days to Say I Love You
Numbers rapidly count down from 100 to 1.

INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY

YE FAN, wearing a black suit, stands at the back of a crowded wedding hall. His face is ashen.

AT THE ALTAR, SHEN MENGNA in a wedding dress stands beside her GROOM. She sees Ye Fan and her breath catches.

YE FAN forces his way forward. He takes Shen Mengna's hand and places a ring on her finger.

YE FAN
(whispering)
Be happy. I'm sorry.

YE FAN turns and walks away.

SHEN MENGNA (V.O.)
Don't go. Please, turn around.

A drop of blood falls on the marble floor. Ye Fan clutches his chest.

SHEN MENGNA's bouquet falls to the ground.

YE FAN collapses.

SHEN MENGNA, holding up her wedding dress, runs toward him.

YE FAN lies on the ground, watching her through dimming vision.

YE FAN (V.O.)
I love you. Goodbye.

YE FAN closes his eyes.

TITLE CARD

Black screen with white text: 100 Days Earlier
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The elevator doors open. SHEN'S FATHER leads a group of BODYGUARDS in black suits, walking out with an imposing presence.

SHEN'S FATHER and his entourage cross through the hospital lobby toward the consultation rooms. The nurses at the reception desk watch them in surprise.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

YE FAN, wearing a white coat, is examining a PATIENT.

YE FAN
Your condition is recovering very well.

PATIENT (wearing a mask)
(nods)

YE FAN
So, starting tomorrow—

Before he can finish, SHEN'S FATHER pushes the door open, interrupting them.

YE FAN
(looks up)
Who are you?

SHEN'S FATHER walks over to the PATIENT, pats his shoulder, pulls out a stack of cash from his pocket and stuffs it into the patient's hand.

SHEN'S FATHER
For your inconvenience. The chairman appreciates your cooperation.

The PATIENT takes the money, nods to Ye Fan, and exits.

YE FAN
(frowning)
That was a sick man.

SHEN'S FATHER
He's a rich man now. My father, however, needs his doctor.

SHEN'S FATHER walks to YE FAN's desk and leans down.

SHEN'S FATHER
I don't forget my debts.

SHEN'S FATHER straightens up and snaps his fingers. Two BODYGUARDS unfurl two large red banners.

BODYGUARDS (shouting in unison)
Doctor Su is strong! Doctor Su is great! Doctor Su's treatment is different! Accurate diagnosis, superb medical skills! Doctor Su is an angel in white!

YE FAN is amused by this display. He picks up his thermos from the desk.

YE FAN
(smiling)
Wrong doctor. But the effort's... memorable.

SHEN'S FATHER looks back at the banner, which reads "Doctor Ye is Strong."

SHEN'S FATHER
(laughs awkwardly)
The printer got ahead of themselves. The sentiment stands.

The two shake hands.

SHEN'S FATHER
Doctor Ye, you've given my father time. I won't forget it.

Suddenly, YE FAN's expression becomes pained. He feels dizzy, and his vision begins to blur. He covers his face with his hand, his body swaying as if seeing some kind of vision. He lifts his head, his eyes unfocused, nearly fainting.

YE FAN
(whispering)
The wedding... you're there...

title: Hidden Pregnancy
description: A pregnant student desperately tries to hide her condition from her family while facing financial struggles at school.
context:
Title: Hidden Pregnancy
Description: A pregnant student desperately tries to hide her condition from her family while facing financial struggles at school.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

WEI YUXIAN (22, scholarship student) stares at the ultrasound screen, her reflection ghosted over the image of two heartbeats.

DOCTOR
Twins. About twelve weeks. Congratulations.

WEI YUXIAN
(absently)
Thank you.

DOCTOR
As a university student, I'm required to notify your emergency contact. Standard policy for medical leave.

The doctor reaches for the phone. WEI YUXIAN's hand shoots out, pressing it down with surprising strength.

WEI YUXIAN
(quietly urgent)
Please. My scholarship requires full-time enrollment. If they find out—

DOCTOR
Miss Wei, with twins, you'll be showing by finals week.

WEI YUXIAN meets the doctor's gaze, her expression a carefully constructed wall.

WEI YUXIAN
Then I'll need to work faster.
continuation:
EXT. SCHOOL GATE - NIGHT

THREE MONTHS EARLIER - SCHOOL GATE

WEI YUXIAN walks alone, canvas bag heavy with library books. A black luxury car idles by the curb.

INT. LUXURY CAR - CONTINUOUS

FU XUANYI (late 20s, heir apparent) listens to his Bluetooth earpiece, gaze drifting out the window.

FU XUANYI
(on phone)
The merger can wait. I'm more interested in the R&D tax credits.

His eyes catch WEI YUXIAN crossing the street. She drops a book, picks it up without breaking stride, her movements efficient, unbothered by the rain starting to fall.

FU XUANYI
(to driver)
Pull forward. Slowly.

The car glides alongside WEI YUXIAN. FU XUANYI watches her check her phone - a cracked screen held together with tape - then disappear into a dormitory.

FU XUANYI
(quietly, to himself)
Find her schedule.

INT. SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

SCHOOL CAFETERIA

WEI YUXIAN's tray holds one steamed bun, one bowl of plain porridge. She swipes her meal card.

CASH REGISTER (V.O.)
Insufficient balance.

She swipes again. Same result. The cafeteria worker, middle-aged and tired, doesn't look up from her own phone.

CAFETERIA LADY
Card's empty, dear.

WEI YUXIAN
Could you try once more? Sometimes the magnetic—

CAFETERIA LADY
No balance is no balance.

Behind her, a STUDENT giggles to a friend. WEI YUXIAN's jaw tightens almost imperceptibly. She slides the tray back.

WEI YUXIAN
I'll come back.

She walks away, leaving the food. Her stomach growls audibly. No one offers to help. She passes a trash can and discreetly drops the ultrasound appointment card into it, her face unreadable.

She swipes again. Same result. The cafeteria worker, middle-aged and tired, doesn't look up from her own phone.

CAFETERIA LADY
Card's empty, dear.

WEI YUXIAN
Could you try once more? Sometimes the magnetic—

CAFETERIA LADY
No balance is no balance.

Behind her, a STUDENT giggles to a friend. WEI YUXIAN's jaw tightens almost imperceptibly. She slides the tray back.

WEI YUXIAN
I'll come back.

title: The Medical Consultant
description: A medical doctor is persuaded to become a film consultant while treating an agent who is trying to secure a role for her client.
context:
Title: The Medical Consultant
Description: A medical doctor is persuaded to become a film consultant while treating an agent who is trying to secure a role for her client.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

HUANG ZONG (50s, shrewd film producer) holds a coffee cup, walking toward XUE ZE (30s, sharp-featured ER doctor) who is sitting on the sofa, scrolling his phone.

HUANG ZONG
Xiao Ze. Have you considered what I asked?

XUE ZE
(without looking up)
I told you, Uncle. I'm not interested. Find another consultant.

XUE ZE pockets his phone and stands.

XUE ZE
I have rounds in twenty minutes.

HUANG ZONG
(blocking him)
Your mother called this morning. Wants to know when she'll get grandchildren.

XUE ZE
(irritated)
Tell her I'm married to my residency.

XUE ZE moves toward the door.

HUANG ZONG
(shouting after)
At least look at the project before--

A FEMALE ASSISTANT enters.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Mr. Huang? Xu Ruo from Huanyu Talent is here for the casting meeting.

XUE ZE freezes, hand on the doorknob. He glances back.

HUANG ZONG
Send her in.

Xue Ze hesitates, then casually settles into a chair near the door, retrieving his phone.

HUANG ZONG
(suspicious)
I thought you had urgent surgery?

XUE ZE
The patient can wait three minutes.

MISS XU (20s, polished talent agent) enters carrying a tablet, her left hand loosely bandaged.

MISS XU
Mr. Huang. Thank you for seeing me.

HUANG ZONG
(standing)
Miss Xu. Let me introduce my nephew, Dr. Xue Ze. Just back from Johns Hopkins.

XUE ZE
(standing, studying her)
We met last night. Though you were too busy arguing with the ER nurse to notice.

MISS XU
(eyes narrowing)
That was you? Behind the attending?

XUE ZE
(grinning)
You have a memorable negotiation style.

HUANG ZONG
You two know each other?

XUE ZE
She bulldozed into my trauma bay at 2 AM. Insisted her client needed VIP treatment for a papercut.

MISS XU
(defensive)
It was a deep laceration. And Bai Jingfan had a photoshoot today.
continuation:
HUANG ZONG
Bai Jingfan? The one up for the lead? Is he alright?

MISS XU
Perfectly fine, thanks to Dr. Xue's eventual cooperation.

Xue Ze notices blood seeping through her bandage.

XUE ZE
(grabbing her wrist)
You didn't even get this sutured.

MISS XU
(jerking away)
I was busy.

XUE ZE
Uncle, first-aid kit.

The three sit on the sofa. Xue Ze cleans the wound.

MISS XU
About the role, Mr. Huang. The director's concerns about Bai Jingfan's physique--

HUANG ZONG
This is an S+ medical drama. We need authenticity.

MISS XU
He'll gain fifteen pounds by next month.

XUE ZE
(applying pressure)
Stop flexing.

HUANG ZONG
We've also got meetings with two established actors.

MISS XU
(leaning forward)
Bai Jingfan studied pre-med. And his marriage is trending positively. College sweethearts, not scandal.

XUE ZE
(glancing up)
Wait. You and Bai Jingfan--you're not together?

MISS XU
(incredulous)
I'm his agent.

HUANG ZONG
What are you implying?

XUE ZE
(eyes locked on Huang)
If I sign on as consultant... what's my authority?

HUANG ZONG
(hesitant)
Creative input. Why?

XUE ZE
(leaning toward Miss Xu, low voice)
Tell me the real reason you need this role.

Miss Xu's breath catches. She studies his face.

MISS XU
(quietly)
He's about to become a father. He needs stability.

Xue Ze tapes the final bandage.

XUE ZE
(to Huang)
I'll do it. On one condition.

HUANG ZONG
(surprised)
Name it.

XUE ZE
Bai Jingfan gets the part. And Miss Xu becomes my liaison.

He releases her hand. Their eyes meet briefly before she looks away, blinking rapidly.

title: The Fake Heiress Goes Viral After Giving Up in the Entertainment Industry
description: After being exposed as the switched daughter and thrown out by her wealthy family, a young woman enters the entertainment industry and rises to stardom, much to the fury of the real heiress.
context:
Title: The Fake Heiress Goes Viral After Giving Up in the Entertainment Industry
Description: After being exposed as the switched daughter and thrown out by her wealthy family, a young woman enters the entertainment industry and rises to stardom, much to the fury of the real heiress.

INT. SHEN FAMILY MANSION - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Quick cuts: Shattered crystal. A DNA report. Inverted memories—chaos.

SHEN QINGLI (V.O.)
Twenty-three years. Erased in a blood test.

SHEN FATHER's face fills the frame, reflected in polished marble.

SHEN QINGLI (V.O.)
If I'm not your daughter, then who am I?

SHEN FATHER stares down at SHEN QINGLI clutching a photo.

SHEN FATHER
Your mother saw an opportunity. When Shen Lu donated—for you—the records didn't match.

Close-up: SHEN QINGLI's profile, tears staining the photo.

SHEN FATHER (V.O.)
The car's at the east gate. Don't use the front.
continuation:
EXT. POND SIDE - DAY

SHEN QINGLI sits on a rock, feet in water, designer shoes beside her.

SHEN QINGLI
(to herself)
I used to feed these fish. Now I can't afford bread.

An OLD MAN fishes nearby, gear worn but expensive.

OLD MAN
You scare the fish, you owe me dinner.

SHEN QINGLI
Apologies. I'll move.

The OLD MAN gets up, holds out a business card.

OLD MAN
My granddaughter's casting an indie film. Needs someone who's actually lost everything.

OLD MAN
No pity. Just a test. You pass, you earn it.

INT. SHEN LU'S ROOM - DAY

White text on screen: ONE YEAR LATER.

SHEN LU watches a video on her phone—SHEN QINGLI in a raw performance. Comment section explodes.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Shen Qingli's breakout role earns Oscar buzz, making her the year's most unexpected success story.

SHEN LU's knuckles whiten. She slams the phone face-down.

SHEN LU
(to herself, through gritted teeth)
I took your name. Your parents. And you're still here.

SHEN LU picks up her phone, opens a chat.

SHEN LU
(into phone)
Find everything. Turn her into a disgraced artist. Get her erased.

title: The False Heiress's Identity Exposed
description: A woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal with her sister and learns she is not the true daughter of the family.
context:
Title: The False Heiress's Identity Exposed
Description: A woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal with her sister and learns she is not the true daughter of the family.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

OU YAN pushes open the door. Stops cold.

GAO YANG and YAO YAO on the bed—clothes twisted, hair mussed. A lipstick stain on his collar.

OU YAN
(soft, dangerous)
Gao Yang.

YAO YAO
(smoothing her skirt)
You really should knock, sister.

OU YAN
(eyes only on him)
Get away from my fiancé.

GAO YANG
(stands, placing himself between them)
I can't marry you. Not after what I found.

He pulls a folded document from his jacket. Hospital seal visible.

GAO YANG
Your mother's blood type. It didn't match. So I had it tested.

OU YAN
Tested what?

GAO YANG
Yao Yao is their blood. You're the one they brought home by mistake.

FATHER and MOTHER enter. Mother already holds the envelope.

FATHER
Yan Yan—

MOTHER
(cutting him off)
continuation:
Don't. She doesn't deserve the name.

FATHER
(hand shaking)
The DNA confirms it. We took the wrong baby from the hospital.

MOTHER
(to Yao Yao)
Are you alright, darling?

OU YAN
(staring at the envelope)
You knew. And you let me pick my wedding dress.

MOTHER
It was non-refundable. Why waste the deposit?

FATHER
Your real parents... they're coming tonight. We found them.

MOTHER
Take your personal items only. The jewelry stays. It's Yao Yao's inheritance.

OU YAN
(quiet fury)
Twenty-three years. You want me gone in twenty-three minutes?

She takes the envelope. Rips it cleanly in half.

OU YAN
Keep your proof.

OU YAN removes her engagement ring. Drops it.

OU YAN
(to Gao Yang)
You two deserve each other. Perfectly matched.

She turns. Walks out. The ring spins on the hardwood.

MOTHER pulls Yao Yao close. Father stares at the torn paper.

The door stays open.

title: After Fake Bankruptcy, the Heiress Goes on a Rampage
description: A wealthy heiress's wedding day becomes a test of character when her family stages a fake bankruptcy to expose those with ulterior motives.
context:
Title: After Fake Bankruptcy, the Heiress Goes on a Rampage
Description: A wealthy heiress's wedding day becomes a test of character when her family stages a fake bankruptcy to expose those with ulterior motives.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

A black Rolls-Royce wedding car slowly approaches and stops at the hotel entrance.

LIU FENGXIAN (Zhou Yaozhu's mother) gets out of the car, her smile brightening as she opens the car door for the bride.

JIANG YAO (daughter of Jiangnan Province's richest man), wearing a pure white wedding dress and holding a bouquet, elegantly steps out of the car.

LIU FENGXIAN
Daughter-in-law.

SONG YA (Jiang Yao's mother) approaches from the other side, her expression carefully composed.

LIU FENGXIAN
In-law, this is the hotel where we're holding the wedding. You two go rest in the dressing room first. I'll go check on how Yaozhu's preparations are going.

SONG YA and JIANG YAO walk toward the hotel. SONG YA answers her phone.

SONG YA
(on phone)
Hello, honey, my daughter and I have already arrived at the hotel entrance.

SONG YA looks around, her professional smile tightening slightly.

SONG YA
(on phone)
Yaoyao insisted on honoring the Zhou family. We'll manage.

EXT. HELIPAD - DAY

JIANG LONG (Jiangnan Province's richest man) walks on a red carpet with subordinates in suits standing on both sides. A helicopter is parked behind him.

SUBORDINATES
(in unison)
Hello, Chairman!

JIANG LONG
(on phone)
I'm on my way. Yaoyao wanted to respect her husband's roots.

JIANG LONG glances at his bare thumb, a ghost of a smile on his face.

JIANG LONG
(on phone)
The shareholders noticed I'm not wearing the ring. Questions are starting.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

LIU FENGXIAN walks into the hotel lobby and suddenly remembers something.

LIU FENGXIAN
Oh my, I left the big gold bracelet my daughter-in-law just gave me in the car.

She turns to go out but overhears SONG YA's phone conversation.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

SONG YA
(on phone)
They think something happened to you. Some people are even spreading rumors that our Jiang family went bankrupt.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

LIU FENGXIAN hears the word "bankrupt" and her eyes widen in shock.

LIU FENGXIAN
(to herself)
Bankrupt?

She quietly hides behind a pillar to eavesdrop.

EXT. HELIPAD - DAY

JIANG LONG
(on phone)
Bankrupt?

JIANG LONG's expression shifts, a calculating look replacing his earlier concern.

JIANG LONG
(on phone)
Let them think it. We'll see who still stands by my daughter when they believe she's no longer an heiress.

SONG YA
(on phone)
Okay, good. Come over soon then.

JIANG LONG
(on phone)
Let's leave it at that.

JIANG LONG hangs up, gazing into the distance.

JIANG LONG
People's hearts are hard to read.

He turns to ASSISTANT HAN beside him.

JIANG LONG
Discreet security. County towns can be unpredictable.

ASSISTANT HAN
Yes, Chairman.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

SONG YA hangs up the phone and says to JIANG YAO.

SONG YA
Yaoyao, your father will be here soon. Let Mom go with you to touch up your makeup.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

LIU FENGXIAN hides behind the pillar, her face full of horror.

LIU FENGXIAN
(to herself)
The Jiang family actually went bankrupt! Oh no, my son finally hooked a rich heiress, and before we even got the money, it's all gone! No, I have to tell my son right away!

LIU FENGXIAN runs off in a panic.

title: Obsessive Redemption
description: A woman loved a man for six years, but what began as his pursuit became a joke to everyone around them.
context:
Title: Obsessive Redemption
Description: A woman loved a man for six years, but what began as his pursuit became a joke to everyone around them.

INT. JIANG FAMILY HOME - SIX YEARS AGO - NIGHT

SHU YU (V.O.)
I loved him with all my strength for six years. It started with his initiative, but I became a laughingstock to everyone.

JIANG SICHEN stumbles through the front door, loosening his tie, looking exhausted and drunk.

SHU YU, who is grading papers, hears the noise and looks up.

SHU YU
Uncle? You're back.

JIANG SICHEN sways toward her. SHU YU immediately stands, catching him as he stumbles. His hand grips her shoulder—too tight, too familiar.

SHU YU
Let me help you rest.

JIANG SICHEN
(mumbling)
Don't leave...

SHU YU helps JIANG SICHEN away, his fingers trailing down her arm.
continuation:
INT. BAR - SIX YEARS LATER - NIGHT

JIANG SICHEN and a group of FRIENDS are partying at a bar. His new girlfriend QIN YI sits beside him, adjusting his collar.

FRIEND 1
To Brother Chen's latest—and Shu Yu's next victim?

EVERYONE
Cheers!

FRIEND 2
She's got a PhD in scaring off competition.

FRIEND 3
Six years of this circus. What's the endgame?
(to Jiang)
Does the little stray actually think you'll adopt her?

SHU YU stands at the private room door, holding a small bottle of Hang-Bai-Ling (liver tonic). She overhears.

JIANG SICHEN (O.S.)
(slight pause)
Shu Yu? A habit. Like a stray you feed once and it won't leave.

JIANG SICHEN puts his arm around QIN YI, speaking with deliberate dismissal.

JIANG SICHEN
It's nothing more than charity. Even strays stop begging eventually.

SHU YU, heartbroken, pushes the door open. The tonic slips from her fingers.

JIANG SICHEN
(surprised, then cold)
Why are you here? Go back.

SHU YU
(trembling, but clear)
Uncle, you've needed me for six years. Was it all just... charity? Then what was that night six years ago? When you said I was your anchor?

JIANG SICHEN
(jaw tight)
Shu Yu. Have some self-respect. All you do is revolve around me. Don't you have shame?

(beat)
Fine. You want an explanation?

JIANG SICHEN suddenly turns and, right in front of SHU YU, grabs QIN YI in a performative, punishing kiss. The FRIENDS cheer—some uncomfortable, some catcalling.

Shu Yu watches, tears streaming down her face. She steps back, crushing the tonic bottle underfoot. Then turns and walks out—not runs.

INT. BAR CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

SHU YU leans against the wall, crying silently. She touches a small jade pendant around her neck—then rips it off. She dials her phone, voice steady with finality.

SHU YU
Aunt Li? I'll take the exchange program. The flight's tonight.
full_script:
Title: Obsessive Redemption
Description: A woman loved a man for six years, but what began as his pursuit became a joke to everyone around them.

INT. JIANG FAMILY HOME - SIX YEARS AGO - NIGHT

SHU YU (V.O.)
I loved him with all my strength for six years. It started with his initiative, but I became a laughingstock to everyone.

JIANG SICHEN stumbles through the front door, loosening his tie, looking exhausted and drunk.

SHU YU, who is grading papers, hears the noise and looks up.

SHU YU
Uncle? You're back.

JIANG SICHEN sways toward her. SHU YU immediately stands, catching him as he stumbles. His hand grips her shoulder—too tight, too familiar.

SHU YU
Let me help you rest.

JIANG SICHEN
(mumbling)
Don't leave...

SHU YU helps JIANG SICHEN away, his fingers trailing down her arm.

INT. BAR - SIX YEARS LATER - NIGHT

JIANG SICHEN and a group of FRIENDS are partying at a bar. His new girlfriend QIN YI sits beside him, adjusting his collar.

FRIEND 1
To Brother Chen's latest—and Shu Yu's next victim?

EVERYONE
Cheers!

FRIEND 2
She's got a PhD in scaring off competition.

FRIEND 3
Six years of this circus. What's the endgame?
(to Jiang)
Does the little stray actually think you'll adopt her?

SHU YU stands at the private room door, holding a small bottle of Hang-Bai-Ling (liver tonic). She overhears.

JIANG SICHEN (O.S.)
(slight pause)
Shu Yu? A habit. Like a stray you feed once and it won't leave.

JIANG SICHEN puts his arm around QIN YI, speaking with deliberate dismissal.

JIANG SICHEN
It's nothing more than charity. Even strays stop begging eventually.

SHU YU, heartbroken, pushes the door open. The tonic slips from her fingers.

JIANG SICHEN
(surprised, then cold)
Why are you here? Go back.

SHU YU
(trembling, but clear)
Uncle, you've needed me for six years. Was it all just... charity? Then what was that night six years ago? When you said I was your anchor?

JIANG SICHEN
(jaw tight)
Shu Yu. Have some self-respect. All you do is revolve around me. Don't you have shame?

(beat)
Fine. You want an explanation?

JIANG SICHEN suddenly turns and, right in front of SHU YU, grabs QIN YI in a performative, punishing kiss. The FRIENDS cheer—some uncomfortable, some catcalling.

Shu Yu watches, tears streaming down her face. She steps back, crushing the tonic bottle underfoot. Then turns and walks out—not runs.

INT. BAR CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

SHU YU leans against the wall, crying silently. She touches a small jade pendant around her neck—then rips it off. She dials her phone, voice steady with finality.

SHU YU
Aunt Li? I'll take the exchange program. The flight's tonight.

title: Secretly Like You
description: A college student returns to find her childhood friend, only to discover he has moved on with someone else.
context:
Title: Secretly Like You
Description: A college student returns to find her childhood friend, only to discover he has moved on with someone else.

EXT. UNIVERSITY ROAD - DAY

CEN SHUHE steps onto campus, autumn leaves crunching underfoot. She clutches a worn book, scanning the quad with barely contained hope.

CEN SHUHE (V.O.)
My name is Cen Shuhe. I promised someone I'd return to Qingnan.

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

YOUNG JIANG YAN shows YOUNG CEN SHUHE a crystal ball. His palm is bandaged.

YOUNG JIANG YAN
Look how it holds the light.

YOUNG CEN SHUHE
Your hand...

YOUNG JIANG YAN
It's nothing. Now we have something permanent.

EXT. UNIVERSITY ROAD - DAY

CEN SHUHE quickens her pace, eyes scanning faces.

CEN SHUHE (V.O.)
He promised he'd wait.

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

YOUNG CEN SHUHE
What if I can't come back?

YOUNG JIANG YAN
Then we both remember. Five years. Qingnan. No matter what.
continuation:
EXT. UNIVERSITY ROAD - DAY

JIANG YAN, wearing a beige sweater, approaches. Their eyes meet. His face shutters closed—cold, distant. They pass in silence.

JIANG YAN (V.O.)
We promised to meet at Qingnan. To be together for life.

INT. LIBRARY - DAY

YOUNG JIANG YAN
This is our witness.

YOUNG CEN SHUHE
What if forgetting is easier?

Young CEN SHUHE turns away. Young JIANG YAN watches her, the crystal ball dull in his palm.

EXT. UNIVERSITY ROAD - DAY

CEN SHUHE stands frozen. FRIEND A and FRIEND B run over.

FRIEND A
Shuhe! You disappeared—

FRIEND B follows her gaze to JIANG YAN's retreating back.

FRIEND B
Jiang Yan. No wonder.

FRIEND A
Student council president. He barely talks to anyone.

FRIEND B
Except that girl from his department. They're always together.

FRIEND A
She's been chasing him since freshman year.

FRIEND B
He lets her hang around, at least.

A GIRL catches up to JIANG YAN, linking her arm through his. He doesn't pull away.

FRIEND A
Maybe he finally gave in.

FRIEND A turns to CEN SHUHE.

FRIEND A
Did you know him?

CEN SHUHE's fingers find the crystal ball in her pocket.

CEN SHUHE (V.O.)
I kept my promise. He kept his distance.

CEN SHUHE
We don't know each other.

She walks away. The friends exchange glances.

JIANG YAN stops at the corner, watching her leave. The GIRL beside him notices.

GIRL
Friends of yours?

JIANG YAN
No one.

He looks down at his hand, at the faint scar.

JIANG YAN (V.O.)
You came back. But you're not the girl who left.

title: Forced Marriage and Amnesia
description: A man pressured to marry before turning 27 suffers a car accident and loses his memory, while a woman agrees to a marriage of convenience to save her grandmother.
context:
Title: Forced Marriage and Amnesia
Description: A man pressured to marry before turning 27 suffers a car accident and loses his memory, while a woman agrees to a marriage of convenience to save her grandmother.

INT. GU FAMILY MANSION - STUDY - DAY

MOTHER GU (50s, immaculately dressed) slams a jade bracelet on the mahogany desk. GU MINGYANG (late 20s, sharp suit) stands rigidly before her.

MOTHER GU
Your birthday is in three weeks. If you don't produce a marriage certificate by then, don't bother claiming the Gu name.

She slides a prenuptial agreement across the desk. The jade bracelet cracks under her pressure.

EXT. CITY HIGHWAY - DAY

GU MINGYANG speeds in his black sedan, jaw clenched. His phone buzzes with "MOTHER" calling. He ignores it.

A scooter swerves into his lane. He jerks the wheel. The car spins, screeches, CRASHES into the barrier.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

GU MINGYANG awakens, head bandaged. The antiseptic smell hits him. WANG LEI (30s, anxious) hovers nearby.

GU MINGYANG
(groggy)
What... happened?

WANG LEI
Car accident. Three days ago. You swerved to avoid a scooter.

The DOCTOR enters, scanning a chart.

DOCTOR
Mr. Gu, your vitals are stable. How's your memory?

GU MINGYANG
I remember... Mother. The company. But...

He touches his temple, wincing.

GU MINGYANG
Why was I driving so fast? It feels like I'm missing something important.

WANG LEI
(exchanging glance with Doctor)
The police found a marriage certificate in your car. Registered six hours before the crash.

GU MINGYANG
(stunned)
Married? To who?
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WAITING AREA - DAY

PEI YUCHENG (mid-20s, tired eyes) sits clutching a thermos. A text glows on her phone: "Grandma's surgery scheduled. Deposit due: ¥100,000."

Her thumb hovers over a photo of GU MINGYANG from the registration office. The caption reads: "Husband. Don't remember me."

INT. PEI'S GRANDMOTHER'S HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK - ONE WEEK AGO)

PEI YUCHENG holds her GRANDMOTHER's frail hand. MOTHER PEI (voice from doorway) is sharp-edged but desperate.

MOTHER PEI (V.O.)
A matchmaker offered 100,000 for a quiet registration. No wedding, no contact afterward. Just sign the paper.

PEI YUCHENG
(whispering to Grandma)
I won't let them stop your treatment.

INT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - MARRIAGE REGISTRY - DAY (FLASHBACK)

PEI YUCHENG in a simple white dress, helmet still tucked under her arm. GU MINGYANG in a brown suit, eyes hollow.

The clerk stamps their certificates. They don't touch.

GU MINGYANG
(quietly)
Three weeks. Then we file for separation.

PEI YUCHENG
That's all I need.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

Back to present. GU MINGYANG stares blankly at the marriage certificate. PEI YUCHENG's name and photo beside his.

WANG LEI
Mr. Gu, she's been here every day. Waiting.

GU MINGYANG
I don't know this woman.

DOCTOR
Memory loss from trauma is tricky. Familiar faces might help. Or...

The Doctor hesitates.

DOCTOR
The emotional connection that triggered the event could be the key.

Beat. GU MINGYANG's phone rings. "MOTHER GU."

WANG LEI
(sotto voce)
She's checking on the certificate.

GU Mingyang looks from the phone to PEI YUCHENG's photo. His jaw tightens with recognition he can't place.

EXT. HOSPITAL ENTRANCE - DAY

PEI YUCHENG stands with the thermos, watching the window where GU MINGYANG's room is. Her phone buzzes: "He's asking for you."

She looks up. GU MINGYANG stands at the window, their eyes meeting through the glass. The distance between them is physical and emotional.

Neither moves. The certificate burns between them like a question mark.

title: Bringing Glory to the Ancestors
description: At a neglected family grave, a single mother's desperate attempt to teach her son about heritage ends in tragedy when he chases a stolen offering into a developer's construction site.
context:
Title: Bringing Glory to the Ancestors
Description: At a neglected family grave, a single mother's desperate attempt to teach her son about heritage ends in tragedy when he chases a stolen offering into a developer's construction site.

INT. ANCESTRAL GRAVE - DAY

A crumbling tombstone: "Li Yuan, 1889-1957." Weeds choke the neglected grave.

LIN MEI (30s, calloused hands, threadbare clothes) scrubs the stone while her son GLORY (8, hungry eyes) watches.

LIN MEI
(whispering a prayer)
...bless this worthless daughter... and her son...

GLORY
Mom, why'd you name me Glory?

LIN MEI
Because you're the last Li male. Your father died for that name.

GLORY
But what does it—

LIN MEI
It means you don't steal from the dead.

She pulls out a cheap jade pendant, ties it around his neck.

LIN MEI
It means you earn. Not beg.

She points to the offering plate—three withered apples.

LIN MEI
These are for them. Not us. Understand?

GLORY
(quietly)
But I'm hungry...

LIN MEI clutches her stomach, feeling it too. She stands, looks down the hill toward a construction site.

LIN MEI
Wait here. I'll find something.

She takes three steps away, turns back.

LIN MEI
Don't. Touch. Anything.

GLORY nods. Lin Mei disappears over the ridge. Glory waits... then grabs an apple. It slips through his fingers.
continuation:
EXT. HILLSIDE - DAY

MR. XIAO (60s, tailored suit, hollow eyes) surveys the hillside with ASSISTANT WANG.

ASSISTANT WANG
The Li family plot breaches our eastern boundary. That old well is a liability.

MR. XIAO
(quietly)
My father built his first factory on Li land. Debts unpaid.

He touches his chest—instinctively, where a pendant might hang. There's nothing.

MR. XIAO
Some liabilities... we keep.

An APPLE rolls past their feet. They turn.

EXT. FOREST - DAY

GLORY scrambles after the apple.

GLORY
(whispering)
Come back... come back...

He lunges, slips on loose soil, and vanishes over an edge. A distant THUD.

EXT. HILLSIDE - DAY

The SCREAM echoes. Mr. Xiao and Assistant Wang freeze.

MR. XIAO
Check the old well.

ASSISTANT WANG
But Mr. Xiao, the warning signs—

MR. XIAO
Now.

INT. DEEP PIT - DAY

Muddy water. Glory floats, unconscious. The jade pendant bobs beside him, its carved characters visible: GLORY.

EXT. FOREST - DAY

Assistant Wang peers into the well. His flashlight catches the pendant. He pulls out his phone.

ASSISTANT WANG
(into phone)
Mr. Xiao... it's a boy. And you're not going to believe what's around his neck.

The pendant gleams in the dark water.

FADE OUT.

title: The Road of Time Never Returns
description: At a rural wedding, a groom promises his bride a better future in the city, but harbors dark secrets about their relationship and children.
context:
Title: The Road of Time Never Returns
Description: At a rural wedding, a groom promises his bride a better future in the city, but harbors dark secrets about their relationship and children.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

A lively rural wedding courtyard, decorated with red lanterns and colorful ribbons everywhere. Guests sit around round tables.

MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN
The groom is here! Light the firecrackers, bring out the good food and wine!

XIAO PANG
(shouting)
Coming!

Firecrackers explode, smoke fills the air. Groom XU YIXIANG and bride LIN WANQING walk down the red carpet with their twin children (XU YIYANG and XU YIRU). The children carry baskets, scattering flower petals. Guests applaud warmly.

XU YIXIANG
(standing at the entrance, addressing the guests)
Thank you all for coming. We've prepared modest food and drink—please enjoy.

Guests begin to eat.

GOSSIP WOMAN 1
(whispering to GOSSIP WOMAN 2 at the same table)
Interesting timing, isn't it? Twins already walking and talking before the wedding.

GOSSIP WOMAN 2
Some girls know how to secure their future. Though I heard she wasn't exactly... born into good circumstances.

XU YIXIANG overhears, his face darkens.

XU YIXIANG
If anyone has something to say—

LIN WANQING
(gently touching his arm)
Yixiang. Please. Let them talk. Today is enough.

XU YIXIANG turns to her, his expression softening.

XU YIXIANG
You gave up everything for this family. I won't let them diminish what you've built. Once I finish school, we'll leave this place. A real home, in the city. A proper life.

LIN WANQING
(smiling, though her eyes hold something else)
I know you will.

FENG MEI approaches, holding a wrapped gift. Her floral shirt stands out among the countryside attire.

FENG MEI
City jobs and registrations don't just fall into your lap. Wanqing, you've made quite a sacrifice.

LIN WANQING
Feng Mei. You kept your promise to come.

FENG MEI
Why wouldn't I? We have history.

FENG MEI extends her hand to XU YIXIANG. Their handshake lasts a moment too long.

FENG MEI
Congratulations, Yixiang. You've achieved exactly what you planned.

XU YIXIANG
(swallows)
Thank you.

A jade pendant hangs from LIN WANQING's waist. Daughter XU YIRU points at it curiously.

XU YIRU
Mommy, what's that?

XU YIYANG
Let me see!

XU YIRU
It has tigers!

LIN WANQING kneels, removing the pendant which splits in two. She gives each child a half.

LIN WANQING
These are yours. Never take them off. They tell you who you are.

CHILDREN
Okay!

FENG MEI picks up a radio from the gift table.

FENG MEI
I'll put this in the bridal chamber. For later.

She exits toward the house. XU YIXIANG watches her go.
continuation:
INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - DAY

XU YIXIANG sits on the wedding bed, head in hands. FENG MEI enters, already changed into LIN WANQING's qipao.

FENG MEI
The children are eating with their grandmother. We have time.

XU YIXIANG
(looking up, startled)
You shouldn't be wearing that.

FENG MEI
(teasing, but with an edge)
Why not? You bought it. For me.

XU YIXIANG stands, pacing.

XU YIXIANG
The plan is working. She's committed now. Mother talks to her, not to strangers. The kids are attached. But the money from the girl—that feels...

FENG MEI
Don't become sentimental. You chose this. You made her fall for you, got her pregnant, convinced her to stay. All so you could keep the son and fund our future.

XU YIXIANG
She thinks she's protecting me. The gossip, the sacrifice—she believes in it. That's the worst part.

FENG MEI
You did what you had to. Women like her don't belong in the city anyway.

A small cough from the doorway. XU YIYANG stands there, holding a cup of tea.

XU YIYANG
Dad. Mom says you should drink this. For the toast.

XU YIXIANG takes the cup, his hand trembling. Behind the boy, XU YIRU peeks in, her eyes going from the qipao to Feng Mei's face.

XU YIRU
(quietly)
You look like Mommy. But you're not.

The tea cup slips from XU YIXIANG's hand. It shatters on the floor.

FADE OUT.

Guests begin to eat.

GOSSIP WOMAN 1
(whispering to GOSSIP WOMAN 2 at the same table)
Interesting timing, isn't it? Twins already walking and talking before the wedding.

GOSSIP WOMAN 2
Some girls know how to secure their future. Though I heard she wasn't exactly... born into good circumstances.

XU YIXIANG overhears, his face darkens.

XU YIXIANG
If anyone has something to say—

LIN WANQING
(gently touching his arm)
Yixiang. Please. Let them talk. Today is enough.

XU YIXIANG turns to her, his expression softening.

XU YIXIANG
You gave up everything for this family. I won't let them diminish what you've built. Once I finish school, we'll leave this place. A real home, in the city. A proper life.

LIN WANQING
(smiling, though her eyes hold something else)
I know you will.

FENG MEI approaches, holding a wrapped gift. Her floral shirt stands out among the countryside attire.

FENG MEI
City jobs and registrations don't just fall into your lap. Wanqing, you've made quite a sacrifice.

LIN WANQING
Feng Mei. You kept your promise to come.

FENG MEI
Why wouldn't I? We have history.

FENG MEI extends her hand to XU YIXIANG. Their handshake lasts a moment too long.

FENG MEI
Congratulations, Yixiang. You've achieved exactly what you planned.

XU YIXIANG
(swallows)
Thank you.

A jade pendant hangs from LIN WANQING's waist. Daughter XU YIRU points at it curiously.

XU YIRU
Mommy, what's that?

XU YIYANG
Let me see!

XU YIRU
It has tigers!

LIN WANQING kneels, removing the pendant which splits in two. She gives each child a half.

LIN WANQING
These are yours. Never take them off. They tell you who you are.

CHILDREN
Okay!

FENG MEI picks up a radio from the gift table.

FENG MEI
I'll put this in the bridal chamber. For later.

She exits toward the house. XU YIXIANG watches her go.

INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - DAY

XU YIXIANG sits on the wedding bed, head in hands. FENG MEI enters, already changed into LIN WANQING's qipao.

FENG MEI
The children are eating with their grandmother. We have time.

XU YIXIANG
(looking up, startled)
You shouldn't be wearing that.

FENG MEI
(teasing, but with an edge)
Why not? You bought it. For me.

XU YIXIANG stands, pacing.

XU YIXIANG
The plan is working. She's committed now. Mother talks to her, not to strangers. The kids are attached. But the money from the girl—that feels...

FENG MEI
Don't become sentimental. You chose this. You made her fall for you, got her pregnant, convinced her to stay. All so you could keep the son and fund our future.

XU YIXIANG
She thinks she's protecting me. The gossip, the sacrifice—she believes in it. That's the worst part.

FENG MEI
You did what you had to. Women like her don't belong in the city anyway.

A small cough from the doorway. XU YIYANG stands there, holding a cup of tea.

XU YIYANG
Dad. Mom says you should drink this. For the toast.

XU YIXIANG takes the cup, his hand trembling. Behind the boy, XU YIRU peeks in, her eyes going from the qipao to Feng Mei's face.

XU YIRU
(quietly)
You look like Mommy. But you're not.

The tea cup slips from XU YIXIANG's hand. It shatters on the floor.

FADE OUT.

title: The Wedding Confrontation
description: At a wedding, a private daughter confronts the bride over a stolen fiancé, leading to a dramatic revelation and violent confrontation.
context:
Title: The Wedding Confrontation
Description: At a wedding, a private daughter confronts the bride over a stolen fiancé, leading to a dramatic revelation and violent confrontation.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

QI TONGTONG cuts through the wedding crowd like a blade. She ignores the whispers.

XIAO YU
(whispering to XIAO'S MOTHER)
That's Qi Tongtong. The daughter from the affair.

XIAO'S MOTHER
(whispering)
Disgraceful.

Qi Tongtong halts before the stage. XIAO XU sees her and pales.

QI TONGTONG
I'm taking back what's mine.

JING LUO
Xiao Xu belongs to me now.

JING LUO
I saved him from you and your schemes. Remember?

XIAO XU
Jing Luo, don't—

JING LUO
Then make her admit what she did.

Qi Tongtong's breathing quickens. She whispers to herself.

QI TONGTONG (V.O.)
If he finds out the truth, I'll lose him forever.

Her fingers close around a cake knife.
continuation:
JING LUO
(panicking)
Xiao Xu, she's—

Qi Tongtong presses the blade to her own pulse point.

QI TONGTONG
Choose. Right now.

XIAO XU
Tongtong, don't do this—

QI TONGTONG
Who do you love?

Xiao Xu's eyes lock with hers. A lifetime passes in seconds.

XIAO XU
You. Only you.

JING LUO
(whispered, shattered)
Five years... was I ever anything more than your shield?

Xiao Xu says nothing. His silence damns her.

Qi Tongtong releases a sob of relief and fury. She shoves the nearest object—the wedding cake cart.

QI TONGTONG
Leave us alone!

It crashes into Jing Luo. She crumples, hands clutching her stomach, blood blooming on white silk.

XIAO XU
(roaring)
Jing Luo!

Qi Tongtong watches, knife still trembling in her hand.
