title: The Whole Family Eavesdrops on the Miao Mother and Daughter's Thoughts
description: A Miao woman and her daughter search for the child's father while the family mysteriously hears their inner thoughts.
context:
Title: The Whole Family Eavesdrops on the Miao Mother and Daughter's Thoughts
Description: A Miao woman and her daughter search for the child's father while the family mysteriously hears their inner thoughts.

EXT. MOUNTAIN FOREST - DAY

YUN WANWAN, dressed in Miao ethnic clothing, sits cross-legged in meditation, surrounded by a blue aura. Dark clouds gather in the sky with lightning and thunder.

BAOBAO (O.S.)
Mommy, watch out!

A bolt of lightning strikes toward YUN WANWAN. BAOBAO descends from the sky holding a small umbrella, blocking the lightning strike in front of YUN WANWAN.

YUN WANWAN slowly descends to the ground.

BAOBAO
(in a childish voice)
Thanks, Baobao.

BAOBAO
You promised we'd find Daddy. We've been down the mountain for days, and you don't even know what he looks like!

YUN WANWAN
Seven years ago, my poison arts entered demonic deviation. Memories scattered like poison mist. But some marks... some marks the soul doesn't forget.

BAOBAO
What kind of mark?

YUN WANWAN
(touching Baobao's shoulder gently)
A cloud etched in spirit energy. Find the mark, find your father.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

LU MINGXIU, shirtless, looks at the cloud-shaped mark on his shoulder in the mirror.

LU MINGXIU
(to himself)
Seven years. The mark remains.

FLASHBACK
continuation:
INT. STEAM-FILLED BATHROOM - NIGHT (SEVEN YEARS AGO)

LU MINGXIU stands under running water, disoriented.

LU MINGXIU
Who's there?

YUN WANWAN emerges from steam, her veil translucent, eyes fever-bright.

YUN WANWAN
Love poison courses through my veins. The cure... it's heat. Your heat.

LU MINGXIU
(dazed)
I don't understand--

YUN WANWAN
(pressing close, whispering)
Miao women bond for eternity. One touch seals fate.

Her fingertip glows azure. She traces the mark on his shoulder. It flares, then fades into his skin.

YUN WANWAN
Find me through this cloud.

END FLASHBACK

INT. ROOM - DAY

LU MINGXIU's phone rings.

LU MINGXIU
Mingyu? Slow down--

SISTER (V.O.) (sobbing)
Brother, Mom collapsed! City Hospital, now!

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

YUN WANWAN and BAOBAO walk down the street.

YUN WANWAN
Baobao, use your sight. Find someone whose energy resonates with ours. Someone whose fate line crosses the cloud's path.

BAOBAO
But Mommy, the money--

YUN WANWAN
Survival first, honor second. We'll find a way to earn it honestly. Just... show me who glitters with fate and fortune.

BAOBAO's eyes emit a golden light as she looks at the vehicles passing on the road. An ordinary white SUV passes by, then a black SUV. Finally, a golden, gleaming Rolls-Royce appears.

BAOBAO
(excited)
Mommy, he's the one!

YUN WANWAN
(happy)
The cloud mark... it's responding!

INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - DAY

LU MINGXIU is driving. The cloud MARK on his shoulder suddenly burns. He winces, clutching it. Then -- distant VOICES echo in his mind, overlapping.

BAOBAO (V.O.)
Mommy, he's the one!

YUN WANWAN (V.O.)
The cloud mark... it's responding!

LU MINGXIU
(to himself, stunned)
Those voices... in my head?

He looks out, sees Yun Wanwan and Baobao on the sidewalk. Their eyes meet. Time seems to slow. The burning intensifies.

title: Global Apocalypse Announcement & Rotating Disasters: Heatwave to Cold Wave to Extinction
description: After losing everything in a global apocalypse, a man is reborn 15 days before the end to save his sister and humanity from rotating monthly disasters.
context:
Title: Global Apocalypse Announcement & Rotating Disasters: Heatwave to Cold Wave to Extinction
Description: After losing everything in a global apocalypse, a man is reborn 15 days before the end to save his sister and humanity from rotating monthly disasters.

EXT. RUINED CITY - DAY

The city has become ruins, broken walls and debris, smoke and dust everywhere. Several scrapped cars are scattered on the muddy streets.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
At first, nobody understood the pattern. A heat dome in Siberia. A flash freeze in Panama. They called them isolated events. Until the grid failed everywhere.

EXT. SPACE/EARTH - DAY

Earth rotates in space, surrounded by purple nebulae. The scene cuts to dry, cracked earth, the sun scorching everything.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The magnetosphere fractured. The planet began pulsing. Each month, a new extinction protocol.

EXT. ABOVE THE RUINS - DAY

On a desolate field of rubble, many corpses lie scattered. CHEN ASHENG holds his dying sister CHEN NAN, both covered in blood.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
January: The Burning. Over a billion dead. Governments collapsed by the third week.

CHEN NAN
(whispering, urgent)
The bunker coordinates... in my journal. Don't wait for me.

CHEN NAN presses a blood-stained notebook into his hand. Her breathing stutters.

CHEN ASHENG
(quiet, desperate)
Stay with me. The portals could reopen. Just hold on—

CHEN NAN
No more waiting. Promise me... you'll stop counting the dead.

CHEN NAN's hand goes limp. CHEN ASHENG bows his head, silent.

A figure approaches through the dust—LIU FANG, once polished, now hardened.

LIU FANG
(quiet, cold)
She's gone. We need to move. The Collective is heading west.

CHEN ASHENG
(not looking up)
You led them here. For what? A few cans of preserved meat?

LIU FANG
For a chance. Something you never understood.
continuation:
INT. BUILDING HALL - NIGHT

NARRATOR (V.O.)
February: The Deep Freeze. Survivors huddled in shelters... until the fuel ran out.

A MAN carrying a box of supplies is being pursued. His GIRLFRIEND lags behind, panic in her eyes.

GIRLFRIEND
(frantic)
Drop it! They'll kill you!

The MAN stumbles, refuses to let go. He's cornered, beaten.

GIRLFRIEND
(screaming)
Give them what they want!

The MAN is killed. The GIRLFRIEND, trembling, retrieves the box and approaches the attackers.

GIRLFRIEND
(hollow)
Can I... come with you? I know where there's more.

INT. SUBWAY CAR - NIGHT

NARRATOR (V.O.)
March: The Reanimate. The dead didn't stay dead. And the living turned faster.

The car is a mess, corpses everywhere. CHEN ASHENG, covered in blood, sits slumped on the ground. LIU FANG stands beside a man in tactical gear, KOVACS, who holds a chainsaw.

KOVACS
(grim efficiency)
You made the right call. We couldn't carry three.

LIU FANG
(to Chen)
There was only room for two in the tunnel. It was mathematical.

CHEN ASHENG
(bitter)
Mathematical. You slit JIN's throat while he slept. That's your math?

LIU FANG
JIN was wounded. He'd have slowed us down. You taught me that—survival calculus.

KOVACS
(raising the chainsaw)
Don't take it personal. The world's just optimizing.

CHEN ASHENG
(quiet, resigned)
See you in the next cycle.

EXT. TEACHING BUILDING PLAZA - DAY

CHEN ASHENG jolts awake, finding himself standing in a plaza, everything normal around him. He looks at his hands, completely intact.

CHEN ASHENG (V.O.)
Fifteen days. That's the buffer. The magnetosphere anomaly started on August 3rd. Today is July 19th.

CHEN ASHENG (V.O.)
This time, the math is different. This time, we don't leave anyone behind.

EXT. NATIONAL CRISIS COMMAND CENTER ENTRANCE - DAY

CHEN ASHENG runs toward a fortified building. SECURITY PERSONNEL block him.

CHEN ASHENG
I need to see Director Harding! Now!

QIN MUYAN, mid-30s, observant, steps out.

QIN MUYAN
Stand down. This is a restricted facility.

CHEN ASHENG
The August 3rd anomaly—it's going to cascade. Monthly disasters. I've seen the pattern.

QIN MUYAN
(senses his conviction)
Everybody's seen the solar flare reports. What makes your theory different?

CHEN ASHENG
Because I've already buried my sister three times. And I'm done counting.

QIN MUYAN studies him—a man who knows too many specifics.

QIN MUYAN
Wait here. Don't move.

She gestures to security, then disappears inside.

title: Dump the Ungrateful Woman
description: After eight years together, a man's marriage proposal is interrupted when his girlfriend abandons him to comfort her male best friend.
context:
Title: Dump the Ungrateful Woman
Description: After eight years together, a man's marriage proposal is interrupted when his girlfriend abandons him to comfort her male best friend.

INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT

A group of FRIENDS sit around a large round table eating dinner, the atmosphere lively.

FRIEND
Ye Tian, eight years with Yiqing deserves more than a "we'll see."

QIN YIQING
(smiling)
We're still editing the story.

ZHANG HANZHI
(picking up a shrimp and placing it in Yiqing's bowl)
Sister Qing, your favorite.

QIN YIQING
(happily)
My hero. Some things never change.

YE TIAN's face darkens as he silently drinks his wine.

FRIEND
You two have your own rhythm, huh?

YE TIAN slams down his wine glass heavily, making a loud noise. Everyone turns to look.

ZHANG HANZHI
(clapping)
Good!

YE TIAN
(sarcastically)
Why don't you two just share a bowl while you're at it?

QIN YIQING
(shocked and angry)
Ye Tian, what are you saying?

YE TIAN
I'm saying eight years of watching this circus is enough. I wish you both the happiness you clearly deserve.

QIN YIQING
Ye Tian, you've had too much to drink.

ZHANG HANZHI
(seriously)
You'd better apologize to Sister Qing right now! Sister Qing and I are just friends.

YE TIAN
(sneering)
Male bestie, right? The kind who rates above a marriage proposal when he cries wolf?

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

ONE DAY EARLIER

The room is decorated with balloons and rose petals. YE TIAN kneels on one knee, holding a diamond ring, proposing to YIQING.

YE TIAN
Qingqing, will you marry me? Let me stop waiting.

YIQING's phone rings. The caller ID shows "Ahan." She answers the call.

ZHANG HANZHI (V.O.)
Sister Qing, I just broke up. Can you come keep me company?

QIN YIQING
(without hesitation)
I'm on my way.

YIQING turns to leave. YE TIAN quickly stands up and grabs her.

YE TIAN
Qingqing, the ring is still in my hand.

QIN YIQING
(impatiently)
Ahan needs me. Marriage can wait.

YE TIAN
His breakup is more important than our future?

QIN YIQING
(angrily)
Ye Tian, Ahan is family. If you can't respect that, we're done.

YE TIAN hugs her from behind.

YE TIAN
Eight years of "we'll talk later." How much longer?

ZHANG HANZHI's voice comes through the phone.

ZHANG HANZHI (V.O.)
Sister Qing, if it's not convenient, I can be alone tonight. It's fine.

QIN YIQING
(struggling)
Let go of me! He needs me right now!

YE TIAN
(painfully)
He needs you, but I don't? Does he need to marry you?

YIQING breaks free forcefully and slaps YE TIAN across the face.

QIN YIQING
(furiously)
I warned you not to test this.

She picks up her phone.

QIN YIQING
(into the phone, voice softening)
Ahan, I'm leaving now. Ye Tian understands.

YIQING kicks off her high heels and leaves without looking back. YE TIAN stands alone, looking at the scattered rose petals and the open ring box on the floor, his eyes filled with despair.

END FLASHBACK.

(picking up a shrimp and placing it in Yiqing's bowl)
Sister Qing, your favorite.

QIN YIQING
(happily)
My hero. Some things never change.

YE TIAN's face darkens as he silently drinks his wine.

FRIEND
You two have your own rhythm, huh?

YE TIAN slams down his wine glass heavily, making a loud noise. Everyone turns to look.

ZHANG HANZHI
(clapping)
Good!

YE TIAN
(sarcastically)
Why don't you two just share a bowl while you're at it?

QIN YIQING
(shocked and angry)
Ye Tian, what are you saying?

YE TIAN
I'm saying eight years of watching this circus is enough. I wish you both the happiness you clearly deserve.

QIN YIQING
Ye Tian, you've had too much to drink.

ZHANG HANZHI
(seriously)
You'd better apologize to Sister Qing right now! Sister Qing and I are just friends.

YE TIAN
(sneering)
Male bestie, right? The kind who rates above a marriage proposal when he cries wolf?

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

ONE DAY EARLIER

The room is decorated with balloons and rose petals. YE TIAN kneels on one knee, holding a diamond ring, proposing to YIQING.

YE TIAN
Qingqing, will you marry me? Let me stop waiting.

YIQING's phone rings. The caller ID shows "Ahan." She answers the call.

ZHANG HANZHI (V.O.)
Sister Qing, I just broke up. Can you come keep me company?

QIN YIQING
(without hesitation)
I'm on my way.

YIQING turns to leave. YE TIAN quickly stands up and grabs her.

YE TIAN
Qingqing, the ring is still in my hand.

QIN YIQING
(impatiently)
Ahan needs me. Marriage can wait.

YE TIAN
His breakup is more important than our future?

QIN YIQING
(angrily)
Ye Tian, Ahan is family. If you can't respect that, we're done.

YE TIAN hugs her from behind.

YE TIAN
Eight years of "we'll talk later." How much longer?

ZHANG HANZHI's voice comes through the phone.

ZHANG HANZHI (V.O.)
Sister Qing, if it's not convenient, I can be alone tonight. It's fine.

QIN YIQING
(struggling)
Let go of me! He needs me right now!

YE TIAN
(painfully)
He needs you, but I don't? Does he need to marry you?

YIQING breaks free forcefully and slaps YE TIAN across the face.

QIN YIQING
(furiously)
I warned you not to test this.

She picks up her phone.

QIN YIQING
(into the phone, voice softening)
Ahan, I'm leaving now. Ye Tian understands.

YIQING kicks off her high heels and leaves without looking back. YE TIAN stands alone, looking at the scattered rose petals and the open ring box on the floor, his eyes filled with despair.

END FLASHBACK.

title: Raising a Son Like a Tiger
description: A father loses his son to kidnappers while trying to save another child, and vows to find him while adopting the boy he rescued.
context:
Title: Raising a Son Like a Tiger
Description: A father loses his son to kidnappers while trying to save another child, and vows to find him while adopting the boy he rescued.

INT. BRIDGE - DAY

LIN JIANGUO pedals a tricycle with his son RULONG in the cart, both smiling.

RULONG
Dad, can I really go to school here?

LIN JIANGUO
(happily)
Of course. When you get there, be polite to your teachers and classmates. And be as brave as a tiger.

RULONG
I will.

LIN JIANGUO
Good boy. What do you want to eat later?

A car speeds past, clips the tricycle. LIN JIANGUO struggles for control as the wheel buckles.

EXT. NIGHT MARKET - NIGHT

A white van stops abruptly. GANG LEADER and two THUGS exit, scanning the crowd.

Nearby, a MOTHER pays at a stall while her LITTLE BOY holds her hand, watching the men fearfully.

The THUGS move in—one grabs the MOTHER, another yanks the LITTLE BOY.

VENDOR
Let go of them!

MOTHER
(struggling)
Let go of my son!

LITTLE BOY
Mommy! Mommy!

LIN JIANGUO and RULONG sit at a nearby table, their damaged tricycle visible in the background.

LIN JIANGUO
(to RULONG)
Stay here. Don't move.

LIN JIANGUO stands, walks toward the commotion.

GANG LEADER
(to the crowd)
This isn't your business!

LITTLE BOY
(crying)
Mommy!

LIN JIANGUO
(to THUGS)
Let the boy go. He's not part of this.

GANG LEADER
(viciously)
Get him.

The THUGS attack. LIN JIANGUO fights, but is outnumbered. The MOTHER, breaking free, lunges for her son—a THUG shoves her. She hits her head on a concrete pillar and collapses.

LIN JIANGUO
The child!

RULONG
(running forward)
continuation:
Dad!

A THUG grabs RULONG by the arm.

THUG
Got you!

RULONG
(terrified)
Dad! Save me!

The THUGS shove RULONG into the van.

LIN JIANGUO breaks free, reaches the van window, pounds on it desperately.

RULONG
(crying inside)
Dad! Save me!

LIN JIANGUO
(roaring)
Rulong! Rulong!

The van speeds away. LIN JIANGUO falls to his knees, screaming.

LIN JIANGUO
Rulong!

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

The operating room light: SURGERY IN PROGRESS.

A DOCTOR emerges. LIN JIANGUO, injured, bloody, moves forward. The LITTLE BOY stands beside him.

LIN JIANGUO
Doctor, how is she?

DOCTOR
(gravely)
The head trauma was catastrophic. We did everything possible.

The LITTLE BOY stares in disbelief.

LITTLE BOY
(whisper)
You're lying... right?

He begins to tremble, tears falling.

LITTLE BOY
Mommy...

LIN JIANGUO crouches, pulls the boy into his arms.

LIN JIANGUO
Child...

LITTLE BOY
(sobbing)
Mommy... don't leave me... I don't want to be alone...

LIN JIANGUO holds him tightly, his own tears falling now. He looks down at the boy, seeing his son's face.

LIN JIANGUO
(gently but firmly)
You're not alone. From today, you are my son. Your name is Lin Silong.

The boy cries uncontrollably in LIN JIANGUO'S arms.

LIN JIANGUO (V.O.)
Rulong... wherever you are... your father is coming.

title: Reborn Splendor
description: The eldest daughter of the Ye family is reborn on the day she was forced to marry a poor scholar, while her sister took her place to marry the powerful Prince of Zhenbei.
context:
Title: Reborn Splendor
Description: The eldest daughter of the Ye family is reborn on the day she was forced to marry a poor scholar, while her sister took her place to marry the powerful Prince of Zhenbei.

INT. YE MANOR - DAY

SCENE: YE ZHAO'S BEDROOM

YE ZHAO sits before a vanity, wearing an ornate red ceremonial dress and a phoenix crown. Her fingers trace the empty socket where a pearl is missing. Her eyes hold the weight of memory.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
The last time I wore this crown, I died in it.

A MAID drapes a black outer robe embroidered with a golden phoenix over her shoulders.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
Three years ago, my sister Ye Ruoyao and I both came of age.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

YE ZHAO and YE RUOYAO walk side by side in the palace. Ye Ruoyao's silk slippers leave no mark; Ye Zhao's hem is frayed at the toes.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
She was betrothed to the powerful Prince of Zhenbei, Xiao Heng.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD/SNOWY LANDSCAPE - DAY

PRINCE XIAO HENG, wearing armor and wielding twin blades, stands with his back to the camera, a mighty figure. A banner with his house sigil tears in the wind.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
As for me, I was arranged to marry a poor scholar, Sun Tingzhi.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

YE ZHAO stands together with the poor scholar SUN TINGZHI. He offers her a jade pendant. She accepts it, but her eyes remain on the palace gates.

MONTAGE - PAST LIFE MEMORIES

XIAO HENG, bare-chested and covered in wounds, is bound by ropes, about to be executed. His eyes find Ye Zhao in the crowd and hold them.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
The Prince was falsely accused of treason and beheaded.

A blade flashes. Blood splatters on wooden planks.

YE RUOYAO sits in a dim room, tearing at her wedding robes with her teeth, screaming through silk.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
Ye Ruoyao went mad.

SUN TINGZHI gently drapes an outer garment over YE ZHAO's shoulders. She flinches at his touch.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
The scholar became Prime Minister.

SUN TINGZHI, dressed in official robes, laughs triumphantly.
continuation:
EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE INVESTITURE CEREMONY - DAY

YE ZHAO kneels in the center of the courtyard, receiving her official title.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
On the day I received my imperial mandate...

YE RUOYAO, expression crazed, rushes toward YE ZHAO with a dagger. The pearl from Ye Zhao's crown is sewn into Ye Ruoyao's hem.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
Ye Ruoyao, consumed by jealousy, plunged a blade into my body.

YE RUOYAO stabs the dagger into YE ZHAO's abdomen. Surrounding soldiers immediately draw their bows, and several arrows strike YE RUOYAO.

YE ZHAO spits blood and collapses to the ground. YE RUOYAO also falls, struck by arrows.

YE RUOYAO
(weakly, spitting blood)
Even this... you did first.

Both lie on the ground, dying.

YE ZHAO (V.O.)
If there is a next life, I will choose my own cage.

The screen flickers with glitch effects, indicating rebirth.

INT. YE MANOR GREAT HALL - DAY

YE ZHAO suddenly awakens, gripping a marriage contract. Her palm bleeds where her nails have pierced the fresh paper.

YE ZHAO (INTERNAL)
This contract... unmarked. Today's date.

She looks up to see her father YE ZHENGSONG and stepmother DENG SHUANG'ER seated in the places of honor.

EXT. STREET - DAY

MATCHMAKER SUN POPO and the Zhenbei Prince's Manor STEWARDESS ZHANG MAMA walk down the street carrying betrothal gifts.

INT. YE MANOR GREAT HALL - DAY

YE ZHAO kneels before her parents.

DENG SHUANG'ER
(sighing)
Ruoyao hasn't eaten or drunk for three days. The physician says her constitution is too delicate.

YE ZHAO (INTERNAL)
I've returned to the day they sold me.

YE ZHENGSONG
(to Ye Zhao)
You are the elder sister. The resilient one.

DENG SHUANG'ER
Scholar Sun is virtuous. A gentle man. He'll treat you with respect, no matter what.

A SERVANT presents a marriage contract before YE ZHAO. She sees both contracts on the tray—prepared in the same handwriting.

YE ZHAO (INTERNAL)
They drew up both fates. And chose the easier path.

YE ZHAO
(quietly)
The Prince's household expects the legitimate eldest daughter.

She meets her father's eyes. For the first time in two lifetimes, she doesn't look away.

DENG SHUANG'ER
(laughing lightly)
The Prince cares only for beauty. And Ruoyao's health—

YE RUOYAO rushes into the hall, breathless. Her fine silk is wrinkled. She smells of medicine and desperation.

YE RUOYAO
(falling to her knees)
I'll marry Scholar Sun.

title: Prison Gate
description: A young man is released from prison after taking the fall for his girlfriend, only to be betrayed and threatened by her and her new lover.
context:
Title: Prison Gate
Description: A young man is released from prison after taking the fall for his girlfriend, only to be betrayed and threatened by her and her new lover.

INT. PRISON GATE - DAY

A heavy iron door slowly opens, blinding sunlight streaming in.

YE CHEN, 26 with hardened features, steps out from the darkness into the light. He carries a worn paper bag, squinting against the glare.

EXT. PRISON ENTRANCE - DAY

YE CHEN stands near the sign reading "Zhengcheng Second Prison." He pulls a cheap phone from his pocket and dials.

YE CHEN
(into phone)
It's me.

YE CHEN
(into phone)
Qianqian, where are you?

LIU QIAN (V.O.)
Look to your left.

YE CHEN looks left. A black sedan idles at the curb, blocking the walkway. LIU QIAN and ZHAO XIAOFENG step out.

ZHAO XIAOFENG
(mockingly)
Well, well. Young Master Ye. Out in the world again.

ZHAO XIAOFENG
(continuing mockingly)
I was debating—should we invite you to our wedding, or skip the formalities?

YE CHEN
(shocked)
You're marrying him?

YE CHEN
(turning to LIU QIAN)
Qianqian, you promised. If I went to prison—
continuation:
LIU QIAN
(coldly)
I promised I'd survive. I have.

ZHAO XIAOFENG
You didn't think she'd marry an ex-con with a record and that cough?

YE CHEN
(struggling to keep his voice steady)
Qianqian, it's not disease. It's an old injury.

ZHAO XIAOFENG
(disgusted)
It's a liability. Are you trying to drag her down?

YE CHEN
(quietly)
I'm not.

LIU QIAN
(sharply)
Enough, Ye Chen. The way you are now, you're not even worthy of carrying my shoes.

LIU QIAN
(threateningly)
I came here to tell you—after today, you disappear. Or the evidence we have makes you disappear permanently.

YE CHEN
(angrily)
You—

YE CHEN
(quietly)
Three years is a long time to make friends.

Ye Chen pulls a small recorder from his pocket. Drops it. The light blinks.

YE CHEN
I kept your secrets. Now you keep mine.

Ye Chen walks away, leaving the recorder between them.

title: Goodbye, My Childhood Sweethearts
description: A successful designer is forced into an arranged marriage while dealing with her childhood friends who favor her rival.
context:
Title: Goodbye, My Childhood Sweethearts
Description: A successful designer is forced into an arranged marriage while dealing with her childhood friends who favor her rival.

EXT. CITY/NEWS REPORT - DAY

News footage rapidly switches: the Pangu Model AI interface, stock charts soaring, then a press conference.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Gu Corporation's Pangu Model IPO has skyrocketed CEO Gu Cilan to the Forbes Celebrity List—net worth in the hundreds of billions, and according to a recent poll, the man most netizens want to marry.

EXT. ARCHERY RANGE - DAY

GU CILAN (30s, precise, controlled) draws a compound bow, his focus absolute. His ASSISTANT hovers nearby with a tablet.

ASSISTANT
Sir, the old master insists. This year, you marry the Song heir, no exceptions.

GU CILAN
I don't do arranged marriages.

He releases. Arrow splits the previous bullseye.

ASSISTANT
Shall I inform the Song family their daughter isn't convenient?

GU CILAN
(tensing slightly)
Which daughter?

ASSISTANT
The youngest—Song Shiwei. Currently based in Haicheng.

GU CILAN lowers his bow, considering. A beat.

GU CILAN
(quietly)
The one who turned down our Beijing partnership last year.

ASSISTANT
That's her.

GU CILAN
She's practical. Won't complicate things.
(beat)
Tell them I agree. But I'm handling this personally. Book Haicheng.

ASSISTANT
Yes, sir.
continuation:
EXT. CITY SKYLINE - DAY

Gu Corporation's red helicopter arcs across the skyline.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

SONG SHIWEI (20s, sharp-eyed, tired) paces in a pink linen dress, phone to her ear.

SONG SHIWEI
Mom, I need time to—

SONG'S MOTHER (O.S.)
Your grandfather's heart medication isn't a negotiation, Weiwei. The engagement honors his generation.

SONG SHIWEI
(rubbing her temple)
Fine. But this conversation isn't over.

She hangs up. XIANG HAN (early 20s, polished, too-smiling) appears in the doorway holding a crystal trophy.

XIANG HAN
Shiwei? The director sent me with your award.

SONG SHIWEI
Just set it down.

XIANG HAN
Actually... I was hoping you'd let me announce this as a co-win. For my portfolio. You know how competitive senior designer promotions are.

SONG SHIWEI
You contributed one color suggestion.

XIANG HAN
(softly)
But everyone knows I need this more than you do.

She extends the trophy. Song reaches. Xiang Han "slips"—the trophy crashes. Glass shatters across tile.

A shard slices Song Shiwei's calf. Blood seeps through her dress.

GUO ZEYU and YUN SHEN (mid-20s, athletic, visibly closer to Xiang Han) burst in.

GUO ZEYU
Han!

They instinctively shield Xiang Han, checking her hands for cuts.

YUN SHEN
What happened?

XIANG HAN
(tearfully)
I just wanted to celebrate her win, but...

GUO ZEYU
(seeing Song's bleeding leg)
Weiwei, was this necessary? It's her birthday.

YUN SHEN
She came bearing gifts. You couldn't even pretend to be gracious?

Song Shiwei meets their eyes—first wounded, then something harder. She tears a strip from her dress, binds her leg herself.

SONG SHIWEI
(icy calm)
Get out. All of you.

XIANG HAN
Sister, I—

SONG SHIWEI
Now.

The three exchange glances—Xiang Han's subtly victorious, the boys' confused. They retreat. Song Shiwei stands alone, bleeding, and very still.
full_script:
Title: Goodbye, My Childhood Sweethearts
Description: A successful designer is forced into an arranged marriage while dealing with her childhood friends who favor her rival.

EXT. CITY/NEWS REPORT - DAY

News footage rapidly switches: the Pangu Model AI interface, stock charts soaring, then a press conference.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Gu Corporation's Pangu Model IPO has skyrocketed CEO Gu Cilan to the Forbes Celebrity List—net worth in the hundreds of billions, and according to a recent poll, the man most netizens want to marry.

EXT. ARCHERY RANGE - DAY

GU CILAN (30s, precise, controlled) draws a compound bow, his focus absolute. His ASSISTANT hovers nearby with a tablet.

ASSISTANT
Sir, the old master insists. This year, you marry the Song heir, no exceptions.

GU CILAN
I don't do arranged marriages.

He releases. Arrow splits the previous bullseye.

ASSISTANT
Shall I inform the Song family their daughter isn't convenient?

GU CILAN
(tensing slightly)
Which daughter?

ASSISTANT
The youngest—Song Shiwei. Currently based in Haicheng.

GU CILAN lowers his bow, considering. A beat.

GU CILAN
(quietly)
The one who turned down our Beijing partnership last year.

ASSISTANT
That's her.

GU CILAN
She's practical. Won't complicate things.
(beat)
Tell them I agree. But I'm handling this personally. Book Haicheng.

ASSISTANT
Yes, sir.

EXT. CITY SKYLINE - DAY

Gu Corporation's red helicopter arcs across the skyline.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

SONG SHIWEI (20s, sharp-eyed, tired) paces in a pink linen dress, phone to her ear.

SONG SHIWEI
Mom, I need time to—

SONG'S MOTHER (O.S.)
Your grandfather's heart medication isn't a negotiation, Weiwei. The engagement honors his generation.

SONG SHIWEI
(rubbing her temple)
Fine. But this conversation isn't over.

She hangs up. XIANG HAN (early 20s, polished, too-smiling) appears in the doorway holding a crystal trophy.

XIANG HAN
Shiwei? The director sent me with your award.

SONG SHIWEI
Just set it down.

XIANG HAN
Actually... I was hoping you'd let me announce this as a co-win. For my portfolio. You know how competitive senior designer promotions are.

SONG SHIWEI
You contributed one color suggestion.

XIANG HAN
(softly)
But everyone knows I need this more than you do.

She extends the trophy. Song reaches. Xiang Han "slips"—the trophy crashes. Glass shatters across tile.

A shard slices Song Shiwei's calf. Blood seeps through her dress.

GUO ZEYU and YUN SHEN (mid-20s, athletic, visibly closer to Xiang Han) burst in.

GUO ZEYU
Han!

They instinctively shield Xiang Han, checking her hands for cuts.

YUN SHEN
What happened?

XIANG HAN
(tearfully)
I just wanted to celebrate her win, but...

GUO ZEYU
(seeing Song's bleeding leg)
Weiwei, was this necessary? It's her birthday.

YUN SHEN
She came bearing gifts. You couldn't even pretend to be gracious?

Song Shiwei meets their eyes—first wounded, then something harder. She tears a strip from her dress, binds her leg herself.

SONG SHIWEI
(icy calm)
Get out. All of you.

XIANG HAN
Sister, I—

SONG SHIWEI
Now.

The three exchange glances—Xiang Han's subtly victorious, the boys' confused. They retreat. Song Shiwei stands alone, bleeding, and very still.

title: The Peasant Girl Who Won the Emperor's Heart
description: A flower gardener's daughter catches the eye of the emperor after a fateful encounter in the palace gardens, but her humble origins threaten their union.
context:
Title: The Peasant Girl Who Won the Emperor's Heart
Description: A flower gardener's daughter catches the eye of the emperor after a fateful encounter in the palace gardens, but her humble origins threaten their union.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE GARDEN - DAY

JIANG WANLI, wearing a plain cotton ruqun, carries a pot of azaleas through the garden, her face determined.

JIANG WANLI
(to herself)
If these azaleas please the Empress Dowager, perhaps Father's position will finally be secured.

She stumbles, gripping a stone lotus pedestal. The world spins. The pot falls from her grasp.

MONTAGE:

- CHEN FENGYING stirs a bowl of steaming tonic, worry etched on her face.

CHEN FENGYING
Ah Li, your father prepared this strength tonic. Drink it before you go to the palace.

JIANG WANLI
Thank you, Mother.

She drinks. The bitter liquid makes her wince.

END MONTAGE.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE GARDEN - CONTINUOUS

JIANG WANLI clutches her chest, vision blurring. A pair of strong arms catch her. XIAO JINGYUAN appears, dressed in fine but simple robes.

XIAO JINGYUAN
(concerned)
Miss, are you unwell?

JIANG WANLI
(weakly)
The tonic... something was wrong...

She collapses against him. He discreetly presses a jade pendant into her palm.

XIAO JINGYUAN
(whispering)
Hold this. I'll get you to safety.

He lifts her and carries her toward a secondary palace.
continuation:
INT. JINGREN PALACE SIDE CHAMBER - DAY

XIAO JINGYUAN lays JIANG WANLI on a couch. She stirs, their faces close.

JIANG WANLI
(groggy)
You... the western garden boy...

XIAO JINGYUAN
(smiling)
You remember.

He shows her a scar on his palm.

FADE TO BLACK.

INT. JINGREN PALACE SIDE CHAMBER - MORNING

JIANG WANLI wakes with a start. She finds the jade pendant in her hand. XIAO JINGYUAN sits nearby.

XIAO JINGYUAN
(softly)
You called me Ah Yuan in your sleep.

JIANG WANLI
I must go. My father will worry.

She rises and leaves quietly, clutching the pendant.

XIAO JINGYUAN
(quietly)
Wanli... ten years I've searched.

INT. CINING PALACE - DAY

EUNUCH
His Majesty arrives!

XIAO JINGYUAN, now in imperial yellow robes, enters and bows.

XIAO JINGYUAN
Mother Empress, this son seeks permission to take a consort.

EMPRESS DOWAGER OF DAXIA
Which family's daughter?

XIAO JINGYUAN
The imperial gardener Jiang Youde's daughter.

The Empress Dowager's smile freezes.

EMPRESS DOWAGER OF DAXIA
A gardener's daughter? The court will say you've lost your mind.

XIAO JINGYUAN
(places the jade pendant on the table)
She saved my life as a boy. I intend to elevate her family and demonstrate imperial grace to all common scholars.

EMPRESS DOWAGER OF DAXIA
(sighs)
You always did hide sentiment behind statecraft. Very well. But she must pass the Six Bureaus examination. I will not have an ill-prepared girl embarrassed in the Inner Court.

XIAO JINGYUAN
She'll outshine them all.

EXT. PALACE PATHWAY - DAY

PALACE MAID A
His Majesty demands the gardener's daughter face examination for consort.

PALACE MAID B
She won't survive a day against those palace sharks.

JIANG WANLI is nearby, trimming peonies. Her scissors slip. The jade pendant falls from her pocket.

JIANG WANLI (V.O.)
Ah Yuan... the Emperor? Then the western garden boy was a prince all along.

She stares at the pendant, then at the palace towers rising above.

title: Winter Court Snow
description: A general's daughter waits in the snow on her beloved's wedding night, confronting him about their broken engagement and his betrayal.
context:
Title: Winter Court Snow
Description: A general's daughter waits in the snow on her beloved's wedding night, confronting him about their broken engagement and his betrayal.

EXT. PEI MANOR COURTYARD - NIGHT

The night is deep, heavy snow falls. The Pei Manor is decorated with lanterns and red silk. A plaque reads "General Pei's Manor."

In the silhouette of a window, a man and woman embrace intimately.

WOMAN (V.O.)
You've finally returned.

SHENG CANGLANG stands alone in the snow, wearing an elaborate red wedding dress and phoenix crown, gazing at that window. Her expression is both sorrowful and resolute.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: Sheng Canglang, legitimate daughter of the Duke Protector's Manor

BYSTANDER 1 (V.O.)
They say the Duke Protector's daughter has been standing there for hours. The General hasn't sent a single person out.

BYSTANDER 2 (V.O.)
Who could blame her? The man she nursed back from death—now he returns and marries another. I'd want answers too.

The maid QIU MIAN runs to SHENG CANGLANG's side, holding an oiled paper umbrella.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: Qiu Mian, Sheng Canglang's maid

QIU MIAN
Miss, your father has called for you three times already. If the Duke discovers you're here—

SHENG CANGLANG
(eyes resolute, voice barely above a whisper)
Then let him disown me. I just need to hear it from his own lips. That our engagement—that I—meant nothing.

The manor gate opens. PEI ZHAO walks out, wearing black ceremonial armor and a heavy cloak, his expression cold and distant.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: Pei Zhao, General Protector of the Nation

PEI ZHAO
On this day of Pei's wedding, before I could even change out of my wedding attire, I heard Miss Sheng was waiting here. Forgive my poor reception.

SHENG CANGLANG
(tearfully questioning)
Pei Zhao, I'll only ask you once: do you truly wish to break our engagement?

PEI ZHAO
I have already obtained an imperial edict to annul our engagement. Do you wish to defy the emperor's decree and have your entire family executed? 
(beat, voice dropping lower)
What we had... it was a child's promise. I grew up. You should too.

SHENG CANGLANG looks at him in shock. PEI ZHAO turns to leave, his cloak brushing her shoulder. SHENG CANGLANG staggers and falls to her knees in the snow.

She clutches a pure white jade hairpin tightly in her hand.

SHENG CANGLANG
(murmuring)
Then what does this mean?

FLASHBACK

ON-SCREEN TEXT: Ten years ago
continuation:
EXT. SNOWY STONE STEPS - DAY

Young and destitute PEI ZHAO, in tattered clothes, lies frozen on the stone steps of the Sheng family temple.

The young lady SHENG CANGLANG, wearing a white fur coat and holding an umbrella, appears before him. She is no older than twelve.

INT. ROOM - NIGHT

PEI ZHAO devours a bowl of rice ravenously.

PEI ZHAO
(mouth full)
This is the first thing I've eaten in three days. Thank you, Miss.

SHENG CANGLANG
The northern border campaign took your family?

PEI ZHAO
(stops eating, looks down)
Everyone. I have nothing left.

SHENG CANGLANG
(quietly)
Then stay. Learn to read, learn the sword. If you earn your place, you'll never go hungry again.

PEI ZHAO sets down his bowl and kneels solemnly. He takes out a jade hairpin from his chest—the only intact thing he owns.

PEI ZHAO
My father said this hairpin belonged to my mother. It's all I have of them. 
(he offers it to her)
I want you to have it. So I never forget.

END FLASHBACK

EXT. PEI MANOR COURTYARD - NIGHT

Back in the present, SHENG CANGLANG kneels in the snow, holding up that jade hairpin, tears streaming down her face.

SHENG CANGLANG
(voice trembling)
What does this jade hairpin mean? What do your promises mean? What do I, Sheng Canglang, mean to you?

PEI ZHAO
(coldly, but his jaw tightens)
It means you were a fool to believe them. And I was a fool to make them. We're both wiser now.

PEI ZHAO
My wife has traveled far and should not be disturbed. Leave us in peace.

At the doorway, another bride in red, SONG YANYAN, appears supported by a maid.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: Song Yanyan, Pei Zhao's newlywed wife

SONG YANYAN
(gently, but with steel beneath)
The General and I are grateful for your attendance, Miss Sheng. But the night grows cold, and some dreams belong only to winter. You should go home.

The words land like blows. SHENG CANGLANG's hand moves to the ceremonial sword at PEI ZHAO's belt—a wedding gift, ornate and sheathed. She draws it in one swift motion. PEI ZHAO does not flinch.

SHENG CANGLANG
(laughing through tears, voice breaking)
You said your life belonged to me. So now return it!

SHENG CANGLANG thrusts the sword forward. It pierces his side—not a killing blow, but deep enough. Blood spatters onto the snow, stark red against white.

SHENG CANGLANG grips the sword, her face showing a complex expression of shock, pain, and a dawning horror at what she's done.

PEI ZHAO's expression finally cracks—revealing not anger, but something like relief, or perhaps grief.

title: Unexpected Pregnancy
description: A woman discovers she's pregnant with twins after breaking off her engagement with an unfaithful fiancé, only to realize the father is a mysterious stranger from a drunken night.
context:
Title: Unexpected Pregnancy
Description: A woman discovers she's pregnant with twins after breaking off her engagement with an unfaithful fiancé, only to realize the father is a mysterious stranger from a drunken night.

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

A sterile room with medical charts on the walls. LIN XI sits opposite DOCTOR RUAN MIAN, who studies a report. Voices of COLLEAGUES fade beyond the closed door. 

RUAN MIAN
Your bloodwork looks fine, but the ultrasound—

CHEN JIAOJIAO (O.S.)
Must be nice getting special treatment.

Through the window, CHEN JIAOJIAO smirks at Lin Xi before turning to the other COLLEAGUES.

CHEN JIAOJIAO (O.S.)
Bet she's getting a "private consultation" for something embarrassing.

LIN XI
(quietly)
Ignore her. She's still bitter about the promotion.

RUAN MIAN closes the blinds. She delivers the news with practiced gentleness.

RUAN MIAN
Lin Xi, I need to ask—when was your last period?

LIN XI
(thrown)
I-I don't know. With the wedding stress, I've been irregular...

RUAN MIAN
You're six weeks pregnant. The ultrasound shows two sacs. Twins.

She slides the report across the desk. Lin Xi stares at the blurry images, her hand trembling.

LIN XI
That's... impossible. The fertility specialist said—

RUAN MIAN
The specialist was wrong. Or your body changed. It happens more than you'd think.

RUAN MIAN leans forward, voice lowered.

RUAN MIAN
I know you called off the engagement with Jiang Ze. Does he...?

Lin Xi meets her gaze, a bitter laugh escaping.

LIN XI
He couldn't keep it in his pants for one night. I don't think he's been faithful for a year.

RUAN MIAN
Then you'll want a full panel. For your health, and the babies'.

LIN XI touches her stomach, the reality beginning to sink in.

LIN XI
Mianmian, whose are they?

FADE TO:

INT. LIN XI'S HOME - DAY

Six weeks earlier.

Red banners hang for the engagement celebration: "Double Happiness" cuts through the air like a lie. LIN XI adjusts her qipao as JIANG ZE sings off-key in the shower.

His phone BUZZES on the dresser. Lin Xi glances at it—then again, as another message pops up.

ON SCREEN: A string of heart emojis. "Can't wait for tonight, baby. Same hotel?"

Her fingers move before she can think. She opens the messaging app. Voice notes fill the screen—dates going back months. She presses one.

VOICE (FEMALE, O.S.)
Your usual girl's free if you want the discount. Full night, six hundred.

JIANG ZE emerges, towel around his waist. He freezes.

JIANG ZE
What the hell are you doing?

LIN XI
(quietly)
Who is she?

JIANG ZE snatches the phone.

JIANG ZE
You have no right to snoop! Maybe if you weren't such a prude—always 'waiting for marriage'—I wouldn't have to—

LIN XI
(standing)
Don't you dare twist this.

JIANG ZE
The fertility report said you're broken, and I still wanted you! I paid two hundred thousand for damaged goods! You should be—

He stops at her expression. She picks up the red envelope from the dresser.

LIN XI
This was never a marriage. It was a transaction.

She drops the envelope and walks out. At the door, her mother LI LAN, brother LIN JIAHAO, and Jiang Ze's friend form a wall.

LI LAN
The banquet starts in twenty minutes. Where are you—?

LIN XI
It's over.

LI LAN
The deposit's paid. The gifts are displayed. You—

LIN XI
He hired prostitutes. Throughout our engagement.

A gasp goes up. Jiang Ze's friend steps forward.

JIANG ZE'S FRIEND
Keep your voice down! The guests—

LI LAN's hand flashes, striking Lin Xi's cheek.

LI LAN
Lower your head. Apologize.

LIN XI
For what? His cheating or your complicity?

LI LAN
Two hundred thousand! Your brother's house depends on this!

LIN JIAHAO
Mom's right. Just... look the other way. Please.

Lin Xi scans their faces—desperation, greed, resignation. None see her.

LIN XI
(to herself)
I've been looking the other way my whole life.

She pushes through them, the red dress disappearing down the stairs.

DISSOLVE TO:
continuation:
INT. BAR - NIGHT

Four hours later.

LIN XI slumps at the counter, red dress glaring under neon lights. She stares at her banking app. Her salary: 8,500 RMB. She watches the number until it blurs.

BARTENDER
Another?

LIN XI
(nods)
Let it bleed.

She drains her glass as a man settles two seats away—FU CHIYE, sharp suit, tired eyes. He orders whiskey, neat. Lin Xi catches his reflection in the mirror behind the bar. Something familiar.

FU CHIYE
(V.O.)
The red dress from the lobby this morning. She looked... cornered.

Lin Xi's phone rings. "Mom." She silences it. Then "Jiang Ze." She blocks him. The alcohol is warm in her veins, burning away the numbness.

LIN XI
(to herself)
Eight years of salaries. Handed over. For what?

She stands too fast, stumbles. Fu Chiye's hand catches her elbow—steady, impersonal.

FU CHIYE
Careful.

Their eyes meet. His hold lingers a second too long. Not predatory. Just... present.

LIN XI
(slow smile)
How much for one night?

FU CHIYE
(quietly)
I don't pay for company.

LIN XI
Lucky you. Tonight, I do.

She leans in, her breath warm against his cheek.

LIN XI
Take me somewhere I can't think.

He studies her—the desperation masked as bravado, the tremor in her fingers. Then he nods.

They walk out together. As they step into the rain-lit street, he pulls her close, his thumb brushing away a tear she didn't know she'd cried.

FADE TO:

INT. HOSPITAL PARKING LOT - DAY

BACK TO PRESENT.

Lin Xi sits in her car, the ultrasound in her lap. She traces the two white smudges. Her phone buzzes—unknown number. She ignores it. Starts the engine.

Through the windshield, she watches a couple walk into the hospital, his hand on her rounding belly. Her own hand moves to her stomach.

LIN XI
(whisper)
Okay then.

She pulls out of the parking space. The ultrasound slides to the floor as she turns—face-up, visible. She doesn't look back.

FADE OUT.

Description: A woman discovers she's pregnant with twins after breaking off her engagement with an unfaithful fiancé, only to realize the father is a mysterious stranger from a drunken night.

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

A sterile room with medical charts on the walls. LIN XI sits opposite DOCTOR RUAN MIAN, who studies a report. Voices of COLLEAGUES fade beyond the closed door. 

RUAN MIAN
Your bloodwork looks fine, but the ultrasound—

CHEN JIAOJIAO (O.S.)
Must be nice getting special treatment.

Through the window, CHEN JIAOJIAO smirks at Lin Xi before turning to the other COLLEAGUES.

CHEN JIAOJIAO (O.S.)
Bet she's getting a "private consultation" for something embarrassing.

LIN XI
(quietly)
Ignore her. She's still bitter about the promotion.

RUAN MIAN closes the blinds. She delivers the news with practiced gentleness.

RUAN MIAN
Lin Xi, I need to ask—when was your last period?

LIN XI
(thrown)
I-I don't know. With the wedding stress, I've been irregular...

RUAN MIAN
You're six weeks pregnant. The ultrasound shows two sacs. Twins.

She slides the report across the desk. Lin Xi stares at the blurry images, her hand trembling.

LIN XI
That's... impossible. The fertility specialist said—

RUAN MIAN
The specialist was wrong. Or your body changed. It happens more than you'd think.

RUAN MIAN leans forward, voice lowered.

RUAN MIAN
I know you called off the engagement with Jiang Ze. Does he...?

Lin Xi meets her gaze, a bitter laugh escaping.

LIN XI
He couldn't keep it in his pants for one night. I don't think he's been faithful for a year.

RUAN MIAN
Then you'll want a full panel. For your health, and the babies'.

LIN XI touches her stomach, the reality beginning to sink in.

LIN XI
Mianmian, whose are they?

FADE TO:

INT. LIN XI'S HOME - DAY

Six weeks earlier.

Red banners hang for the engagement celebration: "Double Happiness" cuts through the air like a lie. LIN XI adjusts her qipao as JIANG ZE sings off-key in the shower.

His phone BUZZES on the dresser. Lin Xi glances at it—then again, as another message pops up.

ON SCREEN: A string of heart emojis. "Can't wait for tonight, baby. Same hotel?"

Her fingers move before she can think. She opens the messaging app. Voice notes fill the screen—dates going back months. She presses one.

VOICE (FEMALE, O.S.)
Your usual girl's free if you want the discount. Full night, six hundred.

JIANG ZE emerges, towel around his waist. He freezes.

JIANG ZE
What the hell are you doing?

LIN XI
(quietly)
Who is she?

JIANG ZE snatches the phone.

JIANG ZE
You have no right to snoop! Maybe if you weren't such a prude—always 'waiting for marriage'—I wouldn't have to—

LIN XI
(standing)
Don't you dare twist this.

JIANG ZE
The fertility report said you're broken, and I still wanted you! I paid two hundred thousand for damaged goods! You should be—

He stops at her expression. She picks up the red envelope from the dresser.

LIN XI
This was never a marriage. It was a transaction.

She drops the envelope and walks out. At the door, her mother LI LAN, brother LIN JIAHAO, and Jiang Ze's friend form a wall.

LI LAN
The banquet starts in twenty minutes. Where are you—?

LIN XI
It's over.

LI LAN
The deposit's paid. The gifts are displayed. You—

LIN XI
He hired prostitutes. Throughout our engagement.

A gasp goes up. Jiang Ze's friend steps forward.

JIANG ZE'S FRIEND
Keep your voice down! The guests—

LI LAN's hand flashes, striking Lin Xi's cheek.

LI LAN
Lower your head. Apologize.

LIN XI
For what? His cheating or your complicity?

LI LAN
Two hundred thousand! Your brother's house depends on this!

LIN JIAHAO
Mom's right. Just... look the other way. Please.

Lin Xi scans their faces—desperation, greed, resignation. None see her.

LIN XI
(to herself)
I've been looking the other way my whole life.

She pushes through them, the red dress disappearing down the stairs.

DISSOLVE TO:

INT. BAR - NIGHT

Four hours later.

LIN XI slumps at the counter, red dress glaring under neon lights. She stares at her banking app. Her salary: 8,500 RMB. She watches the number until it blurs.

BARTENDER
Another?

LIN XI
(nods)
Let it bleed.

She drains her glass as a man settles two seats away—FU CHIYE, sharp suit, tired eyes. He orders whiskey, neat. Lin Xi catches his reflection in the mirror behind the bar. Something familiar.

FU CHIYE
(V.O.)
The red dress from the lobby this morning. She looked... cornered.

Lin Xi's phone rings. "Mom." She silences it. Then "Jiang Ze." She blocks him. The alcohol is warm in her veins, burning away the numbness.

LIN XI
(to herself)
Eight years of salaries. Handed over. For what?

She stands too fast, stumbles. Fu Chiye's hand catches her elbow—steady, impersonal.

FU CHIYE
Careful.

Their eyes meet. His hold lingers a second too long. Not predatory. Just... present.

LIN XI
(slow smile)
How much for one night?

FU CHIYE
(quietly)
I don't pay for company.

LIN XI
Lucky you. Tonight, I do.

She leans in, her breath warm against his cheek.

LIN XI
Take me somewhere I can't think.

He studies her—the desperation masked as bravado, the tremor in her fingers. Then he nods.

They walk out together. As they step into the rain-lit street, he pulls her close, his thumb brushing away a tear she didn't know she'd cried.

FADE TO:

INT. HOSPITAL PARKING LOT - DAY

BACK TO PRESENT.

Lin Xi sits in her car, the ultrasound in her lap. She traces the two white smudges. Her phone buzzes—unknown number. She ignores it. Starts the engine.

Through the windshield, she watches a couple walk into the hospital, his hand on her rounding belly. Her own hand moves to her stomach.

LIN XI
(whisper)
Okay then.

She pulls out of the parking space. The ultrasound slides to the floor as she turns—face-up, visible. She doesn't look back.

FADE OUT.

title: Path of Survival in the Ice Prison
description: A man is betrayed by his business partner and left to die in a freezing refrigerated truck with only 60 hours to survive.
context:
Title: Path of Survival in the Ice Prison

Description: A man is betrayed by his business partner and left to die in a freezing refrigerated truck with only 60 hours to survive.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Have you ever felt death breathe on your neck?

INT. REFRIGERATED TRUCK - NIGHT

Dark, freezing cold. XIAO YICHEN (30s) lies on the metal grate floor, frost crystallizing on his eyelashes. Blood seeps from his abdomen, freezing at the edges.

On the floor: an open music box playing a distorted lullaby, a diamond ring, a "Share Transfer Agreement" with Wang Yang's name on it, and a handwritten note.

A surveillance camera in the corner FLASHES red.

A red electronic timer displays: 60:00:00. It begins counting down.

ONE DAY AGO

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE VENUE - NIGHT

XIAO YICHEN stands before a pristine white refrigerated truck, beaming with pride.

XIAO YICHEN
--and with our patented steel alloy, the cargo hold reaches optimal temperature in under an hour. Tomorrow, I'll personally demonstrate its safety systems from inside.

EXT. OUTDOOR PARTY - NIGHT

Post-rehearsal celebration. WANG YANG (30s) obsessively scores a steak with surgical precision, his cutlery CLINKING like ice cracking.

LIU NINGNING and LIN YUE watch Xiao's presentation from the crowd.

XIAO YICHEN joins them, slipping his arm around Liu Ningning.

LIU NINGNING
You sure about tomorrow's stunt? It's reckless.

XIAO YICHEN
It's symbolic. I'm betting everything on this company. On us.

He subtly pats his jacket pocket where the ring box bulges.

LIN YUE
Rescue team just got called. Minor emergency. I'll check in later.

LIU NINGNING
I'll ride with you. Save us parking tomorrow.

She kisses Xiao's cheek.

LIU NINGNING
(to Wang Yang, calling out)
Don't let him drink too much!

WANG YANG waves without looking up from his bloody plate.
continuation:
EXT. OUTDOOR PARTY - LATER

Xiao stands alone near the truck, moonlight glinting off its surface. He opens the music box--a tiny ballerina spins. He smiles.

WANG YANG's shadow falls across him. A blade GLINTS.

XIAO YICHEN
(turning)
Yangzi? Thought you left--

WANG YANG drives the knife into Xiao's abdomen. No hesitation.

XIAO YICHEN
(gasping)
Why?

WANG YANG
(quiet, controlled)
You made me your co-pilot. But your name's on the patent. On the building. On everything.

XIAO YICHEN
The agreement... in the truck... full partnership...

WANG YANG
I signed it. With your blood.

He drags Xiao toward the truck's open doors.

WANG YANG (CONT'D)
Enjoy the demonstration. I'll be watching.

He shoves Xiao inside. The doors SLAM.

INT. REFRIGERATED TRUCK - NIGHT

Xiao wakes. The timer reads 58:47:12.

He spots the agreement--Wang Yang's signature drips red. The note reads: "You have 60 hours. Then the crusher. Ningning will never know."

Xiao's breath crystallizes. He crawls toward the door, leaving a crimson trail. He pounds weakly.

XIAO YICHEN
(whispered)
System override... emergency code...

He fumbles at a wall panel, fingers too numb. He collapses, eyes fixed on the surveillance camera.

XIAO YICHEN (V.O.)
He thinks I'll freeze. He doesn't know I installed a fail-safe.

Xiao forces his frozen hand into his blood-soaked pocket. retrieves his phone. Shattered.

He spots the music box. The ballerina's base--a USB key.

INT. CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT

WANG YANG watches multiple screens. Xiao's feed shows him motionless.

WANG YANG
(into phone)
It's done. Pick up the truck in three days.

INTERCUT with:

INT. REFRIGERATED TRUCK - NIGHT

Xiao pries the surveillance camera housing open. Inside: a manual override port.

He plugs the USB key in. The screen flickers. His own face appears--a pre-recorded message.

SCREEN XIAO YICHEN
If you're seeing this, the emergency protocol activated. Voice authorization required.

Xiao leans close to the camera, steam from his breath fogging the lens.

XIAO YICHEN
(strained)
Xiao Yichen. Authorization: Protect Ningning.

The screen flashes green. The timer accelerates--57:00:00 becomes 00:05:00.

Alarms BLARE. The temperature DROPS further. But the rear doors CLICK--unlocked.

Xiao crawls toward them as frostbite blackens his fingers.

EXT. REFRIGERATED TRUCK - NIGHT

The doors burst open. Xiao falls out, gasping. He's in a desolate warehouse district.

His phone--now functional from the system reboot--BUZZES. Five missed calls from LIN YUE.

VOICEMAIL (LIN YUE)
Xiao! Wang Yang's been embezzling. I traced the truck's GPS. I'm two minutes out.

Headlights SCREECH around the corner. A rescue van. Lin Yue at the wheel.

INT. REFRIGERATED TRUCK - NIGHT

Wang Yang, still in the control room, watches the empty truck. The doors swing in the wind.

The timer hits zero. The truck's refrigeration system DIES. Instead of crushing, it shuts down permanently.

A final message appears on his screen: "Fail-safe activated. All evidence uploaded to cloud. Recipient: Liu Ningning."

EXT. WAREHOUSE DISTRICT - NIGHT

Xiao lies in Lin Yue's arms as she wraps him in thermal blankets.

XIAO YICHEN
(whispering)
He wanted everything... but he never understood what I was building.

The music box lies open in the dirt. The ballerina still spins.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Sometimes surviving means letting the cold take everything else.

FADE OUT.

title: Mr. Leng, Your Bodyguard is So Arrogant
description: A woman wakes up after being drugged by her sister, only to discover she's with the wrong man—a disciplined bodyguard who was in the wrong place at the wrong time.
context:
Title: Mr. Leng, Your Bodyguard is So Arrogant
Description: A woman wakes up after being drugged by her sister, only to discover she's with the wrong man—a disciplined bodyguard who was in the wrong place at the wrong time.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAWN

A man and QIU TIAN lie on a rumpled hotel bed. Men's and women's clothing are scattered across the floor. The room is dim, tinted gray by early morning light.

QIU TIAN slowly wakes, her expression pained. She sits up, adjusts her straps, and stares at the stranger beside her.

QIU TIAN (V.O.)
What happened last night?

FLASHBACK:

INT. HOTEL BAR - NIGHT

QIU TIAN stumbles away from the bar, clearly disoriented. LENG JUNSHAN, mid-thirties, muscular build, catches her in a dark suit with a security earpiece visible.

LENG JUNSHAN
(leaning close)
You're in no state to be alone. Let me get you to a room.

She clutches his arm, pupils dilated, as he guides her toward the elevator.

END FLASHBACK.

QIU TIAN (V.O.)
Where did this man come from?

Her phone on the nightstand BUZZES. Caller ID shows "YE ZI."
continuation:
INT. QIU TIAN'S APARTMENT - DAY

Sunlight streams through the blinds. QIU TIAN, now wearing a sports tank top, answers the phone with trembling hands.

QIU YE (O.S.)
Sis, thank God! You have to help me—

QIU TIAN
What kind of trouble did you get me into this time?

INT. PRIVATE CLUB - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

QIU YE, in a sequined dress, sits on a velvet sofa. Across from her are GAO DAMING and his SUBORDINATES.

QIU YE
Brother Daming, my sister will pay off my debt. She always cleans up my messes.

GAO DAMING
(leaning forward)
I don't want money anymore. I want her.

GAO DAMING'S SUBORDINATE
Boss has a permanent suite at the Hilton. Top floor's cleared for a VIP client tonight. Very private.

GAO DAMING
(sliding a vial across the table)
GHB. She won't remember. Makes things... smoother.

QIU YE (V.O.)
Better her than me.

QIU YE
(to GAO DAMING)
She's more cooperative when she's had a few drinks.

She tips the liquid into a beer glass.

EXT. HILTON HOTEL - NIGHT

A black SUV pulls up. LENG JUNSHAN, wearing sunglasses and a sharp suit, steps out. A row of HOSTESSES in qipao dresses wait at the entrance.

HOTEL MANAGER
(bowing)
Mr. Leng, perfect timing. The Zhou family's security sweep is complete.

LENG JUNSHAN
My client arrives in three hours. I need the perimeter checked again.

LENG JUNSHAN walks expressionlessly toward the entrance, his movements precise, professional, and radiating quiet authority.

FADE OUT.

title: The Abandoned Concubine's Promotion Chronicle
description: A modern screenwriter is transported into her best friend's script as a disgraced concubine in the Cold Palace, forced to navigate palace intrigue to survive and return home.
context:
Title: The Abandoned Concubine's Promotion Chronicle
Description: A modern screenwriter is transported into her best friend's script as a disgraced concubine in the Cold Palace, forced to navigate palace intrigue to survive and return home.

INT. COLD PALACE - NIGHT

Thunder rumbles, lightning flashes.

LU YUNXI, dressed in white robes, hangs from a ceiling beam by a white silk rope, her hands clutching the silk as she struggles in pain.

LU YUNXI (V.O.)
What the hell is going on? Wasn't I just reading a script at home? How did I end up in this godforsaken place hanging myself? I can't take it anymore! Somebody get me a rewrite!

The maid LÜ YA rushes into the room. Seeing LU YUNXI hanging, she is so frightened she falls to her knees.

LÜ YA
(crying out)
Miss! Miss! Your family still needs you! Please!

LU YUNXI (V.O.)
I'm not dead yet. I can still be saved.

LÜ YA gets up and struggles to bring LU YUNXI down.

LÜ YA
Easy, Miss.

LU YUNXI is lowered down. She kneels on the ground, coughing violently.

INT. COLD PALACE - DAY

LU YUNXI has changed into light blue robes and sits on the edge of the bed. LÜ YA kneels before her.

LU YUNXI
You're saying I'm Concubine Xi, and I was sent to the Cold Palace for trying to seduce the Emperor?

LÜ YA
Yes, Miss.

LU YUNXI
(puzzled)
Why does this plot sound so familiar?

INT. MODERN APARTMENT - DAY

FLASHBACK:

LU YUNXI sits at a desk, looking at a script on her laptop.

LU YUNXI
(to herself)
Concubine Xi is sent to the Cold Palace for trying to seduce the Emperor.

Her best friend NING RUOCHU, wearing a red top and glasses, walks in dramatically.

NING RUOCHU
Xixi, this is my birthday present to you—a blockbuster script! Aren't you touched? As long as you play the female lead, I guarantee you'll be on fire! Then you can treat me to the good life!

NING RUOCHU gestures excitedly.

LU YUNXI
(annoyed)
Ning Ruochu! Do you even know how to write a script?

NING RUOCHU
Hey, don't mention it. After all, we're basically soulmates with different DNA.

LU YUNXI
(pushing her away)
Get lost! Look at what you've written! The female lead transmigrates into a book, gets sent to the Cold Palace, and has to win over the dog Emperor to become Empress before she can return to the modern world. Your brain must have been caught in a door!

NING RUOCHU
(leaning in)
Wait, the exciting part comes later. Soon, Noble Consort Ning will burst in and slap you!

LU YUNXI picks up a water kettle and accidentally spills water on the laptop. The computer immediately sparks with electricity.

LU YUNXI
Ning Ruochu, how dare you write me this kind of script!

NING RUOCHU
It's pretty good!

LU YUNXI is struck by the electric current, her body convulsing.

NING RUOCHU
(panicking)
Xixi, what's wrong? Xixi, what's happening?

A bright light flashes and LU YUNXI disappears.

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
INT. COLD PALACE - DAY

LU YUNXI snaps back to reality, her face full of shock.

LÜ YA
Miss? Miss? Are you... somewhere else again? Well, the Cold Palace is just a worse place to live. At least you've never even seen the Emperor's face.

LU YUNXI
(suddenly realizing)
I remember now! Isn't this the script my idiot best friend wrote? I've transmigrated into the script? Wait, doesn't that mean in a moment, Noble Consort Ning will come in and—smack—slap me?

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Noble Consort Ning has arrived!

NOBLE CONSORT NING YUYAN enters with her maid YINGXIA and a group of attendants.

NING YUYAN
(contemptuously)
Little darling. Slut. Still clinging to fantasies, I see.

NING YUYAN walks up to LU YUNXI and raises her hand to slap her.

LU YUNXI
(head snaps to the side)
Wait, that's assault!

NING YUYAN
Little darling. Slut. Who gave you the nerve to seduce the Emperor?

LU YUNXI (V.O.)
It's real. All of it. Every trope.

LU YUNXI
(collapsing, shouting to the heavens)
Oh my God! Are you really going this far?

YINGXIA
(sternly)
Insolent! Kneel before our Noble Consort!

NING YUYAN
No manners.

NING YUYAN raises her hand to strike again, but LU YUNXI catches her wrist, twisting it with a pressure-point hold.

NING YUYAN
(shocked, pained)
How dare you, Concubine Xi! Release this consort at once!

YINGXIA
(supporting NING YUYAN)
My Lady! My Lady, are you alright?

NING YUYAN
(furious)
A discarded concubine attacks me? Guards! Break every bone in her body!

LU YUNXI's eyes widen in terror.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

Title: The Abandoned Concubine's Promotion Chronicle
Description: A modern screenwriter is transported into her best friend's script as a disgraced concubine in the Cold Palace, forced to navigate palace intrigue to survive and return home.

INT. COLD PALACE - NIGHT

Thunder rumbles, lightning flashes.

LU YUNXI, dressed in white robes, hangs from a ceiling beam by a white silk rope, her hands clutching the silk as she struggles in pain.

LU YUNXI (V.O.)
What the hell is going on? Wasn't I just reading a script at home? How did I end up in this godforsaken place hanging myself? I can't take it anymore! Somebody get me a rewrite!

The maid LÜ YA rushes into the room. Seeing LU YUNXI hanging, she is so frightened she falls to her knees.

LÜ YA
(crying out)
Miss! Miss! Your family still needs you! Please!

LU YUNXI (V.O.)
I'm not dead yet. I can still be saved.

LÜ YA gets up and struggles to bring LU YUNXI down.

LÜ YA
Easy, Miss.

LU YUNXI is lowered down. She kneels on the ground, coughing violently.

INT. COLD PALACE - DAY

LU YUNXI has changed into light blue robes and sits on the edge of the bed. LÜ YA kneels before her.

LU YUNXI
You're saying I'm Concubine Xi, and I was sent to the Cold Palace for trying to seduce the Emperor?

LÜ YA
Yes, Miss.

LU YUNXI
(puzzled)
Why does this plot sound so familiar?

INT. MODERN APARTMENT - DAY

FLASHBACK:

LU YUNXI sits at a desk, looking at a script on her laptop.

LU YUNXI
(to herself)
Concubine Xi is sent to the Cold Palace for trying to seduce the Emperor.

Her best friend NING RUOCHU, wearing a red top and glasses, walks in dramatically.

NING RUOCHU
Xixi, this is my birthday present to you—a blockbuster script! Aren't you touched? As long as you play the female lead, I guarantee you'll be on fire! Then you can treat me to the good life!

NING RUOCHU gestures excitedly.

LU YUNXI
(annoyed)
Ning Ruochu! Do you even know how to write a script?

NING RUOCHU
Hey, don't mention it. After all, we're basically soulmates with different DNA.

LU YUNXI
(pushing her away)
Get lost! Look at what you've written! The female lead transmigrates into a book, gets sent to the Cold Palace, and has to win over the dog Emperor to become Empress before she can return to the modern world. Your brain must have been caught in a door!

NING RUOCHU
(leaning in)
Wait, the exciting part comes later. Soon, Noble Consort Ning will burst in and slap you!

LU YUNXI picks up a water kettle and accidentally spills water on the laptop. The computer immediately sparks with electricity.

LU YUNXI
Ning Ruochu, how dare you write me this kind of script!

NING RUOCHU
It's pretty good!

LU YUNXI is struck by the electric current, her body convulsing.

NING RUOCHU
(panicking)
Xixi, what's wrong? Xixi, what's happening?

A bright light flashes and LU YUNXI disappears.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. COLD PALACE - DAY

LU YUNXI snaps back to reality, her face full of shock.

LÜ YA
Miss? Miss? Are you... somewhere else again? Well, the Cold Palace is just a worse place to live. At least you've never even seen the Emperor's face.

LU YUNXI
(suddenly realizing)
I remember now! Isn't this the script my idiot best friend wrote? I've transmigrated into the script? Wait, doesn't that mean in a moment, Noble Consort Ning will come in and—smack—slap me?

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Noble Consort Ning has arrived!

NOBLE CONSORT NING YUYAN enters with her maid YINGXIA and a group of attendants.

NING YUYAN
(contemptuously)
Little darling. Slut. Still clinging to fantasies, I see.

NING YUYAN walks up to LU YUNXI and raises her hand to slap her.

LU YUNXI
(head snaps to the side)
Wait, that's assault!

NING YUYAN
Little darling. Slut. Who gave you the nerve to seduce the Emperor?

LU YUNXI (V.O.)
It's real. All of it. Every trope.

LU YUNXI
(collapsing, shouting to the heavens)
Oh my God! Are you really going this far?

YINGXIA
(sternly)
Insolent! Kneel before our Noble Consort!

NING YUYAN
No manners.

NING YUYAN raises her hand to strike again, but LU YUNXI catches her wrist, twisting it with a pressure-point hold.

NING YUYAN
(shocked, pained)
How dare you, Concubine Xi! Release this consort at once!

YINGXIA
(supporting NING YUYAN)
My Lady! My Lady, are you alright?

NING YUYAN
(furious)
A discarded concubine attacks me? Guards! Break every bone in her body!

LU YUNXI's eyes widen in terror.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Fill in the Blank
description: A young widow discovers her late husband's hidden legacy when his estranged mother appears at the funeral, offering protection from a family that sees her as an asset.
context:
Title: Fill in the Blank
Description: A young widow discovers her late husband's hidden legacy when his estranged mother appears at the funeral, offering protection from a family that sees her as an asset.

INT. MOURNING HALL COURTYARD - DAY

HE YUJIA stands in white mourning clothes, her composure fragile. Her BROTHER blocks her path, voice low and urgent.

HE YUJIA'S BROTHER
Sign the papers. The Zhang family's offer expires tonight.

A black sedan glides into the alley, stopping silently. BODYGUARDS emerge and form a perimeter—not aggressive, simply present.

A woman in black (SONG MINGXI'S MOTHER), quiet but commanding, steps out. She carries a wooden box.

HE YUJIA'S BROTHER
Who—

She walks past him straight to Yujia, noticing the hand resting on her stomach.

SONG MINGXI'S MOTHER
You must be Yujia. I'm Mingxi's mother.

HE YUJIA
(stiffening)
The one he never spoke of.

A flicker of grief crosses the older woman's face.

SONG MINGXI'S MOTHER
The one he left to protect his choices. May I?

She opens the box: photos of Mingxi at construction sites, laughing. A key.

SONG MINGXI'S MOTHER
He sent these. I came to meet my grandchild's mother.

HE YUJIA'S BROTHER
(mocking)
Construction workers don't have money. She just wants a caretaker.

HE YUJIA
(quietly fierce)
My husband wanted this child. That makes his family mine.

She turns, offering her arm.
continuation:
HE YUJIA
Let's go... Mom.

The word catches in her throat.

HE YUJIA'S BROTHER lunges for her wrist. A BODYGUARD intercepts, holding him firmly.

HE YUJIA'S MOTHER
(from the doorway)
He's family!

HE YUJIA'S BROTHER
Let me go!

SONG MINGXI'S MOTHER
(ice)
You threatened my daughter-in-law. Break his hand.

A BODYGUARD twists. Bone cracks. The brother screams.

She walks out with Yujia. No one follows.

EXT. COURTYARD ENTRANCE - DAY

HE YUJIA
Auntie... I know he missed you.

SONG MINGXI'S MOTHER
(lovingly)
Don't honor him by calling me Auntie. Call me Mom.

HE YUJIA
(tears in her eyes)
Mom.

SONG MINGXI'S MOTHER
(gratified, squeezing her hand)
Good child. Let's go home.

The two leave together.

EXT. MANSION ENTRANCE - DAY

A luxury car stops at the entrance of a magnificent estate. BODYGUARDS stand in formation.

The car door opens, and HE YUJIA steps out in simple clothes, the wooden box still clutched to her chest. She looks at the estate before her, then down at her belly—resolute.

title: Mortal Celestial Bone
description: On a stormy night, the Zhuo family is attacked by masked assassins seeking the Celestial Bone heir. Young Zhuo Bufan witnesses his parents' deaths and is sealed away by his mother to protect him, only to emerge as a beggar child until rescued by a kind girl.
context:
Title: Mortal Celestial Bone
Description: On a stormy night, the Zhuo family is attacked by masked assassins seeking the Celestial Bone heir. Young Zhuo Bufan witnesses his parents' deaths and is sealed away by his mother to protect him, only to emerge as a beggar child until rescued by a kind girl.

EXT. ZHUO FAMILY COMPOUND - NIGHT

Rain pours down. The Zhuo family compound is in chaos. ZHUO QINGYUN fights fiercely against several MASKED MEN wearing red masks and red robes. Zhuo Qingyun is skilled, but outnumbered. He staggers back with a mortal wound.

INT. ZHUO FAMILY HALL - NIGHT

ZHUO QINGYUN stumbles into the hall, bleeding heavily. TUFEI YUAN TAILANG appears, surrounded by MASKED MEN.

TUFEI YUAN TAILANG
Capture the Celestial Bone heir alive. As for the rest, kill them all on the spot.

ZHUO QINGYUN
(weakly)
The Zhuo line... will not end...

TUFEI YUAN TAILANG
(contemptuously)
The heir is the last vessel of Great Xia's martial lineage. Where is he?

ZHUO QINGYUN
You'll never... find him...

TUFEI YUAN TAILANG
Then we tear this place apart. Search!

The MASKED MEN rush forward. In the corner, young ZHUO BUFAN and another LITTLE GIRL hide in terror.
continuation:
INT. ZHUO FAMILY ROOM - NIGHT

LIANG JINGROU holds young ZHUO BUFAN, her expression grave and urgent.

LIANG JINGROU
Fan'er, this lock will seal your memories and power. When you're strong enough, it will break. Remember: to become a great tree, do not compete with grass. A general has a sword, but does not cut straw ropes.

ZHUO BUFAN
(crying)
No, Mother! I want to avenge Father!

LIANG JINGROU
Fan'er, until this lock breaks, the road ahead is danger. Mother only wishes for your survival. Forget everything that happened tonight.

ZHUO BUFAN
(crying)
Mother, I'll remember. I will definitely forget.

LIANG JINGROU hides ZHUO BUFAN in a cabinet, tears in her eyes.

INT. ZHUO FAMILY HALL - NIGHT

TUFEI YUAN TAILANG
The Celestial Bone heir. Whoever captures him first gets a thousand taels of gold.

A MASKED MAN discovers LIANG JINGROU.

MASKED MAN
She's a bit old, but I'm not picky. Hand over the Celestial Bone heir. Serve us brothers well, and we'll spare your life.

LIANG JINGROU
(furiously)
Shameless scoundrel, die!

LIANG JINGROU fights the MASKED MEN with twin blades but is quickly stabbed and falls dead. ZHUO BUFAN in the cabinet witnesses everything, covering his mouth in horror.

MASKED MAN
Let's go. That little brat isn't here.

The MASKED MEN leave. The hall falls silent. ZHUO BUFAN crawls out of the cabinet, looks at his mother's body, cries silently, and clutches the longevity lock on his chest.

EXT. STREET - DAY

ON SCREEN: One month later.

ZHUO BUFAN has become a ragged, disheveled beggar child, his memories locked away. A group of CHILDREN surround him, throwing things at him and bullying him.

ZHUO BUFAN picks up a meat bone from the ground and devours it hungrily. The CHILDREN laugh and mock him.

ZHUO BUFAN
(muttering)
Meat bone... my meat bone...

CHILDREN
(singing)
Foggy morning, August first, the stinking fool is cursed! When the chief points to the bay, the beggar rushes all the way, broken shoes and socks in disarray!

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

XIA MENGYING, a delicate LITTLE GIRL in a white princess dress, walks by with an umbrella, accompanied by MAMA LIU. She sees ZHUO BUFAN being bullied.

XIA MENGYING walks up to ZHUO BUFAN and extends her hand.

XIA MENGYING
Little fool, will you come home with me? All the meat bones you can eat.

ZHUO BUFAN looks up, sees XIA MENGYING's kind face, and breaks into a bright smile.

title: Phoenix Mountain Journey - Phoenix Cry, Lone Moon, Stars Fill the Sky
description: A centuries-old revenge unfolds as a cat spirit seeks vengeance against the descendants of an ancient empress who executed her former master.
context:
Title: Phoenix Mountain Journey - Phoenix Cry, Lone Moon, Stars Fill the Sky
Description: A centuries-old revenge unfolds as a cat spirit seeks vengeance against the descendants of an ancient empress who executed her former master.

EXT. MOUNTAIN PEAK - NIGHT

Mist swirls around jagged cliffs. MOONLIGHT slices through ancient cypress trees.

A SUBORDINATE (20s, wiry, face obscured by black cloth) kneels before a hooded figure.

SUBORDINATE
Master, the Third Prince has been found.

The figure lowers her hood. XUAN TIE (eternal 30s, silver-streaked hair, eyes like polished obsidian) stares into the valley below.

EXT. PALACE COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SUPER: "1,400 Years Ago - Phoenix Mountain Palace"

The DEMON EMPRESS (40s, robes of crimson and gold, jade crown) stands on vermilion steps. Below, GUARDS force CONSORT XIAO (30s, once-beautiful, now defiant in blood-stained silks) to her knees.

DEMON EMPRESS
You plotted against your Empress. Why?

CONSORT XIAO
(laughing; voice raw)
Why? Because you taught me—strike first, or be devoured.

The Empress's knuckles whiten on her scepter.

DEMON EMPRESS
Then learn this final lesson.

She raises a hand. The GUARDS' swords flash.

Consort Xiao collapses. Blood blossoms on the stone.

A gray CAT darts from the shadows, mewling. It nuzzles Consort Xiao's hand.

CONSORT XIAO (weakly)
Xuan Tie... avenge me.

She dies. The cat's eyes glow with sudden, unnatural intelligence. It releases a sound between yowl and human sob.

DEMON EMPRESS
Slaughter every cat in Phoenix City. Let none survive.
continuation:
EXT. MOUNTAIN PEAK - NIGHT (PRESENT DAY)

The gray cat watches from a granite outcrop, its gaze fixed on Xuan Tie.

XUAN TIE (V.O.)
Fourteen centuries, Mistress. Your descendants will pay in blood.

She crumples the paper in her fist. It ignites, turning to ash.

INT. LI XIAO AN'S APARTMENT - DAY

LI XIAO AN (25, lean, modern security uniform unbuttoned at the collar) sleeps fitfully on a worn sofa.

His hand twitches. Bronze light flickers at his fingertips.

EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

Li Xiao An, now in white training robes, flows through sword forms. Each movement precise, ethereal.

BLACK-CLOTHED ASSASSINS materialize from the bamboo grove. Ten. Twenty. Their blades hiss as they draw.

Li Xiao An spins, sword flashing. Steel meets steel. SPARKS fly.

He drops three assassins. A FOURTH unleashes a purple energy blast.

The wave strikes Li Xiao An's chest. He crashes through a wooden pillar, coughing blood.

An assassin raises a jade dagger for the killing stroke.

Purple light EXPLODES.

Xuan Tie stands between them, robes billowing. She flicks a finger. The assassins fly backward, slamming into stone walls.

She turns. Her eyes meet Li Xiao An's—confused, wounded.

XUAN TIE
(whisper)
The bloodline remains... unbroken.

Li Xiao An reaches for his sword. She steps on the blade.

XUAN TIE
But you are not ready to die yet, Third Prince.

She vanishes in a swirl of mist. The gray cat reappears on a nearby wall, watching.

Li Xiao An clutches his chest, where bruises form in the shape of cat's claws.
