title: Phoenix Returns to Nest
description: A fisherman's daughter is taken away after helping rescue a drowning CEO, separating her from her mother on her birthday.
context:
Title: Phoenix Returns to Nest
Description: A fisherman's daughter is taken away after helping rescue a drowning CEO, separating her from her mother on her birthday.

INT. BEACH - DUSK

The sun sets across the beach. Small waves whisper against the shore.

Little girl ZHAO XIAOXI crouches in the wet sand, stacking smooth stones into a careful tower.

The distant THUMP of a helicopter rotor cuts through the quiet.

Her mother, fisherwoman XU XIU, rows her small boat to shore.

XU XIU
Xiaoxi!

Xiaoxi looks up and stands, smiling.

ZHAO XIAOXI
Mom!

She runs toward the water.

Xu Xiu gets off the boat, holding a string of freshly caught fish.

XU XIU
Good haul today.

ZHAO XIAOXI
Mom, you and Dad are so busy. Today is my birthday. Can you spend more time with me?

XU XIU
(softening)
Last catch of the season pays for your art classes. Then I'm yours all night. Deal?

ZHAO XIAOXI
(excited)
Deal!

XU XIU
Let's go home.

They clasp hands, walking up the beach.

The helicopter ENGINE SCREECHES overhead. A SHADOW passes.

Then—an EXPLOSION. The helicopter CRASHES into the sea, sending up a massive water plume.

Fishermen freeze.

On the churning water, a man, GU PEISHENG, struggles, gasping.

GU PEISHENG
Help... help...

Xu Xiu tenses, releasing Xiaoxi's hand.

ZHAO XIAOXI
(frightened)
Mom!

XU XIU
(firm)
Wait here.

She runs into the water, swimming powerfully.

GU PEISHENG
(sinking)
I can't... hold on...

Xu Xiu reaches him, grabs his collar.

XU XIU
Xiaoxi! The life ring!

Xiaoxi rushes to the boat, unhooks the life ring, throws it toward her mother.

The ring lands near them. Xu Xiu pushes it into Gu Peisheng's hands.

His fingers clasp it—then go limp. He sinks, pulling the ring down.

His hand SLIPS OFF. He disappears.

Xiaoxi sees her mother go under too.

She dives in without hesitation.
continuation:
INT. BEACH - MOMENTS LATER

Several black SUVs speed up and stop on the beach.

A group of BODYGUARDS in tactical gear rush out and into the water.

BODYGUARD A
Principal located! West side!

BODYGUARD B
Juvenile down! Not breathing!

They pull Gu Peisheng's limp body onto a rescue board. Another guard lifts Xiaoxi's small form.

BODYGUARD A
Any sign of her parents?

BODYGUARD B
Negative. She needs a hospital now. Witness protocol.

BODYGUARD A
Load them both!

The bodyguards carry Gu Peisheng and Xiaoxi to the SUVs. The convoy speeds away.

Xu Xiu staggers out of the water thirty yards down the beach, coughing. She sees the commotion, the departing vehicles.

She spots Xiaoxi's purple shirt in a bodyguard's arms.

XU XIU
(shouting)
XIAOXI! THAT'S MY DAUGHTER!

She sprints up the sand toward the road.

The last SUV disappears around the bend.

Xu Xiu runs to the road, stops. She's too late.

She turns, sees the crushed stone tower in the tire tracks.

XU XIU
(whispering)
Xiaoxi...

The screen flashes white and ends.
full_script:
Title: Phoenix Returns to Nest
Description: A fisherman's daughter is taken away after helping rescue a drowning CEO, separating her from her mother on her birthday.

INT. BEACH - DUSK

The sun sets across the beach. Small waves whisper against the shore.

Little girl ZHAO XIAOXI crouches in the wet sand, stacking smooth stones into a careful tower.

The distant THUMP of a helicopter rotor cuts through the quiet.

Her mother, fisherwoman XU XIU, rows her small boat to shore.

XU XIU
Xiaoxi!

Xiaoxi looks up and stands, smiling.

ZHAO XIAOXI
Mom!

She runs toward the water.

Xu Xiu gets off the boat, holding a string of freshly caught fish.

XU XIU
Good haul today.

ZHAO XIAOXI
Mom, you and Dad are so busy. Today is my birthday. Can you spend more time with me?

XU XIU
(softening)
Last catch of the season pays for your art classes. Then I'm yours all night. Deal?

ZHAO XIAOXI
(excited)
Deal!

XU XIU
Let's go home.

They clasp hands, walking up the beach.

The helicopter ENGINE SCREECHES overhead. A SHADOW passes.

Then—an EXPLOSION. The helicopter CRASHES into the sea, sending up a massive water plume.

Fishermen freeze.

On the churning water, a man, GU PEISHENG, struggles, gasping.

GU PEISHENG
Help... help...

Xu Xiu tenses, releasing Xiaoxi's hand.

ZHAO XIAOXI
(frightened)
Mom!

XU XIU
(firm)
Wait here.

She runs into the water, swimming powerfully.

GU PEISHENG
(sinking)
I can't... hold on...

Xu Xiu reaches him, grabs his collar.

XU XIU
Xiaoxi! The life ring!

Xiaoxi rushes to the boat, unhooks the life ring, throws it toward her mother.

The ring lands near them. Xu Xiu pushes it into Gu Peisheng's hands.

His fingers clasp it—then go limp. He sinks, pulling the ring down.

His hand SLIPS OFF. He disappears.

Xiaoxi sees her mother go under too.

She dives in without hesitation.

INT. BEACH - MOMENTS LATER

Several black SUVs speed up and stop on the beach.

A group of BODYGUARDS in tactical gear rush out and into the water.

BODYGUARD A
Principal located! West side!

BODYGUARD B
Juvenile down! Not breathing!

They pull Gu Peisheng's limp body onto a rescue board. Another guard lifts Xiaoxi's small form.

BODYGUARD A
Any sign of her parents?

BODYGUARD B
Negative. She needs a hospital now. Witness protocol.

BODYGUARD A
Load them both!

The bodyguards carry Gu Peisheng and Xiaoxi to the SUVs. The convoy speeds away.

Xu Xiu staggers out of the water thirty yards down the beach, coughing. She sees the commotion, the departing vehicles.

She spots Xiaoxi's purple shirt in a bodyguard's arms.

XU XIU
(shouting)
XIAOXI! THAT'S MY DAUGHTER!

She sprints up the sand toward the road.

The last SUV disappears around the bend.

Xu Xiu runs to the road, stops. She's too late.

She turns, sees the crushed stone tower in the tire tracks.

XU XIU
(whispering)
Xiaoxi...

The screen flashes white and ends.

title: Phoenix Cry in the Palace
description: A concubine is murdered for her unborn child by a scheming imperial consort, but vows revenge as she dies and is mysteriously reborn.
context:
Title: Phoenix Cry in the Palace
Description: A concubine is murdered for her unborn child by a scheming imperial consort, but vows revenge as she dies and is mysteriously reborn.

INT. YIXIU PALACE - NIGHT

Thunder rattles the lattice windows. Palace lanterns sway.

GAO YAOFENG, Imperial Noble Consort, cradles a voodoo doll. A needle glints in her hand. Her smile is measured.

GAO YAOFENG
(softly)
Almost done.

INT. ANNEX CHAMBER - NIGHT

SU YUNROU lies bound to a birthing bed, full-term and struggling.

NANNY LI arranges surgical blades with cold precision.

NANNY LI
Early, but the method is sound. I've done it before.

INT. CORRIDOR - NIGHT

XIAO TAO thrashes between two GUARDS.

XIAO TAO
She's not even due yet—

NANNY LI appears, backhanding Xiao Tao across the mouth. The maid crumples.
continuation:
INT. ANNEX CHAMBER - NIGHT

Su Yunrou's eyes snap to the slamming door.

SU YUNROU
(to Gaoyaofeng)
The Emperor's heir—he'll know!

GAO YAOFENG glides forward, silk robes whispering.

GAO YAOFENG
Know what? That you died in childbirth? Tragic. But common.

GAO YAOFENG
(to Nanny Li)
Bring me the child. If it's a girl—you know what to do.

SU YUNROU
Elder sister, we share blood—

GAO YAOFENG seizes Su Yunrou's jaw, forcing cloth into her mouth.

GAO YAOFENG
Blood? You're father's shame. I brought you here because you reminded me of her. The late Empress. You dared to carry what I could not.

SU YUNROU
(sobbing)
I never wanted—

GAO YAOFENG
You have it. And now I do.

CONSORT SUN enters with a lacquered bowl.

CONSORT SUN
Kindness is just another word for blind here, Su Yunrou.

NANNY LI's blade rises. Falls.

A muffled scream——

A baby's thin cry.

NANNY LI wraps the infant in imperial yellow.

NANNY LI
A prince, Your Ladyship.

GAO YAOFENG takes the child. Su Yunrou reaches weakly.

SU YUNROU
My son...

CONSORT SUN forces the poison down. Su Yunrou convulses, blood on her lips. A final, bitter laugh.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Concubine Su is gone. Prepare the rites.

SU YUNROU (V.O.)
I was clay. You fired me into porcelain. Next life, I will be the hammer.

EXT. PALACE ROOFTOP - NIGHT

Lightning forks. The palace glows white.

INT. GARDEN PAVILION - DAY

SU YUNROU, now thirteen, awakens with a gasp. She touches her flat stomach. Remembers.

SU YUNROU
(voice hardening)
Clay remembers the kiln.

She rises.

title: Rise Above
description: After serving five years in prison for his brother's crime, Chen Fan returns home to confront his past and the family that betrayed him.
context:
Title: Rise Above
Description: After serving five years in prison for his brother's crime, Chen Fan returns home to confront his past and the family that betrayed him.

INT. DIHAO GROUP - DAY

TANG RUOXUE stands at the window, LI YAN behind her with a tablet.

LI YAN
President Tang, the consortium awaits. This deal secures Dihao's future.

TANG RUOXUE
Cancel it.

LI YAN
All of it?

TANG RUOXUE
Grandfather's instructions. Chen Fan's release is today. I'm handling it personally.

LI YAN
(quietly)
The prisoner from the sealed files? The one who—

TANG RUOXUE
Saved his life. Yes.

TANG RUOXUE strides through the executive corridor. LI YAN hurries to keep pace.

TANG RUOXUE (V.O.)
Grandfather sees something in this man. Something the official records don't show. In our world, that's worth more than any contract.

They cross the lobby. BODYGUARDS flank them.

EXT. DIHAO GROUP - DAY

BODYGUARDS open the doors of a black sedan. TANG RUOXUE and LI YAN slide inside. The convoy pulls away.
continuation:
EXT. PRISON - DAY

The iron gate groans open. CHEN FAN emerges, a black backpack over one shoulder. He touches the scar above his eye.

BROADCAST (V.O.)
Prisoner Chen Fan. Sentence complete.

EXT. OUTSIDE CHEN FAMILY COURTYARD - NIGHT

Rain hammers down. CHEN FAN stops before the weathered plaque: "Harmony Brings Prosperity."

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
Five years. I counted every sunset.

His hand clenches the backpack strap.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
You swore you'd be here.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. OUTSIDE CHEN FAMILY COURTYARD - 5 YEARS AGO NIGHT

Young CHEN FAN and LIN YUFEI hang wedding lanterns.

LIN YUFEI
Higher! Mother measures everything.

CHEN FAN
Let her measure. I'll give her daughter the world.

The lanterns sway between them, casting gold light.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. OUTSIDE CHEN FAMILY COURTYARD - NIGHT

CHEN FAN's jaw tightens.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
My brother's hands. My mother's knees. My fiancée's silence. My cage.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. OUTSIDE CHEN FAMILY COURTYARD - 5 YEARS AGO NIGHT

WU GUIYING pulls CHEN DAFA through the gate. Wedding banners flutter.

WU GUIYING
Xiao Fan—help your brother!

CHEN FAN
What happened?

WU GUIYING drops to her knees, clutching his legs.

WU GUIYING
An accident. But he's our name! Our provider!

CHEN DAFA
(slides a bank card onto the step)
Settled with the family. Five years maximum. 500,000 yuan, Little Brother. For your sacrifice.

CHEN FAN
(stumbling back)
My wedding... Yufei...

LIN YUFEI appears in the doorway, holding her wedding dress.

LIN YUFEI
(quietly)
Mother raised the bride price to 300,000. This solves everything, Fan. We can wait.

She covers the bank card with her palm. Stares at the ground.

A long beat. CHEN FAN's hand covers hers.

Wu Guiying's tears turn to triumph.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. OUTSIDE CHEN FAMILY COURTYARD - NIGHT

CHEN FAN turns away. A blinding beam of car headlights cuts through the rain.

title: Debuting as a Diva
description: A songwriter is betrayed by her boyfriend, a singer she helped launch to stardom, and finds herself reborn with a second chance.
context:
Title: Debuting as a Diva
Description: A songwriter is betrayed by her boyfriend, a singer she helped launch to stardom, and finds herself reborn with a second chance.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY STAGE - NIGHT

Dazzling stage lights flicker across a sea of faces.

EMCEE
Let us welcome the Chinese Golden Song Queen, SONG YA!

Thunderous applause. SONG YA, in a crystalline gown that catches every light, crosses to the podium. She touches the trophy, emotion catching in her throat.

SONG YA
(into the microphone)
They say music captures moments. This moment... I wrote it three years ago, in a cramped apartment, not knowing if anyone would ever hear it.

A faint RUMBLE overhead. The spotlight quivers.

SONG YA
(smiling)
Dreams have a way of surprising you.

The spotlight SCREECHES—metal shearing. Song Ya's smile freezes. The audience rises, a collective gasp rippling through the theater.

She looks up. The world slows.

The spotlight detaches. Plummets.
continuation:
INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

SONG YA gasps awake, cheek pressed against cold tile. Scattered sheet music pools around her fingers. A simple blue dress—nothing like the gown.

Her hands fly to her neck, her chest. No wounds. No blood.

She stares at her palms, wrong-sized. The room—wrong-shaped. Memory fragments flicker: a different mirror, a cheaper chair, the smell of stale coffee.

Her gaze lands on the door. Two figures. Familiar. Impossible.

KANG ZHEYUAN leans against the frame, arms crossed. ZHANG YUAN holds a leather folio. Their casual superiority fills the space.

ZHANG YUAN
(consulting documents)
Standard dissolution agreement. All compositions transferred to Mr. Kang's holdings. One-time compensation: one million RMB.

SONG YA's fingers curl into the sheet music, creasing notes she remembers writing—will write? A sharp pain lances through her ribs.

ZHANG YUAN
Please don't make this theatrical. Your little episodes won't change the contract.

KANG ZHEYUAN
(coolly detached)
You should see a doctor, Song Ya. For real this time.

Song Ya's breath hitches—not from pain, but recognition. This pain. This room. This moment. She's lived it before. Died after it.

She pulls herself up slowly, vertebra by vertebra. Her eyes find Kang Zheyuan's reflection in the mirror—avoiding hers.

SONG YA
(softly)
Three years. You recorded my demos on a laptop that froze every five minutes. You said—

KANG ZHEYUAN
People change.
(adjusting his cuff)
Your songs were... adequate. But adequate doesn't fill stadiums.

ZHANG YUAN
Talent's cheap. Distribution isn't. Miss Hong provides what you can't—platform, visibility, capital. You were a placeholder.

HONG MANNI (O.S.)
Such an unflattering word.

HONG MANNI appears in the doorway, wearing pink silk that costs more than the entire room. She doesn't look at Song Ya—only at Kang Zheyuan, possessive and certain.

HONG MANNI
(to Kang Zheyuan)
The car's waiting. Press conference starts in twenty.

She finally glances at Song Ya, her smile polite, final. A door clicking shut.

title: The Unruly Princess
description: A modern woman is shot by her partner and wakes up in ancient times as a general's daughter, only to find herself caught in a deadly conspiracy.
context:
Title: The Unruly Princess
Description: A modern woman is shot by her partner and wakes up in ancient times as a general's daughter, only to find herself caught in a deadly conspiracy.

EXT. LAKESIDE GRASS - DAY

Mist drifts off the water. SU XIAORU, 20s, in soaked ancient robes, lies unconscious on dew-covered grass.

A MAID, 16, kneels beside her, trembling.

MAID
(whispering)
Miss... please wake up. Please...

Su Xiaoru's eyes snap open. She seizes the maid's wrist with a fighter's reflex, then freezes—staring at her unfamiliar silk sleeves.

SU XIAORU
(voice hoarse)
What...?

Her fingers brush an empty dagger sheath at her belt. Her jaw clenches.

SU XIAORU
(gritted teeth)
Xie Zichen. You bastard.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Rain hammers concrete. SU XIAORU, leather jacket and boots, sprints with XIE ZICHEN, 30s.

Tires SCREECH. Three SUVs block the exit. THUGS emerge.

THUG (O.S.)
No way out, Xichen. Hand her over.

Su Xiaoru glances at Xie Zichen. A silent question.

XIE ZICHEN
(low)
I'll cover you. Go left.

She trusts him. Nods.

Su Xiaoru charges left, grabs a baseball bat from an SUV's trunk—crack, crack, two thugs drop. When she turns, Xie Zichen stands alone, gun raised. At her.

XIE ZICHEN
(softly)
They have my sister. I'm sorry.

The BLAST echoes. Su Xiaoru falls, rain mixing with blood. Her eyes stay open, locked on his.

SU XIAORU (V.O.)
(traveling through)
That look... he meant it.
continuation:
EXT. LAKESIDE GRASS - DAY

Su Xiaoru staggers up, touching her chest—no wound. The maid hovers.

MAID
Miss! The Crown Prince's guards are sweeping the grounds. If they hear you—

SU XIAORU
(distant)
Water. I need to get back.

She stumbles toward the lake.

MAID
(desperate)
The Grand Princess sent word! Prime Minister Li's men will be here by sunrise. Your mother—she's arranged passage. But we must move now!

Su Xiaoru stops. Turns.

SU XIAORU
My mother?

MAID
The Grand Princess. She said... if the General's daughter dies, the northern army marches.

A beat. Su Xiaoru's expression shifts—calculation replacing panic.

SU XIAORU
Then I'm the bait. Perfect.

She snatches a sharp rock from the shore.

SU XIAORU
(grim)
Lead the way. If I'm going to die twice today, I'll pick the battlefield.

EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

Torches flicker in pre-dawn mist. The MAID pulls Su Xiaoru through a bamboo grove. Su Xiaoru wheezes, clutching her side.

SU XIAORU (V.O.)
(first time)
This body... never seen a gym.

They reach a moon gate. Silk lanterns glow beyond.

MAID
We're here. The Grand Princess's sanctuary—

INT. GRAND PRINCESS'S MANOR INNER COURTYARD - DAY

The GRAND PRINCESS, regal in her 40s, stands perfectly still. A MAN in court robes holds a white silk sash around her neck—just taut enough to restrain, not kill.

GRAND PRINCESS
(calm, seeing Su Xiaoru)
Run, child. The game was rigged from the start.

The Man yanks the sash. The Grand Princess crumples—elegant, final.

MAID
(scream muffled by horror)

Su Xiaoru doesn't scream. She studies the Man's face, memorizing it. Her grip on the rock tightens.

SU XIAORU
(to the maid, voice steely)
Change of plan. We're not running.

Miss! The Crown Prince's guards are sweeping the grounds. If they hear you—

SU XIAORU
(distant)
Water. I need to get back.

She stumbles toward the lake.

MAID
(desperate)
The Grand Princess sent word! Prime Minister Li's men will be here by sunrise. Your mother—she's arranged passage. But we must move now!

Su Xiaoru stops. Turns.

SU XIAORU
My mother?

MAID
The Grand Princess. She said... if the General's daughter dies, the northern army marches.

A beat. Su Xiaoru's expression shifts—calculation replacing panic.

SU XIAORU
Then I'm the bait. Perfect.

She snatches a sharp rock from the shore.

SU XIAORU
(grim)
Lead the way. If I'm going to die twice today, I'll pick the battlefield.

EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

Torches flicker in pre-dawn mist. The MAID pulls Su Xiaoru through a bamboo grove. Su Xiaoru wheezes, clutching her side.

SU XIAORU (V.O.)
(first time)
This body... never seen a gym.

They reach a moon gate. Silk lanterns glow beyond.

MAID
We're here. The Grand Princess's sanctuary—

INT. GRAND PRINCESS'S MANOR INNER COURTYARD - DAY

The GRAND PRINCESS, regal in her 40s, stands perfectly still. A MAN in court robes holds a white silk sash around her neck—just taut enough to restrain, not kill.

GRAND PRINCESS
(calm, seeing Su Xiaoru)
Run, child. The game was rigged from the start.

The Man yanks the sash. The Grand Princess crumples—elegant, final.

MAID
(scream muffled by horror)

Su Xiaoru doesn't scream. She studies the Man's face, memorizing it. Her grip on the rock tightens.

SU XIAORU
(to the maid, voice steely)
Change of plan. We're not running.

title: Don't Act Cute with Me
description: A college student who silently admired a basketball star gets a second chance when she travels back in time after his tragic death.
context:
Title: Don't Act Cute with Me
Description: A college student who silently admired a basketball star gets a second chance when she travels back in time after his tragic death.

EXT. BASKETBALL COURT - DAY

ZHOU JINGSI, wearing a red jersey, shoots the basketball. It swishes through the net.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
Zhou Jingsi. I spent three years memorizing his schedule just to "accidentally" pass by.

ZHOU JINGSI runs across the court. GIRLS on the sidelines cheer for him.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
They called him the moon. Untouchable. Perfect.

WEN SHU stands on the sidelines, clutching a water bottle she never had the courage to give him.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
I was background noise. One of many.

ZHOU JINGSI high-fives his TEAMMATES, smiling brightly.

A GIRL hands ZHOU JINGSI a bottle of water. He smiles and accepts it.

Wen Shu glances at the unopened water bottle in her hand, then quietly places it back in her bag.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
Two weeks before graduation, I finally decided to talk to him. Then the world collapsed.

EXT. ZHOU GROUP HEADQUARTERS - DAY (FLASHBACK)

FAST CUTS:
- Cranes frozen mid-motion over a half-built skyscraper
- WORKERS protesting with signs: "PAY OUR WAGES"
- Zhou's father being escorted into a police car, head ducked
- Zhou Jingsi pushing through reporters, his face hollow

WEN SHU (V.O.)
I saw him once. At the gate. He looked... smaller.
continuation:
INT. WEN SHU'S DORM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Wen Shu scrolls through her phone. News headlines blur past:
"Zhou Group West City project collapse"
"Bankruptcy filed"
"Former CEO dies in hospital"

Her thumb hovers over a message draft to Zhou Jingsi: "Are you okay?" It remains unsent.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
I typed ten versions of that text. Never sent one.

EXT. UNIVERSITY ROOFTOP - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Police tape. A small crowd. Wen Shu pushes through, her breath visible in the cold air.

PARAMEDICS lift a covered stretcher. A corner of white cloth flutters loose, revealing a red jersey sleeve—the number 23.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
He wore it that day. The jersey I washed for him when he spilled coffee in the library. He didn't even know my name.

Wen Shu's fingers close around something in her pocket: a student ID card, corners worn from handling. Zhou Jingsi's face smiles from the plastic.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
I found it in a book he'd returned. Kept it like a secret.

She looks at the ID, then at the ambulance doors closing.

WEN SHU
(whispering)
Let me go back. Let me go back.

She presses the ID to her lips—a desperate, childish wish.

A flash of white light. The cityscape distorts, folding like a crumpled photograph.

EXT. BASKETBALL COURT - DAY

Wen Shu stumbles, nearly falling. She's back in her old clothes. The water bottle is in her hand again, unopened.

She looks up. ZHOU JINGSI is alive, mid-game, perfect.

QIAO XIN walks past Wen Shu, barely glancing at her.

QIAO XIN
(to a friend)
Some people are just destined to be invisible. Sad, really.

ZHOU JINGSI (O.S.)
Hey.

Qiao Xin turns. Zhou Jingsi is walking toward them, sweat dripping, but his eyes are on Wen Shu.

ZHOU JINGSI
(to Wen Shu, casual)
You're in my lit class, right? The one with the color-coded notes?

Wen Shu stares, the water bottle slipping from her fingers.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
He knows I exist. He knows I exist.

The bottle hits the ground. Zhou Jingsi catches it in one smooth motion, hands it back to her.

ZHOU JINGSI
(small smile)
Don't drop this. Looks important.

He walks back to the court. Wen Shu looks at the bottle, at her hands, at the living, breathing boy.

WEN SHU (V.O.)
I got my second chance. This time, I won't be background noise.

title: Merit Too Great Invites Suspicion, I Turn to Join Mobei
description: A war hero who helped a prince ascend the throne finds himself betrayed and stripped of power due to the emperor's suspicion and the court's jealousy.
context:
Title: Merit Too Great Invites Suspicion, I Turn to Join Mobei
Description: A war hero who helped a prince ascend the throne finds himself betrayed and stripped of power due to the emperor's suspicion and the court's jealousy.

EXT. OUTSIDE CITY GATE - DAY

A war scene. Flames dance across the battlefield. Corpses of both armies litter the scorched earth. The city walls loom in the distance.

SHAO XUJI (30s), in mud-splattered golden prince robes, is cornered against the city gate with his last dozen guards, surrounded by hundreds of rebel soldiers.

SHAO XUJI
(strained, desperate)
Li Zhen... you promised...

The sound of HOOFBEATS. LI ZHEN (late 20s), in ornate armor that bears the marks of countless battles, charges through the rebel flank on a white stallion. His spear moves with supernatural precision—a Fifth Rank warrior's power.

LI ZHEN
(shouting over the chaos)
I gave my word, Your Highness! Your throne awaits!

SHAO XUJI
(voice cracking with hope)
When this is done—when I wear the crown—you'll stand at my side. As we planned!

Li Zhen's spear blazes with blue energy. He cuts through the rebel forces like a scythe through wheat. The battle ends in moments. The remaining rebels flee.

The surviving soldiers of both sides kneel.

SOLDIERS
(in unison)
Long live Emperor Shao! Long live the Savior General!

SHAO XUJI laughs, the sound edged with hysterical relief. Then he notices Li Zhen swaying in his saddle.

SHAO XUJI
(rushing forward)
Li Zhen! Your wounds—

LI ZHEN
(gripping his chest, each word an effort)
The price... of using my core energy... Worth it... for your vow...

SHAO XUJI
(frantically)
I'll build you a temple! Make you Prime Minister! Anything—

Li Zhen topples from his horse. Shao Xuji catches him.

LI ZHEN
(whispering)
Just remember... we were friends... once...

Li Zhen loses consciousness.

SHAO XUJI (V.O.)
Thus Li Zhen became Prime Minister of Great Yu. Below one man, above ten thousand. That was the promise.
continuation:
INT. IMPERIAL PALACE HALL - DAY

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER

SHAO XUJI, now in imperial dragon robes, sits rigidly on the throne. His sister SHAO XUXUE stands to his right, her hand resting on a sword hilt. LI ZHEN, in Prime Minister's red robes, stands center hall. The markings on his armor have faded—he's clearly weakened.

Civil and military officials fill the hall. There's an undercurrent of whispers.

MINISTER ONE
(stepping forward, eyes downcast)
Prime Minister Li's reforms have centralized too much power. The regional lords... they speak of tyranny.

MINISTER TWO
His martial cultivation never returned after the battle. Yet he still commands the loyalty of two-thirds of our armies. The court... we fear what happens if he...

The ministers glance at each other, then at the Emperor's sister.

ALL MINISTERS
(kneeling in unison)
We humbly request Your Majesty reconsider the Prime Minister's... broad authorities. For the stability of the realm.

LI ZHEN (V.O.)
Five years since I transmigrated into this world. Three years since I made him Emperor. I've given everything—my cultivation, my health, my soul. And this is my dividend.

SHAO XUJI
(avoiding Li Zhen's eyes)
The court's concerns... they have merit. You'll retain your title, but... the military seal. Transfer it to the Princess Royal.

LI ZHEN
(quietly)
You're not asking for my seal. You're asking for my head wrapped in silk.

SHAO XUJI
(sharply)
I am your Emperor, Li Zhen. Not your debtor. Debts of gratitude... they have interest rates in politics.

SHAO XUXUE
(fingers tightening on her sword)
Husband, accept the grace. You've served your purpose. Don't make this... unpleasant.

Li Zhen looks at her, truly seeing her for the first time. The political bride who never shared his bed, only his title.

LI ZHEN
(to Shao Xuxue)
You were my wife in name. He was my brother in deed. I misjudged which bond was weaker.

SHAO XUXUE
(drawing her sword, blue energy flaring)
You misjudged everything, transmigrator.

Her blade strikes faster than Li Zhen can react. He crumples, blood pooling beneath him. The ministers look away.

SHAO XUXUE
(looking down at him)
Fifth Rank warrior, reduced to a crippled administrator. You never belonged here.

Li Zhen's fingers twitch. His blood begins to glow faintly gold.

SYSTEM VOICE (V.O.)
Host status: Critical. Loyalty bonds: Severed. Life choice imminent. Activating...

title: The Hidden Truth
description: A young woman discovers evidence that suggests her mother might be a human trafficker and that she could be the lost daughter of a wealthy tycoon.
context:
Title: The Hidden Truth
Description: A young woman discovers evidence that suggests her mother might be a human trafficker and that she could be the lost daughter of a wealthy tycoon.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

ZHOU YIYI sits at the table, her laptop displaying a missing person database. She touches the circular birthmark on her forearm.

ZHOU YIYI
(to herself)
Same age. Same mark. Same hospital where she "found" me.

LI HUILAN enters, grocery bags in hand, stopping when she sees the screen.

LI HUILAN
You blocked my calls.

ZHOU YIYI
(coldly)
I was busy.

LI HUILAN
Busy with what?

ZHOU YIYI
Finding out why you've been lying.

LI HUILAN
What nonsense—

ZHOU YIYI
—That you stole me? That I'm not your daughter?

LI HUILAN
(shocked)
Who's been filling your head with this?

ZHOU YIYI
Stop pretending. Look.

ZHOU YIYI rolls up her sleeve, revealing the birthmark. She turns the laptop toward LI HUILAN, showing a missing baby alert and age-progressed photo that mirrors her face.

ZHOU YIYI
And this. My real father. Still looking. Still paying investigators.

LI HUILAN
(sighing)
Yiyi, half the babies born that year had marks. You're imagining—
continuation:
LI HUILAN walks forward, reaching for YIYI's arm.

LI HUILAN
Listen. I've found a new school. We'll go next week, away from these influences.

ZHOU YIYI
(pulling her hand away)
I'm not going anywhere with you. Unless you take the test.

LI HUILAN
(voice tight)
Paternity test.

ZHOU YIYI
The only thing I trust.

LI HUILAN
(V.O.)
They'll take her. They'll say I kidnapped her. Everything ends.

LI HUILAN
(firmly)
No. No test.

ZHOU YIYI
(pressing closer)
Guilty conscience?

LI HUILAN
Don't push me, Yiyi. I am your mother. Your father died protecting us. That's the truth.

ZHOU YIYI
Then why are you shaking?

Li Huilan's hand trembles as she pulls back.

ZHOU YIYI
Once I contact him, we'll see who the liar is.

ZHOU YIYI walks into her room, the door clicking shut.

LI HUILAN stands motionless. She pulls out her phone, opens a hidden folder. Inside: a photo of her younger self holding baby Yiyi in a hospital bed, a man's arm around her—the same man from the missing person alert.

LI HUILAN
(V.O.)
She wants the truth. But truth means I was never her mother. Only her kidnapper.

She deletes the photo. The screen fades to black.

title: North River Never Sees Koi
description: A young woman haunted by memories of her childhood savior is forced into an arranged marriage, while both she and her fiancé search for their lost loves from the past.
context:
Title: North River Never Sees Koi
Description: A young woman haunted by memories of her childhood savior is forced into an arranged marriage, while both she and her fiancé search for their lost loves from the past.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Surgical lights GLARE. Heart monitors BEEP. Medical staff in scrubs surround two adjacent beds. LITTLE BROTHER BEI (CHILDHOOD) wears a surgical cap, oxygen mask in place. SONG JINLI (CHILDHOOD) lies beside him, reaching out.

Their hands clasp between the beds.

SONG JINLI (CHILDHOOD) (V.O.)
I don't want you to do this. Please.

LITTLE BROTHER BEI (CHILDHOOD) (V.O.)
You saved me first. Now it's my turn.

SONG JINLI (CHILDHOOD) (V.O.)
Will I see you again?

LITTLE BROTHER BEI (CHILDHOOD) (V.O.)
Forever. We promised.

A doctor inserts a needle. His grip loosens. His hand drops.

INT. SONG FAMILY MANSION - BEDROOM - DAY

SONG JINLI wakes with a gasp. Her brother SONG CHEN sits beside the bed.

SONG CHEN
That same dream again?

SONG JINLI
(still dazed)
He was real.

SONG CHEN
Sister—

SONG JINLI touches the cord bracelet on her wrist.

SONG JINLI
Seven days.
continuation:
INT. LU BEICHUAN'S OFFICE - DAY

LU BEICHUAN studies an identical cord bracelet.

LU BEICHUAN
(whispering)
Where are you?

His phone rings.

LU BEICHUAN
Grandmother, I won't marry Song Jinli.

GRANDMOTHER (V.O.)
Her fortune is your only salvation. Dihao Hotel.

LU BEICHUAN
I don't believe in that.

GRANDMOTHER (V.O.)
Believe in my resolve. Come, or I will jump.

LU BEICHUAN
(anxious)
Grandmother!

The call disconnects. LU BEICHUAN stands.

LU BEICHUAN
(to secretary)
Prepare the car. Release a statement I'm abroad.

SECRETARY ZHENG
Yes, sir.

INT. SONG FAMILY MANSION - BEDROOM - DAY

SONG CHEN
What about the Lu family marriage in seven days?

SONG JINLI'S phone rings. She answers.

FATHER (V.O.)
Lu Beichuan is with a woman at Dihao Hotel. Do your job.

SONG JINLI
He doesn't want me.

FATHER (V.O.)
Make him want you. Remember your place, Song Jinli. The Song family name is a privilege, not a right.

SONG JINLI
(hanging up, muttering)
If Mother were here...

She throws off the covers.

INT. SONG FAMILY MANSION - HALLWAY - DAY

SONG JINLI walks out. SONG CHEN blocks her.

SONG CHEN
Let me go with you.

SONG JINLI
I'm ending the engagement.

SONG CHEN
(smiling)
Good plan.

SONG JINLI
(to a maid)
A cleaning service uniform.

MAID
Yes, Miss.

SONG CHEN watches her. His eyes darken.

SONG CHEN
(to himself)
Sister, you can only be mine.

INT. DIHAO HOTEL - LOBBY - DAY

LU BEICHUAN hurries in, pressing the elevator button.

LU BEICHUAN
(under his breath)
Wait for me.

He enters. The doors close.

SONG JINLI, now in a cleaning uniform, runs up. She watches the elevator ascend.

FADE OUT.

Title: North River Never Sees Koi
Description: A young woman haunted by memories of her childhood savior is forced into an arranged marriage, while both she and her fiancé search for their lost loves from the past.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Surgical lights GLARE. Heart monitors BEEP. Medical staff in scrubs surround two adjacent beds. LITTLE BROTHER BEI (CHILDHOOD) wears a surgical cap, oxygen mask in place. SONG JINLI (CHILDHOOD) lies beside him, reaching out.

Their hands clasp between the beds.

SONG JINLI (CHILDHOOD) (V.O.)
I don't want you to do this. Please.

LITTLE BROTHER BEI (CHILDHOOD) (V.O.)
You saved me first. Now it's my turn.

SONG JINLI (CHILDHOOD) (V.O.)
Will I see you again?

LITTLE BROTHER BEI (CHILDHOOD) (V.O.)
Forever. We promised.

A doctor inserts a needle. His grip loosens. His hand drops.

INT. SONG FAMILY MANSION - BEDROOM - DAY

SONG JINLI wakes with a gasp. Her brother SONG CHEN sits beside the bed.

SONG CHEN
That same dream again?

SONG JINLI
(still dazed)
He was real.

SONG CHEN
Sister—

SONG JINLI touches the cord bracelet on her wrist.

SONG JINLI
Seven days.

INT. LU BEICHUAN'S OFFICE - DAY

LU BEICHUAN studies an identical cord bracelet.

LU BEICHUAN
(whispering)
Where are you?

His phone rings.

LU BEICHUAN
Grandmother, I won't marry Song Jinli.

GRANDMOTHER (V.O.)
Her fortune is your only salvation. Dihao Hotel.

LU BEICHUAN
I don't believe in that.

GRANDMOTHER (V.O.)
Believe in my resolve. Come, or I will jump.

LU BEICHUAN
(anxious)
Grandmother!

The call disconnects. LU BEICHUAN stands.

LU BEICHUAN
(to secretary)
Prepare the car. Release a statement I'm abroad.

SECRETARY ZHENG
Yes, sir.

INT. SONG FAMILY MANSION - BEDROOM - DAY

SONG CHEN
What about the Lu family marriage in seven days?

SONG JINLI'S phone rings. She answers.

FATHER (V.O.)
Lu Beichuan is with a woman at Dihao Hotel. Do your job.

SONG JINLI
He doesn't want me.

FATHER (V.O.)
Make him want you. Remember your place, Song Jinli. The Song family name is a privilege, not a right.

SONG JINLI
(hanging up, muttering)
If Mother were here...

She throws off the covers.

INT. SONG FAMILY MANSION - HALLWAY - DAY

SONG JINLI walks out. SONG CHEN blocks her.

SONG CHEN
Let me go with you.

SONG JINLI
I'm ending the engagement.

SONG CHEN
(smiling)
Good plan.

SONG JINLI
(to a maid)
A cleaning service uniform.

MAID
Yes, Miss.

SONG CHEN watches her. His eyes darken.

SONG CHEN
(to himself)
Sister, you can only be mine.

INT. DIHAO HOTEL - LOBBY - DAY

LU BEICHUAN hurries in, pressing the elevator button.

LU BEICHUAN
(under his breath)
Wait for me.

He enters. The doors close.

SONG JINLI, now in a cleaning uniform, runs up. She watches the elevator ascend.

FADE OUT.

title: The Hidden Heiress Identity
description: After serving a year in prison for her boyfriend's cousin, a wealthy heiress is released only to discover a shocking betrayal on what was supposed to be their wedding day.
context:
Title: The Hidden Heiress Identity
Description: After serving a year in prison for her boyfriend's cousin, a wealthy heiress is released only to discover a shocking betrayal on what was supposed to be their wedding day.

INT. PARK - DAY

MU XIAOXIAO walks through the park, sunlight glinting off a simple gold bracelet—the only remnant of her former life. She wears a casual shirt and jeans, tags still visible on the collar.

ON SCREEN: Mu Xiaoxiao | Shangjing Mu Family Heiress

MU XIAOXIAO (V.O.)
One year. Finally out. But freedom feels heavier than I remember.

FLASHBACK:

INT. PARK BENCH - NIGHT

A year ago at night, MU XIAOXIAO sits with her boyfriend SHEN YI under dim lamplight.

SHEN YI
Xiaoxiao, cousin Xuan's in deeper trouble than you know. Third offense. They'll destroy her.

SHEN YI takes MU XIAOXIAO's hand, his grip tighter than his words.

SHEN YI
One year for you, minimum security. The day you're released, we register our marriage. No more hiding.

MU XIAOXIAO studies his face, searching for truth. She finds only her own reflection.

MU XIAOXIAO
And my family?

SHEN YI
Forget them. We'll have our own.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. PARK - DAY

Back to the present, MU XIAOXIAO stands at a crossroads, watching couples pass.

MU XIAOXIAO (V.O.)
I wonder if Brother Ayi remembers what today is. If Uncle Lin kept his promise to help him while I was inside.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

A Rolls-Royce drives through the city streets. Inside, tension crackles.

HUO TIANYU, a handsome man in a suit and sunglasses, sits in the back seat on a phone call.

ON SCREEN: Huo Tianyu | CEO of Shangjing Huo Corporation

HUO TIANYU
(into phone)
Grandmother, the Mu merger is business. My marriage is my own decision.

The car brakes sharply. MU XIAOXIAO is knocked to the ground, her bag spilling open.

HUO TIANYU
Xiao Li, get out and see what happened.

XIAO LI (DRIVER)
Mr. Huo, my legs seem a bit weak.

HUO TIANYU frowns and opens the car door himself.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

HUO TIANYU walks to MU XIAOXIAO lying on the ground. He kneels down, noticing her release papers among scattered belongings.

HUO TIANYU
Are you alright?

MU XIAOXIAO
Just scrapes.

She tries to hide the papers, but he's already seen.

HUO TIANYU
Your first day out?

MU XIAOXIAO
(defensive)
I'm heading to the Civil Affairs Bureau. My boyfriend is waiting.

HUO TIANYU helps her stand, his eyes scanning her face with unusual interest.

HUO TIANYU
I'll take you.

EXT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU ENTRANCE - DAY

HUO TIANYU's car stops at the entrance. From another car, SHEN YI and MU XUAN get out holding hands, matching rings visible.

ON SCREEN: Shen Yi | The Promise
ON SCREEN: Mu Xuan | The Cousin

SHEN YI and MU XUAN walk intimately toward the Civil Affairs Bureau.

MU XIAOXIAO gets out of HUO TIANYU's car and walks toward the entrance, her steps confident.

MU XIAOXIAO
Brother Ayi, today's the day. Just like you promised.

She sees MU XUAN beside SHEN YI. Her smile doesn't freeze—it shatters.

SHEN YI
(coldly)
She's the one I'm marrying today.

SHEN YI looks at MU XIAOXIAO and says contemptuously.

SHEN YI
You served your purpose. Now you're just a reformed criminal.

MU XIAOXIAO
(shocked)
She's the cousin. The one you asked me to protect. The one I took the fall for.

MU XUAN smirks, linking her arm through SHEN YI's.

MU XUA
You really thought he'd wait? For someone like you?

MU XIAOXIAO's expression changes from shock to something harder. Something dangerous.

MU XIAOXIAO
(quietly)
I kept my end of the bargain. I protected your family secret while you built a new one.

She looks at HUO TIANYU, who has been watching silently.

MU XIAOXIAO
Mr. Huo, is your offer for a ride still open?

HUO TIANYU
It is.

MU XIAOXIAO
Take me to Shangjing Mu Financial Headquarters. I have a board meeting to attend.

She removes the cheap bracelet, dropping it at SHEN YI's feet.

MU XIAOXIAO
The Mu family doesn't forget debts. Especially not family ones.

She walks back to the Rolls-Royce, leaving them staring.

SHEN YI
(paling)
Mu family?

title: The Yue Traitors Must Die
description: A beloved imperial consort's family is accused of treason. Her father dies in battle, and her brother is executed as a traitor while she watches helplessly.
context:
Title: The Yue Traitors Must Die
Description: A beloved imperial consort's family is accused of treason. Her father dies in battle, and her brother is executed as a traitor while she watches helplessly.

EXT. EXECUTION GROUND - DAY

The execution ground. Dust and silence. The EXECUTIONER's blade is a slice of winter sky. GENERAL YUE kneels center stage, bound, his wounds speaking of a trial held in secret.

MESSENGER (O.S.)
Consort Yue! The Emperor's edict is posted - the Duke fell at South Pass, and your house is declared traitor! Collusion with southern tribes!

YUE NANYAN enters the square, breathless, alone. Her imperial silks are torn, her jade hairpin missing. The CROWD sees her, and a ripple passes through them.

ONLOOKER A
The traitor's daughter dares to show her face.

ONLOOKER B
That face was on the Emperor's coin last year. How quickly metal melts.

ONLOOKER C
Let's see if she melts too. Tear the silk from her back!

ONLOOKER D (O.S.)
General's head to South Gate by dusk. The household wagons are already on the exile road.

MESSENGER (O.S.)
The palace gates are barred to you, Consort. The Emperor's guard said you're to learn "the weight of a name."

ONLOOKER E
Her name's worth less than the dirt she's crawling on.

ONLOOKER C
Dirt is too good for Yue blood.

YUE NANYAN crawls to her brother's side, not from weakness, but because her legs have turned to stone beneath her.

YUE NANYAN
(sobbing)
Brother.

GENERAL YUE
You climbed the garden wall. I told you that cherry tree wouldn't hold your weight.

YUE NANYAN
(kneeling, touching his face)
It broke. Like everything else.

GENERAL YUE
(trying for a smile)
Father's last dispatch had a message for you. He said: "Tell Yan'er the caves are full of stars." You understand?
continuation:
YUE NANYAN
The southern caves. The refugee children. You hid them.

GENERAL YUE
We hid them. That's your legacy now. Not this.

YUE NANYAN
I'll go to the Emperor. The maps, the battle reports—

GENERAL YUE
(cuts her off, voice hard)
The Emperor read those reports by candlelight last night. He wept while he signed the order. That's not a man who can be persuaded. That's a man who needs a villain.

SUPERVISING OFFICIAL
(throwing the token)
Time, General. The edict is specific.

YUE NANYAN
(screaming)
Wait! I need more time—

GENERAL YUE
(over his shoulder)
You have all the time I'm giving you. Live in it. Don't look back.

SOLDIERS move in. She clutches his arm until they pry her fingers loose.

GENERAL YUE
(straightening, voice ringing)
I, Yue Xiang, die today! But the maps my father made will still guide our soldiers. The children my brother hid will still breathe. Try to erase the Yue family - you'll just teach them how to hide better!

YUE NANYAN
(held by soldiers, suddenly still)
Let me watch. Let me see.

The EXECUTIONER raises the blade. It falls. Blood arcs across the sand, spattering YUE NANYAN's face. She doesn't close her eyes.

YUE NANYAN
(a soundless shape)

CROWD
(uneven, not a cheer)
So ends the traitor...

YUE NANYAN lies on the ground. The blood on her face begins to dry. Her eyes, which have known nothing but palace finery, now know the color of iron.

YUE NANYAN
(voice-over)
My father taught me to navigate by star maps. My brother taught me to navigate by honor. Today I learned the most important lesson: in the empire of the blind, the woman who remembers is queen. And I remember everything.

title: South Wind Towards Li
description: On a rainy night, Zhou Chuli discovers her boyfriend made a bet to seduce her, leading to a painful breakup and a mysterious figure watching from the shadows.
context:
Title: South Wind Towards Li
Description: On a rainy night, Zhou Chuli discovers her boyfriend made a bet to seduce her, leading to a painful breakup and a mysterious figure watching from the shadows.

EXT. RAINY NIGHT STREET - NIGHT

A torrential night. City neon lights bleed through rain-streaked windows.

A blue taxi stops at the wet curb.

A foot in black high heels steps onto the pavement, sinking into a puddle.

ZHOU CHULI, an elegant woman in a white trench coat, exits the taxi. She balances a blue umbrella in one hand while checking her phone with the other: a message from SHEN LI reads "Everyone's waiting for you."

FRIEND (V.O.)
Chuli, where are you? You're the only one from our class who hasn't arrived yet.

ZHOU CHULI
(anxiously)
Sorry, traffic was murder. I'm here now.

She pockets the phone and hurries toward a KTV entrance, her face showing traces of fatigue and apology.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Inside the KTV room, colorful lights flash and music blares. A group of young men and women party around a table covered with bottles.

ZHOU CHULI reaches the door. It's cracked open.

SHEN'S FRIEND 1
(slurred)
Pay up, Brother Shen. Three days, just like you said.

BROTHER SHEN
(quietly)
Shut it.

SHEN'S FRIEND 2
He's actually ashamed! Never thought I'd see the day.

SHEN'S FRIEND 1
(louder, for the room)
"Zhou Chuli from the finance seminar? She's just a challenge." Your words, man.

Laughter. ZHOU CHULI's hand goes limp on the door handle.

SHEN'S FRIEND 2
At least she's hot. Even if she does just...lie there.

ZHOU CHULI stands outside, her face pale, expression shifting from shock to heartbreak, and finally to cold fury.

She turns to leave, then stops. Checks her phone one last time. Deletes every message from Shen.

She turns back, eyes determined, and walks into the room.
continuation:
INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

ZHOU CHULI walks up to BROTHER SHEN. The room falls silent.

ZHOU CHULI
(coldly)
Congratulations. You won.

BROTHER SHEN sees her, jumps up.

BROTHER SHEN
(panicking)
Chuli, let me explain—

ZHOU CHULI ignores him, picks up a glass of red wine from the table, and without hesitation splashes it in BROTHER SHEN's face.

BROTHER SHEN is drenched in wine, looking utterly disheveled. The entire room falls silent.

ZHOU CHULI
(resolutely)
We're done.

She turns and walks out of the room without looking back.

Inside the room, SHEN's friends exchange glances. BROTHER SHEN looks shocked and angry.

After a moment, BROTHER SHEN wipes his face with a napkin.

SHEN'S FRIEND 2
Brother Shen, should you go explain?

BROTHER SHEN
(angrily)
Explain what? She'll come back. They always do.

SHEN'S FRIEND 1
Then let's bet again. Brother Shen, do you dare?

BROTHER SHEN
(through gritted teeth)
I dare!

INT. KTV CORRIDOR - NIGHT

A man in a waiter's uniform hides in a corner, talking on his phone.

WAITER
(in a low voice)
Boss, it's done. Zhou Chuli knows everything.

EXT. RAINY NIGHT STREET - NIGHT

ZHOU CHULI stands alone in the heavy rain, water soaking her trench coat. She walks down the street in a daze, letting the rain wash over her.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

Inside a luxury sedan, a man in a suit (BOSS) sits in the back seat, his face hidden in shadow. He holds his phone.

BOSS
(calmly)
Good.

He puts down the phone and through the rain-covered window sees ZHOU CHULI getting into a taxi.

BOSS
(to the driver)
Don't lose her.

FADE OUT.

title: The Misogynist Heartthrob Clings to Me
description: A desperate young woman faces rejection from her family after discovering she's pregnant, leading her to the edge, but a chance encounter with a powerful CEO two months earlier may have changed her fate.
context:
Title: The Misogynist Heartthrob Clings to Me
Description: A desperate young woman faces rejection from her family after discovering she's pregnant, leading her to the edge, but a chance encounter with a powerful CEO two months earlier may have changed her fate.

INT. ROOFTOP - DAY

ZHAO ZHAODI stands at the edge of the rooftop, her expression full of despair, clutching a medical test report in her hand.

MOTHER (V.O.)
Your brother's surgery is in two weeks. All that tuition money... it was our only choice.

FATHER (V.O.)
We'd have nothing left. You understand, don't you?

ZHAO ZHAODI walks step by step toward the edge of the rooftop railing, tears streaming down her face.

ZHAO ZHAODI
(choking up)
Why is survival always someone else's price to pay?

She clutches the test report tightly to her chest, closing her eyes in pain. The report slips from her hand and falls to the ground.

ON SCREEN: TWO MONTHS AGO
continuation:
EXT. UNIVERSITY ENTRANCE - DAY

The campus is bustling with people coming and going. ZHAO ZHAODI pulls her suitcase, wearing a backpack, and walks into the campus.

INT. SCHOOL LOBBY - DAY

YAN SHIHAO, wearing a black suit, walks through the lobby surrounded by a group of people. ZHAO ZHAODI happens to enter from the doorway. They pass each other, their eyes meeting briefly.

ON SCREEN: YAN SHIHAO, CHAIRMAN OF GU CORPORATION

YAN SHIHAO and his entourage walk out the door.

INT. NEW STUDENT REGISTRATION DESK - DAY

ZHAO ZHAODI waits in line at the registration desk. When it's her turn, she hands a bank card to the REGISTRATION TEACHER.

REGISTRATION TEACHER
(looking at the computer)
I'm showing insufficient funds on this card.

ZHAO ZHAODI
(surprised)
That's impossible. I deposited four thousand seven hundred myself. Could you try once more?

The REGISTRATION TEACHER takes the card and swipes it again.

REGISTRATION TEACHER
The balance is zero. The account was cleared out yesterday.

ZHAO ZHAODI
(whispering)
She promised she wouldn't. Not after I earned that scholarship...

MALE STUDENT
(waiting in line behind her)
You're Zhao Zhaodi, right? The scholarship poster girl? Thought your education was paid for.

FEMALE STUDENT
(next to the male student)
Maybe scholarships don't cover everything these days. Some of us have to work for it.

ZHAO ZHAODI lowers her head in embarrassment, picks up her belongings, and prepares to leave.

REGISTRATION TEACHER
Student, if you can provide proof of financial hardship by Friday, we have an emergency fund. Don't lose hope.

ZHAO ZHAODI turns back, tears in her eyes, a flicker of something other than despair on her face.

title: The Character of a Master Chef
description: A pregnant chef faces workplace betrayal when her ambitious apprentice plots to take her position by exploiting her condition.
context:
Title: The Character of a Master Chef
Description: A pregnant chef faces workplace betrayal when her ambitious apprentice plots to take her position by exploiting her condition.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

CLOSE UP - wok

Oil sizzles in the hot pan, steam rising.

HAO PING, wearing a pristine white chef's uniform, focuses intently as she tosses the wok.

QUICK CUTS:
- Green peppers are rapidly sliced into thin strips.
- Carrots are cut into thin strips.
- Pork is sliced into shreds.

HAO PING adds the prepared ingredients to the wok one by one, her movements skilled and fluid. Flames rise along the edge of the pan.

She plates the stir-fried dish - a colorful and aromatic green pepper, carrot, and pork shred dish is complete.

HAO PING
Old Jia, order up!

OLD JIA
Coming!

OLD JIA takes the plate. HAO PING suddenly feels nauseous and steadies herself against the counter, breathing carefully.

OLD JIA
(quietly)
You alright?

HAO PING
(hand on her belly)
Not quite four months yet.

OLD JIA
High-risk at your age... doctor's okay with this?

HAO PING
(firmly)
She'll be raised in her father's kitchen. No matter what.

HAO PING strokes her belly, a quiet, determined smile on her face.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY (FLASHBACK)

HAO PING stands by the street, touching her stomach beneath a trench coat, looking at a photograph. She closes her eyes, then walks toward a restaurant called "Happy Little Kitchen."

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

COLLEAGUE A
Starting to show now.

COLLEAGUE B
Xiaolin's been on prep six months. Thought he'd graduate to the wok by now.

HUANG XIAOLIN peeks out from behind the curtain, listening.

HAO PING
(smiling, focused on her work)
Flavor needs time. Prep the ginger.

HUANG XIAOLIN's expression tightens, his knuckles white on the curtain.

HUANG XIAOLIN
(internal monologue)
Six months. Exactly how long does "time" take?

INT. KITCHEN - LATER

COLLEAGUE A
Thinks she's irreplaceable.

COLLEAGUE B
(quietly)
Woman carries what she carries. Mind your tongue.

INT. RESTAURANT FRONT DESK - DAY

A female CUSTOMER gives thumbs up to the owner, DAI LI.

CUSTOMER
Boss lady, your chef is the best! I'll definitely come back!

DAI LI
(enthusiastically)
Take care!

After the customer leaves, DAI LI checks the ledger.

DAI LI
(to herself)
Eight-grand chef. Better be worth it.

HUANG XIAOLIN approaches, wiping his hands.

HUANG XIAOLIN
Boss, I've been studying her technique. Every move. Every recipe.

DAI LI
And?

HUANG XIAOLIN
Just saying... if she needs more check-ups, I can hold the line. For less.

DAI LI
(skeptical)
She told you she's pregnant?

HUANG XIAOLIN
Didn't have to.

DAI LI
(quietly furious)
If she can't fulfill the role, we'll need a solution. But that's her business, not yours. Yet.

HUANG XIAOLIN
(overjoyed)
Great!

HUANG XIAOLIN's face shows a triumphant smile.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

HAO PING alone, cleaning her knives. She finds a prep list with Xiaolin's handwriting - her signature dishes, meticulously copied. She touches her belly, looks around the empty kitchen, then carefully wraps the knives in cloth.

HAO PING
(softly)
Your father built this place with his hands. I'll be damned if a boy who can't wait burns it down.

She pockets the prep list and walks out, straight-backed.

FADE OUT.

title: The Beginning of a Contract Marriage
description: A woman trapped in a loveless family proposes a contract marriage to an old classmate, seeking escape and convenience in a year-long arrangement.
context:
Title: The Beginning of a Contract Marriage
Description: A woman trapped in a loveless family proposes a contract marriage to an old classmate, seeking escape and convenience in a year-long arrangement.

INT. CHU RONG'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

In the dimly lit room, candlelight flickers. CHU RONG, wearing a red slip dress, sits on the sofa with a cold, elegant expression. A glass of wine rests on the table in front of her.

MU JUNZE (V.O.)
Miss Chu.

MU JUNZE, a handsome man in a white shirt, walks in from the doorway.

CHU RONG
My eight o'clock appointment. You're late.

MU JUNZE walks behind CHU RONG, gently stroking her hair, leaning forward to whisper in her ear.

MU JUNZE
Then I'll give you a discount. Eight thousand yuan.

CHU RONG sits up straight and turns to look at him. She reaches out, gently touching MU JUNZE's chest beneath his open shirt.

CHU RONG
I'll give you twenty thousand. Twice.

The atmosphere between them becomes charged with unspoken tension. They stand and slow dance to faint music, the kiss that follows lingering with uncertainty.

EXT. APARTMENT BALCONY - NIGHT

CHU RONG and MU JUNZE stand on the balcony, the city's night view behind them. CHU RONG holds a lit cigarette.

CHU RONG
Enjoying the performance, Mr. Mu?

MU JUNZE
Your father's sixtieth. Songhe Restaurant? The imperial chef's successor handles Huaiyang cuisine.

CHU RONG
You're overachieving in this role.

MU JUNZE
Thank yous don't extend contracts.

CHU RONG
The terms are clear. Eleven months is the limit.

CHU RONG turns around, her expression softening with a hint of vulnerability.

CHU RONG
Don't tell me you're confusing this with reality.

CHU RONG turns and walks back inside, leaving MU JUNZE alone on the balcony with a complicated expression.
continuation:
INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

CHU RONG, now wearing a floral print dress, sits at a dining table with her father CHU ZHIHUA, stepmother LAN FANG, and stepsister CHU YANG eating dinner.

LAN FANG and CHU YANG are examining an array of red gift boxes containing gold and silver jewelry.

LAN FANG
Emerald Bay penthouse. A Porsche. Five sets of gold jewelry. That's my Yang Yang—knows how to honor her family. Not like some who contribute nothing. Just like her mother. Nothing but ill fortune.

CHU YANG
Mother-in-law says proper families require complete backgrounds. Incomplete upbringing causes... complications.

CHU RONG
(coldly)
Better to stay single than join that kind of family.

LAN FANG
(angrily)
If you're so superior, bring a man home. Prove your worth.

CHU YANG
(pretentiously)
Mother, don't fret. Sister's doing the world a favor. Saving some poor man from misery.

CHU ZHIHUA
Today is Rong Rong's birthday. Enough.

LAN FANG
(shouting at CHU ZHIHUA)
You stay out of this. I kept her in this family. Unmarried at her age—what cause for celebration?

MU JUNZE appears at the dining room entrance, witnessing everything.

CHU RONG puts down her chopsticks and stands up.

CHU RONG
I'd rather not be part of this family.

CHU RONG walks out of the dining room.

EXT. STREET OUTSIDE RESTAURANT - NIGHT

CHU RONG stands alone by the street, lighting a cigarette. MU JUNZE walks to her side.

MU JUNZE
Share a light?

CHU RONG looks up and sees him, somewhat surprised.

MU JUNZE
Mu Junze. From second year.

CHU RONG
(smiling)
Long time no see, old classmate.

FLASHBACK: The two sitting on a park bench.

MU JUNZE (V.O.)
Always alone. Always underestimated.

CHU RONG
What? You want to be a savior?

MU JUNZE
For the right person.

Back to the present. The two walk side by side on the night street.

CHU RONG
Still single?

MU JUNZE
Depends who's asking.

CHU RONG stops, turns to face MU JUNZE, her eyes determined.

CHU RONG
Someone needs a husband. For a year. Interested?

MU JUNZE looks at her, a flash of surprise and deeper meaning in his eyes.

title: Attending the Emperor's Enthronement, the Empress Dowager is Drowned (Episode 41)
description: On the eve of his enthronement, the new Emperor awaits his mother's arrival—but the ambitious Empress-to-be, fearing political eclipse, moves to eliminate her rival before dawn.
context:
Title: Attending the Emperor's Enthronement, the Empress Dowager is Drowned (Episode 41)
Description: On the eve of his enthronement, the new Emperor awaits his mother's arrival—but the ambitious Empress-to-be, fearing political eclipse, moves to eliminate her rival before dawn.

INT. IMPERIAL PALACE INNER CHAMBER - NIGHT

EUNUCH CAO (O.S.)
Your Majesty—still at your desk?

EUNUCH CAO enters bearing a silk-wrapped dossier. He finds EMPEROR LONG staring at a weathered jade amulet.

EUNUCH CAO
The court astrologers have divined an auspicious hour. Tomorrow, the Mandate of Heaven passes to you. Yet the hour grows late...

EMPEROR LONG
(fingers tracing the amulet)
Ten years I've fought. Ten years I've measured each step toward this throne. But without her footsteps behind me, what do these steps matter?

EUNUCH CAO
Your honored mother...

EMPEROR LONG
During the great drought, when I was nine, she fed me from her own arm while the wealthy turned us away. When I raised the banner of rebellion, she sold the ancestral tablets to buy me a horse. Three New Years past, an assassin's blade meant for my neck found her shoulder instead. This empire... it belongs to her as much as me.

EUNUCH CAO
She will stand at your side tomorrow. The escort I personally selected—

EMPEROR LONG
—must be discreet. She despises ostentation. See that no fanfare marks her arrival. Let her enter as she once entered our hut: simply, with only the love she carries.

EUNUCH CAO
This old servant understands.

Eunuch Cao sets down the dossier—a roster of the new imperial consorts. His finger hovers beside one name: SU JINFENG.

EMPEROR LONG
You may withdraw.

EUNUCH CAO
(bowing)
May Your Majesty find peace this night.

EUNUCH CAO withdraws, his shadow lingering a moment against the paper doors.
continuation:
EXT. PALACE CORRIDOR - NIGHT

SU JINFENG walks with measured grace, her HANDMAIDENS trailing like silent kites.

SU JINFENG
He has not summoned me for fifteen nights. A future Empress cannot be invisible.

YUE QING
Perhaps His Majesty is preoccupied with the ceremony, my lady.

They pause before the inner chamber. Through the lattice, fragments drift: "...without her... what do these steps matter?" "...belongs to her as much as me."

SU JINFENG
(coldly)
Whom does he speak of?

XIAO YU
Surely Your Ladyship, the—

SU JINFENG
I've given his court my family's silver, my brother's army, my own youth. And he speaks of another "her"?

Her knuckles whiten against a lacquered box—tonic for the Emperor's fatigue.

SU JINFENG
(returning the way she came)
Summon my brother's captain. Not through official channels. Make it seem a routine patrol.

YUE QING
My lady, the risk—

SU JINFENG
The risk is in allowing another woman to hold the empire's heart while I hold only its titles. Find her. Delay her. Let the ceremony proceed without... interruption.

EXT. PALACE PATHWAY - DAWN MIST

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER walks with XIAO LIZI, both in plain travel-worn robes. Morning fog coils around their ankles.

XIAO LIZI
Old Madam, we should have waited for the formal procession. Your wound—

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER
—has healed enough. My son becomes Emperor at sunrise. A mother doesn't need trumpets to witness her child's tomorrow. She needs only to arrive.

They turn a corner. Before them, SU JINFENG stands with two handmaidens and four IMPERIAL GUARDS bearing her family crest.

SU JINFENG
(blocking the path)
This route is reserved for imperial family. State your purpose.

XIAO LIZI
Do you not recognize—

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER
(quietly, with dignity)
We are bound for the Hall of Supreme Harmony. As is our right.

SU JINFENG
(inspecting her)
Your right? Your clothes stink of common roads. Your hands show labor. Tell me—what sorcery makes Emperor Long mistake a peasant for a person of consequence?

She takes a step closer. The guards shift, hands to sword hilts.

SU JINFENG
(low, lethal)
I am Su Jinfeng. My father commands the eastern armies. My dowry built the northern fortresses. Who are you, to make him whisper your name in the dark?

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER
I am his mother.

The words hang like struck iron. Su Jinfeng's composure cracks—panic flickering beneath prestige.

SU JINFENG
(to the guards, voice rising)
Arrest these intruders! Spies, sent to disrupt the ceremony!

XIAO LIZI
Madness! She bears the Emperor's own seal—

SU JINFENG
—seal? Show me this seal.

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER
reaches for her satchel. Su JINFENG's hand flashes—no slap, but a shove. The mother stumbles backward. Her foot catches the pathway's edge.

She falls. Silently. The mist swallows the splash below.

XIAO LIZI's scream splits the dawn.

SU JINFENG stares at her own trembling hand, the sound of water still rippling in the silence.

I've given his court my family's silver, my brother's army, my own youth. And he speaks of another "her"?

Her knuckles whiten against a lacquered box—tonic for the Emperor's fatigue.

SU JINFENG
(returning the way she came)
Summon my brother's captain. Not through official channels. Make it seem a routine patrol.

YUE QING
My lady, the risk—

SU JINFENG
The risk is in allowing another woman to hold the empire's heart while I hold only its titles. Find her. Delay her. Let the ceremony proceed without... interruption.

EXT. PALACE PATHWAY - DAWN MIST

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER walks with XIAO LIZI, both in plain travel-worn robes. Morning fog coils around their ankles.

XIAO LIZI
Old Madam, we should have waited for the formal procession. Your wound—

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER
—has healed enough. My son becomes Emperor at sunrise. A mother doesn't need trumpets to witness her child's tomorrow. She needs only to arrive.

They turn a corner. Before them, SU JINFENG stands with two handmaidens and four IMPERIAL GUARDS bearing her family crest.

SU JINFENG
(blocking the path)
This route is reserved for imperial family. State your purpose.

XIAO LIZI
Do you not recognize—

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER
(quietly, with dignity)
We are bound for the Hall of Supreme Harmony. As is our right.

SU JINFENG
(inspecting her)
Your right? Your clothes stink of common roads. Your hands show labor. Tell me—what sorcery makes Emperor Long mistake a peasant for a person of consequence?

She takes a step closer. The guards shift, hands to sword hilts.

SU JINFENG
(low, lethal)
I am Su Jinfeng. My father commands the eastern armies. My dowry built the northern fortresses. Who are you, to make him whisper your name in the dark?

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER
I am his mother.

The words hang like struck iron. Su Jinfeng's composure cracks—panic flickering beneath prestige.

SU JINFENG
(to the guards, voice rising)
Arrest these intruders! Spies, sent to disrupt the ceremony!

XIAO LIZI
Madness! She bears the Emperor's own seal—

SU JINFENG
—seal? Show me this seal.

EMPEROR LONG'S MOTHER
reaches for her satchel. Su JINFENG's hand flashes—no slap, but a shove. The mother stumbles backward. Her foot catches the pathway's edge.

She falls. Silently. The mist swallows the splash below.

XIAO LIZI's scream splits the dawn.

SU JINFENG stares at her own trembling hand, the sound of water still rippling in the silence.

title: Another Year of Soul-Breaking Night
description: A top AI scientist faces a massive cyber attack threatening her nation's technological sovereignty, forcing her to make an impossible choice between years of research and protecting core technology.
context:
Title: Another Year of Soul-Breaking Night
Description: A top AI scientist faces a massive cyber attack threatening her nation's technological sovereignty, forcing her to make an impossible choice between years of research and protecting core technology.

INT. HIGH-TECH LABORATORY - DAY

Red alarm lights flash urgently. Screens display red "ACCESS DENIED" messages.

FAST CUTS:
Scientists frantically typing on keyboards.
Green code scrolling rapidly on screens.
The entire laboratory in a state of high tension.

ON SCREEN: ZHENG NIANJIA, Chief Scientist, appears on monitor composed amidst chaos.

A MALE COLLEAGUE stands up from his seat in panic, rushing toward ZHENG NIANJIA, who studies a tablet.

MALE COLLEAGUE
(anxiously)
Chief Engineer Zheng, we can't hold on much longer! Eighty hours now, this exceeds normal human physiological limits! The attack—230 million requests per second. This is nation-state level. If they breach the kernel...

ZHENG NIANJIA
(coldly)
Return to your station.

The MALE COLLEAGUE looks reluctant but turns back.

ZHENG NIANJIA stands, tablet pressed to her chest, addresses the room.

ZHENG NIANJIA
Everyone. My father bled out in a lab in '03 building the prototype you're using. The WestTech embargo took his arm, not his work.

(beat)
This isn't about data. They want the skeleton—how our AI thinks. If they get that, we become obsolete.

She holds up her tablet. On it: a photo of her father, sleeves pinned, before a whiteboard.

ZHENG NIANJIA
We protect the method. Not the files.

The MALE COLLEAGUE and other colleagues are inspired, eyes becoming determined.

COLLEAGUES (V.O.)
The method. The method.

MONTAGE:
Team members working day and night, clock shadows spinning rapidly across the screen.

ZHENG NIANJIA looks exhausted, pressing her temples, frowning tightly.

ZHENG NIANJIA looks at the tablet in her hand, the screen showing the same photo.

FLASHBACK - INT. HUMBLE HOME - DAY

Young Nianjia sits at the table, looking at her FATHER with an injured arm in a bandage.

YOUNG NIANJIA
Dad, can't you rest?

FATHER takes out a notebook, pushes it toward her.

FATHER
The algorithm's yours now. Make it so they can't take it away.

Young Nianjia opens it, sees his handwriting.

YOUNG NIANJIA (V.O.)
Make it mine.

FATHER smiles with relief.

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
INT. HIGH-TECH LABORATORY - DAY

Back to reality, ZHENG NIANJIA looks at the photo on the tablet, silently wipes away a nosebleed, her eyes even more resolute.

The alarm sounds again, more piercing.

MALE COLLEAGUE
(terrified)
Chief Engineer Zheng, our server, even the IP address has been locked!

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(desperate)
The neural weights—five years of training. If we cut power, we lose everything!

ZHENG NIANJIA stands, expression resolute.

ZHENG NIANJIA
Cut the power.

She walks toward the emergency power cut button.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
(turning around emotionally)
No, we can't cut the power! The server can't stop! Otherwise all our results will be destroyed! This is five years of our work!

ZHENG NIANJIA
(shouting)
Cut the power!

ZHENG NIANJIA
(calmly but firmly)
The architecture is in our heads. The data is just practice. We start over.

ZHENG NIANJIA walks to the emergency button, colleagues watching her in horror.

Tears in her eyes but expression resolute, she presses the red emergency stop button.

Colleagues' expressions are painful, desperate.

ZHENG NIANJIA closes her eyes, a tear falls.

VOICE (O.S.)
Chief Zheng. The Vice Minister is holding.

Zheng opens her eyes, already moving toward exit.

ZHENG NIANJIA
Tell him: the method is secure. Send whoever's still standing to the backup facility.

She exits. The dead lab behind her.

FADE OUT.

title: Another Mid-Autumn Moon
description: A devoted father dies after being crushed by stones while working to help his ungrateful son, who only cares about money.
context:
Title: Another Mid-Autumn Moon
Description: A devoted father dies after being crushed by stones while working to help his ungrateful son, who only cares about money.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

HOU WANYU, a haggard middle-aged woman in a simple plaid shirt, speaks to the camera.

HOU WANYU
My husband is dead.

QUICK FLASHBACK:
- HOU WANYU waiting outside the operating room, gripping a phone that won't ring.
- CHU HAISHENG on the operating table, doctors calling time.
- Their son CHU TIANYU at a crowded banquet, his smile cracking at the edges.

HOU WANYU
He died working for a son who couldn't wait to ask for more.

FLASHBACK: HOU WANYU kneels beside a body covered in white cloth, pressing a weathered hand to her cheek. No tears—just exhaustion.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - NIGHT

Under a bloated moon, the construction site is silent except for distant fireworks. CHU HAISHENG and HOU WANYU, both in yellow hard hats, share a cold steamed bun on a rubble pile. CHU HAISHENG's knee is wrapped in grimy gauze.

HOU WANYU
That leg's been swollen three days. The doctor said rest.

CHU HAISHENG
(softly)
Tianyu called. Crying. Said if he doesn't get twenty thousand by tomorrow, everything collapses.

HOU WANYU
Everything always collapses with him.

CHU HAISHENG
It's for Yangyang. For his future. For ours.

They lean against each other, looking at the moon.

CHU HAISHENG
Remember when he drew the moon? Said we were all up there. Even him.

HOU WANYU
That was before he learned money could buy a better view.

INT. LUXURY RESTAURANT - NIGHT

CHU TIANYU, in a crisp blue shirt, sits with his wife YINGYING, father-in-law AN JIANGUO, and their child. The table shows expensive dishes.

ALL
Happy Mid-Autumn!

AN JIANGUO
(sipping tea)
Zhang's son-in-law bought him a villa. Six years you've been married.

YINGYING
Dad, Tianyu brought your medicine. That Handi Yuanyuan wine—120,000 yuan. Said it helps your rheumatism.

AN JIANGUO
(raising an eyebrow)
Generous.

CHU TIANYU
(staring at the wine)
It's... supposed to be.

YINGYING kicks him under the table.

CHU TIANYU
Excuse me. I need to check on something.
continuation:
INT. RESTROOM - NIGHT

CHU TIANYU locks the door. He pulls out his phone: balance 97,651.36 yuan. He opens his wallet—to a faded photo of his parents at their first home. Behind it, a folded prescription for his father's heart medication. Expired. He presses his knuckle to his teeth.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - NIGHT

CHU HAISHENG's phone rings. "Son."

CHU HAISHENG
(to HOU WANYU)
It's him.

HOU WANYU
Don't tell him you're hurt.

CHU HAISHENG
(answering)
Tianyu! Happy festival. Are you... are you well?

CHU TIANYU
(on phone, strained)
Dad. The money. I know it's too much. But this deal—it's everything. I'll pay it back. I'll get you both a house, I swear.

CHU HAISHENG
(stopping him)
Son. We'll have it tonight.

CHU TIANYU
(on phone, choking)
Dad, I—

CHU HAISHENG
Bring Yangyang home soon. We'll make those dumplings you liked.

The call ends. CHU HAISHENG looks at his wife.

CHU HAISHENG
He said he'll come.

HOU WANYU
He says many things.

The CONSTRUCTION SITE BOSS approaches.

CONSTRUCTION SITE BOSS
Emergency shipment. Double pay. Anyone?

WORKER A
Festival night. My kid's waiting.

CHU HAISHENG
(rising)
We'll do it.

HOU WANYU
(grabbing his arm)
Your heart—

CHU HAISHENG
(taking her hand)
One last time.

EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE UNLOADING AREA - NIGHT

CHU HAISHENG and HOU WANYU unload cement bags. On the third bag, he stumbles. She steadies him.

HOU WANYU
Enough. Let's go home.

CHU HAISHENG
(pushing her hand away)
Almost done.

He reaches for a loose stone slab to brace himself. It shifts. The pile above groans.

HOU WANYU
Old man—

The slab slides. He falls. Stones follow. Not an avalanche—just enough. One heavy stone catches his chest.

HOU WANYU
(screaming, but quiet)
Ah!

She scrambles, moving stones with her hands. Finds his phone in his pocket. Still on the call log—"Son." 11:47 PM. Three minutes ago.

INT. HOSPITAL OUTSIDE OPERATING ROOM - DAY

CHU HAISHENG is wheeled past, an oxygen mask on his face. HOU WANYU waits. Hours pass. She sits against the wall, phone in hand.

A DOCTOR emerges. Shakes his head.

HOU WANYU nods. She dials.

INT. LUXURY RESTAURANT - DAY

CHU TIANYU steps outside. The banquet roars behind him.

CHU TIANYU
Mom? The transfer—did it go through?

HOU WANYU
(cutting him off, voice hollow)
Your father died five hours ago. Crushed. While you were drinking 120,000 yuan wine.

Silence. AN JIANGUO's voice calls from inside.

AN JIANGUO
Tianyu! They're asking about the wine!

CHU TIANYU
(whisper)
Mom, I...

HOU WANYU
(softly)
He kept your photo. In his helmet. Said you built this city.

She hangs up.

Tianyu stares at the phone. Opens his banking app. The transfer to his mother is still pending. He opens messages—his father, yesterday: "Son, are you eating well? Mom made soup."

He tries to type. Can't. There's a roar from the banquet—laughter, toasts. He looks at the restaurant's festive lanterns, then at his reflection in the dark window. A man who cannot go in, and cannot leave.

FADE OUT.

title: The Twin Plant Secret
description: A desperate man seeks a cursed medicine from a spectral innkeeper who harvests pain as payment, while pursued by the sorcerer who annihilated his clan.
context:
Title: The Twin Plant Secret
Description: A desperate man seeks a cursed medicine from a spectral innkeeper who harvests pain as payment, while pursued by the sorcerer who annihilated his clan.

INT. INN - NIGHT

A woman in embroidered silk robes (FEMALE INNKEEPER) fans herself with a crimson peacock feather fan. Between them, a metal cage holds a withered plant with twin stems.

A man (MAN) lies slumped, blood at his mouth, leg shattered. He smashes the cage against his wound.

MAN
(screaming into his sleeve)
Ahhh!

The Twin Plant's veins glow, absorbing blood. One stem unfurls a pale leaf.

FEMALE INNKEEPER
(smiling slightly)
The Feng clan's heir. Still so... thorough.

MAN
(gasping)
For my sister... what's one leg?

FEMALE INNKEEPER
From the looks of it, this isn't just about seeing her.

MAN
(through gritted teeth)
When the fruit blooms... I'll have the power. Power to kill you, Grand Sorcerer. For my clan.

The FEMALE INNKEEPER's fan stills. Sadness flickers across her face.

FEMALE INNKEEPER
(quietly)
Vengeance is a thirst the plant can't quench.

MAN
(weakly)
The medicine... can you give it to me now?

FEMALE INNKEEPER
That depends on whether they agree.

MAN
Who?

An invisible force strikes the MAN down. He coughs blood.

VOICE (O.S.)
Save us!

FEMALE INNKEEPER
Those who enter my Spirit Refuge are all exchange guests. Since they came for me, how could I stand by and do nothing?
continuation:
EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

Two figures in black robes race through moonlit cypress, swords humming with dark sigils.

INT. INN - CONTINUOUS

The two BLACK-ROBED FIGURES burst through paper doors, blades at the FEMALE INNKEEPER's neck. She calmly sips wine. The Twin Plant pulses behind her.

BLACK-ROBED FIGURE 1
We saw him come here. Sorcerer wants the Feng bloodline.

FEMALE INNKEEPER
Guests pay in coin or ki. You've brought neither.

Her eyes turn sharp. The phoenix tattoo on her shoulder glows. Crimson memory-threads surge from her body, entangling the figures. Their blades rust to dust.

BLACK-ROBED FIGURE 1
(terrified)
Spirit Weaver!

The threads pierce their armor, showing flickers: these men burning Feng scrolls, killing children. The plant drinks their agony.

BLACK-ROBED FIGURES
(screaming)
Ahhh!

FEMALE INNKEEPER
(whispering to the air)
Harming the loyal, aiding tyrants. Today I'll take your lives to honor the righteous!

The red energy consumes them. They collapse. The MAN watches, shocked.

BLACK-ROBED FIGURES
(pleading from the ground)
Save us, Grand Sorcerer!

A translucent white-haired man (GRAND SORCERER) appears. He absorbs the figures as black smoke into his phantom form.

FEMALE INNKEEPER
They were your men.

GRAND SORCERER
Those who fail have only one fate: death.

FEMALE INNKEEPER
You dare send a projection to my inn?

GRAND SORCERER
Sooner or later, I will claim you. But him...

The GRAND SORCERER's phantom hand grasps the MAN's throat, pulling him.

GRAND SORCERER
The Twin Plant's fruit is mine by pact. You know this.

FEMALE INNKEEPER
In my Refuge, only the house law binds.

She transforms into a blue firebird, diving at the SORCERER. He strikes; she twists. His palm blast shatters a pillar. The MAN is caught in the wave, slamming into the wall.

The two battle. Tables and chairs overturn. The MAN lies on the ground, his reopened blood streaming toward the plant. The second stem blooms silver.

The GRAND SORCERER strikes toward the FEMALE INNKEEPER. She dodges; the force hits the MAN.

The silver fruit hangs between them, pulsing. The SORCERER flickers, weakening.

GRAND SORCERER
(vanishing)
The fruit ripens. But can you harvest it before I return... in flesh?

The MAN crawls toward the plant, hand outstretched.

FADE OUT.
