context:
Title: The Duke's Manor Tutorial Class
Description: A 21st-century doctor transmigrates into a book as an unloved young lady, marries a dead man to become the most powerful person in the Duke's Manor, and gains three stepchildren.

EXT. ANCIENT STREET - DAY

The sound of suona horns and gongs and drums fills the air. A lively ancient wedding procession moves through the street. At the front, someone carries a large red placard with the double happiness character.

LU CHU (V.O.)
I was a traditional Chinese medicine doctor in the 21st century. Not only did I transmigrate into a book as an unloved young lady of the Minister's Manor, but my vicious stepmother planned to sell me to a disgusting old merchant. So I found a loophole: the Duke's heir, reported dead at the border. A posthumous marriage to a hero—widowhood, wealth, and freedom. The perfect tutorial run.

The camera turns to the bride LU CHU sitting in the sedan chair. She wears a gorgeous green wedding dress and a phoenix crown. She weighs a gold ingot in her hand, her eyes determined. She touches three small protective amulets in her sleeve.

LU CHU (V.O.)
Three stepchildren. Three bosses with trust issues according to the novel's forums. But I've studied every child psychology text I could download. I'm ready.

LU CHU's lips curl into a satisfied smile that falters for just a moment.

EXT. STREET - DAY

A man wearing a half gold mask, GU CI, comes galloping on a fast horse. The horse rears up in front of the wedding procession, its front hooves rising high as it neighs. The sedan chair shakes violently, and LU CHU screams as she falls out.

GU CI leaps from his horse, catches LU CHU in mid-air, and spins to the ground while holding her. His mask shifts, revealing a scarred jawline.

LU CHU (V.O.)
That jawline... I've seen it in the portrait gallery. But he's supposed to be—

GU CI
(voice rough, holding her tighter than necessary)
The dead man you married. Surprised, Madam?

QING ZHI
Miss!

LU CHU suddenly snaps back to reality and awkwardly breaks free from GU CI's embrace, her medical instinct already assessing his injuries.

QING ZHI
Are you alright?

LU CHU
(to GU CI)
My apologies, my lord. I was told you were... otherwise occupied.

LU CHU stuffs a box of pastries into GU CI's hands, her fingers briefly pressing against his palm.

LU CHU
For your trouble.

LU CHU hurriedly leaves, pulling her maid QING ZHI with her. GU CI holds the pastries, watching her retreating figure. He looks down and sees a pink embroidered pouch on the ground—one of the amulets. He bends down to pick it up and examines it. His name is stitched inside in tiny characters.

GU CI (V.O.)
She came prepared. But preparation and survival are different lessons.
continuation:
INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - NIGHT

Red candles flicker in the room, decorated festively. The Duke's wife XU LAN and Duke GU YANGDE stand before the bed. LU CHU sits on the bed covered with a red veil. XU LAN's hands tremble as she extends the household keys.

XU LAN
Xiao Chu... A Ci's death broke us. This arrangement was our last resort. These keys—they're not just authority. They're three children's hearts.

LU CHU
(voice soft, genuine)
Mother, I didn't come here to replace your son. I came here because children shouldn't lose everything.

A beat. XU LAN's expression shifts, seeing something unexpected in the girl.

XU LAN
The steward will assist you. But the children... they've built walls. Don't expect gratitude.

LU CHU
I expect work. That's different.

XU LAN and GU YANGDE exchange a weighted glance, then turn to leave. GU YANGDE pauses, his hand on the door.

GU YANGDE
The clay pot. They made it for you. Be... careful.

The door closes. LU CHU throws off the veil and exhaes sharply, the confident mask slipping to reveal panic.

LU CHU (V.O.)
Okay. The husband's alive. Tutorial mode: shattered. Three children, one pot, zero clue what's inside.

LU CHU forces herself to breathe, straightens her shoulders, and sits at the table. Maids enter carrying dishes.

QING ZHI
Madam, the Duke's Manor has excellent food. Please try some.

LU CHU picks up her chopsticks and tastes a dish.

LU CHU
Mm. Excessive oil, but sophisticated spice. Not Drunken Fragrance standards, but salvageable.

LU CHU's gaze falls on a black clay pot. She notices the lid is slightly askew—traces of small fingerprints in the soot.

LU CHU
What dish is this?

Outside the door, three children are secretly peeking in. The oldest, about ten, holds a slingshot. The middle one clutches a wooden sword. The youngest girl sucks her thumb. All three watch with a mixture of defiance and desperate hope.

LU CHU's fingers hover over the clay pot lid, her medical training catching the scent—something medicinal, something intentional. Her expression changes from curiosity to professional concern.

FADE OUT.

title: Return of the National Hero
description: A brilliant scientist who faked his death to work on secret military projects receives a desperate call from his daughter after successfully testing a revolutionary hypersonic missile.
context:
Title: Return of the National Hero
Description: A brilliant scientist who faked his death to work on secret military projects receives a desperate call from his daughter after successfully testing a revolutionary hypersonic missile.

INT. SPACE COMMAND CENTER - DAY

A circular command hall humming with quiet intensity. At the center, a ring-shaped console where TECHNICIANS monitor streams of data. A massive curved screen displays telemetry from an orbital test platform.

LIN TIAN (40s, composed, faint shadows under his eyes) stands with ZHANG SHOU (military liaison, mid-30s) and the DIRECTOR OF TIANGONG BUREAU (50s, crisp suit) behind the console, watching in tense silence.

LIN TIAN
(quietly)
Orbital platform ready. Initiate Project Tathagata test sequence.

TECHNICIAN A
(into headset)
All stations, confirm status.

TECHNICIAN B
Environmental green. Thrusters primed. Guidance locked.

TECHNICIAN C
Trajectory calculated. Re-entry window confirmed.

LIN TIAN
(to Director)
Once we verify the glide vehicle's control surfaces, we'll have a deployable system.

The Director nods, fingertips drumming the console edge.

LIN TIAN
 ignition in three...

The screen shows a sleek vehicle detaching from the orbital platform, its heat shield glowing as it bites atmosphere.

TECHNICIAN B
Ignition confirmed. Hypersonic transition... now.

The telemetry shows velocity climbing rapidly. Trajectory curves across the Pacific.

TECHNICIAN A
Mach 15... Mach 20... Atmospheric skip trajectory stable.

ZHANG SHOU
(under his breath)
Come on...

TECHNICIAN C
Terminal phase initiated. Glide vehicle responding.

The screen switches to a remote camera feed—an uninhabited atoll in the distance. The vehicle streaks down like a falling star.

TECHNICIAN B
Impact in five... four...

A silent flash blossoms on the screen. The fireball is precise, contained. The command center releases its collective breath—

—then focused applause breaks out, restrained but genuine.

TECHNICIAN A
Direct hit. Impact deviation: less than three meters.

DIRECTOR OF TIANGONG BUREAU
(to Lin Tian, voice low)
Operational range?
continuation:
LIN TIAN
Anywhere on Earth within thirty minutes. Undetectable until terminal phase.

The Director's composure cracks—just barely. He squeezes Lin Tian's shoulder.

DIRECTOR OF TIANGONG BUREAU
Seven years, Commander. You've given us something... decisive.

A communication officer approaches with a tablet.

COMMUNICATION OFFICER
Sir. Five diplomatic channels requesting urgent consultation. State Department, Defense Ministry...

He glances at the tablet.

COMMUNICATION OFFICER
...and three allied nations offering cooperative research frameworks.

ZHANG SHOU
(a thin smile)
They're not demanding anything. They're asking.

LIN TIAN
(studying the telemetry)
The technology stabilizes the strategic balance. That's all that matters.

The Director gestures to the nearby seating area—modest, functional.

DIRECTOR OF TIANGONG BUREAU
Let's debrief. Then you take the leave you've been refusing.

They move toward the chairs. Lin Tian's steps are measured, but his hand strays to his pocket—instinctively, then catches himself. He sits.

The others settle, opening tablets. Lin Tian's phone—an older model, screen showing zero bars for years—suddenly vibrates. Once. Twice.

His body goes still. The Director is speaking, but the sound recedes.

Lin Tian stares at the device in his palm. The number is unknown. Area code from a city he left behind.

ZHANG SHOU
(noticing)
Commander Lin?

Lin Tian's thumb hovers. He answers.

FEMALE VOICE (O.S.)
(broken, whispering)
Dad... it's Meiying. They took Mom. They said you owe them seven years.

Lin Tian's face drains of color. The tablet in his other hand slips—

—he catches it, but his knuckles are white.

ZHANG SHOU
Commander?

Lin Tian stands. The room watches him.

LIN TIAN
(to the Director)
I need to take this.

He walks toward the exit, phone pressed to his ear, leaving silence behind him.

END SCENE

title: After Ten Years as a Backup, I Leave and She Cries
description: A wealthy heir is betrayed by the woman he loved for seven years, who conspired with her lover to destroy his family. After being killed, he is reborn to the day before their wedding.
context:
Title: After Ten Years as a Backup, I Leave and She Cries
Description: A wealthy heir is betrayed by the woman he loved for seven years, who conspired with her lover to destroy his family. After being killed, he is reborn to the day before their wedding.

INT. STREET - NIGHT

JIANG RAN, once-proud features now hollowed by hunger, claws open a red trash bin.

He extracts a steamed bun in a dirty plastic bag.

Sinking against a tree, he devours it with animal desperation.

A black sedan glides to a silent stop. ZHANG MUQING emerges, three BODYGUARDS flanking him. He opens the rear door.

LIU QING'AN steps out, white satin gown gleaming under streetlights. A diamond necklace—Jiang Ran's first anniversary gift—sparkles at her throat.

They approach. Jiang Ran's hand tightens on the bun.

ZHANG MUQING
The great Young Master Jiang. Scavenging for scraps.

JIANG RAN
(eyes on the necklace)
Qing'an...

LIU QING'AN
Don't. Don't look at me like you still own me.

ZHANG MUQING
He never owned you. He purchased you.

LIU QING'AN
(to Jiang Ran)
That ten-million bride price. The contract that saved my father's company. Did you really think that bought love?

JIANG RAN
(shaken)
You said... you needed time. I waited two years.

LIU QING'AN
Two years of playing the grateful wife while you played the generous husband. How convenient.

She kicks the bun from his hand. It rolls into the gutter.

LIU QING'AN
Every time you touched me, I thought of him. Every time you called me "Mrs. Jiang," I counted the days until I could make you pay for forcing me to betray him.

ZHANG MUQING
We didn't come for sentiment.

LIU QING'AN
No. We came to collect.

The bodyguards seize Jiang Ran's arms, forcing him to his knees.
continuation:
JIANG RAN
(struggling)
The Jiang Group fed your family when you were starving! I funded your patents, Muqing—your entire startup was built on my investment!

ZHANG MUQING
That wasn't investment. That was tribute.

Jiang Ran struggles. A bodyguard twists his arm—sickening CRACK.

JIANG RAN
(screaming)
Qing'an! Seven years—I loved you for seven years!

LIU QING'AN
(icy)
And I hated you for every single day.

She produces a USB drive.

LIU QING'AN
The files from your computer. The bidding documents. All me, Jiang Ran. While you slept, I built our future.

She drops the drive on his trembling body.

LIU QING'AN
Break his hands first. Then his legs. I want him to crawl when he sees our wedding photos.

Jiang Ran explodes with desperate strength, breaking free. He sprints—

Onto the road. A delivery truck BLARES its horn—

Impact. Jiang Ran crumples. Blood pools.

A WOMAN IN WHITE (30s, severe business suit) rushes from a building entrance.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(pressing his wound)
Jiang Ran! Stay with me!

His vision fades on her anguished face.

INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - DAY

Jiang Ran GASPS awake. Drenched in sweat.

He stares at his hands—clean, uncalloused. A gold Patek Philippe on his wrist.

On the laptop: a news broadcast. "Haicheng Financial Daily - October 25, 2017."

His phone BUZZES. A message from "Qing'an": "Tomorrow, my love. Can't wait to be Mrs. Jiang."

Jiang Ran touches his chest—no wound. He looks at the date again.

A slow, cold smile forms.

title: Reborn Heiress Seeks Revenge
description: After dying in a car accident orchestrated by her father and his mistress, a young woman is given a chance to return by a mysterious resurrection system to seek vengeance.
context:
Title: Reborn Heiress Seeks Revenge
Description: After dying in a car accident orchestrated by her father and his mistress, a young woman is given a chance to return by a mysterious resurrection system to seek vengeance.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

A young man clutches the unconscious WEN YAN (22) against his chest, sprinting through fluorescent-lit corridors. His dress shirt is soaked crimson. Nurses scramble.

YOUNG MAN
Doctor! She's crashing!

CLOSE-UP - WEN YAN's face: blood trickles from her temple, her lips parted in a silent gasp.

YOUNG MAN (V.O.)
(whispered, desperate)
Not like this. Not you too.

INT. PURE WHITE SPACE - DAY

WEN YAN lies on a seamless white platform, her hospital gown pristine. She jolts awake, gasping. No wound. No pain. Just endless white.

She touches her temple—finds only smooth skin.

WEN YAN (V.O.)
Mom... the brakes...

WEN YAN
(looking around, disoriented)
Hello?

A FIGURE materializes—TWELVE, wearing a featureless white suit, his face obscured by a shifting digital mask.

TWELVE
(hostile detected)

WEN YAN
What is this place?

TWELVE
A threshold. You're dead, Wen Yan. Three minutes ago, clinically. Your mother's been gone for seven.

WEN YAN
(staggering to her feet)
No. We were just in the car...

TWELVE
Your father's Mercedes T-boned you at the intersection. He'd cut your brake lines. The same accident is being reported as a tragic loss—mother and daughter—leaving him sole heir.

Wen Yan's breath hitches. She doesn't cry—yet. She goes very still.

WEN YAN
(quiet, dangerous)
Liang Mei.

TWELVE
And her children. Your stepbrother now runs Wen Corporation. Your stepsister is auctioning your mother's art collection tonight.

A tremor runs through Wen Yan's hands. She clenches them into fists.

WEN YAN
Then send me back.

TWELVE
I can't. You're legally deceased. Court approved. Burial plot selected.

WEN YAN
(frustrated)
continuation:
You're a resurrection system. Find a loophole.

TWELVE
Exactly. I don't resurrect bodies. I transplant consciousness. A new host. Someone recently deceased. Someone with access.

WEN YAN
(access?)

TWELVE
Liang Mei's daughter. Liang Xue'er. Overdose. Thirty minutes ago. They haven't found her body yet.

WEN YAN
(eyes narrowing)
Her daughter...

TWELVE
Host compatibility: 97%. Her social circle puts you at the auction tonight. At your father's side. But there's a cost.

WEN YAN
Anything.

TWELVE
You inherit her memories. Her guilt. Her addiction. The system suppresses it, but it's there. And if you fail—if they discover you—true death. For both of us.

Wen Yan looks down at her hands. They shimmer, becoming translucent.

WEN YAN
(softly)
Mom wanted me to live.

She looks up, and for the first time, her eyes are dry. Clear. Focused.

WEN YAN
Let's make them pay for both of us.

TWELVE
Transfer initiating. Don't forget—I'm in your head now. Your only ally.

Twelve's mask dissolves into a cascade of code that swirls around Wen Yan. The white space fractures.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY [MEMORY]

Wen Yan's POV: The young man from before—her fiancé, SHENG—holding her dying body. His tears fall on her face.

SHENG (V.O.)
I'll find who did this. I swear.

The memory shatters. The white space implodes.

Title: Reborn Heiress Seeks Revenge
Description: After dying in a car accident orchestrated by her father and his mistress, a young woman is given a chance to return by a mysterious resurrection system to seek vengeance.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

A young man clutches the unconscious WEN YAN (22) against his chest, sprinting through fluorescent-lit corridors. His dress shirt is soaked crimson. Nurses scramble.

YOUNG MAN
Doctor! She's crashing!

CLOSE-UP - WEN YAN's face: blood trickles from her temple, her lips parted in a silent gasp.

YOUNG MAN (V.O.)
(whispered, desperate)
Not like this. Not you too.

INT. PURE WHITE SPACE - DAY

WEN YAN lies on a seamless white platform, her hospital gown pristine. She jolts awake, gasping. No wound. No pain. Just endless white.

She touches her temple—finds only smooth skin.

WEN YAN (V.O.)
Mom... the brakes...

WEN YAN
(looking around, disoriented)
Hello?

A FIGURE materializes—TWELVE, wearing a featureless white suit, his face obscured by a shifting digital mask.

TWELVE
(hostile detected)

WEN YAN
What is this place?

TWELVE
A threshold. You're dead, Wen Yan. Three minutes ago, clinically. Your mother's been gone for seven.

WEN YAN
(staggering to her feet)
No. We were just in the car...

TWELVE
Your father's Mercedes T-boned you at the intersection. He'd cut your brake lines. The same accident is being reported as a tragic loss—mother and daughter—leaving him sole heir.

Wen Yan's breath hitches. She doesn't cry—yet. She goes very still.

WEN YAN
(quiet, dangerous)
Liang Mei.

TWELVE
And her children. Your stepbrother now runs Wen Corporation. Your stepsister is auctioning your mother's art collection tonight.

A tremor runs through Wen Yan's hands. She clenches them into fists.

WEN YAN
Then send me back.

TWELVE
I can't. You're legally deceased. Court approved. Burial plot selected.

WEN YAN
(frustrated)
You're a resurrection system. Find a loophole.

TWELVE
Exactly. I don't resurrect bodies. I transplant consciousness. A new host. Someone recently deceased. Someone with access.

WEN YAN
(access?)

TWELVE
Liang Mei's daughter. Liang Xue'er. Overdose. Thirty minutes ago. They haven't found her body yet.

WEN YAN
(eyes narrowing)
Her daughter...

TWELVE
Host compatibility: 97%. Her social circle puts you at the auction tonight. At your father's side. But there's a cost.

WEN YAN
Anything.

TWELVE
You inherit her memories. Her guilt. Her addiction. The system suppresses it, but it's there. And if you fail—if they discover you—true death. For both of us.

Wen Yan looks down at her hands. They shimmer, becoming translucent.

WEN YAN
(softly)
Mom wanted me to live.

She looks up, and for the first time, her eyes are dry. Clear. Focused.

WEN YAN
Let's make them pay for both of us.

TWELVE
Transfer initiating. Don't forget—I'm in your head now. Your only ally.

Twelve's mask dissolves into a cascade of code that swirls around Wen Yan. The white space fractures.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY [MEMORY]

Wen Yan's POV: The young man from before—her fiancé, SHENG—holding her dying body. His tears fall on her face.

SHENG (V.O.)
I'll find who did this. I swear.

The memory shatters. The white space implodes.

(holding back panic)
Mom... give me strength.

(to herself, testing the voice)
Time for introductions.

She smiles. It's Liang Xue'er's smile. But the hatred behind it is pure Wen Yan.

FADE OUT.

title: Summer's Embers & A Kiss
description: On the second anniversary of her mother's death, Qin Yingxia returns home to find her father with a pregnant woman, sparking a painful confrontation that leads to a fateful encounter with Jin Zhuo in the rain.
context:
Title: Summer's Embers & A Kiss
Description: On the second anniversary of her mother's death, Qin Yingxia returns home to find her father with a pregnant woman, sparking a painful confrontation that leads to a fateful encounter with Jin Zhuo in the rain.

INT. QIN FAMILY VILLA - DAY

QIN SHAN stands with HUANG LI in the sunlit foyer, his hand resting on her visible pregnancy. The late afternoon light catches the framed photograph of Qin's mother still hanging on the wall behind them.

Outside, the first drops of rain begin to fall. QIN YINGXIA, drenched in her school uniform, stops dead in the doorway. Her backpack slides from her shoulder.

QIN SHAN
Yingying. This is—

QIN YINGXIA
(eyes on the photograph)
Today is her day.

HUANG LI
(softly)
I know this is difficult—

QIN YINGXIA
(turns to her father)
You moved her ceramic bowls to the storage room. But you kept her willow pattern tea set. For guests?

QIN SHAN
(defensive)
Your Auntie Huang is family now.

QIN YINGXIA
Family doesn't erase family.

She spins toward the door, her wet shoes squeaking against the marble.

QIN SHAN
Yingxia! Come back here—

The door slams shut behind her.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

Rain sheets down in silver curtains. QIN YINGXIA pedals furiously, her backpack abandoned as a useless shield. She skids through a puddle, the bike wobbles, and she goes down hard on the asphalt.

A pair of worn school shoes enters her frame. A hand extends—not pristine, with ink stains on the fingers.

She stares at the hand, then up at JIN ZHUO, rain plastering his uniform to his shoulders. His expression is neither pity nor curiosity, but assessment.

She takes his hand. It's warmer than she expects.

QIN YINGXIA (V.O.)
That was the first time anyone looked at me and saw something more than grief.

INT. TAXI - DAY

One year later. QIN YINGXIA's head rests against the window, fingers tracing condensation patterns. The university gates blur past in fragments. She jolts awake as the car stops.

DRIVER
Miss? Imperial Capital University.

She blinks, rubbing sleep from her eyes, and pays without meeting his gaze in the mirror. Her thumb brushes the worn strap of her backpack.

EXT. IMPERIAL CAPITAL UNIVERSITY ENTRANCE - DAY

The taxi pulls away. QIN YINGXIA stands with her single suitcase before the chaotic welcome station. Students surge around her like a current.

A MALE STUDENT glances up from his phone, does a double-take.

MALE STUDENT
You're the one. The protestor's daughter who scored perfect math.

The phrase lands like a stone. Students turn, phones emerging.

FEMALE STUDENT A
Can I... get a photo?

FEMALE STUDENT B
My mother wants to know—did you really study eighteen hours a day?

The crowd compresses. QIN YINGXIA stumbles backward over her suitcase. Then—an arm catches her waist, pulling her against a solid frame.

JIN ZHUO's breath is at her ear. He smells of old books and graphite.

JIN ZHUO
(low, familiar)
Still can't watch where you're going?

She whirls around. He holds her steady, his dark eyes holding the same assessment from that rainy afternoon, but softer at the edges now.

QIN YINGXIA
(whisper)
You remembered.

JIN ZHUO
I never forget a good bike crash.

His smile is slight, barely there, but it changes the shape of his entire face.

title: The Concubine Enters, I Remarry and Become Empress
description: On her wedding night, a noblewoman's husband is summoned away by the palace. Three years later, he returns with a concubine and child, forcing her to make a life-changing decision.
context:
Title: The Concubine Enters, I Remarry and Become Empress
Description: On her wedding night, a noblewoman's husband is summoned away by the palace. Three years later, he returns with a concubine and child, forcing her to make a life-changing decision.

INT. WEDDING CHAMBER - NIGHT

A festive wedding chamber with red candles flickering.

PEI XUAN and YUN QING wear bright red wedding attire, sitting across from each other. Exquisite wine vessels are placed on the table.

PEI XUAN pours wine for YUN QING, his hands trembling slightly.

PEI XUAN
The Yongning Marquis Manor could have allied with any noble house. Yet you chose... us.

YUN QING watches him, her smile gentle but measured.

YUN QING
I chose you.

PEI XUAN meets her eyes, his voice low and sincere.

PEI XUAN
Then I will spend my life proving you right.

They raise their cups. The moment stretches—

Pounding erupts at the door.

MAID (O.S.)
Young Master! Urgent summons!

A MAID bursts in, breathless.

MAID
The Northern Border dispatch—General Pei is ordered to Ye City immediately!

PEI XUAN freezes. YUN QING's cup pauses mid-air.

PEI XUAN
(surprised)
Tonight?

MAID
The carriage waits, Young Master.

PEI XUAN turns to YUN QING. He cups her face, trying to memorize it.

PEI XUAN
Wait for me to return.

He kisses her forehead, then hurries out. YUN QING stands alone, the red silk veil slipping from her hair. She looks at the two full cups on the table, perfectly aligned.
continuation:
INT. A ROOM - NIGHT

A SERVANT kneels before a desk where a MAN writes. A small "Pei" embroidered pouch lies beside his brush.

SERVANT
Master, as per your instructions, the Young Master of the Duke of Qingguo's Manor has departed for Ye City.

The MAN's lips curl into a cold smile, his hand tightly clutching the embroidered pouch.

MAN
Three years. Let him remember what he left behind—or forget why he should have.

TITLE CARD: THREE YEARS LATER

INT. ROOM - DAY

YUN QING, in muted grey robes, reviews manor accounts by the window. Her white veil is practical, not decorative. The MAID runs in excitedly.

MAID
Madam! Madam, the Young Master has returned!

YUN QING's brush stills. Ink bleeds onto the page. She carefully sets it down.

YUN QING
Let's go. Return to the manor.

EXT. DUKE OF QINGGUO'S MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

A dust-covered carriage lurches to a stop. SHEN MIAO YUN, holding a baby, descends. PEI XUAN follows, exhaustion etched on his face.

Two MAIDS whisper to each other in the distance.

MAID A
Did you see? The Young Master actually brought back a woman.

MAID B
I also heard a child crying. Could they have bypassed Madam and directly produced an illegitimate eldest son?

MAID A
If that's true, Madam is truly pitiful.

MAID B
She is the legitimate daughter of a Marquis Manor, yet now she's being treated and humiliated like this. How can she maintain her position in the manor from now on?

YUN QING and her MAID happen to arrive at the manor entrance and overhear their conversation.

MAID
(anxiously)
Miss, this servant doesn't believe the Young Master would cast aside his wife and remarry. Don't believe these slanderous words.

YUN QING looks at the happy trio in the distance, her eyes dimming.

YUN QING
Whether it's slander or not, we'll know once we return.

YUN QING's jaw tightens. She turns sharply—her foot catches on a loose stone.

A hand catches her elbow. XIAO LANG, in weather-stained travel robes, steadies her.

XIAO LANG
Be careful, Miss.

YUN QING steadies herself and nods slightly.

YUN QING
Thank you, sir.

MAID
Miss, we should return to the manor.

YUN QING takes one last look in PEI XUAN's direction, then resolutely follows her MAID away.

XIAO LANG stands in place, watching YUN QING's departing figure. Then he slowly turns his head, his eyes beneath the conical hat becoming cold and sharp, gazing toward PEI XUAN.

XIAO LANG (V.O.)
Pei Xuan, I gave you a chance.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Night Banquet
description: A woman undergoes facial reconstruction surgery after a car crash that killed her family, and agrees to work undercover for the mysterious man who saved her life.
context:
Title: Night Banquet
Description: A woman undergoes facial reconstruction surgery after a car crash that killed her family, and agrees to work undercover for the mysterious man who saved her life.

INT. OPERATING ROOM/RECOVERY ROOM - NIGHT

CLOSE UP on a woman's face, wrapped in bandages. Her hands slowly and carefully begin to unwrap the gauze.

Her new face is revealed. She is FANG XINYAN. She stares at her reflection in a mirror, her expression a mix of awe, sadness, and uncertainty.

FANG XINYAN (V.O.)
Who is this stranger in the mirror?

A man, JIANG YICHUAN, appears behind her, looking at her reflection with a confident smirk.

JIANG YICHUAN
Perfect. You're unrecognizable.

He places a hand on her shoulder, then moves it to her neck, his touch possessive.

JIANG YICHUAN
Ready to repay your debt, Miss Fang?

TITLE CARD: THREE MONTHS AGO

EXT. ROAD - NIGHT

FLASHBACK. A white car drives down a road at night. Inside, a younger FANG XINYAN (wearing glasses) sits with her parents, FATHER and MOTHER. They are laughing and happy.

FANG XINYAN
What should we eat?

MOTHER
(chuckling)
We've barely finished dinner and you're already planning the next meal?

FATHER
These two will eat me out of house and home.

MOTHER
Your figure is already perfect. Don't worry.

FATHER
Alright. Surprise us, then.

MOTHER
Mm, okay.

Suddenly, the bright headlights of a large truck fill the screen. The sound of a LOUD HORN and SCREECHING TIRES.

QUICK CUTS of the car crash. The car flips over violently.
continuation:
EXT. CRASH SITE - NIGHT

The white car lies upside down on the road, heavily damaged. Inside, Fang Xinyan's parents are bloody and motionless.

Fang Xinyan, bleeding from her head, crawls out from the wreckage. She is weak and disoriented.

A figure wearing a GUY FAWKES MASK and dark clothing approaches. He steps on shattered glass, the sound crunching under his boot.

The MASKED MAN crouches down, looking at the barely conscious Fang Xinyan. He pulls out a lighter.

MASKED MAN
One left. Let's finish this.

He flicks the lighter open, igniting a trail of gasoline on the ground. The flames race towards Fang Xinyan.

FANG XINYAN
(weakly)
Why them... why...

The Masked Man stands up and walks away as the fire closes in.

Suddenly, rain begins to pour down, extinguishing the flames just before they reach Fang Xinyan. A figure holding a large black umbrella appears through the rain and smoke. It's JIANG YICHUAN.

Fang Xinyan sees him. With her last bit of strength, she reaches a bloody hand towards him.

FANG XINYAN
Please... they killed them...

Jiang Yichuan looks down at her, his expression unreadable. He reaches down and takes her hand.

BACK TO PRESENT

INT. RECOVERY ROOM - NIGHT

Jiang Yichuan stands behind Fang Xinyan, his hand still on her neck. Her expression hardens into something sharp and purposeful.

FANG XINYAN
You find the man in the mask. I'll be whoever you need.

JIANG YICHUAN
(smiles)
Good.

He turns her to face him, gripping her chin, forcing her to look at him.

JIANG YICHUAN
Miss Fang, your first mission... infiltrate the Zhou family.

He stares intensely into her eyes. She stares back, resolute.

END SCENE

Title: Strength Works Miracles (Episode 57)
Description: A young martial artist with incredible power accidentally destroys her master's prized fish pond and must go down the mountain to earn money for compensation, only to save a CEO who tore up their arranged marriage contract.

EXT. LAKESIDE - DAY

ZHUGE DALI, a young girl in simple practice clothes, squats by the lake, jabbing her bamboo fishing pole at the water like it's a training dummy.

ZHUGE DALI
Master said one fish. That's all.

Her stomach GROWLS. She clutches it, then her eyes brighten with recognition.

ZHUGE DALI
Oh. Right.

She leaps up, assumes a stance, and executes a kata among the fallen leaves. Energy concentrates in her palms. Air currents whip around her.

EXT. TRAINING GROUND - DAY

ZHUGE IMMORTAL, elderly with white hair and beard, dozes in a hand-carved rocking chair surrounded by DISCIPLES flowing through forms.

A low RUMBLE builds. The disciples freeze. The rocking chair flips, dumping Zhuge Immortal onto the flagstones.

ZHUGE IMMORTAL
(roaring)
DALIII!

EXT. LAKESIDE - DAY

Fish flop across the grass, gasping. ZHUGE DALI scoops them into her basket, proud.

ZHUGE DALI
Efficiency. That's what Master preaches.

She looks up as ZHUGE IMMORTAL storms over with eldest disciple ZHUGE QING.

ZHUGE DALI
(excitedly)
Master! Senior Brother! Dinner's—

She trails off, seeing their faces.

ZHUGE IMMORTAL
(staring at the empty pond, voice cracking)
My spirit-gathering fish. Twenty years of alchemical feed. Gone.

ZHUGE QING
Junior Sister, this pond cost Master everything.

ZHUGE IMMORTAL
(pointing a trembling finger)
Eighty-eight million, eight hundred eighty-eight thousand, eight hundred eighty-eight yuan and eighty-eight cents. Every fen.

ZHUGE DALI
(nervous now)
That's... very exact.

ZHUGE IMMORTAL
Off the mountain. Don't return without it.

ZHUGE DALI
But Master, my cousin Pei Weiwei's wedding—

She fumbles out a red invitation.

ZHUGE DALI
She's marrying into the Fu family. Cloud City's richest. I could—

ZHUGE IMMORTAL
Then go! But you pay every fen yourself.

ZHUGE DALI
(quiet, serious)
Fine. I'll earn it.

She shoulders her bundle and leaves without looking back.
continuation:
EXT. ZHUGE VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

ASSISTANT SHEN in a suit argues with a VILLAGER.

VILLAGER
Zhuge Village doesn't welcome outsiders.

FU YUCHENG, handsome and cold, steps from a black luxury car.

ASSISTANT SHEN
Young Master, Zhuge Immortal refuses to see you. Must you personally reject this marriage contract?

FU YUCHENG
Give it to me.

Assistant Shen hands over a red marriage scroll. The paper shimmers faintly. Fu Yucheng's fingers hesitate a fraction—then he tears it. Thunder CRACKS. The air DISTORTS.

ASSISTANT SHEN
(terrified)
The contract was sealed by blood oath!

FU YUCHENG
Superstition.

He reaches for the car door. His hand sticks. The engine ROARS to life.

FU YUCHENG
What—

The car lurches forward, dragging him. He fights to keep his feet.

ASSISTANT SHEN
(chasing)
Young Master! The cliff!

FU YUCHENG
(shouting)
I can't let go! The handle—

The car speeds toward the edge. Fu Yucheng hangs on, desperate.

ZHUGE DALI, leaving the village, sees this. She launches into the air like a projectile.

She slams into Fu Yucheng, the impact ripping him free. They tumble across the dirt as the car sails over the cliff behind them.

They roll to a stop. Dali lands hard on her back, winded. Fu Yucheng stares up at the sky, stunned.

ASSISTANT SHEN
(catching up)
Young Master!

FU YUCHENG
(sitting up, looking at his freed hand, then at Dali)
Who—

ZHUGE DALI
(interrupting, sitting up painfully)
You're the Fu family heir, right?

She pulls out the torn invitation.

ZHUGE DALI
Your fiancée's cousin. I'm here to collect a debt.

title: The Abstinent Uncle Knows How to Flirt
description: A young woman who suffered abuse from her adoptive parents is drugged and sent to a village chief's son, but escapes by jumping from a window, landing on a luxury car belonging to a mysterious man who saves her.
context:
Title: The Abstinent Uncle Knows How to Flirt
Description: A young woman who suffered abuse from her adoptive parents is drugged and sent to a village chief's son, but escapes by jumping from a window, landing on a luxury car belonging to a mysterious man who saves her.

EXT. OUTSIDE BUILDING - NIGHT

SU MINGYUE (20s, bruised but defiant) teeters on a third-floor balcony ledge. Below, a black sedan glides silently into view. She calculates the distance, takes a ragged breath, and jumps.

TITLE CARD: ONE YEAR LATER

EXT. PARK - DAY

SU MINGYUE and FU JINGQI (late 30s, tailored suit, distant gaze) walk through cherry blossoms. His fingers brush hers—deliberate, then he pulls away.

SU MINGYUE (V.O.)
Desperation has a sound. Mine was shattering glass and screeching metal. His was silence.

Fu Jingqi stops, studies her face like a puzzle. He leans in, hesitates, then cups her cheek with a restraint that costs him.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

ONE YEAR AGO. Su Mingyue awakens on a stained mattress. Her fingers find needle marks on her arm.

SU MINGYUE (V.O.)
I turned eighteen at midnight. By 1 AM, my adoptive parents sold me to a predator.

ZHOU DABAO (30s, feral grin) looms over her. She grabs a lamp, smashes it against his temple. He howls.

ZHOU DABAO
(bit bleeding)
Bitch! I'll break your—

She's already vaulting through the window, glass shredding her palms.

EXT. OUTSIDE BUILDING - NIGHT

Su Mingyue lands on the sedan's sunroof—CRACK! She rolls, absorbs the impact with a gymnast's reflex, and collapses on the pavement.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

LIN WEIYUAN (40s, driver) slams the brakes.

LIN WEIYUAN
Master Qi—she fell from the sky.

FU JINGQI (O.S.)
(icy calm)
Check the car. Then the girl.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Su Mingyue crawls to the tinted window, leaving bloody handprints. She pounds weakly.

SU MINGYUE
Please... sir. I need—

The window lowers. Fu Jingqi's eyes assess her without emotion. He steps out, his presence a wall of controlled power.

SU MINGYUE
You're... you're not like them. Please.

She clutches his sleeve. He doesn't recoil—observes her grip like a data point.

Two BODYGUARDS materialize from a follow car. Zhou Dabao charges out, sees Fu Jingqi's cold authority, and freezes. One guard drops him with a precise strike to the throat.

Fu Jingqi supports Su Mingyue's weight, his touch clinical yet oddly gentle.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

Fu Jingqi settles her on the leather seat. Su Mingyue's drugged haze makes her fingers wander to his collar.

FU JINGQI
(batting her hand away)
Don't.

SU MINGYUE
(delerious)
It burns. Please, just... hold me.

FU JINGQI
(to driver)
Hospital.

SU MINGYUE
No! They'll find me. Please...

She kisses his jaw. He goes rigid—abstinence etched in every muscle. He holds her wrists in one hand, radio silence with the other.

FU JINGQI
Change course. Private clinic.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

THREE WEEKS LATER. Su Mingyue stares at the ultrasound report: TWINS. Her knuckles whiten.

DOCTOR (O.S.)
Healthy. Strong heartbeats. Are you sure—

SU MINGYUE
(interrupting)
I can't.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

SU MINGYUE
I want the procedure. Today.

DOCTOR (50s, maternal)
Twins rarely come twice. And you're asking me to—twice. The father?

SU MINGYUE
There is no father.

She slaps cash on the desk. The doctor pushes it back.

DOCTOR
Payment after consultation. Three days. That's policy.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Su Mingyue cradles her stomach, eyes hollow. She turns—

—and walks straight into Fu Jingqi's chest. His hand steadies her elbow, thumb pressing her pulse point.

They freeze. Recognition jolts through them.

SU MINGYUE
(small, broken)
You.

title: The Torn Notice
description: An elder brother sacrifices everything to support his siblings, but jealousy leads to betrayal when university acceptance letters arrive.
context:
Title: The Torn Notice
Description: An elder brother sacrifices everything to support his siblings, but jealousy leads to betrayal when university acceptance letters arrive.

INT. CLINIC - DAY

A DOCTOR examines LI YANG's swollen, callused hand. X-ray films glow on the desk.

DOCTOR
The inflammation is severe. Those tingling sensations you've been ignoring? That's nerve damage. You need proper treatment at the county hospital, or this could become permanent.

LI YANG
(quietly)
How much?

DOCTOR
At least three thousand for the procedure. More for medication.

LI YANG
(staring at his hand)
A box of patches is twenty yuan. I'll take four.

DOCTOR
You can't just—

LI YANG
I'm fine, Doctor. Really.

The DOCTOR reluctantly hands over the patches, watching LI YANG tuck them into his worn jacket. As LI YANG exits, the DOCTOR turns to the NURSE.

DOCTOR
(quietly)
That's the boy who supports his whole family. Works three jobs, they say. Barely twenty.

NURSE
And still found time to take the exams?

The DOCTOR nods grimly.

EXT. STREET - DAY

LI YANG walks, flexing his fingers experimentally. He stops at a notice board, where a local university's scholarship poster catches his eye. He touches it briefly, then keeps walking.
continuation:
EXT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

LI YANG and LI SIYU haul cement bags. LI YUE sits on a crate, pretending to massage his ankle.

LI SIYU
(gasping)
Big brother, your face is pale.

LI YANG
Just dehydrated. Pass me that thermos.

He drains it, his hands trembling slightly. LI YUE watches, a peculiar expression on his face.

LI YUE
(casual)
Hey, I need to check on that job application. Be back in an hour.

LI YANG
You mean the one you already got rejected from?

LI YUE
(defensive)
They said they'd reconsider.

LI YANG says nothing, just nods. LI YUE slinks away.

EXT. ALLEY BEHIND SITE - DAY

LI YUE leans against a wall, scrolling through his phone. A slip of paper is visible in his pocket—an exam results preview. He stares at it, knuckles white.

LI YUE
(quietly)
Eight points. Eight lousy points below him.

A VILLAGE WOMAN hurries past, spots him.

VILLAGE WOMAN
Li Yue! Registered mail at the office. Your whole family's names are on it. I saw Li Yang's too—big university seal!

LI YUE
(frozen)
Both? Together?

VILLAGE WOMAN
Better hurry. They're closing in ten minutes.

She leaves. LI YUE stares at nothing, then begins walking—not toward the office, but away.

EXT. UNDER THE BRIDGE - DAY

LI YUE sits beneath the concrete, both acceptance letters unopened on his lap. His fingers trace LI YANG's name on the thick envelope. He opens his own first—a modest provincial college. He opens Li Yang's—a top-tier university with a full scholarship note visible.

LI YUE
(whispering)
Full ride. Of course. And mine...

His hands shake. He pulls out a worn photograph—three smiling kids in threadbare clothes. His thumb grazes LI YANG's youthful face.

INT. KITCHEN - FLASHBACK - NIGHT

LI YANG stirs congee, tired. LI SIYU (younger) and LI YUE (youngest) sit at the table.

LI SIYU
But you scored highest in your practice tests. You should be the one to—

LI YANG
(cutting her off)
Yue's English is weak. He needs more prep time. I'll work.

LI YUE
(from doorway)
I don't need your charity.

LI YANG
It's not charity. It's family.

BACK TO:

EXT. UNDER THE BRIDGE - DAY

LI YUE stares at the letters, tears streaming down his face. He begins ripping LI YANG's letter—slowly at first, then violently. The scholarship notice flutters down: 50,000 yuan stipend.

LI YUE
(choking)
You wouldn't even need this. You'd find a way. You always do.

LI YANG and LI SIYU's voices echo in the distance.

LI YANG (O.S.)
Ah Yue! The foreman's paying out early!

LI YUE scrambles, stuffing the pieces into his pocket. He stands, wiping his face, forcing a smile.

CLOSE-UP on his pocket. The torn edge of LI YANG's name is visible, stained with tears.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Great Teacher of Daxia
description: A daughter discovers that her father's seemingly delusional claims about being a legendary teacher are actually true when a former village official recognizes him.
context:
Title: The Great Teacher of Daxia
Description: A daughter discovers that her father's seemingly delusional claims about being a legendary teacher are actually true when a former village official recognizes him.

INT. PARK PATH - DAY

MENG RUFANG pushes her father MENG LINGSHAN, who sits in a wheelchair, through the park. Sunlight filters through the leaves, casting dappled shadows.

MENG RUFANG (V.O.)
My father says he was the greatest teacher in Daxia. That his students led the nation forward for twenty years.

MONTAGE BEGINS:

- Young MENG LINGSHAN writes equations on a cracked blackboard, thirty children lean forward.
- School uniforms chase a departing van, their voices calling "Teacher Meng!"
- MENG LINGSHAN's hand rests on the vanishing school gate as it's demolished.

MONTAGE ENDS.

MENG RUFANG (V.O.)
He says the school was torn down after they left. That it's been twenty years. He wants to see them, he says.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

MENG LINGSHAN sits in his wheelchair, watching television news. The broadcast shows a group of engineers at a construction site.

MENG RUFANG (V.O.)
He points at the screen. Calls them his students. Maybe they were, once.

MENG LINGSHAN
(watching TV, murmuring)
My students.

MENG RUFANG (V.O.)
But that was before the diagnosis. Before the forgetting started.

MENG LINGSHAN
(eyes full of longing)
I promised I'd see them graduate.
continuation:
INT. PARK PATH - DAY

MENG RUFANG crouches in front of MENG LINGSHAN, gently stroking his leg, her expression helpless and heartbroken.

MENG RUFANG
You're mixing up decades, Baba. It's the illness.

MENG LINGSHAN
(repeating in confusion)
Fantasy... fantasy...

An elderly man in traditional Chinese clothing, LIU GENSHENG, passes by. He stops, looking at MENG LINGSHAN with surprise.

LIU GENSHENG
Meng? Meng Lingshan?

MENG RUFANG
(looking up)
Yes. Do you know him?

LIU GENSHENG
(excitedly walking forward, grasping MENG LINGSHAN's hand)
We lost track after the flood. I never thought—

MENG RUFANG
(shocked, eyes welling up)
You knew him? As a teacher?

LIU GENSHENG
Panlong Village, twenty years ago. He taught under a roof that leaked when it rained. Every single one of his students—

MENG RUFANG
(tears streaming down her face)
The greatest teacher in Daxia...

FLASHBACK:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

MENG LINGSHAN points at successful people on the television.

MENG LINGSHAN
My student. She wrote to me for years.

MENG RUFANG
(impatiently)
Stop it, Baba. Please.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. PARK PATH - DAY

LIU GENSHENG still looks at MENG LINGSHAN excitedly.

LIU GENSHENG
I was the village secretary. We tried to name the new school after him, but he disappeared.

MENG RUFANG
(completely convinced, sobbing)
Everything he said... I thought it was—

LIU GENSHENG
It's been twenty years. We never forgot.

MENG LINGSHAN
(eyes vacant, murmuring)
They promised... to come back...

A faint smile appears on MENG LINGSHAN's face, as if he is immersed in beautiful memories that no longer belong to him.

MENG RUFANG (V.O.)
He says the school was torn down after they left. That it's been twenty years. He wants to see them, he says.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

MENG LINGSHAN sits in his wheelchair, watching television news. The broadcast shows a group of engineers at a construction site.

MENG RUFANG (V.O.)
He points at the screen. Calls them his students. Maybe they were, once.

MENG LINGSHAN
(watching TV, murmuring)
My students.

MENG RUFANG (V.O.)
But that was before the diagnosis. Before the forgetting started.

MENG LINGSHAN
(eyes full of longing)
I promised I'd see them graduate.

INT. PARK PATH - DAY

MENG RUFANG crouches in front of MENG LINGSHAN, gently stroking his leg, her expression helpless and heartbroken.

MENG RUFANG
You're mixing up decades, Baba. It's the illness.

MENG LINGSHAN
(repeating in confusion)
Fantasy... fantasy...

An elderly man in traditional Chinese clothing, LIU GENSHENG, passes by. He stops, looking at MENG LINGSHAN with surprise.

LIU GENSHENG
Meng? Meng Lingshan?

MENG RUFANG
(looking up)
Yes. Do you know him?

LIU GENSHENG
(excitedly walking forward, grasping MENG LINGSHAN's hand)
We lost track after the flood. I never thought—

MENG RUFANG
(shocked, eyes welling up)
You knew him? As a teacher?

LIU GENSHENG
Panlong Village, twenty years ago. He taught under a roof that leaked when it rained. Every single one of his students—

MENG RUFANG
(tears streaming down her face)
The greatest teacher in Daxia...

FLASHBACK:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

MENG LINGSHAN points at successful people on the television.

MENG LINGSHAN
My student. She wrote to me for years.

MENG RUFANG
(impatiently)
Stop it, Baba. Please.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. PARK PATH - DAY

LIU GENSHENG still looks at MENG LINGSHAN excitedly.

LIU GENSHENG
I was the village secretary. We tried to name the new school after him, but he disappeared.

MENG RUFANG
(completely convinced, sobbing)
Everything he said... I thought it was—

LIU GENSHENG
It's been twenty years. We never forgot.

MENG LINGSHAN
(eyes vacant, murmuring)
They promised... to come back...

A faint smile appears on MENG LINGSHAN's face, as if he is immersed in beautiful memories that no longer belong to him.

title: The God of Football of Great Xia
description: A legendary football king's son is secretly switched at birth by a vengeful man, setting the stage for a twisted fate involving honor, deception, and the future of Dragon Nation football.
context:
Title: The God of Football of Great Xia
Description: A legendary football king's son is secretly switched at birth by a vengeful man, setting the stage for a twisted fate involving honor, deception, and the future of Dragon Nation football.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE HALL - DAY

The scene opens with boiling voices and flashing lights.

FANS hold up signs reading "Show Your Skills" and "Fight for Dragon Nation Football," shouting wildly.

FAN (V.O.)
Football King! Football King! Football King!

A FEMALE REPORTER holds a microphone, standing in front of the crowd, ready to interview.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The screen displays electronic words saying "Please Keep Quiet."

LI HUITANG, wearing an exquisite striped suit, stands with a serious expression. He is the "Football King" that the fans are shouting about.

SECRETARY TANG, a young woman in a pink dress, quickly walks up to him.

SECRETARY TANG
Chairman Li, all the media have arrived. They're all waiting for you.

LI HUITANG
Notify the hospital to bring my son over. It's time to meet the media.

LI HUITANG strides forward.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL MAINTENANCE CLOSET - DAY

YE ZUO, a janitor with calloused hands, polishes a faded football medal. His reflection in the metal shows years of buried resentment.

He pockets the medal.

INT. HOSPITAL NURSERY - DAY

YE ZUO enters, pushing a cleaning cart. His keycard grants him access. The cries of babies rise and fall.

He walks to a crib marked with the number "9" and picks up the baby inside. This is his son, YE LONGDAN.

YE ZUO (V.O.)
Your father took everything from me. Now I take you from him.

He walks to the crib marked with the number "6," where LI HUITANG's son YE FAN lies. YE ZUO hangs his own son's medal on YE FAN.

YE ZUO (V.O.)
You will wear his chains. My son will wear his crown.

YE ZUO switches the two babies. He puts his own son into crib "6" and picks up LI HUITANG's son.

YE ZUO
(whispering to the baby in his arms)
All his glory... becomes yours.

He holds the child, a flicker of pain crossing his face, and turns to leave.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YE ZUO walks out of the nursery holding the child and runs into DIRECTOR WANG and a YOUNG NURSE.

DIRECTOR WANG and the NURSE look at him with a trace of disdain in their eyes.

DIRECTOR WANG
(to the nurse)
This kind of person doesn't deserve to share a nursery with the Football King's son.

YOUNG NURSE
Yes, Director. The Football King is very anxious. We need to hurry over.

DIRECTOR WANG and the NURSE hurry away.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE HALL - DAY

The atmosphere at the scene is enthusiastic. The FANS shout again.

FANS
The Football King is here! Football King!

LI HUITANG and SECRETARY TANG walk on the red carpet toward the stage. DIRECTOR WANG, holding the switched baby (YE ZUO's son), walks onto the stage and hands him to LI HUITANG.

FEMALE REPORTER
(loudly asking)
Football King, since you retired, Dragon Nation football has been in decline. Do you think there is still hope?

LI HUITANG holds the baby, facing the camera, full of confidence.

LI HUITANG
Of course there's hope. My son has inherited my genes. He is the future of Dragon Nation football. He is the hope of Dragon Nation football!

Thunderous applause and cheers erupt from the audience below.

Flashlights keep flashing. LI HUITANG looks proudly at the "son" in his arms.

The scene cuts to YE ZUO pushing a baby carriage in an empty corridor.

The final shot shows LI HUITANG's and YE ZUO's faces in a split screen, their expressions forming a stark contrast.

title: Wedding Night
description: On her mother's remarriage night, a woman discovers her new stepfather dead, uncovering dark secrets about her mother's past.
context:
Title: Wedding Night
Description: On her mother's remarriage night, a woman discovers her new stepfather dead, uncovering dark secrets about her mother's past.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

JIANG YA lies asleep in bed, her brow slightly furrowed.

JIANG YA (V.O.)
My mother wore red tonight. She reserves that color for special occasions. The last time she wore it, my father died.

SFX: Distant firecrackers. Thunder.

WEN FUYAO (O.S.)
Chaoyang!

JIANG YA's eyes snap open.

WEN FUYAO (O.S.)
(panicked)
Chaoyang, please—

JIANG YA sits up, looking confused and tense.

JIANG YA
Mom?

WEN FUYAO (O.S.)
(urgent)
Chaoyang, look at me! Chaoyang!

JIANG YA immediately gets out of bed, hurriedly puts on slippers, and runs out.
continuation:
INT. JIANG CHAOYANG'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

The room is crowded with wedding guests, the atmosphere heavy. WEN FUYAO wears a bright red qipao, standing to the side with a grief-stricken expression.

JIANG YA is pushed through the crowd to the bedside.

On the bed, her stepfather JIANG CHAOYANG lies with eyes closed, lifeless.

JIANG YA
(crying)
Dad! Dad! Dad, what's wrong? It's Xiao Ya! Dad!

CROWD
The doctor is here! Make way, make way!

An elderly man in a long robe, carrying a medicine box, pushes through the crowd.

The OLD DOCTOR approaches the bed and leans in, sniffing the air.

OLD DOCTOR
(to himself)
This smell...

JIANG YA
(urgently)
Doctor, please check on him! What's happened?

The OLD DOCTOR sets down his medicine box, sits on the edge of the bed, and takes Chaoyang's pulse. His expression is serious as he carefully examines him.

After a moment, the OLD DOCTOR stands and shakes his head.

OLD DOCTOR
Medicine cannot help him now. The family should prepare.

JIANG YA
(shocked)
No! That's impossible!

JIANG YA falls to her knees before the OLD DOCTOR.

JIANG YA
(pleading)
Doctor, I'm begging you, please check him again! He was just dancing at the wedding!

The OLD DOCTOR turns to look at WEN FUYAO.

OLD DOCTOR
Fuyao. The wedding wine. Did he drink more than usual?

WEN FUYAO
(eyes evasive)
We were celebrating. Then he said he needed to rest...

JIANG YA stands up, looking at her mother in disbelief.

JIANG YA
You're lying. I saw his cup. You kept filling it.

SFX: Flashback of wine pouring into a cup—overspilling.

WEN FUYAO's face changes, a flash of panic crossing her eyes.

title: The Big Boss Returns to the Village on the Fifth Day of the New Year
description: Qin Chuan, a powerful CEO traveling incognito during the Spring Festival rush, is confronted by an arrogant internet celebrity after a minor traffic incident, only to have his true identity revealed when the wealthiest woman in Jiangcheng arrives to greet him.
context:
Title: The Big Boss Returns to the Village on the Fifth Day of the New Year
Description: Qin Chuan, a powerful CEO traveling incognito during the Spring Festival rush, is confronted by an arrogant internet celebrity after a minor traffic incident, only to have his true identity revealed when the wealthiest woman in Jiangcheng arrives to greet him.

EXT. TRAIN STATION AREA - DAY

QIN CHUAN, wearing a simple green military coat and a fur hat, pulls a suitcase down the street. He is on the phone.

ASSISTANT (V.O.)
President, the Chairman of Jiangcheng Chamber of Commerce has specially prepared eighty-eight tables at the Imperial Banquet Restaurant to welcome you home, inviting all members of the Qin family to celebrate the New Year together.

QIN CHUAN
(into phone)
I know, I'm on my way to the hotel now.

A PASSERBY trips over his own large luggage and falls. QIN CHUAN steps forward to help him up.

QIN CHUAN
Easy, friend.

QIN CHUAN continues pulling his suitcase, still on the phone.

ASSISTANT (V.O.)
President, did you take the Spring Festival rush train by yourself again? Your confidentiality agreement has been lifted. The group could have sent a helicopter to take you back.

QIN CHUAN
That helicopter doesn't have the atmosphere of the Spring Festival rush, right?

EXT. PARKING LOT ROADSIDE - DAY

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN drives a white car, looking irritably at the pedestrians on the road.

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
(under her breath)
So many people. Can't these peasants use the sidewalk?

The INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN's car clips QIN CHUAN's suitcase as she swerves. The suitcase spins, spilling contents. QIN CHUAN stumbles back.

The INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN screeches to a halt, leaps out, and crouches to inspect her bumper—a faint scuff. She whips out her phone, recording.

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
(furiously)
You scratched my car!

PASSERBY A
She hit his suitcase!

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
(to Passerby A)
Mind your own business!

She advances on QIN CHUAN, camera in his face.

QIN CHUAN
You were driving recklessly.
continuation:
INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
(raising her hand)
Don't lecture me! Pay up!

QIN CHUAN
Have your lawyers contact mine.

The INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN shoves his shoulder. QIN CHUAN doesn't move, but his fur hat falls.

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
You think you're clever?

PASSERBY B
She's the reckless one!

PASSERBY C
—nearly hit him!

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
(to crowd)
You're just jealous of the rich!

She grabs QIN CHUAN's coat sleeve.

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
You're not leaving!

A convoy of luxury cars approaches, led by a Rolls-Royce with license plate "A 88888." The convoy stops.

The INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN and QIN CHUAN freeze, along with other passersby.

BODYGUARDS get out and open the rear door for WANG YANRAN. WANG YANRAN, wearing a white coat and exuding noble elegance, exits the car surrounded by bodyguards.

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
(shocked, muttering)
Jiangcheng's richest person, Wang Yanran! President Wang!

WANG YANRAN walks toward QIN CHUAN with her bodyguards.

BODYGUARDS
(bowing in unison)
Congratulations, Brother Chuan, Happy New Year!

WANG YANRAN stands before QIN CHUAN. The INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN releases his sleeve.

WANG YANRAN
(quietly)
We expected you at the hotel. I came to see what detained you.

She extends a red envelope with both hands.

The INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN stares at QIN CHUAN's coat, the spilled belongings, the convoy, and the envelope. Her phone slips.

INTERNET CELEBRITY WOMAN
(stammering)
Bro... Brother Chuan?

title: The Great Magician
description: A legendary Peking Opera martial role actor refuses to perform for Japanese invaders and pays the ultimate price, leaving his son to carry on his legacy.
context:
Title: The Great Magician
Description: A legendary Peking Opera martial role actor refuses to perform for Japanese invaders and pays the ultimate price, leaving his son to carry on his legacy.

INT. GUAN FAMILY TROUPE THEATER - NIGHT

A plaque reads "Guan Family Troupe."

The sound of Peking Opera drums and gongs is intense.

GUAN HAITIAN, dressed in full martial role costume, fights fiercely against multiple attackers inside the theater. He is skilled, but outnumbered, his hands already stained with blood.

After a brutal battle, GUAN HAITIAN defeats all his enemies and stands alone in the center of the devastated theater, breathing heavily.

INT. GUAN FAMILY TROUPE BACKSTAGE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

GUAN HAITIAN speaks to a large wooden crate. His young son GUAN YILONG is hidden inside.

GUAN HAITIAN
Your grandfather taught me the martial role carries heroes' weight. Tonight I bear it alone. Tomorrow, you must.
(quietly)
When they offer safety for your art... remember this crate. Promise me.

GUAN YILONG
Father, I promise!

GUAN HAITIAN closes the lid. GUAN YILONG peers out through the cracks in terror.

INT. GUAN FAMILY TROUPE THEATER - NIGHT

YU KUI enters with a group of men carrying a plaque that reads "Master of Martial Roles."

GUAN HAITIAN
You're returning it to the wrong theater, Yu Kui.

YU KUI
The art belongs to whoever keeps it alive, Haitian. Not to a building.

A man in Japanese clothing, YAMAMOTO TAKESHI, steps forward.

YAMAMOTO TAKESHI
Your "Zhao Yun at Changban" was definitive. I would consider it a personal honor.

GUAN HAITIAN
I would rather die backstage than sing for you.

YU KUI
The art dies with you!

GUAN HAITIAN
The art died when you started translating libretti for them.
continuation:
GUAN HAITIAN shouts and launches an attack. Both sides engage in fierce combat again.

Though brave, GUAN HAITIAN is ultimately outnumbered. He is stabbed multiple times and falls to the ground. GUAN YILONG witnesses everything through the cracks in the crate, covering his mouth in terror, tears streaming down his face.

YU KUI
(quietly)
Just say yes.

GUAN HAITIAN
(grinning through blood)
Listen close...

GUAN HAITIAN uses his last strength to stab YAMAMOTO TAKESHI in the face with the pheasant feather from his headdress.

YAMAMOTO TAKESHI
(covering his face, screaming)

YAMAMOTO TAKESHI, enraged and humiliated, draws his sword and kills GUAN HAITIAN.

YAMAMOTO TAKESHI
(to YU KUI)
The plaque is yours. But you will always be the man who let this happen.

YU KUI clutches the plaque, his expression hollow.

EXT. STREET CORNER - NIGHT

GUAN YILONG has become a young beggar. He finds some leftover food and tries to feed it to a stray dog named XIAO HEI.

GUAN YILONG
Xiao Hei, Xiao Hei.

GUAN YILONG is starving. He grabs the leftover food from the ground and stuffs it into his mouth, his hands covered in dirt and blood.

A cleanly dressed young girl, YE MULAN, approaches and hands him a steamed bun.

YE MULAN
My grandfather says you have a performer's hands.

GUAN YILONG looks at her warily.

YE MULAN
Eat. The body forgets, but the hands remember.

GUAN YILONG takes the bun and devours it hungrily.

MASTER YE approaches and looks at GUAN YILONG.

MASTER YE
Would you come with us to the Ye Family Troupe? We have a crate in our storeroom.

GUAN YILONG looks up at them, eyes brimming with tears.

You're returning it to the wrong theater, Yu Kui.

YU KUI
The art belongs to whoever keeps it alive, Haitian. Not to a building.

A man in Japanese clothing, YAMAMOTO TAKESHI, steps forward.

YAMAMOTO TAKESHI
Your "Zhao Yun at Changban" was definitive. I would consider it a personal honor.

GUAN HAITIAN
I would rather die backstage than sing for you.

YU KUI
The art dies with you!

GUAN HAITIAN
The art died when you started translating libretti for them.

GUAN HAITIAN shouts and launches an attack. Both sides engage in fierce combat again.

Though brave, GUAN HAITIAN is ultimately outnumbered. He is stabbed multiple times and falls to the ground. GUAN YILONG witnesses everything through the cracks in the crate, covering his mouth in terror, tears streaming down his face.

YU KUI
(quietly)
Just say yes.

GUAN HAITIAN
(grinning through blood)
Listen close...

GUAN HAITIAN uses his last strength to stab YAMAMOTO TAKESHI in the face with the pheasant feather from his headdress.

YAMAMOTO TAKESHI
(covering his face, screaming)

YAMAMOTO TAKESHI, enraged and humiliated, draws his sword and kills GUAN HAITIAN.

YAMAMOTO TAKESHI
(to YU KUI)
The plaque is yours. But you will always be the man who let this happen.

YU KUI clutches the plaque, his expression hollow.

EXT. STREET CORNER - NIGHT

GUAN YILONG has become a young beggar. He finds some leftover food and tries to feed it to a stray dog named XIAO HEI.

GUAN YILONG
Xiao Hei, Xiao Hei.

GUAN YILONG is starving. He grabs the leftover food from the ground and stuffs it into his mouth, his hands covered in dirt and blood.

A cleanly dressed young girl, YE MULAN, approaches and hands him a steamed bun.

YE MULAN
My grandfather says you have a performer's hands.

GUAN YILONG looks at her warily.

YE MULAN
Eat. The body forgets, but the hands remember.

GUAN YILONG takes the bun and devours it hungrily.

MASTER YE approaches and looks at GUAN YILONG.

MASTER YE
Would you come with us to the Ye Family Troupe? We have a crate in our storeroom.

GUAN YILONG looks up at them, eyes brimming with tears.

title: All Scumbags Are Equally Dark (Episode 42)
description: A pregnant woman braves a stormy night to beg for money so her husband can study abroad, selling everything her family owns and desperately seeking help from neighbors and the village chief.
context:
Title: All Scumbags Are Equally Dark (Episode 42)
Description: A pregnant woman braves a stormy night to beg for money so her husband can study abroad, selling everything her family owns and desperately seeking help from neighbors and the village chief.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - NIGHT

A stormy night with thunder and lightning. On a muddy path, pregnant LING HUA (late 20s, determined eyes, using a yellow fertilizer bag as shield) struggles forward with a flashlight. She stops, steadies herself against a tree, one hand on her belly, then pushes on with renewed purpose.

INT. CLINIC - NIGHT

LING HUA, soaking wet, stands before DR. LI (60s, stern but tired). She places her worn work permit on the counter.

LING HUA
Doctor, please. Just a week's advance. I'll work double shifts after—

DR. LI
(interrupting, firm)
You're not on staff. And in your condition?

DR. LI pushes the permit back.

DR. LI
Go home. Think of your child.

Ling Hua's jaw tightens. She pockets the permit, nods once, and turns to leave.
continuation:
EXT. FARMHOUSE YARD - NIGHT

LING HUA stumbles out of the clinic porch, leans against the wall. She dials a number—no answer. Stares at her phone: a photo of HONG YU in graduation robes. She whispers.

LING HUA
(barely audible)
You promised.

She wipes her face, straightens, and moves down the road to a wooden fence.

LING HUA
Auntie Wang. I'll work your fields—three months, no pay. Just the advance.

AUNTIE WANG (O.S.)
(cold, through window)
My crops failed. You've got nothing to offer.

The window slams. Ling Hua grips the fence, then releases it deliberately. She doesn't crumble—she calculates.

EXT. VILLAGE CHIEF'S HOUSE - NIGHT

LING HUA kneels on the steps, but her posture has changed—exhausted yet unbroken. She speaks clearly.

LING HUA
Village Chief. The scholarship deposit is due tomorrow. My father pawned his wheelchair. I've sold every hen. I need five thousand more. I'll sign any contract.

The VILLAGE CHIEF (50s, weathered) opens the door. He studies her, then pulls out an envelope.

VILLAGE CHIEF
Your husband called yesterday. Asked for the same amount. Said it was for your hospital fees.

Beat. Ling Hua's face goes still. The rain pounds.

VILLAGE CHIEF
(offering envelope)
This is what he didn't take. Three thousand. It's yours.

Ling Hua takes it slowly, her expression unreadable.

VILLAGE CHIEF
(quiet warning)
Whatever he's chasing... make sure he brings something back worth keeping.

LING HUA
(folds money into her bag, voice firm)
Thank you, Chief.

She rises on her own, turns, and walks back into the storm—no longer hunched, but walking tall, one hand on her belly, the other gripping the bag. The flashlight beam ahead of her is steady.

The Village Chief watches, then pulls out his phone, dialing.

VILLAGE CHIEF
(into phone)
Hong Yu? She just left. She knows.

He hangs up, looking grim.

FADE OUT.

title: Heaven's Game
description: A desperate mother is cruelly deceived by a manipulative man who promises to save her dying daughter if she climbs 8000 stone steps on her knees.
context:
Title: Heaven's Game
Description: A desperate mother is cruelly deceived by a manipulative man who promises to save her dying daughter if she climbs 8000 stone steps on her knees.

EXT. PARK STONE STEPS - DAY

ZHAO CUI kneels on the ground, holding her unconscious daughter in her arms. Her expression is desperate as she cries out to passersby for help.

ZHAO CUI
(calling out)
Please, her fever's at 105! We need emergency care!

Pedestrians walk past hurriedly, some filming but no one stopping.

ZHAO CUI
(choking up)
The hospitals turned us away. Please...

A middle-aged man wearing glasses, SU LIANG, stops in front of her.

SU LIANG (V.O.)
Perfect. The algorithm loves desperate parents.

ZHAO CUI looks up with tearful eyes, seeing a glimmer of hope.

ZHAO CUI
You'll help?

SU LIANG squats down and looks at the child.

SU LIANG
There's a protocol. Experimental. Requires bioequivalent sacrifice.

SU LIANG
If I anchor the transfer, I can hack her cytokine response.

ZHAO CUI
(confused)
What does that mean?

SU LIANG stands up and points to a long stone stairway in the distance.

SU LIANG
Eight thousand steps. Knees only. No stopping. It generates enough cellular trauma signal to reset her immune system. Six hours exactly.

ZHAO CUI looks at the steep steps, her eyes becoming determined.

MONTAGE:

- ZHAO CUI begins to crawl upward with difficulty on her knees, leaving a trail of blood behind her.
- The knees of her pants are worn through, blood flowing freely.
- At the halfway point, she collapses, then forces herself up again.
continuation:
EXT. TOP OF STONE STEPS - DAY

ZHAO CUI, covered in injuries, finally reaches the top. She crawls toward SU LIANG, completely exhausted.

ZHAO CUI
(weakly)
Six hours... I made it...

SU LIANG looks at her coldly, phone recording.

SU LIANG
(shouting)
Too late! The window closed!

ZHAO CUI falls to the ground, her face full of shock. SU LIANG laughs loudly as young people emerge from hiding, filming.

SU LIANG
(laughing)
She believed the quantum healing BS! Best content this month!

INT. OFFICE - DAY

A young girl rushes into the office.

YOUNG GIRL A
Su Liang's stream is number one trending! The comments are death threats!

She hands her phone to YOUNG GIRL B, the screen showing comments scrolling rapidly.

YOUNG GIRL B
That's the third "healer" scam this year. When will platforms ban them?

MONTAGE:

- People everywhere watch Su Liang's video on their phones, showing angry expressions.
- A crowd surrounds SU LIANG, phones out, shouting.

PASSERBY A
She could have died!

PASSERBY B
You're streaming this too? You're no better!

PASSERBY C
Cancel him! Delete the platform!

EXT. PARK - DAY

In the crowd, a female college student named ZHOU QIAN steps forward, facing the media and cameras.

ZHOU QIAN
(loudly)
I want to accuse him! Su Liang scammed my mother last year with fake cancer treatments!

She holds up medical bills.

ZHOU QIAN
Today he's arrested for fraud. But the real crime? Tech companies profit from our desperation!

She turns to show ZHAO CUI on a stretcher, her daughter now conscious and weeping beside her.

title: The Little Immortal Chef
description: A mischievous immortal girl who inherited the God of Cooking's divine position descends to the mortal world to find her father and fulfill her destiny.
context:
Title: The Little Immortal Chef
Description: A mischievous immortal girl who inherited the God of Cooking's divine position descends to the mortal world to find her father and fulfill her destiny.

INT. LAKESIDE - DAY

SUPER: IMMORTAL REALM

A little girl in flowing silk robes, YUANYUAN (8), stirs from sleep atop a jade-colored boulder. She stretches, her nose already twitching.

YUANYUAN
(to herself)
Nothing but ambrosia for three hundred years... I'm starving for something real.

She springs up, eyes sparkling with inspiration.

YUANYUAN
Time for something with actual flavor!

Above the misty lake, two divine beasts circle—GOLDEN DRAGON and FIRE PHOENIX—playfully chasing each other through clouds.

MALE VOICE A (V.O.)
The little ancestor's awake! Hide the divine beasts!

MALE VOICE B (V.O.)
Too late—she's already spotted them!

Yuanyuan stands on a floating wooden pier, hands on hips, her laughter like silver bells.

YUANYUAN
Dragon and Phoenix Hot Pot! Perfect!

She whips out a tiny slingshot carved from peach wood. As she aims, the ammunition glows—essence orbs, not stones. She fires once, twice. The divine beasts shimmer and TRANSFORM mid-air into their base spiritual forms: a chicken and a fish, which plop into Yuanyuan's waiting basket.

Yuanyuan catches them effortlessly, already setting up her cooking pot.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY

XUANTIAN LAOZU, an ancient immortal whose white beard trails to his knees, shuffles through the courtyard in panic.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(calling out)
Long'er! Feng'er! Where have those rascals gotten to now?

His nose catches an irresistible aroma. He follows it like a man possessed.

He finds Yuanyuan tending her pot, the broth simmering with heavenly fragrance.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(leaning close to the pot)
Ah, Yuanyuan... that aroma could wake the dead. Mortal fire needs mortal fuel, yes? Let this old one stoke it for you.

XUANTIAN LAOZU casts a spell, and the flames leap up, singeing his sleeve. He doesn't notice.

YUANYUAN
(without looking up)
You just want first taste.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(rubbing his hands together)
A mere sample. For quality assurance.

YUANYUAN
(pointing her spoon)
One spoonful. That's it.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(beaming)
You're a jewel among immortals!

XUANTIAN LAOZU plunges his hand into the pot—time and pain mean nothing to him—and extracts a morsel.

YUANYUAN
(disgusted)
At least use a spoon. We're civilized beings.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(mouth full, eyes wide)
Divine! What is this? I've tasted every beast in the nine heavens, but this...

YUANYUAN
(casually)
Dragon and phoenix, of course.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(shocked)
MY Dragon? MY Phoenix? The ones I've raised since they were eggs?

YUANYUAN
They looked mature enough to harvest.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(grief-stricken)
My beautiful mounts! My companions of a thousand years!

XUANTIAN LAOZU collapses on the ground, beating his chest.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
Little ancestor, please show mercy! The divine beasts on this Spirit Mountain are almost all eaten by you.

NINE HEAVENS SAINT, a fairy in white robes, walks over.

NINE HEAVENS SAINT
Yuanyuan. You've consumed half the spiritual guardians of this mountain.

YUANYUAN
continuation:
(pouting)
It's not my fault. The God of Cooking's divine position requires actual cooking. You can't make an omelet without breaking a few eggs. Or roasting a few dragons.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(standing up)
She has a point. It's her nature.

NINE HEAVENS SAINT
Since Yuanyuan loves cooking so much, why don't you go to the mortal world to find your father?

YUANYUAN
(delighted)
Father? I have a father?

NINE HEAVENS SAINT
Every immortal has an origin.

NINE HEAVENS SAINT casts a spell, and an image shimmers in the air—a MAN in a modern chef's coat, his face kind, his hands skilled.

YUANYUAN
(whispering)
He looks... kind. And his hands know work.

NINE HEAVENS SAINT
It was a winter's night when your mortal mother saved his life.

FLASHBACK: A young woman tends to an injured man in a mountain inn.

MAN
I thought I'd die alone on that cliff.

WOMAN
Then it's fortunate I was hunting for rare herbs.

END FLASHBACK.

NINE HEAVENS SAINT
(noticing YUANYUAN has disappeared)
Hmph, this little imp—

XUANTIAN LAOZU watches as Yuanyuan's life statue in the courtyard—the measure of her divine power—glows, then hardens into ordinary stone.

XUANTIAN LAOZU
(sadly)
She's sealed her immortal power. In the mortal world, she'll be just a gifted child. Until she earns her place.

NINE HEAVENS SAINT
Let us hope gifted is enough.

INT. HOTEL KITCHEN - DAY

The kitchen is bustling. Head Chef ZHANG (40s) towers over LIN YANG (28), a talented sous chef.

CHEF ZHANG
Lin Yang! That prep work should've been done ten minutes ago! This is a kitchen, not a meditation hall!

LIN YANG
Chef Zhang, I'm doing the work of three people here. I can't—

A golden light flashes, and YUANYUAN appears, her ancient robes ludicrously out of place.

She spots Lin Yang's hands—the way they move, the precision in his knife work. Her eyes widen. It's the same hands from the vision.

YUANYUAN
(voice trembling)
Daddy?

Yuanyuan runs to Lin Yang and hugs his leg fiercely.

LIN YANG
(surprised)
Whoa! Hey, little girl. I'm not—

CHEF ZHANG
(exploding)
You bring a KID into my kitchen? Lin Yang, if you don't want to work, get out!

LIN YANG
No, she's not my child.

CHEF ZHANG
If she's not your child, is she mine?

YUANYUAN
(shouting at Chef Zhang)
Don't you bully my daddy!

CHEF ZHANG
So what if I bully him?

YUANYUAN
(pointing at Chef Zhang)
You just wait!

CHEF ZHANG
I'm waiting! Go away!

YUANYUAN walks to the cutting board, picks up a piece of carrot and a cleaver. In a BLUR OF MOTION, she reduces it to perfect julienne. The kitchen falls silent.

LIN YANG and CHEF ZHANG stare, mouths agape.

Yuanyuan looks up, her face fierce with pride and vulnerability.

YUANYUAN
(to Lin Yang)
I can help. Just... don't send me away.
