context:
Title: Chickens, Chance, and a Billion-Dollar Secret
Description: A small-town girl's first night in the city takes a wild turn when her traveling companions (two hens) cause chaos in a high-end bar, leading to an unexpected encounter with a mysterious stranger.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

A sleek, modern bar pulses with ambient electronic music. City professionals mingle over craft cocktails.

ZHIZHI (20s, practical farm girl in simple clean clothes) sits at the bar beside a WOVEN BASKET. She sips a colorful drink cautiously.

ZHIZHI
(pleasantly surprised)
Not bad. Tastes like fermented berries.

She sets the glass down gently.

ZHIZHI
(to bartender, polite)
Excuse me, could I have another? It's my twenty-first birthday.

The BARTENDER nods, impressed by her manners, and mixes a fresh drink.

ZHIZHI
(softly, to herself)
Ten years since Mom brought me here. City hasn't gotten any quieter.

Her phone BUZZES. Caller ID: "Grandpa." She answers.

ZHIZHI
(clearly)
Hey, Grandpa. Everything okay?

EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

GRANDPA (70s, sharp eyes in simple clothes) tends bonsai under string lights. BUTLER WANG watches respectfully.

GRANDPA
(into phone)
Your aunt called. Said you never arrived. What's this about bringing livestock on a bus?

INT. BAR - NIGHT

ZHIZHI
(eyeing her basket)
Auntie's sick. Fresh eggs help. The hens were a surprise for her birthday. They're very well-behaved.

A tipsy BUSINESSMAN stumbles backward, KICKING the basket. The lid flips. Two HENS erupt out, squawking.

ZHIZHI
(calm but urgent)
Oh no—my hens!
continuation:
EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

GRANDPA
(frowning at the noise)
Is that... squawking?

BUTLER WANG
Perhaps the young lady needs assistance, sir?

GRANDPA
She'll manage. The contract for her trust fund is ready, yes?

BUTLER WANG
Yes, sir. Though... some board members question her readiness for a nine-figure inheritance.

GRANDPA
(firmly)
She's more capable than any of them. She's her mother's daughter.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

The hens dart between legs. Patrons laugh and gasp. ZHIZHI moves swiftly, not panicked but focused.

CUSTOMER
Chicken! Real chickens!

ZHIZHI
(apologetic, to room)
Sorry everyone! They're just scared!

She deftly scoops one hen, then spots the second flying toward—

JIANG CHEN (30s, sharp suit, tired eyes) sits alone with whiskey. He blinks as a hen lands on his table.

—ZHIZHI lunges for the hen, tripping over his chair leg. She catches the chicken mid-air but lands HARD against his chest. They both freeze.

JIANG CHEN
(steadying her, surprised)
Got the chicken. You okay?

ZHIZHI
(breathless, staring at him)
I... yes. Sorry. You're...

She trails off, noticing his eyes—kind despite his stern face.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

ZHIZHI, slightly tipsy now, leans against a wall. The BUSINESSMAN from before hovers.

BUSINESSMAN
(slurring)
Let me help you to your room, sweetie...

ZHIZHI
(firm, pushing him away)
I said I'm fine. My aunt's place is two blocks away.

He retreats. Zhizhi squints at door numbers, then stumbles.

ZHIZHI
(to herself)
Wait... which floor am I on?

She knocks on the nearest door—312.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

ZHIZHI tumbles through the opening door into—

JIANG CHEN, in a hoodie now, holding a first aid kit. He catches her expertly.

JIANG CHEN
(stern but concerned)
You again. You're bleeding.

ZHIZHI
(touching her scraped elbow)
Just a scratch. I'm tougher than I look.

JIANG CHEN
(guides her to a chair)
Sit. Let me clean it. I'm a doctor.

ZHIZHI
(studying him)
You don't look like a doctor.

JIANG CHEN
(smiling faintly)
You don't look like someone who travels with chickens.

They share a beat of understanding. He gently cleans her wound. Zhizhi's eyes flutter—exhaustion, not just drunkenness.

ZHIZHI
(quietly)
Thanks. For catching me. Both times.

JIANG CHEN
(softly)
Anytime.

She leans in—he doesn't pull away. Their lips meet, soft and tentative, both fully present.

The hen in her basket CLUCKS, making them laugh against each other's mouths.

FADE OUT.

title: The Genius Painter is Not to Be Trifled With
description: A talented young painter is reborn after being betrayed by her junior sister who stole her masterpiece and claimed it as her own, leading to her downfall and death.
context:
Title: The Genius Painter is Not to Be Trifled With
Description: A talented young painter is reborn after being betrayed by her junior sister who stole her masterpiece and claimed it as her own, leading to her downfall and death.

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

AN YIRUO, a young woman in a white dress, sits with her back to the camera in front of a blank easel. In the distance, a brightly lit cross-sea bridge spans the horizon.

ON SCREEN: AN YIRUO - A genius young woman with exceptional painting skills

AN YIRUO suddenly wakes with a start, her expression filled with terror.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
I've been reborn. But the canvas is still empty.

AN YIRUO looks at her hands as memories flood back.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
Seven days and nights. Every brushstroke, a piece of my soul. She took it while I blinked.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. STREET - DAY

AN YIRUO, wearing period costume, runs through the rain and gets into a taxi.

A large truck collides with the taxi.

AN YIRUO, blood covering her face, loses consciousness inside the car.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
The rain was so loud. I never got to say goodbye.
continuation:
INT. AWARD CEREMONY - DAY

SU WANXIAO, a young woman with exquisite makeup, smiles on stage holding up a first-place certificate and trophy. The audience applauds below.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
While she held my trophy, they applauded my downfall.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY - DAY

The HOST stands next to SU WANXIAO, holding a microphone to interview her.

HOST
Miss Su, as Master An's final disciple, you've won the championship at such a young age. Truly remarkable. By the way, why didn't your senior sister An Yiruo come to compete?

SU WANXIAO
(smiling)
My senior sister... the genius painter...

SU WANXIAO suddenly leans closer to the microphone, her expression becoming subtle.

SU WANXIAO
(in a whisper)
I hope she finds her own inspiration someday.

In the audience seats below, a MAN and WOMAN are discussing.

MALE AUDIENCE MEMBER
That's the third time she's hinted at it. Poor Master An's daughter...

FEMALE AUDIENCE MEMBER
Where there's smoke...

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

AN YIRUO stands before the easel, her expression filled with pain and unwillingness.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
The contempt, the disdain... that honor was mine to claim.

AN YIRUO turns around, her eyes becoming determined.

AN YIRUO (V.O.)
This time, I'll paint a truth she can't steal.

INT. STUDIO - DAY

AN YIRUO is painting in front of an easel in her studio. Her phone rings, the caller ID shows "AN HONGSHAN."

She picks up the phone to answer.

AN HONGSHAN (V.O.)
Your mother understands if you withdraw. She's making your favorite soup.

A beat.

AN HONGSHAN (V.O.)
(coldly)
Xiaoxiao's work is already in the gallery. Don't make this harder than it needs to be.

AN YIRUO listens to the phone, her expression firm, her eyes revealing confidence. She ends the call, picks up her brush.

title: Belated Judgment
description: A lawyer's daughter, a bar waitress, is assaulted by a powerful young man. When the court dismisses her case amid public humiliation, her father must choose between compromise and conscience as his daughter's life hangs in the balance.
context:
Title: Belated Judgment
Description: A lawyer's daughter, a bar waitress, is assaulted by a powerful young man. When the court dismisses her case amid public humiliation, her father must choose between compromise and conscience as his daughter's life hangs in the balance.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

Through the high windows, a distant figure in white balances on a rooftop edge.

CHEN XIAOYA (20s, bar waitress) sits motionless at the plaintiff's table, her white dress a stark contrast to the dark wood.

At the defense table, SHEN HAO (20s, real estate heir) signs documents with a gold pen.

PRESIDING JUDGE
The charge of rape against Shen Hao is dismissed. Evidence of forcible assault remains inconclusive.

Shen Hao's lawyer hands him a phone. He glances at the screen and smiles.

PRESIDING JUDGE
The plaintiff is hereby notified: the defendant's family has filed civil suits for defamation and extortion. Surrender your passport pending the first hearing.

The gavel strikes. Gallery murmurs swell into audible contempt.

SHEN HAO
(quietly, to Chen Jianjun)
She should have taken the offer.

CHEN JIANJUN
(slamming the table)
She was unconscious. The medical report showed--

SHEN HAO'S LAWYER
Voluntary alcohol consumption. Nothing more.

Shen Hao turns to leave. A COURT OFFICER approaches Xiaoya.

COURT OFFICER
Miss Chen, I'll need your identification.

GALLERY VOICES rise in judgment.

SPECTATOR 1
Bar girls like her always have a price.

SPECTATOR 2
These girls see a rich kid and think it's their lottery ticket.

CHEN XIAOYA
(standing, voice shaking)
I sold drinks. Not myself.

SHEN HAO
(at the door)
Your resume suggests otherwise.

CHEN JIANJUN
(blocking his path)
My daughter worked to pay my medical bills. You think that gives you the right--

SHEN HAO
I think it makes her desperate. And desperation is negotiable.

He exits. The gallery erupts.

SPECTATOR 3
He offered settlement, didn't he? She just wanted more.

SPECTATOR 4
Probably has a dozen sugar daddies.

CHEN JIANJUN
(to the room)
She's twenty-two. She poured whiskey for tourists. Does that make her a prostitute?

SPECTATOR 5
In my day, decent girls became teachers.

SPECTATOR 6
She's got a lawyer for a father and still can't win. Must be guilty.

CHEN XIAOYA
(quietly, to her father)
You fought so hard. Every hearing. Every deposition.

CHEN JIANJUN
Because you're innocent--

CHEN XIAOYA
Then why did I see you take his money?

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
INT. LAW OFFICE - NIGHT (ONE WEEK AGO)

Shen Hao slides a bank card across Chen Jianjun's desk.

SHEN HAO
Surgery's expensive. This covers it. Advise your client that memory can be... uncertain.

Through the door's crack, Chen Xiaoya watches her father's hand hesitate above the card.

BACK TO:

INT. COURTROOM - CONTINUOUS

CHEN XIAOYA
You let me believe. You let me testify.

CHEN JIANJUN
Xiaoya, I returned it. That same night--

CHEN XIAOYA
But you considered it. For three minutes, you considered it.

She walks toward the exit. Spectators' final barbs follow.

SPECTATOR 7
Like father, like daughter.

SPECTATOR 8
Two hundred thousand yuan buys a lot of silence.

CHEN JIANJUN
(to himself)
Not silence. Never silence.

He looks at Shen Hao's empty chair.

EXT. COURTHOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY

Chen Jianjun pushes through REPORTERS.

REPORTER 1
Lawyer Chen, did you advise your daughter to refuse settlement?

REPORTER 2
Your daughter worked at three bars in six months. Comment?

SHEN HAO
(emerging behind him)
Miss Chen was desperate to save her father. We understand.

REPORTER 3
Will you drop the civil suit, Mr. Shen?

SHEN HAO
If they apologize publicly, perhaps. I'm not cruel.

CHEN JIANJUN
You drugged her.

The crowd freezes. Shen Hao's smile tightens.

SHEN HAO
Allegations require proof. Your expert witness couldn't confirm it.

Chen Jianjun's phone BUZZES. He reads a text: "You promised."

A second message appears: a photo of white fabric against concrete.

CHEN JIANJUN
(to Reporter 3)
Which building is in that stream?

REPORTER 3
(looking at phone)
Financial district tower. Why?

Chen Jianjun sprints down the steps. Shen Hao watches, then taps his phone.

SHEN HAO
(into phone)
Make sure she doesn't jump before she recants.

He pockets the phone. In the distance, Chen Jianjun's figure grows smaller.

SHEN HAO
(to no one)
Desperation is so predictable.

title: Don't Disturb If Not Sincere
description: A middle-aged woman faces harsh judgment from male contestants on a senior dating show, until an unexpected suitor arrives.
context:
Title: Don't Disturb If Not Sincere
Description: A middle-aged woman faces harsh judgment from male contestants on a senior dating show, until an unexpected suitor arrives.

INT. STUDIO - NIGHT

Dazzling stage lights pulse rhythmically. The audience murmurs with anticipation.

HOST (V.O.)
Welcome to "Don't Disturb If Not Sincere"! Let's meet tonight's first guest.

SU LIZHEN, 48, walks to center stage in a simple charcoal dress, her hands steady but her smile slightly strained.

SU LIZHEN
Hello. I'm Su Lizhen. I keep a small garden and try to stay active.

MALE CONTESTANT A, 55, polished but predatory, leans forward and presses his light.

MALE CONTESTANT A
Forty-eight? Blunt question—are you even still... you know, physically capable?

Scattered laughter ripples through the male contestants' area.

SU LIZHEN
I manage just fine. Though I notice most of you look to be in your fifties and sixties yourselves.

MALE CONTESTANT A
Different calculus for men. We have time. You, at your age—

SU LIZHEN
(coolly)
I think I've answered enough about my biology.

MALE CONTESTANT B, 62, gentle-eyed but with a desperate edge, presses his light.

MALE CONTESTANT B
I kept my light on. You seem... kind. My daughters are grown. I was hoping, perhaps, for a son to carry the name.

SU LIZHEN
(quietly)
I'm sterilized. Medical reasons.

MALE CONTESTANT B
(deflating)
Oh. I see. I... I should turn off my light then.

MALE CONTESTANT C, 58, nervous, clears his throat.

MALE CONTESTANT C
I don't mind age. But my startup needs capital. Do you have... assets?

SU LIZHEN stares at him, saying nothing.

INT. CHAIRMAN'S OFFICE - DAY

QIU SHUSEN, 65, distinguished, reviews financial reports. His daughter QIU DONGQIU, 32, bursts in with a tablet.

QIU DONGQIU
Dad. You haven't had dinner with anyone but me in six months. I submitted your profile.

QIU SHUSEN
A dating show? I'm the chairman of Zhongcheng Group. I have board members, not blind dates.

QIU DONGQIU
Mom's been gone three years. You think she'd want this? You, alone in this office until midnight every night?

QIU SHUSEN
(sighs heavily)
I don't need strangers judging my worth on television.

QIU DONGQIU
Then go observe. The production company sent a van. Just... see.

She places a plain gray workman's cap on his desk.
continuation:
INT. LOADING DOCK - DAY

QIU SHUSEN, now in plain gray work clothes, climbs into an unmarked white production van. He hesitates, then pulls the cap low over his eyes.

INT. STUDIO - NIGHT

MALE CONTESTANT D, 60, bureaucratic, peers at a clipboard.

MALE CONTESTANT D
Pension? Medical insurance? What's your monthly income?

MALE CONTESTANT E, 67, tired and irritable, crosses his arms.

MALE CONTESTANT E
My daughter-in-law just had twins. Can you cook? Manage a household?

MALE CONTESTANT D

title: Heaven's Favored Son
description: A young celestial being, favored by the Heavenly Dao itself, accidentally falls to the mortal realm and awakens in a bathhouse to find his mortal family in turmoil.
context:
Title: Heaven's Favored Son
Description: A young celestial being, favored by the Heavenly Dao itself, accidentally falls to the mortal realm and awakens in a bathhouse to find his mortal family in turmoil.

EXT. CELESTIAL REALM - DAY

A vast sea of clouds roils beneath towering jade pillars. Golden light fractures through mist.

LI WANWAN (8), a small boy in flowing celestial robes, balances atop a pillar's tip, eyes closed, a simple wooden fan resting on his knees. Around him, the air shimmers with suppressed power.

Four divine figures materialize from golden light: TAISHANG LAOJUN with his longevity staff, ERLANG ZHENJUN with his third eye gleaming, DAOXING TIANZUN bearing a jade tablet, and WENQU XINGJUN holding a calligraphy brush.

LI WANWAN's eyes snap open. He doesn't turn.

LI WANWAN
You're late.

The four deities flinch collectively. DAOXING TIANZUN's jade tablet cracks in his grip.

DAOXING TIANZUN
Forgive us, Little Master. The Eastern Star needed realigning—

LI WANWAN
(fanning himself lazily)
I said I'd practice my new technique on you today.

He flicks the fan. A single, delicate petal of golden flame drifts toward them.

The four deities VANISH in a panic, reappearing a hundred yards away—except WENQU XINGJUN, whose beard singes.

WENQU XINGJUN
(inspecting his beard)
Seventeen millennia of cultivation... singed by a child with a fan.

LI WANWAN pouts. He hops down, misjudges the distance—

LI WANWAN
Ouch!

—and vanishes into the clouds. His fan spirals upward. A final golden spark flickers, then dies.

INT. MORTAL BATHHOUSE - DAY

Steam hangs thick. Tiled walls drip with condensation.

LI WANWAN lies on a massage bed, now in a faded sweater and patched jeans. He jolts awake, clutching his head. A wooden fan—identical to the celestial one—sits clutched in his hand.

MAN A (O.S.)
Old Liu's luck turned yesterday. Won three months' wages at cards.

MAN B (O.S.)
Take me next time. My daughter needs school fees.

LI WANWAN stares at the fan. It feels wrong—heavy, powerless. He touches his chest, feeling a strange hollowness.

LI WANWAN
(whispering)
Where... am I?

A FEMALE ATTENDANT ushers out two customers, her smile tired but warm.

FEMALE ATTENDANT
Come again. We'll have hot water waiting.

ZHOU XIUFANG (30s), calloused hands and quiet eyes, approaches with a steaming towel. She freezes seeing LI WANWAN awake.

ZHOU XIUFANG
Wanwan?

She kneels beside him, pressing the warm towel to his forehead. Her fingers tremble slightly.

ZHOU XIUFANG
(softly)
You fell asleep in the changing room again. Here—

She produces a bamboo basket covered with a red cloth. Inside, three eggs nestle like treasures.
continuation:
ZHOU XIUFANG
Your teacher said you fainted at school. I saved these from our hens. Eat one. Please.

LI WANWAN looks at her. A memory surfaces: this same face, younger, offering him a candied hawthorn in winter. The memory feels like his own and borrowed at once.

LI WANWAN (V.O.)
Mother.

ZHOU XIUFANG's smile fades as laughter erupts at the entrance. LI ZHENDONG (40s), glasses crooked and tie loosened, stumbles in with ZHAO MENGJIE (20s), her designer bag clashing with the humble setting.

LI ZHENDONG
(shouting)
Boss! Couple's room. Now!

ZHAO MENGJIE
(adjusting his tie)
We don't need service, darling. Just privacy.

ZHOU XIUFANG stands, smoothing her apron. Her back straightens with quiet dignity.

ZHOU XIUFANG
I'm the attendant today. Private room's twenty yuan.

She meets LI ZHENDONG's eyes. Recognition hits him like a slap.

LI ZHENDONG
...Xiufang? What're you— You work here?

He looks from her to LI WANWAN. Comprehension dawns, then twists into something ugly.

LI ZHENDONG
(low, dangerous)
You're hiding my son in this... place? While I'm paying your rent?

LI WANWAN stands, the wooden fan gripped tight. Another memory: this man, younger, taking the hawthorn, laughing. Not cruel—just careless.

LI WANWAN (V.O.)
Father.

LI ZHENDONG
(pointing at LI WANWAN)
He's mine. I'm taking him.

ZHOU XIUFANG
(surprisingly firm)
 courts gave him to me. You signed the papers.

LI ZHENDONG laughs, a broken sound.

LI ZHENDONG
Courts? I owe more than I own. Mengjie's family needs an heir. A clean one.

He grabs LI WANWAN's wrist. The boy's eyes flash—not with celestial power, but with mortal fury.

LI WANWAN
Let go.

Something in his voice makes LI ZHENDONG pause. The lights flicker. The steam swirls.

LI WANWAN steps between his parents, facing his father. He looks small, but his shadow stretches wrong—tall, winged, impossibly large.

LI ZHENDONG stares at the shadow, then at his son's eyes. He sees something ancient and terrible looking back.

LI ZHENDONG
(releasing him, voice shaking)
What... what are you?

LI WANWAN's shadow snaps back to normal. He smiles, a child's smile with edges like broken glass.

LI WANWAN
I'm your son.

He touches the wooden fan to his father's chest. LI ZHENDONG stumbles back as if pushed by a hurricane.

ZHOU XIUFANG watches, not with fear, but with something like recognition.

FADE OUT.

title: Heaven-Sent Little Ancestor, Five and a Half Years Old
description: A young girl with a special bloodline that causes misfortune when she praises people is sent by her master to find a father who can resolve her fate.
context:
Title: Heaven-Sent Little Ancestor, Five and a Half Years Old
Description: A young girl with a special bloodline that causes misfortune when she praises people is sent by her master to find a father who can resolve her fate.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

JIANG NING lies in a hospital bed with a cast on his leg. LITTLE YU'ER sits on a small stool beside the bed, crying.

LITTLE YU'ER
(crying)
Master, I just wanted to praise you. I didn't mean to make you fall from the tree.

JIANG NING
(resigned)
Even you ended up hospitalized.

LITTLE YU'ER
(wailing)
What am I going to do from now on?

JIANG NING
(comforting, stroking Little Yu'er's head)
Good girl, your master doesn't blame you. I don't blame you.

LITTLE YU'ER
(breaking into a smile through tears)
I knew it! Master has the best heart!

Suddenly, flame effects emanate from LITTLE YU'ER's hands.

LITTLE YU'ER
(panicking)
Master, I said the wrong thing again!

JIANG NING immediately clutches his chest, his expression pained.

JIANG NING
(shouting)
Nurse! Nurse! My chest, my chest hurts so much!

A NURSE runs into the room.

NURSE
What's wrong?

The NURSE takes out a stethoscope to examine JIANG NING.

JIANG NING
(in pain)
Why does my heart feel like it's burning alive?

LITTLE YU'ER
(earnestly)
Nurse, my master's heart has been bad for a long time. His heart is broken, he's going to die!

NURSE
(panicking)
This is serious, I'll get the doctor!

The NURSE turns to leave but is stopped by JIANG NING.

JIANG NING
(immediately sitting up, back to normal)
Wait, Nurse! My heart is fine now, it doesn't hurt anymore.

The NURSE turns back, puzzled, and checks again with the stethoscope. Everything is normal. She angrily removes the stethoscope.

NURSE
(sternly)
The hospital is not a place for your games. You can't joke about things like this!

The NURSE leaves angrily.

JIANG NING
(embarrassed)
I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

JIANG NING looks at LITTLE YU'ER with a serious expression.

JIANG NING
Your ability to make words come true is getting stronger and stronger now.

LITTLE YU'ER
(lowering her head)
I'm sorry, Master. I caused trouble again.

JIANG NING
From now on, you can't go around praising people randomly. Whoever you praise becomes unlucky. The abbots are in critical condition because of your praise.

JIANG NING
We've exhausted our funds.

JIANG NING
(thinking)
So, Master has decided to find a father for your special bloodline.

LITTLE YU'ER
(surprised)
Find a father?

JIANG NING
That's right. The father your master is finding for you is wealthy and powerful. He'll withstand your blessing. Hopefully his fortune can resolve your bloodline's deadly tribulation.
continuation:
INT. DARK ROOM - NIGHT

A MAN lies on the ground, being beaten by SHEN JUN's subordinates. SHEN JUN, wearing a red suit, watches coldly.

MAN
(groveling on the ground)
Young Master, Young Master, please spare me this once! I won't dare do it again!

SHEN JUN steps on the man's hand.

SHEN JUN
You won't have a chance for a next time.

The SUBORDINATES continue beating the man. QIN TIANQI walks in.

QIN TIANQI
Big Brother, he was just confused by money for a moment. Teaching him a lesson is enough. If someone actually dies, it won't be good for the company's reputation.

SHEN JUN
We're leaving.

SHEN JUN and one subordinate turn and leave.

QIN TIANQI
(to the remaining subordinates)
Alright, stop hitting him. Get him to the hospital quickly.

After QIN TIANQI leaves, two black-suited BODYGUARDS gossip.

BODYGUARD A
The Second Young Master is still kind-hearted. The First Young Master is too ruthless.

BODYGUARD B
With that temper, how will he take over the company in the future?

QIN TIANQI stands not far away, a smug smile on his lips.

QIN TIANQI
(to himself)
I think in the future, the whole company will probably end up in the Second Young Master's hands.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

JIANG NING and LITTLE YU'ER hide in the bushes by the roadside.

JIANG NING
(whispering)
Hey, Little Yu'er, look, that's President Shen's car. Go quickly.

LITTLE YU'ER immediately runs out from the bushes and throws herself onto the hood of a stationary black sedan.

JIANG NING
(covering his face, desperately)
Oh heavens! The car hasn't even moved yet. Hua Xiaoyu, you're staging an accident too early!

LITTLE YU'ER
(rolling on the hood)
Ow! Ow!

SHEN JUN walks out of the hotel, sees LITTLE YU'ER on the car, and frowns.

SHEN JUN
Whose child are you? Where are your parents?

LITTLE YU'ER jumps down from the car, runs up to SHEN JUN, and points.

LITTLE YU'ER
Daddy!

SHEN JUN looks shocked and stunned.

That's right. The father your master is finding for you is wealthy and powerful. He'll withstand your blessing. Hopefully his fortune can resolve your bloodline's deadly tribulation.

INT. DARK ROOM - NIGHT

A MAN lies on the ground, being beaten by SHEN JUN's subordinates. SHEN JUN, wearing a red suit, watches coldly.

MAN
(groveling on the ground)
Young Master, Young Master, please spare me this once! I won't dare do it again!

SHEN JUN steps on the man's hand.

SHEN JUN
You won't have a chance for a next time.

The SUBORDINATES continue beating the man. QIN TIANQI walks in.

QIN TIANQI
Big Brother, he was just confused by money for a moment. Teaching him a lesson is enough. If someone actually dies, it won't be good for the company's reputation.

SHEN JUN
We're leaving.

SHEN JUN and one subordinate turn and leave.

QIN TIANQI
(to the remaining subordinates)
Alright, stop hitting him. Get him to the hospital quickly.

After QIN TIANQI leaves, two black-suited BODYGUARDS gossip.

BODYGUARD A
The Second Young Master is still kind-hearted. The First Young Master is too ruthless.

BODYGUARD B
With that temper, how will he take over the company in the future?

QIN TIANQI stands not far away, a smug smile on his lips.

QIN TIANQI
(to himself)
I think in the future, the whole company will probably end up in the Second Young Master's hands.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

JIANG NING and LITTLE YU'ER hide in the bushes by the roadside.

JIANG NING
(whispering)
Hey, Little Yu'er, look, that's President Shen's car. Go quickly.

LITTLE YU'ER immediately runs out from the bushes and throws herself onto the hood of a stationary black sedan.

JIANG NING
(covering his face, desperately)
Oh heavens! The car hasn't even moved yet. Hua Xiaoyu, you're staging an accident too early!

LITTLE YU'ER
(rolling on the hood)
Ow! Ow!

SHEN JUN walks out of the hotel, sees LITTLE YU'ER on the car, and frowns.

SHEN JUN
Whose child are you? Where are your parents?

LITTLE YU'ER jumps down from the car, runs up to SHEN JUN, and points.

LITTLE YU'ER
Daddy!

SHEN JUN looks shocked and stunned.

title: Fortune Baby's Destiny
description: A young girl cursed with bad luck must leave her temple home to find her destined family and break the curse that affects all around her.
context:
Title: Fortune Baby's Destiny
Description: A young girl cursed with bad luck must leave her temple home to find her destined family and break the curse that affects all around her.

INT. DILAPIDATED TEMPLE - DAY

A dusty sunbeam cuts through the temple. FU BAO (8) sits on a cushion, perfectly still.

MASTER SHAN YUAN (O.S.)
Fu Bao.

FU BAO opens her eyes.

FU BAO
Master?

MASTER SHAN YUAN (60s), robes frayed at the edges, hurries in clutching a bowl of rice.

MASTER SHAN YUAN
Look. Actual alms.

He offers it. A silver ingot drops in. They watch it harden into stone. Neither reacts—it's routine.

Master sighs, then produces a steamed bun from his sleeve.

MASTER SHAN YUAN
Plan B.

He turns toward the altar. His foot catches the threshold. He stumbles. The bun arcs through the air, petrifying before it lands.

FU BAO
Master!

She catches his elbow. For a moment, she just holds him steady.

FU BAO
(quietly)
I'll mend the threshold.

MASTER SHAN YUAN
The threshold is fine.

He straightens with a wince.

FU BAO (V.O.)
Three brothers gone. Two winters without worshippers. Master says the temple follows the seasons, but I know which season I brought.

MASTER SHAN YUAN
What did I teach you about cause and effect?

FU BAO
That they're tangled like kites.

MASTER SHAN YUAN
Find where your string leads. It untangles everything.

A roof tile SHATTERS beside them. This, too, is routine.

But then Master flexes his fingers. The tips crumble to dust.

FU BAO
(staring)
Master—

MASTER SHAN YUAN
The mountain is done with me, Little Fortune. It needs you to leave.

FU BAO
I can try harder. I'll—

MASTER SHAN YUAN
Then I'll be dust by winter. Is that what you want?

Fu Bao's lip trembles. She shakes her head.

MASTER SHAN YUAN
(softening)
Find the family that shares your name. They'll be the ones who need you most.

He draws three yellow talismans. Presses them into her palm.

MASTER SHAN YUAN
One for true danger. That's all I can anchor from here.

FU BAO
What if I can't find them?

MASTER SHAN YUAN
What if you can?

He turns her toward the gate.

Fu Bao hesitates, then kneels. Three quick kowtows. She doesn't look back as she walks out.

Master Shan Yuan watches her go, his hand still crumbling.
continuation:
EXT. MOUNTAIN PATH - DAY

The HE family bounces in a donkey cart. WU CHUNHUA (40s) counts coins. LI XIUE (50s) sits rigid. HE DA JIANG (30s) drives. HE DA SHAN (28) lounges.

WU CHUNHUA
Six hundred wen. For the risk.

LI XIUE
We agreed on four hundred.

WU CHUNHUA
That was before your pig died. Bad luck has a price.

HE DA JIANG
(quietly)
The pig was sick.

WU CHUNHUA
The village calls it cursed. My cart, my rules.

HE DA SHAN
Just pay her, Big Brother. It's not like fortune favors you.

LI XIUE
A hundred wen for the return. Not one more.

WU CHUNHUA
Ha! Your eldest dead, your second sick—who else would take your grain? Who else would take you?

LI XIUE
You go too far!

HE DA JIANG
(firmly)
Enough.

The donkey STUMBLES. The cart jerks to a halt.

HE DA SHAN
Watch the road!

HE DA JIANG
(staring ahead)
There's a child.

FU BAO stands in the path, robes too big, smile too bright. Like she's holding something back.

HE DA SHAN
Perfect. More bad luck.

Silence.

FU BAO
Excuse me. Are you the He family?

Li Xiue's breath catches. He Da Jiang's knuckles whiten on the reins.

FU BAO
I think I'm supposed to come with you.

A long beat. The wind moves through the trees.

WU CHUNHUA
(coldly amused)
A hundred wen and you can have the whole lot of them. They're good at finding strays.

Fu Bao's gaze never leaves Li Xiue's face. Searching.

HE DA JIANG
(to his wife, low)
We can't even feed our own.

LI XIUE
(considering Fu Bao)
We've lost enough.

She doesn't reach for Fu Bao. But she doesn't turn away.

FU BAO
Thank you.

She climbs into the cart. The axle CREAKS. The donkey brays again, but Wu Chunhua flicks the reins, and they roll forward.

Fu Bao sits very still among them, holding her breath. Then she looks up and meets Li Xiue's eyes.

Her smile is real this time. And desperate. And hopeful. All at once.

title: The Prince's Manor
description: Over two thousand years ago, a loyal general pledges eternal devotion to a woman destined to become Crown Princess, but betrayal and tragedy await them both.
context:
Title: The Prince's Manor
Description: Over two thousand years ago, a loyal general pledges eternal devotion to a woman destined to become Crown Princess, but betrayal and tragedy await them both.

TITLE CARD: THE PRINCE'S MANOR - OVER 2000 YEARS AGO

EXT. PRINCE'S MANOR CORRIDOR - TWILIGHT

SHENG WEIRAN and SHEN MUBAI stand at the corridor's edge, their armor catching the last light. The weight of unspoken history hangs between them.

SHENG WEIRAN
The Emperor's edict arrives tomorrow. I'll be named Crown Princess. After fifteen years of fighting beside you... is this truly all you have to say?

SHEN MUBAI
(struggling to keep his voice steady)
My duty doesn't change with titles. I will protect the Crown Princess with my life. As I have always done.

SHENG WEIRAN
(quietly fierce)
I didn't ask about your duty. I asked about you.

SHEN MUBAI meets her eyes for a heartbeat, then deliberately breaks contact. He kneels, drawing his sword in a fluid motion—the blade flashes between them.

SHEN MUBAI
(formal, hollow)
The Crown Princess must not disobey the Emperor. Your honor is the empire's honor. But if you ever turn back... I will be behind you.

SHENG WEIRAN watches him kneel, understanding the gulf his words create. She turns away before he can see her face crumble.

SHENG WEIRAN
(softly, to herself)
I understand.

INT. SHENG WEIRAN'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

SHENG WEIRAN sleeps fitfully. The door lock—visible in the foreground—has been cleanly broken.

A strange man, LOVER, materializes from the shadows. His fingers, cold as iron, trace her cheek. He takes her hand, pressing something into her palm.

SHENG WEIRAN
(mumbling in her sleep)
Mubai...

She jerks awake. The LOVER smiles—a predator's expression.

SHENG WEIRAN
(terror mixing with confusion)
The guards—how did you—

LOVER
(lifting her hand to show a jade token pressed against her skin)
The Crown Prince sends his regards, my beloved consort.

The door explodes inward. The CROWN PRINCE enters, flanked by soldiers holding torches. His eyes fix on the token in her hand.

CROWN PRINCE
(oiling rage with triumph)
Sheng Weiran.

SHENG WEIRAN scrambles backward, the token slipping from her fingers. It clatters to the floor—identical to the one the Prince wears.

CROWN PRINCE
I offered you legitimacy. My father's favor. And you repay me with this?

SHENG WEIRAN
(desperate, seeing the trap)
Your Highness, I was drugged! The wine—

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
INT. VICTORY BANQUET HALL - PREVIOUS NIGHT

The CROWN PRINCE personally pours wine for SHENG WEIRAN, his thumb pressing a white powder against the cup's rim.

CROWN PRINCE
(charming)
To the hero of Great Jin.

She drinks. He watches.

END FLASHBACK.

SHENG WEIRAN
(whisper)
The rebellion is over. My family's army is the threat now.

CROWN PRINCE
(coldly pleased)
The Sheng name is too powerful. But an adulterous Crown Princess? Her name will be erased. Guards—execute her.

Soldiers advance. SHEN MUBAI crashes through the window, glass shattering. He moves like a storm, his sword taking two soldiers in the opening heartbeat. But more pour through the door.

A blade finds his back. He staggers.

SHENG WEIRAN
(scream)
Mubai!

SHEN MUBAI drops to his knees before her, blood seeping through his armor. She catches him, her hands coming away red.

SHEN MUBAI
(barely audible)
I broke my vow. I turned back.

Their eyes meet. For the first time, no duty stands between them.

CROWN PRINCE
(raising his sword)
How touching. Let history remember you together.

He drives his blade through SHEN MUBAI's chest. The sword's tip emerges through SHENG WEIRAN's back. Their blood mingles on the floor.

SHENG WEIRAN's hand finds SHEN MUBAI's as the light leaves her eyes.

TRANSITION TO MODERN DAY

Time-space bleeds through blood—ancient red fades to neon.

INT. WALK-IN CLOSET - DAY

SHENG WEIRAN in modern dress is pinned against the wall by SHEN MUBAI in modern dress, his hand around her throat.

SHENG WEIRAN
(struggling)
Mubai...

title: The Lady's Rebellious Nature
description: A modern woman finds herself transported into an ancient world after reading a mysterious novel, where she must navigate danger and romance with seven attendants.
context:
Title: The Lady's Rebellious Nature
Description: A modern woman finds herself transported into an ancient world after reading a mysterious novel, where she must navigate danger and romance with seven attendants.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

Black screen. White Song typeface text: Episode One

A woman in ancient costume (THE LADY) lies unconscious on fallen leaves.

A BLACK-CLAD MASKED MAN crouches down and reaches out to check THE LADY's breath.

MASKED MAN (V.O.)
No breath. The poison worked.

The MASKED MAN begins searching THE LADY's body.

MASKED MAN (V.O.)
The Linglong Mirror must be on her.

Suddenly, THE LADY opens her eyes and sits up abruptly. She grabs his wrist. The MASKED MAN stumbles back in shock.

THE LADY (V.O.)
The last thing I remember—a truck's headlights. Then darkness. This isn't a hospital.

MONTAGE:

INT. CAR - NIGHT

A woman in modern clothes sits in the driver's seat, eyes vacant. A book lies open on the passenger seat, pages glowing.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Yuewen Platinum author Nangong Qiuyue's new work "The Lady's Rebellious Nature" is now available.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

A man types on a laptop, screen showing the same book.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
They say the final chapter binds your fate. They say you wake as the Lady herself.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

THE LADY runs through the forest in panic.

THE LADY
(screaming)
No—this isn't real!

END MONTAGE.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

THE LADY and the MASKED MAN face off.

MASKED MAN
Where is the Linglong Mirror?

THE LADY
I don't know what you're—

MASKED MAN
Then I'll take it from your corpse.

The MASKED MAN grabs her wrist. She twists free and kicks at him.

THE LADY
I'm not your damsel!

The MASKED MAN catches her ankle, sending her sprawling. He draws his sword.

MASKED MAN
You're whatever I say you are.

He swings. A CRIMSON FAN snaps open, catching the blade. The ATTENDANT appears.

MASKED MAN
The Qiushui fan!

ATTENDANT
I'm taking the Lady home.

The ATTENDANT and MASKED MAN engage in fierce combat. Blades flash, the fan whirls.

After an intense fight, the ATTENDANT drives off the MASKED MAN.

The ATTENDANT runs to THE LADY, who clutches her arm.

ATTENDANT
My lady! Your arm—

THE LADY
Who are you?

ATTENDANT
Your seventh attendant. San.

THE LADY
I don't need saving.

SAN
smiles faintly.

SAN
You need a guide.

The ATTENDANT holds the LADY, his expression full of concern.

FADE OUT.

title: Madam's Obedience Is All an Act
description: On a stormy night, a woman drugged at a party seeks help from a mysterious CEO in his car, leading to an unexpected encounter that changes her life three months later.
context:
Title: Madam's Obedience Is All an Act
Description: On a stormy night, a woman drugged at a party seeks help from a mysterious CEO in his car, leading to an unexpected encounter that changes her life three months later.

EXT. RAINY ROADSIDE - NIGHT

A thunderstorm rages. A Rolls-Royce is parked by the roadside, headlights on.

ON SCREEN: Is Madam's Obedience All an Act?

SHENG JINGYAN (President of Shengshi Group) sits in the back seat, expressionless.

YU ZHENG (biological daughter of the Yu family), wearing an evening gown, walks through the rain in a dazed state. She approaches the Rolls-Royce, opens the door, and gets in.

INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - NIGHT

YU ZHENG and SHENG JINGYAN sit in the back seat. The atmosphere is charged.

YU ZHENG
Save me.

SHENG JINGYAN
You've been drugged.

YU ZHENG moves closer to SHENG JINGYAN and pushes him down onto the seat.

YU ZHENG
Then don't make me beg.

YU ZHENG kisses SHENG JINGYAN. He hesitates, then responds with controlled intensity.

Outside the car, SECRETARY LIN (Sheng Jingyan's secretary) holds an umbrella, watching the car with concern.

Inside the car, YU ZHENG lies on the seat, looking weak. SHENG JINGYAN looks down at her.

SHENG JINGYAN
This won't be forgotten.

SHENG JINGYAN kisses YU ZHENG again.
continuation:
EXT. RAINY ROADSIDE - NIGHT

YU ZHENG exits the car, holding a black umbrella, walking barefoot through puddles. She takes out her phone and sends a message.

YU ZHENG (V.O.)
Trace this plate. Every detail.

YU ZHENG turns and walks away.

MONTAGE

ON SCREEN: Three Months Later

Daytime cityscape.

INT. BUBBLE TEA SHOP - DAY

YU ZHENG, wearing a staff apron, works behind the counter. She unconsciously touches her abdomen, lost in thought.

YU ZHENG (V.O.)
Beating the odds, one day at a time.

INT. HOSPITAL - DAY

The DOCTOR hands an ultrasound report to YU ZHENG.

DOCTOR
Three months. With your condition, the risks are substantial.

YU ZHENG
(looking at the image)
So is my tolerance for them.

INT. BUBBLE TEA SHOP - DAY

YU ZHENG holds a cocktail shaker, distracted.

Zhengzheng! Zhengzheng! What are you thinking about? It's time to get off work.

YU ZHENG
Nothing. You go ahead. I'll clean up.

QIAOQIAO
Then I'm leaving. Bye-bye.

After QIAOQIAO leaves, YU ZHENG cleans the counter alone, still deep in thought.

YU ZHENG
(to herself)
Forget it. I'll think about it later. Time to go home.

INT. YU FAMILY VILLA - DAY

YU ZHENG returns home. As she enters the living room, a glass shatters at her feet.

FATHER YU stands in the center of the living room, glaring at her. MOTHER YU and another GIRL sit on the sofa.

FATHER YU
You still have the face to come back! The eldest daughter of the Yu family, shaking bubble tea outside—you've completely disgraced our family!

YU ZHENG stands at the entrance, looking at her father expressionlessly. Her phone buzzes.

ON SCREEN: "Shengshi Group CEO: Sheng Jingyan. Direct line: Secured."

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Female Boss Lifts Me to Success After Heartbreak
description: A skilled massage therapist from a family tradition finds himself in an awkward situation when his technique is misunderstood by his client, a female boss.
context:
Title: The Female Boss Lifts Me to Success After Heartbreak
Description: A skilled massage therapist from a family tradition finds himself in an awkward situation when his technique is misunderstood by his client, a female boss.

INT. MASSAGE ROOM - DAY

HU LING lies face down on a massage table, tension visible in her shoulders. Massage therapist CHEN ZHE works on her calves with practiced hands.

CHEN ZHE
Pressure okay?

HU LING
(muffled)
Harder. I've had three all-nighters this week.

CHEN ZHE
You really need to take care of your—
(catches himself)
—Sorry. Just a therapist, not your doctor.

HU LING
(softening slightly)
My doctor just tells me to meditate. As if I have time.

CHEN ZHE moves to her back, applying pressure to a specific point. Hu Ling flinches.

HU LING
Ow! What was that?

CHEN ZHE
Liver 3 point. Stress accumulates there. It's... intense.

HU LING
(breathing heavily)
Feels like you're prying open a door I locked on purpose.

CHEN ZHE
Sometimes the body keeps what the mind won't face.

Hu Ling goes still. The words hit too close.

HU LING
(suddenly cold)
Stop. Just... stop.

She sits up abruptly, wrapping the towel around herself. Chen steps back, confused.

CHEN ZHE
Did I hurt you?

HU LING
(avoiding his eyes)
I said stop. Session's over.

She exits quickly. Chen stands alone, bewildered.
continuation:
INT. MASSAGE ROOM - LATER

Chen cleans the table, frustrated. His phone shows overdue rent notices. He opens a worn photo album - his grandfather's clinic, his father's hands working. He touches his own calloused fingers.

CHEN ZHE
(softly, to himself)
Some doors should stay locked...

His phone rings. He doesn't answer.

INT. HU LING'S OFFICE - NIGHT

Hu Ling sits at her desk, scrolling through Chen's website on her laptop. His bio mentions "four generations of trauma-informed bodywork." She watches a testimonial video where an elderly client praises his gentle approach.

Her eyes fall on a framed photo - her wedding day, face scratched out with marker. She closes her eyes, remembering her ex-husband's words: "You don't let anyone in."

She picks up her phone.

INT. MASSAGE ROOM - DAY

A week later. Chen prepares the room, looking defeated. The door opens. Hu Ling stands there, holding a briefcase.

CHEN ZHE
(startled)
Sister Hu... I didn't expect—

HU LING
(cutting him off)
My divorce finalized yesterday. My lawyer said I need to "release stored tension." Ridiculous advice.

She sets the briefcase on the table.

HU LING
But then I remembered... you knew exactly where I was storing mine.

Chen meets her eyes, sees the vulnerability there.

CHEN ZHE
I can show you how to release it safely.

HU LING
(nodding slowly)
And I can show you something. I've been reviewing your business plan. The one tucked behind your diploma.

Chen blushes.

HU LING
It's terrible. But the core idea—corporate wellness partnerships—that's solid. My company needs a provider.

She opens the briefcase, revealing a contract.

HU LING
Fifty therapists. Three-year contract. Upfront payment.

Chen stares, unable to speak.

HU LING
But I have one condition. You work on me. Not just my knots. Teach me how to let someone help me.

INT. CHEN'S WELLNESS CENTER - MONTHS LATER

A bustling reception area. Staff in branded uniforms. Chen walks through, confident now. He stops at a private room.

Through the glass, he watches Hu Ling leading a meditation circle for executives. She catches his eye, gives a small, genuine smile.

He smiles back. Two people, both finally unclenched.

title: After Heartbreak, I Rise in the Workplace with My Boss
description: After a painful breakup, Xiao Xi finds support from his female boss as he confronts his ex-girlfriend and begins a new chapter in his career.
context:
Title: After Heartbreak, I Rise in the Workplace with My Boss
Description: After a painful breakup, Xiao Xi finds support from his female boss as he confronts his ex-girlfriend and begins a new chapter in his career.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

XIAO XI and his EX-GIRLFRIEND sit across from each other. The FEMALE BOSS sits beside XIAO XI.

XIAO XI slams the table and stands up, glaring at his EX-GIRLFRIEND.

XIAO XI
I signed the papers. We're done. Why are you here?

EX-GIRLFRIEND
Your mom says you're a mess. I wanted to see if you'd changed your mind.

XIAO XI
I haven't. I'm done.

XIAO XI stands up, walks behind the FEMALE BOSS, and places his hands on her shoulders.

XIAO XI
This is my girlfriend. She trusts me. That's richer than anything.

EX-GIRLFRIEND
(standing up angrily)
Your boss? How convenient. President Sun wants to marry me. He's everything you're not.

XIAO XI
While he's still married? You're still the same.

XIAO XI gets emotional and moves forward. The FEMALE BOSS grabs his wrist to stop him.
continuation:
FEMALE BOSS
(coldly)
You've made your point. Let her leave.

The EX-GIRLFRIEND glares at them, then turns and storms off angrily.

XIAO XI and the FEMALE BOSS watch her leave.

XIAO XI and the FEMALE BOSS sit back down.

XIAO XI
(gratefully)
Sis, thank you for being with me today. If it weren't for you, I wouldn't have known how to break up with her.

FEMALE BOSS
Xiao Xi, she was the one who had a change of heart. Why did you play the bad guy?

XIAO XI
Men need to save face. If she spoke first, how awkward would that be?

FEMALE BOSS
Do you feel better now?

XIAO XI
(relieved)
I'm at peace with it. Life is free from now on.

FEMALE BOSS
I'm glad you're happy. Oh right, there's a meeting in a bit. Come with me and stay sharp.

The FEMALE BOSS's expression becomes serious.

title: Champion: The Queen of Track and Field
description: A mother rushes to bring lunch to her daughter at the training facility, only to witness the harsh treatment her daughter endures from a corrupt coach.
context:
Title: Champion: The Queen of Track and Field
Description: A mother rushes to bring lunch to her daughter at the training facility, only to witness the harsh treatment her daughter endures from a corrupt coach.

EXT. TRAINING FACILITY ENTRANCE - DAY

LI GUIFANG (40s, careworn) clutches a stainless steel lunch box, walking hurriedly.

LI GUIFANG
(shouting)
Shengnan! Shengnan!

A SECURITY GUARD blocks her.

SECURITY GUARD
Whoa, whoa! Training in progress. No entry.

LI GUIFANG
Her lunch. Stomach condition—

SECURITY GUARD
Never heard of her. Orders.

He pockets her ID. She grips the lunchbox, knuckles white.

EXT. TRACK AND FIELD - DAY

STARTER
(voice over)
Ready! Set!

The starting gun fires. WU DI and athletes burst forward. COACH ZHOU WEILIN holds a stopwatch.

ZHOU WEILIN
(shouting)
Drive! Drive!

WU DI crosses the finish line, gasping.

ZHOU WEILIN
Thirteen point six five. Not close.

WU DI
Coach, please. Trials—

ZHOU WEILIN
Provincial level, maybe.

Wu Di steps close, voice dropping.

WU DI
(quietly)
Coach...

He slips a red envelope. Zhou pockets it without looking.

ZHOU WEILIN
(casual)
Hour break. Show me something real.

WU DI
(overjoyed)
Yes! Thank you!

Olympic Director QIN FENG watches from the shade, tablet in hand.

QIN FENG
(muttering)
Interesting process.
continuation:
EXT. FIELD SIDELINE - DAY

ZHOU WEILIN scrolls his phone.

ZHOU WEILIN
Water!

Across the field, WU SHENGNAN runs over, exhausted. LI GUIFANG strains beyond the fence.

WU SHENGNAN
Coach—

ZHOU WEILIN swats the bottle away without looking.

ZHOU WEILIN
Late. Ten laps. No water. Ninety-second pace.

WU SHENGNAN
But—

ZHOU WEILIN
Eleven.

She bites her lip and runs. Qin Feng times her, eyebrows rising.

QIN FENG
(muttering)
Efficient.

EXT. FIELD GRASS - DAY

ZHOU WEILIN eats watermelon. WU SHENGNAN finishes, weaving, hand pressed to her side.

WU SHENGNAN
Eleven.

ZHOU WEILIN
(checking phone)
Thirteen fifty. Bolt would laugh.

He tosses the rind.

ZHOU WEILIN
Twenty more. Sub-thirteen. Or you're off.

WU SHENGNAN
Coach—

ZHOU WEILIN
Gate's open.

Wu Shengnan glances at her mother beyond the fence, then Qin Feng. She swallows and turns back.

Two steps. Her knees buckle. She catches herself. Another step. Collapses.

LI GUIFANG screams from outside the field.

LI GUIFANG
Shengnan!

The lunchbox hits dirt. She's over the fence before anyone moves.

title: Phoenix Seizing Platform (Episode 49)
description: A female emperor faces a conspiracy by her court officials who demand she sacrifice her daughter to appease the heavens during a time of natural disasters.
context:
Title: Phoenix Seizing Platform (Episode 49)
Description: A female emperor faces a conspiracy by her court officials who demand she sacrifice her daughter to appease the heavens during a time of natural disasters.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE ALTAR - DAY

The IMPERIAL EUNUCH reads, his voice trembling against the weight of the words.

EUNUCH
By the Mandate of Heaven, the Emperor decrees: I, as a woman, have inherited the throne, which goes against propriety and has angered the heavens, causing endless natural disasters in our Li Kingdom. Now, heeding the will of the people, the Eldest Princess Xu Han shall be offered as a sacrifice to appease their wrath.

The EMPRESS stands atop the steps, her expression carved from stone.

EMPRESS
(very quiet)
Is this the harmony you promised, Minister Li?

PRIME MINISTER
(kneeling)
Your Majesty is wise and sage.

ALL OFFICIALS
Your Majesty is wise and sage.

EMPRESS
(to herself)
Han'er...

PRIME MINISTER
(rising)
Dusk approaches, Your Majesty. The court grows restless. Some question whether a woman may enter the ancestral temple—delay only feeds their doubts.

EMPRESS
(fury building)
You speak of propriety now? When the rebel banners flew over these walls, I saw no ministers debating rites. I saw men ready to barter the kingdom for their lives.

PRIME MINISTER
A ruler must know when to preserve the state through wisdom, not steel.

EMPRESS
And steel saved you. Yet now you hold my daughter hostage to your "wisdom."

PRIME MINISTER
The princess serves the realm through sacrifice. Guards—bring her.

SOLDIERS seize the YOUNG PRINCESS.

YOUNG PRINCESS
Mother Empress! Save me!

YOUNG PRINCE
(rushing forward)
Minister, I beg you—

The EMPRESS holds her son, her eyes finding EUNUCH WANG at the altar's edge—an old soldier turned servant. His slight nod is almost imperceptible.

EMPRESS
continuation:
(firmly)
Han'er. Keep the hairpin safe.

The YOUNG PRINCESS touches the golden pin in her hair, understanding.

EUNUCH WANG whistles sharply. The SOLDIERS holding the princess are jostled by LOYAL GUARDS from the crowd. EUNUCH WANG snatches the princess.

EUNUCH WANG
Your Majesty—go!

EMPRESS
(handing him the hairpin)
Proof of our reunion.

EUNUCH WANG
(taking it)
Your Majesty...

PRIME MINISTER
(screaming)
Archers! Shoot them!

Arrows fly. EUNUCH WANG shields the princess, taking two bolts. He stumbles but runs.

YOUNG PRINCESS
(screaming)
Mother!

EMPRESS
(to her son, fierce)
Close your eyes.

A SOLDIER rushes forward, clutching a bloodied shoulder.

SOLDIER
Your Majesty! The Eastern Barracks—your seal reached them! They hold the west gate!

The EMPRESS picks up a fallen blade, testing its weight. A cold, precise smile forms.

EMPRESS
Then let us cleanse the court.

EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

Rain pours. EUNUCH WANG crawls into a humble courtyard, the YOUNG PRINCESS unconscious in his arms. He collapses.

A SERVANT opens the door, lantern shaking. He sees the imperial insignia on Wang's blood-soaked armor.

SERVANT
(whispering)
Prime Minister's men... searching every house. Said a traitor escaped. But this is—

EUNUCH WANG
(grabbing his ankle, voice shredded)
Not... traitor... Princess Xu Han... save...

EUNUCH WANG dies. The SERVANT sees the golden hairpin in his hand—imperial workmanship. The YOUNG PRINCESS stirs. The lantern trembles violently.

(to her son, fierce)
Close your eyes.

A SOLDIER rushes forward, clutching a bloodied shoulder.

SOLDIER
Your Majesty! The Eastern Barracks—your seal reached them! They hold the west gate!

The EMPRESS picks up a fallen blade, testing its weight. A cold, precise smile forms.

EMPRESS
Then let us cleanse the court.

EXT. COURTYARD - NIGHT

Rain pours. EUNUCH WANG crawls into a humble courtyard, the YOUNG PRINCESS unconscious in his arms. He collapses.

A SERVANT opens the door, lantern shaking. He sees the imperial insignia on Wang's blood-soaked armor.

SERVANT
(whispering)
Prime Minister's men... searching every house. Said a traitor escaped. But this is—

EUNUCH WANG
(grabbing his ankle, voice shredded)
Not... traitor... Princess Xu Han... save...

EUNUCH WANG dies. The SERVANT sees the golden hairpin in his hand—imperial workmanship. The YOUNG PRINCESS stirs. The lantern trembles violently.

context:
Title: Homecoming
Description: A successful woman struggles between her husband's family obligations and her longing to return to her own parents during the holidays.

MONTAGE

EXT. CITY - DAY

A series of quick cuts showing festive atmosphere:
- A shopping mall filled with red lanterns and spring couplets, crowds moving on escalators.
- Large red lanterns hanging from bare tree branches, swaying in the winter wind.
- A hand placing a red paper-cut "Fu" character on a window, sunlight shining through the cutout.

INT. LUXURY GIFT SHOP - DAY

The shop is lavishly decorated, full of Spring Festival atmosphere. A red banner hangs at the entrance.

LU XIAOMIN, wearing a wool coat and simple scarf, walks into the shop. A CLERK at the entrance nods politely.

CLERK
Welcome, ma'am.

A SNOBBISH CLERK looks LU XIAOMIN up and down, noting her modest accessories.

SNOBBISH CLERK
(quietly, to another clerk)
Another tourist just browsing...

LU XIAOMIN stops at a display of premium gift sets. One open box contains a large ginseng root with a price tag reading 28,888.

LU XIAOMIN
(to herself)
A bit steep for relatives we only see once a year.

SNOBBISH CLERK (approaching)
Miss, this is our premium local ginseng, perfect for gifting. We also have more affordable options in the back.

LU XIAOMIN
(dryly)
I can read the price. Do you have twenty sets?

SNOBBISH CLERK
(stunned)
Twenty...? Of this premium line?

LU XIAOMIN
For the elders. And ten boxes of the tea sets. The ones in the window display.

The SNOBBISH CLERK fumbles for her tablet. A FRIENDLY CLERK immediately steps forward.

FRIENDLY CLERK
Madam, let me assist you with a bulk order. Would you like them delivered?

LU XIAOMIN
No, I'll take them today. For New Year visits.

FRIENDLY CLERK
(voice lowered)
Of course. We'll arrange everything.
continuation:
INT. GIFT SHOP TEA AREA - DAY

LU XIAOMIN sits at a corner table, checking her phone. A TEA MASTER prepares tea beside her.

LU XIAOMIN (on phone)
Editor Li, yes I saw the deposit. The Writers Association event? Same weekend as New Year... I know it's good exposure, but my parents are expecting me. Can we push it to after the holiday?

(pauses)
That's what I'll do then. Family first.

She hangs up and glances at her banking app briefly: balance shows 1,247,836.00 yuan. She closes it, looking tired.

The FRIENDLY CLERK approaches with a clipboard.

FRIENDLY CLERK
Madam, your order totals 485,760 yuan. We can have it ready in two hours.

LU XIAOMIN
Fine. Send them to this address.

She hands over a business card.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

LU XIAOMIN is folding clothes and placing paper-cuts into a suitcase. Her husband QI YAN, wearing a sweater, enters and sits on the bed's edge.

LU XIAOMIN
(almost finished packing)
Train's at nine. Mom's probably making dumplings right now, checking her phone every five minutes.

She looks up, sees QI YAN staring at his shoes.

LU XIAOMIN
What's wrong?

QI YAN
(quietly)
I exchanged our tickets. We're going to my parents' place tomorrow.

LU XIAOMIN
(still processing)
What do you mean 'exchanged'? We talked about this months ago.

QI YAN
I know. But my sister called. Dad's not doing well—his check-up results came back with concerns. Everyone's gathering this year. They want us there.

LU XIAOMIN
(deflating)
You already refunded our tickets?

QI YAN
Last night. I was going to tell you, but you had that deadline.

LU XIAOMIN
(frustrated, but not shouting)
And? Are there any tickets left now?

QI YAN shakes his head. Xiaomin sits down heavily, pulls out her phone to check anyway. Sold out. She stares at the screen.

LU XIAOMIN
(whisper)
I promised them, Yan.

QI YAN
We'll go the day after New Year's. First train. I'll make it right with your dad.

LU XIAOMIN
It's not about making it right. It's about...

She stops, dials her mother. QI YAN watches her, helpless.

LU XIAOMIN (on phone, controlled)
Mom? It's me. About tomorrow...

XIAOMIN'S MOTHER (V.O.)
(understanding already)
No tickets left, is that it?

LU XIAOMIN
...I'm sorry.

XIAOMIN'S MOTHER (V.O.)
(pause, then gently)
Your father said the train schedule looked full this year. He'll still set out your favorite dishes. Second day is good too. We'll wait.

LU XIAOMIN
(hand over mouth, holding back)
Mom, don't wait up. Eat while it's hot.

XIAOMIN'S MOTHER (V.O.)
We're not that hungry anyway. Just... come when you can, Xiaomin.

The line disconnects. Xiaomin holds the phone to her forehead, eyes closed.

QI YAN
(softly)
I'm sorry. I should've asked first.

LU XIAOMIN
(after a long moment)
Second day. No exceptions. And we're staying three full days.

QI YAN
(firmly)
Yes. I'll tell them tonight.

LU XIAOMIN
(leaning into him, exhausted)
She knew, Yan. She already knew.

They sit together in the quiet room, the packed suitcase between them.

EXT. PARENTS' HOME ENTRANCE - DAY

An elderly white-haired mother (XIAOMIN'S MOTHER) stands at the doorway, looking down the empty street, her hand on the doorframe. The table inside is set with dishes growing cold.

title: A Woman's Rebirth (Episode 46)
description: A mother endures mistreatment from her mother-in-law while her husband remains indifferent, as her young daughter is punished unfairly.
context:
Title: A Woman's Rebirth (Episode 46)
Description: A mother endures mistreatment from her mother-in-law while her husband remains indifferent, as her young daughter is punished unfairly.

INT. HOME - DAY

Opening scene. The WIFE huddles on the sofa, QIANQIAN cradled in her arms. Both are tear-streaked, their cries quiet and exhausted.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

The WIFE stirs a pot mechanically, her shoulders slumped in quiet resignation.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

QIANQIAN sits on the carpet, whispering to a worn plush cow.

QIANQIAN
Little cow, time for medicine. All better now.

Her brother DOUDOU rushes over, bigger and bolder, and snatches the toy.

DOUDOU
Mine now!

QIANQIAN scrambles after him.

QIANQIAN
(crying out)
Give it back! That's mine!

QIANQIAN trips and falls hard. The MOTHER-IN-LAW emerges from the bedroom holding a bowl. Seeing DOUDOU on the floor, she gasps.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Doudou! My treasure!

The MOTHER-IN-LAW rushes to help DOUDOU up, checking him thoroughly.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Let Grandma see. Are you hurt?

The MOTHER-IN-LAW whirls on QIANQIAN, her face darkening.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
What have you done? You clumsy, unlucky girl—how dare you hurt your brother!

The MOTHER-IN-LAW yanks QIANQIAN up and shoves her onto the sofa.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Sit there! That mother of yours raised a disrespectful, ungrateful child!

QIANQIAN looks up, her small face set in a defiant glare.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(stabbing a finger)
Don't you look at me like that!

The MOTHER-IN-LAW seizes QIANQIAN, pulling her toward the guest room and slamming the door with a bang.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(shouting)
No manners! Just like your mother!
continuation:
INT. DINING ROOM - DAY

The family sits around the dining table. MOTHER-IN-LAW, DOUDOU, SISTER-IN-LAW, and the husband MINGLIANG. MINGLIANG stares at his phone, indifferent to his surroundings. MOTHER-IN-LAW heaps food onto DOUDOU's plate.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Eat up, my good boy.

SISTER-IN-LAW
Where's the soup? We're waiting.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Soup?

The WIFE comes out carrying a large bowl and places it on the table.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(dismissive)
Can't earn, can't cook. What did my son see in you?

The SISTER-IN-LAW tastes the soup and grimaces.

SISTER-IN-LAW
Salt. Did you empty the whole jar, sister-in-law?

WIFE looks embarrassed, glancing around.

WIFE
Mingliang, where's Qianqian?

MINGLIANG
(without looking up)
Didn't notice.

WIFE
(anxiously)
How could you not notice? Where is she?

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(calmly)
She's reflecting in the back room. She hit Doudou and dared talk back.

WIFE
(in disbelief)
Mom, Qianqian would never—

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(raising her voice)
So I'm a liar now? In my own home?

The WIFE stops arguing. She gets up, worry etched on her face, and walks toward the room.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

The WIFE opens the door to find QIANQIAN facing the wardrobe, her small frame trembling in the dim light.

The WIFE walks over and kneels in front of QIANQIAN. QIANQIAN's face is wet with tears, but she makes no sound.

The WIFE's face crumples, tears falling freely.

The WIFE pulls QIANQIAN tightly into her arms. Mother and daughter cry bitterly together.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Daughters Are Also Family Treasures
description: A mother rewards her daughter for academic success, but the girl's grandfather disapproves and takes drastic action against the child he deems unworthy.
context:
Title: Daughters Are Also Family Treasures
Description: A mother rewards her daughter for academic success, but the girl's grandfather disapproves and takes drastic action against the child he deems unworthy.

EXT. STREET - DAY

ZHOU YUEHONG holds a red cloth bundle containing a necklace.

ZHOU YUEHONG
Xiaojuan, perfect scores on both exams. This is for you.

ZHOU YUEHONG puts the necklace on her daughter CHEN JUAN's neck.

CHEN JUAN
(looking down)
Mom, can you buy me an ice cream?

ZHOU YUEHONG
(delighted)
Of course. Whatever flavor you like.

ZHOU YUEHONG tells CHEN JUAN to wait for her at the shop entrance.

ZHOU YUEHONG
Wait here for me.

ZHOU YUEHONG walks into an ice cream shop. CHEN JUAN stands obediently at the entrance. In the distance, GRANDPA CHEN watches her, then walks over.

GRANDPA CHEN
You think ice cream will fix that cough? Imported junk. Waste of money.

CHEN JUAN
But my cousin always comes to this shop to buy ice cream.

GRANDPA CHEN
Your cousin is a boy. He'll carry on the Chen line. You're just... temporary.

GRANDPA CHEN roughly grabs CHEN JUAN and drags her away.

INT. ICE CREAM SHOP - DAY

ZHOU YUEHONG stands at the counter.

ZHOU YUEHONG
I'd like to buy an ice cream.

CLERK
Twenty yuan each.

ZHOU YUEHONG
(surprised)
That's expensive.

CLERK
This is a foreign brand ice cream. Are you still buying it, ma'am?

ZHOU YUEHONG
(smiling)
Yes. My daughter earned it.

ZHOU YUEHONG counts out money from her wallet and hands it to the CLERK, who gives her the ice cream.

CLERK
Buying it for your daughter, you're really generous, ma'am. When my son turned ten, I couldn't bear to buy him one.

ZHOU YUEHONG
(smiling)
She doesn't ask for much.
continuation:
EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

CHEN JUAN lies motionless by the roadside. A black sedan approaches.

WEI YAN
(inside the car)
Stop, stop, stop!

The car brakes suddenly. WEI YAN gets out and runs to CHEN JUAN's side.

WEI YAN
(anxious)
Little girl? Can you hear me?

WEI YAN picks up CHEN JUAN and runs toward his car.

EXT. ICE CREAM SHOP ENTRANCE - DAY

ZHOU YUEHONG walks out with the ice cream, only to find her daughter gone.

ZHOU YUEHONG
(panicked)
Xiaojuan! Xiaojuan!

She looks around the street, searching anxiously.

EXT. VILLAGE PATH - DAY

ZHOU YUEHONG runs and encounters an OLD WOMAN.

ZHOU YUEHONG
(out of breath)
Auntie, Auntie, have you seen a little girl, about this tall...

OLD WOMAN
A man took her that way.

ZHOU YUEHONG
Which one?

The OLD WOMAN points to GRANDPA CHEN walking in the distance.

OLD WOMAN
Yes, that's him.

ZHOU YUEHONG immediately runs toward GRANDPA CHEN and stops him.

ZHOU YUEHONG
(urgently)
Father, where's Xiaojuan? Have you seen Xiaojuan?

GRANDPA CHEN
(dismissively)
She fell.

ZHOU YUEHONG
(shocked)
What?

The ice cream in ZHOU YUEHONG's hand falls to the ground.

title: After Her Son's Death, Mom Regrets It All
description: A mother loses her son in a hit-and-run orchestrated by her younger daughter. As grief consumes the family, a revelation leads to tragic consequences.
context:
Title: After Her Son's Death, Mom Regrets It All
Description: A mother loses her son in a hit-and-run orchestrated by her younger daughter. As grief consumes the family, a revelation leads to tragic consequences.

INT. ROAD - DAY

FANG RONGRONG waits by the roadside.

FANG MINGCHUAN walks across the street carrying a cake box.

FANG RONGRONG sees FANG MINGCHUAN and waves happily.

FANG RONGRONG
Brother!

A black sedan suddenly starts up and accelerates toward FANG MINGCHUAN.

Accompanied by the piercing sound of brakes, FANG MINGCHUAN is hit and falls to the ground. The cake is destroyed. The vehicle flees the scene.

FANG RONGRONG runs in terror toward FANG MINGCHUAN lying on the ground.

FANG RONGRONG
(crying out)
Brother! Please! Someone help!

INT. FANG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

The living room is set up as a mourning hall with FANG MINGCHUAN's portrait on the table. FANG RONGRONG kneels before the altar, grief-stricken.

FANG SHIWEN supports his grieving wife LIU JING.

FANG SHIWEN
The child is gone. You must take care of yourself.

LIU JING stares at FANG RONGRONG, her grief turning to fury.

LIU JING
(hysterical)
You. You insisted he go.

She breaks free from FANG SHIWEN and pushes FANG RONGRONG to the ground.

FANG SHIWEN
What are you doing!

LIU JING

title: Daughter Reborn to Urge Me to Bet on Cryptocurrency
description: A daughter travels back in time to prevent her father's death and save herself from her mother's betrayal.
context:
Title: Daughter Reborn to Urge Me to Bet on Cryptocurrency
Description: A daughter travels back in time to prevent her father's death and save herself from her mother's betrayal.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

QIN LING'ER lies in a hospital bed, head bandaged, clutching a phone showing a Bitcoin chart and a faded photo of her father QIN BUFAN. Tears stream down her face.

QIN LING'ER (V.O.)
Old Qin... you died for nothing. I lived, but lost everything. If only I'd known about this back then.

FLASHBACK: INT. QIN FAMILY APARTMENT - DAY - TEN YEARS AGO

The cramped apartment is in chaos. QIN BUFAN cowers as TWO DEBT COLLECTORS loom over him. LITTLE LING'ER hides behind a worn sofa.

DEBT COLLECTOR #1
Three months overdue. The boss wants his money.

QIN BUFAN
Please... my daughter's tuition. Just one more week.

DEBT COLLECTOR #2
(grabbing QIN BUFAN's collar)
You'll pay now. Or we take the girl.

LITTLE LING'ER rushes forward.

LITTLE LING'ER
Leave my dad alone!

The collector shoves her back. Her head strikes the coffee table edge. She crumples, blood pooling.

QIN BUFAN
LINGER!

He crawls to her. The collectors hesitate, seeing the blood.

DEBT COLLECTOR #1
She's breathing. But you still owe. We'll be back.

They drop a final notice and exit. QIN BUFAN checks LING'ER's pulse - faint. He sobs with relief.

QIN BUFAN
(to himself)
She's alive... but they'll return. I need money.

He sees his daughter's school laptop - a news article about "digital currency" flickers on screen.

END FLASHBACK
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

QIN LING'ER watches as her mother XIA YUN and her lover ZHOU DONGFEI enter wearing expensive clothes.

XIA YUN
Ling'er, my poor baby. How are you feeling?

QIN LING'ER
(weak but sharp)
Save it. You orchestrated the "accident."

ZHOU DONGFEI
Your mother worries about you. That company is a heavy burden.

XIA YUN
Just sign the power of attorney. Let us handle everything.

She slides documents onto the bed tray. QIN LING'ER sees the notary stamp.

QIN LING'ER
Never... Dad built that company for me.

ZHOU DONGFEI
Your father's dead. And you're clearly not thinking straight.

He reaches for her IV drip. QIN LING'ER sees his intent.

QIN LING'ER
(desperate)
Don't...

The heart monitor flatlines. Time distorts, image flickers.

INT. QIN FAMILY APARTMENT - DAY - TEN YEARS AGO

QIN BUFAN holds the unconscious LITTLE LING'ER, crying. Her eyes snap open - clear, focused, adult.

LITTLE LING'ER
Dad. Stop crying. I'm fine.

She sits up abruptly, seeing the laptop showing Bitcoin at $0.08.

QIN BUFAN
(stunned)
Ling'er?

LITTLE LING'ER
(grabbing his arm)
Dad, listen. Buy Bitcoin. All our savings. Right now.

She pulls him close, whispering urgently.

LITTLE LING'ER
(whispering)
Trust me, Old Qin. This is how we save our lives.

She glances at the door where the debt collectors left, then back at the laptop screen showing the crypto article - their salvation.

title: Daughter, Mom Will Take You Home
description: A mother is reborn after being murdered by her son-in-law and his mistress, and vows to save her daughter and unborn grandson from their deadly scheme.
context:
Title: Daughter, Mom Will Take You Home
Description: A mother is reborn after being murdered by her son-in-law and his mistress, and vows to save her daughter and unborn grandson from their deadly scheme.

INT. CEO OFFICE - DAY

On screen: Character information - CHEN FANG, Chairman of Chen Group.

CHEN FANG sits at her desk, reviewing quarterly reports with a focused expression.

BAO'ER (V.O.)
Mom? Are you there?

CHEN FANG glances at her phone. The caller ID shows "Bao'er." She answers.

BAO'ER (V.O.)
Chengze is insisting on twelve o'clock sharp. The fortune teller said it's the only auspicious time. He's already scheduling the surgery.

Chen Fang's hand tightens on the phone, her knuckles white. A shadow passes over her face.

MONTAGE - FLASHBACK

FAST CUTS:
- JIANG CHENGZE's cold eyes: "Begin the procedure."
- A clock's hands spinning backward in a vortex of light.
- The sound of a flatline monitor.

INT. HOSPITAL MORGUE - DAY (PREVIOUS LIFE)

ON SCREEN: Previous Life - Hospital Morgue

CHEN FANG is bound to a chair, her silk blouse torn, mascara streaking her face. She strains against the ropes.

CHEN FANG
(whispered, shattered)
Bao'er... please...

LIN QIAN, in surgical scrubs, adjusts a lamp over a body on the operating table. Her voice is calm, conversational.

LIN QIAN
She lost consciousness during the delivery. Such a shame. But the baby is... viable.

CHEN FANG's head snaps up, understanding dawning through her grief.

JIANG CHENGZE, in a tailored red shirt, stands near a tray of surgical instruments. He selects a syringe without looking at Chen Fang.

CHEN FANG
(desperate)
That child is your son! Your heir!

JIANG CHENGZE finally turns. His expression is blank, clinical.

JIANG CHENGZE
continuation:
My son needs a brother. Someone compatible. Bao'er was... convenient.

He fills the syringe methodically. The amber liquid glistens.

JIANG CHENGZE
You helped me build an empire, Mother. But empires require sacrifices.

LIN QIAN touches his arm, a gesture of intimate partnership.

LIN QIAN
Don't prolong this. We have preparations to make.

JIANG CHENGZE walks toward Chen Fang. He kneels, brushing a strand of hair from her face with grotesque gentleness.

JIANG CHENGZE
(softly)
Thank you for everything. Rest now.

He injects the syringe into her neck. Chen Fang's eyes widen, her body rigid with paralysis. As darkness creeps in, she hears Lin Qian's voice:

LIN QIAN (O.S.)
Harvest the cord blood first. Then schedule the tissue matching.

CHEN FANG (V.O.)
(internal monologue)
My ambition destroyed her. I gave her to a wolf and called it a good marriage. Jiang Chengze, Lin Qian, you took my daughter and her child. If fate gives me another chance, I'll bury you both.

INT. CEO OFFICE - DAY

CHEN FANG gasps awake, gripping her desk edge like a lifeline. Her breath comes in ragged bursts. She touches her neck—no needle mark.

CHEN FANG
(strangled)
Bao'er...

She scrambles for her phone. The screen glows: 10:39, October 9th.

CHEN FANG
(awestruck)
October 9th. The day before...

She looks up, her face transforming from terror to iron resolve.

CHEN FANG
(quietly)
They're still alive. And this time...

She faces the window, her reflection superimposed over the city skyline.

CHEN FANG
(voice hardening)
...I'll burn your kingdom to ash.

title: Ma'am, Please Move Your Car (Episode 29)
description: A trauma surgeon's attempt to save a child is blocked by an illegally parked car—owned by the boy's own mother, who refuses to move it.
context:
Title: Ma'am, Please Move Your Car (Episode 29)
Description: A trauma surgeon's attempt to save a child is blocked by an illegally parked car—owned by the boy's own mother, who refuses to move it.

EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

Torrential rain hammers the asphalt. Urban canyons of glass and steel disappear into low clouds.

RADIO BROADCAST (V.O.)
...Severe rainstorm warning remains. Emergency services report flooding on multiple arterial roads...

A white SUV pulls in. DR. SHEN QINGXUE (30s) emerges, quickly covering her medical bag with her blazer. Her movements are precise, practiced.

A white sports car idles crookedly across two spaces, blocking three vehicles. LV RONGRONG (40s) steps out, designer handbag first, then her son CHENGCHENG (7).

CHENGCHENG
Mom, that space is open. The guard said—

LV RONGRONG
—Mom knows best. I'm just five minutes. Go play.

She kisses his forehead, already checking her phone. ChengCheng hesitates, then trots toward the playground, looking back once.

EXT. PARK PLAYGROUND - DAY

Rain drips from the jungle gym. ChengCheng climbs, jacket abandoned on wet mulch.

SHEN QINGXUE walks the perimeter path, posture straight, eyes scanning—old habit from ER rotations.

ChengCheng's sneaker slips on wet bars. He falls. No scream—just a sickening THUD and gasp.

Shen freezes. Turns.

ChengCheng lies crumpled, rain diluting the blood pooling beneath his head. His fingers twitch.

Shen runs, already unbuttoning her cuffs.

EXT. PARK PLAYGROUND - DAY

Shen slides to her knees in the mulch beside ChengCheng. Two fingers to his neck—carotid pulse thready.

SHEN QINGXUE
(low, commanding)
Hey. Can you hear me? Open your eyes.

She examines his pupils—one blown. Hematoma forming at the temporal bone. She rips her scarf, folds it into a pressure dressing.

SHEN QINGXUE
(sharp, not panicked)
Stay with me. Don't close your eyes.

She scans the empty playground, then down at his face—the same features as the woman from the parking lot. Her jaw tightens.

She lifts him—one arm under knees, one supporting his neck, keeping the spine aligned—and moves.
continuation:
EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

Rain pounds harder. Shen reaches her SUV, blocked completely by the white sports car. She tries the door—locked. The sports car's tires sit in pooled water. No driver.

Shen settles ChengCheng against the SUV's wheel, keeping him stable while she unlocks her car. She places him across the back seat, elevating his head.

INT. SHEN QINGXUE'S CAR - DAY

ChengCheng's breath comes in shallow gasps. Blood seeps through the makeshift bandage.

CHENGCHENG
...Mommy...

Shen pulls out her phone. Dials emergency. Busy signal. She tries again—same. A text from the hospital floods group: ALL AMBULANCES DIVERTED DUE TO FLOODING.

She looks out at the sports car. Then at ChengCheng. Her knuckles whiten on the phone.

EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

Shen stands by the sports car, phone to her ear. She reads the number plate—LV 8888. Memorizes it.

INT. MAHJONG PARLOR - SECOND FLOOR - DAY

Smoke, clacking tiles, low murmurs. LV RONGRONG's phone BUZZES on the glass table. She glances—unknown number.

GIRLFRIEND A
Telemarketers never quit.

LV RONGRONG
(eyeing her tiles)
Let them call. I never answer strangers.

The phone stops. Then BUZZES again. Same number.

LV RONGRONG
(picking up, annoyed)
Yes? What?

EXT. PARKING LOT / INT. MAHJONG PARLOR - DAY

Intercut:

SHEN QINGXUE
(dead calm)
Is this the owner of white Porsche, license LV 8888? Your car is blocking emergency vehicle access outside Riverside Park. You need to move it now.

LV RONGRONG
(conscious of her friends listening)
I'm... I'm in a meeting. Can't you wait ten minutes?

SHEN QINGXUE
There's a child with a head injury. Possible intracranial hemorrhage. Every minute counts.

LV RONGRONG
(glancing at her tiles)
Then call an ambulance! Why are you bothering me?

SHEN QINGXUE
Your car is the only vehicle that can get through the flooding. The ambulance cannot.

LV RONGRONG
(defensive, loud)
I'm not even in the area! I lent my car to a friend. I can't help you!

She hangs up. Stares at her phone. Her hand trembles slightly. She reaches for a cigarette.

EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

Shen lowers the phone. She looks through the rain-streaked window at ChengCheng's small form in her back seat. Then at the sports car—through its windshield, she can see a child's booster seat inside.

Her expression shifts from shock to something harder. More dangerous.

She opens her car door.

description: A gifted young woman from a concubine's background excels in both literature and martial arts, earning praise from her tutor and hope for a future in the imperial examinations, but faces jealousy and danger within her own household.
context:
Title: The Female Scholar
Description: A gifted young woman from a concubine's background excels in both literature and martial arts, earning praise from her tutor and hope for a future in the imperial examinations, but faces jealousy and danger within her own household.

INT. YAN RESIDENCE - COURTYARD - DAY

YAN RUYU flows through her forms, sparring with YAN YAOZU. Her flying kick lands with controlled precision, sending him to the ground without injury.

TUTOR ZHAO
(muttering to himself)
Remarkable. She reads three moves ahead.

TUTOR ZHAO steps forward, clapping.

TUTOR ZHAO
Excellent! Brother Yan, your daughter's mind is as sharp as her blade.

MASTER YAN watches from the doorway, pride warring with concern.

MASTER YAN
She does us honor, Teacher.

Several CHILDREN watching from the gate begin to chant:

CHILDREN
Ruyu-jiejie wins again! Ruyu-jiejie wins again!

YAN YAOZU lies on the ground, humiliation burning his face.

YAN YAOZU
(quietly)
This isn't over.

MASTER YAN
(to Tutor Zhao)

TUTOR ZHAO

MASTER YAN's eyes widen. He turns to SU WENPEI, who stands with her tea tray forgotten.

SU WENPEI
(voice barely audible)

YAN RUYU

MASTER YAN
(overwhelmed)

TUTOR ZHAO
The future waits for no man. Or woman.

continuation:
