YAN RUYU kneels on the floor, her essay scroll in hand. SU WENPEI stands over her, trembling.

SU WENPEI
Do you know your mistake?

YAN RUYU
I controlled the blow. He wasn't injured.

SU WENPEI
You injured something more precious. His place.

YAN RUYU
Father said excellence is the only path for women like me.

SU WENPEI
(fiercely)
NOT. FOR. YOU.

She slaps Yan Ruyu, the crack echoing. Then she collapses beside her, gathering her daughter close.

SU WENPEI
(anguished)
Child, why won't you listen? I hide you to protect you. Every brilliance you show is a target on your back.

YAN RUYU
(pulling back)
Then I'll be too bright to shoot.

SU WENPEI
You cannot outshine the sun. We are swallows under the eaves. We bow our heads, or we are swept away.

YAN RUYU
I won't be swept. And I won't bow.

She pushes free and runs. Su Wenpei crawls after her, falling at QIN SHUANG's feet. Qin Shuang holds a bowl, steam rising like a ghost.

QIN SHUANG
Wenpei, you've raised a phoenix in a sparrow's nest. Master Yan speaks of nothing else. He even mentions... making you his legitimate wife.

SU WENPEI looks up in horror.

SU WENPEI
No... I never wanted...

QIN SHUANG
I know. But your daughter's talents have ambitions of their own. So. You drink this, and she becomes mine. Legitimate, protected, destined for greatness. Or she continues as she is, and I cannot answer for what becomes of either of you.

She holds out the bowl. The liquid within reflects only darkness.

title: Episode One
description: A successful CEO and multi-talented woman finds herself transported into a novel, becoming a supporting character with the same name.
context:
Title: Episode One
Description: A successful CEO and multi-talented woman finds herself transported into a novel, becoming a supporting character with the same name.

TITLE CARD: EPISODE ONE

EXT. EVENT VENUE - NIGHT

Elegant piano music drifts through the night air.

INT. DARK ROOM - CONTINUOUS

REN ZONG (27), elegant and formidable, commands the piano under the spotlight.

CUT TO: REN ZONG surrounded by a group of REPORTERS.

REPORTERS
(excitedly)
Ms. Ren! Over here! Youngest CEO on the exchange—your secret? 
Your new collection—any comment? Ms. Ren!

ON SCREEN TEXT: CEO | Concert Pianist | Painter | Top Designer

REPORTER
How do you balance it all?

REN ZONG
(confidently)
I don't believe in limits.

REN ZONG puts on sunglasses and walks toward her car, escorted by BODYGUARDS.

REPORTERS
(chasing)
Ms. Ren! One more question!

REN ZONG
(coldly)
The office awaits.
continuation:
INT. CAR - NIGHT

REN ZONG sits in the back seat, reading a novel.

REN ZONG
(to herself)
Same name. Zero backbone. The Ren family heir reduced to... this?

She shakes her head, disgusted.

DRIVER
Chairman, don't you need to rest?

REN ZONG
No need. I'm almost done with this book, so I'll just—

REN ZONG suddenly widens her eyes, her face showing terror.

DRIVER
(shouting)
Watch out!

SOUND of screeching tires and a loud crash.

BLACK SCREEN

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

REN ZONG lies in bed, slowly waking up. A man in traditional Chinese clothing, BUTLER QI, stands beside the bed.

BUTLER QI
Miss Ren. Miss Ren?

REN ZONG stretches and opens her eyes to see BUTLER QI. She sits up abruptly, shocked.

BUTLER QI
Miss Yihan returns tomorrow. Your services are no longer required. 
According to the contract, you must vacate before dark. Mr. Luo's instructions. 
Please sign the agreement.

BUTLER QI places a document on the bed.

REN ZONG picks up the document, looking at it in disbelief.

REN ZONG (V.O.)
Substitute contract? Transmigrated? I'm the pathetic supporting character?

REN ZONG looks at the agreement in her hand, her expression shifting from shock to steel.

REN ZONG
(to herself)
A Ren heir playing doormat? Not anymore.

title: The Female CEO's Personal General
description: A capable CEO meets a mysterious amnesiac general disguised as a beggar, who demonstrates extraordinary combat skills when she is threatened by thugs.
context:
Title: The Female CEO's Personal General
Description: A capable CEO meets a mysterious amnesiac general disguised as a beggar, who demonstrates extraordinary combat skills when she is threatened by thugs.

EXT. COMPANY BUILDING STAIRWAY - DAY

QIAO WEIRAN, sharp-suited and visibly stressed, walks down the exterior stairway outside her corporate headquarters. Subtitle introduction: QIAO WEIRAN, President of Qiao Group.

Her phone screen glows with her father's face—SONG ZHIGUO, apoplectic.

SONG ZHIGUO (V.O.)
Qiao Weiran, get back here this instant!

QIAO WEIRAN stops. At the bottom of the stairs sits YE FENG, mid-30s, his tattered clothes belying a soldier's posture. Subtitle introduction: YE FENG, Amnesiac National Guardian General.

QIAO WEIRAN
(into phone)
Why should I? I'm president of Qiao Group. My decisions are mine alone.

SONG ZHIGUO
On what grounds? I'm still chairman! Hongyuan Group is worth billions. If you sign with Chen Tech, you're burning our future!

QIAO WEIRAN
Then watch me.

She angles her phone camera toward Ye Feng, then extracts a stack of cash from her bag. She fans the bills—letting them flutter down.

SONG ZHIGUO
You stubborn—Weiran! Weiran!

QIAO WEIRAN hangs up. A fifty-dollar bill lands on Ye Feng's lowered head.

QIAO WEIRAN
Heads up. Free money. Aren't you going to take it?

YE FENG slowly opens his eyes—alert, calculating.

YE FENG
I don't take charity. I trade value.

QIAO WEIRAN
(thinking)
A businessman beggar?

YE FENG takes the bill off his head and picks up another from the ground.

YE FENG
This covers a day's wage. For that, I'll demonstrate.

YE FENG stands up in one fluid motion.

YE FENG
Consider it a preview.

QIAO WEIRAN
(thinking)
Great. A performance artist.
continuation:
QIAO WEIRAN turns to leave.

YE FENG
Miss Qiao.

She freezes. She never told him her name.

A black van screeches to a halt. Four MEN in suits emerge—led by SCAR-FACED THUG LEADER.

THUG LEADER
Miss Qiao. Boss Wei wants a word.

QIAO WEIRAN turns back to Ye Feng.

QIAO WEIRAN
That demonstration. Can it involve breaking bones?

YE FENG
(smiles faintly)
Only if they insist.

THUG LEADER
(to Ye Feng)
Walk away, drifter. This is corporate business.

YE FENG
You're blocking the lady's path.

THUG LEADER
(laughs)
And you're blocking my patience—

YE FENG moves. A blur. His palm strikes the Leader's sternum—sends him stumbling.

THUG LEADER
Get him!

The thugs surge. Ye Feng snatches a fallen tree branch—whips it in a tight arc. Two men drop.

QIAO WEIRAN ducks behind a concrete planter.

QIAO WEIRAN
(thinking)
Holy shit.

The Thug Leader draws a knife. More men rush forward. Ye Feng spins the branch like a baton. Crack. Crack. Everyone down.

QIAO WEIRAN runs out from behind the planter.

QIAO WEIRAN
Behind you!

YE FENG whips around to see a thug with a metal pipe. The frame freezes.

FADE OUT.

title: Her Scheme
description: A wealthy man hires a caregiver with a hidden agenda, inspired by a news story about a tycoon leaving his fortune to his nurse.
context:
Title: Her Scheme
Description: A wealthy man hires a caregiver with a hidden agenda, inspired by a news story about a tycoon leaving his fortune to his nurse.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

A news broadcast plays on the television screen.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
The inheritance case of a wealthy tycoon surnamed Z in our city has finally concluded after three years. He bequeathed 10% of his assets to his caregiver.

A hand uses a remote control to turn off the television.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - LATER

Three CAREGIVERS in uniforms stand in a row. The BUTLER stands to the side. QI HAO sits on the sofa.

BUTLER
Mr. Qi, is there anyone among these caregivers that you find suitable?

QI HAO stands up and walks in front of the caregivers, examining them one by one.

QI HAO
(to the first caregiver)
Too desperate.

QI HAO
(to the second caregiver)
continuation:
Too forgettable.

QI HAO stops in front of LIU XIMEI.

QI HAO
Looks... possible.

BUTLER
Seven years of experience. Former private nursing. Discreet.

QI HAO
You. Acceptable.

OTHER CAREGIVERS (V.O.)
Another lottery ticket.

QI HAO suddenly moves close to LIU XIMEI, their faces nearly touching.

QI HAO
(in a low voice)
My father is dying. He fears being forgotten. Make him remember you.
(beat)
Change his will. Can you do that?

LIU XIMEI looks directly at him, her eyes determined with a flicker of ambition.

LIU XIMEI
The only person who can help you do this is me.

title: She's Like the Distant Moon
description: A woman mistakenly enters the wrong hotel room and spends the night with a stranger, only to discover a shocking connection.
context:
Title: She's Like the Distant Moon
Description: A woman mistakenly enters the wrong hotel room and spends the night with a stranger, only to discover a shocking connection.

EXT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

A dreamlike sequence. GU JINLAN wears a red dress, lying on the bed. SHI YE leans over her, gripping her wrist.

SHI YE
Who are you?

SHI YE (V.O.)
This dream feels more real than any before.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

GU JINLAN, wearing a red dress, staggers through the hotel corridor while on the phone.

GU JINLAN
I'm almost there, stop rushing me.

WOMAN ON PHONE (V.O.)
The Song family doesn't know you changed your surname. Remember to use the name Ye Jinlan.

GU JINLAN
I know.

WOMAN ON PHONE (V.O.)
When you meet Song Yuze, you better behave. He's someone we can't afford to offend.

GU JINLAN
You better... you better show me some respect.

WOMAN ON PHONE (V.O.)
Have you been drinking?

GU JINLAN
Yeah, I... Mr. Ye was buying, it would be a waste not to drink.

WOMAN ON PHONE (V.O.)
You're really causing trouble. The room number is 807, don't get it wrong.

GU JINLAN
I know.

GU JINLAN hangs up and leans against the wall unsteadily. She looks at room number 804 through blurry eyes.

GU JINLAN
(to herself)
807...

She continues walking, searching for the room.

GU JINLAN
(to herself)
807... 807...

She stops at room 808, the door slightly ajar.

GU JINLAN
(to herself)
807... here it is.

She pushes the door open and enters.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

SHI YE sits against the headboard with his shirt unbuttoned, eyes closed. Water and prescription bottles on the nightstand.

GU JINLAN enters and looks at SHI YE on the bed.

GU JINLAN (V.O.)
My God. My husband of four years... and he's devastating. But so ill.

GU JINLAN walks to the bed and touches his forehead.

GU JINLAN
Hey. Wake up.

She leans closer. Suddenly, SHI YE opens his eyes, grabs her wrist, and pulls her onto the bed.

GU JINLAN
Ah!

They entangle on the bed.

GU JINLAN (V.O.)
Hongyu drugged me. And him...

GU JINLAN looks at SHI YE beneath her.

GU JINLAN
I'll bring you good fortune, you be my antidote. That's not too much to ask, right?

She lowers her head and kisses SHI YE. They embrace and kiss passionately.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Morning. Sunlight streams through the window. GU JINLAN and SHI YE lie in bed.

GU JINLAN wakes up, rubbing her head in pain. She sits up and adjusts her torn dress.

GU JINLAN (V.O.)
Ridiculous. How does someone so ill have such strength?

She walks to the table by the bed and picks up a welcome card.

The card reads "Esteemed Mr. Shi, Suite 808."

GU JINLAN
(shocked)
Mr. Shi? Oh God, I slept with the wrong person!

She turns back in horror to look at SHI YE, still asleep in bed.

Title: The Ultimate Green Tea Concubine's Palace Domination & Phoenix of Ten Thousand Phoenixes (Episode 63)
Description: A palace drama where the newly promoted Noble Consort Mi receives imperial gifts, but her rival Noble Consort Yao intercepts the delivery and threatens the servants.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE - DAY

The majestic palace gates loom against a copper sky.

EDICT EUNUCH (V.O.)
By the mandate of Heaven, the Emperor decrees: Consort Mi, virtuous in nature, diligent and gentle, is hereby elevated to Noble Consort Mi, to jointly manage the harem with Noble Consort Yao. By imperial decree.

NOBLE CONSORT MI rides a palanquin, her expression a mask of carved jade.

Servants process through the palace courtyards.

HEAD EUNUCH
You new servants, hold those items steady. Remember this well: the gifts in the eunuchs' hands are for Noble Consort Mi. The gifts in the palace maids' hands are for Noble Consort Yao.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO's palanquin materializes, blocking the path.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
His Majesty's blessings are... generous today.

EUNUCHS AND PALACE MAIDS
Blessings upon Your Ladyship.

HEAD EUNUCH
Halt!

The procession freezes. Trays clatter. Precious gifts spill across the stone.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO descends, her silk robes whispering against the ground.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
Who claims this hairpin?

HEAD EUNUCH (under his breath)
I must not say Noble Consort Yao—these two consorts are sworn enemies.

SI XI
Noble Consort Yao.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
Tomorrow marks my birthday. These gifts must be mine. You confused dogs.

SI XI
The Emperor's grace knows its rightful place, Your Ladyship.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
Still you lie. Pan Dehai!

PAN DEHAI
Your Ladyship.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
Remove the hands of these palace maids. Feed them to the fish in Yixin Pool.

PALACE MAIDS
Mercy! Your Ladyship, mercy!

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
Why do you not tremble?

SI XI
Because you are the Emperor's light, Your Ladyship. True favor casts no shadows.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
(lightly)
Most favored consort? How... tedious.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
Pan Dehai.

PAN DEHAI
Your Ladyship.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
Must I repeat myself?

SI XI releases the parrot from her sleeve cage. It arcs to NOBLE CONSORT YAO's shoulder.

PARROT
Empress! Consort Mi shall be Empress!

PAN DEHAI
Your Ladyship—a living phoenix, foretelling your rival's ascension!

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
(to SI XI)
Did you teach it weakness?

She lifts SI XI's chin.

NOBLE CONSORT YAO
You gamble with your life.

SI XI
This servant knows the cost of choosing wrong, Your Ladyship. That is why she chooses carefully.
continuation:
INT. SI XI'S HOME - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

ON SCREEN: One Year Ago

SI XI'S MOTHER sews by lamplight, turning gold melon seeds in calloused fingers.

SI XI bursts through the door, snow dusting her shoulders.

SI XI
Mother! I finished it—the nine-tailed phoenix!

SI XI'S MOTHER
Let me see... Ah, my daughter's hands are blessed.

She pulls SI XI close.

SI XI
Where did these gold seeds come from?

SI XI'S MOTHER
From Lady Yao. She wore my phoenix-and-peony skirt into the palace. For her rise, we received mercy.

SI XI
Then I too shall enter the palace, Mother. I will earn us more.

SI XI'S MOTHER
(grasping her hand)
Never. The palace is a graveyard dressed in silk. Noble Consort Mi destroys any who cross her shadow.

EXT. SI XI'S HOME ENTRANCE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Snow swallows the world. NOBLE CONSORT MI arrives with archers.

EUNUCH
Noble Consort Mi! Present yourself for reward!

INT. SI XI'S HOME - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SI XI'S MOTHER's face drains of blood. She stumbles toward the door.

An arrow shatters through the window, piercing her throat.

SI XI
(screaming)
Mother! MOTHER!

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Good People Have Good Fortune
description: A young man who cannot swim saves a drowning child and nearly dies, only to be blessed by a deity with wishes coming true and extraordinary luck.
context:
Title: Good People Have Good Fortune
Description: A young man who cannot swim saves a drowning child and nearly dies, only to be blessed by a deity with wishes coming true and extraordinary luck.

EXT. LAKESIDE BOARDWALK - DAY

A young man (HAOYU, 28) lies unconscious on a wooden boardwalk, soaking wet. A JOGGER performs chest compressions. A small crowd watches.

A BOY (7) wrapped in a blanket trembles, eyes fixed on Haoyu.

JOGGER
(pressing rhythmically)
Come on. Breathe.

A WOMAN clutches the boy's shoulder, crying.

WOMAN
(to the boy, whispering)
Pray for him. He gave everything for you.

The boy nods, lips moving silently.

INT. HAOYU'S CONSCIOUSNESS SPACE - DAY

Golden light bleeds through watery darkness. Haoyu floats weightless.

A MUFFLED VOICE echoes, sourceless.

HAOYU (V.O.)
Am I...?

THE VOICE
You chose the deep when you couldn't touch bottom. Ten thousand ripples for one life. Wake, child of the current. The world bends for those who bend for others.

EXT. LAKESIDE BOARDWALK - DAY

Haoyu convulses, water spilling from his mouth. He gasps, eyes opening.

The Jogger sits back, exhausted. The crowd exhales.

JOGGER
Don't move. EMS is coming.

Haoyu pushes himself up, scanning until he spots the boy. Their eyes lock.

Haoyu manages a weak thumbs-up. The boy bursts into tears.

WOMAN
Please—hospital. We'll pay.

HAOYU
(raspy)
Just need dry clothes.

He stands, wobbles. The Jogger steadies him.

JOGGER
Your name?

HAOYU
(laughs weakly)
Just... a guy who saw splashing.

He walks off unsteadily, backpack dripping.

HAOYU (V.O.)
Three years of drought. One act of drowning. And now... voices in the deep? Must be oxygen deprivation.

Haoyu checks his phone—miraculously, it works.

The phone buzzes. Caller ID: "Manager Yang." He answers.

HAOYU
Manager Yang?
continuation:
INT. MANAGER YANG'S OFFICE - DAY

MANAGER YANG sits behind his desk, phone to his ear.

MANAGER YANG
Haoyu? Where are you?

EXT. LAKESIDE BOARDWALK - DAY

HAOYU
Personal day. My mom's—

MANAGER YANG (O.S.)
Chen Qiang's out. Fender-bender. Lingyun Group's revisiting their options this afternoon. They asked for you specifically—remember that proposal? They finally read it.

Haoyu stops walking, stunned.

HAOYU
But the promotion—

MANAGER YANG (O.S.)
Yours if you want it. Clean up. Be here by three.

The line goes dead. Haoyu stares at the phone.

HAOYU
(whispering)
Specifically...

The phone buzzes again. Caller ID: "Dr. Wang."

HAOYU
Dr. Wang? The results—

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

DR. WANG sits at his desk, looking at a report.

DR. WANG
Benign. Better positioned than we thought. Laparoscopic possible—less invasive, half the cost. Come today?

EXT. LAKESIDE BOARDWALK - DAY

HAOYU
(voice breaking)
Yes. Yes, I can.

He pockets the phone, breathing hard.

Ahead, a LOTTERY BOOTH banner flaps in the wind.

Haoyu looks at his reflection in a puddle—soaking, but alive.

He smiles, walks past the booth without stopping.

ONLOOKER (O.S.)
Wait! He didn't leave his name!

Haoyu raises a hand in farewell, walking into the morning light.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: If Love Is Inevitable, It Must Be You
description: A woman's marriage crumbles when her husband's first love returns, forcing her to confront the painful truth that she was never truly loved.
context:
Title: If Love Is Inevitable, It Must Be You
Description: A woman's marriage crumbles when her husband's first love returns, forcing her to confront the painful truth that she was never truly loved.

EXT. RAINY STREET - NIGHT

SOUND of heavy rain

CLOSE UP on a woman's feet in white heels stepping into a puddle.

LI SUSU, dressed in a white skirt and beige cardigan, walks aimlessly in the pouring rain. She clutches a red marriage certificate, the corner torn.

LI SUSU (V.O.)
I believed love was a promise you build, brick by brick. I never realized his foundation was built on sand.

She stops, her hair soaked, tears mixing with the rain. She glances at the certificate, then lets it hang at her side.

INT. OFFICE LOBBY - DAY

TITLE CARD: 12 HOURS AGO - COMPANY OFFICE

LI SUSU, dressed elegantly, walks into a modern office lobby holding a bouquet of flowers and a designer shopping bag. Two female RECEPTIONISTS whisper at the front desk.

RECEPTIONIST 1
(whispering)
Shilin's flight lands at three. President Chen cleared his whole afternoon.

RECEPTIONIST 2
(whispering)
His white moonlight, finally back...

LI SUSU freezes. A small tremor in her hand causes a single flower petal to drift to the marble floor. She turns and walks out, leaving everything behind.

EXT. RAINY STREET - NIGHT

SOUND of thunder

LI SUSU stares at the marriage certificate in the downpour.

LI SUSU (V.O.)
I finally understand. The piece of paper means nothing when his heart was never mine.

She sinks to her knees on the wet asphalt.
continuation:
INT. HOME - DAY

TITLE CARD: TWO MONTHS AGO

Quick cuts: CHEN ZHUOLIN, handsome in a suit, staring at his phone with a soft smile. A woman's hand - not Li Susu's - rests on his shoulder. He whispers a name.

CHEN ZHUOLIN
Shilin.

LI SUSU enters with red roses, smiling.

LI SUSU
Zhuolin, I got your favorites...

She sees the phone in his hand - a photo of Shilin with another woman. The other woman's hand pulls away. The roses slip from her grasp, scattering like dropped hopes.

She turns and flees.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

CHEN ZHUOLIN grips LI SUSU's wrist as she walks away.

CHEN ZHUOLIN
Enough!

LI SUSU
(yelling)
I've had enough! You cleared your schedule for her. On your birthday, when I planned everything, you were waiting for her!

CHEN ZHUOLIN
She's been through a divorce! I'm just helping a friend adjust!

LI SUSU
(in disbelief)
A friend? Then why did you flinch when I touched your phone? Why does our bedroom still have her book on the nightstand? Why, Chen Zhuolin, am I always competing with a ghost?

CHEN ZHUOLIN
Don't be dramatic!

LI SUSU
I'm dramatic? You took her to lunch on our anniversary. You keep her gifts in your desk. You call me by her name when you're tired. I've been patient. I've been understanding. I've been everything you needed except the one thing you actually want.

SOUND of a sharp slap

CHEN ZHUOLIN slaps LI SUSU. She staggers, touching her cheek. Her eyes change—hurt becoming clarity.

LI SUSU
(quietly)
You love her that much.

CHEN ZHUOLIN looks away, jaw tight.

LI SUSU
(voice steady)
Then let me go. Let's get divorced.

CHEN ZHUOLIN
What?

LI SUSU
(looking at him)
I signed the papers. They're on your desk. I'm done being your consolation prize.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

CLOSE UP: A clerk's hand stamps "VOID" across the marriage certificate photo.

LI SUSU stands on the sidewalk, handing the voided document to CHEN ZHUOLIN.

CHEN ZHUOLIN
(coldly)
Don't expect me to come after you.

He takes it, turns, gets in his car, and drives away. She stands alone in the dark, rain beginning to fall.

She looks at her empty hands, then slowly sinks to the ground, silent tears becoming sobs.

Suddenly, the rain stops hitting her. She looks up.

CHEN ZHUOLIN stands over her, holding an umbrella. His tie is loosened, his expression haunted.

They stare at each other in silence.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Bridge Confrontation
description: A former CEO who gave up his billion-dollar empire for love confronts his ex-girlfriend on a bridge, only to discover the devastating truth about his sacrifice.
context:
Title: The Bridge Confrontation
Description: A former CEO who gave up his billion-dollar empire for love confronts his ex-girlfriend on a bridge, only to discover the devastating truth about his sacrifice.

EXT. BRIDGE - NIGHT

A young man (GU MING) sits on the bridge railing, looking dejected. A crowd of onlookers gathers around, taking out their phones to record.

FEMALE PASSERBY A
What's this guy doing? Is he going to jump?

A middle-aged MALE PASSERBY steps forward.

MALE PASSERBY
Hey buddy, it's dangerous standing up there. Come down quickly.

GU MING looks at his phone. A notification sound comes from it.

PHONE VOICE (V.O.)
Your order has been reassigned due to delay.

ON SCREEN: GU MING - Former Chairman, Tianlang Group.

MALE PASSERBY
Young man, whatever's troubling you, don't do anything foolish.

GU MING
Tell Gong Yue'er to come see me.

MALE PASSERBY
We can talk about whatever it is once you come down, okay?

GU MING
(shouting)
I said tell Gong Yue'er to come see me!

MALE PASSERBY
(turning to the crowd)
Does anyone know Gong Yue'er?

FEMALE PASSERBY B
Gong Yue'er? Is that the CEO who just took over Tianlang?

FEMALE PASSERBY B hands her phone to the MALE PASSERBY. The phone is playing a live stream of a press conference.

GONG YUE'ER (on phone video)
Tianlang Group will operate as an independent subsidiary under Gong Corporation.

MALE PASSERBY
(to GU MING)
You're a delivery driver. Why would the chairman—

GU MING climbs back over the railing onto the bridge.

MALE PASSERBY
Good, good, don't get agitated.
(to the crowd)
Tag Tianlang's account. Someone's life is at stake.

The onlookers all start operating their phones.

Several black luxury cars speed up and stop on the bridge. A group of BODYGUARDS get out and line up in two rows.

GONG YUE'ER, dressed in elegant clothing, gets out of a car and walks through the bodyguards toward GU MING.

GU MING
Yue'er, you finally came to see me.

ON SCREEN: GONG YUE'ER - CEO, Tianlang Group.

A man in a suit (ZHANG TAO) also gets out of the car.

ON SCREEN: ZHANG TAO - CFO, Gong Corporation.

ZHANG TAO
(to the onlookers)
continuation:
Stop filming. You're violating CEO Gong's rights. Leave now.

The bodyguards begin dispersing the crowd.

GU MING
Yue'er, I sent everything I made. Ten thousand.

ZHANG TAO
Gu Ming, she makes that in interest by noon.

GU MING
But... it's what I earned.

ZHANG TAO laughs contemptuously.

GU MING
I wanted to prove I could survive without Tianlang.

GONG YUE'ER
You proved you can't. Zhang Tao's bonus last month was one hundred thousand.

GU MING
That's because I gave you Tianlang!

GONG YUE'ER
I didn't force you. You signed the papers voluntarily.

GU MING
For you! So we could be together!

ZHANG TAO
She's with me now. We merged accounts last week.

GONG YUE'ER
Gu Ming, Zhang Tao and I are married.

GU MING
(shocked)
That's impossible. Yue'er, that's impossible, right?

GU MING tries to grab GONG YUE'ER's hand but is pushed away by ZHANG TAO.

ZHANG TAO
What are you doing?

GU MING
I gave you three generations of business. What more do you want?

GONG YUE'ER
Look at yourself. You think love is a transaction. You gave me a company to buy my loyalty. I'm not for sale.

GU MING
Yue'er, if you think I don't love you enough—

ZHANG TAO
Love? Gu Ming, when you were CEO, your life had value. Now? You're worthless.

GONG YUE'ER
Jump or don't. Either way, I won't be there.

GU MING
Yue'er, we've been together so long. Did you never—

GONG YUE'ER
I hate this pathetic version of you. Following me around like a dog. No—dogs have pride.

GONG YUE'ER and ZHANG TAO both laugh.

GU MING
Yue'er, stop joking.

ZHANG TAO
Joking? Your father died the moment you signed. He collapsed in Yue'er's office.

GU MING's expression changes drastically upon hearing this, his eyes filled with shock and disbelief.
full_script:
Title: The Bridge Confrontation
Description: A former CEO who gave up his billion-dollar empire for love confronts his ex-girlfriend on a bridge, only to discover the devastating truth about his sacrifice.

EXT. BRIDGE - NIGHT

A young man (GU MING) sits on the bridge railing, looking dejected. A crowd of onlookers gathers around, taking out their phones to record.

FEMALE PASSERBY A
What's this guy doing? Is he going to jump?

A middle-aged MALE PASSERBY steps forward.

MALE PASSERBY
Hey buddy, it's dangerous standing up there. Come down quickly.

GU MING looks at his phone. A notification sound comes from it.

PHONE VOICE (V.O.)
Your order has been reassigned due to delay.

ON SCREEN: GU MING - Former Chairman, Tianlang Group.

MALE PASSERBY
Young man, whatever's troubling you, don't do anything foolish.

GU MING
Tell Gong Yue'er to come see me.

MALE PASSERBY
We can talk about whatever it is once you come down, okay?

GU MING
(shouting)
I said tell Gong Yue'er to come see me!

MALE PASSERBY
(turning to the crowd)
Does anyone know Gong Yue'er?

FEMALE PASSERBY B
Gong Yue'er? Is that the CEO who just took over Tianlang?

FEMALE PASSERBY B hands her phone to the MALE PASSERBY. The phone is playing a live stream of a press conference.

GONG YUE'ER (on phone video)
Tianlang Group will operate as an independent subsidiary under Gong Corporation.

MALE PASSERBY
(to GU MING)
You're a delivery driver. Why would the chairman—

GU MING climbs back over the railing onto the bridge.

MALE PASSERBY
Good, good, don't get agitated.
(to the crowd)
Tag Tianlang's account. Someone's life is at stake.

The onlookers all start operating their phones.

Several black luxury cars speed up and stop on the bridge. A group of BODYGUARDS get out and line up in two rows.

GONG YUE'ER, dressed in elegant clothing, gets out of a car and walks through the bodyguards toward GU MING.

GU MING
Yue'er, you finally came to see me.

ON SCREEN: GONG YUE'ER - CEO, Tianlang Group.

A man in a suit (ZHANG TAO) also gets out of the car.

ON SCREEN: ZHANG TAO - CFO, Gong Corporation.

ZHANG TAO
(to the onlookers)
Stop filming. You're violating CEO Gong's rights. Leave now.

The bodyguards begin dispersing the crowd.

GU MING
Yue'er, I sent everything I made. Ten thousand.

ZHANG TAO
Gu Ming, she makes that in interest by noon.

GU MING
But... it's what I earned.

ZHANG TAO laughs contemptuously.

GU MING
I wanted to prove I could survive without Tianlang.

GONG YUE'ER
You proved you can't. Zhang Tao's bonus last month was one hundred thousand.

GU MING
That's because I gave you Tianlang!

GONG YUE'ER
I didn't force you. You signed the papers voluntarily.

GU MING
For you! So we could be together!

ZHANG TAO
She's with me now. We merged accounts last week.

GONG YUE'ER
Gu Ming, Zhang Tao and I are married.

GU MING
(shocked)
That's impossible. Yue'er, that's impossible, right?

GU MING tries to grab GONG YUE'ER's hand but is pushed away by ZHANG TAO.

ZHANG TAO
What are you doing?

GU MING
I gave you three generations of business. What more do you want?

GONG YUE'ER
Look at yourself. You think love is a transaction. You gave me a company to buy my loyalty. I'm not for sale.

GU MING
Yue'er, if you think I don't love you enough—

ZHANG TAO
Love? Gu Ming, when you were CEO, your life had value. Now? You're worthless.

GONG YUE'ER
Jump or don't. Either way, I won't be there.

GU MING
Yue'er, we've been together so long. Did you never—

GONG YUE'ER
I hate this pathetic version of you. Following me around like a dog. No—dogs have pride.

GONG YUE'ER and ZHANG TAO both laugh.

GU MING
Yue'er, stop joking.

ZHANG TAO
Joking? Your father died the moment you signed. He collapsed in Yue'er's office.

GU MING's expression changes drastically upon hearing this, his eyes filled with shock and disbelief.

title: Don't Run Mommy, Daddy is a Wife-Doting Maniac
description: A woman pregnant with a mysterious man's child faces her abusive mother's wrath and decides to divorce her husband she's never met, while he searches for the woman from that fateful night.
context:
Title: Don't Run Mommy, Daddy is a Wife-Doting Maniac
Description: A woman pregnant with a mysterious man's child faces her abusive mother's wrath and decides to divorce her husband she's never met, while he searches for the woman from that fateful night.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHEN RONG violently pushes LIN ANRAN to the ground. A MARRIAGE CERTIFICATE falls from a folder, showing two names: LIN Huanen and XIAO Yunchen.

CHEN RONG
Shameless! After two years of bankrolling this family through your marriage, you dare get pregnant with some wild man's bastard? Who is he?

LIN ANRAN
(weakly)
I... I don't remember. I was—

CHEN RONG
Drugged? Drunk? I don't care! The Xiao family heir can never know.

FLASHBACK:

INT. ROOM WITH PSYCHEDELIC LIGHTING - NIGHT

LIN ANRAN and a man's silhouettes are in intimate contact under purple light, embracing, kissing. His hand brushes her hair aside—a distinct wedding ring glints.

XIAO YUNCHEN (V.O.)
Just breathe. I've got you.

LIN ANRAN (V.O.)
So hot... the room... spinning...

END FLASHBACK.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHEN RONG
Tomorrow, we end this pregnancy. If Xiao Yunchen finds out you cheated, our monthly allowance disappears. I won't let your ruinous choices destroy me.

LIN ANRAN
(lifting her head, eyes determined)
Mom, I endured every blow since childhood. Even when you changed my name to Huanen—"repay kindness"—as if I were your investment. But this child is my own.

CHEN RONG
(coldly laughing)
Hmph! You think "Anran" makes you different? From today, you're no daughter of mine. And those payments? Consider them gone.

CHEN RONG leaves in anger, her phone already dialing. LIN ANRAN sits alone on the floor, picking up her phone with trembling hands.

LIN ANRAN (V.O.)
The number I swore I'd never call. But for this child...

She dials.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

XIAO YUNCHEN is working at his desk, a private investigator's report open: "Hotel Violet Room Incident - Unidentified Female." His phone rings—"WIFE (LIN Huanen)." He answers.

XIAO YUNCHEN
Yes?

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

LIN ANRAN holds her phone, that single syllable sending a shock through her.

LIN ANRAN (V.O.)
That voice. That very particular way of saying "yes"...

XIAO YUNCHEN (O.S.)
Who is this?

LIN ANRAN
Lin Huanen. Your wife of two years. I'm calling for a divorce.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

XIAO YUNCHEN
(pause)
I'll have my lawyer contact you.

But he doesn't hang up. He leans forward, suddenly intent.

XIAO YUNCHEN
Why now?

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

LIN ANRAN
(softly)
Because I'm pregnant. And this child deserves better than a nameless father who never wanted this marriage.

She ends the call before he can respond. She touches her stomach.

LIN ANRAN
(to her belly)
We'll be enough, just us two.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

XIAO YUNCHEN sits behind his desk, staring at his phone. Assistant SU HE walks in with a file.

SU HE
President Xiao, your mother arranged the marriage to fulfill your father's wish, but you've never met Mrs. Xiao. About the divorce—

XIAO YUNCHEN
Have Lawyer Song triple the settlement. Include the house and lifetime support.

SU HE
Sir, that's unprecedented. You always said this marriage was just business.

XIAO YUNCHEN
Just do it.

SU HE exits. Xiao Yunchen pulls out a distinctive ring from his drawer—the one from that night—turning it over in his palm.

XIAO YUNCHEN (V.O.)
That woman in violet light. The one who ran before dawn. Could she be...

FLASHBACK:

INT. ROOM WITH PSYCHEDELIC LIGHTING - NIGHT

The silhouette of the two kissing appears again. Xiao Yunchen's hand reaches for her face, his wedding ring catching the light.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

XIAO YUNCHEN
(to himself)
...my wife?

He opens his laptop, pulling up the marriage registry photo of Lin Huanen. Then he opens the hotel security footage from that night. He overlays the two images. The profiles align.

XIAO YUNCHEN
Find her. Before the lawyers finalize anything.

title: Mom, I Don't Hurt
description: A traffic accident forces a doctor to choose between his own daughter and another patient, revealing his misplaced priorities and cold heart.
context:
Title: Mom, I Don't Hurt
Description: A traffic accident forces a doctor to choose between his own daughter and another patient, revealing his misplaced priorities and cold heart.

EXT. ROAD UNDER OVERPASS - DAY

A multi-car pileup. Twisted metal and broken glass litter the asphalt. BYSTANDERS pull survivors from vehicles.

BYSTANDER A
(shouting)
Need help here!

BYSTANDER B
They're coming!

An ambulance ROARS up. TWO NURSES sprint out with trauma kits.

NURSE 1 moves to a YOUNG MAN bleeding from his head.

NURSE 1
Sir, don't move.

She checks his pupils, attaches a GREEN tag to his wrist: "Level 1 Minor."

Nearby, XIA MENG sits holding her daughter HAN NIANNIAN (8), whose leg is soaked in blood.

XIA MENG
(choking up)
Niannian, hold on. Dad's hospital is three minutes away.

HAN NIANNIAN
(whispering)
Mom... it's not that bad.

NURSE 2 runs over, kneels, begins assessing.

NURSE 2
Name?

XIA MENG
Han Niannian. I'm an ER nurse. How's the distal pulse?

NURSE 2
Weak. Might be the femoral.

She wraps a pressure bandage, attaches a YELLOW tag: "Level 2 Moderate."

NURSE 2
Keep pressure. Doctor's coming.

XIA MENG
(to Niannian)
You're stable. You're so brave.

A second ambulance SCREECHES to a halt. DR. HAN DONG jumps out, pulling on gloves. He scans the scene: professional, methodical.

His eyes land on his wife and daughter. He takes a step toward them.

PARAMEDIC
(shouting)
Doctor! Red tag! Chest trauma!
continuation:
Han Dong turns. In a crushed sedan, PARAMEDICS work on YAOZHU (17). The boy coughs blood.

DR. HAN DONG
(to paramedic)
Status.

PARAMEDIC
Tension pneumothorax. Lost pulse once.

Han Dong sees the RED tag on Yaozhu's wrist. He glances at Niannian's YELLOW tag.

XIA MENG
(shouting)
Han Dong! Please! She's your daughter!

DR. HAN DONG
(strained)
He's coding. Two minutes. I stabilize, then I'm there.

XIA MENG
Her pressure's dropping!

DR. HAN DONG
(over shoulder)
You're a nurse, Xia Meng. You know RED means now.

He turns away. Xia Meng trembles.

XIA MENG
(whispering)
She's slipping to Level 3.

Niannian's head lolls. Her breathing shallows.

HAN NIANNIAN
Mom... Dad's helping them first... because they're worse.

Blood seeps through the bandage. The YELLOW tag is now meaningless.

XIA MENG
(whispering fiercely)
No. He's coming back.

She presses harder with both hands.

XIA MENG
(shouting, raw)
Han Dong! Her tag's wrong! It's RED!

Niannian's fingers touch her mother's face.

HAN NIANNIAN
Mom... I don't hurt anymore.

Her hand falls. Xia Meng screams.

XIA MENG
Niannian! Niannian!

Sirens wail. Smoke rises. Han Dong works on Yaozhu, his back to his family. The PARAMEDICS call out vitals. Yaozhu's monitor shows a steady rhythm returning.

Han Dong's shoulders tighten. He knows.

title: The Last Gift
description: A terminally ill mother records a final video message for her son, preparing gifts for every birthday she will miss, before taking her own life to spare her family further pain.
context:
Title: The Last Gift
Description: A terminally ill mother records a final video message for her son, preparing gifts for every birthday she will miss, before taking her own life to spare her family further pain.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Opening shot: A warm family photo of three sits on a table.

Cut to: MOM sits on the floor of a bedroom. In front of her is an open suitcase filled with clothing. A video camera on a tripod is recording her.

MOM
(to the camera)
Chenchen... these are for you. The birthdays I'll miss.

MOM picks up a pair of blue denim shorts, her smile strained.

MOM
Clothes until you're a teenager. Probably all the wrong styles by then. Exchange whatever you don't want.

MOM puts down the shorts and picks up a beautifully wrapped blue gift box.

MOM
Your birthday gifts. Age five to eighteen. Take care of yourself. I'll be watching.

MOM's eyes redden, her voice begins to choke.

MOM
Forgive me for missing your eighteenth. Please don't hate me for this.

MOM holds back tears. After finishing, she reaches out and turns off the camera. The moment the camera shuts off, she can no longer hold back. She covers her face and breaks down crying.

MOM
(sobbing uncontrollably)
Forgive me... I'm sorry...

Suddenly, a childish voice calls out.

CHENCHEN (O.S.)
continuation:
Mom?

MOM immediately stops crying, wipes away her tears, and turns to look at the doorway. Her son CHENCHEN stands there in pajamas.

CHENCHEN
When is Dad coming home? I'm hungry.

MOM
(gently)
Soon. Come here. Sleep with me for a bit?

CHENCHEN nods obediently and climbs onto the bed.

MOM also walks over and lies down beside CHENCHEN.

MOM
(gently stroking CHENCHEN's hair)
You sleep so deeply now. Remember last week's thunderstorm? You didn't even stir.

CHENCHEN
Mm. I like sleeping with you.

MOM
Good boy.

MOM holds CHENCHEN tightly, closes her eyes, and begins to hum a lullaby softly.

MOM
(singing)
The dark sky hangs low, bright stars follow along, insects fly, insects fly...

Sound effect: A gunshot.

CHENCHEN
(murmuring in his sleep)
Mom...

A children's choir version of the lullaby plays. MOM lies quietly, no longer breathing. The expression on her face is one of pain released, not peace.

title: Mother's Battlefield
description: A mother fights desperately to save her daughter's life after a hit-and-run accident, facing opposition from her family over medical costs.
context:
Title: Mother's Battlefield
Description: A mother fights desperately to save her daughter's life after a hit-and-run accident, facing opposition from her family over medical costs.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

The wheels of an emergency gurney roll rapidly across the floor.

A hand covered in blood grips the gurney's handrail tightly.

LIN WEI (O.S.)
Doctor, she's crashing!

DOCTORS and NURSES push the emergency gurney down the hospital corridor at full speed. LIN WEI, wearing a light blue dress and barefoot, runs alongside, crying out anxiously.

LIN WEI
Please, I beg you—please save my daughter!

WANG JIANGUO and his mother TANG HONGYAN rush in from the other end of the corridor.

LIN WEI stops a FEMALE DOCTOR wearing a mask, emotional and with tears streaming down her face.

LIN WEI
Doctor, how is she?

DOCTOR
Critical. She needs immediate surgery. You need to pay the deposit now.

WANG JIANGUO
How much?

DOCTOR
Two hundred thousand yuan upfront.

TANG HONGYAN
(shocked)
Two hundred thousand?

WANG JIANGUO
(looking troubled)
Our new policy doesn't start until next week.

TANG HONGYAN
The driver?

WANG JIANGUO
Gone. Hit and run.
continuation:
TANG HONGYAN
(angry)
Foolish! The Wang family can't take this loss!

WANG JIANGUO
We'd have to mortgage the house.

TANG HONGYAN
(firmly)
I worked forty years for that house. It's my funeral money.

LIN WEI
(crying and pleading)
Mom, that's your granddaughter. Eighteen. She got into Tsinghua.

TANG HONGYAN
(disdainful)
A daughter's dowry is water on sand.

LIN WEI
(breaking down)
She's not sand—she's breathing! Right now!

TANG HONGYAN
Where's the money? Should we all beg on the street because you let her work nights?

TANG HONGYAN clutches her chest and begins wailing dramatically.

TANG HONGYAN
Oh, my life is so bitter! I buried two sons before they were ten, and now in my old age, I must choose between a granddaughter and homelessness! Oh, my fate!

The DOCTOR rushes out from the emergency room.

DOCTOR
Blood pressure's crashing. I'm starting whether you pay or not.

LIN WEI completely breaks down, falling to her knees, grabbing the DOCTOR's hand and pleading desperately.

LIN WEI
Please. I will get your money. I will sell my own kidneys. Please.

DOCTOR
(helping LIN WEI up)
We need thirty minutes. After that, I can't stop.

LIN WEI looks desperately toward the operating room, her eyes hollow. In the dark window behind her, sirens paint red spirals across the glass.

Doctor, how is she?

DOCTOR
Critical. She needs immediate surgery. You need to pay the deposit now.

WANG JIANGUO
How much?

DOCTOR
Two hundred thousand yuan upfront.

TANG HONGYAN
(shocked)
Two hundred thousand?

WANG JIANGUO
(looking troubled)
Our new policy doesn't start until next week.

TANG HONGYAN
The driver?

WANG JIANGUO
Gone. Hit and run.

TANG HONGYAN
(angry)
Foolish! The Wang family can't take this loss!

WANG JIANGUO
We'd have to mortgage the house.

TANG HONGYAN
(firmly)
I worked forty years for that house. It's my funeral money.

LIN WEI
(crying and pleading)
Mom, that's your granddaughter. Eighteen. She got into Tsinghua.

TANG HONGYAN
(disdainful)
A daughter's dowry is water on sand.

LIN WEI
(breaking down)
She's not sand—she's breathing! Right now!

TANG HONGYAN
Where's the money? Should we all beg on the street because you let her work nights?

TANG HONGYAN clutches her chest and begins wailing dramatically.

TANG HONGYAN
Oh, my life is so bitter! I buried two sons before they were ten, and now in my old age, I must choose between a granddaughter and homelessness! Oh, my fate!

The DOCTOR rushes out from the emergency room.

DOCTOR
Blood pressure's crashing. I'm starting whether you pay or not.

LIN WEI completely breaks down, falling to her knees, grabbing the DOCTOR's hand and pleading desperately.

LIN WEI
Please. I will get your money. I will sell my own kidneys. Please.

DOCTOR
(helping LIN WEI up)
We need thirty minutes. After that, I can't stop.

LIN WEI looks desperately toward the operating room, her eyes hollow. In the dark window behind her, sirens paint red spirals across the glass.

title: Mom, You Were Wrong (Episode 43)
description: Three years after a devastating fire, a devoted daughter cares for her comatose mother while her brother returns with sinister intentions.
context:
Title: Mom, You Were Wrong (Episode 43)
Description: Three years after a devastating fire, a devoted daughter cares for her comatose mother while her brother returns with sinister intentions.

INT. BURNING BEDROOM - NIGHT

Smoke churns near the ceiling. Flames crawl across a child's desk.

CUI MIN coughs beneath a blanket near the door, curled tight.

TAO FENGXIA crashes through the doorway, a wet cloth pressed to her face.

TAO FENGXIA
Guodong! Where are you?

She spots the blanket, moves toward it.

TAO FENGXIA
Hold on! Mom's coming!

CUI MIN thrusts her head out, face twisted in terror.

CUI MIN
Mom! Guodong's under the bed!

Across the room, CUI GUODONG peeks from beneath the bed frame, frozen.

CUI GUODONG
Mom!

TAO FENGXIA's eyes sweep the room—Guodong is closer to the flames. She dives for him.

TAO FENGXIA
(to Guodong)
Stay down!

She pulls Guodong out. A burning beam CRASHES between them and the door, blocking Cui Min's escape.

CUI MIN
(screaming)
Mom!

The beam pins Tao Fengxia's leg. She shoves Guodong toward the hallway.

TAO FENGXIA
Run! Get help!

CUI MIN
(desperately)
Mom, your leg!

FIREFIGHTER (O.S.)
Anyone in there?

TAO FENGXIA
(to firefighter)
My daughter! Get her first!

A firefighter appears through the smoke, reaching for Min.

FIREFIGHTER
Take my hand!

Tao Fengxia shoves Guodong out as the ceiling begins to collapse.
continuation:
EXT. HOSPITAL - DAY

ON SCREEN: Three Years Later

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR/NURSES' STATION - DAY

CUI MIN walks with a water basin, movements mechanical.

NURSE A and NURSE B watch.

NURSE A
Three years. She hasn't missed a day.

NURSE B
They say the son inherits everything. Hasn't visited once.

NURSE A
Quiet. She hears everything.

Min passes, eyes fixed ahead.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

TAO FENGXIA lies comatose, oxygen tube in place.

Cui Min dips a cloth, wipes her mother's hand with methodical care.

The door opens. CUI GUODONG enters, pregnant WIFE behind him.

CUI GUODONG
Still here.

CUI MIN
(still wiping)
Someone has to be.

CUI GUODONG
The deed's in my name. I need to sell.

CUI MIN
Dad's house.

CUI GUODONG
Dad's gone. Mom's... this. I have debts.

He steps toward the bed. His wife touches his arm.

WIFE
Guodong, we should talk to the doctor—

CUI GUODONG
No more waiting.

His hand moves toward the oxygen tube. Min drops the basin—water splashes.

CUI MIN
Don't.

CUI GUODONG
You weren't chosen. You were left behind.

Cui Min blocks his path, body shielding their mother.

CUI MIN
Then why am I the one who stayed?

CUI GUODONG
Move.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: When Will Sister Return
description: A woman searches for her lost brother for twenty years while working at a quarry, unaware he has been adopted by a wealthy family and is now searching for her.
context:
Title: When Will Sister Return
Description: A woman searches for her lost brother for twenty years while working at a quarry, unaware he has been adopted by a wealthy family and is now searching for her.

EXT. QUARRY - DAY

SHEN XIAOYU and many WORKERS labor hard with hammers and shovels on the rugged quarry terrain.

A shrill bell rings.

LIU DAYI (V.O.)
Hurry up, everyone! It's Mid-Autumn Festival, the factory is handing out mooncakes! Come line up! Come get your mooncakes!

The WORKERS put down their tools and walk toward a table to line up for mooncakes. LIU DAYI sits behind the table distributing them.

SHEN XIAOYU runs to the front of the line, holding a yellowed black-and-white photo in her hand, anxiously showing it to the workers.

SHEN XIAOYU
Please... this is my younger brother. Missing twenty years. I'll give everything I have for a real lead.

Most workers shake their heads expressionlessly and walk around her to get their mooncakes.

SHEN XIAOYU walks disappointedly to LIU DAYI's table.

LIU DAYI
(flippantly)
Hey, Xiaoyu, your mooncake isn't here. Tonight, go to the factory manager's office to get it.

SHEN XIAOYU
(coldly)
If there isn't one, forget it.

SHEN XIAOYU turns and leaves.

LIU DAYI
(disdainfully)
What's she pretending for!

SHEN XIAOYU walks to the side and sits down. She takes out a cloth-wrapped steamed bun from the basket on her back and eats it silently. She looks at the bun in her hand, then touches a tooth-shaped pendant hanging around her neck, her eyes filled with sadness.
continuation:
INT. FLASHBACK - COUNTRY ROAD - 20 YEARS AGO - RAINY NIGHT

A car speeds past and hits a little boy (young SHEN XINCHENG).

A well-dressed couple (BAI XIA and her HUSBAND) get out of the car and discover the boy lying in the rain.

BAI XIA
Whose child is this? Does anyone know?

BAI XIA'S HUSBAND
To the hospital!

The couple picks up the little boy and hurries into the car.

Not far away, young SHEN XIAOYU runs through the rain, crying.

YOUNG SHEN XIAOYU
(crying out)
Little brother, where are you?

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

Twenty years later, SHEN XINCHENG, dressed in a suit, excitedly hands a document to his adoptive mother BAI XIA.

SHEN XINCHENG
Mom, the investigator found her. She's been searching for me online for five years. At a quarry.

BAI XIA
(smiling)
You've done well. The company is yours. But Xincheng—how many impostors have we seen?

SHEN XINCHENG
She has the pendant. The one from the hospital. And our photo together. Mom, I need to bring her home.

BAI XIA
(sighing)
Then go. But wear humility like armor. Test her heart before you trust.

SHEN XINCHENG listens, then falls into thought.

EXT. VILLA - DAY

SHEN XINCHENG changes into simple, worn clothes and walks toward an old car. An ASSISTANT in a suit follows behind him.

ASSISTANT
President, the DNA kit and documents are ready. This vehicle...

SHEN XINCHENG
Take me to the quarry, then head back right away. I'll go see my sister by myself.

SHEN XINCHENG gets in the car.

EXT. QUARRY - DAY

SHEN XIAOYU is working when a CO-WORKER runs over.

CO-WORKER
Sister Xiaoyu, there's someone at the bottom of the mountain looking for you. He says he's your younger brother. Showed the guards a photo... of you both as children.

SHEN XIAOYU suddenly looks up, her face full of shock and disbelief.

SHEN XIAOYU
(urgently)
Where is he? Where?

Tears well up in SHEN XIAOYU's eyes, filled with hope.

title: Sister, Please Run Wild With Me
description: After a passionate night in a hotel, a woman in a wedding dress leaves money for the man, claiming it was just for fun. The man, revealed to be a powerful CEO, has been unable to forget her for years and decides to pursue her by assuming a student identity.
context:
Title: Sister, Please Run Wild With Me
Description: After a passionate night in a hotel, a woman in a wedding dress leaves money for the man, claiming it was just for fun. The man, revealed to be a powerful CEO, has been unable to forget her for years and decides to pursue her by assuming a student identity.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

HUO YANCHUAN has just finished showering, a white towel wrapped around his lower body, emerging from behind a frosted glass door. His physique is strong, with well-defined muscles.

NAN WAN, wearing a magnificent wedding dress, sits on the messy bed, holding her phone, looking at him warily.

HUO YANCHUAN walks toward the bed step by step, his eyes full of aggression as he looks at NAN WAN.

NAN WAN
First time since Barcelona?

HUO YANCHUAN
Does it matter?

NAN WAN
It does. I don't share.

HUO YANCHUAN
Is that so? Then why the dress?

NAN WAN picks up a wine glass and takes a light sip of red wine.

NAN WAN
Can you handle a wedding dress, or does sister need to teach you?

HUO YANCHUAN
(chuckling)
Sister?

NAN WAN
I'll show you how it's done.

HUO YANCHUAN leans closer to NAN WAN, one hand propped on the bed, the other caressing her cheek.

HUO YANCHUAN
You won't be walking tomorrow.

HUO YANCHUAN kisses NAN WAN. The two kiss passionately and fall onto the bed. The room's lights dim.

FADE TO:
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

The next morning. Broken wine glasses and clothing are scattered on the floor.

On the bed, NAN WAN has changed into silk pajamas. She gently strokes the chest of HUO YANCHUAN sleeping beside her, her expression complex.

NAN WAN
(to herself)
This was a mistake. It can't happen again.

NAN WAN gets out of bed, changes into a sharp black business suit, puts on high heels, and prepares to leave.

HUO YANCHUAN suddenly wakes up and grabs her hand from behind. NAN WAN turns around, and the two lock eyes.

NAN WAN breaks free, takes out a stack of cash from her handbag, and throws it on HUO YANCHUAN.

NAN WAN
For the room. We're even.

HUO YANCHUAN
(sitting up, covering himself with the blanket)
You think money solves this?

NAN WAN
What do you want? A ring? I'm engaged. This was goodbye.

HUO YANCHUAN
You're running.

NAN WAN
(leaning close to him, lifting his chin with her finger)
We were always good together. But some things don't change.

NAN WAN straightens up and removes a diamond ring from her hand.

NAN WAN
Here. My engagement ring. I've been trying to forget you since the day I accepted it.

NAN WAN places the ring in front of HUO YANCHUAN, turns and leaves gracefully. At the door, she turns back and blows him a kiss, then closes the door and leaves.

HUO YANCHUAN watches her leave, his expression shifting from shock to determination. He takes out a photo from his wallet - a younger NAN WAN at a beach bar.

HUO YANCHUAN (V.O.)
Three years, Nan Wan. You really think I'd let you go?

HUO YANCHUAN picks up his phone and makes a call.

HUO YANCHUAN
Cancel the Tokyo deal. Get me a student identity at Nancheng University. Business school.

ASSISTANT (O.S.)
Yes, Mr. Huo.

HUO YANCHUAN hangs up the phone, picks up the ring NAN WAN left behind, his eyes becoming determined and possessive.

HUO YANCHUAN (V.O.)
You want to run? Then we'll play it your way.

FADE OUT.

title: Betrayal and Revenge
description: A once-wealthy heir, poisoned and betrayed by his lover and best friend, discovers the horrifying truth behind his terminal illness.
context:
Title: Betrayal and Revenge
Description: A once-wealthy heir, poisoned and betrayed by his lover and best friend, discovers the horrifying truth behind his terminal illness.

INT. RUNDOWN BLACK CLINIC - DAY

Thunder and lightning rage outside. A rat steals chocolate beans from a messy table.

LU HAOSHEN (30s), wearing a stained hospital gown, deathly pale and trembling, lies face down on a rusted bedframe. His fingers—once steady enough to sign million-dollar deals—struggle toward a cracked medicine bowl on the nightstand.

His hand convulses. The bowl shatters on the concrete floor. Bitter medicine pools with blood from his bleeding gums.

LU HAOSHEN rolls off the bed, crawling through the ceramic shards. He scoops the tainted residue with trembling hands, forcing it into his mouth. Blood trickles from his lips.

He moans, eyes fixed on the poison bottle on the table. He inches forward.

A pair of designer heels clicks over, crushing his fingers against the floor.

ZHAO JINGKUN (O.S.)
My God. Is that really you, Haoshen?

JI XIAOXIAO (O.S.)
Three months. You look like a corpse we forgot to bury.

JI XIAOXIAO and ZHAO JINGKUN loom over LU HAOSHEN, their reflections warped in the medicine puddle.

JI XIAOXIAO
(laughing)
Oh, this is precious.

LU HAOSHEN
(weakly)
Xiaoxiao... please. Just enough for one dose.

LU HAOSHEN
The antidote... you know the price. Xiaoxiao, for everything I gave you...

ZHAO JINGKUN kicks his hand away. LU HAOSHEN's fracture from last week screams.

LU HAOSHEN
(moaning)
Ah...!

ZHAO JINGKUN
(crouching, gripping LU HAOSHEN's jaw)
Still begging from her? After you signed over your family's shares? Your penthouse? Tell me, was it my idea or yours to make you my personal ATM?

LU HAOSHEN
(agitated)
I gave you everything. The company, the properties... You said you'd save me. Xiaoxiao, remember? When I bankrolled your 'art career'—when you needed that Taipei gallery—

JI XIAOXIAO
(kicking his ribs, precisely)
That was consulting fee. For teaching a spoiled boy to pretend he had talent. But pigs can't paint, and pigs don't get to marry their owners.

LU HAOSHEN
(desperately)
Our agreement. The transfer documents. You signed them—you promised marriage. A life together.

JI XIAOXIAO
You're a dead man walking. I'd rather burn in hell.

ZHAO JINGKUN
Let's go. The smell of failure is contagious.
continuation:
EXT. OUTSIDE CLINIC - NIGHT

Heavy rain pours. ZHAO JINGKUN hauls LU HAOSHEN by the collar, throwing him into the mud. A final kick to the spine.

LU HAOSHEN
(in pain)
Not possible... the doctors said... autoimmune...

ZHAO JINGKUN
(grabbing LU HAOSHEN's hair)
Autoimmune? Cute. Ever wonder why your 'vitamins' tasted metallic? Xiaoxiao's special thallium blend. Slow. Undetectable. Terminal. She painted the capsules herself.

FLASHBACK: Young LU HAOSHEN paints, chewing his pencil nervously. JI XIAOXIAO beside him gently corrects his grip, her smile warm. She produces a vitamin case. He swallows without looking.

LU HAOSHEN
(shocked)
The... supplements? Three years?

JI XIAOXIAO
(walking over with an umbrella, finally sincere)
I loved watching you trust me. Every morning, like a good little dog.

JI XIAOXIAO and ZHAO JINGKUN kiss—slow, deliberate, inches from LU HAOSHEN's face.

LU HAOSHEN
(heartbroken)
No... not you both. Not since—

JI XIAOXIAO
(triumphantly)
Since university. Your money bought our vacations. Our apartment. This baby.

She touches her stomach. ZHAO JINGKUN covers her hand with his.

ZHAO JINGKUN
(laughing)
Tomorrow's our wedding. Black tie. Your family chapel. We'll save you a seat—if you can crawl.

ZHAO JINGKUN and JI XIAOXIAO leave in the rain, his arm around her shoulders.

LU HAOSHEN lies in the mud, convulsing. Not from poison—from truth.

LU HAOSHEN
Ahhh—!

A red sports car hydroplanes to a stop. The door flies open. GU JIA (28, in a business suit) sprints out, phone already dialing emergency.

GU JIA
(anxiously)
Haoshen! Stay with me—stay—

GU JIA lifts LU HAOSHEN's head from the water. Her ID badge dangles: LU CORPORATION HEAD OF FORENSICS.

GU JIA
I have the lab results. I know what they did.

LU HAOSHEN's eyes focus for the first time in months. He sees her. He sees everything.

LU HAOSHEN loses consciousness as sirens wail in the distance.
full_script:
Title: Betrayal and Revenge
Description: A once-wealthy heir, poisoned and betrayed by his lover and best friend, discovers the horrifying truth behind his terminal illness.

INT. RUNDOWN BLACK CLINIC - DAY

Thunder and lightning rage outside. A rat steals chocolate beans from a messy table.

LU HAOSHEN (30s), wearing a stained hospital gown, deathly pale and trembling, lies face down on a rusted bedframe. His fingers—once steady enough to sign million-dollar deals—struggle toward a cracked medicine bowl on the nightstand.

His hand convulses. The bowl shatters on the concrete floor. Bitter medicine pools with blood from his bleeding gums.

LU HAOSHEN rolls off the bed, crawling through the ceramic shards. He scoops the tainted residue with trembling hands, forcing it into his mouth. Blood trickles from his lips.

He moans, eyes fixed on the poison bottle on the table. He inches forward.

A pair of designer heels clicks over, crushing his fingers against the floor.

ZHAO JINGKUN (O.S.)
My God. Is that really you, Haoshen?

JI XIAOXIAO (O.S.)
Three months. You look like a corpse we forgot to bury.

JI XIAOXIAO and ZHAO JINGKUN loom over LU HAOSHEN, their reflections warped in the medicine puddle.

JI XIAOXIAO
(laughing)
Oh, this is precious.

LU HAOSHEN
(weakly)
Xiaoxiao... please. Just enough for one dose.

LU HAOSHEN
The antidote... you know the price. Xiaoxiao, for everything I gave you...

ZHAO JINGKUN kicks his hand away. LU HAOSHEN's fracture from last week screams.

LU HAOSHEN
(moaning)
Ah...!

ZHAO JINGKUN
(crouching, gripping LU HAOSHEN's jaw)
Still begging from her? After you signed over your family's shares? Your penthouse? Tell me, was it my idea or yours to make you my personal ATM?

LU HAOSHEN
(agitated)
I gave you everything. The company, the properties... You said you'd save me. Xiaoxiao, remember? When I bankrolled your 'art career'—when you needed that Taipei gallery—

JI XIAOXIAO
(kicking his ribs, precisely)
That was consulting fee. For teaching a spoiled boy to pretend he had talent. But pigs can't paint, and pigs don't get to marry their owners.

LU HAOSHEN
(desperately)
Our agreement. The transfer documents. You signed them—you promised marriage. A life together.

JI XIAOXIAO
You're a dead man walking. I'd rather burn in hell.

ZHAO JINGKUN
Let's go. The smell of failure is contagious.

EXT. OUTSIDE CLINIC - NIGHT

Heavy rain pours. ZHAO JINGKUN hauls LU HAOSHEN by the collar, throwing him into the mud. A final kick to the spine.

LU HAOSHEN
(in pain)
Not possible... the doctors said... autoimmune...

ZHAO JINGKUN
(grabbing LU HAOSHEN's hair)
Autoimmune? Cute. Ever wonder why your 'vitamins' tasted metallic? Xiaoxiao's special thallium blend. Slow. Undetectable. Terminal. She painted the capsules herself.

FLASHBACK: Young LU HAOSHEN paints, chewing his pencil nervously. JI XIAOXIAO beside him gently corrects his grip, her smile warm. She produces a vitamin case. He swallows without looking.

LU HAOSHEN
(shocked)
The... supplements? Three years?

JI XIAOXIAO
(walking over with an umbrella, finally sincere)
I loved watching you trust me. Every morning, like a good little dog.

JI XIAOXIAO and ZHAO JINGKUN kiss—slow, deliberate, inches from LU HAOSHEN's face.

LU HAOSHEN
(heartbroken)
No... not you both. Not since—

JI XIAOXIAO
(triumphantly)
Since university. Your money bought our vacations. Our apartment. This baby.

She touches her stomach. ZHAO JINGKUN covers her hand with his.

ZHAO JINGKUN
(laughing)
Tomorrow's our wedding. Black tie. Your family chapel. We'll save you a seat—if you can crawl.

ZHAO JINGKUN and JI XIAOXIAO leave in the rain, his arm around her shoulders.

LU HAOSHEN lies in the mud, convulsing. Not from poison—from truth.

LU HAOSHEN
Ahhh—!

A red sports car hydroplanes to a stop. The door flies open. GU JIA (28, in a business suit) sprints out, phone already dialing emergency.

GU JIA
(anxiously)
Haoshen! Stay with me—stay—

GU JIA lifts LU HAOSHEN's head from the water. Her ID badge dangles: LU CORPORATION HEAD OF FORENSICS.

GU JIA
I have the lab results. I know what they did.

LU HAOSHEN's eyes focus for the first time in months. He sees her. He sees everything.

LU HAOSHEN loses consciousness as sirens wail in the distance.

title: I Am the Female Lead
description: A wife confronts an actress she believes is having an affair with her husband on a film set.
context:
Title: I Am the Female Lead
Description: A wife confronts an actress she believes is having an affair with her husband on a film set.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

GUO ZILU bursts through the door, her trembling hand gripping YAO JIALING's shoulder. YAO's makeup brush clatters into the mirror.

GUO ZILU
(low, trembling)
You look smaller in person, Yao Jialing.

YAO JIALING
(jerking away)
Do I know you? Who let you—

GUO ZILU
(her voice cracks)
Three months of deleted texts. Four hotel charges. One bracelet I never received.

YAO JIALING
(thin smile)
Ah. The wife. How... method of you.

GUO ZILU
Security! Get this—

YAO JIALING
(overlapping, louder)
Security! Remove her!

ASSISTANT (O.S.)
(urgent whisper into phone)
Mrs. Tie found out. Yes, THAT Mrs. Tie.

GUO ZILU
You wanted his money? Fine. But you posted that bracelet on Weibo. Tagging our anniversary date.

YAO JIALING
I post a lot of things. So does your husband. Like that "business trip" to Sanya—
continuation:
TIE GUO charges in, blocking the doorway from gathering crew.

TIE GUO
(to hallway)
Show's over! Back to work!

GUO ZILU
(to YAO)
You think this is a show? These people should know what their "female lead" does after wrap.

TIE GUO
(pleading under his breath)
Zilu, not here. The project's fifty million in—

YAO JIALING
(smoothing her costume)
Sixty. And I earned every frame.

ASSISTANT (O.S.)
(overheard, snapping fingers)
That's why she got Li Lin to post that denial. Damage control.

YAO JIALING
(spins toward door)
My sister already clarified those screenshots. Find better gossip.

GUO ZILU
Your sister defended you. Your "boyfriend" denied you. Your investor's wife is standing right here. Who's the lead in your life story, Jialing?

TIE GUO
(to GUO ZILU, desperate)
She's just talent. A contract. You think I'd risk us for... for craft services and a call sheet?

YAO JIALING
(trembling, but projects to the room)
I survived three years of auditions and your husband's "meetings." I AM the female lead. And you?

She slams the dressing table. The mirror cracks between their reflections.

title: Beloved Wife in Arms: The 80s Factory Director's Endless Love
description: A young woman marries a man she barely knows to fulfill her grandmother's dying wish. On their wedding night, he is called away for work, and they don't see each other again for five years.
context:
Title: Beloved Wife in Arms: The 80s Factory Director's Endless Love
Description: A young woman marries a man she barely knows to fulfill her grandmother's dying wish. On their wedding night, he is called away for work, and they don't see each other again for five years.

EXT. COUNTY CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - DAY

MOTHER ZHOU paces anxiously at the entrance of the Civil Affairs Bureau, clutching a cloth-wrapped bundle.

ZHOU YUCHEN rides up on a bicycle patched with tape, carrying ZHANG XIUYING. Both have dust streaked across their faces, sleeves rolled to the elbow.

ZHOU YUCHEN
Mom. The shuttle bus from the commune broke down.

MOTHER ZHOU
(angrily)
You're getting your marriage certificate and you look like you've been dragged through a rice paddy! This is your first time laying eyes on each other.

ZHANG XIUYING
(meeting Zhou Yuchen's gaze)
At least we know neither of us shirks hard work.

A shared, tentative smile passes between them.

MOTHER ZHOU
Wipe your faces. Registrar Lao Wang is waiting.

She hands them a damp towel. Zhou Yuchen passes it to Zhang Xiuying first.

INT. MARRIAGE REGISTRATION OFFICE - DAY

ZHOU YUCHEN and ZHANG XIUYING sit before the REGISTRAR, still faintly smudged. The Registrar adjusts his glasses.

REGISTRAR
Occupations?

ZHOU YUCHEN
Hydraulic engineer. Third Machine Tool Factory.

ZHANG XIUYING
Embroidery mechanic. Fifteenth Production Brigade.

The Registrar stamps two certificates with a loud CLACK and slides them forward. They reach for them simultaneously, hands brushing.
continuation:
INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - NIGHT

Wedding night. ZHANG XIUYING sits on the kang in a simple red jacket, fingers tracing the wood grain of the kang table. ZHOU YUCHEN sets down a kerosene lamp.

He opens a wooden box containing a slender gold bracelet, its clasp shaped like a tiny gear.

ZHOU YUCHEN
My grandmother wore this while operating the textile machines. She said it brought her luck during the toughest years.

He fastens it around her wrist. The lamp light catches the gold.

ZHANG XIUYING
Then I'll wear it while I work.

ZHOU YUCHEN
When the factory bonus comes through this winter, we'll have a proper ceremony.

For the first time, he lifts her face to the light, studying it carefully.

INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - MORNING

ZHOU YUCHEN, fully dressed, watches Zhang Xiuying sleep. He touches a Polaroid photo on the nightstand—her Mao badge ID photo, obtained through his mother.

Urgent knocking. He opens the door to COLLEAGUE LI, breathless.

COLLEAGUE LI
(nervously)
Zhou! The Guangzhou foundry's new hydraulic press failed. Four workers injured. They need our specs and you on site immediately. Train leaves in forty minutes.

He thrusts a hard-won ticket into Zhou Yuchen's hand. Zhou Yuchen glances back at the bedroom, then grabs a scrap of paper and a pencil stub.

INT. XIXIAN EMBROIDERY FACTORY - DAY

ON SCREEN: Five years later

FEMALE WORKERS crowd the hall, gossiping. ZHANG XIUYING crouches by a broken treadle machine, adjusting the shuttle with a screwdriver. A SMALL GIRL with her hair in tufted braids clutches her leg.

FEMALE WORKER A
They say the new director demanded our best mechanic be present for inspection. That's why we're all lined up like ducks.

FEMALE WORKER B
If he's single, I'll volunteer to oil his bicycle chain every morning!

The workers giggle. Zhang Xiuying stands, wiping her hands on her work apron.

ZHANG XIUYING (V.O.)
Four letters sent, none returned. The factory moved last year. Maybe he can't find us.

A black sedan stops. ZHOU YUCHEN steps out, older, leaner, carrying a leather portfolio. He moves through the bowing workers, eyes scanning the machinery, not the people—until he sees Zhang Xiuying's hands. The screwdriver. The gear-shaped bracelet.

He stops mid-step. She looks up.

ZHOU YUCHEN
(quietly)
You're supposed to be at the Fifteenth Brigade.

ZHANG XIUYING
We transferred when the factory opened. I... kept the bracelet oiled.

The little girl peers out from behind her. Zhou Yuchen's knuckles go white on his portfolio.

title: The Delicate County Magistrate Enters Your Embrace
description: An emperor in disguise travels to Peach Blossom County and encounters a mysterious modern woman who has become the county magistrate.
context:
Title: The Delicate County Magistrate Enters Your Embrace
Description: An emperor in disguise travels to Peach Blossom County and encounters a mysterious modern woman who has become the county magistrate.

EXT. PEACH BLOSSOM COUNTY OUTSKIRTS - DAY

A carriage creaks along a dusty path beneath weathered ramparts.

The carriage passes through the city gate, where a wooden sign reads "PEACH BLOSSOM COUNTY."

EXT. PEACH BLOSSOM COUNTY STREET - DAY

The carriage halts amid market chaos. Vendors shout. Children scatter.

XIAO LIZI (O.S.)
Your Majesty...

XIAO LIZI jumps down, dusting his sleeves as he approaches the cabin.

XIAO LIZI
We've reached Peach Blossom County. The Empress Dowager's envoys won't find you here.

FANG SHANG (late 20s, regal bearing poorly hidden by plain robes) emerges, eyes scanning the street with sharp interest.

FANG SHANG
I came to see the wonders I've heard of—caravan separators, strange laws, and talents that could serve the realm.

XIAO LIZI
As you wish! Onward!

FANG SHANG
(softly)
We're simple travelers, Xiao Lizi. Not an imperial procession.

XIAO LIZI
My apologies, mas— master.

The carriage inches forward through crowds.

XIAO LIZI
Master... there's talk of a woman running this county. Some say she's overturned tradition.

FANG SHANG
That remains to be seen.

FLASHBACK
continuation:
INT. PALACE - DAY (THREE YEARS AGO)

Black and white. FANG SHANG (younger, curious) stands before a glowing bronze vessel. He pins a strange badge to his robe.

The water swirls. XUE FEIFEI (20s, pink bunny pajamas, toothbrush in mouth) emerges.

Their eyes meet.

FANG SHANG
A spirit?

XUE FEIFEI
(amazed)
Time travel—

FANG SHANG
(stumbling back)
Assassin!

He looks back. She's vanished. Only the badge pulses in his hand.

FANG SHANG
(whisper)
A woman from nowhere... or from years ahead?

END FLASHBACK

EXT. PEACH BLOSSOM COUNTY STREET - DAY

FANG SHANG touches his chest where the badge hangs hidden.

FANG SHANG
Drive on.

EXT. COUNTY OFFICE ENTRANCE - DAY

XUE FEIFEI (early 20s, face half-veiled) steps out, reading a bamboo slip. The carriage clips her.

She drops the slip, catching herself mid-fall.

XUE FEIFEI
(rapid-fire)
Ow! Spine, elbow, dignity...

She tests her limbs.

XUE FEIFEI
Still functional.

FANG SHANG and XIAO LIZI approach.

FANG SHANG
You're mobile. Good. Then—

XIAO LIZI
You ran into us deliberately.

XUE FEIFEI
(brandishing the slip)
This is a marked crosswalk. Even merchants must yield.

She points to chalk lines on the ground.

LING'ER (severe bun, watchful eyes) appears at the doorway.

LING'ER
The Magistrate hears disputes at noon. Wait inside.

XUE FEIFEI
Yes.

She turns, veil slipping.

FANG SHANG
That voice—

XIAO LIZI
Master, we should depart—

FANG SHANG
(cutting him off)
This county has... unusual priorities.

LING'ER
Our priorities are fairness. Even nobles must obey the crossing law.

XIAO LIZI
You'd apply law to—the highest authority?

LING'ER
The Magistrate wrote it. All bow to precedent.

INT. COUNTY OFFICE HALL - DAY

XUE FEIFEI has shed her veil. In official robes, she strikes the gavel.

XUE FEIFEI
Court is in session!
(eyes drifting to the doorway)
Bring in the travelers from the street incident.

She fingers her sleeve's hem, where a tiny embroidered rabbit peeks out.

title: The Feisty Pregnant Wife
description: A young village girl's university acceptance letter is burned by her family, who plan to marry her off to pay for her sister's education.
context:
Title: The Feisty Pregnant Wife
Description: A young village girl's university acceptance letter is burned by her family, who plan to marry her off to pay for her sister's education.

EXT. VILLAGE PATH - DAY

Golden afternoon light. SONG AIWEI (18), a determined girl in patched floral clothing, balances a bamboo basket of firewood on her back while clutching a worn math textbook.

She reaches a stone bridge where AUNT WANG and AUNT LIU rest with their hoes.

AUNT WANG
(noticing the book)
Aiwei! The postmaster just came through—university letters arrived. You still waiting on Jiangcheng?

SONG AIWEI
(eyes lighting up)
I am. Thought I'd finish gathering wood first.

AUNT LIU
Go, child. Education won't wait for firewood.

SONG AIWEI
(grateful smile)
Thank you. I'll go now.

She sets down the basket and hurries off, book still in hand.

SONG AIWEI (V.O.)
Two years of studying by lantern light. It has to be enough.

EXT. FARMHOUSE COURTYARD - DAY

MOTHER (40s, tired eyes) stands guard near the door while FATHER (50s, calloused hands) crouches behind the water barrel, feeding papers to a small cookfire.

MOTHER
(low voice)
The postmaster said afternoon. She could be—

FATHER
(quiet, grim)
We finish this now.

SONG AIWEI rounds the corner, breathless.

SONG AIWEI
Did anything come from—

She freezes. Sees the corner of a familiar red-and-white envelope turning to ash.

SONG AIWEI
(voice cracking)
No...

She lunges, grabbing the scorched remnant. The university seal half-visible.

SONG AIWEI
(whisper)
Why?

MOTHER
(stepping forward)
Your sister got her acceptance yesterday. City university. Expensive.

FATHER
(staring at the fire)
Two college girls? We can't.
continuation:
SONG AIWEI
(desperate)
I'll work. Loans. Anything—

MOTHER
(hard voice)
Don't be foolish. Wang Mazi offered sixty thousand. For Yuqing's tuition. Your sister's future.

SONG AIWEI
And mine?

YUQING (17, nervous energy) appears in the doorway, avoiding eye contact. YUHANG (16, sullen) loiters behind her, rope coiled at his waist.

SONG YUHANG
You're the oldest. It's your duty.

SONG AIWEI
(to Yuqing)
You knew?

Song Yuqing flinches but says nothing.

WANG MAZI (40s, limping) enters the courtyard, grin revealing missing teeth.

WANG MAZI
Your parents speak true, girl. You'll be well cared for.

SONG AIWEI
(backing against the wall)
I'd rather die.

MOTHER
Don't be dramatic. You'll thank us—

SONG AIWEI
I won't go!

She makes a break for the gate. Yuhang blocks her. Father grabs her arm.

SONG YUHANG
(getting rope)
Hold her still!

Title: The Feisty Pregnant Wife
Description: A young village girl's university acceptance letter is burned by her family, who plan to marry her off to pay for her sister's education.

EXT. VILLAGE PATH - DAY

Golden afternoon light. SONG AIWEI (18), a determined girl in patched floral clothing, balances a bamboo basket of firewood on her back while clutching a worn math textbook.

She reaches a stone bridge where AUNT WANG and AUNT LIU rest with their hoes.

AUNT WANG
(noticing the book)
Aiwei! The postmaster just came through—university letters arrived. You still waiting on Jiangcheng?

SONG AIWEI
(eyes lighting up)
I am. Thought I'd finish gathering wood first.

AUNT LIU
Go, child. Education won't wait for firewood.

SONG AIWEI
(grateful smile)
Thank you. I'll go now.

She sets down the basket and hurries off, book still in hand.

SONG AIWEI (V.O.)
Two years of studying by lantern light. It has to be enough.

EXT. FARMHOUSE COURTYARD - DAY

MOTHER (40s, tired eyes) stands guard near the door while FATHER (50s, calloused hands) crouches behind the water barrel, feeding papers to a small cookfire.

MOTHER
(low voice)
The postmaster said afternoon. She could be—

FATHER
(quiet, grim)
We finish this now.

SONG AIWEI rounds the corner, breathless.

SONG AIWEI
Did anything come from—

She freezes. Sees the corner of a familiar red-and-white envelope turning to ash.

SONG AIWEI
(voice cracking)
No...

She lunges, grabbing the scorched remnant. The university seal half-visible.

SONG AIWEI
(whisper)
Why?

MOTHER
(stepping forward)
Your sister got her acceptance yesterday. City university. Expensive.

FATHER
(staring at the fire)
Two college girls? We can't.

SONG AIWEI
(desperate)
I'll work. Loans. Anything—

MOTHER
(hard voice)
Don't be foolish. Wang Mazi offered sixty thousand. For Yuqing's tuition. Your sister's future.

SONG AIWEI
And mine?

YUQING (17, nervous energy) appears in the doorway, avoiding eye contact. YUHANG (16, sullen) loiters behind her, rope coiled at his waist.

SONG YUHANG
You're the oldest. It's your duty.

SONG AIWEI
(to Yuqing)
You knew?

Song Yuqing flinches but says nothing.

WANG MAZI (40s, limping) enters the courtyard, grin revealing missing teeth.

WANG MAZI
Your parents speak true, girl. You'll be well cared for.

SONG AIWEI
(backing against the wall)
I'd rather die.

MOTHER
Don't be dramatic. You'll thank us—

SONG AIWEI
I won't go!

She makes a break for the gate. Yuhang blocks her. Father grabs her arm.

SONG YUHANG
(getting rope)
Hold her still!

She kicks, struggles. Yuqing watches, trembling.

SONG AIWEI
(to Yuqing)
Help me! Please!

(terrified, to Aiwei)
