title: Sorry, I'm Not Your White Moonlight
description: An interior designer unexpectedly reunites with a CEO from a fateful night four years ago when she arrives late to present her design proposal.
context:
Title: Sorry, I'm Not Your White Moonlight
Description: An interior designer unexpectedly reunites with a CEO from a fateful night four years ago when she arrives late to present her design proposal.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

CLOSE UP on a man's black dress shoes pacing, then a woman's pointed heels step into frame.

A woman (NING XI) looks up at a man (ZHAN LIHAN).

CLOSE UP on the woman's hands on the man's bare chest.

The couple lies in bed, embracing.

INT. NING XI'S BEDROOM - DAY

An alarm rings on a smartphone showing 08:00.

NING XI, an interior designer, wakes with a start, hand pressed to her chest.

NING XI (V.O.)
Four years, and that night still follows me.

The bedroom door creaks open. A little girl, NING ANXING, peeks in.

NING ANXING
Mommy, you'll be late.

Ning Xi bolts up, rushes to her daughter.

NING XI
Xingxing.

She kneels, smoothing her daughter's hair.

NING XI
Big meeting today. Grandma's picking you up, okay?

Ning Xi kisses her daughter's cheek.

NING XI
Land this contract, and that princess dress is yours.

NING ANXING
Good luck, Mommy!

Ning Xi smiles and rushes off.
continuation:
EXT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

Establishing shot of a modern glass skyscraper.

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

ZHAN LIHAN, a CEO, sits at the head of a long conference table. He pushes aside a design portfolio.

ZHAN LIHAN
This is your standard?

ANNA, Ning Xi's superior, stands nervously.

ANNA
Mr. Zhan, our senior designer is en route—

Ning Xi enters, breathless. She freezes at the sight of Zhan Lihan—her portfolio tumbling onto the table.

Zhan Lihan and Ning Xi lock eyes. Shock ripples between them. NING YANG, another woman at the table, tenses.

NING YANG
(under her breath)
Ning Xi...

ANNA
(relieved)
Finally.

ANNA
(to Zhan Lihan)
Mr. Zhan, Ning Xi—our lead designer.

ANNA
(to Ning Xi)
Show him your design.

As Ning Xi reaches for her scattered work, her finger grazes the mole behind Zhan Lihan's ear. She freezes.

A quick montage: their intimate night four years ago, the mole, a scent.

Zhan Lihan's hand tightens on the table. Ning Xi jerks back.

ZHAN LIHAN (V.O.)
That scent...

Zhan Lihan stands, his chair scraping the silence.

ZHAN LIHAN
May 20th. Four years ago. Where were you?

Ning Xi stares back, the papers trembling in her hands.

title: Sorry, I Got the Cultivation Script
description: A young woman raised in a Taoist temple returns to her wealthy birth family, but she only seeks to sever karmic ties and leave.
context:
Title: Sorry, I Got the Cultivation Script
Description: A young woman raised in a Taoist temple returns to her wealthy birth family, but she only seeks to sever karmic ties and leave.

INT. UNDER THE BRIDGE - DAY

LIN MOMO, in a weathered Taoist robe and bamboo hat, packs her fortune-telling stall with methodical precision. The LIN FAMILY YOUNG MASTER, mid-twenties in a tailored brown suit, approaches with the forced patience of someone handling a problem.

LIN FAMILY YOUNG MASTER
Three hundred thousand. Leave the capital tonight, and we all move on.

Lin Momo's hands still. She turns. Her eyes catch the light—not quite human.

LIN MOMO
Three hundred thousand. For a life?

FATHER LIN strides from a black sedan, its door still open, chauffeur waiting. His phone screen glows in his hand—stock market red.

FATHER LIN
What is this?

LIN FAMILY YOUNG MASTER
(to Father Lin)
She's threatening me!

LIN MOMO
(calmly, to Father Lin)
The Lin family has... obligations. Three million settles them. Then I'm gone.

MOTHER LIN emerges from the same sedan, LIN SUSU on her arm. Susu's silk dress catches the wind perfectly.

FATHER LIN
(staring at his phone)
Three million?

LIN SUSU
(to Father Lin, voice like syrup)
Daddy, sister doesn't understand how we do things here. Let's not overwhelm her.

She turns to Lin Momo, her smile reaching nowhere near her eyes.

LIN SUSU
Sister, I've never seen Dad this worried. Just come home, okay?

Lin Momo studies Susu's face—the darting eyes, the asymmetry in her features. Her fingers find the edge of a talisman in her sleeve.

FATHER LIN
(pointing at the talisman)
Hmph! Hands that could work, yet she chooses to swindle!

MOTHER LIN
(takes Lin Momo's hand, her touch ice-cold)
Momo, come home. We'll teach you how to be a proper Lin.

Lin Momo looks down at their joined hands. The memory hits like a physical blow.

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
EXT. MOUNTAIN FOREST - DAY

Young LIN MOMO, eight years old, clutches a basket of rare herbs. Three children in designer clothes knock her down. Mud slicks her face.

CHILDREN (O.S.)
Temple rat! Temple rat! No family, no name!

EXT. YUNQING TEMPLE ENTRANCE - DAY

Heavy snow. Young Lin Momo curls frozen at the temple gate, a jade pendant clutched in her fist. The door creaks. OLD TAOIST MASTER picks her up like she weighs nothing.

INT. TEMPLE COURTYARD - DAY

Young Lin Momo, now ten, carries water buckets twice her size. A teenage monk trips her. Water spills. She catches her reflection in the puddle—sees the Lin family jade around her neck. Wipes her eyes.

The Old Taoist Master places a wooden sword in her hands. She grips it hard enough to whiten her knuckles.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. UNDER THE BRIDGE - DAY

Lin Momo's fingers tighten around Mother Lin's cold hand. Then release.

LIN MOMO
(internal monologue)
Heaven and earth raised me. The Lin name only gave me a body to repay.

She looks up. Her jade pendant—the same from the flashback—catches the fading light. Not quite a glow. A promise.

LIN MOMO
(quietly)
Fine. I'll come. I'll settle the karma.

She turns, her bamboo hat shadowing her eyes, and walks toward the waiting sedan.

title: Finding the Secret of Cinderella
description: A reclusive fashion prodigy, scarred by public humiliation, becomes easy prey for her stepsister's long con—until a single interview exposes the true cost of her hunger for acceptance.
context:
Title: Finding the Secret of Cinderella
Description: A reclusive fashion prodigy, scarred by public humiliation, becomes easy prey for her stepsister's long con—until a single interview exposes the true cost of her hunger for acceptance.

EXT. FASHION GALA - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SCISSORHAND BAI stands before a shattered mannequin, scissors still in hand. The CROWD erupts.

CROWD
(laughing, chanting)
Scissorhands! Scissorhands!

SCISSORHAND BAI flees, dropping her shears.

EXT. TOWNHOUSE - DAY

SCISSORHAND BAI trudges home, clutching her portfolio.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Her stepsister BAI XUE arranges orchids.

BAI XUE
(not turning)
The gallery called again. I told them you were unwell.

SCISSORHAND BAI
You didn't have to—

BAI XUE
(facing her, concerned)
But who else will protect you?

She gestures to a cake—two tiers, sugar scissor motif.

BAI XUE
Your favorite. It took all morning.

SCISSORHAND BAI
(softening)
You shouldn't have.

BAI XUE
You deserve sweetness, sister. After all that ugliness.

SCISSORHAND BAI approaches the cake.

BAI XUE (V.O.)
(low, melodic)
Yes. Eat. Fill that hollow place.

BAI XUE
(aloud, bright)
The Gallery sketches—you promised them.

SCISSORHAND BAI
(mouth full)
Mmf. Desk drawer.

BAI XUE
My angel.
continuation:
INT. DESIGN STUDIO - DAY

SCISSORHAND BAI hunches over her drafting table. BAI XUE brings coffee, sees the laptop—an email from NEW FASHION.

BAI XUE
(reading aloud, casual)
'Dear Scissorhand Bai—intriguing portfolio... feature opportunity...'

BAI XUE
(turning to SCISSORHAND BAI, delighted)
They want you! You must go.

SCISSORHAND BAI
I can't—

BAI XUE
You won't have to. I'll be your voice.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE VENUE - DAY

REPORTERS crowd around. SCISSORHAND BAI, ill-fitting gown. BAI XUE, custom couture.

REPORTER
Which of you is—

BAI XUE
(smiling for cameras)
I'm Scissorhand Bai. This is my assistant... also Bai. Family tradition.

BAI XUE squeezes SCISSORHAND BAI'S shoulder—possessive, final. SCISSORHAND BAI stares at the cameras, hollow.

SCISSORHAND BAI
(whisper)
My shears...

BAI XUE
(whisper back)
Don't worry. I'll cut for you now.

SCISSORHAND BAI watches her sister become her. The cake turns to acid in her stomach.

title: Seeking Jade
description: A man leaves a jade pendant with a woman after a night together, but a scheming rival takes the pendant and frames her. Six years later, the woman is found by mysterious followers.
context:
Title: Seeking Jade
Description: A man leaves a jade pendant with a woman after a night together, but a scheming rival takes the pendant and frames her. Six years later, the woman is found by mysterious followers.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Romantic music plays. The silhouettes of a man and woman kiss intimately in warm lighting. Cut to their hands intertwined - the man wears a watch, the woman wears a ring.

The man (XIE JINYAN) in a white shirt adjusts his tie. The woman (YE LIANGYU) lies in bed, covered by a blanket.

XIE JINYAN (V.O.)
Keep this safe. When you're ready, come find me at the Xie family residence.

XIE JINYAN places a jade pendant in YE LIANGYU's hand, then turns and leaves.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - LATER

A woman (YAO QINGQING) in a black camisole and red pants enters the room aggressively with two BODYGUARDS in black.

BODYGUARD
President Xie's driver confirmed he used his suite key-card here.

YAO QINGQING sees YE LIANGYU sleeping in the bed. Her expression instantly turns furious.

YAO QINGQING
(whispering)
She's just a street vendor from the garden party. She actually dared...

YAO QINGQING
Seize her.

BODYGUARD
Yes!

YAO QINGQING
Wait.

YAO QINGQING notices the jade pendant in YE LIANGYU's hand. She walks forward and takes it, examining it closely.

YAO QINGQING (V.O.)
The heirlooms have specific inscriptions. If the poison affected his vision... this could work.

YAO QINGQING
Put her in the service elevator. Take her to the Shanghai director's suite. Leave extra cash.

BODYGUARD
Understood.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

Six years later.

YE LIANGYU, wearing a simple white dress, pushes a cart full of flowers down the street. A pink sign hangs on the cart reading "Valentine's Day Flower Sale."

YE LIANGYU
(calling out)
Valentine's Day flower sale! Come take a look!

YE LIANGYU sees a couple walking by and immediately approaches them.

YE LIANGYU
Hey, sir, buy a flower for your girlfriend.

The couple ignores her and walks away. YE LIANGYU spots another man walking past.

YE LIANGYU
Sir, buy a flower for your girlfriend.

A man in a floral shirt (PASSERBY A) stops and takes a flower from YE LIANGYU.

PASSERBY A
Hey, beautiful. If you're willing to be my girlfriend, I'll buy all these flowers for you. How about it?

YE LIANGYU
(smiling)
Sure. But let's see if you have what it takes.

YE LIANGYU suddenly grabs PASSERBY A's wrist and twists it hard.

PASSERBY A
(in pain)
Ow ow ow ow!

PASSERBY A breaks free, rubbing his wrist.

PASSERBY A
If you don't want to, fine. What's the big deal? No wonder you're alone.

PASSERBY A walks away cursing. YE LIANGYU looks at his back with disdain.

YE LIANGYU
(Quietly)
Still counting.

EXT. STREET - CONTINUOUS

Suddenly, a group of young women in black uniforms carrying short batons quickly run up and surround YE LIANGYU and her flower cart, forming a formation.

A leader (XIAO LINGLONG) steps forward from the group, approaching YE LIANGYU and bowing respectfully.

XIAO LINGLONG
Young Master.

YE LIANGYU looks at her in surprise.

XIAO LINGLONG
We have finally found you. Please come back with us.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Bringing the Human Trafficker to Justice
description: A young waitress discovers her childhood abductor on the news and must confront her painful past.
context:
Title: Bringing the Human Trafficker to Justice
Description: A young waitress discovers her childhood abductor on the news and must confront her painful past.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

Young waitress TAO GUIJIA, wearing an apron, carries a plate of steamed buns and a bowl of porridge, walking out from the kitchen with a practiced smile.

TAO GUIJIA
Your order is ready.

She places the food in front of a table of customers.

CUSTOMER (O.S.)
Check, please!

TAO GUIJIA
Coming.

TAO turns toward the cashier. Her hand drifts to her pocket, touching something small. She winces slightly, rubbing her lower back.

MALE CUSTOMER
Waitress—beer.

TAO GUIJIA
(quickly composing herself)
Right away.

TAO moves toward the cooler. Her phone VIBRATES. Caller ID: "Mom." The smile drops. She stares at it, then answers.

INT. RESTAURANT BY THE WINDOW - DAY

TAO stands by the window, phone pressed to her ear, gaze distant.

TAO'S MOTHER (V.O.)
Your brother's school fees are due. Why is it only two thousand this month? The doctor again?

TAO
(faintly)
It got worse.

TAO'S MOTHER (V.O.)
Then stop wasting money on doctors. Send everything next time. Your brother needs—

The call cuts. TAO lowers the phone, her fingers shaking. She swallows hard, eyes glassy. Her hand returns to her pocket, clutching something hidden there.

TAO (V.O.)
Five hundred yuan. Just to hear there's nothing they can do.
continuation:
INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

The OWNER appears, his voice sharp but controlled.

OWNER
Table four's been waiting. You're here to work, not stare out windows, understood?

TAO GUIJIA
(quickly wiping her eyes)
Yes, boss. Sorry.

OWNER
Get back to it.

TAO hurries toward the tables.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

TAO approaches a MALE CUSTOMER and FEMALE CUSTOMER with a bottle of beer. A TV on the wall plays the evening news.

TV NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...in the case against human trafficking suspect MEI, prosecutors presented surveillance footage showing...

MALE CUSTOMER
(glancing at his phone)
They caught her because of some traffic camera. Eight years.

TV NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...sentenced to eight years imprisonment.

TAO freezes mid-step. The glass bottle slips in her grip.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Should've been longer. They say she's appealing.

MALE CUSTOMER
They all do.

TAO sets the beer down with forced steadiness.

TAO GUIJIA
Your beer.

She turns. The TV screen shows a courthouse photo of MEI, 50s, unremarkable. TAO's breath catches. She stares, unblinking. Her hand drifts to her pocket again, emerging with a broken green plastic ring—child-sized, faded.

FLASHBACK - EXT. FOREST PATH - 20 YEARS AGO

Desaturated footage.

MEI (30s) drags a small figure by the wrist through dense trees. YOUNG TAO (6) stumbles, her green ring catching light.

YOUNG TAO
(whispered, terrified)
Please... I dropped my ring...

MEI
Keep walking.

Young Tao looks back at something glinting in the dirt. Mei yanks her forward. The ring is left behind, half-buried.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

TAO stands motionless, tears streaming down her face. She turns the broken ring over in her fingers, fitting the pieces together. Her jaw tightens.

TAO (V.O.)
You left something behind.

TAO pulls out her phone with her free hand. Her thumb hovers over the emergency number on the screen, her gaze fixed on the TV.

(quickly composing herself)
Right away.

TAO moves toward the cooler. Her phone VIBRATES. Caller ID: "Mom." The smile drops. She stares at it, then answers.

INT. RESTAURANT BY THE WINDOW - DAY

TAO stands by the window, phone pressed to her ear, gaze distant.

TAO'S MOTHER (V.O.)
Your brother's school fees are due. Why is it only two thousand this month? The doctor again?

TAO
(faintly)
It got worse.

TAO'S MOTHER (V.O.)
Then stop wasting money on doctors. Send everything next time. Your brother needs—

The call cuts. TAO lowers the phone, her fingers shaking. She swallows hard, eyes glassy. Her hand returns to her pocket, clutching something hidden there.

TAO (V.O.)
Five hundred yuan. Just to hear there's nothing they can do.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

The OWNER appears, his voice sharp but controlled.

OWNER
Table four's been waiting. You're here to work, not stare out windows, understood?

TAO GUIJIA
(quickly wiping her eyes)
Yes, boss. Sorry.

OWNER
Get back to it.

TAO hurries toward the tables.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

TAO approaches a MALE CUSTOMER and FEMALE CUSTOMER with a bottle of beer. A TV on the wall plays the evening news.

...in the case against human trafficking suspect MEI, prosecutors presented surveillance footage showing...

MALE CUSTOMER
(glancing at his phone)
They caught her because of some traffic camera. Eight years.

TV NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...sentenced to eight years imprisonment.

TAO freezes mid-step. The glass bottle slips in her grip.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Should've been longer. They say she's appealing.

MALE CUSTOMER
They all do.

TAO sets the beer down with forced steadiness.

TAO GUIJIA
Your beer.

FLASHBACK - EXT. FOREST PATH - 20 YEARS AGO

Desaturated footage.

MEI (30s) drags a small figure by the wrist through dense trees. YOUNG TAO (6) stumbles, her green ring catching light.

YOUNG TAO
(whispered, terrified)
Please... I dropped my ring...

MEI
Keep walking.

Young Tao looks back at something glinting in the dirt. Mei yanks her forward. The ring is left behind, half-buried.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

TAO stands motionless, tears streaming down her face. She turns the broken ring over in her fingers, fitting the pieces together. Her jaw tightens.

TAO (V.O.)
You left something behind.

TAO pulls out her phone with her free hand. Her thumb hovers over the emergency number on the screen, her gaze fixed on the TV.

title: Little Magpie's Long Tail (Episode 53)
description: A son brings his rural parents to the city, but his wife and mother-in-law stage a fake accident to test his priorities, leading to unexpected consequences.
context:
Title: Little Magpie's Long Tail (Episode 53)
Description: A son brings his rural parents to the city, but his wife and mother-in-law stage a fake accident to test his priorities, leading to unexpected consequences.

EXT. LIN FAMILY VILLAGE - DAY

WU XIUYUN and LIN CHENGDONG are chasing a large rooster around the yard with great effort.

WU XIUYUN
Corner it by the well!

LIN CHENGDONG
I'm trying! Quick, grab it!

Their son LIN TIANCI, wearing a suit, stands next to a black car, watching them with affectionate worry.

LIN TIANCI
Mom! Dad! Please, just let it go. The trunk's already full.

WU XIUYUN makes a flying leap and finally catches the rooster.

WU XIUYUN
(laughing, breathless)
Got the rascal! All this trouble for Qianwen's soup.

WU XIUYUN holds the rooster gently. LIN TIANCI opens the trunk with a smile, rearranging things to make space.

LIN TIANCI
She'll taste the love in it, Mom.

LIN TIANCI closes the trunk.

LIN TIANCI
Dad, Mom.

LIN CHENGDONG and WU XIUYUN walk over carrying a carefully wrapped bundle and a basket of fresh eggs.

LIN TIANCI
You shouldn't have gone to all this trouble. The doctor said Qianwen needs rest, not surprises.

WU XIUYUN
Home-raised eggs don't need a doctor's note.

LIN TIANCI
(softly)
I know. Get in, please.

They get in the car, and the vehicle drives away from the village.
continuation:
INT. FANG QIANWEN'S CAR - DAY

FANG QIANWEN drives a white car, knuckles tight on the wheel. Her mother XU XIA sits in the back seat.

FANG QIANWEN
The specialist said minimize stress. How is having your in-laws camped in our living room stress-free?

XU XIA
You're eight months pregnant. If Tianci won't prioritize you now, when will he? A small test, Qianwen. Just to see where his heart is.

INT. LIN TIANCI'S CAR - DAY

LIN TIANCI drives while his parents sit in the back seat, beaming with quiet happiness.

LIN TIANCI
Qianwen's been anxious about the baby. The doctor suggested... routine.

LIN CHENGDONG
We won't be any trouble. Your mother can cook in the hallway if she has to.

WU XIUYUN
(nodding with a smile)
We'll be quieter than the rooster.

INT. FANG QIANWEN'S CAR - DAY

FANG QIANWEN
I need to know I'm not becoming invisible, Mom. That our family still comes first.

FANG QIANWEN glances at a "NO STOPPING" sign, then jerks the steering wheel. The car makes a sharp braking sound and stops by the roadside.

INT. LIN TIANCI'S CAR - DAY

LIN TIANCI's phone rings. He pulls the car over at an awkward angle on a slight incline, tires scraping the curb.

LIN TIANCI
(answering, hurried)
Qianwen?

FANG QIANWEN (V.O.)
(panicked)
We got rear-ended! My stomach—something's wrong!

LIN TIANCI
Where are you? Call 911!

FANG QIANWEN (V.O.)
Just come. Please.

XU XIA (V.O.)
(grabbing the phone, ice-cold)
Lin Tianci. Your wife is bleeding. Are you dropping off luggage or saving your child?

FANG QIANWEN (V.O.)
(whispering)
I'm scared.

LIN TIANCI
(hand trembling)
I'm two minutes away.

He ends the call. The car's dash shows a warning: "TRANSMISSION ACTIVE."

LIN CHENGDONG
Son. Go. We'll sit here.

WU XIUYUN
We'll be right here.

LIN TIANCI's face crumples. He jumps out, keys still in hand. The doors click locked behind him.

EXT. CITY ROAD - DAY

LIN TIANCI's black car sits crookedly on the incline. He runs toward FANG QIANWEN's white car. Its hood is open, but FANG QIANWEN and XU XIA stand unharmed, faces stricken.

FANG QIANWEN
Tianci—

LIN TIANCI
(getting out, rushing)
Where's the ambulance?

He looks back. His black car begins rolling forward, steering locked.

LIN TIANCI
Dad! The brake!

INT. BLACK CAR - DAY

WU XIUYUN and LIN CHENGDONG are trapped inside the rolling car. LIN CHENGDONG fumbles for the brake pedal, but his legs won't respond.

WU XIUYUN
Old man! The gear!

She lunges for the shifter as the car picks up speed down the hill.

WU XIUYUN
Tianci! The key! The key!

The car rolls through an intersection toward a construction barrier.

FADE OUT.

title: Little Empress Dowager at Four and a Half
description: A modern woman transmigrates to ancient times and becomes a four-year-old Empress Dowager, enjoying a life of luxury while managing the imperial harem.
context:
Title: Little Empress Dowager at Four and a Half
Description: A modern woman transmigrates to ancient times and becomes a four-year-old Empress Dowager, enjoying a life of luxury while managing the imperial harem.

INT. CINING PALACE - DAY

Inside Cining Palace, lavishly decorated. Four-year-old Empress Dowager YUN SHU sits on the main seat, wearing luxurious court robes that dwarf her tiny frame.

A group of CONCUBINES kneel on the ground, bowing to her with precise, practiced movements.

CONCUBINES
(in unison)
Empress Dowager, may you live a thousand years, a thousand years, a thousand thousand years!

YUN SHU
(childish but dignified)
Rise.

CONCUBINES
Thank you, Empress Dowager.

The concubines stand and line up on both sides, their practiced smiles barely concealing their scrutiny.

YUN SHU (V.O.)
Three weeks ago, I was a twenty-eight-year-old accountant. Today, I'm a four-year-old Empress Dowager. The costume is ridiculous. The power? Strangely real.

NOBLE CONSORT ZHANG steps forward holding a bowl of exquisite fruit honey, her smile too sweet.

NOBLE CONSORT ZHANG
(obsequiously)
Empress Dowager, this fruit honey came from the Western Regions. Please honor this consort by tasting it.

YUN SHU's eyes light up. Maid QING'ER receives the bowl and hands it to YUN SHU.

Seeing this, NOBLE CONSORT CHEN immediately steps forward, holding up a huge rainbow lollipop concealed in her sleeve.

NOBLE CONSORT CHEN
Empress Dowager, my tribute is sweeter still. And it lasts longer than honey.

QING'ER takes the lollipop and hands it to YUN SHU. YUN SHU hugs the candy that's bigger than her face, her composure cracking into a child's grin.

YUN SHU (V.O.)
They think I'm a child. I encourage it. It's easier when they underestimate the puppet—especially when the puppet holds the strings.

YUN SHU
(composing herself)
Noble Consort Chen understands my heart. I have told the Emperor to visit you tonight.
continuation:
NOBLE CONSORT CHEN
(overjoyed)
Your servant thanks Empress Dowager!

NOBLE CONSORT ZHANG
(jealous but restrained)
Empress Dowager is most kind.

YUN SHU
The Emperor will go to Noble Consort Chen tonight. To you, tomorrow. Balance is the way of the harem.

Seeing this, the other concubines take out various candies and swarm forward.

CONCUBINES
(talking over each other)
Empress Dowager! Try mine! I prepared— Mine is— Please—

YUN SHU
(putting on a stern face, her small hand raising)
Enough. You are sisters in the imperial family. Act like it. Dismissed.

CONCUBINES
(respectfully)
Yes, Empress Dowager.

The concubines withdraw, some casting dark glances back at the child on the throne.

QING'ER stands beside YUN SHU, refilling her tea.

QING'ER
(quietly)
They grow more desperate, Empress Dowager. Yesterday it was silk, today it's sweets. Tomorrow—

YUN SHU
(studying the lollipop)
As long as they compete with candy, they won't compete with knives. That's management, Qing'er. Not desperation.

A PALACE MAID runs in frantically and kneels on the ground.

PALACE MAID
(anxiously)
Empress Dowager! The Empress has collapsed in Kunning Palace—over the new Consort Yun Zhao!

YUN SHU
(her expression changes, the child vanishing from her eyes)
Fetch my physician's pouch. Not the palace one. Mine.

YUN SHU sets down the lollipop, her small fingers steady as a surgeon's.

title: Little Her
description: An elderly underground worker with limited time left is tasked with finding a legendary information genius known only as "Red Hat" to help with the urgent war effort.
context:
Title: Little Her
Description: An elderly underground worker with limited time left is tasked with finding a legendary information genius known only as "Red Hat" to help with the urgent war effort.

INT. GRANDFATHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY

RADIO (V.O.)
...mathematical genius program activated. Northern front encryption failing under enemy information warfare...

OLD WANG (70s, trembling hands) sits with XUANXUAN (8, still as a pond, eyes too old).

OLD WANG
Xuanxuan. Show me what I taught you.

OLD WANG places a ONE-JIAO COIN on the table.

OLD WANG
One jiao. One steamed bun. Base value.

OLD WANG places a FIVE-JIAO BILL beside it.

OLD WANG
Five jiao. One bun with filling. But context changes worth.

XUANXUAN
(calculating silently)
Plain: 80 grams. Filled: 120 grams. Filling density unknown. Value requires more data points.

OLD WANG
(faint pride)
Always more data.

AUNT DIAO (50s, practical, worn-thin) enters, envelope in hand.

AUNT DIAO
Hospital courier. Said deliver it straight.

She sets it down. Old Wang reads. His jaw tightens.

INSERT: DIAGNOSIS
"Daqing People's Hospital. Terminal. 30 days."

AUNT DIAO
(quieter)
My sister's boy could use a friend. She'd be fed. I'd see to it.

OLD WANG
She's not a pot to pass around when I'm gone.

AUNT DIAO
(defensive)
Someone has to think practical.

She leaves. Old Wang pockets the paper.

MONTAGE:
- A black sedan speeds through narrow alleys.
- SPECIAL AGENT A (30s, lean) exits, briefcase cuffed to his wrist.
- SPECIAL AGENT B (40s, solid) scans the street, urgent but controlled.
continuation:
INT. GRANDFATHER'S HOUSE LIVING ROOM - DAY

OLD WANG
(to himself)
One month.

The agents enter. Agent A notices the currency arranged in a pattern on the table.

SPECIAL AGENT A
Old Wang. Northern front's losing codes every three hours. We need Red Hat.

OLD WANG
Twenty years in Yuncheng underground. Never heard that name.

SPECIAL AGENT B
1962. Used newspaper circulation numbers to crack a diplomatic cipher. No description. Just the code name.

OLD WANG
No description... except he sees patterns.

SPECIAL AGENT A
(intense)
Exactly.

Xuanxuan has arranged the bills into a star pattern. She looks up, unblinking.

OLD WANG
Xuanxuan. Take five jiao. Buy a bun. Then count the bridge pillars. Bring me the pattern.

XUANXUAN
Pattern is data. Data has value.

She takes the bill and leaves. Agent B watches her measured steps.

SPECIAL AGENT A
The child—

OLD WANG
(to Aunt Diao)
Aunt Diao, please go back as well.

AUNT DIAO
Who cares.

AUNT DIAO leaves. SPECIAL AGENT A notices the diagnosis in Old Wang's pocket.

SPECIAL AGENT A
What's that?

OLD WANG
(laughing)
Gallstones. Two doses of herbs and fine.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

XUANXUAN walks, calculating aloud.

XUANXUAN
Bridge has six pillars. Six points on a star. Red Hat last seen Yuncheng '62. Grandpa's scarf has six red knots...

SPECIAL AGENT A (V.O.)
The situation at the front is extremely urgent right now. The enemy's information offensive against us is very fierce. We came here to find the legendary information genius.

OLD WANG (V.O.)
Information genius? Are there any distinguishing features?

SPECIAL AGENT A (V.O.)
No distinguishing features whatsoever.

SPECIAL AGENT B (V.O.)
All we know is that the last place he appeared was Yuncheng. The only thing we know is his code name: Red Hat.

EXT. DILAPIDATED BRIDGE UNDERPASS - DAY

A BEGGAR (60s, sleeping) wears a tattered RED HAT with a SIX-POINT STAR pattern. XUANXUAN approaches. She places her five-jiao bill beside him, then arranges SIX STONES in a matching star.

The beggar's eyes open—sharp, aware. He touches the pattern, nods slowly.

XUANXUAN
Grandpa says the pattern is the message.

She unties her scarf—same red star pattern—and holds it out.

FADE OUT.

description: A writer who sympathizes with a doomed sect in her novel is transported into the story, becoming a minor character destined to be expelled. She tries to get kicked out, but things don't go as planned.

Description: A writer who sympathizes with a doomed sect in her novel is transported into the story, becoming a minor character destined to be expelled. She tries to get kicked out, but things don't go as planned.

EXT. WASTELAND - DAY

Corpses litter scorched earth. Blood pools in the dirt. A man lies still, blood masking his features.

CHU FENG (Taiyi Sect Saintess)
If the Demon Cult is not eliminated, the righteous path cannot be upheld!

YING WUJI (Wuqing Sect Senior Brother)
Today, I shall grant your wish!

YING WUJI channels energy—blue lightning crackles across his body. CHU FENG lunges, blade glinting. Their clash erupts in a shower of sparks and light. SU YAO presses against a boulder, watching through trembling fingers.

INT. SU YAO'S STUDY - DAY

SU YAO hunches before her computer, fingers frozen above the keyboard. The screen glows with final paragraphs.

SU YAO (V.O.)
They bleed for honor. Wuqing bleeds because I wrote it. Cannon fodder for someone else's story.

Her jaw tightens. She types one last sentence. The monitor blazes—white light floods the room, swallows her. The chair spins, empty.

INT. WUQING SECT GREAT HALL - DAY

The hall looms—mahogany pillars, incense smoke curling toward rafters. Disciples whisper as they enter. A flash of light. SU YAO materializes center floor, ancient robes over modern clothes, pink keyboard clutched to her chest.

SU YAO
(to herself)
Alive. Not home.

She sees a white-haired, one-eyed man—HONG XIVIANG—seated on the high throne. YING WUJI and YU WEI stand at the base.

HONG XIVIANG (Wuqing Sect Master)
Confess. Who killed your fellow disciple?

YING WUJI
(urgently)
Junior Sister, explain!

SU YAO (internal)
Cannon fodder junior sister. Perfect.
continuation:
HONG XIVIANG
Confess now, and I will merely expel you.

YU WEI
Master, I witnessed it. Junior Sister struck the blow.

A vision flashes: YU WEI's triumphant smirk, the words "Divine assist from the enemy camp" glowing beside her.

SU YAO
(loudly)
Yes! I confess—I killed him! Unforgivable! Expel me as example!

YING WUJI
(shocked)
Your skill couldn't—

SU YAO
(cutting him off)
I cheated! Hidden weapons! Sneak attack!

HONG XIVIANG
(slamming the armrest—stone cracks)

Flames erupt in his palm. He thrusts it toward Su Yao.

YING WUJI
(blocking)
No, Master!

The flaming palm strikes YING WUJI's chest—he flies back, crumpling at Su Yao's feet. The flames sputter out.

HONG XIVIANG's expression shifts. He smiles—a slow, approving curve.

HONG XIVIANG
Little Yao... you understand at last.

SU YAO
(blank confusion)
Huh?

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

FADE OUT.

title: The Little Ancestor Became Obedient
description: A young woman is reborn to the day she was framed for drugging her fiancé, determined to change her fate and make those who wronged her pay.
context:
Title: The Little Ancestor Became Obedient
Description: A young woman is reborn to the day she was framed for drugging her fiancé, determined to change her fate and make those who wronged her pay.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Inside the hotel

LU ZHIXIA (the Gu family's adopted daughter) lies on the bed, eyes closed. SHEN CI (Lu Zhixia's fiancé) leans over her, his expression pained, breathing ragged.

SHEN CI
Zhixia... I think I've been drugged. My head...

His hand reaches for her face. LU ZHIXIA's eyes snap open—wide with sudden, horrifying recognition. Her body goes rigid.

LU ZHIXIA (V.O.)
This moment. This exact moment.

She lunges for a red decorative box on the nightstand. SHEN CI grabs her wrist.

SHEN CI
Don't fight it. We belong together--

LU ZHIXIA
(struggling)
Let go!

She wrenches free, swings the box with desperate force. It connects with his temple. SHEN CI collapses, groaning.

Panting, LU ZHIXIA staggers to her feet. She stares at him with pure loathing.

LU ZHIXIA (V.O.)
Not this time.

She straightens her clothes, smooths her hair, and walks out with measured steps.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

LU ZHIXIA exits just as GU CIYUAN (President of Gu Corporation) turns the corner ahead, flanked by BODYGUARDS. His secretary LINA holds a tablet. MENG WAN'ER trails behind, phone in hand, eyes widening.

GU CIYUAN
Stop her.

The guards move forward. LU ZHIXIA freezes.

GU CIYUAN
(to Lina, low)
The tip was accurate. Get the security footage.

MENG WAN'ER
(stepping forward, voice saccharine)
Zhixia, I tried to stop you. Drugging Shen Ci like this—it'll destroy the Gu family's reputation.

From inside the room, SHEN CI's slurred voice:

SHEN CI (O.S.)
No... she didn't... we were just...

LINA
Sir, he's conscious. Should we call medical?

GU CIYUAN
(eyes on Lu Zhixia, cold)
Arrest him. Possession of controlled substances.

GU CIYUAN takes a step closer to LU ZHIXIA, his voice dropping.

GU CIYUAN
Tell me I was wrong about you.

LU ZHIXIA meets his gaze. Her hands tremble. She blinks—once, twice—tears welling despite her control.

INT. OUTDOORS - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

ON SCREEN: The Previous Life

GU CIYUAN holds a younger LU ZHIXIA in his arms. Rain pours down. Her face is pale, blood on her lips.

GU CIYUAN (V.O.)
I found you too late. Always too late.

INT. CAR - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

GU CIYUAN (V.O.)
If I'd been braver... would you have chosen me?

A hand goes limp. The car fills with engine exhaust.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - PRESENT

GU CIYUAN
Lu Zhixia. Do you have anything to say?

LU ZHIXIA looks up at him, tears streaming down her face. She walks toward him, each step deliberate. The bodyguards shift uncertainly. MENG WAN'ER inhales sharply.

LU ZHIXIA stops before GU CIYUAN. She looks up at him—seeing him, truly seeing him, for the first time in both lives.

Under everyone's astonished gaze, LU ZHIXIA stands on her toes and kisses GU CIYUAN.

title: Young Zhang Bei (Episode 63)
description: A young prodigy of the Zhang family demonstrates his appraisal skills as a Japanese master arrives to challenge the Eight Great Families.
context:
Title: Young Zhang Bei (Episode 63)
Description: A young prodigy of the Zhang family demonstrates his appraisal skills as a Japanese master arrives to challenge the Eight Great Families.

EXT. ANCIENT TOWN - DAY

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
Word spreads: Hikawa Daiyuu, master appraiser from across the sea, has returned to Great Xia with a declaration to test the Eight Great Families. Yesterday, he swept three houses in a single day, leaving none unbested.

QI ZHENGYANG walks along the streets, his calloused fingers twitching with quiet fury.

QI ZHENGYANG
This foreign thief's ambition grows bolder with every step on our soil.

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
This very morning, Hikawa Daiyuu and his disciples entered Suzhou. Whispers say the Zhang family stands next in his path.

QI ZHENGYANG arrives at a courtyard where a growing crowd watches a lean young man at an antique-laden table.

ZHANG BEI threads a silk cord through two seals, pulling it taut. The seals dance—spinning, stopping, reversing—in a blur of controlled motion.

ONLOOKER A
Dragon Rope Circling Treasure... he's actually doing it.

ONLOOKER B
My grandfather spoke of this technique. Thought it was a legend.

ONLOOKER C
Can a child truly master what masters spend decades learning?

Qi Zhengyang's eyes narrow. This is a test.

QI ZHENGYANG
(calling out)
Han Dynasty goldsmiths left their copper hollow!

ZHANG BEI
(without looking up)
Hollow from trapped air during casting. Genuine seals should feel light above, heavy below.

The spinning seal trembles—ever so slightly—then rights itself. Zhang Bei smiles.

ZHANG BEI
This one spins too true. The forger made it solid.

He flicks his wrist. The seal arcs down and shatters against the table.

ONLOOKER D
Stone dust! It was only pressed clay!

ONLOOKER E
The boy saw through it mid-spin...

ONLOOKER A
Zhang family's legacy is safe.

ONLOOKER B
continuation:
(quieter, to his companion)
But at what cost? He hasn't slept in two days.

Qi Zhengyang steps forward, presenting an ebony box.

QI ZHENGYANG
For your art. Imperial-grade pearl powder—rare as dragon's breath.

ZHANG BEI
For my mother's brushes. She'll need another.

QI ZHENGYANG
(startled, then understanding)
You're preparing for a siege. Hikawa comes tomorrow.

ZHANG BEI
(softly)
She'll paint whether I win or lose. I'd rather she paints joy.

Qi Zhengyang produces a small silk pouch.

QI ZHENGYANG
Three-hundred-year-old saffron. For tea. For strength.

Zhang Bei leans close.

ZHANG BEI
(whispering)
Both seals were false. I broke the cheaper one to keep the crowd calm.

QI ZHENGYANG
(stunned)
The genuine danger hides in plain sight?

ZHANG BEI
(laughing, suddenly a boy again)
You need sharper eyes, old friend!

He sprints toward the alley, youthful energy restored. Qi Zhengyang stares at the remaining seal.

A distant GONG echoes—three sharp notes from the Zhang family compound.

SERVANT'S VOICE (V.O.)
Young Master! The Elder Council summons you! Now!

ZHANG BEI
(calling back)
Tell them I'm coming! And tell Mother the pearl powder is real!

He vanishes into the twisting lanes. Qi Zhengyang watches the retreating figure, his shock melting into something like hope.

QI ZHENGYANG
(to himself)
With this young general defending the Zhang family... Hikawa Daiyuu will find his iron plate. Heh heh heh...

He pockets the seal with a faint smile.

title: Mountain Village's Exceptional Little Farmer
description: A reincarnated farmer with spiritual energy grows miraculous vegetables that heal ailments, but his peaceful life is disrupted when his sister-in-law faces danger.
context:
Title: Mountain Village's Exceptional Little Farmer
Description: A reincarnated farmer with spiritual energy grows miraculous vegetables that heal ailments, but his peaceful life is disrupted when his sister-in-law faces danger.

EXT. VILLAGE COURTYARD - DAY

ER HU, a sturdy young man in coarse cloth clothing, tends a strange garden where vegetables glow faintly. He examines a cucumber with reverent fingers.

ER HU
(quietly)
One more day. Just one more day until this one's ready.

WIDOW ZHANG, a young woman in pink traditional costume, enters with a medicine pouch in hand. She hesitates at the gate.

WIDOW ZHANG
Er Hu. May I...?

ER HU
(turning, guarded)
Widow Zhang. The cucumbers for the clinic aren't ready yet.

WIDOW ZHANG
(earnestly)
It's not for me. Young Mistress Liu's fever won't break, and Dr. Chen is out of herbs. I thought maybe...

ER HU
(frowning)
Every time I give one early, its power halves. People treat them like candy.

WIDOW ZHANG
(softly)
I know what they cost you. I see the blood on your sleeves.

She points to his forearms, where faint cuts mark the skin—prices paid for channeling spiritual energy.

ER HU
(resigned)
Fine. But this is the last early harvest this month.

He moves to the wooden basin, where vegetables float in spring water. He selects a small cucumber and pricks his thumb on a hidden thorn, letting one drop of blood fall on its skin. The cucumber glows briefly.

WIDOW ZHANG
(receiving it with both hands)
The child will owe you her life.
continuation:
ER HU
(bitterly)
They all owe me. And yet I still owe this village everything.

WIDOW ZHANG
(perceptively)
Your sister-in-law's cough returned this morning, didn't it?

ER HU's jaw tightens. He nods.

WIDOW ZHANG
Then why give this away?

ER HU
(struggling)
Because the cure that finally worked on her... it only worked because I learned from helping others first.

Widow Zhang bows deeply and leaves.

ER HU crouches by the basin, exhaustion in his shoulders. He speaks to the vegetables, not to us.

ER HU
(whispering)
Reincarnated with heaven's gifts, and what do I become? A farmer who barters miracles for grudges. They want miracles. I just want...

He trails off, touching a withered leaf on an eggplant.

ER HU
(softly)
...for her to outlive me this time.

A VILLAGER rushes in, breathless.

VILLAGER
Er Hu! The county magistrate's men—they've taken your sister-in-law! They say her cure was witchcraft!

ER HU's hoe snaps in his grip.

ER HU
(voice like ice)
What?

Close-up of ER HU's face, fury and fear warring in his eyes, with "TO BE CONTINUED" appearing on screen.

title: The Abandoned Girl
description: A young girl is left behind when her parents divorce, each refusing to take responsibility for her.
context:
Title: The Abandoned Girl
Description: A young girl is left behind when her parents divorce, each refusing to take responsibility for her.

INT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - DAY

A young girl, SHEN WANQIU, wears a yellow floral shirt and stands alone, her expression carefully blank.

CLOSE-UP - A divorce certificate being stamped with "DIVORCED BY MUTUAL CONSENT."

CLERK (V.O.)
Your marriage is now terminated.

Shen Wanqiu's father, ZHAO JINBAO, and mother, GAO YUE, turn from the counter. Both glance at Wanqiu, then look away, pained.

SHEN WANQIU
(following)
Dad, Mom... can't we go home together?

GAO YUE
(quietly firm)
I can't breathe in that house anymore. You follow him.

ZHAO JINBAO
(defensive)
You wanted this. You take her.

GAO YUE
(angrily)
You never once went to her appointments!

ZHAO JINBAO
(sharp)
And you never missed a chance to remind me what she cost us!

They lock eyes—mutual resentment and guilt. Then they turn and walk in opposite directions, leaving SHEN WANQIU rooted in place.
continuation:
EXT. PARKING LOT - NIGHT

ZHAO JINBAO gets into a black sedan. Through the window, he looks back once. Then he drives away.

GAO YUE stands alone, trembling. She throws her purse down.

Suddenly, thunder crashes and heavy rain pours down.

SHEN WANQIU runs to GAO YUE and tugs her coat.

SHEN WANQIU
Mom, I'm scared.

GAO YUE turns. For a moment, her face softens. She hums a lullaby.

SHEN WANQIU
(confused)
Mom... I can't hear it. Not in my right ear.

The humming stops. GAO YUE's expression hardens—not with cruelty, but with a kind of breaking.

GAO YUE
(whispered)
Neither of us knows how to do this.

She walks to her white sedan. SHEN WANQIU follows.

SHEN WANQIU
Mom?

GAO YUE gets in and locks the doors. SHEN WANQIU runs to the window, pressing her palm to the glass.

SHEN WANQIU
(pleading)
Mom, please. I'll be good.

Inside, GAO YUE looks at the small hand. Her own hand mirrors it, stopping halfway. Her voice is flat.

GAO YUE
He left first. Why should I be the one to stay?

The car pulls away. SHEN WANQIU runs after it, slips, and falls into a puddle.

FLASHBACK AND VOICEOVER

SHEN WANQIU in slow motion. Underneath, fragmented memory:

ZHAO JINBAO (V.O.)

full_script:
Title: The Abandoned Girl
Description: A young girl is left behind when her parents divorce, each refusing to take responsibility for her.

INT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU - DAY

A young girl, SHEN WANQIU, wears a yellow floral shirt and stands alone, her expression carefully blank.

CLOSE-UP - A divorce certificate being stamped with "DIVORCED BY MUTUAL CONSENT."

CLERK (V.O.)
Your marriage is now terminated.

Shen Wanqiu's father, ZHAO JINBAO, and mother, GAO YUE, turn from the counter. Both glance at Wanqiu, then look away, pained.

SHEN WANQIU
(following)
Dad, Mom... can't we go home together?

GAO YUE
(quietly firm)
I can't breathe in that house anymore. You follow him.

ZHAO JINBAO
(defensive)
You wanted this. You take her.

GAO YUE
(angrily)
You never once went to her appointments!

ZHAO JINBAO
(sharp)
And you never missed a chance to remind me what she cost us!

They lock eyes—mutual resentment and guilt. Then they turn and walk in opposite directions, leaving SHEN WANQIU rooted in place.

EXT. PARKING LOT - NIGHT

ZHAO JINBAO gets into a black sedan. Through the window, he looks back once. Then he drives away.

GAO YUE stands alone, trembling. She throws her purse down.

Suddenly, thunder crashes and heavy rain pours down.

SHEN WANQIU runs to GAO YUE and tugs her coat.

SHEN WANQIU
Mom, I'm scared.

GAO YUE turns. For a moment, her face softens. She hums a lullaby.

SHEN WANQIU
(confused)
Mom... I can't hear it. Not in my right ear.

The humming stops. GAO YUE's expression hardens—not with cruelty, but with a kind of breaking.

GAO YUE
(whispered)
Neither of us knows how to do this.

She walks to her white sedan. SHEN WANQIU follows.

SHEN WANQIU
Mom?

GAO YUE gets in and locks the doors. SHEN WANQIU runs to the window, pressing her palm to the glass.

SHEN WANQIU
(pleading)
Mom, please. I'll be good.

Inside, GAO YUE looks at the small hand. Her own hand mirrors it, stopping halfway. Her voice is flat.

GAO YUE
He left first. Why should I be the one to stay?

The car pulls away. SHEN WANQIU runs after it, slips, and falls into a puddle.

FLASHBACK AND VOICEOVER

SHEN WANQIU in slow motion. Underneath, fragmented memory:

ZHAO JINBAO (V.O.)
—another specialist bill I can't pay—

GAO YUE (V.O.)
—you missed the diagnosis again—

ZHAO JINBAO (V.O.)
—not my fault she was born this way—

GAO YUE (V.O.)
—she's eight years old, Jinbao—

ZHAO JINBAO (V.O.)
—some kids are just behind—

BACK TO REALITY

SHEN WANQIU lies in the downpour, soaked through. She curls into herself and hums the lullaby.

SHEN WANQIU
(quietly)
Don't abandon me... don't abandon me...

The rain intensifies. The humming continues, barely audible beneath the thunder.

title: Master Chuan's Sweet Wife with Good Fortune
description: A young woman working undercover to expose cheating husbands crosses paths with a wealthy CEO trying to escape his grandmother's matchmaking schemes.
context:
Title: Master Chuan's Sweet Wife with Good Fortune
Description: A young woman working undercover to expose cheating husbands crosses paths with a wealthy CEO trying to escape his grandmother's matchmaking schemes.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

A young woman (WU WANWEI) wearing a sailor school uniform walks into a stylishly decorated but empty bar. She has her hair in twin braids, looking innocent and pure.

A greasy middle-aged man (MR. LIU) sits by the bar counter in a striped suit. Seeing WU WANWEI, he reveals a greedy smile.

WU WANWEI walks up to him with a smile.

WU WANWEI
College Student

WU WANWEI
You're looking sharp, Mr. Liu.

MR. LIU
Mr. Liu

MR. LIU
(standing up with a laugh)
The view just got a whole lot better.

MR. LIU approaches, placing his hand inappropriately on WU WANWEI's shoulder, then sliding it to her waist, attempting to kiss her neck. WU WANWEI appears compliant on the surface, but her eyes flash with alertness—and something colder beneath.

A miniature camera hidden behind a bottle flashes a red light.

HENCHMAN (O.S.)
Mr. Liu! Your wife is pulling up!

MR. LIU is shocked and immediately releases WU WANWEI.

MR. LIU
Damn!

MR. LIU
(to WU WANWEI)
Wait here. I mean it.

MR. LIU runs off in panic. The smile on WU WANWEI's face immediately disappears, becoming cold and stern. She shudders once, then walks to the bar counter and retrieves the hidden camera.

A HENCHMAN walks over and discovers her action.

HENCHMAN
What's that? Hey—

The HENCHMAN grabs WU WANWEI's arm. WU WANWEI counters with an over-the-shoulder throw, slamming him hard to the ground.

HENCHMAN
(in pain)
You bitch—!

WU WANWEI turns and runs.

HENCHMAN
(struggling to his feet)
Don't let her leave! Now!
continuation:
EXT. CITY - DAY

Aerial shot of the city's towering skyscrapers piercing through morning mist.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

SHENG YANCHUAN, a handsome man wearing gold-rimmed glasses, sits at a luxurious desk reviewing documents. The weariness in his eyes contradicts his polished appearance.

SHENG YANCHUAN
Sheng Group CEO

SPECIAL ASSISTANT SUN rushes in hurriedly.

SPECIAL ASSISTANT SUN
Sheng Yanchuan's Assistant

SPECIAL ASSISTANT SUN
Mr. Sheng. The Old Madam's here—two candidates in tow. She's blocking all exits. Says this blind date is non-negotiable.

SHENG YANCHUAN puts down his pen and stands up, his jaw tight.

SHENG YANCHUAN
Delay her. I'll find my own exit.

SHENG YANCHUAN quickly leaves the office.

INT. SUBWAY STATION/SUBWAY CAR - DAY

WU WANWEI runs down the escalator breathlessly, entering the subway station. Two men chase after her relentlessly.

She rushes into a subway car about to close its doors. The two pursuing men are shut outside, only able to watch helplessly as the subway departs.

WU WANWEI breathes a sigh of relief and notices a yellow delivery worker's vest and helmet left on a seat. She quickly puts on the vest, helmet, and mask, disguising herself as a delivery worker.

The two men chasing her walk over from another car, searching for WU WANWEI in the car, but don't recognize her in disguise and walk right past.

The subway reaches the station and the doors open. WU WANWEI immediately gets off.

The two men react, but the doors have already closed. They're trapped on the train and can only angrily pound on the window.

HENCHMAN
(muffled)
We're not done!

WU WANWEI stands on the platform, watching the departing subway and waves goodbye, her hand trembling slightly.

INT. SUBWAY PLATFORM - DAY

WU WANWEI removes the delivery worker's equipment and takes out her phone to check. The screen displays a bank text message showing she has received a 3000 yuan transfer.

WU WANWEI
(talking to herself, hollow smile)
Another family saved.

She shows a satisfied smile that doesn't quite reach her eyes.

title: Industrial Light
description: A brilliant scientist who invented a time machine seeks to return to the past to right the wrongs done to his love and his country.
context:
Title: Industrial Light
Description: A brilliant scientist who invented a time machine seeks to return to the past to right the wrongs done to his love and his country.

INT. FUTURISTIC LAB - DAY

A pristine laboratory of holographic displays and quantum interfaces. ZHOU SHENG stands on a circular platform, facing a 3D projection of his younger self.

Data streams flash across the projection.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Temporal extraction verified. Anchor stable. Memory imprint complete.

ZHOU SHENG lowers his hands. They tremble slightly.

Above, the ELDERLY MAN watches from the observation deck with the FEMALE SCIENTIST and FOREIGN MALE SCIENTIST.

FEMALE SCIENTIST
(quietly)
Neural feedback is peaking. If he loses focus...

ELDERLY MAN
He won't.

The projection dissolves. Zhou steps off the platform.

ELDERLY MAN
(through intercom)
Chief Designer Zhou. The Council has approved your request.

The Elderly Man descends. A FEMALE ASSISTANT carries a metal case.

ELDERLY MAN
Controlled fusion, nanotech replicators, lunar transport, Mars independence... each breakthrough, you asked for nothing. Today, you ask for the impossible.

He opens the case. Inside, a crystalline medal pulses with light.

ELDERLY MAN
For Hua Nation's future.

He pins it to Zhou's black tunic.

ELDERLY MAN
What will you change?

ZHOU SHENG
(quietly)
One conversation. With Su Xiaoxi.

ELDERLY MAN
(reducing voice)
The sanctions, the blockades... you could rewrite a decade of defense policy.

ZHOU SHENG
(steady)
Without her, there's nothing to defend.

The Foreign Male Scientist steps forward.

FOREIGN MALE SCIENTIST
My country's resources are at your disposal. She was your compass.

ZHOU SHENG
She still is.
continuation:
INT. PARK - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Rain. Young ZHOU SHENG's vision blurs. He's on the ground, blood at his mouth.

SU XIAOXI struggles in LI KUNLUN's grip. Her eyes lock on Zhou's.

SU XIAOXI
(to Li)
Let him go! The drive is useless!

SU TIANBAO emerges, umbrella in hand.

SU TIANBAO
The Fengtian acquisition closes at midnight. Your interference stops now.

SU XIAOXI
(to Tianbao)
You're trading our family's name for a seat at their table?

SU TIANBAO
I'm buying our survival with it.

LI KUNLUN
(to Xiaoxi)
Come with me, or he doesn't leave this park.

THUGS raise their clubs. Su Xiaoxi sees Zhou's fingers twitch toward a broken data drive in the mud.

SU XIAOXI
(voice breaking)
I'll go. Just stop.

Li Kunlun nods. THUGS drag Zhou's unconscious body away.

Su Xiaoxi whispers something lost to the rain.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. FUTURISTIC LAB - DAY

Zhou Sheng stands motionless. The medal pulses with his heartbeat.

A monitor shows headlines: HUA TECH COMPANIES BLACKLISTED.

ZHOU SHENG (V.O.)
She traded herself for a fake blueprint. For ten years, I believed she betrayed us.

He walks toward the time machine - a neural interface chair.

ZHOU SHENG (V.O.)
Now I know. And I have three hours before Fengtian's deal locks.

He sits. Interfaces activate.

ZHOU SHENG
(whisper)
This time, I'll be standing.

The lab dims. The Elderly Man watches.

ELDERLY MAN
(to himself)
For all our sakes.

The temporal field ignites. The crystal medal goes dark.

FADE TO WHITE.

title: Iron Cavalry Heroine Guards the Rivers and Mountains
description: A legendary female general who defended her nation is betrayed by the emperor she served, leading to a tragic downfall on the day of her greatest victory.
context:
Title: Iron Cavalry Heroine Guards the Rivers and Mountains
Description: A legendary female general who defended her nation is betrayed by the emperor she served, leading to a tragic downfall on the day of her greatest victory.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

Thousands of soldiers clash on the barren plains, dust flying everywhere. Female General JI LI, clad in scarred silver armor, rides a black horse, wielding a long spear, her banner cutting through enemy lines.

JI LI (V.O.)
In the year 284 of the Xia Calendar, the Northern Wilderness bled into our southern fields. I led our army to reclaim what was lost, my spear becoming the border itself.

JI LI
(shouting)
For every home! For every child!

SOLDIERS
(shouting in unison)
Not an inch! Not an inch! Not an inch!

JI LI's gauntleted hand presses her abdomen for a heartbeat, her eyes finding the horizon beyond the carnage.

JI LI (V.O.)
Ah Yuan... our child will know peace.

EXT. CITY GATE - DAY

JI LI and her husband, General LIN YUAN, ride through the gates victorious. Citizens line the streets, their joy tempered by years of war. An OLD WOMAN offers a simple bowl of water.

OLD WOMAN
You brought our boys home, General Ji.

A LITTLE GIRL, missing one arm from a raid, steps forward.

LITTLE GIRL
Will I be brave like you?

JI LI
(kneeling to her eye level)
You already are.

LIN YUAN touches Ji Li's shoulder—a quiet world between them. In the distance, the EMPEROR awaits on a high platform, his shadow long.
continuation:
EXT. PALACE SQUARE - DAY

JI LI and LIN YUAN kneel before the EMPEROR, abreast.

JI LI
Your Majesty, the Northern banners are burned. The borders hold.

EMPEROR
(stepping forward)
Rise. Let the people see their heroes.

EMPEROR
General Ji, your victories echo across the realm. A ruler must reward such... renown.

The EMPEROR gestures. A ceremonial box is thrown down—inside, a Northern assassin's blade. LIN YUAN's face drains. He knows a planted truth when he sees it.

ARCHERS appear on the walls, arrows drawn. The EMPEROR clutches his shoulder as if pierced and staggers—feigning injury.

GUARDS immediately surround JI LI and LIN YUAN. From behind, a SWORD slides through JI LI's abdomen, the blade cold and expert. Blood ribbons from her mouth. LIN YUAN catches her.

JI LI
(to the EMPEROR)
We bled for you. Why?

EMPEROR
(sneering)
Because Great Xia cannot bow to a woman. Because your name in their mouths makes my throne hollow. Because peace leaves you unnecessary.

EMPEROR
They will remember you as a traitor. Release.

LIN YUAN
(crying out)
Ah Li!

LIN YUAN covers her body with his. Arrows find his back, the sound of iron on bone. He becomes her shield.

JI LI
(screaming)
Husband!

title: Married in a Flash with Baby, Spoiled by Mr. Gu
description: A woman gives birth to a baby after a one-night stand, only to have the child's father suddenly appear at the hospital claiming responsibility.
context:
Title: Married in a Flash with Baby, Spoiled by Mr. Gu
Description: A woman gives birth to a baby after a one-night stand, only to have the child's father suddenly appear at the hospital claiming responsibility.

INT. HOSPITAL OPERATING ROOM - DAY

The operating room light is on, displaying "SURGERY IN PROGRESS."

SU NIANXUE lies on the operating table, screaming in pain.

DOCTOR
Push! I can see the baby's head!

SU NIANXUE
Ah!

DOCTOR
He's born! It's a boy.

SU NIANXUE's monitor alarms—her blood pressure drops. She faints.

NURSE
She's hemorrhaging! Get the attending—now!

INT. COMPANY CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

SECRETARY YE rushes into the conference room, looking panicked.

SECRETARY YE
Mr. Gu, something's wrong.

GU JINGYE is presiding over a meeting. He frowns.

GU JINGYE
What?

SECRETARY YE quickly walks to GU JINGYE's side and leans down to whisper in his ear.

SECRETARY YE
(whispering)
Su Nianxue. Heping Hospital. She just delivered your son. Five pounds, eight ounces.

GU JINGYE
(whispering)
The mother?

SECRETARY YE
(whispering)
Stable. No family listed.

GU JINGYE stands up.

GU JINGYE
(to Secretary Ye)
Prepare the car.

GU JINGYE and SECRETARY YE quickly leave the conference room.
continuation:
EXT. HOSPITAL ENTRANCE - DAY

A black sedan brakes urgently and stops at the hospital entrance. GU JINGYE gets out of the car with a serious expression and walks toward the hospital building.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

GU JINGYE enters a ward and pulls back the curtain beside the bed.

SU NIANXUE lies in the hospital bed, just waking up.

SU NIANXUE
Who are you?

The baby in the crib starts crying.

SU NIANXUE
Sir, you've got the wrong room, haven't you?

GU JINGYE
I'm Gu Jingye, the child's father.

SU NIANXUE looks at him in shock.

SU NIANXUE
You're the man from nine months ago?

GU JINGYE
That's me.

SU NIANXUE
(angrily)
So it was you.

SU NIANXUE grabs a pillow from the bed and throws it at GU JINGYE, who catches it.

SU NIANXUE
You disappeared! How dare you show your face here?

GU JINGYE steps forward and grabs SU NIANXUE's wrist.

GU JINGYE
We both know what happened that night. Now there's him.

Tears well up in SU NIANXUE's eyes, her expression both aggrieved and angry.

What?

SECRETARY YE quickly walks to GU JINGYE's side and leans down to whisper in his ear.

SECRETARY YE
(whispering)
Su Nianxue. Heping Hospital. She just delivered your son. Five pounds, eight ounces.

GU JINGYE
(whispering)
The mother?

SECRETARY YE
(whispering)
Stable. No family listed.

GU JINGYE stands up.

GU JINGYE
(to Secretary Ye)
Prepare the car.

GU JINGYE and SECRETARY YE quickly leave the conference room.

EXT. HOSPITAL ENTRANCE - DAY

A black sedan brakes urgently and stops at the hospital entrance. GU JINGYE gets out of the car with a serious expression and walks toward the hospital building.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

GU JINGYE enters a ward and pulls back the curtain beside the bed.

SU NIANXUE lies in the hospital bed, just waking up.

SU NIANXUE
Who are you?

The baby in the crib starts crying.

SU NIANXUE
Sir, you've got the wrong room, haven't you?

GU JINGYE
I'm Gu Jingye, the child's father.

SU NIANXUE looks at him in shock.

SU NIANXUE
You're the man from nine months ago?

GU JINGYE
That's me.

SU NIANXUE
(angrily)
So it was you.

SU NIANXUE grabs a pillow from the bed and throws it at GU JINGYE, who catches it.

SU NIANXUE
You disappeared! How dare you show your face here?

GU JINGYE steps forward and grabs SU NIANXUE's wrist.

GU JINGYE
We both know what happened that night. Now there's him.

Tears well up in SU NIANXUE's eyes, her expression both aggrieved and angry.

title: Lucky Shop
description: A mysterious man with a black cat runs a shop on Lucky Road where supernatural rules govern who may enter and seek fortune.
context:
Title: Lucky Shop
Description: A mysterious man with a black cat runs a shop on Lucky Road where supernatural rules govern who may enter and seek fortune.

EXT. LUCKY SHOP - NIGHT

Rain beads on the shop window. Three motorcycles surround a girl backed against the door.

THUG LEADER
(grinning)
Last chance. Where's the pendant?

GIRL
(breathless)
I don't have it!

THUG LEADER
(mocking)
Your father's debt says otherwise.

The girl's eyes find a man in a tailored suit reclining on the sidewalk, black cat in his lap. She runs toward him.

GIRL
Please! Just call—

The cat's eyes snap open—glowing amber. The girl freezes mid-plea.

THUG LEADER
Zhou family business. Walk away.

YOUNG MASTER ZHOU
(leaning from his sports car)
Haicheng Zhou. You're interfering.

The cat MEOWS. A low hum vibrates through the pavement. Young Master Zhou's smirk vanishes as he reads the shop sign.

YOUNG MASTER ZHOU
(shaken)
Lucky Road. I thought that was just a story...

He stumbles from the car, cufflinks catching the light.
continuation:
THUG LEADER
Sir?

YOUNG MASTER ZHOU
(urgent)
Release her. Now.

He SLAPS the thug across the face. Both men crash to their knees as if shoved by a gale.

MOTORCYCLIST
(whispering)
We crossed the threshold...

YOUNG MASTER ZHOU
(eyes downcast)
Forgive us, Guardian.

MYSTERIOUS MAN
(eyes still closed)
The rules?

YOUNG MASTER ZHOU
(rapid)
"Fortune's path is earned. Never bought. Never taken."

The girl inches toward the shop door. It begins to glow.

THUG LEADER
(crawling forward)
We meant no disrespect!

The cat PURRS. Young Master Zhou is flung backward.

MYSTERIOUS MAN
You recite the words. But you broke the road's first law.

The girl's hand touches the doorknob. Warm light spreads up her arm.

END SCENE

title: Torn Acceptance Letter Before School Starts
description: A young woman's university acceptance letter is torn up by a village chief who wants to force her to marry his son.
context:
Title: Torn Acceptance Letter Before School Starts
Description: A young woman's university acceptance letter is torn up by a village chief who wants to force her to marry his son.

EXT. VILLAGE COURTYARD - DAY

DAD (50s, weathered) lies on the ground, his expression pained. The VILLAGE CHIEF (60s, calculating) stands nearby. GRANDMA (80s, frail) runs over from a distance.

GRANDMA
What are you doing!

VILLAGE CHIEF'S SON (20s, stammer)
(seeing Xinyue, excitedly)
Hey, wife!

XINYUE (18, fierce) rushes into the courtyard.

XINYUE
(getting between them)
Dad! Get out of the way!

XINYUE runs to DAD's side and helps him up.

XINYUE
Dad, are you okay?

DAD
(whispering)
The lease—he's canceling it—

VILLAGE CHIEF
(contemptuously)
Because your daughter thinks she's above my family.

XINYUE stands up, looking angrily at the VILLAGE CHIEF.

XINYUE
Village Chief! My dad has always been law-abiding. What right do you have to keep bullying him?

VILLAGE CHIEF
(smoothing his jacket)
The right of a creditor. Your father's store exists on my land.

DAD
(grabbing Xinyue, anxiously)
Xinyue, go! Get out of here! He wants to marry you off to his son to cancel the debt! Go quickly!

VILLAGE CHIEF'S SON
(stammering)
W-wife...

MONTAGE:
continuation:
EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - NIGHT (TWO YEARS AGO)

DAD is soaked through, blood running down his leg, sitting in the mud, clutching a package of books tightly in his hands.

DAD (V.O.)
Xinyue, the books you wanted, Dad bought them for you.

EXT. VILLAGE COURTYARD - DAY (PRESENT)

XINYUE's eyes fill with tears, but she looks at DAD with determination.

XINYUE
No, I'm not leaving. Dad, all my life, you've protected me. Now that I'm an adult and have been accepted to Tsinghua University, it's my turn to protect you.

XINYUE turns to the VILLAGE CHIEF.

XINYUE
Village Chief, I will never marry your son. Give up on that idea!

VILLAGE CHIEF
It's too late to say that now.

The VILLAGE CHIEF suddenly steps forward and snatches the acceptance letter from XINYUE's hand.

XINYUE
That's my future! Give it back to me!

XINYUE tries to grab the letter back, but the VILLAGE CHIEF'S SON grabs her from behind.

VILLAGE CHIEF'S SON
Wife... give back...

XINYUE
(struggling)
Let go of me! Let go!

DAD
(rushing forward to pull them apart)
Let go of my daughter! Let go! Let her go!

The VILLAGE CHIEF looks at the "Tsinghua University" acceptance letter in his hand.

VILLAGE CHIEF (V.O.)
This girl got into a famous university. If I let her leave, I lose my leverage.

The VILLAGE CHIEF's eyes harden, and he tears the acceptance letter in half.

DAD
(horrified)
No!

XINYUE
(screaming, then quiet)
No! 

She stops struggling. The SON lets go. XINYUE looks at the torn pieces.

XINYUE
(quietly)
You tore paper. Not my admission number. Not the email.

She pulls out her phone.

XINYUE
They want me. And they'll want to know why a chief is preventing this.

GRANDMA taps her stick.

GRANDMA
Your power ends here, Chief.

The VILLAGE CHIEF stares at the phone.

title: Divorced at the Start and Became the Ultimate Boss
description: A man helps his wife win a game show, only to discover her affair with a judge. Betrayed and murdered, he is given a second chance.
context:
Title: Divorced at the Start and Became the Ultimate Boss
Description: A man helps his wife win a game show, only to discover her affair with a judge. Betrayed and murdered, he is given a second chance.

INT. ULTIMATE BOSS SHOW RECORDING STUDIO - DAY

Text appears on screen: ULTIMATE BOSS - LIVE BROADCAST

Host WANG XIAOYE stands center stage. Two contestants, LIN LIHUA and AN YICHENG, stand behind their podiums.

Studio lights BLAZE overhead. Five hundred spectators hold their breath as cameras swivel toward the contestants.

WANG XIAOYE
Final question. Five seconds remaining. The winner not only receives five million in prize money, but will also represent our Ultimate Boss show at the Autumn Gala. Countdown! Five, four, three...

LIN LIHUA's fingers tremble above her buzzer. She turns to AN YICHENG, her voice a desperate whisper.

LIN LIHUA
(whispering)
Which beast controls food? I can't lose this.

AN YICHENG's jaw tightens. He doesn't look at her, but his hand moves imperceptibly toward option A on his podium.

LIN LIHUA reads his micro-expression and slams her buzzer.

LIN LIHUA
I choose A, Taotie!

WANG XIAOYE
Lin Lihua has buzzed in successfully. Now revealing the correct answer, which is... Taotie!

In the front row, JUDGE LI QIAN watches with predatory stillness, his silk suit catching the stage lights.

WANG XIAOYE
I announce that the champion of this Ultimate Boss competition is... Lin Lihua!

AN YICHENG forces a smile, his knuckles white on the podium edge.

WANG XIAOYE
(turning to AN YICHENG)
An Yicheng, you just missed the championship and won't receive any prize. Do you have any regrets?

AN YICHENG
It's her moment. I'm happy for her.
continuation:
INT. BACKSTAGE DRESSING ROOM - DAY

AN YICHENG slips into his worn delivery jacket, the yellow fabric faded from years of use. The distant SOUND of stagehands tearing down equipment echoes through the corridor.

A muffled GIGGLE stops his hands mid-zip. Then fabric rustling. The click of a lock.

He follows the sounds to a storage alcove off the main dressing room.

LIN LIHUA is pressed against the wall, LI QIAN's mouth at her neck.

LIN LIHUA
(laughing, breathless)
Not here. Someone will see.

LI QIAN
The crew's gone. I made sure of it.

AN YICHENG steps into the doorway, his shadow falling across them.

AN YICHENG
Lihua.

She doesn't jump. Instead, she slowly detangles herself, adjusting her blouse with deliberate calm.

LIN LIHUA
You weren't supposed to see this.

AN YICHENG
Five years. Delivery routes, double shifts, quiz questions every night. For this?

LIN LIHUA
(softly cruel)
You answered trivia, An. He answers doors. The Autumn Gala isn't for drivers.

LI QIAN steps between them, his voice oil-smooth.

LI QIAN
You served your purpose. Don't make this ugly. Walk away.

AN YICHENG
I'll expose the rigged questions, the affair—

LI QIAN's hand shoots out, slamming AN YICHENG against the concrete wall. The impact knocks the wind from his lungs.

LI QIAN
(low, vicious)
You'll disappear. Right now.

LI QIAN's grip tightens. AN YICHENG gasps, legs buckling. LIN LIHUA watches, her expression unreadable.

AN YICHENG collapses. His phone slips from his pocket, screen lighting up with a photo of him and LIN LIHUA on their wedding day.

The photo fades to black as the phone screen cracks against the floor.

title: Luring Him Into the Trap
description: A woman who pretends to be paralyzed orchestrates a plan after a tragic accident that destroyed her family, as dark secrets and betrayals unfold in her luxurious mansion.
context:
Title: Luring Him Into the Trap
Description: A woman who pretends to be paralyzed orchestrates a plan after a tragic accident that destroyed her family, as dark secrets and betrayals unfold in her luxurious mansion.

INT. LUXURY MANSION LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A dark room lit by candles creates an eerie atmosphere. Thunder rumbles.

LIN JIU, a woman in a black silk robe, sits reading a book titled "Dialogues with the Devil." A small black snake coils around her wrist.

A wheelchair waits in the shadows.

The housekeeper AI LI enters with XU XIUHONG, the newly hired caregiver.

AI LI
Madam, the new caregiver.

LIN JIU doesn't look up.

LIN JIU
Take me upstairs. Then you may rest.

AI LI eyes XU XIUHONG with a warning look, then leaves.

XU XIUHONG approaches, her footsteps tentative on the marble floor.

XU XIUHONG
Madam, shall I help you to—

LIN JIU closes her book and turns off the vinyl record player beside her. She rises. Fluidly.

She walks toward XU XIUHONG, trailing the small black snake between her fingers.

XU XIUHONG is stunned, hand flying to her mouth.

XU XIUHONG
(stunned)
You're not paralyzed.

LIN JIU's smile sharpens with predatory knowing.

INT. LUXURY MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

ON SCREEN: ONE YEAR AGO
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

LIN JIU and her husband LUO QIAN walk arm in arm, her head on his shoulder.

LIN JIU (V.O.)
I had a perfect family. Once.

INT. CAR - DAY

LUO QIAN and LIN JIU sit in the car, the atmosphere sweet.

LUO QIAN adjusts the rearview mirror, catching Lin Jiu's eye.

LUO QIAN
Passenger seat's still yours. Mirror's still yours.

He hands her chamomile without looking.

LUO QIAN
And today's flowers.

LIN JIU
(quietly)
You remember.

LUO QIAN
Sit tight. Hotel's ready. I'll handle everything.

LIN JIU
You're too good to me.

LUO QIAN's smile freezes. He stares at something ahead.

LUO QIAN
If I don't spend my leave with you—

He SCREAMS, yanking the wheel. Tires SCREECH. The world spins.

EXT. ACCIDENT SCENE - DUSK

The car is wrecked on the roadside. LIN JIU lies on the ground, bleeding from her abdomen, her expression agonized.

LUO QIAN crawls out and rushes to her side.

LUO QIAN
(panicked)
Lin Jiu!

LIN JIU
(gasping)
My legs... can't feel...

END FLASHBACK.

INT. LUXURY MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

LIN JIU (V.O.)
From that day, this wheelchair became my cage.

LUO QIAN pushes LIN JIU in her wheelchair. Her face is stone.

LUO QIAN kneels, pulling out documents.

LUO QIAN
German team says there's hope. I'll find a way.

LIN JIU watches him, her expression unreadable.

A small boy, ZI HAN, runs in.

ZI HAN
Mommy!

LUO QIAN
The orphanage called. The adoption's final.

He hesitates.

LUO QIAN
Said he'd bring us luck.

He looks away.

LUO QIAN
Since you can't... manage alone, I hired help.

AI LI enters, elegant, poised.

LUO QIAN
Senior rehab therapist. She'll care for you when I'm away.

LIN JIU's eyes turn cold and vigilant. AI LI meets her gaze with a provocative smile.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

description: An emperor is entertained by a mysterious veiled dancer who reveals herself as an assassin, leading to a confrontation that transcends time.
context:
Title: Return of the Phoenix
Description: An emperor is entertained by a mysterious veiled dancer who reveals herself as an assassin, leading to a confrontation that transcends time.

INT. PALACE - NIGHT

Close-up on calloused fingers playing a melancholy pipa melody. Oil lamps flicker across jade tiles.

Emperor LU ZIYU reclines on a sandalwood couch. Two veiled HANDMAIDENS attend him, watchful.

Center hall: a DANCER in crimson silk, face hidden behind a golden phoenix mask, dances with predatory grace.

LU ZIYU watches, fingers tapping arrhythmically against his wine cup.

The DANCER's final spin stops before him. Her mask catches the lamplight.

LU ZIYU
(to Handmaidens)
Leave us.

The Handmaidens hesitate, then bow and retreat.

LU ZIYU
(quietly)
You planned this for months. Don't let them ruin it.

The DANCER freezes. Her mask tilts.

The phoenix mask. The northern melody. The red silk. You left breadcrumbs, Song Yao. I followed them home.

LU ZIYU

He extends his hand.

LU ZIYU
Come. Finish what he started.

The DANCER rips off her mask, revealing FEMALE ASSASSIN, stunning and devastated.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
He taught me to survive. You taught me to burn.

She moves into his arms. The dagger in her sleeve warms against his chest.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
(whisper)

She strikes. The dagger flashes toward his heart. LU ZIYU catches her wrist, shows her an old scar above his heart.

LU ZIYU
I was waiting for you to grow strong enough.

He disarms her with her father's technique. She stumbles back.
continuation:
LU ZIYU
No guards tonight. Only the debt I owe.

They fight. He mirrors her movements—teacher and student, ghost and echo. She strikes with grief. He deflects with regret.

He pins her against the carved bedpost. The dagger between them reflects both faces.

LU ZIYU
(breathless)
Your father died protecting my throne. His last request: spare his daughter. Train her. Let her choose.

The dagger trembles.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
You let me believe—

LU ZIYU
I let you live. Anything else would have broken you.

Light erupts from the phoenix mask on the floor. The jade tiles pulse with carved symbols: a ritual circle, activated by blood and vengeful intent.

LU ZIYU
(soft)
We die tonight, Song Yao. Or we burn forever.

He presses the dagger into her palm, blade toward his chest.

MONTAGE:

- Flames consume the ancient palace. Two silhouettes embrace.
- Phoenix nebula blossoms—wings of fire and ash.
- Time fragments: a thousand deaths, a thousand rebirths.

INT. MODERN LOFT - DAY

LU ZIYU and FEMALE ASSASSIN crash onto polished concrete, still locked in their fatal embrace. He wears a suit, she a leather jacket. The dagger is now a letter opener. The phoenix mask: a tattoo on his wrist, fading.

They pull apart, gasping.

FEMALE ASSASSIN

LU ZIYU
Until we get it right.

He shows his wrist—the tattoo reforms. Her matching mark burns on her shoulder blade.

Their eyes meet.

FEMALE ASSASSIN
I still want to kill you.

LU ZIYU
I know.

He offers his hand.

FADE OUT.

title: Luring Her Into the Trap
description: A woman betrayed by her husband and his mistress is reborn to the day they first brought deception into her home, determined to exact revenge.
context:
Title: Luring Her Into the Trap
Description: A woman betrayed by her husband and his mistress is reborn to the day they first brought deception into her home, determined to exact revenge.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

The camera pans across a lit table lamp casting long shadows, a pair of slippers kicked aside, a prescription bottle on its side, pills scattered.

LIN XINLAN lies on the floor, eyes fixed on the ceiling, a trace of blood at her lips.

LIN XINLAN (V.O.)
They say your life flashes before you when you die. Mine didn't. I only saw the truth I'd refused to see.

A flashback flickers: HAO JIAN gently brushing hair from SHEN ZHIQING's neck, a look passing between them that could be mistaken for familial care.

INT. BEDROOM - TWO HOURS EARLIER

ON SCREEN: Two Hours Earlier

LIN XINLAN lies in bed, pale, coughing into a trembling hand. A wedding photo faces her on the nightstand.

HAO JIAN enters, carrying a bowl of steaming soup. He sets it down, helps her sit up.

LIN XINLAN's hand shakes as she reaches for her heart medication.

HAO JIAN watches her fumble with the bottle. He doesn't help.

Suddenly, LIN XINLAN gasps, clutching her chest. The pills scatter.

LIN XINLAN
(strangled)
Hao Jian... the medicine... it's wrong...

HAO JIAN's expression empties. He picks up the bottle, reads the label with mild interest.

HAO JIAN
(calculating)
Wrong? No. It's exactly what I requested. Double concentration.

LIN XINLAN
(whispering)
Why? I gave you everything...

HAO JIAN
You gave me a title and a cage. Ten years of playing the grateful husband.

LIN XINLAN
(realizing)
The company... you wanted Tianlan Group...

SHEN ZHIQING (O.S.)
He wanted me.

SHEN ZHIQING walks in, wearing LIN XINLAN's silk robe, belted loosely. She leans against the doorframe.

HAO JIAN releases the bottle. It rolls across the floor. SHEN ZHIQING picks it up, examining it.

LIN XINLAN
Cousin Shen...? You're family...

SHEN ZHIQING laughs, a sound like breaking glass.

HAO JIAN
We share a surname. That's all we ever shared.
continuation:
SHEN ZHIQING
(to LIN XINLAN)
Calling me 'cousin' let me help him pick out your anniversary gifts. Know your schedule. Your medical history.

LIN XINLAN
(dawning fury)
You were planning this... all along...

SHEN ZHIQING
We were waiting for your heart to finish what we started.

She places a manicured hand on HAO JIAN's shoulder. He covers it with his own.

LIN XINLAN
(struggling upright)
I'll destroy you both...

SHEN ZHIQING shoves her back with one sharp motion.

SHEN ZHIQING
You'll die. And the world will mourn the poor heiress who couldn't live without her husband.

HAO JIAN produces a small vial from his pocket, holds it up to the light.

HAO JIAN
Digitalis overdose. Looks like suicide. Depression is such a convenient disease.

LIN XINLAN
No—wait—

He forces it between her teeth. She fights, but he's stronger. The liquid burns down her throat.

HAO JIAN
(quietly)
Goodbye, Xinlan. Thank you for the empire.

He watches as she convulses, his face betraying nothing.

LIN XINLAN (V.O.)
I wouldn't get a next life. But I got something better: a second chance.

She goes still.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

The clock on the wall spins backward, blurring.

LIN XINLAN gasps, jerking upright on the sofa, hand flying to her chest. Her heartbeat is strong. Impossible.

She's in a designer dress, hair perfectly styled. The living room is sunlit, vulgar in its opulence.

She grabs her phone from the coffee table. The screen shows "March 1st, 2023."

LIN XINLAN
(whisper)
The day I welcomed them home.

Her breathing steadies. Her hand stops trembling. She looks at her reflection in the darkened TV screen.

LIN XINLAN (V.O.)
Last time, I didn't know the rules.
(beat)
This time, I make them.

She sets the phone down gently. In her eyes, something colder than vengeance: certainty.
