title: Playing with Fire
description: Shen Zhinian discovers her crush of three years only sees her as a shadow of his ex-girlfriend. Heartbroken and drunk, she mistakes a powerful heir for her beloved.
context:
Title: Playing with Fire
Description: Shen Zhinian discovers her crush of three years only sees her as a shadow of his ex-girlfriend. Heartbroken and drunk, she mistakes a powerful heir for her beloved.

INT. OFFICE HALLWAY - DAY

SHEN ZHINIAN walks through a modern office corridor, carrying a pink insulated lunch box, a hopeful smile on her face. She pauses, smoothing her hair.

INT. XIAO HECHUAN'S OFFICE - DAY

NING YUROU (Xiao Hechuan's ex-girlfriend) and XIAO HECHUAN (a popular actor) are in the office.

XIAO HECHUAN
Yurou, let me explain.

NING YUROU
(agitated)
Everyone's saying you're with Shen Zhinian now. The Shen family.

XIAO HECHUAN grabs NING YUROU's hand and pushes her against the desk, embracing her from behind.

SHEN ZHINIAN arrives at the door just in time to witness this scene. She stops in shock, the door slightly open.

XIAO HECHUAN
(whispering in Ning Yurou's ear)
She only matters because she reminds me of you. In my heart, you're irreplaceable.

NING YUROU breaks free from XIAO HECHUAN's embrace.

NING YUROU
She's chased you for three years. Her family's money, her connections--you feel nothing?

XIAO HECHUAN
I've never had feelings for her. She's just your shadow. Her family disowned her when she chose acting. No support, no resources. I swear, I've never thought about being with her.

Outside the door, SHEN ZHINIAN hears everything. Her heart breaks, tears streaming down her face. The lunch box in her hand nearly drops. She staggers backward, clutching her chest in pain, leaning against the wall.

SHEN ZHINIAN
(voice-over, crying)
Xiao Hechuan, three years. In your heart, I'm just a shadow.
continuation:
INT. BAR - NIGHT

SHEN ZHINIAN sits alone at the bar, looking sad as she scrolls through photos of XIAO HECHUAN on her phone. She lingers on one, then deletes it.

SHEN ZHINIAN (V.O.)
Tonight, I'm erasing everything about you.

SHEN ZHINIAN picks up a row of shots and drinks them one after another.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

CHENG CHUXIAO (a wealthy heir from Beijing's elite circle) enters the bar wearing a black suit, his presence commanding. Several FEMALE CUSTOMERS at the bar immediately notice him.

FEMALE CUSTOMER A
CEO Cheng's here alone?

FEMALE CUSTOMER B
No assistant. Such a good opportunity.

FEMALE CUSTOMER A
Go for it!

FEMALE CUSTOMER C
Last woman who threw herself at him got shut down hard.

Drunk SHEN ZHINIAN looks at CHENG CHUXIAO's back with blurry eyes, seemingly mistaking him for XIAO HECHUAN.

SHEN ZHINIAN
(murmuring)
Hechuan...

SHEN ZHINIAN stumbles toward CHENG CHUXIAO and suddenly hugs him from behind.

SHEN ZHINIAN
I like you! Can't you tell?

The surrounding customers stare at them in shock.

FEMALE CUSTOMER A
What? What's their relationship?

FEMALE CUSTOMER C
The Cheng and Shen families are old friends. They grew up together.

FEMALE CUSTOMER B
But the second Miss Shen has always been at odds with Mr. Cheng. Now she's confessing?

CHENG CHUXIAO turns around in surprise, holds SHEN ZHINIAN by the shoulders, pushes her back slightly, and sees her face clearly. Recognition dawns.

SHEN ZHINIAN
(looking up at Cheng Chuxiao, eyes unfocused)
You must like me, right?

They look at each other.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Return to the Homeland
description: A top scientist decides to go abroad to advance his research on controlled nuclear fusion, facing accusations of betrayal while believing he serves his country's greater interests.
context:
Title: Return to the Homeland
Description: A top scientist decides to go abroad to advance his research on controlled nuclear fusion, facing accusations of betrayal while believing he serves his country's greater interests.

EXT. DESERT RESEARCH BASE - DAY

In the vast desert stands a research base composed of prefabricated buildings, sandblasted and worn. Scavenged equipment parts lie beside a rusted perimeter fence. A faded DAXIA NATIONAL FLAG flaps tiredly in the hot wind.

INT. EXPERIMENT CONTROL ROOM - DAY

Red alarm lights flash. Scientists in white protective suits work frantically. A whiteboard in the corner shows 343 red X's - failed experiments.

Gu Sen (30s, intense, exhausted) watches the reactor through protective glass. His hands tremble slightly.

A scientist pulls down a massive circuit breaker with force.

The entire control room shakes violently. Equipment emits smoke. Scientists stumble.

Silence, except for the HISS of cooling systems shutting down.

Gu Sen stares at the dead reactor. His knuckles are white on the console.

GU SEN
(quietly)
The containment field collapsed at fourteen seconds.

PROFESSOR JIN (60s, fatherly, weary) removes his protective goggles. His face is etched with decades of disappointment.

PROFESSOR JIN
The power couplings failed again. Same as last month.

Gu Sen picks up a melted component from the floor.

GU SEN
Moguo solved this two years ago. Their alloy specifications are classified.

Wang Youde (40s, pragmatic, protective) steps forward, his boots crunching on glass.

WANG YOUDE
Emols University invited you. I saw the letter.

SENIOR BROTHER (Late 30s, loyal, anxious) glances between them.

SENIOR BROTHER
Joint research program. With tech sharing. But...

WANG YOUDE
But it's a trap. You go, you'll be their poster boy. "Defecting Daxian genius." I've seen it before.

PROFESSOR JIN
Gu Sen, your work is here. With us.

Gu Sen looks at the whiteboard. At the 343 failures.

GU SEN
My work is nuclear fusion. Not geography.

SENIOR BROTHER
(pleading)
Junior Brother, they'll call you a traitor. Your parents...

GU SEN
My parents survived the Energy Crisis of '28. They know what happens when Daxia falls behind.

Wang Youde slams his hand on a table.

WANG YOUDE
And when you come back with nothing? When they keep the real tech for themselves? You'll just be another dog who bit his own tail.

PROFESSOR JIN
That's enough!

The room falls silent.

PROFESSOR JIN
(thoughtfully, to himself)
continuation:
Forty years ago, I watched our first reactor fail. Same desert. Same excuses. "Make do." "Be patient." We lost a generation to those words.

He turns to Gu Sen, eyes sharp.

PROFESSOR JIN
What if they don't let you publish? What if you disappear into a Moguo lab for ten years?

GU SEN
Then I'll send every note, every failure, every hypothesis back to you. Through the private channels. Through the diplomatic pouch. Through any means.

Professor Jin pulls out an old notebook from his coat. Its pages are yellowed.

PROFESSOR JIN
I kept this from my own time abroad. Before the blockade tightened. The last viable exchange we had with Moguo.

He holds it out to Gu Sen.

PROFESSOR JIN
If I sponsor your appointment... if I accompany you as a visiting scholar... we retain Daxian oversight. Officially.

Gu Sen stares at him.

GU SEN
Professor, your reputation...

PROFESSOR JIN
My reputation is an old man's vanity. Your future is Daxia's future.

Wang Youde turns away, his jaw tight.

SENIOR BROTHER
Professor... you're risking everything.

PROFESSOR JIN
We already have.

(he looks around the broken room)
We risk everything every day we refuse to change.

Gu Sen takes the notebook. Their hands meet.

GU SEN
(softly)
Thank you.

Professor Jin squeezes his hand, then releases.

PROFESSOR JIN
The War God Hall will review this. They'll want assurances. Plausible deniability.

WANG YOUDE
(coldly)
They'll want a scapegoat if it fails.

PROFESSOR JIN
Then let me be the scapegoat. Gu Sen carries enough.

Gu Sen starts to protest. Professor Jin stops him with a look.

PROFESSOR JIN
Go home. Tell your parents you'll be teaching. Nothing more.

Gu Sen nods, clutching the notebook. He turns toward the door.

Wang Youde watches him go, his expression unreadable. He pulls out his phone, scrolls through headlines: "ANOTHER DAXIAN SCIENTIST MISSING ABROAD."

SENIOR BROTHER
(quietly)
What if he's right?

Wang Youde doesn't answer. He just pockets the phone.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCRIPT

And when you come back with nothing? When they keep the real tech for themselves? You'll just be another dog who bit his own tail.

PROFESSOR JIN
That's enough!

The room falls silent.

PROFESSOR JIN
(thoughtfully, to himself)
Forty years ago, I watched our first reactor fail. Same desert. Same excuses. "Make do." "Be patient." We lost a generation to those words.

He turns to Gu Sen, eyes sharp.

PROFESSOR JIN
What if they don't let you publish? What if you disappear into a Moguo lab for ten years?

GU SEN
Then I'll send every note, every failure, every hypothesis back to you. Through the private channels. Through the diplomatic pouch. Through any means.

Professor Jin pulls out an old notebook from his coat. Its pages are yellowed.

PROFESSOR JIN
I kept this from my own time abroad. Before the blockade tightened. The last viable exchange we had with Moguo.

He holds it out to Gu Sen.

PROFESSOR JIN
If I sponsor your appointment... if I accompany you as a visiting scholar... we retain Daxian oversight. Officially.

Gu Sen stares at him.

GU SEN
Professor, your reputation...

PROFESSOR JIN
My reputation is an old man's vanity. Your future is Daxia's future.

Wang Youde turns away, his jaw tight.

SENIOR BROTHER
Professor... you're risking everything.

PROFESSOR JIN
We already have.

(he looks around the broken room)
We risk everything every day we refuse to change.

Gu Sen takes the notebook. Their hands meet.

GU SEN
(softly)
Thank you.

Professor Jin squeezes his hand, then releases.

PROFESSOR JIN
The War God Hall will review this. They'll want assurances. Plausible deniability.

WANG YOUDE
(coldly)
They'll want a scapegoat if it fails.

PROFESSOR JIN
Then let me be the scapegoat. Gu Sen carries enough.

Gu Sen starts to protest. Professor Jin stops him with a look.

PROFESSOR JIN
Go home. Tell your parents you'll be teaching. Nothing more.

Gu Sen nods, clutching the notebook. He turns toward the door.

Wang Youde watches him go, his expression unreadable. He pulls out his phone, scrolls through headlines: "ANOTHER DAXIAN SCIENTIST MISSING ABROAD."

SENIOR BROTHER
(quietly)
What if he's right?

Wang Youde doesn't answer. He just pockets the phone.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCRIPT

title: Homecoming
description: After seven years building an empire in Africa, Li Xu returns to Yun City as one of the continent's most successful entrepreneurs, ready to repay his debts and confront the family he left behind.
context:
Title: Homecoming
Description: After seven years building an empire in Africa, Li Xu returns to Yun City as one of the continent's most successful entrepreneurs, ready to repay his debts and confront the family he left behind.

EXT. CITY BOULEVARD - DAY

A convoy of black luxury sedans glides through morning traffic. The vehicles move with precision, commanding the road.

The lead car turns toward a gleaming convention center.

EXT. CONVENTION CENTER PLAZA - DAY

MAYOR OF YUN CITY waits with local OFFICIALS and BUSINESS LEADERS. Bodyguards flank the reception line. The atmosphere is taut with expectation.

MAYOR OF YUN CITY
(to an aide, low)
This investment is everything. No mistakes today.

The convoy enters the plaza. Sunlight flashes off tinted windows.

Inside the car, LI XU touches a simple steel watch against his expensive cuff.

A YOUNG BYSTANDER films from the crowd's edge.

The cars stop. Bodyguards exit first. One opens Li Xu's door.

Li Xu emerges. Beige suit, sunglasses. He surveys the waiting officials like a stranger in his own hometown.

A WOMAN approaches with flowers.

MAYOR OF YUN CITY
(beaming)
Mr. Li! Yun City welcomes you. We've prepared a conference—

LI XU
(removes sunglasses)
Seven years.
(beat)
Before conferences, I see my mother. And my daughter.

The mayor's smile falters. He wasn't briefed on a child.

FLASHBACK
continuation:
EXT. OLD TRAIN PLATFORM - DAY

The image dissolves into memory.

YOUNG LI XU kneels on cracked concrete, travel bag beside him. His mother ZHANG GUIFANG holds a sleeping toddler—LI MEI. Uncle LI GUANGZU stands apart, arms crossed. Cousin LI XING hovers.

YOUNG LI XU
(to Li Guangzu)
Uncle. Please. Take care of them.

LI GUANGZU
Africa?
(snorts)
Send what you can. Don't dream too big.

YOUNG LI XU
(to his mother, voice breaking)
Mom... I'll make this right.

ZHANG GUIFANG
(holding back tears)
Just make it back.

Li Xu kisses his daughter's forehead. She stirs, reaches a small hand toward his face.

LI XING
Keep the phone charged, brother.

YOUNG LI XU
(stands)
I'll make you proud.

He walks toward the train. Doesn't look back.

END FLASHBACK

EXT. CONVENTION CENTER PLAZA - DAY

Li Xu stands motionless. The flowers remain unaccepted.

LI XU
(to Mayor)
The old district. Now.

Li Xu's hand tightens on the worn strap of his bag—the same simple bag, now leather-patched but intact.

His expression reveals nothing. But his knuckles are white with the weight of seven years.

title: The Matriarch Seeks Divorce (Episode 81)
description: A matriarch faces challenges from her husband's family as she prepares for his return home.
context:
Title: The Matriarch Seeks Divorce (Episode 81)
Description: A matriarch faces challenges from her husband's family as she prepares for his return home.

INT. MARQUIS MANOR MAIN HALL - DAY

CHU WANQING walks briskly into the main hall, her confident stride checking slightly when she sees Zhang Shi already at Grandmother's ear.

CHU WANQING
Grandmother, I heard my husband is coming back.

ZHANG SHI stands beside GRANDMOTHER, looking displeased.

ZHANG SHI
(coldly)
The Marquis is coming back. Here is the list. Look it over carefully and make the necessary arrangements to welcome the Marquis home.

LINGDANG steps forward to receive the list.

LINGDANG
(checking the list, surprised)
Replace the tiles and doors? We just replaced them during New Year's, and it hasn't even been half a year. And this menu, even a state banquet wouldn't be this extravagant.

ZHANG SHI
(suddenly steps forward and slaps LINGDANG)
Lowly dog!

LINGDANG
(covering her face, shocked--but her jaw sets)

ZHANG SHI
(sternly)
Is it your place to speak here?

GRANDMOTHER
(calmly)
Wanqing, this maid from your family home is far too insolent.
continuation:
ZHANG SHI
If she doesn't know her place, it doesn't matter. Just sell her off and replace her with someone who does.

CHU WANQING
(frozen for a breath, her voice tight)
Grandmother. Lingdang knows she was wrong.

CHU WANQING
(to LINGDANG)
Lingdang, apologize.

ZHANG SHI
Kneel down!

LINGDANG reluctantly kneels, her posture stiff with suppressed fury.

GRANDMOTHER
I won't hold it against an insolent maid. I'll just ask you this: should this money be spent or not?

CHU WANQING
(hesitating briefly, then--a faint, mirthless smile)
It should. A Marquis deserves a home that reflects his station.

GRANDMOTHER
Good that you know. Go make the preparations.

CHU WANQING
Yes.

CHU WANQING leaves with LINGDANG.

ZHANG SHI
(supporting GRANDMOTHER)
Truly, the master is reflected in the servant. A mere slave dares to talk back to the Grand Madam. She must have been influenced by Lady Chu. Merchant families are just so vulgar. You can't make silk from a sow's ear.

GRANDMOTHER
(cold smile)
No need to be anxious. Even if mud can't stick to the wall, it doesn't matter. Our Marquis Manor will soon welcome a true lady of noble birth. When that happens, she'll be more anxious than anyone.

title: When Love Becomes the Past
description: A devoted husband discovers his wife's betrayal on their tenth wedding anniversary, forcing him to confront his hidden identity as heir to a powerful conglomerate.
context:
Title: When Love Becomes the Past
Description: A devoted husband discovers his wife's betrayal on their tenth wedding anniversary, forcing him to confront his hidden identity as heir to a powerful conglomerate.

INT. MODERN BUILDING EXTERIOR - DAY

ZHUO FAN rides a yellow shared bicycle, a large bouquet of flowers in the basket. He navigates through evening traffic with practiced ease.

A BLACK SEDAN with tinted windows pulls alongside him, keeping pace.

ZHUO FAN glances over, unease flickering across his face.

The sedan's window lowers. SHEN YOUYOU looks out, her elegant composure stark against the mundane street.

SHEN YOUYOU
Brother Zhuo Fan. Please.

ZHUO FAN
Not now, Youyou.

The sedan speeds up, then stops sharply ahead. TWO BODYGUARDS step out, moving to flank Zhuo Fan's path—not aggressively, but with military precision.

The lead BODYGUARD holds out a phone.

BODYGUARD
Miss Shen needs a moment. It's about your grandfather.

ZHUO FAN brakes. The bodyguards step back, giving him space.

ZHUO FAN
(quietly)
My grandfather made his choice ten years ago.

SHEN YOUYOU steps from the car, her voice lowered.

SHEN YOUYOU
He passed yesterday. Your father will announce a new heir at the Jiang Group gala—unless you claim what's yours.

ZHUO FAN
My wife is my family now.

SHEN YOUYOU
The Zhuo family seal, Brother. He's giving you three days.

ZHUO FAN mounts his bike, waves the bodyguards off, and rides away.

SHEN YOUYOU stands in place, watching him go with disappointment.
continuation:
INT. JIANG DUODUO'S APARTMENT - EVENING

ZHUO FAN sets the final candle on a carefully arranged dinner table. He places the flowers in a vase, adjusts a wine glass.

His phone BUZZES—caller ID "My Beloved Wife."

ZHUO FAN
(answering)
Honey? I'm just—

JIANG DUODUO (phone voice)
(filtered)
Meeting's running late. Don't wait up.

ZHUO FAN
But it's our anniversary—

JIANG DUODUO (phone voice)
(cold)
We'll celebrate tomorrow.

The line GOES DEAD. Zhuo Fan lowers the phone, candlelight reflecting in his eyes.

INT. UPSCALE RESTAURANT - EVENING

JIANG DUODUO sits at a secluded table, her evening gown catching the dim light.

Her sister JIANG YAYA, dressed in a server's uniform, walks over.

JIANG YAYA
You canceled on Zhuo Fan?

JIANG DUODUO
He'll understand. He always does.

JIANG YAYA
He'd do anything for you. Doesn't that mean anything?

JIANG DUODUO
It means he's reliable. Predictable.
(beat)
Wang Hao's investment closes tonight. That's what matters.

JIANG YAYA
Sis...

JIANG DUODUO
Go home, Yaya.

Yaya exits as WAITERS begin setting up a candlelit spread. Duoduo checks her phone, a calculating smile on her face.

INT. JIANG DUODUO'S APARTMENT - EVENING

Zhuo Fan sits alone. His phone BUZZES—a message from an unknown number:

"Thought you should know."

Attached: a SOCIAL MEDIA VIDEO from the restaurant's account. Duoduo toasts with WANG HAO. Their kiss is unmistakable.

ZHUO FAN stares at the screen, knuckles white around the phone.

His phone RINGS again—Shen Youyou calling. He stares at the betraying screen, then answers.

SHEN YOUYOU (phone voice)
(filtered)
Brother Zhuo Fan. The seal. Three days. The Jiang Group gala.

ZHUO FAN
(studying the frozen video frame)
Tell my father...
(beat)
I'll be there.

ZHUO FAN ends the call. He looks at the ruined dinner, then back at the video. Tears fall, but his jaw sets—pain hardening into resolve.

title: After the Bride Price Negotiation Failed, I Found a CEO to Be My Husband
description: A woman breaks up with her boyfriend over unreasonable bride price demands, only to be set up on a blind date with a mysterious CEO by an elderly friend.
context:
Title: After the Bride Price Negotiation Failed, I Found a CEO to Be My Husband
Description: A woman breaks up with her boyfriend over unreasonable bride price demands, only to be set up on a blind date with a mysterious CEO by an elderly friend.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

LIN YUE traces circles on the fogged window, the wedding invitation behind her a blurred ghost.

CHEN ZISI (O.S.)
Lin Yue!

CHEN ZISI bursts through the door, jacket crumpled, dress shirt untucked.

CHEN ZISI
I'm willing to marry an orphan like you and give you a home. What more could you possibly want?

LIN YUE and CHEN ZISI argue heatedly.

CHEN'S MOTHER (O.S.)
The down payment for the house is six hundred thousand.

LIN YUE
I scraped together four hundred thousand, two hundred thousand borrowed. But your family put the house in your name, not ours.

LIN YUE
You want me to quit my job to take care of you, claiming it's for my own good?

LIN YUE lifts the red envelope from the table, gold 888 glinting mockingly.

LIN YUE
Here's your eight hundred eighty-eight yuan bride price back.

LIN YUE lets it flutter to the floor like a dead leaf. Chen Zisi flinches as if struck.

LIN YUE
We're breaking up.

EXT. NURSING HOME - DAY

SHI WEI picks her way down the garden path in stilettos that sink into the grass, her designer handbag held like a shield.

SHI WEI (V.O.)
I have no idea how Old Man Tao convinced Grandmother to make me come to this dump for a blind date.
continuation:
INT. CEO'S OFFICE - DAY

LU XUN blocks the doorway, holding TAO SHOUYAN's briefcase.

TAO SHOUYAN wears a suit, his expression unreadable.

LU XUN
A blind date? You're about to close the Eurasia deal. And you're going to a nursing home?

TAO SHOUYAN
Because my grandfather asked. Once.

TAO SHOUYAN pushes LU XUN aside and leaves.

EXT. NURSING HOME PAVILION - DAY

SHI WEI stumbles as her heel catches on a fallen cane.

SHI WEI
(to the seated elderly man) You old fool! Watch where you put that thing! These shoes cost more than your care fee.

LIN YUE appears, steadies the old man.

LIN YUE
Grandpa Tao, are you alright?

SHI WEI
Old Man Tao? I'm Shi Wei, here for a blind date with your grandson. Though I expected somewhere more appropriate.

GRANDPA TAO
If a girl judges by the venue, she might miss the man.

LIN YUE
Miss, Grandpa Tao is—

SHI WEI
Respect? He nearly broke my ankle!

TAO SHOUYAN approaches in a casual white shirt, his presence immediate.

TAO SHOUYAN
Grandpa.

TAO SHOUYAN
I'm Tao Shouyan.

LIN YUE
Oh. Hello.

TAO SHOUYAN
(to SHI WEI) You're Miss Shi? I should warn you—I don't own a car. I rent my apartment. I work seventy-hour weeks.

LIN YUE
(trying to explain) You really—

SHI WEI
(interrupting LIN YUE) You're Tao Shouyan? I'm Shi Wei. No car, no house, no prospects? You're delusional. To marry me, you need a city-center villa plus one-point-eight million bride price.

TAO SHOUYAN
Miss Shi, what makes you think I'd want to marry you?

SHI WEI
What a waste of my afternoon!

SHI WEI turns and leaves.

GRANDPA TAO
(to LIN YUE) Yueyue, you know this one's not worth your tears.

GRANDPA TAO
(to TAO SHOUYAN) Tao Shouyan, thirty-two, Tao Group. Lin Yue, twenty-eight, nurse. Both too stubborn for your own good.

TAO SHOUYAN
(interrupting) Grandpa, don't trust just anyone.

GRANDPA TAO
Forget it! Yueyue, weren't you registering marriage today?

LIN YUE
No delay, Grandpa Tao. I don't need to go today.

GRANDPA TAO
Why is that?

LIN YUE
(bitter smile) Same as Miss Shi—the bride price negotiation fell through.

GRANDPA TAO
Yueyue, what do you think of my grandson?

GRANDPA TAO suddenly grabs LIN YUE and TAO SHOUYAN's hands and puts them together.

GRANDPA TAO
(laughing) You two, get married!

Split screen - LIN YUE's eyes widen; TAO SHOUYAN's lips twitch with the ghost of a smile.

(to TAO SHOUYAN) Tao Shouyan, thirty-two, Tao Group. Lin Yue, twenty-eight, nurse. Both too stubborn for your own good.

TAO SHOUYAN
(interrupting) Grandpa, don't trust just anyone.

GRANDPA TAO
Forget it! Yueyue, weren't you registering marriage today?

LIN YUE
No delay, Grandpa Tao. I don't need to go today.

GRANDPA TAO
Why is that?

LIN YUE
(bitter smile) Same as Miss Shi—the bride price negotiation fell through.

GRANDPA TAO
Yueyue, what do you think of my grandson?

GRANDPA TAO suddenly grabs LIN YUE and TAO SHOUYAN's hands and puts them together.

GRANDPA TAO
(laughing) You two, get married!

title: Movie Queen, Your Husband's Persona Has Collapsed
description: A former award-winning actress is betrayed by her husband and his new star during a film shoot, leading to a tragic end in the snow.
context:
Title: Movie Queen, Your Husband's Persona Has Collapsed
Description: A former award-winning actress is betrayed by her husband and his new star during a film shoot, leading to a tragic end in the snow.

EXT. VILLA SNOW FIELD - NIGHT

Heavy snow falls. Outside a villa glowing with warm light, a vintage street lamp is covered in white snow.

A STUNT COORDINATOR falls from the second-floor balcony into a snowdrift, shouting about a faulty harness. The camera shakes.

A BEST FRIEND rushes out from the villa, chasing after MENG GE.

BEST FRIEND
Meng Ge, the medic said your hands can't grip in this cold!

MENG GE, wearing a thin dress, stands by a fire basin in the center of the snowy ground, holding a dagger, her expression empty.

MENG GE
Then I'll hold on tighter.

She stabs. The blade - weighted wrong, cold steel - sinks in before she can register. Shock floods her face.

MENG GE
(gasping)
...weighted...

The BEST FRIEND looks at her in horror, then at the crew already packing the last gear.

MENG GE lies in the snow, trembling.

DIRECTOR (O.S.)
Cut! Exterior unit wrapped! Report to main set!

The crew members finish loading, departing. The courtyard is silent.

MENG GE whispers weakly.

MENG GE
It was... supposed to be retractable...

XIA WAN and GU YUAN walk over sharing a black umbrella. XIA WAN wears a thick down jacket, her makeup exquisite.

XIA WAN
Sister's commitment to authenticity is... total.

MENG GE looks at them, comprehension replacing agony.

MENG GE
(struggling)
The accident rider... pays out personally...

GU YUAN crouches down, gently stroking MENG GE's cheek, his eyes cold.

GU YUAN
Death by misadventure. You're worth more to me dead than alive.

MENG GE
(in disbelief)
...ten years... for a payout?

GU YUAN
Don't take it personally. It's just insurance.

XIA WAN
We both thank you, Sister. For the legacy.

MENG GE
(agitated)
...my signature... forged?
continuation:
GU YUAN
Amended. You were medicated, remember?

MENG GE
(grief-stricken)
...my phone... records...

GU YUAN
We have it.

He holds up her phone - already wiped.

XIA WAN
Don't worry, Sister. We'll tell your story beautifully.

MENG GE
(weak smile)
...not my story... yours...

She taps her smartwatch - a livestream notification pops up on Gu Yuan's phone: "Meng Ge: Behind the Scenes" - 100K viewers.

GU YUAN
(quietly)
Cancel it.

XIA WAN
How?

GU YUAN
(to MENG GE)
End the stream.

MENG GE
(desperately)
Too late... it's in the cloud...

GU YUAN
Then we find it.

He stands, pulling Xia Wan away. They rush to their car, leaving her.

EXT. VILLA SNOW FIELD - LATER

SHEN NAN runs anxiously into the courtyard.

SHEN NAN
Xiao Ge!

He sees MENG GE's smartwatch, still streaming. He discovers her in the snow.

SHEN NAN rushes over and holds MENG GE in his arms.

SHEN NAN
Xiao Ge! Stay with me!

MENG GE slowly opens her eyes.

MENG GE
(barely breathing)
Shen Nan... did it save?

SHEN NAN
The stream? It's everywhere.

MENG GE
Then I didn't... lose everything...

After speaking, MENG GE's head tilts to the side, and she breathes her last.

FADE OUT.

title: Actress Strategy Manual
description: A woman working at a KTV faces harassment from a lecherous client until a mysterious man in a suit intervenes.
context:
Title: Actress Strategy Manual
Description: A woman working at a KTV faces harassment from a lecherous client until a mysterious man in a suit intervenes.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Dim lighting, loud music.

SHEN YANRAN (20s) wears an ill-fitting business suit, pouring wine. Her hands tremble, but her eyes are fixed—counting seconds.

BOSS QIAN (50s), lecherous, grabs her wrist, his thumb pressing her pulse point.

BOSS QIAN
(leaning in)
That face. Like you're dying on stage. Does it work?

SHEN YANRAN
(strained)
Boss Qian, I'm just staff.

BOSS QIAN
(tightening grip)
My streaming platform needs fresh faces. One drink, I'll put you in front of a camera. Better tips than this.

He pulls her toward his lap. She resists—measured, practiced.

BOSS QIAN
(laughing)
Come on. Everyone's watching.

The room's other men glance, then look away—protocol.

A man in a sharp suit, AN FENG (30s), enters. His jaw tightens at the scene.
continuation:
BOSS QIAN notices AN FENG, doesn't release Shen Yanran.

BOSS QIAN
(stammering)
Boss An! Perfect timing. We were scouting talent for your platform. This one's... dedicated.

AN FENG
(approaching)
Dedicated. I like that. But my platform has rules.

His eyes meet Shen Yanran's. Her terror flickers—recognition.

AN FENG
(to Shen Yanran)
Safe word?

SHEN YANRAN
(quietly)
"Strategy."

BOSS QIAN releases her, confused.

AN FENG
(to Boss Qian)
She's under contract. With me.

He extends a hand. Shen Yanran hesitates, then takes it—her grip steadier than it should be.

CUT TO:

Close-up of Shen Yanran's face: the fear is real, but so is something else—calculation.

title: Legal Elite
description: A dedicated public interest lawyer wins a major case against a corrupt corporation, but his victory triggers a deadly revenge against his family.
context:
Title: Legal Elite
Description: A dedicated public interest lawyer wins a major case against a corrupt corporation, but his victory triggers a deadly revenge against his family.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

BAILIFF
This court is now in session. Case number 2024-0784, The People v. Wu Shengjie.

The defendant WU SHENGJIE, a bald man in prison uniform, stands in the defendant's dock with clenched fists.

BAILIFF
All rise!

Everyone stands, including plaintiff's attorney CHEN YUAN (40s, exhausted but determined) and colleague HUANG SHUPING.

Chen subtly checks his phone screen: a missed call from "Home" and a text: "Dinner at 7? Xin made you a card."

PRESIDING JUDGE
(reading verdict)
The defendant, as controller of Linhai Group, willfully evaded payment of 1.07 million yuan in wages through property transfers. This constitutes criminal refusal to pay labor remuneration, aggravated by the scale.

The judge pauses, glancing at the gallery of workers.

PRESIDING JUDGE
Three years imprisonment, suspended eighteen months. Fine of 100,000 yuan. Full restitution within seven days.

The gallery erupts in restrained relief—tears, quiet thank-yous, not theatrical applause.

WU SHENGJIE
(quietly, to his lawyer)
This isn't over.

XU MINGHAO (50s, silver-haired, bespoke suit) and his counsel YE GUOBANG watch from the front row. Xu removes his sunglasses slowly, eyes fixed on Chen.

PRESIDING JUDGE
Court adjourned.

The gavel falls.

EXT. COURTHOUSE STEPS - DAY

REPORTER A
(to camera)
Linhai Group's star legal team falls to Chen Yuan's public interest firm, marking twelve consecutive pro bono victories.

Chen and Huang descend. Chen's phone buzzes again. He silences it.

HUANG SHUPING
That suspension was generous. Linhai's pull still shows.

CHEN YUAN
The workers get paid. That's the point.

MIGRANT WORKER A approaches, clutching an envelope.

MIGRANT WORKER A
Attorney Chen, my mother's surgery is scheduled. Because of you.

He extends the envelope.

MIGRANT WORKER A
Our collection. Six thousand yuan. Please.

CHEN YUAN
(raising hand)
Keep it. Pay the hospital. That's my fee.

The man nods, too moved to speak, and walks away.

REPORTER B
Attorney Chen, twelve straight pro bono wins. What drives you?

CHEN YUAN
A law degree's a privilege. Privilege should buy justice for those who can't afford it.

He glances at his silent phone.

CHEN YUAN
(softly)
Even when it costs more than you planned.

REPORTER C
Your undefeated record—

XU MINGHAO's voice cuts in from behind them.

XU MINGHAO
Records exist to be corrected.

Xu stands at the top of the steps with Ye and WANG TING (30s, poised, dangerous efficiency).

XU MINGHAO
(to Ye)
You said he was manageable.

YE GUOBANG
His firm operates on grants and goodwill. No institutional backing. I miscalculated the optics.

XU MINGHAO
Optics. (turns to Wang Ting) Rebalance the equation. Make it quiet. Make it personal.

WANG TING
(notes in tablet)
Timeline?

XU MINGHAO
Before the seven-day restitution deadline. Let him watch it break.

They turn away. Chen watches them go, a shadow crossing his face.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - NIGHT

LIN NUOYI (30s, tired but warm) walks with daughter CHEN XIN (8, clutching a handmade card).

CHEN XIN
Mom, if Dad's job is helping people, why does he miss my soccer games?

LIN NUOYI
Because doing the right thing and doing the easy thing are rarely the same night.

CHEN XIN
He's still coming to dinner?

LIN NUOYI
Let's see. He promised.

They reach the crosswalk. The light turns WALK.

LIN NUOYI
Hold my hand.

CHEN XIN
I'm not a baby.

LIN NUOYI
Humor your mother.

They step into the crosswalk. Chen Xin looks down at her card: stick figures labeled "Dad, Mom, Me" and "Best Lawyer Ever!"

A white sedan idles half a block away, engine running.

LIN NUOYI
Your father wanted to be there today, Xin. He called during the—

The sedan accelerates silently, no squealing tires, just sudden speed.

Chen Xin looks up. Sees her mother's face change. Sees the car.

The impact is clean, professional. Lin Nuoyi is lifted, not thrown—an awful, graceful arc. She lands on the sidewalk, the card crushed beneath her.

The sedan speeds away, no plate visible.

CHEN XIN
(whisper)
Mom?

She crawls to her mother. Lin Nuoyi's eyes flutter. Blood pools beneath her head, thick and dark.

LIN NUOYI
(gasp)
Xin'er... card...

Her hand twitches toward the crushed paper.

CHEN XIN
(screaming)
HELP! SOMEONE HELP!

She presses her small hands to her mother's chest. The card flutters in a passing breeze, stick figures smeared with blood.

FADE OUT.

title: Not Worth the Cost
description: A successful businesswoman returns home to find her mother mistreated by her sister-in-law over family inheritance money.
context:
Title: Not Worth the Cost
Description: A successful businesswoman returns home to find her mother mistreated by her sister-in-law over family inheritance money.

EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE - DAY

ON SCREEN: Hello, President Su

A black sedan stops at the company entrance. FU LI'AN waits near the curb. SU YAOYAO emerges, glancing at LI'AN with mild exasperation. A row of BODYGUARDS stand in formation.

SU YAOYAO
Li'an, it's just my parents' house. Not a board meeting.

FU LI'AN
Your future husband wants to make a good impression. Even if he's stuck here.

SU YAOYAO
She's just nervous. New family, new house, baby on the way.

FU LI'AN
(to the bodyguards)
Discreet distance.

BODYGUARDS
Yes.

SU YAOYAO walks away, her confident stride momentarily faltering as she checks her phone—no messages from her mother.

INT. SU FAMILY NEW HOUSE - DAY

At the dining table, DONGDONG, SU ZE, and JIANG MANQIN are seated. The food is untouched. DONGDONG traces patterns on her belly.

DONGDONG
How long does it take to cross one city?

JIANG MANQIN
She messaged. Twenty minutes.

DONGDONG catches SU ZE scrolling his phone and slaps the table.

DONGDONG
Let's just eat.

SU ZE
Dongdong...

JIANG MANQIN
When we signed the demolition papers, I promised—
continuation:
DONGDONG
Don't.

SU ZE
Mom, not now.

JIANG MANQIN
I said if anything was left, Yaoyao should have it.

DONGDONG
(shouting)
There is nothing left! This house, the baby, your son's future—it's all gone if we start handing out gifts to people who don't live here anymore!

JIANG MANQIN
She needs to hold her head up there.

DONGDONG
Her neck's not my problem.

SU ZE
Yaoyao doesn't need our scraps. Dongdong's pregnant, Mom. Why today?

JIANG MANQIN gets up to pour tea.

JIANG MANQIN
Dongdong.

DONGDONG
It's cold.

DONGDONG shoves her bowl. It shatters on the floor.

DONGDONG
Clean it up. You're good at that.

JIANG MANQIN kneels, picking shards. Blood beads on her finger.

SU YAOYAO walks in, gifts in hand.

SU YAOYAO
Mom.

SU YAOYAO sees her mother on the floor, bleeding.

SU YAOYAO
What happened?

JIANG MANQIN looks up, her face a map of shame and relief.

title: Race Against Time
description: A man faces an impossible choice when his young wife is diagnosed with terminal cancer and he has only one week to save her life.
context:
Title: Race Against Time
Description: A man faces an impossible choice when his young wife is diagnosed with terminal cancer and he has only one week to save her life.

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

FAST CUTS: Fluorescent lights humming. A sonogram machine. Lin Yang pacing in the hall.

DR. WANG WEI enters the consultation room and closes the door. The latch clicks softly.

LIN YANG stands by the desk, restless.

LIN YANG
Doctor, my wife's been waiting for her ultrasound results. The tech wouldn't tell us anything. What's happening?

WANG WEI
(measured)
I need you to sit down for this, Mr. Lin.

LIN YANG
(slowly sitting)
That bad?

WANG WEI
We found a mass in her pancreas. It's already blocking the bile duct.

WANG WEI places a scan on the desk.

WANG WEI
This is stage four. The cancer's in her liver.

CLOSE-UP: The scan shows a white mass spider-webbing through gray tissue.

LIN YANG
continuation:
(pale)
Three months ago she had stomach pains. We thought it was her diet.

LIN YANG stares at the scan, then at Wang Wei.

LIN YANG
There's a trial, right? Something experimental?

WANG WEI
One. A gene therapy that targets the specific mutation. But the synthesis takes six days. After that, the tumor's genetic drift makes it useless.

LIN YANG

title: Loop & Call Through Time
description: A mother receives a mysterious phone call from her deceased daughter five years in the past, giving her a chance to prevent the tragedy that took her child's life.
context:
Title: Loop & Call Through Time
Description: A mother receives a mysterious phone call from her deceased daughter five years in the past, giving her a chance to prevent the tragedy that took her child's life.

EXT. PSYCHOLOGY CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

On screen: Year 2024.

SHEN QING sits at the table, a cracked phone clutched in white-knuckled fingers.

SHEN QING
She's been gone five years.

SHEN QING
(quietly)
I could've saved her. That night—

PROFESSOR YANG sits across from her, pen poised over a notepad.

PROFESSOR YANG
How?

SHEN QING places the dead phone on the table between them.

SHEN QING
This phone. It took me back. Five years—to that night.

PROFESSOR YANG
Miss Shen, you understand how that sounds.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

On screen: October 1, 2019, 21:55.

Little girl SHEN NIAN sits on the sofa, holding a doll, phone pressed tight.

SHEN NIAN
Mom, it's National Day. Everyone's home but us.
continuation:
INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN QING, wearing professional attire, paces while talking on the phone. Colleagues wait in the background.

SHEN QING
I know, baby. Tomorrow—first thing.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN NIAN
But...

A shadow spills under the door, stretching across the carpet.

INT. CONFERENCE ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN QING glances toward the meeting table.

SHEN QING
Meeting's starting. I have to go.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN NIAN
Mom, there's—

The call drops. SHEN NIAN stares at the dark hallway, doll squeezed tight. She steps forward.

The door bursts open. A man fills the frame.

SHEN NIAN
(softly)
...Daddy?

He lunges. The doll hits the floor.

SHEN NIAN
(screaming)
Mom! Mom!

On screen: 21:59.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

SHEN QING wakes from a nightmare, gasping for air. On screen: October 1, 2024, 22:00.

Her HUSBAND is awakened.

HUSBAND
Same nightmare? It's been five years, Qing. Let me get you some water.

HUSBAND gets out of bed. SHEN QING sits up, clutching her smartphone—the wallpaper: SHEN NIAN's last school photo.

SHEN QING
(crying)
You'd be thirteen now. Almost as tall as me.

Suddenly, a childish ringtone sounds.

RINGTONE (V.O.)
Mom, your baby is calling, if you don't answer I'm going to be mad.

SHEN QING freezes. Following the sound, she searches through a storage box beside the bed. From a pile of stuffed animals, she finds the old phone. Its screen glows: incoming call from "Baby Niannian."

SHEN QING
(to herself)
Five years dead. Now it's ringing.

She answers with a trembling thumb.

SHEN QING
...Hello?

Her daughter's voice from five years ago comes through static.

SHEN NIAN (V.O.)
Mom, everyone else is on holiday for National Day, why aren't you coming home?

SHEN QING's face drains of color. The phone slips in her grip.

SHEN QING
(shocked)
Niannian?

title: Heartbeat Transgression
description: Jiang Qiao discovers her fiancé's betrayal at his birthday party, shattering her belief in their childhood engagement and perfect love.
context:
Title: Heartbeat Transgression
Description: Jiang Qiao discovers her fiancé's betrayal at his birthday party, shattering her belief in their childhood engagement and perfect love.

INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY

JIANG QIAO, dressed in an elegant gown, looks around the room.

JIANG QIAO (V.O.)
Twenty years of practice. I still can't tell if this necklace is a promise or a noose.

Several FEMALE GUESTS gather together, holding wine glasses and gossiping.

GUEST A
That heirloom's basically a down payment. Non-refundable.

GUEST B
Childhood engagement? More like a business contract with better PR.

GUEST C
They look right together, though. Shame about the rumors.

GUEST D
Hush. She's right there.

LIN YIN, Jiang Qiao's college classmate, holds a wine glass, watching the distance with complex emotions.

GUEST C
Must be nice. Marrying into that kind of security.

PEI YUNXIAO walks toward JIANG QIAO.

JIANG QIAO (V.O.)
Keep breathing. That's all happiness is anyway.

PEI YUNXIAO takes JIANG QIAO's hand. They walk together to center stage as GUESTS applaud.

PEI YUNXIAO and JIANG QIAO stand still. He waves to the GUESTS.

PEI YUNXIAO
Thank you all for celebrating today. On this occasion, I'm grateful to confirm what many have expected—Miss Jiang Qiao and I will marry this autumn.

GUESTS applaud again, offering congratulations.

GUEST A
Second Young Master Pei, always so traditional!

JIANG QIAO stands beside him, her expression gradually freezing.

The scene becomes dreamlike. Images of GUESTS raising their glasses in celebration overlap with JIANG QIAO's lonely figure.

JIANG QIAO (V.O.)
I thought I was building a life. Turns out I was just decorating a cage.

Tears well up in JIANG QIAO's eyes.
continuation:
EXT. BANQUET HALL GARDEN - NIGHT

JIANG QIAO stands alone in the garden, looking sad.

LIN YIN (O.S.)
Quite the performance. Though I wonder—were you acting for them, or yourself?

The camera turns to a corner where PEI YUNXIAO and LIN YIN are embracing intimately.

PEI YUNXIAO
She's starting to suspect. I saw her checking my phone.

LIN YIN
And yet you still invited me. How reckless.

PEI YUNXIAO
Father's watching. This has to look authentic.

LIN YIN
Authentic. Is that what we are?

PEI YUNXIAO
(quietly bitter)
She's a debt my father owes. You're the choice I made. Even if neither of you can ever know.

JIANG QIAO hides behind a tree, hearing the entire conversation, tears streaming down her face.

LIN YIN
Your little fiancée—what would she do if she found out?

PEI YUNXIAO
She'd stay. Where else would she go?

LIN YIN
You're so certain.

PEI YUNXIAO
I'm necessary.

They kiss—not passionate, but desperate. JIANG QIAO watches this scene in pain.

Suddenly, a hand covers JIANG QIAO's mouth from behind, and another hand covers her eyes. It's PEI ZHIHONG.

PEI ZHIHONG
(whispering)
You can confront them. Or survive them. Choose.

JIANG QIAO, teary-eyed, nods once.

PEI ZHIHONG removes his hands, putting an arm around JIANG QIAO's shoulder, leading her away.

In the distant corridor, two PAPARAZZI are frantically taking photos of PEI YUNXIAO and LIN YIN kissing with their cameras.

title: The Sealed Legacy
description: A martial arts clan is massacred in a storm-swept night of betrayal. The young heir's memories are sealed away, leaving him to survive as a street urchin until a chance encounter offers a fragile hope.
context:
Title: The Sealed Legacy
Description: A martial arts clan is massacred in a storm-swept night of betrayal. The young heir's memories are sealed away, leaving him to survive as a street urchin until a chance encounter offers a fragile hope.

INT. ZHUO FAMILY COMPOUND - NIGHT

Rain lashes the courtyard. Lightning reveals a dozen ASSASSINS in crimson robes and demon masks descending from tiled roofs.

ZHUO QINGYUN, clan patriarch, fights with desperate precision. He strikes one assassin down, but three more converge. A spear thrust ends his resistance. He falls, mud mixing with blood.

His brother, ZHUO QINGFENG, witnesses from the hall steps, blade trembling in fury.

ZHUO QINGFENG
For the honor of Zhuo!

INT. ZHUO FAMILY COMPOUND - NIGHT

ZHUO QINGFENG stands alone before the advancing assassins. Their leader emerges—TUFEI YUAN in embroidered black silk, porcelain mask gleaming.

TUFEI YUAN
The Heaven Bone Spirit lives in the child's blood. Bring him to me alive. Kill all else.

ZHUO QINGFENG
Our legacy is not meat for scavengers.

TUFEI YUAN
Then die with it.

TUFEI YUAN
Kill them.
continuation:
INT. ZHUO FAMILY INTERIOR - NIGHT

ZHUO BUFAN (8) runs through smoke-filled corridors, pulled back by his mother LIANG JINGROU. She presses a jade pendant to his chest—it clicks open, revealing intricate mechanisms.

LIANG JINGROU
Fan'er, power without wisdom is a blade without a hilt. When this seal breaks, you will understand.

ZHUO BUFAN
(crying)
Mother, I can fight—

LIANG JINGROU
(slamming the pendant shut)
You will forget. You will survive. Into the hidden cellar. No matter what you hear—silence.

She pushes him toward a concealed floor panel.

INT. ZHUO FAMILY COMPOUND - NIGHT

TUFEI YUAN
First to find the heir claims the Spirit's blessing.

ASSASSINS
(scattered)
Yes, Commander!

INT. ZHUO FAMILY INTERIOR - NIGHT

LIANG JINGROU stands before the concealed panel, twin blades ready. Two assassins burst through paper doors.

ASSASSIN ONE
The matriarch. She'll know where the cub hides.

ASSASSIN TWO
Talk or bleed. Your choice.

LIANG JINGROU
The Zhuo women do not bargain.

She launches forward, a whirl of steel. Through a crack in the panel, Zhuo Bufan watches his mother cut down one assassin before the second's blade finds her heart.

ASSASSIN ONE
( checking her body)
The boy's scent is here. Search every room.

The assassins tear the chamber apart but miss the masterfully disguised panel. Soon, they move on.

Zhuo Bufan emerges. The pendant around his neck grows cold and dark. His tear-streaked face goes blank—memories bleeding away.

EXT. STREET - DAY

TITLE CARD: One Year Later

ZHUO BUFAN (9) crouches in an alley, filthy and feral. He wrests a soggy bun from muddy cobblestones.

XIA MENGYING (9) approaches under a paper umbrella, silk robes immaculate. Her nurse, MAMA LIU, trails behind.

XIA MENGYING
You're hungry.

Zhuo Bufan freezes.

XIA MENGYING
(extends her hand, palm up)
My father's kitchen has more food than we can eat. Would you like some?

Zhuo Bufan stares at her hand. Something flickers in his empty eyes. He reaches out slowly.

title: Happy Kung Fu Baby
description: A young kung fu prodigy named Yan Xiaoyu has defeated all the bandits and martial arts sects in the region, forcing them to give up their old ways. Now his master reveals it's time for him to return home.
context:
Title: Happy Kung Fu Baby
Description: A young kung fu prodigy named Yan Xiaoyu has defeated all the bandits and martial arts sects in the region, forcing them to give up their old ways. Now his master reveals it's time for him to return home.

EXT. WASTELAND - DAY

FAST CUTS showing callused hands fumbling with a hoe, the BOSS squinting at a seed packet like it's a lost treasure map, and two HENCHMEN practicing staff techniques with all the grace of scarecrows in a storm.

BOSS
(roaring at the sky)
Hiya!

The BOSS stomps to the campfire and collapses onto a small stool, peeling a blister on his thumb.

HENCHMAN A and HENCHMAN B exchange glances and lean on their staffs, panting.

HENCHMAN A
(limping over)
Boss! Our Viper Gang, a century of robbery... now I'm getting blisters from a hoe. Why are we farming?

HENCHMAN B
(rubbing his lower back)
My tattoo's so depressed it's fading. Why did we abandon our trade?

BOSS
(leaning forward, voice dropping)
Yan Xiaoyu.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. ANCIENT MONUMENT - DAY

YAN XIAOYU (8), round-faced and smirking, lounges atop a sacred stone monument munching a meat bun. He sneezes, spraying crumbs across the carved text.

YAN XIAOYU (V.O.)
Yan Xiaoyu. Carefree. Unstoppable.

EXT. WASTELAND - DAY

BOSS
This kid didn't just demolish eight martial arts sects.

MONTAGE:

- Yan Xiaoyu yawns while deflecting a dozen swords with one finger.
- Hardened bandits weep with joy as he teaches them synchronized farming dances.
- A hand-painted sign: "SITTING MOUNTAIN EAGLE's ORGANIC FARM - Livestream Daily!"

BOSS (V.O.)
He reformed every last one of us.

BOSS
You ever heard of Sitting Mountain Eagle?

HENCHMAN A and B
(shaking their heads)
Huh?

BOSS
Now he's afraid to kill a mosquito. Sells radishes online.

BOSS
And River-Crossing Dragon?

HENCHMAN A
(nodding fearfully)

BOSS
Beat him into poetry. Bandit rap about his feelings.

BOSS
So. You want Yan Xiaoyu to come give you a hug?

HENCHMAN A
(terrified)
You wanna die?

BOSS
I don't want to die.

HENCHMAN A
(shaking his head frantically)

BOSS
What are you looking at? Go farm!

The BOSS stands up, kicks both henchmen, and all three scramble off to tend their crops.
continuation:
EXT. FOREST - DAY

YAN XIAOYU (8) practices kung fu, each strike sending ripples through the bamboo grove.

A white-haired, white-bearded MASTER approaches, watching with quiet pride.

MASTER
Little Fish.

YAN XIAOYU
(startled, then beaming)
Master! I gathered wild peaches. And honey. And—

He pulls an improbable feast from his tiny cloth bag.

YAN XIAOYU
—your favorite sesame cakes. For seclusion.

MASTER
(eyes softening)
You'll make me fat before I begin.

YAN XIAOYU
(serious)
Eighty-one days is long. What if you starve? I'd have to find a good burial mountain.

MASTER
(angry yet helpless)
Heartless child! I won't die.

YAN XIAOYU
(grinning)
Good. Because who'd teach me new moves?

MASTER
(sighs, then gentle)
Seven years since I pulled you from that river. You've mastered everything I know. It's time to find your parents.

YAN XIAOYU
(turning away)
I have a family here.

MASTER
The Yan family of Yuzhou is... different. They have resources. Power.

YAN XIAOYU
(facing him, eyes narrowing)
How much power?

MASTER
Enough to buy every bun in the empire... and hire every bandit you reformed.

YAN XIAOYU considers this. A slow, dangerous smile spreads.

YAN XIAOYU
Good. They work hard.

He runs off, a blur of energy. The Master catches a tossed peach, chuckling softly.

FADE OUT.

Boss! Our Viper Gang, a century of robbery... now I'm getting blisters from a hoe. Why are we farming?

HENCHMAN B
(rubbing his lower back)
My tattoo's so depressed it's fading. Why did we abandon our trade?

BOSS
(leaning forward, voice dropping)
Yan Xiaoyu.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. ANCIENT MONUMENT - DAY

YAN XIAOYU (8), round-faced and smirking, lounges atop a sacred stone monument munching a meat bun. He sneezes, spraying crumbs across the carved text.

YAN XIAOYU (V.O.)
Yan Xiaoyu. Carefree. Unstoppable.

EXT. WASTELAND - DAY

BOSS
This kid didn't just demolish eight martial arts sects.

MONTAGE:

- Yan Xiaoyu yawns while deflecting a dozen swords with one finger.
- Hardened bandits weep with joy as he teaches them synchronized farming dances.
- A hand-painted sign: "SITTING MOUNTAIN EAGLE's ORGANIC FARM - Livestream Daily!"

BOSS (V.O.)
He reformed every last one of us.

BOSS
You ever heard of Sitting Mountain Eagle?

HENCHMAN A and B
(shaking their heads)
Huh?

BOSS
Now he's afraid to kill a mosquito. Sells radishes online.

BOSS
And River-Crossing Dragon?

HENCHMAN A
(nodding fearfully)

BOSS
Beat him into poetry. Bandit rap about his feelings.

BOSS
So. You want Yan Xiaoyu to come give you a hug?

HENCHMAN A
(terrified)
You wanna die?

BOSS
I don't want to die.

HENCHMAN A
(shaking his head frantically)

BOSS
What are you looking at? Go farm!

The BOSS stands up, kicks both henchmen, and all three scramble off to tend their crops.

EXT. FOREST - DAY

YAN XIAOYU (8) practices kung fu, each strike sending ripples through the bamboo grove.

A white-haired, white-bearded MASTER approaches, watching with quiet pride.

MASTER
Little Fish.

YAN XIAOYU
(startled, then beaming)
Master! I gathered wild peaches. And honey. And—

He pulls an improbable feast from his tiny cloth bag.

YAN XIAOYU
—your favorite sesame cakes. For seclusion.

MASTER
(eyes softening)
You'll make me fat before I begin.

YAN XIAOYU
(serious)
Eighty-one days is long. What if you starve? I'd have to find a good burial mountain.

MASTER
(angry yet helpless)
Heartless child! I won't die.

YAN XIAOYU
(grinning)
Good. Because who'd teach me new moves?

MASTER
(sighs, then gentle)
Seven years since I pulled you from that river. You've mastered everything I know. It's time to find your parents.

YAN XIAOYU
(turning away)
I have a family here.

MASTER
The Yan family of Yuzhou is... different. They have resources. Power.

YAN XIAOYU
(facing him, eyes narrowing)
How much power?

MASTER
Enough to buy every bun in the empire... and hire every bandit you reformed.

YAN XIAOYU considers this. A slow, dangerous smile spreads.

YAN XIAOYU
Good. They work hard.

He runs off, a blur of energy. The Master catches a tossed peach, chuckling softly.

FADE OUT.

title: Revealing World Champion Identity After Pregnancy
description: A pregnant game developer faces betrayal when her supervisor takes credit for her work, but she holds a secret identity as world champion Queen.
context:
Title: Revealing World Champion Identity After Pregnancy
Description: A pregnant game developer faces betrayal when her supervisor takes credit for her work, but she holds a secret identity as world champion Queen.

EXT. GAME WORLD - DAY

Hyper-realistic fantasy battlefield. QUEEN (Ye Qingyi's avatar), armored in crimson, executes a frame-perfect combo. Her celestial spear leaves light trails as enemies shatter into luminous particles. Damage numbers cascade: 9999, CRITICAL, PERFECT.

A single button materializes: [START GAME].

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Open-plan workspace. Monitors glow with game builds. Concept art covers every wall.

YE QINGYI (30s, eight months pregnant) navigates the maze of desks, one hand steadying her belly, the other clutching a tablet with live launch metrics. She moves with quiet authority.

QIAN GUANGJIN (40s, sloppy, slouched in a gaming chair) mashes his phone screen, face reddening with each tap.

YE QINGYI
Director Qian? Final QA cleared. We're live in ten minutes.

QIAN GUANGJIN
(without looking up)
Whatever.

Ye turns to leave. Qian's muttering carries just enough.

QIAN GUANGJIN
Thinks she's Queen of game design. This derivative trash...

Ye freezes. Her knuckles whiten on the tablet. She inhales, straightens, and walks on—spine steel-straight.

MONTAGE

- Ye Qingyi, dark circles etched deep, debugs code while rubbing her swollen feet under the desk. She winces, then types faster.
- A PROGRAMMER (20s) face-plants into his keyboard, snoring. Ye drapes a blanket over his shoulders.
- MONITORS show the download counter: 1,000... 50,000... 500,000. The numbers blur upward.
- Bandaged fingers—Ye's fingers—press ENTER. The key is worn smooth from use.
- The team, haggard and unshaven, watches the counter explode past 1,000,000. Silence. Then a single cheer.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

Confetti made from shredded bug reports drifts through the air. Team members toast with energy drinks.

CHEN RUOHAN (25, eager, glasses smudged)
Sister Qingyi—one million downloads in six hours.

YE QINGYI
(quietly)
We did it.

She presses a hand to her heart.

YE QINGYI
Five years. We actually built it.

QIAN GUANGJIN
His phone shows [DEFEAT]. He slams it down, forces a smile.

QIAN GUANGJIN
Excellent! My leadership delivered!

He claps once, sharply. The celebration quiets.

QIAN GUANGJIN
Qingyi, you'll attend the banquet tomorrow. Wear something... appropriate.

His gaze flicks to her belly, dismissive.

CHEN RUOHAN
(quietly, to Ye)
He hasn't committed code in three months...

YE QINGYI
(firm)
Not now.

Her phone VIBRATES. Caller ID: "Lu Lin ❤️"
continuation:
INT. HALLWAY / INT. TEA ROOM - DAY

Ye leans against the wall, cradling the phone. Her face softens.

INTERCUT WITH:

LU LIN (30s, composed) in a minimalist tea room, pouring oolong with one hand, phone in the other.

LU LIN
(filtered)
The champion of my heart.

YE QINGYI
Don't. How's the nursery?

LU LIN
(filtered)
Empty. Tomorrow's ultrasound is non-negotiable. Four missed appointments, Qingyi.

YE QINGYI
(defensive)
I know. I promised—

LU LIN
(filtered)
The baby doesn't care about launch windows.

YE QINGYI
hand drops to her belly. Her face crumples, then steadies.

YE QINGYI
I'm coming home tonight. For real.

LU LIN
(filtered)
I'll believe it when I see you. Love you.

She hangs up. Stares at her reflection in the dark window—pregnant, exhausted, unbreakable.

INT. CELEBRATION BANQUET HALL - DAY

Crystal chandeliers. WAITERS serve champagne. The team tugs at uncomfortable collars.

ON SCREEN: Three Days Later

CHEN RUOHAN
(whispering)
Feels like a funeral.

YE QINGYI
(smiling for the cameras)
It is.

She accepts sparkling water instead of champagne.

COMPANY BOSS YU QING (50s, sharp, silver-haired) takes the podium. The room hushes.

YU QING
Leqing Technology rewards its lions. This quarter's revenue proves it.

Behind him, a screen shows a soaring revenue graph.

YU QING
But lions must be correctly identified.

Qian joins him on stage, beaming.

YU QING
Director Qian's vision transformed a dying prototype into gold. Primary recognition belongs to him.

Applause. Qian bows. Yu Qing raises a hand.

YU QING
However. Miss Ye Qingyi's... condition... caused critical delays. Her "pregnancy fatigue" compromised code integrity...

Ye's team stiffens. Chen Ruohan half-rises.

YU QING
(pulling out a tablet)
And forensic audit shows she attempted to exfiltrate Director Qian's design documents.

The screen flickers: emails, timestamps, fabricated evidence.

CHEN RUOHAN
(standing)
She was in the hospital! I visited her!

SECURITY appears at the doors.

YU QING
(coldly)
Effective immediately, Miss Ye is terminated. Shares forfeit. Access revoked.

The room erupts. Ye stands frozen, one hand on her belly, the other clutching her water glass so tightly it cracks.

QIAN GUANGJIN
(leaning in)
Should've taken leave sooner. This is MY game now... Queen.

He smirks at her belly.

YE QINGYI
(very quiet)
Check the blockchain.

QIAN GUANGJIN
What?

YE QINGYI
(louder, crystal clear)
Every design doc. Timestamped. With my biometric key. Buried in the ledger.

The room stills. Yu Qing's smile shatters.

YE QINGYI
(to the crowd)
You want to know who I am?

She pulls out her phone. On screen: a tournament trophy. Her avatar: QUEEN.

YE QINGYI
I'm the reigning world champion of game design. And this...

She looks down at her belly, then up at Qian and Yu.

YE QINGYI
...this is my greatest creation. Not the game. This LIFE.

She drops her company badge. It CLATTERS on marble.

YE QINGYI
Consider my identity... revealed.

She walks toward the exit. Her team parts. Qian's phone buzzes. He glances down:

ON HIS PHONE: News alert—"World Champion Queen announces new studio. Investors swarm."

Qian's face drains. The camera holds on Ye's back as she exits, pregnant, powerful, untouchable.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: After Pregnancy! Crying Red Eyes! Miss Shen Won't Look Back (Episode 64)
description: A famous masked singer gives up her career to care for her blind husband, only to discover a shocking betrayal when his sight is restored.
context:
Title: After Pregnancy! Crying Red Eyes! Miss Shen Won't Look Back (Episode 64)
Description: A famous masked singer gives up her career to care for her blind husband, only to discover a shocking betrayal when his sight is restored.

INT. CONCERT STAGE - NIGHT

SHEN QINGYU wears a white wedding dress and an ornate white mask, singing emotionally under the spotlight. The background music is a melancholic song.

SHEN QINGYU
(singing)
Who makes your heart flutter, who makes your heart ache.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

THREE DAYS AGO

A DOCTOR and SHEN QINGYU stand at a ward door, looking through the round window.

DOCTOR
He's refusing treatment. Won't let anyone within six feet.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

GU MINGXUAN sits in a wheelchair, his eyes and wrists wrapped in bandages, his head turned toward the window.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The DOCTOR pushes GU MINGXUAN's wheelchair down the corridor. SHEN QINGYU follows, carrying a small whiteboard.

GU MINGXUAN
(coldly)
Get out. I don't want anyone.

SHEN QINGYU stops, writes quickly on the board, and holds it up: "I'm mute. Not a threat."

GU MINGXUAN
(furious)
I said GET OUT!

He swings his arm, knocking the whiteboard from SHEN QINGYU's hands.

INT. CONCERT STAGE - NIGHT

SHEN QINGYU's fingers tremble on the microphone as she continues singing.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

SHEN QINGYU retrieves the whiteboard. She writes slowly, then holds it before GU MINGXUAN's bandaged eyes: "I'll be your eyes."

She takes his hand. He pulls away, but she gently persists, tracing letters on his palm.

INT. CONCERT STAGE - NIGHT

The song reaches its climax. The fans below go wild with cheers.

FANS
Diva! Diva!

SHEN QINGYU bows. The LED screen behind her displays: "The Final Note - Thank You."

FAN A
One more song! Please!

FAN B
We love you, whoever you are!

NARRATOR (news broadcast)
The mysterious diva vanishes. Her identity remains unknown.

On stage, SHEN QINGYU removes her mask, revealing her face only to the empty air above the audience. No cameras capture this moment. Tears fall.

SHEN QINGYU (V.O.)
Brother Pudding. Little Bottle Cap is coming home.
continuation:
EXT. PARK - DAY

SEVEN YEARS LATER

SHEN QINGYU wears a simple cotton dress, walking with a smile. Her daughter WEIWEI (6) skips beside her.

EXT. PLAZA - DAY

A group of fans hold up a giant poster: "The Masked Diva: 7 Years of Searching."

FAN C
Seven years and we still don't know her name!

FAN D
We'll keep looking. She's out there.

SHEN QINGYU stops at a distance, watching. Weiwei tugs her sleeve.

WEIWEI
Mommy, why are you staring? Do you like masked singers too?

SHEN QINGYU smiles, shakes her head. She pulls out a small notebook, writes: "Legends never fade."

She shows it to the fans as they pass.

FAN D
(nodding)
That's beautiful, thank you.

A fan hands Shen Qingyu a bunny ear headband.

FAN C
For good luck.

SHEN QINGYU accepts it, placing it on Weiwei's head.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

SHEN QINGYU and WEIWEI walk hand in hand. WEIWEI wears the bunny ears.

WEIWEI
Mommy, will Daddy really see us tomorrow?

SHEN QINGYU
(gently)
The doctor confirmed it three times.

WEIWEI
(happily)
Then he'll see me dance! And see YOU!

SHEN QINGYU's hand drifts to her belly. A small smile plays on her lips.

SHEN QINGYU (V.O.)
Seven years of silence. Tomorrow, I'll sing again.

EXT. PARK - OTHER SIDE - DAY

GU MINGXUAN stands in a sharp suit. A DOCTOR removes the final bandage.

WEIWEI
(pointing)
Look! Daddy's bandages are off!

GU MINGXUAN opens his eyes. Blinks. Focuses.

His gaze finds SHEN QINGYU and WEIWEI. His smile begins, then freezes.

He turns his head sharply. His face transforms—recognition, guilt, and something else.

He runs forward.

SHEN QINGYU moves toward him, happiness lighting her face.

GU MINGXUAN runs RIGHT PAST HER.

SHEN QINGYU and WEIWEI freeze.

GU MINGXUAN embraces a WOMAN and SMALL BOY (5) nearby.

SMALL BOY
Daddy! You can see!

SHEN QINGYU's smile shatters. Disbelief. Then a cold, terrible understanding.

GU MINGXUAN looks up, catches her eye across the distance. His face drains of color.

SHEN QINGYU (V.O.)
Seven years of silence. For a lie.

She turns away.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

SHEN QINGYU walks away, pulling WEIWEI with her. Her face is stone.

WEIWEI looks back.

WEIWEI
Mommy?

SHEN QINGYU doesn't answer. Just keeps walking. Resolute.

The bunny ear headband lies abandoned on the path.

title: Survival Guide for a Love-Brained Harem
description: A woman caught in palace intrigue realizes too late that she and her rival are merely pawns in a larger game orchestrated by the Empress.
context:
Title: Survival Guide for a Love-Brained Harem
Description: A woman caught in palace intrigue realizes too late that she and her rival are merely pawns in a larger game orchestrated by the Empress.

EXT. EXECUTION GROUND - DAY

CHENG XIAOXIAO, clothes stained with blood, bound by ropes, kneels on the ground with a desperate expression.

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(crying out)
I beg Your Majesty, in remembrance of our childhood friendship, spare the Cheng family!

CHENG LANG, also bound, kneels nearby.

CHENG LANG
Little sister, you need not do this! The Emperor listens to slander. This kind of foolish ruler does not deserve our Cheng family's loyalty!

Emperor ZHAO RIXING, wearing dragon robes, sits expressionless on the high platform.

Imperial Consort YA HUANYAO stands beside him, speaking to the Emperor.

YA HUANYAO
Your Majesty, although the Cheng family has committed grave crimes, Consort Ru grew up with you as childhood sweethearts. I humbly beg Your Majesty to spare the Cheng family.

ZHAO RIXING coldly picks up the execution token and throws it to the ground.

JAILER
(shouting)
The noon hour has arrived. Proceed with the execution!

The executioner raises his blade. Suddenly, YA HUANYAO leaps forward and blocks the blade aimed at CHENG XIAOXIAO. But the other executioner's blades fall on the rest of the Cheng family.

Blood splatters.

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(heartbroken)
No!

YA HUANYAO reveals a satisfied smile. ZHAO RIXING remains expressionless.

At the execution ground, CHENG LANG and the Cheng family members lie in pools of blood.
continuation:
INT. PRISON CELL - NIGHT

A bright moon hangs high in the night sky.

YA HUANYAO
(laughing softly)
Ha ha ha.

YA HUANYAO
(coldly)
Well, little sister...

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(angrily)
You wretch! You played the Empress's game to perfection. Was my family's death not enough?

CHENG XIAOXIAO
(shocked)
The Empress... she moves against me?

YA HUANYAO
The shadows warned you. You chose the sun.

YA HUANYAO

(grinning wickedly)

ANOTHER JAILER
Right!

Title: Lovebrain Daughter Is Beyond Saving
Description: A mother separated from her son during a desperate escape is reunited with him twelve years later, but tragedy strikes when her son-in-law's jealousy leads to a deadly accident.

EXT. DARK FOREST - NIGHT

Rain hammers the canopy. CHANG HUAIYU sprints through mud with young LIU QINGHONG (6) and LIU ZHI (8), clutching a canvas bag. Flashlight beams stab through trees behind them.

DEBT COLLECTOR (V.O.)
Chang Huaiyu! Your husband's factory is bankrupt! The court order's clear—surrender the assets or face fraud charges!

CHANG HUAIYU stumbles, shielding the children. Three SILHOUETTES close in, wielding batons.

DEBT COLLECTOR
Spread out! Check every ditch!

CHANG HUAIYU presses against a fallen tree, her breath ragged. LIU QINGHONG whimpers.

LIU QINGHONG (YOUNG)
(whispering)
Mama, I'm scared...

CHANG HUAIYU
(quietly)
Hold my hand tight. Both of you.

She grips their hands. LIU ZHI's fingers slip in the mud.

LIU ZHI (YOUNG)
(struggling)
Mama, my hand—

A flashlight beam sweeps toward them. CHANG HUAIYU makes a split-second choice—she shoves LIU ZHI under the fallen tree's hollow.

CHANG HUAIYU
(urgent, low)
Stay down. Don't move.

LIU ZHI (YOUNG)
(protesting)
But—

CHANG HUAIYU
Trust Mama.

She breaks a jade pendant from her neck—it's already cracked in one corner. She presses the larger half into LIU ZHI's palm.

CHANG HUAIYU
(whispering)
Your grandmother's pendant. If we get separated... find the match. Now hide.

She covers him with wet leaves just as—

DEBT COLLECTOR (V.O.)
There! By the deadfall!

CHANG HUAIYU scoops up LIU QINGHONG and runs. The lights chase her. LIU ZHI watches through leaves, clutching the pendant, rain washing over him.

ON SCREEN: TWELVE YEARS LATER
continuation:
INT. HIGH-RISE OFFICE - DAY

Adult LIU ZHI (20) stands at the window, running his thumb over the jade half. His ASSISTANT enters, holding a tablet.

LIU ZHI
The investigation?

ASSISTANT
Closed. Your parents returned to Jiangcheng six years ago. They run a small brickworks. You have a sister—Liu Qinghong. Married last year.

The ASSISTANT shows a photo: a modest factory, a family dinner. LIU ZHI's hand trembles.

LIU ZHI
(softly)
They look... ordinary.

ASSISTANT
Sir, the debt was legitimate. Your father signed the bankruptcy papers himself. They weren't victims.

LIU ZHI
(turning away)
I was eight years old. I remember what I remember.

He pockets the jade.

EXT. BRICK FACTORY COURTYARD - DAY

LIU JIANGUO (60s) inspects a cracked brick. CHANG HUAIYU sorts invoices. LIU QINGHONG (18) helps. LI ZICHENG (25) carries water.

LIU JIANGUO
(tossing the brick aside)
This batch is useless. Zicheng, the kiln temperature's been off for weeks.

LI ZICHENG
(measured)
I'm still learning the controls, Dad.

LIU JIANGUO
Learning? You've been here two years. When I was your age—

LIU QINGHONG
(interrupting gently)
Dad, Zicheng's doing his best. The equipment is old.

CHANG HUAIYU
(quietly)
Jianguo, let it be.

LIU JIANGUO mutters, walking away. LI ZICHENG's smile fades. He fills cups, then stops behind a brick stack—structurally unsound, visibly wobbling. He stares at LIU JIANGUO's back.

LI ZICHENG
(under his breath)
Two years. Still the useless son-in-law.

He nudges a loose brick at the base. The stack creaks. He glances around—no one watching. He nudges it again, harder. A single brick topples from the top.

LIU QINGHONG
(looking up)
The stack—

CHANG HUAIYU
(shouting)
Jianguo! Move!

She shoves LIU JIANGUO clear. The stack collapses, bricks thundering down. CHANG HUAIYU stumbles. One brick strikes her temple. She falls, motionless, half-buried.

LIU QINGHONG
(screaming)
Mama!

LI ZICHENG stands frozen, water kettle still in hand.

THE END

title: Just When the Rain Falls
description: A mother's daughter dies while her husband, a doctor, abandons them to save his first love's daughter instead. She vows revenge.
context:
Title: Just When the Rain Falls
Description: A mother's daughter dies while her husband, a doctor, abandons them to save his first love's daughter instead. She vows revenge.

EXT. MILITARY TRAINING GROUND - DAWN

QING'ER, in white martial attire now stained with dust, drills her sword through the morning mist. Her strikes carry a precision that borders on fury.

QING'ER (V.O.)
My daughter died five days ago. By the time I carried her through the storm, there was no blood left to bleed. My husband—the physician sworn to heal—chose to save his first love's child instead.

QING'ER's blade slashes downward, splitting a training dummy clean through.

QING'ER
(whispering to the wind)
Fu Huai'an. Zhou Ran. Blood debts are paid in blood.

LIGHTNING flickers—not in the sky, but in her eyes.

CUT TO BLACK.

TITLE CARD: That Night

EXT. MOUNTAIN VILLAGE - MAIN ROAD - NIGHT

The landslide has reduced the village to rubble and screams. A wooden beam juts from the wreckage, its protruding nail dark with blood.

QING'ER stumbles through the dust, clutching her bleeding daughter AN'AN (7). The child's head lolls, a thin trickle of blood at her temple.

QING'ER
(voice cracking)
Her pulse—can you feel it?

FU HUAI'AN, his physician's sleeve torn, presses fingers to An'an neck. His face tightens with professional assessment.

FU HUAI'AN
Superficial head wound. Stable for now. But the pulse is thready—

A distant cry—feminine, familiar—echoes from below the ridge.

FU HUAI'AN
(turning instinctively)
Ranran's cottage was in the slide path.

QING'ER
(emotional subtext: don't you dare)
Huai'an...

FU HUAI'AN
(avoiding her eyes)
I'll triage and return. Ten minutes.

He grabs his kit. His boots are already moving.

JUN JUN (O.S.)
Uncle Doctor! Please!

QING'ER
(screams after him)
She's your daughter!

But he's vanished into the dust.
continuation:
EXT. ZHOU RAN'S COLLAPSED COTTAGE - NIGHT

FU HUAI'AN finds ZHOU RAN (40s, elegant even in ruin) clutching her daughter JUN JUN. Ran's arm is a mess of blood-soaked silk.

ZHOU RAN
Junjun first. Please.

FU HUAI'AN
(sweeping his light over the girl)
She's unmarked. Shocked, but—

JUN JUN
Mother's arm won't stop bleeding! I tried to tie it but—

FU HUAI'AN
(already cutting the sleeve)
Let me see.

The wound is deep. Not fatal, but arterial. Blood spurts with each heartbeat. His medical training kicks in—pressure, pressure, pressure.

ZHOU RAN
(weakly)
Go. Qing'er needs you...

FU HUAI'AN
(wrapping a tourniquet)
Pressure won't hold. I have to cauterize. Two minutes.

His V.O. is a whispered promise:

FU HUAI'AN (V.O.)
An'an, hold on. Two minutes.

EXT. MOUNTAIN VILLAGE - MAIN ROAD - NIGHT

QING'ER presses her sash to An'an head wound. The white fabric turns crimson. An'an eyes flutter.

AN'AN
Daddy promised... he'd fix me...

QING'ER
He will, sweetheart. He will.

But An'an's breathing has changed—shallow, uneven. The skull fracture is bleeding internally.

AN'AN
Why did Daddy... leave me?

QING'ER
(rocking her)
He didn't. He's coming back.

AN'AN
Cold, Mama...

The rain begins. Not a drizzle—a sudden, biblical pour.

QING'ER
(seeing the truth in her daughter's fading eyes)
No. No no no—

She lifts An'an. Runs. The mud sucks at her boots. The rain erases the path.

EXT. MEDICAL DISTRICT - NIGHT

QING'ER staggers down a street of shuttered clinics. Each door she hammers on is locked, dark.

QING'ER
(screaming over the storm)
Anyone! Apothecary! Midwife! Please!

Her fist leaves blood on the third door. No answer.

QING'ER
(collapsing)
I'll trade my life—just save hers...

An'an's head lolls against her shoulder. The rain washes them both clean.

FADE OUT.

title: Love Moves the Little Rose
description: A woman waits alone on her birthday, only to be reminded by her lover that she is merely a substitute for someone else.
context:
Title: Love Moves the Little Rose
Description: A woman waits alone on her birthday, only to be reminded by her lover that she is merely a substitute for someone else.

INT. UPSCALE RESTAURANT - NIGHT

ZHU YAO (28, elegant exhaustion) sits alone at a table with a birthday cake in front of her. She gazes out the window with a forlorn expression.

A WAITER approaches carrying a tray with a glass of water.

WAITER
Miss, it's nine o'clock. Would you like to order now?

ZHU YAO picks up the glass and takes a sip.

ZHU YAO
Not yet.

WAITER
Alright.

The WAITER turns and leaves.

ZHU YAO takes out her phone. The lock screen shows a photo of her with a man—arms around each other, but their eyes don't meet. The time reads 21:04. She unlocks the phone and sends the man a message.

PHONE SCREEN displays the message: "Are you coming?"

Soon, a reply comes back.

PHONE SCREEN displays the message: "Yangyang woke up. I'm staying with her tonight."

ZHU YAO's expression freezes. Tears well up in her eyes, and one tear slides down her cheek.

ZHU YAO (V.O.)
Three years. Same script. Different night.

CUT TO:

Another part of the restaurant. SHEN SHIWU (30, sharp suit) sits alone, drinking red wine pensively. He watches Zhu Yao's reflection in the mirror behind the bar.
continuation:
A FLOWER GIRL approaches SHEN SHIWU's table.

FLOWER GIRL
Last rose, mister?

SHEN SHIWU takes a red rose from the girl's basket and hands her money. The girl glances at Zhu Yao, understanding.

ZHU YAO looks down and continues typing on her phone.

PHONE SCREEN displays the message: "Thirty minutes. Please. It's my birthday."

As soon as the message is sent, a reply comes back immediately.

PHONE SCREEN displays the message: "Zhu Yao. Don't make me remind you what you signed."

ZHU YAO looks at the message, completely heartbroken.

At that moment, the FLOWER GIRL walks to ZHU YAO's table carrying her basket.

FLOWER GIRL
Miss.

ZHU YAO looks up and forces a smile.

ZHU YAO
I'm not buying roses, but thank you, little one.

The FLOWER GIRL takes a red rose from her basket and hands it to ZHU YAO.

FLOWER GIRL
He said... "You weren't really waiting for him."

ZHU YAO is stunned. She follows the girl's gaze.

SHEN SHIWU is at the front desk settling his bill. He leaves a business card by his glass, then turns and leaves the restaurant.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED...

title: Intelligence Analysis Office
description: A special agent volunteers for a suicide mission after receiving surveillance footage that suggests his wife, a fellow operative, has compromised herself during a critical interrogation.
context:
Title: Intelligence Analysis Office
Description: A special agent volunteers for a suicide mission after receiving surveillance footage that suggests his wife, a fellow operative, has compromised herself during a critical interrogation.

INT. DIRECTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

QIN MING, in black tactical gear, sits before the DIRECTOR's desk. He places a signed form on the blotter.

QIN MING
Qin Ming, intelligence analysis. Volunteer for decapitation operation.

The Director picks up the "DECAPITATION OPERATION ACKNOWLEDGMENT FORM."

DIRECTOR
If you go, you won't be able to return.

QIN MING
I know.

DIRECTOR
Are you certain?

QIN MING
Certain.

The Director stamps the form.

DIRECTOR
Lone Shadow.

QIN MING
The King of Agents died five years ago.

DIRECTOR
You and Xizhi have been married five years. Even love doesn't prevent operational compromise.
continuation:
INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

SPECIAL POLICE secure a medical station. YAN XIZHI monitors LI MUYANG—wounded, restrained, fading.

XIAO WU
(anxiously)
He's been poisoned. Condition's worsening. We need to extract the antidote formula before he flatlines.

XIAO LU looks to XIAO QI.

XIAO QI
(quickly)
Don't look at me. I'm not trained for chemical interrogation.

YAN XIZHI
