title: A Stunning Smile Captivates the Heavens
description: Chen Ping'an, the last male heir of a loyal military family, is forced to disguise himself as a woman to escape political purge, but unexpectedly gets summoned into the palace as an imperial consort.
context:
Title: A Stunning Smile Captivates the Heavens
Description: Chen Ping'an, the last male heir of a loyal military family, is forced to disguise himself as a woman to escape political purge, but unexpectedly gets summoned into the palace as an imperial consort.

INT. CHEN RESIDENCE - NIGHT

Candlelight flickers. Shadows stretch across painted screens.

CHEN PING'AN (18, sharp-featured, battle-hardened hands) sits before a bronze mirror. He presses red paper to his lips. His reflection shows fury warring with resignation.

CHEN PING'AN (V.O.)
Three generations of Chen blood soaked the borders. Now I'm painting my lips to survive.

He slams the rouge box down. Vermillion powder blooms like smoke across the table.

EXT. FOREST - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Sunlight slashes through canopy. Metal screams against metal.

CHEN PING'AN, in dented armor, spins his spear through a BARBARIAN RAIDER'S throat. Two more corpses litter the moss. He pivots, breathing hard, as the BARBARIAN GENERAL (40s, scarred, bored) spits blood.

BARBARIAN GENERAL
The Great Wall is rubble. Daxia's masters are carrion. Who are you, boy?

CHEN PING'AN
Tianbo Manor. Chen Ping'an.

He lunges. The spear takes the General through the heart.

INT. CHEN RESIDENCE MAIN HALL - DAY

GRAND MATRON SHE (70s, iron-gray hair, courtier's eyes) sits at a rosewood desk, studying a scroll marked with red seals. Four names are crossed out.

CHEN PING'AN strides in, tosses a bloodied sack on the floor. A head rolls out.

CHEN PING'AN
The barbarian raider is dead. Petition the Emperor. Let me lead the northern army.

GRAND MATRON SHE
You think a savage's head buys you the right to die?

CHEN PING'AN
Father died at the Wall. My brothers died at the Wall. I won't hide in women's quarters!

GRAND MATRON SHE rises, cane striking the floor like a gavel.

GRAND MATRON SHE
The Chancellor's faction has purged four military families this month. Every Chen male is marked for elimination.

She throws the scroll. It unfurls at his feet.

GRAND MATRON SHE
You want honor? Honor is a dead man's luxury.

The three SISTERS-IN-LAW enter, arms full of silk.

ELDEST SISTER-IN-LAW
We sold our dowries to bribe the census officials. You're registered as female now.
continuation:
SECOND SISTER-IN-LAW
Your second brother's death pension paid for it. Don't waste his sacrifice.

THIRD SISTER-IN-LAW
(softly)
We know what we ask, little brother. But ghosts don't father children.

Chen's jaw tightens. He closes his eyes.

CHEN PING'AN
(whisper)
Begin.

They undress him. Armor clatters. Silk whispers. They bind his chest, arrange his hair, slip earrings through untouched lobes. The transformation is silent, funereal.

SECOND SISTER-IN-LAW
(studying him)
Even Duke Xu would look plain beside you.

GRAND MATRON SHE
(nods, satisfied)
As a woman, you're invisible to our enemies. Survive first. The rest can follow.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Imperial decree!

EUNUCH LI, flanked by GOLD-ARMORED GUARDS, sweeps in. The Chen family drops to their knees.

EUNUCH LI
(unfurling yellow silk)
By Heaven's Mandate: The maiden Chen Ping'an, virtuous and graceful, daughter of a loyal house, is summoned to the Inner Palace as Noble Consort. Let it be known!

The scroll snaps shut. Grand Matron She goes pale.

EXT. CHEN RESIDENCE ENTRANCE - DAY

Red lanterns hang like blood drops. GRAND MATRON SHE and the sisters-in-law watch the bridal sedan.

GRAND MATRON SHE
(to the ancestors' tablets)
Forgive us.

The sedan lifts. Chen's red-veiled face disappears behind swaying curtains.

INT. IMPERIAL PALACE BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

Red candles weep wax. CHEN PING'AN sits rigid, veil in place.

CHEN PING'AN (V.O.)
Hide as a woman, they said. Become invisible. Instead, I'm unveiled before the Son of Heaven.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Your Majesty! The auspicious hour arrives.

Chen's hand trembles. He lifts the veil's edge. In the copper mirror: a stranger's face, painted and terrified.

FADE OUT.

title: May You Be Well
description: A princess raised by the royal family volunteers for a political marriage to a distant land after the prince she loves chooses another, hiding her heartbreak behind duty.
context:
Title: May You Be Well
Description: A princess raised by the royal family volunteers for a political marriage to a distant land after the prince she loves chooses another, hiding her heartbreak behind duty.

INT. IMPERIAL PALACE THRONE ROOM - DAY

The EMPEROR sits on his throne, a sealed missive in his hands. JIANG NING kneels before him.

EMPEROR
Jiang Ning, Western Xia's latest raiding party was turned back at the border. Their Khan now offers peace... through marriage. You know what they are like. The cold, the harshness. Why would you offer yourself?

JIANG NING
Your Majesty took me in when I had nothing. This marriage brings peace without costing a true princess. It is my duty... and perhaps my only path forward.

EMPEROR
Your bond with the Crown Prince spans so many years. If you need time...

JIANG NING
Time changes nothing, Your Majesty. Action does.

EXT. OUTSIDE THE CITY - DAY

ON SCREEN: Fifteen days earlier

JIANG NING stands in the crowd, beaming as she clutches a handkerchief. Two PASSERSBY whisper behind her.

PASSERBY A
The Crown Prince returns victorious. His Majesty himself comes to greet him. Mark my words - he'll finally claim what's been his all these years.

PASSERBY B
One would think. Though I hear Minister Meng has been rather visible at court lately. And his daughter's dowry includes the northern garrison's loyalty.

The Crown Prince's procession thunders into view. PEI YAN, armor gleaming, reins his warhorse before the EMPEROR and assembled court.

JIANG NING darts forward, offering her handkerchief. PEI YAN's eyes meet hers briefly - then look away. He dismounts and kneels.

PEI YAN
Father Emperor, I ask but one reward for my service: your blessing to take a wife.

EMPEROR
Your patience these years has not gone unnoticed. Rise, my son, and claim...

PEI YAN
Minister Meng's daughter, Lanxin. As Crown Princess.

JIANG NING's handkerchief slips from her fingers. The crowd's murmur rises around her.

PASSERBY B
Beggar girl playing princess. Who would have her now?

PEI YAN rises, approaches Jiang Ning. He takes her hand - a final, false tenderness.

PEI YAN
(loud enough for all to hear)
She saved my life once. For that, she deserves honor. But the Crown Princess must be worthy of the throne. Blood tells, Father. And hers is common.

He drops her hand. Jiang Ning's tears fall silently.

EMPEROR
You dishonor her publicly? You dishonor yourself.

PEI YAN
I secure your empire. Minister Meng's support is worth more than nostalgia.
continuation:
INT. IMPERIAL PALACE THRONE ROOM - DAY

JIANG NING (V.O.)
Blood tells, he said. So let it speak elsewhere.

JIANG NING
Western Xia knows me only as a princess of the realm. My fluency in their tongue is a weapon no envoy carries. Let me be useful, Your Majesty. Let me be gone.

She bows low, her forehead to the ground. The Emperor studies her - seeing not a broken girl, but a strategist born.

EMPEROR
After the New Year. The decree will be sealed.

JIANG NING
One request, Your Majesty. Let the Crown Prince believe it is his idea. That I go because I am... in the way.

EMPEROR
You would protect his pride even now?

JIANG NING
I would protect the alliance. He need not know until I am beyond recall.

EXT. PALACE SIDE COURTYARD - DAY

MENG LANXIN practices archery with several HANDMAIDENS. Her precision is cold, mechanical.

HANDMAIDEN A
They say Princess Anning petitioned His Majesty.

HANDMAIDEN B
Her name hasn't even been cleared from the palace rolls. She could still make trouble...

MENG LANXIN (V.O.)
Trouble. Yes. The kind that whispers of sacrifice and makes princes feel guilt.

She spots JIANG NING walking with her attendants in the distance. Meng Lanxin draws, holds - then shifts her aim slightly.

The arrow whistles past Jiang Ning's face, embedding in a pillar. A warning. A message.

JIANG NING touches her unmarked cheek, understanding. She meets Meng Lanxin's gaze - and nods once, acknowledging the hit.

Without a word, Jiang Ning turns and walks on. The arrow remains quivering behind her.

title: Rebirth to 1990
description: A man crushed under a car finds himself transported back to 1990, to the day he was delivering betrothal gifts, and decides to change his fate.
context:
Title: Rebirth to 1990
Description: A man crushed under a car finds himself transported back to 1990, to the day he was delivering betrothal gifts, and decides to change his fate.

TRANSITION: TIME-WARP DISSOLVE

EXT. VILLAGE PATH - DAY

The MALE LEAD steadies a Forever bicycle, a thin pork cut wrapped in wax-paper tied to the rack. His eyes clench shut, body tense with memory.

AUNT LIU, a middle-aged woman in a floral cotton jacket, walks over with her hands on her hips, looking aggressive.

AUNT LIU
Oh my, meditating now? Watched too much Journey to the West, trying to become immortal? Watched too many Calabash Brothers, trying to become a spirit? What are you thinking? Let me tell you, is it easy for our Furong? Our Furong is extraordinary, a broadcaster at Red Star Commune, eating the national rice bowl! Pushing a broken bicycle, thinking you can marry our Furong? Dream on!

MALE LEAD (V.O.)
The car... crushing me... then this? The same path. The same pork.

AUNT LIU
Let me tell you, without a watch, a sewing machine, and thirty-two table legs, let me tell you, forget about this marriage!

AUNT LIU (V.O.)
I'm counting on my daughter's marriage to get things to save for my son's wedding. A mud-leg who can't even farm properly, can't even eat his fill, and wants to marry my daughter?

MALE LEAD (V.O.)
May 17th, 1990. The day I knelt. The day she smirked. The day I wore shame for years.

The MALE LEAD slowly opens his eyes, his expression changing from confusion to cold clarity. He looks at AUNT LIU, a smile that doesn't reach his eyes.

MALE LEAD
Aunt Liu. Your scale is broken.

AUNT LIU
continuation:
(shocked)
Who? You're cursing me? You dare curse me? You dare curse me? Well, today I'll tear your mouth apart, I tell you! I have no shame? You have shame? If you have shame, do you have a job? With that big face of yours, go find a job! Can't even afford food! A mud-leg who can't even farm, poor as a church mouse, marrying our Furong? Dream on!

MALE LEAD
When marrying a wife, marry virtue. It's not that I can't afford a wife, it's that your daughter is not worthy!

AUNT LIU
(furious)
Who's not worthy? Who are you saying is not worthy? Our Furong eats the imperial grain, the national rice bowl, our Furong isn't worthy, but you are? What are you worthy of? Bah! Let me tell you, I was planning to use the betrothal gifts from marrying off our girl to get our son married. With what you have, what can you give? What can you afford? You're about to starve to death yourself! A toad lusting after swan meat, dreaming big dreams!

MALE LEAD
The Red Star Commune dissolves in '93. Your Furong's rice bowl breaks. She marries the secretary's son. By '95, he's gambled your house away.

AUNT LIU
(fury cracking)
Fortune-telling? Lies—

MALE LEAD
Rest assured, I will never be a bachelor in this life, and I will marry a woman a hundred times better than Chen Furong! Don't regret it.

The MALE LEAD turns around with his bicycle, preparing to leave.

MALE LEAD
The marriage between our two families is off. Tell your daughter not to cling to me shamelessly. I'm leaving!

The MALE LEAD gets on his bicycle and leaves.

AUNT LIU
(chasing and cursing from behind)
You're all talk! You've got some nerve, all talk! Go home, get lost and go home! Go home!

The MALE LEAD rides away, looking back at the furious AUNT LIU, a smile of certainty on his face.

The marriage between our two families is off. Tell your daughter not to cling to me shamelessly. I'm leaving!

The MALE LEAD gets on his bicycle and leaves.

AUNT LIU
(chasing and cursing from behind)
You're all talk! You've got some nerve, all talk! Go home, get lost and go home! Go home!

The MALE LEAD rides away, looking back at the furious AUNT LIU, a smile of certainty on his face.

title: I Am Not the World's Number One
description: Chu Ran, once the world's greatest martial artist, became a beggar after sealing away his powers following his wife's tragic death. When a woman with his late wife's face appears, his past resurfaces.
context:
Title: I Am Not the World's Number One
Description: Chu Ran, once the world's greatest martial artist, became a beggar after sealing away his powers following his wife's tragic death. When a woman with his late wife's face appears, his past resurfaces.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

An elderly STORYTELLER talks animatedly to several young BEGGARS. CHU RAN, a destitute beggar, lies on a pile of straw nearby, his hands trembling.

STORYTELLER
You ask me who is the strongest in the world? Who is the strongest in the world? That would be Chu Ran, the great hero Chu.

EXT. LAKESIDE/CLIFF - DAY (FLASHBACK)

CHU RAN, dressed in white robes, displays extraordinary martial arts skills, running across water and fighting numerous men in black.

STORYTELLER (V.O.)
Legend has it that Hero Chu mastered all martial arts by age thirteen, reached the transcendent realm at twenty, and was only one step away from shattering the void.

CHU RAN easily defeats several enemies, finally splitting a massive rock with his sword, carving the words "Number One Under Heaven."

STORYTELLER (V.O.)
Two years ago, at Meteor Immortal Cliff, he defeated the Four Absolutes and finally claimed the title of Number One Under Heaven.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

YOUNG BEGGAR A
What happened after that?

STORYTELLER
After that? After that, Hero Chu naturally ascended to the Immortal World. Or so they say.

CHU RAN
(weakly)
He did not ascend. He became a beggar.

YOUNG BEGGAR B
What kind of joke is that! With that kind of power, why would he become a beggar?

CHU RAN (V.O.)
That's because...
continuation:
EXT. LAKESIDE/CLIFF - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

CHU RAN'S WIFE runs toward CHU RAN and embraces him, crying tears of joy.

CHU RAN'S WIFE
Chu Ran, you were gone so long. I was so afraid.

CHU RAN (V.O.)
Two years ago, after I defeated the Four Absolutes, my enemies didn't just want revenge. They wanted to destroy what I loved.

An ENEMY emerges from shadows with a crossbow. Chu Ran's guard is down. The BOLT flies—not at him, but at his wife. She sees it, and in that split second, pushes Chu Ran aside. The BOLT takes her in the chest.

Chu Ran catches her as she falls, his face transforming from joy to horror. He crushes the crossbow mechanism with a glance, killing the hidden archer instantly, but it's too late.

CHU RAN holds his dying wife, grief-stricken.

CHU RAN
Qingcheng... my qi can still save you—

CHU RAN'S WIFE
(weakly, blood on her lips)
No... promise me something. Promise you'll stop being their hero. Just... be a man who lives.

CHU RAN (V.O.)
I spent a lifetime conquering the heavens, but couldn't protect the one thing that made earth worth standing on.

CHU RAN
(broken)
Qingcheng...

CHU RAN (V.O.)
That night, I shattered my own cultivation. Every meridian. Every technique. I killed my power, not sealed it.

EXT. COURTYARD/STREET - DAY

A woman in black runs frantically into the courtyard, pursued by several WARRIORS. Her clothes are torn, but her bearing suggests nobility.

PURSUED WOMAN
Please! Help me!

MU FAMILY WARRIOR
Traitor! There's nowhere left to run!

YOUNG BEGGAR A
Those are the Mu family warriors! They don't leave witnesses!

The young BEGGARS and the STORYTELLER hurriedly flee. CHU RAN remains lying in place, his trembling hands clenched.

CHU RAN (INTERNAL MONOLOGUE)
Number One Under Heaven. What good is a title when I couldn't even save her? Let the world burn. I won't play their games anymore.

The PURSUED WOMAN is cornered. She stops and turns around, breathing hard. Her face is identical to CHU RAN'S deceased wife, down to the small scar above her left eyebrow. CHU RAN's eyes snap open. He stares, his face draining of color. His trembling hands go still.

CHU RAN
(shocked)
Wife?

title: After I Stopped Loving Her, My Cold Ex-Wife Cried
description: A devoted husband returns from France with a surprise for his wife on their tenth anniversary, only to discover a devastating betrayal.
context:
Title: After I Stopped Loving Her, My Cold Ex-Wife Cried
Description: A devoted husband returns from France with a surprise for his wife on their tenth anniversary, only to discover a devastating betrayal.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL STREET - DAY

A rainy day, the street is wet. LIN HUAI, a man in a trench coat, pulls a suitcase and holds a transparent umbrella, walking hurriedly.

LIN HUAI (V.O.)
Ten years today. Three months in Paris. She thinks I'm still there.

LIN HUAI wears wireless earbuds, on a phone call, smiling.

FRIEND (PHONE)
Lin Huai, you're back already?

LIN HUAI
Lang Lang signed the recommendation. No need to stay.

FRIEND (PHONE)
Three months busking at the opera? That's not devotion, that's a ghost story.

LIN HUAI
I'm home now. Talk later.

LIN HUAI removes his earbuds, ending the call. He looks ahead, his face glowing with anticipation.

LIN HUAI (V.O.)
She always said her music needed Paris. I finally gave it to her.

In LIN HUAI's line of sight appears a young man, SU HAN, wearing a blue jacket and holding a bouquet of flowers, talking on the phone.

SU HAN (PHONE)
See me? I flew back. Come down.

LIN HUAI watches SU HAN, somewhat curious.

SU HAN (V.O.)
Gu Nian, I've memorized every piece you love. Stop pretending.
continuation:
INT. OPEN SPACE DOWNSTAIRS - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Young SU HAN kneels on one knee, surrounded by candles arranged in a heart shape. He confesses to young GU NIAN.

SU HAN
Will you be with me?

GU NIAN
I...

FRIENDS (O.S.)
Together! Together! Together!

GU NIAN accepts the flowers, her eyes on someone outside the circle.

END FLASHBACK.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL STREET - DAY

LIN HUAI watches SU HAN in the distance, smiling and shaking his head.

LIN HUAI
(to himself)
Youth.

LIN HUAI takes out his phone, preparing to send a voice message to his wife.

LIN HUAI
(into the phone)
Honey, there's a guy downstairs with flowers...

Before he finishes, GU NIAN runs out of the building. She runs straight to SU HAN, and they embrace tightly.

GU NIAN
Why didn't you tell me?

SU HAN
I needed to see you first.

They gaze at each other, then kiss carefully, like a secret.

LIN HUAI stands not far away, witnessing everything. The umbrella slips from his hand and falls onto the wet ground. The smile on his face freezes, his eyes filled with shock and disbelief.

LIN HUAI
(shocked)
Honey?

The phone screen shows: "Recording..."

title: I Help the Empress Stabilize the Empire
description: A 21st-century ammunition engineer is transported to an ancient dynasty where he must serve as a eunuch in the Empress's palace while hiding his true identity.
context:
Title: I Help the Empress Stabilize the Empire
Description: A 21st-century ammunition engineer is transported to an ancient dynasty where he must serve as a eunuch in the Empress's palace while hiding his true identity.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

A high-tech ammunition lab. Warning lights strobe. SENIOR ENGINEER ZHANG YI monitors glowing screens while LI TIANLE (26, sharp-eyed) preps a prototype.

ZHANG YI
Ready for velocity calibration. Tianle, final check on the propellant mix.

LI TIANLE
(grinning)
Optimized for stability. This batch won't combust prematurely—

The control panel erupts in sparks. Tianle lunges for the emergency shutdown but a blinding energy surge envelops him—

INT. EUNUCH'S QUARTERS - NIGHT

Lightning cracks through a window. LI TIANLE jolts awake on an ancient bed, spasming. He touches his temple—blood. Silk robes replace his lab coat.

He notices the eunuch's red uniform. His face drains.

LI TIANLE
(whisper)
No...

He checks himself frantically—exhales in relief.

LI TIANLE
(loud whisper)
Thank god.

A knock sounds at the door.

PALACE MAID (O.S.)
Eunuch Li! Her Majesty's bath is drawn. Don't keep her waiting.

LI TIANLE
(stalling)
Just—just preparing the oils!

PALACE MAID (O.S.)
The Empress tolerates many things. Tardiness isn't one.

Footsteps recede. Li Tianle paces, pressing his forehead.

LI TIANLE (V.O.)
Gunpowder equations I understand. Imperial protocol?

He spots a scroll: "Palace Conduct for Eunuchs." His engineer's eye scans it methodically.

LI TIANLE (V.O.)
Okay. Variables: one volatile Empress. Constant: my head on the block. Solution: survive tonight, escape tomorrow.
continuation:
INT. BATHHOUSE - NIGHT

Steam clouds the chamber. The EMPRESS (30s, steel in her eyes) soaks, flanked by silent maids. Li Tianle enters, tray balanced with surgical precision.

EMPRESS
Xiao Lizi. The towel.

LI TIANLE
(eyes averted)
Yes, Your Majesty.

He moves forward—his foot hits a wet patch. The tray flies. He grabs instinctively—hands land on her shoulders. The maid GASPS.

EMPRESS
(frozen fury)
You dare.

LI TIANLE
(voice cracking)
The coefficient of friction on wet cypress is—

EMPRESS
What?

LI TIANLE
(releasing her)
—nothing, Your Majesty. My profound apologies.

EMPRESS
Get out. Kneel in the courtyard until dawn.

LI TIANLE
(retreating)
Yes. Yes, of course.

EUNUCH WANG enters, bowing deeply.

EUNUCH WANG
Your Majesty, the Duke of Qi demands immediate audience. He brings... soldiers.

EMPRESS
(laughs bitterly)
Of course he does. Even my bath isn't sacred.

She rises, water dripping. A maid wraps her in silk. She glances at Li Tianle—her look sharpens.

EMPRESS
Bring the clumsy one. Let him witness what happens when men overstep.

A PALACE MAID walks to LI TIANLE's side and whispers urgently.

PALACE MAID
Follow. Now.

LI TIANLE
(quietly)
This is a containment breach. Worst kind.

He trails the procession, his engineer's mind already calculating angles of escape.

title: My Name is Ruan Tiantian & I Haven't Been a Villainess in Years
description: A delivery worker accidentally spills milk tea on a woman's designer bag, leading to an unexpected confrontation and a shocking discovery at home.
context:
Title: My Name is Ruan Tiantian & I Haven't Been a Villainess in Years
Description: A delivery worker accidentally spills milk tea on a woman's designer bag, leading to an unexpected confrontation and a shocking discovery at home.

EXT. STREET - DAY

A DELIVERY WORKER runs while talking on the phone.

DELIVERY WORKER
Almost there, almost there.

The DELIVERY WORKER carefully bumps into the WIFE, spilling milk tea on her and her designer bag.

DELIVERY WORKER
I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

WIFE
You blind idiot.

DELIVERY WORKER
I'm sorry, my order is about to be late.

WIFE
I don't care if it's late! If you damage something, you pay! If you don't pay, I'll sue! Pay up now!

DELIVERY WORKER
How much?

WIFE
Twenty-eight thousand!

DELIVERY WORKER
(shocked)
What? I... I don't have that much money. I can't afford such an expensive bag.

WIFE
That's for trying to run. The bag is fine. The Supreme Triple Milk Tea was eight yuan. Consider the rest a life lesson.

DELIVERY WORKER
(confused)
I don't understand—

WIFE
Pay the eight yuan and disappear.

The DELIVERY WORKER pays and runs off. The WIFE watches him, then pulls a fresh milk tea from her bag, pouring the remnants into it.
continuation:
INT. HOME - DAY

The WIFE returns home carrying the milk tea.

WIFE
Lao Hao, I'm back!

The WIFE pushes open the bedroom door and sees her HUSBAND with a MISTRESS in bed. She freezes, her expression shifting from shock to cold fury.

WIFE
(furious)
You bastard.

The WIFE throws the milk tea in her hand at them. Quick cuts show the HUSBAND being beaten.

The HUSBAND lies on the floor with a black eye and swollen face, a straw stuck in his nostril, moaning in pain.

The WIFE looks at her HUSBAND on the floor, then turns to the MISTRESS on the bed.

WIFE
Now it's your turn.

The MISTRESS stands up, revealing her pregnant belly, and raises her hand to stop her.

MISTRESS
I'm pregnant!

The WIFE freezes. The HUSBAND on the floor also shows a surprised expression.

HUSBAND
...What?

title: I Run Towards You
description: A young woman from an ancient medical family flees with a sacred text after her home is attacked, seeking refuge with a destined stranger who shares mysterious dreams of a past life.
context:
Title: I Run Towards You
Description: A young woman from an ancient medical family flees with a sacred text after her home is attacked, seeking refuge with a destined stranger who shares mysterious dreams of a past life.

INT. BAI FAMILY ESTATE - NIGHT

Thunder splits the sky. MEN IN BLACK scale the walls, blades flashing. Lanterns shatter. Servants scatter.

WAN BEI (30s, ruthless elegance) strides through the carnage, silver pistol glinting.

WAN BEI
(to his men)
Find the scripture. The woman is mine.

INT. BAI FAMILY QUARTERS - CONTINUOUS

Bai Mother shoves a silver bracelet onto BAI XINTONG's wrist.

BAI MOTHER
Cloud Peak Manor, Jiangcheng. Show this to Old Master Fu.

Boots pound outside. She presses a sealed scroll into Xintong's palm.

BAI MOTHER
(whispering fiercely)
The Medicine King Scripture lives in your hands now. Not theirs. Go.

The door splinters. Men in black seize Bai Mother as Xintong vaults through the hidden panel.

BAI MOTHER
(shouting after her)
Live, Xintong! Live and remember!

WAN BEI enters, brushing dust from his sleeve. He raises the pistol.

WAN BEI
You taught me everything I know about poison, Sister. Even how long it takes to die.

The shot muffles against her chest. She crumples, crawling toward the scroll Xintong dropped.

BAI MOTHER
(gasping)
My daughter... will finish... what you started...

WAN BEI
(crouching)
And I'll be waiting. Family is patient.

He aims at her head. Thunder covers the second shot.
continuation:
INT. DREAM - FOREST - NIGHT

Mist curls through ancient trees. The WOMAN IN RED's laughter echoes as she vanishes into shadow, leaving only the scent of medicinal herbs.

WOMAN IN RED (V.O.)
Yanlang... next time, find me sooner.

INT. FU FAMILY ESTATE - DAY

FU JINGYAN (28, hollow-eyed elegance) jerks awake, his bracelet leaving red welts on his wrist. His Master pours tea with meditative calm.

FU JINGYAN
Every night. For eighteen years. The same ending.

MASTER
She waits in the space where your heart should ache.

FU JINGYAN
(flexing his hand)
I felt nothing when Father died. Nothing when I broke my arm at twelve. How can a dream hurt?

MASTER
Perhaps it is not a dream. Perhaps it is a memory that cut too deep.

FU JINGYAN
Then give it back to me.

MASTER
(patting his shoulder)
You cannot take what you never lost. Only meet it again.

FU MOTHER bursts in, a wedding invitation clutched like a weapon.

FU MOTHER
The Ye family arrives in one hour! If I see you moping like a ghost again, I'll hire an exorcist!

She unfurls a portrait - a girl in red, face hidden by a fan.

FU MOTHER
Your fiancée. Real. Breathing. Not some nightmare.

FU JINGYAN rises, his movements precise as a blade being drawn.

FU JINGYAN
Then I'll go breathe somewhere else.

He leaves. Fu Mother stares at the bracelet on the table, identical to the one in the portrait's wrist.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

FU JINGYAN watches condensation drip down his glass. The door crashes open.

BAI XINTONG (22, blood on her cheek, fire in her eyes) stumbles in, clutching the scroll. She crashes into his table. Their bracelets click together, magnetic.

BAI XINTONG
Sorry - I need to -

Their eyes meet. The scar above her eyebrow - he's seen it on the Woman In Red, bleeding from a thorn. He catches her as she reels, and for the first time in eighteen years, his fingers tremble.
full_script:
Title: I Run Towards You
Description: A young woman from an ancient medical family flees with a sacred text after her home is attacked, seeking refuge with a destined stranger who shares mysterious dreams of a past life.

INT. BAI FAMILY ESTATE - NIGHT

Thunder splits the sky. MEN IN BLACK scale the walls, blades flashing. Lanterns shatter. Servants scatter.

WAN BEI (30s, ruthless elegance) strides through the carnage, silver pistol glinting.

WAN BEI
(to his men)
Find the scripture. The woman is mine.

INT. BAI FAMILY QUARTERS - CONTINUOUS

Bai Mother shoves a silver bracelet onto BAI XINTONG's wrist.

BAI MOTHER
Cloud Peak Manor, Jiangcheng. Show this to Old Master Fu.

Boots pound outside. She presses a sealed scroll into Xintong's palm.

BAI MOTHER
(whispering fiercely)
The Medicine King Scripture lives in your hands now. Not theirs. Go.

The door splinters. Men in black seize Bai Mother as Xintong vaults through the hidden panel.

BAI MOTHER
(shouting after her)
Live, Xintong! Live and remember!

WAN BEI enters, brushing dust from his sleeve. He raises the pistol.

WAN BEI
You taught me everything I know about poison, Sister. Even how long it takes to die.

The shot muffles against her chest. She crumples, crawling toward the scroll Xintong dropped.

BAI MOTHER
(gasping)
My daughter... will finish... what you started...

WAN BEI
(crouching)
And I'll be waiting. Family is patient.

He aims at her head. Thunder covers the second shot.

INT. DREAM - FOREST - NIGHT

Mist curls through ancient trees. The WOMAN IN RED's laughter echoes as she vanishes into shadow, leaving only the scent of medicinal herbs.

WOMAN IN RED (V.O.)
Yanlang... next time, find me sooner.

INT. FU FAMILY ESTATE - DAY

FU JINGYAN (28, hollow-eyed elegance) jerks awake, his bracelet leaving red welts on his wrist. His Master pours tea with meditative calm.

FU JINGYAN
Every night. For eighteen years. The same ending.

MASTER
She waits in the space where your heart should ache.

FU JINGYAN
(flexing his hand)
I felt nothing when Father died. Nothing when I broke my arm at twelve. How can a dream hurt?

MASTER
Perhaps it is not a dream. Perhaps it is a memory that cut too deep.

FU JINGYAN
Then give it back to me.

MASTER
(patting his shoulder)
You cannot take what you never lost. Only meet it again.

FU MOTHER bursts in, a wedding invitation clutched like a weapon.

FU MOTHER
The Ye family arrives in one hour! If I see you moping like a ghost again, I'll hire an exorcist!

She unfurls a portrait - a girl in red, face hidden by a fan.

FU MOTHER
Your fiancée. Real. Breathing. Not some nightmare.

FU JINGYAN rises, his movements precise as a blade being drawn.

FU JINGYAN
Then I'll go breathe somewhere else.

He leaves. Fu Mother stares at the bracelet on the table, identical to the one in the portrait's wrist.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

FU JINGYAN watches condensation drip down his glass. The door crashes open.

BAI XINTONG (22, blood on her cheek, fire in her eyes) stumbles in, clutching the scroll. She crashes into his table. Their bracelets click together, magnetic.

BAI XINTONG
Sorry - I need to -

Their eyes meet. The scar above her eyebrow - he's seen it on the Woman In Red, bleeding from a thorn. He catches her as she reels, and for the first time in eighteen years, his fingers tremble.

title: I Teamed Up With My Ex-Wife (Episode 1)
description: A successful painter is framed by his brother-in-law after his father-in-law's suicide, leading to his wife's vow for revenge.
context:
Title: I Teamed Up With My Ex-Wife (Episode 1)
Description: A successful painter is framed by his brother-in-law after his father-in-law's suicide, leading to his wife's vow for revenge.

INT. VILLA - DAY

A television news broadcast is playing.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Allegations of securities fraud against Song Group President Song Tingchen continue to mount. Sources confirm illegal capital raising and manipulated stock trades through controlled accounts.

SONG TINGCHEN watches the news on TV expressionlessly. His photo is displayed on the screen. He picks up a rope hanging from the ceiling, ties a knot, and puts it around his neck.

He stands on a box, closes his eyes with a pained expression, then kicks the box away. His body hangs in the air.

Suddenly, a young woman, SONG WAN, rushes in.

SONG WAN
(screaming hysterically)
Dad! Dad! Dad!

SONG WAN kneels on the ground, holding SONG TINGCHEN who is now lying on the floor, crying bitterly.

SONG WAN
(sobbing)
Dad! Dad, look at Wanwan! You can't leave Wanwan alone! I've already thought of a solution! Dad!

The TV news continues.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
According to reliable sources, it was Song Group's son-in-law Wen Cheng who exposed the company's wrongdoings. In 2018, Wen Cheng married Song Wan, the only daughter of Song Group. After marriage, his career flourished. As one of Yun City's top ten outstanding painters, Wen Cheng is now worth over a hundred million.

SONG WAN stops crying upon hearing the news. She looks up in shock, her eyes filled with disbelief and rage.

SONG WAN
(through gritted teeth)
Wen Cheng... I will make you pay with blood.

EXT. CEMETERY - NIGHT

Heavy rain pours down with thunder rumbling. SONG WAN, dressed in black and wearing sunglasses, stands before a tombstone. A BODYGUARD holds an umbrella over her.

SONG WAN
(to the tombstone)
Dad, rest assured. I will make Wen Cheng suffer a thousand cuts. Bring Wen Cheng to me! I want him to kneel before my father's grave and admit his guilt!

Two BODYGUARDS drag WEN CHENG over, soaking wet and covered in mud, forcing him to kneel on the ground.

SONG WAN
Wen Cheng, do you know? Your face used to be my favorite thing about you. But now, seeing your face makes me feel nothing but disgust! I hate myself for marrying you, for sponsoring you and making you famous! People like you should crawl in the gutter for the rest of your life and never rise again!

WEN CHENG
(weak)
Wanwan, Wanwan, it really wasn't me who betrayed Dad.

SONG WAN
But my father is already dead! I have no father anymore! Even my mother had a stroke because of you and is hospitalized! You've destroyed my family like this, how long will you keep making excuses!

WEN CHENG
At that time, Mom and I were following someone into the archive room. She had the proof.
continuation:
INT. ARCHIVE ROOM CORRIDOR/ARCHIVE ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

WEN CHENG supports his mother SHEN LIZHEN as they walk through the company corridor. She clutches a folder—Song Group's original audit reports.

WEN CHENG
Why is someone still here at this hour?

SHEN LIZHEN
Your father said these would clear him. We need the hard copies.

WEN CHENG
I'll go check.

WEN CHENG enters the archive room, which is in complete disarray. A MAN wearing a mask and hat appears from behind the door and strikes WEN CHENG on the back of the head with a club. WEN CHENG falls unconscious.

When WEN CHENG wakes up, he finds himself lying on the floor with a splitting headache. He exits the archive room and sees his mother collapsed in the corridor, the folder gone.

WEN CHENG
(panicking)
Mom! Mom! Mom, don't scare me! Mom, wake up! Mom!

The scene shifts to SONG WAN holding the unconscious SHEN LIZHEN.

SONG WAN
(anxiously)
Mom!

Another man, ZHENG YUCHUAN, appears.

ZHENG YUCHUAN
Wen Cheng, you gave the company's confidential information to the media, and now you want to harm your mother-in-law?

WEN CHENG
(at the computer, frantically)
It wasn't me! Wanwan, it wasn't me!

EXT. CEMETERY - NIGHT

Back to reality, ZHENG YUCHUAN walks to SONG WAN's side holding an umbrella.

WEN CHENG
(to SONG WAN)
That person pretended to be...

ZHENG YUCHUAN
(interrupting him)
Wen Cheng! You're still stubborn even at death's door. Do you take everyone for fools? A real man should own up to his actions!

SONG WAN
(to ZHENG YUCHUAN)
How did the matter I asked you to handle go?

ZHENG YUCHUAN
It's done. The famous painter Wen Cheng is suspected of smuggling famous paintings with a case value of up to one billion. That's enough to put our great painter away for ten years.

SONG WAN
Ten years isn't enough. I want him dead.

ZHENG YUCHUAN
Don't worry, he won't come out alive.

ZHENG YUCHUAN kicks WEN CHENG to the ground.

ZHENG YUCHUAN
(crouching down, to WEN CHENG)
Competing with me for Song Wan? You're not worthy!

ZHENG YUCHUAN takes out a knife and stabs it viciously into WEN CHENG's palm.

WEN CHENG
(screaming)
Ah!

ZHENG YUCHUAN
(sneering)
Still want to be a painter? In your next life, be an animal instead!

ZHENG YUCHUAN twists the knife forcefully, then pulls it out and stands up to leave. WEN CHENG lies in the mud in agony.

title: I Return to the 90s to Open a Hotpot Restaurant
description: A time-traveler buys a warm coat for his mother in 1990s, but gossip reveals a darker truth about his family loyalties.
context:
Title: I Return to the 90s to Open a Hotpot Restaurant
Description: A time-traveler buys a warm coat for his mother in 1990s, but gossip reveals a darker truth about his family loyalties.

INT. CLOTHING STORE - DAY

TIANHE walks into a bustling 1990s clothing store, glancing at the calendar: "1995."

TIANHE
Brother Zhang.

BROTHER ZHANG looks up from his newspaper.

BROTHER ZHANG
Tianhe! How's the hotpot restaurant?

TIANHE
Almost ready. Which coat is warmest?

BROTHER ZHANG
For your mother? These just came in.

Brother Zhang pulls out a black leather jacket and a red fleece coat. Tianhe's fingers trace the red fleece gently.

TIANHE
This one. Price?

BROTHER ZHANG
Thirty. Pure wool.

TIANHE
Perfect.

Tianhe pays, hugging the coat. He pulls out a notebook—"1995 Business Plan" visible.

TIANHE (V.O.)
Last timeline, Mom froze in rags. Not this time.

BROTHER ZHANG
Gift wrap?

TIANHE
She'll wear it home. Thanks.

Tianhe exits. Two customers approach the counter.

CUSTOMER 1
Always buying for his mother. Such a good son.

BROTHER ZHANG
(quietly, watching through window)
Last week his "mother" got a TV. My sister lives next door—she says his real mother wears newspapers in her shoes.

CUSTOMER 2
Maybe she needs it more?

BROTHER ZHANG
(shakes head)
The other mother. His real one hasn't seen him in a month.

CUSTOMER 1
(scoffing)
Another fool marrying the mistress and forgetting his own.
continuation:
EXT. VILLAGE STREET - DAY

TIANHE carries the coat and a bag labeled "Hotpot Spices." AUNTIE and AUNT notice.

AUNTIE
Tianhe! New supplies for your restaurant?

TIANHE
Mom's recipe. Getting it right this time.

AUNT
She must be proud.

TIANHE
She will be.

He walks on. The women's smiles fade.

AUNTIE
(quietly)
"Mom." He calls that woman Mom now.

AUNT
His real mother eats plain congee while he feeds them meat.

AUNTIE
(spitting)
Money makes you blind.

EXT. TIANHE'S FAMILY HOUSE - DAY

TIANHE approaches a modest shack. His MOTHER (60s) tends vegetables in thin, patched clothes.

TIANHE
Mom.

MOTHER
(startled)
Tianhe! I told you not to—

TIANHE
Try this.

He helps her into the red coat. It fits perfectly. She touches it, disbelieving.

MOTHER
This costs too much...

TIANHE
The restaurant's first profit. And...

He pulls out a photo: a new sign reading "TIANHE'S HOTPOT - MOM'S ORIGINAL RECIPE."

TIANHE (CONT'D)
You're the only chef I want. Opening next week.

MOTHER
(eyes watering)
The neighbors said...

TIANHE
Let them talk. When they taste your broth, they'll know which mother I've been learning from.

Mother clasps his hand, looking at the photo.

MOTHER
My foolish son... always planning ahead.

FADE OUT.

title: The Fisherman's Regret
description: A legendary fishing champion's life of glory comes crashing down when his daughter reveals the dark truth behind his success—a wife driven to suicide by his gambling addiction. Given a second chance, he travels back in time to save his family.
context:
Title: The Fisherman's Regret
Description: A legendary fishing champion's life of glory comes crashing down when his daughter reveals the dark truth behind his success—a wife driven to suicide by his gambling addiction. Given a second chance, he travels back in time to save his family.

TITLE MONTAGE

EXT. RIVERSIDE - DAY

A series of quick cuts showing HUA ZHIGANG's fishing career.

SUPER: Age 35, Winner of the Fishing King Cup

SUPER: Age 60, Lifetime Achievement Award

Newspaper headlines flash by: "Zhigang Reels In Another Championship," "Fishing Legend's Midas Touch."

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

Elderly HUA ZHIGANG, dressed in a suit, walks with REPORTERS through a luxury hotel corridor.

REPORTER 1
Master Hua, your title streak is unprecedented. What drives you?

REPORTER 2
Twenty-five years without missing a tournament. That's real devotion.

HUA ZHIGANG
(smiling modestly)
My daughter arranged a celebration. Let's discuss this later.

His daughter DUODUO (25) approaches, her expression unreadable.

HUA ZHIGANG
Duoduo.

DUODUO
Dad. Your surprise is waiting.

She leads him toward a door. He pushes it open. Funeral paper offerings swirl out.

INT. MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

The room is arranged as a funeral hall. A large portrait of ZHOU JINGSHU hangs above an altar. The banner reads: "In Deep Mourning of Zhou Jingshu."

HUA ZHIGANG
(stunned)
What is this?

DUODUO
You don't remember? Today's her death anniversary. Or did your trophy cabinet take up all the space in your memory?

HUA ZHIGANG
Duoduo, not today--

DUODUO
(her voice rising)
She hanged herself because you gambled away our lives! Every tournament bet, every "sure thing" that left us with nothing. You killed her as surely as if you'd tied that rope!

Reporters crowd the doorway, cameras flashing.

REPORTER 1
Mr. Hua, is your daughter's accusation true?

FLASHBACK MONTAGE
continuation:
EXT. RIVERSIDE - DAY (1999)

Young JINGSHU pleads with YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG (35). Baby DUODUO cries in a carrier nearby.

JINGSHU
The rent's due. Duoduo needs formula. We can't survive on your winnings that never come!

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
One more tournament. I've got a feeling--

JINGSHU
You always have a feeling! Meanwhile, our daughter--

He turns away, already dialing his bookie.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT (1999)

JINGSHU, exhausted, holds newborn DUODUO. She phones Hua Zhigang.

JINGSHU
Seven pounds, eight ounces. She's perfect.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG (O.S.)
(excitedly)
Eight pounds? That's tournament weight! Where'd you land her?

JINGSHU stares at the phone, then at her daughter.

EXT. VILLAGE ROAD - DAY (2000)

JINGSHU carries feverish three-year-old DUODUO along a dusty road.

JINGSHU
(into phone)
The clinic says it's serious. We need money now.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG (O.S.)
(yelling)
Fifteen pounds! I knew that spot was golden!

She disconnects, looking at her daughter's flushed face.

INT. OLD HOUSE - NIGHT (2000)

JINGSHU blocks the door, holding DUODUO's hand.

JINGSHU
If you walk out that door to place another bet, we're done. I mean it.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
You're bluffing.

He shoves past. Later, JINGSHU stands on a stool, a rope in her hands. Little DUODUO watches from the doorway.

LITTLE DUODUO
Mommy? What are you doing?

END FLASHBACK MONTAGE

INT. MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

DUODUO
(quietly, devastatingly)
You came home to her body. Then you went fishing the next day. For 25 years, I've waited for you to choose us. Just once.

HUA ZHIGANG
(gasping, clutching his chest)
Duoduo... I was wrong...

DUODUO
(voice breaking)
She used to say your memory was like a knot in ice—frozen shut. I hope you finally thaw.

HUA ZHIGANG collapses.

HUA ZHIGANG (V.O.)
If I could go back... I'd give it all up...

The room spins. Clocks rewind.

TIME REVERSAL

A calendar rapidly flips backward: 2024... 2005... 2000... 1999.

EXT. FISHING PLATFORM - DAY (1999)

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG jolts awake on a wooden dock, betting slips in his hand. The river is calm.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
(confused)
What...?

He suddenly remembers Jingshu's face. The rope. Duoduo's voice.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
(whispering)
The knot in ice...

He scrambles to his feet and sprints.

INT. OLD HOUSE - DAY (1999)

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG bursts through the door. JINGSHU stands at the threshold, holding baby DUODUO, startled. Alive.

She takes a step back from his wild eyes. He looks from her to their daughter.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
(breathless)
I'm home.

He sinks to his knees, overcome. She watches him, uncertain. Baby Duoduo gurgles.

FADE OUT.

Young JINGSHU pleads with YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG (35). Baby DUODUO cries in a carrier nearby.

JINGSHU
The rent's due. Duoduo needs formula. We can't survive on your winnings that never come!

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
One more tournament. I've got a feeling--

JINGSHU
You always have a feeling! Meanwhile, our daughter--

He turns away, already dialing his bookie.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT (1999)

JINGSHU, exhausted, holds newborn DUODUO. She phones Hua Zhigang.

JINGSHU
Seven pounds, eight ounces. She's perfect.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG (O.S.)
(excitedly)
Eight pounds? That's tournament weight! Where'd you land her?

JINGSHU stares at the phone, then at her daughter.

EXT. VILLAGE ROAD - DAY (2000)

JINGSHU carries feverish three-year-old DUODUO along a dusty road.

JINGSHU
(into phone)
The clinic says it's serious. We need money now.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG (O.S.)
(yelling)
Fifteen pounds! I knew that spot was golden!

She disconnects, looking at her daughter's flushed face.

INT. OLD HOUSE - NIGHT (2000)

JINGSHU blocks the door, holding DUODUO's hand.

JINGSHU
If you walk out that door to place another bet, we're done. I mean it.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
You're bluffing.

He shoves past. Later, JINGSHU stands on a stool, a rope in her hands. Little DUODUO watches from the doorway.

LITTLE DUODUO
Mommy? What are you doing?

END FLASHBACK MONTAGE

INT. MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

DUODUO
(quietly, devastatingly)
You came home to her body. Then you went fishing the next day. For 25 years, I've waited for you to choose us. Just once.

HUA ZHIGANG
(gasping, clutching his chest)
Duoduo... I was wrong...

DUODUO
(voice breaking)
She used to say your memory was like a knot in ice—frozen shut. I hope you finally thaw.

HUA ZHIGANG collapses.

HUA ZHIGANG (V.O.)
If I could go back... I'd give it all up...

The room spins. Clocks rewind.

TIME REVERSAL

A calendar rapidly flips backward: 2024... 2005... 2000... 1999.

EXT. FISHING PLATFORM - DAY (1999)

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG jolts awake on a wooden dock, betting slips in his hand. The river is calm.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
(confused)
What...?

He suddenly remembers Jingshu's face. The rope. Duoduo's voice.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
(whispering)
The knot in ice...

He scrambles to his feet and sprints.

INT. OLD HOUSE - DAY (1999)

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG bursts through the door. JINGSHU stands at the threshold, holding baby DUODUO, startled. Alive.

She takes a step back from his wild eyes. He looks from her to their daughter.

YOUNG HUA ZHIGANG
(breathless)
I'm home.

He sinks to his knees, overcome. She watches him, uncertain. Baby Duoduo gurgles.

FADE OUT.

title: I'm Busy Farming in the Cold Palace
description: A modern woman dies in a car accident and wakes up in the body of an empress who has been left to die in the Cold Palace of ancient China.
context:
Title: I'm Busy Farming in the Cold Palace
Description: A modern woman dies in a car accident and wakes up in the body of an empress who has been left to die in the Cold Palace of ancient China.

INT. COLD PALACE - DAY

A desolate chamber. Weeds crack the stone floor.

The camera pushes in. CHUN TAO weeps beside the bed where LU YUN SU lies still.

CHUN TAO
(sobbing)
Your Majesty... please don't leave us!

A EUNUCH enters with two SUBORDINATES, faces impassive.

CHUN TAO
(pleading)
Your Majesty!

The SUBORDINATES approach the bed.

CHUN TAO
(blocking them)
Stop! She is Prime Minister Lu's legitimate daughter—the Empress! The seven-day rite isn't complete!

EUNUCH
(disdainfully)
Move.

The EUNUCH pushes CHUN TAO aside.

EUNUCH
The Lu family committed treason. She never saw His Majesty's face. What Empress?

CHUN TAO
(defiant)
Even one day crowns you forever!

EUNUCH
In the Cold Palace, forever is just another corpse.

The EUNUCH gestures. LU YUN SU'S fingers twitch. He jerks back, tripping over a clay pot.

EUNUCH
(terrified)
She... she lives!
continuation:
He peers at the bed. LU YUN SU'S eyes open. She sits up.

EUNUCH
(shrieking)
Ghost!

The EUNUCH and SUBORDINATES flee.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Help! Help!

LU YUN SU sits up, dazed. Her head pounds. Images of a car accident flash through her mind.

MALE VOICE (V.O.)
Miss? Stay with me!

FEMALE VOICE (V.O.)
Call an ambulance!

LU YUN SU
(internal monologue)
Where am I?

CHUN TAO
(tentative)
Mistress?

Realizing LU YUN SU lives, CHUN TAO rushes to her, weeping.

CHUN TAO
You breathe! Oh gods, you breathe!

LU YUN SU
(disoriented)
Your... Majesty?

She glances down at her ancient robes, then around the room. Her gaze fixes on the fallen pot and its withered herb sprout.

LU YUN SU
(to herself)
Impossible...

LU YUN SU'S eyes widen in shock.

FADE OUT.

title: My Undercover Life in Ancient Times - The Tale of Lu Ding
description: A modern man accidentally travels back in time to ancient China and finds himself caught up in a revolutionary plot to infiltrate the palace.
context:
Title: My Undercover Life in Ancient Times - The Tale of Lu Ding
Description: A modern man accidentally travels back in time to ancient China and finds himself caught up in a revolutionary plot to infiltrate the palace.

INT. SWIMMING POOL - NIGHT

XIAO BAO mops the pool deck after hours. TWO WOMEN in bathing suits walk past, chatting.

One of the WOMEN suddenly spots him near a decorative fountain and screams.

WOMAN
(terrified)
Help! Intruder!

XIAO BAO startles, drops his mop. It strikes a hidden switch on the fountain base. A MECHANICAL WHIRR. The fountain splits open, revealing an ANCIENT BRONZE MIRROR.

XIAO BAO
What the—

He reaches for it, trips on the wet floor, and falls. As he collides with the mirror, BLINDING LIGHT engulfs the screen.

INT. QIANKUN HALL - NIGHT

XIAO BAO lies on cold stone floor. TORCHES flicker. MEN in ancient costumes hold torches, standing with serious expressions. Plaque above reads "Qiankun Hall." Banners reading "Overthrow Qian, Restore Zhou" and "Restore the Great Zhou" hang in front of the hall.

CHEN JINBEI stands before the crowd, speaking passionately.

CHEN JINBEI
The Qian Emperor's tyranny ends now! Qiankun Hall will restore the Great Zhou!

XIAO BAO scrambles up, patting himself in disbelief.

XIAO BAO (V.O.)
This isn't a set... this is real.

MEMBER A
(whispering to XIAO BAO)
Xiao Bao! Keep your voice down!

MEMBER B
(pointing at CHEN JINBEI)
Chen Jinbei, leader of Qiankun Hall.

MEMBER A
Today we're selecting the two hundred and fiftieth hero to go undercover in the palace.

MEMBER B
Two hundred and forty-nine have fallen. Keep your head down.

CHEN JINBEI
(shouting)
continuation:
Complete the great cause!

The crowd retreats, no one daring to come forward.

XIAO BAO (V.O.)
They think I'm Xiao Bao. According to history, Xiao Bao volunteers. But 249 people died. I'm not sticking my neck out.

CHEN JINBEI
Good! We'll do it the old way.

XIAO BAO (V.O.)
I'm a college student. I've got cheat codes. I know the plot. I'll grab a chair and sit this out.

Music plays. Everyone begins playing musical chairs. The music stops. Everyone has found a seat except XIAO BAO, who stands there dumbfounded.

XIAO BAO (V.O.)
(stunned)
Damn. Even ancient China is this competitive.

CHEN JINBEI
Hero, wait.

CHEN JINBEI walks up to XIAO BAO and excitedly grabs his shoulders.

CHEN JINBEI
In our Qiankun Hall, the previous two hundred and forty-nine palace undercover agents were all chosen by lottery. Today, finally, a hero has emerged!

XIAO BAO
(helplessly)
Please, there's been a mistake—

WANG CHUNHUA (V.O.)
Let him go!

A woman in red clothes with elaborate makeup—WANG CHUNHUA—walks in, waving a fan.

CHEN JINBEI
(warily)
State your business.

WANG CHUNHUA
Wang Chunhua of Yihong Brothel. You'd best remember my name.

XIAO BAO sees WANG CHUNHUA, his eyes light up with impossible recognition.

XIAO BAO
(surprised)
Mom?

Both WANG CHUNHUA and CHEN JINBEI freeze.

title: The Lin Family Turmoil
description: A man is falsely accused of theft by his wife's family, leading to a confrontation that reveals deep-seated prejudice and ultimately prompts him to demand a divorce.
context:
Title: The Lin Family Turmoil
Description: A man is falsely accused of theft by his wife's family, leading to a confrontation that reveals deep-seated prejudice and ultimately prompts him to demand a divorce.

INT. LIN FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

The Lin family sits in tense silence. LIN XUEQIN seizes QIN CHUAN's wrist and pries a jade pendant from his hand.

QIN CHUAN
(struggling)
Xueqin, that's—

LIN XUEQIN slaps him hard across the face.

QIN CHUAN stares at her.

LIN XUEQIN
Sili's jade pendant? My God, Qin Chuan.

MOTHER LIN
(from the sofa, voice cold)
We welcomed you into this family. This is how you repay us?

QI SILI
(leaning forward)
There's no need for this, Brother-in-law. If you admired it, you could have asked.

QIN CHUAN
It's mine.

LIN XUEYAN
(incredulous)
Yours? I've been married to you for five years. Don't I know—

LIN XUEQIN
You have any idea what that's worth?

LIN XUEYAN
At least ten million.

QI SILI
(shaking his head)
And to think I trusted you.

CHENGCHENG
(loudly)
Enough! He's my dad!

QI SILI crosses to CHENGCHENG, crouching before him.

QI SILI
(gently)
Chengcheng, tell everyone again what you saw.

CHENGCHENG
But I don't—

LIN XUEQIN
It's all right, sweetie. Just tell the truth.

CHENGCHENG
(eyes darting)
I saw Dad... in Uncle Qi's room. He had something shiny.

LIN XUEYAN
(hissing)
How could you, with your child watching?

QIN CHUAN
(desperate)
continuation:
It was my father's. Our name is carved—

MOTHER LIN
An heirloom? (scoffs) You expect us to believe that?

She rises, shoving QIN CHUAN.

MOTHER LIN
You need to learn respect!

LIN XUEQIN
Sili, take that thing.

QI SILI reaches for the pendant, examining it.

QI SILI
(quietly)
Wait... this isn't from my collection.

LIN XUEYAN
What?

MOTHER LIN
Not yours?

QI SILI
The craftsmanship is exquisite. I assumed... but I've never seen this piece.

LIN XUEYAN
Then whose is it?

QIN CHUAN
The seal. It's been in my family for generations.

LIN XUEYAN takes the pendant, holds it to the light.

LIN XUEYAN
(surprised)
There really is—
(drops it)
Fine. Take it.

QIN CHUAN bends, retrieves the pendant, wipes it.

QI SILI
(smoothing his collar)
Perhaps... he was trying to impress us. It happens when people feel... out of place.

MOTHER LIN
A poor man putting on airs—how pathetic.

LIN XUEYAN
I can't believe you'd go this far.

QIN CHUAN
(lifting his head, eyes hollow)
Is this really what you think of me?

LIN XUEYAN
What was I supposed to think? You've been so... embarrassed lately.

QIN CHUAN
(bitter smile)
Yes. I'm embarrassing. I have nothing more to say.

He stands, picks up his jacket.

QIN CHUAN
(calmly)
Lin Xueyan. I want a divorce.

title: My Mother's Life-Saving Money Became My Sister-in-Law's Dowry
description: A daughter witnesses her family torn apart when her brother diverts their mother's surgery funds for his girlfriend's demands, leading to tragic consequences.
context:
Title: My Mother's Life-Saving Money Became My Sister-in-Law's Dowry
Description: A daughter witnesses her family torn apart when her brother diverts their mother's surgery funds for his girlfriend's demands, leading to tragic consequences.

INT. FUNERAL PARLOR ENTRANCE - DAY

ZHOU XIAOLIN, dressed in white with a red scarf, holds an urn with a sorrowful expression, walking slowly.

ZHOU XIAOLIN (V.O.)
In this small box lies my mother. From now on, I have no mother. The culprit behind all this is my own brother.

ON SCREEN: SEVEN DAYS AGO

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

A door plate reads "Ward 403."

Inside the ward, MOTHER WANG CHUNFANG lies in bed. Daughter ZHOU XIAOLIN and son ZHOU XIAOFENG are at her bedside caring for her.

ZHOU XIAOLIN gently wipes MOTHER's frail hands with a warm towel. The monitor's steady beep fills the sterile room.

WANG CHUNFANG
You both took time off... your bosses won't be happy.

ZHOU XIAOLIN
The only boss I answer to right now is you, Mom.

ZHOU XIAOFENG sits peeling a pear, the ribbon falling in one continuous spiral.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
Chemo numbers were good today. One more surgery. That's all.

WANG CHUNFANG stares at the ceiling, her fingers worrying the blanket's edge.

WANG CHUNFANG
That house... your father built it with his own hands.

ZHOU XIAOLIN exchanges a glance with her brother.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
(quietly)
It's just wood and concrete, Mom. You're the real home.

He pats his jacket pocket, a faint card-shaped bulge, then squeezes his mother's shoulder.

WANG CHUNFANG
(turning away)
I'm so tired, children.

ZHOU XIAOLIN
Then rest. We'll be here when you wake up.

Mother's breathing steadies into sleep. The siblings share a moment of fragile hope.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
I'll handle the paperwork.

He exits. Xiaolin stays, holding mother's hand.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

ZHOU XIAOFENG rounds the corner, running a hand through his hair. LIU FEIFEI sits slumped in a plastic chair, a bruise blooming across her cheekbone.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
Feifei.

She flinches, then seizes his wrist with desperate strength.

LIU FEIFEI
Xiaofeng. They'll kill him. They'll really kill him.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
(trying to pull away)
Slow down. Who?

LIU FEIFEI
My brother. The loan sharks. He used our parents' shop as collateral. If I don't bring them 600,000 by tomorrow...

She chokes on a sob. Zhou Xiaofeng goes very still.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
600,000.

LIU FEIFEI
(pleading)
Just a loan. Just for a month. I'll pay it back, I swear. My brother's life, Xiaofeng. They'll take his life.

ZHOU XIAOFENG stares at the bank card in his hand. Then at the ward door. Then back at Feifei's tear-streaked face.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
(whispering)
One month.

He hands it to her. She clutches it to her chest.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

ZHOU XIAOLIN wakes with a start, alone in the darkened ward. A NURSE stands nearby, chart in hand.

ZHOU XIAOLIN
Where's my mother?

NURSE
Emergency transfer to ICU an hour ago. Her son signed the forms. Said there were... complications with payment.

Xiaolin's phone buzzes. A bank notification: "Transfer of 600,000 yuan approved."

Her hand begins to tremble holding the phone. She looks at the empty bed.

BACK TO:

INT. FUNERAL PARLOR ENTRANCE - DAY

ZHOU XIAOLIN's knuckles whiten around the urn.

ZHOU XIAOLIN (V.O.)
He sold our past to buy her future. Then he sold our mother's future to pay for her past. The price was the same. The math was perfect. The tragedy was simple.

My brother. The loan sharks. He used our parents' shop as collateral. If I don't bring them 600,000 by tomorrow...

She chokes on a sob. Zhou Xiaofeng goes very still.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
600,000.

LIU FEIFEI
(pleading)
Just a loan. Just for a month. I'll pay it back, I swear. My brother's life, Xiaofeng. They'll take his life.

ZHOU XIAOFENG stares at the bank card in his hand. Then at the ward door. Then back at Feifei's tear-streaked face.

ZHOU XIAOFENG
(whispering)
One month.

He hands it to her. She clutches it to her chest.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

ZHOU XIAOLIN wakes with a start, alone in the darkened ward. A NURSE stands nearby, chart in hand.

ZHOU XIAOLIN
Where's my mother?

NURSE
Emergency transfer to ICU an hour ago. Her son signed the forms. Said there were... complications with payment.

Xiaolin's phone buzzes. A bank notification: "Transfer of 600,000 yuan approved."

Her hand begins to tremble holding the phone. She looks at the empty bed.

BACK TO:

INT. FUNERAL PARLOR ENTRANCE - DAY

ZHOU XIAOLIN's knuckles whiten around the urn.

ZHOU XIAOLIN (V.O.)
He sold our past to buy her future. Then he sold our mother's future to pay for her past. The price was the same. The math was perfect. The tragedy was simple.

title: I Would Brave Thorns for You
description: A powerful CEO returns to his homeland after fifteen years to finally reunite with his long-lost younger sister, whose token has been discovered at a nightclub.
context:
Title: I Would Brave Thorns for You
Description: A powerful CEO returns to his homeland after fifteen years to finally reunite with his long-lost younger sister, whose token has been discovered at a nightclub.

INT. LAWN - DAY

SU YE descends from a helicopter, his composure absolute. A SUBORDINATE bolts forward, intercepting him.

MEN IN BLACK
Welcome back, President Su!

SUBORDINATE
(catching his breath)
Sir—the young miss's token. Platinum Bar.

The Subordinate extends a photograph. Su Ye's gloved fingers hesitate a millisecond before taking it.

SU YE (V.O.)
Ranran's whistle. I'd know it in my sleep.

SU YE
(to himself)
Fifteen years...

His jaw tightens imperceptibly.

SU YE
Mobilize everyone. And wake my brothers.

SUBORDINATE
All five, sir?

SU YE
Every single one. We bring her home tonight.

INT. OUTSIDE OPERATING ROOM - DAY

SU QI scrubs his hands at a sink, the water running red. He shuts it off with deliberate calm.

SU QI
(to himself)
Thirty hours. Worth it.

He turns to find a NURSE holding his phone.

NURSE
Urgent call, Doctor Su. It's about the patient in three.

SU QI
Tell them I've resigned as chief.
(softly)
I'm needed elsewhere.
continuation:
INT. FILMING LOCATION - DAY

SU XUN emerges from a sea of screaming fans, flawless. His AGENT trails behind.

AGENT
The sequel's been moved up! We shoot tomorrow—

SU XUN
(putting on sunglasses)
Cancel it.

AGENT
Your career—!

SU XUN
(smiling coldly)
My sister's been found. That's my career now.
(to the fans)
Family emergency. The permanent kind.

INT. AUCTION HOUSE - DAY

The AUCTIONEER's voice cracks with excitement.

AUCTIONEER
Six hundred million! Do I hear—?

SU ZHUOZE's voice cuts through, unhurried.

SU ZHUOZE
One billion. For everything.

Silence. He leans into the light.

SU ZHUOZE
My sister shouldn't have to choose.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

SU LIN stands in a corridor of unconscious security personnel, adjusting his cufflinks.

SU LIN
(into phone)
Platinum Bar. Ownership transfer. Tonight.

He pockets the phone, addressing the groaning man at his feet.

SU LIN
Apologies for the mess.
(smoothly)
Family business. You understand.

INT. CAR - DAY

SU ZHE holds a creased photograph, his thumb wearing through the corner. The city blurs past.

ASSISTANT
Sixth Young Master... Miss Feifei's birthday. Platinum Bar. She's—persistent.

SU ZHE
(folding the photo with care)
Tell her I'm coming.
(quietly)
And that I'll be taking someone far more important with me.

title: Battle for the Stone of Penglai Island
description: When a massive deposit of combustible ice is discovered on Penglai Island, nations compete to claim it under new Earth Alliance rules, but Daxia's champion betrays them at the last moment.
context:
Title: Battle for the Stone of Penglai Island
Description: When a massive deposit of combustible ice is discovered on Penglai Island, nations compete to claim it under new Earth Alliance rules, but Daxia's champion betrays them at the last moment.

INT. DAXIA COMMAND CENTER - DAY

A command center filled with futuristic technology. In the center is a massive throne where the NATIONAL LEADER sits. A FEMALE HOST stands at the front, facing the camera to deliver a broadcast.

FEMALE HOST
Urgent update from Penglai Island—combustible ice reserves confirmed in the trillion-ton range. Under Earth Alliance's new Protocol Seven, the nation that secures the Island Heart Stone claims full extraction rights. No appeals, no negotiations.

NATIONAL LEADER
(seriously)
The Western coalitions are mobilizing their augmented champions. We will not yield.

The NATIONAL LEADER turns to ELDER SITU.

NATIONAL LEADER
Elder Situ, confirm our team status.

ELDER SITU
Reporting—final selection complete. Broadcasting encrypted feeds.

ELDER SITU points forward, and a massive holographic screen lights up.

EXT. WILDERNESS - NIGHT

The holographic screen displays the scene. Moonlight reveals ZHOU ZHIRUO moving through mist, twin blades flashing as she silently dismantles three training drones. No wasted motion.

MALE COMMENTATOR (V.O.)
Zhou Zhiruo... Sutian Sect's living shadow. First field deployment in three years. This commitment speaks volumes.

INT. DAXIA COMMAND CENTER - DAY

A FEMALE ROBOT steps forward.

FEMALE ROBOT
Second candidate initializing.

INT. QIN LAN'S HOME - DAY

The second holographic screen lights up. QIN LAN cradles her sleeping infant while brewing herbs. The baby stirs—fever. She touches its forehead; green light flows from her fingertips. The fever breaks.

MALE COMMENTATOR (V.O.)
The Medical Saint... I thought maternal leave was mandatory for Class-A assets.

Suddenly, the door breach alarm flashes. A training drone slams through the window. QIN LAN shields the infant with her body, her free hand projecting a green ward that catches the debris mid-air.

QIN LAN
My child is here.
continuation:
INT. DAXIA COMMAND CENTER - DAY

MALE COMMENTATOR
Two specialists already. The third?

FEMALE ROBOT
(pointing to the third screen)

EXT. WASTELAND - DAY

On the third screen, SU KEKE materializes in a pink-tinted wasteland, her cannon already firing. She doesn't aim—she predicts. Each blast hits a moving target a second before it reaches cover.

FEMALE COMMENTATOR (V.O.)
Su Keke. The Ghost Gunner. Zero public sightings, hundred percent mission success.

MALE COMMENTATOR (V.O.)
Assassin, healer, shooter. We're fielding an atypical roster.

SU KEKE catches a spent casing and pockets it like a souvenir.

SU KEKE
One for the collection.

INT. DAXIA COMMAND CENTER - DAY

NATIONAL LEADER
(dissatisfied)
Where is our anchor? Where is Ye Tianchen?

ELDER SITU
National Leader, the God of War was—

A SOLDIER rushes in, data-slate trembling.

SOLDIER
Report! God of War Ye's shuttle just docked at Wo Nation's command carrier. His transponder... it's broadcasting their encryption now.

Everyone is shocked. The holographic screens flicker.

ELDER SITU
(in disbelief)
His loyalty protocols... how?

The NATIONAL LEADER stands up, expression angry but resolute.

NATIONAL LEADER
The competition proceeds. We'll field four champions. Daxia doesn't retreat.

ELDER SITU
Our AI model can extrapolate a substitute from behavioral matrices. It's... unconventional.

NATIONAL LEADER
(nodding)
Show me.

Staff members begin typing rapidly on keyboards, and the holographic screen displays "AI SEARCHING."

EXT. LONGSU MOUNTAIN - DAY

The AI search ends, and the screen shows an ancient-style courtyard. ZHAO FAN lounges in a modified gaming chair, holographic battle maps orbiting him like satellites. He guides them with idle gestures, eyes never leaving his phone.

ZHAO FAN
(to his phone)
Northwest ridge, fall back. Spring the trap at grid seven.

INT. DAXIA COMMAND CENTER - DAY

MALE COMMENTATOR
(dumbfounded)
That interface... he's logged into our tactical network?

EXT. LONGSU MOUNTAIN - DAY

ZHAO FAN notices the surveillance camera and smirks, then turns back to his phone.

ZHAO FAN
(to his phone)
Little sister, run the Penglai simulation. Priority alpha.

A female voice comes from the phone: "Already loading, strategist."

ZHAO FAN smiles smugly and makes a kissing expression toward the phone screen.

title: A Son's Regret
description: A man prioritizes his father-in-law's birthday over his dying father's final wish, leading to devastating consequences.
context:
Title: A Son's Regret
Description: A man prioritizes his father-in-law's birthday over his dying father's final wish, leading to devastating consequences.

INT. STUDY - DAY

XU CHENGQI anxiously answers the phone, turning away from the celebration outside.

XU CHENGQI
Mom? I can barely hear you—what's wrong?

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER (V.O.)
(strained)
Your father... hospital... hurry...

The call drops. Xu Chengqi stares at his phone, then heads for the door.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Balloons drift across the ceiling. The FATHER-IN-LAW, mid-70s, watches television in his birthday crown. LILIAN intercepts Xu Chengqi, her smile tightening.

LILIAN
Chengqi. Dad's cake is coming out. Where are you going?

XU CHENGQI
My father's in the hospital. That was my mother.

LILIAN
(glancing toward her father)
And we're in the middle of Dad's birthday. You promised him you'd be here.

XU CHENGQI
Lilian, this could be—he might not have long.

LILIAN
(quietly fierce)
My brother missed Dad's seventieth for a "work emergency." He cried for a week. I'm not doing that to him again. Not today.

XU CHENGQI
Please. Just let me go check—I'll be back in two hours.

LILIAN
If you walk out that door, don't bother coming back.

XU CHENGQI freezes. His hand on the doorknob. He looks back at his wife, then at his father-in-law. Slowly, he releases the knob and pulls out his phone.

XU CHENGQI
(into phone, voice hollow)
Mom. Tell Dad... I'll come tomorrow. For his birthday. First thing.

He ends the call.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER tries calling back. It goes to voicemail. She lowers the phone, defeated.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

XU CHENGQI returns to the table. The Father-in-Law studies him.

FATHER-IN-LAW
Change of plans?

XU CHENGQI
(quietly)
Family emergency. But it's... handled.

LILIAN and Xu Chengqi light candles. The Father-in-Law claps, alone.

LILIAN
(overly bright)
Make a wish, Dad!

ALL THREE
(singing, strained)
Happy birthday to you...

MONTAGE:

- In the living room, Lilian kisses her father's cheek as Xu Chengqi stares at his plate, the birthday song trailing off.
- In a crowded hospital corridor, XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER holds the phone to her husband's ear, tears streaming down her face.
- XU CHENGQI'S FATHER, oxygen mask fogging with each weak breath, hears the faint singing through the phone, his trembling hand clutching the blanket.

END MONTAGE.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER ends the call. The phone slips through her fingers. Her husband's eyes find hers.

XU CHENGQI'S FATHER
(whisper)
...Chengqi?

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER
(forcing a smile)
He's downstairs. Parking.

XU CHENGQI'S FATHER
The steamed buns... in the kitchen... he loved them... as a boy...

A final exhale. The heart monitor flatlines.

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER
(scream whisper)
Changgeng! You promised you'd wait—Chengqi's almost here!

FLASHBACK:

XU CHENGQI'S FATHER
Chengqi. My birthday wish... see you blow out the candles... like when you were small.

XU CHENGQI (V.O.)
I'll be there, Dad. I promise.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. OLD HOUSE MAIN HALL - DAY

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER arranges steaming buns before her husband's portrait—he's smiling in a field.

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER
Your birthday, Changgeng. Your son... he's...

She can't finish.

EXT. OLD HOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY

An OLD NEIGHBOR opens the gate as XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER emerges with a basket of buns, still warm.

A car screeches to a halt. XU CHENGQI leaps out, tie askew.

XU CHENGQI
Mom—how is he?

He sees the buns. The basket. The black cloth on her arm.

XU CHENGQI
(softly)
...Where's Dad?

She doesn't answer. The buns steam between them in the cold morning air.

title: Golden Valley Blind Box Auction
description: At an exclusive auction in Golden Valley, high-stakes bidders compete for a mysterious blind box, until a masked stranger makes a shocking entrance.
context:
Title: Golden Valley Blind Box Auction
Description: At an exclusive auction in Golden Valley, high-stakes bidders compete for a mysterious blind box, until a masked stranger makes a shocking entrance.

INT. AUCTION HALL - NIGHT

FAST CUTS: JACK (40s, sharp suit, subtle clown makeup) adjusts his bow tie; a WOMAN in obsidian silk cradles a white snake; DANCERS in golden masks perform hypnotic movements.

On stage, the AUCTIONEER (40s, crimson velvet gown) commands the microphone with practiced ease.

AUCTIONEER
Ladies and gentlemen, per Golden Valley tradition, our weekend mystery auction begins. One blind box, unlimited potential. Opening bid: one hundred million. Do I have one hundred?

Below stage, VANCE (50s, pinstriped suit, sweat on his collar) raises his paddle.

VANCE
One hundred million.

MAUGHAM (70s, white fedora, eyes like chipped flint) studies him from two seats over, voice a low rasp.

MAUGHAM
You're new here, son. This is my house.

JACK lounges in the back row, a razor-thin smile playing at his lips.

JACK
Not tonight.

JACK rises with languid precision, moving down the aisle.

JACK
Five hundred million.

An audible gasp ripples through the hall. VANCE goes pale.

MAUGHAM
(quietly, to his aide)
Wall Street Jack. I thought he was in Geneva.

VANCE
(stammering)
continuation:
That's... that's the man who shorted the entire Eastern market in one afternoon.

JACK reaches the stage lip, arms spreading like a conductor.

JACK
Half a billion. Anyone else?

The hall falls silent. VANCE sinks into his seat.

VANCE
Not me.

MAUGHAM
Not tonight.

JACK
(triumphant)
Then the box is mine.

AUCTIONEER
Five hundred million, once!

AUCTIONEER
Five hundred million, twice!

AUCTIONEER
Five hundred million, thri—

MAUGHAM
Wait.

The doors crash open. A MASKED MAN (golden dragon mask, tailored black on black) enters with a SILENT WOMAN (veiled, holding a silver briefcase).

MASKED MAN
One billion.

The room freezes. JACK's smile vanishes.

CLOSE-UP on MASKED MAN's eyes—cold, certain.

FADE OUT.

That's... that's the man who shorted the entire Eastern market in one afternoon.

JACK reaches the stage lip, arms spreading like a conductor.

JACK
Half a billion. Anyone else?

The hall falls silent. VANCE sinks into his seat.

VANCE
Not me.

MAUGHAM
Not tonight.

JACK
(triumphant)
Then the box is mine.

AUCTIONEER
Five hundred million, once!

AUCTIONEER
Five hundred million, twice!

AUCTIONEER
Five hundred million, thri—

MAUGHAM
Wait.

The doors crash open. A MASKED MAN (golden dragon mask, tailored black on black) enters with a SILENT WOMAN (veiled, holding a silver briefcase).

MASKED MAN
One billion.

The room freezes. JACK's smile vanishes.

CLOSE-UP on MASKED MAN's eyes—cold, certain.

FADE OUT.

title: Three Days Ago
description: A woman made a deal with a mysterious witch seven years ago to save the man she loves, betting her life that he would love her in return by the day he becomes the world's richest man.
context:
Title: Three Days Ago
Description: A woman made a deal with a mysterious witch seven years ago to save the man she loves, betting her life that he would love her in return by the day he becomes the world's richest man.

ON SCREEN: THREE DAYS AGO

INT. CITY NIGHT SCENE - NIGHT

Time-lapse photography of city traffic flowing through the streets, lights streaking like liquid gold.

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
Breaking news. Lu Jingchen, Chairman of Lu Group, with a fortune of three hundred billion dollars, ranks first on the world's richest list.

A black sedan stops. LU JINGCHEN exits, his expression cold and stern, surrounded by bodyguards.

INT. MENG WANQI'S HOME - DAY

MENG WANQI sits on the sofa, looking at news on her phone about Lu Jingchen becoming the richest man. A sad, knowing smile appears.

MENG WANQI
(whispering)
Jingchen... you've finally achieved your dream.

Her daughter XINGXING, wearing a beautiful princess dress, runs up to her.

XINGXING
Mommy, tonight I want to wear this pretty dress to see Daddy.

MENG WANQI
(fingers trembling on the phone)
He'll think you're the most beautiful thing he's ever seen.

XINGXING
Will he smile this time?

MENG WANQI
(kissing her head)
We have to believe he will.

MENG WANQI opens her arms. XINGXING runs over, and mother and daughter embrace.

Suddenly, the room's lighting turns red. The atmosphere becomes eerie.

WITCH (V.O.)
Meng Wanqi. The wheel has turned.

A WITCH wearing a black robe and wide-brimmed hat appears in the room.

MENG WANQI
(terrified, shielding Xingxing)
Not in front of her. Please.

WITCH
The bargain doesn't wait for children.

ON SCREEN: SEVEN YEARS AGO
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL - DAY

LU JINGCHEN lies in a hospital bed, his body and head wrapped in bandages, his expression pained.

A TELEVISION in the corridor shows: "LU CORPORATION: BANKRUPTCY."

Young MENG WANQI walks past, overhearing two NURSES.

NURSE A
Even if he survives, he'll never walk again. And with these debts...

NURSE B
Poor man. Lost everything.

Meng Wanqi's hand clutches a HEART-SHAPED LOCKET.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR (ILLUSION) - NIGHT

The surrounding environment turns an eerie red. The WITCH appears before MENG WANQI, shuffling TAROT CARDS.

WITCH
You'd give your life for a stranger's?

MENG WANQI
He's not a stranger.

WITCH
He will be. Draw.

MENG WANQI hesitantly takes a card.

WITCH
The Wheel. He rises, you fall—unless he chooses you at the peak. Seven years, Meng Wanqi. Seven years to make the richest man in the world love a woman he can't remember.

MENG WANQI
(firmly)
He will.

WITCH
Then pray he does. For your sake... and for the child you'll bear him.

INT. MENG WANQI'S HOME - PRESENT DAY

The WITCH stands before MENG WANQI, holding an HOURGLASS where sand flows upward instead of down.

WITCH
Three days remain on our wager. Does he know your real name yet? Does he remember how you met?

MENG WANQI
He's been... distracted. Building his empire.

WITCH
Empires don't love back. Tonight, his victory gala. I will be there. And when the clock strikes midnight...

Close-up of the WITCH's face, revealing a mysterious smile that promises nothing good.
