title: My Dad is the God of War
description: A legendary military commander must choose between his duty to the nation and his family when enemies attack while his wife is dying in the hospital.
context:
Title: My Dad is the God of War
Description: A legendary military commander must choose between his duty to the nation and his family when enemies attack while his wife is dying in the hospital.

EXT. MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

Rain pours down. A black Maybach speeds in, drifting to a stop on the wet pavement.

A formation of BODYGUARDS in black tactical gear stands at attention, umbrellas forming a silent corridor.

The DRIVER emerges and opens the rear door.

CHEN PING'AN steps out, civilian clothes beneath an open coat. He moves with unnatural stillness.

INT. BUILDING LOBBY - DAY

CHEN PING'AN enters, water dripping from his coat. The bodyguards remain outside.

TAI SUI waits near the elevator, holding a medical file.

TAI SUI
The specialist landed ten minutes ago.

CHEN PING'AN
(taking the file)
How long have you known?

TAI SUI
Three weeks. She made us promise not to tell you. The border situation...

CHEN PING'AN
I retire tomorrow. Officially.

TAI SUI
The Heaven-Supporting Hall doesn't have a retirement plan.

CHEN PING'AN
(wearily)
Find one.

A MESSENGER stumbles through the entrance, blood soaking through his shirt. He collapses against the security desk.

MESSENGER
The Ten have breached the capital shield. They're at the Gate.

CHEN PING'AN's phone rings. The screen shows: LANLAN - HOSPITAL.

INT. HOSPITAL - DAY

NURSES wheel QING HE down a corridor, CHEN LAN running alongside, holding her mother's hand.

Heart monitors scream. QING HE's fingers twitch.

QING HE
(struggling)
Don't... blame him...

CHEN LAN
(into phone)
Dad? It's Mom. You need to—
continuation:
INT. BUILDING LOBBY - DAY

CHEN PING'AN watches the messenger's blood pool on the marble floor. He answers.

CHEN PING'AN
(into phone)
Lanlan.

MESSENGER
(kneeling)
The President's protection detail is down. The city will fall in hours.

CHEN PING'AN
(quietly)
I know. I'm sorry.

CHEN LAN (V.O.)
(distant, hollow)
She's asking for you.

CHEN PING'AN looks at the medical file in his hand. At the messenger's blood. At Tai Sui's face.

CHEN PING'AN
(into phone)
Tell her I'll be there in twenty minutes.

He hangs up. Turns to Tai Sui.

CHEN PING'AN
The Gate is fifteen minutes away.

TAI SUI
Sir, you can't—

CHEN PING'AN
(handing him the file)
If I'm not at the hospital in thirty, give her this. Tell her I read every page.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - NIGHT

A crater in the city's financial district. Buildings sag like melted candles. At the center, CHEN PING'AN stands in ceremonial armor, etched patterns glowing faintly against the darkness.

The TEN surround him. Not soldiers. Something else. Their shadows move wrong.

CHEN PING'AN fights with economical violence. Each movement ends one of them. He takes wounds that would kill a normal man.

Last enemy down, he kneels, armor flickering, failing.

CHEN PING'AN
(barely a whisper)
Twenty minutes...

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

CHEN LAN sits outside the operating room, clutching her mother's wedding ring.

DOCTOR emerges, pulling off surgical gloves. The look says everything.

DOCTOR
My condolences. Four minutes ago.

CHEN LAN
(numb)
Thank you.

She stares at the ring. Doesn't cry. Not yet.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - MOMENTS LATER

CHEN PING'AN limps into the corridor, coat soaked with blood. He sees his daughter. The ring.

CHEN PING'AN
Lanlan...

CHEN LAN stands. Her face is blank.

CHEN LAN
She waited. Kept asking if you were parking the car.

CHEN PING'AN takes a step forward.

CHEN LAN
(cold, precise)
You smell like gunpowder.

CHEN PING'AN stops.

CHEN LAN
(screaming, sudden)
Four minutes! You couldn't be four minutes earlier?!

She slams the ring into his chest. It drops to the floor, rolling away.

CHEN LAN
(breaking)
Four minutes, Dad.

She slides down the wall, sobbing. CHEN PING'AN stands frozen, ring at his feet, his daughter's words echoing the same measurement that decided a nation's fate.

title: My 26-Year-Old Rich and Beautiful Female Boss
description: A former legendary assassin working as a security guard is reunited with a woman from his past, who reveals a shocking secret.
context:
Title: My 26-Year-Old Rich and Beautiful Female Boss
Description: A former legendary assassin working as a security guard is reunited with a woman from his past, who reveals a shocking secret.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

A red sports car brakes hard, stopping with controlled precision at the hotel entrance.

VOICE (V.O.)
Ruyan, your target is the legendary Lord of Canglong Hall. He cleared the Western territories alone. Don't underestimate him.

LIU RUYAN, in a black fitted dress, exits the car. Every movement is intentional.

LIU RUYAN
(into her earpiece)
No one leaves my net.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

CHEN FAN stands at the window, wine glass in hand, shoulders tense.

LIU RUYAN enters, closing the distance between them with quiet steps.

LIU RUYAN
Sir. Room service.

CHEN FAN
(without turning)
Stop. Remove your clothes.

LIU RUYAN
Sir prefers directness.

She unzips her leather skirt, letting it drop. The silk slip beneath is simple. She steps out of her heels.

LIU RUYAN
Satisfied?

CHEN FAN
Come here.

She approaches. Her hands settle on his shoulders, beginning the practiced rhythm of a massage.

LIU RUYAN
Let me ease your tension.

Chen Fan moves—fast. A hand towel becomes a restraint. They fight in controlled bursts, each move precise. He has her pinned.

CHEN FAN
You're skilled. But I'm leaving tomorrow. Don't follow.

LIU RUYAN
And if I want more?

She reverses, her kiss sudden. He meets it.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - LATER

CHEN FAN secures LIU RUYAN's wrists and ankles with cloth strips. He places his coat over her.

CHEN FAN
(to himself)
Better this way.

He leaves. Ruyan watches him go, her expression unreadable.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

ZI HUANG storms from the elevator with TWO MEN.

SUBORDINATE
The sedative should be hitting her now. She can't have gone far.

ZI HUANG
She has my father's files. Find her.

Meanwhile, LIU RUYAN (SONG YUWEI) has freed herself. In a maid uniform now, she moves down the corridor, fighting the drug's effects. She touches her neck—her jade pendant is still there. She ducks into a room.

INT. ANOTHER HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

SONG YUWEI enters. CHEN FAN lies unconscious on the bed, breathing steady. She moves to his side, checks his pulse. Stable.

She looks at the silver hip flask on the nightstand—his. She'd palmed it during their fight.

She leans down, kisses him. His eyes open, unfocused.

CHEN FAN
(groggy)
Head... spinning...

SONG YUWEI
(softly)
I know. I found you.

They come together, the room dissolving.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - MORNING

Dawn. CHEN FAN wakes first. He studies SONG YUWEI sleeping beside him, sees the jade pendant at her throat. He removes it carefully, replaces it with his silver dragon ring.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
Five years running, and I still fell.

He takes a small gold earring from her ear.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
Fair trade.

EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE SECURITY BOOTH - DAY

ON SCREEN: FIVE YEARS LATER

CHEN FAN, in a security uniform, shows the gold earring to TWO COLLEAGUES.

CHEN FAN
Song Yuwei's.

SECURITY CAPTAIN
Sure. And I'm the CEO's husband. Let it go, Chen.

SECURITY COLLEAGUE
Yeah, man. She's in the penthouse, you're in the booth. Reality check.

Chen Fan pockets the earring, says nothing.

A Rolls-Royce stops. SONG YUWEI steps out, sunglasses on, holding a LITTLE GIRL's hand.

SECURITY CAPTAIN
Eyes forward. President Song.

SONG YUWEI removes her sunglasses. Her gaze locks with Chen Fan's. No surprise. Recognition.

The LITTLE GIRL pulls free, runs to the booth.

DAUGHTER
Daddy!

She crashes into Chen Fan's legs. He doesn't move, doesn't breathe.

Song Yuwei walks toward them, inevitable.

SONG YUWEI
(to Chen Fan)
The files were decrypted three months ago. I knew where you were.

She opens her hand. The silver dragon ring rests in her palm.

CHEN FAN
You waited.

SONG YUWEI
I needed to know you'd choose to stay.

She nods at their daughter.

SONG YUWEI
She needed to know her father came home willingly.

FADE OUT.

title: My Connections Span Three Realms
description: A God King, forced to live as a beggar for three years, must return money given to him by a kind woman before he can reclaim his true form.
context:
Title: My Connections Span Three Realms
Description: A God King, forced to live as a beggar for three years, must return money given to him by a kind woman before he can reclaim his true form.

EXT. MODERN PLAZA - DAY

A group of FLIGHT ATTENDANTS in uniform pull their luggage in neat formation across a plaza beneath a modern glass dome structure.

CUT TO:

A ragged, disheveled BEGGAR (GOD KING) lies lazily on a bamboo mat. In front of him is a white cloth painted with a Tai Chi Bagua diagram, bearing the words "My Fate is Mine, Not Heaven's" and "Donors Will Lose Their Fortune," with an empty bowl in the center.

The FLIGHT ATTENDANTS pass by. The LEAD FLIGHT ATTENDANT stops and looks at the beggar with disdain.

LEAD FLIGHT ATTENDANT
Arrogant bastard. Begging like he's royalty.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT B
Only the desperate would fall for it.

LEAD FLIGHT ATTENDANT
(to her colleagues)
Eyes forward. We're on a schedule.

The FLIGHT ATTENDANTS continue walking.

A young woman in a white business suit (XIAO LINGXIN) walks toward them, carrying a hospital envelope.

FLIGHT ATTENDANTS
(respectfully)
President Xiao.

XIAO LINGXIN gives a minimal nod, her gaze drawn to the beggar's sign. She walks over, takes out three hundred-yuan bills, and places them in the bowl.

XIAO LINGXIN
(to herself)
For Grandfather's luck. Not yours.

She taps the hospital envelope, then turns and leaves.

The BEGGAR yawns, stretches, and sits up. He sees the money and freezes.

ON SCREEN: The Three Years Are Up.

GOD KING
(shouting)
Old Jiang! Show yourself!

A white light flashes. An elderly man with white hair and beard, immortal in appearance (OLD JIANG), appears out of thin air, smiling at the GOD KING.

OLD JIANG
(teasing)
Found a reason to stay mortal?

GOD KING
continuation:
The vow is fulfilled. Restore my form.

OLD JIANG
(shaking his finger)
Three hundred yuan remain. You are not the poorest beggar.

GOD KING
(shocked)
That's—

OLD JIANG
(cutting in)
Money given freely becomes your asset. You must return it personally. Vow's law.

GOD KING
(breaking down)
I take from hundreds. I don't remember faces.

OLD JIANG
You command Heaven's clerks, Hell's scribes. One mortal soul should be simple.

GOD KING
(staring at the bills)
One who gave without wanting fortune.

The GOD KING picks up his wooden staff and strikes it forcefully on the ground.

GOD KING
(commanding)
All Earth Gods and Earth Goddesses of Jiangzhou, appear before me now!

God King!

The DEITIES immediately pull out tablets, their fingers flying across the screens as data stream effects swirl around them.

(giving a thumbs up)
Still commanding from a bamboo mat.

GOD KING
(leveled stare)
This mat taught me what my throne never did.

OLD JIANG's smile fades. He studies the God King with new eyes.

OLD JIANG
Then perhaps the lesson is complete.

A group of FLIGHT ATTENDANTS in uniform pull their luggage in neat formation across a plaza beneath a modern glass dome structure.

CUT TO:

A ragged, disheveled BEGGAR (GOD KING) lies lazily on a bamboo mat. In front of him is a white cloth painted with a Tai Chi Bagua diagram, bearing the words "My Fate is Mine, Not Heaven's" and "Donors Will Lose Their Fortune," with an empty bowl in the center.

The FLIGHT ATTENDANTS pass by. The LEAD FLIGHT ATTENDANT stops and looks at the beggar with disdain.

Arrogant bastard. Begging like he's royalty.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT B
Only the desperate would fall for it.

LEAD FLIGHT ATTENDANT
(to her colleagues)
Eyes forward. We're on a schedule.

The FLIGHT ATTENDANTS continue walking.

A young woman in a white business suit (XIAO LINGXIN) walks toward them, carrying a hospital envelope.

FLIGHT ATTENDANTS
(respectfully)
President Xiao.

XIAO LINGXIN gives a minimal nod, her gaze drawn to the beggar's sign. She walks over, takes out three hundred-yuan bills, and places them in the bowl.

XIAO LINGXIN
(to herself)
For Grandfather's luck. Not yours.

She taps the hospital envelope, then turns and leaves.

The BEGGAR yawns, stretches, and sits up. He sees the money and freezes.

ON SCREEN: The Three Years Are Up.

GOD KING
(shouting)

(teasing)
Found a reason to stay mortal?

GOD KING
The vow is fulfilled. Restore my form.

OLD JIANG
(shaking his finger)

GOD KING
(shocked)

OLD JIANG
(cutting in)
Money given freely becomes your asset. You must return it personally. Vow's law.

GOD KING

title: The General's Reincarnation
description: A dying general promises his beloved he will return. A thousand years later, she finally finds his reincarnation working as a delivery man.
context:
Title: The General's Reincarnation
Description: A dying general promises his beloved he will return. A thousand years later, she finally finds his reincarnation working as a delivery man.

INT. DA QIAN PALACE - NIGHT

Torches flicker across blood-stained marble. YUE YAO (20s, imperial robes soaked crimson) cradles YE CHEN's mutilated body.

YE CHEN
(whispering, blood on his lips)
The elixir... it's in my armor. For you.

YUE YAO
(fingers trembling)
What good is eternity without you?

YE CHEN
A general dies for his kingdom. A man... dies for his beloved. Next life... wait for me...

His hand falls from her cheek. YUE YAO's silent scream echoes.

She tears the elixir vial from his breastplate, smashes it, then clasps the YIN-YANG JADE PENDANTS around their necks.

YUE YAO
(voice breaking)
These pendants bound our souls once. They will again.

She kisses his forehead as the pendants begin to GLOW.

EXT. CITY STREET - DAWN

Rain slicks the pavement. YE CHEN (20s) jolts awake on his delivery scooter, hand clutching his chest. The YIN-YANG PENDANT hangs beneath his uniform, unnoticed.

He touches it, confused, then shakes off the déjà vu and revs the engine.
continuation:
INT. LIU CORPORATION - EXECUTIVE SUITE - MORNING

LIU RU YAN (YUE YAO, ageless eyes in a 30-year-old CEO) stands at the floor-to-ceiling window, half a jade pendant in her palm. Behind her, the city sprawls like a conquered kingdom.

ZHU QUE (30s, sharp suit) hovers by the door.

ZHU QUE
Mistress, the board is waiting. You've postponed three meetings already.

LIU RU YAN
(not turning)
They can wait another thousand years if need be.

She closes her fist around the pendant. It flickers, warm against her skin.

EXT. LIU CORPORATION - LOADING DOCK - CONTINUOUS

YE CHEN's scooter sputters to a stop at the service entrance. He checks the delivery bag: a modest BIRTHDAY CAKE and a wrapped gift.

INT. LIU CORPORATION - EXECUTIVE SUITE - CONTINUOUS

LIU RU YAN's pendant suddenly BLAZES, searing hot. She gasps, whirling.

LIU RU YAN
He's here.

ZHU QUE
Mistress?

LIU RU YAN
(yanking open the door)
The delivery entrance. Now!

EXT. LIU CORPORATION - SERVICE ELEVATOR - MOMENTS LATER

YE CHEN steps out, cake in hand. WANG QIAN (40s, executive assistant) blocks his path.

WANG QIAN
Service deliveries stay in the loading dock.

YE CHEN
It's her birthday. I'm her—

WANG QIAN
—personal life stays outside. Especially when Young Master Chu is here.

She glances toward the main office. Through the glass, CHU TIAN FAN (30s, tailored suit) opens a velvet box containing a dazzling necklace.

INT. LIU CORPORATION - EXECUTIVE SUITE - CONTINUOUS

CHU TIAN FAN
(lifting the necklace)
Ru Yan, the Heart of Ocean. Ten years to acquire. One moment to give.

He moves to clasp it around her neck.

EXT. LIU CORPORATION - SERVICE ELEVATOR - CONTINUOUS

YE CHEN sees the intimate gesture through the glass. His knuckles whiten around the cake box.

YE CHEN
(low)
Let me through.

WANG QIAN
Don't embarrass her.

YE CHEN shoulders past. The cake tilts. He catches it—barely—then pushes through the main doors.

INT. LIU CORPORATION - EXECUTIVE SUITE - CONTINUOUS

The necklace clicks shut as YE CHEN stumbles in, breathless, cake frosting smeared on his uniform.

YE CHEN
Ru Yan?

LIU RU YAN freezes. The pendant at her throat mirrors the one visible now through YE CHEN's unbuttoned collar, both pulsing in unison.

CHU TIAN FAN
(coldly)
Who let a delivery boy in here?

title: My Grandfather is a Hidden Boss
description: A corporate employee faces brutal humiliation from his boss and suffers a tragic accident that changes everything.
context:
Title: My Grandfather is a Hidden Boss
Description: A corporate employee faces brutal humiliation from his boss and suffers a tragic accident that changes everything.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

ZHAO CE storms into the office, termination papers in hand. He slams them on SHAO QINGYUN's desk.

ZHAO CE
What the hell is this?

ZHAO CE grabs the papers and slaps them against SHAO QINGYUN's chest.

ZHAO CE
One-point-two million. Gone. The company might as well raise a dog—at least it barks. You just give me migraines.

ZHAO CE throws the papers at SHAO QINGYUN.

SHAO QINGYUN
(pleading)
Please. My daughter's surgery. One more chance.

ZHAO CE
Just one chance?

SHAO QINGYUN
(nods)

ZHAO CE
(contemptuously)
Convince me. On your knees.

SHAO QINGYUN hesitates, glances at his daughter's photo, then kneels. He touches his forehead to the floor.

SHAO QINGYUN
(looking up)
Is that enough? I'll work all night—

ZHAO CE squats down and grabs SHAO QINGYUN's face, squeezing.

ZHAO CE
Even if you kowtow until your ancestors' graves crack, it's over. Get lost.

ZHAO CE shoves SHAO QINGYUN back. The papers scatter.

SHAO QINGYUN
(desperately)
Boss, I can still kowtow!

SHAO QINGYUN continues kowtowing forcefully, his forehead bleeding.

SHAO QINGYUN
Overtime, anything!

Two SECURITY GUARDS enter and drag SHAO QINGYUN out.

SHAO QINGYUN
(struggling)
I can still kowtow! I can do anything!
continuation:
EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE STREET - DAY

The SECURITY GUARDS throw SHAO QINGYUN onto the sidewalk. He staggers up, bleeding. Dazed, he stumbles toward the crosswalk.

ZHAO CE (V.O.)
The company can't afford a useless waste like you.

SHAO QINGYUN painfully lifts his head. A delivery VAN speeds toward him.

SOUND: Car horn and screeching brakes

The van clips SHAO QINGYUN. He cracks his head against the curb and lies unconscious, bleeding.

The DRIVER and PASSERSBY gather.

PASSERBY A
Call an ambulance!

PASSERBY B
He walked straight into traffic—

PASSERBY C
(on phone)
Emergency services! A man's been hit!

PASSERBY D
There's so much blood...

CLOSE-UP of SHAO QINGYUN lying in a pool of blood. A cracked jade pendant falls from his hand.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: My Paper Boyfriend
description: A writer wakes up to find her fictional male protagonist has come to life in her bedroom.
context:
Title: My Paper Boyfriend
Description: A writer wakes up to find her fictional male protagonist has come to life in her bedroom.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

A closed laptop sits on the desk. SU NANYAN, wearing pajamas, walks into the room, sits at the desk, and opens the computer.

SU NANYAN begins typing, text appearing on the screen.

ZHUANG YIN
Twenty-four. Finally seen.

SU NANYAN continues typing, her expression focused.

Cut to: SU NANYAN now wearing glasses, sitting comfortably on the bed typing on the computer, a sad smile on her face.

SU NANYAN (V.O.)
Same story. Different chapter.

SU NANYAN rests her chin on her hands, gazing at the computer screen, then sighs.

EXT. BEACH - DAY

Fast-cut montage. ZHUANG YIN, a handsome man, is surrounded by women on the beach. But his eyes are hollow. He plays volleyball mechanically. Sits alone with a drink, staring blankly.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Bright sunlight. SU NANYAN sleeps in bed. She turns over, her hand accidentally touching a man's body beside her. She jolts awake and sits up abruptly.

SU NANYAN
Ah!

ZHUANG YIN wakes with a start and sits up. SU NANYAN clutches the blanket tightly to her chest. They stare at each other in shock.

ZHUANG YIN
Who are you?

SU NANYAN
Why are you here?

ZHUANG YIN
What did you do to me?

SU NANYAN
I didn't! I was asleep!

ZHUANG YIN
Stop finishing my sentences! I'm trying to think!

He rubs his forehead, disoriented.
continuation:
ZHUANG YIN
The sheets are wrong. This isn't my penthouse.

SU NANYAN
You don't have a penthouse. You have descriptions.

ZHUANG YIN
What?

SU NANYAN
(whisper)
Zhuang Yin.

Flashback in SU NANYAN's mind of the novel content she wrote, but the words are dissolving.

SU NANYAN (V.O.)
Zhuang Yin, twenty-four. CEO. Perfect. Paper-thin.

ZHUANG YIN
You wrote "unable to take care of himself." I remember typing it. Your fingers on my hands.

SU NANYAN
That's impossible.

ZHUANG YIN
So is being cold. But I am. So is being scared. But I am.

He looks at her—really looks. Not as an intruder.

ZHUANG YIN
Make me real. Or make me gone. But don't leave me half-written.

SU NANYAN
I can delete the files.

ZHUANG YIN
Or write what happens next. Not the fantasy. The version where I learn.

She reaches slowly for the laptop. He watches, not stopping her.

SU NANYAN
"Zhuang Yin didn't know how to be human. So he asked."

She looks at him. The words hang between them.

ZHUANG YIN
(quiet)
I'm asking.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: My Internet Celebrity Neighbor
description: A woman is murdered by her neighbor's obsessed fan after being mistakenly identified as a provocative livestreamer due to deliberately wrong delivery addresses.
context:
Title: My Internet Celebrity Neighbor
Description: A woman is murdered by her neighbor's obsessed fan after being mistakenly identified as a provocative livestreamer due to deliberately wrong delivery addresses.

INT. DARK ALLEY - NIGHT

ZHOU YUE runs barefoot through the alley, clutching her phone.

ZHOU YUE
(into phone)
—Xiangyang Alley, send help—

She stumbles. The phone skids away.

CHEN ZEYU (30s, face twisted with possessive rage) closes in with a kitchen knife.

CHEN ZEYU
Parasite. Blocking me from Luna.

ZHOU YUE
Please—my ID, I can prove—

CHEN ZEYU grabs her hair. Slams her head against brickwork.

CHEN ZEYU
No more lies.

He raises the knife and stabs her.

ZHOU YUE lies on the ground, dying.

ZHOU YUE (V.O.)
My name is Zhou Yue. I died for a door number.

The camera pans to the corner of the alley, where LIN TINGTING (mid-20s, red dress) watches, phone in hand.

ZHOU YUE (V.O.)
Three weeks earlier.

INT. ZHOU YUE'S APARTMENT HALLWAY - NIGHT (THREE WEEKS EARLIER)

ZHOU YUE (work blazer, exhausted) opens her door to a DELIVERY GUY holding a stack of luxury parcels.

DELIVERY GUY
Miss "Lin Tingting"? Room 434?

ZHOU YUE
That's not my name.

Across the hall, LIN TINGTING's door opens. She's mid-livestream, phone camera on her face.

LIN TINGTING
(to stream)
Oops! Wrong door, guys!

She winks at Zhou Yue.

LIN TINGTING (CONT'D)
(to Delivery Guy)
She signs for me. My hero neighbor.

ZHOU YUE
(stiffly)
Fifth time this week.

LIN TINGTING
(to stream)
So sweet!

She takes the packages, closes her door.

ZHOU YUE stares at three other unclaimed boxes piled by her door. She pulls out her phone—her face photoshopped onto lingerie ads, comments flooding:

PHONE SCREEN
"luna's copycat neighbor... 434 Riverside"
continuation:
INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

ZHOU YUE exits the elevator, eyes on her phone—doxxed address, death threats.

ZHENG HEHUA (40s, expensive purse) blocks her path, brandishing a tablet.

ZHENG HEHUA
You! Luna the homewrecker!

ZHOU YUE
Ma'am, I'm not—

ZHENG HEHUA
My husband sent fifty thousand yuan to 434 Riverside!

She shoves the tablet at Zhou Yue—screenshots of Lin Tingting's stream, Zhou Yue's face blurred in the background.

ZHENG HEHUA (CONT'D)
Thinks I don't recognize you?

A crowd gathers. Phones rise.

ZHOU YUE
(pleading)
That's my neighbor's address—

ZHENG HEHUA's BROTHER (muscle, gold chain) grabs Zhou Yue's lanyard.

BROTHER
Your boss knows you're a camgirl?

He shoves her. She falls.

BROTHER
Let's see you go viral.

People start recording.

ZHOU YUE curls on the floor as kicks come. She locks eyes with a COLLEAGUE—who looks away.

ZHOU YUE (V.O.)
Because of this, I became a homewrecker. Lost my job. My life.

INT. DARK ALLEY - NIGHT (PRESENT)

ZHOU YUE's blood pools on concrete. Her phone lights up with one final notification:

PHONE SCREEN
"Luna is live: 'Goodbye parasites'"

From the corner, LIN TINGTING watches. Her own phone buzzes. A donation from Chen Zeyu:

PHONE SCREEN
"$50,000 - For protecting you"

LIN TINGTING's expression flickers. She pockets the phone and walks away.

ZHOU YUE's phone shows a final reminder: "Lease Renewal - Apt 434"

FADE TO BLACK.

LIN TINGTING (CONT'D)
(to Delivery Guy)
She signs for me. My hero neighbor.

ZHOU YUE
(stiffly)
Fifth time this week.

LIN TINGTING
(to stream)
So sweet!

She takes the packages, closes her door.

ZHOU YUE stares at three other unclaimed boxes piled by her door. She pulls out her phone—her face photoshopped onto lingerie ads, comments flooding:

PHONE SCREEN
"luna's copycat neighbor... 434 Riverside"

INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

ZHOU YUE exits the elevator, eyes on her phone—doxxed address, death threats.

ZHENG HEHUA (40s, expensive purse) blocks her path, brandishing a tablet.

ZHENG HEHUA
You! Luna the homewrecker!

ZHOU YUE
Ma'am, I'm not—

ZHENG HEHUA
My husband sent fifty thousand yuan to 434 Riverside!

She shoves the tablet at Zhou Yue—screenshots of Lin Tingting's stream, Zhou Yue's face blurred in the background.

ZHENG HEHUA (CONT'D)
Thinks I don't recognize you?

A crowd gathers. Phones rise.

ZHOU YUE
(pleading)
That's my neighbor's address—

ZHENG HEHUA's BROTHER (muscle, gold chain) grabs Zhou Yue's lanyard.

BROTHER
Your boss knows you're a camgirl?

He shoves her. She falls.

BROTHER
Let's see you go viral.

People start recording.

ZHOU YUE curls on the floor as kicks come. She locks eyes with a COLLEAGUE—who looks away.

ZHOU YUE (V.O.)
Because of this, I became a homewrecker. Lost my job. My life.

INT. DARK ALLEY - NIGHT (PRESENT)

ZHOU YUE's blood pools on concrete. Her phone lights up with one final notification:

PHONE SCREEN
"Luna is live: 'Goodbye parasites'"

From the corner, LIN TINGTING watches. Her own phone buzzes. A donation from Chen Zeyu:

PHONE SCREEN
"$50,000 - For protecting you"

LIN TINGTING's expression flickers. She pockets the phone and walks away.

ZHOU YUE's phone shows a final reminder: "Lease Renewal - Apt 434"

FADE TO BLACK.

title: I Brought My Daughter Local Chickens, She Held My Funeral
description: A father's tragic loss and his struggle to raise his daughter, only to face betrayal and heartbreak.
context:
Title: I Brought My Daughter Local Chickens, She Held My Funeral
Description: A father's tragic loss and his struggle to raise his daughter, only to face betrayal and heartbreak.

EXT. FUNERAL HALL - DAY

The sound of mournful horns fills the air. A banner reading "In Solemn Mourning" hangs in the hall. LU YONGCHANG and his daughter LU YUEXI, both dressed in mourning clothes, kneel on the ground.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
Filial sons and virtuous descendants, take your positions before the spirit.

Relatives and friends step forward one by one to bow.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
First bow! Second bow! Third bow!

VILLAGER A (V.O.)
Lu Yongchang's life is so bitter. He finally had a daughter in his old age, and now his wife is gone and his leg is broken. How will he manage in the days to come?

LU YUEXI has an injury on her forehead, freshly bandaged. She looks up at her grieving father.

LU YUEXI
Dad... is Mom in pain anymore?

LU YONGCHANG can no longer control his emotions. He holds his daughter and breaks down crying.

INT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

Flashback to the past.

LU YUEXI sits by a pile of bricks at the construction site, drawing seriously. A chicken feather is tucked behind her ear.

LU YONGCHANG, drenched in sweat, carries cement bags in the distance, his steps unsteady.

COWORKER
Payday!

COWORKER
Old Lu, stop carrying! Time to collect your pay!

LU YONGCHANG
You guys go first. I'll carry two more bags.

LU YONGCHANG struggles to lift another bag. After a few steps, his legs give out and the cement bag falls to the ground, breaking open.

The FOREMAN walks over, looking displeased.

FOREMAN
What's going on? Can you do the job or not? If not, leave!

LU YONGCHANG
(urgently)
I can do it. You can't fire me. I still have a daughter to support—and chicks to buy!

LU YONGCHANG struggles and uses all his strength to pick up the broken cement bag, walking forward with difficulty.

LU YUEXI
Dad!

LU YONGCHANG puts down the cement bag, a smile appearing on his weary face.

LU YONGCHANG
Ah, my daughter!

LU YUEXI
(holding up a drawing)
Look at the big house I drew. That's you and Mom, and me. And chickens.

LU YONGCHANG looks at the drawing, tears in his eyes, deeply moved.

LU YONGCHANG
My daughter draws so well!

The FOREMAN walks over.

FOREMAN
I've told you so many times not to bring kids here. Why did you bring your daughter again? What kind of father are you?

LU YONGCHANG
(smiling apologetically)
It won't happen again. Look how well my daughter draws.

FOREMAN
(handing over money)
Here's your pay.

LU YONGCHANG
(taking the money)
Thank you, boss.

FOREMAN
Hey, wait. Old Zhang!

A worker throws over a large checkered woven bag. The FOREMAN catches it and hands it to LU YONGCHANG.

FOREMAN
Was going to throw it away. Give it to your daughter.

LU YONGCHANG is stunned, then bows gratefully.

LU YONGCHANG
Thank you, boss!

LU YONGCHANG opens the bag. Inside are some old clothes.

LU YONGCHANG
(to his daughter)
Daughter, look, we have new clothes to wear.

LU YUEXI
Dad, you worked so hard.

His daughter reaches out her small hand to wipe the sweat and dust from LU YONGCHANG's face.

LU YONGCHANG
(moved)
Yuexi, Dad will definitely give you a good life in the future.
continuation:
EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

LU YONGCHANG lets Yuexi ride on his shoulders. Father and daughter happily sing as they walk down the road.

LU YONGCHANG & LU YUEXI
(singing)
The dark sky hangs low, bright stars follow along...

LU YUEXI
Dad, I'm hungry.

EXT. STEAMED BUN SHOP - DAY

LU YONGCHANG brings Yuexi to a steamed bun shop.

LU YONGCHANG
Boss, two buns please.

BUN SHOP OWNER
Coming right up! Here you go, little girl.

LU YONGCHANG
Okay, good.

As LU YONGCHANG pays, he notices a little girl in ragged clothes with a dirty face (LU QINGYAO) sitting not far away, staring at them longingly. A scar marks her temple.

BUN SHOP OWNER
Ah, that little beggar has no parents. She'll starve to death sooner or later. So pitiful.

LU YONGCHANG looks at the little beggar, then at the change in his hand, his face showing compassion and sudden recognition.

LU YONGCHANG
Give me two more steamed buns... make that two more buns.

BUN SHOP OWNER
Right away.

LU YONGCHANG takes the buns and walks over to the little beggar, crouching down.

LU YONGCHANG
Little girl.

He hands the buns to the little beggar. She takes them and devours them hungrily.

LU YONGCHANG turns to leave with Yuexi. The little beggar silently follows behind them.

LU YUEXI
Dad, this sister is so pitiful. But we barely have enough.

LU YONGCHANG stops, turns back to look at the little beggar, struggling internally. He finally crouches down and asks gently.

LU YONGCHANG
Little girl, would you like to come home with us?

The little beggar hesitates, then nods vigorously, a shy smile appearing on her face.

LU YONGCHANG
(to Yuexi)
Yuexi, from now on you have an older sister.

Yuexi smiles, though her eyes hold a flicker of uncertainty.

LU YONGCHANG holds Yuexi with one hand and Qingyao with the other. The three of them walk home together.

title: I'll Send My Father to the Top
description: A successful CEO returns home after years of absence, only to find his father in critical condition at a hospital.
context:
Title: I'll Send My Father to the Top
Description: A successful CEO returns home after years of absence, only to find his father in critical condition at a hospital.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

LIN TIAN (30s, power suit, dead eyes) moves through a gauntlet of BODYGUARDS. REPORTERS swarm, flashbulbs erupting like firecrackers.

REPORTER A
President Lin—first move as Zhao Group's head?

REPORTER B
They call you the ghost of the Elite Program. How'd you outlast a hundred rivals?

REPORTER C
Biotech patent—when's the drop?

Lin Tian's PR CHIEF intercepts, but his gaze is already a thousand miles away.

PR CHIEF
Tomorrow, 0800. No further questions.

EXT. HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

LIN TIAN, escorted by BODYGUARDS, walks through the red carpet and gets into a black Maybach. The car slides away, merging into the city's neon bloodstream.
continuation:
INT. MAYBACH CAR - NIGHT

LIN TIAN has changed into a faded jacket and striped shirt, sitting in the back seat.

DRIVER
(looking at LIN TIAN through the rearview mirror)
The old man won't know this version of you.

LIN TIAN
(smiling thinly)
That's the point.

LIN TIAN (V.O.)
Every deal had your name in the margins. Now I'm home with everything but the time I owe you.

FLASHBACK

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

Fifteen years ago.

YOUNG LIN SHAN rides a rusted Phoenix bicycle with YOUNG LIN TIAN on the back seat. The sunlight is thin, tired.

LIN SHAN (V.O.)
Eyes forward, Xiao Tian. I'll handle the wheels.

YOUNG LIN TIAN
What if I make it to the top first?

LIN SHAN
(laughing)
Then you pull me up. Deal?

The two ride away, silhouettes fading into the light.

END FLASHBACK

INT. MAYBACH CAR - NIGHT

LIN TIAN is lost in memories. His phone rings, harsh. He answers. The smile dies, replaced by shock and panic.

LIN TIAN
(into the phone)
Jiangcheng Hospital—what?

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

LIN TIAN bursts in. The antiseptic smell is a physical wall. LIN SHAN lies shrunken in the white bed, machines breathing for him.

A NURSE checks vitals. Lin Tian goes straight for the chart, reading the numbers he understands too well.

LIN TIAN
(to himself, barely audible)
We had a deal.

Images flash on screen of LIN TIAN as a confident president, forming a stark contrast with his current anxious and helpless state.

title: Return of the God of War - The Slapping God of War
description: Seven years after being poisoned and presumed dead, the legendary Northern Prince Ye Beixiao is sought by his loyal protectors to return and save the realm.
context:
Title: Return of the God of War - The Slapping God of War
Description: Seven years after being poisoned and presumed dead, the legendary Northern Prince Ye Beixiao is sought by his loyal protectors to return and save the realm.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

ON SCREEN: Northern Prince Ye Beixiao - The Slapping Palm God of War

YE BEIXIAO, golden armor glinting with fresh blood, stands among the fallen. He catches a wine gourd from the air, drinks deeply, eyes scanning the horizon.

ON SCREEN: Northern Territory - Four Great Assassins

FOUR ASSASSINS drop from the sky, landing in a perfect circle. Their leader's blade reflects sunlight.

ASSASSIN LEADER
The Four Shadows. We've come to collect.

They attack as one. YE BEIXIAO flows between them, each strike a blur. His signature technique—open-palm strikes that crack like thunder—sends them flying.

The gourd arcs through the air. YE BEIXIAO snatches it, drinks.

YE BEIXIAO
(quoting the ancient poet)
"With joy—drink to the dregs. Let no moonlight waste in empty cups."

GU QIUYU (O.S.)
Poetry suits the dying.

ON SCREEN: Southern Barbarian God of War - Gu Qiuyu

GU QIUYU emerges from the mist, her own armor scarred from battle. Her gaze holds something more than triumph.

GU QIUYU
Three hundred thousand. You crushed them like insects. Yet here you stand.

YE BEIXIAO
I don't kill women. Not even rebel generals.

GU QIUYU
(laughs, bitter)
You never could see past a pretty face. That's always been your flaw.

YE BEIXIAO stumbles, grips his chest. The wine gourd falls.

YE BEIXIAO
The wine...

GU QIUYU
Meridian Venom. Activated when you fought. The assassins were just... the key turning in the lock.

YE BEIXIAO
We were allies once.

GU QIUYU
Once. Now you're the last wall between me and peace. My peace.

She attacks. POISONED, YE BEIXIAO's movements blur between precision and desperation. He takes two soldiers down, breaks through their line, vanishes into the smoke.

MALE SUBORDINATE
He escaped!

GU QIUYU
Let him run. The poison will finish what I started. When he's gone, no one remains to stop the unification.
continuation:
EXT. OCEAN - DAY

ON SCREEN: Seven Years Later

SPEEDBOATS slice through fog. A WARNING SIREN blares.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Northern Territory blockade. All vessels halt and identify. Enter our waters unannounced, and we fire.

ISLAND NATION ENVOY (V.O.)
Island Nation trading vessel! We have papers!

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Too slow. Warning shots across your bow. Turn back or be boarded.

ON SCREEN: Northern Territory Left Protector - Murong Wushuang

LEFT PROTECTOR stands at the helm, modern tactical gear over traditional robes. He studies the horizon.

LEFT PROTECTOR
The old National Lord fades. The princes are... disappointments.

ON SCREEN: Northern Territory Right Protector - Murong Qingling

RIGHT PROTECTOR consults an ancient compass, its needle spinning wildly.

RIGHT PROTECTOR
Only the Slapping Palm God of War can stabilize the realm now.

The compass needle locks—pointing west.

RIGHT PROTECTOR
He's alive. In Jiangxia.

LEFT PROTECTOR
Then we go. On our knees if we must.

The speedboats pivot, engines screaming toward shore.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Return of the God of War, The Hidden Boss is My Mom (Episode 67)
description: A mother and martial arts master must leave her daughter behind to answer the call of duty and defend her nation.
context:
Title: Return of the God of War, The Hidden Boss is My Mom (Episode 67)
Description: A mother and martial arts master must leave her daughter behind to answer the call of duty and defend her nation.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

LUO LIN brushes a stray hair from her sleeping daughter XIAO LUO YAO's forehead, a rare moment of stillness.

The window latch rattles. Once. Twice. Then shatters.

A MASKED ATTACKER rolls through the opening, blade already sweeping low.

LUO LIN moves without thought—scooping Yao Yao behind her, snatching the practice sword from its wall mount, deflecting the strike into the mattress. She flows into the next motion: a sharp elbow to the attacker's temple, then a disarming twist that snaps bone. The intruder crumples.

A second ASSAILANT charges through the door, scimitar raised. Luo Lin kicks the fallen sword across the floor—it slides between his feet, tangling his step. She's already there, using his momentum to drive him headfirst into the bedpost. He goes limp.

She doesn't even breathe hard.

EXT. COURTYARD - CONTINUOUS

LUO LIN steps out, carrying Yao Yao. Six more MASKED FIGURES emerge from shadows cast by swaying lanterns. They've been waiting.

She sets Yao Yao gently on the stone bench against the wall, shielding her with one arm as the first blade whistles past. Luo Lin catches the wrist, pivots, and uses the attacker's own knife to block a second strike. She moves like water—each parry flowing into a counter, each step repositioning her enemies between themselves.

A thrown dagger skims her shoulder. She lets it, catching the weapon mid-air and flicking it back into its owner's thigh. He drops.

Within seconds, the courtyard is quiet except for groaning bodies and the hiss of a lantern that spilled its oil.

Boots crunch on gravel.

WU ZIXING strides through the gate, five SUBORDINATES flanking him. They take in the scene—Luo Lin standing calm among the fallen, Yao Yao small and trembling on the bench.

WU ZIXING
Sect Master?

LUO LIN
(hand still on Yao Yao's shoulder)
Check them for coastal clan tattoos. This wasn't random.

WU ZIXING kneels, prying back a sleeve. His jaw tightens.

WU ZIXING
Eastern invaders. The Phoenix Seal we intercepted—you were their target.

ALL SUBORDINATES
(kneeling)
Sect Master!

WU ZIXING
The border forts are falling. They know you're the last Phoenix Blade. The only one who can unify the resistance.

ALL SUBORDINATES
(in unison)
We need our Sect Master!

LUO LIN
(staring at Yao Yao)
I swore I'd be her mother first.

The wind shifts. Distant thunder rolls.

LUO LIN
(quietly)
But she has a future only if the homeland stands.

She straightens, pulling her hand from Yao Yao's shoulder like ripping a bandage.

LUO LIN
Three days. I'll need that long to place them somewhere safe.

WU ZIXING
Your word is our command.
continuation:
EXT. COURTYARD GATE - NIGHT

Rain begins as a drizzle, then a downpour. LUO LIN hands a waterproof satchel to her cousin HE JUAN. XIAO LUO YAO clutches He Juan's hand. Behind them, LUO CHANGSHAN sits in his wheelchair, a blanket over his knees.

LUO LIN
The documents are inside. The safehouse in Qingyang Province knows to expect you.

HE JUAN

Mama...

LUO LIN

title: Guardian's Promise - Heaven Rewards Diligence
description: A successful CEO returns to his homeland after building a business empire, only to receive a mysterious message that forces him to confront the past he left behind.
context:
Title: Guardian's Promise - Heaven Rewards Diligence
Description: A successful CEO returns to his homeland after building a business empire, only to receive a mysterious message that forces him to confront the past he left behind.

MONTAGE:

City skyline at night. News broadcast plays over glittering towers.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Zhao Group's IPO closes at a three hundred billion valuation, making it Daxia's most valuable corporation.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

ZHAO QIN sits motionless in a designer chair, face half in shadow, watching the celebration on muted screens.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Founder Zhao Qin has reportedly returned to the country, declining all interview requests.

The screens flicker through headlines: "Zhao Group's Record-Breaking IPO," "The Emperor of E-Commerce." Zhao Qin's reflection overlays the images.

END MONTAGE.

EXT. ZHAO GROUP BUILDING - DAY

A black Bentley glides to the entrance. SECRETARY WANG exits first, positioning herself by the rear door.

ZHAO QIN emerges, documents tucked under his arm, his expression a practiced mask of indifference.

ON SCREEN: ZHAO QIN - CEO, ZHAO GROUP

SECRETARY WANG
(solicitous, hovering)
The board is preparing the closing documents. They'll want your final signature today.

ZHAO QIN hands her the acquisition papers without breaking stride. They walk toward the entrance.

SECRETARY WANG
(scanning, breathless)
This gives us controlling interest in...
(glancing up)
You really did it, sir. No one in Daxia comes close now.

She holds the door. Zhao Qin pauses, looking at the building's facade as if seeing it for the first time.

ZHAO QIN
(quiet, almost to himself)
Neither did they ten years ago.

He enters.
continuation:
INT. ZHAO QIN'S OFFICE - DAY

ZHAO QIN crosses to the floor-to-ceiling window. He removes a handkerchief, polishes a smudge on the glass, then stares through it at the city below. His thumb traces circles on the windowpane—a nervous habit.

His phone BUZZES on the mahogany desk. Once. Twice.

ZHAO QIN
(finally turning)
Persistent spam.

He walks to the desk, glances at the screen. A text from an unknown number: "Sir, can you help me?"

ZHAO QIN
(scoffing)
They have my private number now?

He swipes to delete. Another message appears—an ultrasound image, timestamped. Below it: "Mom said this was you. She's gone now."

ZHAO QIN freezes. The handkerchief slips from his hand. He picks up the phone with both hands, zooming in on the image. His breathing stops.

ZHAO QIN
(whisper)
No. She wouldn't have...

The phone BUZZES again. A final message: "Please. The hospital says I have three days."

EXT. RUNDOWN CORNER - DAY

XIAO XIAO, ten years old, huddles against a concrete wall, her phone clutched to her chest. She watches people pass, their expensive shoes clicking past her worn sneakers. She doesn't look at the screen—just holds the phone like a talisman.

ON SCREEN: XIAO XIAO - XIAO YUROU'S DAUGHTER

Her finger hovers over the send button. She presses it, then quickly pockets the phone, hugging her knees.

FLASHBACK:

Ten years ago.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Young ZHAO QIN and XIAO YUROU share earbuds, dancing to music only they can hear, laughing. He spins her—she stumbles into him. They freeze, foreheads touching.

YOUNG ZHAO QIN
(soft)
Two years. I'll build us something real.

XIAO YUROU
(touching his face)
I don't need empires. I need you here.

EXT. STREET - CONTINUOUS

The same street. Rain hammers down. A taxi's hazards flash.

YOUNG ZHAO QIN blocks the car door, desperate.

YOUNG ZHAO QIN
Yurou, the medical trial in London—it could change everything. For us.

XIAO YUROU
(haunted, clutching her stomach)
You don't understand. Some things can't wait two years.

YOUNG ZHAO QIN
Then make me understand!

She pushes past him into the taxi. He slaps the window as it pulls away.

YOUNG ZHAO QIN
(running, voice breaking)
Yurou! You said we'd face everything together!

His foot catches a pothole. He goes down hard, palms scraping pavement. The taxi vanishes around the corner. He pushes himself up, blood mixing with rainwater, and stares at his torn hands—not with resentment, but with dawning terror that he's broken something irreparable.

INT. TAXI - NIGHT

XIAO YUROU stares at the rearview mirror, watching him fall. Her hand presses against her belly. She pulls out a Zhao Group business card—his old number circled in red. She kisses it, then tucks it into her coat pocket, close to her heart.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. ZHAO QIN'S OFFICE - DAY

ZHAO QIN stands motionless at the window, phone pressed to his forehead. Outside, rain begins to fall.

He scrolls to the ultrasound image again, his thumb hovering over the timestamp: October 12, 2014—nine months after she left.

ZHAO QIN
(quietly)
You tried to tell me.

His reflection shows a man no longer looking at a city, but at a ghost.

EXT. RUNDOWN CORNER - DAY

XIAO XIAO checks her phone. No reply. She pushes herself up, wincing—her hand goes to her side. She limps toward the hospital entrance, her small frame disappearing into the morning crowd.

Rain begins to fall on the empty corner where she sat.

title: New Year's Eve
description: On New Year's Eve, a wife catches her husband in bed with her best friend and demands a divorce, but the husband suspects it's all a setup orchestrated by her brother.
context:
Title: New Year's Eve
Description: On New Year's Eve, a wife catches her husband in bed with her best friend and demands a divorce, but the husband suspects it's all a setup orchestrated by her brother.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

GU YANZHI and XIAOXIAO (YE XIAO's best friend) are asleep in bed, champagne glasses on the nightstand.

YE XIAO bursts in with brother YE XI and AUNT LIU.

YE XIAO yanks the blanket off.

YE XIAO
(barely controlled)
Happy New Year, husband. My best friend.

XIAOXIAO
(waking, panicked)
Xiaoxiao—wait—I don't remember—I was at the party—

YE XIAO
The party I threw for us.

YE XIAO grabs for XIAOXIAO. Chaos erupts.

XIAOXIAO
(covering herself)
I swear, there's something wrong with me—

YE XI
Sis, your medication. Remember your heart.

YE XIAO
(turning to GU YANZHI)
Sign it. Every page.

YE XIAO slams a document on GU YANZHI's chest.

GU YANZHI
(in disbelief)
Divorce papers?
continuation:
GU YANZHI flips through the document. "Divorce Agreement - Revised 12/30" is stamped on top.

GU YANZHI
(quietly)
You had them ready before tonight. Before you even knew.

GU YANZHI
(to YE XIAO)
Ten years. Did you ever believe in us?

YE XI
(stepping closer)
She believes in evidence. Right here, in our family home.

GU YANZHI
(to YE XI)
The emergency board meeting. Tomorrow morning. You need me out before then.

GU YANZHI
(to YE XIAO)
He's been planning this. Ask him about the shares.

YE XI
(nervously)
He's desperate, sis. Don't fall for it—

GU YANZHI
(grabs YE XI's collar)
Show her your phone. The texts.

GU YANZHI shoves YE XI against the wall, hand on his throat.

YE XI
(gasping)
You're insane!

YE XIAO
(pulling GU YANZHI back)
Stop! Stop—

YE XIAO freezes. A phone on the floor shows a message: "She's coming. Make it convincing."

title: Found the Wife - She's Dating on a Romance Show
description: A woman wakes up at her own funeral to find herself in another person's body, desperately searching for her lost child.
context:
Title: Found the Wife - She's Dating on a Romance Show
Description: A woman wakes up at her own funeral to find herself in another person's body, desperately searching for her lost child.

INT. FUNERAL HALL - DAY

The funeral hall is arranged with cold elegance, white roses surrounding an open casket. A banner reads: "Farewell to Su Shangjing."

A young woman, SU SHANGJING, dressed in white, lies in the casket. Her black and white portrait is placed in front.

GUESTS in black clothing bow under the direction of a MASTER OF CEREMONIES.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
First bow.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
Second bow.

CLOSE-UP - SU SHANGJING's hands folded on her chest. Her fingers twitch slightly.

A FEMALE GUEST's eyes widen in horror, pointing at the casket.

FEMALE GUEST A
She moved! The body moved!

Everyone looks over, their faces showing alarm.

CUT TO: FLASHBACK

INT. SHABBY BEDROOM - 2019 - DAY

GU YUNUO lies on a bed, giving birth. A MIDWIFE and LIN YUEE attend her.

MIDWIFE
Push! Harder!

LIN YUEE
That's it!

A baby's cry. GU YUNUO looks at the child, exhausted but relieved.

LIN YUEE's expression darkens. She grabs the child.

LIN YUEE
A bastard child with no father? I'll give it a real home.

GU YUNUO
(panicked)
Aunt Lin, no! My baby...

GU YUNUO struggles to reach her child.

GU YUNUO
Please... give him back...

LIN YUEE
(viciously)
You're not fit to be a mother!

LIN YUEE shoves GU YUNUO. Her head slams against the bedside table. Blood flows as she loses consciousness.

LIN YUEE
(to the child, calculating)
Mr. Lin pays well for baby boys.

BACK TO: PRESENT
continuation:
INT. FUNERAL HALL - DAY

The body's eyes snap open. She sits up abruptly.

SU SHANGJING (with GU YUNUO's consciousness)
My child!

The GUESTS scatter in terror, screaming.

GUESTS
(V.O.)
A ghost! A ghost!

YAN JINCHUAN stands in place, looking at her coldly.

YAN JINCHUAN
You really didn't die.

FEMALE GUEST B
(to her companion)
I thought when President Yan divorced her on that dating show, she'd at least have the decency to stay dead.

FEMALE GUEST A
She faked a pregnancy to trap him. Why not fake a suicide?

The woman clutches her head, her expression pained and confused.

SU SHANGJING
Where is this? Where is my child?

She stumbles toward Yan Jinchuan and grabs his arm.

YAN JINCHUAN
(shaking her off)
Su Shangjing, what trick is this?

SU SHANGJING
(desperate, confused)
Su Shangjing? No... I'm...

She looks down at her unfamiliar hands, then at the portrait.

SU SHANGJING
(whispering)
Who is Su Shangjing?

Who is Su Shangjing?

WANG YOUCHENG

YE YU
(suppressing her anger)

WANG YOUCHENG
Fifteen.

YE YU opens her wallet and realizes she doesn't have enough money.

YE YU

WANG YOUCHENG
(lecherous look)

YE YU
(panicked)

WANG YOUCHENG
Let me touch you, and I'll give you a discount. How about that?

YE YU
(struggling, shouting)
Help! Someone! This pervert!

Two FEMALE PASSERSBY nearby, instead of helping, take out their phones and laugh while filming.

WANG YOUCHENG
(more excited)
The more you scream, the more excited I get!

YE YU
(desperately shouting)
Help! Someone help!

WANG YOUCHENG

A large scallion suddenly flies through the air and hits WANG YOUCHENG on the head. He freezes.

WANG YOUCHENG
(angrily looking around)
Who? Who dares to ruin my fun!

Another object flies in, knocking WANG YOUCHENG to the ground.
continuation:
EXT. OUTSIDE VEGETABLE MARKET - DAY

A black Maybach speeds up and stops at the roadside with a beautiful drift. Several BODYGUARDS in black quickly exit and open the rear door for YE HUA. YE HUA, wearing a suit with a stern expression, steps out and walks toward the vegetable market with his bodyguards in an imposing manner.

INT. VEGETABLE MARKET - DAY

YE HUA enters with his bodyguards and walks directly toward the fallen WANG YOUCHENG.

YE HUA
(pointing at the scallion on the ground, to WANG YOUCHENG)

FEMALE PASSERBY B
Exactly. What kind of big shot comes to a place like this?

FEMALE PASSERBY A

YE HUA
Subordinate greets the Young Miss.

All the BODYGUARDS bow in unison.

YE YU
(helping YE HUA up)
Butler Ye, why are you here?

YE HUA

YE HUA
Also, your black card can now be used normally.

YE YU
(taking the black card, quiet intensity)

Yes, Butler Ye. I guarantee I'll complete the task perfectly.

BAI YU
(to himself)
Oh, deliver it tomorrow? Then today this car is mine. Perfect timing to drive it to the class reunion and show off.

title: The Mom Who Braves All Odds
description: A martial arts master must choose between her sacred secret manual and her daughter's life when betrayed by her closest allies.
context:
Title: The Mom Who Braves All Odds
Description: A martial arts master must choose between her sacred secret manual and her daughter's life when betrayed by her closest allies.

EXT. ANCIENT FOREST - NIGHT

Ancient forest at night. Moonlight reveals a fallen monument. JIN YANCHUAN, masked, drops from the stone and blocks BAI XIUCHUN, in white warrior robes.

JIN YANCHUAN
The Biaoyue Manual. Last chance.

BAI XIUCHUN's stance is unreadable. JIN YANCHUAN attacks. Their exchange ends in three strikes. Bai Xiuchun's palm drops him.

JIN YANCHUAN
(gasping)
The Shadowless Hand...

BAI XIUCHUN
Not today.

Torchlight flares through trees. YING LENGYUE arrives with SUBORDINATES. In their crane's cargo net: GU HONG and daughter JIAJIA, bound.

JIAJIA
Mom!

BAI XIUCHUN
(shocked)
What is this?

SUBORDINATE
Hold!

GU HONG
(bleeding)
She poisoned Master. The manual can't—

YING LENGYUE
(icy)
Enough.

She snaps Gu Hong's neck. He falls.

JIAJIA
(screaming)
Dad!

BAI XIUCHUN
(whisper)
No...
continuation:
YING LENGYUE
Manual or daughter. Choose.

She squeezes Jiajia's shoulder. The girl bites back a cry.

YING LENGYUE
(to Jin Yanchuan)
Uncle. We've won.

She tosses an empty scroll case at Bai Xiuchun's feet.

YING LENGYUE
The Kunshan School ends tonight.

BAI XIUCHUN
(desperate)
Jiajia...

The crane lifts away. Darkness swallows their cries.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

Rain slashes across tombs. BAI XIUCHUN and QING HU stand before GU HONG's grave.

BAI XIUCHUN (V.O.)
They taught me to save thousands. Not one.

She pulls the Biaoyue Manual from her robes. Forces it into Qing Hu's hands.

BAI XIUCHUN (V.O.)
Kunshan is dead. Let its ghosts remember.

She touches the tombstone. Rain streams down her face.

BAI XIUCHUN
(to the storm)
Bai Xiuchun is dead.

EXT. WANGFU GUEST HOUSE - DAY

SUPER: FIFTEEN YEARS LATER

Mist clings to a courtyard. APENG practices Wing Chun on a wooden dummy. LIN JUNRU watches from above, sharp-eyed. She fingers a jade pendant.

LIN JUNRU
(quiet)
Jiajia would be twenty-four.

She tucks the pendant away. Descends into morning light.

title: Bringing a Prince to the Modern Era
description: A delivery girl accidentally travels to ancient times and brings a prince back to the modern world.
context:
Title: Bringing a Prince to the Modern Era
Description: A delivery girl accidentally travels to ancient times and brings a prince back to the modern world.

EXT. FILM STUDIO - DAY

On an open field, a yellow electric cart speeds past.

YE ZHAOXI (V.O.)
Two minutes left on the timer.

YE ZHAOXI, a girl wearing a yellow delivery uniform with twin ponytails, stops the cart and grabs the food delivery and her phone. A jade pendant hangs at her neck.

YE ZHAOXI (V.O.)
Last order. Rent's locked.

YE ZHAOXI runs into a large building.

INT. FILM STUDIO CORRIDOR - DAY

YE ZHAOXI sprints through the corridor, passing various actors in costume.

YE ZHAOXI
(dodging through)
Sorry—excuse me!

PASSERBY A
Watch it!

A woman's voice comes from one room.

WOMAN (O.S.)
Dongmei, what are you doing?

In another room, a girl climbs onto a windowsill.

GIRL
Burn, my youth!

YE ZHAOXI continues running forward, passing a simulated airplane cabin set.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT (O.S.)
Ladies and gentlemen, our plane is experiencing turbulence, please remain calm.

INT. AIRPLANE SIMULATION CABIN - DAY

The DIRECTOR sits in front of monitors, watching the flight attendant actress performing.

DIRECTOR
Cut! Who told you to act like that? Can you be more realistic? Do it again!

The DIRECTOR sees YE ZHAOXI at the door.

DIRECTOR
What are you doing?

YE ZHAOXI
I'm delivering food.

DIRECTOR
(impatiently)
Food? Get out!

YE ZHAOXI is driven out. She looks down at her phone.

YE ZHAOXI
(to herself)
Wrong address...

She notices a door marked "HISTORICAL SOUNDSTAGE B-3" and pushes through.
continuation:
INT. ANCIENT MILITARY TENT - DAY

The scene switches to an ancient battlefield, two armies at war.

ON SCREEN: 600 BC - KINGDOM OF DANZHU

Inside the military tent, PRINCE DANZHU wears armor, his back to a sand table. He turns around, his eyes resolute.

PRINCE DANZHU
(to the generals)
The Rong tribes raid our borders. We answer with steel. Today, Danzhu writes its legend!

GENERALS
Long live Danzhu! Long live the Prince!

Suddenly, YE ZHAOXI appears out of nowhere in the military tent. She looks around bewildered.

YE ZHAOXI
(quietly)
This is the spot.

The GENERALS and PRINCE DANZHU stare at her in shock.

YE ZHAOXI
(holding up the delivery bag)
Food delivery.

PRINCE DANZHU
Dismissed.

GENERALS
Yes!

The generals leave. Only PRINCE DANZHU and YE ZHAOXI remain in the tent.

YE ZHAOXI
(handing over the food)
Hello, your delivery has arrived. Remember to give me a five-star review.

She looks curiously at the sand table.

YE ZHAOXI
Wow, your crew made this map so detailed, really authentic. Where's the hidden camera? It's really well hidden.

She reaches out to touch PRINCE DANZHU's armor.

PRINCE DANZHU
(grabbing her hand)
Identify yourself. How did you enter this tent?

YE ZHAOXI
(in pain)
Dude, ow ow ow! Do all you actors get this into your roles?

PRINCE DANZHU restrains her, and they end up in an intimate position close together.

PRINCE DANZHU
If you don't answer, you're a spy.

YE ZHAOXI
Just because you're handsome doesn't mean you can do whatever you want! Are you harassing me? Let go!

PRINCE DANZHU
I have ways to make you talk.

INT. ANCIENT MILITARY TENT - CONTINUOUS

A black-clad ASSASSIN suddenly bursts in.

ASSASSIN
Prince Danzhu, die!

The ASSASSIN swings his blade. PRINCE DANZHU immediately shields YE ZHAOXI behind him. As he turns, the jade pendant on YE ZHAOXI's neck emits a brilliant light.

Space-time distorts, and they are both engulfed by the light.

EXT. OUTSIDE FILM STUDIO - DAY

The light fades. PRINCE DANZHU and YE ZHAOXI appear on a modern street. PRINCE DANZHU looks around in shock at the unfamiliar environment.

PRINCE DANZHU
What place is this?

YE ZHAOXI
(impatiently)
Are all the people in your crew like this? All this fighting and killing.

PRINCE DANZHU
Woman, I ask, you answer. How far is this place from Danzhu?

YE ZHAOXI
Danzhu? That was over two thousand years ago.

PRINCE DANZHU
(shocked)
You're saying Danzhu no longer exists?

YE ZHAOXI
Yeah. It's ancient history.

PRINCE DANZHU staggers back, unable to believe it.

PRINCE DANZHU
Two thousand years have already passed...

YE ZHAOXI looks at his devastated expression and freezes.

YE ZHAOXI
No way? You're really the Prince of Danzhu?

They look at each other. The pendant is now dark and lifeless. Both are in extreme shock.

title: Saving My Primitive Brother
description: A young woman wakes up injured in a deep forest with no memory, only to be saved from a bear attack by a mysterious wild man.
context:
Title: Saving My Primitive Brother
Description: A young woman wakes up injured in a deep forest with no memory, only to be saved from a bear attack by a mysterious wild man.

EXT. FOREST - DAY

Mist shrouds the ancient forest. Silence broken by dripping water.

A young woman (INJURED WOMAN), 25, lies on decaying leaves. Pink sports jacket torn. Blood on her forehead. A broken silver heart necklace.

Her eyes snap open. Pain. She sits up, gasping.

INJURED WOMAN (V.O.)
Breathe. Don't pass out. Move.

INJURED WOMAN
Where...? What happened to me?

She touches her temple—blood. No memories. Only survival.

INJURED WOMAN
I have to get out.

She forces herself up, staggers forward. Alert. Terrified.

A low GROWL. Close.

A massive BLACK BEAR emerges on hind legs. Seven feet tall.

The woman freezes. Backs into a deadfall—trapped.

The bear drops, CHARGES.
continuation:
She covers her face—

A blur. The WILD MAN—matted hair, scarred, draped in furs—grabs her waist, pulls her aside. She faints.

He lays her behind a massive oak.

The Wild Man grabs a dry branch, strikes it against a boulder—CRACK. He beats it against trees in a sharp rhythm.

The bear halts. Uncertain.

The Wild Man stands his ground, holding the branch like a torch.

The bear woofs, shakes its head, retreats into the forest.

The Wild Man watches until it's gone. A choked laugh escapes. He pounds his chest once.

He turns. The woman is conscious now, pressed against the oak.

Her eyes drop to his neck—an identical silver necklace, but whole. She clutches her broken one.

INJURED WOMAN
Who are you?

The Wild Man touches his necklace. Points at her, then himself.

INJURED WOMAN
The legend... Shennongjia wild man?

He tilts his head. Recognition wars with confusion. He extends a hand.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Champion Mom, Stop Hitting Her - She's Really Your Daughter
description: World champion boxer Shen Mingyu wins her title but refuses to throw a fight, leading to a deadly confrontation that threatens her family.
context:
Title: Champion Mom, Stop Hitting Her - She's Really Your Daughter
Description: World champion boxer Shen Mingyu wins her title but refuses to throw a fight, leading to a deadly confrontation that threatens her family.

INT. BOXING GYM - NIGHT

ZHOU ZIFENG lies on the boxing ring, unconscious. REFEREE raises SHEN MINGYU's trembling hand.

REFEREE
World champion, Shen Mingyu!

In the audience, SHEN MINGYU'S HUSBAND clutches daughter JIAJIA and son SHEN TAO.

SHEN TAO
Mom's the strongest!

JIAJIA
(quietly)
She always keeps her promises.

SHEN MINGYU receives the championship medal. It's ceremonial, designed to be split. She separates it.

SHEN MINGYU
(gently)
Hold these. You're my real champions.

JIAJIA
Mom's amazing.

SHEN TAO
I'll be brave like you.

Smoke grenades EXPLODE. The exits are blocked.

AUDIENCE MEMBERS
Move! Now!

SHEN MINGYU
(covering her children's faces)
Breathe through my coat!

Through smoke, ZHOU ZIFENG emerges with HENCHMEN.

ZHOU ZIFENG
You chose the ring over your family.
continuation:
INT. BOXING GYM - ONE HOUR EARLIER (FLASHBACK)

During intermission, ZHOU ZIFENG approaches SHEN MINGYU.

ZHOU ZIFENG
My daughter needs surgery. They'll pay. Just drop the fifth.

SHEN MINGYU
I can't teach my children to stand for nothing.

The match resumes. Shen Mingyu's punches carry the weight of her principles.

INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT (PRESENT)

SHEN MINGYU awakens in a warehouse, hands zip-tied. Her family is bound before her.

SHEN MINGYU (V.O.)
The gas is still in my lungs. But it's not what weakens me.

One HENCHMAN tears a medal half from JIAJIA's neck.

SHEN MINGYU
Jiajia!

ZHOU ZIFENG
(holding a blade)
Your tendons. Or your daughter's future. Ten seconds.

JIAJIA
(struggling)
Don't hurt her!

The HENCHMAN strikes Jiajia. Shen Mingyu lunges against her bonds.

SHEN MINGYU
(despairing)
Jiajia!

INT. BOXING GYM - BEFORE THE MATCH (FLASHBACK)

JIAJIA helps Shen Mingyu with her gloves.

JIAJIA
Mom, would you still love me if you lost?

SHEN MINGYU
I'd love you more. Because I'd still have you.

She taps Jiajia's nose, but her eyes show the first crack of doubt.

INT. ABANDONED FACTORY - NIGHT (PRESENT)

ZHOU ZIFENG
(to Henchmen)
Take the girl. Livestream the lesson.

The HENCHMEN drag JIAJIA toward the exit.

JIAJIA
Mom!

SHEN MINGYU
(screaming)
Wait!

She looks at her restrained hands - the hands that won a world championship. Then at her daughter's face.

SHEN MINGYU
(quietly, utterly defeated)
Let her go. I'll do it. I'll throw every fight. I'll retire. I'll disappear.

She meets Zhou Zifeng's eyes, a champion surrendering her crown to save her child.

title: Return of the Fist King
description: A champion fighter defies corruption to defend his honor in an underground fighting tournament.
context:
Title: Return of the Fist King
Description: A champion fighter defies corruption to defend his honor in an underground fighting tournament.

INT. BOXING ARENA - NIGHT

Neon bleeds through tinted windows. The crowd erupts.

MALE HOST (V.O.)
Welcome to No Rules DX. The Fist King Championship.

The arena pulses. Spectators wave LED batons and banners.

MALE HOST
Tonight's challenger: from Yunzhou, the undefeated Qin Zun!

AUDIENCE
Qin Zun! Qin Zun! Qin Zun!

QIN ZUN (30s), scarred knuckles, worn training gear, pushes through the crowd.

MALE HOST
Ninety-nine victories in two years. One legend in the making.

MALE HOST
His opponent: from Tokyo, the Yakuza Open champion.

MALE HOST
Yamada Sato!

YAMADA SATO (30s), gold chains, enters with calculated swagger.

FEMALE HOST
Seventy-seven wins. Zero losses. He earned every one.

MALE HOST
Will Qin Zun claim the Hundredth Crown, or will Sato break the streak? Let's find out!

YAMADA SATO
The great Qin Zun. Heard you're only good against local talent.

QIN ZUN
You heard wrong.

MALE HOST
Fight's on!

FLASHBACK - INT. BACKROOM - NIGHT

SENIOR BROTHER (40s) pins QIN ZUN's hand to the table.

SENIOR BROTHER
Third round. You go down.

QIN ZUN
Deliberately lose? That's career suicide.

SENIOR BROTHER
Career? I built you. Those ninety-nine wins belong to me.
continuation:
SENIOR BROTHER signs a check, pushes it forward.

SENIOR BROTHER
Five million. Walk away now, or you're back to nothing.

END FLASHBACK - INT. BOXING ARENA - NIGHT

QIN ZUN's jaw tightens. Eyes fixed on Sato.

RING GIRL circles with a "Round One" sign.

REFEREE
Fight!

YAMADA SATO
Time to learn your place!

Sato rushes, throwing a lightning combo. Qin Zun blocks, redirects, absorbs.

YAMADA SATO (O.S.)
Ha! Predictable!

MALE HOST
Sato's dominating the early exchange!

QIN ZUN
(to himself)
Level one. Level two. Level three.

YAMADA SATO
This is what you brought?

As Sato finishes, his eyes widen. His shirt tears. A crimson welt blooms.

REFEREE
K.O.!

YAMADA SATO
Three... levels...

AUDIENCE
He's down! He's down!

MALE HOST
Qin Zun wins! The Hundred Crown Fist King!

Confetti erupts. Qin Zun stands alone, breathing hard.

AUDIENCE
Hundred Crown! Hundred Crown!

INT. BACKROOM - NIGHT

SENIOR BROTHER crushes his whiskey glass.

INT. BOXING ARENA - NIGHT

QIN ZUN, amid confetti, locks eyes with Senior Brother through the crowd.

title: People Who Can't Be Warmed Don't Need to Be Kept
description: A woman endures eight years with a boyfriend who prioritizes his "white moonlight" over her, even abandoning her on her birthday.
context:
Title: People Who Can't Be Warmed Don't Need to Be Kept
Description: A woman endures eight years with a boyfriend who prioritizes his "white moonlight" over her, even abandoning her on her birthday.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

YE NINGYU and QIN RUNIAN stand together. YE NINGYU's expression is calm, practiced.

YE NINGYU (V.O.)
Eight years of learning to look away while he reaches for someone else. My boyfriend's "white moonlight"—the girl he could never forget. She gets his best smiles. I get the leftovers.

ZHANG KEKE jumps onto QIN RUNIAN's back from behind, wrapping her arms around his neck.

ZHANG KEKE
Penalty for being late! Ten push-ups with me on your back.

QIN RUNIAN
(doting)
You'll break me.

ZHANG KEKE
That's what you said last time.

ZHANG KEKE notices YE NINGYU. She stays on his back.

ZHANG KEKE
Oh. Ningyu. Didn't see you there. Brother Nian and I are just doing our usual. You don't mind, right?

YE NINGYU
(smiling faintly)
Why would I? You're family.

QIN RUNIAN's smile fades. He lowers ZHANG KEKE.

QIN RUNIAN
You're being dramatic.

ZHANG KEKE
We played that game months ago, this is just our thing. You're not still upset about your birthday yesterday, are you? I'll give him back, promise.

YE NINGYU
Keep him. I'm done sharing.
continuation:
INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT

ONE DAY EARLIER

YE NINGYU wears a birthday crown, sitting before a cake with candles. She closes her eyes.

YE NINGYU
Please let this year be different.

QIN RUNIAN's phone RINGS. He checks it—ZHANG KEKE's photo lights the screen. He answers.

QIN RUNIAN
Keke? What's wrong?

ZHANG KEKE (O.S.)
(sobbing)
He left me. I can't—I don't know what to—

QIN RUNIAN
I'll be right there.

He stands to leave. YE NINGYU's hand catches his wrist.

YE NINGYU
Don't. Please.

QIN RUNIAN
She needs me.

YE NINGYU
I need you. It's my birthday.

QIN RUNIAN
(pulling away)
And she just had her heart broken. Don't be selfish.

YE NINGYU
If you walk out that door—

QIN RUNIAN
(furious, careless)
Stop acting like a child!

He knocks the birthday crown from YE NINGYU's head. It clatters to the floor. He leaves without looking back.

QIN RUNIAN
(into phone)
I'm coming, Keke. Stay on the line.

YE NINGYU watches him go. She picks up the crown. It bends in her hands.

YE NINGYU (V.O.)
Eight years. For this.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

YE NINGYU places a box by the door. Inside: QIN RUNIAN's keys, a phone charger, their graduation photo. She surveys the apartment—his things stacked, hers already gone.

Her phone lights up. QIN RUNIAN calling. She declines. Blocks the number.

The birthday crown sits in the trash, glitter dulled.

YE NINGYU (V.O.)
The heart doesn't break. It calcifies. And then it walks away.

She exits. The door locks with a final CLICK.

title: After the Marriage Swap, I Help My Husband Rise
description: A woman is reborn to the day of her broken engagement after being killed by her sister, who resented her for marrying into a powerful family.
context:
Title: After the Marriage Swap, I Help My Husband Rise
Description: A woman is reborn to the day of her broken engagement after being killed by her sister, who resented her for marrying into a powerful family.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Gauze curtains flutter over the bed. XIAO MANXI and ZHANG QIANG lie in bed together.

XIAO MANXI
Brother Qiang, you're truly amazing. Not like my useless husband Liang Shaoqian. After we got married, he never even touched me.

ZHANG QIANG
A woman as lovely as you, he deserves to miss out. Who told him to be crippled in both legs, can't even stand up.

Zhang Qiang suddenly gasps, his body stiffening. He goes limp.

XIAO MANXI
(panicking)
Brother Qiang? Zhang Qiang! Zhang Qiang!

The door is kicked open. LIANG SHAOQIAN sits in a wheelchair, pushed in by DU SANNIANG.

LIANG SHAOQIAN
(furious)
Xiao Manxi, you shameless woman! How dare you betray me!

XIAO MANXI
(disdainful)
So what if I betrayed you? I only married you because you were the eldest son of the Liang family, destined to inherit the position of sect master, and I would be the sect master's wife. Who would have thought you'd give the position to your younger brother? You're such a coward!

DU SANNIANG
(demanding)
Where is my husband?
continuation:
DU SANNIANG rushes to the bed, sees the dead ZHANG QIANG, and screams in horror.

DU SANNIANG
(breaking down)
You evil Xiao Manxi! A living person, and you actually played him to death! I will make you pay with blood! You can all go to hell together!

DU SANNIANG grabs a dagger from her sleeve and stabs it viciously into XIAO MANXI'S abdomen. XIAO MANXI spits blood.

XIAO JIANING
(rushing in)
Stop! Stop!

XIAO JIANING holds the wounded XIAO MANXI.

XIAO JIANING
(pleading with DU SANNIANG)
Manxi is my sister. Could you please, for my sake, forgive Manxi this time?

XIAO MANXI
(looking at XIAO JIANING with resentment)
Xiao Jianing, I became like this because of you! You clearly married the second son Liang Haochen, so why do you get to be the sect master's wife? It's all you, all you who made me become like this! I will destroy you!

XIAO MANXI grabs the dagger's handle and twists it free. With her dying strength, she slashes it across XIAO JIANING'S neck. XIAO JIANING falls dead, and XIAO MANXI collapses as well.

INT. GREAT HALL - DAY

The hands of a clock spin rapidly backward.

XIAO JIANING suddenly wakes up, finding herself in an antique-styled great hall, with several people sitting around her.

XIAO JIANING (V.O.)
This is... the day I broke off the engagement? I've been reborn?

title: Marriage Exchange
description: A prime minister's wife, killed by her jealous stepsister, is reborn twenty years into the past and given a chance to change her fate.
context:
Title: Marriage Exchange
Description: A prime minister's wife, killed by her jealous stepsister, is reborn twenty years into the past and given a chance to change her fate.

FLASHBACK MONTAGE

INT. LIU RESIDENCE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Prime Minister's wife JIANG ZHITANG, dressed in luxurious robes, walks slowly with a cane, supported by a MAID.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
Twenty years ago, two crimson contracts sealed our fates—my stepsister's and mine.

EXT. RESIDENCE COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

In the rain, JIANG ZHITANG and the MAID walk through the courtyard.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
She chose the warrior's path. I chose the scholar's. Two decisions, one moment of pride.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

The GENERAL fights bravely in the rain, covered in wounds, his sword falling from his grasp.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
The sword shattered on distant battlefields.

INT. PRISON CELL - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Stepsister JIANG WANRU, dressed in rags, clutches the bars with bloodied fingers, her eyes hollow with hunger and rage.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
The brush wrote my name into immortality she could only dream of.
continuation:
EXT. RESIDENCE COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG ZHITANG sits collapsed on the wet ground, trembling, the MAID supporting her.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
While she rotted in prison, my husband rose. When the imperial decree came...

INT. STUDY - DAY (FLASHBACK)

The poor scholar, now the PRIME MINISTER, stands proudly as officials bow.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
...I knelt in robes she believed were hers by right.

EXT. RESIDENCE COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG ZHITANG, dressed in the robes of an imperial lady, kneels to receive the decree.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Hereby conferred the title of First Rank Imperial Lady. By imperial decree!

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
That moment cost me everything.

JIANG WANRU rushes out from behind, holding a gold hairpin, her face twisted with a lifetime's worth of envy as she stabs toward JIANG ZHITANG's neck.

JIANG ZHITANG gasps, blood staining her robes. She falls. JIANG WANRU's laugh dies in her throat as an arrow pierces her chest. She collapses beside her stepsister.

The MAID rushes to JIANG ZHITANG's side, her voice breaking.

MAID
My lady! My lady! Someone help! My lady!

END FLASHBACK MONTAGE

INT. JIANG RESIDENCE - DAY

After a time-reversal effect, JIANG ZHITANG finds herself back in her young maiden's chamber. Her fingers instinctively touch her unblemished neck.

Stepmother LI QIULI sits in the main seat. JIANG ZHITANG and her sister JIANG WANRU stand below.

LI QIULI
Two contracts, two futures. The Xie family offers martial glory. The Liu family... Young Master Liu is a poor scholar, but his examination essays show considerable talent.

JIANG ZHITANG (INTERNAL)
The same words. Twenty years undone. The scar on my neck—gone.

LI QIULI
Zhitang, as the elder sister, you may choose first.

JIANG ZHITANG's hand trembles as she reaches toward the Liu family's marriage contract.

JIANG ZHITANG (INTERNAL)
Unless I choose differently. Unless—

JIANG WANRU suddenly rushes forward.

JIANG WANRU
Mother!
