full_script:
Title: Marriage Exchange
Description: A prime minister's wife, killed by her jealous stepsister, is reborn twenty years into the past and given a chance to change her fate.

FLASHBACK MONTAGE

INT. LIU RESIDENCE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Prime Minister's wife JIANG ZHITANG, dressed in luxurious robes, walks slowly with a cane, supported by a MAID.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
Twenty years ago, two crimson contracts sealed our fates—my stepsister's and mine.

EXT. RESIDENCE COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

In the rain, JIANG ZHITANG and the MAID walk through the courtyard.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
She chose the warrior's path. I chose the scholar's. Two decisions, one moment of pride.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

The GENERAL fights bravely in the rain, covered in wounds, his sword falling from his grasp.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
The sword shattered on distant battlefields.

INT. PRISON CELL - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Stepsister JIANG WANRU, dressed in rags, clutches the bars with bloodied fingers, her eyes hollow with hunger and rage.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
The brush wrote my name into immortality she could only dream of.

EXT. RESIDENCE COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG ZHITANG sits collapsed on the wet ground, trembling, the MAID supporting her.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
While she rotted in prison, my husband rose. When the imperial decree came...

INT. STUDY - DAY (FLASHBACK)

The poor scholar, now the PRIME MINISTER, stands proudly as officials bow.

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
...I knelt in robes she believed were hers by right.

EXT. RESIDENCE COURTYARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

JIANG ZHITANG, dressed in the robes of an imperial lady, kneels to receive the decree.

EUNUCH (O.S.)
Hereby conferred the title of First Rank Imperial Lady. By imperial decree!

JIANG ZHITANG (V.O.)
That moment cost me everything.

JIANG WANRU rushes out from behind, holding a gold hairpin, her face twisted with a lifetime's worth of envy as she stabs toward JIANG ZHITANG's neck.

JIANG ZHITANG gasps, blood staining her robes. She falls. JIANG WANRU's laugh dies in her throat as an arrow pierces her chest. She collapses beside her stepsister.

The MAID rushes to JIANG ZHITANG's side, her voice breaking.

MAID
My lady! My lady! Someone help! My lady!

END FLASHBACK MONTAGE

INT. JIANG RESIDENCE - DAY

After a time-reversal effect, JIANG ZHITANG finds herself back in her young maiden's chamber. Her fingers instinctively touch her unblemished neck.

Stepmother LI QIULI sits in the main seat. JIANG ZHITANG and her sister JIANG WANRU stand below.

LI QIULI
Two contracts, two futures. The Xie family offers martial glory. The Liu family... Young Master Liu is a poor scholar, but his examination essays show considerable talent.

JIANG ZHITANG (INTERNAL)
The same words. Twenty years undone. The scar on my neck—gone.

LI QIULI
Zhitang, as the elder sister, you may choose first.

JIANG ZHITANG's hand trembles as she reaches toward the Liu family's marriage contract.

JIANG ZHITANG (INTERNAL)
Unless I choose differently. Unless—

JIANG WANRU suddenly rushes forward.

JIANG WANRU
Mother!

JIANG WANRU snatches the Liu family's marriage contract, clutching it to her chest with desperate hunger.

JIANG WANRU
I want to marry the Liu family's poor scholar!

JIANG ZHITANG and LI QIULI freeze, staring at her in shock.

title: After the Marriage Swap, My Sister Regrets Everything
description: A successful woman is murdered by her jealous sister at her award ceremony, only to be reborn one year earlier on the day of their arranged marriages, giving her a chance to change their fates.
context:
Title: After the Marriage Swap, My Sister Regrets Everything
Description: A successful woman is murdered by her jealous sister at her award ceremony, only to be reborn one year earlier on the day of their arranged marriages, giving her a chance to change their fates.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY VENUE - NIGHT

Golden confetti rains down. SU LI, elegant in a champagne gown, cradles the Entrepreneur of the Year trophy center stage, her smile genuine but tired.

SU LI (V.O.)
The day I reached the top. Finally.

SU LI traces the trophy's engraving—a moment of quiet triumph. Then her spine straightens. A familiar presence.

SU LI (V.O.)
She couldn't let me have even this.

SU XUE'ER emerges from the wings, stained trench coat over trembling shoulders, a kitchen knife glinting in her white-knuckled grip.

SU LI (V.O.)
My sister. Coming to collect what she thinks I stole.

SU LI's breath catches. She steps back, but the podium blocks her escape.

SU XUE'ER
(whispering, desperate)
It should have been mine.

She lunges. The blade sinks into SU LI's side. No scream—just a sharp exhale. SU LI clutches the wound, crimson blooming between her fingers. She collapses, the trophy clattering beside her.

SU XUE'ER stares at her bloody hands, a sob-choked laugh escaping.

A BODYGUARD vaults onstage, weapon drawn. One shot.

SU XUE'ER jerks, crumples beside her sister. Their eyes lock—one filled with regret, the other with resignation.

ON SCREEN: What if we could choose again?

The image fractures like shattered glass. Time rewinds.

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

One year earlier. A lavish garden wedding. SU LI and SU XUE'ER stand in identical gowns, but their postures tell different stories—SU LI rigid with duty, SU XUE'ER practically vibrating with anticipation.

SU LI (V.O.)
We stood here once. Before everything burned.

SU XUE'ER beams as she clasps the red silk with JI HAN ZHOU, the tech mogul in his wheelchair, his smile thin and unreadable.
continuation:
INT. HUMBLE WEDDING ROOM - DAY

SU LI sits beside JIANG HAO on a creaking bed, red double happiness peeling at the corners. He offers her tea with careful, calloused hands.

JIANG HAO
(quietly)
I'll make this right. Somehow.

SU LI studies his earnest face, almost believing him.

INT. BOARDROOM - NIGHT

JI HAN ZHOU's empire collapses. Bankers pound the table. SU XUE'ER barges in, hair wild, as a notification lights up her phone: ASSETS FROZEN.

INT. BURNING PENTHOUSE - NIGHT

Flames consume Ji Corporation's headquarters. SU XUE'ER claws at the window, watching her diamond bracelet melt into slag. She laughs, high and broken.

SU XUE'ER
(to the flames)
I chose this! I chose him!

EXT. SNOWY STREET - NIGHT

SU XUE'ER huddles in a designer coat turned inside-out, the label hidden. She shoves her last possession—a gold wedding band—at a street vendor, who tosses it back: "Fake."

INT. AWARD CEREMONY VENUE - DAY

JIANG HAO stands stage-side, filming SU LI's speech on his phone, pride and something like fear in his eyes. She catches his gaze mid-sentence, falters, then smiles for real.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY VENUE - NIGHT

Blood spreads across the stage. SU LI's vision tunnels. Her fingers find the trophy—cold, meaningless.

SU LI (V.O.)
Jiang Hao's empire. My empire. We built it from nothing. She destroyed it from spite.

The shattered glass effect intensifies.

INT. SU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

SU LI gasps, jerking upright on the sofa. White dress. Living parents. The scent of her mother's perfume—suffocatingly familiar.

SU MOTHER (O.S.)
—listening? Honestly, Su Li, you're so—

SU MOTHER and SU FATHER loom over her, faces rearranged into concerned masks.

SU MOTHER
That poor boy is waiting downstairs. You'll do as you're told.

SU FATHER
(tamping his pipe, not looking up)
Xue'er's made her choice. Don't embarrass us.

SU LI's knuckles whiten on the sofa arm. The phantom pain lingers.

SU LI (V.O.)
The fire. Jiang Hao's first algorithm. The date on the newspaper. All here. All real.

SU MOTHER
(leaning close, voice syrupy)
Be a good daughter. Your sister deserves this chance.

SU LI's eyes lift. Not to her mother—to the family portrait above the mantle. Her own face, carefully blurred in the background.

SU LI (V.O.)
Or maybe I deserve it.

SU LI stands. Her spine straightens with a deliberation that makes her parents exchange a glance.

SU LI
Let me marry Ji Han Zhou.

SU FATHER's pipe freezes mid-tamp. SU MOTHER's smile cracks.

SU XUE'ER appears in the doorway, pink dress too tight, victory already written on her face until she hears the words.

SU XUE'ER
What? No—I'll take Jiang Hao.

Her voice is too quick. Desperate. She catches herself, smooths her expression.

SU XUE'ER
(carefully, to her parents)
He's... more suitable. For me.

SU LI watches her sister twist the narrative. The trophy's phantom weight in her hand. The knife's phantom pain in her side.

SU LI
Then it's settled.

She extends her hand—not to her parents, to SU XUE'ER. A mirror of the red silk ritual.

SU LI
Sisters shouldn't fight over fate.

SU XUE'ER stares at the offered hand like it's a weapon.

title: Moving to the Next Station After Shift Change
description: A nurse switches shifts with a colleague, but a pregnant woman dies on her watch, leading to accusations and a desperate search for the truth.
context:
Title: Moving to the Next Station After Shift Change
Description: A nurse switches shifts with a colleague, but a pregnant woman dies on her watch, leading to accusations and a desperate search for the truth.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD/CORRIDOR - DAY

LIN MENGRAN (V.O.)
I switched night shifts with a colleague. By dawn, a pregnant woman was dead.

LI JUNXIONG rushes toward LIN MENGRAN, seizes her throat, and slams her against the wall.

LI JUNXIONG
(furious, trembling)
The duty roster had your name! My wife called for help—three times! You killed her. You killed our child!

LIN MENGRAN
(choking, desperate)
No! I traded with Chen Qingyuan. Check the sign-out log!

One day earlier.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

The HEAD NURSE briefs LIN MENGRAN and CHEN QINGYUAN. A PREGNANT WOMAN rests in bed 502.

HEAD NURSE
Room 502—high-risk primigravida. Any contractions, any bleeding, you page Dr. Wu immediately. No exceptions.

CHEN QINGYUAN
(glancing at Lin)
I'll monitor her closely, Head Nurse.

LIN MENGRAN
Yes, Head Nurse.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

LIN MENGRAN works at the nurses' station. ZHANG CHENGFA enters with red roses; CHEN QINGYUAN follows.

ZHANG CHENGFA
Mengran.

CHEN QINGYUAN
Surprise.

ZHANG CHENGFA kneels and presents the roses.

ZHANG CHENGFA
Three years. Imperial Hotel, eight o'clock. I've booked our table.

LIN MENGRAN
(torn)
I can't. Bed 502 is high-risk—I promised Head Nurse.

ZHANG CHENGFA
(insistent)
Qingyuan worked high-risk obstetrics at County Hospital. She's more than qualified.

CHEN QINGYUAN
(smiling)
Sister Mengran, I've covered for you before. Go celebrate. I'll handle everything.

LIN MENGRAN looks between them, then signs the shift-change form. CHEN QINGYUAN's eyes linger on her signature.

LIN MENGRAN (V.O.)
Chen Qingyuan had been Zhang Chengfa's friend since childhood. I should have noticed how her smile never reached her eyes.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Back to present. LI JUNXIONG still grips LIN MENGRAN. Detective ZHAO YANG intervenes.

ZHAO YANG
(official, firm)
Release her. Now.

ZHAO YANG separates them, flashes his badge.

ZHAO YANG
Homicide division. You assault her again, you're under arrest. Clear?

LI JUNXIONG
(shaking, tearful)
The duty nurse ignored her. She bled out while someone played on their phone!

He plays a voice memo. The PREGNANT WOMAN's voice is weak, terrified.

PREGNANT WOMAN (O.S.)
(barely audible)
Junxiong... she won't help. Says I'm being dramatic. Please... I'm so cold.

LI JUNXIONG
(pointing at Lin)
Her name was on the roster!

LIN MENGRAN
(urgent)
I signed off at 19:00. Check the surveillance!

ZHAO YANG
(to Lin)
Ward cameras?

LIN MENGRAN
Bed 502 has a dedicated monitor. It records everything.

ZHAO YANG
(to everyone)
We're reviewing it now. All of you.

INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - DAY

Everyone clusters around a monitor. Timestamp: 02:47 AM.

ON SCREEN: The PREGNANT WOMAN crawls from her bed, leaving a trail of fluid. She reaches the nurses' station.

PREGNANT WOMAN
(gasping)
Nurse... please...

The NURSE ON DUTY faces away, head down, phone glowing.

NURSE ON DUTY
(annoyed)
Can't you see I'm on break?

PREGNANT WOMAN
I'm bleeding... help...

NURSE ON DUTY
(into phone, excited)
Pentakill! Yes!

She stands, triumphantly raising both hands. The camera catches her face: CHEN QINGYUAN.

LI JUNXIONG
(roaring)
You—YOU killed her!

LI JUNXIONG lunges for LIN MENGRAN. The scene freezes on her face—recognizing the trap.

TO BE CONTINUED

title: Untitled Revenge Drama
description: A man abandoned by his father exacts revenge on those who wronged him and his late mother.
context:
Title: Untitled Revenge Drama
Description: A man abandoned by his father exacts revenge on those who wronged him and his late mother.

ON SCREEN: Country A, Tai City

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

FU JINGNIAN sits in a chair, smoking a cigar. He wears a black suit, his expression controlled, unreadable.

A WOMAN is pressed across a stone table by his subordinates, her face twisted with hatred.

WOMAN
Fu Jingnian!

WOMAN
Twenty years rotting in this valley, and you crawl back now? Your father cast you out like refuse, cast out that wheelchair-bound mother. You were never worthy of the Fu name!

FU JINGNIAN lightly flicks ash from his cigar. A BESPECTACLED SUBORDINATE offers an ashtray.

FU JINGNIAN
Continue.

WOMAN
That fire should have erased both of you!

FU JINGNIAN's hand stills. He rises slowly, accepting a dagger from a subordinate.

WOMAN
(screaming)
Ah!

FU JINGNIAN drives the dagger through her palm, pinning it to the table.

FU JINGNIAN
(coldly smiling)
Thank you. The fire forged me. Taught me what this family truly is.

He twists the blade. She screams again, voice breaking.

FU JINGNIAN
continuation:
(grabbing her chin)
You will remember my mother. Every moment you pray for death.

The WOMAN struggles, terror replacing her rage.

BESPECTACLED SUBORDINATE
President Fu.

ANOTHER SUBORDINATE
Orders?

WOMAN
(whispering)
Please... no...

FU JINGNIAN takes a syringe from a subordinate's hand and injects it into the woman's neck. She goes limp.

FU JINGNIAN
(to subordinates)
East wing. Keep her conscious.

The subordinates drag the woman away. Fu Jingnian wipes his hands with a handkerchief, his composure settling back into place.

BESPECTACLED SUBORDINATE
The lakefront assembly. The dancer.

FU JINGNIAN
(quietly)
I know.

EXT. LAKESIDE DOCK - DAY

LU WENSHENG dances on the dock in a white dress, her movements hypnotic. People surround her, applauding.

FU JINGNIAN watches from a distance. His mask slips—surprise, recognition, a flicker of something like regret.

FU JINGNIAN (V.O.)
Lu Wensheng. Daughter of my enemy. Mirror of my mother's grace.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

Description: A talented artist abroad finds herself trapped in a possessive relationship with a powerful CEO who will stop at nothing to keep her under his control.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

ON SCREEN: Overseas City C

GU MANQING and her SENIOR sit facing each other.

SENIOR hands GU MANQING a certificate.

SENIOR
Swiss gold. They wanted you at the ceremony.

GU MANQING takes the certificate, a flicker of a smile.

GU MANQING
This is enough.

GU MANQING's hand trembles, knocking over her cup.

SENIOR
Let me, let me.

SENIOR picks up a napkin to help wipe, his hand touching GU MANQING's hand.

SENIOR
Some habits never change.

ON SCREEN: SHEN JUN - CEO of Shen Group

SHEN JUN, wearing a dark suit and accompanied by a group of BODYGUARDS in black, walks into the coffee shop with a grim expression. He sees the intimate gesture of SENIOR and GU MANQING's hands touching, and his eyes turn even colder.

SHEN JUN walks straight toward GU MANQING's table.

SENIOR senses something is wrong and looks up at SHEN JUN.

SENIOR
(to GU MANQING)
Manqing?

SHEN JUN stands by the table, looking down at GU MANQING condescendingly.

SHEN JUN
You've been stationary too long.

SHEN JUN pulls GU MANQING up and draws her into his arms.

SHEN JUN
Time to go home.

SENIOR stands up.

SENIOR
Who are you? What are you doing? Let her go!

SHEN JUN's BODYGUARDS immediately step forward and pin SENIOR down on the table, immobilizing him.

SHEN JUN
(to Senior)
Don't miss your flight.

SHEN JUN leaves with GU MANQING.
continuation:
INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

SHEN JUN and GU MANQING return home.

GU MANQING
There's nothing between us. He's just a senior from school who came to give me my award certificate.

SHEN JUN's expression is cold, but his movements are gentle as he supports GU MANQING's shoulders.

SHEN JUN
I believe you. Sit down.

SHEN JUN has GU MANQING sit on the sofa.

SHEN JUN
I have a gift for you.

A BODYGUARD hands over a small wooden box. SHEN JUN takes it and places it in front of GU MANQING.

GU MANQING opens the box with confusion. Upon seeing what's inside, her face instantly turns deathly pale, her eyes filled with terror. Inside the box are three severed fingers in preservative fluid.

SHEN JUN (V.O.)
These are the three fingers he used to touch you today.

GU MANQING looks at her own hand in horror.

SHEN JUN embraces the trembling GU MANQING from behind.

SHEN JUN
Don't be afraid. Don't be afraid.

title: Groom Marries Bridesmaid After Dowry Demands
description: A groom faces excessive demands during the wedding pickup ceremony from his bride's family, who keep raising the stakes for money.
context:
Title: Groom Marries Bridesmaid After Dowry Demands
Description: A groom faces excessive demands during the wedding pickup ceremony from his bride's family, who keep raising the stakes for money.

EXT. VILLA - DAY

CHEN GE stares at a table lined with forty shot glasses of baijiu. The GROOMSMAN hovers nearby.

CHEN GE (O.S.)
This much?

GROOMSMAN
If he finishes drinking all this, will the wedding even be able to continue?

MOTHER-IN-LAW blocks the villa entrance, flanked by BROTHER-IN-LAW.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
If he can't show his sincerity, how can I feel at ease giving my daughter to him?

CHEN GE
Mom, can we discuss this? There's really too much alcohol here.

BROTHER-IN-LAW
If you want to be my brother-in-law, you can't fail to withstand even this small test, right?

GROOMSMAN
Bro, let me drink it for you.

BROTHER-IN-LAW
He has to drink all this alcohol by himself. No one can help.

GROOMSMAN
But this...

BROTHER-IN-LAW
Stop dawdling. My sister is still waiting upstairs. Drink up!

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Can't even drink this little bit of alcohol.

FEMALE RELATIVE
Can you even call yourself a man?

MALE RELATIVE
Drink up!

GROOMSMAN
You people!

CHEN GE stops the agitated GROOMSMAN.

CHEN GE
I'll drink.

He walks to the table. At the window above, XIAO XIA watches impassively. MEI (the bridesmaid) stands near the GROOMSMAN, hands clenched.

CHEN GE picks up a glass, downs it. Then another. And another.

BROTHER-IN-LAW
Hurry up, brother-in-law. You're dawdling after just a few glasses. My sister is still waiting upstairs.

CHEN GE continues, face reddening. He stumbles, coughs violently.

GROOMSMAN
(supporting CHEN GE)
Chen Ge, stop! They're deliberately making things difficult.

CHEN GE
Xiao Xia is carrying my child. For our baby... I have to drink.

BROTHER-IN-LAW
Right, for my sister, keep drinking!

CHEN GE pushes the GROOMSMAN away, drinking faster. His hands shake.

BROTHER-IN-LAW
Brother-in-law, drink faster!

CHEN GE spits out his twentieth glass, collapses vomiting.

GROOMSMAN
(rushing forward)
Chen Ge! Chen Ge, are you okay?

BROTHER-IN-LAW
Hey, the one he spit out doesn't count. Twenty more to go.

GROOMSMAN
(angrily)
He's in this condition, forget the rest!

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Forget it? We're not even married yet and you're already brushing me off?

GROOMSMAN
Chen Ge can't take it anymore, what more do you want?

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Simple. Twenty more glasses. Ten thousand per glass. Two hundred thousand to buy out.

GROOMSMAN
So this is what you were waiting for. The dowry was three-sixty! This is extortion!
continuation:
MOTHER-IN-LAW
Call it family tradition.

BROTHER-IN-LAW
What family can't come up with two hundred thousand for a wedding?

MOTHER-IN-LAW
You've built three companies and haven't saved that much?

CHEN GE
(weakly)
Go get it.

GROOMSMAN
Chen Ge, that's the wedding gift money for the banquet—

CHEN GE
Just get it. Please.

The GROOMSMAN runs to the car, returns with a suitcase and black bag. MEI watches, tears falling.

GROOMSMAN
Two hundred thousand.

He takes out bound cash stacks. BROTHER-IN-LAW and MOTHER-IN-LAW snatch them, counting greedily.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(beaming)
That's more like it. Go upstairs then.

BROTHER-IN-LAW
(whispering)
Mom, I saw at least half a million in that bag.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(whispering)
Hush. The Bentley, the public company—we'll get the rest after the ceremony.

They share a predatory smile. The GROOMSMAN helps CHEN GE up the steps.

The villa door opens. XIAO XIA stands there in her wedding gown, but her eyes are cold.

XIAO XIA
You took so long. Mom texted me. You shorted us twenty thousand on the dowry. The gold sets could've been heavier.

CHEN GE
(whispering)
What?

XIAO XIA
But since you're willing to make it up...

She holds out her hand. CHEN GE stares at her, then at her belly. Something breaks in his eyes.

CHEN GE
(to GROOMSMAN)
Call my lawyer. Halt the property transfer. Prepare a media statement. I'm withdrawing.

XIAO XIA
You can't—

CHEN GE
You're not pregnant, Xiao Xia. I saw your medical report last month. The clinic is in my company's portfolio.

XIAO XIA pales. MOTHER-IN-LAW bursts forward.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
What nonsense is this? After all we've—

CHEN GE
(turning to MEI)
You knew. You tried to tell me. Three times.

MEI
(trembling)
I couldn't betray her. She's my cousin. But I couldn't let you—

CHEN GE
My driver has a luggage cart upstairs. Get your things. We're leaving.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
She's just the bridesmaid! You can't—

CHEN GE
Watch me.

He takes MEI's hand. She looks at XIAO XIA, then at CHEN GE, and nods.

CHEN GE
(to MOTHER-IN-LAW)
Keep the cash. Buy yourselves a conscience.

He descends the steps with MEI and the GROOMSMAN. Behind them, XIAO XIA screams, MOTHER-IN-LAW curses. At the car, CHEN GE stops.

CHEN GE
Your apartment's small. And a cat.

MEI
(smiling through tears)
As long as the cat doesn't ask for two hundred thousand.

They get in the Bentley. It drives away, leaving the family on the steps clutching their cash and a shattered lie.

title: Embracing the Moon Over Nanzhou
description: A woman with intellectual disabilities is rescued by a powerful man from her abusive family who tried to sell her.
context:
Title: Embracing the Moon Over Nanzhou
Description: A woman with intellectual disabilities is rescued by a powerful man from her abusive family who tried to sell her.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

SONG LANYUE cowers against the headboard, blood seeping through crooked gauze. She clutches a crumpled photograph, humming a broken tune.
A FAT MAN leers down, his belt unbuckled.

FAT MAN
Your mommy already spent the money. Time to collect.

EXT. OUTSIDE VILLA - DAY

A black Bentley stops at a rusted gate. SONG'S MOTHER and SONG'S BROTHER wait.

SONG'S MOTHER
(whispering)
Another mark. Double the price.

The DRIVER opens the door. SHI NANZHOU steps out, flanked by BODYGUARDS. One carries a leather folio.

SHI NANZHOU
Song Lanyue. Where.

SONG'S BROTHER
Who're you?

SONG'S MOTHER blocks his path.

SONG'S MOTHER
Private property! Son, call the police!

A BODYGUARD crushes the Brother's phone with one hand.

SHI NANZHOU
The marriage license is legal. I'm taking my wife.

He walks past, another BODYGUARD already picking the villa lock.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

The FAT MAN pins SONG LANYUE's wrists. The door SPLINTERS open—kicked from its frame.
BODYGUARDS haul him screaming off the bed.
SHI NANZHOU enters, spots the photograph on the floor: his face, crudely pasted beside Song Lanyue's.

FAT MAN
My brother runs the docks!

SHI NANZHOU
(to Bodyguards)
His hands first. Then his brother's.

The Fat Man drops to his knees.

FAT MAN
Please! Her mother sold her! I have papers!

SHI NANZHOU's eyes stay on SONG LANYUE. He gestures. The BODYGUARDS gag the Fat Man and drag him out.

SHI NANZHOU approaches. SONG LANYUE swings at him. He catches her wrist, seeing the bruises.

SONG LANYUE
(whispering)
Husband... the picture promised you'd save Yueyue.

SHI NANZHOU
That picture lied.

SONG'S MOTHER and BROTHER burst in.

SONG'S MOTHER
You can't just—

She stops. A BODYGUARD holds her bamboo cane.

SHI NANZHOU
(softly, to Song Lanyue)
How?

SONG LANYUE
Stick stick. Here. Here. Here. Mommy says I'm a mistake. No food for mistakes.

SONG'S MOTHER
I made you! I can break you!

She lunges. The BODYGUARD snaps the cane.

SONG'S BROTHER
Triple price. Cash. Or we call the real cops.

SHI NANZHOU
Zhou Rui.

ZHOU RUI steps forward.

ZHOU RUI
Boss.

SHI NANZHOU
Document everything. Hundredfold.

Zhou Rui nods. The BODYGUARDS produce flex-cuffs and tablets.

SHI NANZHOU lifts SONG LANYUE. She goes stiff, then melts against his shoulder.

SONG LANYUE
Where is Yueyue's home?

SHI NANZHOU
Where mistakes don't exist.

He carries her out. Behind them, Zhou Rui activates a voice recorder.

ZHOU RUI
"Unlawful confinement. Assault. Fraud..."

The words follow them like a vow.

title: The Regent's Unforgettable Love (Episode 38)
description: A regent mourns his childhood promise as war claims the family of the woman he loves, forcing him into a deadly political game to save her from a forced marriage.
context:
Title: The Regent's Unforgettable Love (Episode 38)
Description: A regent mourns his childhood promise as war claims the family of the woman he loves, forcing him into a deadly political game to save her from a forced marriage.

INT. FOREST PATH - DAY

Wide shot: several cavalrymen gallop frantically through a muddy forest path.

SOLDIER
Miss! The vanguard's cut off—the General ordered us to fall back! No reinforcements!

ZHOU MINGYAN rides on a white horse, her expression resolute.

ZHOU MINGYAN
(shouting)
Fall back to the ridge! We'll punch through from the west!

They charge through a wall of fire. An explosion throws ZHOU MINGYAN from her horse.

ZHOU MINGYAN (V.O.)
The ridge... Father said he'd hold the ridge.

ZHOU MINGYAN rises from the ground and rushes into the war-torn battlefield. She wields her spear, fighting fiercely against the enemy.

After intense combat, she arrives at the center of the devastated battlefield and sees her father lying on the ground.

ZHOU MINGYAN
(grief-stricken)
Your sword... you promised to show me the thirty-sixth stroke.

Several enemy soldiers roar as they charge toward her.

ENEMY SOLDIERS
Take the Zhou bitch's head!

ZHOU MINGYAN's eyes fill with tears, but they crystallize into something harder. She grabs her spear, her movements precise and brutal, each strike ending an enemy.

The battle ends. ZHOU MINGYAN stands alone on the corpse-strewn, smoke-filled battlefield, her eyes hollowed by firelight.

ON SCREEN: Great Xia - Princess Ning'an - Zhou Mingyan
continuation:
INT. REGENT'S STUDY - NIGHT

JUN WUHUAN sits at his desk, caressing a scroll painting—a younger ZHOU MINGYAN, grinning with a wooden sword.

ZHOU MINGYAN (V.O.)
(child's voice, singing off-key)
Drink it up, drink it up, or I'll never marry you!

JUN WUHUAN (V.O.)
Ten years. You've become the woman in this painting. And I've become the poison you tried to sweeten.

His subordinate MO YU rushes in, breathing hard.

MO YU
The Zhou men—both fallen. Our palace guards with them. Only Mo Ying's body wasn't found.

JUN WUHUAN freezes. He slams his fist on the desk—something cracks. Blood dots the scroll painting.

MO YU
Your Highness, the physician said—

JUN WUHUAN braces himself against the table and stands, blood pooling at the corner of his mouth.

JUN WUHUAN
Ayan?

MO YU
She took the Beiluo Marshal's head. Now King Wanyan offers peace—if his new bride comes with it.

JUN WUHUAN
(eyes cold)
He doesn't want a bride. He wants a scapegoat to hang our war crimes on. And the Emperor wants an excuse to erase the Zhou name.

MO YU
The palace guard is being repositioned. Quietly.

JUN WUHUAN's hand closes around the scroll.

JUN WUHUAN
Then we'd better be louder. Carriage. Now.

ZHOU MINGYAN's eyes fill with tears, but they crystallize into something harder. She grabs her spear, her movements precise and brutal, each strike ending an enemy.

The battle ends. ZHOU MINGYAN stands alone on the corpse-strewn, smoke-filled battlefield, her eyes hollowed by firelight.

ON SCREEN: Great Xia - Princess Ning'an - Zhou Mingyan

INT. REGENT'S STUDY - NIGHT

JUN WUHUAN sits at his desk, caressing a scroll painting—a younger ZHOU MINGYAN, grinning with a wooden sword.

ZHOU MINGYAN (V.O.)
(child's voice, singing off-key)
Drink it up, drink it up, or I'll never marry you!

JUN WUHUAN (V.O.)
Ten years. You've become the woman in this painting. And I've become the poison you tried to sweeten.

His subordinate MO YU rushes in, breathing hard.

MO YU
The Zhou men—both fallen. Our palace guards with them. Only Mo Ying's body wasn't found.

JUN WUHUAN freezes. He slams his fist on the desk—something cracks. Blood dots the scroll painting.

MO YU
Your Highness, the physician said—

JUN WUHUAN braces himself against the table and stands, blood pooling at the corner of his mouth.

JUN WUHUAN
Ayan?

MO YU
She took the Beiluo Marshal's head. Now King Wanyan offers peace—if his new bride comes with it.

JUN WUHUAN
(eyes cold)
He doesn't want a bride. He wants a scapegoat to hang our war crimes on. And the Emperor wants an excuse to erase the Zhou name.

MO YU
The palace guard is being repositioned. Quietly.

JUN WUHUAN's hand closes around the scroll.

JUN WUHUAN
Then we'd better be louder. Carriage. Now.

title: The Old Friend's Last Visit
description: A mysterious woman arrives at the Zhou family estate on a rainy day, claiming to be the only person the dying patriarch has been waiting for.
context:
Title: The Old Friend's Last Visit
Description: A mysterious woman arrives at the Zhou family estate on a rainy day, claiming to be the only person the dying patriarch has been waiting for.

EXT. ZHOU FAMILY ESTATE - DAY

A cold rain hammers the ancient Zhou family mansion gate. The plaque reading "Zhou Residence" barely gleams through the downpour.

A woman in an elegant cheongsam with a white knit cardigan, YUN SHA, holds an oil-paper umbrella and climbs the steps without hurry.

She lifts the door knocker and lets it fall. The impact echoes like a temple bell.

The door cracks open. A BUTLER in a long robe peers out.

BUTLER
The family is in mourning. We receive no one.

YUN SHA
I'm here to see Zhou Cangshan.

BUTLER
(eyes narrowing)
His name is not for strangers. Identify yourself.

Yun Sha tilts her umbrella. A jade cicada hairpin gleams at her temple.

BUTLER
(voice trembling)
That pin... please. Come in.

YUN SHA
You're wrong. Without seeing me, he won't release that last breath. If you want him to find peace, step aside.

BUTLER (V.O.)
Three months at death's door. He clings to something. Or someone...

BUTLER
(respectfully)
Miss, please enter. I'll announce you at once.

YUN SHA closes her umbrella and steps inside.
continuation:
EXT. ZHOU ESTATE COURTYARD - BAMBOO PATH - DAY

The Butler leads Yun Sha along a path where bamboo stalks bow under the rain's weight.

BUTLER
Please wait here, miss.

He hurries away, glancing back once at the hairpin.

Yun Sha stands alone in the bamboo grove. Rainwater streams off her umbrella's edge, writing temporary characters in the mud that the storm instantly erases.

YUN SHA (V.O.)
(barely a whisper)
Bean Sprout. You're going ahead after all.

INT. MASTER ZHOU'S BEDROOM - DAY

MASTER ZHOU lies in bed, eyes closed, his breathing a thin thread pulled taut.

Beside the bed, his two sons keep vigil. ZHOU YUAN holds his father's hand; ZHOU XIANG sits slumped in a corner chair.

ZHOU YUAN
(voice cracking)
Three months. Everyone's come. Everyone you've ever known.

He bows his head to his father's knuckles.

ZHOU YUAN
(whispering)
Just... stop fighting. Please.

The BUTLER rushes in, his shoes leaving wet marks on the pristine floor.

BUTLER
First Master, Second Master - a visitor.

ZHOU YUAN
(not looking up)
No more.

BUTLER
She wears the cicada. The one from the old master's sketches.

Zhou Yuan's head snaps up. In the corner, Zhou Xiang rises from his chair.

On the bed, Master Zhou's closed eyes move rapidly beneath paper-thin lids.

title: Sprinkling Sugar
description: On her wedding day, a woman awakens in a hospital to discover her fiancé is draining her blood to save his mistress—triggering fragmented memories of betrayal and awakening a vengeful resolve.
context:
Title: Sprinkling Sugar
Description: On her wedding day, a woman awakens in a hospital to discover her fiancé is draining her blood to save his mistress—triggering fragmented memories of betrayal and awakening a vengeful resolve.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

CLOSE ON a needle piercing skin. Dark red blood flows through a tube into a collection bag.

Widen to reveal JIANG YU (28, bridal makeup smudged) unconscious in a hospital gown, a wedding tiara still tangled in her hair. Her complexion is alarmingly pale.

NURSE (40s, harried) monitors the transfusion, her hands trembling.

The DOCTOR (50s, exhausted) bursts in, chart in hand.

DOCTOR
That's her third unit in an hour! Her pressure's already seventy over forty—

CHU KAI (32, tailored suit, flawless) stands flanked by two BODYGUARDS. His expression is ice.

CHU KAI
Then start a pressor. I need two more units before the specialist arrives.

DOCTOR
Sir, she's your fiancée. If you drain her dry, there won't be a wedding.

CHU KAI
There never will be. As long as she breathes, she'll keep Yingying alive.

Jiang Yu's eyes snap open. She gasps—a ragged, wet sound.

CHU KAI
(to Nurse)
Continue.

The Nurse shoots a desperate glance at the Doctor.

JIANG YU
(weak, disoriented)
Kai...?

CHU KAI
(Smiling placidly)
You're awake. Good. Saves me the paperwork.
continuation:
EXT. BRIDGE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

JIANG YU, radiant in her wedding dress, sprints through billowing smoke. Her veil tears free.

XIA YINGTONG (29, red silk dress, immaculate) emerges from the haze, holding a syringe.

XIA YINGTONG
Stop running, little nurse. You'll only die tired.

JIANG YU
(Panting)
Kai loves me.

XIA YINGTONG
He loves what you can do for him. Your rare blood type. Your medical connections. But I can give him a child.

She touches her own flat stomach.

XIA YINGTONG
Or I could have. Until you "accidentally" mixed my prenatal vitamins with oxytocin.

JIANG YU
(horrified)
I would never—I'm a doctor!

XIA YINGTONG
Exactly. Who else would know how to cause a miscarriage so perfectly?

A MAN IN BLACK steps from the shadows, baseball bat in hand.

XIA YINGTONG
Make it look like a suicide. Broken bride, jumped from the bridge.

JIANG YU
(Crying out)
Someone help—

The bat swings. Impact. Jiang Yu crumples.

FROM ABOVE: The three figures stand over her motionless body. Jiang Yu's blood begins to glow faintly—then fades.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY (PRESENT)

Jiang Yu jolts, clutching her head. Her fingers brush raised letters on a medical bracelet: "DU LANG—VIP PATIENT."

Her vision blurs—memories overlaying like double exposure:

—A masked woman in black, her hands healing wounds with golden light.

—The same woman, cornered, swallowing a small jade pendant.

—Her own voice: "If I die, the secret dies with me."

Jiang Yu stares at her own hands. They glow faintly. The sensation is familiar. Terrifying. Right.

CHU KAI
(to Doctor)
Prep the fourth unit. Yingying's waiting.

Jiang Yu's fingers close around the IV pole. She sits up, steady despite the blood loss. Her voice is different—older, colder.

JIANG YU
You'll take no more from this body.

CHU KAI
(turning, amused)
Oh? And you'll stop me?

JIANG YU
I will. Because I'm not the woman you tried to kill.

She pulls the needle from her arm in one fluid motion. The wound seals instantly, glowing faintly.

JIANG YU
I'm the one who just remembered how to bury you.

SUPERIMPOSED TEXT: TO BE CONTINUED

title: After Letting Go, The Scumbag Begs Me For Forgiveness
description: A former heiress, now sick and destitute, confronts her ex-lover on his wedding day, seeking help for her illness while uncovering the truth of her downfall.
context:
Title: After Letting Go, The Scumbag Begs Me For Forgiveness
Description: A former heiress, now sick and destitute, confronts her ex-lover on his wedding day, seeking help for her illness while uncovering the truth of her downfall.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

MU NINGNING stumbles forward, her face pale, clutching a medical report. She gasps for breath as a passing patient nears—she flinches, crashing into the wall. Pain doubles her over. She leans there, trembling.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

MU NINGNING sits across from the DOCTOR.

DOCTOR
Your balance is sixty thousand in arrears. The pharmacy won't release your ART.

MU NINGNING
(voice thin)
My mother's estate—

DOCTOR
—was liquidated two years ago. The hospital isn't a charity.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

MU NINGNING leans against the wall, a tear sliding down. She opens the report: "HIV Antibody Positive" in bold type. She crumples it, then forces it flat, smoothing the paper with obsessive care.

INT. NURSE STATION - DAY

MU NINGNING passes the nurse station. TWO NURSES gossip, not bothering to whisper.

NURSE A
That's Mu Ningning? The one whose mother built this wing?

NURSE B
Now look at her. AIDS, broke, and alone.

NURSE A
I heard she gave everything to some man.

NURSE B
The Horizon Group CEO. He Jingchen.

Mu Ningning freezes mid-step, then keeps walking.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - DAY

The TV broadcasts news. Photos of HE JINGCHEN and FANG JINGYI in evening wear.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
He Jingchen, Horizon Group's youngest billionaire, and fiancée Fang Jingyi prepare for their wedding at Wanhao Grand Hotel...

Mu Ningning watches from the shadows. She looks down at her phone—cracked screen, eviction notice in her texts. She twists the jade bracelet on her wrist, a gift from her mother. She doesn't take it off.

EXT. WEDDING HOTEL ENTRANCE - DAY

MU NINGNING approaches the service entrance. A BODYGUARD blocks her path.

BODYGUARD
Private event. Move along.

She tries to dart past. He shoves her back—she falls hard against a marble planter. Blood trickles from her palm.

The main doors open.

HE JINGCHEN and FANG JINGYI emerge—him in a suit, her in a silk robe over her wedding dress, phone in hand as if interrupted.

HE JINGCHEN
Mu Ningning?

MU NINGNING
(struggling up)
He Jingchen. Please. Just five minutes.

FANG JINGYI
(contemptuous)
She's here for money. Isn't that right?

MU NINGNING
The company transfer. You signed for my medical trust.

HE JINGCHEN
(leaning against the wall)
That trust was contingent on you remaining an employee. You quit, remember?

MU NINGNING
You told me to sign over my shares first. Then you'd marry me.

FANG JINGYI
And you believed him? How pathetic.

MU NINGNING
(to He Jingchen)
I have nothing left. Just lend me enough for the medication. I'll disappear.

HE JINGCHEN
Nothing left? You have your mother's jade.

Her hand flies to the bracelet.

HE JINGCHEN (CONT'D)
But that's not enough. You want my money, you earn it.

He takes out a black card. Waves it slowly.

HE JINGCHEN (CONT'D)
Kneel. Lick my shoe clean. Then we'll discuss your allowance.

Mu Ningning stares at him. For the first time, her tears stop. Something behind her eyes hardens.

Her knees begin to bend.

title: No Kin in Homeland, Wind on the Road Home
description: A young woman becomes China's youngest female billionaire and announces her retirement to return to her village, seeking to honor her late parents and repay the community that raised her.
context:
Title: No Kin in Homeland, Wind on the Road Home
Description: A young woman becomes China's youngest female billionaire and announces her retirement to return to her village, seeking to honor her late parents and repay the community that raised her.

INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

The camera follows the footsteps of a woman in a white suit (CHENG YUE) as she walks confidently through the lobby.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Breaking news: At just thirty-four, Cheng Yue has become China's youngest self-made billionaire, and the first woman to top the wealth rankings in three decades.

A group of REPORTERS swarm forward, surrounding CHENG YUE.

REPORTER 1
Ms. Cheng! Congratulations. The market expected you to expand overseas next. What's your move?

CHENG YUE
(smiling)
I'm retiring. Effective today.

The reporters are in an uproar, looking at each other in confusion.

REPORTER 2
You're stepping down completely? Not even advisory roles?

CHENG YUE
I'm going home. To farm.

The reporters are even more shocked. CHENG YUE leaves under the escort of BODYGUARDS, with reporters chasing after her.

REPORTER 2
Will you maintain any business interests?

CHENG YUE and her entourage get into a row of black sedans. The convoy drives away.
continuation:
INT. SEDAN - DAY

CHENG YUE sits in the back seat, gazing out at the city she helped build. Her assistant SUN TIAN sits in the passenger seat.

SUN TIAN
The relocation permits are approved. The new burial site is prepared. But Ms. Cheng, are you certain about moving them? Some might see it as...

CHENG YUE
(quietly)
When they died, I had nothing to give them. Now I can. That's all that matters.

SUN TIAN
The villagers... they've received the agricultural equipment and the investment fund. But this relocation—it's costing millions. More than anyone would spend.

CHENG YUE
(closing her eyes)
Then it's enough.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY (FLASHBACK)

A simple tombstone reads: "Cheng Gang and Li Xiulan - Beloved Parents."

Young CHENG YUE (12) kneels in thin clothes, arranging wildflowers. Her fingers are numb with cold.

Several VILLAGERS pass by, farm tools on their shoulders.

AUNT ZHANG
(pulling her coat tighter)
Child, it's freezing. You'll catch your death.

SISTER LIU
That's Baldy Cheng's girl.

LI XIUHUA
(whispering)
Both parents gone in that truck crash. No relatives left.

SISTER LIU
Someone should...

LI XIUHUA
(soft but firm)
Someone will. Come here, little one.

LI XIUHUA kneels, wrapping her scarf around Cheng Yue's neck.

LI XIUHUA
(to the others)
One bowl of rice from each home. That's all it takes. Who's with me?

The villagers nod, silent but resolute. Young CHENG YUE looks up, seeing not pity, but purpose.

EXT. VILLAGE ALLEY - DAY

LI JIANREN and DA ZHU smoke cigarettes behind the old grain depot.

DA ZHU
The demolition crew comes tomorrow. If Cheng Yue's doing Tomb Sweeping in two days...

LI JIANREN
(grinding his cigarette underfoot)
The municipal park project can't wait. The Party Secretary himself wants this land cleared.

DA ZHU
But her parents' grave... she'll be furious.

LI JIANREN
It's already been relocated. Quietly. To the old quarry site. Boss Yu paid triple for the expedited permit.

DA ZHU
What if she finds out before the ceremony?

LI JIANREN
She won't. And if she does? We'll remind her that graves don't pay for village roads or new school equipment. She wants to play the grateful daughter? Fine. She can be grateful we sold her land for the community's benefit.

DA ZHU
(nervous)
She's not the same girl who left here, Brother Li. She could ruin us.

LI JIANREN
Then we make sure she owes us instead.

Both parents gone in that truck crash. No relatives left.

SISTER LIU
Someone should...

LI XIUHUA
(soft but firm)
Someone will. Come here, little one.

LI XIUHUA kneels, wrapping her scarf around Cheng Yue's neck.

LI XIUHUA
(to the others)
One bowl of rice from each home. That's all it takes. Who's with me?

The villagers nod, silent but resolute. Young CHENG YUE looks up, seeing not pity, but purpose.

EXT. VILLAGE ALLEY - DAY

LI JIANREN and DA ZHU smoke cigarettes behind the old grain depot.

DA ZHU
The demolition crew comes tomorrow. If Cheng Yue's doing Tomb Sweeping in two days...

LI JIANREN
(grinding his cigarette underfoot)
The municipal park project can't wait. The Party Secretary himself wants this land cleared.

DA ZHU
But her parents' grave... she'll be furious.

LI JIANREN
It's already been relocated. Quietly. To the old quarry site. Boss Yu paid triple for the expedited permit.

DA ZHU
What if she finds out before the ceremony?

LI JIANREN
She won't. And if she does? We'll remind her that graves don't pay for village roads or new school equipment. She wants to play the grateful daughter? Fine. She can be grateful we sold her land for the community's benefit.

DA ZHU
(nervous)
She's not the same girl who left here, Brother Li. She could ruin us.

LI JIANREN
Then we make sure she owes us instead.

title: Medical Encounter with the Ex
description: A 28-year-old teacher suffering from an embarrassing gynecological condition discovers her ex-boyfriend is now her doctor.
context:
Title: Medical Encounter with the Ex
Description: A 28-year-old teacher suffering from an embarrassing gynecological condition discovers her ex-boyfriend is now her doctor.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The hospital corridor is bustling with people. Doctors and nurses push gurneys past hurriedly. LIN QINGQING, wearing a patient gown, stands checking her phone.

ZIHAN'S MOTHER (V.O.)
Teacher Lin, our Zihan is so short, and you put him in the last row where he can't see the front. Zihan got a mosquito bite on his butt, why did the mosquito only bite our Zihan and not anyone else?

LIN QINGQING walks while holding her phone and medical records, talking on the phone, looking exhausted. She collides with a NURSE coming from the opposite direction. Medical records and papers scatter all over the floor.

LIN QINGQING
(flustered)
I'm sorry, I'm so sorry.

The NURSE also crouches down to help pick things up.

LIN QINGQING
I'll get them, I'll get them.

LIN QINGQING crouches down to pick up the items. Her phone on the floor rings, the screen showing "Director Zhang calling." She answers the call.

DIRECTOR (O.S.)
Lin Qingqing, what kind of homeroom teacher are you? Zihan's mother has been at-ing you in the group chat so many times, don't you know to reply?

LIN QINGQING
(holding back discomfort)
I'm sorry, Director. I'm at the hospital right now.

LIN QINGQING suddenly shows pain on her face, her hand clutching her lower abdomen.

LIN QINGQING (V.O.)
It's acting up again. So itchy. This damn gynecological condition.

NURSE
(calling out)
Lin Qingqing? Patient Lin Qingqing?

LIN QINGQING
continuation:
(quickly raising her hand)
Yes, I'm here, I'm here!

A MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN in a volunteer uniform walks over quickly and helps LIN QINGQING up.

MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN
Wait a moment.

The MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN turns to LIN QINGQING, her tone unfriendly but efficient.

MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN
Dr. Jiang's waiting. Move along.

The two crouch down together to pick up the items. Nearby, a couple in patient gowns, PASSERBY A and PASSERBY B, watch them.

PASSERBY A
(quietly)
So young to be here...

MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN
(while picking up items)
Exactly. Young people today.

The MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN looks up and glares at the couple.

MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN
Eyes on your own business.

LIN QINGQING (V.O.)
My name is Lin Qingqing. I'm 28 years old. I'm clearly an older single woman with no sex life whatsoever, yet I've contracted an embarrassing gynecological condition. My mother had no choice but to take me to see doctors everywhere.

INT. GYNECOLOGY EXAMINATION ROOM - DAY

LIN QINGQING walks into the examination room holding her medical records. A handsome male doctor in a white coat, JIANG YAN, is writing something at his desk with his head down.

The nameplate on the desk reads "Attending Physician JIANG YAN."

LIN QINGQING sees the nameplate, then looks up at the doctor. She freezes instantly, her face full of shock.

LIN QINGQING (V.O.)
Jiang Yan? The attending physician is actually my ex-boyfriend!

title: The Ungrateful Apprentice
description: A veteran craftswoman is fired by her own apprentice, who has just been promoted to workshop director and believes machines can replace traditional handwork.
context:
Title: The Ungrateful Apprentice
Description: A veteran craftswoman is fired by her own apprentice, who has just been promoted to workshop director and believes machines can replace traditional handwork.

INT. GARMENT FACTORY WORKSHOP - DAY

ZHAO ZHI, a gray-haired master craftswoman wearing glasses, is focused on hand-weaving repairs. Around her is a busy workshop filled with sewing machines and fabrics.

Two young female colleagues (COLLEAGUE A and COLLEAGUE B) walk over with tentative smiles.

COLLEAGUE A
(gently)
Sister Zhi... is it true about Xiao Cheng's promotion?

COLLEAGUE B
(quietly)
They say she's already implementing the automation plan.

ZHAO ZHI
(never looking up from her work)
She's capable. She'll need guidance.

COLLEAGUE B
(pouting)
Let's hope she remembers who taught her.

ZHAO ZHI
(smiling faintly)
She knows the value of craftsmanship.

COLLEAGUE A
(looking toward the door)
She's here.

ZHAO ZHI looks up with a smile toward the door.

XU XIAOCHENG, wearing a sharp business suit and high heels, walks in with forced confidence. She carries a document in her hand.

COLLEAGUE A
Director Xu.

COLLEAGUE B
Director.

ZHAO ZHI
(standing up, warmly)
Xiao Cheng.

XU XIAOCHENG
(avoiding eye contact)
Director Xu.

XU XIAOCHENG sets the document on the fabric in front of ZHAO ZHI.
continuation:
XU XIAOCHENG
Corporate's orders. The manual repair position is eliminated.

ZHAO ZHI
(quietly)
After twenty years.

COLLEAGUE A
But she's training the new hires!

COLLEAGUE B
And Zhao Ying'er's dress for the awards—

XU XIAOCHENG
(interrupting, strained)
The system has her patterns. I've digitized every technique.

ZHAO ZHI
(studying her face)
You've learned the motions. Not the judgment.

XU XIAOCHENG
(defensive)
My certification scores were perfect.

ZHAO ZHI
(points to the intricate silk dress)
Raw silk warp repair. One wrong tension and the entire pattern unravels. Machines can't read fabric memory.

XU XIAOCHENG
(quietly firm)
I'll handle it. Please... just go quietly.

ZHAO ZHI
(picking up her tools)
Let me finish this. For the factory's reputation.

XU XIAOCHENG
(firmly)
I've got it. You need to clear out by end of day.

ZHAO ZHI
(places a small wooden tool on the table)
Then you won't need this. My father carved it. For silk only.

She walks toward the exit. XU XIAOCHENG stares at the tool, then at the dress. Her hand trembles slightly as she reaches for it.

XU XIAOCHENG
(softly, barely audible)
Wait—

But ZHAO ZHI is already gone. XU XIAOCHENG picks up the tool, her confident facade cracking as she examines the complex repair.

title: Educating Children Properly
description: A well-mannered woman and her elderly mother encounter a spoiled child and his enabling grandmother at a hotel, leading to escalating conflicts on Chinese New Year's Eve.
context:
Title: Educating Children Properly
Description: A well-mannered woman and her elderly mother encounter a spoiled child and his enabling grandmother at a hotel, leading to escalating conflicts on Chinese New Year's Eve.

INT. JINGCHENG GRAND HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

GU QINGCI (red coat, capable) supports her MOTHER (white coat, gentle) who is using a cane as they walk slowly down the polished corridor.

GU QINGCI
Mom, the doctor said not to rush.

MOTHER
(smiling, patting her hand)
I'm just happy to be out for New Year's.

CUI PENGPENG (red Tang suit) darts around the corner, toy gun in hand, cartoon mask askew. He barrels forward without looking.

CUI PENGPENG
(as he runs)
Bang! Bang! You're all—

He crashes into MOTHER's cane. MOTHER stumbles, her handbag slipping. GU QINGCI catches her just before she falls.

GU QINGCI
(steadies her mother, then turns)
Hey! Watch where you're—

She stops as CUI PENGPENG, mask now off, stares at them with wide, unapologetic eyes.

MOTHER
(breathing heavily)
Qingci, it's alright. He didn't mean—

CUI PENGPENG
(whining)
You blocked my way!

He spits on the carpet near GU QINGCI's feet. GU QINGCI's jaw tightens.

GU QINGCI
(low, controlled)
Apologize to my mother.

WANG YUFENG rushes over, immediately positioning herself between them.

WANG YUFENG
(to GU QINGCI, sharp)
For what? He was just playing! Your mother should watch her step.

MOTHER
(quietly firm)
It's Chinese New Year. Let's not...

She squeezes GU QINGCI's arm. GU QINGCI exhales slowly, helping her mother continue down the corridor.

WANG YUFENG mutters loud enough to hear.

WANG YUFENG
Some people have no holiday spirit.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL FRONT DESK - DAY

WANG YUFENG leans over the counter toward the HOTEL RECEPTIONIST, CUI PENGPENG picking at a complimentary candy display.

WANG YUFENG
The premium gift basket. I was promised it would be ready.

HOTEL RECEPTIONIST
(professional)
It's being prepared, madam. Please—

CRASH. The blue and white porcelain vase on the counter shatters at their feet. CUI PENGPENG stands frozen, hand still outstretched.

HOTEL RECEPTIONIST
(stiffens)
That was a Ming dynasty replica. Valued at 8,800 yuan.

WANG YUFENG
(grabs CUI PENGPENG's hand, inspecting it)
Are you hurt? Why do you put such fragile things where children can reach them?

HOTEL RECEPTIONIST
Madam, the vase was clearly—

WANG YUFENG
(cold smile)
He's six years old. The law says children under eight have no civil liability. Check your regulations.

She guides CUI PENGPENG away, leaving the receptionist pale with anger but motionless.

WANG YUFENG
(quietly to Pengpeng)
Grandma will handle it. Don't worry.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

WANG YUFENG and CUI PENGPENG walk down another corridor lined with display shelves. CUI PENGPENG trails his hand along a ceramic tea set.

CUI PENGPENG
Grandma, are we in trouble?

WANG YUFENG
No, sweetie. Grandma protects you. Always.

Ahead, GU QINGCI and her MOTHER stand outside their private dining room. GU QINGCI is speaking quietly with the SERVER.

GU QINGCI
...and please, no peanuts. My mother is allergic.

MOTHER
(notices the boy)
Qingci, let it be.

But GU QINGCI has already turned, her expression changing. She watches as CUI PENGPENG, more hesitantly now, reaches for another object on the shelf. His hand pauses.

Their eyes meet—GU QINGCI's exhausted but unwavering, CUI PENGPENG's defiant but uncertain. WANG YUFENG follows his gaze, her protective mask flickering for a second.

The SERVER holds open the dining room door.

SERVER
Madam, your family is waiting.

GU QINGCI guides her mother inside, glancing back once more before the door closes softly.

WANG YUFENG stares at the closed door, then down at CUI PENGPENG, who has quietly withdrawn his hand from the shelf.

WANG YUFENG
(quieter than before)
Come on. Grandma's tired.

They walk away, CUI PENGPENG now holding her hand instead of the toy gun, his mask forgotten on the floor behind them.

title: After Breaking Ties, Three Brothers Beg for My Forgiveness
description: A young woman takes the fall for her adoptive brother's hit-and-run, only to face betrayal and violence in prison.
context:
Title: After Breaking Ties, Three Brothers Beg for My Forgiveness
Description: A young woman takes the fall for her adoptive brother's hit-and-run, only to face betrayal and violence in prison.

EXT. RAINY HIGHWAY - NIGHT

A black sedan speeds through the rain.

INT. SEDAN - CONTINUOUS

SHEN YANQI and his GIRLFRIEND are making out in the car.

Suddenly, a MAN rushes into the middle of the road.

GIRLFRIEND
(terrified)
There's someone!

SHEN YANQI jerks the steering wheel and slams on the brakes, but still hits the man. The man is thrown into the air and falls into a pool of blood.

SHEN YANQI and GIRLFRIEND get out to check. They are horrified by what they see.

GIRLFRIEND
(breaking down in tears)
We killed someone! I can't go to prison! My life will be over!

SHEN YANQI
(irritably)
Shut up! I have a plan.

SHEN YANQI dials his phone with shaking hands.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

SHEN MO, wearing an apron, stirs a pot of soup while looking at her phone.

EXT. RAINY HIGHWAY - NIGHT

SHEN YANQI's phone rings. He answers it.

SHEN YANQI
(surprised)
Little sister.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

SHEN MO
(on phone)
Big brother? You never call this late. The soup's gone cold.
continuation:
EXT. RAINY HIGHWAY - NIGHT

SHEN YANQI
(voice breaking)
Little sister, I need you to remember what Mom made you promise. About protecting family. About the car registration.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

SHEN MO
(shocked)
What have you done?

SHEN MO's expression becomes grave as she continues stirring the soup.

SHEN MO
(on phone)
Tell me where you are.

EXT. RAINY HIGHWAY - NIGHT

SHEN YANQI
(hesitant)
The north highway. But if you come, they'll know—

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

SHEN MO
(firmly)
I'll take your place. The Shen name raised me. Now I'll save it. Delete this call.

INT. PRISON CORRIDOR - DAY

A sign on the wall reads "Xia Kingdom Class-A Criminal Prison."

VOICE-OVER
Shen Mo, for causing death by vehicular manslaughter, according to Article 7 of the Greater Xia Legal Code, Shen Mo is sentenced to life imprisonment.

SHEN MO, wearing prison uniform, is escorted by GUARDS.

INT. PRISON SHOWER ROOM - DAY

A GUARD uses a high-pressure water hose to wash SHEN MO's body.

GUARD
Put this on. Consider this your initiation.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

SHEN SHAO sits on a sofa, watching a video on his phone of SHEN MO being hosed down.

SHEN SHAO
Make sure there's no doubt.

INT. PRISON - DAY

The WARDEN is on the phone.

WARDEN
Shen Shao, Shen Mo won't see the end of the month.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

SHEN SHAO hangs up. His GIRLFRIEND walks over and sits on his lap.

GIRLFRIEND
Shen Shao.

They kiss.

SHEN SHAO
(sneering)
Mom's stray dog. Thought signing away her claim would make her family. Now she's just a liability.

GIRLFRIEND
The inheritance is secure. She's legally renounced.

SHEN SHAO
Then renounce her existence.

INT. PRISON WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

The WARDEN opens the door. Several MALE PRISONERS walk in and surround SHEN MO, who keeps her back to the wall.

SHEN MO
Shen Shao's orders?

LEAD PRISONER
The warden's problem. You're too visible. Makes the brass nervous.

SHEN MO
(struggling)
I'm already dead in here.

LEAD PRISONER
Not dead enough. Get her!

SHEN MO fights back fiercely, kicking one prisoner down.

LEAD PRISONER
You don't know when to quit! Finish it!

The PRISONERS close in. A PRISONER picks up an iron rod.

SHEN MO
(screaming)
Ah! Let me go!

The rod strikes. SHEN MO falls to the ground, blood spilling from her mouth.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

SHEN MO, wearing an apron, stirs a pot of soup while looking at her phone.

EXT. RAINY HIGHWAY - NIGHT

SHEN YANQI's phone rings. He answers it.

SHEN YANQI
(surprised)
Little sister.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

SHEN MO
(on phone)
Big brother? You never call this late. The soup's gone cold.

EXT. RAINY HIGHWAY - NIGHT

SHEN YANQI
(voice breaking)
Little sister, I need you to remember what Mom made you promise. About protecting family. About the car registration.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

SHEN MO
(shocked)
What have you done?

SHEN MO's expression becomes grave as she continues stirring the soup.

SHEN MO
(on phone)
Tell me where you are.

EXT. RAINY HIGHWAY - NIGHT

SHEN YANQI
(hesitant)
The north highway. But if you come, they'll know—

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

SHEN MO
(firmly)
I'll take your place. The Shen name raised me. Now I'll save it. Delete this call.

INT. PRISON CORRIDOR - DAY

A sign on the wall reads "Xia Kingdom Class-A Criminal Prison."

VOICE-OVER
Shen Mo, for causing death by vehicular manslaughter, according to Article 7 of the Greater Xia Legal Code, Shen Mo is sentenced to life imprisonment.

SHEN MO, wearing prison uniform, is escorted by GUARDS.

INT. PRISON SHOWER ROOM - DAY

A GUARD uses a high-pressure water hose to wash SHEN MO's body.

GUARD
Put this on. Consider this your initiation.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

SHEN SHAO sits on a sofa, watching a video on his phone of SHEN MO being hosed down.

SHEN SHAO
Make sure there's no doubt.

INT. PRISON - DAY

The WARDEN is on the phone.

WARDEN
Shen Shao, Shen Mo won't see the end of the month.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

SHEN SHAO hangs up. His GIRLFRIEND walks over and sits on his lap.

GIRLFRIEND
Shen Shao.

They kiss.

SHEN SHAO
(sneering)
Mom's stray dog. Thought signing away her claim would make her family. Now she's just a liability.

GIRLFRIEND
The inheritance is secure. She's legally renounced.

SHEN SHAO
Then renounce her existence.

INT. PRISON WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

The WARDEN opens the door. Several MALE PRISONERS walk in and surround SHEN MO, who keeps her back to the wall.

SHEN MO
Shen Shao's orders?

LEAD PRISONER
The warden's problem. You're too visible. Makes the brass nervous.

SHEN MO
(struggling)
I'm already dead in here.

LEAD PRISONER
Not dead enough. Get her!

SHEN MO fights back fiercely, kicking one prisoner down.

LEAD PRISONER
You don't know when to quit! Finish it!

The PRISONERS close in. A PRISONER picks up an iron rod.

SHEN MO
(screaming)
Ah! Let me go!

The rod strikes. SHEN MO falls to the ground, blood spilling from her mouth.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Internet Cafe Chaos
description: A timid technician finds himself in an awkward situation with a flirtatious customer just as an earthquake strikes the internet cafe.
context:
Title: Internet Cafe Chaos
Description: A timid technician finds himself in an awkward situation with a flirtatious customer just as an earthquake strikes the internet cafe.

INT. INTERNET CAFE - DAY

XIAO PANG sits in front of a computer, rapidly typing on the keyboard. The screen displays a BIOS interface.

XIAO PANG (V.O.)
CPU temps in the red. Classic cooling failure.

A foot wearing black stockings and platform shoes suddenly props up on XIAO PANG's desk, startling him.

FEMALE CUSTOMER sits in a gaming chair, legs on the desk, watching XIAO PANG with amusement.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
My hero. How's the rescue mission going?

XIAO PANG
(nervous)
Working on it, almost done.

FEMALE CUSTOMER pulls her legs back, sees tissues on the desk, and picks them up.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
You're drenched. Let me help.

FEMALE CUSTOMER approaches XIAO PANG with the tissue to wipe his sweat. XIAO PANG quickly dodges.

XIAO PANG
(defensive)
I've got it.

XIAO PANG takes the tissue and wipes his sweat, continuing to work on the computer.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
So... you always this dedicated? Or is this just for me?

XIAO PANG
(avoiding eye contact)
Just... doing my job.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Right. So no girlfriend waiting at home?

XIAO PANG
I... that's personal.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(teasing)
Just curious. You seem so... untouchable.

XIAO PANG immediately stands up.

XIAO PANG
Actually, this unit needs a full replacement. I'll get you another station.

XIAO PANG turns to leave. FEMALE CUSTOMER grabs his arm.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Wait! I like this one. Just finish what you started.
continuation:
INT. INTERNET CAFE FRONT DESK - DAY

MALE CUSTOMER pounds the front desk, complaining to the FEMALE BOSS.

MALE CUSTOMER
Eight disconnections! Where's your tech support?

FEMALE BOSS
Sorry, please wait a moment, I'll get someone to fix it for you right away.

MALE CUSTOMER
Hurry up!

FEMALE BOSS watches the MALE CUSTOMER walk away, impatiently shouting into the cafe.

FEMALE BOSS
Xiao Pang! Xiao Pang! Never know what he's doing all day, can't find him when you need him.

INT. INTERNET CAFE - DAY

XIAO PANG reluctantly returns to the FEMALE CUSTOMER's computer.

XIAO PANG
Alright, let me check if the cables underneath are plugged in properly.

XIAO PANG lies on the ground, crawling under the desk to check the wiring.

FEMALE BOSS walks over, looking around for XIAO PANG, then sees him under the desk.

FEMALE BOSS bends down, looking at XIAO PANG under the desk.

FEMALE BOSS
What are you doing?

XIAO PANG
(startled)
Behind schedule, I know!

FEMALE BOSS
(suspicious)
Fixing the computer by crawling under the desk? Get up right now, there's a customer over there with a computer problem.

XIAO PANG
Okay.

XIAO PANG is about to crawl out from under the desk when FEMALE CUSTOMER suddenly looks down, pretending to be alarmed as she covers her short skirt.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(overreacting)
Hey! What are you—

FEMALE BOSS
(severe)
Xiao Pang, get up here!

XIAO PANG
(pleading)
It's not what it looks like!

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(flustered)
I didn't— I mean, he wasn't—

The entire cafe SHAKES. Monitors topple.

MALE CUSTOMER (O.S.)
Earthquake! Under the desks!

FEMALE CUSTOMER freezes. XIAO PANG grabs her wrist.

XIAO PANG
(authoritative)
Under. Now.

He pulls her down as the lights FLICKER OUT. Darkness, dust, and the sound of structural groans.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: New Grandma's Love Story
description: A 65-year-old woman falls for an online romance with a man 10 years younger, but her family suspects he might be a scammer targeting elderly victims.
context:
Title: New Grandma's Love Story
Description: A 65-year-old woman falls for an online romance with a man 10 years younger, but her family suspects he might be a scammer targeting elderly victims.

INT. COMMUNITY PLAZA - DAY

The camera quickly flashes past several posters about preventing online fraud.

LI XIULAN, wearing a red volunteer vest, holding a small pinwheel and a gong, stands before display boards. Her face shows quiet determination, a marked change from her former exuberance.

LI XIULAN
Pies don't fall from the sky, free gifts are traps.

LI XIULAN strikes the gong once, the sound echoing with purpose rather than celebration.

LI XIULAN
Pension investments, be careful.

RESIDENT #1
Illegal fundraising ruins your savings!

RESIDENT #2
Sister Xiulan, you're a real hero. How did you get so wise?

LI XIULAN
(softly, with dignity)
I learned from my own mistake.

SHEN JIAYI (V.O.)
My grandmother Li Xiulan is 65 years old this year. What you're seeing is her hard-won redemption. But three months ago, she was a woman blinded by a different kind of light.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: Three months ago

LI XIULAN, elegant in a red fur coat, sits at her vanity table, applying lipstick with trembling hands. She clutches a smartphone.

LI XIULAN
The old gentleman asked me to meet him in Shanghai. His driver will pick me up in his Rolls-Royce.

SHEN JIAYI walks out, holding a cup of tea, her face gentle but firm.

SHEN JIAYI
Grandma, we need to talk about Little Abin.

SHEN ZHUANGNAN walks out from another room, sees the tension, and stays silent.

SHEN GUODONG approaches from the sofa, his weathered face filled with concern.

LI XIULAN
(proudly, but with forced bravado)
He's a retired official from Beijing. Ten luxury homes. And he says I'm his precious flower, just like your father used to—
continuation:
SHEN GUODONG
Mom, Jiayi found something.

SHEN JIAYI
These photos you showed me... they're all stolen from different websites. The mansions, the cars, even his profile picture. It's a scam called pig butchering. They build your trust, then—

LI XIULAN
(interrupting, voice breaking)
Then take everything. I was going to send him fifty thousand for a "visa" to visit me.

LI XIULAN touches a faded wedding photo on her vanity, tears streaming down her carefully made-up face.

LI XIULAN
After your father died, I filled my days with noise. But nights... nights were so quiet. Abin called me every night.

SHEN JIAYI
(gently taking her grandmother's hand)
Real love doesn't ask for money, Grandma. Real love doesn't hide behind fake photos. And loneliness isn't weakness—it's just part of being human.

SHEN GUODONG
(hand on his mother's shoulder)
We should have checked on you more. We're here now.

LI XIULAN looks at her family, tears giving way to resolve.

LI XIULAN
I need to make this right.

INT. COMMUNITY PLAZA - DAY (PRESENT)

LI XIULAN faces the residents with authentic strength.

LI XIULAN
They targeted my loneliness after I lost my husband. But my family saved me. Now I save others.

She strikes the gong twice, each ring a testament to her transformation.

LI XIULAN
Protect your pension money!

RESIDENTS
(in unison)
Enjoy a happy retirement!

LI XIULAN
And protect your hearts. That's the real treasure.

The residents applaud. Shen Jiayi watches from the edge, tears of pride in her eyes.

SHEN JIAYI (V.O.)
My grandmother's love story didn't end with a prince in a Rolls-Royce. It ended with her becoming the hero she always was—just on her own terms this time.

FADE OUT.

title: Remarrying on My Wedding Day, Ex-Husband's Uncle Dotes on Me Alone
description: On her wedding day, the bride discovers her groom's infidelity on the big screen. She declares she will marry on the spot and seeks a new groom from the guests, leading to an unexpected turn of events.
context:
Title: Remarrying on My Wedding Day, Ex-Husband's Uncle Dotes on Me Alone
Description: On her wedding day, the bride discovers her groom's infidelity on the big screen. She declares she will marry on the spot and seeks a new groom from the guests, leading to an unexpected turn of events.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

LIN ZITAO and WU SHANSHAN tumble onto the bed, clothes askew.

LIN ZITAO
This young master will conquer you tonight.

WU SHANSHAN
(giggling)
Don't rush.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

The wedding venue is decorated lavishly. XIE WEI, in a white wedding dress, walks down the aisle with a bouquet. Her smile is genuine.

WEDDING MC (V.O.)
Distinguished guests, welcome to the wedding of Mr. Lin Zitao and Ms. Xie Wei. Let's welcome our beautiful bride!

Guests applaud.

WEDDING MC (V.O.)
And now, the groom!

The large screen flickers. Instead of a romantic video, LIVE FOOTAGE shows Lin Zitao and Wu Shanshan in the hotel room.

Xie Wei stops dead. The bouquet drops from her hands.

GUESTS (V.O.)
Is that real?
The groom's cheating?
On his wedding day?

On screen, Wu Shanshan looks directly into the camera.

WU SHANSHAN
He's mine, Xie Wei. Always has been.

Xie Wei stands frozen, then her expression shifts from shock to steel.

GUEST A
This wedding is finished.

GUEST B
The Xie family is humiliated.

Xie Wei bends down, picks up the microphone. Her hand trembles, then steadies.

XIE WEI
Today's wedding will proceed. The groom will not.

The guests erupt.

XIE WEI
I need a man. Right here, right now. Any single man willing to marry me—I'll say yes.
continuation:
TWO MEN rush the stage.

MAN #1
I volunteer!

MAN #2
Pick me!

A sharp whistle cuts through. YOUNG MASTER HUANG appears, shoving them aside.

YOUNG MASTER HUANG
You dare compete with me?

He strides to Xie Wei, leering.

YOUNG MASTER HUANG
Don't worry, darling. I'll take care of you.

He reaches for her face. Xie Wei jerks back.

XIE WEI
Don't touch me! I never chose you.

YOUNG MASTER HUANG
You're damaged goods. Who else would want you?

Some guests start chanting.

GUESTS
Marry him! Marry him!

Young Master Huang grabs Xie Wei's arm.

XIE WEI
Let go! Get off me!

GUEST C
That's Huang Daqian—the richest man here.

GUEST D
She's trading one hell for another.

YOUNG MASTER HUANG
(leaning in)
Give me a kiss, pretty—

Suddenly, LIN CHENGYI rushes forward and slams his fist into Young Master Huang's face.

Young Master Huang crumples.

LIN CHENGYI stands protectively before Xie Wei, adjusting his glasses.

LIN CHENGYI
This woman is marrying me.

Xie Wei stares up at him, breathless.

FADE OUT.
