title: The New Benevolent Healer
description: A master with a pure yang body must find a woman with a pure yin body to break through the tenth level of martial arts and save his dying son.
context:
Title: The New Benevolent Healer
Description: A master with a pure yang body must find a woman with a pure yin body to break through the tenth level of martial arts and save his dying son.

INT. SUPREME HALL - DAY

The OLD SUPREME, white-haired and white-bearded, with an immortal demeanor, points at his disciple LU YUAN.

OLD SUPREME
You have a naturally pure yang body. Inside you is a massive energy. You only need to find a woman with a pure yin body and dual cultivate with her...

The OLD SUPREME's expression becomes slightly lecherous, then he quickly clears his throat and resumes his serious demeanor.

OLD SUPREME
(clearing throat)
Then you will surely break through to the tenth level of the Supreme Heart Method in one go.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - DAY

Several luxury sports cars race along a winding mountain road.

Inside one car, sisters LIU QING and LIU HONG shout excitedly.

LIU QING & LIU HONG
Brother Yuan, we're coming to marry you!

In another car, LIU PIAOLIN speaks disdainfully.

LIU PIAOLIN
(to herself)
As if that makes them worthy of Lu Yuan.

In a third car, FANG FEIXUE, wearing sunglasses, sneers.

FANG FEIXUE
With your old jalopies, you'll be eating my dust.

FANG FEIXUE floors the accelerator, and her sports car speeds ahead. The cars engage in a chase along the mountain road, finally stopping in front of the archway marked "Supreme Manor." Several beautifully dressed women get out of their cars one by one.
continuation:
INT. ILLUSION REALM - DAY

LU YUAN meditates in a realm of swirling energy and phantom landscapes, attempting to break through his martial arts technique, but the aura around him collapses. He suddenly opens his eyes, looking disappointed.

LU YUAN
I still haven't broken through to the tenth level of the Supreme Heart Method.

INT. SUPREME HALL - DAY

LU YUAN walks up to the OLD SUPREME, who is sweeping the floor, and bows respectfully.

LU YUAN
Master.

OLD SUPREME
Lu Yuan, you've been on the mountain for twenty years now, haven't you?

LU YUAN
Master, it will be exactly twenty years in one more month.

OLD SUPREME
I remember, when you came up the mountain, it was to cure your son's illness?

LU YUAN
Yes. My son was diagnosed with the Severed Meridian Body when he was ten years old. He can barely live past thirty. Unless I use the tenth level of the Supreme Heart Method to remake his body and reconstruct his meridians. Unfortunately, I still haven't grasped the essence of the tenth level.

OLD SUPREME
(smiling mysteriously)
Because you've been trying to force yang into yang. The tenth level requires harmony, not more power. You already have the answer I gave you.

LU YUAN
(urgently)
The pure yin body.

OLD SUPREME
(leaning closer)
Within one month. The union of opposites is the only way to save your son. Some sacrifices aren't sacrifices at all—they're merely choices we were too stubborn to make.

LU YUAN
(making a surprised sound)
Ah?

OLD SUPREME
Ah what? Your son needs a father who knows how to ask for help. Better to live with a woman's balance than die a solitary hero.

LU YUAN kneels down and kowtows heavily.

LU YUAN
Thank you, Master!

OLD SUPREME
Alright, alright, hurry down the mountain.

LU YUAN stands up but doesn't leave immediately. Instead, he looks down the mountain.

OLD SUPREME
Why aren't you leaving, boy?

The camera turns to the steps down the mountain, where LIU QING, LIU HONG, LIU PIAOLIN, FANG FEIXUE and several other women are walking up.

OLD SUPREME
(greatly alarmed, then amused)
Oh no, this boy's romantic debts have come knocking! And every one of them carries a different fate...

LU YUAN also looks at the approaching women with a stunned expression.
full_script:
Title: The New Benevolent Healer
Description: A master with a pure yang body must find a woman with a pure yin body to break through the tenth level of martial arts and save his dying son.

INT. SUPREME HALL - DAY

The OLD SUPREME, white-haired and white-bearded, with an immortal demeanor, points at his disciple LU YUAN.

OLD SUPREME
You have a naturally pure yang body. Inside you is a massive energy. You only need to find a woman with a pure yin body and dual cultivate with her...

The OLD SUPREME's expression becomes slightly lecherous, then he quickly clears his throat and resumes his serious demeanor.

OLD SUPREME
(clearing throat)
Then you will surely break through to the tenth level of the Supreme Heart Method in one go.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - DAY

Several luxury sports cars race along a winding mountain road.

Inside one car, sisters LIU QING and LIU HONG shout excitedly.

LIU QING & LIU HONG
Brother Yuan, we're coming to marry you!

In another car, LIU PIAOLIN speaks disdainfully.

LIU PIAOLIN
(to herself)
As if that makes them worthy of Lu Yuan.

In a third car, FANG FEIXUE, wearing sunglasses, sneers.

FANG FEIXUE
With your old jalopies, you'll be eating my dust.

FANG FEIXUE floors the accelerator, and her sports car speeds ahead. The cars engage in a chase along the mountain road, finally stopping in front of the archway marked "Supreme Manor." Several beautifully dressed women get out of their cars one by one.

INT. ILLUSION REALM - DAY

LU YUAN meditates in a realm of swirling energy and phantom landscapes, attempting to break through his martial arts technique, but the aura around him collapses. He suddenly opens his eyes, looking disappointed.

LU YUAN
I still haven't broken through to the tenth level of the Supreme Heart Method.

INT. SUPREME HALL - DAY

LU YUAN walks up to the OLD SUPREME, who is sweeping the floor, and bows respectfully.

LU YUAN
Master.

OLD SUPREME
Lu Yuan, you've been on the mountain for twenty years now, haven't you?

LU YUAN
Master, it will be exactly twenty years in one more month.

OLD SUPREME
I remember, when you came up the mountain, it was to cure your son's illness?

LU YUAN
Yes. My son was diagnosed with the Severed Meridian Body when he was ten years old. He can barely live past thirty. Unless I use the tenth level of the Supreme Heart Method to remake his body and reconstruct his meridians. Unfortunately, I still haven't grasped the essence of the tenth level.

OLD SUPREME
(smiling mysteriously)
Because you've been trying to force yang into yang. The tenth level requires harmony, not more power. You already have the answer I gave you.

LU YUAN
(urgently)
The pure yin body.

OLD SUPREME
(leaning closer)
Within one month. The union of opposites is the only way to save your son. Some sacrifices aren't sacrifices at all—they're merely choices we were too stubborn to make.

LU YUAN
(making a surprised sound)
Ah?

OLD SUPREME
Ah what? Your son needs a father who knows how to ask for help. Better to live with a woman's balance than die a solitary hero.

LU YUAN kneels down and kowtows heavily.

LU YUAN
Thank you, Master!

OLD SUPREME
Alright, alright, hurry down the mountain.

LU YUAN stands up but doesn't leave immediately. Instead, he looks down the mountain.

OLD SUPREME
Why aren't you leaving, boy?

The camera turns to the steps down the mountain, where LIU QING, LIU HONG, LIU PIAOLIN, FANG FEIXUE and several other women are walking up.

OLD SUPREME
(greatly alarmed, then amused)
Oh no, this boy's romantic debts have come knocking! And every one of them carries a different fate...

LU YUAN also looks at the approaching women with a stunned expression.

title: Beyond Saving
description: A woman discovers her husband has terminal leukemia, unaware that he believes she is the one dying.
context:
Title: Beyond Saving
Description: A woman discovers her husband has terminal leukemia, unaware that he believes she is the one dying.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

Doctor GU YICHEN sits at his desk, facing SU MINGXUE.

GU YICHEN
Your husband has leukemia. Terminal stage.

SU MINGXUE is shocked. A glass cup falls from her hand and shatters on the floor.

SU MINGXUE
What? Leukemia?

GU YICHEN
Yes, terminal stage leukemia. If he doesn't get a bone marrow transplant, he probably only has a week left.

SU MINGXUE
(muttering to herself)
Bone marrow transplant...
(urgently)
You mean if he gets a bone marrow transplant, he can live?

GU YICHEN
(nodding)
Yes.

SU MINGXUE
Then let's do the transplant! How much does it cost?

GU YICHEN
At least 600,000 yuan.

SU MINGXUE
(shocked)
Six... 600,000... Why so much?

SU MINGXUE
Yichen, please help me find suitable bone marrow. I'll go raise the money right now!

SU MINGXUE gets up to leave. GU YICHEN grabs her arm.

GU YICHEN
Wait!

GU YICHEN takes out a bank card.

GU YICHEN
I have 300,000 here. Take it first. No rush to pay it back.

SU MINGXUE
No, Yichen, this is too much. I can't accept it.

GU YICHEN
(grabbing SU MINGXUE's hand, pressing the card into it)
Mingxue! If you hadn't given up your job back then, this money would be nothing to you. Saving a life is what matters. Just take it.

SU MINGXUE
(moved)
Yichen... Thank you. I will definitely pay you back.

GU YICHEN
Mingxue, for three years I've wanted to ask you - was it really worth it? Giving up your million-yuan annual salary for Sun Hong?

FLASHBACK BEGINS:

In the scene, SU MINGXUE lies at a car accident site, covered in blood.

SUN HONG (V.O.)
Mingxue! Mingxue!

The scene cuts to a hospital room. SU MINGXUE has bandages wrapped around her head. SUN HONG sits by the bed, his face exhausted with worry.

SUN HONG
Mingxue, you're awake.

FLASHBACK ENDS.
continuation:
INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

SU MINGXUE
(bitter smile)
Of course it was. He saved my life back then. Now that he's in this situation, even if I have to sell everything I own, I'll save him.

GU YICHEN
Mingxue, back then, maybe...

SU MINGXUE
(interrupting)
Yichen, is it true what you said? If he has the surgery, he can live?

GU YICHEN
(hesitating briefly)
Yes.

GU YICHEN
The surgery requires registration. Let me take you to handle it.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

SUN HONG leans against the wall on his phone, his voice low and tense.

SUN HONG
(into phone)
She's still pushing for more tests. Thinks it's about her.
(listens)
No, she doesn't know. Just keep quiet for now.

He sees SU MINGXUE and GU YICHEN walking toward him. He ends the call.

SUN HONG
Mingxue!

SUN HONG rushes up to them.

SUN HONG
Another consultation?

SU MINGXUE
I wasn't feeling well.

SUN HONG
(to Gu Yichen)
And you need to hold her hand for that?

GU YICHEN
(withdrawing his hand)
I was helping her up.

SUN HONG
(turning to Mingxue)
Where's the report?

SU MINGXUE
Still processing.

Two NURSES walk by, one carrying a patient file.

NURSE A
Room 309's wife still doesn't know. Terminal AML.

NURSE B
Six hundred thousand yuan. They'll never raise it in time.

SUN HONG overhears the conversation. His expression changes drastically as he stares in shock at the direction SU MINGXUE left.

SUN HONG
(whispered)
309... that's my room...

He looks down at his phone. His lock screen shows their wedding photo.

He deletes a number from his call log: "Lawyer."

SUN HONG
(to himself)
What have I become...

title: The Unchangeable Life
description: A woman in a wedding dress is hunted down by her best friend on what should have been her happiest day, revealing a dark conspiracy of jealousy and betrayal.
context:
Title: The Unchangeable Life
Description: A woman in a wedding dress is hunted down by her best friend on what should have been her happiest day, revealing a dark conspiracy of jealousy and betrayal.

INT. FOREST - NIGHT

Mist clings to the trees. JIA YI, her wedding dress torn, runs barefoot.

Several PURSUERS with torches chase her.

PURSUERS
Stop! Stop!

JIA YI hides behind a tree, breathing heavily.

The PURSUERS search. JIA YI runs again, reaching a lake shore.

The PURSUERS surround her.

PURSUER
Run again, we break your legs.

The Pursuer shoves JIA YI to the ground.

JIA YI
Who paid you?

BAI XIAOXIAO, in a silver dress, emerges from the pursuers.

BAI XIAOXIAO
I did.

JIA YI
(shocked)
Bai Xiaoxiao? We were sisters. I held you after your miscarriage. I paid your rent. Why?

BAI XIAOXIAO crouches, grabbing JIA YI's hair.

BAI XIAOXIAO
While you planned your wedding, I swallowed pills. While he bought you a villa, I couldn't afford groceries. You stopped seeing me.

BAI XIAOXIAO pushes her down.
continuation:
BAI XIAOXIAO
(triumphant)
Your life was supposed to be mine. Now it will be.

JIA YI
(clutching her belly)
The baby... it's coming. Please.

BAI XIAOXIAO
(cold smile)
When I lost mine, you said "it's for the best." I'm that best. Your child will be mine.

BAI XIAOXIAO stands.

BAI XIAOXIAO
After she gives birth, eliminate her.

PURSUERS
Yes!

BAI XIAOXIAO
Drown her!

JIA YI
(whisper)
No...

Headlights blaze through the mist. Two SUVs screech to a halt.

FU RUI gets out with BODYGUARDS.

FU RUI
(to the bodyguards)
Secure the perimeter. Ensure Madam's safety.

JIA YI collapses, water breaking, screaming.

A baby's cry rings out.

FLASHBACK: JIA YI holds the baby, blood on her face, eyes haunted.

title: Infinite Resources System
description: After being forced into an arranged marriage where he must accept his fiancée's pregnancy with another man's child, Chen Fan severs ties with his family and awakens a mysterious system that rewards him with billions.
context:
Title: Infinite Resources System
Description: After being forced into an arranged marriage where he must accept his fiancée's pregnancy with another man's child, Chen Fan severs ties with his family and awakens a mysterious system that rewards him with billions.

INT. CHEN RESIDENCE - DAY

CHEN FAN, a young man wearing glasses, walks into a spacious luxurious living room carrying a backpack. His family—Grandfather CHEN SHANHAI, cousin CHEN HAOYU, aunt CHEN YUZHEN, and his fiancée XU JUNYAO—are waiting for him.

XU JUNYAO
(assessing)
You're Chen Fan.

CHEN SHANHAI
(brusque)
Good. We can finalize this.

CHEN HAOYU
(smiling)
The prodigal returns.

CHEN YUZHEN
(sickly sweet)
We've been waiting, dear.

XU JUNYAO gestures to her stomach.

XU JUNYAO
Xu Junyao. I'm pregnant. The father is Li Qianming. After our marriage, I'll give birth. You'll appear on the certificate.

CHEN FAN stares.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
She's not asking. She's claiming.

XU JUNYAO
Three clauses. First, the child takes Qianming's surname. You'll register as Qin Fan. Second, no physical contact. I visit the capital twice monthly. Third, absolute obedience. The Xu family compensates loyalty.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
This is a purchase order for a human being.

XU JUNYAO
Well?

CHEN HAOYU
(laughing)
Miss Xu is his salvation! He'll sign anything.

CHEN YUZHEN
(gently)
Your parents' legacy needs this, Chen Fan. Don't let pride destroy it.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
Twelve years since they vanished. Twelve years of these vultures.

CHEN FAN
Chen Haoyu's always wanted my place. Let him take it.

CHEN HAOYU
(vicious)
I have worth. You're just rust they couldn't scrape off.

CHEN SHANHAI
(flat)
continuation:
The Chen Group defaults next month without Xu capital. You will marry her.

CHEN FAN
Grandfather, I have—

CHEN SHANHAI
Your girlfriend will be compensated. This is final.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
So that's the truth. I'm not family. I'm leverage.

CHEN FAN
And if I refuse?

XU JUNYAO
(shrugging)
Then your family's debt becomes public by Friday. Your choice.

CHEN FAN
Then it's not a choice.

CHEN FAN sets down his backpack. He pulls out paper and pen, writing deliberately.

CHEN FAN
"I, Chen Fan, renounce all claim to the Chen family name, inheritance, and obligations."

CHEN SHANHAI
(quietly dangerous)
Sign that and you're erased.

CHEN FAN
I was erased when you traded me for a loan.

CHEN FAN hands over the document. CHEN SHANHAI signs violently, throws the pen aside.

CHEN FAN
(picking up the paper)
Thank you for the clarity.

CHEN FAN walks out. The door closes.

CHEN HAOYU
(uncertain)
He'll beg. They always beg.

CHEN YUZHEN
(quietly)
What if he doesn't?

EXT. CHEN RESIDENCE ENTRANCE - DAY

CHEN FAN walks out of the Chen family gate, holding the severance document. He takes out his phone. The screen suddenly lights up, displaying a futuristic interface.

SYSTEM VOICE (V.O.)
Severance threshold achieved. System activating...

SYSTEM VOICE (V.O.)
Check-in System: Day 1. Reward: 1,000,000,000 yuan. Transfer complete.

A bank notification appears. Chen Fan stares at the balance.

CHEN FAN (V.O.)
This is what freedom costs. And what revenge requires.

title: If Only I Had Known
description: A woman who neglected her mother for years returns for her birthday, only to discover a tragic accident that changes everything.
context:
Title: If Only I Had Known
Description: A woman who neglected her mother for years returns for her birthday, only to discover a tragic accident that changes everything.

EXT. VILLAGE PATH - DAY

Quick cuts: An elderly woman (WANG HUIRU, 70s) falls to the ground, her head hitting a stone. Blood trickles from her temple.

WANG HUIRU
(whispering, disoriented)
Dalong... Xiaoting... the soup...

A college student (JIANG QINGYA, 20s) jogs along the path, stopping short at the sight. She rushes forward, kneeling.

JIANG QINGYA
(gasping)
Auntie Wang! Can you hear me?

Jiang Qingya's fingers tremble as she dials her phone.

WANG HUIRU
(mumbling)
Xiaoting's favorite... red dates...

JIANG QINGYA
(into phone, urgent)
Emergency? Village path east of Willow Creek. Elderly woman, head trauma, unconscious. Yes, immediately!

SIRENS wail in the distance, growing louder.

JIANG QINGYA
(squeezing Wang's hand)
Stay with me. They're coming. Your children need you.

The AMBULANCE screeches to a halt. DR. HU (40s) and a NURSE leap out.

DR. HU
Ma'am, move aside please.

Dr. Hu performs a rapid assessment, his expression grim.

DR. HU
(to Nurse)
GCS 8, possible epidural hematoma. Let's move. Sir, we need family contact.

JIANG QINGYA
I live nearby. I can sign, but please—save her first.

DR. HU
Get in.

INT. SEDAN - DAY

CHEN XIAOTING (35), polished nails gripping the wheel, navigates narrow village roads.

CHEN XIAOTING
(into bluetooth)
Brother, I'm literally five minutes away. Put Mom on, I'll apologize for being late.

CHEN DALONG (V.O.)
She's not answering. It's her birthday, Ting. She waited all morning.

CHEN XIAOTING
(exhaling sharply)
I know. I bought her that coat she wanted. And these cakes from Shanghai—cost a fortune. I'm trying, okay?

She checks her reflection, dabbing lipstick.

CHEN DALONG (V.O.)
Dad died waiting for us to come home. Don't let Mom—

CHEN XIAOTING
(cutting him off)
I'm here now. That's what matters.

The ambulance ROARS around a blind curve, directly toward her.

CHEN XIAOTING
(screaming)
Move! Move!

She jerks the wheel, mounting the embankment. Metal SCREECHES—her mirror rips off, smashing against the ambulance. The vehicle shudders to a halt.

CHEN XIAOTING
(clutching her bleeding hand)
You maniac!

She stumbles out, ready to scream, then freezes.

Through the ambulance's open rear doors, she sees Dr. Hu working frantically. The patient is tiny, frail. A flash of gray hair. A familiar sweater.

Her breath catches. The cake box tumbles from her hands.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Chen Xiaoting sprints after the gurney, blood dripping from her hand unnoticed.

CHEN XIAOTING
(panicked)
Mom? Mom! That's my mother!

DR. HU
(stern)
Wait here.

The double doors SLAM shut. Chen Dalong (40s) rushes in, breathless.

CHEN DALONG
Mom? Where is she? What happened?

CHEN XIAOTING
(whispering)
I saw her, Dalong. I saw her on that stretcher. The blood...

Her legs give way. He catches her.

CHEN DALONG
(to reception)
Our mother—Wang Huiru—just arrived. I'm her son.

RECEPTIONIST
Sir, the doctor needs consent for emergency craniotomy. Are you immediate family?

CHEN XIAOTING
(voice cracking)
I'm her daughter. I'll sign. I'll sign anything.

She grabs the forms, her designer handbag slipping from her shoulder.

INT. HOSPITAL WAITING ROOM - NIGHT

Four hours later. The brothersister sit in silence. Chen Xiaoting's nails are chipped, her coat stained with her own blood.

DR. HU enters, surgical cap in hand. They spring up.

DR. HU

title: The Man in the Suit
description: When her boyfriend abandons her on her birthday for another woman, a heartbroken celebration planner finds herself in peril—until a mysterious figure from her past intervenes.
context:
Title: The Man in the Suit
Description: When her boyfriend abandons her on her birthday for another woman, a heartbroken celebration planner finds herself in peril—until a mysterious figure from her past intervenes.

EXT. CAMPING SITE - NIGHT

Rain hammers a meticulously decorated outdoor birthday setup. Twinkling lights sag under the downpour. A champagne bottle lies on its side, contents bleeding into mud. QIN SHUZHI clutches a small velvet box.

SHEN YIQIONG already has his car keys out.

QIN SHUZHI
Shen Yiqiong—wait.

SHEN YIQIONG stops, shoulders taut.

QIN SHUZHI
(quietly)
The client from last week. The one you swore was 'just business.'

SHEN YIQIONG
She slipped in her penthouse. I lose her account, I lose the partnership. Everything I've built.

QIN SHUZHI
And us? Three years is just... billable hours?

She opens the velvet box—a vintage watch he promised to replace. He doesn't recognize it.

SHEN YIQIONG
Don't make me choose between my future and your anxiety.

QIN SHUZHI
I'm not asking you to choose. I'm asking you to remember.

SHEN YIQIONG
I can't. Not tonight.

He opens his umbrella. The handle is monogrammed: Z.S.Q.

QIN SHUZHI
If you walk away, we're done. For real.

SHEN YIQIONG
Then I guess we're done.

He leaves. QIN SHUZHI stands motionless as rain destroys her perfect party. She spots her grandmother's locket on the gift table—must have fallen when he shook her off. She walks back for it.
continuation:
EXT. STONE PATH - NIGHT

QIN SHUZHI, now barefoot, shielding the locket under her dress. Her phone flashlight flickers.

Two THUGS, THUG A and THUG B, in soaked work uniforms share a flask under a leaky tarp. They notice her.

THUG A
Boss's girl ain't showing. But hey, birthday princess looks lost.

THUG B
(steps forward, slurring)
Need an escort home, pretty thing?

He reaches for her waist. She shoves him. He stumbles, flask skittering across stones.

THUG A
Bitch just cost me good liquor.

EXT. FOREST PATH - NIGHT

QIN SHUZHI runs, phone clutched in one hand, locket in the other. She dials.

QIN SHUZHI
(into phone, gasping)
Shen—there's men—I'm on the forest path—

SPLIT SCREEN

Left: QIN SHUZHI trips, scrambles up.

Right: SHEN YIQIONG glances at his car's GPS—her location still shows the campsite.

SHEN YIQIONG (V.O.)
Your tracking says you're at the tent, Shuzhi. I'm not driving back for theater.

QIN SHUZHI
(desperately)
The locket—your umbrella—please—

Her phone sputters, dies from water damage. The men close in.

END SPLIT SCREEN

EXT. FOREST PATH - NIGHT

A MAN IN SUIT emerges from the tree line, umbrella perfectly still. He sees QIN SHUZHI cornered.

MAN IN SUIT (V.O.)
Still running toward danger. Some things never change.

He pulls out a telescopic baton with practiced ease.

FADE OUT.

title: Wings of Time
description: A pop diva and her producer are reborn into 1978 after a fatal car accident, where they must navigate new lives in a world decades before their own time.
context:
Title: Wings of Time
Description: A pop diva and her producer are reborn into 1978 after a fatal car accident, where they must navigate new lives in a world decades before their own time.

EXT. AWARD CEREMONY RED CARPET - NIGHT

Fans scream wildly, holding up banners with "SHEN WU" and "HEARTTHROB" written on them.

CLOSE UP: A pair of black high heels descending stairs.

SHEN WU, a pop diva, wears a gorgeous black evening gown. She elegantly walks down the stairs, smiling and waving to fans. She steps onto the red carpet. Flashbulbs pop constantly, fans cheer one after another.

INT. SEDAN - NIGHT

SHEN WU sits in the back seat, rubbing her temples, looking somewhat tired. Her manager and best friend XU YIN sits beside her.

XU YIN
(low, proud)
You did it, Xiao Wu. One year, and you own the stage. The critics who said you'd burn out can eat their words now.

SHEN WU
(softly)
The words are yours, Yin. Every lyric you bled onto paper. I just sang them loud enough for people to hear.

XU YIN
We built this together. No takebacks.

SHEN WU
(quiet vulnerability)
Promise me something. When we get to the afterparty, don't make me network. Just... let me breathe. With you.

XU YIN
(counting on fingers)
Three songs, two handshakes, one photo. Then I smuggle you out the back.

SHEN WU
Deal.

Suddenly, a large truck drives toward them head-on. Blinding lights illuminate the car interior. XU YIN instinctively grabs SHEN WU's hand.

XU YIN
(yelling)
Hold on—

SOUND EFFECT: Piercing brake sounds and violent collision.

INT. UNFAMILIAR ROOM - DAY

SHEN WU wakes up in a man's arms. She is wearing festive red clothing. The man is LU XUAN.

SHEN WU (V.O.)
(horrified realization)
These aren't my hands. This isn't my body. This is—

LU XUAN
(opening his eyes)
Shen Wu, what are you doing?

SHEN WU
(groggily)
Get up, hey you...

LU XUAN
Get up!

SHEN WU
(hugging tighter, mumbling)
No, no, no... if I wake up, I'm dead. We both are. Just let me—

LU XUAN
Shen Wu, Shen Wu!

LU XUAN pushes SHEN WU away forcefully. She falls from the bed to the floor.

LU XUAN
Shen Wu!

SHEN WU
(painfully)
That hurts. Dreams don't hurt like this.

SHEN WU looks around. The room has old-fashioned wooden furniture, with red double happiness paper cuts on the walls. The style is very dated.

SHEN WU
(confused)
Where... where is this? The set design is too detailed for a—

LU XUAN
(settling back on the bed, cold)
Save your performance for Lin Zhiyuan. You got what you wanted, didn't you? Ran from our wedding night straight into his arms.

LU XUAN pulls out a packed bundle from under the bed and throws it on the floor beside her.

LU XUAN
It's signed. Be gone by dawn.

SHEN WU
(shocked)
Educated youth? Divorce?
continuation:
EXT. NIGHT STREET - NIGHT

QUICK CUTS: SHEN WU runs through old streets carrying the bundle, expression panicked. A man chases behind her. Another man looks at her in horror.

SHEN WU (V.O.)
(deeper panic setting in)
I'm in a stranger's skin, running from a stranger's husband, in a world that shouldn't exist. Yin... where are you?

INT. UNFAMILIAR ROOM - DAY

SHEN WU sits on the edge of the bed, arms crossed over her chest, face full of disbelief.

SHEN WU (V.O.)
(cold dread pooling)
Traveling through time. That's not... that's not a thing. But I felt the truck hit us. I felt—

GIRL (O.S.)
Ah! Who are you?

SHEN WU is startled and turns around.

GIRL
Yin Yin! Yin Yin, something happened, Yin Yin!

A girl wearing a red sweater and green skirt rushes in. It's XU YIN's appearance—but younger, thinner, desperate.

SHEN WU
(running over, voice cracking)
Yin? Is that... you?

XU YIN
(grasping her hands)
Sister Shen! I woke up in this body and I knew—somehow I knew you'd be here. I ran every street in this damned town until—

SHEN WU
(urgent whisper)
The truck. The award. Did you—

XU YIN
(low voice, haunted)
I remember dying. I remember your hand in mine. And then... this.

The two embrace, shaking.

SHEN WU
(pulling back, studying her face)
You're seventeen. You look seventeen.

XU YIN
(mock laugh)
You're married. You look terrified.

SHEN WU
(quietly)
Ten years of life and death, so vast.

XU YIN
(whispering)
Five years of sound and death, so vast.

XU YIN
Sister!

SHEN WU
Sister!

The two embrace excitedly.

Their eyes fall on a calendar on the wall.

CLOSE UP: The calendar clearly shows the year "1978".

The two turn their heads simultaneously, looking at each other, faces filled with shock and fear.

SHEN WU & XU YIN
(in unison, V.O.)
We really traveled through time!

title: Time Agent
description: A terminally ill man attempts suicide after being abandoned by his girlfriend, but a mysterious Time Elder saves him and grants him a pocket watch that can extend life, see death countdowns, and manipulate time.
context:
Title: Time Agent
Description: A terminally ill man attempts suicide after being abandoned by his girlfriend, but a mysterious Time Elder saves him and grants him a pocket watch that can extend life, see death countdowns, and manipulate time.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
(Girlfriend's voice)
Li Yang, let's break up. I won't be with someone who has a terminal illness.

EXT. RAINY STREET - NIGHT

LI YANG, wearing a plaid shirt, staggers through the rain. He covers his mouth, coughing. A medical bracelet on his wrist.

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

LI YANG stands at the edge of the rooftop, blood at the corner of his mouth, his eyes hollow. Below, a crowd gathers, phones raised to record.

LI YANG looks down at the crowd, his expression anguished.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
(Girlfriend's voice)
Take a good look at yourself and see what you really are.

LI YANG (V.O.)
I gave you everything I had. I was truly blind.

LI YANG spreads his arms and falls backward, plummeting from the high-rise.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Time suddenly stops. Everything and everyone on the street freezes. Flower petals from a man's hand hang suspended in mid-air. Popcorn from a girl's hand also stops in mid-air.

A ragged, white-haired TIME ELDER slowly walks toward the falling LI YANG.

The TIME ELDER extends his hand. LI YANG's body floats in the air, then is gently placed on the ground.

Time resumes. LI YANG lies on the ground, groaning in pain.

LI YANG
Ah!

LI YANG jolts awake and finds himself lying safely on the ground. Confused, he stands up and looks at the crowd around him.

LI YANG
What's going on?

The TIME ELDER walks up to him, holding a pocket watch.

TIME ELDER
Young man, since you paid for it, this pocket watch is yours.

LI YANG
Pocket watch?

EXT. STREET CORNER - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

The TIME ELDER stops a distraught LI YANG.

TIME ELDER
Young man, want to buy something? This pocket watch is a good item. Only five hundred yuan.

LI YANG gives a bitter smile and pulls out all his cash from his pocket, handing it to the TIME ELDER.

LI YANG
Old man, this money doesn't mean anything to me anymore. I don't need the watch. You keep it.

LI YANG turns to leave.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

The TIME ELDER holds the watch up. It glows softly.

TIME ELDER
It measures what you have left. Save a life, gain half a day. The rest will reveal itself.

The TIME ELDER places the pocket watch in LI YANG's hand and then disappears.

LI YANG looks at the pocket watch in his hand. The watch glows and forms a countdown on his arm: 06:59:59.

LI YANG stares in shock at the numbers on his arm, then looks at the crowd around him.

LI YANG
Old man!

LI YANG's ex-girlfriend appears in the crowd, looking at him with confusion.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

EXT. RAINY STREET - NIGHT

LI YANG, wearing a plaid shirt, staggers through the rain. He covers his mouth, coughing. A medical bracelet on his wrist.

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

LI YANG stands at the edge of the rooftop, blood at the corner of his mouth, his eyes hollow. Below, a crowd gathers, phones raised to record.

LI YANG looks down at the crowd, his expression anguished.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
(Girlfriend's voice)
Take a good look at yourself and see what you really are.

LI YANG (V.O.)
I gave you everything I had. I was truly blind.

LI YANG spreads his arms and falls backward, plummeting from the high-rise.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Time suddenly stops. Everything and everyone on the street freezes. Flower petals from a man's hand hang suspended in mid-air. Popcorn from a girl's hand also stops in mid-air.

A ragged, white-haired TIME ELDER slowly walks toward the falling LI YANG.

The TIME ELDER extends his hand. LI YANG's body floats in the air, then is gently placed on the ground.

Time resumes. LI YANG lies on the ground, groaning in pain.

LI YANG
Ah!

LI YANG jolts awake and finds himself lying safely on the ground. Confused, he stands up and looks at the crowd around him.

LI YANG
What's going on?

The TIME ELDER walks up to him, holding a pocket watch.

TIME ELDER
Young man, since you paid for it, this pocket watch is yours.

LI YANG
Pocket watch?

EXT. STREET CORNER - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

The TIME ELDER stops a distraught LI YANG.

TIME ELDER
Young man, want to buy something? This pocket watch is a good item. Only five hundred yuan.

LI YANG gives a bitter smile and pulls out all his cash from his pocket, handing it to the TIME ELDER.

LI YANG
Old man, this money doesn't mean anything to me anymore. I don't need the watch. You keep it.

LI YANG turns to leave.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

The TIME ELDER holds the watch up. It glows softly.

TIME ELDER
It measures what you have left. Save a life, gain half a day. The rest will reveal itself.

The TIME ELDER places the pocket watch in LI YANG's hand and then disappears.

LI YANG looks at the pocket watch in his hand. The watch glows and forms a countdown on his arm: 06:59:59.

LI YANG stares in shock at the numbers on his arm, then looks at the crowd around him.

LI YANG
Old man!

LI YANG's ex-girlfriend appears in the crowd, looking at him with confusion.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Longing Under the Bright Moon
description: A wealthy mother searches for her lost daughter while her son prepares to introduce his girlfriend, unaware of the connection that binds them.
context:
Title: Longing Under the Bright Moon
Description: A wealthy mother searches for her lost daughter while her son prepares to introduce his girlfriend, unaware of the connection that binds them.

INT. CHEN FAMILY MANSION - DAY

CHEN FENG sits on a luxurious sofa, a silver picture frame in her lap. She runs her thumb over the glass, lost in thought. After a moment, she sets it face-down on the cushion beside her.

CHEN NIANMING enters, loosening his tie. He notices the frame, hesitates.

CHEN NIANMING
Mom. I was hoping we could talk.

CHEN FENG
(quickly smoothing her expression)
Of course. About what?

She reaches for the frame, but Nianming sits beside her, blocking it.

CHEN NIANMING
I've been seeing someone. For two years now.

CHEN FENG's hand stills. She looks at him, hope flickering.

CHEN NIANMING
(gentle)
Not about Mingyue. The investigators haven't... there are no new leads.

The hope in CHEN FENG's eyes dims. She withdraws her hand, folds it in her lap.

CHEN FENG
I see.

A beat. She forces a smile.

CHEN FENG
But this... this is good news. Tell me about her.

CHEN NIANMING
Her name is Sisi. She's nothing like what you'd expect.

CHEN FENG
Meaning?

CHEN NIANMING
She's... herself. Not from our world. But she'll fit. I know she will.

CHEN FENG
(small smile)
You sound certain.

CHEN NIANMING
I am. Dinner tonight. Her father too.

CHEN FENG nods, glancing at the overturned frame.

CHEN FENG
Then we should prepare something appropriate.

CHEN AIMING enters with a fruit platter, notices the tension.

CHEN AIMING
Mom? Everything alright?

CHEN FENG
Your brother's finally bringing someone home.

CHEN AIMING
(to NIANMING, teasing)
Two years? You actually managed to keep a secret?

CHEN NIANMING
She's worth protecting.

CHEN FENG stands, her composure returning.

CHEN FENG
Aiming, help me with the jewelry safe. I want to find something suitable.

As they exit, CHEN FENG's gaze drifts back to the sofa. The overturned photo.

CHEN FENG (V.O.)
The right age now. Maybe even... no. Don't hope.
continuation:
INT. SISI'S HOME - DAY

A small, tidy apartment. LI XIANG, mid-fifties, rolls his shoulder with a wince as he reaches for a jar of ointment.

LI SISI enters, still in her work uniform, grocery bag in hand.

LI SISI
Dad, stop. You'll make it worse.

She sets the bag down, takes the jar. He lowers his hand, lets her take over.

LI XIANG
Just old bones. Doesn't take much.

LI SISI's fingers work gently, practiced. She says nothing, but her touch is careful.

LI XIANG
(quieter)
You're home early.

LI SISI
Swapped shifts. For tonight.

A pause. He studies her profile.

LI XIANG
You nervous?

LI SISI
(smiling)
Terrified.

LI XIANG
Good. Means you care.

He touches her hand briefly.

LI XIANG
Go get ready. I'll be fine.

LI SISI nods, but stays a moment longer, ensuring the patch is smooth.

MONTAGE

CHEN NIANMING is on the phone in his office, expression soft.

CHEN NIANMING
(on phone)
She wants everything to be perfect. Which means she's already planning.

LI SISI answers the phone at her workplace, keeping her voice low.

LI SISI
(on phone)
Tell her not to. Please. Just... normal.

CHEN NIANMING
(on phone)
I'll try. But 'normal' isn't really her specialty.

LI SISI
(on phone, laughing quietly)
I'll wear the dress then. The one you like.

CHEN NIANMING
(on phone)
The one I bought you? You said it was too much.

LI SISI
(on phone)
It is. But if it helps...

CHEN NIANMING
(on phone)
Just be you. That's what I need tonight.

LI SISI looks at her uniform, the name tag: "Li Sisi." She touches it.

LI SISI
(on phone)
I'll try.

She hangs up. The name tag catches the light.

title: The Ice Coffin
description: A woman whose family was destroyed by the Regent Prince undergoes a painful transformation in an ice coffin to seek revenge.
context:
Title: The Ice Coffin
Description: A woman whose family was destroyed by the Regent Prince undergoes a painful transformation in an ice coffin to seek revenge.

INT. GU PHYSICIAN IMMORTAL'S RESIDENCE - DAY

A woman in red, JIANG YINGYUE, walks barefoot on cold stone. White cloths inscribed with talismans hang like ghosts. The camera cuts—her hair turns snow-white in an instant.

GU PHYSICIAN IMMORTAL (V.O.)
Jade Maiden Water. Seven days and seven nights in the ice coffin. You'll emerge with restored youth... enough to walk into any palace unchallenged. But the pain will hollow you out. And after ten months, the price comes due.

INT. ICE COFFIN - DAY

JIANG YINGYUE lies in the coffin, white mist swirling. Her body convulses silently.

JIANG YINGYUE (V.O.)
They took everything.

She lies on red silk, her eyes empty. Blood trickles from her lip where she's bitten through.

JIANG YINGYUE (V.O.)
Three days ago, my husband was summoned to cook his famous Diaochan Tofu for the Regent's concubine...

FLASHBACK:

Her shadow writhes on the talisman cloths, contorted in agony.

ON SCREEN: THREE DAYS AGO
continuation:
INT. SU FAMILY COURTYARD - DAY

Peach blossoms drift. JIANG YINGYUE pushes her daughter SU JIUJIU on a swing.

SU JIUJIU
Higher, Mother!

SU JINCHENG enters with SU XU, carrying market baskets.

SU JINCHENG
My dear wife. The Regent's concubine requests my Diaochan Tofu.

SU XU
A hundred taels, Mother! Enough for your birthday jade pins.

SU JIUJIU
What about me, Father?

SU JINCHENG
(Laughing)
A gold lock for your dowry, little one.

He kisses JIANG YINGYUE's forehead. The family laughs together.

EXT. REGENT PRINCE'S MANSION - NIGHT

LIU YAN reclines on a silk couch. SU JINCHENG and SU XU kneel.

LIU YAN
Your wife cannot stand bean odor, yet loves your tofu?

SU JINCHENG
Yes, my lady. The technique removes the essence completely.

LIU YAN
(Sitting up)
The Prince values loyalty. A man who shares secrets with his wife shares them with his enemies.

She flicks a dagger. It embeds between them.

LIU YAN
Guards. Boil them until their secrets are gone.

GUARDS seize them. SU JINCHENG shields his son.

SU JINCHENG
Mercy! We've done nothing!

LIU YAN
You existed. That is crime enough.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Moon Shines on My Heart
description: A young wife says goodbye to her soldier husband who leaves for war just one month after their wedding. Thirty years later, a chance encounter at a hospital may reunite them.
context:
Title: The Moon Shines on My Heart
Description: A young wife says goodbye to her soldier husband who leaves for war just one month after their wedding. Thirty years later, a chance encounter at a hospital may reunite them.

INT. VILLAGE DIRT ROAD - DAY (THIRTY YEARS AGO)

A military truck loaded with young soldiers slowly drives along. Villagers wave goodbye from the roadside, emotions running high.

Young XIAO YUE (20s) grips the edge of the truck tightly, holding hands with her husband ZHOU GE (20s) on the truck, tears streaming down her face.

ZHOU GE
Xiao Yue, I'm sorry. Just one month after our wedding, I have to leave for the strait war. I've failed you.

XIAO YUE
(crying)
Zhou Ge, you must come back safe and sound.

ZHOU GE
Don't worry. We'll definitely win in six months. Six months from now, wait for me to come home.

The truck accelerates, forcing Xiao Yue to let go. She runs after the truck for a few steps, shouting loudly.

XIAO YUE
(shouting)
Zhou Ge! Zhou Ge! I haven't told you yet - you're going to be a father! It's twins! We'll have both a son and a daughter!

Zhou Ge on the truck leans out as far as he can, but due to the distance and noise, he can't hear clearly.

ZHOU GE
(shouting)
Xiao Yue, what did you say? I can't hear you!

The truck drives away. Xiao Yue stops running, caressing her belly, watching the departing truck, her face covered in tears.

DISSOLVE TO:

INT. XIAO YUE'S HOME - DAY

Elderly XIAO YUE (50s) busies herself in the kitchen, preparing a table full of delicious dishes. She wears a smile, seemingly anticipating something.

Her phone rings. Xiao Yue happily answers.

XIAO YUE
(on phone)
(happy)
Hello?

DAUGHTER XIAO XIAO (V.O.)
Mom? I hate to do this, but my boss just scheduled an emergency meeting for tonight. I tried everything to get out of it--

Xiao Yue's smile falters. She forces brightness into her voice.

XIAO YUE
(on phone)
It's okay, sweetie. Your career is important. We'll celebrate next weekend.

Xiao Yue hangs up, looking at the prepared feast. The phone rings again.

SON NIAN NIAN (V.O.)
Mom, I'm so sorry. Your grandson has a fever and Jun's working late. I can't bring him out in this weather--

XIAO YUE
(on phone)
Take care of my grandson. That's what matters. I'll save you both some mooncakes.

She ends the call, staring at her reflection in the window. Her dog TU DOU nudges her hand.

Later, Xiao Yue takes out a red marriage certificate from a drawer and gently opens it. She caresses the photo of her and Zhou Ge from their youth, then touches the well-worn edges.

She places it beside a framed photo of her children as toddlers, then looks at a newer photo of her grandchildren on the wall.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - DAY

Xiao Yue stands in front of a self-service registration machine, squinting at the screen. Her hands tremble slightly as she touches it.

A YOUNG MAN behind her shifts impatiently.

YOUNG MAN
Can you hurry up?

XIAO YUE
(flustered)
I'm trying... this new system confuses me.

YOUNG MAN
(sighs)
Then get your kids to help! Some of us have actual jobs to get back to.

XIAO YUE
(lowered voice)
They're busy.

She steps aside, clutching her hospital card. The young man brushes past.

Xiao Yue approaches a help desk instead, where a NURSE notices her.

INT. HOSPITAL INFUSION ROOM - DAY

Xiao Yue sits alone in a chair receiving an IV drip. The bag is nearly empty. She watches the drip chamber, tracking each drop.

Across the room, a HOSPITAL MAN (50s) - weathered face, graying hair - also sits with an IV. He glances at her.

Xiao Yue notices him. She stares. His profile, his posture...

Her breath catches. She studies his hands - one bears a faint scar across the knuckles.

FLASHBACK: Zhou Ge's hand, young and strong, that same scar from a childhood accident.

The Hospital Man feels her gaze and turns. Their eyes meet. He blinks, puzzled.

XIAO YUE
(whisper)
Zhou... Ge?

The man tilts his head. A flicker of something crosses his face - confusion, recognition, disbelief.

HOSPITAL MAN
(hoarse)
Do I... know you?

Xiao Yue trembles, tears filling her eyes. She touches her chest, then points to him.

XIAO YUE
It's me. Xiao Yue.

He stares. The IV alarm BEEPS beside him. Neither moves.

A NURSE approaches Xiao Yue.

NURSE
Ma'am, your drip's done.

The Nurse removes Xiao Yue's needle. Xiao Yue doesn't look away from the man.

The Nurse notices the tension, glances between them.

NURSE
(to Hospital Man)
Sir? Your bag's empty too.

He barely nods, still locked on Xiao Yue. The Nurse removes his needle.

When the Nurse leaves, silence stretches between them.

HOSPITAL MAN
(quiet, strained)
They told me... my family thought I was gone. I couldn't remember my name for twenty years. Only fragments.

XIAO YUE
(voice breaking)
We waited. I waited.

He looks down at his weathered hands. When he looks up, his eyes are wet.

HOSPITAL MAN
The twins?

Xiao Yue nods slowly, tears streaming down her face.

XIAO YUE
A son and a daughter. Both grown. Two grandchildren now.

She reaches into her bag with shaking hands and pulls out her phone. Shows him a photo of her family - her children, grandchildren.

His hand trembles as he reaches for the phone.

HOSPITAL MAN
(whisper)
I have a family.

XIAO YUE
You always did.

He hands back the phone. Their fingers brush. A lifetime passes in that touch.

HOSPITAL MAN
I'm staying with... someone who helped me. After the war injuries. But... may I see them? The children?

XIAO YUE
(softly)
They're your children too.

For the first time, a small, hesitant smile touches his lips.

HOSPITAL MAN
Mid-Autumn Festival is next week. I remember... you promised to wait.

XIAO YUE
I never stopped.

He nods, eyes glistening with resolve.

HOSPITAL MAN
Then... we still have time.

Xiao Yue looks at him - this stranger who is her husband. The tears on her face are no longer just of sorrow.

FADE OUT.

HOSPITAL MAN
(whisper)
I have a family.

XIAO YUE
You always did.

He hands back the phone. Their fingers brush. A lifetime passes in that touch.

HOSPITAL MAN
I'm staying with... someone who helped me. After the war injuries. But... may I see them? The children?

XIAO YUE
(softly)
They're your children too.

For the first time, a small, hesitant smile touches his lips.

HOSPITAL MAN
Mid-Autumn Festival is next week. I remember... you promised to wait.

XIAO YUE
I never stopped.

He nods, eyes glistening with resolve.

HOSPITAL MAN
Then... we still have time.

Xiao Yue looks at him - this stranger who is her husband. The tears on her face are no longer just of sorrow.

FADE OUT.

title: The Pearl's Promise
description: Gu Mingzhu, the Gu family's eldest daughter, finds herself in an unexpected encounter with Yan Jingcheng, the fourth young master of the Yan Group, leading to a night that changes everything.
context:
Title: The Pearl's Promise
Description: Gu Mingzhu, the Gu family's eldest daughter, finds herself in an unexpected encounter with Yan Jingcheng, the fourth young master of the Yan Group, leading to a night that changes everything.

INT. HOTEL SUITE - NIGHT

GU MINGZHU, the Gu family's eldest daughter, sits on the edge of a hotel bed in a simple white dress, clutching a pearl necklace. The city lights gleam through the window.

GU MINGZHU (V.O.)
The Wang family wants an answer by tomorrow. Mother's medical bills are due next week.

She places the necklace carefully on the nightstand and lies down, exhausted.

GU MINGZHU (V.O.)
Just one night of peace. That's all I ask.

She closes her eyes.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

Neon lights pulse. YAN JINGCHENG, the fourth young master of the Yan Group, sits alone, ignoring his buzzing phone. He pours another drink.

YAN JINGCHENG (V.O.)
Another merger negotiation. Another marriage they want to arrange for me.

He downs the glass and stands, swaying slightly.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

YAN JINGCHENG fumbles with his key card at the door. The green light flashes. He enters.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL SUITE - CONTINUOUS

YAN JINGCHENG stops short. GU MINGZHU stirs on the bed, still in her white dress.

YAN JINGCHENG
(to himself)
Wrong room. Damn key cards.

He turns to leave, but his jacket catches the door handle. As he yanks it free, GU MINGZHU sits up with a start.

GU MINGZHU
Who—get out!

She grabs the nearest object—the pearl necklace—and flings it at him. He instinctively catches it and steps forward to return it.

YAN JINGCHENG
Wait, I—-

Her foot catches in the bedsheet. She falls backward, pulling him with her in a tangle of limbs. They land on the bed. The necklace drops between them.

The scene cuts away.

INT. HOTEL SUITE - DAY

Morning light filters through the curtains. YAN JINGCHENG sits on the sofa, head in his hands. GU MINGZHU emerges from behind the screen, her expression controlled fury.

YAN JINGCHENG
You can relax, Miss Gu. I have no interest in whatever scheme you're running.

GU MINGZHU
Scheme? This is my room. You broke in.

YAN JINGCHENG
The hotel made an error. But you certainly seemed...accommodating last night.

GU MINGZHU
Accommodating? I was defending myself.

YAN JINGCHENG
By pulling me into bed?

GU MINGZHU
By trying not to break my neck. Your technique needs work, Fourth Young Master.

She spots her pearl necklace on the floor and snatches it up.

GU MINGZHU
Keep your assumptions. And your distance.

She takes a business card from her bag and places it on the table.

GU MINGZHU
If you're worried about...complications, call this number. My lawyer deals with parasites.

She turns to leave.

YAN JINGCHENG
Parasites? That's rich coming from someone who practically gift-wrapped herself for the Wang merger.

GU MINGZHU freezes, then walks out without looking back.

YAN JINGCHENG notices something on the nightstand: a medical bill with her mother's name, stamped "URGENT." His expression shifts.

Secretary CHEN QING enters with a tablet.

CHEN QING
Fourth Young Master, the hotel confirms—this suite is registered to Gu Mingzhu. Your actual room is three floors up. And...the Wang family meeting is in two hours.

YAN JINGCHENG stares at the medical bill, then toward the door where GU MINGZHU disappeared.

title: Starlight Falls Into My Palm
description: A young woman is forced to marry a comatose heir in place of her employer's daughter, entering a world of wealth and secrets.
context:
Title: Starlight Falls Into My Palm
Description: A young woman is forced to marry a comatose heir in place of her employer's daughter, entering a world of wealth and secrets.

INT. CHEN FAMILY BEDROOM - DAY

Sunlight filters through heavy curtains. CHEN YUBAI lies motionless, breathing aided by subtle medical equipment. DR. JIANG reviews charts while a NURSE adjusts IV lines.

CHEN'S MOTHER (60s, elegant, fraying at the edges) hovers near the door. SECRETARY QIN stands impassively beside her.

DR. JIANG closes the file with a soft snap.

CHEN'S MOTHER
Dr. Jiang?

DR. JIANG
The vitals remain stable. But Madam... two years. The brain activity hasn't changed.

CHEN'S MOTHER
(quietly desperate)
So we're just waiting for his body to give up?

DR. JIANG
We're doing everything medically possible. Sometimes... there are limits.

The doctor exits. The nurse follows.

CHEN'S MOTHER stares at her son, then at the medical equipment keeping him alive. She touches a jade bracelet on her wrist—an heirloom.

CHEN'S MOTHER
(to herself)
The fortune-teller said... a wedding might shift his fate.

CHEN'S MOTHER
(to SECRETARY QIN)
The Song girl. The engagement our fathers made. Bring her.

SECRETARY QIN
Madam... the legalities—

CHEN'S MOTHER
A ceremony. That's all. Something to wake the universe. Make it happen.

SECRETARY QIN
Yes, Madam.

INT. SONG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

SONG YAYA (20, polished, terrified beneath the anger) paces like a caged animal. A vase crashes to the floor. Her parents watch from the sofa.

FATHER SONG
Yaya, the Chen family holds our debt. We have no choice.

SONG YAYA
Then let them take the house! I'm not spending my life tethered to a corpse!

MOTHER SONG
It's only symbolic. A year, then you can—

SONG YAYA
A year of my life, Mother! A year of being the widow who was never a wife!

MOTHER SONG
(to FATHER SONG)
What about Qiao Wanwan? Your late brother's illegitimate daughter. She owes us.

FATHER SONG
(rubbing his temples)
She looks enough like Yaya to pass. But if Chen's mother finds out...

MOTHER SONG
She won't. Wanwan knows what happens to her mother if she talks.

MOTHER SONG
(calling sharply)
Wanwan!

QIAO WANWAN (22, quiet eyes, contained fire) enters. She holds herself like someone used to being invisible.

QIAO WANWAN
Madam?

FATHER SONG
Your cousin's engagement. You'll stand in for her. Temporarily.

QIAO WANWAN
I'm not family enough to be family, but I'm family enough for this?

MOTHER SONG
Don't be clever. Your mother needs her medication. That expensive treatment.

QIAO WANWAN
(very still)
You're threatening my mother.

MOTHER SONG
I'm offering you a way to save her. And yourself.

QIAO WANWAN looks at SONG YAYA, who won't meet her eyes. Then at the shattered vase on the floor.

QIAO WANWAN
I'll need it in writing. My mother's care. Guaranteed.
continuation:
EXT. SONG FAMILY VILLA - DUSK

QIAO WANWAN, in a simple white dress that doesn't quite fit, kneels before SISTER QIAO (50s, frail but sharp).

SISTER QIAO
(trembling fingers on Wanwan's face)
You're lying. The Song girl would never let you—

QIAO WANWAN
(forcing a smile)
It's a job, Mom. Like being a caretaker. Just... in a nicer house.

SISTER QIAO
Wanwan...

SECRETARY QIN waits by the black car, face neutral.

SONG YAYA appears on the balcony above, clutching a wine glass. She raises it in a bitter toast.

SONG YAYA
Don't forget to send postcards from your new life.

QIAO WANWAN helps her mother stand, then walks to the car without looking back.

INT. CHEN FAMILY MANSION - NIGHT

QIAO WANWAN follows SECRETARY QIN through cavernous halls. Modern art clashes with ancestral portraits. Everything gleams with old money.

QIAO WANWAN (V.O.)
Rich enough to buy miracles. Desperate enough to try.

SECRETARY QIN stops at double doors.

SECRETARY QIN
He doesn't know you're coming. Or maybe he does. Who can say?

He opens the doors but doesn't enter.

INT. CHEN FAMILY BEDROOM - CONTINUOUS

QIAO WANWAN steps inside. The doors close behind her. She hears the LOCK CLICK.

She tries the handle. Locked.

She turns. The room is larger than her entire childhood home. And there, in the center, CHEN YUBAI.

She approaches slowly. Up close, he looks younger than his photographs. A faded scar cuts through his left eyebrow.

She notices his hand rests on top of the blanket. On impulse, she places her smaller hand near his—not touching, just... parallel.

QIAO WANWAN
(whisper)
They bought me to be your ghost bride. But I don't believe in ghosts.

She sits in the chair beside his bed. Outside, the city lights begin to flicker on.

QIAO WANWAN (V.O.)
Let them lock their doors. I've been a ghost my whole life.

FADE OUT.

title: Starlight Trap
description: A famous actress is murdered by her fiancé and wakes up in the body of an unknown girl, forced to attend her own funeral.
context:
Title: Starlight Trap
Description: A famous actress is murdered by her fiancé and wakes up in the body of an unknown girl, forced to attend her own funeral.

EXT. ROAD - DAY

ZHEN TIAN walks down the street. A young man (SUITOR) holding red roses catches up to her.

SUITOR
Tiantian! When will you finally agree to be my girlfriend?

ZHEN TIAN glances back at him. A tired smile.

ZHEN TIAN
When I'm ready. When this film wraps.

ZHEN TIAN runs laughing toward the other side of the road. A stunt truck speeds toward her—wrong cue. Brakes SCREAM.

SUITOR
(terrified)
Stunt team! Abort!

The truck hits ZHEN TIAN. She falls in a pool of blood. The SUITOR drops his roses.

CREW MEMBERS rush over.

DIRECTOR
(through megaphone)
Who cleared that rig? Medic! Now!

The SUITOR kneels beside ZHEN TIAN.

SUITOR
(crying out)
Tiantian, don't close your eyes! Tiantian!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

A television news broadcast is playing.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Best Actress Zhen Tian remains critical after on-set accident. Fiancé Yan Chengyi filed emergency partner benefits.

YAN CHENGYI enters holding flowers and a legal folder. Approaches the bed. ZHEN TIAN lies unconscious, oxygen mask on.

YAN CHENGYI takes out a document. Looks at ZHEN TIAN tenderly.

YAN CHENGYI
Tiantian, we signed that co-production deal last week. Made me your heir.

ZHEN TIAN slowly opens her eyes.

ZHEN TIAN
(weakly)
Why... the truck...

YAN CHENGYI holds her hand.

YAN CHENGYI
I heard your agent's calls. You were leaving me.

His expression suddenly turns cold and sinister.

YAN CHENGYI
Fool, why think about the future? You don't have one.

ZHEN TIAN
(confused)
The contract...

YAN CHENGYI
Exactly. If you die before breaking it, I inherit everything. Your estate, your IP, your star power.

YAN CHENGYI stands up and pulls out ZHEN TIAN's oxygen tube.

YAN CHENGYI
(whisper)
Tiantian, rest in peace.

ZHEN TIAN struggles, then stops breathing. YAN CHENGYI watches and breaks into maniacal laughter.

INT. BATHROOM - DAY

A young woman (ZHEN ER) suddenly wakes up in a bathtub, gasping for air and spitting out water.

She struggles to climb out and kneels by the toilet, dry heaving.

A phone rings. The caller ID shows "AGENT." ZHEN ER weakly answers.

ZHEN ER
...hello?

AGENT (V.O.)
Zhen Er, Zhen Tian's funeral. Starts at three. Get there early. Network.

ZHEN ER
(shocked)
Attend my funeral?

AGENT (V.O.)
What do you mean your funeral? You're a nobody with the same surname. Go get seen.

The call ends. ZHEN ER looks up in disbelief at the unfamiliar face in the mirror. Her expression shifts—confusion to horror to something calculating.

ZHEN ER
(whisper)
He thinks I'm dead.

She touches her new face. The ghost of a plan forms.

FADE OUT.

title: Sparks of Fire
description: A young boy witnesses a brutal attack on his family by loan sharks, leading to a tragic fire that changes his life forever.
context:
Title: Sparks of Fire
Description: A young boy witnesses a brutal attack on his family by loan sharks, leading to a tragic fire that changes his life forever.

INT. GU FAMILY COURTYARD - NIGHT

Two MEN shove GU FATHER to the ground. He lands hard on the cobblestones, blood trickling from his lip.

GU FATHER
Please... we just need more time.

Two other men drag GU MOTHER out by her arms, throwing her beside her husband. Her hands tremble as she reaches for him.

GU FATHER
(quiet)
Are you hurt?

GU MOTHER
(shaking her head)
Not yet.

TAI GE steps from the shadows, his leather jacket creaking with each step.

TAI GE
Three months late. My patience has interest too.

A subordinate sets down a metal can and sloshes gasoline over the parents. The sharp chemical stench fills the air.

In a dark corner, GU JINGSHEN watches from inside a bamboo basket, his knuckles white against the woven lid.

TAI GE
(satisfied)
Much better.

GU FATHER, soaked and wheezing, presses his forehead to the ground.

GU FATHER
The bank approved us. Three days—we'll have everything.

TAI GE
(crouching)
Three days is a luxury. My boss didn't authorize that.

TAI GE motions to his subordinate, who splashes gasoline across the threshold.

GU MOTHER
(her voice breaking)
This house is our son's future. Please.

She crawls forward, her fingers brushing Tai Ge's boot.

TAI GE
Your son? He'll thank me for freeing him of this debt.

TAI GE stands and signals to his men.

TAI GE
Let's go.

TAI GE and his crew exit. GU FATHER and GU MOTHER collapse, holding each other as they cry.

GU JINGSHEN shoves the basket aside and runs toward his parents.

GU JINGSHEN
Dad!

GU FATHER
Jingshen!

GU MOTHER
My baby!

The family embraces tightly, surrounded by the smell of gasoline.
continuation:
EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT

QIN MUXUE peeks around the corner, her fish-shaped lantern trembling.

TAI GE and his men barrel past, shoving her against the wall.

TAI GE
Out of the way, kid.

One of the men flicks a lit cigarette behind him without looking. It lands in the gasoline pooled at the Gu family's doorway. Flames erupt instantly.

INT. GU FAMILY COURTYARD - NIGHT

The doorway explodes into flames. GU JINGSHEN stares at the inferno, frozen.

Across the courtyard, AUNT LIU runs through the side gate, a wet cloth over her mouth. She spots QIN MUXUE cowering near the well.

AUNT LIU
Muxue! Get out through the back!

QIN MUXUE
But Jingshen—

AUNT LIU
Now!

QIN MUXUE runs. AUNT LIU spots Jingshen collapsed near the basket, overcome by smoke. She scoops him up as flames engulf the main house.

EXT. WILDERNESS - NIGHT

AUNT LIU, QIN MUXUE, and the unconscious GU JINGSHEN huddle around a small bonfire. Jingshen's breathing is shallow.

QIN MUXUE
(whispering)
Mom... his parents didn't come out.

AUNT LIU
(quiet)
I know.

QIN MUXUE
Will he live with us now?

AUNT LIU
(looking at the boy)
He'll need a name. A new start.

GU JINGSHEN stirs, his fingers finding a charred family photo in his pocket—the edges blackened, but three faces still visible.

GU JINGSHEN bolts upright, gasping.

GU JINGSHEN
Mom! Dad!

FLASHBACK to the fire scene: Shadows of two figures in the flames, barely visible through thick smoke.

GU JINGSHEN
(voice cracking)
They left me.

The charred photo falls from his fingers. The title appears over the image: SPARKS OF FIRE.
full_script:
Title: Sparks of Fire
Description: A young boy witnesses a brutal attack on his family by loan sharks, leading to a tragic fire that changes his life forever.

INT. GU FAMILY COURTYARD - NIGHT

Two MEN shove GU FATHER to the ground. He lands hard on the cobblestones, blood trickling from his lip.

GU FATHER
Please... we just need more time.

Two other men drag GU MOTHER out by her arms, throwing her beside her husband. Her hands tremble as she reaches for him.

GU FATHER
(quiet)
Are you hurt?

GU MOTHER
(shaking her head)
Not yet.

TAI GE steps from the shadows, his leather jacket creaking with each step.

TAI GE
Three months late. My patience has interest too.

A subordinate sets down a metal can and sloshes gasoline over the parents. The sharp chemical stench fills the air.

In a dark corner, GU JINGSHEN watches from inside a bamboo basket, his knuckles white against the woven lid.

TAI GE
(satisfied)
Much better.

GU FATHER, soaked and wheezing, presses his forehead to the ground.

GU FATHER
The bank approved us. Three days—we'll have everything.

TAI GE
(crouching)
Three days is a luxury. My boss didn't authorize that.

TAI GE motions to his subordinate, who splashes gasoline across the threshold.

GU MOTHER
(her voice breaking)
This house is our son's future. Please.

She crawls forward, her fingers brushing Tai Ge's boot.

TAI GE
Your son? He'll thank me for freeing him of this debt.

TAI GE stands and signals to his men.

TAI GE
Let's go.

TAI GE and his crew exit. GU FATHER and GU MOTHER collapse, holding each other as they cry.

GU JINGSHEN shoves the basket aside and runs toward his parents.

GU JINGSHEN
Dad!

GU FATHER
Jingshen!

GU MOTHER
My baby!

The family embraces tightly, surrounded by the smell of gasoline.

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT

QIN MUXUE peeks around the corner, her fish-shaped lantern trembling.

TAI GE and his men barrel past, shoving her against the wall.

TAI GE
Out of the way, kid.

One of the men flicks a lit cigarette behind him without looking. It lands in the gasoline pooled at the Gu family's doorway. Flames erupt instantly.

INT. GU FAMILY COURTYARD - NIGHT

The doorway explodes into flames. GU JINGSHEN stares at the inferno, frozen.

Across the courtyard, AUNT LIU runs through the side gate, a wet cloth over her mouth. She spots QIN MUXUE cowering near the well.

AUNT LIU
Muxue! Get out through the back!

QIN MUXUE
But Jingshen—

AUNT LIU
Now!

QIN MUXUE runs. AUNT LIU spots Jingshen collapsed near the basket, overcome by smoke. She scoops him up as flames engulf the main house.

EXT. WILDERNESS - NIGHT

AUNT LIU, QIN MUXUE, and the unconscious GU JINGSHEN huddle around a small bonfire. Jingshen's breathing is shallow.

QIN MUXUE
(whispering)
Mom... his parents didn't come out.

AUNT LIU
(quiet)
I know.

QIN MUXUE
Will he live with us now?

AUNT LIU
(looking at the boy)
He'll need a name. A new start.

GU JINGSHEN stirs, his fingers finding a charred family photo in his pocket—the edges blackened, but three faces still visible.

GU JINGSHEN bolts upright, gasping.

GU JINGSHEN
Mom! Dad!

FLASHBACK to the fire scene: Shadows of two figures in the flames, barely visible through thick smoke.

GU JINGSHEN
(voice cracking)
They left me.

The charred photo falls from his fingers. The title appears over the image: SPARKS OF FIRE.

title: Stars Guard the Moon
description: After a car accident leaves Mu Jin paralyzed, her best friend Song Yuqing stays by her side, but hidden betrayals lurk beneath the surface of loyalty.
context:
Title: Stars Guard the Moon
Description: After a car accident leaves Mu Jin paralyzed, her best friend Song Yuqing stays by her side, but hidden betrayals lurk beneath the surface of loyalty.

INT. CAR - DAY

Dark clouds gather. Typhoon winds batter the car. MU JIN drives one-handed, phone to her ear.

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
Typhoon Kaigeli intensifies to Signal No. 9...

MU JIN
I'm almost home.

CHEN TIANYOU (V.O.)
(over phone)
Old Bai's barbecue. Mom's craving it.

MU JIN
I already bought some.

CHEN TIANYOU (V.O.)
(over phone, tighter)
She wants the one from Old Bai's. Turn back.

MU JIN
The storm—

CHEN TIANYOU (V.O.)
(over phone)
Two hours, Jin. That's all.

Mu Jin's jaw tightens. She checks the rearview. A red truck barrels forward, horn blaring. She jerks the wheel.

Metal screams. Glass shatters.
continuation:
EXT. ACCIDENT SCENE - DAY

MU JIN's car lies overturned, debris scattered. She lies unconscious beside it, typhoon rain washing over her.

TITLE CARD: THREE MONTHS LATER

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

MU JIN sits in a wheelchair, back to the door, watching the storm outside.

SONG YUQING enters with water. She hesitates.

SONG YUQING
(kneeling, holding Mu Jin's hand)
You should drink.

MU JIN
You're here every day.

SONG YUQING
Where else would I be?

Her phone VIBRATES. She silences it without looking.

MU JIN
I dream about walking.

JIANG MEI (O.S.)
(outside door, sharp)
The settlement will take years! What are we supposed to do—wait while she drains us?

SONG YUQING
(reluctant)
I'll handle it.

SONG YUQING stands and exits.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

JIANG MEI throws her purse on the table. CHEN TIANYOU sits apart, silent. SONG YUQING enters.

JIANG MEI
(to Chen Tianyou)
She can't even give you a child. Now this? Your father built this family—
(to Song Yuqing)
You. Explain to your friend what happens to wives who become furniture.

CHEN TIANYOU
Mom, stop.

JIANG MEI
Fine. I can't look at this anymore. Son?

CHEN TIANYOU stands. He and SONG YUQING exchange a glance—fleeting, weighted.

CHEN TIANYOU
(to Jiang Mei)
I'll walk you down.

JIANG MEI
Don't bother. You're needed here.

She leaves. The door clicks shut. CHEN TIANYOU and SONG YUQING remain still, the silence between them growing dense with complicity.

CHEN TIANYOU turns. SONG YUQING doesn't step back.

FADE OUT.

title: Stars Fall When Hearts Lean
description: A woman returns to avenge her twin sister's death, confronting the family that destroyed her.
context:
Title: Stars Fall When Hearts Lean
Description: A woman returns to avenge her twin sister's death, confronting the family that destroyed her.

INT. HOTEL - NIGHT

SU QINGQING (eldest daughter of the Su family) lies weakly on the bed in a white shirt, disoriented.

SU QINGQING
(weakly)
So thirsty... everything's spinning...

A man, YAN SIMING (adopted son of the Zuo family), suddenly lunges onto the bed and pins down SU QINGQING's hands.

SU QINGQING struggles in terror.

YAN SIMING smirks and takes out his phone to photograph SU QINGQING.

SU XIAOHAN (second daughter of the Su family) stands nearby, recording with her phone, a triumphant smile on her face.

SU XIAOHAN
The world sees perfection. I'll show them truth.

YAN SIMING
(viciously)
Stay still!

SU QINGQING fights back with all her strength, grabbing the bedside lamp and striking YAN SIMING. She breaks free and runs out of the room.

YAN SIMING clutches his head, his expression pained.
continuation:
EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

ZUO QINGCHUAN (heir to the Zuo Corporation) is on the phone, looking anxious.

ZUO QINGCHUAN
(into phone)
The specialist was supposed to be here. Grandfather's condition can't wait.

He suddenly stops in his tracks, seeing SU QINGQING collapsed on the road not far away, blood at the corner of her mouth.

ZUO QINGCHUAN immediately rushes over and crouches down to check on her.

ZUO QINGCHUAN
(softly)
Qingqing? Qingqing...

He reaches to check SU QINGQING'S breathing and discovers she has stopped breathing. His eyes show shock and grief.

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

In the center of the mourning hall sits a portrait of SU QINGQING. SU XIAOHAN leans against YAN SIMING, pretending to cry.

SU XIAOHAN
(sobbing)
She was always so... fragile.

SUN YAN (matriarch of the Su family / SU XINGCHEN's stepmother) stands to the side, expressionless.

SUN YAN
Some girls simply can't handle pressure.

YAN SIMING leans down to whisper in SU XIAOHAN'S ear.

YAN SIMING
Our arrangement is complete.

The mourning hall doors are suddenly pushed open. A woman in a black suit and sunglasses, SU XINGCHEN (SU QINGQING's twin sister), walks in holding a black umbrella. Her appearance is identical to SU QINGQING.

Everyone present is stunned.

SU XINGCHEN walks forward slowly, removes her sunglasses, her eyes cold.

SU XIAOHAN falls backwards onto the ground in fright.

SU XIAOHAN
(terrified)
A ghost!

SUN YAN is shocked at first, then puts on a false smile and approaches.

SUN YAN
Xingchen, you've finally come home.

SU XINGCHEN ignores her and walks straight to her sister's portrait, then turns to face everyone.

SU XINGCHEN
(coldly)
Let's finish what she started.

title: Stars Fall Into Your Eyes
description: A man discovers his wife has been manipulated against him after her parents' fatal car accident, leading to a devastating betrayal orchestrated by a rival.
context:
Title: Stars Fall Into Your Eyes
Description: A man discovers his wife has been manipulated against him after her parents' fatal car accident, leading to a devastating betrayal orchestrated by a rival.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The hospital corridor is chaotic. Medical staff rush by pushing a gurney. LU CHENZHOU runs in, his face pale, scanning the corridor frantically.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Breaking news: Shen Group President Shen Deming and his wife Liu Xinlan have been airlifted to the hospital after a fatal car accident. Their daughter Shen Qingwan was also in the vehicle.

LU CHENZHOU spots a gurney covered with a white sheet being wheeled into emergency surgery. He sprints toward it.

LU CHENZHOU
Wanwan!

A NURSE bursts from a side room, chart in hand, intercepting him.

NURSE
Mr. Lu! The blood bank is critically low on her rare type.

LU CHENZHOU
Take mine. I'm O-negative.

The Nurse hesitates, then another medical professional in scrubs rushes past.

DOCTOR
Her optic nerve trauma is severe. We may not be able to save her vision.

LU CHENZHOU stops in shock, his face crumpling with despair.

LU CHENZHOU
(murmuring)
Wanwan... no...

LU CHENZHOU grabs the Doctor's arm with trembling hands.

LU CHENZHOU
(grabbing the doctor's arm)
Anything. Please. Test me for compatibility—

A second NURSE walks over, double-checking a tablet.

NURSE
Are you Shen Qingwan's emergency contact?

LU CHENZHOU freezes and slowly turns his head.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LU CHENZHOU pushes open the door. SHEN QINGWAN stands by the window in a hospital gown, turning a blood-stained envelope in her hands. Her eyes are clear but empty.

LU CHENZHOU exhales sharply, relief flooding his face.

LU CHENZHOU
Wanwan. Thank God you're okay. I thought—

He takes a step forward, arms opening. SHEN QINGWAN's hand trembles inside the envelope.

SHEN QINGWAN
(quietly)
Did you think I wouldn't find out?

She pulls a scalpel from the envelope. In one fluid motion, she drives it into LU CHENZHOU's abdomen. Not deep—but enough.

LU CHENZHOU clutches the wound, blood seeping between his fingers. Disbelief wars with agony.

LU CHENZHOU
(in pain)
Wanwan... why?

FLASHBACK - INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

Three hours earlier. HUI YUNZE stands beside SHEN QINGWAN's bed, his tablet casting a cold glow on her tear-stained face. He scrolls through financial transfers, timestamped emails, a blurred photo of a cut brake line.

HUI YUNZE
(softly)
Your father discovered the embezzlement the day before the accident. Chenzhou had access to the car. Connect the dots, Qingwan.

SHEN QINGWAN stares at the screen, her breathing shallow. Her fingers trace the brake line photo.

END FLASHBACK - INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

HUI YUNZE enters with a BODYGUARD, his footsteps deliberate.

HUI YUNZE
Qingwan—

He moves between them, shielding her with his body, studying Lu Chenzhou's wound.

HUI YUNZE
(to the bodyguard)
Miss Shen needs her medication. Now.

The BODYGUARD gently takes SHEN QINGWAN's elbow. She doesn't resist.

LU CHENZHOU
Wanwan!

He reaches for her, staining the floor with drops of blood.

LU CHENZHOU
(in pain)
It wasn't me. I'd never—

SHEN QINGWAN
(coldly, not turning)
I saw the accounts. I saw the report. For the rest of my life, Lu Chenzhou... I want to unsee you.

She lets the bodyguard lead her out.

LU CHENZHOU
(desperately)
Wanwan!

HUI YUNZE kneels beside him, his voice low and venomous.

HUI YUNZE
She chose you once. Against everything. Starting now, she chooses herself.

He shoves LU CHENZHOU back. From his pocket, he produces a phone. The screen shows a video: HUI YUNZE, hours ago, caressing Shen Qingwan's unconscious face in this very room, whispering in her ear.

HUI YUNZE
She'll never believe a word you say. I made sure of it.

LU CHENZHOU sees the timestamp on the video—the moment she woke up. Realization dawns. He lunges, but the pain blinds him. Blood fills his mouth. He collapses, one hand still reaching toward the empty doorway.

title: Spring Romance
description: A woman chooses a mysterious man for a one-night stand, only to discover he is her fiancé's uncle who has just returned home.
context:
Title: Spring Romance
Description: A woman chooses a mysterious man for a one-night stand, only to discover he is her fiancé's uncle who has just returned home.

INT. KTV - NIGHT

Neon lights fragment across black marble floors. Bass throbs through the walls.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
Tonight, I'm not the fiancée who smiles at the right moments. Tonight, I'm just... me.

JIANG FU, in a champagne slip dress, moves through the private room like a knife through smoke. Her eyes find CHENG JIALUO alone in a velvet booth, rolling a tumbler of whiskey.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
There. The one who doesn't belong.

She slides into the booth, leaving precise distance between them.

JIANG FU
Your solitude looks expensive. Mind if I try it?

CHENG JIALUO
I'm waiting for someone.

JIANG FU's laugh is soft, barely audible over the music.

JIANG FU
Aren't we all.

She starts to rise. His hand shoots out, circling her wrist—not rough, but unbreakable.

JIANG FU
Sir?

CHENG JIALUO
What if they're not coming?

JIANG FU
Then I'd hate to waste a good dress.

He studies her face for a beat that stretches. Then releases her wrist, but his eyes hold her still.

CHENG JIALUO
Neither would I.

He stands, offering his arm. She takes it.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Moonlight cuts across tangled sheets. JIANG FU's back arches, her fingers twisting in CHENG JIALUO's hair. A crystal tumbler lies shattered on the floor, forgotten.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - MORNING

Sunlight pools on the carpet. They lie side by side in white robes, not touching.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
This was supposed to be simple. A transaction. So why does my chest feel like a locked room?

CHENG JIALUO
Running already?

JIANG FU
I don't do breakfast.

CHENG JIALUO
Who said anything about food?

He leans in. She doesn't pull away. His lips brush her forehead, her nose—each touch a question.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - LATER

JIANG FU wakes alone. Shower steam curls under the bathroom door. Her phone buzzes on the nightstand: "Aunt Qiu."

JIANG FU
Hello, Aunt Qiu.

AUNT QIU (V.O.)
Xiaofu! Jiamu's uncle returns tonight. The family dinner's at seven—don't be late. He's very... particular.

JIANG FU
Particular?

AUNT QIU (V.O.)
Just be your charming self. And wear the pearls Jiamu gave you.

The call ends. JIANG FU sits up slowly, ice forming in her veins.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
Cheng Jialuo. The monk in Gucci. Back from his temple in Kyoto.

She spots her dress pooled on the floor—beside a man's leather wallet. She opens it. A driver's license: CHENG JIALUO. Date of birth makes him older than she thought. Much older.

Her fingers tremble as she dresses. On the pillow beside hers: a single prayer bead, sandalwood. She leaves it there.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
One night. No names. No consequences.

She slips out. The door clicks shut.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

CHENG JIALUO emerges, towel around his waist. He touches the abandoned prayer bead. Picks up his wallet—sees it slightly askew. A knowing smile plays on his lips.

He pulls out his phone, scrolls to a photo: JIANG FU and JIAMU at their engagement party. He sets it down, then notices her pearl necklace on the nightstand.

CHENG JIALUO
Game's just starting, little fiancée.

He pockets the pearls.
