JIANG FU (V.O.)
Tonight, I'm not the fiancée who smiles at the right moments. Tonight, I'm just... me.

JIANG FU, in a champagne slip dress, moves through the private room like a knife through smoke. Her eyes find CHENG JIALUO alone in a velvet booth, rolling a tumbler of whiskey.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
There. The one who doesn't belong.

She slides into the booth, leaving precise distance between them.

JIANG FU
Your solitude looks expensive. Mind if I try it?

CHENG JIALUO
I'm waiting for someone.

JIANG FU's laugh is soft, barely audible over the music.

JIANG FU
Aren't we all.

She starts to rise. His hand shoots out, circling her wrist—not rough, but unbreakable.

JIANG FU
Sir?

CHENG JIALUO
What if they're not coming?

JIANG FU
Then I'd hate to waste a good dress.

He studies her face for a beat that stretches. Then releases her wrist, but his eyes hold her still.

CHENG JIALUO
Neither would I.

He stands, offering his arm. She takes it.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Moonlight cuts across tangled sheets. JIANG FU's back arches, her fingers twisting in CHENG JIALUO's hair. A crystal tumbler lies shattered on the floor, forgotten.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - MORNING

Sunlight pools on the carpet. They lie side by side in white robes, not touching.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
This was supposed to be simple. A transaction. So why does my chest feel like a locked room?

CHENG JIALUO
Running already?

JIANG FU
I don't do breakfast.

CHENG JIALUO
Who said anything about food?

He leans in. She doesn't pull away. His lips brush her forehead, her nose—each touch a question.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - LATER

JIANG FU wakes alone. Shower steam curls under the bathroom door. Her phone buzzes on the nightstand: "Aunt Qiu."

JIANG FU
Hello, Aunt Qiu.

AUNT QIU (V.O.)
Xiaofu! Jiamu's uncle returns tonight. The family dinner's at seven—don't be late. He's very... particular.

JIANG FU
Particular?

AUNT QIU (V.O.)
Just be your charming self. And wear the pearls Jiamu gave you.

The call ends. JIANG FU sits up slowly, ice forming in her veins.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
Cheng Jialuo. The monk in Gucci. Back from his temple in Kyoto.

She spots her dress pooled on the floor—beside a man's leather wallet. She opens it. A driver's license: CHENG JIALUO. Date of birth makes him older than she thought. Much older.

Her fingers tremble as she dresses. On the pillow beside hers: a single prayer bead, sandalwood. She leaves it there.

JIANG FU (V.O.)
One night. No names. No consequences.

She slips out. The door clicks shut.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

CHENG JIALUO emerges, towel around his waist. He touches the abandoned prayer bead. Picks up his wallet—sees it slightly askew. A knowing smile plays on his lips.

He pulls out his phone, scrolls to a photo: JIANG FU and JIAMU at their engagement party. He sets it down, then notices her pearl necklace on the nightstand.

CHENG JIALUO
Game's just starting, little fiancée.

He pockets the pearls.

title: Unrepayable Kindness
description: A foster son's gambling debts drive him to violence against his foster mother who won the lottery, leading to a tragic confrontation that reveals the true cost of their fractured bond.
context:
Title: Unrepayable Kindness
Description: A foster son's gambling debts drive him to violence against his foster mother who won the lottery, leading to a tragic confrontation that reveals the true cost of their fractured bond.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

A dark hospital room. Rain streaks the windows, monitors beeping softly.

ON SCREEN: COMA WARD - DAY 3

LI XIUZHEN lies unconscious in a hospital gown, surgical staples along her scalp, brow furrowed in a nightmare.

LI CHENGMIN (V.O.)
You never trusted me! Not once in twenty years!

Nightmare flashback: LI CHENGMIN with a vicious expression, wooden stool raised high.

LI XIUZHEN (V.O.)
(muffled)
Chengmin, no—

LI XIUZHEN wakes with a gasp, eyes wide with terror. She touches her bandaged head, breathing hard.

LI XIUZHEN
(whispered)
Still here.

NURSE (O.S.)
Your son is still in the waiting room, Mrs. Li. Won't leave.

LI XIUZHEN's eyes fill with fear. And something else. Recognition.
continuation:
INT. LI XIUZHEN'S HOUSE - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: THREE DAYS AGO

LI CHENGMIN (28), disheveled and frantic, rifles through a cabinet. Finds a red bankbook hidden behind old photo albums.

He opens it: "BALANCE: ¥3,150,000.00 (POST-TAX)."

LI CHENGMIN
(voice shaking)
Three million... enough to bury this.

LI XIUZHEN (65) appears in the doorway, holding medication.

LI XIUZHEN
That's not for running. It's for staying.

LI CHENGMIN
(stammering)
Foster Mom. I thought you were asleep—

LI XIUZHEN
I haven't slept through the night since you moved back. The debt collectors called. Five hundred thousand. Day three.

LI CHENGMIN
(defensive)
I can fix this. I promise.

LI XIUZHEN
(voice hard)
By stealing? Again?

LI XIUZHEN reaches for the bankbook. LI CHENGMIN pulls back.

LI CHENGMIN
They'll take the house. Everything.

LI XIUZHEN
Let them. I'd rather be homeless than watch you gamble yourself dead.

She turns toward her bedroom.

LI XIUZHEN
Getting the withdrawal slip. And the police scanner. You have five minutes.

LI CHENGMIN
(panicking)
Foster Mom, no— wait—

He grabs her arm. She shakes him off.

LI XIUZHEN
Be better than this, Chengmin.

LI CHENGMIN lunges past her, knocks a wooden stool. It catches her ankle.

She falls. Her head cracks against the cabinet corner.

She drops. Silent. Blood pools beneath her gray hair.

LI CHENGMIN stares at the stool in his hands. The bankbook lies between them.

He drops the stool. Doesn't take the money.

NEIGHBOR (O.S.)
Li? Everything okay in there?

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Spring Swallow Never Returns & Return to the 80s as the Family Treasure
description: A woman poisoned by her husband and his mistress is reborn to the day before her death, determined to reclaim what was stolen from her.
context:
Title: Spring Swallow Never Returns & Return to the 80s as the Family Treasure
Description: A woman poisoned by her husband and his mistress is reborn to the day before her death, determined to reclaim what was stolen from her.

INT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

CHUN YAN convulses on the damp concrete, bitter almond taste filling her mouth. White foam mixed with blood trickles from her lips. A cracked bottle of rat poison rolls beside her frozen fingers.

Through a splintered crack in the warped door, she glimpses the celebration.

EXT. VILLAGE COMMITTEE ENTRANCE - DAY

The village square erupts with firecrackers and gongs. A red banner flutters: "Welcome Chief Lu to Fangjia Village."

LU XIAO, distinguished in his military greatcoat, raises his hands for silence.

LU XIAO
Fellow villagers, please. After ten years of searching, I've found the girl who saved my life. Bai Zhi—come forward.

BAI ZHI, demure in a patched cotton coat, steps up. The crowd roars approval.

BAI ZHI (V.O.)
All this was meant to be yours, Chun Yan. But your son will call me mother, and your medal will hang around my neck. Sleep well.

BAI ZHI
(to LU XIAO, voice trembling)
Chief Lu...

LU XIAO
You pulled me from the river ice. I've never forgotten.

BAI ZHI
Fate is merciful. We're finally reunited.

INT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

CHUN YAN's vision blurs. Her hand claws toward the door, fingers trembling. She hears the cheers as her life leaks away.
continuation:
EXT. VILLAGE COMMITTEE ENTRANCE - DAY

BAI ZHI produces a worn military medal, places it in LU XIAO's palm.

LU XIAO
(holding it high)
This medal—proof of Bai Zhi's courage. Those who sheltered her shelter me. Your kindness will be repaid!

BAI ZHI covers her face, then kneels in the dirt.

BAI ZHI
I ate from a hundred bowls, wore a hundred hand-me-downs. Without you, I'd be bones in the mountain. I swear—I will never forget.

The villagers murmur praise.

VILLAGERS
True gratitude! What a heart!

INT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

CHUN YAN's hand falls. Her final breath whispers out.

CHUN YAN
(whisper)
Mine... everything... was mine...

Her eyes fix on the medal glinting through the crack.

INT. CHUN YAN'S HOUSE - DAY

ONE DAY EARLIER

The cramped main room. CHUN YAN clutches three-year-old XIAO TIAN. QIN YI stands with BAI ZHI, whose sleeve hides bandaged wrists.

QIN YI
Chun Yan, be reasonable. Bai Zhi can't have children after the miscarriage. Let her adopt Xiao Tian. You'll have another.

CHUN YAN
(furious)
The child I nearly died for? The miscarriage you gave her while I was carrying your son?

QIN YI
Lower your voice!

CHUN YAN
Never. I'll die first.

BAI ZHI
(tearfully)
Sister Chun Yan, I just want to be part of this family...

CHUN YAN
Don't "sister" me, you—

QIN YI lunges for the boy. CHUN YAN twists away. BAI ZHI grabs her arm. CHUN YAN bites down, hard. BAI ZHI shrieks. QIN YI shoves CHUN YAN. She cracks her head against the stove.

QIN YI
(panicked)
Get up... get up!

She doesn't move.

INT. CHUN YAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

CHUN YAN gasps awake, hand flying to her temple—no wound. She sits up in her wedding bed. A 1980 calendar shows the same date: October 14.

CHUN YAN
(barely audible)
Dead... I was dead...

She touches her throat, her stomach—whole. Her eyes fall on the medal box, empty on the dresser.

CHUN YAN
(whisper)
Lu Xiao arrives tomorrow. They poison me at dusk. The medal... Xiao Tian...

She looks at her sleeping son in the corner crib. Her expression hardens from terror to something colder. More certain.

CHUN YAN
(quietly)
This time, I take what's mine before they can.

She rises, smoothing the covers with deliberate hands.

title: Radiant Youth
description: A young woman betrayed by her sister, who stole her face and future as empress, is given a chance at revenge by a mysterious figure.
context:
Title: Radiant Youth
Description: A young woman betrayed by her sister, who stole her face and future as empress, is given a chance at revenge by a mysterious figure.

EXT. PRIME MINISTER'S MANOR BACKYARD - NIGHT

Several corpses lie scattered on the ground. A man is thrown violently through a circular doorway, an arrow lodged in his forehead. He dies instantly.

XIE YUNING (dressed in white) staggers into the courtyard. She sees the carnage before her, terror-stricken.

XIE YUNING (V.O.)
I, Xie Yuning, was once the eldest daughter of the Prime Minister's manor. To heal my sister Xie Yuzhi's scarred face, I surrendered my place as future Empress, kissing the earth every three steps for ten miles.

XIE YUNING sees her parents lying on the ground. She collapses, running to them and falling to her knees.

XIE YUNING (V.O.)
I believed scars ran only skin-deep.

XIE YUNING
(crying out)
Mother... Father...

XIE YUZHI (scars on her face) emerges from the shadows, touching her own cheek with trembling fingers.

XIE YUNING
(looking up, disbelieving)
Yuzhi... the medicine—

XIE YUZHI
(quietly)
The medicine worked. Thanks to you.

XIE YUZHI crouches before XIE YUNING, gripping her jaw.

XIE YUZHI
Father raised your commoner parents to ensure your compliance. He never imagined you'd outshine me. But now...

She touches her own face, which begins to smooth and transform.

XIE YUZHI
Now I wear what was never yours to keep.

XIE YUZHI releases her, standing.

XIE YUZHI
Tomorrow, I ascend as Empress. You die nameless.
continuation:
EXT. MASS GRAVE - NIGHT

Thunder and rain. XIE YUNING's body is thrown onto a mass grave littered with bones.

A MYSTERIOUS FIGURE wearing a conical hat appears beside her. Rain cascades off the hat's rim.

MYSTERIOUS FIGURE
The dead have no use for vengeance. But you're not dead yet.

The MYSTERIOUS FIGURE extends a hand. XIE YUNING's fingers twitch, then grasp his.

MYSTERIOUS FIGURE
Some debts can only be paid in flesh and memory. Are you certain?

XIE YUNING
(weakly)
Yes.

INT. THATCHED HUT - NIGHT

XIE YUNING lies on a bed, her face bloody and raw. The MYSTERIOUS FIGURE (now wearing white robes and a half-mask) prepares tools for the face transplant.

MYSTERIOUS FIGURE (V.O.)
The legitimate daughter, the future Empress—stripped of face and destiny. But what is a face? A mask the world sees. A mask you choose to wear.

XIE YUNING
(whispered)
I want to be the nightmare they don't see coming.

MYSTERIOUS FIGURE
You will obey. You will forget who you were. And when you stand before them, even you won't recognize yourself.

The MYSTERIOUS FIGURE begins the procedure. XIE YUNING screams silently, her body arching.

MYSTERIOUS FIGURE
Remember this pain. It's the last honest thing you'll feel.

INT. THATCHED HUT - DAY

Sunlight streams through the window. XIE YUNING lies on the bed, white gauze covering her eyes.

She sits up, raises her hand, removes the gauze from her face.

The gauze falls away, revealing a face of perfect, breathtaking beauty—stranger than memory, colder than vengeance.

title: Late Summer Ripples
description: A woman discovers her fiancé is abandoning her to marry her stepsister for family inheritance, shattering their three-year relationship on what should have been their wedding day.
context:
Title: Late Summer Ripples
Description: A woman discovers her fiancé is abandoning her to marry her stepsister for family inheritance, shattering their three-year relationship on what should have been their wedding day.

INT. BRIDAL SHOP - DAY

Black curtains pull back, revealing LIN XIXIA in a gorgeous wedding dress, admiring herself in a three-way mirror. The train is enormous, covering the entire floor.

A SHOP ASSISTANT is arranging LIN XIXIA's veil.

SHOP ASSISTANT
Miss Lin, Mr. Fu treats you so well. This wedding dress is Vera Wang's latest design. Many brides in Haicheng fought to buy it but couldn't. Yet he reserved it for you a month ago.

LIN XIXIA
(smiling, fingers finding a cello charm hidden in the lining)
Yes... he remembers what I like.

FLASHBACK: Fu Zhun at her recital, his face uncomplicated and proud.

LIN XIXIA
(continuing, barely audible)
He used to listen.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

FU ZHUN, wearing a suit, paces by a window on his phone, voice low and urgent.

FU ZHUN
(into phone)
Mom, I've exhausted every option. The board won't recognize a stepdaughter as a legitimate alliance. The bylaws are explicit.

LIN XIXIA appears at the far end of the hallway, holding two coffee cups. She slows, hearing his voice.

FU ZHUN
(continuing, voice cracking)
I know what Xixia sacrificed. But if I don't marry Lin Qiao, I lose the voting shares. I become nobody.

He turns, still unaware of her, studying his reflection.

FU ZHUN
(softly, to himself)
I can't become him. I can't be the man who gave up his birthright and regretted it.

One cup slips from LIN XIXIA's grip, SHATTERING on the marble floor.

FU ZHUN whirls around. Their eyes lock.

LIN XIXIA
(voice trembling)
The board... your inheritance. That's what this is about?

FU ZHUN
(steps forward, hands raised)
Xixia, let me explain -

LIN XIXIA
(cutting him off, tone hollow)
The canceled dinners. The late nights. You weren't working, were you?
continuation:
She sets the remaining cup down deliberately.

FU ZHUN
(struggling)
The Lin family will only vote with us if I marry into the bloodline. Qiaoqiao's talent, her connections - it's survival. Not personal.

LIN XIXIA
(tears falling but voice steady)
My audition for Berlin. The one I gave up for your company's crisis. Was that survival too?

FU ZHUN
(visibly shaken)
You made that choice. I never asked -

LIN XIXIA
(laughs, bitter)
Because you begged me to stay. And I believed we were a team.

She steps out of the wedding shoes, revealing bandaged heels.

LIN XIXIA
These shoes were never my size. None of this was.

She begins pulling off the veil with trembling hands.

FU ZHUN
(softening)
Xixia, I can fix this. A foundation, a house - don't destroy yourself.

LIN XIXIA
(rips the veil cleanly)
I'm not destroying myself. I'm shedding what was never mine.

She removes the diamond ring, holds it to the light.

LIN XIXIA
Your mother gave me this with a warning. "Remember your place." I thought she meant as your wife.

She places the ring on the windowsill.

LIN XIXIA
Thank you for finally being honest.

She walks toward the stairwell, barefoot.

FU ZHUN
(calls after her, voice breaking)
Xixia, please. If you walk away now, the families -

LIN XIXIA
(stops at the stairs, doesn't turn)
The household registration book. I'll send someone for it tomorrow.

She ascends the stairs, her silhouette small against the grand architecture.

FU ZHUN stands frozen, the ring gleaming on the windowsill, his face a mask of grief and relief.

LIN XIXIA
(smiling, fingers finding a cello charm hidden in the lining)
Yes... he remembers what I like.

FLASHBACK: Fu Zhun at her recital, his face uncomplicated and proud.

LIN XIXIA
(continuing, barely audible)
He used to listen.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

FU ZHUN, wearing a suit, paces by a window on his phone, voice low and urgent.

FU ZHUN
(into phone)
Mom, I've exhausted every option. The board won't recognize a stepdaughter as a legitimate alliance. The bylaws are explicit.

LIN XIXIA appears at the far end of the hallway, holding two coffee cups. She slows, hearing his voice.

FU ZHUN
(continuing, voice cracking)
I know what Xixia sacrificed. But if I don't marry Lin Qiao, I lose the voting shares. I become nobody.

He turns, still unaware of her, studying his reflection.

FU ZHUN
(softly, to himself)
I can't become him. I can't be the man who gave up his birthright and regretted it.

One cup slips from LIN XIXIA's grip, SHATTERING on the marble floor.

FU ZHUN whirls around. Their eyes lock.

LIN XIXIA
(voice trembling)
The board... your inheritance. That's what this is about?

FU ZHUN
(steps forward, hands raised)
Xixia, let me explain -

LIN XIXIA
(cutting him off, tone hollow)
The canceled dinners. The late nights. You weren't working, were you?

She sets the remaining cup down deliberately.

FU ZHUN
(struggling)
The Lin family will only vote with us if I marry into the bloodline. Qiaoqiao's talent, her connections - it's survival. Not personal.

LIN XIXIA
(tears falling but voice steady)
My audition for Berlin. The one I gave up for your company's crisis. Was that survival too?

FU ZHUN
(visibly shaken)
You made that choice. I never asked -

LIN XIXIA
(laughs, bitter)
Because you begged me to stay. And I believed we were a team.

She steps out of the wedding shoes, revealing bandaged heels.

LIN XIXIA
These shoes were never my size. None of this was.

She begins pulling off the veil with trembling hands.

FU ZHUN
(softening)
Xixia, I can fix this. A foundation, a house - don't destroy yourself.

LIN XIXIA
(rips the veil cleanly)
I'm not destroying myself. I'm shedding what was never mine.

She removes the diamond ring, holds it to the light.

LIN XIXIA
Your mother gave me this with a warning. "Remember your place." I thought she meant as your wife.

She places the ring on the windowsill.

LIN XIXIA
Thank you for finally being honest.

She walks toward the stairwell, barefoot.

FU ZHUN
(calls after her, voice breaking)
Xixia, please. If you walk away now, the families -

LIN XIXIA
(stops at the stairs, doesn't turn)
The household registration book. I'll send someone for it tomorrow.

She ascends the stairs, her silhouette small against the grand architecture.

FU ZHUN stands frozen, the ring gleaming on the windowsill, his face a mask of grief and relief.

title: Dawn in the Dark Night
description: A young girl witnesses her father's death in a hit-and-run and her mother's murder by a powerful family. Fifteen years later, she returns for revenge.
context:
Title: Dawn in the Dark Night
Description: A young girl witnesses her father's death in a hit-and-run and her mother's murder by a powerful family. Fifteen years later, she returns for revenge.

EXT. ROAD - NIGHT

A small ball rolls across wet asphalt through a streetlight's glow.

SHU YU'S FATHER chases after it.

A little girl in a red dress, SHU YU (7), holds a photo frame, standing by the roadside.

SHU YU'S FATHER picks up the ball. A car speeds toward him, blinding headlights blazing.

SOUND: Sharp braking and collision.

The photo frame falls to the ground, glass shattering. The photo shows a family of three.

SOUND: Thunder.

SHU YU
(terrified)
Daddy!

SHU YU runs to her father lying in a pool of blood and holds him, crying.

SHU YU
Daddy!

SHU YU'S FATHER
(weakly)
Go... find your mother. At the big house.

SHU YU
(crying)
No, Daddy!

SHU YU'S FATHER
(weakly)
Go... go!

INT. FU RESIDENCE - NIGHT

SHU YU'S MOTHER kneels on the ground, clutching LIN PEIRONG'S hand, begging desperately. FU ZHENGXIN stands nearby, expressionless.

SHU YU'S MOTHER
Madam, I beg you, please spare me, spare our family, Madam!

BUTLER LIU walks to FU ZHENGXIN'S side.

BUTLER LIU
Young Master, we've confirmed it. She is indeed RH negative blood type. Young Miss Fu's surgery is at dawn. We can operate now.

FU ZHENGXIN
Do it.

Two men in black step forward and grab SHU YU'S MOTHER.

SHU YU'S MOTHER
(struggling)
Let me go! What are you doing! Let go!
continuation:
INT. MAKESHIFT OPERATING ROOM - NIGHT

SHU YU'S MOTHER is pressed onto the operating table. A masked person approaches with a syringe.

SHU YU'S MOTHER struggles violently but is eventually injected with the drug. A tear rolls down her cheek as she loses consciousness.

SHU YU'S MOTHER
(barely audible)
Shu Yu...

EXT. ROAD - NIGHT

SHU YU runs through the rain and falls on the grass.

SHU YU
(crying out)
Mommy!

INT. FU RESIDENCE - NIGHT

SHU YU runs down the stairs and sees two men carrying her mother out, covered with a white cloth.

SHU YU
(crying out)
Mommy! Mommy! Mommy! Look at me, wake up, Mommy!

SHU YU throws herself on her mother, crying.

FU ZHENGXIN and LIN PEIRONG walk out of the room.

SHU YU
(crying out)
Mommy, wake up!

LIN PEIRONG
What's all this noise? You little bastard! Grab her!

BUTLER LIU steps forward and grabs SHU YU.

SHU YU
(struggling, crying out)
You killed Daddy in the accident and hurt Mommy! You're bad people! Bad people!

SHU YU breaks free and bites BUTLER LIU'S hand.

LIN PEIRONG steps forward and slaps SHU YU hard, knocking her to the ground.

LIN PEIRONG
You dare bite me? You little brat! Filthy thing!

FU ZHENGXIN
Uncle Liu, clean this up together. Make it clean.

BUTLER LIU picks up the unconscious SHU YU. SHU YU lies on the ground, weakly reaching out her hand, watching her mother being carried away. A small birthmark shows on her wrist.

SHU YU
(weakly)
Mommy... Mommy...

INT. CAR - NIGHT

DRIVER
Butler Liu, what should we do with this little girl?

BUTLER LIU holds the unconscious SHU YU in the back seat.

BUTLER LIU
Send her abroad. I hope she never comes back... and forgets what she saw.

EXT. CITYSCAPE - SUNSET

ON SCREEN: Fifteen years later

INT. GRAND HALL - NIGHT

The adult SHU YU, wearing a red sequined gown, walks into a magnificent hall with a powerful presence. A jade bracelet circles her wrist. Her figure alternates with images of her childhood self.

SHU YU (V.O.)
Lin Peirong, Fu Zhengxin. It's been fifteen years. We meet again.

FU ZHENGXIN and LIN PEIRONG stand together, watching SHU YU approach.

SHU YU walks toward them with determined eyes, step by step. In her clutch: the preserved, torn photograph.

title: Late-Life Flash Marriage is True Love (Episode 1 of 36)
description: A wealthy CEO disguised as a janitor seeks true love through blind dates, while rescuing a kind woman from an abusive suitor.
context:
Title: Late-Life Flash Marriage is True Love (Episode 1 of 36)
Description: A wealthy CEO disguised as a janitor seeks true love through blind dates, while rescuing a kind woman from an abusive suitor.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

CHEN PING, JIANG CHENG's blind date, wearing a luxurious qipao, slams a glass of water heavily on the table. Water splashes onto JIANG CHENG's work uniform.

CHEN PING
A stinking janitor dares to think of marrying me? Why don't you take a piss and look at yourself to see if you're worthy!

CHEN PING removes the ring from her hand and throws it on the table, then turns and leaves arrogantly. JIANG CHENG watches her calmly.

XIAO ZHANG, JIANG CHENG's assistant, wearing a suit, rushes over.

XIAO ZHANG
Chairman, are you alright?

XIAO ZHANG uses a handkerchief to wipe JIANG CHENG's wet clothes.

XIAO ZHANG
Third one this month.

JIANG CHENG
(calmly)
Weiwei means well.

XIAO ZHANG
(anxiously)
The board is asking questions. One word about who you really are, and—

JIANG CHENG
Then I'd never know who's sincere. My daughter deserves a real mother, not another gold-digger.

The camera cuts to another side of the coffee shop.

ZHANG HU, a crude man wearing a red suit, towers over BAI JIE.

ZHANG HU
Don't be ungrateful! A woman your age should be grateful any man still wants you. You dare to question me?

ZHANG HU throws the menu on the table. BAI JIE flinches.

BAI JIE
(timid but firm)
I just want a peaceful life. We're not suitable.

ZHANG HU suddenly grabs BAI JIE's wrist, wrenching her forward.

ZHANG HU
Two thousand a month, and you complain about my other women? You're marrying me today!

BAI JIE
(struggling)
Let go! I won't—

JIANG CHENG
(standing up, voice cutting through)
continuation:
Let her go.

ZHANG HU pushes BAI JIE back and whirls on JIANG CHENG.

ZHANG HU
(pointing at JIANG CHENG)
This doesn't concern you, old man!

JIANG CHENG grabs ZHANG HU's finger, bending it back. ZHANG HU cries out.

XIAO ZHANG
(stepping forward)
Leave. Now.

ZHANG HU is frightened. He grabs the documents from the table and points at them.

ZHANG HU
You'll regret this!

ZHANG HU runs out of the coffee shop in embarrassment.

JIANG CHENG squats down and helps BAI JIE up from the floor.

JIANG CHENG
Did he hurt you?

BAI JIE
(rubbing her wrist)
I'm okay. Thank you.

JIANG CHENG
Come on, get up, get up.

JIANG CHENG helps BAI JIE stand up.

JIANG CHENG
Another blind date?

BAI JIE nods, managing a weak smile.

JIANG CHENG
(sincerely)
Then... what do you think of someone who only has his honesty to offer?

BAI JIE looks at him, really looks at him. Her expression softens.

BAI JIE
You have kind eyes. And steady hands.

JIANG CHENG
If you can accept a janitor's life, perhaps we could start with lunch?

BAI JIE
(studying him)
Or... we could skip the pretense. My whole life has been pretense. If you're serious about building something real—let's get the certificate today.

A bright, brave smile appears on BAI JIE's face.

title: Dawn Light Enters Dreams and Shakes Mountains and Rivers
description: During a sacrificial ceremony to pray for rain, a consort desperately tries to save her newborn daughter from being sacrificed, but divine intervention strikes at the crucial moment.
context:
Title: Dawn Light Enters Dreams and Shakes Mountains and Rivers
Description: During a sacrificial ceremony to pray for rain, a consort desperately tries to save her newborn daughter from being sacrificed, but divine intervention strikes at the crucial moment.

INT. SACRIFICIAL ALTAR - DAY

A cavernous temple hall, heavy with incense and dread. DEMON-MASKED DANCERS move in hypnotic patterns across the taiji symbol carved into the stone floor. The EMPEROR sits rigid on the gilded throne, his knuckles white on the armrests. CONSORT SHEN stands beside him, her serene expression masking a watchful intensity. Below, CONSORT XIAN clutches her wrapped infant, her court robes stained with tears.

CONSORT XIAN
(quietly, to her child)
Stay quiet, little one. Stay quiet.

The High Priest's staff strikes the ground with three resonant thuds. Guards advance toward Consort Xian.

CONSORT XIAN
(sharply)
She is imperial blood! The ninth pearl of the Dragon's line!

CONSORT SHEN
(to Emperor, measured)
Your Majesty, the drought extends to nine provinces. The Oracle pronounced a royal sacrifice. We cannot show hesitation.

CONSORT XIAN
(turning on her)
You speak of hesitation? My daughter is forty days old.

CONSORT SHEN
My own son is six years, and would go if the divination had chosen him. This is the price of sovereignty.

CONSORT XIAN
The price is always paid by others.

EMPEROR
(quietly, to Consort Shen)
Is this truly the only path?

HIGH PRIEST
The heavens demand purity of conviction! Vacillation brings not rain, but thunder!

He gestures. The guards close in. Consort Xian backs toward the altar.

CONSORT XIAN
(to the court)
Will none of you speak? Will you let ash become of flesh?

The EMPEROR's face hardens, but he does not look away.
continuation:
EMPEROR
(to Consort Xian)
If she brings rain, she saves millions. She will be immortalized.

CONSORT XIAN
(fierce, low)
She will be dead.

The guards wrench the infant from Consort Xian's arms. She lunges, but they hold her firm. The baby, placed on the pyre, does not cry.

CONSORT XIAN
(her voice breaking)
At least let me hold her once more. Let me—please.

HIGH PRIEST
The vessel must be pure. Untouched.

He lifts the torch. The dancers' rhythm intensifies. Consort Xian's eyes fix on the Emperor—not pleading now, but branding his face into memory.

CONSORT XIAN
You will remember this. Every raindrop will whisper her name.

The EMPEROR flinches. The torch descends.

A sudden darkness swallows the temple. Lightning—brilliant, impossible—cracks through the ceiling, striking the altar dead center. The explosion of light and sound sends bodies sprawling. The pyre splinters. Smoke billows.

Silence.

Consort Xian is first to move. She scrambles through charred debris, not caring about the smoke or the crackling energy still dancing across the stones. She finds the baby—intact, breathing, asleep.

CONSORT XIAN
(whispering)
...impossible.

She unwraps the cloth with trembling fingers. The infant's eyes open—clear, ancient, knowing.

WEICHI XI (V.O.)
(soft, resonant)
Mother. The covenant is witnessed.

Consort Xian freezes, the baby's gaze holding hers. The child blinks and is simply an infant again, but the temple now smells of ozone and something else... rain on the wind.

MINISTER
(off-screen, awed)
The heavens... they have answered.

title: Once a Stunning Reflection Came
description: A woman who sacrificed everything for her beloved is betrayed on her wedding day when he abandons the ceremony to rush to his childhood sweetheart's side.
context:
Title: Once a Stunning Reflection Came
Description: A woman who sacrificed everything for her beloved is betrayed on her wedding day when he abandons the ceremony to rush to his childhood sweetheart's side.

EXT. NING MANOR - DAY

A grand wedding procession fills the courtyard. Music swells. NING AN rides a tall horse, his red robes pristine—but his knuckles are white on the reins. The sedan chair sways. Inside, YE WANGSHU holds a round fan, her smile fading as she studies Ning An's rigid posture through the sheer curtain.

YE WANGSHU (V.O.)
Seven years ago, his family fell from grace. I was the princess who traded my title for his promise. Today, he wears red of a top scholar. I wear red of his bride.

Ning An extends a hand. Ye Wangshu touches his palm—his fingers are ice-cold. She steps onto the red carpet, clutching her fan.

INT. WEDDING CORRIDOR - DAY

GUESTS line the path, their murmurs swelling.

GUEST A
Miss Ye's father must be turning in his grave—watching his daughter's status traded for a scholar's robe.

GUEST B
Yet the top scholar's devotion is the talk of the capital. He refused three promotions to stay near her.

Guest A exchanges a skeptical glance with Guest B.

GUEST A
Devotion... or debt?
continuation:
INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY

The hall glows with crimson lanterns. Ye Wangshu and Ning An stand before the ancestral tablets. A MAID ties the ceremonial ribbon around their wrists.

MAID
May you never be parted.

Ning An's gaze fixes on the ribbon's knot. His throat works.

NING AN
Wangshu. From this day forward—

Ye Wangshu watches his eyes, searching for the man she nursed through fevers, the nights she copied texts until her fingers bled.

YE WANGSHU
We are bound.

OFFICIANT
Bow to heaven and earth!

A commotion at the entrance. SILENCE cuts through the hall. A GUARD, mud on his boots, pushes through the crowd—his face is stricken.

GUARD
Master Ning... urgent word from the Chu estate.

NING AN
Speak.

GUARD
Miss Chu Yun. She took poison. The physician says she won't last the hour.

A collective GASP. The ribbon goes taut. Ye Wangshu feels the pull. She looks up at Ning An. His face is stone cracking.

NING AN
You were told never to—

GUARD
She asked for you. Only you. By name.

Ning An's fingers brush the ribbon. Then his jaw sets. He doesn't look at Ye Wangshu. He draws the guard's sword. The blade slices the silk.

The severed ends hang limp. He runs.

YE WANGSHU

YE WANGSHU (V.O.)
Seven years ago, his family fell from grace. I was the princess who traded my title for his promise. Today, he wears red of a top scholar. I wear red of his bride.

Ning An extends a hand. Ye Wangshu touches his palm—his fingers are ice-cold. She steps onto the red carpet, clutching her fan.

INT. WEDDING CORRIDOR - DAY

GUESTS line the path, their murmurs swelling.

GUEST A
Miss Ye's father must be turning in his grave—watching his daughter's status traded for a scholar's robe.

GUEST B
Yet the top scholar's devotion is the talk of the capital. He refused three promotions to stay near her.

Guest A exchanges a skeptical glance with Guest B.

GUEST A
Devotion... or debt?

INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY

May you never be parted.

NING AN
Wangshu. From this day forward—

We are bound.

Bow to heaven and earth!

Speak.

title: The Fabulous Model
description: At a glamorous fashion show, two businessmen meet to discuss a mysterious plan involving one of the models.
context:
Title: The Fabulous Model
Description: At a glamorous fashion show, two businessmen meet to discuss a mysterious plan involving one of the models.

EXT. FASHION SHOW VENUE - NIGHT

MONTAGE - FASHION SHOW

A fast-paced montage of beautiful models walking a runway under bright, flashing lights. Upbeat, heavy rock music plays.

LAN LINGWANG, in a sparkling gown, poses confidently.

XIAO MENGYUE, in a white mini-dress, smiles sweetly.

BBB JIANG, in a strapless dress, walks with purpose.

YEZI DAREN, in a black sequined dress, dances playfully.

SHI NI YIRAN, in a gold dress, winks at the camera.

XIAO XUEHUA, in a silver dress, strikes a pose.

CAI YUE, in a red dress, blows a kiss.

GU YAN, in a golden-yellow dress, walks gracefully.

CHENG ER, in a shimmering silver dress, makes a "shush" gesture.

The montage ends. The title card appears: THE FABULOUS MODEL.

Two men, WANG ZONG and DAVID, walk towards each other in a dimly lit area outside the venue. WANG ZONG is wearing a fur-collared coat. DAVID is in a suit.

DAVID
Wang Zong.

WANG ZONG
(smiling and shaking hands)
David. You're late to your own party.
continuation:
DAVID
I was making sure the merchandise was properly displayed.

WANG ZONG
Merchandise has a way of developing opinions.

DAVID
Which is why this particular asset interests me.

DAVID takes out his phone and shows a picture to WANG ZONG. On the screen is a photo of CHENG ER—different life. Younger. Bruised.

DAVID (V.O.)
Remember this girl?

WANG ZONG stares at the photo. His smile calcifies. Recognition hits like a memory of a wound. A sharp sound effect plays.

WANG ZONG
(quietly)
I remember a debt.

DAVID
Outstanding. Now she's worth ten million dollars to the right collector.

WANG ZONG looks toward the venue. CHENG ER's silhouette moves behind glass—free, famous, unaware.

WANG ZONG
She'll recognize you.

DAVID
She won't recognize herself.

A beat. WANG ZONG's hand tightens on the phone.

WANG ZONG
Then let's make it interesting.

The sharp sound effect crescendoes with a heartbeat.

title: The One Who Loves You Most (Episode 1 of 68)
description: A pregnant woman faces rejection from her lover's wealthy family and struggles to give birth alone after being abandoned.
context:
Title: The One Who Loves You Most (Episode 1 of 68)
Description: A pregnant woman faces rejection from her lover's wealthy family and struggles to give birth alone after being abandoned.

INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - DAY

YI SHUQIN (28, exhausted but focused) lies on the delivery bed, her knuckles white around the rails. Sweat mats her hair to her forehead.

NURSE
Breathe. Now push—hard.

YI SHUQIN bears down, a primal sound escaping through gritted teeth.

DOCTOR
(to nurse, urgent)
BP's crashing. Prep the OR for possible emergency hysterectomy.

NURSE
(consulting chart)
No emergency contact listed. No one to authorize the surgical consent.

YI SHUQIN
(whispering)
He's coming... just wait...

The monitor's beeping grows more insistent.

FLASHBACK TO:

TITLE CARD: SEVEN MONTHS EARLIER

INT. GU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

Vintage golden hour light streams through floor-to-ceiling windows. LIU WAN'E (60s, silk scarf perfectly knotted) studies Yi Shuqin like a specimen. GU YIJIN (32, tailored suit slightly rumpled) stands apart, hands in pockets.

GU YIJIN
Mother, Shuqin's carrying a Gu heir.

LIU WAN'E
(sipping tea)
An heir requires a lineage the board can sanction.

YI SHUQIN
(quiet but firm)
My grandfather built your first factory. He worked there forty years.

LIU WAN'E
Exactly. A worker's granddaughter carrying our next CEO? The headlines write themselves.

LIU WAN'E slides a medical consent form across the marble table.

LIU WAN'E
continuation:
Friday appointment. Discreet. In and out before the Han merger announcement.

YI SHUQIN
(to Gu Yijin)
You said we'd tell them together.

GU YIJIN
(staring at floor)
If this leaks before the merger... it's not just us. Hundreds of jobs.

LIU WAN'E
(to Yi Shuqin)
You're practical. You understand what's at stake. The settlement covers everything.

Yi Shuqin doesn't look at the papers. She keeps her eyes on Gu Yijin.

YI SHUQIN
You promised. At the lighthouse. You said nothing would—

GU YIJIN
(quiet, broken)
I can't lose everything. It's not just about us.

GU Yijin turns away. Yi Shuqin's hand falls from his sleeve.

INT. WEDDING BANQUET HALL - DAY

LIU WAN'E accepts congratulations, her smile like armor. Behind her, the wedding portrait shows GU YIJIN and HAN XIMENG (25, serene in white). The banner reads: "Two Families, One Vision."

GUEST
A perfect match. The markets certainly think so.

LIU WAN'E
(raising champagne)
We're letting the children enjoy the honeymoon first.

INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - DAY

YI SHUQIN's grip tightens on the bedrail.

YI SHUQIN
(to herself)
You don't get to choose.

NURSE
Last push—now!

The infant's cry cuts through the room.

Yi Shuqin collapses back, a tear sliding down her temple.

TITLE CARD: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Moonlight Mirror
description: A construction worker receives his wages and attempts to use his money for his family, but faces disdain from his wife and contempt from his boss.
context:
Title: The Moonlight Mirror
Description: A construction worker receives his wages and attempts to use his money for his family, but faces disdain from his wife and contempt from his boss.

EXT. HOME HALLWAY - DAY

ON SCREEN: July 6, 2018, 8:03 AM

LIN YI (40s, calloused hands, hopeful eyes) adjusts his gray work uniform in the bathroom mirror. Behind him, his daughter's backpack hangs with a torn strap.

LIN YI
Hey. Got paid. Thought I'd get her that new bag.

MENG YUAN (30s, weary, not turning) holds their daughter's hand, staring at the floor.

MENG YUAN
Rent's due Tuesday. Electric's past due.

She meets his gaze in the mirror's reflection, her exhaustion louder than anger.

MENG YUAN
Just... bring what's left.

She leads their daughter away. Lin Yi stands alone, his reflection wavering. He lifts his sleeve—recognition, not confusion.

LIN YI
(to himself)
Can't wash it out.
continuation:
INT. UNFINISHED BUILDING - DAY

Concrete dust hangs in the air. Workers in identical uniforms wait, voices low, expectant.

ZHANG
Third time they've moved payday.

ZHAO
Long as it comes.

The FOREMAN (50s, leather jacket, clipboard) raps the table. The FEMALE ACCOUNTANT sits poised with a pen.

FOREMAN
Line up! One sound and you're back on the rubble.

Silence. They form a line.

FEMALE ACCOUNTANT
Zhang Long. 1200.

FEMALE ACCOUNTANT
Zhao Hu. 1200.

FEMALE ACCOUNTANT
Zhao Si. 1400.

FEMALE ACCOUNTANT
Lin Yi. 2500. Night shift bonus.

Lin Yi steps forward. The Foreman's hand stops him.

FOREMAN
(loud enough for all)
Working yourself dead for what? She still flinches when you touch her.

Lin Yi's signature wavers on the page. The Foreman turns to the room.

FOREMAN
Moonlighting for nothing.

INT. LOTTERY SHOP - DAY

LIN YI counts bills at the counter, fingers precise. The SHOPKEEPER waits.

SHOPKEEPER
Same numbers?

LIN YI
No.

He writes: his daughter's birth date, their apartment number, the bonus—2500.

LIN YI
(quietly)
Just these.

He holds the ticket to the light. His fingers glow red through the paper. He looks up at the shop's glass door—his reflection layered over the street, both there and not. He folds the ticket into his shirt pocket, next to his heart, and walks out.

title: A Child with a Mother (36 Episodes)
description: A mother's intuition warns her of danger as her daughter faces a deadly betrayal by her father and his mistress.
context:
Title: A Child with a Mother (36 Episodes)
Description: A mother's intuition warns her of danger as her daughter faces a deadly betrayal by her father and his mistress.

EXT. MOUNTAIN PATH IN SUBURBS - NIGHT

A hazy night. Insects chirp in the tall grass.

FAKE MOTHER (SHEN RUOYUN) grips LITTLE SU YUE's hand as they walk toward a clearing. In the distance, SU YUE'S FATHER (SU HAI) watches from behind trees, cigarette smoke curling around his face.

FAKE MOTHER
Yueyue, Mommy brought you here to see the stars. Just like you wanted.

LITTLE SU YUE
Mommy, do you have a cold? Your voice sounds strange.

FAKE MOTHER
(clearing her throat)
Just a little one. Nothing to worry about.

SU YUE'S FATHER
(quietly, to himself)
Sharp kid. Too sharp.

LITTLE SU YUE
(offering candy)
Here, Mommy. Candy makes everything better.

FAKE MOTHER takes the candy, fingers trembling. Her expression hardens.

FAKE MOTHER
Good girl. But Mommy doesn't want candy. She wants...

She tightens her grip on the child's wrist.

FAKE MOTHER (CONT'D)
...you to disappear.

FAKE MOTHER yanks LITTLE SU YUE toward the cliff edge.

LITTLE SU YUE
(screaming)
Mommy! Stop!

SU YUE'S FATHER bursts from the trees.

SU YUE'S FATHER
Ruoyun! Let her go!

LITTLE SU YUE
Daddy, help!

FAKE MOTHER
(to SU YUE'S FATHER)
Stay back! Or I swear I'll do it!

SU YUE'S FATHER
Think about what you're doing! She's your daughter!

FAKE MOTHER
I can't afford to think! I'm carrying his son now. His real heir!

LITTLE SU YUE
(crying)
I'll be good, Mommy. I'll love the baby. Please don't do this. You said I was your treasure...

FAKE MOTHER
(her voice breaking)
You were never mine.

She shoves LITTLE SU YUE over the edge.

SU YUE'S FATHER
YUEYUE!

He lunges, grasping at empty air.

FAKE MOTHER tears off her mask, revealing YE LAN. She staggers back, breathing hard.

YE LAN
It's done.

SU YUE'S FATHER
(embracing her)
Perfect. With her gone, the insurance money is ours. And Shen Ruoyun will rot in prison for it.

YE LAN
But what if they find the body?

SU YUE'S FATHER
They won't. Not down there.

They share a quiet, satisfied smile.
continuation:
INT. COMPANY CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

REAL MOTHER (SHEN RUOYUN) pours tea for executives around a polished table.

CHEN FEI
The Liu Group representatives land in forty minutes. Five million yuan contract. No mistakes. Understood?

SHEN RUOYUN clutches her chest, the teapot slipping from her grasp. It shatters on the floor.

A cold wave of dread hits her. She sees flashes—her daughter's face, a cliff edge, darkness.

SHEN RUOYUN (V.O.)
Yueyue...

CHEN FEI
Shen Ruoyun! What's wrong with you?

SHEN RUOYUN
(Already moving toward the door)
My daughter. Something's happened.

CHEN FEI
You walk out now, you lose everything. The commission, your bonus—it's all gone!

SHEN RUOYUN
She's all that matters.

She runs.

EXT. BOTTOM OF CLIFF - NIGHT

SUPER: TEN HOURS LATER

Lightning slashes the sky. Thunder cracks. Rain hammers down.

LITTLE SU YUE lies broken on the rocky ground, blood mixing with mud.

LITTLE SU YUE
(whispering)
Mommy... why...

Her voice echoes into the storm.

title: A Dragon's Hope: The National Scholar Returns Home
description: A brilliant scientist returns to honor his parents after receiving the nation's highest award for his groundbreaking work in controlled nuclear fusion.
context:
Title: A Dragon's Hope: The National Scholar Returns Home
Description: A brilliant scientist returns to honor his parents after receiving the nation's highest award for his groundbreaking work in controlled nuclear fusion.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY HALL - DAY

A background screen displays "National Scholar Medal Ceremony."

An elderly man with white hair (ELDER JIANG), wearing a uniform, stands at the podium delivering a speech. The audience below is packed.

ELDER JIANG
Let us give a round of applause to welcome the Father of Controlled Nuclear Fusion, Chen Ming!

Thunderous applause erupts from the audience.

The young and handsome CHEN MING, wearing a black Zhongshan suit, walks up to the stage from below. He smiles, his steps steady and confident.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Ten years at the Advanced Research Institute. Ten years since he left the mountains.

CHEN MING walks to center stage and bows to the audience.

A CEREMONIAL HOSTESS walks onto the stage carrying a wooden box containing a golden National Scholar Medal.

ELDER JIANG takes the medal from the box.

CHEN MING (V.O.)
Dad, Mom. Ten years.

ELDER JIANG personally pins the medal on CHEN MING.

ELDER JIANG picks up a red certificate of honor and hands it to CHEN MING.

ELDER JIANG
Comrade Chen Ming, it is my honor to present you with the National Scholar Medal. For ending a century of technological containment.

CHEN MING
Elder Jiang, you are too kind.

ELDER JIANG
Not too kind. The organization instructed me: whatever you need, name it.

CHEN MING walks to the podium, holding the certificate of honor, facing the microphone.

CHEN MING
Ten years ago, my parents sold our only pig. The village pooled eggs, basket by basket. This belongs to them.

CUT TO:
continuation:
EXT. RURAL FARMHOUSE COURTYARD - DAY

ON SCREEN: Ten Years Ago

CHEN MING'S FATHER, leaning on a crutch, excitedly looks at the "Qingbei University Admission Notice" in his hand.

FATHER
We did it!

CHEN MING'S MOTHER runs out from inside the house. Seeing the notice, she cries tears of joy.

MOTHER
My son... my brilliant son...

YOUNG CHEN MING, dressed plainly, stands to the side.

YOUNG CHEN MING
Dad, I can work at the mine. I don't have to go.

Father's smile freezes. He raises his crutch, his hand trembling.

FATHER
You'd throw this back in their faces?

MOTHER
(quickly stopping him)
Old Chen! He's trying to help!

YOUNG CHEN MING
The tuition is eight hundred yuan. You haven't eaten a full meal in a week.

FATHER
My stomach troubles me. That's not your burden.

YOUNG CHEN MING
Dad...

FATHER
I limp through that mine so you wouldn't have to! You think I want to see you back here in ten years?

Father steadies himself against the doorframe.

FATHER
A man lives for his pride. Don't make me die having failed at the only thing that matters.

YOUNG CHEN MING drops to his knees with a thud, sobbing uncontrollably.

YOUNG CHEN MING
(crying out)
I'll fail. I'll waste it all!

FATHER
Then fail trying. Not here.

Father suddenly clutches his chest. His crutch slips, and he steadies himself against the wall, breathing hard.

FATHER
(quietly)
The ticket is bought, son. Don't make them take it back.

title: Heatwave Apocalypse
description: A devastating heatwave transforms the world into a hellish wasteland. A man betrayed by his family is given a second chance when he's reborn before the apocalypse begins.
context:
Title: Heatwave Apocalypse
Description: A devastating heatwave transforms the world into a hellish wasteland. A man betrayed by his family is given a second chance when he's reborn before the apocalypse begins.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

A white convertible speeds along a winding road. Inside, WU YANYAN, styled impeccably, enjoys the wind in her hair. A man's hand (LI LONG's) rests on her thigh.

Suddenly, a sharp crack. The windshield shatters into a spiderweb pattern. WU YANYAN screams.

She stops the car, shaken. A charred bird smokes on the hood.

WU YANYAN
What the hell?

WU YANYAN looks toward the distance in horror. Flickers of intense heat shimmer in the air, distorting the city skyline. Her phone buzzes with an emergency alert.

WU YANYAN
(reading)
"Extreme solar flare activity... seek immediate shelter..."

She frantically calls someone.

WU YANYAN
(into phone, panicking)
Long, something's wrong. The sun—it's getting hotter. Where are you?

LI LONG (V.O.)
I'm at the apartment. Get back here before—

The phone call cuts off. The sun pulses brighter. WU YANYAN covers her face and screams in pain.

WU YANYAN
So hot! The sun is burning!

The convertible sits abandoned on dried grass, surrounded by desolation.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
At first, everyone thought it was just an ordinary heatwave, not knowing they had entered an apocalyptic hell.

TITLE CARD: ONE MONTH AFTER THE HEATWAVE

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING - DAY

LIU SHI's grime-caked hand trembles against a wall. Cut to a man with sun-damaged skin and an exhausted expression, LIU SHI.

He listens to two SHADOWY FIGURES huddled nearby.

SHADOWY FIGURE 1
(weakly)
...heard some families are hoarding resources. Living like kings while we starve...

SHADOWY FIGURE 2
...upper floors of the Greenview Apartments. Generator, water purifier, the works...

LIU SHI's eyes harden with determination.

LIU SHI (V.O.)
Greenview Apartments. My home.
continuation:
EXT. ABANDONED STREET - DAY

LIU SHI, wrapped in scavenged plastic and rags, staggers through shimmering heat waves. He collapses, his bag spilling open.

A gaunt VAGRANT appears, eyes fixed on something.

VAGRANT
Water... is that water?

The VAGRANT lunges. LIU SHI fights back with feral strength, clutching his prize: a half-crushed water bottle and moldy bread.

INT. APARTMENT ENTRANCE - DAY

LIU SHI drags his exhausted body to his front door and opens it.

LIU SHI
(excited, hoarse)
Zhuangzhuang... I found food...

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - DAY

The room is cool. An air conditioner hums. WU YANYAN, son ZHUANGZHUANG, brother-in-law WU JIE, and his in-laws sit in clean clothes, eating canned peaches. WU JIE guards the door with an aluminum bat.

LIU SHI stumbles in. His eyes light up at the sight of his son.

LIU SHI
Zhuangzhuang... I found food...

He reaches into his bag. WU JIE moves fast, slamming the bat into LIU SHI's ribs.

LIU SHI
(crashing down, gasping)
What... are you...

WU JIE
Not so fast, freeloader.

WU YANYAN rises, her face cold.

WU YANYAN
That's all you bring? After three days?

She kicks the bag. The meager supplies scatter.

WU YANYAN
We have four mouths to feed. You know the rules: contribute or get out.

LIU SHI
(struggling)
I'm... his father...

From the bedroom, LI LONG emerges, wearing LIU SHI's robe. He ruffles ZHUANGZHUANG's hair. The boy doesn't look at his real father.

LI LONG
A father provides, brother. You just... take up space.

WU YANYAN's smile cuts like glass.

WU YANYAN
Did you really think I married you for your salary? Long's divorce finalized last month. We were just waiting for the right time.

LIU SHI
You... planned this...

LIU SHI tries to rise. LI LONG's boot pins his neck to the floor.

LI LONG
The heatwave just sped things up. Thanks for your emergency fund. Really helped us ride this out in comfort.

LIU SHI
(roaring, voice cracking)
Zhuangzhuang! Look at me!

The boy finally turns. His eyes are empty.

ZHUANGZHUANG
Mom says if you really loved me, you'd want me to be safe. With Daddy Long.

LI LONG
Now, about that "contribution" you owe us...

LI LONG picks up the bat from WU JIE.

LI LONG
We can't afford another mouth. But we can always use... spare parts.

The truth hits LIU SHI: they're not just abandoning him. They're recycling him.

LIU SHI
(whisper)
No...

LI LONG raises the bat.

LI LONG
Nothing personal. Just survival.

The blow falls. Blackness.

LIU SHI (V.O.)
If I could do it over again... I'd make you beg me for scraps.

The screen goes black, then a bright light flashes.

EXT. BUS STOP - DAY

LIU SHI jolts awake to find himself sitting on a bench at a bus stop. He looks at his clean hands and normal clothes, completely bewildered.

Around him is a bustling modern cityscape. Everything appears normal. A teenager scrolls her phone.

TEENAGER
...record-breaking summer. Like, surface-of-the-sun hot...

LIU SHI checks his phone. The date glows: JUNE 15. Two weeks before Heatfall.

He looks at his reflection in the bus shelter glass. Unburned. Alive.

LIU SHI
(shocked, to himself)
Two weeks...

A slow, cold smile spreads across his face.

LIU SHI
This time... I'll be ready.

FADE OUT.

title: The Temptation of Power: The Secretary's Glamorous Transformation
description: A devoted secretary discovers her boss has a fiancée after five years together, forcing her to confront the reality of being a substitute and make a difficult choice.
context:
Title: The Temptation of Power: The Secretary's Glamorous Transformation
Description: A devoted secretary discovers her boss has a fiancée after five years together, forcing her to confront the reality of being a substitute and make a difficult choice.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Moonlight streams through curtains. SHI SHENG stands at the window, a silk robe draped on her shoulders.

SHI SHENG (V.O.)
Five years of being his shadow. His secret. I stopped expecting the proposal. I just... forgot to expect anything.

Flashback: SHI SHENG gently removes LI JING's glasses as he sleeps. Kisses his forehead.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

A phone BUZZES—not hers. SHI SHENG picks it up. The screen displays a message from "YE WANROU."

YE WANROU (V.O.)
Brother A-Jing, I miss you.

LI JING enters in a bathrobe. Freezes.

LI JING
You checked my phone.

SHI SHENG
(looking up)
Who is Ye Wanrou?

LI JING's phone RINGS. He answers, voice softening instantly.

LI JING
(on phone)
You're jet-lagged. Order room service.

He hangs up. The silence crystallizes.

LI JING
My fiancée. She returns tomorrow.

SHI SHENG
(steady)
I see.

LI JING
This ends now. Don't come back.

SHI SHENG
(hand on nightstand)
Five years. You couldn't say it until now.

LI JING
Don't make this difficult.

He turns. She watches him go, touches her reflection in the dark window.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

SHI SHENG types at her desk—a resignation letter.

SHI SHENG (V.O.)
This job ends today too.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Sister Sheng, it's time. President Li is here.

SHI SHENG closes her laptop. Composed.

INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

SHI SHENG stands apart from bowing employees.

LI JING enters with BODYGUARDS.

EMPLOYEES
(bowing)
Good morning, President!

LI JING stops before SHI SHENG.

LI JING
My office. Now.

SHI SHENG
Yes, President Li.

INT. LI JING'S OFFICE - DAY

LI JING reviews documents. SHI SHENG enters.

LI JING
The teal dress. Tonight's banquet with Jiang Huaichuan.

SHI SHENG
The one who harasses female employees.

LI JING
(looks up)
What?

SHI SHENG
The briefing mentioned his reputation.

LI JING
Then you know to avoid him.

SHI SHENG takes the dress.

SHI SHENG
Five years of handling your problems. Tonight, I handle mine.

At the door, she pauses.

SHI SHENG
I'm resigning after the banquet. Clean break.

She exits. LI JING stares at the closed door.

title: In My Next Life, I'll Still Be Mother's Daughter
description: A successful businesswoman is betrayed by her stepmother and stepbrother, who orchestrated an accident to steal her billion-dollar empire.
context:
Title: In My Next Life, I'll Still Be Mother's Daughter
Description: A successful businesswoman is betrayed by her stepmother and stepbrother, who orchestrated an accident to steal her billion-dollar empire.

INT. CITY HIGH-RISE - DAY

Wide shot showing the bustling cityscape through floor-to-ceiling windows.

EXT. STOCK EXCHANGE PLAZA - DAY

SONG YINGZHEN and XIE WANQING cross the crowded plaza, XIE WANQING's hand resting possessively on SONG YINGZHEN's arm.

SONG YINGZHEN answers her phone.

SONG YINGZHEN
Hello.

VOICE ON PHONE (O.S.)
Director Song, Dingsheng Group has officially gone public. Opening at $38 a share.

SONG YINGZHEN
(into phone)
Thank you. Tell the team we'll celebrate tomorrow.

She hangs up, turning to XIE WANQING with trembling excitement.

SONG YINGZHEN
We did it, Mom. Dad's company—everything he dreamed.

XIE WANQING
He'd be so proud of you, Zhenzhen.

They embrace at the curb. XIE WANQING's eye catches something over SONG YINGZHEN's shoulder—her smile flickers.

A BLACK SEDAN screeches around the corner, tires smoking.

XIE WANQING
(sharp)
Zhenzhen!

She shoves SONG YINGZHEN forward. The car clips SONG YINGZHEN, throwing her to the ground. It speeds away. XIE WANQING collapses artfully.

XIE WANQING
(crawling to her)
My daughter! Somebody call an ambulance!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

SONG YINGZHEN lies unconscious, monitors beeping softly. Her head is bandaged.

XIE WANQING rushes in.

XIE WANQING
Zhenzhen!

SONG YINGZHEN slowly opens her eyes.

XIE WANQING
(concerned)
How are you feeling?

SONG YINGZHEN
Mom... everything hurts...

XIE WANQING's expression shifts. The maternal warmth drains away, replaced by cold contempt.

XIE WANQING
Am I your real mother? And you still call me Mom?

SONG YINGZHEN looks shocked.

SONG YINGZHEN
Mom, what's wrong? I gave you the Dingsheng shares. The house. What more do you want?

SONG JINCHENG emerges from the shadows, smiling, holding a document.

SONG YINGZHEN
(seeing him)
Jincheng...?

XIE WANQING
(sneering)
You really are that stupid. The accident was arranged.

XIE WANQING laughs, a cold, sharp sound.

XIE WANQING
Twenty years of playing perfect mother. All for this moment.

SONG JINCHENG
Sister, don't worry. We'll take excellent care of your billions.

SONG YINGZHEN
(furious)
You—

XIE WANQING
(stroking her face)
The world believes you sacrificed yourself to save me. Dingsheng stock is soaring. You're dying a hero.

SONG JINCHENG hands her the document.

XIE WANQING
(holding an organ donation form)
I'll make sure your organs save lives. A final gift to boost our reputation.

She signs "Song Yingzhen" with practiced strokes.

SONG YINGZHEN
(struggling)
No... give it back!

She falls from the bed, looking up in agony.

SONG YINGZHEN
(crying)
All those years... your notes in my lunchbox... teaching me to dance... Was any of it real? Did you ever love me? Even for a moment?

XIE WANQING crouches close, her voice a blade.

XIE WANQING
You're the daughter of the woman who stole my life. You were a tool. Nothing more.

She stands, smoothing her dress. SONG YINGZHEN collapses in complete despair.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

SONG YINGZHEN lies unconscious, monitors beeping softly. Her head is bandaged.

XIE WANQING rushes in.

XIE WANQING
Zhenzhen!

SONG YINGZHEN slowly opens her eyes.

XIE WANQING
(concerned)
How are you feeling?

SONG YINGZHEN
Mom... everything hurts...

XIE WANQING's expression shifts. The maternal warmth drains away, replaced by cold contempt.

XIE WANQING
Am I your real mother? And you still call me Mom?

SONG YINGZHEN looks shocked.

SONG YINGZHEN
Mom, what's wrong? I gave you the Dingsheng shares. The house. What more do you want?

SONG JINCHENG emerges from the shadows, smiling, holding a document.

SONG YINGZHEN
(seeing him)
Jincheng...?

XIE WANQING
(sneering)
You really are that stupid. The accident was arranged.

XIE WANQING laughs, a cold, sharp sound.

XIE WANQING
Twenty years of playing perfect mother. All for this moment.

SONG JINCHENG
Sister, don't worry. We'll take excellent care of your billions.

SONG YINGZHEN
(furious)
You—

XIE WANQING
(stroking her face)
The world believes you sacrificed yourself to save me. Dingsheng stock is soaring. You're dying a hero.

SONG JINCHENG hands her the document.

XIE WANQING
(holding an organ donation form)
I'll make sure your organs save lives. A final gift to boost our reputation.

She signs "Song Yingzhen" with practiced strokes.

SONG YINGZHEN
(struggling)
No... give it back!

She falls from the bed, looking up in agony.

SONG YINGZHEN
(crying)
All those years... your notes in my lunchbox... teaching me to dance... Was any of it real? Did you ever love me? Even for a moment?

XIE WANQING crouches close, her voice a blade.

XIE WANQING
You're the daughter of the woman who stole my life. You were a tool. Nothing more.

She stands, smoothing her dress. SONG YINGZHEN collapses in complete despair.

context:
Title: The Mute Woman from the Mountains
Description: A mother from a mountain village loses one daughter in a tragic accident and sacrifices everything to give her surviving daughter a chance at education and a better life.

EXT. VILLAGE ROAD - DAY

A man holds an injured little girl (JIA'ER) in his arms, surrounded by VILLAGERS. The man shouts anxiously.

MAN
Someone call for help! The ambulance!

CUIHUA and her young daughter (WAN'ER) walk down the road and see a crowd gathered ahead. CUIHUA's heart tightens. She runs over, her hands already forming desperate signs.

CUIHUA
(frantically gesturing)
[Where? My daughter? Sweet shop?]

She grabs a VILLAGER's arm, pointing toward her small roadside sweet stand, then holding her hand at Jia'er's height.

FEMALE NEIGHBOR
Cuihua... the car came too fast. Your Jia'er... she's gone. Driver fled. The Zhangs called the police.

CUIHUA collapses to her knees, her face contorted in a silent scream. She stares at the chalk outline on the pavement, touches a smudge of red clay dust - not blood, just earth. Her shoulders convulse.

WAN'ER
(crying, kneeling down)
Mama, it's my fault. I wanted the ribbon for my hair. If I hadn't kept you at the market...

CUIHUA pulls Wan'er close, pressing the girl's head to her chest. She rocks them both, her mouth open in a soundless wail.

INT. CUIHUA'S HOUSE - NIGHT

TEN YEARS LATER

CUIHUA sits on the edge of the bed, knitting by oil lamp. Her hair is steel-gray. Rain pounds the tin roof. WAN'ER bursts in, clutching a wet envelope, rainwater streaming from her braids.

WAN'ER
Mom! Mom! I got it!

She thrusts the envelope into Cuihua's hands. Cuihua's fingers tremble as she opens it. Her eyes trace the characters. A smile cracks her weathered face. She stands and touches JIA'ER's memorial photo - a faded Polaroid tucked into the mud wall.

CUIHUA
(signing gently)
[She sees you. She's proud.]

WAN'ER
Beijing Normal University. Full tuition is ten thousand yuan.

Cuihua's smile doesn't fade. She pulls a cloth bundle from under the bed - layers of fabric unfold to reveal carefully sorted bills: tens, twenties, fives. She counts. Two thousand, three hundred. Wan'er watches her mother's quick, practiced fingers.

WAN'ER
(quietly)
Mama, I could stay. Teach at the township school.

CUIHUA
(signs sharply, eyes flashing)
[No. You will go.]

She reaches under the mattress, pulls out her bankbook. Points to the balance line. Then points to Wan'er, then skyward, gesturing: "I will find more."

WAN'ER
(moved, but controlled)
Mama...

Mother and daughter embrace. Cuihua's arms are rope-muscled and strong.

MONTAGE:
- CUIHUA loads her rusted tricycle at dawn, cucumbers and bok choy arranged like jade. She pedals uphill, her calves straining.
- CUIHUA carries mortar at a construction site, her small frame bent double. A WORKER points; she nods, points to her back, loads more.
- CUIHUA works a night market stall, hands flying in sign language to customers. She clears tables, her fingers blistered.
- CUIHUA harvests rice under white sun, her sickle a silver blur. She stumbles, rights herself, keeps cutting.
- CUIHUA clutches her side at the construction site. She waves off a coworker, tries to stand, then folds slowly to the ground like a closing fan.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

CUIHUA lies in bed, an oxygen mask covering her face. WAN'ER sits beside her, now a young woman in a university sweater. A DOCTOR enters with a clipboard.

WAN'ER
She opened her eyes once. Didn't sign.

DOCTOR
Your mother's coworker brought her medical card. She's been buying painkillers for months. The scans show advanced renal failure. She needs surgery within weeks.

Cuihua's eyes flutter open. She sees the doctor, sees the clipboard with cost estimates. She tears the mask off.

CUIHUA
(gasping, signing weakly)
[No. Wan'er's last year.]

WAN'ER
(firmly, tears streaming)
Mama, if you die, I leave school. I come back here. I plant rice. That's the end.

CUIHUA
(trying to rise, face pale)
[My life is mine to spend!]

WAN'ER
(holding her down)
And my life is mine to lose if you go!

The two women lock eyes. Cuihua's hands fall still. Wan'er turns to the doctor.

WAN'ER
She'll have the surgery. I'll get the money.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

TEN YEARS LATER

CUIHUA sits at her doorstep, hair pure white. She shells peanuts with quick fingers, dropping them in a bowl. A few NEIGHBORS chat not far away.

NEIGHBOR
Her daughter's doing well in Jinghai. Two children now. Sends money every month.

CUIHUA hears this, slowly lifts her head, her eyes filled with complex emotions. She looks at the paved road leading out of the village, runs a finger along the rim of a porcelain bowl Wan'er sent last Spring Festival. Her hands remember the weight of mortar, the burn of hot oil. The bowl is empty. She fills it with shelled nuts anyway, arranges them in a neat circle, a silent offering.

A car horn sounds. She doesn't look up. The neighbors scatter. She keeps shelling, her fingers steady, her face giving nothing away.

title: Escape from the Pillow
description: A woman betrayed by her husband and cousin is given a second chance when she wakes up three minutes before the tragedy that killed her.
context:
Title: Escape from the Pillow
Description: A woman betrayed by her husband and cousin is given a second chance when she wakes up three minutes before the tragedy that killed her.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

FAST CUTS: Headlights slice through torrential rain. An ambulance screeches to a halt. Medical staff rush two hospital beds down the corridor. JIANG RANRAN and SHEN YIYI lie on the beds, moaning. Blood covers Ranran's legs.

ZHOU YIXUAN
(anxiously)
Stay with me, Ranran.

JIANG JINGYU
Hold on, Ranran.

JIANG JINGYU
(to Zhou Yixuan)
The merger needs me. You'll stay?

JIANG RANRAN
(weakly)
Go. He'll be here.

JIANG JINGYU
(to Zhou Yixuan)
Protect her.

Jiang Jingyu exits. Zhou Yixuan pushes the bed into the operating room with staff.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

Zhou Yixuan waits outside. Inside, doctors work. Ranran's monitor alarms.

The Doctor meets Zhou Yixuan's eyes through the glass, holds up three fingers.

DOCTOR
(muffled through glass)
Mother or child?

ZHOU YIXUAN
(intercom button)
There must be another way.

DOCTOR
Not full term. Fall caused malpositioning. Decide.

Zhou Yixuan's knuckles whiten. His reflection smiles.

ZHOU YIXUAN
Save the baby. She'd want her daughter.

Ranran screams.
continuation:
INT. OPERATING ROOM - LATER

A baby cries. The Doctor carries a newborn out.

DOCTOR
She's asking for you.

Zhou Yixuan enters with the baby. Ranran, oxygen mask fogging, reaches out. His sadness evaporates.

ZHOU YIXUAN
Look at our daughter.

JIANG RANRAN
Let me see...

ZHOU YIXUAN
She'll never know her mother made me crawl for every scrap of power.

SHEN YIYI enters in a silk kimono, holding a baby. Her makeup is perfect.

SHEN YIYI
Sister. You still don't see?

JIANG RANRAN
Yiyi... what...

SHEN YIYI
He was never yours. You owned the shell. I held his heart.

JIANG RANRAN
I was good to you both...

SHEN YIYI
Good? I'm the bastard cousin who shares your blood but not your name. He's the genius who fetched your coffee. We deserve more.

ZHOU YIXUAN
(pulling off mask)
Wife, when you die, I become CEO. Our daughter inherits everything. It's perfect.

The monitor flatlines. Zhou Yixuan and Shen Yiyi smile.

MONTAGE

Time rewinds violently. The flatline jumps back to life.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Ranran wakes gasping. She touches her throat, her flat stomach. The clock shows 9:16.

JIANG RANRAN
(to herself)
Three minutes...

She looks at her phone. The date confirms it. Her eyes turn to steel.

title: The Campus Belle's Secret
description: After a reckless night upends her future, a scholarship student must navigate an unexpected pregnancy, a manipulative family, and a fateful encounter with a reclusive heir.
context:
Title: The Campus Belle's Secret
Description: After a reckless night upends her future, a scholarship student must navigate an unexpected pregnancy, a manipulative family, and a fateful encounter with a reclusive heir.

INT. HOSPITAL EXAMINATION ROOM - DAY

A DOCTOR holds up an ultrasound report.

DOCTOR
Jiang Yingying? You're pregnant. With twins.

JIANG YINGYING (a Qingbei University student) stares at the report, shock freezing her features.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

JIANG YINGYING lies on unfamiliar sheets, disoriented.

JIANG YINGYING (V.O.)
I'm still in school...

A YOUNG MAN'S silhouette moves beside her.

YOUNG MAN (V.O.)
Relax. I'm sterile—there's no risk.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. HOSPITAL EXAMINATION ROOM - DAY

Back in the present, JIANG YINGYING still stares at the report.

DOCTOR
I need to ask—do you have a support system? Someone we can contact?

The DOCTOR gestures toward her file. JIANG YINGYING's eyes widen.

JIANG YINGYING
No! Please... you can't.

She leans forward, voice dropping.

JIANG YINGYING
If they find out, they'll destroy me. Please. This stays between us.

The DOCTOR studies her, seeing genuine terror.

TRANSITION: Two months earlier
continuation:
INT. JIANG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

LI HONGMEI (Jiang Yingying's adoptive mother) slaps JIANG YINGYING across the face.

LI HONGMEI
You ungrateful leech! You think I'm an ATM? Look around you—this isn't a charity!

JIANG WENBIN (Jiang Yingying's younger brother) lies on the sofa, engrossed in his phone.

JIANG YINGYING
(trembling)
My wages—every penny went to you. The deadline is Friday. If I can't pay—

LI HONGMEI
Then figure it out! That's what adults do.

JIANG WENBIN
Mom, the new iPhone drops tomorrow. You promised.

LI HONGMEI's demeanor shifts instantly—honeyed and warm.

LI HONGMEI
Of course, baby. We'll get you the Pro Max.

She turns back to Jiang Yingying, voice like ice.

LI HONGMEI
And you—stop wasting oxygen and make yourself useful. Dinner won't cook itself.

EXT. LU XING TOWER - NIGHT

In the night, a gleaming skyscraper towers above.

JIANG YINGYING stands outside, clutching a resume folder. She approaches the SECURITY GUARD.

JIANG YINGYING
Excuse me, I'm here about the custodial position—

SECURITY GUARD
Applications are online. No walk-ins.

He turns away. Jiang YINGYING stumbles back, her heel catching on the curb. She falls, papers scattering.

SU XINGCHEN (heir to the Su family conglomerate) and an ATTENDANT exit the building.

The SECURITY GUARD snaps to attention.

SECURITY GUARD
Mr. Su. Sir.

SU XINGCHEN's gaze drops to Jiang Yingying—on the ground, dignity shattered, eyes glistening. Their eyes meet for a heartbeat.

He continues walking without a word. The Attendant follows.

Jiang Yingying remains on the pavement, watching them disappear into a waiting black sedan.

END SCENE

title: Deception Game
description: A con artist team uses a fake charity scheme to lure villagers into their trap, starting with free mooncakes and a planted accomplice.
context:
Title: Deception Game
Description: A con artist team uses a fake charity scheme to lure villagers into their trap, starting with free mooncakes and a planted accomplice.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE CLEARING - DAY

A delivery truck idles in dust. LU HONG stands on the flatbed with stacked gift boxes. Villagers keep their distance.

LU HONG
(raising megaphone)
Mid-Autumn Festival! Free mooncakes from GreenSun Energy!

VILLAGER A
Free? What's the catch?

VILLAGER B
Probably expired stock.

XU HAOYU steps forward, holding a medical bill envelope.

XU HAOYU
Never heard of GreenSun.

LU HONG
New startup. Our CEO invests in villages, not TV ads.

XU HAOYU
Boss has a name?

LU HONG
CEO Wan. Come see for yourself.

XU HAOYU glances at his envelope, then accepts a box.

XU HAOYU
Real lotus paste.

VILLAGER C
My grandson loves these. We can't afford them this year.

CHEN HAO leans from the driver's window.

CHEN HAO
One per family, folks.

GANG ZI pushes through, holding a box.

GANG ZI
Another for my sister's place.

LU HONG
One per household, brother. Rules are rules.

GANG ZI
City rules or village rules?

Villagers relax, some chuckling. They line up.

LU HONG
(once distribution slows)
GreenSun seeks one local partner. Invest one thousand yuan today, get it back tomorrow with five percent dividend. Plus free solar consultation.

The crowd stills. XU HAOYU grips his medical bill.

XU HAOYU
Five percent in one day? What bank gives that?

VILLAGER B
Sounds like pyramid schemes.

GANG ZI
I've seen their East District office. Three floors, glass front.

CHEN HAO
(producing a laminated certificate)
License and tax records. All proper.

GANG ZI takes the certificate, examines the seal closely.
continuation:
GANG ZI
(to Xu Haoyu)
I've worked construction in the city. This seal is legit.

XU HAOYU
(quietly)
You're from here?

GANG ZI
Used to be. Back for my mother. City life's expensive.

XU HAOYU
My mother needs surgery. Ten thousand.

GANG ZI
A thousand's a thousand. Sometimes you gotta trust something.

GANG ZI pulls a worn wallet, counts out one thousand yuan. Villagers watch.

VILLAGER C
Brother, don't do it.

VILLAGER A
We've seen this story before.

GANG ZI
I've seen their office. What have you seen?

He hands cash to Lu Hong. Lu Hong writes a receipt.

LU HONG
Partnership recorded. Same time tomorrow, nine sharp.

GANG ZI
(nodding to Xu Haoyu)
See you tomorrow?

XU HAOYU
(staring at envelope)
Maybe.

LU HONG, CHEN HAO, and SU WAN in the cab exchange a look.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The truck rumbles down the narrow road.

INT. TRUCK CABIN - DAY

LU HONG drives. SU WAN counts cash in the passenger seat. CHEN HAO and GANG ZI ride in back, silent.

SU WAN
One brings ten tomorrow.

LU HONG
(quiet)
The one with the hospital bill looked ready to break.

SU WAN
That's the business.

GANG ZI
(leaning forward)
He recognized me. From the factory.

SU WAN
So?

GANG ZI
Nothing. Just... he recognized me.

SU WAN
Get some sleep. Tomorrow we collect.

The truck accelerates into the distance.
