Title: Deception Game
Description: A con artist team uses a fake charity scheme to lure villagers into their trap, starting with free mooncakes and a planted accomplice.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE CLEARING - DAY

A delivery truck idles in dust. LU HONG stands on the flatbed with stacked gift boxes. Villagers keep their distance.

LU HONG
(raising megaphone)
Mid-Autumn Festival! Free mooncakes from GreenSun Energy!

VILLAGER A
Free? What's the catch?

VILLAGER B
Probably expired stock.

XU HAOYU steps forward, holding a medical bill envelope.

XU HAOYU
Never heard of GreenSun.

LU HONG
New startup. Our CEO invests in villages, not TV ads.

XU HAOYU
Boss has a name?

LU HONG
CEO Wan. Come see for yourself.

XU HAOYU glances at his envelope, then accepts a box.

XU HAOYU
Real lotus paste.

VILLAGER C
My grandson loves these. We can't afford them this year.

CHEN HAO leans from the driver's window.

CHEN HAO
One per family, folks.

GANG ZI pushes through, holding a box.

GANG ZI
Another for my sister's place.

LU HONG
One per household, brother. Rules are rules.

GANG ZI
City rules or village rules?

Villagers relax, some chuckling. They line up.

LU HONG
(once distribution slows)
GreenSun seeks one local partner. Invest one thousand yuan today, get it back tomorrow with five percent dividend. Plus free solar consultation.

The crowd stills. XU HAOYU grips his medical bill.

XU HAOYU
Five percent in one day? What bank gives that?

VILLAGER B
Sounds like pyramid schemes.

GANG ZI
I've seen their East District office. Three floors, glass front.

CHEN HAO
(producing a laminated certificate)
License and tax records. All proper.

GANG ZI takes the certificate, examines the seal closely.

GANG ZI
(to Xu Haoyu)
I've worked construction in the city. This seal is legit.

XU HAOYU
(quietly)
You're from here?

GANG ZI
Used to be. Back for my mother. City life's expensive.

XU HAOYU
My mother needs surgery. Ten thousand.

GANG ZI
A thousand's a thousand. Sometimes you gotta trust something.

GANG ZI pulls a worn wallet, counts out one thousand yuan. Villagers watch.

VILLAGER C
Brother, don't do it.

VILLAGER A
We've seen this story before.

GANG ZI
I've seen their office. What have you seen?

He hands cash to Lu Hong. Lu Hong writes a receipt.

LU HONG
Partnership recorded. Same time tomorrow, nine sharp.

GANG ZI
(nodding to Xu Haoyu)
See you tomorrow?

XU HAOYU
(staring at envelope)
Maybe.

LU HONG, CHEN HAO, and SU WAN in the cab exchange a look.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

The truck rumbles down the narrow road.

INT. TRUCK CABIN - DAY

LU HONG drives. SU WAN counts cash in the passenger seat. CHEN HAO and GANG ZI ride in back, silent.

SU WAN
One brings ten tomorrow.

LU HONG
(quiet)
The one with the hospital bill looked ready to break.

SU WAN
That's the business.

GANG ZI
(leaning forward)
He recognized me. From the factory.

SU WAN
So?

GANG ZI
Nothing. Just... he recognized me.

SU WAN
Get some sleep. Tomorrow we collect.

The truck passes the village sign. LU HONG checks the rearview mirror—GANG ZI watches the receding fields.

The truck accelerates into the distance.

title: Singer 2024: Shining Stage (Episode 79)
description: A woman discovers her boyfriend and best friend's betrayal, leading to a tragic accident that changes everything.
context:
Title: Singer 2024: Shining Stage (Episode 79)
Description: A woman discovers her boyfriend and best friend's betrayal, leading to a tragic accident that changes everything.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

LIN QINGXUE, wearing a pink bathrobe, walks seductively toward WU LIANG. She caresses his chest, removes his glasses, and they gaze at each other intimately.

WU LIANG pushes LIN QINGXUE down onto the bed.

LIN QINGXUE
Ah.

LIN QINGXUE lies on the bed, looking up at WU LIANG hovering above her.

LIN QINGXUE
Why the rush? Did Chen Xiaoying sign the final transfer?

WU LIANG
Just thinking about still being that fat pig's boyfriend in name makes me sick. One more show.

WU LIANG leans down to kiss LIN QINGXUE. Suddenly, the door bursts open. CHEN XIAOYING, wearing pineapple-patterned pajamas, stands in the doorway, shocked by the scene before her.

CHEN XIAOYING
(shocked, stuttering)
You... you two! What are you doing?!

WU LIANG and LIN QINGXUE immediately separate and sit up. LIN QINGXUE adjusts her clothes while WU LIANG buttons his shirt.

LIN QINGXUE
(calmly)
Since you've seen us, we have nothing to hide.

CHEN XIAOYING
(stepping forward, demanding answers)
Wu Liang, what... what is this?

WU LIANG
(disgustedly shaking off her hand)
Let go! The ghost arrangement is over.

CHEN XIAOYING
(in disbelief)
Ghost arrangement?

WU LIANG
Don't you have any self-awareness? Damn, I really can't stand this charade anymore.

LIN QINGXUE
(mocking)
You actually dream about debuting? That's hilarious.

CHEN XIAOYING
(grabbing LIN QINGXUE's arm, crying)
Lin Qingxue! Are you going to take everything from me?

LIN QINGXUE
(forcefully shaking her off)
Let go! You naive child!

CHEN XIAOYING is pushed to the floor, covering her cheek.

LIN QINGXUE
(looking down at her)
A voice like yours is only good enough to sing behind the scenes for me. Besides that, you're completely useless.

WU LIANG
Right. If it weren't for using you as Qingxue's ghost singer, I would never maintain this lie.

LIN QINGXUE
(arms crossed, coldly)
Chen Xiaoying, you have no value anymore. I suggest you get out now, or don't blame me for being rude.

LIN QINGXUE grabs CHEN XIAOYING's chin, then forcefully pushes her head away. CHEN XIAOYING falls to the floor, heartbroken. Thunder roars outside the window.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Heavy rain pours down. CHEN XIAOYING stumbles through the rain, crying in anguish.

The insulting words of WU LIANG and LIN QINGXUE echo in her mind.

LIN QINGXUE (V.O.)
A voice like yours is only good enough to sing behind the scenes for me.

WU LIANG (V.O.)
I would never maintain this lie.

CHEN XIAOYING breaks down crying in the rain. A car speeds toward her, its headlights blinding.

CHEN XIAOYING
(screaming)
Ahhh—!

The piercing sound of brakes and impact.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR/EMERGENCY ROOM - DAY

CHEN XIAOYING, face covered in blood and wearing an oxygen mask, is rushed on a gurney by medical staff toward the emergency room.

The emergency room doors close and the light turns on.

Doctors and nurses work frantically around the operating table to save CHEN XIAOYING.

MUFFLED DOCTOR'S VOICE
Prep the experimental facial reconstruction! Save the vocal cords!

ON SCREEN: ONE YEAR LATER

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

A NURSE checks the IV bag beside a hospital bed.

A WOMAN lies in the bed, wearing a hospital gown with an IV needle in her hand.

The NURSE checks the patient's condition and suddenly notices the patient's hand move slightly.

NURSE
(excited)
Ah? Doctor! Doctor! The patient is waking up!

The WOMAN in the bed slowly opens her eyes. Her face has become LIN QINGXUE's face.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Justice Will Not Be Absent
description: A celebrated lawyer is framed, murdered, and betrayed by his wife and rival, only to wake up ten years in the past with a chance to prevent his downfall.
context:
Title: Justice Will Not Be Absent
Description: A celebrated lawyer is framed, murdered, and betrayed by his wife and rival, only to wake up ten years in the past with a chance to prevent his downfall.

EXT. POOL PARTY - NIGHT

A lively pool party is in full swing. People dance, drink, and celebrate by the poolside. The music is loud and chaotic.

CHEN YANG, a man in an elegant suit and glasses, sits alone on a bench, quietly reading a book, out of place amidst the surrounding clamor.

A woman in an orange dress (FEMALE GUEST 1) walks up to CHEN YANG with a wine glass.

FEMALE GUEST 1
Congratulations, Lawyer Chen Yang, on becoming the first certified lawyer of the Grand Xia Bar Association.

Another woman in a yellow dress (FEMALE GUEST 2) also approaches.

FEMALE GUEST 2
They say the Sun Cong case was your biggest victory yet. That's the one that made history.

CHEN YANG closes his book, stands up, and picks up a glass of wine from the table.

CHEN YANG
History has a way of repeating itself.

FEMALE GUEST 1
Let's hope not. To your future!

Everyone raises their glasses together, shouting "Cheers," and drinks in one gulp.

Suddenly, a sharp sound of shattering glass. The party music and noise come to an abrupt halt.

Everyone turns back in shock.

ZHAO HAI, a disheveled, grief-stricken middle-aged man in catering staff uniform, emerges from the service entrance. He wears two black-and-white memorial portraits pinned to his chest and carries a black garbage bag. He staggers forward, grabbing handfuls of white paper money from the bag and scattering it into the air.

ZHAO HAI stumbles toward CHEN YANG, his eyes filled with hatred.

ZHAO HAI kneels before CHEN YANG, placing the portraits on the ground.

CHEN YANG
(carefully)
Zhao Hai? This is a private event—

CHEN YANG
(recognizing the portraits)
Wait. Is that your daughter?

YE QINGYAN, a woman in a sequined jacket, and ZHANG XUAN, a man in a white suit, walk forward from the back of the crowd, looking smug.

YE QINGYAN
He came because you destroyed his family. And ours.

CHEN YANG
(shocked)
Qingyan, what are you—

YE QINGYAN
Don't. The investigators have everything.

ZHANG XUAN takes out a document with "Notice of Disbarment Proceedings" written on the cover.

ZHANG XUAN
continuation:
The 2 million from Sun Corporation. The altered evidence. Your license is suspended pending trial. It's over.

CHEN YANG takes the document, looking at it in disbelief.

CHEN YANG
This is fabricated! Zhao Hai, you must believe me—I fought for your daughter's case with everything I had!

YE QINGYAN
(quietly cruel)
You fought just hard enough to lose. Just like I designed.

FEMALE GUEST 1
Eighty-seven wins, one loss... and that loss destroyed the Zhao family.

FEMALE GUEST 2
Was any of it real?

CHEN YANG
(shouting at the crowd)
Check the sealed evidence! Sun's lawyers knew our strategy before trial!

GUESTS
(murmuring among themselves)
The transfer records are public...
He's been embezzling for months...
We should have seen the signs...

CHEN YANG turns to ZHANG XUAN and grabs his clothes.

CHEN YANG
You were inside our systems. You and—

Suddenly, ZHAO HAI rushes forward from behind and stabs a knife into CHEN YANG's abdomen.

CHEN YANG groans in pain as blood spreads across his white shirt.

The party erupts into chaos with screams everywhere.

GUESTS
(terrified)
Someone call 911! Now!

CHEN YANG falls to the ground, clutching his wound. ZHAO HAI stands nearby, first laughing maniacally, then crying bitterly.

ZHAO HAI
(laughing and crying)
She's gone... they're all gone... and you helped him walk free...

CHEN YANG lies on the ground, looking weakly at YE QINGYAN and ZHANG XUAN.

CHEN YANG
Why... husband and partner... why...

YE QINGYAN
(leaning close, whispering)
I took the money. I gave Zhang Xuan access to your files. In ten years, when you're nothing but a memory... we'll control everything you built.

ZHANG XUAN
(smirking)
Justice, Chen. Sometimes it's just another service we provide.

CHEN YANG lies motionless. The sequined jacket sparkles as YE QINGYAN turns away.

title: These Stars Are Not Last Night's Stars (Episode 77)
description: A woman confronts her jealous friend who pushes her into traffic, revealing years of resentment over adoption and fortune.
context:
Title: These Stars Are Not Last Night's Stars (Episode 77)
Description: A woman confronts her jealous friend who pushes her into traffic, revealing years of resentment over adoption and fortune.

INT. ALLEY - NIGHT

A car drives up, its headlights blinding.

SHEN XINGCHEN and JIANG YE stand together. SHEN XINGCHEN looks terrified.

SHEN XINGCHEN
Watch out!

JIANG YE forcefully pushes SHEN XINGCHEN toward the car. SHEN XINGCHEN is hit onto the hood, then falls to the ground. Her phone drops beside her. She looks very weak.

JIANG YE crosses her arms, looking down at SHEN XINGCHEN on the ground.

JIANG YE (V.O.)
Shen Xingchen, do you know how long I've watched you?

EXT. BUILDING EXTERIOR - DAY - FLASHBACK

ADOPTIVE FATHER crouches down to comfort YOUNG JIANG YE who is crying. YOUNG XINGCHEN sits alone on the steps.

ADOPTIVE FATHER
(to Jiang Ye, beaming)
What a good girl.

ADOPTIVE MOTHER walks over, her gaze fixed on Young Xingchen.

ADOPTIVE MOTHER
(gently)
That little girl... she's so quiet. Maybe she needs us more?

ADOPTIVE MOTHER points to YOUNG XINGCHEN. ADOPTIVE FATHER looks at YOUNG XINGCHEN, then smiles in agreement.

ADOPTIVE FATHER
Child, would you like to come home with us?

ADOPTIVE MOTHER smiles and extends her hand to YOUNG XINGCHEN.

ADOPTIVE MOTHER
Come on.

YOUNG XINGCHEN stands up, takes ADOPTIVE MOTHER's hand, and the three leave together. YOUNG JIANG YE watches their backs, her small hands clenching into fists.
continuation:
INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT

JIANG YE and SHEN XINGCHEN sit at a dining table. JIANG YE is pouring wine.

SHEN XINGCHEN
Jiang Ye, I don't drink.

JIANG YE
(with a sharp laugh)
You never could handle your liquor. Some things don't change, even when lives do.

SHEN XINGCHEN
What do you mean?

JIANG YE (V.O.)
She doesn't even see it. The life that should have been mine.

JIANG YE
Feng Xiao called me. About the engagement.

SHEN XINGCHEN
We haven't seen each other in over twenty years. I don't even know what he looks like now.

JIANG YE takes a sip of wine, her knuckles white on the glass.

JIANG YE
How convenient. Some people get everything... without even trying.

INT. ALLEY - NIGHT

Back to reality, JIANG YE's face is twisted with jealousy, but her hand trembles slightly.

JIANG YE (V.O.)
They say imitation is flattery. But you... you were always the original.

SHEN XINGCHEN lies weakly on the ground. Her phone rings. She struggles to reach for it.

Just as she's about to touch the phone, JIANG YE steps on it, crushing the screen. Her heel grinds down slowly.

SHEN XINGCHEN looks at her in pain.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

context:
Title: Step by Step to the Heart
Description: Sheng Xia, kidnapped as a child, finally reunites with her parents only to lose them in a tragic accident moments later.

INT. STREET - DAY

The camera is blurred, focusing on a street.

SHENG XIA (V.O.)
My name is Sheng Xia.

SHENG XIA walks on the street, her expression grave. Text appears on screen: Sheng Xia, Heiress of Sheng Group.

SHENG XIA (V.O.)
Over twenty years ago, I was kidnapped by human traffickers. Today, I finally found them.

EXT. PARK LAWN - DAY (FLASHBACK)

On a sunny lawn, young SHENG XIA in a school uniform crouches on the ground playing.

A white puppy runs over.

YOUNG SHENG XIA
Wow, the puppy is so cute.

The TRAFFICKER crouches beside young SHENG XIA, offering a treat.

TRAFFICKER
Want to see more like him? My house is full of them.

YOUNG SHENG XIA
Really?

TRAFFICKER
Just through those trees. Come on.

The TRAFFICKER extends her hand, takes young SHENG XIA's, and leads her away.

EXT. STREET - DAY

SHENG XIA looks across the street toward a café where FATHER SHENG and MOTHER SHENG wait anxiously, a document folder on their table. Text appears on screen: Father Sheng, Mother Sheng.

SHENG XIA
Mom...
continuation:
EXT. PARK LAWN - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Young SHENG XIA and her parents are having a picnic on the lawn. She holds a pinwheel.

YOUNG SHENG XIA

SHENG XIA (breaking down)
Mom... no... I just got you back...

SHENG XIA (struggling)
Let me go! Let go! Let go!

title: The Broken Her
description: A young student is terrorized by a powerful young master, leading to a tragic fall, while her mother witnesses the horror unfold.
context:
Title: The Broken Her
Description: A young student is terrorized by a powerful young master, leading to a tragic fall, while her mother witnesses the horror unfold.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

HAN SANSHAO wears a black tank top and studded pants, his back to the camera as he cleans his bloodied knuckles. He turns, his smile empty.

ON SCREEN: HAN is HAN SANSHAO, Third Young Master Han

HAN SANSHAO slowly walks forward and crouches down.

HAN SANSHAO
Let's try that again.

YE TANGTANG, wearing a school uniform, scrambles up from the sofa in terror and retreats toward the window.

YE TANGTANG
One more step and I'm gone.

YE TANGTANG opens the window. Her temple is bruised, her lip split, her eyes hold a final decision.

HAN SANSHAO
(chuckling)

YE TANGTANG
(terrified)
Stay back!

HAN SANSHAO
Han Corporation owns this building. I own you.

HAN SANSHAO walks to the window, looking down at YE TANGTANG.

HAN SANSHAO
Then jump. Need instructions? Jump. Jump! Jump!

HAN SANSHAO
(shouting)
JUMP!

YE TANGTANG falls from the window.
continuation:
EXT. BUILDING ENTRANCE - DAY

YE TANGTANG lies on the concrete ground, covered in blood, dead.

Her mother, YE XIANGYUN, stands in the parking lot not far away, having witnessed everything, her expression shocked and anguished.

ON SCREEN: YE TANGTANG, daughter of YE XIANGYUN

YE XIANGYUN
(silent scream)
Tangtang!

ON SCREEN: YE XIANGYUN

Time reversal effects and sound.

ON SCREEN: 2 HOURS EARLIER

EXT. STREET - DAY

HAN SANSHAO wears a studded leather jacket and sunglasses, getting out of a luxury car, followed by a group of men in black suits.

YE TANGTANG, in her school uniform, stands by the roadside holding a few small oranges.

HAN SANSHAO swaggers down the street with his men, walking toward the fruit stand where YE TANGTANG is.

HAN SANSHAO
Give me your number. Now.

He reaches for the oranges in YE TANGTANG's hands. YE XIANGYUN, who runs the fruit stand, immediately rushes over to protect her daughter.

YE XIANGYUN
Young man, what would you like to eat? We have barbecue here, and oranges, all quite sweet. Try one.

YE XIANGYUN picks up an orange and offers it to HAN SANSHAO.

HAN SANSHAO knocks over the basket full of oranges.

HAN SANSHAO
Eat what?! You're not even good enough to look at.

YE XIANGYUN shields her daughter behind her.

YE XIANGYUN
Why are you doing this?

The frame freezes on the terrified faces of YE XIANGYUN and YE TANGTANG.

title: Mother's Rebirth
description: A woman trapped in an abusive marriage endures violence while protecting her son, clinging to memories of better times. A moment of trauma becomes the catalyst for her resolve to break free.
context:
Title: Mother's Rebirth
Description: A woman trapped in an abusive marriage endures violence while protecting her son, clinging to memories of better times. A moment of trauma becomes the catalyst for her resolve to break free.

FADE IN:

EXT. DILAPIDATED FARMHOUSE COURTYARD - DAY

The gate swings open with a rusty groan. LIU JUN, 40s, stumbles through, reeking of cheap baijiu.

INT. DIM ROOM - DAY

ZENG PENG, 30s, sits with AN'AN (8) on the bed's edge. Her body tenses.

AN'AN
Dad's back.

ZENG PENG
(quiet but firm)
An'an, you must hide now. No matter what sounds you hear, don't come out. Promise me.

AN'AN
Mom, why do you lock me away every time? I don't want to be alone.

ZENG PENG
(gently)
Because Dad's not himself when he drinks. It's just for a little while. Mom will be right here, okay? Come on.

She leads him to a storage room, kisses his forehead, then locks the door.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

ZENG PENG steps out, positioning herself between the house and LIU JUN.

LIU JUN
(slurred, seething)
Another night at the tables. Down two months' wages. Your fault, you know that?

ZENG PENG
(quietly)
An'an just fell asleep. Please keep your voice down.

LIU JUN
(shoving her)
My house! My son! Don't tell me what to do!

ZENG PENG
(stumbling back)
I just want peace for one night.

LIU JUN
Peace? You think you deserve peace?

He grabs her wrist, twists. She winces but doesn't cry out.

LIU JUN
(LOWERED VOICE)
Thirty thousand yuan. That's what your brother took. You're my investment.

He forces her against the wall, his weight pressing down.

LIU JUN
(hot breath on her neck)
You don't get peace until I get my money's worth.

ZENG PENG
(strangled whisper)
An'an... will hear...

LIU JUN
Good. Let him learn what women are for.

He assaults her. ZENG PENG's eyes squeeze shut.
continuation:
INT. DIM ROOM - FLASHBACK

Warm lamplight. ZENG PENG's hands stitch shoe soles, steady and sure.

AN'AN (O.S.)
Mom, what are you making?

ZENG PENG
(gently)
Shoes for you. Strong ones, for running far away.

AN'AN (O.S.)
Can we run together?

ZENG PENG
One day, my love. One day.

She touches the shoes like a talisman.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY - PRESENT

BACK TO SCENE. LIU JUN finishes, breathing heavily. ZENG PENG slides to the ground, trembling.

LIU JUN
(zipping up)
Don't look at me like that. You got off easy.

He stumbles inside. ZENG PENG remains slumped against the wall.

Her hand finds a loose brick near the doorframe. Her fingers wrap around it. For a moment, she just holds it.

Then, slowly, she pulls herself up. Her knuckles whiten around the brick.

Through the window, we see AN'AN'S small face pressed against the storage room's crack. His eyes meet hers.

Something in ZENG PENG'S face changes. The trembling stops. Her jaw sets.

She tucks the brick into her pocket, her movements deliberate. She wipes her tears with the back of her hand.

ZENG PENG
(whispered to herself)
Not one more day.

She turns toward the house, her shadow long and straight across the courtyard.

FADE OUT.

title: A Mother's Hope & The Moon's Return
description: A mother honors a life debt by adopting an orphan boy, but tragedy strikes on Mid-Autumn Festival. Twenty years later, the lost son returns as a successful businessman.
context:
Title: A Mother's Hope & The Moon's Return
Description: A mother honors a life debt by adopting an orphan boy, but tragedy strikes on Mid-Autumn Festival. Twenty years later, the lost son returns as a successful businessman.

INT. YANG XIUE'S HOUSE - NIGHT

A bright full moon fills the window.

YANG XIUE carries mooncakes to the table where LI JIANG, LI HE, and GU HENG sit.

YANG XIUE places the mooncakes on the table.

YANG XIUE
Today is Mid-Autumn Festival. Mother has something for each of you.

YANG XIUE takes out three jade pendants on red cords.

YANG XIUE
Eldest.

YANG XIUE hands the first pendant to LI JIANG.

YANG XIUE
(to LI HE)
Second.

YANG XIUE
(to GU HENG)
Heng Heng.

She fastens the third pendant around the boy's neck.

YANG XIUE
These mean you are brothers. Blood or not.

YANG XIUE looks at LI JIANG and LI HE.

YANG XIUE
He has lost everything. You will not let him lose this family. Swear it.

LI JIANG and LI HE nod slowly.

YANG XIUE
Eat.

She divides a mooncake into three pieces. LI JIANG and LI HE stare at GU HENG, knuckles white.
continuation:
EXT. VILLAGE ROAD - NIGHT

AUNT WANG runs toward YANG XIUE, barefoot and panicked.

AUNT WANG
Yang Xiue! The boys—by the river—Heng Heng fell in!

EXT. RIVERSIDE - DAY

FLASHBACK - One year ago

Rain pours. YANG XIUE kneels by SISTER HAN's body on the riverbank. Little GU HENG weeps beside her.

YANG XIUE
Sister Han!

VILLAGER A (V.O.)
She died pulling your boys from the flood.

VILLAGER B (V.O.)
The debt can never be repaid.

VILLAGER C (V.O.)
Only the boy remains. Six years old. Alone.

YANG XIUE looks at GU HENG, tears streaming down her face.

YANG XIUE takes the jade pendant from Sister Han's hand.

YANG XIUE
(softly)
You are my son now.

END FLASHBACK

EXT. RIVERSIDE - NIGHT

YANG XIUE runs to the riverbank. Villagers hold torches. Her sons kneel in mud, soaked and crying.

YANG XIUE
Where is my son?

LI JIANG
Mom, the current—it took him—

LI HE
We tried, we couldn't hold on!

YANG XIUE sees GU HENG's small shoe in the reeds. She collapses.

YANG XIUE
Heng Heng! Sister Han, forgive me!

She beats the earth, her pendant cracking against stone.

LI JIANG and LI HE crawl to her.

LI HE
Mom, punish us!

LI JIANG
Beat us!

YANG XIUE
(embracing them)
Find him. Search every river, every village, every city until he's home. Swear on your blood.

LI JIANG/LI HE
(in unison)
We swear!

EXT. OUTSIDE COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

ON SCREEN: Twenty Years Later

Three black sedans stop before a glass tower. BODYGUARDS open doors. GU HENG steps out, sharp suit, gold glasses, his jaw tight with old loss.

INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

GU HENG walks through the marble lobby with BODYGUARDS. Employees bow deeply.

EMPLOYEES
Good day, President Gu!

An ASSISTANT hurries over.

ASSISTANT
President Gu, the Lijia Village demolition. One holdout—a widow named Yang.

GU HENG
(thoughtfully)
Lijia Village... I haven't returned in twenty years.

GU HENG
Arrange it. I'm going personally.

ASSISTANT
Yes, President Gu.

GU HENG turns away, touching the jade pendant beneath his shirt.

title: Countdown of a Mother's Love
description: A terminally ill mother applies for euthanasia after her son publicly denounces her, choosing to leave him her savings instead of continuing treatment.
context:
Title: Countdown of a Mother's Love
Description: A terminally ill mother applies for euthanasia after her son publicly denounces her, choosing to leave him her savings instead of continuing treatment.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

Close-up shot of an "Euthanasia Application Form" written in calligraphy.

DOCTOR (O.S.)
Ms. Lu, are you certain you want to discontinue treatment for your glioblastoma and receive a euthanasia injection?

LU XINYA, a middle-aged woman in her fifties, sits across from the doctor, her expression calm but slightly weary.

LU XINYA
The tumor has spread to my spine. I've already spent his college fund. Better he keeps the apartment.

LU XINYA picks up a pen and signs her name on the application form.

DOCTOR
Your son should sign the witness statement. He turns eighteen next month.

LU XINYA
That's why I'm doing this now.

LU XINYA (V.O.)
Five days from now, after Xiaojie finishes his college entrance exam, he can finally stop pretending he needs me.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR/WAITING AREA - DAY

LU XINYA walks alone through the hospital corridor, looking dejected. She stops at a waiting area with a television mounted on the wall.

The TV screen is broadcasting a news interview. Her son SUN JIE, a high school student in uniform, is being interviewed by a reporter. The news headline reads "Senior Student Sun Jie Ranks First in the City Three Times in Mock Exams."

REPORTER (V.O.)
Sun Jie, at this moment, is there anything you'd like to say to the loved ones who have supported you?

title: Motherless Love
description: A mother sacrifices everything, including her own kidney and dignity, to save her son's life and send him to university.
context:
Title: Motherless Love
Description: A mother sacrifices everything, including her own kidney and dignity, to save her son's life and send him to university.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Tense music.

A DOCTOR and NURSES push a hospital bed carrying WANG BIN rapidly forward. WANG CUIFEN follows anxiously beside them.

DOCTOR
Acute renal failure. We need to get him to surgery now.

WANG CUIFEN tries to follow into the operating room but is stopped by the DOCTOR.

DOCTOR
You can't go in. Wait here.

WANG CUIFEN grips the DOCTOR's arm, her voice trembling.

WANG CUIFEN
Doctor, please. Wang Bin just got into university. He's... he's everything.

DOCTOR
(gently removing her hand)
His kidney function is critically compromised. He'll likely need a transplant. But we don't have a donor match available.

WANG CUIFEN
I've already been tested. My kidney is compatible. Please.

DOCTOR
You're not an ideal candidate. The surgery carries significant risk for someone your age.

WANG CUIFEN
(quietly intense)
He's my son. I'll sign whatever you need.

The DOCTOR studies her face, sees her resolve, then nods once.

DOCTOR
Wait here. We'll do everything we can.

WANG CUIFEN watches them disappear through the doors, pressing a trembling hand to her mouth.

TRANSITION: Two months later, Xiushui Village
continuation:
EXT. XIUSHUI VILLAGE - DAY

WANG CUIFEN carries a cloth bundle, moving with determination despite her slower gait.

WANG CUIFEN (V.O.)
Two eggs a day. That's what the doctor said I could spare. Fifty eggs should be worth something.

WANG CUIFEN stops at a modest house and knocks.

WANG CUIFEN
Uncle Wang? It's Cuifen.

WANG CHENG opens the door, sees her, and his expression softens with pity.

WANG CHENG
Cuifen. I heard about the surgery. How's the boy?

WANG CUIFEN
Recovering well. But... the medical bills took everything. And now there's tuition.

She unwraps the bundle to reveal carefully packed eggs.

WANG CUIFEN
(quietly)
I know these won't cover it. But if you could lend me the rest, I'll work it off. I can clean, cook, work the fields...

WANG CHENG
(sighs heavily)
I just had to pay for my wife's treatment. We're stretched thin.

He disappears inside. WANG CUIFEN stands frozen, not breathing. He returns with an envelope.

WANG CHENG
It's not much. Three thousand. But it's yours.

WANG CUIFEN tries to refuse, but he presses it into her hand.

WANG CUIFEN
I'll repay every cent. I swear it.

WANG CHENG
Just get that boy educated. That's repayment enough.

He closes the door gently. WANG CUIFEN stands there, clutching the envelope and eggs, tears streaming down her face.

TRANSITION: A few days later

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

WANG BIN, now healthier, adjusts his backpack. WANG CUIFEN touches his sleeve nervously. VILLAGERS watch from a distance.

WANG CUIFEN
Call me when you arrive. And don't skip meals. I sent some dried mushrooms with your things.

WANG BIN
Mom, you need to rest more. The doctor said—

WANG CUIFEN
(interrupting)
—I'm fine. You just focus on your studies.

The VILLAGE CHIEF approaches, holding a small red envelope.

VILLAGE CHIEF
Wang Bin. The village collected this. For your books.

WANG BIN
Chief, I can't—

VILLAGE CHIEF
You can. Your mother carried water for eight families last week while her incision was still healing. We know what this cost.

WANG BIN stares at his mother, understanding finally hitting him fully. He takes the envelope with trembling hands.

WANG BIN
(whispering)
Mom... your kidney. The doctor told me you insisted. You didn't tell me about the pain, the work...

WANG CUIFEN
You needed to focus on getting well.

WANG BIN drops to his knees, not in performance, but as if his legs can no longer hold him.

WANG BIN
I thought I understood. I didn't.

WANG CUIFEN pulls him up, fierce and tender.

WANG CUIFEN
You understand now. That's enough.

The BUS DRIVER leans out.

DRIVER
Last call!

WANG BIN boards, looking back. WANG CUIFEN waves once, strong and steady. As the bus pulls away, she finally lets her hand drop, her shoulders sagging with exhaustion and relief.

title: Everlasting Love
description: A mother's desperate search for her kidnapped daughter leads to a fateful reunion five years later at an orphanage, but a switched locket creates a tragic case of mistaken identity.
context:
Title: Everlasting Love
Description: A mother's desperate search for her kidnapped daughter leads to a fateful reunion five years later at an orphanage, but a switched locket creates a tragic case of mistaken identity.

INT. MARKET - DAY

LIN FENGYI (30s) holds daughter HE CHAOCHAO (5) close, both in matching pink dresses. A bustling Chinese market surrounds them.

A distant children's choir sings "Only Mother is Good in the World."

Lin sets Chaochao down by a clothing stall.

LIN FENGYI
Baby, wait here for Mommy. I'll buy you a new dress.

HE CHAOCHAO
(nodding)
Okay.

Lin walks to the vendor three steps away.

LIN FENGYI
Boss, let me see this dress.

Chaochao waits, clutching a rabbit plushie. A MAN in a baseball cap approaches.

HUMAN TRAFFICKER
(crouching, offering candy)
Little girl, want some candy?

Chaochao steps back. The man lunges—hand over her mouth—snatching her away. The rabbit falls. Muffled cries vanish into the crowd.

Lin turns, dress in hand, beaming.

LIN FENGYI
Chaochao, look—

Her smile freezes. The space is empty. Only the rabbit remains.

LIN FENGYI
(frantically)
Chaochao? Chaochao!

She drops the dress, running through the market.

LIN FENGYI
Chaochao!

She grabs a PASSING GIRL.

LIN FENGYI
Have you seen a little girl with a longevity lock?

The girl shakes her head.

Lin grabs an ELDERLY WOMAN.

LIN FENGYI
Please—a girl in pink, with a pink longevity lock?

The woman shrugs helplessly.

Lin grabs a YOUNG MAN.

LIN FENGYI
Sir, my daughter—

He pushes her away. She falls, clutching the rabbit. The crowd flows past, indifferent.

LIN FENGYI
(heartbroken)
Chaochao! He Chaochao!

The screen fades to black.

ON SCREEN: FIVE YEARS LATER
continuation:
EXT. ORPHANAGE COURTYARD - DAY

HE CHAOCHAO (10) and XIAO XUE (10) draw at a table. Chaochao's gold longevity lock glints.

XIAO XUE
Chaochao, it's so beautiful.

HE CHAOCHAO
(touching the lock)
My mother gave it when I was sick. For good health.

XIAO XUE
(lowering her head)
But now neither of us has a mother.

HE CHAOCHAO
(comforting)
Don't be sad. I'll let you wear it.

She removes the lock, placing it on Xiao Xue.

HE CHAOCHAO
Your mother will come. When I find mine, I'll take you home.

XIAO XUE
(tearful)
Really?

HE CHAOCHAO
(firmly)
Pinky promise. Whoever lies is a puppy.

XIAO XUE
Best friends forever?

HE CHAOCHAO
Sisters forever.

They link pinkies, smiling.

EXT. ORPHANAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

A black sedan screeches to a halt. BODYGUARDS emerge, opening the door.

LIN FENGYI steps out in a sharp white suit, expression urgent. The DIRECTOR waits with a file.

DIRECTOR
Mrs. He, this is the child you're looking for.

She points to the courtyard. Lin's gaze sweeps over—and fixes on XIAO XUE wearing the lock.

Lin's eyes widen. The file drops. Five years collapse into this moment.

LIN FENGYI
(whispered)
Chaochao...

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Fish Longs for the Abyss & Baby's Assist: Daddy is Super Sweet
description: A woman gives birth after a passionate night with a powerful CEO, only to be reunited with him six years later when he searches for the mother of his child.
context:
Title: The Fish Longs for the Abyss & Baby's Assist: Daddy is Super Sweet
Description: A woman gives birth after a passionate night with a powerful CEO, only to be reunited with him six years later when he searches for the mother of his child.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

GU YUAN stumbles from the bathroom, collar open, fighting for composure. CHI YU stands near the door, clutching a room service tray.

GU YUAN
(voice rough)
Someone drugged the wine. Please. Just stay.

Chi Yu sets the tray down, wary. Her cracked JADE PENDANT catches the light.

GU YUAN
I've seen that before.

He focuses on the pendant, recognition cutting through his haze. He steadies himself against the wall.

INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - NIGHT

Exterior of the hospital building.

CHI YU grips the delivery bed rails, drenched in sweat, her eyes fierce.

DOCTOR
Bleeding's not slowing. Push now, Chi Yu.

NURSE
You're almost there. One more.

Chi Yu bears down with a guttural cry. A baby's WAIL fills the room.

NURSE
(holding the newborn)
It's a boy. And look at this...

The NURSE traces a STAR-SHAPED BIRTHMARK on his shoulder.

NURSE
Unique mark.

CHI YU weakly reaches for the infant, but her hand falls limp as she loses consciousness.

Fade to black.

ON SCREEN: SIX YEARS LATER
continuation:
EXT. GU CORPORATION BUILDING - DAY

A black SUV convoy arrives. BODYGUARDS stand in formation.

ASSISTANT LI exits the vehicle and opens the rear door. GU YUAN steps out, holding the hand of GU XINGXING.

BODYGUARDS
(in unison)
Good day, President Gu!

ASSISTANT LI
We found her. At a clinic. Using a different name.

GU YUAN looks at Xingxing's pendant - a match to Chi Yu's.

GU YUAN
(to Xingxing)
Ready to meet her?

Xingxing nods, clutching the pendant. Gu Yuan picks him up.

GU YUAN
(to Assistant Li)
Set up the meeting. No guards.

ASSISTANT LI
Yes, sir.

GU YUAN holds his son, expression determined.

title: Lost in Your Gentle Eyes
description: A woman sacrifices everything for her actor husband's career, only to face his coldness and betrayal after he becomes successful.
context:
Title: Lost in Your Gentle Eyes
Description: A woman sacrifices everything for her actor husband's career, only to face his coldness and betrayal after he becomes successful.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

GUO ROU sits on the sofa, hand pressed to her abdomen. Her phone shows Gu Yu's Weibo - Best Actor photos, fans asking about his "mystery muse."

GUO ROU (V.O.)
I was Guo Rou, VP of Starlight Entertainment. Gu Yu was a contract actor. I traded my shares for his spotlight. Now I'm trading my life for his freedom.

MONTAGE - FLASHBACK

INT. KTV - NIGHT

GUO ROU in a power suit, the only woman in a smoke-filled VIP room.

GUO ROU
(to MR. WANG)
Mr. Wang, Gu Yu's last series hit 2.3 billion views. This next one? Three-episode guarantee.

She drains her tumbler.

GUO ROU turns to a PRODUCER, pouring steadily.

GUO ROU
Director Chen wants to recast? Gu Yu's data guarantees 200M opening.

ANGLE ON: In the mirror, GUO ROU's reflection doubles over for a heartbeat.

She turns to SISTER ZHANG, BROTHER LI, BROTHER ZHAO:

GUO ROU
Sister Zhang. Brother Li. Brother Zhao. Your investments made him. Let me show you his real worth. I'll drink it all, you drink as you please.

EVERYONE
Good, good, good.

She empties her glass. They cheer.

END MONTAGE
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Back to reality. GUO ROU still sits on the sofa. She drops the phone.

GUO ROU (V.O.)
He won Best Actor. I became invisible. The jasmine perfume wasn't mine.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

GUO ROU in pajamas, working at the kitchen island. The door opens.

GU YU enters, drops his keys.

GUO ROU
Reshoots?

GU YU
Yeah.

He shrugs off his coat. She catches it. Her fingers brush his collar - stage makeup and jasmine.

GUO ROU
(softly)
This isn't makeup.

GU YU
(looking away)
Don't start.

He leaves. The jasmine lingers.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

title: The Fall
description: A young woman with photosensitive eyes is forced by her adoptive family to marry into the wealthy Han family, only to discover a shocking truth a year later.
context:
Title: The Fall
Description: A young woman with photosensitive eyes is forced by her adoptive family to marry into the wealthy Han family, only to discover a shocking truth a year later.

INT. RECEPTION ROOM - DAY

Butler HAN and XIA TIAN sit facing each other. XIA TIAN wears sunglasses.

BUTLER HAN
Miss Xia, your eyes... certain duties require precision work.

XIA TIAN
Only sunlight affects me. Indoors, I see perfectly.

BUTLER HAN
The Han family pays generously. Many candidates have fewer... complications.

XIA TIAN
I don't want generosity. I want to earn it.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

FLASHBACK BEGINS:

XIA TIAN's GRANDMOTHER lies in bed, oxygen monitor beeping. XIA TIAN stands by the bed. Her adoptive parents, XIA FATHER and XIA MOTHER, and her sister XIA MENG sit nearby.

XIA MOTHER
The Han family has approved your medical profile. The contract is ready. Tomorrow, you sign.

XIA TIAN
You promised I'd finish my degree. That I could choose--

XIA FATHER
(interrupting, weary)
The company is bleeding, Tian. This isn't about choice. It's about survival. Your grandmother's. Ours.

XIA MENG
(adjusting her makeup)
Old Master Han needs a companion in his final years. Your condition makes you... suitable. Don't act like you have options.

XIA TIAN looks at GRANDMOTHER, then at the medical bills on the nightstand. Her jaw tightens.

XIA TIAN
I'll sign. But I won't be their puppet. After the ceremony, I'm on my own.

FLASHBACK ENDS.
continuation:
EXT. CIVIL AFFAIRS BUREAU ENTRANCE - DAY

XIA TIAN holds a marriage certificate, squinting at it in harsh light. HAN YUCHENG exits behind her, on his phone.

HAN YUCHENG
(into phone)
France is confirmed. A year, maybe more. Keep the marriage out of the press. No one needs to know.

He glances at XIA TIAN briefly, then walks away.

XIA TIAN (V.O.)
The lawyer said "Han family heir." Not "elder." But he was gone before I could even see his face. A year abroad. Perfect.

She tucks the certificate in her bag.

XIA TIAN (V.O.)
Three hundred million for Grandmother's care. I won't touch a cent of it. I'll earn my own way.

INT. RECEPTION ROOM - DAY

Back to the interview scene.

BUTLER HAN
The previous girl lasted three days. The villa's lighting system is... particular.

XIA TIAN
(removing her sunglasses)
I adapt. Always have.

Her pale eyes are steady. Butler Han studies her, then nods.

BUTLER HAN
Six a.m. Don't be late.

INT. HAN FAMILY VILLA - DAY

MONTAGE:
- XIA TIAN ties her hair back, examining a maid's uniform. Her sunglasses sit on the counter.
- XIA TIAN kneels by an ornate fountain, adjusting a complex filtration system. She consults a manual.
- XIA TIAN reorganizes a wine cellar, her phone flashlight illuminating labels. She makes detailed notes.
- XIA TIAN helps another maid with a heavy vase, her movements precise and efficient.

INT. HAN FAMILY VILLA LIVING ROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: One Year Later

Several MAIDS adjust their uniforms anxiously. BUTLER HAN reviews a clipboard.

BUTLER HAN
Quiet now. President Han's return is unexpected. Standard protocol.

XIA TIAN lines up, her sunglasses replaced by subtle tinted contacts. She stands confidently.

HAN YUCHENG enters, scanning the room with sharp focus. The staff bows. He starts toward the stairs, then pauses.

His gaze lands on XIA TIAN. She meets his eyes directly, recognition flashing across her face. Her composure remains, but her eyes flash with cold realization.

HAN YUCHENG's expression shifts. He recognizes her.

BUTLER HAN
(whispering to Han Yucheng)
Our new head housemaid, sir. Exceptional. Quite indispensable.

HAN YUCHENG stares at XIA TIAN, who now holds her chin high, her jaw set.

HAN YUCHENG
(to Xia Tian)
Your name.

XIA TIAN
Xia Tian, sir.

A beat. The weight of the year hangs between them.

HAN YUCHENG
Interesting. My wife has the same name.

XIA TIAN
A coincidence, I'm sure.

She holds his gaze. He studies her, the truth clicking into place.

HAN YUCHENG
I doubt that.

FADE OUT.

title: Law Proves Me Innocent, Love Sentences Me to Death
description: A renowned gold-medal lawyer gives up her career to become a housewife for six years, only to discover during her live legal consultation stream that her husband considers their marriage a fraud.
context:
Title: Law Proves Me Innocent, Love Sentences Me to Death
Description: A renowned gold-medal lawyer gives up her career to become a housewife for six years, only to discover during her live legal consultation stream that her husband considers their marriage a fraud.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

LI YAOXUE lies awake in bed, staring at a wedding photo of her and GU SIPEI on the wall.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
I hereby announce that the first place winner of this year's Global Lawyer Gold Award goes to—Lawyer Li Yaoxue!

LI YAOXUE closes her eyes.

LI YAOXUE (V.O.)
Six years ago, I stood on that stage.

FLASHBACK:

LI YAOXUE, wearing a lawyer's robe, holds up a trophy at a grand awards ceremony. The audience applauds thunderously. She smiles brilliantly, full of pride and ambition.

END FLASHBACK.

LI YAOXUE (V.O.)
Now, I answer to a different call.

She touches the wedding photo, her expression bittersweet.

GU SIPEI enters, checking his watch.

GU SIPEI
You're still in bed.

LI YAOXUE
I was about to—

GU SIPEI
No need. Breakfast is ready.

LI YAOXUE
You didn't have to.

GU SIPEI
I married you for a reason, didn't I? Go eat before it gets cold.

He adjusts his tie, a practiced gesture.

GU SIPEI
I have an early meeting. Don't wait up.

He kisses her forehead—a brief, automatic gesture—then exits.

LI YAOXUE watches him leave, her smile fading slightly.

Her phone BUZZES. LI YAOXUE answers.

BEST FRIEND (O.S.)
Stream's at ten, right? You're cutting it close.

LI YAOXUE
I'll be ready.

BEST FRIEND (O.S.)
Six years, Yaoxue. You really think he'll be okay with this?

LI YAOXUE
He doesn't control everything.

BEST FRIEND (O.S.)
Just... be careful.

LI YAOXUE
I know what I'm doing.

She ends the call, a flicker of doubt crossing her face.
continuation:
INT. STUDY - DAY

LI YAOXUE sits at a desk, adjusting a microphone, phone propped before her. The livestream interface shows viewer counts climbing.

COMMENT
The legendary Lawyer Li is back!

COMMENT
Show yourself!

COMMENT
We want to see the famous gold-medal lawyer!

LI YAOXUE turns on the camera, composed.

LI YAOXUE
Good morning. This is Lawyer Li. For those joining the consultation, please follow the protocol. Active participants receive a token of appreciation.

She indicates a sleek jewelry box beside her—containing an elegant necklace.

LI YAOXUE
Let's begin. First caller?

She taps her screen.

LI YAOXUE
You're connected. Please describe your case.

GU SIPEI (O.S.)
Lawyer Li. I need to dissolve a fraudulent marriage. A woman deceived me—trapped me with false pretenses. I want to make her pay.

LI YAOXUE's breath catches. This voice—familiar yet cold, professional.

LI YAOXUE (thinking)
Isn't that... no. It can't be.

GU SIPEI (O.S.)
She pretended to be someone she wasn't. Wasted six years of my life. How do I ensure she leaves with nothing?

LI YAOXUE stares at the screen—audio only, caller ID hidden. Her knuckles whiten on the desk edge.

LI YAOXUE (V.O.)
Six years.

The stream chat EXPLODES with reactions.

FREEZE FRAME on LI YAOXUE's face—shock giving way to something harder. Determined.

TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Master Returns in Glory (Episode 35)
description: A renowned geneticist refuses lucrative offers abroad and returns to his homeland with a groundbreaking cancer treatment, determined to prove his country's worth to the world.
context:
Title: The Master Returns in Glory (Episode 35)
Description: A renowned geneticist refuses lucrative offers abroad and returns to his homeland with a groundbreaking cancer treatment, determined to prove his country's worth to the world.

INT. NEWS STUDIO - DAY

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Breaking news from Geneva—Professor Xia Zhongjie has cracked skin cancer's cellular code. A breakthrough for two billion patients worldwide.

EXT. COUNTRY A RESEARCH INSTITUTE - DAY

Reporters surge around XIA ZHONGJIE and his RESEARCH TEAM as they exit the institute, all in white lab coats.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Professor Xia, the director's called an emergency meeting—

XIA ZHONGJIE
(without looking back)
My flight's in four hours. They know my terms.

MORI blocks their path with two bodyguards.

MORI
Professor. Five million annually. Lab of your design. Full autonomy.

XIA ZHONGJIE
(continuing forward)
My homeland invested in me when no one else would.

MORI
(hastily correcting himself)
Fifteen million! This research is too important for Country A to lose!

EXT. INSTITUTE PLAZA - DAY

A swarm of reporters rushes forward, thrusting microphones at XIA ZHONGJIE.

REPORTER
Professor Xia, are you really taking this world-class research back to Xia Nation? Science has no borders. Won't it benefit humanity just the same?

ANOTHER REPORTER
That's right, Professor Xia. Xia Nation can't match our facilities. Why compromise the work?

XIA ZHONGJIE stops, looking at the reporters with a serious expression.

XIA ZHONGJIE
Science has no borders, but scientists carry roots. Fifteen years ago, Xia Nation sent one student abroad. Today, I return what I owe.

XIA ZHONGJIE finishes speaking and leaves, surrounded by his team. The reporters continue chasing after him.

REPORTER (O.S.)
Professor Xia, what is your next plan?

MORI and the bodyguards stand in place, watching XIA ZHONGJIE's departing figure.

MORI
(to the bodyguards)
If he reaches Xia soil, we've already lost.

XIA ZHONGJIE walks while speaking to the FEMALE ASSISTANT beside him.

XIA ZHONGJIE
Contact the domestic side. Arrange the refrigerated transport for tonight. I'll take the coastal road and draw their eyes away.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
They'll track your phone.

XIA ZHONGJIE
Then let them.

He slips off his lab coat, revealing a plain jacket, and merges into the crowd.
continuation:
INT. SU FAMILY OFFICE - DAY

SU QINGNING, a young woman in a red business suit, slams the desk.

SU QINGNING
The biopsy confirmed—it's in my lymph nodes. If I'm not in Professor Xia's trial...

Her fingers tremble at her silk scarf.

SU JIANGUO, a middle-aged man in a Zhongshan suit, sits in a chair.

SU JIANGUO
He's landing at Dehong Airport, then driving to the institute. A three-hour window.

SU QINGNING
And Gu Ming's mother saw the report. If I'm just the dying daughter of a mid-tier executive...

SU JIANGUO
You're not dying. And you're more than what they see.

SU QINGNING
I'll be at that terminal. I'll make him see me.

She grabs car keys. Turns to leave.

SU JIANGUO
(shouting after her)
Qingning! Your scarf—it's slipping!

EXT. XIA NATION HIGHWAY - DAY

SU QINGNING drives a silver convertible sports car while on the phone.

SU QINGNING
(impatiently)
Clear a landing slot at Dehong. I don't care whose jet is there. This is life or death.

Meanwhile, XIA ZHONGJIE, dressed simply in a blue jacket, drives an old sedan ahead of SU QINGNING. He wears earphones and is also on the phone.

XIA ZHONGJIE
(gently)
No, I'm not taking the company jet. Too conspicuous. Just an old professor on holiday.

SU QINGNING sees the old car ahead driving slowly, honks impatiently, then jerks the steering wheel, accelerates to overtake, and suddenly cuts in front of the car.

XIA ZHONGJIE brakes urgently. The two cars nearly collide.

SU QINGNING shows a shocked and angry expression in her car.

SU QINGNING
(mutters)
Out of my way.

Xia pulls over, breathing hard. His assistant's voice crackles from the dropped phone.

FEMALE ASSISTANT (V.O.)
Professor? Professor! Are you alright?

Xia watches the convertible disappear. He picks up the phone.

XIA ZHONGJIE
(quietly)
Fine. Just a spoiled child in a hurry.

He checks his rearview—a reporter's car appears in the distance.

XIA ZHONGJIE
Change of plans. Tell them I'll take the mountain pass instead.

He pulls back onto the road—away from the airport.

Meanwhile, XIA ZHONGJIE, dressed simply in a blue jacket, drives an old sedan ahead of SU QINGNING. He wears earphones and is also on the phone.

XIA ZHONGJIE
(gently)
No, I'm not taking the company jet. Too conspicuous. Just an old professor on holiday.

SU QINGNING sees the old car ahead driving slowly, honks impatiently, then jerks the steering wheel, accelerates to overtake, and suddenly cuts in front of the car.

XIA ZHONGJIE brakes urgently. The two cars nearly collide.

SU QINGNING shows a shocked and angry expression in her car.

SU QINGNING
(mutters)
Out of my way.

Xia pulls over, breathing hard. His assistant's voice crackles from the dropped phone.

FEMALE ASSISTANT (V.O.)
Professor? Professor! Are you alright?

Xia watches the convertible disappear. He picks up the phone.

XIA ZHONGJIE
(quietly)
Fine. Just a spoiled child in a hurry.

He checks his rearview—a reporter's car appears in the distance.

XIA ZHONGJIE
Change of plans. Tell them I'll take the mountain pass instead.

He pulls back onto the road—away from the airport.

title: The God of Bathing
description: The legendary God of Bathing mysteriously vanishes, replaced by the arrogant Bath King. Three years later, the retired master hides his identity in Mu Shen Palace.
context:
Title: The God of Bathing
Description: The legendary God of Bathing mysteriously vanishes, replaced by the arrogant Bath King. Three years later, the retired master hides his identity in Mu Shen Palace.

INT. MYSTERIOUS SPACE - DAY

NARRATOR (V.O.)
In Great Xia, legend spoke of hands that could realign the flow of heaven itself. The God of Bathing. Then he vanished.

EXT. AWARDS CEREMONY VENUE - DAY

FANS hold banners, their chant rhythmic and desperate.

FANS
Bath God! Bath God! Bath God! Bath God!

FEMALE REPORTER holds a microphone, camera rolling.

FEMALE REPORTER
Zhou Lin claims his fifth consecutive Global Tour Championship, but the absence they feel is louder than any trophy.

ZHOU LIN holds the championship trophy, his smile hollow. LIU WANCHUN, temporary representative, and WANG DONGLAI, president, present the honor with trembling hands.

FEMALE REPORTER
This moment was meant to honor a god. Instead, we watch a throne stand empty.

A black sedan stops at the entrance. The crowd surges.

FANS
Bath God! Bath God!

LIU CHUNLAI rushes to the car door, plaque in hand, bowing.

LIU CHUNLAI
The God of Bathing's carriage—I've been honored to—

The door opens. BATH KING steps out, golden serpent-head cane striking the ground. Both LIU CHUNLAI and WANG DONGLAI stare.

LIU CHUNLAI
The Serpent Seal... who are you?

BATH KING
The one who holds the Seal.

WANG DONGLAI
Where is the Bath God?

BATH KING
Retired.

He removes his mask. It hits the ground, cracks.

BATH KING
The God of Bathing is no more. I am the Bath King. Kneel.

WANG DONGLAI
The Council... they wouldn't—

FEMALE REPORTER
(into mic, urgent)
Breaking: The Bath King appears with the Serpent Seal, claiming legitimate succession. But where is the transition order?

Newspaper headlines flash by: "BATH KING USURPS THRONE" / "GOD OF BATHING: RETIRED OR DEPOSED?" / "COUNCIL SILENT"

FEMALE REPORTER (V.O.)
Three years later, one question remains: where is the true God of Bathing?
continuation:
INT. MU SHEN PALACE - DAY

Three years later.

A faded "God of Bathing" poster. MISS MU studies an ancient text, green medicinal soup steaming.

MISS MU
Three qian cassia seed, one qian Paris root... green again. The Phoenix Nirvana requires gold to unlock the meridians. What am I missing?

The MYSTERIOUS MAN (ZHOU LIN) stands nearby, his scarred hands folded.

MYSTERIOUS MAN
The Paris root's cold properties need two harmonizers. Not in the recipe. In the timing.

XIAO WAN looks at him with disdain.

XIAO WAN
The young miss recreates a lost art. You scrub floors.

XIAO ZHOU
Wan'er—he means no harm.

XIAO WAN
If the God of Bathing walked through that door, he couldn't fix what generations lost. Some things stay buried.

MISS MU
That's enough. Xiao Zhou, stoke the fire.

A SERVANT rushes in.

SERVANT
Young Miss! The Zhang family demands we close—calls your methods fraud!

MISS MU
(turning, voice like steel)
Let them watch me—

Her sleeve catches the cauldron. It tilts. The MYSTERIOUS MAN moves, his scarred palm steadying it. As he does, two ingredients slip from his fingers into the soup.

The green broth shudders. Then, like sunrise, it turns gold.

MISS MU
(frozen)
That transformation... only the original master could—

She turns. He's already retreating to his corner, his hands trembling from the effort.

SERVANT
Miss! The Zhang family—!

MISS MU
(still staring at the golden soup)
Tell them the God of Bathing's art isn't dead. It waits.

She looks from the cauldron to the trembling hands in the shadows.

FADE OUT.

title: New Year's Eve
description: A mother faces her daughter's medical crisis while her husband prioritizes another woman, leading to a life-changing decision.
context:
Title: New Year's Eve
Description: A mother faces her daughter's medical crisis while her husband prioritizes another woman, leading to a life-changing decision.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

The ward is dimly lit, with the city's night view visible through the window. WEN QINGYU stands by the window on the phone, looking exhausted. On the bed, her daughter YAYA wears an oxygen mask, sleeping quietly. A monitor beside her emits regular beeping sounds.

WEN QINGYU
(on the phone)
The Berlin fellowship... is there any flexibility on the deadline?

TEACHER (V.O.)
They must charter the medical flight tonight, Qingyu. You have one hour to decide.

WEN QINGYU
I understand.

She hangs up and looks at her daughter with concern. The monitor's oxygen saturation drops to 78%. A piercing alarm sounds.

WEN QINGYU turns in horror and rushes to the bed.

WEN QINGYU
(panicking)
Yaya! Nurse! Someone!

WEN QINGYU squeezes her daughter's hand, her voice cracking.

WEN QINGYU
(crying out)
Don't do this, baby. Please don't do this!

Several DOCTORS and NURSES rush into the ward.

DOCTOR
(urgently)
Bag her! Get RT down here now!

Medical staff urgently resuscitate YAYA. WEN QINGYU is pushed aside. She anxiously takes out her phone and dials, but no one answers.

A NURSE prepares a syringe. The DOCTOR coordinates the resuscitation.

After resuscitation, the monitor shows oxygen levels stabilizing at 86%.

WEN QINGYU dials again, her voice trembling.

WEN QINGYU
Dongxu... Yaya stopped breathing. They had to—

XU YAO (V.O.)
Senior, the car's downstairs.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

SONG DONGXU is getting dressed, looking impatient.

SONG DONGXU
(on the phone)
I'm in client meetings all night, Wen. This is the Tokyo account.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

The monitor alarms again. YAYA's hand goes limp in Wen's.

WEN QINGYU looks at everything in despair, a tear sliding down her face.

INT. ENCLOSED ROOM - NIGHT

FLASHBACK. WEN QINGYU sits alone in a corner of an empty, dark room. She looks at her phone, crying in pain. She rolls up her sleeve, revealing old scars on her wrist. She touches them gently, remembering.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

SONG DONGXU lies on the bed, continuing the phone call. XU YAO, in business attire, organizes documents.

SONG DONGXU
Wen, you can't keep interrupting. Xu Yao needs me here. Her anxiety is crippling her pitch tomorrow.

XU YAO
(quietly)
Senior, the team dinner is at nine.

SONG DONGXU
(lying to WEN QINGYU)
It's a working dinner. Look, just give Yaya her usual meds. I'll be there first thing. If it's actually serious.

INT. ENCLOSED ROOM - NIGHT

WEN QINGYU looks at her phone. On the screen is a message from XU YAO with a photo: Song Dongxu's hotel room key card on a nightstand, his watch beside it. The text reads: "Thanks for sharing him. You're so understanding."

WEN QINGYU (V.O.)
(internal monologue)
Yaya, we both know he's not coming. And we're done waiting.

WEN QINGYU's phone rings. The caller ID shows "Teacher." She answers, tears still on her face but her voice steady.

WEN QINGYU
We're taking the fellowship. Both of us.

She ends the call. Opens a message to Song Dongxu. Types:

WEN QINGYU (V.O.)
(typing)
"Happy New Year. We're leaving. Don't look for us."

She hits send. Turns off her phone. Returns to Yaya's bedside.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Three Lives in a Floating Dream
description: A woman seeks revenge after being left for dead, assuming a new identity to confront those who wronged her and her family.
context:
Title: Three Lives in a Floating Dream
Description: A woman seeks revenge after being left for dead, assuming a new identity to confront those who wronged her and her family.

EXT. WILDERNESS - NIGHT

JI YUNMENG (20s, trembling) has her hands bound and mouth sealed with tape. She struggles against the ropes, eyes wide with terror.

A MALE KIDNAPPER in a security uniform pins JI YUNMENG's head down with his boot.

JIANG YOURONG (40s, elegant, drunk on power) walks forward, swirling a bottle of expensive alcohol, studying Ji Yunmeng like a specimen.

JIANG YOURONG
(ice beneath silk)
You always wanted to belong. Now you always will.

JIANG YOURONG shoves JI YUNMENG to the ground. The MALE KIDNAPPER covers her with a weighted burlap sack.

The MALE KIDNAPPER drags the sack to the riverbank—it catches, then slides free. SPLASH. The river claims its offering.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

JI YUNMENG wears a hospital gown, her face a map of cuts. Thick bandages cover her eyes. She unwinds them slowly, revealing one eye clouded white, the other burning with focus.

JI YUNMENG (V.O.)
(ritualistic whisper)
Ji Yunmeng drowned in that river. These scars are her tombstone. Nian Zihe is what the water spat back.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

Rain hammers down. NIAN ZIHE, in a black suit, holds an umbrella over two fresh graves—her own clothes soaked through. She places a shattered whiskey bottle and a security badge on the wet earth. Her expression is stone.

NIAN ZIHE (V.O.)
They thought the river would bury their secrets. I'll teach them how secrets are buried.

title: Late Night God of Cooking
description: A powerful woman seeking to unify the city's underworld confronts a notorious gang leader, leading to a fateful night at a mysterious restaurant.
context:
Title: Late Night God of Cooking
Description: A powerful woman seeking to unify the city's underworld confronts a notorious gang leader, leading to a fateful night at a mysterious restaurant.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

A row of bound men under a single swinging bulb.

WANG XINRAN (V.O.)
Grandfather's final test: unify Jiangcheng or walk away.

ZHANG HU drops to the concrete, blood at his mouth. WANG XINRAN sits, impassive.

ZHANG HU
(struggling)
My brother will burn this place down.

WANG XINRAN
Bring him my offer: the 20 clubs for your life.

She signals. Her men cut ZHANG HU's ropes. He scrambles for the door.

WANG XINRAN (V.O.)
Mercy is just delayed war.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

ZHANG BAO in white, his crew in black. They move with disciplined steps.

ZHANG HU limps into view, clutching his ribs.

ZHANG HU
Brother... Wang family.

ZHANG BAO
(stops)
They don't touch our business.

ZHANG HU
She does. Says she'll be waiting.

A SHENG
The men need food before a fight.

ZHANG BAO
(nods)
We'll eat. Then decide.

Ahead, a lone restaurant glows. Sign: "Late Night God of Cooking."

ZHANG HU
Just there.

A SHENG
Pricey block for a diner.

ZHANG BAO
Good. Neutral ground.

They head toward it.
continuation:
INT. LATE NIGHT GOD OF COOKING RESTAURANT - NIGHT

Empty. A chalkboard: "Today's Meditation: Egg Fried Rice 99998"

ZHANG BAO, ZHANG HU, and A SHENG sit.

ZHANG BAO
Menu?

The PROPRIETOR appears, calm and exact. He hands a single-page menu.

ZHANG HU
(pointing at board)
Ninety-nine thousand?

A SHENG
(to Proprietor)
For rice?

PROPRIETOR
For clarity.

SUBORDINATE A
Brother Bao, this is—

ZHANG BAO
(raising hand)
Three.

PROPRIETOR
One per person. House rules.

He walks away. ZHANG BAO watches him go.

ZHANG BAO (V.O.)
Before war, my grandfather fed us. "Taste what you're losing."

Kitchen sounds: wok on flame, oil sizzling.

The PROPRIETOR returns, three bowls. Steam rises.

ZHANG BAO
(scents it)
WANG XINRAN eats here?

PROPRIETOR
She pays full price.

ZHANG BAO
(smiles)
Honest.

He eats. Shoulders drop. The men watch, uncertain.

A SHENG
Brother? The crew's waiting.

ZHANG BAO
Tell them to wait.

He takes another bite, slow.

ZHANG BAO
(to Proprietor)
She's outside.

PROPRIETOR
Always.

ZHANG BAO
(to A SHENG)
The clubs are hers. But not my men.

He stands, leaves cash on the table.

ZHANG BAO
(to Proprietor)
One more. For her.

The PROPRIETOR nods, already reaching for a fourth bowl. ZHANG BAO exits. His men follow, confused.

title: Schemes and Rouge in the Deep Mansion
description: A maid is reborn after suffering a tragic death and vows revenge against the mistress who destroyed her.
context:
Title: Schemes and Rouge in the Deep Mansion
Description: A maid is reborn after suffering a tragic death and vows revenge against the mistress who destroyed her.

INT. LUXURIOUS HALL - DAY

Light streams through the latticed windows into the antique hall. Several maids stand solemnly on both sides. Maid HAI TANG kneels on the carpet in the center.

ZHAO MANHIANG, the mistress, wears luxurious red brocade robes and an exquisite headdress. She sits elegantly, sipping tea.

ZHAO MANHIANG
Hai Tang, the Young Master returns tonight. You will attend him.

HAI TANG keeps her head lowered, her fingers pressing into the carpet weave.

HAI TANG (V.O.)
Didn't I die?

MONTAGE - FLASHBACK

INT. HALL - DAY (MEMORY)

The image turns black and white, filled with oppression. HAI TANG looks at ZHAO MANHIANG with determination.

HAI TANG
I would rather die than become a concubine!

HAI TANG throws her teacup to the floor. It shatters.

ZHAO MANHIANG
(frozen smile)
How... disappointing.

Maid DU JUAN steps forward, her movements precise.

DU JUAN
The Mistress shows you kindness.

DU JUAN's slap is sudden. HAI TANG falls, blood at her lip. DU JUAN grabs her hair, forcing her head back.

DU JUAN
(quietly, for Hai Tang alone)
You should have said yes.

ZHAO MANHIANG
(coldly)
Take her to learn her place.
continuation:
INT. WOODSHED - DAY (MEMORY)

HAI TANG is secured to a wooden post. Her hands are locked with iron chains.

HAI TANG
(struggling)
Let me go!

ZHAO MANHIANG (O.S.)
Since Miss Hai Tang thinks so highly of herself...

ZHAO MANHIANG stands at the woodshed door, speaking to two household guards.

ZHAO MANHIANG
...find someone to teach her humility.

GUARD (O.S.)
It will be done, Young Mistress.

The door closes. Darkness. The sound of a struggle. A muffled scream. Then silence.

INT. DILAPIDATED HUT - DAY (MEMORY)

ON SCREEN: Three Years Later

Heavy snow falls. HAI TANG, gaunt and limping, empties a chamber pot. She stumbles, catches herself against the wall.

HAI TANG
(to herself)

She falls. The snow begins to cover her form.

HAI TANG (V.O.)

END MONTAGE

INT. LUXURIOUS HALL - DAY

HAI TANG snaps back to reality, her spine straightening a fraction.

HAI TANG raises her head, a slight smile on her face.

HAI TANG

ZHAO MANHIANG
(satisfied)

HAI TANG
(submissively)
Yes.

ZHAO MANHIANG

HAI TANG bows and kowtows.

HAI TANG
This servant obeys.

HAI TANG (V.O.)

ZHAO MANHIANG picks up her teacup, a satisfied smile on her lips.

ZHAO MANHIANG

title: Qingfeng Yisan (Episode 42)
description: A woman discovers her devoted husband's affair with their housekeeper and decides to leave him by emigrating alone, despite his public displays of love and sacrifice.
context:
Title: Qingfeng Yisan (Episode 42)
Description: A woman discovers her devoted husband's affair with their housekeeper and decides to leave him by emigrating alone, despite his public displays of love and sacrifice.

INT. POLICE STATION SERVICE HALL - DAY

SHEN XINYAN stands at the counter, looking dejected. Across from her sits a FEMALE CLERK.

FEMALE CLERK
Mrs. Zhou, Mr. Zhou's family has served in the military for three generations. He cannot leave the country, so he cannot apply for immigration.

SHEN XINYAN
I am applying for immigration by myself.

FEMALE CLERK
(surprised)
Ah? Why? I just saw a news report about Mr. Zhou buying an entire cake factory just because you mentioned wanting chestnut cake. Look.

The FEMALE CLERK takes out her phone and plays a news segment.

INT. NEWS STUDIO - DAY (FLASHBACK)

ZHOU YUSHEN, wearing a suit and holding an exquisite chestnut cake, smiles at the camera.

ZHOU YUSHEN
Only because my wife, Shen Xinyan, loves chestnut cake, I acquired a nearly bankrupt chestnut cake shop in our city. I hope everyone will support it.

INT. POLICE STATION SERVICE HALL - DAY

The FEMALE CLERK and her colleagues whisper among themselves.

FEMALE CLERK
(whispering to colleague)
Oh my God, she's the wife of that wife-doting maniac Zhou Yushen.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Zhou Yushen would give up money and even his life for her.

MALE COLLEAGUE
Yes, they're famous as a model couple. Everyone in Jiangcheng knows about them.

SHEN XINYAN hears the gossip, a bitter smile crosses her lips. She looks down at the documents in her hand.

SHEN XINYAN (V.O.)
Model couple?

SHEN XINYAN slowly removes the diamond ring from her ring finger.

SHEN XINYAN (V.O.)
Right, we're famously in love.

MONTAGE (FLASHBACK)

A series of images showing ZHOU YUSHEN doting on SHEN XINYAN rapidly cut together.

SHEN XINYAN (V.O.)
Everyone envied Zhou Yushen's crazy pursuit of me. Giving me bags, houses, cars. Just because I casually mentioned wanting to eat chestnut cake that had been discontinued for years, he revived an entire factory.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SHEN XINYAN lies in a hospital bed, very weak. ZHOU YUSHEN anxiously talks with a DOCTOR.

SHEN XINYAN (V.O.)
But what truly moved my heart was that this intimidating billionaire CEO once sacrificed his dignity for me.

ZHOU YUSHEN
As long as you can save Yanyan, I'll pay whatever you ask.

DOCTOR
Mr. Zhou, this isn't about money. Right now, if Miss Shen wants to live, we can only ask the most authoritative doctor in America, Dr. Thomas, to come out of retirement. But he despises the wealthy and powerful, and recently went to Africa as a Doctors Without Borders volunteer. He won't accept.

ZHOU YUSHEN
Wealthy and powerful? I'm not wealthy or powerful. I'm just a man who can't control what he owns. Tell Dr. Thomas, as long as he's willing to save Yanyan, I'll give up anything, whatever he asks.

A tear rolls down SHEN XINYAN's cheek as she lies in the bed.

SHEN XINYAN (V.O.)
Even Zhou Yushen's life and dignity.

ZHOU YUSHEN slowly kneels beside the bed, holding SHEN XINYAN's hand.

INT. POLICE STATION SERVICE HALL - DAY

Back to reality, the FEMALE CLERK looks at SHEN XINYAN.

FEMALE CLERK
Mrs. Zhou, are you sure you want to proceed now?

SHEN XINYAN
(eyes determined)
Yes, proceed.

SHEN XINYAN (V.O.)
I once thought that Zhou Yushen and I would be together for life. But why would someone willing to sacrifice everything for me get involved with our housekeeper?

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

SHEN XINYAN hides behind the door, recording with her phone. Inside the bedroom, the housekeeper ZHAO YAOYAO nestles in ZHOU YUSHEN's arms.

ZHAO YAOYAO
You've been buying her so many gifts. What do I get for keeping your secret?

ZHOU YUSHEN
(expressionless)
You get what you deserve. Nothing more. I told you I only love Xinyan. If she finds out, I'll destroy you.

ZHAO YAOYAO
Are you that afraid of losing her?

ZHOU YUSHEN
Yes. I can't function without my wife. If she leaves, I cease to exist.

Outside the door, SHEN XINYAN painfully covers her mouth, tears streaming down her face.

INT. POLICE STATION SERVICE HALL - DAY

The FEMALE CLERK stamps the documents.

FEMALE CLERK
Mrs. Zhou? Mrs. Zhou! The preliminary review has been approved. After the system processes it, you can leave the country in three days.

SHEN XINYAN
(coming back to her senses)
Thank you.

SHEN XINYAN collects the documents and turns to leave.

SHEN XINYAN (V.O.)
Zhou Yushen, in three days, you'll learn what happens when you lose control.

SHEN XINYAN walks out of the hall, her eyes resolute.

title: After My Scumbag Husband's Terminal Diagnosis, I Went Crazy
description: A woman discovers her husband has a terminal illness and desperately seeks to save him, unaware of his true nature.
context:
Title: After My Scumbag Husband's Terminal Diagnosis, I Went Crazy
Description: A woman discovers her husband has a terminal illness and desperately seeks to save him, unaware of his true nature.

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTATION ROOM - DAY

SHU YUAN sits rigidly, watching DR. LIN LEYAN examine a test file.

SHU YUAN
Leyan, please. Just tell me what it says.

LIN LEYAN
His creatinine reading is 731. Normal levels are below 133.

SHU YUAN
(pleading)
I don't understand what that means. Just tell me.

LIN LEYAN
(quietly)
End-stage renal failure. Without immediate intervention...

SHU YUAN
No. There has to be a mistake. Run the tests again.

LIN LEYAN
I already have. Three times.

Lin reaches across the desk, covering Shu Yuan's trembling hands.

LIN LEYAN
(gently)
Yuanyuan, I know you want to fix this. But you have to accept—

SHU YUAN
(cutting in)
A transplant. That's the answer, right?

LIN LEYAN
If we can find a matching donor within a week... there's a chance.

SHU YUAN
Mine. Take mine.

LIN LEYAN
You know it's not that simple. And the procedure costs at least 500,000 yuan.

SHU YUAN
(urgent)
I'll find the money. Just promise me you'll call me the moment a donor matches.

LIN LEYAN
I'll put him on every priority list I can. But Yuanyuan, he deserves to know. It's his life.

SHU YUAN
(firmly)
Not yet. Let me protect him from this until I have a solution.

Shu Yuan stands, already dialing her phone.

LIN LEYAN
Wait. I work with a medical foundation. Let me file an emergency grant application for your family.

SHU YUAN
(grateful)
Thank you.

Shu Yuan heads for the door.

LIN LEYAN
Yuanyuan?

Shu Yuan pauses, hand on the doorknob.

LIN LEYAN
You promised to take care of yourself too. Don't forget that.

SHU YUAN
I won't.

Shu Yuan exits, the door clicking softly shut.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

LIN LEYAN leans against the wall near the elevators, speaking with a YOUNG NURSE.

YOUNG NURSE
Dr. Lin, you just prioritized your friend's husband like that?

LIN LEYAN
He's family. I have to try.

GU ZEYANG watches from behind a pillar, a wilted bouquet in his hands.

LIN LEYAN
(continuing)
Seven days. If we don't find a kidney donor by then, I'm not sure she'll survive the month.

YOUNG NURSE
It's always the devoted ones who ignore their own symptoms. Now it's half a million yuan for a miracle.

LIN LEYAN
(sharp)
We don't discuss patients in public corridors. Even when it's personal.

The nurse nods and hurries away.

GU ZEYANG (V.O.)
Seven days. So that's her secret. Hiding uremia from me.

He crushes the flower stems in his fist.

GU ZEYANG (V.O.)
500,000 yuan to save her? She really thinks I'm that desperate.

SHU YUAN rounds the corner, her phone pressed to her ear, and stops short.

SHU YUAN
(surprised)
Zeyang? What are you doing here?

GU ZEYANG looks at her coldly, the mangled flowers dangling in his grip.

GU ZEYANG
Came to check on my "busy" wife. Heard you haven't been feeling well.

title: The Scumbag's Brother Has Had a Crush on Me for Ten Years
description: A young woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal and his true feelings about their engagement while desperately trying to save her grandmother's life.
context:
Title: The Scumbag's Brother Has Had a Crush on Me for Ten Years
Description: A young woman discovers her fiancé's betrayal and his true feelings about their engagement while desperately trying to save her grandmother's life.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

GRANDMA JIANG (70s, fragile but dignified) lies still, her breathing labored against the hum of monitors.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

Thunder rumbles. JIANG QIAO (mid-20s, exhausted but determined) sprints down the corridor, hospital slippers squeaking on linoleum.

A DOCTOR (40s, weary) exits the ward, charts in hand. Jiang Qiao skids to a stop.

JIANG QIAO
Doctor, my grandmother—

DOCTOR
She's stable. For now. There's a new treatment. Twenty thousand per dose.

The doctor holds her gaze, knowing the weight of it. Jiang Qiao's hand instinctively finds her empty pocket.

JIANG QIAO
(hushed)
I'll get it. Today.

The doctor nods, walks away. Jiang Qiao pulls out her phone with trembling fingers. She dials "Mom." The voicemail beeps.

PHONE VOICE (V.O.)
The subscriber you have called...

JIANG QIAO
(voice cracking)
Mom, please. I need—

Disconnected. She stares at the screen, then scrolls to "Yunxiao." Her thumb hovers.

JIANG QIAO
(whisper)
He said we're family now.
continuation:
EXT. PEI FAMILY VILLA - NIGHT

Rain lashes the windows of a riverfront mansion. A single light burns on the second floor.

INT. PEI FAMILY VILLA BEDROOM - NIGHT

SHEN SU (late 20s, polished) watches the rain streak the glass. PEI YUNXIAO (30, sharp-featured) lounges on the bed.

SHEN SU
She's planning the engagement party. My sister saw the venue booking.

PEI YUNXIAO
She can plan whatever she wants.

He moves behind Shen Su, hands sliding around her waist.

PEI YUNXIAO
(against her ear)
The company's expanding north. I'll need a wife who understands that. Not some charity case my father imported.

Outside the door, Jiang Qiao's hand freezes mid-knock. A takeout bag slips from her other hand—soup for Yunxiao.

JIANG QIAO (V.O.)
Imported. Like furniture.

The door clicks shut. Jiang Qiao presses her back against the wall, soup pooling at her feet.

INT. PEI FAMILY VILLA HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS

Jiang Qiao sinks to the floor. A handkerchief appears—PEI ZHIHE (early 30s, quiet intensity) crouches beside her.

PEI ZHIHE
I was looking for you. Grandmother's hospital called.

He produces a check from his jacket. The amount is blank.

PEI ZHIHE
(beat)
I assume you need this more than he does.

Title: Episode One
Description: Wen Ni and Jian Yuchen, former high school and college rivals, are now married and share an intimate moment after his return from a business trip.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

WEN NI lies in bed, watching a movie via projector. She watches with rapt attention, unconsciously biting her finger.

MALE VOICE IN MOVIE (V.O.)
Baby, am I amazing?

JIAN YUCHEN, wearing a suit and pulling a suitcase, appears silently at the doorway. He watches WEN NI thoughtfully.

WEN NI is startled by JIAN YUCHEN's sudden appearance and sits up abruptly.

WEN NI

After three years, you're still embarrassed? It's just a movie.

continuation:
