title: Sleepless in Harbor City
description: A woman discovers her mysterious lover from a passionate night may be connected to her own husband, as family intrigue unfolds around a dying patriarch's fortune.
context:
Title: Sleepless in Harbor City
Description: A woman discovers her mysterious lover from a passionate night may be connected to her own husband, as family intrigue unfolds around a dying patriarch's fortune.

INT. BILLIARD ROOM - NIGHT

An ambiguously lit billiard room. Playing cards are scattered on the table.

SONG QINGYUN, a woman wearing a black lace mask and a black slip dress, is leaning over to take a shot. LIANG YOUJIN, a handsome man in a white shirt and suspenders, approaches from behind, teaching her hand-over-hand.

LIANG YOUJIN
(voice low, controlled)
Does your husband know about us?

SONG QINGYUN straightens up, holding the cue, and turns to look at him. Her eyes glitter behind the mask.

SONG QINGYUN
I'm interested in you.

She pauses, her gaze teasing, searching.

SONG QINGYUN (CONT'D)
And him?

SONG QINGYUN turns and walks away, sitting on a nearby sofa. She picks up a rose-shaped candle from the table and blows on it, the flame dancing in her palm.

LIANG YOUJIN walks over and stands in front of her.

SONG QINGYUN
(looking up at him)
Divorce. Maybe he's even better at playing games than I am.

LIANG YOUJIN suddenly reaches out and grabs her chin, his eyes sharp.

LIANG YOUJIN
(low voice, serious)
What did you say?

SONG QINGYUN
(fearless)
I said...

She reaches up and removes her mask, revealing her delicate features.

SONG QINGYUN (CONT'D)
Divorce. You...

Before she can finish, LIANG YOUJIN leans down and kisses her. They kiss passionately as he lifts her up and presses her onto the sofa.

MONTAGE:
- The two kiss passionately on the sofa.
- LIANG YOUJIN lifts SONG QINGYUN into his arms.
- They kiss in front of a mirror, images overlapping.
END MONTAGE.

LIANG YOUJIN (V.O.)
Baby, this is your punishment. You've been very naughty.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL BEDROOM - MORNING

Sunlight streams through the curtains into the room. SONG QINGYUN lies in the disheveled bed, drowsy.

Her phone rings on the nightstand. She reaches out to answer it.

SONG QINGYUN
(hoarse voice)
Who is it?

LIANG YOUJIN (V.O.)
(on phone, voice cold, formal)
Liang Youjin.

SONG QINGYUN
(confused)
Who's Liang Youjin?

LIANG YOUJIN (V.O.)
(on phone)
Your husband. The one you married three years ago. Don't tell me you've forgotten.

SONG QINGYUN snaps awake, sitting up abruptly and wrapping herself in the blanket. Her knuckles whiten around the phone.

SONG QINGYUN (V.O.)
Why does this feel like being caught in bed?

SONG QINGYUN
(into phone, tight)
What do you need?

LIANG YOUJIN (V.O.)
(on phone)
Tomorrow there's a family banquet at the old Harbor City estate. Grandfather is gravely ill. We need to be there together.

Beat.

LIANG YOUJIN (V.O.) (CONT'D)
(on phone)
The succession arrangements will be announced. Try not to embarrass the family.

SONG QINGYUN (V.O.)
The Liang family patriarch's time is running out. It seems the battle for the billion-dollar fortune has already begun beneath the surface.

SONG QINGYUN
I'll return as soon as possible.

LIANG YOUJIN (V.O.)
(on phone)
Wait. Baby, drink more warm water. Your voice sounds so hoarse.

FLASHBACK: Brief flashes of their intimate moments from last night—a whispered "baby" in the dark.

SONG QINGYUN freezes upon hearing "baby" and noticing her hoarse voice, her eyes filling with doubt. She hangs up, staring at the phone.

SONG QINGYUN (V.O.)
That voice... why does it sound so familiar?

She gets up and picks up the black dress from the floor beside the bed. A small card slips from the dress.

She picks up the card. It reads: "Looking forward to seeing you again, my butterfly," with a butterfly drawn beside it.

SONG QINGYUN looks at the card thoughtfully. She walks to the nightstand and holds the card near a lit candle.

SONG QINGYUN (V.O.)
I won't play with the same man twice.

The card slowly burns in the flame. She watches it turn to ash, her hand steady but her eyes conflicted.

INT. MANSION HALLWAY - DAY

SONG QINGYUN, now dressed in an elegant white qipao, walks down the hallway with dignified grace. Her face is a perfect mask of composure.

At the end of the hallway, LIANG YOUJIN waits for her. Seeing her approach, a smile curves his lips as he unconsciously touches the butterfly tattoo behind his ear.

LIANG YOUJIN (V.O.)
It's been seven years, little butterfly. We're finally going to officially meet.

He watches SONG QINGYUN, his gaze complex and profound. She meets his eyes, her expression giving nothing away—but her fingers, hidden in her sleeve, tremble slightly.

title: The Stock Market Tycoon's Comeback
description: A legendary stock trader known as "One Six Middle Road" faces a coordinated attack from rival traders who crash his stocks, forcing him to choose between saving himself or protecting the retail investors who trust him.
context:
Title: The Stock Market Tycoon's Comeback
Description: A legendary stock trader known as "One Six Middle Road" faces a coordinated attack from rival traders who crash his stocks, forcing him to choose between saving himself or protecting the retail investors who trust him.

INT. LU MINGYU'S OFFICE - DAY

LU MINGYU (on-screen text: LU MINGYU) sits surrounded by six monitors casting blue light on his face. Empty coffee cups litter his desk. His fingers dance across the keyboard with mechanical precision, but his jaw is clenched tight.

INT. HAICHENG SECURITIES TRADING HALL - DAY

The hall is packed. RETAIL INVESTORS crane their necks at the giant LED screen, phones clutched like lifelines. The air smells of stale cigarettes and desperation.

OLD INVESTOR (on-screen text: OLD INVESTOR)
(trembling finger pointing at screen)
There! 9898! Brother Six's fingerprints all over it!

FEMALE INVESTOR (on-screen text: FEMALE INVESTOR)
(gripping her child's hand)
Sea Cucumber Pigeon... up eight percent already!

The screen erupts in green. A digital stamp appears: LIMIT UP.

CROWD
(gasping)
He did it... he actually did it...

INT. LU MINGYU'S OFFICE - DAY

LU MINGYU's shoulders drop a fraction. He reaches for a cold teacup, hand trembling slightly before steadying.

HE XIAOQUN (V.O.)
(through headset, breathless)
Big brother... we locked the board.

INT. HE XIAOQUN'S OFFICE - DAY

HE XIAOQUN (on-screen text: HE XIAOQUN) stares at his screen, knuckles white on his mouse.

HE XIAOQUN
(low, urgent)
Thirty million in paper profits. Should we start peeling—

INT. LU MINGYU'S OFFICE - DAY

LU MINGYU's expression hardens. He types a single command.

LU MINGYU
Quiet. Something's wrong.

On his main monitor, the LIMIT UP stamp flickers. Then vanishes.
continuation:
INT. HE XIAOQUN'S OFFICE - DAY

HE XIAOQUN shoots to his feet, his chair slamming backward.

HE XIAOQUN (V.O.)
(desperate)
No, no, no—it's dumping!

HE XIAOQUN
(to himself, cracking)
That's not us. Who's hitting the bid?

INT. LU MINGYU'S OFFICE - DAY

LU MINGYU's face is stone, but his throat bobs in a swallow.

LU MINGYU
(into headset)
Hold your position. Don't chase it down.

INT. DARK ROOM - NIGHT

Four figures in animal masks glow in monitor light. MA JIALOU (on-screen text: MA JIALOU) leans back, fingers steepled.

MA JIALOU
The lemmings are panicking. Perfect.

CHIP MONKEY (on-screen text: CHIP MONKEY)
(voice filtered)
Order flow shows retail stop-losses triggering like dominoes.

LITTLE SQUID (on-screen text: LITTLE SQUID)
(tilting head)
One Six's reputation won't survive this.

TECH HERO (on-screen text: TECH HERO)
(leaning forward)
He thought he could rewrite the rules. Teach the sheep to think.

MA JIALOU
(smiling behind the mask)
Now watch him bleed. Either he cuts Zhiyuan Tech to save himself...

CHIP MONKEY
Or he goes down with them.

LITTLE SQUID
Either way, we feast.

They laugh - a cold, synthesized chorus.

The video call windows blink out, one by one. Alone, CHIP MONKEY removes his monkey mask, revealing GU KAI's face.

GU KAI (on-screen text: GU KAI)
(cold laugh)
When I become the real One Six Middle Road...

INT. LU MINGYU'S OFFICE - DAY

HE XIAOQUN paces behind LU MINGYU, who hasn't moved in twenty minutes. The screen shows cascading red.

HE XIAOQUN
Big brother, Zhiyuan Tech is our lifeblood. If we don't sell now—

LU MINGYU
(quietly)
Seventy thousand retail accounts followed us in.

INT. HE XIAOQUN'S OFFICE - DAY

HE XIAOQUN
(pleading)
They'd do the same to you! Every man for himself!

INT. LU MINGYU'S OFFICE - DAY

LU MINGYU finally turns from the screen. His eyes are hollow but burning.

LU MINGYU
Then why did they open accounts at One Six Middle Road?

HE XIAOQUN's mouth snaps shut. LU MINGYU looks back at the screen.

LU MINGYU
Prep the war chest. We're catching the knife.

INT. HAICHENG SECURITIES TRADING HALL - DAY

The hall is silent except for choked sobs. The OLD INVESTOR sits on the floor, back against the wall.

FEMALE INVESTOR
(voice breaking)
Brother Six wouldn't... not like this.

OLD INVESTOR
(bitter laugh)
They all say that. Until the bill comes due.

The screen blinks. A massive green order appears. Then another. And another.

FEMALE INVESTOR
(whisper)
Look...

The OLD INVESTOR squints. The stock halts its freefall. Begins to climb.

OLD INVESTOR
(softly, almost prayer)
He's... buying?

ON SCREEN: The price ticks up. Slowly. Deliberately.

title: Rebirth of the Scorned Wife
description: A modern woman dies from overwork and wakes up in the 1980s, reborn in the body of an overweight woman who was mocked and driven to suicide.
context:
Title: Rebirth of the Scorned Wife
Description: A modern woman dies from overwork and wakes up in the 1980s, reborn in the body of an overweight woman who was mocked and driven to suicide.

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

Several VILLAGERS struggle to carry a black coffin, but quickly lose their grip and drop it on the ground.

VILLAGER A
Christ almighty! My spine's done. She's gotta be three hundred pounds if she's an ounce.

VILLAGER B
(puffing)
Like dragging a sack of cement through mud.

VILLAGER C
Always parading around in city dresses. Made a proper spectacle at Xiao Qin's factory last week, didn't she?

HAN RUOLIN
(walking over with a water cup)
Here, big brother. Wet your throat.

VILLAGER C
(taking the cup)
Aiya, only you think of us.

HAN RUOLIN
It's a shame, though. She's already gone, and Xiao Qin won't even show his face.

VILLAGER C
(slyly)
Good riddance. Now he can remarry proper. You and him, that would be—

VILLAGER B
(stuttering)
A... a... a perfect match!

VILLAGER C
Right, right, right.

HAN RUOLIN
(laughing softly)
Big brother, please.

VILLAGER A
Alright, enough resting. Let's finish this.

VILLAGER A
Come on, heave.

Everyone gathers around the coffin again to lift it.

VILLAGER A
Three, two, one!

Just as they exert force, a light sound comes from inside the coffin. Everyone stops.

VILLAGER B
...I heard something.
continuation:
VILLAGER A
No, you didn't. Again!

They prepare to lift. A louder THUMP echoes. The lid shifts.

VILLAGER A
(terrified)
God... God help us!

HAN RUOLIN
(panicking)
Quick! Nail it down! Before she—

HAN RUOLIN (V.O.)
Du Qiao, you're finally dead. Your husband, your son... they're mine now.

Suddenly, the coffin lid is thrown open by a tremendous force, and a hand reaches out. Everyone screams and backs away.

LI YUE (in Du Qiao's body) sits up from the coffin and stretches.

LI YUE
(raspy, disoriented)
...server migration at three AM... need to file the incident report...

LI YUE looks around, completely bewildered.

LI YUE
Who are you people? Why are you dressed like this? Why am I in a box?

HAN RUOLIN
(trembling, pointing)
Are you... human or ghost?

VILLAGER D
Back! Back!

LI YUE tries to climb out but discovers her body is abnormally large. She stares at her hands.

LI YUE
What is...? This isn't my body. My body was... I was at my desk. The IPO deadline. I just needed...

Memory fragments flash: A floral dress, seams straining. Her husband's face—disgust. Concrete walls echoing with laughter. Ice-cold water filling her lungs.

LI YUE
(clutching her chest)
No. Oh no. I died. I died and I've been... I've been...

She looks at the mourners' 1980s clothing. At the wooden coffin. Her eyes widen with shock.

LI YUE
(whisper)
...transmigrated.

HAN RUOLIN
Du Qiao...?

LI YUE's head snaps up. Her eyes—sharp, modern—fix on Han Ruolin.

LI YUE
Who the hell is Du Qiao?

Always parading around in city dresses. Made a proper spectacle at Xiao Qin's factory last week, didn't she?

HAN RUOLIN
(walking over with a water cup)
Here, big brother. Wet your throat.

VILLAGER C
(taking the cup)
Aiya, only you think of us.

HAN RUOLIN
It's a shame, though. She's already gone, and Xiao Qin won't even show his face.

VILLAGER C
(slyly)
Good riddance. Now he can remarry proper. You and him, that would be—

VILLAGER B
(stuttering)
A... a... a perfect match!

VILLAGER C
Right, right, right.

HAN RUOLIN
(laughing softly)
Big brother, please.

VILLAGER A
Alright, enough resting. Let's finish this.

VILLAGER A
Come on, heave.

Everyone gathers around the coffin again to lift it.

VILLAGER A
Three, two, one!

Just as they exert force, a light sound comes from inside the coffin. Everyone stops.

VILLAGER B
...I heard something.

VILLAGER A
No, you didn't. Again!

They prepare to lift. A louder THUMP echoes. The lid shifts.

VILLAGER A
(terrified)
God... God help us!

HAN RUOLIN
(panicking)
Quick! Nail it down! Before she—

HAN RUOLIN (V.O.)
Du Qiao, you're finally dead. Your husband, your son... they're mine now.

Suddenly, the coffin lid is thrown open by a tremendous force, and a hand reaches out. Everyone screams and backs away.

LI YUE (in Du Qiao's body) sits up from the coffin and stretches.

LI YUE
(raspy, disoriented)
...server migration at three AM... need to file the incident report...

LI YUE looks around, completely bewildered.

LI YUE
Who are you people? Why are you dressed like this? Why am I in a box?

HAN RUOLIN
(trembling, pointing)
Are you... human or ghost?

VILLAGER D
Back! Back!

LI YUE tries to climb out but discovers her body is abnormally large. She stares at her hands.

LI YUE
What is...? This isn't my body. My body was... I was at my desk. The IPO deadline. I just needed...

Memory fragments flash: A floral dress, seams straining. Her husband's face—disgust. Concrete walls echoing with laughter. Ice-cold water filling her lungs.

LI YUE
(clutching her chest)
No. Oh no. I died. I died and I've been... I've been...

She looks at the mourners' 1980s clothing. At the wooden coffin. Her eyes widen with shock.

LI YUE
(whisper)
...transmigrated.

HAN RUOLIN
Du Qiao...?

LI YUE's head snaps up. Her eyes—sharp, modern—fix on Han Ruolin.

LI YUE
Who the hell is Du Qiao?

title: The Whole City Knows
description: A woman who won 10 million in the lottery becomes the subject of a live broadcast reality show, revealing her true character when her impoverished mother begs for help with her father's medical bills.
context:
Title: The Whole City Knows
Description: A woman who won 10 million in the lottery becomes the subject of a live broadcast reality show, revealing her true character when her impoverished mother begs for help with her father's medical bills.

INT. BROADCAST STUDIO - DAY

A large broadcast studio. Several GUESTS sit on stage, and the audience fills the seats below. A FEMALE HOST stands at center stage.

HOST
(facing the camera)
Ten million dollars. That's what Wang Lingzhi won. That's also how many opinions this city suddenly has. Tonight, we watch—and you judge.

HOST
Now, let me introduce our life observers. Professor of Philosophy at Jiangdong University, Professor Li Ren.

CLOSE-UP: Professor Li Ren smiles thinly and waves. Sparse applause.

HOST
Chairman of Fuyao Group, Mr. Cao De.

CLOSE-UP: Mr. Cao De nods, eyes sharp. Polite applause.

HOST
Our nation's famous commentator, Teacher Liu Fang.

CLOSE-UP: Teacher Liu Fang stands and bows. Scattered applause.

HOST
Our observers will score Miss Wang Lingzhi's choices. Next, please watch.
continuation:
INT. LUXURY GOODS STORE - DAY

MONTAGE: WANG LINGZHI, designer suit and sunglasses, walks into a luxury goods store. STORE CLERKS line up and bow.

STORE CLERKS
(in unison)
Miss Wang.

CUSTOMER A and CUSTOMER B notice WANG LINGZHI and whisper.

CUSTOMER A
There she is. The lottery girl. Cameras everywhere.

CUSTOMER B
Poor woman. No such thing as a private sin anymore.

A STORE CLERK walks up carrying a black handbag.

STORE CLERK
Miss Wang, this is your "New Life." Please inspect it.

WANG LINGZHI
(examining the bag)
New Life. This name suits me. How much?

STORE CLERK
One million.

WANG LINGZHI
(without hesitation)
Swipe it.

STORE CLERK
(taking the card)
Of course.

CUSTOMER A and CUSTOMER B watch WANG LINGZHI's back.

CUSTOMER A
It's easy to judge.

CUSTOMER B
Harder to understand.

AT THE STORE ENTRANCE: An elderly woman in plain clothes, LIU FENLAN, looking anxious, is blocked by a SECURITY GUARD.

LIU FENLAN
(struggling)
Let me in! I'm Wang Lingzhi's mother!

WANG LINGZHI hears and turns around.

LIU FENLAN breaks free, runs to WANG LINGZHI, grabs her hand and kneels.

LIU FENLAN
(crying out)
Lingzhi, save your father! He needs fifty thousand for surgery, just fifty! The doctor said—

WANG LINGZHI
(disgustedly shaking off her hand)
I told you. I already paid that debt.

WANG LINGZHI coldly turns and leaves. LIU FENLAN cries on the ground. The STORE CLERKS and CUSTOMERS all stare in shock.

INT. BROADCAST STUDIO - DAY

The large screen displays everything that happened in the luxury goods store. The audience below and the GUESTS on stage all show expressions of shock and dismay.

title: Missing You for the Rest of My Life
description: A mother desperately tries to save her dying daughter after being abandoned by the boyfriend she once sacrificed everything for.
context:
Title: Missing You for the Rest of My Life
Description: A mother desperately tries to save her dying daughter after being abandoned by the boyfriend she once sacrificed everything for.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

A heart monitor BEEP pulses from within the room.

Through a small window, TANGTANG (20s) lies fragile, oxygen mask fogging with each shallow breath.

AUNT JIANG (50s) stands guard, hollow-eyed, clutching a crumpled medical bill: FINAL NOTICE.

FOOTSTEPS approach. She turns.

LIN WANTANG'S BOYFRIEND (30s) stops a few feet away, empty-handed.

AUNT JIANG
(quietly pleading)
Li Wei. The hospital's given us three days. Sixty thousand.

LIN WANTANG'S BOYFRIEND
I don't have it.

AUNT JIANG
(desperate)
You promised. You swore--

LIN WANTANG'S BOYFRIEND
I know what I said. I also know when to quit.

He pulls out a small box, sets it on a chair.

LIN WANTANG'S BOYFRIEND
Tell her I said goodbye.

AUNT JIANG
(sobbing)
When you were dying, she gave you a kidney. Her blood. Everything.

LIN WANTANG'S BOYFRIEND
That's why I'm in debt. Not love.

He walks away. AUNT JIANG grabs his sleeve.

AUNT JIANG
Don't you dare--

He pulls free. The motion sends her to her knees.

AUNT JIANG
(wailing)
She won't survive the week!

WANG CHUNLING (40s) rushes over, helps her up.

WANG CHUNLING
Cousin? What happened?

AUNT JIANG
(to WANG CHUNLING)
He's gone. And Tangtang's medicine money...

WANG CHUNLING
(quietly)
There's a man. Older. Wealthy. He'll pay two hundred thousand for a marriage. On paper only.

AUNT JIANG
(sharp)
What kind of man buys a wife?

WANG CHUNLING
The kind who doesn't ask questions.

AUNT JIANG looks through the window at Tangtang's still form.

AUNT JIANG
Where?
continuation:
EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

A black luxury van pulls up. ZHANG QI steps out, opens the door.

Two MEN IN SUITS emerge, take positions flanking the entrance.

ZHUANG YUNSHENG (60s, granite-faced) steps out.

MEN IN SUITS
(in unison)
Chairman.

ZHUANG YUNSHENG
Wait in the van.

They comply. ZHANG QI closes the door.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

ZHUANG JING'AN (30s) struggles with leg braces in a wheelchair. ZHUANG YUNSHENG watches.

ZHUANG JING'AN
Dad, go to Switzerland. I'll manage.

ZHUANG YUNSHENG
You need legal authority for medical decisions. I found someone.

ZHUANG JING'AN
A hired wife?

ZHUANG YUNSHENG
A practical solution. Nothing more.

He helps adjust his son's brace.

EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

ZHUANG YUNSHENG stands by the van with ZHANG QI.

ZHUANG YUNSHENG
Discretion is paramount. Jing'an cannot know it's contractual.

ZHANG QI
Understood, Chairman. The candidate arrives momentarily.

ZHUANG YUNSHENG
Description?

ZHANG QI
Khaki dress. Approximately forty-five. Riding a tricycle.

ZHUANG YUNSHENG
Alright. Leave us.

ZHANG QI bows and departs. ZHUANG YUNSHENG waits.

ZHUANG YUNSHENG
(to himself)
Khaki.

EXT. STREET - DAY

AUNT JIANG pedals a tricycle through traffic, khaki dress stained with sweat. Her phone is wedged between ear and shoulder.

WANG CHUNLING (V.O.)
Two hundred thousand, Auntie. Just sign. No one has to know.

AUNT JIANG (V.O.)
Tangtang, hold on.

She veers sharply, cutting across lanes.

EXT. PARKING LOT - DAY

ZHUANG YUNSHENG checks his watch.

A SCREECH of brakes. AUNT JIANG's tricycle wobbles into the lot, overloaded with cardboard boxes.

She's looking back over her shoulder, yelling at a car--

When she turns forward, ZHUANG YUNSHENG is directly in her path.

AUNT JIANG
(shouting)
Move! Move!

She yanks the handlebars. The tricycle tips.

ZHUANG YUNSHENG stumbles backward as the cargo bed swings toward him--

He falls back INTO the tricycle's cargo bed, landing among the boxes.

AUNT JIANG sprawls on the pavement.

They stare at each other, both stunned: him in the wreckage of her life, her at his polished shoes.

FADE OUT.

title: Untitled Script
description: A powerful family enforcer terrorizes a father into signing documents after killing his son, while the eldest son, a decorated military commander, prepares to return home.
context:
Title: Untitled Script
Description: A powerful family enforcer terrorizes a father into signing documents after killing his son, while the eldest son, a decorated military commander, prepares to return home.

INT. TANG FAMILY HOUSE - DAY

MR. HUO and several HENCHMEN burst into the Tang family home. The Tang family's younger son, TANG CHEN, is held by two henchmen, a knife at his throat. TANG FATHER (TANG SHUJIN) and TANG MOTHER (CHEN XIAOHUI) are restrained.

MR. HUO
(to TANG SHUJIN)
The deed to your fishing rights. Sign it now, or I take payment in blood.

TANG SHUJIN
(defiant)
You have no claim to those waters.

MR. HUO
(smiling)
I have ten men with blades. That's claim enough.

TANG CHEN struggles. The knife bites deeper.

CHEN XIAOHUI
(pleading)
Shujin, please—

TANG SHUJIN
(stalling)
My eldest son serves the Xiaolong Legion. He'll—----

MR. HUO
(laughs)
Your hero son is five years absent. I'm here today.

TANG CHEN
(through gritted teeth)
Father, don't—

MR. HUO nods. The henchman cuts TANG CHEN's throat. Blood spills. TANG CHEN collapses.

CHEN XIAOHUI
(screaming)

TANG SHUJIN
(anguished)
continuation:
Chen!

MR. HUO wipes blood from his face, unfazed.

MR. HUO
Now. About that signature. Your wife's blood next, or your ink?

He produces a scroll and presses it open. A henchman forces TANG SHUJIN's hand onto the paper.

TANG SHUJIN
(weeping)
I built that fleet... five generations...

MR. HUO
Then you should've built a better wall.

A henchman raises a stick against CHEN XIAOHUI.

TANG SHUJIN
(broken)
Stop! I'll sign...

He takes the pen with trembling fingers.

EXT. MILITARY CAMP - DAY

The Tang family's eldest son, TANG YUFENG, in military uniform, stands before his commander, ZHENG LONG. The Xiaolong Legion forms ranks behind them.

TANG YUFENG
Five years, Commander. Thank you.

ZHENG LONG
Your family earned this honor. Return with it.

A soldier, QIN HAO, kneels.

QIN HAO
Farewell, Commander Feng!

ALL SOLDIERS
(in unison)
Farewell, Commander Feng! Farewell, Commander Feng! Farewell, Commander Feng!

TANG YUFENG touches a jade pendant—his mother's gift. His eyes harden with purpose. He turns toward home.

title: Blazing Night
description: A young female student in desperate need of money contacts a surgeon about selling her eggs, leading to a tense and morally complex negotiation.
context:
Title: Blazing Night
Description: A young female student in desperate need of money contacts a surgeon about selling her eggs, leading to a tense and morally complex negotiation.

INT. HOSPITAL EMERGENCY ROOM ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Ambulance sirens wail.

Medical staff rush forward pushing a stretcher.

CROWD
Make way, make way!

FAMILY MEMBER (O.S.)
Doctor, save them!

NURSE (O.S.)
Notify Dr. Shi immediately!

INT. OPERATING ROOM - NIGHT

FAST CUTS: surgical lights, surgical instruments, syringes, disinfection, scalpel cutting skin, heartbeat lines on the monitor.

The "Surgery in Progress" light is on.

SHI LIN, wearing a mask and glasses, performs surgery with focused eyes.

SHI LIN
Foreign object removed.

SHI LIN
Suture.

The surgery ends.

SHI LIN
Thank you all for your hard work.

SHI LIN removes his surgical gown and mask, walking out of the operating room. ON SCREEN TEXT appears: Beicheng Hospital, Deputy Director of Surgery, Shi Lin.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL STAFF LOUNGE - NIGHT

SHI LIN pours coffee. A phone rings from his bag.

INT. SHI LIN'S ROOM - NIGHT

SHI LIN answers the persistently ringing phone.

SHI LIN
Hello?

INT. LIN MIAN'S ROOM - NIGHT

LIN MIAN, a young woman, sits on her bed, nervously gripping her phone. Medical bills visible on her desk. ON SCREEN TEXT appears: Beicheng University, Architecture and Design Department, Freshman, Lin Mian.

LIN MIAN
(voice trembling)
You... hello, I want to sell my eggs.

SHI LIN
What?

LIN MIAN
I'd like to ask, is it true you pay a hundred thousand yuan for one time?

SHI LIN
You have the wrong number.

LIN MIAN
(urgently)
Sir, I'm completely sincere. I really need the money. I won't report you to the police, and I'll help you keep it secret. Can you... give me a chance?

INT. HOSPITAL NURSES' STATION - DAY

LIN MIAN stands at the nurses' station. SHI LIN in a white coat walks past her, looking at a medical chart in his hands.

LIN MIAN
Excuse me, I'd like to inquire about egg donation.

NURSE
We don't do that, young lady. It's illegal.

LIN MIAN
(desperately)
I really have no other option...

SHI LIN's steps slow slightly, then continue.

INT. SHI LIN'S ROOM - NIGHT

Back to the scene of SHI LIN on the phone.

SHI LIN
Are you clean?

LIN MIAN (V.O.)
What?

SHI LIN
If you're clean, we can talk. Otherwise, don't bother.

LIN MIAN (V.O.)
I'm clean. I have medical records.

SHI LIN
Octagon City, Building 6, Unit 1009. Sunday, 8PM.

INT. LIN MIAN'S ROOM - NIGHT

LIN MIAN falls silent, holding a small yellow card in her hand that reads "Highly Educated Women Preferred - One Hundred Thousand Per Time."

SHI LIN (V.O.)
Why so quiet? If you don't have the guts, don't fantasize about making big money. Go to bed.

LIN MIAN
(determined)
I'll come.

FADE OUT.

LIN MIAN, a young woman, sits on her bed, nervously gripping her phone. Medical bills visible on her desk. ON SCREEN TEXT appears: Beicheng University, Architecture and Design Department, Freshman, Lin Mian.

LIN MIAN
(voice trembling)
You... hello, I want to sell my eggs.

SHI LIN
What?

LIN MIAN
I'd like to ask, is it true you pay a hundred thousand yuan for one time?

SHI LIN
You have the wrong number.

LIN MIAN
(urgently)
Sir, I'm completely sincere. I really need the money. I won't report you to the police, and I'll help you keep it secret. Can you... give me a chance?

INT. HOSPITAL NURSES' STATION - DAY

LIN MIAN stands at the nurses' station. SHI LIN in a white coat walks past her, looking at a medical chart in his hands.

LIN MIAN
Excuse me, I'd like to inquire about egg donation.

NURSE
We don't do that, young lady. It's illegal.

LIN MIAN
(desperately)
I really have no other option...

SHI LIN's steps slow slightly, then continue.

INT. SHI LIN'S ROOM - NIGHT

Back to the scene of SHI LIN on the phone.

SHI LIN
Are you clean?

LIN MIAN (V.O.)
What?

SHI LIN
If you're clean, we can talk. Otherwise, don't bother.

LIN MIAN (V.O.)
I'm clean. I have medical records.

SHI LIN
Octagon City, Building 6, Unit 1009. Sunday, 8PM.

INT. LIN MIAN'S ROOM - NIGHT

LIN MIAN falls silent, holding a small yellow card in her hand that reads "Highly Educated Women Preferred - One Hundred Thousand Per Time."

SHI LIN (V.O.)
Why so quiet? If you don't have the guts, don't fantasize about making big money. Go to bed.

LIN MIAN
(determined)
I'll come.

FADE OUT.

title: Hot Dad Returns to 18
description: A wealthy CEO is murdered by his scheming wife and his soul enters the body of a bullied high school student, giving him a chance to protect his daughter.
context:
Title: Hot Dad Returns to 18
Description: A wealthy CEO is murdered by his scheming wife and his soul enters the body of a bullied high school student, giving him a chance to protect his daughter.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

CHU TIAN (40s, tailored suit, exhaustion etched in his features) watches a viral video on his phone: his daughter CHU NUO (17) screaming "I hate you!" in a crowded mall before storming off.

CHU TIAN
A circus. She's working at a circus.

SHEN BINGYAN (30s, immaculate, pearls glowing softly) materializes beside him, offering a wine glass. Her grip lingers.

SHEN BINGYAN
She's testing the walls you built. Like any caged animal.

CHU TIAN
(accepting the glass)
I wanted her to have a normal life. Not this gilded prison.

SHEN BINGYAN
You wanted her to have a life you never did. Not many fathers would hide their wealth to let their daughter struggle.

She says it with practiced warmth. Chu Tian's shoulders loosen slightly.

CHU TIAN
You're the only one who understands the cost.

He pulls her close. Over his shoulder, her smile disappears.

INT. BALCONY - NIGHT

Shen Bingyan stands by the railing, phone in hand. The city sprawls below like a conquered kingdom. Chu Tian joins her, swirling his wine.

SHEN BINGYAN
The board meeting recording cut off early. Did you need it for the auditors?

CHU TIAN
(frowning)
Why do you ask?

SHEN BINGYAN
(turning)
Because they're questioning your recent decisions. The charity fund. The offshore accounts. The amended will that leaves everything to a daughter who publicly disowns you.

CHU TIAN
The will protects Nuo from me. From what I built.

SHEN BINGYAN's voice drops to ice.

SHEN BINGYAN
What about protecting me? Fifteen years of whispering the right lies, smiling at the right events, swallowing my own dreams—

CHU TIAN
You have everything—

SHEN BINGYAN
I have NOTHING! No children. No company. While your bastard daughter inherits a kingdom?

Chu Tian stumbles. The glass shatters against marble.

CHU TIAN
(gasping)
The wine... you've been...

SHEN BINGYAN
(quietly)
Three months of arsenic, darling. Tonight was the final dose.

She grabs his throat with surgeon's precision.

SHEN BINGYAN
(whispering)
I'll kill her too. After I watch you fall.
continuation:
EXT. BACK ALLEY - NIGHT

LUO CHEN (17, overweight, glasses cracked) curls fetal as THREE BULLIES rain kicks on him. His diary pages scatter.

BULLY 1
Read it. The part about her smile.

BULLY 2
(flipping pages)
"Chu Nuo's laugh is the only thing that makes this hell bearable—"

LUO CHEN
(bloody, desperate)
Stop... please...

BULLY 3
You don't write that about Bai Shao's girl, fat boy. That's a death sentence.

Luo Chen's phone buzzes—Chu Nuo's photo lights the screen. A text: "on my way, stay there."

BULLY 1 spots it.

BULLY 1
Shit. He actually knows her.

He stops kicking. The others freeze.

CHU TIAN's body plummets past the building edge far above. At that exact instant, Luo Chen's skull cracks against concrete.

A SILENT PULSE ripples through the air. Chu Tian's eyes snap open—inside Luo Chen's body. He convulses once.

CHU TIAN (AS LUO CHEN)
(choked)
Nuo Nuo... I'm here...

Both bodies lie still in the alley.

BULLY 2
(panicking)
Is he breathing?

BULLY 1
(seeing Chu Tian's body at the end of the alley)
What the— RUN!

They scatter. Luo Chen's phone glows—Chu Nuo's text: "Almost there."

EXT. BACK ALLEY - MOMENTS LATER

CHU NUO sprints in, breathless. She sees Luo Chen first—his battered face vaguely familiar from school assemblies. Then her father's body crumpled twenty feet away. Her legs buckle.

CHU NUO
(whisper)
Daddy...

She crawls to Chu Tian, trembling fingers at his neck. No pulse. A soundless scream tears from her throat.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - MORNING

LUO CHEN (CHU TIAN) wakes to beeping monitors. His body feels wrong—heavier, aching in unfamiliar places. He sees CHU NUO asleep in a plastic chair, clutching his hand.

CHU TIAN (AS LUO CHEN)
(whisper)
Nuo Nuo...

Chu Nuo jerks awake. Her eyes are hollow, but she forces a smile.

CHU NUO
Luo Chen. Thank God.

She helps him sit up, gently fitting his cracked glasses onto his face. The world sharpens—he catches his reflection in the dark window: a stranger's face. Luo Chen's face.

CHU NUO
(quietly)
You were clutching this.

She holds up a blood-stained business card: CHU TIAN, CEO. His card. The edge is torn where he scratched a note.

CHU TIAN (AS LUO CHEN)
(heart stopping)
How did I—

CHU NUO
You must have found him. Tried to help.

Her voice breaks. She touches the card gently.

CHU NUO
But you kept calling him "Dad." Why?

Chu Tian stares at his new hands—Luo Chen's hands—that held his daughter's card. And his secret.

CHU TIAN (AS LUO CHEN)
(softly)
I... don't know.

title: Photo Deletion
description: A girl discovers a mysterious instant camera at an old junk shop that can make people disappear forever, while a security guard encounters supernatural danger during his night patrol.
context:
Title: Photo Deletion
Description: A girl discovers a mysterious instant camera at an old junk shop that can make people disappear forever, while a security guard encounters supernatural danger during his night patrol.

EXT. JUNK SHOP - DAY

Rain drizzles on a narrow alley. XIAO WEN walks toward the weathered storefront of "Jizhou Junk Bookstore."

XIAO WEN enters, clutching a creased photograph.

INT. JUNK SHOP - DAY

The interior is dimly lit, filled with forgotten items. Dust motes drift in the weak light.

XIAO WEN moves through the narrow aisles. She stops at a pristine white Kodak instant camera on a shelf, oddly free of dust.

The JUNK SHOP OWNER appears behind her.

JUNK SHOP OWNER
That one doesn't just capture moments. It releases them.

XIAO WEN
(quietly)
That's exactly what I need.

She pockets the camera, her knuckles white around the photograph.
continuation:
EXT. RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITY GARDEN - NIGHT

Fog rolls through manicured hedges. SECURITY CAPTAIN and REN XIAOHAO patrol with dim flashlights.

SECURITY CAPTAIN
(reciting, voice low)
Dark moon, high wind—

REN XIAOHAO
(looking pained)
Boss, my grandma's scarier than any ghost story.

SECURITY CAPTAIN
(grinning)
Exactly. Ghosts can't fire you. I can.

A CAT YOWLS in the distance. The Captain's flashlight beam catches something—he freezes, pointing ahead. He vanishes with a soft POP, his cap left spinning on the ground.

REN XIAOHAO
Boss? This isn't—

Realization hits. Ren snatches the cap, his breath hitching.

Another cry—desperate. Ren follows the sound into the bushes, finds a black cat tangled in blue rope.

REN XIAOHAO
There you go, off you go.

He crouches, takes out a box cutter, carefully cuts the rope. The cat purrs, nuzzling his hand.

Behind him, XIAO WEN emerges, camera raised. The cat HISSES.

Just as Ren stands, the camera FLASHES. Ren stumbles back, something tightening around his neck.

A photograph ejects—his own face developing, eyes wide with terror.

title: Love Deepens with Time
description: A woman ends her five-year role as a stand-in lover and seeks freedom, but her former partner refuses to let her go.
context:
Title: Love Deepens with Time
Description: A woman ends her five-year role as a stand-in lover and seeks freedom, but her former partner refuses to let her go.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Under purple lighting, the atmosphere is intimate.

JI MINGCHUAN reaches out his hand, his watch reading 23:47.

JI MINGCHUAN
Don't move.

JI MINGCHUAN covers YUN RUYAN's eyes with a black lace blindfold and leans down to kiss her. His thumb traces the edge of the fabric—a familiar ritual.

As music plays, the two interact intimately.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

JI MINGCHUAN wakes up in bed, adjusting his black shirt. He reaches for the other side—empty, cold.

YUN RUYAN sits on the bed behind him, fully dressed, a document folder beside her.

YUN RUYAN
Mr. Ji. Please settle the final payment.

JI MINGCHUAN
(contemptuously)
What final payment?

YUN RUYAN
Five years as Su Wenwen's substitute. The contract expires today. Let's not make this ugly.

JI MINGCHUAN stands up, takes out a bank card from his pocket, and extends it toward YUN RUYAN.

JI MINGCHUAN
This is ten million. I want to renew.

JI MINGCHUAN tosses the card onto the bed. It lands on her document folder.

JI MINGCHUAN
(over his shoulder)
You were never just a substitute.

He leaves the room. Yun Ruyan picks up the bank card, a mocking smile appearing at the corner of her mouth.

YUN RUYAN (V.O.)
Renew a ghost story? No, thank you.
continuation:
EXT. AIRPORT/CITY - DAY

YUN RUYAN, now wearing a fashionable denim outfit and sunglasses, pulls a yellow suitcase and leaves with confidence. Her reflection in the glass shows a woman unrecognizable to herself.

YUN RUYAN (V.O.)
Goodbye, Ji Mingchuan. And goodbye to the woman I was.

CLOSE-UP: YUN RUYAN deletes JI MINGCHUAN's contact from her phone. She deletes the backup. Then she removes the SIM card and drops it in a trash bin.

Establishing shot of the city at night.

INT. JI MINGCHUAN'S VILLA - DAY

JI MINGCHUAN, wearing a brown suit, returns home and looks around. Her absence is a physical weight.

JI MINGCHUAN
Uncle Ma! Where is Yun Ruyan?

The butler, UNCLE MA, walks over with a sealed envelope.

UNCLE MA
Miss Yun left early this morning. She asked me to give you this.

JI MINGCHUAN
(shocked)
She left?

Ji Mingchuan opens the envelope: inside is the bank card and his house key.

UNCLE MA
She said, 'Tell Mr. Ji the contract is fulfilled. Paid in full.'

JI MINGCHUAN sits on the sofa, takes out his phone, and makes a call. The call cannot connect.

PHONE PROMPT (V.O.)
The number you have dialed is temporarily unavailable.

JI MINGCHUAN dials again, but still gets a busy signal. He angrily puts down his phone.

JI MINGCHUAN
(through gritted teeth)
Yun Ruyan!

JI MINGCHUAN
(ordering Uncle Ma)
Find her. Not by force—find where she chose to go. And bring her back.

INT. BAR - NIGHT

YUN RUYAN arrives at a lively bar, her face showing the smile of newfound freedom. She sits alone, owning the space.

YUN RUYAN (V.O.)
Finally free. Tonight I drink for myself.

A man in a white Chinese-style shirt, JIANG JUN, walks toward her with two friends. He stops, studying her.

JIANG JUN
(flippantly)
Well, well. The real Yun Ruyan emerges.

YUN RUYAN stops and looks at him coldly. Her smile doesn't fade—it sharpens.

YUN RUYAN
And you're still chasing ghosts.

She raises her glass in mock salute.

YUN RUYAN
Careful, Jiang Jun. This one bites back.

title: The Betrayal
description: A musician is betrayed by his wife and manager, who exploit him through a reality show and steal his work.
context:
Title: The Betrayal
Description: A musician is betrayed by his wife and manager, who exploit him through a reality show and steal his work.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

JI HENG and MENG LING run desperately ahead, pursued by a mob of REPORTERS and FANS.

PURSUER (O.S.)
There! By the corner!

PURSUER 1
That's him? The guy from "Unbroken Vows"? He looked taller on screen.

PURSUER 2
They just posted a reconciliation video an hour ago! Five million views and half the comments are calling it staged!

A FAN rushes from a rideshare, phone glowing.

FAN
We defended you for weeks! Was it all for merchandise sales?

REPORTERS and FANS surround JI HENG, shoving equipment in his face.

REPORTERS
(talking over each other)
Ji Heng! Your DMs leaked—Meng Ling's planning a livestream partnership? Your new song's copyright transfer is dated before the show even aired?

JI HENG retreats, shielding his face.

REPORTERS
(continuing)
The metadata doesn't lie, Mr. Ji! Was the entire show a pretext?

JI HENG
(breaking)
I trusted her! I thought—

JI HENG pushes through and flees.

REPORTER
Three-part question!
continuation:
INT. JI HENG'S HOUSE - NIGHT

JI HENG bursts through the door, collapsing on the sofa. He picks up the remote.

TV displays a freeze-frame from "Unbroken Vows"—him and Meng Ling in their kitchen, apparently reconciling. The caption reads: "Day 12: Healing Begins."

JI HENG (V.O.) (TV audio)
(quietly)
Once we finish these episodes... can we stop performing?

TV screen fills with comments: "Calculated." "Check the filing dates." "His songwriting credits are gone."

JI HENG
(agitated)
The episodes aren't even aired yet...

He throws the remote. It thunks against the TV frame.

MENG LING enters with YANG CHENG. Meng Ling carries a document folder.

YANG CHENG
(to Meng Ling)
The trending hashtag's holding steady. Good timing.

MENG LING
(to Ji Heng, measuring her words)
You ran. That was a mistake. We could've controlled the narrative.

JI HENG
(standing)
Controlled? You said this was about saving our marriage.

MENG LING sets the folder on the coffee table.

MENG LING
I am saving what's savable. The song's being released next week.

JI HENG
My song. The one I wrote about—

MENG LING
(interrupting)
The one you wrote while contractually employed. Read the amendment.

JI HENG flips through pages. His hands shake.

JI HENG
You signed this for me. Last month. You said it was a performance license for the show.

MENG LING
I said it was necessary for the show. The show is necessary for our brand.

YANG CHENG
(smoothly)
Your voice doesn't test as well as mine in the demo, Ji Heng. Be reasonable.

JI HENG
You... you sang the guide vocal...

MENG LING
We're a team. Your composition, Yang Cheng's platform. The residuals will keep us comfortable.

JI HENG
Us? There is no us!

MENG LING
There is when I sign the checks.

She raises her hand—not to strike, but to silence. He flinches. She lowers it, seeing his reaction. A beat of terrible clarity.

MENG LING
(quietly, finally)
Don't make this harder than it is.

YANG CHENG watches the power shift, satisfied.

Description: A musician is betrayed by his wife and manager, who exploit him through a reality show and steal his work.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

JI HENG and MENG LING run desperately ahead, pursued by a mob of REPORTERS and FANS.

PURSUER (O.S.)
There! By the corner!

PURSUER 1
That's him? The guy from "Unbroken Vows"? He looked taller on screen.

PURSUER 2
They just posted a reconciliation video an hour ago! Five million views and half the comments are calling it staged!

A FAN rushes from a rideshare, phone glowing.

FAN
We defended you for weeks! Was it all for merchandise sales?

REPORTERS and FANS surround JI HENG, shoving equipment in his face.

REPORTERS
(talking over each other)
Ji Heng! Your DMs leaked—Meng Ling's planning a livestream partnership? Your new song's copyright transfer is dated before the show even aired?

JI HENG retreats, shielding his face.

REPORTERS
(continuing)
The metadata doesn't lie, Mr. Ji! Was the entire show a pretext?

JI HENG
(breaking)
I trusted her! I thought—

JI HENG pushes through and flees.

REPORTER
Three-part question!

INT. JI HENG'S HOUSE - NIGHT

JI HENG bursts through the door, collapsing on the sofa. He picks up the remote.

TV displays a freeze-frame from "Unbroken Vows"—him and Meng Ling in their kitchen, apparently reconciling. The caption reads: "Day 12: Healing Begins."

JI HENG (V.O.) (TV audio)
(quietly)
Once we finish these episodes... can we stop performing?

TV screen fills with comments: "Calculated." "Check the filing dates." "His songwriting credits are gone."

JI HENG
(agitated)
The episodes aren't even aired yet...

He throws the remote. It thunks against the TV frame.

MENG LING enters with YANG CHENG. Meng Ling carries a document folder.

YANG CHENG
(to Meng Ling)
The trending hashtag's holding steady. Good timing.

MENG LING
(to Ji Heng, measuring her words)
You ran. That was a mistake. We could've controlled the narrative.

JI HENG
(standing)
Controlled? You said this was about saving our marriage.

MENG LING sets the folder on the coffee table.

MENG LING
I am saving what's savable. The song's being released next week.

JI HENG
My song. The one I wrote about—

MENG LING
(interrupting)
The one you wrote while contractually employed. Read the amendment.

JI HENG flips through pages. His hands shake.

JI HENG
You signed this for me. Last month. You said it was a performance license for the show.

MENG LING
I said it was necessary for the show. The show is necessary for our brand.

YANG CHENG
(smoothly)
Your voice doesn't test as well as mine in the demo, Ji Heng. Be reasonable.

JI HENG
You... you sang the guide vocal...

MENG LING
We're a team. Your composition, Yang Cheng's platform. The residuals will keep us comfortable.

JI HENG
Us? There is no us!

MENG LING
There is when I sign the checks.

She raises her hand—not to strike, but to silence. He flinches. She lowers it, seeing his reaction. A beat of terrible clarity.

MENG LING
(quietly, finally)
Don't make this harder than it is.

YANG CHENG watches the power shift, satisfied.

title: Love Like Blossoms on Brocade
description: A mother-in-law discovers her daughter-in-law is pregnant and desperately tries to secure funds for a life-saving procedure, but a misunderstanding leads to shocking accusations.
context:
Title: Love Like Blossoms on Brocade
Description: A mother-in-law discovers her daughter-in-law is pregnant and desperately tries to secure funds for a life-saving procedure, but a misunderstanding leads to shocking accusations.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

MIAO SHULAN stands anxiously before a DOCTOR, clutching a medical file.

MIAO SHULAN
Doctor, you must think of a way. This is the last bloodline of our Li family.

DOCTOR
(showing her a form)
Severe preeclampsia with placental insufficiency. We need immediate intervention. The procedure costs 550,000 yuan. And it requires the patient's mother or mother-in-law to sign consent.

MIAO SHULAN
(firmly)
I'll sign. No matter the cost.

Behind a half-open door, a WOMAN IN RED COAT (GOSSIPING WOMAN) strains to listen.

GOSSIPING WOMAN (V.O.)
(contemptuously)
Miao Shulan? Spending 550,000 on a pregnancy? I'm telling Yingying.

MIAO SHULAN studies the file, a relieved smile appearing.

MIAO SHULAN (V.O.)
The baby can be saved. Yaohui's father is watching from above. I must preserve this bloodline.

MIAO SHULAN
Doctor, when I signed earlier, I put my name on the wrong line.

DOCTOR
That's fine. As long as the patient herself confirms before the procedure, it's valid.

MIAO SHULAN
(relief washing over her)
Good. I'll bring her tomorrow.

INT. MAHJONG PARLOR - DAY

XU YINGYING and MAHJONG FRIENDS play. The GOSSIPING WOMAN rushes in, whispering.

XU YINGYING
(shocked, standing up)
What? Miao Shulan is spending 550,000 on a pregnancy?

GOSSIPING WOMAN
I saw the consent form. Her signature. The doctor said "Li family bloodline" and "high-risk pregnancy."

XU YINGYING
550,000?

GOSSIPING WOMAN
(leaning in, speaking softly)
She's already sold your house. And called her boss for money.

XU YINGYING
(angrily)
I have to go home.

She pushes the mahjong tiles away.

XU YINGYING
I'm not playing anymore.
continuation:
EXT. REAL ESTATE AGENCY/STREET - DAY

MIAO SHULAN stands before a real estate window, her expression grave. Then she walks down the street looking dejected.

MIAO SHULAN (V.O.)
The house only sold for 400,000. I still need 150,000 more.

A flashback of the doctor's warning flashes through her mind.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Aunt Miao, remember—the procedure must happen before 20 weeks. Any delay, and we could lose both mother and child.

MIAO SHULAN stops and takes out her phone to make a call.

MIAO SHULAN
(into the phone)
General Manager Jiang, sorry to bother you. Could I advance 150,000 yuan from my salary? I just secured the Chengdong contract for the company.

GENERAL MANAGER JIANG (O.S.)
You've worked for us fifteen years. Consider it done. The money will be wired today.

MIAO SHULAN
(gratefully)
Thank you. I'm very grateful.

GENERAL MANAGER JIANG (O.S.)
Take care of your family.

MIAO SHULAN hangs up the phone, clutching it tightly, breathing a sigh of relief.

MIAO SHULAN (V.O.)
At least now I have enough.

She turns around, a hopeful smile on her face. In the distance, XU YINGYING is walking toward her with an unfriendly expression.

INT. HOME - DAY

MIAO SHULAN enters the house happily, carrying groceries. Her son LI YAOHUI and daughter-in-law XU YINGYING are sitting at the table.

MIAO SHULAN
Everyone's here. Perfect timing. I bought lots of vegetables today, and even an old hen to make soup to nourish you both.

XU YINGYING
(coldly)
Nourish us, or nourish yourself?

MIAO SHULAN
(smiling)
Of course it's to nourish you.

LI YAOHUI (V.O.)
What's going on?

XU YINGYING
(standing up, arms crossed)
Miao Shulan, you're quite the actress, aren't you? Such a huge thing happened, you kept it from us, borrowed money and sold the house on your own, and came back acting like nothing happened.

MIAO SHULAN
(stunned for a moment)
You all know? I was just about to give you a surprise.

MIAO SHULAN takes out the consent forms from her bag.

XU YINGYING
Of course you hoped we wouldn't find out. Miao Shulan, you usually seem so honest and proper, but I never imagined that at your age, you'd actually get pregnant!

MIAO SHULAN's hand holding the forms freezes in mid-air, her face filled with shock and disbelief.

MIAO SHULAN
(stunned)
What? I'm pregnant?

title: Love You Like Brilliant Stars
description: A wounded young master is saved by a mysterious woman in a forest. Three months later, he searches for her to repay his debt, only to discover she is the daughter of a prominent family who has lost part of her memory.
context:
Title: Love You Like Brilliant Stars
Description: A wounded young master is saved by a mysterious woman in a forest. Three months later, he searches for her to repay his debt, only to discover she is the daughter of a prominent family who has lost part of her memory.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

Muddy ground after rain. A pair of feet run frantically past, splashing water.

LIN YUE (male lead) clutches his bleeding abdomen, running desperately through the dim forest. He wears a dark jacket and white T-shirt.

ON SCREEN: Lin Family Young Master - Lin Yue

PURSUER A (O.S.)
Stop! Let's see where you can run!

LIN YUE glances back and continues stumbling forward.

He hides in a dense thicket.

Two PURSUERS in black, carrying knives, arrive.

PURSUER A
He disappeared in just a moment.

PURSUER B
He's injured. He can't get far.

PURSUER A
Check the perimeter.

The two PURSUERS move past his hiding spot.

LIN YUE hides behind the bushes, breathing painfully. Suddenly, a hand covers his mouth. It's QIAO RAN (female lead), wearing a face mask and medical backpack.

LIN YUE (V.O.)
Those eyes...

QIAO RAN confirms the pursuers have left, then releases her hand.

QIAO RAN
They're gone. You're safe now.

LIN YUE, weakened by exhaustion and fever, collapses onto QIAO RAN's shoulder.

QIAO RAN
Hey, what are you...

QIAO RAN supports him and touches his forehead.

QIAO RAN
You have a fever.

She sees the wound on LIN YUE's abdomen and is about to examine it when LIN YUE suddenly grabs her wrist.

LIN YUE
What are you doing?

QIAO RAN
Saving you. Let go.

LIN YUE releases her hand. QIAO RAN opens her medical kit, takes out tools, and begins treating his wound—disinfecting, applying medicine, and bandaging. Her movements are professional and swift.

After a while, QIAO RAN touches his forehead again.

QIAO RAN
The fever's gone down.

QIAO RAN packs up her medical kit and prepares to leave. LIN YUE grabs her hand and places a bullet casing in her palm, then closes her hand around it.

LIN YUE
Take this. I will find you to repay this debt.

LIN YUE (V.O.)
Strange. I don't seem to mind her touch.

In the distance, the pursuers return.

PURSUER B
Let's go!

QIAO RAN hears the sound and looks back in terror. A PURSUER raises his knife and stabs toward her.

In the nick of time, LIN YUE turns and holds QIAO RAN tightly in his arms, using his back to block the incoming blade. He groans in pain.
continuation:
INT. UPSCALE BAR - DAY

ON SCREEN: Three months later

LIN YUE, wearing a sharp suit, sits at the bar counter, elegantly swirling a wine glass. His SUBORDINATE hurries over.

SUBORDINATE
Young Master.

LIN YUE
Did you find her?

SUBORDINATE
Yes. Qiao Ran—Qiao family daughter. Volunteer doctor. The clinic confirmed her medical bag was slashed that night. Supply records match.

LIN YUE
Memory?

SUBORDINATE
Delayed evacuation. Brain hypoxia. She doesn't remember the incident.

LIN YUE puts down his wine glass.

LIN YUE
Hotel.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

QIAO RAN, wearing a beige suit, pulls her suitcase while studying her phone screen—a photo of a woman, then a hotel map. She checks handwritten notes, confused.

ON SCREEN: Qiao Family Daughter - Qiao Ran

She turns around, accidentally bumping into LIN YUE who is walking toward her. Her phone falls to the ground.

LIN YUE quickly catches her.

Their eyes meet. He searches her face; she meets his gaze politely, no recognition.

QIAO RAN
Sorry, I'm so sorry.

QIAO RAN pulls away from him and crouches down to pick up her things. LIN YUE suddenly grabs her wrist.

QIAO RAN looks up in surprise.

LIN YUE looks at her, a smile playing at the corner of his mouth.

LIN YUE
Found you.

title: Hai Tong
description: A kind-hearted young woman helps a lost elderly lady at a night market, unknowingly meeting the grandmother of a powerful CEO.
context:
Title: Hai Tong
Description: A kind-hearted young woman helps a lost elderly lady at a night market, unknowingly meeting the grandmother of a powerful CEO.

INT. CONVENIENCE STORE - NIGHT

HAI TONG (20s, plain clothes, baseball cap, towel around her neck) hauls the final case of bottled water through the door, her arms trembling with exhaustion. She sets it down with a soft thud, forcing a tired smile.

HAI TONG
Last case. That's ten total.

She wipes sweat from her brow, pulls out her phone. The screen shows three unread messages about overdue bills. She pockets it quickly.

HAI TONG
Five yuan, right?

The BOSS nods, scans her payment code without looking up. The transaction pings.

EXT. NIGHT MARKET - SAUSAGE STAND - NIGHT

GRANDMA ZHAN (70s, elegant coat, silver hair) watches sausages sizzle, her stomach growling audibly.

GRANDMA ZHAN
One, please.

VENDOR
Five yuan. Pay first.

GRANDMA ZHAN
My grandson will settle up. He always does.

VENDOR
(eyes narrowing)
No cash, no food. That's the rule.

GRANDMA ZHAN
I seem to have misplaced my purse...

VENDOR
(muttering)
Great. Another time-waster.

He turns his back, dismissing her. Grandma Zhan wobbles, clutching the stand for support.

HAI TONG
(O.S.)
Hey!

She catches Grandma Zhan's elbow just as she stumbles.

HAI TONG
Got you. You okay?

GRANDMA ZHAN
(studying Hai Tong's face)
You have her eyes. Same kindness.

HAI TONG
(confused)
I'm sorry?

GRANDMA ZHAN
My granddaughter-in-law. Before she... well. You remind me of her.

HAI TONG
(softening)
Oh. No, I'm just—I'm nobody.

Hai Tong glances at her phone wallpaper: a photo of her with an elderly woman.

HAI TONG
(to Vendor)
Two sausages. On my account.

VENDOR
You got an account now?

HAI TONG
(icy smile)
I do now.

She slaps a crumpled five and singles on the counter. The vendor grunts, but starts cooking.

HAI TONG
(to Grandma Zhan, gentle)
They'll be ready in a minute. No chili, right?

GRANDMA ZHAN
continuation:
How did you know?

HAI TONG
My grandmother couldn't handle spice either.

The vendor passes the sausages. Hai Tong hands them over, then hesitates. She pulls out the last of her cash—three singles.

HAI TONG
For the bus. Or... whatever you need.

GRANDMA ZHAN
I couldn't.

HAI TONG
Please. I'd want someone to help my nai nai if she were lost.

Hai Tong grabs a napkin, scribbles quickly.

HAI TONG
My number. If you get stuck again.

She presses napkin and cash into Grandma Zhan's hand.

HAI TONG
Gotta run. Last delivery.

Hai Tong sprints toward a beat-up electric scooter, hops on, and vanishes into the crowd.

Grandma Zhan watches her go, then looks at the napkin. A slow, knowing smile spreads across her face.

GRANDMA ZHAN
(whispers)
Hai Tong.

EXT. NIGHT MARKET STREET - CONTINUOUS

A black sedan with tinted windows glides to the curb. Two SECURITY GUARDS step out, efficient and calm.

SECURITY GUARD
Madam Zhan. Your grandson is concerned.

PASSERBY A
(whispering)
Is that...?

PASSERBY B
Zhan Group. Must be.

ZHAN YIN (30s, sharp suit, controlled intensity) emerges from the car, scanning the crowd with barely contained anxiety.

ZHAN YIN
Grandmother. You disappeared for two hours.

GRANDMA ZHAN
I was making a strategic investment.

ZHAN YIN
(sighs)
The doctor said—

GRANDMA ZHAN
—I'm fine. Better than fine.

She holds up the napkin like a winning lottery ticket.

GRANDMA ZHAN
I found the one.

ZHAN YIN
(pained)
We've talked about this. You can't just—

GRANDMA ZHAN
Oh, hush. She's different. I have receipts.

She waves the cash Hai Tong gave her.

GRANDMA ZHAN
Dinner tomorrow. Seven o'clock. You're driving.

She hobbles toward the car, leaving Zhan Yin staring at the napkin.

ZHAN YIN
(to himself)
Hai Tong. Jesus.

He follows, already pulling out his phone.

Hai Tong sprints toward a beat-up electric scooter, hops on, and vanishes into the crowd.

Grandma Zhan watches her go, then looks at the napkin. A slow, knowing smile spreads across her face.

GRANDMA ZHAN
(whispers)
Hai Tong.

EXT. NIGHT MARKET STREET - CONTINUOUS

A black sedan with tinted windows glides to the curb. Two SECURITY GUARDS step out, efficient and calm.

SECURITY GUARD
Madam Zhan. Your grandson is concerned.

PASSERBY A
(whispering)
Is that...?

PASSERBY B
Zhan Group. Must be.

ZHAN YIN (30s, sharp suit, controlled intensity) emerges from the car, scanning the crowd with barely contained anxiety.

ZHAN YIN
Grandmother. You disappeared for two hours.

GRANDMA ZHAN
I was making a strategic investment.

ZHAN YIN
(sighs)
The doctor said—

GRANDMA ZHAN
—I'm fine. Better than fine.

She holds up the napkin like a winning lottery ticket.

GRANDMA ZHAN
I found the one.

ZHAN YIN
(pained)
We've talked about this. You can't just—

GRANDMA ZHAN
Oh, hush. She's different. I have receipts.

She waves the cash Hai Tong gave her.

GRANDMA ZHAN
Dinner tomorrow. Seven o'clock. You're driving.

She hobbles toward the car, leaving Zhan Yin staring at the napkin.

ZHAN YIN
(to himself)
Hai Tong. Jesus.

He follows, already pulling out his phone.

Title: Love in the Eighties (Episode 74)
Description: A middle-aged woman attends a dating show and faces ridiculous demands from male contestants, until a sincere security guard offers her genuine companionship.

INT. DATING SHOW STAGE - DAY

A brightly lit studio decorated with pink flowers, full of romantic atmosphere. The HOST stands at the side of the stage.

HOST
Please welcome our female guest number one, from Haicheng, forty-eight years old, Ms. Song!

Music plays. The door opens. In the bright light, SONG HAILIAN (48, elegant but visibly nervous) slowly walks to center stage. Three male contestants sit below: LI DASHENG (overdressed, slicked hair), FANG ZHIHAO (tank top, excessive jewelry), and NING JIANYE (crisp suit, practiced smile).

LI DASHENG stands and presses his light-off button.

LI DASHENG
(checking his watch)
Forty-eight? Look, I'm sure you're lovely, but I'm looking for someone who can give me a family. You know, before time runs out.

SONG HAILIAN
(steadying herself)
According to your profile, you're fifty-two. Does your timer have different rules?

LI DASHENG
(smoothing his collar)
Men mature later. It's biology. I'm just being practical.

He sits. FANG ZHIHAO stands and turns his light off.

FANG ZHIHAO
Kids? Already got six. Two different mamas. What I need is a woman who knows how to run a household. You cook, clean, handle the chaos while I build my empire.

SONG HAILIAN
So you're advertising for unpaid staff?

FANG ZHIHAO
(smirking)
Marriage is a partnership. I bring the vision, you bring the order. That's the deal.

He sits. NING JIANYE rises, finger hovering over his button.

NING JIANYE
You misunderstand, gentlemen. A woman of this caliber isn't for conventional needs. My foundation supports artists. You'd be perfect as a hostess for our gatherings. A muse, if you will. My wife understands this arrangement.

SONG HAILIAN
(frost forming in her voice)
An arrangement where I'm decorative and your wife tolerates it? How modern of you.

NING JIANYE
(offended, presses button)
High standards for someone taking such a public risk at your age.
continuation:
INT. COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

ZHAO GUOQIANG (late 50s, security uniform fitting him like a second skin) walks briskly through a marble lobby. Assistant WEN HUI (30s, anxious) trails behind.

WEN HUI
(handing over a radio)
The production team confirmed everything. You're listed as emergency security detail, but sir, this is highly irregular.

ZHAO GUOQIANG
(adjusting his belt)
What's irregular is using wealth as a wall instead of a door. I've read her file. She built her business from nothing after her husband left. She'll spot a fraud in seconds.

WEN HUI
But appearing as a security guard?

ZHAO GUOQIANG
What I am isn't what I wear. If she can't see that, we're both wasting time.

He exits. Wen Hui watches, troubled.

INT. DATING SHOW STAGE - DAY

SONG HAILIAN stands alone under harsh lights, three darkened screens behind her.

SONG HAILIAN (V.O.)
Life partner. The words sound heavier each time I hear them. Not a business merger. Not a caretaker. Just... someone to witness your life while you witness theirs.

A door stage-left cracks open. ZHAO GUOQIANG slips in, surveys the setup, then moves with quiet purpose toward the fourth contestant station.

SONG HAILIAN
(turning to the host)
May I say something?

HOST
Of course.

SONG HAILIAN
(to the darkened screens)
I'm not here to audition for anyone's second act. I built my own stage. I just hoped—

ZHAO GUOQIANG
(from the fourth station, not on camera yet)
Then maybe stop auditioning.

SONG HAILIAN
(startled, searching for the voice)

ZHAO GUOQIANG
(emerging, uniform straight, cap in hand)
Those three turned off their lights. My station was dark before I arrived. Clean slate.

He walks to center stage, addressing the host but looking at her.

ZHAO GUOQIANG
Zhao Guoqiang. Work security for the studio complex. Fifty-six. My daughter says I need to stop talking to the television and talk to real people.

(beat)

I clock in, I do my rounds, I go home to an empty apartment. You're right—building something alone means you get tired of being the only one who knows it exists.

(to Song)
I don't need an heir or a housekeeper or a gallery piece. I need someone who'll ask how my day was and actually want to hear the answer. Maybe we could start with coffee and see if we want to witness each other's lives.

SONG HAILIAN
studies him—the wear in his uniform, the steadiness in his eyes, the absence of performance.

SONG HAILIAN
Coffee sounds like a beginning.

INT. PHOTO STUDIO - DAY

ZHAO GUOQIANG and SONG HAILIAN sit side by side in white shirts, facing the camera. Her hand rests gently on his. A simple gold band catches the light on her finger.

FLASH.

In the frozen moment, they aren't looking at the camera. They're looking at each other, smiling at some private joke.

FADE OUT.

title: Love at Life's Crossroads
description: A dedicated employee discovers her boss has blocked her on social media and credits her work to another woman, leading to a confrontation about stolen achievements and betrayal.
context:
Title: Love at Life's Crossroads
Description: A dedicated employee discovers her boss has blocked her on social media and credits her work to another woman, leading to a confrontation about stolen achievements and betrayal.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

A FEMALE COLLEAGUE approaches MU XIAN, who is working late at her desk.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Mu Xian, check Boss Huo's post. It's... exploded.

MU XIAN takes the phone, then checks her own, confusion hardening into suspicion.

MU XIAN
That's not showing up on my feed.

Screenshots of HUO YUCHEN and LIU JIAOJIAO's social media posts flash on screen.

HUO YUCHEN (V.O.)
Day 1,001 of knowing each other. A surprise arrives.

LIU JIAOJIAO (V.O.)
The most special day. Lucky to have you.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
He blocked you. Look at that ring—must be six figures.

MU XIAN
(quietly)
Go home. I'll handle this.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
Sister Mu...

MU XIAN
Please.

The FEMALE COLLEAGUE leaves. Mu Xian pulls up a file on her laptop: "Wanjing Deal - Final Negotiations." Her name is on every page. She slams the laptop shut.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE HALLWAY - MOMENTS LATER

MU XIAN sees HUO YUCHEN and LIU JIAOJIAO by the elevators.

LIU JIAOJIAO
Next time has to be even bigger.

HUO YUCHEN
Name it.

MU XIAN
Huo Yuchen. The Wanjing contract.

HUO YUCHEN
Jiaojiao closed it. Wire transfer's pending.

MU XIAN
I negotiated those terms. I have the proof from yesterday.

HUO YUCHEN
(coldly)
Every deal she closes, you claim. It's unprofessional jealousy.

LIU JIAOJIAO
(softly)
Sister Mu, if you need this win for your review...

HUO YUCHEN
Don't. She doesn't get to claim your work.

(to Mu Xian)
Tomorrow's celebration is mandatory. You'll draft the proposal. 8 AM. My desk.

INT. OFFICE - CONTINUOUS

LIU JIAOJIAO sets a water bottle on Mu Xian's desk.

LIU JIAOJIAO
Overtime, then party planning. You must be exhausted, Sister Mu. Might want to invest in better foundation tomorrow—for the photos.

Mu Xian's hand shakes. She grabs the bottle and splashes water in LIU JIAOJIAO's face.

LIU JIAOJIAO
(screams)
Ah!

She falls back against the desk.

HUO YUCHEN
(roaring)
What the hell is wrong with you?

HUO YUCHEN rushes over, catching Liu Jiaojiao.

LIU JIAOJIAO
(tearfully)
She saw the ring post, Boss Huo. I tried to apologize...

HUO YUCHEN
(to Mu Xian)
Over a diamond? She's the reason we're not bankrupt. Apologize. Now.

Mu Xian looks at her phone—still showing the blocked feed—then at the water dripping from her hand onto her name tag.

title: Wedding Night
description: On her wedding night, Jiang Yining faces the painful realization that her groom still loves another woman, despite her ninety-nine attempts to win his heart.
context:
Title: Wedding Night
Description: On her wedding night, Jiang Yining faces the painful realization that her groom still loves another woman, despite her ninety-nine attempts to win his heart.

TITLE CARD: WEDDING NIGHT

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

On a red wedding bed, JIANG YINING lies as LI XUN leans over her. His eyes are glazed, sleepwalking through ritual.

LI XUN
Xia Xia... don't leave me.

He kisses her—by rote, not passion. Suddenly, he gasps, clutching his chest. He collapses beside her, shuddering once, then still.

JIANG YINING
Li Xun?

She shakes him. His breathing is ragged but steady. After a long moment, she pulls a silk blanket over him and slips out of bed.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

JIANG YINING sits among wedding gifts. She opens a heart-shaped card: "Thinking of you, loving you, forever and ever. Li Xun."

LI XUN (V.O.)
Xia Xia, don't leave me.

The words echo. Her hands shake. A translucent interface materializes.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Host, critical instability detected. Ning Xia's presence is corrupting the affection index.

JIANG YINING
(whisper)
Ninety-nine times...

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Current reading: forty-seven percent. Recommend timeline termination.

A tear falls, smudging the ink on "forever."

JIANG YINING
(V.O.)
I didn't stay for the conquest.

Footsteps. LI XUN stands in the doorway, pale but conscious. He sees her tears.

LI XUN
A Ning...

He crosses to her, kneels, takes her cold hands.

LI XUN
The room was too hot. I should have thought—tomorrow, humidifier. And I'll take you to Wansheng Hall. For the Seven Treasure Porridge. You asked about it once.

He stands, pulling her up. A pearl rolls from her sleeve into his palm. He stares at it—recognition flickering.

JIANG YINING
(V.O.)
System... I'm staying.

She places her hand in LI XUN's. The interface flickers out.

title: CEO Fu's Inescapable Love and Hate
description: Lin Yiyi, the second daughter of Tianjin Group, watches helplessly as her sister steals her groom on what was supposed to be her wedding day.
context:
Title: CEO Fu's Inescapable Love and Hate
Description: Lin Yiyi, the second daughter of Tianjin Group, watches helplessly as her sister steals her groom on what was supposed to be her wedding day.

INT. PARK - DAY

LIN YIYI sits beneath an ancient oak, her ivory wedding dress pooling around her. She stares at her phone, which displays a photo of FU JINGXUAN.

Her FRIEND, elegant in a crimson dress, kneels before her, visibly distressed.

FRIEND
Your sister's wearing your dress, marrying your man. And you're just... scrolling through memories?

LIN YIYI doesn't answer. A tear lands on her phone screen.

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

An outdoor ceremony is in progress.

The bride, LIN XIAOTONG, wears Lin Yiyi's custom gown and holds a bouquet, triumph in her eyes.

The groom, FU JINGXUAN, stands on stage in a black suit, his gaze fixed on the empty seat where Lin Yiyi should be.

In the guest seating area, FU JINGXUAN'S MOTHER watches with a sharp, expectant expression.

The OFFICIANT stands before the couple.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Fu Jingxuan, do you take Miss Lin Xiaotong as your lawfully wedded wife? In sickness and in health, for richer or poorer?

FU JINGXUAN remains silent, his eyes complex. He glances at his mother.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Fu?

FU JINGXUAN turns back to face LIN XIAOTONG. She gives him an expectant smile.

FU JINGXUAN
(after a weighted pause)
I do.

LIN XIAOTONG's face lights up with a victorious smile.
continuation:
INT. PARK - DAY

LIN YIYI'S FRIEND grasps her arm emotionally.

FRIEND
She forged the paperwork, Yiyi. Your mother approved it—called it "correcting a family mistake." Are you going to let their lies become your truth?

LIN YIYI finally looks up, devastation giving way to something colder.

LIN YIYI
What truth? That I was always the expendable daughter?

EXT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

FU JINGXUAN and LIN XIAOTONG exchange rings. Petals fall from above.

The GUESTS applaud enthusiastically.

GUESTS (O.S.)
Kiss! Kiss! Kiss!

FU JINGXUAN and LIN XIAOTONG lock eyes amid the cheering, slowly leaning closer. He shuts his eyes.

EXT. ROAD - DAY

LIN YIYI breaks free and stumbles toward the road, her expression hollow.

A black sedan speeds toward her.

The piercing sound of brakes screeches.

LIN YIYI is struck and thrown into the air, landing heavily.

She lies on the asphalt, her dress stained, blood trickling from her mouth, eyes staring blankly.

FADE TO BLACK.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Father's Secret
description: On a rainy night, a desperate mother fights to save her child from being sold by her gambling addict husband, while a delivery man with his own hidden trauma intervenes in the tragic confrontation.
context:
Title: Father's Secret
Description: On a rainy night, a desperate mother fights to save her child from being sold by her gambling addict husband, while a delivery man with his own hidden trauma intervenes in the tragic confrontation.

EXT. OUTDOOR STAIRCASE - NIGHT

Torrential rain pounds the concrete stairs. ZHANG HAO (30s, haggard, desperate) runs down holding a SWADDLED INFANT. SU MENG (28, bruised but unbroken) chases.

SU MENG
(screaming)
Hao, don't!

She catches him. They struggle over the crying baby.

ZHANG HAO
(roaring)
I'm his father!

SU MENG
That doesn't make this right!

ZHANG HAO
(shoving her)
I decide what's right!

SU MENG
(hysterically)
The gambling, the drinking, the beatings—I took it all. But not my son!

ZHANG HAO
Shut your mouth!

ZHANG HAO pushes SU MENG to the ground. She gasps, winded.

SU MENG
(crying, crawling forward)

title: A Father's Glory Through His Son
description: A father faces pressure from neighbors over land while awaiting his son's return for Spring Festival, hoping for reconciliation, not rescue.
context:
Title: A Father's Glory Through His Son
Description: A father faces pressure from neighbors over land while awaiting his son's return for Spring Festival, hoping for reconciliation, not rescue.

INT. OLD HOME - DAY

LI JIANGUO (60s) presses a red paper-cut "Fu" on the window, smoothing corners with calloused fingers. Below, LIU YUEYING (50s) chops bok choy, knife steady. A phone shows LI HAOCHENG (29) in an office, holding blueprints.

LI HAOCHENG (V.O.)
Mom, once these purchase orders are signed, I'm coming home.

LIU YUEYING
Your father hung the "Fu" you sent. Says it's finer than the village market's.

She angles the phone toward Jianguo—he turns away.

LI HAOCHENG
(on the phone screen)
Dad still won't talk to me?

LIU YUEYING
He worries about the roads. And... other things.

LI HAOCHENG
(on the phone screen)
I bought train tickets. Arrive tomorrow.

LI JIANGUO
(steps down, dusts hands)
Tell him to check tire pressure. Highway's full of idiots.

LIU YUEYING
(to phone)
Your father cares.

LI HAOCHENG
(on the phone screen)
Loud and clear. Mom, have the lawyers called about the land?

LI JIANGUO
(stiffens)
What lawyers?

LIU YUEYING
Just paperwork. They say our lease renewal... might be complicated.

LI JIANGUO
(grabs phone, voice low)
Is that why you're coming? Because contracts need signing?

LI HAOCHENG
(on the phone screen)
Dad, it's not—

LI JIANGUO
Six years abroad, six months in Shanghai, and now you run home for paperwork.

He hands the phone back, walks out.

LIU YUEYING
(calls after)
Jianguo!

LI HAOCHENG
(on the phone screen)
Mom, I'll fix this. I promise.

The call disconnects. Liu Yueying looks at the solitary "Fu" on the window.
continuation:
EXT. VILLAGE OPEN SPACE - DAY

An excavator idles on Jianguo's plot. NEIGHBOR LI QIUSHENG (60s) and his son LI QINGHUA (32) examine a survey map.

LI QIUSHENG
Jianguo! We're marking Qinghua's workshop foundation. New committee approved it.

LI JIANGUO
Our vegetable plot. Twenty-year lease.

LI QINGHUA
That lease was under old rules. Family with sons living here gets priority.

LIU YUEYING
What does that mean?

LI QIUSHENG
(avoiding eyes)
Your Haocheng... city job. Not village.

LI QINGHUA
(to workers)
Mark the east boundary.

A worker moves forward with spray paint. Jianguo blocks him.

LI JIANGUO
Not one step.

LI QINGHUA
Uncle, don't be stubborn. My brother's kids need space. Your son won't.

LI QINGHUA shoves Jianguo—he stumbles, catches himself with the shovel. Liu Yueying rushes forward, quiet fury in her eyes.

LIU YUEYING
(low, dangerous)
Touch him again, and I'll burn your permits myself.

LI QINGHUA
(laughs)
With what? Promises from Shanghai?

The excavator engine revs. Jianguo stands his ground, the faded "Fu" on his sweater visible.

FADE TO BLACK

INT. OLD HOME - NIGHT

Jianguo sits in the dark. His phone shows a message: "Train arrives midnight."

LIU YUEYING
(softly)
He wouldn't come if he didn't care.

LI JIANGUO
I don't want him fighting my battles.

Three soft KNOCKS—two, then one. The door opens. LI HAOCHENG stands there, holding a folder.

LI HAOCHENG
Dad. I bought the land. Free and clear. In your name.

He opens the folder: a deed to the adjacent fallow acreage, twice the size.

LI HAOCHENG
Qiusheng can have the old plot. We don't need it.

Jianguo looks at the deed, then his son. The "Fu" catches lamplight behind Haocheng.

LI HAOCHENG
I brought something else.
(pulls out a photo)
Mei helped with the survey. She's an architect.
(meets his eyes)
I needed to build a way home first. Not just walls.

LIU YUEYING
(tears falling)
You built a bridge.

Jianguo takes the photo. His hand trembles. He looks at his son—really looks.

LI JIANGUO
(gruffly)
The "Fu" is crooked. Fix it tomorrow.

His hand lingers on Haocheng's shoulder—one brief second.

FADE OUT

title: A Father's Irredeemable Love
description: A general must choose between saving his daughter or protecting the young prince during a deadly ambush, making an agonizing decision that will haunt him forever.
context:
Title: A Father's Irredeemable Love
Description: A general must choose between saving his daughter or protecting the young prince during a deadly ambush, making an agonizing decision that will haunt him forever.

EXT. NIGHT SKY - NIGHT

A bright moon hangs in the cloudy night sky.

EMPEROR (V.O.)
Prince Ning's rebellion finds me dying, Qin Yi. I sent the boy to you, but traitors opened our gates. His life is now your sword to keep.

EXT. STREET/COURTYARD - NIGHT

The GENERAL fights fiercely against ASSASSINS in the night, blades flashing. He protects the young CROWN PRINCE, fighting his way through the siege.

EMPEROR (V.O.)
One spark to kindle a dynasty. One blade to guard it.

INT. RESIDENCE HALL - NIGHT

The battle continues inside the hall. The GENERAL moves skillfully, defeating several ASSASSINS.

Little XIAOXIAO hides behind a screen, clutching a wooden soldier doll.

An ASSASSIN seizes the GENERAL'S wife, WAN'ER.

GENERAL
(crying out)
Wan'er!

XIAOXIAO covers her mouth in fright.

The GENERAL rushes toward the ASSASSIN and strikes him down with one blow. He catches WAN'ER as she falls.

Bodies of ASSASSINS and servants lie scattered throughout the hall.

GENERAL
(anguished)
Hold on...

WAN'ER
(whispering)
Keep her... invisible...

WAN'ER finishes speaking, her hand falls limply, and she passes away.

GENERAL
(screaming)
Wan'er!

The GENERAL is overcome with grief, then frantically searches for his daughter.
continuation:
GENERAL
Xiaoxiao!

A SUBORDINATE rushes in with the young CROWN PRINCE, whose face is pale with terror.

SUBORDINATE
General! East gate has fallen!

GENERAL
The tunnel. Take him.

SUBORDINATE
They're cutting off the path!

The SUBORDINATE prepares to leave with the CROWN PRINCE. The GENERAL stays behind, engaging the incoming ASSASSINS in fierce combat.

XIAOXIAO runs out from her hiding place.

XIAOXIAO
(crying out)
Father!

XIAOXIAO stumbles on her mother's blood, falling at the foot of a toppled pillar.

ASSASSIN LEADER
The prince! He's escaping!

ASSASSINS close in on XIAOXIAO, trapping her against the pillar.

XIAOXIAO
(choking)
Father... please...

The GENERAL looks at his fallen daughter and the Crown Prince behind him, his heart torn with anguish.

GENERAL
(shouting)
Xiaoxiao! Stay down!

GENERAL
(whispered, not to her)
Forgive me...

The GENERAL resolutely turns around, pulls up the young CROWN PRINCE, and rushes out the door without looking back.

XIAOXIAO lies on the ground, desperately reaching out her hand, watching her father's departing figure.

XIAOXIAO
(barely audible)
Father...

The ASSASSINS raise their blades and surround the helpless XIAOXIAO.
