title: Dad, I'm Waiting for You (Episode 37)
description: A mother donates her kidney to save her son, but the doctor chooses to save another child instead, leading to a heart-wrenching confrontation.
context:
Title: Dad, I'm Waiting for You (Episode 37)
Description: A mother donates her kidney to save her son, but the doctor chooses to save another child instead, leading to a heart-wrenching confrontation.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Close-up of the "OPERATING ROOM" light sign illuminated.

Doctors and nurses push two gurneys quickly down the corridor. YAN LU sits in a wheelchair, IV pole attached, and her son NAN NAN lies on a separate bed, both wearing hospital gowns.

YAN LU
Wait.

YAN LU reaches out and grasps NAN NAN's hand on the adjacent gurney.

YAN LU
Nan Nan, Mom's kidney is on its way. You must be strong and survive, okay?

NAN NAN
(weakly)
Okay.

The two gurneys are pushed in different directions, their hands forced apart. YAN LU struggles to sit up but is unable.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

A nurse prepares a syringe.

GU TINGFENG, wearing a white coat, mask, and glasses, approaches NAN NAN lying on the operating table. He is the transplant director, not the surgeon.

GU TINGFENG
Don't be afraid. Dad's here.

Suddenly, the operating room door bursts open. Nurse LIU YIN rushes in pushing another gurney with a child, LE LE.

LIU YIN
(frantically)
Dr. Gu! Le Le's kidneys are failing. He's dying. There's a protocol emergency—both are O-negative matches!

LIU YIN notices the organ container on ice.

LIU YIN
That kidney could save Le Le!

GU TINGFENG
But the allocation committee approved it for Nan Nan.

LIU YIN
(crying and pleading)
Tingfeng, I'm begging you. Le Le is critical. He needs this now or he won't survive!

NAN NAN
(weakly)
Dad...

NAN NAN
Uncle Gu, I'm in pain. Save me.

GU TINGFENG looks at both children, caught in an agonizing choice.

GU TINGFENG
(to Nan Nan)
Nan Nan, be good. Le Le's condition is more critical by protocol. Dad will authorize Le Le first. You wait a little longer for Dad.

GU TINGFENG motions for NAN NAN to be moved to a gurney nearby. LIU YIN and other nurses immediately move LE LE onto the operating table.

NAN NAN
(crying out)
Dad! Dad! Dad!

Nurses wheel NAN NAN out of the operating room. The door slowly closes.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YAN LU leans weakly against the wall outside the operating room, waiting anxiously.

The operating room door opens. A nurse wheels out NAN NAN's gurney.

YAN LU
(struggling to stand)
Why are you out so quickly? Nan Nan?

NAN NAN
Mom, Dad gave the kidney to Le Le.

YAN LU
(shocked)
What?

YAN LU rushes to the operating room door, pounding on it.

YAN LU
Tingfeng! Tingfeng!

YAN LU looks through the small window in the door at the scene inside, crying out in anguish.

YAN LU
(hysterically)
Tingfeng! You made Nan Nan sacrifice again, just for her? For your past? Gu Tingfeng! Are you even human?

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

YAN LU sits on the hospital bed. NAN NAN lies beside her, asleep. YAN LU is on the phone, looking haggard and angry.

GU TINGFENG (V.O.)
I'm with Le Le for his treatment. Whatever it is, handle it yourself.

YAN LU hangs up, her eyes filled with despair.

NAN NAN
(sleep talking)
Dad... Dad...

GU TINGFENG, wearing a white coat, walks into the room. YAN LU immediately gets out of bed and blocks him.

GU TINGFENG
Yan Lu, Le Le needs this anti-rejection medicine first. Let Nan Nan wait for the next batch.

GU TINGFENG places a medicine bottle in YAN LU's hand, then turns and leaves. YAN LU stares in disbelief at his departing figure.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YAN LU clutches her abdominal wound, leaning against the wall in pain, slowly sinking down. Blood seeps through the bandage.

A nurse wheels NAN NAN's gurney past her.

NAN NAN
Mom...

YAN LU struggles to crawl toward him, reaching out to grab NAN NAN.

NAN NAN
Mom, don't cry.

YAN LU cannot reach NAN NAN's hand and watches helplessly as he is wheeled away.

YAN LU
(crying out)
Nan Nan!

YAN LU collapses on the floor, sobbing in despair.

YAN LU
(shocked)
What?

YAN LU rushes to the operating room door, pounding on it.

YAN LU
Tingfeng! Tingfeng!

YAN LU looks through the small window in the door at the scene inside, crying out in anguish.

YAN LU
(hysterically)
Tingfeng! You made Nan Nan sacrifice again, just for her? For your past? Gu Tingfeng! Are you even human?

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

YAN LU sits on the hospital bed. NAN NAN lies beside her, asleep. YAN LU is on the phone, looking haggard and angry.

GU TINGFENG (V.O.)
I'm with Le Le for his treatment. Whatever it is, handle it yourself.

YAN LU hangs up, her eyes filled with despair.

NAN NAN
(sleep talking)
Dad... Dad...

GU TINGFENG, wearing a white coat, walks into the room. YAN LU immediately gets out of bed and blocks him.

GU TINGFENG
Yan Lu, Le Le needs this anti-rejection medicine first. Let Nan Nan wait for the next batch.

GU TINGFENG places a medicine bottle in YAN LU's hand, then turns and leaves. YAN LU stares in disbelief at his departing figure.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YAN LU clutches her abdominal wound, leaning against the wall in pain, slowly sinking down. Blood seeps through the bandage.

A nurse wheels NAN NAN's gurney past her.

NAN NAN
Mom...

YAN LU struggles to crawl toward him, reaching out to grab NAN NAN.

NAN NAN
Mom, don't cry.

YAN LU cannot reach NAN NAN's hand and watches helplessly as he is wheeled away.

YAN LU
(crying out)
Nan Nan!

YAN LU collapses on the floor, sobbing in despair.

title: Father's Love, Mother's Devotion (Episode 1 of 40)
description: An elderly woman lies dying in a hospital, desperately waiting to see her daughter one last time while family tensions simmer beneath the surface.
context:
Title: Father's Love, Mother's Devotion (Episode 1 of 40)
Description: An elderly woman lies dying in a hospital, desperately waiting to see her daughter one last time while family tensions simmer beneath the surface.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

A DOCTOR examines LIU AIFANG, an elderly woman lying in a hospital bed, her skin ashen against the white sheets. Her husband, ZHANG XUEYI, sits ramrod straight in a plastic chair, his knuckles white around her hand. Their son ZHANG XING hovers near the equipment monitors, while his wife ZHAO ERMEI stands by the window, her reflection unreadable.

DOCTOR
(quietly)
We should prepare for the transition. Tonight, most likely.

ZHANG XUEYI's jaw tightens. ZHANG XING spins toward the doctor.

ZHANG XING
The experimental drug from Beijing—I can sign the waiver!

ZHAO ERMEI
(to the glass, not turning)
And mortgage what? The pension barely covers this room.

LIU AIFANG's eyes open to slits.

LIU AIFANG
(faintly)
Lili's flight...?
continuation:
ZHANG XUEYI
She landed. The traffic from Pudong is terrible.

LIU AIFANG
She always hated... the traffic.

ZHANG XING
(overly bright)
I sent her the address three times. With photos of the new wing.

ZHAO ERMEI
(softly, almost to herself)
Hope she remembers where the billing office is.

The words sink like stones. Zhang Xing shoots her a look but says nothing.

LIU AIFANG
(straining)
Her old room... I kept the jade bracelet...

ZHANG XUEYI
(gently)
I'll wait by the east entrance. The one she remembers.

He presses two fingers to his lips, then to her forehead, and walks out. Alone now, save for the humming machines, Liu Aifang turns her head toward the door. A tear escapes, tracing a path through the lines of her face. She doesn't wipe it—she's saving her strength for when her daughter finally arrives.

title: The Inheritance Betrayal
description: A young executive fights for her legacy when her grandmother's final moments become a battlefield for control.
context:
Title: The Inheritance Betrayal
Description: A young executive fights for her legacy when her grandmother's final moments become a battlefield for control.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

GRANDMOTHER (70s) lies frail, oxygen tube in place. Her breathing is labored.

UNCLE (50s, sharp suit, sweat on his brow) looms over a legal document.

UNCLE
(whispered urgency)
The company can't wait, Mother. Just your thumbprint. I'll protect everything you built.

He presses an ink pad to her thumb. She weakly resists.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YU XIN (28, business attire, phone to ear) sprints toward the ward.

YU XIN
(into phone)
—called security twice! Where are they?

She's blocked by two PRIVATE SECURITY GUARDS at the door.

YU XIN
That's my grandmother. I'm her legal healthcare proxy.

GUARD 1
Mr. Yu's orders. He's inside with the patient.

YU TIANJIE (25, casual luxury) appears from the waiting area, smirking at his phone.

YU TIANJIE
Took you long enough, Cousin. Busy closing deals?

YU XIN
The board meeting's in two hours. You don't have the votes yet.

YU TIANJIE
(showing his phone)
Interim authority. Grandmother's already signed. While you've been "networking."
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

GRANDMOTHER's eyes open. She sees UNCLE forcing her thumb toward paper.

GRANDMOTHER
(whisper)
...lawyer... witness...

UNCLE
The lawyer's stuck in traffic. This can't wait, Mother.

He tries to uncurl her fingers. She clenches tighter.

UNCLE
(quiet, cold)
You're making this difficult, Mother. The company needs leadership now.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YU XIN attempts to push through. The GUARDS restrain her professionally.

YU XIN
(shouting down the hall)
Nurse! Patient rights violation!

A NURSE looks over, sees MU WANQING (48, elegant, commanding) approaching, and quickly retreats.

MU WANQING intercepts the NURSE with a nod, then turns to the GUARDS.

MU WANQING
Firm but careful. She's distraught.

YU XIN notices MU WANQING's smooth control of the situation. Her jaw tightens.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

UNCLE glances at the door, then back at GRANDMOTHER's clenched fist.

UNCLE
(quietly)
You're forcing my hand, Mother. I won't let it all collapse.

He reaches for her oxygen tube.

GRANDMOTHER
Xinxin... trust...

UNCLE
She'll learn.

He disconnects the tube. The monitor alarm begins to beep—tone steady, then urgent.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

YU XIN freezes at the alarm sound. She grabs YU TIANJIE's phone.

YU XIN
That's a cardiac alert! Move!

The GUARDS hesitate. MU WANQING's voice is calm authority:

MU WANQING
Stand your ground. Let the doctors handle it.

YU XIN pulls out her own phone, starts recording.

YU XIN
This is Yu Xin, CEO. Documenting obstruction—

The door opens. UNCLE emerges, face stricken, document in hand.

UNCLE
(somber)
She's gone. Signed just before... Her final wish. Stable hands for the company.

YU XIN
(voice cracking)
Let me see her.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

YU XIN enters. GRANDMOTHER lies still. The pillow is undisturbed. The monitor shows a flatline.

YU XIN kneels, takes GRANDMOTHER's hand. Sees ink stains on clenched fingers. And something else—her own initials faintly visible in the ink, as if GRANDMOTHER tried to write.

YU XIN's grief hardens into focus. She photographs the ink-stained hand. Then notices the oxygen tube—connected to the wall unit, but the patient connector is spotlessly clean, untouched.

She looks back at UNCLE in the doorway.

YU XIN
(quiet, dangerous)
You cleaned the wrong end, Uncle.

His expression shifts from sorrow to something colder.

UNCLE
Grief distorts things, Xinxin. Come. We have arrangements.

A warning, not a comfort.

title: The Ace Agent's Billionaire Heiress Wife
description: A secret agent married to a billionaire's daughter faces thugs at her birthday party, hiding his true identity as a mere construction worker.
context:
Title: The Ace Agent's Billionaire Heiress Wife
Description: A secret agent married to a billionaire's daughter faces thugs at her birthday party, hiding his true identity as a mere construction worker.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Music blares, lights flash. YAN SHISHI's friends celebrate her birthday. One GIRLFRIEND sings while two others hold LED signs reading "Happy Birthday Sister Shishi."

FRIEND A
Come on, let's toast to Shishi!

FRIEND B
To Shishi! And to you and Shuai—may you two grow old together!

YAN SHISHI
Thank you, thank you all.

GIRLFRIEND
Brother-in-law, treat her right. You know how many men chased after her?

LI SHUAI
Every day I wonder what she sees in a construction worker like me.

YAN SHISHI
Stop that.

GIRLFRIEND
That's love. So promise us.

LI SHUAI
I promise. Always.

Everyone raises their glasses. They drink.

GIRLFRIEND
Now sing! "The Moon Represents My Heart"!

YAN SHISHI
Think we still remember?

LI SHUAI
For you? Every word.

LI SHUAI picks up the microphone. The door BURSTS open. JIA BIAO storms in with THUGS. One—BLONDE, arms and legs in casts—sits in a wheelchair.

THUG
Turn that shit off!
continuation:
Another THUG yanks the karaoke plug. Silence.

YAN SHISHI
Who are you?

JIA BIAO
Ask your husband.

Li Shuai is already moving, placing himself between the thugs and the group.

LI SHUAI
This is my wife's birthday. Leave. Now.

JIA BIAO
You put my brother in that wheelchair. We came for the party.

YAN SHISHI
My father is Yan Dajiang. My brother is Yan Hu. If you—

JIA BIAO
(laughing)
Yan Dajiang's daughter in a dump like this? With some laborer husband? Right.

YAN SHISHI
I'll prove it.

LI SHUAI
(gently stopping her)
Shishi. Let me handle this.

Li Shuai guides Yan Shishi and her friends to sit. He faces Jia Biao.

JIA BIAO
Speak.

LI SHUAI
What do you want?

JIA BIAO
You beat my brother like this. What do you think I want?

JIA BIAO kicks a bottle. It SHATTERS.

LI SHUAI
He helped a telecom fraud ring scam my aunt out of two hundred thousand. If he won't hand over the mastermind, then I had no choice but to break his arms and legs.

JIA BIAO
Breaking his arms and legs is fine. Pay one million in compensation. If you can't pay, I'll take your life!

title: A Civet Cat Cannot Replace the Crown Prince
description: A woman discovers her scheming relatives' plot to use a surrogate pregnancy to steal her family's fortune and takes action to stop them.
context:
Title: A Civet Cat Cannot Replace the Crown Prince
Description: A woman discovers her scheming relatives' plot to use a surrogate pregnancy to steal her family's fortune and takes action to stop them.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

MISS LIN, wearing a black trench coat, sunglasses, and a hat, walks determinedly through the long hospital corridor.

MISS LIN (V.O.)
Last time, I found the investigator's report too late. This time, I'm three steps ahead.

MISS LIN stops and looks at a wall-mounted doctor's introduction board, showing DOCTOR WANG LIN's photo and information.

MISS LIN (V.O.)
Zhao Lan thinks she'll carry the next Lin heir. Let her. Just not with my father's blood.

MISS LIN turns and pushes open a hospital room door.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

ZHAO LAN sits on the bed in a patient gown, clutching a small bag of belongings. Her brother ZHAO DAJUN sits on the adjacent bed, tension in his shoulders.

ZHAO DAJUN
You're certain? If Mrs. Lin finds out before—

ZHAO LAN
She won't. By the time she knows, I'll be carrying the family's future. Blood always wins.

ZHAO DAJUN
And the cousin? The real daughter?

ZHAO LAN
She's had her chance. No sons, only pride. Men like President Lin need heirs, not wives.

ZHAO LAN touches her stomach almost protectively.

ZHAO LAN
My whole life has been serving them. This time, they serve me.

ZHAO DAJUN
(quietly)
For our family's future.

ZHAO LAN
For our survival.

A NURSE enters the room.

NURSE
Patient Zhao Lan, bed 826. Doctor Wang is ready.

ZHAO DAJUN
(whispering)
Make it take root.

ZHAO LAN
It will. It has to.

ZHAO LAN is helped out by the NURSE.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

ZHAO DAJUN waits anxiously outside the operating room, rubbing a jade ring. MISS LIN secretly observes him from behind a corner.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

MISS LIN stands before DOCTOR WANG LIN, holding a sealed medical container.

MISS LIN
Use this instead. It's the legitimate Lin heir's sample.

DOCTOR WANG LIN
Miss Lin, the protocol is clear. I cannot—

MISS LIN
(slides a file forward)
Your malpractice settlement last year. My family made it disappear. We can make it reappear.

DOCTOR WANG LIN
(hesitates)
This is different. This is fraud.

MISS LIN
What Zhao Lan intends is fraud. I'm correcting a bloodline. The choice is yours—disgrace or discretion.

MISS LIN produces a document with the Lin family seal.

DOCTOR WANG LIN
(quietly)
I need this in writing. For my protection.

MISS LIN
Of course. For the family records.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

DOCTOR WANG LIN, wearing surgical scrubs, walks out of the operating room.

DOCTOR WANG LIN
The procedure was successful. All implantation markers are positive.

ZHAO DAJUN
(overwhelmed, grasping the doctor's hand)
Thank you... you've given us everything.

MISS LIN watches coldly from a distance.

MISS LIN (V.O.)
They think they're planting a dynasty. They're just sowing their own exile.

Medical staff wheel ZHAO LAN out of the operating room on a hospital bed.

ZHAO DAJUN
Sis, it's done. You're going to be a mother.

ZHAO LAN
(weak but hopeful)
Finally... finally I belong in that family.

ZHAO DAJUN
Let's get you home. Rest for the future.

ZHAO LAN
Yes. Our future.

Joy and exhaustion mix on their faces.

title: Hunting You
description: A mysterious woman in a black mask observes a nightclub before targeting Jin Xuan, a young man with a mysterious seven-year gap in his past, at a masquerade party.
context:
Title: Hunting You
Description: A mysterious woman in a black mask observes a nightclub before targeting Jin Xuan, a young man with a mysterious seven-year gap in his past, at a masquerade party.

INT. NIGHTCLUB - NIGHT

Neon veins pulse through the darkened space. Bodies move like a single organism to the thundering bass. At the VIP balcony, YAN LINGXI sits untouched champagne before her. The ornate black mask obscures her expression, but her eyes track every entrance below with predatory precision.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

YAN LINGXI leans against a white sedan, checking her phone. XIE YOU approaches in a burgundy suit, extending a sealed folder.

XIE YOU
Jin Xuan's file. Heaven on Earth, masquerade tonight. One night only.

YAN LINGXI
(flicks it open, stills)
Fifteen to twenty-two. Seven years, erased.

XIE YOU
Someone buried him deep after his brother died. Be careful.

She snaps the folder shut, her knuckles white.

INT. NIGHTCLUB - NIGHT

A Venetian-style masquerade. Gold and crimson masks glimmer in candlelight. YAN LINGXI moves through the crowd like a shadow.

At the center, JIN XUAN holds court. His white mask is a stark contrast to his deliberate, performative charm. He raises his crystal tumbler.

JIN XUAN
To returning ghosts. May they stay buried.

The crowd laughs, uneasy. He scans the room while sipping, his smile never reaching his eyes.

YAN LINGXI watches from behind a marble pillar. She catches his reflection in a gilded mirror—just as his gaze flicks toward her. The music warps, distorts. For a heartbeat, their eyes lock.
continuation:
INT. NIGHTCLUB WASHROOM - NIGHT

JIN XUAN splashes water on his face, then freezes. On the marble counter lies a single playing card—the King of Spades, with "J.X." written in red ink. He pockets it, movements sharp. Behind him, a stall door clicks shut. He follows.

INT. WASHROOM STALL - NIGHT

Little dove?

Your past.

(voice breaking)

title: Crime Hunter: No Escape (Episode 35)
description: A livestreamer plans to expose her abusive boyfriend's crimes, but an unexpected delivery leads to a dangerous situation.
context:
Title: Crime Hunter: No Escape (Episode 35)
Description: A livestreamer plans to expose her abusive boyfriend's crimes, but an unexpected delivery leads to a dangerous situation.

INT. LIVESTREAM ROOM - DAY

CHEN LINLIN livestreams a dance, her smile mechanical.

CHEN LINLIN
Babies, new outfit's en route. Any minute now.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Delivery driver LIN FENG bikes while watching CHEN LINLIN's livestream on his phone. He checks the delivery bag—label reads "Costume: Sexy Bunny."

LIN FENG
(to himself)
No way. Actually her?

His phone buzzes—timeout warning. He swerves into a building.

INT. LIVESTREAM ROOM - NIGHT

CHEN LINLIN speaks to the camera.

CHEN LINLIN
Be right back, lovelies. Quick try-on.

She ends the stream.
continuation:
INT. CHEN LINLIN'S HOME - NIGHT

Chen picks up a photo of her with boyfriend ZHAO LONGFEI. She rolls up her sleeve, revealing scars. She opens a box containing a USB drive.

CHEN LINLIN (V.O.)
One more hour. Then you're done.

She slams the photo face-down. Pounding at the door makes her drop the USB. It slides under the couch.

CHEN LINLIN
Who's there?

LIN FENG (O.S.)
Delivery!

INT. DOORWAY - NIGHT

Chen opens the door to Lin Feng.

CHEN LINLIN
You trying to break my door?

LIN FENG
Traffic. Here's your package.

He hands it over. She glances at him, then at the hallway security camera.

CHEN LINLIN
Wait. I need to inspect it.

LIN FENG
I should—

CHEN LINLIN
Two minutes. Or I complain.

She leaves the door open. Lin Feng steps inside.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Chen emerges in the bunny costume. Lin Feng stares. She checks the mirror.

CHEN LINLIN
Does it look defective?

LIN FENG
No.

She moves closer, backing him against the wall—her eyes flick to a blinking red light in a smoke detector.

CHEN LINLIN
You were never in this room.

The front door unlocks. Chen spins, panicked.

CHEN LINLIN
No. He's back.

LIN FENG looks shocked.

title: Mystic Sister Wants to Go Up the Mountain, Brothers Please Let Go
description: An orphan girl with a special fate must reunite with her lost family and find her destined partner to overcome a tribulation and ascend to immortality.
context:
Title: Mystic Sister Wants to Go Up the Mountain, Brothers Please Let Go
Description: An orphan girl with a special fate must reunite with her lost family and find her destined partner to overcome a tribulation and ascend to immortality.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY

Close-up shot of an antique-style lantern.

MASTER YUN LING, an old man with white hair and beard, wearing fashionable sunglasses and a Taoist robe, lounges leisurely in a chair in the courtyard, fanning himself.

He picks up a teacup and takes a sip.

MASTER YUN LING
(intoxicated)
Ah, excellent tea!

EXT. SKY/COURTYARD - DAY

Special effects shot. LING YA carries an unconscious man, SU TANG, on her shoulder. Surrounded by golden light, she descends from the sky and lands outside the courtyard.

LING YA carries SU TANG into the courtyard.

LING YA
(excitedly)
Master, I brought back a great treasure!

MASTER YUN LING
(startled, sitting up)
Oh my, put him down quickly! Gently, gently!

LING YA puts SU TANG on the ground. A white puppy named "WANGCAI" runs over. LING YA happily picks it up.

LING YA
Wangcai!

LING YA holds the dog and speaks to her master.

LING YA
Master, he can actually replenish my spiritual energy!

MASTER YUN LING
(surprised, removing his sunglasses)
What? He is your second brother. You two share a blood bond!

LING YA
(delighted)
Then won't I be able to ascend soon?

MASTER YUN LING
(dismissively pointing at SU TANG on the ground)
Rely on him? A hundred years wouldn't be enough!

MASTER YUN LING
(seriously)
Aiya, you encountered a lightning tribulation during your ascension because you have the fate of a solitary star. To break this curse, you need to reunite with your family to complete your kinship line, and then find your destined partner to fulfill your marriage line. Only by reversing your fate this way can you ascend smoothly!

LING YA
Master, who is my destined partner?

MASTER YUN LING
(calculating with his fingers)
Let me calculate.

MASTER YUN LING'S face suddenly changes drastically.

MASTER YUN LING
(panicked)
Oh no! Your destined one will die within three days! Only if you dual-cultivate with him can you save him!

LING YA
(shocked)
What?!

MASTER YUN LING
Aiya, quickly return to the Su family with your second brother to reunite with your relatives, and hurry to save your destined one!

LING YA
Then I'll wake him up right now!

LING YA prepares to cast a spell on SU TANG.

MASTER YUN LING
(hastily stopping her)
Aiya, no! He's been poisoned with Soul Confusion Poison! Even I would need weeks to cure it properly. Don't waste your energy.

MASTER YUN LING walks away, fanning himself.

LING YA
(thoughtfully)
Soul Confusion Poison?

LING YA suddenly thinks of something. Her eyes light up, and she turns and runs into the house.
continuation:
INT. ROOM - DAY

LING YA quickly searches through the bookshelf, pulls out an ancient text with "Essential Prescriptions from the Golden Cabinet" written on the cover.

LING YA
(happily)
Got it!

She opens the book and finds a page.

LING YA
Acupressure method.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

LING YA crouches beside the unconscious SU TANG, holding the book in one hand while gesturing at acupressure points on his body with the other.

LING YA
(pressing a point)
Hm? Wrong point?

She anxiously pats SU TANG.

LING YA
Wake up!

She tries pressing another point. SU TANG'S fingers twitch.

LING YA
(confused)
Hm? Wrong again? This shouldn't be. Isn't this what the book says?

LING YA tosses the book aside and decides to do it herself.

LING YA
Try again!

She frantically presses points all over SU TANG'S body, forcing spiritual energy through her fingertips to suppress the poison.

Black screen. Text displays: 2 HOURS LATER

SU TANG lies on the ground, his body twitching slightly.

INT. ANCESTRAL HALL - NIGHT

MASTER YUN LING meditates cross-legged in the ancestral hall. SU TANG slowly wakes up, leaning against the doorframe, looking dazed.

SU TANG
(weakly)
Who am I?

He shakily stands up and walks into the hall. At that moment, LING YA walks in carrying a large stone.

SU TANG
Excuse me, may I ask where this is?

LING YA
This is Yunling Temple. You fainted at the foot of the mountain. I brought you back.

SU TANG
(gratefully bowing)
Many thanks for saving my life, hero.

He straightens up, feeling something wrong with his entire body.

SU TANG
(painfully)
But why does my whole body hurt?

LING YA
(eyes darting away, guiltily)
It's not my fault! I mean, I don't know either.

SU TANG'S phone rings. He takes it out to answer.

SU TANG
Hello, Dad.

SU TAI'AN (V.O.)
You're out fooling around every day. Do you still want this family or not?

SU TANG
Dad, I fainted. This hero saved me.

SU TANG turns the phone camera toward LING YA. LING YA waves at the camera, showing a smile.

SU TAI'AN (V.O.)
Ah?

On the phone screen, SU TAI'AN sees LING YA'S face and his eyes widen in shock.

SU TAI'AN (V.O.)
Ah? This...

LING YA
(sudden sharp pain in her chest, whispering)
That voice...

FADE OUT.

title: City Night Encounter
description: A down-on-his-luck factory worker's fate begins to change after a chance encounter at a bus stop on a bustling night.
context:
Title: City Night Encounter
Description: A down-on-his-luck factory worker's fate begins to change after a chance encounter at a bus stop on a bustling night.

EXT. BUS STOP - NIGHT

Neon from a night market bleeds into the bus shelter. Steam from food carts clouds the air.

A FEMALE STREAMER holds a selfie stick, navigating the crowd.

FEMALE STREAMER
Back on the streets, fam! Where should we eat tonight?

JIANG FEI, a young factory worker in a gray uniform, leans against a pole eating a pancake.

A BLIND WOMAN wearing headphones and holding a white cane misjudges the space and collides with JIANG FEI.

JIANG FEI's pancake falls to the wet pavement.

BLIND WOMAN
(startled)
Oh! Watch where you're standing!

A MAN holding a fill light steps between them, eyeing JIANG FEI's uniform.

MAN
(to Blind Woman)
Don't worry, ma'am. He's fine. Used to it.

He guides her away, glancing at the ruined food with a slight smirk.

FEMALE STREAMER
(to phone)
Thanks for the superchat, Boss_88. Yeah, tough night for some.

JIANG FEI stares at the pancake. He scrapes it up with a napkin, sets it aside.

A VOICE (O.S.)
That one's done for.

OLD COWORKER, a man in the same uniform, sits on the bench with a paper bag.

OLD COWORKER
Trade you. Wife made too many.

JIANG FEI hesitates, then accepts a steamed bun. He notices the uniform patch.

JIANG FEI
(quietly)
continuation:
Eastern Plastics?

OLD COWORKER
Thirty years. You?

JIANG FEI
Three months.

OLD COWORKER
It gets easier. Not better, maybe. But easier.

ZHOU YANLIN, a young woman in a designer coat, walks by. Her phone slips from her bag.

Jiang Fei sees it, picks it up.

JIANG FEI
(calling out)
Miss! Your phone!

She turns, sees his uniform, flinches slightly.

ZHOU YANLIN
Thanks.

She checks the screen.

ZHOU YANLIN
Screen's not cracked. Lucky.

She pulls out cash.

ZHOU YANLIN
For your trouble.

JIANG FEI
No need.

He walks back to OLD COWORKER. ZHOU YANLIN watches, expression shifting. She puts the cash away.

The bus arrives. They line up.

OLD COWORKER
Our stop?

JIANG FEI
Yeah.

JIANG FEI looks back at ZHOU YANLIN, who gives a small nod. He boards.

title: Rose's Marriage
description: A pregnant woman endures abuse from her mother-in-law and neglect from her husband, while suspecting his infidelity.
context:
Title: Rose's Marriage
Description: A pregnant woman endures abuse from her mother-in-law and neglect from her husband, while suspecting his infidelity.

INT. KITCHEN - NIGHT

HUANG MEIGUI, 34, haggard-looking but with a tight-set jaw, struggles to stir congee one-handed while bracing her swollen belly. Sweat beads her forehead. Each small movement costs her.

INT. LIVING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

MOTHER-IN-LAW (70s, iron-gray perm) and granddaughter JINGJING (10) sit on the sofa watching TV. MOTHER-IN-LAW cracks sunflower seeds, her laugh a sharp bark.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(laughing)
Ha ha ha.

XU RENJUN, 36, comes home from work, shoulders slumped. He places a premium formula tin on the coffee table.

XU RENJUN
I'm home.

MOTHER-IN-LAW's face immediately darkens. She squints at the imported brand.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Son, these cans cost half your salary, don't they? Look at her belly—so round. Must be another girl who'll just spend my son's money. Ten years and she can't even give you a proper heir.

INT. DELIVERY ROOM - DAY (TEN YEARS AGO)

Flashback. YOUNG HUANG MEIGUI (24) lies on the delivery bed, screaming in agony.

HUANG MEIGUI
(screaming in pain)
Ah! Ah!

NURSE (V.O.)
The baby's in distress. We need to operate now!

DOCTOR (V.O.)
I need consent for a C-section. The mother can't hold on much longer.

MOTHER-IN-LAW (V.O.)
No anesthesia—it makes babies stupid. She's young. She can suffer for a grandson. My son needs an heir, even if she's... damaged.

HUANG MEIGUI hears this, her eyes snapping open in horror. Then closing in despair.
continuation:
INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT (PRESENT)

Back to reality. MOTHER-IN-LAW makes pointed remarks to JINGJING.

HUANG MEIGUI
(to her daughter)

Honey—

title: The Secret of Rose
description: A mysterious woman named Rose arrives at an engagement party, revealing a dangerous connection to the groom that threatens to unravel everything.
context:
Title: The Secret of Rose
Description: A mysterious woman named Rose arrives at an engagement party, revealing a dangerous connection to the groom that threatens to unravel everything.

INT. UNKNOWN LOCATION - DAY

Close-up on ROSE, wearing a red dress, exquisite makeup, sharp eyes, and a mysterious smile at the corner of her mouth.

ROSE (V.O.)
Zi'an thinks he's the player. Let's see how he likes being played.

EXT. GARDEN PARTY - DAY

An outdoor engagement party is in progress. Guests chat in small groups.

MR. CHEN, wearing a black tailcoat and gold-rimmed glasses, appears restless in the crowd. He checks his phone, then spots something that makes his face pale.

MR. CHEN grabs ROSE by the arm and pulls her behind a backdrop printed with wedding photos.

MR. CHEN
(through gritted teeth)
I told you to stay away.

ROSE
(straightening his boutonniere)
And miss your big day? I'm her favorite guest.

MR. CHEN
(grabbing her hand)
Stop. Whatever you want—

In the distance, SU WANYING in a white wedding dress and her BRIDESMAIDS walk toward them.

ROSE
(leaning close, voice like honey)
She's coming. Smile, darling. Wouldn't want her to see you sweat.

MR. CHEN's expression tightens. He turns around in panic.

SU WANYING approaches.

MR. CHEN
(going to meet her, forced cheer)
Wanying.

ROSE steps forward first, embracing SU WANYING with genuine warmth.

ROSE
Finally! I almost thought you'd locked her in a tower, Zi'an.

SU WANYING
(delighted)
Rose! You made it.

ROSE
continuation:
Wouldn't miss it. Though your fiancé seems... nervous about my gift.

MR. CHEN
It's nothing, honey. Rose was just leaving.

SU WANYING
(to ROSE)
Ignore him. He's been a wreck all day. Stay—please.

ROSE
I'll be careful not to cause trouble.

MR. CHEN
(quietly desperate)
Wanying, the guests—

SU WANYING
(to MR. CHEN)
Go entertain them. We'll catch up.

MR. CHEN
It's better not to wander around, to avoid causing trouble.

ROSE
(looking at him, smile sharp)
Trouble finds me. Always has.

SU WANYING
(to ROSE)
Meet me later? There's something I want you to see.

ROSE
Wouldn't miss it.

SU WANYING and MR. CHEN leave. ROSE watches them, her smile fading. She touches a hidden object in her clutch.

INT. CORRIDOR - DAY

ROSE walks alone down a quiet corridor, her high heels clicking crisply. She stops at a door marked "STUDY."

She reaches for the handle, then hesitates. Listens.

ROSE
(under her breath)
Right on time.

As soon as the door opens a crack, a MAN WITH A KNIFE wearing a hat emerges from behind it, controls ROSE from behind, and holds a small knife to her neck.

MAN WITH A KNIFE
(whisper)
Shouldn't have come back.

ROSE's eyes become cold and alert. She doesn't struggle.

FADE OUT.

title: Misty Mountain
description: A young fortune-teller from Misty Mountain livestreams his services, offering predictions and charms, before descending the mountain to find his birth mother who faces a life-threatening crisis.
context:
Title: Misty Mountain
Description: A young fortune-teller from Misty Mountain livestreams his services, offering predictions and charms, before descending the mountain to find his birth mother who faces a life-threatening crisis.

EXT. MISTY MOUNTAIN - DAY

A banner reading "Fortune Telling, Feng Shui, Naming Services" hangs in the air.

A little boy, YUAN BAO, wearing a "Congratulations and Prosperity" headpiece, is livestreaming on his phone.

YUAN BAO
I am Yuan Bao, the boss of Misty Mountain. Livestreaming fortune-telling, five hundred per reading, no charge if inaccurate.

YUAN BAO
This looks good, right?

YUAN BAO
Hey, brothers and sisters, don't go! My handmade elixir pills, evil-repelling talismans - all free if you get a reading from me!

Through the smoke, four NEPHEWS in white robes rush out. Seeing what Yuan Bao is giving away during the livestream, they look distressed.

NEPHEW A
Oh no, everything our junior uncle is giving away belongs to us!

NEPHEW B
Spare the rod, spoil the child. We must teach him a lesson!

SENIOR BROTHER
Junior brothers, don't worry. This prodigy won't be arrogant much longer.

Yuan Bao senses them and his eyes narrow.

An invisible force sends the four nephews tumbling backward.

YUAN BAO
(hands on hips)
Dear nephews, looking for me?

The nephews quickly approach.

NEPHEW B
Junior Uncle!

SENIOR BROTHER
(ingratiatingly)
Haven't you been searching for your birth mother? I've calculated it - your mother is the daughter of the Lin family in River City. You can descend the mountain to find her now.

YUAN BAO
You think I need you to calculate that? I figured it out long ago. But Master said I must help ten people before I can descend the mountain. I still have... four left. I'll continue my livestream.

SENIOR BROTHER
(quickly grabbing Yuan Bao)
Oh, Junior Uncle, no! I just calculated that your mother faces a life-or-death crisis. The Master's rule allows exceptions for family emergencies!

YUAN BAO
(alarmed)
I'm descending the mountain right now!

Yuan Bao grabs his bundle and runs down the mountain.

The nephews watch his retreating figure and laugh triumphantly.

NEPHEW C
Senior Brother is brilliant!

SENIOR BROTHER
I just feel a bit bad for the Lin family.

SENIOR BROTHER
Send word to the junior members of our families. Mobilize the power of all four great families. All resources in River City are to be made available to the Lin family. Whatever Miss Lin says, grant it without question.

NEPHEWS
Yes!
continuation:
EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

Yuan Bao holds a compass, searching for direction in the modern city streets.

YUAN BAO
Found it! Mommy is here!

Yuan Bao runs excitedly toward a tall building.

EXT. LIN CORPORATION BUILDING - DAY

LIN CHUXIA rides an electric scooter and is stopped by her father LIN HAI and sister LIN SHIYI.

LIN HAI
Chuxia. We need to discuss your future at the company.

LIN CHUXIA
I was on my way to the warehouse.

LIN SHIYI
Father means you should stop embarrassing yourself. The Shen family wants to discuss the marriage arrangement.

LIN CHUXIA
The one you refused because Master Shen is "too traditional"?

LIN SHIYI
(pretending to be pitiful)
I only wanted what's best for our family. This connection could save us.

LIN CHUXIA
So you volunteered me.

LIN HAI
During the years you were lost, Shiyi fulfilled your duties. Show some gratitude.

LIN CHUXIA
Should I thank her for enjoying the Lin family's wealth while I survived on scraps?

LIN HAI
(raising his hand to strike)
You will show respect!

YUAN BAO
(running over)
Mommy! Mommy!

Yuan Bao runs to Lin Chuxia and hugs her.

YUAN BAO
(looking up with a happy smile)
I finally found you!

Lin Chuxia looks down at the suddenly appearing Yuan Bao, shocked and bewildered.

title: Are You Crazy! How Dare You Fire A Miracle Doctor
description: When Jiangzhou's richest man suffers a catastrophic stroke, a conflicted young TCM prodigy must risk his career and legacy to attempt a forbidden technique—knowing his intervention could either save a life or destroy his own.
context:
Title: Are You Crazy! How Dare You Fire A Miracle Doctor
Description: When Jiangzhou's richest man suffers a catastrophic stroke, a conflicted young TCM prodigy must risk his career and legacy to attempt a forbidden technique—knowing his intervention could either save a life or destroy his own.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

JIANG BEI (28), stethoscope around his neck, hunches over an ancient thread-bound book: "Nine Needles to Break Evil Spirits." A faded family photo peeks from the pages. 

His phone BUZZES urgently. On his computer, a news ticker scrolls silently: "BREAKING: Jiuzhou tycoon Chen Yi suffers massive stroke—critical condition."

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...sources confirm Mr. Chen's condition is deteriorating rapidly. Our top story: Medical emergency at Huacheng Sanatorium...

Jiang Bei silences his phone, hand trembling as he touches the book.

JIANG BEI
(whispering)
Forgive me, Grandfather.

EMERGENCY RESCUE MONTAGE:

- Red ambulance lights slice through rain-soaked streets.
- CHEN YI (60s) is wheeled into trauma bay, monitors flatlining.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Chen Yi, listed in critical condition, has been admitted to Huacheng Sanatorium's elite neuro unit. Specialists have been mobilized...

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Medical staff sprint alongside the stretcher. CHEN XIAOLONG (30s), bespoke suit soaked with rain, jogs beside them.

CHEN XIAOLONG
(voice cracking, authoritative)
Save him. Whatever it costs—my father built this hospital wing. He doesn't get to die in it.

A NURSE gently restrains him as the OR doors swing shut. The "SURGERY IN PROGRESS" sign ignites.
continuation:
INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

Chaos. LEAD SURGEON (50s) studies a CT scan—white mass obscuring brain stem. Monitors chirp arrhythmically.

LEAD SURGEON
Bleed's too deep. Craniotomy's useless. Pressure's spiking—190 over 110.

FEMALE NURSE
What about thrombolytics?

LEAD SURGEON
He's already maxed. Last option is Dr. Jiang's technique, but—

The OR door hisses open.

Jiang Bei enters, shrugging on sterile scrubs, his medical box tucked under one arm. The staff part like water.

LEAD SURGEON
Dr. Jiang. We can't stabilize—

JIANG BEI
(interrupting, calm)
Vitals. CT.

He opens the red wooden box. Silver needles gleam under surgical lights. Chen Yi's monitor PINGS—pressure climbing.

Jiang Bei palpates Chen Yi's skull, eyes closed. His fingers find a point. He hesitates—a heartbeat of doubt.

FEMALE NURSE
(quietly, to colleague)
He's doing it blind?

LEAD SURGEON
(whispering)
Twenty years training. His family's technique predates this hospital.

Jiang Bei exhales. The needle sinks in—precise, surgical. A second. Third.

Monitors stabilize. Blood pressure drops: 140 over 85. Heart rate steadies.

FEMALE NURSE
(astonished)
Clot's resolving on the scan...

Jiang Bei closes his box, shoulders tight.

JIANG BEI
These needles maintain pressure equilibrium. Remove any within sixty minutes—

LEAD SURGEON
What happens?

JIANG BEI
(turning away)
Rebound hemorrhage. Instantaneous. The technique is... unforgiving.

He stops at the door, not looking back.

JIANG BEI (CONT'D)
And Doctor? My methods weren't in your protocol. If this goes wrong—I'm already fired.

The door closes. The staff stare at the needles—tiny, fragile, holding a life in balance.

INT. LUXURIOUS BEDROOM - NIGHT

SU ZHU stands in a crimson gown, testing a serpent-skin whip. Across the chamber, XIE CHENZHOU lies bound to the bedposts in black silk robes.

She cracks the whip. It gouges the headboard, splintering wood across his pillow.

XIE CHENZHOU
Your aim is as poor as your character.

Her arm trembles—not from effort, but system feedback. She strikes again. The whip wraps her own wrist, the tail snapping across her shoulder.

SU ZHU
(crying out)
Ah!

LIU LIU (V.O.)
Meridian penalty feedback. Host, withdraw.

SU ZHU
(to herself)
System interference? I'll compensate.

SU ZHU swings again. The whip strikes her chest. She staggers, clutching her heart.

SU ZHU
(gasping)
Liu Liu... this body...

LIU LIU (V.O.)
Cardiac arrest. Congenital defect. Eighty seconds.

SU ZHU
(weakly)
Solution?

LIU LIU (V.O.)
Consummation stabilizes. Alternate: ingest his blood. Any wound.

Su Zhu crawls onto the bed, seizing his collar with trembling hands.

XIE CHENZHOU
What are you—

She bites his neck. He recoils, chains rattling.

XIE CHENZHOU
(shouted rage)
Demon!

She drinks. Her heart steadies. She pulls back, blood on her lips.

SU ZHU
(whispering)
Not enough. Need more.

She bites again, lower. After a moment, she collapses across his chest.

XIE CHENZHOU
(voice low)
Is this another game?

SU ZHU
(mumbled)
Ropes... wear off... dawn. Just... endure.

She falls unconscious. Xie Chenzhou stares at the canopy, her weight pressing him down.

XIE CHENZHOU (O.S.)
She could have killed me. She didn't.

FADE OUT.
continuation:
INT. LUXURIOUS BEDROOM - DAY

SU ZHU jolts awake, alone in bed. CHUN'ER enters with a jade tray.

CHUN'ER
Miss, the physician noted bruising on your neck. Shall I prepare balm?

SU ZHU
(voice hoarse)
Neck?

SU ZHU touches her throat, remembering.

SU ZHU
Yes. The best.

CHUN'ER
Medicine King Valley's new elixir. Very costly.

She hands a white porcelain bottle.

SU ZHU
(taking it)
Stock this always.

CHUN'ER
Last night's... fervor... echoed through the palace.

SU ZHU
(flustered)
Where is Xie Chenzhou?

CHUN'ER
The City Lord has him in the eastern courtyard. Flogging began at dawn.

SU ZHU
(shocked)
Flogging? Why?

CHUN'ER
You collapsed in his presence. The Lord demands answers.

LIU LIU (V.O.)
Ding. Mission pivot: capture Xie Chenzhou's heart. Seven months. Failure: real-world death. Current favorability: negative 123,060.

SU ZHU (O.S.)
Capture his heart?

SU ZHU
(desperate)
The system wants me dead!

She buries her face in her hands, the medicine bottle clutched tight.

title: White Moonlight Paradox
description: A woman is reborn and discovers her husband never loved her, but always loved Shen Zhizhi instead.
context:
Title: White Moonlight Paradox
Description: A woman is reborn and discovers her husband never loved her, but always loved Shen Zhizhi instead.

INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - NIGHT

RUAN WAN (28) sits by floor-to-ceiling windows, a fashionable denim jacket over silk pajamas. Her reflection shows a face that's died before.

RUAN WAN (V.O.)
I died screaming their names. Now I wake up three years earlier. Before Shen Zhizhi returns. Before my husband breaks me.

FLASHBACK:

Images flash: Ruan Wan crying over divorce papers. A man's hand pushing her away. Shen Zhizhi's triumphant smile. A car plunging off a cliff.

RUAN WAN (V.O.)
The clown. The placeholder. Their obstacle.

ON SCREEN: Character name - RUAN WAN.
continuation:
INT. CLUB HALLWAY - NIGHT

RUAN WAN walks expressionless, phone in hand - a photo of her husband with Shen Zhizhi. Her knuckles are white.

RICH HANDSOME MAN (O.S.)
Ignoring me now? Or did hubby finally confess?

She stops, hollow-eyed.

RICH HANDSOME MAN (O.S.)
You thought we wanted you? Every dinner, every gift - just to help Zhizhi test his devotion. And yours.

He laughs, cruel.

RICH HANDSOME MAN (O.S.)
She lands tomorrow. Your anniversary spot. You're not half what she is.

RUAN WAN closes her eyes, absorbing the insults. A tear falls.

Then she opens them, now cold and clear.

RUAN WAN
(internal monologue)
Three years head start. Let's see who laughs last.

RUAN WAN stares directly at the camera, her eyes filled with terrible clarity. She holds up her phone, deletes the contact: "Husband."

title: Heart Transplant Recipient
description: A young boy awaits a life-saving heart transplant while his mother's financial desperation threatens to cost him everything.
context:
Title: Heart Transplant Recipient
Description: A young boy awaits a life-saving heart transplant while his mother's financial desperation threatens to cost him everything.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

The camera rapidly pans across the crowd of hurried people in the hospital.

DOCTOR YUAN (V.O.)
This transplant recipient, Yu Zhengkai, is only an eight-year-old child. He's been waiting for a compatible heart for four years. You must safely deliver the heart to Second Hospital within two hours.

ZHANG HAORAN, a young man, carries a blue cooler marked "Human Organ Transport - Special Use" and runs anxiously through the corridor.

EXT. HOSPITAL PARKING LOT - DAY

ZHANG HAORAN runs to a white SUV and opens the trunk.

ZHANG HAORAN
(speaking into the air, as if on a phone call)
Don't worry, Doctor Yuan. I know this route well. It won't even take two hours.

He carefully places the cooler in the trunk. Close-up of the recipient information card on the box, with the name "Yu Zhengkai" written in the name field.

INT. HOSPITAL PARKING GARAGE - DAY

YU ZHENGKAI, an eight-year-old boy with a surgical scar visible above his collar, sits on a low concrete wall, listlessly kicking his feet. LIU WEN stands nearby, her back to him, speaking urgently into her phone.

LIU WEN
(into phone, desperate)
Three days. That's all I need. You can't cancel his coverage when we're this close.

YU ZHENGKAI watches a NURSE walk past pushing a wheelchair. A small stuffed animal tied to the chair catches his eye. He instinctively reaches toward it.

The NURSE stops, protective.

NURSE
Please don't touch the equipment, sweetie.

YU ZHENGKAI
(startled)
I just liked the—

LIU WEN wheels around, her anxiety manifesting as defensiveness.

LIU WEN
He's just a child! We're waiting for his appointment.

NURSE
There are better places to wait than a parking garage.
continuation:
LIU WEN
(exhausted, bitter)
The waiting room is full. The pharmacy is closed. Should we wait in the street?

YU ZHENGKAI suddenly clutches his chest, his face draining of color.

YU ZHENGKAI
(whispering)
Mom... something's wrong...

He slumps sideways. LIU WEN catches him.

LIU WEN
(panic shattering everything else)
Xiao Kai! Xiao Kai, look at me!

NURSE
(radioing immediately)
Code team, pediatric cardiac, parking garage level two.

INT. HOSPITAL OFFICE/CORRIDOR - DAY

DOCTOR WANG, a middle-aged doctor, is excitedly on the phone.

DOCTOR WANG
(into the phone)
Confirmed? Perfect. We're ready.

He hangs up and rushes out of the office to the nurses' station.

DOCTOR WANG
(to the NURSE)
Yu Zhengkai's heart is here. We need him in pre-op immediately. Page his mother.

NURSE
She's not responding to pages. I'll try her personal number.

The NURSE dials. We hear ringing.

INT. HOSPITAL PARKING GARAGE - DAY

Split screen.

On the left, LIU WEN holds YU ZHENGKAI as medical staff converge with a gurney and equipment. On the right, LIU WEN's phone, set on the concrete wall, lights up with "Hospital Surgery."

LIU WEN
(to NURSE)
Help him. Please, just help him.

The phone vibrates silently. The call goes unanswered as the code team surrounds them.

title: Yingying's Stratagem in the Martial Court
description: In the sixth year of the Wu Dynasty, a great drought strikes and barbarian tribes invade. A woman finds herself trapped in a war-torn border region, mistaken for a spy, and confronts the cold general she was forced to marry.
context:
Title: Yingying's Stratagem in the Martial Court
Description: In the sixth year of the Wu Dynasty, a great drought strikes and barbarian tribes invade. A woman finds herself trapped in a war-torn border region, mistaken for a spy, and confronts the cold general she was forced to marry.

EXT. NORTH MOUNTAIN PASS - DAY

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The sixth year of the Wu Dynasty. Drought cracks the earth. Barbarian hordes swallow the northern frontier. The court's coffers are empty—no grain, no reinforcements.

ZHAN BEICHENG, 28, armor scarred from a hundred battles, rides a gaunt black horse. Dark circles bruise his eyes. He leads a squadron of equally ragged soldiers through the gate.

He raises his spear—not in triumph, but a weary salute. His soldiers follow, their boots kicking up dust from a road that hasn't seen rain in months.

EXT. BORDER CITY - DAY

The city chokes on silence. A WOMAN hunches over a water barrel, scraping algae from the wood. Her child lies listless in the dirt, ribs visible through torn silk.

Mei'ER (V.O.)
I thought hunger had a sound. It doesn't. It's the absence of everything.

INT. PRISON CELL - DAY

MEI'ER, 24, lies in a dark cell. Her modern jeans and hoodie have been replaced by a torn hanfu, but her manicured nails remain spotless—impossibly clean.

She clutches her head, a migraine splitting her skull.

MEI'ER
(weakly)
Not a spy. I'm his wife. The General's—

A green light pulses from her jade pendant. MEI'ER gasps, her vision doubling—concrete walls flicker beneath the wooden bars. She swallows vomit.

MEI'ER
(panicked)
No. Not again. Not here—

She shakes the cell door. Rust flakes bite her palms.

MEI'ER
Is anyone there? Anyone!

FEMALE PRISONER (O.S.)
(listlessly)
Save your voice. Seven days since the last millet ration. If you want to live, sleep.

MEI'ER
(shocked)
Seven days?

Mei'er spots a rat corpse in the corner, its bones picked clean.

FLASHBACK TO:
continuation:
INT. MANOR - DAY

MEI'ER, dressed in designer silk, kneels before her FATHER, a tech magnate.

MEI'ER
Father, I've analyzed Zhan Beicheng's military records. His supply chain logistics are... elegant. I need to meet him.

FATHER
The Emperor's decree is sealed. But the border is death.

MEI'ER
Then I'll optimize it.

INT. WEDDING HALL - DAY

MEI'ER stands alone in red wedding robes. A HOUSEKEEPER holds a rooster.

HOUSEKEEPER
My son defends our last granary. Bow to the rooster, or return to your palace.

MEI'ER touches a hidden pocket in her sleeve—her smartphone, now useless. She bows.

MEI'ER (V.O.)
If the system won't come to me, I'll go to the system.

EXT. BORDER VILLAGE - DAY

MEI'ER, now in peasant disguise, sketches fortifications in the dirt with a stick. A SOLDIER grabs her wrist.

SOLDIER A
What are you mapping?

MEI'ER
I—I'm just drawing. I'm the General's—

SOLDIER B
Another spy. Take her to the cells.

INT. PRISON CELL - NIGHT

MEI'ER sits on straw, calculating. She tears a strip from her hem, ties it around her finger.

MEI'ER
(to herself)
Okay. Transmigrated into a side character. Check. System malfunctioning. Check. If I can trigger the exit protocol—

The cell door CREAKS open. TWO SOLDIERS enter, carrying a torch that sputters from tallow shortage.

SOLDIER A
General's interrogating prisoners tonight. You're next.

MEI'ER
Wait—my jade pendant. It's not—

SOLDIER B
Move.

They haul her up. Her pendant swings, catching the torchlight. It flickers green.

INT. GENERAL'S TENT - NIGHT

ZHAN BEICHENG pores over a map, marking supply routes with charcoal. His hands shake from exhaustion.

The soldiers push MEI'ER to her knees. Her pendant hits the dirt—GREEN LIGHT pulses.

ZHAN BEICHENG
(coldly, without looking up)
How many in your raiding party?

MEI'ER
I don't—I'm not a soldier. Look at my hands.

She extends her palms—soft, uncalloused.

ZHAN BEICHENG finally glances at her. His eyes narrow.

ZHAN BEICHENG
Then you're a court spy, testing my loyalty.

MEI'ER
No! I'm the woman you married by decree. I came to fix your logistics—

ZHAN BEICHENG
I have no wife. Drag her out.

Mei'er lunges. The pendant FLARES—

MEI'ER
(screaming)
I want to go home!

She VANISHES. The pendant clatters to the ground, smoking.

SOLDIER A stares at the empty space.

SOLDIER A
General...?

ZHAN BEICHENG picks up the pendant. It's warm. Through the smoke, he sees a faint image: MEI'ER, dressed strangely, in a room of glass and light.

The image flickers out.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: Peerless Hero - None Other Than Me
description: A disciple born without a dantian relies on sheer physical strength to defy fate and protect his sect from demonic forces.
context:
Title: Peerless Hero - None Other Than Me
Description: A disciple born without a dantian relies on sheer physical strength to defy fate and protect his sect from demonic forces.

INT. XUANTIAN SECT TRAINING GROUND - DAY

Morning mist burns off magnificent mountain ranges. On the training ground, QILIN practices palm strikes against a massive stone stele. Each impact leaves a faint imprint. His hands are scarred callouses.

QILIN
(shouting)
Ha!

The stele trembles. A fresh hairline crack appears.

FATTY runs over, breath ragged, and grabs Qilin's arm.

FATTY
Qilin, Gu Ming's coming. Now.

QILIN
Shakes him off, checking his wrist.
Let him.

FATTY
(desperate)
He's bringing Inner Court disciples. They'll do worse than last time. You remember last time.

QILIN
Looks at his scarred hands. At the stele covered in three years of his impact marks.
I remember every hit. That's why I'm done being a dummy.

FATTY
We can't cultivate, Qilin. No dantian, no future.

QILIN
Then I build my own path. Shangyan Academy selection is in three months.

FATTY
They'll never—

A purple energy wave strikes Fatty mid-sentence. He crashes to the ground, groaning.

QILIN
(shouting)
Er Pang!

QILIN rushes to him.

QILIN
Er Pang! Get up!

SENIOR BROTHER GU MING approaches with several disciples. Purple energy still crackles around his hand.

GU MING
(arrogant)
Who gave you permission to dodge?
continuation:
INT. XUANTIAN CANYON - DAY

Scene transition. XUANTIAN SECT DISCIPLES lie scattered across the canyon floor, defeated. Residual demonic energy sparks in the air.

DEMON SECT LEFT PROTECTOR LUOCHA stands triumphant, surrounded by red-black energy coils.

LUOCHA
(laughing)
Your Xuantian Sect is nothing. The Central Province belongs to the Demon Sect now.

XUANTIAN SECT SAINTESS SU ZHI lies on the ground, her sword shattered, face streaked with dirt and blood.

Lord Luocha!

CHEN YUAN
When did we gain a monster disguised as a disciple?

SU ZHI

title: The Sanatorium Outskirts
description: A young girl named Bai Shuqing sacrifices herself to save her mute older brother from pursuers, losing her sight in the process. Twenty years later, the brother, now a powerful CEO, searches desperately for her.
context:
Title: The Sanatorium Outskirts
Description: A young girl named Bai Shuqing sacrifices herself to save her mute older brother from pursuers, losing her sight in the process. Twenty years later, the brother, now a powerful CEO, searches desperately for her.

INT. SANATORIUM OUTSKIRTS - NIGHT

Rain pounds the pine forest surrounding the crumbling state sanatorium. Young BAI SHUQING pulls young MUTE BROTHER, who clutches a worn notebook.

BAI SHUQING
(breathless)
This way!

Five PURSUERS in white orderly uniforms crash through the trees, torches flickering. PURSUER A, heavy-set with a scarred face, shouts.

PURSUER A
Bai Shuqing! The Director ordered all subjects returned!

MUTE BROTHER stumbles and falls. His notebook spills open to a crayon drawing of two figures holding hands.

BAI SHUQING
(frantic)
Get up!

PURSUER A (O.S.)
Consent forms are legal! Don't make this worse!

BAI SHUQING
(whispering)
They'll erase your voice again. Hide under that tree. I'll lead them away.

She shoves him toward a fallen pine, then runs left, snapping branches.

PURSUER A
There! The girl!

PURSUER B
Split up!

The pursuers chase Shuqing. Mute Brother crawls under the tree.

BAI SHUQING is surrounded and falls.

PURSUER A
Where's the boy?

BAI SHUQING
(defiant)
Gone.

PURSUER A
The experimental drugs will kill him without supervision.

He backhands her. She crumples. Mute Brother watches, biting his fist.

PURSUER A
Search the area.

A FEMALE PURSUER with a medical bag kneels as Shuqing tries to rise.

FEMALE PURSUER
She's bleeding from the eyes—hit a rock. We need to stabilize her.

They lift Shuqing. A tiny BELL on a red string dangles from her wrist.

BAI SHUQING (V.O.)
(weak)
I promised...

Mute Brother's fingers close around an identical bracelet in his pocket.
continuation:
INT. ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Sunlight through barred windows. Shuqing and Mute Brother sit at a table. He shows her a notebook filled with bell drawings.

BAI SHUQING
(softly)
When the pills steal your words, draw this. I'll know.

She ties a red string bracelet with a small bell around his wrist.

BAI SHUQING
Three shakes means "I'm here." Two means "run."

Mute Brother ties a matching bracelet on her wrist.

BAI SHUQING
One day we'll leave. Then no one can separate us.

She shakes her wrist three times. The bell rings.

INT. SANATORIUM OUTSKIRTS - NIGHT

Shuqing, limp, is carried toward the main building. Her bracelet sways. Mute Brother watches from shadows, his bracelet now on his wrist.

EXT. MODERN BUILDING EXTERIOR - DAY

ON SCREEN: TWENTY YEARS LATER

Glass towers reflect sun. Adult SHEN YIZHOU walks toward an SUV, the bracelet visible at his cuff.

TWELVE BODYGUARDS in tactical gear bow in unison.

BODYGUARDS
President Shen.

Shen Yizhou touches the bell.

ASSISTANT ZHANG approaches with a tablet.

SHEN YIZHOU
The West Hills records?

ASSISTANT ZHANG
Opened yesterday. Bai Shuqing, discharged 2004. Then... nothing. The blindness would have made her--

SHEN YIZHOU
(interrupting)
She's alive. The investigators?

ASSISTANT ZHANG
Three leads. One runs a piano school for blind children.

Shen Yizhou's fingers tighten around the bell.

SHEN YIZHOU (V.O.)
Little Bell, I learned to speak so I could call your name. I promised I'd marry you. Where are you?

He gets in the SUV.

title: After My Live Stream Exposed Me, The World Begged Me To Return
description: A legendary hero working as a stunt double is revealed when he secretly saves the nation's military network from a foreign cyberattack.
context:
Title: After My Live Stream Exposed Me, The World Begged Me To Return
Description: A legendary hero working as a stunt double is revealed when he secretly saves the nation's military network from a foreign cyberattack.

INT. CYBERSECURITY CENTER - NIGHT

SFX: Alarm sounds continuously.

Red "WARNING" text flashes on screens along with scrolling code. TECHNICIANS operate computers frantically.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Warning, warning, system intrusion detected. Critical failure imminent.

The DIRECTOR rushes into the command center.

DIRECTOR
Report.

TECHNICIAN
(typing rapidly)
Foreign actors hitting our military grid at three thousand requests per second. Standard defenses are failing.

DIRECTOR
Timeline?

TECHNICIAN
Four minutes to total system collapse.

MONITOR: The firewall visualization shatters.

TECHNICIAN
(surprised)
Wait—unauthorized access detected. But... he's patching our vulnerabilities?

On screen, a golden data stream enters the breach, systematically neutralizing threats. It forms a dragon sigil that consumes the attack.

FEMALE TECHNICIAN
That's not one of ours. Who--

TECHNICIAN
(stunned)
Attack neutralized. He didn't just block them, he rewrote our entire security architecture.

The room falls silent. The golden dragon dissolves, leaving a single pixel marker.

TECHNICIAN
I've never seen code like this. It's... impossible.

DIRECTOR
(quietly)
The Ghost Dragon.

She produces a small, ornate case. Inside, a dragon-shaped medal catches the light.

DIRECTOR
This was meant for him. Before he disappeared five years ago.

TECHNICIAN
The legendary hacker? I thought he was a myth.

DIRECTOR
He's real. And he's back. Find him.

FEMALE TECHNICIAN
Director—I'm monitoring a film set live stream for an unrelated op. Look.

SECOND MONITOR: A live feed shows a film set. A figure in black prepares for a stunt.

TECHNICIAN
Facial recognition... ninety-seven percent match. It's him.

DIRECTOR
(leaning forward)
He Fan. Working as a stunt double.

TECHNICIAN
Orders?

DIRECTOR
(standing)
We bring him in. Quietly.
continuation:
EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

HE FAN, 30s, unassuming but with battle-hardened eyes, stands at the edge. THREE ASSASSINS encircle him.

VILLAIN
(pointing blade)
The Ghost dies tonight!

HE FAN
(smiling faintly)
Wrong ghost.

He raises one hand. Clouds above churn ominously.

DIRECTOR (O.S.)
CUT! Perfect! Stunt double up!

EXT. FILM SET - DAY

The rooftop is revealed as a green-screen setup. DIRECTOR ZHANG, 50s, harried, gestures with his walkie-talkie.

In a corner, He Fan sits on a crate, a ruggedized tablet on his lap. Screen reads: "Protocol Complete."

HE FAN
(whispering)
Just in time.

He locks the device as Director Zhang approaches.

DIRECTOR ZHANG
He Fan! We're losing light. I need you to sell this next take.

HE FAN
(nodding)
Understood.

DIRECTOR ZHANG
Good. Hustle.

He Fan hands the tablet to a PA, then moves to his mark. The WIRE TECH fits his harness.

WIRE TECH
You're rigged.

DIRECTOR ZHANG
(into walkie-talkie)
Picture's up! Three, two, one, action!

With wire assistance, He Fan executes the fight choreography—impossibly precise. He leaps—

The rigging GROANS under unnatural stress.

CREW MEMBER
(shouting)
Director! Load sensors are redlining!

DIRECTOR ZHANG
What?

CREW MEMBER
Rig's rated for two-fifty. We're reading four hundred pounds of force and climbing--

SNAP.

He Fan drops ten feet, rolls, and lands in a perfect crouch. Unharmed.

Silence.

DIRECTOR ZHANG
(quietly)
How did you...

He Fan glances past him—to a black sedan arriving at set perimeter. Two officials exit.

HE FAN
(softly)
Been exposed.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Dare to Speak Your Secret
description: A woman is manipulated by her desperate brother into appearing on a live mediation show, where long-simmering family tensions erupt over a house, an unborn child, and a damning psychological accusation.
context:
Title: Dare to Speak Your Secret
Description: A woman is manipulated by her desperate brother into appearing on a live mediation show, where long-simmering family tensions erupt over a house, an unborn child, and a damning psychological accusation.

INT. TV STATION STUDIO - DAY

Lights flicker, the stage is beautifully decorated, and the audience seats are full.

The HOST stands center stage, holding a microphone.

HOST
Welcome everyone to "Dare to Speak Your Secret." Now, please welcome our guests—Mr. Wu Zhengyi, Miss Jia Zhenzhen, and Ms. Wu Haoyue.

In the audience, WU ZHENGYI and WU HAOYUE sit together. Hearing her name, WU HAOYUE freezes.

The audience applauds enthusiastically.

WU HAOYUE
(whispering to Wu Zhengyi)
Zhengyi. You told me this was a business special. "Support your brother's career."

WU ZHENGYI
(gripping her hand, voice low)
Sis, Zhenzhen's leaving me. She's booked the appointment. Just... tell her what she needs to hear.

WU HAOYUE
(eyes narrowing)
You brought me here to bargain?

WU ZHENGYI
(desperate)
On your niece's life. On what we used to be.

He slides down, kneeling. Cameras pivot.

WU ZHENGYI
(whispered)
Twenty-three years you raised me. Is this what you wanted?

WU HAOYUE
(tearful, bitter smile)
You think I wanted to be the villain in your life story?

A long beat. The studio holds its breath.

WU HAOYUE
continuation:
(quietly)
Get up. I'll speak.

WU ZHENGYI helps her up, steering her toward the stage.

HOST
Let's welcome this moment of reconciliation.

WU ZHENGYI and WU HAOYUE walk onto the stage. From the other side, a pregnant JIA ZHENZHEN appears, dry-eyed and resolute.

The three stand center stage.

HOST
(to Jia Zhenzhen)
Miss Jia, you've asked for emergency mediation. What will it take?

JIA ZHENZHEN
(hand on her belly)
I need to not bring my daughter into a house where love comes with a price tag.

HOST
Please, everyone sit.

They sit: Wu Zhengyi beside Jia Zhenzhen, Wu Haoyue across.

MALE EXPERT
Miss Jia, this is a safe space. The broadcast is live. What hasn't been said?

FEMALE EXPERT
And Ms. Wu—this began with property, but where does it end?

WU ZHENGYI
(gently to his wife)
Tell them, Zhenzhen. Tell them why you flinch when she enters a room.

JIA ZHENZHEN turns to Wu Haoyue. Her composure cracks.

JIA ZHENZHEN
Because she... because my therapist has a word for it. NPD. Narcissistic Personality Disorder. And I'm the one paying for her diagnosis.

JIA ZHENZHEN
(quieter, but clear)
I don't need the label. I need her to stop looking at me like I'm a thief who stole her brother and her house.

She wipes her eyes. Wu Haoyue sits motionless, but her jaw tightens—imperceptible, but there.

title: Blind Date Failure, I Registered Marriage with My Boss
description: After a disastrous blind date where the groom's family demands she quit her job and bear children, a woman escapes by claiming a passing stranger as her husband.
context:
Title: Blind Date Failure, I Registered Marriage with My Boss
Description: After a disastrous blind date where the groom's family demands she quit her job and bear children, a woman escapes by claiming a passing stranger as her husband.

INT. UPSCALE RECEPTION ROOM - DAY

HU MOTHER, HU KAI, and HE WAN sit on the sofa for a blind date.

HU MOTHER
The matchmaker explained our expectations. Once married, you'll of course leave that little job of yours. The Hu family doesn't need your salary. Focus on your health, and... (meaningful pause) family planning.

HE WAN sets down her teacup with deliberate calm.

HE WAN
I appreciate your candor, Mrs. Hu. But I think we're looking for fundamentally different things.

HU KAI
(surprised)
Wait—Mom, she's perfect. Don't go.

HU KAI turns to HU MOTHER with a fawning expression.

HU KAI
We can skip the formalities. Let's just set a date.

HE WAN
(turning, ice in her voice)
The formalities are what separate a business meeting from harassment, Mr. Hu.

HU KAI
(dismissive)
You're making this complicated.

HU MOTHER
(angry)

HU KAI reaches for HE WAN's wrist.

(dodging sharply)
Don't.

HU MOTHER

Find whoever spent it.

HU KAI and HU MOTHER advance. HE WAN backs toward the door.

HU KAI
You!

Impossible! He Xiang guaranteed you were—

(helpless)

(to himself)

(shouting)

HU KAI
Stop making scenes!

(V.O.)

(shouting)
Ji! Finally—tell them I'm with you!

HU KAI and HU MOTHER freeze. JI CHENGTIAN's gaze sweeps the scene, landing on HE WAN's calculated desperation.

JI CHENGTIAN
(cool, assessing)
He Wan. From the Beijing conference.

HE WAN
(playing the role)
I texted you I'd be early. These relatives of my stepmother seem to have confused me with property.

JI CHENGTIAN's eyes flick to HU KAI's grip on HE WAN's arm. A beat. He makes his decision.

JI CHENGTIAN
(to HU KAI)
Release my CFO's hand. Then explain why you're touching what's mine.

title: Seventeen Years Ago
description: A desperate gambler sells his own children to pay his debts while his wife fights to save them.
context:
Title: Seventeen Years Ago
Description: A desperate gambler sells his own children to pay his debts while his wife fights to save them.

INT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - NIGHT

Thunder and lightning rage outside.

YAN LANG, gaunt and trembling, clutches a half-empty bottle. Sweat mixes with rain that drips through the ceiling. His wife ZHANG XIULIAN shields their three children with her body.

XIAO NIAN (10) stands guard. TUANTUAN (6) clutches his leg.

YAN LANG
That's the last of it. There's nothing left.

ZHANG XIULIAN
(quiet but firm)
I buried Mom's money. For her surgery. Not for you to chase ghosts.

YAN LANG lunges for a loose floorboard. Xiulian tackles him. They struggle. The bottle crashes against the wall.

YAN LANG
(through gritted teeth)
They'll kill me. You understand? Kill me.

ZHANG XIULIAN
Then they'll kill a monster, not a father.

YAN LANG backhands her. She falls, cracking her head against the table. Blood trickles. The children scream.

XIAO NIAN
(not crying, fierce)
Don't touch her!

TUANTUAN
Mommy's bleeding...

Yan Lang freezes. For a heartbeat, he looks at his bloodied wife, his terrified children. Then he hears a phantom DOG BARK outside - a debt collector's signal. His face hardens.

YAN LANG
(quietly, to himself)
Better to be a live devil than a dead man.

He yanks the floorboard up, grabs a worn envelope. Xiulian grabs his ankle.

ZHANG XIULIAN
(whispering)
Yan Lang... you swore on their lives.

YAN LANG
(shaking her off)
Swears don't pay debts.

He stumbles toward the children. Xiao Nian tries to fight, but Yan Lang overpowers him, stuffing a rag into his mouth. He drags all three toward the door.
continuation:
INT. TRICYCLE CART - NIGHT

The children lie bound with coarse rope, wedged between feed sacks. XIAO NIAN's eyes gleam in the dark - alert, storing every detail. TUANTUAN whimpers.

TUANTUAN
(whispering)
Brother, I'm scared...

XIAO NIAN
(whispered, fierce)
Remember his face. Remember everything.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - NIGHT

YAN LANG waits by a broken mile marker, hood up. A pickup truck approaches. A HUMAN TRAFFICKER steps out, snake tattoo on his neck.

HUMAN TRAFFICKER
They quiet?

YAN LANG
(gripping the envelope)
Terrified. Won't make a sound.

The Trafficker peers into the tricycle. The children freeze, playing possum.

HUMAN TRAFFICKER
Three's a lot. Hard to move.

YAN LANG
(tightening his grip)
They're small. And forgetful.

A beat. The Trafficker counts cash onto the envelope. Yan Lang's hand trembles as he takes it.

HUMAN TRAFFICKER
One hour. Don't look back.

Yan Lang watches the pickup's taillights disappear. He counts the money again, slowly. A drop of rain hits the cash - or maybe it's something else.

INT. DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAWN

Weak light filters through the broken window. ZHANG XIULIAN stirs, her head wound crusted. She touches it - dizzy, nauseous. She sees the empty corner where the children slept. The rag Xiao Nian bit through.

ZHANG XIULIAN
(voice cracking)
Nian'er...?

She finds Grandma's medicine bottle, empty. Her fingers trace the floorboards - pried up. Her wedding photo, smashed.

EXT. OUTSIDE THE HOUSE - DAWN

ZHANG XIULIAN stumbles out, clutching her head. She sees a tricycle slowly driving away, her children bound in the back, canvas flapping. Through the morning mist, she hears them.

CHILDREN
(crying out)
Mom! Mom, save us!

ZHANG XIULIAN stands frozen for a heartbeat, then sprints barefoot after the tricycle, blood seeping through her bandaged head as the sun breaks over the ridge.

title: Meeting in Joy
description: A prince and his family are ambushed by assassins in a bamboo forest at night, leading to a desperate fight for survival and a tragic sacrifice.
context:
Title: Meeting in Joy
Description: A prince and his family are ambushed by assassins in a bamboo forest at night, leading to a desperate fight for survival and a tragic sacrifice.

EXT. BAMBOO FOREST PATH - NIGHT

Rain slashes through the bamboo forest. A carriage races along the flooded path, six black-clad ASSASSINS closing in.

ASSASSIN (O.S.)
Prince Jinming's head buys freedom! Kill the rest!

Inside the carriage, PRINCE XIE JINMING grips the reins, his expression grave.

FAN ZHU
The river ford is ahead! I can hold them at the narrows!

FAN ZHU spurs his horse back toward the assassins.

EXT. FOREST CLEARING - NIGHT

PRINCESS QING SHU runs through the forest carrying XIE YUTANG. Her foot catches a root—she twists, taking the impact on her shoulder. Three ASSASSINS fan out around them.

QING SHU
(shielding Tangtang)
Back.

XIE JINMING arrives just as an assassin lunges. Their swords clash. He engages them, but there are too many.

QING SHU scrambles behind a moss-covered boulder.

QING SHU
(whispered)
Our night market game. Silent as stone. Not a breath.

XIE YUTANG
(trembling)
No matter what?

QING SHU
No matter what.

QING SHU kisses Tangtang's forehead, then deliberately steps away from the boulder.

Elsewhere, XIE JINMING is outnumbered, his sleeve ripped and bloodied.

QING SHU spots an assassin circling toward the boulder. She grabs a fallen branch, swings it.

QING SHU
continuation:
Here! The princess is here!

The assassin turns. Behind him, another raises a crossbow at XIE JINMING's back.

QING SHU
Jinming! Behind you!

QING SHU lunges, tackling the crossbowman. The bolt grazes her. A third assassin's blade catches her side—she stumbles toward the cliff edge.

XIE JINMING
Qing Shu!

QING SHU looks from her bleeding husband to the assassins near Tangtang's boulder. Beyond the cliff, the river roars.

QING SHU
For Tangtang!

She sprints for the cliff, breaks free of grasping hands, and dives toward the white water.

XIE JINMING
QING SHU!

XIE JINMING frantically cuts down the assassins around him and rushes to the cliff edge. The river churns below.

FAN ZHU arrives.

FAN ZHU
Your Highness!

XIE JINMING
She dove for the river! Willow Bend!

FAN ZHU
I'll find her!

FAN ZHU immediately heads down the cliff with a rope.

EXT. RIVER SHALLOWS - DAWN

Dawn breaks. QING SHU lies unconscious on a sandbar, breathing shallow but steady.

A LITTLE GIRL prods her with a stick, then drops it in alarm.

LITTLE GIRL
Don't die! My mother knows herbs! I'll get her!

She splashes away through the reeds.

title: Untitled Screenplay
description: A disturbing night unfolds as a father forces his way into his daughter's room with sinister intentions.
context:
Title: Untitled Screenplay
Description: A disturbing night unfolds as a father forces his way into his daughter's room with sinister intentions.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

A young woman (DAUGHTER, 20s) in a nightgown sits on the floor by the bed, urgently texting on her phone. The room is dimly lit.

SFX: Knocking sound

FATHER (O.S.)
Daughter, open the door.

SFX: Louder knocking

FATHER (O.S.)
Open the door. Now.

DAUGHTER
(urgently)
Dad, I'm sleeping.

FATHER (O.S.)
Don't lie. I know you're not.

SFX: Loud crash of door being kicked open

A middle-aged man in a suit (FATHER) enters, holding a prescription bottle. His expression flickers between concern and menace.

FATHER
You're hiding something. Having one of your spells?

FATHER pulls out a worn photograph.

FATHER
Your sister stopped believing me too.

DAUGHTER backs onto the bed, phone hidden.

DAUGHTER
(whispering)
That was different. You need to leave.

FATHER
(grinning)
Leave? I protect you. From everything.
continuation:
FATHER lunges, pinning her. DAUGHTER screams.

FATHER
She fought like this. Exact same way.

DAUGHTER kicks him hard in the chest.

FATHER
(groaning)
Ah! You think pain matters anymore?

FATHER grabs a pillow. The phone drops—screen shows: "911 ON WAY."

FATHER
Let me help you. Let me fix this.

FATHER presses the pillow hard against DAUGHTER's face. DAUGHTER struggles, then goes limp.

FATHER removes the pillow. DAUGHTER lies still.

FATHER
(shaking her)
Get up! You can't do this to me—get up!

FATHER drags her to the floor.

FATHER
Stop playing! Your sister played dead too!

He checks her pulse. His face drains of color.

FATHER
No. No no no.

FATHER drops the photograph and rushes out.

EXT. BRIDGE - DAY

A handsome man in a suit (GU QICHEN) holds a bouquet, checking his phone anxiously. Caption appears: GU QICHEN, Young Master of Gu Group.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

DAUGHTER still lies on the floor, her fate uncertain. Her phone BUZZES: "Gu Qichen: almost there."

SFX: Heavy sound effect like a gunshot

title: The Real and Fake Heiress Returns
description: A woman is brought to the Tan family estate as a potential long-lost granddaughter, but faces suspicion and danger from the paranoid patriarch.
context:
Title: The Real and Fake Heiress Returns
Description: A woman is brought to the Tan family estate as a potential long-lost granddaughter, but faces suspicion and danger from the paranoid patriarch.

INT. TAN FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

OLD MASTER TAN (70s, sharp-eyed, calculating) sits in his leather armchair. Beside him on the sofa is WEI LING (20s, nervous, the current "granddaughter" who arrived three months ago). A silver tea set sits untouched.

OLD MASTER TAN
(to Wei Ling)
Pour the tea. Let me see your hands tremble.

Before Wei Ling can respond, LEI CHANGPING (40s, slick, predatory) enters with CHEN YUN (20s, composed but with haunted eyes).

LEI CHANGPING
Old Master Tan. This is Chen Yun. Our genetic indicators are a 99.8% match.

CHEN YUN
(formal, controlled)
Grandfather.

WEI LING
(vehement, desperate)
Grandfather, she's lying! I saw her surveillance file—she was recruited from a debtor's prison!

OLD MASTER TAN
(to a servant)
The briefcase.

A SERVANT delivers a leather briefcase to Lei Changping. He opens it: stacks of pristine bills.

LEI CHANGPING
(satisfied)
Wise choice. She's all yours.

LEI CHANGPING turns to leave, but OLD MASTER TAN's voice freezes him.

OLD MASTER TAN
One month. If she survives, you'll receive ten times that.

LEI CHANGPING
(confused)
Survives?

OLD MASTER TAN
My last three "granddaughters" didn't.

LEI Changping's smile falters. He glances at Chen Yun, seeing her not as a commodity but as a potential corpse, then exits quickly.

Chen Yun steps forward, her hands visibly scarred. She kneels before Old Master Tan, her voice barely controlled.

CHEN YUN
Father died two years ago. His last words were about your birthday—he said you always wanted rain, but feared the ache in your joints. He kept a bottle of your favorite malt whiskey under his bed. Never opened it.

Wei Ling lunges forward, but two MAIDS materialize, holding her back.

WEI LING
(screaming)
He's testing you! None of it's real!
continuation:
OLD MASTER TAN
(to Chen Yun)
The whiskey was a decoy. The real test was whether you'd mention the daughter I actually lost. She drowned at seven.

Chen Yun's face goes pale—this detail wasn't in any file.

OLD MASTER TAN
(to the maids)
Remove the imitation.

A maid presses a chloroform-soaked cloth to Wei Ling's face. Her body goes limp.

OLD MASTER TAN
(to Chen Yun)
Stand up. Real heirs don't kneel for money.

CHEN YUN
(standing, voice steady)
Then give me something worth standing for.

OLD MASTER TAN
(cold laugh)
Ha. Zhang Jiaxin!

INT. STUDY - DAY

BUTLER ZHANG JIAXIN (50s, immaculate, unreadable) enters. The walls are lined with photos of girls at various ages—all suspected impostors, all crossed out with red X's.
