Master.

OLD MASTER TAN
(hands over evidence bag)
Test this hair against my son's remains. Not the living tissue samples.

ZHANG JIAXIN
The ones in the sealed vault?

OLD MASTER TAN
If she's a plant, they'll have compromised the vault. This way, we see who prepared which lie.

On the desk: a photo of a seven-year-old girl in a yellow raincoat—the only uncrossed picture.

INT. HALLWAY - NIGHT

Zhang Jiaxin walks through the darkened corridor, now in a simple slip dress—her off-duty attire. She makes a phone call, her posture completely changed: relaxed, predatory.

The fifth one. She's different.

ZHANG JIAXIN
(into phone)
Miss Qin, the old man is running a parallel test. Should I intercept?

A beat. She listens, then smiles.

ZHANG JIAXIN
Understood. I'll make sure Chen Yun passes. After all, we need a real heiress to access the Tan Group shares.

INT. TAN FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

Grandfather.

The briefcase.

Survives?

title: Waking Up Five Years Later, Married to the Richest Heir
description: After waking from a coma, Lin Ci discovers she's lost five years of memory and is married to the powerful heir she once admired from afar.
context:
Title: Waking Up Five Years Later, Married to the Richest Heir
Description: After waking from a coma, Lin Ci discovers she's lost five years of memory and is married to the powerful heir she once admired from afar.

INT. SCHOOL PLAYGROUND - DAY

LIN CI (18 years old), wearing a school uniform, nervously holds a pink love letter in both hands.

LIN CI (V.O.)
Today, eighteen-year-old Lin Ci has decided to confess her feelings to her senior, Jiang He.

LIN CI smiles, walking across the playground full of anticipation.

FLASHBACK:

JIANG HE and Lin Ci's best friend LI SIQI embrace tightly on the steps.

LIN CI (V.O.)
But Jiang He and my best friend Li Siqi were hugging each other. I was betrayed by my best friend.

Back to reality, the smile on LIN CI's face disappears, replaced by shock and pain. The love letter slips from her hand and floats to the ground. She angrily throws the letter at the embracing couple.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LIN CI (23 years old) suddenly wakes up from the hospital bed, bandages wrapped around her head, a look of terror on her face.

A DOCTOR enters the room.

DOCTOR
Young Madam, you're awake. How are you feeling?

LIN CI
(disoriented)
Young Madam? I'm Lin Ci. What happened to me?

LIN CI sees the electronic clock on the bedside table displaying "October 9, 2024." Her eyes widen in shock.

LIN CI (V.O.)
Isn't it 2019 now? How can it be 2024?

LIN CI
(to the Doctor)
You're saying I'm twenty-three now, and I aged five years in my sleep?

DOCTOR
You were in a coma. It appears so.

LIN CI
Who did I marry?

DOCTOR
Well, that's—

At this moment, LU BOCHUAN, a handsome man wearing a white coat, walks in. SUPER: LU BOCHUAN, HEIR OF THE LU FAMILY.

DOCTOR
(to Lu Bochuan)
Mr. Lu, the Young Madam is awake.

LIN CI (V.O.)
He's so handsome.

LIN CI
(to Lu Bochuan)
Are you Lu Bochuan? You're the one treating me, right?

LU BOCHUAN
(coldly)
Lin Ci, what are you trying to pull now?

DOCTOR
(to Lu Bochuan)
Mr. Lu, she's lost five years of memory. She doesn't remember you anymore.

LIN CI points at LU BOCHUAN in disbelief.
continuation:
LIN CI
Sir... I'm your wife?

LU BOCHUAN
That's right. I'm your husband of three years, Lu Bochuan. Also the husband you've hated for three years.

FLASHBACK:

LIN CI is grabbed by the arm by LU BOCHUAN. She struggles violently.

LIN CI (in flashback)
Go away, don't touch me!

Back in the hospital room, LIN CI's expression changes from shock to secret delight.

LIN CI (V.O.)
The big boss is my husband!

LIN CI looks at LU BOCHUAN shyly and happily.

LIN CI
(bashfully)
Honey... hug me.

The DOCTOR tactfully prepares to leave.

DOCTOR
Well... I won't disturb you two then.

LU BOCHUAN (V.O.)
She's actually willing to let me touch her.

LU BOCHUAN walks toward LIN CI and extends his hand. LIN CI also reaches out to touch him.

FLASHBACK:

A WOMAN questions LU BOCHUAN.

WOMAN (in flashback)
If it weren't to repay a debt of gratitude, would you have married Lin Ci?

LU BOCHUAN (in flashback)
No.

Another flashback, the WOMAN is hit by a car on the road.

Back in the hospital room, LIN CI suddenly clutches her head in severe pain.

LIN CI
Ah!

LU BOCHUAN
(anxiously)
Headache?

LIN CI (V.O.)
(chaotic images flash through her mind)
Affair... I thought this car accident... How is he just like Jiang He, the guy I blindly had a crush on in college? They're both scumbags. How is my taste always so bad?

LIN CI
(pushing Lu Bochuan away)
Don't touch me! I'm fine, perfectly fine!

LIN CI gets out of bed herself, but her body is weak.

LU BOCHUAN (V.O.)
Sure enough, even with amnesia, she won't let me touch her.

LIN CI's legs give way, she cries out and is about to fall.

LIN CI
Ah!

LU BOCHUAN immediately turns around, his eyes full of concern.

title: The Young Lady of the Warlord's Mansion
description: Fifteen years after a renowned opera singer destroyed her family, a woman sells herself into servitude at the enemy's gates—not for survival, but for revenge.
context:
Title: The Young Lady of the Warlord's Mansion
Description: Fifteen years after a renowned opera singer destroyed her family, a woman sells herself into servitude at the enemy's gates—not for survival, but for revenge.

EXT. HUO MANSION - DAY

Snow falls like ash. GU WANYI, early twenties, kneels motionless in threadbare robes before the mansion gates. A wooden sign before her reads: "Selling Myself to Bury My Father."

GU WANYI (V.O.)
My name is Gu Wanyi. At least, that's what the forged papers say. The girl who watched her family die in this house died with them fifteen years ago.

Footsteps crunch through snow. SHEN PEIYUN emerges, mid-forties, wrapped in black fox fur, her face unlined by time. A servant holds a red oil-paper umbrella above her. She studies Wanyi with calculating eyes.

GU WANYI (V.O.)
She's spent fifteen years turning this mansion into a fortress. She thinks she's safe.

SHEN PEIYUN
Another desperate soul looking for sanctuary?

Wanyi lifts her face—tears frozen on her cheeks, eyes carefully downcast.

GU WANYI
I can read. Write. Manage accounts. I'll do anything.

GU WANYI (V.O.)
Anything including watching you bleed.

Shen Peiyun's gaze sharpens. She circles Wanyi slowly, inspecting her like livestock.

SHEN PEIYUN
You've the look of someone who's known better days. What's your real name, girl?

GU WANYI
Wanyi is the name my father gave me before he died. Nothing else matters now.

Shen Peiyun's eyes narrow—something flickers, but fades. She waves a dismissive hand.

SHEN PEIYUN
The kitchens need scrubbing. Don't die before sunrise.

She sweeps inside. Wanyi's tears stop. Her knuckles whiten around the sign.

GU WANYI (V.O.)
She doesn't recognize me. Fifteen years changes a child into a stranger.

FLASHBACK

TITLE CARD: FIFTEEN YEARS AGO
continuation:
INT. GU MANSION OPERA STAGE - DAY

SHEN PEIYUN, twenty-five and radiant, performs in costume. Below, YOUNG JINYUE (8) sits on her father GU HUAI'AN's lap, mesmerized.

GU WANYI (V.O.)
Back then, she was just a voice. A beautiful, deadly voice.

A fan slips from Shen Peiyun's hand during a flourish. She locks eyes with Gu Huai'an. A silent understanding passes.

INT. GU MANSION COURTYARD - DAY

Post-performance. Shen Peiyun approaches Gu Huai'an, who studies her with too much interest. His WIFE sits stiffly beside him.

YOUNG JINYUE
Father, can she stay? Please?

GU HUAI'AN
(deflecting)
My daughter enjoys your performance, Miss Shen.

SHEN PEIYUN
(lowering her eyes)
Then I would be honored to remain. Temporarily.

Gu Huai'an's wife grips her teacup until it cracks.

INT. GU MANSION BEDROOM - DAY

Shen Peiyun emerges from behind a screen wearing MRS. GU'S finest qipao—too young for her, too tight. Jinyue stands frozen.

YOUNG JINYUE
That's Mother's dress...

SHEN PEIYUN
(smirking)
Not anymore. Your father has... new tastes.

She advances. Jinyue backs against the wall.

SHEN PEIYUN
You know what else, little Jinyue? Your father's "intelligence reports" are being... re-evaluated. By the Deputy General. Who shares his new tastes.

Her smile turns cold steel.

SHEN PEIYUN
Run while you can. The Huo family doesn't leave loose ends.

INT. GU MANSION BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jinyue and her BROTHER (6) hide under the bed. Heavy boots thunder closer.

GU HUAI'AN (O.S.)
Jinyue, no matter what you hear—stay hidden. Protect your brother. You're the last of us.

The door splinters. DEPUTY GENERAL HUO enters with soldiers and Shen Peiyun.

DEPUTY GENERAL HUO
Governor Gu. Your treasonous correspondence with the Japanese has been discovered.

GU HUAI'AN
(laughing bitterly)
I was a fool. I invited the wolf to guard the sheep.

Gunfire erupts. Jinyue's mother collapses beside the bed, her blood seeping under the frame. Her dying eyes meet Jinyue's—she presses a finger to her lips, then goes still.

Jinyue clamps a hand over her brother's mouth, her own silent scream tearing through fifteen years of nightmares.

GU WANYI (V.O.)
Fifteen years ago, I learned that revenge isn't a choice. It's the only way to exhale.

title: Blind for Fifteen Years, Invincible for a Lifetime
description: A young boy protects a sacred artifact at the cost of his family, sacrificing himself to save his adoptive sisters and guard the nation's treasure.
context:
Title: Blind for Fifteen Years, Invincible for a Lifetime
Description: A young boy protects a sacred artifact at the cost of his family, sacrificing himself to save his adoptive sisters and guard the nation's treasure.

INT. LIN FAMILY ESTATE - NIGHT

VOICEOVER
The Star Transformation has resurfaced. The imperial bounty reads one hundred million gold—but the Jing bloodline that can truly wield it? That price cannot be printed.

Blood reflects moonlight like scattered rubies across the courtyard. The RED-ROBED WOMAN glides through the carnage, silk ribbons humming through the air. At the far corridor, a MAIDSERVANT presses a fragment of glowing jade into YOUNG LIN MENGYAO'S palm while pushing three children ahead.

MAIDSERVANT
(whispering)
Three pieces, one soul. The young master is the key. Now run—and don't look back.

She shoves them toward the servant's passage, then slams the door, bracing her body against it. A crimson blade pierces the wood. No scream—only a final, shuddering breath.

LIN MOTHER
(sword raised, steady)
I am Lin Qingyan, and this house stands by its word.

She fends off BLACK-CLAD ASSASSINS until the RED-ROBED WOMAN'S ribbon snaps her blade from her grip.

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(circling)
Your family shelters a Jing boy. Where is he?

LIN MOTHER
(defiant)
Ask the ghosts you made tonight. They'll tell you—some things are worth more than gold.

The ribbon tightens. LIN MOTHER'S gaze drifts to the hidden exit. Her last breath leaves a silent command.

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(releasing the ribbon)
Find him. But remember—the boy must be taken alive. Dead blood is useless blood.
continuation:
EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

The three children crash through mist-shrouded pines. YOUNG LIN MENGHAN twists her ankle with a muffled cry.

YOUNG LIN MENGHAN
(gritted teeth)
Second Sister, I can still—

YOUNG LIN MENGYAO
(pressing jade fragments into JING TIAN'S hands, fierce)
Mother died so you could live, Jing Tian. Not because of your blood—but because you're our brother.

YOUNG JING TIAN
(trembling)
Then let us live together.

YOUNG LIN MENGYAO
(softens, almost maternal)
A family listens to its eldest. When you find us again—describe the sky for me.

She clutches MENGHAN'S hand. Together, they leap into the portal that erupts from the assembled pendant. Light swallows them.

YOUNG LIN MENGYAO/YOUNG LIN MENGHAN (V.O.)
(barely audible)
Third Brother...

RED-ROBED WOMAN materializes at the clearing's edge.

EXT. FOREST CLEARING - NIGHT

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(cold smile)
The Star Transformation, little prince. Hand it over, and I'll spare your sisters the trouble of burying you.

YOUNG JING TIAN
(internal monologue)
They think they died for a stone. No—they died believing I was worth more than a stone. Mother, I won't make a liar of you.

YOUNG JING TIAN
(raising the pendant)
You want Great Xia's treasure? Take it from my heart.

He smashes the jade against his brow. Blinding light erupts, searing his vision white.

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(shielding her face, snarling)
The resonance! He's triggered the blood seal!

She lunges, but YOUNG JING TIAN clutches the artifact to his chest. His eyes begin to scar over.

YOUNG JING TIAN
(choking, smiling)
I, Jing Tian... I see you, Mother. I see you both...

He falls. The RED-ROBED WOMAN pries the pendant from his grip—but its glow is dead. Dormant.

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(to subordinates)
Fifteen years. That's how long until the bloodline renews. Then we hunt the sisters.

INT. LIN FAMILY ESTATE - NIGHT

OLD TU kneels beside LIN MOTHER, closing her eyes. FENG LING examines a bloodied silk ribbon.

OLD TU
The boy's resonance has vanished. Not dead—transformed.

FENG LING
(rolling the ribbon)
Then we have fifteen years to find him before they do.

They melt into the shadows, following a trail only they can see.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

The MYSTERIOUS FIGURE cradles YOUNG JING TIAN'S body. The boy breathes—shallow, scarred, but alive. The pendant is fused to his chest, dark.

MYSTERIOUS FIGURE
(whisper)
Blind for fifteen years. But alive. And when those eyes open again... no one else will be invincible.

FADE OUT.

Ask the ghosts you made tonight. They'll tell you—some things are worth more than gold.

The ribbon tightens. LIN MOTHER'S gaze drifts to the hidden exit. Her last breath leaves a silent command.

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(releasing the ribbon)
Find him. But remember—the boy must be taken alive. Dead blood is useless blood.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

The three children crash through mist-shrouded pines. YOUNG LIN MENGHAN twists her ankle with a muffled cry.

YOUNG LIN MENGHAN
(gritted teeth)
Second Sister, I can still—

YOUNG LIN MENGYAO
(pressing jade fragments into JING TIAN'S hands, fierce)
Mother died so you could live, Jing Tian. Not because of your blood—but because you're our brother.

YOUNG JING TIAN
(trembling)
Then let us live together.

YOUNG LIN MENGYAO
(softens, almost maternal)
A family listens to its eldest. When you find us again—describe the sky for me.

She clutches MENGHAN'S hand. Together, they leap into the portal that erupts from the assembled pendant. Light swallows them.

YOUNG LIN MENGYAO/YOUNG LIN MENGHAN (V.O.)
(barely audible)
Third Brother...

RED-ROBED WOMAN materializes at the clearing's edge.

EXT. FOREST CLEARING - NIGHT

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(cold smile)
The Star Transformation, little prince. Hand it over, and I'll spare your sisters the trouble of burying you.

YOUNG JING TIAN
(internal monologue)
They think they died for a stone. No—they died believing I was worth more than a stone. Mother, I won't make a liar of you.

YOUNG JING TIAN
(raising the pendant)
You want Great Xia's treasure? Take it from my heart.

He smashes the jade against his brow. Blinding light erupts, searing his vision white.

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(shielding her face, snarling)
The resonance! He's triggered the blood seal!

She lunges, but YOUNG JING TIAN clutches the artifact to his chest. His eyes begin to scar over.

YOUNG JING TIAN
(choking, smiling)
I, Jing Tian... I see you, Mother. I see you both...

He falls. The RED-ROBED WOMAN pries the pendant from his grip—but its glow is dead. Dormant.

RED-ROBED WOMAN
(to subordinates)
Fifteen years. That's how long until the bloodline renews. Then we hunt the sisters.

INT. LIN FAMILY ESTATE - NIGHT

OLD TU kneels beside LIN MOTHER, closing her eyes. FENG LING examines a bloodied silk ribbon.

OLD TU
The boy's resonance has vanished. Not dead—transformed.

FENG LING
(rolling the ribbon)
Then we have fifteen years to find him before they do.

They melt into the shadows, following a trail only they can see.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

The MYSTERIOUS FIGURE cradles YOUNG JING TIAN'S body. The boy breathes—shallow, scarred, but alive. The pendant is fused to his chest, dark.

MYSTERIOUS FIGURE
(whisper)
Blind for fifteen years. But alive. And when those eyes open again... no one else will be invincible.

FADE OUT.

title: Marrying Behind My Boyfriend's Back After Eight Years
description: A woman discovers her boyfriend of eight years has grown distant with his new secretary, leading her to agree to an arranged marriage he knows nothing about.
context:
Title: Marrying Behind My Boyfriend's Back After Eight Years
Description: A woman discovers her boyfriend of eight years has grown distant with his new secretary, leading her to agree to an arranged marriage he knows nothing about.

INT. NUANNUAN'S APARTMENT - DAY

Close-up shot, a designer handbag sits on the sofa, next to an open suitcase.

NUANNUAN sits on the sofa, packing her luggage. Her phone BUZZES.

NUANNUAN picks up her phone to check.

The phone screen displays a message.

MOM (V.O.)
Nuannuan, the wedding's in two weeks. Gu Chuan sent these plans—which do you like?

NUANNUAN looks at her phone, her expression dejected.

NUANNUAN (O.S.)
I'm getting married, but my boyfriend of eight years doesn't know. He hired a new secretary last month. Yesterday, he ordered her a three-tier cream cake for her birthday. After eight years, he still "forgets" I'm allergic.

INT. A XIAO'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

FLASHBACK:

A XIAO and ZHANG YUYAN, wearing a white dress, laugh as they wipe cream from their faces.

ZHANG YUYAN (laughing)
You got me!

NUANNUAN walks in, stopping cold. The living room is decorated for a party.

A XIAO and ZHANG YUYAN freeze.

NUANNUAN
A Xiao. What's going on?

ZHANG YUYAN
We were just—

A XIAO lunges for napkins but slips. The cake in his hand flies—

Slow motion close-up, the cake smashes into NUANNUAN's face.

NUANNUAN staggers back, wiping cream from her eyes. She gasps.

A XIAO is laughing, but then realizes it's NUANNUAN. His smile freezes.

NUANNUAN tastes the cream. Her face changes. She starts coughing, struggling to breathe.

A XIAO
Nuannuan? I thought you were at your conference—

NUANNUAN clutches her chest and collapses to the floor.

A XIAO (panicking)
Nuannuan!

A XIAO rushes to support her.

ZHANG YUYAN (fearfully)
Is she...?

A XIAO (frantically)
Call 120! NOW!

ZHANG YUYAN
I'm calling!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

The DOCTOR and NURSES rush down the corridor pushing NUANNUAN on a hospital bed. A XIAO follows alongside, looking anxious.

A XIAO
Please save her!

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

NUANNUAN lies in the hospital bed, receiving an IV drip. A XIAO stands by the bed. The DOCTOR is speaking to him.

DOCTOR
Severe anaphylaxis. Another ten minutes, we might've lost her.

The DOCTOR shakes his head and leaves.

A XIAO walks to the bedside and holds NUANNUAN's hand.

A XIAO
Nuannuan, I'm so sorry. I forgot—

NUANNUAN opens her eyes and looks at him.

NUANNUAN
(raspy)
You celebrated her birthday... in our home.

A XIAO
Nuannuan, you...

A XIAO's phone rings. He walks aside to answer it.

A XIAO
Hello?

ZHANG YUYAN (V.O.)
(crying)
Brother A Xiao? I'm at the office alone. The security alarm went off. I think someone's breaking in.

A XIAO
Yuyan, get out. Call building security—

ZHANG YUYAN (V.O.)
Please come. I'm scared.

A XIAO hangs up and turns to NUANNUAN.

NUANNUAN (O.S.)
Go save your secretary.

A XIAO
Nuannuan, it's a real emergency. I'll be back.

A XIAO turns and hurries away.

NUANNUAN lies in bed, devastated, tears streaming down her face.

After a while, NUANNUAN struggles to sit up and picks up her phone. She scrolls through it—seeing a photo of A Xiao and Zhang Yuyan, heads together at a restaurant, posted last night.

NUANNUAN dials.

NUANNUAN
Mom. Tell Gu Chuan I accept. And move the wedding up.

She hangs up, staring at the ceiling. The tears stop. Her expression hardens into resolve.

title: Tattered Long Wind
description: Lin Mufeng vows to uncover the truth behind his father's death, no matter the cost.
context:
Title: Tattered Long Wind
Description: Lin Mufeng vows to uncover the truth behind his father's death, no matter the cost.

EXT. JIANGCHENG LIN CORPORATION - DAY

Glass towers reflect morning sun over landscaped lakes. Workers stream toward the gleaming LIN CORPORATION logo.

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

A small plain room. Black cloth. A portrait of LIN ZHAN. Incense smoke curls above offerings.

LIN MUFENG bows with the FEMALE ASSISTANT. She clutches documents.

The BUTLER enters, expression grave.

BUTLER
Young Master.

LIN MUFENG
(still bowing)
The forensics report?

BUTLER
Wiped. All surveillance, corrupted.

Lin Mufeng straightens. His knuckles whiten on the table edge.
continuation:
LIN MUFENG
Then we start over. Every business rival. Every family disagreement.

LIN MUFENG
(quietly)
Every lie he ever told.

The Assistant's grip tightens on her documents.

A SUBORDINATE enters, whispers to the Butler.

BUTLER
(shocked)
You're certain?

The Subordinate nods, exits.

BUTLER
Our Jiangcheng contact. They've found something at one of Lin Hu's warehouses. Something... wrapped in your father's favorite suit.

LIN MUFENG
(still)
Jiangcheng.

LIN MUFENG
(eyes sharp)
Lin Hu's territory.

title: Giving Up Hope
description: A woman endures emotional neglect and abuse from her fiancé who cannot let go of his ex-girlfriend, until a broken cup becomes the final straw.
context:
Title: Giving Up Hope
Description: A woman endures emotional neglect and abuse from her fiancé who cannot let go of his ex-girlfriend, until a broken cup becomes the final straw.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

WEN ZHIXIAN, wearing a white shirt, curls up in the corner of the bathroom, letting cold water from the shower pour over her entire body. She covers her face with both hands, crying silently.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
Hope doesn't fracture. It erodes.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

WEN ZHIXIAN carries a cup of coffee, smiling as she walks toward GU YUCHEN, who sits on the sofa reviewing contracts.

WEN ZHIXIAN
Yuchen, I made that Ethiopian blend you like—

GU YUCHEN doesn't look up, his hand swats impatiently.

GU YUCHEN
I said no distractions.

GU YUCHEN stands up abruptly, knocking into WEN ZHIXIAN. Coffee spills across his sleeve. He curses under his breath, walking away without a glance back. WEN ZHIXIAN watches his back, the smile fading.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
His words were sharpening.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

WEN ZHIXIAN sits on the sofa, phone pressed to her ear, her posture eager.

WEN ZHIXIAN
(into the phone)
Yuchen, you won't believe what happened at the gallery today—

The line disconnects. She stares at the screen, the moment stretching.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
Every silence grew heavier.
continuation:
EXT. STREET SIDE - NIGHT

GU YUCHEN is drunk, leaning against a utility pole. WEN ZHIXIAN supports him, struggling with his weight.

GU YUCHEN suddenly grips her chin, his eyes focusing with drunken clarity.

GU YUCHEN
(murmuring)
Your jaw... it's all wrong. Not like hers.

He shoves her away. WEN ZHIXIAN stumbles, catching herself against a wall. She watches him sink to the ground, the truth pooling like blood.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
Truths spoken like accidents.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

Flashback. WEN ZHIXIAN breaks down crying under the shower.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

WEN ZHIXIAN kneels on the floor, cleaning up broken coffee cup pieces. Her injured hand trembles. Her gaze falls on a mug with a cartoon pattern, tucked in the back of the cabinet—different from their usual set.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
But I never imagined the last straw would be something so small.

She reaches for it. Her fingers slip. The mug falls, shattering on the tile—not with a crash, but a soft, final sound.

GU YUCHEN hears the sound and rushes over.

GU YUCHEN
(roaring)
Wen Zhixian!

He glares at WEN ZHIXIAN furiously.

GU YUCHEN
Didn't I tell you not to touch this cup? Do you know it's...

WEN ZHIXIAN
(interrupting, voice breaking)
I know. I know it's from her. But I didn't—

GU YUCHEN
Don't touch me! You think I'll believe you? You're just narrow-minded, you can't tolerate anything related to Zhaomu!

WEN ZHIXIAN
(her own fury rising)
Then why is it here? In our home? With our wedding invitations on the table!

She points to the mantle where a photo of GU YUCHEN and another woman sits half-hidden behind a plant.

GU YUCHEN
(quietly venomous)
Don't you dare speak her name.

He raises his hand. The slap cracks across her face. WEN ZHIXIAN's head snaps. She touches her cheek, disbelief giving way to something harder.

Flashback. GU YUCHEN fastens a pearl bracelet on WEN ZHIXIAN's wrist, his voice earnest.

GU YUCHEN (V.O.)
This can be our beginning.

Back to reality. WEN ZHIXIAN looks at the bracelet. She twists it until the string snaps. Pearls scatter, bouncing across the hardwood.

WEN ZHIXIAN
(not a question)
You asked me to build a life on ground you never left.

She places the broken string in GU YUCHEN's hand and turns to leave.

GU YUCHEN stands frozen, the string coiled in his palm like a dead thing.

WEN ZHIXIAN pauses at the threshold. She looks back. Then, methodically, she walks back and slaps him—not in fury, but with the weight of finality. The sound echoes.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED...

title: The Debt of Honor
description: A man returns from prison expecting to fulfill his engagement, only to be rejected and humiliated by the family he once sacrificed for—discovering loyalty is a currency they no longer accept.
context:
Title: The Debt of Honor
Description: A man returns from prison expecting to fulfill his engagement, only to be rejected and humiliated by the family he once sacrificed for—discovering loyalty is a currency they no longer accept.

EXT. LIANG FAMILY ESTATE COURTYARD - DAY

Aerial shot of a magnificent Chinese-style mansion with a plaque reading "LIANG RESIDENCE." The courtyard is decorated with lanterns and filled with guests attending a banquet. A lion dance troupe performs in the yard, drums and gongs resounding, creating a festive atmosphere.

MASTER LIANG, the elderly founder of the Liang family, wearing a brown robe, top hat, and holding a cane, walks spiritedly on the red carpet, greeting guests.

GUEST
Master.

GUEST (O.S.)
Master, Master.

A SUBORDINATE rushes up to MASTER LIANG.

SUBORDINATE
He's here.

MASTER LIANG
King Qi Shan?

SUBORDINATE
(shakes head)

MASTER LIANG
Show him in.

MASTER LIANG turns to welcome the honored guest. However, standing at the entrance is a plainly dressed man with prison-hardened eyes - ZHAO GANGZI. The lions fall silent.

MASTER LIANG
(strained)
Zhao Gangzi.

ZHAO GANGZI walks slowly on the red carpet as surrounding guests cast strange looks. MASTER LIANG, the second daughter LIANG RUORU, and her mother LI JINLIAN all look at him with carefully masked panic.
continuation:
LIANG RUORU
(whisper-harsh)
You were told not to come today.

ZHAO GANGZI
The engagement was set three years ago. I'm here to honor it.

LI JINLIAN
(sharp)
You've tracked prison filth into our home. Did you truly believe a promise could survive three years of shame?

LIANG RUORU
(tightly)
You shouldn't have done this.

ZHAO GANGZI
(steady)
Are you breaking your word?

LIANG RUORU
Because you are an ex-convict.

ZHAO GANGZI
(quietly fierce)
I took that record for you. For this family.

LIANG RUORU
(crossing her arms)
The past is ash. Where's your proof?

ZHAO GANGZI
(shaken)
What?

ZHAO GANGZI stares at LIANG RUORU, his hand moving to his coat pocket where something heavy rests.

title: The Divine King Couple
description: Two legendary warriors, the Northern God Lord and the Southern Goddess King, defend their nation's borders before resigning to reunite and live ordinary lives together.
context:
Title: The Divine King Couple
Description: Two legendary warriors, the Northern God Lord and the Southern Goddess King, defend their nation's borders before resigning to reunite and live ordinary lives together.

INT. NORTHERN BORDER OF DAXIA - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Northern Border of Daxia

Torches sputter in churned mud. The stench of blood hangs thick. Daxia's broken shield wall holds by a thread. Bodies of the fallen litter the scorched earth, armor twisted like parchment.

A BARBARIAN GENERAL, scar crossing his blind eye, wipes gore from his mace and laughs through broken teeth.

BARBARIAN GENERAL
The Northern God Lord is myth! This land is ours!

His horde ROARS, pounding battered shields. They surge forward—

—And freeze. 

From the writhing fog, shadows emerge. Black armor that drinks the firelight. At their head, CHU XIAO. No flourish. No proclamation. Just presence.

The BARBARIAN GENERAL's good eye narrows.

BARBARIAN GENERAL
Impossible. He hasn't been seen in—

CHU XIAO
(softly, but it cuts through the din)
Ten years. I was beginning to think you'd forgotten.

Silence. Then the MASKED PERSON at the General's side draws twin curved blades, moonlight dancing on the steel.

MASKED PERSON
Then let us remind you why you hid.

CHU XIAO moves. Not fast—inevitable. His sword flares to life, flame racing up the blade like a living thing. He meets the Masked Person mid-leap.

The clash rings like a temple bell. CHU XIAO flows between three opponents. Each strike is precise, almost meditative. A Barbarian lunges—CHU XIAO pivots, the blade passing through where he was. The soldier falls, armor glowing red.

The MASKED PERSON presses a desperate attack. CHU XIAO deflects, guiding the energy past his shoulder, then reverses. The pommel strikes the mask—crack—the figure crumples.

The BARBARIAN GENERAL charges. CHU XIAO plants his feet. The dragon tattoo on his neck begins to glow. Behind him, a massive phantom takes shape—flaming scales, ancient eyes. Not a beast. A guardian.

The phantom dragon ROARS. The Barbarian army breaks. They flee into the darkness.

CHU XIAO watches them go. The flame on his sword dies. He looks at the blood on his hands—not all of it enemy—and wipes it on his cloak.

EXT. SOUTHERN DOMAIN OF DAXIA - DAY

ON SCREEN: Southern Domain of Daxia

Morning mist clings to rice paddies turned to mire. The corpses of Daxia's southern legion steam in the cold. MU BINGQING stands atop a burial mound, her silver-white armor unstained amid the carnage.

ON SCREEN: Southern Goddess King - Mu Bingqing

Below, a thousand warriors of Wo kneel in surrender. Only their GENERAL remains standing, his banner trembling in his grip.

WO GENERAL
You can't kill us all. The empire will just send more.

MU BINGQING
Not for ten years.

She descends the mound. Her sword, still sheathed, hums with contained power. The air around her grows brittle.

WO GENERAL
You'd massacre prisoners?

MU BINGQING stops before him. She reaches out—not to strike. She touches the banner. Frost spreads from her fingertip, racing up the silk, turning it to brittle crystal. It shatters.

MU BINGQING
No. I'm taking your will to fight.

She walks past him. The WO WARRIORS flinch as she passes, but she touches none of them. They simply... break. Not bodies. Spirits. They drop their weapons and stare at their hands as if forgetting what they're for.

At the tree line, she turns back. The entire invasion force sits in the mud, weeping.
continuation:
EXT. SOUTHERN DOMAIN MILITARY CAMP - DAY

MU BINGQING unbuckles her pauldrons. They fall with a heavy CLANG. Her lieutenant, MEI, catches them, eyes wide.

MEI
My lady, you can't—

MU BINGQING
I already have.

She's down to quilted gambeson now. From a chest, she takes a simple jade pendant—civilian jewelry. Slips it on.

MEI
The council will demand your return. The peace won't hold without your name.

MU BINGQING
My name is just a word. Teach them to remember the dead instead.

She pulls out the folded marriage certificate. It's worn at the creases, read a thousand times. She touches Chu Xiao's written name, a ghost of a smile on her lips, then tucks it away.

MU BINGQING
The Southern Goddess King died on that field. Tell them Mu Bingqing is going home.

MEI salutes, tears in her eyes. The FEMALE SOLDIERS stand at attention as MU BINGQING walks through their ranks, each gaze a farewell.

INT. NORTHERN FORTRESS - NIGHT

CHU XIAO sits on a war chest, cleaning his blade. The firelight makes him look older than his thirty years. Around him, his veterans stand guard—more family than soldiers.

A grizzled SERGEANT steps forward.

SERGEANT
The capital's already sending couriers. They want a triumph. They want their hero.

CHU XIAO
The only triumph is that we're still breathing.

He slides the sword into its scabbard. The leather is worn smooth—not from battle, but from thumbprints at morning and dusk, when he would take out a hidden thing to look at it.

The SERGEANT follows his gaze.

SERGEANT
She still waiting?

CHU XIAO
She's never waited. She's been fighting her own war.

He pulls out the red marriage certificate. It's creased, the characters fading. He studies it like a map to a place he thought he'd never reach.

CHU XIAO
But the war's over now. For both of us.

He stands and offers the sword to the SERGEANT. Not as a gift—as a burden being set down.

CHU XIAO
Tell them Lin Chu Xiao is dead. All that remains is a man with a promise to keep.

The SERGEANT takes it, understanding. The other SOLDIERS bow—not to a god, but to a brother.

EXT. SOUTHERN DOMAIN MILITARY CAMP - DAY

MU BINGQING stands at the camp's edge. Her simple travel pack is light. She looks back once at the banners, the armor, the life.

Her hand rests on her chest, where the certificate lies against her skin.

A young SOLDIER approaches, offers her a lotus bun wrapped in cloth.

YOUNG SOLDIER
For the journey, my lady.

MU BINGQING
I'm not your lady anymore.

She takes it anyway. Smiles. For the first time in years, it reaches her eyes.

MU BINGQING
Just Mu Bingqing.

She walks toward the rising sun. The certificate flutters in her hand as she adjusts her pack. The names are visible: Lin Chu Xiao, Mu Bingqing.

Close-up on the certificate, but now we see something new—a date. Ten years ago, the day they married in secret before the wars began.

The parchment trembles—not from wind. From the hand holding it, finally steady.

FADE OUT.

title: Universe Cave Heaven
description: An immortal cultivator confronts the embodiment of the Heavenly Dao to break through the barriers of time and return to the mortal realm.
context:
Title: Universe Cave Heaven
Description: An immortal cultivator confronts the embodiment of the Heavenly Dao to break through the barriers of time and return to the mortal realm.

INT. IMMORTAL REALM - DAY

The Immortal Realm, shrouded in clouds and mist. Giant floating stone islands hover in the air, waterfalls cascading from their edges, frozen mid-flow.

CHEN YULONG, magnificent armor bearing a charred scar across the chestplate, sits cross-legged on a floating rock. A golden light formation flickers around him, unstable.

He opens his eyes. The light fades.

CHEN YULONG
(to himself)
Three hundred years, and still the mortal heart beats beneath immortal skin.

He touches his chest. A faint blue lotus tattoo pulses, then disappears.

EXT. ENTRANCE TO THE RIVER OF TIME - DAY

Chen Yulong stands at the edge of a cliff. Below, time flows as liquid silver.

The sky changes color. A massive blue vortex appears.

CHEN YULONG
(alert)
So you knew I was coming.

The HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT emerges from the vortex, an old man in white robes woven with constellations.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
I am the guardian of all cause and effect. You achieved Immortal Venerable to escape grief. Do not throw away eternity for a ghost.

CHEN YULONG
She is not a ghost to me.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
Return to your cultivation. The mortal world has forgotten you.

CHEN YULONG
Then I will remind them.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
I have witnessed ten thousand ascensions. All who return become less than memory.

Chen Yulong draws his sword. The blade bears a single notch near the hilt.

CHEN YULONG
This notch remembers. That is enough.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
Infinite Universe, Ten Directions Earth Treasury!

The sky fractures. Crystal pillars of causality descend.

CHEN YULONG
Azure Lotus Sword Art.
continuation:
His sword meets the first pillar. The impact ripples through his arm.

A lightning bolt tears through his shoulder, leaving a smoking wound.

CHEN YULONG
(strained)
Sword Wind.

He deflects the bolt, but staggers. Blood drips from his gauntlet.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
You bleed eternity. How much can you lose before you are no longer yourself?

CHEN YULONG
(steady)
As much as it takes.

He channels energy. The sword's notch glows blue.

CHEN YULONG
Azure Lotus Sword Art. Sword Force.

The golden net of sword qi strikes. The Heavenly Dao Embodiment flickers, briefly transparent.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
(surprised)
You use your own soul as blade edge?

CHEN YULONG
What else would I use?

Chen Yulong's charred scar spreads across his armor. His hair shows a streak of white.

CHEN YULONG
(shouting)
Azure Lotus Sword Art! Sword Song!

A massive golden sword shadow erupts from his blade, consuming the Heavenly Dao Embodiment. As the embodiment shatters, he laughs.

HEAVENLY DAO EMBODIMENT
You win the battle. But against time... you will lose yourself.

The vortex collapses. Chen Yulong falls to one knee, breathing heavily.

EXT. MOUNTAIN PEAK IN THE MORTAL REALM - DAY

Chen Yulong materializes, sword planted in earth to support himself. He is visibly aged, armor cracked beyond repair.

He gazes at a distant village. A blue lotus blooms in the valley below.

CHEN YULONG
(quietly)
The pond... it still holds water.

He touches the notch in his sword—now cold.

He transforms into a white light and vanishes.

title: The Abstinent Boss Dotes on the Factory Flower & The Poor Girl Rises Through Childbirth
description: A 19-year-old factory worker discovers she is pregnant with triplets after a one-night encounter with a mysterious man, who turns out to be a powerful CEO visiting the factory.
context:
Title: The Abstinent Boss Dotes on the Factory Flower & The Poor Girl Rises Through Childbirth
Description: A 19-year-old factory worker discovers she is pregnant with triplets after a one-night encounter with a mysterious man, who turns out to be a powerful CEO visiting the factory.

INT. HOSPITAL EXAMINATION ROOM - DAY

JIANG XIUQING wears a patient gown, sitting on the hospital bed, clutching her stomach with a pained expression.
The DOCTOR sits at the desk with her back turned.

DOCTOR
Last menstrual period?

JIANG XIUQING
(surprised)
What?

DOCTOR
(turning slightly)
Date of your last period.

JIANG XIUQING
(looking down, quietly)
I don't remember. Maybe three months ago? The factory...

DOCTOR
And intercourse?

JIANG XIUQING
(voice barely audible)
Once. Three months ago.

The DOCTOR turns around and hands a medical report to JIANG XIUQING.

DOCTOR
You're pregnant. Triplets. Twelve weeks.

JIANG XIUQING takes the report, staring at it in disbelief, her hand trembling.

DOCTOR
(sternly, but lower)
Three premature births cost more than you'll make in five years. You need to contact the father. Today.
continuation:
INT. ELECTRONICS FACTORY WORKSHOP - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Three months ago.
Workers bustle along the assembly line.

SUPERVISOR
(shouting)
National Day shipment! This batch must be finished! All time off is cancelled!

EXT. ELECTRONICS FACTORY ENTRANCE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Workers line up at the entrance in formation.
LIU XUEMEI and ZHANG YAN are not wearing work uniforms; they're dressed up beautifully.
JIANG XIUQING, wearing her work uniform and holding a lunch box, runs up hurriedly.

JIANG XIUQING
Why aren't you all wearing uniforms?

ZHANG YAN
(disdainfully)
Some of us read memos. Qi Yanchen's inspection.

LIU XUEMEI
(whispering excitedly)
They say he's ice-cold. Never looks at anyone twice. But maybe today—

ZHANG YAN
(proudly)
He has a type, and it's not factory issue.

Several black luxury cars arrive and stop before the red carpet.
BODYGUARDS exit and open the doors.
QI YANCHEN steps out of the car and adjusts his suit, his expression unreadable.

FEMALE WORKERS
(excitedly)
Wow!
It's Master Qi!
Master Qi is here!
It really is Master Qi!
Oh my god!
Master Qi is so handsome!

ZHANG YAN and LIU XUEMEI excitedly push through the crowd.

ZHANG YAN
(pushing JIANG XIUQING aside)
Get out of the way!

JIANG XIUQING is shoved and stumbles forward, falling right into QI YANCHEN's arms.
QI YANCHEN steadies her, his grip firm. Their eyes meet. For a split second, his mask slips—surprise, then something darker.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Prince and the Courtesan
description: A woman sold into servitude discovers her fate entwined with a compromised prince, challenging both his supposed infertility and her own survival.
context:
Title: The Prince and the Courtesan
Description: A woman sold into servitude discovers her fate entwined with a compromised prince, challenging both his supposed infertility and her own survival.

INT. BROTHEL - NIGHT

Golden lanterns cast fractured light across a smoke-filled hall. GUESTS shout over dice while DANCERS move through orchestrated desire.

MADAM
(through a painted smile)
Wine for all! Enjoy the pleasures of the night!

The MADAM shoves a YOUNG GIRL toward the main floor.

MADAM
(coldly)
Earn your keep or join the street rats.

The MADAM ascends the stairs, her smile evaporating into calculation.

INT. BROTHEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

STEWARD HE drags SONG SHIWEI by her bound wrists.

SONG SHIWEI
(struggling, fierce)
I was contracted as a maid! Not this—

STEWARD HE hurls her against the bedpost.

SONG SHIWEI
(breathless)
My father died in your master's service. Have you no honor?

STEWARD HE
Honor? The debt he left buys you tonight.

SONG SHIWEI
I will not—

She bites his forearm, deep. He backhands her across the face.

STEWARD HE
(hissing, clutching his bleeding arm)
Next time, I'll sell you to the docks. Master Wu arrives within the hour.

He locks the door. Her lip bleeds. She spits crimson onto the floor.

SONG SHIWEI
(to herself, trembling but resolute)
Not while I draw breath.
continuation:
INT. BROTHEL ROOM - LATER

The lock clicks. PEI JINGYUAN stumbles through, his pupils blown, sweat soaking his royal silks. He leans on the doorframe, fighting invisible flames.

PEI JINGYUAN
(groggy, desperate)
Which room...?

SONG SHIWEI bolts for the hidden servant's entrance. He catches her arm—not roughly, but with a drugged man's clumsy strength.

PEI JINGYUAN
(squeezing his eyes shut)
Please. They're watching. If I don't... they'll know I'm not compromised.

She sees the corridor shadow—ZHOU QING's silhouette. Understanding cuts through her terror.

SONG SHIWEI
(whispered, calculating)
Sixteen. My first night.

PEI JINGYUAN
(pleading)
I won't remember this. You won't suffer for it. The physicians say I'm barren.

He presses something into her palm—a jade token, still warm.

PEI JINGYUAN
Take this. For your silence. For whatever comes after.

Their eyes meet. Two cornered animals. She makes a choice, subtle and terrible, and nods once.

He pushes her toward the bed. The candle gutters. Rose petals drift from a rafter, already dying.

INT. BROTHEL ROOM - MORNING

SONG SHIWEI wakes alone, the token clutched in her fist. PEI JINGYUAN stands at the window, his back to her, shoulders rigid with shame.

PEI JINGYUAN
(without turning)
I remember enough to hate myself. The token bears my seal. Use it if you must. Or bury it. I deserve no agency in your choice.

He leaves. She examines the token: the character PEI, carved into blood-jade.

SONG SHIWEI (V.O.)
The Prince Regent. The one they call the Shadow King.

INT. BROTHEL CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

ZHOU QING blocks her exit, his hand on his sword hilt.

ZHOU QING
(formal, lethal)

Title: The Prince and the Courtesan
Description: A woman sold into servitude discovers her fate entwined with a compromised prince, challenging both his supposed infertility and her own survival.

INT. BROTHEL - NIGHT

Golden lanterns cast fractured light across a smoke-filled hall. GUESTS shout over dice while DANCERS move through orchestrated desire.

MADAM
(through a painted smile)
Wine for all! Enjoy the pleasures of the night!

The MADAM shoves a YOUNG GIRL toward the main floor.

MADAM
(coldly)
Earn your keep or join the street rats.

The MADAM ascends the stairs, her smile evaporating into calculation.

INT. BROTHEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

STEWARD HE drags SONG SHIWEI by her bound wrists.

SONG SHIWEI
(struggling, fierce)
I was contracted as a maid! Not this—

STEWARD HE hurls her against the bedpost.

SONG SHIWEI
(breathless)
My father died in your master's service. Have you no honor?

STEWARD HE
Honor? The debt he left buys you tonight.

SONG SHIWEI
I will not—

She bites his forearm, deep. He backhands her across the face.

STEWARD HE
(hissing, clutching his bleeding arm)
Next time, I'll sell you to the docks. Master Wu arrives within the hour.

He locks the door. Her lip bleeds. She spits crimson onto the floor.

SONG SHIWEI
(to herself, trembling but resolute)
Not while I draw breath.

INT. BROTHEL ROOM - LATER

The lock clicks. PEI JINGYUAN stumbles through, his pupils blown, sweat soaking his royal silks. He leans on the doorframe, fighting invisible flames.

PEI JINGYUAN
(groggy, desperate)
Which room...?

SONG SHIWEI bolts for the hidden servant's entrance. He catches her arm—not roughly, but with a drugged man's clumsy strength.

PEI JINGYUAN
(squeezing his eyes shut)
Please. They're watching. If I don't... they'll know I'm not compromised.

She sees the corridor shadow—ZHOU QING's silhouette. Understanding cuts through her terror.

SONG SHIWEI
(whispered, calculating)
Sixteen. My first night.

PEI JINGYUAN
(pleading)
I won't remember this. You won't suffer for it. The physicians say I'm barren.

He presses something into her palm—a jade token, still warm.

PEI JINGYUAN
Take this. For your silence. For whatever comes after.

Their eyes meet. Two cornered animals. She makes a choice, subtle and terrible, and nods once.

He pushes her toward the bed. The candle gutters. Rose petals drift from a rafter, already dying.

INT. BROTHEL ROOM - MORNING

SONG SHIWEI wakes alone, the token clutched in her fist. PEI JINGYUAN stands at the window, his back to her, shoulders rigid with shame.

PEI JINGYUAN
(without turning)
I remember enough to hate myself. The token bears my seal. Use it if you must. Or bury it. I deserve no agency in your choice.

He leaves. She examines the token: the character PEI, carved into blood-jade.

SONG SHIWEI (V.O.)
The Prince Regent. The one they call the Shadow King.

INT. BROTHEL CORRIDOR - CONTINUOUS

ZHOU QING blocks her exit, his hand on his sword hilt.

ZHOU QING
(formal, lethal)

Barren. They said barren.

title: You Caused the Divorce, Don't Come to Me with Regrets
description: A woman who waited five years for a man realizes at their wedding that his heart still belongs to another, forcing her to confront whether to continue a one-sided relationship.
context:
Title: You Caused the Divorce, Don't Come to Me with Regrets
Description: A woman who waited five years for a man realizes at their wedding that his heart still belongs to another, forcing her to confront whether to continue a one-sided relationship.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

A pristine banquet hall. Guests murmur, stealing glances at the empty groom's seat. LIN HAN sits still as a painted figurine at the main table, hands folded in her lap.

EMCEE (O.S.)
Ladies and gentlemen, we appreciate your patience. The ceremony will commence shortly.

HAN XIAO hovers nearby, checking her phone.

HAN XIAO
(low)
It's been forty minutes. He's not even picking up.

LIN HAN
He's coming.

The phrase lands like a prayer she's repeated too often.

LU YANG approaches with a wine glass, ZHOU SHUAI trailing behind.

LU YANG
Brother Chen texted. Traffic.

Zhou Shuai glances at Lin Han's hands. Opens his mouth, then shuts it.

ZHOU SHUAI
(to Lu Yang, quietly)
That ring—

LU YANG
(sharp glance)
Not now.

LIN HAN (V.O.)
Five years. He missed my graduation, my mother's funeral, my promotion dinner. I always had a reason ready. Today, I wonder who I'm convincing.

The hall doors open. XIAO YICHEN enters. Behind him, CHU MO in ivory silk. Guests whisper.

XIAO YICHEN
(to the table)
Apologies. Urgent business at the airport.

He pulls out a chair for Chu Mo beside his empty seat.

HAN XIAO
That's the bride's seat.

XIAO YICHEN
She needs to sit. She's unwell.

LIN HAN
(slowly)
There are chairs at the guest tables.

CHU MO
(softly)
I shouldn't have come. Brother Yichen insisted...

Her voice trails off. Xiao Yichen's hand remains on the chair back.

XIAO YICHEN
She'll be more comfortable here. You don't mind.
continuation:
It's not a question. Lin Han studies his face—searching for something, anything. Finds only impatience.

She stands, smoothing her dress.

LIN HAN
Of course. I'll wait backstage.

As she turns, Zhou Shuai catches her wrist, his voice barely a whisper.

ZHOU SHUAI
The lotus engraving... it's his design from five years ago, isn't it?

Lin Han looks down at her ring. The platinum band catches the light.

XIAO YICHEN
(O.S., dismissive)
Didn't have time to commission a new one. It's just a detail.

Chu Mo watches Lin Han's face, a flicker in her eyes—pity? triumph?—then turns to Xiao Yichen, holding a sliced apple.

CHU MO
You barely ate all day.

He leans in, takes it from her fingers. Natural as breathing.

Lin Han walks away, back straight. No one sees her hands trembling.

INT. DRESSING ROOM - DAY

Lin Han faces the mirror. In her reflection, a stranger in wedding red.

LIN HAN (V.O.)
When did 'waiting' become my entire personality?

FLASHBACK:

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

Lin Han, younger, sits by a hospital bed. Xiao Yichen stands by the window, a check on the nightstand between them.

XIAO YICHEN
Your mother will have the best care.

(beat)
I need someone consistent in my life. Someone who won't leave.

He looks at her—not with warmth, but a desperate kind of hunger.

XIAO YICHEN
Stay. That's all.

END FLASHBACK.

MAKEUP ARTIST
Miss Lin? We're ready when you—

The artist sees Lin Han's expression and stops.

LIN HAN
Cancel the ceremony.

She removes the ring, places it on the vanity. The lotus seems to bloom in the light.

LIN HAN (V.O.)
Five years taught me his patterns. The next five will teach me mine.

She walks out, leaving the ring and the dress behind.

title: You Proposed the Divorce, Why Are You Anxious About My Remarriage?
description: A woman discovers her husband's affair and learns shocking truths about her past and present.
context:
Title: You Proposed the Divorce, Why Are You Anxious About My Remarriage?
Description: A woman discovers her husband's affair and learns shocking truths about her past and present.

INT. DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

The DOCTOR sits behind her desk, expression neutral. JI RUOLAN sits across from her, staring at an ultrasound image.

DOCTOR
Mrs. Wang. You're eight weeks pregnant. Given your medical history, this is unprecedented.

JI RUOLAN
(clipped, controlled)
Impossible. I have documented premature ovarian failure. Fifteen years of negative tests.

DOCTOR
Your current hormone panel contradicts those records. Or perhaps...

She slides a consent form across the desk. JI RUOLAN's eyes fix on her forged signature.

DOCTOR
Your husband transferred your last frozen embryo six months ago. I felt you deserved to hear this from me.

JI RUOLAN's face is a mask. She folds the report with trembling fingers.

JI RUOLAN
(quietly)
I have no family. Only assets to protect.

She stands and exits. The DOCTOR watches, troubled.

TITLE CARD: ONE MONTH AGO
continuation:
EXT. VILLA DISTRICT STREET - DAY

JI RUOLAN carries groceries in a canvas tote, walking with measured steps. She pauses, touching her abdomen with a flicker of confusion.

JI RUOLAN
(to herself)
Strange...

She turns back toward her villa.

INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM - DAY

WANG JIANYE lounges on the sofa in a silk robe. The MAID, CHEN MEI, dusts the coffee table.

WANG JIANYE
Little Mei. My humidifier needs adjusting. It's too dry in here.

CHEN MEI
Of course, Mr. Wang.

As she passes, he catches her wrist.

WANG JIANYE
She'll be at her luncheon until four. We have time.

CHEN MEI
(softly, complicit)
The staff notice things.

WANG JIANYE
Let them. Fifteen years of a ghost in my bedroom. You, at least, are warm.

He pulls her onto the sofa. The front door opens silently.

JI RUOLAN stands frozen in the foyer. The tote bag slips from her shoulder—organic bread, figs, and a bottle of prenatal vitamins scatter across the marble floor without a sound.

WANG JIANYE and CHEN MEI turn, mid-embrace.

JI RUOLAN
(voice barely a whisper)
How thorough. The maid already knows all your preferences.

She doesn't move, but her spine straightens.

JI RUOLAN
(cold clarity)
I came back for my wedding ring. I seem to have misplaced it fifteen years ago.

BLACKOUT

title: The Richest Man Became My Suitor After Divorce
description: After her grandfather's death, Tang Yao enters a marriage of convenience with the cold CEO Ji Hancheng to fulfill a promise between their families.
context:
Title: The Richest Man Became My Suitor After Divorce
Description: After her grandfather's death, Tang Yao enters a marriage of convenience with the cold CEO Ji Hancheng to fulfill a promise between their families.

EXT. COMPANY BUILDING - DAY

A black luxury car with license plate A99999 slowly approaches. At the same time, a young woman in a yellow modified cheongsam, TANG YAO, arrives on a beige electric scooter. The luxury car stops at the company entrance, and TANG YAO parks her scooter nearby.

A group of BODYGUARDS in black suits rush out of another car and line up beside the luxury car. TANG YAO parks, removes her helmet, revealing her delicate features.

ON SCREEN: TANG YAO - DISGRACED HEIRESS

The BODYGUARDS open the car door. An elderly man in white traditional Chinese clothing, holding a cane, JI YEYE, exits the car surrounded by bodyguards.

ON SCREEN: JI SHOUCUN - JI FAMILY PATRIARCH

JI YEYE
Miss Tang.

TANG YAO
Grandpa Ji. Thank you for meeting me.

JI YEYE
Old Tang saved my life in '98. I promised him I'd protect his girl. This is my grandson, Ji Hancheng.

The BODYGUARDS step aside, revealing a young man in a blue striped suit with a stern expression, JI HANCHENG, who walks forward.

ON SCREEN: JI HANCHENG - ACTING CEO, JI GROUP

TANG YAO extends her hand.

TANG YAO
Mr. Ji.

JI HANCHENG glances at her hand, then walks past without accepting it. TANG YAO smoothly lowers her hand, typing a quick text.

TANG YAO (V.O.)
At least he looked at my hand. For a second.

JI HANCHENG (V.O.)
Grandpa skipped his medication this morning. This is blackmail.

JI YEYE
(smiles)

TANG YAO
Let's not keep the office waiting.

JI HANCHENG (V.O.)
She's already planning her exit strategy.

JI YEYE
Go on.

JI HANCHENG walks toward the marriage registration office. TANG YAO follows, sending her text. JI YEYE and his men watch with satisfied expressions.

JI YEYE
She has his eyes. Steady.

BODYGUARD
Sir?

JI YEYE
Nothing. Just an old man's fancy.
continuation:
EXT. MARRIAGE REGISTRATION OFFICE - DAY

TANG YAO and JI HANCHENG exit, both expressionless, holding red marriage certificates.

TANG YAO (V.O.)
Two signatures. Twenty minutes. One lifetime.

They approach JI YEYE.

TANG YAO
Grandpa Ji, I have hospital rounds. I'll call tomorrow.

JI YEYE
Take care, child.

TANG YAO turns and walks to her scooter, securing the certificate in her medical bag. JI YEYE and JI HANCHENG watch her merge into traffic.

JI HANCHENG (V.O.)
She rides like she's escaping a sinking ship.

JI YEYE
Bring her home tonight. No arguments.

JI HANCHENG
I understand.

JI YEYE (V.O.)
She's drowning, boy. Don't just watch.

JI HANCHENG (V.O.)
If this marriage secures Grandpa's treatment and my board vote... fine. For now.

INT. MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

ON SCREEN: THREE DAYS LATER - TANG FAMILY MEMORIAL

TANG YAO, dressed in black, kneels before her grandfather's portrait.

TANG YAO'S GRANDFATHER (V.O.)
Yaoyao, happiness is a choice. Not a debt.

A man in a worn suit, TANG XIN, stumbles in, flanked by two COLLECTORS.

ON SCREEN: TANG XIN - YAOYAO'S FATHER

TANG XIN
Yaoyao—please. They followed me here.

DEBT COLLECTOR
Two hundred thousand. Today.

TANG XIN
(crawling toward TANG YAO)
Your grandfather's insurance! It's family money!

TANG XIN lunges for TANG YAO's bag. She sidesteps, letting him crash. The marriage certificate slides out.

TANG YAO
(quietly)
I liquidated it. For Grandpa's surgical bills. Every yuan.

TANG XIN stares at the certificate, then at her.

TANG XIN
You married him? The Ji family CEO?

The DEBT COLLECTOR picks up the certificate, photographing it.

DEBT COLLECTOR
Mrs. Ji. We'll be in touch about your father's obligations.

TANG YAO watches the collector dial his phone, her knuckles white.

FADE OUT.

title: After Divorce, Meeting a Soft-Hearted God
description: A woman discovers her husband's betrayal on their daughter's birthday, the same night she encounters a mysterious doctor with a dangerous secret.
context:
Title: After Divorce, Meeting a Soft-Hearted God
Description: A woman discovers her husband's betrayal on their daughter's birthday, the same night she encounters a mysterious doctor with a dangerous secret.

INT. DIM ALLEY - NIGHT

A bag of medicinal powder is thrown on the ground, white dust scattering across wet cobblestones.

DEAN GU and LI QINGGE lean against a brick wall, kissing intensely. His hand tangles in her hair; hers clutches his shoulder.

LI QINGGE's eyes fly open. She bites down hard on his lower lip.

She shoves him back. Blood drips from the corner of her mouth—his blood. She wipes it away, disgust and horror flickering across her face.

She slaps DEAN GU hard across the face.

DEAN GU
(subtitle: Bastard)
Bastard.

LI QINGGE
(angrily)
I should have let those people catch you!

Her knees buckle. She leans against the wall, gasping, then staggers away into the darkness.

DEAN GU leans against the wall, dazed. He touches his bleeding lip—and the burning under his skin, the poison that's been his constant companion for five years, is suddenly... quiet.

DEAN GU (V.O.)
Old Gu swore only a pure Yin body could quiet the Yang poison. But she...

He watches her disappear around the corner.

DEAN GU (V.O.)
...she silences it.

BIAN XU rushes into the alley, medical bag in hand.

BIAN XU
Dean Gu! The investigators—

He stops, seeing Dean Gu's expression.

BIAN XU
Your vitals. They're stable. How?

Dean Gu's gaze stays fixed on the empty alley entrance.

DEAN GU
The woman Old Gu hid. She was here.

Bian Xu hesitates, then nods slowly.

BIAN XU
We tracked her to this district. Then lost her trail when he died.

Dean Gu touches his lip again, a slow realization burning brighter than any poison.

DEAN GU
Find her. Not just her location. Her life. Everything.

BIAN XU
Yes, Dean Gu.
continuation:
INT. HE YUNFAN'S HOME - NIGHT

LI QINGGE unlocks the door with trembling fingers. She sets down the birthday cake, its candles askew from her shaking hands. In the bathroom, she spits into the sink—more blood, his blood, swirling away. She splashes water on her face, trying to scrub away the alley.

LI QINGGE (V.O.)
Not now. An An's birthday.

She smooths her hair, practices a smile in the mirror.

LI QINGGE (V.O.)
That's all that matters.

The smile stays in place as she heads toward the bedroom.

LI QINGGE
(gently)
An An? Mommy's home—

She pushes open the bedroom door. The cake box tilts in her grip.

HE YUNFAN is in bed with CHU YAO—Li Qingge's research assistant. An An's blanket is crumpled on the floor.

LI QINGGE
(shocked)
What—

CHU YAO
(smiling)
You're home early. We were just... celebrating.

HE YUNFAN sits up, no shame, just cold purpose.

HE YUNFAN
The Institute fellowship is finalized next week. I can't have a wife with "health issues" and midnight wanderings. Sign the papers tomorrow. You leave with nothing.

LI QINGGE's grip on the cake box tightens. Cardboard buckles. She looks from his face to Chu Yao's smug smile—to An An's blanket on the floor.

Pain fills her eyes. But behind it, something flickers. The same fury that made her bite a god in a dark alley.

She sets the cake down carefully on the dresser.

LI QINGGE
(quietly)
After An An's party. I'll sign then.

She turns and walks out, closing the door softly behind her.

HE YUNFAN
(calling after)
Don't try to run, Li Qingge. I'll find you.

Through the closed door, her voice floats back—steady, terrifying in its calm.

LI QINGGE (O.S.)
I know.

Title: After Divorce, Meeting a Soft-Hearted God
Description: A woman discovers her husband's betrayal on their daughter's birthday, the same night she encounters a mysterious doctor with a dangerous secret.

LI QINGGE's eyes fly open. She bites down hard on his lower lip.

She slaps DEAN GU hard across the face.

Bastard.

(angrily)

title: After Divorce, CEO Lu Becomes a Simp and Helps Me with My Shoes
description: A woman diagnosed with terminal liver cancer discovers her husband's mistress is pregnant and decides to end her three-year marriage to live for herself.
context:
Title: After Divorce, CEO Lu Becomes a Simp and Helps Me with My Shoes
Description: A woman diagnosed with terminal liver cancer discovers her husband's mistress is pregnant and decides to end her three-year marriage to live for herself.

INT. HOSPITAL - DOCTOR'S OFFICE - DAY

GU XINGMAN sits across from the DOCTOR.

DOCTOR
Miss Gu, you have late-stage liver cancer. I'm afraid you only have a year left.

GU XINGMAN's breath catches. She reaches for the report, fingers trembling. Stares at the words until they blur. A tear lands on the paper. She doesn't wipe it away.

INT. HOSPITAL - CORRIDOR - DAY

GU XINGMAN moves through the hospital corridor, the report clutched to her chest. The world blurs around her.

She stops by a window, fishing out her phone. The lock screen shows a wedding photo: her and a man, smiling.

A notification appears: BAI JINROU. A message.

She opens it. An ultrasound. Then a photo of her husband's watch—on a nightstand she recognizes—next to a pregnancy test. Two lines. A third photo: the same watch, on Bai Jinrou's wrist in a mirror selfie. No words. None needed.

Gu's hand goes slack. The diagnosis report slips, pages scattering. She stares at the images, then at her reflection in the window. A woman crumbling from the inside out.
continuation:
EXT. LU FAMILY VILLA - DAY

An aerial shot of the manicured estate. Text on screen: LU ESTATE, 3 YEARS LATER.

INT. LU FAMILY - LIVING ROOM - DAY

Fresh lilies overflow from crystal vases. The HOUSEKEEPER adjusts their stems.

GU XINGMAN enters, her keys clicking on marble. She inhales—and a ragged cough tears through her. She covers her mouth, body convulsing.

HOUSEKEEPER
Madam? The master requested these. Said the roses were... predictable.

Gu straightens, wiping her watering eyes. She approaches the vase, running a finger along a petal. Her throat itches. Her skin flushes where pollen touched.

Without a word, she plucks a lily. Crushes it in her fist. The petals bruise, then tear. She opens her hand. The mangled pieces fall like confetti.

She climbs the stairs without looking back.

INT. LU CORPORATION - CONFERENCE ROOM - DAY

LU SIYE sits at the head of the table, checking his watch. ASSISTANT HE hovers nearby.

ASSISTANT HE
The quarterly review begins in two minutes. Secretary Gu isn't responding.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE
She's never missed a board meeting. Not once.

LU SIYE dials. Voicemail. His knuckles whiten.

LU SIYE
(to Assistant)
Find her.

ASSISTANT HE
Yes, sir.

The door swings open.

GU XINGMAN (O.S.)
Looking for me?

GU XINGMAN stands in the doorway, red silk dress cutting through the beige corporate landscape. Sunglasses hide her eyes. She holds a manila envelope—not her usual leather portfolio.

She walks to the head of the table, each step deliberate, and sets the envelope before Lu SiYe.

The room holds its breath.

title: After Leaving Home, I Made My Own Way
description: A wife is forced to become a servant in her own home to stay with her children, while the woman who replaced her faces the same fate eighteen years later.
context:
Title: After Leaving Home, I Made My Own Way
Description: A wife is forced to become a servant in her own home to stay with her children, while the woman who replaced her faces the same fate eighteen years later.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

XU LILI scrambles to the edge of the bed in panic.

MENG WANRU (40s, white suit, trembling with rage) storms in, finger pointing.

MENG WANRU
(furious)
Xu Lili! You were never a nanny—you want my children, my life! I'll kill you first!

She lunges.

CHEN GUOZHANG (40s) rushes in, grabs MENG WANRU's arm.

CHEN GUOZHANG
Control yourself!

He pushes her back with force. She falls. He turns to XU LILI, helps her up.

XU LILI
(fragile)
Guozhang...

CHEN GUOZHANG
(soothing)
It's over. You're safe.

He grabs a document, hurls it at MENG WANRU.

CHEN GUOZHANG
You're out. The boys call my choice "Mother."

MENG WANRU sees the divorce agreement, shock cracking her voice.

MENG WANRU
(desperate)
No—I won't leave! Hanfeng, Hanyu, Hankai—I'm their mother!

She drops to her knees, grabs his legs.

MENG WANRU
(begging)
Please! Anything! Just don't take them from me!

XU LILI
(smiling coldly)
Then be their nanny. Prove your devotion.

MENG WANRU goes rigid, humiliation burning her cheeks. She whispers:

MENG WANRU
(defeated)
...Yes. I'll be the nanny.

FADE OUT.

FADE IN:

SUPER: EIGHTEEN YEARS LATER
continuation:
INT. MANSION HALLWAY - NIGHT

XU LILI (50s, plain sweater, worn) kneels on the gleaming floor, wiping.

BUTLER (V.O.)
Madam, the master bedroom.

XU LILI looks up, her eyes sharp with memory.

XU LILI
(voice low)
Eighteen years ago, I wiped these floors as a nanny. I became the mistress. Tonight, I wipe them again.

She rises, marches to the bedroom.

INT. MASTER BEDROOM - NIGHT

XU LILI throws open the door.

On the bed, the SON (20s) and NEW NANNY (20s, red pajamas) freeze, clutching sheets.

XU LILI
(betrayed)
Eighteen years ago, you did this to me. Now you do it to my son?

NEW NANNY
(contemptuous)
Eighteen years ago, you were the affair. You're still the affair—still trying to own what isn't yours.

NEW NANNY slaps her.

NEW NANNY
You're the shameless one.

XU LILI stares, hand on her cheek, at her own ghost.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: Office Storm
description: Office gossip erupts when the CEO's engagement to a wealthy heiress is announced, revealing the complicated relationship between the CEO and his secretary.
context:
Title: Office Storm
Description: Office gossip erupts when the CEO's engagement to a wealthy heiress is announced, revealing the complicated relationship between the CEO and his secretary.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

XIANG JIE waters a drooping office plant at the window, her back to the room. Several colleagues huddle nearby, speaking in hushed tones.

A laptop screen shows a news alert: "BREAKING: Yan Group CEO Yan Lihan to Announce Engagement with Li Family Heiress Li Ying."

MALE COLLEAGUE A
(whispering)
The airport photos look coordinated. Pure PR strategy.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE A
It's a merger wearing a wedding ring.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE B
(noticing XIANG JIE's scarf)
Those marks on her neck. She's been in his office until 2 AM all week.

MALE COLLEAGUE B
Some doors only open from the inside. She's knocking on a locked one.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE A
Wealth marries wealth. A secretary signs NDAs, not prenups.

XIANG JIE's hand trembles, spilling water on the sill. She wipes it slowly, carefully.

LI YING enters, her presence immediately shifting the room's energy. She stops beside XIANG JIE, following her gaze to the spilled water.

LI YING
(to the room, calm but firm)
The press conference is at three. Until then, any discussion of my personal life is a speculation about company leaks. Back to work.

The colleagues scatter. LI YING turns to XIANG JIE, her voice dropping.

LI YING
My father negotiated this arrangement. I negotiated the terms. One of them is discretion.

XIANG JIE
(meeting her eyes)
And the other?

LI YING
(a slight smile)
That I don't let good people stand alone. Come on. He's waiting.

They walk toward the executive suites together.
continuation:
INT. CEO'S OFFICE - DAY

XIANG JIE stands before CEO YAN's desk, a contract between them. CEO YAN watches her, not the document.

CEO YAN
You heard them.

XIANG JIE
I hear everything. It's my job.

CEO YAN
The engagement protects the merger. It doesn't define me.

XIANG JIE
And Louis? The meeting's still on your calendar.

CEO YAN
(frowning)
You were right about the risk. I'm handling it personally.

He stands, approaching her slowly. He stops when she shifts her weight—not retreating, but repositioning.

CEO YAN
This morning... the marks. I shouldn't have been so careless with you.

XIANG JIE
(quietly firm)
I wasn't careful either. Sir.

She meets his gaze. The contract trembles slightly in her hands—not from fear, but from the weight of choices.

CEO YAN takes her scarf from the desk where she'd left it. He doesn't blindfold her. He offers it.

CEO YAN
You left this. You can wear it... or decide you don't need to hide.

XIANG JIE takes it, her fingers closing over the silk. The choice is hers.

title: Technology Takes Me to New Heights
description: In 2089, Professor Yue's plasma shield successfully blocks an electromagnetic pulse attack. As he celebrates, he collapses, and his consciousness travels back to 2024, giving him a chance to change his father's tragic fate.
context:
Title: Technology Takes Me to New Heights
Description: In 2089, Professor Yue's plasma shield successfully blocks an electromagnetic pulse attack. As he celebrates, he collapses, and his consciousness travels back to 2024, giving him a chance to change his father's tragic fate.

INT. TEST SITE - DAY

A vast, dry riverbed stretches to the horizon. A weathered bridge frame looms in the distance. RESEARCHERS in tactical gear monitor equipment across the site.

ON SCREEN: Year 2089

XIAO LIN (20s, nervous energy) sprints toward PROFESSOR YUE (60s, gravity in every step), her silver suit glinting.

XIAO LIN
(breathless)
Sir, Silicon Valley's EMP barrage just hit the perimeter. Our grid's collapsing. We lost visual on the drones.

Professor Yue lifts a hardened comm device, his voice steady.

PROFESSOR YUE
(into device)
Power status?

ASSISTANT (V.O.)
Green across the board. Waiting on your mark.

PROFESSOR YUE
Transmitting in three... two... one.

A circular array on the ground HUMS, lifting a crystalline energy cube. MASSIVE BLUE LIGHTNING forks from the sky—then the screen blacks out.

BROADCAST VOICE (V.O.)
All systems restored. Signals nominal.

The screen flickers back. Xiao Lin stares at Professor Yue, awe replacing panic.

XIAO LIN
(quietly)
It held. Sir... you just ended the era of nuclear blackmail.

The other ASSISTANTS exchange disbelieving looks, relief breaking across their faces.

PROFESSOR YUE
(gaze fixed on the cube)
He deserved to see this. Not just the results—the moment the world knew he was right.

YUE XINGYU (V.O.)
Dad, if you could see what your plasma research became...

Professor Yue looks up, tears cutting through dust on his face.

PROFESSOR YUE
(whispering)
Zhou... they can't call you a fraud anymore.

Professor Yue's laugh turns to a choked gasp. He collapses backward. Assistants surge forward.

ASSISTANTS
(panicked)
Medical! We need a medic here!

The energy cube PULSES. Time rewinds on screen: 2066... 2039... 2029...
continuation:
INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

YUE XINGYU (17, sharp eyes) jerks awake at his desk. Ancient fluorescents buzz overhead. The TEACHER's voice drones.

TEACHER REN (O.S.)
The formula's on the board. Someone must remember Tuesday's lesson.

Yue Xingyu blinks at his hands—smooth, unlined. He turns to his deskmate.

YUE XINGYU
Da Long... why are you—?

DA LONG
(whispering)
Why am I what? Stop mumbling, he'll hear you.

TEACHER REN
(sharply)
Xingyu! Long! Up here. Now.

Yue Xingyu stands, disoriented. He spots the date on the blackboard: May 8, 2024.

YUE XINGYU
(to himself)
Twenty-four? That's before—

Flashes hit him: the lightning, the cube, his father's voice.

TEACHER REN
Xingyu, I expect better. But since you're usually awake—does anyone know how to derive the shielding equation?

Yue Xingyu looks down at his textbook. A notation in the margin in his father's handwriting. He recognizes it—plasma field mathematics, decades ahead of this class.

YUE XINGYU
(quietly, to himself)
I'm not just back. I'm here before they destroyed him.

MONTAGE - THE DOWNFALL OF YUE ZHOU

A) INT. ACADEMY CORRIDOR - DAY
A MIDDLE-AGED OFFICIAL reads from a tablet, flanked by security.

OFFICIAL
The Academy finds Professor Yue Zhou guilty of fabricating plasma research data. Effective immediately, his tenure is revoked.

B) EXT. RESEARCH COMPLEX - DUSK
YUE ZHOU (40s, hair graying prematurely) clutches a cardboard box of personal effects. His glasses slip as he stumbles on the steps.

C) EXT. SHANGHAI STREET - NIGHT
Yue Zhou, in a sanitation worker's vest, crouches under a streetlamp. He smooths a yellowed paper: "On Plasma Aviation Applications." A black sedan pulls up.

JIANG JIAHAO (50s, polished suit) emerges, snatches the paper.

JIANG JIAHAO
Still playing scientist, Zhou? The Academy's toilets need scrubbing more than your 'research' needs reading.

YUE ZHOU
(voice cracking)
That's my life's work. Please—

JIANG JIAHAO tears the paper slowly, letting pieces scatter in the wind. Yue Zhou lunges; Jiang's bodyguard shoves him to the pavement.

JIANG JIAHAO
(handing over a pen)
Sign the confession. Admit the plasma work was fantasy. Then disappear.

CLOSE ON: The document titled "Academic Fraud Confession."

END MONTAGE

Yue Xingyu grips his desk edge, knuckles white. The textbook page blurs. He looks up at Teacher Ren writing formulas—primitive, flawed formulas that will lead to decades of failure.

YUE XINGYU
(under his breath)
I can fix it. I can fix all of it.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED
