INT. TEST SITE - DAY

A vast, dry riverbed stretches to the horizon. A weathered bridge frame looms in the distance. RESEARCHERS in tactical gear monitor equipment across the site.

ON SCREEN: Year 2089

XIAO LIN (20s, nervous energy) sprints toward PROFESSOR YUE (60s, gravity in every step), her silver suit glinting.

XIAO LIN
(breathless)
Sir, Silicon Valley's EMP barrage just hit the perimeter. Our grid's collapsing. We lost visual on the drones.

Professor Yue lifts a hardened comm device, his voice steady.

PROFESSOR YUE
(into device)
Power status?

ASSISTANT (V.O.)
Green across the board. Waiting on your mark.

PROFESSOR YUE
Transmitting in three... two... one.

A circular array on the ground HUMS, lifting a crystalline energy cube. MASSIVE BLUE LIGHTNING forks from the sky—then the screen blacks out.

BROADCAST VOICE (V.O.)
All systems restored. Signals nominal.

The screen flickers back. Xiao Lin stares at Professor Yue, awe replacing panic.

XIAO LIN
(quietly)
It held. Sir... you just ended the era of nuclear blackmail.

The other ASSISTANTS exchange disbelieving looks, relief breaking across their faces.

PROFESSOR YUE
(gaze fixed on the cube)
He deserved to see this. Not just the results—the moment the world knew he was right.

YUE XINGYU (V.O.)
Dad, if you could see what your plasma research became...

Professor Yue looks up, tears cutting through dust on his face.

PROFESSOR YUE
(whispering)
Zhou... they can't call you a fraud anymore.

Professor Yue's laugh turns to a choked gasp. He collapses backward. Assistants surge forward.

ASSISTANTS
(panicked)
Medical! We need a medic here!

The energy cube PULSES. Time rewinds on screen: 2066... 2039... 2029...

INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

YUE XINGYU (17, sharp eyes) jerks awake at his desk. Ancient fluorescents buzz overhead. The TEACHER's voice drones.

TEACHER REN (O.S.)
The formula's on the board. Someone must remember Tuesday's lesson.

Yue Xingyu blinks at his hands—smooth, unlined. He turns to his deskmate.

YUE XINGYU
Da Long... why are you—?

DA LONG
(whispering)
Why am I what? Stop mumbling, he'll hear you.

TEACHER REN
(sharply)
Xingyu! Long! Up here. Now.

Yue Xingyu stands, disoriented. He spots the date on the blackboard: May 8, 2024.

YUE XINGYU
(to himself)
Twenty-four? That's before—

Flashes hit him: the lightning, the cube, his father's voice.

TEACHER REN
Xingyu, I expect better. But since you're usually awake—does anyone know how to derive the shielding equation?

Yue Xingyu looks down at his textbook. A notation in the margin in his father's handwriting. He recognizes it—plasma field mathematics, decades ahead of this class.

YUE XINGYU
(quietly, to himself)
I'm not just back. I'm here before they destroyed him.

MONTAGE - THE DOWNFALL OF YUE ZHOU

A) INT. ACADEMY CORRIDOR - DAY
A MIDDLE-AGED OFFICIAL reads from a tablet, flanked by security.

OFFICIAL
The Academy finds Professor Yue Zhou guilty of fabricating plasma research data. Effective immediately, his tenure is revoked.

B) EXT. RESEARCH COMPLEX - DUSK
YUE ZHOU (40s, hair graying prematurely) clutches a cardboard box of personal effects. His glasses slip as he stumbles on the steps.

C) EXT. SHANGHAI STREET - NIGHT
Yue Zhou, in a sanitation worker's vest, crouches under a streetlamp. He smooths a yellowed paper: "On Plasma Aviation Applications." A black sedan pulls up.

JIANG JIAHAO (50s, polished suit) emerges, snatches the paper.

JIANG JIAHAO
Still playing scientist, Zhou? The Academy's toilets need scrubbing more than your 'research' needs reading.

YUE ZHOU
(voice cracking)
That's my life's work. Please—

JIANG JIAHAO tears the paper slowly, letting pieces scatter in the wind. Yue Zhou lunges; Jiang's bodyguard shoves him to the pavement.

JIANG JIAHAO
(handing over a pen)
Sign the confession. Admit the plasma work was fantasy. Then disappear.

CLOSE ON: The document titled "Academic Fraud Confession."

END MONTAGE

Yue Xingyu grips his desk edge, knuckles white. The textbook page blurs. He looks up at Teacher Ren writing formulas—primitive, flawed formulas that will lead to decades of failure.

YUE XINGYU
(under his breath)
I can fix it. I can fix all of it.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Poor Father, Rich Road
description: A humble father from the countryside arrives in the city for his grandson's full moon celebration, carrying mysterious gifts that hint at a hidden identity his son doesn't recognize.
context:
Title: Poor Father, Rich Road
Description: A humble father from the countryside arrives in the city for his grandson's full moon celebration, carrying mysterious gifts that hint at a hidden identity his son doesn't recognize.

INT. TRAIN CAR - DAY

Rain streaks the windows as the train glides past towering concrete apartment blocks. Zhou Guodong's weathered hands rest on a cloth sack emblazoned with faded corporate logos.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
South Province Train Station. Please watch your step.

EXT. TRAIN STATION PLAZA - DAY

The crowd parts around ZHOU GUODONG (50s, calloused hands, patched jacket) as he shoulders a massive cloth sack marked "KANGYI CONSORTIUM—PROPERTY OF LOGISTICS DEPT." A black plastic bag dangles from his other hand.

ON SCREEN: ZHOU GUODONG - WILD GINSENG CULTIVATOR

His son ZHOU XIANGYU (30s, tailored suit, designer briefcase) hurries over, phone pressed to his ear.

ZHOU GUODONG
Son. Which exit for the banquet car?

ZHOU XIANGYU
(panicked, covering phone)
Dad! I said I'd send a driver. You're... visible.

ZHOU XIANGYU notices the plastic bag.

ZHOU XIANGYU
Is that trash? Give it here.

He reaches. Zhou Guodong pivots, the sack's logo flashing toward camera—unseen by his son.

ZHOU GUODONG
Your wife's postpartum tea. The bag's new. I washed it twice.

ZHOU XIANGYU
Tea? Dad, Siyan's father imports ceremonial grade matcha by the crate. He judges gifts by brand, not affection.

ZHOU GUODONG
(tapping the sack)
Brands can be bought. True things can't.
continuation:
ZHOU XIANGYU
(scoffs)
The only "true thing" here is that my father-in-law controls Kangyi's purchasing. He could blacklist me for showing up with—

ZHOU GUODONG
—local specialties?

He unties the plastic bag. Inside: pristine ginseng roots, their shapes perfect, almost luminous. Zhou Xiangyu pauses, unfamiliar recognition flickering.

ZHOU GUODONG
(softly)
When you were six, you burned fever for three days. These boiled with jujube brought you back. Remember?

ZHOU XIANGYU
(voice catching, then hardening)
That was a village remedy. This is a city. Different worlds.

He checks his Rolex.

ZHOU XIANGYU
Just... walk behind me. And for god's sake, hide that sack.

Zhou Guodong's PHONE rings—caller ID: "Kangyi Chairman Office." Zhou Xiangyu is too busy texting to notice.

ZHOU GUODONG
(into phone)
Chairman Xiao. Yes, I'm here for family. The consortium matter can wait.

XIAO HE (O.S.)
Elder Zhou! The board won't wait. They need your verification on the—

ZHOU GUODONG
Tomorrow.

He ends the call. Zhou Xiangyu looks up, annoyed.

ZHOU XIANGYU
Who was that?

ZHOU GUODONG
Wrong number.

Hefting the sack, the logo now clearly visible but ignored by his son, Zhou Guodong follows. The ginseng in the plastic bag catches the light—more valuable than gold.

title: Reborn as an Ancient Younger Sister, I Lead My Family to Prosperity
description: A modern woman transmigrates into a period drama as a sister-in-law who exploits her family to pamper her scholar husband, only to be abandoned after he passes the imperial exam.
context:
Title: Reborn as an Ancient Younger Sister, I Lead My Family to Prosperity
Description: A modern woman transmigrates into a period drama as a sister-in-law who exploits her family to pamper her scholar husband, only to be abandoned after he passes the imperial exam.

INT. YE FAMILY COURTYARD - DAY

YE CAIPING peeks out from behind a door, scanning the courtyard with calculated caution. She empties a small pouch of expensive medicinal herbs into the family's drinking water vat—supplements for her husband, purchased with her brother's fishing earnings.

OLD LADY YE lifts the vat lid. Her weathered face tightens at the floating ginseng shavings.

YE CAIPING hurries past with a linen sack of grain, hugging it close.

OLD LADY YE
Ye Caiping! That sack contains the seed grain for spring planting. Put it down.

OLD LADY YE seizes the sack's edge. YE CAIPING pulls back, knuckles white.

OLD LADY YE
Your brother's family will starve if you take this.

YE CAIPING
Scholars cannot eat brown rice. It clouds the mind. Zhiyuan needs white buns and pork to concentrate for the imperial exam.

DU JINYAN rushes from the kitchen, blocking YE CAIPING's path. Her own hands are raw from washing clothes.

DU JINYAN
My children have eaten watery porridge for a month, Auntie. Your husband feasts while my daughter cries herself to sleep.

YE CAIPING
This is an investment! Once Zhiyuan becomes an official, you'll wear silk and live in a manor house.

DU JINYAN
Eight years of investments. Eight years of empty promises.

YE CAIPING
You understand nothing about—

A distant GONG echoes through the village. Everyone freezes.

ANNOUNCEMENT OFFICIAL (V.O.)
Attention Linxia Village! Li Zhiyuan has passed the provincial examination!

Boots thump on the threshold. Two ANNOUNCEMENT OFFICIALS in vermillion robes stride into the courtyard.

YE CAIPING
(breathless)
He passed. He finally passed.

DU JINYAN exchanges a stunned glance with OLD LADY YE.

DU JINYAN
The gods must be blind.
continuation:
INT. LI FAMILY MAIN ROOM - DAY

LI ZHIYUAN stands before the ancestral shrine, clutching the red announcement. His reflection in the polished bronze shows a smile that doesn't reach his eyes.

LI ZHIYUAN
Eight years. Eight years of borrowed books and borrowed money.

YE CAIPING bursts in, breathless, holding a basket of steaming buns.

YE CAIPING
Husband! I knew today would be the day! I woke before dawn to steam these—

LI ZHIYUAN turns. The basket flies from his hand. Buns roll across the dirt floor.

YE CAIPING
(stumbling back)
The buns—Zhiyuan, why—

LI ZHIYUAN produces a folded paper from his breast pocket.

LI ZHIYUAN
Divorce papers. I've drafted them every spring. Today, I can finally sign them.

YE CAIPING
Divorce? But... the imperial banquet, your official posting. I'll be your respected wife—

MOTHER LI sweeps in, linking her arm through her son's.

MOTHER LI
A peasant daughter-in-law who bears only girls is barren land. My son needs fertile soil to continue our family line.

She shoves a small figure—five-year-old YE JIN'ER—who has been standing silent in the corner.

YE JIN'ER
(quietly)
Mother... my stomach hurts.

MOTHER LI
Quiet, girl! Your useless mother couldn't even produce a grandson!

YE CAIPING
Don't touch her!

YE CAIPING lunges. MOTHER LI stumbles backward, landing hard.

MOTHER LI
(wailing)
A daughter-in-law striking her elder! This is madness!

LI ZHIYUAN helps his mother up, his face a mask of cold fury.

LI ZHIYUAN
You cannot bear a son and you dare attack my mother? Pack your things. You and your daughter leave by nightfall.

YE CAIPING
Zhiyuan... Jin'er is yours. Your blood.

She reaches for his sleeve. He shakes her off with clinical precision.

LI ZHIYUAN
Then consider it my final gift to you.

YE CAIPING's gaze fixes on the pillar. Her breathing quickens.

YE CAIPING
If I die here, will that stain your perfect record?

She runs. LI ZHIYUAN doesn't move.

LI ZHIYUAN
The county coroner reports suicides weekly.

The impact resounds. YE CAIPING crumples, blood blooming across her forehead.

YE JIN'ER
(screaming)
Mother!

INT. MODERN LIVING ROOM - DAY

A modern YE CAIPING in cashmere pajamas sits on a leather sofa, phone gripped in both hands. On screen, the bleeding woman lies motionless.

MODERN YE CAIPING
Same name. Same stupid face. At least my crypto phase only lost me money, not my life.

She hurls the phone onto the cushions. The ancient YE JIN'ER's wail continues from the speaker.

YE JIN'ER (phone audio)
Mother, please wake up!

INT. LI FAMILY MAIN ROOM - DAY

OLD LADY YE and DU JINYAN kneel beside the fallen body.

DU JINYAN
Caiping? Mother, she still breathes.

OLD LADY YE
Child, open your eyes.

YE CAIPING's eyelids flutter. Her fingers brush the gash on her forehead, sticky with blood. She blinks—once, twice—seeing not a drama, but real faces, real tears.

YE CAIPING (V.O.)
This isn't a screen. These are my hands, my blood. And that... that's my daughter's voice.

YE CAIPING's eyes snap fully open. They are no longer a fool's eyes, but a stranger's—sharp, calculating, and utterly horrified.

title: Reborn as a Demon Lord, I Only Seek Death
description: A soul transmigrates into the body of a fearsome demon lord during a wedding raid, completely changing the course of events.
context:
Title: Reborn as a Demon Lord, I Only Seek Death
Description: A soul transmigrates into the body of a fearsome demon lord during a wedding raid, completely changing the course of events.

INT. JADE POOL PALACE - DAY

A GRAND HALL DRAPED IN CRIMSON SILK FOR THE WEDDING CEREMONY. THE SAINTESS, 19, POISED IN ELABORATE RED ROBES, IS BEING ATTENDED BY HER MAIDENS. ELDER TEA, 60S, SHARP-EYED, STANDS NEARBY.

ELDER TEA
The Saintess looks radiant. That Dragon Palace brat doesn't know how fortunate he is.

SAINTESS
Elder Tea, please. Today is about alliance, not sentiment.

ELDER TEA
I'll still report your blushing.

A LOW, MENACING LAUGH REVERBERATES THROUGH THE HALL, SHAKING THE LANTERNS.

THE SAINTESS'S EYES NARROW. SHE EXTENDS HER HAND; A PURPLE CRYSTAL SWORD MATERIALIZES.

SAINTESS
(Intensely)
That energy... everyone, with me!

SHE SPRINTS FOR THE EXIT, ATTENDANTS FOLLOWING.

EXT. JADE POOL PALACE - DAY

THE SAINTESS AND HER ATTENDANTS BURST ONTO THE PALACE STEPS. ABOVE, QI YE, 30S, FLOATS IN OBSIDIAN ARMOR WREATED IN CRACKLING SHADOW-FLAMES.

SAINTESS
Identify yourself!

QI YE
(Smiling coldly)
Qi Ye, sovereign of the Demon Sect. I've come to claim what's mine.

ELDER TEA
(Whispering)
Saintess... it's the Butcher of Qingyun.

SAINTESS
I'm pledged to Long Aotian. Your claim is dust, demon.

SHE LAUNCHES UPWARD, SWORD ARCING WITH VIOLET LIGHT. QI YE DEFLECTS WITH A FLICK OF HIS WRIST. THE SAINTESS CRASHES ONTO THE RED CARPET, BLOOD STAINING HER VEIL.

ELDER TEA
Saintess!

QI YE DESCENDS SLOWLY.

QI YE
Dragon Palace is nothing. Kneel and live as my consort, or perish with your pride.

ELDER TEA
His cultivation... it's at the Void Shattering realm!

THE SAINTESS STAGGERS TO HER FEET, WIPES BLOOD FROM HER LIPS.

SAINTESS
(To attendants)
The Spring Water Formation. Target his meridians.

ELDER TEA
(Understanding)
Yes!

THE ATTENDANTS FORM A CIRCLE, PINK ENERGY WEAVING BETWEEN THEIR PALMS.
continuation:
INT. ILLUSORY REALM - DAY

QI YE STANDS IN A STEAMING HOT SPRING. THE SAINTESS AND ATTENDANTS MATERIALIZE THROUGH THE MIST, THEIR SILK CLINGING.

QI YE
(Amused)
An illusion? How quaint.

SAINTESS
(Breathily)
Lord Qi Ye, why conquer when you could indulge? Stay. Rule beside me.

HER HAND SLIDES BENEATH THE WATER, EMERGING WITH A GLOWING PURPLE DAGGER.

SAINTESS
Demon, you're mine!

SHE STRIKES. HE CATCHES HER WRIST EFFORTLESSLY.

QI YE
Dragon Palace's little toothpick? Even the Nine Heavens Thunder couldn't scratch this vessel. Break.

HE RELEASES A PULSE OF PURE DEMONIC ESSENCE. THE REALM SHATTERS LIKE GLASS.

EXT. JADE POOL PALACE - DAY

THE ATTENDANTS ARE HURLED BACKWARD, SCREAMING. QI YE RISES, GATHERING A BLUE ENERGY SPIRAL IN HIS PALM.

QI YE
Now, kneel.

THE SAINTESS CLASPS HER HANDS. THE FORMATION'S PINK ENERGY SURGES UPWARD, COLLIDING WITH QI YE'S ATTACK. THE ENERGIES CREATE A FEEDBACK LOOP.

DIVINE TRIBULATION CLOUDS FORM INSTANTLY IN THE SKY.

A BOLT OF HEAVENLY LIGHTNING STRIKES THE ENERGY NEXUS, ELECTROCUTING BOTH QI YE AND THE SAINTESS. THEY PLUMMET.

QI YE LANDS ACROSS THE UNCONSCIOUS SAINTESS. SMOKE RISES FROM HIS ARMOR.

AFTER A MOMENT, QI YE'S EYES SNAP OPEN. THE DARKNESS IN THEM IS GONE.

QI YE
(Confused)
Hospital...? No, this is...

HE TOUCHES HER FACE GENTLY.

QI YE
(Wondering)
Are you... real?

HE PINCHES HER CHEEK. HER EYES FLUTTER OPEN.

QI YE
(Grinning with relief)
You're okay!

THEY LOCK EYES. RECOGNITION AND HORROR HIT SIMULTANEOUSLY. THEY SCREAM IN UNISON.

LIGHT FLASHES, ENDING THE SCENE.

QI YE
Dragon Palace is nothing. Kneel and live as my consort, or perish with your pride.

ELDER TEA
His cultivation... it's at the Void Shattering realm!

THE SAINTESS STAGGERS TO HER FEET, WIPES BLOOD FROM HER LIPS.

SAINTESS
(To attendants)
The Spring Water Formation. Target his meridians.

ELDER TEA
(Understanding)
Yes!

THE ATTENDANTS FORM A CIRCLE, PINK ENERGY WEAVING BETWEEN THEIR PALMS.

INT. ILLUSORY REALM - DAY

QI YE STANDS IN A STEAMING HOT SPRING. THE SAINTESS AND ATTENDANTS MATERIALIZE THROUGH THE MIST, THEIR SILK CLINGING.

QI YE
(Amused)
An illusion? How quaint.

SAINTESS
(Breathily)
Lord Qi Ye, why conquer when you could indulge? Stay. Rule beside me.

HER HAND SLIDES BENEATH THE WATER, EMERGING WITH A GLOWING PURPLE DAGGER.

SAINTESS
Demon, you're mine!

SHE STRIKES. HE CATCHES HER WRIST EFFORTLESSLY.

QI YE
Dragon Palace's little toothpick? Even the Nine Heavens Thunder couldn't scratch this vessel. Break.

HE RELEASES A PULSE OF PURE DEMONIC ESSENCE. THE REALM SHATTERS LIKE GLASS.

EXT. JADE POOL PALACE - DAY

THE ATTENDANTS ARE HURLED BACKWARD, SCREAMING. QI YE RISES, GATHERING A BLUE ENERGY SPIRAL IN HIS PALM.

QI YE
Now, kneel.

THE SAINTESS CLASPS HER HANDS. THE FORMATION'S PINK ENERGY SURGES UPWARD, COLLIDING WITH QI YE'S ATTACK. THE ENERGIES CREATE A FEEDBACK LOOP.

DIVINE TRIBULATION CLOUDS FORM INSTANTLY IN THE SKY.

A BOLT OF HEAVENLY LIGHTNING STRIKES THE ENERGY NEXUS, ELECTROCUTING BOTH QI YE AND THE SAINTESS. THEY PLUMMET.

QI YE LANDS ACROSS THE UNCONSCIOUS SAINTESS. SMOKE RISES FROM HIS ARMOR.

AFTER A MOMENT, QI YE'S EYES SNAP OPEN. THE DARKNESS IN THEM IS GONE.

QI YE
(Confused)
Hospital...? No, this is...

HE TOUCHES HER FACE GENTLY.

QI YE
(Wondering)
Are you... real?

HE PINCHES HER CHEEK. HER EYES FLUTTER OPEN.

QI YE
(Grinning with relief)
You're okay!

THEY LOCK EYES. RECOGNITION AND HORROR HIT SIMULTANEOUSLY. THEY SCREAM IN UNISON.

LIGHT FLASHES, ENDING THE SCENE.

title: Crossing Ice to Embrace You
description: A mysterious warrior living in hiding works as a pool cleaner, but his past catches up with him when an elite assassin is sent to kill him.
context:
Title: Crossing Ice to Embrace You
Description: A mysterious warrior living in hiding works as a pool cleaner, but his past catches up with him when an elite assassin is sent to kill him.

INT. INDOOR POOL - NIGHT

LING TIAN, late 20s, wears a white tank top and shorts with a dark blindfold—a self-imposed handicap. He crouches by the pool, methodically wiping tiles with a towel despite not seeing them. His movements are precise, economical. A faded scar traces his collarbone.

CHENG CHENG, elegant in an orange patterned bikini with a matching cover-up, emerges from the pool and sits at the edge. Water droplets fall from her wet hair. She watches his hands.

CHENG CHENG
Come here and give me a massage.

LING TIAN continues wiping the floor, his head tilted to track her by sound.

LING TIAN
Sorry, I only know how to scrub backs, not massage.

CHENG CHENG takes out a matte black card from her cover-up and places it on the pool edge. No numbers. Just a single embossed character: Han.

CHENG CHENG
This card is worth a year of your wages here. Walk away. Tonight.

LING TIAN stops his work, stands up, and walks behind CHENG CHENG. He begins massaging her shoulders. His fingers find pressure points with surgical precision.

CHENG CHENG
(enjoying it)
Harder.

LING TIAN
That wasn't the deal.

CHENG CHENG
Not bad technique. Why don't you stay with me tonight?

CHENG CHENG reaches back to touch LING TIAN's face. He grabs her wrist—firm but not cruel.

LING TIAN
I sold my sword. Not my soul.

LING TIAN releases her hand. CHENG CHENG smiles, stands up from the pool, and tucks the black card into the collar of LING TIAN's tank top.

CHENG CHENG
Is that so? Come find me tomorrow.

CHENG CHENG smiles and turns to leave.
continuation:
EXT. BUILDING EXTERIOR - NIGHT

A black Maybach sedan drives through the night and stops at the building entrance.

INT. MAYBACH CAR - NIGHT

A MYSTERIOUS MAN sits in the back seat, watching surveillance footage on a phone—Ling Tian's downcast face, his scar circled.

MYSTERIOUS MAN (V.O.)
Three years ago, the War Ancestor of the Great Han vanished. I lost hundreds tracing him to this hole. If he lives, the Han cannot fall. You have one chance.

YI XUAN, mid-20s, gets out of the car. She wears a black swimsuit beneath a white robe.

YI XUAN
Don't worry. I never miss.

YI XUAN walks confidently toward the building.

INT. INDOOR POOL - NIGHT

LING TIAN crouches down to continue wiping the floor. He slips the black card into his pocket. The door opens.

LING TIAN
(without looking up)
Sorry, we're closed.

YI XUAN walks over, wearing a black swimsuit with a white robe.

YI XUAN
That's okay, I'll be quick.

YI XUAN removes her robe and throws it on the ground. It lands with a soft thud—weighted.

YI XUAN
Master, my chest hurts. Can you massage it for me?

YI XUAN approaches LING TIAN from behind, wrapping her arms around him. A very thin metal wire appears in her hands, ready to strangle his neck.

LING TIAN
(coldly laughing)
Silver silk golden wire. Third on the assassin rankings. I expected better.

LING TIAN breaks free by simply standing—his movement cracks the tile beneath his feet. He twists, and YI XUAN is airborne, splashing into the pool.

LING TIAN
(coldly)
You dirtied my floor. Get out now. If you ever step through that door again, I'll kill you.

YI XUAN looks at LING TIAN in shock from the water. LING TIAN turns around, wipes the blood from the corner of his mouth. His eyes are ice cold—and utterly exhausted.

title: The Transmigrated Princess's Counterattack Strategy
description: A modern forensic pathologist is transported into the body of a betrayed princess consort who lost everything to a scheming concubine and her cruel husband.
context:
Title: The Transmigrated Princess's Counterattack Strategy
Description: A modern forensic pathologist is transported into the body of a betrayed princess consort who lost everything to a scheming concubine and her cruel husband.

INT. PRINCE'S MANOR BEDROOM - DAY

LING SIWAN sits on the bed, leisurely stirring a bowl of medicinal tonic with a silver spoon.

THE PRINCESS CONSORT kneels on the ground, clothes disheveled, blood at the corner of her mouth, her expression a blend of grief and banked fury.

PRINCESS CONSORT
(coldly)
If it's revenge you want, take it from me. But my child—he's innocent. Give him back.

LING SIWAN
(sinisterly sweet)
Sister, don't be dramatic. You caused my fall—accidents happen. Though I must admit, your child's... gift... has done wonders for my recovery.

The PRINCESS CONSORT's eyes widen with comprehension. She lunges at LING SIWAN, grabbing her throat with trembling hands.

PRINCESS CONSORT
(hoarsely)
You monster.

The PRINCE rushes in and shoves the PRINCESS CONSORT away. She collapses.

PRINCE
(furious, weary)
Still at it? Even now?

PRINCESS CONSORT
(coughing blood, laughing bitterly)
She used our child for her medicine, and you ask if I'm still at it?

MAID
(rushing to support her)
Your Highness, the physician said she mustn't be distressed—her vitals are already—

PRINCE
I don't care! She had an affair and birthed that bastard. She deserves every ounce of this.

PRINCESS CONSORT
(quietly, dangerously)
It was that night. The fire. You were delirious. I carried you out.

LING SIWAN
(feigning shock)
Sister... the stable boy with the lazy eye? Even for a lonely noblewoman, that's desperation. The whole manor knows. Just admit it.

PRINCE
(explosive, embarrassed)
Stop lying! I defended you to the court, to my father. And this is how you repay me?

The PRINCE turns to leave. LING SIWAN walks past, her heel "accidentally" grinding into the PRINCESS CONSORT's hand.

The PRINCESS CONSORT lies motionless, blood pooling beneath her.

PRINCESS CONSORT (V.O.)
Chu Chen'an, when you learn it was my blood that saved you, my body that warmed you that night—regret won't be a sharp enough word.
continuation:
EXT. ANTIQUE ARCHITECTURE PLAZA - DAY

A SCIENTIST sits on a rideable suitcase, watching a short drama, shaking her head.

SCIENTIST
Five episodes of "Chasing Wife to Crematorium" and she hasn't even planted a single piece of forged evidence. Amateur hour.

She accelerates the suitcase, swerving to avoid a CHILD crossing her path while shouting.

SCIENTIST
Watch it! Garbage sorting is a civic duty!

The suitcase clips a stone pillar. The SCIENTIST is launched into the air, strikes her head, and crashes down, unconscious.

PASSERSBY gather.

PASSERBY A
Someone call emergency services!

PASSERBY B
Is she breathing?

The scene flashes between the SCIENTIST's bleeding temple and the PRINCESS CONSORT's lifeless form.

INT. PRINCE'S MANOR BEDROOM - DAY

THE PRINCESS CONSORT lies on the bed, eyes snapping open—cold, clinical, assessing her surroundings like a crime scene.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Article 20: Acquittal (Pilot Episode)
description: A father wrongfully imprisoned as an accomplice to bank robbery, after a bureaucratic nightmare at the bank, fights for justice while his family unravels.
context:
Title: Article 20: Acquittal (Pilot Episode)
Description: A father wrongfully imprisoned as an accomplice to bank robbery, after a bureaucratic nightmare at the bank, fights for justice while his family unravels.

INT. PRISON CORRIDOR - DAY

Heavy iron doors CLANG shut. LI ZIZHONG (45, weary but stoic) shuffles in leg irons, sandwiched between two prison guards. His knuckles are white around a crumpled family photo.

PRESIDING JUDGE (V.O.)
The court will now announce its verdict in the case of The People v. Li Zizhong.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

A packed gallery. The air is thick with sweat and tension.

COURT CLERK
All rise.

The gallery stands. The PRESIDING JUDGE (60, impassive) adjusts her glasses.

PRESIDING JUDGE
On appeal, this court finds the defendant's presence during the robbery and acceptance of stolen currency constitute sufficient evidence of collusion. Under Article 263, Section 2, the conviction stands. Defendant Li Zizhong: twenty years imprisonment.

GAVEL BANGS. LI ZIZHONG's shoulders sag. At the plaintiff's table, bank president WANG DAFU (50s, perfectly groomed) whispers to his lawyer.

WANG DAFU
(quietly)
Our compliance protocols are ironclad for a reason.

LI ZIZHONG turns to the gallery, where his teenage daughter LI NA weeps. His voice cracks.

LI ZIZHONG
I never even touched that money. I just wanted to save my son.

Bank lawyer SONG ZHIMING (40s, razor-sharp) gathers her files.

SONG ZHIMING
The law doesn't distinguish between motives, Mr. Li. Only actions.

EXT. COURTHOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY

Bailiffs guide LI ZIZHONG toward a prison van. Flashbulbs erupt.

REPORTER
Mr. Li! Any comment on the court's decision?

MONTAGE - TELEVISION SCREENS

A) NEWS ANCHOR at desk.
NEWS ANCHOR
The controversial Li Zizhong case has ignited online debate. At issue: a father's desperate attempt to withdraw his comatose son's savings.

B) SPLIT SCREEN showing security footage.
NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Bank of Tongjiang refused the withdrawal, citing regulations requiring personal presence for accounts over 50,000 yuan—even with power of attorney.

C) GRAPHIC showing the timeline.
NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Minutes later, armed robbers stormed the branch.

END MONTAGE
continuation:
INT. BANK - DAY - FLASHBACK

LI ZIZHONG stands at the counter, clutching documents. The BANK TELLER (20s, nervous) points to a laminated certificate.

BANK TELLER
It's Bank Regulation 203. Even with his ID, your son's biometric verification is mandatory for this account type.

LI ZIZHONG
He's in a coma. Please, this is for his surgery.

BANK TELLER
I need my job, sir. There's nothing I can—

The front door EXPLODES open. Three MASKED ROBBERS flood in. One fires a warning shot into the ceiling.

ROBBER #1
Everybody down! Now!

SCREAMS. LI ZIZHONG drops, shielding his head. A robber crouches beside him, notices the medical papers scattered on the floor.

ROBBER #2
Hospital bills? Bank screw you too?

LI ZIZHONG
(whispering)
They won't let me withdraw my own son's money.

The robber hesitates. Then stuffs a wad of cash into LI ZIZHONG's jacket.

ROBBER #2
Consider it interest you already paid.

EXT. COURTHOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY - BACK TO PRESENT

LI ZIZHONG stares blankly at the reporters.

REPORTER
Prosecutors argued your presence created a distraction. Do you maintain your innocence?

LI ZIZHONG
(quietly)
My son still doesn't know I'm gone.

A bailiff pushes him into the van. The doors slam.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Six months later.

LI MU (18) lies comatose, machines beeping. LI NA (16) watches a news program on her phone showing the courthouse footage.

NEWS ANCHOR (ON PHONE)
The Supreme Court has declined to hear Li's case.

LI NA
(whispering)
Dad...

An elderly DOCTOR enters, reviewing a chart.

DOCTOR
His vitals are stable. Neural activity is... minimal.

LI NA
How minimal?

DOCTOR
We wait. And hope.

The Doctor leaves. LI NA collapses in a plastic chair, exhausted.

INSERT: LI ZIZHONG's anguished face from the news footage.

SOUND: Heart monitor FLATLINING, then steady beep returning.

LI MU's eyes snap open. He stares at the ceiling, gasping.

LI MU
Dad...

MATCH CUT TO:

INT. LAW LIBRARY - DAY

LI MU, now gaunt but determined, pores over legal texts. His fingers trace Article 263 of the Criminal Code.

LI MU
(whispering)
Accomplice liability... requires intent.

He marks the page, his eyes burning with purpose.

FADE OUT.

title: When the World Turns Upside Down, You Will Come to Love Me
description: On the anniversary of her father's death, He Yan, CEO of Fanxing Group, suffers a car accident that leaves her disfigured. After reconstructive surgery, she wakes up with a completely different face.
context:
Title: When the World Turns Upside Down, You Will Come to Love Me
Description: On the anniversary of her father's death, He Yan, CEO of Fanxing Group, suffers a car accident that leaves her disfigured. After reconstructive surgery, she wakes up with a completely different face.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - NIGHT

A sports car speeds along a pitch-black highway. The headlights cut through the darkness.

SUPER: Today marks the anniversary of He Tingxiao's death. His daughter He Yan, now CEO of Fanxing Group, makes the journey alone.

INT. SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

HE YAN drives, her expression focused. Her phone BUZZES—a call from "Yu Ge." She answers via Bluetooth.

HE YAN
(into earpiece)
Tell me you're already at the temple.

YU GE (V.O.)
Waiting with your father's favorite incense. The shareholders are just arriving.

HE YAN
Good. I can't face their condolences again.

YU GE (V.O.)
You don't have to carry this alone anymore, He Yan.

HE YAN's grip tightens on the wheel.

HE YAN
You're the only one who never says his name like it's a weapon.

YU GE (V.O.)
Tonight, after the ceremony... there's something I've been meaning to ask you.

HE YAN
(softens)
I've been meaning to tell you something too.

YU GE (V.O.)
A surprise?

Suddenly, headlights BLIND her from the opposite lane—wrong side.
continuation:
EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - NIGHT

The two cars collide. HE YAN's car spins violently.

INT. ROLLING SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

HE YAN is tossed inside the car, glass shattering around her.

HE YAN
(screaming)
Yu Ge!

The vehicle crashes to a stop.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

HE YAN lies in a hospital bed, her face wrapped in bandages, only her eyes visible. She slowly opens them, vision blurry.

DR. CHEN appears above her.

HE YAN
(weakly)
Where am I?

DR. CHEN

title: System Rebelled and I'm Surrounded by Princesses
description: A transmigrator who wants nothing more than to live a lazy life in the imperial library is pressured by his system to complete world-changing quests.
context:
Title: System Rebelled and I'm Surrounded by Princesses
Description: A transmigrator who wants nothing more than to live a lazy life in the imperial library is pressured by his system to complete world-changing quests.

INT. LIBRARY PAVILION - DAY

SOUND of bubbling hotpot.

CLOSE UP on a boiling spicy hotpot, steam rising through the winter air.

LI YUNZHOU, dressed in ancient green robes, leans over the pot and inhales the aroma with satisfaction. A half-finished bamboo scroll covered in detailed cataloging notes sits on the desk beside him.

He uses chopsticks to swish a piece of tripe in the pot.

LI YUNZHOU
Covered in sesame sauce.

He dips the cooked tripe into a small bowl of sesame sauce, then eats it with a look of pure bliss.

LI YUNZHOU
(muffled, ecstatic)
Oh my god! Winter calls for something hot like this.

In the same room, XIAO LIU, a girl in a modern black leather jacket and punk hairstyle, sits reading a book. Books float magically in the air around her. She glances at the bamboo scroll with narrowed eyes, then snaps the book shut.

XIAO LIU
Host, you spent three months perfecting that cataloging system for the Hanlin Academy. You told them it was just "organizing stuff." Do you have any idea you just restructured the entire imperial bureaucracy's knowledge system?

LI YUNZHOU
(waving dismissively with chopsticks)
I just wanted to find books faster for my reading list. The fact that it made them more efficient is their problem, not mine.

XIAO LIU
That's exactly what I'm talking about! Every time you try to slack off, you accidentally change the world. The quest isn't about working—it's about stopping you from breaking the timeline through sheer laziness!

LI YUNZHOU stops chewing, looking genuinely troubled for a moment.

LI YUNZHOU
...Then fire me. Please.

He immediately shakes off the moment and returns to his food.

LI YUNZHOU
Hey, Xiao Liu, you sure you don't want some?

XIAO LIU looks at him with a deadpan expression.

LI YUNZHOU
(chuckles)
Right, I forgot. You're a system, you can't eat. Well, don't mind if I do then.

XIAO LIU's jaw tightens. She teleports in a flash of light to his side.

XIAO LIU
(in a low, urgent voice)
Host, do you remember what happened to the last transmigrator who refused their fate? The system unassigned them. Without system protection, the world's logic rejects you. Slowly at first. A missed meal. A forgotten name. Then...

LI YUNZHOU
(still eating, but his hand trembles slightly)
...I know the speech. Sixty-seven times. You're not scaring me.

XIAO LIU
(pleading, voice softening)
Brother Yunzhou, just accept the quest. Please. For me.
continuation:
EXT. PALACE CORRIDOR - DAY

PRINCESS ZHAOYANG, dressed in elegant robes, walks briskly with her maid, QINGMEI. She clutches a silk handkerchief covered in complex mathematical equations.

PRINCESS ZHAOYANG
(angry)
Kong Xiang gave me a problem that supposedly has no solution. Says it's to "test my limits." But I saw the Wei Prince's spy watching the whole lesson. They're not testing me—they're testing whether the imperial family is still fit to rule.

QINGMEI
Princess, what if the library pavilion doesn't have the answer either?

PRINCESS ZHAOYANG
(stops and turns, eyes blazing)
It has to. Because if it doesn't... then they've already won.

INT. LIBRARY PAVILION - DAY

LI YUNZHOU
(waving his hand)
Do what quest? Doing quests is just working for you, isn't it? I'm telling you, working is impossible. Impossible in this lifetime!

He gestures around the room.

LI YUNZHOU
This library pavilion is perfect. There's food, drinks, a salary, and no one bothering me. A slacker's paradise! I'm going to work here until—

SOUND of a large door creaking open.

LI YUNZHOU
(startled)
Someone's coming! Go, quickly!

XIAO LIU disappears in a flash of light.

LI YUNZHOU quickly stands up and tries to look presentable, hiding the food. His hand trembles again as he adjusts his robes.

PRINCESS ZHAOYANG enters the library.

She and LI YUNZHOU lock eyes. He freezes—not just at her beauty, but at the silk handkerchief in her hands. She looks at him with desperation barely concealed beneath imperial hauteur.

LI YUNZHOU
(softly, almost to himself)
...Calculus.

CLOSE UP on PRINCESS ZHAOYANG's face, surprise flickering across her features at the unfamiliar word.

title: The Lazy Scholar
description: A modern man transmigrated to ancient times decides to live a carefree life in the imperial library, avoiding all responsibilities, until an unexpected visitor disrupts his peace.
context:
Title: The Lazy Scholar
Description: A modern man transmigrated to ancient times decides to live a carefree life in the imperial library, avoiding all responsibilities, until an unexpected visitor disrupts his peace.

INT. LIBRARY PAVILION - DAY

A steaming hot pot bubbles on a desk buried in scrolls.

LI YUNZHOU leans in to smell it, his face full of bliss.

He lifts a piece of tripe with chopsticks, swishing it in the pot a few times.

LI YUNZHOU dips the cooked tripe in a sesame sauce bowl.

LI YUNZHOU (V.O.)
Coated with sesame sauce.

LI YUNZHOU eats it in one bite, his expression extremely satisfied.

LI YUNZHOU
Oh my goodness! Winter calls for something hot like this.

XIAO LIU sits on a bookshelf nearby in modern dress, reading seriously. Several books float in the air around her.

LI YUNZHOU eats hot pot while looking at books.

LI YUNZHOU
Wonderful, wonderful.

XIAO LIU casually tosses a book away. The book spins rapidly through the air toward the opposite bookshelf.

LI YUNZHOU
Hey, Xiao Liu, you really won't have some? Oh right, you're a system, you can't eat. I won't hold back then.

XIAO LIU
Three years in Great Liang. When does the mission begin?

LI YUNZHOU
The mission to change a dynasty's fate? Xiao Liu, the ancients managed without me. They'll manage still.

XIAO LIU
What would make you try?

LI YUNZHOU
Nothing. If it needs doing, find a hero.

XIAO LIU gets angry, transforms into a beam of light, and instantly appears beside LI YUNZHOU, affectionately holding his arm.

XIAO LIU
(acting cute)
Brother Yunzhou, just do the mission, it's very simple.
continuation:
EXT. PALACE CORRIDOR - DAY

Princess ZHAO ANNING of Zhaoyang and her maid QINGMEI are walking briskly through the corridor.

ZHAO ANNING
(angry)
That old bastard Kong Xiang gives me impossible puzzles. "Personalized teaching" to humiliate Imperial Sister. I won't let him win.

QINGMEI
Princess, with your status, who would dare?

ZHAO ANNING
The Wei Prince's people dare. They want us weak.

The two arrive at the entrance of the library pavilion.

QINGMEI
But if there's no answer here either?

ZHAO ANNING
This is the world's most complete collection. It must be here. Let's go.

INT. LIBRARY PAVILION - DAY

LI YUNZHOU
Doing missions is just working for you. Working is impossible—absolutely impossible. This library has food, drink, salary, and no supervision. A slacker's paradise. I'll die here before I retire!

XIAO LIU
Brother Yunzhou...

The library pavilion door is suddenly pushed open.

LI YUNZHOU
(panicking)
Someone's coming! Go quickly!

XIAO LIU transforms into a beam of light and disappears.

LI YUNZHOU frantically clears the hot pot from the table.

Princess ZHAO ANNING walks in.

The two lock eyes. LI YUNZHOU stares at the beauty before him, stunned.

LI YUNZHOU shows an awkward yet polite smile.

ZHAO ANNING looks at him expressionlessly, then sniffs the air.

ZHAO ANNING
You smell of rebellion. And beef tallow. Find me Kong Xiang's answer by dawn, or I'll report this "abandoned" library has a tenant.

title: Ultimate Teacher
description: A man named Su Ming accepts a challenge to reform the worst school in the province within a month to win a marriage contract with a beautiful CEO, aided by a mysterious system.
context:
Title: Ultimate Teacher
Description: A man named Su Ming accepts a challenge to reform the worst school in the province within a month to win a marriage contract with a beautiful CEO, aided by a mysterious system.

EXT. ROOFTOP - DAY

On a rainy day, a man in a leather jacket, SU MING, stands on the rooftop holding a black umbrella.

SU MING (V.O.)
Longhua Academy. Not a school anymore—just a warehouse for problems the system gave up on. Ranked dead last province-wide.

FLASHBACK:

Students in uniform loiter in chaotic clusters. One group huddles around a phone, another shoves a classmate against a locker.

BACK TO PRESENT:

On the exterior wall behind SU MING, a weathered poster reads: "REFORM ACADEMY, WIN CONTRACT" beside a photo of CEO QIAO XUE.

SU MING (V.O.)
If I can pull them back from the brink in thirty days... I win a marriage contract with CEO Qiao Xue. The terms are clear.

SU MING's knuckles tighten on the umbrella handle, rainwater streaming from the spokes.

SU MING (V.O.)
They were my classmates once. I know exactly how they think.

A STATIC HISS fills the air. Geometric equations materialize, glowing faint blue around SU MING's silhouette.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Umbrella Protocol activated. Experience-based behavioral correction will trigger reward distribution.

SU MING flinches, fingers brushing his earpiece.

SU MING
System?

SU MING (to himself)
Two years in the wilderness. About time the universe cashed its debt.

SU MING's jaw sets. He snaps the umbrella shut.

SU MING
Let's see what dead last really looks like.

He strides past the poster. His fingers tear it from the wet brick as he passes.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Commencing operation.
continuation:
INT. PRINCIPAL'S OFFICE - DAY

Modern campus buildings visible through floor-to-ceiling windows.

SU MING waits by the window, arms crossed. His dry shirt suggests he's changed since the rooftop.

Sharp FOOTSTEPS. QIAO XUE (late 20s, sharp suit, glasses) enters, tablet in hand.

Her presence catches SU MING's attention. He subtly straightens his posture.

SU MING (quietly)
Impressive.

QIAO XUE settles behind the desk, scrolling through the tablet.

QIAO XUE
The certificate photo didn't do you justice, Mr. Su. You're the ninety-ninth candidate this year. The others broke contracts, not students.

SU MING
I don't break easily. Though I'm curious—is the contract clause still binding?

QIAO XUE
One month. Measurable improvement in behavior metrics. Today's monthly exam is your baseline assessment. Ready to observe?

SU MING
I'll need a uniform.

QIAO XUE (puzzled)
You're administrative staff.

SU MING (leaning forward, precisely)
Tigers don't change their stripes from the observation deck.

title: I Became a Wealthy Heir on My Wedding Day
description: On his wedding day, Chu He discovers his bride in bed with another man, only to learn he is the long-lost heir to a powerful conglomerate.
context:
Title: I Became a Wealthy Heir on My Wedding Day
Description: On his wedding day, Chu He discovers his bride in bed with another man, only to learn he is the long-lost heir to a powerful conglomerate.

INT. TEMPLE - DAY

CHU GE, mid-40s in a simple dark suit, kneels in a temple alcove. Two BODYGUARDS wait respectfully at a distance. He holds worn wooden divination blocks.

CHU GE clasps his hands together, eyes closed.

CHU GE
Please, gods and Buddha, help me find my brother. Before it's too late.

CHU GE tosses the blocks. They clatter on the stone floor - both land face up.

SECRETARY LIN, professional in a black dress, rushes up the temple steps, phone in hand.

SECRETARY LIN
President Chu. The investigator just sent confirmation.

CHU GE
(standing slowly)
And?

SECRETARY LIN
Your brother is in Hidden Dragon Village. Getting married today.

CHU GE
(surprised, then pained)
Married? Without me there to see it?

SECRETARY LIN
The car is ready. We can make the reception if we leave now.

CHU GE
No. We'll make the ceremony. And Secretary Lin - cancel my meetings. Find me a gift. Something worthy of a Chutian heir.

SECRETARY LIN
Yes, sir.

Chu Ge looks at a faded photo on his phone - two boys, one helping the other with a basketball, a tender smile on his face.
continuation:
EXT. RESIDENTIAL BUILDING - DAY

CHU HE, late 20s, adjusts his slightly loose suit. He holds a modest bouquet of carnations. A PHOTOGRAPHER gestures from the street below.

PHOTOGRAPHER
The groom looks great! One more smile! Look up!

Chu He forces a smile, but his eyes scan the building's windows. The BEST MAN, his cousin, approaches with a phone.

BEST MAN
Your father's calling. Third time.

CHU HE takes the phone.

CHU HE
(answering)
Dad. I told you, it's handled.

CHU HE'S FATHER (V.O.)
Xiao He, listen. Ruyan's father just called. She's been asking about annulment procedures. Last week.

CHU HE
(frozen, hand tightening on the bouquet)
What?

CHU HE'S FATHER (V.O.)
She's carrying your child. Whatever happens today, just... be patient with her.

CHU HE
(quietly)
I'll handle it.

He ends the call, his knuckles white on the bouquet stems.

INT. LIU RUYAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

LIU RUYAN, 26, sits on the edge of the wedding bed in her dress, head in her hands. JIANG KUN, 30s and predatory, leans against the wall by the window.

JIANG KUN
Your phone's been buzzing since breakfast. He knows, doesn't he?

LIU RUYAN
(quietly, not looking up)
His father suspects. I told you this was insane, doing this here—

JIANG KUN
The best place to hide is in plain sight. And he's downstairs taking photos.

JIANG KUN crosses to her, stands too close.

JIANG KUN
One month. You marry him, get access to his family's accounts, then file for divorce. The paternity test stays our secret. Everyone wins.

LIU RUYAN
Except Chu He.

JIANG KUN
(smiling)
Small price for a fortune.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

CHU HE walks upstairs, bouquet in hand, his face set, jaw tight. The BEST MAN follows, checking his phone.

They reach the door of Room 402. It's ajar. A man's low laugh floats out from inside.

INT. LIU RUYAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

JIANG KUN is close to LIU RUYAN, his hand on her bare shoulder strap, whispering in her ear. Her face is turned away, eyes closed.

The door opens. CHU HE stands in the doorway, frozen.

CHU HE sees them. The bouquet slides from his hands. Carnations scatter on the floor.

full_script:
Title: I Became a Wealthy Heir on My Wedding Day
Description: On his wedding day, Chu He discovers his bride in bed with another man, only to learn he is the long-lost heir to a powerful conglomerate.

INT. TEMPLE - DAY

CHU GE, mid-40s in a simple dark suit, kneels in a temple alcove. Two BODYGUARDS wait respectfully at a distance. He holds worn wooden divination blocks.

CHU GE clasps his hands together, eyes closed.

CHU GE
Please, gods and Buddha, help me find my brother. Before it's too late.

CHU GE tosses the blocks. They clatter on the stone floor - both land face up.

SECRETARY LIN, professional in a black dress, rushes up the temple steps, phone in hand.

SECRETARY LIN
President Chu. The investigator just sent confirmation.

CHU GE
(standing slowly)
And?

SECRETARY LIN
Your brother is in Hidden Dragon Village. Getting married today.

CHU GE
(surprised, then pained)
Married? Without me there to see it?

SECRETARY LIN
The car is ready. We can make the reception if we leave now.

CHU GE
No. We'll make the ceremony. And Secretary Lin - cancel my meetings. Find me a gift. Something worthy of a Chutian heir.

SECRETARY LIN
Yes, sir.

Chu Ge looks at a faded photo on his phone - two boys, one helping the other with a basketball, a tender smile on his face.

EXT. RESIDENTIAL BUILDING - DAY

CHU HE, late 20s, adjusts his slightly loose suit. He holds a modest bouquet of carnations. A PHOTOGRAPHER gestures from the street below.

PHOTOGRAPHER
The groom looks great! One more smile! Look up!

Chu He forces a smile, but his eyes scan the building's windows. The BEST MAN, his cousin, approaches with a phone.

BEST MAN
Your father's calling. Third time.

CHU HE takes the phone.

CHU HE
(answering)
Dad. I told you, it's handled.

CHU HE'S FATHER (V.O.)
Xiao He, listen. Ruyan's father just called. She's been asking about annulment procedures. Last week.

CHU HE
(frozen, hand tightening on the bouquet)
What?

CHU HE'S FATHER (V.O.)
She's carrying your child. Whatever happens today, just... be patient with her.

CHU HE
(quietly)
I'll handle it.

He ends the call, his knuckles white on the bouquet stems.

INT. LIU RUYAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

LIU RUYAN, 26, sits on the edge of the wedding bed in her dress, head in her hands. JIANG KUN, 30s and predatory, leans against the wall by the window.

JIANG KUN
Your phone's been buzzing since breakfast. He knows, doesn't he?

LIU RUYAN
(quietly, not looking up)
His father suspects. I told you this was insane, doing this here—

JIANG KUN
The best place to hide is in plain sight. And he's downstairs taking photos.

JIANG KUN crosses to her, stands too close.

JIANG KUN
One month. You marry him, get access to his family's accounts, then file for divorce. The paternity test stays our secret. Everyone wins.

LIU RUYAN
Except Chu He.

JIANG KUN
(smiling)
Small price for a fortune.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY

CHU HE walks upstairs, bouquet in hand, his face set, jaw tight. The BEST MAN follows, checking his phone.

They reach the door of Room 402. It's ajar. A man's low laugh floats out from inside.

INT. LIU RUYAN'S BEDROOM - DAY

JIANG KUN is close to LIU RUYAN, his hand on her bare shoulder strap, whispering in her ear. Her face is turned away, eyes closed.

The door opens. CHU HE stands in the doorway, frozen.

CHU HE sees them. The bouquet slides from his hands. Carnations scatter on the floor.

JIANG KUN looks up slowly, not startled. Pleased.

LIU RUYAN turns. Her eyes meet Chu's. For a moment, just guilt.

No one speaks.

title: Eternal Emperor and Timeless Minister - Episode 1
description: A modern warehouse manager transmigrates into a minor county magistrate and has been living a laid-back life for ten years, but boredom leads him to make unusual reforms.
context:
Title: Eternal Emperor and Timeless Minister - Episode 1
Description: A modern warehouse manager transmigrates into a minor county magistrate and has been living a laid-back life for ten years, but boredom leads him to make unusual reforms.

INT. COUNTY OFFICE BACK HALL - DAY

The hall pulses with colored lanterns and a rotating mirror ball. Silken drapes cascade from rafters. Red petals drift across polished floorboards.

YUN'ER, in flowing silks, performs a mesmerizing dance that blends classical grace with modern rhythm, her sleeves painting patterns in the air.

YOUNG MASTER, in refined scholar's robes with dark lenses, watches intently from a low couch, tapping his fingers to the beat.

Yun'er's dance reaches a crescendo, then she flows into a graceful bow.

YUN'ER
(still breathless)
Well? Did my "fiscal revenue stimulation dance" meet the Young Master's approval?

YOUNG MASTER
(removing his lenses)
You're getting too good at this. Soon I'll need to institute a "too beautiful" tax just to keep the treasury balanced.

YUN'ER
(leaning in teasingly)
And when will you tax yourself for being too clever by half?

YOUNG MASTER
(grinning)
The day you stop pointing out my contradictions.

YOUNG MASTER (V.O.)
Ten years. Ten years since a warehouse inventory sheet became my life. I tried to be content with calligraphy and tea, but innovation is a habit that dies hard. So I've been... renovating. Quietly.

MA DE, a stout constable with an official's badge askew, bursts through the door.

MA DE
Young Master! Two merchants from the capital! They carry imperial travel permits!

YOUNG MASTER
And?

MA DE
(hesitant)
The old custom... the "road maintenance contribution"? Shall I... invite them to our "reception"?

YOUNG MASTER
(eyes narrowing)
Ma De, how long have we run a clean office here?

MA DE
(defensive)
Two years, but Young Master, these are high-born ladies! The contribution could fund the new irrigation--

YOUNG MASTER
The irrigation system is funded by the theater profits. As I've explained. Twelve times.

MA DE
But... they're very beautiful high-born ladies.

YOUNG MASTER
(standing abruptly)
Beautiful? Imperial permits? Do you want to bring the entire bureaucracy down on us?

MA DE
(confused)
So... no?

YOUNG MASTER
(throwing up his hands)
Bring them in properly! Official escort, proper lodging, no "contributions"! And Ma De-- try to remember we're civil servants, not theater villains.

MA DE
(perking up)
The theater needs villains! I could audition--

YOUNG MASTER
Get out.

Ma De exits hastily.
continuation:
EXT. YUNBIAN COUNTY OUTSKIRTS ROAD - DAY

A carriage with plain wooden panels rumbles along a well-maintained road. Drainage ditches line either side, engineered with precision.

INT. INSIDE CARRIAGE - DAY

HER MAJESTY, early thirties, wears simple brocade. Her posture is rigid with contained tension. FU RONG, her guard, watches the landscape.

FU RONG
Your Majesty, the reports can't be right. This district was supposed to be impoverished.

HER MAJESTY
(fingering a tax scroll)
Year after year, Yunbian pays its levies early. While the Three Rivers region floods and starves.

FU RONG
A fluke?

HER MAJESTY
Four consecutive years? That's not luck. That's a question I've come to answer.

FU RONG
Prime Minister Lin will notice your absence.

HER MAJESTY
Let him. He thinks me helpless. A woman playing at emperor.

HER MAJESTY (V.O.)
Father's throne was never meant for me. But I will not be the footnote in a man's history.

EXT. YUNBIAN COUNTY OUTSKIRTS ROAD - DAY

A mechanical ROAR echoes. A steam-powered tractor, brass and wood, belches white vapor as it passes the carriage, pulling three cargo carts.

INT. INSIDE CARRIAGE - DAY

Fu Rong's eyes widen.

FU RONG
Your Majesty! That contraption--

HER MAJESTY
(staring, a slow smile forming)
Yes. That is definitely a question worth answering.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Deadly Escape
description: A blind woman discovers the horrifying truth about her husband and sister's betrayal on her birthday.
context:
Title: Deadly Escape
Description: A blind woman discovers the horrifying truth about her husband and sister's betrayal on her birthday.

INT. BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

ZHAO YUHAN touches her fingers, feeling the sticky wetness. She sniffs and recoils.

ZHAO YUHAN
What is this? It smells metallic.

SONG YUJIA moves quickly, pressing a silk napkin into her hands.

SONG YUJIA
The chef's undercooked reduction. Too much liver in the sauce. Let's get you upstairs.

SU YUE enters from the shadows, her phone clutched tight.

SU YUE
Her parents texted. Flight's delayed until morning.

SONG YUJIA guides ZHAO YUHAN toward the exit. He glances back at SU YUE, his expression hard. SU YUE watches them leave, her face unreadable.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

ZHAO YUHAN closes the bathroom door. Water runs.

SONG YUJIA enters, pouring whiskey with unsteady hands.

SU YUE stands on the balcony, smoking. She crushes the cigarette.

SU YUE
The safe was empty. No transfer papers.

SONG YUJIA
She hasn't signed yet.

SU YUE
Then we stick to the plan? Before she tells anyone?

SONG YUJIA
The picnic. The ridge trail has no guardrails.
continuation:
SU YUE
What if she really is—

The water stops. ZHAO YUHAN's voice comes muffled.

ZHAO YUHAN
Who's out there? I heard voices.

SONG YUJIA
(to the door)
The staff. We're leaving for your surprise at noon.

ZHAO YUHAN
(smiling)
Can't wait.

Her footsteps recede. SU YUE meets SONG YUJIA's eyes. Neither looks away.

EXT. VILLA - DAY

SU YUE opens the car door, guiding ZHAO YUHAN's hand to the frame.

SONG YUJIA loads a picnic basket and blanket into the trunk, tucking a small shovel beneath. He closes it.

INT. CAR - DAY

SONG YUJIA drives. The road climbs. ZHAO YUHAN sits behind him, her hand resting on her stomach. SU YUE watches the cliffside through her window.

SU YUE
You never signed those insurance forms.

ZHAO YUHAN
I wanted Song to review them first.

SU YUE
He already did. Yesterday.

ZHAO YUHAN turns toward SU YUE.

ZHAO YUHAN
This road feels wrong. Too steep.

The car slows. SONG YUJIA's eyes meet SU YUE's in the rearview mirror. The engine idles. Wind screams outside. No one speaks.

title: Dark Forest Encounter
description: A young woman saves a poisoned heir in a dark forest, leading to a fateful meeting that intertwines their destinies as she becomes entangled in a murder conspiracy.
context:
Title: Dark Forest Encounter
Description: A young woman saves a poisoned heir in a dark forest, leading to a fateful meeting that intertwines their destinies as she becomes entangled in a murder conspiracy.

INT. DARK FOREST - NIGHT

A rainy night, lightning and thunder flash through the trees. Rain pours through the canopy in sheets.

LING YING, wearing simple clothes and a bamboo hat, runs frantically through the muddy path, constantly looking back at pursuing flashlights.

She slips and falls toward a ravine—

A hand shoots out. QIN YANSHI, white shirt and black leather jacket soaked through, face pale and weak, catches her wrist and pulls her to safety.

In the distance, flashlight beams and pursuing voices can be heard.

PURSUER (V.O.)
There's movement over there, spread out! Catch him!

LING YING
(urgent whisper)
Follow me.

LING YING pulls QIN YANSHI to hide behind a rocky overhang. The pursuers pass by with flashlights and clubs.

QIN YANSHI trembles, poison making his muscles spasm. He notices the purple veins visible on his hands.

PURSUER LEADER (V.O.)
Remember: Qin Yanshi's been injected. He can't have gone far. Check every crevice.

The pursuers move past. QIN YANSHI releases his grip on the rock, his body swaying. He focuses on LING YING's silver ring with a distinctive lotus design.

QIN YANSHI
(strained)
That ring... proof you helped me...

He twists it—the ring separates into two halves. He pockets one half.

LING YING
What are you—

QIN YANSHI
Promise I'll find you...

QIN YANSHI collapses against the rock, unconscious. LING YING looks at him, then at the half-ring, conflicted.

FADE TO:

EXT. HILLSIDE - DAY

Golden sunrise. QIN YANSHI has changed into a clean white shirt. A DOCTOR is taking a blood sample. SECRETARY XU stands nearby.

SECRETARY XU
Young Master, we've searched the entire mountain. No trace of the woman. Do you recall any identifying features?

QIN YANSHI
(recalling)
Only that ring. Silver. Splits in two. Find it, and you find her.

He holds up the half-ring, letting light catch the lotus etching.

QIN YANSHI
She saved my life. Use every resource.
continuation:
INT. JIANG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

JIANG MOTHER and JIANG FATHER sit on the sofa. Their daughter LING YAN anxiously paces.

JIANG MOTHER
The Qin matriarch is dead. They found the car—a rental under our family name. If they trace it—

LING YAN
(voice breaking)
I didn't mean to—to hit her that hard. She recognized me, she was going to expose the deal—

JIANG FATHER
(interrupting)
Enough. The rental agreement uses Ling Ying's identity. It's clean.

At the doorway, LING YING, now wearing a white dress, walks in and overhears. Shock and betrayal cross her face.

LING YING
You sent me away because you couldn't afford three children. I worked three jobs to get into Beijing University, thinking we could finally—

JIANG MOTHER
(desperate)
Ying'er, there's been a terrible accident. Your sister—she was driving. A woman was hit. But the car... it was rented using your ID months ago.

LING YING
My ID? You took my documents when I left—

LING YAN
(approaching)
It was an accident. Please. I'll spend my life making it up to you.

LING YAN notices the silver lotus ring on LING YING's hand.

LING YAN
That ring...

She grabs Ling Ying's hand, examining it.

LING YAN
Let me hold onto it for now. For safekeeping.

LING YING
No! It's from Grandma—

LING YAN
The grandmother who gave you away? I'll keep it safe.

Ling Yan pulls the ring off, trying it on. It fits. Ling Ying lunges, but JIANG FATHER restrains her.

EXT. JIANG FAMILY ENTRANCE - DAY

LING YING is escorted out, hands bound with zip ties. A black sedan pulls up.

SECRETARY XU and QIN YANSHI exit the car. JIANG MOTHER approaches.

JIANG MOTHER
May I help you?

SECRETARY XU
I represent Qin Corporation security. We're investigating the matriarch's death.

LING YAN
(internal monologue)
Qin Corporation? They found the car already?

LING YAN immediately points at the restrained LING YING.

LING YAN
She's the one you want! She confessed to everything!

LING YING sees QIN YANSHI. Recognition and hope flare in her eyes.

LING YING
(internal monologue)
It's him. If he remembers the forest, he knows I wasn't driving. I was saving him.

QIN YANSHI's gaze falls on LING YING, then on the ring gleaming on LING YAN's finger.

QIN YANSHI
(internal monologue)
The ring... but the woman in the forest was different. I felt her urgency, her kindness.

He pulls out his half. The lotus patterns match.

QIN YANSHI
(to Ling Yan)
Miss, where did you acquire that ring?

LING YAN
(nervously)
Family heirloom. Passed down.

QIN YANSHI
(to Secretary Xu)
Run facial analysis on last night's thermal footage. Cross-reference with these women.

He looks between the sisters, suspicion growing.

QIN YANSHI
One of you was in that forest last night. The truth will show which.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

description: A desperate young woman encounters a mysterious injured man while trying to save her sick mother, leading to a fateful night that changes everything.
context:
Title: Sin and Sugar
Description: A desperate young woman encounters a mysterious injured man while trying to save her sick mother, leading to a fateful night that changes everything.

INT. CAMPING CANOPY - NIGHT

GU NIAN, LIU RUQING, and two other classmates (one male, one female) sit around a table.

GU NIAN
Excuse me, I need to take a call.

GU NIAN gets up and leaves.

FEMALE CLASSMATE
Isn't she the eldest daughter of the Gu family? Why is she borrowing money from us at a camping party?

LIU RUQING
(pouring tea)
Her mother is dying. Some debts you can't outrun.

EXT. WISHING TREE - NIGHT

GU NIAN stands under a tree covered with red ribbons, anxiously making a phone call.

GU NIAN
(into phone, voice choking)
Dad, I'm only short a hundred thousand yuan. Mom's illness can't be delayed any longer.

FATHER (V.O.)
Then stop prolonging it. Your sister got into a car accident and hit someone.

GU NIAN
(agitated)
She's not my sister, she's your illegitimate daughter!

The call is disconnected. Busy tone. GU NIAN stares at her phone in despair, tears streaming down her face.

GU NIAN
(looking up, praying)
God, why don't you punish the bad people instead of tormenting my mother? Who can help me?

A man (LU CHENZHOU) suddenly runs past her from behind, knocking GU NIAN down. They both fall on the grass.

GU NIAN
Ah!

GU NIAN helps LU CHENZHOU sit up.

GU NIAN
Sir, are you alright?

LU CHENZHOU
(weakly)
Help me. No hospitals.

In the distance, two PURSUERS in suits are searching.

PURSUER A
Split up. You go that way.

LU CHENZHOU
(grabbing GU NIAN's arm)
Help me, help me.

GU NIAN
Come!

GU NIAN helps LU CHENZHOU up, and they stumble into a nearby tent.
continuation:
EXT. TENT - NIGHT

The two PURSUERS approach the tent. A silhouette is projected on the tent showing GU NIAN kneeling over LU CHENZHOU, performing CPR motions—rhythmic, medical, urgent.

PURSUER A
(contemptuously)
Hmph, a camper practicing first aid. Let's go.

The PURSUERS turn and leave.

INT. TENT - NIGHT

GU NIAN
(relieved)
They're gone. It's okay now.

GU NIAN notices LU CHENZHOU's black turtleneck is torn, with blood on his collarbone.

GU NIAN
(panicked)
Sir, you're hurt!

LU CHENZHOU's eyes are unfocused. He suddenly pulls GU NIAN down as his knees buckle, collapsing behind crates.

LU CHENZHOU
(breathing heavily)
I'm sorry. I was drugged. Can't stay awake.

GU NIAN
(struggling to support him)
Then let me help.

The light in the tent flickers, implying they remain through the night—her monitoring his breathing, not relations.

EXT. TENT - NIGHT

GU NIAN runs out of the tent disheveled and falls to the ground. LIU RUQING walks over from a distance and sees this.

LIU RUQING
(puzzled, to herself)
Why is she in such a panic?

EXT. WISHING TREE - NIGHT

The PURSUERS return to the tree.

LU CHENZHOU (V.O.)
(voice weaker)
Find that woman for me. She has what I need.

EXT. ROADSIDE - NIGHT

GU NIAN sits alone by the roadside, hugging herself and shivering, wearing glasses, crying helplessly. Her phone vibrates.

She picks up the phone and sees a photo: a woman in a hospital coat standing by her mother's bedside, holding a document: "TREATMENT AUTHORIZATION: PENDING PAYMENT."

GU NIAN
(terrified)
Mom...

GU NIAN immediately makes a call.

GU NIAN
(crying into phone)
What do you want?

THREATENER (V.O.)
Come to the hospital immediately. Otherwise, your mother's treatment authorization will be revoked.

GU NIAN's face is filled with fear and despair.

title: Beauty as a Trap
description: A woman pushes away the man she loves to protect him from a powerful family's revenge after her parents' deaths in a car accident.
context:
Title: Beauty as a Trap
Description: A woman pushes away the man she loves to protect him from a powerful family's revenge after her parents' deaths in a car accident.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

Balloons drift near the ceiling, losing air. Rose petals scatter across the floor. ZHOU YE kneels, holding a modest ring box. WEN RUAN stares at his split knuckles.

ZHOU YE
Ruan Ruan. Will you marry me?

WEN RUAN
I... won't.

She opens her fingers. The ring drops, rolls under the dresser. ZHOU YE's face empties.

Bathroom door opens. SECOND UNCLE (50s, Wen family executor, hotel robe) emerges, hair damp.

SECOND UNCLE
Awkward.

WEN RUAN
You're late.

She moves to SECOND UNCLE. They sit on the bed, her leg touching his. ZHOU YE stands, bouquet falling.

ZHOU YE
Ruan Ruan, who—

SECOND UNCLE
Who am I? Who are you? A signature on a paycheck.

WEN RUAN
(over her shoulder)
My father hired you. I fired you. Effective now.

ZHOU YE
I can help. The threats—

WEN RUAN
That's why you have to go. They don't know your name yet. Keep it that way.

SECOND UNCLE
produces a credit card.

SECOND UNCLE
First class. One way.

WEN RUAN
Take it. Before they learn it.

ZHOU YE
I was wrong about you.

He leaves. Door clicks.

WEN RUAN (V.O.)
Wrong is the only gift I have left.
continuation:
INT. WEN FAMILY VILLA - MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

Parent portraits in fresh frames. WEN RUAN adjusts offerings as YANG WAN (60s, Qi matriarch, black suit) enters with BODYGUARDS.

YANG WAN
Make it match.

WEN RUAN blocks the portraits. A bodyguard shoves her into the marble base. Her head snaps back. Urns shatter.

WEN RUAN
(dazed)
They didn't know—

YANG WAN
(heel on WEN RUAN's hand)
My son knew. When the car hit the pole. He knew.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

QI CHANGSHENG (30s, halo brace, one eye filmed over) watches footage of the memorial hall on his phone. He screenshots WEN RUAN's bloodied hand.

QI CHANGSHENG (V.O.)
Payment on principle.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

WEN RUAN, bound to a chair, tape over her mouth. HE TONG (40s, hired muscle, scarred knuckles) films with his phone.

HE TONG
The Qi family wants collateral. You're it.

WEN RUAN
headbutts the phone. He backhands her. She slumps.

HE TONG
We'll edit that out.

INT. WEN FAMILY VILLA - MEMORIAL HALL - DAY

WEN RUAN, bruised, tries to glue a broken urn. Her hands won't steady. Her phone shows a text: "FOOTAGE RECEIVED."

WEN RUAN (V.O.)
They have their leverage. You have your life. Fair trade.

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

YANG WAN sits in a sedan, watching ZHOU YE through tinted windows.

YANG WAN
I knew it would turn out this way. Get in the car.

ZHOU YE keeps walking, eyes forward. He doesn't look back.

title: Beautiful Chef Girl
description: A young chef's apprentice faces a wealthy CEO suffering from anorexia, as her master's legendary cooking skills are put to the test.
context:
Title: Beautiful Chef Girl
Description: A young chef's apprentice faces a wealthy CEO suffering from anorexia, as her master's legendary cooking skills are put to the test.

EXT. PAKTUO MOUNTAIN, CLOUD CITY - DAY

Quick cuts showing chefs handling fish, chopping garlic, and other cooking scenes, interspersed with a convoy of black luxury cars driving along a winding mountain road. Leading the convoy is a Rolls-Royce.

ON SCREEN: Shen Group CEO - SHEN RONGJING
ON SCREEN: ASSISTANT XU

INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - DAY

ASSISTANT XU
Mr. Shen, Paktuo Mountain is where the old God of Cooking lives in seclusion. If anyone can break your fast, it's him.

SHEN RONGJING
(looking out window, hollow-eyed)
Another mountain. Another miracle.

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

A young woman is frying rice with skilled movements, flames rising as she tosses the wok. Her face shows focused intensity.

ON SCREEN: God of Cooking's Apprentice - JIANG SUISUI

JIANG SUISUI plates the fried rice, sprinkles green onions on top, and studies it critically.

EXT. OLD GOD OF COOKING'S COURTYARD - DAY

JIANG SUISUI carries the egg fried rice and other dishes out of a rustic wooden house. In the courtyard, an old man with white hair and beard is dozing in a rocking chair. His hands bear the scars of decades at the wok.

ON SCREEN: Cloud City's ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING

JIANG SUISUI
Master, time to eat! Master, time to eat!

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
(waking slowly)
Mm.

JIANG SUISUI
(setting the dishes on the table)
Your favorite. Though today's scallions are from the lower field—they lack the snap of the hill crop.

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
(sitting up, studying her)
You're too hard on yourself. The mountain teaches patience.

JIANG SUISUI
(softly)
I just want it to be perfect. For you.

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
Then sit. Perfection tastes better shared.
continuation:
EXT. COURTYARD ENTRANCE - DAY

SHEN RONGJING'S convoy stops at the courtyard gate. Bodyguards exit quickly, opening the car door and holding a black umbrella. SHEN RONGJING steps out slowly, unsteady on his feet.

MALE VILLAGER
(whispering)
Look at him. Like a ghost in a suit.

FEMALE VILLAGER
All that money can't buy a meal.

EXT. OLD GOD OF COOKING'S COURTYARD - DAY

SHEN RONGJING is escorted by bodyguards to ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING. ASSISTANT XU steps forward, spotting Zhang.

ASSISTANT XU
Mr. Zhang? I apologize for the intrusion.

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
(fanning himself, not looking up)
You're here about the boy's eating.

ASSISTANT XU
Mr. Shen hasn't kept solid food down in three weeks. Our doctors—

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
Doctors treat the body. I treat the spirit.

ASSISTANT XU signals. Bodyguards bring forward several trays. He uncovers them partially—not a theatrical reveal, but a quiet showing.

ASSISTANT XU
We understand you've retired. These are merely... resources. For your foundation. Eight kilos of medical-grade ginseng. A research grant under your name. And unrestricted access to our agricultural futures.

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
I don't cook anymore. My hands shake too much for fine knife work.

JIANG SUISUI
(from the kitchen doorway)
Master?

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
But my disciple... she's known the weight of a wok since she could walk. This rice you smell? She made it. Not me.

JIANG SUISUI approaches, carrying fresh tea. She sees the strangers and freezes.

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
(to Suisui)
They need a cook, not a miracle.

ASSISTANT XU
Our Mr. Shen cannot afford experiments.

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
Then let him smell. Let him decide.

ZHANG, GOD OF COOKING
(to Suisui, softer)
The French ham, forty-nine days. The peas from this morning's frost. Rice grains separate, each coated. Technique is right.

SHEN RONGJING has been silent, staring at the simple bowl. He moves slowly forward, bodyguards tensing.

SHEN RONGJING
(quietly)
Everyone says that. "Just smell."

He picks up the spoon. His hand trembles slightly. He takes a small bite. The courtyard holds its breath.

ASSISTANT XU
Mr. Shen?

SHEN RONGJING
(frowning, but different—confused, not disgusted)
This... this rice is...

ASSISTANT XU misreads the expression—he's seen hope collapse too many times.

ASSISTANT XU
(turning on Zhang, voice sharp)
If you've harmed him—if this is another false promise—

Bodyguards shift forward, hands reaching inside jackets.

JIANG SUISUI
(stepping between them)
Wait. Look.

SHEN RONGJING has taken another bite. And another. Tears stream down his face, silent.

SHEN RONGJING
(whispering)
...simply... not enough.

He reaches for the bowl, pulling it closer. The shaking has stopped.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Roll On, Imposter
description: After being abducted as a child, a young woman discovers her true identity when her wealthy uncles finally locate her eighteen years later in a village about to be demolished.
context:
Title: Roll On, Imposter
Description: After being abducted as a child, a young woman discovers her true identity when her wealthy uncles finally locate her eighteen years later in a village about to be demolished.

INT. PARK PAVILION - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Young SITU FENG and young YU MO stand side by side before an easel beneath a wooden pavilion. Rain taps the pavilion roof. Yu Mo's canvas shows a clumsy lotus. Situ Feng looks down at the painting, dips a brush, guiding her hand. Young YU MO holds a paintbrush, lost in thought.

YOUNG SITU FENG
(gentle)
Here—let the petals breathe.

YOUNG YU MO
(throat dry)
Second Uncle... can I have some water?

YOUNG SITU FENG
(grins)
Stay right here. Don't move.

He jogs toward a distant fountain. A MAN (TRAFFICKER) watches from behind a tree. He moves fast—grabs Yu Mo, clamps a hand over her mouth.

YOUNG YU MO
(muffled scream)
Mmph! Second—

The man sprints. Situ Feng spins, water bottle dropping.

YOUNG YU MO
(screaming)
Second Uncle! Help!

SITU FENG
Yu Mo! NO!

Situ Feng bolts after them, but his sneaker catches on gravel. He crashes, palms shredding. The van screeches away.

YOUNG YU MO
(from inside van)
Second Uncle!

SITU FENG
(on knees, bleeding)
YUUU MOOOO!

ON SCREEN: EIGHTEEN YEARS LATER
continuation:
EXT. CITY OVERPASS - DAY

Morning fog swallows the overpass. Below, the city awakens.

EXT. MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

A blue and white Bentley drives into a luxurious manor and stops at the entrance. The DRIVER gets out and opens the rear door for SITU FENG. SITU FENG, wearing an exquisite suit and gold-rimmed glasses, steps out with a stern expression.

ASSISTANT JIANG XIAO hurries forward with an envelope.

JIANG XIAO
(hushed urgency)
President Situ, there's news about Miss Yu Mo. She's staying in Cheng Family Village, which we're about to demolish.

JIANG XIAO hands SITU FENG the envelope containing several photos.

SITU FENG takes out the photos to examine them. One shows a butterfly-shaped birthmark on a back, another shows the Situ family's blood-infused jade pendant. His eyes are resolute.

SITU FENG
(V.O.)
My sister said that Yu Mo has a butterfly birthmark on her back. She also wears the jade pendant infused with the Situ family's blood essence.

SITU FENG
With these two clues, we will definitely find Yu Mo.

INT. COMPANY CORRIDOR - DAY

SITU AN, wearing a suit with a powerful aura, walks through the company corridor. His ASSISTANT follows beside him, reporting on work.

ASSISTANT
President, Mr. Zhang and Mr. Wang are already waiting for you in the conference room.

EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

SITU HU, wearing sunglasses, drives a sports car with a FEMALE COMPANION in the passenger seat. He's on the phone.

INT./EXT. MULTIPLE LOCATIONS - DAY

Split screen shows SITU FENG, SITU AN, and SITU HU all on the phone simultaneously.

SITU FENG
(on phone)
Big Brother. Third Brother. We found Yu Mo.

SITU AN
(sharp intake of breath)
What?

SITU HU
(laughing in disbelief)
What? You found my niece?

SITU AN hangs up and immediately turns back.

SITU AN
Right away.

ASSISTANT
But President, this contract is worth a hundred million!

SITU AN
Not important.

SITU HU kicks the FEMALE COMPANION out of the car.

FEMALE COMPANION
(confused)
Baby, what's wrong?

SITU HU
Get out!

FEMALE COMPANION
Damn scumbag!

CHENG XIANGHUA
Get out! Get out and stay far away!

Today is the day to sign the demolition agreement. Your foster father left all ten million in demolition compensation to your sister Han Wan. Now take this pile of trash and get out!

(on hands and knees, rain streaming)

Title: Roll On, Imposter
Description: After being abducted as a child, a young woman discovers her true identity when her wealthy uncles finally locate her eighteen years later in a village about to be demolished.

INT. PARK PAVILION - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Young SITU FENG and young YU MO stand side by side before an easel beneath a wooden pavilion. Rain taps the pavilion roof. Yu Mo's canvas shows a clumsy lotus. Situ Feng looks down at the painting, dips a brush, guiding her hand. Young YU MO holds a paintbrush, lost in thought.

YOUNG SITU FENG
(gentle)
Here—let the petals breathe.

YOUNG YU MO
(throat dry)
Second Uncle... can I have some water?

YOUNG SITU FENG
(grins)
Stay right here. Don't move.

YOUNG YU MO
(muffled scream)
Mmph! Second—

The man sprints. Situ Feng spins, water bottle dropping.

YOUNG YU MO
(screaming)
Second Uncle! Help!

SITU FENG
Yu Mo! NO!

Situ Feng bolts after them, but his sneaker catches on gravel. He crashes, palms shredding. The van screeches away.

YOUNG YU MO
(from inside van)
Second Uncle!

SITU FENG
(on knees, bleeding)
YUUU MOOOO!

ON SCREEN: EIGHTEEN YEARS LATER

EXT. CITY OVERPASS - DAY

Morning fog swallows the overpass. Below, the city awakens.

EXT. MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

A blue and white Bentley drives into a luxurious manor and stops at the entrance. The DRIVER gets out and opens the rear door for SITU FENG. SITU FENG, wearing an exquisite suit and gold-rimmed glasses, steps out with a stern expression.

ASSISTANT JIANG XIAO hurries forward with an envelope.

JIANG XIAO
(hushed urgency)
President Situ, there's news about Miss Yu Mo. She's staying in Cheng Family Village, which we're about to demolish.

JIANG XIAO hands SITU FENG the envelope containing several photos.

SITU FENG takes out the photos to examine them. One shows a butterfly-shaped birthmark on a back, another shows the Situ family's blood-infused jade pendant. His eyes are resolute.

SITU FENG
(V.O.)
My sister said that Yu Mo has a butterfly birthmark on her back. She also wears the jade pendant infused with the Situ family's blood essence.

SITU FENG
With these two clues, we will definitely find Yu Mo.

SITU AN, wearing a suit with a powerful aura, walks through the company corridor. His ASSISTANT follows beside him, reporting on work.

ASSISTANT
President, Mr. Zhang and Mr. Wang are already waiting for you in the conference room.

EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

SITU HU, wearing sunglasses, drives a sports car with a FEMALE COMPANION in the passenger seat. He's on the phone.

INT./EXT. MULTIPLE LOCATIONS - DAY

Split screen shows SITU FENG, SITU AN, and SITU HU all on the phone simultaneously.

SITU FENG
(on phone)
Big Brother. Third Brother. We found Yu Mo.

SITU AN
(sharp intake of breath)
What?

SITU HU
(laughing in disbelief)
What? You found my niece?

SITU AN hangs up and immediately turns back.

SITU AN
Right away.

ASSISTANT
But President, this contract is worth a hundred million!

SITU AN
Not important.

SITU HU kicks the FEMALE COMPANION out of the car.

FEMALE COMPANION
(confused)
Baby, what's wrong?

SITU HU
Get out!

FEMALE COMPANION
Damn scumbag!
