title: Revenge of a Grieving Mother
description: A woman plots to destroy her husband and his family after they caused the death of her newborn son through their negligence and cruelty.
context:
Title: Revenge of a Grieving Mother
Description: A woman plots to destroy her husband and his family after they caused the death of her newborn son through their negligence and cruelty.

INT. DIMLY LIT ROOM - NIGHT

QINQIN, a woman in a black business suit, walks determinedly into a dimly lit room. BOSS XU sits behind a desk.

QINQIN (V.O.)
The loan defaults in seven days. By then, every asset we own will be worthless to him.

QINQIN sits down across from BOSS XU.

BOSS XU examines the marriage certificate and property deed, then studies QINQIN.

BOSS XU
You're destroying your own credit to ruin him.

QINQIN
(coldly precise)
He deserves to lose everything.

BOSS XU
What justifies this?

QINQIN
(quiet rage)
His family killed my son. He chose to let it happen.

EXT. PARK - DAY (FLASHBACK)

FIVE MONTHS AGO

QINQIN, eight months pregnant in a blue maternity dress, sits on a park bench speaking softly on her phone.

QINQIN
(on the phone)
Checkup went perfectly. Four weeks to go.

Nearby, SISTER-IN-LAW guides her son JIAHUI on a bicycle.

SISTER-IN-LAW
Jiahui, ease up on the pedals. Gentle turn—yes, like that!

She releases the bike. JIAHUI wobbles, loses control. The bicycle veers toward QINQIN.

JIAHUI
(panicked)
Can't stop!

QINQIN turns. The front wheel strikes her side. QINQIN falls from the bench. JIAHUI topples over.

SISTER-IN-LAW rushes forward, her face flickering between alarm and calculation.

SISTER-IN-LAW
Jiahui!

QINQIN lies curled on the ground, breathing sharply, hands cradling her belly.

QINQIN
The baby...

JIAHUI cries, a shallow scrape on his elbow. SISTER-IN-LAW kneels by him first.

SISTER-IN-LAW
Let me see—just a scratch. You'll be fine.

QINQIN's husband AYUE runs over, his phone still in hand.

AYUE
What happened—Jesus, Qinqin!

He crouches beside QINQIN.
continuation:
QINQIN
(clenched teeth)
Contractions. Something's wrong.

SISTER-IN-LAW
(over her shoulder)
Ayue, Jiahui's arm needs cleaning. The handlebar caught him.

JIAHUI
(whimpering)
Mom, it stings...

QINQIN
We need the hospital. Now.

AYUE
Right—I'll get the car, we can—

SISTER-IN-LAW
(interrupting)
Qinqin's not due for weeks. It's probably false labor from the shock.

QINQIN
(gasping)
This isn't false. I'm bleeding.

SISTER-IN-LAW
(pleading)
Ayue, your brother died when Jiahui was a baby. He's all I have left. Please—just get him checked first. Ten minutes.

AYUE looks between them.

QINQIN
Ayue. Don't leave me here.

SISTER-IN-LAW
(to QINQIN)
You're an adult. You can wait. He's a child.

(to AYUE)
She's fine. Women carry babies through worse. But Jiahui—what if it's worse than it looks?

JIAHUI
(pale)
Mom, I feel dizzy...

SISTER-IN-LAW
See? Ayue, I'm begging you.

She grips AYUE's arm, tears forming.

AYUE
(agonized)
Qinqin... it's just ten minutes. I'll be right back.

QINQIN
(pleading)
Please. I can't stand up.

AYUE
Wait here. I'll send an ambulance from the car.

SISTER-IN-LAW
She doesn't need an ambulance, she needs to breathe. Come on.

SISTER-IN-LAW pulls AYUE up. He looks back once, then guides JIAHUI away, moving faster with each step.

QINQIN watches them leave, clutching her stomach. A dark stain spreads on her dress. Her breathing shallows.

QINQIN
(voice breaking)
It hurts...

She's alone. The phone lies broken beside her.

title: After My Husband Cheated, I Became a Matchmaker
description: A woman discovers her husband and best friend's betrayal while battling terminal illness on a hospital rooftop.
context:
Title: After My Husband Cheated, I Became a Matchmaker
Description: A woman discovers her husband and best friend's betrayal while battling terminal illness on a hospital rooftop.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOFTOP - NIGHT

XUE NING supports SU LI, who is wearing a patient gown and hat, as they walk on the rooftop.

SU LI
Xue Ning, thank you for these nights. I know Yan Li's been working late. You shouldn't have to--

XUE NING
(smiling gently)
What are best friends for? Yan Li wanted tonight to be perfect. He'll be here soon.

XUE NING and SU LI stop at a bench. XUE NING holds SU LI's hand.

XUE NING
We prepared something. Wait by the trellis? He wants to see your face when you see it.

XUE NING leads SU LI to a corner with a decorative trellis, partially hidden by hanging vines. XUE NING makes a "shh" gesture, then turns and leaves.

SU LI leans against the wall, her face showing an expectant smile.

XUE NING walks to the other side. JI YAN LI approaches, and they embrace.

SU LI overhears from her spot. The smile fades.

JI YAN LI
(quietly, to XUE NING)
The lawyer called. Papers are ready.

XUE NING
(softly)
We should wait. She's weaker tonight.

JI YAN LI
We've waited six months. Every day she holds on, we're--
continuation:
XUE NING
(lowered voice)
--I know. But she trusts us.

A beat of silence. Su Li's tears begin. She shifts, and a small decorative stone falls from the ledge.

JI YAN LI and XUE NING turn abruptly.

SU LI staggers out from behind the trellis, clutching her hat.

SU LI
(trembling, but controlled)
Six months.

JI YAN LI
(hesitating, not angry)
Li, you don't understand--

SU LI
(pointing, voice breaking)
I understand perfectly. The late nights. The "gala planning." The way you stopped touching my head when the hair fell out.

JI YAN LI steps forward, not in fury, but panic.

JI YAN LI
Stop. You're making yourself sick--

He reaches for her arm. She jerks back. He grabs harder, instinctively. The hat falls.

SU LI
(different voice)
Let. Go.

She yanks free. Her legs buckle from chemo-weakness, not his force. She goes down, catching herself on the trellis. The hat lies on the ground, bald head exposed.

JI YAN LI stares at his hands. XUE NING moves toward Su Li, then freezes mid-step.

SU LI is on her knees, not crying hysterically, but making a sound like she's dying all over again—quiet, breathless, final.

title: Honey, I Want to Go Public
description: A beloved actor hides his marriage to protect his wife's family from media attention, but the strain of secrecy pushes him toward a public reckoning that could destroy the careful life they've built.
context:
Title: Honey, I Want to Go Public
Description: A beloved actor hides his marriage to protect his wife's family from media attention, but the strain of secrecy pushes him toward a public reckoning that could destroy the careful life they've built.

INT. BEDROOM - MORNING

Morning light filters through sheer curtains. AN ZICHU traces patterns on ZUO LAN's shoulder as she sleeps.

AN ZICHU
Xiaoyin's casting is confirmed. They announce today.

ZUO LAN
(stirring)
We promised to wait.

AN ZICHU
I've waited three years. I've hidden. I've lied.

ZUO LAN
The press killed Mom, Zichu. I won't let that happen to her.

AN ZICHU
So she finds a husband on television while I stay invisible?

The phone RINGS. Caller ID shows "Little Sister Xiaoyin." ZUO LAN frantically grabs it.

ZUO LAN
(whispering to AN ZICHU)
Not a sound.

ZUO LAN answers the call.

ZUO LAN
(into the phone)
Hey.
continuation:
EXT. CITY STREET - CONTINUOUS

ZUO XIAOYIN wears a pristine coat, talking on the phone.

ZUO XIAOYIN
(on the phone, anxiously)
My interview's in forty minutes. You promised you'd help me prep.

INT. BEDROOM - CONTINUOUS

ZUO LAN
(frantic)
I'm leaving now. I just—

ZUO XIAOYIN
—She's all we have left, Lan. Don't forget.

The call drops. ZUO LAN stares at the phone.

She grabs a silk scarf from the nightstand, ties it around her neck—covering a mark. Her hands tremble.

ZUO LAN
(quietly)
Please. Just a little longer.

She kisses AN ZICHU's cheek, brief.

ZUO LAN
Come to the taping early.

ZUO LAN rushes out. AN ZICHU sits in the empty room. He picks up his phone, finds the show's producer contact.

His thumb hovers. Then presses call.

title: My Teacher (Episode 46)
description: A devoted rural teacher helps his three female students escape their families' attempts to stop them from attending prestigious universities abroad, sacrificing himself to ensure their departure.
context:
Title: My Teacher (Episode 46)
Description: A devoted rural teacher helps his three female students escape their families' attempts to stop them from attending prestigious universities abroad, sacrificing himself to ensure their departure.

EXT. RURAL DIRT ROAD - DAY

A pockmarked dirt road bakes under midday sun. Dust motes hang in the air. TEACHER LIN ZHIYUAN (50s, threadbare shirt, deeply weathered hands) stands with three young women: SU HONGYU (clutching a patched duffel bag), JIANG QING (gripping a worn suitcase), and LIN QINGQING (holding a canvas satchel with paint stains). Their luggage sits at their feet, dust-covered.

Lin Zhiyuan reaches into his pocket and pulls out three envelopes, his fingers trembling slightly.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Hongyu. Jiang Qing. Qingqing.

He places an envelope in each student's hand, lingering on the touch.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Keep them safe. Right next to your passports.

SU HONGYU
(quietly)
Teacher, your hands...

She notices his knuckles are raw, nails cracked.

JIANG QING
You sold the last of the rice paddies.

LIN ZHIYUAN
The soil was tired anyway.

LIN QINGQING
(whispering)
Uncle...

Lin Zhiyuan meets her eyes. A shared understanding passes between them.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Your scholarships cover tuition. This... this just covers distance.

A distant engine. They all turn. A minibus appears, kicking up red dust.

Lin Zhiyuan quickly loads their luggage into the bus hold, his movements urgent but gentle.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Go now. Before your parents finish market.

SU HONGYU
(turning back)
Teacher, they'll know you helped.

LIN ZHIYUAN
(smiling)
I'm just an old teacher. What can they do, make me teach more?

But his smile doesn't reach his eyes.

He herds them toward the open bus door. As they climb in, the sound of ANGRY SHOUTS cuts through the air.

Down the road, LIN ZHIJIANG leads a group of VILLAGERS at a dead run. LIN QINGQING's father carries a broken broom handle.

LIN ZHIJIANG
(shouting)
Lin Zhiyuan! Stop that bus!

SU HONGYU'S MOTHER sprints ahead, her market basket abandoned.

SU HONGYU'S MOTHER
continuation:
Hongyu! Get down from there!

Lin Zhiyuan SLAMS the bus door shut and bangs on the side.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Driver! Go!

The minibus lurches forward. Through the window, we see the girls' faces pressed against the glass.

Lin Zhiyuan stands in the road, arms spread wide, blocking the pursuing villagers.

LIN ZHIJIANG
Qingqing, if you leave, you're dead to this family!

LIN QINGQING
(from the bus)
Dad, please!

Lin Zhiyuan grabs Lin Zhijiang's arm, pulling him away from the moving bus. The other villagers swarm.

A fist catches Lin Zhiyuan's jaw. He staggers. The broken broom handle swings at his ribs. He goes down in the dust.

Inside the bus, the girls witness this.

JIANG QING
(screaming)
No!

SU HONGYU
Teacher!

Lin Zhiyuan curls on the ground, shielding his head, but his eyes find the bus. He mouths one word: "Go."

The bus accelerates. The villagers' figures shrink in the dust.

LIN QINGQING
(whispering)
He's still down...

INT. MINIBUS - DAY

The bus rattles over potholes. The three young women stand in the aisle, gripping seatbacks for balance. They exchange looks—guilt, terror, determination.

Lin Qingqing fumbles with her envelope. Inside, besides the ticket, there's a folded sketch: a crude drawing of four figures under a tree, childish but recognizable. Their teacher and them, years ago.

Her hands shake.

LIN QINGQING
We never asked what it cost him.

SU HONGYU
We never had to.

Jiang Qing pulls out her own ticket envelope. Inside, a small, pressed wildflower falls out. She catches it.

JIANG QING
We know.

Lin Qingqing looks at the sketch, then toward the rear window where dust still hangs in the air.

LIN QINGQING
Then we know what we have to do.

They don't kneel. They simply stand there, three young women watching their village disappear, their teacher's blood still drying on the road behind them.

FADE OUT.

LIN ZHIYUAN
The soil was tired anyway.

LIN QINGQING
(whispering)
Uncle...

Lin Zhiyuan meets her eyes. A shared understanding passes between them.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Your scholarships cover tuition. This... this just covers distance.

A distant engine. They all turn. A minibus appears, kicking up red dust.

Lin Zhiyuan quickly loads their luggage into the bus hold, his movements urgent but gentle.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Go now. Before your parents finish market.

SU HONGYU
(turning back)
Teacher, they'll know you helped.

LIN ZHIYUAN
(smiling)
I'm just an old teacher. What can they do, make me teach more?

But his smile doesn't reach his eyes.

He herds them toward the open bus door. As they climb in, the sound of ANGRY SHOUTS cuts through the air.

Down the road, LIN ZHIJIANG leads a group of VILLAGERS at a dead run. LIN QINGQING's father carries a broken broom handle.

LIN ZHIJIANG
(shouting)
Lin Zhiyuan! Stop that bus!

SU HONGYU'S MOTHER sprints ahead, her market basket abandoned.

SU HONGYU'S MOTHER
Hongyu! Get down from there!

Lin Zhiyuan SLAMS the bus door shut and bangs on the side.

LIN ZHIYUAN
Driver! Go!

The minibus lurches forward. Through the window, we see the girls' faces pressed against the glass.

Lin Zhiyuan stands in the road, arms spread wide, blocking the pursuing villagers.

LIN ZHIJIANG
Qingqing, if you leave, you're dead to this family!

LIN QINGQING
(from the bus)
Dad, please!

Lin Zhiyuan grabs Lin Zhijiang's arm, pulling him away from the moving bus. The other villagers swarm.

A fist catches Lin Zhiyuan's jaw. He staggers. The broken broom handle swings at his ribs. He goes down in the dust.

Inside the bus, the girls witness this.

JIANG QING
(screaming)
No!

SU HONGYU
Teacher!

Lin Zhiyuan curls on the ground, shielding his head, but his eyes find the bus. He mouths one word: "Go."

The bus accelerates. The villagers' figures shrink in the dust.

LIN QINGQING
(whispering)
He's still down...

INT. MINIBUS - DAY

The bus rattles over potholes. The three young women stand in the aisle, gripping seatbacks for balance. They exchange looks—guilt, terror, determination.

Lin Qingqing fumbles with her envelope. Inside, besides the ticket, there's a folded sketch: a crude drawing of four figures under a tree, childish but recognizable. Their teacher and them, years ago.

Her hands shake.

LIN QINGQING
We never asked what it cost him.

SU HONGYU
We never had to.

Jiang Qing pulls out her own ticket envelope. Inside, a small, pressed wildflower falls out. She catches it.

JIANG QING
We know.

Lin Qingqing looks at the sketch, then toward the rear window where dust still hangs in the air.

LIN QINGQING
Then we know what we have to do.

They don't kneel. They simply stand there, three young women watching their village disappear, their teacher's blood still drying on the road behind them.

FADE OUT.

title: Mr. Gong, Please Behave Yourself
description: A tense confrontation between a man and a woman escalates into a dangerous negotiation.
context:
Title: Mr. Gong, Please Behave Yourself
Description: A tense confrontation between a man and a woman escalates into a dangerous negotiation.

INT. PRIVATE LOUNGE - NIGHT

GONG SHIXIONG corners TANG XUE against the wall. TANG XUE's stance is defensive but measured.

TANG XUE
We had an agreement.

GONG SHIXIONG
I'm revising it.

TANG XUE
My services are specialized. And costly.

GONG SHIXIONG
Cost is relative to satisfaction.

GONG SHIXIONG tries to close the gap. TANG XUE tracks his movement, poised.

GONG SHIXIONG
That defiance will cost you.

TANG XUE
I'm... particular about my clients. Perhaps I should withdraw.

TANG XUE tries to create space, but GONG SHIXIONG blocks her.
continuation:
GONG SHIXIONG
You don't get to bait and switch.

TANG XUE
Let me go!

GONG SHIXIONG
Everyone has their breaking point. Name yours.

TANG XUE
Two million. Verifiable transfer.

GONG SHIXIONG
(chuckling)
Done.

GONG SHIXIONG taps his phone. TANG XUE's hand finds the ashtray.

TANG XUE (V.O.)
Wire transfer initiated. Threat neutralization ready.

She strikes. He drops.

TANG XUE checks his pulse, then photographs the transaction screen.

TANG XUE
Professional consultation concluded. Proceeding to phase two.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Rebirth of the Fat Wife: The Regent's Long Road to Win Her Back
description: A modern surgeon is betrayed by her boyfriend and stepsister, dies in a car accident, and is reborn into the body of an overweight ancient noblewoman who was left for dead.
context:
Title: Rebirth of the Fat Wife: The Regent's Long Road to Win Her Back
Description: A modern surgeon is betrayed by her boyfriend and stepsister, dies in a car accident, and is reborn into the body of an overweight ancient noblewoman who was left for dead.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

XIAO CHURAN and XIA ROU'ER are intimate in the back seat, their clothes disheveled.

XIA ROU'ER (V.O.)
(moaning)
Churan...

EXT. PARKING LOT - NIGHT

A black luxury car is parked in a secluded spot, the vehicle swaying slightly.

XIA NANWEI, wearing a white lab coat and holding her phone out to livestream, walks toward the luxury car with an expressionless face.

XIA NANWEI
(broadcasting)
Third time this month. Same parking lot. Let's see if he notices his location is still shared.

She taps sharply on the tinted window with her keys. Several passersby are drawn over, taking out their phones to record.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

The two people inside are startled by the sound and hastily straighten their clothes.

XIA ROU'ER
(hissing)
Someone's outside!

XIAO CHURAN
Shit.

XIA NANWEI suddenly yanks the car door open.

EXT. PARKING LOT - NIGHT

PASSERBY A
Look at this!

XIAO CHURAN
(shocked)
Nanwei? What are you doing?

XIA NANWEI
(to the phone)
Catching my boyfriend cheating. For the third time.

XIAO CHURAN awkwardly gets out of the car.

XIA ROU'ER
(leaning out)
Sister, please! This isn't—

XIAO CHURAN
(pointing at XIA NANWEI)
If anyone's to blame, it's you for refusing to open your legs!

XIA NANWEI
(furious)
You—

XIA ROU'ER
(getting out, clinging to XIAO CHURAN)
Sister, don't blame him! You drove him away!

XIA NANWEI
(to XIA ROU'ER)
Xia Rou'er. My own stepsister.
continuation:
XIA NANWEI steps forward and slaps XIA ROU'ER hard across the face.

XIA ROU'ER
(covering her face)
Xiao Churan!

XIA NANWEI
(to XIAO CHURAN)
You cheated on me with my family. Have you no shame?

XIAO CHURAN
You're the one who doesn't know what's good for you!

XIAO CHURAN forcefully pushes XIA NANWEI away. XIA NANWEI stumbles backward onto the road.

A car speeds toward her. Tires SCREECH. The impact is brutal and immediate.

XIA NANWEI lies in a pool of blood, barely alive. Her phone lies nearby, stream still live.

XIA NANWEI (V.O.)
(weak)
Every incision I ever made... every life I saved...

Her vision blurs. Phone screen shows scrolling comments: "CALL 911" "SHE'S NOT MOVING"

XIA NANWEI (V.O.)
(fierce)
If I die... everything goes to charity. Not them. Never them.

Her hand goes limp. A pulse of golden light escapes her fingertips and shoots toward the sky.

EXT. MASS GRAVE - NIGHT

A fat woman in ancient costume (ELDEST MISS) lies motionless on the ground.

LU LUO and two SERVANTS surround her.

SECOND MISS'S MAID
(checking her breath)
She's not breathing. She's dead.

SERVANT A
Second Miss said ruin her virtue, not... this.

SERVANT B
She ran. Tripped. The fall—

LU LUO
(quietly)
She's dead. That's what matters.

LU LUO picks up a thick wooden stick, preparing to finish the job.

LU LUO
(whispering)
Forgive me, Eldest Miss. You were just... in the way.

LU LUO raises the stick high. Suddenly, ELDEST MISS'S hand shoots up and grabs it.

ELDEST MISS (XIA NANWEI) gasps, eyes snapping open. Ancient memories flood her mind—insults, betrayal, forced marriage.

XIA NANWEI
(disoriented)
Where am I?

XIA NANWEI (V.O.)
Ancient costume? A different body? I've traveled through time...

She meets LU LUO's terrified gaze and smiles.

XIA NANWEI (V.O.)
Good. Let them be afraid.

title: Brain Hole City (Episode 51)
description: A desperate young man working odd jobs contemplates theft after hearing a viral news quote, only to discover an unexpected connection when caught in the act.
context:
Title: Brain Hole City (Episode 51)
Description: A desperate young man working odd jobs contemplates theft after hearing a viral news quote, only to discover an unexpected connection when caught in the act.

EXT. BUSTLING STREET - NIGHT

XIAO WEI (20s, gaunt, dark circles like bruises) clutches a stack of flyers to his chest as pedestrians flow around him like he's invisible. He extends a flyer to a passing couple—they don't even register his existence. The flyers tremble in his hands.

SOUND: Mournful suona music weaves through traffic noise.

INT. DIM ALLEY - NIGHT

XIAO WEI squats under a flickering streetlamp, murmuring into a worn copy of "New Concept English 2."

XIAO WEI (V.O.)
Lesson 25: Do the English speak English? I arrived at London airport. 'The climate is not very pleasant.' Nobody spoke English. Nobody understood the questions. They understood neither English nor me.

His finger traces the words, knuckles raw and red.

INT. PUBLIC RESTROOM - NIGHT

XIAO WEI kneels on stained tile, gloveless hands scrubbing a urinal with desperate precision. He pauses, staring at his reflection in the porcelain—catches himself baring his teeth in silent rage. They're slightly too sharp.

XIAO WEI (V.O.)
I understood nothing.
continuation:
EXT. STOREFRONT WITH ROLLING SHUTTER - NIGHT

XIAO WEI slumps against cold metal. A phone plays a news clip:

VOICE OVER (News interview recording)
—as for working, working is impossible. It's impossible to work in this lifetime. I don't know how to do business either. Only stealing can maintain my livelihood. They said it themselves, plain as day.

XIAO WEI's jaw tightens. He looks at his trembling hands. Presses them flat against his thighs to stop the shaking.

VOICE OVER (News narrator)
The logic is simple, they explained. Cars are just—

XIAO WEI stands. Something in his eyes switches off. Or on.

EXT. BACK ALLEY - NIGHT

A white electric scooter gleams under a broken streetlight. XIAO WEI approaches with stiff, deliberate steps. He doesn't look around—just pulls out a bent paperclip and goes to work on the lock. The clip snaps. He tries again, his breathing too loud in the quiet.

LAO ZHOU (40s, wiry, cigarette dangling) materializes from the shadows, squinting through smoke.

LAO ZHOU
Heh. Paperclip. That's adorable.

He grabs XIAO WEI's shoulder. XIAO WEI spins, teeth bared—not a threat, an animal reflex. His canines gleam, impossibly long.

LAO ZHOU
What the—

He stumbles back. The cigarette falls. They stare at each other through the dark, recognition hitting like a slap.

LAO ZHOU
(whisper)
Xiao Wei?

XIAO WEI's fangs retract with an audible click. He touches his mouth, horrified.

XIAO WEI
Lao... Zhou?

The frame freezes on XIAO WEI's face—shame and terror and something else. Something hungry.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Emperor's Fall
description: An empress is betrayed and chased to a cliff by rebel forces. She jumps to escape and is rescued by a leisurely fisherman who pulls her from the river.
context:
Title: The Emperor's Fall
Description: An empress is betrayed and chased to a cliff by rebel forces. She jumps to escape and is rescued by a leisurely fisherman who pulls her from the river.

EXT. CLIFF EDGE - DAY

The EMPRESS (30s, imperial grace in torn silk) and two HANDMAIDENS—XIAO CUI (20s, fierce loyalty) and XIAO DIE (20s, steady resolve)—are cornered by FIVE ARMED REBELS at a mist-shrouded cliff edge. Nowhere to run.

REBEL LEADER
No more paths, Your Majesty.

REBEL #2
Never touched imperial silk before.

REBEL LEADER
Take them!

XIAO CUI and XIAO DIE draw hidden daggers, forming a protective wall. Steel clashes. XIAO CUI takes a blade to the shoulder—staggers but holds.

EMPRESS
(urgent whisper)
Stand down. That's an order.

XIAO DIE
We serve beyond death, my lady.

XIAO CUI
Live for us.

Both maidens charge. They fall within heartbeats, bodies crumpling at the cliff edge.

The EMPRESS drops to her knees, fingers trembling over XIAO DIE's still face. Grief hardens to stone.

She rises, backing to the precipice. Her hand clutches an IMPERIAL SEAL necklace.

EMPRESS
(low, lethal)
I remember every face. Every name.

She steps backward into empty air.
continuation:
EXT. RIVERSIDE - DAY

GU FEIBAI (35, scholar's hands in peasant garb) lounges by the river, incongruous sunglasses perched on his face. Two maidens—DA YA (capable) and ER YA (sharp)—stand guard.

DA YA
The council meeting begins at dusk.

GU FEIBAI
Zhang Biao can wait. I'm teaching him patience.

DA YA
You've caught nothing for hours.

GU FEIBAI
Then leaving now would be defeat.

ER YA
We could lie. Say you released them.

GU FEIBAI
Er Ya, your mouth is why you never see court.

DA YA
Master—

The fishing float VANISHES underwater—YANKED violently downstream.

DA YA
Master!

GU FEIBAI heaves back. The line strains, moving WITH the current.

ER YA
That's drifting. Not fighting.

A white-clad figure BREACHES the surface, hook snagged on her robes.

GU FEIBAI
Not a fish. A woman.

He drops the rod, sprints along the bank. The maids follow.

Together they drag the unconscious EMPRESS ashore. Her imperial seal necklace gleams in the sun.

GU FEIBAI's smile vanishes. He goes still, recognition flickering across his face.

DA YA checks her pulse.

DA YA
Alive. Barely.

GU FEIBAI
(quietly)
Of course she is.

He crouches, fingers hovering over the seal. His expression shifts—calculation, then decision.

GU FEIBAI
Da Ya, prepare the carriage. Er Ya, fetch my medicine chest. Silence.

He rolls up his sleeves, posture transforming from lazy fisherman to something deliberate and dangerous.

GU FEIBAI
(to himself)
So it begins again.

His hands move to begin resuscitation, practiced and precise.

title: Supreme Immortal Emperor
description: An Immortal Emperor on the verge of ascension is pulled back by a tribulation of mortal ties, finding himself drawn to a wedding hall where a woman and her daughter face a forced marriage.
context:
Title: Supreme Immortal Emperor
Description: An Immortal Emperor on the verge of ascension is pulled back by a tribulation of mortal ties, finding himself drawn to a wedding hall where a woman and her daughter face a forced marriage.

INT. CHAOTIC UNIVERSE

NARRATOR (V.O.)
When chaos first opened, the universe was established. The light and clear qi rose to become the heavens, the heavy and turbid qi descended to form the earth.

INT. CELESTIAL REALM

The IMMORTAL EMPEROR and numerous IMMORTALS cast spells, forming a massive magical array. Light radiates in all directions, energy surging.

IMMORTAL EMPEROR
Ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation, ten thousand years of cultivation. Today, this final tribulation ends.

A crimson thread of light pierces through the EMPEROR's chest. He clutches his heart, veins of mortal energy spreading across his divine form.

IMMORTAL EMPEROR
(to himself)
A bloodline tribulation? But I severed all mortal ties... unless—

The EMPEROR's eyes flash with recognition. He transforms into a white light and vanishes.
continuation:
INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY

FATHER LIN paces nervously as SUITED MEN hold LIN LING'ER down.

FATHER LIN
Young Master Zhang's motorcade is five minutes out! Put on the dress—now!

LIN LING'ER thrashes against her captors, wedding dress tangled at her feet.

LIN LING'ER
I'd rather die than marry that man!

NANNAN
Mommy!

NANNAN darts forward but Father Lin seizes her arm.

LIN LING'ER
Nannan, run!

NANNAN
(kicking)

Nannan!

Title: Supreme Immortal Emperor
Description: An Immortal Emperor on the verge of ascension is pulled back by a tribulation of mortal ties, finding himself drawn to a wedding hall where a woman and her daughter face a forced marriage.

INT. CHAOTIC UNIVERSE

NARRATOR (V.O.)
When chaos first opened, the universe was established. The light and clear qi rose to become the heavens, the heavy and turbid qi descended to form the earth.

INT. CELESTIAL REALM

The IMMORTAL EMPEROR and numerous IMMORTALS cast spells, forming a massive magical array. Light radiates in all directions, energy surging.

IMMORTAL EMPEROR
Ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation, ten thousand years of cultivation. Today, this final tribulation ends.

A crimson thread of light pierces through the EMPEROR's chest. He clutches his heart, veins of mortal energy spreading across his divine form.

IMMORTAL EMPEROR
(to himself)
A bloodline tribulation? But I severed all mortal ties... unless—

The EMPEROR's eyes flash with recognition. He transforms into a white light and vanishes.

INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY

FATHER LIN paces nervously as SUITED MEN hold LIN LING'ER down.

FATHER LIN
Young Master Zhang's motorcade is five minutes out! Put on the dress—now!

LIN LING'ER thrashes against her captors, wedding dress tangled at her feet.

LIN LING'ER
I'd rather die than marry that man!

NANNAN
Mommy!

NANNAN darts forward but Father Lin seizes her arm.

LIN LING'ER
Nannan, run!

(kicking)

title: A Parent's Deep Love
description: A new mother faces conflict with her traditional mother-in-law over modern childcare practices while her husband fails to support her.
context:
Title: A Parent's Deep Love
Description: A new mother faces conflict with her traditional mother-in-law over modern childcare practices while her husband fails to support her.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

SHI QING (30s, exhausted but dignified) clutches her pregnant belly, breathing through a contraction. Sweat beads her forehead. She reaches for the call button.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

NURSES wheel SHI QING on a gurney toward the operating room. XU CHEN (30s, harried) jogs alongside, phone buzzing insistently in his pocket.

SHI QING
(between breaths)
Stay with me. Please.

XU CHEN
I'm right here. I'm not going anywhere.

As they reach the operating room doors, his phone rings again. He glances at it—"MOM" flashes on screen. He shuts it off.

The doors swing shut between them.

INT. OUTSIDE OPERATING ROOM - DAY

The "Surgery in Progress" light glows. XU CHEN slumps against the wall, ignoring his vibrating phone. He stares at the ceiling.

XU CHEN
(quietly)
Just let them both be okay. That's all.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

SHI QING gasps through the final pushes. The baby's cry cuts through the tension. She collapses back, tears streaming down.

NURSE
It's a boy, Dr. Shi. He's perfect.

SHI QING
(whispering)
Let me see him.

They place the baby on her chest. She closes her eyes, breathing him in.
continuation:
EXT. HOSPITAL - DAY - MONTAGE

- Sunlight moves across the building facade
- A NEWBORN FIST clenches around a finger
- SHI QING sleeps sitting up, still in her hospital gown, baby on her chest

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

SHI QING cradles her son. DR. YU BIN (40s, kind) checks her chart.

YU BIN
You're healing well. But listen to your own advice—rest during confinement. No hospital calls.

SHI QING
(smiling)
You're ordering a doctor to take her own medicine?

YU BIN
Absolutely. When you're back, we'll celebrate properly.

He leaves. At the doorway, CHEN CAIMEI (60s, energetic) bustles in with XU CHEN, who carries a basket of eggs. CHEN CAIMEI's face transforms when she sees the baby.

CHEN CAIMEI
(softening)
Oh... he's so small.

She reaches for him but pauses, hands hovering.

SHI QING
You can hold him, Mom. Just wash your hands first.

CHEN CAIMEI
Right, right. Modern ways.

She dutifully uses the sanitizer by the bed, then takes the baby with surprising gentleness.

CHEN CAIMEI
But look at him. So thin. Are you sure he's eating enough?

SHI QING
It's normal weight loss. Breast milk is all he needs right now.

CHEN CAIMEI
In my day, we supplemented. A little egg yolk—

SHI QING
(firm but kind)
Mom, I'm a pediatrician. I see allergic reactions from that. We wait until six months.

CHEN CAIMEI's face hardens. She looks to her son.

CHEN CAIMEI
Xu Chen, go start the discharge papers. Save some money.

XU CHEN
Mom, the doctor said she needs rest—

CHEN CAIMEI
She IS a doctor. She can rest at home. And I can help.

SHI QING studies her husband's conflicted face. She straightens, despite the pain.

SHI QING
Xu Chen. I need three more days here. For monitoring.

XU CHEN
Honey, Mom came all this way...

SHI QING
Then let her stay in the guest room. But my medical decision stands.

She locks eyes with CHEN CAIMEI.

SHI QING (V.O.)
I am his mother. And I am a doctor. Both truths matter.

CHEN CAIMEI clutches the baby tighter. XU CHEN looks between the two women, realizing the battlefield has just been drawn.

CHEN CAIMEI
(quietly, to the baby)
Don't worry, little one. Grandma knows best.

SHI QING doesn't look away.

SHI QING
(quietly)
We'll see about that.

The baby coos between them, oblivious to the war being waged in whispers.

title: A Good Match Is Never Too Late
description: A mother is given a second chance when she's reborn to the moment before her son's destructive choices tear their family apart.
context:
Title: A Good Match Is Never Too Late
Description: A mother is given a second chance when she's reborn to the moment before her son's destructive choices tear their family apart.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

XIAO HUI sits on the sofa, clutching a worn bankbook.

XIAO HUI (V.O.)
Please. Let this be enough.

FLASHBACK: JIANG NAN slumped over the kitchen table, empty bottles around him.

JIANG NAN stumbles through the front door, reeking of alcohol.

JIANG NAN
(pointing at Xiao Hui)
That wedding should've been mine.

XIAO HUI sees him and quickly stands up.

XIAO HUI
I'll get you some water.

JIANG NAN rushes forward and grabs Xiao Hui's arm, his face twisted with rage.

JIANG NAN
You made sure it wasn't.

XIAO HUI
(panicked)
Jiang Nan, you're drunk--

JIANG NAN
Xu Wanru. Remember her? Or don't you read the gossip pages?

FLASHBACK: XU WANRU in a wedding gown, laughing with her GROOM.

JIANG NAN
(agitated)
She would've had my kid. The Xu empire would've been mine.

JIANG NAN collapses onto the sofa, exhausted. A bottle falls to the floor.

JIANG NAN
(crying out)
Twenty years... you owe me twenty years!

XIAO HUI sits down beside him and gently touches his hand.

XIAO HUI
You think Miss Xu loved you? Or just the idea of a husband her father couldn't control?

JIANG NAN
(lying on the sofa, drunk)
What's wrong with being a live-in son-in-law? Being a Xu dog beats being a Jiang son.

JIANG NAN suddenly pushes XIAO HUI away. She falls to the floor.

XIAO HUI
(heartbroken)
I sold my wedding ring for your first debt. Canceled my surgery for your phone. And you think I kept you from paradise?

JIANG NAN
Mom... you're my mother. You chose to have me. That means you owe me everything.

JIANG NAN's gaze drops to the bankbook in her hand. His eyes light up and he reaches to grab it.

JIANG NAN
What's that?

XIAO HUI
Let go!

They struggle over the bankbook. JIANG NAN pushes XIAO HUI down.

JIANG NAN opens the bankbook and sees the amount.

JIANG NAN
(delighted)
One hundred thousand... hoarding it from your own son?

XIAO HUI gets up and grabs his arm.

XIAO HUI
It was for your debts! To save you!

JIANG NAN's gaze falls on the jade bracelet on XIAO HUI's wrist.

JIANG NAN
And that bracelet. The apartment. Everything.

XIAO HUI
(crying out)
Your father gave me this!

JIANG NAN
(sneering)
So that's it. You're collecting for your new family.

XIAO HUI
(in disbelief)
Jiang Shan raised you like his own--

JIANG NAN
Give it to me!

XIAO HUI
Let go!

JIANG NAN yanks hard. XIAO HUI is violently pushed away, her head hitting the corner of the sofa. She falls to the ground, motionless. JIANG NAN grabs the items and runs out without looking back.
continuation:
INT. APARTMENT HALLWAY - NIGHT

JIANG NAN rushes out and collides with a well-dressed man, JIANG SHAN.

JIANG SHAN
Jiang Nan?

JIANG NAN
(roaring)
Get out of my way!

JIANG NAN pushes JIANG SHAN aside and runs off. JIANG SHAN frowns, sensing something is wrong, and hurries into the apartment.

INT. APARTMENT - NIGHT

JIANG SHAN rushes inside and sees XIAO HUI lying in a pool of blood.

JIANG SHAN
(horrified)
Xiao Hui!

JIANG SHAN kneels down and holds XIAO HUI in his arms.

JIANG SHAN
Xiao Hui!

XIAO HUI
(barely breathing)
The bracelet... it's yours.

JIANG SHAN
(choking up)
Stay with me. We'll fix everything.

XIAO HUI
(using her last bit of strength)
Next time... I won't choose wrong.

XIAO HUI's hand falls limp, losing all signs of life.

JIANG SHAN
(devastated)
Xiao Hui! Xiao Hui, don't leave me! Xiao Hui!

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

XIAO HUI's eyes snap open. She finds herself lying in bed, completely unharmed. She sits up in shock, looking around.

JIANG NAN (O.S.)
Mom! This is the last time I'm calling you that! If you don't agree to let me be with Wan Ru, I'm cutting ties with you!

XIAO HUI hears her son's voice, her eyes filled with shock and disbelief.

XIAO HUI
(internal monologue)
I... I've been reborn.

title: Flowers Bloom in an Empty Hall
description: Qin Sang is brought back to the Prime Minister's Manor on the day Qin Yao dies. For three years, Qin Yao's death anniversary becomes Qin Sang's day of suffering.
context:
Title: Flowers Bloom in an Empty Hall
Description: Qin Sang is brought back to the Prime Minister's Manor on the day Qin Yao dies. For three years, Qin Yao's death anniversary becomes Qin Sang's day of suffering.

EXT. PRIME MINISTER'S MANOR - NIGHT

Snowflakes fall. QIN SANG dances with a red staff in the snow, her movements weakening. Blood stains the snow.

QIN SANG (V.O.)
The day I was brought back to the Prime Minister's Manor, Qin Yao died. For the next three years, her death anniversary became my day of suffering.

INT. BUDDHIST HALL - DAY

MADAM QIN kneels before the Buddha statue, praying. A SNAKE strikes her wrist. She collapses.

QIN SANG, wearing a pink dress, enters with offering incense. She rushes to MADAM QIN.

QIN SANG
(anxiously)
Madam! Madam!

QIN SANG kneels down to check and discovers bite marks on MADAM QIN's wrist.

QIN SANG
It's snake venom! I must remove it.

QIN SANG tears a strip from her own sleeve, binding it tightly above the wound. She uses her mouth to suck the wound, spitting black blood on the ground. After repeating this, QIN SANG's face turns pale and she collapses, poisoned.

QIN YAO walks in. She sees the scene and her eyes widen.

QIN YAO
(coldly)
The snake I released... bit Mother instead?

MADAM QIN slowly regains consciousness.

MADAM QIN
(weakly)
Ah Yao...

QIN YAO immediately changes her expression and steps forward to support MADAM QIN.

QIN YAO
(with concern)
Mother, are you alright?

MADAM QIN
Did you remove the snake venom?

QIN YAO
(without hesitation)
Yes, I removed it for you. Let's leave quickly.

MADAM QIN sees QIN SANG unconscious on the ground.

MADAM QIN
Who is she?

QIN YAO
A beggar who snuck in. Don't worry about her, let's go.

MADAM QIN struggles to stand up and notices the heart-shaped birthmark on QIN SANG's neck. She is shocked.

MADAM QIN
This birthmark... she is my biological daughter!

QIN YAO's expression changes.

QIN YAO (V.O.)
My own trap has caught me instead. Don't blame me for eliminating you completely.
continuation:
INT. ROOM - DAY

QIN SANG lies on the bed, still unconscious. MADAM QIN sits by the bedside, her face full of affection.

MADAM QIN
My daughter, you've finally woken up. This is wonderful.

QIN SANG slowly opens her eyes.

QIN SANG
(confused)
Daughter?

MADAM QIN
Heaven has shown mercy. I was bitten by a venomous snake, but fortunately Ah Yao removed the poison for me, and I found you. I'm so happy.

QIN SANG
(excited)
The one who removed the snake venom for you was clearly me, how could it be her?

QIN YAO stands to the side, feigning grievance.

QIN YAO
What?

MADAM QIN
(puzzled)
What is going on here?

QIN YAO
(crying)
Sister just returned and already wants to compete for favor and steal credit from me? It seems this manor can no longer accommodate me, this imposter. I might as well die!

MADAM QIN
(hastily)
Wait, Ah Yao!

QIN SANG tries to get up to explain, but her body is powerless.

QIN SANG
No, I must make things clear to them.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

QIN SANG chases after them and kneels on the ground.

QIN SANG
Mother, I'm not lying. It was truly me who saved you!

MADAM QIN turns around and angrily slaps QIN SANG.

MADAM QIN
Don't call me mother! If it weren't for you, Ah Yao wouldn't have died!

QIN SANG
(shocked)
What? Qin Yao is dead?

QIN YU steps forward and throws a blood letter in front of QIN SANG.

QIN YU
It's all because of you that Ah Yao drowned herself in the lake! I'll kill you right now!

QIN YU draws his sword and thrusts it at QIN SANG.

PRIME MINISTER QIN
Stop!

PRIME MINISTER QIN walks over.

PRIME MINISTER QIN
Ah Yao is already dead, and the marriage arrangement with Pei Heng still needs her to substitute. She cannot die.

MADAM QIN
(crying)
As soon as you returned, you stole Ah Yao's credit and caused her death. Now her body is barely cold and you want to steal her fiancé. How can you be so vicious!

QIN YU
Don't think marrying Pei Heng will bring you good days. I won't let you off!

QIN YU strikes QIN SANG with the sword hilt. QIN SANG coughs blood and falls to the ground.

QIN SANG (V.O.)
When Qin Yao was alive, she stole everything from me. After her death, I became the one blamed for killing her.

EXT. SNOWY GROUND - NIGHT

QIN SANG lies in the snow, recalling the scene from three years ago.

QIN SANG (V.O.)
Three years. Not a single person remembers that today is my birthday. Or perhaps, it's my death day.

INT. BUDDHIST HALL - FLASHBACK

QIN SANG lies on the ground. The Buddha statue emits golden light.

BUDDHA (V.O.)
You were poisoned by snake venom while saving someone. Your death is near. This True Heart Spell can temporarily delay the poison. Three years from today, if you receive a sincere blessing from a loved one, the death sentence can be lifted.

EXT. SNOWY GROUND - NIGHT

The snow falls heavier. QIN SANG lies on the ground, her breath weakening.

VOICE (O.S.)
Close the gates at noon!

QIN SANG
(weakly)
The hour of midnight is approaching. There's no time left.

QIN SANG crawls with difficulty through the snow and finally collapses, unconscious. In the distance, QIN YU, MADAM QIN, and others run toward her with panicked expressions.

QIN SANG
(whisper)
Save me, save me.

QIN SANG's hand drops limply.

QIN YAO immediately changes her expression and steps forward to support MADAM QIN.

QIN YAO
(with concern)
Mother, are you alright?

MADAM QIN
Did you remove the snake venom?

QIN YAO
(without hesitation)
Yes, I removed it for you. Let's leave quickly.

MADAM QIN sees QIN SANG unconscious on the ground.

MADAM QIN
Who is she?

QIN YAO
A beggar who snuck in. Don't worry about her, let's go.

MADAM QIN struggles to stand up and notices the heart-shaped birthmark on QIN SANG's neck. She is shocked.

MADAM QIN
This birthmark... she is my biological daughter!

QIN YAO's expression changes.

QIN YAO (V.O.)
My own trap has caught me instead. Don't blame me for eliminating you completely.

INT. ROOM - DAY

QIN SANG lies on the bed, still unconscious. MADAM QIN sits by the bedside, her face full of affection.

MADAM QIN
My daughter, you've finally woken up. This is wonderful.

QIN SANG slowly opens her eyes.

QIN SANG
(confused)
Daughter?

MADAM QIN
Heaven has shown mercy. I was bitten by a venomous snake, but fortunately Ah Yao removed the poison for me, and I found you. I'm so happy.

QIN SANG
(excited)
The one who removed the snake venom for you was clearly me, how could it be her?

QIN YAO stands to the side, feigning grievance.

QIN YAO
What?

MADAM QIN
(puzzled)
What is going on here?

QIN YAO
(crying)
Sister just returned and already wants to compete for favor and steal credit from me? It seems this manor can no longer accommodate me, this imposter. I might as well die!

MADAM QIN
(hastily)
Wait, Ah Yao!

QIN SANG tries to get up to explain, but her body is powerless.

QIN SANG
No, I must make things clear to them.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

QIN SANG chases after them and kneels on the ground.

QIN SANG
Mother, I'm not lying. It was truly me who saved you!

MADAM QIN turns around and angrily slaps QIN SANG.

MADAM QIN
Don't call me mother! If it weren't for you, Ah Yao wouldn't have died!

QIN SANG
(shocked)
What? Qin Yao is dead?

QIN YU steps forward and throws a blood letter in front of QIN SANG.

QIN YU
It's all because of you that Ah Yao drowned herself in the lake! I'll kill you right now!

QIN YU draws his sword and thrusts it at QIN SANG.

PRIME MINISTER QIN
Stop!

PRIME MINISTER QIN walks over.

PRIME MINISTER QIN
Ah Yao is already dead, and the marriage arrangement with Pei Heng still needs her to substitute. She cannot die.

MADAM QIN
(crying)
As soon as you returned, you stole Ah Yao's credit and caused her death. Now her body is barely cold and you want to steal her fiancé. How can you be so vicious!

QIN YU
Don't think marrying Pei Heng will bring you good days. I won't let you off!

QIN YU strikes QIN SANG with the sword hilt. QIN SANG coughs blood and falls to the ground.

QIN SANG (V.O.)
When Qin Yao was alive, she stole everything from me. After her death, I became the one blamed for killing her.

EXT. SNOWY GROUND - NIGHT

QIN SANG lies in the snow, recalling the scene from three years ago.

QIN SANG (V.O.)
Three years. Not a single person remembers that today is my birthday. Or perhaps, it's my death day.

INT. BUDDHIST HALL - FLASHBACK

QIN SANG lies on the ground. The Buddha statue emits golden light.

BUDDHA (V.O.)
You were poisoned by snake venom while saving someone. Your death is near. This True Heart Spell can temporarily delay the poison. Three years from today, if you receive a sincere blessing from a loved one, the death sentence can be lifted.

EXT. SNOWY GROUND - NIGHT

The snow falls heavier. QIN SANG lies on the ground, her breath weakening.

VOICE (O.S.)
Close the gates at noon!

QIN SANG
(weakly)
The hour of midnight is approaching. There's no time left.

QIN SANG crawls with difficulty through the snow and finally collapses, unconscious. In the distance, QIN YU, MADAM QIN, and others run toward her with panicked expressions.

QIN SANG
(whisper)
Save me, save me.

QIN SANG's hand drops limply.

title: Youth Must Not Be Wasted
description: A mother struggles to support her son's education after he is accepted into a prestigious university, only to face unexpected challenges from her community.
context:
Title: Youth Must Not Be Wasted
Description: A mother struggles to support her son's education after he is accepted into a prestigious university, only to face unexpected challenges from her community.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY

ZHANG YUMEI, a woman with graying hair, sits weaving bamboo baskets. She coughs into her sleeve, trying to muffle the sound.

XIAO SHENG (O.S.)
Mom! Mom!

XIAO SHENG runs into the courtyard, breathless, clutching an envelope.

XIAO SHENG
Tsinghua! The physics department!

ZHANG YUMEI takes the letter, tears streaming down her face.

ZHANG YUMEI
Your father would be so proud.

She tries to stand, but wobbles. XIAO SHENG steadies her.

XIAO SHENG
You're pale.

ZHANG YUMEI
(waving her hand)
Just tired. I must finish these. For your tuition.

She sees his worry and softens.

ZHANG YUMEI
How much is it?

XIAO SHENG watches her face as she unfolds the fee schedule.

CLOSE-UP: The letter reads "Tuition & Housing: 8,500 yuan/semester."
continuation:
ZHANG YUMEI
(shocked)
Eight thousand...?

ZHANG YUMEI's face changes, showing great anxiety.

ZHANG YUMEI
(talking to herself, anxiously)
Only two thousand in the box... Short by so much...

She furrows her brow, then remembers.

ZHANG YUMEI
That's right. The committee owes me. For the festival baskets. I'll collect today.

She turns toward the house just as VILLAGE CHIEF and his WIFE walk in.

VILLAGE CHIEF
(smiling)
Yumei! Good news travels fast.

VILLAGE CHIEF
We heard about Tsinghua. My nephew also got into Jiangbei University. We're holding a joint graduation banquet. How much will your family donate to celebrate?

ZHANG YUMEI freezes, the letter feeling heavy in her hands.

ZHANG YUMEI
(stunned)
Donate?

VILLAGE CHIEF'S WIFE
Everyone contributes what they can. But we will announce all the families who support our village scholars.

ZHANG YUMEI looks at her son, then at the chief. Her face shows a mixture of pride and panic.

ZHANG YUMEI
For the community. Of course.

title: Mr. Ye, You Flash-Married the Heir to the Richest Fortune
description: A wealthy heir gives up his fortune to prove his girlfriend's love is genuine, only to be betrayed six years later when he lives as a delivery worker.
context:
Title: Mr. Ye, You Flash-Married the Heir to the Richest Fortune
Description: A wealthy heir gives up his fortune to prove his girlfriend's love is genuine, only to be betrayed six years later when he lives as a delivery worker.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

The Ye Family Consortium tower dominates the skyline. YE TIAN stands in a beige suit, posture straight. GREAT-GRANDFATHER YE holds a document between two fingers.

GREAT-GRANDFATHER YE
She's already consulting divorce lawyers. Before the wedding. That's your "true love."

YE TIAN
Grandfather. Let me prove what she values.

GREAT-GRANDFATHER YE
Prove it? Renounce everything. Six years. Not one yuan of family money.

YE TIAN
I'll sign.

Ye Tian places a divestiture agreement and his black titanium card on the desk.

YE TIAN
For her.

Great-Grandfather Ye sweeps them to the floor.

GREAT-GRANDFATHER YE
Don't shame this family by crawling back.

Ye Tian bows deeply and exits. LAWYER ZHANG enters, seeing the scattered papers.

LAWYER ZHANG
Elder Ye, the board will not accept this.

GREAT-GRANDFATHER YE
They'll wait. A man must learn what he's defending.

Great-Grandfather Ye coughs violently into a silk handkerchief. A small red stain spreads.
continuation:
EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

ON SCREEN: Six Years Later

Rain-darkened pavement. YE TIAN, in a worn delivery vest, kneels with a modest ring box.

YE TIAN
Jingjing. Marry me.

JIANG JINGJING opens the box. A simple silver ring.

JIANG JINGJING
With this? Tian, I have debts, a job offer in Singapore. I'm done waiting.

She drops the box. The ring clatters on concrete.

YE TIAN
I gave you every paycheck—

JIANG JINGJING
You gave me dreams! While I worked double shifts, borrowed money—

A red Ferrari stops. YOUNG MASTER ZHANG emerges with an umbrella.

YOUNG MASTER ZHANG
Jingjing. The car's waiting.

JIANG JINGJING
(to Ye Tian)
He paid Mom's surgery bills. Got me a visa. What can you offer?

YE TIAN
I gave up the Ye family fortune. Trillions.

JIANG JINGJING
(laughs bitterly)
And I gave up my twenties. We're even.

YOUNG MASTER ZHANG
Last year she sold her car for your hospital bills. You never asked where the money came from.

JIANG JINGJING
My biggest regret? Believing love was enough.

YE TIAN
You'll regret this.

JIANG JINGJING
No. I'll forget you.

Ye Tian punches Young Master Zhang. They fall into a puddle.

JIANG JINGJING
(screams)
Zhang!

YE TIAN
(into phone)
Grandfather. I'm coming home.

title: Parents' Long-Awaited Happiness
description: A wealthy man returns after twenty years to fulfill his promise to his wife, but their son opposes the reunion, fearing the loss of a bigger fortune.
context:
Title: Parents' Long-Awaited Happiness
Description: A wealthy man returns after twenty years to fulfill his promise to his wife, but their son opposes the reunion, fearing the loss of a bigger fortune.

INT. COUNTRY ROAD - NIGHT

WANG QIUMING, dressed in a white suit, walks slowly down a country road surrounded by a group of BODYGUARDS in black. His expression is solemn and thoughtful.

WANG QIUMING (V.O.)
Life's greatest regret is when you can finally afford the diamond ring, the person who was willing to marry you in the rain is already gone.

INT. COUNTRY ROAD - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Heavy rain pours down. Young WANG QIUMING, wearing a soaked suit, pushes a tricycle. Young LIN QIUXIA, wearing a white dress, happily helps him push the cart. They laugh together in the rain.

LIN QIUXIA
(laughing)
A groom in a suit pushing a tricycle—you're the only one in the world I recognize!

WANG QIUMING
(shouting loudly)
When I buy the warehouse at the east end of the village, I'll sew you a wedding dress made of gold and silver thread!

LIN QIUXIA
Okay!

END FLASHBACK.

WANG QIUMING stands in place, looking at the tricycle before him, lost in memories.

WANG QIUMING
Back then I vowed to make something of myself, to give you a grand wedding. But when I returned to this homeland, a flood had submerged my hometown, tearing my family apart.

WANG QIUMING's eyes redden with emotion.

WANG QIUMING
(choking up)
Qiuxia, where are you?

Assistant WANG HUI rushes down from the car.

WANG HUI
Chairman! We found her! Chairman, I found your wife! Number 37 Wutong Alley.

WANG QIUMING
(urgently)
Are you certain it's her?

WANG HUI
Your wife has been going to the dock every day waiting for your return. She's been waiting for twenty years.

WANG QIUMING
(excitedly)
Prepare ninety-nine dragon and phoenix chests, plus a betrothal gift of one billion yuan, and deliver them to her tonight!

WANG HUI
Sir, the board—should we confirm the identity first?

WANG QIUMING
(firmly)
I know my Qiuxia. Tonight, we make this right.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

ZHOU LING runs excitedly into the office. XIAO CHEN is working at his desk, rubbing his temples.

ZHOU LING
Honey! The chairman's assistant called—they found your mother a husband!

XIAO CHEN
(looking up, wary)
What are you talking about?

ZHOU LING
(slaps a red envelope on the desk)
Longteng Group. One billion yuan betrothal. They're sending the chests tomorrow.

XIAO CHEN
(stunned, opening the envelope)
This can't be real. Mom never said—

ZHOU LING
She wanted to surprise you! And think—no children, that whole empire... 

XIAO CHEN
(quietly)
Mom waited twenty years. This isn't about money.

ZHOU LING
(leaning close)
Isn't it? You've been paying her rent. Now she can finally help you. This is your inheritance, Xiao Chen. Yours.

XIAO CHEN stares at the document, conflicted.

XIAO CHEN
I need to hear her say it.

He picks up his phone.

INT. LIN QIUXIA'S HOUSE - DAY

LIN QIUXIA is cleaning the house. Her phone on the table rings. She walks over and answers it.

LIN QIUXIA
(gently)
Hello?

XIAO CHEN (O.S.)
Mom. The lawyer's papers... is it true?

LIN QIUXIA
(a smile in her voice)
Yes. Your father came back. We're having the ceremony Saturday. Will you come?

INT. OFFICE - DAY

XIAO CHEN's face darkens. He looks at the betrothal amount, then at his wife's expectant face.

XIAO CHEN
(strained)
Mom, you don't know this man anymore. Twenty years...

LIN QIUXIA (O.S.)
He's the man who promised me a wedding dress of gold thread.

XIAO CHEN
(clenching the phone)
Mom, please—just delay the ceremony. A week. Let me check—protect you.

INT. LIN QIUXIA'S HOUSE - DAY

LIN QIUXIA's smile fades. She understands now.

LIN QIUXIA
(quietly)
You're afraid he'll take what you think is yours.

She hangs up the phone, standing still, the weight of twenty years settling on her shoulders.

title: The Bitter Stepmother Awakens and Goes Wild
description: A renowned actress known for tragic roles collapses at an awards ceremony and awakens in an ancient world, inhabiting the body of a mistreated daughter who was just murdered.
context:
Title: The Bitter Stepmother Awakens and Goes Wild
Description: A renowned actress known for tragic roles collapses at an awards ceremony and awakens in an ancient world, inhabiting the body of a mistreated daughter who was just murdered.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY RED CARPET - NIGHT

The SOUND of camera shutters click like machine gun fire. Fans SCREAM from behind velvet ropes.

RUAN QINGXUAN, mid-30s, glides down the red carpet in a sapphire gown that catches every flash. She clutches two golden trophies, her face a mask of practiced serenity. BODYGUARDS flank her, creating a bubble of space.

HOST (V.O.)
This just in—Ruan Qingxuan sweeps Best Actress and the prestigious Tearjerker Award for her devastating performance in "The Abandoned Wife."

Reporters surge forward, microphones stabbing the air like spears.

YOUNG REPORTER
Miss Ruan! Your thoughts on the double win?

Ruan stops. Turns. The cameras love her, but her eyes hold something else—exhaustion flickering beneath the perfection.

RUAN QINGXUAN
I'm grateful. Truly. But after twelve years of playing victims, I have to ask—why does everyone see tragedy when they look at me? I can be more. I want to be more.

She holds up the trophies.

RUAN QINGXUAN (CONT'D)
So this is my last time holding these. No more tears. No more suffering. I'm done.

The reporters explode with questions. Ruan takes one step, then—

Her face drains of color. She grips her head, a look of pure terror crossing her features.

RUAN QINGXUAN
No—not again—

She collapses. The trophies CLATTER on marble. Her head smacks the red carpet.

CHAOS erupts. Bodyguards rush in. Reporters press closer.

YOUNG REPORTER
Someone call a doctor! Miss Ruan! Miss Ruan!
continuation:
INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

Silence. Thick incense chokes the air.

Ruan Qingxuan lies on a wooden funeral bed, drapin white burial silks. Her eyes snap open.

MEMORIES slam into her—fragmented, violent, not her own:
- A newborn's cry, a father's disappointed scowl
- Small hands scrubbing clothes in freezing water
- A shove from behind, the shock of icy water filling lungs
- A scroll being read: "By imperial decree..."
- Ruan Yuyao's sneering face: "You'll never be more than a concubine's daughter..."

Ruan's chest heaves. She focuses on a figure across the room.

NINGSHUANG, a teenage maid, kneels before RUAN YUYAO, early 20s, who wears silk robes that scream privilege.

RUAN YUYAO
You dare accuse me? Your precious Second Miss slipped and fell. Her own clumsiness killed her.

NINGSHUANG
I saw you push her! For that marriage decree—you wanted—

Ruan Yuyao's fan snaps shut.

RUAN YUYAO
Guards.

Two burly MAIDS seize Ningshuang, forcing her to her knees.

NINGSHUANG
(struggling)
What are you—

RUAN YUYAO
Since you're so devoted, go serve her in hell.

Ningshuang's eyes lock onto Ruan's body, tears streaming.

NINGSHUANG
Second Miss! I'll find you in the next life!

Ruan Yuyao raises a heavy wooden club, her face a mask of genteel cruelty.

RUAN YUYAO
Such touching loyalty. Let's make it quick.

Ruan Yuyao swings—

Ruan Qingxuan sits bolt upright, the silk shroud sliding off.

RUAN QINGXUAN
Seriously? Can't a corpse get some fucking sleep around here?

The club freezes mid-air. Ningshuang's mouth falls open. A tiny vase drops from someone's hand, SHATTERING.

RUAN YUYAO
(whispered horror)
A... a jiangshi...

RUAN QINGXUAN
Jiang—what?

Ruan's head whips around. Her gaze lands on the memorial tablet: "Spirit Tablet of Deceased Daughter—RUAN QINGXUAN."

The name hits her like a second blow. The memories crystallize.

RUAN QINGXUAN
(softly, to herself)
Oh no. I've become... her.

Ningshuang scrambles free, crawling to clutch Ruan's hand.

NINGSHUANG
Second Miss! Your heart still beats! Thank the heavens—

Ruan stares at their joined hands. The girl's joy is so raw, so real. A stranger's devotion, now hers to bear.

RUAN QINGXUAN
(quiet, modern steel in her voice)
Alright then. Let's see what kind of tragedy this script really is.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY RED CARPET - NIGHT

The SOUND of camera shutters click like machine gun fire. Fans SCREAM from behind velvet ropes.

RUAN QINGXUAN, mid-30s, glides down the red carpet in a sapphire gown that catches every flash. She clutches two golden trophies, her face a mask of practiced serenity. BODYGUARDS flank her, creating a bubble of space.

HOST (V.O.)
This just in—Ruan Qingxuan sweeps Best Actress and the prestigious Tearjerker Award for her devastating performance in "The Abandoned Wife."

Reporters surge forward, microphones stabbing the air like spears.

YOUNG REPORTER
Miss Ruan! Your thoughts on the double win?

Ruan stops. Turns. The cameras love her, but her eyes hold something else—exhaustion flickering beneath the perfection.

RUAN QINGXUAN
I'm grateful. Truly. But after twelve years of playing victims, I have to ask—why does everyone see tragedy when they look at me? I can be more. I want to be more.

She holds up the trophies.

RUAN QINGXUAN (CONT'D)
So this is my last time holding these. No more tears. No more suffering. I'm done.

The reporters explode with questions. Ruan takes one step, then—

Her face drains of color. She grips her head, a look of pure terror crossing her features.

RUAN QINGXUAN
No—not again—

She collapses. The trophies CLATTER on marble. Her head smacks the red carpet.

CHAOS erupts. Bodyguards rush in. Reporters press closer.

YOUNG REPORTER
Someone call a doctor! Miss Ruan! Miss Ruan!

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

Silence. Thick incense chokes the air.

Ruan Qingxuan lies on a wooden funeral bed, drapin white burial silks. Her eyes snap open.

MEMORIES slam into her—fragmented, violent, not her own:
- A newborn's cry, a father's disappointed scowl
- Small hands scrubbing clothes in freezing water
- A shove from behind, the shock of icy water filling lungs
- A scroll being read: "By imperial decree..."
- Ruan Yuyao's sneering face: "You'll never be more than a concubine's daughter..."

Ruan's chest heaves. She focuses on a figure across the room.

NINGSHUANG, a teenage maid, kneels before RUAN YUYAO, early 20s, who wears silk robes that scream privilege.

RUAN YUYAO
You dare accuse me? Your precious Second Miss slipped and fell. Her own clumsiness killed her.

NINGSHUANG
I saw you push her! For that marriage decree—you wanted—

Ruan Yuyao's fan snaps shut.

RUAN YUYAO
Guards.

Two burly MAIDS seize Ningshuang, forcing her to her knees.

NINGSHUANG
(struggling)
What are you—

RUAN YUYAO
Since you're so devoted, go serve her in hell.

Ningshuang's eyes lock onto Ruan's body, tears streaming.

NINGSHUANG
Second Miss! I'll find you in the next life!

Ruan Yuyao raises a heavy wooden club, her face a mask of genteel cruelty.

RUAN YUYAO
Such touching loyalty. Let's make it quick.

Ruan Yuyao swings—

Ruan Qingxuan sits bolt upright, the silk shroud sliding off.

RUAN QINGXUAN
Seriously? Can't a corpse get some fucking sleep around here?

The club freezes mid-air. Ningshuang's mouth falls open. A tiny vase drops from someone's hand, SHATTERING.

RUAN YUYAO
(whispered horror)
A... a jiangshi...

RUAN QINGXUAN
Jiang—what?

Ruan's head whips around. Her gaze lands on the memorial tablet: "Spirit Tablet of Deceased Daughter—RUAN QINGXUAN."

The name hits her like a second blow. The memories crystallize.

RUAN QINGXUAN
(softly, to herself)
Oh no. I've become... her.

Ningshuang scrambles free, crawling to clutch Ruan's hand.

NINGSHUANG
Second Miss! Your heart still beats! Thank the heavens—

Ruan stares at their joined hands. The girl's joy is so raw, so real. A stranger's devotion, now hers to bear.

RUAN QINGXUAN
(quiet, modern steel in her voice)
Alright then. Let's see what kind of tragedy this script really is.

title: The Gatekeeper
description: A veteran school security guard's final week becomes his most dangerous when a desperate fugitive threatens the children.
context:
Title: The Gatekeeper
Description: A veteran school security guard's final week becomes his most dangerous when a desperate fugitive threatens the children.

INT. SECURITY ROOM - DAY

A TV news broadcast is reporting a wanted notice.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Police are searching for a dangerous fugitive in Wuyun City. The suspect is believed to be armed and authorities warn he may target schools. All security teams are on high alert.

Security guard UNCLE LI (60s, rubbing his knee) and his COLLEAGUE are eating while watching the news, their expressions grave. The school bell rings.

COLLEAGUE
School's out. Knee acting up again?

UNCLE LI
Last week before retirement. It's reminding me.

COLLEAGUE
Let's go.

They stand and walk out.

EXT. SCHOOL GATE - DAY

Children run happily out of the school gate.

LITTLE GIRL
Goodbye, Uncle Li!

UNCLE LI
Bye bye, be safe!

LITTLE BOY
Uncle Li, do you have any cigarette cards?

UNCLE LI
(bending down)
Did you get 100 on your test? You know the rule.

LITTLE BOY
I did.

The LITTLE BOY takes out a test paper with a perfect score from his backpack and hands it to UNCLE LI.

UNCLE LI
(taking the paper)
Perfect. That's worth celebrating.

He takes out a stack of cigarette cards from his pocket and hands them to the LITTLE BOY.

UNCLE LI
Here you go. Make good choices.

COLLEAGUE
(laughing)
continuation:
You're really going through with retirement? Who'll bribe these kids?

UNCLE LI
(smiling)
Maybe their parents will learn my methods.

CHILDREN gather around, pulling out perfect score test papers.

CHILDREN
I have one too! Me too!

UNCLE LI
(laughing)
Okay, okay, let me see. All hundreds? My last pack... take them, but find your parents first.

The children happily divide up the cigarette cards and run toward their parents waiting at the gate. In the crowd, a MAN watches with hollow eyes, hand trembling inside his coat.

UNCLE LI immediately becomes alert.

UNCLE LI
(quietly, to Colleague)
That one. Watch him.

The MAN pulls a knife and charges toward the children. The crowd screams. UNCLE LI quickly rushes forward and uses a practiced wrist-lock to subdue him within a few moves.

The MAN lies on the ground, sobbing, and lifts his shirt to reveal a crude bomb strapped to his body.

UNCLE LI
(shouting)
Everyone back! Now!

MAN
(crying, not laughing)
My boy... they wouldn't listen...

UNCLE LI sees the timer on the bomb counting down.

UNCLE LI
(to his colleague)
Scissors. Fourth drawer.

The COLLEAGUE sprints back to the security room to find scissors.

MAN
(barely conscious)
No one cared... no one...

The COLLEAGUE runs back with scissors. UNCLE LI takes the scissors and carefully cuts the tape, revealing simple wiring. His expression is focused but calm. He clips a wire. The timer stops.

Police sirens wail. Uncle Li sits back against the fence, exhausted, as parents clutch their children.

UNCLE LI
(to Colleague)
Still got it.

FADE OUT

title: Desert Island Treasure Hunt
description: After five years stranded on a deserted island, Chu Feng and his companions finally get a chance to find treasure and escape, but betrayal and a tsunami change everything.
context:
Title: Desert Island Treasure Hunt
Description: After five years stranded on a deserted island, Chu Feng and his companions finally get a chance to find treasure and escape, but betrayal and a tsunami change everything.

EXT. DESERT ISLAND BEACH - DAY

CHU FENG, QING YAO, and LIU RUYAN stand on rocks by the sea, watching the receding tide expose unfamiliar reef formations.

CHU FENG
The storm last month changed everything. If my readings are right, the base entrance should be accessible for the first time.

QING YAO
(quietly determined)
Then let's finish this.

CHU FENG
(to Liu Ruyan)
Wait here. If the tide turns, fire the signal.

LIU RUYAN
(touching his arm)
Chu Feng... be careful.

CHU FENG and QING YAO walk into the sea, put on diving masks, and submerge.

Liu Ruyan watches them disappear. She glances at the signal flare on her belt, her expression unreadable.

EXT. UNDERWATER - DAY

CHU FENG and QING YAO swim through murky depths, following a faint, pulsing light source.

QING YAO (V.O.)
Chu Feng, the pressure...

CHU FENG (V.O.)
Almost there. The base beacon is active.

They discover a sealed container embedded in the reef, covered in bio-luminescent algae.

QING YAO (V.O.)
Is that...?

CHU FENG (V.O.)
The evacuation kit. The boat's activation key is inside.

QING YAO (V.O.)
I'll secure it.

As QING YAO reaches for the container, LIU RUYAN swims into view from behind a rock formation—she's wearing a spare diving set.

CHU FENG (V.O.)
Ruyan? You followed us?

LIU RUYAN (V.O.)
I couldn't wait up there. Not after five years.

As CHU FENG turns back to help QING YAO, LIU RUYAN retrieves a pressure injector from her diving belt and presses it to his neck. Chu Feng convulses and goes limp.

LIU RUYAN (V.O.)
I'm sorry. But I can't do another year of this.

QING YAO (V.O.)
(screaming through water)
No!

QING YAO catches the unconscious CHU FENG as he sinks, sharing her oxygen.
continuation:
EXT. DESERT ISLAND BEACH - DAY

CHANG WEI and LIU RUYAN have dragged the container ashore. Inside: sealed rations, a satellite communicator, and an encrypted keycard.

CHANG WEI
The key still works. The evacuation boat is ours.

LIU RUYAN
(scanning the horizon)
Just the two of us. Like we planned.

CHU FENG staggers from the surf, carrying QING YAO who isn't breathing.

CHU FENG
(barely conscious)
Ruyan... what did you...

CHANG WEI rushes forward, disarming Chu Feng with a practiced strike.

LIU RUYAN
You were never meant to leave this island, Chu Feng. You know too much about what happened to the research team.

QING YAO
(gasping, waking)
She's been relaying our position... for months...

CHANG WEI
(laughing)
Months? Try years. The corporation's been waiting for the base to unlock.

LIU RUYAN
(to Chu Feng)
You were a useful guide. Nothing more.

CHU FENG
(roaring)
The research logs... you destroyed them...

He lunges, but Chang Wei easily subdues him.

QING YAO
Chu Feng, don't! She's not worth it!

CHANG WEI
Pathetic. You still think this is about betrayal? It's about survival.

A low rumble builds. The horizon darkens unnaturally.

QING YAO
(looking past them)
The reef pattern... it's wrong...

CHU FENG
(whispering)
The tide's reversing. Faster than I calculated.

LIU RUYAN
What are you talking about?

CHU FENG
The base wasn't just abandoned. It was submerged to contain the experiment.

A massive wall of water appears in the distance, moving impossibly fast.

CHANG WEI
Tsunami! Move!

CHU FENG grabs both their ankles with the last of his strength.

CHU FENG
(resolutely)
Containment protocol. We're all quarantined now.

QING YAO
Chu Feng, let go! Save yourself!

LIU RUYAN
(screaming)
You're insane!

CHU FENG
(to Qing Yao)
I already killed you once. Not again.

The wave crashes down.

EXT. DESERT ISLAND BEACH - DAY

CHU FENG lies alone on the beach, battered but alive.

CHU FENG (V.O.)
The experiment... it looped time. Every death sends me back. Qing Yao's died a hundred times. A thousand. I have to break the cycle.

INT. AIRPLANE CABIN - DAY

CHU FENG jolts awake in his seat, surrounded by normal passengers. He looks out the window at clear skies.

CHU FENG (V.O.)
Isn't this...?

He sees an electronic display above the cabin door showing "April 24, 2124 - Flight 447."

CHU FENG
(shocked, to himself)
April 24... the crash date. I've been reborn.

Chu Feng looks across the aisle. QING YAO sits there, alive and well, reading a tablet.

CHU FENG's face shows an expression of disbelief and determination.

FADE OUT.

title: No Good Deed Is Too Small
description: A son's parents visit the city for the first time, but a traffic accident creates an unexpected confrontation between his wife and mother.
context:
Title: No Good Deed Is Too Small
Description: A son's parents visit the city for the first time, but a traffic accident creates an unexpected confrontation between his wife and mother.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

CHEN ZHIYUAN, in a suit and tie, sits at his desk making a phone call, his expression warm but distracted.

EXT. BUS STOP - DAY

MOTHER-IN-LAW and FATHER-IN-LAW just got off a minibus, carrying large and small bags of luggage. MOTHER-IN-LAW walks while answering the phone.

CHEN ZHIYUAN (V.O.)
Mom, where are you? Do you want me to pick you up?

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Oh, your dad and I just got off the bus. Son, it's fine, no need to pick us up. We can find the place.

CHEN ZHIYUAN
Alright, Mom. Then I'll have Siqi prepare more dishes, and we'll host a welcome dinner for you two tonight.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
No, no, that won't do! Isn't your daughter-in-law pregnant? She should be resting. We can manage.

CHEN ZHIYUAN (V.O.)
She insists. She wants to make a good impression.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
The girl should learn to take care of herself first.

CHEN ZHIYUAN hangs up the phone.

FATHER-IN-LAW
(glancing at MOTHER-IN-LAW)
She's probably still upset we missed the ceremony...

MOTHER-IN-LAW
She'll understand. City life is complicated. Besides, she's carrying our grandchild - that's what matters now.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

At the pedestrian crossing, the red light is on. Voice prompt: "Red light now, please wait."

MOTHER-IN-LAW and FATHER-IN-LAW carry their luggage, preparing to cross the street.

FATHER-IN-LAW
The light's red, old woman!

MOTHER-IN-LAW
Everyone does it back home. The lights are just... suggestions. Come on, we'll be quick.

FATHER-IN-LAW
These aren't country roads!

MOTHER-IN-LAW pulls FATHER-IN-LAW along, stepping into the crosswalk as cars approach.

INT. CAR - DAY

CHU SIQI, CHEN ZHIYUAN's wife, is driving. The phone on the car mount rings, showing "Husband" on the caller ID. She answers.

CHU SIQI
What's up, honey?

CHEN ZHIYUAN (V.O.)
Honey, my parents have arrived. Do you have time to prepare?

CHU SIQI
(smiling)
Sure. I'm actually out right now - picking up something from the market near the station.

CHEN ZHIYUAN (V.O.)
Thanks, honey. Just... be careful out there, okay? The roads near the station can be crazy.

CHU SIQI
I know, honey.

CHU SIQI hangs up and continues driving.

EXT. STREET - DAY

CHU SIQI's car approaches the pedestrian crossing. She suddenly sees FATHER-IN-LAW and MOTHER-IN-LAW stepping into the road. She slams on the brakes in terror and jerks the steering wheel.

CHU SIQI
(screaming)
Ah!

The car makes a piercing brake sound and stops just in front of the elderly couple. MOTHER-IN-LAW falls to the ground in shock.

FATHER-IN-LAW
(helping MOTHER-IN-LAW up)
Old woman! Are you okay?

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(staggering to her feet, voice shaking)
You... you almost...

She locks eyes with CHU SIQI, recognition dawning. Her fear hardens into something else.

CHU SIQI, still shaken, clutches her belly with a pained expression. She unbuckles her seatbelt, opens the car door, and gets out.

MOTHER-IN-LAW walks unsteadily toward CHU SIQI, her hand trembling as she raises it.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(fury masking terror)
You'd risk everything? Your own child?

The slap lands before CHU SIQI can speak. She staggers back, covering her face, her expression shifting from shock to a dawning, devastating understanding.

MOTHER-IN-LAW
(turning away, voice breaking)
Some things can't be undone...

title: Mrs. Gu, the Adorable Wife, is Actually a True Metaphysics Master

Title: Mrs. Gu, the Adorable Wife, is Actually a True Metaphysics Master
Description: A young woman arrives to fulfill a childhood marriage contract with a wealthy heir, warning him that breaking their mystical engagement will cost him his life.

INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

Fast-paced music plays.

A series of quick cuts:
GRANDMA's finger tracing the blood-red thread sewn into a faded Bagua diagram.
A cloth bundle wrapped in silk, the Tai Chi Bagua diagram glinting.
MU WANQING's reflection in a spoon—her eyes flash gold before she blinks.
GU TINGXIU loosening his collar, a bead of sweat trickling down his neck despite the AC.

GRANDMA, MU WANQING, and GU TINGXIU sit around a dining table.

GRANDMA
Wanqing has honored her family's promise. The engagement your grandfather sealed lays here.

GRANDMA
The ancestors have chosen the tenth day of this month.

GU TINGXIU
(coolly)
I've closed a three-billion-yuan merger this quarter. I think I can manage my own marriage.
continuation:
MU WANQING
That merger crossed a soul at the Jinmao Tower. You felt it—the chill that cameras can't explain.

MU WANQING
This contract isn't paper. It's a tether. You snap it, and everything you've built becomes a hunting ground.

GU TINGXIU
She's been briefed well. How much is the performance costing you, Grandmother?

MU WANQING
My price? A roof that doesn't leak. For you...

MU WANQING's eyes suddenly turn golden, glowing with light.

MU WANQING
(quietly)
But you...

A red digital countdown appears on GU TINGXIU's face, labeled "DEATH COUNTDOWN."

MU WANQING
Will lose your life.

Tense music plays as the countdown continues to flash on GU TINGXIU's face.
