title: Adorable Treasure Descends the Mountain
description: A gifted young girl raised by a Taoist master must descend the mountain to help a cold-hearted man inherit his family fortune to break her own curse and prevent chaos.
context:
Title: Adorable Treasure Descends the Mountain
Description: A gifted young girl raised by a Taoist master must descend the mountain to help a cold-hearted man inherit his family fortune to break her own curse and prevent chaos.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY

JIAOZI, a little girl with double buns and wearing a red belly warmer, blinks playfully.

CLOSE-UP - The red bead in JIAOZI's hand is crushed.

Wind and clouds surge in the mountains. Quick cuts.

EXT. FOREST - DAY

QINGYUE, a young woman also wearing double buns, looks around in panic.

QINGYUE
(shouting)
Jiaozi!

INT. PAVILION - DAY

JIAOZI forms hand seals, chanting, surrounded by golden magical effects.

JIAOZI
Heaven and earth without limits, Qiankun technique, urgent as the law commands!

The magical light flashes.

EXT. STONE STEPS - DAY

JIAOZI sits on the stone steps, guiltily munching on a giant dried fish.

QINGYUE runs over, out of breath and furious.

QINGYUE
Jiaozi! You actually ate Master's Qiankun Dragon Fish!

JIAOZI
(smiling weakly)
It was an accident...

JIAOZI throws away the fish and runs. QINGYUE chases after her.
continuation:
EXT. TEMPLE ENTRANCE - DAY

JIAOZI, now wearing white Taoist robes, peeks out from behind the door.

JIAOZI
(whispering)
Senior Sister.

QINGYUE walks over, holding a huge decorative rock with one hand.

QINGYUE
Master's been divining for hours. That bead you broke was sealing a karmic debt from your past life. Master is calculating how you can survive the backlash.

INT. MASTER'S ROOM - DAY

MASTER BAIMEI sits cross-legged, performing divination magic. He suddenly clutches his chest in pain, spits out blood, and his white hair instantly turns gray-blue.

BAIMEI
(painfully)
The karmic seal is shattered...

He shouts toward the door.

BAIMEI
Qingyue! Jiaozi! Come!

QINGYUE and JIAOZI rush into the room and kneel before BAIMEI.

QINGYUE/JIAOZI
Master!

BAIMEI
(seriously)
Jiaozi, listen. In four days, the karmic debt you carry will claim your life. Unless you descend the mountain and balance the scales.

JIAOZI
How? Tell me what to do!

BAIMEI
A man named Xiao Qianfan. In a past life, he shielded you from a catastrophe. You owe him a destiny. Now he refuses his inheritance, and his cousin will use that power for bloodshed. You must ensure he claims his rightful place. Only then will the scales balance.

QINGYUE
But Master, if he refuses his own fortune--

BAIMEI
This palm-leaf fan holds a fragment of his past life's vow. It may awaken what he has forgotten.

He throws the fan. Jiaozi catches it.

BAIMEI
Qingyue, watch over her. The path will be dangerous.

QINGYUE
Yes, Master.

JIAOZI picks up the fan, and they leave together.

INT. MASTER'S ROOM - DAY

After they leave, SENIOR BROTHER BUFAN appears in the corridor, his eyes sinister.

BUFAN
A little girl chosen over me? I'll make sure your journey is cut short.

BUFAN crushes a talisman. Outside, an explosion echoes.

EXT. MOUNTAIN CLIFF - DAY

A violent explosion rocks the cliff path.

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT

QINGYUE and JIAOZI walk on a city street, both wearing more modern clothing.

QINGYUE
Master said Xiao Qianfan was your protector in a past life. When you see him, trust what you feel.

Not far ahead, XIAO QIANFAN is surrounded and beaten by a group of MEN IN BLACK, lying on the ground with injuries on his face.

JIAOZI sees this scene and her mouth drops open in shock.

JIAOZI
My past-life bodyguard is getting his ass kicked!

title: Flash Marriage with a Tycoon Thanks to Baby's Assist
description: A young boy tries to find a wife for his grandfather by holding a matchmaking event, while a grandmother and granddaughter face bullying at a park.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage with a Tycoon Thanks to Baby's Assist
Description: A young boy tries to find a wife for his grandfather by holding a matchmaking event, while a grandmother and granddaughter face bullying at a park.

INT. MATCHMAKING EVENT VENUE - DAY

A banner reads "Executive Senior Mixer - Lin Foundation."

Rows of folding chairs face a registration table. Middle-aged and elderly women whisper excitedly.

A poster shows LIN GUO'AN: "Honored Guest & Benefactor."

MRS. CHEN
(excitedly)
I raised three sons, all successful. Our family values strength and fertility!

ASSISTANT
(checking clipboard)
Thank you. Next.

MRS. WANG
My paralyzed ex-husband taught me dedication. I managed everything alone.

ASSISTANT
(polite)
Appreciate your story. Next.

MS. ZHANG
I'm 52, still unmarried. Pure and ready for commitment!

The crowd murmurs.

A boy's voice rings out.

LIN FAN TONG (O.S.)
Attention!

LIN FAN TONG, in a small suit, stands on a stool behind the table.

LIN FAN TONG
You're all wrong for my grandfather.

He points at MRS. CHEN.

LIN FAN TONG
Too desperate.

(at MRS. WANG)
Too sad.

(at MS. ZHANG)
Too fake.

The women GASP.

A door CRASHES open.

LIN FAN TONG
(startled)
Eek!

ASSISTANT
(whispering)
Young master, your grandfather--

LIN GUO'AN enters with BODYGUARDS. The room stirs.

LIN GUO'AN
(icy)
Fan Tong. Home. Now.

LIN FAN TONG
(quiet)
Yes, sir.

The women surge forward, starstruck.

WOMEN
Mr. Lin! Please!

BODYGUARD
Sir, the exit--

LIN GUO'AN spots his fleeing grandson.

LIN GUO'AN
Fan Tong!

He gives chase.
continuation:
EXT. PARK - DAY

BAI QIAO QIAO holds a lollipop near a playground.

BAI QIAO QIAO
Can I play?

BULLY GIRL
My mom says no. You don't have a mother.

She slaps the lollipop away.

BAI QIAO QIAO
(aggrieved)
But--

BULLY GIRL
You're illegitimate. A bastard.

BAI QIAO QIAO
(crying)
I have my grandmother!

A PARENT approaches with two others.

PARENT 1
What are you doing near my child?

She pushes Bai Qiao Qiao lightly. The girl stumbles.

PARENT 2
No wonder your father left. Bad blood.

PARENT 3
And your mother ran off. Like grandmother, like mother.

BAI QIAO QIAO cries.

BAI QIAO QIAO
Don't talk about my grandmother!

PARENT 1
You little--I'll teach you respect!

She raises her hand. BAI XIU LAN rushes over.

BAI XIU LAN
(holding Bai Qiao Qiao)
Touch her and you'll regret it.

BAI XIU LAN faces the parents.

BAI XIU LAN
(quietly fierce)
Adults bullying a child. Disgraceful. Next time, I go to the school board. And the news.

PARENT 1
(hesitating)
Let's go. Not worth it.

They leave. Bai Qiao Qiao sobs.

BAI QIAO QIAO
Grandma, if I had a grandfather--

BAI XIU LAN
(heartbroken)
I know, Qiao Qiao. I know.

LIN FAN TONG runs through, pursued.

LIN FAN TONG
(shouting)
Move!

He crashes into them. All three tumble.

LIN FAN TONG
(panicked)
Little sister! I'm sorry!

BAI XIU LAN
(groaning)
Child, watch where--

LIN GUO'AN arrives.

LIN GUO'AN
Fan Tong!

LIN FAN TONG
(hiding behind Bai Xiu Lan)
Grandma, save me! Kidnapper!

LIN GUO'AN looks at Bai Xiu Lan, breathless. A moment passes.

LIN GUO'AN
(softly)
My apologies. Are you hurt?

title: Baby Cupid, Daddy Don't Run
description: A woman is betrayed by her sister and left for dead after discovering the truth about her pregnancy.
context:
Title: Baby Cupid, Daddy Don't Run
Description: A woman is betrayed by her sister and left for dead after discovering the truth about her pregnancy.

EXT. SUBURBAN ROAD - NIGHT

A black sedan and a white sedan lie twisted on the asphalt, headlights casting ghostly beams through smoke.

The black sedan's door hangs open. SU YUE, wearing a white dress, tumbles onto the pavement. Crimson blooms across the fabric. Blood streams from her forehead and the corner of her mouth.

SU YUE moans in pain, struggling against wreckage pinning her legs. Her fingers scrape the asphalt, leaving red trails.

A pair of black high heels CLICKS toward her. SU YUE lifts her head and sees her younger sister, SU LU, in a black lace dress.

SU YUE
(weakly)
Sister... save my child...

SU LU crosses her arms, looking down with a triumphant sneer. She lifts her foot and presses her stiletto into SU YUE's ribcage, grinding slowly.

SU YUE
(crying out)
Ah!

SU LU squats down and grabs SU YUE's chin.

SU LU
(mockingly)
Oh my, bleeding so much.

SU LU
Sister, aren't you a doctor? Why do you need me to save you?

SU YUE
(terrified)
What do you mean?

SU LU
You disgraced the family, carrying a bastard child. Dad said this child must die.

SU LU lifts her foot and drives it into SU YUE's abdomen.

SU YUE
(screaming)
Ah!

SU LU
You planned to birth this bastard. Tell me, don't you deserve to die?
continuation:
SU YUE
(crying)
This child is Lu Yi's... Lu Yi's!

SU LU
(scoffing)
You? Worthy? The child in my belly is Lu Yi's. That night, the man in your bed was a homeless man I found behind the hotel. I filmed it for Brother Lu. He wept.

SU YUE's pupils contract sharply, her face filled with shock and despair.

FLASHBACK - INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

SU YUE lies on the bed, seemingly drugged, unconscious. A half-empty water glass on the nightstand. Her phone shows missed calls from "Lu Yi."

FLASHBACK - INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

SU LU stands at the door of room 908, on the phone, glancing down the empty hallway.

SU LU
(into phone)
Room 908. Take the money. Don't talk.

FLASHBACK - INT. HOTEL ROOM - DAY

A strange man wearing glasses enters the room and leans over the unconscious SU YUE.

END FLASHBACK - EXT. SUBURBAN ROAD - NIGHT

SU YUE completely breaks down, silent tears mixing with blood.

SU LU
(triumphantly)
Now you can die here with that bastard. And I'm going back to become Mrs. Lu.

SU LU turns and walks away, laughing.

SU YUE lies on the ground, her trembling hand on her belly.

SU YUE
(crying, to her belly)
Baby... baby... I won't let you die...

Her hand fumbles and touches a sharp glass shard from the headlight. Her eyes flash with determination. She picks it up.

SU YUE
(to her belly, whispering)
Be brave... for both of us...

She plunges the glass into her lower abdomen with a surgeon's precise, desperate incision. Blood gushes. She lets out a scream, then loses consciousness, her bloody hand cradling her belly in a final protective arc.

title: Adorable Helpers: A Wedding at Fifty

context:
Title: Adorable Helpers: A Wedding at Fifty
Description: A real estate CEO searches for a cure for his paralyzed grandson, unaware that the children are secretly matchmaking him with a skilled doctor they encountered on the street.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

A black luxury car drives along a tree-lined road.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Three years, seventeen specialists, and Zhou Zhenhua's hope has become a ritual.

Inside, XIANG DONG drives. ZHOU ZHENHUA sits in back, rubbing a child's crayon drawing.

XIANG DONG
Guangzhou specialist canceled. Said Dabao's case was "outside intervention range."

ZHOU ZHENHUA
(folds the drawing)
He stopped asking when he'll walk. Now he asks if I'll be too tired to carry him.

INT. CHILDREN'S ROOM - DAY

DABAO sits in his wheelchair by the ground-floor window, tablet showing a map. ERBAO studies a notebook.

DABAO
She always walks this way after Thursday clinic. Grandpa's meetings end at four.

ERBAO
One chance.

DABAO
Then we can't mess it up.

EXT. STREET - DAY

DR. JIANG YUEQIN walks briskly, medical bag in hand. She pauses to rub her ankle—an old injury—then continues.

INT. CHILDREN'S ROOM - DAY

DABAO and ERBAO each hold their phones, tracking a location dot.
continuation:
INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

ZHOU ZHENHUA's phone receives a WeChat notification. He opens a voice message.

MOM (O.S.)
(voice message)
Your matchmaker has three women for Sunday. Unless you've found someone yourself?

ZHOU ZHENHUA
(types reply)
I'll handle it.

INT. CHILDREN'S ROOM - DAY

DABAO sees his grandfather's reply. ERBAO gives him a thumbs up, then drops a water balloon from the windowsill.

EXT. STREET - DAY

XIANG DONG's car swerves to avoid the burst balloon, hitting a deep pothole. Muddy water splashes JIANG YUEQIN's trousers.

JIANG YUEQIN
Stops, examines the damage.

The car stops. XIANG DONG rushes out.

XIANG DONG
I'm so sorry—are you hurt?

title: Cute Babies from the Future
description: A woman disrupts a billionaire's wedding to protest a demolition project, only to be followed by two children from the future claiming to be his offspring.
context:
Title: Cute Babies from the Future
Description: A woman disrupts a billionaire's wedding to protest a demolition project, only to be followed by two children from the future claiming to be his offspring.

INT. NEWS STUDIO - DAY

NEWS ANCHOR
According to our sources, the Qin-Su union tonight will activate demolition contracts for Dong Family Village within hours. This merger isn't just a marriage—it's a billion-dollar land acquisition personally greenlit by Elder Kun.

EXT. CAPITAL CITY HOTEL - DAY

A black Bentley arrives at the entrance. Two rows of BODYGUARDS in black suits bow in unison.

BODYGUARDS
(in unison)
Master Qin.

QIN HANCHENG emerges, his face controlled. Assistant LIN RONG checks a tablet showing a live feed.

LIN RONG
Master Qin, Wen Xingtong's filed an emergency injunction. She's chained herself to the medical facility at unit 7—her grandmother's oxygen machine is still running inside.

EXT. DONG FAMILY VILLAGE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

An excavator idles before a modest house. WEN XINGTONG sits on the porch steps, surrounded by REPORTERS, holding medical bills and a property deed.

WEN XINGTONG
This house is my grandmother's lungs. Qin Hancheng surveyed this land himself five years ago. He knows what's at stake.

She holds up a photo of a young Qin Hancheng volunteering at the village clinic, dated ten years prior.

EXT. CAPITAL CITY HOTEL - DAY

Qin pauses at the entrance, staring at the same photo on his phone before deleting it.

QIN HANCHENG
Tell the crew to wait on my order. No demolition until sunrise.

LIN RONG
But Elder Kun expects the contract to trigger at midnight—

QIN HANCHENG
I said wait.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

The EMCEE stands before a massive screen displaying the merger contract. QIN HANCHENG and SU QIANXIAO exchange rings.

EMCEE
As the final signature seals their partnership, let us celebrate the newlyweds.

Qin signs the contract with a tremor. Su notices.

SU QIANXIAO
(whispering)
Your hand is shaking, Master Qin. Cold feet or guilty conscience?

QIN HANCHENG
I don't regret decisions. I calculate outcomes.

A security radio chirps urgently. WEN XINGTONG's voice echoes.

WEN XINGTONG (O.S.)
Stop!

WEN XINGTONG appears at the stairs in a simple white dress, holding a property deed and a medical power-of-attorney document.

WEN XINGTONG
You can't sign what you don't legally own, Qin Hancheng. This deed and my grandmother's medical proxy predate your acquisition.

She projects the documents onto the screen, overlaying the merger contract.

MALE GUEST
That's the protester from the news!

FEMALE GUEST
Two brides? The Qin family name is finished.

WEN XINGTONG walks to the stage.
continuation:
WEN XINGTONG
Ten years ago, you promised to protect this land. I was stupid enough to believe the boy who bandaged my grandmother's wounds.

She slams the documents onto the signing table. The glass display case shatters.

WEN XINGTONG (V.O.)
If you want to bury your promise, you'll have to bury me with it.

FEMALE REPORTER
This is streaming live to five million viewers!

WEN XINGTONG begins to fake cry.

LIN RONG
(to security)
Contain this immediately.

SECURITY GUARDS advance. Cameras record every angle.

FEMALE REPORTER
Press access is protected by law!

SU QIANXIAO
(to Qin)
You surveyed that land yourself. You knew the medical facility was still operational.

QIN HANCHENG
(to Wen)
You're destroying your own future.

WEN XINGTONG
I'm saving my past.

The venue lights flicker. A low-frequency hum fills the air.

LIN RONG
Generator malfunction?

WEN XINGTONG
(surprised)
The medical equipment...?

FEMALE GUEST
(pointing at the ceiling)
The chandelier!

A silver sphere materializes and implodes silently on stage. When the light clears, GUO BAO and TANG BAO kneel in silver suits, each holding a holographic frame.

GUO BAO AND TANG BAO
Daddy!

GUO BAO
You promised Mommy you'd protect the village. We came to remind you.

TANG BAO
Before you make us orphans.

SU QIANXIAO
Qin Hancheng, you have a family?

WEN XINGTONG (V.O.)
...What?

The children run to Wen, hugging her legs.

TANG BAO
Mommy!

GUO BAO
Mommy!

TANG BAO
You did it. You stopped him.

GUO BAO
Mommy!

WEN XINGTONG looks at the holographic frame—showing herself, older, with these children and a thriving Dong Family Village behind them.

title: Cute Baby's Divine Assist - Mommy Can't Escape (Episode 1 of 80)
description: A woman gives birth under tragic circumstances, losing her child to a cruel rival. Six years later, fate brings her back.
context:
Title: Cute Baby's Divine Assist - Mommy Can't Escape (Episode 1 of 80)
Description: A woman gives birth under tragic circumstances, losing her child to a cruel rival. Six years later, fate brings her back.

INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - NIGHT

MENG YU clutches a silver locket, fighting through violent contractions.

DOCTOR
Push! One more push—he's crowning!

MENG YU
(gasping)
Please... save him...

A final push. A BABY'S WAIL erupts. Meng Yu collapses, tears of joy streaming.

MENG YU
(whispering)
My baby...

The door SLAMS open. ZHAO WANWAN strides in, flanked by BODYGUARDS. The Doctor pales.

ZHAO WANWAN
(to Doctor)
The Lu family thanks you for your discretion. Now, the child.

DOCTOR
(trembling)
Miss Zhao, protocol requires—

ZHAO WANWAN
Your family's medical debts. Consider them paid. The child.

The Doctor hands over the newborn. Zhao's crimson nails trace his cheek.

ZHAO WANWAN
(to Bodyguard)
Get rid of this bastard child. Make it clean.

The Bodyguard swaddles the baby and exits. Meng Yu's eyes snap open.

MENG YU
(weak but desperate)
No... that's... mine...

Meng Yu falls from the bed, crawling toward Zhao's heels.

ZHAO WANWAN
(crouching, venomous)
You really thought he'd choose you? A poor, filthy mistake?

Zhao's stiletto grinds into Meng Yu's knuckles.

MENG YU
(screaming)

ZHAO WANWAN
(whispering)
Forget tonight. Forget him. Or I'll bury you both.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

LU TINGFENG sprints down the hall, suit rumpled. He collides with the Bodyguard holding his son.

LU TINGFENG
Where is she?

BODYGUARD
She's gone, sir. Refused the child. Signed the papers.

The Bodyguard thrusts the baby into Lu Tingfeng's arms. The newborn squalls. Through the cracked door, Zhao's shadow retreats from the delivery room.

LU TINGFENG
(quietly, to Assistant)
Find her. Every hospital, every train station. Find her.

EXT. STREET - DAY

ON SCREEN: SIX YEARS LATER

A white sedan glides through golden hour light. MENG YU walks with quiet confidence, the same locket around her neck.

A LITTLE BOY in a worn suit darts into traffic, chasing a paper airplane.

TIRES SCREECH. The sedan bears down.

MENG YU
(horrified)
LOOK OUT!

She drops her suitcase and lunges.

title: Binhai
description: A down-on-his-luck man faces rejection, betrayal, and loss on his birthday, leading to a fateful encounter with a fox spirit who offers him a chance to change his destiny.
context:
Title: Binhai
Description: A down-on-his-luck man faces rejection, betrayal, and loss on his birthday, leading to a fateful encounter with a fox spirit who offers him a chance to change his destiny.

INT. COMPANY LOBBY - DAY

A dozen JOB SEEKERS crowd the modern lobby, resumes in hand. ZHANG YE (30s, worn suit) sits apart, staring at his reflection in a window—practicing a smile that doesn't reach his eyes.

The HR MANAGER emerges, flanked by SECURITY.

HR MANAGER
Thank you all for your time. We've made our selections. Those not called, please see yourselves out.

Dispirited, the crowd shuffles toward the exit. Zhang Ye stays rooted, gripping his folder.

ZHANG YE
Sir, I've been waiting five hours. Could you just—five minutes?

HR MANAGER
( already walking away )
Decisions are final.

ZHANG YE
My mother—she's sick. I need this job.

The Manager pauses, then gestures to Security without looking back.

Zhang Ye is gently but firmly escorted out.

EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE - DAY

The guards deposit Zhang Ye on the sidewalk. His resume folder spills, papers scattering.

SECURITY GUARD
Some doors just don't open, brother. Don't take it personal.

The guards retreat inside. Zhang Ye kneels, gathering papers as a light rain begins.

His PHONE BUZZES. "Mom" flashes on screen. He stares at it, lets it ring twice before answering—voice steady, practiced.

ZHANG YE
Hey, Mom.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER (O.S.)
How did it go?

ZHANG YE
( forcing brightness )
Really well. They said they'd call this week.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER (O.S.)
That's wonderful. You come home early, hear me? I made your favorite—stuffed lotus root. We'll celebrate properly.

ZHANG YE
(choking on the word)
...Yeah.

INT. ZHANG YE'S APARTMENT - DAY

Small, cluttered. LI QIAN (late 20s) lounges on the sofa, phone pressed to her ear, laughing—an intimate, familiar laugh.

LI QIAN
...he's always at those pathetic interviews. You know I can't remember the last time he actually—

She freezes. ZHANG YE'S MOTHER stands in the doorway, grocery bags slipping from her hands. A carton of eggs SMASHES on the floor.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER
Qianqian... who were you talking to?

LI QIAN
(recovers, defensive)
You scared me! Why are you sneaking around?

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER
I heard you. On the phone. Who is 'he'?

Li Qian stands, smoothing her dress. A beat of silence. Then:

LI QIAN
Don't pretend you don't know. This life—this apartment, your medical bills—it's all on me now. Your son can't even keep a job for six months.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER
(quietly)
He's trying.

LI QIAN
Trying? I see his bank statements. The interviews. The rejections. I'm drowning here, and you're both—just—sinking me faster.

She moves to leave. The older woman touches her arm.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER
Please. We can—

Li Qian yanks free. The mother stumbles, catches herself on the counter.

LI QIAN
(cold)
I'm done being ashamed. I want my life back.

She grabs her purse and exits, slamming the door.
continuation:
INT. ZHANG YE'S APARTMENT - LATER

Zhang Ye enters. The apartment is dim. Li Qian sits at the kitchen table, a document waiting beside her packed suitcase.

ZHANG YE
Mom called. She's staying with Auntie tonight—what's going on?

LI QIAN
She fell. I didn't touch her. But while we're being honest...

She slides the document forward. "DIVORCE AGREEMENT."

ZHANG YE
You can't be serious.

LI QIAN
My lawyer drew it up. No contest, no alimony. Clean break.

ZHANG YE
(unfolding)
Where will you go?

LI QIAN
(stands)
Somewhere I don't have to pretend anymore.

Clipped FOOTSTEPS echo from the hallway. A man's silhouette passes the door window. Li Qian's eyes follow it, just for a second—but Zhang Ye catches it.

ZHANG YE
(low)
Him?

LI QIAN
At least he doesn't apologize for what he wants.

She leaves. Zhang Ye stares at the closed door. His gaze falls to a GIFT BOX on the counter—small, wrapped in newspaper.

He opens it: a modest cake, and a card in his mother's trembling hand.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER (V.O.)
"Son—happy birthday. I'm proud of you, even when you're not. Eat something sweet. Love, Mom."

Zhang Ye touches the cake frosting with one finger. It comes away red. His hands are shaking.

EXT. BINHAI LAKE - NIGHT

Mist rises off black water. Zhang Ye sits on the bank, surrounded by empty bottles. He doesn't drink—just stares at his reflection.

ZHANG YE
(to himself)
Thirty-two years. Same face. Same story.

A small WHITE FOX emerges from the reeds, watching him with amber eyes. It approaches, tentative.

ZHANG YE
Hey, little guy. You hungry too?

He breaks off a corner of the cake from his pocket. The fox takes it delicately.

ZHANG YE
Yeah. Me too.

He stands, walks to the water's edge. The fox follows, whining softly. Zhang Ye looks down at the dark surface.

ZHANG YE
(whispers)
Just... tired.

He takes another step. The water touches his shoes.

The fox BARKS—once, sharp. Light blooms from it, fierce and silver. Zhang Ye shields his eyes. When he lowers his hand, a WOMAN stands there in white, fox-fire dancing around her fingertips.

FOX SPIRIT
You fed me. That debts a thread.

ZHANG YE
(stumbling back)
What—?

FOX SPIRIT
One wish, mortal. But threads cut both ways. The price... will be part of you.

ZHANG YE
(desperate, laughing)
Rich. I want to be rich. Powerful. So no one can—

FOX SPIRIT
(interrupting)
So you can become the one who looks away?

She smiles, knowing. The fox-fire flickers. Zhang Ye's bravado crumbles.

ZHANG YE
(quiet)
I want... I want to matter.

The Fox Spirit steps closer. Her fingers brush his chest.

FOX SPIRIT
Then we have a bargain.

FADE OUT.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER
I heard you. On the phone. Who is 'he'?

Li Qian stands, smoothing her dress. A beat of silence. Then:

LI QIAN
Don't pretend you don't know. This life—this apartment, your medical bills—it's all on me now. Your son can't even keep a job for six months.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER
(quietly)
He's trying.

LI QIAN
Trying? I see his bank statements. The interviews. The rejections. I'm drowning here, and you're both—just—sinking me faster.

She moves to leave. The older woman touches her arm.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER
Please. We can—

Li Qian yanks free. The mother stumbles, catches herself on the counter.

LI QIAN
(cold)
I'm done being ashamed. I want my life back.

She grabs her purse and exits, slamming the door.

INT. ZHANG YE'S APARTMENT - LATER

Zhang Ye enters. The apartment is dim. Li Qian sits at the kitchen table, a document waiting beside her packed suitcase.

ZHANG YE
Mom called. She's staying with Auntie tonight—what's going on?

LI QIAN
She fell. I didn't touch her. But while we're being honest...

She slides the document forward. "DIVORCE AGREEMENT."

ZHANG YE
You can't be serious.

LI QIAN
My lawyer drew it up. No contest, no alimony. Clean break.

ZHANG YE
(unfolding)
Where will you go?

LI QIAN
(stands)
Somewhere I don't have to pretend anymore.

Clipped FOOTSTEPS echo from the hallway. A man's silhouette passes the door window. Li Qian's eyes follow it, just for a second—but Zhang Ye catches it.

ZHANG YE
(low)
Him?

LI QIAN
At least he doesn't apologize for what he wants.

She leaves. Zhang Ye stares at the closed door. His gaze falls to a GIFT BOX on the counter—small, wrapped in newspaper.

He opens it: a modest cake, and a card in his mother's trembling hand.

ZHANG YE'S MOTHER (V.O.)
"Son—happy birthday. I'm proud of you, even when you're not. Eat something sweet. Love, Mom."

Zhang Ye touches the cake frosting with one finger. It comes away red. His hands are shaking.

EXT. BINHAI LAKE - NIGHT

Mist rises off black water. Zhang Ye sits on the bank, surrounded by empty bottles. He doesn't drink—just stares at his reflection.

ZHANG YE
(to himself)
Thirty-two years. Same face. Same story.

A small WHITE FOX emerges from the reeds, watching him with amber eyes. It approaches, tentative.

ZHANG YE
Hey, little guy. You hungry too?

He breaks off a corner of the cake from his pocket. The fox takes it delicately.

ZHANG YE
Yeah. Me too.

He stands, walks to the water's edge. The fox follows, whining softly. Zhang Ye looks down at the dark surface.

ZHANG YE
(whispers)
Just... tired.

He takes another step. The water touches his shoes.

The fox BARKS—once, sharp. Light blooms from it, fierce and silver. Zhang Ye shields his eyes. When he lowers his hand, a WOMAN stands there in white, fox-fire dancing around her fingertips.

FOX SPIRIT
You fed me. That debts a thread.

ZHANG YE
(stumbling back)
What—?

FOX SPIRIT
One wish, mortal. But threads cut both ways. The price... will be part of you.

ZHANG YE
(desperate, laughing)
Rich. I want to be rich. Powerful. So no one can—

FOX SPIRIT
(interrupting)
So you can become the one who looks away?

She smiles, knowing. The fox-fire flickers. Zhang Ye's bravado crumbles.

ZHANG YE
(quiet)
I want... I want to matter.

The Fox Spirit steps closer. Her fingers brush his chest.

FOX SPIRIT
Then we have a bargain.

FADE OUT.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The Bloodsucking Relatives
description: A successful CEO faces relentless demands for money from her manipulative uncle's family, who fake illnesses to exploit her generosity.
context:
Title: The Bloodsucking Relatives
Description: A successful CEO faces relentless demands for money from her manipulative uncle's family, who fake illnesses to exploit her generosity.

TITLE CARD: TIANYUAN TOWER

EXT. COMPANY BUILDING ENTRANCE - DAY

A black sedan idles across the street from the gleaming corporate tower. Through the windshield, we see SU JIANHAO (50s, once-powerful now faded) chewing his thumbnail. In the back, ZHANG CAIFENG adjusts her plain coat, hiding designer labels, while their son SU YING (25, restless) scrolls his phone.

SU YING
Three million for a Porsche? That's barely a down payment.

SU JIANHAO
(eyes fixed on the building)
We're not buying anything. We're saving your life.

ZHANG CAIFENG
(quietly, to her husband)
Jianhao, what if she checks the records this time?

SU JIANHAO
She won't. Her father already called. She's soft.

He opens the door. They exit, cross the street. Their gait shifts—shoulders hunching, steps slowing. Transforming.

INT. TIANYUAN TOWER LOBBY - CONTINUOUS

The revolving doors spin. The family enters, now projecting an exhausted, desperate aura. SU YING leans on his mother as if weakened.

RECEPTIONIST
May I help you?

SU JIANHAO
(a practiced tremor in his voice)
We're here to see Su Yue. I'm her uncle. Please... it's urgent.

Receptionist hesitates, sees SU YING's gaunt performance, picks up the phone.
continuation:
INT. SU YUE'S OFFICE - DAY

SU YUE (30s, composed but weary) watches security footage on her monitor—her relatives in the lobby. She closes her eyes.

Her parents, SU JIANGUO (60s, conflicted) and LI QIUHONG (50s, anxious), hover near the window.

SU JIANGUO
Your aunt called three times this morning. Yingying's fever spiked.

SU YUE
(dryly)
Sudden symptom. Convenient timing.

LI QIUHONG
Xiao Yue, we saw the boy last month. He looked...

SU YUE
(wheels around, controlled fury)
He looked fine because he is fine. I've transferred two hundred thousand this year alone—Uncle's "surgery," Aunt's "medication," Yingying's "specialist consultations." Yet their neighbors tell me about weekend golf trips and a new villa in the suburbs.

SU JIANGUO
(sitting heavily)
Family helps family.

SU YUE
(quieter, directed at her father)
When does help become enabling? When does generosity become their business model?

She pulls out a document, slides it across the desk. Her parents lean in—photos of Su Ying racing a sports car, property records, luxury purchases.

LI QIUHONG
(whispering)
They told us... medical debts.

SU YUE
They lied. And we let them. You let them, Dad, because guilt is easier than boundaries.

SU JIANGUO
(defensive)
Your uncle raised you when I was working overseas—

SU YUE
—and hasn't let me forget it for twenty years. That debt is paid.

A KNOCK. The door opens. The relatives stand there, transformed: SU YING pale and trembling, ZHANG CAIFENG dabbing invisible tears, SU JIANHAO clutching a plastic bag of medication bottles.

SU JIANHAO
(pleading)
Yueyue... the hospital needs a deposit by five. Yingying's numbers dropped again.

He steps forward, revealing desperation beneath the performance—a flicker of real fear. Maybe for the first time.

ZHANG CAIFENG
Just this last time. We promise.

SU YUE studies them. Beat. She reaches into her desk—not for a checkbook, but a folder.

SU YUE
I spoke with Dr. Chen at Municipal Hospital. He has no record of Yingying as a patient.

The room freezes. SU YING straightens slightly, caught. SU JIANHAO's jaw tightens.

SU YUE
So I made Yingying an appointment. Tomorrow, 9 AM. Full workup. I'll personally pay every expense—directly to the hospital.

She slides the appointment card across the desk. A test.

SU YUE
Unless there’s something you need to tell me first?

TITLE CARD: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Blue Contract
description: A young woman with luminescent blood must decide whether to reveal her secret to a mysterious wealthy man in order to save her dying father.
context:
Title: Blue Contract
Description: A young woman with luminescent blood must decide whether to reveal her secret to a mysterious wealthy man in order to save her dying father.

INT. LUXURY CLUB - NIGHT

A line of well-dressed young women stand nervously.

WANG HAO, Master Shen's special assistant, holds a tray covered with red cloth holding small knives.

He passes the tray down the line. Each girl takes a knife.

SHEN SIHAN sits on a distant sofa, his presence commanding and cold.

SHEN SIHAN
Begin.

WANG HAO
Start now.

Black-clad BODYGUARDS step forward with trays of clear water glasses.

The girls hesitate, then cut their fingertips. Blood drops fall, dispersing without any unusual reaction.

WANG HAO carries a tray of tested glasses to SHEN SIHAN.

WANG HAO
(respectfully)
Master Shen, none of them are the one.

SHEN SIHAN
(waves his hand)

WANG HAO
(to the girls)
You may all leave.

The girls turn and leave, disappointment clear.
continuation:
EXT. STREET OUTSIDE HOTEL - NIGHT

ZHONG XIAOKUI, plainly dressed, picks through a trash bin for plastic bottles.

Two fashionable girls from the club walk past, one checking her phone.

FASHIONABLE GIRL A
Third time this month. Two hundred girls each time, all born at the Tiger hour. And for what? Some blood that lights up?

FASHIONABLE GIRL B
Who cares? Easy money just for the test. And if you're the one in a million whose blood actually glows... they pay a million.

FASHIONABLE GIRL A
True. I'll find more friends next time.

They walk away.

ZHONG XIAOKUI overhears, her hands still in the bin. She pulls out, her finger catching on a sharp edge.

ZHONG XIAOKUI
(to herself)
Blood... glows...

FLASHBACK - EXT. DILAPIDATED ALLEY - 15 YEARS AGO

Young ZHONG XIAOKUI falls, her palm cut. Blood drops into a puddle, emitting a blue glow.

Two young boys see it, pointing in terror.

YOUNG BOY A
Her blood glows, she's a monster!

YOUNG ZHONG XIAOKUI
(frightened)
I'm not a monster.

YOUNG BOY B
Liar! Even your blood proves it!

YOUNG BOY A
Stone her!

They grab rocks.

ZHONG JIANGUO (O.S.)
Xiaokui!

The boys run. ZHONG JIANGUO, her father, rushes over. He sees the glowing blood, immediately wipes it with his sleeve, and bandages her hand with a handkerchief.

ZHONG JIANGUO
(serious, heartbroken)
Xiaokui, no matter what happens, never let anyone see your blood glow in water. Promise me.

Young ZHONG XIAOKUI nods, not fully understanding but sensing his fear.

EXT. STREET OUTSIDE HOTEL - NIGHT

ZHONG XIAOKUI looks at her injured finger.

ZHONG XIAOKUI (V.O.)
All these years, I've kept Dad's secret. Now he's dying. Eight hundred thousand for the transplant. Just one test could save him.

A flash of determination appears, then fades to doubt.

ZHONG XIAOKUI (V.O.)
But once they know... I can't take it back.

A luxury car pulls up nearby. SHEN SIHAN gets out under bodyguard escort, holding a black umbrella. He walks past ZHONG XIAOKUI. Their eyes meet briefly—his exhausted, hers desperate.

ZHONG XIAOKUI watches his retreating figure with a complex expression.

title: Master Bo's Rise Through His Son
description: A young maid is coerced into delivering drugged soup to a wealthy young master, leading to an unexpected night together and a life-changing consequence.
context:
Title: Master Bo's Rise Through His Son
Description: A young maid is coerced into delivering drugged soup to a wealthy young master, leading to an unexpected night together and a life-changing consequence.

INT. LUXURIOUS ROOM - NIGHT

Candlelight flickers. BO XIANGQIU, late twenties and sharp-featured in a black silk shirt, sits alone in a leather armchair, swirling a glass of red wine. A legal document lies on his lap—he's been staring at the same paragraph for minutes.

AN QIAN, nineteen, appears at the doorway holding a porcelain soup bowl, her expression hollow.

AN JINCAI, forty-five with a small mustache, intercepts her in the corridor. He produces a white pill and drops it into the steaming soup. It dissolves instantly.

AN JINCAI
(quietly, almost fatherly)
Your grandmother's surgery deposit—paid in full.
(leans closer)
He's had three bottles. He won't remember. You won't either.

He squeezes her shoulder and disappears. An Qian stares at the bowl, then forces herself forward.

AN QIAN
Young Master... your sobering soup.

BO XIANGQIU looks up, sets his wine down. He studies her trembling hands, her downcast eyes.

BO XIANGQIU
You're new.

AN QIAN
(whisper)
Two months.

Something in her voice makes him pause. He reaches for the bowl.

BO XIANGQIU
Then you should know—I don't bite.

He drinks it in three measured sips, holding her gaze. An Qian watches his throat work, her own constricting.

The wine glass suddenly tips—Bo jerks, trying to catch it. It shatters against the floor. Wine bleeds across marble. He grabs the chair arm, knuckles whitening.

BO XIANGQIU
continuation:
What the...

He stands, swaying. His eyes find An Qian's—confusion giving way to dawning horror.

BO XIANGQIU (CONT'D)
You...

An Qian backs away, but the bed blocks her path. She falls onto it as Bo staggers forward. He collapses onto the mattress, his body pinning hers. She goes rigid, a strangled sound escaping.

An Qian's hands push against his chest—futile. Bo's fingers find her wrist, his grip surprisingly gentle even as his consciousness fades.

BO XIANGQIU (CONT'D)
(slurred)
Don't... be afraid...

He leans down. The candlelight flickers out.

ON SCREEN: TWO MONTHS LATER

INT. MANSION LIVING ROOM - DAY

AN QIAN walks out of a room looking anxious, her hand hidden behind her back. Her uniform strains slightly at the waist.

MAN'S VOICE (O.S.)
Where is she?

AN QIAN
(responding hastily)
Coming!

She stops, turns the pregnancy test over with trembling fingers.

CLOSE-UP: Two stark red lines.

AN QIAN (V.O.)
(quiet, shattered)
Grandma's medicine is expensive. This costs more.

She lifts her head, staring at the door to Bo's wing. Her reflection ghosts in the polished wood—trapped in the same corridor, the same nightmare.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Hidden in Day and Night
description: Qin Rong returns to Beicheng for work and is picked up by Zhang Henian, her father's second wife's brother, with whom she shares a complicated past.
context:
Title: Hidden in Day and Night
Description: Qin Rong returns to Beicheng for work and is picked up by Zhang Henian, her father's second wife's brother, with whom she shares a complicated past.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY (DREAM SEQUENCE)

Soft light. QIN RONG and ZHANG HENIAN embrace intimately.

ZHANG HENIAN leans close to QIN RONG's ear, whispering.

QIN RONG's fingers gently trace across ZHANG HENIAN's lips. They gaze deeply at each other, about to kiss.

CUT TO: The two kissing on a sofa, the atmosphere intimate.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT (O.S.)
Miss Qin.

INT. AIRPLANE CABIN - DAY

QIN RONG jolts awake, finding herself sitting on an airplane.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT
Miss Qin. The plane will be landing soon. Let me adjust your seat back for you.

QIN RONG
Thank you, I'll manage.

The FLIGHT ATTENDANT nods. QIN RONG adjusts the seat back herself, breathing a sigh of relief.

QIN RONG (V.O.)
Just a dream.

EXT. AIRPORT RUNWAY - DAY

An airplane lands smoothly on the runway.
continuation:
INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - DAY

QIN RONG pulls a pink suitcase, walking through the bustling airport terminal.

QIN RONG (V.O.)
Beicheng. One year. His territory.

ZHANG HENIAN, wearing black camouflage and sunglasses, walks toward her. They meet in the crowd and stop.

ZHANG HENIAN
Have you been waiting long?

QIN RONG
No, just arrived.

ZHANG HENIAN
Let's go.

ZHANG HENIAN naturally places his hand over QIN RONG's hand on the suitcase handle. They push the suitcase together and leave.

QIN RONG
I'm sorry to trouble you.

ZHANG HENIAN
No need.

INT. CAR - DAY

ZHANG HENIAN drives. QIN RONG sits in the passenger seat, fastening her seatbelt.

QIN RONG (V.O.)
Father's second wife's brother. My uncle. But he and I...

FLASHBACK:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

In a sunlit room, QIN RONG gently wipes ZHANG HENIAN's cheek as he lies on the sofa. The atmosphere between them is warm and intimate.

END FLASHBACK.

ZHANG HENIAN
Have you arranged a place to stay?

QIN RONG
I'll stay at a hotel first. The hospital will assign dormitories later.

ZHANG HENIAN
I have an apartment in the city center. Ten minutes from the hospital. You can stay there first.

QIN RONG
No need to trouble yourself.

ZHANG HENIAN
Your father arranged it. He told me to take care of you.

QIN RONG
What if your girlfriend comes over? It wouldn't be convenient.

ZHANG HENIAN
Who told you that?

QIN RONG
No one told me.

ZHANG HENIAN
You can stay there without worry. It won't be inconvenient.

QIN RONG
Then thank you, Uncle.

ZHANG HENIAN suddenly slams on the brakes. The car stops. He turns his head, staring sharply at QIN RONG.

ZHANG HENIAN
Qin Rong. What did you call me?

The FLIGHT ATTENDANT nods. QIN RONG adjusts the seat back herself, breathing a sigh of relief.

QIN RONG (V.O.)
Just a dream.

EXT. AIRPORT RUNWAY - DAY

An airplane lands smoothly on the runway.

INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - DAY

QIN RONG pulls a pink suitcase, walking through the bustling airport terminal.

QIN RONG (V.O.)
Beicheng. One year. His territory.

ZHANG HENIAN, wearing black camouflage and sunglasses, walks toward her. They meet in the crowd and stop.

ZHANG HENIAN
Have you been waiting long?

QIN RONG
No, just arrived.

ZHANG HENIAN
Let's go.

ZHANG HENIAN naturally places his hand over QIN RONG's hand on the suitcase handle. They push the suitcase together and leave.

QIN RONG
I'm sorry to trouble you.

ZHANG HENIAN
No need.

INT. CAR - DAY

ZHANG HENIAN drives. QIN RONG sits in the passenger seat, fastening her seatbelt.

QIN RONG (V.O.)
Father's second wife's brother. My uncle. But he and I...

FLASHBACK:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

In a sunlit room, QIN RONG gently wipes ZHANG HENIAN's cheek as he lies on the sofa. The atmosphere between them is warm and intimate.

END FLASHBACK.

ZHANG HENIAN
Have you arranged a place to stay?

QIN RONG
I'll stay at a hotel first. The hospital will assign dormitories later.

ZHANG HENIAN
I have an apartment in the city center. Ten minutes from the hospital. You can stay there first.

QIN RONG
No need to trouble yourself.

ZHANG HENIAN
Your father arranged it. He told me to take care of you.

QIN RONG
What if your girlfriend comes over? It wouldn't be convenient.

ZHANG HENIAN
Who told you that?

QIN RONG
No one told me.

ZHANG HENIAN
You can stay there without worry. It won't be inconvenient.

QIN RONG
Then thank you, Uncle.

ZHANG HENIAN suddenly slams on the brakes. The car stops. He turns his head, staring sharply at QIN RONG.

ZHANG HENIAN
Qin Rong. What did you call me?

title: Hidden Beauty
description: After five years of unthinkable transformation, a scarred woman emerges with her enemy's perfect face to dismantle the family that destroyed her own.
context:
Title: Hidden Beauty
Description: After five years of unthinkable transformation, a scarred woman emerges with her enemy's perfect face to dismantle the family that destroyed her own.

INT. MEDICAL HALL - NIGHT

In a candlelit room, a woman in simple robes, SHEN ZHIYI, faces away from the camera, her face wrapped in bandages dark with fluid. She slowly raises a trembling hand and unwraps the final layer.

SHEN ZHIYI (V.O.)
Five years. Two thousand nights of insects feeding on bone. All to wear your face.

The bandages fall away, revealing a delicate and beautiful face. She looks at herself in the mirror, her eyes flickering with disbelief and revulsion.

The witch doctor CAI YUE stands nearby.

SHEN ZHIYI
Cai Yue, do you think I look like Gu Xuerou?

FLASHBACK: A younger Shen crawls through broken glass, blood on her face, crying out in terror. Another woman in fine robes—GU XUEROU—laughs triumphantly as servants hold torches.

CAI YUE
Yes, exactly alike. Except your eyes hold what hers never could. The weight of having survived.

SHEN ZHIYI
(touching her own face)
Gu Xuerou, this time I will personally drag you down from your high position and trample you in the mud. I will return to you all the pain you inflicted, one by one.

SHEN ZHIYI's eyes are resolute as she clenches her fists tightly.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

A luxurious carriage bearing the Prime Minister's crest travels down the street.

INT. CARRIAGE - DAY

Inside the carriage, FATHER GU angrily slaps his daughter GU XUEROU across the face.

FATHER GU
You foolish girl! Why did you only tell me after His Majesty granted the marriage? If the Crown Prince discovers you're infertile, you'll drag our entire household down with you!

GU XUEROU
(covering her face, crying)
Father, I was wrong. That scholar seduced me. I've already had him beaten to death. I regret it too.

MOTHER GU
(comforting Father Gu)
Enough, enough. Husband, those lowly people are full of schemes. Our Rou'er is pure and innocent by nature, which is why she was deceived. The urgent matter now is to figure out how to help Rou'er deceive the Crown Prince.

GU XUEROU
(tugging at Father Gu's sleeve)
Father, please help me. Once I become Crown Princess, everything in the Great Yan Kingdom will be ours to command.

FATHER GU
But he's the Crown Prince! What can our household possibly do? Your wedding is in three days. Even if we find someone to replace you now, there isn't enough time!

The carriage suddenly stops with a loud crash.

EXT. STREET - DAY

The COACHMAN shouts angrily at the person in front of the carriage.

COACHMAN
You death-seeking fool! How dare you block the Prime Minister's carriage? Are you tired of living?

FATHER GU
(leaning out from inside)
What's happening?

The camera turns to reveal SHEN ZHIYI in front of the carriage, dressed in white mourning clothes, wearing a white veil, kneeling on the ground. Beside her stands a wooden sign reading "Filial Daughter - Will Serve."

SHEN ZHIYI
(kowtowing)
Forgive me, sir. I beg you to have mercy on this humble woman's filial devotion and allow my father to rest in peace. I am willing to serve you like an ox or horse.

COACHMAN
Get lost! How unlucky!

GU XUEROU descends from the carriage.

GU XUEROU
What lowly creature dares to block my carriage in the street? Drag her away and beat her!

SHEN ZHIYI slowly raises her head. Her face beneath the white veil is partially visible, her eyes fixed firmly on GU XUEROU.

GU XUEROU sees her face and freezes in shock.

GU XUEROU
Wait!

She turns back to look at her parents inside the carriage, a scheming smile spreading across her face.

GU XUEROU
Father, Mother... we've found someone to replace me!

title: Sweet and Doting Snake Lord Husband
description: A woman betrayed by her sister and husband is reborn on the day of her coming-of-age ceremony, determined to seek revenge for the wrongs done to her in her past life.
context:
Title: Sweet and Doting Snake Lord Husband
Description: A woman betrayed by her sister and husband is reborn on the day of her coming-of-age ceremony, determined to seek revenge for the wrongs done to her in her past life.

EXT. GOLDEN SNAKE PALACE - NIGHT

Thunder and lightning crash across a storm-swept sky. Rain pours down in violent sheets. MAID A and MAID B sprint from the palace entrance, silk robes clinging to their skin.

MAID A
The Consort's delivering! The Snake Lord's wife is in labor!

MAID B
And Lady Jiao—both sisters at once! The physicians are divided!

INT. GOLDEN SNAKE PALACE - BIRTHING CHAMBER - NIGHT

LIN ZHAOZHAO (20s, golden-eyed) writhes on the birthing bed, drenched in sweat and agony. A luminous GOLDEN EGG materializes mid-air, humming with ancestral power.

LIN ZHAOZHAO
(screaming)

MAID A
(delighted)
A golden egg! First-rank—blessed!

The egg pulses with corrupt energy. Its luster drains, replaced by pitch black. The humming dies.

LIN ZHAOZHAO
(terrified)
It was golden. I saw it.

LONG BEICHEN (30s, regal) strides in. His gaze locks on the black egg. His jaw clenches, scales rippling beneath his skin.

LONG BEICHEN
(furious)
A black egg. Fifth-rank filth, from pure golden blood.

LIN ZHAOZHAO
Beichen, my lineage scores prove—

LONG BEICHEN strikes her with his palm. She crashes into the wall.
continuation:
INT. GREEN SNAKE PALACE - BIRTHING CHAMBER - NIGHT

LIN JIAO (20s, delicate) stands gracefully, showing no sign of strain. A perfect GOLDEN EGG rests in her hands.

LIN JIAO
(mocking)
Sister's auspice... so easily taken.

INT. GOLDEN SNAKE PALACE - BIRTHING CHAMBER - NIGHT

MAID B
(quietly, to Maid A)
The clan ranks gold, purple, green, white, black. This makes no genealogical sense.

LIN JIAO enters, cradling the golden egg.

LIN JIAO
(sympathetic)
Poor sister. Two golden serpents cannot birth black. Who was he? That white-scaled diplomat who visited last spring?

LIN ZHAOZHAO
You did this. The egg changed after birth—

LIN JIAO
(leaning close, whispering)
I swapped them. My black egg for your golden. Beichen's seed was always mine.

FLASHBACK: LONG BEICHEN and LIN JIAO passionately kissing, his golden aura flowing into her.

LIN ZHAOZHAO
(breaking)
Why? I loved you both—

LIN JIAO
You overshadowed me our entire lives. But Beichen prefers my gentle grace. And I prefer... your fertility.

LONG BEICHEN
Swallow this bastard egg. Taint your own body with your shame.

Lin Jiao casts a spell. The black egg flies toward Lin Zhaozhao's mouth, forcing itself down. She collapses, convulsing.

LONG BEICHEN
Guards. Ten Thousand Snakes Pit. No burial rites.

EXT. TEN THOUSAND SNAKES PIT - NIGHT

Guards hurl Lin Zhaozhao over the cliff edge. She plummets toward the writhing abyss.

LIN JIAO stands at the cliff edge, watching. Her form shimmers. A SCORPION TAIL briefly manifests, then vanishes.

LIN JIAO
Since you're dying anyway—I'm not a snake. Your parents adopted a scorpion spirit. I repaid their kindness by destroying their bloodline.

LIN ZHAOZHAO
(desperate, defiant)
I'll return. I'll make you pay in blood and venom!

INT. SNAKE CLAN GREAT HALL - DAY

Lin Zhaozhao's eyes SNAP OPEN. She stands in the ceremonial hall among NOBLE SNAKES. An ELDER holds a fertility-testing jade to the light.

ELDER
The coming-of-age rites begin. Let Nüwa reveal their breeding potential.

LIN ZHAOZHAO
(inner monologue)
Reborn. The day they tested my worth. Lin Jiao, Long Beichen—this time, I'll bury you in the pit you dug for me.

She turns. Lin Jiao stands beside her, smiling sweetly. Lin Zhaozhao's gaze burns with cold determination.

title: Snake Woman and Dragon Son-in-Law & Live Up to Youth, Live Up to You
description: A poor college student who picks up bottles to make ends meet is pressured by his grandfather to bring a girlfriend home, leading to an unexpected arrangement with the campus beauty.
context:
Title: Snake Woman and Dragon Son-in-Law & Live Up to Youth, Live Up to You
Description: A poor college student who picks up bottles to make ends meet is pressured by his grandfather to bring a girlfriend home, leading to an unexpected arrangement with the campus beauty.

INT. MEMORY FLASHBACK - DAY

SU CHUANJIE (V.O.)
You little brat, your grandpa is already eighty-nine, about to enter the ancestral grave. If you still can't bring a girlfriend home by Tomb Sweeping Day, don't ever face the Su family ancestors again.

EXT. UNIVERSITY TRACK FIELD - DAY

SU CHUANJIE drags a large burlap sack, picking up plastic bottles on the track. His worn sneakers have holes. He checks his phone - a cracked screen displays a bank balance: ¥187.50.

SU CHUANJIE
(to himself)
Right. Ancestor festival in three days. Perfect timing.

INT. BENTLEY CAR - DAY

An extended Bentley drives slowly. In the back seat, OLD MASTER SU wears a straw hat and simple linen shirt. The driver is ZHAO CHONGJIU in a suit.

ZHAO CHONGJIU
Master, the board is questioning these weekly campus visits. They don't understand making the young master struggle like this.

OLD MASTER SU
They wouldn't. A blade must be tempered. Besides, hardship keeps him humble.

OLD MASTER SU spots a bottle by the roadside.

OLD MASTER SU
(stop)
Pull over.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

The Bentley stops. OLD MASTER SU watches as ZHAO CHONGJIU steps out to retrieve two plastic bottles from the ditch.

ZHAO CHONGJIU
(returning)
Master, with respect - even a rental BYD doesn't make this necessary.

OLD MASTER SU
(smiling)
He doesn't know it's a Bentley. Never will. The lesson is in the principle, not the performance.

ZHAO CHONGJIU
And the girl, sir?

OLD MASTER SU
If he's worthy, he'll find one. If not, the conglomerate finds another heir.

They drive away.
continuation:
EXT. CAMPUS PATH - DAY

SU CHUANJIE roots through a trash bin, pulling out bottles. His fingers are chapped. He spots SHISHI walking with friends, her designer bag obvious.

SU CHUANJIE
(hesitant)
Shishi? Could I...

SHISHI
(not breaking stride)
Chuanjie, I'm uploading.

SU CHUANJIE
Just for a day. Tomb Sweeping. My grandfather...

SHISHI
(turning, laughs)
You're serious? You want me to spend a holiday with your garbage-picking family? For content?

She walks off. SU CHUANJIE's knuckles whiten on the sack.

He approaches a WOMAN on a bench.

SU CHUANJIE
(nervous)
Miss? Sorry, this is weird, but...

WOMAN
(stands, moves away)
No thanks.

SU CHUANJIE
For my grandfather's festival, I meant. Not that you're...

WOMAN
Creep.

She hurries off. SU CHUANJIE sags against a tree.

SU CHUANJIE
(to himself)
Idiot.

A Maserati screeches to a halt. XIONG ANSHU steps out in vintage band tee and sunglasses. She ignores the gathering stares.

PASSING STUDENT A
That's Xiong Anshu. From the drama.

PASSING STUDENT B
What's she doing in the poor district?

XIONG ANSHU walks directly to SU CHUANJIE, phone in hand.

XIONG ANSHU
Chuanjie. I need a boyfriend for a day. You're poor, invisible, and desperate. Perfect.

SU CHUANJIE
(confused)
You know me?

XIONG ANSHU
I research. You're all about family duty. So am I, unfortunately.

PASSING STUDENT A
Did campus beauty just...

PASSING STUDENT B
That guy smells like garbage.

SU CHUANJIE
But why...

XIONG ANSHU
Because you won't get ideas. Name your price.

SU CHUANJIE
(calculating)
Eighty yuan is a good day. So...

XIONG ANSHU
I'll give you two thousand. Plus meals.

SU CHUANJIE
(shocked)
That's...

XIONG ANSHU
More if you convince my family we're real. Deal?

SU CHUANJIE
(steadying himself)
Deal. But we go to my grandfather's first. And I sell my time, not...

XIONG ANSHU
(leaning close)
Relax. I don't want your body.

She traces his jaw with one finger. He holds perfectly still.

XIONG ANSHU
(quietly)
I want your credibility. Don't disappoint me.

She turns to her car, leaving SU CHUANJIE frozen, sack still in hand.

title: Year of the Snake: Counterattack (Episode 37)
description: A young woman is kidnapped and realizes too late that she should have listened to her boyfriend's warnings about trusting the wrong people.
context:
Title: Year of the Snake: Counterattack (Episode 37)
Description: A young woman is kidnapped and realizes too late that she should have listened to her boyfriend's warnings about trusting the wrong people.

INT. RUNDOWN WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Darkness. The crunch of dry straw underfoot.

LIU GANG enters, pushing open a rusted metal door. It groans against the frame.

ZHOU XIAOXUE lies on a straw mat, bound and gagged, unconscious in a beige dress.

LIU GANG crouches beside her. His fingers tug at her dress collar.

ZHOU XIAOXUE's eyes snap open. Terror.

LIU GANG
Awake already? Good. Let's not waste the night.

She strains against the ropes, muffled screams escaping the gag.

ZHOU XIAOXUE (V.O.)
Du Bo's warnings echo. "Be careful who you trust." I laughed then. I don't laugh now.

LIU GANG
This won't take long.

ZHOU XIAOXUE (V.O.)
Jiaojiao's voice. The wine. The room spinning. If I had listened—

FLASHBACK BEGINS

INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

Neon lights flicker over HUANG JIAOJIAO and ZHOU XIAOXUE walking arm-in-arm.

HUANG JIAOJIAO
He's inside. Says he can connect you to that curator job.

ZHOU XIAOXUE
Du Bo doesn't like these places.

HUANG JIAOJIAO
Du Bo doesn't like anything that might set you free.

They laugh, disappearing into a private room.
continuation:
INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Dim lights pulse. Bottles clutter the table.

A phone BUZZES on the table—"Du Bo" on the caller ID.

ZHOU XIAOXUE answers, turning away from the noise.

ZHOU XIAOXUE
Hey. I'm still at the library.

INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

DU BO stands at the end of a hallway, phone pressed to his ear.

DU BO
Xiaoxue, where are you?

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

ZHOU XIAOXUE
(guiltily)
Working late.

DU BO (V.O.)
She's never lied before. Why now?

HUANG JIAOJIAO snatches the phone, ends the call.

HUANG JIAOJIAO
You're not his prisoner. Drink.

She pours whiskey into two glasses. Her body blocks Zhou's view as she slips powder into one.

HUANG JIAOJIAO
To new beginnings.

They drink. Zhou coughs—the liquor burns.

The door opens. LIAN FEI enters, sharp suit, predator's smile.

HUANG JIAOJIAO
Baby. Finally.

She hands him the second glass. They both watch Zhou.

ZHOU XIAOXUE
Jiaojiao... everything's tilting...

HUANG JIAOJIAO
(cold smile)
That's the good stuff.

ZHOU XIAOXUE
(speech slurring)
You... my friend...

HUANG JIAOJIAO
Friends don't let friends stay poor.

ZHOU XIAOXUE collapses. Her phone screen illuminates: "Payment received."

END FLASHBACK

INT. RUNDOWN WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

ZHOU XIAOXUE's breath steadies. She feels the rope knots.

LIU GANG
Your friend paid well. Said you were naive.

ZHOU XIAOXUE (V.O.)
If I survive this... I'll trust the quiet warnings more than loud promises. The love, not the lies.

She goes limp. Liu Gang relaxes his grip.

Her fingers find a loose nail in the floorboard.

ZHOU XIAOXUE (V.O.)
If.
full_script:

Description: A young woman is kidnapped and realizes too late that she should have listened to her boyfriend's warnings about trusting the wrong people.

INT. RUNDOWN WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Darkness. The crunch of dry straw underfoot.

LIU GANG enters, pushing open a rusted metal door. It groans against the frame.

ZHOU XIAOXUE lies on a straw mat, bound and gagged, unconscious in a beige dress.

LIU GANG crouches beside her. His fingers tug at her dress collar.

ZHOU XIAOXUE's eyes snap open. Terror.

Awake already? Good. Let's not waste the night.

title: Snake Year Fortune - Unstoppable Wedding
description: A wealthy heir marries against his mother's wishes, but his controlling mother and scheming friend have plans that could unravel everything.
context:
Title: Snake Year Fortune - Unstoppable Wedding
Description: A wealthy heir marries against his mother's wishes, but his controlling mother and scheming friend have plans that could unravel everything.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

Background music plays.

ON SCREEN: Chen Yihan, Wang Group Heir

CHEN HAN
Dad, Mom, please head upstairs. We'll be up for the tea ceremony shortly.

LIU'S MOTHER
It's too cold to wait out here.

LIU'S MOTHER
You're a thoughtful son-in-law.

ON SCREEN: Liu's Father, Liu Qianqian's Father

LIU'S FATHER
A son-in-law is half a son.

LIU'S MOTHER
Chen Han, we're entrusting our daughter to you now.

CHEN HAN
Mom, we're family. No need for formalities.

LIU'S FATHER
Go on then.

LIU'S FATHER
Let's go.

CHEN HAN stands alone, expression clouding. He checks his phone and makes a call.

INT. WANG GROUP OFFICE - DAY

ON SCREEN: Wang Group

ASSISTANT
The custom LV arrived this morning. They embossed our company logo as requested.

ON SCREEN: Wang Fang, Wang Group Chairman

WANG FANG
Subtle. Send our regards.

WANG FANG's phone rings. She answers it.

CHEN HAN (V.O.)
Mom... I'm married. Today.

WANG FANG
(ice in her voice)
Married.
continuation:
INT. VILLA LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

ON SCREEN: Three Years Earlier

WANG FANG sits rigid at the dining table. CHEN HAN pulls a suitcase.

WANG FANG
You're leaving this family for a woman?

CHEN HAN
Mom, Qianqian loves me—not the Wang name. If you can't accept that, I'll build my own life.

INT. WANG GROUP OFFICE - DAY

ASSISTANT
Congratulations, Chairman.

WANG FANG
That girl plays a long game. But my son has chosen.
(rising)
Prepare the customary gifts. I'll fulfill my role.

ASSISTANT
Of course.

WANG FANG
(smoothing her jacket)
If she knows her place, I'll tolerate this. If not...
The Wang Group doesn't forgive mistakes.

EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE - DAY

WANG FANG and her ASSISTANT exit, flanked by BODYGUARDS. They approach a Rolls-Royce.

WANG FANG
(getting into the car)
Set the GPS. We'll congratulate the couple.

INT. BADAO GROUP OFFICE - DAY

ON SCREEN: Badao Group

HU XIANG enters briskly, FEMALE SECRETARY trailing.

FEMALE SECRETARY
Sir, your three o'clock—

HU XIANG
Cancel it. Retrieve those black pearls from the vault.

FEMALE SECRETARY
The deep-sea pair you never sell?

HU XIANG
The Wang heir is marrying in our city. This gift buys us into their world. Move.

INT. WEDDING CAR - DAY

LIU QIANQIAN and bridesmaid ZHANG LIYA sit in the luxury sedan.

ON SCREEN: Liu Qianqian, Chen Han's Wife

ON SCREEN: Zhang Liya, Liu Qianqian's Best Friend

ZHANG LIYA
(glancing around)
Modest security, simple flowers... Qianqian, men test boundaries. We'll establish yours now. Follow my lead.

LIU QIANQIAN
(squeezing her hand)
You're always looking out for me. Best friends forever.

ZHANG LIYA
A reminder today saves years of headaches. Trust me.

LIU QIANQIAN
I do. Completely.

title: Happy Snake Year - The Red Envelope Mystery
description: A woman relives the moment before a cursed red envelope destroys her family, determined to change their fate.
context:
Title: Happy Snake Year - The Red Envelope Mystery
Description: A woman relives the moment before a cursed red envelope destroys her family, determined to change their fate.

INT. MONTAGE - NIGHT

A woman's bandaged face unwraps to reveal chemical burns. She screams at her phone: ¥0.00. A man falls from a rooftop. Zheng Chuchen struggles in a hayloft. Ye Jiajia films with her phone.

ZHENG CHUCHEN (V.O.)
One red envelope. Three days. Everyone I loved—gone.

INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Ten relatives crowd around a lazy susan with steaming hot pot, clinking beer bottles.

EVERYONE
Happy New Year!

AUNT
Jiajia's sending lucky money! Grab it!

ZHENG CHUCHEN
Happy New Year, everyone.

YE JIAJIA
First paycheck. From the heart.

Phones ping. Everyone swipes.

YE JIAJIA
8.88 yuan. Smooth sailing, cousin—biggest share.

YE JIAJIA
4.44 yuan, sister-in-law. Four seasons of fortune.

YE JIAJIA
6.66 yuan, uncle. Everything goes smoothly.

YE JIAJIA
All gone. May all your wishes come true.

EVERYONE
Cheers!
continuation:
INT. HAYLOFT - NIGHT

Zheng Chuchen lies in filthy straw, wrists burned by rope.

ZHENG CHUCHEN (V.O.)
Three days. That's all it took.

Flashback: Sister-in-law opens her envelope, sparks burn her face. Uncle's restaurant, a customer collapses, police arrive, he jumps from the window. Zheng Chuchen's parents tear her from a family photo. Uncle and Aunt hand her to a mountain man. Ye Jiajia films it.

ZHENG CHUCHEN (V.O.)
We were cursed. She stole my life.

INT. DINING ROOM - NIGHT

Zheng Chuchen sits at the table, holding her phone with the unopened envelope showing 8.88.

Ye Jiajia walks behind Zheng Chuchen.

YE JIAJIA
Aren't you going to open it, cousin?

Zheng Chuchen looks up, determination in her eyes.

ZHENG CHUCHEN (V.O.)
I was reborn to this moment.

Close-up of Zheng Chuchen's face, expression complex and resolute.

FADE OUT.

title: 2008 Yangcheng Train Station
description: During the 2008 Spring Festival travel rush, a family struggles to return home as a snowstorm causes train cancellations at Yangcheng Station.
context:
Title: 2008 Yangcheng Train Station
Description: During the 2008 Spring Festival travel rush, a family struggles to return home as a snowstorm causes train cancellations at Yangcheng Station.

INT. YANGCHENG TRAIN STATION - DAY

The train station hall is packed with people, a solid mass of bodies and baggage. YAZHI grips XUXU's hand tightly, scanning for NANNAN.

YAZHI
(anxiously)
Xuxu, hold on. Don't let go.

XUXU
Okay.

YAZHI
Nannan, here! Quickly!

NANNAN appears, backpack clutched to her chest.

NANNAN
Mom, they said Beijing is cancelled.

YAZHI
We're not Beijing. We're home.

Across the hall, ZHENGYANG waves tickets overhead.

ZHENGYANG
(shouting)
Yazhi! I got them!

YAZHI
All of them?

ZHENGYANG pushes closer, holding two tickets.

ZHENGYANG
Last two. Standing room only.

YAZHI
(confused)
But there's four--

ZHENGYANG
We'll sort it on the train. Now!

The loudspeaker crackles.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
Attention. Due to severe snow, all trains after 18:00 are cancelled. After 18:00 only.

The crowd erupts.

PASSERBY A
That's our train! 5:45!

PASSERBY B
No! My mother is waiting!

PASSENGER C
Five years. Five years I've saved.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
Trains before 18:00 depart as scheduled. Immediate boarding only.
continuation:
ZHENGYANG checks his watch.

ZHENGYANG
(shouting)
Five forty-two! Go!

They push forward.

A GUARD blocks the platform gate.

GUARD
Platform closed! Wait for next announcement!

PASSERBY D
Next announcement? Another year?

PASSERBY E
They can't stop us all! Push!

The crowd surges. The guard is shoved aside.

YAZHI
Nannan! Your hand!

NANNAN
Mom!

A shoulder, a suitcase, and their hands separate. Nannan stumbles.

XUXU
Sister!

ZHENGYANG
I've got her!

But the current pulls him forward with Xuxu.

YAZHI
(screaming)
Nannan! Nannan!

Nannan falls. Yazhi sees her on the floor through moving legs.

NANNAN
Mom! Mom!

Yazhi fights, immobilized by the crush.

YAZHI
(desperate)
She's just a child! Please!

The PA crackles. A whistle blows.

ANNOUNCER (V.O.)
Train K203, Platform 4. Final boarding. Now.

The crowd freezes. Then parts.

ZHENGYANG stands with Xuxu, his hand extended down to Nannan on the floor. He'd fought his way back.

ZHENGYANG
(breathless)
Yazhi. The tickets.

He holds them up. Two tickets. Four people. The choice hangs between them as the final call echoes. The guards are regrouping. The crowd is watching. Time has run out.

title: The Exchanged Life
description: A village celebrates a student's university admission with a million-yuan prize, but a shocking revelation turns the celebration upside down.
context:
Title: The Exchanged Life
Description: A village celebrates a student's university admission with a million-yuan prize, but a shocking revelation turns the celebration upside down.

EXT. DAOHUA VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

SFX: Sound of gongs and drums.

A group of VILLAGERS gather around a long table covered with red cloth, stacks of thick cash piled on top. Village Chief WU YOUDE wipes sweat from his brow, gripping a microphone. Behind him hangs a red banner reading: "Celebrating Our Village's College Success!"

WU YOUDE
Fellow villagers! Ten years. Ten long years since Daohua Village produced a college student. But this morning, the county office called. This year... this year we've done it.

The VILLAGERS cheer and celebrate.

WU YOUDE
But let's not get ahead of ourselves. The official team is coming to verify everything in person.

The VILLAGERS turn their attention to LIN SIWEN and her father LIN CHAOYANG near the front. Siwen clutches a worn school bag.

VILLAGER A
Old Lin, congratulations!

VILLAGER B
Has to be Siwen. She topped every exam since primary school.

VILLAGER C
Truly a phoenix from our humble nest. Your family's fortune is changing, Old Lin.

LIN SIWEN manages a nervous smile. LIN CHAOYANG bows slightly, his hands trembling. Nearby, WU XIAOMAN sits on a low wall, methodically eating a popsicle, her uniform tie loosened.

WU XIAOMAN
(quietly)
What a circus.

WU YOUDE
Siwen, step forward. Our village set aside one hundred thousand yuan each year for this moment. Ten years, it's become one million. But remember—the county must confirm the admission first.

The VILLAGERS murmur in amazement.

WU YOUDE
The team will be here any minute. If all goes smoothly...

LIN CHAOYANG
(faintly)
Thank you, Village Chief.

WU YOUDE
(raising his voice)
One million yuan. A life-changing sum.

VILLAGER C
Old Lin, have you thought about how—

LIN CHAOYANG suddenly pulls out a small, leather-bound notebook, pressing it to his chest.

LIN CHAOYANG
Every neighbor who helped Siwen—who bought her books, who shared their meals—it's all here. Not as debt. As gratitude.
continuation:
He looks at his daughter. Siwen hesitates, then slowly kneels, not to the crowd, but to a few familiar faces in front.

LIN SIWEN
(to specific villagers)
Auntie Zhang's steamed buns... Uncle Li's late-night tutoring... I remember everything. If I can go, I'll return. I'll make this place better for all of us.

The VILLAGERS applaud, some wiping their eyes.

VILLAGER A
Good child.

VILLAGER D
(shouting)
They're coming!

SFX: Gongs, drums, and motorcycle engines grow louder. WU XIAOMAN stands, brushing off her skirt.

WU XIAOMAN
Dad, I'm leaving.

WU YOUDE
Stay.

WU XIAOMAN
Why? This is her moment.

WU YOUDE
(glancing at the approaching motorcycles)
Just watch.

WU XIAOMAN
(frowning)
What did you do?

WU YOUDE doesn't answer. Two motorcycles draped in red silk pull up. The GOOD NEWS TEAM MEMBER steps off, holding an official envelope, his eyes downcast.

LIN SIWEN
(to her father, voice cracking)
Dad... we can finally...

LIN CHAOYANG
(tears falling)
Our ancestors can rest proud. That's all that matters.

LIN SIWEN
I just want you to rest, Dad. No more double shifts.

WU YOUDE intercepts the team member before he can reach the table.

WU YOUDE
Comrade, let me help you. The student is Lin Siwen, correct?

The official hesitates, looking at his clipboard.

GOOD NEWS TEAM MEMBER
Actually, sir... I'm here for Wu Xiaoman.

The words hang in the air. The gongs stop. LIN SIWEN's face drains of color. LIN CHAOYANG's hand grips his notebook until his knuckles whiten. WU XIAOMAN's popsicle falls from her hand, staining the dust red. WU YOUDE finally exhales, his smile thin and hollow.

The VILLAGERS turn their attention to LIN SIWEN and her father LIN CHAOYANG near the front. Siwen clutches a worn school bag.

VILLAGER A
Old Lin, congratulations!

VILLAGER B
Has to be Siwen. She topped every exam since primary school.

VILLAGER C
Truly a phoenix from our humble nest. Your family's fortune is changing, Old Lin.

LIN SIWEN manages a nervous smile. LIN CHAOYANG bows slightly, his hands trembling. Nearby, WU XIAOMAN sits on a low wall, methodically eating a popsicle, her uniform tie loosened.

WU XIAOMAN
(quietly)
What a circus.

WU YOUDE
Siwen, step forward. Our village set aside one hundred thousand yuan each year for this moment. Ten years, it's become one million. But remember—the county must confirm the admission first.

The VILLAGERS murmur in amazement.

WU YOUDE
The team will be here any minute. If all goes smoothly...

LIN CHAOYANG
(faintly)
Thank you, Village Chief.

WU YOUDE
(raising his voice)
One million yuan. A life-changing sum.

VILLAGER C
Old Lin, have you thought about how—

LIN CHAOYANG suddenly pulls out a small, leather-bound notebook, pressing it to his chest.

LIN CHAOYANG
Every neighbor who helped Siwen—who bought her books, who shared their meals—it's all here. Not as debt. As gratitude.

He looks at his daughter. Siwen hesitates, then slowly kneels, not to the crowd, but to a few familiar faces in front.

LIN SIWEN
(to specific villagers)
Auntie Zhang's steamed buns... Uncle Li's late-night tutoring... I remember everything. If I can go, I'll return. I'll make this place better for all of us.

The VILLAGERS applaud, some wiping their eyes.

VILLAGER A
Good child.

VILLAGER D
(shouting)
They're coming!

SFX: Gongs, drums, and motorcycle engines grow louder. WU XIAOMAN stands, brushing off her skirt.

WU XIAOMAN
Dad, I'm leaving.

WU YOUDE
Stay.

WU XIAOMAN
Why? This is her moment.

WU YOUDE
(glancing at the approaching motorcycles)
Just watch.

WU XIAOMAN
(frowning)
What did you do?

WU YOUDE doesn't answer. Two motorcycles draped in red silk pull up. The GOOD NEWS TEAM MEMBER steps off, holding an official envelope, his eyes downcast.

LIN SIWEN
(to her father, voice cracking)
Dad... we can finally...

LIN CHAOYANG
(tears falling)
Our ancestors can rest proud. That's all that matters.

LIN SIWEN
I just want you to rest, Dad. No more double shifts.

WU YOUDE intercepts the team member before he can reach the table.

WU YOUDE
Comrade, let me help you. The student is Lin Siwen, correct?

The official hesitates, looking at his clipboard.

GOOD NEWS TEAM MEMBER
Actually, sir... I'm here for Wu Xiaoman.

The words hang in the air. The gongs stop. LIN SIWEN's face drains of color. LIN CHAOYANG's hand grips his notebook until his knuckles whiten. WU XIAOMAN's popsicle falls from her hand, staining the dust red. WU YOUDE finally exhales, his smile thin and hollow.

title: After My Son Tricked Me onto a Mediation Show, I Saw the Truth
description: A mother is deceived by her son into appearing on a family mediation TV show, where her daughter-in-law accuses her of being a cruel mother-in-law, but the truth is far more complicated.
context:
Title: After My Son Tricked Me onto a Mediation Show, I Saw the Truth
Description: A mother is deceived by her son into appearing on a family mediation TV show, where her daughter-in-law accuses her of being a cruel mother-in-law, but the truth is far more complicated.

INT. TV STUDIO - DAY

LIN XIUYING, wearing a pink qipao, stands on stage under the spotlight, her expression grave.

LIN XIUYING (V.O.)
My son's gift. A ticket. My best qipao.

Quick cuts of her pregnant daughter-in-law WU YUANYUAN and son ZHAO QILE, both with complicated expressions.

LIN XIUYING (V.O.)
I didn't realize I would be the performance.

On stage, the family of three stands with the HOST, with a full audience below.

WU YUANYUAN
(trembling)
She monitors every bite I eat. Says meat will make the baby too large. In last month's heatwave, she locked the AC remote away. Five-minute showers, exactly.

WU YUANYUAN
(stroking her pregnant belly)
When the ultrasound suggested a girl, she took me to three different clinics. Wanted me to "reconsider."

LIN XIUYING
(firm)
That isn't what happened.

WU YUANYUAN
(accusing)
Then she killed my dog. Poisoned his food. Because she said his hair was "bad for the baby."

The audience murmurs, casting accusatory looks at LIN XIUYING.

ZHAO QILE walks up to LIN XIUYING and drops to his knees with a thud.

ZHAO QILE
Mom.

LIN XIUYING looks at her son in shock.

ZHAO QILE
(pleading)
For your grandson. For our family. Just say the words.

LIN XIUYING (V.O.)
My son kneels for her story.

LIN XIUYING clenches her fists tightly, her eyes both determined and sorrowful.

LIN XIUYING (V.O.)
The truth is a photograph under my cushion.
continuation:
INT. LIN XIUYING'S HOME - DAY

ON SCREEN: Six Hours Earlier - Lin Xiuying's Home

LIN XIUYING sits alone on the sofa, looking dejected.

LIN XIUYING (V.O.)
Three days of silence. Because I said not yet.

LIN XIUYING takes out bankbooks and bank cards from a box under the table, looking at the balances.

LIN XIUYING (V.O.)
Saved enough. But she's not saving him.

She takes out a photo from the box showing ZHAO QILE intimately embracing another, unfamiliar woman.

LIN XIUYING (V.O.)
Should I tell him?

The door opens and ZHAO QILE enters.

ZHAO QILE
Mom, I'm home.

LIN XIUYING, startled, hurriedly hides the photo back in the box and covers it.

ZHAO QILE
What's wrong? Why so flustered?

LIN XIUYING
(forcing a smile)
Nothing, nothing at all.

LIN XIUYING (V.O.)
The test isn't back. If this baby is his...

ZHAO QILE
Mom, what's really going on with you today? You seem so distracted. I know that the other day when I pressured you about buying the house, it upset you.

ZHAO QILE pulls out a show ticket from his pocket.

ZHAO QILE
Here, I specially bought a ticket to the live taping of "Love Mediation." I'm inviting you to go. Consider it my way of making amends.

LIN XIUYING
(delighted)
That show? Mom knows it. It's so popular now. So many people around me are watching it. This must have been expensive, right? Mom doesn't need it, you keep it for yourself.

ZHAO QILE
(pressing the ticket into his mother's hand)
I have something to do and can't go, so you have to go. Don't refuse. Hey, the show is starting soon. Go get dressed up nicely and head over there.

LIN XIUYING
(happily)
Alright! Mom accepts this filial gesture. In a bit, I'll take out my treasured qipao and go get a new hairstyle. I definitely won't embarrass you.

ZHAO QILE
(smiling)
Go on, go on.

LIN XIUYING smiles happily.

FADE OUT.
