title: Pursued by the Empress, the Proud Princess Regrets (Episode 61)
description: In the waning days of the Great Qian Dynasty, a mysterious strategist known as Master Fulong aids five lords in establishing peace. Fifteen years later, as disaster strikes again, the daughter of one lord seeks his help once more.
context:
Title: Pursued by the Empress, the Proud Princess Regrets (Episode 61)
Description: In the waning days of the Great Qian Dynasty, a mysterious strategist known as Master Fulong aids five lords in establishing peace. Fifteen years later, as disaster strikes again, the daughter of one lord seeks his help once more.

MONTAGE - VARIOUS LOCATIONS - DAY

A grand palace silhouetted against a hazy, golden sky. Below, a sea of people gathers, their murmurs like distant thunder.

A man in royal red robes stands on a balcony, his face etched with worry.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Great Qian Dynasty breathed its dying breaths. While the emperor drowned in wine and poetry, the realm fractured. Six provinces. Six lords with six armies. And one name whispered in both hope and desperation: Master Fulong.

Red banners snap in the wind above a marching army. The palace burns—flames consuming gilded halls. People flee through smoke-choked courtyards. Soldiers march toward a city gate consumed by fire.

EXT. FULONG PAVILION - DAY

Three lords stand before a modest pavilion. XIA YUAN, King of Qianzhou—stoic, weathered—leads. They bow to MASTER FULONG, who reclines in a yellow rosewood chair, eyes closed, a silk fan resting on his chest.

XIA YUAN
Xia Yuan of Qianzhou humbly requests Master Fulong's counsel. Our orchards wither. Our people hunger.

LORD WEI
(impassioned)
Wei of Yuezhou begs the same. Our mines run dry, our treasuries empty.

LORD MU
(gravely)
Mu of Cangzhou reports pirate fleets blockade our harbors. Trade dies.

MASTER FULONG
(still as stone)
Rise. I have no interest in courts or titles. But I will give each of you one thread to pull. Follow it, and your peoples will survive the chaos.

XIA YUAN
We await your wisdom, Master.

MASTER FULONG
(eyes opening—clear, cutting)
Qianzhou's mountains hide a secret. Plant persimmons where the mist gathers at dawn. The soil remembers blood; feed it fruit instead. In seven years, your tribute will feed half the realm.

He writes on a scroll, seals it with wax.

MASTER FULONG (V.O.)
Yuezhou's gold is not in the earth—it's in the water. Build your furnaces where three rivers meet. The sediment yields more than any mine.

A second scroll. A third.

MASTER FULONG (V.O.)
Cangzhou fears the sea. Become the sea. Hollow your cliffs into ship-holds that breathe with the tide. The pirates will find no shore to land upon, only walls of water and stone.

The lords accept their scrolls like holy relics, bowing low.

XIA YUAN
This debt will not be forgotten, Master.

MASTER FULONG
(faint smile)
Debt is a human invention. Go, and do not return unless the sky itself falls.

The lords depart, their steps lighter.
continuation:
EXT. FULONG PAVILION - DAY

MASTER FULONG remains motionless. His attendant, ACAI—a sharp-eyed young woman—watches from the shadows.

MASTER FULONG
Acai. Are they truly gone?

ACAI
The last horse passed the valley gate three minutes ago.

MASTER FULONG snaps upright. The silk fan becomes a propeller in his hand, stirring the air. He stretches, rolls his shoulders, and the ancient gravity falls away like a discarded cloak.

MASTER FULONG
Three minutes? I was aiming for five. These old generals have better hearing than I credited.

He peels away the artificial wrinkles at his temples—prosthetic appliances. Beneath, his skin is unlined.

MASTER FULONG
And not a single one brought decent wine. Or company worth looking at.

ACAI
(smiling despite herself)
Shall I summon the jade table, Master?

MASTER FULONG
Absolutely. My kingdom for a proper skewer.

ACAI unfolds a sleek, lacquered table that seems too modern for the setting. On it: marinated chicken skewers, a bowl of spices. MASTER FULONG withdraws from his robe a gauntlet of burnished jade and gold—etched with glowing sigils that pulse like embers. He slips it on, and a controlled flame ignites from his palm.

ACAI
The lords would weep to see their legendary strategist... grilling.

MASTER FULONG
The greatest strategy is knowing what truly matters. Right now, that's caramelization.

He rotates a skewer precisely.

ACAI
(accepting a perfectly charred wing)
You haven't aged a day in fifteen years. The villagers say you made a pact with the mountain spirits.

MASTER FULONG
The mountain spirits wish they had my skincare routine. Let's just say... I was born in a different calendar.

ACAI
Different calendar?

MASTER FULONG
(gears shifting)
The kind where empires rise and fall faster than you can blink. I'm what happens when someone brings a map to a knife fight, Acai. The chosen one was busy, so they sent me instead.

He laughs—self-aware, not quite mocking. ACAI chews her chicken, processing.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The scrolls were followed. Kingdoms rose. And the man who refused to rule became the axis upon which six realms turned.

INT. XIA YUAN'S BEDCHAMBER - NIGHT

TITLE CARD: FIFTEEN YEARS LATER - XIA KINGDOM IMPERIAL PALACE

Candles burn low. XIA YUAN, now white-haired and hollowed by illness, labors for breath. His daughter XIA YUNGE—mid-twenties, fierce, sleepless circles under her eyes—holds his hand between both of hers.

XIA YUNGE
Just rest, Father. I've doubled the granary rations. Su Yi from Qinke Academy arrives tomorrow.

XIA YUAN
(whispering, urgent)
Listen... the drought is no accident. The locusts... they're a symptom. Someone... wants our rivers.

His fingers tighten on hers.

XIA YUAN
Su Yi is brilliant, but he cannot see what I saw. You must find... the pavilion.

XIA YUNGE
(stiffening)
Father, you know I—

XIA YUAN
(interrupting)
Every night since you were twelve, you read his scroll by candlelight. Don't think I didn't know.

XIA YUNGE's mask cracks—just slightly.

XIA YUNGE
He was a myth. A story we told ourselves to feel less alone.

XIA YUAN
Myths don't age. You... you will need someone who doesn't play by the rules our enemies understand. Promise me... you'll ask.

A long silence. XIA YUNGE presses her forehead to her father's hand.

XIA YUNGE
I promise.

EXT. CITY GATE - DAY

XIA YUNGE, in practical riding leathers, mounts a white horse. Behind her: a lean retinue of guards, nothing ostentatious. Snow falls—not a flurry, but a warning.

XIA YUNGE
Qinke Academy first. Then... the mountain pass.

She gazes toward the horizon, where mist clings to distant peaks. The same mist from her father's stories.

XIA YUNGE
(to herself)
If you're real... you'd better be worth the wait.

She spurs her horse forward. The gates groan shut behind her.

title: After Being Abandoned for Treatment, I Rise Magnificently
description: A dying artist discovers her painting sold for millions, only to uncover her family's betrayal as she prepares for a triumphant return.
context:
Title: After Being Abandoned for Treatment, I Rise Magnificently
Description: A dying artist discovers her painting sold for millions, only to uncover her family's betrayal as she prepares for a triumphant return.

INT. AUCTION HOUSE - DAY

A packed auction hall. Auctioneer ZHAO MING commands the podium, gavel in hand.

ZHAO MING
Thirty million. Do I hear thirty-one?

Silence. ZHAO MING scans the room.

ZHAO MING
Going once. Going twice. Sold.

The gavel falls. Sparse applause. ZHOU YUSHENG sits mid-row, his subtle smile belying his excitement.

ZHAO MING
Lot 47: "I Love My Family" by Shengxia. Sold to Mr. Wang for thirty million.

Staff unveil the painting - a vibrant, emotionally charged canvas. The crowd murmurs appreciatively.

Zhou Yusheng discreetly texts on his phone.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

A shared room. DOCTOR ZHAO XINYU reviews a chart at SHENG ANNUAN's bedside. The hospital gown swallows her frail frame.

ZHAO XINYU
The surgical window is closing, Ms. Sheng. We need the deposit by Friday.

SHENG ANNUAN
My husband's meeting with investors today. He promised...

ZHAO XINYU
I understand. But without confirmation, I have to schedule you for palliative chemo instead.

The doctor exits. Nurse LIU HUIMIN squeezes Sheng Annuan's shoulder before following.

Sheng Annuan stares at her phone - no messages from "Husband." She dials. It rings. And rings. She hangs up, trembling.

Her phone VIBRATES. Zhou Yusheng's name appears. She answers.
continuation:
SHENG ANNUAN
Yusheng?

ZHOU YUSHENG (V.O.)
Senior. Your piece just sold. Thirty million.

Sheng Annuan's breath catches. The patient in the next bed, LI XIN, glances over.

SHENG ANNUAN
That's... that's impossible.

ZHOU YUSHENG (V.O.)
The buyer, Mr. Wang, wants to host a retrospective. This weekend, Jiangnan. Says you're the most undervalued artist of our time.

SHENG ANNUAN
This weekend... I don't know if I'll...

ZHOU YUSHENG (V.O.)
We'll make it work. Get some rest. I'll bring the contract tomorrow.

SHENG ANNUAN
Thank you.

She lowers the phone, tears streaming silently.

INT. OLD APARTMENT HALLWAY - DAY

Sheng Annuan, in a worn cardigan, climbs the stairs slowly, her energy depleted but hope flickering.

SHENG ANNUAN (V.O.)
Thirty million. Enough to breathe again. To live. To give them everything...

She reaches her door - it's slightly ajar. Muffled VOICES from within.

MOTHER-IN-LAW (O.S.)
...won't suspect a thing. She'll sign whatever you put in front of her.

HUSBAND (O.S.)
The donation papers are ready. Tonight, after we tell her about the loan.

Sheng Annuan's hand freezes on the doorframe. The key slips from her fingers, silent on the worn carpet.

Staff unveil the painting - a vibrant, emotionally charged canvas. The crowd murmurs appreciatively.

Zhou Yusheng discreetly texts on his phone.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

A shared room. DOCTOR ZHAO XINYU reviews a chart at SHENG ANNUAN's bedside. The hospital gown swallows her frail frame.

ZHAO XINYU
The surgical window is closing, Ms. Sheng. We need the deposit by Friday.

SHENG ANNUAN
My husband's meeting with investors today. He promised...

ZHAO XINYU
I understand. But without confirmation, I have to schedule you for palliative chemo instead.

The doctor exits. Nurse LIU HUIMIN squeezes Sheng Annuan's shoulder before following.

Sheng Annuan stares at her phone - no messages from "Husband." She dials. It rings. And rings. She hangs up, trembling.

Her phone VIBRATES. Zhou Yusheng's name appears. She answers.

SHENG ANNUAN
Yusheng?

ZHOU YUSHENG (V.O.)
Senior. Your piece just sold. Thirty million.

Sheng Annuan's breath catches. The patient in the next bed, LI XIN, glances over.

SHENG ANNUAN
That's... that's impossible.

ZHOU YUSHENG (V.O.)
The buyer, Mr. Wang, wants to host a retrospective. This weekend, Jiangnan. Says you're the most undervalued artist of our time.

SHENG ANNUAN
This weekend... I don't know if I'll...

ZHOU YUSHENG (V.O.)
We'll make it work. Get some rest. I'll bring the contract tomorrow.

SHENG ANNUAN
Thank you.

She lowers the phone, tears streaming silently.

INT. OLD APARTMENT HALLWAY - DAY

Sheng Annuan, in a worn cardigan, climbs the stairs slowly, her energy depleted but hope flickering.

SHENG ANNUAN (V.O.)
Thirty million. Enough to breathe again. To live. To give them everything...

She reaches her door - it's slightly ajar. Muffled VOICES from within.

MOTHER-IN-LAW (O.S.)
...won't suspect a thing. She'll sign whatever you put in front of her.

HUSBAND (O.S.)
The donation papers are ready. Tonight, after we tell her about the loan.

Sheng Annuan's hand freezes on the doorframe. The key slips from her fingers, silent on the worn carpet.

title: After Her Thoughts Are Read, The Mystic Heiress Is Doted On By Her Whole Family
description: A reborn cultivator with the ability to read minds must navigate modern treachery while discovering that true power lies not in strength, but in the connections she builds.
context:
Title: After Her Thoughts Are Read, The Mystic Heiress Is Doted On By Her Whole Family
Description: A reborn cultivator with the ability to read minds must navigate modern treachery while discovering that true power lies not in strength, but in the connections she builds.

INT. CELESTIAL MOUNTAIN PEAK - DAY

JIANG JIU, dressed in white robes, levitates above a bamboo raft formation. Thunder rumbles as golden light fractures around her. She cries out—

JIANG JIU
I was so close!

Lightning obliterates her form in a blinding flash.

INT. MODERN LIVING ROOM - DAY

JIANG JIU gasps awake on a velvet sofa, clutching her bandaged wrist. The unfamiliar surroundings spin before her eyes resolve on—

CHU CICHEN enters, his polished shoes clicking against marble. He stops cold.

CHU CICHEN
(quietly)
Not dead, then.

JIANG JIU's head snaps up. His voice echoes twice—once spoken, once thought:

CHU CICHEN (V.O.)
(thought)
Thank god.

JIANG JIU
What did you—

He cuts her off with a dismissive turn.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Original JIANG JIU trembles on tile, razor in hand. Blood blooms in water. Her face wears not despair, but dawning horror—like something's controlling her.

INT. TAOIST TEMPLE - NIGHT

Candles flicker across a memorial tablet. The OLD TAOIST PRIEST drips wax onto a straw doll.

OLD TAOIST PRIEST
The soul suppression is complete. She'll finish what she started.

LIN CAIWEI hovers near the door, phone clutched tight.

LIN CAIWEI
And the memories?

OLD TAOIST PRIEST
(selecting a thicker needle)
Buried deep. She'll never remember the pregnancy.

LIN CAIWEI's knuckles whiten. She doesn't smile—just nods, hollow.
continuation:
INT. MODERN LIVING ROOM - DAY

JIANG JIU stares at the bandages, then at CHU CICHEN's retreating back. His thoughts bleed through again—images of a sonogram, a hospital corridor, his own voice begging.

CHU CICHEN (V.O.)
(thought)
Not again. I can't lose another—

JIANG JIU
(rising)
The child wasn't yours?

CHU CICHEN freezes. His mask cracks.

CHU CICHEN
How could you—

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

A drugged, hazy vision: CHU CICHEN's face above hers, but his eyes are wrong—too dark, too empty. LIN CAIWEI stands in the corner, filming. She's crying.

INT. MODERN LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHU CICHEN
(strangled)
Three years. You've tormented Caiwei for three years.

His thoughts scream louder than his voice:

CHU CICHEN (V.O.)
(thought)
You pushed her down the stairs. You took everything. But I saw the tox screen. I know what they did to you.

JIANG JIU's grip trembles—not with rage, but recognition. The original owner's memories surface: hands pushing her, a voice whispering "drink this," waking in that hotel room.

JIANG JIU
(softly, to herself)
You were protecting her.

CHU CICHEN
(bruised)
What madness now?

He thinks: I deserved that. I let them destroy you.

INT. HALLWAY - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Original JIANG JIU reaches for LIN CAIWEI, who's already stepping backward, already bracing. The fall is choreographed. But in the background—barely visible—a MAID watches from a cracked door.

INT. MODERN LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHU CICHEN throws the divorce papers down.

CHU CICHEN
Sign it. End this.

JIANG JIU touches the document. It doesn't burn—instead, her fingers trace the characters: "Irreconcilable Differences." She reads his final thought:

CHU CICHEN (V.O.)
(thought)
Please remember. Please see the truth. I can't save you if you don't remember.

JIANG JIU looks up. Her eyes aren't cold anymore.

JIANG JIU
You think divorce will protect me?

Behind them, footsteps. CHU CICHEN's MOTHER and FATHER appear in the doorway, the maid from the flashback beside them. The mother's eyes dart from the destroyed coffee table to her son's bruises to JIANG JIU's bandaged wrist.

MOTHER
(to maid)
You were right. Bring the doctor. And the lawyers.

She moves to JIANG JIU, not her son.

MOTHER
(quietly)
Let's get you cleaned up. We'll need your statement.

JIANG JIU meets CHU CICHEN's eyes. For the first time, his thoughts and words align:

CHU CICHEN
(whisper)
Welcome back.

The family closes around her like a shield.

title: Foresee Death
description: A water delivery worker awakens a special ability to see people's impending deaths but struggles to save anyone because no one believes him.
context:
Title: Foresee Death
Description: A water delivery worker awakens a special ability to see people's impending deaths but struggles to save anyone because no one believes him.

INT. STREET - DAY

ZHANG HAIYANG rides a blue three-wheeled water delivery cart down an old street, his knuckles white on the handlebars.

ZHANG HAIYANG (V.O.)
Three days. Five faces. All gone.

ZHANG HAIYANG glances up at a high-rise building. A HIGH-ALTITUDE WORKER cleans windows on the exterior wall.

Special effect subtitles appear above the worker's head: [DEATH BY FALLING] and a countdown timer: 00:00:08.

ZHANG HAIYANG
(shouting)
The rope! Master, your rope!

The rope snaps. The worker falls. No scream—just the sickening crunch of impact.

ZHANG HAIYANG squeezes his eyes shut, gripping the handlebars until his hands shake.

ZHANG HAIYANG (V.O.)
I'm not a hero. I'm a ghost who watches.

INT. WATER DELIVERY STATION - DAY

TIME CARD: 11:30 AM

ZHANG HAIYANG pushes a cart loaded with water barrels into the station, his movements mechanical.

He passes COLLEAGUES—above each head, different timers, different causes. His eyes dart between them, calculating.

He stops cold. Above WU LI's head: [00:23:45 GAS EXPLOSION]. Above FU YI's: [00:24:02 GAS EXPLOSION].

FU YI reviews paperwork at his desk. WU LI answers calls.

WU LI
(into phone)
Happy District Building 502—yes, twenty minutes.

She hangs up, notices Zhang's stare.

WU LI
(concerned)
Old Zhang, you look like hell.
continuation:
ZHANG HAIYANG
Xiao Li... go home. Right now.

FU YI looks up.

FU YI
We have twelve pending orders.

ZHANG HAIYANG
(quietly urgent)
The building. A gas explosion in twenty-three minutes.

FU YI
Zhang Haiyang! Address me by my title!

FU YI slams a clipboard onto the desk.

FU YI (CONT'D)
Focus on your job or you're done.

Zhang looks around. Above the DELIVERY GUY's head: [00:15:20 GAS EXPLOSION]. Above two DISPATCHERS: [00:16:40 GAS EXPLOSION].

ZHANG HAIYANG
(to himself, barely audible)
Everyone. The whole building.

He drops the clipboard. It clatters. Every head turns.

ZHANG HAIYANG (CONT'D)
Fifteen minutes. You'll feel headaches first. Then—

FU YI
Enough!

Fu Yi grabs Zhang's arm. Zhang pulls free, but doesn't retreat. His terror has hardened into something else—resignation, or determination.

ZHANG HAIYANG
(softly, to the room)
I'm not asking you to believe me. I'm asking you to check.

He looks directly at Wu Li, who sees something in his eyes that makes her hesitate.

ZHANG HAIYANG (V.O.)
I couldn't stop the fall. But maybe I can make them listen before the fire.

The timers tick down. Zhang stands motionless, a messenger no one wants to hear.

FADE OUT.

title: Layoff and Restructuring Plan
description: A new general manager implements strict rules on his first day, firing his own fiancée for sleeping at work, only to discover she was key to a major deal.
context:
Title: Layoff and Restructuring Plan
Description: A new general manager implements strict rules on his first day, firing his own fiancée for sleeping at work, only to discover she was key to a major deal.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

CHU TIANJIAO and WU MEIXUE walk into the office surrounded by a group of EMPLOYEES.

FEMALE EMPLOYEE
(whispering)
Manager Chu's here. Everyone, look sharp.

CHU TIANJIAO
I'm Chu Tianjiao. My rules: late, leaving early, sleeping on shift—fired immediately. No exceptions.

CHU TIANJIAO sees LIN XIAOXIAO sleeping at her desk, contract files scattered around her.

CHU TIANJIAO
Lin Xiaoxiao.

He raps on her desk. Lin Xiaoxiao lifts her head, groggy.

LIN XIAOXIAO
Tianjiao... five more minutes...

She starts to put her head down again.

CHU TIANJIAO
Sleeping during work hours?

COLLEAGUE A
Manager Chu, she's been on the General Qin deal three nights straight.

COLLEAGUE B
She's exhausted. Just ten minutes.

CHU TIANJIAO
I care about performance, not reasons.

COLLEAGUE B
She volunteered to fix the contract. For the company.

LIN XIAOXIAO
(to herself)
Never again. Not for this salary.

WU MEIXUE
Manager Chu, she's your fiancée. Perhaps in private?

CHU TIANJIAO
(to Wu Meixue)
Rules don't bend, Meixue. Not for anyone.

LIN XIAOXIAO
(sitting up, voice sharp)
You'd let her twist you like this? She's been undermining that deal for days.

WU MEIXUE
I'm defending you, Xiaoxiao. Don't be ungrateful.

LIN XIAOXIAO
Your "defense" is sarcasm wrapped in silk.

CHU TIANJIAO
Enough. Lin Xiaoxiao, clear your desk. You're dismissed.
continuation:
LIN XIAOXIAO
You're serious? Over this?

CHU TIANJIAO
I don't let personal matters interfere with business. Even fiancées aren't exempt.

LIN XIAOXIAO
Then consider our engagement void. Severance?

CHU TIANJIAO
(takes cash from pocket)
Two months. Take it.

He throws it on the desk. Lin Xiaoxiao stares at the money, then laughs bitterly.

LIN XIAOXIAO
Double happiness.

She sweeps her things into a bag, humming: "I gave my youth to summer..." She exits. Silence.

MANAGER LU
Manager Chu, Lin Xiaoxiao blocked the chairman. The Qin contract—she's the signatory.

WU MEIXUE
I'm her supervisor. I prepared the documents.

MANAGER LU
General Qin only negotiates with her. You're the report writer. She's the relationship. We're dead without her.

CHU TIANJIAO
Then we get her back. Now.

MANAGER LU
She left a message: "Tell Tianjiao the engagement and deal are canceled. He can explain to Daddy."

WU MEIXUE
She can't—my degree—

The CHAIRMAN and GENERAL QIN enter.

GENERAL QIN
Where's Miss Lin? We need signatures.

CHAIRMAN
Son, get your fiancée.

CHU TIANJIAO
Dad... Xiaoxiao...

CHAIRMAN
What did you do?

CHU TIANJIAO
I fired her. For sleeping.

The Chairman's face darkens. General Qin checks his watch.

GENERAL QIN
Then I suggest you unfire her. In twenty minutes. Or I leave.

CHAIRMAN
(low, dangerous)
You fired the woman who secured this merger? Explain.

FADE OUT.

title: Diva Awards Ceremony
description: A famous singer publicly refuses an award after being deceived by an entertainment company, leading to tragic consequences when the company retaliates against her family.
context:
Title: Diva Awards Ceremony
Description: A famous singer publicly refuses an award after being deceived by an entertainment company, leading to tragic consequences when the company retaliates against her family.

TITLE CARD: DIVA AWARDS - AWARDS CEREMONY

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY VENUE - NIGHT

Crystal chandeliers cast fractured light across a sea of designer gowns and tuxedos. The audience murmurs with anticipation. The HOST, a veteran presenter with a practiced smile, stands center stage.

HOST
Tonight, we celebrate excellence. Please welcome Yinhuang Entertainment's Chairman, Wang Changjun, to present the Grand Xia Top Ten Songs Award to our own Lin Yue.

WANG CHANGJUN, silver-haired and impeccably tailored, strides to the podium. He accepts the crystalline trophy from an attendant with a gracious nod. He extends it toward LIN YUE, who stands at the edge of the stage, her silk gown shimmering like armor.

Lin Yue doesn't take the trophy. Instead, she reaches for the microphone, her fingers steady, her eyes scanning the room.

LIN YUE
The invitation said "Most Popular Female Singer." Your company gave that award to your daughter's new protege. So you manufactured this trophy instead. Real artistry doesn't need consolation prizes.

A collective gasp ripples through the auditorium. Cameras flash like lightning. Wang Changjun's smile freezes.

Lin Yue turns and walks off stage, her heels clicking a staccato rhythm against the marble floor.

LIN YUE (V.O.)
Never again.

REPORTERS surge forward, a tidal wave of shouted questions and extended microphones.

REPORTER (V.O.)
Chairman Wang! Is this retaliation for your contract dispute?

HOST
(arms raised, placating)
Technical error! There must have been a mix-up in the program!
continuation:
INT. YINHUANG ENTERTAINMENT - BOARDROOM - NIGHT

Wang Changjun stares at a wall of monitors replaying Lin Yue's exit on every news channel. His reflection ghosts across the darkened glass. He crumples a financial report in his fist—headlines screaming "Yinhuang Stock Plummets."

WANG CHANGJUN
(quietly, to the monitors)
You think you can humiliate me and walk away?

He turns to his SUBORDINATE, a shadow in the corner.

WANG CHANGJUN
She cost me three hundred million in market value before midnight. Make sure her next performance is her last.

SUBORDINATE
(adjusting his cufflinks)
How comprehensive?

WANG CHANGJUN
Everything she values. Leave nothing.

INT. LIN YUE'S HOME - LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A modest apartment, warm with string lights and vinyl records. Lin Yue curls on the sofa, scrolling through her phone—supportive messages from fans flooding her screen. Her HUSBAND emerges from the kitchen with two mugs of tea.

HUSBAND
They're calling you the voice of integrity.

LIN YUE
They're calling Yinhuang a sinking ship.

The lights flicker. Once. Twice. Then die.

HUSBAND
(quiet, urgent)
The breaker—

Glass shatters in the bedroom. Heavy boots on hardwood.

Lin Yue's husband shoves her behind him as SHADOWS converge from three directions, black masks and glinting blades.

INT. LIN YUE'S HOME - HALLWAY - CONTINUOUS

The fight is brutal and silent—professional killers vs. a man fighting for his life. Her husband lands a solid blow, but there are too many. A blade flashes. He grunts, staggers.

EXT. LIN YUE'S HOME - COURTYARD - NIGHT

title: The Cemetery
description: A former immortal emperor, now a spirit bound to his grave, plays chess with a fellow immortal while his son unknowingly awakens a powerful destiny through his desperate plea.
context:
Title: The Cemetery
Description: A former immortal emperor, now a spirit bound to his grave, plays chess with a fellow immortal while his son unknowingly awakens a powerful destiny through his desperate plea.

INT. CEMETERY - DAY

Ancient tombstones sleep beneath swaying cypress trees. YE IMMORTAL EMPEROR and NINE YANG IMMORTAL, a spectral elder in flowing white, sit before a floating chess board.

NINE YANG IMMORTAL
You always did prefer... atmospheric settings.

YE IMMORTAL EMPEROR
During tribulation, my son mistook my soul's departure for death. They cremated me. Now my spirit anchors to these ashes.

He places a piece. The board glows.

YE IMMORTAL EMPEROR
(calm)
Checkmate.

YE IMMORTAL EMPEROR
Without that single spark of immortality left in my remains, I'd be scattered to the void.

NINE YANG IMMORTAL
Your son carries the Sage's Fortune. Reality bends to his words. True?

YE IMMORTAL EMPEROR
True. Each manifestation burns through his mortal years. I've kept it dormant, waiting for his body to ripen.

YE IMMORTAL EMPEROR's head snaps up.

YE IMMORTAL EMPEROR
He's here.

YE IMMORTAL EMPEROR
(urgent)
Conceal us.

They dissolve into golden motes of spiritual essence.
continuation:
EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

YE FAN shuffles through the gates in a faded delivery uniform, plastic bag clutched to his chest. Exhaustion drags at every step.

He kneels before a humble tombstone, arranging bruised fruit and lighting incense.

YE FAN
Dad.

He sets down a crushed cigarette pack.

YE FAN
You promised me power. Destiny. I'm twenty-six, Dad. Twenty-six years of waiting.

YE FAN slumps onto the grass, voice raw.

YE FAN
(desperately)
Two thousand bad reviews. Five hundred drinks to the face. Today's losses—eight hundred yuan. And Jia... she left. Eight years, gone.

His tears drop onto the dirt.

YE FAN
(pleading)
If you weren't lying... just give me something real. Someone who stays. Enough to breathe.

YE FAN slams his palms on the grave, throwing his head back with a choked cry.

A silent pulse of golden light ripples from the tombstone.

INT. LUXURIOUS OFFICE - DAY

A palatial manor overlooking a private lake. GRAND ELDER reclines on rosewood, smoking a golden pipe. SUBORDINATE 1 stands at attention.

SUBORDINATE 1
Elder, John Family representatives await the hundred-billion merger signature.

SUBORDINATE 2 bursts in, breathless.

SUBORDINATE 2
Elder! The Master's fate tablet— it ignited!

GRAND ELDER
(shooting to his feet)
Thirty years silent.

GRAND ELDER
(awed)
His inheritance built our empire. If he's returned...

SUBORDINATE 2
His lifeline has ended. But there's an heir. Ye Fan. Jiang City. A deliveryman.

GRAND ELDER
(freezing)
An heir.

GRAND ELDER
(to SUBORDINATE 1)
Cancel the meeting. Fuel the jet.

He strides toward the door, then stops.

GRAND ELDER
(quietly)
Do the Three Fates know?

SUBORDINATE 2
(swallowing)
Their bindings would have sensed it. They're moving already.

GRAND ELDER
(pale)
Gods help us.

He sprints from the office, subordinates scrambling behind.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

YE FAN stares at his hands. The cigarette on the grave has transformed into a jade talisman, pulsing with faint light. He reaches for it, trembling.

FADE OUT.

title: Remember! I Am the Medicine God
description: A dedicated scientist spends three years developing a breakthrough cancer drug to fulfill his promise to his wife, only to return home and discover her betrayal.
context:
Title: Remember! I Am the Medicine God
Description: A dedicated scientist spends three years developing a breakthrough cancer drug to fulfill his promise to his wife, only to return home and discover her betrayal.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

FAST CUTS: A modern city skyline at dawn. A laboratory window reflects Su Chen's exhausted face. Chemical reagents bubble in sophisticated instruments.

SU CHEN, early thirties with silvering hair at his temples, carefully drips a crimson solution into a crystalline chamber. The mixture glows faintly.

Around him, COLLEAGUES watch in hushed anticipation.

A laptop screen shows rotating DNA helices and data streams. A timer counts down: 00:00:10.

COMPUTER SCREEN (V.O.)
Final trial: Anti-cancer compound XR-7.

The countdown hits zero. Data spikes across the screen.

COMPUTER SCREEN (V.O.)
Test complete. All markers: Optimal.

The display reads: "XR-7 Clinical Trial - SUCCESS."

FEMALE COLLEAGUE A
(barely containing emotion)
It's... it's perfect.

FEMALE COLLEAGUE B
(to Su Chen, voice thick)
Three years. You actually did it.

MALE COLLEAGUE A
Director Su, this will save thousands.

OLD PROFESSOR
(quietly, with weight)
Your wife's company has its miracle.

SU CHEN touches the screen, his reflection overlapping the data. He whispers:

SU CHEN
For you, Ruoxue. For your mother.

CUT TO:

A wedding photo—SU CHEN and LIN RUOXUE, laughing—sits next to a legal document: "Asset Transfer Agreement."
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

LIN RUOXUE, elegant but with hollow eyes, sits at the vanity. YOUNG MASTER JIANG (30s, predatory charm) appears behind her, placing hands on her shoulders.

LIN RUOXUE
The IPO hearings are Monday. If the valuation collapses...

YOUNG MASTER JIANG
(smoothly)
The Jiang Group's capital infusion is guaranteed. Your biotech firm will be the star of the market.

LIN RUOXUE
(still uncertain)
But without Su Chen's research...

YOUNG MASTER JIANG
You have my word. That's worth more than any three-year delusion.

He lifts the wedding photo, studies it.

YOUNG MASTER JIANG
He gave you promises. I give you certainty.

He sets it face-down. LIN RUOXUE watches, her throat working silently.

LIN RUOXUE
(soft, broken)
I can't wait anymore. The company, my mother's debt... I'm drowning.

YOUNG MASTER JIANG
Then let me be your life raft.

He draws her to the bed. She goes, not eagerly, but like someone surrendering to gravity.

The photo lies face-down, glass cracking beneath YOUNG MASTER JIANG's shoe.

INT. HOME HALLWAY - DAY

SU CHEN, in a tailored suit, clutches a briefcase and a temperature-controlled case. He almost rings the doorbell, then uses his key—surprised it's not changed.

SU CHEN (V.O.)
She doesn't know I'm home early. She doesn't know I brought her mother's cure... and her company's future.

He hears a soft moan from the bedroom. Freezes. Then moves, quiet and numb.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

SU CHEN pushes the door open. The briefcase slips from his hand.

LIN RUOXUE and YOUNG MASTER JIANG entangled. She looks up, sees him.

Not contempt. Pure, raw horror.

LIN RUOXUE
(whisper)
Chen...

The temperature-controlled case hits the floor. A faint crack.

SU CHEN's face doesn't show pain. It shows nothing at all. The face of a man whose soul has just left his body.

FADE OUT.

title: Promise You This Life's Favor
description: At a high society garden party, the wealthy and famously private Pei Jinghuai becomes the target of scheming women after his grandmother's public announcement of a matchmaking reward.
context:
Title: Promise You This Life's Favor
Description: At a high society garden party, the wealthy and famously private Pei Jinghuai becomes the target of scheming women after his grandmother's public announcement of a matchmaking reward.

EXT. GARDEN PARTY - DAY

Four elegantly dressed women surround a table laden with desserts and champagne, each glancing at their phones.

WOMAN A
(whispering excitedly)
Old Mrs. Pei just posted—Pei Jinghuai is officially "open to introductions." Ten billion dowry, plus Pei Corporation shares.

WOMAN B
Please. The man has a three-foot no-fly zone for women. Someone like you would make him break out in hives.

WOMAN C
He needs someone who actually reads his business journals, not just his bank statements.

FENG YOUYAO
(inner monologue)
They're playing checkers while the board's on fire.

ON SCREEN: Pei Jinghuai, CEO of Pei Corporation.

A shot flashes of Pei Jinghuai's weary face.

EXT. GARDEN PARTY - NIGHT

The party continues under string lights. Pei Jinghuai sits alone, massaging his temples.

WOMAN A saunters toward him, blocking his exit path.

WOMAN A
Smile, handsome. My portfolio's more interesting than your frown.

Pei Jinghuai stiffens. Blood trickles from his nose. He wipes it quickly, stands, and grabs the nearest champagne flute.

PEI JINGHUAI
You want attention? Here's your spotlight.

He pours the champagne down the front of her dress. She shrieks. He walks away, jaw tight.
continuation:
INT. OFFICE - DAY

Pei Jinghuai stands at a window, overlooking the city. ZHOU JINGMEI enters with documents.

ZHOU JINGMEI
The Singapore deal needs your signature. And my father's asking... again... about dinner.

PEI JINGHUAI
Tell Minister Zhou I don't do political theater.

He turns, his reflection ghosted against the glass—utterly alone.

EXT. GARDEN PARTY - NIGHT

Back at the party. Feng Youyao watches Pei from across the lawn. She pulls a small vial from her clutch—homeopathic stress drops—and adds them to a fresh glass of water.

She intercepts Pei as he reaches for a wine glass.

FENG YOUYAO
You need this more.

She swaps the glasses. Pei Jinghuai studies her, then drinks the water.

PEI JINGHUAI
You didn't ask about the reward.

FENG YOUYAO
I'm allergic to grandmothers who meddle.

Pei Jinghuai's tension visibly eases. He gestures toward the quiet tent.

PEI JINGHUAI
Walk with me.

INT. TENT - NIGHT

Inside the lantern-lit tent, Pei Jinghuai turns to face Feng Youyao.

PEI JINGHUAI
You're the first person tonight who looked at me like a liability, not a lottery ticket.

FENG YOUYAO
Maybe I like fixing broken things.

A beat. He steps closer. She doesn't retreat.

PEI JINGHUAI
I'm not broken. Just... very tired.

He cups her face gently. She leans in. Their foreheads touch.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: Eerie Harem
description: In a mysterious imperial palace, a palace maid named Chaoyan searches for her sister's soul pearl, suspecting it may be connected to the ageless Imperial Consort who has held the Emperor's favor for ten years.
context:
Title: Eerie Harem
Description: In a mysterious imperial palace, a palace maid named Chaoyan searches for her sister's soul pearl, suspecting it may be connected to the ageless Imperial Consort who has held the Emperor's favor for ten years.

EXT. PALACE CORRIDOR - NIGHT

A lone lantern bleeds crimson light across frost-slicked stones. CHAOYAN (20s), hollow-eyed and shivering, presses trembling fingers against her chest where a faint blue glow pulses beneath her robes. She freezes.

CHAOYAN
(whisper)
Jiejie... is that you?

In the distance, YAOHUA PALACE doors explode with a blinding white light. The glow from Chaoyan's chest flares in response, then dies. She gasps, staggers back—the lantern crashes. Footsteps echo. She runs.

EXT. PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

Snow falls like ash. Twenty palace maids kneel in rigid formation, heads bowed. Chaoyan is among them, her knuckles white with cold and terror. No one speaks. The silence is its own death sentence.

A palanquin emerges through the flurry—blood-red silk curtains concealing its occupant. The IMPERIAL CONSORT's shadow moves within like a flame. Her attendant, DENGXIN, surveys the maids with flat, reptilian patience.

DENGXIN
Her Ladyship requires a new handmaiden for the inner chamber.
continuation:
A collective shudder ripples through the line. Dengxin stops before Chaoyan, whose head remains dutifully lowered—yet her jaw is clenched with something other than fear.

DENGXIN
You. Look at me.

Chaoyan obeys. In her eyes: grief sharpened to a weapon. Dengxin studies her a beat too long, then steps aside.

IMPERIAL CONSORT (O.S.)
This one.

The voice is porcelain-thin, cracking with centuries. The Consort emerges—not beautiful, but unchanging. Timeless. Her gaze fixes on Chaoya's chest, where the blue glow has begun to pulse again, faint but undeniable.

IMPERIAL CONSORT
She smells of blood and memory. Bring her.

Chaoyan's breath hitches. She rises, not as a victim, but as a hunter who has finally cornered her prey. Dengxin grips her arm—warning or anchor, it's impossible to tell.

DENGXIN
(soft, only for Chaoyan)
Pray she doesn't taste what you're hiding.

They walk toward the palace. The white light behind its doors waits.

A lone lantern bleeds crimson light across frost-slicked stones. CHAOYAN (20s), hollow-eyed and shivering, presses trembling fingers against her chest where a faint blue glow pulses beneath her robes. She freezes.

CHAOYAN
(whisper)
Jiejie... is that you?

In the distance, YAOHUA PALACE doors explode with a blinding white light. The glow from Chaoyan's chest flares in response, then dies. She gasps, staggers back—the lantern crashes. Footsteps echo. She runs.

EXT. PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

Snow falls like ash. Twenty palace maids kneel in rigid formation, heads bowed. Chaoyan is among them, her knuckles white with cold and terror. No one speaks. The silence is its own death sentence.

A palanquin emerges through the flurry—blood-red silk curtains concealing its occupant. The IMPERIAL CONSORT's shadow moves within like a flame. Her attendant, DENGXIN, surveys the maids with flat, reptilian patience.

DENGXIN
Her Ladyship requires a new handmaiden for the inner chamber.

A collective shudder ripples through the line. Dengxin stops before Chaoyan, whose head remains dutifully lowered—yet her jaw is clenched with something other than fear.

DENGXIN
You. Look at me.

Chaoyan obeys. In her eyes: grief sharpened to a weapon. Dengxin studies her a beat too long, then steps aside.

IMPERIAL CONSORT (O.S.)
This one.

The voice is porcelain-thin, cracking with centuries. The Consort emerges—not beautiful, but unchanging. Timeless. Her gaze fixes on Chaoya's chest, where the blue glow has begun to pulse again, faint but undeniable.

IMPERIAL CONSORT
She smells of blood and memory. Bring her.

Chaoyan's breath hitches. She rises, not as a victim, but as a hunter who has finally cornered her prey. Dengxin grips her arm—warning or anchor, it's impossible to tell.

DENGXIN
(soft, only for Chaoyan)
Pray she doesn't taste what you're hiding.

They walk toward the palace. The white light behind its doors waits.

title: Mistakenly Provoking the Rose
description: A young woman who was switched at birth discovers her true identity after being mistreated by her adoptive family, only to find her real family is far more powerful than anyone imagined.
context:
Title: Mistakenly Provoking the Rose
Description: A young woman who was switched at birth discovers her true identity after being mistreated by her adoptive family, only to find her real family is far more powerful than anyone imagined.

INT. YE FAMILY VILLA EXTERIOR - DAY

LIN AIPING thrusts a DNA report at SHEN MEIGUI.

LIN AIPING
Our Ye family raised you for twenty-three years. You occupied Wan'er's identity for twenty-three years. You bully our real daughter and don't know gratitude? Kneel down and apologize right now!

SHEN MEIGUI
(quietly)
I've never bullied anyone.

YE JIANGBO
You little bitch—what do you mean by that?

SHEN MEIGUI
Without me, where would you get all that money?

She turns and leaves.

YE WAN'ER
(crying)
Mom, Dad, look at her!

LIN AIPING and YE JIANGBO rush to comfort YE WAN'ER.

LIN AIPING
It's okay, it's okay. Don't worry.

YE JIANGBO
Her poor parents are already on their way. From now on, the Ye family has one heiress, and that's you.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

SHEN CHEN holds a walkie-talkie.

SHEN CHEN
Third Brother, lose the banner.

SHEN SHUANGCHENG (V.O.)
This will definitely scare our little sister.

SHEN CHEN
I could tolerate a fan display, but what is this?

SHEN SHUANGCHENG (V.O.)
Your passion, like a raging fire, ignites...

SHEN CHEN
Nonsense! Take it down!

SHEN SHUANGCHENG
You don't understand. Love needs expression.
continuation:
INT. ANOTHER LUXURY CAR - DAY

GU JINXIU speaks anxiously into the walkie-talkie.

GU JINXIU
Can you all hurry up?

SHEN CHEN (V.O.)
Of course we can! Speed up!

SHEN XINGYUN
Accelerate. We're bringing our sister home.

SHEN CHEN (V.O.)
Come on, speed up, accelerate!

EXT. ROAD - DAY

A large truck displays a red banner: "Miss Shen is coming! Everyone move aside!"

Suddenly, a loud crash. A rear-end collision.

EXT. ACCIDENT SCENE - DAY

The Shen family gets out.

SHEN XINGYUN
What happened?

DRIVER
Master, Madam, Young Masters, our vehicle rear-ended another car.

SHEN YAOYUAN
Handle it quickly.

SHEN CHEN
Dad, Mom, we're almost at my sister's house, but now the car won't run.

GU JINXIU
(crying)
When I think about your sister all these years—she should have lived a carefree, luxurious life as the Shen family's eldest daughter, but instead she went hungry at the Ye family. How could I have mixed them up! Now we've finally found her, and we got into an accident. What are we going to do?

SHEN SHUANGCHENG
Mom, don't blame yourself. The Ye family may not compare to ours, but they wouldn't let her starve.

GU JINXIU
We can't pick up our Meigui in this broken car.

SHEN XINGYUN
I have an idea.

INT. YE FAMILY VILLA EXTERIOR - DAY

YE WAN'ER walks toward SHEN MEIGUI holding a bag, smug.

YE WAN'ER
I heard your biological parents are poor. Not only do they have no jobs, but they also have three unmarried sons. I bought you some dry food—ten thousand yuan for this bag. Eat some on the road, and let your poor parents and brothers have a taste too.

YE WAN'ER throws the bag on the ground. The Ye family laughs.

SHEN MEIGUI's phone rings.

SHEN MEIGUI
(answering)

SUBORDINATE (V.O.)
Boss, should I still transfer the money from selling those items to the Ye family account?

SHEN MEIGUI
Do I look like a masochist?

A luxury car suddenly hits SHEN MEIGUI.

EXT. ROAD - DAY

SHEN MEIGUI lies on the ground in pain. She struggles to stand and walks to the car window, knocking.

The window rolls down, revealing QIN JINGXIAO.

SHEN MEIGUI
Don't you know how to drive?

QIN JINGXIAO
How much do you want?

He holds out a blank check. SHEN MEIGUI snatches and tears it.

SHEN MEIGUI
You stinking man, who needs your money! I have plenty myself!

title: The Phoenix's Return
description: A skilled healer saves a desperate woman from her abusive husband, unaware that a jade pendant will reconnect her to the palace and a forgotten past.
context:
Title: The Phoenix's Return
Description: A skilled healer saves a desperate woman from her abusive husband, unaware that a jade pendant will reconnect her to the palace and a forgotten past.

EXT. COURTYARD GATE - DAY

YUN'ER (O.S.)
Open the door, Yun'er!

YUN'ER frantically pounds on a tightly shut wooden door.

A fierce-looking THUG charges toward her.

THUG
(roaring)
You think you can hide?

YUN'ER turns, her face draining of color.

CHANG GE steps from the shadows, her movements fluid and practiced. She flings a handful of powder.

The THUG inhales, coughs violently, then stumbles, his hands clawing at his neck and arms.

CHANG GE
My own recipe. Feels like wasps beneath the skin. The antidote is timed.

The THUG drops to his knees, gasping.

THUG
(hoarse pleading)
Make it stop!

CHANG GE
Then listen carefully. You will forget Shen Yun'er's name. You will forget this town. If I see your face again, there is no second antidote.

She tosses a wrapped leaf onto the dirt. The THUG snatches it and chews desperately.

CHANG GE
Now crawl away.

The THUG staggers off. CHANG GE watches until he's gone, her jaw tight. She turns to the door, her expression softening almost imperceptibly.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY

YUN'ER peeks out, sees the empty street, and exhales sharply.

YUN'ER
You... you truly carry such poison?

CHANG GE
Only pepper and nettle. The fear does the rest.

YUN'ER
(quietly)
I thought—

CHANG GE
(interrupting)
You thought to use me as a shield. Again.

YUN'ER
(crying, voice cracking)
He's worse when he drinks. Look.

She pulls back her sleeve. Deep bruises pattern her arm, some old and yellowed, others fresh and dark.

YUN'ER
(touching her abdomen)
And now there's the child.

She sinks to her knees, gripping CHANG GE's hand.

YUN'ER
You promised. In the mountains, when we were barely twelve. You said if I ever needed—

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
EXT. WILDERNESS - DAY (WINTER)

Snow blankets the ground. Young CHANG GE, bloodied and unconscious, is sheltered by a crude lean-to. Young YUN'ER, chapped hands and hollow cheeks, presses snow to her wounds.

Young CHANG GE's eyes flutter open. She touches a rough wooden pendant at her neck.

YOUNG CHANG GE
(whisper)
You stayed.

YOUNG YUN'ER
We protect each other now.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY

CHANG GE stares at Yun'er. Her hand moves instinctively to her own throat, where a simple wooden pendant hangs.

CHANG GE
(softly)
The jade one is packed away. Safe.

YUN'ER
(nodding frantically)
Yes, yes. Just as you asked.

CHANG GE helps her up, decision made.

CHANG GE
Then we leave tonight. He'll return with friends.

YUN'ER
(weeping with relief)
The northern roads—

CHANG GE
Will take us to a new life. Come.

TITLE: FIVE YEARS LATER

EXT. HEALING HALL - DAY

Under the faded Healing Hall sign, TOWNSPEOPLE bow deeply.

TOWNSPEOPLE (V.O.)
Your hands have blessed this town.

INT. HEALING HALL - DAY

CHANG GE takes an elderly woman's pulse, her touch gentle.

CHANG GE
Xiao Shiliu, angelica root, two liang.

XIAO SHILIU (O.S.)
Already measured!

The boy, seven years old and quick-fingered, slides a packet onto the table.

CHANG GE
(approving)
And three liang of platycodon. You read my mind.

ELDERLY WOMAN
The boy learns your heart.

XIAO SHILIU beams.

XIAO SHILIU
Mother says healing is the only nobility that matters.

Everyone chuckles warmly.

YUN'ER enters, carrying a heavy tray. Her face is drawn, eyes hollow. She bumps an OLD MAN.

OLD MAN
Oh! Forgive me, lady—

YUN'ER
(sharp, exhausted)
Watch your step. Can't you see I'm—

She catches herself, shame flickering across her features.

CHANG GE
Yun'er. Rest.

YUN'ER
(curtly)
Rest doesn't pay our debts.

She disappears into the back room. XIAO SHILIU watches her go, his smile fading. He notices a crack in the wall panel. Prying it open, he finds a small cloth bundle.

INT. HEALING HALL - CONTINUOUS

XIAO SHILIU unwraps a carved white jade pendant, luminous and cool. He glances toward the back room, then slips it into his pocket.

INT. PAWN SHOP - DAY

XIAO SHILIU stands on his toes to reach the counter. He places the pendant down.

XIAO SHILIU
For my mother's medicine. How much?

The PAWN SHOP OWNER's breath catches. He turns the pendant over, finding a royal seal on the back.

PAWN SHOP OWNER
(carefully)
Thirty taels. For the craftsmanship.

He pushes the silver forward. XIAO SHILIU hesitates, then takes it.

INT. PALACE HALL - DAY

HIS HIGHNESS sits rigid, reviewing tax ledgers. A GUARD enters, kneeling.

GUARD
Your Highness. The pendant surfaced in a border village. With a woman matching the description. And a boy. The scholars calculate his age at seven years.

HIS HIGHNESS's hand stills. He looks up, his face a mask of old grief and sudden, terrible hope.

FADE OUT.

title: Please Listen to My Confession
description: A young woman discovers she was merely a bet when she overhears her boyfriend and his friends talking at a KTV club.
context:
Title: Please Listen to My Confession
Description: A young woman discovers she was merely a bet when she overhears her boyfriend and his friends talking at a KTV club.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

Music pulses at half-volume. GU ZHIYAN, mid-twenties with the casual confidence of old money, sits apart from the group, nursing a glass. On screen appears his name "Gu Zhiyan – Department Manager"

EXT. CLUB STAIRCASE - NIGHT

SHEN NANYIN, late twenties in a crisp white blazer, descends the spiral stairs two at a time, clutching her phone. A genuine smile plays on her lips. On screen appears her name "Shen Nanyin – Finance Analyst"

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

CHEN YUANYI, loud and liquid with drink, collapses onto the sofa beside Gu Zhiyan.

CHEN YUANYI
(slurring)
You never celebrate. Month's end, man. We closed the Peterson deal.

INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

SHEN NANYIN reaches the door. Through the narrow glass pane, she spots Gu Zhiyan. She pauses, about to knock, when she hears her name.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

CHEN YUANYI
(leans in, conspiratorial)
Finance Department's ice queen. Who would've thought?
continuation:
INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

SHEN NANYIN's hand freezes mid-knock. She leans closer to the glass.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

FRIEND A
(from the mic)
Thought you were buying us drinks when it flopped.

CHEN YUANYI
(to Gu Zhiyan)
She still thinks you met at the strategy meeting?

GU ZHIYAN
(stares into his glass)
She does.

INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

SHEN NANYIN steps back from the door, phone clutched white-knuckled. She doesn't cry. She breathes—deep, measured—then smooths her blazer.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

FRIEND B
So? What's the damage?

CHEN YUANYI
Mocktails at the hotel bar. Three grand total.

FRIEND A
Cheap win.

CHEN YUANYI
(raises his glass)
To feigned innocence. Best investment you ever made.

Gu Zhiyan doesn't toast. He sets his glass down untouched.

GU ZHIYAN
It's not clean anymore.

INT. KTV HALLWAY - NIGHT

SHEN NANYIN's expression goes still. Professional. Empty. She reaches for the handle.

INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

The door opens. SHEN NANYIN stands in the frame, her face a perfect, unreadable mask. The room falls silent. GU ZHIYAN looks up, and for the first time, his composure cracks—just slightly.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Who Is the Killer
description: A young thief breaks into an apartment to find the tenant murdered. When potential suspects arrive, he must hide among the dead to uncover the truth—or become the next victim.
context:
Title: Who Is the Killer
Description: A young thief breaks into an apartment to find the tenant murdered. When potential suspects arrive, he must hide among the dead to uncover the truth—or become the next victim.

INT. APARTMENT HALLWAY - DAY

A young man (THIEF), mid-20s, crouches in a corner, trembling. Blood on his hands—not his own. He wipes them frantically on his jeans.

THIEF (V.O.)
Shit shit shit. One lousy smash-and-grab. Now I'm standing in a fucking horror movie.

A middle-aged man in rumpled clothes (LANDLORD) appears at the open doorway, frowning at the damaged lock.

LANDLORD
Damn students. Always losing keys, then the super gets the bill.

LANDLORD pulls out his phone, scrolls, then shrugs.

LANDLORD
Text says she's visiting her mom till Sunday. Guess the rent can wait.

LANDLORD turns, already tapping a game on his phone, and ambles off.

THIEF lets out a shaky breath, pulling a crumpled PHOTO from his pocket—a selfie of XIAO LI with the Thief, both laughing at a noodle stand.

THIEF
I'm so sorry, Li. Should've known that tip was too good to be true.

THIEF stuffs the photo back, steels himself, and moves toward the bedroom door.
continuation:
INT. APARTMENT BEDROOM - DAY

XIAO LI (20s) lies on the bed, blood pooled beneath her. The room is tossed—drawers emptied, closet rifled.

THIEF kneels, head bowed—not prayer, but guilt.

THIEF
You remembered my name. Nobody does that.

Suddenly, the sound of keys opening the door comes from the entrance.

THIEF races back to the peephole.

Peephole view: A bald, burly man (ZHANG BIAO) in a bloody chef's apron, clutching a MEAT CLEAVER.

THIEF (V.O.)
Oh Christ. That's her uncle. The one she ran from.

Outside the door, ZHANG BIAO struggles with the key, cursing. It's the wrong one.

THIEF
(whispering)
He doesn't have the key. But I do...

THIEF pulls a HOUSE KEY from his pocket—the one he used to enter. His face hardens with realization.

ZHANG BIAO finally kicks the door open, splintering the frame. He storms in, cleaver raised.

THIEF dives under the bed just as ZHANG BIAO enters the bedroom.

INT. APARTMENT BEDROOM - CONTINUOUS

ZHANG BIAO stands over the body, breathing heavily.

ZHANG BIAO
Stupid girl. Should've given me the key to the safe. Now look at you.

Under the bed, THIEF covers his mouth, eyes wide open. He sees ZHANG BIAO's bloody work boots—identical to the prints near the window.

ZHANG BIAO
Where did you hide it?

ZHANG BIAO kneels, his knee cracking, and reaches under the bed frame. His hand brushes THIEF's sneaker.

THIEF's phone BUZZES—silent mode, but the screen lights up his face.

ZHANG BIAO freezes.

ZHANG BIAO
Someone's here.

ZHANG BIAO stands, takes one step back, then SLAMS the cleaver into the mattress above THIEF's head.

FADE OUT.

title: Who Says I'm a Poor Guy
description: A poor young man is coerced into a deal by a wealthy heiress who needs to meet charity requirements by giving him billions, only to have him return the money later.
context:
Title: Who Says I'm a Poor Guy
Description: A poor young man is coerced into a deal by a wealthy heiress who needs to meet charity requirements by giving him billions, only to have him return the money later.

INT. LU CORPORATION OFFICE - DAY

The POOR GUY sits rigid in a leather chair, hands clenched. The FEMALE LEAD stands at the floor-to-ceiling windows, back to him. Her ASSISTANT waits by a desk.

FEMALE LEAD
Your sister's medical bills. Three hundred thousand. Overdue.

The POOR GUY's jaw tightens.

POOR GUY
How did you—

FEMALE LEAD
(Turning, sliding a contract forward)
I need to disperse five billion from my trust. Charity requirement. I lose everything if I don't.

She studies him, her poise barely masking desperation.

FEMALE LEAD
Hold it for thirty days. One hundred million is yours. The rest comes back.

The POOR GUY stares at the black bank card on the desk.
continuation:
POOR GUY (V.O.)
One hundred million. Yaoyao's engagement gift. Mom's chemo. A life.

He picks up the pen, then stops.

POOR GUY
What's stopping me from keeping it all?

The FEMALE LEAD's smile is razor-thin.

FEMALE LEAD
The same thing stopping me from finding someone else. Mutual destruction.

She leans in, her voice low.

FEMALE LEAD
Sign. Save your family. We'll both get what we need.

The POOR GUY signs. The ASSISTANT slides the black card toward him.

FEMALE LEAD
Welcome to the Lu Corporation's charity program.

The Poor Guy takes the card—his hand steady, but his eyes show the weight of the bargain.

title: Scheming His Years
description: A young woman whose family was destroyed by gambling debts is forced into a dangerous deal to infiltrate a wealthy heir's life and sabotage his engagement.
context:
Title: Scheming His Years
Description: A young woman whose family was destroyed by gambling debts is forced into a dangerous deal to infiltrate a wealthy heir's life and sabotage his engagement.

INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - DAWN

SONG FANYIN, mid-20s with haunted eyes, stands by the floor-to-ceiling window in a silk nightgown. Behind her, GU MINGCHENG sleeps undisturbed in a bed that cost more than her father's debts.

SONG FANYIN (V.O.)
Three months ago, I watched my father burn our world. Tonight, I'm in his enemy's bed. Some debts you pay with money. Others, you pay with yourself.

INT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

CREAKING metal. The smell of KEROSENE. SONG FANYIN'S FATHER, 50s and broken, slumps against a rusted barrel, photos scattered at his feet—family vacations, his daughter's graduation, all soaked in fuel.

SONG FANYIN'S FATHER
(whispering to the photos)
Gone. All gone. Can't even face her...

SONG FANYIN'S MOTHER, trembling, grabs his arm. He shoves her back so hard she hits the concrete.

SONG FANYIN'S MOTHER
(screaming)
The loan sharks took the house, not our daughter! We can start over!

He fumbles with a LIGHTER, thumb shaking over the wheel. SONG FANYIN, 22, crouched by the exit, phone in hand—she'd been calling for help. She lunges forward, but the WHOOSH of flames beats her. Heat blasts her back as the photos ignite like falling stars.

SONG FANYIN
DAD—NO!

She grabs her mother's arm, dragging her toward the metal door as fire licks the ceiling.

INT. HOSPITAL BURN UNIT - DAY

A HEART MONITOR beeps. SONG FANYIN wakes, bandages on her forearms. Ash still stains her jawline. She bolts upright.

SONG FANYIN
Mom?

A man in a tailored suit, WEN LIHAN, 40s and shark-eyed, stands by the window examining a charred business card. He doesn't turn.

WEN LIHAN
She's alive. For now.

SONG FANYIN
Who are you? Where—

WEN LIHAN
Your father's creditor. I came to collect. Found you instead.

He tosses the card onto her lap. Her father's handwriting: GU WENHAI GROUP - FINAL NOTICE.

WEN LIHAN
News is already calling it a tragedy. Not a crime.

He taps a tablet. A news video plays: flames consuming the warehouse.

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
...local businessman apparently self-immolated after gambling losses. Wife and daughter in critical condition. Police rule it a suicide...

The screen freezes on SONG FANYIN'S FATHER'S face, twisted in the firelight.

SONG FANYIN
(throwing the tablet back)
Critical? Take me to her. NOW.
continuation:
INT. ICU WARD - CONTINUOUS

SONG FANYIN'S MOTHER lies unconscious, oxygen mask fogging with each shallow breath. A DOCTOR reviews charts, eyes tired.

DOCTOR
She inhaled too much smoke. Cardiac arrest. We stabilize with meds, but she needs bypass surgery within two weeks. Aftercare? Minimum six months. You're looking at half a million.

SONG FANYIN
(voice cracking)
I can—

WEN LIHAN
(interrupting, to the doctor)
Give us a moment.

The doctor nods, exiting. WEN LIHAN pulls out a phone, scrolling.

WEN LIHAN
Your father's debt: three point two million. Transfers to next of kin. Due in thirty days. This hospital? Files liens on burn victims' families. Standard practice.

SONG FANYIN
(staring at her mother's gray face)
You didn't save us out of kindness.

WEN LIHAN
I see potential. Waste bothers me.

He turns the phone toward her. A photo: GU MINGCHENG, 30s, handsome, laughing at a charity gala beside his fiancée.

WEN LIHAN
Gu Mingcheng. Wenhai Group's heir. His engagement to Yucheng Capital's daughter finalizes in three months. When that merger happens, certain people become... inconvenient. Permanently.

SONG FANYIN
You want me to be a homewrecker.

WEN LIHAN
I want you to be a delay. A complication. A woman from his past he can't resist.

SONG FANYIN
I went to community college. He summers in Monaco.

WEN LIHAN
You survived a fire for your mother. That kind of desperation? It's a skill.

He pockets the phone.

WEN LIHAN
Mandarin, Cantonese, English. Your transcripts say you're fluent. His fiancée only speaks money. You'll fit right in.

A beat. SONG FANYIN looks from her mother to the photo of GU MINGCHENG. Two different prisons.

SONG FANYIN
(quietly)
What if I can't?

WEN LIHAN
Then your mother moves to a hallway bed. The debt collectors find you. And I find someone else.

He places a key card on the bedside table.

WEN LIHAN
Apartment is furnished. Training starts Monday. You have one week to make him notice you.

He walks out. The heart monitor continues its steady beep. SONG FANYIN picks up the key card, her reflection in the dark window showing a ghost of who she was.

EXT. GU MINGCHENG'S PENTHOUSE BUILDING - NIGHT (BACK TO PRESENT)

City lights blur below. Inside, SONG FANYIN still watches GU MINGCHENG sleep. She touches the lighter burn on her palm—a perfect circle from her father's final gesture.

SONG FANYIN (V.O.)
One week to make him love me. Three months to destroy him. And every night, I wonder if I'm burning down his world... or just relighting mine.

title: Beneath the Lie
description: A woman undergoes surgery to assume the identity of her enemy's daughter in order to exact revenge for her father's wrongful conviction.
context:
Title: Beneath the Lie
Description: A woman undergoes surgery to assume the identity of her enemy's daughter in order to exact revenge for her father's wrongful conviction.

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: THE TRANSFORMATION

QIAO XING (ZHOU JING) sits on an operating table, a striped hospital gown hanging loose. Her eyes fix on something miles away. A DOCTOR in a white coat wraps sterile gauze around her face.

QIAO XING (V.O.)
They say you must kill the part of you that hurts. Today, I killed my face.

The Doctor steps back. In the mirror's reflection, bandages slowly unwind—revealing not Zhou Jing's features, but another woman's entirely.

The Doctor holds up a sketch portrait of a woman.

DOCTOR
You understand the risks. To look like her...

QIAO XING (ZHOU JING)
I need to become her.

She touches her new face in the mirror.

EXT. PRISON GATE - DAY

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER - JIANGBEI PRISON

The prison iron gate slowly opens. QIAO XING (ZHOU JING) walks out carrying a bag, her expression cold enough to frost glass.

Three luxury cars pull up and stop. QIAO YI gets out.

QIAO YI
Sister.

QIAO XING (ZHOU JING) looks at him coldly.

QIAO YI
Sis, these three years in prison taking the fall for Dad, you've had it rough. I came specially to welcome you back. Look, how's this setup? Are you satisfied?

QIAO XING
Specially arranged for me? Qiao Yi, I think you were hoping I'd never get out.

QIAO YI
How could that be? I was just...

QIAO XING
And another thing.

QIAO XING (ZHOU JING) suddenly pulls out a small kraft paper packet.
continuation:
QIAO XING
This is the powder you suddenly mixed into my food. Want to try some?

QIAO YI steps back in horror.

QIAO YI
I was doing it for your own good, okay?

QIAO XING
Days in prison might actually be better than days at home.

QIAO XING (ZHOU JING) swiftly kicks QIAO YI and simultaneously pulls a switchblade from his pocket, then steps back. She presses the button and the blade springs out.

QIAO YI
(panicked)
Ah! This... you... how did you get that?

QIAO XING
This thing is too dangerous. I'll keep it safe for you.

QIAO XING (ZHOU JING) closes the knife and puts it in her pocket.

QIAO YI
(in disbelief)
Ha, Qiao Xing, haven't seen you in a few years. You've changed quite a bit.

INT. QIAO FAMILY MANSION - DAY

A wide shot reveals a magnificent European-style castle estate.

QIAO XING (ZHOU JING) enters the luxuriously decorated villa hall and looks around. Her gaze falls on a family portrait leaning against the wall, showing QIAO HUAIEN, QIAO YI, and the real QIAO XING.

QIAO XING (V.O.)
This is my enemy, Qiao Huaien.

QIAO HUAIEN, wearing a suit and smiling broadly, walks out from inside.

QIAO HUAIEN
My precious daughter has come home.

QIAO HUAIEN opens his arms, preparing to embrace her.

QIAO XING (V.O.)
Three years ago, he framed my father and erased me. I will make you taste what it's like to lose everything.

QIAO XING (ZHOU JING)'s face instantly switches to a bright smile.

QIAO XING
I'm home.

She walks forward and embraces QIAO HUAIEN. Golden light particle effects appear on the screen.

title: Ghost Marriage
description: A disabled and supposedly cursed family patriarch arrives to claim his bride, only to discover her coffin is empty and she faked her death.
context:
Title: Ghost Marriage
Description: A disabled and supposedly cursed family patriarch arrives to claim his bride, only to discover her coffin is empty and she faked her death.

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

An open coffin sits in the center of the vast mourning hall, surrounded by white and yellow chrysanthemums. Ornate bridal clothes are arranged inside.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Mo Financial Conglomerate claims its bride today. But Zhao Yutang refused to be a sacrifice.

ZHAO XIYA kneels beside the coffin, supported by MRS. ZHAO. MASTER ZHAO hovers nearby, his grief feigned.

ZHAO XIYA
Elder Sister...

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
Guests, please observe silence for the deceased.

All bow their heads.

EXT. ZHAO FAMILY MANSION - DAY

A convoy of black vehicles drives into the estate. MO YEPO emerges from the lead Rolls-Royce, leaning on a cane, his presence commanding.

Subordinates line up with red-draped gift trays.

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

The Master of Ceremonies signals to close the coffin.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
Seal the—

MO YEPO (O.S.)
Wait.

Mo Yepo enters. His men display the gifts. The room falls silent.

MO YEPO
I've come for my wife.

GUEST A
(softly)
The cursed patriarch... I heard—

Mo Yepo's stare cuts through the gossip. He approaches the coffin.

MASTER ZHAO
Mr. Mo, she's gone. Took her own life.

MO YEPO
(cold laugh)
A Zhao would never.

He lifts the lid. The coffin is empty. Gasps fill the hall.

MASTER ZHAO
Impossible—

MO YEPO
Find her. Now.

A subordinate exits.
continuation:
EXT. RAINY ROADSIDE - NIGHT

FLASHBACK:

ZHAO YUTANG stumbles through rain, clutching a torn red dress. She crashes into MO YEPO, who shelters her with an umbrella.

ZHAO YUTANG
(gasping)
Take this... help me...

She forces a jade pendant into his pocket. Mo Yepo lifts her.

INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - NIGHT

Mo Yepo sets her in the back seat. Zhao Yutang pulls him close, desperate.

ZHAO YUTANG
(whispering)
Help me disappear...

They kiss. The pendant falls between them.

BACK TO:

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

Among the mourners, ZHAO YUTANG in black lifts her head. Her eyes lock on Mo Yepo.

ZHAO YUTANG (V.O.)
The driver... why is he here?

She edges toward the door.

full_script:
Title: Ghost Marriage
Description: A disabled and supposedly cursed family patriarch arrives to claim his bride, only to discover her coffin is empty and she faked her death.

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

An open coffin sits in the center of the vast mourning hall, surrounded by white and yellow chrysanthemums. Ornate bridal clothes are arranged inside.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Mo Financial Conglomerate claims its bride today. But Zhao Yutang refused to be a sacrifice.

ZHAO XIYA kneels beside the coffin, supported by MRS. ZHAO. MASTER ZHAO hovers nearby, his grief feigned.

ZHAO XIYA
Elder Sister...

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
Guests, please observe silence for the deceased.

All bow their heads.

EXT. ZHAO FAMILY MANSION - DAY

A convoy of black vehicles drives into the estate. MO YEPO emerges from the lead Rolls-Royce, leaning on a cane, his presence commanding.

Subordinates line up with red-draped gift trays.

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

The Master of Ceremonies signals to close the coffin.

MASTER OF CEREMONIES
Seal the—

MO YEPO (O.S.)
Wait.

Mo Yepo enters. His men display the gifts. The room falls silent.

MO YEPO
I've come for my wife.

GUEST A
(softly)
The cursed patriarch... I heard—

Mo Yepo's stare cuts through the gossip. He approaches the coffin.

MASTER ZHAO
Mr. Mo, she's gone. Took her own life.

MO YEPO
(cold laugh)
A Zhao would never.

He lifts the lid. The coffin is empty. Gasps fill the hall.

MASTER ZHAO
Impossible—

MO YEPO
Find her. Now.

A subordinate exits.

EXT. RAINY ROADSIDE - NIGHT

FLASHBACK:

ZHAO YUTANG stumbles through rain, clutching a torn red dress. She crashes into MO YEPO, who shelters her with an umbrella.

ZHAO YUTANG
(gasping)
Take this... help me...

She forces a jade pendant into his pocket. Mo Yepo lifts her.

INT. ROLLS-ROYCE - NIGHT

Mo Yepo sets her in the back seat. Zhao Yutang pulls him close, desperate.

ZHAO YUTANG
(whispering)
Help me disappear...

They kiss. The pendant falls between them.

BACK TO:

INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

Among the mourners, ZHAO YUTANG in black lifts her head. Her eyes lock on Mo Yepo.

ZHAO YUTANG (V.O.)

She edges toward the door.

EXT. ZHAO FAMILY MANSION COURTYARD - DAY

Zhao Yutang rushes out and collides with Mo Yepo. The jade pendant hangs from his tie.

Zhao Yutang freezes, staring at the pendant in horror.

title: A Good Wife Brings Prosperity
description: A successful CEO returns to his hometown after ten years to marry his childhood sweetheart who supported him through poverty, fulfilling his promise with a fortune.
context:
Title: A Good Wife Brings Prosperity
Description: A successful CEO returns to his hometown after ten years to marry his childhood sweetheart who supported him through poverty, fulfilling his promise with a fortune.

INT. CELEBRATION VENUE - DAY

Music plays, the atmosphere is lively. LI ZICHEN, in a sharp suit, full of confidence, strikes the listing gong.

The backdrop reads: "Congratulations to Zichen Group on surpassing 100 billion market value upon listing."

Everyone applauds.

ON SCREEN: President of Zichen Group - LI ZICHEN

CROWD
Congratulations to Zichen Group, 100 billion market value, successful listing!

SECRETARY WANG, wearing glasses in professional attire, holds a microphone and asks a question.

ON SCREEN: Li Zichen's Secretary - SECRETARY WANG

SECRETARY WANG
Mr. Li, what has supported you in achieving such success?

LI ZICHEN takes the microphone, his gaze profound.

LI ZICHEN
The woman who taught me that dignity isn't bought with money—it's earned through keeping your word. Even when I couldn't reach her for ten years.

INT. WANG FAMILY DINING TABLE - DAY (TEN YEARS AGO)

ON SCREEN: Ten years ago - Tingling Village

Flashback to ten years ago. Young LI ZICHEN, WANG TINGTING, and Tingting's father WANG CHANGSHUN sit around a simple dining table eating.

WANG TINGTING picks up a piece of chicken and places it in LI ZICHEN's bowl.

WANG TINGTING
Brother Zichen, eat more.

WANG CHANGSHUN sees this and slams his chopsticks on the table with a loud bang.

WANG CHANGSHUN
Eat, eat, eat, all you know is eating!

ON SCREEN: Wang Tingting's Father - WANG CHANGSHUN

WANG CHANGSHUN
A waste who's been living off our family for over ten years!

WANG TINGTING
Dad, how can you say that about Brother Zichen?

WANG CHANGSHUN
I need to make him recognize his place!

ON SCREEN: Li Zichen's Childhood Sweetheart - WANG TINGTING

WANG CHANGSHUN
The son of a convict, a waste who only knows how to study! He needs to give up any idea of climbing high and marrying you!

EXT. WANG FAMILY COURTYARD - DAY (TEN YEARS AGO)

The three argue as they come to the courtyard.

LI ZICHEN
I'm not a waste!

WANG CHANGSHUN
Not a waste? If you're not a waste, why have you been freeloading at our house for over ten years? Tuition and living expenses, didn't Tingting pay for them all? What are you if not a waste? At least a dog can guard the house when you feed it. What can you do?

WANG TINGTING
(interrupting)
Dad! I lent him that money—he refused three times before taking it. And I'll leave with him tonight if I must!

WANG CHANGSHUN
(pointing at LI ZICHEN)
You want to marry him? Over my dead body!

WANG CHANGSHUN storms into the house and slams the door hard.

WANG TINGTING
Dad! Dad!

LI ZICHEN holds back the heartbroken WANG TINGTING. He pulls out a jade pendant.

LI ZICHEN
Uncle Changshun is right. Being poor means having no dignity. So I'm going out to make something of myself, then I'll come back to marry you. Sell this if you need to. I won't touch another cent of yours.
continuation:
INT. CELEBRATION VENUE - DAY

The scene cuts back to the celebration. LI ZICHEN's eyes shine with determination.

LI ZICHEN (V.O.)
Ten years. The letters all came back unopened. But I kept writing.

LI ZICHEN turns to SECRETARY WANG.

LI ZICHEN
Secretary Wang, prepare the rural development fund. And bring the cases. I'm going home.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

A row of luxury cars slowly enters the village, decorated with red flowers at the front, firecrackers exploding.

Villagers gather by the roadside, chattering.

VILLAGER A
Look at those cars, so magnificent!

VILLAGER B
An important guest has arrived!

VILLAGER C
Is that Zichen? He's back!

VILLAGER D
Tingting's school finally got its funding!

LI ZICHEN gets out of the car in a sharp suit, wearing gold-rimmed glasses. WANG TINGTING stands in the crowd wearing simple, practical clothes, holding a stack of worn envelopes.

WANG CHANGSHUN, nervous but smiling, approaches.

WANG CHANGSHUN
(pushing aside someone nearby)
Move aside!

WANG CHANGSHUN
Brother Zichen... we got your letters. Every single one.

LI ZICHEN, accompanied by SECRETARY WANG and several BODYGUARDS carrying metal cases, walks toward the crowd.

LI ZICHEN walks up to TINGTING and gently takes her hand.

LI ZICHEN
Tingting, I've fulfilled my promise. I've come back to marry you.

WANG TINGTING
(tears in her eyes)
Brother Zichen, I used the money you sent to build the school. We opened it three years ago. I wasn't just waiting—I was building what you dreamed of.

WANG CHANGSHUN announces to the villagers, his voice cracking.

WANG CHANGSHUN
Folks, when Zichen left... I burned his letters. I thought he'd forget us. But Tingting saved every one he sent in secret. Today he's come back to marry my daughter. What does that show? This boy values loyalty—and this girl knew it before any of us.

The VILLAGE CHIEF and ACCOUNTANT LIU whisper among the crowd.

ON SCREEN: Village Chief

VILLAGE CHIEF
Old Changshun finally grew a conscience.

ON SCREEN: Accountant Liu

ACCOUNTANT LIU
Took him ten years to realize his daughter saw what he couldn't.

VILLAGE CHIEF
Zichen made it big. But Tingting made this village worth coming back to.

ACCOUNTANT LIU
Li Shancun must have accumulated good karma. His son remembered where he came from.

LI ZICHEN sees his father LI SHANCUN in the crowd and walks up to him.

ON SCREEN: Li Zichen's Father - LI SHANCUN

LI ZICHEN
Dad. Your son was unfilial, came back late.

LI SHANCUN
(emotionally)
You kept your word. That's all that matters.

WANG CHANGSHUN comes over, unable to meet LI ZICHEN's eyes.

WANG CHANGSHUN
Zichen... the money you sent. It's all accounted for. Every yuan went to the school or Tingting saved it. She never spent a cent on herself.

LI ZICHEN smiles and nods, signaling to SECRETARY WANG.

SECRETARY WANG directs the BODYGUARDS to bring the metal cases forward and open them.

The cases contain not cash, but documents and a single jade pendant.

VILLAGERS murmur in confusion.

WANG CHANGSHUN stares at the pendant, recognition dawning.

WANG CHANGSHUN
This... this is the one I threw in the fire...

LI ZICHEN faces all the villagers.

LI ZICHEN
Folks, everyone knows our family's situation. Over the years, we've received a lot of help from all of you. Today is my wedding day. A drop of kindness should be repaid with a fountain.

LI ZICHEN
(announces loudly)
Inside these cases are the deeds to the school expansion, the medical clinic, and the agricultural co-op. And this... is my promise kept.

LI ZICHEN places the jade pendant in WANG TINGTING's palm, closing her fingers over it.

LI ZICHEN's face breaks into a brilliant smile.

title: Penny Wise, Pound Foolish
description: A gold-medal teacher returns to her hometown after ten years to teach at her alma mater, but faces family members who take advantage of her father's small shop.
context:
Title: Penny Wise, Pound Foolish
Description: A gold-medal teacher returns to her hometown after ten years to teach at her alma mater, but faces family members who take advantage of her father's small shop.

INT. CONVENIENCE STORE - DAY

On the TV screen, gold-medal teacher SONG YUEYOU is being interviewed.

REPORTER (V.O.)
Teacher Song, every school you've taught at this year has seen improvements in enrollment and graduation rates without exception. Now prestigious schools from around the world are extending olive branches to you. Where do you plan to teach in the future?

SONG YUEYOU
(on TV)
I've already agreed to teach at Qiming Middle School. That's my alma mater.

REPORTER (V.O.)
Education for all, indeed.

In the convenience store, a GIRL watches the TV.

GIRL
Teacher Song's actually coming to our county? No way...

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

SONG YUEYOU pulls her suitcase along a snow-covered road.

SONG YUEYOU (V.O.)
Ten years. The store looks exactly the same. I hope Dad's been taking care of himself.

INT. CONVENIENCE STORE - DAY

SONG YUEYOU enters the convenience store. Her father, SONG WEIMIN, is organizing goods with his back to her.

SONG WEIMIN
Whatever you want, help yourself.

SONG YUEYOU
I'm not buying anything.

SONG WEIMIN turns around, freezes for a moment, then joyfully recognizes his daughter.

SONG WEIMIN
My daughter's home!

He excitedly grabs his daughter's hands. His are calloused, rough.

SONG YUEYOU
Dad. I'm home for good.

SONG YUEYOU (V.O.)
He doesn't know yet. About the gold medal. About choosing Qiming over Beijing.

SONG WEIMIN
You've gotten thinner. Youyou, your timing is perfect—Grandma's eightieth birthday is soon. Now I have help.

SONG YUEYOU
Then I'll have good news for everyone at the banquet.

SONG WEIMIN
Yes! Watch the counter. I'll take your things to the back.
continuation:
SONG YUEYOU
Okay, Dad. Don't worry.

SONG WEIMIN pulls the suitcase into the back room. At that moment, ELDEST AUNT SONG CAIYING walks in.

SONG CAIYING
Little brother! Got any new stock?

SONG CAIYING and several CUSTOMERS with her help themselves to snacks from the shelves and start eating them without paying.

SONG CAIYING sees SONG YUEYOU and approaches her.

SONG CAIYING
Youyou! Back from the city? Don't worry if you didn't save much. A woman's real career is marriage anyway.

SONG YUEYOU
Aunt. That's seven yuan for the snacks.

SONG CAIYING
(surprised)
What? I'm your own eldest aunt! Family doesn't split bills—money talk ruins relationships.

SONG YUEYOU
Small businesses can't survive on goodwill.

SONG CAIYING
(angry)
Your father never complained!

SONG YUEYOU
Because he's family. But I'm the accountant now.

SONG CAIYING
I'm supporting your father's business!

SONG CAIYING is too angry to speak. She throws the vegetables in her hand back into the box and turns to leave.

SONG CAIYING
(leaving)
Ungrateful girl.

SONG CAIYING picks up a vegetable, looks at it, then throws it down.

SONG CAIYING
These vegetables look wilted. I was doing you a favor.

SONG CAIYING storms out angrily. The CUSTOMERS, embarrassed, put their snacks back and follow.

SONG YUEYOU picks up the opened but undrunk beverage SONG CAIYING left behind and pours it out expressionlessly.

She turns to find SONG WEIMIN watching from the doorway.

SONG WEIMIN
You always had backbone.

SONG YUEYOU
I learned it from watching you carry this store alone.

She drops the empty bottle in the trash. The sound is final.

FADE OUT.
