title: Longing for Moonlight, Regretting the Morning Sun
description: A man who gave everything to his beloved fiancée discovers her betrayal the night before their wedding, only to be reborn and given a second chance.
context:
Title: Longing for Moonlight, Regretting the Morning Sun
Description: A man who gave everything to his beloved fiancée discovers her betrayal the night before their wedding, only to be reborn and given a second chance.

INT. CAR - NIGHT

LIN ZE (V.O.)
They say love makes you blind. I built my whole world around Xu Ruoxi—gave her everything she asked for, and everything she didn't. Tomorrow, we're supposed to get married.

LIN ZE sits in the driver's seat, looking at a photo of XU RUOXI on his phone. He dials her number. It rings four times, then voicemail.

INT. KTV - NIGHT

A private room filled with laughter. XU RUOXI sits among friends, the light catching the diamond on her finger.

CUI YUANYUAN
To Ruoxi! May your last night of freedom be unforgettable.

ALL raise their glasses, the moment genuine.

FRIEND A
That ring is stunning. Lin Ze has taste.

CUI YUANYUAN
(gently)
He commissioned it months ago. Custom design—apparently cost a small fortune.

XU RUOXI
(small smile)
He's... generous.

Her phone BUZZES on the table. "Lin Ze" lights up the screen.

INT. CAR - NIGHT

LIN ZE (V.O.)
Generous. That's one word for it. I thought love meant giving until it hurts. I didn't know she'd be taking from someone else too.

INT. KTV - NIGHT

The party continues. A distinguished man, MENG TIANHAO, enters quietly. All eyes turn to him.

CUI YUANYUAN
(leaning to Ruoxi)
You didn't tell me he was back.

XU RUOXI stands, surprise and something else flickering across her face.

MENG TIANHAO
(raising his glass)
To your happiness, Ruoxi. I mean that.

XU RUOXI
Senior... I thought you were still in Berlin.

MENG TIANHAO
I was. But some things couldn't wait.

Their eyes hold. Her phone BUZZES again—Lin Ze. She silences it without looking.

MENG TIANHAO
You should answer. He'll worry.

XU RUOXI
(quietly)
He always worries.

She walks to the corner, answers.

INT. CAR / KTV - NIGHT (INTERCUT)

LIN ZE
Ruoxi? The office said you left hours ago.

XU RUOXI
I'm still in meetings. Can we not do this tonight?

LIN ZE
(slight pause)
You never miss calls. Not three in a row.

XU RUOXI
(defensive)
I'm trying to respect my team. Is that so hard to understand?

LIN ZE
I understand more than you think.

The line goes dead. Xu Ruoxi stares at her phone, a flicker of something like guilt crossing her face.
continuation:
INT. XU FAMILY HOME - DAY (FLASHBACK)

LIN ZE, wearing a suit, sits with XU RUOXI's parents. The atmosphere is businesslike.

ZHANG YAFANG
We want our daughter's future secured, Lin Ze. The ten million is... insurance. As is the property. You understand.

LIN ZE
I want Ruoxi to have everything she deserves.

He places a bank card on the table.

ZHANG YAFANG
(avoiding his eyes)
We... don't have much to offer in return. Family circumstances, you see.

LIN ZE
I didn't expect anything. I love your daughter.

XU RUOXI
(from doorway)

LIN ZE

XU RUOXI

The music continues, but the room goes silent.

(whisper)
Lin Ze...

(quietly, dangerously)
Don't stop on my account. After all, it's just business, right?

title: Miss Fu Bao's Five Elements Need Cash
description: A young Taoist gifted in divination but cursed with poverty is sent down the mountain to earn money and accumulate merit, hoping to change her fate.
context:
Title: Miss Fu Bao's Five Elements Need Cash
Description: A young Taoist gifted in divination but cursed with poverty is sent down the mountain to earn money and accumulate merit, hoping to change her fate.

INT. TAOIST TEMPLE DINING HALL - DAY

FAST CUTS: The temple's plaque reading "Linyun Taoist Temple," Taoist sandals, hanging talismans, and LITTLE FU BAO—double buns pinned with a "GET RICH" clip—hunched over a bowl, eating voraciously. A tower of empty bowls before her.

ON SCREEN: Little Fu Bao - Young Divine Healer of Linyun Taoist Temple

MASTER PINGZHEN, silver-haired and weary, watches with fond exasperation.

ON SCREEN: Master Pingzhen - Little Fu Bao's Master

LITTLE FU BAO scrapes her bowl clean and holds it up.

LITTLE FU BAO
Master, may I have more?

MASTER PINGZHEN
(sighing)
Child...

Master Pingzhen refills the bowl. Fu Bao attacks the noodles. The Master fans himself, brow furrowed.

LITTLE FU BAO
(through a mouthful)
Why do you sigh, Master?

MASTER PINGZHEN
Fu Bao, your birth chart is complete—except for wealth. Since you arrived, our temple's fortunes have crumbled. Even our Patriarch...

The camera pans to a cobweb-shrouded statue. Special effects: statue flashes golden, then instantly reverts to dusty bronze.

LITTLE FU BAO
(still chewing)
Master?

MASTER PINGZHEN
(perking up)
Yes? Perhaps it's time you descended the mountain?

LITTLE FU BAO
ignores him, slurps the last noodle, raises her bowl again.

LITTLE FU BAO
Another, please.

MASTER PINGZHEN
(broken)
Alas! Go, child! Earn our fortune! Otherwise, we sleep under stars.
continuation:
EXT. TEMPLE ENTRANCE - DAY

Master Pingzhen nudges FU BAO—bundle on her shoulder—out the door.

MASTER PINGZHEN
(shutting the door, then cracking it open)
Fu Bao.

FU BAO turns, eyes bright.

MASTER PINGZHEN
(producing a jade pendant)
This pendant—you wore it when I found you on the temple steps. It may lead you to your destiny. Take it. Accumulate merit. When our Patriarch shines again, so too will your fortune.

LITTLE FU BAO
(accepting the pendant, earnest)
I will earn our fortune and restore the temple, Master.

MASTER PINGZHEN
(touched)
Good. Now go.

FU BAO bounds down the stone steps.

EXT. MODERN CITY/PARK - DAY

AERIAL VIEW: Skyscrapers gleam. FU BAO races through a public park, bundle swinging.

EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

A black sedan idles by the curb. Inside, an elegant OLD MADAM gasps, clutching her chest. Two BODYGUARDS panic.

BODYGUARD 1
Old Madam! Old Madam!

BODYGUARD 2
Call an ambulance! Now!

One BODYGUARD dials. FU BAO passes by, climbs into the sedan, grasps the OLD MADAM's wrist.

LITTLE FU BAO
(to herself)
Her life thread frays. Her heart will fail before help arrives.

FU BAO extracts a white porcelain vial from her bundle, pours a pill, presses it to the OLD MADAM's lips.

BODYGUARD 2
(returning, alarmed)
What are you giving her?

LITTLE FU BAO
A Heart-Saving Pill. Without it, she won't survive the wait.

BODYGUARD 2
(suspicious, shoving FU BAO aside)
Nonsense! If you've harmed her—

The OLD MADAM's hand twitches. Her eyes open. FU BAO stumbles but grins.

LITTLE FU BAO
She'll be well now.

The BODYGUARDS gape as the OLD MADAM breathes steadily.

BODYGUARD 1
Old Madam? You're...

OLD MADAM
(weak but clear)
That child... saved me.

She looks out the window. FU BAO has vanished into the crowd.

OLD MADAM
Find her. The He family offers five million to whoever brings her to me.

FADE OUT.

title: Crimson Flame Beauty
description: Ten years after trading her sword for solitude, the legendary Crimson Flame Queen must break her vow of seclusion when old allies are hunted. But her return draws unwanted attention from a young master who arrives to sever ties—unaware he's igniting the very flame he seeks to escape.
context:
Title: Crimson Flame Beauty
Description: Ten years after trading her sword for solitude, the legendary Crimson Flame Queen must break her vow of seclusion when old allies are hunted. But her return draws unwanted attention from a young master who arrives to sever ties—unaware he's igniting the very flame he seeks to escape.

EXT. MONTAGE - DAY

Ink-wash Tai Chi diagrams swirl across ancient parchment. Silhouettes flow through combat forms, dissolving into mist-shrouded peaks. The final image lingers on a single falling leaf that bursts into crimson flame.

ON SCREEN: Crimson Flame Beauty - Episode 1

EXT. PAVILION - DAY

SHEN LIGE, her ink-patterned robes worn thin at the edges, moves through sword forms with mechanical precision. A wine gourd hangs from her belt, sloshing half-empty. Each strike falters slightly—just enough to notice.

She freezes mid-form, sword trembling. Her reflection in the blade shows eyes that have seen too much blood.

A tremor runs through the gourd. Wine spills. She doesn't notice.

EXT. OUTSIDE THE PAVILION - DAY

A MESSENGER in white sect robes stumbles to one knee, one hand pressed to his ribs. Blood seeps between his fingers. He clutches a sheathed blade wrapped in white silk—the traditional call for aid.

MESSENGER
Elder Shen... the Shadow Sect... they've taken the outer valleys. Master Zhou's lineage... wiped out.

SHEN LIGE stands on the pavilion steps, her expression unreadable.

SHEN LIGE
I am no elder. Not anymore.

MESSENGER
(looking up, desperate)
They know you live. They won't stop until—

He coughs blood. An arrowhead protrudes from his back.

SHEN LIGE's knuckles whiten on her sword hilt.

SHEN LIGE
How many?

MESSENGER
Twenty... maybe more. Led by... Lu He.

His eyes glaze over. The wrapped blade slips from his fingers.

SHEN LIGE rushes down, catching him before he falls. She checks his pulse—already gone. Her thumb brushes the sect sigil on his collar: a crane in flight.

She lowers him gently, her movements careful, almost ritualistic.

From the tree line, a dozen MASKED MEN emerge. Their leader, LU HE, wears a crimson cloak but no mask.

ON SCREEN: Character Name - LU HE, Shadow Sect Enforcer

LU HE
I told them you were a myth. Yet here you are, weeping for a boy.

SHEN LIGE stands slowly, her back to them. She picks up the messenger's blade.

SHEN LIGE
(quietly)
He was seventeen.

LU HE
And you're about to join him, old woman.

SHEN LIGE turns. The air around her seems to heat.

SHEN LIGE
I left the world so no one else would die by my hand. You bring death to my door.

The sword in her hand ignites—not with actual flame, but with qi so dense it warps the air into crimson waves.

LU HE's smile flickers. He signals his men forward.

They charge. She doesn't move until the first blade is inches from her throat.

Then she dances.

Three heartbeats later, eleven bodies lie still. The twelfth man drops his weapon and runs.

LU HE hasn't moved. His confidence has curdled into terror.

LU HE
Martial God Realm... You are—

SHEN LIGE flicks blood from her blade. The crimson qi vanishes.

SHEN LIGE
Tell your masters the Crimson Flame is lit. If they want it extinguished, they know where to find me.

LU HE flees.

SHEN LIGE kneels by the messenger's body, closing his eyes. The wine gourd on her belt feels heavier now.
continuation:
EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

The rumble of engines echoes through the valley. Three motorcycles with silent turbines glide to a stop. Their riders wear tactical gear over silk undershirts: the uniform of the Northern Alliance.

JIANG YIPING, his black coat settling around him like armor, dismounts. His subordinate, LENG YE, carries a digital scroll case.

ON SCREEN: Character Name - JIANG YIPING, Northern Alliance Delegate

They approach the pavilion. The bodies are gone, but the blood remains.

JIANG YIPING studies the scorch marks on the ground—perfect circles burned into stone.

JIANG YIPING
(to himself)
Crimson Flame technique...

LENG YE spots Shen Lige by the pavilion, wrapping the messenger's blade in fresh silk.

LENG YE
Delegate Jiang, she's—

JIANG YIPING
Wait.

SHEN LIGE ties the blade to a pole, creating a memorial marker.

JIANG YIPING approaches, stopping at a respectful distance.

JIANG YIPING
Shen Lige?

SHEN LIGE
If you're here about the Shadow Sect, you're too late.

JIANG YIPING
I'm here about our engagement.

SHEN LIGE stills. Her back remains to him.

SHEN LIGE
That was twenty years ago. Between our masters. Not us.

JIANG YIPING
My faction requires a clean break from the old ways. Consider it a formality.

He pulls out a slim tablet, offering it.

JIANG YIPING (CONT'D)
Sign the dissolution, and the Alliance will guarantee your safety. No more blood on your hands.

SHEN LIGE turns. Her eyes are ancient.

SHEN LIGE
You think the Crimson Flame needs your protection?

A leaf drifts between them. As it passes Shen Lige, it smolders to ash.

JIANG YIPING's tablet screen flickers. The dissolution document glitches, words rearranging into a single line: "The fire chooses its keeper."

JIANG YIPING
(internal monologue)
She just rewrote my diplomatic mission with a glance. The Alliance has no idea what they're dealing with.

SHEN LIGE
(faint, weary smile)
Return to your masters, young delegate. Tell them the engagement stands—not as a chain, but as a warning.

She walks back to the pavilion, taking a long pull from her wine gourd.

JIANG YIPING stares at his tablet, then at the woman who just made his authority irrelevant.

LENG YE
What do we tell the Alliance?

JIANG YIPING
(quietly)
We tell them we found a ghost. And she's not interested in being laid to rest.

SHEN LIGE (O.S.)
Next time, send wine instead of contracts. Good wine.

A flash of crimson light crosses the screen, and the scene ends.

Tell your masters the Crimson Flame is lit. If they want it extinguished, they know where to find me.

LU HE flees.

SHEN LIGE kneels by the messenger's body, closing his eyes. The wine gourd on her belt feels heavier now.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

The rumble of engines echoes through the valley. Three motorcycles with silent turbines glide to a stop. Their riders wear tactical gear over silk undershirts: the uniform of the Northern Alliance.

JIANG YIPING, his black coat settling around him like armor, dismounts. His subordinate, LENG YE, carries a digital scroll case.

ON SCREEN: Character Name - JIANG YIPING, Northern Alliance Delegate

They approach the pavilion. The bodies are gone, but the blood remains.

JIANG YIPING studies the scorch marks on the ground—perfect circles burned into stone.

JIANG YIPING
(to himself)
Crimson Flame technique...

LENG YE spots Shen Lige by the pavilion, wrapping the messenger's blade in fresh silk.

LENG YE
Delegate Jiang, she's—

JIANG YIPING
Wait.

SHEN LIGE ties the blade to a pole, creating a memorial marker.

JIANG YIPING approaches, stopping at a respectful distance.

JIANG YIPING
Shen Lige?

SHEN LIGE
If you're here about the Shadow Sect, you're too late.

JIANG YIPING
I'm here about our engagement.

SHEN LIGE stills. Her back remains to him.

SHEN LIGE
That was twenty years ago. Between our masters. Not us.

JIANG YIPING
My faction requires a clean break from the old ways. Consider it a formality.

He pulls out a slim tablet, offering it.

JIANG YIPING (CONT'D)
Sign the dissolution, and the Alliance will guarantee your safety. No more blood on your hands.

SHEN LIGE turns. Her eyes are ancient.

SHEN LIGE
You think the Crimson Flame needs your protection?

A leaf drifts between them. As it passes Shen Lige, it smolders to ash.

JIANG YIPING's tablet screen flickers. The dissolution document glitches, words rearranging into a single line: "The fire chooses its keeper."

JIANG YIPING
(internal monologue)
She just rewrote my diplomatic mission with a glance. The Alliance has no idea what they're dealing with.

SHEN LIGE
(faint, weary smile)
Return to your masters, young delegate. Tell them the engagement stands—not as a chain, but as a warning.

She walks back to the pavilion, taking a long pull from her wine gourd.

JIANG YIPING stares at his tablet, then at the woman who just made his authority irrelevant.

LENG YE
What do we tell the Alliance?

JIANG YIPING
(quietly)
We tell them we found a ghost. And she's not interested in being laid to rest.

SHEN LIGE (O.S.)
Next time, send wine instead of contracts. Good wine.

A flash of crimson light crosses the screen, and the scene ends.

title: Super Powered Baby Finds Daddy
description: A skilled assassin mother and her gifted daughter escape from a secret organization to find the child's father and seek a cure for her inherited condition.
context:
Title: Super Powered Baby Finds Daddy
Description: A skilled assassin mother and her gifted daughter escape from a secret organization to find the child's father and seek a cure for her inherited condition.

INT. DARK PAVILION - NIGHT

FAST CUTS of animated imagery: A wolf howling at the moon on a snowy mountain, an ancient tower glowing red, two girls running through streets, then leaping through the night sky.

The animation transitions to live action. YE GE and her daughter TANGTANG hold hands, their figures graceful as they leap from a rooftop and land in a traditional courtyard.

YE GE
Today we leave the Dark Pavilion behind. All of it.

YE GE crouches down, looking at TANGTANG tenderly.

TANGTANG
Mommy, can we find Daddy? Before the cold inside gets worse?

YE GE
(smiling)
That's why we're going.

TANGTANG
(happily)
Will he like my candies?

YE GE
He'll love them.

SFX: Motorcycle engines snarling closer.

TANGTANG
Mommy, someone's coming.

YE GE and TANGTANG quickly put on masks. Several motorcycles rush into the courtyard, surrounding them. ELDER RONG, the leader, gets off his bike. He wears clown makeup and has gray-white hair.

ELDER RONG
continuation:
(laughing maniacally)
The Pavilion's finest, running away with a child? You know the price of betrayal.

YE GE
I taught you everything. Even how to fail.

ELDER RONG
(laughing loudly)
Attack!

TANGTANG
Mommy, let me! Let them taste my candied hawthorn!

TANGTANG takes several spherical objects from her small bag and throws them forcefully at the motorcyclists. The spheres emit bright light upon impact, knocking the targets down.

ELDER RONG
(angrily)
Worthless.

TANGTANG proudly eats one of her "candied hawthorns." ELDER RONG, seeing this, prepares to attack personally.

YE GE
Tangtang, stand back!

YE GE steps forward, her body radiating golden light, transforming into a phoenix form. She engages in fierce combat with ELDER RONG. After several exchanges, YE GE defeats ELDER RONG.

The battle ends. YE GE withdraws her aura and removes her mask.

TANGTANG
Mommy, where are we going to find Daddy?

YE GE gently removes TANGTANG's mask.

YE GE
(eyes determined)
The Imperial Capital.

title: Tiptoeing Guardian & Longing Hidden in the Tutu & I Want Us Together
description: A mother returns home with a surprise ballet dress for her daughter, only to discover her husband's betrayal and her daughter's disappearance.
context:
Title: Tiptoeing Guardian & Longing Hidden in the Tutu & I Want Us Together
Description: A mother returns home with a surprise ballet dress for her daughter, only to discover her husband's betrayal and her daughter's disappearance.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

HUO ZIXI rides an old-fashioned tricycle. Her son BAO'ER sits in the cart behind her, holding a pristine white ballet tutu in his arms.

BAO'ER
Mom, let's hurry back. Sister Bei'er has always wanted a ballet tutu with a bow. She'll definitely love this surprise.

HUO ZIXI
(turning back with a smile)
Okay.

HUO ZIXI pedals faster, her face glowing with happiness.

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

HUO ZIXI rides the tricycle back to the courtyard in front of their home and stops.

HUO ZIXI
(lifting BAO'ER down)

BAO'ER
Mom, Bao'er is hungry.

HUO ZIXI
(affectionately stroking her son's face)
What a little foodie. Dad made your and sister's favorite sweet and sour pork tonight.

BAO'ER
(cheering)
Yay!

HUO ZIXI
Let's go.

BAO'ER, holding the dress, runs excitedly toward the door.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

BAO'ER
(shouting)
Dad!

BAO'ER and HUO ZIXI enter the house and freeze instantly. Husband WEN YICHENG is lying on the sofa with his head in another woman's (MISTRESS) lap. The MISTRESS is intimately feeding him. On the table: a MEDICAL FILE and STACK OF CASH.

HUO ZIXI stands shocked at the doorway.

HUO ZIXI
(trembling)
Wen Yicheng, what are you doing?

WEN YICHENG sits up impatiently.

WEN YICHENG
What am I doing? Cleaning up your mess.

HUO ZIXI rushes forward angrily and slaps WEN YICHENG hard across the face.

HUO ZIXI
(crying out)
Shameless!

WEN YICHENG, enraged, shoves HUO ZIXI away.

WEN YICHENG
You want shameless? Try being a father who can't afford his daughter's treatments!

HUO ZIXI
(tearful but resolute)
Fine. We're getting divorced. I'm taking Bao'er and Bei'er with me.

WEN YICHENG
(sneering)
Bei'er? The collectors took her at noon.

HUO ZIXI
(panicking)
Bei'er?

HUO ZIXI rushes toward the bedroom.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

HUO ZIXI bursts into the bedroom and finds her daughter's bed empty. She runs back to the living room in terror.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

HUO ZIXI
(demanding)
Where's Bei'er?

WEN YICHENG
(indicating the cash)
To a private facility. They specialize in children like her.

HUO ZIXI
(collapsing in tears)
You sold her... while she's sick?

HUO ZIXI lunges at WEN YICHENG. WEN YICHENG roughly shoves her to the ground.

WEN YICHENG
They'll cure her! Not that you'd understand the cost!

BAO'ER rushes forward, pounding WEN YICHENG with his small fists.

BAO'ER
(crying out)
You hit my mom! Why are you treating Mom like this? Give me back my sister!

WEN YICHENG
(roaring at BAO'ER)
Enough! The men I owe aren't patient!

HUO ZIXI rises from the ground, wipes her tears, her eyes becoming cold and determined.

HUO ZIXI
I gave up everything for you.

HUO ZIXI removes the wedding ring from her finger and throws it forcefully at WEN YICHENG.

HUO ZIXI
When I find her, you'll pay.

She takes BAO'ER's hand and walks out without looking back.

WEN YICHENG
(shouting at her back)
You're better off without me!

After the door closes, WEN YICHENG's arrogant demeanor vanishes instantly. He collapses to his knees in agony, picks up the wedding ring from the floor, and with trembling hands puts it back on his own finger, tears streaming down his face.

MISTRESS
(worried)
The debt's cleared. But your family...

WEN YICHENG
(doesn't answer, only cries in pain. He crawls toward the bedroom, opens a hidden compartment under the bed, where his daughter BEI'ER lies sleeping, an IV taped to her small arm)

WEN YICHENG
(inner monologue, voice choked)
Zixi... forgive me. This was the only way to keep you safe while I save her.

title: Freeloading Cousin
description: A struggling young man's act of kindness leads to an unexpected opportunity that could change his fortune forever.
context:
Title: Freeloading Cousin
Description: A struggling young man's act of kindness leads to an unexpected opportunity that could change his fortune forever.

INT. ROAST DUCK SHOP - DAY

COUSIN (20s, lean, quick-eyed) sweeps duck debris. His stomach RUMBLES. He glances at a GOLDEN CRISPY DUCK hanging by the counter.

DUCK SELLER (40s, weary) bags a duck for a CUSTOMER. The Customer pays with worn bills.

COUSIN'S eyes track the transaction. As the Customer turns, a piece of duck skin slides from the bag. In one fluid motion, Cousin catches it, pops it in his mouth.

DUCK SELLER
(catching him)
Hey! What're you doing?

COUSIN
(chewing, casual)
Cousin, just checking it's not spoiled.

DUCK SELLER
(snatching the broom)
Spoiled my ass. You work three days, you eat for free. Those are the rules.

COUSIN
(grinning)
Guess I'm still on day two, then.

EXT. COUSIN'S HOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY

Rain drizzles. GRANDPA (80s, frail but sharp) clutches a faded PHOTO of young Cousin with his parents.

OLDER COUSIN (30s, well-fed) and his WIFE hustle Grandpa toward a waiting car.

OLDER COUSIN
We're late. Let's go.

Grandpa turns back. Cousin stands in the doorway, holding a WARM BOILED EGG.

COUSIN
Grandpa. For the road.

Grandpa takes it. Their hands touch. The rain falls harder between them. Grandpa's mouth trembles, but no words come. He nods once, slow and heavy.

The car door SLAMS. Tail lights vanish into the gray downpour.

EXT. WAREHOUSE - DAY

Cousin hauls fifty-pound rice sacks. Sweat darkens his camo shirt. He stacks them with machine precision.

BOSS (50s, gruff) counts cash, then holds out THREE RED BILLS.

BOSS
Five days. No complaints.

Cousin takes the money. Counts it. Folds it carefully into his shoe.

COUSIN
Thank you, boss.

BOSS
(shrugging)
You earned it. Come back Monday.

EXT. OLD HOUSE - DAY

Cousin trudges up to a sagging wooden house. Paint peels like old skin. He stops on the steps, exhausted.

QIAN CAIQING (20s, beautiful despite threadbare clothes) sits on a stool, dabbing her lips with crushed petals for color. She spots him and smiles.

QIAN CAIQING
Tough day?

COUSIN
Forces a smile. Pulls out the three bills.

COUSIN
Got us something.

He produces a small BUNDLE: second-hand clothes. She unfolds a dress. The SEAM splits slightly.

QIAN CAIQING
(laughing despite herself)
Champion of the discount bins.

COUSIN
(defensive)
The vendor said it was last year's style—

QIAN CAIQING
(pressing finger to his lips)
Hush. It's perfect.

She holds it against her body, twirls. For a moment, they both forget the roof leaks.

COUSIN
Your mother called again?

QIAN CAIQING
(sighs)
She wants twenty thousand dowry. Or we wait another year.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

Cousin walks the crowded street in his warehouse camo. Billboards advertise LUXURY CARS, MANSIONS. He looks at his cracked phone screen: 86 RMB balance.

A siren WAILS in the distance.

EXT. ROAST DUCK SHOP - DAY

MR. WANG (60s, elegant but unassuming) guides MRS. WANG (50s, pregnant, radiant) toward the shop.

MR. WANG
The skin is crispier than the city hotels.

MRS. WANG
Then what are we waiting—

A SCREECH of tires. A DELIVERY VAN swerves toward them. Mr. Wang freezes.

Cousin, passing by, SHOVES them aside. The van's MIRROR clips his shoulder. He hits the ground hard.

Mrs. Wang screams. Blood pools beneath her.

MR. WANG
(frantic)
Someone call an ambulance!

COUSIN
(clutching his arm)
Hospital's two blocks. My tricycle's faster.

He points to a battered THREE-WHEELER with a cargo bed.

EXT. HOSPITAL - CONTINUOUS

Cousin pedals wildly through traffic, Mr. Wang cradling Mrs. Wang in back.

MR. WANG
(holding her bleeding head)
Stay with me. Please stay.

INT. HOSPITAL EMERGENCY ROOM - DAY

DOCTOR (40s, calm, urgent) and NURSES wheel Mrs. Wang away. Mr. Wang tries to follow. A NURSE stops him.

NURSE
Wait here.

MR. WANG
(to Cousin, trembling)
You saved us. Thank you.

COUSIN
(grimacing at his own cut)
She'll be okay. Strong lady.

MR. WANG
How can I ever—

COUSIN
Just doing what's right.

The Doctor emerges, pulling off bloody gloves.

DOCTOR
Mr. Wang? Your wife has severe internal bleeding. She needs AB negative. We have... one unit. We need three.

MR. WANG
I'll pay anything. Import it.

DOCTOR
No time. The nearest is two hours away.

COUSIN
(quietly)
I'm AB negative.

MR. WANG
(turning to him)
What?

COUSIN
Test me. If it matches, take it.

INT. HOSPITAL - BLOOD DRAW ROOM - DAY

Cousin lies on a bed, tube in his arm. Blood flows dark red into a bag. He watches it, pale.

Mr. Wang sits beside him, holds his other hand.

MR. WANG
I have no children. This baby was... our hope. Now I just want my wife.

COUSIN
You'll have both.

MR. WANG
Why are you doing this?

COUSIN
Someone once told me: when you can give, you give. That's all.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - LATER

Cousin stumbles out, arm bandaged. Mr. Wang supports him.

COUSIN
(weak smile)
You owe me a watermelon. The expensive kind.

MR. WANG
(laughs through tears)
I'll buy you the whole farm.

The Doctor reappears.

DOCTOR
She's stable. Your blood saved her.

MR. WANG
(to Cousin)
My name is Wang Dekuang. My home is empty. Too empty. If you ever need...

INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - LATER

BUTLER LIN (50s, precise) arrives with TWO BODYGUARDS. He takes in Cousin's bloodied camo, the bandage.

BUTLER LIN
Mr. Wang? Is Madam—

MR. WANG
Stable. Thanks to this young man. Where's the village project file?

BUTLER LIN
(pulling out a TABLET)
Ready. But sir, the board—

MR. WANG
(to Cousin)
You understand hard work. You understand sacrifice. Our rural education initiative needs someone who's lived it. Not another MBA.

COUSIN
(confused)
Me? I barely finished high school.

MR. WANG
You finished life school. Top of your class. Try it. Three months. Paid.

BUTLER LIN
(softly, to Mr. Wang)
Sir, his background check—

MR. WANG
I know exactly who he is. The only person who mattered when my world was ending.

Butler Lin hesitates, then bows to Cousin.

BUTLER LIN
Young Master Wang. Welcome to Kuangshi Group.

COUSIN
(overwhelmed)
I just wanted the watermelon.

MR. WANG
(chuckling)
You'll get it. And maybe a future worth building.

ON SCREEN: FREELOADING COUSIN - END OF EPISODE ONE

MR. WANG
(to Cousin, trembling)
You saved us. Thank you.

COUSIN
(grimacing at his own cut)
She'll be okay. Strong lady.

MR. WANG
How can I ever—

COUSIN
Just doing what's right.

The Doctor emerges, pulling off bloody gloves.

DOCTOR
Mr. Wang? Your wife has severe internal bleeding. She needs AB negative. We have... one unit. We need three.

MR. WANG
I'll pay anything. Import it.

DOCTOR
No time. The nearest is two hours away.

COUSIN
(quietly)
I'm AB negative.

MR. WANG
(turning to him)
What?

COUSIN
Test me. If it matches, take it.

INT. HOSPITAL - BLOOD DRAW ROOM - DAY

Cousin lies on a bed, tube in his arm. Blood flows dark red into a bag. He watches it, pale.

Mr. Wang sits beside him, holds his other hand.

MR. WANG
I have no children. This baby was... our hope. Now I just want my wife.

COUSIN
You'll have both.

MR. WANG
Why are you doing this?

COUSIN
Someone once told me: when you can give, you give. That's all.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - LATER

Cousin stumbles out, arm bandaged. Mr. Wang supports him.

COUSIN
(weak smile)
You owe me a watermelon. The expensive kind.

MR. WANG
(laughs through tears)
I'll buy you the whole farm.

The Doctor reappears.

DOCTOR
She's stable. Your blood saved her.

MR. WANG
(to Cousin)
My name is Wang Dekuang. My home is empty. Too empty. If you ever need...

INT. HOSPITAL LOBBY - LATER

BUTLER LIN (50s, precise) arrives with TWO BODYGUARDS. He takes in Cousin's bloodied camo, the bandage.

BUTLER LIN
Mr. Wang? Is Madam—

MR. WANG
Stable. Thanks to this young man. Where's the village project file?

BUTLER LIN
(pulling out a TABLET)
Ready. But sir, the board—

MR. WANG
(to Cousin)
You understand hard work. You understand sacrifice. Our rural education initiative needs someone who's lived it. Not another MBA.

COUSIN
(confused)
Me? I barely finished high school.

MR. WANG
You finished life school. Top of your class. Try it. Three months. Paid.

BUTLER LIN
(softly, to Mr. Wang)
Sir, his background check—

MR. WANG
I know exactly who he is. The only person who mattered when my world was ending.

Butler Lin hesitates, then bows to Cousin.

BUTLER LIN
Young Master Wang. Welcome to Kuangshi Group.

COUSIN
(overwhelmed)
I just wanted the watermelon.

MR. WANG
(chuckling)
You'll get it. And maybe a future worth building.

title: After Marrying Another, My Ex-Fiancé Regrets Everything
description: A woman realizes her worth when her fiancé chooses to save his mother who can swim, leaving her to drown.
context:
Title: After Marrying Another, My Ex-Fiancé Regrets Everything
Description: A woman realizes her worth when her fiancé chooses to save his mother who can swim, leaving her to drown.

INT. BRIDAL SHOP - DAY

SHEN RAN (orphaned daughter of the Shen family) gently caresses a pure white wedding dress.

SHEN RAN (V.O.)
I once thought I'd only wear white for Qin Feng. Until his mother, who swam competitively for years, and I fell into the water together.

EXT. SWIMMING POOL - NIGHT

SHEN RAN struggles in the pool, crying out for help in terror.

SHEN RAN
Help! Help! Save me!

JIANG HUI (Qin Feng's mother) stands at the edge of the pool, looking at SHEN RAN with disgust.

JIANG HUI
You money-losing wretch! Always playing the victim!

QIN FENG (Shen Ran's fiancé) rushes over.

QIN FENG
Mom!

He sees SHEN RAN in the water, takes off his jacket, and jumps into the water without hesitation.

JIANG HUI
(to Shen Ran)
You jinx! If you want to die, just die, why are you dragging my son into this!

QIN FENG swims to SHEN RAN and holds her.

QIN FENG
Ranran, don't be afraid. I'm here. I'll get you out.

JIANG HUI, seeing her son's devotion, stamps her foot in anger, slips, and also falls into the water.

JIANG HUI
Xiao Feng, save me!

QIN FENG hears the cry for help, turns to see his mother also struggling in the water, and is shocked.

QIN FENG
Mom!
continuation:
QIN FENG turns to SHEN RAN.

QIN FENG
Ranran, Mom is older and can't take this kind of stress. I need to save Mom first.

SHEN RAN
(crying out)
No, Qin Feng! You know I'm most afraid of water, please save me first! Mom can swim, she can wait a little longer!

QIN FENG
She's sixty-five and panicking! What kind of son would I be if I didn't save his mother?

QIN FENG releases SHEN RAN and turns to swim toward JIANG HUI.

SHEN RAN
(screaming in despair)
No!

QIN FENG swims to JIANG HUI.

QIN FENG
Mom!

JIANG HUI
(struggling)
Xiao Feng! Xiao Feng, save me!

QIN FENG rescues JIANG HUI to shore. SHEN RAN watches this scene helplessly in the water, gradually sinking.

QIN FENG
(anxiously)
Mom, are you okay?

JIANG HUI
(coughing)
Xiao Feng, I swallowed water. Quick, take me to the hospital.

QIN FENG
But Ranran...

JIANG HUI coughs violently, clutching her chest.

QIN FENG
(making up his mind)
Mom, I'll take you to the hospital!

QIN FENG picks up JIANG HUI and leaves without looking back. The camera turns to underwater, where SHEN RAN's eyes are filled with a terrifying clarity.

title: Soft and Sweet Wife Is Hard to Coax
description: A delivery girl helps an elderly man at a luxury residential gate, not knowing he is the patriarch of the wealthy Jiang family who wants to matchmake her with his grandson.
context:
Title: Soft and Sweet Wife Is Hard to Coax
Description: A delivery girl helps an elderly man at a luxury residential gate, not knowing he is the patriarch of the wealthy Jiang family who wants to matchmake her with his grandson.

EXT. LUXURY RESIDENTIAL COMPLEX ENTRANCE - DAY

An elderly man (GRANDFATHER JIANG) stands at the gate, leaning on a cane. A SECURITY GUARD approaches him.

SECURITY GUARD
Sir, this is a private entrance. You need to wait by the visitor's bench.

GRANDFATHER JIANG
(smiling)
My grandson is coming. This shade is better for old bones.

SECURITY GUARD
(agitated)
Move, or I'll move you.

The SECURITY GUARD shoves GRANDFATHER JIANG's shoulder. He stumbles backward.

A delivery scooter speeds up. The rider, a young woman named HAN MOMO, catches GRANDFATHER JIANG mid-fall.

HAN MOMO
Grandpa! I've got you.

GRANDFATHER JIANG
(laughing and waving his hand)
Ha! Good catch.

HAN MOMO
(to the SECURITY GUARD)
He was just standing there. Why shove him?

SECURITY GUARD
Daily scam attempts. You think I don't recognize the playbook? Jiang family property.

HAN MOMO
You see scams. I see an elder you almost dropped.

SECURITY GUARD
(stuttering)
I was doing my job—

HAN MOMO
(turning to GRANDFATHER JIANG)
Any injuries?

GRANDFATHER JIANG
(smiling)
Not even a bruise. Young lady, you're quite righteous. What's your name?

HAN MOMO
Han Momo. Call me Momo.

GRANDFATHER JIANG
Momo. Spirited. My grandson lacks that.

HAN MOMO
(surprised)
Grandpa, I don't—

GRANDFATHER JIANG
Oh right, he's late. I'll introduce you.

HAN MOMO
(waving her hands)
No, no. I'm not marrying anyone. I have deliveries.

GRANDFATHER JIANG
continuation:
(nodding)
Focus is good.

HAN MOMO's phone rings. She answers, the screen cracked.

HAN MOMO
(on the phone)
At the gate. Two minutes.

She pockets the phone.

HAN MOMO
(to GRANDFATHER JIANG)
Gotta go. Here—

HAN MOMO tears a page from her notepad, scribbles, hands it to GRANDFATHER JIANG.

HAN MOMO
My number. If you need help.

GRANDFATHER JIANG
(taking the note)
You give this to old strangers?

HAN MOMO
(grinning)
You're not a stranger. You're family to someone.

HAN MOMO revs her scooter and rides away.

GRANDFATHER JIANG
Drive safely!

SECURITY GUARD
(impatiently)
She's gone. You need to leave too.

A black luxury car stops. JIANG BEICHEN steps out in a tailored suit, tie loosened, BODYGUARDS flanking him.

BODYGUARDS
(bowing)
Welcome back, sir.

The SECURITY GUARD's legs give out. He collapses.

SECURITY GUARD
(shocked)
Master Jiang... he's your—

JIANG BEICHEN
(weary)
Get up. Apologize.

GRANDFATHER JIANG
You missed her. Your future wife.

JIANG BEICHEN
(confused)
Grandpa, I flew in from Tokyo. What—

GRANDFATHER JIANG
(holding up the note)
She gave me this. Before she knew. Blind date. Now.

GRANDFATHER JIANG grabs JIANG BEICHEN's arm, dragging him.

JIANG BEICHEN
(being dragged)
Ahhh! Grandpa, no! Someone save me!

title: Resigning the Chief Minister
description: The dying Chief Minister Shen Qi calls for his wife Liu Mianmian, but an imperial edict after his death elevates his mistress to equal status, shocking his widow.
context:
Title: Resigning the Chief Minister
Description: The dying Chief Minister Shen Qi calls for his wife Liu Mianmian, but an imperial edict after his death elevates his mistress to equal status, shocking his widow.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

Chief Minister SHEN QI lies in bed, his breath fading.

SHEN QI
(whispering)
Mianmian... the pendant...

Chief Minister's wife LIU MIANMIAN sits beside the bed, tears streaming down her face.

LIU MIANMIAN
(voice tight)
She already wears hers.

SHEN QI
(gasping)
Forgive... Mianmian...

SHEN QI finishes speaking, his hand drops, and he passes away.

LIU MIANMIAN
(in grief)
Shen Qi... I'm here...

LIU MIANMIAN holds SHEN QI's hand, sobbing uncontrollably.

LIU MIANMIAN
(crying out)
You gave me that name... you gave me that name...
continuation:
EXT. STREET - DAY

A funeral procession moves along the street, paper money fluttering in the air. LIU MIANMIAN, dressed in mourning clothes, walks at the front holding SHEN QI's memorial tablet, her expression hollow.

PASSERBY A (V.O.)
The Chief Minister's widow walks alone.

PASSERBY B (V.O.)
Strange—no male heir to lead the rites.

A MESSENGER rides up on horseback at full speed.

MESSENGER
(shouting)
Imperial edict has arrived!

A EUNUCH holding an imperial edict walks up to LIU MIANMIAN.

EUNUCH
Liu Mianmian, receive the edict.

LIU MIANMIAN, holding the memorial tablet, slowly kneels down.

EUNUCH
(unrolling the edict)
By the mandate of Heaven, the Emperor decrees: In recognition of Chief Minister Shen Qi's service, his deathbed petition is granted. His first wife Zhao MIANMIAN and second wife Liu Mianmian shall both hold equal status as wives. The eldest son, Shen Cheng of Zhao, inherits the estate. By this decree.

The surrounding crowd erupts in discussion.

PASSERBY C (V.O.)
A mistress elevated?

PASSERBY D (V.O.)
Both named Mianmian?

LIU MIANMIAN looks up in disbelief.

LIU MIANMIAN
(voice trembling)
Her name... was also Mianmian?

title: Fallen in the Wild
description: A woman in a red gown crashes her ex-lover's engagement party to reclaim what she believes is rightfully hers.
context:
Title: Fallen in the Wild
Description: A woman in a red gown crashes her ex-lover's engagement party to reclaim what she believes is rightfully hers.

INT. MAYBACH - NIGHT

A black Maybach drives through the city at night.

Inside the car, SONG HUAN wears a gorgeous red evening gown and is on the phone.

QIN HUAN (V.O.)
Song Huan, when are you arriving? Cheng Jiarou is already on stage.

SONG HUAN (V.O.)
Let her have her moment. It won't last.

Song Huan looks at a pendant in her hand - a photo of her and WEN KEYI, laughing together.

INT. BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

Inside the luxurious banquet hall, guests gather. CHENG JIAROU wears a light blue gown and stands on stage. GRANDPA WEN gives a speech beside her.

GRANDPA WEN
I'm very happy to attend Jiarou's birthday banquet. This is our Wen family's ancestral bracelet. I'm giving it to you as a birthday gift.

CHENG JIAROU
Thank you, Grandpa. I will treasure it.

GRANDPA WEN
Keyi, come, put it on Jiarou yourself.

WEN KEYI, wearing a black suit, walks onto the stage from below.

GRANDPA WEN
(to Wen Keyi)
Your marriage with Jiarou has been settled.

WEN KEYI takes the box containing the bracelet, his expression complex.

GRANDPA WEN
(into the microphone)
Taking advantage of Jiarou's birthday banquet, I invite all the guests to witness together as Keyi and Jiarou turn a new page in their lives. From now on, Jiarou will be our Wen family's granddaughter-in-law.

The guests applaud enthusiastically.
continuation:
INT. MAYBACH - NIGHT

SONG HUAN is applying lipstick, her hand trembling.

QIN HUAN (V.O.)
If the engagement is confirmed, he'll refuse the donation. This is your last chance.

SONG HUAN (V.O.)
Three years of chemo, and I'm not letting her steal my donor.

SONG HUAN
(to driver)
Stop here.

The car stops. SONG HUAN pushes open the door, steps out barefoot onto the pavement, and walks toward the banquet hall.

INT. BANQUET HALL - NIGHT

WEN KEYI and CHENG JIAROU stand in front of the birthday cake.

WEN KEYI
(quietly to Cheng Jiarou)
Make a wish and cut the cake.

WEN KEYI holds CHENG JIAROU's hand as they cut the cake together.

WEN KEYI
Cheng Jiarou, Grandpa is announcing the engagement today, but you know in your heart that we are just using each other. We've never been a real couple.

CHENG JIAROU
But Keyi, I truly love you.

WEN KEYI
Don't get too into character.

CHENG JIAROU
(tearfully)
I know you're doing all this to force Song Huan to return to the country. But Keyi, have you thought about it? Will someone who betrayed you ever come back? Are you going to keep waiting for her?

WEN KEYI
That's none of your concern.

On stage, GRANDPA WEN continues speaking.

GRANDPA WEN
Good things come in pairs. Today, I have another important announcement to make—

Suddenly, a cold female voice rings out.

SONG HUAN (O.S.)
I object.

The entire hall falls silent. Everyone turns around. SONG HUAN stands in the crowd wearing a red gown, her presence commanding.

CHENG JIAROU and GRANDPA WEN look shocked. WEN KEYI stares at SONG HUAN, his eyes filled with surprise and complex emotions.

title: This Mom Is Not So Calm
description: An elderly mother, rejected by her children on a snowy night, collapses in despair and awakens in the 1970s, given a second chance to relive her life.
context:
Title: This Mom Is Not So Calm
Description: An elderly mother, rejected by her children on a snowy night, collapses in despair and awakens in the 1970s, given a second chance to relive her life.

EXT. XIANG BEI'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Heavy snow falls. Elderly XIA YUEE, leaning on a cane, knocks hard on the door.

XIA YUEE
Xiang Bei. It's your mother. Just for tonight. The doctor said—

The door opens a crack. XIANG BEI'S WIFE's face appears.

XIANG BEI'S WIFE
The doctor said you need rest. Not our problem. Third brother's turn.

She slams the door. XIA YUEE touches the eviction notice taped beside it, then turns away.

EXT. XIANG DONG'S HOUSE - NIGHT

XIA YUEE huddles against a door curtain, her voice weak.

XIA YUEE
Xiang Dong. Wen Ying. I brought the dumplings you like. I'll leave them—

WEN YING (O.S.)
We don't want your food! Go bother Xiang Nan. It's his month!

XIA YUEE
Wen Ying, I haven't eaten in two days. Just some hot water—

WEN YING (O.S.)
There's a tap at the bus station!

XIA YUEE collapses against the door, then forces herself to stand.
continuation:
EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT

XIA YUEE staggers between houses. Through a window, she sees a family having dinner. Her eyes blur.

YOUNG XIANG BEI (O.S.)
Mom! You promised!

She stops. At the alley's end, FOUR CHILDREN wave—her sons and daughter, ages 8-12, in patched 1970s clothes.

FLASHBACK TO:

INT. OLD HOUSE - DAY (1970S)

Young XIA YUEE (30s) darns socks by a coal stove. Four small children surround her, breath visible in the cold.

ELDEST SON
Mom, when I'm big, I'll buy you a house with heating. Promise.

YOUNG XIA YUEE
(smiling, hands raw)
You'll freeze first without mittens. Here—I finished yours.

She pulls tiny mittens from her pocket.

YOUNGEST SON
Mom, you always eat the burnt rice. I want you to have the good pieces.

YOUNG XIA YUEE
(ruffling his hair)
Mom likes the crunchy bits.

DAUGHTER
(quietly, touching Xia's scarred hand)
Does it hurt?

YOUNG XIA YUEE
Not when I'm with you.

BACK TO:

EXT. ALLEY - NIGHT

XIA YUEE runs toward the children, but her cane slips. She falls. Blood trickles from her forehead onto fresh snow.

Her hand reaches toward the phantom children.

XIA YUEE
(whispering)
You forgot... the promises...

Her eyes close. Snow begins to cover her.

INT. HOME IN THE 1970S - DAY

XIA YUEE gasps, jolting upright in bed. Her hands—smooth, young—fly to her face. She sees the patched quilt, the coal stove, the cramped room.

CHEN WEIJUN (40s) enters with a bowl of porridge.

CHEN WEIJUN
You fainted in the vegetable line. The neighbors carried you home.

He sets down the bowl. Xia Yuee stares at her children's mittens drying by the stove—identical to the ones she just dreamed.

XIA YUEE
(quietly, to herself)
No. Not this time.

She looks at the calendar: January 1976. Her jaw tightens.

FADE OUT.

title: What's Wrong With This Hotel - Episode 1
description: A hotel manager's fiancée is attacked by a masked intruder. Six months later, a young woman arrives at the hotel for a pool party, only to encounter her boyfriend working as a server.
context:
Title: What's Wrong With This Hotel - Episode 1
Description: A hotel manager's fiancée is attacked by a masked intruder. Six months later, a young woman arrives at the hotel for a pool party, only to encounter her boyfriend working as a server.

INT. HOTEL HALLWAY - NIGHT

YANG ZHIJIAN and HE SIQING stand together. YANG ZHIJIAN is the general manager of Guochao Hotel, HE SIQING is the chairman's daughter.

YANG ZHIJIAN
The quarterly reports can wait until morning. You've been here since dawn.

HE SIQING
(flipping through documents)
And let the board think I'm just a figurehead? I need these signatures tonight.

YANG ZHIJIAN
At least let me wait for you.

HE SIQING
Go home. Your mother's expecting us for dinner tomorrow. Can't have you exhausted.

YANG ZHIJIAN kisses HE SIQING's forehead, reluctant. He leaves. HE SIQING unlocks her office door.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - CONTINUOUS

HE SIQING enters the dark room, immediately sensing something wrong. Before she can react, a MASKED MAN emerges from the shadows, gloved hand clamping over her mouth, a blade glinting at her throat.

MASKED MAN
Cooperate, and you'll see him again.

HE SIQING's eyes flash with recognition. She bites down hard on his gloved hand, stumbles backward, grabbing a crystal paperweight. She swings it—misses. The MASKED MAN shoves her. Her temple cracks against the edge of the mahogany desk. She collapses, papers fluttering down around her like snow.

The MASKED MAN stares at her still body, breathing hard. He pulls out a phone, texts a single word: "Done."

SIX MONTHS LATER
continuation:
EXT. HOTEL BUILDING - DAY

The hotel gleams in morning light, a stark contrast to the night's violence.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

SONG XIAOLING and her two best friends, FANGNI and LINGLING, walk into the hotel lobby.

FANGNI
(whispering)
I still can't believe we're actually here. Xiaoling, you're seriously connected.

SONG XIAOLING
(adjusting her designer sunglasses)
Connections are just relationships you haven't monetized yet.

LINGLING
So... survival strategy? Cheng's parties are notorious for those influencer types circling like sharks.

FANGNI
Speak for yourself. I've been practicing my laugh in the mirror for a week.

SONG XIAOLING
(smiling)
Don't worry. Sharks only attack when they smell blood. We, my dears, are perfume and opportunity.

They laugh, the sound echoing across the marble floor.

LINGLING
(hesitant)
What about... you know, your American boyfriend? The one you said is flying back soon?

SONG XIAOLING
Weixuan? Please. By the time he's back from his 'business trip,' I'll be in a whole different tax bracket.

FANGNI
(laughing)
You're terrifying. And I love it.

Lingling spots something, her smile faltering.

LINGLING
Xiaoling... is that—

FANGNI
(pointing)
Isn't that your boyfriend?

Across the lobby, HE WEIXUAN adjusts his hotel server uniform, tray in hand. His eyes meet SONG XIAOLING's. Hers widen, then narrow, calculating. His face drains of color.

SONG XIAOLING's expression freezes, but only for a heartbeat. She recovers, a slow, dangerous smile forming.

title: This Time Let Me Love You
description: A desperate mother fights to protect her daughter from being sold by her gambling-addicted husband, enduring years of abuse while clinging to hope for a better future.
context:
Title: This Time Let Me Love You
Description: A desperate mother fights to protect her daughter from being sold by her gambling-addicted husband, enduring years of abuse while clinging to hope for a better future.

INT. RUSTIC WOODEN HOUSE - DAY

XIANG BAORONG (25 years old) forcibly drags his daughter XIANG LE'AN (5 years old), trying to hand her over to a MIDDLE-AGED WOMAN (the buyer). YU MAN (23 years old) rushes forward desperately trying to stop him.

XIANG BAORONG
She's a good girl. No trouble.

YU MAN
(screaming)
Don't touch my daughter!

XIANG BAORONG
(shoving Yu Man)
I lost everything gambling!

YU MAN
(on her knees)
Please... she's my daughter!

BUYER
(surveying Le'an)
Small. Weak.

XIANG BAORONG
Yes, yes! Take her—
continuation:
YU MAN
(lunges, grabs Buyer's wrist)
Take me instead!

The buyer recoils, shaking Yu Man off. He turns and leaves. Xiang Baorong kicks a stool and storms out. Yu Man crawls to her frightened daughter and holds her tightly.

YU MAN
(sobbing)
Mama's here, my child.

THREE YEARS LATER

EXT. HOUSE PORCH - DAY

XIANG LE'AN (8 years old) sits in a chair, watching her father XIANG BAORONG walk by. She doesn't speak. YU MAN (26 years old) paints in secret.

XIANG BAORONG
Yo, what garbage are you painting?

He snatches the painting, crumples it, throws it down. He tugs Yu Man's ear hard.

XIANG BAORONG
You think you can work in the city? Stop dreaming.

He leaves. Yu Man picks up the crumpled paper, her eyes showing pain—and something harder. Le'an watches from the doorway.

YU MAN
(softly)
Soon, baby. Soon.

title: A Belated Confession
description: A successful CEO returns to his homeland after ten years and unexpectedly reunites with a woman from his past who has lost her memories of him.
context:
Title: A Belated Confession
Description: A successful CEO returns to his homeland after ten years and unexpectedly reunites with a woman from his past who has lost her memories of him.

EXT. AIRPORT RUNWAY - DAY

A private Gulfstream jet descends through afternoon haze.

EXT. HIGHWAY/CITY LANDSCAPE - DAY

A news broadcast plays over aerial footage of congested Imperial Capital.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Imperial Capital Airport grounds all commercial flights for VIP arrival. President Gu Tingfei returns after a decade abroad.

INT. LUXURY SEDAN - DAY

GU TINGFEI (30s, immaculate suit, hollow eyes) studies a silver charm bracelet—tiny lotus pendants catching the light.

GU TINGFEI
(softly)
Ten years, Nan Yan. Are you still here?

SECRETARY FENG drives, professional.

SECRETARY FENG
President, hotel in ten minutes. President Zhang's banquet is confirmed. Also... your grandmother's office called regarding succession requirements.

GU TINGFEI
Marriage.

SECRETARY FENG
Her exact word was "ultimatum."

GU TINGFEI pockets the bracelet.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

BODYGUARDS in formation. GU TINGFEI moves through, a man inspecting his kingdom.

BODYGUARDS
(bowing)
President Gu.

NAN YAN (late 20s, blazer, hurried) speed-walks while checking her phone. She clutches a portfolio.

They collide. GU TINGFEI catches her by the elbow. Papers scatter. A worn gold band drops, rolling across marble.

Their eyes meet—hers widen in shock, then blank confusion.

NAN YAN
(breathless)
Watch where you're—

SECRETARY FENG steps forward.

SECRETARY FENG
Do you realize who—

NAN YAN
(automatic apology)
Sorry, I'm late. Flight delays, client crisis—

She sees the ring. Panic crosses her face. She snatches it up.

NAN YAN
My ring—how did—

GU TINGFEI's eyes fix on the band.
continuation:
GU TINGFEI
Nan Yan.

NAN YAN
(steps back)
That's not my name. I'm—

She checks her phone: "Shen Group meeting MOVED to hotel. Emergency."

NAN YAN
I have to go. My client—

GU TINGFEI
You don't remember me.

NAN YAN
(flinches)
Should I?

A flicker—pain behind her eyes. She touches her temple.

NAN YAN
(whisper)
Why does my chest hurt?

She hurries toward elevators, ring clutched tight.

NAN YAN (V.O.)
That bracelet. I've dreamed it.

FLASHBACK:

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Rain-slicked street. Headlights. A girl's hand, lotus bracelet sliding off. The screech. A scream muffled by thunder.

END FLASHBACK.

NAN YAN stops at elevators, breathing hard.

NAN YAN (V.O.)
Ten years of missing pieces.

She boards. Doors close.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

SECRETARY FENG approaches GU TINGFEI.

SECRETARY FENG
President, your grandmother requires an answer by morning. The inheritance—

GU TINGFEI watches the elevator numbers climb.

GU TINGFEI
Draft a contract. I'll marry the woman who just left.

SECRETARY FENG
(stunned)
But you don't even know her name.

GU TINGFEI
She wears my grandmother's missing ring. She flinches when it rains. She'll remember.

(beat)

And I have ten years of empire to bargain with.

SECRETARY FENG stares as GU TINGFEI walks toward the banquet hall, determination in every step.

title: Tempting Game
description: Chen Nan, a fitness coach turned private driver for a wealthy CEO, receives a shocking request that changes everything.
context:
Title: Tempting Game
Description: Chen Nan, a fitness coach turned private driver for a wealthy CEO, receives a shocking request that changes everything.

INT. LUXURY CAR/EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

A black stretch luxury car is parked by the roadside.

CHEN NAN (V.O.)
I traded squat racks for these leather seats. Six months ago, I was a fitness coach.

CHEN NAN gets out of the driver's seat. He adjusts his cufflink, catches his reflection in the tinted window. A gold watch peeks from his sleeve.

CHEN NAN (V.O.)
Through a client's "generous" introduction, I became Wang Changhua's personal driver. Chairman of Changhua Group.

CHEN NAN opens the rear door for a GLAMOROUS WOMAN—her perfume hits him. He helps her out, simultaneously retrieving a gold-plated business card holder she drops. A MAN IN A SUIT hovers. CHEN NAN pockets the holder, returns to the driver's seat, and drives away.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD/COUNTRY LANE - DAY

The luxury car travels along a tree-lined road.

CHEN NAN (V.O.)
The salary's triple what I made. Benefits? Obscene.

INT. LUXURY CAR - DAY

CHEN NAN focuses on driving, his knuckles white on the wheel.

CHEN NAN (V.O.)
But sometimes...

FLASHBACK:
continuation:
INT. LUXURY CAR BACK SEAT - DAY

WANG CHANGHUA whispers to a YOUNG WOMAN—not his wife. His hand trails her thigh.

YOUNG WOMAN
(giggling)
Not here. He'll see.

END FLASHBACK.

CHEN NAN stares dead ahead. His grip tightens.

CHEN NAN (V.O.)
...I realize I'm just another asset. Traded. Managed.

EXT. WANG CHANGHUA'S HOUSE ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Night has fallen. The luxury car slowly stops in front of a luxurious villa.

CHEN NAN (V.O.)
Until tonight.

CHEN NAN (to the rearview mirror)
Boss. Home.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

The interior lighting is dim. WANG CHANGHUA sits in the back seat, expressionless.

WANG CHANGHUA
Xiao Chen. How long have you worked for me?

CHEN NAN
Six months, Boss.

WANG CHANGHUA
You're disciplined. Strong. My wife respects discipline.

CHEN NAN
(confused)
Sir?

WANG CHANGHUA slowly removes his gold-rimmed glasses. His gaze becomes sharp and serious.

WANG CHANGHUA
She needs to respect someone else. Someone... younger.

CHEN NAN's smile freezes instantly. His face is filled with shock and disbelief.

CHEN NAN (internal, shocked)
What?

WANG CHANGHUA
Seduce her. Make her fall. I'll pay you the company.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

CHEN NAN stares dead ahead. His grip tightens.

CHEN NAN (V.O.)
...I realize I'm just another asset. Traded. Managed.

EXT. WANG CHANGHUA'S HOUSE ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Night has fallen. The luxury car slowly stops in front of a luxurious villa.

CHEN NAN (V.O.)
Until tonight.

CHEN NAN (to the rearview mirror)
Boss. Home.

INT. LUXURY CAR - NIGHT

The interior lighting is dim. WANG CHANGHUA sits in the back seat, expressionless.

WANG CHANGHUA
Xiao Chen. How long have you worked for me?

CHEN NAN
Six months, Boss.

WANG CHANGHUA
You're disciplined. Strong. My wife respects discipline.

CHEN NAN
(confused)
Sir?

WANG CHANGHUA slowly removes his gold-rimmed glasses. His gaze becomes sharp and serious.

WANG CHANGHUA
She needs to respect someone else. Someone... younger.

CHEN NAN's smile freezes instantly. His face is filled with shock and disbelief.

CHEN NAN (internal, shocked)
What?

WANG CHANGHUA
Seduce her. Make her fall. I'll pay you the company.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Lost Lamb (Episode 49)
description: A wife receives a suspicious tip about her husband's whereabouts at a hotel, leading her to confront a potential betrayal.
context:
Title: Lost Lamb (Episode 49)
Description: A wife receives a suspicious tip about her husband's whereabouts at a hotel, leading her to confront a potential betrayal.

INT. HOTEL ROOM/HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

A WOMAN IN RED wearing a red silk blouse examines herself in front of the bathroom glass door.

WOMAN IN RED (V.O.)
Let's see what Xu Zhimo's wife thinks of her perfect husband now.

CUT TO: WIFE wearing a white dress, walking anxiously through the hotel lobby.

WIFE (V.O.)
Zhimo, would you really do something to betray me?

CUT BACK TO: WOMAN IN RED, her expression cold and calculated.

WIFE continues running through the corridor, phone clutched tightly.

WIFE (V.O.)
Please don't be in that room.

WOMAN IN RED takes out lipstick and touches up her makeup in the mirror.

WOMAN IN RED (V.O.)
The show is about to begin.

WIFE walks with a panicked expression.

WIFE (V.O.)
You would never betray me, right?

WIFE walks toward the elevator.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

WIFE walks down the corridor and suddenly hears sounds coming from Room 603.

FEMALE VOICE (O.S.)
Come on, don't stop...

MALE VOICE (O.S.)
You're insatiable, you know that?

FEMALE VOICE (O.S.)
Only for you, Xu. Don't make me wait.

MALE VOICE (O.S.)
Patience, baby.

WIFE stops outside the door, her face pale. She raises her trembling hand.

Knock knock.

Silence. She knocks harder.

KNOCK KNOCK KNOCK!

The door opens. She stares into the room in horror.

A hand lands on her shoulder.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT
(20 MINUTES EARLIER)

WIFE stands on the street, looking dazed. LIN DAN walks over.

LIN DAN
Hey, long time no see. How have you been lately?

WIFE
Sister Lin Dan, what a coincidence. Aren't you at work? I just talked to Zhimo on the phone, he said he was working overtime at the company with you in a meeting, discussing the resort project proposal.

LIN DAN
(awkwardly)
Ah, well...

WIFE
What's wrong? Is something the matter?

LIN DAN
Well, it's not really my place to say.

WIFE
Sister Dan, you and I knew each other before Zhimo and I got married. So first and foremost, you're my friend, and only secondly are you my husband's boss. So what is it that you can't tell me?

LIN DAN
Oh, I'm afraid that saying it will affect your marriage.

WIFE
(expression grave)

LIN DAN
Forget it. Lidu Hotel, Room 603. Go see for yourself.

LIN DAN turns and leaves. WIFE stands frozen in place, her face filled with shock and determination.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED...

title: Retired and Spoiled by Three Sons
description: A sanitation worker mother is surprised when her three successful sons appear at her workplace to honor her.
context:
Title: Retired and Spoiled by Three Sons
Description: A sanitation worker mother is surprised when her three successful sons appear at her workplace to honor her.

INT. GARBAGE BAG - DAY

Close-up shot of calloused hands deftly separating plastic bottles from refuse, placing each in a canvas sack with practiced efficiency.

EXT. PARK PATH - DAY

LIU XIAOHONG, 58, in a faded red sanitation vest, works methodically. Her movements carry the quiet dignity of decades of labor.

A YOUNG MOTHER passes with her DAUGHTER, who points at a discarded toy.

YOUNG MOTHER
Don't touch that. Dirty.
(glancing at Liu)
See? That's why we keep studying.

The mother hurries away. Liu pauses briefly, then resumes her work, her expression weathered but unbroken.

She heaves a bag onto her tricycle. A "Qirong Village Elementary 40th Anniversary" flyer flutters from her pocket. She smooths it carefully.

LIU XIAOHONG
(to herself)
Can't be late. They want me to speak about... old times.

She mounts the trike. Her colleague ZHANG YAN, 60, approaches with a thermos.

ZHANG YAN
Xiaohong, stop. Try my daughter's new tea.

Liu slows. Zhang pours tea, her gold bracelet catching the morning light.

LIU XIAOHONG
That's lovely, Yan.

ZHANG YAN
(inspecting it)
She insisted. Said mothers should have something nice. How are your boys?

LIU XIAOHONG
Busy. They have their own lives.

ZHANG YAN
Sons. So capable, yet so distant.
(sipping tea)
At least mine visits every Sunday.

Liu smiles politely, a familiar wall behind her eyes.

LIU XIAOHONG
Every family is different.

The rumble of engines cuts through the morning quiet—first a motorcycle, then the purr of luxury vehicles approaching slowly.
continuation:
FU CHENGZHI, 28, athletic and impatient, stops his Ducati. He removes his helmet, scanning the area with nervous intensity.

From the Rolls-Royce emerges FU QINGSHI, 35, impeccably suited, every movement calculated. He carries a leather folio.

FU SUIYUN, 32, steps from the Range Rover in casual designer wear, a gentle smile already on his face.

Liu sees them. Her grip tightens on the handlebars. She tries to pedal away.

Two bodyguards approach—not blocking, but positioning themselves respectfully nearby, hands clasped.

The three sons walk forward as one, but each moves differently: Chengzhi with restless energy, Qingshi with deliberate authority, Suiyun with calm assurance.

They stop before her. Chengzhi speaks first, his voice rough with emotion.

FU CHENGZHI
Mom. Please. Just listen.

Liu looks up, her composure cracking.

FU QINGSHI
We know why you do this. We know you refused our money again.

He opens the folio, revealing legal documents.

FU QINGSHI
We established the foundation in your name. For sanitation workers. For dignity.

FU SUIYUN
(softly)
But we can't let them honor you today while you hide who you are.

He gestures toward the path, where STUDENTS and TEACHERS from the reunion are gathering, watching. Liu follows his gaze, seeing the community she served, the children she helped raise.

FU SUIYUN
Let us be your sons. Properly. Just this once.

Chengzhi kneels, gently taking his mother's gloved hands.

FU CHENGZHI
The world should know. Not that we're rich. But that you're proud.

Liu's eyes fill. She looks at her three sons—so different, yet so united in this moment. She nods, almost imperceptibly.

ZHANG YAN watches from the sidelines, her tea forgotten, as the school group begins to applaud.

LIU XIAOHONG
(whispering)
You always were too much trouble.

She lets Chengzhi help her from the tricycle. Qingshi removes his suit jacket, draping it over her shoulders. Suiyun picks up her canvas sack.

Together, the four of them walk toward the waiting school celebration as the bodyguards begin loading her equipment into the vehicles with surprising care.

FADE OUT.

title: The Delicate Girl Stops Pretending on the Day of the Broken Engagement
description: A modern woman transmigrates into a 1978 period novel as Ye Weiwei, a sent-down youth engaged to a scoundrel, and wakes up to find herself being rescued by the handsome veteran Huo Xiao.
context:
Title: The Delicate Girl Stops Pretending on the Day of the Broken Engagement
Description: A modern woman transmigrates into a 1978 period novel as Ye Weiwei, a sent-down youth engaged to a scoundrel, and wakes up to find herself being rescued by the handsome veteran Huo Xiao.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE UNDER A TREE - DAY

Montage of vintage newspapers with "Reform and Opening Up" headlines, weathered propaganda posters, and black-and-white factory photos, accompanied by crackling radio broadcast of "The March of the Volunteers," creating the atmosphere of 1978.

Three female villagers (VILLAGER A, B, C) sit by the wall, sharing a melon, voices hushed with theatrical urgency.

VILLAGER A
(conspiratorially)
I saw it with my own eyes—Educated Youth Ye was pressed against Huo Xiao by the riverbank. Her clothes were soaked through.

VILLAGER B
(gasping, clutching her chest)
Then isn't Educated Youth Zhao losing face worse than a stepped-on watermelon rind?

VILLAGER C
(eyes gleaming)
Quick! The Brigade Secretary's wife is heading that way!

They scramble up, abandoning the melon, and hurry off with a mix of concern and excitement.

EXT. RIVERSIDE GRASSLAND - DAY

A small crowd of villagers has gathered at a respectful distance, murmuring. YE WEIWEI lies motionless on the grass, her wet hair plastered to pale skin, one sleeve torn.

ON SCREEN: Ye Weiwei - Sent-down Youth

HUO XIAO kneels beside her, his faded uniform soaked, a jagged scar visible above his left eyebrow. He checks her pulse with practiced fingers, then begins rhythmic chest compressions.

ON SCREEN: Huo Xiao - Demobilized Soldier

A strangled cry erupts from the edge of the crowd.

ZHAO MINGZHE pushes through, his face red, YE WANWAN clutching his arm with calculated alarm.

ON SCREEN: Zhao Mingzhe - Paper Mill Worker, Ye Weiwei's Fiancé
ON SCREEN: Ye Wanwan - Ye Family's Niece

ZHAO MINGZHE
(sputtering)
What—what are you doing to her! Unhand her!

YE WANWAN
(wailing)
Cousin Weiwei! Oh heavens, she's been violated!

HUO XIAO
(glancing up sharply)
continuation:
She's not breathing. I'm reviving her.

Huo Xiao tilts Ye Weiwei's head back, pinches her nose, and delivers two measured rescue breaths. The crowd collectively inhales.

ZHAO MINGZHE
(his voice cracking)
You're kissing her! My fiancée! In front of everyone!

He lunges, but Huo Xiao deflects the blow with a forearm, never stopping the compressions. Zhao Mingzhe stumbles.

YE WEIWEI coughs, water dribbling from her lips. Her fingers twitch. Her eyes flutter open—first with confusion, then with startling clarity.

YE WEIWEI (V.O.)
(quiet wonder)
These calloused hands. This borrowed body. That scar...

HUO XIAO
(gently firm)
Stay still. You've nearly drowned.

YE WEIWEI
(faint, voice hoarse)
Where... am I?

ZHAO MINGZHE
(scrambling up, voice shrill)
Don't play dumb! Tell this beast to release you!

He charges again. Huo Xiao smoothly extends a leg; Zhao Mingzhe trips face-first into the mud. Ye Wanwan shrieks.

YE WEIWEI (V.O.)
(realization dawning)
Huo Xiao. The war hero who... Zhao Mingzhe. The smiling villain from the novel who poisons his wife's medicine.

ZHAO MINGZHE
(face covered in mud, screaming)
Ye Weiwei! Command your paramour to stop!

HUO XIAO
(jaw tight, hand on Zhao's collar)
Another word and I'll send you to the Brigade for public indecency.

YE WEIWEI (V.O.)
(hand pressed to heart, trembling)
This is the chapter where the original Ye Weiwei begs forgiveness. But I am not her.

Quick flashback—modern city: fluorescent office lights, a woman typing furiously, the screen showing a web novel titled "Rebirth of the Eighties: Hubby's Sweetheart."

YE WEIWEI (V.O.)
(icily calm)
I transmigrated. And this story—this tragedy—ends today.

title: Asia-Pacific Cup Final
description: A star footballer wins the championship but exposes match-fixing, only to be betrayed by his wife and agent who destroy his career.
context:
Title: Asia-Pacific Cup Final
Description: A star footballer wins the championship but exposes match-fixing, only to be betrayed by his wife and agent who destroy his career.

INT. FOOTBALL STADIUM - NIGHT

Seventy thousand souls hold their breath. Floodlights bleach the night sky. Zhang Ran, 28, Daxia's prodigal son, receives the ball at midfield.

COMMENTATOR (V.O.)
(voice cracking)
Twenty seconds left... Ran has nowhere to go... three defenders closing...

The stadium's roar muffles to a pulse in Zhang Ran's ears. He doesn't see the defenders—he sees the text message from this morning: "Lose or lose everything." He cuts left, then right, gravity-defying. Blue flame seems to trail his boots.

ZHANG RAN
(under his breath)
Not like this.

He strikes. The ball SCREAMS through the air, a comet of pent-up fury. The keeper stretches—fingertips brush leather—but it erupts into the net.

COMMENTATOR (V.O.)
(screaming)
GOALLLL! Zhang Ran! In the 94th minute! Daxia are champions!

Teammates SWARM him, but Zhang Ran stares straight up at the stadium lights, tears streaming down his face. Not joy. Relief. Defiance.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE VENUE - DAY

Flashes STROBE like gunfire. Zhang Ran stands at the podium, trophy gleaming beside him. Charles, 60s, silver-haired, adjusts his FIFA lapel pin.

CHARLES
The integrity of our sport remains paramount. Mr. Ran, your performance was... extraordinary.

WORLD FOOTBALL ASSOCIATION FIRST DIRECTOR
We are honored to recognize Daxia's first champion in the modern era.

The Director extends a hand. Zhang Ran hesitates—just a beat—then shakes it. A reporter's phone BUZZES. Another checks his screen. Whispers ripple through the room.

REPORTER #1
Zhang Ran! Your contract's up—what's next for—

ZHANG RAN
Today is my last day as a professional footballer.

The room goes silent. Charles' smile freezes.

ZHANG RAN
(gripping the podium)
The Daxia Football Association and my agent, Fang Gu, attempted to fix this match. I have evidence. Financial records. Audio recordings.

REPORTER #2
(standing)
Where's the evidence? This is a serious accusation!

ZHANG RAN
It will be delivered to international authorities by end of business today. I cannot be part of a sport where a championship can be bought.

Cameras surge forward. Security rushes the stage. In the chaos, Zhang Ran locks eyes with a man in the back—FANG GU, 40, shark-eyed, already walking toward the exit.
continuation:
INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

Zhang Ran exits the elevator, trophy case in hand. His phone shows 47 missed calls. The garage is deserted except for his Maserati—fitted with a club parking pass.

FOOTSTEPS echo. Fang Gu emerges from behind a pillar, flanked by two bodyguards.

FANG GU
(smiling)
You couldn't just take the win, could you? The association was prepared to make you a god.

ZHANG RAN
They wanted me to be a puppet.

FANG GU
Puppets don't get mansions. Puppets don't get their wife's gallery funded.

ZHANG RAN
What?

LIU YITONG, 30, elegant in a silk blouse, steps from the shadows. She doesn't look at Zhang Ran. She looks at Fang Gu.

LIU YITONG
I told you he'd crack. Too much integrity. Very inconvenient.

ZHANG RAN
Yitong...?

She finally turns to him—her expression is pity, not guilt.

LIU YITONG
The Daxia Contemporary Art Museum wants me as curator. Fang made it happen. You made fourteen million a year kicking a ball. He made that in a weekend. That's the math, Ran.

FANG GU
(to Zhang Ran)
The evidence you think you have? It's already been edited. By your wife. She's quite good with computers.

Zhang Ran's grip tightens on the trophy case until his knuckles whiten.

FANG GU
But we can't have you running around playing whistleblower.

The bodyguards move forward—then stop. Fang Gu pulls out a vial of pills, shakes them like a maraca.

FANG GU
Olympic-grade anabolic steroids. Found in your locker. Your bloodstream. Your child's baby formula. That's a nasty custody battle waiting to happen.

ZHANG RAN
(low, dangerous)
Leave my son out of this.

FANG GU
Or what? You'll tweet about it?

He nods. The bodyguards seize Zhang Ran. One produces a syringe.

FANG GU
Just a small dose to make the story stick. You'll be asleep when the police arrive. Very tragic—Football King, couldn't handle the pressure, turned to chemicals.

Liu Yitong watches as they force Zhang Ran's mouth open. The pills rattle down his throat. He gags, struggles.

LIU YITONG
(quietly)
Don't fight. Xiaofan will still have his father. Just... not the one who plays football.

Fang Gu crouches, watching Zhang Ran convulse on the concrete, foam at his lips.

FANG GU
There never was a Football King. Only a ball-kicker who forgot his place.

He stands, wipes his shoes on Zhang Ran's jersey, and walks away. Liu Yitong follows, not looking back.

INT. NEWS STUDIO - DAY

The news anchor speaks with practiced solemnity. Behind her, Zhang Ran's face—eyes closed, being carried on a stretcher.

NEWS ANCHOR
Breaking: Daxia's football hero Zhang Ran hospitalized after acute drug overdose. Police sources confirm illicit substances found at his residence. The Football Association has stripped his title pending investigation. His career—his legacy—now hangs in the balance.
