Twenty seconds left... Ran has nowhere to go... three defenders closing...

The stadium's roar muffles to a pulse in Zhang Ran's ears. He doesn't see the defenders—he sees the text message from this morning: "Lose or lose everything." He cuts left, then right, gravity-defying. Blue flame seems to trail his boots.

ZHANG RAN
(under his breath)
Not like this.

He strikes. The ball SCREAMS through the air, a comet of pent-up fury. The keeper stretches—fingertips brush leather—but it erupts into the net.

COMMENTATOR (V.O.)
(screaming)
GOALLLL! Zhang Ran! In the 94th minute! Daxia are champions!

Teammates SWARM him, but Zhang Ran stares straight up at the stadium lights, tears streaming down his face. Not joy. Relief. Defiance.

INT. PRESS CONFERENCE VENUE - DAY

Flashes STROBE like gunfire. Zhang Ran stands at the podium, trophy gleaming beside him. Charles, 60s, silver-haired, adjusts his FIFA lapel pin.

CHARLES
The integrity of our sport remains paramount. Mr. Ran, your performance was... extraordinary.

WORLD FOOTBALL ASSOCIATION FIRST DIRECTOR
We are honored to recognize Daxia's first champion in the modern era.

The Director extends a hand. Zhang Ran hesitates—just a beat—then shakes it. A reporter's phone BUZZES. Another checks his screen. Whispers ripple through the room.

REPORTER #1
Zhang Ran! Your contract's up—what's next for—

ZHANG RAN
Today is my last day as a professional footballer.

The room goes silent. Charles' smile freezes.

ZHANG RAN
(gripping the podium)
The Daxia Football Association and my agent, Fang Gu, attempted to fix this match. I have evidence. Financial records. Audio recordings.

REPORTER #2
(standing)
Where's the evidence? This is a serious accusation!

ZHANG RAN
It will be delivered to international authorities by end of business today. I cannot be part of a sport where a championship can be bought.

Cameras surge forward. Security rushes the stage. In the chaos, Zhang Ran locks eyes with a man in the back—FANG GU, 40, shark-eyed, already walking toward the exit.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

Zhang Ran exits the elevator, trophy case in hand. His phone shows 47 missed calls. The garage is deserted except for his Maserati—fitted with a club parking pass.

FOOTSTEPS echo. Fang Gu emerges from behind a pillar, flanked by two bodyguards.

FANG GU
(smiling)
You couldn't just take the win, could you? The association was prepared to make you a god.

ZHANG RAN
They wanted me to be a puppet.

FANG GU
Puppets don't get mansions. Puppets don't get their wife's gallery funded.

ZHANG RAN
What?

LIU YITONG, 30, elegant in a silk blouse, steps from the shadows. She doesn't look at Zhang Ran. She looks at Fang Gu.

LIU YITONG
I told you he'd crack. Too much integrity. Very inconvenient.

ZHANG RAN
Yitong...?

She finally turns to him—her expression is pity, not guilt.

LIU YITONG
The Daxia Contemporary Art Museum wants me as curator. Fang made it happen. You made fourteen million a year kicking a ball. He made that in a weekend. That's the math, Ran.

FANG GU
(to Zhang Ran)
The evidence you think you have? It's already been edited. By your wife. She's quite good with computers.

Zhang Ran's grip tightens on the trophy case until his knuckles whiten.

FANG GU
But we can't have you running around playing whistleblower.

The bodyguards move forward—then stop. Fang Gu pulls out a vial of pills, shakes them like a maraca.

FANG GU
Olympic-grade anabolic steroids. Found in your locker. Your bloodstream. Your child's baby formula. That's a nasty custody battle waiting to happen.

ZHANG RAN
(low, dangerous)
Leave my son out of this.

FANG GU
Or what? You'll tweet about it?

He nods. The bodyguards seize Zhang Ran. One produces a syringe.

FANG GU
Just a small dose to make the story stick. You'll be asleep when the police arrive. Very tragic—Football King, couldn't handle the pressure, turned to chemicals.

Liu Yitong watches as they force Zhang Ran's mouth open. The pills rattle down his throat. He gags, struggles.

LIU YITONG
(quietly)
Don't fight. Xiaofan will still have his father. Just... not the one who plays football.

Fang Gu crouches, watching Zhang Ran convulse on the concrete, foam at his lips.

FANG GU
There never was a Football King. Only a ball-kicker who forgot his place.

He stands, wipes his shoes on Zhang Ran's jersey, and walks away. Liu Yitong follows, not looking back.

INT. NEWS STUDIO - DAY

The news anchor speaks with practiced solemnity. Behind her, Zhang Ran's face—eyes closed, being carried on a stretcher.

NEWS ANCHOR
Breaking: Daxia's football hero Zhang Ran hospitalized after acute drug overdose. Police sources confirm illicit substances found at his residence. The Football Association has stripped his title pending investigation. His career—his legacy—now hangs in the balance.

title: Transmigrated as Regent Prince
description: A mistreated office worker is knocked unconscious during a confrontation with his abusive boss and wakes up in ancient times as a powerful Regent Prince.
context:
Title: Transmigrated as Regent Prince
Description: A mistreated office worker is knocked unconscious during a confrontation with his abusive boss and wakes up in ancient times as a powerful Regent Prince.

TITLE CARD

INT. OFFICE HALLWAY - MORNING

ZHANG JI (28, rumpled suit, exhaustion in his eyes) checks his phone: 7:58 AM. A calendar notification spells "MOM'S SURGERY - Payment Due."

He sprints.

INT. OFFICE - CONTINUOUS

ZHAO LI (35, sharp suit, impeccable) sits at her glass desk. She doesn't look up when Zhang Ji enters, breathless.

ZHANG JI
(placing a folder down)
The market analysis. Before eight.

ZHAO LI
(flicking a speck from her desk)
Color-coded tabs, Zhang Ji. This isn't kindergarten.

ZHANG JI
You never specified—

ZHAO LI
(leaning forward)
I shouldn't have to. That's why you're you, and I'm me.

She pushes a deduction form: "-¥2,000." Zhang Ji's fingers tremble.

ZHANG JI
(very quiet)
My mother's medication...

ZHAO LI
(turning to her mirror)
Your personal life is not company property.

She applies lipstick. In the reflection, his face hovers beside hers—ghostly, erased.

ZHAO LI (CONT'D)
Powerless people have powerless problems. Now leave. You're staining my carpet.

Zhang Ji looks down—his worn shoes on pristine white carpet. He looks at his reflection in the dark monitor—hollow-eyed, invisible.

He slams his palm on the desk—not at her, but at the reflection. The mirror jumps. Zhao Li shrieks, lipstick streaking her face.

ZHANG JI
(stumbling back)
I didn't—

His head cracks against the steel filing cabinet. He collapses, unconscious. Blood trickles onto the white carpet.

TRANSITION TO ANCIENT BATTLEFIELD MONTAGE

War drums thunder through mist. SOLDIERS charge. A PRINCE on horseback raises his sword. The banner reads: "GREAT CHU."
continuation:
INT. REGENT PRINCE'S MANSION - DAY

ON SCREEN: Regent Prince's Mansion

ZHANG JI lies on a lacquered bed, eyes fluttering open. He wears crimson robes, embroidered with golden dragons. His hands—calloused, sword-worn—touch silk.

ON SCREEN: ZHANG JI - Regent Prince

He sits up, disoriented. The air smells of sandalwood and snow. His gaze lands on a bronze mirror—an unfamiliar face, his own eyes but older, harder.

On the bedside: a jade seal, heavy with authority. A scroll: "Regent's Edict—Power Over All Court Affairs."

ZHANG JI
(whisper, to himself)
...transmigrated?

Through the window, ARMORED GUARDS pass in formation. Their COMMANDER salutes him—a gesture of absolute loyalty.

Zhang Ji looks at his reflection. He tries on the proud smile from his fantasies. It feels like a mask.

He touches his temple—no wound. But the memory of Zhao Li's voice echoes: "Powerless people have powerless problems."

Now he has power. Infinite power. The thought doesn't bring joy—only the cold weight of the jade seal in his palm.

He closes his eyes. For a moment, he misses being invisible.

END SCENE

title: Comeback Life: My Name is Li Xixi
description: A determined young athlete and her disabled mother struggle to afford travel expenses for a national competition, facing difficult choices when a relative demands money.
context:
Title: Comeback Life: My Name is Li Xixi
Description: A determined young athlete and her disabled mother struggle to afford travel expenses for a national competition, facing difficult choices when a relative demands money.

INT. LI FAMILY HOME - DAY

LI CUIPING, mid-40s with a permanent limp, leans heavily on a crutch as she enters the one-room house. A plastic bag of discounted meat hangs from her wrist. Her daughter, LI XIXI, 16, kneels among flattened cardboard boxes.

LI CUIPING
Xixi. Dinner.

LI XIXI
(turning, eyes bright)
Mom! Coach called—I made nationals!

LI XIXI rushes to help her mother onto a stool. She notices CuiPing's swollen ankle.

LI XIXI (CONT'D)
Beijing. Next week.

CuiPing's hand drifts to her pocket. Her smile tightens.

LI CUIPING
Need money for the trip.

LI XIXI
Just a thousand. Everything included.

CuiPing unwraps a handkerchief. Counts: 700. Her knuckles whiten. She counts again, slower.

LI CUIPING
Your uncle owes us. From the accident. I'll send you tomorrow.

LI XIXI
(quietly)
Mom, it's okay. I can ask coach--

LI CUIPING
No. We don't beg. We collect.
continuation:
EXT. VILLAGE ROAD - DAY

A white Audi Q5 crunches gravel, stopping at the Li house. LI JIANQIANG, 50, gold watch glinting, scrolls his phone.

INT. LI FAMILY HOME - DAY

LI XIXI helps CuiPing stand as the door bangs open.

LI JIANQIANG (O.S.)
Cuiping! You home?

LI JIANQIANG and his wife, WANG LING, enter. He eyes the concrete walls.

LI JIANQIANG (CONT'D)
Saw Xixi's photo on the school WeChat. National athlete now, huh?

He produces a red envelope, taps it against his palm.

LI JIANQIANG (CONT'D)
My boy's wedding. I need the two thousand you borrowed back.

LI CUIPING
(freezing)
Brother. YOU borrowed. For your car.

LI JIANQIANG
(waves hand)
Details. Look, I need cash. Heard you scraped together money for Beijing. Hand it over, we're even.

The 700 yuan lies on the stool between them—tuition, medicine, food. Everything.

LI XIXI
Uncle, we only have--

LI JIANQIANG
--Seven hundred. Village talks. That's fine. The rest you owe.

He reaches. CuiPing's hand trembles but doesn't move.

LI CUIPING
(voice low)
That's her competition money.

LI JIANQIANG
(laughs)
Competition? Girl runs fast. So what? My son's future is real.

He plucks the cash from the stool. CuiPing's face drains. Xixi watches the Audi keys, the red envelope—her lane to Beijing vanishing.

LI XIXI
(suddenly clear)
Uncle.

He pauses.

LI XIXI (CONT'D)
Keep it. Consider it our wedding gift.

She helps her mother sit, back straight.

LI XIXI (CONT'D)
But we're done. The two thousand you owe us? Forget it. We're not family anymore.

Li Jianqiang's face darkens. Wang Ling pulls him out. The door slams.

LI CUIPING
(whispering)
Xixi... your dream--

LI XIXI folds the crumpled acceptance letter, presses it into her mother's hand.

LI XIXI
No, Mom. OUR dream.

She looks at the cardboard pile. Then at her mother's leg. A decision hardens.

LI XIXI (CONT'D)
But first, you need medicine. The nationals can wait.

EXT. LI FAMILY HOME - NIGHT

LI XIXI loads boxes onto a rusty tricycle. She glances at the stars, then at their window—her mother silhouetted there.

She pedals away, riding through the Audi's fresh tire tracks, erasing them.

FADE OUT.

title: The Choice
description: On her wedding day, a woman's life is shattered when her husband exposes an alleged affair video, forcing her to choose between leaving with nothing or being committed to a mental institution.
context:
Title: The Choice
Description: On her wedding day, a woman's life is shattered when her husband exposes an alleged affair video, forcing her to choose between leaving with nothing or being committed to a mental institution.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

A romantic wedding scene with a champagne tower and wedding photos, everything promising a happy beginning.

SONG XIAOQIAO (V.O.)
On my wedding day, my beloved husband exposed a video of my alleged affair. He gave me two choices: leave with nothing, or be sent to a mental institution.

The wedding ceremony is in progress. The groom, LI SIQI, and the bride, SONG XIAOQIAO, gaze at each other affectionately and exchange rings.

Suddenly, the large screen at the venue begins playing an indecent video.

In the video, a woman who looks remarkably like SONG XIAOQIAO is in bed with a strange man, behaving intimately.

MYSTERIOUS MAN (V.O.)
Sister, who's better, me or your husband?

The guests erupt in shock, murmuring among themselves. LI SIQI looks at the screen in disbelief, then turns to SONG XIAOQIAO.

SONG XIAOQIAO
(shocked)
What... what is this?

LI SIQI
(furious)
Song Xiaoqiao! You've been sleeping with another man behind my back!

SONG XIAOQIAO
(panicked)
No! I haven't!

Her best friend, ZHAO TIANTIAN, stands up, looking heartbroken.

ZHAO TIANTIAN
Xiaoqiao, you love Siqi so much. How could you do such a thing?

SONG XIAOQIAO's father, SONG DESHENG, also stands up, his face filled with rage.

SONG DESHENG
That's my daughter in the video!

SONG XIAOQIAO
(crying)
It's not! It's not me! I never did anything like this!

GUEST A
I heard the bride really loves the groom. She even got his name tattooed on her body.

Close-up shot of SONG XIAOQIAO's collarbone showing an ECG tattoo with "LSQ" on it.

GUEST B
Miss Song is a well-known entrepreneur in Jiangcheng. How could such a powerful woman do something so scandalous!

SONG DESHENG
continuation:
(roaring)
Song Xiaoqiao! You disgraceful creature!

The video plays another sound clip.

MYSTERIOUS MAN (V.O.)
Sister, who's better, me or your husband?

SONG XIAOQIAO (V.O.)
You, of course.

SONG DESHENG rushes to the stage and slaps SONG XIAOQIAO hard across the face. She falls to the ground.

SONG DESHENG
I never imagined my daughter would be such a promiscuous woman!

SONG XIAOQIAO
(desperate)
I didn't! It's not me! It really isn't me!

SONG XIAOQIAO (V.O.)
I love Li Siqi so much. How could I possibly do that with another man?

SONG XIAOQIAO crawls on the ground toward LI SIQI and clings to his leg.

SONG XIAOQIAO
Honey, please believe me. I really didn't!

LI SIQI
(shoving her away in disgust)
Don't touch me! You're filthy!

SONG XIAOQIAO
Honey, how could I possibly betray you? I only love you. Put the ring back on my finger. Let's continue with the wedding, okay?

LI SIQI
(coldly)
The evidence is right there. How can I believe you?

SONG XIAOQIAO
That video is fake! It must be fabricated!

LI SIQI
How could the video be fake?

SONG XIAOQIAO
You can check my schedule! I installed a tracking app just to put your mind at ease! Look, you can see where I was and how long I stayed everywhere! Everyone in my phone contacts, you know them all!

SONG XIAOQIAO takes out her phone and hands it to LI SIQI. He takes the phone and scrolls through it.

He sees the location data, and his expression softens slightly. Suddenly, he clicks on a voice message.

MYSTERIOUS MAN (V.O.)
Sister, you were amazing last night. I have a break next week. I'll be waiting for you at the apartment you rented for me.

LI SIQI's face turns ashen. He stares at SONG XIAOQIAO in shock. Her expression changes from hopeful to utterly devastated.

title: Heavenly Path
description: A warrior returns to discover his true heritage as the grandson of the dying National Lord, who reveals his royal destiny and a marriage arrangement.
context:
Title: Heavenly Path
Description: A warrior returns to discover his true heritage as the grandson of the dying National Lord, who reveals his royal destiny and a marriage arrangement.

EXT. SU CORPORATION BUILDING - DAY

A pink Maserati screeches to a halt. SU QING, mid-30s, smartwatch glinting, emerges first. Her sharp eyes scan the plaza before she opens the rear door.

YE FENG waits across the street in faded fatigues, his military boots worn but polished. He clutches a folded letter.

SU YUBING steps out—ice-blue silk gown, posture regal as a blade. She hasn't seen Ye Feng in two years.

YE FENG
(quiet intensity)
Yubing.

He crosses toward her. Su Qing blocks his path.

SU QING
(low, urgent)
The National Lord's condition is critical. If President Su arrives after the Council, the family loses everything.

YE FENG
My grandfather is dying. He's asking for you.

SU YUBING
(freezing)
Your grandfather was a border militiaman who disowned you for enlisting. Don't you dare—

SU YUBING
(hand trembling slightly)
The National Lord lies in state. Five thousand are waiting.

She extends a credit card, deliberately not meeting his eyes.

SU YUBING
Take it. For his burial.

She turns. The Maserati's engine screams.

The convoy arrives before she reaches the car—three black Rolls-Royces. BODYGUARDS form a perimeter.

YUN HE, 28, appears in a scarlet qipao, her battlefield grace evident in every step. She nods to the bodyguards—they part for Ye Feng.

YUN HE
(to Ye Feng, low)

(whisper-thin)
You wore your rank.

YE FENG

(seeing them)

A pink Maserati screeches to a halt. SU QING, mid-30s, smartwatch glinting, emerges first. Her sharp eyes scan the plaza before she opens the rear door.

Yubing.

(hand trembling slightly)
The National Lord lies in state. Five thousand are waiting.

Take it. For his burial.

title: Hospital Encounter
description: A woman discovers her supposedly dead fiancé may still be alive when she sees his doppelganger at a hospital with a pregnant wife.
context:
Title: Hospital Encounter
Description: A woman discovers her supposedly dead fiancé may still be alive when she sees his doppelganger at a hospital with a pregnant wife.

INT. HOSPITAL - DAY

HOSPITAL ANNOUNCER (O.S.)
Numbers 23 and 24. Please line up here to collect your medicine.

JIANG WANCHU holds a prescription slip, waiting in line at the pharmacy window. She looks forlorn, her gaze inadvertently catching sight of a couple walking by in the distance. The woman has a pregnant belly, and the man gently supports her.

PREGNANT WOMAN (O.S.)
The doctor says she might come early. I need to rest more.

MAN (O.S.)
(leaning in)
Then let's get you home.

JIANG WANCHU watches them, falling into a memory.

JIANG WANCHU (V.O.)
Tingchen. You'd be a father now.

PHARMACIST
Miss, here's your medicine.

JIANG WANCHU snaps back to reality.

JIANG WANCHU
Oh.

She takes the medicine, forcing a faint smile. She looks again at the couple. The man is speaking tenderly to the pregnant woman.

MAN (O.S.)
Almost there.

The man turns his face, revealing features identical to SONG TINGCHEN. JIANG WANCHU's pupils contract sharply. She freezes in shock. The medicine and prescription slip fall from her hands and scatter across the floor.

JIANG WANCHU
(murmuring)
Tingchen... Tingchen...

PHARMACIST
(leaning out)
Hey, Miss, what's wrong?

JIANG WANCHU rushes out desperately, frantically searching the hospital corridor for the man, but he has vanished into the crowd.

JIANG WANCHU (V.O.)
No remains. Just a name on a list. It could be anyone.
continuation:
INT. SONG FAMILY APARTMENT BUILDING - DAY

JIANG WANCHU arrives at the Song family's building, looking lost and distraught. She walks to the door and raises her hand to knock.

SONG MOTHER opens the door.

SONG MOTHER
(surprised)
Oh my, why are you back so—

She sees it's JIANG WANCHU. The smile on her face freezes instantly.

INT. RESTAURANT - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Four years ago.

JIANG WANCHU is eating cake when she suddenly bites into something hard. She takes it out and sees it's a ring.

JIANG WANCHU
This is...

SONG TINGCHEN sits across from her, looking at her affectionately.

SONG TINGCHEN
Chuchu, will you marry me?

JIANG WANCHU nods with tears and a smile. SONG TINGCHEN puts the ring on her finger.

SONG TINGCHEN
When my mission is over, I'll come back and marry you.

The scene cuts to a black and white memorial photo of SONG TINGCHEN.

INT. SONG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

SONG MOTHER holds JIANG WANCHU's hand, her expression grief-stricken.

SONG MOTHER
They said it was a containment breach. No remains to identify. His name was on the list.

JIANG WANCHU
(crying)
No body means no proof. He could still be alive.

SONG MOTHER
(choking up)
You're a good girl. Our Tingchen wasn't fortunate enough. Some doors have to stay closed.

INT. SONG FAMILY DOORWAY - DAY (PRESENT)

Back to the present. JIANG WANCHU stands at the door, her eyes sad but determined.

JIANG WANCHU (V.O.)
You broke your promise, Tingchen.

SONG MOTHER
(nervous)
Why are you here?

JIANG WANCHU's gaze moves past SONG MOTHER to a family portrait hanging on the wall. The man in the photo is the "SONG TINGCHEN" she saw at the hospital.

JIANG WANCHU
(voice trembling)
I wasn't mistaken. Tingchen is really still alive.

JIANG WANCHU
If I hadn't come, would I have been kept in the dark forever?

SONG MOTHER's face crumples, grief and guilt warring across her features.

title: Regret Cannot Be Remedied
description: A father abandons his daughter on her birthday in a rainstorm to visit another woman, leading to tragedy.
context:
Title: Regret Cannot Be Remedied
Description: A father abandons his daughter on her birthday in a rainstorm to visit another woman, leading to tragedy.

INT. GU FAMILY COURTYARD - DAY

Rain pounds the courtyard. ZHOU HONG shelters under the awning, phone to her ear. Snacks for Mengmeng's party sit on a wet table.

ZHOU HONG
(on phone)
Ma, not today. It's Mengmeng's birthday.

She drops her keys.

ZHOU HONG
(into phone, sudden)
Wait—did Dachuan pick her up?

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

Heavy rain. GU DACHUAN rides a motorcycle. His daughter MENGMENG clutches his waist, helmet slipping.

GU DACHUAN
(into phone)
I've got her. We're on the old road.

ZHOU HONG (V.O.)
(over phone)
But that's—

He hangs up. The phone RINGS—different tone. He glances down. "Xiaolian." Doesn't answer.

MENGMENG
Dad? The strawberry cake?

GU DACHUAN
(distracted)
We'll see.

MENGMENG
You promised.

The phone RINGS again.
continuation:
INT. PAN XIAOLIAN'S HOUSE - DAY

PAN XIAOLIAN watches the storm, phone to her ear. KAIKAI sits beside her.

PAN XIAOLIAN
(into phone, soft)
Brother Chuan? Kaikai won't blow out his candles until you come.

She waits.

PAN XIAOLIAN
(whisper)
He keeps asking for you.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

GU DACHUAN brakes. The bike idles. He stares at the phone.

MENGMENG
Dad?

GU DACHUAN
(not turning)
Get off.

MENGMENG
What?

GU DACHUAN
I forgot the cake. Walk from here.

MENGMENG
But the rain—

GU DACHUAN
(quiet, harsh)
You want your party or not?

A beat. The phone RINGS. He answers, voice low.

GU DACHUAN
(into phone)
Xiaolian.

PAN XIAOLIAN (V.O.)
(over phone)
We're waiting.

Mengmeng watches her father's face.

GU DACHUAN
(to Mengmeng, still not looking)
Stay on the road.

He kickstarts the bike. Rides away. Taillights vanish.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD/HIGHWAY - DAY

Mengmeng walks alone. Rain pounds. She spots a footpath—orange construction tape marking a shortcut through flooded fields.

She takes it.

Mud slides. She falls.

MENGMENG
Dad!

Water rushes, pulling her toward a drainage culvert.

MENGMENG (O.S.)
Dad... help...

Rain pours into the culvert. The construction tape snaps, floats away.

title: A Long-Awaited Promise
description: A schoolgirl vandalizing a car in a parking garage has an unexpected encounter with the car's owner, a celebrity fleeing from fans.
context:
Title: A Long-Awaited Promise
Description: A schoolgirl vandalizing a car in a parking garage has an unexpected encounter with the car's owner, a celebrity fleeing from fans.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

A black motorcycle screeches to a halt.

LIN LEYAO, a girl wearing a school uniform and a baseball cap, gets off the bike and shakes out her long hair. Her expression is cold as she walks toward an orange convertible sports car parked nearby.

She takes out a white marker from her bag and crouches in front of the car.

LIN LEYAO (V.O.)
You black-hearted boss, this is what you get for breaking my father's contract.

She begins to graffiti on the hood of the car.

EXT. COMMERCIAL BUILDING - NIGHT

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO, a young man wearing a bucket hat and sunglasses, walks out of the building flanked by two BODYGUARDS.

A large crowd of FANS swarms forward, screaming frantically.

FANS
(screaming)
He's here, he's here! Shangguan Yunhao! Shangguan Yunhao!

The BODYGUARDS struggle to hold back the fans, clearing a path for SHANGGUAN YUNHAO.

BODYGUARD
Make way, make way!

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO
Where are my parents?

BODYGUARD
They're in a meeting. Your mother is preparing dinner. Your stepmother is in the parking garage—with your car.

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO
(impatiently)
Don't follow me.

He pushes through the crowd, heading toward the parking garage.
continuation:
INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

LIN LEYAO is still focused on vandalizing the car.

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO enters the parking garage and sees the scene. He freezes. He removes his sunglasses, staring in disbelief.

He takes out his phone and snaps a photo of LIN LEYAO.

LIN LEYAO senses someone's presence and turns around alertly, seeing SHANGGUAN YUNHAO.

LIN LEYAO
Don't interfere.

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO
This is my car.

LIN LEYAO
(shocked)
Yours?

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO presses the car key. The convertible top automatically closes. LIN LEYAO jumps in fright and awkwardly stands up.

LIN LEYAO
(stammering)
This car... if you just touch up the paint, it shouldn't cost that much, right?

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO
You—

FANS (O.S.)
Yunhao! Shangguan Yunhao! That person up ahead looks like him! Over there!

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO sees the fans chasing after him. He pulls LIN LEYAO toward him and kisses her.

LIN LEYAO's eyes widen in shock.

The FANS catch up and see the two kissing. They stop in their tracks.

FANS
Catch up to him! Don't run away, Yunhao!

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO breaks the kiss and looks at LIN LEYAO, his eyes signaling her.

The FANS are still watching from a distance.

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO
(to LIN LEYAO)
Get in the car.

He pulls LIN LEYAO into the passenger seat. He picks up her bag from the ground and gets into the driver's seat himself.

FANS
Shangguan Yunhao, don't let him escape! Quick, quick, quick! They're over there! He got away again!

SHANGGUAN YUNHAO starts the car and speeds out of the parking garage with LIN LEYAO.

title: Return of the Dragon King
description: A legendary Dragon King loses his wife to terrorists and abandons his power to live in mourning, seeking vengeance against the Death God organization.
context:
Title: Return of the Dragon King
Description: A legendary Dragon King loses his wife to terrorists and abandons his power to live in mourning, seeking vengeance against the Death God organization.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

A crude wooden tombstone stands in the wilderness, inscribed with "Tomb of Beloved Wife Shen Wenwan."

LI PING'AN, in tattered clothes and unshaven, kneels before the grave, holding a wine flask. He pours a last drop onto the earth.

LI PING'AN
(quietly)
Every day I tell myself I'm done. And every night... I see you.

He touches the tombstone, then pulls his hand back as if burned.

LI PING'AN
(whispering)
I'm sorry.

His shoulders tremble, but he makes no sound.

DISSOLVE TO:

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING - DAY (THREE YEARS AGO)

SUPER: THREE YEARS AGO

The PRODIGY DRAGON KING (LI PING'AN) in black armor, sword at the DEMON KING's throat. Around them, defeated terrorists.

PRODIGY DRAGON KING
Your stronghold is dust. Your men are gone. End this.

DEMON KING's mask is cracked, blood seeping through. He coughs a laugh.

DEMON KING
You think this is the end? We knew you'd come. Death God knows your true weakness.

The Dragon King's grip tightens.

PRODIGY DRAGON KING
What did you do?

DEMON KING
(gasping)
Three squads. Fire Mountain Village. By the time you hear this... she's already ash.

The Dragon King's sword clatters to the ground. He grabs the Demon King by the throat.

PRODIGY DRAGON KING
(voice deadly quiet)
Liar.

DEMON KING
(strangled)
Check... your phone. The Death God organization... will be waiting.

The Prodigy Dragon King's palm strikes. The Demon King disintegrates.

PRODIGY DRAGON KING
Bastard! Go to hell!
continuation:
EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

LI PING'AN's SUV screams to a halt at the village edge. He stumbles out, armor half-removed, phone showing fifteen missed calls.

EXT. FIRE MOUNTAIN VILLAGE - DAY

BING FENG meets him halfway, her expression saying everything. Behind her, Shen Wenwan's body lies covered.

LI PING'AN
(stumbling)
No. No, I ordered—

BING FENG
They were waiting. They knew our response time.

LI PING'AN pushes past her to the body. He pulls back the cloth. Sees the gold ring on her finger, the one he gave her before he left.

LI PING'AN
(voice hollow)
I told her she was safe. I promised.

He doesn't roar. He goes still, like something inside him has snapped.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY (THREE YEARS AGO)

LI PING'AN digs the grave himself, places the wooden marker, then buries his Dragon King insignia at its foot. Subordinates watch from a distance.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY (PRESENT)

LI PING'AN takes out his phone to make a call.

LI PING'AN
Dragon King hotline, transfer to Office Number One. Immediately issue the directive: activate the global Underground Dragon, exterminate the Death God organization.

OFFICE NUMBER ONE (V.O.)
Office Number One, directive received. Activating Underground Dragon, exterminating Death God.

MONTAGE: Rapid cuts of battle sequences across the globe. Underground forces mobilize, launching a comprehensive extermination operation against the Death God organization. Gunfire, explosions, flames shooting into the sky. Each team bears the dragon-and-sword insignia.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

The CHIEF watches the operations on wall screens. LI PING'AN enters in civilian clothes, face unreadable.

CHIEF

It'll make sure no one else has to dig a grave like mine.

Title: Return of the Dragon King
Description: A legendary Dragon King loses his wife to terrorists and abandons his power to live in mourning, seeking vengeance against the Death God organization.

EXT. CEMETERY - DAY

A crude wooden tombstone stands in the wilderness, inscribed with "Tomb of Beloved Wife Shen Wenwan."

LI PING'AN
(quietly)
Every day I tell myself I'm done. And every night... I see you.

He touches the tombstone, then pulls his hand back as if burned.

(whispering)
I'm sorry.

His shoulders tremble, but he makes no sound.

title: That New Year's Eve, Never to Meet Again in Life or Death
description: A mother loses her voice searching for her children in the snow after they mysteriously disappear on New Year's Eve, only to discover her husband's dark secret.
context:
Title: That New Year's Eve, Never to Meet Again in Life or Death
Description: A mother loses her voice searching for her children in the snow after they mysteriously disappear on New Year's Eve, only to discover her husband's dark secret.

EXT. VILLAGE SQUARE - NIGHT

Snow falls gently on the village square. Red lanterns sway above. YOUNG SONG ZE (8) and YOUNG SONG YA (6) dance in circles, tracing patterns with sparklers.

SONG PING (40s) approaches, his smile tight at the edges.

SONG PING
Xiao Ze, Xiao Ya. Time to go.

YOUNG SONG YA
Where, Dad? We just started.

SONG PING
Your mother's waiting. In the city.

YOUNG SONG ZE
Mom? She's home?

SONG PING
She sent a car. For New Year's.

The children's faces light up. Song Ya drops her sparkler, runs to the waiting car. Song Ze follows, then stops.

YOUNG SONG ZE
Aren't you coming?

SONG PING
Dad has preparations here. Call me when you arrive.

The children climb into the car. It pulls away, red tail lights bleeding through snow.

Song Ping watches until it vanishes. His smile fades. He pulls out a phone, dials.

SONG PING
(into phone)
It's done. They're on their way.

He hangs up. A complex emotion crosses his face—something between relief and dread.

FLASHBACK:

INT. SONG FAMILY HOME - DAY - THREE YEARS AGO

Liu CUILAN (30s) stands with a suitcase. Young Song Ya clings to her leg, sobbing.

YOUNG SONG YA
Mom, don't go! I hate you!

Liu Cuilan kneels, wipes tears.

LIU CUILAN
I'll be back soon. I promise.

She kisses Song Ya's forehead. The child turns away.

BACK TO PRESENT:
continuation:
INT. SONG FAMILY HOME - NIGHT - ONE HOUR LATER

The front door bursts open. LIU CUILAN enters, snow dusting her coat. She scans the empty room.

LIU CUILAN
Song Ping? Kids?

SONG PING sits in shadows, perfectly still.

LIU CUILAN
Where are they?

SONG PING
You tell me.

LIU CUILAN
What?

SONG PING
They left this.

He slides a crumpled paper across the table. She grabs it.

INSERT: Childish scrawl—"Mom, we went to find you. Don't worry."

LIU CUILAN
(fading)
Ze'er's handwriting...

SONG PING
(quietly)
I came home. They were gone.

LIU CUILAN
But—they don't know the way. They can't—

SONG PING
You work in that city three hundred days a year. Maybe they learned the route.

A barb hidden in concern. Liu Cuilan's hands shake.

LIU CUILAN
We have to call—

SONG PING
And tell them what? That their mother was too busy for them? That she finally came home and they're missing?

LIU CUILAN
Song Ping, please—

SONG PING
(rising)
You look. I'll... wait here.

He turns away. In the window reflection, his expression hardens—calculating, not grieving.

EXT. VILLAGE STREETS - DAY

MONTAGE - TWO DAYS OF SEARCHING

-- Liu Cuilan runs door to door, snow soaking her shoes.

-- She tapes flyers to every pole: MISSING in bold characters.

-- At a bus station, she shows the flyer to a DRIVER. He shakes his head.

-- She stands at a crossroads, spinning in circles, calling their names until her voice cracks.

-- Night falls. She collapses against a wall, missing person flyers falling from her frozen hands.

Her voice grows HOARSER with each call.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Liu Cuilan wakes to white walls. She tries to speak—nothing emerges but air.

Her fingers fly to her throat. The DOCTOR (50s) enters with a chart.

DOCTOR
Vocal cord hemorrhage. Three days of screaming in subzero temperatures. The damage is permanent.

Liu Cuilan stares, silent tears beginning.

DOCTOR
(gently)
You can learn to sign. You can write.

Liu Cuilan grabs a pen from his pocket, scribbles on a tissue: "MY CHILDREN?"

The doctor's face falls. He shakes his head.

Liu Cuilan crumples, soundless sobs shaking her shoulders.

INT. SONG FAMILY HOME - DAY - ONE WEEK LATER

Liu Cuilan returns. The house is silent. She moves like a ghost, touching the children's small coats, their drawings on the wall.

She finds the note again on the table. Studies it. Something's wrong—the handwriting too perfect, the words too mature.

She flips it over. A phone number. Smudged. City area code.

Her eyes narrow. She looks toward the bedroom where Song Ping sleeps, then back at the number.

She folds the note, tucks it into her shirt, close to her heart.

Her silence has become armor.

FADE OUT.

title: Xuantian Emperor
description: A cultivator who has been stuck at the Qi Refining stage for twenty years is urged to descend the mountain to fulfill marriage contracts, while a powerful enemy reappears.
context:
Title: Xuantian Emperor
Description: A cultivator who has been stuck at the Qi Refining stage for twenty years is urged to descend the mountain to fulfill marriage contracts, while a powerful enemy reappears.

INT. WILDERNESS - DAY

SHEN FAN sits cross-legged before a cracked spirit tablet. He meditates, hands forming seals. Golden energy spirals from him in ten thousand fragile threads.

CUT TO: A white fox darts through the forest, drawn by the unstable aura.

Sweat beads on Shen Fan's forehead. The threads tangle and snap.

Several FOX DEMONS materialize from the shadows, their movements hypnotic.

FOX DEMON
(O.S.)
Twenty years, and the mountain still echoes your name...

FOX DEMON
(O.S.)
Such focus. Such loneliness.

FOX DEMON
(O.S.)
Big brother, even stone yields to rain.

The demons brush against him, their touch like silk over iron.

SHEN FAN's eyes snap open—molten gold, weary but unbroken.

SHEN FAN
The mountain yields to those who walk down it. I haven't.

SHEN FAN forms seals.

SHEN FAN
Break.

Energy implodes, dissolving the demons into smoke.

FOX DEMON
(hissing, reforming)

The lead demon smirks, sharp-toothed.

FOX DEMON
Stubborn. But can you break your own chains?

The demons hurl phantom blades and rotting silk.

SHEN FAN sits steady. The spirit tablet glows, forming a shield etched with names.

SHEN FAN
Watch how this Daoist deals with his ghosts.

The shield pulses. The demons shatter into petals.

Shen Fan exhales. An old hand rests on his shoulder.

SHEN FAN
(voice low)
Another test?

He whirls, fist raised.

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
(blocking, wincing)
Ouch! It's me, you paranoid turtle!

SHEN FAN
(surprised, lowering his fist)
Junior Martial Uncle? You know I hate being touched.
continuation:
JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
The twenty-year anchor lifted at dawn. Time to descend.

SHEN FAN
Dawn was ten thousand layers ago. I'm still Qi Refining.

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
Ten thousand layers that crack mountains. You're not fooling anyone.

Shen Fan says nothing.

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE pulls out lacquered contracts and jade tokens.

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
Grand Master's wards. Ten women, ten cities. Your breakthrough isn't up here.

SHEN FAN
(eyeing the tokens)
He thought pretty faces would tempt me?

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
He thought losing Yun Feng taught you that some things matter more than cultivation.

Spiritual energy surges. Leaves wither.

SHEN FAN
(softly)
The Xuantian Jade.

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
Fire Cloud Evil God has it. Three days, Haizhou.

Shen Fan's hands tremble. The tokens glow in his grip.

SHEN FAN
He wants me to break the contracts for revenge.

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
He wants you to live. Finally.

Shen Fan stares at the tokens. Each shows a woman with Yun Feng's eyes.

SHEN FAN
I'll go down the mountain.
(beat)
To honor the dead. Not to marry the living.

He pockets the contracts.

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
They're not tigresses. Most aren't even cultivators.

SHEN FAN
(over his shoulder)
Then they'll understand when I break their hearts.

He walks away. The white fox watches from the shadows.

JUNIOR MARTIAL UNCLE
(calling)
Some hearts don't break easily!

FLASHBACK: YUN FENG, bleeding, presses a jade token into young SHEN FAN's hand.

YUN FENG
Stay at Qi Refining. Protect them for me.

Shen Fan nods, clutching the token.

BACK TO PRESENT: Shen Fan touches the matching token in his pocket. It pulses warm.

title: Domestic Violence Confrontation
description: A police captain visits a household after reports of domestic abuse, where a battered wife finally reaches her breaking point and decides to fight back against her violent husband.
context:
Title: Domestic Violence Confrontation
Description: A police captain visits a household after reports of domestic abuse, where a battered wife finally reaches her breaking point and decides to fight back against her violent husband.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

CAPTAIN FENG stands at the door, clipboard in hand.

CAPTAIN FENG
Third call this month, Mr. Xiang. Explain.

XIANG SHIREN
(leaning against the frame)
Domestic bliss, Captain. Neighbors wouldn't understand.

AN NING emerges, bruised, holding DUODUO.

CAPTAIN FENG
Mrs. Xiang. What happened?

AN NING
(pointing)
He hit me. Again.

XIANG SHIREN
(before Feng can respond)
Captain, couples argue. It's normal.

CAPTAIN FENG
(interrupting)
It's not normal when we respond three times. I'm filing a report. Next time, charges are automatic.

He hands An Ning a card.

CAPTAIN FENG
Shelter. Use it.

Captain Feng leaves. Xiang Shiren locks the door, drops the smile.

XIANG SHIREN
You think that card helps?

AN NING
It proves you lie.

XIANG SHIREN slaps her.

AN NING
That's assault.

XIANG SHIREN
(grabs belt)
You want to report me?

DUODUO rushes forward.

DUODUO
Stop!

XIANG SHIREN kicks her away.
continuation:
AN NING
Duoduo!

AN NING rushes to her daughter.

AN NING
(turning, resolute)
I've had enough. I want a divorce.

XIANG SHIREN
What?

He grabs her collar.

XIANG SHIREN
Divorce? You think you can?

AN NING
I know I must.

XIANG SHIREN slaps her again.

AN NING
(tears streaming)
I protected you for Duoduo. But a leopard can't change spots. So either you kill me, or I'm divorcing you.

XIANG SHIREN
(grabs throat)
You want to die?

DUODUO bites his hand.

XIANG SHIREN
(screams)
You little—

AN NING
(grabs knife)
Let her go!

XIANG SHIREN
You dare?

AN NING
I dare. Because I'm done.

XIANG SHIREN
You don't have the guts.

AN NING
Watch me.

He lunges.

AN NING
(screams)
You forced this!

She charges, knife raised.

title: Urban Supreme
description: A hidden tycoon endures humiliation while secretly protecting his wife's family and searching for a traitor in his company.
context:
Title: Urban Supreme
Description: A hidden tycoon endures humiliation while secretly protecting his wife's family and searching for a traitor in his company.

EXT. PLAZA - DAY

Overhead shot: black sedans drive in perfect formation around a circular plaza.

The convoy stops before a glass tower. Bodyguards in black suits exit simultaneously, movements crisp.

A Rolls-Royce glides to a red carpet entrance. Bodyguards flank both sides.

A bodyguard opens the car door. A stiletto heel touches crimson carpet.

AN XINRAN, in a black sequined mini dress, steps out with forced elegance.

BODYGUARD
Happy birthday, Miss An.

ZHOU MENGTING exits another car in white sequined silk, watching like a cat with a mouse.

EXT. BUILDING ENTRANCE - DAY

A FEMALE ASSISTANT approaches with a velvet case containing a blue heart-shaped diamond.

FEMALE ASSISTANT
Miss An. The Heart of the Ocean. Eighty million. One of one. He wished you happy birthday.

AN XINRAN
Who?

ZHOU MENGTING
(stepping forward)
Young Master Wu, obviously. Your father's empire is ash. Only Wu can rebuild it. Divorce your stray dog husband. Marry Wu. It's your only way out.

AN XINRAN
(clenching her fists)
The An family won't fall.

She turns and walks away.
continuation:
INT. SEDAN - DAY

ZHU QUE drives. YE YU watches from the back seat.

ZHU QUE
President Ye. The gift is delivered.

YE YU
Good.

ZHU QUE
Five years of their scorn. The mole still hides. How much longer must you wear this mask?

YE YU
Until the traitor shows his face. The An contract?

ZHU QUE
One billion yuan. Delivered in three days.

YE YU
Then I'll attend my wife's party.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

An Xinran strides through marble halls. Zhou Mengting snares her wrist.

ZHOU MENGTING
Xinran.

YE YU enters, tie askew.

YE YU
Sorry I'm late.

ZHOU MENGTING
(looking at Ye Yu with contempt)
You useless waste. Late to your wife's birthday. A dog earns its keep. You only cost dignity.

title: Reborn: Who Still Talks About Love
description: A man is reborn in ancient times with a system that requires him to be rejected by a princess 99 times to unlock rewards, but she might actually say yes.
context:
Title: Reborn: Who Still Talks About Love
Description: A man is reborn in ancient times with a system that requires him to be rejected by a princess 99 times to unlock rewards, but she might actually say yes.

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

SERVANTS cluster near the eastern gate, their gossip barely hushed.

SERVANT A
Ninety-eight bouquets wilted on the palace steps. One wonders if he cultivates flowers or stubbornness.

SERVANT B
The Princess has exhausted every polite refusal. What more can she say?

SERVANT C
Perhaps he's simply memorizing the pattern of the cobblestones.

They fall silent as YE XIAO passes, clutching today's bouquet with trembling determination.

YE XIAO (V.O.)
One more rejection. That's all. Then the system unlocks, and I can finally stop this absurd theater.

INT. YE XIAO'S BEDROOM - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

The jade pendant glows, projecting a translucent interface of modern armaments.

XIAO AI (V.O.)
Congratulations, host. Task progress: 98/99 rejections collected. Final milestone imminent.

YE XIAO stares at holographic tanks and aircraft, then at his reflection in the bronze mirror—exhausted, hollow-eyed.

YE XIAO
(softly)
And then what? I rule the world with machines, while...

YE XIAO shakes his head, banishing the thought.

YE XIAO
No. Focus. One more.
continuation:
EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

YE XIAO steadies himself, the flowers drooping in the afternoon heat.

YE XIAO
(whispered prayer)
Don't say yes. Please, don't say yes.

He shouts toward the latticed windows.

YE XIAO
Princess Yunshu! Grant me your answer!

INT. PRINCESS'S CHAMBER - DAY

XIA YUNSHU sits by the window, scroll forgotten. Her MAID bursts in.

MAID
He's here! Ninety-nine, correct? Will you finally—

XIA YUNSHU
I know the count.

MAID
Every eligible lord in the capital has withdrawn. Yet he remains.

XIA YUNSHU
He persists.

MAID
My lady, the whispers grow louder. They say his devotion borders on madness. Or true love.

XIA YUNSHU
(quietly)
What if they are the same thing?

The MAID falls silent. Xia Yunshu watches Ye Xiao's small figure below.

XIA YUNSHU
He's different today. Not just tired... altered.

MAID
Shall I deliver the final refusal?

XIA YUNSHU
No. I will answer him myself.

MAID
(shocked)
Princess—

EXT. IMPERIAL PALACE COURTYARD - DAY

YE XIAO paces, checking an invisible interface.

YE XIAO (V.O.)
Where is she? She's never made me wait this long. Just come to the window and reject me like always—

The doors open. XIA YUNSHU steps out, the MAID trailing behind. YE XIAO freezes mid-pace, bouquet slipping from his grasp.

YE XIAO (V.O.)
No. This is wrong. This is not how rejection looks—

YE XIAO stares in mounting terror as Xia Yunshu descends the veranda steps, her silk robes whispering against the stone, her expression unreadable.

title: Return to 1985: Reversing Fate
description: A man murdered for his organs in 2005 is reborn in 1985, determined to take revenge on his treacherous wife and her family.
context:
Title: Return to 1985: Reversing Fate
Description: A man murdered for his organs in 2005 is reborn in 1985, determined to take revenge on his treacherous wife and her family.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

ON SCREEN: Year 2005

Fluorescent lights flicker over ZHANG WEIGUO, unconscious with oxygen tube hissing. CHEN GUIHUA files her nails at his bedside.

CHEN GUIHUA
Twenty years of patience ends today.

A manila envelope slides from his chest onto the floor.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (FLASHBACK)

ZHANG WEIGUO collapses to his knees, clutching CHEN GUIHUA's silk sleeve.

ZHANG WEIGUO
Mother's surgery. I'll repay every yuan—

CHEN GUIHUA
Repay me? With greasy apron strings?

She yanks free. Her heels echo down the corridor.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Same ward. CHEN GUIHUA perches on ZHANG WEIGUO's bed, laughing. STRANGE MAN pours champagne.

STRANGE MAN (O.S.)
He can't hear us?

CHEN GUIHUA
(glancing at Zhang)
He only hears what I permit.

ZHANG WEIGUO's fingers spasm against the sheet.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

CHEN YIMENG enters with notary stamp and document.

CHEN YIMENG
Sis. Insurance claim needs his thumbprint.

CHEN GUIHUA
(to Zhang)
Beijing apartment for our son. Your final contribution.

She pulls out a restaurant deed. CHEN YIMENG grabs ZHANG WEIGUO's hand.

ZHANG FANGFANG (O.S.)
Stop!

ZHANG FANGFANG and SONG XUAN rush in.

ZHANG FANGFANG
Chen Guihua, you'll not touch his savings!

CHEN YIMENG
Sister-in-law, it's for the boy's future.

SONG XUAN
What boy? Even neighbors know he's not Zhang Weiguo's!

CHEN GUIHUA slaps SONG XUAN.

ZHANG FANGFANG
You shameless—

CHEN YIMENG shoves ZHANG FANGFANG into the IV stand. It topples. The heart monitor flatlines.

CHEN GUIHUA
(over the alarm)
Dead weight must pay its debts.

CHEN YIMENG presses a pillow over ZHANG WEIGUO's face. Zhang Weiguo convulses once, then stills. He slides off the bed, IV pole crashing down.

His hand lands in saline mixed with ZHANG FANGFANG's blood from a split lip. Their fingertips brush.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

CHEN YIMENG presses ZHANG WEIGUO's bloody thumb to the document.

CHEN YIMENG
(to Guihua)
Accidental overdose. Clear-cut case.

He releases the thumb. It leaves a perfect print.

ZHANG WEIGUO (V.O.)
Guihua...I'll remember this weight.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

ZHANG WEIGUO gasps awake in a twin bed with chenille blankets. Sweat soaks his shirt. He touches his face—smooth.

A wall calendar shows "March 1985."

ZHANG WEIGUO
...the weight's gone.

He stumbles to a mirror. Studies his young reflection. His jaw tightens.

ZHANG WEIGUO
(through gritted teeth)
But I kept the memory.

His reflection smiles—a cold, patient smile.

title: Reborn in 2000: I Became the Top Scholar
description: A woman who died after being forced to give blood to her brother is reborn on the day of the college entrance exam in 2000, determined to change her fate.
context:
Title: Reborn in 2000: I Became the Top Scholar
Description: A woman who died after being forced to give blood to her brother is reborn on the day of the college entrance exam in 2000, determined to change her fate.

MONTAGE START

Various street scenes from different eras flash by: 2020, 2014, 2007, 2000. College entrance exam scenes appear with the words "COLLEGE ENTRANCE EXAM - VICTORY" superimposed.

MONTAGE END

EXT. SCHOOL ENTRANCE - DAY

A school broadcast announcement echoes through the campus.

BROADCAST (O.S.)
There are thirty minutes remaining until the college entrance exam begins. All examinees please prepare.

TONG YING, wearing a school uniform, walks through the campus looking somewhat dazed. She suddenly stops and opens her canvas bag.

Inside the bag, a college entrance exam admission ticket from the year 2000 lies quietly.

TONG YING (V.O.)
I've been reborn?

TONG YING snaps back to reality and runs toward the exam hall.

Suddenly, a woman in a floral shirt, LIN CUIFEN, rushes out and pushes her hard to the ground.

LIN CUIFEN
(urgent, low)
Zheng Ergou's family is waiting at home. I told you to sign those betrothal papers.

TONG YING
(struggling)
The exam... it's my whole life—

LIN CUIFEN
Your brother's wedding is next month. That's your life.

TONG YING lies on the ground, staring at her mother in shock as memories from her past life flood back.

FLASHBACK START
continuation:
INT. DIMLY LIT ROOM - NIGHT

In her past life, TONG YING is forcibly dragged by her parents TONG DEGUI and LIN CUIFEN.

TONG YING (PAST LIFE)
(struggling)
Let me go! My boss will dock my pay!

LIN CUIFEN
(desperate)
Your brother's anemia is getting worse! He needs the transfusion today!

INT. ILLEGAL CLINIC - NIGHT

TONG YING is held down on a bed, a blood extraction tube inserted in her arm. TONG DEGUI stands nearby, his expression cold.

TONG DEGUI
My son is the family's foundation. Everything else is secondary.

TONG YING (PAST LIFE)
(weakly, tearfully)
Dad... I'm your daughter...

LIN CUIFEN
(to the doctor)
Draw it. She'll manage. She always manages.

TONG YING's consciousness gradually fades. The waveform on the heart monitor becomes a flat line.

Multiple voiceovers flash back.

VOICEOVER (V.O.)
"You work to earn money just to buy your brother a house for his wedding, right?"
"My son is the family's foundation."
"Everything else is secondary."

TONG YING (V.O.)
If there's a next life, I must take control of my own destiny.

Black screen. Subtitles appear.

SUBTITLE
The patient has gone into shock from excessive blood loss.

FLASHBACK END

EXT. SCHOOL ENTRANCE - DAY

TONG YING slowly pushes herself up from the ground, her eyes becoming incredibly determined.

TONG YING (V.O.)
Since heaven has given me a chance to start over, this time I will definitely take the college entrance exam and change my fate!

The faces of TONG YING, LIN CUIFEN, and TONG DEGUI appear on screen, foreshadowing the coming conflict.

title: Back to the 80s: Partnering with the Village Hunk in Business
description: An overworked office worker dies from exhaustion and is reborn in 1982, only to find herself about to marry the village fool instead of the handsome rural hero she imagined.
context:
Title: Back to the 80s: Partnering with the Village Hunk in Business
Description: An overworked office worker dies from exhaustion and is reborn in 1982, only to find herself about to marry the village fool instead of the handsome rural hero she imagined.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

SU AILING (28), disheveled with dark circles, slumps over her desk covered in financial reports. Her computer glows with an unfinished spreadsheet.

SU AILING
(to herself)
Another all-nighter. Zhang Zhiming, if I die at this desk, I'm haunting every quarterly report you touch.

She clutches her chest, gasps, and collapses. The spreadsheet flickers.

SU AILING (V.O.)
Well... that escalated quickly.

FLASHBACK TO:

EXT. VILLAGE SQUARE - DAY

SUPER: RED WILLOW VILLAGE, 1982

SU AILING lies on a reed mat, eyes closed. She's in a red wedding tunic. A CROWD murmurs around her.

WANG ERMAO (24), broad-shouldered with a simple, earnest face, kneels beside her. He wipes his nose on his sleeve.

WANG ERMAO
(whispering)
Wife? The matchmaker said you were just sleeping, but... you've been sleeping a real long time.

He gently pokes her shoulder.

WANG ERMAO
Wanna wake up? We gotta dig the new latrine pit before dinner.

SU AILING's eyes snap open. She sees his face inches from hers. She screams and SLAPS him. The crowd GASPS and scatters.

SU AILING
(clutching her temples)
What the—?

She sees the commune loudspeaker, a "HOUSEHOLD CONTRACT SYSTEM" banner, and Ermao's rough cotton tunic. Her eyes widen.

BROADCAST (O.S.)
—since implementing the Household Responsibility System, production initiative has increased by forty percent—

SU AILING
(under her breath)
continuation:
Those characters... that slogan... 1982?

She scrambles to her feet, touching her clothes, her hair.

SU AILING
(whispering)
I transmigrated. I actually transmigrated.

SU AIQIN (18), tear-streaked face, runs through the crowd.

SU AIQIN
Sister! You're alive! Doctor Zhang said your pulse was threadier than sewing cotton!

SU AIQIN grabs Su Ailing's hands, shaking.

SU AIQIN
How could you faint on your wedding day? The Wang family thinks we're trying to cheat them out of the bride price!

SU AILING
Marriage? Wait—marriage to who? The village entrepreneur? The returning soldier?

SU AIQIN
What?

SU AIQIN points at Wang Ermiao, who's rubbing his cheek but still grinning.

SU AIQIN
Him! Your betrothed since childhood!

WANG ERMAO
(taking a step forward)
Wife. I brought you a sugar apple. For when you wake up.

He holds out a bruised fruit, wiping his sleeve again.

WANG ERMAO
(proudly)
I washed extra good for the wedding. Am I handsome now?

SU AILING stares at the simple-minded man before her, then at the village around her—mud roads, thatched roofs, poverty.

SU AILING
(desperate whisper)
Then I'd rather be dead.

She sways on her feet, eyes rolling back. The sugar apple drops from Ermao's hand as he lunges to catch her.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Return to the 70s to Find You
description: A woman trapped in an abusive marriage is killed by her ex-husband in 2024, only to wake up in the 1970s with a chance to reunite with her daughter.
context:
Title: Return to the 70s to Find You
Description: A woman trapped in an abusive marriage is killed by her ex-husband in 2024, only to wake up in the 1970s with a chance to reunite with her daughter.

INT. ZHAO LINGLING'S HOME - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: 2024 - ZHAO LINGLING'S HOME

A stormy night with thunder and lightning. A man kicks the door open.

LI YONG (O.S.)
Lingling! Don't make me break it down!

ZHAO LINGLING, with injuries on her face, huddles in the corner holding her daughter TANGTANG in terror.

LI YONG, wearing rumpled pajamas, paces around the messy living room. He picks up a wedding photo from the mantle, stares at it, then hurls it to the ground. Glass shatters.

LI YONG crushes the frame under his heel.

He pours wine into a glass, drinks. His eyes never leave Lingling.

LI YONG
You really thought a piece of paper would keep me out?

ZHAO LINGLING
The court order was clear. You're not supposed to be here.

LI YONG
Court order. (scoffs) You're still wearing my ring in that picture.

TANGTANG (whispering)
Mommy, I'm scared.

ZHAO LINGLING (quietly)
I know, baby. Just look at me. Only me.

LI YONG drains his glass, sets it down with a sharp click.

LI YONG
You took everything. The house. My daughter.

He picks up Tangtang's doll from the sofa, examines it.

LI YONG
What did you tell her? That Daddy's the monster?

TANGTANG (small, fierce)
You are a monster! You hurt Mommy!

LI YONG's expression darkens. He drops the doll, grabs Tangtang's arm.
continuation:
LI YONG
Come here.

ZHAO LINGLING
Li Yong, she's just a child!

LI YONG yanks Tangtang toward him, then shoves her away. Tangtang's head hits the coffee table. She slumps, unconscious.

ZHAO LINGLING (screaming)
Tangtang!

ZHAO LINGLING lunges. LI YONG catches her throat.

LI YONG
You think you can erase me? From her life? From your life?

They struggle toward the staircase. LI YONG's grip tightens.

LI YONG
Let's see you try to leave now.

He pushes. They fall.

ZHAO LINGLING's hand reaches desperately toward Tangtang as they tumble down.

MONTAGE

Images rapidly rewind. Calendar pages flip backward: 2021, 2016, 2008, 1995, 1987... Each date dissolves into older textures—wood grain, faded fabric, yellowed photographs.

INT. 1970S ROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: THE 1970S - ZHAO LINGLING'S HOME

ZHAO LINGLING jolts awake—gasping, hand flying to her throat. Air comes easy. She stares at her hands. Smooth. Unblemished.

She looks around: peeling wallpaper, wooden dresser, a calendar showing 1978.

ZHAO LINGLING (breathing hard)
Tangtang...?

She spots a photo frame on the nightstand. Her younger self smiles back, holding a toddler—unmistakably Tangtang.

ZHAO LINGLING (V.O.)
1978. I remember this room. But I remember it differently.

She touches her face—no scars. Her hair is longer.

ZHAO LINGLING (V.O.)
Unless... Tangtang?

She clutches the photo to her chest, a sob escaping—joy and terror mixed.

title: Return to the Eighties: Protecting My Mute Wife
description: A man is reborn to 1981, determined to prevent the tragedy of his beloved being sold to a fool.
context:
Title: Return to the Eighties: Protecting My Mute Wife
Description: A man is reborn to 1981, determined to prevent the tragedy of his beloved being sold to a fool.

INT. SIMPLE BEDROOM - DAY

CHEN MO (20s) bolts awake, gasping. He stares at his hands—unlined, strong. His eyes sweep the room in disbelief.

CLOSE-UP: A red "double happiness" paper-cut, sun-bleached on the window.

CLOSE-UP: The same character warps on the old wardrobe mirror.

CLOSE-UP: The calendar: "April 1981."

CHEN MO (V.O.)
April 15th, 1981. I'm back.

KNOCKING at the door.

VILLAGER (O.S.)
Groom! The matchmaker's waiting!

CHEN MO
(whisper)
Groom?

CHEN MO (V.O.)
Last life, I brought betrothal gifts today. They sold Meng Ying by dusk.

He swings his legs off the bed, fists clenching.
continuation:
INT. BRIDAL ROOM - DAY

Red silk drapes the vanity. SISTER (20s) fixes her wedding earrings while FOSTER MOTHER (50s) counts cash. MENG YING (18, bruised) hovers near the wall, voice barely a whisper.

SISTER shoves MENG YING hard.

SISTER
Stay in your shadow. Don't you dare take what's mine.

MENG YING
(whispered)
What did I take?

SISTER
Everything you touch.

FOSTER MOTHER
(points without looking)
Food, clothes, husband—all hers. You exist to work.

MENG YING
(tears falling)
Please... just be kind to Chen Mo.

SISTER laughs, sharp and delighted.

SISTER
Don't worry about him. Mom took Zhao family's betrothal. Triple the amount. You're theirs now—their idiot son's reward.

She waves a red envelope with Zhao seal.

MENG YING
(tries to run)
I won't—

FOSTER MOTHER snatches her wrist, slaps her.

FOSTER MOTHER
You will. You're voiceless. No one will hear you scream.

VOICE (O.S.)
The groom has arrived!

EXT. COURTYARD - DAY

Lanterns sway over banquet tables. GUESTS murmur as CHEN MO enters with VILLAGERS carrying betrothal gifts. He scans the windows, sees a shadow struggling.

CLOSE-UP: CHEN MO's eyes—hard, certain, burning.

He takes one deliberate step forward. The courtyard falls silent.

title: Reborn: Never Again a Stepfather
description: A man who sacrificed everything for his stepfamily is abandoned on his deathbed, only to be given a second chance to make things right with his biological daughter.
context:
Title: Reborn: Never Again a Stepfather
Description: A man who sacrificed everything for his stepfamily is abandoned on his deathbed, only to be given a second chance to make things right with his biological daughter.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

OPENING:

A document labeled "Severance of Relations Agreement" and a red inkpad box.

CHEN QIANQIAN, a young woman in a white coat, stands beside the hospital bed. Her father, CHEN SIHAI, lies wearing an oxygen mask, his expression pained.

CHEN QIANQIAN (V.O.)
Chen Sihai. After twenty years, this is how we end.

CHEN QIANQIAN
You look smaller than I remember.

She checks his pulse. He doesn't react.

CHEN QIANQIAN
Your beloved wife signed your DNR yesterday. Her sons went home to "discuss finances" three days ago. I was top of my class. Full scholarship. You made me quit school for your factory. Meanwhile, your stepsons went to private college.

Chen Sihai's fingers twitch. A tear escapes.

CHEN QIANQIAN
Don't you dare cry now.

She slaps the document onto his chest.

CHEN QIANQIAN
This is for me. So when they call about your funeral, I can tell them to go to hell.

She grips his thumb, presses it into the inkpad, then onto the paper.

CHEN QIANQIAN
Goodbye, Chen Sihai.

She walks out. The document flutters to the floor.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

QIN HUAIRU and her two sons, QIN DAHU and QIN ERHU, wait on plastic chairs.

QIN DAHU
Mom, what if she pays?

QIN HUAIRU
The hospital called her as next-of-kin. That's procedure. But she hates him more than we do.

QIN ERHU
And if she doesn't?

QIN HUAIRU
Then we tried. No guilt, no bill.

The ward door opens. CHEN QIANQIAN emerges, wiping her eyes.

QIN HUAIRU
Doctor Chen, how is—

CHEN QIANQIAN
He's your problem now.

She shoves past them.

QIN DAHU
Bitch.

QIN HUAIRU
She's just smart.

They exchange glances, then walk toward the exit.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Chen Sihai lies alone, the agreement on the floor. He hears the corridor conversation. His breathing accelerates. He reaches for the call button—too far.

CHEN SIHAI
(weakly)
Qianqian... they promised...

He tries to sit up, slides off the bed, pulling the IV stand down with a CRASH. Blood trickles from his mouth.

CHEN SIHAI (V.O.)
One chance. That's all I ask.

The heart monitor flatlines. A brilliant light fills the room.

INT. SHABBY ROOM - DAY

Young CHEN SIHAI lies on a crude bed and suddenly wakes with a start. He sees a little girl (young CHEN QIANQIAN) standing on a stool trying to reach something on a cabinet. She slips and falls, and a bowl of steamed buns crashes to the floor.

CHEN SIHAI looks shocked and confused.

FADE OUT.

THE END

title: Reborn as the Domineering CEO
description: After being betrayed and killed, a woman is reborn and given a second chance to protect those she loves and take revenge on those who wronged her.
context:
Title: Reborn as the Domineering CEO
Description: After being betrayed and killed, a woman is reborn and given a second chance to protect those she loves and take revenge on those who wronged her.

EXT. ABANDONED WAREHOUSE - DAY

JING YOU, covered in blood, shields KE QIAO as they run through the empty warehouse. MEN IN BLACK chase them, weapons drawn. Jing You fights them, taking multiple stab wounds.

KE QIAO
Jing You, they're after me. You need to go!

JING YOU
I won't leave you.

Jing You is stabbed again and collapses in pain.

KE QIAO (V.O.)
Jing You... I'm sorry. If I could have another chance, I'd protect you.

INT. DARK ROOM - NIGHT

KE QIAO lies on a bed, blood at the corner of her mouth, consciousness fading. CHU CHAN holds a bowl of medicine, feeding her with a spoon.

CHU CHAN
Qiao Qiao, time for your medicine. Come on, open up.

KE QIAO (V.O.)
I thought family was sacred. Until profit poisoned it.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

KE QIAO jolts awake in bed, coughing violently. She looks around, bewildered.

KE QIAO (INTERNAL)
I died. But I'm here. I've been reborn.

KE QIAO gets out of bed and picks up a calendar from the table.

KE QIAO (INTERNAL)
The graduate school interview. It's tomorrow.

The door opens. CHU CHAN enters carrying a lunch box.

KE QIAO
Chu Chan.

CHU CHAN
Cousin, I got you some food. You should eat.

KE QIAO (INTERNAL)
This lunch box. The start of everything.

KE QIAO smiles and takes the lunch box.

KE QIAO
Thanks, cousin. I'll take it to the library to eat.

KE QIAO turns and leaves, leaving CHU CHAN with a confused expression.

EXT. CAMPUS - DAY

KE QIAO walks to a trash can and throws the lunch box in without hesitation.

KE QIAO
Some things belong in the trash.

KE QIAO turns around, her eyes cold with resolve.

KE QIAO
Chu Chan, you'll experience the heartbreak you gave me.

title: Rebirth of the Prodigal Son (Episode 75)_1
description: A wealthy CEO is murdered by his own son and reborn five years in the past, given a chance to change his fate.
context:
Title: Rebirth of the Prodigal Son (Episode 75)_1
Description: A wealthy CEO is murdered by his own son and reborn five years in the past, given a chance to change his fate.

INT. COMPANY CELEBRATION BANQUET - DAY

Distant view of a city skyline with tall buildings.

The company celebration banquet is in progress. A red banner hangs on the background wall reading "Jianghe Group - Celebrating Our IPO."

A group of employees in business attire stand in a row, applauding enthusiastically. Colorful confetti falls from above.

CHU JIANGHE, a middle-aged man in a blue suit, spirited and confident, walks into the venue with a smile, waving to the employees. The applause grows louder.

CHU JIANGHE walks to the podium, smiling.

FEMALE EMPLOYEE
Congratulations, President Chu! We just hit a trillion in valuation!

MALE EMPLOYEE
The board's calling you Emperor of Daxia!

The employees applaud enthusiastically again. CHU JIANGHE smiles and waves to everyone.

CHU JIANGHE
Jianghe Group's achievements belong to each one of you.

The employees applaud.

CHU JIANGHE
(laughing)
These old bones are about to retire. I hope you'll all support my son when he takes over.

EMPLOYEES
Yes!

The employees applaud warmly. CHU JIANGHE applauds along with them.

Suddenly, the phone on the podium rings. The caller ID shows "CHU TIANCI."

CHU JIANGHE picks up the phone and answers.

CHU JIANGHE
(smiling)
Tianci, did you see the—

KIDNAPPER (V.O.)
Mr. Chu. We have your son. Transfer five hundred million to the account we're texting. Twenty minutes.

The smile on CHU JIANGHE's face freezes instantly, turning to shock.

KIDNAPPER (V.O.)
Don't involve police. Or we send him back in pieces.

CHU TIANCI (V.O.)
(strangled)
Dad, please hurry...

CHU JIANGHE
(anxiously)
Don't hurt him! I'll pay!

The call disconnects. A text pings with an offshore account number.

CHU JIANGHE
(shouting into the phone)
Tianci! Hello! Hello!

He frantically puts down the phone, immediately rushes down from the podium, and runs out.
continuation:
EXT. ABANDONED INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX - DAY

CHU JIANGHE rushes onto the rooftop, clutching his phone. Transfer confirmed.

CHU JIANGHE
(shouting)
I transferred it! Let him go!

CHU TIANCI, a young man in a red jacket, walks out from the other side with two thugs.

CHU JIANGHE
(relieved)
You're safe—

CHU TIANCI
(mocking)
Safe? Father, I'm finally free.

CHU JIANGHE
(confused)
What are you saying?

CHU TIANCI
Fifteen years. You controlled my schools, my friends, my engagement. You even chose my major.

CHU TIANCI
But you can't control my inheritance. The moment you die, it's all mine. That's what I needed from you.

CHU JIANGHE
(stricken)
The will... you altered it...

CHU TIANCI
Goodbye, Father.

The thugs move in. CHU JIANGHE swings his phone but they overwhelm him, striking his knees. He collapses.

CHU TIANCI
(calmly)
Enough.

They drag the bruised CHU JIANGHE to the edge. He clutches at CHU TIANCI's leg, leaving a bloody print.

CHU JIANGHE
(whispering)
I only wanted you to have a better life...

CHU TIANCI
You wanted a puppet. I want my life.

He kicks CHU JIANGHE's hand away. CHU JIANGHE falls backward.

CHU JIANGHE (V.O.)
If I could go back... to when I still had a son...

CHU JIANGHE crashes heavily to the ground. His cracked phone shows a photo of young Tianci.

Time-travel special effects sequence.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHU JIANGHE suddenly awakens to find himself sitting on a luxurious European-style sofa. He wears a casual blazer.

CHU TIANCI, five years younger, stands before him, trembling with rage.

CHU TIANCI
(roaring)
You think money fixes everything? Lili's gone! You paid her to leave!

CHU JIANGHE is stunned, recognizing this moment.

CHU JIANGHE
(internal monologue)
What's going on?

He looks around and sees a desk calendar showing "March 2015."

CHU JIANGHE
(shocked, internal monologue)
I've been reborn. Five years before he killed me.

A golden light envelops CHU JIANGHE.

FADE OUT.

CHU JIANGHE picks up the phone and answers.

CHU JIANGHE
(smiling)
Tianci, did you see the—

KIDNAPPER (V.O.)
Mr. Chu. We have your son. Transfer five hundred million to the account we're texting. Twenty minutes.

The smile on CHU JIANGHE's face freezes instantly, turning to shock.

KIDNAPPER (V.O.)
Don't involve police. Or we send him back in pieces.

CHU TIANCI (V.O.)
(strangled)
Dad, please hurry...

CHU JIANGHE
(anxiously)
Don't hurt him! I'll pay!

The call disconnects. A text pings with an offshore account number.

CHU JIANGHE
(shouting into the phone)
Tianci! Hello! Hello!

He frantically puts down the phone, immediately rushes down from the podium, and runs out.

EXT. ABANDONED INDUSTRIAL COMPLEX - DAY

CHU JIANGHE rushes onto the rooftop, clutching his phone. Transfer confirmed.

CHU JIANGHE
(shouting)
I transferred it! Let him go!

CHU TIANCI, a young man in a red jacket, walks out from the other side with two thugs.

CHU JIANGHE
(relieved)
You're safe—

CHU TIANCI
(mocking)
Safe? Father, I'm finally free.

CHU JIANGHE
(confused)
What are you saying?

CHU TIANCI
Fifteen years. You controlled my schools, my friends, my engagement. You even chose my major.

CHU TIANCI
But you can't control my inheritance. The moment you die, it's all mine. That's what I needed from you.

CHU JIANGHE
(stricken)
The will... you altered it...

CHU TIANCI
Goodbye, Father.

The thugs move in. CHU JIANGHE swings his phone but they overwhelm him, striking his knees. He collapses.

CHU TIANCI
(calmly)
Enough.

They drag the bruised CHU JIANGHE to the edge. He clutches at CHU TIANCI's leg, leaving a bloody print.

CHU JIANGHE
(whispering)
I only wanted you to have a better life...

CHU TIANCI
You wanted a puppet. I want my life.

He kicks CHU JIANGHE's hand away. CHU JIANGHE falls backward.

CHU JIANGHE (V.O.)
If I could go back... to when I still had a son...

CHU JIANGHE crashes heavily to the ground. His cracked phone shows a photo of young Tianci.

Time-travel special effects sequence.

INT. LUXURIOUS LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHU JIANGHE suddenly awakens to find himself sitting on a luxurious European-style sofa. He wears a casual blazer.

CHU TIANCI, five years younger, stands before him, trembling with rage.

CHU TIANCI
(roaring)
You think money fixes everything? Lili's gone! You paid her to leave!

CHU JIANGHE is stunned, recognizing this moment.

CHU JIANGHE
(internal monologue)
What's going on?

He looks around and sees a desk calendar showing "March 2015."

CHU JIANGHE
(shocked, internal monologue)
I've been reborn. Five years before he killed me.

A golden light envelops CHU JIANGHE.

FADE OUT.

title: A Life of Regret
description: A desperate father, crushed by medical debt, pushes his wife too far in a drunken rage over their daughter's treatment money, leading to tragedy and unbearable remorse.
context:
Title: A Life of Regret
Description: A desperate father, crushed by medical debt, pushes his wife too far in a drunken rage over their daughter's treatment money, leading to tragedy and unbearable remorse.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Medical bills cover the coffee table beside a child's crayon drawing. LIN QIANYU crouches among pill bottles, sorting them into a bag.

SHEN CHUAN slumps on the sofa, crushing an empty can in his fist.

The room smells of stale beer and antiseptic.

SHEN CHUAN
(mutters)
Two hundred thousand. Just like that.

LIN QIANYU
(quietly)
The coordinator called. They found a 9/10 match.

SHEN CHUAN
And?

LIN QIANYU
We have to wire the deposit by noon. The donor's ready.

SHEN CHUAN
Wire it. With what?

He grabs his jacket, fumbles inside.

SHEN CHUAN
The card. Give it.

LIN QIANYU
(desperately calm)
That's Niannian's protocol money. Experimental.

SHEN CHUAN
My cousin's guy can get us in. 48 hours.
continuation:
LIN QIANYU
It's not a table game.

SHEN CHUAN kicks the table. Bills scatter.

SHEN CHUAN
It's math! Double it or bury her!

NIANNIAN appears in the hallway, clutching a rabbit.

NIANNIAN
(whisper)
Daddy, you're loud.

LIN QIANYU
Go back to bed, baby.

SHEN CHUAN
Even she knows—

He lunges for her purse. LIN QIANYU pulls back. He shoves. She trips over the trash bag, head cracking the table edge. She goes still.

A pill bottle rolls across the floor.

NIANNIAN
Mommy. Wake up. Wake up now.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

SHEN CHUAN sits on the stripped mattress, holding the crayon drawing. Police lights pulse through curtains.

SHEN CHUAN
(whisper)
We were supposed to be three.

He folds the drawing. Police radio CHATTER grows louder. It falls from his fingers.

A KNOCK on the front door.

title: Rebirth: Grandma's Regret Comes Too Late
description: A woman betrayed by her family is given a second chance at life after dying from neglect, determined to make those who wronged her pay.
context:
Title: Rebirth: Grandma's Regret Comes Too Late
Description: A woman betrayed by her family is given a second chance at life after dying from neglect, determined to make those who wronged her pay.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Close-up, the heart monitor beeps steadily.

ZHENG PANPAN lies in the hospital bed, pale-faced, wearing an oxygen nasal tube, unconscious.

A DOCTOR holds a surgical consent form, speaking to her FATHER, GRANDMOTHER, and ZHENG LAIYOU gathered around the bed.

DOCTOR
The patient suffered massive hemorrhaging from a miscarriage. She must have surgery immediately. Please sign.

FATHER
(hesitantly)
Um, how much will this cost?

DOCTOR
Ten to twenty thousand yuan.

FATHER looks troubled. GRANDMOTHER snatches the consent form.

GRANDMOTHER
(eyes wide)
That expensive!

GRANDMOTHER angrily tears the surgical consent form to shreds, letting the pieces fall like confetti.

ZHENG PANPAN (V.O.)
(weakly)
These are my relatives.

DOCTOR
(shocked)
Isn't this patient your own granddaughter?

ZHENG PANPAN (V.O.)
Just like the name they gave me, an endless waiting that never mattered.

FATHER
We refuse the surgery.

ZHENG PANPAN (V.O.)
Even my half-brother from the same father.

GRANDMOTHER
Her husband doesn't even care about her, why should I bother!

FATHER
(to the DOCTOR)
Um, when she's gone, just notify us. We'll need a death certificate to handle the funeral expenses.

DOCTOR
(in disbelief)
The patient has a very good chance of survival, and you're just giving up like this?
continuation:
ZHENG LAIYOU
(leaning to FATHER's ear)
Dad, I checked her company insurance. Natural causes pay double. Plus her apartment...

GRANDMOTHER's eyes light up upon hearing this. She immediately changes her expression and smiles.

GRANDMOTHER
Then hurry to the insurance company and ask. Get the money out and buy my good grandson a new car.

FATHER
(excitedly)
Right, let's go, go, go, go!

The family of three leaves cheerfully.

The heart monitor suddenly sounds an urgent alarm, the heart rate becomes a flat line.

DOCTOR
(shouting)
Quick, resuscitate immediately!

The DOCTOR and NURSES rush forward, performing CPR and defibrillation on ZHENG PANPAN.

ZHENG PANPAN (V.O.)
If life could start over, I would remember everything. And I would make each of you pay.

A rapidly reversing clock appears on screen.

INT. ZHENG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

ZHENG PANPAN is asleep at her desk.

ZHENG PANPAN (V.O.)
(echoing)
If life could start over... If life could start over...

ZHENG PANPAN suddenly wakes up, looking around in confusion.

ZHENG PANPAN (V.O.)
This is... home?

GRANDMOTHER storms in angrily.

GRANDMOTHER
You money-losing wretch! These dishes aren't washed, waiting for maggots to grow?

GRANDMOTHER roughly grabs ZHENG PANPAN's arm and yanks her up.

ZHENG PANPAN
(in pain)
Ow!

ZHENG PANPAN looks at GRANDMOTHER's vicious face, then sees her FATHER on the sofa in the distance, leisurely playing on his phone, completely indifferent to the situation. Her eyes sharpen, understanding dawns.

ZHENG PANPAN (V.O.)
I've been reborn.
