title: Faking Death to Escape
description: A man fakes his death in a car accident, leaving his wife to pay off his debts while he escapes abroad with his mistress, only to return ten years later.
context:
Title: Faking Death to Escape
Description: A man fakes his death in a car accident, leaving his wife to pay off his debts while he escapes abroad with his mistress, only to return ten years later.

INT. WRECKED SEDAN - DAY

Twisted metal. Shattered glass. A white sedan lies overturned in a ditch, smoke curling from the hood. Blood trickles down PEI ZHIWEN'S forehead. He's trapped, but conscious.

Outside, sirens wail. SU CHUN (30s, determined) crawls through the broken window, glass cutting her palms.

SU CHUN
Zhiwen... stay with me.

Pei Zhiwen's eyes flutter. He grips her hand weakly.

PEI ZHIWEN
Mother... take care of her. Promise me.

SU CHUN
I promise. Just hold on.

His hand goes limp. Su Chun's breath catches. She checks his pulse—faint. Paramedics pull her back. She watches them work, face pale.

PEI ZHIWEN (V.O.)
I knew you'd keep your word.

INT. PRIVATE CLINIC - NIGHT

PEI ZHIWEN (40s, calculating) sits on a sterile hospital bed, cleaning his glasses. LIU SHANSHAN (30s, ambitious) watches from the doorway.

LIU SHANSHAN
The investigators closed the case. They're calling it a fatal accident.

PEI ZHIWEN
And Su Chun?

LIU SHANSHAN
She's already meeting with your creditors. Just like you planned.

Pei Zhiwen hesitates, then takes her hand.

PEI ZHIWEN
This was the only way. For us to start over.
continuation:
INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

SU CHUN holds Pei Zhiwen's portrait, surrounded by white chrysanthemums. Her knuckles are raw, nails broken.

A CREDITOR (50s, predatory) enters with two ASSOCIATES. He doesn't raise his voice—his presence is enough.

CREDITOR
Mrs. Pei. Your husband's signature on this loan is very much alive. Even if he isn't.

SU CHUN
I'll honor his debts.

CREDITOR
With what? Empty promises?

He places a document on the altar. An eviction notice. His associate casually knocks over a vase.

CREDITOR
You have thirty days.

They leave. Su Chun doesn't pick up the broken porcelain. She just stares at the portrait.

SU CHUN
(whisper)
I'll find a way.

MONTAGE - TEN YEARS OF DEBT

-- Su Chun works a double shift at a textile factory, fingers bleeding from the machines.

-- She lies awake, studying accounting books by candlelight. Her mother-in-law sleeps in the next room, an IV drip silently feeding medicine.

-- A calendar page tears away: YEAR ONE.

-- Su Chun haggles with a scrap dealer, sweating in the summer heat.

-- She hands an envelope of cash to the creditor. He counts it without looking at her.

-- A hospital bill: partial payment for mother-in-law's treatment.

-- Su Chun works construction, hauling cement bags twice her weight.

-- TORN CALENDAR PAGES: YEAR THREE. YEAR FIVE. YEAR EIGHT.

-- Su Chun eats a cold steamed bun on a construction beam, fifty stories high.

-- She deposits the final payment. The bank teller nods. Su Chun's shoulders finally slump.

EXT. LUXURY HOTEL ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Rain pours. SU CHUN (now early 40s, weathered but steady) sweeps the entrance in a magenta uniform. She moves methodically, as if the rain can't touch her.

She finds a folded photo in her pocket: her and Pei Zhiwen, young and smiling. A cough racks her body. She wipes blood from her lip with a trembling hand, then pockets the photo.

A black Maybach pulls up. A BODYGUARD opens an umbrella.

PEI ZHIWEN steps out, silver-haired and tailored. LIU SHANSHAN on his arm, diamonds at her throat.

Su Chun stops sweeping. The broom handle slips from her fingers.

SU CHUN
(softly, to herself)
Zhiwen?

Pei Zhiwen's gaze passes over her—then returns. Recognition flickers. He falters, but Liu Shanshan tightens her grip, steering him toward the hotel doors.

LIU SHANSHAN
(quietly)
Don't look back. She's just the help.

Pei Zhiwen walks on, but his step has lost its confidence. Su Chun watches him disappear inside, then slowly picks up her broom. Her face is stone, but her hands shake.

SU CHUN
(to the night air)
I kept my promise.

title: Mountain Village Tragedy
description: A rural woman who studies English in secret watches helplessly as superstition and ignorance destroy her family.
context:
Title: Mountain Village Tragedy
Description: A rural woman who studies English in secret watches helplessly as superstition and ignorance destroy her family.

INT. LI FAMILY HOME - DAY

The courtyard is transformed for ritual. WANG PO (60s, embroidered robes, bronze bell in hand) moves with practiced authority, chanting rhythmic incantations.

NIU GENMIAO (40s, weathered features) watches with desperate hope. His mother WANG XIUYING (60s, sharp-eyed, arms crossed) stands guard.

A VILLAGER holds weak, feverish ZHUANGZHUANG (8, frail) as another forces black liquid down his throat.

ZHUANGZHUANG
Mama...

EXT. DEEP MOUNTAINS - DAY

LI LANXIANG (30s, threadbare clothes, determined eyes) climbs the forest path, English primer in hand.

LI LANXIANG
(whispering to herself)
S-c-i-e-n-c-e... science... f-r-u-i-t...

She spots wild berries. Her face lights up. She picks them carefully.

LI LANXIANG
(to herself)
Zhuangzhuang loves these berries. He'll be so happy.

INT. LI FAMILY HOME - DAY

LI LANXIANG runs home. Stops cold. The ritual scene unfolds before her.

LI LANXIANG
(shouting)
Stop!

WANG XIUYING
What are you doing?

LI LANXIANG
Let go!

She rushes to embrace ZHUANGZHUANG.

LI LANXIANG
Zhuangzhuang, Mama's here.

NIU GENMIAO
The shaman is treating his lung disease. This is none of your business. Get back to cooking!

LI LANXIANG
It's just his old asthma. Two aspirin tablets will fix it. There's no need for this.

She pulls a foil strip from her pocket.

WANG XIUYING
(pushing LI LANXIANG away)
You know a few foreign words and think you're a city person!

LI LANXIANG
(frantically trying to give medicine)
Take the medicine! Take it! You'll be fine!

WANG PO
Calm authority
Medicine won't work! Give him a bath and he'll be fine naturally. A poisonous insect bit him.

ZHUANGZHUANG suddenly convulses, gasping violently.

LI LANXIANG
(terrified)
We can't delay any longer! Zhuangzhuang will die! Let me go!
continuation:
NIU GENMIAO
(to WANG PO)
Wang Po?

WANG PO
Put him in the water vat. Purify his body! Just for a moment.

Two MEN grab ZHUANGZHUANG. WANG XIUYING restrains LI LANXIANG.

ZHUANGZHUANG
(crying out)
Mama!

LI LANXIANG
(struggling)
He can't swim!

WANG XIUYING
Trust the shaman!

NIU GENMIAO lifts ZHUANGZHUANG toward a large water vat.

NIU GENMIAO
(softly)
It'll be quick. For your own good.

LI LANXIANG
(desperate)
The medicine! It's in my hand!

NIU GENMIAO places ZHUANGZHUANG in the vat. The boy's head tips back, eyes wide with fear.

WANG PO
Hold him under. Count to seven.

NIU GENMIAO pushes ZHUANGZHUANG'S head under. Water splashes. The boy's hands flail.

LI LANXIANG
(heart-wrenching)
Stop! Stop!

NIU GENMIAO
(crying)
Seven... six...

NIU GENMIAO pushes LI LANXIANG away. She falls. He sees the English book tumble from her pocket.

NIU GENMIAO
(roaring)
Reading this useless stuff again! You just want to sneak away! Take the exam! Leave us!

LI LANXIANG
(shouting from the ground)
How is studying useless? Give my son the medicine!

NIU GENMIAO
I think you want to seduce those college students and leave this family!

ZHUANGZHUANG in the vat has stopped moving. His body floats up.

WANG PO
(alarmed)
Pull him out! Pull him out!

NIU GENMIAO yanks ZHUANGZHUANG out. The boy's limbs hang limp.

NIU GENMIAO
Zhuangzhuang! Zhuangzhuang!

LI LANXIANG
(crawling)
My son...

LI LANXIANG'S eyes become sharp, filled with hatred. She looks at each person in the courtyard, memorizing their faces.

She rushes to embrace ZHUANGZHUANG.

LI LANXIANG
Zhuangzhuang, Mama's here.

NIU GENMIAO
The shaman is treating his lung disease. This is none of your business. Get back to cooking!

LI LANXIANG
It's just his old asthma. Two aspirin tablets will fix it. There's no need for this.

She pulls a foil strip from her pocket.

WANG XIUYING
(pushing LI LANXIANG away)
You know a few foreign words and think you're a city person!

LI LANXIANG
(frantically trying to give medicine)
Take the medicine! Take it! You'll be fine!

WANG PO
Calm authority
Medicine won't work! Give him a bath and he'll be fine naturally. A poisonous insect bit him.

ZHUANGZHUANG suddenly convulses, gasping violently.

LI LANXIANG
(terrified)
We can't delay any longer! Zhuangzhuang will die! Let me go!

NIU GENMIAO
(to WANG PO)
Wang Po?

WANG PO
Put him in the water vat. Purify his body! Just for a moment.

Two MEN grab ZHUANGZHUANG. WANG XIUYING restrains LI LANXIANG.

ZHUANGZHUANG
(crying out)
Mama!

LI LANXIANG
(struggling)
He can't swim!

WANG XIUYING
Trust the shaman!

NIU GENMIAO lifts ZHUANGZHUANG toward a large water vat.

NIU GENMIAO
(softly)
It'll be quick. For your own good.

LI LANXIANG
(desperate)
The medicine! It's in my hand!

NIU GENMIAO places ZHUANGZHUANG in the vat. The boy's head tips back, eyes wide with fear.

WANG PO
Hold him under. Count to seven.

NIU GENMIAO pushes ZHUANGZHUANG'S head under. Water splashes. The boy's hands flail.

LI LANXIANG
(heart-wrenching)
Stop! Stop!

NIU GENMIAO
(crying)
Seven... six...

NIU GENMIAO pushes LI LANXIANG away. She falls. He sees the English book tumble from her pocket.

NIU GENMIAO
(roaring)
Reading this useless stuff again! You just want to sneak away! Take the exam! Leave us!

LI LANXIANG
(shouting from the ground)
How is studying useless? Give my son the medicine!

NIU GENMIAO
I think you want to seduce those college students and leave this family!

ZHUANGZHUANG in the vat has stopped moving. His body floats up.

WANG PO
(alarmed)
Pull him out! Pull him out!

NIU GENMIAO yanks ZHUANGZHUANG out. The boy's limbs hang limp.

NIU GENMIAO
Zhuangzhuang! Zhuangzhuang!

LI LANXIANG
(crawling)
My son...

LI LANXIANG'S eyes become sharp, filled with hatred. She looks at each person in the courtyard, memorizing their faces.

title: Reborn to Slap My Hypocritical Husband
description: A devoted wife endures years of hardship while her husband prioritizes his sister-in-law, until she discovers the truth and gets a second chance.
context:
Title: Reborn to Slap My Hypocritical Husband
Description: A devoted wife endures years of hardship while her husband prioritizes his sister-in-law, until she discovers the truth and gets a second chance.

INT. REPUBLIC ERA YEAR TEN, STREET - DAY

ON SCREEN: REPUBLIC ERA YEAR TEN

A street full of Republican-era atmosphere, bustling with people and rickshaws weaving through.

A POSTMAN rides a bicycle with a mail bag on the back seat. He stops, looks up, and shouts.

POSTMAN
Jiang Xue!

JIANG XUE (O.S.)
Yes!

POSTMAN
You have a letter!

JIANG XUE walks out from inside, followed by her daughter XIE WEN (10) and son XIE FEIYANG (8). She forces a smile as she walks down the steps.

POSTMAN
Here, take it.

JIANG XUE takes the letter.

JIANG XUE
Thank you.

POSTMAN
I'm off.

The POSTMAN rides away on his bicycle.

JIANG XUE (to the children)
Look, it's from your father.

XIE WEN/XIE FEIYANG
Yay!

JIANG XUE opens the letter, her face beaming with happiness, and begins to read.

JIANG XUE (reading)
"My beloved Xuexue, another month passes in camp. I count the days until we're together."

JIANG XUE (to the children)
See? Father remembers us.

XIE WEN/XIE FEIYANG
Read more!

JIANG XUE (V.O.)
Twenty-one letters now. Each one a reminder of his heart. But hearts don't feed children.

TRANSITION: One Month Ago
continuation:
INT. XIE FAMILY ANCESTRAL HOME - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: ONE MONTH AGO - XIE FAMILY ANCESTRAL HOME

XIE JUNYAO, wearing a pristine military uniform, speaks to JIANG XUE with a practiced expression of concern.

XIE JUNYAO
The general's wife insists—one family per officer. Sister-in-law's reputation would be ruined if she stayed.

JIANG XUE
But the children need—

XIE JUNYAO (interrupting her)
Need me to honor my dead brother's trust. I'll send for you when I can.

XIE JUNYAO'S NEPHEW (O.S.)
Second Uncle, get in the car!

XIE JUNYAO
Write to me. I'll reply every week.

XIE JUNYAO turns and leaves. JIANG XUE watches his back with a sad expression, chasing a few steps before stopping.

INT. REPUBLIC ERA YEAR TEN, STREET - DAY

JIANG XUE snaps out of her memory, suddenly remembering something.

JIANG XUE
The allowance—

She hurriedly opens the envelope. Empty.

JIANG XUE (quietly)
Nothing again.

XIE WEN
Where's the money?

JIANG XUE (forcing a smile)
Your father must have forgotten. I'll remind him.

She takes the children's hands, her thumb rubbing the cracked watch on her wrist—a cheap wedding trinket, worthless to anyone but her.

JIANG XUE (V.O.)
Twenty-one excuses. Twenty-one times I believed. But belief has a price, and my children were paying it.

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER - THE SIEGE OF JIANGNAN

INT. SNOWY NIGHT STREET - NIGHT

On a snowy night, JIANG XUE and her two children walk down the street in tattered clothes, cold and hungry. A MILITARY SUPPLY TRUCK rumbles past, heading toward the camp.

XIE WEN
Mother, I'm so hungry.

JIANG XUE squats down and hugs the children with heartache.

JIANG XUE
Wait here.

She looks at her watch. Then at the PAWNSHOP across the street, shuttered for the night. Then at the CHILDREN'S CLINIC sign, glowing faintly.

XIE FEIYANG
When is Father coming?

JIANG XUE
Soon.

She unclasps the watch. Holds it tight.

JIANG XUE (V.O.)
That night, I learned that devotion is just another word for surrender. And I was done surrendering.

She stands, leads her children toward the clinic. Snow erases their tracks behind them.

FADE OUT.

title: Reborn: I Will Not Marry You, Your Highness
description: After destroying her life for unrequited love, a noblewoman is reborn to the moment before her downfall.
context:
Title: Reborn: I Will Not Marry You, Your Highness
Description: After destroying her life for unrequited love, a noblewoman is reborn to the moment before her downfall.

INT. SHEN AN'AN'S ROOM - NIGHT

SHEN AN'AN sits at a table, deathly pale. Blood stains her lips. She coughs, crimson spreading across the letter before her.

Her MAID (MO XIANG) hurries forward to support her.

MAID
Miss, you're so ill. The Fourth Prince should be here. I'll bring him, even if I must drag him from his chambers.

SHEN AN'AN stops her.

SHEN AN'AN
Let him be. I forced this marriage, tore him from his beloved. Five years of loathing is enough. In death, I set him free.

MONTAGE:

- SHEN AN'AN in a red wedding dress, shoved to her knees.
- SHEN AN'AN hurls a porcelain bowl, it shatters against painted doors.

SHEN AN'AN (V.O.)
Where is he? I sent you to fetch the Fourth Prince!

- SHEN AN'AN kneels among broken fragments, clutching a torn love token.

SHEN AN'AN (V.O.)
Tell him I'm hurt. Tell him to come.

- SHEN AN'AN in white robes points at a cowering woman.

SHEN AN'AN (V.O.)
Vixen! You dare seduce the Fourth Prince?

- XIAO YUAN grabs SHEN AN'AN'S wrist, casts her aside.

END MONTAGE.
continuation:
INT. SHEN AN'AN'S ROOM - NIGHT

SHEN AN'AN weeps in her MAID'S arms.

SHEN AN'AN
I became poison, Mo Xiang. Twisted by love I never earned. And my family... Father threw away his career, his honor--all for his monstrous daughter.

SHEN AN'AN
(grabbing the MAID'S hand)
Tell me, do they hate me? In their quiet moments, do they wish I'd never been born?

MAID
(choking up)
They love you, Miss. Always.

SHEN AN'AN
Then tell them... I'm sorry. And tell Xiao Yuan--if I could begin again, I would never marry him.

SHEN AN'AN collapses. The MAID screams.

MAID
Miss! Miss!

TRANSITION:

The world spins, twisting into a tunnel of light and shadow.

INT. PALACE BANQUET HALL - DAY

SHEN AN'AN jolts awake at a magnificent banquet. She blinks, disoriented.

Her PARENTS sit together, alive and smiling, not far away.

Dancers perform in the center. An OFFICIAL raises his cup.

OFFICIAL
Congratulations to the Fourth Prince on suppressing the bandits!

SHEN AN'AN follows his voice to XIAO YUAN, young and proud, accepting praise.

SHEN AN'AN
(internal)
The banquet. Five years ago. Have I been... reborn?

SHEN AN'AN looks at her unblemished hands. A small, sharp smile forms--disbelief and possibility warring in her eyes.

FADE OUT.

title: Reborn as a Mystic Heiress: My Ex Cries
description: A woman who sacrificed everything for her lover is betrayed and left brain-dead, only to awaken with mysterious powers after a celestial tribulation scene appears on the moon.
context:
Title: Reborn as a Mystic Heiress: My Ex Cries
Description: A woman who sacrificed everything for her lover is betrayed and left brain-dead, only to awaken with mysterious powers after a celestial tribulation scene appears on the moon.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

FENG QIAO'AN stands by the hospital bed, looking at the unconscious YE ZHIQIU.

FENG QIAO'AN (V.O.)
Still breathing. What a disappointment.

A television in the room is broadcasting the news.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
The Shenlong satellite has transmitted the latest images from the moon, showing what appears to be a mythical tribulation scene.

On the TV screen, a woman in ancient costume (YE ZHIQIU) is undergoing tribulation. She looks anguished, finally coughing up blood and collapsing, transforming into a golden light.

Back in the hospital room, a DOCTOR and NURSE are talking with FENG QIAO'AN.

NURSE
Doctor, any change?

DOCTOR
Medically speaking, the probability of recovering from brain death is almost zero.

FENG QIAO'AN takes out a black bank card and slips it into the DOCTOR's pocket.

FENG QIAO'AN
I will cover all treatment costs for this patient. Please think of something.

DOCTOR
(taking the card)
We will do our best to save her.

The DOCTOR and NURSE leave. FENG QIAO'AN looks at YE ZHIQIU.

FENG QIAO'AN (V.O.)
A dead ex-lover brings questions. A sleeping one... just vanishes.

FENG QIAO'AN turns to leave, but then returns and picks up a lunch box.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

A rainy night. Young YE ZHIQIU and FENG QIAO'AN share an umbrella. YE ZHIQIU hands FENG QIAO'AN a lunch box filled with cash.

YE ZHIQIU
My overtime pay. For your MBA application.

FENG QIAO'AN
Zhiqiu...

YE ZHIQIU
Just come back to me.

INT. CAFE - DAY (FLASHBACK)

FENG QIAO'AN is dressed elegantly, sitting across from an anxious YE ZHIQIU.

FENG QIAO'AN
The Lu family is reviewing my proposal. I can't have complications now.

FENG QIAO'AN pushes papers in front of YE ZHIQIU.

YE ZHIQIU
(sliding a paper across)
Is this... complicated?

FENG QIAO'AN unfolds it: a pregnancy test report. His expression changes drastically. He pulls out a bank card from his pocket.

FENG QIAO'AN
One million. Take care of it.

INT. BATHROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

YE ZHIQIU is soaking wet, collapsed on the bathroom floor. Her wrist shows self-inflicted wounds, blood stains everywhere.

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Miss Ye, overwork not only caused your miscarriage, but you've also developed severe pelvic inflammation. You may be infertile for life. Where is the baby's father?

YE ZHIQIU collapses on the floor in despair.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

FENG QIAO'AN scoops up liquid food with a spoon, trying to feed the unconscious YE ZHIQIU.

FENG QIAO'AN
Drink.

FENG QIAO'AN (V.O.)
I built everything. You don't get to ruin it.

FENG QIAO'AN
(impatiently)
Drink.

He shoves the spoon. Liquid dribbles from her mouth.

FENG QIAO'AN
(harshly)
Drink it!

Suddenly, YE ZHIQIU's eyes snap open, her pupils turning pure white. An invisible force overwhelms FENG QIAO'AN.

The lunch box trembles, then lifts off the table, hovering.

FENG QIAO'AN shows a terrified expression.

FADE OUT.

title: Reborn Chubby Wife's Counterattack - The General Can't Handle It
description: A modern scientist dies in an explosion and is reborn into the body of a betrayed bride on her wedding day, seeking revenge against her unfaithful fiancé.
context:
Title: Reborn Chubby Wife's Counterattack - The General Can't Handle It
Description: A modern scientist dies in an explosion and is reborn into the body of a betrayed bride on her wedding day, seeking revenge against her unfaithful fiancé.

EXT. SHEN RESIDENCE - DAY

Festive music spills from the courtyard. Red petals drift across a plaque: "Shen Residence."

SHEN YIRAN, resplendent in wedding red, extends a hand toward the bridal sedan.

SERVANT
The bride approaches!

GUEST #1
What a match!

GUEST #2
May they prosper!

Shen Yiran's smile freezes. The music warps, discordant.

From the sedan, a figure in bridal red emerges—TANG WANQING, cleavers glinting in each hand. Her eyes lock onto Shen Yiran like a predator.

GUEST #2
(whispering)
Is that...?

The crowd recoils. A child drops wedding candy.

YOUNG GIRL
Mama, knives!

SHEN YIRAN
(tight smile cracking)
Guards. Restrain her.

Two servants lunge. Tang Wanqing sidesteps, her bulk becoming grace—physics repurposed.
continuation:
INT. TANG FAMILY MEDICAL LAB - DAY

Modern lab. MODERN TANG WANQING examines a black pill.

MODERN TANG WANQING (V.O.)
Subject 247. Success rate: 99.8%. Just one final—

The explosion rips through. Whiteout.

EXT. SHEN RESIDENCE - DAY

Tang Wanqing stares at her hands—smaller, softer, holding blades she never trained with.

TANG WANQING (V.O.)
New variables. Foreign architecture. Period clothing. Calculating—

She winces, memories cramming into her skull like corrupted data.

TANG WANQING
(gasping)
System overload...

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (MEMORY)

Shadows. SHEN YIRAN and TANG WANYU entwined.

TANG WANYU
She'll be the hunter's problem by dawn. Then nothing stands between us.

SHEN YIRAN
Your sister's face when she saw us... shame she had to learn this way.

A door crashes open. ORIGINAL TANG WANQING stands there, trembling.

ORIGINAL TANG WANQING
(voice breaking)
How could you?

MADAM LIU materializes, stick already rising.

MADAM LIU
You brought this on yourself, girl.

The stick falls. The memory glitches—pain, then nothing.

EXT. SHEN RESIDENCE - DAY

Tang Wanqing's eyes snap open. Her grip tightens on the cleavers.

TANG WANQING
(cold, precise)
Shen Yiran. Your equation is fatally imbalanced.

Shen Yiran's face drains of color. His hand reaches for a sword that isn't there.

Tang Wanqing stares at her hands—smaller, softer, holding blades she never trained with.

TANG WANQING (V.O.)
New variables. Foreign architecture. Period clothing. Calculating—

She winces, memories cramming into her skull like corrupted data.

TANG WANQING
(gasping)
System overload...

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (MEMORY)

Shadows. SHEN YIRAN and TANG WANYU entwined.

TANG WANYU
She'll be the hunter's problem by dawn. Then nothing stands between us.

SHEN YIRAN
Your sister's face when she saw us... shame she had to learn this way.

A door crashes open. ORIGINAL TANG WANQING stands there, trembling.

ORIGINAL TANG WANQING
(voice breaking)
How could you?

MADAM LIU materializes, stick already rising.

MADAM LIU
You brought this on yourself, girl.

The stick falls. The memory glitches—pain, then nothing.

EXT. SHEN RESIDENCE - DAY

Tang Wanqing's eyes snap open. Her grip tightens on the cleavers.

TANG WANQING
(cold, precise)
Shen Yiran. Your equation is fatally imbalanced.

Shen Yiran's face drains of color. His hand reaches for a sword that isn't there.

EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

A white sedan tears down the highway, a black SUV riding its bumper.

INT. PROTAGONIST'S CAR - DAY

The PROTAGONIST drives frantically while talking on the phone.

PROTAGONIST
Honey, what's happening? Why are they—

WIFE (V.O.)
Lose them. Meet me at the dock.

The call disconnects.

PROTAGONIST
Han'er?

INT. PURSUIT CAR - DAY

The BLACK-CLAD LEADER sits in the passenger seat, ordering the driver.

BLACK-CLAD LEADER
Close the gap. Don't let him slip away.

BLACK-CLAD DRIVER
Eighty million yuan Tang Sancai in that car—
continuation:
EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

The SUV surges forward, trying to box the sedan in. The sedan swerves, clips the guardrail – SPARKS ERUPT.

The BLACK-CLAD DRIVER attempts to ram the PROTAGONIST's car.

BLACK-CLAD DRIVER
You're going to kill us!

Just stop him.

The Xia family doesn't forgive thieves.

BLACK-CLAD MAN
(ripping away the velvet)
The Tang Sancai is fake!

BLACK-CLAD LEADER
(furious)
What?

He grabs the ceramic horse and SMASHES it against the ground. Fragments scatter.

(to the protagonist)
Still playing games?

CRUNCH.

The protagonist lies bandaged, on a ventilator. A DOCTOR prepares a syringe.

The WIFE, in a red silk dress, sits beside him.

His eyes flutter open.

(weakly)

(smiling)

I'm the one who stole it.

title: Dark Side of the Moon
description: In the year 2090, Martial God Wang Xian leads humanity's final stand against invading six-winged angels on the moon's far side, only to be reborn decades earlier with a chance to save the woman who believed in him.
context:
Title: Dark Side of the Moon
Description: In the year 2090, Martial God Wang Xian leads humanity's final stand against invading six-winged angels on the moon's far side, only to be reborn decades earlier with a chance to save the woman who believed in him.

INT. DARK SIDE OF THE MOON - DAY

ON SCREEN:
New Martial Calendar 2090
Six-Winged Angel invaders attack
Martial God Wang Xian leads humanity's elite
Final battle on the dark side of the moon

WANG XIAN (Human Martial God), covered in wounds, lies beside a crater on the lunar surface.

MICHAEL (Six-Winged Angel)'s holographic image appears, hovering in the air.

MICHAEL
Wang Xian, your race's elite are all dead. You struggle on just to save those ants on Earth. Is it worth it?

WANG XIAN doesn't answer. He struggles to pull out a photo card from his chest.

FLASHBACK

INT. INDOOR ROOM - DAY

YE MIYUE (Martial Academy Beauty) smiles at the camera.

YE MIYUE (V.O.)
Wang Xian, one day, you will become a Martial God.

END FLASHBACK

WANG XIAN looks at the card in his hand with Ye Miyue's writing on it. He shows a slight smile, then his eyes become determined. He grips the card tightly and struggles to stand.

WANG XIAN
In my days of weakness, only Ye Miyue believed that a waste like me could become a Martial God. Though she has died, this Earth is our eternal home, and of course it's worth protecting!

WANG XIAN extends his hand. A futuristic sword burning with red light flies into his grasp.

MICHAEL
(laughing)
Hahaha, you're so gravely injured, yet you still want to stop my race's conquest?

WANG XIAN grips his sword horizontally, gathering energy.

WANG XIAN
Death is nothing!

WANG XIAN's body explodes with powerful energy, instantly transforming into a silver high-tech battle armor with energy wings spreading from his back.

MICHAEL
Seeking death!

MICHAEL also transforms into red battle armor, spreading six metal wings, engaging Wang Xian in fierce combat on the lunar surface.

Their energies collide, light effects burst everywhere, and surrounding meteorites and ship wreckage are shattered by the energy waves.

WANG XIAN
Martial Way, Ultimate Ascension!

WANG XIAN unleashes even greater power, swinging a world-destroying sword strike. A massive sword energy sweeps across the entire battlefield, cleaving through Michael and her ship together, triggering a massive explosion.

After the explosion, a huge fissure appears on the lunar surface.

WANG XIAN in battle armor stands in place, extending his hand, watching as his body gradually dissolves into points of starlight.

WANG XIAN
(softly)
Miyue, this world... I protected it.

WANG XIAN completely dissolves into light particles and vanishes.
continuation:
INT. UNKNOWN SPACE - DAY

WANG XIAN jolts awake, finding himself lying on the floor of a modern-style room, wearing athletic clothes.

INT. NORTH FIST MARTIAL HALL - DAY

WANG XIAN sits on the floor of a futuristic training room, looking bewildered.

WANG DABIAO (Third Uncle) and a SERVICE ROBOT stand before him.

WANG DABIAO
Brat, get up!

WANG XIAN
(astonished)
Third Uncle?

WANG XIAN stands up, looking at Wang Dabiao in shock.

WANG XIAN
Third Uncle, weren't your eyes blinded?

WANG DABIAO
(laughing and patting him)
Hey, what nonsense are you talking about!

WANG XIAN
(confused)
That's not right. Weren't your eyes blinded during the alien planet campaign?

ROBOT
Hello Wang Xian, welcome to New Martial Calendar December 1st, 2024. This is North Fist Martial Hall.

WANG XIAN
(shocked)
New Martial Calendar Year 24? I've been... reborn? December 1st—this is the day Ye Miyue died!

FLASHBACK

EXT. RUINS - DAY

YE MIYUE lies in the ruins after an explosion, already dead.

ON SCREEN: Qin City suffered an S-class beast attack. Streets exploded. Ye Miyue died as a result.

END FLASHBACK

WANG XIAN
(internal)
In this life, I must save her!

WANG DABIAO
(putting his arm around Wang Xian's shoulder)
What are you thinking about, Xiao Xian? Third Uncle arranged a massage for you.

WANG XIAN
(breaking free)
Third Uncle, I have urgent business. You go yourself.

WANG DABIAO
(forcibly pulling him along)
Come on, come on, hurry!

WANG DABIAO pushes WANG XIAN into a room.

INT. MASSAGE ROOM - DAY

WANG XIAN is pushed into a dimly lit room.

WANG XIAN
(impatiently)
Third Uncle, I really have urgent business!

The door opens. YE MIYUE walks in wearing a school uniform.

YE MIYUE
Hello, I'm Masseuse Number 8.

WANG XIAN sees YE MIYUE and freezes instantly.

WANG XIAN
(shocked)
It's you?

title: Return to Eighteen, Rejecting the School Belle
description: A man betrayed by his girlfriend and best friend is reborn twenty years in the past, determined to change his fate and never be a fool for love again.
context:
Title: Return to Eighteen, Rejecting the School Belle
Description: A man betrayed by his girlfriend and best friend is reborn twenty years in the past, determined to change his fate and never be a fool for love again.

EXT. SNOWY ROAD - NIGHT

An ambulance speeds through the snowy night, emergency lights flashing.

INT. AMBULANCE - CONTINUOUS

JIANG LIN lies on a stretcher, wearing an oxygen mask, on the verge of death. He weakly opens his eyes and sees his girlfriend TANG YUE leaning intimately close to GU XINGZHI, both thinking he's unconscious.

TANG YUE
(whispering)
The lawyer said if he doesn't make it tonight... everything goes to the children.

GU XINGZHI
(quietly)
Twenty years of this charade. At least the bastards are actually mine.

TANG YUE
(soft laugh)
Don't— He might hear you.

GU XINGZHI
Look at him. He can't hear anything.

Jiang Lin's fingers twitch. The heart monitor BEEPING becomes IRREGULAR—then FLATLINES. His eyes widen as his body convulses.

INT. WHITE VOID - DAY

JIANG LIN, wearing a high school uniform, stands suspended in pure white space. The VOICES of Tang Yue and Gu Xingzhi echo.

He clutches his chest, gasping.

JIANG LIN
(choking)
No... not like this...

The ambulance interior FLASHES before his eyes—Tang Yue's hand reaching for his mask.

He tears at his collar, air flooding his lungs.

JIANG LIN
(gasping)
Ah!
continuation:
INT. SCHOOL CAFETERIA - DAY

Jiang Lin YANKS out his earbuds, his own gasp echoing. Students stare.

A BLACKBOARD reads: "College Entrance Exam: 78 Days."

Jiang Lin touches his face, his hands, disbelieving. His fingers press against his chest—feeling a heartbeat.

JIANG LIN (V.O.)
Seventeen. I'm... seventeen again.

ON SCREEN: Seventeen Years Old

He sees TANG YUE across the cafeteria, seventeen and radiant. Her eyes meet his, then slide away.

FRIEND (O.S.)
But Jiang Lin always buys your lunch...

TANG YUE
(over her shoulder)
I told him not to. It's embarrassing.

Jiang Lin's knuckles go white on the table edge.

JIANG LIN (V.O.)
All those years... every moment... a lie.

He stands and walks to the food window.

JIANG LIN
Old Wei. Meat combo.

OLD WEI
(enthusiastically)
Coming right up!

OLD WEI adds an extra bun to Jiang Lin's tray.

JIANG LIN
Thanks.

He turns. Tang Yue appears beside him, smiling.

TANG YUE
Oh, you shouldn't have! But since you did—

She reaches for the tray. Jiang Lin shifts it away.

JIANG LIN
I didn't.

TANG YUE
(confused)
What?

JIANG LIN
(quietly)
These are for me. You have your own money, Tang Yue. Use it.

He walks to an empty table. She follows, voice dropping.

TANG YUE
(whispering)
Jiang Lin, what's wrong with you?

Jiang Lin sits, meets her eyes with something she doesn't recognize—weight, finality.

JIANG LIN
Nothing. I'm just... done.

He takes a deliberate bite. Tang Yue's face crumples slightly, then hardens. She spins and leaves.

Jiang Lin watches her go, the food suddenly tasteless. He forces another bite.

JIANG LIN (V.O.)
This time, I choose myself.

title: Return to Sixteen, Scumbag Father and Godmother Tremble
description: A woman loses everything after her father's affair destroys her family. Hit by a car while grieving her mother's death, she awakens in her sixteen-year-old body on the day she discovered the betrayal, determined to change fate.
context:
Title: Return to Sixteen, Scumbag Father and Godmother Tremble
Description: A woman loses everything after her father's affair destroys her family. Hit by a car while grieving her mother's death, she awakens in her sixteen-year-old body on the day she discovered the betrayal, determined to change fate.

INT. RAINY NIGHT ROAD - NIGHT

Dark clouds smother the sky. Lightning flickers. Rain hammers down.

ADULT LING YUE stumbles through the downpour, cradling a ceramic urn. Her cheap coat is soaked through. She stops under a streetlamp.

LING YUE
(whispering to the urn)
Mom... I thought telling the truth would fix everything.

She looks up at the rain.

LING YUE
(softly, broken)
I was so stupid.

She sinks to her knees, water pooling around her.

EXT. HONGYUN RESIDENTIAL COMPLEX - DAY (2003)

Golden afternoon light. TEENAGE LING YUE clutches her stomach, rushing toward the building.

TEENAGE LING YUE
Mom, bathroom emergency!

She bolts inside.

JIANG QIUMAP follows at a measured pace, carrying Ling Yue's piano bag.

JIANG QIUMAP
(smiling after her)
Key's in my purse!

INT. HOME BEDROOM - DAY (2003)

LING GUOZHI and ZHENG LUOMEI lie tangled in bedsheets, half-dressed.

The door bursts open. TEENAGE LING YUE freezes.

TEENAGE LING YUE
(eyes widening)
Dad?

JIANG QIUMAP appears in the doorway behind her, still holding the piano bag. It drops from her hand.

JIANG QIUMAP
(quietly)
Luomei.

ZHENG LUOMEI
(covering herself, voice sharp)
We need to talk. Calmly.

LING GUOZHI
(to Jiang, measured)
You weren't supposed to be home.

JIANG QIUMAP walks to the window, opens it wide.

JIANG QIUMAP
(calling down, voice steady)
Mrs. Chen? Could you come up? I need a witness.

LING GUOZHI's face tightens.

ZHENG LUOMEI moves to JIANG QIUMAP, low.

ZHENG LUOMEI
Don't be rash. Think about Ling Yue's college fund.

JIANG QIUMAP slaps her. Hard.

Downstairs, NEIGHBORS begin gathering.

FEMALE NEIGHBOR
That's the piano teacher. She's the godmother...

JIANG QIUMAP stands at the window, back straight, as LING YUE watches in silent horror.
continuation:
INT. INDUSTRIAL PARK OFFICE - DAY (2004)

LING GUOZHI slides papers across his desk. JIANG QIUMAP doesn't touch them.

LING GUOZHI
The debt collectors come next week. Sign, and I'll make sure they understand you're not involved.

JIANG QIUMAP
(reading)
"You assume all marital debt... waive claim to property..."

She looks up.

JIANG QIUMAP
You're bluffing.

LING GUOZHI places a bank statement on top. Red circles mark the defaults.

ZHENG LUOMEI enters, pours coffee, sets it down with a photograph underneath—an industrial park ultrasound.

ZHENG LUOMEI
(to Jiang, pleasantly)
He needs a clean slate. For the new family.

She sips her coffee, watching JIANG QIUMAP's face crumble.

YOUNG LING YUE storms in, sees her mother's tears.

LING YUE
(to Zheng)
You did this.

ZHENG LUOMEI
(smiling)
Your mother did it. She signed.

EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE - DAY (2024)

ADULT LING YUE blocks LING GUOZHI's Tesla. He steps out, annoyed.

LING GUOZHI
The answer's still no.

LING YUE
(holding medical bills)
Mom's liver. The transplant list—

LING GUOZHI
She made her choices.

He moves to get back in his car. LING YUE grabs his arm.

LING YUE
(desperate)
I'll do anything.

LING GUOZHI
(studies her)
Director Hao's son needs a wife. Someone... reliable.

LING YUE
(confused)
He's... disabled.

LING GUOZHI
(voice low)
His family pays. Your mother lives. You decide.

His phone rings. He answers, listens, then holds it out to her.

LING GUOZHI
Hospital.

NURSE (V.O.)
Miss Ling? Your mother coded ten minutes ago.

LING YUE takes the phone. Her hand is steady. Too steady.

LING YUE
(whispered)
Thank you.

She hands it back. Walks away.

INT. RAINY NIGHT ROAD - NIGHT

ADULT LING YUE stands in the same spot, the urn gone—left at the hospital.

She takes out her phone. Deletes LING GUOZHI's contact. Then every contact.

The rain stops. Headlights blind her. She doesn't move.

The car slams its brakes. Too late.

LING YUE's body arcs through the air, crashes heavily to the ground, and loses consciousness.

EXT. HONGYUN RESIDENTIAL COMPLEX - DAY (2003)

LING YUE (16) blinks. Sunlight warms her face. She's holding piano exam keys.

JIANG QIUMAP leans out from the building entrance.

JIANG QIUMAP
What are you dawdling for? Didn't you rush home right after your piano exam?

LING YUE looks at her hands—soft, unlined. She touches her face.

She sees the keys. Her grip tightens.

LING YUE
(internal monologue)
Not this time.

She looks up at her mother's window, eyes dry and clear.

LING YUE
(internal monologue)
I know how the story ends.
full_script:
Title: Return to Sixteen, Scumbag Father and Godmother Tremble
Description: A woman loses everything after her father's affair destroys her family. Hit by a car while grieving her mother's death, she awakens in her sixteen-year-old body on the day she discovered the betrayal, determined to change fate.

INT. RAINY NIGHT ROAD - NIGHT

Dark clouds smother the sky. Lightning flickers. Rain hammers down.

ADULT LING YUE stumbles through the downpour, cradling a ceramic urn. Her cheap coat is soaked through. She stops under a streetlamp.

LING YUE
(whispering to the urn)
Mom... I thought telling the truth would fix everything.

She looks up at the rain.

LING YUE
(softly, broken)
I was so stupid.

She sinks to her knees, water pooling around her.

EXT. HONGYUN RESIDENTIAL COMPLEX - DAY (2003)

Golden afternoon light. TEENAGE LING YUE clutches her stomach, rushing toward the building.

TEENAGE LING YUE
Mom, bathroom emergency!

She bolts inside.

JIANG QIUMAP follows at a measured pace, carrying Ling Yue's piano bag.

JIANG QIUMAP
(smiling after her)
Key's in my purse!

INT. HOME BEDROOM - DAY (2003)

LING GUOZHI and ZHENG LUOMEI lie tangled in bedsheets, half-dressed.

The door bursts open. TEENAGE LING YUE freezes.

TEENAGE LING YUE
(eyes widening)
Dad?

JIANG QIUMAP appears in the doorway behind her, still holding the piano bag. It drops from her hand.

JIANG QIUMAP
(quietly)
Luomei.

ZHENG LUOMEI
(covering herself, voice sharp)
We need to talk. Calmly.

LING GUOZHI
(to Jiang, measured)
You weren't supposed to be home.

JIANG QIUMAP walks to the window, opens it wide.

JIANG QIUMAP
(calling down, voice steady)
Mrs. Chen? Could you come up? I need a witness.

LING GUOZHI's face tightens.

ZHENG LUOMEI moves to JIANG QIUMAP, low.

ZHENG LUOMEI
Don't be rash. Think about Ling Yue's college fund.

JIANG QIUMAP slaps her. Hard.

Downstairs, NEIGHBORS begin gathering.

FEMALE NEIGHBOR
That's the piano teacher. She's the godmother...

JIANG QIUMAP stands at the window, back straight, as LING YUE watches in silent horror.

INT. INDUSTRIAL PARK OFFICE - DAY (2004)

LING GUOZHI slides papers across his desk. JIANG QIUMAP doesn't touch them.

LING GUOZHI
The debt collectors come next week. Sign, and I'll make sure they understand you're not involved.

JIANG QIUMAP
(reading)
"You assume all marital debt... waive claim to property..."

She looks up.

JIANG QIUMAP
You're bluffing.

LING GUOZHI places a bank statement on top. Red circles mark the defaults.

ZHENG LUOMEI enters, pours coffee, sets it down with a photograph underneath—an industrial park ultrasound.

ZHENG LUOMEI
(to Jiang, pleasantly)
He needs a clean slate. For the new family.

She sips her coffee, watching JIANG QIUMAP's face crumble.

YOUNG LING YUE storms in, sees her mother's tears.

LING YUE
(to Zheng)
You did this.

ZHENG LUOMEI
(smiling)
Your mother did it. She signed.

EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE - DAY (2024)

ADULT LING YUE blocks LING GUOZHI's Tesla. He steps out, annoyed.

LING GUOZHI
The answer's still no.

LING YUE
(holding medical bills)
Mom's liver. The transplant list—

LING GUOZHI
She made her choices.

He moves to get back in his car. LING YUE grabs his arm.

LING YUE
(desperate)
I'll do anything.

LING GUOZHI
(studies her)
Director Hao's son needs a wife. Someone... reliable.

LING YUE
(confused)
He's... disabled.

LING GUOZHI
(voice low)
His family pays. Your mother lives. You decide.

His phone rings. He answers, listens, then holds it out to her.

LING GUOZHI
Hospital.

NURSE (V.O.)
Miss Ling? Your mother coded ten minutes ago.

LING YUE takes the phone. Her hand is steady. Too steady.

LING YUE
(whispered)
Thank you.

She hands it back. Walks away.

INT. RAINY NIGHT ROAD - NIGHT

ADULT LING YUE stands in the same spot, the urn gone—left at the hospital.

She takes out her phone. Deletes LING GUOZHI's contact. Then every contact.

The rain stops. Headlights blind her. She doesn't move.

The car slams its brakes. Too late.

LING YUE's body arcs through the air, crashes heavily to the ground, and loses consciousness.

EXT. HONGYUN RESIDENTIAL COMPLEX - DAY (2003)

LING YUE (16) blinks. Sunlight warms her face. She's holding piano exam keys.

JIANG QIUMAP leans out from the building entrance.

JIANG QIUMAP
What are you dawdling for? Didn't you rush home right after your piano exam?

LING YUE looks at her hands—soft, unlined. She touches her face.

She sees the keys. Her grip tightens.

LING YUE
(internal monologue)
Not this time.

She looks up at her mother's window, eyes dry and clear.

LING YUE
(internal monologue)
I know how the story ends.

title: Reunion: CEO Fu's Eyes Reddened, Humbly Confessing Love in the Rain
description: At a reunion party, Lin Ran encounters her ex-boyfriend Fu Xingjian, who used her as a tool to get close to his true love years ago, now a billionaire CEO.
context:
Title: Reunion: CEO Fu's Eyes Reddened, Humbly Confessing Love in the Rain
Description: At a reunion party, Lin Ran encounters her ex-boyfriend Fu Xingjian, who used her as a tool to get close to his true love years ago, now a billionaire CEO.

INT. PARTY PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

City lights streak across floor-to-ceiling windows. Young men and women drink and chat in a luxurious private room, the atmosphere lively.

LIN RAN, in a white suit, enters. She smooths her blazer, a habit when nervous.

ZHUO TING
Lin Ran!

ZHUO TING rushes over with a wine glass.

ZHUO TING
You made it.

She hands Lin Ran the glass, pulling her toward the sofa area.

ZHUO TING
(quietly)
Scoop just came in. Fu Xingjian's on his way.

LIN RAN
Six years abroad. Probably married with kids by now.

ZHUO TING
He chased Yao Ning there. Stayed six whole years.

ZHUO TING
(fingers tightening on her own glass)
Made you his stepping stone. You couldn't hold your head up in front of the whole school.

LIN RAN
Bad people don't always get bad karma.

ZHUO TING
Now he's Yutou Group's CEO. Worth billions.

LIN RAN
(pats Zhuo Ting's hand)
Ancient history. My 996 boss won't even let me have a ghost.

She checks her phone—three urgent messages light up the screen.

LIN RAN
Half a day off and they're already hunting me.
continuation:
ZHUO TING
Evil capitalists.

The door opens. FU XINGJIAN, black suit, gold-rimmed glasses, stands in the doorway. The room quiets.

CLASSMATE A
Fu Xingjian! Everyone stand up!

Everyone stands up to greet him.

CLASSMATE B
CEO Fu, it's been six years. Didn't expect you'd remember us.

CLASSMATE A
Yes, yes, CEO Fu, please come in. Here.

CLASSMATE A hands FU XINGJIAN a glass of wine.

FU XINGJIAN
(taking the glass)
Tonight I'm just a classmate. Enjoy yourselves.

CLASSMATE A
CEO Fu is so generous! Everyone applaud!

Everyone applauds and cheers.

ZHUO TING
(disdainfully)
A capitalist performing humility.

ZHUO TING glances at Lin Ran—her knuckles are white around the wine glass.

ZHUO TING
Let's go.

LIN RAN
And give him that power?

ZHUO TING
He's coming.

FU XINGJIAN walks up to Lin Ran and stops.

FU XINGJIAN
Lin Ran. Long time no see.

Lin Ran looks up, meeting his gaze. She doesn't blink.

title: Reunited, His Love Remains True & Loving You is a Lonely Heart's Secret
description: A young woman's first love is torn apart by family tragedy and class differences, forcing her to make a heartbreaking choice.
context:
Title: Reunited, His Love Remains True & Loving You is a Lonely Heart's Secret
Description: A young woman's first love is torn apart by family tragedy and class differences, forcing her to make a heartbreaking choice.

INT. BASKETBALL COURT - DAY

A basketball flies toward SHEN NANCHU, who is walking.

HUO SHIYAN
Watch out!

HUO SHIYAN rushes over and catches the ball before it hits SHEN NANCHU. Their eyes meet, time seems to stand still.

SHEN NANCHU (V.O.)
That year I first met Huo Shiyan. From then on, he illuminated my entire youth.

MONTAGE

- Huo Shiyan carries Shen Nanchu on his back, running across the field, both laughing happily.
- The two fall onto the grass, laughing and playing.

EXT. GRASS FIELD - NIGHT

SHEN NANCHU and HUO SHIYAN sit side by side watching the night sky. A shooting star streaks across.

SHEN NANCHU
Look, make a wish, make a wish!

They immediately close their eyes and clasp their hands together to make wishes.

SHEN NANCHU/HUO SHIYAN (in unison)
I hope that in the future, Huo Shiyan/Shen Nanchu will be together.

They open their eyes and smile at each other.

INT. BEDROOM - DUSK

Five years later. SHEN NANCHU (23) wears a simple white dress, talking on an old phone.

SHEN NANCHU
(into phone)
I'm wearing the dress you sent. See you at the bridge.

She hangs up. Her STEPFATHER bursts in, reeking of alcohol.

HUO SHIYAN (O.S.)
(through phone)
Nanchu? The signal...

INT. LIVING ROOM - DUSK

STEPFATHER points at SHEN NANCHU, furious.

STEPFATHER
You stole from my drawer for that pretty boy! When I married your mother, I took on two parasites!

STEPFATHER grabs her arm. MOTHER rushes over.

MOTHER
She used her scholarship money! Let her go!

STEPFATHER
(to Mother)
Stay out of this!

He shoves MOTHER. She stumbles, knocks over a faulty SPACE HEATER. Sparks fly. STEPFATHER trips on the cord, falls. Curtains ignite.
continuation:
INT. BURNING LIVING ROOM - CONTINUOUS

SHEN NANCHU crawls through smoke toward her unconscious MOTHER.

SHEN NANCHU
(coughing)
Mom... please...

She drags MOTHER toward the door as flames grow.

EXT. HOSPITAL - NIGHT

Shen Nanchu's torn dress flaps in the wind as she stares at the building.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

SHEN NANCHU, dress bloodstained from carrying her mother, waits. A DOCTOR approaches.

DOCTOR
Your mother has third-degree burns. She'll need months of intensive care.

SHEN NANCHU
How much?

DOCTOR
At least two hundred thousand. Upfront.

The DOCTOR leaves. Shen Nanchu slides down the wall, trembling. GRANDFATHER HUO (70s, impeccable suit) appears with two BODYGUARDS.

GRANDFATHER HUO
Miss Shen. I'm Huo Shiyan's grandfather.

SHEN NANCHU stands, wiping her face.

SHEN NANCHU
Sir.

GRANDFATHER HUO
Shiyan is preparing his proposal. Our family has already chosen his fiancée. A suitable girl.

He produces a black bank card.

GRANDFATHER HUO
Five hundred thousand. For your mother's treatment. And your silence.

SHEN NANCHU stares at the card. Then at the emergency room doors.

SHEN NANCHU (V.O.)
That was the moment I learned love was a luxury I couldn't afford.

She reaches for the card. Her hand shakes.

INT. BRIDGE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

Huo Shiyan waits with flowers, checking his phone.

EXT. TRAIN STATION - DAWN

Shen Nanchu boards a train, the card clutched in her hand. She turns off her phone.

INT. HUO FAMILY MANSION - NIGHT (PRESENT)

Huo Shiyan (28, hardened) pours whiskey. His phone shows a photo: Shen Nanchu in the white dress.

HUO SHIYAN
(to himself)
Five years, Nanchu. You vanished without a word.

A BODYGUARD enters.

BODYGUARD
Sir, we found her. She's working at a coastal hospital.

Huo Shiyan's glass shatters against the floor.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Shen Nanchu (28, tired) changes a patient's bandages. She looks up. HUO SHIYAN stands in the doorway.

SHEN NANCHU
(voice breaking)
You shouldn't have come.

HUO SHIYAN
You left me a corpse. I came back for the truth.

He holds up the black card, now cracked in half.

HUO SHIYAN
Did you ever love me? Or was it always about the price?

Shen Nanchu meets his eyes. She reaches for her locket, opens it: a photo of them on the grass field.

SHEN NANCHU
I loved you enough to become someone you could hate.

The patient MONITOR BEEPING intensifies. Shen Nanchu turns back to her work, but her hand finds his wrist, just for a moment.

FADE OUT.

title: Daughter Shines After Double Ninth Festival
description: A mother mourns her daughter who was betrayed and driven to jump off a cliff five years ago, as painful memories resurface during the Double Ninth Festival.
context:
Title: Daughter Shines After Double Ninth Festival
Description: A mother mourns her daughter who was betrayed and driven to jump off a cliff five years ago, as painful memories resurface during the Double Ninth Festival.

INT. OLD DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY

The camera pans across a rundown farmhouse courtyard.

Cut to the interior, where a simple memorial altar displays a black and white portrait of YANG QIQI. ZHANG CHUNLING (Yang Qiqi's mother) is burning incense, her expression filled with sorrow.

ZHANG CHUNLING (V.O.)
Qiqi, time hasn't moved since you left.

ZHANG CHUNLING's tears stream down her face.

ZHANG CHUNLING
It's Double Ninth again.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT (FIVE YEARS AGO - FLASHBACK)

YANG QIQI awakens on a bed, disoriented, as a MAN photographs her. She clutches her torn blouse.

YANG QIQI
What did you do? Lili, why?

A phone on the nightstand shows photos uploading.

EXT. CLIFF EDGE - DAY (FIVE YEARS AGO - FLASHBACK)

ZHANG CHUNLING (V.O.)
Your best friend set the trap. Loans you never took. Photos you never knew.

YANG QIQI stands at the cliff edge, surrounded by LOAN SHARKS. She holds her phone, speaking, her expression desperate.

ZHANG CHUNLING (V.O.)
She emptied our accounts. Said it wasn't enough.

ZHANG CHUNLING (on the phone, crying out)
Qiqi, I sent the funeral savings! It's all I have!

YANG QIQI (into the phone, crying)
Mom, you and Dad are my world. Forgive me.

YANG QIQI hangs up the phone, her eyes resolute.
continuation:
EXT. NEAR THE CLIFF - DAY (FIVE YEARS AGO - FLASHBACK)

ZHANG CHUNLING and YANG GUOXIANG (Yang Qiqi's father) run frantically toward the cliff edge.

ZHANG CHUNLING
(heart-wrenching scream)
Qiqi! Don't!

YANG GUOXIANG
(heart-wrenching scream)
Qiqi! Please, no!

ZHANG CHUNLING
(heart-wrenching scream)
Qiqi!

ZHANG CHUNLING and YANG GUOXIANG reach the cliff edge, collapsing to the ground in anguish, looking down.

ZHANG CHUNLING
(crying out)
My baby girl...

EXT. CLIFF EDGE - DAY (FIVE YEARS AGO - FLASHBACK)

LIN LILI (Yang Qiqi's best friend) stands nearby, watching everything with contempt.

LIN LILI
Just photos. Can't face the shame? Pathetic.

LIN LILI takes out her phone, the screen displaying "Successfully transferred 80,000.00 yuan." She laughs triumphantly.

LIN LILI
Perfect! Their life savings and funeral money. All mine.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. OLD DILAPIDATED HOUSE - DAY (PRESENT)

ZHANG CHUNLING kneels before the memorial altar, sobbing uncontrollably.

ZHANG CHUNLING
We were helpless then. But not now.

A NEIGHBOR WOMAN rushes in, panicked.

NEIGHBOR
Chunling, something terrible happened! Your Guoxiang scattered paper money in Erniu's orchard, and Erniu has tied him up!

ZHANG CHUNLING
(shocked)
Guoxiang...

ZHANG CHUNLING's eyes widen in terror.

description: Su Hui, kept as a caged canary by the powerful Shen Yan, is captured after her 99th escape attempt. Threatened with her sister's safety, she vows revenge.
context:
Title: The Canary's Counterattack
Description: Su Hui, kept as a caged canary by the powerful Shen Yan, is captured after her 99th escape attempt. Threatened with her sister's safety, she vows revenge.

INT. LUXURIOUS VILLA HALL - NIGHT

SU HUI sits disheveled on the polished marble, soaking wet, eyes hollow with defeat. Two BODYGUARDS in black flank her like silent sentinels.

SU HUI (V.O.)
A caged canary. That's what I am. That's what he made me.

A series of quick flashback shots:
- SU HUI sprints through torrential rain, headlights blazing.
- Bodyguards tackle her into the mud.
- She's dragged back, fingers clawing at the asphalt.

SU HUI (V.O.)
Ninety-nine attempts. Ninety-nine failures.

SU HUI (in flashback)
(screaming)
Let me go! Let me GO!

The shot returns to reality. SU HUI's jaw tightens.

SU HUI (V.O.)
But a cage is still a cage.

SHEN YAN walks in from the rain surrounded by bodyguards. He wears a suit and gold-rimmed glasses, his expression cold. He walks up to SU HUI, crouches down, and grabs her chin.

SHEN YAN
Why did you run?

SU HUI raises her head, her eyes full of hatred.

SU HUI
You destroyed my family, forced me to drop out, made me your secret while you got engaged. And you ask why?

SHEN YAN stands up and signals to the bodyguards.

SU HUI
(terrified)
No!

The bodyguards push in a trembling young girl (SISTER).

SU HUI
(shouting)
Let her go!

SISTER
(crying)
Sister, don't worry about me! Sister, run! Sister, don't worry about me, just run!

SU HUI
(struggling)
Let go! Let me go! Sister!

SHEN YAN
(coldly)
I won't hurt her.

SHEN YAN walks up to SISTER and examines her face.

SHEN YAN
(to bodyguards)
Let her go.

SHEN YAN
These eyes, nose, mouth - she looks so much like you.
continuation:
SISTER
(afraid)
No, please...

SHEN YAN
Too bad her eyes can't see. But that's good - she won't run around like you do.

SISTER
(crying out)
No!

SHEN YAN
Using her as your replacement would be a good choice.

SHEN YAN
(mimes a cutting motion)
So fragile.

SISTER
(screaming)
Please, no!

SU HUI
(shouting desperately)
Stop! I'll stay— just don't hurt her!

SU HUI
(compromising)
You want me to stay, right? I will! Just don't touch my sister!

SHEN YAN
(smiling)
Good. Then it's settled.

SU HUI rushes over and hugs SISTER.

SISTER
(crying)
Don't trade yourself! Just run!

SHEN YAN
Take her away.

The bodyguards drag SISTER away.

SISTER
(shouting as she's dragged away)
Sister! Don't let him win!

SU HUI
(chasing after)
Where are you taking her? Let her go!

SHEN YAN grabs SU HUI's arm and pulls her back.

SHEN YAN
As long as you stay here obediently, your sister will be fine.

SHEN YAN roughly pushes SU HUI onto the living room sofa and leans over her.

SU HUI
(struggling)
Let me go! Let me go!

SU HUI
(through gritted teeth)
Shen Yan! You killed my foster father, humiliated us. I'll make you live a life worse than death!

While struggling, SU HUI's hand quietly reaches into SHEN YAN's suit pocket, touches something, and grips it tightly. Her eyes flash with cold determination.

title: Golden Branch, Green Leaf
description: In a hospital room, a cruel woman abuses an injured girl while protecting her own daughter, revealing a twisted family dynamic.
context:
Title: Golden Branch, Green Leaf
Description: In a hospital room, a cruel woman abuses an injured girl while protecting her own daughter, revealing a twisted family dynamic.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

A hospital room with two beds. AUNT TANG and her HUSBAND are caring for their daughter RUIRUI on one bed. On the other bed sits an injured girl, JIANSHENG, with her mother MANMAN standing beside her.

AUNT TANG
Come on, Ruirui. Take your medicine.

RUIRUI takes the medicine. HUSBAND hands her a glass of water.

AUNT TANG
You scared us.

RUIRUI
(groggily)
And Aunt Tang too.

RUIRUI'S HUSBAND
(concerned)
How's the pain now?

On the other bed, JIANSHENG stifles a moan.

JIANSHENG
(weakly)
Mom... it hurts.

JIANSHENG reaches out to grab AUNT TANG'S sleeve.

AUNT TANG
(disgustedly shaking her off)
Don't touch me.

RUIRUI
Mom, there's extra medicine here. Give it to her.

MANMAN reaches out to take the medicine.

AUNT TANG
(snatching the medicine away)
That's Ruirui's. She doesn't deserve it.

JIANSHENG
(crying, reaching for MANMAN)
Please...

AUNT TANG grabs JIANSHENG'S hand and violently throws it away.

AUNT TANG
continuation:
(viciously)
Scream again and I'll end you.

Someone throws a pillow at JIANSHENG.

MANMAN
(rushing forward)
She's twelve.

AUNT TANG
(sneering)
You signed for this. I'm sending her to her death.

AUNT TANG and MANMAN push JIANSHENG off the hospital bed. JIANSHENG falls heavily to the floor.

AUNT TANG
(crouching down, waving the medicine bottle in front of JIANSHENG)
Last chance. Want it?

JIANSHENG
(nodding)
Yes.

AUNT TANG pours out the pills, drops them on the floor, and crushes one with her high heel.

JIANSHENG
Mom...

AUNT TANG
You begged for it.

AUNT TANG grabs JIANSHENG'S head and presses her face toward the pills on the floor.

AUNT TANG
Eat it.

MANMAN
No!

RUIRUI gets off the bed and holds MANMAN back, preventing her from going forward.

AUNT TANG
(grabbing JIANSHENG'S hair)
You were born for this.

AUNT TANG violently pushes JIANSHENG down to the floor.

AUNT TANG
(contemptuously)
Better off dead. Disgusting.

JIANSHENG lies on the floor, curled up in pain, crying in despair.

title: Golden Lawyer
description: A world-renowned lawyer who gave up his career for love discovers his wife's betrayal during a live stream consultation.
context:
Title: Golden Lawyer
Description: A world-renowned lawyer who gave up his career for love discovers his wife's betrayal during a live stream consultation.

INT. TANG JINGCHENG'S HOME - DAY

TANG JINGCHENG, wearing an apron, mops the floor with methodical strokes. His phone rings. He answers with a Bluetooth earbud.

SU YUJIAN (V.O.)
Senior. The network's waiting. You promised.

CUT TO:

INT. SU YUJIAN'S LAW OFFICE - DAY

SU YUJIAN, 30s, sharp-suited, leans back at his desk.

TANG JINGCHENG (V.O.)
Let me finish here. Then breakfast. Pingping's still asleep.

SU YUJIAN
You made multinationals pay billions. Now you're—

TANG JINGCHENG
—exactly where I want to be. Voice only today. No face.

SU YUJIAN
Five years invisible. They'd mortgage buildings to find you.

TANG JINGCHENG
They won't.

SU YUJIAN
Your rules.

FLASHBACK:

At an awards ceremony, young TANG JINGCHENG in lawyer's robes receives a golden trophy. The audience applauds thunderously.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Chinese lawyer who makes multinational corporations tremble has once again dominated the global lawyer authority index, winning the world's number one golden lawyer award. He is Mr. Tang.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. TANG JINGCHENG'S HOME - DAY

TANG JINGCHENG tucks the trophy deep into a bookshelf, nameplate turned inward. He checks his watch.

PINGPING emerges from the bedroom, stretching. She spots him and smiles.

PINGPING
Honey, stop. You'll wear yourself out.

She hugs him from behind, her eyes scanning the spotless floor with a flicker of satisfaction.

TANG JINGCHENG
Wanted everything perfect for you.

PINGPING
You're too good to me.

She takes the mop, guides him to the sofa, presses a game controller into his hands.

PINGPING
Play. Relax. Spoiling you is my only job.

Her phone chimes. She glances at the screen, her smile tightening at the corners.

PINGPING
Work call. Be right back.

She walks to the balcony, slides the door shut. Through the glass, Tang watches her reflection—her face shifting from warmth to cold efficiency.

PINGPING (V.O.)
(muffled through glass)
...understand. On my way.

She returns, grabbing her coat.

PINGPING
Emergency at the office. I'll grab a taxi.

TANG JINGCHENG
I can drive you.

PINGPING
(panicked)
No! You rest.

She kisses his forehead quickly, exits. Tang watches the door, then looks at the controller in his hands. Sets it down.

TANG JINGCHENG
(quiet)
One month until five years.
continuation:
INT. TANG JINGCHENG'S STUDY - DAY

TANG JINGCHENG positions his phone on a tripod, angles it away from his face. He places the golden lawyer trophy in frame, starts the live stream.

LIVE STREAM COMMENTS (V.O.)
Golden trophy! No face? This guy solved my uncle's case!

TANG JINGCHENG
(modulated voice)
Three consultations today.

He accepts a connection. The user's avatar shows a phone case with a cherry pendant—partially cropped.

TANG JINGCHENG
Madam, your legal issue?

The voice is filtered, robotic.

LIANBIN (V.O.)
(voice-filtered)
Divorce. Financial abuse.

INT. CAO YANBIN'S OFFICE - DAY

PINGPING sits with CAO YANBIN, 40s, polished. She holds her phone, voice-filter app active. Her cherry pendant sways as she leans forward.

PINGPING
(into phone, modulated)
He's useless. Won't work. Just plays games.

INT. TANG JINGCHENG'S STUDY - DAY

TANG JINGCHENG
(eyes narrowing)
What evidence?

LIVE STREAM COMMENTS (V.O.)
Record everything!

The voice filter glitches, drops for one syllable.

LIANBIN (V.O.)
—home, he—
(real voice, crystal clear)
—never leaves.

TANG JINGCHENG freezes. That cadence. That rise on "never."

INT. CAO YANBIN'S OFFICE - DAY

PINGPING doesn't notice. She continues, voice-filtered again.

PINGPING
Leave him with nothing. Can you guarantee that?

CAO YANBIN squeezes her shoulder, nods approvingly.

INT. TANG JINGCHENG'S STUDY - DAY

TANG JINGCHENG stares at the avatar—the cherry pendant, the phone case he gave her last anniversary. His hand trembles on the desk.

TANG JINGCHENG (I.V.)
Our case.

On screen, the shadows of PINGPING and CAO YANBIN merge in the background.

LIANBIN (V.O.)
(filtered, cold)
Make him pay for wasting my life.

Close-up: Tang's reflection in the darkened monitor—anguish hardening into something unreadable.

END SCENE

title: Golden Words and Jade Lies
description: A woman whose parents were killed by a rich heiress seizes the chance to become her substitute bride, plotting revenge from within the powerful Fu family.
context:
Title: Golden Words and Jade Lies
Description: A woman whose parents were killed by a rich heiress seizes the chance to become her substitute bride, plotting revenge from within the powerful Fu family.

INT. BOXING CLUB - NIGHT

A dark, industrial-style boxing club. Dim lighting, tense atmosphere.

ZHAO SIMIAO (V.O.)
Five years ago, Qin Shuiyin killed my parents with her car and her connections. Now she's the perfect fiancée of Fu Shao—the man who rules Haicheng. She won't remember my face.

QIN SHUIYIN and a group of friends stand by the boxing ring. She is fashionably dressed, her arrogance thin over desperation. Next to her stands a handsome man, PRETTY BOY.

PRETTY BOY
Shuiyin, Fu Shao's wedding is in three weeks. If we can't find someone to take your place...

QIN SHUIYIN
(quietly terrified)
I know what happens to women who disappoint him.

ZHAO SIMIAO emerges from the shadows, her presence arresting.

ZHAO SIMIAO (V.O.)
She thinks she's hunting for a substitute. She doesn't realize the trap is already set.

ZHAO SIMIAO walks straight toward QIN SHUIYIN.

QIN SHUIYIN
Zhao Simiao. That name... from that night.

ZHAO SIMIAO
I'm here to be Miss Qin's substitute.

QIN SHUIYIN
(recovering)
Of course you are. How... useful.

MONTAGE:
- QIN SHUIYIN's car speeds through a crosswalk, fishtailing. Young ZHAO SIMIAO's father shoves her aside, taking the full impact.
- Young ZHAO SIMIAO holds her mother's body, a torn university admission letter clutched in her hand.

QIN SHUIYIN (V.O.)
I told you to disappear. You should have listened.

ZHAO SIMIAO
(coldly)
Should I forgive and forget?

QIN SHUIYIN
(smiling)
Forgiveness is above your station.
continuation:
EXT. STREET - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

ZHAO SIMIAO's father lies on the ground, bleeding out. Her mother cradles his head. QIN SHUIYIN exits her car, already calling her lawyer.

QIN SHUIYIN
(into phone)
Daddy, I need damage control. Now.

ZHAO SIMIAO'S MOTHER
You were drunk! You murdered him!

QIN SHUIYIN
(to her men)
Teach her about leverage.

QIN SHUIYIN's men grab the mother. Young ZHAO SIMIAO runs toward them.

ZHAO SIMIAO
Mom!

ZHAO SIMIAO'S MOTHER
(protecting her)
Miaomiao, close your eyes! Don't watch!

The mother is beaten while shielding her daughter. She collapses, dying.

ZHAO SIMIAO'S MOTHER
(whispering)
Don't become what they are... survive...

She dies. Young ZHAO SIMIAO sits immobile between her parents, rain mixing blood and tears.

INT. BOXING CLUB - NIGHT (PRESENT)

Back to reality. ZHAO SIMIAO stands motionless as QIN SHUIYIN evaluates her.

QIN SHUIYIN
(satisfied)
Good. You'll meet Fu Shao tomorrow and dissolve the engagement.

She throws a stack of money. Bills flutter around ZHAO SIMIAO.

QIN SHUIYIN
Buy a proper dress. My replacement shouldn't look like she crawled from the gutter.

QIN SHUIYIN grinds a bill under her heel. ZHAO SIMIAO kneels to retrieve it. QIN SHUIYIN seizes her wrist.

QIN SHUIYIN
Such delicate hands. Pity they still reek of poverty.

ZHAO SIMIAO
(quietly)
They'll learn to wear your diamonds.

QIN SHUIYIN
(laughing)
Remember this moment. You're trading one cage for another.

QIN SHUIYIN and her entourage exit. PRETTY BOY hesitates, studying Zhao Simiao with something like recognition.

PRETTY BOY
(to Zhao Simiao)
She never looks back at the wreckage.

He leaves. ZHAO SIMIAO remains kneeling, her hands trembling slightly as she gathers the scattered bills.

ZHAO SIMIAO (V.O.)
The powerful never look down long enough to see the blade rising.

ZHAO SIMIAO stands, her reflection in the darkened mirror showing both her face and the money in her hands—blood money becoming her dowry.

ZHAO SIMIAO (V.O.)
Qin Shuiyin, I'll marry Fu Shao in your name. And when I do, you'll learn what happens when victims stop looking down.

END SCENE

- QIN SHUIYIN's car speeds through a crosswalk, fishtailing. Young ZHAO SIMIAO's father shoves her aside, taking the full impact.
- Young ZHAO SIMIAO holds her mother's body, a torn university admission letter clutched in her hand.

QIN SHUIYIN (V.O.)
I told you to disappear. You should have listened.

ZHAO SIMIAO
(coldly)
Should I forgive and forget?

QIN SHUIYIN
(smiling)
Forgiveness is above your station.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

ZHAO SIMIAO's father lies on the ground, bleeding out. Her mother cradles his head. QIN SHUIYIN exits her car, already calling her lawyer.

QIN SHUIYIN
(into phone)
Daddy, I need damage control. Now.

ZHAO SIMIAO'S MOTHER
You were drunk! You murdered him!

QIN SHUIYIN
(to her men)
Teach her about leverage.

QIN SHUIYIN's men grab the mother. Young ZHAO SIMIAO runs toward them.

ZHAO SIMIAO
Mom!

ZHAO SIMIAO'S MOTHER
(protecting her)
Miaomiao, close your eyes! Don't watch!

The mother is beaten while shielding her daughter. She collapses, dying.

ZHAO SIMIAO'S MOTHER
(whispering)
Don't become what they are... survive...

She dies. Young ZHAO SIMIAO sits immobile between her parents, rain mixing blood and tears.

INT. BOXING CLUB - NIGHT (PRESENT)

Back to reality. ZHAO SIMIAO stands motionless as QIN SHUIYIN evaluates her.

QIN SHUIYIN
(satisfied)
Good. You'll meet Fu Shao tomorrow and dissolve the engagement.

She throws a stack of money. Bills flutter around ZHAO SIMIAO.

QIN SHUIYIN
Buy a proper dress. My replacement shouldn't look like she crawled from the gutter.

QIN SHUIYIN grinds a bill under her heel. ZHAO SIMIAO kneels to retrieve it. QIN SHUIYIN seizes her wrist.

QIN SHUIYIN
Such delicate hands. Pity they still reek of poverty.

ZHAO SIMIAO
(quietly)
They'll learn to wear your diamonds.

QIN SHUIYIN
(laughing)
Remember this moment. You're trading one cage for another.

QIN SHUIYIN and her entourage exit. PRETTY BOY hesitates, studying Zhao Simiao with something like recognition.

PRETTY BOY
(to Zhao Simiao)
She never looks back at the wreckage.

He leaves. ZHAO SIMIAO remains kneeling, her hands trembling slightly as she gathers the scattered bills.

ZHAO SIMIAO (V.O.)
The powerful never look down long enough to see the blade rising.

ZHAO SIMIAO stands, her reflection in the darkened mirror showing both her face and the money in her hands—blood money becoming her dowry.

ZHAO SIMIAO (V.O.)
Qin Shuiyin, I'll marry Fu Shao in your name. And when I do, you'll learn what happens when victims stop looking down.

END SCENE

title: Iron Fist Mom's Search for Her Daughter
description: A mother's desperate search for her kidnapped daughter leads her into a dangerous confrontation with a human trafficking ring.
context:
Title: Iron Fist Mom's Search for Her Daughter
Description: A mother's desperate search for her kidnapped daughter leads her into a dangerous confrontation with a human trafficking ring.

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING - NIGHT

XIAO YA (17, exhausted) runs through debris-strewn corridors. Flashlight beams cut through darkness behind her.

The TRAFFICKER OLD WOMAN (60s, sharp eyes) blocks the corridor's end with two HENCHMEN.

TRAFFICKER OLD WOMAN
End of the line, little rabbit.

A HENCHMAN lunges. XIAO YA swings a metal pipe—hits his knee. He drops. She vaults through a doorway.

INT. ABANDONED BUILDING - GROUND FLOOR - CONTINUOUS

XIAO YA crashes into a flooded room. She scrambles toward a broken window.

The TRAFFICKER BOSS steps through the window opening, scarred face lit by moonlight.

TRAFFICKER BOSS
Ducks that fly through windows
break their wings.

He catches her wrist. Twists. XIAO YA screams.

The TRAFFICKER OLD WOMAN appears, breathing hard.

TRAFFICKER OLD WOMAN
Buyers land in three hours.

TRAFFICKER BOSS
Then we deliver quality.

He examines XIAO YA's face as she loses consciousness. Two HENCHMEN drag her away.

EXT. LUXURY MANSION - NIGHT

A Rolls-Royce stops at mansion steps. BODYGUARDS block REPORTERS.

YUN ZHENHAI (70s, silk suit) sits in the wheelchair, pushed by MO HANBING (30s, calm). His son XIN ZICHEN and bodyguard ALI follow.

REPORTER
Mr. Yun! Xiao Ya Zhang's mother
says police are demanding bribes.
Your foundation promised action.

YUN ZHENHAI
(smiling)
We donated five million to the
anti-trafficking unit. Trust the
professionals.

REPORTERS
Mr. Yun! Mr. Yun!

BODYGUARDS block them. Yun Zhenhai is helped into the mansion. The door closes.
continuation:
INT. MODEST HOME - NIGHT

XIAO YA'S MOTHER (40s, calloused hands) stares at her phone. XIAO YA'S FATHER (45s) sits at the table, a bottle between them.

XIAO YA'S MOTHER
You told her she was your greatest
disappointment.

XIAO YA'S FATHER
I told her to respect her curfew.

XIAO YA'S MOTHER
(angrily)
She's missing because of you!

She kicks the table over. Food spills. XIAO YA'S FATHER jumps back.

XIAO YA'S MOTHER
(grabbing his collar)
If you'd been a father—

XIAO YA'S FATHER
(pushing her away)
Breaking things won't bring her back!

XIAO YA'S MOTHER
(furious)
Waiting will?

She picks up a photo of XIAO YA holding a martial arts trophy.

XIAO YA'S MOTHER
Police want money. I want my
daughter.

She straps a knife sheath to her ankle.

XIAO YA'S MOTHER
You wait. I'm going to find the
people who actually know.

She pulls on a leather jacket: "IRON FIST GYM."

XIAO YA'S MOTHER
Don't follow me.

She walks out. The door hangs open.

XIAO YA'S FATHER looks at the photo. Pours out the wine.

INT. UNKNOWN LOCATION - NIGHT

XIAO YA wakes, bound to a chair. Across the room, GIRLS sit in cages.

The TRAFFICKER OLD WOMAN enters with a bowl of congee.

TRAFFICKER OLD WOMAN
Eat. Buyers pay more for healthy.

XIAO YA
(weak)
My mother will find me.

TRAFFICKER OLD WOMAN
(amused)
They all say that.

She tries to feed her. XIAO YA turns away.

TRAFFICKER OLD WOMAN
(sighs)
Stubborn ones cost us profit.

She leaves. XIAO YA works at her ropes.

Through a crack: moonlight. And footsteps. Running.

FADE TO BLACK.

title: Time in the Galaxy
description: A young female doctor's life changes forever after a fateful night when she saves a mysterious man, leading to a case of mistaken identity.
context:
Title: Time in the Galaxy
Description: A young female doctor's life changes forever after a fateful night when she saves a mysterious man, leading to a case of mistaken identity.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

CLOSE-UP - XIA SHIGUANG's trembling hands buttoning her blouse.

XIA SHIGUANG (20s, dedicated but exhausted) finishes adjusting her vintage white blouse beneath a practical jumper dress. She stares at a small JADE NECKLACE on the bedside table—its surface seems to shimmer with an faint, otherworldly light. Her expression is a storm of shame, anger, and confusion.

XIA SHIGUANG
(whispered mantra)
Just a bad shift. Bad shifts end.

CUT TO: A white bedsheet with a small red bloodstain. The jade necklace lies beside it.

XIA SHIGUANG snatches up her lab coat, shoving the necklace deep into its pocket.

XIE JINROU (30s, polished, ambitious) strides in wearing designer heels and a sequined jacket, immediately checking her reflection in a glass cabinet.

XIE JINROU
Without turning
Xia Shiguang. Tell me you didn't burn the place down covering my shift.

XIA SHIGUANG
Forces a smile, voice steady
All patients survived. Some even thrived.

XIE JINROU
Finally looks at her, smiles sharply
That's why I always pick you. Reliable, invisible, and too broke to say no.

Xie Jinrou pats her shoulder and exits.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - 8 HOURS EARLIER - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

The emergency lights cast a crimson emergency glow.

XIA SHIGUANG
Spinning at a sound
Who's there?

FU SHIYAN (30s, sharp features, blood soaking through his shirt) stumbles through the door, clutching his chest. A strange pattern glows faintly beneath his skin.

FU SHIYAN
Delirious
The poison... it's accelerating...

He collapses forward. Xia Shiguang catches him. They fall backward onto the bed.

XIA SHIGUANG
Struggling under his weight
Get off! You're bleeding—

FU SHIYAN
Face inches from hers, eyes unfocused
You stopped the spread. In my family, that means you're bound to me now.

His hand finds hers. He presses the jade necklace into her palm.

FU SHIYAN
Whispering
Find me before the clock resets.

He passes out. A single tear escapes Xia Shiguang's eye as she stares at the impossible object.

END FLASHBACK.
continuation:
INT. FU FAMILY RESIDENCE - NIGHT

FU SHIYAN sits in a candlelit study, still in his bloodstained shirt. He studies a HOLOGRAPHIC DISPLAY of a DNA helix spiraling backwards.

FU SHIYAN (V.O.)
Find me before the clock resets.

FU SHIYAN
To ZHAO QI (40s, loyal, weary)
The toxin temporarily unbound my chronosomes. I couldn't see her face clearly, but I left her the resonator.

ZHAO QI
The jade necklace, sir? That hasn't been activated in three generations.

FU SHIYAN
Standing, determined
If she saved me, she's entangled now. Find the resonator's signature. Whoever holds it isn't just my savior—she's the key to stabilizing my timeline. And my mother's dying wish.

ZHAO QI
Bows
I'll retrieve her immediately.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Xie Jinrou strips the bed, finds the bloodstain. Her eyes narrow.

XIE JINROU
Calling out
Shiguang? Why does this sheet look like a crime scene?

XIA SHIGUANG
Enters, sees the stain, pales
Patient complication. I handled it.

XIE JINROU
Reaches under the pillow, finds the necklace
With jewelry?

XIA SHIGUANG
Lunges for it
That's mine!

XIE JINROU
Holds it up; the jade pulses faintly
Funny. This looks like something that belongs in a museum. Or a black market auction.

A memory flash: FU SHIYAN's hand pressing the necklace into hers.

FU SHIYAN (V.O.)
Find me.

XIA SHIGUANG
Voice hard
It's worthless. A trinket from a patient who couldn't pay.

XIA SHIGUANG
Turns away
Keep it. I don't want reminders.

XIE JINROU
Voice sweet, eyes calculating
Did you break protocol last night, little orphan?

XIA SHIGUANG
Flustered, grabbing her bag
My internship ends in six hours. I need to make rent.

She bolts.

XIE JINROU
Examines the pulsing jade
Oh, this is worth way more than rent.

She loops the necklace around her neck. The jade flares, then dims.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Xia Shiguang runs face-first into ZHAO QI and BODYGUARDS. Their SCANNER DEVICES immediately beep in unison, all pointing toward the ward she just left.

ZHAO QI
To his team
Resonator locked. Room 407.

Xia Shiguang presses against the wall, holding her breath.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Xie Jinrou, now wearing a lab coat over her camisole, touches the necklace. Her eyes widen as alien symbols briefly flicker across the jade surface.

ZHAO QI enters. The scanner stops beeping.

ZHAO QI
Bows deeply
The chronosignature matches. Young mistress.

XIE JINROU
Freezes, then a slow smile spreads
I think you have the right doctor.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED
