title: Misplaced Life
description: A young woman discovers she is the long-lost heiress of a wealthy family, forcing her to leave behind her simple life and her boyfriend.
context:
Title: Misplaced Life
Description: A young woman discovers she is the long-lost heiress of a wealthy family, forcing her to leave behind her simple life and her boyfriend.

INT. JIANG FAMILY GARDEN - DAY

MR. JIANG paces beside a koi pond, phone pressed to his ear. His knuckles whiten around the device.

MR. JIANG
You're certain? No mistakes?

UNCLE JIANG (V.O.)
The pendant matches. The DNA is conclusive. But Mr. Jiang, we must proceed carefully. The media cannot know yet.

MR. JIANG
Then bring her home. Before anyone else finds her.

He ends the call, staring at the water as if it holds answers.

INT. XIA YAO'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The room smells of medicinal herbs. XIA YAO'S GRANDFATHER (70s, kind-eyed but frail) hums as he arranges tea cups. LIN YAN (25, pretty but tired) helps, her sleeve slipping to reveal a faint bruise on her wrist. She quickly pulls it down.

ZHAO XINGZE (26, earnest mechanic's hands) stands by the window, his duffel bag packed.

The door opens. XIA YAO (24, bright but worn) enters, water delivery uniform damp with sweat, a genuine smile for ZHAO XINGZE.

XIA YAO
Caught the last delivery. Almost missed you.

ZHAO XINGZE
You always cut it close.

He crosses to her, wipes sweat from her temple with a calloused thumb. She leans into the touch.

ZHAO XINGZE
(softly)
Six months. Then I'm back for good. No running off with some rich city boy while I'm gone.

He kisses her forehead, a promise. She grabs his hand, pressing something into his palm.

XIA YAO
Your lucky charm. Now it's got my warranty.

He opens his hand to find her pendant necklace. His expression shifts—protest and love warring.

ZHAO XINGZE
Xia Yao—

XIA YAO
—will be right here. Waiting.
continuation:
INT. CEO JIANG'S OFFICE - DAY

Floor-to-ceiling windows overlook Qingcheng's skyline. CEO JIANG (30, sharp suit, sharper eyes) studies a file. His assistant, MS. WU, waits with perfect posture.

CEO JIANG
The pendant. You're positive it's mother's?

MS. WU
The engraving matches the archive photos. The girl's adoption record shows she was found at a train station twenty-three years ago. Same date.

CEO JIANG
(flipping a photo)
And Xingze?

MS. WU
His overseas training begins tomorrow. As requested, he believes it's a career opportunity. Completely funded.

CEO JIANG
Make sure it's a good program.

MS. WU
Sir, if I may... sending him away could complicate things.

CEO JIANG
She'll need space to adjust.

He touches the photo: XIA YAO laughing at something off-camera, pendant glinting at her throat.

INSERT - FLASHBACK

XIA YAO catches CEO JIANG as he stumbles on icy steps. For a heartbeat, their faces inches apart, her pendant swinging between them. Recognition flickers in his eyes before she hurries away.

BACK TO SCENE

CEO JIANG gently closes the file.

CEO JIANG
Bring the car around. We'll go ourselves.

INT. XIA YAO'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

XIA YAO massages her grandfather's shoulders as LIN YAN clears cups.

XIA YAO'S GRANDFATHER
A prestigious degree, and you're stuck here with an old man. I hold you back.

XIA YAO
Grandpa, don't. You didn't hold me back. You held me together.

Lin Yan's father shouts outside. Lin Yan flinches, spilling tea. XIA YAO catches her wrist—the bruises darker now, fingerprint-sized.

XIA YAO
(quiet fury)
He did it again.

LIN YAN
It's nothing. I'll outlast him.

XIA YAO
Or I'll outmatch him. Want me to talk to him?

LIN YAN
No! It'll just make—

A KNOCK cuts through. Three sharp raps.

The door opens before anyone moves. UNCLE JIANG (60s, impeccable suit, weathered hands) stands in the hallway, his presence like an expensive ghost.

UNCLE JIANG
Young Miss Xia.

He scans the humble room without judgment, gaze settling on XIA YAO like finding a missing constellation.

UNCLE JIANG
My name is Jiang Cheng. I held you when you were three days old. You wore this.

He extends his palm. The pendant—identical to the one XIA YAO just gave ZHAO XINGZE—catches the light.

XIA YAO
(steps back)
That's... mine.

UNCLE JIANG
It belongs to the Jiang family of Qingcheng. As do you. The DNA results arrived this morning.

He produces an envelope. Her name typed. Official. Final.

UNCLE JIANG
Your grandfather knows. He has the adoption papers. We never stopped searching.

XIA YAO'S GRANDFATHER closes his eyes. A tear escapes.

XIA YAO looks between them—the bruise on Lin Yan's arm, her grandfather's silent confirmation, the pendant's impossible twin.

Her fingers find the empty space at her throat where her own pendant used to rest.

He opens his hand to find her pendant necklace. His expression shifts—protest and love warring.

ZHAO XINGZE
Xia Yao—

XIA YAO
—will be right here. Waiting.

INT. CEO JIANG'S OFFICE - DAY

Floor-to-ceiling windows overlook Qingcheng's skyline. CEO JIANG (30, sharp suit, sharper eyes) studies a file. His assistant, MS. WU, waits with perfect posture.

CEO JIANG
The pendant. You're positive it's mother's?

MS. WU
The engraving matches the archive photos. The girl's adoption record shows she was found at a train station twenty-three years ago. Same date.

CEO JIANG
(flipping a photo)
And Xingze?

MS. WU
His overseas training begins tomorrow. As requested, he believes it's a career opportunity. Completely funded.

CEO JIANG
Make sure it's a good program.

MS. WU
Sir, if I may... sending him away could complicate things.

CEO JIANG
She'll need space to adjust.

He touches the photo: XIA YAO laughing at something off-camera, pendant glinting at her throat.

INSERT - FLASHBACK

XIA YAO catches CEO JIANG as he stumbles on icy steps. For a heartbeat, their faces inches apart, her pendant swinging between them. Recognition flickers in his eyes before she hurries away.

BACK TO SCENE

CEO JIANG gently closes the file.

CEO JIANG
Bring the car around. We'll go ourselves.

INT. XIA YAO'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

XIA YAO massages her grandfather's shoulders as LIN YAN clears cups.

XIA YAO'S GRANDFATHER
A prestigious degree, and you're stuck here with an old man. I hold you back.

XIA YAO

Lin Yan's father shouts outside. Lin Yan flinches, spilling tea. XIA YAO catches her wrist—the bruises darker now, fingerprint-sized.

XIA YAO
(quiet fury)
He did it again.

LIN YAN
It's nothing. I'll outlast him.

XIA YAO
Or I'll outmatch him. Want me to talk to him?

LIN YAN
No! It'll just make—

A KNOCK cuts through. Three sharp raps.

The door opens before anyone moves. UNCLE JIANG (60s, impeccable suit, weathered hands) stands in the hallway, his presence like an expensive ghost.

UNCLE JIANG
Young Miss Xia.

He scans the humble room without judgment, gaze settling on XIA YAO like finding a missing constellation.

UNCLE JIANG
My name is Jiang Cheng. I held you when you were three days old. You wore this.

He extends his palm. The pendant—identical to the one XIA YAO just gave ZHAO XINGZE—catches the light.

XIA YAO
(steps back)
That's... mine.

UNCLE JIANG
It belongs to the Jiang family of Qingcheng. As do you. The DNA results arrived this morning.

He produces an envelope. Her name typed. Official. Final.

UNCLE JIANG
Your grandfather knows. He has the adoption papers. We never stopped searching.

XIA YAO'S GRANDFATHER closes his eyes. A tear escapes.

XIA YAO looks between them—the bruise on Lin Yan's arm, her grandfather's silent confirmation, the pendant's impossible twin.

Her fingers find the empty space at her throat where her own pendant used to rest.

title: Mistaking Oneself for the Protagonist
description: A wealthy CEO who funded a village girl's education through a poverty relief program is surprised years later when she assumes they have a close personal relationship.
context:
Title: Mistaking Oneself for the Protagonist
Description: A wealthy CEO who funded a village girl's education through a poverty relief program is surprised years later when she assumes they have a close personal relationship.

INT. RURAL VILLAGE ROAD - DAY

Firecrackers POP in the distance. A red banner hangs crooked: "Mingshi Group Poverty Relief Foundation."

LI HONG
Chairman Chen, welcome. The whole village is grateful.

CHEN MING
Just doing what should be done, Village Chief.

The VILLAGERS murmur appreciatively. Distant SHOUTS cut through the polite applause.

FANG SHUIMING (O.S.)
Get back here!

FANG SHUIMING storms through the crowd, dragging his struggling daughter FANG YAOYAO by the wrist. Her shirt sleeve is torn.

FANG SHUIMING
You'll work in the factory like your cousins! No more school!

LIU LIFANG
Don't let her shame the family!

FANG YAOYAO
(pleading)
Dad, please—

FANG SHUIMING raises his hand. CHEN MING steps forward, but his SECRETARY ZHOU LIANG intervenes first.

ZHOU LIANG
That's enough! Mingshi Foundation will cover her tuition.

FANG SHUIMING
Who're you to—

LI HONG
(restraining him)
Old Fang, the Foundation is offering! Take it!

The VILLAGERS pull him back. Yaoyao looks up—not at Zhou, but past him to Chen Ming. Their eyes meet for one second.

CHEN MING
(to Zhou)
Document it. Standard procedure.

Chen turns away, already checking his phone. Yaoyao watches him go.

FANG YAOYAO
(whispering)
Thank you...

She clutches the crumpled scholarship letter Zhou handed her. The letterhead reads: "Mingshi Group Foundation."

TRANSITION: FIVE YEARS LATER
continuation:
EXT. UNIVERSITY PLAZA - DAY

CAPS fly into the air. FANG YAOYAO stands with SHEN BINGBING and ZHAO NANA in graduation gowns.

ZHAO NANA
Thirty applications. Zero callbacks.

SHEN BINGBING
We majored in the wrong thing. No connections, no jobs.

FANG YAOYAO
I might have an option. Mingshi Group.

SHEN BINGBING
The Mingshi Group? How?

FANG YAOYAO
They've... kept in touch. Sort of.

She pulls out her phone—screenshot of an annual foundation newsletter, Chen Ming's photo circled. Another screenshot: a form letter signed by his automated signature.

ZHAO NANA
You've met the chairman?

FANG YAOYAO
He came to my village. He stopped my father from... It was personal.

(off their doubt)
He signs every letter himself. Look.

She scrolls to a text thread: "Foundation: Happy Birthday Yaoyao! -CM" Auto-sent.

FANG YAOYAO
(quietly, to herself)
He wouldn't keep supporting me if I was just a number. Would he?

EXT. CHAIRMAN'S OFFICE - DAY

CHEN MING walks with SUN QIAN, reviewing contracts.

CHEN MING
If Wang signs today, we're cleared for IPO.

His phone BUZZES. Unknown number. He almost declines it, then—

FANG YAOYAO (V.O.)
(filtered, nervous)
Hello? Is this... is this Chairman Chen?

CHEN MING
Who's calling?

INTERCUT:

FANG YAOYAO
It's Yaoyao. Fang Yaoyao. From the Qingyuan Village program. I... graduated today. You said to call when—

CHEN MING
Program? Which department is this?

FANG YAOYAO
(beat)
The one you personally saved. Five years ago. In my village.

Chen mouths to Sun: "Who is Fang Yaoyao?" Sun shrugs, checks a tablet.

SUN QIAN
(quietly)
Foundation has six hundred active scholars, Chairman.

CHEN MING
(into phone)
Miss Fang, I'm glad you graduated. But our Foundation handles all employment inquiries. Zhou Liang's team will—

FANG YAOYAO
No, I mean... you promised I'd work for you. Directly. I thought—

CHEN MING
I'm afraid there's been a misunderstanding.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Phoenix Glory
description: A concubine's ten-year plan for power is shattered when her newborn prince is replaced with a dead cat by a jealous empress, leading to her imprisonment and the loss of her child.
context:
Title: Phoenix Glory
Description: A concubine's ten-year plan for power is shattered when her newborn prince is replaced with a dead cat by a jealous empress, leading to her imprisonment and the loss of her child.

INT. BOUDOIR - DAY

SHEN FENGYI, dressed in luxurious robes, sits at her vanity. Her reflection reveals a woman carrying the weight of years. Her maid, MINGZHU, fastens a jade hairpin with trembling hands.

MINGZHU
(softly)
The sedan from Prince Qi's mansion waits. Third time this month.

SHEN FENGYI rises silently and kneels before her family's ancestral tablets. Her kowtow is slow, deliberate.

SHEN FENGYI
(whispering)
Forgive me.

She touches the faded silk pouch hanging from her waist—tucked inside, a childhood betrothal token, now scratched and worn.

MINGZHU
(noticing the gesture)
All these years... was it for this?

SHEN FENGYI
(thumb rubbing the token)
A woman can be replaced. An empress cannot.

MINGZHU
(horrified realization)
Miss...

SHEN FENGYI
Imperial favor is a knife held by someone else's hand.

INT. DELIVERY ROOM - NIGHT

Lightning illuminates the chamber. SHEN FENGYI's knuckles are white against the bedposts. Rain hammers the roof like accusations.

MIDWIFE
(strained)
One more push, Consort!

SHEN FENGYI
(scream)

The cry of a newborn cuts through the storm. The MIDWIFE's face floods with relief—then terror as she sees the silhouette outside.

Through the window: FENG ZHUOHUA stands beneath an umbrella, a LIVE BLACK CAT cradiled in her arms. She makes a swift slicing gesture across her throat. The MIDWIFE's own teenage daughter is held by one of Feng's attendants—a silent threat.

MIDWIFE
(hand shaking)
A... a prince...

FENG ZHUOHUA enters, rainwater pooling at her feet. She strokes the cat as it hisses.

FENG ZHUOHUA
(coldly)
The Emperor's first son must come from the Empress's body.

MIDWIFE
Your Highness, please—

FENG ZHUOHUA snaps the cat's neck. The crack is drowned by thunder.

FENG ZHUOHUA
Wrap it.

The MIDWIFE's hands tremble violently as she swaddles the dead animal.
continuation:
INT. DELIVERY ROOM - LATER

EMPEROR MU NINGYUAN enters, his face unreadable. He smells of incense and war council.

MU NINGYUAN
Where is my son?

ALL
Your Majesty.

SHEN FENGYI
(weakly, reaching)
Your Majesty... he's...

A MAID presents the swaddled bundle. MU NINGYUAN unfolds it. The dead cat's eyes stare upward.

MU NINGYUAN
(quiet, dangerous)
Explain.

MAID
(kowtowing, terrified)
The Consort... she screamed... when we looked, it was...

EUNUCH LIU
(stepping forward smoothly)
Your Majesty, the astrologers warned of dark stars aligning. Some women, when consumed by ambition, birth abominations.

MU NINGYUAN's jaw tightens. He looks at SHEN FENGYI—not with fury, but disappointment tinged with something else. Fear?

MU NINGYUAN
(to Shen)
Did you truly think I wouldn't know?

SHEN FENGYI
(confused, horrified)
Know what? Your Majesty, this isn't—

He throws the cat. It lands with a sickening thud. SHEN FENGYI crawls to it, her mind breaking.

SHEN FENGYI
(screaming)
No! NO! I felt him! I felt his heart!

MU NINGYUAN
(to guards)
Cold Palace. Forever.

SHEN FENGYI clutches his leg, her nails drawing blood.

SHEN FENGYI
The Empress—she was here! Check her sleeves! Check her hands!

MU NINGYUAN shakes her off, but his eyes flicker. A sliver of doubt.

MU NINGYUAN
(to Feng Zhuohua, low)
You were right. She is deranged.

He exits. FENG ZHUOHUA waits until his footsteps fade. Then she crouches, her perfume choking.

FENG ZHUOHUA
(whispering)
Childhood sweethearts? He told me your ambition disgusts him. That you seduced him with potions.

SHEN FENGYI
(spitting blood)
Where is he?

FENG ZHUOHUA
(clapping once)
Bring the "stillborn."

A EUNUCH enters with the real prince—the baby is quiet, eyes open.

SHEN FENGYI
(lunging, held back by guards)
Give him to me!

FENG ZHUOHUA
(gripping Shen's face)
Every favor you ever received was him pitying you. This child will call me mother. He will erase you.

She stands, smoothing her robes.

FENG ZHUOHUA
Take it to the south tower. Let the ravens finish what the cat started.

The EUNUCH turns. The baby makes a sound—a small coo.

SHEN FENGYI's scream is no longer human. It is the sound of a woman becoming something else entirely.

title: The Koi Family
description: A young woman faces debt collectors threatening her family after her mother became a guarantor for a loan that defaulted.
context:
Title: The Koi Family
Description: A young woman faces debt collectors threatening her family after her mother became a guarantor for a loan that defaulted.

INT. STREET - DAY

LI JING walks down the street, holding a resume, looking dejected.

INTERVIEWER (V.O.)
Sorry, your qualifications don't meet our requirements. Please go back.

LI JING looks at the resume in her hand and sighs.

LI JING
(to herself)
Sigh, failed again. How many companies is this now?

Her phone rings. LI JING takes it out of her pocket and answers.

LI JING
Hello, Mom.

LI JING listens to the phone, her expression suddenly changing. She clutches the nearest wall.

LI JING
What? Don't panic, I'll be right back!

INT. LI JING'S HOUSE - DAY

Several DEBT COLLECTORS are beating LI QIANGLIN, who is lying on the ground. LI JING'S MOTHER is crying and trying to stop them.

LI JING'S MOTHER
Stop it, stop it! My sister is bringing the money!

DEBT COLLECTOR #1
(consulting his phone)
Guarantor Li Shuqin. No more stories.

LI JING rushes up the stairs and runs into the house.

LI JING
What are you doing!

LI JING rushes over to help her parents up.

LI JING
(to the debt collectors)
My mom isn't the one who owes you money! The debtor ran away, go find the person who owes the debt, why are you making trouble at our house!

DEBT COLLECTOR #1
Who told your mom to be the guarantor? Now he's run away, who else should we ask if not you?

DEBT COLLECTOR #2
Cut the crap, hurry up and pay back the five hundred thousand! The brothers are waiting to celebrate New Year!

DEBT COLLECTOR #1
(to his accomplices)
Brothers, go!

A woman's voice comes from the doorway.

WU XIUMEI
What's going on here?

WU XIUMEI and her daughter WANG MENG walk in.

WU XIUMEI
No matter how much trouble you make, there's no money to collect. Listen to me, go back first. I guarantee you'll receive the money tomorrow.

DEBT COLLECTOR #1
(pointing at WU XIUMEI)
Wu Xiumei, right? I know you. If I don't receive the money tomorrow, I'll come find you!

WU XIUMEI
(confidently)
Oh, don't worry about it.

The DEBT COLLECTOR leaves with his men.
continuation:
INT. LI JING'S HOUSE - LATER

The family sits on the sofa. WU XIUMEI and WANG MENG are also there.

LI JING'S MOTHER
Xiumei, thank you so much for today.

WU XIUMEI takes out a document from her bag and hands it over.

WU XIUMEI
Hurry up and sign it.

The document reads "Property Transfer Contract."

LI JING
(surprised)
Auntie, Dad, this...

LI QIANGLIN
(painfully)
This is... I agreed to let your mom and your aunt handle it.

LI QIANGLIN takes the contract and flips through it, his expression changing.

LI QIANGLIN
Didn't we agree on five hundred thousand? How did it become two hundred thousand?

WU XIUMEI
I had someone else appraise it for you. This is only worth two hundred thousand.

WU XIUMEI
(impatiently)
Are you going to sign or not?

LI QIANGLIN hesitates, picks up the pen, and prepares to sign.

LI QIANGLIN
I'll sign.

LI JING presses down on her father's hand.

LI JING
Don't sign. She's the one who introduced Mom to that investor.

title: Dragon Suppressor
description: A man killed by a loan shark is reborn after a thousand years of cultivation in the immortal realm, returning to the day before his daughter's death to change his family's tragic fate.
context:
Title: Dragon Suppressor
Description: A man killed by a loan shark is reborn after a thousand years of cultivation in the immortal realm, returning to the day before his daughter's death to change his family's tragic fate.

INT. SHABBY APARTMENT - DAY

YE CHEN lies on the floor, his head pinned under YOUNG MASTER XIAO's leather shoe.

YOUNG MASTER XIAO
Had enough, Ye Chen?

XIAO XIAO peeks from behind a sewing machine. She darts out, hugging Xiao's leg.

XIAO XIAO
Don't hurt Daddy!

YE CHEN
(struggling)
Xiao Xiao, run!

YOUNG MASTER XIAO
(to XIAO XIAO)
Your father owes two million. You're both mine now. Feng—get rid of her.

HENCHMAN
Yes, sir.

XIAO XIAO
No!

YE CHEN
Xiao Xiao, get back!

The HENCHMAN grabs XIAO XIAO. MENG WEI bursts through the door.

MENG WEI
(terrified)
Xiao Xiao!

She lunges, tearing XIAO XIAO from the henchman's grip. They collapse together.

YE CHEN
Meng Wei!

MENG WEI
(crawling toward YOUNG MASTER XIAO)
Please... let my daughter go. I'll pay you.

YOUNG MASTER XIAO
(sneering)
With what? He sold you to me. Take her to the back room.

MENG WEI
(being grabbed)
No! Xiao Xiao!

YOUNG MASTER XIAO
(to henchmen)
Hold him.

They restrain YE CHEN. YOUNG MASTER XIAO backhands XIAO XIAO. She crumples, her temple striking the table edge. Blood pools.

YE CHEN
(anguished)
Xiao Xiao...

MENG WEI
(scrambling)
Baby... wake up...

YOUNG MASTER XIAO
(grabbing MENG WEI's hair)
She's useless now. But you're still mine.

MENG WEI
Let me go!

YE CHEN
(roaring)
I'LL KILL YOU!

HENCHMEN force him to his knees. YOUNG MASTER XIAO leans close.

YOUNG MASTER XIAO
(quietly)
You were dead the moment you took my loan. Every card, every bet—I dealt them. Die knowing you never had a chance.

The HENCHMAN raises a crowbar.
continuation:
INT. SHABBY APARTMENT - DAY (AFTER REBIRTH)

YE CHEN jolts awake on the sofa, gasping. He touches his unscarred neck.

YE CHEN
(to himself)
A dream?

YE CHEN (V.O.)
Death. Rebirth. A thousand years cultivating in the immortal realm. Yet this memory still bleeds.

YE CHEN notices movement. XIAO XIAO peeks from behind the door, a faint bruise on her cheek.

YE CHEN
Xiao Xiao?

She runs into his arms. He freezes, then slowly enfolds her.

XIAO XIAO
Daddy...

She tilts her head up, revealing the bruise.

XIAO XIAO
(whispering)
I didn't mean to cry last night. Please don't be angry.

YE CHEN
(stunned, touching the mark)
Xiao Xiao... this is real. I've come back.

XIAO XIAO
(confused)
Back?

YE CHEN
(firmly)
No one will hurt you again. Not while I breathe.

His eyes flash with ancient power, determination setting like stone.

title: The Seventh Son of the Northern King
description: After three years of brutal war, the youngest son of the Northern King emerges as the sole survivor of his family and a legendary warrior who turned the tide of battle.
context:
Title: The Seventh Son of the Northern King
Description: After three years of brutal war, the youngest son of the Northern King emerges as the sole survivor of his family and a legendary warrior who turned the tide of battle.

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

A scorched wasteland. Smoldering siege towers leak black smoke. Rain hammers down on a field of corpses. The Wu banners, soaked and tattered, flutter like dying birds.

Through the downpour, QIN CHUAN (25), silver-white armor dented and bloodstained, fights THREE ENEMY SOLDIERS. His movements are economical, brutal. He kills them, then stumbles against a broken war chariot.

He rips off his helmet. His face is hollow, eyes staring at the carnage. On his chest plate, six identical family crests are etched beside his own - each one scarred by a blade strike.

A WHITE HORSE nuzzles his shoulder. He mounts, gripping a bloodied spear.

QIN CHUAN
(voice raw)
I am all that remains.

His army - what's left of it - gathers behind him. Wounded, exhausted, but alive.

QIN CHUAN
(shouting)
For the fallen!

WU GENERAL
For the fallen!

SOLDIERS
(weak chorus)
For the fallen!

Qin Chuan raises his spear. The setting sun breaks through the storm, casting his shadow across the field of dead.
continuation:
INT. IMPERIAL PALACE THRONE ROOM - DAY

Silence. The EMPEROR (60s), jade crown gleaming, reads a bamboo scroll. His face betrays nothing.

EUNUCH CAO (50s), gaunt and watchful, stands beside the PRINCESS (22), who clutches her silk sleeves.

EMPEROR OF GREAT WU
The Northern King's bloodline... extinguished. All but one.

EUNUCH CAO
A heavy price, Your Majesty. But victory is ours.

PRINCESS
(finding her voice)
Father. Qin Chuan saved Great Wu. We must honor that.

EMPEROR OF GREAT WU
(studying his daughter)
Honor must be measured carefully. Power even more so.

GUARD (O.S.)
Your Majesty, Qin Chuan requests an audience.

A beat. The Emperor rolls the victory scroll shut.

EMPEROR OF GREAT WU
Let him come. Let us see what the war has left us.

EUNUCH CAO
(loudly)
Summon Qin Chuan!

EXT. BATTLEFIELD - DAY

Qin Chuan's horse picks its way through the dead. He stops at the body of the ENEMY GENERAL, still clutching a broken standard.

Fingers trembling, he pries a jade pendant from the dead man's hand. Six identical pendants already hang at his belt.

He doesn't look back.

INT. IMPERIAL PALACE THRONE ROOM - DAY

The doors open. Qin Chuan enters, still in his battle armor, the pouch at his belt. His boots leave mud on the polished marble. Blood and rain drip from his spear.

The Princess takes a step forward, then stops. The Emperor's eyes narrow at the pouch, the six crests on Qin Chuan's armor.

Qin Chuan meets the Emperor's gaze. No joy. No pride. Only the weight of what he carries.

The throne room feels very far from the battlefield. And yet, the war is not done with any of them.

title: Elder Brother as Father
description: A young boy desperately tries to find a home for his sister after their parents' death, flashing back to a tragic family dinner one month prior.
context:
Title: Elder Brother as Father
Description: A young boy desperately tries to find a home for his sister after their parents' death, flashing back to a tragic family dinner one month prior.

EXT. COUNTRY ROAD - DAY

CHEN DACHUN and CHEN WENWEN kneel before a silver sedan, kowtowing to a well-dressed MAN and WOMAN loading luggage.

CHEN DACHUN
(voice cracking)
She's all I have left. I can't keep her safe anymore.

MAN
Jesus Christ... stand up, kid. We're not—where are your relatives?

CHEN DACHUN
Dead. All of them. Please. She'll be no trouble.

WOMAN
(softening)
How old are you?

CHEN DACHUN
Twelve. Too young to work. Too young to be her father.

The woman crouches, studying Wenwen's face. Dachun pulls a small locket from his pocket.

CHEN DACHUN
(continuing)
This is our mother's. So she won't forget.

He presses the locket into Wenwen's palm, forcing her fingers closed.

CUT TO:

Black screen with white text: ONE MONTH AGO

EXT. FARMHOUSE COURTYARD - NIGHT

Fireflies drift through twilight. CHEN DACHUN helps his younger siblings—CHEN BIN and CHEN XIAOYUN—catch them in jars.

MOTHER (O.S.)
Dachun! Bring them in. The chicken's getting cold.

CHEN DACHUN
Last one, Mom!

He lets the firefly go. The children sprint inside.
continuation:
INT. FARMHOUSE - NIGHT

Oil lamp light flickers across a modest feast—vegetables, peanuts, and one steamed chicken. FATHER bounces CHEN XIAOYUN on his knee.

CHEN XIAOYUN
Mom only cooks chicken on special days! I want the drumstick.

CHEN BIN
Me too! I called it first!

CHEN DACHUN
(cutting calmly)
Drumsticks go to the youngest. That's the rule.

FATHER winks at Dachun, mouthing "good man."

MOTHER
Dachun, you're the oldest. You know what everyone needs.

CHEN DACHUN
Yes, Mom.

He tears the drumsticks, placing them on Bin and Xiaoyun's bowls.

CHEN DACHUN
(to CHEN WENWEN)
Second sister?

CHEN WENWEN
The wing tip. It has the best flavor. Mom always says so.

Dachun smiles, separating the wing tips for his parents' bowls.

CHEN DACHUN
Here. The best parts.

FATHER
You eat them. Dad's happy with peanuts.

MOTHER
And Mom loves vegetables. You eat.

CHEN DACHUN
(lowering his voice)
Please. I divided them already.

FATHER's eyes glisten. He squeezes MOTHER's hand.

FATHER
Our boy's growing up too fast.

MOTHER winces, touching her temple briefly, but forces a smile.

MOTHER
Then let's eat before it gets cold.

They raise their chopsticks. MOTHER sways. Her bowl slips.

FATHER
Wife?

She seizes, chair tipping back, and crashes to the floor.

CHEN WENWEN
Mom!

FATHER catches her head, shouting toward the door.

FATHER
Dachun—get Doctor Li! Now!

Dachun freezes, staring at MOTHER's pale face. Wenwen yanks his arm.

CHEN WENWEN
Go!

He bolts out the door. The remaining children collapse around MOTHER, wailing.

CUT TO:

EXT. FARMHOUSE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS)

Dachun sprints down the dirt path, clutching the chicken wing he grabbed from MOTHER's bowl. His shadow stretches long under the moonlight.

FATHER (V.O.)
You eat, you eat.

The wing trembles in his fist. He runs faster, tears flying behind him.

title: The Princess Above All
description: During a selection for palace guards at the Princess's manor, a mysterious candidate protects the Princess from an assassination attempt, earning her special favor.
context:
Title: The Princess Above All
Description: During a selection for palace guards at the Princess's manor, a mysterious candidate protects the Princess from an assassination attempt, earning her special favor.

INT. PRINCESS'S MANOR - DAY

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Princess's manor is selecting guards. If you are chosen, you will surely rise to great heights in the future.

A group of men stand or sit around. Several are shirtless. The HEAD MAID is inspecting a muscular man.

HEAD MAID
Excellent musculature, acceptable composition. Grade A.

The HEAD MAID walks toward another sturdy man.

HEAD MAID
Strong frame, but undistinguished bearing. Grade B.

The camera shifts to two HANDMAIDENS whispering behind the PRINCESS.

HANDMAIDEN A
The Princess isn't selecting guards at all, she's clearly selecting—

HANDMAIDEN B
(interrupting)
Hush! Do you want to join the dungeons?

The HEAD MAID walks up to GU XUANQING.

HEAD MAID
Unsheathe yourself.

GU XUANQING
Shouldn't a guard's worth be measured by combat skill, not appearance?

HEAD MAID
(inspecting her nails)
The Princess requires discipline. Refuse, and you forfeit your chance.

SHEN ZIJUN
(eagerly stepping forward)
Head Maid, permit me. This stranger clearly lacks proper instruction.

The HEAD MAID shoves SHEN ZIJUN aside, her gaze fixed on GU XUANQING.

HEAD MAID
Last warning. Strip or depart. Disobedience is a luxury we don't permit.

PRINCESS
(languidly)
What discord is this?

The PRINCESS rises and slowly walks toward the group. Everyone immediately bows.

ALL
Princess.
continuation:
INT. IMPERIAL PALACE - DAY

A EUNUCH reports to the EMPEROR.

EUNUCH
Your Majesty.

EMPEROR
Have our gifts been delivered to my dear sister's 'selection'?

EUNUCH
Precisely as commanded. The assassin blends with the candidates.

EMPEROR
Let us see how Li Yunzhen handles her own poisons.

INT. PRINCESS'S MANOR - DAY

HEAD MAID
Princess, please resume your leisure. This servant will conclude these formalities.

A candidate guard (ASSASSIN) suddenly upends a ceremonial basin, water splashing across marble as he extracts a blade from its sealed base.

ASSASSIN
(shouting)
Li Yunzhen! Your hands are stained with loyal blood! Today you face justice!

The ASSASSIN charges. GU XUANQING intercepts, weaponless, catching the sword's edge on his bracer. The blade bites flesh. In three swift moves, he disarms the ASSASSIN and drives the attacker's own weapon through his throat.

PRINCESS
(coldly)
Impressive audacity. Chain him in the oubliette. I wish to hear his screams echo for weeks.

The ASSASSIN is dragged away, gurgling.

ASSASSIN
(gurgling as he's dragged)
Chen... will... avenge...

PRINCESS
(to the guards)
And you lot—your incompetence disgusts me. Ten lashes each. Learn vigilance through pain.

Everyone present immediately kneels.

ALL
Princess, forgive us! Princess, spare us!

The PRINCESS notices crimson pooling from GU XUANQING's torn bracer. She approaches, lifting his chin with two fingers.

PRINCESS
(sharp interest)
Your name, bold one?

GU XUANQING
This subordinate is Gu Xuanqing.

PRINCESS
(smiling like a blade)
When your wound closes, present yourself to my private chambers. We'll discover what else you conceal.

GU XUANQING lowers his head, his jaw tightening with unspoken burden.

title: The Gu Family Manor
description: A mysterious opera singer arrives at the Gu family estate, harboring a dark secret connected to the family's past crimes.
context:
Title: The Gu Family Manor
Description: A mysterious opera singer arrives at the Gu family estate, harboring a dark secret connected to the family's past crimes.

EXT. GU FAMILY MANOR - NIGHT

Night envelops the Jiangnan water town-style Gu family manor. Lantern light reflects on the river surface, rippling like shattered amber.

GU JINGSHEN (30s), in a crisp suit and gold-rimmed glasses, stands by the roadside, watching servants unload luggage from a boat. His expression sharpens.

GU JINGSHEN
(to passing SERVANT)
Expecting royalty?

The SERVANT freezes, two suitcases in hand, and bows deeply.

SERVANT
Second Young Master. The eldest young master has... entertainment from South Street. For a private engagement.

GU JINGSHEN
(expressionless)
How novel. You may go.

SERVANT
Yes, sir.

The SERVANT scurries away. Gu Jingshen adjusts his glasses, his reflection ghosting across the dark water.

INT. GU FAMILY MANOR - NIGHT - CONTINUOUS

title: Flash Marriage - My Partner Spoils Me to the Sky
description: A wealthy CEO's daughter plays matchmaker for her father, arranging a blind date with a kind massage therapist who saved her from a hit-and-run accident.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage - My Partner Spoils Me to the Sky
Description: A wealthy CEO's daughter plays matchmaker for her father, arranging a blind date with a kind massage therapist who saved her from a hit-and-run accident.

INT. LUXURY CAR/COMPANY ENTRANCE - DAY

Fast cuts: Three identical black Maybachs merge through traffic, a tactical diversion. Real vehicle splits off last second.

LI ZHENHUA (40s, sharp suit, rimless glasses) sits in backseat, scrolling through a contract on his tablet. A gold wedding band hangs loose on his right pinky—moved after his wife's death five years ago.

A BODYGUARD (30s, scar across temple) speaks into his cuff mic. Six guards exit the Li Corporation tower, forming a loose perimeter—casual but watchful.

The Maybach glides to a stop. Bodyguard opens door.

LI ZHENHUA's phone BUZZES. He glances at it—ten dating profiles, all filtered through Xiaoxiao's bubblegum-pink app interface. He almost smiles.

LI XIAOXIAO (V.O.)
Dad, these are all pre-screened. No gold-diggers, I promise. Just... pick one before you turn into a statue.

LI ZHENHUA pockets the phone, his expression softening for a heartbeat before the corporate mask returns.

LI ZHENHUA
(to Yu Shuo, approaching)
Move the 3 PM. I need... personal time.

YU SHUO (late 20s, ever-present tablet) nods without question.

Li Zhenhua enters the building, guards dissolving into the lobby crowd.

EXT. ALLEY - DAY

LI XIAOXIAO (18, vintage band t-shirt, vintage jeans) walks while typing, grinning.

LI XIAOXIAO
(under her breath)
One of these has to stick...

A white Range Rover REVERSES at speed, backup camera BEEPING wildly. Li Xiaoxiao freezes.

The bumper clips her leg. She goes down—hard. Jeans tear at the knee, blood seeping through.

ZHENG YUHONG (45, calloused hands, gentle eyes) rushes from "Harmony Massage" storefront, towel still over shoulder.

ZHENG YUHONG
Easy, easy—don't move yet.

The driver, CHEN JIAO (30s, designer tracksuit), emerges checking her nails.

CHEN JIAO
(eyeing the alley)
You scratched my bumper with your... whatever this is.

LI XIAOXIAO
You were doing forty in reverse!

ZHENG YUHONG
(quietly firm)
My cameras cover this entire alley. We can wait for police, or you can leave your insurance.

Chen Jiao's smile tightens. She flings a business card.

CHEN JIAO
Fine. But if it's a scam, I'll sue you both blind.

She squeals tires leaving. The card flutters—"Elite Wellness Spa."

ZHENG YUHONG helps Xiaoxiao up, already assessing the injury with practiced hands.

ZHENG YUHONG
Come inside. That needs cleaning before it needs a lawyer.
continuation:
INT. MASSAGE PARLOR - DAY

Clean but dated: certificates on walls, a shrine photo of a young girl (12, gap-toothed smile) tucked among them.

Zheng Yuhong works silently, antiseptic sting filling the air. Her touch is methodical, practiced.

LI XIAOXIAO
(wincing)
You're different from those spa people.

ZHENG YUHONG
I learned on factory workers. They don't pay for pretty.

LI XIAOXIAO
Why give this up? You're magic.

ZHENG YUHONG's eyes flick to the shrine photo.

ZHENG YUHONG
My son bought a place uptown. Mortgage is... heavy. This shop is just bricks.

LI XIAOXIAO
What about you? Don't you—

ZHENG YUHONG
I had a daughter once. She'd be about your age.

The silence hangs. Zheng Yuhong tapes the bandage.

ZHENG YUHONG
Stand. Test it.

Li Xiaoxiao rises, surprised—pain is a dull throb, manageable.

LI XIAOXIAO
Can I... can I come back? Pay proper?

ZHENG YUHONG
(smiling, sad)
I'm closed next week. But thank you.

Li Xiaoxiao nods, but her thumb moves—snap—photo of Zheng Yuhong, catching her turning away from the shrine.

INT. LI ZHENHUA'S OFFICE - DAY

LI XIAOXIAO sits cross-legged on a leather chair, scrolling through the photo.

LI XIAOXIAO
She didn't even ask for my number. Just... helped.

LI ZHENHUA (O.S.)
And you're showing me because...

Li Xiaoxiao spins. Li Zhenhua stands in the doorway, tie loosened.

LI XIAOXIAO
She's real, Dad. Not like those profile robots.

She holds out her phone. Li Zhenhua takes it, expecting to dismiss.

His thumb hovers over Zheng Yuhong's face. He zooms in—on the shrine photo behind her. His breath catches.

LI ZHENHUA
(quietly)
Where is this?

LI XIAOXIAO
Just a block from—wait, you're actually interested?

Li Zhenhua is already texting Yu Shuo.

EXT. COMPANY ENTRANCE - DAY

Li Zhenhua exits, now in a simple sweater, no guards. Yu Shuo jogs up, concerned.

YU SHUO
Sir, the Chen merger—

LI ZHENHUA
Delayed. I'm... scouting a location.

He heads toward the alley, then stops. Turns to a young SECURITY GUARD (20s, crisp uniform).

LI ZHENHUA
Trade me your jacket. Thirty minutes.

The guard blinks, but Li Zhenhua's expression allows no argument.

INT. ZHENG KAIXUAN'S HOME - DAY

Modern minimalist condo. ZHENG KAIXUAN (28, tired eyes) opens the door for his mother.

ZHENG KAIXUAN
Mom, you should have called.

His wife, WANG MIN (26, silk loungewear), appears—pregnant, clearly uncomfortable.

WANG MIN
You're tracking... street dirt. The nursery is white carpet.

Zheng Yuhong freezes, looks at her worn shoes.

ZHENG YUHONG
I can wash—

ZHENG KAIXUAN
(softly)
Just... stay in the kitchen for now. I'll bring tea.

Zheng Yuhong nods, but her hand clutches the bag of massage oils—her only luggage. She catches her reflection in the window: a stranger in her son's home.

ZHENG YUHONG
(to her reflection, whispering)
Tuantuan would have let me in.

She pulls out her old phone, scrolls to a locked gallery—photos of a young Li Xiaoxiao's face, side-by-side with her daughter's shrine picture. The resemblance is uncanny.

EXT. MASSAGE PARLOR - NIGHT

The shop is dark. Li Zhenhua, in the guard's jacket, stands across the street, watching.

His phone shows the same split-screen photo Li Xiaoxiao had taken—Zheng Yuhong, and the shrine photo behind her. His wedding ring gleams in the phone's light.

LI ZHENHUA
(to himself)
She has your eyes.

He doesn't notice Yu Shuo's car idling at the corner, or the BODYGUARD reporting: "He's been there an hour."

Inside the dark shop, a MOTION SENSOR light flickers on—Zheng Yuhong, returning for something forgotten. She sees the figure across the street. Hesitates.

ZHENG YUHONG
(calling out, cautious)
We're closed.

Li Zhenhua steps into the light. His face is open, vulnerable—nothing like the CEO from the morning.

LI ZHENHUA
I know. I just... needed to see.

The moment stretches between them, weighted with something neither understands yet.

FADE OUT.

title: Flash Marriage CEO, Don't Spoil Me
description: A woman's wedding day turns into a nightmare when her groom betrays her with her best friend, only for a mysterious elderly man to intervene.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage CEO, Don't Spoil Me
Description: A woman's wedding day turns into a nightmare when her groom betrays her with her best friend, only for a mysterious elderly man to intervene.

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

The wedding doors slowly open.

OFFICIANT (O.S.)
Please welcome the bride.

AN RAN, wearing a white wedding dress and holding a bouquet, walks into the wedding venue. Her smile trembles at the edges.

AN RAN walks toward the groom TANG QINGYUN standing on stage. He steps down, takes the bouquet from her hands, turns, and extends it to—

JI TONG, appearing beside him in an ivory dress, accepts it with a gloved hand.

AN RAN
(shocked)
Ji Tong? This is my wedding!

JI TONG
(smoothly)
Not anymore.

TANG QINGYUN
An Ran, time to wake up. Did you think I'd marry a poor wretch like you? Six months of devotion for that loan. Consider it payment rendered.

AN RAN
(quiet fury)
You committed fraud.

JI TONG
The documents are signed, the house is collateral. Do you want to stay for the ceremony?

AN RAN
Shut up!

TANG QINGYUN
(stepping between them)
We're family now. When is it your turn to interrupt?
continuation:
TANG QINGYUN raises his hand. An Ran doesn't flinch. He smirks and lowers it.

TANG QINGYUN
You have no place here.

AN RAN
(voice shaking)
No place? I mortgaged my parents' house! I paid for this wedding! I gave you everything!

TANG QINGYUN
All voluntary.

TANG'S MOTHER rises from her seat.

TANG'S MOTHER
The Tang family needs a proper daughter-in-law. Not some barren charity case with delusions.

AN RAN
(stumbling back)
You people—

TANG'S MOTHER
No money, no family, no future. Who would want you now?

OLD MASTER (O.S.)
I would.

The wedding doors open again. An OLD MASTER in a white Tang suit, holding a cane, walks in with measured steps.

OLD MASTER
(to the room)
This wedding is void. The debt, however...

He looks at An Ran. Something flickers—recognition? Promise?

OLD MASTER
...has only just begun to be repaid.

He extends his hand.

OLD MASTER
Miss An. Shall we?

title: Flash Marriage Partner is From a Wealthy Family
description: A wealthy chairman's adopted daughter tries to find him a suitable partner, leading to an unexpected encounter with a kind street vendor.
context:
Title: Flash Marriage Partner is From a Wealthy Family
Description: A wealthy chairman's adopted daughter tries to find him a suitable partner, leading to an unexpected encounter with a kind street vendor.

EXT. GROUP ENTRANCE - DAY

Two black sedans drive through the gate of a luxurious estate.

LEI ZHIYUAN, a middle-aged man in a suit, gets out of the car. ON SCREEN: Lei Zhiyuan, Chairman of Lei Group.

A group of BODYGUARDS in black suits stand in two rows, bowing to LEI ZHIYUAN.

BODYGUARDS (in unison)
Chairman.

LEI ZHIYUAN adjusts his suit and walks into the building with the bodyguards.

INT. CHAIRMAN'S OFFICE - DAY

LEI ZHIYUAN sits at his desk working.

LEI MENGJIE, a young and beautiful girl, pushes the door open with purpose. ON SCREEN: Lei Mengjie, Lei Zhiyuan's Adopted Daughter.

LEI MENGJIE
Dad.

LEI ZHIYUAN
(looking up with a tired smile)
You're persistent, daughter.

LEI MENGJIE
(holding a stack of photos of women)
Seventeen prospects. Which one deserves you?

LEI ZHIYUAN
(glancing at the photos dismissively)
They lack authenticity.

LEI ZHIYUAN
But you, you're already 28. When will you prioritize your own future?

LEI MENGJIE
I told you, our fates are linked.

LEI ZHIYUAN
A standoff, then.

LEI MENGJIE
(pouting, but determined)

LEI ZHIYUAN
(laughing helplessly)
You leave me no choice. I'll engage with the process.

LEI MENGJIE
(immediately brightening)
Your word?

LEI MENGJIE turns and walks away.

LEI ZHIYUAN
Wait—

LEI MENGJIE (O.S.)
Bye, Dad!

LEI ZHIYUAN
(sighing)
That girl will be the death of me.
continuation:
EXT. ROADSIDE - DAY

LEI MENGJIE gets out of her white sedan and closes the door.

She suddenly notices the flower bed by the roadside, her expression changes, and she begins having difficulty breathing.

LEI MENGJIE
Why are there so many flowers here? Where's my asthma medicine?

LEI MENGJIE falls to the ground, struggling to crawl toward the inhaler.

LEI MENGJIE
(whispered)
Help... please... save... me...

A middle-aged woman, SHI XIAOXIU, carrying large and small bags, passes by and sees LEI MENGJIE on the ground. ON SCREEN: Shi Xiaoxiu, Street Vendor.

SHI XIAOXIU immediately puts down her luggage and rushes over, pulling a spare inhaler from her own purse, helping LEI MENGJIE up.

SHI XIAOXIU
Easy, child. Breathe.

SHI XIAOXIU puts the inhaler in LEI MENGJIE's mouth, helping her inhale the medicine.

SHI XIAOXIU
Better now?

LEI MENGJIE's breathing gradually stabilizes, and she looks at SHI XIAOXIU with gratitude and dawning recognition.

SHI XIAOXIU
(gently)
There. You're safe.

SHI XIAOXIU helps LEI MENGJIE up, and LEI MENGJIE stands. SHI XIAOXIU turns to get her luggage.

LEI MENGJIE runs over to help.

LEI MENGJIE
Auntie... your kindness is rare. My father—

SHI XIAOXIU
(laughing, but moved)
I have a grandson waiting.

LEI MENGJIE
(pulling her back)
A contact. Nothing more. Until you're ready.

SHI XIAOXIU
(amused)
You're an unusual girl.

The two take out their phones and add each other on WeChat.

INT. APARTMENT ENTRANCE - DAY

SHI XIAOXIU's son LI DAPENG opens the door. ON SCREEN: Li Dapeng, Shi Xiaoxiu's Son.

LI DAPENG
Mom!

SHI XIAOXIU walks in carrying large and small bags.

LI DAPENG
Come in.

SHI XIAOXIU
(looking around)
Oh my, son, your wedding apartment is really nice!

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Daughter-in-law ZHU XINYI sits on the sofa, looking displeased as they enter. ON SCREEN: Zhu Xinyi, Shi Xiaoxiu's Daughter-in-law.

SHI XIAOXIU puts a large bag on the floor and takes out a big plate of farm eggs.

SHI XIAOXIU
(beaming)
Auntie Liu's finest eggs—for your recovery, daughter-in-law. Perfect nutrition.

She hands the eggs toward ZHU XINYI.

ZHU XINYI suddenly stands up and knocks the plate of eggs to the ground. The eggs break all over the floor.

ZHU XINYI
(disgusted, voice cracking)
What kind of cheap stuff are you bringing into my house! So dirty!

SHI XIAOXIU freezes in place, her face full of shock and familiar hurt.

title: Sorry, My Best Friend
description: A woman risks her life to save her best friend, only to be betrayed in the cruelest way possible.
context:
Title: Sorry, My Best Friend
Description: A woman risks her life to save her best friend, only to be betrayed in the cruelest way possible.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

LIN XIA lies in a hospital bed, wearing an oxygen mask, unconscious.

WANG CUILAN (Lin Xia's mother, 50s) sits beside her, gripping a hospital bill. JIANG XIN (mid-20s) hovers near the door, clutching her purse.

WANG CUILAN
(quietly)
Eight times. Eight knives.

JIANG XIN
I should go--

WANG CUILAN
(standing, trembling)
Your boyfriend. Your mess. She bled cleaning it up.

Wang Cuilan stumbles toward Jiang Xin, holding out the bill.

WANG CUILAN
Will you pay? Or just walk away?

JIANG XIN
I don't have that kind of money!

WANG CUILAN
Then you're nothing to her.

Wang Cuilan grabs Jiang Xin's arm. Jiang Xin shoves her back. Hard.

WANG CUILAN
(falling)
Ahh--

Her head strikes the metal bed frame. She collapses, motionless. Blood begins to pool.

Jiang Xin stares at her hands, at the blood.

LIN XIA's eyes flutter open. She sees her mother on the floor. Sees Jiang Xin standing over her.

LIN XIA (V.O.)
Is this the best friend I risked my life to protect?

A NURSE passes the open door, sees the scene, and SCREAMS.

FLASHBACK TO:

ON SCREEN: 24 HOURS EARLIER

INT. OUTSIDE JIANG XIN'S APARTMENT - DAY

SHEN LEI (30s, volatile) pounds on the door, a bottle in one hand, a knife glinting in his belt.

SHEN LEI
Jiang Xin! Come out, bitch! I know you're in there!
continuation:
INT. JIANG XIN'S LIVING ROOM - DAY

JIANG XIN trembles behind LIN XIA.

JIANG XIN
He's going to kill me. You were right about him--

LIN XIA
Stay back.

Lin Xia moves to the door, phone already dialing 110 behind her back.

INT. JIANG XIN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE - DAY

Lin Xia opens the door a crack, blocking it with her body.

LIN XIA
She's done with you, Shen Lei. Leave.

SHEN LEI
You showed her those texts! You made her leave me!

LIN XIA
Because you hit her. Because you're a monster.

He kicks the door. It bursts open. The knife is suddenly in his hand.

SHEN LEI
(in her face)
You ruined us!

He stabs. Once. Twice. Lin Xia gasps.

SHEN LEI
(hissing)
This is your fault.

He stabs a third time, then turns and runs. Through the doorway, Lin Xia sees Jiang Xin watching, phone in hand, frozen. Not calling for help. Just watching.

LIN XIA
(whispering)
Xin... help...

END FLASHBACK.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Lin Xia struggles to stay conscious. The DOCTOR and NURSES rush in.

DOCTOR
What happened?

JIANG XIN
(voice rising, panicked)
She attacked me! The mother, she said I owed them money--for the bills--and when I couldn't pay--

The lie forms in real-time, growing as she speaks it.

JIANG XIN
--she tried to push me! I just pushed back!

The doctor checks Wang Cuilan's pulse. Looks at Jiang Xin. Skeptical.

JIANG XIN
(screaming)
It was self-defense! They were extorting me!

She points at Lin Xia.

JIANG XIN
Ask her! She'll tell you!

Lin Xia meets Jiang Xin's eyes. For a long moment.

FLASHBACK TO:

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY (THREE MONTHS EARLIER)

Lin Xia wakes with a start from a nightmare.

JIANG XIN
(excitedly)
Lin Xia, Lin Xia!

JIANG XIN shows Lin Xia her phone, a photo of SHEN LEI on screen.

JIANG XIN
Look, what do you think? I said yes! He's my boyfriend now!

LIN XIA
(studying the photo)
Xin... there's something in his eyes.

JIANG XIN
I know. Dangerous. Isn't it hot?

They laugh. Lin Xia's smile doesn't reach her eyes.

BACK TO REALITY.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

Lin Xia watches Jiang Xin unravel. She makes her choice.

Slowly, deliberately, Lin Xia turns her head away from Jiang Xin. The silence is her answer.

SECURITY GUARDS enter. They grab Jiang Xin.

JIANG XIN
(struggling)
She's lying! They're lying!

But Lin Xia doesn't look back. She reaches for her mother's hand.

INT. POLICE STATION - DAY (ONE WEEK LATER)

Jiang Xin sits in an interrogation room, makeup smeared. The DETECTIVE enters with Lin Xia's statement.

DETECTIVE
She's awake. And she says you lied about everything.

Jiang Xin's face crumples.

FADE OUT.

title: Mr. Lu's Sweet Wife and Cool Baby
description: A woman framed and abandoned by her fiancé returns six months later, pregnant and determined to keep her child despite family pressure.
context:
Title: Mr. Lu's Sweet Wife and Cool Baby
Description: A woman framed and abandoned by her fiancé returns six months later, pregnant and determined to keep her child despite family pressure.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

SU YAO, six months pregnant in a simple white maternity dress, walks in the hospital corridor. She accidentally bumps into QI RUIZE.

QI RUIZE
Su Yao, you disappeared for half a year, and you return carrying another man's child? How can you face me, your fiancé?

INT. PROPOSAL PARTY VENUE - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

ON SCREEN: HALF A YEAR AGO

QI RUIZE covers SU YAO's eyes with his hand and leads her into an elaborately decorated proposal party venue, filled with pink and white balloons, with a "MARRY ME" neon sign in the background.

QI RUIZE
No peeking.

QI RUIZE removes his hand. SU YAO looks at everything before her with delighted surprise. QI RUIZE kneels on one knee and takes out a ring.

QI RUIZE
Ah Yao, marry me.

SU YAO
(moved)
I do.

QI RUIZE puts the ring on SU YAO's finger. The two embrace happily. LIN XIAO walks over with a bottle of wine.

LIN XIAO
Ah Yao, congratulations. You and Ruize have finally achieved your happy ending.

The three raise their glasses.

LIN XIAO
Cheers.

The three drink together. After drinking, SU YAO suddenly feels dizzy.

SU YAO
What's happening? My head is so dizzy.

SU YAO sways and collapses into QI RUIZE's arms. LIN XIAO shows a hint of a triumphant smile. QI RUIZE picks up the unconscious SU YAO and carries her toward the elevator.
continuation:
INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

LU JINGCHEN, a young man wearing a waiter's uniform, leans against the wall, looking unwell. He swipes a card and enters a room.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

SU YAO sleeps unconsciously on the bed. LU JINGCHEN enters the room, removes his shirt, and walks toward the bed. He leans down to kiss SU YAO, and the two have relations.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY (END FLASHBACK)

Back in the present hospital corridor, SU YAO faces accusations from QI RUIZE and MOTHER SU, her emotions running high.

SU YAO
I've told you, someone framed me back then! Why won't you believe me?

QI RUIZE
As long as you terminate this pregnancy now, I can let bygones be bygones and marry you. The merger can still be saved.

SU YAO
(coldly laughing)
Qi Ruize, you want to marry me only for the Su family's investment. I will never fall for your tricks again.

MOTHER SU
(furious)
Su Yao, shut up! You have no shame, but the Su family still has our reputation! If you don't abort this child, don't blame me for disowning you as my daughter!

SU YAO
(resolute)
Fine. From now on, I sever all ties with the Su family and with you! I will raise this child myself. I will never abandon him!

SU YAO turns to leave. MOTHER SU steps forward and grabs her.

MOTHER SU
Hey, Su Yao!

SU YAO shakes off her mother's hand and leaves resolutely.

MOTHER SU
(shouting from behind)
Su Yao! Su Yao! Su Yao!

FADE OUT.

title: The Long Road Home on New Year's Eve
description: A pregnant woman's journey home for the New Year is disrupted when an entitled grandmother and her grandson take her seat on the high-speed train.
context:
Title: The Long Road Home on New Year's Eve
Description: A pregnant woman's journey home for the New Year is disrupted when an entitled grandmother and her grandson take her seat on the high-speed train.

INT. HIGH-SPEED RAIL STATION - DAY

LIN SHAN (28, pregnant, pale but determined) clutches a red envelope as her father adjusts her scarf. She slips the envelope into her bag—revealing a medical file peeks out.

LIN SHAN
I'll be back before the baby's born. Promise.

LIN SHAN'S FATHER
Your blood pressure medication—top pocket. Don't forget.

He taps her jacket. She nods, eyes glistening.

LIN SHAN
You take your heart pills. I'll call when I arrive.

She turns, pulling her small suitcase. Her father doesn't move, watching until she disappears through the gate.

INT. HIGH-SPEED TRAIN CAR - DAY

LIN SHAN steadies herself against a seat, breathing hard. She checks her phone—gestational diabetes meal reminder flashes. She dials.

LIN SHAN
(on phone)
Hey. Made it on.

INT. CEO'S OFFICE - DAY

XU WEI (40s) watches snowfall through the window, phone to his ear. His assistant Wu Chuan enters with documents, hesitates.

XU WEI
(on phone)
You sound exhausted. The second ticket—did they honor it?

INT. HIGH-SPEED TRAIN CAR - DAY

LIN SHAN
(on phone)
It's fine. Two seats, less nausea. I'll sleep most of the way.

She glances at her watch—30 minutes until departure. Passengers still boarding.

LIN SHAN
(on phone)
Gotta go. Love you.

She ends the call. A commotion at the car door—

WU SHUANGHUA (60s, aggressively anxious) drags a large red gift box and WU XIAOYUAN (7, headphones on, stimming with a fidget spinner). A CONDUCTOR blocks them.

CONDUCTOR
Ma'am, this is Business Class. Your tickets are Economy.

WU SHUANGHUA
My son bought these! Special seats for my grandson—he's sensitive!

She flashes tickets. The conductor checks—confused. Wu Shuanghua shoves past.

WU SHUANGHUA (cont'd)
Don't touch him! He has a doctor's note!

She spots Lin Shan's two adjacent seats—one with a medical cushion, one empty.

WU SHUANGHUA (cont'd)
Xiaoyuan! Here! Sit!

She dumps the gift box on the medical cushion, pushing Lin Shan's bag aside. Xiaoyuan curls into the empty seat, still spinning.

LIN SHAN
(quietly firm)
Excuse me. That's my seat. Both of them.

WU SHUANGHUA
(Not looking up, arranging bags)
Train's full. You can sit anywhere. Young people are so entitled.

LIN SHAN
I bought two tickets. This one—

She touches the medical cushion.

LIN SHAN
—is for my condition.

WU SHUANGHUA
(Barking laugh)
Condition? My grandson has autism! He needs space! You look fine.
continuation:
She gestures at Lin Shan's belly with contempt.

WU SHUANGHUA (cont'd)
Pregnant women ride standing all the time. Where's your manners?

A BUSINESSMAN across the aisle looks up from his laptop.

BUSINESSMAN
Ma'am, she has the ticket.

WU SHUANGHUA
(Snarling)
You stay out! My son is General Manager of—

She catches herself, looks around conspiratorially.

WU SHUANGHUA (cont'd)
(Whispering harshly to Lin Shan)
My son's boss loves children. This gift? Jade for his newborn. One word from you and I throw your bag out the window. Choose.

Lin Shan glances at the gift box—imperial quality, expensive. She looks at Xiaoyuan, who has begun rocking, humming. Her hand goes to her blood pressure monitor in her pocket.

LIN SHAN
(Dead calm)
That's assault. And that seat is mine.

She reaches for her bag. Wu Shuanghua grabs her wrist—surprisingly strong. Xiaoyuan's fidget spinner falls, clattering. He begins to moan, a rising sound.

WU SHUANGHUA
(Panicking now)
See? You triggered him! Fix this! Give him your seat!

The Businessman stands. Others look over. The conductor approaches.

LIN SHAN
(To conductor, steady)
I need my seat. And my medical bag. Now.

The conductor sees Lin Shan's ticket—two seats, medical note attached. He reaches for Wu Shuanghua.

CONDUCTOR
Ma'am, you need to move—

WU SHUANGHUA
(Voice breaking, not anger—desperation)
Please. My son's whole life depends on this meeting. The jade, the boy—it's all we have. She can have any other seat!

She clutches the gift box like a shield. Xiaoyuan's moaning gets louder. The whole car watches.

LIN SHAN
(Quietly, to Wu Shuanghua)
Your son's promotion matters more than my baby's safety?

WU SHUANGHUA
(Tears now)
You can try again. My son only gets one chance.

Lin Shan's face changes—recognition of something. She looks at the medical file in her bag, then at the desperate woman.

LIN SHAN
(To conductor)
Is there an empty seat in First Class?

CONDUCTOR
One. Last minute cancellation.

LIN SHAN
(Nodding)
Upgrade her. Charge my card.

She pulls out her credit card. The car goes silent. Wu Shuanghua stares, uncomprehending.

WU SHUANGHUA
What?

LIN SHAN
(Picking up Xiaoyuan's spinner, handing it to him)
Your son's future isn't worth a seat. It's worth two. Go.

She gestures to the conductor. He takes the card, leads the stunned Wu Shuanghua away. Xiaoyuan follows, looking back at Lin Shan.

LIN SHAN
(To the Businessman)
Could you help me with my bag?

She sinks into her seat, trembling, and pulls out her blood pressure monitor. The numbers flash high. She swallows a pill, alone in the crowded car.

FADE OUT.

LIN SHAN (28, pregnant, pale but determined) clutches a red envelope as her father adjusts her scarf. She slips the envelope into her bag—revealing a medical file peeks out.

LIN SHAN
I'll be back before the baby's born. Promise.

LIN SHAN'S FATHER
Your blood pressure medication—top pocket. Don't forget.

He taps her jacket. She nods, eyes glistening.

LIN SHAN
You take your heart pills. I'll call when I arrive.

She turns, pulling her small suitcase. Her father doesn't move, watching until she disappears through the gate.

INT. HIGH-SPEED TRAIN CAR - DAY

LIN SHAN steadies herself against a seat, breathing hard. She checks her phone—gestational diabetes meal reminder flashes. She dials.

LIN SHAN
(on phone)
Hey. Made it on.

INT. CEO'S OFFICE - DAY

XU WEI (40s) watches snowfall through the window, phone to his ear. His assistant Wu Chuan enters with documents, hesitates.

(on phone)

LIN SHAN
(on phone)

She glances at her watch—30 minutes until departure. Passengers still boarding.

LIN SHAN
(on phone)

title: Blood Awakening
description: A woman reborn with memories of two lifetimes seeks to reclaim what was stolen and avenge her father's death.
context:
Title: Blood Awakening
Description: A woman reborn with memories of two lifetimes seeks to reclaim what was stolen and avenge her father's death.

EXT. MAGNIFICENT TEMPLE - DAY

The camera overlooks a temple complex where a golden Buddha fountain flows. Incense smoke snakes upward with the Buddhist chants.

ZENG BAILU (V.O.)
Two lifetimes as one. The temple taught me patience. This life won't.

The camera cuts to the Buddha's weathered stone hand. ZENG BAILU, black leather over saffron robes, traces the carvings.

ZENG BAILU (V.O.)
You took his company. His name. His grave.

ZENG BAILU stands on the temple balcony, overlooking the city's industrial district below.

ZENG BAILU (V.O.)
Father, watch me return what was stolen. In both our names.
continuation:
EXT. WATERFRONT ROOFTOP - SUNSET

ZHANG TIANYI, 30s, bespoke suit, walks toward ZENG BAILU who stands at the edge. ZENG BAILU turns a JADE BEAD between her fingers.

ZENG BAILU
You traced my father's shell companies and hacked his sealed records. But you didn't find the ring.

ZHANG TIANYI
Miss Zeng, I'm only securing your inheritance. As agreed.

ZENG BAILU
Stop acting. Do you think I'm a fool?

ZENG BAILU laughs, cold as the wind.

ZENG BAILU
You're after the Master's Token Ring.

ZHANG TIANYI
Ring? I've never heard of it.

ZENG BAILU
Today, I expose you. Starting with how you knew where to dig.

ZHANG TIANYI's expression shatters, revealing something feral.

ZHANG TIANYI
Zeng Bailu, die!

ZHANG TIANYI rushes her, fist cocked. ZENG BAILU traps his wrist, the jade bead glowing between her fingers. She drives her boot toward camera. FRAME FREEZES on the bead's crimson light.

title: The Sacred Blood
description: A desperate mother learns of a child's miraculous healing blood and makes a tragic choice to save her own dying daughter.
context:
Title: The Sacred Blood
Description: A desperate mother learns of a child's miraculous healing blood and makes a tragic choice to save her own dying daughter.

INT. TEMPLE ENTRANCE - NIGHT

Thunder rumbles.

WANG PO, clutching a feverish child, staggers up the temple steps.

WANG PO
(hoarse)
Please! Anyone! My child—

A SERVANT opens the door, blocking her way.

SERVANT
No beggars! The Holy Mother prays within—disturb her at your peril!

WANG PO
But she'll die!

The servant shoves. Wang Po's grip slips. The child starts to fall—

A slender hand catches the child's arm.

HE NANWAN, the Lady of Zhenguo Marquis Manor, stands in the doorway, handmaidens holding umbrellas.

HE NANWAN
Let them in.

WANG PO
(whispering)
Thank you...

EXT. TEMPLE COURTYARD - NIGHT

The rain lessens.

GU BAOZHU (8), the Marquis's youngest, pricks her finger on a withered lotus pot. One drop of blood falls. The plant erupts into bloom.

GU BAOZHU
Mother! It worked!

She runs to He Nanwan.

HE NANWAN
(taking her hand)
Your gift is sacred, Baozhu. Never wasted.

She ties a silk ribbon around the wound.

GU BAOZHEN (10) approaches with a silver bell.

GU BAOZHEN
Your token, sister. The Miao bells protect us.

She fastens the bell around Baozhu's neck.

MARQUIS
(from the doorway)
Girls, inside. Now.

GU BAOZHEN
Father, does my blood heal too?

MARQUIS
Both you carry the gift. But it requires willing sacrifice—not theft.

HE NANWAN
You cannot force a miracle.

Wang Po, hidden behind a lantern, hears. She looks at her own child, limp in her arms. Her face hardens.
continuation:
INT. GIRLS' BEDROOM - NIGHT

Moonlight through paper windows.

Gu Baozhu and Gu Baozhen sleep, silver bells on their pillows.

Wang Po slips through the window, a cloth in one hand, a jade vial in the other.

GU BAOZHEN
(groggy)
Baozhu...?

She sits up. Sees the figure.

GU BAOZHEN
Who—

Wang Po lunges for Baozhen, clamps the cloth over her mouth. Their eyes meet—terror meets desperation. Wang Po's resolve wavers.

GU BAOZHU
(sitting up)
Jiejie? What's—

She sees.

GU BAOZHU
(screaming)
MOTHER!

Wang Po releases Baozhen—unconscious but breathing. She snatches Baozhu instead, lighter to carry. She runs.

GU BAOZHU
(kicking)
Let me go!

EXT. TEMPLE COURTYARD - NIGHT

Gu Baozhen stumbles out, gasping.

GU BAOZHEN
(croaking)
Mother... She took Baozhu... Wanted her blood...

He Nanwan bursts from the temple, face white. She sees the open window, empty bed. Thunder cracks.

HE NANWAN
(whisper, then shout)
Sound the alarm! The Holy Maiden is taken!

Torches flare. The hunt begins.

title: The Scam on the Bus
description: A young woman becomes the target of a group of scammers on her way to work on the weekend.
context:
Title: The Scam on the Bus
Description: A young woman becomes the target of a group of scammers on her way to work on the weekend.

EXT. BUS STOP - DAY

CHEN XUE (V.O.)
Third weekend in a row. My boss calls it "opportunity." I call it exploitation. Mom's waiting at the restaurant. I promised I wouldn't be late.

SU QIUYA watches CHEN XUE from behind mirrored sunglasses. A slight nod to ZHENG XUEWEN.

ZHENG XUEWEN
(under his breath)
The blue coat. Solo commuter. Won't fight back.

A bus arrives. People cluster at the doors.

ZHENG XUEWEN and ZHENG DAQIAN brush past CHEN XUE, jostling her phone from her hand.

CHEN XUE
Hey!

SU QIUYA
(shoving forward)
Young people! No respect for elders!

ZHENG DAQIAN
Move it.

ZHENG XUEWEN retrieves Chen Xue's phone from the pavement.

ZHENG XUEWEN
Here. My apologies.

CHEN XUE checks her phone—screen spiderwebbed.

CHEN XUE
(under her breath)
Great. Just perfect.

LIN MEI and DOUDOU wait back, observing.

LIN MEI
(quietly)
See how they boxed her in?

DOUDOU
Three points of contact. Just like you said.
continuation:
INT. BUS - DAY

CHEN XUE scrolls on her cracked screen. ZHENG XUEWEN moves close, holding a phone.

ZHENG XUEWEN
(a dry cough)
Miss, help an old man? My grandson messed with the settings...

He offers the phone. Chen Xue's hand moves toward it—then stops.

CHEN XUE
You had your phone out at the stop. I saw you texting.

ZHENG XUEWEN
What?

CHEN XUE
And she called you "young lady" when she yelled. But you called her "old woman."

Beat. The scammers freeze.

SU QIUYA
(grabbing Zheng Xuewen's arm)
Let's go.

CHEN XUE
(to driver)
Driver, these people are running a scam.

ZHENG DAQIAN
(lunging)
You little—

LIN MEI blocks his path, phone recording.

LIN MEI
Don't. I've got three witnesses here. Plus your faces on dashcam.

DOUDOU taps the mounted camera, grinning.

ZHENG XUEWEN
Abort.

The scammers bolt for the exit. The bus stops.

CHEN XUE
(to Lin Mei)
You knew?

LIN MEI
They got my mother last month. She wasn't as sharp.

CHEN XUE looks at her cracked screen, then at Doudou.

CHEN XUE
Guess I'm still making lunch. Mom hates eating alone.

LIN MEI
We'll join you. If you don't mind company.

Doudou takes Chen Xue's hand, leading her off the bus.

EXT. BUS - DAY

The bus pulls away. The scammers regroup on the curb.

SU QIUYA
(tossing her fake grandmother cardigan)
Next time, we pick the phone up ourselves.

ZHENG XUEWEN
Next time, we find a bus without cameras.

They slink away as a police siren wails in the distance.

title: Zero Degree Ambiguity
description: A couple bound by a marriage of convenience struggles with their conflicting emotions as physical attraction complicates their agreement to stay distant.
context:
Title: Zero Degree Ambiguity
Description: A couple bound by a marriage of convenience struggles with their conflicting emotions as physical attraction complicates their agreement to stay distant.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

A projection screen displays a romantic movie. On screen, a man and woman are kissing.

MOVIE FEMALE VOICE (V.O.)
This is a mistake. We're not supposed to—

MOVIE MALE VOICE (V.O.)
I know. Tell me you don't feel it too.

CUT TO:

WEN XUAN lies on the bed, hugging a pillow, watching.

WEN XUAN
(to herself)
Forty episodes for that.

JIAN YUCHEN appears at the door, pulling a suitcase. He looks exhausted.

WEN XUAN sees him and tenses.

WEN XUAN
You're back.

JIAN YUCHEN
The deal closed early.

He notices the screen. A beat.

JIAN YUCHEN
Our blueprint?

WEN XUAN
Background noise.

JIAN YUCHEN removes his jacket, folds it.

JIAN YUCHEN
Guest bathroom's leaking.

WEN XUAN
Maintenance comes tomorrow.

JIAN YUCHEN
Then I'll use this one.

He unbuttons his cuffs. WEN XUAN grips her pillow.

WEN XUAN
continuation:
I'll go.

JIAN YUCHEN
Stay.

He sits on the bed's edge, tugs the blanket lightly.

WEN XUAN
The contract—

JIAN YUCHEN
I wrote every clause.

Movie dialogue swells.

MOVIE FEMALE VOICE (V.O.)
We promised simplicity.

MOVIE MALE VOICE (V.O.)
We lied.

JIAN YUCHEN's fingers brush hers. She doesn't move.

JIAN YUCHEN
Three weeks. No messages.

WEN XUAN
You didn't either.

JIAN YUCHEN
I wrote twelve. Deleted them all.

She searches his face.

WEN XUAN
This is how deals collapse.

JIAN YUCHEN
Let's renegotiate.

He leans in. She could pull back. She doesn't.

WEN XUAN
Distance. Autonomy.

JIAN YUCHEN
Void the contract.

He kisses her. She meets him halfway.

The camera pans to their wedding photo—crooked.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Barren Mountain
description: A woman abandoned in a remote mountain village by her husband must choose between saving her rival or reclaiming her own life through a mysterious system.
context:
Title: Barren Mountain
Description: A woman abandoned in a remote mountain village by her husband must choose between saving her rival or reclaiming her own life through a mysterious system.

EXT. BARREN MOUNTAIN ROAD - DAY

A black sedan winds through misty peaks, gravel crunching beneath its tires. It slows before a weathered sign: "VILLAGE CLOSED - NO THROUGH ROAD."

The car stops. XU YUNIAN (30s, pristine suit) steps out, his face etched with cold resolve. He glances back at the passenger door—then at something covered in white cloth on the roadside.

XU YUNIAN
Get out.

The door opens. MU WAN (late 20s, bruised, hands trembling) emerges. She sees the cloth-covered figure and freezes.

XU YUNIAN
You still don't get it, do you? 

He yanks the cloth away, revealing MU YIYI's limp form—blood on her shirt, but breathing.

MU WAN
(stumbling back)
I didn't—Anian, I swear I never—

XU YUNIAN
(cutting her off)
The knife had your prints. Yiyi identified you. What more do you want?

He crouches beside the unconscious woman, gently brushing hair from her face.

XU YUNIAN
She's the only one who never asked me for anything. And this is how you repay her?

From the back seat, their son AN'AN (6, clutching a teddy bear) watches with wide, uncertain eyes.

MU WAN
(pleading)
An'an... you know Mommy wouldn't—

AN'AN
(quietly)
Daddy says you're lying again.

XU YUNIAN
(standing)
This village was evacuated five years ago. No roads, no signal. Consider it a time-out until you stop being a danger to everyone around you.

He walks back to the car, pulling AN'AN with him.

MU WAN
Anian! He needs his mother—

XU YUNIAN
He needs safety. Which you clearly can't provide.

The car door slams. Engine revs. Mu Wan runs after them, but the sedan disappears around a bend, leaving only dust.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Host life signs unstable. Binding protocol available. Confirm?

Mu Wan stares at the empty road, tears mixing with dirt on her face.

MU WAN
(whispering)
No. I have to... he might come back.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Protocol noted. Offer expires in ninety days.
continuation:
EXT. ABANDONED MOUNTAIN VILLAGE - DAY

TITLE: EIGHTY-SEVEN DAYS LATER

Sun bleaches the dilapidated houses. MU WAN, gaunt but moving with purpose, emerges from a shack with a basket of foraged mushrooms. She checks snares made from stripped wire.

A distant engine. She straightens, eyes narrowing.

The same black sedan crawls into view. Xu Yunian steps out, blue suit crisp against the decay. AN'AN follows, holding a tablet instead of his bear.

XU YUNIAN
You look... functional.

MU WAN
I learned.

XU YUNIAN
Good. Then you'll understand this.

He slides a document across a rotting fence post: "MEDICAL COMPENSATION AGREEMENT."

XU YUNIAN
Yiyi's kidneys are failing. Fast. Sign this, and I'll take you back. You'll be a hero.

MU WAN
I already gave you bone marrow five years ago. You think I'm a catalog?

XU YUNIAN
That was different. This will save a life.

AN'AN
(fidgeting)
Daddy says if you don't sign, Auntie Yiyi will die like in the movies. But... but you won't die, right?

Mu Wan's eyes flicker toward her son—his confusion, his hopeful glance.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Day eighty-seven. Binding protocol remains active.

Mu Wan's fingers trace the paper edges, feeling the weight of every word.

MU WAN
What does it say I have to give?

XU YUNIAN
Everything listed.

She flips pages. Kidney. Partial liver. Bone marrow if needed. A blank line at the bottom: "Additional tissue as required."

MU WAN
You want me to be her spare parts warehouse.

XU YUNIAN
I want you to atone.

He reaches for a pen in his jacket. As he does, a photograph flutters from An'an's pocket—himself, Yunian, and Yiyi at a theme park, laughing.

An'an scrambles for it, but Mu Wan is faster. She sees the date stamp: three weeks ago.

MU WAN
(quietly)
You took our son. To meet the woman who framed me.

AN'AN
She bought me ice cream... and a new bear...

XU YUNIAN
Sign the damn paper, Mu Wan. Or I leave, and the next vehicle you see will be a coroner's van.

Mu Wan stares at the photo. At her son's guilty face. At the man she once knew.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Final offer. Expires in three days.

MU WAN
(to herself)
Three days.

She picks up the pen. Signs with sharp, deliberate strokes.

MU WAN
Done.

XU YUNIAN
The hospital expects us in—

MU WAN
No. You go.

She tears the photo in half—Yiyi and Yunian fall away. She keeps the piece with An'an's face.

MU WAN
System. Confirm binding.

SYSTEM (V.O.)
Protocol engaged. Mission deployment in 72 hours. Warning: All current affiliations will be severed. Irreversible.

Mu Wan looks at her son one last time, then turns toward the mountains.

MU WAN
Tell Yiyi she can have my body. But she'll never have my life.

She walks away as the system interface flickers to life in her vision—coordinates, resources, a new identity waiting.

XU YUNIAN
(calling after)
Where the hell do you think you're going?

MU WAN
(not turning)
To die. So someone worth saving can be born.

FADE OUT.

title: Shock, Poor Wife is Actually a High-Born Heiress
description: A woman endures humiliation in her husband's family, unaware of her true identity as a wealthy heiress, until fate intervenes.
context:
Title: Shock, Poor Wife is Actually a High-Born Heiress
Description: A woman endures humiliation in her husband's family, unaware of her true identity as a wealthy heiress, until fate intervenes.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT

ZHENG JIAMING and LAN XIN are intimately embracing.

ZHENG JIAMING
Lan Xin, you make me feel alive again.

LAN XIN
Your wife—does she suspect?

ZHENG JIAMING
Gu Wan? She's too busy scrubbing floors to notice anything. I married her out of pity, but she's been nothing but dead weight.

LAN XIN
Still, three years...

ZHENG JIAMING
Three years of charity. She should be grateful I haven't sent her back to that village.

EXT. STREET - DAY

GU WAN tends to a small herbal medicine stall. A CUSTOMER examines her goods.

PASSERBY (O.S.)
The city patrol is coming!

GU WAN
(to a customer)
Sir, you haven't paid yet—three yuan for the ginseng!

The customer disappears into the crowd. GU WAN scrambles to pack her wares into a worn satchel. Her hands move with practiced urgency.
continuation:
EXT. PARK - DAY

GU WAN sits on a bench, catching her breath. She counts crumpled bills in her palm—clearly insufficient.

GU WAN
(quietly)
Dr. Chen's consultation fee... and Jiaming's mother needs her heart medicine. There has to be a way.

She touches a simple silver locket around her neck—her only jewelry.

ZHENG HUANHUAN strides by with two friends, carrying shopping bags from designer stores. She stops, recognizing GU WAN.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
(tilting her sunglasses down)
Well, well. The charity case is playing shopkeeper now? How delightfully desperate.

GU WAN
(standing)
Zheng Huanhuan. I was properly married into this family. I kept your household running when your mother was ill.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
(clicking her tongue)
A maid's work. Nothing more.

She signals to her friends. They block GU WAN's path.

HUANHUAN'S FRIEND 1
Sister Huan, is this really your sister-in-law? She looks... provincial.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
Let me educate you. This is what happens when my brother tries to be noble. He saved her from poverty, and this is her contribution—embarrassing us in public parks.

She snatches GU WAN's satchel and dumps the carefully wrapped herbs onto the ground.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
Let's see what trash you've been peddling.

GU WAN
(trying to retrieve them)
Those took weeks to harvest!

ZHENG HUANHUAN
(coldly)
And they're worth exactly what you are. Nothing.

She grinds one package under her heel. GU WAN freezes, her hands trembling—not with fear, but restrained fury.

GU WAN
(low voice)
I am still your brother's wife.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
A title, not a truth. Remember your place.

HUANHUAN'S FRIEND 2
Maybe we should help her find her "place." The service entrance is that way.

They laugh. GU WAN meets their eyes steadily, a quiet dignity in her bearing that seems out of place with her worn clothes.

Suddenly, a convoy of three luxury SUVs pulls up. Black-suited bodyguards emerge, scanning the area. One approaches, his eyes fixed on GU WAN's locket.

SENIOR GUARD
(to GU WAN, formally)
Miss. We've been searching for three years. Your grandfather's estate awaits your return.

ZHENG HUANHUAN
(stunned)
What did you call her?

The Senior Guard turns to her with a look of ice.

SENIOR GUARD
Step away from the heir to the Gu Fortune. Now.
