title: Mr. Huo, Your Wife is the Real Boss
description: Two strangers fleeing their arranged marriages collide, literally, leading to an unexpected connection and a case of mistaken identity.
context:
Title: Mr. Huo, Your Wife is the Real Boss
Description: Two strangers fleeing their arranged marriages collide, literally, leading to an unexpected connection and a case of mistaken identity.

INT. CORRIDOR - DAY

HUO XINGZHOU (29, sharp suit, jaw set) walks quickly through the corridor, three BODYGUARDS trailing behind—until he suddenly sprints for the exit.

BODYGUARD
Young Master Huo! The ceremony!

EXT. CITY STREET - DAY

JIANG YAN (27, leather jacket, disheveled wedding updo) walks down the street, checking over her shoulder every few steps.

JIANG YAN (V.O.)
Four minutes until they find the mannequin. I need a miracle.

A MOTORCYCLE roars toward her. Jiang Yan steps into the crosswalk without looking—the bike SCREECHES, stopping inches away.

The rider, HUO XINGZHOU (helmeted), spots THREE BLACK SEDANS turning the corner behind her.

JIANG YAN
(no hesitation)
Drive. Now.

She grabs the spare helmet, mounts the bike. The motorcycle PEELS OUT as the sedans screech to a halt.

BODYGUARD
(into radio)
Targets acquired. Miss Jiang is with the heir.

TRANSITION: Ten minutes earlier

INT. WEDDING VENUE - DAY

The EMCEE beams at the full venue.

EMCEE
Welcome the bride and groom!

The "BRIDE" stumbles—veil slips, revealing ASSISTANT XU in a wig.

ASSISTANT XU
She promised this wouldn't go viral!

GRANDFATHER JIANG
(rocketing to his feet)
Where is my granddaughter?!

MADAME HUO
(yanks the groom's mask)
And where is my son?

It's the BEST MAN, sweating.

BEST MAN
Huo Xingzhou left on his motorcycle.

MADAME HUO
(into phone)
Intercept them. They must not meet.
continuation:
EXT. HIGHWAY - DAY

The motorcycle weaves through traffic, sedans closing in.

JIANG YAN
(over the wind)
They're boxing us!

HUO XINGZHOU
Then we go where cars can't.

He swerves onto a construction ramp. The bike bounces wildly—Jiang Yan's arms lock around his waist.

A sedan tries to follow, bottoms out. The bike hits gravel.

They tumble. Jiang Yan lands hard, helmet striking Huo Xingzhou's. Faceplates slam together—through scratched polycarbonate, they're nose to nose.

JIANG YAN (V.O.)
...oh.

She scrambles up, breathing hard.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

DOCTORS wheel Huo Xingzhou—bandaged, unconscious—into a bay. Jiang Yan jogs alongside.

JIANG YAN
Will he—

DOCTOR
Concussion, compound fracture. Twenty-four hour hold.

NURSE
(handing a tray)
His personal effects. Are you family?

JIANG YAN
I... no. I just—

She spots his wallet. Inside: a formal portrait of herself, from the engagement album she'd refused to pose for.

NURSE
(seeing her expression)
Room 407. You can sign as "close contact."

The Nurse exits. Jiang Yan stares at the unconscious man, then at his wedding band—identical to the one she'd thrown in a fountain hours ago.

JIANG YAN
(softly)
So you were running from me.

She reaches for the gauze on his forehead, hesitates.

FADE OUT.

title: The Mu Manor's Daughter's Wedding
description: A noble family's daughter marries and leaves home to travel to the capital, bidding farewell to her beloved family.
context:
Title: The Mu Manor's Daughter's Wedding
Description: A noble family's daughter marries and leaves home to travel to the capital, bidding farewell to her beloved family.

INT. MU ROYAL MANOR - DAY

The plaque of the Mu Royal Manor hangs high, the atmosphere solemn yet tinged with the sadness of parting.

MU CHANGXUAN wears a magnificent red wedding dress, a phoenix crown on her head, her features exquisite, but her eyes filled with reluctance to leave her family.

MU CHANGXUAN'S FATHER holds his daughter's hand, pressing the sword callus on her palm.

MU CHANGXUAN'S FATHER
Shengjing is not our Northwest. Shen Yan is a good man, but your temper is a blade. Sheathe it wisely.

MU CHANGXUAN (eyes brimming with tears)
Father, who will remind me to wear my cloak?

MU CHANGXUAN'S MOTHER adjusts the phoenix crown.

MU CHANGXUAN'S MOTHER
Your father checked the dowry list seven times. Write to us. Not just the good parts.

MU CHANGXUAN
Father, Mother, Brothers... Xuan'er is leaving. You must all take care.

MU JING, Mu Changxuan's eldest brother, has a serious expression.

MU JING
Imperial decree binds us to the Northwest. Not even for your wedding. Do not forgive us.

SECOND BROTHER offers a small falcon bell.

SECOND BROTHER
The capital speaks in whispers. Ring this at the northern gate.

THIRD BROTHER cracks his knuckles.

THIRD BROTHER
If Shen Yan forgets that elbow strike—remind him.

MU CHANGXUAN, hearing this, smiles through her tears.
continuation:
MU CHANGXUAN
Third Brother... the grain sacks are terrified of me now.

A shout comes from the distance.

SERVANT (O.S.)
The wedding procession has arrived!

MU CHANGXUAN'S FATHER holds back his tears, picks up the red veil, and places it over his daughter's head.

MU CHANGXUAN'S FATHER
Go.

MU JING takes his sister's hand and escorts her out.

EXT. MU ROYAL MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

The wedding procession is already waiting at the entrance. The groom SHEN YAN wears red wedding attire, riding on a tall horse, looking heroic and imposing.

MU JING places his sister's hand into SHEN YAN'S hand. SHEN YAN takes MU CHANGXUAN'S hand and gently lifts a corner of her veil.

MU CHANGXUAN (playfully)
Trade me places. I'll take the horse.

MU CHANGXUAN'S FATHER (O.S.)
Xuan'er!

SHEN YAN
Cover it. Quickly now.

MU CHANGXUAN
Then next time, I'm the groom.

SHEN YAN
And I'd choose you anyway.

MU CHANGXUAN
Mm.

SHEN YAN replaces her veil properly, takes her hand, and walks toward the festive wedding sedan chair. The Mu family stands at the entrance, watching them depart, their eyes filled with blessings and reluctance.

SECOND BROTHER offers a small falcon bell.

SECOND BROTHER
The capital speaks in whispers. Ring this at the northern gate.

THIRD BROTHER cracks his knuckles.

THIRD BROTHER
If Shen Yan forgets that elbow strike—remind him.

MU CHANGXUAN, hearing this, smiles through her tears.

MU CHANGXUAN
Third Brother... the grain sacks are terrified of me now.

A shout comes from the distance.

SERVANT (O.S.)
The wedding procession has arrived!

MU CHANGXUAN'S FATHER holds back his tears, picks up the red veil, and places it over his daughter's head.

MU CHANGXUAN'S FATHER
Go.

MU JING takes his sister's hand and escorts her out.

EXT. MU ROYAL MANOR ENTRANCE - DAY

The wedding procession is already waiting at the entrance. The groom SHEN YAN wears red wedding attire, riding on a tall horse, looking heroic and imposing.

MU JING places his sister's hand into SHEN YAN'S hand. SHEN YAN takes MU CHANGXUAN'S hand and gently lifts a corner of her veil.

MU CHANGXUAN (playfully)
Trade me places. I'll take the horse.

MU CHANGXUAN'S FATHER (O.S.)
Xuan'er!

SHEN YAN
Cover it. Quickly now.

MU CHANGXUAN
Then next time, I'm the groom.

SHEN YAN
And I'd choose you anyway.

MU CHANGXUAN
Mm.

SHEN YAN replaces her veil properly, takes her hand, and walks toward the festive wedding sedan chair. The Mu family stands at the entrance, watching them depart, their eyes filled with blessings and reluctance.

title: Listening to My Daughter's Thoughts Made Me a Landlady
description: A young mother who can hear her newborn daughter's thoughts discovers her baby has superpowers and uses them to fight back against her scheming family.
context:
Title: Listening to My Daughter's Thoughts Made Me a Landlady
Description: A young mother who can hear her newborn daughter's thoughts discovers her baby has superpowers and uses them to fight back against her scheming family.

INT. LIN FAMILY VILLA - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

A stormy night. Dark clouds cover the city sky. Rain lashes against windows.

NEWS BROADCAST (V.O.)
The National Meteorological Center warns of severe storms tonight, with potential power outages. Citizens should remain indoors while crews work to restore services.

A PREGNANT WOMAN lies in a pool of blood on the marble floor, cradling her belly. Her breathing is shallow. This is LIN MENG'S MOTHER.

PREGNANT WOMAN
(whispering)
I'll protect you... I'll bring you safely into this world...

Her hand slips. Lightning flashes.

EXT. CITY STREET - NIGHT (FLASHBACK)

An ambulance speeds through the downpour, sirens wailing.

INT. HOSPITAL DELIVERY ROOM - DAY

LIN MENG (25) lies on the delivery bed, drenched in sweat, pushing through exhaustion.

DOCTOR
One more push, Lin. You're almost there.

A newborn's cry echoes through the room.

DOCTOR
Congratulations. It's a girl.

LIN MENG collapses back, tears of relief streaming down her face as a NURSE places the baby on her chest.

INT. PRIVATE HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LIN MENG, in a hospital gown, sits on the bed cradling her daughter LIN XIXI. She touches the baby's tiny fingers.

LIN MENG
(softly)
You chose me. And I'll be the mother you deserve.

The door swings open. LIN ZHIWEI (50s, worn suit) enters with WANG AIJUN (40s, designer handbag) and LIN YANRAN (22, smug expression).

LIN YANRAN
(leering)
Already popped out a bastard? How efficient.

LIN MENG
(eyes flashing)
My daughter is not a bastard.

WANG AIJUN
You don't even know the father's name. What would you call it?

FLASHBACK BEGINS:
continuation:
INT. KTV PRIVATE ROOM - NIGHT

LIN MENG struggles against a SHADOWY FIGURE pinning her to a sofa.

LIN MENG
Let go! I was just delivering documents—

The scene cuts away.

FLASHBACK ENDS.

INT. PRIVATE HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LIN MENG
(to Lin Yanran)
You sent me there that night. You set me up.

WANG AIJUN steps forward and SNATCHES the baby from Lin Meng's arms.

LIN MENG
(frantic)
Give her back! Give her back!

LIN YANRAN slaps a document onto the bed tray.

LIN YANRAN
Sign the gift agreement for the old house, and you can keep your mistake.

LIN MENG scans the document: "Property Gift Agreement - 47 Lin Family Lane."

LIN MENG
(voice cracking)
This is all Mom left me. You're taking that too?

LIN YANRAN
Mom and I are the real Lin family now. We deserve what's ours. Right, Dad?

LIN ZHIWEI
(avoiding eye contact)
Just sign it, Meng. Keep the peace.

LIN MENG
(desperate)
You're using my daughter as leverage?

LIN YANRAN
Sign, or I drop her at the police station. Abandoned.

WANG AIJUN shakes the baby slightly. Lin Xixi begins to CRY.

LIN MENG
(breaking)
No—okay! I'll sign!

Lin Meng grabs the pen, hand shaking. She touches the paper.

LIN XIXI (V.O.)
Mommy. Don't sign. Please.

LIN MENG stops. Freezes. Looks around.

LIN MENG
...What?

LIN XIXI (V.O.)
It's me, Mommy. Listen.

LIN YANRAN
What's the hold-up? Sign!

Lin Meng stares at her daughter. Lin Xixi stops crying. Their eyes lock. Lin Meng's expression hardens.

She RIPS the document in half.

LIN MENG
No.

LIN XIXI (V.O.)
Bad woman. Hurt Mommy. Now you pay.

A faint BLUE LIGHT pulses from Lin Xixi's blanket, streaking toward Lin Yanran. Lin Yanran DOUBLES OVER, clutching her stomach.

LIN YANRAN
(gasping)
Mom—my stomach—

WANG AIJUN
What is it?

Lin Yanran GAGS, a wave of nausea hitting her. She stumbles.

LIN ZHIWEI
(stepping back)
Yanran, you're green. Get to the bathroom.

Lin Yanran sprints for the door, a hand clamped over her mouth. Lin Meng watches, eyes wide, a small smile forming.

LIN YANRAN
(at the door, voice muffled)
This isn't over!

Wang Aijun shoves the baby back into Lin Meng's arms.

WANG AIJUN
(hissing)
Take your brat and get out. This room isn't free.

LIN XIXI (V.O.)
Ouch. No manners, Grandma.

LIN MENG
(to Wang Aijun)
You can't kick me out—I'm still admitted.

WANG AIJUN
Your chart says discharged. Now.

Wang Aijun pushes Lin Meng toward the door. Lin Xixi begins to CRY again.

LIN MENG
(cradling Xixi)
Okay. We're leaving. We're leaving.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Lin Meng, barefoot in her hospital gown, carries Lin Xixi through the fluorescent-lit hallway.

LIN XIXI (V.O.)
Don't cry, Mommy. Your love woke me up. Now I'll protect you. We'll be okay.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Beneath the Mask
description: A woman goes undercover as a hotel maid to find her mother's killer while a reluctant heir tries to avoid an arranged marriage, their paths colliding during a high-stakes heist.
context:
Title: Beneath the Mask
Description: A woman goes undercover as a hotel maid to find her mother's killer while a reluctant heir tries to avoid an arranged marriage, their paths colliding during a high-stakes heist.

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - DAY

Two MEN in white shirts and black suspenders stride past, their footsteps echoing off marble.

YUN QIANQIAN (20s) pushes a cleaning cart, her knuckles white on the handle.

YUN QIANQIAN (V.O.)
Grandpa's blind date. His old comrade's grandson. Meanwhile, I'm here for SIT's classified chip. The one that might tell me who killed Mom.

She stops at a reinforced door, keycard ready.

INT. MODERN BUILDING LOBBY - DAY

HUO CHENYUAN (late 20s) leads SUBORDINATES through the bright lobby, earpiece in place. Commanding presence, but his shoulders are tense.

ON SCREEN: Character introduction card in comic style: [CODENAME: SNOW EAGLE - HUO CHENYUAN, SIT Security Chief]

INT. VAULT - NIGHT

YUN QIANQIAN ditches the maid uniform, revealing a black tactical suit. She secures a mask.

ON SCREEN: Character introduction card in comic style: [CODENAME: AGENT J - YUN QIANQIAN, Independent Contractor]

ASSISTANT
Boss, the outfit's convincing. But your mother called again. She's serious about this marriage.

HUO CHENYUAN
I'm serious about not being traded like company stock. Focus on the summit.

ASSISTANT
The summit's covered. You can't dodge family duty forever.

HUO CHENYUAN
Watch me.

INT. VAULT - NIGHT

YUN QIANQIAN rappels from a ceiling vent, landing silent. She deploys a disruptor against the security panel.
continuation:
INT. MODERN BUILDING LOBBY - DAY

HUO CHENYUAN and ASSISTANT walk through the lobby.

ASSISTANT
Someone's breached the vault suite. Bypassed perimeter security.

HUO CHENYUAN
(serious expression)
Seal all exits immediately. We cannot let SIT's top secret be stolen!

ASSISTANT
Yes, sir!

SECURITY GUARDS rush off.

Suddenly, BLACK-CLAD THUGS block their path.

THUG LEADER
Mr. Huo. Our employer wants that encryption key. Hand it over.

ASSISTANT
More fools with a death wish. Boss, your sparring partners have arrived.

HUO CHENYUAN
(contemptuous)
I've got ninety seconds.

INT. VAULT - NIGHT

Red laser grids pulse. YUN QIANQIAN flows through them, planting micro-bypasses.

INT. MODERN BUILDING LOBBY - DAY

THUGS charge. HUO CHENYUAN demonstrates exceptional combat skills—precise, economical. He uses his suit jacket as a weapon, taking them down one by one.

GRANDPA (O.S.)
(through phone)
Qianqian, have you met Grandpa's old comrade's grandson yet? Have a good chat with him.

YUN QIANQIAN (V.O.)
(into communicator)
Don't worry, Grandpa. I'm making a great impression.

She slips through the final laser.

HUO CHENYUAN defeats the last thug, taking the phone from ASSISTANT.

MOTHER (O.S.)
(through phone)
Chenyuan, have you met your grandfather's old comrade's granddaughter yet? You must seal the deal today!

HUO CHENYUAN
Don't worry, Mom. I'm sealing something.

He hangs up. ASSISTANT checks his pocket watch.

ASSISTANT
One minute twelve. Sloppy.

HUO CHENYUAN
I was multitasking.

MONTAGE

Split screen: LEFT shows HUO CHENYUAN watching vault feeds. RIGHT shows YUN QIANQIAN entering the final safe code.

HUO CHENYUAN (V.O.)
Catch the thief. Protect the secret.

YUN QIANQIAN (V.O.)
Get the chip. Find the killer.

INT. VAULT - NIGHT

YUN QIANQIAN enters the code on the safe and opens it. An alarm blares. She looks up, straight into the security camera.

INT. MODERN BUILDING LOBBY - DAY

HUO CHENYUAN senses it, snapping his head up. He smiles.

HUO CHENYUAN
(into comms)
Checkmate.

FADE OUT.

title: Young Master Gu's Pampered Little Wife (Episode 1 of 80)
description: A woman wakes up to discover she's been betrayed by her fiancé and cousin on her wedding day, and learns the terrible truth about her past.
context:
Title: Young Master Gu's Pampered Little Wife (Episode 1 of 80)
Description: A woman wakes up to discover she's been betrayed by her fiancé and cousin on her wedding day, and learns the terrible truth about her past.

INT. HOTEL BEDROOM - NIGHT

QIAO NUAN lies on the bed, her eyes fluttering open. A shirtless MAN leans over her, his face obscured, trailing kisses along her collarbone.

QIAO NUAN (V.O.)
(whispered, fragmented)
Dead... I was supposed to be...

MAN
You wanted this, Qiao Nuan. Remember that.

He continues, but Qiao Nuan's body remains rigid, unresponsive.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

ON SCREEN: On the wedding day, having an affair with the bride's cousin

YOUAN (the fiancé) reclines on the sofa. The COUSIN curls in his lap, toying with his tie.

COUSIN
(softly, teasing)
She's still your wife, Brother Youan. For the next hour, at least.

YOUAN
A cripple who can't even walk down the aisle? Hardly a wife.

COUSIN
And the baby she lost? Was that... inconvenient?

YOUAN
The car accident solved two problems at once. Be grateful.

The Cousin smiles, leaning in to kiss him.
continuation:
QIAO NUAN (O.S.)
(filtered, as if underwater)
Brother Youan...?

The couple freezes. QIAO NUAN sits in her wheelchair in the doorway, veil askew, hands trembling on the wheels.

QIAO NUAN
(whisper)
What did you say... about the accident?

YOUAN
(exchanging look with Cousin)
You're early.

COUSIN
(standing smoothly)
Let me help you freshen up before the ceremony.

She takes a step toward Qiao Nuan.

INT. BATHROOM - DAY

QIAO NUAN gasps awake, submerged in bathtub water. She thrashes upward, coughing.

QIAO NUAN
(choking)
No—stop—

The COUSIN stands over the tub, holding a hair dryer, its plug near the water.

COUSIN
(calmly)
Don't worry. It'll look like an accident. Again.

She reaches for the plug.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Mr. Gu, Your Wife Ran Away With A Child
description: A woman drugged at a party seeks help from her cold husband, only to face his cruelty and humiliation in their loveless marriage.
context:
Title: Mr. Gu, Your Wife Ran Away With A Child
Description: A woman drugged at a party seeks help from her cold husband, only to face his cruelty and humiliation in their loveless marriage.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - NIGHT

Candlelight flickers across an overturned wine glass.

YUN YI lies on the bed, breathing heavily, painfully clutching the sheets. She has clearly been drugged.

GU YUBAI sits on the sofa, looking at her coldly.

GU YUBAI
Attending a party and getting drugged, you really are predictable.

YUN YI struggles to get up from the bed and reaches out to GU YUBAI for help.

YUN YI
(weakly)
Xiaobai... save me... help me...

YUN YI lunges toward GU YUBAI and embraces him. GU YUBAI pushes her down onto the bed and leans over her.

GU YUBAI
I've told you many times, don't call me that.

GU YUBAI grabs YUN YI's chin.

GU YUBAI
You want me to help you? Do you deserve it?

YUN YI
(tearfully)
I'm your wife!

GU YUBAI roughly pushes her away.

GU YUBAI
We both know how this marriage came to be. How dare you call me that?

Under the effect of the drug, YUN YI unconsciously caresses GU YUBAI's neck and ear. GU YUBAI's expression is conflicted. Finally, he picks her up and carries her toward the bed.

LATER

GU YUBAI takes a whip from a box and walks toward YUN YI lying on the bed. His knuckles whiten around the handle, then he drops it on the floor and walks away.
continuation:
EXT. GU FAMILY ESTATE - DAY

In the antique courtyard.

WEI XINNING, wearing a black slip dress, is pouring tea for an elegant OLD MADAM.

WEI XINNING
(respectfully)
Old Madam, please.

The OLD MADAM takes the teacup.

OLD MADAM
I've been hoping that Xiaoyi and Yubai would give me a chubby grandson.

WEI XINNING
(pointedly)
Mrs. Gu has been married for over two years, and her belly still hasn't shown any signs.

WEI XINNING
Old Madam, haven't you ever suspected that Mrs. Gu might actually be a hen that can't lay eggs?

The OLD MADAM's expression instantly darkens.

Xiaobai... save me... help me...

YUN YI lunges toward GU YUBAI and embraces him. GU YUBAI pushes her down onto the bed and leans over her.

GU YUBAI
I've told you many times, don't call me that.

GU YUBAI grabs YUN YI's chin.

GU YUBAI
You want me to help you? Do you deserve it?

YUN YI
(tearfully)
I'm your wife!

GU YUBAI roughly pushes her away.

GU YUBAI
We both know how this marriage came to be. How dare you call me that?

Under the effect of the drug, YUN YI unconsciously caresses GU YUBAI's neck and ear. GU YUBAI's expression is conflicted. Finally, he picks her up and carries her toward the bed.

LATER

GU YUBAI takes a whip from a box and walks toward YUN YI lying on the bed. His knuckles whiten around the handle, then he drops it on the floor and walks away.

EXT. GU FAMILY ESTATE - DAY

In the antique courtyard.

WEI XINNING, wearing a black slip dress, is pouring tea for an elegant OLD MADAM.

WEI XINNING
(respectfully)
Old Madam, please.

The OLD MADAM takes the teacup.

OLD MADAM
I've been hoping that Xiaoyi and Yubai would give me a chubby grandson.

WEI XINNING
(pointedly)
Mrs. Gu has been married for over two years, and her belly still hasn't shown any signs.

WEI XINNING
Old Madam, haven't you ever suspected that Mrs. Gu might actually be a hen that can't lay eggs?

The OLD MADAM's expression instantly darkens.

title: Mr. Gu's Secret Love
description: A young woman is pressured by her family to go on blind dates for dowry money, only to discover her date is the nephew she once promised to marry.
context:
Title: Mr. Gu's Secret Love
Description: A young woman is pressured by her family to go on blind dates for dowry money, only to discover her date is the nephew she once promised to marry.

INT. STREET - DAY

The ELDEST DAUGHTER OF THE SHEN FAMILY rides an electric scooter and stops by the roadside. She takes out her phone.

The phone rings.

ELDEST DAUGHTER answers the phone.

AUNT WANG (V.O.)
Three hundred thousand. He's waiting.

ELDEST DAUGHTER
That's enough for everything?

AUNT WANG (V.O.)
Every debt. Now go.

ELDEST DAUGHTER hangs up. She takes a deep breath.

INT. SHEN FAMILY HOME - DAY

ELDEST DAUGHTER returns home. SHEN'S MOTHER and SHEN'S YOUNGER BROTHER stand in the living room.

SHEN'S MOTHER
You'll go. You'll say yes.

ELDEST DAUGHTER
Mom, he's fifty—

SHEN'S MOTHER
And he'll pay your brother's way. That's what matters.

SHEN'S YOUNGER BROTHER
Just do this one thing. Please.

ELDEST DAUGHTER looks at her brother, then her mother.

ELDEST DAUGHTER
I'll bring you the money. Then I'm done.

She turns and leaves.
continuation:
INT. STREET - DAY

ELDEST DAUGHTER sits on her electric scooter. She checks her phone - a photo of MR. ZHANG, distinguished but older.

ELDEST DAUGHTER
(to herself)
Three months. Then I'm free.

INT. GU MINGZE'S OFFICE - DAY

GU MINGZE wears a suit. SPECIAL ASSISTANT LI enters with a group of BODYGUARDS.

EVERYONE
Hello, Mr. Gu.

GU MINGZE
What's this?

SPECIAL ASSISTANT LI
Old Madam's orders. The café. The blind date.

GU MINGZE
Fine. But why the escort?

SPECIAL ASSISTANT LI
Precaution. She doesn't remember you.

The BODYGUARDS leave.

GU MINGZE
And the money?

SPECIAL ASSISTANT LI
Transferred to Shen family this morning.

GU MINGZE
Good.

INT. CAFÉ - DAY

ELDEST DAUGHTER walks into the café and sees GU MINGZE sitting by the window.

ELDEST DAUGHTER (thinking)
Wrong table. Too young. But...

ELDEST DAUGHTER walks over and sits down across from GU MINGZE.

ELDEST DAUGHTER
Hello. I'm here for the blind date.

GU MINGZE
I know. I arranged it.

ELDEST DAUGHTER
You're not—

GU MINGZE
I'm Gu Mingze. The nephew you left behind.

FLASHBACK - INT. GARDEN - DAY

YOUNG GU MINGZE picks a rose and walks toward his AUNT sitting on a swing.

YOUNG GU MINGZE
Aunt, this flower is for you.

AUNT
Thank you, my dear nephew.

YOUNG GU MINGZE
When I grow up, I'm going to marry you.

AUNT
But I'm your aunt—

YOUNG GU MINGZE
Grandma said you were adopted. So we can.

AUNT
(smiling)
Then wait for me.

INT. CAFÉ - DAY

Back to reality, GU MINGZE and ELDEST DAUGHTER look at each other.

GU MINGZE
I waited fifteen years.

ELDEST DAUGHTER
You bought my family's debt.

GU MINGZE
I bought our promise.

ELDEST DAUGHTER
That was a child's game.

GU MINGZE
Was it?

He places a small velvet box on the table.

The image freezes on ELDEST DAUGHTER's hand, reaching toward it.

title: Secretary Gu Wants a Divorce Every Day
description: Secretary Gu Shanshan wakes up after a drunken night to discover she may have cheated on her contract husband, CEO Pei. When she finds out she's pregnant, she must destroy the evidence before he discovers the truth.
context:
Title: Secretary Gu Wants a Divorce Every Day
Description: Secretary Gu Shanshan wakes up after a drunken night to discover she may have cheated on her contract husband, CEO Pei. When she finds out she's pregnant, she must destroy the evidence before he discovers the truth.

INT. HOTEL ROOM - MORNING

GU SHANSHAN wakes up in bed with a splitting headache. She sits up, discovers men's clothing and a tie scattered beside the bed. Her fingers tremble as she touches the silk.

FLASHBACK

QUICK FLASHES: Gu Shanshan kissing a man passionately in this very room. His face remains SHADOWED.

END FLASHBACK

GU SHANSHAN covers her mouth, her face pale.

GU SHANSHAN (V.O.)
Three months into this contract marriage, and I've already blown it.

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTING ROOM - DAY

Doctor SUN XIANG studies a B-ultrasound report with professional detachment.

SUN XIANG
Six weeks. Congratulations.

GU SHANSHAN and her friend TANG NING freeze. Tang's jaw drops.

GU SHANSHAN
You're... sure?

TANG NING
Six weeks?!

TANG NING snatches the report, scanning it.

TANG NING
(whispering)
Six weeks ago... that's when you...

GU SHANSHAN
(nods, voice cracking)
Don't say it.

TANG NING
(urgent)
Does CEO Pei know?

GU SHANSHAN
He doesn't even know I exist outside the office.

FLASHBACK

INT. HOTEL CORRIDOR - NIGHT

A month ago. Gu Shanshan stumbles against the wall, drunk, disoriented. A door opens. She slips inside.

END FLASHBACK

INT. HOSPITAL CONSULTING ROOM - DAY

TANG NING
Then you can't let him find out. Not with your father's bills. Not with—

GU SHANSHAN's phone rings. Caller ID: "CEO PEI."

GU SHANSHAN
(shaking)
It's him.

TANG NING
Don't answer—!

GU SHANSHAN forces a smile, answers.

GU SHANSHAN
(into phone)
Secretary Gu speaking.

PEI HANKONG (V.O.)
Physical examination. Company-wide. 2 PM. You'll coordinate.

GU SHANSHAN
(frozen)
Physical...?

PEI HANKONG (V.O.)
Problem?

GU SHANSHAN
(quickly)
No, CEO Pei. I'll handle it.

She hangs up. Her hand trembles.

GU SHANSHAN
Pregnant women can't take X-rays. I'm done for.

She grabs the report and stands.

GU SHANSHAN
I'll resign. Right now.

TANG NING blocks her.

TANG NING
That's admitting guilt. The money, your dad, the baby—think!

GU SHANSHAN
What choice do I have?

TANG NING
That hotel keeps surveillance for thirty days. If you can get to it first...

GU SHANSHAN
(hope dawning)
The footage. If I delete it...

TANG NING
Go. I'll stall the medical team.

GU SHANSHAN squeezes her hand, then bolts.
continuation:
INT. PEI HANKONG'S OFFICE - DAY

PEI HANKONG sits on his sofa, a surveillance photo on his tablet—an image of Gu Shanshan in the hotel corridor, face obscured. Assistant LIANG YAN enters.

LIANG YAN
CEO Pei, the original footage from that night is at the hotel. They won't release it digitally.

PEI HANKONG
Then we'll retrieve it ourselves.

PEI HANKONG stands, his expression unreadable.

INT. HOTEL LOBBY - DAY

GU SHANSHAN flashes her corporate ID at the front desk.

GU SHANSHAN
CEO Pei's office. We need the surveillance backup from March 15th.

FRONT DESK CLERK
One moment.

The clerk produces a USB drive.

FRONT DESK CLERK
This month's archive. Sign here.

As Gu signs, she spots PEI HANKONG and LIANG YAN entering the lobby.

GU SHANSHAN
(snatching USB)
Thank you.

She turns—straight into PEI HANKONG.

GU SHANSHAN
(panicking)
CEO Pei.

PEI HANKONG
Gu Shanshan.

Gu nervously pockets the USB.

PEI HANKONG
What brings you here?

GU SHANSHAN
Just... company business.

LIANG YAN
The footage we requested—

GU SHANSHAN
I'll deliver it personally.

PEI HANKONG
Hand it over.

GU SHANSHAN
Sir, I really think—

LIANG YAN reaches for her pocket. Gu instinctively clutches her bag—the report inside.

GU SHANSHAN (V.O.)
The ultrasound. That's worse than the footage.

LIANG YAN
Your bag, Secretary Gu.

PEI HANKONG
I'll take that.

He extends his hand. Gu's face drains of color. The scene freezes.

title: Double Joy at the Yan Mansion
description: On the day of the warlord's triumphant return, two new concubines are brought into the Yan Mansion, but a deadly conspiracy lurks beneath the festive celebrations.
context:
Title: Double Joy at the Yan Mansion
Description: On the day of the warlord's triumphant return, two new concubines are brought into the Yan Mansion, but a deadly conspiracy lurks beneath the festive celebrations.

INT. YAN MANSION - DAY

Gongs and drums clash, firecrackers explode in bursts of red paper.

DEPUTY CHEN, dressed in military uniform, stands solemnly at the entrance of the Yan Mansion.

Two large red bridal sedan chairs are carried into the mansion. A crowd gathers, the atmosphere festive but strained.

Inside one sedan chair, FIFTH CONCUBINE XIA, wearing a red wedding dress, lifts her red veil and smiles.

Inside the other sedan chair, SIXTH CONCUBINE SHEN XIN'ER, also in wedding attire, nervously peers out through a gap.

DEPUTY CHEN
(shouting)
The auspicious hour approaches! Commander Yan's double blessing! Carry the sedan chairs, enter!

The crowd applauds and cheers, though the sound is thin.

SHEN XIN'ER sees her sister SHEN QINGZHU, dressed in a maid's uniform, through the sedan chair.

SHEN XIN'ER
(softly)
Qingzhu—

SHEN QINGZHU walks to the sedan chair and holds SHEN XIN'ER's hand, pressing a small silk pouch into her palm.

SHEN QINGZHU
Don't be nervous. And don't trust anyone.

The sedan chairs are carried deep into the mansion.
continuation:
INT. YAN MANSION RECEPTION HALL - DAY

THE FIRST WIFE sits in the main seat, holding prayer beads. THE SECOND CONCUBINE and several other concubines sit around a table drinking tea and eating snacks.

SECOND CONCUBINE
Today is truly a wonderful day. The Commander returns victorious, and the Yan Mansion welcomes two new sisters at the same time. From now on, things will be much livelier around here.

SECOND CONCUBINE
I heard that these two sisters each have their own charms. Fifth Sister is the world's greatest opera singer, with a voice that's absolutely exquisite. And Sixth Sister, everyone who's seen her says she looks like... the late First Madam.

The atmosphere instantly becomes tense.

SECOND CONCUBINE
(coldly smiling)
She's as beautiful as a lotus flower emerging from water. When the Commander sees her, he'll surely fall head over heels. These two are quite capable little vixens. But so what? They probably don't know yet how Fourth Sister died.

FIRST WIFE
(calmly)
In the future, all the sisters will serve the Commander together. I hope you will all live in harmony.

SECOND CONCUBINE
(meaningfully)
Then tonight, we should take good care of our new sisters.

INT. BRIDAL CHAMBER - NIGHT

Rain lashes the windows. Thunder and lightning flash outside. A single candle flickers on the dressing table.

SHEN QINGZHU enters quietly, dressed as a maid, carrying a bowl of warm wine.

SHEN QINGZHU
Xin'er? I've brought—

She looks up and discovers FIFTH CONCUBINE XIA, wearing a red wedding dress, hanging from the beam by a white silk rope. The body sways gently.

SHEN QINGZHU
(screaming in terror)
Ah!

SHEN QINGZHU stumbles backward, her eyes on the hanging corpse. She sees the silk pouch she gave her sister lying open on the floor below, its contents scattered.

SHEN QINGZHU
(crying out)
Xin'er!

CLOSE-UP: The hanged XIA's face is deathly pale, eyes wide open, reflecting the candle's flame.

title: Betrayal and Truth
description: A woman discovers her husband's affair and a shocking secret about her son's true parentage.
context:
Title: Betrayal and Truth
Description: A woman discovers her husband's affair and a shocking secret about her son's true parentage.

INT. MODERN APARTMENT - NIGHT

Dim lamplight cuts through silence. ZHANG BO (45, immaculate suit, predator's patience) holds his phone. LINLIN (28, sharp edges, hungry eyes) drifts toward the door. YAO YAO (42, trembling resilience) hides under the dining table, knuckles white against the floor.

ZHANG BO
(into phone, smooth)
Yao Yao. Stop panicking. She's probably walking home. One missed call from half an hour ago isn't a crisis.

He pockets the phone. Moves to Linlin. Fingers trace her waist, familiar.

LINLIN
(quiet, venomous)
Dead weight cow...

ZHANG BO
She'll return for her phone. Let's not be here.

LINLIN
(coquettish edge)
You're wicked.

He guides her toward the door, arm possessive at her waist. Yao Yao begins crawling out, panicked. Her knee KNOCKS a chair leg.

Freeze. Zhang Bo's head turns. He moves back, crouches, peers under the table. His eyes find hers.

ZHANG BO
(soft, lethal)
Come out.

Yao Yao emerges. Stands. Her back finds the wall. No escape.
continuation:
ZHANG BO
If Linlin hadn't noticed your slippers missing from the entrance, I wouldn't have known.

YAO YAO
(crying, but sharp)
You cheat and you hunt me? Zhang Bo, this is my home.

ZHANG BO
(contemptuous)
Trash I lifted from poverty. Don't forget—your son breathes because I pay for it.

LINLIN
(from doorway)
That private suite costs more than your existence.

YAO YAO
(stands taller)
He's your son. Your blood. You wouldn't abandon him.

ZHANG BO
(sneering)
That bastard? Worthy? Six years ago, I drugged your wine. You vanished. Returned pregnant.

He slaps her. Hard. Her head snaps. When she looks back, something is shattered behind her eyes.

ZHANG BO
You made me a fool. You owe me everything.

Yao Yao covers her face. Stares at him. Shock calcifies into horror.

YAO YAO (V.O.)
Drugged... another man... that night... wasn't him?

Her face fills with disbelief.

(soft, lethal)
Come out.

Yao Yao emerges. Stands. Her back finds the wall. No escape.

ZHANG BO
If Linlin hadn't noticed your slippers missing from the entrance, I wouldn't have known.

YAO YAO
(crying, but sharp)
You cheat and you hunt me? Zhang Bo, this is my home.

ZHANG BO
(contemptuous)
Trash I lifted from poverty. Don't forget—your son breathes because I pay for it.

LINLIN
(from doorway)
That private suite costs more than your existence.

YAO YAO
(stands taller)
He's your son. Your blood. You wouldn't abandon him.

ZHANG BO
(sneering)
That bastard? Worthy? Six years ago, I drugged your wine. You vanished. Returned pregnant.

He slaps her. Hard. Her head snaps. When she looks back, something is shattered behind her eyes.

ZHANG BO
You made me a fool. You owe me everything.

Yao Yao covers her face. Stares at him. Shock calcifies into horror.

YAO YAO (V.O.)
Drugged... another man... that night... wasn't him?

Her face fills with disbelief.

title: Soaring into the Sky & Legend of the Clouds & Love in the Blue Sky
description: A flight attendant and a businessman engage in a risky affair aboard a plane, only to be caught by her unsuspecting husband.
context:
Title: Soaring into the Sky & Legend of the Clouds & Love in the Blue Sky
Description: A flight attendant and a businessman engage in a risky affair aboard a plane, only to be caught by her unsuspecting husband.

INT. AIRPLANE CABIN - DAY

FLIGHT ATTENDANT navigates her cart through business class, her polished smile masking exhaustion. She pauses near row four.

The camera shifts to the passenger seats, where MR. LU and HUSBAND sit side by side. MR. LU types on his phone. HUSBAND sleeps against the window.

The Flight Attendant approaches MR. LU, her steps faltering when she sees his face.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT
Sir? Your water.

MR. LU looks up. Recognition passes between them—charged and unwelcome.

MR. LU
Thank you.

As the Flight Attendant turns to HUSBAND, her voice drops to a private whisper.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT
Honey... wake up.

She touches his shoulder. HUSBAND stirs but doesn't wake. MR. LU's eyes sharpen—he watches this intimate gesture.

The Flight Attendant walks away. MR. LU glances at HUSBAND's left hand—wedding ring. Then at the disappearing attendant—same ring on her finger.

INT. AIRPLANE LAVATORY - CONTINUOUS

The Flight Attendant enters, locking the door. A soft knock—two taps, then one. She opens it.

MR. LU slips inside, phone already in hand.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT
(whispering)
You promised you deleted that.

MR. LU
I promised many things. You promised to stay away.

He points the camera at the mirror, capturing both their faces.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT
(strangled)
He'll hear us. He has before.

MR. LU
Then be quiet.

He grabs her wrist, pulling her close. Their embrace is violent, desperate—power and punishment, not passion.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT
(between tears)
Please... not like this.

MR. LU
You chose this. Every time.
continuation:
INT. AIRPLANE CABIN - LATER

Turbulence jolts HUSBAND awake. He rubs his eyes, notices MR. LU's phone—abandoned on the seat, screen glowing.

A notification: "Shared album: [Flight Attendant's first name]"

HUSBAND's eyes move to the Flight Attendant's name tag. The album name matches.

He picks up the phone. The album opens—video thumbnail shows his wife in a hotel room. Timestamp: three months ago.

HUSBAND's breath catches. He looks toward the lavatory. A PASSENGER waits, annoyed.

PASSENGER
Both occupied for twenty minutes.

HUSBAND stands, walks over. He hesitates, then presses his ear to the door.

Muffled sounds. A voice—his wife's—stifled, familiar.

HUSBAND
(to himself)
That's... her...

He tries the handle. Locked. His wedding ring scrapes the metal.

INT. AIRPLANE LAVATORY - CONTINUOUS

The Flight Attendant and MR. LU freeze at the sound. Her wedding ring sits on the sink, abandoned.

MR. LU points the phone camera at the mirror, capturing their reflection.

MR. LU
(quietly)
Smile for the camera.

FLIGHT ATTENDANT
(panicked)
He's right there—

MR. LU
Then you'd better answer it.

INT. AIRPLANE CABIN AISLE - CONTINUOUS

HUSBAND stands outside the lavatory door, hearing strange sounds.

HUSBAND
(to himself)
Why does that sound so familiar?

He suspiciously places his hand on the door handle and gently pushes it open a crack.

He sees his wife being intimate with MR. LU inside. The phone camera catches her face—eyes wide with terror.

HUSBAND's eyes widen in shock as he pushes the door open.

HUSBAND
(shouting)
WIFE!

MR. LU and the FLIGHT ATTENDANT both turn around in horror.

The Flight Attendant's expression is not guilt, but pure, desperate fear.

Not of being caught.

Of what comes next.

title: Can't Escape My Grasp
description: An airport ground crew worker falls for a handsome pilot who turns out to be the new CEO of the airline, leading to unexpected complications.
context:
Title: Can't Escape My Grasp
Description: An airport ground crew worker falls for a handsome pilot who turns out to be the new CEO of the airline, leading to unexpected complications.

EXT. AIRPORT RUNWAY - DAY

An Airbus A380 touches down, reverse thrusters roaring.

Ground crew scramble into position. XU XIAOSHUANG (26, efficient, ponytail snapping in the jet wash) marshals the massive plane with crisp hand signals.

Her colleague, LIN, struggles with a jammed luggage cart. Xu Xiaoshuang darts over, kicks the wheel lock free with practiced ease, and shoots Lin a grin.

LIN
Thanks. You make everything look easy.

XU XIAOSHUANG
Muscle memory. Two years of this will do that.

They wheel the baggage train toward the terminal.

INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - DAY

XIAO HEMING (30, captain's stripes on his shoulders) moves through the terminal with the easy confidence of someone who belongs in the sky. Heads turn.

Near the windows, Lin nudges their other colleague, MEI.

LIN
Don't stare.

MEI
Too late.

EXT. TARMAC - DAY

Xu Xiaoshuang glances up from loading bags. She spots Xiao Heming approaching the crew door.

Her hands still. There's something about the way he moves—like the planes she guides, all purpose and grace.

LIN (O.S.)
Earth to Xiaoshuang.

Xu Xiaoshuang startles, nearly dropping a suitcase.

LIN
Eyes on your work, dreamer.
continuation:
INT. AIRPORT TERMINAL - DAY

Xiao Heming's phone buzzes. He checks the screen, his jaw tightens.

XIAO HEMING
(into phone)
Dad. I literally just landed.

(he listens)
No, we are not discussing the board meeting or my personal life in the same breath.

An assistant hovers nearby with a tablet.

ASSISTANT
Mr. Xiao, your 10 a.m.--

XIAO HEMING
(cutting her off)
Reschedule. I'm running the safety inspection myself.

He pockets the phone, his captain's uniform suddenly looking like armor.

EXT. TARMAC / FANTASY SEQUENCE - DAY

Xu Xiaoshuang watches Xiao Heming duck through the crew door. For a heartbeat, she imagines:

--The two of them in a cockpit, him explaining dials and levers, her actually understanding--

BACK TO REALITY

She blinks. A small, real smile plays on her lips. Not just handsome. He looks like he takes his job as seriously as she does.

LIN
Stop grinning at the plane.

XU XIAOSHUANG
Wasn't the plane.

MEI
(jogging over, phone in hand)
Guys. Airport newsfeed just blew up. That captain? He's Xiao Heming. As in, the new CEO of Lanxiang. The founder's son.

XU XIAOSHUANG
CEO? I thought the President's son was... different.

She mimes the bloated, arrogant profile of the former heir apparent.

MEI
That's the older brother. This one's the real deal. Licensed pilot, MIT grad, the whole--

LIN
--fantasy ends here. He's in the boardroom, we're in the baggage hold. Different flight paths.

XU XIAOSHUANG
(quietly)
Doesn't mean we can't look at the sky.

SUPERVISOR (O.S.)
Xu Xiaoshuang! You're stacking those bags wrong!

Xu Xiaoshuang whirls. The bag she'd been holding is indeed upside-down. She flips it, but her eyes drift back to the terminal.

title: Bound Betrayal
description: A woman in white awakens to find herself captive in a twisted plot orchestrated by her husband's obsessed admirer.
context:
Title: Bound Betrayal
Description: A woman in white awakens to find herself captive in a twisted plot orchestrated by her husband's obsessed admirer.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

A woman in white lies on the floor beside the bed, her hands bound behind her back. She awakens gradually, confusion hardening into guarded awareness.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(hushed)
Is anyone there?

The bedroom door opens. SHANG XUE enters in a black dress.

SHANG XUE
You're awake sooner than expected.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(measured)
Shang Xue. I hoped I was wrong.

SHANG XUE
(smiling without warmth)
Don't worry. As long as you obey, I won't take your life.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(quietly fierce)
What does obedience look like today?

SHANG XUE produces a small vial, rolling it between her fingers.

SHANG XUE
Something to blur the lines between loyalty and instinct. When Yuchen sees the footage, he'll question everything he thought he knew about his perfect wife.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(struggling)
Don't come near me.

SHANG XUE steps forward and grips the Woman's jaw, vial ready.

SHANG XUE
I was his family. Before you made him choose propriety over blood. Swallow it. After he sees what you become, he won't want the reminder.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(steady)
The staff know I'm here. Any minute—
continuation:
SHANG XUE
(mocking)
The staff are enjoying their unexpected holiday. Your husband's orders.

A suited man (SUITED MAN) appears in the doorway.

SHANG XUE
(to SUITED MAN)
Mark the time. Authentic timestamps.

SUITED MAN
(nodding)
Camera's rolling.

SHANG XUE
Make it convincing. Nothing that leaves evidence.

The Suited Man approaches, removing his cufflinks with methodical precision. A phone on the dresser captures the scene.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(coldly)
He's paying you for performance, not improvisation. What's your actual price?

SUITED MAN
(pausing)
Some performances are their own reward.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(lower, urgent)
Triple. Before she pays you at all. Account numbers in my purse—check the lining.

The Suited Man hesitates, his eyes flickering toward the door.

SHANG XUE
(from across the room)
Don't entertain her games.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(to Suited Man)
She's already shown you you're disposable. Are you?

The Suited Man's hand stops mid-reach.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Inspector Xiangxiang
description: When a revered monk dies under mysterious circumstances just before a royal ceremony, a prince must uncover the truth behind the seemingly impossible suicide.
context:
Title: Inspector Xiangxiang
Description: When a revered monk dies under mysterious circumstances just before a royal ceremony, a prince must uncover the truth behind the seemingly impossible suicide.

EXT. FAHUA TEMPLE ENTRANCE - DAY

Guardian deities rise from morning mist, their stone eyes seeming to judge all who pass. PRINCE JING climbs the stairs, his folding fan snapping shut with a sharp crack. Behind him, INSPECTOR XIANGXIANG moves like a shadow.

MASTER MINGZHE waits on the landing, hands pressed in prayer, his bow perfectly measured.

MASTER MINGZHE
Prince Jing. The temple honors your presence.

PRINCE JING
(to Xiangxiang, barely a whisper)
Note how he doesn't ask why we're early.

(to Mingzhe)
Where is Mingkong?

MASTER MINGZHE
Urgent preparations for the Grand Ceremony detain him. He asked me greet you in his stead. Amitabha.

PRINCE JING
The Emperor's decree was explicit. The ceremony will proceed as planned. Time is not a luxury we possess.

MASTER MINGZHE
Indeed. The Grand Ceremony cannot wait. Please, this way—

A YOUNG MONK stumbles onto the landing, robes askew, breath ragged.

YOUNG MONK
Master Mingkong is dead! In his meditation chamber!

PRINCE JING
(still as stone)
By his own hand?

YOUNG MONK
His brush... still in his fingers. But the door was barred from inside!

MASTER MINGZHE
(voice faltering)
I spoke with him not an hour past. He was at peace. He said the temple's future was assured.

PRINCE JING
(to Xiangxiang)
Seal every gate. No monk leaves this temple.

(to the young monk)
Take us there. Now.

MINGZHE watches them go, his prayer hands tightening until knuckles whiten.
continuation:
INT. MEDITATION CHAMBER - DAY

Thick incense cannot mask the iron scent beneath. MASTER MINGKONG lies slumped over his writing desk, serene face frozen mid-gasp. A single candle gutters, wax pooling like a scarlet stain.

PRINCE JING enters, his fan held forgotten. XIANGXIANG moves past him, already studying the scene without touching.

PRINCE JING
Stand back.

XIANGXIANG
(leaning close)
The final character is incomplete. And see—the brush fell here, an arm's length away. No dying man throws his brush.

MINGZHE hovers in the doorway, prayer beads clicking rapidly.

MASTER MINGZHE
The ceremony... the Emperor will be—

PRINCE JING
The Emperor will have truth. Mingkong opposed the temple's new land grants. You signed them, Mingzhe.

MINGZHE's beads fall silent.

XIANGXIANG
(quietly)
Prince Jing. The ink is still wet.

Everyone looks at Mingzhe. His lips move in silent prayer. Or a silent curse.

EXT. FAHUA TEMPLE ENTRANCE - DAY (MOMENTS LATER)

MINGZHE stands alone before the guardian deities, watching distant figures seal the temple gates. A faint, satisfied smile touches his mouth. He pulls a folded temple deed from his sleeve—the land grants, bearing only his signature now. He tears it slowly, letting the pieces flutter away like ash.

title: My Cold Ex-Husband Pursues Me
description: A woman believed to be simple-minded marries a wealthy man, only to be betrayed and divorced while pregnant. After an accident, she awakens to her true identity.
context:
Title: My Cold Ex-Husband Pursues Me
Description: A woman believed to be simple-minded marries a wealthy man, only to be betrayed and divorced while pregnant. After an accident, she awakens to her true identity.

INT. WEDDING CHAMBER - DAY

A sumptuous Chinese bridal chamber. QIN NIANAN (20s), radiant in red silk, sits veiled on the marriage bed. Her fingers tremble slightly as she unwraps a candy.

MAID A
(arranging dowry)
Never thought I'd see Master Qin wed the... the simple one. Not with Miss Wanqing waiting.

MAID B
(urgent whisper)
Old Madam's dying wish. Said the girl's birth chart could save him. Now she's gone, he's stuck with it.

A candy slips from Nianan's grasp, rolling across polished floorboards.

The chamber door swings open. QIN WANGYAN (30s) enters, ceremonial robes hanging from his broad frame like armor. His gaze fixes on the veiled figure.

He lifts the red silk. Beneath it: Nianan's face—ethereal, unreadable, a porcelain mask of calm.

QIN WANGYAN's fingers brush hers. Nianan looks up, eyes impossibly clear. She offers the candy with the solemnity of a sacred rite.

QIN NIANAN
(softly)
Sweet. Like you might be.

QIN WANGYAN studies the offering. Something passes across his face—too quick to name. He leans in, kissing her deeply, almost desperately.

QIN WANGYAN
(against her lips)
Sweet.

QIN NIANAN
Sweeter than what you'll taste tomorrow.

QIN WANGYAN
(whisper)
Foolish girl.

CUT TO:

ON SCREEN: TEN MONTHS LATER
continuation:
INT. QIN FAMILY STUDY - DAY

Nianan, nine months pregnant, perches on the arm of Wangyan's chair, guiding his hand over her belly.

QIN NIANAN
(laughing)
There—did you feel? He knows his father.

QIN WANGYAN
(stiffly)
You're both fools, then.

QIN NIANAN
(undimmed)
The best kind.

QIN WANGYAN
Are you obedient?

QIN NIANAN
(earnest)
Always for you.

QIN WANGYAN slides a document across the desk. His signature already bleeds across the final page—a violent slash of ink.

QIN WANGYAN
Then sign this. For the child's future.

Nianan picks up the pen, studies the characters without comprehension. She draws each stroke of her name with a child's careful art.

QIN WANGYAN watches, jaw tight, fists tighter.

QIN WANGYAN
Qin Chao.

QIN CHAO (O.S.)
Master?

QIN WANGYAN
Take her to the estate. Tonight.

QIN NIANAN
(confusion dawning)
The mountain house? I'll wait for you there?

QIN CHAO enters—built like a vault, eyes like a grave. He takes Nianan's elbow.

QIN NIANAN
(struggling)
Wangyan, you said—you promised we'd be a family—

QIN WANGYAN turns to the window, showing only his reflection.

QIN WANGYAN
(to the glass)
I promised my grandmother I'd try. I never promised to succeed.

QIN CHAO hauls the sobbing Nianan out. Her candy tin falls from her pocket, scattering sweets across the threshold.

INT. BLACK LUXURY SUV - RAINY NIGHT

Nianan presses against the window, rain streaming down glass like tears. Her hands cradle her belly.

QIN NIANAN
(whispering a mantra)
Three days. He'll need three days to miss me. Then he'll come.

Headlights behind them—too close, too fast.

The crash is a scream of metal. The world tumbles. Glass explodes. Nianan's head cracks against the window.

SOUND EFFECT:
Piercing brake screech. Bone-crunching impact.

Blood ribbons down her face. In the shattered rearview, the other car reverses, vanishes into darkness.

QIN NIANAN (V.O.)
The candy taste. Blood taste. I remember—

MONTAGE FLASHES:
—A little girl in designer clothes, crying "I want my candy!"
—A woman's voice: "Never say your real name."
—Signing the divorce paper, the characters suddenly legible, suddenly obscene.
—Wangyan's kiss, his guilt, her knowing.

QIN NIANAN opens her eyes in the wreckage. Her gaze focuses—razor-sharp.

She touches her bloodied temple, smiles a predator's smile.

QIN NIANAN
(weak but venomous)
Shen. Yinyin. You forgot the family motto, little fool: never trust a Qin.

She spits blood. Her hand finds a surviving candy, crushes it in her fist.

THE END

title: Chu Yang
description: A poor but brilliant student faces his family's sacrifices to afford his education at a prestigious high school.
context:
Title: Chu Yang
Description: A poor but brilliant student faces his family's sacrifices to afford his education at a prestigious high school.

INT. CHU YANG'S ROOM - NIGHT

Dim lighting. CHU YANG, wearing a white tank top, is bent over his desk writing furiously, studying complex mathematical function graphs. A single candle burns beside him—electricity was cut off weeks ago.

CHU YANG (V.O.)
This proof could win the provincial competition. First prize: 5,000 yuan. Enough for three months of meals at school. But the entry fee is due tomorrow...

EXT. BLACK COAL MINE - DAY

CHU LAOHAN and a group of COWORKERS, wearing blue work uniforms and safety helmets, push wheelbarrows through the dusty mining area. His hands are wrapped in bloody bandages.

Lunchtime. The workers sit together eating. CHU LAOHAN's lunchbox contains only white rice.

COWORKER
Old Han, you won't even eat meat or vegetables. How will you have the energy to work? And those hands...

CHU LAOHAN
(laughing, hiding his bandaged hands)
Hey, I've got plenty of energy. Save the good stuff for my grandson.

The COWORKERS and CHU LAOHAN all laugh.

In the distance, TEACHER LIN rides up on an old bicycle.

COWORKER
(shouting)
Uncle Laohan, news from the school!

CHU LAOHAN stands up and walks toward TEACHER LIN.

CHU LAOHAN
Teacher Lin.

TEACHER LIN
(beaming, but with concern)
Uncle Laohan, your grandson has been accepted into the best high school in our province! But there's a complication—provincial education bureau requires a 3,000 yuan qualifying deposit for rural students. Due in three days.

TEACHER LIN takes out a blue acceptance letter from his bag and hands it to CHU LAOHAN. CHU LAOHAN excitedly takes it, his hands trembling as he looks at it.

TEACHER LIN
I've spoken to the mathematics department. If Chu Yang wins next month's competition, he could get an exemption. But the deposit...

CHU LAOHAN
(surprised)
3,000? That much? Xiao Yang's mother just had surgery. His father, Dahe, is taking care of her while working, but...

TEACHER LIN
I'm Chu Yang's teacher. Don't worry, I'll help figure something out too.

CHU LAOHAN
(eyes determined)
Xiao Yang is our family's hope. Even if I have to sell everything we own, I'll make sure he has the tuition. Three days... I'll find a way.
continuation:
EXT. CHU FAMILY VILLAGE - DAY

CHU YANG walks out of the house and sees several strangers carrying away their chairs and furniture.

CHU YANG
(rushing forward)
Hey, what are you doing? Why are you taking our things?

FURNITURE BUYER
Your grandfather sold all this to us to raise money for your tuition. Needed cash by tonight.

CHU YANG turns back in shock to look at his grandfather.

CHU YANG
(to his grandfather)
To send me to school, you've left our home completely empty. I won't go! I can win the competition and get the exemption!

CHU LAOHAN
What nonsense are you talking! The competition is next month, the deposit is due in three days.

CHU YANG
Grandpa, I can study at home on my own and take care of you. I can still get into university.

CHU LAOHAN
(anguished, holding up his bandaged hands)
Look at these hands, Xiao Yang. Forty years in the mines. Your father has the same cough I had at his age. We are already dust. You are the only thing we have that isn't. Don't make our sacrifices meaningless.

CHU LAOHAN has a short, wracking cough he can't quite hide.

CHU LAOHAN
Education is the only way out for our family. Not just for you—for all of us. So we can finally hold our heads up high.

CHU YANG's eyes moisten, deeply moved.

CHU YANG
(quietly)
I will study hard. I'll make it worth something.

CHU LAOHAN pulls out a stack of money from his pocket and presses it into CHU YANG's hands. A folded paper flutters out—a medical prescription for his grandfather's lungs, dated today but unfilled.

CHU LAOHAN
(insisting)
Here, take this. It's exactly 3,000. I counted it three times. Pack your things. Teacher Lin arranged a ride for tomorrow morning.

CHU YANG
(voice breaking, picking up the prescription)
Grandpa... your medicine...

CHU LAOHAN
I'll get it next month. After you win that competition.

They both look at each other, the weight of generations in their eyes.

title: After the College Entrance Exam, I Became Famous Nationwide
description: A man reborn from 60 years in the future must choose between revealing advanced technology or living a normal life as he faces the college entrance examination.
context:
Title: After the College Entrance Exam, I Became Famous Nationwide
Description: A man reborn from 60 years in the future must choose between revealing advanced technology or living a normal life as he faces the college entrance examination.

INT. DAXIA TECHNOLOGY EXPO - DAY

A packed auditorium. LI XIUXIU stands center stage, gown shimmering.

LI XIUXIU
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome. Thank you all for attending this Daxia Technology Expo. First, our distinguished guests.

She gestures to the front row.

LI XIUXIU (V.O.)
Professor Wang Chuan from the Daxia Research Institute.

PROFESSOR WANG CHUAN smiles and waves.

LI XIUXIU (V.O.)
Professor Li Feng from the Daxia Physics Research Institute.

PROFESSOR LI FENG retains a serious expression.

LI XIUXIU
And finally, the organizer, the youngest Nobel Prize nominee, Professor Xu Qing.

PROFESSOR XU QING sits, expression calm, phone in hand.

Audience whispers rise.

FEMALE AUDIENCE MEMBER A
I heard Professor Xu organized this for some unknown scientist.

MALE AUDIENCE MEMBER A
Rumors say he's mastered controlled nuclear fusion.

PROFESSOR LI FENG overhears, lip curling.

LI FENG
(muttering)
I heard lithography machines.

XU QING checks her phone: "Are you here? Today you will stand on the world stage. I'm waiting for you." Her mouth quirks slightly.
continuation:
INT. CHENG DENGMING'S BEDROOM - DAY

A levitating sphere pulses blue light. CHENG DENGMING watches the expo stream on his laptop. His exam admission ticket lies torn in half.

CHENG DENGMING (V.O.)
Reborn from sixty years forward. Should I reveal controlled nuclear fusion sixty years early, or take the college entrance exam step by step?

He zips the sphere into his backpack. The glow persists.

INT. CHENG DENGMING'S HOUSE - LIVING ROOM - DAY

CHENG'S FATHER burns incense before his late wife's portrait. The expo broadcast plays on TV.

CHENG'S FATHER
Dengming's mother, today our son takes your dream to Tsinghua. Bless him.

The doorbell rings. TEACHER WANG YONGCHANG enters with firecrackers.

WANG YONGCHANG
Time to make history!

CHENG DENGMING walks out, backpack glowing faintly.

CHENG DENGMING
Teacher Wang. Burn those for Mom. I'm not going.

CHENG'S FATHER
Dengming!

WANG YONGCHANG
Dengming!

CHENG DENGMING
Dad, Mom wanted me to live. Not just survive. I have to try.

He exits. The sphere's glow intensifies.

INT. DAXIA TECHNOLOGY EXPO - DAY

XU QING stands at the podium, staring at the entrance. Nothing.

LI XIUXIU
Professor Xu?

XU QING
(into microphone)
Cheng Dengming is saying goodbye to the life his mother wanted. So he can build the world she deserved.

She looks into the camera.

XU QING
Take your time. The future waits.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Top Scholar's College Admission Letter
description: A hardworking mother labors on a construction site to save money for her son's college tuition, only to suffer a tragic accident just as he brings news of his excellent exam results.
context:
Title: Top Scholar's College Admission Letter
Description: A hardworking mother labors on a construction site to save money for her son's college tuition, only to suffer a tragic accident just as he brings news of his excellent exam results.

INT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

LI QIUMEI, lean and weathered, hauls a cement bag across the muddy yard. She pauses, presses a hand to her lower back, then continues.

She kneels to stack the bag with trembling arms.

Two CO-WORKERS share a thermos nearby.

CO-WORKER A
She's been at it since dawn.

CO-WORKER B
Boss still hasn't paid her husband's settlement.

CO-WORKER A
Her boy's taking the exam this week.

The FOREMAN approaches with cash envelopes.

FOREMAN
Qiumei. Your day's wages.

LI QIUMEI
(grateful)
Thank you.

She counts the bills and folds them into a plastic pouch.

LI QIUMEI
(quietly)
One more month. Then he's free.
continuation:
EXT. SMALL ROAD - DAY

HE ZHONGWANG, a lanky boy in a faded uniform, clutches a red envelope, his face beaming.

HE ZHONGWANG (V.O.)
Scores blocked. First in the county. Top university.

He sprints past a vegetable stand, breathless with joy.

INT. CONSTRUCTION SITE - DAY

LI QIUMEI leans against a pillar, pulling out a worn photo of her son.

HE ZHONGWANG (O.S.)
Mom! Where are you?

She turns, smiling. Steps forward, slips on a metal plate. Grabs a work lamp—the cord casing is split.

She convulses once and drops.

HE ZHONGWANG runs into the site, sees her on the ground. The red envelope falls from his hand.

HE ZHONGWANG
(horrified)
Mom!

He rushes to her side, drops to his knees in the gravel.

HE ZHONGWANG
Mom!

title: The Devil Lawyer's Retribution
description: A ruthless defense attorney who never loses a case wins freedom for a murderer, only to face tragic consequences that force him to confront the moral cost of his victories.
context:
Title: The Devil Lawyer's Retribution
Description: A ruthless defense attorney who never loses a case wins freedom for a murderer, only to face tragic consequences that force him to confront the moral cost of his victories.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

JUDGE
The prosecution has failed to prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt. The defendant is acquitted of all charges.

The JUDGE strikes the gavel.

The DEFENDANT's handcuffs are removed. He smirks at the prosecution table.

PLAINTIFF 1 (pointing at SEAN, voice breaking)
You did this. You twisted the truth!

PLAINTIFF 2 (to the DEFENDANT)
You'll answer for this someday.

SEAN (gathering documents)
The jury made their decision. That's how justice works.

DEFENDANT rises, straightens his jacket. He leans close to SEAN.

DEFENDANT
(quietly)
Told you I'd see you on the outside. Same time next year?

DEFENDANT exits with his attorney.

EXT. COURTHOUSE STEPS - DAY

SEAN exits, immediately surrounded by REPORTERS and PROTESTERS.

REPORTER
Seventy-eighth murder acquittal. What's your secret?

REPORTER 2
How do you sleep at night?

PROTESTERS (overlapping)
Killer! Devil! Blood money!

SEAN checks his phone: three missed calls from the hospital.

REPORTER 3
Any comment on your nickname?

SEAN
(looking past them)
No comment.

A PROTESTER spits near his feet.

PROTESTER
You think you're above the law?

SEAN's phone rings. He answers.

SEAN
(barked)
What?

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Mr. Sean, your wife is in emergency surgery. You need to come now.

SEAN
(paling)
The baby?

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Hurry.

SEAN pushes through the crowd and runs.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

SEAN bursts in. LIN XIAO lies still, an oxygen mask on her face. The room hums with equipment.

SEAN
(softly)
Xiao?

LIN XIAO's eyes flutter open. She removes her mask with trembling fingers.

LIN XIAO
(whisper)
You missed it.

SEAN
I'm here now. That's what matters.

LIN XIAO
Our daughter... perfect. Dark hair like yours.

SEAN
(pause)
Where is she?

LIN XIAO
I lost too much blood. They tried. I waited...

SEAN
(frantic)
For what?

LIN XIAO
For you.

The words hang. SEAN stares, stricken.

LIN XIAO
Promise me... next case... make it someone who deserves you.

Her hand drops. The heart monitor's beep slows.

SEAN
No. Stay with me. Xiao!

The monitor's tone goes continuous.

DOCTOR rushes in, checks vitals, then stops.

DOCTOR
(quietly)
She's gone.

SEAN
You didn't—how could you not—

He breaks off, seeing the doctor's expression. He turns back to the bed.

SEAN
(to himself)
I silenced my phone.

- PLAINTIFF 1's tear-streaked face.
- The DEFENDANT's parting wink.
- SEAN's own hands, turning off his phone before closing arguments.

A NURSE pulls a white sheet over LIN XIAO's face.

SEAN remains frozen beside the bed, surrounded by machines that no longer need to beep.
full_script:
Title: The Devil Lawyer's Retribution
Description: A ruthless defense attorney who never loses a case wins freedom for a murderer, only to face tragic consequences that force him to confront the moral cost of his victories.

INT. COURTROOM - DAY

JUDGE
The prosecution has failed to prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt. The defendant is acquitted of all charges.

The JUDGE strikes the gavel.

The DEFENDANT's handcuffs are removed. He smirks at the prosecution table.

PLAINTIFF 1 (pointing at SEAN, voice breaking)
You did this. You twisted the truth!

PLAINTIFF 2 (to the DEFENDANT)
You'll answer for this someday.

SEAN (gathering documents)
The jury made their decision. That's how justice works.

DEFENDANT rises, straightens his jacket. He leans close to SEAN.

DEFENDANT
(quietly)
Told you I'd see you on the outside. Same time next year?

DEFENDANT exits with his attorney.

EXT. COURTHOUSE STEPS - DAY

SEAN exits, immediately surrounded by REPORTERS and PROTESTERS.

REPORTER
Seventy-eighth murder acquittal. What's your secret?

REPORTER 2
How do you sleep at night?

PROTESTERS (overlapping)
Killer! Devil! Blood money!

SEAN checks his phone: three missed calls from the hospital.

REPORTER 3
Any comment on your nickname?

SEAN
(looking past them)
No comment.

A PROTESTER spits near his feet.

PROTESTER
You think you're above the law?

SEAN's phone rings. He answers.

SEAN
(barked)
What?

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Mr. Sean, your wife is in emergency surgery. You need to come now.

SEAN
(paling)
The baby?

DOCTOR (V.O.)
Hurry.

SEAN pushes through the crowd and runs.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

SEAN bursts in. LIN XIAO lies still, an oxygen mask on her face. The room hums with equipment.

SEAN
(softly)
Xiao?

LIN XIAO
(whisper)
You missed it.

SEAN
I'm here now. That's what matters.

LIN XIAO
Our daughter... perfect. Dark hair like yours.

SEAN
(pause)
Where is she?

LIN XIAO
I lost too much blood. They tried. I waited...

SEAN
(frantic)
For what?

LIN XIAO
For you.

LIN XIAO

title: The Phoenix's Shocking Turn
description: Empress Xiao Yuhuan practices a secret technique to maintain the Emperor's favor, but her position is threatened when he brings another woman to his private chambers.
context:
Title: The Phoenix's Shocking Turn
Description: Empress Xiao Yuhuan practices a secret technique to maintain the Emperor's favor, but her position is threatened when he brings another woman to his private chambers.

INT. XIAO YUHUAN'S PALACE - DAY

Close-up shot: A hand places several brown eggs on an exquisite cushion.

EUNUCH (V.O.)
Her Majesty is practicing. Everyone withdraw.

XIAO YUHUAN, dressed in luxurious red robes, kneels on a prayer mat, attended by two PALACE MAIDS. She picks up a piece of red paper, skillfully unfolds it into a fan, then closes it and sets it aside.

CAIWEI picks up an egg, examining it with delight.

CAIWEI
Your Majesty, each one is perfect. The Emperor hasn't visited another consort in weeks.

XIAO YUHUAN
(eyes closed, focused)
The ritual binds his heart, but it cannot give me what I truly need. Fifteen years, and still no child. Without a son, these eggs are just... shells.

She touches her abdomen briefly, a flicker of vulnerability crossing her face before it hardens.

A PALACE MAID rushes in frantically and kneels on the ground.

PALACE MAID
Your Majesty! A woman entered the Hall of Mental Cultivation with His Majesty—she's been there since noon!

XIAO YUHUAN
(shocked, rising)
What?

CAIWEI
Your Majesty, he's never allowed anyone inside his private chambers, not even—

XIAO YUHUAN
(furious, but controlled)
I know what it means. He hasn't just taken a new concubine. He's given her a key.
continuation:
XIAO YUHUAN
Did you see her face?

PALACE MAID
She wears the jade pendant of the southern tribute dancers, Your Majesty. They arrived last month.

CAIWEI
(whispering)
The ones trained in the arts of illusion...

EUNUCH XIAO FUZI walks briskly into the hall and bows respectfully, his expression grave.

XIAO FUZI
Your Majesty, the Office of Imperial Bedchamber confirms: His Majesty will not receive you tonight. He has... requested privacy.

XIAO YUHUAN stands motionless. The tea cup beside her trembles from her shaking hand. She deliberately picks it up, studies it, then drops it. The shattering echoes through the silent hall.

She walks slowly to the window, her back to the servants. Her voice drops to a whisper.

XIAO YUHUAN
So. All the spells, all the offerings... broken by a dancing girl.

She turns, her face a mask of cold fury, but her eyes glisten with tears she refuses to shed.

XIAO YUHUAN
(to CAIWEI)
Bring me the book from the Western merchant. The one I told you to burn. And have the chief astrologer attend me at dawn.

She looks at the broken cup on the floor, then at the eggs on the cushion.

XIAO YUHUAN
(softly, to herself)
Shells can be broken. So can spells. And so can empresses... if they don't learn new tricks.

She sweeps past the kneeling servants, her robes flowing like blood, leaving them in fearful silence.

FADE OUT.

title: Hong Tian
description: An illegitimate son of the Qin family is brutally punished for secretly practicing martial arts, leading to his cultivation being destroyed and his expulsion from the family.
context:
Title: Hong Tian
Description: An illegitimate son of the Qin family is brutally punished for secretly practicing martial arts, leading to his cultivation being destroyed and his expulsion from the family.

EXT. QIN FAMILY COMPOUND - DAY

The Qin family plaza lies in suffocating silence. Guards form a perimeter. Servants watch from stone corridors.

QIN NIAN slams onto the central stone slabs, thrown by an invisible force. He lies still, then pushes himself up on trembling arms.

QIN YUANSHAN stands on the main steps, robes immaculate, palm glowing with violet-crimson energy.

QIN YUANSHAN
(cold fury)
You steal our secrets. Corrupt our bloodline. For that, you will return what you took—tenfold.

The energy blast strikes QIN NIAN, lifting him into the air. His body convulses. Blood sprays. He crashes down, unmoving.

On the steps, QIN NIAN's two brothers, QIN CHEN and QIN TIAN, watch. Qin Chen smirks. Qin Tian turns his face away.

QIN NIAN crawls to his hands and knees, blood dripping from his chin. His knuckles whiten against the stone.

QIN NIAN
(quiet, hoarse)
I earned this cultivation. With my own blood. My own nights.

QIN CHEN
(leaning forward)
You earned nothing. You stole. Like mother, like son.

QIN NIAN
(struggling to stand)
I called you brother. I meant it.

QIN CHEN
The word is not yours to give.

QIN CHEN flicks his wrist. Blue energy snaps across the plaza, cracking into QIN NIAN's ribs. He collapses with a gasp.

QIN CHEN walks to him, looks down.
continuation:
QIN CHEN
(contempt quiet)
Every time I had to acknowledge you, I felt sick.

He kicks QIN NIAN. Once. A cracking sound.

QIN NIAN curls on the ground. A laugh bubbles from his throat—low, then rising.

QIN NIAN
(between laughs)
I was wrong... I thought excellence could buy belonging.

QIN YUANSHAN
(dismissive)
Your mother was a weakness. You are its price. Without our name, you are meat for wolves.

QIN NIAN forces himself upright, swaying. He meets QIN YUANSHAN's eyes.

QIN NIAN
Then I renounce the name. And all its poison.

QIN NIAN
(softly, clearly)
I see it now. You fear me. Not what I've done—but what I might become.

QIN YUANSHAN
(pure rage)
You are nothing!

He hurls a final blast. It takes QIN NIAN in the chest, slamming him back. Blood mists the air.

In a daze, QIN NIAN sees a vision of his mother XU MENG, blood at the corner of her mouth, her face full of worry.

QIN NIAN
(whisper)
Mother... I'll bury them.

QIN NIAN's eyes become unfocused as he slowly falls.

title: Redemption in Darkness & Time's Gentle Warmth (Episode 69)
description: A bodyguard proposes to a woman haunted by a tragic past, triggering memories of betrayal and the loss of her daughter ten years ago.
context:
Title: Redemption in Darkness & Time's Gentle Warmth (Episode 69)
Description: A bodyguard proposes to a woman haunted by a tragic past, triggering memories of betrayal and the loss of her daughter ten years ago.

EXT. STREET - NIGHT

Rain sheets the asphalt. SHEN SHIYANG (30s) stands beneath a streetlight, arms open. Across the street, XU ZINAN (30s) approaches with an umbrella.

ON SCREEN: Redemption in Darkness

INT. BANQUET HALL CORRIDOR - DAY

SHEN SHIYANG and LU ZEMING (40s) walk down a marble corridor. SHEN SHIYANG wears black tactical gear; LU ZEMING, a tailored suit.

INT. BANQUET HALL - DAY

The hall stands empty. Morning light filters through tall windows.

SHEN SHIYANG
The arrangements?

LU ZEMING
Ready.

LU ZEMING picks up a massive bouquet of red roses from a service cart. Hands them to SHEN SHIYANG.

LU ZEMING
(indicating reception area)
I'll monitor from here.

SHEN SHIYANG
Alright.

SHEN SHIYANG walks toward the windows. LU ZEMING watches him go, his professional mask slipping.

LU ZEMING (V.O.)
Ten years. When does protecting become penance?
continuation:
INT. RESTAURANT - DAY

XU ZINAN sits by a window in a white dress, turning a wooden pendant over in her hands.

SHEN SHIYANG enters with the bouquet. He sets it down, drapes his jacket over a chair, then kneels, opening a ring box.

SHEN SHIYANG
Let me carry what you shouldn't have to.

XU ZINAN
(whisper)
Shen Shiyang...

She looks from him to the pendant. Her breathing shallows.

FLASHBACK

Ten years ago

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

YOUNG LU ZEMING (20s) strikes YOUNG XU ZINAN (20s). She stumbles.

XU ZINAN
Where's Nuannuan?

LU ZEMING
With someone who deserves her.

He moves to strike again. She flinches.

LU ZEMING
You forced my hand.

EXT. STREET - DAY

NUANNUAN (5) struggles as a masked figure drags her toward a white van.

NUANNUAN
Mommy!

A KIDNAPPER clamps a hand over her mouth.

KIDNAPPER
Quiet.

YOUNG XU ZINAN bursts from the building. Sees the van doors slam shut.

XU ZINAN
Nuannuan!

She runs. The van lurches forward, clipping her leg. She crashes down.

A sedan swerves, SMASHING into a dumpster. YOUNG SHEN SHIYANG (20s) leaps out.

YOUNG SHEN SHIYANG
Don't move!

He runs to YOUNG XU ZINAN. Blood seeps from her forehead.

XU ZINAN
(weak)
They took her...

Sirens wail, distant. The van speeds through traffic, gone.

YOUNG SHEN SHIYANG
I will find her. I swear to you.

He pulls out his phone, dialing with shaking hands.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Black Humor
description: A former rich playboy, now a waiter, serves his ex-girlfriend who has become a powerful CEO after he once supported her financially.
context:
Title: Black Humor
Description: A former rich playboy, now a waiter, serves his ex-girlfriend who has become a powerful CEO after he once supported her financially.

INT. LUXURY RESTAURANT PRIVATE ROOM - DAY

CHEN SHU (V.O.)
The campus beauty I once kept, now stands at the center of the world.

SU QINGWAN and a group of BUSINESS PARTNERS sit around a large round table, raising glasses in celebration. She wears a white suit and gold-rimmed glasses, exuding a capable aura.

CHEN SHU (V.O.)
And I am just a waiter in the private room.

CHEN SHU, wearing a waiter's uniform, carries a tray with a bottle of water, looking forlorn as he watches SU QINGWAN inside the room.

CHEN SHU enters the room and places the water bottle on the table in front of SU QINGWAN.

CHEN SHU
Your water.

SU QINGWAN picks up the bottle and examines it.

SU QINGWAN
You remembered.

CHEN SHU
(looking down)
If there's nothing else, I'll step out now.

SU QINGWAN
Wait.

SU QINGWAN puts down her empty wine glass.

SU QINGWAN
Pour the wine.

CHEN SHU
(hesitating for a moment)
Okay.

CHEN SHU picks up the decanter and begins pouring wine for SU QINGWAN. A male classmate at the table, QI RANDONG, speaks up.

QI RANDONG
President Su, whatever happened to that rich second generation who used to drive you around? The one with the Ferrari?

FEMALE CLASSMATE A
Chen Shu. He was so arrogant back then.

MALE CLASSMATE B
I heard his family went bankrupt senior year. Never even graduated.

QI RANDONG
The tables have turned. He probably has no idea the girl he "mentored" is now CEO of the country's largest tech company.

CHEN SHU (V.O.)
How could I not know? Su Qingwan was once my woman.

FLASHBACK - EXT. BONFIRE - NIGHT

Young CHEN SHU, dressed fashionably, plays guitar and sings for young SU QINGWAN.

CHEN SHU
(singing)
I'm only afraid I'll fall in love with you, maybe one day I won't be able to help myself.

FLASHBACK - INT. ROOM - NIGHT

SU QINGWAN wears a white dress, looking at CHEN SHU with sad eyes.

SU QINGWAN
My grandmother is sick. I need money.

CHEN SHU pulls her into his arms with heartache.

CHEN SHU
Three hundred thousand. I'll take care of you.
continuation:
INT. LUXURY RESTAURANT PRIVATE ROOM - DAY

The scene cuts back to the present. SU QINGWAN watches CHEN SHU pouring wine.

SU QINGWAN
I've wondered what he'd say. Seeing what I've become.

QI RANDONG
If it were me, I'd make him crawl.

FEMALE CLASSMATE A
He just had stinking money. Now President Su could crush him with a flick of her finger.

SU QINGWAN
Maybe I've been looking for him all these years. Not for revenge.

QI RANDONG deliberately extends his foot and bumps CHEN SHU's hand while he's pouring wine. Wine spills on the tablecloth. He immediately stands up and scolds loudly.

QI RANDONG
What are you doing!

CHEN SHU keeps his head down, silently enduring. SU QINGWAN watches coldly.

SU QINGWAN
(ice in her voice)
Qi Randong. Sit down.

She turns to Chen Shu. The room holds its breath.

SU QINGWAN
You brought this from the staff fridge. Not our VIP stock. Why?

CHEN SHU
(voice barely audible)
You always said it tasted better.

SU QINGWAN
I did.

She produces a business card, places it beside the stained cloth.

SU QINGWAN
My private line. Not a handout. A partnership. If you still want to take care of me.

She exits. Chen Shu stands alone, fingering the card. A ghost of a smile touches his lips.

SU QINGWAN
(ice in her voice)
Qi Randong. Sit down.

She turns to Chen Shu. The room holds its breath.

SU QINGWAN
You brought this from the staff fridge. Not our VIP stock. Why?

CHEN SHU
(voice barely audible)
You always said it tasted better.

SU QINGWAN
I did.

She produces a business card, places it beside the stained cloth.

SU QINGWAN
My private line. Not a handout. A partnership. If you still want to take care of me.

She exits. Chen Shu stands alone, fingering the card. A ghost of a smile touches his lips.
